metadata.novel_title: Simulation Towards Immortality In A Group Chat

novel_info.title: Simulation Towards Immortality In A Group Chat
novel_info.author: Ethereal Like A Dream
novel_info.summary: One day, Wang Ping joined a transmigrators' group chat, where each member could randomly transmigrate to different worlds and obtain their own exclusive cheats. Wang Ping thought he was about to reach the pinnacle of his life...“Wait, 60 out of 67 group members went offline? What happened?”“Ding, one group member was eliminated. Chen Kang, who joined the group chat at the same time as you, has died. He didn't survive for even ten seconds. All group members, please take this as a warning.”Wang Ping was stunned, instantly realizing that this transmigrators' group chat was a huge scam, with a high mortality rate among its members. Death could happen in the blink of an eye.Fortunately, Wang Ping awakened the Life Simulator!“Ding, Life Simulator activated, talent refreshing...”“Congratulations to the host for obtaining the golden talent—Holy Body, the legendary talent—Space-Time Celestial Body, and the legendary talent—Becoming Stronger By Taking In Disciples.”……………………………………………………………

chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1: Damn it! I want to leave the group!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Damn it! I want to leave the group!
"Unbelievable! I write so well, but I only have 56 subscribers! That's ridiculous!"
Wang Ping looked at his author's dashboard on the computer, where there were only 56 initial subscribers, and felt frustrated.
Just like his name, Wang Ping was merely an ordinary person in his ordinary life.
He had completed nine years of compulsory education and then went to college.
After graduation, he worked as a waiter and a screw assembler.
His girlfriend, who deemed him useless and aimless, had left him for another man.
This made him even more depressed and immersed in the world of novels.
Every time he saw an author posting something toxic, he would criticize that author, questioning their ability to write novels.
Then he heard that writing novels could make money, so he thought that after reading novels for so many years, it wouldn't be so hard for him to write one.
But there was no "then".
From the beginning, when he couldn't even write a sentence, to the point where he could finally write more fluently, he had spent so much energy and effort.
However, when his first book was published, it only had single-digit initial subscriptions, which almost made him collapse.
Although his second book had better subscriptions than the first one, the result was still disappointing.
Most importantly, he didn't have the money to stay in a rental apartment and focus solely on writing novels anymore.
"Sigh, it's true. No industry is easy."
Wang Ping looked at the instant noodles on his cluttered computer desk, took a puff of a cigarette, let out a deep sigh, and stared blankly at the ceiling.
Now he was 25 years old, and he had no idea how to live the rest of his life.
At 25, with no savings and being an orphan, marriage seemed unlikely for him.
If he were to get sick, it would be a catastrophe.
"This Earth OL is so bad, I would be better off not playing it!"
Wang Ping breathed out a ring of smoke and grumbled.
"Ding, Transmigrator Chat Group invites you to join. Do you want to join immediately?"
It was at this moment that a mechanical voice suddenly rang in Wang Ping's mind.
Then, a pale blue virtual luminescent screen appeared before his eyes.
On it were the options "'Yes" and "No"
"!!!"
This made Wang Ping snap back to his senses and rub his eyes, thinking that he might have had both hallucinations and auditory hallucinations.
However, even after rubbing his eyes several times without the luminescent screen disappearing, he couldn't help but get excited.
"Chat group!?"
"So it turns out that I am a winner in life with a golden finger. It's just that this golden finger has come a little too late in life."
Wang Ping excitedly rubbed his hands together.
Many novel protagonists were ordinary people who obtained golden fingers during their most desolate moments, which then led them to soar high in life and reach the peak of their lifetime.
He guessed that was probably his case, too.
However, a chat group storyline was somewhat outdated in the world of web novels.
Moreover, chat groups were usually a collective golden finger and not a personal one.
If it was a harmonious and helpful chat group, that would be great.
But if it was a highly competitive and scheming chat group, it would be quite troublesome.
"Whatever, even if it's a dark chat group, as long as I can lay low, reduce my desires a little, it will be fine."
Wang Ping thought to himself:
All he needed was to improve himself a little through the chat group, make some money and enjoy life in this ordinary world of his.
That's right, even after joining the chat group, he only wanted to live a more affluent, peaceful, and happy life.
Although this might seem a bit lacking in ambition, it was already much better than his previous life.
Of course, this was based on the assumption of joining a chat group with a not-so-good atmosphere. If it was a chat group with a great atmosphere, he would still fantasize about attaining extraordinary powers and immortality.
As numerous thoughts flooded his mind, Wang Ping chose 'Yes.'
"Ding! Congratulations on joining the Transmigrator Chat Group. The transmigration will begin in half an hour. Please be mentally prepared."
The system voice sounded, leaving Wang Ping stunned.
"Transmigration? What the hell is this?"
While Wang Ping was still in shock, new messages appeared in the chat group.
"Ding, congratulations to the 66th group member Wang Ping for joining the Transmigrator Chat Group."
"Ding, congratulations to the 67th group member Chen Kang for joining the Transmigrator Chat Group."
With the appearance of these two group messages, the group became lively.
Wu Jun (20): "Oh, two new members at once? Welcome!"
Liu Mei (15): "Two more unfortunate souls? Poor them."
Zhang Hu (5): "Silent tribute. I wonder if these two can survive."
Fang Yun (3): "It's tough. None of the recent ten newcomers have survived. It's really sad."
...
"???"
Looking at the chat content in the group, Wang Ping was a bit dumbfounded.
Huh!? What did these group members mean? Did people often die in this group?
Just as Wang Ping was about to speak, the other newcomer interrupted.
Chen Kang (67): "Senior transmigrators, what do you mean all the recent ten newcomers died!? Is this group a trap? Frightened.jpg"
Fang Yun: "Heh, you figured it out pretty quickly, knowing that this is the Transmigrator's Chat Group, and calling us senior transmigrators. Just as you said, this group indeed has a trap, and it's a huge one."
Chen Kang (67): "..."
Wang Ping (66): "...."
Zhang Hu (5): "You can see the order we joined the group through the numbers next to our names. Now look at the group member list and see how many names are still there."
Following Zhang Hu's words, Wang Ping hurriedly looked at the group list.
Then he saw a scene that made his scalp tingle.
Group members: 7/67.
A series of dark avatars and names.
This meant that out of the 65 previous group members, only five had survived?
This death rate was absolutely off the charts!
For a moment, Wang Ping felt numb, and a sense of panic began to breed within him.
He thought that a golden finger had come, but who would have thought that it was actually a death warrant.
Wang Ping (66): "....Can I withdraw from the group now?"
Chen Kang (67): "....Same question as the guy above."
Liu Mei (15): "Hehe, no can do. Once you've joined the group, there's no going back. Instead of being frightened, it's better to prepare for the transmigration in half an hour. That way, your chances of survival might be slightly higher. But of course, it's only a tiny bit."
Wang Ping: "....Why do you say that?"
Liu Mei (15): "The transmigration you're imagining probably involves soul travel, with a nice family, or at worst, is a classic orphan setting, right?"
Chen Kang (67): "Isn't that the case?"
Liu Mei: "Hehe, of course not. The real situation is that this chat group randomly selects a world and throws you into it. In other words, your identity is completely unrecognized. To the people in the Exoteric World, you're just a strangely dressed and possibly foreign-speaking, unregistered oddity. I don't need to tell you what the consequences might be."

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2: Time-traveler colleague defeated in five seconds!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Time-traveler colleague defeated in five seconds!
Chen Kang (67): "..."
Wang Ping (66): ".....Is this system so pitiful?"
Wang Ping's face twitched, and his heart grew more and more terrified.
Before, he was too naive, actually thinking that the worst-case scenario was that the chat group was dark and full of intrigue.
This chat group wasn't about being dark, it was a matter of life and death!
If he could, he really wanted to take back his words about Earth OL being a crappy game.
After all, at least he could survive there.
Liu Mei (15): "Do you think this is the most dangerous? No! The real danger is when you first travel through time. The location of the time travel is completely random. It could be in the sky, in the ocean, or in the mountains and forests. The chances of being in a town are relatively low. Moreover, even if you travel directly to a town, it's not safe, as people may think you're a monster. Of course, if you're lucky, they might consider you a god, but even so, whether you can survive depends on your IQ and luck."
Chen Kang (67): "...I TM..."
Wang Ping was dumbfounded as well.
He used to yearn for time travel when reading novels, but this real-time travel was too treacherous.
Just following Liu Mei's possibilities, he could understand why the mortality rate among newcomers was so high.
Wu Jun (20): "Ahem, Liu Mei, you don't have to scare them so much. In fact, each newcomer will randomly get their own Golden Finger after time travel. Although the Golden Finger is not the ultra-powerful type, it's somewhat helpful."
Chen Kang: "Really? What a pleasant surprise .jpg."
Wang Ping looked at his excited fellow newcomers, but he didn't share their optimism.
After all, if the Golden Finger were really useful, the casualty rate wouldn't be so high.
Liu Mei (15): "What's the use of comforting them? Even if they're lucky enough to get a powerful Golden Finger, they'll still die if their luck is bad at the beginning. Anyway, I've said everything I need to say. With the little time left, I suggest you change into some clothes and shoes that are easy to move in and buy as many compressed biscuits and mineral water as possible."
Liu Mei (15): "Of course, it's best to prepare protective clothing, firearms, and other things within half an hour if you can."
Chen Kang: "...Well, I'm just an ordinary person, so I can only prepare the simplest things. Thanks for the reminder from my predecessors, I'm going to prepare some food and drink now."
Wang Ping: "I'm grateful too."
Wang Ping also left his message, quickly changed his clothes and shoes, then dragged a suitcase and ran to the convenience store downstairs to shop frantically.
Eventually, under the strange gaze of the convenience store clerk, Wang Ping filled his entire suitcase.
Wang Ping returned home and packed his clothes, shoes, and pants into his backpack.
"There wasn't enough time, and I couldn't buy much."
Wang Ping looked at his suitcase and backpack, and sighed.
If possible, he would like to prepare the universal set of time-travel items such as potatoes and the like.
With these things, if he traveled to an ancient world, he would be very happy and content.
"Ding, time is up. Time travel begins..."
As Wang Ping was feeling helpless, the cold mechanical voice of the system sounded.
Then, Wang Ping was wrapped in a beam of light and disappeared instantly.
...
When Wang Ping opened his eyes again, he found himself on a muddy dirt road amidst verdant trees, and the chirping of birds in the woods was very pleasant to the ear.
In the distance, there was a village with smoke curling up, causing Wang Ping to be a little lost in thought.
A few seconds later, Wang Ping took a deep breath and finally came back to his senses.
He had really time-traveled.
However, his luck seemed to be good, as the location of the time travel was excellent: neither the sky nor the ocean, nor the wilderness, nor the town, but outside a village.
No one noticed his sudden appearance...
This was undoubtedly a relatively good start."
Just as Wang Ping was considering whether or not to go and check out the village ahead, the chat group system notification rang out abruptly, causing him to freeze.
"Ding, Group member Chen Kang (67) is dead."
"???"
Wang Ping's face was astonished, and he wondered if he had heard it wrong.
Chen Kang and he joined the group at the same time, the time difference was virtually nil.
That is to say, their time travel time was about the same.
He had just arrived for about five seconds, and Chen Kang was already dead?
This was too absurd.
Immediately, Wang Ping tried to mentally access the chat group.
In a flash, the virtual chat group page appeared in front of Wang Ping's eyes.
The group was lively and bustling.
Liu Mei (15): "Although I thought the newcomers this time would struggle to survive, I didn't expect a death within five seconds, breaking the record for fastest death."
Wu Jun (20): "Moment of silence, so tragic."
Zhang Hu (5): "I wonder where he time-traveled to and what the initial location was, that he died so quickly."
Fang Yun (3): "We'll know once the Death Replay comes out. By the way, how is the other newcomer doing?"
Wang Ping looked at the chat group and remained silent.
Well, there's even a Death Replay? The chat group system is so 'considerate'.
Wang Ping (66): "I ended up on a muddy dirt road by a small forest, with a small village in front of me."
Fang Yun (3): "Well, you're quite lucky."
Wu jun (20): "Indeed, among all the group members' starts, you're already in the top ten."
Liu Mei (15): "Newcomer, even though you've had a good start, don't be too careless. Otherwise, you'll still die. Once, there was a group member who had a similar start, but he ran into the village without any precautions. It turned out to be a goblin village, and he was tied up and roasted alive, dying a terrible death."
Wang Ping: "????"
Oh dear, was it that tragic?
He even got roasted and eaten by goblins.
The dangers after time travel are truly everywhere.
Wu jun (20): "Liu Mei is right, caution is key after time travel. Don't be careless even if you encounter beings that have a similar appearance to humans. After all, there are many cases of savages eating people. Even normal villages can be very unwelcoming to outsiders, let alone those in the worlds after time travel."
Zhang Hu (5): "Definitely. Quite a few group members have tripped up on this kind of thing."
Wang Ping (66): "It's so dangerous... No wonder so few people survive. By the way, how did you seniors manage to survive?"
Wang Ping was curious about the current situation of the five surviving group members.
Wait, speaking of which, there are five group members, and one of them seems to have never spoken up at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 3: The Variety of Ways the Transcendent Die!
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: The Variety of Ways the Transcendent Die!
Right then, Wang Ping couldn't help but glance at the group member list and noticed Cai Yonglong (1) at the top.
The first group member who joined and is still alive to this day, his luck is seriously tough.
Wang Ping couldn't help but feel a sense of admiration.
After all, the first group member didn't have anyone to guide him, and had to figure things out himself which must have been difficult.
One has to know that, before he transmigrated, if it weren't for the predecessors' reminders, he would never have known that transmigration involves so many twists and turns, and is so dangerous.
Wu Jun (20): "Uh, how did you survive... I transmigrated to an Earth-like planet several times larger than Earth, inhabited by humans with far more advanced technology. I was fortunate enough to transmigrate into a deserted alley. Although I am also undocumented now, my basic needs for food, clothing, and shelter have been met."
Zhang Hu (5): "I transmigrated to a magical world and got lucky enough to land in a Knight Academy. As it's a magical world, the existence of magic didn't frighten people. Instead, my sudden appearance aroused the interest of the academy's instructor. Adding the decent Golden Finger I acquired, I am currently studying at the Knight Academy."
Liu Mei (15): "I transmigrated to a world set in ancient times, living a life of luxury."
Fang Yun (3): "I also transmigrated to ancient times, but not an ordinary world. This world has martial arts, and I am currently working hard at martial training. My goal is to achieve greatness in martial arts, roam the Jianghu, and embrace a beautiful woman."
Wang Ping (66): "... everyone's situation seems pretty good."
Wang Ping was envious.
Although these four predecessor transmigrators had varying levels of difficulty, none of them faced a life-threatening situation, which was already better than many others.
After all, with so many transmigrators dead, those who can survive are truly lucky.
However, it seems that each of the predecessors' transmigrated worlds are different, and the type of world they can transmigrate to depends on their luck.
Wang Ping (66): "By the way, what kind of world did the number one transmigrator end up in, and why isn't he speaking up?"
Wu Jun (20): "If you're talking about Cai Yonglong, he transmigrated to the Profound World and became an Inner Sect Disciple of a powerful sect. He doesn't have time to chat in the group. If he has any spare time, he'd rather spend it on cultivation to become even stronger. After all, the Profound World is extremely exciting, but also very dangerous."
Wang Ping (66): "Alright..."
The Profound World is indeed dangerous, and one wrong move could be fatal.
However, the tremendous power of burning mountains and boiling seas and crushing stars with a single finger in the Profound World is also full of allure.
Moreover, most Profound Worlds allow people to pursue longevity, which is better than many other worlds.
Of course, when it comes to longevity, the most attractive world is the Cultivation world.
"Ding, the Death Replay of group member Chen Kang (67) has been recorded. Group members can click to view and learn from the experience."
At this moment, the group system's notification sound rang out, making Wang Ping's eyes somewhat peculiar.
However, he didn't say anything, and silently clicked on it.
In a flash, a virtual luminescent screen emerged, displaying the scene.
Chen Kang in the scene looked to be around thirty years old, and he was in a rural old house before the transmigration.
Similar to Wang Ping, Chen Kang also prepared many things in that half an hour, including seeds for various plants and fruits.
Clearly, Chen Kang had also read a lot of web novels.
Then the transmigration began.
Chen Kang appeared on a rundown street after the transmigration.
From a bird's-eye view, one could see that the street was full of monsters.
Wang Ping was quite familiar with the looks of these monsters—they were zombies.
There was a mutated zombie about four meters tall right in front of Chen Kang.
The instant Chen Kang appeared, the mutated zombie noticed him and grabbed him in one hand.
Chen Kang struggled in terror and despair, but to no avail, as the mutated zombie twisted his head off and devoured it.
It was as if a human was eating a twisted doughnut...
Watching the bloody scene, Wang Ping's face turned pale, and he felt uncomfortable in his stomach.
Chen Kang had it really rough.
In the chat group, everyone was watching the video and starting to discuss it.
Wu Jun (20): "It's too miserable, utterly miserable, he actually transmigrated right in front of a mutated zombie and was eaten like a twisted doughnut."
Liu Mei (15): "This is the danger of transmigration... The world and location of transmigration are completely random, and life and death depend on luck. Apparently, the new guy Chen Kang's luck is quite poor."
Zhang Hu (5): "It seems like it'll take a while for the group to have ten surviving members and unlock the group mission function."
Fang Yun (3): "Actually, I think it's better not to unlock the group mission function. With the nature of this chat group, the group missions are bound to be really dangerous, and one slip might cost us our lives."
Wu Jun (20): "You've got a point. However, even though the death rate is high, it's only a matter of time before we have ten members, so there's no need to worry too much. Otherwise, you'll get worn out from all the mental distress."
Liu Mei (15): "Wu Jun is right, it's pointless to think too much, just go with the flow. So newbie, try your best to survive and don't die as miserably as those other transmigators."
Wang Ping (66): "I'll do my best... bitter_smile.jpg"
Wang Ping felt a bit helpless.
Not having died on arrival after transmigrating was only just a beginning.
Next, he must ensure that he could stay alive for some time.
Even if he managed to stay alive, he still didn't know what to expect once the Group Task was unlocked.
Cai Yonglong (1): "This new guy, quite miserable, huh."
Suddenly, a chat message appeared in the group, and everyone was taken aback, then the chatroom heated up.
Wu Jun (20): "Wow, Cai Yonglong actually spoke up, I better start kneeling and licking."
Zhang Hu (5): "Silently peeking at the screen, while looking up to the big shot."
Liu Mei (15): "Hey, Mr. Cai, why do you have time to chat? Aren't you preparing for the Inner Sect Competition right now?"
Fang Yun (3): "Do you even have to ask? Mr. Cai must have finished his closed-door cultivation and his strength has soared, so he doesn't need additional preparation."
Cai Yonglong (1): "It's true that I finished my closed-door cultivation and my strength has significantly increased, but I can't say that I have much confidence in winning. o(*￣︶￣*)o"
Fang Yun (3): "Here he goes again. Can't you boast in a different way, Mr. Cai? Not much confidence means you have 99% assurance, right? (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻."
Cai Yonglong (1): "You underestimate me, your horizons are too limited. I've progressed to the 7th Tier of the Innate Realm and reached the 8th layer of the Earth Fiend Skill. My fighting capability rivals those of the Innate Perfection Realm. With 99% confidence, I can say that I'll be the champion in the competition."

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4: Golden Finger Arrives! Life Simulator!
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Golden Finger Arrives! Life Simulator!
Fang Yun (3): "???"
Wu Jun (20): "Wow, the boss is getting better and better at showing off."
Liu Mei (15): "I'm shocked, can only worship, ╰(*°▽°*)╯."
Zhang Hu (5): "Show-off offender, disdainful like a goofy dog.jpg."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Tiger, what did you just say?"
Group member Zhang Hu (5) withdrew a message.
Zhang Hu (5): "Bro, I didn't say anything!"
Wang Ping (66): "Wow, is it really that real...?"
Fang Yun (3): "How can it not be real in front of the boss? After all, the Innate Realm from the Profound World can easily destroy a street. Someone like Mr. Cai, a genius in the Innate Realm, should have no problem destroying a small mountain at full power."
Cai Yonglong (1): "It's not bad. The Innate Realm is just the true threshold for entering cultivation. By the way, Little Yun, what realm are you in?"
Fang Yun (3): "Just reached the Innate Realm. Meloncoly.jpg."
Cai Yonglong: "Oh, you're also in the Innate Realm, congratulations, congratulations. Laughing Fat Tiger.jpg."
Fang Yun (3): "I TM..."
Wang Ping (66): "Uh, they're both in the Innate Realm, but Fang Yun's reaction seems a bit over the top."
Fang Yun (3): "....."
Wu Jun (20): "Wang Ping, you seem to forget that Fang is from a Low Martial World, while Mr. Cai is from Profound World. Although both realms are called the Innate Realm, the gap between them is like the difference between heaven and earth. Amusing.jpg."
Wang Ping (66): "Okay..."
Wang Ping's gaze also became strange.
He almost forgot that Fang Yun had exposed himself as someone who had transmigrated into a Swordsman World.
Swordsman World and Profound World obviously cannot be compared. Although both realms are called Innate Realm, there must be a fundamental difference in name only.
Of course, the Swordsman World also has Low Martial, Mid Martial, and High Martial distinctions. The High Martial World is quite powerful, too.
Fang Yun (3): "I don't want to talk about it anymore, my mentality is collapsing, let's go."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Alright, I won't tease you anymore. Anyway, newbie, have you claimed your golden finger yet? Instead of wasting time in the group chat, you should hurry up and claim your golden finger and find a safe place to survive. After transmigrating, danger is everywhere, and you might be attacked by something weird while you're distracted by chatting and then die right away."
Wang Ping (66): "Uh, thank you for Mr. Cai's reminder. How do I claim the golden finger?"
Cai Yonglong (1): "Find the option to extract the golden finger in the chat group's function page and select confirm. Based on my experience, most golden fingers are of the optional type, but there are also some very good ones, good luck."
Wang Ping (66): "Hmm, I'll take your lucky words."
Wang Ping eagerly opens the chat group's function page and quickly finds the option to draw the golden finger, selecting confirm.
Then, a mysterious lake appears, with many drifting bottles in it.
Wang Ping sees this scene and gains some insight.
These drift bottles probably contain different golden fingers. What golden finger he selects depends on his luck and vision.
Immediately, Wang Ping struggles for a while and randomly chooses a drifting bottle.
"Ding, congratulations on obtaining your exclusive golden finger, Life Simulator."
Suddenly, the chat group system's prompt also sounded.
At the same time, Wang Ping's eyes also see a pale blue luminescent screen with some words on it, introducing the functions of the Life Simulator.
Life Simulator:
Function ①: The host can simulate once daily for free. After simulation ends, the simulation times refresh at midnight.
Function ②: Spend Spiritual Stones for special simulations with a 100% chance of obtaining simulation rewards.
Additionally, before starting the simulation, there is a chance to obtain a simulation talent.
However, the amount of Spiritual Stones needed for each special simulation increases with the number of simulation times.
Also, after completing a special simulation, the free simulation newbie benefits will disappear, and only one free simulation will be available every 10 days. Simulation times can be stored up.
"!!!"
Wang Ping looked at the functions of the Life Simulator and showed a shocked expression.
Goodness, it's actually a Life Simulator.
This kind of golden finger is the ideal one!
The simulator can help avoid danger and death and quickly increase strength!
"With the simulator, my survival ability is definitely top-notch. Now, let's simulate whether this village is safe or not."
Wang Ping's excitement, took several deep breaths to calm down, looked at the village with cooking smoke not far away, and chose to use the Life Simulator.
[Ding, Life Simulation begins.]
[After pondering, you choose to go to the village ahead, and to your surprise, the villagers speak standard Mandarin, making you very happy.]
[The village chief questions who you are and why you are here, you explain that you are a traveler and hope they will take you in. The village chief considers it and chooses to accept you.]
[You are overjoyed and take out some chocolate as a token of gratitude for the village chief and others. They hold the food but do not eat it. Sharp-eyed, you deduce that they are afraid the food is poisoned and can't help but eat it first.]
[Seeing you eat, the village chief and others relax and choose to eat the food. However, after the village chief eats the snack, his expression changes dramatically, and he exclaims that the food is poisoned and kills you on the spot.]
[This simulation is over, and there are no remaining simulations today.]
"???"
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content on the virtual screen, completely baffled.
What's going on? The cause of death is so strange...
He took out snacks in a well-meaning way to thank others but ended up being considered as poisoned and killed on the spot.
This death was baffling, inexplicable.
As Wang Ping was confused, a chat group prompt appeared in his mind, indicating someone was @ him.
With that, Wang Ping came to his senses and brought up the chat group page.
Fang Yun (3) @ Wang Ping (66): "How was it, newcomer? What golden finger did you draw? Let's have a look."
Wu Jun (20): "Could it be like me, drew a trash golden finger and went straight into self-lockdown?"
Liu Mei (15): "Golden fingers are not something to force, it's better to have one than none."
Zhang Hu (5): "Why do you guys just assume that the newcomer drew a trash golden finger? Couldn't they have drawn an awesome golden finger and be in a state of ecstasy?"
Cai Yonglong (1): "Tiger has a point. You guys are so negative."
Fang Yun (3): "Mr. Cai, do you have the right to say that? Face twitching, jpg."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Why don't I have the right? Righteous indignation.jpg."
Wu Jun (20): "Sob sob sob, Mr. Cai, search your conscience, and recall how you laughed at me when I revealed my golden finger back then."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Did I? Absolutely not!"
Wu Jun (20): "...."

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5: The Envy of the Group Members!
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: The Envy of the Group Members!
At this point, Wang Ping also spoke.
Wang Ping (66): "I drew an excellent 'Golden Finger.' Fortunately, I drew an excellent 'Golden Finger.' Otherwise, I might have died instantly. Tom shivering.jpg."
Cai Yonglong (1): "What do you mean? What happened to you?"
Wang Ping (66): "It's not about what has happened, but about what will happen."
As soon as Wang Ping said this, the chat group blew up instantaneously.
Fang Yun (3): "Damn, don't tell me you drew a 'Golden Finger' and now have the ability to foresee the future, so jealous.jpg."
Liu Mei (15): "Based on what the newcomer said, that's probably the case. Joining in the envy.jpg."
Zhang Hu (5): "Foreseeing the future, huh? Among the 'Golden Fingers' that have appeared so far, it could rank in the top three. The newcomer is lucky. His survival ability is maxed out."
Wu Jun (20): "So sour! I'm so sour! Why is only my situation so miserable! Boo hoo hoo, I'm so frustrated!"
Cai Yonglong (1): "Predicting the future, huh? Not bad, not bad, the newcomer has potential. By the way, what future did you see?"
Seeing everyone acknowledging that his 'Golden Finger' is foreseeing future, Wang Ping was taken aback.
His instinct was to explain that his 'Golden Finger' was not about foreseeing the future, but a more extreme life simulator.
However, Wang Ping quickly calmed down. Even though he was a homebody, he had several years of social experience and had read many novels. He understood well that one should not be careless about others.
So, he didn't explain.
Wang Ping: "This is how it goes..."
Wang Ping briefly recounted the content of the simulator.
Wu Jun (20):"Hmm, the village chief seemed decent at first, why did he suddenly turn his face and kill?"
Liu Mei (15): "So that's how it is, I understand now."
Zhang Hu (5): "Tsk, tsk, tsk. The newcomer is indeed fortunate. If he didn't have the ability to foresee the future, he would actually be done for. This is indeed a classic mistake made by transmigrators."
Fang Yun (3): "Yes. Differences in world views can be fatal."
Wang Ping (66): "So, what's the actual reason..."
The corner of Wang Ping's lips twitched.
These people were playing riddles with him, not stating the specific reasons, which was very frustrating.
Cai Yonglong (1): "You guys, do you enjoy bullying the newcomer?"
At this point, Cai Yonglong also spoke, which touched Wang Ping a bit.
Then, the next second, his expression froze.
Cai Yonglong (1): "To be honest, bullying the newcomer is indeed fun. Count me in. Amusing.jpg."
Wang Ping (66): "..."
Wu Jun (20): "I think we should stop playing riddles with the newcomer, or his mental state might collapse. That said, I am also very curious, o(*￣︶￣*)o."
Liu Mei (15): "It's simple. What you thought was a delicious modern snack is not so. Modern snacks are full of additives, preservatives, and all sorts of messy things. Even the ingredients have been sprayed with pesticides. There was a meme on the internet once. A naive transmigrator thought that giving the emperor instant noodles would make him linger for more, but in reality, they were accused of poisoning and were beheaded when they poured out the seasoning."
Fang Yun (3): "Liu Mei's analogy is quite right, but it's not completely accurate. Ordinary people in the olden times might not be able to taste any problems. But, in a world with extraordinary powers, one can easily sense whether the food they eat is toxic. Even the most powerful beings can determine this before even eating."
Zhang Hu (5): "The previous two have summed it up quite comprehensively. So, you know where you went wrong, right? At the same time, we can basically infer that the world you have transmigrated to isn't ordinary and is imbued with extraordinary powers. That village chief, he's definitely not a normal person."
Wang Ping: "..."
After watching the predecessors' remarks, Wang Ping was dumbstruck.
My goodness, this danger is everywhere, it's virtually unavoidable.
A small mistake could lead to death.
Who would have thought that chocolates are poisonous to people from other worlds?
Wang Ping (66): "What should I do now...?"
Cai Yonglong (1): "What can you do? Why not predict a future where you don't bring out the snacks?"
Wang Ping (66): "My 'Golden Finger' can only be used once a day...it refreshes the times at midnight."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Oh, once a day? Well, it seems that your 'Golden Finger' isn't as awesome as I thought. Nevertheless, it's still stronger than many other 'Golden Fingers'."
Liu Mei (15): "If you have the guts, you can simply go ahead blindly. Of course, I recommend you be more cautious and wait until midnight to refresh the simulation times."
Zhang Hu (5): "Liu Mei is right. Normally, you have to take risks, but since you've got the 'Golden Finger' for predicting future, there's no need to rush."
Fang Yun (3): "Have you guys not considered the possibility of being attacked by strange creatures when spending the night in the forest? Even close to the village, it isn't safe, is it?"
Wu Jun (20): "I remember...Number 36 was in this kind of situation, right? He hesitated for a long time about whether or not to enter the upcoming tribe, and then he was bitten by a poisonous bug and died instantly."
Cai Yonglong (1): "Little Wu is right, it's unsafe to stay outside. Ah, number 36, he died rather tragically. His 'Golden Finger' could arguably be the strongest 'Golden Finger' that has appeared so far. As long as he killed someone, he would become stronger. If he survived and developed, he would definitely become invincible in the future."
Fang Yun (3): "So, transmigrating is so dangerous. Even if you have a badass 'Golden Finger,' it's useless without luck. If you're supposed to die, you'll still die."
Wu Jun (20): "Stop talking. If you guys keep talking, the newcomer's spirits might just collapse."
Wang Ping (66): "..."
Wang Ping was truly dumbfounded.
My goodness, he originally wanted to wait until the simulation times refreshed before entering the village, which should have been safer.
But it doesn't seem so now.
This danger is everywhere...a slight carelessness could lead to death.
For a moment, his previous joy of obtaining the remarkable 'Golden Finger' life simulator instantly vanished.
In the novels he read before, the protagonist who obtained the simulator system could survive easily, then rise rapidly and dominate the world.
He thought his future was bright. Although the opening death made him rant, he still had fantasies in his heart.
It appears now that even if one obtains a powerful 'Golden Finger,' being complacent is not advisable.
One must pay attention to all details and must be cautious.
Zhang Hu (5): "The newcomer stopped talking, it seems his spirits have really collapsed."
Liu Mei (15): "You guys, always bullying the newcomer. We're all in the same situation and should be helping each other. Wang Ping, based on your previous description, I think the people in this village are quite good, otherwise they wouldn't have let you in. So, you can totally go to the village. Of course, this is my personal judgment, and whether or not to go, you still need to make the decision yourself."
Wu Jun (20): "I've been wronged. I'm a great big kind-hearted person."
Zhang Hu (5): "I'm also a good person. Innocent eyes.jpg."

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6: One wrong step, like falling into an abyss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: One wrong step, like falling into an abyss!
Next, Wang Ping didn't look at the antics of the people in the group but began to think seriously.
Indeed, according to the simulator's description, the people in this village were quite kind-hearted, otherwise, they wouldn't allow him to stay overnight in the village.
He was killed because his snacks were mistaken for poison.
If he didn't do that, he probably wouldn't die.
However, Wang Ping felt it safer to wait until the early hours of the simulation before deciding whether to go or not.
It can't be that he's as unlucky as No.36 Traveler.
But why couldn't something happen to him if it could happen to others?
He, Wang Ping, was just an ordinary person after all.
Although he was lucky enough to receive the Golden Finger for Life Simulator, which seemed to have good luck, was No.36 Traveler just unlucky?
"Let's go..."
Wang Ping clenched his teeth, fists tight, and made a decision.
Then, Wang Ping took a deep breath, walked slowly towards the nearby village, his steps heavy.
When Wang Ping came to the entrance of the village, two strong men dressed in linen at the gate noticed him, directly gripping their long spears, and stared at him with sharp eyes, shouting, "Stop immediately, give your name and origin, otherwise don't blame us for being rude."
Red Fire Village was just this big, and everyone knew each other well.
Wang Ping was a stranger, dressed in strange clothes they had never seen before.
Therefore, they naturally judged Wang Ping to be from another place.
Moreover, through Wang Ping's somewhat pale face and skin, and the lack of calluses on his palms, they could also judge that Wang Ping's identity probably wasn't ordinary people, most likely he was an outsider from the city with a very good life.
Finally, they could see that Wang Ping's strength was pathetic, and he probably couldn't compete with the children in their village, looking like an empty shell, completely like a weakling with a combat power less than 5.
This also made them label Wang Ping as non-threatening.
Of course, although Wang Ping wasn't a threat, they also couldn't let him just enter the village.
"My name is Wang Ping, I am a traveler who accidentally got lost in this forest and ran over here after seeing the smoke in the sky," Wang Ping quickly raised his hands and explained.
"You got lost in the forest? How could you dare to break in here alone?"
...
A few minutes after, the village guard came back with an elderly man with white hair and beard at the entrance.
Although the old man looked old, his eyes were bright and spirited, giving an excellent impression that made people doubt whether he was really an elderly person.
"Hello, my name is Wang Ping, and I accidentally came here. Please allow me to stay for a while, Chief, and I will repay your kindness in the future," seeing the chief's bright eyes staring at him, Wang Ping felt the pressure and quickly bowed his hands and spoke.
"Hehe, our village is far from the hustle and bustle, and few people can come here. You can come here safely and soundly, which means you have good luck, and it is also a little fate with our village. So, it's not impossible for you to stay for a while," the village chief looked at Wang Ping with a deep meaning and laughed.
"Thank you, village chief," seeing the village chief's agreement, Wang Ping sighed in relief, bowed his hands again and said gratefully.
"No need to be polite, just follow me, I'll find a place for you to stay."
The village chief nodded his head, turned around, and walked towards the village.
Wang Ping quickly followed.
After they left, the two village guards looked at each other and murmured, "It's really lucky for this kid to be a weakling, but he's lucky enough to run alone in the Black Wind Forest and not be eaten by monster beasts or bitten by poisonous insects."
The reason why few outsiders came to Red Fire Village was because it was located in the Black Wind Forest.
Although it was only on the outskirts, it was not a place where ordinary people could survive.
There were monster beasts and poisonous insects everywhere.
Not to mention a wealthy young master who couldn't even compete with the children in their village, even some powerful martial artists could die if they weren't careful.
This was still just the daytime in the Black Wind Forest. At night, it becomes more terrifying, with dangers lurking everywhere. Even an Innate Realm strongman would be in great danger if he didn't find a hidden cave to hide in before nightfall.
And now, there was less than an hour left before sunset.
...
The village chief led Wang Ping down the village road, attracting the attention of many villagers.
These people were mostly the elderly, weak women, and children. The number of young and strong men was relatively small, and they seemed to be guarding the village.
When these people saw Wang Ping, they all showed surprise and curiosity, looking at Wang Ping.
Some children even curiously followed along.
At this point, Wang Ping couldn't help but look around, very curious about the village.
At the same time, he guessed that most of the young and strong men in the village were probably out hunting, otherwise, there would be relatively few young men, mostly guards.
"Young friend, I don't know where you come from, but I'm quite familiar with the outside world," said the village chief suddenly, turning to Wang Ping.
At this point, Wang Ping came back to his senses, instinctively wanting to tell a random lie.
However, Wang Ping remembered that cultivators in the Profound World were not easy to deceive, and the village chief's gaze seemed to see right through him, putting pressure on Wang Ping.
After thinking for a moment, Wang Ping said, "I come from White River Town, and I am the eldest son of the Wang Family in White River Town."
There was no lie in this statement.
He did indeed come from White River Town, but it was the White River Town on Earth.
As for being the eldest son of the Wang Family, there was no problem either. He was the only child in his family, so it was no problem to call him the eldest son of a farming family.
"White River Town?"
The village chief frowned slightly.
He had never heard of this White River Town.
This was also very normal. Although he had some understanding of the outside world, he could only remember cities above the county level.
Villages and towns were too numerous in the Xia Dynasty for him to possibly learn about each one.
Besides, these places were not worth his attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7: Oh, those with kidney deficiency!
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Oh, those with kidney deficiency!
"If someone from the village goes out in the future, I'll have them take you away from here."
Then, the village chief shook his head and said.
"Thank you, village chief!"
Hearing this, Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
It seemed that the village chief believed his words, and the problem of his identity and background was barely resolved.
Actually, Wang Ping really wanted to say that he wanted to stay here for a long time.
After all, he knew nothing about this world now.
Once he left the village, he would be out on the streets.
Frankly speaking, it would be very dangerous.
However, it was already good enough that the village allowed him to stay for a while, and he wasn't in a position to ask for more.
...
"Big brother, what's in your bag? It smells so nice."
At this moment, a ten-year-old girl wearing a linen dress and with braids mustered up the courage to trot over. She pinched Wang Ping's clothes, staring at him with her innocent big eyes, her voice clear and melodious.
After the ten-year-old girl came over, the other children hanging behind seemed to have gained a backbone. They all surrounded Wang Ping, staring at him with wide eyes.
Some children even gulped, swallowing their saliva.
"..."
Wang Ping's expression froze under the children's gazes.
He still remembered the contents of the Life Simulator.
If they ate it, the outcome would definitely be very tragic.
After all, the village chief had nearly killed him after eating it, not to mention giving it to the children.
"This is a food from my hometown. Although it's convenient to eat, and it's fragrant and tasty, it's poisonous and harmful to the body. It's not suitable for children."
Wang Ping's brain was spinning fast, and finally, he chose to tell the truth.
"Poisonous, that's scary."
"Are all people from the outside world so stupid? They actually eat poisonous things."
"Grandpa said that if it's poisonous, don't touch it, no matter how delicious it is."
"Eating poisonous food affects martial training, I don't want to eat it."
As Wang Ping told the truth, the children showed disappointed expressions and then dispersed.
With that, Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief.
"Are all the people from your hometown so crazy?"
The village chief looked at Wang Ping, his gaze a bit weird.
"..." Wang Ping opened his mouth but didn't know how to respond.
"No wonder your body is so weak. It seems that it's not only because of indulgence in lust, but also because of this food."
Seeing Wang Ping's awkwardness, the village chief shook his head and spoke.
"Young man, don't be immersed in lust or the so-called deliciousness. Cherish your body."
"What the village chief taught is right. I won't do it in the future."
Wang Ping felt awkward and pretended to take the advice humbly.
Being pointed out that indulgence in lust had emptied his body was indeed embarrassing.
However, modern people indeed had many bad habits that were frightening, so he couldn't refute it.
"Village chief, do you think I can still practice martial arts?"
Immediately, Wang Ping asked with a hopeful face.
"The kidneys are the foundation of one's innate constitution, and your innate constitution has been severely damaged, which has a great impact on martial training. Moreover, you are old now, and it's too late to start training. Even if you force yourself to train under the immersion of medicine, you won't achieve much in the future, at most just strengthening your body."
The village chief glanced at Wang Ping and handed him a death sentence.
"...."
Wang Ping had nothing to say.
However, he didn't completely despair.
After all, he had the chat group and the Life Simulator.
There was still hope for martial arts in the future.
The seniors in the chat group had not necessarily been in a better situation than him before crossing, and now they were all on the path of cultivation.
Especially senior Cai Yonglong, who was doing really well.
"Of course, you don't have to be disheartened. There are benefits to martial training and benefits to being an ordinary person. As for different life paths, there is no absolute better or worse."
"Sometimes, living a peaceful life is better than entering the World of cultivators and fighting every day."
Seeing Wang Ping's silence, the village chief comforted him.
"The village chief is right. But this experience has taught me the importance of martial training, so I will still work hard to train in martial arts. I have also heard of some people who started practicing martial arts in their middle age, had good luck and obtained precious medicinal treasures, and achieved extraordinary success in the end."
Wang Ping first nodded humbly, and then seriously said.
"Your narrow escape from death is indeed a lesson, and it's safer to have strength by your side when traveling in the Jianghu. As for the medicinal treasures you mentioned, it all depends on your fate. If your fate is good and you obtain some elixirs that can make up for your innate constitution and improve your qualifications, you may achieve something in the future."
The village chief nodded, approving Wang Ping's words.
Of course, he didn't think Wang Ping could obtain such treasures.
After all, these heavenly and earthly Spirit items were things that could be met but could not be sought after.
"Alright, you can stay here. Meanwhile, help this old man take care of a child."
During their conversation, the village chief stopped in front of a very simple courtyard.
Wang Ping looked around and saw four chickens and three ducks in the courtyard.
In addition, there was a yellow dog rolling on the ground, playing with a big goose.
"A child?"
Wang Ping looked puzzled at the village chief.
"Yes, he is called Chifeng. His parents died in a hunting accident. Due to the sudden departure of his parents, he suffered excessive grief and became silent and reticent, staying in the house all day."
The village chief nodded and spoke.
"You are from the outer world and should be an educated person who has read books. I hope you can help me enlighten this child."
Wang Ping was surprised how the village chief could tell that he had read books.
However, Wang Ping didn't have any intention to ask further and nodded, saying, "Since the village chief has entrusted me, I will do my best."
"Hmm."
The village chief nodded and pushed open the fence, leading Wang Ping in.
When Wang Ping and the village chief walked into the simple wooden house, they saw a thin boy, who looked about eight years old, sitting in a chair and staring blankly, apparently lost in thought.
Even when Wang Ping and the village chief walked in, Chifeng just glanced at them and didn't greet them, continuing to lower his head and stare blankly.
"Chifeng, Grandpa has brought a guest for you. He will stay here for a while and can tell you about the outside world."
Seeing Chifeng's appearance, the village chief sighed inwardly. He then showed a kind smile, walked over, and touched Chifeng's head.
It was only then that Chifeng reacted somewhat.
However, Chifeng quickly lowered his head and said with a hoarse voice, "I don't want to know about the outside world. I just want my parents to come back."
Hearing this, the village chief gave a bitter smile.
The child was too stubborn, and no matter how they tried to persuade him, it wouldn't work.
But considering the sudden death of both of his parents, the blow to a child was indeed great, so it was understandable that he couldn't walk out of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 8: Divine Fire in the Pupil!
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Divine Fire in the Pupil!
"Once a person is dead, they cannot come back. However, I have heard that if you practice martial arts to the utmost, you can become like an immortal, capable of reversing time and bringing people back to life. I believe your parents wouldn't want you to waste your life being so dispirited. If you work hard in martial training, your parents in the afterlife will feel relieved. And if you achieve the peak of martial arts, there may be a possibility to reverse time and resurrect your parents."
At this moment, Wang Ping thought for a moment and spoke to comfort him.
Upon hearing these words, the village chief was stunned and gave Wang Ping a deep look.
He had initially thought that Wang Ping was just an ordinary rich young man, but he didn't expect him to say such profound words.
He was unsure if cultivating martial arts to the extreme could reverse time and bring living beings back to life.
However, he had indeed heard rumors of forbidden places in this world where resurrection of living beings was possible.
"Big brother, is it true? Can martial training really bring my parents back to life?"
At this time, Chifeng also reacted and looked at Wang Ping with hopeful eyes.
"Although I cannot guarantee that it can be done, there is definitely hope."
Wang Ping replied with some lack of confidence.
He had no idea about the situation and cultivating system of this world. His words were merely the result of reading too many novels.
However, although Wang Ping was not confident, the child didn't dwell on it and couldn't notice the change in Wang Ping's tone.
Chifeng deeply remembered one thing.
That is, to practice martial arts, as long as he works hard, he could resurrect his parents, just that.
"I will work hard in martial training! I must reach the Martial Peak and bring my parents back to life!"
Chifeng clenched his fists, and the previously dull and lifeless eyes regained their luster, becoming bright and spirited, as if a flame was burning within them.
Looking at such eyes, Wang Ping even doubted if he was seeing things, as he seemed to see a flame.
"Wang Ping, thank you so much this time."
Seeing Chifeng regain his fighting spirit and even setting such a surprising goal, the village chief also showed a relieved smile and thanked Wang Ping.
Although it is almost impossible for Chifeng to reach the Martial Peak,
Moreover, due to certain reasons, it is extremely difficult for them, as a clan, to break through to the Innate Realm and beyond.
But as long as Chifeng could regain his spirit, that would be enough.
After all, he was still young. When he grew up, even if he found out that reality was cruel, it wouldn't matter anymore.
"You're welcome. After all, you took me in, and I really want to do something for the village."
Wang Ping touched his head and smiled.
"If you don't mind, you can live here for as long as you want, and I will do my best to teach you martial training. Of course, if you want to leave, I will also arrange for someone to take you home."
The village chief nodded and looked at Wang Ping with an incredibly kind gaze.
"I want to stay here for a while longer."
Upon hearing these words, Wang Ping was overjoyed and quickly said.
No kidding, he didn't want to leave.
In this world, he was completely undocumented, and even with the simulator, he would still have a high chance of death if he wandered outside.
After all, the simulator could only be used once a day, and it was impossible to cover all the details.
Sometimes, there would also be a butterfly effect.
The main point was that the current Life Simulator could not help him become stronger.
Therefore, from any perspective, staying in this village was the safest option.
The village chief looked deeply at Wang Ping, then laughed and said, "Since you want to stay here, stay here. Whenever you want to leave, just let me know."
"Okay!" Wang Ping nodded.
"Chifeng, from now on you will live with Wang Ping. Don't cause trouble for him, understand?"
The village chief looked at Chifeng again and instructed him.
"Grandpa Village Chief, don't worry, I won't cause any trouble for big brother."
Chifeng muttered.
"Haha, Chifeng is the most sensible." The village chief stroked his long white beard, laughed out loud, and happily left the place.
"Big brother, you came from the outer world, hurry up and tell me stories from the outer world!"After the village head left, Chifeng pulled Wang Ping with a hopeful look on his face.
"I thought you said you weren't interested?" Wang Ping teased.
"I-I am interested, just didn't have the mood earlier..." Chifeng's slightly dirty face turned red, and he said awkwardly.
"Haha, I understand." Wang Ping laughed.
However, he found himself in a difficult situation again.
After all, he was not from this world. He was just an ordinary transmigrator. If he talked about the outer world, he would surely expose himself.
"Right, let me tell you some stories instead."
Wang Ping thought for a moment and spoke.
He didn't know much about the outer world, so to satisfy Chifeng's request, he could only bring up the stories from the novels he had read before.
"Stories? What stories?"
Chifeng asked curiously.
"A story called Battle Through the Heavens..."
Wang Ping spoke slowly, smiling at the corner of his mouth.
With that, an hour passed, and Chifeng listened with bright eyes and rapt attention.
It wasn't until the sky darkened and a loud commotion came from outside that Wang Ping stopped.
"Wang Ping, is there more? Does Xiao Yan regain his fighter's cultivation?"
Upon seeing Wang Ping stop, Chifeng couldn't help but anxiously ask.
He was captivated by the story and waited for Xiao Yan to regain his cultivation and surprise everyone, only for Wang Ping to suddenly stop. Chifeng felt a little frustrated.
"He successfully broke through to become a fighter."
Wang Ping nodded.
Hearing this, Chifeng's eyes brightened, and he said admiringly, "He really succeeded. Xiao Yan is so strong."
Going from a genius to a waste, being abandoned in a marriage, and then quickly rising again, it was truly inspiring.
"By the way, Chifeng, with all this commotion outside, it must be the hunters from your village returning."
Wang Ping looked outside and said.
"Yes. The hunting team in our village usually hunts once every three days, leaving in the morning and returning at dusk."
Chifeng nodded and spoke admiringly.
"Wang Ping, let me tell you, the hunters in our hunting team are the strongest people in our village. Their cultivation is all in the Post-Heaven Realm, and the team leader is even in the Innate Realm, very powerful. My dream used to be to become the leader of the hunting team."
"Post-Heaven Realm? Innate Realm?"
Wang Ping was taken aback.
It was the Innate Realm again.
Both Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun in the group chat were from worlds with Innate Realms, and he wasn't expecting that his world would also have such a concept.
"Chifeng, do you know the specifics of the cultivation level divisions?"
Wang Ping asked curiously.
"Strange, Wang Ping, don't you know the divisions of cultivation levels?"
Chifeng looked at Wang Ping, his innocent eyes full of confusion.
"I'm just a scholar, I don't know much about martial arts. I want to learn more in detail." Wang Ping shook his head and said.
"I see." Chifeng nodded, not thinking too much, and explained earnestly: "Grandpa Village Head once said that there are three realms in cultivation: Body Refining, Post-Heaven, and Innate."
"The first realm, the Body Refining Stage, consists of Muscle Training, Skin Training, Bone Refining, Meridian Opening, and Viscera Training. Viscera Training is the hardest."
"The second realm is called the Post-Heaven Realm. After refining the internal organs, one can condense True Qi."
"After the Post-Heaven Realm comes the Innate Realm. Grandpa Village Head said that only when one reaches the Innate Realm can they truly begin cultivation. Upon breaking through the Innate Realm, one can shed their impurities, Cleanse Marrow, and return to their innate pure body. At that time, not only can one live without eating, but their strength will also undergo a qualitative change, and their lifespan can be extended to 200 years."
"As for the realms beyond Innate Realm, Grandpa Village Head never mentioned it, and I don't know either."
Chifeng scratched his head, explained again, and by the end, he too felt somewhat embarrassed, yet yearning for levels beyond the Innate Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9: Cursing me to death, it’s simply toxic!
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Cursing me to death, it's simply toxic!
"I see."
Wang Ping nodded at Chifeng's answer, not surprised.
Chifeng was just a child, everything he knew was from the village elder, so it was impossible for him to understand everything.
Even the village elder might not be familiar with the situation beyond the Innate Realm.
It was surprising enough for Wang Ping that a village elder was aware of the details of the three major realms.
This also indirectly showed how extraordinary the village elder and this village were.
"Big brother, let's go and meet the hunting party. I tell you, every return of the hunting party is the most lively time in the village, there's never-ending meat to eat!"
At this moment, Chifeng dragged Wang Ping out, his throat rolling, swallowing saliva, appearing gluttonous.
At this, Wang Ping staggered, nearly fell down, could only say helplessly: "Chifeng, I can walk on my own, you dragging me like this, I might trip easily."
It sounded embarrassing for him to admit that he, an adult, might not be able to keep up with a child.
However, considering that this was a world with extraordinary power, Wang Ping was at peace with it.
"I'm sorry." Hearing Wang Ping's words, Chifeng stopped in embarrassment, scratched his hair and said, "I forgot that big brother, you're just a scholar, feeble and delicate."
"..." Wang Ping's face twitched.
Although this was just a child's unintentional remark, it was indeed quite embarrassing.
He made up his mind to come up with ways to become stronger!
As a man, he absolutely couldn't be seen as weak and sickly!
...
Soon, Wang Ping followed Chifeng to the village entrance.
The village entrance was bustling at this time.
All the villagers were here, welcoming the hunting party.
Wang Ping looked around and was shocked.
The members of the hunting squad were men over two meters tall, wearing beast skins, with all kinds of prey beside them.
These prey were all oddly shaped, and generally as big as an elephant.
Most importantly, even though these prey were dead, they gave him a strong sense of danger.
This feeling, to describe it, was as if he was alone in the wilderness facing a hunting tiger. It was heart-pounding.
"The uncles and aunts of the hunting squad are truly amazing. This time's hunting gains are so huge. They even caught a black wind leopard, a massive 5th-tier demonic beast that is as strong as the Innate Realm!"
Chifeng looked at the strong members of the hunting squad and their prey, speaking with a face full of admiration.
Hearing Chifeng's words, Wang Ping couldn't help but be surprised.
Hunting a 5th-tier demonic beast comparable to the Innate Realm?
The information in this statement was shocking.
Although Wang Ping knew this village was extraordinary, he didn't expect it to be so powerful, capable of hunting beasts from the Innate Realm.
At the same time, Wang Ping felt incredibly fortunate and terrified.
Since this village was so powerful, and they hunted beasts from the Innate Realm in this forest, one could imagine how dangerous this forest was.
If he had decided to survive a night outside the village, waiting for the life simulator's simulation times to reset, he would probably have ended up as miserable as No. 36 Traveler.
Luckily, he gathered his courage and made the right choice, otherwise the consequences would have been unthinkable.
"Indeed, even having something as powerful as the life simulator, I can't guarantee my own safety, danger truly is everywhere."
Wang Ping gave a bitter smile, and his understanding of the dangers of traversing has deepened once again.
"Chifeng, you're finally willing to go out... I apologize, it's my fault that I couldn't protect your parents."
Just then, a strong man carrying a large sword walked over, touched Chifeng's head and said remorsefully.
"It's not Uncle Chi Hu's fault. My father and mother chose themselves to stay behind... They are the pride of the village. Besides, I have decided to climb to the Martial Peak and resurrect my parents."
Chifeng clenched his fist, speaking with a determined face.
Chih Hu sighed inwardly and said, "Hmm, then you should practice your martial skills diligently. I will train you strictly."
Climbing to Martial Peak and reviving his parents sounds impossible even thinking about it.
Of course, since Chifeng had finally become strong, he wouldn't ruthlessly shatter the child's illusion.
"You're Wang Ping, right? The village chief told me about you, thank you for what you did for Chifeng. In this village, I'm the one who teaches martial arts to the children. If you want to learn martial arts, come to the Drill Ground tomorrow with Chifeng."
Chih Hu then looked at Wang Ping and spoke warmly.
"If Brother Chih Hu says so, then I won't stand on ceremony."
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping gave a light laugh and gave a bow with his hands.
"Of course, there's no need for courtesy. However, you have to be prepared, my training is very rigorous, and it may be too hard for you. Of course, with medicinal potions and monster beast flesh to nourish you, you certainly won't die."
Chih Hu grinned, slapping Wang Ping on his shoulder.
"...."
Wang Ping's face stiffened, feeling a sense of foreboding.
However, even though he felt the coming days would be misery, he's determined to become stronger through martial training and have the ability to protect himself, he didn't intend to back down at all.
Then, under the enthusiastic lead of Chih Hu, Wang Ping came to know many people in the village.
The sky gradually darkened, the moon hanging high, the forest occasionally echoed with the chirping of birds and insects, and the roars of monsters.
The thirty hunters in the village were all drinking heavily, discussing their hunting expriences.
The children were playing happily.
Chifeng was among them.
And the women and elderly people in the village were all cooking, dealing with the monster meat, preparing a hearty feast.
As for the rice, it was already being cooked before Wang Ping entered the village, ready to be eaten straight away.
Seeing all this, Wang Ping inexplicably felt a sense of warmth and security.
"Even though there is danger everywhere, I'm really lucky. After traversing, I was able to live in a village like this right away."
Wang Ping couldn't help but sigh.
Afterwards, Wang Ping opened the chat group, wanting to see if there were any messages.
As Wang Ping opened the chat group, he found that people were mentioning him and discussing him to varying degrees.
Wu Jun (20): "@Wang Ping so many times and he hasn't appeared, has something really happened to him?"
Liu Mei (15): "The number of survivors in the group hasn't decreased, which means he's not dead. Of course, it doesn't rule out the possibility of being stung by a poisonous bug and fainting, now waiting to die."
Fang Yun (3): "Newbie Aha, my newbie, your death is so miserable. This time's newbies are wiped out again, it's too tragic."
Zhang Hu (5): "Let's wait a bit more. Perhaps in a while, we'll get a system prompt and then we could use the death replay."
...
Looking at the chat group messages, Wang Ping's forehead vein popped.
Immediately, he responded in the chat.
Wang Ping (66): "Can you all stop? I didn't respond for just an hour or two, and you guys are here cursing my death, that's simply toxic."

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 10: Simulating Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Simulating Again
Zhang Hu (5): "Huh, the newbie has spoken. He didn't die."
Fang Yun (3): "What the hell, he actually didn't die. I thought you were a goner."
Wu Jun (20): "The boss is so cunning, we weaklings are shivering.jpg."
Wang Ping (66): "....."
Liu Mei (15): "So, Wang Ping, did you make it to the village?"
Wang Ping (66): "It turns out the forest I was in was the Mystical Beast Forest. If I hadn't reached the village, I think I'd be dead by now..."
Liu Mei (15): "Honestly speaking, your luck is pretty good, and you showed some courage; otherwise, you would indeed have died. However, you can't be careless. Even in the village, there's no guarantee your life will be safe. Just remember to be careful in everything."
Wang Ping (66): "Okay! Thanks for the reminder, Sister Liu Mei!"
Wang Ping looked at Liu Mei's avatar and felt a strong sense of security.
In the chat group, although Liu Mei had a sharp tongue at the beginning, she has been helping the newbies all along. She's got a great personality.
Liu Mei (15): "You're welcome. As transmigrators, we're all drifting in the Exoteric World, and our lives are unpredictable. Helping each other is what we should do."
Wang Ping looked at Liu Mei's words and felt emotional.
Just look at this, this is what the best members should say. The likes of Zhang Hu and Fang Yun are way too cunning.
Wang Ping (66): "By the way, what are your Golden Fingers? Curious baby.jpg."
Immediately, Wang Ping recalled the scene when Wu Jun wanted to cry because of his own Golden Finger, and couldn't help but ask curiously.
Liu Mei (15): "As for me, my Golden Finger is One-click Makeup... I can adjust my appearance freely. Thanks to this Golden Finger, I'm now the Emperor's favorite concubine."
Wang Ping (66): "(⊙o⊙)…"
Wang Ping's eyes were a bit subtle.
Well, there's even such a Golden Finger? Truly an eye-opener.
Fang Yun (3): "My Golden Finger is quite ordinary, it just helps speed up my cultivation. Seriously, compared to your Golden Fingers, I'm too weak. Envious eyes.jpg."
Zhang Hu (5): "Knight's Blessing. I don't want to talk about the specifics."
Wu Jun (20): "..."
Wang Ping (66): "There really are all kinds of Golden Fingers, huh? What are Wu's and Mr. Cai's?"
Wang Ping didn't fully believe the others.
After all, he had kept some things to himself, so the others might have as well.
Golden Fingers are their biggest trump cards and secrets, and no normal person would reveal them lightly.
Wu Jun (20): "We don't know what Mr. Cai's Golden Finger is. As for mine, can I not say it? o(╥﹏╥)o"
Wang Ping (66): "Just say it. It's not like you're going to get pregnant."
Zhang Hu (5): "Not getting pregnant? Amusing.jpg."
Fang Yun (3): "I'm dying of laughter. It really would get pregnant."
Wang Ping: "?!?!"
Wang Ping was taken aback.
What kind of Golden Finger is that? It actually can get pregnant.
This is just too outrageous.
Wu Jun (20): "!!! "
Wu Jun (20): "Don't talk about it! If you say it, I'll break off relations with you!"
Liu Mei (15): "Don't overdo your jokes. And didn't we promise not to tell anyone? One must keep one's word."
Wu Jun (20): "Woo, Sister Liu Mei is always reliable. You're like my real sister!"
Fang Yun (3): "Don't worry, we won't say anything."
Zhang Hu (5): "As an honorable knight, I obviously won't take pleasure in other people's pain."
Wang Ping (66): "..."
I don't believe any of you. Both of you are cunning and mischievous.
Soon, Wang Ping continued to chat in the group for a while before logging off.
It was dinner time, and the monster beast meat was ready.
"This is 1st-tier Mystical Beast Meat. Eating it will be very beneficial to you. However, your body is too weak, and the tonics will be too much for you, so you can't eat too much."
The village head brought a bowl of rice and a small plate of meat in front of Wang Ping and spoke.
"Thank you, village head."
Wang Ping accepted the food, expressing his gratitude.
Next, Wang Ping couldn't help but eat with gusto.
No doubt, this Mystical Beast meat was really fragrant and delicious.
However, as the village head said, Wang Ping's body was too weak. After eating a small plate of Mystical Beast meat, he felt warm all over and very comfortable.
At the same time, he also felt full and couldn't eat any more.
He could only envy those Chi Village people who were eating and drinking heartily.
The adults ate Post-Heaven Realm and even Innate Realm monster beast meat, gulping down their alcohol.
Even children, women, and elderly people could eat a lot of low-tier monster beast meat, showing an astonishing appetite.
After the meal in Chi Village, Wang Ping went home with Chifeng.
The next day, before dawn, Wang Ping was awakened by the sound of explosions.
He rubbed his sleepy eyes, pushed open the door, and saw Chifeng practicing martial arts in the courtyard.
Although Chifeng was only eight years old, he was nearly one meter sixty tall. His punches were powerful, and the air roared around him.
Wang Ping felt that Chifeng could kill a tiger with one punch.
Of course, this was probably true.
Because, despite his young age, Chifeng had cultivation, and ordinary tigers were no match for him.
"Chifeng, what realm are you in now?"
Wang Ping asked curiously.
"My talent is only average in the village. After two years of Martial training, I only reached the Mid-Skin Refining Stage." Chifeng retracted his fist and replied shyly.
"Mid-Skin Refining, huh?" Wang Ping pondered, unsure whether that was strong or weak.
After all, he had no standard to judge.
"Wang Ping, you can go back to sleep. It's still half an hour before Uncle Chi Hu teaches us martial arts." Chifeng continued practicing and reminded him.
"It's okay, since I'm awake, I'm not sleepy anymore. I might as well watch you practice."
Wang Ping smiled.
Chifeng nodded and continued to practice with full concentration.
Wang Ping immersed himself and called up the Life Simulator.
It was already past midnight, and the number of simulation times on the Life Simulator had undoubtedly been refreshed. He planned to start a new simulation.
"Life Simulator, start the simulation."
Wang Ping said in his heart.
"Ding, simulation begins."
Soon, the virtual luminescent screen appeared, and words began to float on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 11: Incoming Enemies
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Incoming Enemies
[Ding, life simulation begins.]
[Daya calendar, year 480, March 1st. Under the guidance of Chih Hu, you practiced Solidifying Soirit and Tempering Physique Skill. The cultivation was extremely painful, and you almost couldn't bear it. However, spurred on by Chih Hu, you gritted your teeth and persevered for the sake of your manly dignity.]
[March 2nd, you continued cultivating, feeling much more at ease this time.]
[March 3rd, you carried on with your cultivation.]
[June 5th, through your diligent cultivation and the nourishment of the monster beast meat, you successfully entered the Early Stage of Muscle Training. Overjoyed by this, you were very delighted.]
[June 12th, you continued to cultivate diligently, aiming to make further progress. However, in the evening, only one badly injured person returned from the hunting team, and everyone else had died. This news, like a bolt from the blue, nearly knocked out everyone from Chi Village.]
[Inquiring about the situation, you learned about the cause and consequences. It turned out that Chi Village's hunting team went hunting and discovered two stalks of Peiyuan grass, which had the effect of solidifying foundations and improving cultivation talent.]
So, the hunting team members were ecstatic and decided to gather all the small hunting squads to battle the 6th Tier Demonic Beast - Gale leopard guarding the treasure elixir. However, they didn't expect that there was another Gale leopard.]
In the end, the hunting team was nearly annihilated by the claws and fangs of the two Gale leopards.]
[After learning the cause and consequences, the village chief was extremely grieved and looked much older. The elderly, the weak, and the women and children in the village were also heartbroken. As you were already familiar with the villagers, the deaths of Chih Hu and others deeply saddened you.]
[Following the funeral, discussions began concerning the survival of Chi Village. An elder suggested that Chi Village no longer had the capability to survive in the Black Wind Forest and should move the entire tribe elsewhere.]
[However, this proposal was vetoed by the village chief. They had hidden in the Black Wind Forest to escape their enemies, and if they moved out, the consequences would be unimaginable if discovered.]
[In the end, after much debate, the village chief decided to assign half of the men guarding the village to form a new hunting team to venture further out to collect monster beasts to sustain their livelihood.]
[August 15th, your cultivation remained at the Early Stage of Muscle Training, and it was difficult to break through to the Middle Stage. The village chief approached you, wanting to arrange a marriage for you to have more children and strengthen Chi Village.]
[You were very happy about this, as you and Chi Ling'er from Chi Village had already taken a fancy to each other. In the end, you married under the blessings of the villagers.]
[August 20th, you were still diligently practicing martial arts. However, a self-proclaimed Innate Realm expert named Li Huai arrived at Chi Village and began slaughtering villagers. You were extremely angry, but powerless to do anything. In the end, the village chief and other elders from Chi Village stepped forward to face the enemy. Still, they were no match for that person, and all were killed.]
[Nevertheless, he didn't kill the children of Chi Village, only the adult males.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
...
"This..."
Wang Ping looked at the results of the simulation and fell silent.
This world was even more dangerous than he had imagined.
He had been prepared to tread carefully for a lifetime.
However, it was still of little use.
The hunting team of Chi Village encountered an unexpected disaster, almost being completely wiped out.
Furthermore, a powerful enemy appeared later on.
However, Wang Ping was very puzzled as to why that person didn't kill children and women.
"Moreover, it seems that the simulation completely ignores the existence of the chat group."
Wang Ping thought of another point, somewhat surprised.
Soon, he understood.
After all, the simulator was just a subsystem of the chat group, so how could it simulate the future situation of the chat group?
It could be said that the simulator was simulating the future direction without the existence of the Golden Finger.
"Fortunately, I have the simulator. Otherwise, even if I have a growth-type Golden Finger, I would probably not be able to escape death."
Wang Ping regained his senses and felt extremely grateful.
After all, even though his Golden Finger was of the growth type, it was impossible for him to become an outstanding cultivator in the Innate Realm within 150 days.
At that time, when he faced Li Huai, the villain who slaughtered Chi Village, he would still have faced certain death.
("I have to tell the people of Chi Village about this news.")Wang Ping thought secretly in his heart.
If the hunting team hadn't been annihilated because of the 6th Tier demonic beast Gale leopard, perhaps they could have dealt with Li Huai.
After all, the hunting team was full of young and strong experts, with several Innate Realm powerhouses among them, their combat power was astonishing.
"However, I can't speak directly. I'll wait and see. There's still a long time before the incident happens. I can wait until tomorrow to simulate the situation and find the best way to clear the stage."
Wang Ping thought for a moment and made a decision.
"Brother Wang, let's go to the drill ground to practice martial arts."
Half an hour later, Chifeng stopped his training and told Wang Ping.
"Alright!"
Wang Ping nodded and followed Chifeng out of the house.
Soon, Wang Ping arrived at the drill ground.
Many children had gathered on the drill ground.
Among them, there were children under ten years old like Liefeng and children over ten years old.
But their ages generally didn't exceed fourteen.
That's because, once they turned fourteen, they would join the hunting team and become a glorious hunter.
Wang Ping's arrival amused the children.
