After all, it was the first time they had seen an adult practicing martial arts with them.
"Great, no one is late today, let's get started."
At the forefront, Chih Hu looked at Wang Ping and the children with satisfaction, nodded, and began teaching everyone cultivation.
Most of the children knew the Solidifying Spirit and Tempering Physique Skill, so Chih Hu let them practice on their own while he came to Wang Ping, teaching him the moves and the secrets one by one.
Wang Ping listened attentively.
However, every time his movements were not standard and Chih Hu helped him adjust, he would wince with pain due to the crisp sounds and his face would twitch.
And this was just the beginning. The upcoming training sessions would be even more exhausting and painful, making it difficult for him to endure.
Wang Ping could only smile bitterly.
Although he had known about the difficulties and pains of cultivation from the simulation and had prepared himself mentally, he almost couldn't hold on.
However, being an adult in front of a group of children, Wang Ping didn't want to lose face, so he clenched his teeth and persisted.
"Not bad, I thought you would give up halfway, but it seems that your willpower is quite strong."
When the day's cultivation was over, Chih Hu praised Wang Ping and handed him a bag of medicinal herbs.
"After you go back, soak in a bath of herbal water, and continue your hard training tomorrow."
"I'm not the type to give up halfway." Wang Ping took the bag of herbs and said.
"Not bad. You've read books, and you're quite clever, and your willpower is also strong. You have the makings of a martial artist. It's a pity that you're too old and it's a bit late for you to practice martial arts. Your body is too weak to achieve anything, and basically there is no hope for the Post-Heaven Realm."
Chih Hu nodded and said.
"Maybe." Wang Ping laughed and didn't feel discouraged.
With the simulator and the chat group, as long as he continued to develop, it wouldn't be a problem to reach the Innate Realm level, let alone the Post-Heaven Realm.
Next, Wang Ping looked at the other children who were still practicing martial arts earnestly and were still full of energy, lamented his weakness, and returned to the courtyard alone to soak in medicine.
Without soaking in medicine, he could already imagine the miserable state he would be in afterwards. His body was bound to ache all over, and he wouldn't even be able to move tomorrow.
The next day, Wang Ping got up early again and started a new simulation while watching Chifeng practice his boxing.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 12: Change the Future!
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Change the Future!
[Ding, Life Simulation begins.]
[On the 2nd day of the 3rd month, year 480 of the Daya calendar, you rigorously practice martial arts. After the cultivation is over, you tell Chih Hu about Peiyuan grass and the Gale leopard. Chih Hu is very surprised and asks how you know about it. You make up a lie, saying that it was because of this that the escort was wiped out.]
[Chih Hu believes your words, and says he will let the hunting team pay attention. However, Chih Hu asks if you know where the Peiyuan grass is. You feel helpless and can only say that you lost your way while running away.]
[Hearing your answer, Chih Hu feels somewhat regretful.]
[On the 3rd day of the 3rd month, you cultivate diligently...]
[On the 10th day of the 3rd month, the hunting team finds the Peiyuan grass. However, they remember your words and don't act rashly. The members of the hunting team gather all the other hunting teams, return to the village chief and discuss their strategies.]
[In the end, the village chief decides to take matters into his own hands. After formulating a detailed plan, he prepares to deal with the Gale leopard.]
[On the 11th day of the 3rd month, after everything is ready, the village chief leads the hunting team members in their attack, successfully killing the two Gale leopards and obtaining the Peiyuan grass.]
[Upon returning, the village chief and the others are grateful to you and share a Peiyuan grass to help you strengthen your foundation and improve your cultivation aptitude. Delighted, you choose to take it, improving your aptitude and restoring the depleted innate foundation.]
[On the 12th day of the 3rd month, you practice diligently and find that your cultivation efficiency has improved a lot.]
[On the 20th day of the 3rd month, Chih Hu successfully breaks through to the Innate Realm thanks to the two 6th Tier Demonic Beasts' Elixirs and Peiyuan grass, becoming the sixth powerful practitioner in the Innate Realm in Chi Village. The entire village celebrates.]
[On the 10th day of the 4th month, you break through to the early stage of Muscle Training. You are extremely happy!]
[On the 1st day of the 7th month, you break through to the middle stage of Muscle Training.]
[On the 20th day of the 8th month, you successfully break through to the later stage of Muscle Training. At this point, you also remember that there will be enemies coming to attack today in your life simulation, so you find an excuse to prevent the hunting team members from going out hunting, as it would be dangerous.]
[The men of Chi Village are very puzzled, but they consider your kindness to the village and choose to believe your words.]
[In the afternoon, Li Huai, a powerful practitioner in the Innate Realm, arrives at Chi Village and starts fighting without saying a word. The villagers are outraged, and everyone stands against him together.]
[However, Li Huai is very powerful. Although there are six Innate Realm practitioners in Chi Village, and the village chief is a 7th-Tier powerful practitioner of the Innate Realm, they are no match for Li Huai and are killed one by one. After that, all the adult men in Chi Village are massacred.]
[Due to your death, this simulation comes to an end...]
...
"What..."
Wang Ping is astonished at the results of the simulation.
He didn't expect that even after avoiding the death of the hunting team and allowing Chih Hu to break through to the Innate Realm thanks to the bodies of two 6th Tier demonic beasts and Peiyuan grass, the village would still be wiped out.
Is that Li Huai really that strong?
"According to the simulation description, the village chief is a 7th-Tier Innate Realm practitioner. To be able to kill the village chief and others on his own, Li Huai must be a powerful practitioner at the Innate Perfection Realm."
Wang Ping frowns, feeling somewhat uneasy.
Moreover, judging by the first simulation, Chi Village undoubtedly has a mortal enemy.
That's also the reason why Chi Village is hidden in Black Wind Forest.
Li Huai is most likely the enemy of Chi Village.
That's why he doesn't hesitate to attack and massacre the village after finding it.
"This is troublesome."
Wang Ping rests his chin on his thumb, deep in thought.
Chi Village has been very kind to him, and he doesn't want it to be destroyed.
Moreover, leaving Chi Village would be too dangerous for him in the outer world, and a little carelessness could lead to death.
Apart from that, once he leaves Chi Village, he won't have access to such good cultivation resources.
Therefore, he must find a way to save Chi Village.
However, he has already used up today's simulation times, and he has no clues for the time being, so he can only sigh helplessly.
...
Next, Wang Ping and Chifeng go to the Drill Ground to continue their martial training.
"Uncle Chih Hu, there's something I want to tell you."
After Wang Ping has completed his cultivation for the day, he finds Chih Hu and says seriously.
"What is it?" Chih Hu is somewhat surprised.
"Actually, the reason I got lost in the Black Wind Forest is that my escort found two Peiyuan grass plants, but we didn't expect that there were two 6th Tier demonic beast Gale leopards guarding them..." Wang Ping pretends to be frightened as he speaks.
"Peiyuan Grass!?" Chih Hu's eyes widen.
Peiyuan grass is a rare and valuable medicinal treasure that can improve cultivation aptitude and strengthen one's foundation. It is of great benefit for breaking through to the Innate Realm, making it extremely precious.
"You mean, your escort was killed by the Gale leopards while picking Peiyuan grass, and only you managed to escape by a stroke of luck?"
Chih Hu then speaks again.
"Yes." Wang Ping nods, pretending to be relieved, "Fortunately, those Gale leopards didn't think I was worth eating, otherwise I would have died too. But because of the panic when running away, I had no idea where to go."
"The reason why I'm telling you this is because I don't want you and the others to rush to pick Peiyuan grass as soon as you see it; it will definitely lead to casualties." Wang Ping pauses, his face serious.
"I see, I will let the hunting team members be careful." Chih Hu nods, pats Wang Ping on the shoulder and smiles, "Your information is very useful; if we find Peiyuan grass, you will also benefit from it."
"Mm." Wang Ping nods and smiles.
Through the simulation, he knows that the people of Chi Village are very kind and generous. When they find Peiyuan grass, they are even willing to give him one plant as a thank-you gift.
In the fantasy novels he had read, when people found a treasure, they would often turn against each other, wanting to monopolize it, even killing the leading character and trying to silence them.
...
Next, Wang Ping returns to his room to soak in medicinal baths, relieving the fatigue in his body while absorbing the Qi and Blood from the herbs, strengthening his body.
While soaking in the bath, Wang Ping can't help but open the chat group, only to find no one talking, making him somewhat helpless.
Yesterday, no one was talking either.
Wang Ping knows that the group members only come out to chat when new members join the group or when a group member dies; otherwise, they rarely chat unless something big happens.
After all, everyone has their own things to do, and they don't have much time to chat in the group.
The next day, Wang Ping continues the simulation.
[Ding, simulation begins.]
[On the 3rd day of the 3rd month of the year 480 of the Daya calendar, you practice diligently...]
[On the 10th day of the 3rd month, the hunting team finds the Peiyuan grass and the Gale leopard.]
[On the 11th day of the 3rd month, after the village chief makes thorough preparations, he leads the elites of the hunting team to kill the two Gale leopards and harvest the Peiyuan grass successfully. You receive one of the Peiyuan grass plants and choose to consume it.]
[On the 1st day of the 7th month, you break through to the middle stage of Muscle Training. You are very happy! However, you are also worried about the powerful enemies that will arrive on the 20th of the 8th month.]

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 13: Do Not Show Off Wealth
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Do Not Show Off Wealth
[After some thought, you decided to find the village head and tell him that before entering Black Wind Forest, you knew about an Innate Realm Perfection Master named Li Huai who was searching for something and to be careful. The village chief's face changed drastically upon hearing this.]
[You asked for the reason, and the village chief told you. It turned out that Chi Village was once a great family in Xia Kingdom, and together with the Li Family, they were known as the two great families of White Moon City. However, for some reason, their clan could not break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm above the Innate Realm. Therefore, fifty years ago, after the Li Family Ancestor broke through to the Spiritual Origin Realm, he launched an attack on the Chi family, intending to wipe them out completely.]
[In the end, the Chi family suffered heavy casualties, and only a small number of people escaped and hid in Black Wind Forest, not daring to leak any information.]
[After listening to the village chief's explanation, you deeply felt the danger of this world and sighed at the unfortunate experience of the Chi family. However, you also wondered why the village chief would let you leave Chi Village.]
[The village chief saw your doubts and said that Chi Village had a drug that could make people forget some of their memories. This made you understand why the village chief had said such words.]
[Soon after, the village chief fell into deep thought and worry. A strong cultivator with Innate Perfection Realm cultivation wouldn't be a threat to the Chi Village, but they are now no match for him. If they were found, it would certainly bring disaster.]
[You asked the village chief if it was possible for him to break through to the Innate Realm Perfection. The village chief shook his head, saying that his potential had been depleted because of his advanced age, and breaking through was impossible. You felt helpless at this.]
[The village chief then called a meeting of the clan elders, and they eventually decided to relocate the entire clan, so as not to risk being wiped out.]
[On July 3, you followed the Chi Village people out of the Black Wind Forest. In order to not burden you, they gave you a lot of silver banknotes, urging you to return to your own family. You didn't want to leave, but they insisted on pushing you out of the group.]
[In the eyes of the Chi Village people, they were being hunted by the powerful Xia Kingdom families. If their whereabouts were leaked, it would cause great trouble. At the same time, they saw you as a benefactor and didn't want to bring you any trouble. Chifeng didn't want you to leave either, but also urged you to do so.]
[Feeling helpless and unable to say otherwise, you left the Chi Village group and made a living in the nearby Black Wind Town.]
[Without the ample supply of Blood Food from hunting in Chi Village, your cultivation progress slowed down. You began to worry about your future life.]
[In the end, you chose to focus on cultivation. Fortunately, although you no longer had access to monster beast blood and flesh, the Chi Village people had given you plenty of silver banknotes, allowing you to live without worry, purchase some cultivation resources, and cultivate at ease.]
[August 20, and you still hadn't advanced to the late stage of Muscle Training Realm.]
[On October 1, you finally reached the late stage of Muscle Training Realm.]
[On May 5th of Daya calendar 481, you finally reached the peak of the Muscle Training Realm.]
[On May 25th, 481, you were targeted and killed by mercenaries in Black Wind Town due to your ability to purchase cultivation resources without ever engaging in trade or hunting monster beasts. They took your money and possessions.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
...
"That's just too miserable."
Wang Ping was speechless.
He told the Chi Village people about Li Huai, and they had to move their entire village, their fates unknown.
He could only struggle to survive and cultivate outside of Black Wind Forest, not daring to venture too far.
The result was still being watched.
It was quite miserable.
This world was indeed full of dangers everywhere.
"It seems that no matter which world, we must always keep in mind the principle of not flaunting wealth."
Wang Ping shook his head and thought silently.
"If possible, I still have to find a way to figure out one thing."
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and fell into thought.
Did Li Huai accidentally find Chi Village, or did he search for it?
If he accidentally found Chi Village, all they needed to do was kill him, and they wouldn't need to relocate their clan. He could cultivate peacefully in Chi Village.
If Li Huai had searched for the village on purpose, then it would be troublesome, and they would have to flee.
But when Li Huai searched, they also had to investigate carefully.
"From the simulation, it seems more likely that he accidentally found it. Otherwise, in this simulation, I've survived in Black Wind Town for so long. I shouldn't have been able to avoid hearing any news. After all, searching would definitely cause a stir. No matter if it came from the Li Family's mobilization of strong cultivators to search, or the mobilization of mercenaries in Black Wind Town, there should have been some clues within the simulation."
Wang Ping quickly pondered.
"However, my guess is still just a guess. I need to continue the simulation to figure out the specifics," Wang Ping frowned and hesitated slightly. "Besides, I must also think of a solution. Otherwise, even if I'm sure they accidentally found us, I still can't solve the problem of our massive power gap."
With that thought, Wang Ping opened the chat group and shared the situation he was likely to encounter and asked for advice on how to solve it: "Hello, experts, my current situation is like this... In this case, how should I solve it?"
Soon, someone responded.
Wu Jun (20): "Wow, Wang Ping, can you really see into the future like that? Your talent for predicting the future is really formidable. I'm so envious, QAQ~"
Liu Mei (15): "You really seem to have a lot of misfortune... It's not easy to save your life, but you're encountering danger again? However, according to your description, the martial power level in your world seems to be quite high."
Fang Yun (3): "What can you do? Just accept it, I guess. Worst case scenario, run away alone."
Wang Ping (66): "I want to protect Chi Village. The people there are so good, and if I stay there, I can cultivate safely and be taught cultivation..."
Fang Yun (3): "There's a huge gap between you and that enemy. The truth is, in your current situation, there's no turning point to get out of this mess. Of course, there may be a breaking point, but you just haven't thought about it yet."
Wang Ping (66): "By the way, does the chat group have a delivery function? If Cai Yonglong could come and help, it would be great."
Fang Yun (3): "We haven't even unlocked the task function yet, and you're dreaming of a delivery function? You're daydreaming! Rolling his eyes.Jpg."
Wang Ping (66): "Alright..."
Wang Ping felt at a loss.
In his current situation, Cai Yonglong was the only one he could think of who could face a strong Innate Realm Perfection cultivator.
After all, Cai Yonglong had said that his cultivation had reached the 7th-Tier Innate Realm, which was enough to compete with an Innate Perfection Realm cultivator.
Of course, their worlds were different, and there might be some deviations in their strengths.
"Wait, there seems to be a breaking point."
As Wang Ping thought about it, he suddenly thought of something and his eyes lit up.
The two Gale Leopards were also powerful forces. If they could lure Li Huai into the presence of the leopards and have them fight, then the Chi Village people could join forces with the leopards to deal with him. Perhaps there would be a chance of victory.
"This might work."
The more Wang Ping thought about it, the more he felt that this method was feasible, and he clenched his fist in excitement.
"However, I also need to find a way to get the Chi Village people to give me some Spiritual Stones to help with the simulation. After all, I can become stronger through the simulation much faster than through cultivation. This might be the quickest way to break the deadlock."
Wang Ping thought of this and took a deep breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - 14: The Wife Who Takes Lives
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: The Wife Who Takes Lives
"Drink!"
It was when Wang Ping had thought of two countermeasures that Chifeng also shouted and threw a punch, directly detonating the air and creating a sonic boom.
This also surprised Wang Ping.
"Did you break through?" Wang Ping looked at the joyful Chifeng and asked curiously.
"Yes! I broke through to the late stage of the Skin-refining Realm!" Chifeng said excitedly.
"Not bad, not bad." Wang Ping praised.
In the Life Simulator, it took him nearly a year to reach the Muscle Training Peak, and he didn't know when he could break through to the Skin-refining Realm.
For Chifeng, an eight-year-old child, to reach the late stage of Skin-training was truly impressive.
...
The next day, Wang Ping resumed the simulation.
[Ding. Life simulation begins.]
[Daya calendar 480, March 4th, you practice diligently.]
[March 10th, the hunting team successfully finds the Peiyuan grass. They return and inform the village chief. You take this opportunity to tell the village chief everything about Li Huai. The village chief is puzzled by how much you know, even the specific time of the enemy's attack. You can't explain it, but you can only hope that the village chief will believe you.]
[In the end, the village chief deliberates for a long time and finally chooses to believe you.]
[August 20th, under the preparations of Chi Village people, Li Huai is discovered early, intentionally caught, and lured to the location of the Peiyuan grass. Li Huai is overjoyed and has a big battle with the two Gale leopards. The Gale leopards are not a match.]
[The four Great Innate Realm powerhouses of Chi Village join the battle under the leadership of the village chief, besieging Li Huai. Li Huai is furious and bursts out with shocking fighting strength. In the end, at the cost of serious injuries, he kills all the people of Chi Village and the two Gale leopards.]
[Not long after, Li Huai discovers Chi Village, and you die because of it.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends...]
...
"This..."
Wang Ping was silent.
They had successfully lured the enemy but still did not win. Is the power gap between the Innate Realms so great?
"It seems that we have to find another way."
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
"Ask the Chi Village people for some Spiritual Stones. We can sell the Peiyuan grass to Chi Village and get some Spiritual Stones in exchange. Then, we can use the Spiritual Stones for simulation to become stronger and find a way to survive."
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief, pinning his hopes on this single path.
Otherwise, Chi Village would have to move their entire clan, and he would have to wander outside to survive.
...
The next day, Wang Ping performed the simulation again.
[Ding. Life Simulator begins.]
[Daya calendar 480, March 5th, you practice diligently.]
[March 10th, the people of Chi Village successfully find the Peiyuan grass.]
[March 11th, the village chief leads a team to successfully hunt down the two Gale leopards, obtaining two Peiyuan grass plants and giving you one. Instead, you express that you don't want the Peiyuan grass but want to exchange it for some Spiritual Stones.]
[The village chief is speechless about your request. Peiyuan grass is something rare and precious, and exchanging it for Spiritual Stones is a waste. Moreover, only cultivators in the Post-Heaven Realm can use Spiritual Stones.]
[You insist that you need the Spiritual Stones. The village chief is puzzled but doesn't ask further. He only asks you to take the Peiyuan grass, and they can give you the Spiritual Stones.]
[You are very happy and grateful, thanking them repeatedly. With the help of the village chief, you obtain ten lower-tier Spirit Stones and take the Peiyuan grass.]
[August 1st, due to your increasingly diligent cultivation, you successfully break through to the late Muscle Training stage. After considering, you tell the village chief about Li Huai. The village chief is shocked and ultimately trusts you, deciding to move the entire village.]
[August 3rd, the people of Chi Village leave Black Wind Forest. You are forced to separate from the team, staying in Black Wind Town.]
[Because of your previous experience, you are very cautious when buying resources, not wanting to be noticed.]
[Daya calendar 481, April 20th, you successfully break through to the Muscle Training Peak, starting your assault on the Skin-refining Realm.]
[Daya calendar 482, December 15th, you successfully break through to the Early Skin Refining Realm.]
[Daya calendar 483, July 5th, you successfully break through to the Mid-Skin Refining stage.]
[Daya calendar 484, October 7th, you get married to a young woman in Black Wind Town and start a family.]
[Daya calendar 486, April 8th, you successfully break through to the Skin Refining Realm Late-stage, and you are very happy. However, your wife discovers the Spiritual Stones you have hidden, finds them very beautiful, and takes one away.]
[Daya calendar 486, April 9th, your wife's Spirit Stones are discovered, and she is brutally killed. Others find you and force you to hand over the Spiritual Stones. You are forced to hand over the Spiritual Stones, but eventually still meet your end.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
...
"This... I was killed again because of the treasure."
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, feeling helpless.
In this world, wealth really should not be displayed or risk death.
Unless you have enough strength to protect these things, it's too dangerous.
Previously, just a pile of banknotes attracted fatal disaster, and now these Spiritual Stones, if discovered, would make Body Refining Martial Artist and even Post-Heaven Realm Martial Artist tempted, leading to murder and silence.
Spiritual Stones were simply too precious.
"But at least this time I survived a few more years, and that's progress. And it also verifies that the village chief can give me Spiritual Stones."
Wang Ping shook his head and breathed a sigh of relief.
Of course, if he wants to obtain Spiritual Stones, he still has to wait until the Peiyuan grass has been harvested.
Otherwise, his current status in Chi Village is just a guest freeloading on their food and drink. If he asks for Spiritual Stones now, he will definitely be despised.
Of course, Wang Ping doesn't care. After all, there is still some time before the danger arrives.
...
In the blink of an eye, a few more days pass, and it is finally March 10th.
Wang Ping watches the backs of Chih Hu and the hunting team's strongmen as they leave, knowing that they will have a big harvest today.
As for him, Wang Ping will be able to obtain Spiritual Stones for special simulation either today or tomorrow, thus becoming stronger to face the challenges ahead.
"Spiritual Stones, only Spiritual Stones can break the deadlock."
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
These days, he still continued his daily simulations.
However, no matter how he simulated, he could only face various deaths.
Even if he didn't stay in Black Wind Town, which was full of mercenaries and dangers, but chose to go to other villages, it was still useless.
The journey to other villages was also dangerous, and there was a risk of encountering bandits who wanted both money and life.
It could only be said that practitioners in Muscle Training and Skin-training Realms had it worse off than ordinary people when traveling outside.
Because bandits simply didn't care about the possessions of ordinary people, they could rob a martial artist with much more valuable items than those of many ordinary people.
However, through these constant killings and close encounters with bandits, Wang Ping could guess that the situation in Daya must not be too good.
Because, if it were a time of peace and stability, bandits would not dare to rob and kill on official roads.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 15: New Group Members! The Same World!
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: New Group Members! The Same World!
"Ding, group member Wu Hao (68) has joined the chat."
"Ding, group member Zeng Peng (69) has joined the chat."
"Ding, group member Zhang Jun (70) has joined the chat."
At this point, a system notification suddenly popped up, causing Wang Ping to be momentarily stunned and show a surprised expression.
In response, Wang Ping quickly pulled out the Transmigrator Chat Group page.
Fang Yun (3): "Three newbies at once? That's rare. Welcome, welcome!"
Wu Jun (20): "Welcome, and good luck. I hope you all survive."
Wang Ping (66): "I'll second that."
Wu Hao (68): "What do you mean by 'survive'...?"
Zeng Peng (69): "Bro, the way you put it, I'm feeling a little panicked."
Zhang Jun (70): "Excuse me, did I just join a dark group?"
Wang Ping (66): "You're absolutely right, this group is pretty dark. I suggest you check out the group notice, and you'll quickly find out what's going on and what to do next."
During this period, Wang Ping had been researching the group's features and found that each group member could fill in the contents of the group notice.
Among them was the notice written by Big Sister Liu Mei, which contained the precautions for the Transmigrator Chat Group.
After Wang Ping finished speaking, the newbies instantly disappeared from the group, obviously going to read the group notice.
After reading the group notice, they were all dumbfounded, their minds full of curses.
This group was poisonous!
The mortality rate was way too outrageous.
Wu Hao (68): "Enough talk, I'm off to prepare supplies. I hope I can survive."
Zeng Peng (69): "....TMD, same here, I don't want to die."
Zhang Jun (70): "I'm a rich second-generation, a winner in life, but I had to itch and click to join the group. If I had known, I would have clicked to refuse. Damn it!"
Looking at these three cursing newcomers, Wang Ping also felt a bit nostalgic.
When he first joined, he was just like this, full of regrets.
However, once you were in the group, there was no turning back.
Of course, the premise was that they wouldn't end up dead immediately after transmigrating.
Zhang Hu (5): "Three newbies, huh. Brothers, should we make a bet on how many of them can survive?"
Liu Mei (15): "....Zhang Hu, you and your gloating, go away."
Zhang Hu (5): "When did I become a gloat? I'm a proud knight."
Liu Mei (15): "You're really a disgrace to knights. Sneer.jpg."
Zhang Hu (5): "Damn, Liu Mei, did you wake up early just to heckle me?"
Liu Mei (15): "This humble girl wouldn't dare to heckle a knight."
Zhang Hu (5): "Damn it, what a passive-aggressive attitude."
Fang Yun (3): "By the way, Wang Ping, have you solved your problem?"
Wang Ping (66): "Not really. Speaking of which, we can trade items in this chat group, right?"
Fang Yun (3): "Hehe, Wang Ping, you wouldn't be planning to ask Mr. Cai for some cultivation skills, would you? I can see through you at a glance. Not_human.jpg."
Zhang Hu (5): "Forget it. Although the skills in Mr. Cai's Profound World are powerful, they're not for ordinary people to practice. For example, our world has Elemental Power and Fighting Spirit, but it doesn't have Spiritual Energy, so we can't practice it at all. As for Fang Yun's world, it's even more desperate. They have nothing, so they practice inner strength."
Wu Jun (20): "Don't remind me. At least your two worlds have extraordinary powers; my world and Liu Mei's are just ordinary worlds without anything special. It's so sad."
Liu Mei (15): "It's not that bad... Though we don't have extraordinary powers, we can still practice the Inner Strength Cultivation Skill Fang Yun gave us. Moreover, the Body Refining Realm practiced in Mr. Cai's world doesn't require Spiritual Energy, so it can be practiced."
Wu Jun (20): "That's true. But without the Golden Finger to help us in cultivation, practicing on our own is so slow. It's tough."
Wang Ping (66): "???"
Wang Ping was stunned looking at the chat messages above.
Was the first realm in Cai Yonglong's world also the Body Refining Realm?
Could it be that he traveled to the same world as Cai Yonglong?
If that was the case, it would be quite a marvelous fate.
Maybe he could try to probe.
Fang Yun (3): "Huh? What's with your reaction? Are you excited or do you have Spiritual Energy in your world?"
Wang Ping (66): "Uh, yeah, there is Spiritual Energy."
Fang Yun (3): "Damn! There really is! I'm so jealous!"
Zhang Hu (5): "You actually have Spiritual Energy? Doesn't look like the power level would be too low. So jealous."
Fang Yun (3) @Zhang Hu (5): "You, jealous for what? A Grand Magister in your world can annihilate a city with one forbidden spell! In my world, even a Grandmaster Realm master can't defeat thousands of opponents; at most, they can only take the head of enemy generals amidst the army."
Zhang Hu (5): "Look, someone's turned into a sour lemon. I won't say who. Evil_laugh.jpg."
Fang Yun (3): "I am..."
Wang Ping (66): "Anyway, can anyone share the Body Refining Technique from Mr. Cai's world with me?"
Liu Mei (15): "I can. However, Mr. Cai is willing to share it with us for cultivation on the condition that we owe him a favor."
Wang Ping (66): "I understand."
"Ding, Liu Mei (15) has sent you an exclusive red envelope."
Seeing the red envelope, Wang Ping was overjoyed and chose to accept it.
"Ding, you have opened Liu Mei (15)'s red envelope and obtained the Green Spirit Body Tempering Skill."
As Wang Ping accepted the red envelope, he found his mind filled with new information.
When he had finished receiving this information, he could not help but reveal a shocked expression.
That was because the small realms recorded in the Green Spirit Body Tempering Skill were the same as the ones he knew.
They were: Muscle Training, Skin Training, Bone Refining, Meridian Opening, and Viscera Training.
Moreover, each small realm was divided into early, middle, late, and peak stages.
"Mr. Cai and I might really be in the same world."
Waves of emotions surged in Wang Ping's heart, unable to calm down.
However, even if they were in the same Profound World, they might not necessarily be on the same continent.
After all, typical Profound Worlds had numerous continents, resplendent with glorious adventures.
"If I really can't solve the Li Huai problem, I'll try to probe if Mr. Cai is on the same continent as me and if it's close by."
Wang Ping thought to himself.
He had a good impression of Cai Yonglong, the transmigrating bigshot, but he also had necessary vigilance.
If two transmigrators were in the same world, who knew what might happen?

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 16: Two More Deaths!
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Two More Deaths!
As everyone was chatting casually in the group, half an hour passed quickly, and the three newcomers passed through one after another.
Soon, there was a message from the group.
"Ding, group member Wu Hao (68) has died."
Wang Ping (66): "Well, that was quick. Although not as fast as Chen Kang, it's not much slower..."
Fang Yun (3): It's another unlucky one. So pitiful. I'm guessing he didn't even have time to draw his golden finger, just like Chen Kang.
Zhang Hu (5): "I wonder how he died this time. Let's wait for the death replay."
Liu Mei (15): "Looks like it's going to be a long time before we have ten group members."
...
"Ding, group member Zeng Peng (69) has died."
Everyone: "???"
Wang Ping and the others looked at each other with a strange expression.
Are the newcomers this miserable this time? Two of them died one after another.
Could it be that they all have to be wiped out this time?
Wu Jun (20): "It's too terrible, really. I don't know if the remaining one can survive."
Fang Yun (3): "It's difficult. And not dying immediately upon arrival is just the beginning."
Zhang Jun (70): "..."
Wang Ping (66): "Hey, newcomer just sent a message. What's your situation over there?"
Zhang Jun (70): "I really didn't expect two of them to die so quickly. I'm a little scared..."
Zhang Hu (5): "Alright, alright, we know you're scared. Hurry up and answer the question so we can have some fun... oh, I mean, give you some advice."
Zhang Jun (70): "..."
Zhang Jun (70): "I don't know whether to say my luck is good or bad. I was transferred to an empty room. However, looking out, there are zombies everywhere in the corridors downstairs."
Fang Yun (3): "Be content. If you look at the death replay section in the group files, you'll know how lucky you are. The last newcomer to join the group, a guy named Chen Kang, appeared in front of mutated zombies and was directly eaten like a twist."
Liu Mei (15): "You're already luckier than many, since you didn't die immediately after arrival. I suggest you don't make any noise and quickly find a place to hide and extract your golden finger."
Zhang Hu (5): "Kid, you're still lucky. Don't be greedy."
Zhang Jun didn't say anything, silently looked at Chen Kang's death playback video, and then fell silent.
Okay, compared to the unlucky Chen Kang, he was indeed quite lucky.
Then, he began to extract his own golden finger.
At this moment, the group system's voice rang out again.
"Ding, Wu Hao (68)'s death replay has been recorded. Group members can click to watch it and learn from it."
"Ding, Zeng Peng (69)'s death replay has been recorded. Group members can click to watch it and learn from it."
Seeing the prompts, Wang Ping's eyes lit up and he hurriedly checked.
Then he learned the cause of death for Wu Hao and Zeng Peng.
Both of them were quite miserable.
One was transferred mid-air and fell to his death.
The other was transferred to the ground but tragically ended up in a toxic forest full of corrosive gas, quickly dying.
"I'm really lucky."
After learning about their deaths, Wang Ping could only sigh again.
Being transferred was risky, and the danger was simply too great.
Fang Yun (3): "Falling to death has happened before, but Zeng Peng being transferred to a toxic forest adds a new mode of death."
Liu Mei (15): "So pitiful."
Wu Jun (20): "Honestly, I feel lucky all over again."
Zhang Hu (5): "Oh, you're so lucky, except for when you drew your golden finger. Laugh.Jpg."
Wu Jun (20): "I TM..."
Fang Yun (3): "Alright, stop teasing Jun. By the way, what's the newcomer's golden finger? Come on out and tell us, let's broaden our horizons."
Zhang Jun (70): "I don't want to say."
Fang Yun (3): "You're quite cautious, not very gregarious."
Liu Mei (15): "It's up to him whether he wants to say it or not. Mr.Cai didn't say it either, so don't force it."
Fang Yun (3): "Sister, I was just joking. Rolling eyes.Jpg."
...
"Wang Ping, the hunting team has returned, and they have brought back a big harvest. Let's go and take a look."
As Wang Ping was in the group chat, Chifeng's voice sounded in his ear, bringing him back to reality.
"Alright." Wang Ping smiled and followed Chifeng towards the village entrance.
When the two arrived, they saw Chih Hu and the others excitedly talking with the village head.
Seeing Wang Ping and Chifeng coming, Chih Hu laughed loudly, walked over, slapped Wang Ping on the shoulder, and said, "You were right! There were two Peiyuan grasses and two Gale Leopards. Without your information, we would have suffered heavy casualties."
"Thanks a lot."
Chi Tie, the hunting team leader, also spoke seriously.
Although he had the Innate realm 6th Tier cultivation, the Gale leopard was a 6th Tier demonic beast, and its strength was equivalent to that of a 7th-Tier Innate realm martial warrior, fierce and powerful.
If they faced one Gale leopard, they could still rely on their numerical advantage to fight back.
But if they faced two Gale leopards at once, they would likely be annihilated.
Therefore, Wang Ping's information had saved their hunting team and their village.
"You're welcome. You took me in, so it's something I should do." Wang Ping said with a smile.
The village chief looked at Wang Ping with a smile and said, "Tomorrow I will go and kill these two Gale Leopards and pick the Peiyuan grass. I will give you one to help you consolidate your cultivation. Only then will you have any hope of becoming successful in martial arts."
"Thank you, village chief." Wang Ping clasped his fist in gratitude.
"But, village chief, I wonder if the village has any Spiritual Stones." Immediately after, Wang Ping couldn't help but ask.
"Although we are secluded in the Chi Village, Spiritual Stones are considered valuable, but we do have some in the village. What do you need the Spiritual Stones for?"
The village chief asked with curiosity.
Chi Village had to build their village hidden in the Black Wind Forest to avoid enemies and remain secluded.
However, they still needed to buy things like clothing, food, medicine, and weapons from outside.
Therefore, they naturally had spiritual stones, which helped with cultivation.
"I have some uses for them. I wonder if the village chief could lend me some." Wang Ping said.
"You have done a great favor to our Chi Village. If you still want to borrow some spiritual stones, it would be completely despicable."
The village chief shook his head and said,
"Here are ten lower-tier Spirit Stones, you take these first. If it's not enough, just let me know." The village chief gently touched the black ring on his index finger, and ten crystal-clear Spiritual Stones appeared in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 17 - 17: The First Paid Simulation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: The First Paid Simulation!
"Thank you, Village Chief." Wang Ping took the spiritual stone and smiled in thanks.
"No need for courtesy." The village chief patted Wang Ping's shoulder and walked away hunched over.
Now that the Peiyuan grass had been found, it was time to discuss how to deal with the two Gale leopards.
...
"Now the village chief is even closer to Wang Ping than he is to me. He just gave him ten spiritual stones." Chifeng muttered, staring at Wang Ping's hand filled with spiritual stones.
Ten lower-tier Spiritual Stones were precious, enough to make many Post-Heaven Realm martial artists covet them.
As a result, Wang Ping was given them as soon as he asked. According to the Village Chief, Wang Ping only had to ask if he needed more of them.
"You don't even need lower-tier spiritual stones right now, what's there to envy?"
Wang Ping couldn't help but smile, patting him on the head.
"I'm not envious, but Wang Ping, you don't need them either, do you? What are they for?"
Chifeng shook his head, then asked curiously.
"Don't ask so many questions, kid. Remember, your goal is to reach the Martial Peak, then revive your parents. You need to practice your punches quickly." Wang Ping smiled, then walked away, holding the spiritual stones.
Chifeng rolled his eyes and didn't follow.
When Wang Ping got home, he spoke inwardly, "Simulator, I want to do an extra simulation."
"Ding, extra simulation requires one lower-tier Spirit Stone. Do you want to pay now?"
"Pay."
Wang Ping spoke without hesitation.
Although it cost one lower-tier Spirit Stone each time, he still had to spend it when necessary.
"Ding, life simulation starting."
"Ding, Talent Refresh in progress... Congratulations, you have refreshed the White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius; White Talent: Martial Arts Genius. Please select one talent within one minute."
"White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius - After obtaining this talent, one's natural aptitude in swordsmanship will improve and be considered a genius in swordsmanship by ordinary people."
"White Talent: Martial Arts Genius - After obtaining this talent, one's natural aptitude in martial arts will improve and be considered a genius in martial arts by ordinary people."
"Eh, I actually refreshed my talents? Spending money on this simulation is really worth it!"
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, smiling happily.
"System, I choose the White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius."
After thinking for a moment, Wang Ping murmured inwardly.
There was no distinction between strong and weak in swordsmanship and martial arts.
Compared to using fists, he preferred using swords.
There was no helping it. In his previous life, he had seen many TV dramas and read fantasy novels about sword-wielding immortal heroes and always longed for it.
"Ding, Talent selection successful, Simulation starts."
[Daya Calendar, year 480, March 10th, you ate a lot of meat at night and told Chifeng the story of breaking through the heavens.]
[March 11th, the village chief and his people successfully killed the two Gale leopards and harvested the Peiyuan grass. After returning, the village chief hosted a banquet to celebrate, and also gave you a Peiyuan grass.]
[August 1st, due to your increasingly hard cultivation, you successfully broke through to the late-stage Skin Refining Realm. After thinking about it, you tell everything about Li Huai. The village chief was shocked, eventually trusting you and deciding to move the entire tribe.]
[August 3rd, the people of Chi Village left the Black Wind Forest. You were forced to stay behind in Black Wind Town.]
[Then you lived in Black Wind Town, being extremely cautious. You opened a breakfast shop selling steamed buns, hiding in plain sight. Your buns tasted good, and many people liked them, which surprised you.]
[Daya Calendar, year 486, April 8th, you successfully broke through to the late-stage Skin Refining Realm and were very happy. This time, you didn't choose to get married; you planned to lay low until death.]
[Daya Calendar, year 487, August 1st, you successfully broke through to the peak of Skin Refining Realm. However, on that day, the monster beasts in the Black Wind Forest went wild, causing a Beast Tide, and you were caught in the chaos, bitten and eaten by a monster beast while fleeing.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
...
"Did I die again?"
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, feeling somewhat speechless.
Moreover, the chosen talent, the system did not give any textual explanation, which was quite disappointing.
It should be said that in the simulation, he may have learned swordsmanship but hardly used it. He had no chance to showcase it, always laying low while practicing bitterly.
Nevertheless, he still couldn't avoid death.
However, this time he survived a bit longer, living for seven years and five months.
"Ding, Reward Generation Successful. You can choose one from the following rewards:
①. Peak Skin Refining Realm cultivation."
"System, I choose ①."
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, his gaze subtle.
There was only one; so there wasn't really an option to choose from.
"Ding, Selection successful."
The system's voice rang out.
Then, Wang Ping felt a warmth in his body, and his body crackled as a surge of strong Qi and Blood rushed through his veins, giving him the illusion of being incredibly strong.
A few minutes later, the strange sensation disappeared, and Wang Ping reveled in the changes within him, a smile of joy on his face.
Now, compared to before, his muscle lines were close to perfection, and his skin had become a healthy wheat color. His body was incredibly tough.
With his cultivation at the Peak Skin Refining Realm, ordinary swords and knives would be unable to cut him, and he could better withstand blunt weapon attacks, buffering the force to protect his internal organs.
"That feeling of effortlessly improving cultivation is so satisfying."
Wang Ping couldn't help but sigh.
However, after the special simulation, he had lost the newbie benefits of free simulation and could only have one free simulation every ten days from now on.
But, it couldn't be helped...
In order to become stronger and seek a way to break the situation, he had no choice but to use the special simulation.
At least, the free simulation chances could be stored, providing some small psychological comfort. He could use them in critical moments to avoid danger and find a way to survive.
"By the way, System, what's the difference between the talent levels?"
At this moment, Wang Ping remembered the issue of talent levels and asked curiously.
"Talent levels are ranked from lowest to highest as follows: White Talent, Green Talent, Blue Talent, Red Talent, Purple Talent, Golden Talent, and Rainbow Talent. There's a huge difference between different colors of talent. Also, the higher the level of the talent, the lower the probability of refreshing it."
The system's voice rang out.
"I see." Wang Ping nodded in understanding.
"System, how many spiritual stones do I need for the next extra simulation?"
Immediately, Wang Ping asked inwardly.
"The second extra simulation requires two lower-tier Spirit Stones."
The system's voice sounded again.
"Two? That's still acceptable." Wang Ping sighed in relief and said, "System, I want to start a new life simulation."
"Ding, life simulation starting... Talent Refresh in progress..."
The system's voice rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 18 Youth Swordsman•Bai Tianhong!
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Youth Swordsman?Bai Tianhong!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Whitened Talent – Business Genius; Whitened Talent Extraordinary Physique.”
Whitened Talent – Business Genius: With this talent, your ability in business will be improved.
Whitened Talent – Extraordinary Physique: With this talent, the host’s cultivation aptitude will be improved to a certain degree, reaching a level stronger than ordinary people.
The system’s voice rang out again, causing Wang Pings eyes to light up slightly.
“System, I choose Whitened Talent – Extraordinary Physique.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
In the simulation, his talent was improved by taking Peiyuan grass, consolidating his foundation, and improving his aptitude, allowing him to have the ability to practice martial arts.
However, his previous aptitude was too poor and he started too late. Even if he took Peiyuan grass, his talent was still not as good as Chifeng’s children.
In the simulation, it took him seven and a half years to reach the Peak Skin -refining Realm.
Therefore, Wang Ping placed great importance on improving his Bone and
Root Aptitude Talent.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Immediately afterward, the pale blue virtual luminescent screen appeared again in front of Wang Ping, and text began to appear on it.
[Daya calendar year 480, March 10, you ate a lot of meat at night and talked about the story of Fighting Broken with Chifeng.]
[March 11, the village chief led people to successfully kill two Gale leopards and pick Peiyuan grass. After returning, the village chief held a banquet to celebrate and gave you a Peiyuan grass.]
[At the same time, the village chief was surprised to find that your cultivation had actually reached the Peak Skin Training Realm and was very surprised, knowing that you had a big secret. You didn’t know how to explain it.]
[However, the village chief did not make things difficult for you in the end, but said that everyone has their own little secrets, and hoped that you would remember that in the outer world, you must never let anyone find out that your cultivation can suddenly soar.]
[You said that you remembered the village chief’s teachings. At the same time, you were very grateful for the good character of the people in Chi Village, otherwise, you would really be in danger.]
[August 5, you successfully broke through to the Early Bone Refining Realm, which gave Chifeng a sense of urgency and made him even more diligent in his cultivation. After thinking about it, you told the village chief about Li Huai’s matter. The village chief was shocked and finally trusted you, deciding to move the entire clan.]
[August 7, the people of Chi Village left Black Wind Forest, and you were forced to leave the team and stay in Black Wind Town.]
[Afterward, you lived in Black Wind Town, very cautiously, opening a breakfast shop selling steamed buns to hide your identity.]
[Daya calendar year 481, March 5, you successfully broke through to the Middle Bone Refining Realm.]
[Daya calendar year 481, December 7, you successfully broke through to the Late Bone Refining Realm.]
[Daya calendar year 482, October 8, you successfully broke through to the Peak Bone Refining Realm.][Daya Calendar Year 484, May 5th, you successfully advanced to the early stage of Meridian Opening period. At that time, you were already considered a small expert in Black Wind Town, and finally felt relieved.]
[Daya Calendar Year 487, July 1st, you successfully advanced to the early stage of the Viscera Training Realm, and you were very happy. To reward yourself, you went to a restaurant and ate and drank to your heart’s content. On the way, you overheard mercenaries excitedly discussing something. After eavesdropping, you learned about the whole story.]
[It turned out some people discovered a trail of the Tier-7 Demon Beast “Silver Moon Wolf” deep in Black Wind Forest. Moreover, this Tier-7 Silver Moon Wolf King seemed to be pregnant and was about to give birth to its offspring. If someone could get the cub, it would be like soaring to the sky in a single step.]
[After listening to the mercenaries, you were shocked, and you also learned why the Monster Beast Tide suddenly broke out on August 1st in the Year 487 of Daya Calendar. Surely some powerful people sneaked into the Black Wind Forest, stole Silver Moon Wolf’s cub, and enraged it.]
[You hurriedly finished your meal and went straight home to pack your things, planning to flee Black Wind Town. The farther away from Black Wind Town, the better. Otherwise, you would certainly be eaten by monster beasts.]
“So that’s how it happened…”
Wang Ping finally understood as he looked at the luminescent screen’s text.
He was wondering why the Black Wind Forest suddenly erupted with a terrifying beast tide, it turned out the cub of a Tier-7 demonic beast might have been stolen.
A 6th-Tier Demonic Beast is already equivalent to a monster above the 7th-Tier of Innate Realm.
A 7th Tier Monster Beast, equivalent to the Spiritual Origin Realm above the Innate Realm, is unimaginable how horrifying its existence is.
“However, the cultivation progress in this simulation is quite large this time.
After seven years, the cultivation directly reaches the Viscera Training Period. It seems that the Whitened Talent – Extraordinary Physique still has a strong effect on improving aptitude, at least much better than the average person.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but chuckle as he pondered the matter of cultivation.
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping continued to watch the luminescent screen with full attention.
As Wang Ping stared, the text on the luminescent screen continued to appear. The life simulator was very user-friendly.
[You left Black Wind Town with your belongings, fleeing cautiously. Relying on the Viscera Training Realm cultivation level, you managed not to be captured and killed by bandits this time.]
[Daya Calendar Year 487, July 10th, you escaped to White Wood Village two thousand miles away from Black Wind Town. You found that there were only two thousand people in White Wood Village, and there were two big families in the village, the Ye’s family and the Zhao Family. The strongest members in these two families were only in the Viscera Training Realm, which made you feel relieved. You believed that with your current cultivation, even if the Ye’s family and Zhao Family tried to take action against you, you could easily escape.]
[However, due to reading too many web novels, you were wary of the Ye’s family. After all, Ye surname was a leading character’s surname, which could not be provoked.]
[In the following days, you did not reveal your cultivation. You bought a bun shop in Bai Wood Village, continued selling buns, and hid yourself, wanting to live a low-profile and cultivate quietly. Because of your tasty buns, Ye Xiaorou, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, frequently came to your shop to buy buns, and you gradually got acquainted.]
[Daya Calendar Year 487, August 7th, you learned about the news of the Beast
Tide in Black Wind Forest from Ye Xiaorou’s mouth. On August 1st, the Beast Tide in Black Wind Forest erupted, affecting many surrounding villages and towns, killing and wounding hundreds of thousands of people. Eventually, under the leadership of the Silver Moon Wolf, the Beast Tide attacked Clear Wind City.]
[Martial artists from Clear Wind City defended the city but ultimately lost against the Beast Tide, almost causing the city to be breached and a million people to die by the beast’s mouth. At a critical moment, a young swordsman stepped forward, killed the Silver Moon Wolf and repelled the Beast Tide, displaying unparalleled dominance.]
[Hearing the news, you were very shocked. A young swordsman who could kill the Seventh Tier Monster Beast Silver Moon Wolf was truly abnormal. Driven by curiosity, you asked about the young swordsman’s story. Ye Xiaorou, who admired the young swordsman, told you.]
[It turned out the other party was Bai Tianhong, who was considered the once-in-a-century Sword Skill Talent in Xia Empire. At the age of only twenty-five, he had reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm, and had even comprehended the legendary Sword Spirit. With this, he was able to kill the weakened Silver Moon Wolf after giving birth, but at the cost of severe injuries.]
[After hearing about Bai Tianhong’s deeds, you couldn’t help but sigh that there was such a huge gap between people. Ye Xiaorou deeply agreed. Now, at the age of eighteen, she had only cultivated to the Bone Refining Realm, and at most, she could only reach the Post-Heaven Realm in the future. However, Bai Tianhong already became one of the Striking Generation Experts at the age of 25..]

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 19: Son of Fortune
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Son of Fortune
Translator: 549690339
On the 8th of October in the 487th year of the Daya calendar, Ye Xiaorou was attacked and you accidentally stumbled onto the scene. You chose to intervene and drove the enemy away, thus revealing your cultivation. Ye Xiaorou developed a secret affection for you and invited you to visit the Ye’s family. Despite your polite refusal, Ye Xiaorou’s enthusiasm left you with no choice but to visit them.
The Ye Family was very surprised when they learned about your powers. After all, it’s quite remarkable for someone to reach Viscera Training at the age of thirty-three. They also noticed Ye Xiaorou’s affection for you and wanted to betroth her to you.
You refused their proposal due to the significant age gap. However, Ye Xiaorou didn’t care about the age difference and her father also believed that age was not an issue, wanting to bind you to the Ye family’s warship.
In the end, you agreed and successfully married Ye Xiaorou.
The Zhao Family was very displeased with your presence, seeing you as a future threat to their family, and wanted to get rid of you.
On the 4th of March in the 488th year of the Xia calendar, your cultivation successfully broke through to the mid-stage of the Viscera Training. At the same time, Ye Xiaorou was pregnant. The Ye family was overjoyed at this double blessing.
On the 1st of June, the Zhao Family paid a high price to hire a peak martial artist of the Viscera Training Stage, initiating a night raid on the Ye Family. That night, a bloody battle ensued in which Ye Xiaorou was killed; you almost went crazy, fighting fiercely in retaliation.
Despite your years of tough cultivation, you did not have a deep understanding of martial arts. Despite achieving mid-stage of Viscera Training, you were killed by a newbie elder from the Zhao Family.
In this battle, the Ye Family was wiped out. Only Ye Chen, a gifted son of the Family Master, managed to escape.
Due to your death, the simulation ends…
“I died again. As expected, getting married is a big taboo. A slight carelessness can lead to death. If I want to live long, I just have to cultivate low key.”
Wang Ping scratched his head, somewhat helpless.
However, Wang Ping in the simulation is a real person too. It’s natural to want to get married if you meet a girl you like when you grow older. He couldn’t stop that.
“Speaking of which, this Ye Chen is definitely no ordinary person. Surviving alone after his family was exterminated, he has an extraordinary talent. He’s the perfect template for a revenge-oriented main character.”
Wang Ping looked at the penultimate line of the text and muttered.
According to his understanding of the simulator, the simulation usually ends as soon as he dies. But this time, it simulated a bit more, which is unusual.
“Nevermind, whether he’s a main character template or not, I will find out in the future.’
Soon thereafter, Wang Ping didn’t think too much about it and was just excited about the rewards that the system was about to distribute.
“Ding, reward generation successful. You can choose one from the following rewards:
White Talent – Extraordinary Physique.
@. Combat Experience.
Whitened Talent – Business Genius.’
“This isn’t even a choice, it’s definitely the White Talent – Extraordinary
Physique.”
Looking at the rewards, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate to make his choice.
Only by choosing the Extraordinary Physique could his cultivation quickly improve.
As for the other rewards, their values were not significant.
“Successful selection.
The system’s voice resounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt a warmth in his body but experienced no other sensations.
However, Wang Ping clearly understood that his cultivation talent had been upgraded.
“Speaking of which, I was unexpectedly killed in this simulation. It’s definitely embarrassing.”
At this point, Wang Ping was reminded of his humiliating defeat and couldn’t help but feel embarrassed.
Other cross-world travelers kill no matter their rank, but he was killed by an ordinary person, which is a true disgrace to the cultivators.
“It seems that when I get a chance, I have to practice Martial Arts more often. I can’t miss talents like Swordsmanship Genius.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
“System, I want to continue simulating.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping spoke again from his heart.
“Ding, this simulation requires the consumption of 4 Lower-tier Spirit Stones, do you want to start the simulation?” The system’s voice rang out.
“4 pieces?” Wang Ping was surprised.
He thought it would be 3, but it turned out to be 4 Lower-tier Spirit Stones, which was a twofold increase.
It better not be that the price doubles each time, next asking for 8 Lower-tier Spirit Stones?
That would be the end of him.
“Pay.” Although Wang Ping was slightly pained, he still chose to pay.
He had no choice but to spend his precious stones for the simulation and the strength it brings along.
“Ding, life simulation starts, talent refresh in progress…”
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the White Talent:
Swordsmanship Genius, White Talent: Escape Master.”
White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius: Enhances the talent for swords to a certain extent.
White Talent: Escape Master: Increases speed to a certain extent while escaping.
“Uh… This Escape Master is quite unique.”
Wang Ping looked at the introduction of the two talents and his expression was complicated.
Now that he has the Escape Master talent, wouldn’t he be able to get a talent like ‘Fall Behind Others’ in the future, with the effect being something like ‘when you fall behind others, it’s harder for the enemy to target you as their primary target’.
“System, I choose White Talent: Escape Master.”
After contemplating, Wang Ping still chose the talent ‘Escape Master’. He had no choice, he just wanted to cultivate for the time being.
Although he has complained about being killed before, compared with confronting people, running faster is undoubtedly the key to surviving longer. “Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins… ‘
On the 10th of March in the 480th year of the Xia calendar, you spent the night devouring meat and shared the story of the fabled battle with Chifeng.
On the 10th of July in the 487th year of the Xia calendar, you fled to Bai Wood Village, two thousand miles away from Black Wind Town, and began to cultivate on the sly, no longer running a bun shop, but making a living by blacksmithing instead.
On the 8th of October, you learned that Ye Xiaorou would be attacked but didn’t intervene, resulting in her death.
On the 2nd of January in the 488th year of the Xia calendar, your cultivation successfully broke through to the mid-stage of Viscera Training.
On the 1st of June, the Zhao Family paid a heavy price to bring in a peak Viscera
Training Realm martial artist and launched a night raid on the Ye Family. The Ye Family was annihilated, with only Ye Chen escaping. You knew that this child would achieve greatness.
On the 5th of November in the 488th year of the Xia calendar, you successfully advanced to the latter stage of Viscera Training. Because the Ye Family was annihilated, and the Zhao Family dominated Bai Wood Village, the villagers had been bullied and oppressed. You couldn’t avoid it either, but you chose to endure and develop quietly.
On the 7th of June in the 489th year of the Xia calendar, you successfully advanced to the peak of the Viscera Training, one step away from the Post-Heaven Realm.
On the 1st of July, the 15-year-old Ye Chen returned to the Bai Wood Village, miraculously reaching the Post-Heaven Realm at the age of fifteen. He single-handedly annihilated the Zhao Family in revenge. You were surprised when you heard the news and felt your judgement was correct – this child is the Son of Fortune.
Because the Zhao Family and the Ye Family were consecutively exterminated, you relaxed and believed no one posed a threat to you in Bai Wood Village
anymore..

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - 20: Uprising! Special Reward!
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Uprising! Special Reward!
Translator: 549690339
[Daya Calendar 489, December 1st, you tried to break through the Post-Heaven Realm but failed. You knew that if you followed the normal method, it would take a long time to possibly break through to the Post-Heaven Realm. And if you dragged on for more days, there might be no chance for you to break through to the Innate Realm.]
[Finally, you decided to take the remaining Spiritual Stones and head to the nearest Black Rock City to see if there were any Elixirs to help break through to the Post-Heaven Realm.]
[Daya Calendar 489, December 2nd, you were ambushed by Post-Heaven
Realm bandits on your way to Black Rock City, but your White Talent: Escape Master came into play, increasing the speed of your horse and allowing you to escape successfully. You were very grateful for this.]
[Daya Calendar 489, December 3rd, you successfully arrived at Black Rock City, found the largest pharmacy in the city, and inquired about Elixirs. Eventually, you learned of an Elixir called Post-Heaven Elixir that could improve your chances of breaking through to the Post-Heaven Realm, which made you very happy.]
[You asked the price and found that it required three Lower-tier Spiritual Stones, which was very distressing. But you could only take out the remaining three Lower-tier Spiritual Stones to pay the bill. At this moment, you regretted not asking for more Spiritual Stones when you parted ways with the people of Chi Village.]
[After purchasing the Post-Heaven Elixir, you closed yourself in an inn and cultivated. Eventually, you successfully broke through to the Post-Heaven Realm, becoming a Post-Heaven Realm Martial Artist. Then, you chose to return to Bai Wood Village and continue to live a low-profile life without seeking adventures in the Jianghu.]
[Daya Calendar 490, during the New Year’s Eve, you watched the people of Bai Wood Village celebrate and felt very lonely. You considered whether to establish a family and develop a clan, at least to leave a legacy.]
[In the end, you chose to start a family and grow your family line. During the year Daya Calendar 490, you sought to expand your family. At the same time, you began to show off your cultivation and suppress other families in Bai Wood Village, making them respect you.]
[Daya Calendar 491, floods and droughts occurred in various parts of the Xia Country, causing suffering among the people. Coupled with the foolish actions of the Xia Emperor and the corruption of court officials, the Xia Country began to show signs of chaos. You were worried because your cultivation level at the time was only in the Post-Heaven Realm 2nd Tier, which might not be able to protect your wives and children in a chaotic era.]
[Daya Calendar 493, July 8th, your cultivation reached the Post-Heaven Realm
4th Tier, and your family gradually grew stronger. At the same time, Xia Country was completely in chaos, with bandits running rampant and various heroes rising in rebellion, even affecting Bai Wood Village. Some people invited you to join the Rebellion Army but you chose to refuse.]
[Seeing your refusal, the Rebellion Army demanded that you hand over money and food to support their cause. Enraged, you knew that they were obviously trying to rob you of your hard-earned family fortune. However, knowing that you were not strong enough to resist, you went along with their demands. The rebel soldiers sneered at you for daring to glare at them and declared that you were loyal to the tyrant. They arrogantly killed you.] [Due to your death, this simulation is over…]
“These rebels are really no different from bandits.”
Wang Ping watched the conclusion of the simulation with a frown, feeling very displeased.
Killing people and seizing their possessions without any provocation was something only bandits would do.
It should be said, they were even worse than bandits. At least bandits were blatant about their evil intentions to kill and rob people.
These rebel soldiers wanted to kill and rob while still putting an unjust label on others, which was completely hypocritical behavior.
“Seems like living a low-profile life is still the best option. Starting a family and expanding my clan would only bring disaster upon myself.”
Wang Ping shook his head, recalling the content of the simulation.
He really couldn’t stand loneliness in the simulation. Even though he had become a Post-Heaven Realm Martial Artist by living a low-profile life, he might still have a slim chance of becoming an Innate Master if he continued to do so.
However, once he gained some power, he wanted to start a family, which eventually attracted the attention of the rebels, and he was tragically killed.
Perhaps, this was the innate nature of people in Xia, having an inexplicable obsession with starting a family.
Of course, without exposing his strength and expanding his power to earn cultivation resources, it was estimated that his cultivation in the end wouldn’t reach the Post-Heaven Realm 4th Tier.
After all, if one didn’t have enough cultivation resources, their cultivation progress would certainly become more and more difficult and slow as time went on.
At this time, the system’s voice sounded again, bringing Wang Ping back to his senses.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose two of the following rewards:
White Talent Escapist.
@. White Talent Swordsmanship Genius.
Life Experience.”
“Can I really choose two?”
Wang Ping was surprised. However, looking at the three rewards, he was still torn.
He wanted all three of these rewards.
The White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius could enhance his sword skills, preventing others from killing him across levels after his cultivation.”
The effect of the White Talent: Escape Master was already shown in the simulation. You could be weaker than others, but you absolutely couldn’t afford to be slower than them.”
As for the third reward, although it seemed unimpressive at first glance, upon a closer look, it was extremely valuable.”
After all, this meant that Wang Ping would gain over ten years of life experience for free.”
Granted, it didn’t seem like a big deal, but upon further thought, the value within was staggering.”
The richer one’s life experiences were, the more mature they became.”
At the same time, this could also include his experience in martial training, which would allow him to improve his cultivation faster during the next simulation.”
“System, I choose O and O.”
After struggling with his decision, Wang Ping finally set his heart on the third reward.”
“Ding, selection successful, distributing rewards…”
The system’s voice rang out.”
Then, Wang Ping suddenly felt numerous memories appear in his brain, immersing himself in them.”
This feeling was very strange, as if he had truly experienced those ten-plus years, his state of mind had a significant improvement and gained many different life insights through this process.”
Especially for exploring the cultivation experience, he was completely captivated.”
There was also a sense of temporal disorientation.”
It took a long time for Wang Ping to come back to reality.” This feeling was incredibly intriguing, leaving him speechless for a long time.”
“Choosing life experience was indeed the right decision.”
Wang Ping murmured softly.”
The current Wang Ping, although his appearance seemed unchanged, his temperament had altered. He gave off a steady vibe, no longer displaying the obvious restlessness as before.’
If he were to simulate again, as long as he continued to cultivate honestly,
Wang Ping thought he should be able to set foot in the Innate Realm.”
“System, how many Spiritual Stones do I need to start another simulation?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked the system in his heart.” “Eight Lower-tier Spiritual Stones.” The system answered.”
“Indeed, it doubled.” Wang Ping sighed.”
With the doubling of the cost, the number of Spiritual Stones he would need for future simulations might become astronomical.”
Frankly, it was a bit frightening.”
“Wang Ping, it’s time for dinner.”
At this moment, Chifeng entered and spoke to Wang Ping.”
But as soon as he began speaking, he noticed something different about Wang
Ping….

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 21: Special Constitution!
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Special Constitution!
Translator: 549690339
“Eh, Wang Ping, your cultivation…” Chifeng was somewhat astonished.
He could feel that Wang Ping’s Qi and Blood had risen not just a little bit compared to before.
This aura was even stronger than his.
But now, he was in the late stage of the Skin Refining Realm.
Doesn’t that mean that Wang Ping has reached the peak of the Skin Refining
Realm?
This was truly unbelievable.
After all, Wang Ping was still an ordinary person before, not even having the cultivation of the Muscle Training Realm.
“My constitution is special, absorbing Spiritual Stones can improve my cultivation. ”
After considering it, Wang Ping came up with this answer.
His cultivation speed was bound to be astonishing in the future, so he had to find a suitable reason.
At the same time, Wang Ping could also use this reason to ask the village chief for more Spiritual Stones.
Otherwise, relying solely on himself, it would be difficult to get Spiritual Stones.
Without Spiritual Stones, there would be no way to simulate.
“Special Constitution? My grandfather once said that there are many special constitutions in this world, each with different powers. For example, the Fire Spiritual Body can increase cultivation speed and combat power when practicing Fire attribute Cultivation Skills.”
Chifeng looked at Wang Ping with envy and said.
“Wang Ping, having a Special Constitution is great. If I also had a Spiritual
Body, my cultivation speed would definitely be very fast.” “Special Constitution is innate, it cannot be forced.”
Wang Ping smiled, walked over, and patted Chifeng’s head.
“That’s not necessarily the case.” Chifeng’s black eyes were full of longing as he said, “My grandfather told me that some Spiritual Bodies are not innate, but created by powerful cultivators changing their own constitution and passing it down. As a result, their families are also known as Spirit Clans, mysterious and powerful.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping was surprised.
Could it be that powerful cultivators can change their own constitution, create Spiritual Bodies, and even pass them down?
The cultivating system of this world is indeed magical.
“It’s a pity that there were no such powerful people among my ancestors.” Chifeng muttered and clenched his fists: “However, I will definitely become such a powerful person and create a strong Spirit Clan!”
“You have ambition, and I believe you can do it.” Wang Ping smiled and then said, “Alright, let’s eat.”
“Okay!” Hearing this, Chifeng quickly followed.
When the two arrived at the large pot of rice, they were noticed by many people.
For a moment, the villagers looked at Wang Ping with astonished expressions.
“Wang Ping, your cultivation…” Chih Hu was somewhat uncertain.
The village chief was also unable to calm down. After all, Wang Ping was just an ordinary person before.
“My constitution is special and can swallow Spiritual Stones to improve my cultivation.” Wang Ping said the same thing again.
“Special Constitution?” Hearing this, the villagers of Chi Village were shocked. “This Special Constitution that can swallow Spiritual Stones to improve cultivation is too powerful.”
“Special Constitution…” The village chief frowned slightly, muttered to himself, then deeply looked at Wang Ping.
No wonder Wang Ping had asked him for Spiritual Stones, as it turned out he had a special constitution.
However, there were contradictions in this.
After all, if Wang Ping was indeed a Special Constitution, he should have become a powerful person a long time ago, and he wouldn’t have been an ordinary person with a weak physique before.
As for the Wang family not being able to produce Spiritual Stones, it was also unrealistic.
Because Wang Ping’s guards were able to protect him deep into the Black Wind Forest, it meant at least they had Post-Heaven Realm cultivation, and not a small number of them; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to come here.
Having Post-Heaven Realm Martial Artists as guards but not being able to produce Spiritual Stones is a contradictory matter.
However, everyone has their own secrets, and the Village Chief had no intentions to inquire about Wang Ping’s secrets.
In the end, Wang Ping bore no ill-will towards Chi Village, but was full of kindness, and that was enough.
“Good, limitless potential.” The Village Chief patted Wang Ping on the shoulder and said.
Wang Ping knew that the village chief had noticed something wrong, but after absorbing more than a decade of life experience, he wasn’t embarrassed or nervous anymore, just smiled and said, “Village Chief, I don’t know if I can ask you for some more Spiritual Stones, I want to improve my cultivation a bit faster.’
“Yes.” The village chief nodded and said, “Later, I will give you another hundred
Lower-tier Spiritual Stones. Now, let’s eat first.” “Thank you, Village Chief.”
Wang Ping slightly bowed his hand in gratitude.
He knew that Chi Village’s reserve of Spiritual Stones was not much as they were hiding in the Black Wind Forest from the Li Family.
Because Spiritual Mines were precious and mainly controlled by the Xia Kingdom, powerful families, and sect forces.
Very few Spiritual Stones circulated in the market, and it would be hard to exchange them with gold and silver.
Even if they could be collected, it would attract some people’s attention.
This contradicted Chi Village’s low-profile style.
Therefore, Chi Village’s cultivation resources mainly relied on hunting monster beasts, consuming monster beast meat, and processing monster beast Inner Elixirs for cultivation.
The village chief had already given him ten Lower-tier Spiritual Stones before.
Now, not only did he not inquire about his secrets, but he also generously gave out another hundred Lower-tier Spiritual Stones, which was undoubtedly very kind to him.
Feeling grateful, Wang Ping swore to himself that he would definitely save everyone in Chi Village.
“You are our benefactor in Chi Village, there’s no need to say thank you.” The village chief patted Wang Ping’s shoulder and said, “Remember, even if you join a sect or family in the future, try not to reveal your Special Constitution. There are unpredictable people in this world.”
“I understand.”
Wang Ping nodded seriously.
As a transmigrator, he understood this better than anyone.
“As long as you know.” The village chief nodded and said, “Alright, let’s eat.” “Hmm.” Wang Ping smiled and followed.
Next, under the enthusiastic and admiring gazes from the villagers of Chi Village, Wang Ping started to eat and drink heartily.
