Because of his improved cultivation, he could finally eat heartily.
After filling himself with food and drink, the village chief gave Wang Ping a hundred Lower-tier Spiritual Stones.
Moreover, in order for Wang Ping to carry them conveniently, the village chief directly gave him a Lower-tier Storage Ring.
“Village Chief, this Storage Ring is very precious, I can’t take it.”
Wang Ping was both surprised and happy at this, but he quickly responded and wanted to refuse.
“Storage Rings are indeed precious, and only a few Innate Realm cultivators are qualified to have them. However, you will need this even more when you journey outside in the future.”
The village chief said solemnly.
“Wang Ping, don’t refuse, this is also an investment I made in you. Once you grow up, please take care of my Chi Village.”
After a moment, the village chief sighed and spoke again.
Hearing this, Wang Ping was slightly startled, then he no longer declined, accepted the Storage Ring, and said solemnly, “If I live for one day, nothing will happen to Chi Village.”
“That’s good.” The village chief was very gratified.
With Wang Ping’s mysterious background and unique constitution, he was expected to step into the transcendent realm in the future.
Once Wang Ping grew up, they would no longer have to hide in the dangerous
Black Wind Forest..

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 22: Changing Dynasties!
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Changing Dynasties!
Translator: 549690339
Afterward, Wang Ping and Chifeng went back to their room together.
It was late at night, and Wang Ping didn’t have the desire to continue the simulation, so he chose to sleep.
The next day, Wang Ping and Chifeng got up early as usual.
Chifeng was still cultivating diligently.
Wang Ping, holding the little earth dog Huang raised by Chifeng and stroking its head, muttered in his heart, “System, I want to start a new simulation.”
“Ding, the cost of this simulation is 8 Lower-tier Spirit Stones. Do you want to proceed with the simulation?”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Spend it,” Wang Ping said without hesitation.
As the words fell, eight Lower-tier Spirit Stones were removed from Wang
Ping’s Storage Ring, and the system’s voice rang out once more.
“Ding, Life Simulation initiated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for not refreshing any talents.”
Wang Ping:
Wang Ping was truly speechless.
Congratulating me for not refreshing any talents is just absurd.
[Ding, Life Simulation begins.]
The system did not pay heed to Wang Ping’s complaints, and words began to appear on the virtual luminescent screen.
[Daya Calendar 480 Year, March 11, you cultivate hard. At dusk, the village chief and others return, bringing back two Peiyuan Grass and two Gale Leopard corpses. The village chief asked if you want a Peiyuan Grass, and you chose to accept it. The village chief gave you a Peiyuan Grass.]
[In the time that followed, your cultivation did not progress rapidly, leaving the village chief puzzled and disappointed. However, he did not say much, and he continued to treat and cultivate you diligently.]
[Daya Calendar 480 Year, August, the entire Chi Village relocated, and you were left behind in Black Wind Town.]
[Daya Calendar 487 Year, July 10, you escaped to White Wood Village, two thousand miles away from Black Wind Town, and began to cultivate secretly, swearing never to reveal yourself again.]
[Daya Calendar 487 Year, October 8, you learned of Ye Xiaorou’s impending attack but did not do much about it, leading to her death.]
[Daya Calendar 488 Year, January 5, you successfully broke through to the Peak of Viscera Training Stage.]
[Daya Calendar 488 Year, February 15, you felt that it was time to break through to the Post-Heaven Realm and chose to go to Black Rock City to buy a
Post-Heaven Elixir. After swallowing it, you broke through to the Post-Heaven Realm.
“Huh, the speed of cultivation this time has become much faster. “Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and smiled slightly.
Having an extra ten years of life experience indeed brought significant benefits to both interpersonal skills and martial training.
Next, Wang Ping focused on the luminescent screen once again and continued watching.
The words on the screen continued to appear.
[Daya Calendar 488, June 1st, the Ye’s family was annihilated.]
[Daya Calendar 488, November 5th, you successfully broke through to the Post-Heaven Realm. Since the Ye’s family was wiped out, and the Zhao family dominated White Wood Village, the villagers were bullied and oppressed, and you were no exception. Instead of choosing to endure, you secretly took action and wiped out the Zhao family.]
[With the Zhao family wiped out, White Wood Village rejoiced, and everyone was grateful to you. You kept your achievements quiet and continued to cultivate diligently.]
[Daya Calendar 489, July 1st, due to an abundance of Spiritual Stones to aid your cultivation, you made rapid progress and reached the third level of the
Post-Heaven Realm.]
[On this day, fifteen-year-old Ye Chen returned to White Wood Village with a miraculous Post-Heaven Realm cultivation level. He wanted revenge, but learned about the destruction of the Zhao family. With a complicated mix of joy and disappointment, he realized he could not personally take vengeance on his enemies.
[Daya Calendar 491, numerous floods and droughts occurred in various parts of Xia Country, resulting in widespread suffering. With the incompetent Xia Emperor and corrupt ministers ruling, Xia Country began to show signs of chaos. In the same year, your cultivation improved, breaking through to the 7th-tier of the Post-Heaven Realm.]
[What frustrated you was that you had completely used up your Spiritual Stones and could no longer quickly increase your cultivation level.]
[Daya Calendar 493, chaos spread throughout Xia Country, with bandits rampant and heroes at various places starting a rebellion. This also affected
White Wood Village, where a riot started when a rebel army passed through, plundering food from many villagers, including you.]
[Knowing the true nature of the rebel army, you chose not to conflict with them and gave up your belongings and food.]
[Daya Calendar 494, your cultivation broke through to the 8th tier of the Post-Heaven Realm. In the same year, the court sent troops to suppress the rebel army. Hearing the news, you applauded, thinking that these rebels, who oppressed the people, deserved to be wiped out.]
[At the end of Daya Calendar 495, you broke through to the 9th tier of the
Post-Heaven Realm. In the same year, the invincible Spiritual Realm Old Ancestor of the Xia Royal Family passed away, and the vassals could no longer be restrained. They began to rally various forces, establish their own kingdoms, and covet the imperial throne.]
[The court responded with outrage, intending to send a large army to suppress the vassals. However, the vassals had grown too powerful and difficult to suppress. Chaos erupted frequently within Xia Country, and White Wood Village was caught in the turmoil, with many people becoming refugees. You knew that staying here would mean you could not cultivate peacefully.]
[Eventually, you chose to find a relatively safe mountainside, clear some land for farming, and seclude yourself for cultivation.]
[Daya Calendar 497, you successfully advanced to the 10th tier of the
Post-Heaven Realm. In this year, the internal strife in Xia Country escalated, and the court’s army and the vassals both suffered heavy losses. The country was filled with corpses, like a living hell. Chu State, which bordered Xia Country, wanted to send troops to conquer it, intending to annex it.]
[However, Zhao State, which bordered Chu State, did not want Chu to grow stronger by annexing Xia Country, so they stationed heavy troops at the border, forcing Chu State to abandon its plans and also station troops in border cities to prevent sudden invasions by Zhao State.]
[Daya Calendar 499, the Xia Royal Family was overthrown, and the vassals began a civil war to claim the throne. Various factions fought against each other, and the common people suffered. You continued to seclude yourself, trying to break through to the Innate Realm but failed repeatedly. Regarding this, you could only sigh, realizing that breaking through to the Innate Realm was indeed difficult, not unlike Chi Village with only a few Innate Realm powerhouses.]
[Daya Calendar 500, Bai Tianhong, who had reached the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier, couldn’t bear to see the miserable state of Xia Country’s people any longer and intervened. He helped Lord Liu Yu defeat other lords, allowing him to claim the throne.]
(After Lord Liu Yu ascended to the throne, he changed the country’s name to Great Shu. Peace returned to the world, and order gradually resumed.]
[After the world was peaceful, you re-emerged, intending to find a way to break through to the Innate Realm. You were very clear that you were already 45 years old, and if you didn’t find another method soon, the probability of breaking through to the Innate Realm would only get lower, eventually dying old in the Post-Heaven Realm.]
[In the end, you traveled the world and learned about an elixir called the Innate
Elixir. Similar to the Post-Heaven Elixir, it could help Cleanse Marrow for Post-Heaven Realm martial artists and improve the chances of breaking through to the Innate Realm. However, the Innate Elixir was extremely precious, and you, being poor, couldn’t afford it.]
[As a result, you chose to hunt monster beasts to earn Spiritual Stones. However, your talent was mediocre, and you were still not proficient in Martial Arts. Your combat power was weaker than others in the same realm. Although you were very careful and only targeted monster beasts with lower cultivation levels, fate was unpredictable… Two months later, you accidentally encountered a 6th Tier Demonic Beast and died tragically in its jaws.]
[Due to your death, the simulation is complete….]

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 23: Increased Cultivation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Increased Cultivation!
Translator: 549690339
“Died again. But this time, lasted up to the Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier peak, not bad.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and nodded with satisfaction.
Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier peak! There are only a few people who have reached that stage in Chi Village, but in the whole Xia, it can be considered a master.
That’s the perverted part of the simulator; it not only allows people to foresee the future but also allows people’s cultivation to skyrocket effortlessly.
“But this world is really full of dangers everywhere.”
Wang Ping thought of the other contents and sighed a bit.
He dodged Li Huai, dodged the Black Wind Forest Beast Tide, dodged the Famine Rebellion, and dodged the chaos of the rise of many vassals. He finally survived until the dynastic change when the world was at peace, but he died tragically while searching for resources for a breakthrough. It’s a pity.
However, Wang Ping could also understand the thoughts of himself in the simulation.
After all, the Innate Realm is a big checkpoint. If one can pass it, one’s lifespan can be extended to two hundred years, and it’s impossible not to be tempted.
And in the simulation, if he relied on his own grinding and continued to stall, the probability of making a breakthrough was too small, perhaps less than 10%. He had to try his luck.
“This Bai Tianhong is indeed a character.”
Then, Wang Ping thought of Bai Tianhong and praised him.
He single-handedly quelled the Beast Tide and then re-emerged to end the chaotic era directly, causing the Xia to undergo a dynastic change. He was truly amazing.
Wang Ping could also guess that the reason he appeared later was probably to make a breakthrough to the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier. At that level, he was probably an invincible existence within the Xia.
But if he couldn’t break through to the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier, his strength would not be enough, and even if he appeared, there would be no way to deal with it.
“I don’t know where Ye Chen went. Logically speaking, he, who is suspected to have a leading character halo, shouldn’t be so quiet.”
Wang Ping thought of Ye Chen and was a little confused.
“Forget it, it doesn’t matter what happened to him for now. What I need to do is keep simulating to get stronger, that’s all.”
Wang Ping shook his head, discarded his distracting thoughts, and began to look forward to his rewards.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:”
1.Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier peak cultivation.
2.Combat Experience.
3.Practiced Martial Arts.”
“System, I choose O.”
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards, put down Huang from his arms, went back to the room, and spoke in his heart.
As Wang Ping spoke, he felt a fiery sensation throughout his body and heard crackling sounds from within. He felt several times stronger, and the Qi and Blood in his body was astonishing.
At the same time, he felt a mysterious and powerful energy in his elixir field.
“Hoo… What a wonderful feeling.”
Feeling his own strength, Wang Ping smiled.
Ordinary people at the Innate Realm can easily destroy a street with their bare hands, which is extremely powerful.
Although the Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier peak is not as strong as the Innate Realm, it’s not weak either. In Xia, it can be considered a powerhouse.
“Wang Ping, is this…?”
At this point, Chifeng rushed into the room in astonishment, staring at Wang Ping.
“Woof woof!”
At this moment, the little earth dog Huang also wagged its tail and barked with its tail frozen.
“I absorbed a Spiritual Stone and made some breakthroughs.” Wang Ping explained.
“Wang Ping, do you call this just ‘some breakthroughs’? I feel like your cultivation has already reached the Post-Heaven Realm. This cultivation speed is even faster than swallowing exotic fire.”
“Alright, I’m not as exaggerated as you say. You go on with your cultivation.” Wang Ping laughed and waved at him.
“Special Constitution, it’s really abnormal.” Chifeng muttered again before continuing to practice bitterly.
Anxiety surged in his heart.
Wang Ping’s cultivation improvement was so fast that it was a big blow to him.
Just a while ago, Wang Ping was just a weak ordinary person, but now he has directly become a Post-Heaven Realm cultivator, not even swallowing exotic fire was this fast.
After driving away Chifeng, Wang Ping planned to continue with the simulation.
However, the little earth dog Huang kept wagging its tail by his side.
At this, Wang Ping smiled softly, picked Huang up, and continued to stroke his head.
“System, I want to start a new simulation.” Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, 16 lower-tier Spirit Stones are required for this simulation. Do you want to start the simulation immediately?” The system’s voice sounded.
“Spend it.” Wang Ping muttered.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, talent refresh in progress…”
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the White Talent: Beast Tamer; Green Talent Sword Skill Talent.”
White Talent Beast Tamer: With this talent, the host will be able to train some low-level monster beasts for their own use.
Green Talent Sword Skill Talent: With this talent, the host’s talent in swordsmanship will be greatly improved, becoming a genius that stands out among ordinary talents.
“System, I choose Green Talent Sword Skill Talent.”
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up, and he made a choice without hesitation.
Sword Skill Talent is undoubtedly an upgraded version of Sword Skill Genius and the first Green Talent to appear. It was bound to bring him some surprises.
After all, his cultivation had also improved now.
Then, there was still a problem.
His combat power was too weak among his peers.
As his cultivation increased, his combat power became more critical.
[Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins]
The system’s voice sounded, and the virtual luminescent screen also began to display text.
[Daya calendar 480, March 11th, you and Chifeng went to the Drill Ground together. Chih Hu was surprised that he couldn’t see through you, Chifeng casually mentioned your cultivation improvement, causing Chih Hu to be greatly shocked and wonder if it was true.]
[Knowing that your cultivation would be difficult to hide anyway and that revealing it would have benefits, you did not hide it and revealed that you had reached the Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier peak.]
[This revelation left all the children dumbfounded, and Chih Hu opened his eyes wide, even calling you a pervert.]
[The matter of your cultivation gradually spread throughout Chi Village, and the hunting team members were shocked. The village chief was also very happy that your Special Constitution was so abnormal.]
[Then, the village chief wanted to invite you to participate in a hunting experience to get some exposure to real combat. After all, martial artists cannot only focus on bitter cultivation. You did not refuse, as having an elder to teach and protect you, your progress would be faster and safer.]
[You participated in the hunting, showing enough combat experience to surprise everyone. The village chief and the others could see that your combat experience was not bad, not quite what they expected. They were puzzled, not knowing whether you had an outstanding talent or had fought before.]
[As for their doubts, you were not in a position to explain, and they did not make things difficult for you..]

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 24: The Changing Future
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: The Changing Future
Translator: 549690339
[Next, you participated in the hunting all the way, providing great help to the Hunting team. You also demonstrated astonishing sword skill talent, which surprised the people of Chi Village.]
[A few hours later, the village chief led the team to systematically deal with two Gale leopards, luring them away and successfully harvesting Peiyuan grass. And you, witnessing the terrifying battle of an Innate Realm expert for the first time, saw everything in a radius of several kilometers flattened to the ground.]
[In the end, the village chief and others successfully killed the two Gale leopards and triumphantly returned with the team.]
[After returning, the village chief gave you a Peiyuan grass, which you chose to consume. Meanwhile, the people of Chi Village provided you with a Profound mid-tier cultivation skill, the Fire Spirit Skill, which you began cultivating. At the same time, you started learning Chi Village’s sword techniques personally.]
[While teaching you, the village chief also sighed. It was a pity that the Chi Clan had fallen to the point where they only possessed Profound mid-tier cultivation skills and martial arts. Unaware of the village chief’s thoughts, you continued to diligently practice.]
[On June 1, Daya calendar 480, with Chi Village’s help, you consumed many resources and successfully broke through to the Innate Realm, becoming an
Innate Realm expert. You were very excited, and the people of Chi Village were also happy for you.]
“What a big change.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, somewhat emotional.
As his cultivation improved, his treatment changed again. Chih Hu, who was originally going to break through to the Innate Realm, was replaced by him.
Moreover, the village chief no longer had any reservations, teaching him the best cultivation skills and sword techniques in the village.
For this simulation, he wondered how far he could go.
“By the way, Chi Village’s background doesn’t seem simple…”
Soon after, Wang Ping’s gaze flashed to the village chief’s thoughts, his eyes shimmering.
With more than a decade of life experience, Wang Ping had learned the grading of cultivation skills in this world.
From high to low, Cultivation Skill levels were Heaven, Earth, Profound, and Ecliptic.
Heaven-tier skills were entirely legendary, while Earth-tier skills were only possessed by the Xia Royal Family and enormous sects like Sword Spirit Sect.
Families like Li Family that had wiped out the Chi family only had Profound mid-tier skills.
Of course, this was the Li Family of the past; now that the Li Family had a Spiritual Realm expert beyond Innate Realm, they could further progress, perhaps even obtaining Profound high-tier or even Profound top-tier cultivation skills.
After all, a Spiritual Realm expert in Xia was a truly top-tier master.
Only forces with a Spiritual Realm expert could be considered as Ist-tier Influence.
“The village chief seems to look down on Profound mid-tier skills, and the Chi Clan people can’t break through to the Spiritual Realm. It seems like there are many hidden secrets I don’t know about.”
Many thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
“Forget it. There’s no point in thinking about it now. I just need to continue the simulation and become stronger.”
One minute later, Wang Ping shook his head, stopped thinking, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen, with text continuing to emerge.
[On August 1, Daya calendar 480, you felt that the time was ripe, and staying in Black Wind Forest was dangerous. You decided to tell the story of Li Huai. At this moment, your prestige was very high, and the people of Chi Village trusted you. The village chief also believed your words and chose to move the entire village.]
[This time, you told the village chief that you wanted to leave with them. The village chief hesitated for a while, but eventually agreed to your request, taking you with him. You were overjoyed by this.]
Seeing this, Wang Ping was very surprised, as another plot change had occurred…
As expected, the improvement of strength would change many aspects, completely opening up a new life path.
[On August 21, Daya calendar 480, you and the people of Chi Village moved to a remote mountain village to hide. On the same day, Li Huai suddenly appeared. You were extremely shocked and angry, completely unaware of how Li Huai had found the people of Chi Village.]
[You questioned Li Huai. Li Huai sneered, refused to answer, but mercilessly attacked. You, the village chief, and the others fought back hard, but to no avail, ultimately being killed by Li Huai.] [Due to your death, this simulation ended.]
“How on earth did this guy find Chi Village?”
Wang Ping’s expression changed, and his heart was restless.
Despite leaving the Black Wind Forest, they were still found. There was definitely something strange going on in this situation.
Obviously, his previous guess that Li Huai might have accidentally found Chi Village was wrong.
This guy knew where Chi Village was and directly came to find them.
Possibly, the people of Chi Village would be found by him even if they escaped to the ends of the earth.
That is to say, in the previous simulations, the people of Chi Village always met a tragic end of slaughter.
No wonder there was no news from them in those simulations after all those years, and the people of Chi Village never contacted him.
“What method did he use… ‘
Wang Ping frowned tightly, unable to understand.
If he didn’t know how his rival found them, even if his strength improved to a level stronger than Li Huai, it would be useless.
That is because the Li Family not only had one Innate complete realm expert.
The most terrifying part of the Li Family was their Ancestor.
Those in the Spiritual Realm had a 300-year lifespan. The Li Family Ancestor broke through 50 years ago.
By now, the Ancestor’s cultivation must have become more terrifying. Even if Wang Ping broke through to the Spiritual Realm, he might not be a match for the Ancestor.
“This is troublesome.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
Chi Village people had done him a great favor, and he also vowed not to let their clan be exterminated.
So, no matter what method he used, he must find a way to eliminate the Li Family.
“Woof-”
At this moment, Huang seemed to sense Wang Ping’s low mood, and licked Wang Ping, barking at him.
At this, Wang Ping snapped back to reality, petting the head of this little puppy, Huang, and smiling to calm himself down, “There is still a long time before Li Huai’s attack; I don’t need to hurry. Just continue the simulation, and there must be a way to survive.”
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, Host can choose one of the following rewards:
Innate Realm Level 1 cultivation.
Green Talent Sword Skill Talent.
Cultivation Skill and Martial Arts Insights.”
“System, I choose 2.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards and made a decision without hesitation.
By now, it was easy for him to become an Innate Realm expert.
And Green Talent Sword Skill Talent was too valuable to pass up, so naturally, he had to choose this.
Although in the last simulation, this talent didn’t show much effect, it was just because the development time was too short.
If this Green Talent Sword Skill Talent could enable him to comprehend Sword Spirit like Bai Tianhong, then he’d have a better chance of facing the Li Family Ancestor in the future.
Of course, before that, he’d have to deal with Li Huai first.
Otherwise, it would all be for nothing..

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 25: The Mystery Fog of Chi Village
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: The Mystery Fog of Chi Village
Translator: 549690339
As Wang Ping chose the reward, he felt a sense of clarity in his mind, making him feel comfortable.
At the same time, some difficult-to-understand parts of the sword technique also became easier to comprehend.
“Is this the effect of the Green Talent Sword Skill Talent? Indeed, it’s amazing.” Feeling the changes in himself, Wang Ping couldn’t help but exclaim.
He had an intuition that as long as he didn’t die too early, he would eventually be able to comprehend the Sword Spirit just like Bai Tianhong and become an unparalleled swordsman in the world.
“System, I want to start a new simulation.”
Wang Ping settled his mind and spoke at the bottom of his heart.
“Ding, the simulation requires 32 Lower-tier Spirit Stones. Do you want to start the simulation?”
The system’s voice sounded.
This made Wang Ping quite distressed.
This time it cost 32 Lower-tier Spirit Stones.
Next time, he would probably have to spend 64 Lower-tier Spirit Stones, but after this simulation, he would only have 47 Lower-tier Spirit Stones left, which wouldn’t be enough to support the next simulation.
Therefore, he must find a way to survive this time.
“Pay the cost,” Wang Ping said at the bottom of his heart. “Ding, Life Simulator activated, refreshing talent…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing the White Talent – Business Genius; Green Talent Elixir Tao Talent.”
Whitened Talent – Business Genius: With this talent, the host’s ability to conduct business will be enhanced.
Green Talent Elixir Tao Talent: With this talent, the host’s Elixir Tao talent will be improved, becoming a genius in the eyes of ordinary people.
“System, I choose Green Talent Alchemy genius.”
Wang Ping looked at the two talents, his eyes gleaming, and made a decision right away.
Alchemists, in any Profound World, are probably considered a very wealthy profession.
As long as he could master the art of alchemy, he wouldn’t have any issue with spirit stones in the future.
At that time, he wouldn’t need to go through the awkward situation of asking the village head for spirit stones.
As for hunting monster beasts for spirit stones, he could do that, but the efficiency of it would clearly be nothing compared to alchemy, and there would be great risk involved.
So, the Green Talent of Elixir Tao Talent is spot on, and the role it can play is absolutely amazing.
“[Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation has begun.]
The voice of the system sounded again.
[Daya Calendar 480, March 11th, your cultivation reaches the Post-Heaven Realm 10th tier Peak, causing astonishment to all the people of Chi Village.
Following that, you join the village chief and the others in a hunt.]
[Daya Calendar 480, March 12th, you inform the village chief that you have the talent for alchemy and ask if he could provide you with some Elixirs-refining Prescriptions and herbs. The village chief is very surprised, and after some thought, he decides to give you his cherished Elixirs-refining Prescriptions and help you find some herbs.]
[ From then on, you embark on your journey of alchemy.]
[In the following months, you display an amazing talent for alchemy. After only two months of study, you can already refine Ist-tier Elixirs. The villagers are delighted and believe that with you here, Chi Village will grow even stronger.]
[Because of your delay in studying alchemy, you only break through to the Innate Realm on August 5th, 480 of the Daya Calendar.]
[However, after breaking through to the Innate Realm, you start to think about your next move. Unless you venture deeper into the Black Wind Forest and use more powerful monster beasts against Li Huai, it would be impossible to kill him. But even if you kill Li Huai, it would be useless. To save Chi Village completely, you must eliminate the Li Family.]
[After some thought, you come up with a plan. That is, revealing your Sword
Skill Talent and Alchemy Talent to seek protection from a stronger force.]
[In the end, you decide to go to the Sword Spirit Sect, a behemoth in Xia Country, for a tryout. You don’t tell the villagers about this matter and leave
Chi Village alone to go to the Sword Spirit Sect.]
[On August 7th, 480 of the Daya Calendar, you arrive at the gate of the Sword Spirit Sect and state your purpose. Because you’re already an Innate Realm expert in your twenties and you also know alchemy, the Sword Spirit Sect master attaches great importance to you and personally meets you.]
[Eventually, you successfully join the Sword Spirit Sect and become a Guest Elder of the Sect. In the following days, you deliberately show off your sword and alchemy talents, making the sect master value you even more.]
[When you think the time is right, you state your intention and tell the sect master the story of the people of Chi Village, expressing your hope that the Sword Spirit Sect can protect them.]
[You thought things would go smoothly, after all, for a sect like the Sword Spirit Sect, the Li Family doesn’t mean much. But what you didn’t expect is that when the Sword Spirit Sect master hears about Chi Village, he becomes extremely excited, transforming into another person and asks you the whereabouts of the villagers.]
[You notice the abnormal behavior of the Sword Spirit Sect master and realize that things have gone beyond your expectations, so you don’t want to disclose the location of Chi Village.]
[Seeing that you’re ungrateful, the Sword Spirit Sect master suppresses you, destroys your cultivation, and uses Truth Elixir to force you to reveal the location. Due to the effects of the drug, you become an idiot and are dealt with by the Sword Spirit Sect master directly.]
[Because of your death, the simulation has ended.]
“What on earth happened? Why would the Sword Spirit Sect master become so excited upon hearing about the Chi Village people, forcing me to reveal their location without any explanation, then destroying my cultivation and coercing me to take the Truth Elixir.”
Wang Ping’s face was serious as he clenched his fists.
He suddenly realized that the secrets surrounding Chi Village were much deeper than he had imagined.
This seemed to be not just a matter of the Li Family.
What kind of secret is it that attracted the enormous Sword Spirit Sect’s attention?
“Although I’d like to ask the village head, he most likely won’t tell me.” Wang Ping wrinkled his brow, deep in thought.
The secret concerning the Chi Village people is related to their survival.
Although the village head highly values Wang Ping now, he is unlikely to disclose such a critical matter concerning the survival of the entire village.
In that case, Wang Ping would have to find things out slowly on his own.
“Ding, Simulation End, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
Innate Realm 1st stage cultivation.
@. Green Talent Elixir Tao Talent.
Elixir-refining Experience.”
“System, I choose
Looking at the reward list, Wang Ping spoke.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his mind clear up even more.
“From now on, there won’t be enough spirit stones to continue the simulation, and I won’t be able to become stronger.”
Wang Ping left with Huang in his arms, shaking his head.
However, Wang Ping wasn’t in a hurry for now, as there was still plenty of time before the attack came..

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 26: Three Newcomers Join the Group
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Three Newcomers Join the Group
Translator: 549690339
At dawn, Wang Ping and Chifeng arrived at the Drill Ground.
Wang Pings cultivation base significantly astonished Chih Hu.
Just as in the simulation, the entire Chi Village was also shocked by this, with even the village chief expressing his astonishment and joy, and applauding repeatedly.
Next, just as in the simulation, Wang Ping went hunting for monster beasts with the village chief and the others.
The process of hunting the Gale leopard and collecting Peiyuan grass went without a hitch and was very smooth.
The group triumphantly returned to the village.
The village chief, just as in the simulation that had happened many times, handed a Peiyuan grass to Wang Ping and said, “Wang Ping, take this Peiyuan grass.”
“Chief, you should first plant these two Peiyuan grasses in the village. I am very talented in the Elixir Tao, and in the future, I may be able to utilize these two Peiyuan grasses to refine elixirs.” Wang Ping shake his head and said.
“You can refine elixirs?”
This statement made the village chief very surprised.
“I can’t right now, but I will be able to soon.” Wang Ping said with a light smile, extremely confident. “I don’t know if the village has any Elixirs-refining Prescription.”
“We do… Are you sure you want to refine elixirs? It’s a very time-consuming and exhausting task that might delay your cultivation.” The village chief frowned and said with concern.
“Chief, please believe me.” Wang Ping smiled, ” Not to mention, I have a special constitution. I don’t need to seriously cultivate at the moment. I just need to consume spiritual stones to improve my cultivation.”
“Indeed.” Hearing this, the village chief nodded in agreement.
There are countless special constitutions in the world, and he is aware of those similar to Wang Ping’s where one can swallow spiritual stones to enhance their cultivation.
However, those special constitutions he knew were not as dominant as Wang Ping’s, capable of improving cultivation so rapidly.
After all, even if someone can improve their cultivation by swallowing spiritual stones, they should do it slowly, right?
Like Wang Ping, who soared directly from the peak of the Skin-refining Realm to the peak of the 10th tier of the Post-Heaven Realm in a short period, it was unheard of.
“I will give you the Elixirs-refining Prescription later. If you need any medicinal herbs, I will have Hu Zi and the others gather them for you.” The village chief nodded and said.
“By the way, you should have run out of spiritual stones. I have three hundred spare spiritual stones here, feel free to use them.”
After a pause, the village chief said again.
“Thank you, Chief.” Wang Ping didn’t refuse and thanked him with a smile.
The Chief was really good to him, which made Wang Ping more determined to save the people of Chi Village.
“No need for thanks. If you become stronger, we will be safer.” The village chief sighed. “Unfortunately, these are all the spiritual stones we have. Due to some hidden circumstances in our Chi Village, we dare not exchange too many spiritual stones outside. Once we attract attention, it is very dangerous.”
“Chief, why is your Chi Village hiding in the Black Wind Forest and not interacting with the outside world? Could there be any enemies?” Wang Ping asked as if puzzled.
“Indeed, we have enemies.” The village chief hesitated to speak.
“I swear to the heavens, if I grow up, I will definitely protect Chi Village with all my might. I wonder if the chief can reveal some of the hidden circumstances.” Wang Ping said with a serious face.
Seeing Wang Ping suddenly making a vow, the village chief were stunned.
Then, he smiled with relief.
In this world, the Heavenly Tao truly exists.
If martial artists break their vows to the heavens, the consequences are very serious. Although not everyone will be struck by lightning, it is very easy to breed Heart Demons, and then lose their way and die.
Upon hearing Wang Ping’s vow, the village chief felt at ease, believing that he had indeed chosen the right person.
“Our Chi family used to be one of the two major families in White Moon City, with many strong people in the Innate Realm. However, because the elder of the Li family, another major family in White Moon City who is opposed to our Chi family, suddenly broke through to the Spiritual Origin Realm, our entire outer department of the Chi family suffered genocide.”
“In the end, in order to avoid the pursuit of the Li family, I reluctantly led the remaining clansmen into the depths of the Black Wind Forest, using some secret family techniques, ensuring that no monster beasts would approach the surrounding area. At the same time, because this is a deep part of the Black Wind Forest, ordinary Innate Realm martial warriors do not have the ability to rush in. So, it’s safe here.
The village chief said with hatred.
“Chief, isn’t there a deeper reason?” Wang Ping couldn’t help but ask.
If it was just for this reason, he would have known it from the simulation.
He really wanted to know why the Sword Spirit Sect also targeted the people of
Chi Village.
“A deeper reason?” The village chief frowned. “The Li family wiped out our Chi family, wasn’t it because we Chi family was their enemy? After getting rid of us, they can unify White Moon City, occupy all businesses and dominate as the only family.”
“Fine then.” Wang Ping sighed, knowing that he shouldn’t ask any further.
If he asked why the people of the Chi family can’t break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm, and why the Sword Spirit Sect master was also malicious towards the people of the Chi family, he would definitely be suspected by the village chief.
At that time, some really bad things might happen.
So, he could only touch on it lightly.
It seemed that if he wanted to figure out the cause and effect, he could only explore it in the simulation.
Next, after the village chief took out the Elixirs-refining Prescription, he handed it to Wang Ping.
In addition, he also gave all the remaining three hundred spiritual stones to Wang Ping.
For this, Wang Ping thanked the village chief again, and then went back to his room to prepare for the new simulation.
However, it was at this moment that a new group message popped up, making Wang Ping slightly stunned.
“Ding, group member Li Ping (73) has died. The Death Replay has been recorded. All group members should take this as a warning.”
“What’s going on? Why did a group member named Li Ping (73) suddenly appear? It was clearly Zhang Jun who recently joined the group, and his group sequence is 70…”
Wang Ping was a little confused and quickly called up the chat group.
Then, he found out that three new people joined the group today.
They are: Female group member Chen Yao (71).
Male group member Zhang Tao (72).
Male group member Li Ping (73).
The reason there was no notification for joining the group was probably because the chat group judged that he was in a dangerous environment, so the group notice was selectively hidden.
It has to be said that this is quite user-friendly.
If it didn’t have this function, if a group notice popped up while he was in a deadly battle, he might lose his life.
Or if a message popped up while he was practicing, it might cause him to lose his mind and die.
“These three newcomers were quite lucky at the start.”
After reading the chat content, Wang Ping looked a little odd.
Transmigrator Chat Group’s initiation kill is a major factor in the high death rate.
However, these three newcomers were all lucky enough to dodge the initiation kill, their transmigration starting points were pretty good.
Chen Yao’s transmigration location seemed to be a modern society like Wu Jun’s.
But her Golden Finger is much better than Wu Jun’s, it adopts the Point addition system.
Although there are many restrictions, it can be considered as a cheat system.
Of course, being transported to modern society seems to limit the potential of this Golden Finger..

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 27: Too Innocent
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Too Innocent
Translator: 549690339
As for Zhang Tao, the newcomer, his luck was not bad either. He traveled to a world with an ancient background. Whether there were extraordinary powers or not, he hasn’t seen any strange things running around. He managed to find a village and was taken in by a warm-hearted farmer.
As for his golden finger, it was quite ordinary. It allowed him to enhance his physical strength through training.
On the other hand, the death of Li Ping was quite miserable.
He traveled to a place outside the Barbaric Tribe.
Due to hearing about the adventures of No.36 Traveler, after much hesitation, he mustered the courage to try to enter the Barbaric Tribe to develop himself.
However, before he could break in, an unknown arrow shot straight through him, making him explode.
That’s right, it didn’t pierce through a vital part, but his entire body exploded into pieces, utterly miserable.
However, this also meant that the world he traveled to was definitely not simple.
Unfortunately, with Li Ping’s death, no one could know what kind of power system exists in this world anymore.
Wang Ping (66): “Wow, three newcomers have suddenly appeared while I didn’t pay attention for a day.”
Fang Yun (3): “Indeed, it’s surprising. Recently, the frequency of newcomers joining the group has increased significantly. At the same time, it’s also surprising that two newcomers managed to survive this time.”
Fang Yun (3): “That being said, you are responsible for the newcomer’s death.
If it wasn’t for your stories, he wouldn’t have risked it. Smirk.jpg”
Wang Ping (66): “What does it have to do with me! In his situation, whether he went into the Barbaric Tribe or not, the outcome was pretty much the same. It’s hard to survive in the wilderness. Also, Brother Fang, why are you always in the chat group? Don’t you need to cultivate?”
Fang Yun (3): “What do you know? My dream is to become the Dragon King of this group. As for whether I need to cultivate, I just recently broke through to the Innate Realm. I need to relax a bit. I can’t be cultivating all day and night, what’s the point of living then?” Wang Ping (66): “You’re really carefree, huh?”
Wang Ping shook his head.
If you don’t work hard at cultivating, when you encounter danger, you won’t have enough strength to save yourself, then you’ll regret it. This kind of thing happened too many times in the life simulation.
Fang Yun (3): “Wow, you’re really something.”
Wang Ping (66): “I think you should focus on cultivating. Otherwise, when you face danger, it’ll be too late if you don’t have enough strength. I have the ability to foresee the future, and I still haven’t found a way out of this situation. I’ve witnessed various ways to die. Even if I escaped from Chi Village and tried to survive, death was everywhere.”
Fang Yun (3): “Uh…”
Fang Yun was at a loss for words.
Alright, when Wang Ping, who could foresee the future, said this, it was indeed very persuasive.
Wang Ping (66): “By the way, Miss. Liu didn’t show up today, which is quite rare.”
Fang Yun (3): “It’s normal. Liu Mei has a great personality and is basically a newcomer instructor. But after all, she is the Emperor’s favored concubine, so she doesn’t have much time to chat. Maybe, she’s enjoying the time with the Emperor right now.”
Wang Ping (66): ‘
Wang Ping was speechless.
Your argument makes so much sense that I can’t even refute it.
At this moment, a message appeared, attracting Wang Ping’s attention.
Zhang Tao (72): “Another big shot has appeared, a newbie trembling with fear.” Wang Ping (66): “Newcomer, how’s your situation now?”
Zhang Tao (72): “It’s not bad. The old man is very kind, and I’m going to sleep soon. ”
Wang Ping (66): “Okay, just be careful and beware of the old man.”
Zhang Tao (72): “Big shot, I don’t like what you’re saying. The old man is so kind. He not only provided me with the little food he had left but also prepared a place for me to sleep. How can you say bad things about such a good grandfather!”
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t be so emotional. I just think it’s better to be cautious.”
Wang Ping didn’t mind that Zhang Tao thought of him as a villain.
After all, people with a normal moral compass wouldn’t like others to speak ill of their benefactors.
However, Wang Ping still believed in the need for caution.
After all, people’s hearts are unpredictable.
If it wasn’t for the simulator, he wouldn’t have trusted the Chi family so easily and revealed so many secrets.
Fang Yun (3): “Newcomer, Wang Ping is right. Why are you so agitated? The group notice also said, be careful in everything, and don’t trust others too easily.”
Zhang Tao: “I… Ah!
Zhang Tao originally wanted to say something, but the later words were obviously not normal.
This caused Wang Ping and Fang Yun’s pupils to constrict slightly.
That’s because the messages in the chat group were mainly sent by thoughts.
In other words, Zhang Tao’s later ‘Ah!!!’ was clearly due to a sudden encounter with something unusual.
Zhang Tao: “Help, help…save me!!!”
At this moment, Zhang Tao’s message appeared again, directly shouting for help.
This made Wang Ping and Fang Yun’s eyelids jump, knowing that something bad had happened.
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t be scared, first tell us what you encountered.”
Fang Yun (3): “Yeah, calm down.”
“Ding, group member (72) Zhang Tao has died.”
Wang ping (66):
Fang Yun (3):
Wang Ping and Fang Yun both fell silent.
Well, he dies just like that, how miserable.
Wang Ping (66): “Does this count as me having a crow’s beak?”
Fang Yun (3): “What do you think?”
Wu Jun (20): “Wow, what happened? Another newcomer died.”
Zhang Jun (70): “…This is the result of being too relaxed. People are unpredictable. No matter where you are or who you are with, you have to be vigilant. If nothing unexpected happened, he should have been harmed by that so-called kind-hearted old man.”
Fang Yun (3): “I feel the same. Only he had the opportunity. Moreover, the fact that he didn’t kill Zhang Tao right away indicates that it was most likely done by an ordinary person. Anyway, whatever the situation, once the Death Replay appears, we’ll know the reason.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Wow, I didn’t show up for a while, and so many newcomers have died? It’s really miserable.”
Fang Yun (3): “Hey, Mr.Cai appeared. Mr.Cai, what have you been up to? You haven’t shown up for a long time.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “What else can I do? I was in closed-door cultivation. This time I made great progress and gained 10% Saber Intent! Hahaha, I think now I can say that I am invincible in the Innate Realm.” Wang Ping (66): “Saber Intent? Mr.Cai, you’re amazing.”
Wang Ping was really surprised.
After all, he had seen the power of Sword Spirit in the life simulation. Bai Tianhong relied on the Sword Spirit to kill the weakened Tier 7 Demon Beast
Silver Moon Wolf..

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 28: Transcendent Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Transcendent Realm!
Translator: 549690339
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, Mr. Cai, you’re getting stronger and stronger. You’re aiming for the sky here.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Not quite, not quite. Only when I break through to the
Transcendent Realm can I be referred to as a true powerhouse!”
Wang Ping (66): “Transcendent Realm, what kind of realm is that?”
Wang Ping is a bit curious.
He knows that above the Innate Realm is the Spiritual Origin Realm, but he doesn’t know what realm lies above the Spiritual Origin Realm.
Because the strongest in Xia Country is also in the Spiritual Origin Realm. The other two major countries are probably at the same level.
Fang Yun (3): “Wang Ping, we’re not from the same world, why are you asking about this?”
Wang Ping (66): “I’m just curious…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “The divisions of the realms as I currently understand them are Body Refining, Post-Heaven, Pre-Heaven, Spiritual Origin, Transcendent
Great Realm. Of course, although the Transcendent Great Realm is the highest,
I believe there should be higher realms. I just haven’t reached that level yet.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “If the Innate Realm is considered the body cleansing, shedding of impurities, and the birth of Innate True Qi, then, the Spiritual
Origin Realm is the compression of the Innate True Qi in the body into liquid
Spiritual Essence, massively amplifying its power.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “As for the Transcendent Great Realm. It’s a very interesting Great Realm. It includes three realms: Spirit Sea Realm, Spirit Embryo Realm, and Spirit Accumulation Realm.
The characteristic of the Spirit Sea Realm is to expand the Dantian to form a Spiritual Essence ocean and bring a complete transformation to one’s strength, making it hard to be defeated by those of an inferior level. Anyway, there’s a saying: ‘Below Transcendence, all are ants.’
As for the Spirit Embryo Realm, it is nurturing the body with the Spiritual
Essence Ocean, making the body stronger and more adapted to the Spiritual Energy of Heaven and Earth. In this realm, one can enhance cultivation talents, and it brings great fortune. Some people with special talents or cultivation skills can form a Spiritual Body in this realm, which can potentially evolve into a Spirit Clan in the future.”
The final one, the Spirit Accumulation Realm, opens up the Soul Palace, nurtures the soul, and can also utilise Spiritual Sense to survey the surroundings, and it lets one initially communicate with the Spiritual Energy of Heaven and Earth to assist in battle, greatly increasing one’s power.”
Some powerful individuals in the Spirit Accumulation Realm can even store and nurture their own spiritual tools in the Soul Palace, growing together with them, and exerting an enormous power.”
Fang Yun (3): “Fascinating. Damn, I wish I could go to such a world.
Wang Ping (66): “In other fantasy worlds, the Spiritual Body is usually something innate, but here you can actually cultivate it yourself and even pass it onto your descendants. This Spirit Embryo Realm is indeed interesting.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shimmered, his mind was rather unsettled, and he gained a relatively clear understanding of his future cultivation.
Otherwise, if he were to rely solely on Chi Village, there might be some hope of breaking through to the Spiritual Origin Realm, but reaching the Transcendent Great Realm would definitely be impossible.
After all, not a single individual in Xia has reached the Transcendent Great Realm, so there’s no way Chi Village could possess knowledge about the secrets of the Transcendent Great Realm.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Indeed, it’s quite interesting. So, as soon as one becomes a Spirit Embryo Realm strongman, they can propagate a powerful Spirit Clan, and in front of a Spirit Clan, regular geniuses are nothing. -1 ( ‘V’ )
Cai Yonglong (1): “Speaking of which, it reminds me of the descendants of the Spirit Clan in my sect, who all became True Inheritor Disciples without much effort. If I didn’t have my Golden Finger, I would probably be ground into dust by them once I break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm and become a True Inheritor Disciple.”
Fang Yun (3): “Stop being a wuss, you’re Mr. Cai, a man destined to be invincible.”
Cai Yonglong (1) @Fang Yun (3): “Get out of here and play in the mud! My Golden Finger isn’t the type to let people become strong easily. It’s still very stressful, you know. Fortunately, not every descendant of the Spirit Clan can awaken a Spiritual Body, otherwise, there’s no chance I could be the champion in the Inner Sect Competition.”
Fang Yun (3): “Mr. Cai, you’ve changed. You’re no longer the self-confident and invincible guy I used to admire. You’re a wimp now, I decide to stop being your fan. Evil_smile.jpg.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Huh? Who did you say is a wimp? Where’s my knife!?”
“Ding, the death replay of Zhang Tao (72) has been recorded.”
At this moment, the system’s voice rang out, drawing everyone’s attention, as they silently clicked to watch.
Wang Ping also opened the video and used fast play mode to focus on the key plot points.
Soon, he came to understand the whole story.
Even if Zhang Tao in the video was just an obvious high school student, he failed to notice anything odd about the elderly family.
As soon as Zhang Tao set foot in the elderly family’s home, they occasionally gave glances at the backpack full of supplies he was carrying, with the descendants of the family sporadically swallowing saliva.
Apparently, they were enticed long ago.
In the end, when they got Zhang Tao to eat some thin porridge and rest, they started to cautiously discuss.
The contents of their conversation were pretty straightforward. Looking at Zhang Tao’s tender and fair-skinned face, they were convinced that he was a rich merchant’s son or a noble’s son, and he was definitely carrying valuable stuff with him.
Given the famine, they were close to being unable to make ends meet.
To survive, even if it meant attacking the son of a noble, they were willing to take action.
The result was that Zhang Tao, who was distracted by chatting in the chat group, was held down and had his throat slit by the family, and was ultimately decapitated, with them even covering his mouth to stifle any sound, with the whole process being rather neat and quick.
Soon, the chat group became lively.
Fang Yun (3): “That’s what I always say, there’s danger everywhere after transmigrating. Some people just don’t like to listen. Well, he’s gone now, got his head chopped off.
Zhang Jun (70): “Nothing much to say, laying low.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Tsk, high school students are still too naive. Any grown-up could see the malice in that family.”
Wang Ping (66): “Not all high school students are so naive. This Zhang Tao was just simply too naive. However, even if he had been more careful after entering the family, it is estimated he still could not have survived.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Indeed. During a famine, human nature can be terrifying. Even incidents of parents resorting to cannibalism can occur. Let alone just killing a stranger. Perhaps, even if the family didn’t kill him, the others in the village would have. If there are no accidents, not only will the family benefit from his food bag, but they will probably also eat him.”
Chen Yao (71): “….At first, I thought I was unfortunate, but it seems I am somewhat lucky…”
Fang Yun (3): “Eh, a girl has surfaced. How’s it going, do you get sliced? 0(*
Chen Yao (71): ‘ .
wu Jun (20) @Fang Yun (3).? “Brother Fang, I beg you, stop being so malicious, be human for once.

chapters.title: Chapter 29 - 29: Demons’ World
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Demons’ World
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66) @Chen Yao (71): “Sis, don’t bother with this guy. Just tell us about your situation.”
Chen Yao (71): “For now, there’s no immediate danger… However, my identity as a transmigrator has been exposed. I don’t know what’ll happen in the future.’
Cai Yonglong (1): “With that kind of entrance, it’d be hard not to attract attention. Speaking of, have you exposed our chat group yet?”
Chen Yao (71): “No… Even though they have the ability to detect if I’m lying, I only told them that a choice to transmigrate suddenly appeared, and I chose to accept it. That doesn’t count as lying.”
Wang Ping (66): “You’re awesome, girl.”
Wang Ping was somewhat impressed by Chen Yao. She was probably an important figure before transmigration and had a high IQ; she didn’t seem panicked at all.
If it were an ordinary person, they would have been panicking and likely would have spilled everything.
Chen Yao (71): “Moving forward, I’ll cooperate with them fully and learn some things about this world from them. It appears that this world is far from ordinary. ”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Interesting, what’s your world like?”
Chen Yao (71): “It’s a world where martial artists and demons coexist. In terms of novels, it probably belongs to the category of High Martial World.”
Wang Ping (66): “Huh, you’re actually familiar with High Martial? It’s quite rare for a girl to read this kind of story.”
Chen Yao (71): “I’m one of the few. Honestly, I feel like I’m in danger, not from the government, but from the demons hiding among people. The human situation in this world isn’t very good.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “That’s normal, isn’t it? In High Martial novels, humans usually have the advantage. But don’t worry too much. Since the human situation isn’t great, they won’t harm you. In fact, they’ll need to treat you well.
Maybe you’re their hope.”
Fang Yun (3): “Mr. Cai has a point. I thought you’d transmigrated to a city, making your point addition system quite overpowered. But it seems I was overthinking. You’re about to rise, beat the demons, become the Empress of the Human Race and reach the peak of life.”
Fang Yun (3): “I get it now. In the future, Chen Yao is going to be the strongest in this group. I bow down to you. Who’s Mr. Cai? I don’t know him! 0(*
Cai Yonglong (1):
Cai Yonglong (1): “Alright, you’re getting cocky. Just you wait until we unlock the group feature for the Arena, then I’ll show you why flowers are so red.”
Fang Yun (3): “Erm, Mr. Cai, I’m sorry, I was just joking. Believe me! I’m your loyal little brother!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Hehe, it’s too late. My blade is already drawn!”
Chen Yao (71): “… Empress and whatnot, I haven’t thought that far. Right now, I just want to focus on survival. I should be under surveillance from all sides.
I’m going to lay low for now.”
Wu Jun (20): “Alright, no more chatter. Back to bricklaying. I’m exhausted. When will I reach the Early Stage of Muscle Training? I won’t be this tired when I reach it.”
Fang Yun (3): “This guy cultivating just to lay bricks, kind of ridiculous.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Speechless. Taking pity on you for being so pitiful, I’ll get you some Qi and Blood Elixirs later, so you can break through faster.”
Wu Jun (20): “Boohoo, I’m so touched. Mr. Cai, you’re like my real brother. Wait, no, my real brother hasn’t treated me this well. From now on, you’re my dad!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Sigh, ever since transmigrating, I haven’t had a chance to send my dorm mates their meals, and I haven’t heard anyone call me ‘dad’ in a while. That ‘dad’ felt good.”
Fang Yun (3) @Cai Yonglong (1): “Wow, Dad, can you send me thousands of
Spiritual Stones while you’re at it?”
Cai Yonglong (1) @Fang Yun: “Thousands of Spiritual Stones? Are you out of your mind? Calling me ‘dad’ or even ‘grandpa’ won’t help.”
Fang Yun (3): “I get it. You’re just showing favoritism. You think Wu Jun can satisfy you, so you’re treating him well.”
Wu Jun (20): “What the hell?!”
Wang Ping (66): ‘
Wang Ping wasn’t sure what to say after reading their chat.
But he was feeling nostalgic; during his school days, it was like this too.
Men’s relationships are strange. Whoever brings food becomes the ‘dad’ of the day.
At internet cafes, whoever carried the team is the ‘dad’, and whoever messed up is the ‘tortoise grandson’.
Though many times, the more they played, the quieter they became. In the morning, they went their separate ways, but it didn’t stop the cycle of taking turns to be the ‘dad’ the next day.
Cai Yonglong (1) @Wang Ping: “Wang Ping, do you need some Qi and Blood
Elixirs? They’re cheap, I can get some for you too.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, Mr. Cai, you’re playing favorites! I want some too!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “You reached the Innate Realm, what do you want them for?
Get lost!”
Wang Ping (66): “Thanks for the offer, Mr. Cai. But I’m doing well right now. The people from Chi Village are strong and willing to teach me cultivation. I have a daily supply of demon meat and plenty of Qi and Blood.”
Fang Yun (3):
Fang Yun (3): “Life’s luck really varies from person to person. You’re enjoying life, freeloading like crazy! I admit, I’m jealous. I’ve decided. Later I’ll donate to charity and heal my wounded, young heart.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Jealous my ass! You donate your ass! You’ll most likely end up dying in a woman’s belly.”
Cai Yonglong (1) @Wang Ping (66): “No need for that then. But, what’s the cultivation system like in your world?”
Wang Ping hesitated for a moment upon seeing Cai Yonglongs question.
This was a difficult question to answer or not answer.
As of now, Cai Yonglong’s personality appeared to be very good, and it seemed unnecessary to hide from him any longer.
Moreover, both their locations must be very far away from each other, and may not even be on the same continent.
If he told him that they were both in the same Profound World, it might benefit them both.
Plus, he had the Life Simulator, so he didn’t have to worry about Mr. Cai having any ill intentions.
The chat group wasn’t subject to simulation, but if people in the same Profound World met, it should be possible to simulate it.
Besides, Wang Ping’s other source of confidence was his OP growth rate granted by the Life Simulator.
Given his rate of growth, he would surpass Cai Yonglong before long..

chapters.title: Chapter 30 - 30: Purple Spirit Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Purple Spirit Realm
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “My situation is the same as Mr. Cai’s.”
Fang Yun (3): “Oh, the same?”
Fang Yun (3): “Wait, did you just say the same!?”
Wu Jun (20) (Co)!
Cai Yonglong (1): “The same… You also went through body refining, then Houtian, Xiantian, Spiritual Origin and Transcendent Realm?
Somewhere, Cai Yonglong, who was drinking tea, almost spat out all the spiritual tea in his mouth, looking completely stunned.
Wang Ping (66): “Yes. So, I suspect that we should have traveled to the same Profound World.’
Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn, why didn’t you say so earlier?”
Wang Ping (66): “I wasn’t sure until now. It was only after I asked Miss. Liu for cultivation skills last time that I started to be somewhat sure. When you mentioned the Spiritual Origin Realm, I finally confirmed it.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “That’s amazing. So we can travel to the same world? I thought all the group members would travel to different worlds. This is interesting, maybe we can actually meet up face-to-face.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, I’m so envious! If Mr. Cai and Wang Ping go on an adventure together, it must be thrilling. Foreshadowing the future, easily avoiding danger, and knowing where opportunities lie.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Amazing! Little Yun, now that you mentioned it, I’m excited! Wang Ping, what do you think, should we go on adventures together in the future! Oh, no, I mean, go to the secret realm!”
Wang Ping (66): “Umm… Although we are in the same Profound World, we may not be on the same planet or continent. After all, there must be upper planes in the Profound World, and then a bunch of lower planes connected to them.” Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn, what you said makes sense, and I’m speechless. But, you can at least tell me where you are, and I can try to find out if it’s the same world. Anyway, I’m in the Purple Spirit Realm, in the Sword Domain of the Ten Desolate Eastern Regions, and the place I’m in is governed by the Heavenly
Sword Divine Land.”
Wang Ping (66): “Sorry, I don’t even know where I am. All I know is that I’m in a country called Xia. There are two neighboring countries: Chu State and Zhao
State. Then there’s the ocean.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
He had more than a decade of life experience.
Among them, there were naturally some memories related to geography.
Frankly, the map of the area he was in was quite small.
The Central Plains covered three countries: Xia, Chu, and Zhao.
Outside the territory of the three countries, there were either plateaus or barren hills. Those who lived in these areas were exotic races, eyeing the three countries greedily.
Further away was the boundless ocean.
Of course, when I say small, it’s relative. In fact, the area he was in was not smaller than the Eurasian continent. Cai Yonglong (1): “Well, that’s it?”
Wang Ping (66): “That’s all I know.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Alright, there’s not much we can deduce from this information.
Fang Yun (3): “Mr. Cai’s false happiness, I can’t stop laughing!” Cai Yonglong (1): “Are you laughing at me, you bastard? Take this!”
Fang Yun (3): “Hehe, someone’s getting irritated, I won’t say who.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Fine, you just wait, see you at the Arena later, I won’t rest till I beat you up!”
Wang Ping (66): “…I’ve memorized Cai’s location, and I’ll inquire later if there’s any place called Heavenly Sword Divine Land or Sword Domain in this world.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Alright, if we really are in the same world, it would be quite a coincidence, and we must go on adventures together in the future!”
Fang Yun (3): “Heh, you’ve changed, Mr. Cai.”
Cai Yonglong (1)@Fang Yun (3): “Little Yun, you’re really looking for trouble.” Looking at the chat content, Wang Ping could not help but smirk.
Fang Yun was a real scoundrel, always feeling like he’d get beaten up sooner or later.
Wang Ping (66): “I have something to do, so I’ll go AFK.”
Then, Wang Ping went offline directly.
“System, I want to start a new simulation!”
Then, Wang Ping spoke to the system in his heart.
“Ding, this simulation will cost 64 lower-tier spirit stones, do you want to proceed?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Proceed!”
Wang Ping spoke from the bottom of his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator is starting, Talent Refresh in progress…”
“Ding, congratulations to the host for refreshing White Talent: a benign face; White Talent: Desiring to being a Devil.”
White Talent: a benign face – Having this talent, when showing a smile during communication, others are more likely to believe you.
White Talent: Desiring to being a Devil – With this talent, the host can only follow the Demon Path. However, there will be additional bonuses when cultivating Demonic Tao skills.
“System, I choose White Talent: a benign face.”
Wang Ping glanced at the two talents and unhesitatingly chose the White Talent: a benign face.
A single white talent wasn’t enough to make him fall into the demonic path.
And the talent of having a benign face would be of great use for his next plan, undoubtedly the most suitable talent choice.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation starting…”
“Daya calendar 480, March 11th, you start studying alchemy.”
“In the following months, you display an amazing alchemy talent. After studying for two months, you can refine Ist-tier elixirs. The villagers are very happy, believing that with you around, Chi Village will grow stronger.”
“Due to your research on alchemy, your cultivation is delayed, and you only break through to the Innate Realm on August 5th of 480.”
“However, after breaking through to the Innate Realm, you decide to go out for practicing, as it would be more conducive to alchemy and cultivation. You promise to come back to protect Chi Village once you have achieved success in cultivation. The village chief is very surprised and thinks your choice is correct. Staying in Chi Village, you wouldn’t have the conditions to succeed in alchemy.”
“Daya calendar 480, August 7th, you come to the Li Family, stating your intentions and expressing your desire to join the Li Family. Due to being an Innate Realm powerhouse in your twenties and being proficient in alchemy, the Li Family Master is extremely delighted and treats you with great respect, making you a guest elder of the Li Family, with a high salary.”
“After all, a twenty-something Innate Realm genius and an alchemist would be valued even in the Sword Spirit Sect. The fact that you’re willing to join the Li Family is like a goose laying golden eggs falling right into their lap.”
“In the following days, you perform well in the Li Family, and with the help of the White Talent: a benign face, you gain the respect of the entire Li Family, with no one daring to be disrespectful to you.”
“August 21st, you hear the news that Li Family’s elder Li Huaixin kindly brought back some child beggars and planned to train them as servants, allowing them to have food to eat..”</p

chapters.title: Chapter 31 - 31: Secrets of the Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Secrets of the Bloodline
Translator: 549690339
Seeing Li Huai appear, Wang Ping narrowed his eyes.
At the beginning of his simulation, his intention was to investigate the Li family and find out why they could easily locate the Chi Village people and also to clarify why he didn’t kill the children.
[You are furious and want to find a way to confront Li Huai. However, you don’t act rashly or have any intention to meet the Chi family. Because if you did, you would surely expose yourself and put yourself in great danger.]
[You suppress your anger and continue to cultivate and study alchemy. You believe that as long as your strength improves, another investigation will eventually reveal the truth.]
[In the blink of an eye, three years have passed. During these three years, you have been cultivating diligently, improving to the Innate Realm 3rd Tier and making great progress in your alchemy, capable of refining 2nd Tier Elixirs. At the same time, your sword skill realm has also improved greatly.]
[Your talents have made the Li family value you even more. The Li Family Master decided to betroth his granddaughter Li Yan to you, in an effort to tie you firmly to the Li family’s chariot. In order to investigate the truth, you choose to marry Li Yan.]
[After your marriage to Li Yan, you gain the Li Family Master’s favor, and are finally granted access to the family’s treasured 3rd Tier Elixir-refining Prescription for research. At the same time, you are also permitted to cultivate the Li family’s Profound-tier Superior Martial Skill, the Refining Spirit Sword Manual.]
[On the surface, you show a kind and gentle demeanor, full of gratitude, but deep down, you laugh coldly, vowing to use the Li family’s Martial Arts to exterminate the entire Li family once your power is sufficient.]
[On Daya calendar 490, May 1st, with the help of abundant Spiritual Stones and Elixirs, your cultivation successfully advances to the Innate Realm 6th Tier. At the same time, under the influence of Green Talent Sword Skill Talent, after years of training, you successfully reach the consummate realm of the Profound-tier Superior Martial Skill, the Refining Spirit Sword Manual, and even gain insight into the Sword Spirit Protoform. Although the Sword Spirit Protoform is still far from the true Sword Spirit, you have a clear direction and have surpassed countless swordsmen.]
[At the same time, your alchemy skills have also made astonishing progress and you can easily refine Tier 3 Pills.]
[You have never revealed your true strength. However, relying on your alchemy, you raise the overall strength of the Li family, expanding their power at an alarming rate.]
[The Li Family Master’s position becomes more stable due to your presence and everyone respects him. He is very happy and often boasts about how he found a good grandson-in-law, making the Li family elders extremely envious. Your position in the Li family is now like the sun at noon, and even Li Huai treats you with courtesy.]
[In Daya calendar 495, Xia begins to experience chaos and uprisings. During these five years, your cultivation has progressed further, successfully advancing to the Innate Realm 7th Tier. In terms of sword skill training, your Sword Spirit Protoform is even more refined, just one step away from comprehending true Sword Spirit. However, what has improved even more is your alchemy. Your alchemy skills have finally improved, reaching the level of a 4th Tier Alchemist, capable of refining 4th Tier Elixirs.]
[As a 4th Tier Alchemist, your status completely surpasses ordinary Spiritual
Realm experts and is highly esteemed across the entire Xia. Even the Sword Spirit Sect – the dominant sect – and the Xia Royal Family treat you with utmost courtesy and dare not neglect you in the slightest.]
[Your presence allows the Li family’s power to continue growing rapidly, making other major powers envious. The Li Family Master often claims that his son-in-law possesses the talent of a Pill King, leaving others speechless
and envious.]
[On Daya calendar 495, August 1st, perhaps sensing that the time is right and having completely integrated you into the Li family, the Li Family Master and the Supreme Elders bring you to the Li family’s basement.]
[Then you witness a scene that enrages you. The children from back then have all grown up, their memories erased by the Li family’s Elixirs, and are being kept like livestock for breeding.]
“Li family!” Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, clenched his fist, and was filled with anger.
A few seconds later, Wang Ping took a deep breath, calmed his anger, and continued to read.
He knew that the moment to unravel the mystery was coming.
As Wang Ping continued to focus, more content appeared on the luminescent screen.
[Next, with the explanation of the Li family, you finally learn the truth. It turns out that after the Li family exterminated the Chi family years ago, they accidentally discovered the Chi family’s hidden secret: their bloodline.]
[The Chi family members are from the Spirit Clan, a hidden Spirit Clan. Their bloodline can be used for alchemy, and with enough Chi family bloodline and a 4th-tier Alchemist, Blood Spirit Elixirs can be refined. These Blood Spirit
Elixirs can give the person who consumes them a Special Constitution of the
Spirit Clan and also have amazing effects on helping break through the
Transcendent Realm.]
[Back then, when the Li family learned this secret, they regretted killing all the Chi family members. If they had kept them alive for breeding, they could have produced numerous Blood Spirit Elixirs.]
[However, after conducting a population survey, the Li family discovered that the Chi family wasn’t completely extinct and that some members had escaped. This made them extremely overjoyed, and they secretly searched for the whereabouts of the Chi family members. Despite eighty years passing, there was still no news.]
[In the end, the Li family even contacted the Sword Spirit Sect to find the Chi family members with the sect’s help. Because the current Sword Spirit Sect Master’s wife was a member of the Li family, the daughter of the Supreme
Elder, and the sister of the Li Family Master.]
[Eventually, even the Sword Spirit Sect couldn’t find any trace of the Chi family, which greatly annoyed the Li family.]
[As you listen to the Li family’s explanation, filled with cold rage, you pretend to be curious and ask how they managed to find them.]
[Li Huai answers your question. They accidentally obtained a Secret Skill called Blood Demon Tracking Skill, which allowed them to track an individual’s location with just a sample of their blood. However, this secret skill could only be used to track Spirit Clan members, and it had significant limitations — it could only track areas with a large concentration of similar bloodlines, not individual people. They were able to find Chi Village through the Blood Demon Tracking Skill, using the blood of the deceased Chi family members.]
[After listening to their explanations and their comments about how “sly” the Chi Village people were for hiding deep in the Black Wind Forest, you are filled with both anger and trepidation, finally understanding why Li Huai was able to continuously find the Chi family members and only killed the adults, leaving the children behind.]
[Because children can be raised and their existence concealed from other powers using the excuse of adoption. Bringing back too many adults would definitely raise suspicions.. The Li family probably wants to monopolize the bloodline and not let the Sword Spirit Sect discover their secret!]

chapters.title: Chapter 32 - 32: Glorious Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Glorious Past
Translator: 549690339
“So that’s how it is, that’s what happened…”
Wang Pings eyes were cold, and his fists clenched.
He had heard about the Transcendent Realm and the Spirit Clan from Cai Yonglong when they were chatting in the group before.
However, he never expected that the Chi family was actually the descendants of the Spirit Clan.
No wonder the Li Family targeted the Chi family, and no wonder the Sword Spirit Sect Master was overjoyed after learning about the Chi Village people from his mouth, directly disabling him and feeding him Truth Elixir to get information…
No wonder Li Huai only killed adults and not children, it was all because the Chi family were descendants of the Spirit Clan.
The bloodline of the Spirit Clan is too powerful and precious, bringing them great potential while also making them desirable to others.
If their family falls and there are no strong people to deter others, their bloodline value would be in jeopardy and countless hungry wolves would pounce upon them.
“However, why can’t the Chi family, as descendants of the Spirit Clan, break through to a higher realm? There must be some hidden secrets.”
Wang Ping recalled some other hidden aspects of the Chi family and murmured.
After all, the Chi family were descendants of the Spirit Clan. Even if their bloodline had become diluted and their Spirit Blood wasn’t manifesting, it shouldn’t be impossible for them to break through to the Spiritual Origin
Realm.
There must be other hidden elements that he is not aware of.
“Could it be that some powerful person has planted a bloodline curse or some other secret skill?”
Wang Ping was thinking when he suddenly thought of this possibility.
After all, this Profound World is full of wonders. The Li Family had previously acquired a magical secret skill like the Blood Demon Tracking Skill, so it’s quite normal for there to be secret skills like bloodline curses.
With his extensive readings, the probability of such a secret skill being planted is over 80%.
No wonder the village chief said in self-mockery that he could only come up with a Profound mid-tier cultivation skill…
It’s likely that the Chi Clan used to be incredibly powerful, but something happened, leaving them to decline and being viciously cursed by their enemies.
In the end, a small part of their clansmen were forced to migrate and settle in the Xia Empire. They developed into a second-rate family in White Moon City but were still destroyed by the Li family and had to hide in Black Wind Forest, fearing being discovered by the Li family. With this explanation, everything makes sense.
“What a complicated past indeed.”
Wang Ping sighed lightly.
No wonder the village chief always looks depressed. With such a history and the constant danger they’re in, it’s no wonder that he is.
Only after he had shown enough potential did the village chief value him so much in hope that he would eventually grow strong enough to reach the Transcendent Realm. Then the village chief hoped Wang Ping could protect the remaining villagers.
Only a cultivator of the Transcendent Realm can fully protect the villagers of Chi.
Otherwise, anyone who discovers the secret of their bloodline would go crazy for it. Only a Transcendent Realm powerhouse would not care.
Some Spirit Clan descendants with unremarkable bloodlines wouldn’t warrant their attention.
Because once these powerful people reach the Spiritual Fetus Realm, they can reproduce and create a powerful Spirit Clan, becoming the ancestor of the clan and dominating one side.
