“Now that I know these secrets, I have a way to avoid the dangers. Next, I can finally save Chi Village.”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
Next, all he needs to do is to have the Chi villagers disperse. In that case, the probability of them being found will be minimized.
After all, the Blood Demon Tracking Skill can only track locations with a large amount of similar bloodlines gathered together and cannot track individuals. “However, this is a last resort. The real way to protect Chi Village is for me to become strong enough and completely exterminate the entire Li Family, and also get the Blood Devil Tracking Skill to prevent it from spreading.’
Wang Ping clenched his fists, his eyes deep and solemn.
“Moreover, the Sword Spirit Sect is also an opposing force for me. Because of this, I must prepare myself to confront them as well.”
“Bai Tianhong…”
Soon after, Wang Ping fell silent again.
Having simulated so many times, he actually had a good impression of Bai Tianhong.
He was an exceptionally talented person, and at just 25 years old, he had already reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm cultivation, and even comprehended Sword Spirit.
To save millions of people, he withstood a battle against the Tier-7 Demon Beast Silver Moon Wolf with only his Half-step Spiritual Realm cultivation, eventually severing the Beast Tide by heavily injuring and executing the monster.
It could be said that in this battle, he must have risked his life as well.
Furthermore, later on, he ventured out to protect the common people from war, ending the chaos, overthrowing the decayed Xia, and bringing about peace to the world.
This was a genius sword cultivator and a chivalrous person.
But, he was a member of the Sword Spirit Sect.
Perhaps he and the Sword Spirit Sect Master were not the same, but if he were to confront the Sword Spirit Sect, it might be inevitable for him to face Bai Tianhong.
“Forget it, there’s no need to overthink it. After all, I can barely interfere with Wang Ping in the life simulation. He’s like an Al with self-awareness, growing and changing his personality, equivalent to me without a simulator. As for how the future will unfold, I can’t be certain.
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, not thinking about it anymore.
After all, how things will develop can be known through the life simulation, and he doesn’t need to dwell on anything.
Then, Wang Ping gazed at the luminescent screen again, wanting to see how the plot would develop next.
As Wang Ping gazed at the luminescent screen once more, the text on it emerged again.
[In your angry heart, the Li Family Master expresses his wish for you to lead other 3rd -Tier Alchemists in researching the Chi family members’ bloodlines to develop a Blood Spirit Elixir-refining Prescription and refine the Blood Spirit Elixir. You chose to agree on the surface.]
[Following this, you claim you need seclusion to study the Elixir’s Prescription. A month later, you find an opportunity to gather all the higher-ups of the Li Family, announcing that you have gained some insights. The Li Family’s higher-ups rejoice. You toast in celebration, claiming you’ll make the Li Family rise above everyone in Xia.]
[The rest of the Li Family are ecstatic, their ambitions unreservedly exposed;
all of them raise their wine cups with you and drink it all. After drinking it, they realize something’s wrong, but it’s too late; their bodies are already poisoned and can’t move.]
[The Li Family Master looks at you in disbelief, questioning why you’ve poisoned them. You don’t waste your words but quietly leave. Although the Chi Village has been kind to you, after so many years in the Li Family, you’ve also developed feelings for them and can’t bear to kill them.]
[Next, you go to the underground chamber, where you euthanize all the captive Chi family members and destroy the Li Family’s collection of Chi family’s bloodlines.]
“Sigh…”
Upon reaching this point, Wang Ping let out a silent sigh.
The simulated Wang Ping must have struggled for a long time before making such a decision.
After all, the captured Chi family members had already lost their personalities, and their lives were worse than death.
And the simulated Wang Ping had no chance to rescue them all.
As for helping the Li Family refine the Blood Spirit Elixir and continue with their sordid plans, that was also something he couldn’t bear to do.
As for pretending that refining the Blood Spirit Elixir was difficult to buy time, that wouldn’t work either.
Moreover, he wouldn’t be able to stall for long because people are all flesh and blood, and because Wang Ping might be able to temporarily suppress his emotions and use the blood of the Chi family members to research the Blood Spirit Elixir, preventing the Li Family from becoming suspicious…
But, as time passed, the Li Family members might notice his hidden emotions and Wang Ping might end up going mad during his own cultivation..

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - 33: Choosing the Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Choosing the Reward
Translator: 549690339
“If I destroy the bloodline, the Li Family will definitely be furious. I don’t know if I can escape alive.”
Wang Ping looked at the luminescent screen again, muttering to himself.
As Wang Ping looked over, the words on the screen reappeared.
[Next, you escape from the Li Family, shrink your body and change your appearance to hide and evade the Li Family’s pursuit.]
[Not long after, your actions are exposed. The reclusive Li Family Ancestor, after hearing the news, is enraged to the extreme. Your wife, Li Yan, faints in disbelief, unable to accept that you would commit such a heinous act.]
[Following this, the Li Family Ancestor offers a massive bounty on you, issuing a kill or capture order to the entire world. The entire Xia is shaken, and everyone is dumbfounded, never expecting that you, a 4th-tier alchemist, would betray the Li Family.]
[As time goes on, your fame even spreads to the Chu and Zhao States, making you well-known across the land. However, you don’t care, and continue to hide in obscurity, waiting to reemerge once your strength is enough.]
[Because you’re proficient in alchemy and can change your own body and appearance, you are not discovered while keeping a low profile.]
[At the end of Daya Calendar year 495, the Spiritual Realm Old Ancestor of the Xia Royal Family passes away, the vassals can no longer hold back, attempting to gather forces, establish themselves as kings, and covet the throne.]
[Among them, the Li Family also begins to support the northern vassal, Liu Yu.]
[Soon afterward, the imperial court is furious and wants to send troops to suppress the vassals. However, the vassals are too powerful, and it is difficult to suppress them. Chaos ensues in Xia territory. You continue to maintain a low profile, abiding your time to protect yourself. With the 7th-Tier Innate Realm cultivation, you’re not worried about dying in the chaos of Xia as long as you don’t expose yourself.]
[In Daya Calendar year 497, you break through to the 8th Tier of the Innate Realm. This year, the turmoil in Xia becomes even more terrifying, with heavy losses suffered by the imperial forces and vassals. Dead bodies are strewn across the land, and it can be called a living hell. The Chu State, neighboring Xia, intends to send troops to conquer Xia and annex it.]
[However, the Zhao State, neighboring Chu, does not want Chu to annex Xia and strengthen itself. As a result, they send a large number of troops to the border, forcing Chu to abandon its ambitions and station troops in the border city, preventing sudden invasion by Zhao.]
[At the end of the Daya Calendar year 499, your cultivation progresses further, reaching the Innate Realm 9th Tier. In the same year, the Xia Royal Family is overthrown, and the vassals begin a civil war to claim the throne. The various parties wage war on each other, causing great suffering to the common people.]
[In the Daya Calendar year 500, Bai Tianhong, who had broken through to the 7th Tier of the Spiritual Realm, could no longer bear to see the misery of the people of Xia and chooses to intervene, helping the vassal Liu Yu defeat the other vassals and ascend the throne.]
[After Liu Yu ascends the throne, he changes the name of the country to Shu, grants Bai Tianhong the title of Sword Saint of Shu, and designates the Sword Spirit Sect as the guardian sect of the kingdom. Peace is restored to the world, and order gradually returns.]
[The world’s peace has nothing to do with you, and you continue your secluded cultivation. Eventually, on the 7th day of the 5th month of Shu Calendar year 1, you successfully comprehend the Sword Spirit and become the unparalleled swordsman of the Shu Kingdom.]
[After comprehending the Sword Spirit, you are filled with confidence, believing that once you break through to the Spiritual Realm, there is nowhere in the world you cannot go.]
[However, things take an unexpected turn. The Li Family Ancestor somehow manages to find you. Despite comprehending the Sword Spirit, you fight a fierce battle with him but are unable to resist due to the massive gap in cultivation and are effortlessly killed by him.] [Due to your death, this simulation ends]
“How did that old guy find me?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and frowned, puzzled.
Since he had successfully hidden for five or six years, it shouldn’t be so dramatic to be discovered.
However, the information revealed at the end was too limited; no matter how much Wang Ping thought about it, it was of no avail, so he had to give up pondering it.
Since he couldn’t think of an answer, he could only learn the truth through the simulation.
“Ding, reward generation successful. The host can choose two of the following rewards:
9th Tier Innate Realm cultivation.
@. All Elixir-refining experience.
Comprehended Sword Spirit.
Profound-tier top-grade sword technique – Refining Spirit Sword Manual.
White Talent:a benign face.
White Talent: Desiring to being a Devil.
Profound mid-tier cultivation skill – Fire Spirit Skill.”
“There are so many reward options this time, and I can choose two rewards what a big surprise!”
Wang Ping was slightly astonished.
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping began to ponder his choices.
He could rule out the two White Talents.
Next were the Refining Spirit Sword Manual and Fire Spirit Skill.
As long as they can be used as rewards, they should be able to grant him all the experience he had in their cultivation during the simulation, right?
Even for a skill like Fire Spirit Skill, it might be directly maxed out.
A cultivator’s strength generally comes from three aspects: cultivation, cultivation skill, and martial arts.
Cultivation goes without saying, while the difference in grade of Cultivation Skill brings about a huge difference in strength.
For the same Fire Attribute skill, the quality of Innate True Spirit cultivated from a Profound low-tier skill and a Profound mid-tier skill would be vastly different, and the power of the same martial arts would also vary greatly.
At the same time, there’s a difference in the speed of absorbing spiritual energy, converting efficiency, and recovering True Qi.
Hence, the importance of Cultivation Skill to a cultivator is self-evident.
Besides that, Cultivation Skills also have tiers; reaching different tiers of the skill will yield different levels of power.
Fire Spirit Skill has a total of six tiers. Each time you break through a tier, the quality and quantity of True Qi would increase significantly, becoming even more blazing.
“Although the Refining Spirit Sword Manual is good, it can’t be more important than Cultivation Skill. If I choose Cultivation Skill, I won’t have to keep studying it in the future, and I could maximize my cultivation efficiency.” Wang Ping analyzed the situation.
“However, the time saved because of maxing out Fire Spirit Skill is, after all, not as good as directly choosing the 9th Tier Innate Realm cultivation. This is a realm that I cultivated in the simulation for a full 20 years, based on the peak of the 10th Tier Post-Heaven Realm.’
Wang Ping looked at the first option.
If Fire Spirit Skill were an Earth-tier skill, he would definitely consider it higher priority than cultivation, but it’s only a Profound mid-tier skill, which is a bit too low in the end.
Apart from that, the Sword Spirit also intrigued Wang Ping.
After all, it was something he comprehended after practicing the sword for 20 years.
Of course, as for this simulation, in order to gain the trust and attention of the Li Family, he undoubtedly focused all his efforts on Alchemy. Otherwise, whether it was cultivation or Sword Spirit, his progress would have been much faster.
“In addition, the 4th Tier alchemist is also tempting. After all, the remaining spiritual stones I have aren’t enough to support me for several more simulations, so I have to find a way to earn a lot of spiritual stones in the future. I guess only Alchemy can meet my requirements.”
Wang Ping looked at the second option and murmured to himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - 34: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fourth Grade Alchemist!
chapters.content:
34  Chapter 34: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fourth Grade Alchemist!
"System, I choose ① and ②."
Looking at the reward page, Wang Ping left the room and finally made a decision, speaking in his heart.
As Wang Ping opened his mouth, he felt a throbbing pain in his head, followed by a surge of memories appearing in his mind.
It was as if he had personally experienced the entire process of learning alchemy, which was extremely mysterious and gave a sense of time-space disorientation.
He didn't know how long it took, but when Wang Ping came to his senses, he found that it was already late at night, and Chifeng was snoring in bed.
"This feeling is really wonderful."
Wang Ping let out a sigh of relief and murmured to himself.
Last time it was the same, unknowingly immersed in memories, as if he had personally experienced that lifetime.
However, compared to the time spent in that lifetime, the loss of several hours this time was undoubtedly insignificant.
Obviously, the issue of time passing was also resolved by the system.
"Now that I am a 4th Tier alchemist, as long as I have enough materials, I will no longer worry about the problem of Spiritual Stone. At least, that's the case for now."
Wang Ping's eyes flickered, and flames emerged from his palms, extremely satisfied.
However, considering the increasing consumption of spiritual stones and their rarity in the Xia Dynasty, he knew that with the increase in simulation times, one day, all lower-tier spiritual stones in the Xia Dynasty combined would not be enough for him to simulate another time.
Not to mention that he couldn't possibly collect all the spiritual stones in the Xia Dynasty.
"Before I can earn enough spiritual stones to support my new simulation, I must become strong enough. Being at the 9th Tier of the Innate Realm is far from enough; I want to become at least Great Perfection of the Spiritual Origin Realm or even Transcendent Realm."
That's what Wang Ping thought.
At this moment, Wang Ping felt an overwhelming power appear within his body.
At the same time, he also expelled a large amount of impurities from his body, which were the impurities of the human body, emitting an unpleasant stench.
As a result, Wang Ping took a bath and cleaned his body.
"A cultivator at the 9th Tier of the Innate Realm is indeed powerful. With this level of cultivation, even if my cultivation skills, martial arts, and combat experience are very ordinary, I can still suppress cultivators below the 7th Tier of the Innate Realm with my realm alone."
Wang Ping spread out his palm, and a ball of pure Innate True Qi emerged from it, murmuring to himself.
Later, Wang Ping returned to the room and didn't start a new simulation. Instead, he looked at Chifeng, who was snoring loudly and occasionally scratching his butt, and began to think.
He remembered that when he first saw Chifeng, he seemed to see flames emerging from Chifeng's eyes.
He thought it was an illusion, but now it seemed not to be the case.
The people of Chi Village are from the Spirit Clan, who all practice fire attribute cultivation skills and martial arts. With the flames in Chifeng's eyes, Wang Ping basically concluded that the Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman of the Chi family was a fire attribute expert, having a Fire Spiritual Body constitution.
"Chifeng might be an exception among the people of Chi Village, who have indistinct bloodlines. He may have the manifestation of a bloodline returning to its origins. If guided correctly, he might awaken his Fire Spiritual Body."
Wang Ping's eyes were sharp as he analyzed in his heart.
Twenty years of alchemy experience had naturally allowed him to browse through many ancient books, and he also had some research on spiritual bodies.
According to legends, spiritual bodies were very mysterious; some were innate.
Innate spiritual bodies didn't need to awaken.
However, as the bloodline became more diluted, the probability of descendants being born with spiritual bodies decreased. Even if some people had spiritual bodies due to bloodline regression, they still belonged to latent spiritual bodies that needed to be guided with special methods to awaken.
The three most common methods were:
For elixirs, there's the 4th Tier Elixir, Spirit Attracting Elixir, which is suitable for the majority of spiritual bodies.
For medicinal treasures, different treasures are needed depending on the spiritual body, but their grades won't be lower than 4th Tier.In the aspect of Cultivation Skill, it requires special Cultivation Skills exclusive to the Spirit Clan, which were created by the Spirit Race Ancestor based on their own bloodlines for future generations.
"I wonder if Chifeng, after awakening the Fire Spiritual Body, can break the Bloodline Curse and reach a realm above the Innate Realm."
Wang Ping pondered slightly.
He couldn't always stay in the Chi Village. After helping the Chi Village solve their troubles, he would eventually leave.
By then, the people of Chi Village would undoubtedly have to defend themselves.
However, the bloodline of the people of Chi Village has been cursed, unable to break through to a realm above the Innate Realm.
Without reaching the Spiritual Origin Realm, they ultimately lack the power to protect themselves in Xia.
Thus, if Chifeng could awaken the Fire Spiritual Body, break the Bloodline Curse, and grow to the Spiritual Origin Realm, it would undoubtedly be the best outcome.
However, this is most likely difficult to achieve.
Perhaps, taming a Seven-Tier Monster Beast to protect Chi Village or enabling them to take revenge was the best option.
"Speaking of which, we could also start from the aspect of Cultivation Skill. I will try to probe in the simulation and see if the village chief has any special Cultivation Skill left by the Ancestor. Of course, it most likely doesn't exist. If there was such a Cultivation Skill, the people of Chi Village would not have been practicing the Earthly Fire Spirit Skill."
Wang Ping shook his head slightly.
Although the Fire Spirit Skill looks very compatible with the Fire Spiritual Body, the special cultivation method created by the Spiritual Fetus Realm Strongman for their Spirit Clan should be at least Earth-tier or above.
Middle Earth-tier is just too weak.
"System, I want to start a new simulation."
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke softly in his heart.
This is probably the last paid simulation in a short period of time. Hopefully, some powerful talents can be refreshed.
12:02
"Ding, this simulation will cost 128 Lower-tier Spirit Stones. Do you want to consume it immediately?"
The system's voice sounded.
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping cringed, feeling some toothache.
It's hard to bear this doubling increase.
He now has 283 Lower-tier Spirit Stones remaining. This simulation requires 128 Lower-tier Spirit Stones. After consumption, he will only be left with 155 Lower-tier Spirit Stones.
The next simulation will double again, which means 256 Lower-tier Spirit Stones will be needed, and his Spirit Stones will not be enough for the next simulation.
However, the Life Simulator is his Golden Finger, and he can't avoid simulating it, so he has to accept it.
"Consume." Wang Ping rubbed his eyebrows and said.
This is probably the last paid simulation in a short period of time. Hopefully, some powerful talents can be refreshed.
"Ding, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing..."
The system's voice sounded, making Wang Ping's mind tremble.
"Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing White Talent · Plain Clothes; White Talent · Sweep Star; Green Talent · Beastmaster."
As the system's voice sounded again, Wang Ping's eyes lit up.
This time the luck is not bad, as it directly refreshed three talents, and one of them is even Green Talent.
However, this White Talent · Sweep Star seems a bit quirky.
Wang Ping felt a bit odd in his heart and looked at the Talent descriptions.
White Talent · Plain Clothes: When the host wears plain clothes, the mind will become calm, which will be more beneficial for cultivation.
White Talent · Sweep Star: People around you will become unlucky when around you.
Green Talent · Beastmaster: The host will have a very good talent in nurturing and training monster beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - 35: The Secret of Chi Village
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: The Secret of Chi Village
Translator: 549690339
After reading the introduction to the talents, Wang Ping was slightly speechless.
White Talent. Simply Dressed, he could understand, but what the hell was this Broom Star… no matter how he thought about it, it seemed like a huge pitfall?
“It doesn’t seem right either, if I can go to the Li Family and the Sword Spirit Sect, can I take advantage of this talent to set traps for them?” Wang Ping stroked his chin, pondering.
“Forget it, a white talent, probably won’t have much effect.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, discarding this strange idea. “So it seems, I can only choose Green Talent Beastmaster.”
Wang Ping looked at this Green Talent, his eyes flashing slightly.
Although he was not interested in Beast Taming, he did not underestimate this talent.
It was a legitimate Green Talent after all, it wouldn’t be too weak.
Green Talent Sword Skill Genius, allowed him in the simulation to comprehend the Sword Spirit that countless swordsmen dreamed of. Green Talent Alchemy Genius, made him a respected 4th Tier Alchemist.
This Green Talent must also have extraordinary advantages.
At this time, Wang Ping also remembered the Silver Moon Wolf, a Seven Tier Monster Beast.
A Seven Tier Monster Beast, there was a high probability that the pups born to the Silver Moon Wolf were stolen by people.
If he could get the pup of this Silver Moon Wolf, and raise it, in the future it could become a Seven Tier Monster Beast.
By then, it would certainly be a powerful force, and he could also have it guard Chi Village once it had grown up. “System, I choose Green Talent Beastmaster.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
[Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.]
The system’s voice sounded.
Immediately after, familiar text began to appear on the luminescent screen in front of Wang Ping.
[Daya calendar 480, March 12th, you showcased your amazing alchemy, shocking the Chi villagers. They never expected your talent in alchemy to be so high. The village chief was especially moved, feeling that Chi Village truly found a benefactor.]
[Following that, you asked the village chief to find some herbs for refining Innate Elixirs, intending to refine Innate Elixirs. The Chi villagers did as told, carefully gathering alchemy materials for you.]
[Daya calendar 480, March 30th, materials gathered, you successfully refined a furnace of excellent Innate Elixirs and handed them to the Chi villagers.] [Chih Hu and the others were extremely excited, full of gratitude towards you.]
[In the next month, Chih Hu and others successfully broke through to the Innate Realm with the help of the Innate Elixirs. In just one month, Chi Village had eight more Innate Realm experts, making the village chief laugh happily.]
[Next, you narrated the affairs of the Li Family to them and also mentioned the Blood Devil Tracking Skill. This left the village chief extremely suspicious. He didn’t know how you knew so much, but he ultimately believed you, and felt fearful because of it.]
[In the end, the village chief decided to move the entire village, then disperse throughout the Xia nation, thereby reducing the chances of being found.]
[As for this decision, you sighed. You knew very well that even if they could avoid pursuit by the Li Family, troubles would still arise in the future. In this chaotic era, many Chi villagers would inevitably be involved, and their survival would be uncertain.]
[However, you could not change anything.]
[Next, you asked the village chief if he had any cultivation methods of his own Spirit Clan to help Chifeng awaken his Fire Spiritual Body. Listening to you, the village chief paused, and in the end he looked lost and sighed, saying that such methods had been lost a long time ago. The Fire Spirit Skill was just formed through adapting an incomplete Earth-tier Cultivation Skill.]
[Having heard the village chief’s words, you were not surprised. You had expected this kind of situation, but you had not thought that the Fire Spirit Skill was modified from an incomplete Earth-tier Cultivation Skill.]
[Finally, you asked the village chief why the Chi villagers were unable to break through to the realm above the Innate Realm.]
[Faced with your question, the village chief was shocked once again, finding it hard to believe. He had no idea how you knew this secret. However, considering that you had no ill intentions towards the Chi villagers and had even made a vow, the village chief finally admitted that the Chi family people indeed could not break through to the Spiritual Realm.]
[You asked again for the reason. The village chief hesitated before answering. He was also unclear about what exactly had transpired. The Chi family’s history was very ancient and too many things had been lost. Many of the family’s secrets were known only to successive clan chiefs, but since the clan chief was killed by the Li family, everything had been lost.]
[Unable to get an answer, you felt very regretful.]
[Seeing your regret, the village chief once again spoke and revealed some secrets he knew. The Chi Clan were not native to this overseas isolated island, but had come from across the sea. According to the family’s ancient records, the Chi Clan had faced several threats of genocide over the past thousand years, all related to curses. A thousand years ago, the Chi Clan was able to produce Spirit Sea Domain Stronger; six hundred years ago, there were still Spiritual Realm Experts; two hundred years ago, nobody could break through to the Spiritual Realm. Up to this day, even breaking through to the Innate Realm was very difficult, and even if a breakthrough to the Innate Realm was achieved, cultivation became slow.]
[With a worried and frightened expression, the village chief speculated that as time passed, their clan might not even be able to break through to the Innate
Realm, and might even eventually become completely unable to cultivate.]
[Upon hearing this news, you felt a chill in your heart. The origin of the Chi Clan made you surprised. They came from across the sea and were capable of producing Spirit Sea Domain Stronger a thousand years ago, but now struggle even to break through to the Innate Realm; this was truly strange.]
[The Chi Clan had a mysterious and strong history, and you couldn’t imagine how powerful the group was at its peak. However, you were more terrified of this bizarre curse. The entity that targeted the Chi Clan was beyond malicious. Perhaps, this entity was fully capable of exterminating the Chi Clan completely, but instead opted to plant this curse, making the Chi Clan slowly wither away, struggle in the mortal world, and ultimately be eradicated.]
[Seeing your fear, the village chief realized you had thought of a few things, so he patted your shoulder and reassured that you owed them nothing. On the contrary, they owed you a great deal, and you shouldn’t worry about the future of their tribe. Once you get involved too deeply, you could be in danger too. Understanding his words, you knew that you should not probe any further into the secrets of Chi village, otherwise you might be in danger..]

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - 36: Joining the Sword Spirit Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Joining the Sword Spirit Sect
Translator: 549690339
[Half a month later, under the guidance of the village chief, the people of Chi Village prepared to leave. However, the chief didn’t let everyone go separately. Some went in pairs, some in groups of three. The purpose of this was to test the strength of Li Family’s Blood Demon Tracking Skill, to see if it could track multiple people gathered together.]
[If three or four people together could escape detection, then the people of Chi
Village would be safer when they gather in small groups in various places in
Xia.]
[You highly agree with the chief’s decision, as it is also your idea. However, this must involve people risking their lives as bets, which you find hard to request.]
[In the end, the men of the hunting team all volunteered to be the test subjects, completely disregarding their own lives. You admire their selflessness, as the people of Chi Village are truly kind and willing to sacrifice for others.]
[Finally, five people remained in Chi Village, led by the village chief. The others went alone or in teams. However, some of the children were still too young to fend for themselves, so they had to let an adult accompany them, taking a gamble that the Blood Demon Tracking Skill couldn’t track the two of them.]
[During the following days, you and Chifeng stayed hidden in Black Wind
Town, focusing entirely on sword practice and improving your cultivation. Consequently, in this life, with an ample supply of elixirs and spiritual stones, your cultivation progressed much more rapidly. On April 5th, Daya calendar 481, you broke through to the Innate Realm 10th Tier, a considerable advancement compared to ordinary Innate Realm cultivators who take one or two decades to advance to a minor level.]
[Subsequently, you visited the grouped Chi Village people and found that even the villagers who traveled in groups of four were not in danger. At this, you and
Chifeng breathed a sigh of relief.]
[After delving deeper into the Black Wind Forest, you discovered that the village chief and others in Chi Village hadn’t been attacked.]
[Following that, you decided to join the Sword Spirit Sect. By capitalizing on your status as a 4th Tier alchemist, you felt that there was a good chance to gain their favor and access their Earth-tier Cultivation Skill and Martial Arts for cultivation, allowing you to cultivate even more swiftly.]
[Although the Sword Spirit Sect could become your enemy, using their resources to make yourself stronger before crushing them would bring even greater joy.]
[Upon arriving at the Sword Spirit Sect and declaring your identity and intentions, the sect was shocked and the Sect Master personally came out to greet you highly valuing you. Ultimately, you easily became an Inner Sect Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect, with great treatment and fame that spread throughout the world.]
[Following this, you continued to devote yourself to cultivation, practicing
Sword Riding Skill. Because of your high status and immense value, the Sword Spirit Sect wanted to win you over even more by allowing you to cultivate their core skill, Sword Essence Skill, and their martial arts technique, Sword Riding Skill, both of which were of Earth lower tier and extremely precious.]
[You successfully cultivated both skills, and during your time at the Sword Spirit Sect, you unexpectedly became friends with Bai Tianhong, often discussing sword techniques with him and forming a close bond. At this time, Bai Tianhong was much younger than you, only 19 years old. However, at 19, Bai Tianhong already had an Innate Realm cultivation, demonstrating his exceptional talent.]
[In Daya calendar 487, your cultivation reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm, and Bai Tianhong’s cultivation was even more terrifying, having already reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm and comprehended Sword Spirit. Naturally, due to your access to the Sword Spirit Sect’s core inheritance, and exchanging sword techniques with Bai Tianhong regularly, you also comprehended Sword Spirit. However, your Sword Spirit was not as powerful as Bai Tianhong’s.]
[Meanwhile, during these years, you had already found out that the five villagers who stayed in Chi Village led by the village chief still hadn’t been attacked. From this, you understood that the Blood Demon Tracking Skill wasn’t as powerful as you had imagined.]
[On August 1st, Daya calendar 487, you invited Bai Tianhong to Black Wind Forest, delving deep to find a Silver Moon Wolf cub. Eventually, you heard the furious howl of a Silver Moon Wolf deep inside the forest and rushed over.]
[Then, both you and Bai Tianhong saw a group of powerful people capturing a
Silver Moon Wolf cub and fleeing. Their cultivation had reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm.]
[You and Bai Tianhong understood the cause and effect. Afterward, you suggested seizing the Silver Moon Wolf cub to domesticate it as a Spirit Pet which Bai Tianhong agreed to help you with.]
“This Bai Tianhong is indeed really good.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but praise as he looked at the simulation content displayed on the luminescent screen.
It turns out that despite the sinister nature of the Sword Spirit Sect master, Bai Tianhong was entirely different and had a genuine character.
“The Blood Demon Tracking Skill isn’t as strong as I thought, which puts me at ease. Although the people of Chi Village are still facing the significant trouble of the Bloodline Curse, it is still possible to prevent a genocide from happening. ”
Wang Ping sighed lightly, thinking privately.
Following this, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you persuaded the Half-step Spiritual Realm expert to hand over the
Silver Moon Wolf cub, promising him ample compensation. Seeing your and Bai Tianhong’s identities, he handed it over without hesitation, reminding you of your promise before fleeing.]
[At this, you were surprised that things went so smoothly. You initially planned to use force if trading wasn’t possible. Bai Tianhong was also relieved since they didn’t have to resort to violence.]
[However, soon after, you were found by an adult Silver Moon Wolf. Facing the enraged Tier-7 Demon Beast Silver Moon Wolf, Bai Tianhong wasn’t afraid and fought bravely, while you also unleashed your astounding combat power, fighting the Silver Moon Wolf together.]
[Eventually, the Silver Moon Wolf was killed by your combined efforts. After slaying the Silver Moon Wolf, you both left the Black Wind Forest with its body, eliminating the potential Beast Tide and preventing massive casualties.]
[Afterward, you and Bai Tianhong returned to the Sword Spirit Sect and continued to cultivate. You also started nurturing the Silver Moon Wolf cub with various spirit medicines.]
[In Daya calendar 495, you were about to break through to the Spiritual Realm, but your innate talent was insufficient and your Martial Enlightenment Heart was not firm enough, so you failed. At this, you had a lengthy discussion with Bai Tianhong, greatly benefiting from understanding your own inner world. You then began to temper your Tao Heart, confident that you would break through to the Spiritual Realm within three years.]
[At the end of Daya calendar 495, the Spiritual Realm Old Ancestor of the Xia Royal Family passed away, and the vassals could no longer suppress themselves. They began to rally various forces, declaring themselves kings and coveting the throne. It was also at the end of the year that you learned about the whereabouts of the Fire Spirit Flower…. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - 37: The Death of Bai Tianhong
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: The Death of Bai Tianhong
Translator: 549690339
“Fire Spirit Flower…”
Upon viewing the simulated content, Wang Ping’s eyes lit up involuntarily.
This Fire Spirit Flower was a rare spirit medicine and was extravagantly valuable.
As long as he knew the location of this Fire Spirit Flower, he could harvest it at any time in the future.
[One of the Supreme Elders of Sword Spirit Sect discovered the Fire Spirit Flower deep in the Black Wind Forest. However, as a top-quality treasure medicine in the 4th Tier Elixir, it was naturally guarded by a demon beast, a Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, an 8-tier monster beast whose cultivation was comparable to a human cultivator at the 8th Tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm. The terrifying power of the beast was not something the Elder from the Sword Spirit Sect could handle, hence he divulged the information hoping to invite other strong individuals from the Sword Spirit Sect to jointly deal with the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.]
[Subsequently, you told the Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect that whoever could help you retrieve this Fire Spirit Flower, as long as the materials could be provided, you were willing to refine a batch of 4th Tier Elixir for them free of charge. All the Supreme Elders were intrigued by this offer.]
[Next, the powerhouses of Sword Spirit Sect banded together and took you to the Black Wind Forest with intentions of dealing with the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger. Bai Tianhong was also included. At this point, his cultivation had reached the 4th Tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm, making him exceptionally powerful.]
[Upon reaching the deepest part of the Black Wind Forest, the Supreme Elders
of Sword Spirit Sect led the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger away, resulting in
fierce confrontations. The surrounding land within thousands of miles
suffered collateral damage and was leveled to the ground. Taking advantage of
the situation, you harvested the Fire Spirit Flower. Overjoyed, you were ready
to leave.]
[However, an unforeseen variable occurred. A monster beast unexpectedly appeared from afar. Known as the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, a seventh-tier monster beast, it wasn’t as formidable as the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, but it could still rival human powerhouses at the eighth tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm.]
[Although your cultivation had reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm, and you had practiced Earth-tier Cultivation Skill and Martial Arts, and had comprehended the Sword Spirit, dealing with a Silver Moon Wolf in a weakened state was manageable. However, battling the Double-tailed Snake Tiger at its peak was nothing short of a wild fantasy.]
[In the end, after a brutal battle, the Supreme Elders managed to kill both beastmonsters with great difficulty. In this battle, Bai Tianhong and a Supreme Elder fell, and you were critically injured.]
[Despite the successful extermination of the two formidable beast monsters, no one could muster a sense of joy, as a legendary prodigy of swordsmanship rarely seen in a millennium had fallen, driving everyone to the brink of insanity.]
[After all, if Bai Tianhong hadn’t fallen, they believed that he would have had a definite chance of advancing to the legendary Transcendent Realm, allowing the long absent Transcendent Realm Master to reappear in the world and restoring the glory of the Sword Spirit Sect from a millennium ago.]
[Regrettably, the marvel of an era was gone. However, seeing the grievous state you were in, the Elders could only do their best to stabilize your injuries, keep you alive and leave the Black Wind Forest with you.]
[Bai Tianhong’s demise sent shockwaves across the entire world. The various major powers of the Central Continent breathed a sigh of relief, secretly delighting in the disaster. Bai Tianhong’s existence was like a thorn in the hearts of all power factions. As for you, because you became a burden during the battle, and Bai Tianhong died to protect you, you found it hard to accept, began to decline, indulged in alcohol all day and were constantly plagued by your Heart Demons.]
“This…’
Wang Ping was taken aback by this development.
He had really not anticipated that in this simulation, he would become close friends with Bai Tianhong, who died valiantly in the process of saving him.
“Bai Tianhong is truly admirable.”
Wang Ping gazed at the luminescent screen, murmuring to himself.
“Furthermore, from the currently simulated content, it seems that not everyone in the Sword Spirit Sect is a villain. Perhaps only the Sword Spirit Sect Master knows about the Chi Clan’s affairs. After all, his wife is the daughter of
Li Family’s Ancestor, so the secret would have been only disclosed to him. Even
it the Sect Master used the power ot the Sword Spirit Sect to search tor people, it is estimated that he would not have revealed the secret.”
Wang Ping was reminded of other matters and fell into deep thought.
If that was the case, the number of people he needed to deal with in the future would be much less.
Then, shaking his head, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, wanting to see the subsequent developments.
As Wang Ping gazed, more text continued to emerge on the screen.
[Feeling depressed, you sought out the people of Chi Village, hoping to check on their condition.]
[Seeing your current state, Chifeng inquired about the cause, which you chose to disclose. Afterwards, Chifeng repeated the words you had spoken before, snapping you back to reality. Indeed, in the Profound World, if one cultivates to the extreme, the possibility of bringing a person back to life is quite high.
With that in mind, you made a vow to reach the peak of the Martial Path and bring Bai Tianhong back to life.]
[You stopped being depressed and began training relentlessly.]
[In the 497th year of the Daya calendar, internal conflicts in Xia country escalated, the imperial forces and vassals suffered heavy losses, and corpses littered the country, making it a living hell. Chu State, which bordered Xia country, wished to send troops to conquer Xia, aiming to annex it.]
[However, Zhao State, which bordered Chu State, did not want Chu State to expand by absorbing Xia country. Hence, it deployed massive forces to the border, making Chu State abandon its plan. Chu State, in turn, deployed troops to the border city to prevent Zhao state from invading suddenly.]
[At the end of 499 in the Daya calendar, your cultivation made another leap, successfully breaking into the Spiritual Origin Realm. In the same year, the royal family of Xia was overthrown, the vassals started a civil war, vying for the throne. Various vassals waged war against one another, making life miserable for the common people.]
[In the 500th year of the Daya calendar, due to the death of Bai Tianhong and the absence of a formidable force that could completely overthrow the war situation, weaker vassals were wiped out, and the stronger vassals’ were relatively balanced. In the end, they all chose to form their own nations. Xia fragmented into five countries, the common people continued to live in poverty, and corpses were scattered everywhere.]
[In the same year, you went down the mountain once again to visit the people of Chi Village. But, you found out that the inhabitants of the Chi Village had mysteriously vanished..]

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - 38: Extinction of a Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Extinction of a Clan
Translator: 549690339
Upon seeing Chi Feng and the Chi family members all mysteriously disappear, Wang Ping’s pupils suddenly shrank.
However, he didn’t think too much and continued to stare at the luminescent screen, wanting to know the answer.
[Regarding this, your first thought was that it was done by the Li Family. You were furious, put on a mask and attacked the Li Family. When the Li Family questioned you about why you were attacking them, you didn’t answer, only saying that the Li Family should be destroyed. You killed more than half of the Li Family’s Innate Realm members.]
[While you were on a killing spree in the Li Family, the Li Family Ancestor finally came out and fought against you. Because your cultivation had broken through to the Spiritual Origin Realm and you had comprehended the Sword Spirit, even the Li Family Ancestor with a cultivation level of Spiritual Origin Realm Third Tier wasn’t your opponent and was killed by you. Afterward, you completely annihilated the Li Family, leaving no one behind.]
[Then, you went to the basement, attempting to find Chi Feng and the others, but found nothing, which left you unsettled. Finally, you discovered the Blood Devil Tracking Skill and hoped to use the blood pool in the basement to locate the Chi family members.]
[However, you still found nothing, as if the Chi family members had completely vanished from the world overnight. It was mysterious and chilling.]
“What’s going on here? If it wasn’t the Li Family, why did Chi Feng and the others suddenly disappear?”
Wang Ping couldn’t figure it out.
Although the Sword Spirit Sect master might be a suspect, it wouldn’t be in his power to do so.
After all, with his status in this simulation, there was no way the Sword Spirit Sect master could hide any actions from him.
To silently make all the Chi family members disappear, this method was too horrifying.
“Could it be the terrifying existence that cursed the Chi Family’s bloodline?” Wang Ping’s face changed, unable to calm down.
If it was that terrifying unknown existence, they indeed would have the ability to do this.
Even worse, if they wanted to, they could easily trigger the Bloodline Curse and kill the Chi family members.
But, could someone really live that long?
After all, the Chi family had escaped to the Central Plains a thousand years ago!
Including the time before the Chi family fled, had their enemy managed to live for a thousand or two thousand years!?
Even a Transcendent Realm cultivator couldn’t possibly have such an astonishing lifespan.
“I’ll ask Mr. Cai when I have the chance,” Wang Ping thought as his eyes glinted.
Transcendent Realm experts have been missing from the Central Plains for too long, and many records have been lost.
Although the village chief’s Chi family had a glorious past, according to him, they had almost faced Genocide several times, and many things had been disrupted. They might not even know the secrets of the Transcendent Realm
anymore.
Therefore, asking Cai Yonglong directly would be best.
However, he was still in the simulation, and it was night time, so Wang Ping didn’t plan to @Cai Yonglong now.
Of course, if he could get an answer during the simulation, that would be the best thing.
But considering his situation in the simulation, that would be difficult.
Wang Ping set aside his numerous thoughts and continued to look at the luminescent screen.
As he stared, the characters on the screen reappeared.
[Next, you thought of the Sword Spirit Sect master and his wife being in the same boat, thinking they might have had a hand in it. You secretly investigated and tried to look into the Sword Spirit Sect master.]
[However, the Sword Spirit Sect master noticed your actions, and angrily confronted you as to why you were investigating him. You no longer hid your intentions and directly confronted him. The Sect Master was astonished, not knowing how you learned that he was looking for the Chi family members. However, he felt that if he found the Chi family members, he would eventually need your alchemy services, so he admitted to his search but claimed he had found nothing.]
[Upon hearing the Sword Spirit Sect master’s words, you were extremely uncertain. You had no idea who could have done this if it wasn’t the Sword Spirit Sect master behind the scenes.]
[Very quickly, you calmed down, thought of the secret on the Chi family members, and sank into silence.]
[The Sword Spirit Sect master spoke again, hoping that you would keep the secret. You chose to ignore him.]
[Soon, the entire world learned of the Li Family’s annihilation at your hands.
Everyone was shocked, never imagining you could be so fierce and ruthless.
Meanwhile, Liu Yu, ruler of the Shu State, was extremely dissatisfied with you because the Li Family had been on his side, and now that they were wiped out, his power had been weakened. However, considering your identity as a Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder and a 4th Tier alchemist, Liu Yu couldn’t blame you too much.]
[Not only Liu Yu held dissatisfaction with you, but the Sword Spirit Sect master was also furious. His wife had been a member of the Li Family, and they were his supporters. As for the Sect Master’s wife, her hatred towards you was bone-deep, wishing to eat your flesh and drink your blood.]
[Both of them wanted to deal with you and let the Supreme Elders judge you. To this, you coldly retorted that the Li Family deserved it for destroying your disciple’s family. The Supreme Elders were shocked and couldn’t believe what had happened. Eventually, you told them the whole story, and the various reactions of the Supreme Elders revealed they hadn’t expecting these past events and were unaware of the collusion between the Sect Master and the Li Family.]
[The Sect Master was furious and argued fiercely. His faction supported the Sect Master, believing that you went too far. However, the Supreme Elders who were at odds with the Sect Master’s faction and owed you a favor supported you. In the end, both sides argued fiercely and nothing came of it.]
[Both the Sect Master and his wife bore deep grudges against you, planning to remove you, as they felt uneasy otherwise. Similarly, you were also considering how to eliminate this treacherous couple.]
[In Daya calendar’s year 502, three kingdoms fell, leaving only the Shu State, ruled by Liu Yu, and the Wu State, ruled by Sun Chang. At this point, the combined population of the two countries had fallen from one hundred million in the ancient times of Xia to just over ten million now, which could be described as living in dire straits. Not only had countless ordinary people died, but even Innate Realm and Spiritual Origin Realm cultivators found it difficult to survive unscathed, suffering heavy casualties.]
[Despite this, the two countries still showed no signs of ceasing war, and vowed not to rest until the enemy was annihilated. And you, watching the living beings suffer, could only drink wine in front of Bai Tianhong’s tomb, filled with regret, loneliness, and saying things like “If you were still alive, the world would have been peaceful long ago.” ]
[In Daya calendar’s year 503, the Sword Spirit Sect’s most powerful Supreme Elder, Bai Tianhong’s master, couldn’t stand by and watch the two countries continue to wage war, believing that it would lead to their own extinction. He took the initiative to abandon the Sword Spirit Sect’s thousand-year neutral position and chose to join the world, assisting the Shu State against the Wu State.]
[With the addition of a large number of experts from the Sword Spirit Sect, the scales of victory tilted instantly towards the Shu State, and it seemed that peace would return to the world of Daya once again..]

chapters.title: Chapter 39 - 39: Choosing the Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Choosing the Reward
Translator: 549690339
[However, it was just when Shu State had defeated Wu State and started to unify the land that Sword Spirit Sect Master colluded with the Exotic Races to begin their invasion. The Exotic Races invaded, plundering and killing people, behaving ruthlessly, treating Shu State people as lambs to be eaten, utterly devoid of humanity. This enraged the King of Shu Liu Yu, who urgently mobilized all available forces to suppress them.]
[Nevertheless, due to the power of Exotic Races and the years of war in Xia Land, even though they had once again unified the rivers and mountains, their strength had already been weakened to the extreme and was naturally no match for the Exotic Races. Therefore, Shu King Liu Yu had no choice but to ask for assistance from the Sword Spirit Sect, allowing them to help deal with the Exotic Races.]
[In the face of the rampant Exotic Races, all the Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect were equally outraged, and every one of them came down the mountain, intending to kill the Exotic Races. That same year, you went down the mountain to gather herbs. Meanwhile, the Sword Spirit Sect Master sneered and secretly contacted the Exotic Races, selling you to them.]
[Subsequently, a powerful existence among the Exotic Races took action, wanting you to submit to them and refine medicine for them. But with your unyielding spirit, you would never yield to the Exotic Races. In the end, you died in battle.]
[Because of your death, this simulation has ended.]
“Has the Sword Spirit Sect been neutral for a thousand years? It seems that most of the higher-ups in the Sword Spirit Sect are good people.”
Wang Ping, after watching the simulation, had a significantly improved impression of the Sword Spirit Sect, which he found quite surprising.
“However, even in the best of forces, there will always be a few rats spoiling the pot. The Sword Spirit Sect Master is undoubtedly one of them.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, recalling the deeds of the Sword Spirit Sect Master, and his eyes revealed a murderous intent.
The Sword Spirit Sect fought for the world, while he conspired with the Exotic Races, allowing the land that had finally regained peace to be engulfed in chaos once again, all for the sole purpose of killing him.
From the current situation, even if the Exotic Races were eventually defeated, Shu State would probably be hard-pressed to recover.
In the end, most likely, they would be annexed by the Chu State.
After all, even with Zhao State’s interference, Shu State’s strength had become too weak. Chu State only needed to dispatch a small number of troops to conquer it, while Zhao State wouldn’t be able to stop them.
However, being annexed by Chu State would probably be the best outcome.
If it weren’t for Chu State, it was likely that they would be directly extinct by the Exotic Races, bringing about catastrophe for all living beings.
In addition, the Sword Spirit Sect Master was ruthless. Wang Ping had not been able to kill him within the simulation. It seemed that it would be difficult to deal with him using ordinary methods.
“Hmph, no matter how cunning and ruthless you are, as long as my strength is sufficient, I can break through the situation with a single effort, and no one can stop me.”
Immediately, Wang Ping let out a cold snort, no longer dwelling on it.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
Earth lower-tier martial Skill Sword Essence Skill. @. Lower Earth-Tier Martial Skill Sword Riding Skill.
Green Talent Beast Taming Master.
White Talent Broom Star.
White Talent Plainly Dressed.
Sword Spirit enlightenment.
Life experience.
1st Tier of Spirit Origin cultivation.”
“There are quite a few reward choices this time, and I can choose two rewards.
The system seems to be getting more and more generous.”
Wang Ping looked at the long list of reward choices and sighed.
He then began to think carefully.
White Talent Broom Star. To be honest, he had felt from the beginning of this simulation that the system might have chosen the wrong talent for him.
After all, this time within the simulation, he was far too burdensome for the people around him.
He had killed Bai Tianhong, and all the people of Chi Village disappeared, which was outrageous.
As for the Beast Taming Master talent, it had no presence at all.
He had obtained the Silver Moon Wolf cub, but the system’s simulation hadn’t even mentioned cultivating it, which was absurd.
“The three talents are not very useful, so I’ll skip them directly. The cost-performance ratio is too low.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he looked at the Cultivation Skills, Martial Arts, and Sword Spirit.
These three rewards were quite good.
“However… ”
But after some thought, Wang Ping turned his gaze to the seventh option, his eyes flickering.
Life Experience – an option he had chosen before.
He was well aware that if he selected this option, he would experience the life of this simulation from a first-person perspective.
At that time, his martial will would be even more unyielding, his martial training experience, combat experience, experience with Cultivation Skills, and Martial Arts he had learned from this simulation would all be in tune.
Even details missed in the simulated text would be completely understood.
Experiencing such a life would undoubtedly be of great benefit to him. The benefits it would bring to his future martial arts cultivation were even more self-evident.
This time, he had lived a long life, experiencing this life, he could directly learn
Earth-level lower-Tier martial Skill Sword Essence Skill, the Lower Earth-Tier Martial Skill Sword Riding Skill, and other Martial Arts practiced in the simulation by himself.
It’s very likely that even his alchemy skills would improve.
Even the Sword Skill enlightenment he had gained could be fully grasped, and the Sword Spirit could be directly mastered.
It could be said that the Life Experience reward option was undoubtedly the best choice, with an incredibly high cost-performance ratio, and also a lower refresh probability.
However, Wang Ping had seen the content of this simulation.
He knew very well that in this simulation, there were too many regrets and remorse, several times of decadence, and several times when he had almost fallen into the demonic path.
The Life Experience would make him feel as if he personally experienced such a life, and it would undoubtedly affect him, perhaps even making it possible for him to fall into the demonic path.
After all, he already knew the future development, but could only watch helplessly, unable to change anything. Perhaps the impact would be even greater than he had imagined.
“This reward is undoubtedly the best.” Wang Ping whispered to himself, “If I fear even such an ordeal, even with the simulator, I won’t achieve much. Sooner or later, there will be accidents if my mindset isn’t keeping up. For example, in this simulation, I could not break through to the Spiritual-origin Realm due to a lack of Tao Heart and mental state.
“Therefore, I don’t need to fear, but instead, I should use this life experience as the best sharpening tool for myself. As long as I can steady my mind and improve my mental state, there will be great achievements.”
As Wang Ping spoke, his expression became resolute, and his eyes shone brightly.
“System, I choose O and O.”
Soon after, Wang Ping silently uttered in his heart.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his consciousness sway and change.
Everything that followed was beyond his control. From a first-person perspective, he watched everything unfold, unable to change anything, like a ghost.
Everything that the other Wang Ping saw, experienced, felt, and realized was in his heart.
This feeling was very strange.
Soon, he personally experienced the sorrow of parting from Chi Village and his helplessness about the future.
Next, after living a year in Black Wind Town, he joined the Sword Spirit Sect, became a Guest Elder, and met Bai Tianhong..

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - 40: A Powerful Feeling
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: A Powerful Feeling
Translator: 549690339
With each image that flashed by, Wang Ping was extremely moved.
By the end of it all, Wang Ping had detached his spirit. He looked around the wooden house in a daze, feeling as if it was all a dream. It seemed unreal to him.
These tangled timelines, these intertwined lives were too contradictory. It created a sensation similar to Zhuang Zhou dreaming he was a butterfly, or a butterfly dreaming it was Zhuang Zhou.
“Life Simulator…” Wang Ping snapped back to his senses after a while, muttering, “Is each simulated life truly a figment of imagination? Is it a simulation of the future? Or, are the developments in each simulated life real, creating parallel universes in their wake? That sense of reality is truly unforgettable.”
“I’m overthinking things, drawing parallels between the profound world and parallel universes. Ultimately, the simulated world is so realistic that I can’t differentiate between illusion and reality,” Wang Ping said, holding his head and smiling bitterly.
The impact of this life experience on him was immense. It was difficult for him to forget many scenes and he generally failed to distinguish between the real world and the simulated one.
“The Wang Ping in the simulation, carrying the miniature fate of a simulated future, hates his own weaknesses and helplessness,” Wang Ping said, opening the door and gazing at the starry sky. “But in the end, what I need to do remains the same. I must become stronger. That is the only way I can avoid death and won’t have to see my acquaintances wither away.”
At this moment, a surge of immense power emerged from within Wang Ping and his cultivation directly ascended to the 1st Tier of Spiritual Origin Realm.
He was addicted to this feeling of strength.
However, Wang Ping was aware that his current foundation was rather weak.
Primarily because he had taken too many elixirs. Since he embarked on the path of cultivation, he never parted with the elixirs.
Starting from today, he must stop taking elixirs blindly. Otherwise, with such a weak foundation, he will eventually get stuck at a certain realm and will not be able to progress.
Take Bai Tianhong for example. He is in a powerful sect like the Sword Spirit Sect, and his master is a Supreme Elder. What resources does he not have? However, he remains true to his heart, never resorting to elixirs, and focuses on cultivation and sword practice.
Even so, his cultivation progresses at an incredible speed and he easily breaks through all bottlenecks. Nothing can hold him back.
That’s the foundation of Bai Tianhong. It’s not perfect, but it’s absolutely solid.
For Bai Tianhong, breaking through bottlenecks might be a natural process.
Wang Ping had an intuition that that the Overseas Isolated Island was too small, that the martial arts heritage was too weak or had been interrupted.
The prodigies in poor areas are not necessarily weaker than those in major sects. They lack only opportunity.
If Bai Tianhong were in the Eastern Desolation as Cai Yonglong mentioned, given Bai Tianhong’s aptitude and character, he would likely rise at an astonishing rate.
“There aren’t many people like Brother Bai in this world, ” Wang Ping sighed.
“Hey! ”
The next day, Wang Ping was walking through Chi Village. He watched the children drink animal milk and play, while the older children like Chifeng, sweating and practicing martial arts. His mood gradually calmed down.
He liked the feeling of having profound cultivation and high status, as well as the feeling of peace.
However, at present, he preferred this feeling of tranquillity as it eliminated his complicated emotions and made him feel composed.
“Hey, Wang Ping, stop dawdling. It would be better if you follow me in martial arts training or go hunting sometimes.” Seeing Wang Ping approach, Chih Hu slapped his shoulder and admonished him loudly, “Otherwise, even if you have a unique physique and your cultivation advances by leaps and bounds every day, without a solid foundation in martial arts and practical experience, you’ll definitely face problems in the future.”
“I have plenty of practical experience, ” Wang Ping smiled and replied.
“Since you revealed that you can absorb the Spiritual Stone to enhance your cultivation, you haven’t practiced with me. And you say you’re experienced?” Chih Hu sneered disdainfully, “I think you’re all show and no go, and you’ll collapse at the slightest hit.”
“Well, why don’t we have a spar?” Wang Ping didn’t mind Chih Hu’s mockery, and suggested with a smile.
He was fully aware that the men in the Chi Village were all real hearty men. Chih Hu didn’t mean to mock him, he was just goading Wang Ping to practice martial arts more and gain more combat experience.”Fine.” Chih Hu grinned, revealing his white, strong teeth, and rubs his hands together, “Hehe, although our cultivation levels are the same, I think I can defeat you in three moves.”
“Hehe.” Wang Ping said with a smile: “I can’t accept that. How about we make a bet? You lose and today’s meat and beverages are all mine.”
“Damn, you’re really ruthless. I’d go crazy if I don’t eat meat and drink for a day.” Chih Hu’s face twitched a little.
“Didn’t you say you could defeat me in three moves? Why don’t you have even this little bit of confidence?” Wang Ping provoked him back, looking eager to try. “You are not scared of me, are you?”
“Who would be scared of a skinny bamboo pole like you.” Chih Hu glared, rubbing his hands together: “Since you have said so much, don’t blame me for being rough. Today, I will show you the gap in our combat experience.”
“Fight! Fight!”
A child chimed in.
“Betting time!” a bigger child said louder.
“I bet a piece of meat, Uncle Chih Hu will win.” “I bet two pieces of meat, Uncle Chih Hu will win!” “I bet a bowl of beast milk, Brother Wang Ping will win!”
Chifeng raised his hand.
“Chifeng, why are you betting on Brother Wang Ping to win? Brother Wang Ping has never fought before, it feels like he can’t even beat us at the same level.” a little girl with twisted braids in Chi Village blinked her lively, beautiful eyes and muttered.
“Exactly, exactly.” The other children also echoed, not believing that Wang Ping would win.
“I believe in Brother Wang Ping.” Chifeng stated firmly, “Uncle Chih Hu, according to Brother Wang Ping’s stories, looks like a typical passerby, a background character. But Brother Wang Ping is mysterious and obviously not simple.”
“Um…” Wang Ping felt speechless.
“Boy, what kind of stories have you been telling Chifeng every day? You even call me a passerby template and a background character.” Chih Hu’s forehead was covered in lines as he stared at Wang Ping with his big, bell-like eyes.
“…” Wang Ping was still speechless.
Chifeng, this little guy, always nagged for stories of novels from him. He understood many plotlines, and his unexpected words would surprise people but not him.
“Forget it, let’s start. Today, I want to see who is really the background character.”
Chih Hu stepped back a little, changed his posture, and said with a grunt.
The surrounding children all stopped their martial training and surrounded them, laughing and teasing.
“I’m coming!” Seeing that Wang Ping was full of flaws, Chih Hu felt that he could defeat Wang Ping with just one move and become the brightest figure in the children’s hearts. He couldn’t help but roar, charging directly towards Wang Ping and punching out.
This punch was powerful and heavy, and an intense fire attribute True Qi enveloped it, making it incredibly hot.
At a crucial moment, Wang Ping calmly dodged this punch with a slight side step.
Then he casually slapped, sending Chih Hu flying out. He fell on the ground and didn’t get up for quite a while.
Chih Hu was dumbfounded.
Just now Wang Ping didn’t move, and he thought Wang Ping was scared silly. He was about to pull his punch, but who knew, Wang Ping was calm and composed, sidestepped his punch, and with an tricky angle, casually slapped him and sent him flying.
If it was a battle of life and death, Wang Ping’s slap just now could have taken his life.
For a while, Chih Hu was questioning his life. He wondered who was really the elite huntsman in the village and who was the rookie who had just started martial training..

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - 41: Zhang Hu’s Group Task
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Zhang Hu’s Group Task
Translator: 549690339
“You little brats, who let you start your own gambling pool?” Chih Hu frowned, speaking to the children. “And at such a young age, you’re already learning to gamble, you’re asking for a beating.” “We learned it from you, Uncle Chih Hu.”
“Exactly, exactly.”
Some older children chimed in.
This made Chih Hu’s face twitch, unable to refute.
“Wang Ping, can you teach us that lifting heavy like it’s light and lifting light like it’s heavy thing?”
At this time, Chi Tongtong and the other children gathered around, their big, lively eyes blinking expectantly at him.
“Of course.” Wang Ping patted Chi Tongtong and the others on the head, smiling in agreement.
“Yay!” The children happily jumped up and down.
“Uncle Chih Hu, you don’t have to teach us anymore, we want Wang Ping to teach us.” Some older children yelled at Chih Hu.
“You little brat, you’ve grown wings, haven’t you?” Chih Hu scolded with a smile, kicking the child’s buttocks, sending him flying out with a sound of pain, causing the other children to burst into laughter.
Watching the chattering and laughing children, Wang Ping couldn’t help but laugh too, his negative emotions completely gone, feeling light and refreshed.
This atmosphere is really nice.
Next, Wang Ping began teaching the children cultivation skills, while Chih Hu left early to join the hunting team for their daily hunting.
The day passed quickly, and at dusk, the children retreated from their cultivation, chasing each other around the village, playing with the geese.
Wang Ping, on the other hand, returned to his courtyard.
“Woof!”
As soon as Wang Ping came back, the little dog Huang wagged his tail happily, running in circles around Wang Ping, occasionally pawing at his pant leg.
Wang Ping laughed, squatting down to pat the dog’s head.
The head pat made Huang even happier, licking Wang Ping’s hand, ticklishly.
“Alright, go keep playing, I have work to do.” Wang Ping said to Huang.
“Woof!” Huang barked, seeming to understand Wang Ping’s words, happily running off to play with the geese in the yard.
Wang Ping took out a wooden chair from the house and brought it to the door.
Stretching lazily, he sat down to watch the setting sun, enjoying a moment of tranquility.
He had no more Spiritual Stones for simulation.
The number of Spiritual Stones he would need for the next simulation was not something the village head could help him with, as it would expose Chi Village to risk.
Because of this, Wang Ping decided to leave Chi Village tomorrow to earn enough Spiritual Stones in Xia and take revenge on the Li Family.
Of course, before that, he still had some things to do.
As his thoughts raced, Wang Ping opened up the Transmigrator Chat Group to see if there were any new messages and to ask Cai Yonglong a few questions. Quickly, he found that the group was quite lively, with several people chatting.
The initiator of the conversation was Zhang Hu.
As soon as Zhang Hu spoke up, he mentioned that the Group Task had been unlocked and that he had received a Group Task out of the blue yesterday.
His words immediately set off a commotion in the group, with many previously lurking people joining the conversation.
Wu Jun (20): “Damn, when did the Group Task get activated? I thought it needed ten people?”
Liu Mei (15): “Come to think of it, it seems quite normal… because when the three newbies joined the group last time, there were already ten members.
Although two new members died soon after, the number of living people in the Transmigrator Chat Group had temporarily reached ten, so the Group Task got unlocked.”
Fang Yun (3): “Liu Mei’s reasoning is quite sound. That’s what I think too.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “The Group Task got unlocked? Interesting, it looks like we now have another way to get stronger. I’m looking forward to it.”
Wu Jun (20): “Wuwuwu, Mr.Cai, you’re looking forward to it, but I’m worried. After all, I’m just a weak bricklayer. If the Group Task is dangerous, wouldn’t I be screwed?”
Fang Yun (3): “Your world is a modern background, there shouldn’t be any danger. It’s not like they’ll make you sell your ass. Tom evil grin.jpg.’ wu Jun (20): ‘ .
Zhang Hu (5): “About the Group Task, I can only say that the first one isn’t difficult. However, the release of the Group Task seems to be based on your current situation. And from what I’ve studied, it looks like Group Tasks are divided into personal tasks and collective tasks.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Hu Zi, you mean personal tasks are issued to you separately, requiring you to complete them alone, while collective tasks are the real Group
Tasks, requiring us to work together, right?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Although there’s no collective task yet, I personally think so.
Before crossing, I’ve read some chat group-type novels. Maybe when a Group Task appears, we will cross into other people’s worlds.”
Wu Jun (20):
Cai Yonglong (1): “Indeed, it’s very likely. Nice, I’m already looking forward to it. What kind of sparks will come from different worlds!”
Liu Mei (15): “As an ordinary person, I’m not looking forward to it at all… I just want to know what Zhang Hu’s first task was.”
Zhang Hu (5): “It’s nothing special, just a simple hunting mission to hunt a magical beast. Hunting this magical beast is a bit difficult for me right now, but it’s still an easy task. And the chat group doesn’t specify that I can’t ask for help. Of course, whether this is an newbie mission and the chat group made it this simple, I’m not sure.”
Fang Yun (3): “I see. That’s actually acceptable. Another question, are there any rewards?”
Zhang Hu (5): “My reward is Group points, which seem to be related to the yet-to-be-opened System Mall. For now, they’re pretty useless. -1 ( ‘V’ ) r”
Wu Jun (20): “System Mall… isn’t that supposed to be opened when there are 15 members in the group? Good grief, did the chat group get the order of unlocking wrong? Shouldn’t it unlock the Group Mall first, then the Group Task?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Chat group: ‘Hmmm, are you teaching me how to do things?’. Sharp gaze.jpg.”
Wu Jun (20): “I wouldn’t dare, I wouldn’t dare…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “In this Transmigrator Chat Group, anything can happen, so just get used to it, and adapt. We don’t even know the purpose of the chat group letting us cross and randomly selecting a golden finger. Whatever happens in the future is normal, and we can only hope that everyone doesn’t die. ”
Wu Jun (20): “Mr. Cai, the more you say, the more I panic!
Liu Mei (15): “Worrying is useless, just have to adapt. If you die, you can only lament your own misfortune. And that day will come sooner or later..”

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 42: Danger Looms
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Danger Looms
Translator: 549690339
For the group members who joined early, they were already used to death. After all, too many compatriots joined the group and died quickly. Perhaps they were deeply touched at first, but eventually, they became numb.
Even if the group chats were usually filled with laughter, there was fear and confusion about the future in their hearts.
Perhaps in the eyes of Liu Mei and others, their unexpected death would come sooner or later.
Wang Ping looked at the chat content in the group and shook his head slightly.
He was no different.
If it weren’t for the Life Simulator, he would have died soon.
He had so many life simulations, each ending in an unexpected death, none of them ended well.
And this did not take into account the factor of the chat group.
Even Wang Ping didn’t think that having the Life Simulator would prevent him from having unexpected deaths.
The Transmigrator Chat Group was cruel and did not care about the death of its members.
And the Life Simulator was just a derivative Golden finger of the Transmigrator Chat Group.
If he died because of the chat group’s tasks, it would be normal.
However, after experiencing Wang Ping’s life in two simulations, especially the one today, Wang Ping still had reverence for life and death but no longer feared it and was no longer confused about the future.
With the advantage brought by the Life Simulator, his state of mind had already been elevated and surpassed those of other group members.
During the silence in the group chat, caused by Liu Mei’s message, Wang Ping sent a message.
Wang Ping (66) @ Cai Yonglong (1): “Mr. Cai, I want to ask you something.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “What is it?”
Wang Ping (66): “I want to ask, how long do cultivators in the Transcendent Realm live?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “The lifespan of the Transcendent Realm… The Spirit Sea Realm’s lifespan is 400 years, and both the Spiritual Fetus Realm and Spirit
Accumulation Realm are 500 years. However, when one reaches the Spirit Accumulation Realm, their soul becomes extremely powerful. Even if their body is destroyed, with good luck, they can rely on spiritual tools to nourish their souls and cling to the world. I have read ancient books from the sect. Some old monsters survived with their residual souls, took possession of others, and started a new life.’
Fang Yun (3): “Tsk, living for four to five hundred years, that’s really enviable.
Under the lemon tree, you and me.jpg.”
Zhang Hu (5): “It’s no wonder it’s a Profound World, even body possession came out.”
Wu Jun (20): “Quietly mocking, doesn’t the fantasy world also have the concept of body possession?”
Zhang Hu (5): “That’s the business of magicians, what does it have to do with me, a knight!”
Liu Mei (15): “Whether it’s a Profound World or a Fantasy World, both are fascinating and awe-inspiring. The powers of the two worlds are strong, and various methods are hard to defend against. I can die, but if someone takes possession of me, that would be too tragic…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “It’s not so bad. Although body possession is possible, it’s not so easy to erase the soul imprint of everyone. The outcome of forced possession is likely just the fusion of the two souls, becoming crazy and confused. By then, that new soul can only be considered a mixed product. Therefore, unless it’s a last resort, cultivators in the Spirit Accumulation Realm will not take possession of other people.”
Zhang Jun (70): “This situation is actually quite friendly to geniuses. Otherwise, old monsters in the Spirit Accumulation Realm could casually take possession of others, and there would be no growth environment for those geniuses.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Not necessarily. Babies in the womb, whether in body or soul, are pure and untainted. Old monsters in the Spirit Accumulation Realm, when taking possession of such infants, won’t affect their own souls and personalities.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, so you’re saying, in your world, the powerful cultivators in the Spirit Accumulation Realm just need to crazily seize babies, and they can survive forever?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Good lord, this way of possession reminds me of a certain anime’s twisted count who crazily took possession of his descendants to survive in this world. Speaking of which, I highly suspect that our world might also have such magic. After all, death is always terrifying, and I wouldn’t be surprised if those crazy magicians did anything to stay alive.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “For the sake of survival, people can do anything. Watching their body age, full of foul smell, and wither away, those old monsters who have been in high positions for a long time and can determine the life and death of millions of people with a single word are very crazy. Although not absolute, most of them are like this. Unfortunately, the Heavenly Tao is compassionate. In this world, powerful cultivators can take possession of others’ bodies and live another life, but no matter what living beings you take possession of, you can only do it once.”
