Wang Ping (66): “So that’s how it is. That’s not bad. Fortunately, that’s the case. Otherwise, I always feel that there are hidden old monsters everywhere.”
“Five hundred years, huh…”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he muttered.
He thought that the Transcendent Realm could live for thousands of years, but it seems he thought too much.
However, the enemies of the Chi family were people from at least a thousand years ago. How could they still be alive and make all the people in Chi Village disappear?
Or is it not because of the enemies of the Chi family as he had imagined, but because of some hidden reasons?
Or could it be that the enemies of the Chi family, through body possession and cultivation, have survived for more than a thousand years and their cultivation has surpassed the Transcendent Realm…
Cai Yonglong (1): “Yes, when I was going through the ancient books before, I thought there were old monsters everywhere, and I got scared. Fortunately, I saw the later content and breathed a sigh of relief.”
Chen Yao (71): ‘ .
Fang Yun (3): “Oh, Chen Yao is online. By the looks of it, did something happen? Or have you been sliced already? Smirk.jpg.”
Chen Yao (71): “Blocked.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn it, don’t do it! I’m just joking!”
Zhang Hu (5): “Hahaha, serves you right! Who told you to have such a sharp tongue! Look at you with your mouth so sharp, dreaming of walking in the
Jianghu and embracing beauty. You’re destined to be lonely!”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, how am I sharp-tongued?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Some people are just asking for it, just ignore them. Speaking of which, Chen Yao, you can tell us what happened.”
Chen Yao (71): “It’s nothing; the demons are just getting more rampant. A hundred thousand people in a small county city were slaughtered and devoured by a giant demon. And this is probably just the beginning.”
Wang Ping (66): “A hundred thousand people… Is the situation in your world already this bad?”
Wang Ping’s gaze condensed in surprise.
Although he had learned from Chen Yao’s few words that the situation in the world she had transmigrated to was bad, it seemed worse than he had imagined.
Transmigrating to such a world, Chen Yao’s life was hanging by a thread, and even the cultivators in that world might not be able to protect her from the demons..

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 43: Chen Yao Takes Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chen Yao Takes Off
Translator: 549690339
Chen Yao (71): “All I can say is, it’s worse than I imagined… So, I’m quite aware of my current situation, and I directly revealed my golden finger. Then, they started treating me like a savior, saying that they’ll spare no resources to cultivate me…”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, I’m jealous! A point addition system paired with the resources of an entire world – this is like a rocket taking off. Soon, Mr. Cai will be nothing compared to Chen Yao. I’m so shocked that my sunflower seeds dropped on the floor.jpg”
Cai Yonglong (1): “You little punk, you’re really asking for a beating. If it weren’t for you joining the group with me, I would’ve wanted to beat you to
death. ”
Zhang Hu (5): “Ah, this guy is too despicable, I also want to beat him up.”
Wu Jun (20): “Don’t worry, don’t worry, once the arena is unlocked or a group task appears, you guys will have plenty of opportunities to beat him up. Let’s see how he’ll continue being a playboy.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Good idea. I must say, it’s for his own good. Give him an Evil-Repelling Sword Manual or something, and his cultivation will skyrocket.”
Fang Yun (3): ‘ ?
Fang Yun (3): “Wu Jun, are you getting cocky now?”
Wang Ping (66): ‘
Liu Mei (15): “This guy is so despicable, always bullying the weak and fearing the strong, ignoring Mr. Cai and Zhang Hu, and only going after Wu Jun.” Wu Jun (20):
Cai Yonglong (1): “Indeed despicable. However, Wu Jun is indeed quite weak, I don’t know why, but people always want to bully him.”
Fang Yun (3): “Hehe, Mr. Cai, you really do have thoughts about Jun, wanting to force your will on him.”
Wu Jun (20): “(?#0 )…Cx…”
Wang Ping (66): “Are we getting off-topic now…”
Fang Yun (3): “What topic, there’s no topic, let’s talk about what actually matters. Smirking.jpg.”
“Ding, group member (3) has been banned from speaking by administrator Cai
Yonglong (1) for 24 hours.”
With this message popping up, everyone was shocked.
Fang Yun was even more dumbfounded, almost falling off his horse.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Phew, the world is finally peaceful.”
Chen Yao (71): “Serves you right…”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn! Mr. Cai, when did you become an administrator?”
Liu Mei (15): “Same surprise here…”
Wang Ping (66): “Same here+l.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “I saw that Zhang Hu mentioned the group mission function was quietly unlocked, so I went to check if there were other functions. Then, I found that I mysteriously became an administrator. I must say, this chat group is really ‘reticent’, didn’t notify me and there’s no green hat. Shrug.jpg.’
Wang Ping (66): “Indeed very ‘reticent’. Speaking of which, what are the privileges of a group manager? Can you kick people out? If so, it might save a lot of people who regret joining the group.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Sorry, currently there’s only the mute function, and a little bit of extra perks for admins – a 10% discount when purchasing items in the System Mall. Oh, and from now on, group announcements can only be made by me.”
Zhang Hu (5): “That’s it?”
Wu Jun (20): “It’s pretty good already. The joy of being an administrator lies in muting people, 0(*
Liu Mei (15): “I feel like Wu Jun is really happy.”
Chen Yao (71): “I am also happy that someone got muted. But, the mute duration is too short; I suggest a year. No, one year is still too short, make it ten years.”
Everyone:
One must learn from women when it comes to holding grudges.
Muting for ten years? It’s even doubtful whether Fang Yun could survive for ten years.
Zhang Jun (70): “Isn’t anyone interested in the 10% discount? I think that perk is pretty nice. Surely there are many good things in the System Mall, and the discount can save a lot of group points.”
Zhang Hu (5): “What’s the point of caring? I’m not a group manager, it’s got nothing to do with me.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Okay then…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “By the way, Zhang Jun, how are you doing now? Do you need any help?”
Zhang Jun (70): “Thanks for asking. I’m fine for now and don’t need any help.”
Wang Ping (66): “You guys continue chatting, I’ll go offline for a while.”
Seeing these people start to chat leisurely, Wang Ping, who accomplished his goal, no longer felt the need to keep interacting in the group.
After closing the chat group page, Wang Ping left the courtyard and slowly walked towards the entrance of the village.
At this time, the hunting team should be returning.
When that happens, it will be time for dinner.
As expected, just as Wang Ping arrived at the entrance of the village, he saw the men of the hunting team return bringing some prey into the village.
The hunt went very smoothly, with no casualties, making the villagers very lively and happy.
Seeing Wang Ping come over, the men of the hunting team warmly greeted him.
“Wang Ping, I never expected that you’d be so strong, taking down Chih Hu in just a few moves.”
“Who was taken down? I just went easy on him.” Chih Hu blushed and shouted.
“Cut the crap. You obviously have a gap in strength with Wang Ping, but you just won’t admit it.”
“Lol, Uncle Chih Hu, you’re so shameless.”
Having children expose the truth, Chih Hu glared.
“Wang Ping, with your skills, it’s not right to stay in the village. Why don’t you join us in hunting?”
Chi Tie, the captain of the hunting team, walked over, patted Wang Ping on the shoulder, and said with a smile.
“Definitely next time, definitely next time,” Wang Ping replied with a smile.
“Alright, we have a deal,” Chi Tie gave a thumbs up.
“Uh…” Wang Ping was left speechless.
He habitually played with the joking tone, but these men obviously didn’t understand his humor, making the situation awkward.
“Village chief, I have something to discuss with you,” Wang Ping approached the village chief and said.
“Are you leaving?” Before Wang Ping could finish, the village chief sighed.
“Village chief, how did you know?” Wang Ping was surprised.
“Your unique physique requires a large amount of Spiritual Stones for cultivation. Hence, it’s inevitable that you’ll leave Chi Village.”
The village chief shook his head.
“However, that’s for the best. The outside world will suit you better compared to Chi Village. Our village is more suitable for a peaceful retirement.”
The village chief sighed.
“I see, ” Wang Ping nodded with understanding.
As expected, the village chief had great wisdom and was able to see through many things.
“I just hope that after you leave, you won’t disclose anything about the village,” the village chief stared at Wang Ping and said.
“I won’t mention it,” Wang Ping shook his head and smiled, “I will also make sure you have enough ability to protect yourselves.” “I believe you,” the village chief smiled and nodded..

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 44: Ancient Jade and the Incomplete Cultivation Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Ancient Jade and the Incomplete Cultivation Skill
Translator: 549690339
“Village Chief, I have something to discuss with you privately.”
At this moment, Wang Ping suddenly spoke to the village chief with a serious expression on his face.
“Village Chief, Chifeng should possess a latent spiritual body. Is there any cultivation skill in the village that can awaken him?”
Although Wang Ping had confirmed this matter in the Life Simulator that there was no suitable cultivation skill in Chi Village, he still wanted to ask once more.
“Yes, and no…” Wang Ping’s sudden message made the village chief slightly stunned, and after a moment of silence, he gave this answer.
The village chief was not surprised, obviously, he had known about Chifeng’s extraordinary physique for a long time.
“What does that mean?” Wang Ping was puzzled.
The current situation was clearly different from what happened in the life simulation, so the village chief in the simulation must have hidden something.
“Our Chi Village’s Fire Spirit Skill was once adapted from an Earth-tier Cultivation Skill. And that cultivation skill was specifically practiced by the people of the ancient Chi Clan,” The village chief sighed.
“However, most of it has been lost, and the remaining parts are seriously incomplete, making it impossible to practice. This is why it was adapted into another cultivation skill,” he added.
“I see.” Wang Ping nodded with understanding.
No wonder the village chief spoke in such an ambiguous manner. If the truth were like this, everything could be explained.
“What a pity that the child has a latent spiritual body… Now it’s impossible for us to awaken his spiritual body using any method.” The village chief sighed deeply after recalling Wang Ping’s words. “Even three hundred years ago, it would not have been possible.”
Wang Ping nodded.
He had also confirmed this point in the life simulation.
“About the Li Family.” Wang Ping looked at the morning glow and said slowly:
“When I go out this time, I will make them lose the power to threaten Chi Village.”
“What?” The village chief looked at Wang Ping in astonishment, almost thinking that he had heard wrong.
“Wait, your cultivation…” At this moment, the village chief finally noticed something wrong.
Wang Ping looked much younger, his skin had become extremely fair, and he had an otherworldly temperament.
In addition, the village chief could no longer see through Wang Ping’s cultivation level.
Logically, one could only see through another’s cultivation if they were of the same level or higher.
“I made a breakthrough.” As Wang Ping said this, he also revealed a trace of his own aura.
“Spiritual Origin Realm!” The village chief’s pupils constricted, revealing an incredulous expression.
It didn’t take long for Wang Ping to reach the Spiritual Origin Realm. Even if he could devour spiritual stones, his speed shouldn’t have been this fast.
Obviously, Wang Ping had a secret the village chief didn’t know about. However, in this world, who doesn’t have secrets? Wang Ping held great goodwill and trust towards Chi Village, so naturally, the village chief would not pry into his secrets, nor did he dare to.
“With my current strength, I am capable of destroying the Li Family. Once I destroy the Li Family, Chi Village will be safe.” Wang Ping said confidently.
“Your physique is so special, you should cultivate for a while first, and then when you are truly invincible, you can go and deal with the Li Family.” The village chief was very grateful and said hastily, “Our Chi Village already owes you too much. We really don’t want you to get into trouble because of us.” “Don’t worry, I have everything under control.” Wang Ping nodded.
Of course, he wouldn’t recklessly go and destroy the Li Family.
After all, the Li Family still had connections with the Sword Spirit Sect.
The village chief nodded, and after taking a deep breath, he walked forward and said, “Wang Ping, follow me. There are two things that might be of great help to you.”
“What are they?” Wang Ping was amazed and followed him.
Soon, Wang Ping followed the village chief to his house.
Then, Wang Ping saw the village chief take out a crystal-clear Pure White Ancient Jade from a hidden compartment under his bed.
On the Pure White Ancient Jade, there were red flame patterns, which looked very beautiful.
“What is this?” Wang Ping was very surprised.
“I don’t know its origin either.” The village chief gently stroked the Ancient Jade and recalled, “This is a relic passed down in my Chi Village, and it also serves as a token verification for our village chief. Only the village chief knows its secret. On the day of the Chi Clan’s Genocide, the village chief only had time to let me take this object and a few of our people to escape through a secret passage.”
“Although I don’t know what secret this Ancient Jade hides, I do know that it has a mysterious effect. Fifty years ago, I was unable to forget the tragic scene in the village and held deep hatred towards the Li Family. An accident occurred while practicing, and I almost lost control due to my anger. In the end, it was this Ancient Jade that emitted a bright glow and made me regain my senses.””Such an important thing, entrusting it to me, it doesn’t feel right.” Wang Ping shook his head, with a shocked expression.
This ancient jade, being an heirloom of the Chi Clan, was definitely not simple, and must be hiding a great secret within.
He was just an outsider, and he couldn’t just take the Chi Clan’s heirloom carelessly.
“This thing, staying with me, won’t do any good.” The village chief said with a bitter smile, and slowly continued: “One day, our Chi Clan will end up as ordinary people, because…”
Listening to the village chief’s recounting of Chi Village’s past, Wang Ping was silent.
From the simulator, he had already learned about the Chi Clan’s past.
The Bloodline Curse of Chi Village had been affecting them all along.
How glorious the Chi Clan used to be, and now even breaking through to the Innate Realm was very difficult…
If the Bloodline Curse could not be lifted, eventually, they would not even be able to cultivate, and would completely become ordinary people.
Even Wang Ping, as he was now, could not guarantee that he could break the Bloodline Curse on the Chi Clan.
Because there were too many unsolved mysteries in it, with deep implications.
Although Wang Ping had the Life Simulator, he did not think that he could always change the bad luck to good and live forever.
“Wang Ping, you are the most suitable person to hold this item. After all, your cultivation progress is too fast, and inevitably there will be problems with your Tao Heart. This thing can save your life at a critical moment.”
“This is our Chi Clan’s way of repaying you, so please accept it. Moreover, even though our Chi Clan had a glorious past, it is ultimately going to come to an end. This thing is useless to us now.”
The village chief placed the ancient jade in Wang Ping’s hand, and sighed. “Besides, although it’s a bit presumptuous of me, I still hope that you’ll try your best to protect our descendants in the future. You don’t need to make them successful, just make sure that others don’t dare to bully them. The future Chi family members are destined to abandon martial arts, to study, or to become merchants.”
In the end, the village chief’s expression was very desolate and sad.
The past glory, like a passing cloud, now had to make such a helpless choice.
“Village chief…” Wang Ping held the ancient jade and handed it back, saying with mixed emotions: “You don’t have to do this.”
In this world, who can not wither away?
Even if the Chi Clan had once been incomparably glorious, they had finally come to this step, which made people sigh.
Moreover, the mysterious disappearance of the Chi villagers in the Life Simulator left him feeling uneasy.
“As I said before, we won’t need this thing in the future. You should keep it. If you become stronger, our Chi family members will be safer and enjoy the blessings of riches and honor.”
The village chief stepped back again and shook his head.
“To be honest, I am very grateful that you appeared in our Chi Village. Otherwise, I can’t imagine what would happen in the future. Even if we were not wiped out by the Li Family, the path ahead would still be exceptionally difficult, struggling in the mortal world. Perhaps, one day, an accident would completely cut off the line of descendants of Chi Village.” The village chief’s eyes were deep, looking far away.
Wang Ping was at a loss for words as the chief spoke the truth.
If he hadn’t shown up, even if they escaped the disaster of the Li Family, there was still the catastrophe of the Beast Tide in the Black Wind Forest.
After escaping the Beast Tide, there would be a continuous war for more than a decade.
They didn’t know what dangers they would encounter in the future.
In this world, it’s too hard to survive.
That’s why the average lifespan of people in ancient times was so short.
In a world without Extraordinary Power like this Profound World, the average lifespan would only be even shorter.
“If that’s the case, then I’ll accept this ancient jade.”
With mixed feelings, Wang Ping did not refuse, and holding the ancient jade, put it into the Lower-tier Storage Ring.
“There is one more thing for you.”
At this moment, the village chief spoke again, taking an ancient, yellowed book from another hidden compartment under the bed.
“This
Wang Ping was surprised.
“This is the cultivation skill handed down by our Chi Clan since a thousand years ago. It is the incomplete cultivation skill I mentioned before.”
The village chief said earnestly..

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 45 Leaving Chi Village
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Leaving Chi Village
Translator: 549690339
“Is this the incomplete cultivation method?” Upon hearing this, Wang Ping showed an astonished and curious expression.
The cultivation method that had been passed down for a millennium had an astonishing origin.
A thousand years was an overly long time, which could allow many things to be lost in the long river of history.
Just like the history of China, it is vast, profound, and unrivaled, but it is difficult to know whether some of the history is real or fabricated by later generations.
Time is ruthless and can bury too many things, leaving future generations unaware of the truth of history.
This millennium-old cultivation method, handed down from the Chi Clan, despite being incomplete, was still extremely valuable. “Chief, how would you rank this cultivation method?”
Wang Ping, feeling a bit of regret, asked.
“Earth-tier top-grade,” the chief answered. “This cultivation method is divided into the upper, middle, and lower volumes. Each volume has astounding secret techniques. And this incomplete ancient book you hold is the lower volume.”
“If it were the upper volume, you could still cultivate with it, although only the first three levels of the technique. But as an Earth-tier top-grade cultivation method, its power is ultimately much stronger than other techniques, surpassing the Earth middle tier, and only the Earth upper tier cultivated to a profound extent can be on par with it.”
The chief sighed as he gently stroked the yellowed ancient book.
This incomplete cultivation method bore too much history. Every time he looked at it, he couldn’t help but imagine how glorious the original Red Race was, and how invincible his ancestors had been after practicing the astounding technique, slaying countless enemies.
However, in the end, when he looked at the situation in Chi Village, he could only be filled with disappointment and sorrow.
“So it’s the lower volume, what a pity,” Wang Ping said with some regret.
Should the upper volume be obtained, his cultivation speed would undoubtedly be much faster.
Although the Earth-level lower-Tier martial Skill – Sword Essence Skill from the Sword Spirit Sect is quite good, the gap between cultivation method tiers and the level of cultivation is vast, with every level higher making a huge difference.
Not to mention the gap between Earth lower tier and Earth-tier top-grade. Even an incomplete Earth-tier top-grade cultivation method is not something an Earth lower tier can compare to.
However, it is quite normal for the village chief not to have the upper volume.
If the village chief had the upper volume, he would have given it to the villagers for cultivation, and they wouldn’t have practiced the self-made Fire Spirit Skill.
“This cultivation method is called Red Fire Skill and is most suitable for Fire Attribute cultivators to practice. If you have great fortune and can find the other two volumes of the method, you will surely be able to dominate your peers and become invincible in the world.”
The village chief handed Wang Ping the yellowed ancient book in his hand, speaking earnestly.
“Thank you, Chief,” Wang Ping solemnly said as he received the book and placed it into his storage ring.
Although he didn’t think he had any great fortune to easily find the two other volumes of the method, he did have the Life Simulator where he could run a few more simulations, perhaps to find some clues.
In such a case, he might be able to bring together the three volumes of the method, allowing the powerful Red Fire Skill to reappear in the world.
Next, the village chief and Wang Ping returned to the others, ready to have dinner together.
“Come on, Wang Ping boy, you’re leaving soon, we won’t stop drinking tonight until we’re all drunk. ‘
Chih Hu hooked Wang Ping’s neck and spoke enthusiastically.
“You lost all the meat and wine to me today, so you don’t qualify for drinking.” Wang Ping said seriously to Chih Hu.
“What are you talking about? Our bet was just verbal agreement; it doesn’t count for anything.”
Chih Hu’s face stiffened, and then he started making faces at Wang Ping, looking nothing like an elder.
To drink and eat meat, he was really desperate.
Upon hearing this, everyone let out a collective hiss.
“Uncle Chih Hu, although I never meant to make you keep your promise and was just joking with you, you really are quite shameless.”
Wang Ping was speechless. In the face of someone so addicted to drinking, he really didn’t need to save face just for the sake of alcohol.
Of course, Wang Ping initially just said those words in jest and didn’t mean for them to be taken seriously.
“Cough, you wicked boy…” Chih Hu blushed, coughed, and looked extremely embarrassed.lf he had known this would happen, he wouldn’t have said that. Now he has utterly embarrassed himself.
Seeing Chih Hu like this, everyone burst into laughter, making the atmosphere lively.
The next day, in the early morning, Wang Ping bid farewell to the people of Chi Village and left.
Of course, this place was located deep within the Black Wind Forest, where ordinary Innate Realm experts would face danger if they traveled alone.
However, with Wang Ping’s current cultivation level, as long as he didn’t venture too deep, there wouldn’t be any danger.
After that, Wang Ping continued on his journey, not encountering any danger.
Although he encountered a tier-five monster beast on the way, the beast had gained some intelligence and knew that Wang Ping was not easy to mess with, so it didn’t dare to attack him.
At sunset, Wang Ping arrived at Black Wind Town under the beautiful sky.
Because of his previous life experiences, Wang Ping was quite familiar with
Black Wind Town.
After all, he had lived in Black Wind Town for about a year.
Soon, Wang Ping went to the first floor of the inn and ordered many dishes. “Sir, it’s quite boring to eat and drink alone. Why don’t we combine tables?” , said one of the men seated at the table across from him.
“My… lord, this is not appropriate. You are of noble status and should not share a table with commoners, ” a young woman responded sharply.
At the table opposite Wang Ping, there were three customers waiting for their dishes — a young man and two females.
The young man appeared to be around fifteen years old, clutching a fan engraved with a phoenix pattern. Dressed in a spotless white robe with smooth hair and fair skin, he was extraordinarily handsome, causing many young girls to blush in shame.
One of the two women seated with him was good-looking, also around fifteen to sixteen years old, and seemed to be the young man’s servant.
The other one was an old woman who looked aged, but her eyes were clear and sharp, staring intently at Wang Ping as if deep in thought.
It was the handsome young man and the girl who seemed to be a servant who had just spoken.
Wang Ping looked up at the three people with a deep gaze.
He didn’t expect to encounter a high-ranking expert just after leaving the Black Wind Forest and entering Black Wind Town.
The handsome young man, although young, had an astonishing cultivation level, having reached the 7th-Tier of the Post-Heaven Realm.
The so-called servant girl also had a 2nd -Tier Post-Heaven Realm cultivation level, demonstrating exceptional talent.
Lastly, the old woman was the most terrifying one, with an unmeasurable cultivation level, making her a Spiritual Realm Expert.
Wang Ping recalled that during his previous life experience, he had come to this inn after leaving Black Wind Forest. However, he had never encountered such a group before.
Of course, he had left Chi Village more than a month later during his previous life experience, so it was natural to encounter different people this time.
“My name is Yuan Xia. May I know your name, sir?” the handsome young man named Yuan Xia asked Wang Ping.
Seeing that the other party didn’t harbor ill intentions, Wang Ping replied, “My name is Wang Ping.”
“Wang Ping, huh? Since we’ve met by chance, why not become friends?” said Yuan Xia while fanning himself with a smile.
“Sure,” Wang Ping nodded nonchalantly, giving the old woman a sidelong glance.
“In that case, let’s combine tables, so it’s more lively,” suggested Yuan Xia enthusiastically. He then combined the two tables and called the waiter,
“Waiter, bring the best dishes and wine you have.”
“Understood!” The waiter immediately responded with a smile.
“So, where are you from, Brother Wang?” asked Yuan Xia curiously. “You are so young and yet have a cultivation level that even I cannot see through. It is truly an extraordinary talent. I wonder why I have never heard of you before.”
Wang Ping appeared to be around twenty years old, and he must have been at least a 7th -Tier Post-Heaven Realm cultivator. Although his talent was probably not as extraordinary as Yuan Xia’s and Bai Tianhong’s, he shouldn’t be an unknown figure..

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 46: Eccentric and Unusual People
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Eccentric and Unusual People
Translator: 549690339
“I travel the world and never compete with others, so it’s natural that you haven’t heard of me,” Wang Ping casually replied, and then counter-questioned, “On the contrary, Yuan, you are incredibly talented, and few can compare to you. I have never heard of you either, which is quite strange.”
“Uh…” Yuan Xia choked up.
Being counter-questioned was indeed a subtle feeling.
“Like Mr. Wang, I also travel the world and never compete with others, so my reputation isn’t prominent.” Yuan Xia then shook his fan and said with a smile, “I came to Black Wind Forest for experience this time; I wonder if Mr. Wang would be interested in accompanying me.”
Hearing this, Wang Ping looked at Yuan Xia, shook his head, and said, “As I mentioned earlier, I don’t like competing with others. And by the way, Yuan, isn’t your behavior a bit too effeminate?”
“Really?”
Yuan Xia was slightly taken aback, and then his face flushed red.
“How dare you accuse our young master of being effeminate!”
Seeing Wang Ping say this, the maidservant beside Yuan Xia couldn’t sit still and scolded him.
These words made Yuan Xia frown and glance at her.
She immediately kept quiet.
“I apologize, she’s somewhat ignorant. Mr. Wang doesn’t have to take her words to heart,” Yuan Xia said, looking at Wang Ping, then coughed lightly and rolled his eyes at Wang Ping, adding, “But Mr. Wang, your previous words were indeed excessive; where did I act effeminately?”
Looking at Yuan Xia’s demeanor and eyes, Wang Ping felt even more bizarre.
Yuan Xia’s facial expressions, actions, and tone were indeed a bit too feminine, making him quite odd.
Could the person in front of him be a young lady from a prominent family or a leader of a big sect, pretending to be a man and wandering around in Jianghu?
This idea flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
At this moment, there were discussions amongst other diners.
“Bai Tianhong, the disciple of Sword Spirit Sect, is really extraordinary. Not long ago, he killed an Innate Realm expert.”
“I’ve also heard about this. Rumors say that an old Innate Realm expert tried to assassinate him, but he ended up killing him.”
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, Bai Tianhong is just eighteen years old and has already reached the 10th-tier peak of the Post-Heaven Realm. He can even slay experienced Innate Realm experts, making him a real monster.”
“Yeah, Bai Tianhong is truly an exceptional genius. Even the Ancestor of Xia
Country once said that if Bai Tianhong doesn’t fall midway, he will become a
Transcendent Realm Master in the future.’
“I dare say that Bai Tianhong is the strongest among the younger generation.
No one from the three countries can compare to him.”
“Bai Tianhong is indeed extraordinary, but he still falls short of my young…master.”
Seeing other diners talk like this, Yuan Xia’s maid glared and countered.
“Hehe, your young master is pale and delicate, clearly not strong. How can he compare to Bai Tianhong?”
“Exactly, if he were really that powerful, we wouldn’t have never heard of him.”
“Little girl, you shouldn’t be talking nonsense.”
The other diners couldn’t help but glance at Yuan Xia and tease him when they heard this.
In their opinion, Yuan Xia was just a handsome young man, not even comparable to Bai Tianhong.
Comparing him to Bai Tianhong was an insult to Bai Tianhong.
“How dare you speak about my master like this!” The maid glared angrily, her palm filled with True Qi, ready to attack.
Seeing the True Qi in the maid’s palm, the other diners were all shocked.
Such a young maid already possessed a Post-Heaven Realm cultivation, which was terrifying.
This was just the maid; one could hardly imagine the noble identity and power of her master.
For a moment, those who had just spoken turned pale and showed panic.They offended these people, even if they were beaten and killed, there would be no place to seek justice.
“Dong’er, don’t cause trouble.” Seeing the maid preparing to take action, Yuan Xia frowned and said.
“But, Master, they insulted you…” The maid’s face was full of grievances.
“If this is considered an insult, then wouldn’t I have to kill everyone wherever I go?” Yuan Xia taught: “We are here to gain experience, not to harm others without understanding the situation.”
“I was wrong.” Seeing Yuan Xia angry, the maid could only lower her head and not dare to refute.
Although her Master was usually gentle and treated her well, she knew the importance of hierarchy and did not dare to talk back to her Master.
“I’m sorry, Mr. Wang, for causing you any embarrassment.” After glancing at her, Yuan Xia spoke to Wang Ping. “Come on, let’s continue eating and drinking. I must get drunk with Mr. Wang today as we hit it off so well.”
The other diners also breathed a sigh of relief, showing grateful expressions towards Yuan Xia, quickly put down a few silver pieces, and left in a hurry without daring to stay any longer.
Wang Ping shook his head to show that he didn’t care, but he glanced at the maid Dong’er.
Those with noble status and exceptional talent are often arrogant, but Yuan Xia’s character is quite good, not being arrogant because of her talent, nor wantonly humiliating and killing others because of her noble status.
However, her maid’s temperament was a bit worse, the typical “my master is very powerful, and no one should insult her” attitude, and she also liked to randomly injure and kill others at will.
Of course, no matter how bad Dong’er’s temperament was, it had nothing to do with Wang Ping.
Next, Yuan Xia continuously engaged Wang Ping in various conversations, very enthusiastically.
After they finished eating and drinking, Wang Ping returned to his room.
“Young Master, this Wang Ping is not simple.”
After Wang Ping went upstairs, the Old Woman who had not spoken finally opened her mouth.
“Oh? How do you know?” Yuan Xia, who had drunk some wine and had a slightly flushed face, asked curiously while shaking her fan.
In Xia Country, there were not many people who could be evaluated as ‘not simple’ by the Old Woman, most of them were top talents.
“He gives me a feeling of danger. It seems as if I would vanish from the world as soon as I fought with him,” said the Old Woman with profound eyes.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Xia was surprised.
Dong’er, the maid standing beside her, also opened her mouth wide in disbelief.
How could it be, the Old Woman was at Spiritual Realm cultivation!
A person who could make a Spiritual Realm Expert feel dangerous was absolutely a Spiritual Realm Expert as well!
Previously, she had underestimated Wang Ping and thought that her Master’s initiative to befriend him was an honor for a small person like Wang Ping. She found it hateful that Wang Ping had been indifferent to her Master. She never expected the Old Woman’s evaluation of Wang Ping to be so high.
It should be said that it was extremely terrifying.
“He’s a Spiritual Realm Expert? But looking at his appearance, isn’t he too young?” Yuan Xia said in surprise.
“A cultivator’s age cannot be judged by their appearance. Two hundred years of lifespan for Innate Realm and three hundred years for Spiritual Origin Realm. Based on his appearance, he seems to be around twenty, but his actual age may be sixty or seventy,” reminded the Old Woman, shaking her head.
“You’re right,” Yuan Xia nodded, exclaiming, “For a sixty or seventy-year-old Spiritual Realm Expert, even though their talent may not be as good as mine or
Bai Tianhong’s, they are definitely the most talented person below us both.”
She and Bai Tianhong were confident that they could break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm before the age of forty. Wang Ping, at sixty or seventy years old, was indeed not on par with her and Bai Tianhong.
However, it was still impressive enough.
After all, in today’s Xia, even counting the older generation experts and hidden experts, there were no more than two hundred Spiritual Realm Experts.
There were only about a hundred Spiritual Realm Experts in the open.
Considering that Spiritual Realm Experts had a lifespan of three hundred years, one could imagine how difficult it was to break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm.
The Old Woman nodded and praised, “We just came out not long ago, and we have already met such an unknown Spiritual Realm genius. There are indeed countless remarkable people in this world..”

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 47: Xia’s Ninth Princess
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Xia’s Ninth Princess
Translator: 549690339
“Going out to gain experience was indeed the right choice.” Yuan Xia shook her fan, saying with a smile.
“Yuan’er, you should try to get close to him; he might be a great help to you.” The old woman suggested seriously.
“The current situation in Xia grows more chaotic. Those vassals are all ambitious, and the princes are all useless and unfit. You are the hope of Xia.” After a pause, the old woman relayed her sentiments through True Qi.
“Hmm…”
Yuan Xia nodded, her eyes flickering uncertainly.
“It’s a pity that the Sword Spirit Sect has always remained neutral for thousands of years. If they could support you, you’d be able to suppress everything.” The old woman spoke again, full of regret.
“It’s normal that we can’t win over the Sword Spirit Sect. If they were so easily swayed, our Xia might not have lasted for 500 years.” Yuan Xia said carelessly.
“I think it’s a blessing that the Sword Spirit Sect can remain neutral.”
“You’re right.” The old woman nodded in agreement.
The Sword Spirit Sect is an ancient sect with a profound foundation. If it hadn’t maintained its neutrality, we might not have succeeded in the dynastic change 500 years ago.
It must be said that this young girl truly sees through the situation.
Her presence is the last hope for Xia, perhaps allowing Xia’s national fortune to revive and continue for another 300 years.
The only thing to regret is that her time is too short, as it seems she will pass away soon.
Thinking of this, the old woman felt somewhat worried.
Inside the inn’s room, Wang Ping opened the interface of the Life Simulator.
Although he no longer had enough Spiritual Stones for paid simulations, he still had one free simulation chance left.
He needed to use this free simulation to learn about some things.
For example, whether Yuan Xia and the others posed a threat to him.
Or if he would encounter any danger on his journey ahead.
“System, initiate the life simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
As Wang Ping spoke, the luminescent screen of the Life Simulator appeared before his eyes.
“Life simulation begins. Host remaining free simulation times: o.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, text began to appear on the luminescent screen.
[Daya calendar 480, March 14th: Nothing happened.]
[Daya calendar 480, March 15th: Yuan Xia enthusiastically invites you to stroll Black Wind Town together. Despite repeatedly refusing, you eventually agree as she remains persistent.]
[You and Yuan Xia stroll around Black Wind Town and eat many snacks.]
[At dusk, Yuan Xia opens a private room in the best restaurant in Black Wind Town and asks you questions about Xia. You calmly answer, leaving Yuan Xia very surprised, feeling that your words make sense. In the meantime, you have a rough idea about Yuan Xia’s identity.]
[Without any accidents, Yuan Xia should be the Xia 9th Princess Xia Yuan. Her current name is simply her name spelled backward. You also associate this with the future of Xia 9th Princess Xia Yuan.]
[The Xia 9th Princess Xia Yuan, talented and gifted, is said to have a cultivation aptitude not inferior to Bai Tianhong. She is highly valued by the Xia Emperor. Unfortunately, the struggle for power in the royal family is often cruel, and all the princes of Xia want to be the new emperor. Among them, the ascendant Third Crown Prince Xia Feng sees the Ninth Princess as a great threat and secretly colludes with the vassals to send a Spiritual Realm Expert to assassinate Xia Yuan during her training, ultimately killing her.]
[The assassination of the Ninth Princess shakes the world, and the Xia Royal Family is infuriated. The strongest ancient creature personally takes action to kill the Spiritual Realm Expert. However, no matter what, the Ninth Princess is dead, and the last hope of Xia is lost.]
“So it’s her.”
Wang Ping looked at the content emerging on the simulator, lost in thought.
Before, when he had talked with Yuan Xia, he had associated it with the Xia Ninth Princess, but the information was too limited to be certain.
However, in the Life Simulator, the two had deeper conversations, allowing him to confirm her identity.
“I’ve gotten myself involved with a troublesome person.” Wang Ping lamented inwardly.
He remembered that Ninth Princess Xia Yuan’s death would occur in ten days.
And now that he had talked with Xia Yuan, it was hard to ensure that he wouldn’t be implicated.
In fact, when he first experienced life, he heard about the assassination of the Ninth Princess, but at that time, he was just a small individual focused on martial training and didn’t pay much attention to it.
After all, by the time he arrived at Black Wind Town, the incident was several months old, and the turmoil had long since subsided, deeming it outdated news.
“I hope it won’t affect me from now on.”
Wang Ping could only think this as he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
If he was implicated, he would head straight to the Sword Spirit Sect.
Only a transcendent sect like the Sword Spirit Sect could guarantee his safety.
Otherwise, even if he was in the Spiritual Realm, he wouldn’t be secure against a behemoth like the Xia Royal Family.
As Wang Ping gazed at the luminescent screen again, the text on the screen continued to emerge.
[After guessing Yuan Xia’s identity, you did not expose her, and planned to leave after the meal. However, due to your enjoyable conversation, Yuan Xia voluntarily reveals her identity and invites you to become her right-hand man.]
[You refuse, stating you just want a peaceful life.]
[To prevent being implicated, you tactfully remind Yuan Xia it is safer to return to the palace. Yuan Xia is surprised but does not take it seriously. You say nothing more.]
[The next day, you head straight for the Sword Spirit Sect without stopping. However, Yuan Xia seems to have taken a liking to you and insists on accompanying you, claiming you are on the same path. You are speechless and can only ignore her.]
[In the end, you arrive at the Sword Spirit Sect. Yuan Xia and the others are astonished and have no idea why you have come to the Sword Spirit Sect. You explain your identity and purpose, and the Sword Spirit Sect’s Mountain Guard is shocked, quickly contacting the Sect Master.]
[Meanwhile, Yuan Xia and the others are also extremely shocked. They never imagined you not only know alchemy but are also a 4th Tier alchemist. Yuan Xia, unable to contain her excitement, once again invites you to be her right-hand man, making astonishing promises.]
[You still decline, saying you don’t want to get involved in the struggle of the royal family. The old woman becomes anxious, mentioning Yuan Xia’s high status as the designated future Empress, in an attempt to sway you.]
[However, you remain unmoved, leaving Yuan Xia and the old woman frustrated.]
[Soon, the Sword Spirit Sect Master arrives, and is surprised to see Yuan Xia and the others. He hurriedly invites you all to enter the sect.]
[Seeing the Sect Master, you feel a murderous intent but do not show it, instead choosing to follow him into the sect..]

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 48: A New Spiritual Tool
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: A New Spiritual Tool
Translator: 549690339
[Next, you successfully joined the Sword Spirit Sect. Yuan Xia stayed with you for half a month, and after you remained unmoved, she could only leave helplessly. However, she also lost interest in continuing her training and decided to return to the Imperial Palace.]
[Because of Yuan Xia’s sensitive identity, the Sword Spirit Sect assigned one of the Supreme Elders to secretly escort her away to prevent any accidents along the way.]
[On the way back to the palace, Yuan Xia was attacked. Fortunately, the Supreme Elder appeared and together with the Old Woman, they defeated the enemy, allowing Yuan Xia to escape alive.]
[At that moment, Yuan Xia recalled your words and was grateful for her decision to join the Sword Spirit Sect with you. Otherwise, she might have died at the hands of the enemies. She secretly vowed to bring the mastermind behind the attacks to justice.]
[You heard about Yuan Xia’s attack, but it was surprising that she managed to survive due to the intervention of the Supreme Elder. You realized that the butterfly effect was at play and were unsure if it was a blessing or a curse.]
[However, you ultimately believed that as long as you stayed in the Sword Spirit Sect, and Bai Tianhong didn’t meet an early end, there wouldn’t be any big problems.]
[In the following years, Xia Yuan wrote to you, not giving up on trying to win you over.]
[In the year 486 of the Daya Calendar, the Xia Kingdom was in turmoil. The Third Prince was killed by the Ninth Princess Xia Yuan in the capital, shocking everyone with her strength and resolute style.]
[The actions of Ninth Princess Xia Yuan made the other princes and princesses shiver in fear. They jointly petitioned for the Old Emperor to punish the Ninth Princess, as they believed that her ruthless behavior, including killing her own brother without reason, made her too cruel.]
[Faced with the joint petition from the princes and princesses, the Ninth Princess stood strong. She directly presented evidence of the Third Prince’s multiple assassination attempts on her, silencing everyone in the court. The Old Emperor eventually sided with the Ninth Princess, making it clear to all the ministers who the rightful heir was. They started to choose sides, no longer wavering in their loyalties.]
[You heard about the Ninth Princess Xia Yuan and shook your head, not expecting her to be so domineering. People couldn’t be judged by their appearances.]
[In the year 487 of the Daya Calendar, you and Bai Tianhong appeared in the Black Wind Forest, killed the Tier-7 Demon Beast Silver Moon Wolf, and prevented a Beast Tide from erupting.]
[By the end of the year 492 of the Daya Calendar, the Old Emperor abdicated, and Ninth Princess Xia Yuan ascended the throne, becoming the Empress Xia Yuan, whose reputation shook the entire Xia Kingdom. In the same year, your cultivation reached the second tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm.]
[In the early part of the 493rd year of the Daya Calendar, Chu State was in chaos, with bandits running rampant and widespread uprisings causing misery among the people. Empress Xia Yuan was furious and quickly sent a large army to suppress the chaos.]
[In the same year, she initiated reforms and issued a series of policies benefiting both the kingdom and its people, executing countless corrupt officials. The situation in Xia Country improved, and people started to praise Empress Xia Yuan, as she gradually gained popular support.]
[However, her dominant style also caused discontent among many officials and vassals of aristocratic families, who began plotting together in secret.]
[Despite this, Empress Xia Yuan showed no signs of backing down. Instead, she became more and more dominant, even enlisting the help of the invincible ancestor of the Xia Royal Family to suppress various small forces. She knew very well that the current Xia Dynasty was approaching its end, and it could collapse at any time. For this reason, decisive measures were needed to govern the country, and there was no room for hesitation.]
[Her actions were both shocking and infuriating to many vassals. However, faced with the might of the invincible ancestor, they had no choice but to lie low and restrain themselves, for fear of giving the Empress an opportunity to eliminate them.]
[By the end of 494th year of the Daya Calendar, the Empress began to reform the imperial examination system and select talents nationwide in order to inject fresh blood into the Xia Kingdom and break the barriers of social stratification. Talented individuals were encouraged by the prospect of becoming officials.]
[However, this action once again angered a group of officials who lost out in the process and became extremely displeased with the Empress. However, due to her domineering style, they could only cooperate, suppressing their dissatisfaction.]
[By the end of the 494th year of the Daya Calendar, Empress Xia Yuan’s effective governance enabled the seamless transition of old and new officials, allowing fresh blood to emerge and revitalize the Xia Kingdom. The lives of its people gradually improved.]
[Although you were in the Sword Spirit Sect, you were aware of the situation in the Xia Kingdom. Nonetheless, you knew that the Empress’s bold reforms and her ability to suppress various forces were backed by the invincible ancestor of the Xia Royal Family. His cultivation had reached the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Essence Realm, and he was unrivaled. Should he die, chaos would be inevitable, and Xia Yuan’s confidence would crumble. After all, it was a world where strength determined everything.]
[At the end of the 495th year of the Daya Calendar, the invincible ancestor of the Xia Royal Family passed away. With the loss of the supreme figure, the many forces that had been suppressing themselves could no longer contain themselves and united in rebellion, attacking and seizing cities, plunging the world into chaos.]
[At the same time, the second Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect discovered the trace of the Fire Spirit Flower and wanted to join forces with the other Supreme Elders to collect it. You appeared at the right time and told them that you also saw the Fire Spirit Flower, explaining the terrifying power of the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger and the existence of another Tier-7 Demon Beast, the Double-tailed Snake Tiger. Bai Tianhong and the other Supreme Elders were all surprised.]
[In the end, they believed your words, and more Supreme Elders took action.
To be on the safe side, they even brought along the sect’s spiritual tool—the Green Spirit Sword.]
[Thanks to the thorough preparations, the hunting process went smoothly. The Supreme Elders effortlessly killed the two demon beasts and took the Fire Spirit Flower.]
[Seeing Bai Tianhong and the others return safely, you couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.]
[By the end of the 496th year of the Daya Calendar, the imperial troops clashed fiercely with the vassals, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. However, because of Xia Yuan’s good governance, the imperial army remained strong, and there was no signs of decline for the time being.]
[Nevertheless, as more and more forces unsatisfied with Empress Xia Yuan’s policies and looking out for their own interests joined the vassals, the pressure on the imperial army increased considerably.]
[At the end of the 496th year of the Daya Calendar, in order to snatch victory in a desperate move, Empress Xia Yuan entered the secret forbidden area hidden within the Xia Royal Family and successfully passed the trial there amidst life-threatening danger. She obtained the spiritual tool Ice Condensation Mirror and successfully made it recognize her as its master.]
[With the assistance of the Ice Condensation Mirror, Empress Xia Yuan’s personal crusade made even the ninth-tier Spiritual Realm powerhouses extremely cautious, not daring to confront her. This placed the vassals under tremendous pressure, and their morale began to falter.]
[You heard about the news and were surprised that the Xia Royal Family also had a spiritual tool. No wonder Xia Yuan had the courage to carry out extensive reforms. However, you were also puzzled, as you didn’t remember any information about the Xia Royal Family possessing a spiritual tool.]
[Under duress, the many vassals went mad and united with the Chu Kingdom, inviting invincible individuals from Chu who possessed Quasi-spiritual Artifacts to join the battle…. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 49: The Demise of the Empress
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: The Demise of the Empress
Translator: 549690339
[The invincible figure from Chu, wielding a quasi-spiritual artifact, proved too powerful even for the Empress who held the Ice Condensation Mirror. The gap between their cultivation levels, as well as their comprehension of martial arts principles, was vast. When the two sides fought, the Empress was forced to retreat, sustaining heavy injuries.]
[The defeat of the Empress greatly dampened the morale of the imperial army, and the rebellious vassals started to counterattack.]
[Meanwhile, the Zhao State, greatly alarmed and angered by Chu State’s support for Xia Country, was unwilling to let Chu intervene. So, it formed an alliance with the various vassals of Xia Country to deal a heavy blow to the
Zhao state, leading to a rapid deterioration of the situation. As a result, the
Zhao State promptly dispatched a large army to attack Chu State.]
[As the Zhao’s army pressured the border and even deployed their invincible figure, Chu’s invincible figure was forced to return to the Chu state, confronting Zhao’s invincible figure.]
[And so, all three states plunged into chaos. You watched the development of the world from your vantage point in the Sword Spirit Sect, sighing in your heart. Xia Yuan owed their survival to you, but in the end, there was nothing you could do to turn the tide.]
[During the great battles, countless losses were recorded, and the national strength of the three states dwindled drastically. The neighboring foreign races started to stir, ready to pounce and attempt to annihilate the Central Earth Ethnicity.]
[You could only sigh at the turn of events. After all, you were only at the Spirit
Realm Second Tier Cultivation and couldn’t change anything. Even Bai Tianhong, despite his deep admiration for the Empress, couldn’t do much in these chaotic times, as he was too young and his strength not quite there. Even with his spiritual tool, the Green Spirit Sword, on hand to help the Empress, he could only allow her to avoid defeat. Moreover, the Sword Spirit Sect’s
Supreme Elders would never allow him to leave the mountain with the Green Spirit Sword.]
[As for the idea of helping the vassals, Bai Tianhong had no intention of doing so. He admired the Empress for her abilities in governing and her determination, looking down upon the traitorous vassals.]
[After listening to Bai Tianhong’s comments on both sides, you couldn’t help but speculate that the Bai Tianhong in your memory helped King of Shu Liu Yu simply because he was the lesser of the evils, a desperate and helpless choice.]
[In the late Daya calendar year 496, the Empress’s injuries proved too severe, and she died in the Imperial Palace. The situation in the Xia State became more chaotic, and the morale of the imperial army plummeted, causing the soldiers to retreat. The ecstatic vassals took the opportunity to conquer the Xia State, dividing it among themselves and waging war on one another.]
[Upon witnessing the situation, you could only express regret that Xia Yuan had ultimately faced misfortune. If the invincible ancestor of Xia State could have lived another ten years, she could have truly suppressed everything and reversed the dire situation.]
“So, in the end, it became like this. But Xia Yuan was indeed a wise ruler.” Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
It was just a shame.
If it were set in a normal ancient context, with the Empress’s talents in governing and the hearts of the people on her side, the vassals would not dare to revolt suddenly.
Public opinion is a terrifying force, capable of amassing unparalleled power.
However, this is the Profound World, where the power of ordinary people amounts to little.
A spiritual realm expert can effortlessly annihilate tens of thousands of ordinary people with a single strike.
Consequently, the vassals naturally didn’t care about public opinion.
Regardless of popular support, they would only need to rule the country once they ascended the throne.
If they failed to become the emperor, what use was public sentiment? What did it matter if more ordinary people died?
“In chaotic times, human lives are like grass.” Wang Ping murmured to himself.
Afterward, Wang Ping looked at the luminescent screen again, wanting to know the subsequent developments.
Though he could probably guess what happened next.
[In Daya Calendar year 500, your cultivation improved, and you successfully advanced to the Spiritual Realm Third Tier. That same year, Bai Tianhong’s cultivation broke through to the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier. Unable to sit back and watch the misery of the common people, he descended the mountain against the Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder’s wishes. Bai Tianhong helped vassal Liu Yu by killing all the spiritual realm experts of the various factions, allowing him to ascend to the throne and rename the country as Great Shu.]
[Meanwhile, Chu and Zhao, witnessing the Sword Spirit Sect abandoning its neutral stance to intervene and Xia undergoing dynastic change, cease their meaningless war and begin healing their wounds.]
[You were not surprised by these developments.]
[On June 1st, in the first year of the Shu Calendar, you went down the mountain to visit Chifeng. However, Chifeng and Chi Tongtong mysteriously disappeared right before your eyes. You were dumbfounded.]
[In your opinion, even if the Chi family’s mortal enemy had made a move using the bloodline curse, it shouldn’t have been so bizarre. At the very least, there should have been an event leading up to their sudden death and subsequent disintegration.]
[Ultimately, you could only drown your sorrows with Bai Tianhong in drink.] “So strange, huh…?” Wang Ping furrowed his brows, his expression somber.
The mysterious disappearance right under his eyes, without even a trace of ashes left behind, was just too strange. He couldn’t imagine what kind of method could have caused this.
“Am I destined to fail in protecting the people of Chi Village?” Wang Ping frowned, feeling uneasy.
After a long silence, Wang Ping could only continue looking at the luminescent screen.
Maintaining its pace, the text on the luminescent screen continued to emerge.
[In the second year of the Shu Calendar, the neighboring Exotic Races took advantage of Great Shu’s weakness and invaded. They pillaged, looted, and committed unspeakable acts wherever they went, leaving no survivors.
Furious, Shu State sent out a large army to suppress them, and the Sword Spirit Sect, also angry, had its Supreme Elders descend from the mountain.]
[Among them, Bai Tianhong returned to the field once more, determined to crush the Exotic Races. In the end, with Bai Tianhong’s unparalleled strength, all the Exotic Races were annihilated, and peace was restored to the world.]
[In the tenth year of the Shu Calendar, Bai Tianhong reached the Great Perfection in the Spiritual Realm and began closed-door cultivation to break through to the Transcendent Realm.]
[That same year, disturbances erupted in the Great Shu Jianghu, with a large number of experts disappearing without trace, along with entire towns and villages of people. This attracted the attention of the Shu government, which launched an investigation.]
[However, the experts dispatched by the Shu government to investigate also mysteriously vanished. Founding Emperor of Shu Liu Yu was alarmed and furious, and he sent out spiritual realm experts to investigate.. Despite this, they were quickly cut off from communication and couldn’t even send back news!]

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 50: Terrifying Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Terrifying Demon
Translator: 549690339
“It’s been peaceful for just a few years, and now there’s trouble again? It’s truly a Profound World.’
Wang Ping looked at the luminescent screen, speechless.
[Founding Emperor of Shu Liu Yu was alarmed and sent people overnight to Sword Spirit Sect, wishing to seek their help. After Sword Spirit Sect received the news, they were also extremely surprised. After all, a top expert with Spiritual Origin Realm Third Tier cultivation in Shu was silently killed and could not pass on any information. The hidden enemy’s strength could be said to be astonishing, and even Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier experts might not be a match for them.]
[Facing the request for help from Shu Taizu, the Supreme Elders of Sword Spirit Sect deliberated for a long time and decided to lend a hand to prevent the situation from deteriorating. After all, the world had just returned to peace and was in a period of recuperation, and more casualties must be avoided.]
[Moreover, the style of that mysterious powerhouse resembled Demonic Path Cultivators, and only Demonic Path Cultivators would massacre villages and towns to refine their skills with blood. In the face of such a brutal Demonic Cultivator, one must take decisive action to suppress them, otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.]
[In the following days, several Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect teamed up to descend the mountain and hunt the Demonic Cultivator. However, the Demonic Cultivator was extremely cunning and difficult to track down. This cast a shadow over the hearts of the Shu court and the higher-ups of the Sword Spirit Sect, leaving them uneasy.]
[In the 11th year of the Shu Calendar, the Wu family, which had Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier Experts, was uprooted by the Demonic Cultivator with no survivors, shaking the world. No one thought that the hidden Demonic Cultivator had grown to such an extent that they could silently wipe out an entire major clan, which was extremely terrifying.]
[For a time, the whole world was shocked, and everyone understood that this was no longer just about the Shu Dynasty, but a matter of life and death for all.
So, everyone started to actively search for traces of the Demonic Cultivator. Even Chu State and Zhao State heard the news and wanted to help, knowing that if the Demonic Cultivator grew stronger, they too would be in great danger.]
[Under the circumstances where the whole world was looking for the Demonic
Cultivator, they finally found his whereabouts. Dozens of Spiritual Realm Experts joined hands to deal with him, including the Spiritual Realm Experts from Chu and Zhao States.]
[However, this battle left the whole world shocked. Facing the siege of dozens of Spiritual Realm Experts, the Demon single-handedly killed them all, leaving no survivors. Moreover, the Demon left a terrifying message carved in blood, shaking the whole world: ‘I, MO Fan, regard all living beings as Blood Food. When I consume them all, I will become Transcendent.’ ]
[As this blood-written message appeared, the whole world was terrified and everyone felt threatened. Not only the Shu Dynasty, but also the cultivators from Chu and Zhao States were all extremely frightened. They rarely united completely to discuss countermeasures, knowing that the Demonic Cultivator had already gained momentum, and if not eliminated, a great demon that no one could control would be born.]
[You also felt depressed knowing that this might be the greatest threat you have encountered so far and began discussing countermeasures. In the end, you could not think of any solution and could only hope for Bai Tianhong to come out of his seclusion and kill the Demon MO Fan.]
[However, Bai Tianhong had already begun to close himself off, preparing to make a breakthrough to the Transcendent Realm. No one could disturb him, and you couldn’t help but sigh helplessly. If Bai Tianhong had closed off later, perhaps he would have been able to kill the demon.]
[Three days later, Demon MO Fan attacked the gathering place of the Spiritual
Realm experts and devoured all of them, killing the Grand Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect in the process.]
[This news once again shook the world, causing countless people to be shocked and desperate, unable to believe it. After all, there were five Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier experts gathered together, and yet they were all annihilated without anyone surviving. The horror of the Demon was unimaginable.]
[Upon hearing the news, you were also very frightened and knew that the Demon had become even more terrifying. Only Bai Tianhong had some hope of killing him. The other Supreme Elders of Sword Spirit Sect were also shocked and angry and thought of this as well.]
[With no other choice, they decided to disturb Bai Tianhong and ask him to leave his seclusion. Bai Tianhong never expected that such a change would occur just one year after he closed off, and even his master had died at the hands of the Demon.]
[Enraged by this rare occurrence, Bai Tianhong took up his sword and descended the mountain, determined to slay the Demon. News of Bai Tianhong’s descent shook the world, and everyone eagerly awaited the invincible Bai Tianhong to kill the Demon MO Fan. Only a few people, including you, harbored some concerns. The Demon’s wings had grown fully, and he devoured a large number of experts. Even Bai Tianhong might not be a match for him.]
[A week later, Bai Tianhong found Demon MO Fan and fought him. However,
Demon MO Fan’s cultivation had already exceeded the level of the Spiritual
Realm and reached half-step Transcendent Realm. He also practiced terrifying
Demonic Skills and possessed a horrifying Demonic Artifact, resulting in Bai
Tianhong’s defeat and death.]
[Upon learning of Bai Tianhong’s death, the entire world fell into despair. Even
Bai Tianhong had died – who could slay the Demon?]
[Upon hearing the news of Bai Tianhong’s death, your heart sank.]
[Three days later, Demon MO Fan stepped on the Sword Spirit Sect and fought all its experts alone. You and many other experts tried your best to attack, but to no avail. In the end, you perished at the hand of Demon MO Fan.]
[Due to your death, this life simulation ends…]
“Where did this Demon MO Fan come from? He’s so terrifying that even Bai Tianhong was killed after coming out of the mountain.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his eyelids twitching and his expression solemn.
Although this guy’s cultivation was somewhat higher than Bai Tianhong’s, it was enough to show his terrifying combat power.
If he was allowed to continue devouring the world’s experts, he would definitely become the first existence to step into the Transcendent Realm in hundreds of years.
When he breaks through to the Transcendent Realm, it will be a disaster for the entire world.
It should be said that to the Wang Ping in his life simulation, the existence of this guy was a huge threat.
Wang Ping’s face was somber, muttering to himself, “I must find out and kill him in advance.”
If Wang Ping couldn’t rely on the Life Simulator to quickly strengthen himself, he would rather kill innocents in his free simulation and not let any of them go.
Just kill everyone named MO Fan.
“But there’s still thirty years left, so there’s no rush.” Wang Ping exhaled lightly, calming down his mood, and his eyes flickered.
Thirty years from now, he wondered what level his cultivation could reach.
By that time, when MO Fan surfaces to devour the world’s experts, he could immediately rush to kill him, and it wouldn’t be a threat..

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 51: Reminder
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Reminder
Translator: 549690339
“How shall I treat Ninth Princess Xia Yuan?”
Wang Ping thought about the matter concerning Ninth Princess Xia Yuan, and was in deep contemplation for a moment.
Through this simulation, it can be seen that as long as he entered the Sword Spirit Sect, Ninth Princess Xia Yuan would be harmless to him.
“A generation of Empress, dying prematurely, it would be too much of a pity. If she didn’t die, the great Xia could revive, and the people of Xia Country could live in peace and work happily, and not need to suffer the casualties of tens of millions. ”
In the end, a decision formed in Wang Ping’s heart.
Not to mention, as long as he kept her safe, he could owe her a big favor, and it would be of great benefit in the future. As for finding MO Fan through her, that was just a matter by the way.
On the next day, when Wang Ping came downstairs to have breakfast at the inn, he saw that Xia Yuan and her team were already sitting there, with a variety of breakfast dishes on the table, and their aroma wafting in the air.
“Mr. Wang, good morning. Would you like to join us for breakfast?” When she saw Wang Ping coming down, Xia Yuan waved her folding fan and extended the invitation with a smile.
“Sure.” Wang Ping nodded and sat down.
“The weather is lovely today, and I want to invite Mr. Wang to take a walk around Black Wind Town with me. Do you have any spare time today, Mr. Wang?” When they had finished breakfast, Xia Yuan extended the invitation once again with a smile.
“If Yuan invites me, I naturally have the time.” Wang Ping nodded slightly, his gaze deep, and his words bearing a profound meaning: “However…”
“What is ‘however’?” Yuan Xia curiously inquired, while the Old Woman and Dong’er both looked at Wang Ping.
“However, Ninth Princess, I advise you to return to the Imperial Palace as soon as possible.”
Seeing that they were all looking at him, Wang Ping didn’t say it out loud, but instead conveyed it to Ninth Princess Xia Yuan through sound transmission.
At his words, Xia Yuan’s pupils contracted involuntarily. She stared at Wang Ping in disbelief, her face revealing her surprise.
The change in Xia Yuan’s expression caught the Old Woman’s attention, who shot Wang Ping a deep look, her brow slightly furrowed.
“How did you figure out my identity?” asked Xia Yuan in surprise as she transmitted her question through true Qi.
“Xia Yuan, Yuan Xia… add to that your high cultivation level at such a young age, it’s not hard to guess your identity.” Wang Ping replied through sound transmission.
“…” Xia Yuan was silent. The name she used while roaming the Jianghu was too casual, and she hadn’t intended to deliberately hide her cultivation level either.
Still, she was rather surprised that Wang Ping had figured it out so effortlessly.
However, what surprised her more were the words that Wang Ping had said.
“What do you mean by telling me to return to the palace quickly?” Xia Yuan asked back, baffled.
“The situation in the Great Xia Empire is grave. His Majesty isn’t getting any younger, and all the royal sons are ambitious and potential threats to the throne,” Wang Ping continued to sound transmit calmly. “You are blessed with immense talent and extraordinary spirit roots, and are highly favored by His Majesty. Therefore, you are the most likely candidate to take the throne. Can you imagine what would happen if it were discovered that you are travelling outside the Palace?”
“…” Xia Yuan frowned, her expression fluctuating.
“Do you mean that my own royal brothers and sisters would harm me?” Xia Yuan asked gravely.
“That’s not what I meant.” Wang Ping replied, his gaze deep. “However, from my perspective, going back to the Palace is the best choice for you.”
There were certain things that Wang Ping did not say directly.
Although, through the simulator, he knew that Xia Yuan was a good person, he couldn’t guarantee that she wouldn’t be enraged by his words.
Even though he wished to gain Xiao Yuan’s favor, he did not want to encounter any risk because of it.
“Thanks for the reminder, Wang Ping.” Xia Yuan frowned, her phoenix eyes flickering uncertainly as she considered something.
Seeing this, Wang Ping did not say any more.
The Xia Yuan of now was still too young and her ideas were somewhat naive. She was not like the formidable Empress in the Life Simulator.
The fight for the throne in the royal family is extremely brutal, and it seemed that, till now, she had not considered that her royal brothers and sisters could try to kill her.
“Yuan’er, what did he tell you?” Seeing the changing expressions on Xia Yuan’s face followed by her deep contemplation, the Old Woman shot Wang Ping a deep look and initiated the true Qi sound transmission to ask.
Dong’er, sitting on the side, regarded Wang Ping and her mistress, but in the end, she chose not to say anything.
After learning about Wang Ping’s talents, both her mistress and the Old
Woman regarded him highly, and this was not the place for her to intervene.
“Nothing.” Xia Yuan shook her head slightly and did not reveal the content of their conversation to the Old Woman.
“Mr. Wang, someone like you who has such exceptional talents, roaming the world freely, is a waste. Why not follow me and become my right-hand man? You can make a difference,” Xia Yuan then said earnestly to Wang Ping: “Once I ascend the throne, I will certainly repay you.”
“Thank you for your kindness, Ninth Princess, but I’m used to leisure and have no interest in holding a government post.”
Wang Ping shook his head and directly declined.
It was safer to stay in the Sword Spirit Sect. As long as he did not attract the attention of Zhang Yuan, the Master of the Sword Spirit Sect, he could grow peacefully and lie low until he died.
If he came to the capital to serve as an official and entered the whirlpool of power, his strength would still not be strong enough to ensure his safety.
Even if he revealed his identity as a 4th tier alchemist, it wouldn’t ensure a peaceful and prosperous life for him, but instead could possibly attract disaster.
“Oh, what a pity,” Xia Yuan sounded extremely regretful, and asked, “So, what do you plan to do next, Mr. Wang?”
“I will join the Sword Spirit Sect, seeking peace,” Wang Ping shared his plan.
“The Sword Spirit Sect…” Xia Yuan’s eyes flickered, and she smiled helplessly.
It seemed that getting a personality like Wang Ping on board might be a long shot.
Even though she had a dream of walking side by side with Wang Ping, discussing major world affairs, trying to touch the human heart like her ancestors, and making them follow her, it seemed that this approach simply did not work on Wang Ping.
She could see that Wang Ping had a very determined will and could not be influenced.
Moreover, thinking about what Wang Ping had mentioned earlier about her returning to the Palace soon, Xia Yuan pondered over many thoughts.
“Mr. Wang, if you ever change your mind, you can come and find me whenever you want, I would be more than happy to welcome you,” said Xia Yuan with a slight bow, her face looking earnest.
This time, she did not use true Qi voice transmission, but said it directly.
“Hmm.” Even though Wang Ping would most likely not change his mind, he did not want to decline her outright and so, nodded slightly..

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 52: Worshiping the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Worshiping the Mountain
Translator: 549690339
“Yuan’er, what did he say to you? Why did you suddenly decide to leave Black
Wind Town and abandon your plan to go to the Black Wind Forest?” On the way out of Black Wind Town, the old woman asked uncertainly.
“He only speculated that someone was trying to make a move on me and urged me to return to the Imperial City as soon as possible.” Xia Yuan narrowed her eyes, gazing in the direction of the Imperial City, and spoke slowly: “However, I won’t immediately return to the Imperial City. I want to ask my grandfather to step forward and see who wants to kill me.”
“Is his word trustworthy?” The old woman frowned. “Isn’t calling for your grandfather a bit of an overreaction?”
She was already over 160 years old.
And Xia Yuan’s grandfather, even older than her, was already 200 years old and a powerful existence in the Xia Royal Family.
“I didn’t fully believe his words, but I also feel that my siblings would take the opportunity to kill me if they can. To be on the safe side, calling for my grandfather is the best option.” Xia Yuan shook her head, looking increasingly cold: “If someone dares to try anything, I won’t care if they’re my brothers and sisters anymore.”
“Sigh.” The old woman fell silent for a moment, shook her head, and could only sigh.
She had been through all these struggles and knew what these people were capable of in order to seize the throne.
So every time the throne changed hands, there would undoubtedly be a bloodbath, and many princes and princesses would die tragically in the struggle for power.
When Xia Yuan was planning to use her fishing method, Wang Ping also left Black Wind Town and headed towards Sword Spirit Sect.
At dusk the following day, Wang Ping arrived at the entrance of the Sword Spirit Sect.
The Sword Spirit Sect was established on the Green Spirit Mountain Range, with beautiful scenery and rich Spiritual Energy, making it very suitable for cultivation.
This place was also where the cultivators of Xia yearned to be, and joining the Sword Spirit Sect was considered a great honor for them.
After all, the history of Xia was only 500 years, and the dynasty was already coming to an end, while the Sword Spirit Sect had a history of a thousand years, always standing at the peak of the Green Spirit Mountain Range, overlooking the land.
Even during Xia’s most prosperous period, the Xia imperial court didn’t want to provoke the Sword Spirit Sect but adopted a policy of befriending them, showing the extraordinary status of the Sword Spirit Sect.
“This is the entrance of the Sword Spirit Sect, stop where you are.”
Soon after, Wang Ping walked along the mountain stone stairs and came to the entrance of the Sword Spirit Sect, where he was stopped by two guarding disciples.
“My name is Wang Ping, a 4th Tier alchemist who seeks to join the Sword Spirit Sect. I kindly request that you inform your Sect Master.” Wang Ping looked at the two disciples and spoke calmly.
“What!? ”
“A 4th Tier Alchemist?”
The two disciples looked shocked, somewhat disbelieving.
“Are you really a 4th Tier Alchemist? You seem too young to be one.” One of the disciples questioned suspiciously.
There were only a few Tier 4 Alchemists in Xia, and their Sword Spirit Sect only had one at the moment.
It was hard to believe that a young man in his twenties claimed to be a 4th Tier Alchemist.
“Being young doesn’t mean being low-skilled in alchemy.” Wang Ping said calmly, “Or do you think I would dare to lie to the Sword Spirit Sect?”
“Uh…” The two mountain-protecting disciples looked at each other, feeling that Wang Ping had a point.
Indeed, no one had ever dared to deceive the Sword Spirit Sect, which would be like an old man seeking death by hanging himself.
“Please wait here, I will inform the Sect Master immediately.”
Immediately, one disciple spoke respectfully to Wang Ping before rushing into the sect, showing off his impressive lightness skill.
Soon, two figures appeared inside the Sword Spirit Sect.
A somewhat refined middle-aged man, riding a flying sword, arrived with the mountain -protecting disciple.
Wang Ping squinted at the man riding the sword in the sky.
Sword Spirit Sect Sect master Zhang Yuan appeared to be gentle and elegant but was in fact ruthless and cunning, hiding his true nature very well.
He was also someone Wang Ping had wanted to kill recently.
However, Wang Ping from the previous free simulation had grown too slowly and never made a move against Zhang Yuan.
Of course, Wang Ping could understand why.
After all, without resorting to drugs, his cultivation speed was indeed slower, but his foundation was solid, allowing him to go further.
Unfortunately, the Wang Ping from the previous free simulation never found an opportunity to reasonably kill Zhang Yuan before he was killed by the suddenly emerging Demon MO Fan.
However, when Demon MO Fan killed Wang Ping from the Sword Spirit Sect, it was certain that Zhang Yuan would die too.
“Fellow Taoist, you claim to be a 4th Tier Alchemist, is that true?”
Zhang Yuan came in front of Wang Ping, riding his sword, and asked curiously.
Initially, when one of his disciples reported the news, Zhang Yuan didn’t pay attention to Wang Ping’s age or appearance.
