After all, those in the Innate Realm had a lifespan of 200 years, and those in the Spiritual Origin Realm had a lifespan of 300 years.
Some people who appeared to be in their twenties might actually be sixty, seventy, or even over a hundred years old.
Since he was at the third tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm, he could see that Wang Ping was at the Spiritual Origin Realm.
So he thought Wang Ping was actually over seventy years old.
Of course, a 4th Tier Alchemist at the age of seventy with Spiritual Origin Realm cultivation was already extremely astonishing. In the history of Xia, there had never been such a person..

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 53: Alchemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Alchemy
Translator: 549690339
“Whether it’s true or not, won’t we know once I start refining the medicine?
There’s no need to doubt.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Yuan and spoke calmly.
“I didn’t mean to doubt you, fellow taoist. It’s just a normal inquiry. Even if you are not a 4th-Tier Alchemist, your cultivation alone would make you an elder in our Sword Spirit Sect.” Zhang Yuan nodded with a smile, extending an invitation. “Fellow Taoist, would you like to accompany me to the alchemy room?”
“I can.” Wang Ping nodded.
“Sword Riding Skill: Spirit Gathering.”
Immediately, Zhang Yuan held up two fingers, and dazzling True Essence fluctuations emerged from them.
A large sword made of True Essence then appeared before everyone’s eyes.
Seeing this white sword, the two mountain-protecting disciples showed admiring and envious expressions.
In general, only Spiritual Realm Experts could fly through the air.
However, there are exceptions,
Sword Spirit Sect’s Sword Riding Skill can control thousands of swords and uses it to fly. Even those in the Innate Realm, and even the Post-Heaven Realm can fly with this skill.
In combat, it not only has unparalleled power but also great flexibility and advantages.
If they could learn it, not only would they be powerful, but they could also fly through the air with ease, greatly enhancing their style.
By then, they could sweep off their feet any female junior disciples.
Zhang Yuan then rode on the sword and disappeared into the sky, while Wang Ping also flew away, following him.
Seeing this scene, the two mountain-protecting disciples opened their mouths wide in shock.
The two never thought that Wang Ping, who looked so young, was actually a Spiritual Realm Expert.
No wonder the Sect Master addressed him as a fellow Taoist. It was an appellation reserved for those in the same realm as Spiritual Realm Experts.
Inside the alchemy room, Zhang Yuan brought Wang Ping here, attracting the attention of the alchemists here.
“Greetings, Sect Master.” An old man greeted Zhang Yuan with a bow, and then looked at Wang Ping and the others, asking with curiosity, “Sect Master, who is
“This fellow taoist is Wang Ping, a 4th-Tier Alchemist who came to join our Sword Spirit Sect.” Zhang Yuan glanced at Wang Ping and smiled at the old man, “Elder Wu, as a 3rd-Tier Alchemist, you can communicate with Mr. Wang more, and perhaps you may gain something.”
“4th-Tier Alchemist?” Elder Wu looked at Wang Ping in shock.
“Nowadays, there really are all kinds of people.”
“Hehe, if he’s a 4th-Tier Alchemist, wouldn’t I be a 5th tier Alchemist?”
“I really don’t know what the Sect Master was thinking, actually believing this liar and bringing him to our Alchemy Room to disturb our refining.”
The other alchemists in the room looked at Wang Ping with suspicious eyes when they heard the conversation.
In this day and age, there really were all kinds of people; they even deceived their way to the Sword Spirit Sect.
There were only a few 4th-Tier Alchemists in the whole Xia Kingdom, and they all reached that level only after the age of one hundred.
Even if Wang Ping had exceptional talent, it would be impossible for him to become a 4th -Tier Alchemist in his twenties, even if he started refining medicine from the womb.
“A bunch of idiots. Even the Sect Master addressed the Senior as a fellow Taoist, which means he’s a Spiritual Realm Expert. You all have no right to insult him!”
Elder Wu saw this and scolded angrily.
Upon hearing this, everyone snapped back to their senses, became anxious, and quickly apologized, fearing that Wang Ping would blame them.
Spiritual Realm Experts were not something they could afford to mess with.
If you consider his 4th-Tier Alchemist status as well, that status was incredibly respected.
“Do you have the materials here to refine the 4th-Tier Elixir: Spirit Realm Elixirs? If you have them, please bring them out.”
Wang Ping asked Elder Wu.
“You want to refine Spirit Realm Elixirs?” Elder Wu was astonished.
The difficulty of refining Spirit Realm Elixirs among 4th -Tier Elixirs was not small, and their effect was to increase a Spiritual Realm Expert’s strength by one small realm.
Moreover, because the materials were rare and the success rate of refining Spirit Realm Elixirs by 4th-Tier Alchemists within the Xia Kingdom was not very high, this kind of elixir became even more precious.
As a result, many Spiritual Realm Experts were fanatical about the Spirit Realm Elixirs.
Even the Sword Spirit Sect’s eccentric 4th-Tier Alchemist had a success rate of less than 40% when refining Spirit Realm Elixirs.
“Senior, we certainly have the herbs, but I wonder if I can assist Master Wang in refining the medicine.” Elder Wu blushed, speaking somewhat awkwardly.
He had been stuck as a 3rd -Tier Alchemist for decades.
And the Sword Spirit Sect’s 4th-Tier Alchemist had an eccentric temperament, showing no interest in teaching him.
If he relied on his own exploration, he would probably never reach the 4th-Tier Alchemist level in his life.
However, proposing to observe the refining process seemed like trying to steal the skills, and even Elder Wu, who had lived for over a hundred years, felt very awkward about it.
“You can.” Wang Ping glanced at Elder Wu and nodded. “I heard that Elder Wu nas been stuck at tne 3rd-‘1’1er tor many years. It Elder Wu IS willing to nelP me refine medicine in the future, I can guide you.”
Wu’s character was actually quite good, and he had been Wang Ping’s best deputy in his past life experiences.
So Wang Ping did not have any intention to refuse.
“Master Wang, I am extremely grateful for your generous guidance. If Master Wang has any requests in the future, feel free to call on me.” Elder Wu was overjoyed to say quickly.
The grace of teaching and learning was the heaviest.
Wu never thought that Wang Ping would be so generous, and he admired Wang
Ping to the extreme.
At the same time, he also firmly remembered this favor in his heart.
If Wang Ping could help him advance further, even following Wang Ping would be acceptable.
“Hurry and bring the treasure medicine! ”
Elder Wu then eagerly instructed his disciples.
“Sect Master, 4th-Tier Treasure Medicine needs to be applied for. What do you think…”
Elder Wu then looked at the Sect Master.
“I allow fellow Taoist Wang to use it.” Sect Master Zhang Yuan nodded.
This delighted Elder Wu beyond expectation.
Afterwards, Wu gathered the treasure medicine and Wang Ping went with him to a closed chamber to refine the 4th -Tier Elixir: Spirit Realm Elixirs.
It wasn’t a problem for high-level alchemists to refine Ist-tier Elixirs in a relatively noisy environment, but refining high-level Elixirs couldn’t have any disturbances. The slightest mistake could result in failure.
Zhang Yuan watched the two enter the closed chamber, and couldn’t help but smile: “I hope he succeeds. By then, our Sword Spirit Sect will have picked up a treasure.”
During his tenure as Sect Master, a genius Spiritual Realm Expert who was also a 4th-Tier Alchemist would actively join and undoubtedly count as part of his meritorious service, enabling him to gain more prestige.
The Sect Master of the Sword Spirit Sect, such an extraordinary sect, wasn’t allowed to serve until death or voluntary abdication. Instead, there was a 50-year cycle.
After fifty years, if more than half of the Supreme Elders supported his continued tenure as Sect Master, he could continue to be Sect Master; if not, he would have to step down.
Now that a 4th-Tier genius alchemist had actively joined during his tenure, the Supreme Elders would likely support his continued tenure as Sect Master as well.
It had to be said that Wang Ping was indeed his lucky star.
However, he didn’t know where this genius alchemist had come from; he had never heard of such a person in the world before..

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - 54: 5th Tier
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: 5th Tier
Translator: 549690339
An hour later, Elder Wu looked at the white elixir emitting a white fluorescent light in the Elixir Furnace, his face full of shock.
Wang Ping’s method of refining Spirit Realm Elixirs was too skillful, the process was smooth, which even made him doubt whether it was a Spirit Realm Elixir or a Ist-tier Elixir being refined.
However, the Elixir with a strong fragrance and the white fluorescence proved that Wang Ping had indeed refined a 4th Tier Spirit Realm Elixir, and its quality seemed excellent, at least it was a high-grade one.
“The main point of refining a 4th Tier Elixir is to control the fire,” Wang Ping looked at Elder Wu and said, “The temperature cannot be off by even a little, otherwise, it will result in a decrease in quality. In severe cases, it will produce a waste pill.”
“I’m well aware of the importance of temperature,” Elder Wu said with a bitter smile. “However, the temperature fluctuations for a 4th Tier Elixir are just too complex, it is difficult for ordinary people to control. Even with your guidance, I haven’t yet mastered it.”
“It is complex. But it’s nothing compared to the 5th Tier Elixir,” Wang Ping shook his head and said, “If it’s said that to become a 4th Tier Alchemist, the most important thing is to control the slight changes in temperature perfectly. Then, for a 5th Tier Alchemist, not only do they need to achieve perfect control of the temperature, but even more important is their cultivation. Without reaching the Transcendent Realm, they will never be able to reach the 5th Tier in their entire life.”
“Yes,” Elder Wu nodded, admiring and regretful, “It’s a pity that not only 5th Tier Alchemist but even the Master in Transcendent Realm has not appeared for hundreds of years.”
The level of cultivation has little impact on alchemists below the 5th Tier, as those in Innate Realm can refine 4th Tier Elixirs.
Even the fire used for refining elixirs can be assisted by external fire sources.
Therefore, theoretically, there is a possibility for cultivators in the Post-Heaven Realm to become a 4th Tier Alchemist.
However, it is not possible for the 5th Tier, as the 5th Tier treasure elixirs already have spirituality and strong vitality, which cannot be melted into the medicinal liquid by ordinary flames.
At the same time, ordinary flames have no spirituality and lack temperature. Only flames condensed by cultivators in the Transcendent Realm have a high enough temperature and spirituality, to be called Spirit Fire, which can refine
5th Tier spiritual elixirs.
Therefore, 5th Tier Alchemists in Profound Turtle Continent have become existences known only in legends, recorded only in ancient books.
That 4th Tier Alchemist of Sword Spirit Sect is constantly looking for opportunities outside to promote his cultivation in the hopes of breaking through the Transcendent Realm in his lifetime and attempting to become a 5th Tier Alchemist.
“In the past thousand years, due to the limitation of cultivation, it has stopped all the 4th Tier Alchemists in history,” Elder Wu sighed.
Of course, he was just lamenting.
After all, he, with limited talent, only hopes to make it to the 4th Tier in his lifetime.
As for the 5th Tier, he dares not even think about it.
“However, you, senior, may have a chance to enter the 5th Tier,” Elder Wu then looked at Wang Ping with reverence and admiration on his face.
Although it was a flattering remark, it still felt like Wang Ping had a slight hope.
After all, being a 4th Tier Alchemist at such a young age, Wang Ping just needs to successfully step into the Transcendent Realm in the future, and becoming a 5th Tier Alchemist would then be a sure thing.
By then, the whole Profound Turtle Continent would revere Wang Ping. Regardless of whether it is his strength or his skill as an Alchemist, it holds true.
If Wang Ping wants to establish his own sect in the future, then pharmacists and cultivators from all over the world will join. His sect will surely become the greatest one in history.
“Who can predict the future?” Wang Ping shook his head indifferently, packed up the Spirit Realm Elixirs, and put them into a white jade bottle. Seeing Wang Ping’s indifference, Elder Wu had a secret sigh in his heart.
Most of the young talents with great achievements tend to be arrogant.
However, Wang Ping, at such a young age, has such a calm personality, not proud nor impatient, which is really amazing.
It can be said that even without the talent in alchemy, Wang Ping is destined for greatness in the future.
There is such a figure in Sword Spirit Sect, Bai Tianhong, who is the disciple of the Supreme Elder.
However, compared to Wang Ping, Bai Tianhong is still young and shows off his sharp edges a bit too much.
Afterward, Wang Ping and Elder Wu left the Alchemy Room.
As soon as the two walked out, all the people in the Alchemy Room were looking at them, wanting to know the result.
“Senior, you are really a remarkable person. You easily refined a high-grade Spirit Realm Elixir,” Seeing everyone looking their way, Elder Wu stroked his beard and said with reverence and fanaticism.
“Hiss!”
With these words, there was an immediate sound of people sucking in a breath of cold air, their faces full of shock.
They didn’t expect that Wang Ping had actually succeeded and even refined a high-grade Spirit Realm Elixir.
This level of alchemy was simply terrifying.
For a moment, many of the senior alchemists could not help but have a thought in their hearts.
This senior was terrifying.
“He’s really a 4th Tier Alchemist, and his alchemy skills are even better than 4th Tier Alchemists of our Sword Spirit Sect” Zhang Yuan was also full of enthusiasm and bursting with excitement as he clenched his fists.
This was indeed a genius 4th Tier Alchemist that he had picked up.
The story of this accomplishment could be added to his Sect Master’s resume.
“I must treat him well in the future. If I can make him lean towards our faction, my position as Sect Master will become more stable. Even if Bai Tianhong grows, he won’t be able to shake my position,” Zhang Yuan secretly thought about the good things their faction could offer to win over Wang Ping.
“Haha, fellow taoist, it was my short-sightedness that I didn’t know there would be such a prodigy like you in the world. Please forgive me for any previous offenses,” Zhang Yuan looked at Wang Ping as he approached, smiling politely and apologizing with a bow.
“Sect Master, in my hometown, when people apologize, they should offer something as a gift to show their sincerity,” Wang Ping said to Zhang Yuan with a warm face.
‘ Zhang Yuan paused for a moment, then laughed, “If it’s a compensation gift, it’s worth giving.”
In Zhang Yuan’s view, Wang Ping felt unhappy with him.
After all, when they came to the Alchemy Room before, he had indeed doubted and allowed Elder Wu to learn from Wang Ping.
Fourth Tier Alchemists are arrogant, let alone a prodigy like Wang Ping.
It’s perfectly normal for the other side to feel unhappy..

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - 55 Supreme Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Supreme Elders
Translator: 549690339
“I obtained this Yang Recovery Grass by accident. I wonder if Fellow Taoist is satisfied with it.”
Before everyone’s eyes, Zhang Yuan somewhat begrudgingly took out a White Jade Box from his Storage Ring, opened it, and revealed a golden and peculiarly fragrant herb to everyone present.
“Yang Recovery Grass!”
Seeing the golden herb that emitted a fragrance that made people feel energized just by smelling it, Elder Wu and others all gasped in amazement, revealing a fervent expression.
Yang Recovery Grass was a 4th Tier Treasure Herb, a Healing Treasure
Medicine. Even if a Spiritual Realm expert suffered serious injuries, consuming this grass could help them recover in a very short time; it could be considered a life-saving holy item.
If the Yang Recovery Grass was used as the main ingredient to refine a furnace of Yang Recovery Elixir, the healing effect would be even more astonishing. Even Spiritual Realm experts would go crazy for it.
Of course, the Yang Recovery Grass and Yang Recovery Elixir also had an extraordinary side effect – they possessed an astonishing effect in fortifying Yang, which was an ability countless men dreamt of.
It could be said that the value of Yang Recovery Grass was difficult to measure and was even more valuable than the Spirit Realm Elixirs.
Although Spirit Realm Elixirs were valuable, they could only enhance one’s cultivation by a small realm, and were useless after the second use. Moreover, they could only help those below the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier.
However, Yang Recovery Grass could potentially be a second life for Spiritual Realm experts, incomparable in value to Spirit Realm Elixirs.
“The Sect Master is really generous,” a disciple muttered under his breath.
Upon hearing this, the others were all rendered speechless.
Generous? Just for an apology, Yang Recovery Grass was used as compensation. This indicated that the Sect Master wanted to win over Senior Wang Ping.
However, this was understandable. With such a young 4th Tier Alchemist, his value was hard to estimate. It was normal to offer Yang Recovery Grass to win him over, even if something more valuable were offered instead.
“The Sect Master is really generous.” As for Zhang Yuan taking out the Yang Recovery Grass, Wang Ping didn’t seem surprised. He took the grass and bowed slightly. “I admire you.”
“I’m glad you like it, Master. Later, I will discuss it with the Supreme Elders so you can get a Supreme Elder position. If all goes well, I’ll announce it to the entire sect tomorrow and appoint you as a Supreme Elder and hold a grand banquet in your honor.”
Seeing Wang Ping didn’t seem to have any intention of blaming him anymore, Zhang Yuan showed a smile and spoke.
“Thank you, Sect Master.” Wang Ping smiled, responding.
“Fellow Taoist, if you need anything in the future, just come to me. As the Sect Master, I will definitely make sure everything is done properly for you,” Zhang Yuan said warmly and enthusiastically, trying his best to win Wang Ping over.
“Of course.” Wang Ping took a deep look at Zhang Yuan and nodded.
“Elder Wu, according to the rules of our Sword Spirit Sect, how should I dispose of the Spirit Realm Elixirs that I have refined?”
Next, Wang Ping suddenly looked at Elder Wu and asked knowingly.
“Well…” Elder Wu glanced at the Sect Master and reluctantly replied, “Fellow Taoist, according to our sect’s rules, if the elixirs were refined by the master using his own materials, they fully belong to the master. However, if they were refined using the sect’s herbs, it would be divided in half.”
“Haha, this indeed is the sect’s rules. But everything has exceptions.” Right after Elder Wu finished speaking, Zhang Yuan laughed and said, “Fellow Taoist has traveled a long way to join our Sword Spirit Sect. If we were to be so petty over these small matters, it would be beneath the dignity of our sect.”
“Therefore, Fellow Taoist, this Spirit Realm Elixir belongs to you.” Zhang Yuan looked at Wang Ping and continued, “I believe no one else would have any objections. ”
“Thank you, Sect Master.” Wang Ping smiled lightly, putting the White Jade Box in his Storage Ring.
This Zhang Yuan was indeed doing everything he could to win him over.
Having said that, this guy didn’t know that he had information on the greedy
Chi Clan people.
If he did know, he would definitely take action, right?
Next, Zhang Yuan smiled and said, “By the way, Fellow Taoist, you’ve just arrived at the Sword Spirit Sect and have no place to stay, right? Since I have some free time now, let me help you find the best residence and familiarize you with our sect’s various pavilions.”
“Thank you, Sect Master.” Wang Ping nodded.
Afterward, Zhang Yuan led Wang Ping out of the Alchemy Room, talking amiably with him all the way, trying to deepen their relationship.”This Zhang Yuan is ruthless and deep-minded. In the face of his insufficient strength, one must be careful while dealing with him.”
Wang Ping stood on the balcony of the classical pavilion Zhang Yuan had selected for him, squinting as he watched Zhang Yuan fly away with his sword.
In the Sect Master Hall, Zhang Yuan had summoned all the Supreme Elders and Inner Sect Elders, and told them about Wang Ping joining the sect.
Everyone was shocked.
None of the elders had thought that a 4th-tier genius alchemist would actually take the initiative to join their sect. It was like a pie falling from the sky! “This is really heaven’s blessing for our Sword Spirit Sect.”
“A Spiritual Realm expert in their seventies and also a 4th-tier alchemist is simply unheard of.”
“Yes, as far as I know, the fastest person to become a 4th-tier Alchemist in
history was around 100 years old. And besides, Wang Ping is not just an
ordinary alchemist.”
“Tsk, tsk. With such a genius joining our sect, the Sword Spirit Sect will continue to prosper. If one day he can advance to the 5th tier, our sect will become even more prosperous – it’s just too incredible to imagine.”
“Reaching the 5th tier is too challenging, as one has to reach the Transcendent Realm with their cultivation. Furthermore, his talent is also limited. Of course, the main reason is that the Profound Turtle Continent currently lacks the necessary conditions for giving birth to Transcendent Realm experts.”
“It’s okay if he doesn’t become a 5th-tier Alchemist. Having an additional genius alchemist in the sect will still make our Sword Spirit Sect more prosperous.”
The Supreme Elders were discussing animatedly.
They were familiar with the Sword Spirit Sect’s own 4th-tier Alchemist.
Unfortunately, the latter was rarely in the sect as he sought any possible opportunity to break through to the 5th tier.
As a result, their sect had a severe shortage of 4th-tier elixirs.
Sometimes, they even had to purchase them from the Xia Royal Family or the Medicinal Alliance, which was somewhat embarrassing.
However, there was no other choice, since 4th-tier Alchemists were extremely rare throughout the Great Xia. There were only three of them in total: one in their Sword Spirit Sect, one in the Xia Royal Family, and another in the Medicinal Alliance.
Now, with an additional 4th-tier Alchemist, they were naturally overjoyed. As long as they offered him sufficient benefits, they could have hope of obtaining precious 4th-tier Elixirs.
Whether it was for cultivation assistance or healing, they would have everything they need.
“Sect Master, you did well in promising Wang Ping the title of Supreme Elder.” The Second Supreme Elder said with a smile all over his face.
He was also from the Sword Spirit Sect’s Zhang Family faction, and naturally felt satisfied with the actions of his juniors.
The position of Supreme Elder was not something the Sect Master could simply appoint, it had to be determined by the Supreme Elders themselves during a meeting.
In other words, Zhang Yuan had exceeded his authority.
By doing so, he managed to recruit Wang Ping first, which brought great benefits to their faction.
If it had been any other time, the other factions’ Supreme Elders would have been unhappy about such an unauthorized act.
However, considering someone like Wang Ping joining, he was definitely due the position of Supreme Elder, so the other Supreme Elders did not have much to say.
“Elders, prepare your gifts ahead of tomorrow’s banquet celebrating the joining of Wang Ping as a Supreme Elder. It will help you get familiar with him and secure Wang Elder’s alchemy services in the future.”
Zhang Yuan said, his face glowing with excitement, speaking to everyone present.
All those present nodded, pondering over what would make a suitable gift.

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - 56: Sword Spirit
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Sword Spirit
Translator: 549690339
The next day, Zhang Yuan ordered to ring the bronze bell, gathering all the elders, deacons, and disciples, appointing Wang Ping as a Supreme Elder.
At the same time, today was a celebration for the entire Sword Spirit Sect to welcome Wang Ping.
This news shocked everyone.
And then, joy.
After all, such major events were rare in centuries, and this grand feast allowed them to indulge in the otherwise hard-to-find Spiritual Wine, which greatly benefited their cultivation.
As the banquet began, the usually elusive Supreme Elders also showed up one by one, fervently presenting gifts to Wang Ping.
Every gift was extremely precious, with several strands of 4th Tier Treasure Medicine appearing, which was astonishing.
Wang Ping, however, was not surprised at all.
After all, he had experienced such a situation in his last life simulation.
Next, after having conversations and sharing wine with the Sword Spirit Sect’s important figures, Wang Ping didn’t miss a single etiquette.
“Bai Tianhong, paying respects to the Supreme Elder.”
At this moment, a young man in white clothes with an extraordinary appearance walked over and bowed slightly to Wang Ping.
“Rumors say Bai Tianhong is the number one genius in the Xia Kingdom. It’s true that seeing is believing.” Wang Ping looked at Bai Tianhong with a smile on his face and exclaimed, “You must be only one step away from comprehending Sword Spirit, right?”
Upon hearing this, the crowd was taken aback.
Elders and disciples alike showed astonished expressions.
Among those Supreme Elders who were aware of this, they were even more surprised at Wang Ping’s ability to see through Bai Tianhong’s details.
Soon enough, a frowning Supreme Elder revealed an amazed look, discovering Wang Ping’s depth.
“How did you know?” Bai Tianhong looked at Wang Ping in surprise, never expecting this new Supreme Elder to discern his abilities so easily.
“Because I’ve comprehended Sword Spirit.” Wang Ping smiled lightly, and his aura suddenly changed. He was like a divine sword that had been unsheathed, sharp and imposing, seemingly capable of annihilating everything in its path.
At the same time, the disciples’ swords at the scene all trembled, emitting sword cries, and had a tendency to exit their sheaths automatically.
It could be said that when Sword Spirit emerged, all swords submitted!
“Sword Spirit!” Feeling Wang Ping’s Sword Spirit, Bai Tianhong’s pupils contracted, his face showing surprise.
He didn’t expect that Wang Ping had comprehended Sword Spirit and that it wasn’t just a simple, recent comprehension. This level of Sword Spirit had reached 20%, making it quite formidable.
Not only was Bai Tianhong surprised, but the elders, deacons, and disciples present all showed stunned expressions, looking at Wang Ping in disbelief.
Wang Ping, a 4th Tier Alchemist.
And now, he had even comprehended Sword Spirit…
This man was simply too outrageous.
“Hiss!”
Although early guesses were made, when Wang Ping finally revealed his Sword Spirit, even the Supreme Elders widened their eyes, unable to hold back their gasps.
Being an Elixir Tao Talent was already impressive enough, but he was also a Sword Skill Talent, with a talent comparable to Bai Tianhong’s.
As a 4th Tier Alchemist with a 20% comprehension of Sword Spirit, this talent was truly terrifying.
It was as if a genius had fallen from the sky.
The Sword Spirit Sect had truly struck gold.
“Bai Tianhong, if you have time, you can come to me for sword discussions, and I can give you some guidance.” Wang Ping said to Bai Tianhong with a smile.
Bai Tianhong had given him guidance many times during the life simulation.
Now that his cultivation and swordsmanship were above Bai Tianhong’s, it was naturally Wang Ping’s turn to guide him.
After all, though the Sword Spirit Sect was powerful, it had no one who had comprehended Sword Spirit, so only Wang Ping could guide Bai Tianhong to improve his swordsmanship and comprehend Sword Spirit more quickly.
“Thank you, Supreme Elder.” Bai Tianhong’s eyes sparkled, his face full of joy as he hurriedly thanked him.
“Mm.” Wang Ping nodded.
Although he wanted to interact with Bai Tianhong as an equal, he didn’t want
to expose too much.
Since everyone in the Sword Spirit Sect believed he was in his sixties or seventies, let them think so.
If he exposed that he was only 25 years old, he could invite unnecessary attention and potential danger.
After all, it’s always best to be cautious.
After the banquet, Wang Ping gave Bai Tianhong some guidance, allowing him to gain a deeper understanding and mastery of Sword Spirit.
Without any accidents, Bai Tianhong will definitely comprehend Sword Spirit in the next two months.
“The gifts I’ve received this time are so abundant that they’re enough to support me in several more simulations. If I manage them well, like refining some of the treasure medicines into elixirs and auction them off in the Xia Kingdom, I’ll be able to earn even more Spirit Stones.”
In the loft, although Wang Ping had already gone through such an experience in his previous life, he couldn’t help but glance at his Storage Ring and sighed.
Now, his Storage Ring had become a more advanced middle-tier Storage Ring with a larger storage space and greater resistance to damage, gifted by a Supreme Elder.
“However, even though I have enough Spirit Stones now, and as long as I continue refining elixirs, I can obtain a constant supply of Spirit Stones, I shouldn’t waste them,” Wang Ping thought with many ideas in his heart.
After all, the amount of Spirit Stones he spent on simulations increased exponentially with each use. As the number of simulations increased, the Spirit Stones used would eventually become staggering.
Although the Life Simulator didn’t set an upper limit for the number of simulations, as they increased, he would eventually run out of Spirit Stones and be unable to simulate for a long time. The upcoming simulations would become more difficult.
Every paid life simulation was precious and must not be wasted.
“Perhaps I can first use the free simulations to find the most suitable development path, then proceed with the paid simulations, so it’s more secure,” Wang Ping secretly thought to himself.
In the following month, while carrying out his daily cultivation, Wang Ping also exchanged some non-essential items for Lower-tier Spirit Stones through sect channels.
As a result, the number of Lower-tier Spirit Stones he had reached an astonishing amount: over 50,000.
In Xia Country, Lower-tier Spirit Stones were something only a small portion of Post-Heaven Realm experts could possess, and having a few pieces was already considered good.
Innate Realm experts could possess more Spirit Stones. For an average Innate Realm expert, having a few hundred Lower-tier Spirit Stones was quite normal.
For top-tier Innate Realm experts, having over a thousand Spirit Stones was considered normal as well.
As for Spiritual Realm Experts, those who stood at the peak of Xia Country, their wealth was substantial, with over 10,000 Spirit Stones being quite ordinary.
This time, for the sake of winning Wang Ping’s favor, the elders and Supreme
Elders of the Spirit Origin Sect spared no expense. It was quite normal for Wang Ping to obtain 50,000 Lower-tier Spirit Stones after exchanging his gifts.
If he exchanged those precious items for Spiritual Stones as well, the number would be even more massive.
“This time, with four free simulations saved, I must find the best path for survival and growth. If I can directly find a way to reach the Transcendent
Realm, that would be the best case.”
Wang Ping thought ambitiously to himself.
Of course, Wang Ping also knew that reaching the Transcendent Realm easily was unrealistic.
After all, if it were that easy to break through to the Transcendent Realm, the Profound Turtle Continent wouldn’t have been unable to produce a single Transcendent Realm expert in centuries..

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 57: Group Task!
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Group Task!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, the detection of anomalies in Zhang Jun’s world has triggered the Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is mandatory, and the number of participants required is 10. As the number of group members is less than 10, no selection process will be done, and all members are forcibly joined.”
“Ding, the transportation time is 10 minutes later. Please make the necessary preparations.”
At this moment, a pop-up style page suddenly appeared in front of Wang Ping, causing his face to change drastically.
The chat group had been quiet for more than a month, and now a group task suddenly sprung up? Moreover, it’s a mandatory task, which meant trouble, and it was definitely going to be dangerous…
“No, I must strengthen my abilities!”
Wang Ping clenched his fists, feeling a sense of crisis in his heart. He didn’t even have time to look at the chat group, and immediately called up the Life Simulator page without hesitation.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation!”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, this life simulation will cost 256 Lower-tier Spirit Stones. Would you like to proceed with the simulation now?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Pay.” Wang Ping said.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
“Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on refreshing the White Talent:
Escape Master and Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons.”
White Talent: Escape Master – When the host escapes, there will be a speed boost.
Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons: With this talent, the host will gain a strong resistance to poison.
“System, I choose the second talent.”
Wang Ping looked at the two talents, especially the Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons, and his eyes immediately lit up.
After all, the world he was going to execute the group task in was Zhang Jun’s Zombie World. If he was accidentally bitten by a zombie, he would become a zombie as well.
It could be said that this talent came just in time.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
[Daya Calendar 480, April 20th, you diligently practice cultivation.]
[Daya Calendar 486, Xia is in turmoil, the Third Prince is killed by the Ninth Princess in the Imperial City, shocking the world, who are amazed by Xia 9th
Princess Xia Yuan’s strength and assertiveness.]
[The actions of Xia 9th Princess Xia Yuan have frightened the other princes and princesses, who jointly submitted a petition to the Old Emperor, requesting him to punish the Ninth Princess. They believe that her actions were unreasonably cruel, even killing her own brother.]
[Facing a joint petition from the princes and princesses, the Ninth Princess showed unparalleled strength, directly presenting evidence of the Third Prince’s multiple assassination attempts on her, silencing the entire court. In the end, the old emperor strongly sided with the Ninth Princess, making it clear to all the ministers who was the heir, keeping their minds active and putting an end to any indecisiveness, causing them to pledge their loyalty.]
[In the year 487 of the Daya calendar, you and Bai Tianhong appeared together in Black Wind Forest. Bai Tianhong powerfully killed the Tier-7 Demon Beast Silver Moon Wolf, preventing a Beast Tide from erupting. You also took the opportunity to meet with the village chief and others.]
[At the end of the year 492 of the Daya calendar, the old emperor abdicated, and the Xia Ninth Princess Xia Yuan ascended the throne, becoming an empress who ruled with awe-inspiring authority over the Xia dynasty.]
[At the beginning of the year 493 of the Daya calendar, the Xia country fell into chaos. Bandits roamed the land, and uprisings began in many regions, with the people in great distress. Empress Xia Yuan was furious and swiftly dispatched troops to suppress the uprisings.]
[By the end of the year 494 of the Daya calendar, the empress governed the nation well, old and new officials began to rotate, and fresh blood emerged. The Xia dynasty showed signs of revival, and the lives of the people gradually improved.]
[Although you were in the Sword Spirit Sect, you observed all the happenings in Xia country. At the same time, you had a plan and had been searching for certain treasured medicines.]
[At the end of the year 495 of the Daya calendar, your cultivation reached the Spiritual Origin Realm Double Peak. You successfully refined the 4th Tier Elixir – Life Prolonging Elixir using Yang Recovery Grass combined with Qi Yu’s Third and Fourth Tier Treasured Medicine, which could extend the life of the Unbeatable Ancestor of Xia by twenty years. You arrived at the Imperial City, met with Empress Xia Yuan, and exchanged the elixir for many benefits. She was very grateful and allowed you to enter the imperial secret spiritual pool.]
[You were bathed in the spirit pool, absorbed the spiritual energy, and gained significant benefits. Your cultivation broke through continuously, reaching the
Spiritual Origin Realm 4th-Tier.]
[In the Xia country, thanks to your elixir, the Unbeatable Ancestor of Xia remained alive and did not sit idle. His terrifying power continued to threaten all sides, and no one dared to act recklessly.]
[Not long after, the supreme elders of the Sword Spirit Sect killed two monster beasts and took away the Fire Spirit Flower.]
[In the year 496 of the Daya calendar, the empress continued her reforms, gradually eroding the power of the vassals and arousing turmoil and bloodshed in Xia. Unable to tolerate this, the vassals finally began to rebel. Consequently, the imperial army and the vassals engaged in fierce battles, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. However, due to Xia Yuan’s effective governance, the Imperial army’s strength did not deteriorate like in the past, and it remained temporarily stable.]
[Not long after, the Unbeatable Ancestor of Xia emerged from the mountain and suppressed all sides. All the major vassals were overpowered and forced into submission. The heads of the various vassals were beheaded by the Unbeatable Ancestor of Xia, who dares not move against him. With no choice, they submitted to the empress and cooperated in her reforms, only to preserve their own lives.]
[After undergoing a tumultuous period of reform, Xia resolved many issues and began to flourish, causing the Zhao and Chu states to become extremely wary.]
[Following this, you once again went to the Imperial City and urged Empress Xia Yuan to find MO Fan, intending to nip him in the bud.]
[Regardless, Empress Xia Yuan didn’t question your motives and proclaimed a search for MO Fan’s whereabouts across the land. However, in a very frustrating turn of events, even such a massive search effort failed to uncover any anomaly, with all the MO Fans in the world gathered together.]
[This was an inevitable outcome as you only knew the name but didn’t know
MO Fan’s appearance and age. It was like searching for a needle in a haystack, with no traces to follow.]
[In the year 500 of the Daya calendar, on June 1st, your cultivation progressed, reaching the Spiritual Origin Realm 4th-Tier. That year, the Chi Clan people mysteriously disappeared again, leaving you no choice but to sigh.]
“They disappeared again…”
Wang Ping looked at the luminescent screen, sighing at the outcome.
[In the year 510 of the Daya calendar, you successfully broke through to the
Spiritual Origin Realm 5th-Tier, and Bai Tianhong’s cultivation reached the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, wanting to start closed-door cultivation to break through the Transcendent Realm. Although your cultivation speed paled in comparison to that of those relying on elixir, you could feel that your foundation was getting more solid, allowing you to go further in the future.]
[However, you knew that the Xia country would be in turmoil soon, so you asked Bai Tianhong not to close himself off yet and accompany you on another adventure. Bai Tianhong agreed, believing that simply focusing on arduous cultivation would not suffice and that the probability of breaking through to the Transcendent Realm was too low, requiring the discovery of opportunities.]
[That same year, the realm of Jianghu began to experience chaos as numerous strong individuals disappeared, and even entire townsfolk vanished mysteriously. This caught the attention of the Empress, and an investigation was launched.]
[However, the strong individuals sent by the Xia Court to investigate also mysteriously disappeared without a trace. The Empress, infuriated, dispatched Spiritual Realm Experts to conduct the investigation.. Yet, they still lost contact quickly and were unable to transmit any information back!]

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 58: A New Extraordinary
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: A New Extraordinary
Translator: 549690339
[You heard the news, and your heart chilled, knowing that the Demon was about to emerge, and Xia would be in turmoil. In response, you took Bai Tianhong with you to the Imperial City to meet Empress Xia Yuan and informed her of what you knew.]
[For a moment, Empress Xia Yuan understood why you were searching for someone named MO Fan, and Bai Tianhong also knew why you wanted him to accompany you on your journey.]
[However, both of them were very confused about how you knew these things in advance, but due to the friendship between you, neither of them delved deeper into the matter.]
[In the following days, the Empress issued a decree to the world, beginning the hunt for demonic cultivators. However, the demonic cultivators were extremely cunning and difficult to trace. You knew that MO Fan was about to strike at the Wu family. As a result, in the Daya calendar’s 511th year, you chose to bring Bai Tianhong and the masters of the Xia Royal Family to the Wu family to await the enemy.]
[In the 511th year of Daya calendar, the Wu family was silently annihilated by the demonic cultivator, leaving no survivors. After the demonic cultivator made a move, Bai Tianhong and the Xia masters also took action, hunting down the demonic cultivator. However, what you didn’t expect was that the demonic cultivator’s secret skill was extremely terrifying. Although he was no match for Bai Tianhong and the Xia Ancestor, he managed to escape with his life.]
[You were deeply regretful that you could not kill him, and a shadow appeared in your heart.]
[The news of Bai Tianhong’s failure to hunt down the demon shocked the world and drew attention, and everyone realized that they would not be safe unless the demon was eradicated. The matter concerned the life and death of everyone. As a result, everyone began to consciously search for traces of demonic cultivators. Even Chu State and Zhao State had heard the news, and they wanted to help. After all, if the demonic cultivator were to grow stronger, they would be in great danger.]
[However, because of their previous setbacks, the demonic cultivators became more cautious. They often took actions but were very clean about it and often changed their appearances, making it difficult for others to find them.]
[Bai Tianhong insisted on continuing to retreat to break through to the half-step Transcendent Realm before the demon, otherwise, it would be very troublesome. To this, you could only agree. However, in your heart, you knew that it was too difficult to compete with Demon MO Fan for the speed of breakthrough.]
[A year passed, and Xia was very peaceful, as if Demon MO Fan had stopped killing. However, you knew very well that this was just the calm before the storm.]
[In December of 512th year of the Daya calendar, the Demon appeared once more. This time, he appeared directly in the Imperial City, his cultivation reaching the half-step Transcendent Realm. He slaughtered everyone in the Imperial Palace, leaving no survivors and causing a stir in the world. Hearing the news, your heart became heavy, knowing that the Demon had become invincible yet again.]
[Facing the invincible Demon, you had no choice but to suggest to the Sword Spirit Sect to move their entire sect. Otherwise, sooner or later, Demon MO Fan would attack the sect, leaving corpses everywhere.]
[Regarding your proposal, the Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect did not agree. In their view, although the Demon was rampant, the Sword Spirit Sect possessed a spiritual tool. As long as Bai Tianhong was armed with it, even a half-step Transcendent Realm opponent could be fought. As a result, they instead hoped that Demon MO Fan would attack the sect so they could eliminate him completely and put an end to the problem once and for all.]
[Seeing that the higher-ups of the Sword Spirit Sect would not listen to your advice, you sighed and made a decision in your heart.]
[Three days later, the Demon stepped into the Sword Spirit Sect and fought alone against all the strong members of the sect. Bai Tianhong came out of seclusion, but still failed to break through to the Transcendent Realm, not even reaching the half-step Transcendent Realm. As such, even with Bai Tianhong holding the Spirit Sword and teaming up with many powerful members of the Sword Spirit Sect to fight against the Demon, they were no match for him.]
[In the end, Bai Tianhong died, and the Sword Spirit Sect was destroyed. During this process, you revealed your identity as a 4th Tier Alchemist and willingly joined the Demon in order to lay low and gain his trust before poisoning him to death.]
[After learning of your 4th Tier Alchemist identity, the Demon considered you a talent and took you in, making you one of his subordinates. However, he did not trust you and planted a demonic mark in your heart, allowing him to detonate your heart with a secret technique regardless of where you may escape to.]
[In the blink of an eye, twenty years had passed, and your cultivation had improved significantly during this time.]
[In these twenty years, the Demon established an overworld demon nation and began to hunt down the strong practitioners of the Profound Turtle Continent. Even hiding deep in the mountains and forests did not help them.]
[Half a year later, the Demon consumed the flesh and blood of all the cultivators he hunted, cultivated his demonic skills, and sought to break through to the Transcendent Realm. You were aware that when the time came for him to make his breakthrough, you and the other demon generals would all be food for him. Therefore, you could only look for an opportunity to deliver the refined elixir, hoping to interfere with the Demon’s breakthrough and cause his downfall. In the end, the Demon was disrupted, became enraged, and crushed your heart.] [Due to your death, this life simulation has come to an end…]
“I still died after all.
Wang Ping looked at the result and was not surprised.
Because after all, Sword Spirit Sect was not Chi Village they couldn’t just move away, abandoning an enormous estate was not possible.
Moreover, with so many people in the Sword Spirit Sect, even if they moved the entire sect, it would not be easy to hide.
So, if the Demon doesn’t die, it will eventually end up like this.
“However, I was caught off guard by the fact that the demon, who attacked the Wu family, managed to escape from Bai Tianhong’s hands. That was truly unexpected.”
Wang Ping frowned and felt heavy-hearted.
At that time, Bai Tianhong probably didn’t have the Green Spirit Sword with him, but he still had an invincible level of strength, along with the masters of the Xia Royal Family. The demonic cultivator still managed to escape under the joint pursuit of these masters. His life-saving abilities were truly astonishing. “I really don’t know how to deal with this demon.”
Wang Ping had a headache.
But soon, he thought about his upcoming System Task, and the headache became even worse.
He doesn’t have much time to think about so many things now.
“Ding, Reward generation successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
White Talent – Escape Master.
@. Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons.
Martial Arts.
Life Experience.”
“These four rewards…
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered.
He wanted all four rewards.
Whether it was the Escape Master or Immunity to All Poisons, they could both enhance his ability to save his life.
As for the fourth one, Life Experience, Wang Ping also wanted that.
Because with the life experience, he could figure out the truth and falsehood of the demon, witness his appearance, and the ability of his demonic skills.
That way, he could better strangle them in the cradle or kill the others during Bai Tianhong’s battle.
However, unfortunately, there was no cultivation reward he wanted the most this time.
“System, I choose
After some thought, Wang Ping finally chose @.
Because he needed the talent of Immunity to All Poisons, and next time it might not be available.
Next, Wang Ping instructed the maids in the tower, saying that he would seclude himself for some time and then entered the tower’s meditation room, bolting the door.
“System, I want to do a paid Life Simulation.”
Wang Ping glanced at the time and saw that there were still a few minutes left before speaking again.
“Ding, this paid simulation requires 512 Lower Tier Spirit Stones, do you want to pay immediately?”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Pay.” Wang Ping’s face twitched slightly as he said.
Exponential growth in consumption, this really hurt.
However, in order to become stronger and survive the upcoming Group Task, he had no choice but to indulge in such extravagant spending.
Hopefully, he could get a cultivation reward this time, or else it would be troublesome..

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 59: Spiritual Essence Realm Great Perfection! (Asking for the first subscription!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 59: Spiritual Essence Realm Great Perfection! (Asking for the first subscription!) _2
Translator: 549690339
[Daya Calendar 511, you, along with Bai Tianhong and the Xia Royal Family’s experts, came to the Wu family and guarded them.]
[Soon after, the Wu family was uprooted by demonic cultivators without a trace, leaving no survivors. After the demonic cultivator’s attack, you all also took action, starting to hunt down the demonic cultivator. Under your joint attack with spiritual tools, the demon was unable to escape despite his best efforts and was killed by you.]
[Next, you searched the demon’s body and found a terrifying demonic skill, which was destroyed by Bai Tianhong to prevent it from causing harm to people again.]
“Huh… It actually succeeded.”
Wang Ping looked at the content in the simulator, very astonished.
He had thought that this time would still end in failure, intending to rely on his subsequent life experiences, but he didn’t expect that they would actually kill Demon Mo Fan.
The speed of his growth in this simulation was truly terrifying.
However, this was also quite normal.
After all, his Martial Enlightenment Heart was already quite robust, and after spending so many years in the simulator, it had become even stronger.
Coupled with having the Green Talent: Excellent Physique and an excellent Bone and Root Aptitude, and numerous resources, reaching the Complete Spiritual Realm Cultivation was to be expected.
And besides, this time they had brought spiritual tools as well.
Three powerful individuals at the Great Perfection level of the Spiritual Realm, carrying spiritual tools – if they still couldn’t kill Demon MO Fan, then there would truly be no other way.
“It looks like this time it will bring me a huge surprise. Maybe there’s hope to break through to the Transcendent Realm.”
Wang Ping thought to himself with great expectation.
While Wang Ping was anticipating, the text on the simulator continued to appear.
[After the Demon was killed, peace once again returned to the world. You and Bai Tianhong both returned to the sect, continuing your cultivation in seclusion, hoping to break through to the Transcendent Realm.]
[However, even after thirty years, you and Bai Tianhong still failed to cross that barrier, not even reaching the half-step Transcendent Realm. In frustration, you and Bai Tianhong realized that in order to break through to the Transcendent Realm, you would need an enormous amount of high-tier spirit stones, as well as a secret skill to expand your Dantian. Without being able to expand your Dantian, and without a massive supply of high-tier spirit stones to provide high-quality spiritual essence, it would be absolutely impossible to break through to the Transcendent Realm by relying solely on absorbing spiritual energy. You wouldn’t even be able to make a half-step Transcendent Realm breakthrough.]
[Perhaps, this is the reason why no one on the Profound Turtle Continent has been able to break through to the Transcendent Realm in centuries – the secret skills have been lost, and the resources on the Profound Turtle Continent are too scarce. Mid-tier Spirit Stone veins are extremely rare, and high-tier spiritual mines had been completely depleted in ancient times. Under such circumstances, how could anyone break through?]
[After reaching this conclusion, you and Bai Tianhong both felt confused about your martial path and became disheartened. In the end, Bai Tianhong made the decision to venture overseas in search of a new opportunity.]
[However, you urged Bai Tianhong not to be impulsive. After all, the seas were extremely dangerous, and no one who had ventured out had ever returned alive – they had all perished. Nevertheless, Bai Tianhong was determined not to live out a mediocre life on the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[As such, you had no choice but to accept his decision with a smile, accompanying Bai Tianhong out to sea, hoping to find a martial path overseas.]
[You set sail and left Profound Turtle Continent. Over the first three days, although you encountered sea monsters’ attacks, you managed to remain unscathed thanks to your strong powers. However, on the fourth day, you were attacked by a horrifying monster and were devoured in an instant.] [Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
“Is it really impossible to break through to the Transcendent Realm while staying on Profound Turtle Continent?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a frown.
In the last simulation, Demon MO Fan had successfully broken through to the Transcendent Realm.
However, his methods were too brutal; he had practically captured all of the martial artists on the Profound Turtle Continent and used them for his cultivation. He had likely targeted even monster beasts and didn’t spare many ordinary people either. Under such circumstances, he had barely managed to break through to the Transcendent Realm after numerous years of preparation.
This was enough to show how difficult it was to break through to the Transcendent Realm.
No wonder no transcendent realms have appeared on Profound Turtle Continent for hundreds of years.
If we consider Chi Village as a foreign guest and that Sword Spirit Sect’s founder was a transcendent realm expert who only appeared a thousand years ago, then it would mean that no transcendent realm expert had appeared on Profound Turtle Continent for a millennium.
Even he and Bai Tianhong were stuck at this level, unable to even step into the half-step Transcendent Realm.
It all comes down to insufficient resources and the loss of secret skills.
“However, regarding secret skills, perhaps I can gain some enlightenment from the demonic skills that Demon MO Fan practiced. Apart from that, I can still ask Mr. Cai.”
Wang Ping thought about Demon MO Fan and his eyes flickered.
Since Demon MO Fan practiced demonic skills and managed to break through to the Transcendent Realm, it meant that there was a secret skill in his demonic skills that could expand the Dantian.
As long as he could get hold of it, there would be some hope.
In this simulation, it was a pity that Bai Tianhong had destroyed the demonic skills.
Of course, if he were ruthless enough to practice the demonic skills, breaking through to the Transcendent Realm would be almost certain.
However, unless it was an absolute life or death situation, Wang Ping really didn’t want to go down that path.
After all, such brutality would not be tolerated by heaven and earth.
As for asking Cai Yonglong…
To be honest, it would be very difficult to obtain secret skills from him.
After all, Cai Yonglong’s current cultivation and status were far too distant from the Transcendent Realm, and he simply couldn’t obtain them. High-tier spirit stones were also equally impossible to obtain..

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 59: Spiritual Essence Realm Great Perfection! (Asking for the first subscription!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 59: Spiritual Essence Realm Great Perfection! (Asking for the first subscription!) _3
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, reward generation successful. The host can choose one of the following rewards:
Complete Spiritual Realm Cultivation.
@. Practiced Martial Arts.
Practiced Cultivation Method.
Sword Spirit.
Green Talent: Excellent Physique.
Life Experience.”
“System, I choose O.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, regretfully glanced at the Green Talent: Excellent Physique option, and then unhesitatingly chose cultivation.
After all, his main goal in this simulation was to improve his cultivation.
Only with strong cultivation could he have the greatest chance of survival in the upcoming group task.
However, his cultivation skyrocketing to the Great Perfection of Spiritual Origin Realm was truly a pleasant surprise.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt a terrifying power appear within his body.
His physical body was becoming stronger, and his cultivation was soaring to the Great Perfection of Spiritual Origin Realm, which was quite frightening.
Moreover, this improvement didn’t feel superficial but rather solid and substantial.
After all, Wang Ping believed in Bai Tianhong’s words and had been cultivating on his own ever since, relying on his own diligent efforts.
The only time he had rapidly advanced his cultivation was when he soaked in the Xia Royal Family’s Spirit Spring, which not only had no side effects but even had some talent enhancing effects.
“Great Perfection of Spiritual Origin Realm, what a powerful feeling.” Wang Ping felt the surging power within his body and couldn’t help but
exclaim in his heart.
He felt that if he wanted, he could easily shatter a small mountain with just a wave of his hand.
“Ding, time’s up, the crossover begins.”
Just when the system’s voice rang out, a white light appeared on Wang Ping’s body.
This made Wang Ping snap back to attention, steady his breath, and brace himself.
Immediately after, Wang Ping felt his consciousness flicker and vanished from within the closed chamber.
The next instant, Wang Ping’s vision brightened, and he found himself inside a house.
In the room, a young man with glasses and bloodstains on his body was sitting on a sofa, wiping a long sword.
“Zhang Jun?” Wang Ping looked at the young man and asked.
“It’s me. And you are?” Zhang Jun stared at Wang Ping with a flickering gaze, asking inquisitively.
“Wang Ping.” Wang Ping answered.
“I didn’t expect you to be the first one here.” Zhang Jun sighed.
At this moment, more light appeared, and two more people materialized in the room.
“Hey, I’m Zhang Hu, who of you is Zhang Jun?” Zhang Hu had a rough appearance and lacked any knightly demeanor. He looked at the other two and said without reservation.
“I’m Fang Yun.” Fang Yun shrugged and looked curiously at Wang Ping and Zhang Jun, then glanced at Zhang Hu and smirked, “Zhang Hu, you’re really not serious.”
“Your mother is not serious.” Zhang Hu glared.
“You two, keep your voices down. Although I’ve cleared the zombies from this area, making too much noise might still attract some monsters.” Zhang Jun said with a headache, looking at Zhang Hu and Fang Yun.
“Uh, sorry.” Fang Yun apologized awkwardly.
Zhang Hu also fell silent.
At this moment, four more lights appeared, and four more people materialized next to them.
One was a young man in a white robe, with a long sword tied around his waist. One was a stunning beauty dressed in a phoenix robe, wearing a golden hairpin on her head.
One was a nervous and somewhat at a loss youth.
And one was a cool, black-haired young girl dressed in refreshing clothes. Looking at the outfits of these four people, Wang Ping and the others exchanged glances and instantly guessed their identities: “Mr. Cai, Miss Liu,
Jun, and Chen Yao?”
“As expected, you guessed right.” Cai Yonglong grinned and glanced at Liu, Wu
Jun, and Chen Yao before looking back at Wang Ping and the others, saying,
“You should also introduce yourselves.”
“I’m Zhang Jun.” Zhang Jun said quietly, “Although it’s a joyous and memorable occasion for us to meet face-to-face, remember not to make too much noise.
“Mr. Cai, you didn’t recognize me at first glance, you really hurt my feelings.” Fang Yun pretended to be sad, saying, “Friendship over.”
“I’m Zhang Hu.” Zhang Hu grinned.
“I’m Wang Ping.” Wang Ping smiled faintly and simply introduced himself.
At the same time, Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong with a hint of surprise.
Cai Yonglong had advanced his cultivation a lot, reaching the Half-step Spiritual Realm.
It was only less than two months since they joined the group crossover, and in less than two months, he had advanced from the 7th-Tier of Innate Realm to the Half-step Spiritual Realm. This cultivating speed was truly astonishing.
It was clear that his golden finger must be very powerful; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to achieve this feat.
“Sad my ass.” At this moment, Cai Yonglong raised an eyebrow and, after nodding to everyone, dashed to Fang Yun’s side, kicking him in the butt and sending him flying into the wall.
“Ouch, my butt!” Fang Yun cried out in pain.
“Heh, that’s for making fun of me in the chat group. Let’s see if you still dare to be so shameless.” Cai Yonglong sneered.
“I won’t dare anymore, I promise.” Fang Yun held his buttocks with a sheepish grin.
Dammit, who knew they’d be meeting face-to-face so soon? Now he was really getting a lesson.
Chat group, I hate you.
Seeing this scene, Zhang Hu couldn’t help but laugh gleefully.
Wang Ping glanced at Fang Yun and thought he deserved to be beaten. Otherwise, he was too aggravating.
Wu Jun couldn’t help but hold back his laughter, wishing that Cai Yonglong would kick him a few more times..

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 59: Spiritual Origin Realm Great
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 59: Spiritual Origin Realm Great
Perfection! (Seeking subscription!)_4
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Jun looked helpless.
Well, what he said was treated as flatulence, which was quite depressing.
“I think we should discuss the matter of the system task now. After all, we come from different worlds and cannot stay in this world for too long.”
Liu Mei sighed and spoke with some concern.
This sudden system task really caught her off guard.
Her sudden disappearance might put her in danger.
Although the emperor loved her, it was hard to ensure that no trouble would arise from this incident.
“Miss. Liu is right. It’s time to discuss the important matter.” Fang Yun hurriedly spoke, fearing that Cai Yonglong would scold him again.
“By the way, Miss. Liu, can you undo the Golden finger ability? It’s hard for me to calm down when you look like this.” Zhang Hu looked at Liu Mei and said with a rogue air.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked at Liu Mei.
Indeed, Liu Mei’s appearance was astonishing at the moment, causing great damage to everyone.
Even Chen Yao, who was also very attractive and could have been considered an aloof goddess in her previous life, paled in comparison to Liu Mei.
Even Zhang Jun, who was a rich second-generation playboy before crossing over and had been with many women, was quite moved and felt restless inside.
Especially after crossing over to this world for more than a month, he had not touched a woman at all and was constantly on edge, killing mutated zombies, surviving, and repeating, which made him somewhat crazy.
“Sorry, I forgot.” Liu Mei felt tense upon seeing everyone’s strange gazes and quietly lowered her appearance, becoming ordinary.
Although the current chat group atmosphere was relatively friendly, no one really knew each other’s true personalities and thoughts.
After all, you never really know someone.
Now, during the task, they couldn’t return to their worlds, so if someone with power wanted to do something to those without power, it would be too easy.
“What a magical golden finger indeed.” Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh as he saw Liu Mei’s appearance become ordinary.
Zhang Jun and Zhang Hu’s gazes returned to normal too.
Wu Jun chuckled shyly, not daring to say much, appearing honest and simple.
Chen Yao also withdrew her gaze, remaining silent.
Liu Mei’s golden finger must be the one many women dream of.
After all, every woman is very concerned about her appearance and figure, and Liu Mei can adjust hers freely.
However, compared to Liu Mei’s golden finger, Chen Yao was more relieved that she got the Point addition system, which allowed her to rapidly grow stronger and save her life.
“Cough, it’s time to discuss the group task.”
Cai Yonglong coughed, drawing back everyone’s attention and spoke seriously.
“Next, we’ll follow the plan we discussed in the chat group earlier.”
“Agreed.” Everyone nodded.
“What did you guys talk about? I didn’t pay attention to the chat group before.” Wang Ping silently raised his hand and asked.
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, everyone twitched their mouths and stared at him with strange gazes.
How reckless, for such a life-and-death matter, Wang Ping didn’t even follow the chat group or read their messages.
“I was preparing some life-saving measures for after crossing over.” Wang Ping coughed lightly.
“Forget it, I’ll go over it again.” Cai Yonglong sighed and began, “The name of the group task this time is to kill the bizarre zombie. There is no time limit, but we have to complete the task in order to return to our respective worlds.”
“Based on our analysis, this so-called bizarre zombie is not an ordinary mutated zombie or a strengthened zombie. As we all know, whenever the word ‘bizarre’ is involved in any type of novel, it makes people’s hair stand on end and its existence is extremely terrifying. Perhaps, the Transmigrator Chat Group allowed us to cross over into different worlds to deal with these bizarre creatures.”
“Of course, all these are just speculations, and they are not particularly important for now.”
“Next is the issue of how to complete the task.”
Cai Yonglong paused and continued.
“Since we currently have no clues, we can only rely on your ability to foresee the future to safely locate the bizarre zombie while avoiding future dangers and minimizing casualties. Once we find the bizarre zombie, we can take action, and I will be the one to kill it.”
“That’s how it is then.” Wang Ping nodded.
“However, I want to tell you something.” Wang Ping paused, glanced at everyone, and said, “I can only use my ability four times. If I use it more, I have to pay a price.”
“Why?” Cai Yonglong frowned. “Once a day, can you only use it four times? Is it restricted by the system?”
Everyone’s expressions became serious.
They had been counting on Wang Ping’s ability to pass the task safely.
If it wasn’t enough, they would just wait a few more days for the cooldown time to refresh.
After all, life is unique, and nobody wants to die.
“My cooldown time has changed to once every ten days. But in turn, I can store uses and use it multiple times in one day.”
Wang Ping explained briefly.
He didn’t want to reveal his power for now.
If he could solve the problem and complete the system task without exposing his power, it would be the best outcome.
Once he exposes too powerful abilities, the group members might guess that his golden finger wasn’t just about foreseeing the future, but something even more powerful.
If it was before the group task, Wang Ping thought the group members were all right, but after Liu Mei’s incident…
His perception had changed.
At least, Zhang Jun and Zhang Hu, these two guys, were most likely not good people.
Although they hid it well, Wang Ping was now at the Great Perfection of Spiritual Origin Realm, and their actions in front of him were in extreme slow motion.
Their gazes at Liu Mei and their unusual reactions of Qi and Blood were all observed clearly by him.
These two had bad intentions towards Liu Mei.
Although it’s normal for a man to have such reactions towards a stunning beauty, their reactions surpassed normal people’s reactions.
Therefore, Wang Ping became more vigilant towards the group members.
“I see.”
Hearing Wang Ping’s explanation, Cai Yonglong and the others exchanged glances, not knowing whether to be happy or worried.
He could use it four times at once, but the cooldown time was changed to once every ten days.
In the short term, it seemed safer, but in the long run, the cooldown time was too long. If they didn’t complete the task in a short time, the task time would be stretched too much.
“Why did your golden finger change?” Zhang Hu asked suspiciously.
“My own choice.” Wang Ping didn’t want to say more.
Zhang Jun heard this and raised his eyebrows. He looked deeply at Wang Ping but didn’t say anything more..

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 60: Complete Annihilation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 60: Complete Annihilation!
Translator: 549690339
“Tsk.” Zhang Hu smacked his lips but didn’t seem to have any more questions.
After all, if Wang Ping didn’t want to elaborate, pressing him on the subject would only offend him.
Moreover, the current Wang Ping wasn’t someone he could afford to offend.
Not to mention, he hadn’t shared any details about his own Golden Finger either.
“Wang Ping, can you try to predict the future with your ability as a gesture of goodwill?”
Cai Yonglong stared intently at Wang Ping and spoke seriously.
He didn’t see Wang Pings cultivation level and thought he was just an ordinary person.
Although swordsmen could sense whether one another had comprehended Sword Spirit, if one party was able to hide it, others wouldn’t be able to perceive it.
Unless the gap in their swordsmanship skills was huge, with the stronger party still being able to see through the weaknesses of the weaker one.
Although Cai Yonglong had comprehended Saber Intent, he obviously didn’t belong to this category.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping glanced at the others without saying much and closed his eyes theatrically.
Even if he closed his eyes, he could still see the text displayed by the Life Simulator.
However, he was just more used to staring at the text with his eyes open.
When Wang Ping closed his eyes, everyone’s expressions turned serious, hoping for a positive development.
As for Fang Yun, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun, the three of them exchanged glances before silently taking up different positions, watching the outside through the peephole or slightly pulling open the curtains, ready to ward off any attacking monsters.
Apparently, they had already discussed this among themselves when they were in the chat group.
On the other hand, Wu Jun and Liu Mei, who had no real combat strength, could only pace around nervously.
As for Cai Yonglong and Chen Yao, they sat quietly, waiting for the result.
“System, I want to start a free simulation.” At this moment, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded in Wang Pings mind, and the text reappeared.
[On the first day, Cai Yonglong and the others are expecting you to predict the future and get a good result, but you reveal that you cannot predict anything, saying that your Golden Finger is ineffective in other worlds.]
[This news greatly disappoints everyone. Feeling like a bad omen has just occurred, they believe they may be in grave danger.]
[Next, you discuss your plans for the future. After the discussion, Cai Yonglong suggests that you, Wu Jun and Liu Mei – the three without any combat power – stay at the temporary stronghold, so they wouldn’t slow the others down. Wu Jun and Liu Mei happily agree, as they feel safer staying behind.]
[You, however, don’t share the same opinion and insist on joining the team to fight the bizarre zombies. Cai Yonglong and the others find your request baffling, thinking that if your Golden Finger is useless and you lack any fighting power, you’d just be a hindrance to the team and endanger them.]
[In response, you deliberately reveal your Innate Perfection Realm cultivation while suppressing your real cultivation level. This revelation shocks everyone, as they never imagined your cultivation would reach the Innate Realm.]
[However, because you revealed your cultivation, everyone becomes suspicious and cautious of you, thinking you must be hiding your true Golden Finger and that your ability to predict the future is fake.]
[You sense their thoughts and feel helpless, but you had anticipated this outcome. In the end, you can only explain that this is due to some opportunities.]
[No one believes you, including Cai Yonglong. Seeing this, you stop trying to explain and simply reiterate your desire to join the team.]
[Eventually, due to your considerable strength, Cai Yonglong allows you to join the team.]
[Then, you leave the temporary stronghold and begin searching for the bizarre zombies, intending to eliminate them. After discussions and analysis, your group believes that the bizarre zombies must be similar to mutated zombies, with some unusual characteristics. And since the Group Task was suddenly released, it’s most likely that the bizarre zombies have appeared in the city where Zhang Jun is located. Otherwise, with no clues, it’s like finding a needle in a haystack, and the mission would be impossible to complete.]
[So, you decide to kill every mutated zombie in the city, leaving no room for error.]
[Your group sets out and begins hunting down mutated zombies to eliminate
them. During the journey, you acquire a special Crystal Stone after killing a zombie. After learning from Zhang Jun’s explanation, you find out that these Crystal Stones can strengthen a person’s physical strength and are unique to this world. He had also relied on hunting zombies and acquiring these Crystal Stones to achieve his astonishing physical strength.]
[For a moment, everyone is taken aback. If you could obtain many high-quality Crystal Stones, it might be possible to significantly enhance your physical strength. Even Cai Yonglong can’t help but be tempted. You too couldn’t help but feel amazed by the wonders of each different world and their resources.]
“There’s actually something like this in this world. As expected of the Zombie
World.’
Upon seeing this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
If these items were useful even for high-level cultivators, then it would be truly incredible.
Of course, even if they weren’t. It could still save them a lot of time in Body Refining, and might even be more useful than Qi and Blood Elixirs.
He just didn’t know if there were any side effects to these Crystal Stones..

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 60: Complete Annihilation! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 60: Complete Annihilation! _2
Translator: 549690339
After the emotional moment, Wang Ping calmed his mind and looked at the simulator again, with the words reappearing before him.
[Next, you all decided that going on like this would be too inefficient, so you split up to hunt separately. However, to prevent accidents, you divided into groups of three. You, Chen Yao, and Fang Yun formed one group, while Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun formed the other. If there is an emergency, you would use the Message Talisman brought by Cai Yonglong to contact each other.]
[A day passed, and the sun set. You killed quite a few mutated zombies and gained some loot, but you couldn’t find the bizarre zombie, which made you slightly anxious.]
[At the same time, you found something very strange. That is, you didn’t see a
single living person, as if everyone in this world had died. Regarding this,
Zhang Jun could only remain silent. He originally thought it was because he hadn’t explored much, so he hadn’t encountered anyone else. Now it seemed that this wasn’t the case.]
[After Zhang Jun’s explanation, as the sky darkened, the zombies became more ferocious and dangerous. It was recommended to return to the temporary stronghold. You could only sigh and head back to the stronghold.]
[However, when you returned to the stronghold, something terrifying happened. Liu Mei and Wu Jun had already turned into zombies and lunged at you, trying to infect you all.]
[As a result, you had no choice but to mercilessly suppress and kill the two of them with a heavy heart.]
[The sudden transformation of the two people cast a shadow over your hearts, and everyone felt depressed. Two people had died in less than a day, which was too strange.]
[Moreover, after your inspection, you found no signs of forced entry from the outside of the house. There were no traces on the doors or windows, and no zombies could have broken in. Even the toilet and sewer were blocked, making it impossible for any strange creatures to sneak in silently.]
[However, despite these circumstances, the two of them had mysteriously turned into zombies, which left you all puzzled and chilled. At this point, even you and Cai Yonglong with your powerful abilities, as well as Chen Yao, were no longer calm.]
[After all, even with great power, it is difficult to defend against such bizarre events.]
[Zhang Jun asked Chen Yao calmly whether the Demon World had similar strange abilities, but Chen Yao said she didn’t know. At this, everyone was disappointed, having no references to go by.]
[Next, you asked Zhang Jun whether it was a virus test that spread through the air. Zhang Jun shook his head, saying it should be impossible. If it was a virus infection, he would’ve turned into a zombie long ago.]
[Zhang Jun’s words made sense, leaving you all with heavy hearts. Unknown things were too terrifying.]
“What’s going on?”
Upon seeing this, Wang Pings face changed, and he instinctively clenched his fists.
As the simulation said, facing a formidable enemy was not scary, as there was still a chance to fight. But such bizarre events were truly hair-raising and hard to stay calm about.
If the bizarre incident was not resolved, Wang Ping had a feeling that they might all be annihilated in this world.
As for Wang Ping’s change of expression, everyone present saw it. They all felt a bad premonition as their pupils contracted and their faces changed.
After all, if the scenes in the future were going smoothly, Wang Ping couldn’t have shown such an expression.
For a moment, everyone’s hearts were heavy.
However, none of them had any intention of disturbing Wang Ping. As long as he didn’t open his eyes, they would stay quiet.
At this moment, Wang Ping looked at the simulator again with apprehension.
[Since you couldn’t discuss any results, you could only sleep with a heavy heart, taking turns to keep watch three at a time.]
[However, two hours later, something bizarre happened again. Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, Fang Yun, Chen Yao, and Zhang Jun suddenly turned into zombies and attacked you. You were shocked and burst out with your true strength to suppress them all.]
