[Although you suppressed them all, your heart was filled with horror because the situation was too strange. You were on guard, but you didn’t sense any zombies entering the room. Yet, the five of them were silently infected and turned into zombies, even the powerful Cai Yonglong and Chen Yao.]
[Keep in mind, Cai Yonglong still had a Half-step Spiritual Realm cultivation, whereas Chen Yao had the point addition system, and grew rapidly with the support of the Demon World. Their strength was on par with an Innate Realm in the Profound World.]
[Yet, these two, too, were infected without a sound, making people’s scalp go numb.]
[For a moment, you were restless. You thought it was because of the room, so you left it overnight, found and moved into a new place. You stayed up all night, fearing that you would suddenly turn into a zombie. You even suspected that if you didn’t have the Immunity to All Poisons Green Talent, you might have turned into a zombie silently like Cai Yonglong and the others.]
[The night passed without you getting infected, which gave you some relief. However, your mood became even heavier, as you now had to survive alone in this strange apocalyptic world.]
[After that, you took all the materials that everyone had brought with them before crossing and put them into the Storage Ring. Then you began to wander through the city. You didn’t continue hunting mutated zombies. Although you wanted to deal with the bizarre zombie, you were more concerned about your own life..]

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 60 Total Annihilation!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 60 Total Annihilation!_3
Translator: 549690339
Gazing at the words within the simulator, Wang Pings expression shifted several times, the dismality reached its extreme, and his fists were clenched tightly.
The thing they were most afraid of had still happened.
Strange… strange!
Upon mentioning the word “strange”, it is not just an issue of power anymore.
They managed to infect Cai Yonglong into a zombie so stealthily, that method is rather terrifying.
The people in the house, seeing Wang Pings expression change drastically again, all had their pupils contracting and felt increasingly uneasy.
However, they could only stare at Wang Ping, daring not make a sound, for fear of disturbing Wang Ping and causing a termination of the ability.
At this moment, words still filled Wang Pings sight.
“[On the second day, you are safe and sound.]”
“[On the third day, you are safe and sound.]”
“[On the tenth day, you encountered a terrifying mutated zombie. Its combat strength astonishingly reached the Innate Realm. You fought it, killed it, obtained a Crystal Stone, and strengthened your physical strength.]”
“[On the twentieth day, you found that there were more and more mutated zombies, and some of the mutated zombies were becoming stronger. You are worried that if these zombies continue to grow stronger, it will threaten your life. Therefore, you plan to leave the city and go to the wild, surviving where the zombies are scarce.]”
“[Because you flew with your sword, you didn’t encounter a zombie tide and successfully escaped.]”
“[On the twenty-first day, you arrived at a certain countryside. After clearing all the zombies inside, you began your lonely life. Because this world lacks Spiritual Energy, you dare not use the Spiritual Stones in your Storage Ring for cultivation at will. And you have already reached the Great Perfection Tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm, you are unable to break through to the half-step
Transcendent Realm, and cultivation is meaningless.]”
“[On the one hundred and sixtieth day, while you were immersed in your
Sword Enlightenment, you suddenly heard a huge noise outside and were awoken. You went out and looked, only to feel your scalp go numb. Zombies as far as the eye can see appeared in your view. In the sky, there were densely packed bird-like mutated zombie creatures.]”
“[You wanted to escape, but encountered great resistance. After an intense battle, you killed a large number of zombies. However, due to the massive number of zombies, many mutated zombies’ combat strength reached the
Post-Heaven Realm, there were not few that even reached the Innate Battle Skill, and some terrifying mutated zombies even reached the Spiritual Origin Realm.]”
“[In the face of such a terrifying army of zombies, you fought desperately, but you still couldn’t break through this horrific encirclement. The Spiritual Energy in your body was almost exhausted and was about to dry up. You were extremely desperate. You didn’t expect to end like this.]”
“[Before you died, you saw a tentacle rushing out from the earth, piercing through your body. Then, you lost consciousness and your vision plunged into eternal darkness.]”
“[Due to your death, this simulation has ended.]”
“This…
Wang Ping looked at the result of this simulation, his eyelids twitching uncontrollably.
Although he knew for a long time that he would definitely die at the hand of zombies in this simulation, he didn’t expect to die so quickly, lasting only a hundred and sixty days.
The speed of these zombies mutating is simply too horrifying.
By the one hundred and sixtieth day, even the Post-Heaven Battle Skill is disregarded, the Innate Battle Skill is everywhere.
Even the Spiritual Origin Realm is not rare.
The combat power of this zombie tide is simply too horrific, he feared that all the martial artists in his world’s Xia combined would not be enough for this zombie tide to gnaw on.
“Different world, different leveling system, it’s really quite colorful.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself in his heart.
In his Xia, it is difficult to become a Innate Realm Expert, let alone talk about the Spiritual Realm Expert, there are probably less than a hundred Spiritual Realm Experts in the entire Xia.
And this, is accumulated over hundreds of years.
However, in Zhang Jun’s Zombie World, these zombies have grown to this level in such a short time.
Although these zombies’ methods are certainly not as good as the experts in the Profound World, the rapid growth is ultimately quite terrifying. “However, the appearance of these zombie tides is a bit too strange.”
Wang Ping frowned, falling into deep thought.
He had already gone into hiding, it should have taken quite a while to involve him.
However, these zombies completely disregarded the Tao, forming a horrific zombie tide to surround him.
Behind this, there must be a highly intelligent mutated zombie leading everything.
There’s a high probability that it’s the puppet master behind the tentacle that appeared last in the simulator and pierced through him.
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, opened his eyes, and glanced at his group members who were staring at him with solemn and tense expressions. “How’s the situation? What will happen in the future?”
Seeing Wang Ping open his eyes, Cai Yonglong asked with a heavy face.
“Annihilation.’
Wang Ping was silent for a moment before uttering these two words.
In an instant, the pupils of everyone present constricted rapidly, their faces turned pale.
Although they had already guessed from Wang Pings previous reaction that the ending would not be too pleasant, they really didn’t expect to encounter the outcome of annihilation.
The first time they met face-to-face, the first Group Task, and they encountered a team wipeout, it really made people shudder and filled their hearts with fear.
“What happened?” Cai Yonglong sighed and asked..

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 60: Total Annihilation! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 60: Total Annihilation! _4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping fell silent for a moment, then turned to Wu Jun and Liu Mei. This made them instantly tense up.
Then, Wang Ping slowly began to speak, “We will proceed according to the plan. Since I won’t have access to my abilities in the future that I foresaw, we’re going to have to explore this world blindly. Wu Jun and Miss. Liu will stay here due to their limited fighting abilities while the rest of us, six in total, will go hunt mutated zombies in our mission to find the bizarre zombie.”
“However, we split into groups of three to hunt as we felt the method was too inefficient. At the end, the day passed uneventfully. By the time our two groups returned to this temporary stronghold, Wu Jun and Miss. Liu had already been infected and turned into zombies.”
Upon hearing Wang Pings statement, everyone’s pupils contracted in shock.
Among them, Wu Jun and Liu Mei turned deathly pale, their faces filled with terror.
Neither of them expected that they would die and be infected on the first day.
“Were we attacked by zombies?” Liu Mei asked bitterly.
“No.” Wang Ping replied calmly, recounting the analysis from the simulator.
Everyone fell silent.
It was bizarre.
Too bizarre.
“I’m done for, I’m going to die.” Wu Jun clutched his head, his face filled with fear, and he fell into a state of panic, “I, I’m still young, I don’t want to die. I still want to fall in love.’
“Shut up.” Zhang Hu glared at Wu Jun’s terrified expression and commanded harshly.
Zhang Hu t s roar startled Wu Jun. He recovered his senses, saw Zhang Hu’s fierce look, promptly closed his mouth, and silently lowered his head. Everyone else frowned slightly at the exchange.
Liu Mei quietly distanced herself from Zhang Hu and moved closer to Cai Yonglong, falling into silence as well.
“Zhang Hu, what’s your problem? Why are you shouting? Jun being terrified after hearing such news is normal.” Fang Yun coldly reprimanded.
Zhang Hu snapped back to reality, his expression returning to normal. He rubbed his neck, awkwardly apologizing, “Sorry, Jun, I guess I’m a bit on edge too.”
“No, it’s my fault.” Wu Jun muttered in response to Zhang Hu t s words, keeping his head bowed.
The atmosphere suddenly became tense.
Chen Yao glanced at Zhang Hu and Fang Yun, then at Zhang Jun who was quietly sharpening his knife. She finally rested her gaze on the composed Wang Ping, her expression still cold and composed.
However, she moved to sit on the couch next to Wang Ping, leaning slightly so their skin almost made contact.
“What happened next?” Cai Yonglong asked after regaining some semblance of calmness.
“Next, we took turns to keep watch. Two hours later, the five of you suddenly turned into zombies,” Wang Ping proclaimed, slowly, his gaze sweeping over everyone.
Upon hearing this, the faces of Wu Jun and Liu Mei turned even paler.
At the same time, Zhang Jun, Zhang Hu, Cai Yonglong, and Fang Yun also paled, their expressions turning rather ugly.
Even Chen Yao, who usually was cold and collected, turned pale.
After all, unlike Wu Jun and Liu Mei, they were powerful.
But they had still been abruptly turned into zombies.
It was unbelievable.
They couldn’t accept it.
They couldn’t comprehend it.
For a moment, the shadow of death hung heavily over everyone, an eerie presence that could not be dispelled.
This especially applied to Cai Yonglong, who had thought that his power would guarantee his survival. The news from Wang Ping shattered his composure, leaving him as troubled as if he had swallowed a bitter pill. “You survived?” Zhang Jun asked, fear still evident in his voice. “Why?”
At this, everyone turned to look at Wang Ping, anxious to hear his explanation.
“There are two reasons,” Wang Ping began.
“The first might be that my cultivation has reached the Spiritual Origin Realm
Great Perfection. The second could be that I possess a Poison Immunity
Physique. Although, I lean more towards the second explanation.”
As Wang Ping spoke, he slightly unleashed his aura, which was so immense that everyone had trouble catching their breath.
With that, the room fell silent again..

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 61: Strange!
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 61: Strange!
Translator: 549690339
Feeling the terrifying aura emitted by Wang Ping, the crowd reacted differently, some were horrified, some were astonished, and some were vacant.
“Wang Ping, your cultivation…” Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping in disbelief, his body trembling slightly.
Because only he and Wang Ping came from the same world, his feelings were the deepest, and he could roughly guess the level of Wang Pings cultivation.
It was the Spiritual Origin Realm, and not an ordinary one; it was at least the Spiritual Origin Realm Seventh Tier or above.
Because he had once seen an elder in his sect take action, and the aura displayed was not as solid and powerful as Wang Pings.
And that elder’s cultivation was the Spiritual Origin Realm Six-Tier.
In comparison to Cai Yonglongs shock, the others simply felt that Wang Ping was very powerful, extremely powerful, and powerful enough to make them tremble, but they didn’t know what level of cultivation he had attained.
“Spiritual Essence Realm Great Perfection.” Wang Ping calmly uttered these six words.
For a moment, Cai Yonglongs pupils contracted, and he gasped in shock.
The others also looked at each other in shock, unable to calm down.
After all, through chatting in the group, they had learned about the cultivation levels in the Profound World of Cai Yonglong and Wang Ping.
Body Refining, Post-Heaven, Innate, Spiritual Essence, Transcendent.
Spirit Essence Realm Great Perfection, which means it is just a step away from entering the Transcendent Realm. This is simply terrifying.
“Wang Ping, you’ve hidden really deep.” Cai Yonglong looked deeply at Wang Ping and spoke slowly.
“So have you, Mr.Cai. You’ve hidden a lot of things as well.” Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and spoke with a smile.
Seeing Wang Ping still willing to call him Mr.Cai, Cai Yonglongs mood was especially subtle, and he looked at Wang Ping with a complicated expression.
The other party clearly wasn’t like Blue Silver Grass, who became arrogant once they gained immense power, disregarding others.
“Haha, I really didn’t expect it, Mr.Wang, you are so strong.” Zhang Hu t s eyes showed a different color, and he approached with a bottle of drink, handed it to Wang Ping, and said with a smile, “This is a Magic Potion unique to our world. It can restore mental strength. You must have consumed a lot just now, maybe you can use it.”
“Hmm.” Wang Ping glanced at Zhang Hu e s forced smile and nodded his head, accepting the Magic Potion without saying much.
Although he didn’t have much goodwill towards Zhang Hu, the Magic Potion,
a product from the Sword and Magic World, was still worth taking and studying.
“Mr.Wang, we’re counting on you this time.” Zhang Jun also came over, his face full of respect, looking up to Wang Ping.
Fang Yun glanced at Wang Ping and then at the complicated-looking Cai
Yonglong, sighed, patted Cai Yonglongs shoulder, and said nothing more.
Wu Jun still kept his head down, remaining silent, seemingly in self-isolation.
Liu Mei opened her mouth but didn’t know what to say, all she could do was give a bitter smile.
None of them asked Wang Ping about his Golden Finger question.
Although they could guess that Wang Pings Golden Finger was not as simple as foreseeing the future, otherwise, he would not have become so strong in such a short period of time.
But now, Wang Ping was the strongest and the hope to complete the task, so they wouldn’t push their luck and risk offending Wang Ping.
Chen Yao’s eyes flickered as she stared at Wang Ping and asked, “Wang Ping, you said we were wiped out, so you died too?”
“Yeah.” Wang Ping admired Chen Yao for a moment and nodded.
Among the people present, only this girl’s character remained unchanged, Although she was in awe of his power, her attitude toward him remained unchanged, just like before,
“After you guys died, I left the city and hid in a rural area. However, on the 160th day, I was suddenly surrounded by a terrifying wave of zombies. The zombies in the wave were extremely terrifying, the Post-Heaven Realm fighters were like dogs, Innate Realm fighters were running everywhere, and even the Spiritual Origin Realm was not in the minority. Then, I was engulfed by the zombie wave and died from exhaustion.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Pings face turned serious, and he continued.
“Before I died, I saw a strange tentacle emerging from the ground, piercing my body. 1 suspect that was the target of our mission.”
Upon hearing this, everyone’s spirits perked up, even Wu Jun couldn’t help but raise his head to look at Wang Ping.
A foreseen future, although they had been annihilated, at least provided them with a clue, which was also a good thing.
It would be truly hopeless if everyone died for nothing and still had no clues at all.
“Wang Ping, based on your description, it is indeed possible that the existence behind this tentacle is our target, but it could also be a zombie wave controlled by some intelligent mutant.” Cai Yonglong spoke in a deep voice after calming down.
“Whether it is or not. we have to kill ite don’t we?” Fang Yun shook his head
and interjected.
“But, this thing appears on the 160th day, and by that time, it’s already able to control such a terrifying zombie wave. How do we deal with it?” Zhang Hu frowned, his face ugly. “Moreover, its power is definitely not weak.”
“Compared to this, I think we should focus more on how to solve the strange infection problem. After all, I don’t want Miss.Liu and Wu Jun to turn into zombies.’
Wang Ping glanced at Wu Jun and Liu Mei and spoke slowly.
Upon hearing this, everyone was stunned.
Wang Ping singled out Liu Mei and Wu Jun, without mentioning everyone else, obviously reminding them that he didn’t want to abandon Wu Jun and
Liu Mei, so they shouldn’t get any ideas..

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 61: Strange! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 61: Strange! 2
Translator: 549690339
This action made Zhang Hu resentful.
He knew that he had stirred up trouble with his earlier shouting, and Wang Ping was taking a swipe at him.
Meanwhile, Liu Mei and Wu Jun looked at Wang Ping with gratitude.
“I’ve never thought about abandoning my companions.” Cai Yonglong paused for a moment before continuing, “Instead of that, we should indeed think about how to crack the bizarre infection problem. Only then can Wang Ping continue to use his abilities. Otherwise, it would waste valuable attempts.”
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions became serious, and they fell deep in thought.
Wang Ping was also immersed in his thoughts, analyzing the simulation’s content and not wanting to miss a single detail.
“l have a question.”
At this moment, Chen Yao looked around at everyone and slowly spoke, her voice cold.
“What’s the question?” everyone asked.
“Why didn’t you get infected while hunting all day, but then got infected just two hours after you came back? Was it really because of the house?”
Chen Yao’s gaze was deep and penetrating as she slowly spoke.
“If there really was a problem with the house, Zhang Jun, whose temporary stronghold this is, should have been infected long ago.”
Upon hearing this, everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
That’s right; they had previously worried about the house being the issue, considering relocating their stronghold.
But now it seemed, it wasn’t necessarily the case.
“l have a guess.”
Wang Ping looked at Chen Yao and gave a faint smile.
“What a coincidence, I have a guess too.” Chen Yao locked eyes with Wang Ping, blinked, and showed an unusually playful smile. Her cold demeanor from before was replaced by a captivating charm.
“You go first?” Wang Ping gestured for her to speak.
“Alright.” Chen Yao nodded.
The conversation between the two caused the rest of the group to show expectant expressions, hoping to find a breakthrough.
“According to my analysis, the bizarre zombie’s controlling ability should work when an even number of humans gather for a relatively long time, infecting them.”
Chen Yao’s eyes flashed with wisdom as she slowly spoke.
“Zhang Jun was not infected when he was alone. You were not infected when you were in groups of three. But Miss. Liu and Wu Jun got infected because they were in a pair of two, which is an even number. And after you came back, the number of people in this room became an even number again, so you got infected two hours later.’
Upon hearing this, everyone, except for Wang Ping who looked at Chen Yao with an appreciative smile, showed either shocked or enlightened expressions. “Indeed, if we analyze it like this, it can explain the bizarre infection.”
“Besides, it can also explain why all the people in this world disappeared. No one can withstand Rules-based Abilities. Even if they managed to survive the initial infection, if they don’t think of this ability, something will go wrong, or they will be killed by the infected.”
“Rules-based abilities are really disgusting.”
Everyone was both excited and wary, filled with lingering fear.
Zombie Virus is horrifying enough, but with the added Rules-based Abilities, it becomes even more terrifying. Ordinary people can’t possibly survive.
“There’s one more thing.” Wang Ping hesitated for a moment before continuing, “The bizarre ability does not directly turn people into zombies.
Instead, when even-numbered humans gather, the virus silently enters their bodies and infects them. Otherwise, even with my Poison Immunity Physique,
I wouldn’t be able to withstand Rules-based Abilities.’
“That’s what I was thinking too.” Chen Yao blinked at Wang Ping.
“Now that we’ve figured out its ability, the next step is easy.” Fang Yun said excitedly, “We just need to split into groups.”
“But we have eight people, an even number, so it’s hard to split evenly.” Zhang Hu glanced at Liu Mei and Wu Jun and shrugged.
“I’ll stay here by myself then. I won’t be a burden to everyone.” Wu Jun spoke, sounding somewhat downcast.
“No need.” Wang Ping frowned slightly and replied.
“It’s fine. I’m a burden, can’t be of much help, and staying here would be less troublesome. It’s really not for any other reason.”
Wu Jun gave Wang Ping a grateful look and spoke again.
“Well, since Jun thinks so, let’s just go with it.” Zhang Hu chimed in quickly.
“Seven people are easier to handle.”
“It’s also easy to handle with groups of three and five.” Wang Ping gave Zhang Hu a cold look and calmly said.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Hu choked and forced out a bitter smile.
“l agree with Wang Ping’s idea.” Cai Yonglong chimed in.
Seeing this, the rest of the group also expressed their agreement.
“l just thought that it would be safer for those without combat capabilities to stay here. If we encounter a horde of zombies, it may be hard to look out for Jun during the fight. If he gets bitten, it’ll be troublesome. But since everyone agrees, then of course we’ll stick together.” Zhang Hu spoke with a wry smile.
“Speaking of this is still too early.” Wang Ping ignored Zhang Hu t s words and continued, “Next, we still have to continue to avoid danger and find a safe way to pass through. Otherwise, our lives are still uncertain.”
“Yes.” Chen Yao nodded, her face serious as she spoke, “And our odd-numbered theory is just a guess and may not be correct. Even if it is correct, there could still be something we’ve overlooked.”
Wang Ping nodded, then closed his eyes to convey that he was going to use his abilities again.
“Zhang Hu, Fang Yun, Zhang Jun, we’re still not sure about the current situation. To prevent accidents, you guys should go rest in other rooms for now, the farther apart the better. That way, it’s like two odd numbers..”

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 61: Strange!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 61: Strange!_3
Translator: 549690339
Seeing this, Cai Yonglong said seriously.
Although he wanted Zhang Hu to go out alone, doing so seemed to be driving Zhang Hu away, so he called the other two as well.
“No problem.” The three nodded without saying much and left the room directly.
At this moment, Wang Ping also spoke in his heart: “System, I want to start a new free simulation.’
“Ding, free simulation activated, the host has two free simulation chances left.”
With the sound of the system, familiar images and text reappeared in front of Wang Ping’s eyes.
[On the first day, you carried out group actions and experiments. In the end, after two hours, there were no accidents, and no one was infected. This news made you all very excited, thinking that your previous guess was correct.]
[On the second day, there were still no accidents, and you breathed a sigh of relief. Next, you began to analyze the possible locations of the bizarre zombies. Chen Yao thought that he might be hiding underground. Moreover, after you left the ground in your previous premonition, you were attacked on the 160th day, which might have been because the mastermind saw your departure path and followed you underground.]
[That is to say, the mastermind monster initially sensed your strength and did not take any rash actions. It only made a move after gathering enough combat power in order to swallow the flesh and blood of a powerful cultivator like you.]
[Therefore, you must not expose yourself to his eyes next. You must let others lure the snake out of hiding.]
[Chen Yao’s analysis makes some sense, and you think it’s necessary to experiment. Otherwise, the ongoing search would be like looking for a needle in a haystack. So, Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Fang Yun, Zhang Hu, and Zhang
Jun went out to hunt, trying to lure the enemy out.]
[On the third day, there was no success, and you remained calm.]
[On the eighteenth day, there was still no sign of success, and you gradually grew anxious. Because you know that the mutation rate of zombies is fast, and if this continues, you may not be able to defeat the zombies. Even at this point in time, mutated zombies with the strength of the Post-Heaven Realm began to increase, posing a significant threat to the three apart from Cai Yonglong and Chen Yao.]
[On the twentieth day, the atmosphere was even more oppressive, and everyone, including you, became increasingly anxious.]
[On the twenty-first day, Cai Yonglong couldn’t bear it anymore. He wanted you to join him in destroying the city without holding back your strength. You refused calmly, choosing to wait and see.]
[Seeing your refusal, Cai Yonglong left on his own and began to use his powerful Martial Arts to bombard the city. With his strength, it would only take a little more time to level the city. As for the issue of consumption, he could recover through Spiritual Stones.]
[The power displayed by Cai Yonglong shocked everyone, except you. The entire city seemed to have been hit by an earthquake.]
[However, due to the commotion caused by Cai Yonglong, the zombies in the city began to be attracted, forming a terrifying wave. Left with no choice, Cai Yonglong had to flee, not daring to stay in place.]
[During the process, he was attacked, and countless tentacles emerged from the ground, drowning Cai Yonglong. Despite his desperate struggle, it was useless. Cai Yonglong anxiously contacted you using a Message Talisman, stating that the mastermind monster had appeared and hoped that you would come and kill it.]
[Upon receiving the message, you directly used the Sword Riding Skill to come, and from the sky, you saw the scene. You rescued Cai Yonglong, then used the Sword Riding Skill technique to attack the monster, lifting the ground to form a terrifying abyss, injuring it.]
[The tentacle monster angrily counterattacked, but you easily severed it, continuing to injure it. At this, the tentacle monster became extremely angry and used its ability. Cai Yonglong was directly infected into a zombie, attacking you. You were terrified, killing Cai Yonglong. At the same time, you realized that this was your target.]
[Seeing how powerful you were, the bizarre zombie escaped from the ground immediately. Anxious, you used your Sword Spirit and launched your strongest attack, but you still failed to kill it. You only managed to severely injure it.]
[Ultimately, you failed to kill it and returned to the temporary stronghold with a heavy heart. When everyone learned of Cai Yonglongs death and that you failed to kill the bizarre monster, they were both frightened and delighted. They were frightened by the terror of the bizarre zombie, which could shorten the infection time even under even-numbered conditions, infecting Cai Yonglong; and delighted that they finally had some clues, making their emotions incredibly complicated.]
[After that, you began discussing tactics again, feeling heavy-hearted once more. You know very well that the bizarre zombie has amazing intelligence. It won’t reappear easily after being injured. Instead, it will develop in secret and then strike back. But at present, you have no good way to find it.]
[At this, you feel especially distressed. If only you had the Li Family’s Blood Devil Tracking Skill, you might be able to track its whereabouts through its blood. Although a bizarre zombie is not of the Spirit Clan, it is stronger than ordinary creatures, and its body is huge, with a lot of blood.]
[Unfortunately, there are no what-ifs. All you can do is discuss tactics. In the end, you still come up empty-handed. Chen Yao suggests that it’s not a good idea to hide. If you do, you’ll only repeat the same mistakes. You should take the initiative to attack and hunt zombies to become stronger..]

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 61: Strange! __4
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 61: Strange! __4
Translator: 549690339
[You highly approve of Chen Yao’s words and begin actively hunting, trying to increase everyone’s strength, waiting for the bizarre zombie to reappear.]
[On the thirty-first day, your physical strength has improved greatly due to the Crystal Stone. However, you also discover that although the Crystal Stone can increase physical strength, it does make the Cleanse Marrow body become dirty again, needing to meditate to expel impurities and cannot be taken for long-term use. Nonetheless, you have no choice but to use it under the current circumstances.]
[On the thirty-second day, at around 4AM, while in your sleep, everyone except you suddenly turns into a zombie and pounces towards you, causing you to be terrified, killing them all.]
[After dealing with everyone, you feel incredibly heavy and cannot understand why it has become like this. There were seven people, not an even number, yet everyone was infected.]
[In the end, unable to find an answer, you can only carry the heavy feeling in your heart, continuing to hunt zombies, trying to improve your strength even a little bit.]
[On the two-hundredth day, the bizarre zombie appears once again, leading a terrifying zombie horde, besieging you. You fight desperately, trying to break through the encirclement. Due to the astonishing degree of your enhanced physical strength, the zombie horde cannot stop your advance, and you almost successfully break through, wielding the sword to leave.]
[However, the bizarre zombie makes its move, unleashing a Terrifying Skill that kills you in mid-air.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, frowns deeply, and remains silent for a long time.
In this simulation, although it has been confirmed that the bizarre zombie does exist in the city, the end result is still complete annihilation.
“How did it go?”
Seeing Wang Pings heavy expression, Cai Yonglong and the others feel their hearts tighten.
“It’s not as bad as you guys think. Call Fang Yun and the others back,” Wang Ping breathes a sigh of relief and slowly speaks.
Seeing Wang Ping say this, Cai Yonglong and the others finally relax slightly.
Soon, Fang Yun and the other two are called back.
Wang Ping also explains the content of the simulation in detail.
“It’s another wipeout… But this time, we’ve gained a lot of information, which is something to be happy about.”
Fang Yun says with a complicated expression.
This Group Task is simply outrageous.
If it were not for Wang Ping, there wouldn’t be enough lives to fill the gaps.
“According to the information, we have the possibility of killing the bizarre zombie. We just need Mr. Cai to wreak havoc in the city and lure it out. In order to avoid the infection issue, Wang Ping can go with me or someone else to form an odd number. This way, the problem of infection can be avoided.” Chen Yao’s expression is serious and her voice cold.
“Although it’s risky, I can do it,” Cai Yonglong falls silent for a moment before speaking.
In the future witnessed by Wang Ping, he dies.
However, there’s no choice. Without luring the snake out of the hole, there’s no way to complete the task.
“But in the end, even the odd number was suddenly infected.”
Zhang Jun’s face looks terrible.
Although there’s hope for completing the Group Task, Zhang Jun still cannot be happy.
Even if the Group Task is completed, he has no way of leaving this world.
According to Wang Pings description, the zombies’ rapid rate of evolution is hair-raising, and with no living humans, his situation remains extremely dangerous.
Moreover, without living humans, they can only vent through the chat group; otherwise, they’ll surely go crazy.
Zhang Jun’s words leave everyone silent, their faces looking somewhat grim.
The odd number being infected is indeed strange.
“There must be a loophole somewhere,” Chen Yao murmurs. “Could it be that its abilities change? For example, odd numbers in January, even numbers in February.”
“Impossible,” Wang Ping shakes his head. “If that were the case, Zhang Jun would have been dead by now. After all, he’s been in this world for over a month.’
“That’s true…” Chen Yao furrows her brows, deep in thought.
Everyone’s faces are somewhat twisted, unable to figure it out while feeling panicked.
If they don’t understand this issue, even with the hope of killing the bizarre zombie, they will still feel uneasy.
“l have a guess…” At this moment, Wu Jun, who has been silent all this time, finally speaks up, his voice slightly timid.
The others turn to look at him in unison.
“Don’t be nervous. You can go ahead and say whatever you have in mind. Everyone can voice their own opinions.” Noticing Wu Jun’s nervous and timid demeanor, Wang Ping offers reassurance..

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 62: A Sword Slash
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 62: A Sword Slash
Translator: 549690339
“Is it possible that the abilities of this bizarre zombie change with the seasons, or maybe every six months?”
Wu Jun took a deep breath and said bravely.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up, thinking it made sense.
They had previously overlooked this time algorithm.
“Find something that can tell us the current time, then we can draw a conclusion.’
Wang Ping looked at everyone and said.
“No need to look, I have it.”
Zhang Jun quietly took out an exquisite electronic watch from his pocket, which displayed the current time.
“Did you pick this up in this world?” Fang Yun raised an eyebrow.
“Yes.” Zhang Jun nodded and said, “This world should be a parallel world of Earth, and the algorithm of time is the same. The current time is May 30. In thirty-two days, it’ll be July, the second half of the year.”
Everyone was shocked and looked at Wu Jun.
Undoubtedly, Wu Jun’s speculation was correct.
The abilities of the bizarre zombie probably changed every six months.
The first half of the year, even numbers.
The second half of the year, odd numbers.
This would explain why they were strangely infected as zombies.
Immediately, everyone felt their scalps tingling, as a chill ran from the soles of their feet up their spines.
This ability was too perverted; who could withstand it?
Even if people in this world survived the first round of infection and made it to the second half of the year, they would still be infected due to the change in the bizarre zombie’s abilities.
No wonder they couldn’t find any living people, giving them a heavy and lifeless atmosphere.
Perhaps only those lucky enough to be born immune to the Zombie Virus could survive in this world.
However, how many such lucky ones could there be?
Even if they were fortunate enough not to be infected, how long could they survive in this wasteland?
For a moment, Cai Yonglong and others looked at Zhang Jun with pity.
Poor Zhang Jun.
Even if they completed the System Task, Zhang Jun would not be able to leave this world.
Merely thinking of a person surviving in this world was enough to drive them crazy.
Moreover, the pace of zombie mutations was terrifying. If Zhang Jun didn’t become stronger at a faster rate, he might not live much longer.
Seeing everyone looking at him, Zhang Jun’s expression was ugly, and he remained silent.
“I’m going to use my ability again. You guys keep looking.”
Wang Ping glanced at everyone, didn’t say much, and began.
Everyone nodded, and then Zhang Jun, Zhang Hu, and Fang Yun left the room
together.
Meanwhile, Wang Ping spoke in his heart: “System, I want a free simulation.”
“Ding, a free simulation has started, with one remaining.”
After the familiar mechanical sound of the System, a pale blue luminescent screen appeared on Wang Pings retina, with text emerging.
[On the first day, you take action, believing that the earlier you draw out the bizarre zombie, the safer it is. The longer you drag it out, the stronger it becomes, and it’s easy for it to escape like in the last simulation.]
[Next, you take action. Cai Yonglong starts the destruction in the city directly. His actions successfully draw out the bizarre zombie, which begins to target him.]
[However, this time the bizarre zombie, although still powerful, is undoubtedly weaker than in the last simulation. Cai Yonglong faces a life-threatening situation but isn’t as embarrassed as before. Relying on the Secret Skill, he withstands the first round of attacks without being severely injured.]
[At this point, you also take action. This time, you directly carry Fang Yun on your sword, arriving at the battlefield. Bringing Fang Yun is to prevent the bizarre zombie from using its abilities to the fullest extent, shortening the activation time of its abilities and causing Cai Yonglong to be infected.]
[Upon your arrival, the bizarre zombie senses your danger and wants to escape. But after you arrive at the battlefield, you don’t waste any time, using your strongest attack to kill it instantly.]
[Your terrifying attack shocks Cai Yonglong and others, leaving them dumbfounded. Then, their hearts are filled with ecstasy because the bizarre zombie is dead, and they have successfully completed the task.]
[Afterward, you return to the temporary stronghold. Due to the completion of the task, you, Cai Yonglong, and others are teleported by the System and leave this world.] [Simulation End.]
“That was short.’
Looking at the content of this simulation, Wang Ping grumbled in his heart.
Then, Wang Ping showed a smile.
This time, it went very smoothly.
He had thought there would be some accidents, leading to a failed extermination.
He even prepared to use Paid Simulation to further enhance his strength.
Although it would be a waste not to practice cultivation in other worlds during the Paid Simulation, he had no choice but to do so in order to survive.
Fortunately, things didn’t go that far.
At this point, Cai Yonglong, Liu Mei, Wu Jun, and Chen Yao saw Wang Pings smile, and all showed excitement and relief.
They knew that this time, things must have gone very well.
“In this future, we successfully dealt with the bizarre zombie, completed the task, and each left this world.’
Wang Ping looked at the four of them with a smile and said:
This caused the faces of Cai Yonglong and others to show excitement, as they finally breathed a sigh of relief..

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 62: A Sword Slash 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 62: A Sword Slash 2
Translator: 549690339
As long as we can complete the task, it’s fine.
They’re really afraid of failure.
After all, there aren’t many chances left.
“I’ll go get them.”
After saying this, Cai Yonglong left and brought back Fang Yun and the other two.
Upon hearing the good news, the three of them were overjoyed, extremely excited, and relieved at the same time.
“This time, we were lucky to have you. Otherwise, we would have been wiped out here.’
Then, Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping with a grateful face and great fear.
This Group Task was too difficult.
Even with the ability to foresee the future and Wang Pings cultivation at the level of Spiritual Origin Realm Great Perfection, they still were wiped out twice, which was absurd.
“We’re lucky to have Mr.Wang around.” Wu Jun quickly spoke, looking at Wang Ping with admiration.
“From now on, I will always follow Mr.Wangs lead.” Zhang Hu also said with a big smile.
Chen Yao, Liu Mei, and the others also nodded in agreement.
“There’s no point in talking about this. Let’s complete the task as soon as possible and leave this world.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“After returning, we must all strive to become stronger. The first Group Task is already this dangerous; it’s hard to imagine how terrifying the future tasks will be.”
Wang Ping paused for a moment, then spoke with a serious expression.
At these words, everyone’s expressions became heavy once again.
Indeed, this was only the first Group Task, and it was already easy for them to be obliterated. It was hard to imagine how difficult future tasks would be.
Although joining the Transmigrator Chat Group had made them aware of the upcoming life-and-death crises, the fact that their first experience was so arduous made them feel even more desperate,
“Becoming stronger…” Liu Mei gave a bitter smile. As an ordinary ancient background character, she didn’t know how to become stronger.
Wu Jun clenched his fists with determination.
It seemed that he couldn’t live an easy life anymore; he must find a way to become stronger.
Although there was no extraordinary power in his current world, the technological level was far superior to Earth before he transmigrated.
Perhaps he could start from there.
If he couldn’t become stronger through cultivation, then he could rely on technology!
“Becoming stronger in a short time seems difficult. However, through Teacher’s channel, perhaps we can get some Forbidden Curse Scrolls.” Zhang Hu t s face changed uncertainly.
A Forbidden Curse is a taboo magic that only Grand Magisters can use.
And a Forbidden Curse Scroll is an item that seals the curse used by a Grand Magister, allowing others to use it freely.
The value of this kind of item is inestimable.
However, in order to survive, he had no choice but to ask for it shamelessly.
Chen Yao remained silent. Her world was dangerous, but it was also full of opportunities.
Her Golden Finger was very powerful. The reason she had only Innate Realm combat power during this task was that she hadn’t been in the Swordsman
World for too long, just over a month.
Given more time, her strength would definitely soar.
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping helplessly and laughed.
He had originally planned to wait until he reached Spiritual Origin Realm before seeking opportunities in a secret realm.
But now, he couldn’t procrastinate any longer.
The appearance of Group Tasks had given him a strong sense of crisis.
It was just a pity that he couldn’t join Wang Ping for Local Tasks. Otherwise, with Wang Pings abilities, they would definitely yield great results and face minimal danger.
By that time, even if he only took a small portion of the resources while Wang Ping took the majority, he could break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm.
Unfortunately, there were no ifs.
They weren’t even sure if they were in the same plane of existence.
Zhang Jun still had a Serious Face, not saying a single word.
Although Fang Yun’s expression hadn’t changed much and he still appeared jovial, there was cloudiness in his heart.
The Swordsman World made his strength too limited, and there was no way for him to rely on technology to become stronger.
Probably, in no time, he would be at the bottom of the group in terms of strength.
At most, he could only be slightly stronger than Wu Jun and Liu Mei.
Frankly speaking, the chances of the three of them dying in the future would be extremely high.
“Mr. Cai, let’s get started. You go out and cause havoc. When that bizarre zombie appears, I’ll go with Fang Yun to kill it.”
Disregarding everyone’s expressions, Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and signaled him to take action.
After all, if they could leave sooner, he wouldn’t want to stay in this world any longer.
“Alright.”
Cai Yonglong nodded his head.
“Why do you want me to come along?” Fang Yun was puzzled. “With my drunkard-like Innate Realm combat power, I won’t be much help.”
Everyone looked at Fang Yun with subtle expressions.
Realizing his blunder, Fang Yun felt embarrassed.
Alright, that was a foolish question.
How else would they make up the odd number to prevent Mr.Cai from being infected?
“You should use your brain more often instead of just thinking about women.” Cai Yonglong looked at Fang Yun with an exasperated expression, patted his shoulder, and then left the room.
At this, Fang Yun’s face twitched, and he couldn’t rebut. He could only mutter,
“What does this have to do with women?”
Standing nearby, Zhang Hu looked at Fang Yun, then Wang Ping. He wanted to say that if Fang Yun wasn’t willing, he could go instead.
That way, maybe he could contribute more during the task and receive more rewards later.
However, he didn’t dare to speak up.
After all, Wang Pings impression of him wasn’t very good due to his previous words. If he stepped forward to fight for benefits now, he would undoubtedly be even more despised.
Soon, Cai Yonglong started his operation a few kilometers away from their temporary stronghold..

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 62: Slaying with a Single Sword_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 62: Slaying with a Single Sword_3
Translator: 549690339
Enveloped in pitch-black True Qi, he treaded on air like a ghost, swinging his blade and slicing the earth beneath him.
With every slash, a strong Saber Intent erupted, creating blade lights that ripped through the earth, causing skyscrapers to collapse with uninterrupted thunderous crashes that made the whole city tremble.
Watching the terrifying power demonstrated by Cai Yonglong, almost everyone present showed a look of envy – everyone except Wang Ping.
This was what a cultivator in the Profound World was like, causing tremendous destruction with just a lift of their hand.
“Mr. Cai really has some incredible luck. His cultivation has reached the Half-step Spiritual Realm. He’s practicing the Earth Fiend Skill–it’s probably an Earth-tier Cultivation Skill. The martial arts he’s mastered are all Earth-tier as well. Coupled with his comprehension of Saber Intent, his strength should rival Bai Tianhong at the Half-step Spiritual Realm. He can fight against a Seven Tier Monster Beast. But, if the Monster Beast is not in a weakened state, I estimate that he would still lose in the end,” Wang Ping commented, looking at Cai Yonglong through the window. He was floating in the air and wildly his saber.
If it weren’t for the bizarre zombie’s tenacious vitality demonstrated in the simulation, Cai Yonglong probably wouldn’t last for more than a few seconds even with his Secret Skill.
After all, just half a month later, the bizarre zombie could survive his full-power strike without dying.
Even if it is a type specialized in defense and vitality, its own strength likely surpasses the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier.
Of course, the current bizarre zombie’s power certainly wasn’t this terrifying, but it still had the battle power of a Spiritual Origin Realm 4th-Tier.
But even so, if it were to exert its full force, killing Cai Yonglong would only take a few seconds.
Listening to Wang Pings words, everyone was left speechless.
Cai Yonglong was indeed quite strong.
But the most abnormal among them all was Wang Ping.
Just thinking about his cultivation at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection made their scalps tingle.
If Cai Yonglong could exhibit such a terrifying battle prowess, then if Wang Ping were to take action, he could likely easily destroy an entire small city.
“BOOM!
At this moment, the ground split open. A powerful and rotten aura surged from beneath the ground.
A bunch of tentacles emerged from the underground as well, reaching for Cai Yonglong in the sky.
This caused both joy and a great change in Cai Yonglongs expression.
After all, the speed of these tentacles was too fast, making it hard for him to dodge.
Even though he was already a cultivator of the Half-step Spiritual Realm and could fly for short periods, he couldn’t move as flexibly as a true Spiritual Realm Expert.
Without hesitation, Cai Yonglong used his Secret Skill, paying a hefty price to boost his strength and narrowly dodge the attack, avoiding a fatal encounter.
“Now it’s our turn.”
Watching this scene, Wang Ping immediately grabbed Fang Yun by the neck and burst through the wall of their temporary stronghold, becoming a streak of sword light. The sight left everyone dumbfounded.
In less than half a minute, Wang Ping crossed several thousand meters and appeared in the sky above the battlefield.
At this moment, Fang Yun’s entire body felt numb, and he felt like he was about to vomit.
Although he was a Transcendent Realm Master, the terrible speed almost didn’t give him any time to catch his breath, making him extremely uncomfortable.
Wang Ping didn’t even bother with Fang Yun. He just looked down at the battlefield below. A long sword suddenly appeared in his hand, emitting a dazzling radiance.
This was the long sword he had gotten as a gift at the welcoming party when he joined the sect. Although it wasn’t a Quasi-Spiritual Artifacts, it was sufficient for the use of an ordinary Spiritual Realm Expert.
At the same moment, Wang Pings formidable aura erupted. His boundless Spiritual Essence exploded like a tide, suppressing this area, causing a large number of ordinary zombies to burst open.
The aura exuded by powerful beings was fatal to the weak
Under Wang Pings aura, those beneath the Mortal Realm would instantly shatter. Even if one survived in the Post-Heaven Realm, they would still be grievously wounded.
Only the experts of the Transcendent Realm could stand, although they were still unable to move.
Even Cai Yonglong started to tremble violently, his face filled with horror as he felt the immense pressure.
Cai Yonglong gritted his teeth and released astonishing Saber Intent, resisting this terrifying aura, and finally began to feel better.
“So this is the pressure of the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection. It really is terrifying.”
Cai Yonglong gazed at Wang Ping in the sky, and while being shocked, he also longed for that power.
The Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, or the Spiritual Realm Tenth Tier Peak, is just a step away from the Transcendent Realm. It really is terrifying.
In front of a cultivator at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, even if several Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier or higher experts attacked together, they would easily be crushed and killed.
The gap of just one small realm was this vast. The Great Perfection represents a leap within a major realm, and was not the same as prior levels.
Even in his own home region, those at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection could be considered top-tier experts.
After all, Transcendent Realm Masters are so lofty they wouldn’t easily show themselves.
Therefore, those at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection could be described as invincible among the creatures of the world, holding the positions of leaders in the major sects, their status and strength both
unmatched.
“Even though I joined the group before him and have been struggling in this world for several years, I’ve been easily surpassed by Wang Ping and left far behind. Such a thought truly leaves me in complicated feelings,” Cai Yonglong thought bitterly as he swiftly moved up to Wang Pings side.
After all, if he stayed below, he would definitely be affected. Even getting swiped by the aftermath could prove fatal.
In comparison to Cai Yonglongs shock, the bizarre zombie was absolutely horrified.
It felt Wang Pings incomparable mighty force..

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 62: Slaying with a Single Sword_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 62: Slaying with a Single Sword_4
Translator: 549690339
Although its genes craved Wang Pings flesh and blood, telling it that if it swallowed Wang Ping, it would definitely evolve again.
But, deep down, it was more afraid of death.
The human in front of it could kill it.
It had only recently arrived in this world, instigating an apocalyptic catastrophe, yearning for the most perfect evolution, and unwilling to die just like that.
Immediately, after suppressing the trembling of its body and the fear in its heart, the bizarre zombie began to wriggle underground, intending to escape from here.
“Think you can escape?”
Wang Ping looked down at the earth, his eyes cold, swinging his long sword.
In an instant, an incredibly powerful Sword Spirit intertwined on Wang Pings sword edge, making the entire sky seem even sharper.
Regardless of whether it was Cai Yonglong or Fang Yun, they both felt their faces stinging from the wind, as if they had been cut by a sword hundreds or thousands of times, making their faces pale.
In particular, the Saber Intent on Cai Yonglongs long sword was directly suppressed, no longer as domineering as before, trembling as if in fear.
This made Cai Yonglong even more uncomfortable, as waves of shock rose in his heart.
He had thought that Wang Ping was just outstanding in his cultivation, but he never expected that in such a short time, not only had Wang Pings cultivation reached the terrifying Spiritual Origin Realm Great Perfection, but he had also comprehended Sword Spirit, and the level of his understanding was clearly above Cai Yonglongs Saber Intent.
Wang Ping didn’t care about what was going on in Cai Yonglongs mind, and the sword move he had been brewing broke out at this moment.
The all-encompassing sword light covered the sky, blocking out the sunlight. At this moment, even the sun was not as dazzling as this sword light. Following that, the all-encompassing sword light shattered the air and fell onto the earth.
Where the sword light reached, the earth cracked, forming a giant gully a thousand meters wide and tens of thousands of meters long, with all the skyscrapers along the way disappearing.
In the depths of the massive gully, the bizarre zombie only had time to let out a miserable scream before it was directly torn apart by the sword light, dying beyond recognition.
“Is it… over?”
Fang Yun, whose neck was being twisted by Wang Ping, was dazed as he looked down at the scene, his entire being rendered stupefied.
He had known that Wang Ping was strong, but the instantaneous destruction he had caused was truly terrifying, nearly making him lose his nerves.
Cai Yonglong was equally shocked, rendered speechless.
As for the five people at the temporary stronghold, they were all even more terrified.
Compared to everyone else’s astonishment, Wang Ping looked down at the long sword in his hand that had already developed countless cracks and was about to burst at any moment, shaking his head slightly.
His power now was too overwhelming, and even a sword made of precious metals, which could allow ordinary Spiritual Realm Experts to fight with their full strength, could not bear his power.
For sword cultivators, having a suitable sword was a must.
It seemed that he needed to find a Quasi-Spiritual Sword when he got back.
Of course, if he could get a Spirit Sword, that would be even better.
However, that was probably just wishful thinking.
After all, there are only two spirit artifacts at present.
One was the Sword Spirit Sect’s Green Spirit Sword.
The other was the Ice Condensation Mirror, which Empress Xia Yuan had brought out of some forbidden land after risking her life in the simulation. “Ding, the bizarre zombie is dead, the Group Task is completed, rewards have been distributed individually, and all group members can receive their respective rewards on the Group Reward Page. Please note that the quantity of task rewards is determined by the contribution of each group member during the Group Task.”
“Ding, the Group Task has been completed, and each group member can silently chant ‘return’ in their minds, thus returning to their original world. If they do not return within 24 hours, the system will forcibly return them to their original world.”
Hearing the voice ringing in his mind, Wang Pings eyes twinkled, and a smile appeared on his face.
Finally, the Group Task was successfully completed.
With that, he could be at ease.
At the same time, what pleased Wang Ping the most was that the Group Task rewards were based on individual contributions.
If it were divided equally, Wang Ping would be truly frustrated.
He put in the most effort, while others reaped the benefits and got the same rewards as him – it would be normal for anyone to feel unbalanced..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 63: Optimizing the Life Simulator!
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 63: Optimizing the Life Simulator!
Translator: 549690339
“The bizarre zombie is dead, let’s go back.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping glanced at the two, and then directly led Fang Yun toward the direction of the temporary stronghold.
Cai Yonglong nodded and followed closely behind Wang Ping.
When the two returned to the temporary stronghold, everyone’s faces showed delight.
“Mr. Wang, thank you so much this time,” Wu Jun was the first one to speak.
The others also quickly nodded their thanks.
“Now that the task is complete, do you want to stay in this world or leave directly?”
Wang Ping nodded and asked everyone.
“l want to go back. If I go back too late, I might be in danger.”
Liu Mei hurriedly spoke up.
The others looked at each other and also expressed their desire to return immediately.
In this desolate and dangerous Zombie World, they had no interest in staying any longer.
Soon, a series of lights appeared, and all the people except Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Wang Ping disappeared in succession.
“Mr. Wang, if it’s a world where we can meet in person, and if you have time, let’s go to the dungeons together. I can find quite a few secret realms.”
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping and said seriously.
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows.
Apparently, after seeing his strength, Cai Yonglong no longer dared to accept the title of “brother.’
But that was normal.
After all, in the Profound World, the strong were respected, and unless one had a good relationship to a certain extent or was a fearless world-class talent, the weak would instinctively hold the strong in awe.
However, Cai Yonglongs words gave Wang Ping some speculation about his golden finger.
Either, Cai Yonglong had information about those secret realms by chance.
Or, his golden finger was the type that could find such opportunities.
Of course, there were other possibilities, but Wang Ping didn’t want to delve deeper.
“If the opportunity arises, we can certainly do so.”
Wang Ping nodded his head.
“Alright.” Cai Yonglong smiled and nodded, disappearing in a flash of light.
“Zhang Jun, live on. When the time comes, we can make some deals. You help me hunt some high-quality Crystal Stones, and I can provide you with some good stuff in exchange.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Jun, patted him on the shoulder and spoke.
“l understand.” Zhang Jun nodded with a complicated expression, watching Wang Ping disappear in a flash of light.
In the Sword Spirit Sect’s secluded chamber, Wang Ping appeared abruptly.
“Although the time spent in the other worlds was short, it was quite thrilling. If I hadn’t simulated twice before the group task began and forcibly raised my cultivation to the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, I would have been in real danger this time.”
Wang Ping scanned the room and sighed to himself.
Initially, he had wanted to save up some Spiritual Stones and simulate later.
Before that, he would first explore a safe route to getting stronger through free simulations.
It seemed that he needed to simulate from time to time after all.
However, the exponential increase in Spiritual Stone consumption was unbearable.
“Forget it, let’s see what the group task rewards are.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, reined in his thoughts, brought out the chat group page, and collected the task rewards.
In an instant, the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, congratulations on your outstanding performance in this group task, with a contribution rate of 96%, earning you 100,000 Group Points.”
“Ding, congratulations on your outstanding performance in this group task, with a contribution rate exceeding 90%, granting you the acting group master position.”
“Ding, congratulations on becoming the acting group master, receiving a 90% discount coupon, which can be used when purchasing an item from the System Mall.”
“100,000 Group Points, acting group master position, a 90% discount coupon…”
Wang Ping was astonished, a smile spreading across his face.
These group task rewards were truly terrifying.
100,000 Group Points, no matter how you looked at it, were a lot.
In addition to the 90% discount coupon, it was equivalent to a million points of purchasing power.
This time, it really was like taking off.
Unfortunately, the System Mall didn’t open until there were fifteen members in the group.
If not, Wang Ping really wanted to go on a shopping spree.
Soon after, Wang Ping entered the chat room.
The chat group was bustling at this time.
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, my contribution is only 0.4%, and I got 400 points. It really makes my scalp tingle.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Stop complaining, I only got 0.1% and 100 points. But this group task, we all lay back and won, so it’s normal to have only a small reward.’
Wu Jun (20): “Sweat, mine is 0.2% ”
Liu Mei (15): “Mine is 0.1%…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Mine is 2%, earning me 2,000 points.”
Chen Yao (71): “0.2%… It seems that the reason for having a little more contribution points is due to the discussion.”
Zhang Jun (70): “0.1%… So according to this, Mr. Wang alone has 97%. But we were carried by Mr. Wang this time, and it’s normal for us to lay back and win, so this distribution is also normal.’
Zhang Hu (5): “By the way, did you guys notice that Mr. Wangs title has turned gold and says ‘acting group master’? And it seems like the System Mall has opened as well.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Huh, it really does look like that. It seems like this group task was also to filter out candidates for acting group master positions. Luckily, even though there’s an acting group master, my administrator position is still there,”
Wang Ping (66): “Huh, has the System Mall opened? It seems that the unlocking of system functions doesn’t necessarily require the group members to reach a certain standard, group tasks can also unlock them. Let me check it out..”

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 63: Optimizing the Life Simulator! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 63: Optimizing the Life Simulator! 2
Translator: 549690339
After Wang Ping dropped this message in the group, he found the System Mall page and opened it.
Then, Wang Ping saw the items in the System Mall.
There were only two items.
Rebirth Tally: After a group member dies, they can be resurrected using
Rebirth Tally.
Price: 100,000 Group Points.
ps: Unlimited purchases, but the purchase price increases progressively. Also, this item cannot be traded.
Golden Finger Optimizer: After purchasing, you can optimize your Golden
Finger to make it more powerful.
Price: 1,000,000 Group points.
ps: Limited to three purchases, and the price will increase progressively each time. Also, this item cannot be traded.
Wang Ping, looking at these two items, his eyes shone, and his face was full of joy.
The Rebirth Tally can bring people back to life, it’s too precious; this is just like a second chance at life, and he must always have one in hand for future use.
The second item made Wang Ping even more excited.
After all, although his simulator is powerful, it’s like a gold-consuming beast. With the increase in the number of simulations, no amount of Spiritual Stones would be enough to fill it.
Now, with the appearance of an item that can optimize the Golden Finger, the problem can be solved, and Wang Pings worries are undoubtedly relieved.
Immediately, Wang Ping used the 90% discount coupon without hesitation and bought the Golden Finger Optimizer.
In an instant, a golden light appeared on Wang Pings palm, and words floated above it: “Do you want to use the Golden Finger Optimizer to optimize your own system?”
“Use.
Wang Ping unhesitatingly said at the bottom of his heart.
As the words fell, the golden light disappeared, and two options appeared before Wang Ping.
“Ding, successful optimization of Golden Finger, host can choose one of the following schemes:
The consumption of Spiritual Stones will continue to increase exponentially, but the multiple will decrease.
The consumption of Spiritual Stones for simulations will increase with the improvement of your strength.”
“System, I choose 2.”
Wang Ping looked at the two options and unhesitatingly chose the second one.
Although the first one will reduce the multiple, as long as it doesn’t reduce that much, the Spiritual Stones consumed in time after time of simulation will still be massive.
And the second option, where the consumption of Spiritual Stones increases with the improvement of strength, leaves a lot of room for operation and is more cost-effective.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for a successful choice, Life Simulator optimization in progress, it will be optimized successfully in three days.” The mechanical voice sounded, making Wang Ping look forward to it.
“Three days later, huh? Since the Life Simulator can’t be used for the next three days, I should also go and deal with some matters in the meantime.”
Wang Ping murmured to himself, converging his aura, and left the retreat room.
As Wang Ping came out, the maids who served him all respectfully saluted him, not daring to slack off in the slightest.
Regarding this, Wang Ping nodded slightly towards them and disappeared into the air on his flying sword, heading towards the boundary beyond Sword Spirit Sect.
Upon sensing Wang Pings aura, the elders and Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect were all very surprised, not knowing what Wang Ping was up to. However, everyone has their own private affairs, so they couldn’t ask too much.
“Elder Wangs aura seems to have become much stronger. His cultivation is so deep now that I can’t even see through it.”
A Supreme Elder at the Spiritual realm six-tier exclaimed.
“Not just you, even I can’t see through it. Theoretically, only a cultivator at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection could have an undetectable cultivation level. However, it is impossible for Elder Wangs cultivation to skyrocket from 1st Tier Spirit Origin to Spirit Elemental Realm Great
Perfection in just one day.”
Bai Tianhongs master, the Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect, mused.
“Unless it’s unexpected, Elder Wang should have cultivated a Secret Skill to conceal his aura.’
“l think so too. Traveling in the Jianghu, concealing cultivation is indeed safer.’
The Spiritual realm six-tier Supreme Elder also agreed.
Deep in the Black Wind Forest, Wang Ping flew through the air, looking down and seeing a red, flame-like treasure medicine swaying in the pit below, and a smile appeared on his face.He had been flying deep into the Black Wind Forest for some time before he finally found it.
“Human, this is not a place for you to act recklessly, leave quickly!”
Just as Wang Ping was gazing at the Fire Spirit Flower, a huge monster tiger with fire-patterned markings on its body down below couldn’t take it any longer and roared at Wang Ping, releasing a powerful aura.
He could see that the human in front of him was incredibly powerful.
However, since the powerful human had set his sights on the Fire Spirit
Flower he was guarding, he would not back down and would do his best to kill him.
After all, the Fire Spirit Flower was too important to him. Once his cultivation improved a little further, he could consume the Fire Spirit Flower and reach the Great Perfection Tier of 8-Tier Demon Beasts.
Faced with the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s warning, Wang Pings expression was indifferent as he condensed a Spiritual Energy Longsword.
Although the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was powerful, Wang Ping needed the Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elders to come out in full force to suppress it in the Life Simulator. But to Wang Ping now, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger wasn’t much of a threat.
After all, his cultivation was at the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, and he had comprehended 20% of the Sword Spirit. In the current Profound Turtle Continent, if no transcendent realm being appeared, he would be invincible,
“Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, I will give you a chance, if you submit to me and become my mount, I can help you advance further in the future, and become a Transcendent Realm Monster,” Wang Ping said, pointing his sword at the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
Wang Ping wasn’t surprised that the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger could speak.
After all, a Seven-Tier Monster Beast that could speak human language was not rare, let alone an exceptional Eight-Tier Monster Beast like the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
“Human, you’re courting death!”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was furious, soaring into the sky, and gathering powerful flames in its mouth which it then shot straight at Wang Ping.
A mere human dared to tame him as a mount; it was truly seeking death.
“Haha, it seems that I’d have to subdue you first.”
Wang Ping chuckled lightly, releasing 20% of his Sword Spirit, and swung his sword violently. A massive Sword Spirit tore the flames apart, continuing to rush towards the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger without losing momentum.
This caused the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s pupils to contract, letting out a roar, and unleashing an incredibly powerful force of flames that covered its giant claw, aiming to smash the Sword Spirit.
However, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger couldn’t easily break the Sword
Spirit intertwined with 20% Sword Spirit. The moment the two collided, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was injured, and barely managed to block the
Sword Spirit with its nearly severed claw.
“Roar!”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger roared in fear.
The human in front of him was even more powerful than he had anticipated.
He was no match for him.
If the fight continued, he would undoubtedly die.
However, as a powerful Eight-Tier Demon Beast, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger would not submit to a human.
He roared once more and charged towards Wang Ping, attempting to use the powerful physical body of a monster beast in close combat.
“Sword Control Art. All Swords Return to the Sect.’
Wang Ping watched as the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger charged towards him, condensing thousands of Spiritual Energy Longswords in mid-air, which densely filled the sky and shot towards the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger. Faced with these overwhelming Spiritual Energy Longswords, the
Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s face was full of fear and could only let out a roar, covering its entire body in its monstrous aura, trying to block these attacks.
However, this move was clearly not something the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger could easily defend against.
Under the overwhelming Spiritual Energy Longswords, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was severely injured all over its body, blood spurting out, and its aura withered to the extreme.
“I’m giving you one more chance, submit to me, and I can help you achieve transcendence in the future,” Wang Ping said solemnly. “Or else, you will die.”
“l submit!” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, floating in midair, finally chose to submit.
Monster Beasts would only submit to humans who were far stronger than them.
And Wang Ping had clearly demonstrated his strength, subduing the beast in front of him.
Furthermore, the promise of the powerful human in front of him had truly moved him.
If he could become a Transcendent Realm Monster, then submitting to a human wouldn’t be a big deal.
Of course, if an elderly human at a high level said this, he would undoubtedly sneer and not believe a word of it.
However, the human master in front of him had a young appearance but possessed the cultivation of the Great Perfection of Spirit Elemental Realm. In the future, he might really have a great chance of becoming a Transcendent Realm Master.
That’s why he believed in the grand vision Wang Ping painted for him. “Monster beasts, they just need to be taught a lesson.”
Seeing the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger submit, Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
That was how monster beasts were; only when they were shown a far greater power and beaten into submission would they possibly submit.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to subdue them with just words..

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 64: Killing Two People!
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 64: Killing Two People!
Translator: 549690339
“Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, where’s your wife?”
After picking the Fire Spirit Flower, Wang Ping sat on the back of the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, patted its head, and asked curiously.
“What wife?”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger looked at Wang Ping with a puzzled face, not understanding why he would say such a thing. “Isn’t the Double-tailed Snake Tiger your wife?”
Wang Ping asked somewhat unexpectedly.
Could it be that at this point in time, the two haven’t gotten together yet?
Well, the timeline of the Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder beating the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger still has quite a few years to go.
“She’s just an ordinary Seven Tier Monster Beast, and not worthy of being with me!” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger snorted, its face full of disdain.
Who is he?
He is a monster beast with the bloodline of a transcendent monster beast in his body, far from being comparable to ordinary monster beasts. An ordinary Seven Tier Monster Beast is not worthy of his time.
“Uh…
Wang Ping was speechless.
It seems that either the two monsters will get together later on.
Or it could be that in the life simulation, the Double-tailed Snake Tiger is simply a loyal, bootlicking monster beast who came to help the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger despite the risk to herself.
“Never mind, it doesn’t matter which case it is, the things I need to do next won’t change.”
Wang Ping looked into the distance, feeling the aura of a Seven Tier Monster Beast rushing towards him, and couldn’t help but smile.
“It’s the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, what is she coming here for?”
Wang Ping could perceive the energy of the Seven Tier Monster Beast, and the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger could naturally perceive it as well. He asked with a frown.
“What else could it be? She’s coming to help you.”
Wang Ping said playfully.
“With her pathetic strength, she wants to help me? More like causing trouble.” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger said disdainfully.
“However, I’ve already been tamed by you, Master, so her presence doesn’t count as causing trouble. Master, are you going to make a move on her?”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger spoke again after a pause.
“l want to subdue her to guard a village.” Wang Ping nodded and said.
“Oh, being tamed by Master is her honor.”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger flattered.
“By the way, Master, how old are you?”
“Twenty-five. Why do you ask?” Wang Ping replied.
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s face went blank.
Well, he thought Wang Ping should be around sixty or seventy years old.
A sixty or seventy-year-old Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection is already terrifying, which is why he believed that Wang Ping had a great chance of achieving the Transcendent Realm.
But he never expected Wang Ping to be only twenty-five years old.
A twenty-five-year-old Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection is too frightening. It’s not just a matter of having a great chance of achieving the Transcendent Realm, but more like being guaranteed to achieve it.
Submitting to Wang Ping was indeed the right choice.
Hmm, as a monster beast, always hiding in the Black Wind Forest, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger obviously doesn’t know how desolate the World of Cultivators’ resources are nowadays, and even talented people can’t break through to the Transcendent Realm without resources.
Of course, it’s a different story if one walks down the Demon Path.
“Roar!”
At this moment, the Double-tailed Snake Tiger had also rushed over. When she saw Wang Ping riding on the wounded Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s head, she couldn’t help but show anger on her face, roaring at Wang Ping and even releasing a powerful demonic energy, wanting to attack Wang Ping.
“What are you roaring for? It’s my honor to submit to my Master. You silly female tiger, hurry up and apologize to my Master and then submit willingly.”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger glared at the Double-tailed Snake Tiger and scolded.
Upon hearing this, the Double-tailed Snake Tiger was confused, unable to believe that the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger had actually submitted to a human, and felt somewhat wronged.
She had come to help the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger and got scolded instead. She was so upset.
However, since she liked this monster beast, she could only swallow the feeling of being wronged, come to Wang Ping, and choose to submit.
Since the monster beast she liked had submitted, it wasn’t a big deal for her to submit as well, as long as she could be with the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
“This is really the life of a bootlicker.”
Wang Ping watched the changes in the Double-tailed Snake Tiger’s expression, his eyes somewhat amused.
It seemed that there were quite a few bootlickers among both humans and monster beasts.
“Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, since both of you are my tamed monster beasts, you need to get along better from now on. Also, Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, she’s a female tiger after all, don’t always roar at her, alright?”
Wang Ping said to the two monsters.
“…” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was full of black lines on his forehead, speaking discontentedly, “Why can’t I roar?”
Compared to the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s discontentment, the Double-tailed Snake Tiger was looking at Wang Ping gratefully.
She was initially unhappy with the human and submitted only for the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, but now it seems that submitting is a good thing.
After all, this Master was clearly speaking up for her and seemed to have the intention of matchmaking her with the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
“You really shouldn’t be so fiery-tempered. It’s a waste of your beautiful fur.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes at the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s straightforward character and couldn’t help but sigh.
These words left the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger even more speechless. What did this have to do with his fur?
Next. Wang Ping didn’t say much and led the two monsters to leave the depths
of the Black Wind Forest to Chi Village.
“Brother Wang, you’re back!”
When Wang Ping and the two monster beasts descended from the sky, the villagers of Chi Village were all shocked.
Although they couldn’t tell how strong the two monster beasts in front of them were, they could still tell that they were definitely Seven Tier Monster Beasts.
Wang Ping went out for a while and subdued two Seven Tier Monster Beasts, which really scared them..

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 64: Killing Two People! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 64: Killing Two People! 2
Translator: 549690339
“Hmm, I’m back.”
Wang Ping looked at the stunned crowd and nodded at Chifeng, then turned to the village head and others, smiling and said, “These two monster beasts are the ones I just tamed. One is a Double-tailed Snake Tiger, the other is a Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
