Their fighting power is equivalent to the 6th level in the Spirit Origin Realm and Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, respectively.”
Upon hearing these words, the crowd was even more stunned. They were somewhat dazed, unable to believe what they had just heard.
After all, before Wang Ping left the village, his cultivation was only at the 1st Tier of Spiritual Origin. After leaving for more than a month, he could tame a beast equivalent to the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection. This was too terrifying.
Doesn’t this mean that Wang Pings current cultivation is at least the Great Perfection of Spirit Elemental Realm, and it might not be as simple as the common Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection?
This rate of growth is outrageous.
For a moment, the village head and others could guess that Wang Pings constitution was definitely not as simple as the Spiritual Body.
However, no one would delve too deeply into it.
“Village Chief, I will leave the Double-tailed Snake Tiger in the village to protect you. After that, you can either use her to seek revenge on the Li family or continue to live in isolation as you wish,” Wang Ping said slowly to the village chief and others.
The Chi Clan would eventually disappear. This was the last thing he could do for them.
He could not prevent the Chi Clan’s disappearance, nor did he want to explore its origin.
After all, the power capable of wiping out the Chi clan and causing the current weird disappearances of the Chi clan was far too dangerous. Any carelessness could cost him his life.
The stronger he grew, the more he understood what those powers represented.
Therefore, having received many favors from Chi Village, using the Double-tailed Snake Tiger now to offer them revenge and protection was his way of settling their karma with no debts left on either side.
Upon hearing Wang Pings words, all the adults, including the village chief, were both shocked and overjoyed, and somewhat embarrassed.
After all, Wang Ping had done so much for them, they owed him a great deal.
However, they felt embarrassed but couldn’t bring themselves to refuse.
Because they had been waiting for this day for a very long time.
Facing the Li family, their sworn enemy, they thought they could only hide for the rest of their lives, unable to take revenge.
Unexpectedly, Wang Pings astonishing rise after his sudden appearance in Chi Village and his taming of the powerful Seven Tier Monster Beast gave them the ability to seek revenge.
“Child, thank you.”
“Only with revenge can the souls of some of our Chi clan rest in peace.” The village chief was moved to tears, unable to control his emotions.
Seeing the village chief and others in this state, Wang Ping sighed.
The past fifty years have indeed been hard for Chi Village, constantly thinking about revenge but being unable to.
Now with the ability to seek vengeance, their emotions were understandably wildly fluctuating.
Next, the village chief and others, who were overjoyed to the point of tears, dragged Wang Ping to chat and even had the women in the village prepare a sumptuous feast.
The next day, the eager village chief climbed onto the back of the
Double-tailed Snake Tiger and headed for White Moon City to seek revenge on the Li family.
Soon, news came out that a man riding a powerful 7th Tier monster beast landed at the Li family. committing genocide.
Even the Li Family Ancestor, who had a Spirit Realm Second Tier Cultivation, was helpless in front of the powerful 7th Tier monster beast.
What was even more shocking was that on this day, Sword Spirit Sect Sect master Zhang Yuan and his wife, the daughter of the Li Family ancestor, happened to be present at the Li Family. They intended to stop the enemy but unfortunately failed.
The Sword Spirit Sect master Zhang Yuan was also tragically affected, killed by the enraged 7th Tier monster beast. Even the old man controlling the 7th Tier monster beast couldn’t stop it.
For a time, the whole world was shocked and a storm was brewing. The Sword Spirit Sect was livid.
After all, the death of the Sect master was a huge disgrace to any power faction.
“Wang Ping, I’m sorry, I’ve caused big trouble for you.”
Upon returning to the village, the village chief told him what had happened, with a look of shame on his face.
The Double-tailed Snake Tiger was a monster beast tamed by Wang Ping. Now that it had been taken out by him and accidentally killed the Sword Spirit Sect Sect master, it was undoubtedly a big mess.
If anything happened to the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, that would mean bringing a big trouble to Wang Ping.
“Zhang Yuan is dead?”
Wang Ping looked oddly at him.
He was thinking about how to handle Zhang Yuan, a man with sinister schemes and allied with Exotic Races, but he didn’t expect Zhang Yuan to die just like that.
“It’s my fault.” The village chief said with a shamefaced expression, took a deep breath and added: “l will disembowel myself in front of the Sword Spirit
Sect’s gate to try not to involve you.”
“Master, I’m sorry. That guy threatened me and even sneak attacked me, injuring me and nearly killing the village chief. That’s why I lost my temper and fought back.”
The Double-tailed Snake Tiger also said with trepidation, knowing that it had made a big mistake.
“There’s no need.’
Wang Ping shook his head.
“If Zhang Yuan is dead, let him be dead.”
“Next, you guys can just reside in the Fire-patterned demon tiger’s territory with the Double-tailed Snake Tiger. I believe, even the Sword Spirit Sect wouldn’t dare to break into the Fire-patterned demon tiger’s territory.” Wang Ping paused, then continued speaking.
“Master, aren’t you taking me out of the Black Wind Forest?”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger asked after deciphering Wang Pings meaning.
“Taking you out is of no use.” Wang Ping nodded and said, “So, just continue to stay in your old lair.”
“…Then why did you tame me?” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger looked disturbed.
“l don’t like to kill innocents.” Wang Ping said very seriously.
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger looked skeptical, not quite believing him. “Actually, I just wanted to give it a try.” Ping smiled and said, without further explanation..

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 64: Killing Two People! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 64: Killing Two People! _3
Translator: 549690339
He had read many fantasy novels and naturally wanted to experience the feeling of taming a monster beast as a mount.
After all, the strong often had many impressive mounts.
For example, the gods and Buddhas in Journey to the West each had a powerful demon as their mount.
Originally, Wang Ping just wanted to try it out and see if drawing cakes for the monster beasts would work. He didn’t expect it to be effective, and it turned out to be a pleasant surprise.
“Try it…” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s face twitched.
It turned out that you were not sincere in wanting to tame me as a mount; it was just out of curiosity.
For a moment, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger even began to doubt Wang Pings promise.
Well, it was only because the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger didn’t know the concept of drawing cakes. If it did, it might have been cursing and swearing by now.
Afterwards, the Chi Clan migrated to the cave where the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger lived.
As for Wang Ping, he left Chi Village and returned to the Sword Spirit Sect.
When Wang Ping returned to the Sword Spirit Sect, he felt that the atmosphere was very oppressive. Both the elders and disciples were extremely angry.
“Elder Wang, please come to the Sect Master Hall immediately.”
Seeing Wang Ping return, a Supreme Elder sent a message.
At this, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he quickly headed for the Sect Master Hall.
At this moment, in the Sect Master Hall, all the Supreme Elders were gathered, their faces gloomy.
“Elder Wang, Sect Master Zhang has been killed. Someone saw that Double-tailed Snake Tiger entering the Black Wind Forest. We are discussing whether to mobilize the entire sect to attack the Black Wind Forest, find the Double-tailed Snake Tiger and the old man, and kill them. What is your opinion?”
After Wang Ping entered, the Supreme Elder asked with a serious face.
Although the person who died this time was not from their faction, Zhang Yuan was still the Sword Spirit Sect master and the face of the Sword Spirit Sect. They could not turn a blind eye to this matter.
Internal conflicts were one thing, but when external enemies appeared, they needed to present a united front.
That was why the Sword Spirit Sect had called back all the Supreme Elders to discuss countermeasures.
“l heard that it was an old man controlling the Double-tailed Snake Tiger who attacked the Li Family. So, have we found out the identity of that old man?”
Wang Ping asked with an unchanged expression.
This remark startled all the Supreme Elders present.
One of the Supreme Elders said solemnly, “That old man should be a former elder of the Chi family.”
“The Chi family…” Wang Ping pretended to ponder and said, “l heard that the Chi family and the Li Family were once the two major families of White Cloud
City. However, after the Li Family Ancestor broke through to the Spiritual Realm, he wiped out the Chi family. Could it be that the Chi family is seeking revenge now?”
“Indeed.’
One Supreme Elder nodded.
“If he wiped out the Li Family, we wouldn’t care. But, he killed the master of our Sword Spirit Sect, and that is something we cannot tolerate.”
The Second Supreme Elder said with a gloomy face,
“But, I heard that it was the sect master who made the first move, nearly killing the old man and preventing him from taking his revenge. Our Sword Spirit Sect’s stance is neutral. According to the sect rules, we are not allowed to interfere in other power’s disputes. The sect master has violated the sect rules.’
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Elder Wang, what do you mean? Are you speaking for the Chi family?”
The Second Supreme Elder scolded.
“I’m just telling the truth.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
“Elder Wang, are you saying that you don’t agree Mith the idea of mobilizing the entire sect to attack the Black Wind Forest?”
Supreme Elder’s eyes flickered as he asked.
“Leaving aside the question of right and wrong, even just mobilizing the entire sect to attack the Black Wind Forest is not a wise move. After all, there are many powerful monsters in the Black Wind Forest. If we attack the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, it might provoke the anger of higher-ranked monsters. At that time, the Sword Spirit Sect may suffer heavy casualties.
Moreover, the Sword Spirit Sect’s position in the Xia may become unstable. Not to mention, sending too many experts deep into the Black Wind Forest may trigger a Beast Tide, affecting millions of people.” Wang Ping looked around at everyone and spoke slowly.
“Wang Ping has a point.”
Supreme Elder nodded his head.
As for the Sword Spirit Sect, including the newly-joined Wang Ping, there were only twelve Spiritual Realm Experts.
With Zhang Yuan dead, there were only eleven left.
One of them, a 4th Tier Alchemist, wasn’t even in the sect most of the time and his current condition was unknown.
If they attacked the Black Wind Forest and lost a few more Spiritual Realm Experts, the sect would be greatly weakened.
Black Wind Forest was not a place where human experts could run wild.
As a monster forest that stretched across three countries, the deepest parts of the Black Wind Forest had more than one Monster Beast with a Great Perfection Spiritual Realm combat power.
In addition to other powerful 7th Tier monsters and 8-tier Demon Beasts, venturing deep into the Black Wind Forest was too dangerous.
Although with his Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier cultivation, he could use the
Green Spirit Sword to rival experts even in the Great Perfection Spiritual
Realm, and even kill them, this would only apply in one-on-one situations. If he provoked other terrifying beasts, it would be equally dangerous.
Not to mention that all the forces were now watching. If they were to deploy their entire force, even bringing along spiritual tools, some forces might harbor ill intentions.
By then, the Sword Spirit Sect would be in danger.
Of course, all of this was predicated on the Double-tailed Snake Tiger hiding deep within the Black Wind Forest.
If it was in a shallow area, they could still go. “Supreme Elder, do you mean we’ll just let it go?”
The Second Supreme Elder’s face was full of rage.
“If we just let it go after the Sect Master of Sword Spirit Sect is killed, how will the world view our Sword Spirit Sect? I’m afraid any random cat or dog will be able to step on our heads!”

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 64 Kill Two People! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 64 Kill Two People! _4
Translator: 549690339
After the Second Supreme Elder spoke, four other Supreme Elders echoed him.
Three of them were from the faction of the Second Supreme Elder.
“I will go into Black Wind Forest and kill some seven-tier monster beasts. I may not necessarily kill the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, but I need to make this gesture. ”
The Supreme Elder glanced at the Second Supreme Elder and others and spoke calmly.
“True revenge will come when our strength is enough.”
“After all, this time it is Zhang Yuan who violated the sect rules, making it difficult for us to proceed or retreat. Over the years, your faction has been in close contact with the outer world, which somewhat challenges the neutral position of Sword Spirit Sect. Remember, I don’t want to see these things happening again, otherwise, I won’t mind cleaning up the inside first.”
After a pause, the Supreme Elder glanced at the Second Supreme Elder and others, his face cold.
The reason Sword Spirit Sect was once superior, with a transcendent status and numerous experts, recognized as a thousand-year-old sect, was not only due to its deep roots, but also its neutral stance.
But the present Sword Spirit Sect has become somewhat decayed. The faction of the Second Supreme Elder is now skilled in internal strife and factional disputes, even deeply involved with external forces, making the atmosphere of the whole Sword Spirit Sect somewhat off.
Therefore, Sword Spirit Sect fell into a predicament where it only had around ten Spiritual Realm Experts.
If it was two hundred years ago, Sword Spirit Sect would not be so desolate.
At that time, the Sword Spirit Sect, although not as prosperous as before, still had more than twenty Spiritual Realm Experts.
“You!” Seeing the warning of the Supreme Elder, the Second Supreme Elder was enraged, but when he felt the stronger aura of the Supreme Elder, he could only snort coldly, flick his sleeves and leave: “Since you are not willing to go deep into Black Wind Forest for revenge, then I will go on my own.”
Seeing the departure of the Second Supreme Elder, the other three Supreme Elders of his faction left the main hall with gloomy faces following him.
“Sigh.” Watching the four leaving, the Supreme Elder sighed deeply.
In the past, he had never suppressed the faction of the Second Supreme Elder. After all, there are too few Spiritual Realm Experts in the Sword Spirit Sect today.
The faction of the Second Supreme Elder has five Spiritual Realm Masters. If they were suppressed, the entire Sword Spirit Sect would be in chaos, fearing an imminent destruction.
But now it seems like the time has come to deal with internal matters.
Otherwise, even if nothing goes wrong while he is alive, it’s uncertain what will happen after his death.
His disciple, Bai Tianhong, has amazing talent, but is too focused on practicing swordsmanship and has no spare thought, not suitable for leading Sword Spirit Sect.
“Elder Wang, do you think I did the right thing?”
The Supreme Elder spoke to Wang Ping with a melancholic expression on his face.
“Very right.” Wang Ping nodded.
The actions of the Supreme Elder align with his interests.
Outside, there a_re indeed some problems inside Sword Spirit Sect.
From his past life experiences, he knows that the faction of the Second Supreme Elder is deeply involved with the outside world.
Of course, with the exception of Zhang Yuan, the Second Supreme Elder and others are not bad.
At least, when the Exotic Races invaded, they also fought hard to protect the citizens of Shu.
But if this continues, more people like Zhang Yuan, who occupy high positions and are selfish, will appear, and the Sword Spirit Sect will eventually have problems.
Quickly, two days passed.
During these two days, the whole Xia was shaken again.
Both the Second Supreme Elder and Supreme Elder of Sword Spirit Sect appeared one after the other in the depths of Black Wind Forest, looking for traces of the Double-tailed Snake Tiger, triggering a massive killing in Black Wind Forest.
In the end, they lured out several powerful 8-tier Monster Beasts, and then exited the Black Wind Forest and returned to Sword Spirit Sect are.
For a while, many people were discussing whether the Double-tailed Snake Tiger had been killed.
Some believed that the Double-tailed Snake Tiger had died, while others believed it hadn’t, there was a variety of opinions, and it was impossible to make a definitive conclusion.
For a time, the matter of the death of the Sword Spirit Sect Master gradually calmed down.
Many forces retracted their devious thoughts after witnessing the firm stance of Sword Spirit Sect..

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 65: Simulation Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 65: Simulation Again
Translator: 549690339
In the Sword Spirit Sect, within the towers, Wang Ping looked at the optimized Life Simulator with a faint smile.
The optimized Life Simulator set the cost for each paid simulation based on his current cultivation level.
His current cultivation was at the Spiritual Origin Realm Great Perfection, and each simulation required 2,000 low-tier spirit stones.
Although the price was higher than before the optimization, if he had used the original Life Simulator twice and then optimized it, it would undoubtedly be more cost-effective and save some spirit stones.
However, Wang Ping didn’t know the price would be 2,000 low-tier spirit stones before optimization, and he wasn’t short of spirit stones at the moment.
So, there was nothing to regret.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and then spoke.
Although he could use the free simulation to scout first, after the experience of group tasks, he still felt that it was better to save up some free simulations.
After all, going to other worlds and using paid simulations was a waste of spirit stones.
Especially since some worlds had no spirit stones, going there to simulate won’t help increase his strength. Using free simulations to scout is the most suitable method and the most cost-effective approach.
Of course, when he has accumulated enough free simulations, he will use them to scout as well.
In any case, he would save spirit stones however he could.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping spoke in his mind.
“Ding, this simulation requires 2,000 low-tier spirit stones. Do you want to proceed?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Proceed.” Wang Ping nodded.
“Payment successful, Life Simulator starting. Refreshing talent.”
The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, talent refresh successful. Congratulations, host, for successfully refreshing the White Talent.Martial Arts Genius.” “Again, White Talent.Martial Arts Genius…”
Wang Ping was speechless.
He felt that the high-level talent refresh rate of the Life Simulator was indeed too low, and he hadn’t refreshed any green-grade or higher talents up until now.
Did he really need to optimize it once more to increase the refresh rate of high-grade talents?
Otherwise, like his previous life playing card games, he could only rely on stacking more cards due to bad luck and eating the guaranteed reward.
“Ding, talent selection successful. Life simulation begins.”
While Wang Ping was complaining in his mind, the luminescent screen of the Life Simulator appeared in front of him, and the words began to emerge. [Daya calendar, year 480, April 23rd, you began to comprehend swordsmanship, aiming to grasp 30% of Sword Spirit.]
[End of Daya calendar, year 495, you successfully comprehended 30% of Sword Spirit, and the world was in turmoil. You came to Xia, refined the Yang
Recovery Elixir, and sought a trade with Empress Xia Yuan to enter the Xia Forbidden Land.]
[Regarding your trade request, Empress Xia Yuan was hesitant, but she eventually agreed in order to save the Ancestor’s life and for the sake of Xia’s stability. However, she warned you that the Forbidden Land was extremely dangerous, and even those in the Spiritual Origin Realm might not survive.]
[You were quite calm and didn’t take it to heart. After all, since Xia Yuan could survive, the chances of you dying were very low.]
[You entered the Xia Royal Family’s hidden forbidden land and accepted the challenge. In the end, you easily passed the test and received a reward – a Spirit Sword. You were very surprised, as the spiritual tool you obtained was different from the one in your memory. Obviously, there was more than one spiritual tool hidden in this forbidden land.]
[Although you wanted to uncover the secrets of the forbidden land, you also knew that it was set up by a powerful being in the Transcendent Realm. With your current strength, if you forced your way in, you would surely die.]
[In the end, you left the Imperial Capital with the Spirit Sword, leaving the Xia Royal Family with mixed feelings. They obviously didn’t expect you to easily pass the test and obtain a spiritual tool. After all, a Spirit Sword was a treasure in the Sword Spirit Sect, and the Xia Royal Family didn’t even have one.]
[Next, due to the fact that the Xia Ancestor didn’t pass away, Empress Xia Yuan continued to reform and suppress all sides, and the Xia Territory began to stabilize.]
[In the year 510 of the Daya calendar, you wanted to comprehend 40% of
Sword Spirit and reach the Minor Achievement level but still failed, stuck at 30% peak, which was a great regret. At the same time, Bai Tianhongs cultivation surpassed you and reached the Spiritual Origin Realm Great
Perfection.]
[In the same year, chaos emerged in the Jianghu, and Demonic Cultivators appeared. You knew what was going to happen next.]
[In the year 511 of the Daya calendar, you brought Bai Tianhong down the mountain and lay in wait around the Wu family.]
[Not long after, the Wu family was annihilated, and you both took action.
Under your joint attack, the Demonic Cultivator was killed. You also found the
Demonic Skill he practiced from his body.]
[In order to prevent it from further harming the mortal world, Bai Tianhong wanted to turn it into ashes, but you stopped him, saying you might be able to find the secret method to expanding the Dantian from it and provide hope for a breakthrough to the Transcendent Realm.]
[Bai Tianhong found your idea very reasonable. Thus, you decided to take the Demonic Skill back to the sect for research.]
[In the end, you found the secret method to expand the Dantian from the
Demonic Skill. However, the method was extremely bloody and despised by
Bai Tianhong. Therefore, he still chose to burn it.]
[You didn’t say much, just suggested that you could improve upon the secret method.]
[At the end of the year 530 of the Daya calendar, you and Bai Tianhong had been researching and discussing the secret method to expand the Dantian based on the Demonic Skill, and finally succeeded in creating a secret method for expanding the Dantian..]

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 65: Simulation Again_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 65: Simulation Again_2
Translator: 549690339
[In the year 540 of the Daya calendar, you and Bai Tianhong both breakthrough to the half-step Transcendent Realm, which is also the Half-step Spiritual Sea Realm. However, due to the lack of high-quality spiritual stones to supply spiritual essence, you are stuck at this stage, and your Elixir Field cannot be maximized. The spiritual essence within your body cannot be liquefied, and then turned into a liquid spiritual essence ocean.] [Regarding this, both of you a_re quite helpless.]
[In the year 545 of Daya calendar, both the Supreme Elder and Second Supreme Elder passed away. Bai Tianhong, after silent contemplation, wishes to go overseas to seek opportunities to break through to the Spirit Sea Realm. However, you know the consequences of going to the sea, and persuading Bai
Tianhong not to set off, as his death would undoubtedly follow.]
[Nevertheless, Bai Tianhong has a tenacious heart for seeking the Dao, believing that cultivators should strive against heaven and not fear death. In the end, he chose to go to sea alone.]
[At this, you feel regretful, believing that Bai Tianhongs decision would undoubtedly lead to his death.]
[In the year 580 of Daya calendar, you successfully comprehend 40% Sword Spirit, reaching the state of Small Success in Sword Spirit. You are delighted by this achievement. In the same year, you finally take on two disciples and devote yourself to teaching their cultivation. The entire Sword Spirit Sect is
overjoyed. With your help, the Sword Spirit Sect has grown stronger. Although some Supreme Elders have passed away over the years, the number of Spiritual Realm Experts has increased rather than decreased, reaching 25.]
[Moreover, with you, an undefeated expert, guarding the sect, no one dares to invade the Sword Spirit Sect. They believe that Sword Spirit Sect will increasingly prosper and perhaps reach its peak a thousand years ago.]
[In the year 620 of Daya calendar, in the past century, the top family of the rising Xia Dynasty, the Lin family, produced an unparalleled genius, Lin Yifei, who rose astonishingly. However, he wants to overthrow Xia and change the dynasty. You focus on the Sword Spirit Sect and don’t pay attention to him, nor do you want to participate in the struggle between major forces.]
[Nevertheless, the Xia Empress Xia Yuan is furious and wants to uproot the Lin family. Unexpectedly, the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier Expert dispatched by the Xia Royal Family is killed by Lin Yifei with a single move, showing his invincible power.]
[In an instant, the entire Xia Dynasty is shaken. Xia Empress Xia Yuan becomes even angrier. Already at the Complete Spiritual Realm Cultivation level, she wields a spiritual tool and personally takes action, intending to suppress Lin Yifei. In the battle, Lin Yifei displays astonishing cultivation, reaching the Complete Spiritual Realm, shocking many experts.]
[However, because Xia Empress Xia Yuan holds a spiritual tool, Lin Yifei is killed by her, and the Lin family is utterly destroyed. The world returns to peace, and no one dares to challenge the Xia Royal Family again.]
“This Lin Yifei is really courting death.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content and can’t help but sigh.
He is talented and powerful, but his temperament is completely different from him and Bai Tianhong. He is too wild, completely unaware of the truth that there are always people and heavens beyond oneself in this world.
[In the year 655 of Daya calendar, your age has reached 200 years, no longer young. Moreover, during these years, Chu State and Zhao State successively experienced great chaos, and their old ancestors who had suppressed the Spiritual Elemental Realm Great Perfection Cultivation had already fallen, with no new Spiritual Elemental Realm Great Perfection appearing.]
[Perhaps because she is also no longer young and gradually entering old age, Empress Xia Yuan wants to do something bigger and leave her name in history. She chooses to mobilize troops and invades Chu State, intending to annex Chu State and then annex Zhao State.]
[The actions of Xia Dynasty shock the two countries, and they are panicked. They choose to join forces to deal with the powerful Xia Dynasty. However, under Empress Xia Yuan’s management, Xia Dynasty is already incomparable to the past and cannot be opposed by the two countries. Even if the forces of two countries join hands, it is difficult to resist.]
[In the year 656 of Daya calendar, Xia Dynasty successfully annexes the two countries, completing the unification of Central Earth after many years. However, Empress Xia Yuan’s ambitions are far from over, and she wants to be an Eternity Emperor.]
[In the year 660 of Daya calendar, after fully digesting the resources of the two countries, Xia Dynasty sends troops to the Exotic Races, intending to eliminate and kill the Exotic Races that often harass the border, forever eradicating future trouble and completing the great unification of the entire
Profound Turtle Continent.]
[In the following two years, major battles break out between the Xia Dynasty and the Exotic Races. With continuous victories, the morale of the Xia Dynasty’s soldiers soars, and Empress Xia Yuan’s prestige reaches its peak, being hailed as an Eternity Emperor.]
[However, unexpected changes occur. As the Xia Dynasty counterattacks the Exotic Races’ territory, driving them to extinction and conquering more than two-thirds of the area, they finally provoke a powerful individual from the Exotic Races who has been in seclusion for many years.][He wielded a spiritual tool ancient staff, and with his own strength, killed the Xia army, causing chaos among them. Even the Great General of the Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier was killed by a single strike of his staff.]
[The news reached Xia, and a great shock swept through the empire. Empress Xia Yuan was also surprised. She knew very well that such a person could not be dealt with by an ordinary Spiritual Realm cultivator. Therefore, she once again personally led her forces to battle, wielding her spiritual tool, the Ice Condensation Mirror, fighting against the exotic race’s expert, wanting to kill him.]
[However, Empress Xia Yuan underestimated the enemy’s strength, and in the battle between them, neither could prevail over the other. Even to the point that during the final moments of the fight, the elderly opponent chose to perish together with Empress Xia Yuan.]
[Thus, Empress Xia Yuan perished, shaking the entire empire and causing a tremendous uproar. No one had expected such an outcome.]
[You heard the news, but there was no great emotional upheaval. After all, in this life, you were not close to Empress Xia Yuan. Now, you have a deep love for the Sword Spirit Sect and don’t care about worldly power struggles. You only wish to protect the Sword Spirit Sect and maintain its unique status.]
[Due to the fall of Empress Xia Yuan, Xia no longer dared to attack the Exotic Races wantonly and began to choose a more defensive stance. Moreover, because of Empress Xia Yuan’s fall, internal issues reemerged within Xia. Some young princes and princesses began to rally their supporters, greatly expanding their power and preparing for the struggle for the throne. The surviving royal families of Chu and Zhao States also began to plan their revivals.]
[At the end of Daya Calendar 660, the 5th Prince of Xia, with a ruthless heart, killed all five princes and princesses who could threaten his claim to the throne, and successfully ascended to the throne, proclaiming himself as Emperor Wen of Xia.]
[However, due to the improper way Emperor Wen of Xia ascended to the throne, he disregarded the interest of the royal family to solidify his position, instead choosing to win the support of many civil and military officials.]
[In Daya Calendar 700, you successfully perceived 50% of Sword Spirit.
However, your cultivation was still stuck at the half-step Transcendent
Realm. You understood that if you continued to stay on Profound Turtle Continent without practicing Demonic Skills, you would probably never reach the Transcendent Realm in this lifetime.]
[The same year, a genius cultivator appeared in Xia with Perfect Level of Spiritual Realm cultivation. He challenged you, but was easily defeated with you using a finger as a sword. He willingly admitted defeat, chose to join the Sword Spirit Sect, and became one of the Supreme Elders who sought your teachings in swordsmanship.]
[In Daya Calendar 750, under the tyrannical rule of Emperor Wen of Xia, in less than a hundred years since Empress Xia Yuan’s fall, a large number of factions appeared in the imperial court of Xia. Furthermore, nobles and aristocrats from Chu and Zhao States who had been plotting their revival also wreaked havoc. With the Xia Empire in turmoil and the people suffering, it resembled the end of a dynasty.]
[You saw everything with your own eyes and knew that the empire was about to collapse, and this time it would probably bring about a dynastic change. However, you didn’t care about it. At the same time, you were well aware that you too were nearing the end of your life, but you didn’t worry about the Sword Spirit Sect facing problems.]
[Under your leadership, the number of Spiritual Realm experts in the Sword Spirit Sect had already reached nearly fifty. Your disciples and descendants were also very outstanding and capable of leading the Sword Spirit Sect well.]
[In the Daya Calendar 756, you passed away peacefully at the peak of Sword Spirit Sect Mountain, your passing leaving the entire sect in mourning and the world in shock!]
[With your death, this simulation comes to an end…]
“This time, I actually died a natural death? It’s really surprising.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and couldn’t help but sigh.
Because every simulation had resulted in an unexpected death, he instinctively thought that dying a natural death in the life simulation was impossible.
Apparently, that wasn’t the case.
As long as he didn’t seek out death, he could still live to die of natural causes.
Of course, the premise was that his strength on the Profound Turtle Continent was unrivaled..

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 66: The Emergence of the Red Flame Technique!
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 66: The Emergence of the Red Flame Technique!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards as a reward:
Half- step Transcendent Realm Cultivation.
50% Sword Spirit.
Sword Essence Skill.
Sword Riding Skill.
Elixir Field Skill.
White Talent.Martial Arts Genius.’
“System, I choose the Elixir Field Skill.”
After scanning the rewards, Wang Ping made his choice.
If the Life Simulator still consumed spiritual stones exponentially, he would definitely prioritize cultivation.
However, the current Life Simulator consumes spiritual stones depending on the cultivation.
Therefore, under absolutely safe circumstances, it is best to prioritize other rewards, figure out the path, and become a hexagonal fighter.
In this way, spiritual stones can be saved better.
Of course, if the situation changes, such as encountering danger, or a group task, or needing to improve cultivation to pass a certain event in the life simulation, he will not hesitate to choose cultivation.
Wang Ping is clear about the pros and cons.
As Wang Ping made his choice, a secret skill appeared in his mind.
This secret skill was the one he and Bai Tianhong created together by borrowing the power of a demonic skill to expand their Dantian.
“Although it can expand the Dantian, the grade is probably not high.”
After studying it, Wang Ping frowned slightly and muttered to himself.
With this secret skill, it is possible to break through to the half-step
Transcendent Realm and to the Transcendent Realm with enough resources.
However, according to Wang Pings guess, the foundation of the Transcendent Realm must also be divided into strong and weak. If you practice low-level secret skills to break through, the expanded Dantian may not be as large as those who practice high-level secret skills, perhaps only half of the others, or even smaller.
In that case, those who break through with high-level secret skills will definitely be stronger and can go further in the future.
“It seems that I can break through to the half-step Transcendent Realm with this secret skill, but if I want a solid foundation and a perfect breakthrough, I need not only enough resources but also a high-level secret skill.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered, and he had an idea in his heart.
He didn’t want his future to be stuck in the Transcendent Realm; he wanted to reach the top and achieve true immortality.
Therefore, he would not harm his potential and foundation for temporary cultivation improvement.
“Maybe I can make a deal with Cai Yonglong. Forget it, there’s probably no chance of that happening.”
Wang Ping thought of Cai Yonglong but shook his head helplessly.
Cai Yonglong’s territory must have more advanced secret skills.
However, such secret skills are definitely the core of a sect, and they cannot be easily taught.
Currently, Cai Yonglong is only at the Half- step Spiritual Realm cultivation, far from the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, so it is impossible for him to learn the secret skills of his sect.
Unless he himself has a chance to obtain a more advanced secret skill.
“Perhaps it is not impossible. After all, his own Golden Finger is likely related to finding opportunities.”
However, Wang Ping remembered Cai Yonglongs Golden Finger and his eyes lit up slightly.
Immediately, Wang Ping opened the chat group and started to speak.
Wang Ping (66)@Cai Yonglong (1):”Cai Yonglong, can you get the secret skill to expand the Dantian? I can trade something of equal value with you.” As Wang Ping @ed, Cai Yonglong also bubbled up.
Cai Yonglong (1):”Uh, I can’t get my hands on such a precious secret skill. At least, not for now.”
Wang Ping (66):”Alright, let me know when you can, and we can make a trade.”
Cai Yonglong (1):”Alright, I’ll try my best.”
Soon, the chat ended, and the chat group went silent again.
After closing the chat group, Wang Ping was somewhat disappointed, but he was not surprised by Cai Yonglongs words.
After all, if such a secret skill was so easy to obtain, it would be unrealistic.
If Cai Yonglong could easily obtain such a secret skill, he would have already used this secret skill to gain a lot of cultivation resources and easily break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm.
“Forget it, let’s continue the simulation.”
Wang Ping focused his mind and resumed the simulation.
“Ding, paid simulation requires the consumption of 2,000 lower-tier spiritual stones, do you want to spend them?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Spend.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, refreshing talents…”
“Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing White Talent.lnnate Contrariness; Green Talent.Escape Prodigy.”
White Talent,lnnate Contrariness: You are naturally rebellious and forgetful of righteousness when you see profit.
Green Talent.Escape Prodigy: With this talent, you are gifted in escaping, and can find a way to survive better in a crisis and run faster than ordinary people.
“Wow, this White Talent.lnnate Contrariness is a complete negative buff, is there such a talent?”
Wang Pings eyes were subtle.
Then, he looked at the Green Talent.Escape Prodigy.
Isn’t this talent an upgraded version of the White Talent: Escape Master?
Escape Master was quite effective when his cultivation was low, but at his current level, it’s not really useful.
Obviously, the effect of low-tier talents will be lower as the cultivation increases.
“But, this Green Talent should be effective in the Spiritual Origin Realm and above.’
Wang Pings eyes flickered and he chuckled lightly.
After all, the few Green Talents he chose before had quite a significant effect until now.
Of course, except for the Beast Taming Prodigy Talent, which had no presence after being chosen once..

Sword Spirit Sect, they need to maintain a neutral position. If they push too hard for the Wu family, you will expel the talented girl from the sect.]

As long as the Wu family doesn’t do anything too outrageous, even the Royal Family wouldn’t easily suppress them.]

You know that Bai Tianhongs journey will undoubtedly bring death, so you choose to use his many years of service to the Sword Spirit Sect to dissuade him from abandoning it in selfishness.]

[Daxia Calendar 580, because you spent less time creating your secret skill and Bai Tianhong did not go to sea, your comprehension of Sword Spirit is more profound this time. You successfully comprehend 50% Sword Spirit.]
[Daxia Calendar 620, Lin Yifei is killed by the Empress, and the Lin family is exterminated.]
[Daxia Calendar 655, Empress Xia Yuan starts a war. One year later, Xia annexes two countries.]
[Daxia Calendar 660, Exotic Races strongman is born, kills the Xia’s Great General of the North, shocking the world. Hearing the nevvs, you are not moved and continue to do your own things, searching for the upper volume of the Red Fire Skill and the opportunity to break through to the Transcendent
Realm. You believe that, as an Earth-tier top-grade cultivation skill, the Red
Fire Skill could very likely contain a high-level secret skill for expanding Dantian.]
[However, you don’t choose to go out of the mountain, but Bai Tianhong does. The Sword Spirit Sect has a transcendent position and a neutral stance. It won’t interfere in the power struggles of Xia, but it won’t be soft on the Exotic
Races that have been invading and plundering the land for thousands of years.
At the same time, if they can obtain spiritual tools from the hands of Exotic
Races experts, it can also increase the foundation of the Sword Spirit Sect.]
[In the end, Bai Tianhong comes out of the mountain, showing his invincible strength. He kills the Exotic Races expert with a single sword in hand, taking away his spiritual tool, shocking the world. Empress Xia Yuan is also astonished by Bai Tianhongs strength. At the same time, she thinks of you, with complex feelings and a great sense of relief. Thankfully, the Sword Spirit Sect is a transcendent sect with a neutral position, otherwise, with you and
Bai Tianhong, it would be too easy for the sect to overthrow Xia’s rule.] [Because Bai Tianhong takes action, the Empress does not fall, the chaos in Xia does not occur, and the extermination of Exotic Races does not stop. Thus, in Daxia Calendar 663, Xia successfully conquers the land of Exotic Races.]
[From then on, Xia completely rules over the Profound Turtle Continent. Empress Xia Yuan is hailed as an Eternity Emperor, highly respected, and enjoys a transcendent status.]
[Daxia Calendar 720, you finally comprehend 60% sword spirit. With this, you can only sigh that Sword Spirit Comprehension becomes more difficult as it progresses. It’s not something that can be broken through by cultivation in seclusion alone. Only by engaging in life-and-death battles with strong opponents can one break through more easily.][ln the same year, after wearing down one prince and princess after another, the Empress finally chose to retire behind the scenes, giving up the throne. For a time, Xia began to experience turbulence, but with the Empress Xia Yuan holding control behind the scenes, there was not too much chaos.]
[In the year 745 of the Daya calendar, a genius suddenly rose to prominence, undefeated along the way, defeating all peers in the same realm, and reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm at the age of fifty.]
[When you hear the news, you are quite surprised because it does not match your memory. However, you also think it’s the butterfly effect.]
[In the year 750 of the Daya calendar, the genius suddenly appeared at the
Sword Spirit Sect, intending to challenge the world-renowned and invincible
Bai Tianhong. Bai Tianhong chose to fight. The two fought, shaking the earth.
The cultivation of the genius unexpectedly reached the half-step
Transcendent Realm and was able to fight Bai Tianhong to a draw.]
[However, you quickly see the clue. You find that the Cultivation Skill practiced by the person in front of you is Red Fire Skill, and the secret skill displayed is also likely a move from Red Fire Skill. That’s why it’s so powerful. At the same time, you also confirm that the upper volume of the Red Fire Skill must contain a high-level Secret Skill to expand the Dantian; otherwise, the genius in front of you could not break through to the half-step Transcendent Realm and be so powerful.]
[For a moment, you are both surprised and delighted, never expecting that the Red Fire Skill of the upper volume, which you need most in your later years, would appear so abruptly before your eyes.]
[As you rejoice in your heart, the battle between the two intensifies. Not until Bai Tianhong unleashes all his strength and uses 60% Sword Spirit does he defeat the genius.]
[The genius person is very unwilling, thinking that he did not lose in strength but in age.]
[Next, the genius wants to leave the Sword Spirit Sect, but you intercept him and propose the exchange of the Red Fire Skill. He is very astonished and vigilant, not expecting to be exposed.]
[You see him alerted and directly propose to exchange the middle volume for
the upper volume. The genius is very surprised, not expecting you to have obtained the middle volume of the Cultivation Skill.]
[Finally, you successfully exchange with him and get the upper volume of the
Red Fire Skill. Thus, you succeed in collecting all the Red Fire Skills, bringing back Earth-tier top-grade Red Fire Skill to the world.]
[After the exchange of the Cultivation Skills, the genius descends the mountain, and you choose to cultivate in seclusion, switching to practice Red Fire Skill and its secret techniques.]

Because he stopped Bai Tianhong from going to sea, the butterfly effect caused Empress Xia Yuan not to die in battle.
As a result, the entire Profound Turtle Continent was unified, and a future genius with a strong destiny obtained the upper volume of the Red Fire Skill.
This allowed Earth-tier top-grade Red Fire Skill to fully emerge, resolving his previous concerns..

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 67: Power Soars! Battle Beyond the Extraordinary!
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 67: Power Soars! Battle Beyond the Extraordinary!
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that in the future simulations, I need to try different paths. Since I am already invincible, there is no need to continue surviving in the Life Simulator. Interfering with development and taking different paths will bring out more possibilities, gain more opportunities, and increase the probability of breaking through to the Transcendent Realm.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
Anyway, his Golden Finger had been optimized, and as long as he doesn’t increase his cultivation, the number of Spirit Stones consumed each time would remain at 2,000.
He didn’t care about a mere 2,000 low-tier spirit stones.
With his current abilities, it wouldn’t be difficult to collect hundreds of thousands, or even millions, of low-tier spirit stones from the Profound
Turtle Continent.
The Profound Turtle Continent just lacks mid-and-high-tier Spirit Stones.
Low-tier Spirit Stones are not scarce and are considered renewable resources.
Of course, if the exploitation and consumption are excessive, the number of low-tier Spirit Stones on the continent would definitely decrease.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards as rewards:
Half-step Transcendent Realm Cultivation.
Earth-tier top-grade skill.Red Fire Skill.
Sword Riding Skill.
@. 60% Sword Spirit.
Green Talent.Escape Prodigy.
Elixir-refining Experience.”
“Huh, there are two rewards this time? System, I choose @ and b.”
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards, and quickly made his choice while still surprised.
The Red Fire Skill might emerge in this simulation but may not in future simulations, so naturally, he has to choose this.
As for Green Talent.Escape Prodigy, although this talent has no presence in this simulation, it doesn’t mean it is useless.
It’s just that Wang Pings strength in the simulation has reached its peak for now, making escape unnecessary; otherwise, it would definitely be of great use.
Therefore, this is the natural choice.
After all, it may not appear next time.
With Wang Pings choice, he felt a green light entering his body.
At the same time, a brand new Cultivation Skill appeared in his mind, and the Spiritual Essence inside his body began to boil. The sharp Spiritual Essence condensed from the Sword Essence Skill transformed into a fiery red color, emitting an extremely high temperature and terrifying fire Elemental Spirit. Not only that, but he also learned all the secret skills recorded in the Red Fire
Skill, reaching the level of mastery.
“So this is an Earth-tier top-grade skill? It’s much more terrifying than I imagined. ”
Wang Ping felt the strength of the Spiritual Essence in his body, his face full of shock.
Although he had known that the gap between different skill grades was huge, he hadn’t expected the gap between Earth lower tier and Earth-tier top-grade to be so big.
The intensity of the Spiritual Essence in his body was at least ten times stronger than before.
This kind of improvement was simply shocking.
Wang Ping even doubted whether he could now kill a half-step Transcendent Realm master at a higher level.
When his Sword Spirit reached 60%, he even felt that he could kill a Spirit Sea
Domain Stronger at a higher level.
“I’m really getting ahead of myself.”
However, Wang Ping quickly sobered up and chuckled.
Transcendence realm and spirit realm are not on the same level; it certainly wouldn’t be that simple to kill a Transcendent Realm master at a higher level.
After all, the saying “all below Transcendence are ants” is not just an empty phrase.
Transcendent means transcending the mundane world, and reaching it marks the beginning of transcendence.
Even a half-step Transcendent Realm, in the face of a Transcendent Realm Master, is nothing but an ant that can be killed with a casual slap.
Furthermore, the cultivation skills of the Transcendent Realm masters cannot be too low; even if they are not Earth-tier top-grade, they must be at least Earth mid-and-high-tier skills. The gap between their cultivation skills won’t be that big.
“l must keep a steady mind and not get arrogant. Arrogance can be fatal.” Wang Ping reminded himself in his heart.
Then, Wang Ping recalled the secret techniques recorded in the Red Fire Skill, feeling amazed.
Red Fire Skill, with its upper, middle, and lower volumes, each recording a secret technique, making it incredibly powerful.
The secret technique recorded in the upper volume is called Red Fire Dragon, which can create a Red Fire Dragon with a bit of intelligence for battle.
The secret technique recorded in the middle volume is called Soaring Red Flames, which can create a pair of wings made of Red Fire, greatly increasing the Cultivating speed and also can be used for combat, agile, and powerful.
The secret techniaue recorded in the lower volume is called Red Fire Seeds. which can condense a Spirit Fire seed inside the body for cultivation, forming a Spirit Fire when it blooms.
The name of the Spirit Fire is similar to that of the Cultivation Skill, called Chiyan Spirit Fire.
Once the Spirit Fire is successful, the power of the Red Fire Skill can be maximized. Without a Heaven-tier skill, it would be difficult for anyone at the same level to rival it.
One should know that although Transcendent Realm practitioners have means to condense Spirit Fire, it is just an ordinary Spirit Fire born from their powerful cultivation, which cannot compare to the natural Spirit Fire in the world.
Although Chiyan Spirit Fire is not a natural-born Spirit Fire but a nurtured one, its power can rival natural Spirit Fire, making it incredibly strong.
Of course, practicing this secret technique is simple to start with, but condensing the Spirit Fire seed is not difficult; what’s difficult is how to cultivate it, make it bloom, and transform it into Spirit Fire.
Probably, not many people in the Original Red Race were able to condense Chiyan Spirit Fire.
“If I were to cultivate normally, I guess it would be tough to condense Chiyan
Spirit Fire. However, I have a life simulator, and I can succeed with time..”

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 67: Soaring Strength! A Great Fight Against the Extraordinary! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 67: Soaring Strength! A Great Fight Against the Extraordinary! _2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping collected his thoughts and chuckled lightly.
“Let’s continue with the simulation. This time, I’ll choose a different path to see if I can break into the Transcendent Realm. If I fail, I’ll focus on increasing my Sword Spirit or other statistics first. I need to enhance my abilities all-round. Otherwise, when the Group Task reappears and my abilities haven’t improved enough, it’ll be quite dangerous.”
As Wang Ping prepared to continue the simulation, sudden notifications from the group chat caught his attention, taking him aback.
“Ding, Wang Shuqi (74) has joined the group chat.”
“Ding, Ye Xiaofan (75) has joined the group chat.”
“Ding, Yu Qiang (76) has joined the group chat.”
“Ding, Qin Tian (77) has joined the group chat.”
A month later, new members finally joined. And this time, four of them joined at one go. The group chat is getting more intense.”
Wang Ping exclaimed deeply.
“I’m just curious about how many of these newcomers will survive.”
As he muttered this, Wang Ping opened the group chat page.
Right now, the group chat was bustling with activity. Most of the old members were sending messages.
Welcome messages came flooding in.
Liu Mei was kindly explaining the usual rules.
And then, the newbies were freaked out and overwhelmed. Wang Shuqi (74): ‘Just asking, can we opt out of the group chat?”
Fang Yun (3): “Ah, good question… obviously, you can’t!”
Qin Tian (77): “Stop being such a coward! What’s a little death? This is a rare chance to explore another reality, to make a big splash in an Exoteric World. It’s way better than staying on the doomed Earth as a wage slave.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Well, newbie, you’re quite gutsy. More courageous than other newbies.’
Yu Qiang (76): “Do you guys still have time to talk? Smart people would already be getting their equipment.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Good grief, going for a gun…what is it that you do exactly?”
Yu Qiang (76): “Mercenary, a word to the wise.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Color me impressed, I’m envious!”
Glancing at the group chat, Wang Ping raised an eyebrow in interest.
So this time, even a mercenary has joined huh? Interesting.
He’s perhaps the first person to bring with him a modern weapon when crossing over to another reality. I wonder how his fate will unfold.
Next, Wang Ping turned his attention to Ye Xiaofan, rubbing his chin thoughtfully.
Ye Xiaofan, surname Ye. The character ‘Ye t makes him think of Emperor Ye.
A protagonist’s common surname, a force to be reckoned with.
Not to mention, Wang Ping also recollected Ye Chen from his previous life simulations.
Back then, he surmised that this guy was the protagonist template but he never showed up in the following simulations. It was as if he had disappeared into the crowd, or maybe he was dead.
The system wouldn’t have missed any significant character after all.
Besides, the surname ‘Lin’ is also commonly found among leading characters. Yet, Lin Yifei had worthwhile performances in life simulations, but he didn’t have any connection to the protagonist template.
“Guess I’ve read too much web fiction and got affected by it.”
Wang Ping mumbled to himself.
Then, instead of participating in the group chat like the others, Wang Ping chose to quietly observe.
As for the newcomers, it would still take some time before they crossed over. Whether they lived or died will only be revealed by then.
Even if they survive the initial stage, their chances of long-term survival still remain uncertain.
“System, I want to initiate the paid simulation again.”
Wang Ping spoke in his mind.
“Ding, Paid simulation initiated. It will cost you 2000 low-tier spirit stones.”
“Ding, Initiating the life simulation. Refreshing talents… Unfortunately, the host didn’t refresh any talents.”
The system’s voice echoed in his head.
“No talent…
Wang Ping’s expression twitched slightly.
This luck, is apparently bad.
However, he could only console himself, claiming it to be a minor cut that would soon yield an outstanding talent.
“Ding, Initiation of the life simulation…”
Once again, the system’s voice resonated, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and text started emerging.
At this, Wang Ping composed himself, looking forward expectantly.
“[Daya calendar 482, you have successfully advanced to the half-step Transcendent Realm and entered Xia Forbidden Land, acquiring a spiritual tool.]”
“The speed of breakthrough to the half- step Transcendent Realm was quite fast this time. As expected, Cultivation Skills not only enhance combat strength but also greatly boosts cultivation speed and the ability to overcome challenges. ”
Upon reading the first line, Wang Ping could not help but express his astonishment.
“[Daya calendar 511, you slain a Demonic Cultivator.]
“[Daya calendar 545, Supreme Elder and Second Supreme Elder passed away.
Bai Tianhong attempted to head overseas, but you blocked him.]”
“[Daya calendar 580, your cultivation of Sword Spirit reached 50% peak capacity.]”
“[Daya calendar 620, Lin Yifei was forcefully slain by the Empress, and the Lin family was destroyed.]”
“[Daya calendar 655, Empress Xia Yuan initiated a war. A year later, Xia swallowed two nations.]”
“[Daya calendar 660, Xia united the Profound Turtle Continent. You successfully comprehended 60% of Sword Spirit. You felt that the time has come and once again entered Xia Forbidden Land, hoping to find an opportunity to break through to the Transcendent Realm.]”
“[However, the Forbidden Land is too dangerous. Despite being unstoppable in your current state, you nearly perished in the Forbidden Land, which alarmed you.]”
“[As a result, you started recuperating and continued your intensive cultivation in seclusion.]”
“[Daya calendar 720, you tried to comprehend 70% Sword Spirit, but got stuck at the peak of 60%, unable to make any progress. You let out a silent sigh.
Achieving 70% Sword Spirit had already reached the Great Completion Domain. Without the right opportunity, it is very difficult to comprehend through Sword Enlightenment..]”

chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 67 Power Surge! Extraordinary Battle! _3
Translator: 549690339
“Simultaneously, you have also noticed your own aging, knowing your end is not far off. Therefore, you want to gamble for one last time. You drag the equally aging Bai Tianhong out to sea with you, wanting to fight for a chance to live, not willing to merely survive till the end in this world.”
“Bai Tianhong is delighted, stating he has been waiting for this day for way too long. Finally, the two of you join forces and venture out to sea.”
“On the first day, you’re safe and sound.”
“On the third day, you’re safe and sound.”
“On the fourth day, you notice that the Spiritual Energy between heaven and earth has suddenly intensified multiple times, surprising you greatly. However, very soon, you feel a terrifying air coming from the sea, rushing towards you.”
“At this, your faces pale, guessing that this is a Transcendent Realm Sea Beast and quickly flee.”
“However, in front of a Transcendent Realm Beast, a half-step Transcendent Realm is merely an ant. Bai Tianhong is killed instantly, turning into a blood fog. But you, due to your talented skill of escape, quickly analyze that the Sea Beast’s flying speed in the sky is definitely not as fast as it is in the sea.”
“For this reason, you quickly retreat into the high sky, exerting the Soaring Red Flames with all your might. In the end, under the effect of the secret skill of the Soaring Red Flames and the rapid speed of your escape talent, you manage to escape the hunt in the sky.”
“However, before you can catch your breath, you detect a large amount of terrifying aura in the high sky once again. Shortly after, streaks of light appear before you, chilling you to the bone.”
“It’s a flying monster beast ethnic group. The leader of the beast is more than a hundred meters long, its aura terrifying, unmistakably a Transcendent Realm Monster. Surrounded, you smile bitterly, knowing that death is inevitable this time. There are flying monster beasts in the sky, terrifying monster beasts in the ocean; there is no escape, talent buffs are of no use here.’
“In the end, you choose to burst out and kill towards the flying monster beast group. You are very strong, and with one swing of your sword, you kill a monster beast endowed with the thick transcendent bloodline, angering the monster beast group. At this, the Transcendent Realm Monster decides to personally take action against you. But you are fearless, unleashing your combat strength to its limit, seeking to fight to the death with the Transcendent State Demon.’
“You fight with the Transcendent State Demon and fall completely, being devoured by the beast. Nevertheless, in this battle, you manage to cut off one of the claws of the Transcendent State Demon, showing your tremendous strength.”
“Due to your death, this simulation ends…”
“Is the forbidden territory really so dangerous? Also, I see that comprehending the Sword Spirit to the 6th Tier Peak, combined with cultivation of the Red Fire Skill, can already enable one to fight against the Transcendent Realm. Even though the fight will end in death, one can still inflict damage on the opponent and is no longer an ant that can be crushed easily.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of this simulation, astonished in his heart.
Of course, in this simulation, his cultivation level of Red Fire Skill must be deeper, and his control over the secret skill should be much stronger than his current self.
Thus, he can’t base the strength of Wang Ping before his simulated death on himself who’s just broken through to the half-step Transcendent Realm.
However, as the simulation progresses, he will surely possess the strength of Wang Ping from the simulation, or even surpass it.
“Speaking of which, the monsters we encountered at sea were really terrifying. ”
Wang Ping thought about the sea adventure plot again, frowning.
Though it was peaceful for the first three days, they encountered multiple
Transcendent Realm Beasts on the fourth day; it was just too hair-raising.
You should know, whether it’s humans or monsters on Profound Turtle Continent, the Transcendent Realm has not appeared for hundreds or even thousands of years.
However, on the fourth day out at sea, they came across multiple
Transcendent Realm Beasts, both in the sea and the sky; it was too numerous.
“Moreover, on the fourth day, the Spiritual Energy between heaven and earth had increased manifold, that’s quite an anomaly too. Besides, if there are so many Transcendent Realm Beasts in the ocean and in the sky, why have they never landed on the Profound Turtle Continent?”
Wang Ping squinted his eyes, his finger tapping on the tabletop, quietly analyzing one piece of information after another.
“Could it be that the Profound Turtle Continent is special, harboring something that these monsters fear, making them not dare to approach?
Perhaps it even affects the density of the surrounding Spiritual Energy, making it much lower than the level apparent in the outer world.”
“It seems that there are still many secrets about the Profound Turtle
Continent that I don’t know about. I’ve always overlooked one thing: the Profound Turtle Continent, as an isolated land mass in the ocean, has been safe for thousands of years with no powerful beasts attacking it; it’s rather unusual. Only, many people are used to this way of life, which is why it’s easily overlooked and hard to contemplate.”
Wang Ping stops tapping on the table, lifting up his cup. He gulps down the Spiritual Wine.
“Perhaps, this is why the Chi Clan chose to retreat from the world here.”
“Hehe, no matter what secrets there are, I will uncover them all by repeating simulations. Perhaps, the opportunities within those secrets will not only help me break into the Spirit Sea Realm, but also increase my power even further.”
As Wang Ping was lost in thought, a system voice rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
Sword Riding Skill.”
“There’s only one reward this time? What choice do I have.”
Wang Ping was at a loss for words and could only choose the Sword Riding Skill.
After choosing, however, Wang Ping discovers that this reward isn’t too bad.
Because the reward for the Sword Riding Skill is high in experience points, it greatly increases his mastery over it, indirectly enhancing his power..

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 67: Soaring Strength! A Great Battle Against the Extraordinary! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 67: Soaring Strength! A Great Battle Against the Extraordinary! _4
Translator: 549690339
“System, I want to proceed with the paid simulation!”
Next, Wang Ping began the simulation again, and the system’s mechanical voice rang out once more.
“Ding, paid simulation costs 2000 lower-tier spirit stones. Life Simulator starting, refreshing talents…”
“Ding, congratulations Host for successfully refreshing green talent: Excellent Physique; white talent: Beast Taming Master.”
Green Talent: Excellent Physique – With this talent, the Host’s bone and root aptitude will receive a considerable improvement, becoming a cultivating genius in the eyes of ordinary people.
White Talent: Beast Taming Master – The Host will have a certain talent in beast taming.
“Huh, did this talent come up again?”
Wang Ping looked at this talent with a slightly brighter gaze.
Wang Ping had refreshed this talent before starting the group task.
It was precisely with this green talent that Wang Pings cultivating speed could soar all the way, quickly reaching the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, and killing the demonic cultivator with Bai Tianhong and completing the group task.
It can be said that Wang Ping had a deep impression of this talent, but at that time, he could only choose one reward and gave up this talent for the sake of cultivation.
Unexpectedly, this talent was refreshed again.
With this, Wang Ping naturally wouldn’t hesitate, and decisively chose the Green Talent: Excellent Physique.
With this talent, Wang Ping believed that he could break through to the Transcendent Realm more easily.
And in the Transcendent Realm, the cultivation speed could be even faster.
After all, his current cultivation talent, if not relying on the life simulator to pile up cultivation, it would actually be very slow.
When he reached the Transcendent Realm, it would probably be as slow as a turtle, and the upper limit would be blocked.
After all, in the Profound World, bone and root aptitude is essential, and without sufficient aptitude, many people would be stuck at a certain realm even if they have opportunities.
Unless he gets a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, to let the useless body rise all the way up.
However, that is entirely the protagonist template of the traditional fantasy genre, and it is impossible for ordinary people to obtain such an opportunity. “Ding, talent selection successful, simulation starting…”
The system’s voice rang out again, the luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged.
[You practiced cultivation in seclusion, and three months later, you successfully broke through to half-step Transcendent Realm, entered the Xia Forbidden Land, and obtained a spiritual tool.]
“The cultivation speed has improved a lot… The effect of improving the bone and root aptitude is really obvious.”
Wang Ping looked at the words, his eyes flickering, and sighed emotionally.
[In the following years, you traveled throughout the Profound Turtle
Continent, exploring hidden places, trying to find the secrets of the Profound Turtle Continent and gain opportunities. At the same time, you have also been studying the bead given to you by the elder village chief, trying to discover its secrets.]
[However, despite your formidable strength, you were unable to harm it or discern its secrets. Although you believe that this object may be at least a spiritual tool, or perhaps beyond that level, you are unable to uncover its secrets and can only sigh helplessly.]
[In the year 620 of the Daya calendar, the butterfly effect appeared. Lin Yifei, who thought he was invincible in the world, casually killed a Sword Spirit Sect
True Inheritance Disciple. You did not want to deal with him and let Bai Tianhong kill him, but you suspected that he was specially mentioned in your memory and might be an important person. You personally went down the mountain to suppress him. Finally, you obtained a cultivation skill from him. It was a defensive skill, and its rank even reached Earth lower tier, named Gold Light Shield.]
[Upon this, you suddenly understood why the Empress Xia Yuan in your memory couldn’t handle him and had to use spiritual tools to strike a lethal blow. With an Earth-tier defensive skill, he indeed had a turtle shell. However, now it is beneficial to you.]
[Afterwards, you continued to focus on diligently cultivating and seeking opportunities.]
[In the year 660 of the Daya calendar, you entered the Forbidden Land once more in search of opportunities but returned severely injured again. However, this time, because of the Gold Light Shield skill, your injuries were not so severe. Nonetheless, you still needed a month to recover. During the recovery, you felt that you lacked an Earth-tier healing skill. Otherwise, you would still be unable to become a Hexagonal Strongman.]
[In the year 680 of the Daya calendar, you ultimately failed to unravel the secrets of the Profound Turtle Continent, and you grew old. As a result, you felt that you could not delay any longer. If you waited another forty years, you would be thoroughly old, and your strength would decline.]
[Therefore, while your strength was still at its peak, you decided to go out to sea with Bai Tianhong..]

chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 68: Two Lucky Newcomers!
Translator: 549690339
[This time, in order to be able to fight side by side at sea and face transcendent realm monsters together, you have already taught Bai Tianhong the Red Fire Skill and many secret skills, which greatly increased his strength.]
[In the first three days before setting sail, you were both safe and sound. Even if powerful monster beasts appeared, they would be easily slain or deterred by you.]
[On the fourth day, when the spiritual energy became dense, a transcendent realm monster beast attacked.]
[Instead of running away, both of you moved the battle to the sky and joined forces to fight the enemy. However, in order to avoid flying too high and attracting the attention of flying monster beasts who rule the sky, you fight the transcendent realm sea beast in the air about a kilometer above the sea.]
[In the end, the two of you managed to repel the transcendent realm sea beast after paying a considerable price and continued your voyage.]
[On the evening of the fourth day, you were attacked again. Two transcendent realm sea beasts appeared, one of which was the one you had repelled earlier.]
[You noticed that the newly emerged sea beast was even more powerful and feared it greatly. Out of helplessness, you had no choice but to flee without fighting. But after escaping to the sky for a while, you were targeted by a transcendent poultry monster. Unable to put up a fight, and with the flying monster beast being faster, the two of you could only injure it together before ultimately meeting your demise.]
[Due to your death, this simulation is over.]
“Is going out to sea without reaching the transcendent realm still a dead end?”
Wang Ping could only sigh upon seeing the result of this simulation.
Once at sea, it was extremely dangerous with so many powerful monster beasts.
“Reward generation successful, host can choose two of the following rewards:
0.6th Tier of the peak sword spirit.
@.Lower-earth Tier defensive martial skill: Golden Light Shield.
9.Green Talent: Excellent Physique.”
“System, I choose and 9.”
After taking a look at the rewards, Wang Ping made his decision.
After he chose these two rewards, he could start accumulating Sword Spirit in the next simulation, and try to grind it to 70% with time.
If he could comprehend 70 percent Sword Spirit, he might truly have the power of the transcendent realm, and his chances of surviving at sea would be higher.
Following Wang Ping’s decision, he felt a warmth in his body, and the efficiency of absorbing and converting the spiritual energy of heaven and earth improved.
Clearly, this was the manifestation of the improvement in his bone and root aptitude.
Next, Wang Pings mind was filled with memories. Those were his insights from practicing the Lower Earth-Tier martial skill: Golden Light Shield during all those years in life simulation.
After absorbing the gains, Wang Ping was quite satisfied.
The Golden Light Shield, as a lower-earth tier martial skill, was indeed a good defensive method.
After absorbing the rewards, Wang Ping simulated three more times.
However, he didn’t get any more talents in three consecutive simulations, which was outrageous.
Moreover, the content of these three life simulations was quite similar, and he still could not find any opportunities, as if all the opportunities on the
Profound Turtle Continent had been drained.
As for his insights on Sword Spirit.
Though he chose Sword Spirit as his reward in all three simulations.
But the Sword Spirit was stuck at 6th Tier peak and could not progress further, unable to enter the great realm.
Wang Ping could only smile helplessly at that.
As expected, the transition from small success to great success was a huge leap, and it was impossible to comprehend it through hard cultivation without enough talent. Only in desperate battles would there be a slight chance of comprehension.
Moreover, the probability of gaining insights into the mysteries of fighting with stronger sword cultivators would be much higher than fighting with monster beasts.
“Talent, talent…
Wang Ping could only shake his head.
It seems that this is the limit for Green Talent: Sword Skill Talent.
White Talent: Swordsmanship Genius made it difficult for him to comprehend Sword Spirit at all.
Green Talent: Sword Skill Talent could comprehend up to the 6th Tier peak of Sword Spirit, which is already quite impressive.
“I can only hope that a bottom guarantee will come soon, allowing me to obtain a stronger talent and have a better chance to break the deadlock.”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
Then, he withdrew his thoughts and did not simulate any further.
His luck today was indeed quite bad, and there was no need to continue the life simulation now as it seemed like he couldn’t find any way forward.
What he needs now is change.
Whether it’s the chat group or something he does himself, causing a big change is another way to break the deadlock.
“Maybe next time, I can try the imperial route.”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of this and whispered to himself.
BV intervening in Xia through the life simulation. becoming the helmsman of the Xia, and centralizing the resources of the entire Profound Turtle Continent in order to break through the transcendent realm, it might be possible. If the quality isn’t enough, make up for it with quantity, and see if it can succeed.
With this, Wang Ping made a plan for the next life simulation, opened the chat group, drank wine and chatted with the group members while waiting for the fate of the four newcomers.
“Ding! Group member Yu Qiang (76) has died. Death Replay recording in progress, please learn from it.”
About half an hour later, a message popped up, and the group fell silent.

Fang Yun (3): “What can we say, it’s just too classic.”

Soon, Qin Tian chimes in again.
Qin Tian (74): “Got it. It’s the Cultivation Realm system. Qi Refining,
Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Primordial Infant, Spiritual
Transformation, Dao Unity, crossing the tribulation, Mahayana.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, even the Cultivation Realm has emerged? I’m so envious!”
Not only Fang Yun, but also people like Wu Jun and Liu Mei, who crossed over to worlds that aren’t very impressive, are envious.
Cultivation, immortality, it’s the dream of many people.
Of course, in this chat group, immortality is secondary; the most important thing is that the strength of the Cultivation Realm is quite strong, so it can become powerful enough to make people feel safer in the future group tasks.Wang Ping (66): “Cultivation world, huh? Not bad.”
Seeing Qin Tian’s response, Wang Pings eyes slightly brightened.
Qin Tian’s appearance, for Wang Ping, was another turning point.
After all, the cultivation world definitely does not lack high-tier Spirit Stones.
Moreover, the cultivation world also has various delivery arrays, which could give him hope of leaving the Profound Turtle Continent without resorting to the dangerous method of crossing the sea.
Of course, Zhang Hu’s world should also have delivery magic, but the feeling of the fantasy world and Profound World not quite matching made Wang Ping think that it might be unusable. Although he has had the idea, he has never proposed a trade to Zhang Hu.
Unless he could find no other way, he would then speak up.
Now, with Qin Tian’s appearance, there is an extra cultivation world traveler, which is naturally more reliable than Zhang Hu’s fantasy world.
Apart from that, it was unknown what Ye Xiaofan’s world was like, If it were also a Profound or Immortal Swordsman World, then that would be the best.
The more Profound and Immortal Swordsman Worlds, the more choices there are.
Of course, Wang Ping does not currently have anything to engage in an equivalent exchange with Qin Tian. He could only wait for the next Group Task to appear and then use the group points for the trade.
“All this is based on the premise that I still can’t break through the
Transcendent Realm in the following days and leave the Profound Turtle Continent. If I can figure it out myself, there won’t be such a hassle.”
Wang Ping chuckled lightly and closed the chat group.
“l should go to the Imperial City for a visit, explore the hidden forbidden area of the Xia Royal Family, and get a Spirit Sword from there first.”
After that, Wang Ping directly rode his sword and left the pavilion, flying out of the Sword Spirit Sect.
The hidden forbidden area of the Xia Royal Family is a place of chance.
Although it is a forbidden area, Xia Yuan had once barely survived during a simulation. But for Wang Ping, there was no danger.
As long as he doesn’t force his way in, there won’t be any problems.
Therefore, this Spirit Sword should be better obtained sooner rather than later.
In this way, he could effectively enhance his strength.
If the Group Task suddenly appears again, he won’t face it empty-handed without a sword.
The Xia Imperial City was not calm.”
A series of major events had occurred recently.
The current emperor of Xia had reached an old age and was about to abdicate to give way to a more virtuous successor, causing the various princes and princesses to openly compete and fight in secret.
Not long ago, the Ninth Princess Xia Yuan had experienced an assassination attempt, suspected to be related to a certain vassal and prince.
As for another event, the Li Family’s annihilation, Sword Spirit Sect master
Zhang Yuan’s death, and the incidents of the two Supreme Elders of the Sword
Spirit Sect joining forces to kill in the Black Wind Forest had not yet completely settled down.
The combination of these events had made the entire Imperial City turbulent and people panic- stricken.
