Just when the Imperial City was somewhat restless, some powerful cultivators were astonished to see a sword light flying at an amazing speed from a distance and landing in the city.
Spiritual Realm Experts were rare in the Imperial City.
They never expected that there would be a Spiritual Realm Expert openly appearing in the Imperial City today, which would undoubtedly make the city’s situation even more chaotic.
Wang Ping did not fly ostentatiously to the Royal Family’s airspace, but instead walked through the streets of the Imperial City, experiencing its customs and observing the situation.
Wang Ping knew very well that before long, the people of the Royal Family would come to find him and escort him into the Imperial Palace.
After all, a Spiritual Realm Expert suddenly descending on the Imperial City, and with the identity of a newly appointed Supreme Elder and 4th Tier
Alchemist of the Sword Spirit Sect, was both too honored and sensitive..

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land
Translator: 549690339
“Mr. Wang, we meet again. No, I think I should call you a senior now.”
At this moment, a playful voice rang out.
Wang Ping turned his head and saw Xia Yuan, still dressed in men’s clothing, walking towards him with the old woman.
“l didn’t expect you to come looking for me first.” Wang Ping said with a faint smile.
“Hehe, after all, I’m the most familiar with senior.’
Xia Yuan said with a light laugh.
“Senior is not familiar with Imperial City, so why not let me show you around?
I wonder what you think.”
After a pause, Xia Yuan said again, extending an invitation.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded.
After that, the two strolled around the Imperial City.
“l don’t know why senior came to Imperial City this time? It shouldn’t be just for sightseeing.”
After a while, Xia Yuan finally asked this question.
“Xia is showing signs of decline, and the only reason it remains stable is because the Ancestor has not yet passed away,” Mang Ping said calmly. “l have come to the Imperial City to enter the Royal Family’s forbidden land. In exchange, 1 can help fellow Taoist Xia Wencheng concoct a Yang Recovery Elixir and extend his life by twenty years.”
“Is senior really telling the truth?”
Hearing Wang Pings words, Xia Yuan was first stunned, and then her face was full of joy.
She didn’t care that Wang Ping knew about the forbidden land.
After all, it wasn’t a secret in the eyes of top factions.
The old woman beside her was also overjoyed, very excited.
Their biggest concern right now was the impending passing of Xia Wencheng, a Great Perfection Spirit Origin Realm expert.
Although they had tried many methods to extend his life, none had worked. They could only delay his aging and decline in power, but not extend his life.
That’s because life-extending medicines are too precious, and even the Xia Royal Family has difficulty finding them.
“Of course it’s true. 1 already have the Yang Recovery Grass. As long as you provide other treasures, I can help him concoct a Yang Recovery Elixir,” Wang Ping said casually.
Xia Yuan and the old woman glanced at each other, overjoyed.
Yang Recovery Elixir is a 4th Tier Elixir that could extend life.
Not only is it difficult to concoct, but the main problem is that Yang Recovery Grass is hard to find.
Now that Wang Ping said he had Yang Recovery Grass, how could the two of them not be delighted?
“If senior really can help our Ancestor concoct a Yang Recovery Elixir, 1 believe he would allow senior to enter and exit the forbidden land freely,” Xia Yuan said seriously.
What she and the Xia Royal Family lacked now was this Elixir.
As long as the Ancestor remained powerful after she ascended to the Emperor’s throne, she could make sweeping reforms.
Maybe this Elixir could really stabilize the Xia Territory for another few hundred years.
Therefore, no matter the price, the Xia Royal Family had to get this Yang
Recovery Elixir.
“Then lead the way,” Wang Ping nodded, without further ado.
In response, Xia Yuan and the old woman exchanged glances and quickly took Wang Ping to the Imperial Palace.
With Xia Yuan and the old woman present, entering the depths of the Imperial
Palace was smooth sailing.
Soon, Wang Ping met the Xia Ancestor, Xia Wencheng.
He was an old man with white hair, exhibiting signs of aging.
However, despite his age, some remnants of his youthful prestige could still be seen on his face.
“Meeting face to face is better than just hearing the name. Fellow Taoist, you’ve hidden yourself quite well. You’ve been cultivating in the Spirit Origin Realm Great Perfection, but back then, you were walking in the world at the
1st Tier of Spirit Origin. The Sword Spirit Sect surely has a thick destiny.”
As Wang Ping examined the old man, the old man also scrutinized Wang Ping.
His cloudy old eyes widened, his face filled with surprise and admiration.
Only peers or stronger cultivators can see through a person’s true cultivation level.
Thus, Xia Ancestor Xia Wencheng saw Wang Ping’s true cultivation.
Of course, this was also because Wang Ping hadn’t cultivated any Secret Skill to conceal it.
Otherwise, Xia Wencheng wouldn’t have been able to see through it.
“What? Senior is at the Spirit Origin Realm Great Perfection cultivation!?” Xia Yuan stared at Wang Ping incredulously, her face full of astonishment.
The old woman next to her also gasped.
Wang Ping looked so young, yet his cultivation was already at the Spirit Origin
Realm Great Perfection. It was extremely terrifying.
Such talent was a rare sight in the world.
“l was too arrogant back then.”
Then, Xia Yuan laughed bitterly.
At that time, she still thought Wang Pings talent was inferior to hers and Bai Tianhongs.
She was confident in reaching the Spirit Origin Realm in her forties or fifties. But now, Wang Ping was already at the Spirit Origin Realm Great Perfection.
Great Perfection of the Spirit Origin Realm, in Xia, was synonymous with invincibility.
The stability of Xia today was mainly due to the fact that the Ancestor had not yet passed away.
Even though the Ancestor was old and approaching his end, no one dared to act recklessly.
That was the deterrent power of a Spirit Origin Realm Great Perfection expert.
“It seems necessary to cultivate a secret skill of the concealing type. That way, others won’t be able to see through my true cultivation and it will be safer.”
Seeing Xia Ancestor Xia Wencheng discern his true cultivation, Wang Ping also thought of something, an idea flashed through his mind.
“l came here this time to make a deal with fellow Taoist.” Wang Ping then spoke directly about the matter at hand: “l will make a Yang Recovery Elixir for fellow Taoist in exchange for the qualification to enter the forbidden land.”
“Actually, there’s no need to use the Yang Recovery Elixir as a trade. There’s a way to let fellow taoist enter the forbidden land freely,” Xia Ancestor Xia Wencheng shook his head and said meaningfully..

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land_2
Translator: 549690339
“Ancestor?” Upon hearing Xia Wencheng say this, Xia Yuan became anxious, not knowing what the ancestor was thinking.
The old woman beside them didn’t say anything.
Being so old and cunning, she naturally knew what Xia Wencheng was planning on doing.
“Oh? What method?” Wang Ping looked playfully at the old man, clearly understanding his thoughts.
“Cough, fellow Daoist, why not leave the Sword Spirit Sect and marry Yuan’er? In that case, the vast lands of Xia will become yours as well, wouldn’t that be great?”
Xia Ancestor Xia Wencheng coughed lightly, speaking with a smile.
Such a young Great Perfection cultivator and a 4th-Tier alchemist who joined the Sword Spirit Sect was truly enviable.
Because of this, he had to think of a way to poach him no matter what.
After all, Wang Ping had only joined the Sword Spirit Sect for a short while, so he couldn’t have formed many bonds yet.
“Ancestor!”
Hearing the Ancestor blatantly sell her out, Xia Yuan’s face turned red, tightly clenching her silver teeth and glaring at him.
Truth be told, the Ancestor’s words were not without appeal.
After all, Wang Ping was so young with such cultivation, one could say that he was one of the few who were compatible with her.
If they could win him over to the side of the Xia Royal Family, then the great Xia would be stabilized.
However, being sold out like this still made her dissatisfied with the Ancestor.
He hadn’t even considered her feelings at all.
“Sorry, no interest.”
Wang Ping glanced at Xia Yuan and spoke indifferently.
Although Xia Yuan was not bad, with a noble status, stunning looks and good talent, he no longer wanted to step into traps.
The Life Simulator had conditioned him several times with the law of guaranteed death upon marriage.
More so, he would eventually leave Profound Turtle Continent, so marriage was even more unnecessary.
“Ah, what a pity.”
The Xia Ancestor sighed with a look of regret on his face.
Such a good person, it’s a shame he couldn’t be brought into the Xia Royal Family.
Xia Yuan felt somewhat unhappy to see that Wang Ping rejected the offer with such calmness, without even a hint of interest.
Did she have no charm for him?
It must be said that a woman’s thoughts are indeed complicated.
“Fellow Daoist, I’ll repeat my earlier offer. For the Yang Recovery Elixir trade, you can choose once more.” Wang Ping shook his head and spoke again.
“Alright, then I’ll have to trouble you to refine one Yang Recovery Elixir for me. As for the other needed treasure medicines, I will have someone gather them quickly.”
Great Summer Ancestor Xia Wencheng could only nod helplessly.
“When will the forbidden area be opened?” Wang Ping asked once more.
“You’re in a hurry to enter the forbidden area?” Xia Wencheng was surprised, then his expression became solemn: “Although there are indeed opportunities to be found there, in the five hundred years since my Xia Dynasty was established, no one has ever completed the trial. Even I almost perished within it back then.’
“Oh? Is it that dangerous? What exactly is the trial in the forbidden area?” Wang Ping asked with a slight frown.
“The trial isn’t complex, it simply tests your battle strength against those in the same realm.’
Xia Wencheng sighed.
“Back when I entered the forbidden area, I encountered the combined assault of five shadowy figures who were in the same realm. I was really close to dying. While I was able to drag it out until the trial time ended, I simply delayed the inevitable and didn’t actually pass the assessment.” “Testing battle strength in the same realm? That’s simple.”
Wang Ping pondered in deep thought.
No wonder the Wang Ping in the life simulation could so easily obtain a spiritual tool.
In the end, his battle strength in the same realm was definitely amongst the top few in Profound Turtle Continent.
Even if Xia Yuan managed to pass the trial with great difficulty, it was normal for him to be able to pass it effortlessly.
“Uh…
Hearing how calm Wang Ping was, Xia Wencheng, Xia Yuan, and the old woman were left speechless.
You should know that if Wang Ping went in, he’d face the assault of at least five Perfect Level of Spiritual Realm cultivators, which was extremely dangerous.
The higher the cultivation, the more dangerous the fight becomes.
After all, when one is weak, powerful Cultivation Skills and martial arts can be used to easily defeat several opponents in the same realm. However, once in the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Realm, it becomes much more difficult.
However, who could say much to Wang Ping, the talented young man with Great Perfection Spiritual Realm cultivation?
“The forbidden area can be entered at any time. If fellow Daoist wishes to enter now, it is possible. However, I hope that fellow Daoist will refine the elixir first, and prepare a letter before entering, not that I fear you will go back on your word, but just in case.”
Xia Wencheng stroked his beard, speaking candidly, the meaning quite obvious.
He didn’t fear Wang Ping would break his word, Wang Ping, being such a young and exceptional powerhouse, usually kept his promises and wouldn’t be dishonest.
However, he feared Wang Ping would die inside.
Once Wang Ping died, big trouble would arise.
Without the Yang Recovery Elixir, and possibly incurring the wrath of the Sword Spirit Sect.
In that case, the Xia Royal Family would have nowhere to cry and could only swallow their sorrow.
“Hehe, of course.’
Wang Ping didn’t blame Xia Wencheng either, as this was normal human behavior.
Moreover, although he indeed desperately needed the Spirit Sword, he could still afford to wait a little longer.
“In that case, fellow Daoist, you can start refining the elixir now. Actually, my Xia Royal Family has always been searching for treasure medicines over the years but has never been able to find the Yang Recovery Grass.” Xia Wencheng smiled and nodded, standing up and speaking.
“l see.” Wang Ping was slightly surprised, but not unexpected.
After all, the Xia Royal Family had certainly tried all sorts of methods for Xia
Ancestor Xia Wencheng, never neglecting to collect herbs.
“l was wondering it the Royal Family has any surplus tire attribute treasure medicines or knows the whereabouts of any fire attribute treasure medicines..

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 69: Mysterious Forbidden Land_3
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, Wang Ping seemed to recall something and asked about it.
To cultivate the Chiyan Spirit Fire, many fire attribute heavenly and earthly Spirit are needed.
The Fire Spirit Flower is one such kind, but a single Fire Spirit Flower is naturally not enough for such a transformation.
To successfully cultivate the Chiyan Spirit Fire, at least one 5th tier fire attribute heavenly and earthly Spirit is needed, along with a large number of
4th tier materials.
The 5th tier materials are rare and exotic treasures useful even to Transcendent Realm cultivators, and are not so easy to obtain.
However, 4th tier materials can still be found on the Profound Turtle
Continent.
Regardless, it’s best to gather them first. In the future, whether it’s used to cultivate the Chiyan Spirit Fire or for refining elixirs, either way is fine.
“4th tier treasure medicines are already rare, let alone specific fire elemental treasure medicines. Even our Xia Royal Family doesn’t have any.” Xia Wencheng, the Xia Ancestor, said with a bitter smile.
“Alright.” Wang Ping shook his head, not feeling disappointed.
The 4th tier treasure medicine is indeed rare on Profound Turtle Continent, so it’s normal that even the Xia Royal Family doesn’t have any.
Of course, they might have gotten some before, but they used them up.
One could only say that the Profound Turtle Continent is too small, and there is too little heavenly and earthly treasures.
Soon, Xia Wencheng and Wang Ping arrived at an alchemy room.
As for Xia Yuan and the old woman, they did not come here and left on their own.
After all, there was no point for the two of them to stay for what was about to
be done, and they couldn’t intervene either.
“Old lady, this is Fellow Cultivator Wang Ping. He brought the Yang Recovery Grass and will refine the Yang Recovery Elixir for me, so we came here to get the materials.’
Upon entering the alchemy room, Xia Wencheng spoke to an equally white-haired female cultivator.
This female cultivator was a 4th Tier Alchemist of the Xia Royal Family and also Xia Wenchengs Tao Companion, who had a prestigious reputation in the Xia Dynasty.
“Wang Ping, the recently rising star Sword Spirit Sect’s 4th-Tier Alchemist?
You have Yang Recovery Grass on you?”
Xia Wenchengs wife was first startled, and then she immediately flashed to Wang Pings side, her face full of surprise.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded, taking out the Yang Recovery Grass from his Storage Ring.
“It’s really Yang Recovery Grass, this is surprising indeed.” Xia Wenchengs wife’s eyes shone brightly, her face full of joy, and she reached out for the Yang Recovery Grass.
At this, Wang Pings brows furrowed slightly as he dodged her hand.
“What do you mean by this?” She seemed somewhat unhappy.
“This is my Yang Recovery Grass. I said I would refine the Yang Recovery Elixir, not give it to you to refine.” Wang Ping indifferently replied, “Of course, if you want to try refining it, that’s fine, but don’t blame me if you fail.”
“I’ve been refining medicines for over two hundred years and became a 4th Tier Alchemist a hundred years ago. If I fail, what makes you think you can succeed.” Xia Wenchengs wife snorted coldly, very dissatisfied with Wang Pings underestimation of her abilities.
“Old lady, he is a complete Spiritual Realm cultivation master.” Seeing his wife wanting to say something more, Xia Wencheng pulled her back with a bitter smile and reminded her.
His wife was generally good, but she was overly obsessed with alchemy and took little heed of the outside world. Even though she was over 200 years old now, she still did not understand many social principles, and her actions were a bit too direct.
Just now, she had reached out to grab the Yang Recovery Grass without any sense of propriety.
“Complete Spiritual Realm cultivation?” The old lady was shocked, staring wide-eyed at Wang Ping, an unbelieving look on her face. Such a young complete Spiritual Realm cultivator?
That was indeed astounding.
Her own cultivation was only at the 1st Tier of Spirit Origin Realm, and she had thought that Wang Pings cultivation would be higher than her own, but not by much. She hadn’t expected that Wang Pings strength would be so terrifying.
For that reason, even though she really wanted to say, “What’s the big deal with Complete Spiritual Realm Cultivation? High cultivation doesn’t necessarily mean high alchemy skills.”
In the end, she thought about what offending Wang Ping would mean and could only remain silent.
Although she didn’t understand the ways of the world, that didn’t mean she was foolish.
“Fellow Cultivator, my wife didn’t mean any harm, I hope you can pardon her.’
Xia Wencheng said to Wang Ping.
“It’s my fault.” Seeing that Xia Wencheng had apologized, the old lady could only apologize as well, “Fellow Cultivator, please give it a try.”
At this moment, the old lady had also realized the severity of the situation and understood her mistake, knowing that she had made a big error.lt made more sense to have Wang Ping refine it.
Even the strongest 4th Tier Alchemist could not guarantee 100% success in refining the Yang Recovery Elixir.
If it failed, that would be a big problem.
Because if Wang Ping failed, it wouldn’t be the fault of the Xia Royal Family.
By that time, if Wang Ping couldn’t fulfill his promise, he would owe the Xia Royal family a favor, which might be useful in the future.
As a result, the old woman who had reacted was really scared and apologized obediently.
Wang Ping nodded and calmly said, “Since you dare not refine the elixir, give way.”
The old woman got out of the way, embarrassed, and left the alchemy room with Xia Wencheng, waiting outside.
Two hours later, a refreshing elixir aroma appeared, shocking their minds.
Then, the door was pushed open, and Wang Ping threw the jade bottle containing the elixir to Xia Wencheng, smiling, “Here is your Yang Recovery Elixir. Now you can show me the way.”
Xia Wencheng took the jade bottle, opened it, and looked at it with joy on his face.
It was really the Yang Recovery Elixir.
And the old woman beside him was also shocked.
He had actually succeeded in refining it, and the quality was quite good too.
Wang Ping’s alchemy level was definitely no worse than hers and might even surpass her.
What kind of monster is he…? Not only is he very young with a Complete Spiritual Realm Cultivation, but he also has such a terrifying alchemy level!
For a moment, the old woman’s gaze towards Wang Ping changed, and she began to feel awe.
Her previous retreat was out of respect for Wang Pings cultivation, but now, it was genuine awe from the heart.
After Xia Wencheng received the elixir, he smiled and led Wang Ping away, heading towards the location of the forbidden area.
The entrance to the forbidden area was underground.
As Wang Ping entered the underground passage, he sensed a dangerous atmosphere coming from below, making his heart palpitate.
This made Wang Ping narrow his eyes.
Although he had learned about the extraordinary nature of this forbidden area through many life simulations, the firsthand experience was quite different.
“I don’t know what’s hidden in this forbidden area, and why there are such trials with precious spiritual tools as prizes.”
Wang Ping whispered to himself.
A spiritual tool was a treasure that only a Transcendent Realm cultivator could possess.
Any power without a Transcendent Realm cultivator but possessing a spiritual tool was either fortunate enough to obtain one or had a Transcendent Realm ancestor who passed it down after their death.
The Sword Spirit Sect fell under the former category, having had a Transcendent Realm Master many years ago.
However, no one in this world could live forever, so their Transcendent Realm Master had also perished.
Moreover, like the Chi Clan, the Sword Spirit Sect had once experienced a crisis of extermination, and many of its legacies had been lost in history.
Otherwise, the Sword Spirit Sect would not be without the secret skill to expand the Dantian.
History could bury many things, and many Cultivation Skills and secret skills could lose their lineage, either disappearing altogether or being undiscoverable.
In life simulations, those who could have a chance to find inheritance often became famous.
Like the demonic cultivator MO Fan and those talented young people with Great Perfection in the Spiritual Realm, they were all like that.
As Wang Pings thoughts raced, he followed Xia Wencheng to the depths of the passage and saw a gate with an evil ghost pattern on it.
Wang Ping stared at the evil ghost pattern on the portal, and an eerie cold air rushed at him, making him shudder involuntarily and his temples throb madly.
For a moment, Wang Ping had a feeling that there was something sinister hidden in this forbidden area.
“Do not stare at the evil ghost pattern; it will affect your state of mind. Some people stared at it too long and developed a Heart Demon. In addition, to open the forbidden area and enter the trial requires the use of 50,000 Lower-tier Spirit Stones and half an hour’s wait.”
Xia Wencheng saw Wang Ping staring at the evil ghost pattern and reminded him with a somber expression.
“Hmm.” Wang Ping came back to his senses and nodded.
Despite the uneasy feeling in his heart, Wang Ping remembered that nothing had happened in his life simulations and calmed down, waiting quietly..

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 70: Ancient Jade Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 70: Ancient Jade Reaction
Translator: 549690339
(PS: Please note, the content in Chapter 69 regarding the leading character’s concoction of medicine and his pre-forbidden-land simulation has been changed, QAQu )
Half an hour later, the voice of the ancestor Xia Wencheng of Xia dynasty rang out, prompting Wang Ping, who was resting his eyes, to open them.
“Fellow Taoist, the gate to the forbidden area has already been opened, you may enter now.
After nodding to ancestor Xia Wencheng, Wang Pings figure moved and jumped into it.
Soon, Wang Ping arrived in a very strange space.
In the sky, there was a round blood moon, giving one a sense of ill omen.
On the ground, there were many dry bones, some human-shaped and some beast-shaped.
Wang Ping stood in the sky, staring at these dry bones, his eyes squinting.
This forbidden area was indeed unusual.
Ordinary secret realm examination locations are unlikely to be set up like this. The impression here gave was more like an ancient battlefield left behind.
“The trial begins.”
“Detected that the cultivator’s cultivation is at the Spiritual Origin Realm Great
Perfection, bone age is 25, talent evaluation is average.”
“The trial target will be positioned at the Spiritual Origin Realm Great Perfection, the amount is 15, and the species is: zombies. Please kill them within ten minutes to pass the trial. If you can’t kill all the zombies within ten minutes, it will be considered a failure.’
At this moment, a somewhat chilly voice echoed in this space.
“A 25 -year-old Great Perfection in the Spirit Origin Realm with an average talent evaluation, what kind of place is this.”
Listening to this cold voice, Wang Pings heart stirred, he was very unsettled. Then, the ground trembled, and the rocks burst open. Zombies filled with an aura of death crawled out from the ground and stared at Wang Ping in the sky.
“Roar!”
As these zombies crawled out of the ground, they all opened their eyes, which were filled with green ghostly fire, and let out a hiss at Wang Ping, they rushed into the sky and attacked him.
At this, Wang Ping remained calm, raised his palm, and directly used the Sword Riding Skill.
In an instant, his Red Fire Spirit exploded from within his body, condensing into a flaming long sword, which carpet bombed the zombies.
Under Wang Pings formidable strength, these zombies were instantly killed and turned into powder.
The Red Fire Skill is an Earth-tier top-grade skill, making Wang Pings strength far superior to the average Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection.
Even if the zombies’ bodies were very tough, far stronger than the average Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, they still couldn’t be a match for Wang Ping.
What’s more, the fire-oriented cultivation skills are very effective against such dark things. Therefore, Wang Ping was able to easily kill them by using only the maneuvers of the Sword Riding Skill, without resorting to Sword Spirit.
The Sword Riding Skill might be of a lower Earth-tier grade, but mainly because it is cool enough and suitable for mowing, there is no advantage in numbers in front of Wang Ping.
“Trial successful, do you want to proceed to the second round of the trial?
After passing, you can get a great opportunity.”
As Wang Ping effortlessly killed all the zombies, the cold voice spoke again.
This time, it seemed to carry a hint of temptation.
Wang Pings eyelids twitched.
In his previous life simulations, Wang Ping had also fought in forbidden areas, but the results of those times were close calls.
At that time, Wang Ping was in the half-step Transcendent Realm.
If the half-step Transcendent Realm Wang Ping was on the verge of death, then his current self was even more so.
At the same time, Wang Ping picked up that this cold voice was different—it seemed to be not a rigid mechanism, but one with wisdom.
Therefore, Wang Ping pretended to ponder, showing a moved expression, but still muttered to himself: “The next trial will certainly be more difficult. It won’t be too late to come back when my strength is stronger.”
The moment Wang Ping said these words, the cold voice sounded again, faintly carrying a hint of regret:” Given that the candidate refuses to accept the second round of trials, the trial will end here.’
With these words, Wang Ping felt a fluctuation in space.
Following this, Wang Ping appeared in the tunnel outside the forbidden area, in front of him was a floating red longsword emitting an aura of spirituality.
This was clearly a Spirit Sword.
Looking at the Spirit Sword floating in the air, ancestor Xia Wencheng of the Xia dynasty was first taken aback, and then his eyes heated up.
The Spirit Sword, such a magnificent item that only the cultivators in the Transcendent Realm have the right to possess.
If a force had one such sword, it could be used to suppress the foundation.
A cultivator at the Ninth Tier of the Spiritual Realm possessing a Spirit Sword can easily kill a cultivator at the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Realm.
It should be noted that it is not difficult to break through the Ninth Tier of the Spiritual Realm, but it is extremely difficult to reach the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Realm.
If the Xia Royal Family had such a Spirit Sword, it might be able to last for a thousand years like the Sword Spirit Sect.
However, ancestor Xia Wencheng of the Xia dynasty quickly sobered up and let out a bitter smile.
The treasures were enticing, but he didn’t have the guts to try to snatch MJang Pings things.
After all, from the moment Wang Ping entered until now, it was only about a
minute’s time.
Such a short amount of time, and the trial was already completed.
This showed that Wang Ping was not just powerful in terms of cultivation, his
combat power must have reached a whopping level.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to instantly kill five enemies of the same realm in a flash.
Such power was a bit too terrifying.
Perhaps only those geniuses of ancient times who had broken through to the
Transcendent Realm could be on par with him when they had reached the Great Perfection of the Spirit Origin Realm.
Therefore, trying to get his hands on Wang Pings things was a death wish, and it would even bring disaster to the entire Xia Royal Family.
“However, once Xia Yuan, that girl, grows up, our Xia royal family may not be without a chance of obtaining a Spirit Sword. Only, by that time, I might have passed away..”

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 70: Ancient Jade Reaction_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 70: Ancient Jade Reaction_2
Translator: 549690339
Xia Wencheng thought of Xia Yuan again, feeling gratified but also somewhat regretful.
“A Fire Attribute Spirit Sword, huh? It actually matches the cultivation skill 1 practice. ”
Wang Ping gripped the spirit sword, feeling the scorching sensation it gave off, and nodded in satisfaction.
Some spiritual tools have their own attributes.
Fire Attribute Spirit Swords could unleash powerful flames, amplifying the strength of fire attribute spiritual essence, allowing fire attribute cultivators to display even greater power.
However, for a Spiritual Realm cultivator to obtain a spiritual sword is already a heavenly opportunity; wanting to obtain a spiritual tool that matches one’s own attribute is an extremely difficult thing.
Only Transcendent Realm cultivators have the ability to specifically search for spiritual tools that match their attributes and combat styles.
“The sword is called Flaming Fire? Nice name.”
Wang Ping saw the two characters ‘Flaming Fire’ engraved on the sword hilt and couldn’t help but chuckle softly before putting it into his storage ring.
“Fellow Taoist, since our transaction is complete, I’ll take my leave.” Afterward, Wang Ping looked at the Great Summer Ancestor Xia Wencheng and spoke.
Xia Wencheng nodded first, and then said, “If you want to enter the forbidden area again, this old man can still guide you.”
“Hmm.” Wang Ping did not refuse.
After all, he would eventually come to explore the forbidden area.
Of course, before his strength was strong enough, he planned to enter the forbidden area through simulation instead.
After all, there seemed to be a lot of hidden secrets in there. If he entered in person, there might still be dangers.
If a butterfly effect occurred accidentally, and something happened inside, he would die with his eyes unwilling to close at death.
“Speaking of which, fellow Taoist, I have a favor to ask.”
At this moment, Wang Ping remembered another reason for coming down the mountain and said to Xia Wencheng.
“What is it?” Xia Wencheng was a bit surprised and curious. “If it’s something that this old man can do, I will do my best.”
“l have a Spirit Realm Elixir here, and 1 would like to ask your Xia Royal Family to host an auction for me.”
Wang Ping took out the Spirit Realm Elixirs from his storage ring and spoke.
Spirit Realm Elixirs were of no use to him, so it would be better to auction them off and exchange them for a large number of Spirit Stones.
Although he still had over 30,000 Spirit Stones on his body, his life simulations were quite frequent, and they would run out after a while.
Therefore, earning more Spirit Stones to keep on hand was very important.
There were many auction houses in Xia, but the largest one was still the one run by the Xia Royal Family.
As a result, handing over the elixir to the Xia Auction House for auction was the most appropriate choice and would maximize the benefits.
“Spirit Realm Elixirs! ”
Xia Wenchengs face was full of surprise.
Although the value of Spirit Realm Elixirs in Daya was not as high as Yang Recovery Elixirs, it was still a very precious elixir. They were highly sought after by cultivators below the sixth-tier of the Spiritual Realm and often sold at astronomical prices.
“Speaking of which, our Xia Auction is about to start, and my grandson has been worried about not finding a suitable finale item. It’s just the right time for you to come forward with this elixir.”
Immediately, Xia Wencheng laughed and said.
“As a token of my gratitude, I will exempt you from the commission for this auction on behalf of my grandson.”
“Well, then I’ll leave this to your Xia Royal Family. I will be staying in the Imperial City for a while, waiting for the auction to commence.” Wang Ping nodded, not caring whether Xia Wencheng was lying to curry favor with him or if it was really true.
Anyway, all he needed were low-tier Spirit Stones.
“Hehe, I’ll still have Yuan’er accompany you around, so as to prevent some mischievous people from causing any unpleasantness to you.
Xia Wencheng nodded and suggested.
“l think having Xia Yuan follow me would attract more trouble, actually.”
Wang Ping spoke with a hidden meaning.
Xia Wencheng was stunned.
However, it didn’t take long for the cunning old man to understand Wang Pings meaning.
Nowadays, many forces in Daya were watching to see who could inherit the throne.
In fact, in the hearts of these old guys, the next emperor had already been decided internally. It was only because they wanted to hone Xia Yuan that these old fellows hadn’t made a stand and explicitly supported Xia Yuan.
“Hehe, they wouldn’t dare. For the sake of Daya, if they still dared to do something, I wouldn’t mind sending them all to the border.”
Xia Wencheng then spoke coldly.
If it weren’t for using them as a whetstone for Xia Yuan, he would have dealt with these little brats long ago. They only knew how to engage in internal strife and couldn’t see the current state of Daya at all.
“Maybe. But still, I don’t want Xia Yuan to follow me. I prefer to wander alone.” Wang Ping shook his head slightly and said.
He could tell that Xia Wencheng hadn’t given up on matchmaking him with Xia Yuan.
However, that was clearly an impossible thing to happen. Instead of getting married, he would rather go to the brothel if he felt lonely.
Seeing Wang Ping clearly refuse, Xia Wencheng could only nod regretfully, leading Wang Ping away from the passage.
Afterward, Wang Ping left the imperial palace and wandered around the city.
At this point, the sky had dimmed.
However, the Imperial City was even more lively after dark than during the day, with countless candles and lanterns lit, more stalls lining the streets, bustling crowds, and a very lively atmosphere.
After enjoying himself, Wang Ping checked into a classic inn in the Imperial City.
The auction would take place a week later.
During this week, the Xia Royal Family would spread the news of the Spirit Realm Elixirs to attract Spiritual Realm experts from Xia and even other places to participate in the auction, thus maximizing the benefits.
As a result, Wang Ping would still be staying in the Imperial City for another week.
The next day, early morning, Wang Ping opened his eyes, ending a night of cultivation.
“A new day, I wonder how my luck will be, a round of life simulation to see the situation.”
Wang Ping chuckled and spoke directly in his mind.
“System, I want to start a paid simulation.”
“Ding, paid simulation, consuming 2000 low-tier spirit stones, do you want to spend?”
“Spend.” Wang Ping nodded.
“Spending successful, Life Simulator started, refreshing talent… ‘
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on refreshing the Green
Talent Beast Taming Master, Life Simulation begins.”
Upon hearing the system’s voice, Wang Ping was slightly surprised.
Beast Taming Master, this talent appeared again.
Though last time, it wasn’t really useful.
However, having a green talent in today’s first simulation was a good omen.
While Wang Ping was feeling emotional, the luminescent screen appeared, and words also floated up subsequently.
[Daya calendar 480, April 24th, you continue to play in the Imperial City.]
[Six days later, you participate in the auction. Unexpectedly, at the auction, you discover an ancient artifact that responds to the ancient jade given to you by the village chief, and you are astonished…. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm!
Translator: 549690339
[You are very surprised that the ancient jade reacted and spent 5,000 lower-tier spiritual stones to successfully win the bid for this red orb. After the auction, you begin to study this red orb. You find that, even if you use all your strength, you cannot leave a trace on it, which amazes you.]
[However, the ancient jade reacts again, causing the red orb to start shining. Then the red orb becomes transparent, and at the same time, a drop of blood appears in front of you, which shocks you.]
[Because you feel an extremely powerful energy fluctuation from it. You suspect that this drop of blood is the blood essence of a super-strong expert, and it is very likely that it was left by a Chi Clan expert. Otherwise, the ancient jade would not have reacted.]
[Next, you want to collect this drop of blood essence and leave the Imperial City. However, the energy waves formed by this drop of blood essence have been dissipated, attracting the attention of many powerful experts in the Imperial City.]
[Some Spiritual Realm experts surround you, intending to make you hand over the treasure. To this, you react coldly. Wealth moves hearts, and these Spiritual Realm experts start to disregard the threat that you are an elder of the Sword Spirit Sect and want to attack you to seize the chance.]
[As a result, you reveal your astonishing power and easily kill every enemy who comes to attack you, then leave the Imperial City with ease. After this battle, your name becomes known throughout the world. The whole world knows that you are an invincible strong expert in the Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection.]
[Even the Sword Spirit Sect didn’t expect you to be so powerful and was shocked. They guess that you had been hiding your strength before. For a while, they began to doubt your purpose in joining the Sword Spirit Sect. With such strength and being a 4th Tier Alchemist, there was no need to join their Sword Spirit Sect at all.]
[At this time, you don’t return to the Sword Spirit Sect but find a secluded mountain forest to swallow the blood essence in an attempt to break through to the Transcendent Realm. You have a premonition that the energy contained in this drop of blood essence is enough to compete with the massive high-tier spiritual stones needed for a breakthrough to the Transcendent Realm.]
[As expected, after three months of closed-door cultivation, you successfully break through to the first realm of the Transcendent Realm – the Spirit Sea Realm. The liquid spiritual essence in your Elixir Field surges like an ocean, becoming extremely powerful. It is only then that you truly feel the power of the Transcendent Realm. In your memory, you were able to fight
Transcending State Demons beyond your realm only because of the peak Sword Spirit and the extremely strong Red Fire Skill. Otherwise, it would have been very difficult for you to harm a Transcending State Demon with only half-step Transcendent Realm.]
[After breaking through to the Spirit Sea Realm, you are in high spirits, and your plan to continue on the imperial path is abandoned. After all, doing so has lost its meaning. Once you reach the Spirit Sea Realm, lower-tier spirit stones have little effect on your cultivation, and you need mid-tier spirit stones and even top-tier spirit stones to cultivate faster.]
[You’re well aware that it’s extremely difficult to advance further while staying on Profound Turtle Continent. As a result, you have thoughts of leaving Profound Turtle Continent.]
[However, before leaving, you plan to explore the Xia Royal Family Forbidden Area one more time to uncover its secrets. You enter the Xia Royal Family Forbidden Area, undergo a second round of trials, and die there.] [Because of your death, this simulation ends…]
Wang Ping is dumbfounded while looking at the simulation content.
Originally, he was overjoyed to break through to the Transcendent Realm, thinking he could conquer the entire world.
However, after the breakthrough, he didn’t even live a month and died unexpectedly…
Even the entire Profound Turtle Continent probably didn’t know that he had already broken through to the Transcendent Realm, and he died just like that.
This seemed too ridiculous.
“It seems that this forbidden area is indeed more terrifying than I had imagined. ”
After Wang Ping comes back to his senses, his expression becomes extremely grave.
He has known about the danger of the Xia Forbidden Land for a long time. After breaking through to the half-step Transcendent Realm and venturing into it, he almost perished.
But he didn’t expect that after breaking through to the Transcendent Realm and entering again, he would die directly, which is outrageous.
The stronger he becomes, the faster he dies, making this place extremely eerie.
“Perhaps, the trial still had me fight against undead of the same realm. But… 1 just broke through to the Transcendent Realm and might be considered quite ordinary in the Transcendent Realm. Fighting against five, or even more, enemies of the same realm at once, it’s normal to die.’
Wang Ping contemplates for a moment with various thoughts flashing through his mind.
After all, the further back in the realm, the more complicated it is.
Before reaching the half-step Transcendent Realm, you could be massacring your opponents crazily and even fighting beyond your realm, but the Transcendent Realm is different.
Those who can break through to the Transcendent Realm are by no means simple, and if you still want to fight multiple opponents at once, or even fight beyond your realm, it becomes extremely difficult.
Unless your innate talent far exceeds the level of the Transcendent Realm, you can continue to fight beyond your level. “I was reckless, or rather, arrogant.”
Wang Ping lets out a bitter smile.
It’s normal for his mentality to change within this life simulation after breaking through to the Transcendent Realm.
After all, he has tried many times, and each time it ended in failure.
It’s not easy to finally break through to the Transcendent Realm and become truly invincible in the world. Wanting to explore the secret of the forbidden area is a normal thing.
However, in his memory, he never perished in the forbidden area, and after achieving Transcendence, he thought it would be even more impossible..

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm! 2
Translator: 549690339
“I thought I would be invincible in the Transcendent Realm, but I died even faster. Thank goodness for the Life Simulator. Otherwise, I would have run out of lives crossing over to the Profound World.”
After calming down, Wang Ping shook his head and couldn’t help but sigh.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
Initial Cultivation of Spirit Sea Realm.”
“There’s only one reward. Aren’t you just forcing me to choose cultivation?”
Wang Ping looked at the reward in front of him and couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth.
As expected, Wang Ping had no room for choice. His cultivation began to rise rapidly, his Elixir Field expanded rapidly, and earth- shattering changes were taking place.
At the same time, the red, flame-like Spiritual Essence quickly liquefied and formed an ocean of liquid Spiritual Essence in the expanding Elixir Field. Fortunately, the process of cultivation upgrade by the system was quiet…
Otherwise, if it caused a commotion, the entire Imperial City would have suffered.
Under the pressure of the Spirit Sea Domain Stronger, let alone the tens of millions of ordinary people in the Imperial City, even the Innate Realm Cultivators would have been directly crushed to death by the pressure of the Spirit Sea Domain.
Only the Spirit Element Realm Great Perfection Cultivators or those Genius Spirit Realm Cultivators could barely resist the pressure.
The Transcendent Realm was indeed too powerful, and even the Spiritual Realm Experts could hardly resist its pressure.
“There really is no choice for me.”
Wang Ping could only smile helplessly as he felt the powerful force within him.
Breaking through into the Spirit Sea Realm was a good thing.
This powerful feeling was indeed fascinating.
However, after breaking through into the Spirit Sea Realm, the amount of Spiritual Stones he needed to consume for life simulations would definitely increase significantly.
He was afraid that the Spiritual Stones he could obtain on the small Profound Turtle Continent would not be enough for many simulations.
This was simply forcing him to leave the small Profound Turtle Continent.
“Well, it’s not the system’s fault for forcing me. This life simulation was too short, and there was simply no possibility for other rewards to appear.”
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief, calmed down, and completely restrained his aura to prevent it from leaking out.
Then, Wang Ping asked in his heart: “System, how many Spiritual Stones do I need to consume for a paid simulation now?”
“Ding, to conduct a paid simulation, you need 1,000 Mid-tier Spirit Stones or 20 top-tier Spirit Stones. The host does not have enough Spirit Stones and cannot conduct a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
He knew that after the breakthrough, things would become very troublesome.
However, he didn’t expect things to be this complicated.
After breaking through into the Spirit Sea Realm, he could no longer use Lower-tier Spirit Stones for simulations.
Of course, considering the exchange ratio between Mid-tier and Lower-tier Spirit Stones, even if he could use Lower-tier Spirit Stones for paid simulations, he would probably need to spend ten or even tens of thousands of Lower-tier Spirit Stones for a single simulation.
It was estimated that even if he emptied the entire Profound Turtle Continent, he wouldn’t be able to afford many simulations.
“This opportunity is truly mixed with both fortune and misfortune.” Wang Ping shook his head and could only sigh.
This opportunity directly solved his long- standing problem of breaking through to the Transcendent Realm.
However, due to this opportunity, his plan was completely disrupted, and he lost the ability to use paid simulations.
Of course, Wang Ping didn’t dwell on the problem.
Since he had already broken through, it was time to consider his next plan.
If he couldn’t use paid simulations, he could just rely on free ones.
Although it would take ten days to accumulate one use, it would be sufficient for exploring a safe path.
Moreover, he could also try to obtain some Spirit Stones from the members of his group. After all, there were more solutions than difficulties.
Wang Pings only concern was the possible group tasks.
Although he now had the Initial Cultivation of Spirit Sea Realm, without enough free simulation chances, he still felt uneasy.
After all, group tasks were too dangerous. In the last group task, strength was important, and completing the task required sufficient strength. However, strength was not the most critical factor. Without the Life Simulator, they would have all been wiped out.
“However, there’s no point in thinking too much. Next, just wait for the auction to begin.”
Wang Ping shook his head and began cultivating to stabilize his realm and get used to the powerful force of the Spirit Sea Realm.
Otherwise, he might not even be able to use more than 50% of his full power.
In the blink of an eye, six days had passed, and the auction was about to begin. Wang Ping opened his eyes.
“Although control of my power is still lacking and requires a lot of actual combat to perfect, my realm is much more stable now. It’s time to attend the
auction.”
With that, Wang Ping stood up and vanished on the spot.
The Xia Auction House was located in the central area of the Xia Imperial City, with roads stretching in all directions.
At this moment, on numerous major roads, there were bustling crowds. Many cultivators and dignitaries lined up in an orderly manner to enter the venue.
However, Wang Ping, being a distinguished figure, didn’t need to wait in line. When he arrived at the entrance of the auction house, a lavishly dressed auction big shot promptly greeted him and invited him inside,
“Mr. Wang, I’ll be waiting outside the door. If you have any instructions, just call me..

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 71: Breaking Through the Transcendent Realm! _3
Translator: 549690339
The lady in the brocade dress spoke very respectfully to Wang Ping.
Although she had a noble status and her strength had reached the Innate Realm, she was nothing in front of Wang Ping.
After all, he was a 4th-Tier Alchemist, a Spiritual Realm Expert, and a Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect. Wang Ping was the big shot that her backstage boss strictly reminded her not to slight in any way.
Even if Wang Ping wanted to do something, even if she had a noble status and was a big shot in the auction, she couldn’t have any thoughts of resisting, or she would lose her head.
Of course, if Wang Ping took a fancy to her, it would be her honor.
“Hmm, you can go out and wait.” Wang Ping nodded, his expression calm.
At this, the lady in the brocade dress sneaked a glance at him, then left the room disappointed when she saw that Wang Ping had no interest in her. “Red Treasured Pearl, Chi Clan strongman’s Blood Essence, huh.”
Wang Ping leaned against the luxurious sofa chair in the room, squinting his eyes as he looked at the auction stage below through the one-way glass.
Only after breaking through to the Spirit Sea Realm could Wang Ping more profoundly feel how terrifying this drop of Blood Essence that appeared in the Life Simulator actually was.
With just a drop of Blood Essence, he could break through to the Spirit Sea Realm.
It’s hard to imagine how powerful the owner of this drop of Blood Essence was in his lifetime.
At least a Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman, right?
No, if a Spirit Embryo Realm strongman’s blood essence could easily allow someone to break through to the Spirit Sea Realm, then they could mass-produce Spirit Sea Realm cultivators, right?
Though the Transcendent Realm has three realms, and the gap between each realm is huge, it shouldn’t be so outrageous.
Could it be that the owner of this drop of Blood Essence was a Spirit Accumulation Realm expert?
Or, even above that…
“If it’s really that powerful, then what force could have wiped out the Chi Clan and forced them to flee to the Profound Turtle Continent? Even then, they still couldn’t escape their grasp.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
The more powerful he got, the more he understood how terrifying the Chi Clan’s enemy was.
His previous self was just too naive.
As Wang Ping was lost in thought, he also noticed that there were more and more cultivators in the auction house.
Especially the people in the private rooms, all of them had cultivation levels of at least Innate Perfection Realm.
Of course, the Innate Realm cultivators wouldn’t have been eligible for private rooms, but they were there representing all major forces.
In the entire auction, there were as many as twenty Spiritual Realm experts, including three experts of the Spiritual Realm Seventh Tier or above.
Among them, there was a Spiritual Realm expert who hid his presence very well. He didn’t stay in the private room but sat in the ordinary seats, having reached an astonishing Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier.
Besides that, Wang Ping sensed a familiar aura.
It was the aura of a Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder.
“No wonder in the Life Simulator, there are Spiritual Realm experts who dare to snatch my things without fearing the Sword Spirit Sect. They indeed have some ability.”
After scanning the entire place with his Spiritual Sense, Wang Ping smiled playfully.
If a Spiritual Realm Seventh-Tier strongman is a loose cultivator, they might not dare to easily offend the Sword Spirit Sect but would not need to fear the Sword Spirit Sect, either.
Although the Sword Spirit Sect is powerful, I’m a carefree wanderer. What can you do to me? If I’m irritated, I’ll wage guerrilla warfare, and crazily kill Sword Spirit Sect disciples.
In that case, the Sword Spirit Sect would also be bewildered.
Therefore, in the Xia empire, no matter which force it is, they will not easily offend Spiritual Realm experts, especially those above the Spiritual Realm
7th-Tier..

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 72: The Second Group Task
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 72: The Second Group Task
Translator: 549690339
None of the cultivators noticed Wang Pings Spiritual Sense scan.
After all, the gap between the Spiritual Realm and Spirit Sea Realm was too great, and only upon reaching the Spirit Sea Realm could one develop Spiritual Sense.
Next, Wang Ping withdrew his Spiritual Sense and awaited the start of the auction.
Soon, the auction began.
The items auctioned off at the beginning were valuable, but only relative to Innate Realm cultivators.
However, such items were already enough to heat up the auction atmosphere.
Ultimately, although the Innate Realm was too weak for Wang Ping now, when looking at the whole Xia, it was actually considered strong. Items precious to the Innate Realm were no longer considered ordinary.
Wang Ping silently watched, waiting for the appearance of the Red Orb.
At his level, only items valued above spiritual tools or 5th Tier Elixirs could attract his attention. Even Quasi-Spiritual Artifacts were no more than ordinary to him.
“Next, the item to be auctioned is the Red Orb. This Red Orb was accidentally obtained by an Innate Realm Expert, who found the material extremely tough, unable to leave any damage on it even with full force. As a result, we specially invited a treasure appraiser master and a Spiritual Realm Expert to study it, and found that even a Spiritual Realm Expert could not leave any damage on it. ”
The Female Auctioneer spoke in an enticing tone.
“So, we suspect that the origin of this Red Orb is not simple, and it may be a spiritual tool.”
‘Hehe, a spiritual tool? Do you think we’re stupid, who would auction a spiritual tool.’
“Just a hard bead, though a little special, but it can only be used to refine a tool at most. With Xia’s Refiner Masters’ level, it is extremely rare to refine a Quasi-Spiritual Artifact, let alone a spiritual tool, dream on.”
“Tsk, isn’t this just to inflate the price? Don’t treat everyone like fools.”
“Exactly.”
As soon as the Female Auctioneer finished speaking, the venue became noisy, and some powerful cultivators scoffed at it.
This made the Female Auctioneer a little embarrassed.
However, she was after all the exclusive auctioneer for Xia’s largest auction, and instantly adjusted her mood, smiled charmingly, and said, “Every word I say is true, this bead is indeed not simple. So the starting price is five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones, and each increase must not be less than one hundred Lower-tier Spirit Stones.”
“If a Spiritual Realm Expert cannot leave any damage on it, it can be considered valuable. But if it is only hard, it cannot be used as a weapon, and such a small item is not even enough to refine a flying dagger.”
“This thing is only of collectible significance, right? However, who would spend five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones to collect this thing? Five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones are not a small sum for Spiritual Realm
Experts.”
The cultivators on the scene were all discussing.
Wang Ping glanced at the crowd, smiled faintly, and said, “Five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones.”
Seeing Wang Ping speak, the cultivators on the scene were a little surprised, recognizing that the private room was Wang Pings.
After all, Wang Pings participation in the auction was not concealed.
They did not expect Wang Ping to spend five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones to buy this item.
For a moment, many people had thoughts like “Could it be that Wang Ping saw the extraordinariness of this item?” flashing through their minds.
But in the end, they dismissed the idea.
For an Alchemist, five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones were nothing. If
Wang Ping had a hobby of collecting rare and exotic treasures, spending five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones would be normal. “Five thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones once.” “Five thousand Lower-tier Spiritual Stones twice.”
“Five thousand Lower-tier Spiritual Stones three times.”
“Congratulations to Mr. Wang in the number one private room for successfully bidding on the Red Orb.”
Seeing that no one was bidding, the Female Auctioneer had no choice but to finalize the deal with a hint of helplessness.
Next, new items were placed on the stage, and a new round of competition began.
After Wang Ping successfully auctioned the Red Orb, he nodded in satisfaction.
However, he did not leave but continued to watch the auction, wanting to see if he could pick up any more items.
After all, in his life simulation, he only had the Perfect Level of Spiritual Realm cultivation and hadn’t developed Spiritual Sense. He might miss out on some treasures.
Unfortunately, Wang Ping ultimately overthought it. The possibility of picking up rare and exotic treasures at an auction on Profound Turtle Continent was too low.
In the end, Wang Ping gained nothing.
As for the last item in the auction, which was the Spirit Realm Elixirs that Wang Ping had refined, they caused many Spiritual Realm Experts to go crazy, and they were auctioned off at a price of fifty thousand Lower-tier Spirit Stones, and were won by a Spiritual Realm Ninth Tier cultivator.
However, the Elixirs were useless for his cultivation, and they should have been prepared for his disciples or descendants.
As the auction ended, the people in the scene orderly left, and Wang Pings items and the Spirit Stones from the auction of the Spiritual Realm Elixirs were respectfully presented to him by a brocade robe woman waiting outside.
Upon taking these items, Wang Ping immediately left the auction and headed to the Black Wind Forest.
In the depths of Black Wind Forest, when Wang Ping returned, the people of Chi Village revealed their joy and welcomed him back.
“Village Chief, this is your Chi Clan’s Red Fire Skill.”
Wang Ping handed the copied Red Fire Skill to the village chief and said with a smile.
The Red Fire Skill was originally a unique technique of the Chi Clan. Since he had already obtained the complete Red Fire Skill, it was only right to give Chi
Village a copy of it..

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 72: The Second Group Task 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 72: The Second Group Task 2
Translator: 549690339
“Red Fire Skill, is this the complete set?”
The village chief took the Red Fire Skill and seemed a bit dumbfounded.
The Red Fire Skill had been lost for many years, and he thought there was no chance of it ever seeing the light of day again. Surprisingly, Wang Ping managed to gather the upper and middle scrolls in a short time, which was truly astounding.
“It seems that the Red Fire Skill and you have a strong connection. Or perhaps you’re someone with great luck and fortune,” the village chief looked at Wang Ping and marveled.
“Hehe,” Wang Ping chuckled lightly, not saying much.
The matters of affinity and fortune were all illusory.
Without the Life Simulator, he would never have been able to gather the Red Fire Skill.
Even with the Life Simulator, it took him a lot of time to barely gather the scrolls.
However, some things are better left unsaid and only understood in his heart.
“Village Chief, the Red Fire Skill records a secret technique for awakening the Spiritual Body of your Chi Clan. You can let Chifeng give it a try,” Wang Ping suggested after a moment of contemplation.
“l know,” the village chief nodded, looking somewhat expectant.
Of course, he was well aware that the chances of success were slim.
After all, there had always been a vague rumor circulating in their Chi Clan.
The so-called Bloodline Curse was not that simple,
The origin of their Chi Clan wasn’t any Spirit Clan either.
It’s just that this rumor had been passed down for so long that even their own people didn’t know whether it was an exaggeration or the truth.
For the next three months, Wang Ping practiced his cultivation in Chi Village.
He occasionally teased the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, rode it to hunt, and searched for precious treasures deep in the Black Wind Forest to prepare for future alchemy refining.
As for the Red Orb, knowing its function, Wang Ping no longer considered using the Ancient Jade to extract the Blood Essence from it.
This item might have other significant uses. Now that he had reached the Spirit Sea Realm Cultivation, using the Blood Essence to cultivate seemed like a waste.
It can be said that he could improve his cultivation by practicing, but he must do it within the Life Simulator.
If he used it up in real life, there would be nothing left in the Life Simulator, which would be a loss.
“Still not working?”
Seeing that Chifengs cultivation of the Red Fire Skill was smooth, but the
Spiritual Body still didn’t appear, Wang Ping shook his head, unsurprised.
The Chi Clan’s Bloodline Curse was too terrifying. The powerful person who cast the curse most likely surpassed the Transcendent Realm.
Breaking the curse with an Earth-tier top-grade skill was just a pipe dream.
If it were that simple, the Chi Clan would never have fallen from grace and become so desolate.
Subsequently, Wang Ping turned his attention away from Chifengs situation and opened the chat group.
During this time, Wang Ping had been busy cultivating, trying to master his own power, and searching for treasures deep in the Black Wind Forest. He hardly had the time to chat in the group. At most, he’d occasionally glance at the messages to avoid missing any important information.
As a result, he was aware of some situations in the group.
For example, among the three newcomers, Ye Xiaofan successfully joined the Immortal Sect. His world – also a cultivation world.
His Immortal Sect was called Ice Cloud Cave Heaven, one of the top ten Immortal Sects in a country with a Golden Elixir Stage cultivator presiding over it.
Upon discovering that Ye Xiaofan had a Sacred Body, they were overjoyed and immediately began grooming him as their future successor. They hoped that Ye Xiaofan would lead Ice Cloud Cave Heaven to become a Holy Land with many nations coming to pay their respects.
Admittedly, Ye Xiaofan indeed had extraordinary luck. The attribute of his awakened Sacred Body was ice, just fitting for Ice Cloud Cave Heaven.
Otherwise, even if Ice Cloud Cave Heaven knew of Ye Xiaofan’s Sacred Body, they wouldn’t have known how to cultivate him, and would have only wasted his potential.
As for Qin Tian, he was even luckier than Ye Xiaofan.
Though he never mentioned his Golden Finger, the fact that he was taken as a personal disciple by a big shot of the Holy Land showed that his Golden Finger was extraordinary.
At the same time, he had also inquired about the situation of his Thunder Realm Holy Land.
His master was a late-stage Primordial Infant cultivator and an Inner Sect Elder of Thunder Realm Holy Land.
On the surface of Thunder Realm Holy Land, there was a God Transformation Stage elder presiding over it.
Well…on the surface…
It’s unthinkable what kind of old monsters could be hiding in the background.
In addition, it was rumored that Thunder Realm Holy Land had once birthed an immortal who ascended to the Immortal World.
One could say that the force it belonged to was absolutely fierce.
In terms of background, Qin Tian was unbeatable among the group members.
As for Wang Shuqi, he was the unluckiest of the three newcomers who survived. His place of crossing was in the wild, and if it weren’t for the food he had prepared before crossing and the Golden Finger that drastically improved his defense, he would have already become food for the beasts.
About a month had passed, and he still hadn’t been able to leave the mountains and forests.
However, this also showed that his cross-world wasn’t some dangerous Transcendent World. Otherwise, he would have long perished.
Of course, this was the group members’ current speculation. The specifics would have to wait for him to encounter intelligent life in this world before making a judgment.
Besides, the old group members also had their own experiences. Other than Chen Yao, who almost got killed by demons and Zhang Jun, who almost got skinned alive by mutated zombies, the rest were relatively safe.
As soon as Wang Ping opened the chat group, a system notification sounded abruptly, causing him to freeze.
“Ding, abnormality detected in the world where group member Chen Yao resides; Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is mandatory for five participants. Acting group masters, please select five group members to participate in the task promptly. If no selection is made in ten minutes, the system will randomly select five members to be sent to Chen Yao’s world for the task..

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 72: The Second Group Task_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 72: The Second Group Task_3
Translator: 549690339
“Another group task again…”
Wang Pings expression became serious.
After three months of silence in the chat group, a group task has finally appeared again.
This interval is a bit short.
Besides this, is it to eliminate the bizarreness again….
Could it be that the meaning of the chat group sending them on these crossworld journeys is truly to eliminate these oddities appearing in different worlds?
As all kinds of thoughts flashed through Wang Pings mind, the chat group had already exploded.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn it, another group task, it’s only been a little over three months, and we already have another one. I’m going numb.”
Wu Jun (20): “This time…it’s a bit tight. I’m a bit panicked.”
Fang Yun (3): “Sigh, it seems like the chat group is more dangerous than we imagined. But, there are only five participants in this task….and we can choose, this should be considered good news. If it were the last time’s forced participation, it’d really make my hair stand on end.”
Zhang Hu (5): “The acting group master… mean Mr. Wang chooses, right? Mr.
Wang, I want to participate in the group task, please let me join.”
Zhang Jun (70): “You’re quite proactive this time… aren’t you afraid of dying?”
Zhang Hu (5): “I’m afraid of dying, but I don’t have a choice. If I don’t get stronger soon, the probability of me dying later is only going to get higher. This time 1 got some magic scrolls from my mentor, which should give me some life- saving ability.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “That makes sense. I’ll join too. After three months of cultivation, along with some luck, I’ve finally managed to break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm. If I can contribute in the task and gain more points, and get a hundred thousand points or a million group points, I can buy the resurrection tally or the Optimized Golden Finger.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Group Task, it really is heart-stirring. I wonder how awesome my sacred body will be after optimization. But considering that I just started the cultivation path, my cultivation is just in the qi refining stage, I should take it easy, I hope Mr.Wang won’t pick me.”
Qin Tian (77): “Ahem, I’m like Ye Xiaofan. Though the future looks promising, we are still future soldiers, not suitable for group tasks. Not until I break through the Foundation Establishment Stage, I’m not confident.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Exactly, at least get to the Foundation Establishment Stage.” To tell the truth, Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian were really somewhat panicked.
They had such a good start and didn’t want to risk participating in the group task. It’s not just worth it for those group points.
With their current cultivation environment and staying low, they felt it was the best path to develop themselves.
Wang Ping (66): “Oh, you two. Weren’t you very cocky during this period? You boasted about yourself a lot in the group.”
Fang Yun (3): “Hehe, these two braggarts are finally scared now. Recently, I almost got an internal injury due to their arrogance.” Liu Mei (15):
Ye Xiaofan (75): “I’m shivering, I won’t boast anymore.”
Qin Tian (77): “Please spare me, boss.”
They really weren’t offended by Wang Pings teasing.
They had not expected that the participants of the group task would be chosen by Wang Ping.
Now, no matter who they offended, they dare not offend Wang Ping anymore.
If Wang Ping designated them to participate in the task, it would undoubtedly be dangerous.
If Wang Ping played tricks on them during the task, that would really be a game over situation.
Before they could grow, they didn’t want their journey to end prematurely..

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 73: Simulating the Demons’ World
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 73: Simulating the Demons’ World
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “I’m definitely participating in this Group Task. Including Cai
Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and local Chen Yao, we still need one more person.
Anyone who wants to apply may speak up.”
Wang Ping didn’t continue teasing the two ‘kings’ but started to talk about serious matters.
Following Wang Ping’s speech, the group members who had previously expressed their unwillingness to participate remained silent.
Wu Jun (20): ‘1 1 haven’t gotten any powerful weapons yet, so if I go, I would be a burden. I won’t go.”
Liu Mei (15): “Me too…”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Although I want to join in the fun, I don’t want to continue being a savage, but occupying a spot doesn’t seem right either, so forget it.” Fang Yun (3): “I’m so useless and also a burden, so 1 won’t join in the fun.”
Zhang Jun (70): ‘
For a moment, the atmosphere in the group chat was somewhat heavy.
Besides those who signed up, the rest clearly didn’t want to participate in the Group Task because it was really dangerous.
At this, Wang Ping frowned slightly.
It seemed like the last Group Task had scared many people.
In this case, it seemed like the final selection could only be determined by random drawing.
Zhang Jun (70): “I’ll participate. Staying in the Zombie World has made me much stronger, but I’m about to go crazy.”
Seeing Zhang Jun speak up, the remaining group members all breathed a sigh of relief, feeling extremely fortunate.
Thanks to Zhang Jun volunteering, otherwise they might still be forced to participate in the Group Task, which would be tantamount to asking for death.
Seeing Zhang Jun volunteering, Wang Ping also praised him.
During the first Group Task, his feelings for Zhang Hu and Zhang Jun had decreased significantly.
But now, with this Group Task, their active participation had improved Wang Pings impression of them.
They might not be good people, but at least they were brave and dared to fight. Compared to the other group members, they seemed more outstanding.
After all, good and bad are relative; being able to play a role in the Group Task is more important.
Wang Ping (66): “In that case, the participants for this Group Task will be me,
Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, Chen Yao, and Zhang Jun.”
With Wang Pings final decision and manually filling in the names of those participating in the Group Task, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun were all enveloped in a thick glow.
Immediately afterwards, the four of them disappeared from the worlds they were in.
In the world where Chen Yao was.
In Chen Yao’s room.
With the appearance of four beams of light, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun successively appeared here.
Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong were still dressed in ancient-style clothing, with an air of transcendence.
As for Zhang Hu, he was dressed in a fantasy style with armor made of fine iron and holding a heavy sword in his hand.
Only Zhang Jun looked even more gloomy than ever, with a strong smell of blood and bloody stains on his clothes.
Fortunately, the crossing process purifies viruses and bacteria from each world; otherwise, going back and forth between Zombie Worlds might cause many other worlds to be infected.
“Welcome to the world where I live.’
Looking at the four of them, Chen Yao spoke softly.
After saying this, she looked specifically at Wang Ping and said seriously, “Mr. Wang, I’m counting on you for this task.”
Chen Yao knew very well that even though they had grown stronger through three months of cultivation, Wang Ping was still the strongest. Moreover, his Golden Finger’s special nature meant he would still be the main force in this Group Task.
“Mm.” Wang Ping nodded, then said seriously, “Chen Yao, in order to better complete the Group Task, we need to understand the specific information about this world. You should organize the information first.”
“Actually, ever since the last Group Task, I’ve been organizing information about this world in case our world faces an abnormal situation, making it easier for everyone to complete the Group Task.”
Chen Yao nodded and directly took several files from her bookshelf and handed them to Wang Ping and the others.
Chen Yao’s actions surprised Wang Ping and the others, making them feel that Chen Yao, as a woman, was indeed more attentive than men.
“It seems we all need to do things like this. When a Group Task appears, we won’t have to be in such a hurry.”
Cai Yonglong took the file and said with a light chuckle.
“l agree.” Wang Ping nodded in agreement, took the file, and silently sat on the sofa in the living room to read it.
For a moment, the scene quieted down.
Chen Yao silently took out some drinks from the refrigerator and put them on the coffee table.
There were colas and milk, as well as beer.
Half an hour later, Wang Ping finished reading the information Chen Yao had organized, narrowed his eyes, and said quietly, “Although everyone often talks about their own world in the group chat, it’s still not detailed enough. Now, I finally have some understanding of your world, and it seems much worse than you described.”
Chen Yao’s world experienced the Demon Revival phenomenon ten years ago.
Actually, Demon Revival is essentially the same as spiritual revival.
However, in Chen Yao’s world, righteous cultivators had paid a heavy price to suppress all the demons in the world and bring peace to the world hundreds of years ago.
As a result, many inheritances were severed, and mysteries disappeared, turning demons into superstitions..

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 73: Simulating the Demons World 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 73: Simulating the Demons World 2
Translator: 549690339
However, ten years ago, spiritual energy suddenly revived, and many suppressed and sealed demons began to stir, with the possibility of regaining their powers.
In addition, after hundreds of years, the seals have loosened, allowing some powerful demons to gradually escape, making Chen Yao’s world increasingly dangerous.
If it weren’t for Taoists coming down the mountain to suppress these rampaging demons, humans would have been doomed long ago.
However, due to the lack of transmission of many heritages, the power of the
Taoists was insufficient, so they could barely defend some major cities.
Places like villages and small county towns have almost become demon-infested paradises.
Even so, as time goes by, more and more powerful demons are emerging in the world, and the situation for humans is getting worse and worse.
Even in some big cities, demons are running rampant.
This has caused divisions within humanity, and some people even want to surrender and survive by any means.
As a result, there are spies within the human ranks.
Chen Yao’s existence was leaked just a month ago by a highly influential figure who had sided with the demons.
This led to Chen Yao being attacked by demons and nearly dying.
In addition, the power structure of this world is very clear.
Demons are divided into lower-, middle-, and upper-level demons, Demon Commanders, and Demon Kings.
The Taoist side consists of lower-, middle-, and upper-level Taoists, Taoist priests, and Great Tao masters.
Among them, the strength of upper-level combatants can be comparable to the Innate Realm cultivators of the Profound World that he resides in, and Demon Commanders vary greatly in power, some not as powerful as the Spiritual Origin Realm, while others are more powerful.
As for Demon Kings, they are extremely powerful. According to Chen Yao’s analysis comparing their destructive power.
Even the weakest Demon King has the power he initially demonstrated in the Zombie World, and the stronger ones have power far beyond his reach.
Without mincing any words… If this continues, humanity will be met with extinction,” Chen Yao paused before saying, “Although many high-tier humans regard me as a savior, I don’t think I have that capability. I’m not the protagonist of a novel about the resurrection of demons. I’m just an ordinary transmigrator who has luckily gained a powerful Golden Finger.” “Not to mention that in our world, there’s even something strange…” Pausing for a moment, Chen Yao’s expression was bitter.
“It seems that we are all pitiful transmigrators who suffer the same fate.” Zhang Jun looked at Chen Yao with a complicated expression.
He lived every day on the edge of death, and Chen Yao’s situation wasn’t much better.
Of course, Chen Yao could at least chat with living people every day and had a better living environment, while he had nothing.
“There’s no point in talking about this. All we can do is become stronger,”
Wang Ping glanced at everyone and said seriously, ‘Of course, before that, let’s complete the group task first.”
“Mr.Wang is right. We should complete the group task first,” Cai Yonglong nodded and said in a solemn voice, “The first thing we need to do is to find the peculiar ones.”
“Based on our previous task experience, the peculiar ones should not be too far away from us.”
Zhang Hu pondered.
“Not necessarily true. The last group task only allowed us to search locally since we couldn’t search the entire world,” Zhang Jun paused before shaking his head and saying, “This world’s transportation and information channels are not cut off. It’s possible that they appear in other regions.”
“Since it is peculiar, there must be something unusual about it. It could be stronger than other demons or cause some abnormal disturbances,” Wang Ping nodded and began to analyze.
Chen Yao, think about it. Has anything extremely strange happened in your world recently?”
“Extremely strange events…? To be honest, various strange events happen every day in this world due to the demon revival. How can we make a judgment…”
Chen Yao frowned and sighed.
These words made Wang Ping and the others frown, feeling somewhat troubled.
