The chat group tasks were troublesome, with no hints and requiring them to find the peculiarities themselves.
If it takes too long, the peculiar ones might grow to a point where they are beyond the ability of the group members to handle.
“If that’s the case, let’s just waste one of the opportunities and take a look at the future. I’ve saved up ten chances, which should be enough.” Wang Ping sighed, having no other choice.
“Ten times.” Chen Yao and the others exchanged glances and breathed a sigh of relief.
Wang Ping used the Golden Finger three times during the last group task, and this time he had ten chances to predict the future, so the probability of completing the task safely was quite high.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.” Wang Ping closed his eyes and said in his heart.
“Ding, the free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out, and the luminescent screen emerged as well.
[Day 1: After discussing tactics, Chen Yao takes you to meet the Grand Elder of
Profound Country. You reveal your astonishing power, which shocks the Grand Elder to the core. As for the Taoist priest personally protecting the Grand Elder, he is even more horrified as he sensed that your power has reached a level far beyond the ordinary Demon King.]
[After revealing your strength, you hope that the Grand Elder of Profound Country can cooperate to solve the demon problem. You know very well that relying solely on the few of your own power is difficult to quickly locate the anomalistic being in the world, let alone solve the problem and force out the genuine anomaly. Only by borrowing the state’s power can tasks be completed faster..]

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 73: Simulation of Demons World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 73: Simulation of Demons World_3
Translator: 549690339
[Because you demonstrated your strength, the Grand Elder of Profound Country was tremendously shocked. After revealing his purpose, he was willing to help. Even so, the Grand Elder of Profound Country believed that you were the hope for saving humanity.]
[Next, with the full cooperation of Profound Country’s intelligence network, you all acted separately to deal with the various strange incidents and the demons lurking behind them.]
[No matter what demons you encountered, you crushed them effortlessly. To restore hope for all mankind, the Grand Elder of Profound Country specially live m streamed your actions with your consent. Your strength and invincibility shocked and inspired all humanity, allowing them to regain hope and no longer be pessimistic.]
[Your power shocked Cai Yonglong and the others, as they all saw that you had grown stronger. Cai Yonglong even suspected that you had taken that step and reached the half-step Transcendent Realm.]
[At the same time, Cai Yonglong and the others also performed well. Cai Yonglong killed several Demon Commanders. Zhang Hu t s growth was also astonishing, and his strength reached a level where he could fight against Demon Commanders.]
[Unexpectedly, Chen Yao and Zhang Jun’s performance was also amazing. Chen Yao and Zhang Jun both possessed Spiritual Origin Realm battle power, allowing them to slaughter most Demon Commanders as if they were killing dogs.]
[On the thirtieth day, you continued to hunt down powerful demons, resolve strange incidents, try to find the source of the anomalies, and complete your mission. Because of your live- streaming of killing Demon Commanders and even Demon Kings, you enraged all powerful demons, causing them to unite and try to kill you.]
[However, facing the onslaught of so many powerful demons, you easily killed them all with a single move. This scene once again shocked all of humanity.
For a moment, they were all excited and hailed you as their savior. On the demon’s side, they no longer dared to act recklessly and began to hide among humans, fearing that they would be discovered and killed.]
[The whole world, because of your appearance, had a tendency to return to peace. However, you didn’t feel happy or optimistic, as you still hadn’t found and dealt with the source of the anomalies. You knew very well that the longer the delay, the worse the situation would become,]
[On the sixtieth day, most of the powerful demons that emerged worldwide had been almost exterminated by you. Humans returned to their harmonious and peaceful lives, although there were still demons causing troubles on a small scale, but they dared not continue to wreak havoc on human populations and cities during the day.]
[On the sixty- seventh day, you made a decision, intending to break some seals proactively, capture and kill the demons within to ensure none were missed.]
[Your idea was stopped by a Great Tao master. He cautioned you that although you were powerful, the demons sealed since ancient times were far more powerful than you could imagine. If you broke the seals willingly, you would plunge the world back into darkness.]
[You did not heed the advice of the Great Tao master and urgently wanted to kill the anomalies. Therefore, you broke the seal of a Demonic Suppressing Cave, allowing the demons inside to be released. You fought them, and those demons were indeed powerful, reaching the half- step Transcendent Realm. However, they were still no match for you and were annihilated.]
[But in the end, a terrifying demon with Transcendent Realm Battle Power appeared. You fought an intense battle with it, and by relying on the Red Fire Skill and Sword Spirit to restrain the demon’s abilities, you managed to kill it rather easily. However, the emergence of a demon with Transcendent Realm Battle Power also made you feel heavy-hearted, realizing that the world was not that simple..]

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 74: The Enemy Within
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 74: The Enemy Within
Translator: 549690339
“There are even demons with Transcendent Realm Battle Power? This world is indeed not simple at all.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his brows slightly furrowed.
The battle power of the Transcendent Realm was terrifying.
Even for him who had just broken through to the first realm of the Transcendent Realm – the Spirit Sea Realm – had the power to level a modernized city with just a single strike.
Theoretically, such a powerful existence should not appear on Earth.
After all, if such an existence wanted to destroy the world, it would only take some time to slaughter all living beings on all continents.
Even if they didn’t intentionally try to destroy everything, the mere aftershocks of their battles would be enough to turn countless mountains and rivers into dust, causing unimaginable destruction to the surface.
“Every world has its own secrets, and I don’t need to delve into them. What I need to do is to complete the Group Task and leave this world. As for what will happen to Chen Yao’s world in the future, it’s up to Chen Yao to consider.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, casting aside the distracting thoughts in his mind.
As Wang Ping cast aside his distracting thoughts and continued looking at the luminescent screen, more text appeared.
[You killed the terrifying demons, shocking all mankind once again. Cai
Yonglong even sees that you have taken that step, becoming a Spirit Sea
Realm cultivator, and is even more shocked, envious beyond measure.]
[However, you are not very happy. Because after learning about the powerful strength of the sealed demons throughout history, you dare not recklessly break the seal of other Demonic Suppressing Caves. If a demon stronger than you appears by accident, you will die, and all of humanity will suffer.]
[Next, you can only cultivate with a heavy heart, and continue to search for the mysterious traces with Cai Yonglong and others.]
[On the hundredth day, a Demonic Suppressing Cave suddenly goes into turmoil, a powerful Demon King emerges, and you go to suppress it, smashing it into pieces. However, due to the great strength of the demon this time, you have suffered serious injuries. In the process, Cai Yonglong, Chen Yao, and Zhang Jun are all killed.]
[As you sigh for the deaths of the three, a figure shrouded in black mist suddenly appears and attacks you, severely wounding you. You angrily fight back but are no match for them, and are killed by their strike. Before dying, you shattered part of the black mist, revealing their human identity.]
[Because of your death, the simulation ends.]
Wang Ping looked at the end of the simulation content, his eyebrows tightly knitted.
He did not expect that he would die at the hands of a fellow human instead of the demons.
Why would this human attack him?
Logically, someone with the power to kill him should not be a scoundrel who sided with the demons. After all, there would be no need for that.
“Or is it possible that they are the Mysterious One…”
Wang Pings pupils suddenly contracted.
They had previously assumed that the Mysterious One must be hidden among the demons and had neglected the possibility of them being concealed among humans.
You should know that the Mysterious One is not a native creature of this world.
They do not belong to any force and are individual invading outsiders.
As a result, it is possible that they could be hidden within any living being.
“How is it? Did you find anything?”
Seeing Wang Pings expression change, Cai Yonglong asked anxiously.
“Yes.
Wang Ping nodded and gave a brief description of the simulation content.
“Human…”
For a moment, Chen Yao’s face turned pale.
She had also overlooked this possibility.
If the Mysterious One was truly hidden among humans, wouldn’t she be in danger at all times?
The only reason she’s not dead is because the opponent is plotting something and hasn’t killed her yet.
Otherwise, with the opponent’s strength, they would definitely have a complete grasp of the human situation and definitely know her background.
“This is troublesome.’
Zhang Hu and Zhang Jun looked at each other, their faces serious.
“I didn’t expect that Brother Wang would actually break through to the Spirit Sea Realm. What’s even more unexpected is that Chen Yao’s world is so dangerous that there are even ancient monsters in the Spirit Sea Realm.” Cai Yonglong clenched his fist, his emotions mixed.
Wang Pings growth was truly fast. Just three months ago, he had asked Cai Yonglong for the secret skill to expand his elixir field, but Cai Yonglong did not have it and gave up on the idea.
He never thought that Wang Ping would have broken through to the Spirit Sea Realm in just three months. This cultivation speed was simply defying the heavens.
At the same time, he did not expect Chen Yao’s world to be so dangerous, with more than one Spirit Sea Realm Battle Power in existence.
This was only on the side of the demons, not to mention the human side.
As expected, no world should be underestimated.
Cai Yonglong sighed inwardly.
At first, he had not paid much attention to Chen Yao’s world, thinking that at most the ceiling of its combat power was only half a step into the Transcendent Realm, but now he has been proven wrong.
“If the Mysterious One is hidden among the humans, what is their goal?” Wang Ping said in a deep voice, frowning.
“If they have such a powerful strength, there is no need for them to hide themselves at all. Or is it that they did not have this strength before the hundred days before they attacked me, and only grew stronger due to some reason? If so, what is their ability?”
“Ability…”
Wang Pings words made Cai Yonglong and the others all ponder deeply..

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 74: The Enemy Within_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 74: The Enemy Within_2
Translator: 549690339
Indeed, if this cunning creature had the power to kill Wang Ping, a Spiritual Sea Realm cultivator from the very beginning, then it wouldn’t have needed to hide itself at all.
Since it was hiding, it could imply that its strength wasn’t enough before.
Additionally, based on the rule-based abilities of the cunning creatures in Zombie World, this cunning creature should have certain abilities of its own.
These abilities, unlike those in Zombie World, might not be rule-based, but rather have the potential to grow.
“Is it possible that the person who attacked you isn’t a cunning creature but a mere human? We directly assumed that they are cunning creatures; it’s too frivolous without sufficient evidence,” Zhang Hu said, after pondering for a moment.
“I’m just speculating, and I don’t rule out the possibility that they are merely humans,” Wang Ping nodded.
“But anyway, this hidden culprit is definitely our enemy, and there’s no mistake about that. Therefore, no matter if they are cunning creatures or not, we must kill them. They attacked me after I was injured in the battle with the demons, so they are not as strong as me,” Wang Ping said, pausing before continuing coldly.
“They must be killed indeed,” Chen Yao clenched her fist, her mood heavy.
“Brother Wang, take this,” At this moment, Zhang Hu t s face was full of heartache, but he still took out two scrolls from his backpack.
“What is this?”
Everyone looked over with curiosity.
“These are forbidden curse scrolls that I shamelessly asked my master for,” Zhang Hu said with a pained expression.
“This one is the Forbidden Curse Mana: Ten Thousand Lightning Destruction, which can unleash countless lightning strikes to obliterate the enemy. In terms of power, it can instantly destroy a modern city without any problems.”
“This one is the Forbidden Curse Mana: Angel Divine Shield. It is a defensive forbidden curse mana that condenses a divine shield with angelic radiance that can the attacks of forbidden curses.’
Hearing Zhang Hu t s introduction, Cai Yonglong, Chen Yao, and Zhang Jun all gasped, staring at Zhang Hu in astonishment.
Goodness, Zhang Hu was too generous. It was outrageous for him to take out something as terrifying as these forbidden curses scrolls at once.
“What kind of person is your master? They are so generous,” Wang Pings eyes became subtle.
According to Zhang Hu, the Grand Magisters in their world could use forbidden curses and annihilate cities with a single strike.
However, just because the Grand Magisters could use forbidden curses doesn’t mean it’s easy to create a forbidden curse scroll.
The ability to make such a forbidden curse scroll would be of unimaginable value.
These forbidden curse scrolls alone could probably buy a city; it’s not an exaggeration to say they’re worth their weight in gold.
“My master is a Sword Master, ranked higher than a Grand Magister and can rival a Mana God,” Zhang Hu said humbly with a slight cough.
Cai Yonglong, Chen Yao, and Zhang Jun were silent.
Goodness, they originally thought that Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan had the best start, but it turned out that it was Zhang Hu who had been too low-key. He was the first- generation lucky star in the Transmigrator Chat Group.
Grand Magisters could use forbidden curses and annihilate cities with a single strike.
This kind of destructive power was already far beyond the level of Spirit Elemental Realm Great Perfection, and it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say it reached the Spirit Sea Realm.
However, because they couldn’t evaluate the strength of the Spirit Sea Realm, it was difficult to make a judgement and comparison.
Nevertheless, the power of a Grand Magister was already terrifying.
Yet, Zhang Hu r s master turned out to be a Sword Master who surpassed Grand Magisters and could rival Mana Gods, which was truly frightening.
There was no doubt that his master was a transcendent-level power, but it was unknown exactly which level he could rival.
“You’re really good at hiding,” Wang Ping had to admit.
This guy was the third in the group, being very low-key, not revealing his background until now.
Of course, Zhang Hu t s cautious personality was also a part of it. He didn’t reveal the specifics of his Golden Finger initially, nor was he unrealistic.
Nevertheless, now that Zhang Hu took out two forbidden curse scrolls voluntarily, Wang Pings respect for him increased once more.
After all, not everyone would be willing to give up something so precious.
Even how difficult the task was, they might not be willing to hand it over.
“Being low-key is the way to go,” Zhang Hu said with a shy smile.
However, his fierce-looking face, giving off the impression of a villain, just couldn’t be associated with the words shy and honest.
“I’m so envious; I wish I had a master like that,” Cai Yonglong became sour again.
He felt like he had recently become a lemonade addict.
It couldn’t be helped; the newer group members either had amazing Golden Fingers, great luck, or both.
Compared to them, Cai Yonglong had initially thought his luck was pretty good, and he was the backbone of the group. But now, it seemed quite ordinary.He thought Zhang Hu would be worse off than him, but it turned out that Zhang Hu was much stronger.
Just look, he casually took out two forbidden curse spells.
Damn it, these are forbidden curses. Based on Zhang Hu t s description, they are powerful enough to be used as trump cards.
If he had such trump cards, he could compete for many opportunities, instead of being so downcast now.
Chen Yao and Zhang Jun also felt disheartened, not feeling so well.
Only Wang Ping was still indifferent.
“The power of this thing, according to your description, has indeed reached the level of the Spirit Sea Realm, but it is only a casual blow at that level. It’s not much use to me. However, if used in a battle within the same realm, it could be a decent way to harass the opponent.”
Wang Ping looked at the Forbidden Curse Mana: Ten Thousand Lightning Destruction and spoke.
“Uh…
Hearing this, everyone was dumbfounded again.
Goodness, such terrifying power is only a casual blow at the level of the Spirit Sea Realm?
The effect is only to harass the opponent, which is outrageous.
At this moment, everyone had a clearer understanding of the strength of the Spirit Sea Realm.
It’s the Profound World indeed.
“As for this forbidden curse scroll, it’s not bad. If I use it well, maybe I can save a life and successfully help us complete the group task. If it’s not needed, I’ll give it back to you.”
Wang Ping seriously looked at the scroll of Forbidden Curse Mana: Angel Divine Shield.
He valued the defensive scroll and considered it more precious than the
Thousand Thunder Extinguishment.
Used properly, it could save a life during an ultimate showdown.
“Miss Chen Yao, are you home?”
At this moment, the doorbell suddenly rang.
Immediately after, the visitor display screen at the door lit up, showing an elder’s kindly face.
This made Wang Ping and the others frown slightly.
“He is Mr. Li, a mentor at Jingcheng Taoist Academy.”
Chen Yao explained to everyone.
Wang Pings eyes flickered and he nodded.
Chen Yao’s information also recorded the development of mankind in recent years.
The establishment of the Taoist Academy was to train a new generation of Taoists as quickly as possible to deal with future crises.
And Chen Yao’s current identity was officially a student of the Jingcheng
Taoist Academy.
Of course, her real identity and status were definitely far above most people, not as simple as just being a student.
Even disregarding her transmigrator identity, her cultivation had reached the level of a Taoist priest, second only to the Great Tao master.
“Do we need to hide?”
Cai Yonglong frowned.
“It’s better not to meet people for now. After all, the internal situation of humans is complicated, and we should not expose ourselves before finding any clues.”
Chen Yao pondered for a moment and spoke seriously.
“It’s already too late. In fact, when we first arrived, some people noticed an anomaly here. After all, there are several Taoist priests in your Jingcheng
Taoist Academy, and I even detected the breath of a Great Tao Master.”
Wang Ping looked at Chen Yao and spoke calmly.
Chen Yao was slightly stunned.
She didn’t know that there was a Great Tao Master in Jingcheng Taoist Academy.
However, after giving it some thought, it made sense.
The Jingcheng Taoist Academy was the strongest Taoist academy in the Profound Country, gathering geniuses from all over the country. If they didn’t hide a Great Tao Master, they would be annihilated if a Demon King attacked.
Of course, if a demon dared to go wild in Jingcheng, human beings would probably be close to extinction.
“It seems that our ability to hide our breath is still lacking.”
Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun all gave bitter smiles.
Although they tried to conceal their aura when they arrived, they ultimately couldn’t.
Presumably, only Wang Pings breath was undetected.
If a Spirit Sea Domain Stronger didn’t want their breath to be detected, no one could discover their existence unless they encountered an equally powerful being.
“In that case, let’s go meet them.”
Chen Yao said helplessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 75: Humanity, How Can It Not Perish?
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 75: Humanity, How Can It Not Perish?
Translator: 549690339
When Chen Yao opened the door, the old man outside, Mr. Li, was taken aback.
He looked at Wang Ping and the others, greatly astonished.
Originally, the headmaster said there would be three people, but now there was an extra one.
Does that mean that even the headmaster, at the level of a taoist priest, was unable to detect the extra person?
The skill of this person in hiding their breath was truly astonishing.
“Miss Chen Yao, these must be your friends.”
Mr. Li greeted Chen Yao with a warm smile on his face.
“Yes, they’re my friends.” Chen Yao calmly nodded.
“l see. Because the current situation is not very good, and you suddenly have guests, it may cause some unnecessary trouble. Therefore, the headmaster asks you to go to his office.” Mr. Li nodded seriously and said.
“So, everyone, please come with me.”
Chen Yao, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Zhang Hu exchanged glances but did not say much as they followed Mr. Li to the Master of Taoist Academy’s office.
When they arrived at the office, they saw a Taoist wearing a robe and with a scratch mark on his face, sitting in the office chair.
Apart from him, there was another person in the office.
He had white hair and beard, a kind expression, and no trace of his breath could be detected, as if he were just an ordinary old man.
Wang Ping glanced at the headmaster and then looked at the kind old man, squinting his eyes.
This person was the Great Taoist tier powerhouse he had sensed.
Although, the person in front of him only seemed to be barely comparable to the half-step Transcendent Realm, there was a unique temperament about him that caught his attention.
As Wang Ping observed the white-haired old man, Chen Yao and the others also noticed his existence and guessed his identity, feeling quite amazed in
their hearts.
“Mr. Li, thank you for your hard work, you may leave first.”
On the headmaster’s side, he asked Mr. Li to leave. Mr. Li respectfully nodded and left the office, gently closing the door behind him.
“Miss Chen Yao, aren’t you going to introduce us to your cross-world traveler friends?”
Soon, the headmaster turned to Chen Yao with a warm smile and asked.
At this remark, Chen Yao’s eyes narrowed slightly.
However, she let it go shortly after.
It was only normal for the headmaster to guess the identities of Wang Ping and the others.
After all, her status was very sensitive, and she had been under constant attention.
And those who could appear silently in her room, dressed differently and without the unique aura of cultivators, could only be guests from the Exoteric World.
“My name is Wang Ping. They are Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun.”
As Chen Yao was thinking about how to speak, Wang Ping stood up, smiled faintly, and introduced himself and his companions.
“The reason we came to this world is at the invitation of Miss Chen Yao, to help the people of this world break free from their predicament.”
The headmaster’s eyes flashed with surprise, and his heart was filled with astonishment as he heard this information bomb.
He had just been testing earlier and did not expect Wang Ping and the others to be cross-world travelers indeed.
Furthermore, from what Wang Ping said, it was clear that there was a connection between the cross-world travelers and that they could even visit the worlds where others were, which was a huge piece of information.
As for the purpose of Wang Pings words, the headmaster also understood. These cross-world travelers could support each other, so don’t think about any crooked ideas.
For a moment, the headmaster and the white-haired old man exchanged glances, their hearts unable to calm down.
On the side, Chen Yao soon realized and shot Wang Ping a grateful look.
“Miss Chen Yao has put in a lot of effort. On behalf of the humans in our world, I express my gratitude for the assistance of you cross-world travelers.”
Then, the headmaster showed a smile, stood up, enthusiastically walked towards Wang Ping and the others, and invited them to sit on the sofa.
Wang Ping and the others did not hold back and simply sat down.
“l wonder how long you friends will be able to stay in our world.”
After the headmaster courteously brewed tea for Wang Ping and the others, he asked with a serious expression on his face.
This was also a test.
“We can stay as long as needed. However, once we’ve resolved the problem, we’ll each go our separate ways.”
Wang Ping answered calmly.
“Hehe, I wonder what exactly you’re referring to when you say ‘resolve the problem.’ Is it helping us suppress the monsters and demons and bring peace to the world? If so, I’m afraid it won’t be easy.”
The headmaster asked with a smile.
During the conversation between the two, Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun all remained silent, like background actors.
As for the old man, he did not say much either, just quietly sitting there like a statue.
“Regarding this, I have plans of my own. But before that, I need to know more about your world specifically. Of course, if you don’t trust us, you do not need to say more.”
Wang Ping did not intend to answer in detail but spoke with a profound meaning.
Having encountered problems within human society in the life simulation, he did not want to reveal too much information this time around.
It was enough to have tried just one time using brute force to collect information like in the previous life simulation.
“Since you’re Miss Chen Yao’s companion, I naturally trust you. Feel free to ask, Fellow Taoist Wang Ping.”
The headmaster said with a smile.
“Chen Yao has already told me about the general situation of your world.
However, I would like to know the specific number of Demon Kings and Great Taoist masters in your world..”

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 75: Humans, none of them have perished? 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 75: Humans, none of them have perished? 2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping nodded, asking a question that held deep implications.
Upon hearing Wang Pings question right off the bat, everyone present was taken aback.
Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Zhang Hu all wore thoughtful expressions.
Surprisingly, even the headmaster looked shocked, unsure of why Wang Ping was asking this.
“Based on the information we currently have, the number of Demon Kings that have emerged on the Demons’ side is twenty. Whereas on our human side, we have only twelve Great Tao masters, which is significantly less than the Demons.’
The headmaster sighed deeply.
“Then, do any of the Great Tao masters on the human side possess a power that significantly surpasses the other Demon Kings?”
Wang Ping pursued the question.
The headmaster frowned, uncertain of Wang Pings true intent in asking these questions.
For a moment, he pondered whether or not to answer.
After all, this was highly classified information.
The present individuals, although brought here by Chen Yao, were still a question mark in terms of trustworthiness.
Their previous dialogue, which alluded to an air of trust, was merely lip service.
“There’s no harm. Go on, tell him.”
At this moment, an elderly man who had remained silent until now spoke up.
Upon hearing this, the headmaster instantly relaxed and said bitterly, “Among our Great Tao masters, there are none that possess power far surpassing the other Demon Kings.”
“l see.” Wang Ping squinted, saying in a meaningful tone, “Although we have fewer strong individuals than the Demon Kings and none that surpass the rest of the Demon Kings in power, why has mankind not been annihilated? On a normal precedent, humans would have been wiped out a long time ago.” With his words, silence filled the room.
Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Zhang Hu were all shocked, unprepared for Wang Ping to utter such an aggravating statement.
“What do you mean by that, fellow Taoist? Mankind has been fighting tooth and nail to survive. Why would you wish for our demise?”
The headmaster questioned with discontent.
“No other intentions, merely a rational discussion.”
Wang Ping responded calmly and slowly.
“Based on the tropes of the novels I’ve read in the past, under normal circumstances, humans should be the weaker force, but there is always some power or trump card that balances out the stronger threat. However, our situation is peculiar. The number of top humans master is almost half as many as the number of Demon Kings, yet they maintain a balance. It’s strange. ”
The faces of Chen Yao, Zhang Hu, Zhang Jun, and Cai Yonglong all shifted imperceptibly upon hearing Wang Pings words.
Being familiar with numerous online novels, they all found Wang Pings observations a little unusual.
Moreover, knowing that there were internal issues within humanity made matters even more peculiar.
In such circumstances, the survival of mankind was indeed nothing short of miraculous.
“That’s because the Demons also fear what else we might have up our sleeve, and they worry about mutual destruction with the Great Tao masters. After all, who would willingly risk their life at the Demon King level?”
The headmaster replied solemnly.
“Then let me ask another question; Are your Great Tao masters stationed together or dispersed across key locations? Additionally, are you able to monitor the movements of all Demon Kings?”
Wang Ping gazed intently at the headmaster and slowly asked.
“Why are you asking this?” The headmaster’s complexion fluctuated.
“Just a simple query. Headmaster, you can choose to answer or not.” Wang Ping responded calmly.
“Naturally, they are dispersed. As for monitoring the Demon Kings, we can only track a subset of them.”
The headmaster let out a deep breath and gave his answer.
“l see.” Wang Ping lamented. “Thank you, Headmaster, for the information.
That concludes my questions.”
“Now that you’re done with your questions, would you be able to answer some of mine?”
The headmaster stared at Wang Ping, speaking in a deep voice.
“What was the purpose of your earlier questions, and how can we break through our current predicament? Moreover, what level are your powers at?” “The intent behind my questions, you should be able to guess. Therefore, I
don’t need to answer that.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke calmly.
“l have no idea.” The headmaster shook his head.
“If you don’t know, then I see no reason to answer. Your questions are really something.”
Wang Ping calmly sipped his tea.
“As for how to help the humans in your world to break free from their current dilemma, I haven’t figured that out yet. Once I do, I’ll let you know. But generally speaking, it has something to do with defeating the Demons.”
After a moment’s pause, Wang Ping spoke again, “As for our powers, theyre equivalent to the Taoist priests in your world. As for me, killing your world’s
Demon Kings is not an issue.”
As he finished speaking, Wang Ping deliberately revealed some of his aura.
In an instant, a heavy atmosphere filled the room.
Even the headmaster, whose level of cultivation was not far from a Great Tao master, had his pupils instantly constricting, revealing a look of astonishment.
The elderly man, who had been very quiet all this while, also had his pupils contract, as he intently stared at Wang Ping.
However, the overwhelming aura that had filled the room earlier quickly disappeared, as if nothing had occurred.
Even though the aura had dissipated, the people present were far from calm.
“That aura was indeed powerful. But most likely it’s the result of hiding their true power. Otherwise, the Spiritual Sea Mirror wouldn’t have shown only this level. t
Cai Yonglong exclaimed internally.
Chen Yao and the others shared the same thought.
Their sense of security grew stronger after hearing this.
With such a strong teammate like Wang Ping, their sense of security was off the charts.
The headmaster was visibly shocked, his gaze fixed on Wang Ping, his astonishment knowing no bounds.
“High-Tier Demon King…No – it even appears to be stronger..”

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 75: Humans, none of them have perished? _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 75: Humans, none of them have perished? _3
Translator: 549690339
The elder gazed at Wang Ping, speaking softly.
“Hehe.’
Watching the reactions of the two people, Wang Ping drained the tea in his cup with a faint smile.
Just now, he had only slightly revealed some of his aura and had not exposed his true strength.
After all, if he were to show his full power, it would likely scare off the cunning ones.
At that time, it would be impossible to lure the snake out of the hole, and the tragedy might happen again, perhaps wasting even more simulation times.
“If you are willing to make a move, indeed, you can help our humans break the stalemate. So far, neither humans nor the Demon Kings have such an existence.”
The elder could no longer remain calm, a smile appeared on his face as he looked at Wang Ping with joy, exclaiming.
No wonder he hadn’t sensed Wang Pings aura before.
He was just an intermediate Great Tao master, equivalent to a mid-tier Demon King, far inferior to Wang Pings strength. If Wang Ping deliberately hid it, he indeed could not detect it.
“So far, huh…
Wang Ping squinted his eyes, recalling the contents of the simulator.
According to the elder, the high-Tier Demon Kings were probably equivalent to the top half-step Transcendent Realm ones.
Earlier, the aura he had exposed was similar to that of the top half-step Transcendent Realm.
Those terrifying demons in the Demonic Suppressing Cave, who had not yet emerged and whose power had reached the Spirit Sea Realm, were most likely above the level of Demon Kings and Great Tao masters.
The reason why Chen Yao didn’t know about this level was that her clearance was too low.
“If the high-Tier humans and your top human powerhouses are willing to cooperate with me in the time to come, I can help you guys suppress and kill those Demon Kings, so that those riotous demons dare not act recklessly.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping looked at the headmaster and the elder and spoke slowly.
At these words, both of them were moved and their minds were restless.
Soon, the conversation ended. The headmaster and the elder both said that they needed to consult with the high-tier humans and the other top powerhouses before giving an answer.
As for Wang Ping, he returned to Chen Yao’s room again.
Of course, the academy would arrange different accommodations for them to stay in.
“Wang Ping, what was the purpose of your inquiry just now?”
Upon returning to the room, Zhang Hu couldn’t help but ask.
“Why do you think the top humans and demonic creatures differ so much in strength, and the powerful ones are scattered, yet humans haven’t been wiped out?”
Wang Ping asked back.
“Uh… If I had that kind of brain, I wouldn’t have dropped out of high school before crossing.”
Zhang Hu said with a bitter smile.
“Won’t you become smarter by cultivating as a knight?”
Wang Ping asked with an odd look in his eyes.
With his cultivation increasing, his mind was becoming sharper.
After all, cultivation was a process of life metamorphosis, and the speed of thinking would also increase by multiples.
“…No.” Zhang Hu’s face twitched.
“You mean either the humans have some hidden trump card that intimidates the demons, but they don’t trust us, so they didn’t tell us, or the humans have made a deal with the demons?”
Cai Yonglong pondered for a moment and said.
“Otherwise, given the current situation, humans should have been extinct long ago. With such a difference in the number of powerhouses, as long as the Demon Kings are not fools, they could wipe out the humans like a devouring silkworm. Not to mention, there are problems within humans themselves… It’s strange that humans haven’t been wiped out under such circumstances.”
“Hmm.” Wang Ping nodded approvingly and slowly said, “Of course, there’s another possibility. That is, someone might be acting secretly, not wanting humans to be wiped out, as that would not be good for him.” At these words, everyone’s hearts felt a sense of horror..

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 76: The Strange Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 76: The Strange Power
Translator: 549690339
“Is there such a possibility?” At this moment, Chen Yao’s face was heavy, and she slowly spoke: “The reason why the demons did not wipe out mankind is to domesticate mankind as their Blood Food.’
“That makes some sense.” Zhang Hu touched his chin, somewhat agreeing.
“There is such a possibility. But the possibility is not big.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“If the demons want to domesticate humans and regard humans as a sustainable source of Blood Food, they should wipe out all the human Taoists first, so that humans completely lose their ability to resist. However, they didn’t do that.”
“It might be because they can’t do it… or it could be that the demons themselves don’t get along, they don’t trust each other, and are even wary of each other.’
Cai Yonglong also expressed his new speculation.
“It’s certain that the demons don’t get along. Even within the same ethnic group, it’s impossible to be completely harmonious. Humans can’t do that, let alone demons. However, if they could kill human Taoists, their interests would be unified. Wiping out humans would be more beneficial to them, and they would definitely unite against the rest of the world. But, they didn’t do that. So the previous speculations are not very likely to happen.” Wang Ping shook his head and expressed his own opinion.
Everyone nodded, feeling it made sense.
“No matter which situation it is, we just need to use the ability one more time, and we will know.”
Wang Ping took a light breath, said this, and then closed his eyes.
Seeing this, everyone quieted down, knowing that Wang Ping was going to use his ‘Premonition of the Future’ ability again.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, the Life Simulator starts and Host has eight free simulation times left.”
The system’s voice sounded, and the familiar pale blue luminescent screen also appeared in front of him once again.
Then, the text emerged.
[Day 1, the Higher-ups of Profound Country had a meeting and finally decided to trust you tentatively. However, since you didn’t reveal all your strength this time, they didn’t fully cooperate with your plan. You don’t mind that.]
[In the following days, you hunted demons, showing great strength. One by one, Commander-tier demons died in your hands. You even killed a Demon
King.]
[This caused a sensation in the world, shocking everyone.]
[Afterward, you hunted powerful demons as you did in your memory. However, unlike in your memory, the strength you showed was not overwhelming. When fighting the High-Tier Demon King, you didn’t appear to be relaxed, but you eventually killed him.]
[Nevertheless, your strength and achievements have won the awe of all the Taoists and the acclaim of all mankind. At the same time, the Great Tao masters and Taoist priests are discussing whether to join forces with you to annihilate the remaining Demon Kings.]
[Some people agree, while others disagree. The opponents think that if a full-scale war is started, it will surely anger the demon side. At that time, the human situation will be very dangerous. After all, the present Demon Kings are only a small part of them, and even more terrifying demons have not yet emerged.]
[These words made everyone silent. If the demons are completely angered, the consequences will be unimaginable. Even that mysterious existence may not be able to appease them.]
[For a while, the high-tier humans can only sigh and remain silent, not planning to support you. You killed the Demon King, which relieved their huge pressure, but it didn’t solve the fundamental problem. If the demons are enraged, they could let you, the outsiders, take the blame, quench the anger of the demons, and preserve themselves.]
Seeing this, Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, his expression becoming much colder.
As expected, the high-tier humans knew about the existence of that mysterious figure.
Moreover, they knew that it was that person who appeased the demons, preventing the destruction of humanity by the demon side.
Obviously, the people of this world did not trust them, and they didn’t reveal this matter even when they were dead.
Of course, this was understandable.
After all, who would believe that someone who suddenly appeared was a time-traveler.
“You don’t have to trust us, but we came to this world to help you kill demons and solve problems. However, before we get to that point, you want to sell us out. How nice.”
Wang Pings face was cold and ruthless, and he laughed coldly.
At first, Wang Ping planned to kill as many powerful demons as possible in this world, so as to bring peace back to it while completing the mission.
Now it seems that there is no need for him to do so.
Everything is focused on completing the mission. As for killing the Demon King, if it is necessary for the mission, then kill him.
If it’s not needed for the mission, be considerate and let the human strong ones deal with the demons and battle it out.
Seeing Wang Pings face change, Chen Yao and the others raised their eyebrows, thinking that something bad might have happened in the future, and they couldn’t help but feel a little uneasy.
[In the following days, you continued to hunt powerful demons. You eventually angered all powerful demons, who joined forces to come and attack you.]
[In this battle, you still hid your strength, fighting extremely hard on the surface and appearing ‘seriously injured’. In the end, you used Zhang Hu t s Forbidden Curse Mana: Ten Thousand Lightning Destruction to kill all the demons..]

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 76: The Strange Ability_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 76: The Strange Ability_2
Translator: 549690339
[Your achievements have spread across the world, shocking and worshipped by countless people, with everyone singing your praises and calling you the savior. Even the high-Tier humans and powerful cultivators are astonished by your methods, their minds filled with countless thoughts.]
[However, your mood is heavy. Even after putting on such a show, the mysterious existence shows no sign of acting, being too patient. You know that the plan to lure the snake out of the hole has failed.]
[After thinking it over, you decide to use a more ruthless method to draw that person out.]
[Ignoring the opposition of the high-ranking humans, you force the seal of a Demonic Suppressing Cave open. Terrifying Demons pour out, including those with Spirit Sea Realm combat skills. You pretend to be defeated, using the Forbidden Curse Scroll – Angelic Holy Shield to save your life and escape the scene.]
[Your actions have infuriated everyone to the extreme, causing them to hate you immensely.]
[Still unfazed, you plan to force out the mysterious existence. Ultimately, the mysterious human can no longer sit still and chooses to take action, killing all the powerful demons that escaped from the Demonic Suppressing Cave and even fighting the Spirit Sea Realm Demon Emperor.]
[Seeing the mysterious human appear and fight with the weakened Demon Emperor, everyone feels a mix of surprise and suspicion. They think if this mysterious human is so powerful, why would they need to negotiate with demons? With him around, no Demon King would dare to act recklessly. In a moment, the clever ones sniff out the smell of conspiracy.]
[Taking advantage of this opportunity, you launch a sneak attack on him. You fight him, unleashing your full power with a single strike. He is shocked and enraged, heavily wounded by your blow, and escapes using bizarre means.]
[Feeling weighed down, you know it will be troublesome to find him now that you’ve let him slip away. For a moment, you desperately wish for a secret skill or spiritual tool to seal the heavens and earth, or a tracing secret technique. Otherwise, neither the bizarre zombies nor this person would ever escape your grasp.]
[At this moment, seeing your sudden appearance and overwhelming strength, the Demon Emperor is terrified and wants to flee. You coldly control your sword and kill him.]
[In the end, peace is once again restored to the world. However, the impact of this battle is far from over. The high-ranking humans and powerful Daoists are all frightened, never expecting you to be so powerful and having considered betraying you. Everyone swears that they must never let you know about this.]
[Next, you have the human side track the enemy’s whereabouts, wanting to kill him. However, you end up empty-handed.]
[On the hundredth day, as in your memory, a Demonic Suppressing Cave suddenly experiences an uprising, and powerful demonic beings emerge. You become alert, guessing that the uprising of this Demonic Suppressing Cave is related to that person. You can guess their general purpose. This person, who previously dealt with the Demon Emperor, appeared to not want humanity to be destroyed. Now, they intentionally released the Demon Emperor to use him against you.]
[In other words, just as you plotted against him earlier, he is now openly plotting against you. Obviously, he has already given up on caring for humanity’s fate.]
[Feeling a headache, you know your situation isn’t promising. The enemy is hidden, while you are exposed. However, you have no choice but to act. If you turn a blind eye, the Demon Emperor will be enough to annihilate humanity.]
[Ultimately, you choose to take action and fight the Demon Emperor. However, this time you don’t fight to the death but warn the Demon Emperor not to act recklessly after demonstrating enough power. At the same time, you remind him that he is being manipulated.]
[In the end, the Demon Emperor reaches a compromise with you, stating that he will not arbitrarily devour the human race.]
[Following this, the human side sends heavy troops to guard the remaining three Demon Suppressing Caves, and uses layers of Great Arrays to protect them, preventing the mysterious person from continuing to break the seals.]
[However, all of this is in vain. One of the Demonic Suppressing Caves is eventually broken into, and terrifying demons emerge. This Demon Emperor has no intention of reconciling with humans and devours humans indiscriminately.]
[Seeing this, another Demon Emperor tears up the agreement as well, joining forces to kill you, wanting to obliterate you, and devour everything about you to become stronger.]
[You cannot escape and have no choice but to face them, fighting two enemies alone. Ultimately, the mysterious person appears again, attacking you in the midst of the fierce battle, causing you to suffer heavy injuries. You are then torn apart by the two Demon Emperors.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
“Still dead, huh?”
Wang Ping frowns slightly, feeling somber.
This mysterious person is truly troublesome.
If you can’t destroy him in one blow, he will be an endless threat, like a poisonous snake, always waiting for you to weaken so he can strike.
“How was it?”
Seeing Wang Ping frown, everyone couldn’t help but ask even though they already had an idea of the answer. “Death ending.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
“I knew it would be like that.”
Everyone gave a bitter smile.
Immediately after, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate to share the simulation content.
“The enemy is hidden, and we are exposed, which is really troubling.”
Cai Yonglong sighs.
“The mysterious person has Spirit Sea Realm combat skills, plus the Demon Emperor in the Demonic Suppressing Cave. Frankly, it’s a bit hard to handle..”

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 76: Bizarre Ablllty_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 76: Bizarre Ablllty_3
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Hu gave a bitter smile.
“It’s a pity we can’t help much. If I had the combat capability of the Spirit Sea Realm, 1 could help share the pressure.”
Chen Yao also looked discontent.
“Spirit Sea Realm combat capability, it’s not that easy to achieve…”
Zhang Jun let out a sigh.
“No need to be so down.”
Wang Ping shook his head, still calm.
“From this premonition, I have roughly guessed the purpose of that mysterious person.”
“What purpose?”
Everyone was shocked and turned to look at him.
“This guy is most likely our task target, that is, the oddity attached to humans.’
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, speaking slowly.
“His reluctance to let humans be exterminated is not because he sees himself as a human just because he is attached to one. He probably values the existence of humans because it holds more meaning than extermination. But, what value could such weak humans hold for him?”
“Well….
Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, Zhang Jun, and Chen Yao all frowned in deep thought.
“Also, from the future, I can analyze that he wants humans, especially me, to kill more demons. But why?”
Wang Ping spoke again, his eyes deep.
“Mr. Wang, you mean that humans killing demons greatly benefits him.” Cai Yonglong was struck with a thought and said solemnly.
“To be more specific, the reason for his rapid increase in strength is that he can grow stronger by consuming the bodies of demons? If that’s the case, it perfectly explains his behavioural pattern.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yao, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun perked up, thinking it made a lot of sense.
“You’re partly right, but not entirely.”
Wang Ping shook his head. “What do you mean?”
Cai Yonglong asked puzzled.
“He might get stronger by consuming demon bodies, but more likely, he gains equal power to any demon that die. Otherwise, considering my cultivation method and tendency to finish off opponents, demons would probably end up ashes. How would he consume their bodies?”
Wang Ping explained with a smile.
Although in the Zombie World where Zhang Jun was, he only struck once.
He always reminded himself to maintain the habit of finishing off opponents, not sparing them just because they seem dead.
The only reason he didn’t finish off opponents in the Zombie World was the notification from the chat group system.
Since he knew they were already gone, there was no need to finish them off.
“Well…then, it’s very likely that his ability is as Mr. Wang speculated.”
Zhang Hu stroked his chin, marveling.
“Damn, it’s not surprising that he’s an oddity, this ability may not be on par with Rules-based Abilities, but it’s strong enough. It’s like the dream ability for slackers, gaining strength while laying down.”
“That’s not right. If he can gain equal strength to a dead demon, with his ability, he could act on his own. Why would he need to protect humans and make things so complicated?”
Cai Yonglong frowned, raising another question.
This ability was even more absurd than gaining strength from killing humans, why would he need such a complicated plan?
“It brings us to the limitations of his ability. I guess if he kills a demon himself, he doesn’t get stronger. Or perhaps, the strength he gains is not much. That’s why he needs detailed planning.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, speaking slowly.
When he said this, everyone’s pupils contracted slightly, a storm raging in their hearts.
Indeed, if this was the case, it would explain all his actions.
“Of course, I thought of another possibility.”
At that moment. Wang Ping snoke again. leaving everyone stunned once again..

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 77: The Mysterious True Face!
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 77: The Mysterious True Face!
Translator: 549690339
“What possibility?”
Immediately, everyone looked over curiously.
“l was considering, can he only gain power through the death of demons, or can he become stronger through the death of humans as well?” Wang Ping swept his gaze across everyone, speaking solemnly.
At these words, everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
That’s right, since he can become stronger through demons, there’s a high possibility he can become stronger through humans as well.
If that’s the case, then the enemy’s purpose is obvious.
He doesn’t want the humans to be wiped out by demons, nor does he want them to eliminate the demons.
His main goal should be trying to maintain the balance of power between the two sides, as well as stirring up conflicts, making both races fight to the death.
That way, powerful beings from humans and demons would continually be born, and then die.
In doing so, he can grow stronger without end.
Therefore, if not for the System Task, the final outcome of this world would be an endless struggle between the two sides>.
Unless, something changes, like the appearance of a Son of Fortune who discovers his existence and defeats him.
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, if we hadn’t appeared, this would have definitely been a Demon Revival themed main storyline.”
Zhang Hu marveled with interest.
“In a sense, it’s indeed like that. We just don’t know who the Son of Fortune in this world is, or if he has already appeared.”
Zhang Jun’s gaze also became subtle.
“Whether there’s a Son of Fortune or not is one thing. If there was, the chat group wouldn’t have thrown us in here. After all, the strange thing isn’t a product of this world.”
Cai Yonglong shook his head and sighed.
“That’s true.” Zhang Hu and Zhang Jun both nodded.
“In that case, Chen Yao is probably a pawn of the strange force. Knowing about Chen Yao’s existence through its strength and secret manipulation of human insiders, it quickly nurtured her to counteract the demons and kill even more demons, which is undoubtedly the most beneficial thing for it.”
Immediately, Cai Yonglong looked at Chen Yao.
“Of course, if Chen Yao becomes too strong and can’t be controlled by the system, he would not hesitate to sell Chen Yao to the demons and let them devour her.’
“……” Chen Yao remained silent, as she had thought about this before as well.
If there wasn’t any group task, she would probably have died without knowing when.
“So, transmigrators and the like should still maintain a low profile and not reveal their identities and golden fingers. Otherwise, they’d just be inviting others to use them as pawns.”
Wang Ping also shook his head.
“I was too naive and careless.” Chen Yao bit her lip and smiled bitterly.
“Okay, let’s not talk about that now. Our task remains the same, find the strange force and kill it.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and brought the topic back on track.
“Speaking of which… if everything had followed its natural course, the strange force could also be considered as this world’s savior, right? After all, without its intervention, the power gap between humans and demons would have led to the extermination of humans.’
Zhang Hu rubbed his chin and suddenly spoke.
Everyone was slightly startled.
What Zhang Hu said seemed quite reasonable.
Although, according to the strange force’s calculations, strong humans in the future would be used as pawns and die tragically at the hands of demons, thus becoming its power.
But, in a sense, it had saved most ordinary humans as well.
“Who cares if it’s considered the savior of humans or not, our group task remains the same: to kill it. Otherwise, we won’t be able to leave this world, and we could even face mortal danger. Chen Yao’s death would be certain.”
Cai Yonglong spoke nonchalantly.
He didn’t care much about the fate of the others in the world.
He’d be happy to play the role of savior and good guy as long as there was no danger involved.
But when it came to his own safety, he couldn’t care less about the fate of others in the world or of all humanity.
Just trying to survive himself and ensuring the safety of his friends was already his limit, he really couldn’t be bothered to think about anything else.
Wang Ping shared a similar perspective.
In the simulation, the only reason he came to a truce with the first Demon Emperor was not because he wanted to protect all humans, but simply because he didn’t want to fight the Demon Emperor, which would make him an easy target for the strange force.
When the second Demon Emperor emerged and suddenly attacked, he didn’t choose to fight to the death for the sake of protecting the human race, but rather because he couldn’t escape.
Facing two powerful Demon Emperors with Same Realm Battle Power, even with his talent for escaping, fully retreating unscathed was impossible.
Not to mention, there was also the strange force launching a sneak attack, which basically meant certain death.
Chen Yao was the only one with mixed feelings.
After all, she couldn’t leave this world and was destined to be tied to it.
If the strange force dies, the people of this world will eventually have to face the demons, and the future would be uncertain.
And she, too, is destined to become the cornerstone against the demons.
It’s not for the sake of humanity as a whole, but purely for the sake of self-preservation.
“l hope the Demon Emperor emerges later, otherwise… I guess I’m as good as dead.’
Chen Yao sighed softly in her heart.
She didn’t intend to ask Wang Ping for help in dealing with the other Demon Kings and Demon Emperors.
The relationship between the two was just that of group members. If she wanted Wang Ping to take action, she’d have to offer something significant in return to face the powerful Demon Emperors and risk his life.
But right now, she really didn’t have anything valuable to offer..

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 77: The Mysterious True Face! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 77: The Mysterious True Face! 2
Translator: 549690339
As for selling herself?
Sorry, she couldn’t do that.
Furthermore, she was well aware that she herself might be precious, but in a more realistic sense, she wasn’t actually worth much to a powerful person like Wang Ping.
After all, Wang Ping was a master of the Spirit Sea Realm. What woman couldn’t he have?
Although she had some beauty, she was just a campus belle. In the Profound World, she couldn’t even be considered a stunning beauty.
Helpless, the Profound World was so vast; what it lacked the least were beautiful women, and even more so, beautiful women with Immortal Spirit.
Wang Ping had no idea that so many thoughts had crossed Chen Yao’s mind.
He simply shook his head and said, “I’ll give it one more try with my ability. This time, there should be hope of killing that guy.”
With that, Wang Ping closed his eyes.
Seeing this, Cai Yonglong, Chen Yao, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun all closed their mouths and quietly waited. “System, I want to use the free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activating, the host has seven free simulation chances remaining.”
The system’s voice rang out once again.
Immediately after, the familiar luminescent screen appeared and the text emerged.
[On the first day, you went directly to the dean and the Great Tao master, telling them about wanting to see the mysterious human. Both the dean and the Great Tao master were shocked and didn’t expect you to know of this person’s existence.]
[They said they could help you to contact him, but you’ll have to wait for that mysterious person’s response. You chose to wait.]
[Soon after, the dean told you that the mysterious man did not want to see you. You were not surprised by this answer.]
[Next, you disappeared with Chen Yao and the others, making it impossible for anyone to find your whereabouts. Then, you began to take tough actions, attacking human Daoists and Great Tao masters one by one, trying to force them out.]
[Your actions angered the high-Tier humans and Daoists to the extreme. They took collective action against you. However, you suppressed them with great strength. You showed no mercy, revealing your intention to kill everyone and using the Forbidden Curse Mana.]
[Eventually, the mysterious person could no longer ignore the situation and chose to take action. He took your Forbidden Curse head-on and scolded you for being a traitor to humanity.]
[In response, you sneered and burst out with your true strength, launching the most powerful attack at the mysterious person. He was terrified and had not expected you to hide so much strength. Caught off guard, he took your blow, was seriously injured, and wanted to escape.]
[You were prepared for this and used the Forbidden Curse Mana: Angel Divine Shield first. However, this time, you didn’t use the Angel Divine Shield to protect yourself. Instead, you formed a barrier-like structure that enveloped the entire space. Although the Angel Divine Shield is defensive, it can be used to trap people if used well.]
[The mysterious person was shocked and did not expect you to have such a move. His expression changed drastically, and he launched an attack to break the Angel Divine Shield. Taking advantage of the opportunity, you unleashed another powerful attack, chopping down on the mysterious person.]
[With a miserable scream, the mysterious person was killed by your strike. When the black fog dissipated, you discovered his identity – it was none other than the dean himself! At this, you were greatly surprised as you hadn’t expected him to hide so deep.]
[Next, your expression changed, as you discovered that the system did not give the mission complete prompt. This meant that Guiyi hadn’t died. You continued to attack the dean, reducing him to ashes, but the mission complete prompt still didn’t appear.]
[This made you feel incredibly heavy. You thought that the mysterious dean was not Guiyi, but you couldn’t understand why he hid his strength and targeted you.]
[Because you killed the mysterious dean, humanity’s hatred and fear of you reached its peak. In response, you remained silent and returned to Cai Yonglong and the others’ hiding place, telling them the situation. The four of them found it hard to believe and couldn’t stay calm.]
[In the end, you discussed it for a long time but still couldn’t come to a conclusion. Then, you began to consider your next move. Soon, you made a decision.]
[You planned to become the highest echelon of humanity, using that position to continue investigating the matter of Guiyi. At the same time, you still had to kill off the demons.]
[You took action and successfully seized power. Your ever-increasing
strength, combined with public opinion manipulation, the killing of powerful demons, and the fact that you had been lauded and worshipped by all.]
[On the 100th day, since you did not unlock the seal of the Demonic Suppressing Cave, there was no movement from it.]
[On the 200th day, the Demonic Suppressing Cave was still silent. At this point, you were certain that all the uprisings in the past in the Demonic Suppressing Cave were caused by the mysterious dean, just to kill you.]
[On the 300th day, with the help of the Point addition system, Chen Yao became a Taoist Saint above the Great Tao masters. Although her combat strength was still far inferior to yours, she was finally considered a Spirit Sea Realm Combat Skill.]
[On the 350th day, all the Demonic Suppressing Caves suddenly erupted at the same time. All the demons broke free from their seals, unleashing endless slaughter. The sky was dyed black by the demon’s aura, and all of humanity was terrified.]
[Chen Yao bore the brunt of the impact, fighting a Demon Emperor. Although she was a Tao Saint on par with the Demon Emperor, her combat experience and ability couldn’t compare to these ancient demons. In the end, by the time you arrived, Chen Yao had already fallen.][After Chen Yao’s death, you noticeably feel the surge in the aura of the monster that looks like a Bull Demon leading the group. This power causes your pupils to shrink, and you think of some things.]
[Next, you have no intention of fighting the demons to the death and plan to retreat. However, led by the Bull Demon, the six Demon Emperors have no intention of letting you go, resulting in a fierce battle. Although your cultivation has improved after 350 days, the increase is not significant.]
[Therefore, when facing the onslaught of the six Demon Emperors led by the
Bull Demon, you are unable to escape the Blood Sky.]
[With your death, the simulation ends…]
As the system prompt sounds, Wang Ping opens his eyes, his gaze profound.
“How did it go?”
Seeing this, everyone looks over.
“It was somewhat unexpected, but the bizarre secrets have finally been thoroughly uncovered. ”
Wang Ping exhales softly, speaking slowly.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes light up.
Following this, Wang Ping wastes no time in recounting the simulation content.
When Wang Ping talks about killing the mysterious person and discovering that they were the dean. everyone is shocked.
Chen Yao, in particular, feels her blood run cold, as she never expected that the mysterious person was beside her all this time. Moreover, they’ve been teaching her cultivation techniques under the guise of a kindly old man.
However, soon, Wang Ping speaks of something that chills Chen Yao’s blood even more.
“How is it possible!? The mysterious Dean didn’t complete the task after his death, so is he not the weird one?”
Cai Yonglong stares wide-eyed, disbelief written all over his face.
Chen Yao, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun are also dumbfounded, unable to accept it.
“Calm down. The Dean is definitely the strange one. However, the strangeness isn’t as simple as we initially thought. As for the specifics, I think I’ve figured it out.”
Wang Ping rolls his eyes, asking everyone to be more patient and not interrupt his explanation.
Wang Ping then quickly recounts the rest of the story.
After Wang Ping finished speaking, the four looked at each other, all somewhat skeptical.
“What’s going on?” Zhang Hu rubs his head in confusion, asking the question.
“If I’m not mistaken, that Bull Demon is the real weirdo? When Chen Yao was killed, he suddenly became stronger, which is obviously not normal and in line with our previous speculation.”
Cai Yonglong frowns, speaking in a deep voice.
“l also think the Bull Demon is the strange one.” Zhang Jun nods in agreement.
“But what about the Dean?” Chen Yao’s face changes rapidly: “Why would he hide his strength and attack us and Mr. Wang?”
“He’s also the weird one. The strange thing we encountered this time should be a double soul.’
Wang Ping had no intention of playing riddles, his eyes deep, speaking directly.
“When I kill the demon, the mysterious person possessing the human dean can become stronger. And the death of a human can make the Bull Demon, who possesses the demon, stronger.”
At these words, everyone is momentarily stunned before quickly responding.
If that’s the case, all the contradictions can be explained.
The Dean’s rapid increase in strength is due to the death of the demons.
And the Bull Demon’s increase in strength is due to the death of humans.
“This strange thing is really interesting. It became the leader of both humans and demons, then watches the two major ethnic groups fight each other while lying down and getting stronger.”
Cai Yonglong sighs..

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 78: Taking Action!
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 78: Taking Action!
Translator: 549690339
“This guy really knows how to play.”
Zhang Hu and Zhang Jun also nodded in agreement.
“Now that we know the secret of the Bull Demon’s weirdness, next time must be a perfect clearing of the future, right?”
Chen Yao let out a sigh of relief, her face full of joy.
“Maybe. After all, everything is just my personal speculation. What it will actually be like still needs to be determined by using my ability.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
After saying this, Wang Ping closed his eyes.
The meaning was very clear.
He was going to use his ability to ‘foresee the future’ again.
Seeing this, Chen Yao and the others all closed their mouths and stopped talking.
Next, Wang Ping said in his heart: “System, I want to start a new simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, host has six remaining simulation times.”
As the system voice sounded, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text began to emerge.
[Day 1: You find the dean and attack him when he is not prepared. Because of your sudden attack and the fact that the dean is not weakened due to the death of many demons, you directly kill him.]
[However, your actions infuriate the high-tier humans and the Great Tao masters. They didn’t expect you to be so strong and even kill the dean directly.]
[Regarding this, you show indifference, just explaining and analyzing a little, making them doubtful. Although they don’t believe your words too much, they can only accept this explanation due to your powerful strength.]
[Next, you consider whether or not to unseal the Demonic Suppressing Caves one by one and kill them one by one to prevent accidents.]
[In the end, you decide to play it safe. With your powerful influence, you force the human higher-ups to provide resources to cultivate Chen Yao. Under your strong influence, the higher-ups have no choice but to submit and provide a large number of resources for Chen Yao’s cultivation. With these resources, Chen Yao’s strength improves rapidly, much faster than in your memory.]
[In just one month, Chen Yao reaches the Tao Saint level, which can rival an ordinary Spirit Sea Realm. Regarding this, you can only lament that the point addition system is really awesome.]
[With Chen Yao as the new Spirit Sea Realm combat power, you finally start to take action. You unlock the seal of the first Demonic Suppressing Cave, cooperate with Chen Yao, and kill the Demon Emperor and many demons inside one by one without any accidents.]
[The demons in the second Demonic Suppressing Cave are much stronger, and the Demon Emperor inside can even make you struggle. However, with the assistance of Chen Yao, you manage to kill it at the cost of only light injuries.]
[The third Demonic Suppressing Cave has a weaker demon emperor, and the two of you easily kill it together.]
[In the fourth Demonic Suppressing Cave, which is sealed under Mount Tai, you encounter a crisis. Because this time the cave is the one where the Bull Demon is sealed, but there is not only one extremely powerful Demon
Emperor, but also another Demon Emperor.]
[A battle ensues. Chen Yao is suppressed by the second Demon Emperor, while the extraordinary strength of the Bull Demon surprises you. You suspect that the death of the dean has allowed the Bull Demon to also gain the same power.]
[This battle is extremely difficult. In the end, Chen Yao dies in battle. You pay a heavy price and, with the help of two Forbidden Curse scrolls, you barely manage to kill the Bull Demon.]
[When the Demon Emperor that killed Chen Yao tries to take advantage of your weakness and launch a fatal blow, you hear the system’s task completion sound and quickly choose to leave this world, saving your life.]
[Because of your return, this simulation ended.]
Wang Ping frowned, his expression slightly solemn.
This Bull Demon was really strong.
Even Wang Ping barely won, thanks to the two Forbidden curse scrolls provided by Zhang Hua Otherwise, the greater possibility might be a defeat or mutual destruction.
Chen Yao suffered an even worse fate, being killed directly.
“What a hassle.’
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
He had already been cautious, letting Chen Yao’s combat power reach the Spirit Sea Realm through resource stacking.
Still, he ended up with such an outcome and only managed to complete the task with great difficulty.
“How is it?”
Seeing Wang Pings strange expression, everyone’s hearts tightened. Wang Ping didn’t hesitate and quickly explained the simulation content.
“This…
After listening, everyone fell silent.
This was too dangerous.
Wang Ping already pushed Chen Yao to the Spirit Sea Realm combat strength, but they still ended up with Chen Yao dying and Wang Ping barely managing to escape with his life. “Are we destined to fail this task?”
Chen Yao bit her lip.
“Having two Demon Emperors together is really troublesome.”
Cai Yonglong bitter smile.
“It’s not that bad compared to the last time when all the Demon Emperors appeared together, that was real despair.”
Zhang Hu sighed.
“It is despairing. What I hate more is that I don’t have enough power to help Wang Ping and Chen Yao.” Zhang Jun clenched his fists, looking frustrated.
Hearing this, Cai Yonglong also fell silent.
In this mission, Chen Yao can play a big role, and Zhang Hu also played a crucial role with the help of the Forbidden curse scrolls.
Only the two of them are weak.
Spiritual Origin Realm strength used to be considered powerful, but in this mission, it’s completely useless.
“Don’t panic. Let’s just think of another way..”

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 78: Taking Action! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 78: Taking Action! 2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping shook his head, still calm.
“At least, this time we know how to clear the stage. Also, we learned that last time’s simultaneous appearance of all Demon Kings was an exception. 1 guess this abnormal Bull Demon has been preparing for it for a long time, but he can’t do it again right now.”
“That makes sense.’
Upon hearing this, the expressions of Chen Yao and the others lightened up a bit.
“What do we do next? Two powerful Demon Emperors in a single Demonic
Suppressing Cave are hard to defeat without consequences.”
Cai Yonglong said with a bitter smile.
“Maybe the abnormal strength of the Bull Demon was because I killed the principal. If I don’t kill him, he might not be that strong, and I might have an easier time dealing with it. Then, we can grievously wound the principal and kill him together.”
Wang Ping contemplated.
“But, is there a possibility that once two abnormalities appear at the same time, they will merge…”
Zhang Jun quietly suggested.
Everybody froze and furrowed their brows.
An abnormality is unpredictable, so it might be possible.
“We will only know if we try.” Wang Ping shook his head and said, “We still have a few chances, no need to rush.’
“That’s true.” Cai Yonglong and the others felt slightly relieved. “Mr. Wang, we have always overlooked the power of our homeland.”
Chen Yao, looking serious, chimed in.
“I’ve studied the history of this world and read numerous scriptures on Tao Skills. Actually, we might be able to find some tools with demonic suppression properties or a Greater Array from the major sects or certain ruins in the world. With the aid of these tools, we might be able to kill the Demon Emperor more efficiently.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping and the others looked surprised and hopeful.
“You make a valid point. Because the humans of this world are so weak and can’t help us, I’ve been ignoring them. However, ancient Taoists who sealed all the demons surely had powerful methods of suppression.”
Wang Ping said with a laugh.
“So that means we do have a way to resolve this.”
Cai Yonglong and the others felt excited.
“Maybe we can not only use these methods to complete our task, but also greatly benefit from studying them when back home.”
The eyes of Cai Yonglong shone brighter.
The Profound World is vast and filled with all kinds of peculiar creatures.
Demons, Blood Demons, corpses, yin sha, and such entities must exist.
If we can study the methods of this world, we may be able to save our own lives in the future.
“l wonder if these methods will work on the undead.” Zhang Hu also murmured to himself.
Zhang Jun remained silent. He didn’t have any energy, just pure physical strength, and he didn’t think these methods would be all that effective against zombies.
“We’ll discuss that later. After we’ve completed the task, Chen Yao can compile the information for us and send it over using a group red packet.”
Wang Ping smiled, interrupting everyone else’s musing.
“Leave it to me,” Chen Yao nodded.
If they accomplish the task, she will become a Tao Saint. Although she might not be able to obtain all the high-rank methods from this world, getting some wouldn’t be a problem.
“Okay, I’m going to use my ability again.”
Wang Ping nodded and once again closed his eyes.
The simulation started, and words appeared on the luminescent screen.
[On the first day, after thinking it over, you decide to kill the principal.
Otherwise, if he escapes, we will face a bigger problem later. Therefore, you suddenly attack the principal and kill him.]
[Then, you cultivate Chen Yao and within a month she becomes a Tao Saint. At the same time, during this month, you’ve already assembled all the Tao Masters to find a method to weaken the Demon Emperors.]
[Finally, the Tao Masters come up with the Demon Locking Array. This great array can seal the Demon Emperor, reducing their power.]
[After everything is prepared, you break the seal of the Demonic Suppressing
Cave beneath Mount Tai, releasing all the demons. When the Demon Emperors come out, the Demon Locking Array – spearheaded by Chen Yao as the new Tao Saint, aided by ten Tao Masters, and supported by a hundred Taoists – is immediately activated, suppressing all demons.]
[Not just that, but the Demon Binding Locks also shows up, intending to tie up all the demons.]
[The demons are shocked and furious, trying to break the formation. You decide to intervene. As the two Demon Emperors are suppressed and with the aid of the Demon Binding Lock, you take on both of them and manage to gain the upper hand.]
[In the end, during the intense battle, you first kill the weaker Demon Emperor and then wage a great battle against the abnormal Bull Demon. The abnormal Bull Demon is very strong, but still, you manage to kill it, only paying the price of minor injuries.]
[Because of the completion of the task, you all celebrate and then leave the world one after the other.]
[Because you leave this world, the simulation ends.]
“Finally, we’ve succeeded.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and heaved a sigh of relief.
Indeed, even if they are weak, they are useful. We cannot overlook their existence,
“Did we succeed?”
Seeing the relaxed expression on Wang Pings face, Chen Yao and the others showed expectant and hopeful expressions.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded while laughing, and relayed the content of the simulation.
“That’s great! ”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yao clenched her fists excitedly.
Cai Yonglong and the others were also extremely thrilled.
After all, completing a group task without harm is the best outcome..

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 78: Taking Action! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 78: Taking Action! _3
Translator: 549690339
“Since we’ve found the way to break the deadlock, let’s take action. There must be no mistakes.’
Wang Ping took a deep breath and said calmly after calming down. Upon hearing this, everyone felt a shiver down their spines.
However, Cai Yonglong and the others exchanged glances, feeling somewhat helpless.
Alright, they couldn’t be of much help; they were mere spectators.
“Chen Yao’s lucky. In a month, she’ll become a powerful Spirit Sea Realm fighter.”
Zhang Hu said with envy.
Zhang Jun silently looked over.
Cai Yonglong was even more envious, his face twitching.
The Point addition system was really unfair.
