Chen Yao and Wang Ping were really awesome, growing into Spirit Sea Realm combatants in such a short time, which made him feel utterly miserable.
“But it’s fortunate that Chen Yao has the Point addition system so she can become stronger quickly. Otherwise, we wouldn’t be able to complete this
Group Task, and we’d all die.”
Soon after, Cai Yonglong sighed with emotion.
Zhang Hu and Zhang Jun were both silent.
“I’ll go find the dean. You guys wait here.”
Wang Ping glanced at the others and left without saying much.
Chen Yao could help him in the future, but not right now.
The four of them were currently only at the Spiritual Origin Realm in combat ability, so they wouldn’t be of much use in dealing with the dean.
“The Transcenders, or so-called saviors…they’re real troublemakers.”
In the dean’s office, he sipped his tea, squinting out the window, his eyes flickering with uncertainty.
Transcenders were the sworn enemies of his mysterious race.
Originally, he had planned to use Chen Yao, the naive enemy, as a pavvn. But now it seemed that he had to change his plan and find a way to kill them all as quickly as possible.
Of course, he had to do this without exposing himself.
Once exposed, he would face the saviors’ relentless pursuit.
At that point, there would be only two outcomes for him.
Death.
Or surviving after destroying all life in this world beforehand.
At this moment, the dean suddenly sensed an approaching presence, feeling a chill in his heart as he pulled himself together and sat up straight.
Soon, Wang Ping pushed open the office door and walked in.
“Fellow Taoist Wang Ping, I wonder what brings you here!”
The dean looked warmly at Wang Ping and chuckled.
Although he wanted to kill Wang Ping, he was also quite wary of him.
He knew that Wang Ping wasn’t as simple as a High-Tier Demon King.
If it were that simple, Wang Ping wouldn’t have gone unnoticed by him when he first descended.
“Dean, I’m here to hear your answer.”
Wang Ping closed the door casually, walked towards the dean, and smiled.
“About that…it hasn’t been that long, isn’t fellow Taoist too anxious?”
The dean said with a wry smile.
“Well, I just want to help Chen Yao get out of this mess as soon as possible.” Wang Ping shook his head and continued walking towards the dean.
“By the way, Dean, where is the Great Taoist Grandfather? I want to talk to him about some things.”
“The elder has something important to attend to.”
The dean explained.
“I see. I originally wanted to discuss Tao Skill with the elder. I’m quite interested in your world’s Tao Skill.”
Wang Ping said with some regret.
“Haha, Tao Skill. Although I’m just a taoist priest, my Tao Skill attainment is not weak, and 1 can explain it to you… ‘
The dean paused for a moment, then laughed heartily and enthusiastically.
However, before he could finish speaking, a fiery red Spirit Sword suddenly appeared in Wang Pings hand.
At the same moment, the surging, boiling red liquid Spiritual Essence within his body burst forth, attaching itself to the Spirit Sword.
Then, with Wang Pings eyes sharp, and his 6th Tier Peak Sword Spirit erupting, a crimson flame Sword Spirit fiercely slashed towards the dean!
This sword was too fast, too ferocious, and since they were too close, by the time the dean reacted, it was already too late!
The dean’s face changed drastically as he desperately tried to mobilize his power and use his Tao Skill to defend himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 79: Slaying the Demon Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 79: Slaying the Demon Emperor!
Translator: 549690339
The Principal’s hasty defense was rendered completely useless, as Wang Pings most powerful sword easily tore through it, bisecting the Principal along with it.
The terrifying Sword Spirit, after killing the Principal, continued its unstoppable trajectory towards the sky, its power reaching an unimaginable extent.
Feeling the horror of this Sword Spirit, both Taoists and hidden Demons within the Royal Capital could not help but show shocked expressions on their faces.
This power was just too overwhelming, far surpassing that of a Demon King, reaching an unfathomable level.
“Dead?”
Wang Ping looked down at the halved body of the Principal, squinting his eyes.
Suddenly, he stretched out his palm, fearsome Red Spiritual Fire condensed and burst forth, incinerating the Principal to ashes.
While Wang Ping was dealing with everything, a figure appeared here, staring at Wang Ping with a mix of fear and anger, questioning, “Wang Ping, what is your intention? Why do you want to kill the Principal?” “Because he is an enemy hidden among humans.”
Wang Ping calmly said.
“What do you mean?”
The Tao Master’s face was filled with uncertainty.
“It doesn’t mean anything. Without evidence, I can’t explain anything, nor do I want to waste time explaining anything.”
Wang Ping held his sword, pointing it at the Tao Master. The sharp edge sent a chill down the Tao Master’s spine.
Wang Pings strength was too terrifying, having reached the level of a Tao Saint and Demon Emperor.
And not just any ordinary Tao Saint and Demon Emperor.
Such strength was enough to push the entire world aside.
“Gather the high-ranked humans and all the powerful Taoists. If you fail to do so, humanity will be destroyed.”
Wang Ping stared at the Tao Master, speaking calmly.
His words left the old Tao Master with a constantly changing expression, unsure whether Wang Ping meant he would annihilate all humans if they didn’t cooperate or if he knew of other impending disasters.
“Understood.’
In the end, the old Tao Master could only nod weakly.
The situation was stronger than anything else; Wang Pings strength was too terrifying, and they didn’t stand a chance to resist.
After the Tao Master left, the powerful figures of the entire academy stared at Wang Ping, silent like cicadas in winter, not daring to make a sound.
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t care about their opinion, he just reunited with Chen Yao and the others.
“Wang Ping, you were too direct.”
Chen Yao said with a wry smile.
Taking this approach would make things extremely awkward in the future, and her position would become rather difficult.
“I don’t have the energy to bother with their insincere concerns.” Wang Ping glanced at Chen Yao and spoke calmly, “Besides, not all of them are good people. At this point, we can only act decisively, kill the Principal and force them to cooperate. Only then, can many things proceed.”
“Don’t worry about it. Eventually, with the resources piled up, you will become a Tao Saint. By that time, no one would dare to speak up after we leave.” “Alright.” Chen Yao nodded.
Not long after, Tao Masters and powerful Taoist priests gathered together; high-ranking humans all gathered in one place, daring to be angry but not daring to speak against Wang Ping.
Ultimately, just like the mock situation, Wang Ping directly stated his demands for all parties to train and deploy Chen Yao, to eliminate the forthcoming Demon Emperor, and protect all of humanity.
Each party was extremely stifled by this, but had no choice but to cooperate.
In the blink of an eye, a month passed, and Chen Yao successfully broke through to the level of a Tao Saint. Her combat skill was extremely powerful, making Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Zhang Hu envious.
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t feel anything. Although Chen Yao’s growth was rapid, her competition in the chat group was in a whole other league. However, Chen Yao’s strength was only in her cultivation, making her weaker compared to other Spirit Sea Realm Combat Skill users. “Let’s go. Today, we will kill the Demon Emperor and destroy the strange.” Wang Ping led the team, flying towards Mount Tai.
Behind him were many followers, including Chen Yao, twelve human Tao Masters, and numerous Taoist priests.
It could be said that almost all of humanity’s high-end combat forces were deployed.
Although this approach would leave their defenses extremely weak, Wang Pings terrifying power had scared the powerful Demons into submission, and they didn’t dare to do anything drastic.
In fact, the human world was more stable than ever, which was one reason why the humans finally decided to cooperate with Wang Ping in destroying the Demonic Suppressing Cave.
Humans not only yielded to Wang Pings strength but also realized that doing so would be greatly beneficial to them.
If Wang Ping led them to destroy the Demonic Suppressing Cave, it would be like defusing a ticking time bomb while also further deterring other potential Demon Emperors, preventing them from acting recklessly.
“Set up the array.”
Upon arriving at the entrance of the Demonic Suppressing Cave at the foot of Mount Tai, Chen Yao shouted, prompting all the Tao Masters and Taoist priests to take action.
Quickly, with Chen Yao’s Array Plate at the center, a combination of twelve Tao Niasters and hundreds of Taoist priests formed the most powerful Demon Locking Array.
At a distance, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun could only watch helplessly, witnessing the great battle that was about to unfold.
“The Demon Locking Array is complete; it’s time to unlock the seal of the Demonic Suppressing Cave.”
Wang Ping smirked and held an ancient talisman in his hand, flinging it towards the entrance of the Demonic Suppressing Cave.
Although Wang Ping could forcefully break the seal with brute force, doing so would consume his own power; using the ancient talisman, the key to unlocking the seal of Demonic Suppressing Cave, was the best choice.
As the ancient talisman unsealed the Demonic Suppressing Cave,
in an instant, a terrifying dark energy erupted from the Demon Suppression Cave, dying the originally clear sky blood black, giving off an incredibly gloomy and oppressive feeling..

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 79: Slaying the Demon Emperor! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 79: Slaying the Demon Emperor! 2
Translator: 549690339
“Hehehe, the seal of the Demonic Suppressing Cave has been broken. Is it the work of our kind?”
“After so many years, this King has finally returned. This time, I will certainly blood-wash the Human Race and devour millions of lives.’
Following that, several strands of evil demonic aura rushed out from the Demonic Suppressing Cave, laughing loudly at the sky.
However, they didn’t have much time to celebrate, as the Demon Locking Array condensed into white chains with sealing power, binding them all and crushing them one by one.
“This is the Demon Locking Array!? Damn it, this is a trap set by those stinking Taoists! ”
Seeing this scene, the demons that rushed out were filled with unparalleled fear.
“Hmph, is a mere Demon Locking Array trying to trap this Emperor?”
At this moment, a terrifying demonic aura suddenly appeared, and a tall figure emerged in midair.
He was eight meters tall, with black fur all over his body, tiger-like features, and a blood-colored third eye on his forehead, appearing extremely vicious.
“The Three-eyed Demon Emperor!”
Looking at this emerging demon, and sensing his terrifying aura, the Taoists present were all filled with trepidation and instinctively trembled a little.
The Demon Emperor was too powerful. Even his oppressive presence was unbearable for them.
If it weren’t for the Demon Locking Array, most of them would have already perished.
“Hehe, interesting. Has a Tao Saint appeared among the humans? However, thinking that a mere newly ascended Tao Saint’s Demon Locking Array could trap and kill this Emperor is too far-fetched.”
Three-eyed Demon Emperor looked at Chen Yao and sneered.
“Not to mention, besides myself, there is another Emperor in this Demonic Suppressing Cave.”
These words sent a shudder through the other demons.
However, they soon sneered.
Right, what could a Tao Saint’s Demon Locking Array do? They had two Demon Emperors here. It was not something the Demon Locking Array could contain.
By voluntarily unsealing the Demonic Suppressing Cave, the humans were simply seeking their own demise.
“In this battle, I am not the main force.” Chen Yao coldly stared at the Three-eyed Demon Emperor and calmly said: “There is someone else to kill you.”
At these words, the demons’ hearts stirred slightly.
It seemed the Three-eyed Demon Emperor sensed something, as his three eyes shrank slightly and he looked towards a certain direction.
In that direction, Wang Pings clothes fluttered, as he held the Spirit Sword and walked in mid-air. His aura burst forth from his body.
“Who are you? Why can’t I sense any Saint’s aura from you, yet your power is so strong!’
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor stared intently at Wang Ping, his face uncertain.
“There’s no need for you to know who 1 am. You only need to know that I am the one who will kill you. That’s enough.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
As his words fell, a cluster of Red Fire wings appeared behind Wang Ping, causing the air to distort from the burning heat.
In the next instant, Wang Ping appeared in front of the Three-eyed Demon Emperor, slashing a sword qi wrapped in 6th Tier Peak Sword Spirit with full force.
“Not good! ”
Three-eyed Demon Emperor’s face changed drastically as he exploded with power to confront Wang Ping, resulting in a terrifying explosion.
Immediately after, the Three-eyed Demon Emperor’s figure was thrown backwards, spitting a mouthful of blood mid-air and sustaining injuries.
As for the other powerful demons, they were turned into dust by the shockwaves of the two’s collision, ceasing to exist.
After all, these demons didn’t have the protection of the Demon Locking Array, and they simply couldn’t withstand the aftermath of a battle between two beings far stronger than themselves.
“Demon Locking Array, suppress!”
Seeing the battle start, Chen Yao shouted and manipulated the Demon Locking Array, condensing numerous chains imbued with sealing power, shooting them towards the Three-eyed Demon Emperor in an attempt to coordinate with Wang Ping and finish the Demon Emperor as quickly as possible.
“Bull Demon, save me!”
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor’s face turned pale as he screamed.
At the same time, another terrifying aura emerged from the Demonic Suppressing Cave and entered the Demon Locking Array.
He was nine meters tall, with a black body and an appearance like a bull.
The moment he appeared, he unleashed a terrifying power, forcibly crushing Wang Pings sword qi, blocking his attack.
Three-eyed Demon Emperor took this opportunity to shatter the Demon Binding Locks, appearing with an ugly expression next to the Bull Demon.
Wang Pings strength had caught him off guard.
If it weren’t for the Bull Demon’s rescue, he would have been in real danger just now.
“Bull Demon, hold him off. I’ll break the Demon Locking Array.”
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor spoke solemnly.”You can’t handle it.” The Bull Demon stared intently at Wang Ping, speaking solemnly: “You hold him off, and I’ll break the formation. It’ll be faster this way.”
“Alright!” The Three-eyed Demon Emperor hesitated for a moment, but ultimately nodded in agreement.
Now was not the time for indecision. The Demon Locking Array would weaken their power. The longer they lingered, the more dangerous it would become.
If there were no other strong contenders, he wouldn’t be worried about things going wrong. However, having a formidable adversary like Wang Ping meant prolonging this would be extremely unfavorable for them.
“Roar!”
Immediately, the Bull Demon roared and unleashed a terrifying demonic force, fiercely bombarding the barrier formed by the Demon Locking Array.
Chen Yao’s face changed, and she hurriedly controlled the Demon Locking Array to confront the demons.
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor wasn’t that big of an issue, but this Bull Demon was cunning, and absolutely could not be allowed to escape.
“Roar!”
On the other side, the Three-eyed Demon Emperor, well aware of Wang Pings strength, also roared and used his full power.
Blood-red demonic energy condensed around his body, and the lone eye shone brightly with blood-red light.
Immediately after, a blood-red light pole burst forth from the single eye, viciously targeting Wang Ping.
Wang Pings expression remained unchanged, and he raised his Spirit Sword.
Behind him, three sword formations instantly emerged, condensing an astonishing Sword Spirit. Then they combined as one, fiercely colliding with the blood-red light pole.
As the two forces collided, the flame Sword Spirit tore apart the blood-red light pole, gradually heading towards the Three-eyed Demon Emperor. “Damn it, this human’s power system may not be specifically tailored to counter demons like a Taoist’s, but the flames and sword spirit he has condensed are more challenging for me than any Taoist.”
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor was very frustrated.
He could sense that in terms of purely strength, he and Wang Ping were almost evenly matched, and he might even be slightly stronger.
But Wang Pings flames and sword intent were too troublesome for him to handle.
On top of that, the power reduction caused by the Demon Locking Array meant that he truly was no match for Wang Ping.
“If that is the strongest you’ve got, then you may as well die.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
As the words fell, Wang Ping held his sword in his right hand and formed a secret incantation with his left.
In an instant, Pings liquid Spiritual Essence surged out, condensing an enormous fire dragon formed of red flames in the outer world.
This was a secret skill recorded in the Red Fire Skill’s scroll called Red Fire Dragon!
As the fire dragon appeared, the temperature of the space around it began to rapidly rise. Even with the protection of the Array Mana, the Taoists present felt unbearably hot and uncomfortable.
They all looked at the scene in fear, their hearts chilled.
If it weren’t for the Demon Locking Array, they would already be dead, not even leaving a trace behind.
Moreover, without the Demon Locking Array, the terrifying force of this power would level Mount Tai to the ground.
This was the horrifying power of a Demon Emperor tier fighter, an unstoppable force they could never forget.
For a moment, they all felt a heightened sense of reverence towards Wang
Ping.
“Damn it!”
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor’s eyes were filled with rage, his face extremely unpleasant as a shadow of death loomed within his heart.
“Bull Demon, save me!”
The Three-eyed Demon Emperor let out a panicked cry, completely bereft of any semblance of a Demon Emperor’s prestige.
Facing the plea for help, the Bull Demon merely cast a cold glance, then ignored him, focusing instead on attacking the Demon Locking Array with even greater ferocity, intending to break it.
This made the expressions of Chen Yao and the others turn deathly Dale. feeling extreme discomfort.
Several Taoists couldn’t even bear the backlash and spat out mouthfuls of blood, their auras becoming weak.
The Bull Demon was too strong, far surpassing any ordinary Demon Emperor. Even the formation of the Demon Locking Array struggled to withstand the power of its attacks.
“Bull Demon!”
Angered by the Bull Demon’s indifference towards him, the Three-eyed Demon Emperor roared.
Unable to defend himself, the Three-eyed Demon Emperor was then swallowed by the fire dragon, burning to ashes.
At the same time, the Bull Demon struck a crack in the Demon Locking Array.
His face lit up, and he prepared to launch another attack to break the Demon Locking Array and escape from it.
“With me here, you still wish to escape?”
Wang Ping let out a cold shout. As the red fire wings behind him vibrated, he transformed into a red divine halo, appearing in front of the Bull Demon and blocking its punch.
After Wang Ping blocked the punch, Chen Yao and her comrades finally had a chance to catch their breath. They hurriedly stabilized the Demon Locking Array, and the cracks disappeared once more..

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 80: Setting Sail Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 80: Setting Sail Again!
Translator: 549690339
“You think that with the aid of the Demon Locking Array, you can defeat this emperor?”
The Bull Demon sneered at Wang Ping, speaking coldly.
“There’s no point in talking about this. You should be well aware. Either you die, or we die, there’s no room for turning back.”
Wang Ping held the Red Spiritual Sword, pointing it at the Bull Demon and coldly spoke.
“Hmph, if that’s the case, then go to your death.”
The Bull Demon roared and charged towards Wang Ping.
They engaged in an intense battle.
It had to be said that the Bull Demon’s strength was truly great, much stronger than that of the Three-eyed Demon Emperor.
If it weren’t for the assistance of the Demon Locking Array, Wang Ping would have indeed suffered severe damage.
However, with the help of the Demon Locking Array, Wang Pings chances of slaying the Bull Demon weren’t slim.
In this battle, the two of them collided fiercely, causing the space around them to shatter, while the Demon Locking Array teetered on the brink of collapse.
The Red Fire Dragon created by Wang Ping was torn apart by the Bull Demon, turning into sparks.
However, the Bull Demon himself was also slashed by Wang Ping, leaving his body covered in sword wounds and blood gushing out.
“Damn it, this is all your fault!”
The Bull Demon’s face contorted with rage, and he roared as his body swelled up.
Seeing this scene, Wang Pings expression changed, realizing the Bull Demon’s intention.
Immediately, Wang Ping mobilized all his strength for defense, his fiery wings enveloping his body, providing a solid protection.
At the same time, he used the Forbidden Curse Mana: Angel Divine Shield, adding another layer of protection surrounding his body.
Moreover, Wang Ping also used the Forbidden Curse Mana: Ten Thousand Lightning Destruction to attack the Bull Demon, hoping to stop his self-destruction.
However, a single Thousand Thunder Extinguishment was clearly not enough to disrupt the Bull Demon.
“BOOM! !!! ! ”
The next moment, a massive explosion rang out within the Demon Locking Array, swallowing everything in its path.
Although Chen Yao had sensed something amiss and increased her defenses to the maximum, the terrifying explosion still caused the Demon Locking Array to be covered in cracks, threatening to burst apart at any moment. Everyone involved in the Array’s formation had pale faces, coughing up blood, and their vitality seemed to be drained to the limit.
Within them, Chen Yao, who was at the center of the Array, took the most significant impact, coughing up large amounts of blood and suffering severe injuries.
However, it was fortunate that she was a Tao Saint and had voluntarily taken the brunt of most of the impact.
Otherwise, all the Taoists here would have faced total annihilation.
From a distance, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Hu, and Zhang Jun saw this scene, their eyelids twitching uncontrollably as they gasped in shock. “Goodness, the self-destruction of a Demon Emperor is terrifying.”
Cai Yonglong clicked his tongue, his face filled with fear.
“Even at this distance, and with the Array Sphere obstructing us, I can still feel a suffocating pressure.”
Zhang Hu e s face also twitched involuntarily.
“Thank goodness for the Demon Locking Array, otherwise Mount Tai would have been razed to the ground, and the surrounding mountains would have been affected.’
Zhang Jun silently said.
At the level of Demon Emperor or Transcendent Realm, their power was incredibly strong and capable of causing havoc and destruction in battle.
The power of their self-destruction was even more terrifying than any ordinary battle, and it would be a breeze to destroy Mount Tai and the surrounding areas. “l wonder how Wang Ping is doing.”
Zhang Hu murmured.
“Just like in the prophetic vision, he’ll suffer some, but it won’t be too serious.”
Cai Yonglong spoke calmly.
Both of them nodded in agreement.
As the explosion’s impact dissipated, Wang Ping reappeared before everyone’s eyes.
At this moment, the fiery wings on Wang Pings back had disappeared, and the golden shield formed by his Taboo MagicAngel Sacred Shield had been shattered.
Wang Pings clothes were torn and tattered, and there was blood at the corner of his mouth.
“The self-destruction of this Demon Emperor is indeed astonishing. If it weren’t for my double-layer defense, the outcome would have been worse than just coughing up some blood.”
Wang Ping wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and shook his head.
“Ding, the Treacherous One has been killed, the Group Task has been completed, and rewards have been distributed separately. Group members can claim their rewards on the Group Reward Page.”
“Ding, the Group Task has been completed, all members may mentally chant
‘return’ within 24 hours to return to their own worlds. If they do not return within 24 hours, the system will forcibly send them back to their original world.’
At the sound of the voice in his mind, Wang Ping chuckled and completely relaxed.
Chen Yao also heard the system prompt, releasing a sigh of relief. She quickly deactivated the Demon Locking Array, panting heavily as she kneeled on the ground.
Despite her exhaustion, Chen Yao was still very happy.
After all, they didn’t have to die.
Although other Demon Emperors would emerge in the future, that was a problem for later, and for now, they could relax. That was enough.
Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Zhang Hu were overjoyed and hurriedly ran towards them.
“It really succeeded…” The Tao Masters present were excited in their hearts.
Killing two Demon Emperors in a single attempt and completely annihilating a Demonic Suppressing Cave was a great accomplishment.
With this achievement, as long as humanity still exists, their names will go down in history.
Furthermore, once this victory is known, the remaining demons would no longer dare to act recklessly and would retreat into hiding.
“Chen Yao, the task is complete, and I’ll be leaving first. As for the Tao skills and the like, you can deal with the remaining matters yourself.”
Wang Ping looked at Chen Yao and said.
“Mhm, I know.”
Chen Yao nodded, her face serious as she spoke..

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 80: Setting Sail Again!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 80: Setting Sail Again!_2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping nodded slightly, and after glancing at Cai Yonglong and the others, his figure directly turned into a ray of light before disappearing.
Staying in this world no longer held any meaning, so it was better to return to his own realm as soon as possible.
Wang Ping preferred the Profound World he inhabited over this one.
It was where he could quickly become stronger.
Only by becoming stronger faster could he deal with bigger crises in the future.
This time was no different.
If it wasn’t for his breakthrough to the Spirit Sea Realm four months ago and obtaining the Red Fire Skill, 6th Tier of the peak sword spirit, and the Spirit Sword, this Group Task wouldn’t have been so easy to complete.
By then, even ten simulations might not have been enough.
After all, he was already so strong, but he still used up five free simulation chances…
Upon returning, Wang Ping exhaled lightly and murmured, “As expected, being bold during the simulation is essential. I must figure out every path to quickly become stronger and go all out. If I keep playing it safe and don’t have enough opportunities to become stronger quickly, my next steps will be difficult. Once my rate of improvement slows down, I might fall during a future Group Task”
The Life Simulator is not just for playing it safe and grinding for rewards. Various adventures, knowing the future advantages, and knowing where opportunities lie and how to seize them are also part of the process.
“Of course, that is assuming I don’t refresh my innate talent. If I manage to refresh a powerful talent, there may be a more suitable path for growth.”
Wang Ping added silently.
Next, Wang Ping opened the chat group.
The chat group was very lively.
As everyone had completed the task, their moods were exceptionally good, so everyone was chatting.
Zhang Hu(5): “Hey, that’s what happened during the task. To tell the truth,
Mr. Wang, you’re amazing! I lucked out again, comfortably earning 10,000 Group Points.”
Cai Yonglong(l): “Damn, 10,000 Group Points, I’m so envious. I only got 300. Well, considering I was just a spectator this time, it’s normal to get only this much. It’s so sad.’
Zhang Jun(70): “1 got the same 300, feels like I just got the lowest amount possible…”
Chen Yao(71):
Zhang Hu(5): “Chen Yao, how many Group Points did you get this time? It must be a lot. After all, you became a Tao Saint and contributed a lot more than I did. I’m genuinely envious. jpg.”
Chen Yao(71): “Not much, just 50,000 Group Points.”
Cai Yonglong(l): “Damn, 50,000, I’m so jealous.”
Fang Yun(3): “Well, the rewards for this Group Task are quite a lot. But considering the difficulty, it’s worth it.”
Ye Xiaofan(75): “Sheesh, so many Transcendent Realm Battle Powers. It’s ridiculous that Mr. Wang still had such a hard time as a Spirit Sea Realm cultivator. Good thing I didn’t go.”
Qin Tian(77): “Yeah, to be honest, if the base reward was higher, I might have thought about joining the fun, but with such a low amount, I wouldn’t want to take the risk. Even though Mr. Wang is strong and has the badass Golden
Finger, there could still be obstacles.”
Fang Yun(3): “You two, give it a rest. Even with enough rewards, considering your previous performance, I doubt you’d go.”
Wu Jun(20): “By the way, why isn’t Mr. Wang speaking up? I’m curious about how many Group Points he got.”
As soon as these words came out, the group became even livelier, with everyone guessing Wang Pings gains.
Seeing this, Wang Pings eyes flickered as he silently opened his own Group Red Packet Reward.
Then, to his surprise, he found that he had received 300,000 Group Points as a reward for this Group Task.
“300,000 Group Points, not bad at all. It’s enough to buy a Rebirth Tally.” Wang Ping was quite satisfied with this harvest.
Without hesitation, he immediately opened the System Mall and directly purchased a Rebirth Tally to save his life.
Afterwards, Wang Ping saw the price of the Rebirth Tally skyrocket from 100,000 Group Points to a million Group Points.
His mouth twitched slightly at this.
Ten times the price increase was shocking.
If he bought another one, the price would not jump to ten million Group Points, right?
Even though there’s no limit on buying Rebirth Tallies, this increasing price is the most significant limiting factor.
“Of course, it’s still not as expensive as the Golden Finger Optimizer.” Then, Wang Ping looked at the second system item and pressed his temples.
Golden Finger Optimizer
Price: 100 million group points.
That’s right, since Wang Ping purchased one, the price of this item skyrocketed a hundred times to 100 million Group Points to buy another one and optimize his Golden Finger again.
Of course, while Wang Ping complained about the price of the Golden Finger Optimizer, he didn’t think it was too high.
After all, the Golden Finger is the most significant cheat for a transmigrator.
Becoming able to optimize his Golden Finger a second time for a price of 100 million Group Points wasn’t expensive at all.
As long as there was a price, there was hope,
If there was no Golden Finger Optimizer available, that would be the most significant loss.
Wang Ping(66): ‘1 1 didn’t get much reward either, just 300k.”
As soon as Wang Pings words came out, the group first went silent before exploding, all of them turning into sour lemons.
Of course, even though they were envious, they knew it was a reward Wang Ping deserved.
Without Wang Ping, both Group Tasks might have ended in total annihilation..

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 80: Setting Sail Again! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 80: Setting Sail Again! _3
Translator: 549690339
Therefore, everyone who had participated in the Group Task was grateful to Wang Ping.
Zhang Hu (5): “Enough talking, let’s continue our cultivation. Also, I need to find another chance to ask my master for some Forbidden Curse Scrolls. They really did come in handy this time!”
Fang Yun (3): “Zhang Hu, you sly dog, hiding your true potential like that. I’m so jealous.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “This guy keeps taking advantage of his master’s generosity. I’m surprised he hasn’t been beaten to death yet.”
Qin Tian (77): “Heh, those with dull minds complain while the smart ones, like me, will also go ask our masters for life-saving treasures.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “…..My Sect Leader is only at the Golden Elixir Realm for cultivation. What good things can he possibly have?”
Wang Ping smiled and closed the lively chat group.
Afterward, Wang Ping bid farewell to the village leader and others, then returned to the Sword Spirit Sect to quietly cultivate.
When he had nothing to do, he would teach Bai Tianhong cultivation or occasionally practice alchemy, helping the Sword Spirit Sect cultivate some strong cultivators.
Two months passed in a blink of an eye, and Wang Pings cultivation improvement wasn’t much.
It couldn’t be helped; there were no mid-and-high-tier Spiritual Stones available, and the Spiritual Energy in the environment wasn’t dense either. In such circumstances, dreaming of rapid cultivation improvement was just wishful thinking.
“I’ve saved up 11 free simulation chances. I can continue with the simulations now.”
Wang Ping sat on a stone stool in front of the waterfall, watching Bai Tianhong practicing swordsmanship while muttering to himself.
“System, I want to proceed with the free simulation.”
Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, the free simulation has begun. The host has ten remaining free chances.’
The system’s voice sounded, a luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged on it.
[On the first day, you do not rush to venture into the sea, planning to wait for further improvement in your cultivation and Bai Tianhongs growth. Thus, you decide to leave the mountain and look for opportunities.]
[In the year 720 of the Daya Calendar, you break through to the Mid Stage of the Spirit Sea Realm and comprehend 70% of the Sword Spirit, finally taking that crucial step. You decide to take the now aging Bai Tianhong to sea.]
[On the first day, both of you are safe and sound.]
[On the third day, both of you are safe and sound.]
[On the fourth day, the Spiritual Energy becomes denser, and you feel the approach of a Transcendent Realm Sea Beast. In response, you reveal your aura, intimidating it. In the end, it chooses not to attack and flees.]
[On the fifth day, the aura of a Transcendent Realm Monster emerges, but both of you remain unharmed.]
[On the sixth day, both of you are safe and sound.]
[On the seventh day, you detect the aura of another Transcendent Realm Sea Beast. This Transcendent Realm Sea Beast is even more powerful than the previous one, reaching the level of the Mid Stage of the Spirit Sea Realm.
Seeing this, you grow serious and release your aura again, trying to intimidate it.]
[However, this Transcendent Realm Sea Beast is very fierce and not only remains undeterred but attacks you directly. You battle fiercely, unleashing your full strength and ultimately slaying it. You take its Demon Beasts’ Elixir and other important parts from its body before moving on.]
[On the eighth day, you are attacked again, but you overpower and slay all the attacking monster beasts. However, you grow increasingly worried, realizing just how dangerous the sea is and how densely packed the Transcendent Realm monsters are.]
[On the twelfth day, you encounter the most terrifying attack. A late-stage peak Spirit Sea Realm Sea Beast, two mid-stage Spirit Sea Realm Sea Beasts, and five early-stage Spirit Sea Realm Sea Beasts launch an assault. The battle is extremely difficult with dangers lurking at every turn.]
[In the end, relying on your powerful 70% Sword Spirit, you barely manage to slay them all. However, you are severely wounded, and Bai Tianhong is tragically killed by the Sea Beast.]
[With a heavy heart, you gaze into the still endless sea and ponder whether to continue your journey. Finally, with a bitter smile, you press on. You no longer have any room for choice and have lost your way back.]
[On the fifteenth day, you are attacked yet again. This time, a terrifying Spiritual Fetus Realm Monster launches an assault against you. As soon as you exchange blows, you are severely injured, and even your Spirit Sword is shattered.]
[In your moment of despair, the Red Treasured Pearl’s Blood Essence and the Ancient Jade shine together. In the end, the Blood Essence is completely consumed, and the Ancient Jade unleashes a tremendous power, killing the Spiritual Fetus Realm Terror Monster outright. You stare at this scene, lost for words for a long time.]
[Subsequently, instead of moving forward, you decide to stay in this area, planning to break through to the Late Stage of the Spirit Sea Realm by leveraging the resources of slain monster beasts.]
[Three days later, you successfully break through to the Late Stage of the Spirit Sea Realm. However, you don’t feel overly joyful, as you know that even with the Rebirth Tally as your last resort, there’s still a high chance of dying in this ocean.]
[After a long period of silence, you once again choose to move forward..]

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 81: Sinful Bloodline Descendants!
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 81: Sinful Bloodline Descendants!
Translator: 549690339
“On the nineteenth day, you were not attacked, which surprised you greatly.”
“On the twentieth day, you were still not attacked, even though you sensed the presence of a Spiritual Embryo Realm Sea Beast, it fled directly, with no intention of attacking you, which surprised and puzzled you. In the end, you guessed that the fear-inducing aura of the ancient jade activated by the Chi
Clan’s Blood Essence was still present, causing the monster beasts to be frightened.”
“After making this judgment, you breathed a sigh of relief, believing that you had hope of successfully crossing the sea.”
“On the twenty-first day, you were still not attacked by a Transcendent Realm
Monster. Thinking you could have a safe day, you quietly healed your wounds. However, unforeseen circumstances may arise, and after entering this sea region, you alarmed an ancient being deep under the sea.”
“It stirred up a thousand waves and appeared on the surface of the sea, looking down at you.”
“You stared in horror at this gigantic sea beast of a thousand feet tall, feeling suffocated, an indescribable sense of fear emerged in your heart. You knew, you were doomed.”
“In the end, after this ancient sea beast said, ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants, must die’, you were immediately reduced to ash.”
“However, due to the Rebirth tally, you were resurrected again. This surprised the ancient sea beast, who didn’t expect you to have such a death-defying secret skill. In the end, it chose to soul-search. Because of the system’s protection, it did not learn about the system’s existence from your mind.”
“After the soul-searching, it crushed you to death. Because of your death, the simulation ended.’
“What kind of monster is this, it’s so terrifying.”
Wang Ping stared at the simulation content, his expression fluctuating unpredictably.
Originally, when he saw the ancient jade activated by Blood Essence and struck a killing blow to the Spiritual Embryo Realm Sea Beast, he was genuinely surprised and delighted.
After all, this was equivalent to discovering some secrets of the ancient jade and obtaining a strong life- saving trump card.
The subsequent deterrence to the Spiritual Embryo Realm Sea Beast also surprised him.
He thought he had a good chance of crossing the sea safely, but he failed at the last minute.
The sea beast that appeared at the end of the simulation was too terrifying.
It was a thousand feet tall, and this was likely only the part above the water surface… it was hard to imagine how massive it was.
Such a sea beast was probably not as simple as the Transcendent Realm.
This boundless ocean was really too dangerous, with various powerful sea creatures lurking in it.
Those active Transcendent Realm Sea Beasts were probably just hunters living in the shallow sea areas.
“Sinful Bloodline Descendants…
Wang Ping remembered the words of the terrifying sea beast, his face solemn.
What did it mean?
Was it referring to the Chi Clan… or was it talking about him?
He was just a traveler, and he had nothing to do with the lineage of this world.
So, was it referring to the Chi Clan’s bloodline?
“It doesn’t seem right either. If the Chi Clan was the so-called Sinful Bloodline Decendants, then the original Red Clan would not have had the power to cross the sea and would have been killed by the terrifying sea beasts in the ocean. ”
Wang Pings eyes flickered uncertainly, murmuring to himself.
Although Wang Ping did not know the cultivation level of the Chi Clan’s leader when they fled to the Profound Turtle Continent, it definitely would not be too low, but nor would it be too high.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have arrived at the Profound Turtle Continent without any powerful inheritance, with the highest level Cultivation Skill being only the Red Fire Skill.
Not to say that the Red Fire Skill is deficient…
The Earth-tier top- grade Red Fire Skill would certainly be considered very strong in the Transcendent Realm, but this level of Cultivation Skill is obviously not commensurate with a strength beyond the Transcendent Realm.
So, whether it’s based on the Cultivation Skill, or the droplet of Blood Essence, the highest level of cultivation that Wang Ping could guess for the Chi Clan’s strongest individual was only the Spirit Accumulation Realm.
Even if he thought higher, it would only be half a step into the Transcendent Realm at most.
Such cultivation level, compared to that terrifying sea beast, would likely still fall short.
And in this sea, such sea creatures slumbering in the deep sea are certainly
not just one.
“Could it be that this sea beast was referring to the people of the Profound
Turtle Continent?”
A light bulb in Wang Pings head suddenly lit up, causing a storm in his heart.
Although he is not a native of the Profound Turtle Continent, he has been cultivating and living there for such a long time that he has probably been infiltrated by its qi.
Moreover, the Profound Turtle Continent still had an unsolved mystery….
This possibility, it seems, is not low.
But, if so, why would the people of the Profound Turtle Continent be referred to as ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ by that terrifying sea beast?
Could it be that their ancestors committed a dreadful act that enraged both gods and men?
“However, if the sea beast hates the so-called Sinful Bloodline Descendants so much, why doesn’t it attack the Profound Turtle Continent? Probably because it lacks the strength, or perhaps it lacks the courage.”
Wang Pings brain was racing, analysing various aspects.
It should be said that all the powerful sea beasts in this sea region don’t dare to attack the Profound Turtle Continent. This might be the reason why the closer one gets to the Profound Turtle Continent, the weaker the sea creatures.
Because those ancient sea beasts know some secrets of the Profound Turtle Continent, knowing its terrifying side, so they didn’t dare to get close. Only some of the newer generation of Transcendent Realm Sea Beasts would linger at closer distances.
Of course, not all Transcendent Realm Sea Beasts are fools, they probably know some taboo rumors about the Profound Turtle Continent.
“Based on this logic, the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ probably refer not to the Chi Clan, but to all the native humans on the Profound Turtle Continent. Whether they are natives or foreigners, as long as they come from the Profound Turtle Continent and carry its qi, they are included by these terrifying sea beasts..”

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 81: Sinful Bloodline Descendants! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 81: Sinful Bloodline Descendants! 2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping made a judgment.
Although it’s just a guess, Wang Ping believes there’s more than a 70% probability of being correct.
“What a headache.’
Wang Ping rubbed his head and shook it helplessly.
It’s really a never-ending series of problems.
It seems difficult to cross the ocean by himself now.
At the same time, Wang Ping is worried about another issue.
That is, whether it’s only the sea beasts targeting the people of Profound Turtle Continent.
If he finally managed to leave the sea region and entered the human territory, but the human experts also came saying ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants, die!’ , then Wang Ping would be in real trouble.
“Ah, I’m thinking too far ahead. The probability of making it through this sea route is already low. Just leaving Profound Turtle Continent itself is a huge problem.”
Wang Ping sighed, having a real headache.
“Speaking of which, it seems like I’ve always missed someone.”
After pondering for a long time, Wang Ping suddenly remembered something.
If he himself doesn’t have the right fortune to obtain opportunities, then he can totally secretly follow someone with great fortune instead.
For example, is that Ye Chen really not a Son of Fortune?
Previously, Wang Ping decided that Ye Chen was not the Son of Fortune because he hadn’t appeared for a while. But this might be a misunderstanding.
“This time, I can test Ye Chen and see what his life is really like.”
Wang Ping made up his mind with a flicker in his eyes.
“System, I want to continue the simulation.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Life Simulator initiated, host has nine remaining free simulation chances.”
The system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and the words started to emerge.
[Day 1: You descend the mountain and arrive at Bai Wood Town to live low-key. You keep an eye on Ye Chen.]
[Daya calendar 488 year, June 1: The Ye’s family suffers a genocide. You stay hidden, then follow Ye Chen who escapes. In the following days, you discover Ye Chen’s abnormalities. Ye Chen begins affronting Jianghu, occasionally fondling the strangely patterned ring on his right index finger. You have keen senses, feeling fluctuations in soul power.]
[Regarding this, you instantly associate it with the “ring grandpa” novel genre, and understand that Ye Chen must be carrying a Soul Body grandpa to help him grow stronger. After knowing this, you become even more interested in him, believing that he really is a Son of Fortune.]
[You silently watch Ye Chen training, growing stronger, and taking revenge.]
[Daya calendar 489 year, Ye Chen encounters a crisis, his strength suddenly increases, and he kills his enemy. This confirms to you that Ye Chen indeed carries a ring grandpa with him. However, you still don’t show any signs of wanting to talk with Ye Chen’s ring grandpa, but continue observing him.]
[Daya calendar 490 year, Ye Chen breaks through to the Innate Realm and arrives at the Purple Sun Mountain Range. You personally witness Ye Chen finding a strange Stele Array and take out a million Lower-tier Spirit Stones from his Storage Spirit Ring to activate the Stele Array.][You sense the fluctuations in space, and in an instant, you understand that this is likely a teleportation array. You couldn’t be more thrilled. You finally understand why Ye Chen seemingly disappeared without a trace in his memories. After reaching the Innate Realm, Ye Chen didn’t stay in Profound Turtle Continent but teleported to somewhere else using this array.]
[Not hesitating, you choose to reveal yourself and attempt to enter the array to follow Ye Chen. Ye Chen is startled by your appearance, terrified. The old man in Ye Chen’s ring also chooses to reveal himself, looking at you solemnly.]
[You state that you have no ill intentions and simply wish to follow both of them.]
[The old man in the ring remains vigilant, expressing astonishment that such a young Transcendent Realm powerhouse could be hidden in the small
Profound Turtle Continent.]
[At the same time, the old man in the ring is somewhat helpless, as he himself is too weak to detect your presence. Had he been at his peak, he could have obliterated you, a Transcendent Realm cultivator, with a flick of his finger.]
[After hearing the old man’s words, Ye Chen is stunned, not expecting you, the famed Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder, to be at the Transcendent Realm, which caught him off guard.]
[Subsequently, you proceed cautiously, with neither of you initiating a fight.
In the end, the Great Array activates, teleporting all of you away.]
“This is truly an unexpected development.”
Wang Ping watches the simulation content, extremely excited.
He initially had just a casual attitude about trying the Life Simulator, but he didn’t expect that Ye Chen would turn out to be a Son of Fortune, carrying the old man in the ring, and knowing how to leave the Profound Turtle Continent.
Who could have imagined that a hidden Stele Array lies deep within the Purple Sun Mountain Range and could be activated with enough Spiritual Stones?
“This may be the only way to leave Profound Turtle Continent under insufficient strength conditions.”
Wang Ping clenched his fists, full of joy.
With this, he could finally leave the Profound Turtle Continent and witness a broader sky!
Immediately, Wang Ping continues to focus on the luminescent screen, eager to learn about what happens next.
[Several minutes later, the three of you appear in another Stele Array. Ye Chen immediately bids you farewell and chooses to flee. You don’t stop him, likewise leaving the array.]
[You then begin to search for places where humans gather. After collecting intelligence, you learn that your current location is known as the Seven Stars Archipelago, Seven Stars Archipelago is comprised of 108 islands of various sizes and appears as a ring when viewed from above. The Seven Stars Archipelago is one of the more distant islands from the Eastern Desolation and also under the control of Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[Within the Seven Stars Archipelago, each island is occupied by forces of varying strength. The more peripheral the territory, the weaker the force. The closer to the inner area of the island, the richer the Spiritual Energy, the more powerful the forces. Among them, the authority of the Seven Star Palace on the central island, Seven Star Island, is the most potent.]
[After gathering information, you’re astonished, not expecting it to be the same world as Cai Yonglong. You have heard about the Heavenly Sword Divine Land from Cai Yonglong.]
[Subsequently, you marvel at the vastness of the Profound World with so many forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago, which is just an island far away from the Eastern Desolation. There are many more similar islands like this.]
[Later on, you continue to gather intelligence and learn that the strongest being in the Seven Stars Archipelago has Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation. This realm is above the Transcendent Realm, but its specifics remain unknown to you. Even though the strongest being in the Seven Stars Archipelago is only at Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, it’s a terrifying realm that Transcendent Realm Cultivators must look up to! ]
[After learning about the general situation of the Seven Stars Archipelago, you head to the Seven Star Island, intending to join the Seven Star Palace and acquire powerful Cultivation Skills and Martial Arts resources to help you cultivate. You believe that with your cultivation and status as a 4th Tier Alchemist, even the colossal Seven Star Palace would regard you as an honored guest.]
[As it turns out, your choice was not wrong. After the Seven Star Palace learns of your cultivation and status as a 4th Tier Alchemist, they choose to let you join. Furthermore, the palace master of the Seven Star Palace elevates you as an Inner Sect Elder, occupying a revered position.]
[Grateful for the palace master’s hospitality, you begin to settle down and cultivate in the Seven Star Palace.]
[Nevertheless, you are well aware that to gain genuine favor from the Seven Star Palace and access to their most powerful inheritance, you must prove your worth. Thus, you continue to study Alchemy.]
[After all, it’s not easy for a Transcendent Realm cultivator to advance, and an ordinary person at this realm isn’t enough to gain special attention from the Seven Star Palace. Only by reaching the 5th Tier Alchemist rank will you be regarded as extraordinary. In addition, you can use your status as a 5th Tier Alchemist to rapidly acquire more resources, aiding your cultivation..]

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 82: Cruel!
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 82: Cruel!
Translator: 549690339
(ps: The previous chapter’s original version seems to have stepped on a landmine, so the last two thousand words have been heavily revised. Readers who read it yesterday can read it again to avoid plot discontinuity, QAQ~)
“Seven Stars Archipelago, Seven Star Palace, Profound Elixir Realm, Heavenly Sword Divine Land…
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Life Simulator and his heart stirred, unable to calm down.
After leaving the Profound Turtle Continent, he could finally see a broader sky.
However, Wang Ping really didn’t expect that he and Cai Yonglong were actually in the same world.
In that case, Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan might also have the possibility of being in the same world.
After all, they were also transported to the Cultivation world.
“Besides, this world is probably even more terrifying than I imagined. In the Seven Stars Archipelago, far away from the Eastern Desolation, there is actually a half-step Profound Elixir Realm expert presiding. It’s astonishing.”
Wang Ping thought of the Seven Star Palace Ancestor, who was at the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, and was quite surprised.
There were three realms in the Transcendent Realm, and each realm was like a layer of heaven. It was hard to imagine the strength of a half-step Profound Elixir Realm and Profound Elixir Realm.
However, such a powerful individual was situated on an archipelago, which easily led to speculation.
How strong are the experts of the Eastern Desolation?
How astonishing is the cultivation of the experts in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land?
“I’m overthinking things. Right now, I’ve only just left the novice village in the Life Simulator as an ordinary Spiritual Sea Cultivator.”
Wang Ping shook his head, discarded the distracting thoughts in his mind, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
At the right time, more words appeared on the screen above.
[After joining the Seven Star Palace, you devotedly study alchemy. Because you show enough talent in alchemy, you were valued by one of the three deputy palace masters, Palace Master Qin Lan, a 7th tier Alchemist, who took you as her disciple and personally taught you alchemy.]
[You were very happy about this and followed Palace Master Qin Lan in alchemy, wishing to quickly improve your alchemy skills.]
[Time flies, and twenty years have passed. In these twenty years, you have become a 5th tier Alchemist, with an even more respected status. At the same time, your cultivation has also broken through to the mid-stage of the Spiritual Sea Realm. Although it isn’t as fast as cultivating the Demonic Skill, it is undoubtedly more than ten times faster than breaking through a small realm in the Profound Turtle Continent after spending more than two hundred years.]
[One day, the Seven Star Palace gathered many elders to discuss important matters. As an Inner Sect Elder, you naturally participated in the meeting. It turns out that the largest secret realm in the Seven Stars Archipelago, the Seven Star Secret Realm, which opens once every two hundred years, is about to begin. Even the cultivators of the Transcendent Realm are crazy about the opportunities to be found there.]
[Thus, the purpose of this meeting is to discuss who will stay in the Seven Star
Palace and who will go to the Seven Star Secret Realm to seek opportunities.]
[After hearing the content of the meeting, you were quite excited. Because you have lived in the Seven Star Palace for twenty years, you have not only learned many secret skills of the Seven-Star Palace but also know that although there are many Spiritual Sea Realm practitioners in the Seven Stars Archipelago, with thousands of them, there are very few Spiritual Embryo Stage practitioners. On the surface, there are only fifty Spiritual Embryo Stage practitioners. Even a force like the Seven Star Palace has only ten powerful Spiritual Embryo Stage experts.]
[Some Spiritual Sea experts have the talent to break through to the Spiritual
Embryo Realm, but breaking through to the Spiritual Embryo Realm requires not only talent but also corresponding secret skills and heavenly and earthly spiritual materials. And the grade of the spiritual materials must be 6th tier.]
[6th tier spiritual materials are already rare and are very rare treasures on the Seven Stars Archipelago, not to mention that they must match one’s own attributes, which makes it even more difficult to find. As a result, many geniuses are stuck in the Spiritual Sea Realm, unable to take that step and form their own Spirit Clan.]
[Therefore, you have also been troubled by the spiritual materials matter in these years. Now, the Seven Star Secret Realm opening is undoubtedly an opportunity. The probability of finding fire-element 6th tier spiritual materials in the Seven Star Secret Realm is the highest.]
[Although every time the Seven Star Secret Realm opens, many Transcendent Realm cultivators fall, but many cultivators also obtain opportunities through this and soar into the sky.]
[However, you think that you are still young, and your cultivation is too low, so there is no need to risk your life. After all, the Seven Star Secret Realm opens once every two hundred years, and you still have plenty of time to improve your cultivation. All you need to do is wait for another two hundred years for the Seven Star Secret Realm to open next time. By then, your survival rate will be higher, and the probability of obtaining opportunities will be even greater.]
[Furthermore, as long as you continue to study alchemy diligently, you might even be able to exchange for 6th tier spiritual materials in the future. So, you still suppress the impulse to enter.]
[In the end, you didn’t choose to enter. Your master, Qin Lan, praised your choice and was very satisfied with your ability to not be blinded by desires.]
[Next, many cultivators from the Seven Stars Archipelago begin to head towards the entrance of the Seven Star Secret Realm, waiting for it to open. You follow as well. However, you have no intention of entering and are just there to watch the excitement and see what the entrance of the secret realm is like.]
[Then, you discover that there are some Spiritual Realm Experts waiting, and you can’t help but admire their fearlessness. At the same time, you also find a familiar face. It is Ye Chen.]
[To your surprise, Ye Chen’s cultivation has reached the Spiritual Sea Realm at this moment. Such a cultivation progression speed is truly astonishing, worthy of being the Son of Fortune with the rings old man..]

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 82: Cruel! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 82: Cruel! _2
Translator: 549690339
[Ye Chen had also discovered your presence, and he was somewhat surprised to see that your cultivation, which had already reached the Spiritual Sea
Realm twenty years ago, had only advanced to the mid-stage of the Spiritual Sea Realm now.]
[In the end, Ye Chen just nodded politely to you and stopped paying any more attention to you.]
[You didn’t care about it either, and after waiting for the secret realm to open and numerous cultivators to fly in, you left. The Seven-Star Secret Realm would be open for a month. You just need to come back here in a month to continue watching the fun.]
[You are well aware that for such a grand event like the opening of a secret realm, it is often when the secret realm closes and everyone comes out that it is the most lively time when various conflicts would arise due to various opportunities and interests. You could also use this opportunity to learn about those who had gained opportunities, the treasures within the secret realm, and perhaps these memories could be helpful to you.]
[Time flies, and in a blink of an eye, a month passes. You were already waiting quietly on the sea. Not only were you waiting, but representatives from all the major powers were also waiting.]
[Soon, people began to come out one after another. They all had varying degrees of injuries, some with joyful faces, some calm, and others with anger, hatred, and frustration, showing a variety of reactions.]
[However, what surprised you was that even though some people harbored hostility toward others, they had no intention of talking nonsense or complaining. This made you understand that these people would not directly engage in conflicts and fight, like those in novels, in front of so many forces.
That would be too dangerous, as someone else would take advantage of it.]
[You guessed that these forces, who harbored resentment, would definitely plan to take action later when they found an opportunity. After understanding this, you sighed that an old ginger is still hotter.]
[Soon, the people from Seven Star Palace also emerged. After they came out, they had harvested quite a bit. Your Master Qin Lan was among them.
Although she was slightly injured, it was not a big deal.]
[Next, you found that many people died. Of the Spiritual Essence Realm cultivators entering, less than one-tenth survived. Even if they survived, those without powerful backing would be ruthlessly and arbitrarily accused of committing a crime and then crushed to death by some shameless powers after being searched for their Storage Rings.]
[Watching this scene, you could only sigh that without a background, even if one entered the secret realm and survived nine deaths and one life, they still could not preserve their lives. That’s the cruelty of the world of cultivators.]
[Later, you saw Ye Chen leaving the secret realm, and following the others back to the Seven Star Palace after long-distance fleeing. Curiously, you asked what happened in the Seven-Star Secret Realm. Your Master Qin Lan gave an answer.]
[This opening of the Seven-Star Secret Realm revealed many great opportunities. A considerable number of 6th Tier spiritual materials were found, and even five 7th tier items were discovered, which led to numerous fierce battles. However, the biggest chaos occurred when a Heaven-tier Skill was found.]
[The appearance of the Heaven-tier Skill almost led to a deadly battle among the factions. In the end, the loose cultivator who had obtained the Heaven-tier Skill knew that he was bound to die, so he brutally destroyed the Heaven-tier
Skill.]
[Upon hearing the news, you were shocked. Heaven-tier Skills were superior to Earth-tier ones, and even a power like the Seven Star Palace didn’t possess a single Heaven-tier Skill. So destroying it was truly wasteful.]
[However, considering the inevitable fate of the person, destroying the Heaven-tier Skill and causing extreme annoyance to everyone was the only thing he could do as revenge.]
[In the end, you were very grateful that you didn’t enter the Seven-Star Secret Realm. Because this trip to the Seven-Star Secret Realm had had extremely heavy casualties. Over two hundred Spirit Sea Realm powerhouses had died, and several Spirit Fetus Realm powerhouses had also perished. Only top-notch powerhouses like your Master Qin Lan in the Spirit Accumulation Realm could emerge intact.]
[Of course, if the loose cultivator hadn’t destroyed the Heaven-tier Skill, even
Spirit Accumulation Realm powerhouses might have fallen. After all,
Heaven-tier Skills had a fatal attraction to cultivators in the Transcendent Realm.]
[For the next few months, you heard about numerous conflicts among the various forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago, some even instigating major battles. You knew that this was the aftermath of the Seven-Star Secret Realm’s opening spreading. However, you had no intention of interfering.]
[After all, as an Inner Sect Elder of the Seven-Star Palace, as long as you were cultivating within the Seven-Star Palace, you would be fine as long as the palace was not destroyed.]
[In the blink of an eye, fifty more years passed. Through your steady cultivation, your cultivation base successfully advanced to the late stage of the Spiritual Sea Realm. In these fifty years, your alchemy level also increased to the 6th Tier.]
[As a 6th Tier Alchemist. you became famous and highly respected in the
Seven Star Palace and even the entire Seven Stars Archipelago. Even cultivators in the Spirit Accumulation Realm would not dare to neglect you.]
[You didn’t become proud or complacent because of your achievements but continued your steady cultivation.]
[Seventy years passed, and your cultivation reached the peak of the Spiritual Sea Realm, only one step away from the Spiritual Fetus Realm. Afterward, you just needed to obtain a 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spiritual Object to step into the Spiritual Fetus Realm and become a top strongman in the Seven Stars
Archipelago.] [After your cultivation reached the pinnacle of the Spirit Sea Realm, you realized that it would be difficult to make any progress for a very long time. Consequently, you began to study Secret Skills and swordsmanship, attempting to raise your Sword Spirit to 80%.]
[Unfortunately, after reaching the pinnacle of Sword Spirit, each increase was incredibly challenging. With no special opportunities coming your way, it became nearly insurmountable to increase your Sword Spirit to 80%.]
[Nevertheless, you had every reason to be proud. In the Seven Stars
Archipelago, there were not many who had comprehended a 70% Sword
Spirit. You came to understand that although all those who reached the Transcendent Realm were geniuses, not everyone had extraordinary comprehension like you and Bai Tianhong.]
“Normal cultivation is really slow, much slower than cultivating as a demonic cultivator. However, cultivating Demons on Profound Turtle Continent is not as bad as doing it on the Seven Star Archipelago; that would be seeking death.” Wang Ping sighed, looking at the simulation content.
“Speaking of which, what happened to Ye Chen? After the Seven Star Secret Realm, he disappeared without a trace. Where has he gone?” Subsequently, Wang Ping thought of Ye Chen.
Ye Chen, rightfully the Son of Fortune, should not have vanished.
Following the normal plotline, shouldn’t he be offending some major power in the Seven Stars Archipelago, and then strive to become stronger, only to overthrow that power decades later?
However, there was no news of him. The life simulation had skipped over fifty or seventy years without mentioning him even once.
“Or is it that Ye Chen, just like before on the Profound Turtle Continent, his master thought that the Seven Star Archipelago was too small for him to develop, so after obtaining the biggest opportunity in the Seven Star Secret Realm, he simply ran off to Eastern Desolation?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, thinking that the possibility was very high.
After all, Ye Chen, as the Son of Fortune with the old man in the ring, could not stay in the Seven Star Archipelago for long, which wasn’t a high-level ‘Instance’.
His rivals couldn’t be those old antiques who had piled up their cultivation through age; only the geniuses of the Eastern Desolation Sect were worthy of being his competitors and stepping stones.
“Tsk, being the Son of Fortune is really enviable. If I had such strong fortune, I wouldn’t have had such tragic experiences in the Life Simulator.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips, truly envious.
After all, even if he was a traveler with a golden finger, it was still no match for great fortune.
Neither Emperor Huangtian, Emperor Ye, nor Emperor Chu were at a level that ordinary travelers with golden fingers could reach.
One could even wonder if their golden fingers were the same grade as those handed out to high-level big shots.
Wang Ping kept pondering about the existence of this terrifying, higher-level being who could wholesale golden fingers to travelers.
“Forget it, thinking too much is unnecessary. Let’s take things one step at a time.”
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts, gazing at the luminescent screen as the text continued to emerge.
[While you were waiting for a 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item to appear or the Seven Star Secret Realm to open again, a major event that shook the entire Seven Stars Archipelago occurred! The ancestral figures of the various powers in the Seven Star Archipelago were all alarmed!]

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 83: Blood Demon Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 83: Blood Demon Array
Translator: 549690339
[The Sea Ape Clan led numerous sea beasts to launch a fierce attack on the Seven Stars Archipelago, intending to annihilate all human cultivators on the islands.]
[As this is a matter of survival for the Seven Stars Archipelago, all forces and numerous strongmen naturally could not sit still and chose to face the enemy together. As a cultivator who has achieved Great Perfection in the Spirit Sea Realm, you are naturally a main combatant and have arrived at the front line battlefield.]
[Heavy in your heart, you know that there is a risk of falling in this battle, and you must be ready to retreat if the situation turns unfavorable. At the same time, you are deeply puzzled by the Sea Ape Clan’s offensive.]
[Because the Seven Stars Archipelago has always maintained a peaceful relationship with the Sea Clan. After all, the Sea Clan’s power is intricate and vast as a whole; even the Heavenly Sword Divine Land would not wage an all-out war with the Sea Clan Emperor in this region. Of course, the Sea Clan Emperor would also be wary of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and would not arbitrarily slaughter the human islands.]
[Although the attacking force is only the Sea Ape Clan, which is a branch of the Sea Clan, they would not take such actions lightly. This is because it is tantamount to provoking the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, which might lead to the dispatch of strongmen to exterminate it, and even the Sea Clan Emperor’s clan would not have much to say about it.]
[Whether it’s you or other cultivators, you all have questions in your hearts, but you can’t find the answers. The Sea Ape Clan descended amidst huge waves with killing intent.]
[A powerful person roared angrily, questioning why the Sea Clan had come to massacre the island. A leader of the Sea Ape Clan cursed angrily, claiming that the strongmen of the Seven Stars Archipelago had broken into their territory, killed their many brethren, and taken their clan’s inherited supreme treasure. If they were not given an explanation, they would undoubtedly slaughter the island.]
[Many strongmen were shocked, never expecting that someone could break into the Sea Ape Clan’s territory, kill people, and steal treasures, which was extremely cruel. However, they were also extremely infuriated by this person. The troublemaker had let them bear the consequences together. The key point is that they must now face the enemy; otherwise, they would all die.]
[A strongman stepped forward, asking the Sea Ape Clan to calm down, as there might be a misunderstanding. The Sea Ape Clan angrily retorted, either hand over the person and return the treasure, or the war would begin.]
[Seeing this scene, you know that the situation is likely beyond repair and must be prepared to preserve your life.]
[As expected, both sides could not reach a peaceful resolution, and the battle began directly. Astounding battles erupted in the sky, the ocean, and the land, plunging the world into darkness.]
[You were also targeted by a powerful person of the Sea Clan in the Spirit Sea Domain, and fought together. Although you could unleash your real power and easily defeat him, you did not choose to do so. Instead, you suppressed your power, fought fiercely, and did not attract too much attention.]
[Soon, the battle escalated. Not only did the cultivators in the Spirit Sea Realm fight together, the Spiritual Fetus Realm also began to clash, and their power was far beyond that of the Spirit Sea Realm cultivators. Upon reaching the Spiritual Fetus Realm, the physical body is extremely powerful, and even without using the liquid spiritual essence, a punch or a kick can easily shatter an ordinary Spiritual Sea Cultivator. Their strength is at an extreme point.]
[However, what shocked you the most were the Spirit Accumulation Realm Cultivators, who were strong in all aspects – Mana, physical body, and soul without any weaknesses. In front of Spirit Accumulation Realm Cultivators, even the Spiritual Fetus Realm is not worth mentioning. The Spirit Accumulation Realm’s physical bodies and Mana may not be much stronger than that of the Spiritual Fetus Realm masters, but their soul power is extremely formidable, and the Spiritual Fetus Realm strongmen cannot withstand the soul impact. They will be easily defeated and killed.]
[Unless the Spiritual Fetus Realm strongman has a spiritual tool that can protect the soul, they can barely fight against the Spirit Accumulation Realm. Otherwise, in front of the Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivator, the Spiritual Fetus Realm is no different from an ant. At most, this ant is a bit more difficult to kill and requires a little more time to clean up.]
[The battle became more and more intense, with cultivators below the
Transcendent Realm suffering heavy casualties. Even among the
Transcendent Realm cultivators in the Spiritual Sea Domain, people occasionally fell, both from the Human Race and the Sea Clan. Even the rare
Spiritual Embryo Realm strongmen began to fall as the battle continued.]
[However, overall, it was still the Seven Stars Archipelago that held the advantage. After all, the Sea Ape Clan is just one clan and cannot compete with the entire human forces of the islands.]
[You also breathe a sigh of relief at this point, knowing that as long as you hold on a little, there should be no danger to your life. However, at this moment, a new change occurs.]
[The Ancestor of the Sea Ape Clan appeared, unleashing the pressure of a half-step Profound Elixir Realm, suppressing the heavens and causing all strongmen to tremble in fear. As a Great Perfection cultivator in the Spirit Sea Domain, you feel suffocated in the face of this pressure.]
[Having personally experienced the pressure of the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, you are chilled to the bone, aware that in the face of such a strongman, even Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivators are likely to be easily crushed.]
[Soon, this pressure was counteracted. Because from the Seven Stars
Archipelago’s side, a half-step Profound Elixir Realm master also took action.
He was none other than the Ancestor of Seven Star Palace, Seven Stars
Ancestor Nangong Yun.]
[After appearing, the two Ancestors confronted each other. Seven Stars
Ancestor Nangong Yun found that negotiations were impossible, so he directly unleashed his astonishing power and began an intense battle with the Sea
Ape Clan Ancestor.]
[The battle was earth-shattering, with the sea water rolling back and the terrifying aftermath causing the Spiritual Embryo Realm cultivators to change
their expressions and hurriedly retreat. Only the Spirit Accumulation Realm
cultivators could withstand the impact of the aftermath without being injured. However, the Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivators did not bother to do such thankless tasks. After retreating a certain distance, they continued to fight fiercely..]

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 83: Blood Demon Array_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 83: Blood Demon Array_2
Translator: 549690339
[You also escaped at the first moment to avoid being killed by the aftermath. After that, you fought more casually. After all, you had to save your strength to flee at any time. In the end, the outcome of this battle depends on who wins or loses between the two half- step Profound Elixir Realm masters. Once the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor kills the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, the Human Cultivators have no choice but to flee madly, with no chance of victory.]
[Similarly, if the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor is defeated, the Sea Ape Clan cultivators also face the same fate. Everyone present knows this very well and has no intention of continuing to fight to the death.]
[In the end, Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun gains the upper hand, killing the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor at the cost of severe injuries. The Sea Ape Clan begins to retreat in fear, while the cultivators of the Seven Stars
Archipelago start to pursue and hunt down the Sea Ape Clan cultivators like cats that smell fishy odor. After all, the Sea Ape Clan is also a monster beast, and every part of them is valuable and cannot be missed.]
[You too become excited and start hunting Sea Ape Clan cultivators without holding back any strength. Your prowess astonishes many people, who are incredibly amazed by you. Initially, they thought you were just an Alchemist, weak in the Spirit Sea Realm, but now it seems that your combat power among the Spirit Sea Realm cultivators can definitely squeeze into the top five.]
“Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun, a half- step Profound Elixir Realm master, killed the half- step Profound Elixir Realm Ancestor of the Sea Ape Clan. This strength is formidable.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and sighed in admiration.
No wonder the Seven Star Palace can stand tall and bold enough to use the Seven Stars as their name.
Having such an Ancestor, it’s understandable that they become the most dominant power in the Seven Stars Archipelago.
“However, my cultivation has reached the Spirit Sea Domain Perfection, and I have comprehended 70% of the Peak Sword Spirit. Can’t I rank first among the combat power in the Spirit Sea Realm, and only squeeze into the top five?” Immediately afterward, Wang Ping looked at the last line of text, quite surprised.
It seems that there are quite a few strong cultivators in the Spirit Sea Realm within the Seven Stars Archipelago.
Just as previously stated in the simulation content, many people are not lacking in talent but simply lack the opportunity to obtain corresponding 6th Tier spiritual materials, which prevents them from breaking through the
Spirit Sea Realm.
Soon after, Wang Ping stopped thinking about it and continued to focus on the luminescent screen, where text once again emerged.
[Soon, the great battle ends. The Sea Ape Clan suffers heavy casualties, and the forces of the Seven Stars Archipelago also suffer losses. However, compared to their gains, this is nothing.]
[However, the biggest gains belong to the Seven Star Palace. Your gains are also excellent, and you are very satisfied.]
[As time’s flow passes, thirty years go by. The Seven Stars Archipelago remains as exciting as ever, with major events happening frequently. But you don’t care about them and focus on your cultivation, waiting for the opening of the Seven Star Secret Realm.]
[However, within the Seven Star Palace, rumors begin to circulate, causing uneasiness among its inhabitants. They say that the Seven Stars Ancestor’s lifespan is approaching its end, and he will soon perish.]
[If Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun perishes, it’s hard to say whether the Seven Star Palace can maintain its status as the most powerful force.]
