[Although the Seven Star Palace is powerful, its palace master and three deputy palace masters are all Spirit Accumulation Realm masters, but there are other forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago that are not much weaker than the Seven Star Palace. For example, the Fire Sect has three Spirit
Accumulation Realm masters, only lacking a half- step Profound Elixir Realm master to hold the fort.]
[If Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun perishes, the Fire Sect only needs to ally with other major powers to compete with and even suppress the Seven Star Palace.]
[However, at this time, these Spirit Accumulation Realm masters dare not show themselves and hide away, fearing that the Seven Stars Ancestor will make a move against them before his perishing, clearing the way for the Seven Star Palace.]
[You also feel uneasy in your heart, but as a Spirit Sea Realm cultivator, you can’t do much and can only sigh. Even a half- step Profound Elixir Realm master has an end. Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun has reached the end of his lifespan. He had once possessed his descendants, living a second life, but he cannot possess them again.]
[Therefore, unless Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun breaks through to the Profound Elixir Realm, he is destined to perish and fade away from the world.]
[A month later, news of the Seven Star Palace Ancestor’s passing is spread, and preparations for his funeral begin. This arouses the interest of many forces. After investigating and confirming that Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun indeed has no breath left, many powerful beings from the major powers of the Seven Stars Archipelago come to participate in the funeral and plan to join forces to pressure the palace and gain even greater benefits.]
[However, just when all the powerful beings let down their guard, Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun opens his eyes and activates the Great Array, enveloping the entire Seven Star Palace.]
[This makes all the powerful beings feel chills running down their spines, terrified to the extreme. They know that this old fellow is faking his death to lure them in.]
[You are also taken aback, not expecting the Ancestor to have such a trick up his sleeve. It’s really quite ruthless.]
[You originally thought that this was the time for Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun to go on a rampage and stabilize Seven Star Palace’s position, but Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun coldly laughs and announces the name of this Great Array—Blood Demon Array.][This array is not meant to trap everyone and prevent them from escaping, but rather a magic array to refine them all.]
[Whether it’s you, other powerful experts from the Seven Star Palace, or those from other forces, they all change color, realizing the true purpose of Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun.]
[He did not fake his death for the Seven Star Palace, but rather to gather the many powerful experts of the Seven- Star Archipelago and refine them, thus breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun’s face was twisted, and he coldly laughed that he didn’t want to fall, but wanted to break through and have a long life in this world. As long as he breaks through to the Profound Elixir Realm, his lifespan can be increased by a thousand years, and he can continue to wander the world for five hundred years. He will also become a significant figure in the Eastern Desolation.]
[The words of the Seven Star Ancestor chilled everyone. They all began to join forces to deal with Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun, even the powerful experts of the Seven Star Palace were no exception.]
[However, all your attacks were useless, being dissolved by Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun using the Blood Demon Array.]
[In the end, all the mighty ones present were refined one by one, including you. You died, you were resurrected, but then you died again.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended.]
“This old fellow is really ruthless.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, furrowed his brows, and sighed.
He personally created the Seven Star Palace, a major force, but he destroyed it himself just to break through the Profound Elixir Realm, too ruthless and heartless.
And this calculation is chilling to the core.
“Fortunately, there’s the Life Simulator, otherwise the pitfalls of this world are really everywhere.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed again.
The Sword Spirit Sect had left a very good impression on him.
The Seven Star Palace was also the same, and the Master Qin Lan he worshipped in the Seven Star Palace must have a good temperament as well.
However, the Seven Star Palace Ancestor was too ruthless.
If it wasn’t for the Life Simulator, he would have been refined without a trace left when he plunged head-first into it.
“It looks like, in the next simulation, I can join the Seven Star Palace, but I have to be on guard against this Seven Star Ancestor. I can’t be refined by him again. ”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
There’s no need to be overly concerned, though. After all, it’s still more than two hundred years before the Seven Star Ancestor is nearing his meditation. The current Seven Star Ancestor may not be that crazy. He is probably only driven to this madness because he’s afraid of death when he’s about to meditate.
If not, there would be no need for him to do such a thing when he was about to meditate. If he planned to trap everyone when he had a sufficient lifespan, success would be more likely and breakthrough would be easier.
“Time, it can corrode everything.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
“l still have nine free simulations left. I can continue to simulate once more, and then I need to consider going to the Seven Stars Archipelago to obtain mid-and-high-tier Spirit Stones. Only then can I carry out paid simulations and truly improve my strength.”
Immediately, Wang Ping converged his thoughts, remembering his main task.
Otherwise, if he continues to stay on Profound Turtle Continent, he won’t be able to carry out paid simulations. If his strength does not improve, and another Group Task appears, it will be dangerous. This is something Wang Ping cannot tolerate..

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 84: Seizing the Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 84: Seizing the Opportunity
Translator: 549690339
“System, I want to use a free simulation.”
Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Life Simulator activated, host has eight free simulation chances remaining.”
The sound of the system rang out, a luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged onto it.
[Day 1: You choose to leave the mountain and head to the Ye’s family in Bai Wood Village. You find Ye Chen and obtain the ring in his possession through a trade. The Ye family is overjoyed to exchange a ring for so many secret books and Spiritual Stones, believing they struck it rich. They think that from now on, the Ye family will rise and may even become a prominent family in Xia.]
[After acquiring the ring, you begin to investigate it with your soul power. Then, you discover the old man’s illusory Soul Body within the ring. He sighs, not expecting such a powerful cultivator like you to appear on the Profound Turtle Continent or for himself to end up in your hands, and attempts to cooperate with you.]
[He hopes that you can help him find some treasures that can aid in the recovery of his soul power, promising to reward you handsomely.]
[After some contemplation, you ask the old man about his cultivation level at his peak, and how he ended up in this state. The old man tells you his story.]
[It turns out that he was also a native cultivator of the Profound Turtle Continent. Two thousand years ago, he was an outstanding individual who reached the Spirit Sea Realm and began to explore ways to go to sea. While heading to sea with a friend, his friend died, but he managed to survive thanks to a spiritual tool, returning to the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[After recovering from his injuries, he began to look for other ways to go to sea, not wanting to be trapped and die on the Profound Turtle Continent.
Eventually, he accidentally discovered the Stele Array in the Purple Sun Mountain Range, which allowed him to teleport away from the Profound
Turtle Continent and arrive at the Falling Star Islands.]
[As you listen to the old man, you wonder why the Seven Stars Archipelago was called the Falling Star Islands. In the end, you realize that the old man is from two thousand years ago and speculate that the Seven Stars Archipelago might not have been called that until the appearance of the Seven Star Palace.]
[The old man continues to recount his story. After wandering around the
Falling Star Islands for some time, his cultivation reached the Spirit
Accumulation Realm, and he then went to the Eastern Desolation.]
[Ultimately, he made a name for himself in the Eastern Desolation, becoming a powerful Profound Elixir Realm Cultivator. However, in his second life, he was finally targeted by a strong individual from a major power. That person called him a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’ and attacked and killed him.]
[If it were not for his sufficient chances, he would have been long dead. After his lucky escape, he realized that the Eastern Desolation was too dangerous and chose to return to the Profound Turtle Continent to hibernate. The reason he has survived for so long is that the ring is a treasure that nourishes the soul, otherwise, his soul would have dispersed into the heavens and earth long ago.]
[After hearing the old man’s description, your heart sinks. You are well aware that the Ancient Beasts in the deep sea refer to the Profound Turtle Continent’s people as Sinful Bloodline Descendants and have analyzed that among the Human Race, there are also such references. Although you have memories of the ‘Seven Stars Archipelago,’ your mind is somewhat at ease, but it seems you still couldn’t escape it.]
[The cultivators of the Eastern Desolation are even more powerful and know more about the ancient secrets, knowing the truth about the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants.’ As a result, like the Deep Sea Ancient Beasts, they harbor great hatred and would not hesitate to kill them.]
[You ask the old man why External Cultivators are so hostile to the Profound
Turtle Continent’s people and why they call us ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants:]
[The old man shakes his head, stating that he doesn’t know. Throughout these years, he has been pondering this question but has never been able to figure it out. This might be a sealed off historical story that only the big shots of the Great Sects know.]
[You feel a sense of loss and unease in your heart. It seems that if you want to go to the Eastern Desolation in the future, you must think it through carefully; otherwise, you will undoubtedly face great danger, and might even perish if you’re not careful.]
[In the end, you curiously ask the rings old man why he told you everything honestly, not fearing that you might kill him after knowing the information.]
[The rings old man shakes his head, stating that he has no choice. From the
beginning, there was no equal dialogue between the two parties. It’s better to tell the truth and let fate decide, rather than being tortured after failing to cooperate. At the same time, he has been holding these words in his heart for many years, and he wanted to vent them, but no one was qualified to listen to his detailed account before.]
[You admire the old man’s free and easy attitude and promise not to harm him. At the same time, you express your desire to become his apprentice and hope that he can teach you cultivation. To this walking encyclopedia, you still feel very tempted and don’t want to miss the opportunity.]
[The old man is surprised at your request to become his apprentice and ultimately agrees. Originally, he planned to wait for his soul to become more solid and then have Ye Chen become his apprentice. However, it seems that there is now a more suitable candidate.]
[After becoming the old man’s apprentice, you learn his real name – Jiang Huai. Upon hearing this name, you are somewhat moved because this name indeed belongs to a famous individual in the history of the Profound Turtle Continent. His swordsmanship was acclaimed as Wind-slicing Swordmaiden, and in his era, no one in the world could rival him.]
[In the days that followed, Jiang Huai began teaching you cultivation. He is amazed at your age and the level of Sword Spirit Comprehension, believing that you are a rare genius of the world whose future achievements may surpass his own. For this, you feel embarrassed. Your situation is unusual; although outsiders may perceive you as talented, in reality, your talent may be falsely high, and reaching those heights in the future is not guaranteed..]

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 84: Seizing the Opportunity_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 84: Seizing the Opportunity_2
Translator: 549690339
[In a blink of an eye, three years had passed, and you successfully cultivated the secret skills and martial arts of the rings old man. However, his cultivation skill was only at the Earth-tier level, and it wasn’t stronger than the Red Fire Skill. Therefore, you did not choose to cultivate it. At the beginning, you were deeply puzzled about why Jiang Huai, a Profound Elixir Realm master, was only cultivating an Earth-tier top-grade skill.]
[Jiang Huai couldn’t help but smile bitterly. It’s not easy for a loose cultivator to obtain a Heaven-tier Skill. Heaven-tier Skills are only possessed by the major powers. In comparison, although it’s difficult to acquire Heaven-tier Martial Arts, as a Profound Elixir Realm master, he did obtain one.]
“Even a Profound Elixir Realm master does not have a Heaven-tier Cultivation skill? That’s truly surprising.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and was very astonished.
Then, he remembered the Heaven-tier Skill that appeared in the Seven Star Secret Realm.
That Heaven-tier Skill was destroyed… it was such a pity.
If it hadn’t been destroyed, the whole Seven Stars Archipelago might have been in chaos, and it might even attract the major powers from other places to fight over it.
“It seems that changing to a stronger cultivation skill in a short time is unrealistic. So, I should concentrate on cultivating the Red Fire Skill and see if I can nurture the Chiyan Spirit Fire. If I manage to nurture the Chiyan Spirit Fire, I can continue to use it even if I change my cultivation skill in the future.” Wang Ping shook his head and continued looking at the luminescent screen, while the text continued to emerge.
[Three years had passed, and although your cultivation hadn’t changed much, your Sword Spirit had broken through to 70% completion. Additionally, you learned the Heaven-tier Martial Arts – Sunset Sword Skill and some secret skills, which greatly enhanced your strength.]
[You finally decided to leave Profound Turtle Continent and head to the Seven Stars Archipelago. When activating the Stele Array, Jiang Huai felt regretful. His physical body had been destroyed in the past, and he had lost the Storage
Ring, so all his possessions were gone. Otherwise, cultivating you into the
Spirit Accumulation Realm in a shorter time would not have been an issue.]
[Hearing Jiang Huai’s words, you felt some regret, but you didn’t care too
much. Anyway, the resources on the Seven Stars Archipelago were not scarce, and with Jiang Huai’s help, you believed you could rise rapidly.]
[As the Stele Array was activated, you arrived at a cave on a remote island outside the Seven Stars Archipelago. You left the island and went to the
Archipelago.]
[After arriving at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you were considering whether to join the Seven Stars Palace again. Jiang Huai believed that it would be best not to join the Seven Stars Palace. Because his spiritual strength was very weak now, he could not hide himself well. If he encountered a very powerful
Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman or a half-step Profound Elixir Realm master at close range, there was a possibility that he would be discovered.]
[Upon hearing Jiang Huai’s words, you felt that they made sense and chose not to join the Seven Star Palace.]
[Next, you began to live on the Seven Stars Archipelago and, under Jiang
Huai’s guidance, safely acquired various resources to cultivate. Furthermore,
Jiang Huai was very familiar with some hidden opportunities on the
Archipelago, which allowed you to reap many rewards.]
[In the blink of an eye, more than 20 years had passed. In just 20 years, your cultivation had grown from the early stages of the Spirit Sea Realm to the Spirit Sea Domain Perfection, much faster than when you cultivated on your own.]
[You were very content with this progress, believing that having an old man in the ring was great, like a walking encyclopedia, and your cultivation level increased rapidly.]
[Finally, the Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and you decided to enter it. After entering the Seven Star Secret Realm, you began to compete for opportunities.]
[You and a Spirit Sea Domain Perfection Strongman discovered a medium-grade Spirit Sword at the same time. You directly split the sword and forcefully took the treasure.]
[You continued searching for opportunities and obtained some precious medicines. Three days later, you heard a loud noise in the distance and decided to go there.]
[Then, you found a 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item, Flame Burst Grass, in a
valley filled with flames. You were extremely excited, thinking that you could finally make a breakthrough to the Spirit Embryo Realm.]
[However, you also noticed that there were more strong cultivators present than expected, including three Spirit Embryo Realm strongmen. Knowing that you were no match for them, you asked Jiang Huai to take action.]
[With Jiang Huai’s help, your strength soared, and you successfully killed all the strong cultivators present and obtained the Flame Burst Grass. You then began preparations to break through to the Spirit Embryo Realm.]
[You found a secluded place and began your retreat to break through.]
[While you were wholeheartedly trying to break through, Jiang Huai finally showed his true colors and chose to possess your body. If he were to delay any longer, once you entered the Spirit Accumulation Realm, he would no longer have the opportunity to possess you.]
[You were extremely outraged and questioned him why he dared to possess you. Weren’t you afraid of losing your personality? Jiang Huai sneered, saying that even with the treasure to nourish the soul, it was impossible for a soul to exist forever, and it would eventually dissipate. He didn’t want to die, and even if forcibly possessing a body would turn him into a completely new personality and drive him crazy, as long as his personality was dominant, it was enough.]
[You cursed Jiang Huai as a madman and started resisting. However, your spiritual power was still inferior to that of Jiang Huai, and you were possessed by him.]
[Your soul combined with Jiang Huai’s, forming a new individual. As a result, you died.]
[Due to your death, this simulation is over.]
“Is it true that the Rebirth tally can’t revive after being possessed? Or is it only the special circumstance of soul fusion that prevents resurrection? If the soul is annihilated or both the physical body and soul are destroyed, can one be resurrected?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, thinking about the issue of the Rebirth tally, and furrowed his brows.”Nevermind, analyzing now is useless, I can only wait to slowly experiment in the simulations later.” “Besides, has this old guy been hiding so deep?”
Afterward, Wang Pings expression became somewhat gloomy.
Not to mention encountering Jiang Huai in reality and talking with him, even within the Life Simulator, before his exposure, there was no abnormality at all.
This guy is too good at hiding himself.
Obviously, from the moment he met him, the other party began plotting. The reason he exposed everything directly was to gain his trust and create a first impression of being open and honest.
Perhaps he would still be defensive later, but with this foundation, he would eventually let down his guard and fully trust the other side.
“Old ginger is spicier,” Wang Ping forced a smile: “That 2,000-year-old monster has thoughts that are too deep, I absolutely can’t trust him. Be it Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun or this Old Dog Jiang Huai, both are teaching me a lesson.”
“Apart from that, I have read too many web novels and am influenced by them, instinctively thinking that the old masters inside the rings are all good.”
Wang Ping continued to mutter.
“Maybe it’s also because I am not the Son of Fortune. If I were the Son of Fortune, perhaps they would have the desire to cultivate me with all their efforts, instead of choosing such an extreme method of body possession.”
Thinking of this, the corner of Wang Pings mouth involuntarily twitched.
Sons of Fortune can always turn the impossible into possible, changing many people and things.
“Well, Jiang Huai, in the following simulations, I will wring out all his value and then kill him.”
Wang Ping stood up, came to the balcony, placed his hands on his hips, and looked at the sunset afterglow, making up his mind.
Such a dangerous guy, as long as there’s no conflict of interest, it’s okay.
If there is a conflict of interest and he is let go, it would be like leaving a poisonous snake to bite him at any time.
In the Life Simulator, he could take out the remaining value and kill it directly to prevent accidents.
But in reality, Wang Ping would not keep him by his side.
After all, Wang Ping did not want the natives of this world to know his secret; the risk of exposure must be eliminated.
Even Cai Yonglong, a fellow transmigrator, Wang Ping had no plans to meet him until he was unable to expose himself.
It would be too dangerous to do so.
“Next, it’s time to go down the mountain.”
After Wang Ping calmed his mind, he soared into the sky, stepping on a spirit sword, and rushed towards the Sword Spirit Sect mountain.
The afterglow sets, night falls.
Bai Wood Village calms down.
A village, after all, can’t be like the Imperial City, where the night is even more lively.
At this time, a red light appeared in the sky and quickly arrived above Bai Wood Village, stopping.
Wang Ping stepped on his flying sword, looked down at the Ye family courtyard below, and watched the child who was still practicing boxing with great effort; his eyes flickered, and he directly unleashed his spiritual sense, scanning the entire Ye family.
Then, he learned the general situation of the Ye family.
He also understood that the child practicing boxing was Ye Chen.
“He’s still practicing boxing so late; he’s diligent.”
Wang Ping laughed lightly, stepping on the flying sword, and swooped down to the Ye family courtyard, stopping about ten meters above the ground..

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 85: Ye Chen wishes to become an apprentice!
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 85: Ye Chen wishes to become an apprentice!
Translator: 549690339
“You are!?”
The sudden voice startled Ye Chen, who was practicing his boxing. He quickly lifted his head, looking at Wang Ping, his face filled with astonishment.
Sword Riding, this was a technique of the Sword Spirit Sect!
Although Ye Chen was still young, he was extremely obsessed with martial training. Hence, he had naturally learned about the major sects in Xia, dreaming of joining one in the future.
Among these sects, the Sword Spirit Sect was the strongest, the sect he aspired to join.
Sword Riding, wandering the world with a sword in hand – how cool, that was his dream!
“Hehe, lad, there’s no need to panic. I have no ill intentions towards the Ye’s family.”
The flying sword under Wang Pings foot disappeared. He lightly landed, standing in front of Ye Chen with his hands behind his back, laughing softly.
“l see.” Ye Chen stared at Wang Ping in awe and curiosity, feeling a bit nervous. Still, he seemed determined. Clenching his fists, he suddenly kneeled in front of Wang Ping and said, “Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect, I wish to become your apprentice and join the Sword Spirit Sect. I wonder if you would accept me?”
Wang Ping was slightly stunned, looking at Ye Chen in surprise.
This Son of Fortune indeed made shocking statements, kneeling to become an apprentice just like that.
This situation didn’t appear in the Life Simulator.
It may have happened, but the Lite Simulator didn’t mention it, or most likely, he had rejected it.
Or perhaps, he didn’t unveil his Sword Spirit Sect identity in the Life Simulator. Instead, he was just talking to the people of the Ye’s family.
“Are you sure you want to become my apprentice?”
Wang Ping inquired with a subtle look in his eyes.
Having a Son of Fortune as an apprentice indeed sounded interesting.
Maybe, after accepting Ye Chen as his apprentice, he could quickly become stronger in the Life Simulator under the protection of Ye Chen’s aura of fortune.
After all, once characters associated with the Leading Character, they tended to level up like a cultivation cheat, quickly improving at an astonishing rate.
Of course, another possibility existed.
That would be… the Heavenly Lone Star.
Some Leading Characters were truly cursed, harming those close to them.
Once someone close to them died, they could level up insanely. Then they would avenge the lost friend, making an outrageous turn of events.
In Wang Pings view, there was a high chance that this Son of Fortune, Ye Chen, had a Heavenly Lone Star destiny.
After all, if he hadn’t interfered, the Ye family would have been wiped out.
Not to mention masters and friends, even his family members could die.
Probably, the ring elder Jiang Huai wouldn’t inexplicably die before he completed his task.
“Yes, I want to become an apprentice, I want to ride the sword, wander the world with a sword, and kill the villains!’
Ye Chen stared at Wang Ping sincerely.
“Give me some time to consider it.’
Wang Ping raised his eyebrow slightly, neither agreeing nor refusing directly.
He needed to simulate some scenarios with the Life Simulator to make certain judgments.
If he carelessly accepted Ye Chen as his apprentice, he might end up mysteriously killed by Ye Chen’s potential Heavenly Lone Star destiny.
“Okay!” Ye Chen looked at Wang Ping full of hope, expecting him to accept him.
After all, although he didn’t agree directly, he didn’t refuse either. He still had a chance.
“Lad, take me to your parents. I have some matters to discuss with them.”
After Wang Ping used his power to pull Ye Chen up, he said.
“Elder, please follow me!”
Ye Chen respectfully nodded and led Wang Ping to meet the Ye Family Master.
“Chen’er, this person is…?”
When Ye Chen brought Wang Ping to meet the Ye Family Master, the latter, seeing Wang Pings extraordinary demeanor, his white robe, his handsome and refined appearance, was taken aback, his pupils dilating in surprise.
Although he didn’t know who Wang Ping was, his demeanor alone indicated that he was no ordinary person. He was likely a big shot, someone who their small Ye’s family could not afford to offend.
“Uh…” Ye Chen was startled, then turned to Wang Ping, not knowing what to say.
He didn’t even know Wang Pings name.
“My name is Wang Ping, the Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder.” Wang Ping, hands behind his back, spoke lightly.
Showing his true identity, there was no need to hide anything.
After all, he was now a well-known figure, and it was easy for people to identify him by his looks.
“Sword Spirit Sect Supreme Elder Wang Ping…?”
The Ye Family Master stared at Wang Ping, shocked and almost jumped up.
Any member of the Sword Spirit Sect, even just a lowly disciple, was not someone their Ye’s family could mess with.
Now, a Supreme Elder had actually come.
That was an utmost powerhouse of the Spiritual Origin Realm!
Not to mention, this Wang Ping was a legend among legends, also possessing the identity of a 4th Tier Alchemist!
With his prestigious identity, he could casually roam anywhere in Xia.
However, such a big shot had condescended to visit their Ye’s family. This almost scared the Ye Family Master to death, leaving him a little at a loss.
But quickly, joy overcame him!
Such a big shot visiting the Ye’s family was a sure sign of a great opportunity!
If they could cozy up to this Wang Ping, the Ye l s family could reach new heights.
“Master Wang Ping, please sit here. You deserve the seat of honor!”
Immediately, the Ye Family Master became extremely enthusiastic, carefully bringing out the most precious tea cup, pouring a cup of tea for Wang Ping, and addressing Wang Ping.
Regarding this, Wang Ping didn’t refuse. He naturally took the seat of honor, looking at the father and son of the Ye family..

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 85: Ye Chen wishes to become an apprentice!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 85: Ye Chen wishes to become an apprentice!_2
Translator: 549690339
“l came here for the ring on this little one’s hand. It is of great importance to me. If you are willing to give it to me, I will offer the Ye’s family a satisfactory compensation.”
Wang Ping drank his tea and chuckled.
The Ye Family Master looked at the black ring on his son’s hand with astonishment, unable to calm his heart.
He didn’t understand why someone as influential as Wang Ping would specifically come for this kind of ring, but he could guess that the origin of this ring, which was originally bought by Ye Chen’s biological mother from the market for Ye Chen as a birthday gift, must be extraordinary and highly valuable.
However, the Ye Family Master also knew very well that no matter what secret the ring held, they were destined not to keep it.
On the contrary, if they acted wisely, they could use this ring to obtain incredible benefits, making the Ye’s family soar.
“If the Sir wants this ring, just take it. We don’t need any compensation.”
The Ye Family Master immediately interrupted Ye Chen when he wanted to say something, laughing heartily.
Wang Ping glanced at him, knowing his thoughts, and spoke calmly: “l don’t like owing favors. There are some profound-tier advanced cultivation skills and martial arts in this storage ring, as well as ten thousand lower-tier spirit stones. You all can accept it.”
During his words, Wang Pings finger brushed the storage ring.
Upon hearing this, the Ye Family Master was dumbstruck.
“Ten thousand lower-tier spirit stones, and profound-tier cultivation skills and martial arts…
The Ye Family Master’s palms started trembling.
This was ten thousand lower-tier spirit stones. Even a Spiritual Realm Expert’s wealth would not be much more than this.
With so many spirit stones and profound-tier cultivation skills and martial arts, the Ye’s family was destined to rise as long as the development was steady.
Overwhelmed with joy that a small ring he couldn’t protect could bring so many resources, the Ye Family Master’s face turned red from excitement.
“Senior, I don’t want any of these things. I only hope that you will take me as your disciple.”
Ye Chen looked at his father’s overjoyed expression, full of his dilemma. Still, he eventually chose to speak.
As soon as he said this, the Ye Family Master also came back to his senses, calmed down a lot, and looked at Wang Ping with a hopeful face: “Senior, if you could take my son as your disciple, our Ye family would be willing to give up these resources.”
He had truly become blinded by his greed earlier, not as far-sighted as his son.
Although these resources were precious and enough to transform a small family into a large one, it was not as practical as becoming a disciple of Wang
Ping.
Wang Ping was a top-level Spiritual Origin Realm expert and a 4th Tier Alchemist!
If Ye Chen could become his disciple, resources would naturally be supplied in abundance, and Ye Chen’s future might also be as a top-level Spiritual Origin Realm expert.
Not to mention the connection with Sword Spirit Sect!
This was far more than ten times better than these resources!
“You are rather greedy.” Wang Ping didn’t care about Ye Chen’s words, just gave the Ye Family Master a glance and spoke indifferently.
As soon as these words came out, the Ye Family Master’s face turned pale, and cold sweat broke out.
Ye Chen had asked to be my disciple before, but I did not agree and needed to consider it for a while.’
Wang Ping shifted his gaze, speaking calmly.
“Whether to accept him as a disciple depends on whether he has a connection with me. You can take these resources since they belong to your Ye family.”
“Yes, yes, yes!”
The Ye Family Master sweated coldly but also sighed in relief, nodding hurriedly.
“Well, prepare a place for me. I will rest at the Ye l s family tonight and give you an answer tomorrow.”
Wang Ping spoke again.
“Thank you, Sir Wang Ping.” The Ye Family Master bowed hastily and then spoke to Ye Chen: “Chen’er, hurry up and give the ring to Senior.”
Ye Chen nodded and carefully handed the ring to Wang Ping, expecting his answer tomorrow.
Upon receiving the ring, Wang Ping nodded but didn’t say anything more.
“Please follow me, Sir!”
Next, the Ye Family Master hurriedly led Wang Ping to the guest room of the Ye’s family, making sure everything was prepared.
During this process, other members of the Ye family also saw it but were driven away by the Ye Family Master to prevent them from disturbing Wang Ping, a big shot.
In the guest room, Wang Ping sat cross-legged on the bed, picked up the black ring in his hand, squinted, and examined it with his spiritual power.
Then, he saw an extremely vague soul body inside the rings internal space.
The man’s face was aged, his eyes carried vicissitudes, and he looked helpless.
He was Ye Chen’s grandfather from the ring, Jiang Huai.
“l didn’t expect that a Transcendent Realm Master like you could be born in Profound Turtle Continent today. It’s really surprising. “Jiang Huai sighed and began speaking.
“l myself only managed to break through to the Transcendent Realm by mere chance, and I’m still not as good as my predecessor.”
Wang Pings tone was gentle, showing no malice.
“Each person has their own talents, so it’s not a matter of who’s stronger or weaker.” Jiang Huai said with emotion, “However, I’m quite curious about how you found out about the special nature of this ring and went out of your way to find it.’
“It was just a coincidence.”
Wang Ping didn’t want to answer and couldn’t give a detailed response, so he was vague.
“Predecessor, your cultivation level in life must have been more than just the Transcendent Realm, right? It doesn’t seem like a realm that can be reached on the Profound Turtle Continent. Can you tell me how you left the Profound
Turtle Continent?”
Wang Ping spoke again, changing the subject.
“Sure enough, those who reach the Transcendent Realm want to find a way out to sea. You chose that path too, didn’t you?”
Jiang Huai’s eyes flickered as he spoke slowly.
“l tried to go out to sea, but I almost died. Therefore, I had to find another way.” Wang Ping sighed.
“Going out to sea is indeed a path of death. Back then…”
Jiang Huai nodded, his expression reminiscing, as he began to recount his past experiences.
As for Wang Ping, he just calmly listened.
Although he had already learned about Jiang Huai’s past through the Life Simulator, he could only listen to it again now.
However, even after listening to it again, Wang Ping couldn’t tell how much of what this guy said was true and how much was false.
“Young friend, if you could help me find a precious medicine that nourishes the soul, I am willing to reward you handsomely. What do you think?”
After telling his story, Jiang Huai made his request.
“l can do that. If there is a soul-nourishing treasure, I will trade it with you.” Wang Ping smiled slightly and nodded.
“Then I must thank you, young friend. However, my Soul Body has become too weak, can you use your Spiritual Essence to help me stabilize my Soul Body? Otherwise, I may disappear into the world at any time.”
At this moment, Jiang Huai asked with a bitter smile.
“Hehe, it’s just a small matter.”
Wang Ping nodded and began to infuse his Spiritual Essence into Jiang Huai.
Of course, Wang Ping infused only a very small amount.
He didn’t want this old fellow to recover enough strength to deal with him.
To deal with this kind of old fellow, one must always be on guard.
If it weren’t for the fact that Wang Ping needed to use the Paid Simulation to squeeze every bit of value out of this old man, he would have killed him long ago.
Apart from that, Wang Ping was also thinking about another issue.
That is, regarding the Stele Array, apart from needing Spiritual Stones, there might also be an activation method required.
In other words, he can’t kill Jiang Huai before leaving the Profound Turtle
Continent.
Seeing that Wang Ping chose to give Jiang Huai some Spiritual Essence to stabilize his Soul Body but without giving too much, just enough to ensure that his Soul Body would not continue to weaken but wouldn’t get stronger either.
This left Jiang Huai frustrated.
However, he didn’t say much.
The two of them had just met, and Wang Ping couldn’t possibly trust him.
Just as Jiang Huai didn’t trust Wang Ping either.
This was all relative, so there was nothing to say about it.
Next, Wang Ping cut off his mental connection and sealed the ring with his Spiritual Essence, preventing Jiang Huai from sensing the outside world.
Then, he closed his eyes and said silently in his heart: “System, I want to use a free simulation.’
“Life Simulator activated. Host has seven free simulation chances remaining.”
Soon, the system’s voice rang out, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text began to emerge.
[On the first night, you start cultivating without any incidents.]
[On the second day, you choose to take Ye Chen as your apprentice. Ye Chen is overjoyed and performs the Inviting Teaching Ceremony. The entire Ye’s family is also shocked and ecstatic.]
[After that, you take Ye Chen to the Sword Spirit Sect, intending to groom him well..]

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 86: Heavenly Lone Star and Heavenly Tier Cultivation Technique!
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 86: Heavenly Lone Star and Heavenly Tier Cultivation Technique!
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, three months have passed. During these three months, in order to gain Jiang Huai’s trust, you helped him stabilize his Soul Body and even chose to become his apprentice.]
[Jiang Huai was very surprised by your request to become his apprentice, but he eventually agreed.]
[In the following two years, you found a 4th Tier Treasure Medicine to help him nourish his soul, which gained you even more of his trust.]
[In return, Jiang Huai, in order to gain your trust, not only gave you many secret skills but also taught you the Heaven-tier inferior Martial Skill – Sunset
Sword Skill.]
[During these two years, you successfully cultivated the Sunset Sword Skill and found that there were no issues with it.]
[After learning the Sunset Sword Skill, you took Ye Chen to the Purple Sun
Mountain Range and teleported.]
[After arriving at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you found an opportunity to eliminate Jiang Huai directly. You knew that once he arrived at the Seven Stars Archipelago, he would have plenty of ways to recover his soul power. If you didn’t act now, you wouldn’t be able to deal with him soon.]
[Next, you began to wander around the Seven Stars Archipelago with the Innate Realm Ye Chen, preparing to find an opportunity to join the Seven Star Palace.]
[However, unforeseen circumstances occurred when Ye Chen picked up a treasure at a market and was pursued by Mr. Evil. In a fit of anger, Ye Chen injured him.]
[Who would have thought that this Mr. Evil was the only son of an old monster with Spirit Sea Complete Realm Cultivation? With his son injured, he was furious and found you, which led to a fierce battle.]
[Although you had comprehended 70% Sword Spirit, your cultivation was ultimately too low. With only the early Spirit Sea Realm, you were no match for this old monster with exceptional battle prowess. In the end, you were forced to use the Heaven-tier inferior Martial Skill – Sunset Sword Skill to barely kill him.]
[However, this action completely stirred up trouble. The appearance of a Heaven-tier Martial Skill drove all the forces on the Seven Stars Archipelago crazy. Even the Seven Star Palace couldn’t sit still and sent strongmen to chase you down.]
[In response, you were extremely frustrated, and finally realized one thing that Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, must have the destiny of the Heavenly Lone Star.]
[Next, you and Ye Chen went on a frantic escape. You knew clearly that if you were to run separately, Ye Chen might be able to escape and even obtain great opportunities. However, you would surely die.]
[If you stayed with Ye Chen, you might have some chance of survival relying on his luck. Therefore, you absolutely couldn’t separate from Ye Chen.]
[While you were thinking, Ye Chen also said things like, ‘This mess was caused by him, and he’s willing to go out and attract the enemies.’ With a twitching face, you sternly refused Ye Chen’s offer to ‘die alone.’ Ye Chen was touched and swore that, if he could survive this calamity, he would take revenge on all strongmen in the future.]
[Soon, you were both intercepted by a Spiritual Fetus Realm Strongman.
Knowing that you were no match, you didn’t hesitate to use the Chi Clan Blood Essence to activate the Ancient Jade. The Ancient Jade erupted with divine power, killing the Spiritual Fetus Realm Strongman into blood fog.]
[You continued to run and search for a new hiding place. However, you were soon discovered by a Spirit Accumulation Realm Strongman. Without any means of escape, you could only pin your hopes on Ye Chen’s ability to unleash the aura of fortune.]
[Then, a figure suddenly appeared in the sky, inexplicably taking Ye Chen away, with even the Spirit Accumulation Realm Strongman unable to react. This left you speechless and annoyed.]
[Next, the Spirit Accumulation Realm Strongman wasted no time in attacking your Sea of Consciousness with soul force, shattering your soul and initiating a soul-search.]
[Because your soul was shattered, you died. However, thanks to the Rebirth tally, you were brought back to life.]
[For your revival, this Spirit Accumulation Realm Strongman was astonished and then overjoyed, thinking that you must have some great treasure on you. However, after your resurrection, knowing that you had no way of surviving, you chose to self-destruct without hesitation, and you died again.]
[With your death, the simulation ends…]
“This really is the Heavenly Lone Star, huh.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his face twitching, at a loss for words.
He had barely reached the Seven Stars Archipelago and already encountered a powerful enemy, forcing him to use the Sunset Sword Skill and causing him to be hunted down by all the strongmen on the Seven Stars Archipelago. It was absurd.
This apprentice simply couldn’t be taken.
If he did, it would cost him his life.
And even in a desperate situation, he would die easily, while Ye Chen would be fine, as someone rescued him.
Presumably, this was an incredibly powerful character who happened to be passing by and discovered Ye Chen’s ‘extraordinary talents, then saved him, intending to take him as a disciple.
“Even in the life simulation, giving up Ye Chen and leaving him to the Spirit Sea Complete Realm strongman would have probably resulted in death.” Wang Ping sighed.
If he really abandoned Ye Chen to that Spirit Sea Domain Perfection strongman, Ye Chen would likely go through tribulations and still live.
Moreover, Ye Chen would despise him deeply and seek revenge against his supposed good master in the future.
And then, Wang Ping would be killed by Ye Chen, and Ye Chen would obtain his valuable items, continuing to upgrade from there.
“Unless you have extremely hard luck yourself, you must not become a master or friends with leading characters with the Heavenly Lone Star destiny. Otherwise, you will surely provide them with an upgrade buff..”

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 86: Heavenly Lone Star and Heavenly Tier Cultivation Technique! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 86: Heavenly Lone Star and Heavenly Tier Cultivation Technique! _2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping was speechless and complained.
“However, this simulation has made one thing clear. The destruction of the soul can also be resurrected. The Rebirth tally is indeed powerful, it’s no wonder it was well-received in the chat group.”
Wang Ping thought of the powerful effects of the Rebirth tally and couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
Unfortunately, he always faced old monsters far superior to him, which made his second life useless. After reviving, he’d still end up being killed, causing him great frustration.
Of course, the usefulness of the Rebirth tally couldn’t be denied.
If anyone thought it was useless, they’d undoubtedly be considered a fool.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and then started the challenge once again.
Since he had confirmed that Ye Chen was indeed the leading character of the Heavenly Lone Star destiny, he had no intention of taking Ye Chen as his disciple in this simulation.
However, he could still try the normal route in the simulation.
After this simulation, he would collect enough Lower-tier Spirit Stones and consider going to the Seven Stars Archipelago.
“Life Simulator activated. Host has six free simulations remaining.”
The system’s voice rang out, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text began to surface.
[Day One, you chose to cultivate.]
[On the second day, you rejected Ye Chen’s request to become your disciple and encouraged him to work hard in his cultivation. Even without a master, he could still achieve greatness.]
[Your encouragement inspired Ye Chen, who vowed to work hard in his cultivation and become a powerful cultivator like you.]
[In the blink of an eye, three years passed. You successfully obtained the Secret Skill and Sunset Sword Skill from Jiang Huai, as well as collected enough Spirit Stones. You decided to head to the Seven Stars Archipelago.]
[Not long after you left, Ye Chen came to the foot of the Sword Spirit Sect mountain and sought to join the Sword Spirit Sect…]
“Uh…
Reading the simulation content, Wang Ping felt an uncomfortable knot in his heart.
In the previous simulations, although the Life Simulator didn’t mention much, he definitely left a way to deal with the hidden danger of Demon MO Fan before leaving.
But now, with Ye Chen losing Jiang Huai as the ring elder, he wanted to join the Sword Spirit Sect instead…
Without a doubt, with Ye Chen’s talent and identity as the Son of Fortune, joining the Sword Spirit Sect would be a sure thing.
At that time, would Ye Chen activate his ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ fate upgrade buff with Bai Tianhong or the entire Sword Spirit Sect?
If that were the case, the Sword Spirit Sect would be doomed.
“Taking away the ring elder has caused a huge butterfly effect. This Son of Fortune is truly a headache.”
Wang Ping shook his head, his emotions complicated.
“Forget it, I won’t worry about him. I’ll continue simulating my own life. After all, these events will only happen in the future. Becoming strong enough beforehand will help me deal with all the hidden dangers.”Wang Ping let out a sigh of relief, stopped thinking too much, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping stared, more text emerged.
[After you arrived at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you directly killed Jiang Huai to prevent him from counterattacking and causing your death.] [Next, you joined the Seven Star Palace and began cultivating within it.]
[20 years later, the Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and after some thought, you chose to enter in search of opportunities. Otherwise, it would be challenging for you to become stronger quickly. Moreover, the six-tier Fire-attribute spirit object within the secret realm was not to be missed, as it was crucial for your breakthrough into the Spiritual Fetus Realm.]
[Upon entering the secret realm, you were not transported with others. You were relieved, but also disappointed. After all, in your memory, there was a mid-tier Spirit Sword there, which you had competed with others for and ultimately won.]
[You ventured through the secret realm, slaying monster beasts and obtaining some resources.]
[You found a sixth-tier earth-attribute spiritual object but decided to give up when you saw two Spiritual Fetus Realm Strongmen fighting and several
Spirit Sea Domain Strongmen watching covetously.]
[Although you could kill a Spiritual Embryo Realm Strongman using your trump card, this trump card was limited and could not be wasted on a spiritual object that did not match your attributes. Otherwise, you would lose the opportunity to fight for the six-tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item.]
[However, what frustrated you was that when you found the location, the battle had already ended, and you missed the chance to seize the six-tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item. You only heard the news that after a fierce battle between the three Spiritual Embryo Realm strongmen, the Fire Attribute spirit object was taken by the Spiritual Embryo Realm strongman of the Fire Sect, Flaming Fire Taoist.]
[You considered finding Flaming Fire Taoist and trading your Red Fire Skill for the six-tier Fire Attribute Spirit item. If the trade failed, you would have to find another way.]
[You found Flaming Fire Taoist and tried to trade your Red Fire Skill, but he wasn’t too interested because the Fire Sect’s own cultivation method was also
Earth- tier top- grade.]
[Still, Flaming Fire Taoist recognized the value of an Earth-tier top- grade skill as a foundation for his sect and chose to take action, intending to kill you and take the Red Fire Skill while no one was watching. Even the Seven Star Palace couldn’t do much without witnesses.]
[Enraged, you activated the Ancient Jade using the Chi Clan Blood Essence and severely wounded Flaming Fire Taoist. You were astonished that he didn’t die, but you also realized the limitation of this power.]
[The Flaming Fire Taoist’s cultivation base was at the Perfect Spiritual Embryo Realm. The Ancient Jade couldn’t kill him, only inflict severe injuries, reducing him to the brink of death.]
[You thought it wasn’t because the Ancient Jade wasn’t strong enough, but the
Chi Clan Blood Essence didn’t contain enough power to activate the full potential of the Ancient Jade.]
[Next, not wanting to give Flaming Fire Taoist a moment’s respite, you used the Sunset Sword Skill to try and finish him off. But even at the brink of death, Flaming Fire Taoist’s cultivation base was far superior to yours, and he counterattacked at the last moment, killing both of you.]
[After reviving with the Rebirth tally, you were filled with lingering fear. Spiritual Embryo Realm Strongmen were indeed terrifying and difficult to deal with. If not for the Rebirth tally, you would have died for real.]
[You then began to collect the spoils of war from the body. You successfully obtained the six-tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item and some other treasures.] [You knew that staying there would undoubtedly cause significant trouble if someone noticed, so you quickly left the scene.]
[Shortly after you left, a powerful cultivator appeared, shocked by the chaos at the scene and learned of Flaming Fire Taoist’s demise.]
[The news of Flaming Fire Taoist’s death spread, causing a tremendous sensation, and many strong cultivators were terrified. After all, Spiritual Embryo Realm Strongmen were rare and highly influential figures. As the third-ranking person in the Fire Sect and a Perfect Spiritual Embryo Realm Strongman, Flaming Fire Taoist’s fall in the Seven Star Secret Realm was truly shocking.]
[You also heard the news, and after realizing you hadn’t been exposed, you breathed a sigh of relief and continued to explore the secret realm.]
[Half a month later, you heard a loud noise and decided to go check it out.
Then, you saw a shocking scene.]
[A powerful loose cultivator in the Spirit Accumulation Realm had obtained a Heavenly-tier cultivation Skill and was fighting desperately. Many other strong cultivators around him were attacking him, trying to seize the Heavenly-tier cultivation Skill.]
[Knowing escape was impossible, the loose cultivator declared, “Since you all want me dead, I will take this Heavenly-tier Skill– Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill with me to the grave.” He then chose to self-destruct.]
[The self-destruction of a Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivator was terrifyingly powerful, severely injuring many other strong cultivators. You were fortunate to have been far enough away, or the shockwave would have killed you.]
[Although you learned the name of the Heavenly-tier cultivation Skill, you couldn’t help but feel disappointed. A Heavenly-tier Skill was gone just like that, which was a terrible waste of heavenly resources.]
[However, no matter how regretful you felt, you could do nothing about it. After all, you were self-aware, and you were too weak to compete for the Skill. Going in would only result in handing over your head, and even giving away all the treasures on your body..]

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent!
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that with the help of the Ancient Jade and the Chi Clan Blood Essence, I can obtain a 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item. Although it will still consume a Rebirth Tally, it’s finally some good news.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and smiled.
Although he could still only watch as the Heaven-tier Skill was destroyed, he finally reaped some benefits.
Anyway, with his current strength, the Heaven-tier Skill could only make him envious.
“But the name of this Heaven-tier Skill is called ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion skill? It’s a nice name. And five elements… five elements, could it allow one to cultivate five different attributes at the same time?”
Wang Ping thought of the name of the Heaven-tier Skill, and his eyes sparkled.
If it really could allow one to cultivate five attributes at the same time, this skill would be truly overpowered.
After all, the five elements inter-promote and restrain each other. Having one more attribute would mean having more means to adapt and deal with different situations.
“When I have enough Mid-tier Spirit Stones to simulate, I must find a way to grab this Heaven-tier Skill. Even if I’m killed in the end, as long as I touch this Skill or remember it in my mind, I might be able to refresh the rewards through it. In that case, it would really be like getting a Heaven-tier Skill for free.’
Wang Pings eyes were sharp, and his thoughts were active.
If he doesn’t have enough strength to grab the Skill, it’s fine.
If he could at least touch it, it would be worth trying.
After all, experimenting a few times, the Spirit Stones spent are not too many. Compared to the value of a Heaven-tier Skill, it’s just a drop in the ocean.
After indulging in his thoughts, Wang Ping focused again and continued to stare at the luminescent screen. The text reappeared.
[In the following days, you didn’t continue to seek opportunities but chose to lie low until the secret realm’s closing time. In the end, you successfully survived the Seven Star Secret Realm.]
[After returning to the Seven Star Palace, you began cultivation in seclusion, trying to quickly cultivate to the Spirit Sea Domain Perfection, and then break through the wall burial with the help of the 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item to advance to the Spiritual Fetus Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, 40 years passed. Because you didn’t focus on Alchemy during these years, your cultivation improved quickly, successfully advancing to the late stage of the Spirit Sea Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 60 years passed, and you successfully broke through to the Spirit Sea Domain Perfection. You started to attack the
Spiritual Fetus Realm, preparing very well and closing yourself in seclusion.]
[You furiously attacked the barrier and condensed your Spiritual Body. After half a year, you finally broke through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm, successfully condensing a Fire Spiritual Body and becoming extremely powerful.]
[As a Spiritual Fetus Stage Cultivator, you can truly establish a foothold in the
Seven Stars Archipelago and be referred to as a top powerhouse.]
[However, due to your hard cultivation in these years, your Alchemy progress has been very slow, only reaching the 5th tier. You don’t particularly care about this.]
“I’m finally at the Spiritual Fetus Realm. Next is how to avoid the plot of the Seven Stars Ancestor. Knowing what will happen, this should be simple.”
Wang Ping looked at the text on the luminescent screen and thought silently.
[Because you have become a Spiritual Fetus Realm cultivator, the Seven Star Palace was alarmed. The palace master of the Seven Star Palace established a new mountain peak for you, making you the eleventh peak master, recruiting disciples widely, and making your status transcendent.]
[When the news spread, the various forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago were restless. After all, the number of Spiritual Fetus Realm strongmen is scarce. There were already ten Spiritual Fetus Realm strongmen in the Seven Star Palace. The appearance of another one is not good news for other forces.]
[Especially the Fire Sect, they were frustrated. They lost a top powerhouse in the late stage of the Spiritual Fetus Realm in the Seven Star Secret Realm, and until now, no one has filled that position.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 20 years passed, and your cultivation has progressed even further but failed to break through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm Mid-stage. You sighed in your heart, the limit of Green Talent: Excellent Physique, without enough opportunities, might not break through to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Soon, the Sea Ape Clan still attacked the island. This time, you became one of the main forces, so you were targeted by the Sea Ape Clan. Fortunately, there were more powerful people on your side, so you didn’t encounter too much danger.]
[After the battle, you obtained abundant resources and were very satisfied in your heart.]
[Next, you continued to cultivate diligently.]
[The flow of time passed, and another 30 years passed. The Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun faked his death. You knew it was his plot, so you left the Seven Star Palace early, hiding yourself and preparing to flee overseas if the situation didn’t look good.]
[As expected, the events in your memory still happened. Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun launched the Blood Demon Array, devouring many strong people. Unfortunately, breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm was too difficult. Even relying on the Blood Demon Array to devour many Transcendent Realm cultivators, and not even sparing the strong people of the Seven Star Palace, he ultimately failed and didn’t break through the barrier or advance to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[With the death of many powerful individuals in the Seven Stars Archipelago, the entire Archipelago was in chaos. Various forces felt chills from Nangong Yun’s methods. Some strongmen who didn’t attend the funeral were even more relieved.]
[Upon hearing the news, you also shook your head and sighed. Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun gave up everything in order to break through, but in the end, he still failed. This kind of behavior is against the natural order of things. If he didn’t have enough luck, his failure might have been destined..]

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent! 2
Translator: 549690339
[The destruction of the Seven Star Palace caused other forces to quickly capitalize, and they aim at the remaining forces of the Seven Star Palace. With everyone pushing the fallen wall, the once powerful Seven Star Palace was completely annihilated.]
[After eradicating the remnants of the Seven Star Palace, the powerful forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago set their sights on Seven Star Island and the heritage of the Seven Star Palace.]
[The numerous masters clearly knew that there must be a lot of inheritances and treasures hidden within the Seven Star Palace, and the Storage Rings of the assimilated masters must have also fallen there.]
[If one could break the Great Array holding the Seven Star Palace, they would receive countless benefits.]
[Thus, the masters of the Seven Stars Archipelago all joined together, wishing to break the Great Array and seize the treasures. You also hid your face and took advantage of the situation.]
[Eventually, all the masters took action together, and after three days and nights of bombing, they successfully broke the Great Array of the Seven Star Palace and began to snatch treasures like mad.]
[You participated in the battles, killing and seizing treasures. You successfully obtained more than ten spiritual tools and Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures of varying quality.]
[In the end, because a master at the Late Stage of Spirit Accumulation Realm discovered your identity and targeted you, you chose to withdraw. This master chose to let you go and continued to fight over treasures.]
[After leaving, you continued to watch from afar. At this point, you noticed a mysterious young master suddenly appear, displaying incredible strength. He killed a Spirit Accumulation Realm master with one move, and his powerful combat abilities made people fearful.]
[You saw this and guessed that the young master’s cultivation must have reached half step Profound Elixir Realm; otherwise, he couldn’t have killed a
Spirit Accumulation Realm master as easily as slapping a fly.]
[In the end, this mysterious young master successfully seized the incomplete Profound Pills left behind by the fallen Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun and disappeared.]
[You were astonished by the strength and identity of this young master and guessed that he was most likely not a native of the Seven Stars Archipelago, for such power could not have gone unnoticed.]
[After the chaotic battle, the masters on the Seven Stars Archipelago suffered heavy casualties, but the survivors had broad smiles on their faces, because the harvest from this incident would give them the chance to advance further.]
[In the blink of an eye, another twenty years passed, and you successfully broke through to the mid-stage of the Spiritual Fetus Realm with the help of the treasures you obtained. Over these two decades, the power balance on the Seven Stars Archipelago had already changed. The Seven Stars Archipelago was eventually ruled by the Fire Sect, which still had one late-stage Spirit Accumulation Realm master.]
[You kept a low profile and cultivated on an overseas island of the Seven Stars
Archipelago, pondering the changes that had occurred. The current Seven Stars Archipelago was much weaker than it had been a hundred years ago; a late- stage Spirit Accumulation Realm master could now dominate. The number of Transcendent Realm masters had also dropped from over a thousand to less than two hundred.]
[Under such circumstances, if the Sea Clan were to attack the Seven Stars Archipelago again, ignoring the authority of the Heavenly Sword Holy Land, the Seven Stars Archipelago would be at genuine risk of annihilation.]
[In the blink of an eye, another sixty years passed, and your cultivation successfully advanced to the late- stage Spirit Embryo Realm. You estimated that your remaining lifespan would be enough to support you in breaking through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm. Considering that Spirit Accumulation Realm practitioners could use Body Possession to reincarnate and prolong their lives, you still had a long lifespan.]
[However, there are always unexpected events; a deep sea ancient beast, roaming the depths with its young, happened to pass by the Seven Stars
Archipelago. It sensed your presence and identified you as a “Sinful Bloodline
Descendant. ” ]
[It chose to take action, reducing you to ashes while you were cultivating. The entire Seven Stars Archipelago was affected, completely destroyed, and turned into dust that scattered into the sea.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
“Is this like a self-fulfilling prophecy?”
Wang Ping fell silent after reviewing the simulation content.
Just a while ago, he was still speculating about his own future prospects and lifespan, only to be casually killed by an ancient beast passing by.
This time, the ancient beast didn’t even show any inclination to negotiate, demonstrating a casual and domineering attitude.
Additionally, this was within the sphere of influence of the Heavenly Sword Holy Land, but the ancient beast didn’t seem to care at all and simply destroyed the island.
“How powerful are these deep sea monsters after all…”
Wang Ping forced a smile.
Being able to act so carelessly suggested that its cultivation level was definitely not limited to the Profound Elixir Realm.
Wang Ping had a feeling that the cultivation level of these strange creatures was several Great Realms higher than the Profound Elixir Realm.
Although he didn’t know what realm was above the Profound Elixir Realm, he had such intuition.
“Having the identity of a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’ is indeed dangerous.” Wang Ping had a headache and rubbed his temples.
Now, even when he’s just quietly cultivating in the Seven Stars Archipelago, not offending anyone, a passing ancient beast destroys him.
If he were to go to the Eastern Desolation, the chances of encountering the older generation of monsters would greatly increase, making his situation even more dangerous.
The key problem is that he has no choice but to go to the Eastern Desolation.
After all, the resources in the Seven Stars Archipelago are limited, making it likely insufficient to support the number of high-tier Spirit Stones he will need for his future simulations.
“Although it’s dangerous, facing it is inevitable. The only way is to slowly simulate and find a safe upgrade path. There is no other way.”
Wang Ping shook his head and cleared his mind.
Then, Wang Ping pondered for a moment, looked at the Soul Nurturing Ring in his palm, and communicated with it using his spiritual power: “Senior, do you know where I can find a large number of lower-tier Spirit Stones, or even mid-tier Spirit Stones? I want to leave Profound Turtle Continent as soon as possible..”

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent!_3
Translator: 549690339
“Your idea of wanting to leave the Profound Turtle Continent as soon as possible is correct. After all, staying in such a place with scarce spiritual energy and no resources is a complete waste of time. And for cultivators, cultivation is a fight against destiny, and time is something that cannot be wasted.’
Upon hearing this, Jiang Huai, who was originally in the midst of nourishing his soul, opened his eyes, his gaze flickering, and laughed softly.
“As for spiritual stones, I know where to find a spiritual mine, and you can go and dig some. If this concealed spiritual mine has not been discovered by others, you should be able to obtain millions of lower-tier spiritual stones, and even some mid-tier spiritual stones. As for upper-tier, it is not possible.” After a pause, Jiang Huai continued to speak.
For Jiang Huai, it was also necessary to leave the Profound Turtle Continent as soon as possible.
Because in this Profound Turtle Continent, finding precious soul nourishing treasure elixirs is too difficult.
Soul nourishing treasure elixirs are well-known for their rarity, so the value of a 4th tier soul nourishing treasure elixir is comparable to that of other 5th tier treasure elixirs.
Only by leaving the Profound Turtle Continent and heading to the ‘Falling Star Islands’ can he find soul nourishing treasure elixirs easily.
By then, his Soul Body can become stronger and avoid the risk of complete collapse.
“For now, these spiritual stones are enough.”
Wang Pings eyes brightened, and his heart was thrilled.
After discovering that there were no treasures in Jiang Huai’s soul nourishing ring, he had guessed that Jiang Huai must know the locations of some spiritual stone mines.
Otherwise, how could Ye Chen, with his Innate Realm cultivation, earn such a huge amount of spiritual stones?
Now, Jiang Huai’s answer confirmed his guess.
But what he didn’t expect was that there were even mid-tier spiritual stones.
If he had mid-tier spiritual stones, he wouldn’t have to rush to the Seven Stars Archipelago, which is full of strong cultivators, to earn spiritual stones. In this way, the risks would undoubtedly be greatly reduced.
“l hope the senior can inform me of the location of the spiritual mine.” After regaining his composure, Wang Ping said with a serious face.
“Fierce Wind Valley,” Jiang Huai replied. “There are arrays that I arranged to block it. Although so many years have passed, and the array has probably lost its original effect under the corrosion of time, the probability of the spiritual mine being discovered is still very small.”
“Sure enough, the senior had already left some back-up plans.”
Wang Ping praised with a light laugh.
Living for nearly two thousand years, even this old monster who has experienced a downfall still left himself with such a backup plan.
Of course, under normal circumstances, the back-up plans Jiang Huai left behind, and all kinds of good things are basically all for Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune.
However, for now, these benefits had been handed over to him.
Then, Wang Ping took advantage of the darkness of the night and turned into a Divine Halo, disappearing from the Ye Family’s guest room.
After all, it’s better to get spiritual stones sooner so that he can feel at ease.
Moreover, he had some thoughts in his heart and wanted to continue simulating a few more times in order to decide how to deal with Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, before tomorrow morning.
Fierce Wind Valley was quite far from Bai Wood Village.
However, it wouldn’t take Wang Ping too long to get there with his speed.
Late at night, when Wang Ping felt the depth of Fierce Wind Valley, the powerful monster beasts here sensed the terrifying aura emanating from him. They were all terrified to the extreme, wailing and crawling on the ground.
Even 8-tier demon beasts, whose cultivation is comparable to the late-stage Spiritual Origin Realm of humans, were extremely frightened.
They never thought that among humans, there would be an existence of Transcendent Realm.
Slaughtering them would be too easy for such an existence.
“Indeed, there is an aura of the Great Array, but it seems incomplete and cannot block the perception of Spirit Sea Domain Stronger.”
Wang Ping walked on air, looking down at the mountains below. After sensing them carefully, he said softly.
“This ore vein was laid by me a thousand years ago. It’s not bad that it still has some effect after such a long time.”
Jiang Huai’s voice sounded, a bit proud and a bit melancholy.
The glory of the past was ultimately like passing clouds.
“Oh? Senior returned to the Profound Turtle Continent a thousand years ago?” Wang Pings thoughts became more active, and he said.
He originally thought that this was a back-up plan Jiang Huai had prepared after fleeing back to the Profound Turtle Continent. He didn’t expect that it was arranged a thousand years ago, which was quite surprising.
“Yes. A thousand years ago, my lifespan was about to end, so 1 made a special trip back to the Profound Turtle Continent, left some back-up plans, and then chose to leave again and body possessed a newly born offspring to live another life.’
Jiang Huai said with mixed emotions.
“These backup plans were left behind in case something like this happened, or to be left to a destined person in the future. It seems that they have indeed come in handy.”
“So that’s the case.’
Wang Pings eyes flickered, and he nodded.
Old monsters were indeed old monsters, with such meticulous minds. Wang Ping even suspected that Jiang Huai might have some back-up plans in the Profound Turtle Continent or the ‘Seven Stars Archipelago’.
However, he certainly wouldn’t reveal them.
At the same time, Wang Ping didn’t dare to let him go to those places. If there were treasures like soul nourishing elixirs there, Wang Ping would be in danger.
Doing so might waste some opportunities, but it would be safer.
During the life simulation, Jiang Huai had once body possessed him. In that simulation, Jiang Huai’s soul power was so strong that he easily killed Fire Daotist and three Spirit Embryo Realm Strongmen..

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 87: Paid Simulation! Blue Talent! _4
Translator: 549690339
Initially, Wang Ping thought it was just three ordinary Spiritual Fetus Realm cultivators, but after the last simulation, he found out that Fire Daotist was at the Great Perfection of Spiritual Fetus Realm, and the other two powerhouses who could fight him were definitely not simple.
However, Jiang Huai was able to easily suppress the three of them, which meant that his soul power at that time had reached the level of a top-notch
Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivator – otherwise, he couldn’t have done that.
And to restore his soul power to such an extent, ordinary soul nourishing treasure elixirs wouldn’t suffice.
With his cultivation level at that time, the probability of obtaining such a treasure elixir was very low.
Not only was it a matter of strength, but there was also the issue of these heavenly materials and earthly treasures being extremely rare – they were not something one could find just by wanting to.
Next, without saying anything more, Wang Ping flashed over to the front of the Great Array, gently touched the light curtain formed by the array, and felt the rebounding force.
Although this force was strong, it didn’t mean much to Wang Ping.
His power surged within him, easily tearing open a gap and breaking in.
Then, Wang Pings spiritual sense detected an astonishing number of spirit stones underground.
This made Wang Pings eyes brighten as he used his skills to lift the earth and began mining.
After several hours, Wang Ping had taken away more than half of the spiritual mine here.
There was a total of more than a million lower-tier spirit stones.
In addition, there were two thousand mid-tier spirit stones, which constituted quite a harvest.
“l can’t mine the remaining spirit stones anymore. If I leave these veins here, they can continue to generate spirit stones. If I take them all away, that would destroy the mine and it won’t bless future generations,”
Wang Ping stopped his actions, murmured to himself, and flew into the sky, heading towards Bai Wood Village.
“This kid is quite magnanimous.”
Jiang Huai saw Wang Ping’s actions and quietly assessed him.
There was an unwritten rule in the World of cultivators: when encountering heavenly materials and earthly treasures, if they were of the renewable type, one must leave the roots and not exhaust them.
Of course, although there was such an unwritten rule, many people found it difficult to suppress their greed and would take away all the treasures with them.
“Perhaps, it’s really possible to trust him a little bit, let him help me find some soul nourishing treasure elixirs, and wait until the Falling Star Archipelago…”
Jiang Huai was considering many things in his heart.
When Wang Ping returned to the Ye’s family, the roosters were already crowing and it wasn’t far from daybreak.
Without any fuss, Wang Ping continued to seal off Jiang Huai’s perception in the Soul Nurturing Ring, took out one thousand pieces of mid-tier spirit stone, and muttered in his heart: “System, I want to do the paid simulation.”
“Ding, the paid simulation requires one thousand mid-tier spirit stones. Do you want to consume them?” The system’s voice sounded.
“Consume.”
Wang Pings eyes were filled with anticipation as he spoke.
It had been a long time since he had done a paid simulation.
Although it was painful to have to use up thousands of hard-earned mid-tier spirit stones all at once, it was worth it.
“Ding, consumption successful, life simulator activated, refreshing talents…” The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing the Blue Talent – Berserker; Green Talent – Moonlight Wolf; White Talent Business Genius.”
Blue Talent – Berserker: When facing a strong enemy, it can stimulate the Berserk State, making most curses and binding- type negative effects invalid, whilst also greatly increasing the host’s power.
The Berserk State can only last for ten minutes, with a cooldown time of one month.
However, if the opponent’s cultivation is far superior to the host’s, some negative effects may still occur and cannot be completely negated.
In addition, once the Berserk State is activated, their thinking ability will be greatly reduced.
Green Talent – Moonlight Wolf: Under the moonlit night, the host can transform into a wolf-type Yao beast, and all attributes will see a certain increase.
White Talent – Business Genius: Has natural business talent.
“Blue Talent!”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time, his expression astonished.
Good fellow, this long-awaited paid simulation refreshed such amazing talents.
Even refreshes a blue talent.
Was this because he hadn’t refreshed any strong talents until now, and has finally reached the guarantee phase?
Or was it that after being unlucky for so long, he’s finally turned the tables and became lucky this time, with fortune favoring him!

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 88: Cultivation Skill in Hand! Generous Rewards!
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 88: Cultivation Skill in Hand! Generous Rewards!
Translator: 549690339
“This Berserk Talent is impressive! ”
Wang Ping looked at the introduction to the Blue Talent with a gleaming eye, his heart restless.
Compared to the effects of the Green Talent, this Blue Talent was obviously superior.
Entering Berserk State, his strength would multiply, and it even has an immunity to controls, which is simply invincible.
This reminded Wang Ping of Olaf’s ultimate move.
Well, it feels like the life simulator has borrowed some stuff.
“Although it’s true that secret methods used by entities with higher cultivation levels can’t be completely negated, this should definitely have some effect. For those whose cultivation isn’t that much higher than mine, they can be directly made immune to controls. With this Blue Talent, maybe 1 actually have a shot at that Heaven-tier Skill.”
In Wang Pings heart, he had no hesitation in choosing this Blue Talent, looking forward to the upcoming simulation.
“By the way, could this talent make me immune to Jiang Huai’s body possession? I think that counts as a negative status.”
At this moment, Wang Ping had a thought and considered the issue with Jiang Huai’s body possession.
If he could resist Jiang Huai’s possession, he could exploit Jiang Huai’s value to the fullest, and not miss any opportunities due to hesitating to sacrifice him..
“Better not test it this time, in case I lose both the talent and the skill. After all, the talents may not show up as rewards. Also, the mid-tier spirit stones I have right now should not be wasted.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart, thinking to himself.
When Wang Ping was considering these, the system voice once again sounded, “Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
