In an instant, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the words began to emerge.
[Day 1, you decide to reject Ye Chen’s request to become his apprentice.]
[Three years later, you only head to the Seven Stars Archipelago after procuring the Sunset Sword Skill from Jiang Huai. After arriving at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you kill Jiang Huai.]
[After that, you join the Seven Star Palace.]
[Twenty years later, the Seven Star Secret Realm opens and you enter it. You are teleported to a different location this time; there is no mid-tier Spirit Sword, but you don’t care.]
[You venture about in the secret realm and encounter Fire Daotist who has acquired a 6th Tier Fire Attribute Spirit Item. You engage in a fierce battle, inflicting heavy damage on him using the Ancient Jade and Chi Clan Blood Essence.]
[Fire Daotist’s desperate counterattack as he was about to die is terrifying. You are driven into a corner, on the verge of death along with him, but you activate the Blue Talent-Berserker. Your power greatly increased, enabling you to kill Fire Daotist and conserve a Rebirth tally.]
[After killing Fire Daotist, you marvel at the strength of the Berserk State.
After cleaning up the scene, you quickly leave the place.]
[You deliberately follow the traces of powerful beings and successfully arrive first at the site of a terrifying battle due to its turmoil. You witness the battle over a Heaven-tier Skill.]
At this point, Wang Ping became nervous.
At the same time, Wang Ping also thought of a problem.
If he first selects the reward that improves his cultivation, boosting his own strength, it seems like the chance of getting it in future simulations could be somewhat greater.
Perhaps, this life simulation should mainly focus on continuing to observe battles and enhancing his own strength.
Once this life simulation ends and his cultivation becomes sufficiently strong —if he can reach the Perfect Spiritual Embryo Realm and then combine that with the Berserk State—he might have a chance to snatch the skill when the opportunity presents itself.
If he makes a move now, death is most likely the outcome.
At this point, his cultivation is only at the Mid Stage of Spirit Sea Realm, and even if he activates the Berserk State, he is probably not a match for a Spirit
Embryo Realm Strongman. Even if he could really contend with a Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman, he probably could only last for a brief time against an Early Stage Spiritual Bearing Realm Strongman at most.
With this level of power, he would not even be able to touch his opponent.
Of course, if he continues to cultivate and raises his strength, and if he chooses to reward his cultivation, he will most likely need many more spirit stones for further simulations.
Therefore, after this simulation, he won’t be able to run a second simulation with the remaining thousand or so mid-tier spirit stones.
At that time, it would also give him quite the headache.
Although going to the Seven Stars Archipelago would earn him some, Wang Ping wanted too many things and needed to run many simulations, so it was somewhat of a loss.
While Wang Ping was in thought, the words continued to surface.
[You are eager to act, but eventually choose not to and opt for a safer approach. You secretly suggest that such battles come with the risk of falling and it’s not worth it. Instead, why not reveal the contents of the skill so that everyone has a chance to cultivate it.]
[Maybe because you arrived before the loose cultivator was in a real death-or-die situation, he actually hesitated.]
[Other strong individuals felt their hearts stir when they saw what was happening and thought your proposal was quite good. After all, the skill was on the loose cultivator, and though there were many of them and they could definitely kill the cultivator, as a Spirit Accumulation Realm strongman, he couldn’t be killed in an instant. If they pushed him into a corner, he has the ability to bring down some of them. Moreover, if he were cornered, there was also the possibility that he would destroy the Heavenly-tier Skill, making it so that no one would get anything at all.]
[In the end, all the strong individuals present began to persuade the loose
cultivator to learn the Heavenly-tier Skill together. You feel hopeful and excited in your heart. Because if the Seven Star Palace were to obtain the Heavenly-tier Skill, as Qin Lan’s disciple—one of the three vice-palace masters, you would naturally be qualified to cultivate it.]
[After thinking it over, the loose cultivator sneered and directly sent part of the skill’s contents to the strong individuals from the Seven Star Palace and the Fire Sect, stating that forces other than the Seven Star Palace and the Fire
Sect do not qualify to cultivate it. If they forced him, he will self-detonate and destroy the skill. This made many strong individuals furious. The Spirit
Accumulation Realm strong individuals from the Seven Star Palace and the Fire Sect stepped forward and chose to support the loose cultivator’s side..]

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 88: Cultivation Skill in Hand! Generous Rewards! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 88: Cultivation Skill in Hand! Generous Rewards! 2
Translator: 549690339
[This angered the other powerful beings beyond belief, leading to another outbreak of battle. For the sake of Cultivation Skills, they no longer cared about the strong presence of the Seven Star Palace and Fire Sect. However, the current fight seemed to be evenly matched. You watched the scene, dumbfounded, and couldn’t help but admire the quick wit of the loose cultivator.]
[As the battle escalated once more, the battlefield grew increasingly tragic, with powerful beings beginning to perish. You can only watch, unable to intervene, leaving you feeling frustrated.]
[Soon, the battle took a new turn… It turned out that Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun had also come here. He chose the right time to strike, ambushing the Spirit Accumulation Realm loose cultivator, slicing off his arm, seizing the Heaven-tier Skill, and then directly suppressing and killing him.]
[As Seven Star Palace Ancestor Nangong Yun made his move, all the powerful beings present shivered in fear. Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun was ruthless, killing all the strong beings on the scene.]
[You admired the strength of Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun. At the same time, you were excited. If Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun obtained this Heaven-tier Skill, you would have a chance to cultivate it as well. This was beyond your expectations, not imagining things would turn out this way.]
[After the journey to the Seven Star Secret Realm, Seven Star Ancestor
Nangong Yun made a decision. That is to give up the territory of the Seven
Stars Archipelago and leave the Seven Stars Archipelago to go far overseas.]
[This was because the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill was a hot potato. Once the news got out, no matter if it was the powers of the other archipelagos, or some strong cultivators from the Eastern Desolation, they would all rush to seize it.]
[By that time, even a Profound Elixir Realm master might not be able to keep this Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill, and staying in the Seven Star Archipelago would be a suicidal behavior. Even if the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill was voluntarily handed over, they would still be exterminated. The world of cultivators is just that ruthless.]
[Including all of you Transcendent Realm Cultivators, and some of the genius figures in the Seven Star Palace, you were all taken away by the Seven Star
Ancestor. As for the rest of the people, they were all dispersed by the Seven
Star Ancestor, leaving them to survive on their own.]
[Many people were helpless and sighed at the actions of the Seven Star Ancestor, as their families were also involved. However, taking away too many people would draw too much attention and could lead to trouble. So, they had to give up on them, and hope that they could manage on their own.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed. Thanks to the Seven Star Ancestor’s decisive actions, many of the major powers and strong cultivators were looking for him, but they found nothing. You were all hiding in an underground cave of a deserted island, cultivating.]
[Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun had great ambition; he wanted to use this Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm, and also wanted you to grow in the future, following him to create an even greater Seven Star Palace.]
[For this purpose, he also taught you the cultivation method of the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill.’ He didn’t worry about you running away with the Cultivation Skill. This is because the great array was arranged here, and without his permission, no one could leave.]
[After obtaining the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion
Skill,’ you were very excited and began to cultivate it. You found that the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill’ was as you had guessed; it allowed you to cultivate five attributes simultaneously, condensing the Five Elements Spirit Body. This Spirit Body is far more powerful than a single Spirit Body, comparable to some of the more powerful innate physique. Moreover, once the Five Elements Spirit Body was condensed, its foundation would be extremely solid, and it wouldn’t lose to any genius from the Great Sect, allowing you to go further in the future.]
[However, you also discovered some shortcomings of the ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill.’ That is, this Cultivation Skill is best suited for cultivators below the Spiritual Fetus Realm. Once you surpass the Spiritual Fetus Realm, it is impossible to condense the Five Elements Spirit Body. Although you can still cultivate five attributes, and your combat power is still strong enough to have no weaknesses, ultimately, there are some flaws, and you cannot cultivate this Cultivation Skill to perfection.]
[In addition, another drawback is that although you can cultivate five attributes, the resources needed are five times that of other cultivators. To break through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm and condense the Five Elements Spirit Body, you need five types of 6th Tier Spiritual Materials for each attribute, corresponding to gold, wood, water, fire, and earth.]
[You can only sigh in your heart that the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill is powerful, but it also consumes more resources. Besides, it seems hard for you to find so many resources now.]
[You know that there might be trouble ahead. This is because Seven Star
Ancestor Nangong Yun doesn’t have much lifespan left, and if he can’t break through to the Profound Elixir Realm within these thirty years, he will definitely do something extreme.]
[In the blink of an eye, thirty years have passed. You have successfully switched to cultivating the ‘Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill,’ condensing five kinds of attribute essence within your body. However, you did not choose to break through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm, still hoping to gather the other 6th Tier Spiritual Materials before doing so.]
[In these thirty years, Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun had already entered a closed-door state, constantly trying to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[In the end, he failed. Due to the failure of the breakthrough, he perished. With the death of Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun, the restrictions on you disappeared, and you were finally free.]
[Each of you had different plans and intended to disperse and continue looking for opportunities, wanting to become Profound Elixir Realm masters in the future. Unfortunately, just as you dispelled the Great Array, you were discovered by someone.]
[A powerful Profound Elixir Realm master descended and directly attacked you. You fought back desperately. Although you had cultivated the Heaven-tier Skill, you were still weak in the face of the immense cultivation gap, and could only lay dying. Because you had a Rebirth tally, you died an extra time.]
[As you died, this simulation ends…]
“Uh…
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his gaze a little strange.
He thought he would have to wait for the next simulation for a chance to get a glimpse of this Heaven-tier Skill.
He didn’t expect that he would learn it in this simulation and managed to cultivate it successfully as well.
All he could say was that plans could never keep up with changes.Although Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun had refined him last time, he was still quite reliable as an Ancestor. He forcefully obtained a heaven-tier cultivation skill and then ran away with them, even giving them the skill to cultivate without monopolizing it for himself.
Unfortunately, he was either too old or had reached the peak of his natural talent, and he failed to make a successful breakthrough.
If he had managed to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm, the Seven Star Palace might have had a chance to rise again and become a major power in this sea region.
“l hope I can refresh and get a heaven-tier cultivation skill… No, the blue talent is even more precious. As long as I know how to obtain heaven-tier
cultivation skills, I can keep doing it, but blue talents are rare!”
Wang Ping was full of anticipation.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two rewards from the following list:
Spirit Sea Complete Realm Cultivation.
Blue Talent.Berserker.
Heavenly Grade Middletier Cultivation Skill.Five Elements Spirit Fusion
Skill.
Heaven-tier inferior Martial Skill.Sunset Sword Skill.
Earth-tier top-grade Secret Skill.Burning Blood Demonic Technique.
Earth-tier top-grade Martial Skill.Seven-Star Skill.
Green Talent.Moonlight Wolf.”
!!!
Wang Pings face was full of surprise as he looked at the refreshed talents.
These rewards were indeed generous.
True enough, the best items have been drawn.
Moreover, the chat group generously allowed him to choose two rewards this time, which was absolutely exhilarating.
“System, I choose @ and O!”
Wang Ping felt extremely excited and said at the bottom of his heart. Although the heaven-tier inferior Martial Skill Sunset Sword Skill was also valuable, it was ultimately not as precious as these two rewards.
Additionally, since it could be refreshed, it could always be chosen next time.
With Wang Pings choices made, a lot of joy appeared in his mind.
That was the information for the Blue Talent.Berserker and the cultivation content of the Heavenly Grade Cultivation Skill.Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill.
Besides, the liquid spiritual essence in his body was also boiling rapidly.
His Elixir Field expanded again by a significant amount, and at the same time, it formed five whirlpool-shaped spiritual essences with different attributes.
These were the whirlpools of the five elemental spiritual essences: gold, wood, water, fire, and earth.
At this moment, Wang Ping felt that the power within his body was at its peak – this was not only due to the addition of four elemental spiritual essences, but the quantity of the spiritual essence had increased five times, and the quality of the spiritual essence had undergone a qualitative change, becoming far stronger than before.
Furthermore, with the five elements mutually producing and overcoming
each other, a qualitative change could be formed once the five-element spiritual essence took shape.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The Third Group Task! (Requesting Monthly Ticket Support!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The Third Group Task! (Requesting Monthly Ticket Support!)
Translator: 549690339
“Whew, this feeling, it’s just amazing.”
Wang Ping smiled, spreading his palm, and different spiritual essences appeared in his hand, each with different colors and power.
“l wonder how powerful I am now. Maybe, if I were to face a Spirit Sea Realm grand completion expert, I could easily defeat them.”
Wang Ping secretly wondered in his heart.
The improvement in strength brought by Heavenly-tier cultivation skills was much stronger than Heavenly-tier martial arts.
Not to mention, the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill is not just an Heaven-tier inferior skill, but a Heavenly Grade Middletier Cultivation Skill.
At the Earth-tier level, even a small gap in rank can be huge, let alone in Heavenly-tier skills.
“Furthermore, some cultivation skills come with secret skills, and the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill is no exception. Although there is only one secret skill recorded in it, it is extremely terrifying.”
Wang Pings eyes shone as he muttered to himself.
Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill First Move – Secret Skills of Gradual Change: You can use other elements of spiritual essence to multiply the power of one element, and also transform it. However, this kind of special enhancement, if it is transformed into other attributes, needs time and can’t be interrupted, so you must be very careful.
Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill Second Move – Secret Skill of Five Elements Unification: You can combine the five elements into one and unleash a more terrifying strength.
However, although this secret skill is powerful, it puts a heavy burden on the body, making it difficult for the meridians to bear.
Therefore, unless you practice cultivating both mana and physique, it is difficult for the meridians to withstand the power of the Five Elements Spiritual Essence for a long time.
“In comparison, the secret skills in the Red Fire Skill may not have special attack and defense methods, but they fundamentally enhance one’s strength without focusing on attack and defense, or special abilities.”
Wang Ping compared the two cultivation skills and gave his evaluation.
The increase in energy quality brought about a qualitative leap in all aspects, whether it was strengthening the physical body or using martial skills to explode in power.
The predecessor who created the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill must have been a person who highly valued their foundation.
From the cultivation points of the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill and the content of its secret skill, one can see some clues.
“Speaking of which, I wonder if I can still use the secret skill from the Red Fire Skill since I’ve switched my cultivation skill.”
Wang Ping remembered the secret skill in the Red Fire Skill and his eyes flickered slightly.
Although the Red Fire Skill is lower in grade, the secret skill is still useful, and he did not want to give it up.
In addition, he was also interested in cultivating the Chiyan Spirit Fire.
Right away, Wang Ping once again took to the sky and tested it.
“l can’t activate it? But it seems that all I need to do is adjust it to the way the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill works, and then I might be able to use it. Besides, the cultivation method of Chiyan Spirit Fire is also worth learning from.’
Wang Ping walked through the air, pondering various things in his mind.
If he could cultivate Five Elements Spirit Fire with the help of the Chiyan Spirit Fire cultivation method, that would be awesome!
Five Elements Spirit Fire would definitely be more powerful and have greater potential than a single Chiyan Spirit Fire.
“It’s worth a try, and I can explore it later with the help of the Life Simulator.” Wang Pings eyes were full of determination as he made a decision.
Thinking of it this way, if I hit a bottleneck in my cultivation in the future, I can let the simulated Wang Ping practice more martial arts, experimenting with creating more of my own martial arts and secret skills.
As of now, I can only follow the path of others, but to reach the Martial Peak in the future, I must forge my own path in the martial way, or else it is impossible to succeed.
With these thoughts, Wang Ping became even more excited for the future simulations.
“Let’s continue the simulation. Since I’ve already acquired the cultivation skill,
I might as well start with Ye Chen and try a different path.”
After Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he made a new decision.
Although Ye Chen has the ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ destiny, as long as Wang Ping is cautious and doesn’t die too late, he might be able to find out about the fortuitous encounters through Ye Chen.
One could say that Ye Chen is a good stepping stone indeed.
“System, I want to do the free simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
He was left with one thousand pieces of mid-tier spirit stone, which meant that he had only one last chance for a paid simulation. He certainly couldn’t afford to waste it. It’s the right choice to use the free simulation to explore the future development.
For example, Wang Ping had always been curious about what kind of treasure Ye Chen had picked up at the market.
Following the normal routine, the Son of Fortune is bound to stumble upon something valuable, and none of the items picked up are simple.
If he could find out where Ye Chen got the valuable item and what it was through the latter, it would be a great gain.
“Ding, the Life Simulator has started, and the host has five free simulation times remaining.”
The system’s voice sounded, and the luminescent screen appeared with the text floating out.
[On the first day, you accepted Ye Chen as your disciple and brought him back to the Sword Spirit Sect.]
[Three years later, after learning the Sunset Sword Skill and achieving 70% Sword Spirit comprehension, you headed to the Seven Star Archipelago with Ye Chen.]
[Upon arrival, you killed Jiang Huai.]
[Shortly afterwards, Ye Chen picked up a treasure at the market on the outskirts of one of the Seven Star Islands and you followed him. You found that the treasure was a bronze ancient lamp that looked very old. However, you didn’t find anything else mysterious about it.]
[Then, Mr. Evil appears, and you unleash your aura to intimidate him. In the end, he leaves grumpily, and there is no conflict between you..]

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The third group task! (Seeking monthly ticket support!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The third group task! (Seeking monthly ticket support!) _2
Translator: 549690339
[You thought the event has ended. However, not long after, a mysterious powerhouse suddenly appeared before you, stating that after years of searching, he finally found it using a Secret Skill.]
[Without wasting any words, he directly took Ye Chen away. You were confused, but somewhat relieved that you weren’t killed, though a bit disappointed you didn’t get any opportunities through Ye Chen.]
[But you celebrated too early. Half a year later, in one of your cultivation practices, you fought with someone, revealing the secret of your Cultivation Skill. An elder from the Spirit Accumulation Realm who was passing by detected you, decided to take action, and as a result, you fought him. Even with all your cards on the table, you were still no match for him, so you died once. You revived yourself with a Rebirth tally, which intrigued the elder, leading him to attempt soul-searching.]
[Helplessly, you activated the Berserk State to stop the opponent from soul-searching. You successfully blocked his soul-search and used this opportunity to self-explode.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
“Good grief, even if that mysterious person didn’t kill me and just chose to take Ye Chen away, I still would’ve died. It was just delayed by a year. This Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill and Martial Skills, though precious and powerful, are also hot potatoes. I absolutely can’t reveal them.”
Wang Ping looked thoughtful.
However, that the death came so quickly might not be unrelated to the fate of Ye Chen, the Heavenly Lone Star.
“l wonder if I can also refresh a Fortunate-type talent. Maybe under the blessings of sufficient luck, even if 1 accept the protagonist of this Heavenly Lone Star’s fate as a disciple, it wouldn’t spell death.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and finally decided to give up on accepting Ye Chen as an apprentice.
To take advantage of the Son of Fortune to seek opportunities isn’t the time yet, to forcefully accept him as a disciple would just turn me into a victim. “Speaking of which, the origin of the bronze ancient lamp that Ye Chen picked up is probably more astounding than I imagined… However, that mysterious powerhouse has always been searching for this ancient lamp, and he always manages to find it. Without enough power, keeping the bronze ancient lamp is like seeking a dead end.”
Wang Ping pondered.
Of course, considering Ye Chen’s survival, that mysterious powerhouse may not kill people at all.
Or perhaps Ye Chen is the Son of Fortune, a special existence, and that’s why he didn’t die.
Besides, the details about this in the Life Simulator are still many, and lots were overlooked.
It’s unnecessary for this mysterious powerhouse to take Ye Chen away if he could directly take the bronze ancient lamp. It’s an entirely redundant act.
Or did Ye Chen experienced personally something that he didn’t know about after getting the bronze ancient lamp? So, this mysterious powerhouse took Ye Chen away after noticing something.
“There’s too little information to deduce the truth. Besides, this bronze ancient lamp isn’t something I can touch at this stage. So, I can only give up on this opportunity temporarily. When I accumulate more free simulation chances and become stronger, I can carry out related simulations to see what happens if I obtained it and didn’t hand it over to that mysterious powerhouse. ”
Wang Ping calculated in his heart.
“I still have five free simulation chances left, I can’t continue to simulate any longer. Otherwise, if a Group Task suddenly appears, that would be troublesome.’
Several minutes later, Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief, collected his thoughts, and muttered to himself.
The next day, early in the morning, Ye Chen woke up and anxiously came to
Wang Pings door, wanting to ask if Wang Ping was willing to accept him as an apprentice. However, he was too nervous to do so, so he could only wait anxiously.
All of a sudden, the door was opened, Wang Ping appeared before him, making Ye Chen’s eyes light up.
“There is no fate between us, so I won’t accept you as a disciple. However, if you work hard in your cultivation, I believe you can join the Sword Spirit Sect and become a disciple of the Sword Spirit Sect on your own.”
Wang Ping responded while looking at Ye Chen.
This kid would eventually make his way to the Sword Spirit Sect, he’d better just give him some encouragement.
“l will definitely work hard! ”
Hearing Wang Pings words, Ye Chen looked disappointed at first, then immediately clenched his fists with determination, voicing his resolve with high spirits.
“Hmm.”
Wang Ping nodded without saying anything more, directly left the Ye i s family and flew into the sky.
The Ye Family Master was informed that his son hadn’t been accepted as a disciple, which left him very disappointed. However, all he could do was sigh.
In the end, his son was still the young master of a minor family and couldn’t catch the eye of of big shots like Wang Ping.
However, for people from small families like theirs, obtaining so many resources from such a big shot like Wang Ping was already a great opportunity. They could no longer ask for more.
Once Wang Ping returned to the Sword Spirit Sect, just as he was about to deal with some affairs, leaving some cover-ups and bid farewell to the Supreme Elders of Sword Spirit Sect, he heard a familiar voice.
“Ding! Detecting that a group member, Wang Shuqi’s world has shown some weirdness. Group Task Publishment: Eliminate Bizarreness. This group task is compulsory, with five participants. The acting group master must quickly select five group members for the group task. If no decision is made within ten minutes, the system will randomly draw five group members to participate in this group task and be transported to the world where group member Wang Shuqi is..”

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The third group task! (Seeking monthly ticket support!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 89: Bronze Ancient Lamp! The third group task! (Seeking monthly ticket support!) _3
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping was stunned.
That was really an unexpected development…
Two months had passed without any newcomers joining the group. And then, a Group Task suddenly popped up.
Moreover, the Group Task was in Wang Shuqi’s world, the newcomer.
This guy had just escaped from the primitive forest and entered human society, living a miserable life working odd jobs. Now, unexpectedly, a Group Task appeared – this was simply misfortune upon misfortune.
“It’s true that we should save more free simulation chances. Otherwise, it would be dangerous when a Group Task comes.”
Soon, Wang Ping came back to his senses, no longer mocking Wang Shuqi, but sighing instead.
Fortunately, he still had five free simulation chances left, and he hadn’t used them all up.
Otherwise, this Group Task would likely lead to a life-or-death crisis.
After all, he wouldn’t think that just because his strength has improved a bit, he could easily handle the Group Task.
He was strong enough during the previous two times, but he still died many times in the Life Simulator.
Unpredictability is unreasonable. Even if you’re strong, you can’t be careless.
However, this also included the fact that he had been staying in other worlds and couldn’t accumulate free simulation times.
If he could accumulate free simulation times in other worlds, he wouldn’t be so worried.
Then, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and entered the chat group.
At this moment, all the group members in the chat group were blown away.
Wang Shuqi (74): “My God, I just got rid of my identity as a savage not long ago, and now there’s a Group Task? Do you really have to toy with me like this, damn it!’
Qin Tian (77): “Wang Shuqi’s mental state has collapsed… Well, anyone would if they were in his situation. After being a savage for several months, escaping to the city almost got him caught; after escaping, he ended up working as an illegal laborer, even more miserable than Wu Jun. To make matters worse, he found out that his world is not an ordinary world, but a dangerous High
Martial World… Now there’s a Group Task, all I can say is, it’s too miserable.”
Liu Mei (15):
Fang Yun (3): “Wow, I feel like you’re even more ill-fated than me…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “It’s not an illusion. This kid simply deserves a beating, even more than you.”
Zhang Hu (5): “I’m speechless. I haven’t even gotten the Forbidden curse scroll yet. After all, it’s not something that can be obtained easily. So, I’m considering whether or not I should participate in this Group Task.”
Zhang Jun (70): “…Anyway, I’m not afraid of death. Count me in this time. Although, last time 1 was completely a side character.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Ahem, I was a side character too. I guess I won’t join this time as well. If my strength doesn’t improve, I feel like I’ll always be useless.”
Liu Mei (15): “As I said before, I’m sure I’ll only hold you guys back, so I won’t go.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Well, with both Mr.Cai and Mr.Zhang not participating, it seems there won’t be enough people.”
wu Jun (20): “…l always feel like this time, someone will be randomly selected.’
Chen Yao (71): “l have a lot to deal with here, and the Demon Emperor could appear at any time, I probably won’t be able to leave.”
Fang Yun (3): “Fine, it seems we really have to draw lots. Sigh, I hope I’m not the one selected. I’m such a noob that I’ll only slow you guys down.”
Qin Tian (77): ‘
For a moment, the atmosphere in the group was somewhat depressing.
Knowing how dangerous the two Group Tasks were, even with Wang Ping – a powerhouse who could foresee the future – leading them, they still faced a considerable risk of being wiped out. Everyone in the group, except Zhang Jun, who had almost gone crazy in the Zombie World, had become timid.
Even Cai Yonglong was no exception.
Of course, there was another reason for this: the rewards and the risks were not proportionate.
Without strength, they could only risk their lives for a basic income, hardly an inspiring prospect for them.
Wang Ping, looking at the group members’ comments, raised his eyebrows a bit.
He understood their timid behavior.
After all, the previous two Group Tasks allowed the group members to fully understand just how dangerous the tasks could be and how lucky they were to complete them at all.
None of them believed that they would have such good fortune every time.
In fact, even Wang Ping, if he could avoid participating in the Group Tasks, would not want to participate.
After all, he had already achieved what he wanted.
The Golden finger was optimized, and he had bought the Rebirth tally.
To collect enough Group points to buy a second Rebirth tally or optimize the Life Simulator, a large amount of points would be needed, which couldn’t be accumulated in just one or two Group Tasks.
Unfortunately, he was now the acting group master and had to participate in the Group Tasks.
This was the responsibility and obligation that came with gaining authority and advantages.
Wang Ping: “Since, except for Zhang Jun, everyone else doesn’t want to participate in the Group Task, let’s use the random selection mode.” Wang Ping also chimed in, saying the sentence directly.
For a while, everyone in the group was silent, quietly praying that they wouldn’t be the unfortunate ones to be chosen.
Soon, the chat group’s automatic lottery was finished.
“Ding! The selection is complete. Congratulations to Group Members Liu Mei
(15) and Qin Tian (77) for participating in this Group Task.”
As the system prompt in the chat group appeared, the group became lively again.
Liu Mei (15): “Why did it have to be me…
Qin Tian (77): “Damn it, I’m so unlucky!’
Fang Yun (3): “Let’s take a moment to pity Miss. Liu. Also, Qin Tian, you must have been showing off too much and reaped your karma. Amusing.jpg.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “I feel the same way. I always thought this guy showed off too much and would have bad luck eventually. Now it seems that’s really the case.”
Zhang Hu (5): “I’ll mourn for you for three seconds. By the way, don’t worry too much. Maybe this time there’s no danger, and big brother Wang can easily carry us. Amusing.jpg.”
Wu Jun (20): “The group suddenly became lively… That’s too real. Anyway, good luck to you guys. Ultraman praying.jpg.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Sigh, mixed feelings really. I actually want to go, but my strength isn’t enough.”
Chen Yao (71): “I could help out, but everyone knows the situation in our world, so I can only say I’m sorry…”
Zhang Jun (70): “We knew this day would come sooner or later… But I don’t care, I’ll just die if I have to..”

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 90: The Strange under the Spotlight!
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 90: The Strange under the Spotlight!
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “In that case, the participants for this task will be me, Zhang
Jun, Liu Mei, Qin Tian, and the local Wang Shuqi.”
After saying this, Wang Ping filled in the task list and prepared for teleportation.
However, before teleporting, Wang Ping pondered whether or not to pay for another simulation to strengthen his own power.
In the end, Wang Ping chose to give it up.
Last time during the Group Task, it took five free simulations to barely pass.
As for now, he only had five free simulation attempts left, which might not guarantee a perfect pass.
If he counted the paid simulation attempt, the success rate would be even higher.
Compared to the increase in strength from a paid simulation, the simulation attempts were more precious.
After all, in the face of such strange things, strength is important, but the information brought by life simulation is even more crucial.
Anyway, in other worlds, he could choose rewards after paid simulations.
Moreover, compared to the increased strength, the importance of his hidden cards was even greater.
Only by advancing his cultivation to the Spiritual Fetus Realm could he undergo a qualitative change, surpassing the effect of a single strike from ancient jade.
Soon after, Wang Ping disappeared from the Sword Spirit Sect.
As the light flashed, Wang Pings vision became clear again, and he found himself in a dark alley.
In front of him was none other than Wang Shuqi.
At this point, Wang Shuqi was dirty and disheveled, living a hard life.
Soon, another light appeared, and the ordinary-looking Liu Mei and the cold-faced Zhang Jun also appeared.
In addition, Qin Tian, wearing a blue robe, also appeared in front of everyone.
“Meeting in such a way is quite complicated,” Qin Tian sighed after looking at the others, and finally turning his gaze to Wang Ping.
“I’m sorry for making everyone meet here. However, 1 was just working a shitty job, and I could only run to a place like this in a short time to avoid attracting attention.
Wang Shuqi said helplessly.
()This landing point was probably the worst one in the group’s history.
“It’s alright, the landing point isn’t important, you don’t have to worry about it. After all, your situation is quite difficult too.”
Wang Ping patted Wang Shuqi on the shoulder, comforting him.
Wang Shuqi’s life was indeed tough, and although some group members had provided him with cultivation skills, he still couldn’t practice under his current circumstances.
First, it was because this world had no Spiritual Energy.
Second, Wang Shuqi didn’t have the energy to cultivate right now.
Some people had suggested giving Wang Shuqi some money through selling gold, silver, and jewelry, but Wang Shuqi had refused.
The reason was that he wasn’t familiar with this place and was an undocumented immigrant, so it was dangerous for him to pawn valuable items.
It had to be said that he was really too straightforward.
“Mr.Wang, we meet again,” Liu Mei said to Wang Ping with mixed feelings.
“Yes,” Wang Ping shook his head and told her, “Miss. Liu, you don’t need to worry, this time I will also try my best to lead everyone to survive and pass.”
“I really can’t accept being addressed as sister by you,” Liu Mei said with a bitter smile, “You should just call me by my name in the future.”
“Alright,” Wang Ping shook his head and said nothing more.
Since he became the leader of the group, and his strength far surpassed the other group members, they couldn’t treat him with the same friendly attitude as before.
“Zhang Jun, your strength seems to have improved a lot. Now, you should be able to deal with a half- step Transcendent Realm cultivator,” Wang Ping sensed Zhang Jun’s aura and praised.
“If I didn’t become stronger fast, I would have died long ago,” Zhang Jun said gloomily, even more depressed than before.
“That’s true,” Wang Ping nodded.
Zhang Jun’s world was dangerous, and zombies mutated rapidly. However, the danger was also accompanied by opportunity, and his strength increased rapidly thanks to the Crystal Stones in the zombies’ bodies.
Of course, he was only strong in terms of raw physical prowess, without any other means.
“Qin Tian… you’re cultivating quite quickly, aren’t you? What’s your cultivation level now?”
Wang Ping finally looked at Qin Tian with a strange expression in his eyes.
He could sense that Qin Tian’s current energy intensity wasn’t weak.
However, the two of them were fundamentally different, so he couldn’t know
Qin Tian’s specific cultivation level.
“Foundation Establishment Early Stage.”
Qin Tian coughed lightly, clasped his hands behind his back, and pretended to be nonchalant.
“….” Liu Mei’s face twitched slightly.
This guy had only been in the group for a few months, and he had quietly cultivated to the Foundation Establishment Stage. Wasn’t his speed a bit too fast?
What happened to the slow cultivation speed of the so-called cultivation system?
“Foundation Establishment Stage, huh? Your master must have given you a lot of good stuff,” Wang Ping nodded, not surprised by Qin Tian’s answer.
A late-stage Primordial Infant old monster as his master, coupled with Qin Tian’s own uniqueness, it was normal for him to have such a rapid cultivation increase.
However, this guy always liked to show off, truly making him want to punch him.
“Indeed, he gave me a lot of good things. This time, I should be able to help a bit. ”
Qin Tian grinned, but he didn’t reveal any information about the trump cards his master had given him.
Wang Ping didn’t ask him about it either.
After all, if it came to a dangerous situation, this guy would immediately use his trump cards, considering his fear of death.
If his underpants were useful, he would probably remove them without hesitation.
“Alright, this is not the place for talking. Let’s find an appropriate place for our conversation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 90: The Strange under the Spotlight! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 90: The Strange under the Spotlight! 2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping glanced at the flow of people outside the alley and spoke.
“Hmm.”
Hearing this, Liu Mei, Zhang Jun, and Qin Tian nodded in agreement.
As for Wang Shuqi, he looked somewhat embarrassed at his own clothes.
“Qin Tian, cast a spell on him to clean him up. Then change into a new set of clothes.’
Wang Ping sighed helplessly, taking out a suitable robe from his Storage Ring.
“Also, do the same for me since the smell of blood on me is too strong.”
Zhang Jun also looked at Qin Tian.
Qin Tian’s face twitched.
Damn, they are treating me as a tool, aren’t they?
“Mr. Wang, you should be able to do it too, right?”
Qin Tian stared at Wang Ping in frustration.
“My cultivation skill is of the Fire Attribute, do you think I can do it?” Wang Ping glanced at Qin Tian and spoke calmly.
“Alright.” Qin Tian sighed and could only use his Mana to cast two
Water-Attribute spells.”
“Cultivation Realm spells, huh? Interesting.”
Wang Ping scanned Qin Tian with his Spiritual Sense, his eyes flickering as he muttered to himself.
I wonder if he can cast spells using Spiritual Essence.
At any rate, if Chen Yao’s world Tao Skill isn’t used by a Taoist with Mana, it won’t work.
He was initially somewhat disappointed, but he added it to his knowledge base, maybe he can use it to create new Cultivation Skills or Martial Arts in the future.
“Mr. Wang, can you please stop scanning me with your Spiritual Sense? I’m a man, not into that sort of thing.”
Qin Tian’s face twitched again, complaining.
“As expected of a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator, your perception is quite sharp.”
Wang Ping withdrew his Spiritual Sense, not feeling embarrassed, and said with a smile.
In his world, those in the Spiritual Origin Realm couldn’t detect his Spiritual Sense, yet Qin Tian did. This just showed the difference in Cultivation Systems.
In terms of strength, Qin Tian at the Foundation Establishment Early Stage might not be a match for someone in the Spiritual Origin Realm, but when it comes to means, he had a lot more to offer, including his Spiritual Sense.
“l feel like you’re making fun of me, but I have no evidence.”
Qin Tian was speechless.
Soon, Wang Shuqi and Zhang Jun finished washing and changed their clothes.
The few of them left the alley together, attracting a lot of attention and turning many heads.
Even some bold girls blushed and approached Wang Ping to ask for his contact information.
After all, after Wang Ping and Qin Tian embarked on the cultivation path, their temperament changed quite a bit, truly giving off a celestial vibe.
Especially Wang Ping, after reaching the Transcendent Realm, the transformation of his life level caused his temperament to change drastically. His appearance became more handsome as well.
One could say that, with deep cultivation, there are no ugly men or women.
Each time they break through a Great Realm, their life level increases, and their appearance gradually becomes more refined and their temperament more ethereal.
At this, Qin Tian wanted to use some spells to lower their presence, but Wang Ping stopped him.
“This is the High Martial World, it’s not that simple. Don’t recklessly use your abilities or draw the attention of this world’s transcendent sectors,” Wang Ping warned.
“At the moment, we know nothing about this world or where strange things might be hidden. If our abilities are exposed, it could be dangerous.”
“Alright…”
Qin Tian was startled, then nodded.
“But, don’t you feel like we’re already attracting enough attention as it is?” Immediately, Qin Tian’s face twitched again.
It’s hard not to attract attention with so many people dressed in something similar to Hanfu walking down the street.
“It’s true that we’re attracting attention, but they might just think we’re cosplaying,” Wang Ping calmly said, leaving Qin Tian speechless.
Indeed, he had heard some people exclaim how handsome their cosplaying as ancient people was.
“However, do you have any money? Going to a café or a similar place to chat without enough money to pay the bill is troublesome. If we use jewelry and the like, it will certainly stand out. But discussing saving the world and such in a park is kind of embarrassing, don’t you think?”
Qin Tian couldn’t help but complain again.
“Dude, we came to this world to be saviors. As a savior, what’s wrong with having a free meal? You can just use some spells to erase their memory, no big deal. Or you can seduce a waitress with your charm and have her pay the bill.”
Zhang Jun looked at Qin Tian and grinned.
“Get lost!” Qin Tian’s face darkened, giving Zhang Jun a glare.
“Who said we’re going to a café?” Wang Ping said exasperatedly; “Please, we don’t know anything about this world yet. Of course, we need to go to places like Gaming Hotels to search the internet for basic information about this world before taking any action.”
Qin Tian fell silent, having nothing more to say.
Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian with a strange expression.
This guy, he isn’t just lucky and likes to show off, but also dumb, right?
For a moment, Wang Ping had an overwhelming feeling of intellectual superiority, yet he forgot that when he was still an ordinary person, his intelligence was just average.
“By the way, do you know any soul-searching spells?”
At this moment, Zhang Jun suddenly spoke up.
“Although soul-searching could cause irreversible damage to ordinary people, as long as we target wrongdoers, there’s nothing to feel guilty about. It’s like getting rid of a menace to society.”
“No, I don’t know.” Qin Tian rolled his eyes: “How many spells do you think 1 can learn in just a few months after transmigrating and improving my cultivation to the Foundation Establishment Stage?” “You have a point.” Liu Mei nodded in agreement.
“Tsk, so you’re just a pretty face.”
Zhang Jun clicked his tongue.
Qin Tian’s face twitched slightly, unable to retort..

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 90: The Weirdness Under the Spotlight! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 90: The Weirdness Under the Spotlight! _3
Translator: 549690339
Niana, he really didn’t know many.
Of course, when it comes to Mana Instruments, that’s another story.
Soon, using Qin Tian’s mana, the five people successfully hypnotized the attendant at the eSports hotel and arrived in a five-person private room.
It must be said, Qin Tian is definitely not a regular guy; he indeed possesses a hypnosis-type mana spell among his few mana abilities.
After all, ordinary people would learn basic magics like the Fireball Skill, right?
As for the strange looks from everyone, Qin Tian simply pretended not to see them.
Apparently, the previous conversation thickened Qin Tian’s skin by many times.
“Ah, eSports hotel… brings back memories.”
Looking at the five computers in the eSports hotel, Zhang Jun spoke with a complicated expression.
“Indeed, I miss it.
Wang Ping also briefly touched the computer, chuckled with a nostalgic look in his eyes.
Before crossing over, playing at an eSports hotel with some friends, losing all night, such memories are still fresh in his mind. Indeed, those were some of the rare moments of happiness.
“Eh, there is even ‘League of Legends’ on it. It seems this world is also a Parallel World, not a world similar to Earth.’
Wang Shuqi turned on a computer and spoke excitedly.
“So, how about a game?”
Wang Shuqi rubbed his hands, eager to play.
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping, Zhang Jun, Liu Mei, Qin Tian all twitched the corners of their mouths.
Do you still have the mood to play games? Your heart is really big.
Besides, brother, even though we can book a room, do you have an account?
It’s as if this world is the same as before we crossed over.
Seeing Wang Ping and others staring at him with speechless expressions, Wang Shuqi scratched his hair awkwardly and fell silent.
“All right, it’s time to start collecting information. Our time is precious. If we waste a day, we might miss the opportunity to clear the level.”
With a sigh, Wang Ping sat in a chair and started to type on the keyboard.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Jun, Qin Tian, Liu Mei, and Wang Shuqi all felt the urgency and began to take action.
Thus, five ‘braggart travelers’ were holed up in an eSports room using ordinary computers to collect data, preparing to ‘save the world’. If anyone found out, they would probably laugh to death.
After a long while, Wang Ping stopped what he was doing and squinted his eyes.
The expressions of the other people also changed, their eyes were peculiar.
“What a peculiar world.”
Qin Tian murmured, frowning.
“Yes, quite an absurd world.”
Wang Shuqi also couldn’t help but speak.
“Clearly it is a world full of crises, yet why is the entertainment industry so prosperous. ”
Liu Mei also murmured incredulously.
“Weird, too weird.’
Zhang Jun also frowned, doubting the authenticity of the information collected online.
Wang Ping didn’t speak, staring at the computer, he shook his head, and said: “…Indeed, it’s quite absurd.”
This world is the High Martial World, where the strong could have authority to burn mountains and boil the sea. Just in terms of power, the Martial Master, who is the limit of this world’s battle power, seems not weaker than a cultivator from the Transcendent Realm. Moreover, there are quite a few of them, with fifteen of them on the surface alone.
And humanity is not without enemies.
In this world, various kinds of Ferocious Beasts exist, posing a severe threat to human safety.
Therefore, humans and ferocious beasts often fight and kill each other.
In the war between the two, humans can’t take advantage of anything.
Because the number of ferocious beasts is numerous, the number of king-tier ferocious beasts comparable to human martial masters is also more than that of humans.
If it weren’t for the human side gaining technology from an alien civilization, and the strength of Lin Zhan, the strongest martial saint of the human side, greatly superior to martial masters and king-tier ferocious beasts, even the Ferocious Beast Emperor is not his opponent, I’m afraid humans would have been exterminated long ago.
However, against such a backdrop, humans do not place a particularly high emphasis on martial arts and technology.
What they value the most is actually culture and entertainment, the celebrities.
In this world, celebrities have a status far higher than martial artists.
And the world-class singers, their status is even higher than the martial masters.
Especially Xia Ruobing, who is known as the World’s Number One Singer, has a large number of fans, killing both men and women, whether they are male martial masters or female martial masters, they are all her fans.
Even Lin Zhan, the strongest martial master in the world and the guardian deity of mankind, is a fan of Xia Ruobing, and has even publicly expressed his fanaticism for her.
This is ridiculous.
The social atmosphere of such a world makes Wang Ping unable to imagine how human beings in this world survived under the threat of ferocious beasts, it seems too unusual.
“The elements are too diverse. I don’t even know what to critique.” Qin Tian said with a contorted face, pointing to the picture of Xia Ruobing found online. “I admitted that this woman is really beautiful. Even our Holy Land’s Holy Woman is merely on par with her. But for a single woman to make everyone in the world go crazy, and all martial masters are obsessed with her, it’s too bizarre.’
“l had a bad record before and didn’t know much, but I do know about Xia Ruobing… I just didn’t think she’d be such a sensation.”
Wang Shuqi also spoke silently.
“The saying ‘entertainment unto death’ used to be a metaphor. But when it came to this world, it became a reality.”
Liu Mei sighed.
“Mr. Wang, what do you think?” Zhang Jun’s gaze flickered, looking towards Wang Ping.
“As Qin Tian said, it’s too bizarre, isn’t it?”
Wang Ping laughed softly and spoke up.
“It seems our mission target this time doesn’t require us to exhaust our efforts to find it. She’s there, under the spotlight, at the most eye-catching spot.” At these words, Qin Tian was startled at first, then quickly caught on.
“Damn!” Qin Tian muttered: “Right, I was stupid. This kind of situation is abnormal no matter how you look at it… It’s normal for one person with the willpower to become a martial master to be obsessed with her, but it’s absolutely abnormal for everyone to be obsessed. Only something peculiar could make this happen.”
“Great! It looks like we’ll complete this mission quite easily!”
Wang Shuqi said excitedly.
“Whew…” Liu Mei also sighed in relief.
The reason why the previous two missions were so dangerous was because they didn’t know the peculiarity, and it took several uses of the ability to predict the future to find him out.
This time there’s no need to search, it’ll surely be much easier.
“Mr. Wang, old rules?” Zhang Jun looked at Wang Ping and said.
“Yes, since we know the basic information and the probable peculiar target, let’s use the ability for a try.”
With these words, everyone started to look forward with anticipation.
Wang Ping didn’t waste words, closed his eyes, and silently said in his heart:
“System, I want to perform a new free simulation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger!
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, the host has four free simulation chances remaining.”
The system’s voice rang out, and the luminescent screen appeared, with familiar text floating into view.
[Day 1, you began your mission, continuing to investigate the intelligence. When night fell and all was quiet, you and Qin Tian went to Xia Ruobings location to make your move.]
[Qin Tian directly took out an Array Plate that could hide one’s aura, covering the luxurious mansion where Xia Ruobing was. However, this action was still detected by Xia Ruobing and the Martial Master guarding her. You ended up fighting with her Martial Master guardian.]
[The Martial Master was very powerful, but you were even more powerful, defeating them in just a few moves. Xia Ruobing saw this scene, showing no sign of fear and instead looked at you with great interest.]
[Then, you felt a strange power entering your mind, and your body began to become immobilized, while you started developing strong feelings for Xia
Ruobing. Sensing the anomaly, your face changed drastically, and you hesitated no further, activating Berserk State to remove this influence.]
[After entering Berserk State, Xia Ruobings influence on you didn’t weaken in the slightest. Horrified, you knew that the woman before you was truly bizarre and that she either possessed a Conceptual-Tier Ability or was on a higher level than you.]
[No matter which possibility it was, you knew that everyone was in danger. In fact, you were already about to become her fanatic fan.]
[The next second, you felt your fondness for Xia Ruobing increase again, and you could no longer make a move on her.]
[Not only you, but even Qin Tian exhibited a similar reaction. Afterward, you both apologized to Xia Ruobing, feeling extremely guilty. Xia Ruobing, however, gently said she didn’t blame you and asked why you were attacking her and where you were from.]
[You hesitated for a long time before finally yielding due to your overwhelming fondness for Xia Ruobing and telling her only the basics. Xia
Ruobing was amazed and asked you to bring Zhang Jun, Wang Shuqi, and Liu
Mei to her.]
[At that point, Zhang Jun, Wang Shuqi, and Liu Mei similarly became Xia
Ruobings fanatic fans, with extremely high admiration for her.]
Upon reading the simulation content, Wang Pings face changed.
This Xia Ruobing was truly bizarre.
Moreover, this ability was too overpowered.
Even when he activated Berserk State, he surprisingly couldn’t break free from her ability.
Could it be that just by seeing her or exchanging a glance, people would develop a strong affinity for her?
If that were the case, it would truly be disgusting.
Of course, there was another possibility: her strength was far above his own.
In some sense, this was even more dangerous…
With a bizarre ability, one could find ways to avoid it.
But if her strength was higher than his, then killing her would become a headache.
Now, everyone saw Wang Pings face change drastically and couldn’t help but feel uneasy.
Zhang Jun and Liu Mei, who had completed missions with Wang Ping before, clenched their fists nervously.
After all, the fact that even the current Wang Ping was so unsettled meant that this mission was far more dangerous than they had imagined.
However, nobody talked, not wanting to disturb Wang Ping. They anxiously waited for the outcome in silence.
[Later, Xia Ruobing found Liu Mei, Zhang Jun, and Wang Shuqi’s appearances to be too ordinary and dismissed them. However, because you and Qin Tian had outstanding looks and temperament, she didn’t mean to expel you and hoped you would become her bodyguards.]
[You and Qin Tian were thrilled and chose to agree.]
“Is she really a face-connoisseur?”
Wang Ping had just calmed down and was now somewhat speechless.
[After that, you and Qin Tian followed Xia Ruobing, protecting her all the time. With your own eyes, you saw that the world’s development of entertainment became increasingly prosperous, and the fans grew more and more fanatic.]
[At the same time, your affection and Qin Tian’s for Xia Ruobing increased daily, becoming utterly infatuated.]
[One year later, even when ferocious beasts attacked the city, powerful martial artists still disregarded everything to attend Superstar Idol concerts. In the end, cities were destroyed, and people died.]
[However, even when cities were annihilated and people perished, nobody seemed to care. They continued celebrating.]
[As time went on, more and more cities were destroyed.]
[Five years later, when Xia Ruobing held her final concert, humanity’s last city was breached by ferocious beasts, and humankind was wiped out. You were killed and devoured by the monsters during the celebration, unable to even feel pain. Due to the Rebirth tally, you revived but still remained in a berserk state, unable to break free. Consequently, you died again.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ended.]
“This ability…”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and fell silent.
Even after reviving from death, he couldn’t break free from her ability. This truly was a bug-like power.
“Mr. Wang, what happened?”
Zhang Jun, though already aware of the results, couldn’t help but ask.
“What else could have happened? We were effortlessly wiped out. Moreover, this wipeout was rather humiliating..”

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger! _2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping rubbed his brow and spoke helplessly.
“Uh…
Hearing this, everyone was taken aback.
Afterward, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate and explained everything.
“This…
When they finished listening, everyone looked at each other speechlessly.
Well, this bizarre phenomenon seemed open, but it was still difficult to deal with.
This ability to turn people into her fanatic fans willing to die for her at will is simply perverted.
And they had no idea what the triggering conditions for the opponent’s ability were.
Could it be eye contact?
Or just being seen by the opponent would work.
Or even if just seeing her through a luminescent screen would be effective.
“l think that her ability is effective even through a luminescent screen. Otherwise, the whole of humanity wouldn’t be so crazy about her.”
After a moment of silence, Liu Mei spoke up.
“l think so too, after all, she couldn’t have seen the entire human race. But we can still think about it more carefully.”
Wang Ping nodded, his eyes flickering, and said.
“Perhaps the condition for her ability to work through the screen is to feel good about her, or to have feelings of admiration, worship, or fanaticism. However, the effect of her ability through the screen may not be so obvious, but it may change subtly.”
“That makes sense. That also explains the purpose of creating such an entertainment-to-death atmosphere.”
Qin Tian stroked his chin and nodded.
“In addition, I’m still thinking about whether her ability has other secrets.”
Wang Ping gazed deeply and spoke deeply.
“For example, the more fanatical her fans are, the stronger she becomes.”
“If that’s really the case, then we’re in trouble.”
Zhang Jun fell silent for a moment and shook his head with a bitter smile.
“After all, the bizarre phenomenon we encountered in the last Group Task was that humans or demons got stronger after death. Even so, it was still tough to deal with. It’s hard to imagine how powerful she has become if fanaticism causes her to be stronger.”
“On top of that, all the martial artists and ordinary people in this world are her bootlickers. This combat power is too terrifying. In other words, being her enemy means being the enemy of human beings in the whole world.”
Listening to Zhang Jun’s words, Qin Tian, Wang Shuqi, and Liu Mei all fell silent.
No one thought that the bizarre phenomenon, which was openly displayed, would be so difficult to deal with. If they fought against it, they would be up against the whole world.
They could barely be considered the “saviors,” but they found themselves in a strange situation.
“The possibility that she is more potent when her fans are more fanatical is relatively low. ”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment and shook his head.
“If that were the case, she would instead become the savior of this world, protecting all humanity, rather than wiping them out.”
“Um… You’re right when you put it that way.”
Qin Tian touched his chin and nodded.
“Based on intelligence analysis, her ability makes everyone feel good about her. And the closer you are to her, or the more she sees you, the more likely you are to quickly turn into her fanatical fan, full of good feelings for her, making it impossible to attack her.”
“However, it’s not like we would become her servants and obey her unconditionally. At first, it’s just an extremely high-level of good feeling that develops into obsession, being willing to die, and even reach the point where people would not react to ferocious beasts devouring them just to watch her concert, completely becoming insane.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered as he analyzed silently.
“That’s why she first took control of the high-Tier humans and Martial Masters to create an entertainment-to-death societal atmosphere, leading to everyone’s downfall and ultimately their destruction.”
“Although we’ve figured out the cause and effect, how do we break the game?”
Qin Tian sighed helplessly, feeling frustrated.
“Attacking her directly, only if successfully assassinating in an instant, otherwise we will become her fanatical fans and ultimately die under her
Pomegranate Skirt. To be honest, it’s too difficult.”
“Indeed, the difficulty is very high, and we still need to collect more intelligence.” Wang Ping rubbed his brow and said, “So, we have to continue using the Golden Finger.”
“Wait a minute, Mr.Wang, how many more times can you use it?”
At this time, Zhang Jun suddenly asked.
“Four or five times, 1 think.” Wang Ping replied.
“Four or five times… That’s a lot less than last time.” Zhang Jun sighed.
“l can’t help it. I also had to use my ability in the Profound World. I couldn’t save it all the time. Of course, this time mainly because 1 didn’t expect the
Group Task to come so quickly.”
Wang Ping was somewhat helpless as well.
In order to become stronger, he had spent too many free simulations to explore the path.
It seemed that he should save more in the future.
If there were not enough Spiritual Stones, free simulations couldn’t be wasted unlimitedly either.
“Alright.” Zhang Jun had nothing else to say.
“Actually, I have a guess, and I don’t know if it’s right or not.”
Then, Zhang Jun spoke again.
“Let’s hear it.” Wang Pings eyes sparkled, and he became interested.
“This Xia Ruobing may not necessarily be the bizarre phenomenon. Perhaps the strangeness is hidden even deeper. The world turned into an entertainment-to-death atmosphere because of the bizarre phenomenon, but it doesn’t necessarily mean Xia Ruobing is involved. I just thought of a contradiction in the timeline.’
Zhang Jun took a light breath, his eyes flickering, and solemnly said. “This world has been experiencing a strange phenomenon of entertainment prosperity starting 25 years ago. And Xia Ruobing is only 20 years old…”
“Thinking about it that way, it doesn’t seem right. Entertainment began to prosper, and Xia Ruobing hadn’t been born yet..”

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 91: Terrifying Ability! Qin Tian’s Golden Finger!_3
Translator: 549690339
Liu Mei also frowned, sensing that something was wrong.
“There’s some truth to that, we seem to have jumped to a conclusion too soon and missed the issue of time.” Wang Ping said, stroking his chin.
“But, it cannot be denied that Xia Ruobings is the biggest problem. Because her behavior is very strange. Besides, you also forgot one thing. The strange person could be possessed. Maybe Xia Ruobings body wasn’t the original host.’
“Uh, that makes sense.” Zhang Jun frowned, with nothing to say.
“In any case, we have to continue the simulation. I hope this time, we won’t waste it.” Wang Ping sighed lightly and closed his eyes again.
Seeing this, the others closed their mouths, not wanting to disturb Wang Ping.
“System, I want to start a new free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, the host has three free simulation chances left.”
The system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, after a thorough analysis, you start to act. However, you didn’t intend to do it yourself, as it was too risky. After finding Xia Ruobings residence, you decide to let Qin Tian use the power of Ancient Jade and Chi
Clan Blood Essence to bomb her from the sky.]
[As for whether it would affect innocent people and cause massive casualties, you can’t control it anymore, If you don’t kill the strange person, not only some innocent people, but the entire world would be doomed. More importantly, you yourself would die.]
[With the terrifying strike from Ancient Jade, the entire city began to tremble, and countless people died under this blow. Xia Ruobings mansion was bombed into dust and no longer existed. The Martial Master protecting her also died without a complete corpse.]
[However, something shocking happened. Xia Ruobing didn’t die. Or rather, her vital signs had disappeared entirely in your perception, but she came back to life, naked.]
[The moment Qin Tian saw her, he developed a strong goodwill towards her, and this goodwill was increasing rapidly. At the same time, he began to regret and resent the fact that you made him do such a thing and blamed you for letting him commit such an atrocity.]
[You were speechless. knowing that he was beyond salvation. You tried to kill him to prevent the news from leaking out. However, Qin Tian’s hidden power was beyond your expectation. He not only relied on powerful mana instruments to withstand your pressure but also used an Array Plate to launch a fierce attack.]
[This attack was strong enough to rival the strike from Ancient Jade. Even you were shocked and were killed in the strike. After being resurrected with the Rebirth tally, you quickly fled.]
[Qin Tian snorted coldly, very displeased by your escape. He shamelessly came to Xia Ruobing, apologized, feeling guilty, and disclosed all your information.]
[Upon learning the information, Xia Ruobing was astonished and began to gather her forces to search for you.]
[Zhang Jun and Wang Shuqi were unfortunately found and killed by Xia Ruobings fanatic fans. Liu Mei, using her ability to change her face, escaped capture. Instead, she gained a following because of her beauty.]
[You were also being hunted. A group of powerful Martial Saints chased you down. Moreover, humans also used the Laser Cannon, a weapon capable of annihilating Martial Saints and ferocious beasts.]
[Although you were powerful and defeated the pursuing Martial Saints, you still couldn’t escape and were eventually caught by the strongest martial saint,
Forest Battle.]
[Forest Battle was unexpectedly strong, reaching the level of Spiritual Fetus Realm, and not an ordinary one. Although you cultivated a Heaven-tier Skill and had peerless combat power, you still fell short against the Spiritual Fetus Realm.]
[In the end, you died under Forest Battle’s blade.]
[Because of your death, this life simulation ended…]
“Is this strongest martial saint Forest Battle really so powerful?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
He originally thought it would be easy to kill the World’s Martial Saints, but it turned out he was a bit too optimistic.
Though this simulation also ended with a wipeout, it had gained more information.
“How about it? Wiped out again?”
Zhang Jun looked at Wang Pings frown and asked.
Although it was a question, he already had the answer in his heart.
“Yes, wiped out.” Wang Ping nodded.
This made everyone’s faces even heavier.
Two simulations, both were wiped out, and the key was that no breakthroughs
were found.
“Qin Tian, you hid it well, having such a trump card. I was even killed by you once.” Wang Ping patted Qin Tian’s shoulder and said with a curl of his mouth.
“Cough cough, I barely begged for it from my master. It’s extremely precious and can only be used once.”
Qin Tian was a bit embarrassed.
“You’re lucky, both you and Zhang Hu have good masters.” Wang Ping shook his head and sighed, “It seems like you should be able to help us a lot in this mission.”
“Bro, can you stop hinting at me? This thing has my imprint on it, only I can use it..”

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 91: Terrifying Power! Qjn Tian l s Golden Finger! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 91: Terrifying Power! Qjn Tian l s Golden Finger! _4
Translator: 549690339
Qin Tian said with a bitter face.
“When did I ever hint at that?” Wang Ping rolled his eyes and looked at him disdainfully, “You’re really narrow-minded.”
Qin Tian’s forehead was full of black lines.
What he just said seemed like a hint anyway.
After all, during the last mission, Zhang Hu handed over the Forbidden Curse Scroll, and it was because of the great effect of the scroll that they were able to complete the mission more easily.
“Mr.Wang, don’t bother with Qin Tian, that narrow-minded poser. Let’s just continue analyzing the information.”
Zhang Jun chuckled and said.
“How am 1 narrow-minded?” Qin Tian’s face twitched.
“Indeed quite narrow-minded.” Liu Mei softly murmured.
“Uh…” Wang Shuqi opened his mouth, unable to say anything.
He seemed useless here, and really couldn’t interrupt the conversation, so he just shut up.
“You need to understand.” Zhang Jun glanced at him, stopped smiling, and said calmly, “This mission will probably not be simpler than the previous two. We have already used two precious opportunities. If you still don’t cooperate and reveal all your trump cards, so Mr. Wang can think about how to use them to get more information, it will be really dangerous.”
“…” Qin Tian fell silent. It made some sense when he put it like that.
However, besides the Killing Formation and the life-saving talisman, he really didn’t have any helpful items for the mission.
The key point was, his master really gave him these two things, and they were sealed so that only he could use them.
Especially the life-saving talisman, it could only be activated automatically when his life was in danger.
As for the other things, what use were the Mana Instruments belonging to a Foundation Establishment Early Stage cultivator? Their power was not even as strong as Wang Pings casual strike.
In the end, he was just a little cultivator at the beginning of the Foundation Establishment stage, not some Doraemon.
“Zhang Jun, you went too far. If he had something useful, he would have taken it out already.” Wang Ping shook his head and said.
Qin Tian was very careful about preserving his life at this point, so there was no way he would hide something from them. Thus, Wang Ping didn’t feel there was anything wrong with him.
“Mr.Wang truly understands me.” Qin Tian was moved to tears.
He was almost wrongly accused, even more so than Dou E.
“Right, Zhang Jun, you called me narrow-minded, but you haven’t mentioned your Golden finger since joining the group. Maybe your Golden finger can be as useful as Chen Yao’s?”
Then, as if remembering something, Qin Tian glared at Zhang Jun and said.
At these words, everyone’s eyes were fixed on Zhang Jun.
Frankly, they were quite interested in his Golden finger.
This guy was always mysterious and has never said anything about it.
“You’re acting like you’ve already told us yours.” Zhang Jun looked at Qin Tian and sneered, “How about this, if you tell us your Golden finger, I’ll tell mine.
That way, we’re even.”
Zhang Jun’s words made Wang Ping feel a bit strange.
This was really killing a thousand enemies while harming 800 of your own. However, Wang Ping did not intend to stop him, as he had always been curious about the other members’ Golden fingers in the chat group.
After all, Golden fingers were the biggest secrets of the transmigrators, so careful and scheming people would hide them well.
“Fine, I’ll tell you, I’m not afraid of you.” Qin Tian said disdainfully, “My Golden finger is the Immortal Tao Fruit. Before becoming immortal, my cultivation will not have any bottlenecks. As long as I have enough spiritual energy, I can quickly become an immortal.”
As soon as Qin Tian’s words fell, Zhang Jun, Wang Shuqi, and Liu Mei were all stunned.
That was quite the Golden finger, the Immortal Tao Fruit. Although it might not be a big deal in the future chat groups, it was amazing right now.
With the Immortal Tao Fruit, one was guaranteed to become an immortal.
Damn, immortals in the Cultivation Realm were known for their longevity. As long as they were not killed, they could live forever.
Moreover, the power of an immortal was formidable.
“You lucky bastard.” Wang Pings eyes looked strange, and he exclaimed.
Starting with the Immortal Tao Fruit as his Golden finger.
What it it gets upgraded( Would it turn into something like an Immortal King Golden finger?
Even if the first upgrade wasn’t that crazy, reaching the level of a Golden Immortal should be no problem, right?
Thinking about it this way, Qin Tian’s cultivation speed might not necessarily be slower than his own.
Maybe one day, Qin Tian!s strength could even surpass his own.
Transmigrators in the chat group were not simple characters. One must not take it for granted that the Life Simulator is the strongest.
Chen Yao’s Point Addition System was also overpowered. With enough resources, she could reach the transcendent tier within a month.
It was just that Chen Yao’s world didn’t have many resources, and her demonstrated power level didn’t seem high enough. Otherwise, Chen Yao would be considered an overpowered character as well..

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 92: Liu Mei l s Debut! The Secret of Her Abilities!
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 92: Liu Mei l s Debut! The Secret of Her Abilities!
Translator: 549690339
However, Wang Ping didn’t think lightly of Chen Yao, thinking she would be limited.
After all, this is just the current situation. Who knows what will happen in the future?
Chen Yao with the Point addition system, as long as she doesn’t die in the future, her growth potential is undeniable.
“I’ve finished talking, now it’s your turn. What is your Golden finger?” At this moment, Qin Tian looked at Zhang Jun, his gaze burning.
This also caused Wang Ping and the others to turn their attention to Zhang
Jun.
“My Golden finger is quite ordinary, just pure Mental Power.”
Zhang Jun sighed and silently activated his ability.
In an instant, the teapot on the table floated.
“Uh… It’s indeed quite ordinary.”
Looking at this ability, Qin Tian’s gaze became subtle, and he muttered.
“So there’s not much to say.” Zhang Jun didn’t mind Qin Tian’s mutterings and shrugged.
“Mental Power is indeed a bit ordinary compared to those special Golden fingers. But, is it weak? That’s not necessarily.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
As seen in many novels, Mental Power has a lot of potential for growth and can be greatly developed.
Optimizing it in the future might bring a pleasant surprise.
“Whether it’s weak or not, it’s inevitable that I can’t help right now.”
Zhang Jun sighed.
Having left that world full of zombies, danger, and boredom, he felt relaxed, like a normal person.
At the same time, he was no longer as cautious as before, no longer hiding everything.
Anyway, life and death were no longer that important, so there’s no need to care too much.
“It’s not like you’ve been helpful the last two times.” Qin Tian sneered.
“You’re really holding a grudge, huh?” Zhang Jun said helplessly.
“There’s no point in talking about this. Let’s continue discussing how to break the game.”
Wang Ping spoke up to prevent them from continuing their war of words.
This attracted the attention of the four of them.
“Judging from the information we have so far, we absolutely cannot fight directly. It won’t end well. The martial skill of this world is much stronger than we thought.”
Zhang Jun also changed his expression and said solemnly.
“That strongest Martial Master has the power to kill Mr. Wang head-on. It’s too dangerous. And the technological power of this world can’t be underestimated.’
“The Native Combat Power of this world is secondary to me. What I’m most concerned about is why Xia Ruobing can resurrect?”
Qin Tian frowned and said solemnly.
“If we don’t figure out the principle behind her resurrection, it’s too difficult to break the game.”
“That’s right…..”
Everyone, including Wang Ping, frowned and fell into deep thought after hearing this.
Being able to resurrect was indeed a bit too unfair.
Without finding her weakness, it’s difficult to kill her thoroughly.
And as long as they couldn’t kill her instantly, they would either become bootlickers under her Pomegranate Skirt or be hunted to death.
“There’s not enough information, so it’s impossible to figure out the principle behind her resurrection ability.”
Several minutes later, Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“Compared to this unsolved mystery, the other two places are more intriguing.”
Everyone looked at Wang Ping, their eyes flickering, and Liu Mei whispered, “You mean Qin Tian’s behavior seems different from last time, and that I can gain fans through my appearance?”
