“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded, “The first time in the future, we were still influenced by Xia Ruobings ability, but still had a strong sense of self. We would still struggle with whether to tell her our secret. It was only after time that we completely fell.”
“This time, Qin Tian became infatuated too quickly, instantly turning into a fanatic bootlicker of Xia Ruobing. He didn’t hesitate to attack me for her sake. Moreover, this was without her issuing any orders.”
After saying this, Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian.
“Why are you looking at me?” Qin Tian’s face darkened, “You better not say that my mental fortitude is weak and that seeing her exposed body made me completely infatuated. Besides, bootlicker, that sounds too harsh!”
“l didn’t say anything.” Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian with a strange expression.
“You haven’t said it, but you want to, right?” Qin Tian’s face twitched.
“l bet he got infatuated after seeing her exposed body. This guy seems like he’s never touched a woman.’
Zhang Jun smirked, his expression malicious.
“Who the hell is inexperienced? I had a few girlfriends before crossing over. Besides, I had a bunch of juniors at the Divine Capital chasing after me!” Qin Tian was a little bit angry.
Zhang Jun was just so annoying that if it weren’t for his weaker abilities, Qin Tian would really want to show him what his Mana Instruments were capable of.
“l feel like you two have that friend with a grudge type of vibe.” Wang Ping was speechless, “You’ve only spoken a few words and you’ve already started quarreling. ”
“Who is friends with him?” Qin Tian twitched his face, “l wish 1 could chop him up.”
“Tsk.” Zhang Jun clicked his tongue.
If it weren’t for the fact that Qin Tian’s abilities might surpass his in the future, Zhang Jun would want to continue verbally sparring.
He had been in the Zombie World for too long, and his spirit was somewhat damaged. If he didn’t vent, he might have problems.
“Perhaps, starting with the fans is a way to break the game.”
Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to Qin Tian’s rebuttal and continued to talk about the main topic.
“Since Miss.. Liu can turn Xia Ruobings fanatical fans into her own, making them stop trying to kill us, what would happen if she took all of Xia Ruobings fans?”

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 92: Liu Mei’s Debut! The Secret of Her Abilities! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 92: Liu Mei’s Debut! The Secret of Her Abilities! 2
Translator: 549690339
“It’s necessary to try. However, it’s quite difficult. Before we find out how to kill Xia Ruobing completely, we can only keep a low profile, not appear in her sight, and probably not even see her with our own eyes, or else we will develop strong affection for her. Under such circumstances, if we let Liu Mei act alone without anyone protecting her, she could easily die miserably.”
Zhang Jun frowned and spoke.
“No matter what, we have to give it a try. After all, we don’t have any better methods, do we?”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
His words silenced the four of them, and the previous lively atmosphere vanished once again.
Everyone was feeling a bit heavy-hearted.
“Mr.Wang, it seems like you’ve missed a detail.”
At this moment, Wang Shuqi, who had been silent, hesitated for a moment and spoke.
“Oh? What detail?”
Wang Ping looked at Wang Shuqi.
“In the second future, you didn’t obsess over Xia Ruobing… At that time, did you choose not to look at her, or did she not see you? Or did you check the information with your Spiritual Sense?”
Wang Shuqi took a deep breath and asked the questions that had been on his mind.
Upon hearing this, Wang Pings eyes flashed slightly, and he fell into deep thought.
That’s right, this detail seemed to be overlooked.
What was the situation with him during the second simulation?
He chose to give the Ancient Jade and Chi Clan Blood Essence to Qin Tian, letting Qin Tian act. It showed that in the simulation, in order to prevent being affected if the assassination failed, he took such action.
But, in the simulation, was he seen by Xia Ruobing? Or did he see her? This was crucial information.
Qin Tian first sensed Xia Ruobings aura and was astonished.
It seemed that he hadn’t been affected by her ability at that time.
Then, Qin Tian saw Xia Ruobing appear naked, got affected instantly, became obsessed, and turned against him.
It seemed that using Spiritual Sense to sense the aura wouldn’t be affected by the ability.
Besides, whether Xia Ruobing saw him when Qin Tian turned against him was another question.
If she did see him, it meant that he wouldn’t be affected by her ability if she looked at him, but only if he looked at her would he be affected.
If she didn’t see him, the situation would still be uncertain, but more information could be collected through simulation. “This detail is quite crucial, and may save one or two uses of my ability.” Wang Ping showed a smile and said to Wang Shuqi.
Hearing this, Wang Shuqi scratched his head, also smiling: “Glad I could help you, Mr. Wang.”
“Alright, I’ll continue to use my ability now. “Wang Ping nodded his head and didn’t say much more, closing his eyes again.
“System, I want to use the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated. There are two remaining simulations for the host.’
The sound of the system rang out, and the luminescent screen appeared with familiar text floating up.
[Day One, you begin planning Liu Mei’s debut and take action. After acquiring the identity of this world through unconventional means, you control an entertainment company and start building momentum.]
[Your actions proceed very smoothly. Liu Mei, relying on her Golden finger ability, maximizes her beauty, making her so stunning that even you have your heart beating fast and almost thought you fell for her.]
[As for Qin Tian, Zhang Jun, and Wang Shuqi, they were even more unbearable, truly infatuated with Liu Mei. Only after Liu Mei lowered her beauty did they return to normal, cursing in their hearts. After adjusting to her beauty multiple times, you gradually got used to it and were no longer affected by Liu Mei’s top-notch appearance.]
[Then, Liu Mei also revealed an unknown side of her. It turned out that she was also a well-educated young lady Before crossing, proficient in Guqin, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, only her looks were rather ordinary.]
[Half a month later, Liu Mei’s concert began. You lurked in the shadows, protecting her. Her concert went very smoothly. In the face of absolute beauty, Liu Mei’s talent became secondary.]
[As a result, after this concert, Liu Mei became famous. Everyone who saw the concert was amazed by her beauty and took her as their goddess in their hearts, surpassing Xia Ruobing. At the same time, on the Internet, Liu Mei’s appearance caused a heated discussion among the world. Everyone knew of her existence, and they were all amazed by her beauty.]
[You are all astonished by this outcome. You didn’t expect the process to be so smooth. Although it’s not yet at the point where Liu Mei has surpassed Xia Ruobing and taken all of her fans, it’s undoubtedly a good start.]
[However, you didn’t let your guard down. Instead, you became more cautious, preventing Xia Ruobing from hurting Liu Mei behind the scenes.]
[But to your surprise, Xia Ruobing didn’t make a move in the face of Liu Mei’s strong rise. She let Liu Mei continue to gain popularity.]
[On Day 31, relying on her stunning beauty, Liu Mei had taken more than half of Xia Ruobings fans, replacing Xia Ruobings position and becoming the
World’s Number One Singer. You couldn’t help but lament, ‘Beauty is justice,’
‘This is indeed an era where looks matter.’ ]
[However, although Liu Niei became the world’s number one singer, she discovered something strange. She found that ever since she started to become popular, Xia Ruobing had not tried to win back her fans, and hadn’t held another concert.]
[On Day 32, Xia Ruobing suddenly came alone to meet Liu Mei. You were all shocked by her sudden attack, and your expressions changed.]
[Zhang Jun and Wang Shuqi, due to seeing Xia Ruobing, became her ardent fans. Meanwhile, you and Qin Tian have been using Spiritual Sense as your eyes since the action began, never revealing yourselves, narrowly escaping the calamity.]
[You are sure of one thing: using Spiritual Sense won’t be affected by abilities.] [Then a surprising thing happened. Although Liu Mei faced Xia Ruobing, she wasn’t influenced by her ability and didn’t become her fan.]
[You couldn’t help but wonder whether it’s because her beauty surpasses Xia Ruobings that she’s immune to her influence, or if it’s because she has more fans than Xia Ruobing.]
[However, there was no time for you to think too much, as you had to take action now. Otherwise, Zhang Jun and the others might have revealed you due to their infatuation with Xia Ruobing.]
[Of course, you still kept your cool and decided to let Qin Tian act first. You suppressed Zhang Jun and the others with your pressure, allowing Qin Tian to make a move and continued to test Xia Ruobings ability. Qin Tian closed his eyes and jumped out to sneak attack Xia Ruobing.]
[The moment Qin Tian leaped out, Xia Ruobing looked at him. Then he became her hardcore fan and started to scold you.]
[You learned one thing: as long as you’re seen, you’ll be affected by her ability.
As a result, you chose to wrap your entire body with the Power of Five Elements to prevent Xia Ruobing from seeing you. At the same time, you didn’t choose to flee but tried to attack her, intending to gauge her strength.]
[A shocking thing happened. When Xia Ruobing saw you, you weren’t affected by her ability. At the same time, your casual attack directly killed her.]
[However, Xia Ruobing resurrected quickly after her death, and Wang Shuqi died mysteriously. After witnessing this, you understood some things.]
[Xia Ruobing can come back to life because her death allows her fans to take her place. In other words, she can resurrect continuously as long as her fans are still alive.. Only when all her fans are dead can she die for good!]

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 93: Annihilation of All Humanity! The Cold-Hearted Zhang Jun
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 93: Annihilation of All Humanity! The Cold-Hearted Zhang Jun
Translator: 549690339
[After guessing Xia Ruobings resurrection ability, you feel extremely terrified and chilled by this power. Instead of choosing to leave, you decide to continue attacking Xia Ruobing, hoping to probe some more information.]
[You only exert the power of the 1st Tier of Spirit Origin and attack Xia Ruobing. Facing such power, Xia Ruobing still has no decent resistance and is killed by you.]
[Fortunately, you’re relieved. As long as Xia Ruobing isn’t strong, there are ways to deal with her. Besides, if they have the information, perhaps Qin Tian alone can kill her.]
[Soon, Xia Ruobing is resurrected again, and the price is the mysterious sudden death of Zhang Jun. You have another solution in your heart: fans closest to Xia Ruobing will most likely become substitutes for death.]
[Just as you kill Xia Ruobing again, Qin Tian gets angry and throws out a Killing Formation, wanting to attack you. You’re utterly speechless and hold nothing back, intending to kill Qin Tian. You’re well aware that he’s beyond help.]
[But just as you strike down Qin Tian, a protective garment appears on his body, blocking your attack. At the same time, the Killing Formation is activated, trapping you inside. You become speechless, never expecting Qin Tian to turn into an unreliable teammate.]
[Next, you use Ancient Jade and Chi Clan Blood Essence to counter the Killing Formation, trying to break it. The collision of two terrifying forces destroys everything, completely annihilating the entire metropolis.]
[Depending on the secret skill of Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, you strengthen the earth attribute Spiritual Essence to defend against the terrifying impact caused by the collision of these powers. But you fail, as the clash of powers strong enough to severely injure or even kill someone at Perfect Spiritual Embryo Realm is not something you can block.]
[You die — and so does Qin Tian in the explosion — dying without even leaving a trace. His protective garment couldn’t save him. As for Liu Mei, the situation is pretty clear. As ordinary people, they’re the first to die.]
[However, due to the rebirth tally, you come back to life again. However, right when you revive, Xia Ruobing sees you, her eyes deep and melancholic as she sighs.]
[Because Xia Ruobing sees you, she uses her Charm Skill on you, and you instantly become her bootlicker.]
[Subsequently, the incident in the metropolis causes a sensation. However, as long as Xia Ruobing explains that it was caused by ferocious beasts attacking the city, nobody doubts her. They secretly hate the beasts’ cruelty, daring to attack Xia Ruobing and Liu Mei, causing Liu Mei’s tragic death and Xia
Ruobings near-death experience.]
[At the same time, everyone is grateful to you for saving Xia Ruobing, treating you as a hero and valuing you above even the strongest martial saint Forest Battle in their hearts.]
[In the time that follows, there is not much change in the world.
Entertainment thrives, and with Liu Mei e s death, Xia Ruobing becomes the World’s Number One Singer again, holding various concerts until several years later, humanity perishes.]
[As for you, you die during the final concert. Before your death, you receive a kiss from Xia Ruobing.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
“Still dead, but at least I figured out all of Xia Ruobings details and found a way to break the stalemate.”
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief, feeling much more relaxed.
However, he thought about the content of the last simulation.
The plot that followed was the same as in the first simulation, but there was a difference.
Why did he receive a kiss from Xia Ruobing?
It was really strange.
If there was any difference, it was that he killed Xia Ruobing a few more times.
Could it be that killing her somehow gained her strange affection?
“Strange,” Wang Ping murmured to himself.
“Mr.Wang, what’s wrong?”
Seeing Wang Ping relax and show an incomprehensible expression, Qin Tian, Zhang Jun, Liu Mei, Wang Shuqi, and others all became nervous.
“Nothing, I’ve found a way to break the stalemate.”
Wang Ping came back to his senses and smiled at everyone.
“To be honest, I didn’t expect it to be this simple. Maybe, as long as you know the information, even Qin Tian alone might have a chance to finish her off.”
“But this guy is really good at digging pits for others. He turned into an unreliable teammate again and killed me once.
“Uh…” everyone was both surprised and confused.
Then, Wang Ping glanced at Qin Tian and smacked his lips.
Wang Ping never thought he would die repeatedly by the hands of his own teammates one day.
This guy’s trump cards were really powerful.
“Uh…” Qin Tian was stunned again, facing the strange gaze of the others, feeling awkward.
Damn it, what had he done again?
Then, without further delay, Wang Ping recounted all the simulation content.
“Good guy, worthy of being Qin Tian. His trump cards are specifically used to attack his own people.”
After listening, Zhang Jun pursed his lips.
“Besides, this kid really has some good stuff hidden. One life-saving trump card after another is super vicious.”
“…..” Qin Tian’s face twitches, unable to retort.
Although he made a minuscule, negligible contribution this time, it didn’t amount to much compared to his mistakes.
Killing Wang Ping repeatedly was indeed embarrassing.
If he had temporarily given his trump cards to Wang Ping, there wouldn’t have been this problem, and they might have cleared the level directly..

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 93: Annihilation of All Humanity! The Cold-Hearted Zhang Jun_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 93: Annihilation of All Humanity! The Cold-Hearted Zhang Jun_2
Translator: 549690339
“Mr. Wang, I think it would be better not to let this guy participate in the mission when we take real action, so as to avoid any possible trouble.”
Zhang Jun suggested.
“Makes sense.” Liu Mei t s gaze also became strange.
In this world, no one could threaten Wang Ping, not even the strongest Niartial Master Forest Fight, as long as Wang Ping uses his trump card, he can kill him.
As a result, the one who poses the greatest threat to Wang Pings life is Qin Tian himself, which is quite ironic.
“…Having great power, but being a hindrance is a first, I guess.” Wang Shuqi chuckled and commented.
“Heh, I feel like this kid will be laughed to death by the group members.” Zhang Jun said gleefully: “Let’s see if he still dares to show off.”
Qin Tian felt ashamed.
“Stop teasing him.” Wang Ping smiled and shook his head: “Without Qin Tian, we might’ve needed twice the simulations to understand everything.”
Although Qin Tian screwed things up twice by killing him, he was able to follow orders and risk his life to test Xia Ruobings ability each time, which was a major advantage.
Despite seeming terrified in the past, he was obedient in critical moments and didn’t let the team down.
Of course, Wang Ping still thought that if possible, it would be better not to carry any trump cards in the future, so as not to accidentally kill his teammates.
“Mr. Wang…” Seeing Wang Ping speaking up for him again, Qin Tian was so touched that tears welled up in his eyes, and he couldn’t help but want to hug Wang Ping.
“Let’s get down to business.” Wang Ping was disgusted by Qin Tian’s reaction and quickly diverted the topic by clearing his throat: “As usual, let’s analyze the information.’
“Xia Ruobings ability has been basically confirmed. If we use spiritual sense and avoid showing her our true selves, we won’t be charmed. On the contrary, just by being seen or seeing her with the naked eye, we’ll be charmed.” “Her power is not strong, only equivalent to Innate battle Skills.”
“Her resurrection ability is very abnormal—she will die, but her fans will take her place. So, to completely kill her, we might have to kill all her fans or even eradicate humanity.”
“Liu Mei, who has a higher appearance value than Xia Ruobing, is not affected by the charm. It is suspected that if one has a higher appearance value or more fans, they won’t be affected.”
“Finally, what is her purpose for coming to see Liu Mei alone?”
Wang Ping looked around at everyone and shared his thoughts.
“As long as we know the principle of her charm, we can basically avoid it.”
Qin Tian spoke up first.
“As Mr. Wang said, maybe I really can take her down by myself.”
“Give it a rest, Wang Ping just said it casually, and you took it seriously. Even if you really have a chance of success, it wouldn’t be more than 10% ”
Zhang Jun rolled his eyes and sneered.
“To kill Xia Ruobing, you have to kill all her fans and exterminate humanity.
Can you do that? Also, she has a Martial Master protecting her.”
“Who says I can’t? As long as I use my trump card, 1 can kill the Martial Master, and then…
Qin Tian was unconvinced and spoke up.
However, his voice weakened in the end.
“And then what?” Zhang Jun said with a mocking smile: “You keep killing Xia Ruobing? I think you’d get tired before that. Besides, Xia Ruobing has Innate battle Skills herself. Without your trump card, it’s questionable whether you can defeat her, let alone kill her multiple times.”
“Even if she really doesn’t resist and you manage to abduct her, are you sure you can get away with her? Don’t forget the ferocious beasts in this world.
Everyone will chase you like crazy.”
“And I doubt if the ferocious beasts can be charmed. If they can be charmed…
the outcome, oh dear…”
Zhang Jun’s words, like sharp knives, pierced Qin Tian’s heart, leaving him red-faced and unable to refute.
These things had crossed his mind halfway through his speech, which was why he choked.
“Sigh, Qin Tian can’t handle it. It’s difficult for Mr. Wang too. Are we really going to exterminate humanity?”
Liu Mei frowned and sighed.
Honestly, even if she had the power to do it, she couldn’t bear the weight of killing billions of people.
Without taking such action, though, she couldn’t think of a way to deal with Xia Ruobing.
After all, Xia Ruobing wouldn’t die as long as her fans lived on.Killing her over and over again was simple; all they needed to do was throw Xia Ruobing into the depths of the barren sea.
With the terrifying pressure beneath, even with Xia Ruobing’s Innate battle skill, she would be crushed to death repeatedly, infinitely reviving and dying, until all of humanity ceases to exist.
But this method of accomplishing the task was too cruel.
“We don’t necessarily have to do that.” Zhang Jun shook his head. “Don’t forget, after you made your debut, in just a month, you took away most of her fans. Although they are ordinary fans and likely haven’t been charmed by her personally, it’s enough to greatly weaken her power.”
“As long as we take away all the ordinary fans, it would shorten the number of times we have to kill her. At that time, at most, several hundred thousand people will die.”
“But, should we really do this? Among those who can be charmed by her may be ordinary people, but the vast majority are martial artists of this world. And I believe, most of the mid-and-high-tier combat skilled martial artists in this world have been charmed by her…”
Qin Tian also stopped feeling awkward and said with a heavy face.
“Once these people die out, when we leave, it’s the end for the people of this world as well. Those ordinary people, even if they aren’t killed by us, will be eaten up by the ferocious beasts.”
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere at the scene became heavy.
“What does that have to do with us?” Zhang Jun also put away his joking and mocking attitude, his expression becoming cold and stern, just like before.
He said coldly, “We are just travelers passing through this world. If we don’t complete the task, we’ll die. So, I don’t care about other people’s lives. What I care about are our lives, that’s all.’
“Zhang Jun, you…are you really that cold-blooded!?”
Qin Tian’s eyes widened, and he straight up grabbed Zhang Jun’s collar, roaring angrily.
“Cold-blooded? Perhaps.” Zhang Jun calmly looked at Qin Tian and spoke softly, “But in my heart, the weight of other people’s lives indeed cannot compare to my companions, no matter if the number is tens of thousands, millions, or even billions.’
“You!” Qin Tian felt a chill in his heart.
“Qin Tian, if you don’t want to be beaten by him, better let go of him.”
Wang Ping finally said something.
Upon hearing this, Qin Tian’s face changed and he eventually released Zhang Jun, turning his head away and no longer looking at him.
People with different beliefs cannot work together.
“Zhang Jun, I appreciate your thought of putting your companions first.” Wang Ping looked at Zhang Jun and chuckled, “But you seem to have forgotten, Wang Shuqi is also a person of this world. Once the human martial artists of this world are wiped out, Wang Shuqi will also be buried with them.”
As these words came out, the silent Wang Shuqi looked at Wang Ping with gratitude in his eyes.
And Zhang Jun was also taken aback, then shifted his gaze to Wang Shuqi.
Because Wang Shuqi didn’t have much of a presence, he overlooked this point.
But if sacrifices truly needed to be made to complete the task, he would still unhesitatingly choose to do so,
He wasn’t familiar with Wang Shuqi, the newcomer, and didn’t talk much.
However, Wang Ping was different.
Wang Ping saved his life and was his benefactor, holding the heaviest weight in his heart.
Moreover, Wang Pings life was more valuable than anyone else’s.
Not to mention the lives of strangers from other worlds, even the lives of anyone in the chat group were not as precious as Wang Pings.
If something happened to Wang Ping, once new tasks emerge, maybe the group members would die.
The current group members would die, and future ones would die as well.
Group tasks were always dangerous. Without Wang Pings Golden Finger, the difficulty to conquer them would be too great. Perhaps others could still lead group members to complete tasks in the future, but there would inevitably be numerous full-team wipeouts.
Even without full-team wipeouts, it would be impossible for them to escape unscathed and minimize casualties every time.
A Golden Finger that predicts the future is a necessary power.
“Yeah, I overlooked him. I can apologize to him.”
Zhang Jun looked at Wang Shuqi and sighed.
“However, I don’t think I said anything wrong. The world is cruel, and the value of human lives is different, with various weights. Some are as light as a feather, while some are as heavy as Mount Tai.”
Qin Tian remained silent, not wanting to look at Zhang Jun.
Liu Mei didn’t speak either. As an old group member who had witnessed the death of many new group members, she agreed more with Zhang Jun’s words, whether it was called selfish or realistic..

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 94: Task Completed
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 94: Task Completed
Translator: 549690339
“Why do you have to act like exterminating the entire human race is necessary?”
Wang Ping held his forehead and said helplessly.
“Is there a better way?” Qin Tian’s eyes suddenly lit up.
“Of course, there is. After all, we haven’t finished analyzing the intelligence.”
Wang Ping sighed, “I think the last piece of information is key.”
“Actually, there really is a better way to handle it.” Zhang Jun spoke up.
“Then why did you say something like that?” Qin Tian looked at Zhang Jun with gritted teeth.
“I was just stating that, in dire situations, we have to distinguish priorities.
That’s all.’
Zhang Jun said calmly.
“We might not need to do that this time, but when our resources are exhausted, if we encounter similar situations in Group Tasks and have to exterminate the entire human race, we have to make choices.’
Qin Tian fell silent.
“Think carefully. As Time Travelers, we can’t be so naive. Our own lives are the most important, and the lives of others have nothing to do with us.”
Zhang Jun sighed and said.
“For example, if we died, how many worlds’ people would die due to strange
or other reasons? Therefore, our lives are more precious. Otherwise, I think you will be in trouble if you continue with your holier-than-thou attitude.” “Kindness is good, but when you gamble with your own life, I have no right to say anything more, and it doesn’t matter. However, this is not just your matter, it’s about the whole team, even all Group members.”
“….” Hearing this, Qin Tian couldn’t say anything.
After careful consideration, he indeed overreacted impulsively without thinking much about the consequences.
Zhang Jun’s words were reasonable, and he couldn’t refute them.
“Zhang Jun, you were a bit too harsh.” Liu Mei whispered, “He’s just a high school student who needs to grow up slowly.”
“Reality won’t give him that much time to grow up. So, he must quickly adapt and see everything clearly. Otherwise, I don’t want him to hurt his teammates.”
Zhang Jun spoke indifferently.
“l was wrong.” Qin Tian smiled bitterly, and in the end, he chose to admit his mistake.
He admitted that he was indeed a bit naive.
“To know your mistake and correct it is a great virtue, a teachable child.”
Zhang Jun patted Qin Tian’s shoulder, finally showing approval.
Wang Ping looked at everyone without joining the conversation.
When the two parties reconciled, and Qin Tian recognized his mistake, he was satisfied with a smile.
In a team, there’s no room for a holier-than-thou attitude.
Although Qin Tian wasn’t exactly a saint, he still needed to correct his train of thought and prioritize the team’s safety and interests during Group Tasks.
“Speaking of which, Mr. Wang, I’m more curious about why Xia Ruobing kissed you at the last moment. I think the hidden information there is also very important.
At that point, Zhang Jun looked at Wang Ping and said thoughtfully.
Liu Mei, Qin Tian, and Wang Shuqi all looked over, their eyes full of confusion and curiosity.
After all, it was very strange that Charm Skill kissed Wang Ping.
“I can’t figure it out. I don’t think Charm Skill has fallen in love with me,” Wang Ping shook his head.
Truth to be told, he was also very puzzled by it.
For a moment, everyone quieted down and began to think seriously.
“Is it possible that this is gratitude?”
Liu Mei finally spoke up after pondering for a long time.
“How so?” Qin Tian looked at Liu Mei and asked.
“Charm Skill can possess other people. When it appeared, Xia Ruobing was not yet born. After Xia Ruobing gained fame, Charm Skill probably possessed her.” Liu Mei said earnestly.
“So when I gained fame, Xia Ruobing, or Charm Skill, did not take action. It was waiting for me to become even more famous and become the new World’s Number One Singer.”
“After I became the World’s Number One Singer, it came to me to possess my body. Because I am even more beautiful than Xia Ruobing, Charm Skill’s ability could reach a higher level and eliminate humanity more quickly.”
“That makes sense. To be honest, I also thought about that.” Wang Ping nodded and shook his head again, “However, it doesn’t seem to have anything to do with why she kissed me.”
Qin Tian, now sober-minded, realized this as well.
If Charm Skill wanted to possess Liu Mei, they could simply kill Charm when it possessed her. There’s no need for all the trouble.
With this in mind, Qin Tian felt annoyed, thinking that Zhang Jun must have realized this early on and just wanted to teach him a lesson.
Even Mr.Wang probably thought of this too but deliberately didn’t say it.
Mr. Wang was probably scared by his performance in the simulation and deliberately let Zhang Jun teach him a lesson to help him grow.
“We’ve been treating Xia Ruobing as Charm Skill, and she is indeed Charm Skill. But we seem to have overlooked one situation. That is whether Xia Ruobing still has her own consciousness and is in a symbiotic relationship with Charm, rather than Charm occupying her body…”
Liu Mei sighed.
“She knew all along what she was doing, and what kind of consequences awaited humanity. So, she really wanted to die, to die with Charm, but she couldn’t. Mr. Wang, your appearance and killing her several times must have made her feel special. That’s why, in the end, she kissed you..”

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 94: Task Completed 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 94: Task Completed 2
Translator: 549690339
“Because at that time, Xia Ruobing might not be mysterious anymore. The mysterious might have already left her body at that moment.”
“In the end, we have never understood what the true nature of the mysterious is. The only thing we can analyze is that the mysterious’ goal is to destroy all of humanity. As for why they want to destroy the humans of each world, it is still unclear right now.”
“Uh…” Qin Tian paused, muttering: “Maybe there really is this possibility.”
“Miss. Liu’s analysis makes sense,” Zhang Jun nodded his head, but then slowly continued: “However, there are also contradictions. If the mysterious’ goal is to destroy humanity, the mysterious from Chen Yao’s world could easily do so, but it didn’t.”
“We can think of it this way,” Wang Ping said with a glint in his eyes, “Destroying all of humanity could be their mission, just like our mission is to eliminate them. After completing their mission, what will happen to them? Will they leave this world like we do? How do they leave, by detaching from the possessed object and directly returning, or by taking the possessed object away with them?”
“Mr.Wang, you mean the mysterious in Chen Yao’s world, their mission can be completed easily, but they belong to the type that can bring their possessed bodies back, so they also want to become stronger, so they did that. This world’s mysterious is different…?”
“l think both ways of leaving can be chosen. It’s just that the mysterious in the Demon World can continuously become stronger, so it doesn’t plan to leave in a short period of time. But the mysterious in this world, its main body is not important, it can just continue possessing in the next world. After all, Xia
Ruobings body is too weak.”
Qin Tian stroked his chin and said.
“We can’t guess the specifics. We can only say that our current speculation is more in line with the current situation. Even so, there are still many loopholes.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
“Anyway, no matter how you look at it, I also think Xia Ruobing might still have her own consciousness, and she is in a symbiotic relationship with the mysterious. This is also the key to solving the mysterious.”
After a pause, Wang Ping continued: “Otherwise, if we want to make a move when the mysterious possesses Liu Mei, it would be too dangerous. If it really succeeds in possessing her and we fail to interrupt it, things will get troublesome. At that point, even if we could use Liu Mei’s ability to lower her attractiveness to its lowest level at the moment of possession and then expose it, causing her to lose a large number of fans, it would be useless. In the end, we would still have to kill Liu Mei.’
Upon hearing this, everyone fell silent.
Indeed. the method of dealing with the mysterious by making it transfer its possession is feasible, but the risk is high.
After all, they didn’t know what the true nature of the mysterious was like, and whether it could be killed during the transfer of the possessed body.
If they fail to kill it midway, then Liu Mei would be in danger.
Liu Mei clenched her fists, her face turning slightly pale.
“Of course, you don’t have to be too nervous. We’ll know if it will really turn out that way, just by looking at the future.”
Wang Ping looked around at everyone and said casually.
“If it really turns out that way, then we can only use a more extreme method to pass this level. Even though doing so might make Wang Shuqi suffer a little, there could still be a way out. On the day of returning, I will take you to a safe place and get some cultivation methods and resources from this world. At that time, whether you can survive or not depends on you. 1 hope you won’t blame me.’
“Mr.Wang, don’t worry about me, I’m fine,” Wang Shuqi said with a simple smile, “This is already the best outcome, isn’t it?”
“Mhm.” Wang Ping nodded and closed his eyes.
Seeing this, everyone else shut their mouths, watching Wang Ping with mixed emotions.
“System, I want to start a new free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Life Simulator is activated, you have one simulation left.”
As Wang Ping spoke, the system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the words began to emerge.
[On the first day, you launched the mission.]
[On the thirty-first day, Liu Mei became the world’s number one singer, and countless people were infatuated with her.]
[On the thirty-second day, Xia Ruobing met Liu Mei alone, and you hid in the dark, sensing everything. Liu Mei was very nervous but tried to remain calm, talking with Xia Ruobing.]
[During the process, Xia Ruobing didn’t show anything strange, she just talked to Liu Mei affectionately, calling her sister repeatedly. You silently watched, with mixed feelings.]
[Suddenly, Xia Ruobing forcibly kissed Liu Mei. Seeing this, you instantly understood that it was a transfer of possession, and you anxiously wanted to use your spiritual sense to sense it all and kill it.]
[However, you found out that you couldn’t feel any abnormal breath from an organism, the mysterious had already possessed Liu Mei’s body. But Liu Mei’s reaction was also very fast, she used her ability to lower her attractiveness the
moment Xia Ruobing forcibly kissed her.]
[Just as you were astonished by Liu Mei’s decisive actions and troubled by what to do next, wondering whether you really had to kill Liu Mei, something unbelievable happened. You received a system prompt that the mission was completed.]
[You were very baffled and didn’t know what happened. You then suspected that the mysterious had failed while fighting over Liu Mei’s body.]
[Soon, Liu Mei gave the answer. It turned out that when the mysterious possessed her body, the group system directly took action and recovered it.]
[Hearing the truth, you fell silent. This mission seemed to be a thousand times simpler than expected. Everything you did before was in vain. All the information you analyzed was useless.]
[After that, you stayed in this world for a while before choosing to leave.][Because of your return, this simulation is over.]
After reading the simulation content, Wang Ping was dumbfounded.
He thought it would be more difficult.
But in the end, it was completed so dramatically?
Doesn’t this mean that even if they didn’t do anything and Liu Mei just debuted, the strange events would happen, and then the task could be completed easily and happily?
On the contrary, his various simulations only complicated the situation.
Although the intel he got was not worthless, in the end, it made things much more complicated.
It seems that the Life Simulator is not omnipotent.
Wang Pings face twitched.
“Mr. Wang, how is it?”
Seeing Wang Pings expression, everyone became nervous.
“…The task is completed.” Wang Ping sighed.
Really!
Hearing this, everyone was overjoyed.
Then, Qin Tian curiously asked: “How did it happen?”
…About that…
Wang Ping rubbed his forehead and explained the simulation content.
” Pfft! ”
After listening to Wang Ping, Zhang Jun, Qin Tian, Wang Shuqi, and Liu Mei were all stunned, looking at each other, doubting their life.
It was completed just like that?
Isn’t this a bit too outrageous?
All four of them felt like they were hallucinating.
“Ah, it can only be said that without me, this task might have been easier to complete. ”
Wang Ping said with a wry smile.
“….” Zhang Jun’s face twitched. This development made him feel like his face was swollen.
After preaching to Qin Tian, this is the result…
Qin Tian looked at Zhang Jun with a resentful gaze.
“What are you looking at? My words can still be useful in the future. This situation is just an exception.”
Zhang Jun said without blushing.
“(V ~)Hmph~~.”Qin Tian curled his lips.
“It’s a good thing that we can complete the task easily without anyone dying.” Wang Shuqi was also overjoyed.
He didn’t want to become a savage again in modern society, dealing with various ferocious beasts and living a life where one could die at any moment.
“Phew…” Liu Mei also breathed a sigh of relief. “It seems that this group task is destined to be credited to Liu Mei.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but laugh as well.
Although his gains would definitely be much less this time, as long as the task could be easily and happily completed, he wouldn’t be greedy..

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 95: Dual Cultivation System!
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 95: Dual Cultivation System!
Translator: 549690339
“Since we already know how to break the situation, let’s take action.”
Wang Ping looked at everyone and spoke.
“Hmm!”
The four of them nodded their heads, eager to complete the task quickly.
In the blink of an eye, thirty-one days had passed.
Liu Mei’s debut went smoothly, just like in the Life Simulator, she became a wildly popular idol, winning over most of Xia Ruobings fans and becoming the World’s Number One Singer.
On the thirty-second day, Xia Ruobing appeared and kissed Liu Mei, attempting to possess her.
Unfortunately, it was undoubtedly a self-inflicted trap, and this eerie being was killed directly by the chat group.
Wang Ping and the other four received a notification from the system.
“Ding, the eerie being is dead, the Group Task is completed, and the rewards have been distributed individually. Group members can claim their respective rewards on the Group Reward Page.”
“Ding, the Group Task has been completed, and all group members can silently chant ‘return’ in their hearts to return to their own worlds. If they do not return within twenty-four hours, the system will forcibly return them to their original worlds.”
Listening to the notification in his mind, Wang Ping revealed a smile.
Although his rewards wouldn’t be too significant this time, there wasn’t much danger, so he considered it a vacation.
Immediately, Wang Ping and Qin Tian couldn’t help but glance at Xia Ruobing.
At this moment, it seemed that the woman had regained control of her body and was staring blankly at Liu Mei. “Miss Liu, thank you for saving me.”
Xia Ruobing said gratefully.
“You still have consciousness? Do you know what you’ve done?”
Liu Mei asked curiously.
“Hmmm… ever since that eerie being possessed me, it’s been doing strange things, and I could only watch helplessly. I’m well aware that if things continued like this, humanity would have been doomed.”
Xia Ruobing said with lingering fear.
“When I was born, it was a time when entertainment was supreme, so my dream was to become the world’s number one singer. When I finally succeeded and was possessed by that eerie being, I saw everything from a bystander’s perspective.”
“l see.” Liu Mei nodded thoughtfully.
“Mr.Wang, she really has her own consciousness. So, in the future you saw, she was indeed grateful to you.” Qin Tian said with a smirk.
“Now, she’s grateful to Miss Liu, and it seems that she’s developed a deep affection for her. Aren’t you regretful?”
“What do I have to regret?” Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
It’s just a woman. Although she is beautiful, it’s not worth dwelling on.
Not to mention, Wang Ping didn’t forget the scenes in the Life Simulator where he was repeatedly vanquished by women.
Women would only affect the speed of his sword drawing.
He, Wang Ping, would never look for a Tao Companion before reaching the pinnacle!
Definitely not.
“Cut, I don’t believe what you’re saying. Which man doesn’t like beauties?”
Qin Tian glanced at Wang Ping with contempt and mumbled.
Wang Ping was speechless and too lazy to argue with Qin Tiana
Next, Wang Ping prepared to leave and do some things he wanted to do.
“Mr.Wang, where are you going?”
Qin Tian asked, somewhat puzzled.
“l want to know if humanity in this world has returned to normal after the eerie beings death. Besides, I want to help Wang Shuqi and get some good things from this world.”
Wang Pings figure had already disappeared, but his voice remained.
Qin Tian didn’t know what to say, so he just stood there stunned.
“Mr.Wang, we’ve completed the mission!”
As soon as Wang Shuqi saw Wang Ping, he said with a smile on his face.
“Hmm.” Wang Ping nodded his head and said, “Wang Shuqi, do you want to become the disciple of the strongest martial saint Forest Battle?”
“Huh…” Wang Shuqi was taken aback.
Zhang Jun, who was standing nearby, also showed a surprised look, glancing thoughtfully at Wang Ping as if guessing his thoughts.
“Of course, I do, After all, in this dangerous world, I don’t want to be a laborer forever.’
Wang Shuqi said with a bitter smile.
“With power comes the ability to protect oneself and the capability to help
Mr.Wang in the future.”
“Since you want to, let’s go find him directly. After all, we can be considered as the saviors of this world. As long as Lin Zhan returns to normal, he will understand what has happened, so it should be quite simple to convince him to accept you as a disciple.”
Wang Ping grabbed Wang Shuqi and flew into the sky, speaking calmly.
The Martial System of this world was not simple. Most importantly, it didn’t require Spiritual Energy to cultivate.
So, Wang Ping wanted to get a hold of it and see if he could cultivate it in the Profound World he lived in.
If he could cultivate it, he would have an additional cultivating system, which might make him even stronger and go further than a cultivator who only practices the Profound World system.
At this moment, the people of this world had all returned to normal due to the death of the eerie being. They recalled the abnormal scenes over the years and felt a chill in their hearts, not knowing why everything had turned out this way.
It seemed as if they had been invisibly controlled by something.
Soon, the martial saints remembered Xia Ruobing and guessed her abnormalities.
For a moment, they all wanted to find Xia Ruobing, to control her or execute her directly.
In the Imperial Capital, the strongest martial saint Lin Zhan was meditating in his villa, with many thoughts running through his mind.
He wanted to find Xia Ruobing but also felt that she was too eerie and couldn’t act rashly. If he were to be mesmerized again, he would be in trouble..

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 95: Dual Cultivation System! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 95: Dual Cultivation System! 2
Translator: 549690339
“Who?”
After an unknown amount of time, Lin Zhan suddenly opened his eyes and shouted. The terrifying Qi and Blood within his body erupted, and his skin turned golden, making him look like a golden man, quite extraordinary.
This was the greatest characteristic of reaching the Martial Master realm, the Martial Master Golden Body.
The defense force of the Martial Master Golden Body was extremely strong, and its recovery ability was equally astonishing.
Therefore, to exterminate a Martial Master, one must be much stronger than their opponent, otherwise, it’s difficult to accomplish.
“No wonder he’s the strongest Martial Master, his strength is indeed formidable.’
Wang Ping landed with Wang Shuqi and gave a slight smile.
“Who are you?”
Lin Zhan narrowed his eyes, staring at Wang Ping.
On Wang Pings body, he sensed some danger, suggesting that the other party had the power to threaten him.
However, Wang Ping gave him a strange feeling. The opponent’s Qi and Blood were not strong, far from reaching the level of a Martial Master, but his body seemed to hide an unimaginably powerful force.
“Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Wang Ping, a traveler from another world. As for my companion here, he is also from another world. However, unlike me, he is a traveler who came to your world, while I came from another world.’
“By the way, we have three more fellow travelers in this world. The current World’s Number One Singer, Liu Mei, is one of our companions and also a traveler. It was her who destroyed the strange creature that had possessed the innocent girl, Xia Ruobing, allowing your world to return to normal.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly, introducing Wang Shuqi and explaining the cause and effect of their presence.
For the past month, he had been learning about this world and investigating the strongest martial saint Lin Zhan’s information.
Lin Zhan’s character was quite bold, and he had cultivated many outstanding individuals, making him a true pillar of humanity.
Without him leading humanity in fighting against the ferocious beasts, humans would have been annihilated long ago.
However, this was also normal. In a world like this, if the strongest human was a cunning and despicable person, humanity would probably have been wiped out earlier.
Even if they weren’t wiped out, they wouldn’t live so comfortably.
Therefore, Wang Ping trusted Lin Zhan.
Although Chen Yao had almost been killed by the treacherous Demon World, that was because the dean was strange and nobody knew about it in advance.
Now that this world had been conquered and many things had been revealed, there was no need to worry about many things.
It should be said that exposing the identity of the travlers from another world brought more benefits than drawbacks.
If Lin Zhan could accept Wang Shuqi as his disciple, the chat group might gain another quite powerful member in the future.
Wang Ping could also obtain more valuable things from this world through Wang Shuqi, making it a win-win situation.
Even if Lin Zhan were short-sighted and had ulterior motives, he wouldn’t dare act recklessly, as the travelers from other worlds were deterrence.
At this moment, Lin Zhan’s pupils constricted violently as he listened to Wang Pings words, revealing a shocked expression.
Even as the strongest Martial Master of mankind, having experienced many storms, hearing such amazing news still made it difficult for him to remain calm.
Five travelers from another world.
Moreover, it was they who had destroyed the strange force and saved him, as well as all of humanity.
Though many times one should not believe a person’s words blindly, Lin Zhan’s intuition told him that this was true.
Because there was no need for the other party to deceive him.
Moreover, the truth of such a matter wasn’t difficult to investigate.
“Travelers from the Exoteric World, on behalf of all the people in our world, I want to thank you for saving us,” Lin Zhan said with a deep breath, his face serious as he bowed deeply to Wang Ping.
Wang Ping stared at Lin Zhan, somewhat surprised that the other party had directly believed his words.
Immediately, Wang Ping didn’t think too much and slowly spoke: “There’s no need to thank us. After all, we came to this world just to complete our task. In addition, I sought you out to clarify our intentions.”
“If there’s anything 1 can help you with, Mr. Wang Ping, just let me know.” Lin Zhan said with a serious face.
“First, I hope you accept Wang Shuqi as a disciple and train him to become a true expert.”
“Second, I need the complete cultivation system information of your world.”
“Third, I need some cultivation resources of your world that can enhance the strength of four people to the level of a Grandmaster.” “Fourth, I need high-end technology information from your world.”
Wang Ping held up four fingers, stating his purpose.
“This is…
Wang Pings words left Lin Zhan stunned.
He had no issue with training Wang Shugi, the traveler, and was actually happy to do so.
He could also achieve the third demand.
Although resources to train a Martial Master were immense and he couldn’t provide them, and resources alone weren’t enough, he could still provide enough resources to train four Grandmasters. Although these resources were precious, they meant little to him.
However, the second and fourth demands, needed careful consideration.
After all, a world’s cultivation system was extremely precious. Wang Ping obviously wanted more than just ordinary cultivation methods; he must have also included advanced cultivation skills and secret skills.
As for technology, it was even more valuable and difficult to estimate in worth.
If used to trade with other worlds through Wang Shuqi and the other travelers, it could potentially change the current state of humanity..

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 95: Dual Cultivation System! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 95: Dual Cultivation System! _3
Translator: 549690339
However, Lin Zhan quickly returned to his senses and couldn’t help but smile.
Trading with Wang Shuqi and other worlds was obviously impossible.
Wang Shuqi and these people were the real partners, and the trading channel was controlled by Wang Ping.
Besides, the difficulty of cross-world trading might be great.
“l can do that. But first, I need to confirm a few things.”
In the end, after pondering for a long time, Lin Zhan nodded his head.
Since the other party had saved him and the entire human race of their world, it was only right to offer a corresponding reward.
Otherwise, it would be a despicable act.
If they made the Transmigrator in front of them dissatisfied, there might be big trouble in the future.
However, if they made the Transmigrator very satisfied, perhaps when their world faced another crisis, the other party would come to help and save them from danger.
“Very well.” Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction, saying meaningfully, “We have already saved several worlds. If your world faces danger again, you can contact me through Wang Shuqi, and 1 will definitely help if 1 can. Of course, you have to offer a corresponding reward.”
“No problem!” Although Wang Ping was drawing a picture for him, Lin Zhan’s eyes brightened a bit, and he nodded with a smile.
Even if Wang Ping was painting a picture, having contact with people from the Exoteric World would be a great thing.
After all, according to the information revealed in Wang Pings words, these Transmigrators could travel to various worlds relatively freely, which is why they could save those worlds.
For this reason, even if Wang Ping really was drawing a picture, he was willing to eat that cake.
After all, the value of being able to contact the Exoteric World is unimaginable.
The resources and power system of the Exoteric World are enough to make people yearn for, and perhaps it can take his martial path to a higher level.
“Glad to cooperate.”
Wang Ping had a smile at the corner of his mouth and reached out to Lin
Zhan.
“Glad to cooperate.” Lin Zhan also stretched out his hand to shake with Lin Zhan, then said generously, “Would you like to come in for a drink? I have some precious wine here, drinking it can enhance Qi and Blood.” “No need, you should have more important things to do now.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
“l can only stay in this world for one more day. And you have to confirm some things too, right?”
“One day?”
Lin Zhan was a little surprised.
However, he didn’t ask much, invited Wang Ping in, had the maid in the villa entertain him, and then went to get busy.
“Brother Wang, you’re really amazing.”
Wang Shuqi sat on the sofa, looked at Wang Ping, and muttered.
This was like blatantly taking advantage of Lin Zhan, the strongest martial saint, yet he agreed so generously. He really didn’t know what the martial saint was thinking.
“What’s so amazing about it? It’s a normal development. It would be strange if he didn’t agree.” Wang Ping casually said, “As the strongest Martial Master, the pillar of mankind, he can’t be short-sighted.”
“Uh, okay.”
Wang Shuqi nodded thoughtfully.
“Brother Wang, thank you for helping me get the chance to become his disciple. ”
Then, with a serious face, Wang Shuqi continued.
“No need to thank me, helping you is also helping myself. Just work hard in the future.” Wang Ping patted Wang Shuqi’s shoulder and encouraged him.
Through this Group Task, he also understood one thing.
Sometimes the tasks of the Transmigrator Chat Group don’t necessarily depend on the strength of the individuals.
Each Transmigrator’s Golden Finger might have an extraordinary effect, and they shouldn’t underestimate their usefulness because of their strength.
Therefore, cultivating Transmigrator partners with good character as much as possible would help them complete tasks better.
Although Wang Shuqi’s Golden Finger was quite ordinary, only enhancing defense, Wang Ping had no intention of giving up on him.
Strengthening defense doesn’t necessarily mean weakness.
This world’s Martial System is quite good. If they can become a Martial Master and forge a golden body,
the Defense of the golden body is already strong, and with the enhanced defensive Golden Finger, Wang Shuqi might be able to become the strongest frontline member of the group one day.
The death rate of Transmigrators in the Transmigrator Chat Group is very high, but if they can survive, Wang Ping believes that none of these
Transmigrators are simple.
“Yes!” Wang Shuqi clenched his fists, his face filled with determination and longing.
This time, he was completely carried along without any presence.
It made him feel awkward and lost.
So, he also wanted to become stronger.
“By the way, Wang Shuqi, how exactly is your Golden Finger’s defense calculated?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, looked at Wang Shuqi, and asked curiously.
“l don’t know.” Wang Shuqi scratched his head and laughed, “l just know that when I am surviving in the wild, no matter what animal I encounter, it can’t break my defense. Oh, right, I also met a giant leopard. I thought it was a leopard, but now it seems to be a ferocious beast. It also couldn’t bite through my skin.”
“Uh…
Wang Pings eyes became strange.
Good guy, as an ordinary person, Wang Shuqi’s skin could resist the biting force of a ferocious beast leopard. Wasn’t this defense a bit too overpowered?
For a moment, Wang Ping had an urge, and said directly, “Wang Shuqi, don’t resist, let me test your defense upper limit.”
This statement made Wang Shuqi stunned for a moment..

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 96: The Mysterious Becomes a Hot Commodity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 96: The Mysterious Becomes a Hot Commodity!
Translator: 549690339
Next, Wang Shuqi willingly didn’t resist, allowing Wang Ping to test his defense upper limit.
Of course, it would have been useless for him to try and resist anyway.
Soon, Wang Ping revealed a shocked expression.
He discovered that using Post-Heaven Realm power, he actually could not break Wang Shuqi’s skin, or shatter the bones inside.
Following that, Wang Ping steeled his heart and directly unleashed Innate Realm power.
As Wang Ping used Innate Realm power, a crack finally appeared in Wang
Shuqi’s skin, and blood flowed out. “Good guy, your Golden finger isn’t simple at all.”
Wang Ping exclaimed in amazement.
update by newn0el .org
Innate Realm power was already impressive; two Innate Realm experts fighting with full strength could easily destroy an entire street.
However, even with such formidable power, it could barely break Wang Shuqi’s skin. This was truly outrageous.
Keep in mind, Wang Shuqi had no actual strength right now; he was just an ordinary person.
If he began cultivating in the future and eventually reached Martial Master-tier, the extent of his defense would be unimaginable.
Wang Ping was very skeptical if he could break his defense after advancing to the Spiritual Fetus Realm.
As expected, any Golden finger should not be underestimated.
A strengthened defense Golden finger might not sound like much, but its true strength was shocking when put to the test.
For example, Liu Mei’s Golden finger could adjust her appearance, it didn’t seem very useful at first, but it played a fantastic role in this mission.
Speaking of this, Wang Ping thought of Zhang Hu and Wu Jun’s Golden fingers.
Zhang Hu only mentioned a name, ‘Knight’s Blessing,’ without describing its specific abilities.
However, the fact that he was noticed and taken as a disciple by the Sword master of their world, and even given forbidden curse scrolls, meant his ability was definitely not simple.
Considering Zhang Hu t s performance, the Golden finger’s ability was most likely growth-oriented.
As for Wu Jun, his case was truly interesting.
Everyone in the group knew about his Golden finger, which seemed quite trash and difficult to mention.
Wang Ping was always curious about what his Golden finger was and what could cause Wu Jun to have such an annoyed reaction.
Of course, Wang Ping didn’t question him if Wu Jun didn’t say anything.
Unless it was a situation like this, in a mission world where they needed to rely on each other’s Golden fingers to complete the group task, he would then ask about it.
“Wang Shuqi, you have a promising future!”
Then, Wang Ping snapped back to his senses, patted Wang Shuqi’s shoulder, and exclaimed.
“Uh…” Wang Shuqi’s face was full of confusion, unsure how strong his Golden finger truly was.
But since Wang Ping didn’t elaborate, he didn’t ask any further either.
After that, with nothing else to do, Wang Ping directly accessed the chat group page.
At this point, the chat group’s page had already exploded.
After the mission’s completion, Qin Tian returned to his world and briefly recounted the details of the mission.
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, was this mission really that easy? I regret not going.”
Fang Yun (3): “I’m astonished that there are missions that can be completed without needing any strength.”
Wu Jun (20): “l never thought Mr.Wang would have a day of laying low and winning,
Cai Yonglong (1): “Could we really consider Mr.Wang’s performance
laid-back? I don’t think so. After all, without foreseeing the future, nobody would have known it would be this easy. When the time came, we would definitely have taken a gamble; it may or may not have happened, with the odds being on the latter. Even if it did happen, we wouldn’t have known about the strange power. If it charmed someone into revealing the identities of the transmigrators, the spirit wouldn’t have possessed Liu Niei.”
Chen Yao (71): “Cai Yonglongs point is quite valid…”
Zhang Jun (70): “To be fair, it’s indeed like that. We can’t overlook Mr.Wangs role just because the mission was easily completed. Without Mr.Wangs Golden finger, who could have calmly completed the group task?”
Liu Mei (15): “Yes, Mr.Wang is always our captain. Without him, no matter what the mission is, it wouldn’t be easy!’
Wang Ping (66): “Hearing you all praising me makes me happy. By the way, what rewards did you all receive?”
Qin Tian (77): “l only got 5,000 group points, so annoying.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Shocking, I got only 1,000 group points. You, who tried to kill
Mr.Wang multiple times, actually got 5,000 group points!”
Fang Yun (3): “Hahaha, I can’t help but laugh at that. Mr.Wang must never have thought he’d be killed by a teammate one day.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “It’s indeed funny. However, what I envy more is Qin Tian, the brat. His Golden finger is so overpowered, he quickly built his foundation and even has a full house!”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Mmp, I’m not saying anything, I’m so bitter.”
Qin Tian (77) @Zhang Jun (70): “What the hell are you bitter about? At least I helped in predicting the future. While you guys went to that world and spent every day picking up girls, I was shocked that you actually received 1,000 group points as a reward. System daddy is too generous!”
Zhang Hu (5): “Good fellow, spending every day picking up girls… I strongly suspect Zhang Jun’s main reason for participating in group tasks is secondary. Going to other worlds to indulge was his true goal. However, betting his life on gambling in exchange for indulging time is truly awesome. l, Zhang Hu, willingly acknowledge you as the strongest in the indulgence world!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “I’m laughing so hard.. Uchiha Itachi’s coffin lid can’t be held down anymore! “

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - Chanter 162: Chanter 06: Becoming a Coveted Delicacy due to Strangeness! 2
chapters.content:
Chanter 162: Chanter 06: Becoming a Coveted Delicacy due to Strangeness! 2
Translator: 549690339
Liu Mei (15): “Well, my reward is somewhat special. Not only did I receive 200,000 group points, but I also obtained an additional ability…This ability is somehow similar to that of the strange one.”
Wang Ping:
Wang Ping was shocked.
Goodness, the strange ability of this world was so outrageous that Liu Mei got it.
With Liu Mei’s golden finger, along with this bizarre ability, she’s definitely going to spiral upwards like crazy!
Not only Wang Ping, but the entire chat group quieted down, all of them gawking in disbelief.
Qin Tian (77): “Holy crap, Miss. Liu got the strange ability? Changing appearances, along with the Charm Skill, it seems like it doesn’t even matter if there’s any real power or not! This is simply becoming a more horrifying existence than the strange one.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “M/ell, well, this is the rhythm of a counterattack. Changing appearances and invincible charm skill, combined with Causality Resurrection Skill…she can charm every strong person she encounters, who could possibly defeat her then.’
update by newn0el .org
Liu Mei (15): “It’s not that outrageous. The ability I got is a crippled version. Although the charm skill isn’t weakened, it can’t work on group members, and it’s no longer a conceptual-tier ability. Strong people might be able to resist it. In addition, the Causality Resurrection Skill has been nerfed, it can only resurrect three times in a day.”
Wang Ping (66): “Even if it’s nerfed, it’s still quite powerful. I have to say, the chat group is really generous.”
Qin Tian (77): “Goodness, you gain three extra lives right away, and it has a cooldown too, not permanently reduced once used. The value of such lives…l’m simply dumbfounded.”
Fang Yun (3): “Darn it, I really want to exchange abilities with Liu Mei.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Why would a man like you need charm?”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn it, Mr. Cai is discriminating against men. I’ll raise the banner of man-fist and knock you down!”
Wang Ping (66): “The topic has sidetracked… What I’m more concerned about now is whether we could do the same in the future. If we can trick the strange one into possessing group members, we might be able to get their crippled version of abilities.’
Upon hearing this, all group members were intrigued.
Goodness, perhaps they could really give it a try. If it works, not only would they make a fortune, but they’d also come up with a new way to complete group tasks.
Liu Mei (15): “Most likely, it’s not possible…This strange one can possess anyone at will, maximizing its abilities, but most of the others don’t have the ability to possess freely. Once they possess someone, they can’t change.”
Wang Ping (66): “That’s unfortunate. However, since it’s only most cases, there should still be a small portion who can. If there’s a chance, let’s give it a shot. The abilities of the strange one are all powerful, far more so than most golden fingers we travelers get. If we can acquire them, we absolutely should.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “l agree! greedilylickslips.jpg.”
Not only Cai Yonglong, but everyone else also got excited.
Damn, this time the group task has proven one point, that accomplishing tasks doesn’t necessarily require great power.
The rewards aren’t just group points, but also potential extra benefits to be gained.
With these two pieces of information, they’ll have the courage to gamble on the next group task.
After all, no one wants to remain a shrinking violet forever; everyone desires to become stronger quickly, it’s just that oftentimes there are no better ways to do so.
Afterward, Wang Ping continued to chat for a while in the group, then stopped paying attention to the chat?fi and opened the red envelope containing his task rewards.
Then, the system prompt appeared.
“Ding! Congratulations, you contributed 50% in this group task and are rewarded with 200,000 group points.”
“200,000, even more than I had imagined. Not bad, not bad.”
Wang Ping nodded with satisfaction.
The life simulator sure is awesome.
Even without any real power or effort, he can still gain a lot of benefits in every group task just by using this golden finger.
Although the extra 200,000 group points are far from being enough for the next optimized golden finger upgrade he needs, Wang Ping won’t disdain it. After all, accumulation makes big things happen.
Half a day later, Lin Zhan managed to get everything Wang Ping needed.
It must be said that it was done quite efficiently.
Wang Ping inspected his acquisitions and found many special cultivation resources.
As for those cultivation skills, they were the highest level energy laws available to humans in the current world, enabling people to quickly absorb energy from the universe to strengthen themselves.
Those high-level battle tactics also had their merits.
Although Wang Ping didn’t understand the last of the technological information, he could tell their value was extraordinary.
Even though Wang Ping didn’t plan to spread technology in the Profound World, sharing this information in the chat group would be considered a resource. Perhaps it could be of great help to some group members later on.
After all, the laser cannon in this world could eliminate a Martial Master and Spirit Sea Realm practitioner.
Besides, those various warplanes were not bad either.
“It was a pleasure working with you. Until next time if there’s a chance.”
After shaking hands with Lin Zhan, Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction and left the world.
Wang Pings mysterious disappearance caused Lin Zhan’s pupils to suddenly constrict. He sensed the surroundings and found no trace of Wang Ping, inwardly sighing.
Such existences as travelers are truly mysterious..

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 96: Becoming a Coveted Delicacy due to Strangeness! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 96: Becoming a Coveted Delicacy due to Strangeness! _3
Translator: 549690339
Soon after, he looked at Wang Shuqi with twinkling eyes, planning to cultivate him well.
As for Wang Ping, after returning to the Sword Spirit Sect, he immediately uploaded all the information about the cultivation system and technology resources he had obtained.
At the same time, he sent three exclusive red envelopes containing resources that could help them cultivate to the Grandmaster level to Qin Tian, Zhang Jun, and Liu Mei.
Wang Ping (66) @AII members: “These cultivation resources I got from Lin Zhan are enough for anyone to easily cultivate to the Grandmaster level. As participants in this Group Task, you all naturally deserve a share. In addition, I’ve uploaded the Cultivation System and Cultivation Skills of the High Martial World, so cultivate well. As for Little Tree, he has become Lin Zhan’s disciple, so I didn’t get any resources for him.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Thank you, Mr. Wang!’
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, what an unexpected surprise! Thanks, Mr. Wang!’
Liu Mei (15): “Thank you, Mr. Wang. With these cultivation skills and resources, I can quickly become stronger!’
At this moment, the other group members were also astonished and envious.
Those who participated in this Group Task have truly made a huge profit. Among them, Liu Mei gained the most, not only obtaining an extra supernatural ability but also these resources, which might make her one of the top members in the chat group.
Of course, many people were envious but also went to browse the group files.
After all, the High Martial World’s cultivation system does not require Spiritual Energy, it only needs to absorb Cosmic Energy, so most of the worlds can be cultivated, and they are no exception.
This is the advantage they got for free.
Liu Mei (15) @Wang Ping (66): “Also, Mr. Wang, thank you for taking me to complete System Tasks twice and fighting for so many cultivation resources for me. This is a small token of my appreciation, and I hope you don’t mind.”
After sending this message, Liu Mei sent an exclusive red envelope to Wang Ping.
When Wang Ping opened the red envelope, he found 100,000 Group Points, which surprised him greatly.
Liu Mei was really generous.
However, knowing gratitude and repaying kindness, Liu Mei’s character was indeed good, making her worth getting close to.
The other group members who had been boosted by Wang Ping saw that Liu Mei sent a red envelope and could only helplessly smile.
They remembered Wang Pings kindness, but either they didn’t have Group Points or planned to repay them in other ways.
Afterward, Wang Ping responded to Liu Mei and then exited the chat group.
The atmosphere of the chat group changed due to this Group Task, but now it was all over.
“I’ve only got one free simulation left before I have to start accumulating them again.”
Wang Ping sighed after coming back to his senses.
“However, instead of waiting for the free simulation to refresh, I might as well stick to my original plan and go to the Seven Stars Archipelago first. After all, no one knows when the next Group Task will be. If the time interval is too short, and I don’t accumulate enough free simulations, it will be troublesome. With Spiritual Stones in hand, I won’t be worried at all.”
At this thought, Wang Pings eyes changed subtly.
He never thought that there would be a day when the Paid Simulation was more reliable than free simulations.
Free simulations are all about waiting for their count to replenish with time.
As for Paid Simulations… it just requires spending Spiritual Stones, and you can simulate as much as you want if you have enough of them.
“Ugh, I need to make more Spiritual Stones in the future. No matter which world you’re in, you need to have money. No matter where or who you are, you can’t escape the fate of needing to work hard for money.”
Wang Ping covered his forehead and started grumbling.
Next, Wang Ping left his quiet room and went directly to the First Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect to inform him of his intention to leave.
In order to act more conveniently, Wang Ping directly revealed his cultivation level.
When the First Supreme Elder found out that Wang Ping was a Transcendent Realm Master, he was completely shocked and unable to say anything to stop him.
After that, Wang Ping made arrangements, leaving the Red Fire Skill for Bai Tianhong to cultivate.
With the Red Fire Skill, Bai Tianhong should be able to reach the half-step Transcendent Realm by the time Demon MO Fan appears, making it easy to kill him and eliminate a huge hidden danger.
Of course, even in the same realm, Bai Tianhong, who possesses the Red Fire Skill, should be able to kill Demon MO Fan as well.
As for Bai Tianhong, Wang Ping had complete trust in him.
The only uncertainty for Wang Ping was the variable of Ye Chen.
However, Wang Ping was not worried.
He would definitely return to the Profound Turtle Continent in the future to explore its many secrets.
By that time, if anything happened, his strength at that time should be enough to suppress it easily.
After taking care of everything, Wang Ping left the Sword Spirit Sect and headed to the Fierce Wind Valley, arriving at the Stele Array.
As a large number of Spiritual Stones appeared, Jiang Huai activated the Stele Array, and Wang Ping turned into a beam of light, disappearing into the sky.
When Wang Pings vision was restored, he found himself appearing on another Stele Array, and the surrounding environment had changed, no longer the mountain forest environment of the Fierce Wind Valley but inside a cave.
“l have finally arrived at the Seven Stars Archipelago.”
Wang Ping saw the environment around him and was extremely delighted.
Although he had been to the Seven Stars Archipelago many times in simulations, this was his first time truly arriving here, and the feeling was completely different.
“Young friend Wang Ping, activating the Stele Array this time has consumed a lot of my soul power. Please help me find some treasures that can help restore my soul power, or else I might disappear.”
Jiang Huai’s figure became increasingly vague, and he said helplessly.
“I’ll do my best.” Wang Ping gazed at Jiang Huai and said with a slight smile.
He then infused some Spiritual Essence into Jiang Huai, making his Soul Body more solid.
As Wang Ping invested his Spiritual Essence into Jiang Huai’s Soul Body, Jiang Huai’s eyes widened a bit.
However, Jiang Huai quickly regained his composure as if nothing had happened.
Despite Jiang Huai’s subtle expression changes and swift composure, they still couldn’t escape Wang Pings notice.
Wang Ping quickly realized something.
His Spiritual Essence was no longer the same as before; now it was a Five Element Spirit. Although he used only Fire attribute Spiritual Essence, it was still very different from the Red Fire Spirit.
Jiang Huai, an old fox who lived at the Profound Elixir Realm during his lifetime, must have noticed the anomaly and possibly seen that Wang Pings cultivation skill had become of the Heavenly tier.
“It seems that I have to squeeze the remaining value out of him as soon as possible and then dispose of him.”
Wang Ping remained expressionless, but murderous intent rose in his heart.
He couldn’t see what kind of methods this old fox Jiang Huai had.
If he waited until he arrived at the Seven Stars Archipelago, the secret of his cultivated Heavenly-tier skill might be leaked, and that would be really dangerous..

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 97: Another Simulation! The Way to Break the Game!
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 97: Another Simulation! The Way to Break the Game!
Translator: 549690339
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his heart as he walked outward without revealing any signs.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated. Do you want to spend one thousand mid-tier spirit stones for a paid simulation?” The system’s voice rang out.
“Spend.”
Wang Ping responded in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful. Talent refresh in progress… Congratulations, Host has successfully refreshed Green Talent.Road Silly, Green
Talent.Self-Destruction, and White Talent.Self-Sacrifice for Others.’
Green Talent.Road Silly: Host will lose a sense of direction and often inadvertently end up in strange places.
White Talent.Self-Sacrifice for Others: Host prefers to help others at the cost of personal interests, with no desire for repayment.
Green Talent.Self-Destruction: When self-destructing, the power of the Host’s self-destruction would be multiplied. “What kind of talents are these?”
Wang Ping felt speechless in his heart.
Could even being directionally challenged become a Green Talent? This was something he really did not expect.
Or was it that the Life Simulator was just trying to make things difficult for him?
As for this White Talent, there’s no need to say how useless it is. It directly changes your personality and causes you to damage your own interests in exchange for helping others, without seeking repayment. That’s clearly a debuff.
However, this Green Talent.Self-Destruction is not bad. I have a Rebirth Tally, maybe it can play a significant role at a critical moment.
“System, I choose Green Talent.Self-Destruction.”
Wang Ping felt helpless, and could only select this strange Green Talent.
“Ding, Talent selection successful. Life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, familiar screens appeared, as the text began to emerge.
[On the first day, you went to the Seven Star Archipelago, investigating the markets on the outer islands one by one, wanting to find the Bronze Ancient Lamp, but not gaining any results. You suspected that at this point in time, the Bronze Ancient Lamp has not yet appeared in the market. In the end, you had no choice but to return in disappointment.]
[Next, after getting the Sunset Sword Skill from Jiang Huai, you eliminated him and permanently removed any possibility of future troubles.]
[After getting rid of Jiang Huai, you began a low-profile cultivation in the
Seven Star Archipelago, occasionally earning resources for cultivation by concocting pills.]
[Because you are a Spirit Sea Domain Stronger and a 4th Tier alchemist who maintained a low profile, nobody bothered you.]
[In the blink of an eye, twenty years passed. Your cultivation improved to the Realm of Spirit Sea Domain Perfection, realizing the difference in efficiency when practicing Heavenly Grade Mid-tier Cultivation Skill compared to Earth-tier top-grade skill is exponential.]
[At the same time, your martial arts cultivation advanced rapidly in these twenty years, reaching the Martial Master-tier, creating a Martial Master Golden Body. At this moment, you are extremely confident, believing that you already possess the strength to crush a Spirit Embryo realm strongman.] [Next, the Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and you entered it. This time, you were incredibly lucky, being teleported directly to the location of the sixth-Tier earth-attribute spiritual objects. Joining you in that location was a Spiritual Embryo Stage Cultivator.]
[The Spiritual Embryo Stage Cultivator was extremely domineering, attacking you directly. Although you were unhappy, you still chose to temporarily retreat because you knew that a powerful spiritual beast guarded the sixth-Tier spiritual object. You planned to sit back and harvest the benefits after the fight.]
[As you burst forth with incredible speed to retreat, you attacked the guardian beast with one palm, enraging it and forcing the Spiritual Embryo Stage Cultivator to be unable to spare any attention for you, allowing you to successfully escape.]
[Soon, the fierce battling began, attracting another Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman to the scene. After defeating the guarding beast together, they started fighting each other with highly intense battle, leaving both of them severely injured.]
