[Next, Cai Yonglong began to explain the issue with his golden finger. It turned out that his golden finger could see the opportunity lines on people who would encounter opportunities in the near future. As long as he followed their opportunity line, he could find their opportunities ahead of time and snatch them away.]
[After listening to Cai Yonglongs explanation, you couldn’t help but recall the somewhat popular fantasy novels from your previous life, in which the golden finger functioned similarly, and you started teasing him. Cai Yonglong helplessly admitted that his golden finger was a castrated version and not as powerful.]
[You agreed, as in those novels, the characters would not only snatch away others’ opportunities but also get additional rewards, which Cai Yonglong did not have. However, his golden finger had great potential for development.]
[At the same time, you thought of Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune. It would be interesting to see what would happen if Cai Yonglong used his golden finger to snatch away Ye Chen’s opportunities.]
[Next, Cai Yonglong told you about an opportunity line that would not only be significant but also highly useful for the Transcendent Realm. With curiosity, you allowed Cai Yonglong to lead you in search of this opportunity.]
[Eventually, driven by curiosity, you followed Cai Yonglong to the endpoint of the opportunity line. There, you found a 5th TierSpirit Elixir guarded by a monster beast in a pregnant and weakened state. In a little while, the beast might become completely weakened, and even a half-step Transcendent Realm cultivator would have a chance to steal the elixir away.]
[Cai Yonglong was thrilled, thinking they hit the jackpot. However, you remained calm and unmoved. A 5th tier spiritual elixir was not a big deal for you.]
[Cai Yonglong felt awkward when he remembered your current status and position.]
[After harvesting the spiritual elixir, you left the place. Believing that his golden finger could play a significant role in the future, you began to cultivate Cai Yonglong. He respected you deeply, and his cultivation progressed rapidly.]
[Three years later, with your help, Cai Yonglong successfully broke through to the Transcendent Realm and became a Spirit Sea Domain Stronger, much to his delight.]
“Three years have passed, and there have been no group tasks? It seems that in life simulation, group tasks do not exist. This may not only apply to me but also to other group members if they appear. This is a future without group tasks in other worlds. One could say that the presence of the chat group has been greatly reduced.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his eyes flickering, and thought about it.
Next, Wang Ping shook his head, stopped thinking about it and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, watching the simulation content.
[After some thought, you decided to take Cai Yonglong back with you to Profound Turtle Continent. If you could utilize Cai Yonglongs golden finger to unearth Ye Chen’s golden finger, it would undoubtedly be a great joy.]
[Using the Stele Array, you and Cai Yonglong arrived at Profound Turtle Continent, and he was shocked to learn that this was your crossing point. He also understood why you had initially struggled to leave.]
[You took Cai Yonglong back to the Sword Spirit Sect where Bai Tianhong and others were surprised by your return and that you had brought a friend.]
[You didn’t explain much but simply exchanged pleasantries before taking Cai
Yonglong to find Ye Chen. At this time, Ye Chen had already joined the Sword
Spirit Sect, becoming a disciple, and he was ecstatic and looked up to vou.] [When Cai Yonglong saw Ye Chen, he was amazed. Because he saw numerous opportunity lines on Ye Chen’s body, which connected in various directions. One of these opportunity lines was on Profound Turtle Continent.]
[Cai Yonglong happily reported this news to you. You were quite surprised, and then you recalled Ye Chen’s unusual experience with a Demonic Cultivation Grandfather, gaining some insights.]
[Then, you asked Cai Yonglong to lead you along the opportunity line to look for chances, intending to find the demonic cultivator beforehand and deal with him.]
[In the end, Cai Yonglong led you to the Black Wind Forest, where you found a mysterious cave. Inside the cave, you sensed an extremely evil demonic energy.]
[You were alarmed and knew that this was where the terrifying demonic cultivator was. You contemplated whether to enter, not knowing how much strength the demonic cultivator had left and not wanting to take excessive risks.]
[You were well aware that without Ye Chen’s interference, this demonic cultivator wouldn’t cause any harm to the mortal world for hundreds of years, meaning he couldn’t leave for some reason. As long as no one else interfered, nothing would happen. However, if you were to interfere, it would be a
different story.]
[Eventually, you chose to give up and had no immediate plans to go in, taking
Cai Yonglong away from the area.]
[You went to Chi Village and had a pleasant conversation with the Chi Clan. However, you also realized a problem: even now, you still couldn’t understand the bloodline curse of the Chi Clan. Moreover, when you thought about forcibly learning about the bloodline curse through power, your heart palpitated, instinctively fearing it, and chose to give up..]

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time!
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time!
Translator: 549690339
“Chi Clan, still so many mysteries remained unsolved.”
Wang Ping sighed as he examined this simulation content.
Now he was not the naive person he used to be. As a Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman, he could reproduce a whole Spirit Clan himself.
Also, as a 7th tier alchemist, his knowledge was rather extensive.
Even so, this kind of feeling had emerged, showing that the curse on the Chi Clan at least originated from someone stronger than the Profound Elixir Realm.
At the same time, Wang Ping had always been puzzled about one issue.
What exactly was the other party’s intention? They could kill or not kill, and they could also tolerate others killing the Chi Clan to the point of genocide. This gave the feeling as if they were deliberately torturing the Chi Clan.
Perhaps, often the simplest guess is the most accurate one.
Wang Ping thought silently and looked at the screen again.
[While you were chatting with the Chi Clan and guiding Chifengs cultivation, Cai Yonglong couldn’t give up the ‘shocks the world opportunity’. He was still hesitating. In the end, he sneaked into the Devil’s Cave while you were practicing.]
[Then he saw the terrifying demonic cultivator sealed by the shocking Great Array. Cai Yonglong sensed the cultivator’s terror, wanted to leave directly, but was still beguiled by the temptation, his mind filled with desire and longing for power.]
[Then, he expressed his intention to travel through the Profound Turtle Continent, to observe this land, and chose to leave your side. You were unsuspecting and chose to return to Sword Spirit Sect for a period of solitude, and then return to Seven Stars Archipelago.]
[During your retreat, Cai Yonglong started to practice demonic skills and began hunting. He was very cautious, choosing to stay far away from the Central Plains, far from you, and ran to the fringes of the Central Plains for hunting.]
[Because Cai Yonglong had extraordinary strength, no one on the Profound
Turtle Continent could compete with him except you, so every time he acted very discreetly, and no one noticed anything unusual.]
[Half a year later, he collected enough Blood Spirit and returned to the Devil’s
Cave. He broke the demonic cultivator’s seal using the method of Blood Sacrifice. The demonic cultivator’s body had long rotten over thousands of years, leaving only the Divine Soul. Therefore, he chose to stay in the Soul Nurturing Ring and stayed by the side of Cai Yonglong to take him as his disciple. He planned to squeeze all of Cai Yonglongs value out and then eat him.]
[However, because Cai Yonglong was possessive, many things about the chat group, the matter of the transmigrators, were all known to the demonic cultivator. The demonic cultivator was shocked to the extreme, he didn’t expect your origins to be so extraordinary. For this reason, the demonic cultivator planned to spare Cai Yonglong for the time being.]
[Afterwards, Cai Yonglong directly took the demonic cultivator to find you. You were very angry and had a great battle with Cai Yonglong. The demonic cultivator chose to take action, exerting a terrifying skill intending to capture you alive. You sensed something was off, instantly turned into Berserk State intending to resist, but it was all in vain.]
[At this, your heart filled with fear and anger. You hated Cai Yonglong deeply, and ultimately chose to self-sacrifice.]
[Because of the Rebirth Tally, you were revived, you self-destructed again, avoiding being miserably captured by the demonic cultivator.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends.]
Wang Ping was lost for words.
Cai Yonglong, this time he really was a major pitfall.
Even he, a Spirit Embryo Realm Strongman with transcendent combat power, would not dare to enter the Devil’s Cave, how dare a mortal from the Spirit Sea Realm like Cai Yonglong go to the Devil’s Cave.
It might be fair to say that Cai Yonglongs desire for power is even stronger than Wang Ping imagined.
Of course, this is not to say it is incomprehensible.
After all, this world is very dangerous, along with the existence of the chat group tasks, forcing each group member to roll up their sleeves and transform themselves to the maximum strength.
However, although it was understandable, Wang Ping stj.ll felt pretty speechless.
“In the life simulation, Wang Ping couldn’t use the Life Simulator to foresee the future. Which is to say, Cai Yonglong couldn’t be controlled by Wang Ping in the simulation. Cai Yonglong was able to see the opportunity which might bring a lot of benefits, but it might also bring a giant pitfall.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
Even though you see the opportunity, if you lack power, that’s just a move to offer one’s head.
Take the case of the 5th TierSpirit Elixir, even if the Spirit Sea Realm monster beast is in a weak state, the one who is a half-step Transcendent Realm could steal this elixir, but it’s just a possibility.
If Cai Yonglong was to rush over, I’m afraid he wouldn’t be slapped to death.
The same goes for this Devil’s Cave, the opportunity is there, but that maybe an opportunity for the Son of Fortune Ye Chen, but for Cai Yonglong, it’s a nightmare.
Being beguiled, losing his will, and getting eating up after being exhausted, leaving no trace behind.
Moreover, Wang Ping was very suspicious that if this happened in reality, Cai Yonglong would also go to other worlds to complete group tasks with the terrifying demonic cultivator.
By then, with the demonic cultivator there, no one knows what will happen.
Perhaps, the possibility of team annihilation is quite likely.
“Thinking so, I need to be more cautious in the future. If other group members were being possessed by some old monster or bringing some old monster to cross to other worlds to carry out group tasks, it could lead to the ending of team annihilation. In addition to that, carrying dangerous items could also lead to the same.’
When Wang Ping thought of this, his heart was startled and noted down this pitfall, mumbling to himself.
“Although Cai Yonglong messed me up in the simulation and caused me to waste a simulation opportunity, he also made me think of this issue, so it can be considered as a compensation.”
After that, Wang Ping closed his eyes, no more thoughts disrupting his mind, and entered the state of cultivation..

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time! 2
Translator: 549690339
Now he had none left.
Whether it was a paid simulation or a free simulation, he couldn’t use either. The only option was to wait and earn enough spiritual stones in the coming months.
He only hoped that the next group task would be delayed.
On Seven Star Island, in Seven Star City, within the Elegant Pavilion, three people were drinking together.
“Mr. Wang, are you really not considering joining my Seven Star Palace?” Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun looked at Wang Ping with a regretful expression.
Wang Ping was a 7th tier alchemist who had suddenly appeared in the Seven Stars Archipelago in the past four months and quickly gained fame.
Although he didn’t know how old Wang Ping was, judging from his youthful appearance, it should not exceed two hundred years old.
Being under two hundred years old and in the Spiritual Fetus Realm, coupled with being a 7th tier alchemist, made Nangong Yun personally invite him.
Such a talent, even if he failed to invite them to join the Seven Star Palace, he couldn’t let Wang Ping join another power, and he had to ensure a good relationship with the Seven Star Palace.
Otherwise, a 7th tier alchemist was capable of making another sect rise to prominence.
As long as he was around, other factions were destined to be suppressed by his Seven Star Palace, but the future was uncertain.
“I have heard of Nangong Yun!s great reputation since I was a child, and I respect him very much. It is my honor to be invited by him. However, I am accustomed to a leisurely life and will not join any power in the Seven Stars Archipelago, so I can only apologize to Nangong Yun.”
Wang Ping pretended to be helpless.
“That’s a pity,” Nangong Yun sighed after hearing Wang Pings words.
He understood what Wang Ping meant.
Wang Ping wouldn’t join the Seven Star Palace, nor would he join any other power, which would not make them enemies and give Nangong Yun peace of mind.
“Well, since fellow Daoist is unwilling to join my Seven Star Palace, I won’t force you. But you and Palace Master Qin Lan are both 7th tier alchemists, you may have common ground and can communicate more often and become friends in your spare time.”
Then Nangong Yun changed the topic and said with a smile.
“Mr. Wang, when I come to drink with you, you can’t refuse.”
Qin Lan also raised her wine glass and smiled.
“Of course not. After all, I have long admired Palace Master Qin Lan.” Wang Ping looked at Qin Lan with a smile on his face, raising his glass.
His words were not false.
After absorbing elixir-refining experience, he naturally had memories of his cheap master Qin Lan teaching him how to refine elixirs.
Therefore, although they were master and disciple in the life simulation, they didn’t have this relationship in reality, but Wang Ping was still grateful to Qin
Lan.
“Hene, since you two nave nit It Ott, from today onwards, Wangs Elixir Pavilion will be under the care of my Seven Star Palace. If any forces dare to target Wangs Elixir Pavilion, they will be targeting my Seven Star Palace, and I won’t spare them.”
Nangong Yun saw Wang Ping raise his glass and nodded with satisfaction. He also raised his glass to Wang Ping and Qin Lan, then stroked his beard and laughed.
“With Elder’s words, I feel at ease. I will toast to Elder once again.”
Wang Ping smiled and raised his cup again.
Although his cultivation had already reached the Early Stage of Spiritual Bearing Realm, he might not be able to resist Nangong Yun.
Not to mention, the Seven Star Palace had other strongmen.
Therefore, Wang Ping would not offend the Seven Star Palace before he had the real invincible power within the Seven Stars Archipelago. As for Nangong Yun e s approach and goodwill, he would naturally choose to accept it and give them face.
Of course, considering the current development, even if Wang Ping had the strength, he would not become an enemy with the Seven Star Palace.
After all, there was no reason for them to become enemies at present, and there was also the relationship with Qin Lan.
After the drinking party, Nangong Yun and Qin Lan left, and Wang Ping finally sighed with relief.
With these two taken care of, he could continue developing his power and earning spiritual stones without worries in the following period.
“In these four months, I’ve earned enough spiritual stones to be able to carry out new simulations. I haven’t had any simulations in four months, I hope I can at least draw some good talents.”
After returning to the building purchased in Seven Star City, Wang Ping prepared for a new simulation.
In the past four months, he had sold some 5th-tier elixirs and a 6th-tier elixir.
A total of 200,000 medium-Tier spirit stones had been sold, enough to support him in 20 life simulations.
It was just a pity that the materials required for refining 6th-tier and 7th-tier elixirs were too precious and difficult to collect in a short time.
If not, Wang Ping wouldn’t have earned just 200,000 medium-Tier spirit stones.
Although it seemed small, 200,000 medium-Tier spirit stones were enough to empty some forces in the Seven Stars Archipelago.
Ordinary Spirit Embryo Realm strongmen’s fortunes would probably not exceed this, and they might not even be able to produce so many medium-Tier spirit stones.
It was only because Wang Ping needed 10,000 medium-Tier spirit stones for a simulation that he thought he had so little money.
“Ding, detected that a group member, Zhang Hu t s world has a bizarre presence. Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is mandatory, involving 5 participants. Please select five group members quickly for the group task. If no selection is made within ten minutes, the system will randomly select five group members to participate in this group task and teleport them to Zhang Hu t s world.”
Just when Wang Ping was about to start a paid simulation, a pop-up window suddenly appeared in front of Wang Ping, causing his face to change..

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 102: Two Group Tasks Appear at the Same Time! _3
Translator: 549690339
After four months, has the group task finally appeared again?
Moreover, this time it’s in the world where Zhang Hu is.
From Wang Pings understanding, Zhang Hu t s world is not so simple.
When a Grand Magister unleashes a forbidden curse, it has the destructive power of the Spirit Sea Realm.
The combat power of a Sword Master should be above the Spiritual Fetus Realm.
However, the Sword Master is not the upper limit of their strength.
The Sword Master is just the ceiling of combat power in the human world.
In their world, there are also dragons, the Demon Clan, and the Divine World.
Their depth is truly unfathomable.
It’s dangerous to carry out a mission in such a world, let alone when a weirdness appears; the mission’s difficulty must be very high.
“You don’t have to worry too much, I have 200,000 medium-Tier spirit stones this time, and I’ve saved twelve free simulation chances. With so many simulation opportunities, as long as it is not an unsolvable situation, the probability of completing the task is still very high.”
Wang Ping quickly calmed down again, comforting himself in his heart.
However, at this moment, a system prompt sounded again, causing Wang Ping to fall silent.
“Ding, detected that group member Fang Yun’s world has also appeared weirdness. Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is mandatory, with a participation of 5 people. Acting group master, please quickly select five group members for the group task. If no choice is made within ten minutes, the system will randomly draw five group members to participate in this group task and be sent to the world where Fang Yun is.”
“There’s actually another group task? This is like a double yolk egg…?” Wang Pings eyelids twitched, and he couldn’t calm down in his heart.
After all, this situation was the first of its kind.
That is to say, this time they were destined to carry out group tasks separately.
There might be casualties this time.
After all, in previous group tasks, everyone had managed to complete them unscathed with the help of his Golden Finger…
This time, without him, who knows what the outcome will be.
Immediately, Wang Ping directly entered the chat group to see the reactions of the other group members.
As M/ang Ping had expected, the entire chat group was in an uproar, extremely panicked.
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, I knew that the worlds we traveled to would definitely have weirdness, otherwise the chat group wouldn’t have let us go there, but I didn’t expect it to be my turn so soon. And this is not just one weirdness, even Fang Yun’s world also has weirdness. This situation is too outrageous.”
Fang Yun (3): “I’m tired, I don’t want to talk… What are we going to do next?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “To be honest, I’m a bit nervous right now. After all, two worlds have simultaneously appeared with weirdness, which means that ten people need to participate in group tasks, but there are only thirteen living people in the chat group right now. That is to say, there are only three who won’t go to the mission world, so the chance of not being picked is extremely low.”
Liu Mei (15): “The most critical issue is that this time there are two group tasks, and there is only one Mr.Wang. This means that one of the teams will not be able to easily obtain information about the various weirdness and pass the tasks without injuries.”
Fang Yun (3): “To be honest, I’m really panicking right now, and I think I’m done for. Mr.Wang, please choose me. Our world has a lower power level, and it will definitely be easier to complete the mission.”
Zhang Hu (5): “….At this time, shouldn’t Mr.Wang go to our world? Your world has a lower power level, and the chances of completing the mission are higher. You can’t waste the most important battle power. The power system in our world is very high, and without Mr.Wang, we might be annihilated.”
Wu Jun (20): “Well, when facing the weirdness, the importance of power levels may not be that crucial. Just like the last group task…”
Zhang Hu (5): “Jun, I know you still have some grudges against me, but I can only tell you clearly that the situation last time was special, and 1 believe everyone knows that in their hearts. Most of the time, to complete the mission, powerful strength is an indispensable factor.”
Chen Yao (71): “l agree with Zhang Hu’s words. Strength is necessary. If Mr.Wangs strength was not that strong, there’s no way we could have completed the mission in our world.”
Fang Yun . “….So that means our world deserves to be abandoned, right?”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “…Ah, they started arguing. But this is normal. 1 just hope I don’t get picked.”
Qin Tian (77): “Mmp, I just participated in the group task four months ago, and it’s not going to be my turn again, is it? Forget it, instead of randomly drawing people to participate in missions, Mr.Wang, I want to follow you to
Zhang Hu t s world.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “l also want to go with Mr.Wang to Zhang Hu t s world….”
Wu Yueming (79): “Although I know some things from the group notice… Do we need to panic so much? Haven’t we all survived every time?”
Fang Yun (3): “You don’t know shit! The reason we were able to complete the missions without casualties before was all thanks to Mr.Wang. Now Mr.Wang can only choose one, so how can we not panic? And also, don’t do this, everyone. If all the powerful fighters go to Zhang Hu t s world, won’t I just be done for?”
Zhang Jun (70): “You all arguing like this is meaningless. It still depends on Mr.Wangs decision.”
Wang Ping (66): “l will go to Zhang Hu e s world. As Zhang Hu said, the power level in their world is too high. Without me there, they are very likely to be annihilated. Fang Yun, I know you’re panicking, but your world is just a Swordsman World with a low power level. As long as there is a group member with strength above the Spiritual Origin Realm, and they can be cunning enough to figure out the weirdness’s abilities, the possibility of completing the mission is still very high.”
Fang Yun (3): “Mr.Wang, please don’t do this. I really feel like I’m going to die. Why don’t we draw lots to decide which world you go to for the mission?” Fang Yun was almost in tears, even using polite language.
But there was no help for it; who could remain calm in the face of matters concerning one’s life?

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 103: Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 103: Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger
Translator: 549690339
Cai Yonglong (1): “Time is limited, we can’t waste time arguing here, let’s just draw lots. I also think drawing lots is fairer…”
Wang Ping (66): “Fine, let’s do it this way. Actually, you guys don’t need to panic too much. As long as 1 kill one of the strange creatures, and then teleport to another world, it should be fine. However, if we really have to do this, I hope all the group points for eliminating the strange creatures will be mine. After all, crossing worlds by teleporting consumes a lot of group points, and I am not a task participant, so I can’t get any rewards.”
Fang Yun (3): “Sure, of course! Not to mention that you, Mr.Wang, take all the rewards, even if we owe you some more, it’s only right.”
Zhang Hu (5): “That should work, but it does put too much risk on Mr.Wang.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Although I’d like to say that even if we overcome this crisis, more severe situations may arise in the future, and we will need to face the crisis and participate in group tasks without Mr.Wang sooner or later, but as we can still do this for now, I won’t say anything more.”
Chen Yao (71): “You’re done talking, right?…”
Qin Tian (77): “This guy just wants to remind everyone. That’s how I got beaten up in the High Martial World where Wang Shuqi was last time.
Sneering.Jpg. ”
Wang Ping watched as the people in the chat group gradually calmed down, and he shook his head slightly.
Immediately after, Wang Ping chose to proceed with random drawing.
“Ding, drawing completed. Group members Wang Ping (66), Chen Yao (71), Qin Tian (77), and Lin Yuanyuan (80) will go to Zhang Hu t s (5) world to participate in the task and kill the strange creatures.”
“Ding, drawing completed. Group members Cai Yonglong (1), Zhang Jun (70), Wang Shuqi (74), and Wu Jun (20) will go to Fang Yun’s (3) world to participate in the task and kill strange creatures.”
As the group notifications sounded successively, the chat group exploded again, some with joy, some with sorrow.
Zhang Hu (5): “Great, Mr.Wang is in my group, and Chen Yao is here too! With you guys here, our chances of completing this task without any casualties are definitely very high!
Fang Yun (3): “Shit, what kind of group arrangement is this? Three high-end combatants from our chat group are going to Zhang Hu e s world to participate in the group mission. Plus Zhang Hu himself is pretty strong, and there’s a Sword master… This combination is just too strong. On our side, including me, there are three people with weak combat power, and both Mr.Cai and Zhang Jun’s combat power hasn’t reached the transcendent realm.”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, that really scared me. Fortunately, I’m in the same group as Mr.Wang. Otherwise, I would be done for. And, Ye Xiaofan, how come your luck is even better than mine, you weren’t drawn.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “…..Thank the goddess of luck for her favor.”
Liu Mei (15): “I’m not in this time….l don’t know whether to be happy or regretful. ”
Wu Yueming (79): “Is this a new member’s benefit? Laughing and crying.jpg.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “….Assigned to the same group as Fang Yun, huh? Well, it’s a moment we have to face sooner or later. Fang Yun, don’t worry. At least my cultivation has reached the Spiritual Origin Realm 5th-Tier now. Combined with Zhang Jun, who also has a strong Spiritual Origin Realm combat power, as long as the strange creatures are not too tough, our chances of completing the group task are still high.”
Zhang Jun (70): “1 admire Mr. Cai t s attitude. The truth is, we should be like this… We can be afraid, we can be upset, but we mustn’t be timid before the battle. At the same time, while it’s good if we can rely on Mr.Wang, we can’t count on him all the time. Otherwise, even if we don’t die this time, next time we will.’
Fang Yun (3):
Wu Jun (20): “…Well, let’s hope we can all complete the group task smoothly. All we can do now is pray.”
While everyone in the group was discussing, Wang Ping was pondering another issue.
If he does a paid simulation before crossing, what will happen after he crosses to the task world? Can he save the rewards and then do a free simulation, making choices later?
In this way, he can improve his strength at any time to cope with crises.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Taking advantage of the fact that he hasn’t crossed yet, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate to say.
“Ding, would you like to spend 10,000 mid-tier Spiritual Stones for a paid simulation?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Paid.” Wang Ping nodded.
As Wang Ping spoke, the system’s voice rang out again: “Ding, payment successful, life simulation begins, talent refreshing.”
Just as the system’s voice sounded, Wang Pings figure was gradually enveloped in white light and disappeared on the spot.
At the same time, Cai Yonglong and others in different worlds were also teleported to the task world one after another by the chat group.
In Zhang Hu e s world, within the Demon Beast Forest, there were continuous flashes of white light.
Wang Ping, Chen Yao, Qin Tian, and Lin Yuanyuan were all teleported here.
And in front of them, Zhang Hu was sitting on a tall earth dragon.
As Wang Ping and the others appeared, the earth dragon immediately reacted with stress and began to roar.
At this, Wang Ping frowned slightly and gave it a calm glance.
In an instant, the earth dragon showed a frightened expression, let out a mournful cry, and took a submissive posture.
“You stupid dragon, even daring to roar at Mr. Wang, you’re really tired of living..”

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 103 Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 103 Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger_2
Translator: 549690339
After slapping the earth dragon irritably on his head, Zhang Hu jumped down and apologized to Wang Ping: “Mr. Wang, my mount is a bit silly. Please forgive its behavior.”
“No matter, I don’t mind.” Wang Ping shook his head.
“Apart from this, your progress in power is quite notable. Judging from the energy intensity within you, you could already rival a cultivator above the 7th-tier of the Spiritual Origin Realm in our world. No wonder you can tame this big fellow as your mount.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping looked again and praised.
“My power is nothing compared to yours, Mr. Wang.” Zhang Hu said with a smile.
“You must be Qin Tian. You really outsmarted Mr. Wang last time. Don’t try to do the same with us this time around.”
Zhang Hu turned to look at Qin Tian, who was anxiously glancing around, speaking with a jovial tone.
“I didn’t do it on purpose last time.” Qin Tian complained. “And why do you say that I must be Qin Tian, are there other men in this world apart from Mr.
Wang?”
Zhang Hu rolled his eyes, muttering: “You truly are narrow-minded, just as Zhang Jun said, and you’re quick to argue.”
Qin Tian:
Damn, these two never miss a chance to belittle me!
“However, your power is indeed formidable. I can’t help but feel that I might not even be able to defeat you.”
Immediately after, Zhang Hu said with suspicion.
“Hmph, if we really fought, I would definitely thrash you.” Qin Tian humphed, stating proudly.
After his mission last time, the time he spent back home was solely dedicated to training strenuously.
In addition to relentlessly asking his master for various valuable objects, his power truly rose quickly.
Having immortal Tao Fruits, his cultivation before becoming an Immortal had no obstacles. As long as he had enough resources, he could level up rapidly.
Therefore, within four months, he had advanced from the early stage of Foundation Establishment to the initial stage of the Golden Elixir, rising a whole Great Realm.
In addition, he possessed a variety of powerful treasures, enabling him to fight
above his level with ease—his battle prowess was truly formidable.
Being a knight and a swordsman, Zhang Hu would be defeated simply by Qin Tian kiting him around.
A mage fighting in close quarters, how could he lose!
“This kid has already reached the Golden Elixir stage, it seems like he is a bit smug.”
Wang Ping glanced at Qin Tian, discerning his power level, and shook his head.
Indeed, Qin Tian’s Golden finger was formidable; his guess from last time wasn’t wrong.
It’s only been a short amount of time, and he has reached the Golden Elixir stage.
The next time they meet, he’ll probably be at the Primordial Infant Stage.
Once he reaches the Primordial Infant Stage, he would be truly formidable; he could probably rival a Transcendent Realm cultivator.
Considering that cultivators are famously versatile, possessing numerous techniques and treasures, even cultivators from Transcendent Realm might face some trouble against opponents with the same energy intensity.
“Haha, in front of Mr. Wang, I would not dare feel complacent.”
Seeing Wang Ping look at him, Qin Tian immediately felt embarrassed, quickly dropping his proud expression.”
“Hmmph, a typical bully.” Zhang Hu looked disdainfully at Qin Tian. Feeling embarrassed, Qin Tian glared at Zhang Hu, but he didn’t complain.
“Mr. Wang, long time no see.”
At this moment, Chen Yao also chimed in, greeting Wang Ping warmly.
“Indeed, it’s been quite some time.” Wang Ping nodded and smiled at Chen Yao, adding with astonishment, “Your power has increased tremendously. I suspect even those Demon Emperors can’t contend with you.”
“Indeed it has.” Chen Yao nodded with a smile, “I’ve expended a huge amount of resources to rise to such level of power. In the past half a year, those Demon Emperors have been defeated one by one. Our world is temporarily safe. With me around, those powerful Demons that are barely alive wouldn’t dare to make trouble.”
“That’s great. But, why did you use the word ‘temporarily’?”
Zhang Hu’s eyes shone, staring at Chen Yao and asked curiously.
Truthfully, he was quite envious of Chen Yao’s Golden finger, or should he say point addition system—the potential was simply unbelievable. As long as there were enough resources, leveling up was a piece of cake. It was so much less troublesome than his own cultivation.
Although with the Golden finger, his Cultivating speed was unfathomable for indigenous people in this world. His monstrous Cultivating speed had been labeled as a freak by many. His master also repeatedly looked at him like he was some kind of freak.
“Because, from the information we obtained from recent excavations of ancient tombs, we learnt that the situation in our world is much more serious than we initially thought.”
Chen Yao looked worried and spoke with a heavy tone. “However, we are still unsure of what exactly is hidden.”
“Uhh…” Zhang Hu was at loss for words.
He had thought that the pinnacle of combat power in Chen Yao’s world was simply limited to Demon Emperors and Great Tao masters. Seems like he was wrong.
True, it’s rare for worlds like the Demon Revival to not have deep potential. “It seems that the pressure on you is quite heavy.” Wang Ping also shook his head.
As for what Chen Yao said, he was not surprised. After all, the Demon World was indeed not simple. It might be that Earth, like the Profound Turtle Continent where he was, was just a novice village in that world.
Then, Wang Ping stopped talking to Chen Yao. Instead, he looked at Lin Yuanyuan, who had been coldly watching the four of them.
Since Lin Yuanyuan berated them in the Transmigrator Chat Group for being too cold-blooded, and also because her help request was ignored, she had held a grudge against the group members.
She occasionally talked about her own situation, but mostly she stayed silent, rarely participating in the chat..

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 103: Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 103: Unfair Grouping! Testing the Golden Finger_3
Translator: 549690339
No one knew what Lin Yuanyuan’s world was like, nor what her Golden Finger was.
“Lin Yuanyuan, although I don’t know how you see us. However, since we have come to this world and are carrying out dangerous group tasks together, I hope you can give up your prejudice against us and work together to complete the group task.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered as he spoke with deep meaning.
“As long as you don’t do anything excessive, or deliberately hold us back, I will do my best to keep you alive.”
“Oh.” Lin Yuanyuan stared coldly at Wang Ping, only uttering this word without emotion.
“What do you mean by that?” Zhang Hu frowned and said coldly, “Mr. Wang has always been caring to group members, and even if someone is not helpful in group tasks, he will not give up on them unless there is a special situation. When I first participated in a group task, I had a small dispute with Mr. Wang because of this. Mr. Wang is our leader, our backbone. Now, he is willing to protect you, and yet you still act so coldly, it’s really ungrateful.”
He felt that this newcomer, Lin Yuanyuan, had some issues.
During the confrontation with the bizarre, having a teammate like her, with unknown mental issues and an unknown Golden Finger, would definitely multiply the risks.
After all, as the saying goes, one should not fear a god-like opponent, but rather a pig-like teammate.
“I didn’t ask him to protect me.” Lin Yuanyuan sneered. “Don’t be so hypocritical here. When I asked you for help before, you all just ignored me coldly. What was Mr. Wang doing then? Now, it’s funny that he’s talking about protecting me.”
“You!” Hearing this, Zhang Hu instantly became angry and wanted to slap Lin
Yuanyuan.
Chen Yao and Qin Tian also frowned.
“Zhang Hu, don’t get worked up. Lin Yuanyuan’s rejection of my kindness is not necessarily ungrateful. Everyone has their own thoughts and we can’t force them upon others.”
Wang Ping held Zhang Hu back, maintaining a calm expression as he spoke. “But…” Zhang Hu glared unhappily at Lin Yuanyuan.
He felt that this woman would pose a great hidden danger to their mission.
“Lin Yuanyuan.” Wang Ping shook his head, motioning Zhang Hu not to speak.
He continued to look at Lin Yuanyuan, speaking meaningfully, “You can be dissatisfied with us, and you can even distrust us. But I hope you don’t do anything outrageous. As long as you do nothing, I will lead you to complete the task. If you say I am insincere, that’s fine, as long as we can complete the group task. However, please remember that if I find out that you’ve done something outrageous during the upcoming mission, I will not show you mercy because you are a woman, or because you are a member of the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
“Everyone’s life is precious. But if you, alone, bring harm to countless people in this world, and even endanger the entire team, I will be the first to kill you.”
After pausing for a moment, Wang Ping spoke again, his eyes turning icy cold and his expression extremely cruel.
“The chat group has never had a case of killing a group member before. I don’t want to be the first to kill one, and I don’t want you to be the first to be killed.”
‘ Wang Ping’s cold words made Lin Yuanyuan, who had originally been indifferent, tense up. Her body instinctively tightened, and a chill rose from the soles of her feet, rushing up along her spine to the top of her head, making her shiver all over.
At this moment, she knew that Wang Ping’s words were not for show. He was actually capable of doing such things.
This was no longer her world; she no longer had those bootlickers around her, and she didn’t have the strength to resist Wang Ping. She could no longer be capricious here.
“I understand.” Lin Yuanyuan guiltily turned her head, retracting her little schemes, and whispered.
“Good.” Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Although he still didn’t trust Lin Yuanyuan, he knew that with the Life Simulator, he would be able to see clearly what she would do in the upcoming future.
So, he wasn’t particularly worried.
If Lin Yuanyuan did anything outrageous, it would just prove that there was something wrong with her brain, that she was overly emotional, and an unstable time bomb.
For that, he would definitely kill her without hesitation, leaving no survivors.
When dealing with the bizarre, there is no room for hesitation or mercy.
Otherwise, even if they really simulated a successful path, Lin Yuanyuan might suddenly act out and doom them all during the mission.
“So, Mr. Wang, what should we do next? Should we use our abilities according to the old rules? How many times can you still use your abilities?”
Zhang Hu glanced at Lin Yuanyuan with contempt, then looked at Wang Ping with admiration and asked.
“Don’t worry, we have more than fifteen chances this time.”
Wang Ping’s reassuring answer brought looks of surprise to Zhang Hu, Chen Yao, and Qin Tian’s faces.
Fifteen chances, that was quite a lot. In the past, they would clear the task with just five or six chances, so this time the guarantee was quite high!
“Before that, let me confirm a few things first.”
Seeing that the three of them were about to say something, Wang Ping closed his eyes and raised his hand to signal them to be quiet.
This caused everyone to close their mouths and wait quietly.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing the Green Talent Magic Genius.”
Green Talent Magic Genius: The host’s talent in cultivating magic will become astonishing.
“Did I actually refresh a talent like Magic Genius…? Could it be that after going to different worlds, I’ll refresh talents characteristic of that world?”
Wang Ping was extremely shocked as this thought crossed his mind.
So, is the content of this Paid Simulation either the continuation of his Profound World’s future without coming to the Magical World, or will it directly follow his current starting point?

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 104: A New Path! Special Rewards!
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 104: A New Path! Special Rewards!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
As Wang Ping was lost in his thoughts, the system’s voice rang out again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared with the text starting to emerge.
[Day 1: After much thought, you decide to go look for Cai Yonglong. When you arrive at Azure Abyss Island, you learn that Cai Yonglong never returned after going down the mountain a month ago. You gasp and recall the events in your memory, guessing that maybe Cai Yonglong really went alone to look for the opportunity.]
[Although you’re eager to go to that place, you eventually give up because you only know about the event in your memory but not the specific location. You decide to wait a bit longer, and if Cai Yonglong still doesn’t return, you’ll basically assume that he’s dead.]
[A month later, Cai Yonglong still doesn’t return. You let out a sigh, thinking that Cai Yonglong is most likely dead and choose to leave.]
“Is it really simulating the future of the Profound World…”
Wang Ping looks at the text in surprise.
At the same time, he’s also surprised by Cai Yonglong’s death, but believes it’s within reason.
After all, Cai Yonglong has expressed his interest in this great opportunity many times, and considering the pressure the chat group brings, it’s quite normal for him to take the gamble.
And taking the gamble usually doesn’t turn a bicycle into a motorcycle but leads to GG on the spot.
Apparently, Cai Yonglong dies in the mouth of the Transcendent Realm Monster Beast carrying the fetus, turning into blood food to nurture its child.
After silently complaining in his heart, Wang Ping continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Following the steps in your memory, you cultivate diligently to become stronger. Because you’re already a 7th tier Alchemist, your cultivation speed has increased significantly. In twenty years, you’ve reached the peak of the
Mid-stage Spiritual Embryo Realm, just one step away from the Late-stage
Spiritual Embryo Realm.]
[When the Seven Star Secret Realm opens, you choose to enter. Due to your strong combat strength and an unexpectedly good fortune this time, you obtain a 7th tier Fire Spirit Material in the secret realm.]
[After completing the journey in the secret realm, you start looking for information on 7th tier spiritual items of other attributes, hoping to cultivate the Five Elements Spirit Fire by using the 7th tier spiritual items of all five attributes, further strengthening yourself and making it more convenient for alchemy.]
[Another ten years pass, and you successfully break through to the Late-stage
Spiritual Embryo Realm. You also manage to collect a 7th tier Water Element
Spiritual Item, which triggers a fierce battle with a Great Perfectionist in Spirit Gathering Realm from the Sea Ape Clan. In the battle, your power is unparalleled, killing him and creating a sensation throughout the Seven Stars Archipelago and surrounding sea regions.]
[At the same time, this event enrages the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor, as a Great Perfection cultivator of the Spirit Accumulation Realm is rare, and the clan losing its only one, who was designated as the future successor, damages the foundation of the Sea Ape Clan.]
[As a result, the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor personally comes forward to pressure the Seven Stars Archipelago to hand you over. However, having a good relationship with you, the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun chooses to protect you and fights the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor, forcing the latter to leave.]
[You’re deeply grateful to Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun. If you had to fight the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor, your true strength might’ve been exposed. Once revealed, you’ll be hunted down by many Transcendent Realm cultivators and even the Profound Elixir Realm masters.]
[However, you sigh in your heart, knowing that Seven Star Ancestor Nangong
Yun will eventually pass away and fall into madness before that day comes.]
[After the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor’s attack is over, you remember the emergence of Demon MO Fan in the Profound Turtle Continent during this period and decide to return there.]
[After returning to the Profound Turtle Continent, you personally track down and kill Demon MO Fan. Then, you destroy the Demonic Skill, preventing it from being practiced by Ye Chen.]
[Next, you go deep into the Black Wind Forest and use the sealing array plates prepared over the years to completely seal off the surrounding area of the Devil’s Cave, preventing more people from accidentally entering and causing the downfall of everyone in the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[Of course, you’re also well aware that without Ye Chen, nothing major would happen for several hundred years, and it’s only because of the variable that Ye Chen introduces that these events unfold.]
[Having taken care of these matters, you recall the Xia Royal Family’s Forbidden Area and visit the Xia Imperial City. After catching up with Xia Yuan, you decide not to enter the Forbidden Area.]
[Then, you leave some heritage in the Sword Spirit Sect and choose to leave the
Profound Turtle Continent with Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong. You want Bai
Tianhong to see a broader sky and don’t want to leave Ye Chen in the Profound
Turtle Continent to continue harming it.]
[After taking Ye Chen to the Seven Stars Archipelago, you give him many
Spiritual Stones, allowing him to act freely without having to follow you. Ye Chen is grateful to you, promising to repay his benefactor someday. You make a quick retort, saying that you can’t be considered his benefactor, and that your connection has ended, urging him not to seek you out again.]
[Ye Chen feels awkward and confused, not knowing why you’re so scared of
him. He then remembers your kindness and decides to repay you one day,
before setting off on his solo adventures.]
[After Ye Chen leaves, you choose to leave the Seven Stars Archipelago and head to Sacred Heart Island. You know that only by going there can you have a better chance of making further progress after breaking through to the Spirit
Accumulation Realm. Meanwhile, you continue to study the High Martial System, hoping to make a breakthrough in the bottleneck of the martial arts system..]

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 104: A New Path! Special Rewards! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 104: A New Path! Special Rewards! 2
Translator: 549690339
[It’s a pity that your research over the years has not made much progress. Expanding one’s path is not easy, and discovering new systems is even more difficult. Even the Emperor Huangtian in your memory suffered hardships before he created a new system based on his predecessors’ foundation. With your current understanding and background, it is almost impossible for you to achieve this.]
[After coming to Sacred Heart Island, you have been quietly cultivating with Bai Tianhong, not participating in the disputes with other forces, reminiscent of a reclusive expert.]
[Thirty years later, under steady cultivation and elixirs that do not affect your foundation, your cultivation has improved and reached the Great Perfection Tier of the Spiritual Fetus Realm.]
[Your cultivation has improved a lot, but you are not satisfied. That’s because, after Bai Tianhong left Profound Turtle Continent, he truly began to shine. In just thirty years, his cultivation reached the astonishing Spirit Sea Domain Perfection.]
[Bai Tianhong is very respectful to you. In his heart, although you have not accepted him as a disciple, he has long regarded you as his master, even more so than the First Supreme Elder of Sword Spirit Sect.]
[Next, Bai Tianhong asks for your permission to leave and search for a 6th Tier Spiritual Material to break through the realm. You said that he doesn’t need to bother with this and that you’ve already prepared it for him. However, Bai Tianhong insists that he needs to gain experience on his own and that he doesn’t want to rely on you for everything.]
[You were delighted by his independent spirit and finally agreed to let Bai
Tianhong obtain the 6th Tier Spiritual Material by himself to break through.
However, recalling how difficult it was for you to obtain the 6th Tier Spiritual Material, you gave Bai Tianhong an Array Plate. This Array Plate could generate a powerful Killing Formation capable of unleashing a single attack at the Spiritual Fetus Realm, which was extremely precious. However, with your identity as a 7th tier alchemist on Sacred Heart Island, obtaining this item wasn’t a problem.]
[Bai Tianhong was extremely grateful, solemnly saluted you, and left. As for you, you continued to collect the refining materials for the 7th tier Elixir Soul-opening Elixir through various channels, hoping to refine the Soul-opening Elixir as soon as possible and break through to the Spirit
Accumulation Realm.]
[Ten years later, you finally collected all the precious materials and began refining the Soul-opening Elixir. You successfully refined the Soul-opening Elixir and managed to breakthrough to the Spirit Accumulation Realm by a stroke of luck.]
[You know that your cultivation has reached its limit, and without an opportunity, you fear that you’ll not be able to advance any further in this life. Therefore, while continuing to cultivate diligently, you also began to focus on alchemy and comprehending Sword Spirit, and started preparing cultivation resources for your next life, hoping to grow again to the Spirit Accumulation Realm and live a few hundred more years.]
[Another ten years passed, and Bai Tianhong never returned, so you began to worry that he might have fallen and started asking people to search for him.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly fifty years passed, and Bai Tianhong was still nowhere to be found. Based on his loyal and righteous character, if he were alive, he wouldn’t stay away; you sighed and accepted in your heart that Bai Tianhong must have perished.]
[After that, you went to the Seven Stars Archipelago and arrived at the territory of the Sea Ape Clan. When you came here, the Sea Ape Clan had not yet experienced any unrest, so you quietly waited.]
[Two months later, the Sea Ape Clan began to experience turmoil. You knew the mysterious young cultivator you’d been watching had started taking action, so you continued to observe the situation. Eventually, you managed to intercept that young cultivator while hiding your identity, forcing him into combat with the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor.]
[As a result, the young cultivator harbored great resentment towards you. In the end, he managed to erupt with formidable combat power, combined with the mighty force of a Profound instrument, and killed the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor. You were astonished at his immense strength.]
[However, although he killed the Sea Ape Clan Ancestor, he too reached the end of his strength. In the end, he was furiously torn to pieces by the other Sea Ape Clan experts who pursued him. You finally decided to make a move, competing for the Profound instrument.]
[With your formidable strength, you managed to seize the Profound instrument and left. From here on, the Sea Ape Clan fell into decline, began migrating away from this Sea region, attempting to escape to weaker Sea regions to survive. Otherwise, they would face the risk of genocide.]
[Time flew by, and another thirty years passed. As the time for Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s imminent demise approached, you had already possessed formidable strength and a Profound instrument, and were no longer afraid of the Mad Demon Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun.]
[Your arrival surprised Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, who hoped you would stay and be a guest in Seven Star Palace for a while. You could guess at Nangong Yun’s thoughts, but with a sigh in your heart, you decided to repay the favor from the past, and took out an elixir. This was a 7th tier Longevity
Elixir which could help increase the lifespan of cultivators below the Profound
Elixir Realm by thirty years.]
[Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun was amazed that you took out such a precious elixir and had complex feelings about it. In the end, he didn’t accept the elixir, as he had already consumed one before and a second time would be ineffective.]
[Next, Seven Stars Ancestor continued to persuade you to stay at Seven Star Palace as a guest for a while, reasoning that if he were to die, chaos would reign in the Seven Star Palace, and he hoped you could help maintain order.]
[You knew the intentions of Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun but ultimately chose to agree, relying on your powerful strength. This was because you wanted to see any unusual phenomenon after breaking through to the
Profound Elixir Realm, and you also wished to obtain an incomplete Profound Pill left behind by Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun after his failed breakthrough attempt as soon as possible. To cultivators below the Profound Elixir Realm, its value was priceless..]

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 104: New Route! Special Rewards!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 104: New Route! Special Rewards!_3
Translator: 549690339
[Soon, everything unfolded just as you remembered it. The Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun faked his death and tricked others into coming to the Seven Star Palace. Then, he came back to life, brought out the Blood Demon Array, and intended to assimilate everyone.]
[You observed the madness of Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun calmly, activated your berserk mode, operated your cultivation skills to protect your body, invoked your Five Elements Spirit Body and Martial Master Golden Body, defended with all your might, and the Blood Demon Array could do nothing to you.]
[Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun was shocked by the many secrets you were concealing. He wanted to attack you, but when you brought out the Profound instrument, he fell silent and had no choice but to deadlock with you, forcefully breaking through the awkward situation.]
[You watched everything calmly, waiting for the outcome.]
[In the end, Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun forced his way into the Profound Elixir Realm. However, his strength was too insignificant, his physical body has already weakened, and the quality of his condensed
Profound Elixir was not satisfactory. Ultimately, he failed to persist and died on the spot.]
[Seeing this, you sighed in your heart. A great ancestor, desperate to breakthrough at any cost, could only end up with such a result. A tragic tale.]
[Subsequently, you claimed the incomplete Profound Pills and all the treasures within the Seven Star Palace, broke the Blood Demon Array, and left. You chose to return to Sacred Heart Island. The Seven Star Palace hence became history. This incident shocked the entire Seven Stars Archipelago.]
[Once you returned to Sacred Heart Island, you continued to seek the 7th tier soul nourishing elixir but alas, nothing was gained as they were not available in the market.]
[In a blink of an eye, ten years passed. You unexpectedly heard that Master Huo Xuan obtained a 7th tier soul nourishing elixir. You were stirred and decided to pay him a visit. Being a 7th tier alchemist yourself, Huo Xuan, an 8-tier alchemist, chose to meet you.]
[You stated your purpose directly, hoping to exchange the elixir. To this end, you took out your incomplete Profound Pills as the trading item. Master Huo Xuan was greatly surprised. The value of the incomplete Profound Pills was indeed great, at least much more precious than the 7th tier soul nourishing elixir.]
[Ultimately, Master Huo Xuan was moved by your sincerity and chose to trade with you. You successfully obtained the 7th tier elixir.]
[Unfortunately, before you could swallow the elixir, news of you obtaining the elixir was known by a Profound Elixir Realm master whose divine soul was severely wounded.]
[He personally confronted you, ruthlessly attacked without showing any mercy. You were enraged and fought to the death with him, but due to the enormous gap in your cultivation levels, you were easily crushed to death.]
[After your death, the Profound Elixir Realm master deeply regretted. He realized that the cultivation skills and martial arts you practiced were of Heavenly tier, hence you must possess some great secret.]
[Regrettably, it was already too late by the time he realized this, and you were dead.]
[At this moment, due to the rebirth tally, you were resurrected. The Profound Elixir Realm master was greatly shocked, then thrilled. He intended to capture you and use soul-searching to extract the secret.]
[However, you were resolute and chose to self-destruct without hesitation, turning both your soul and body to ashes.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ended.]
“A 7th tier soul nourishing elixir is also extremely precious for a master of the
Profound Elixir Realm. But under normal circumstances, Profound Elixir Realm masters wouldn’t shamelessly attack a 7th tier alchemist just for a 7th tier soul nourishing elixir, as it would certainly provoke all the alchemists. After all, if you can kill one alchemist for your selfish benefit today, you might kill them for better items tomorrow.”
Wang Ping frowned as he looked at the simulation content.
“It can only be said that this master of the Profound Elixir Realm was severely wounded in his divine soul, which needed to be nourished by the soul nourishing elixir urgently, otherwise, it will lead to permanent injury or even death. Therefore, he became so desperate. It’s unknown who this master of the Profound Elixir Realm is and who has hurt him like this.’
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two among the following rewards as the reward:
Early Stage of the Spiritual Accumulation Realm for cultivation.
Green Talent Magic Genius.
Various secret methods of cultivation.
Elixir-refining Experience.
Eighty percent of Peak Sword Spirit.
Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky Stick.”
“Huh, not only are there two rewards this time, but there can also be item rewards?”
Wang Ping was stunned as he looked at these reward options.
After all, it was his first time seeing item rewards since he started simulations.
He had originally thought that item rewards were impossible to obtain. Now it seems that it is not the case.
From the looks of it, the drop rate of item rewards is very low, just like his life experiences.
No, it can be said that the probability of refreshing item rewards is even lower than getting life experiences as a reward option, so he thought it was impossible to get items.
“A profound Artifact, it’s a good thing. It can exert a great power, though it’s just a stick and not a sword, it is not handy enough, it can still enhance a part of my strength, which is quite good.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
“System, am I allowed to keep the rewards and choose later? Meanwhile, can I do free simulations during this period?” Then, Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“Yes.” The system’s mechanical voice sounded.
“That’s great.” Wang Ping sighed in relief after hearing this answer.
As long as he could hold on to the options and keep on simulating, there would be a lot of room for manoeuvre.
“So, can I do a paid simulation while keeping my reward choices?”
Wang Ping asked again.
“No. You can only start a new paid simulation after selecting the rewards.” The system answered again, causing Wang Ping to feel regretful.
If he could keep the rewards and start a new simulation, that would be even better.
However, since that wasn’t possible, there was no need to fuss about it.
Immediately, Wang Ping opened his eyes and looked at Zhang Hu and the
others.
“Mr.Wang, how did it go?”
Zhang Hu eagerly asked.
“I wasn’t using my abilities to predict the future just now, I was pondering over some issues.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and said.
“Ah…” Hearing this, Zhang Hu was taken aback, and said a bit awkwardly:
see, I thought Mr.Wang was using his abilities..”

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 105: Chronicles of Elazar
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 105: Chronicles of Elazar
Translator: 549690339
“Zhang Hu, let’s find a place to stay first. This wilderness is not a good place for communication. Moreover, before using our abilities, we must have a clear understanding of the circumstances in your world.”
Wang Ping patted Zhang Hu’s shoulder and said again.
“Alright, let’s go. Actually, I didn’t expect the task to come so suddenly. I was usually training in the Demon Beast Forest. This big guy is an A-tier magical creature that I subdued in the forest.
Zhang Hu explained to Wang Ping with a smile.
“Alright, Mr. Wang, to avoid drawing attention, you’d better conceal your presence and ride my earth dragon. Besides, we should change into clothes that go well with this world. After all, you know that before we find the anomaly, we must keep a low profile and not let the anomaly discover us.” With a pause, Zhang Hu continued.
“Of course I understand.” Wang Ping nodded and then said with a strange look, “But to be honest, riding an earth dragon is also quite ostentatious. If I sit with you, many big shots will definitely notice us.”
“Uh…” Zhang Hu was speechless.
Although they were reluctant to part with the earth dragon, they had no choice but to leave it in the Demon Beast Forest for the time being.
Under the earth dragon’s resentful gaze, Zhang Hu led Wang Ping and the others away from here.
Soon, the five of them, hiding their identities and dressed in black robes, arrived at Udan City, the one closest to the Demon Beast Forest.
After entering the city, Wang Ping, Chen Yao, and Qin Tian all showed astonished expressions, looking around curiously.
The architectural style of this fantasy world was quite different from that of China, tending towards Western, but with many differences.
Of course, besides the architecture, the biggest difference was the various races coming and going on the streets.
There were the human race, the elf clan with their pointed ears, the strong dwarf race, the Amazon and the beastman clan with features of beasts. It could be said that there were many diverse races, showing a truly fantastic world view in front of their eyes.
“Hey, Mr. Wang, the elf clan and the beastman clan are not bad, right? They are famous races in the fantasy world. The female elves generally have high appearance and are exceptionally noble and pure, while the beastmen have a wild beauty.”
Zhang Hu grinned, revealing an expression that every man would understand and whispered.
“Mr. Wang, are you interested in having a good time? I know a decent nightclub.”
“Gulp…” Hearing this, Qin Tian’s eyes widened, and various images involuntarily appeared in his mind, making him swallow his saliva.
MMP, elf clan, beastman clan, and succubus… Hiss…
This Zhang Hu really disrupted his Tao Heart.
“Hmph.” Chen Yao looked at Zhang Hu and Qin Tian disdainfully, snorted coldly, “Two smelly men.”
Lin Yuanyuan also pursed her lips.
However, she didn’t say much about it. Although she was a drama queen, she was not as innocent as Chen Yao in terms of relationships between men and women.
She clearly understood what men liked, and she didn’t feel any contempt for it.
After all, it’s all consensual. You pay, and everyone enjoys, there’s nothing wrong with it.
“Let’s talk about it later. The task is most important.” Wang Ping coughed lightly and shook his head.
“I see.” Zhang Hu looked a little disappointed but didn’t say much more.
Qin Tian also looked regretful, but he remembered that Zhang Jun had been indulging himself in the previous world and disappeared. He became a little itchy for a moment.
Well, there’s plenty of time, no need to rush.
After that, under Zhang Hu’s arrangement, Wang Ping and the others came to a high-end hotel, ordered many specialty dishes and drinks.
After the waiter brought the food and drinks, Zhang Hu took out a scroll and tore it open.
Then, a layer of light enveloped the private room.
“This is a scroll of a soundproof magic barrier, which also has defense and detection functions. With this barrier, we can communicate safely.”
Zhang Hu explained.
“Although you guys might be able to do the same thing, it’s better not to use abilities from other worlds if we don’t have to.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded his head, didn’t say much on this issue, and spoke directly, “Take out the information about your world for us to see. I believe you should have prepared it.”
After Chen Yao’s Demon World mission, the old-timers in the group had formed a good habit of having detailed information about their world prepared in advance to facilitate everyone’s understanding of the world.
Of course, uploading the information directly to the group files would be best, but people in the group were generally cautious.
Doing so might expose the information about their worlds. Although the chat group was harmonious for now, that might not always be the case in the future.
If a severely malicious person appears in the chat group, there could be trouble.
Of course, this sort of precaution doesn’t have a great effect, but as long as there is no clear intention, people only provide detailed information when the group tasks appear and they go to that world.
“Of course I’m prepared.” Zhang Hu smiled, took out several well-bound books from his Storage Ring, handed them to Wang Ping and the others, and said, “Actually, to truly understand a world, unless you have a special situation like Chen Yao where much of the history and extraordinary powers are hidden, the best and most efficient way is to understand a world by understanding its history..”

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 105: Chronicles of Elazar_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 105: Chronicles of Elazar_2
Translator: 549690339
“Of course, I’ve specially written down the information on various powerful beings, their strength levels, and so on. However, this is what I can understand, and there may be some hidden things that I don’t know, and my teacher may not know either.”
After a pause, Zhang Hu spoke again.
“What you said is indeed true. Unless it’s a special situation, the fastest way to understand a world is to read its history books, which would create a complete framework of the world in your mind.”
Wang Ping nodded, agreeing with Zhang Hu’s words, and opened the history book to read it carefully.
Chen Yao and Qin Tian also found it reasonable and started reading silently.
Although Lin Yuanyuan was not interested in history, she was intrigued by the history of the Exoteric World and began reading it as well.
Record of Alza Continent’s History –
During the Epoch of Magic Beasts, magic beasts roamed the land, and none of the major ethnic groups had significant power. They were simply food for the magic beasts, barely surviving in this world.
They dreamed of the existence of deities and hoped for divine protection of humanity.
Finally, their faith was answered.
Various gods descended to the human realm, chose their own messengers, and preached about the greatness of the gods.
Those with deep faith would receive the Blessing of The Power of Faith in Lord, becoming believers.
Human faith is diverse, and they believed in various gods.
However, the main gods were Light Lord God, War Lord God, Thunder Lord God, Storm Lord God, Lord of Fire, Lord of Water, and Lord of Earth.
Amazons believed in the Amazon goddess.
The Elf Clan believed in the Forest Goddess.
The Beastman Clan believed in the Beast God.
The Dwarf Race believed in the God of Blacksmiths.
Through faith, very devout and pure believers received divine blessings and gained power, enough to stand against powerful magic beasts and protect their own ethnic groups.
The miracles of the gods reduced the threat of the magic beasts to a minimum. Their status gradually changed from overlords of the Alza continent to hunted prey. Only a few powerful magic beast groups could avoid being hunted.
Thus, a new era began.
This era was known as the Era of Faith Wars.
During the Era of Faith Wars, almost every ethnic group and living being was fanatically worshipping their own gods, besides the magic beasts.
Eventually, the decline of the magic beasts led to the major ethnic groups furiously expanding and occupying territory.
At the same time, conflicts arose due to differences in faith and ethnicity.
Bearing faith in their own gods, people formed various Great Sects, and started attacking each other.
Ultimately, this evolved into a brutal war.
In this era, the casualties were no less than during the time of the magic beasts, and perhaps even greater.
Because humans were good at slaughtering their own kind.
During the church wars, corpses were strewn everywhere. The accumulation of countless negative emotions gave rise to a new church.
That was the Church of Darkness, which believed in the dark lord.
The rise of the Church of Darkness brought greater darkness to the world.
The doctrine of the Church of Darkness was destruction, spreading fear and darkness to the world.
However, some believers believed that spreading destruction and darkness was not the goal. The real purpose was to use fear to stop the fighting between all living beings.
The Church of Darkness was extremely crazy, but it also produced many talents.
Often, it took a madman to achieve greatness.
And the Church of Darkness gathered most of the madmen in the entire Alza continent.
Among them, a man named Mos opened a new era.
He studied the world, discovered the existence of magic elements, and saw a new world.
Then, he created a new system, which was the magic system.
In just thirty years, he became a terrifying Dark Mana Lord and unleashed the most horrifying Undead Catastrophe in history.
He awakened the dead and controlled them to fight, sweeping across the entire continent.
Under the advance of the Army of the Undead, everything was crushed. No one could stop the march of the army, even the messengers of the gods were powerless.
In the end, numerous churches were destroyed, and godly monuments were toppled.
The people of the Church of Darkness, seeing this scene, went completely insane and fanatical. They called Mos the god of the human world and the true representative of the Dark Lord God.
They followed Mos’s footsteps, bringing destruction and darkness to the entire Alza continent.
Under these circumstances, all the churches and believers sobered up, abandoning their prejudices and fighting together against the terrifying Army of the Undead, trying to kill Mos.
Unfortunately, their combined efforts were useless against the Army of the Undead. Anyone who died would be summoned as a new undead, making it impossible to eliminate them completely.
At this point, everyone was in despair.
Finally, a true miracle appeared. The Image of the Light Lord God appeared in the world, and under the universal radiance of the holy light, everyone’s souls were cleansed, their fears dispersed, and warmth spread throughout their bodies.
According to historical records, at this moment, all the undead were turned to ashes, and the great Magic Founder, as well as the one who brought the apocalypse, the Dark Mana Lord Mos, disappeared under the power of the Light Lord God.
After the end of the Undead Catastrophe, the world regained peace once more.
However, because the Light Lord God displayed his divine light and saved all living beings, most humans changed their faith, except for those who still firmly believed in their own gods..

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 105: Chronicles of Elazar_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 105: Chronicles of Elazar_3
Translator: 549690339
They fanatically believed in the Light Lord God, believing that the Light Lord God could bring light, peace, and warmth to the world, while followers of other religions were heretics and criminals who incited war.
As a result, in the Human Kingdom, the Church of Radiance became the strongest and untouchable church, obtaining the Power of Faith that no other church or person could challenge.
Soon after, the powers granted to humans by the gods were withdrawn, except for the Holy Woman and Pope of the Church of Radiance, leaving humans without the power to protect themselves.
According to historical records, a Pope of the Church of Radiance spread the news that the gods withdrew their power because they saw that granting power to believers in the lower realm would lead to war, and thus they took back their power to make everyone love peace.
Though the Pope of Light tried to comfort the people, the results were not significant, as humans recalled their ancestors’ fear of being dominated by demonic beasts and panic began to spread.
In this situation, some people thought of the Dark Mana Lord Mos, who created the magic system.
As a result, people began searching for manuscripts and research from the Dark Mana Lord Mos.
Eventually, someone found his treasured research diary and began studying the magic system.
In the end, the magical hierarchy gradually took shape, forming a complete ranking system of Magic Apprentice, Junior Magician, Mid-tier Magician, Senior Magician, Grand Magician, Grand Magister, and Mana God.
With this, magicians of various levels continuously appeared, and humans regained the power to contend with demonic beasts, strangling the potential crisis in the cradle.
Thus, humans entered a new era.
Historically known as the Magic Age.
With the arrival of this new era, everyone wanted to become a magician, and magicians became the most noble profession; even the kings of countries had
to treat Grand Magisters with politeness.
Even if a magician killed someone in the street, there would be no punishment.
Unfortunately, not everyone could become a magician. Magicians valued one’s aptitude above all else, and it was not a common occupation.
Therefore, only a few could become magicians.
This also led to magicians being the real nobles, the true elites, with a very high status.
Among them, the Light Magicians produced by the Church of Radiance held the highest status.
In this era, ordinary people who could not become magicians desired to become them, but also envied and hated the magicians’ privileges above ordinary nobles.
One hundred years into the Magic Age, magicians’ status grew even more terrifying, and various strange magics required human experimentation to develop.
Many ordinary people were ruthlessly captured by slave traders, sold as slaves, and fell into the hands of magicians who used them for human experiments.
This further intensified the conflict between the two sides.
People began to resent magicians, hoping that the Church of Radiance could punish them, and also hoped that all kingdoms would revoke the magicians’ privileges.
Unfortunately, those appeals were ignored by the high and mighty.
Though the Church of Radiance did make peace, it was of little significance.
As a result, countless ordinary people were pushed to their limits, and some warriors among them began searching for power to counter magicians.
Meanwhile, in this era, due to the rise of human magicians, various races such as the Elf Clan, Amazon, Dwarf Race, Beastman Clan, and other major tribes were all heavily oppressed.
Although they had also studied the magic system, only the Elf Clan surpassed humans in magical talent. However, the Elf Clan’s population was scarce and unable to oppose humans.
As a result, many elves were captured, becoming slaves and falling into the hands of nobles as playthings.
This situation was based on the gods of the various major tribes showing miracles, deterring the greed of the human race. Otherwise, the entire tribe might have been enslaved and conquered.
On the 120th year of the Magic Age, a new crisis emerged.
A human Mana God discovered a Huge Dragon Nest, stole the Dragon King’s egg, and enraged the dragons of the nest.
All the dragons on the Alza continent went into action, attacking humans.
Faced with such a crisis, human magicians began to gather, intent on slaying dragons and turning the Dragon Clan into magical tools.
However, human magicians underestimated the power of dragons.
Dragons were not inferior half-dragon breeds; they were naturally immune to magic at a terrifying degree.
As a result, the magic power that human magicians were proud of was nothing in the face of dragons, merely scratching the surface.
This caused human magicians to panic, to fear, and to seek peace.
But the furious dragons didn’t negotiate with the greedy and foolish human magicians and continued to attack them.
Despite the fact that the dragons also caused great harm to ordinary people, many twisted minds rejoiced that magicians finally got what they deserved and deserved to die.
“This history book must have been written by an anti-magician.” Wang Ping looked at it with an odd expression.
Then, he silently glanced at the author – Sword Saint Marlha.
Alright, it was indeed a human swordsman.
It seemed that the common occupations and magicians of this world were inherently incompatible.
Shortly after, Wang Ping shook his head, collected his thoughts, and continued to read the history book.
It has to be said, this kind of chronicle was fascinating to read.
Although he wasn’t interested in learning about every hero of each era and their life stories, he was very intrigued by the historical narrative. Not to mention, understanding all this was helpful for his mission..

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 106: Simulation! Zhang Hu and Lin Yuanyuan ‘s Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 106: Simulation! Zhang Hu and Lin Yuanyuan ‘s Golden Finger
Translator: 549690339
