“No, my ability has evolved. You think torturing to the point of collapse is the only way to kill because that’s just my personal preference. I like to see humans collapse, to see them beg for mercy.”
At these words, Zhang Jun’s pupils suddenly shrank Cai Yonglong, Wang Shuqi, and Wu Jun all looked terrified.
“Puchi!”
It was at this moment that the Death God-like bizarre entity swung its blade at Cai Yonglongs neck, beheading him.
This time, Cai Yonglong didn’t come back to life. His severed head wore a look of shock and despair as it flew across the room.
Seeing this, Zhang Jun fell silent and closed his eyes.
Wang Shuqi and Wu Jun also turned pale, unable to speak, feeling even more desperate.
“What, are you desperate already? How boring.”
The Death God-like strange figure floated in front of Zhang Jun, using the
Death God’s Scythe to slap his face before cutting more wounds, mocking him.
“But don’t worry, as a reward for your guess of my abilities, I’ll torture you thoroughly. I won’t stop until you break down and give up your life by yourself.”
“Of course, I like to save the best for last, so let me collect some interest from you first before I slowly torment you.”
With that, the Death God-like entity swung its scythe, cutting off one of
Zhang Jun’s arms and causing Zhang Jun’s face to twist in pain and bitterness.
The strange entity was indeed too hard to deal with. Without Mr. Wangs powers, it seemed impossible…
This time, they might really be wiped out.
“Alright, it’s your turn now. 1 wonder how long you can last.”
Immediately after, the Death God-like creature appeared in front of Wang Shuqi, speaking ominously.
“Don’t!.” Wang Shuqi cried out in terror.
“l like that look on your face. Not bad, let’s increase the intensity.” The Death God-like creature sneered, and swung the scythe, aiming to chop off one of Wang Shuqi’s fingers first.
“Clang! ‘
However, this time, it couldn’t cut off the finger as easily as before, instead creating a sound akin to metal clashing.
“Eh?” The Death God-like creature was stunned.
Wang Shuqi was also startled.
“What’s going on?” The Death God-like strange figure was somewhat baffled, and couldn’t help but swing its blade again, increasing the force.
Nevertheless, it was still useless. It couldn’t injure Wang Shuqi at all.
“What the hell is going on with you humans?” The Death God angrily used various means to torture Wang Shuqi, but was completely unable to break through his defenses.
“l, I don’t know either!” Wang Shuqi’s face was filled with confusion.
He thought that his Golden Finger’s ability to strengthen his defense was only applicable to his physical body, and didn’t expect it to be useful in this strange space as well.
“….” Zhang Jun fell silent.
He knew about Wang Shuqi’s Golden Finger and had thought it was an ordinary ability.
But now, it seemed that he had underestimated it.
Wang Shuqi’s Golden Finger appeared to be quite abnormal.
“….” Wu Jun was also dumbstruck, some of his fear dissipating, unsure how to evaluate everything he was witnessing.
“Is that it? Can’t you make it harder?” Wang Shuqi’s eyes brightened, and he shouted loudly.
Since he knew the strange entity couldn’t break his defense, he felt at ease.
In that case, there was no need to be afraid. It was time to quickly draw hatred, buy time, and prevent the strange entity from targeting Zhang Jun
and Wu Jun..

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _3
Translator: 549690339
If both of those two die as well, there would truly be no hope.
“You’re courting death!” The Death God roared in peculiar fury, increasing the intensity of his torment on Wang Shuqi.
“Is that it? Is that it?”
“Damn, are you even trying?”
“Ouch, you hurt me, but it’s not much. Similar to a mosquito bite.”
“Ah, I can’t even die if I want to, how pathetic. You’re so weird, you’re more like a rat.’
Instantly, all sorts of clamor came from Wang Shuqi, infuriating Death and maxing out his hate meter.
Zhang Jun and Wu Jun could only stare at this unfolding scene, dumbfounded and at a loss for words.
“Ah.” But soon, Zhang Jun let out a sigh.
Drawing aggro, in the end, didn’t mean much.
After all, if Death wanted to kill him and Wu Jun, it would be a piece of cake.
As for Wang Shuqi, although Death couldn’t break his defense, if he calmed down, he would still find ways to torment him.
The best outcome would be Wang Shuqi surviving alone due to his monstrous defense.
Then, Zhang Jun seemed to remember their abilities and looked towards Wu
Jun.
He remembered, Wu Jun also had a Golden finger ability.
But, Wu Jun never displayed any power or presence, so he didn’t know what Wu Jun’s Golden finger ability was.
However, he occasionally heard others in the group talking about Wu Jun’s Golden finger, which always led to Wu Jun angrily dismissing them.
“If you can use it, just use it. What are you waiting for?”
Zhang Jun looked at Wu Jun, reminding him with his eyes and lip-reading.
This brought Wu Jun back to his senses and he understood what Zhang Jun meant.
He hesitated, but finally clenched his teeth.
He obviously also had a Golden finger.
However, his Golden finger was too much of a trap.
Once used, he would transform into a woman for half a year, and there was no way to revert it.
The ability of his Golden finger was also somewhat baffling.
Infinite possibilities: There are infinite possibilities in every moment and every second in the world, just like the development of the future.
You will forever have the ability to force a possibility to a hundred percent of occurring. Even if the probability of such a thing happening is extremely small, you can force it to a hundred percent.
However, you have no control over what possibility will be elevated to a hundred percent.
It could be positive, or it could be negative. And the ratio of positive to negative outcomes is 1:9.
Lastly, this Golden finger has a cooldown time of 72 hours after each use.
Truthfully, if possible, Wu Jun really didn’t want to use this Golden finger.
This Golden finger was undeniably a bug-level Golden finger, but it would turn him into a woman, which was physiologically unacceptable to him.
Besides, this Golden finger was too uncertain. The probability of a positive outcome beneficial to him was merely one-tenth.
He was no lucky guy, he was always down on his luck in games, he really didn’t dare to gamble.
But now, they were facing a deadly situation. There was no choice left but to gamble!
“I’ll gamble!”
Wu Jun mustered up some courage, shouting inwardly, clenching his teeth, and directly using his ability.
Then, under the astonished gaze of Zhang Jun, Wu Jun turned into a woman.
This was also noticed by Wang Shuqi who was standing aside, He was also stunned, bewilderedly looking at Wu Jun.
What’s going on? Why did Wu Jun turn into a woman?
“Death, you’re really perverse. Why did you turn Wu Jun into a woman? Are you thinking of…”
Wang Shuqi started to make sarcastic remarks again.
“Shut up!” Unable to bear it any longer, Death cursed.
However, he was also looking at Wu Jun uncertainly, unsure of what had happened.
This was definitely not his doing.
“Damn, don’t tell me your ability is just to transform into a woman? Is that Zhang Jun finally came back to his senses and cursed volubly.
He was completely dumbfounded.
And he finally understood why other people laughed so exaggeratedly when they found out about Wu Jun’s ability, and why Wu Jun was so outraged.
Turning into a woman was just pathetic and just tragic. “What else can I do? I’m also desperate!”
Wu Jun went red in the face and roared in outrage.
However, because he had turned into a woman, his voice also became somewhat feminine, giving Zhang Jun goosebumps.
“Tsk tsk tsk, this is the first time I’m seeing such a useless savior. As the
Dreamy Oddity, I will hereby address you as the greatest waste of all time.”
Death looked at Wu Jun with a strange look in his eyes, finally realizing everything and started to mock him.
Wu Jun’s face twitched, and he stayed silent.
After using his Golden finger, he didn’t know what kind of possibility would be triggered. And most probably, it would be a negative one.
Even if it were a positive possibility, it might not manifest in front of them immediately. It could be half a month later, or even several years later.
Moreover, even with a positive possibility, it could be something as simple as finding a hundred dollars.
So, this Golden finger was really no use for the mission, he really didn’t dare to use it.
But now, he was forced to use it.
It was over.
It seemed like nothing had changed except for him turning into a woman.
He was about to die as a woman, he was truly in a pathetic situation.
Really, it was quite tragic.
For a while, Wu Jun was devastated, his expression dim, and somewhat numb.
Zhang Jun also became silent once again.
“Hehe, this is really interesting. You guys really put on a wonderful clown
show for me..

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _4
Translator: 549690339
The eerie, grim smile of the Death God.
“Thanks to this farce, I finally calmed down. So, time to torture you in a different way. You think you’re invincible, don’t you? So, how long can you withstand being soaked in poison? How long can you hold your breath if 1 suffocate you?”
Immediately after, the Death God’s eerie eyes turned to Wang Shuqi, full of murderous intent.
As soon as these words came out, Wang Shuqi’s face changed, and he had a bad feeling.
However, he had no power to resist and could only watch as the eerie figure acted against him.
Meanwhile, in outer space, a meteor was mysteriously attracted, hurtling straight towards the ground.
Friction with the air created a huge fireball, which looked extremely eye-catching in the dark night!
Then, under the terrified gazes of some people, the meteor crashed directly into an ancient city.
In an instant, the entire ancient city vanished under the terror of the meteor’s impact, and the ground shook violently as if a massive earthquake had occurred.
Finally, a huge meteor crater appeared, and everyone in the ancient city was completely dead, with no one surviving.
Just as the ancient city was struck by the meteor, the eerie blood-colored space disappeared suddenly.
Zhang Jun, Wang Shuqi, and Wu Jun all woke up with frightened faces.
Among the trio, Zhang Jun’s arm was mysteriously broken, with blood flowing and his face pale.
Wang Shuqi was left in a sorry state, the torment from the dream manifested in reality.
Although Wu Jun was not tortured, he had turned into a woman due to using his abilities.
At this moment, the chat group’s voice also sounded, congratulating the three for completing the group task.
This made the three of them feel like they had just survived a catastrophe.
However, because the three investigated the eerie phenomenon separately and were not together, they couldn’t talk and could only feel relieved and grateful with lingering fear on their faces.
“Did my Golden Finger really help us complete the task?” Wu Jun muttered to himself, somewhat incredulous.
He had gambled on it, not expecting to succeed.
Although the price was a bit high, he had turned into a woman and would have to continue this way for half a year.
“How did we complete the task? How did the eerie figure die?”
Soon after, Wu Jun’s face was full of confusion.
At this moment, the chat group once again popped up with two group messages, causing everyone to fall silent.
“Ding, group member Cai Yonglong (1) has died. Death Replay is being recorded. Since this death occurred as a heroic sacrifice in the group task, the entire development of this group task will be played.”
“Ding, group member Fang Yun (3) has died. Death Replay is being recorded. Since this death occurred as a heroic sacrifice in the group task, the entire development of this group task will be played.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Fuck, Mr. Cai is dead? And Fang Yun too?”
Wang Ping (66): “What happened to you guys? What kind of eerie phenomenon did you encounter?”
Chen Yao (71): “It’s only been one day… Why did this happen.”
Qin Tian (77): . Sigh, death is so close.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80):
Wang Ping and the other four in the fantasy world were truly shocked and felt a chill in their hearts.
It had only been one day, and two people from Fang Yun’s side had died. Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun’s deaths were truly chilling.
This made Zhang Hu, Chen Yao, Qin Tian, and Lin Yuanyuan truly grateful for being on the same team as Wang Ping; otherwise, they might have met the same fate.
Moreover, Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun were among the earliest group members in the Transmigrator Chat Group, and their deaths made people feel complicated.
Liu Mei (15): “…l noticed that Mr. Cai and Fang Yun’s avatars turned gray earlier, and the number of people online in the group also changed. But without a system prompt, I still had some illusions. I didn’t expect…sigh.”
Wu Yueming (79): “Although it’s a bit inappropriate, I’m glad I wasn’t chosen to participate in the group task…”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Same here.”
Wu Jun (20): “…You’ll know what happened soon. This time’s eerie phenomenon is as twisted as always. If it weren’t for our luck…we’d most likely have been wiped out.”
Zhang Jun (70): “l can only say that even with Mr. Wang, we’d most likely have been wiped out. Because the eerie figure knew about our chat group situation and was on guard against Mr. Wang.”
Wang Shuqi (71): “That’s how it is… To be honest, we don’t even know how we completed the task ourselves. It’s all thanks to Wu Jun using the Golden Finger, and we somehow completed the task, it’s really a fluke.”
Hearing the explanation from the trio, everyone, including Wang Ping, felt their scalp tingle.
Wang Pings face changed constantly.
What the hell?
What’s the deal with this eerie figure?
Why would I die if I were there too?
Although it is said that the eerie phenomenon cannot be analyzed rationally, Fang Yun’s world is just a swordsman world. What kind of power does this eerie phenomenon have to be so twisted that even foresight doesn’t work?
“Ding, Death Replay has been successfully recorded. All group members can download and review it.’
The voice of the group’s system sounded again.
This caused Wang Ping to snap back to his senses, take a deep breath, and click on it.
Then, Wang Ping saw the cause and effect of everything.
After the five people met, they started to take separate actions to investigate the eerie phenomenon..

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 109: Wu Jun I s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _ 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 109: Wu Jun I s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _ 5
Translator: 549690339
After all, without his ability, they had to rely on their own investigation.
And then, that’s it.
They didn’t find anything and went to sleep one by one.
Then, they were pulled into a bizarre dream world.
In the dream world, the bizarre was invincible and began to torment them.
Later, the bizarre revealed that it had known about Fang Yun’s existence and the situation inside the Transmigrator Chat Group through Fang Yun’s memory.
Moreover, the bizarre also revealed that it had known about his ability for a long time and had been on guard against him, intending to hunt him down.
“This bizarre thing…” Wang Ping’s face changed constantly.
His ability was not to predict the future, but to simulate life.
However, the Life Simulator may not necessarily guarantee his safety.
Because if the bizarre was hidden deep enough, he might not be able to find it through the life simulator in a short time.
If the bizarre did not do anything during the first simulation, causing the first simulation to yield no intelligence, he might give up continuing to simulate and try other methods to obtain intelligence before simulating again. At most, he would do this after a few more fruitless simulations.
Anyway, he would have to do this sooner or later.
Once he did this, it would be over.
Although he didn’t need time, he still had the habit of sleeping, and the bizarre just had to wait for him to sleep, and it would be the end.
As for how the bizarre could discern which one was really him, it was easy.
Because the him who used the Life Simulator could not continue to use his ability, the bizarre could easily tell from his memory what the situation was.
Just as Zhang Jun said, even if he went this time to face the bizarre dream, he might die as well.
This made Wang Ping silent.
He had always thought that having the Life Simulator meant he would never encounter any danger.
However, this time, the bizarre seemed to have taught him a lesson.
They, the transmigrators, were not necessarily the hunters; the positions of hunter and prey could be switched.
It all came down to the importance of intelligence. If the bizarre knew more than they did, they would also be in danger.
At the same time, Wang Ping was not sure if there was any connection between the bizarre or if there was something like a bizarre chat group.
If such a chat group existed, then his information was completely leaked.
If that was the case, dealing with the Pope-bizarre this time might not be safe either.
Life Simulator would dilute the existence of the chat group; it was like this for him, and it was even more so for the bizarre.
The simulated future was conducted under the condition of the chat group being diluted; if the bizarre had a chat group and obtained his information recently, there might be unexpected accidents.
“I don’t know what Wu Jun’s Golden Finger is, and how they completed the chat group tasks.”
Wang Pings heart was heavy, he murmured and continued to watch the Death Replay.
Then, he saw Cai Yonglong tortured to death after Fang Yun, Zhang Jun guessed the ability, was ridiculed by the bizarre, and had an arm chopped off.
Right after that, Wang Shuqi relied on his insane Defense force to draw aggro, Wu Jun used his ability to become a woman, and the bizarre laughed loudly. Suddenly, the space disappeared mysteriously, and Wu Jun who had turned into a woman, Zhang Jun with a broken arm, and Wang Shuqi in a sorry state returned to the real world, and were notified that they had completed the task.
However, it wasn’t over yet. After the main story was over, the chat group system kindly played the reason for completing the task at the end of the video.
It turned out that a meteorite suddenly changed its course and headed towards Earth, leveling an ancient city.
And the bizarre was inside that ancient city.
Wang Ping (66): “This bizarre thing… is indeed perverse, even if I had gone, I might have died too.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Yes, that’s why I told you guys. To be honest, I was really curious about how they completed the task. I never thought Wu Jun’s Golden Finger would be so perverse. Infinite possibilities… How do I feel like this
Golden Finger’s limit is higher than anyone else’s in the group?”
Ye Xiaofan (75)?? “It’s not an illusion, it’s really too perverse. But the uncontrollable factor is a troublesome issue. If he could buy a Golden Finger Optimizer and optimize it, it might become incredibly perverse.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Wu Jun, I underestimated you before. I want to apologize to you here… But it’s still a complicated feeling that Cai-ge and Fang Yun just died like this.’
Wu Jun (20): “I won’t hold onto the past. But I really regret not using my Golden Finger ability earlier. If I had used it earlier, perhaps Cai-ge and Fang
Yun wouldn’t have died.’
Wang Ping (66): “To be honest, that’s not necessarily the case… Because you used your ability at that second to summon a meteorite, which helped you guys kill the bizarre and complete the task. But if you used your ability a few minutes earlier, it could have had a negative result and elevated a negative possibility to the highest. In that case, your team would be annihilated.”
Wu Yueming (79): “I think what Wang-ge said makes a lot of sense. Luck is mysterious. ”
Wu Jun (20): “….Alright. So, our successful completion of the task this time was entirely due to my explosive luck. And it was not just about using my ability to summon a meteorite. It was just that I was lucky to use my ability at that moment and raised the possibility of a meteorite hitting the bizarre to
100 percent..’!

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 109: Wu Jun’s Abnormal Golden Finger! Double Kill! _6
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “That’s the situation. So, don’t take it to heart. Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun’s deaths are not your fault. On the contrary, you’ve even avenged them.”
Wang Ping also felt a bit complicated about the situation.
As a latecomer in the group, he was profoundly affected by the death of Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun.
“Mr. Cai, I hope you won’t be reeled into such a troublesome chat group in your next life.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
After several simulations, Wang Ping realized that even without this task, Cai Yonglong would still die. His death merely shifted from the hands of an enigma to the mouth of a Transcendent Realm Monster.
In the Profound World, he could change the future and let Cai Yonglong avoid death.
However, in other worlds, he couldn’t intervene.
Moreover, as Zhang Jun stated, even he would face danger if he went there.
“l used to get arrogant because of the Life Simulator. However, even with the Life Simulator, we need to be extremely careful when dealing with enigmas. Now, the Enigma of Dreams has gained information about us through the group members. So, similar enigmas that can predict the future might appear in the future. If I completely trust the simulation content of the Life Simulator at that time, I might not even know how I die.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, muttering to himself.
Zhang Hu (5): “Wu Jun, how much reward did you guys get this time? Maybe you can buy a Rebirth Tally for protection.”
At this time, Zhang Hu sent another message.
Wu Jun (20): “l think I got about 500,000 group points.”
Zhang Jun (70): “10,000 group points.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “l got 20,000 group points. It seems that the timing of my provocation was crucial.”
Wang Ping (66): “500,000 group points? This time, the enigma was quite valuable. However, considering its ability and the extent of damage caused to the group members, it is worth that price. Wu Jun, save some points to optimize Golden Finger, it might come in handy in the future.”
Wu Jun (20): “l understand.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Mr. Wang, how are things on your end? Have you found the enigma?”
Wang Ping (66): “We found it and have a way to get through. However, considering your situation, I suddenly don’t think it will be easy to kill it….”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and explained the situations in the Profound World and his conjecture about the Enigma Chat Group.
For a moment, everyone fell silent, their spirits burdened.
If it were as Wang Ping hypothesized, and there actually was an Enigma Chat Group, the leakage of information was inevitable.
In other words, there’s no guarantee that Wang Ping and the others could safely complete the group task this time,
If something unexpected happened, they might face a situation where death was the only outcome given the significant disparity in their powers.
It could be said that the emergence of the enigma in these two worlds placed a heavy burden on the spirits of the group members in the Transmigrator Chat Group, even giving them a suffocating feeling.
In the past, they were tempted by the substantial benefits Liu Mei obtained.
Then, they fell into a panic due to the simultaneous appearance of enigmas and were even more chilled due to the Enigma of Dreams in Fang Yun’s world.
Now, they were startled by Wang Pings conjecture.
In essence, they had been overly optimistic last time – treating enigmas as if they were prized possessions led to them courting death.
Wang Ping (66): “Of course, all of this is just my conjecture. What we need to do ultimately won’t change; we can only forge ahead stubbornly. Alright, I’m going off the grid now. The earlier we finish the task according to the plan, the earlier we can return.’
After saying that, Wang Ping went off the grid.
Zhang Hu, Qin Tian, Chen Yao, and Lin Yuanyuan also silently went off the grid.
As for Wu Jun and the others, they all didn’t feel like chatting anymore and followed suit.
For a moment, the group chat calmed down once again.
A silence like death.
No one had time to mourn for the deaths of Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun, two predecessor transmigrators. They could only push forward with all their might.
Otherwise, the same outcome awaited them.
Half a month later, in a royal city, the Pope of Light was preaching at the city center.
Surrounding him, the Church of Radiance’s warriors maintained order and protected the Pope.
Additionally, concealed Light Arcane Gods were ready to launch defensive-type forbidden curses at any time.
And Wang Ping, Qin Tian, Chen Yao, and Lin Yuanyuan were all lurking, waiting for the right opportunity.
Just as the Pope’s speech reached its climax, and everyone relaxed somewhat, Wang Ping, Qin Tian, and Chen Yao’s eyes suddenly sharpened, and they went into action.
The Illusion Array that had been set up beforehand was instantly activated, enveloping the Pope and his company.
“No good!” The complexion of the Light Arcane God changed, and he was about to cast a forbidden curse, only for Wang Ping to appear before him as if he were a ghost. Wang Ping exerted his maximum speed and strength, struck the Light Arcane God directly into a blood fog, and killed him instantaneously.
Then, Wang Ping quickly rushed into the Illusion Array and targeted the Pope of Light.
The Pope of Light, trapped in the Illusion Array, was totally unaware as he was easily knocked out by Wang Ping.
This eased Wang Pings worries.
It seemed that there was no connection between the enigmas.
Or, at the very least, there was no connection between these two enigmas.
Otherwise, things wouldn’t have gone so smoothly.
Just now, Wang Ping was prepared to claim rewards at the critical moment and forcefully increase his combat power.
“Lin Yuanyuan, quickly drain his power!”
Wang Ping shouted, using his power to roll Lin Yuanyuan over.
Lin Yuanyuan also didn’t hesitate at all. The moment she arrived, she gritted her teeth, ripped apart her clothes, stripped off the Pope’s robe, and began draining his power.
Soon, the Pope was visibly drained at an alarming rate with his power being transferred to Lin Yuanyuan. This made Lin Yuanyuan appear somewhat divine at this moment.
Of course, considering her present situation, it seemed a bit blasphemous.
However, no one at the scene cared about that. They knew they would be facing an even bigger problem.
Sure enough, an incredibly terrifying energy floated out of the Pope’s body
and exploded into a blinding light.
“Retreat!”
Seeing this burst of light, Wang Pings pupils shrank sharply, and he yelled in anxiety in his mind.
Immediately afterward, they all turned into white lights and disappeared from the spot.
At the very moment of their retreat, the divine power of the Light Lord God exploded, sweeping everything around it.
Everything here was reduced to ashes!

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 110: New Chat Group Feature! New
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 110: New Chat Group Feature! New
Blue Talent
Translator: 549690339
“Finally back. That was really dangerous this time.”
After returning to the building, Wang Ping felt the vibrations of Qi and Blood within his body and was very apprehensive.
If he had returned a second later, he would have been seriously injured or even killed.
The power of the Light Lord God was just too strong.
Wang Ping had always wondered what level the Light Lord God’s power was at.
It seemed that even just the power that the Light Lord God had granted to the Pope of Light was at least on the level of the Profound Elixir Realm.
And the fighting power of the Light Lord God’s true body must surpass the Profound Elixir Realm by at least two levels.
“The ceiling level of the fantasy world where Zhang Hu is isn’t low either.”
Wang Ping murmured.
“Ding, congratulations on contributing 50% in this Group Task, reward
300,000 Group Points.”
“300,000, not bad.”
Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Now he had a total of 800,000 Group Points, including this 300,000.
He wondered if Lin Yuanyuan would follow Liu Mei t s example and send him a large red envelope for bringing her along to complete the Group Task and receiving huge benefits from it.
“Ding, Lin Yuanyuan has sent you an exclusive red envelope.”
At this moment, a system notification sound rang out from the chat group, causing Wang Pings eyes to flash slightly.
He opened the chat group and clicked on the exclusive red envelope.
“Ding, you have received 150,000 Group Points!”
“150,000, half as much. Lin Yuanyuan is generous and knows how to socialize.’
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Thank you, Mr. Wang, for helping me gain such great powers and for bringing me back alive. This is just a token of my appreciation.”
Zhang Hu (5): “F*ck, I only got 10,000 Group Points from this Group Task, Lin
Yuanyuan you gave out 150,000 Group Points, so lavish!”
Chen Yao (71): “Indeed lavish. I got 30,000 Group Points this time, not bad.”
Qin Tian (77): “I got a bit more, around 50,000. The Array Plate is really useful.’
Just as the people in the group were chatting, a system notification sound rang out again.
“Ding, detected that group members have killed five Unusuals, group sign-in function and group strengthening function unlocked. You can strengthen your body or a certain power using points, the specific cost depends on the level of power. At the same time, the System Mall has added one item and an automatic vending function, group members can check it out.”
Wang Ping looked at this system notification and was slightly startled.
Group sign-in function was considered a new benefit.
Signing in once a day would earn a certain amount of Group Points.
“Sign in.”
Wang Ping chose to sign in.
“Ding, sign-in successful, you received 9 Group Points.”
“Not bad, although it’s not much at a time, but the advantage is that it accumulates over time. As long as you sign in every day, even ordinary members can slowly become stronger. That way, the mortality rate will be greatly reduced after crossing worlds, as long as they don’t die on the spot. This chat group has been ridiculed by us quite a bit, but will still reform itself in the end.’
Wang Pings eyes brightened as he murmured in his heart.
By signing in to receive Group Points and then using points to strengthen one’s body or a certain learned skill, one can gradually become stronger.
As long as one can become stronger, and with the existence of the golden finger, one can better deal with various crises, and the future is promising.
Next, Wang Ping opened the System Niall again, wanting to see what new item the system had added.
When Wang Ping saw the introduction of this item, he was slightly taken aback.
Golden Finger Refresh Card
Price: 100,000 Group Points
Function: Spend 100,000 Group Points and redraw a Golden Finger.
PS: Unlimited purchase. However, each time you purchase, the Group Points needed for the next purchase will increase.
“This item is pretty good.”
Wang Pings eyes lit up.
You should know that the biggest cheat for transmigrators is the golden finger.
But some transmigrators have quite ordinary golden fingers.
Therefore, the gap between transmigrators can sometimes be even bigger than between humans and dogs.
If they can get enough Group Points, refresh new golden fingers, they might be able to counterattack.
This is an item that increases the chance of a counterattack for transmigrators.
Of course, he didn’t need this thing since he already had the Life Simulator, which was already one of the top golden fingers.
Then, Wang Ping studied the auction function of the System Mall.
This function was also quite simple, just like the auction, group members can upload their items, set a price, and have other group members buy them. However, the chat group would take a 10% handling fee.
“This function is not bad either. From now on, transactions in the group can be evaluated by the chat group and conducted with Group Points. Group Points can finally play the role of currency. Although a 10% handling fee will be taken, it’s easy. For example, with Cultivation Skills, after uploading them to the Mall, other group members can purchase them without having to trade one by one.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
“However, the chat group’s reform seems to be aimed at having a large number of group members to work properly. But given the current death rate of the chat group, having a large number of group members is still very difficult.’
Wang Ping shook his head, unable to understand what the mastermind behind the Transmigrator Chat Group was thinking and what their purpose was.
In the end, he and the other group members were nothing more than forced laborers, risking their lives for something they didn’t even understand..

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 110: New Group Chat Features! New
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 110: New Group Chat Features! New
Blue Talent 2
Translator: 549690339
Soon after, Wang Ping withdrew his thoughts and returned to the chat page.
At the same time, the chat group was buzzing again.
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, this time the chat group reform is a bit drastic. It seems that the chat group has finally started to pay attention to the lives of the group members.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Indeed, it’s about time, Otherwise, we’ll really be at our wits’ end. Dangerous missions keep cropping up, and the damn rewards are too little. Who can bear it? This is ten thousand times more exploitative than capitalist.”
Qin Tian (77): “Well, aren’t you brave, daring to criticize like that in the group.”
Zhang Jun (70): “To speak or not to speak, it’s all the same. As if we can hide our thoughts.”
Chen Yao (71): “l feel the same.’
Wang Ping (66): “I believe that for some time in the future, there shouldn’t be any dangerous missions. If we continue like this, we’re bound to be wiped out sooner or later. The reform of the chat group is apparently aiming to cultivate more group members. Moreover, new types of missions might appear.
Otherwise, the added selling function in the System Mall doesn’t make much sense. ”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, I’m feeling like Mr. Wang is setting up a death flag here.’
Zhang Jun (70): “It doesn’t matter what happens. Let it be, we can’t really change anything. I’m going to log off and heal my wounds. I lost an arm this time, I’m too miserable.’
Looking at Zhang Jun’s comments, everyone else was once again filled with heaviness in their hearts.
Wang Ping shook his head, sighed, and closed the chat group. He wasn’t in the mood to continue chatting.
As for why the group system updated so greatly after killing the five strange creatures, Wang Ping didn’t feel like pondering it.
“Time to collect the reward. This time, what should I choose.’
Wang Ping pulled up the reward page of the paid simulation, pondering in his mind.
1.Cultivation in the Early Stage of the Spirit Accumulation Realm.
2.Green Talent.Magic Genius.
Various Secret Skills for cultivation.
4.Elixir-refining Experience.
5.80% of Peak Sword Spirit.
6.Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky Stick.
The option of cultivation is definitely not to be chosen for now, otherwise the subsequent consumption will be high.
If you want to refresh a strong talent, you need to accumulate attempts, which will result in a loss if the consumption is high.
Of course, this is also the reason why it’s pointless to obtain cultivation, as it would hamper progress.
If choosing cultivation could break some barriers, Wang Ping would definitely choose it.
“First, let’s increase the combat strength. All those secret skills, Sword Spirit, combat experience and the like all have to be improved. Otherwise, my realm and my other abilities really don’t match.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and was about to make his choice, when he realized something.
Those who practice magic are often powerful in terms of soul strength and mental power.
Because, in fact, a sorcerer casts magic by using mental power to mobilize the magical elements in the outer world, and you can also use the mana accumulated in your body to cast magic, but just relying on your own mana wouldn’t get you far, it isn’t sustainable.
Therefore, a magician will be affected once they reach a place where magical elements are scarce.
However, what Wang Ping is considering is not this, but that magicians are undoubtedly outstanding in mental power, and have a strong type of soul power.
In other words, their talents in the field of the soul are all excellent.
And doesn’t Wang Ping need a talent in the area of the soul?
This Magic Genius completely fulfills his requirement.
For a moment, Wang Ping felt a chill in his heart.
He had been so focused on missions and combat power that he almost missed the talent he needed.
If he had realized a bit later, he truly would have suffered a great loss.
“System, I choose Q. Green TalenteMagic Genius and O. Sea and Sky Staff.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
The Sea and Sky Staff, a profound artifact, is very hard to come by.
Apart from a few reward opportunities, there’s only one item reward.
So naturally, the staff is his choice.
As for the Sword Spirit, Secret Skills, they can all be acquired in the following simulations, no need to hurry.
After all, when choosing rewards, the more scarce the item the more valuable.
Of course, it still needs to be something of great use to oneself, otherwise it still can’t be chosen.
“Ding, selection successful.”
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his mind becoming clearer, his perception sharper, and the area his spiritual sense could cover became greater.
However, this was only because he was no longer in the fantasy world. Otherwise, Wang Ping would definitely be able to easily mobilize the magical elements in the air, and these magical elements were very compatible with him.
As Wang Ping was experiencing his changes, an item appeared in his Storage Spirit Ring.
However, due to the fact that his Storage Spirit Ring was only of medium level, a very terrifying aura leaked out.
That was…the aura of a profound artifact.
“This is bad!”
After seeing the Sea-Sky Stick, Wang Pings face changed.
He didn’t expect the aura of the profound artifact to be so powerful.
Immediately, Wang Ping used his spiritual essence to seal the Storage Spirit Ring, trying to prevent it from leaking any further aura.
Then, he bolted into the sky and flew towards the distance.
He knew trouble was brewing.
The aura from the profound artifact was too strong and there were many cultivators in Seven Star City where he was. There were a fair number of strong individuals, who would definitely notice the abnormality.
If the news reached the Seven Star Palace, under the lure of huge benefits, Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun would not consider any friendship. He would definitely take action against Wang Ping..

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 110: New Chat Group Feature! New Blue Talent 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 110: New Chat Group Feature! New Blue Talent 3
_
Translator: 549690339
After all, the value of a Profound instrument is enormous, and it is a treasure that only Profound Elixir Realm masters have the qualifications to possess.
Even the ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters may not necessarily have a Profound instrument.
As for the Sea Ape Clan, it is guessed that their ancestors were extravagant; otherwise, they wouldn’t have the qualifications to possess Profound instruments.
Even if they owned a Profound instrument, they previously hid it and didn’t dare to expose it, let alone use it casually.
Because once exposed, it might attract the attention of many half-step Profound Elixir Realm masters.
Furthermore, even those ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters might try to snatch it.
Even if the Profound instrument was stolen, the Sea Ape Clan could only say that it is a Supreme Treasure and not reveal the details.
As the influence would be too great.
When Wang Ping rushed out, many powerful practitioners in Seven Star City also looked at Wang Ping, all showing different colors, and followed him in pursuit.
There was no doubt that the breath just now was definitely not a spiritual tool, it was absolutely a Profound instrument.
A Profound instrument is an invaluable existence for cultivators in the Transcendent Realm. and it cannot be missed.
Although Wang Ping is a 7th tier alchemist and a powerful Spiritual Fetus
Realm cultivator, he is not qualified to own such a treasure.
“Wait, how is this guy’s speed so fast?”
However, those cultivators who wanted to chase were shocked to find that Wang Pings speed was too fast, and he soon disappeared from their sight.
This made them feel incredulous.
Why would a Spiritual Fetus Realm cultivator have such a fast flying speed? It was somewhat unreasonable.
It should be known that even Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivators do not have such speed.
These cultivators looked at each other and chose not to continue chasing Wang Ping, but instead immediately used means to notify the forces they belonged to.
By using the intelligence network of the forces, they could track Wang Pings whereabouts in the shortest time.
Moreover, Wang Ping is, after all, a Spiritual Fetus Realm cultivator and has cultivated both mana and physique separately, so his combat power must be extremely strong and not easily dealt with by ordinary Transcendent Realm cultivators.
On a deserted island far away from the Seven Stars Archipelago, Wang Ping secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he found that no one was chasing him.
“This was a lesson. 1 need to get a high-quality Storage Spirit Ring as soon as possible; otherwise, with a low-level Storage Spirit Ring, the hidden danger is too great.”
Wang Ping sighed after he was safe.
He had been cautious for so long, but he was exposed in this way, which made him helpless.
“I’ll simulate once first, and see if I’ll encounter any dangers later. If I’m going to die, I should consider increasing my combat power or returning to the Profound Turtle Continent as soon as possible.” After Wang Ping calmed down, he murmured.
“System, I want to start the paid simulation.”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping said in his heart.
Although free simulations are good, it is still better to do paid simulations at this time.
Because if there is a sudden attack, at least there are rewards to choose from.
“Ding, this paid simulation requires the consumption of 10,000 Mid-tier Spirit Stones. Do you want to proceed with the consumption?”
The system voice sounded.
“Consume.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Ding, consumption successful, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress. ”
The system voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death.”
Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death – In the simulation, the host can transfer the memory images before his death each time he dies.
“Blue Talent!”
Wang Ping was surprised looking at this talent.
He didn’t expect that he would be so lucky as to refresh another Blue Talent once again.
However, the ability of this Blue Talent is not to enhance his power, but to help him with intelligence-related talents.
“This is a useful talent. Many times, the description of death in the Life Simulator is not detailed. I don’t know where the simulated Wang Ping died or how he died. With this talent, it will be of great help to me and help me avoid many dangers.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered as he evaluated this talent in his heart.
“Ding, Talent loading successful, Life Simulation starts.”
As Wang Ping was evaluating, the system’s voice sounded again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text appeared as well.
[Day 1: You did not choose to escape back to the Profound Turtle Continent but thought of some things. If others find the Stele Array, you will lose a means of saving your life. Therefore, you must wait for some time to see if these people will find it here.]
[Day 3: You noticed something unusual. Strange monster beasts were finding their way here, following the breath left by your flight. You became alarmed and knew there was no hiding from it. However, you didn’t immediately return to the Profound Turtle Continent because if you did, you might be trapped and die there. If you don’t destroy the Stele Array, you will face endless enemies.]
[If you’re trapped on the Profound Turtle Continent, your cultivation may stagnate in the Transcendent Realm forever, and it’s very difficult to progress further. This is something you can’t tolerate.]
[You chose to take action and kill that monster beast. Then, you began to fight against the cultivators who chased after you. At first, you only unleashed the combat power of a Nine Stars Martial Saint to defeat the enemies, but as the Spirit Accumulation Realm powerhouses appeared, you were forced to enter the Berserk State and use the power of your Profound instrument to kill them.]
[However, when you killed a Spirit Accumulation Realm powerhouse, Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun appeared. He reasoned with you and invited you to join Seven Star Palace, where he could protect you.]
[You refused. In response, Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun no longer concealed his intentions and chose to attack you. You showed no fear, using your Profound instrument to clash with him head-on. However, you underestimated the strength of Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yune As a half-step Profound Elixir Realm powerhouse who has lived for two lifetimes, nearly a thousand years of cultivation, even a pig could have become skilled in that time.]
[And Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun is certainly not a pig; on the contrary, he is very talented. A thousand years of polishing has allowed him to gain a deep understanding of various Cultivation Skills and Martial Skills, as well as mastering various Secret Skills. However, the strongest aspect is his comprehension of the Concept Realm. The Concept Realm he understood has reached the level of small perfection, which is another level of comprehension.]
[You were wounded by a single blow from Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun, and even your Martial Master Golden Body was shattered in places. You felt that you were too arrogant before. These old fiends were not simple, and the difference in cultivation time was fatal.]
[Therefore, you could no longer hide. You used the Five Elements Spirit Body, deployed the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill secret technique, wielded the Sea and Sky Staff to unleash the Sunset Sword Skill, and burst with the most powerful fighting force, wanting to battle Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun and kill him..]

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent!
Translator: 549690339
[You burst out with all your trump cards, going all out with your firepower, but you still can’t overcome Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, and you continue to be suppressed. Your anxiety starts to rise. On the other hand, amidst his shock, Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun grows increasingly delighted. That’s because he never expected you to have Heaven-tier
Cultivation Skills and Martial Skills. If he could get all the good things on you, his future would be promising!]
[As a result, Seven Stars Ancestor becomes ruthless, using Secret Skills to forcibly increase his combat power. Faced with his vicious tactics, you plunge into a massive disadvantage, In the end, you grit your teeth and choose to find the opportunity to self-destruct, leaving Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun badly injured. Seizing the chance to revive through the Rebirth Tally, you resurrect and launch a mad attack on Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun.]
[In the end, you succeed in killing Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun by using the self-destructive method of killing an enemy at the cost of your own severe losses. Next, you snatch his Storage Spirit Ring, break out of the encirclement, and flee back to the deserted island where the Stele Array is. You activate the Stele Array and successfully teleport back to Profound Turtle Continent.]
[After returning to the Profound Turtle Continent, you immediately destroy a part of the Stele Array to prevent anyone from teleporting over.]
“l still overestimated my own strength. Indeed, it is arrogant to blindly guess what level one’s own strength can rival without actually fighting.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and sighed.
He initially thought he could already challenge a half-step Profound Elixir Realm master, but it seems he overestimated himself.
Now he had an additional Profound Artifact, even if it wasn’t a sword, it should still significantly boost his combat power.
However, even so, he could only severely damage Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun through self-destruction and then kill him after resurrecting through the Rebirth Tally.
It’s evident just how powerful half-step Profound Elixir Realm masters are.
This is just an ordinary half-step Profound Elixir Realm master. If he were to encounter one from the Eastern Desolation’s Great Sects, the power would be unimaginable.
“Living a long life makes one strong. These old monsters may have lower-ranked Cultivation Techniques and Martial Skills than mine, but they have fused and comprehended so much through their cultivation, reaching Great Perfection, their combat power is still very high. What’s even more terrifying is their comprehension of various aspects, making them difficult to kill easily.”
Wang Ping sighed.
His current Sword Spirit is only at the peak of the 6th Tier.
Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s comprehension of the Stellar Intent, on the other hand, reached a terrifying stage of Minor Perfection.
It is known that from 30% to 90% is Achieved Intent, and the gap between each 10% is significant.
Minor Perfection is a tier above 90%, and the increase in combat power is absolutely terrifying.
He only managed to kill Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun through self-destruction and resurrection. If they fought normally, Wang Pings chances of losing would be higher.
Soon after, Wang Ping calms his emotions and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you start recuperating. After your injuries heal, you return to the Sword Spirit Sect and quietly cultivate, occasionally training Bai Tianhong and others.]
[Because you obtained Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s Storage Spirit Ring, the resources within are enough for you to cultivate for a long time. Therefore, you don’t need to worry for the time being and can focus on cultivation.]
[Thirty years later, your cultivation successfully breaks through to the late stage of the Spirit Embryo Realm. You personally ambush Demon MO Fan and kill him. Then, you destroy his Demonic Skill, preventing Ye Chen from cultivating it. At the same time, you have already sealed the area around the Demon’s Cave.]
[Thirty years later, your cultivation has made progress, reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the Spiritual Fetus Realm. However, since you no longer have materials for refining Soul-opening Elixirs, you know that this time you can only rely on yourself to break through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[Nevertheless, you still have some confidence, as your special talent, Demonic Genius, strengthens your soul abilities.]
[Fifty years later, by relying on yourself, you finally break through to the Early
Stage of Spiritual Accumulation Realm. You consider returning to the Seven Stars Archipelago, but considering there might be a bunch of people waiting for you there, you ultimately decide to give up.]
[You continue to quietly cultivate in the Sword Spirit Sect. Eighty years later, your cultivation improved again, reaching the Mid-Yun Ling Region. You’re not completely satisfied with this speed, but it’s still acceptable.]
[However, you think it’s time to prepare for your second life. After all, trapped in the Profound Turtle Continent, you might not be able to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. It’s better to make preparations early, endure for a few hundred more years, and then think about leaving. By then, all those watching you may have died, and you wouldn’t have to worry about anything.]
[You think your idea is good and continue to endure. However, you also think of Ye Chen’s situation. Without Demonic Cultivators and the Rings Old
Grandfather, plus no other strong people able to reach Profound Turtle
Continent, Ye Chen has finally stopped causing trouble.]
[You believe that even the Heavenly Lone Star should still be logical. With no power threatening you, it can’t be easily triggered. Of course, you’re not overly careless either, often strengthening the seal around the Demon’s Cave to prevent Ye Chen from breaking in.]
[Ye Chen’s current cultivation level is stuck at the half-step Transcendent Realm. If nothing unexpected happens, he won’t have the ability to break the seal and enter the Demon’s Cave..]

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent! 2
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred years passed, and your cultivation has improved, reaching the Late Stage of Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[However, because you didn’t help them, both Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong had no power to enter the Transcendent Realm and passed away within the Sword Spirit Sect. You sighed in your heart, realizing that the fortune of the Son of Fortune is not omnipotent. If they don’t trigger certain conditions, they will be stuck in a bottleneck and eventually wither away.]
[While feeling emotional about this, you also breathed a sigh of relief. Since the fortune of the Son of Fortune is not invincible, you don’t need to worry too much about meeting other Sons of Fortune in the future.]
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred and fifty years passed, and your cultivation had another breakthrough, reaching the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm. However, at this point, you’re not far from withering away. Although you can prolong your life for sixty years in theory by taking 7th tier Longevity Elixir, due to the lack of materials, you can’t refine it, and you can only live for about thirty more years.]
[You look back on your life, knowing all the familiar people are dead, and feel somewhat lonely and desolate in your heart. However, you still haven’t given up the idea of cultivation and prolonged life, and begin to truly prepare for living a second time.]
[In the blink of an eye, another thirty-three years passed, and you’ve grown old, your life will soon come to an end. But after many years of focused cultivation, you successfully comprehended 90% Sword Spirit just before passing away.]
[Next, you left the prosperous Sword Spirit Sect and secretly took possession of a newborn offsprings body in the outside world. You successfully lived a second life.]
[Due to the strong Divine Soul and your hundreds of years of cultivation experience, even though the new bodys aptitude is not as good as your original strengthened body, your cultivating speed is still quite fast, much faster than when you first started.]
[At the age of eight, you reached the Postnatal Realm, and at eight and a half, you entered the Innate Realm, followed by the Spiritual Essence Realm at nine, and the Spirit Sea Realm at ten and a half. By fifteen and a half, you had cultivated to the peak of the Spirit Sea Realm.]
[However, because you hastily returned to the Profound Turtle Continent, you didn’t have the Five Elements Spiritual Object prepared. Although there’s a 6th Tier Earth-elemental spirit in the Storage Spirit Ring of Seven Stars Ancestor which you carefully protected for so many years, it’s still lacking four elements for your breakthrough.]
[Just when you were worried about this, at the age of sixteen, you accidentally activated the Five Elements Spirit Body. You are both surprised and delighted because not every offspring can activate their Spirit Body.]
[Once the descendants possess the Five Elements Spirit Body, they might not need spirit materials for a breakthrough to the Spiritual Fetus Realm. Although using spirit materials again to breakthrough and experiencing Heavenly Tribulation would make their Spirit Body stronger, possibly surpassing their ancestors, they can also achieve breakthroughs on their own without the need for spirit materials. It’s just that it’s difficult for ordinary people to achieve this.]
[In the end, the biggest difference between Spiritual Fetus Realm and Spirit Sea Realm is the Spirit Body, and then the strength of the physical body. Now that your Spirit Body has activated, all you need to do is strengthen your physical body to match the strength of a true Spiritual Fetus Realm strongman, and you can be considered one of them.]
[Ordinary Spiritual Fetus Realm descendants and Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivators who live a second life find it difficult to refine their physical body to that level on their own, so they can only rely on spiritual materials for breakthrough and accept the baptism of Heavenly Tribulation. However, you are different because you have the High Martial System which can easily strengthen your physical body.]
[So, you temporarily put aside your cultivation and began to study the High Martial System in depth.]
[While you were cultivating diligently, strange phenomena suddenly occurred on the Profound Turtle Continent. The entire continent shook, and endless dark energy began to spread from the Xia Royal Family Forbidden Area. Anything touched by the dark energy turned into blood.]
[You, who were cultivating at the time, detected the anomaly and your face changed drastically. You hurriedly flew high into the sky.]
[Then, high in the sky, you saw a terrifying sight. Everywhere you looked, there was a black mist, and wherever the black mist reached, all living beings were either decayed or turned into blood.]
[Even if you stared at the black mist for a little longer, you would start to show signs of being possessed by demons, causing your scalp to tingle. You started to fly higher with your eyes closed to prevent getting infected by the black mist.]
[When you flew high enough, you discovered something. The shape of the Profound Turtle Continent resembled a giant turtle.]
[As you were in doubt, a terrifying aura suddenly erupted, sweeping across the entire Profound Turtle Continent and extending to the surrounding sea regions.]
[Where the aura reached, the black mist dispersed. No matter the level of the monster beast, all their bodies exploded, turning the sea into blood. You were also caught in the calamity, your Divine Soul and physical body shattered in an instant, dying completely.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended…]
“Profound Turtle Continent! Profound Turtle Continent!”
Wang Ping was deeply shocked by the simulation content.
At first, he was just curious about the peculiar name of the Profound Turtle
Continent.
Now it seems that the name of the Profound Turtle Continent carries deep implications.
Is the Profound Turtle Continent really a continent?
Could it be that the true form of the Profound Turtle Continent is a Profound Turtle?
And the so-called continent is just on the back of the Profound Turtle.
If that’s the case, it’s too terrifying – what level of existence is this Profound Turtle?

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 111: The Truth of Profound Turtle Continent! _3
Translator: 549690339
Apart from that, what are those dark energies, and why did they appear so strangely above the Profound Turtle Continent?
No, they should have emerged from inside the Xia Royal Family Forbidden Area!
Then, Wang Ping also thought of the feeling of palpitations and the strange trial ground he felt in the forbidden area. He couldn’t help feeling chills crawling down his spine.
“Could the forbidden area and trial place be a Sealed Land? What terrifying existence is sealed inside? It’s likely to be a horrifying demon leader.”
Wang Pings face turned extremely ugly.
“And these dark energies are the demon’s spirit escaping as the demon tries to break through the seal. The aura that appeared in this simulation belongs to the Profound Turtle, and it is suppressing the demon, stabilizing the seal.”
“Mmp, I even went to that forbidden land before. Thinking about it now, it was like walking on a tightrope hanging over a cliff.”
Wang Ping felt chills in his heart and smiled bitterly.
To undergo a trial in the land where the huge demon’s sealed for the sake of a lower-tier spirit tool, he was stupid to the core.
However, who would have known that such a secret awaited him?.
“If it’s true, the secret hidden on this Profound Turtle Continent is truly terrifying. ”
After a pause, Wang Ping took a light breath, calmed his emotions, and muttered to himself.
What is the origin of this sealed demon, and why was it sealed here?
And what is the origin of the Profound Turtle?
Apart from that, why are the people who left the Profound Turtle Continent despised as ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’…
Could it be that just because of their connection with the Profound Turtle’s aura, they are considered ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’?
Indeed, considering the strength of the Profound Turtle, its aura could be understood to last for hundreds or even thousands of years.
However, Wang Ping couldn’t comprehend some things.
Even though the Profound Turtle sealed a powerful demon leader, it eliminated a great threat to the world. Why were they despised by the Holy Lands and Great Sects?
For a moment, Wang Ping thought about many things, and his mind was a mess.
comprehend.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
Perfect cultivation of the Spirit Accumulation Realm.
9th-tier Sword Spirit.
Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill with 500 years of cultivation experience.
Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death.
Sunset Sword Skill with 500 years of cultivation experience.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
With 90% Sword Spirit, Wang Pings combat power had multiplied. However, having learned from this simulation, Wang Ping wouldn’t be overly boastful, as it would make it easy for him to be humiliated.
Thus, he only used conjecture.
“Next, let’s continue the simulation. The secret of the Profound Turtle
Continent doesn’t need to be dealt with for now, as soon as I become strong enough, I will naturally know everything. Now, let’s focus on leveling up and dealing with the current crisis.”
Wang Pings eyes shone brightly, deep in thought.
“System, I want to initiate a paid simulation again.”
Then, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, a paid simulation requires consumption of 10,000 mid-tier spiritual stones. Will the host proceed with the consumption?”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Consume.” Wang Ping nodded.
“Ding, consumption successful, the host has a remaining 170,000 mid-tier spiritual stones, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress…” The system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for not refreshing any talent.”
“… After hitting the bottom, it started to get worse again, huh.” Wang Pings face darkened, and he couldn’t help but complain.
“Ding, Life Simulation begins.”
[Day 1, you know that you will be found sooner or later, so you leave this deserted island and take the initiative to attack, without leaving yourself to be trapped. You believe that even if you really face the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, you would rather kill him in a place with no one around.
Otherwise, if your Heavenly-tier Skill is exposed, you will be in even more trouble.]
[In the following days, you encounter many strong enemies in succession but deal with them easily. Finally, you are cornered by Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun and some Transcendent Realm Masters of the Seven Star Palace. You engage in a fierce battle with them.]
[You go all out right from the beginning, entering the Berserk State and using all your means to suppress and beat up Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yune You severely injure him, and he tries to escape, but he is ultimately killed by you.]
[Afterward, you want to kill everyone else, but this group of people is very cunning and starts scattering in different directions when they see that the situation is not right. You cannot catch up with them.]
[You feel helpless, knowing that the matter of the Heavenly-tier Skill will eventually be exposed. Therefore, you continue to escape, You return to the Seven Stars Archipelago, slaughter in all directions, and then use the teleportation array of the Archipelago to teleport continuously..]

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 112: Breaking Through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 112: Breaking Through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!
Translator: 549690339
[After several transfers, you’ve hidden your identity and arrived at Sacred Heart Island, where you began to cultivate in secret.]
[Thirty years have passed, and your cultivation has successfully broken through to the Late-stage Spirit Embryo Realm.]
[Thirty years later, your cultivation has made progress, reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the Spiritual Fetus Realm.]
[In the tenth year after breaking through to the Perfect Spiritual Embryo Realm, you successfully refined the 7th tier Elixir – Soul-opening Elixir using the elixir refining materials you’d collected and easily broke through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[Next, you started collecting Tool Refining Materials, wanting someone to forge an exclusive top-tier Spirit Sword for you to nurture in your Soul Palace, growing stronger alongside you.]
[In the blink of an eye, eighty years had passed. Your top-tier spiritual tool
had long been successfully forged and was now nurtured in your Soul Palace. Meanwhile, your cultivation had progressed, reaching the Mid-Yun Ling
Region.]
[Just as you were planning to continue cultivating, you were confronted by a
Profound Elixir Realm master. He demanded you hand over your Heaven-tier Skill and Profound instrument. You were shocked and furious, not knowing how your cover was blown.]
[In the end, you were forced into battle, attempting to kill him with a suicidal explosion, but you failed. The gap between your cultivations was too vast, and this Profound Elixir Realm master easily stopped your self-destruction.]
[Due to the Rebirth tally, you were revived, but could only despair and once again self-destruct, dying in the process.]
[With your death, this simulation ends.]
“Are these experts like dogs with an exceptional sense of smell? All these years of hiding from the world, and they can still find me. Or is it because of my purchases of materials that I eventually drew attention from those with ulterior motives?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his expression serious. Although he now already possessed the power to kill Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun, killing him would expose too much and attract more greed from others.
The Profound instrument, oh Profound instrument, it’s truly a hot potato.
“It seems I need to dispose of the Profound instrument as soon as possible. Although this staff-type instrument can enhance my combat abilities, it’s ultimately not a sword. The further I progress, the less helpful it is. It’d be better to trade it away for more resources. Besides, with the Profound instrument out of my hands, there won’t be that many people targeting me.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered, considering some ideas.
As Wang Ping was lost in thought, his vision suddenly changed. He found himself in a strange place.
There were beautiful mountains and rivers here, very picturesque.
In this place, there was also a very simple hut. In front of the hut, on a stone stool, a person was meditating with closed eyes.
This person’s appearance was exactly the same as his, except he appeared to be middle-aged, showing more vicissitudes of life. “Is this a simulated future scene?”
Wang Ping looked at this and was incredibly surprised.
Right, he had previously gained a new talent.
Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death – the ability to see memories of
Clearly, the power of this talent had been triggered just now. “God’s point of view, what a strange feeling.”
Wang Ping scanned his surroundings and murmured to himself.
Soon, Wang Ping saw a shadowy man in black appear here, disturbing the middle-aged Wang Ping who was cultivating.
With a serious face, Middle-aged Wang Ping asked who the visitor was and what his intentions were.
“Hand over the Heavenly tier Skills, Martial Skills, and Profound instrument you possess. 1 can spare your life and let you become a servant,” the haughty Shadow Profound Elixir Realm expert spoke.
“In your dreams.” Middle-aged Wang Ping was shocked and angered. He put forth his strongest attack, unleashing a terrifying strike, but it was wiped out with a casual swipe from the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm expert.
Then, with just one casual strike, the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm expert left Middle-aged Wang Ping in a near-death state, intending to capture him alive.
Despairing, Middle-aged Wang Ping could only self-destruct.
After the self-destruction, he self-destructed once again.
Watching this scene, Wang Ping could only sigh.
A gap in one Great Realm and several minor realms made the difference in their prowess as vast as a chasm, insurmountable. Even though they had powerful cultivation skills and martial techniques, entered Berserk State, and possessed a Profound instrument, they were still like ants in front of their opponent, insignificant.
“Profound Elixir Realm expert, I’ll remember you.”
Wang Ping stared deeply at this Shadow Profound Elixir Realm expert, memorizing his appearance and murmuring to himself.
Watching the clear scenes in the simulation didn’t have much of an impact, but seeing himself being killed in this clear scene made it hard for him to calm down.
Of course, Wang Ping was not just seeking ‘revenge’, but being cautious in future simulations.
While others hadn’t detected his true identity, this person had, clearly possessing secret skills or an intelligence network that others lacked.
Such a person was extremely dangerous.
As he had exposed his Profound instrument now, the possibility of confronting him in the future was high, so he had to be on guard.
Soon, the scene disappeared, and Wang Pings vision returned to normal.
At this moment, the system’s voice also sounded.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
Mid-stage of Spirit Containment Realm cultivation.
Various Secret Skills.
Cultivation Skill Practice Insights.
Martial Skill Cultivation Insights.
Elixir-refining Experience.”
“System, I choose 2.”
After some consideration, Wang Ping made his decision.
In the past, he had neglected Secret Skills due to more valuable rewards..

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 112: Breaking Through the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 112: Breaking Through the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!_2
Translator: 549690339
The Secret Skill is actually very valuable as well.
Among them, there might be Secret Skills that can trigger explosive power, as well as those to track and conceal one’s aura.
Such Secret Skills are essential when traveling outside.
During Wang Pings previous simulation, he was discovered on the second day because monster beasts could trace him through his aura.
If he could hide his aura, there might not be such problems.
As Wang Ping made his choice, all kinds of information appeared in his mind.
There were quite a few Secret Skills, learned throughout Wang Pings simulated life.
There were intermediate secret skills to boost combat power by overdrawing blood essence, as well as those for searching, concealing aura, and changing appearance. There were even strange beast taming secret skills.
“The help of these Secret Skills is significant to me. Next, let’s see if I can escape the search of Seven Stars Ancestor and others. If I can, that would be good. ”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
Then, Wang Ping muttered in his heart, “System, I want to start a new Paid
Simulation.’
“Ding, Paid Simulation requires spending 10,000 mid-tier spirit stones, do you want to consume now?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Consume.”
Wang Ping replied.
“Ding, consumption successful, host’s remaining mid-tier spirit stone count is 160,000. Talent refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice rang again.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for refreshing White Talent – Business Genius; talent successfully filled; life simulation begins.”
With the consecutive sound of the system, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[Day 1, you chose to conceal your aura and change locations again to avoid pursuit. You successfully escaped the hunt of Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun and began utilizing the Delivery Array of the Seven Stars Archipelago to teleport to other islands.]
[You arrived at Sacred Heart Island and started cultivating diligently. Seventy years later, you successfully broke through to the Spirit Accumulation Realm and found the auction event of the Green Moon Sect, one of the two major powers on Sacred Heart Island, where you put the Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky
Stick up for auction.]
[Your action of auctioning the Profound Artifact shocked the person in charge of the Green Moon Auction. After all, Profound Artifacts are very precious, and not every Profound Elixir Realm master on Sacred Heart Island can possess one. Therefore, this is an extremely rare treasure, which can definitely become the finale item.]
[The person in charge asked if you wanted to proceed with the auction, and you responded. Eventually, the auction began its preheating process, and the news of the Profound Artifact being auctioned shocked the entire Sacred Heart
Island, disturbing all powers.]
[Masters at the half step Profound Elixir Realm and even those at the Profound Elixir Realm were burning with desire to obtain this Profound Artifact.]
[You were full of anticipation, wondering what kind of price this Profound Artifact would fetch. As the auction proceeded smoothly, you also witnessed the fierceness of Green Moon Auction. Sixth and seventh-grade treasures, which were usually hard to see, were not rare here. Only rare seventh-grade treasures for nourishing souls were absent.]
[You participated in the auction and purchased some treasures. In the end, your Profound Artifact was auctioned off, fought over by Profound Elixir Realm masters and their powers on Sacred Heart Island; it eventually fetched a sky-high price, bought by a Supreme Elder of the Shaking Earth Sect for 500,000 high-tier spirit stones.]
[The shock in your heart reached its peak. After all, 500,000 high-tier spirit stones were equivalent to 50 million mid-tier spirit stones!]
[After the shock, you felt pleasantly surprised. Next, after receiving the spirit stones you were entitled to, you planned to leave the scene quickly without drawing attention. However, you made a mistake; not long after leaving Green Moon City, a mysterious Profound Elixir Realm master appeared and killed you on the spot, seizing your Storage Spirit Ring.]
[The instant the Profound Elixir Realm master planned to leave, you were revived, and he was shocked. He planned to capture you alive and force more secrets out of you, but knowing the outcome, you chose to self-destruct.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ended.]
“Who set the trap this time?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, feeling heavy in his heart.
He knew that even if he put the Profound Artifact up for auction, he might still be targeted, but he didn’t expect to die just after leaving the auction.
Wang Ping wondered if it was Green Moon Palace’s doing.
However, the possibility was not very high.
If Green Moon Palace did it, their reputation would be ruined once exposed.
“It seems that might not necessarily be the case… If it were a major power that didn’t care about a Profound Artifact, there would be no need to break the rules for the sake of an artifact. But if it were Green Moon Palace, it would be quite possible. After all, the strongest person in Green Moon Palace is just at the Profound Elixir Realm. 500,000 high-tier spirit stones must be a huge sum for them.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
“Sigh, it seems that I have underestimated the value of a Profound Artifact.” Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
He didn’t expect that a Profound Artifact owned by the Sea Ape Clan would drive Profound Elixir Realm masters so crazy.
Now, he understood more why the Sea Ape Clan didn’t tell anyone about their lost supreme treasure being a Profound Artifact until their death.
Otherwise, there might be Profound Elixir Realm masters from other places coming to their door every day.
Even though their Profound Artifact was lost, people always have a gambling mentality.
If you have a Profound Artifact, is there other good stuff you’re hiding as well?

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 112: Breaking Through the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 112: Breaking Through the Spirit Accumulation Realm! Blue Talent Reappears!_3
Translator: 549690339
Once such a situation occurs, the Sea Ape Clan would not be peaceful and might even face complete extinction.
As Wang Ping was thinking, his vision changed again.
In his vision, Wang Ping quickly left, but was soon caught by a Profound Elixir Realm master and killed directly.
Then, he was resurrected and exploded himself.
“That’s not right. I have a secret skill to conceal my aura. According to my plan, I wouldn’t reveal any aura starting from the Green Moon Palace auction. When I left, it was even less likely to attract the attention of other Profound Elixir Realm practitioners. However, I was still spotted and pursued.”
“This means that the other party has been watching me from the beginning. So, they must be from Green Moon Palace. Even if they are not, they are definitely related.”
Looking at this concealed Profound Elixir Realm master, Wang Ping suddenly came to his senses, his pupils constricting sharply.
Yeah, Profound Elixir Realm masters are proud and arrogant, why would they need to hide their identity when killing someone?
The Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master who killed him last time didn’t bother to hide his identity.
For them, killing a Transcendent Realm cultivator is just like killing an ant, there’s no difference.
Only those who would cause big trouble once their identity is exposed would bother to hide their identity.
“Fucking dark! ”
Wang Ping gritted his teeth in anger.
It seems that for these forces, rules are just bullshit. As long as the interests exceed a certain level, they wouldn’t care about rules.
Of course, this is also because his strength is too weak, and the other party can easily kill him, so they can boldly use underhanded tactics.
If his cultivation was also in the Profound Elixir Realm, the other party definitely wouldn’t make a move.
