Because once exposed, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Green Moon Palace’s reputation would be thrown into the trash.
As Wang Ping was cursing, the system’s voice rang again.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose one from the following rewards:
Spirit Accumulation Realm cultivation.”
Seeing this reward, Wang Ping was stunned.
System, are you pulling this trick on me again?
I didn’t want to make a breakthrough last time, but you made me do it.
Now, I still don’t want to make a breakthrough, and you’re forcing me to do it.
As Wang Ping was speechless, his body and the energy within it began to surge.
His body became stronger, and his Five Elements Spirit Body was also more complete and powerful.
His Spiritual Essence also increased in quality a lot.
However, the most significant change was the extra Soul Palace, constantly generating soul power and slowly getting stronger.
“No wonder Spirit Accumulation Realm masters can beat Spirit Embryo Realm strongmen like a father beating a son. With one complete Soul Palace, their soul power is much stronger, making it difficult for Spirit Embryo Realm strongmen to defend against their soul attacks. They can only become living targets. At the same time, after becoming a Spirit Accumulation Realm master, their powerful soul energy makes their minds clearer, and their comprehension seems to have improved a lot.”
“Having increased comprehension means they can cultivate cultivation skills and martial skills more deeply, unleashing even greater power. At the same time, it also makes it easier to comprehend the concept.”
Wang Ping felt his changes and marveled in his heart.
“Maybe I shouldn’t have held back my breakthrough to save Spirit Stones. When necessary, I should break through. Otherwise, if my strength is insufficient, it will be easy to die in the simulation and fail to clear the level, wasting a lot of Spirit Stones.”
“Apart from that, group tasks are also a problem.”
Wang Ping thought silently.
Then, Wang Ping remembered something even more important.
“System, how many Spirit Stones do I need to spend for a Paid Simulation now?”
Wang Ping asked.
“Fifty thousand mid-tier Spirit Stones or 500 top-tier Spirit Stones.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Fifty thousand, huh? I thought it was going to be one hundred thousand, that scared me.’
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief.
Last time, when breaking through from the Early Stage of the Spirit Sea Realm to the Early Stage of the Spiritual Fetus Realm, he had to spend ten thousand mid-tier Spirit Stones, which really hurt his wallet.
Now, it has only increased by five times, much better than last time.
Although it’s still a lot, it’s much less than he expected, making him feel inexplicably comfortable in his heart.
“l can still have three more Paid Simulations with my remaining mid-tier Spirit Stones. Next, I’ll do one last Paid Simulation and then use some free simulations to scout a few times.’ Wang Ping had this thought in his mind.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping spoke directly in his heart.
“Ding, this Paid Simulation requires fifty thousand mid-tier Spirit Stones. Will the host consume them?”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Consume them.’
Wang Ping said without hesitation.
“Ding, consumption successful. The host has a remaining balance of 110,000 mid-tier Spirit Stones. Talent refreshing…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for refreshing Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation.’
Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation: The host will have unparalleled talent in Cultivating Demons. But on the contrary, the host will become extremely cruel and bloodthirsty.
“Another Blue Talent?”
Wang Ping was shocked.
Is this the benefit brought by the breakthrough?
But this Blue Talent is a bit unusual.
It seems to guide him toward the Demon Path.
And because there is only one Talent, he doesn’t have room to choose and has to follow the Talent.
“Ding, Talent filling successful, Life Simulation begins…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared with the text appearing as well.
This made Wang Ping come to his senses, looking forward with anticipation.
He wondered what changes would happen in the plot of this simulation.
Perhaps it could reveal some secrets of the Profound Turtle Continent.
After all, with this Talent, Wang Ping felt that his simulated self would definitely return to the Profound Turtle Continent.
After all, there is a terrifying demonic inheritance there.
There’s even a terrifying demon sealed within the Profound Turtle Continent.
If he could obtain some inheritance, his growth would be unimaginable.
Maybe this time, Wang Ping in the simulation can directly become a Profound Elixir Realm master!

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 113: Slaughtering Holy Heart Island! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 113: Slaughtering Holy Heart Island! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm
Translator: 549690339
[On the first day, you did not choose to flee but quietly awaited the arrival of the strong. When you were found, you attacked on your own initiative, slaughtering the strongest of the Seven Stars Archipelago. The Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun appeared and fought you. You used a cruel killing move to easily kill him.]
[Next, you slaughtered your way back to the Seven Stars Archipelago, ruthlessly destroying the Seven Star Palace and completely eliminating their forces. You slaughtered all the disciples within their sect and plundered their entire treasure vault.]
[Then, you returned to the Profound Turtle Continent, hoping to acquire the demonic inheritance on the continent. You went straight to the depths of the Black Wind Forest, found the Devil’s Cave, and met the terrifying Demonic
Cultivator.]
[The Demonic Cultivator was surprised by your aptitude for the Demon Path and did not say much. You directly stated your intentions, hoping that he would take you as a disciple and teach you the demonic cultivation skills in exchange for refining a physical body for him.]
[The Demonic Cultivator readily agreed. In response, you coldly left, slaughtering the Profound Turtle Continent, gathering a large amount of
Blood and Spiritual Energy, successfully releasing the Demonic Cultivator from the Devil’s Cave.]
[He was very excited, settled into your body, and lived together with you. Then, he told you his name: Blood Demon Yuan Feng. Upon hearing this name, you were surprised and thought of the Blood Demon Array, curious as to whether it was related to him.]
[Next, Blood Demon Yuan Feng taught you a powerful Demonic Skill: the
Heavenly Upper Tier Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, which can absorb the Blood Essence and cultivation of others, rapidly increasing your cultivation. It can also devour Blood Essence in battle, making it very eerie. You thought of Demon MO Fan’s cultivation skill, but that skill was only an Earth lower tier, far inferior to the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique.]
[You suspected that MO Fan did not meet Blood Demon Yuan Fengs standards, so he only taught him a low-level skill. It was because you possessed the Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation that you gained the favor of Blood Demon Yuan Feng.]
[After that, you cultivated with the Demonic Skill, ruthlessly devouring the living beings of the Profound Turtle Continent. At the same time, you also thought of the peculiar nature of the Chi Clan. The heartless you quietly returned to Chi Village.]
[However, as soon as you saw the members of the Chi Clan, Blood Demon
Yuan Feng reacted as if he saw a ghost and urged you to stay away from them.
You kept your heart cold, did not alert the Chi Clan, and quietly left the place.]
[You asked Blood Demon Yuan Feng why he was afraid of the Chi Clan members. Blood Demon Yuan Feng remained silent and did not tell you the reason. Knowing that you could not get an answer, you did not ask any further.]
[Then, you began to probe Blood Demon Yuan Fengs cultivation during his prime. Blood Demon Yuan Feng told you. It turns out that above the Profound Elixir Realm is the Yin Yang Realm. Above the Yin Yang Realm is the Life and Death Realm.]
[And Blood Demon Yuan Feng was a powerful Life and Death Realm Master.
Such cultivation, even in the Eastern Desolation, was considered the strength of a Sect Master level figure. Even in the Holy Land, he would be a high-ranking elder, awe-inspiring.]
[You were very surprised, never expecting Blood Demon Yuan Feng to be so powerful, a Sect Master-level figure.]
[Next, you asked about the matters of the Profound Turtle Continent, curious if Blood Demon Yuan Feng knew the origins of the Profound Turtle and why the spiritual energy of the Profound Turtle Continent was so thin.]
[Blood Demon Yuan Feng said that he did not know the exact origins of the Profound Turtle, only that it was an ancient and terrifying existence. As for the thin spiritual energy problem, it was because every time the Profound Turtle breathed, it would devour most of the spiritual energy within a certain range. In addition, it was because he had brought chaos to the world three thousand years ago, plunging the Profound Turtle Continent into a period similar to the end of the cultivation era.]
[Three thousand years ago, the World of cultivators on the Profound Turtle Continent was actually very prosperous. The inheritance of the major sects and clans were astonishing because their origins were extraordinary, having come from the Eastern Desolation and somehow escaped to the Profound Turtle Continent for some reason.]
[However, after Blood Demon Yuan Feng accidentally obtained the Demonic
Skill and rose to prominence, he began to treat the cultivators of the Profound Turtle Continent as Blood Food, growing stronger. Eventually, all the powerful cultivators of the Profound Turtle Continent, at a great cost, sealed him; all the powerful cultivators died, and the various spiritual stone resources were greatly consumed. At the same time, he destroyed some families’ inheritance.]
[Hearing the news, you finally understood some of the hidden history of the Profound Turtle Continent. Of course, you still had many unanswered questions about the Profound Turtle Continent in your heart.]
[Next, rather than asking too many questions, you chose to leave the Profound Turtle Continent. A place without powerful cultivators was not suitable for your growth. You needed to devour powerful cultivators and become stronger quickly.]
[After returning to the Seven Stars Archipelago, you began a frenzied slaughter, with numerous Transcendent Realm cultivators dying and being devoured by you. Then, you went to Storm Island and started a massacre. In an instant, your notoriety as a great demon spread, terrifying many cultivators.]
[You went on a relentless killing spree, devouring powerful cultivators, and refining their souls into pure soul power. In just half a year, you successfully broke through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm.]
[However, your cruel acts also ignited the anger of many forces, and powerful cultivators from various islands began to hunt you down. Their cultivations were at least at the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, with quite a few at the Profound Elixir Realm..]

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 113: Slaughtering Sacred Heart Island! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 113: Slaughtering Sacred Heart Island! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm_2
Translator: 549690339
[As a result, your cultivation continues to soar, and the power of Blood Demon Yuan Feng becomes increasingly strong.]
[Finally, you reach the limit, about to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. However, Blood Demon Yuan Feng does not advise you to break through immediately. Because the Profound Elixir Realm is a very special realm.]
[In the Profound Elixir Realm, the spiritual fluid in the body will condense into a Profound Elixir, which can also be called the Embryo of Tao. At the same time, the Profound Elixir is also divided into grades. Those below the 7th tier are considered lower-tier Profound Elixirs; 4th, 5th, and 6th tiers are mid-tier Profound Elixirs, and the 3rd, 2nd, and 1st tiers are upper 3 tier
Profound Elixirs. In addition, there is the legendary Flawless Profound Elixir.]
[The different grades of Profound Elixirs have a huge impact on the future. Not only is there a huge gap in Same Realm Battle Power, but it also affects future achievements. Even if a Profound Elixir Realm master who has condensed a lower-tier Profound Elixir, they will not be able to break through to the Yin Yang Realm for their entire lives, even reaching Profound Elixir
Realm Great Perfection would be a luxury.]
[Only by condensing a mid-tier Profound Elixir can one hope to break through to the Yin Yang Realm. Condensing a top-tier Profound Elixir will give one the hope of reaching the Life and Death Realm and higher realms.]
[Upon hearing Blood Demon Yuan Fengs explanation, you understood. At the same time, you were also very fortunate to have Blood Demon Yuan Feng, a Life and Death Realm Master, as an encyclopedia. Otherwise, you might have stumbled in this aspect, causing your cultivation to be stuck at a certain level.]
[In the end, Blood Demon Yuan Feng suggested that you slaughter a large number of half- step Profound Elixir Realm masters and Profound Elixir Realm masters to increase your foundation and use this as an opportunity to break through and condense a top 3 tier Profound Elixir.]
[You made a choice and headed to Sacred Heart Island. You caused a great slaughter on Sacred Heart Island. No one below the Profound Elixir Realm, regardless of who they were, could stand against you. Even if a Profound Elixir Realm master made a move, Blood Demon Yuan Feng would easily suppress them. In the end, all the major powers on Sacred Heart Island were completely annihilated by you.]
[You also used the power of devouring them to begin breaking through to the
Profound Elixir Realm. You triggered a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation and successfully condensed a 3rd Tier Profound Pill. You were not satisfied with this because your ambition was great and you wanted to condense a Ist-tier
Profound Elixir, or even a Flawless Profound Elixir.]
[However, your thoughts were ridiculed by Blood Demon Yuan Feng. In his lifetime, he had only condensed a 3rd Tier Profound Pill, and you could be proud that you had condensed a 3rd Tier Profound Pill. After all, there are not many in the world who can condense a 3rd Tier Profound Pill, even among the great sects, only Sect Master level figures in their youth could achieve it.]
[You didn’t care about Blood Demon Yuan Fengs ridicule and planned to go to Eastern Desolation, start a new journey, slaughter more powerful cultivators, strengthen yourself, and climb to stronger realms.]
[However, before you could set off, a young man appeared in front of you and coldly sentenced you to death.]
[You found that you couldn’t see the other party’s cultivation, and your heart became heavy. Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s face changed dramatically as he recognized the identity represented by the other party’s robe. The other party was actually an Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[Heavenly Sword Divine Land is an absolutely unfathomable force in this world. Even a Life and Death Realm Master is nothing more than an ant-like existence in front of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Once the Holy Land is provoked, even if you flee to the ends of the earth, it will be useless, as this kind of power has the means to find you.]
[Therefore, Blood Demon Yuan Feng did not hesitate to lend you his power to help you quickly escape from here, and you couldn’t fight against this opponent.]
[Naturally, you knew this, and did not hesitate to choose to escape. However, the Inner Sect Disciple of Heavenly Sword Divine Land did not intend to let you go, and burst out with the terrifying cultivation of a 3rd Level Profound Elixir Realm, killing you.]
[You were shocked in your heart and did not expect that an Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land could have such terrifying cultivation. Blood Demon Yuan Feng explained that the Heavenly Sword Divine Land was an extremely ancient Holy Land. Among Holy Land level forces, it could be ranked in the top ten, and the Inner Sect Disciples were naturally terrifying. Basically, in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, anyone who could become an
Inner Sect Disciple would have Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.]
[However, Blood Demon Yuan Feng specifically warned that this Inner Sect
Disciple should not belong to the ordinary Inner Sect Disciple level within the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s inner door, as he was too powerful. In addition, the bigger problem was that he had a powerful protector hidden behind him.
Otherwise, he could still easily kill him.]
[Your heart sank, as the protector of a Profound Elixir Realm genius must have an extremely terrifying cultivation. As a result, you used a Secret Skill to forcibly increase your strength and speed, trying to escape the pursuit.]
[However, the hidden protector finally made a move. With a casual hit, he sent you flying, causing you to suffer serious injuries. Seeing this, Blood Demon Yuan Feng did not hesitate to abandon you, quickly fleeing and disappearing.]
[At this, the protector snorted coldly and chased after him, likewise disappearing. Upon seeing this, you knew you would likely die here. However, you didn’t give up, and instead took the opportunity to self-destruct without hesitation.]
[The Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land did not expect you to be so decisive in self-destructing, and was caught off guard, making him seem a bit embarrassed, but he remained unharmed.]
[Because of the Rebirth tally, you were revived and saw that the other party was unharmed, which shocked you. Afterward, you self-destructed again, not giving him or the protector a chance to capture you alive.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…..]

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 113: Slaughtering Holy Heart Island!
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 113: Slaughtering Holy Heart Island!
Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm_3
Translator: 549690339
“This time, I’ve really reached the Profound Elixir Realm, and I even learned its secret. However, due to my excessively cruel actions, I ended up attracting the attention of Heavenly Sword Divine Land.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content and couldn’t help but sigh.
With the help of the Blue Talent, he was able to fulfill the condition of carrying a Demonic Cultivation Grandfather with him, which he had anticipated might happen.
Becoming a Profound Elixir Realm master was also something he had thought about.
However, he didn’t expect that he would attract the attention of Heavenly Sword Divine Land so quickly.
If nothing unexpected happened, after Heavenly Sword Divine Land learned about the events overseas, they would issue a Holy Land mission.
Or perhaps the various big island forces reported the news and released a mission.
Then, this situation happened.
It would have been one thing to be hunted down by a Heavenly Sword Divine Land Inner Sect Disciple, but this disciple also had a Dao Protector, which was quite outrageous.
No, it’s not actually outrageous.
With Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s intelligence network, they naturally would know about him carrying a Powerful Soul Body with him and would send a strong person to come for him.
While Wang Ping was thinking, his vision also changed.
The scene before him turned into a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.
The Wang Ping in his vision was extremely cold and cruel, his whole body filled with terrifying Blood Spirit, making him like a Hell Asura standing on a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood Crossing Tribulation.
Not long after Crossing Tribulation succeeded, he encountered the Inner Sect Discipline from Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
Then, there was a scene of him being hunted to death.
It is just unknown whether the old demon Blood Demon Yuan Feng managed to escape successfully or not.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
Heaven-tier Superior Martial Skill: Blood Demon Nine Shadows Sword.
Ist-tier Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.
Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation.
Combat Experience.”
“Wow, so many good things.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, his eyes flickering with indecision.
Choosing Profound Elixir Realm cultivation was definitely not an option. This was the Profound Elixir Realm cultivated by demonic cultivation.
Once chosen, he could only walk the Demon Path.
Moreover, the Profound Elixir he condensed this time was only a 3rd Tier Profound Pill.
Although a 3rd Tier was already outstanding, as it was a Top 3 Tier Xuan Dan, Wang Ping was very strict with himself.
If he were to break through, he would condense the strongest Profound Elixir.
Not to mention a Flawless Profound Elixir, he would at least need a Ist-tier one.
Of course, if he could condense a Flawless Profound Elixir, that would naturally be the best.
Otherwise, Wang Ping might be stuck in a certain realm in the future, unable to reach the highest realm.
“Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation is indeed a rare Blue Talent, but I can’t choose it either. Once I choose it, my temperament will be affected, making me cold-blooded and ruthless, killing people like cutting grass. Would I still be me by then? Besides, acting like this makes death too easy.”
Wang Ping passed on the Blue Talent as well.
As for Combat Experience, there was no need to consider it.
Finally, Wang Ping looked at the Heaven-tier Superior Martial Skill: Blood Demon Nine Shadows Sword.
This time, it was precisely because he chose the Blue Talent that he was highly regarded by Blood Demon Yuan Feng.
Next time without this talent, the other party will definitely not value him anymore, let alone pass on their martial skills to him, he would likely be devoured by them.
In other words, if he didn’t choose this martial skill this time, it would be gone next time, and he didn’t know how many more simulations would be needed to refresh the reward.
“Heaven-tier Superior Martial Skill, very good, very tempting, but what I really want is the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill: Bloodthirsty Demon Skill. In the end, it didn’t refresh.’
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
Heaven-tier Superior Martial Skills were undoubtedly powerful, but they weren’t what he needed most.
What he really wanted was the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill: Bloodthirsty Demon Skill.
Although he wouldn’t easily cultivate this, it would be an excellent choice for him to cultivate it in the life simulation and explore new paths.
As a result, the system didn’t refresh it, which was quite annoying.
“System, I choose 1.”
Wang Ping could only say this in his heart.
In an instant, a lot of information appeared in Wang Pings mind.
It was the cultivation method of the Heaven-tier Superior Martial Skill: Blood Demon Nine Shadows Sword.
“This Blood Demon Nine Shadows Sword can split the sword into nine shadows, and each sword spirit carries the corroding effect of spiritual essence, which is indeed domineering.”
Wang Ping mumbled to himself after absorbing the information.
A Heaven-tier martial skill, even if it was placed among those great sects, was considered a top-tier skill.
Although he didn’t get the Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill: Bloodthirsty Demon Skill, Blood Demon Yuan Feng had indeed given him a great gift. As long as he mastered this Blood Demon Nine Shadows Sword, his combat power would be greatly enhanced, which would become a trump card.
“In addition, I never would have thought that the reason for the sparse spiritual energy in Profound Turtle Continent would be like this – the
Profound Turtle devouring the spiritual energy with its breath while Blood
Demon Yuan Feng was a great murderer three thousand years ago.”
Wang Ping thought back to the content in the simulation and couldn’t help but admire.
But, had the strong sects and families that once existed on Profound Turtle Continent come from Eastern Desolation?
He wondered why they would run to Profound Turtle Continent.
Perhaps they had some connection with the real Sinful Bloodline Descendants.
It’s a pity, however, that much of this has been lost to history, making it difficult to know the truth.
“Heavenly Sword Divine Land… If I could join such a powerful force, I wouldn’t have to be so tired all the time. It’s just that the fate of Profound Turtle will make those big shots identify me as a Sinful Bloodline Descendant, and as soon as they see me, they will try to kill me. If I go, it will only lead to death.” Soon after, Wang Ping let out a sigh, filled with regret.
If he could join a Holy Land, he would have the most complete and powerful cultivation inheritance, and would be taught by the most powerful masters who would also protect him.
With such conditions, he wouldn’t need to worry about anything. How could he still need to live a life of displacement, worrying about being targeted by a Profound Elixir Realm master when he acquired a 7th-tier Soul Nourishing Spirit Medicine, and being slapped to death by them?
Unfortunately, there are no “ifs” in this world.
He could only move forward with difficulty as a loose cultivator..

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 114: The Great Battle! Return
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 114: The Great Battle! Return
Translator: 549690339
“Next, it’s time to deal with those enemies that have decided to invade.’
Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and no longer engaged in new simulations. He flew into the sky and looked into the distance.
He and Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun had quite a few intersections in the past, and the latter had even attempted to kill him, but those incidents were merely in simulations.
Now, things had eventually gotten to this stage in reality.
Wealth can influence a person’s heart.
For cultivators, they must compete, even risk their lives for advancement.
He could understand the Seven Stars Ancestor, but understanding aside, if the other party has targeted him, he would not hesitate, he would directly kill him to eliminate all potential dangers.
At this moment, Wang Ping seemed to remember something. He opened the chat group and mentioned Qin Tian.
Wang Ping (66) @O?n Tian (77): “Qin Tian, can you get an Array Plate that can trap a Primordial Infant Cultivator and block external vision? I really need it right now.”
Qin Tian (77): “Uh, Mr. Wang, what have you run into? Why do you need this item?”
Wang Ping (66): “l am being pursued and killed. Once engaged in battle, many of my secrets would be revealed. Therefore, I must kill them all without letting any information slip.”
Qin Tian (77): “Who the hell is so audacious as to dare to hunt my Mr. Wang? Wait a second, I’ll go ask my master and several elders.”
Wang Ping (66): “Okay.”
Soon, Qin Tian returned and sent Wang Ping an exclusive red envelope.
Wang Ping (66): “You should put this thing in the System Mall, and I will buy it directly.”
Wang Ping was well aware that such things were very precious, and he didn’t want to take advantage of Qin Tian.
Qin Tian (77):”Mr. Wang, I’ve been guided by you several times and completed tasks which allowed me to survive until now. It’s just an Array Plate, no need to be polite. You just need to insert the Array Flags into the ground and activate the core with spiritual energy. It’s very simple.”
Wang Ping (66): “Fine. thanks.’
After thinking for a moment, Wang Ping did not refuse Qin Tian’s kindness. He clicked on the red envelope and stored the Array Plate before leaving the chat group without paying any attention to the other messages.
Next, Wang Ping studied the Array Plate for a while before quietly waiting.
Before long, streaks of light appeared above the deserted island, encircling Wang Ping.
The leader was none other than the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, riding on a peculiar monster beast.
In the distance, other cultivators who had pursued him watched from afar.
Wang Ping knew very well that these were only a part of the people. The longer he delayed, the more people would come.
Even worse, the news might spread to other islands, attracting more half step Profound Elixir Realm masters.
Therefore, he had to quickly get rid of Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, conceal his aura, and leave this place, using the Delivery Array to eliminate his aura completely to distance himself from this sea region.
“Wang Ping, if you can hand over the Profound Artifact, I can protect you.”
Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun saw Wang Ping and spoke in a friendly tone,
“No need for false courtesy. Between you and me, it is a matter of us or them. You die, I live,” said Wang Ping calmly.
“Hahaha, I wonder where you got the courage to talk to me like that.”
Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun looked at Wang Ping and no longer concealed his expression. He looked down on Wang Ping and spoke coldly.
“Although you seem to have hidden your real cultivation level before, you are merely in the Spirit Accumulation Realm. I can kill you with a flick of my fingers.”
As these words were spoken, the Seven Star Ancestor began to emit a frightening pressure. With one step forward, he was about to make his move on Wang Ping.
However, at that moment, beams of light suddenly appeared from all directions, forming a dark grey curtain of light, enveloping the entire area. “What is this, a trapping array? But I’ve never seen this kind of Array Mana before.’
The sudden change made the pupils of the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun and other masters shrink, and a sense of foreboding emerged in their hearts.
They originally believed that they were the hunters and Wang Ping was the prey.
But now it seemed that the situation might not be as they thought.
If Wang Ping was not fully confident, why would he prepare a trapping array and wait for them to come?
“All together, kill him.”
Instantly, the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun roared, and he shot a palm straight towards Wang Ping.
As he palmed out, seven shining starlights flashed, looking incredibly powerful.
Seeing this, the other powerful people also followed suit.
Among the cultivators trapped here, the lowest cultivation level was the
Spiritual Fetus Realm and there were multiples at the Spirit Accumulation Realm.
Most of them were cultivators from the Seven Star Palace, but there were also cultivators from major powers like the Fire Sect.
Such a line up was undoubtedly very strong.
However, in the face of such a joint attack, Wang Pings face turned grave, and he immediately activated his Berserk state.
At the same time, he activated his Five Elements Spirit Body and Martial Master Golden Body, maximizing his combat strength.
Then, a blue stick, emanating an incredibly powerful aura, appeared in his hand.
It was, indeed, the Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky Stick.
Wang Ping held the Sea-Sky stick, using it as a sword, and suddenly exploded with the Heaven-tier inferior Sunset Sword Skill.
As if a real sunset had appeared, it shone extremely dazzlingly and collided with numerous attacks.
In a flash, a terrifying explosion swept across the space. Except for Wang Ping, all the others were caught in the residual shock wave of the collision and were flung away, hitting the barrier of the trapping array hard..

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 114: The Great Battle! Return_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 114: The Great Battle! Return_2
Translator: 549690339
Spiritual Fetus Realm and Spirit Accumulation Realm powerhouses, coughed up blood madly,suffering severe injuries.
Even some weak Spiritual Fetus Realm powerhouses were directly shaken to death.
Even the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, who was at the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, turned pale and retreated in a sorry state.
Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun looked at Wang Ping in anger and surprise, having completely underestimated how deeply Wang Ping had been hiding his strength.
Heaven-tier Skill.
Heaven-tier Martial Skills.
90% Sword Spirit.
Dual cultivation of refining Mana and physique separately.
With a Profound instrument added on top.
And a strange Secret Skill that enhances combat power.
These series of means have allowed Wang Ping to easily cross several realms, even injuring him in the process.
This is still considering the joint attack with the other people.
If he were to fight Wang Ping one-on-one, he’d likely suffer serious injuries as well.
“Damn it, 1 underestimated you.”
Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun looked terrible.
“However, since things have come to this point, this old man has no other way out! Killing you would make everything yours mine, and I’ll be able to seize the opportunity to become a highly respected Profound Elixir Realm master! ”
Immediately after, the Seven Stars Ancestor roared, and eerie blood-colored patterns appeared on his body. His skin even showed signs of cracking.
Then, an even more terrifying power emerged.
Apparently, Seven Stars Ancestor has used a secret technique that sacrifices his strength to kill Wang Ping.
“It’s useless.’
Wang Ping looked at Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun indifferently.
Then, he too used the secret technique recorded in the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill.
Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill: Second Move: Five Elements Unification.
In an instant, Wang Pings Five Elements spiritual energy merged into one, erupting with an extremely terrifying Skill.
“Sunset Sword Skill: Final Move: Sunset Afterglow.”
Wang Ping grasped the Sea and Sky Staff and swung it down towards Seven Stars Ancestor with force.
In a flash, a sword spirit resembling a sun bloomed with a brief moment of brilliance, and rushed towards Seven Stars Ancestor to kill him. Although Wang Ping was using a staff to perform this move, which seemed less sharp, the power it contained was still unimaginably formidable.
“Seven Star Crescent Moon!”
Seven Stars Ancestor gritted his teeth and slapped out a palm as well.
In an instant, a huge palm burst forth with seven stars surrounding it and a bright moon in the center, looking quite mysterious.
Soon, the two terrifying attacks collided fiercely.
However, at the moment of collision, Seven Stars Ancestor’s Seven Star Crescent Moon was crushed by Wang Pings Sunset Afterglow, exploding apart, while his remaining offensive momentum continued towards Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun.
“This old man can’t accept this!” Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s face turned ashen, and his eyes were filled with despair. With a roar, he was completely submerged by the Sunset Afterglow, his body left in pieces.
“Stars and the moon can’t compete with the sun. Even if it’s just a sunset, it’s still enough to crush the stars and the moon.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
All the cultivators present who saw that Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun was killed in one move by Wang Ping shuddered in their hearts.
This Wang Ping, who had recently risen to fame as a 7th tier alchemist, who could have imagined that his combat strength was so terrifying, killing a long-established half-step Profound Elixir Realm powerhouse with one move.
“Let’s all go together! Even if we die, we won’t let him have it easy!’ A cultivator with bloodshot eyes roared and charged at Wang Ping.
Surrender was absolutely impossible.
He knew very well that Wang Ping would not let them go.
Since that was the case, even if he had to die, he wanted to bite off a piece of
Wang Pings flesh.
Seeing this, the other cultivators also rushed towards Wang Ping.
Then, as if they had a tacit understanding, they suddenly self-destructed, trying to blow up Wang Ping.
However, as the aftermath of the explosion dissipated, Wang Ping appeared unscathed with a cold expression on his face. “Self-destruction is nothing but a waste of my time.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
In the Life Simulator, he had been forced to self-destruct countless times and knew very well what a cultivator would do when cornered.
Therefore, he was well-prepared, and there was no way these people could hurt him.
Next, Wang Ping casually grabbed the Storage Spirit Rings that had fallen down.
Of course, the ordinary Storage Spirit Rings had all been destroyed in the previous self-destruction, and there were only a few top-tier spirit stone Storage Spirit Rings left, which Wang Ping picked up.
Wang Ping casually wiped away the spirit brand on them and glanced at the contents, unable to help but smile.
The value of the items inside was astonishing.
Just the number of Mid-tier Spirit Stones alone reached one million.
The number of top-tier spirit stones added up to three thousand.
In addition, there were various rare and precious medicines, ores, metals, and Cultivation Skills.
“No wonder so many cultivators like to plunder, it’s indeed a fast way to make money.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Of course, Wang Ping was a man of principle. Unless someone actively attacked him, he wouldn’t pursue a course of killing and taking someone else’s belongings.
Moreover, indulging in such acts too frequently would surely lead to trouble sooner or later.
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping concealed his aura, manipulated the Array Plate, and retrieved the Array Flag, turning into a golden Divine Halo and quickly disappearing from the scene.
At this moment, the Transcendent Realm Cultivator watching the battle from afar, atop the ocean, was shocked to their core as they saw the scene left behind after the Great Array disappeared.
The entire deserted island had been sunk.
And all the cultivators, except for Wang Ping who had just disappeared, were nowhere to be found, not even a corpse remained, likely turned into ashes.
“Who exactly is this Wang Ping? He actually managed to single-handedly eliminate the Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun and many other powerful cultivators..

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 114: The Great Battle! Return_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 114: The Great Battle! Return_3
Translator: 549690339
Some cultivators felt their scalps going numb.
They knew that with so many strong people falling, the Seven Stars Archipelago would undergo massive changes, and they might not be able to protect themselves.
After Wang Ping killed Seven Star Ancestor Nangong Yun and others, he returned to the Seven Stars Archipelago, intending to use the Delivery Array there to go to other islands.
However, Nangong Yun must have feared that Wang Ping would use the Delivery Array to escape, so he had already sent someone to guard it.
That person turned out to be Qin Lan.
When Qin Lan saw Wang Ping, her pupils shrank, and her aura burst out.
“Qin Lan, our relationship is not bad. I don’t want to kill you, so just let me go,”
Wang Ping looked at Qin Lan and said calmly.
As he spoke, Wang Ping also took out Nangong Yun’s Storage Spirit Ring.
When Qin Lan saw the item in Wang Pings hand, her face was full of astonishment, and she found it hard to believe.
“You, did you kill the Ancestor?” Qin Lan exclaimed in fear.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded and stepped onto the Delivery Array.
After a moment of silence, Qin Lan chose to step aside, letting Wang Ping leave.
Since Wang Ping had the power to kill Nangong Yun, he could kill her instantly as well.
Therefore, trying to stop Wang Ping was not a wise choice.
So many strong people in the Seven Star Palace had already died, she couldn’t continue to die, or the Seven Star Palace would really be done for.
Suddenly, Wang Ping disappeared into the Delivery Array.
Sighing after Wang Ping left, Qin Lan also showed a bitter smile on her face.
She and Wang Ping had been through some hard times together.
Unfortunately, a Profound Instrument aroused people’s desire, and the Ancestor ultimately made the wrong choice.
If the Ancestor hadn’t chosen to hunt down Wang Ping, given Wang Pings current potential, if they had a good relationship with him, their Seven Star Palace might be able to go to a higher level in the future.
In the following half a month, Wang Ping traveled among various islands using Delivery Arrays. Each time, he concealed his aura, changed his appearance, and disguised his identity.
Another half a month later, Wang Ping returned to the Seven Stars Archipelago but did not go directly to Sacred Heart Island.
There were too many powerful people on Sacred Heart Island, and Wang Ping was afraid of causing a butterfly effect.
As a result, returning to the Seven Stars Archipelago was much safer.
Anyway, in other people’s eyes, he had already fled to other islands.
After returning to the Seven Stars Archipelago, Wang Ping found that it had changed a lot.
Because of the heavy casualties among the strong people of both the Seven
Star Palace and the Fire Sect, the positions of these two major powers in the Archipelago were precarious. Many powers were eager to seize the various shops and Spiritual Stone Veins belonging to the two powers.
For this reason, the Seven Star Palace and the Fire Sect surprisingly came together to form an alliance to prevent other powers from defeating them one by one, ending in the extermination of their legacy.
Wang Ping did not pay much attention to the various events happening on the Seven Stars Archipelago.
After all, he was temporarily safe now.
However, to be even more secure, Wang Ping was planning to go back to the Profound Turtle Continent.
After all, that Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master made him feel uneasy.
As long as he returned to the Profound Turtle Continent, he would be completely safe.
Anyway, he had now obtained a large amount of Spiritual Stones, so he was not short of the Spiritual Stones needed for simulation at the moment.
Therefore, going back to the Profound Turtle Continent to conduct life simulations was the best choice.
His various previous transfers, concealing his aura, and giving the illusion of fleeing were nothing more than to eliminate the possibility of discovery of the Stele Array on the deserted island.
Next, Wang Ping left the Seven Stars Archipelago, came to the underground cave on the deserted island, activated the Stele Array, and returned to the
Profound Turtle Continent.
“I didn’t expect to return here so soon,”
Wang Ping looked around at the environment, shaking his head.
It had been less than half a year since he left the Profound Turtle Continent.
He could only say that plans could not keep up with changes, and the rewards from the Life Simulator were a bit too tricky.
Next, Wang Ping did not plan to return to the Sword Spirit Sect directly, but chose to go to the Black Wind Forest and arrived at the Chi Village.
“Roar! Master, have you become a Transcendent Realm Master already?”
Seeing Wang Ping return, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger couldn’t help but come over and roar.
As a monster beast, although Wang Ping had hidden his aura, the
Fire-patterned Demon Tiger could still vaguely feel that Wang Pings aura was terrifying. This was not an aura strength that the Spiritual Origin Realm or half-step Transcendent Realm could possess.
“Sort of.” Wang Ping patted the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger’s head and said casually.
“By the way, I promised you earlier that I would make you a Transcendent Realm Monster. Now, it’s time for me to fulfill my promise.”
Wang Ping smiled and said.
As he spoke, Wang Ping casually threw a 5th Tier Fire-attribute Spiritual Elixir to the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger.
For Wang Ping now, the 5th Tier Spiritual Elixir really wasn’t a big deal.
“Roar!”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger was ecstatic, receiving the Spiritual Elixir.
Not much time had passed, and it had already obtained a 5th Tier Spiritual Elixir.
Its master was simply too lavish.
It was determined to cling tightly onto this thick thigh.
At that moment, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger couldn’t help but stick out its big tongue, wanting to lick Wang Ping.
“Get away, a male tiger wants to lick me? Just get your wife over.” Wang Ping slapped it away, grumbling.
“Roar!” The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger roared in grievance.
What’s wrong with being a male tiger? I will sue you for discrimination against males!
Wang Ping ignored the miserable Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, entering Chi Village.
When the villagers of Chi Village saw Wang Ping return, they were all very surprised, and each of them greeted him.
“Brother Wang, you’re finally back. Can you continue to tell me the story of Xiao Huohuo?”
Chifeng came up and pulled Wang Pings sleeve, looking at him eagerly.
“Of course.’
Wang Ping looked at Chifeng and other children who still appeared to be children and felt uneasy in his heart.
Although he had spent a short time in this world since he crossed over, it gave him a very long feeling.
It couldn’t be helped, he had experienced too many things, and naturally felt a sense of time and space chaos.
“Yay! That’s great!”
Seeing Wang Ping agreed, Chifeng was overjoyed, jumping up, and the mysterious flame in his red pupils flashed and disappeared again..

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power
Translator: 549690339
“Xiao Huohuo became The King of Fighter, if only I could become a strong figure like him.”
Chifeng couldn’t help but fantasize after listening to Wang Pings story.
“Hehe, little Feng, don’t even think about it. Your talent isn’t even as good as mine. It would be great if you can become a master in the Innate Realm in the future.’
Some older children teased him.
“Thirty years in the east, thirty years in the west, never underestimate the youth for being poor.”
Chifeng glared and said this, which made the other children laugh.
Even Wang Ping couldn’t help but smile as well.
It can’t be denied that telling stories to the children had relaxed his tense mood recently, and he felt exceptionally good.
However, Wang Ping didn’t intend to continue telling stories to these children and went to find the village chief.
“Village Chief, do you have any plans to leave here and live in the outer
world?”
Wang Ping asked.
“It’s impossible. After all, we have offended the Sword Spirit Sect. Once we go out, we will definitely be hunted down.”
The village chief shook his head.
“The Sword Spirit Sect won’t take action against you.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
With his current cultivation, how could the Sword Spirit Sect take action against Chi Village if they knew about his relationship with Chi Village? Not to mention, he had also handed over the Red Fire Skill to the Sword Spirit Sect.
With this relationship, the Sword Spirit Sect would be even less likely to take action against the Chi Clan.
“Wang Ping, forget about it. We’re used to living in peace in the Black Wind Forest and don’t want to leave.’
The village chief shook his head with gratitude all over his face.
Wang Ping had done enough for them, and he didn’t want Wang Ping to take more trouble for them.
“Alright.” Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say much more.
It was just a casual remark for him anyway, so this matter was not a big deal for him.
However, since the village chief was unwilling to leave, he wouldn’t persuade him.
Next, Wang Ping left some cultivation resources that were useful for cultivators below the Spiritual Origin Realm and left Chi Village, heading to the deepest part of the Black Wind Forest, where the Devil’s Cave was located.
Wang Ping didn’t intend to go in, but rather stood far away and planned to continue the simulation.
He wanted to see how much strength Blood Demon Yuan Feng had left in his sealed state.
If it’s an opponent he could handle, he would try to get the Demonic Skill from him or destroy it directly to eliminate potential threats forever.
“System, I want a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, free simulation begins. You have eight free simulation chances remaining.”
The familiar sound of the system rang out, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text floated up.
[On the first day, you enter the Devil’s Cave and meet Blood Demon Yuan
Feng, expressing your desire to trade with him. As long as he hands over the Demonic Skill, you will find a way to release him. Blood Demon Yuan Feng despises your trading behavior and chooses to attack you directly.]
[You are astonished, not expecting him to erupt with such a Terrifying Skill in his sealed state. You choose to use all your strength to resist his attack as soon as possible.]
[However, the power gap between you and Blood Demon Yuan Feng is too large. Even though he has been sealed for thirty full years, he still retains the terrifying strength to casually kill a cultivator below the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Thus, after enduring a blow from Blood Demon Yuan Feng, you are severely injured and almost killed. In the end, you escape from the Devil’s Cave with lingering fears, realizing how reckless you were.]
[Next, you start healing. After your recovery, you begin your diligent cultivation. Because of the abundant resources, you temporarily have no plans to leave the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[Twenty years have passed, and your cultivation has made some progress, but the distance to the Mid-Yun Ling Region is still very far. You decide to return to the Seven Stars Archipelago for a trip.]
[You are shocked to find that the Seven Stars Archipelago has changed again. The Seven Star Palace and Fire Sect have been destroyed. A new force has appeared in the Seven Stars Archipelago: Sky Wind Pavilion from Storm Island.]
[After occupying the Seven Stars Archipelago, Sky Wind Pavilion is extremely domineering. After the opening of the Seven Star Secret Realm, in order to enter, you must either belong to an affiliated force or, in the case of individual loose cultivators like yourself, swear allegiance to Sky Wind Pavilion.]
[Other forces on the Seven Stars Archipelago are angered but dare not speak up, so they can only choose to obey. After learning of the situation, you also frowned. You didn’t expect the Seven Stars Archipelago to be ruled by the Sky Wind Pavilion and that they would be so domineering.]
[However, you are not afraid of Sky Wind Pavilion and choose to forcibly enter the Seven Star Secret Realm. Your actions anger Sky Wind Pavilion, and they want to send people to hunt you down.]
[In the Seven Star Secret Realm, you search for various opportunities while killing the Sky Wind Pavilion’s cultivators. Your fame starts to spread throughout the archipelago. The native cultivators of the Seven Stars
Archipelago cheer for you in their hearts, feeling refreshed and pleased.]
[In the end, you obtain a 7th tier Fire Spirit Material, three 6th tier Spiritual
Materials, and a Six-Tier Soul Nourishing Class Treasure Medicine in the
Seven Star Secret Realm. As for the Heavenly-tier cultivation skill, Five
Elements Merging Spirit Skill, perhaps because of the changes in the Seven
Stars Archipelago and that loose cultivator not entering, no one has obtained it, and you don’t know how he got this skill.]
[When you are about to leave the Seven Star Secret Realm, the ancestor of Sky Wind Pavilion catches you at the exit. You coldly use the Array Plate to trap them all. Because you used the trapped array, your identity is also exposed..]

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 2
Translator: 549690339
[Elders and cultivators of the Sky Wind Pavilion were terrified, thinking about what happened twenty years ago. You did not say much but struck with all your power, slaying all of them and obtaining the treasures from their bodies, then left the Seven Star Secret Realm gracefully.]
[After the Seven-Star Secret Realm closed, countless people were horrified, never expecting that the experts of Sky Wind Pavilion would all perish within the secret realm. Your fame began to spread throughout the Seven Stars Archipelago, and many cultivators revered you to the extreme.]
[As a result, Sky Wind Pavilion, due to the fall of more than half of its ancestors and experts, began to lose its footing on Storm Island. At the same time, the Sea Clan began to stir, causing hearts to tremble on Storm Island.
You didn’t care about this and decided to take a trip to Sacred Heart Island.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed. You successfully collected many treasure elixirs needed for refining pills on Sacred Heart Island and refined 7th tier Soul Nourishing Elixirs.]
[With the help of the 7th tier Soul Nourishing Elixir, your cultivation successfully broke through to the middle stage of Spirit Accumulation Realm, saving fifty years of bitter cultivation.]
[After breaking through to the middle stage of Spirit Accumulation Realm, you returned to the Profound Turtle Continent, killed Demon MO Fan, and destroyed his demonic skill.]
[Next, you ventured deep into the Black Wind Forest, sealing off the entire region surrounding the Devil’s Cave to prevent anyone from being trapped, causing the downfall and deaths of everyone on Profound Turtle Continent.]
[After thinking about it, you decided to take Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong with you and leave the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[After arriving at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you parted ways with Ye Chen and took Bai Tianhong to Sacred Heart Island.]
[Upon arriving at Sacred Heart Island, you and Bai Tianhong cultivated peacefully together, undisturbed by outside matters.]
[Thirty years later, Bai Tianhongs cultivation reached Spirit Sea Domain Perfection, and he also comprehended 70% of the Sword Spirit. As he wanted to gain experience outside, you remembered your past and chose to give him the already prepared 6th-tier spiritual materials for him to break through. At the same time, you taught him the secret techniques of hiding the aura of a cultivation skill that you had specially researched over the years. This technique could conceal the presence of a Heaven-tier skill as long as it drew from a single attribute.]
[Bai Tianhong successfully broke through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm with your prepared 6th-tier spiritual materials. After deeply bowing to you, he expressed his desire to go out and gain experience.]
[At that moment, you reluctantly understood that Bai Tianhong might not return alive from his travels. After some hesitation, you decided to accompany him.]
[In the end, the two of you, master and disciple, left the Hermit’s Land together and set out into the outside world.]
[Ten years passed, and you and Bai Tianhong encountered several crises, but both of you managed to cleverly resolve them. At the same time, through good fortune, you found a 7th tier soul nourishing treasure elixir and raised your cultivation to the Late-stage Peak of the Spirit Accumulation Realm. Meanwhile, Bai Tianhongs cultivation successfully advanced to the
Late-stage Spirit Embryo Realm.]
[You sighed with emotion, realizing that compared to bitter cultivation, seeking opportunities in the outside world was indeed much faster. Of course, although there were many opportunities, the struggle to seize them was life-threatening. Even you, accompanying Bai Tianhong, experienced several close shaves. If Bai Tianhong had been alone, he might have already perished. You also began to doubt if this was the reason why Bai Tianhong disappeared from other world lines in your memory.]
[It was because he encountered an unbeatable enemy and tragically perished. The possibility was quite high. After all, the Bai Tianhong in your memory had only reached Spirit Sea Complete Realm Cultivation, which was much weaker compared to your current state.]
[However, your guess was ultimately wrong. Three years later, while you and Bai Tianhong were adventuring, you encountered a white-haired old woman.
She was extremely mysterious and powerful, and she directly took Bai
Tianhong away.]
[As for you, you were completely ignored by her, as if you were an insignificant ant by the side of the road, not worth her attention. Angered by this, you didn’t know who she was or the purpose behind taking Bai Tianhong away.]
[Nevertheless, you could only stay silent, because you knew clearly that she was at least a Profound Elixir Realm powerhouse, and possibly even stronger.
She could crush you with a single hand, so there was no way you could rescue Bai Tianhong. At the same time, you realized the reason for Bai Tianhongs disappearance in your memory might be because he was taken away by this white-haired old lady.]
[You could only hope that she meant no harm to Bai Tianhong; otherwise, he would be in danger. Naturally, you suspected that if she wanted to hurt Bai Tianhong, she wouldn’t have just taken him directly.]
[After pondering, you thought about the Profound Turtle Continent and the
“Sinful Bloodline Descendants”. You began to suspect that Bai Tianhong was actually the real “Sinful Bloodline Descendant”.]
[Next, you returned to the Hermit’s Land and continued your peaceful cultivation. After sixty-seven years, your cultivation successfully broke through to the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[Finally, just as you were about to head to the Seven Stars Archipelago and compete for the Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky Stick, someone came to challenge you. This person was still that mysterious shadowy Profound Elixir Realm powerhouse.]
[Without saying a word, he attacked you directly. Although your cultivation was much stronger than when you were in the early stage of Spirit
Accumulation Realm, you were still as weak as a tiny insect in front of a
Profound Elixir Realm master, and he easily killed you..]

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 3
_
Translator: 549690339
[You are extremely unwilling, and after reviving with a Rebirth tally, you choose to self-destruct.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended.]
“What method did this Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master use to find me again precisely at the 140th year and kill me?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a frown, feeling very serious.
He had long concealed his breath and used various delivery arrays to teleport.
However, he was still caught by the other party.
But, if the other party had this method earlier, they wouldn’t have waited for 140 years.
That is to say, this method was achieved through some means they acquired later on.
“If I don’t solve this trouble, after 140 years, I’ll always have to face this Profound Elixir Realm master. Can I only escape back to Profound Turtle Continent when I reach the 140th year?”
Wang Ping thought helplessly.
If that’s the case, the impact on his subsequent development would be enormous.
“Perhaps, if I break through to the half step Profound Elixir Realm and obtain a sword Profound instrument, comprehending the Sword Spirit to the minor Completion-tier or even the Major Completion Tier, I could fight him.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered.
There must be a huge gap between the half step Profound Elixir Realm and the
Profound Elixir Realm.
However, this Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master should not be an extremely powerful Profound Elixir Realm master.
After all, his Cultivation Skill is Heavenly Mid-grade, and his Martial Skills have the upper-tier nonsuch Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword. Except for the gap in cultivation, his configuration is much stronger than the other party.
He might even have the hope of killing across levels if he meets an ordinary Profound Elixir Realm master, as long as he meets the above conditions and draws a stronger talent, he might still have hope to assassinate him by surprise.
The Profound Elixir Realm is not invincible.
“Of course, whether it can be successful or not, I still need to experiment slowly. All aspects of my abilities depend on the Paid Simulation, which sounds simple but is not easy to achieve.”
Wang Ping soon calmed down, sighed and felt somewhat helpless.
It must be said that being blocked by a Profound Elixir Realm master is really uncomfortable.
“Speaking of which, Bai Tianhong’s identity is not simple either. Maybe I can investigate Bai Tianhongs background and see if he really is a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’
Wang Ping thought of Bai Tianhongs identity issues and mumbled.
“System, I want to do the Paid Simulation.”
After thinking, Wang Ping decided to do a new simulation.
His purpose for the next simulation is purely to see if he can refresh his talents to be stronger.
Besides that, he wants to investigate Bai Tianhongs identity and directly brush other aspects of the panel to their current limits.
Finally, he will consider the cultivation issue.
“Ding, this Paid Simulation requires 50,000 mid-tier spirit stones or 500 high-tier spirit stones. Do you want to spend them right away?”
The system’s voice sounded. “Spend.”
Wang Ping said generously.
He now has a million mid-tier spirit stones plus 30,000 high-tier spirit stones, spending it without blinking.
“Ding, consumption successful, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing…” The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, congratulations on successfully refreshing the Green TalentSword
Idiot; White TalentDance and Sing Rap.”
Green Talent,Sword Idiot: The host will be obsessed with swords to the extreme, only interested in the Sword Skill, and everything else is insignificant.
White TalentDance and Sing Rap: The host will become very talented in dance and singing rap, but will also become an eyesore.
“This Green Talent.Sword Idiot is not bad, maybe it can help me understand a stronger Sword Spirit. But what is this White TalentDance and Sing Rap? Can this be considered a White Talent? System, are you mocking my KunKun?”
Wang Pings face twitched slightly, with a weird look in his eyes.
“System, I choose Green Talent.Sword Idiot.”
Seeing that the system didn’t respond to his thoughts, Wang Ping didn’t continue to complain and made his choice directly.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounded again, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged.
[Day 1, you hold a sword and experience Sword Enlightenment.]
[Year 2, you silently experience Sword Enlightenment, lose interest in anything, even in cultivation, and only want to comprehend the supreme Sword Skill.]
[Year 20, you are still silently experiencing Sword Enlightenment. Even though you know that the Seven Star Secret Realm has been opened, you have no intention of leaving the Profound Turtle Continent. However, vour comprehension of the Sword Skill has become astonishing, and the Sword Spirit has reached 90% peak, just one step away from entering the Minor
Completion-tier Sword Spirit.]
[Year 30, you’re still silently experiencing Sword Enlightenment, killing
Demon MO Fan as the demons emerge. To prevent Ye Chen from cultivating
Demonic Skill and affecting your own sword practice, you chose to teleport Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong together to the Seven Stars Archipelago. Then, you return to Profound Turtle Continent and continue to concentrate on experiencing Sword Enlightenment.]
[Year 100, you successfully take that step, comprehending the Minor Completion-tier Sword Spirit, and with a single sword, the Sword Spirit can remain immortal for a hundred years.]
[You are not satisfied with that and continue to experience Sword Enlightenment, trying to comprehend the legendary Great Perfection Sword
Spirit.]
[But the Great Perfection Sword Spirit is too profound, and you can’t easily comprehend it. In the 200th year, you still haven’t been able to comprehend it..]

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 4
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Power 4
_
Translator: 549690339
The 250th year, you gaze at the Sunset Afterglow as if you have an epiphany, entering a marvelous Sword Enlightenment state. Successfully comprehending the sunset atmosphere and integrating it into the Sword Spirit, forming the legendary attribute Sword Spirit, Sunset Sword Spirit, your strength skyrocketed.]
[However, you didn’t care and continued to pursue Sword Enlightenment. In the 400th year, you still haven’t taken that step, comprehending the Great Perfection Sword Spirit.]
[In the 474th year, you were about to die but still focused on sword enlightenment. Even if you were about to die, needing body possession to reincarnate, you still didn’t do so. Because you realized it was the critical moment and didn’t want to interrupt these epiphanies.]
[Finally, you successfully took that step and comprehended the Great Perfection Sword Spirit. At that moment, you laughed joyfully, so happy, and died amidst laughter.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…. ]
“As expected, dying doesn’t trigger the Rebirth tally.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and muttered.
“However, this simulation entirely focused on sword enlightenment. Unless something would disrupt his Sword Enlightenment, Wang Ping in the simulation would only focus on Sword Enlightenment and would not consider other things. This Green Talent.Sword Idiot, it feels like it could compete with some Blue Talents. But its side effects are huge; for sword enlightenment, one could give up everything, even the time to improve cultivation.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping sighed again.
In the end, he chose to understand the Great Perfection Sword Spirit even if he was about to die, not wishing to interrupt those epiphanies. He successfully comprehended the Great Perfection Sword Spirit but died there.
Sword Idiot, Sword Idiot, this talent is truly terrifying.
“Unfortunately, if I chose this talent, I guess I’d be affected too, turning into someone solely interested in swords. Would I still be myself then? Talents that affect my personality are absolutely not acceptable.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping muttered to himself with mixed feelings. “Ding, reward generation in progress, host can choose one from the following rewards as the reward:
1.Green Talent.Sword Idiot.
2.White Talent.Dance and Sing Rap.
3.Sword Skill enlightenment.”
“Sword Skill enlightenment!”
Wang Ping looked at this reward, revealing a surprised and happy expression.
He thought that this time, he could only choose the Sword Spirit option.
To tell the truth, if that had been the case, he would be struggling.
After all, this time, he had comprehended the attribute Sword Spirit.
Apart from that, he didn’t want to give up his comprehension of sword techniques either.
Now, the collective reward of Sword Skill enlightenment appeared, satisfying all his requirements at once.
“System, I choose 3.Sword Skill enlightenment.”
Immediately, Wang Ping said without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, reward selection successful.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, Wang Pings body shook, memories emerged in his mind, immersed in a wondrous state, and absorbed the numerous Sword Skill enlightenment.
Sunrise to sunset.
Seven days later, Wang Ping slowly opened his eyes, his eyes filled with terrifying Sword Spirit that burst out, tearing the sky apart.
Even the sealed Blood Demon Yuan Feng in the Devil’s Cave was alarmed.
Blood Demon Yuan Feng opened his eyes, looked deeply at Wang Ping outside the Devil’s Cave, and squinted his eyes.
Wang Pings emergence was naturally detected by him. He originally wanted to lure Wang Ping in, so he could easily manipulate him.
However, he didn’t expect Wang Ping to directly set up an Array Mana enclosing the area, obviously to prevent intruders.
In Blood Demon Yuan Fengs view, Wang Ping must be someone who knows the truth about the Devil’s Cave, possibly a descendant of those he had killed.
So, he abandoned his plans to lure Wang Ping. It was meaningless and would only waste his power.
He had been sealed far too long and couldn’t last much longer, so he couldn’t waste power casually.
“This Junior has some talent indeed. Merely at the Early Stage of Spiritual
Accumulation Realm, he already comprehended the Great Perfection Sword
Spirit. Such Sword Skill talent, even in the Great Sects, could make him a True Inheritor Disciple. If his roots can keep up, he might become a Yin Yang Realm
Master in the future.’
Blood Demon Yuan Feng silently assessed Wang Ping and then closed his eyes again, no longer paying attention to Wang Ping.
In the outer world, Wang Ping withdrew his Sword Spirit and stared deeply at the Devil’s Cave before leaving.
He was well aware that Blood Demon Yuan Feng had discovered him long ago, and the commotion he had just caused attracted the latter’s attention.
As a result, it was time to leave.
Blood Demon Yuan Feng was a Life and Death Realm Master at his peak. Even after being sealed for three thousand years and losing 99% of his strength, he had the power to easily kill Profound Elixir Realm cultivators and should not be provoked.
Next, Wang Ping returned to the Sword Spirit Sect and sought the Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect, inquiring about Bai Tianhongs background.
He only knew that Bai Tianhong wasn’t born in the Sword Spirit Sect, but was brought back by the Supreme Elder.
Maybe the Supreme Elder knew something.
Wang Pings sudden return startled the Supreme Elder, but he was also puzzled as to why Wang Ping would ask this question.
“Regarding Tianhongs identity, I don’t know either.”
The Supreme Elder shook his head and explained.
It turned out that Bai Tianhong was encountered by the Supreme Elder when he accidentally descended the mountain. At that time, Bai Tianhong was a young beggar who survived by begging..

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring
Power 5
_
Translator: 549690339
Seeing Bai Tianhong looking very clever, he brought Bai Tianhong back to Sword Spirit Sect.
Little did he know, Bai Tianhong had astounding talents and gave him a pleasant surprise.
“I see.”
Unable to gather any information, Wang Ping was disappointed.
“By the way, since he was a child, Tianhong has had a red birthmark on his shoulder, which might be a way for his parents to identify him.”
At this point, the Supreme Elder seemed to have remembered something and said hurriedly.
“A red birthmark?”
Wang Ping pondered.
It’s common for some people to have birthmarks.
However, considering Bai Tianhongs uniqueness, this birthmark might have an extraordinary meaning.
“What does the birthmark look like?”
Wang Ping asked further.
If he knew the shape, he might find some clues in the simulation.
“That birthmark is very strange, it’s a sword with a peculiar appearance.
Honestly, it’s the first time I’ve ever seen such a birthmark, truly peculiar.”
The Supreme Elder stroked his beard, recalling.
“A sword?”
Hearing this, Wang Ping felt more and more that Bai Tianhongs birthmark was extremely strange and believed that there must be a secret behind it.
“Since Bai Tianhong was taken away by the Old Woman, he has a high probability of being a Sinful Bloodline Descendant. It’s quite possible that his special bloodline hasn’t awakened.”
Wang Ping thought of this.
He might be able to concoct a Spirit Attracting Elixir to help Bai Tianhong awaken.
“No, the Spirit Attracting Elixir is only a 4th Tier Elixir after all. It’s okay for awakening ordinary spiritual bodies, but it’s far from enough to awaken powerful bloodlines. If Bai Tianhong is really a Sinful Bloodline Descendant, he needs at least an 8th or 9th tier Elixir or treasure to awaken him. How can I find such a Elixir or treasure now?”
Wang Ping sighed and temporarily gave up on the idea of helping Bai Tianhong awaken his bloodline.
It just wasn’t the right time.
Next, Wang Ping thanked the Supreme Elder and found Bai Tianhong.
“Bai Tianhong, take off your clothes.”
After seeing Bai Tianhong, Wang Ping spoke directly.
“Elder, what are you going to do?”
Immediately, Bai Tianhongs elegant demeanor vanished, and he looked terrified.
“I’m not interested in men, I just want to see your birthmark.”
Wang Pings face darkened as he spoke.
Although he had given up on helping Bai Tianhong awaken his bloodline, he was still very curious about the birthmark and had to see it.
“l see.” Bai Tianhong breathed a sigh of relief, and then took off his upper garment, revealing the birthmark on his right shoulder.
The birthmark was indeed a sword, and it looked like a very mystical one.
Of course, for ordinary people like the Supreme Elder, it might only give such a feeling.
But Wang Ping was different. When he stared at this sword, he felt a piercing pain in his eyes.
This was undoubtedly an incredible phenomenon.
After all, Wang Ping, who had inherited Sword Mad Wang Pings 400-500 years of swordsmanship and was nearing the great perfection with his heavenly-tier sword skills, had a profound understanding of the Sword Spirit.
He had become a powerful sword cultivator.
For such a powerful sword cultivator as him to feel pain in his eyes just by looking at a birthmark, as if being stabbed with an unparalleled sharp blade, was indeed very strange.
“Huh.” Wang Ping moved his eyes away, making them feel better.
“Elder, did you find out anything? Do you know my origins?” Bai Tianhong put on his robe again and asked expectantly.
“I don’t know. But your background is certainly not simple.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“Focus on cultivating. Only by becoming stronger will you have the chance to find out who you really are.”
With that, Wang Ping left gracefully, leaving Bai Tianhong deep in thought.
Next, Wang Ping returned to his chambers in the Sword Spirit Sect.
Although he had been away for a while, his room was cleaned daily and was still very tidy.
Wang Ping sat on his Meditation Cushion and prepared to continue his life simulation.
“System, I want to start a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and then said.
His spiritual stones were enough for countless simulations; he was even able to do more simulations than just from the free ones. Naturally, he didn’t have to save any, so he went crazy with simulations and Talent Refresh.
“Oh, by the way, since I have so many spiritual stones now, you don’t have to remind me whether to pay or not.”
Suddenly, it seemed that Wang Ping had thought of something and said proudly.
“Ding, Paid Simulation successful, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for refreshing the Green Talent:
Flower-picking Thief.”
Green Talent: Flower-picking Thief: The host will become very charming and extremely good at winning women’s hearts. Correspondingly, the host will more easily obtain powerful body technique secret manuals and have outstanding talent in cultivating the body technique.
Wang Ping looked at this talent, somewhat dumbfounded.
Goodness gracious, even such a talent exists?
Is this Flower-picking Thief going to cause him a ton of trouble and amass a pile of love debts?
That’s not good. As everyone knows, Wang Ping has married many times in his previous simulations only to face tragic deaths afterward.
Death after marriage is a constant law.
Or is it that the charm mentioned in the Flower-picking Thief’s talent is of the passionate but heartless kind?
“Ding, Talent loading successful, Life Simulation starting..”

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Strength_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 115: Terrifying Talent! Soaring Strength_6
Translator: 549690339
“[On the first day, you thought of Xia Yuan’s stunning beauty and immediately descended the mountain to start wooing her.]
[After a month, Xia Yuan was touched by your advances and eventually surrendered her heart and body to you. After stealing the heart fo Xia Yuan, you disappeared after a month, without any second thought.]
[This made Xia Yuan both love and hate you, making her search for you throughout the world. However, your cultivation level was too formidable, evidently, it was not something Xia Yuan could locate.]
[You started to woo women everywhere, leaving behind a pile of emotional debt.]
[In the tenth year, you had a small improvement in your cultivation and chose to return to the Seven Stars Archipelago. After returning to the Seven Stars Archipelago, you began to flirt with all the beautiful female cultivators, even sparing none, not even Qin Lan’s disciple. You had a relationship with them.]
[In the fifteenth year, a Spirit Accumulation Realm master from Sky Wind Pavilion appeared, wanting to rule the Seven Stars Archipelago. You found it troublesome, killed him directly, then destroyed the delivery array between two islands, preventing the invasion of the Sky Wind Pavilion, and continued your promiscuous actions.]
[In the twentieth year, the Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and you entered it. You were extremely lucky and found a land of inheritance in secret realm. You passed the assessment, successfully gaining a Heaven-tier inferior body movement skill: Illusive Dragon Step. You were very delighted.]
[After the Journey to the Seven-Star Secret Realm ended, you started to cultivate the Illusive Dragon Step. You had a good talent in this aspect and easily reached the Entry Tier.]
[In the thirtieth year, you successfully collected many treasured herbs needed for pill refining on the Sacred Heart Island and successfully refined the 7th tier Soul Nourishing Elixir. With this, you broke through to the Mid-Yun Ling
Region. However, during these ten years, you also stirred up quite a few waves on Sacred Heart Island.]
[You successfully seduced Bing Ningyue, the successor of Ice Palace, leading her to secretly fall for you, disrupting the Ice Palace’s rule of never marrying for a lifetime. You eloped with Bing Ningyue and escaped from Sacred Heart Island.]
[The palace master of Ice Palace was furious and sent masters to chase and kill you, wanting to kill you both. Because you had a Heaven-tier body movement skill, no one could catch up with you unless directly chased by a Profound Elixir Realm master. You easily got rid of the chase, took Bing Ningyue and escaped from Sacred Heart Island, fleeing overseas.]
[In the end, after discussing with Bing Ningyue, you decided to go to a remote place in the Eastern Desolation. Only by going there, the Ice Palace wouldn’t have the ability to chase and kill you.]
[However, you both thought of a critical problem. Although Sacred Heart Island is very close to the mainland of Eastern Desolation, it is still a long journey. Without a delivery array, you would have to fly for a month, and you might face danger on the way.]
[Eventually, you had no choice but to take a risk and fly there on your own. If you went to Sacred Heart Island to use the delivery array, it would be a suicidal act.]
“Good grief, he was really promiscuous this time, wooing women everywhere.
But how beautiful must this Ice Palace successor, Bing Ningyue, be that even the fickle Wang Ping, who possesses the Green Talent: Flower Picker, is completely smitten, risking his life to elope with her.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a strange expression.
Besides, the abilities of this Green Talent: Flower Picker are also very strong, directly getting him a Heaven-tier inferior body movement skill.
A Heaven-tier skill is not common, and so far, in his simulations, it has only appeared once.
However, speaking of it, there are indeed many secrets hidden in the Seven- Star Secret Realm.
Heavenly Grade Middletier Cultivation Skill: Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill,
Heaven-tier inferior body movement skill: Illusive Dragon Stem it’s hard to imagine that a small Seven Star Archipelago would have such a secret realm.
