However, Wang Ping also knows that he won’t figure anything out by speculating wildly here, so he gathers his thoughts and continues to look at the luminescent screen.
[You and Bing Ningyue encountered many dangers at sea, even encountering a half- step Profound Elixir Realm demonic beast with a powerful bloodline, you almost died in its mouth. Luckily, you had a Heaven-tier body movement skill and narrowly escaped.]
[In the end, you both narrowly escaped to the Eastern Desolation. After arriving in Eastern Desolation, you began to find your way.]
[Unfortunately, as soon as you set foot in the Eastern Desolation, before finding a remote area to settle down, you encountered a Profound Elixir
Realm master from a Great Sect. He sensed Profound Turtle Spirit from you and intended to kill you.]
[You let Bing Ningyue escape, intending to single-handedly hold back the enemy, but Bing Ningyue did not choose to run and instead fought alongside you.]
[In the end, due to the huge gap in cultivation, you were no match for the Profound Elixir Realm master. You and Bing Ningyue both died in battle. The difference is, due to your Rebirth Tally, you survived and injured the Profound Elixir Realm master with a surprise attack.]
[The rage of this Profound Elixir Realm master was triggered and being greedy over your secrets, declared that he could give you a chance to live. You ignored him and chose to self-destruct.] [Due to your death, the simulation ends.]
“This really is bad luck.”
Wang Ping was left speechless.
Having finally carved out a path for survival, as soon as they arrived in
Eastern Desolation, they encountered a Profound Elixir Realm master from a Great Sect, and got run over.
Indeed, women will only affect his speed to draw his sword.
“However, this Bing Ningyue is indeed a passionate person. Even in the face of death, she has no intentions of escaping, truly sharing life and death.”
Wang Ping silently praised her again in his heart.
This kind of woman is quite rare.
Next, Wang Pings vision suddenly shook and changed from the original buildings to a mountain.
There are two figures on the mountain.
It was none other than Wang Ping and Bing Ningyue.
It must be said that Bing Ningyue indeed has an appearance that can cause the downfall of a nation. Her skin is like creamy jade, ice-blue hair and ice-blue pupils are different from ordinary people.
Her temperament, although gives people the feeling of an icy and snowy lotus, when looking at Wang Ping, her eyes are as soft as autumn water, warm and gentle.
In addition, although she looks extremely young, her cultivation has reached the astonishing half- step Profound Elixir Realm, which is even higher than Wang Ping.
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, no wonder the playful Wang Ping in the simulation was smitten, completely reformed. Who wouldn’t be moved by such a Tao Companion?”
Wang Ping looked at Bing Ningyue and clicked his tongue.
In this simulation, he certainly has good luck with women.
However, playing with Xia Yuan and other girls and then running away is indeed heinous..

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over!
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over!
Translator: 549690339
Next, Wang Ping saw a Profound Elixir Realm master unexpectedly appear on the scene.
He was dressed in a blue robe, emitting intense energy.
Upon his arrival, he coldly declared Wang Ping’s death sentence and started to attack.
Wang Ping, shocked and angered, questioned on what basis was he considered a Sinful Bloodline Descendant.
The Profound Elixir Realm Elder did not respond, but harshly attacked instead.
Unexpectedly, Wang Pings performance was truly astonishing. He demonstrated Heaven-tier skills and swordsmanship, exuding an overwhelming aura of divinity.
Bing Ningyue’s performance was equally impressive, appearing to have a rare ice attribute physique. The cultivation skill and martial arts she practiced were of heavenly-tier, and she had also comprehended a bit of perfect icy demeanor.
Even the Profound Elixir Realm Elder was moved and believed that if Wang
Ping had half- step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, he could kill ordinary Profound Elixir Realm cultivators.
And Bing Ningyue, had the strength to threaten regular Profound Elixir Realm masters.
However, in his presence, they still seemed like mere ants.
Then, despite both of them attacking together, they were easily crushed by the elder, resulting in serious injuries for both. Yet, they still did not retreat.
Ultimately, both of them were killed by the elder.
Then, Wang Ping resurrected and self-destructed after launching a surprise attack.
“So it’s as I thought, as long as I reach the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, I will be able to defeat an ordinary Profound Elixir Realm master despite our level difference. But this elder is terrifying; he is definitely not as simple as being in the early stages of the Profound Elixir Realm,”
Upon his return, Wang Ping muttered to himself, deep in thought.
“This simulation has yielded some gains. I hope that the heaven-tier inferior body movement skill scroll can be refreshed.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping, settled down his mind and muttered.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The host can choose one from the following rewards:
Mid- stage of Spirit Containment Realm.
Heaven-tier inferior body movement skill: Illusive Dragon Step.
Green Talent: Flower Picker.”
“System, I choose 2.”
Looking at these rewards, Wang Ping was a bit torn. After giving Green Talent: Flower Picker a glance, he still chose 2 in the end.
This Green Talent was undoubtedly good, but it would also make him rather flirtatious.
He didn’t want to become a philanderer and die under a woman’s belly one day.
Well, this is also related to the talent level being too low.
If a similar Purple Talent would appear, Wang thought he might not be able to resist this temptation.
As Wang Ping made his choice, streams of information and comprehension began to appear in his mind.
That was the introduction to the Illusive Dragon Step.
This body movement has three levels. The first one, Illusionary Dragon Afterimage, is fast and can create almost real images.
The second one, Illusionary Dragon Inch Step, focuses on short-distance explosive movements. With one step, one can travel anywhere.
The third one, Illusionary Flight in the Sky. It’s about conjuring a pair of illusory wings and flying with terrifying speed.
To be honest, the effect of the third level is somewhat similar to the secret skill recorded in the Red Fire Skill.
However, as a pure body movement skill, the Illusive Dragon Step naturally far exceeds the Red Fire Skill.
If the Illusive Dragon Step is cultivated, his speed will not be inferior to that of geniuses of the same realm.
Of course, when it comes to Disciples of the Holy Land, Wang Ping feels that there’s still some uncertainty.
After all, what the Holy Land is never short of is martial arts heritage, The heavenly-tier is rare for a Great Sect, but among the Holy Lands, they may not be considered much.
“Let’s continue the simulation. According to the elder’s evaluation, as long as I reach the half- step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, I will have reached the level of defeating ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters regardless of the difference in our levels. I wonder how 1 compare with that Shadow Profound
Elixir Realm cultivator.’
Wang Ping was thinking on his own.
For this, he was still very curious.
If he could kill him, Wang Ping wouldn’t have to worry about exposing his heavenly-tier skills.
A Profound Elixir Realm master with heavenly-tier skills and martial arts wouldn’t need to rob him.
Those without would either not be able to beat him or even if they could, they might not be able to catch up with him even offline.
One could say that without realizing it, Ping has already grown into a powerhouse.
At least, on the many islands including the Sacred Heart Island, Wang Ping has become a top-tier powerhouse.
Although his current self is still considered as nothing in the vast Eastern Desolation, at least in some small places, he can act as the ancestor, set up teachings, and create a millennial sect.
This feeling made him feel extremely satisfied.
“Since it’s just an experiment, there’s no need to use the paid simulation. Let’s try the free simulation. System, start the free simulation.”
Next, Wang Ping rubbed his chin while muttering.
Just an experimental combat power, not intending to farm any rewards, using a paid simulation would be too wasteful of spirit stones.
Although he currently had many spirit stones, 50,000 mid-tier spirit stones could still be saved.
“Ding, free simulation started.”
The system’s voice on time, a luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words began to emerge.
“[Day One, you are practicing diligently.]
“[Twenty years have passed, your cultivation has made some progress, you return to the Seven Stars Archipelago, forcefully entered the Seven Star Secret Realm, wreaking havoc and massacre. You exterminated the Sky Wind Pavilion cultivators who were after you, and left the Seven Star Secret Realm unscathed.]
“[In the end, within the Seven Star Secret Realm you obtained one 7th tier Fire
Spirit Material, three 6th tier spiritual materials and a 6th Tier Soul
Nourishing Class Treasure Medicine.]
“[In the blink of an eye, 10 years passed and you successfully concocted the
7th tier Soul Nourishing Elixir on Sacred Heart Island..]

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _2
Translator: 549690339
[With the help of 7th tier Soul Nourishing Elixir, your cultivation successfully broke through to the Mid-Yun Ling Region. Then, you returned to the Profound Turtle Continent, bringing Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong with you to leave the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[After arriving at the Seven Stars Archipelago, you and Ye Chen went your separate ways. You brought Bai Tianhong to Sacred Heart Island, where you began practicing in seclusion. At the same time, you were also investigating information about the sword-type birthmark.]
[Thirty years later, Bai Tianhongs cultivation reached the Great Perfection of the Spirit Sea Domain, and he comprehended 70% of the Sword Spirit. With your help, he easily broke through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm. After that, both of you went out to experience the world together.]
[In the following ten years, you and Bai Tianhong encountered several powerful enemies. However, due to your increased strength, you never faced any life-threatening danger and easily defeated your opponents. During this time, you successfully found a 7th tier soul nourishing treasure elixir that elevated your cultivation to the Late-stage Peak of the Spirit Accumulation Realm. Bai Tianhongs cultivation, on the other hand, successfully advanced to the Late-stage Spirit Embryo Realm.]
[Three years later, during your experiences, the white-haired Old Lady appeared before you once again, just like in your memories, intending to take
Bai Tianhong away. You guarded Bai Tianhong behind you and questioned the
Old Lady about her origins.]
[The white-haired Old Lady frowned and coldly stated that you had no right to know. Then, she casually slapped you away and took Bai Tianhong with her. Bai Tianhong became furious after seeing you injured by the Old Lady, and he swung his sword at her despite the gap in cultivation.]
[However, due to the vast difference in cultivation, the white-haired Old Lady easily shattered Bai Tianhongs attack and shook her head, remarking how weak he was even with his bloodline unawakened.]
[Then, the white-haired Old Lady effortlessly knocked out Bai Tianhong and took him away. As for you, she spared your life for Bai Tianhongs sake.] [As you watched the white-haired Old Lady leave, you pondered and became even more certain about Bai Tianhongs bloodline issues. Bai Tianhong might indeed be a genuine descendant of the Sinful Bloodline.]
[After that, you returned to the Hermit’s Land and continued your cultivation. Sixty-seven years later, your cultivation successfully broke through to the
Great Perfection of the Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[Next, you patiently waited for the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master to come. However, you did not act recklessly and prepared many backup plans; even if you lost, it would not be easy for him to kill you.]
[As you predicted, the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master appeared before you, intending to squash you like an ant.]
[You sneered at this in your heart. When you were at the Mid-Yun Ling
Region, your fighting prowess had already far surpassed the half step
Profound Elixir Realm level. Now that your cultivation had reached the Great Perfection of the Spirit Accumulation Realm, your strength had increased even more and was no longer a subject of bullying for the Shadow Profound
Elixir Realm master.]
[A fierce battle erupted between you and the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master, darkening the sky and earth. You successively used the Secret Skills of the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, Great Perfection Sword Spirit, Sunset
Sword Skill, Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword, and many other techniques to fight against the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master.]
[Your strength shocked the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master, who did not expect you to be so powerful. In the end, he could not defeat you and instead got injured by you, choosing to flee in a pathetic manner.]
[You coldly chased him, intending to kill the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master and eliminate any future trouble.]
[The chase and escape on Sacred Heart Island shocked many cultivators on the island. They never imagined that a Spirit Accumulation Realm Cultivator would be hunting down a Profound Elixir Realm Cultivator.]
[A Profound Elixir Realm master who saw this scene felt a chill in his heart and guessed that your identity might be the disciple of a Great Sect. Only disciples of the Eastern Desolation Sect and other super-genius cultivators would have the formidable strength to defeat Profound Elixir Realm Cultivators while at the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm. This was because their inheritance was too terrifying, something that ordinary cultivators could not compare with.]
[Relying on the Illusionary Dragon Movement, you caught up with the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master, severely wounded him, and forced him to reveal how he was able to locate you. Knowing that he would undoubtedly die today, he chose not to speak and cruelly self-destructed his Profound Elixir.]
[The explosion of a 9th tier Profound Elixir was extremely terrifying. Even though you had anticipated this and used the Illusionary Dragon Movement to distance yourself immediately, you were still severely injured as a result.]
[You sighed in your heart, realizing that although your attack power and speed had already surpassed ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters, your defense force remained somewhat insufficient. It seemed that you still needed a Heavenly-tier defensive skill and a self-healing Heavenly tier secret manual to compensate for your weaknesses.]
[After the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master self-destructed, you obtained his Storage Spirit Ring and received numerous valuable items.
However, you could never find out how he managed to locate you.]
“Am I now capable of killing a Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master? It seems that I have underestimated my battle prowess after reaching the Great
Perfection of the Spirit Accumulation Realm. However, this Shadow Profound
Elixir Realm master was indeed just an ordinary one, with only a 9th tier Profound Elixir and not very high cultivation. If that weren’t the case, it would still be very difficult for me to kill him by exceeding my level.”
Wang Ping thought silently as he read this passage.
Unfortunately, he still could not figure out the method used to find him this time.
Wang Ping guessed that the other party must have had some astonishing secret technique, as it would be impossible to achieve this otherwise..

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _3
Translator: 549690339
Of course, there was also a possibility that the other party had bought his information from an intelligence dealer.
However, he had never heard of such a power on Sacred Heart Island.
Therefore, even if such a power existed, it should be present in the Five
Continents.
For the other party to buy information from such a force just for a Profound instrument seemed a bit over the top. The money spent on buying information might even be worth the value of the Profound instrument itself.
Therefore, it was more likely that the other party had a secret skill.
“This secret skill is simply too awesome for tracking enemies. It’s perfect for dealing with cunning opponents. I must find a way to get my hands on it,” Wang Ping stroked his chin.
This time, although his strength was stronger than the other party, he could kill them, but capturing them alive was impossible.
However, he could wait until his strength increased again before trying to catch the other party alive and force them to reveal the secret skill.
Immediately, Wang Ping reined in his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After killing the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master, your fame spread throughout Sacred Heart Island, and even the two dominant forces, Green
Moon Sect and Ice Palace, on Sacred Heart Island showed you some respect.]
[You know that at this point, even if you auction off the Sea and Sky Staff, no one would dare to casually snatch it from you.]
[However, you have no intention of continuing to auction the Sea and Sky Staff, and instead, head to the Seven Stars Archipelago to compete for the Sea
Ape Clan’s Profound Artifact: Sea-Sky Stick.]
[Not long after you arrived at the Sea Ape Clan territory, you discovered that the Sea Ape Clan was already in chaos, and the Cultivator in Complete Spirit Accumulation Realm had already stolen the Profound artifact. You easily captured him and obtained the Sea-Sky Stick with ease. Thus, you obtained two Sea and Sky Staffs.]
[However, due to your reckless actions this time, the Sea Ape Clan managed to track your aura and found you. The Sea Ape Clan Ancestor was furious and attacked you directly. You easily killed him with a palm strike. As a result, you obtained a 7th tier Water Element Spiritual Item from the Sea Ape Clan.]
[Then you left the area and returned to Sacred Heart Island, planning to collect the remaining 7th tier items on Sacred Heart Island.]
[After you arrived at Sacred Heart Island, you auctioned off one of the Sea and Sky Staffs at the Ice Palace auction. The auction sold for a sky-high price, but no one dared to rob you. At the same time, you also obtained two 7th tier items at the Ice Palace auction.]
[Not long after, you completed the transaction for the last 7th tier item at the Green Moon Palace auction. You began to close yourself off from the world, trying to condense the Five Elements Spirit Fire. In the end, you were fortunate to succeed, condensing the Five Elements Spirit Fire and increasing your combat power.]
[Next, you felt the time was ripe and approached the two 8-tier Alchemists on Sacred Heart Island, seeking their counsel on the secrets of 8-tier Alchemists. Both of them felt that you might be from a Major Sect, and due to your strong strength, they treated you very politely and began to discuss the secrets of alchemy with you.]
[You benefited greatly and began to immerse yourself in alchemy.]
[Ten years later, you successfully refined an 8-tier Elixir – Breaking Disaster
Elixir, capable of breaking curses. You were overjoyed but regretful that the Chi Clan people had disappeared, otherwise you could have tried to see if you could break the curse and satisfy your curiosity.]
[The appearance of the 8-tier Elixir had some commotion, and the news of your success in refining the 8-tier Elixir shocked the many forces on Sacred Heart Island. These forces became even more friendly and respectful to you, coming to congratulate you.]
[Seeing the people from the Ice Palace, you suddenly remembered Bing Ningyue’s matter. You found that in this life, it seemed that Bing Ningyue had already left the Ice Palace early, her whereabouts unknown. So, you curiously asked about Bing Ningyue’s news, but the people of Ice Palace did not answer your question.]
[You were very puzzled by this, but you didn’t delve into it too much.]
[For the next fifty years, you have been diligently cultivating, trying to step into the half- step Profound Elixir Realm. Unfortunately, you still found it difficult to succeed.]
[It was during this year that a major secret realm on Sacred Heart Island, Blood Demon Cave, was opened, piquing your interest. Blood Demon Cave produced Blood Demon Crystals in abundance, which could quickly enhance a cultivator’s cultivation level, but consuming too many in a short period could easily lead to madness, falling into a demonic state, or even perishing.]
[Although you were sensitive to the words “Blood Demon” and suspected that there might be some big secrets hidden in this secret realm, you still chose to go. This was because you wanted to step into the half- step Profound Elixir Realm as soon as possible, so you would have a chance to step into the
Profound Elixir Realm in the future. Moreover, you also had to find a way to condense a higher quality Profound Elixir, and you couldn’t waste your time on breaking through to the half- step Profound Elixir Realm.]
[You entered the Blood Demon Cave, hunted down the Blood Demons, which only had killing intent, and obtained Blood Demon Crystals. Your harvest in the first three days was bountiful, and you were very happy. However, on the fourth day, you fell into an ambush.]
[Four Profound Elixir Realm masters from the Green Moon Palace surprisingly surrounded you, intending to kill you and obtain the secrets on your body. It turned out that because your cultivation had not advanced much in these years, they suspected that you were not a Major Sect Successor but just a lucky person who had obtained a shocking inheritance. As a result, they were envious of the opportunities on your body and chose to take action in the
Blood Demon Cave.]
[This was because only in places like Blood Demon Cave could they ensure that you had no chance of escaping. In the outer world, it was difficult to catch you and even more likely to leak the news..]

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _4
Translator: 549690339
“[Your heart is filled with rage and shock, your impression of Green Moon Sect has reached its lowest point, you swear to annihilate it if you survive. You then engage in a fierce battle with four Profound Elixir Realm masters from Green Moon Sect. Since these four aren’t typical beginners of the Profound
Elixir Realm, you’re critically injured in an instant.]
“[At the same time, they seize you and seal off your cultivation, intending to jointly perform a soul- searching on you. Filled with rage, you enter Berserk State to rid you of negative influences, and then self-destruct. Your self-destruction is extremely powerful, the four of them did not expect you could still self-destruct despite being sealed, and they are directly injured by the explosion.]
“[You resurrect thanks to the Rebirth tally. After resurrection, you choose to flee to the depths of the Blood Demon Cave.]
“[The four Profound Elixir Realm masters from Green Moon Sect are surprised at your resurrection and become even more fanatical about the fortune you possess, desperately chasing you down. Due to their formidable cultivation level and the fact that they are not Shadow Profound Elixir Realm masters who have only condensed 9th tier Profound Elixirs, you are eventually cornered.]
“[The members of the Green Moon Sect begin to console you to stop resisting and argue that they are willing to spare your life if you hand over the secret. You scoff in your heart, mocking them and self-destructing once again.]
“[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
“Oh man, I died again. But it seems the Green Moon Sect isn’t trustworthy after all. Last time they tried to kill me at their auction, and now again in the Blood Demon Cave.’
Looking at the simulation content, Wang Ping curses inwardly, feeling dissatisfied with Green Moon Sect.
“But, is that Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master not strong, only having a 9th tier Profound Elixir? I thought he was stronger, but it turns out he’s just a floor tile level cultivator in the Profound Elixir realm.”
Wang Ping remembers the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master and is lost for words.
Due to multiple deaths inflicted by the opponent, Wang subconsciously believes the opponent is not simple.
Now it seems that the opponent is also just a cultivator who luckily condensed a Profound Elixir, having barely stepped into the realm of Profound Elixir
Realm experts, and his cultivation most likely is only at the Ist-tier Profound Elixir Realm.
The reason why he is so powerful is primarily because he relies on his advanced cultivation to bully Wang in his past simulations.
The Wang Ping of that time hadn’t reached the Great Perfection of the Spirit
Accumulation Realm, yet, and did not have the understanding of the Heaven-tier sword method and Great Perfection attribute sword spirit. Dying at his hands was indeed a norm.
“Since 1 don’t have to fear the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master, that’s good. As long as I reach the Great Perfection of the Spirit Accumulation
Realm, my combat power would be enough to fight with the Profound Elixir Realm master, and I won’t be someone the Profound Elixir Realm could easily defeat anymore. I would count as a top-tier force on Sacred Heart Island. Although I’m at the bottom among them, at least I made it in.”
Wang Ping strokes his chin, contemplating.
“Next, I’ll use a paid simulation to grind out the rewards. Five Elements Spirit Fire can also improve my combat effectiveness for now. Although to continue being effective at the Profound Elixir Realm, it will certainly need to be fed more potent Five Elements Spiritual Objects, but currently, it’s sufficient.”
Just as Wang Ping was preparing for a new paid simulation to grind for rewards, a sudden system prompt caught him off guard.
“Ding, Group Member Chen Si (83) joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.” “Ding, Group Member Xu Yi (84) joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.” “Ding, Group Member Luo Weiguo (85) joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
“Ding, Group Member Zhang Yueying (86) joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
“Ding, Group Member Zhao Sihan (87) joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
“Hmm? We have newcomers? And five at once, interesting.”
Wang Ping is surprised, his face filled with astonishment.
Immediately, Wang Ping drops the idea to continue with the simulation, instead directly opening the chat group page.
At this moment, the Transmigrator Chat Group has also lively.
Many group members began to chat.
After all, it has been a while since any newcomers joined.
In addition to the death of the old group members Cai Yonglong and Fang Yun after the last group task, it made the chat group seemed even more deserted.
Wu Jun (20): “Welcome newcomers! Although, joining this chat group might have been an error on your part, but let’s welcome you all the same.”
Liu Mei (15): ‘Yes…After all, the fatality rate is too high.”
Zhang Hu (5): “In the blink of an eye, I’ve become one of the oldest group members. It’s quite sentimental.”
Chen Yao (71):
Qin Tian (77): “Huh, the “newcomers aren’t chatting. Seems like this batch of newcomers have something going on, they must be reading the group notice.”
Wang Ping (66): “Unless something unexpected happens, it should be like that. They should start chatting after they finish.”
Chen Si (83): “Wu wu wu, I don’t want to transmigrate. Can I stay on Earth? I am sure to die if l, a girl, transmigrate.”
Wang Ping (66): “I’m sorry, as acting group master, I regret to inform you that this, unfortunately, is not possible.”
Chen Si (84): how can it be like this.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Um, ah…the last person with the surname Chen I remember was Chen Kang, who joined the group with me and Mr. Wang. He met such a tragic end, not surviving even for five seconds.”
Liu Mei (15): “l remember it too… He was directly devoured when he transmigrated to a place infested with mutated zombies. So terrible.”
Wang Ping (66): “Now that you mention it, I remember it too.”
Chen Si (84): “Wait, are you talking about Chen Kang? Is this what he looks like? Pic.jpg..”

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _5
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, how did you know? Do you have a connection with him or something?”
Chen Si (84): “He’s my brother… my own brother…l thought he didn’t answer the phone because he didn’t want to, but he actually died… brother… how could you die so miserably? *sobs* ”
Wang Ping (66): “…This chat group is really harmful. It trapped someone’s brother to death and even dragged his sister in.”
Liu Mei (15): “In this situation, I don’t know what to say. Condolences. Then, strive to survive.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Crying is meaningless. You’d better prepare supplies. Also, if you need help, you can ask for me.”
Wang Ping (66): ‘Yes, I can provide some basic supplies for you newcomers.”
After last group task, Wang Ping and others discussed in the chat group that they should change the rules, and they must try their best to increase the survival rate of newcomers and the number of group members.
If a newcomer gets a strong Golden finger and survives, they would be able to better deal with the bizarreness.
This way, they could better cope with future crises.
In any case, they have all grown up now, and some things are readily available for their use, but for newcomers, those things might be lifesaving items.
For this reason, the group members have basically prepared an exclusive newcomer gift package after a newcomer enters the group.
Zhang Jun provided lower-grade crystal stones from his world, which can strengthen the physique.
Wang Ping prepared various elixirs, including low-grade detoxification elixirs, blood burst elixirs, and cleaning heart elixirs of 1st and 2nd tier.
Liu Mei’s world seems to be an ordinary ancient world, she could only offer some ancient costumes and gold and silver jewelry, to make a contribution.
Qin Tian got low-level array plates, and Chen Yao got some talismans.
Anyway, every capable group member would try their best to contribute, to improve the survival rate of newcomers as much as possible.
Chen Si (83): “Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.”
Zhang Jun (70)@(83): “Actually, I should have avenged your brother.”
Wang Ping (66): “Huh, what do you mean?”
Zhang Jun (70): “l watched that video too, the characteristic of the mutated zombie is very obvious, I’ve encountered it and killed it. At the same time, I found Chen Kangs clothes fragments and backpack at the location in the video.’
Wang Ping (66): “…Ah, that’s how it is. But it seems like the chat group likes to send us to the same world. When one dies, another one is filled in.’
Chen Yao (71): “Yes, speaking of that, those group members who ‘landed in a coffin’ could be in the same world with one of us, but they don’t know the truth since they ‘landed in a coffin’.’!
Ye Xiaofan (75): “So, I discovered something amazing. That is… the probability of the first two travelers arriving in a world and dying is high, and the survival rate for later travelers is much higher.”
Zhang Jun (70): “That makes some sense, but not much. Could it be that the chat group is like drawing a card, drawing a guarantee?”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s not impossible. After all, there is the theory of world repulsion. We can understand the reason for all the newcomers ending up dead because of world repulsion. Since the world is repelling the travelers, the originally set safe landing points were twisted, which is why there are so many sudden deaths.”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, Mr. Wangs analysis makes a lot of sense. But isn’t it wrong to blame the chat group? It’s not that it doesn’t care about a group member’s life, it’s because of the world’s repulsion?”
Wang Ping (66): “I’m just guessing. There are still doubts. Such as why the chat group would be repelled by sending people from the past to save the world and eliminate the bizarreness. Or those low-level worlds have only instinctual consciousness, instinctively repelling foreign objects, while powerful worlds don’t.”
Qin Tian (77): “Mr. Wangs analysis is very reasonable. For example, my and
Ye Xiaofan’s cultivation world did not repel us, we both survived. And Mr. Wang and Mr. Cai’s Profound World is like this too.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “This hypothesis makes some sense, but it has big flaws.
Although it is common for travelers and reincarnators to appear in the Cultivation and Profound World novels, and it is also common for the settings of some major plots to involve travelers and reincarnators, it does not mean that the world doesn’t repel outsiders. For example, some dead newcomers traveled to a terrifying world.”
Wu Yueming (79): “Well, an ordinary person traveling to that kind of terrifying world, even with the chat group’s care, would naturally have a high mortality rate. In fact, I am more inclined to the option of feeling the stones to cross the river. Decaying travelers are repelled and could be seen as feeling the stones to cross the river. The survival rate of later travelers will gradually increase. ”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Uh, the topic seems to be off track. What about the newcomers? They don’t even know what to say.”
Xu Yi (84): “I’m just preparing supplies… But I found that you seem to have omitted something. That is, why do you all choose physical travel? There’s clearly the soul travel option.”
Luo Weiguo (85): “Honestly, I’m also puzzled about this..”

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 116: Slaying the Profound Elixir Realm! A New Method of Crossing Over! _6
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “Soul Travel? Wait, did the chat group secretly update its features again without telling us?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, Soul Travel, I’m so envious. It seems like the system really wants to save the new group members’ lives.”
Wu Jun (20): “Same here. It feels like they’re trying to take a more aggressive approach.”
Qin Tian (77): “To be honest, this makes more sense. Physical Travel isn’t as safe as Soul Travel. Although you get a new body with Soul Travel, it’s easier to integrate into the Exoteric World, and the survival rate is higher!”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Well, it’s not necessarily better… If Soul Travel were that great, the system wouldn’t still offer the option of Physical Travel. Although Soul Travel may have a higher survival rate in the early stages, the problems of soul and body mismatch are quite troublesome. Besides, are you still the same person after your soul merges with a new body? That is, unless you Soul
Travel into a baby’s body.”
Qin Tian (77): “Err, you have a point.”
Luo Weiguo (85): “I don’t mind either way, but I’ll choose Soul Travel. After all, I’m already 40 years old and suffering from lung cancer. 1 don’t have long to live. Getting a new body through Soul Travel is a great opportunity given by the chat group.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “I’m also grateful to the chat group. After all, my body is paralyzed, and I can’t move. My life is worse than death. I want Soul Travel and a new life!”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Boohoo, I’m just a junior high school student, and I’m not sick. I don’t want to travel or change bodies. Why did I join this dangerous chat group in a moment of exhaustion and confusion?”
Seeing the reactions of the newcomers, Wang Ping and the others were lost in thought.
It seems that after updating the Soul Travel feature, the system began adding people with illnesses to the chat group.
Maybe the chat group wasn’t entirely good-hearted, but it ultimately helped these people, potentially giving them a brand new life.
Oh, chat group, I shouldn’t have accused you of being completely heartless.
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Luo Weiguo (85): “Since it’s Soul Travel, I don’t need to prepare any supplies. I’ll start traveling right away. Good luck to me, brothers.”
After saying this, Luo Weiguo chose to travel.
Then Luo Weiguo felt his consciousness sway for a moment. After a few seconds of darkness, his vision brightened again.
He saw a strange ceiling and an unfamiliar female face.
This female face was haggard and frail, but her eyes exuded motherly love.
“Is this… me?”
Luo Weiguo stared dumbfounded at the woman, then looked at his palm, feeling ecstatic.
He had indeed Soul Traveled and become a young man.
Although it seemed his circumstances weren’t great, it didn’t matter.
At least he had been given a new life and a youthful body. He was determined
to live freely and enjoy life this time!
Wang Ping (66) @ Luo Weiguo (85): “Newcomer, how’s your situation? Have you traveled?”
Luo Weiguo (85): “I’m out, and I feel great! I’ve Soul Traveled into a young man, and I just got a Golden Finger! The ability to control trees—it’s weak, but I’m already very satisfied! ”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, Soul Travel is so cool, huh? You instantly become a young man—it’s really comfortable.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Indeed, it’s refreshing. At the same time, I’m relieved. Since the chat group allows people to Soul Travel to improve their survival rate, it’s likely that all kinds of mandatory dangerous tasks won’t appear frequently. Otherwise, these changes would ultimately just be superficial.”
Liu Mei (15): “1 feel the same.’
Wu Jun (20): “Um, am I the only one who thinks the newcomer’s ability is not weak? This is the ability of the First Generation Hokage.”
Zhang Hu (5): “The First Generation Hokage? Is that strong?”
Wu Jun (20): “Err, never mind. It’s not that impressive in the grand scheme of things.”
Wang Ping (66): “We shouldn’t underestimate the newcomer’s Golden Finger. Perhaps there are hidden abilities we don’t know about.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Since Luo has demonstrated it for me, I’ll travel too.”
Soon, Zhang Yueying chose to travel as well.
This time, she also opted for Soul Travel.
Like Luo Weiguo, she traveled into the body of a woman.
Although she wasn’t a young girl and appeared to be in dire straits, it was still a good outcome.
This once again proved one thing.
Soul Travel is safe and doesn’t result in instant death.
The chat group seems to be genuinely concerned about the lives of their group members now.
The uneventful travels of the first two newcomers tempted the remaining three.
After all, with the high death rate of Physical Travel, Soul Travel seemed to be the safer option.
In the end, Zhao Sihan chose Soul Travel.
However, something unexpected and silent happened.
She did Soul Travel, but instead of a person, she ended up in the body of a cat.
Zhang Hu (5): “Well, it seems that Soul Travel is not completely foolproof.
Although it won’t kill you, it’s possible to end up in an animal’s body. What concerns me the most is Soul Traveling into creatures like flatworms or mice —that’s just terrifying.”
Xu Yi (84): “No words… 1 was considering Soul Travel. Never mind, I’ll stick with Physical Travel. I’m happy with my current body, and I want to remain human.’
Chen Si (83): “l- I don’t know what to do… I’m afraid of dying like my brother, and I’m also afraid of becoming a mouse.”
Wang Ping (66): “If you’re scared, just roll the dice. You have to choose one.” Chen Si (83):
Qin Tian (77): “Haha, my man Wang, truly an invincible straight man.”
Under the strange atmosphere in the group chat,
Chen Si and Xu Yi decided to take the plunge and choose Physical Travel just like everyone else.
Surprisingly, neither of them encountered instant deaths this time, and both traveled to locations above ground—a relatively safe outcome.
Of course, various challenges still lie ahead, which they need to overcome.
If not, even if the chat group solves the instant death problem, they could still face dangers and perish.
“The chat group has really changed. Out of the five newcomers this time, none of them died instantly upon traveling. Among them, only Zhao Sihan had it rough, ending up as a stray cat.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, deep in thought, and felt happy about the changes in the chat group.
At the same time, he pondered the reason behind these changes.
Were the people behind the chat group affected by their complaints and conspiracy theories, prompting them to make these changes?
If that was the case, Wang Ping felt like he and the others should complain a few more times.
While Wang Ping was thinking, he suddenly felt his consciousness sway and was pulled into a strange space..

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 117: Behind the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 117: Behind the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster
Translator: 549690229
“Where is this…?”
The sudden change in his view startled Wang Ping, his pupils constricting as he surveyed the dark surroundings, his heart feeling heavy.
To be able to silently transport him to such a strange place, the strength of his opponent must be unimaginably terrifying.
Furthermore, there had never been an event like this predicted in the Life Simulator.
Was this an occurrence beyond the Life Simulator?
“No need to be alarmed. It was I who summoned you here.”
A mechanical voice rang out, causing Wang Ping to pause and stare towards the source.
He then saw a humanoid mechanical figure appearing out of the darkness, equipped with various mechanical devices but also possessing fantastical energy wings.
Because of the wings’ enchanting energy, the space brightened quite a bit, causing Wang Ping to squint his eyes.
“Are you the creator of the chat group?”
Wang Pings heart felt a turmoil, and he inquired tentatively.
The mechanical voice is too similar to the chat group’s notification tone, so he couldn’t help but suspect.
Moreover, any entity that goes unnoticed in the prediction range of the Life Simulator and doesn’t intend to harm him is seemingly only this person.
“No, I am not the creator of the chat group but the Transmigrator Chat Group’s intelligent system lifeform – Alpha.”
The mechanical Alpha spoke in a cold, mechanized voice.
Upon hearing these words, Wang Pings heart shuddered, realizing that this was the representative created by the maker of the Transmigrator Chat Group and the hidden existence managing it.
“I am curious why you summoned me. Are you offended by our complaints? If so, we will not discuss them again in the future,” Wang Ping took a deep breath and said cautiously.
This group upholds freedom of speech and does not pay attention to the members’ remarks,” Alpha said calmly, devoid of any emotional fluctuations.
“l summoned you only because you have contributed the most to this group, and I have chosen you as the acting group master. If someone else had performed better before this, they would have been the acting group master and would have taken your place.”
“l see. So, what is the purpose of summoning me here? Surely it’s not just to
discuss these matters.”
Wang Pings heart shuddered, continuing to inquire.
“Deception is the enemy of all intelligent living beings. They appear in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, exterminating the intelligent life forms in various worlds and turning them into their nourishment. Ultimately, it leads to the World Source’s incompatibility and loss. Thus, it is something the world despises and fears.”
Alpha spoke calmly.
“For some reason, the Transmigrator Chat Group was created with the purpose of collecting the World Source from various worlds. However, the group cannot use forcibly plundered World Sources. Simultaneously, the world is exclusionary, whether it’s a higher or lower world, it will always repel outsiders.’
“For this reason, deception comes in handy. When deceit appears in the world, the world’s barriers weaken and become less exclusive.’
“However, this is only relative; the transmigrators I cast will still be affected. Therefore, the death rate is quite high. It is necessary to keep casting until at least one survival is achieved.’
“At the same time, as long as the transmigrator kills the deceptive creatures threatening the world, the world will accept the transmigrator. They can cooperate with the chat group by giving the World Source as a price for the group’s protection. Meanwhile, as long as the Transmigrator is in that world, they will continue to supply the chat group with the World Source, albeit in small quantities that won’t impact the world significantly.”
Currently, I have found five deceptive worlds. By sending you to eliminate them, not only are their World Sources obtained, but these five worlds also accept the transmigrators and enter into cooperation with me, providing the chat group with numerous World Sources to optimize the group and better train the transmigrators.”
“Uh….” Wang Ping was speechless, knowing that Alpha was addressing his previous doubts.
So, that’s the truth?
Although the Transmigrator Chat Group is indifferent to the lives of new members, it is not entirely indifferent to the lives of old members. Instead, they have no choice but to operate this way.
However, this also indirectly indicates that the Transmigrator Chat Group is indeed very young, seemingly newly established.
Moreover, Alpha explained so much to him, most likely because they didn’t want him to overthink and instead focus on his work.
Of course, Wang Ping did not know whether what Alpha said was true or false.
Regarding this matter, Wang Ping could only believe about 50% of it.
Seemingly seeing Wang Ping’s thoughts. Aloha snoke again: “The Golden Finger manifested by each individual’s World Source is different. Your situation is rather unique, so I am sharing this information with you. Your doubts will only hinder the development of the chat group.”
“I’m sorry.” Wang Ping fell silent, apologizing sincerely.
The representative of the chat group’s creator personally explained so much to him, giving him great face. However, they probably did so because his Life Simulator was unique, and he could better guide the group’s members.
However, he indeed did not need to think too much about it.
Without the chat group, he would still be just an ordinary loser on Earth.
“I am curious about why only people from Earth, like us, can be selected and transmigrated..”

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping seemed to have remembered something and pursued,
He still had many questions in his mind.
“Because humans from that Earth are special, they were specially modified. As for the reasons, you don’t have the sufficient authority and hence, the right to know yet. ”
Alpha succinctly explained.
“All right.” Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
“Wang Ping, your speculation that the Transmigrator Chat Group has been destroyed and reorganized many times before is correct.”
At this point, Alpha spoke again, his voice unusually no longer mechanical, but rippled.
Wang Ping was shocked.
He was just making a random guess, could it actually be true? It was quite an outlandish thought.
“The original chat group did not use World Source to give transmigrators the golden finger. For me back then, the transmigrators were nothing more than pawns. By introducing a large number of humans into various worlds for breeding, surely some of them could grow. Moreover, those who would grow on their own could go further in the future.”
“Fact proved that my idea was correct. The vast majority of transmigrators died miserably. But indeed, some people grew up and reached amazing levels on their own. But they did not follow the arrangements of the chat group, one of them lay low until the end and eventually destroyed the original chat group.”
“Afterwards, when I reorganized the Transmigrator Chat Group, I strengthened control over the transmigrators, but ultimately it led to another dead end. Because I didn’t offer them sufficient benefits and forced them to undertake dangerous missions, they chose silent rebellion. Although, over time, some lucky and intelligent transmigrators did grow to amazing levels, they hated the Transmigrator Chat Group fiercely and ultimately sided with forces similar to the Transmigrator Chat Group like the Myriad Heavens Forces, using them to destroy the chat group.”
“After experiencing many failures, we finally have the current development model of the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
Alpha quietly recounted.
Despite his calm demeanor, Wang Ping felt chills creep up his spine.
It seemed as though he saw a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, piles of the bodies of countless transmigrators.
The Transmigrator Chat Group of the past was too dark.
If he had joined the original Transmigrator Chat Group, Wang Ping felt that he too would have become cannon fodder.
They still complain about the contemporary Transmigrators’ Chat Group being too dark. But in reality, these improvements came in response to a series of reforms that acknowledged the necessity to treat group members better, and to put full efforts into nurturing them. Compared with the old Transmigrators’ Chat Group, the contemporary version is only a minor evil.
“Why are you telling me this?”
Wang Pings expression was somewhat ugly as he asked.
“l mentioned before, your case is special and you are capable of leading the group members forward.”
Alpha, with his emotionless red pupils staring at Wang Ping, calmly responded.
“Moreover, the crucial point is that the current Transmigrators’ Chat Group can’t withstand any more upheavals. If it were to be destroyed again, there would no longer be a chance to reorganize. What you guys will face next, is not limited to just the Guaijie.”
“To be exact, with your current abilities, encountering dangerous Guaijie is already an act of desperation. This is because only in doing so can the Transmigrators’ Chat Group obtain more development funds. Otherwise, we are simply too poor.”
Towards the end, even the mechanical Alpha seemed to sigh.
” . . . . . ” Wang Ping fell silent.
Goodness me, no matter which world it is, it requires money.
His simulations required Spiritual Stones, which are equivalent to money.
Alpha’s development of the Transmigrator Chat Group also required money.
It’s just that everyone’s need for ‘money’ differs greatly.
Alpha required advanced currency like the World Source, whereas he only needed lower-grade items such as the Spiritual Stones. “What are we going to face next?”
Wang Ping remained silent for a moment before asking.
“All Heavens and Thousands of Realms have many special forces. The Master Lord Tier Space, Reincarnation Land, and Abyssal Space that you can recall are all real. Such forces tend to destabilize the world, distort it, or plunder the World Source voraciously, without any regard for whether the world will perish or practice sustainable development.”
Alpha calmly answered Wang Pings question.
“l will continue to send transmigrators into different worlds. Once we form an alliance with those worlds, we must protect them from any intruder’s mischief. Whether they are Guaijie, Chaotic Evil Forces, or monsters that roam around All Heavens, all of them are targets you need to deal with.”
“l have a feeling that dealing with these forces will be more dangerous than dealing with Guaijie. Can you really deal with the forces behind them now? Besides, we can’t deal with the ones they have trained, right?”
Wang Pings face contorted in response.
“Don’t worry, all you need to deal with are the ones they have trained. Those forces that break worlds for fun and forcefully collect World Source are known as Chaotic Evil Forces, while forces like ours are called Chaotic Orderly Forces. We are enemies, but there are unspoken rules.”
Alpha calmly stated.
“So you mean, the Transmigrators’ Chat Group is a part of the alliance of Chaotic Orderly Forces. There are forces capable of restraining those powerful forces, right?” Wang Pings mood jolted as he guessed.
Alpha didn’t give a direct answer to Wang Pings question, he just nodded..

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_3
Translator: 549690339
“Okay.” Wang Ping let out a sigh of relief.
Learning so many secrets, he could finally catch his breath.
“Since you’ve told me so much, does that mean I’ll get exceptional care?”
Wang Pings eyes lit up as he asked.
“Since I’ve told you all this, hoping you could help me develop the
Transmigrator Chat Group better, of course you would be given special care. Your previous 90% off coupon was the case. Hence, you only need to finish your tasks to earn extra group points. At the same time, you’ll also get a cut when group members complete their tasks. However, as you know how vital the World Source is to the Transmigrator Chat Group, if you fail to prove your worth, your privileges will be revoked.”
Alpha gazed at Wang Ping, saying calmly.
“Finally, don’t harbor any fantasies about me saving you after your death. Although I would not like to see any group members with strong talents dying, I am not a nanny either. If you genuinely have such a strong talent and still accidentally die, it simply means you’re nothing but a golden fingered loser who is not worth investing resources in developing.”
“…..” Wang Ping was lost for words.
Initially, in the chat group, without any golden fingers, some experts depend solely on their growth to reach the level of destroying other chat groups. It was absurd.
If he still dies even with a life simulator, it indeed proves that he is a waste. For a chat group that has seen all kinds of unusual group members after cultivating different strains, he indeed isn’t worth developing.
However, allowing him to get a cut of the group members’ task points implies that the frequency of group tasks might increase in the future, but they won’t be as lethal as against the bizarre.
Apart from this, Alpha is suggesting that he should develop the chat group and rationally cultivate other group members.
After all, Alpha appears to be emotionless and cold. He has failed many times before, even being destroyed by human experts raised with various cultivation techniques.
Therefore, giving charge to him who is also a human might be a more effective way to develop the Transmigrator Chat Group and cultivate more, stronger, and obedient transmigrators.
“You really think highly of me. However, since we’ve reached this point, whether for my safety or future development prospects, I have to work hard to develop the chat group. In other words, I will accept everything that comes my way.”
Wang Ping nodded, seriously responding.
“Strive to get stronger, only then can you lead the Transmigrator Chat Group better and possibly save your life when against Chaos evil cultivators.”
Alpha spoke again.
“Also, remember, the secret of the chat group must not be disclosed to other group members.”
Having said these words, Alpha disappeared.
Then, Wang Ping felt a jolt, his vision shifted, and he found himself back in the loft.
He gazed at the scenery outside the loft, lost in deep thought.
“Knowing the truth about the Transmigrator Chat Group added more pressure. However, somehow, I also feel somewhat relieved. Ah, what conflicting feelings. ”
Finally, Wang Ping exhaled deeply and murmured. “Next, let’s continue with the simulation.’
Wang Ping shook his head, muttering to himself.
Now that he knows the truth, he should strive to become stronger.
As for what sort of worlds are awaiting the five novice transmigrators, Wang Ping is no longer interested in prying now.
Anyway, he will find out sooner or later.
Also, as long as they aren’t dead, it could only mean one of two things – either the chat group has previously sent many transmigrators to their worlds, or their worlds have been cleared before. “System, I want to proceed with the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping requested within his heart.
“Ding! Consuming 50,000 mid-tier spirit stones, Life Simulator is booting up, Talent Refresh commencing…..”
The voice from the Life Simulator System timely provided reassurance to Wang Ping.
Well, the sound of the Life Simulator System is more comforting. Although Alpha’s voice also has a mechanized quality, it’s too cold and devoid of empathy, unlike the soothing sound of the Life Simulator System.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations host for not refreshing any talents.’
The system blared once again, leaving Wang Pings expression stiff.
Alright, he took back what he said earlier – this voice is very annoying indeed.
Anyway, Wang Ping is not ready to admit that he is starting to get unlucky again.
[ The first day, you were busy cultivating.]
[The 20th year, you went on a killing spree in the Seven Star Secret Realm, gaining numerous benefits.]
[The 30th year, on Sacred Heart Island, you successfully refined a 7th tier Soul
Nourishing Elixir. This helped you breakthrough to the mid-Yun Ling
Region.]
[ Then, you returned to the Profound Turtle Continent and brought Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong with you to leave the Profound Turtle Continent, repeating things you remembered.]
[ The 140th year, you successfully broke through to the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[ Up next, you waited for the arrival of the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master. This time, you chose to run away beforehand, fled to a barren place, used a trap in it to fight him. You successfully killed the Shadow Profound
Elixir Realm master and gained a lot of benefits.]
[ Because you handled it well, your reputation didn’t soar exceedingly this time. You were still very low-profile, and the many forces on Sacred Heart Island didn’t notice anything unusual about your strength. ]
[ However, because of your actions, the two 8-tier Alchemists on Sacred Heart Island didn’t consider you a major sect successor. You knew they wouldn’t teach you Alchemy, so you didn’t bother looking for them..]

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_4
Translator: 549690339
[After that, you returned to the Seven Stars Archipelago and obtained the Sea and Sky Staff from the Sea Ape Clan. Then, you continued to cultivate quietly, planning to wait until the Blood Demon Cave opened to enter and obtain a large number of Blood Demon Crystals, which would help you break through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm.]
[In the 200th year, the Blood Demon Cave opened; you entered and hunted Blood Demons to obtain Blood Demon Crystals. Your strength made your harvest quite successful.]
[However, you didn’t gain any other opportunities. Still, when the Blood
Demon Cave closed, you found out that a Profound Elixir Realm master from
Green Moon Sect had fallen, and you were secretly glad.]
[Next, you noticed that the auras of other Profound Elixir Realm masters on Sacred Heart Island were unstable; they were more or less injured. You were surprised and wondered what had happened in the Blood Demon Cave that caused all the Profound Elixir Realm masters to be so miserable, even losing one.]
[You tried to gather information but ultimately couldn’t find out much, as these Profound Elixir Realm masters kept their secrets closely guarded.]
[In the end, you gave up on trying to learn more and continued concentrating on cultivating in seclusion, aiming to break through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm.]
[In the 255th year, you successfully broke through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm with the help of Blood Demon Crystals after 55 years of cultivation. Your strength improved greatly, and you were satisfied, feeling that you may not be the weakest among the Profound Elixir Realm anymore.]
[However, chaos soon erupted on Sacred Heart Island after you broke through.]
[You investigated the cause of the disturbance on Sacred Heart Island, only to be shocked to discover countless blood monsters similar to the Blood Demons from the Blood Demon Cave, but even more terrifying. It seemed like they had developed intelligence, growing stronger after devouring the essences of murdered cultivators.]
[This scene reminded you of the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, sending chills down your spine. You became more convinced of your suspicion that
Simulation Towards Immortality In A Group Chat to the Blood Demons. Blood Demon Yuan Fengs Cultivation Skill was likely created by drawing on the abilities of Blood Demons.]
[You began to kill these Blood Demon clones, trying to escape Sacred Heart Island. With your great strength, you managed to kill these monsters and make a desperate escape. Along the way, you discovered something: the Blood Demon clones causing chaos on Sacred Heart Island were not particularly powerful. From Green Moon Palace and other major powers’ locations, horrifying evil auras could be sensed.]
[Realizing this, you recalled the desperate appearances of these Profound Elixir Realm masters 55 years ago after the Blood Demon Cave had opened, speculating that they had done something within the cave, stirring up significant trouble. Now, they were facing retribution, and you and other cultivators were the innocent bystanders caught in the crossfire.]
[Furious, you felt that these lofty Profound Elixir Realm masters were utterly deplorable. Following that, you didn’t linger, wanting to quickly escape and leave Sacred Heart Island, seeking refuge overseas.]
[Unfortunately, your powerful aura was noticed by a powerful enemy, a Profound Elixir Realm master who engaged you in a fierce battle.]
[You didn’t want to get involved with him and tried to use the Illusionary Dragon Movement to escape, but he stubbornly stuck to you. At the same time, more Blood Demon clones joined the fray and fused into the Profound Elixir Realm body of the Blood Demon, continuously strengthening him.]
[In the end, you couldn’t shake off his pursuit. Knowing there was no doubt you would die if you continued like this, you fought him, determined to kill him. Finally, with a self-destructive fighting style, you managed to kill him once at the cost of using a Rebirth tally.]
[However, you soon encountered even more powerful Blood Demons.
Ultimately, you died while attempting to escape.]
[Due to your death, the simulation has ended…]
“What exactly did these Profound Elixir Realm masters do in the Blood Demon Cave that so many Blood Demon clones appeared 55 years later?”
Wang Ping stared at the simulation content, speechless.
The Profound World truly lived up to its name: full of dangers one after another. Even if one tried to live in peace, they would still suffer calamity.
If he, with his Profound Elixir Realm strength, had died, one could hardly imagine the tragic fate of ordinary cultivators and ordinary people.
“But the system said it was a Blood Demon clone. Does that mean the Blood Demon Cave, like the Profound Turtle’s body, sealed a great Demon, specifically, a Blood Demon?”
Wang Ping thought of the Blood Demon clones mentioned in the simulation and pondered.
However, if such a terrifying Blood Demon was sealed, why didn’t the Heavenly Sword Divine Land intervene and eliminate it completely?
Was it because they could not handle it, the cost was too high, or they simply utilized the sealed Blood Demons, creating a secret realm for people to gain opportunities and blessings for future generations?
The last possibility seemed the most plausible.
Perhaps this crisis wouldn’t have occurred if the Profound Elixir Realm masters on Sacred Heart Island hadn’t stirred up trouble.
“If my guess is correct, what kind of treasure could make these Profound Elixir Realm masters risk their lives and even threaten the seal to fight for it?” Wang Ping was intrigued, but merely toyed with the idea.
With his current cultivation, even reaching the half-step Profound Elixir Realm level in the simulation, the secrets of the Blood Demon Cave were well beyond his reach..

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_5
Translator: 549690339
It was quite possible that in his eagerness to uncover secrets, he might lose his life and waste several simulation opportunities without even uncovering any secrets. This was simply not worth it.
The most important point was that even if he wanted to explore secrets before the simulation, the Wang Ping in the simulation might not comply with his intentions.
Even though the simulated Wang Ping was him, he was not something he could control. This simulated self had his own consciousness, his own life, and naturally, he cherished his life.
If he knew it was dangerous, he wouldn’t just rush in to get killed. That wasn’t his style.
“However, I’m not in a hurry. After all, I have plenty of chances. If all else fails, I can just wait to become more powerful before I explore secrets.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
At this moment, Wang Pings vision also underwent a change, and he found himself appearing above the sky.
He knew that the Blue Talent of Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death had been triggered.
Thus, he looked forward and saw an adult Wang Ping with ethereal wings forming behind him, frantically escaping.
Behind him, a monster made entirely of blood without any facial features was transformed into a ray of blood, chasing the adult Wang Ping.
In the end, the adult Wang Ping was caught up with and a fierce battle broke out.
The power of the Blood Demon avatar was too strong, and every collision could devour parts of the adult Wang Pings flesh and blood. Additionally, their power carried the same corroding effect as the Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword.
Apart from that, the recovery ability of the Blood Demon avatar was very abnormal, making it difficult to completely annihilate.
Ultimately, even if the two sides were not that far apart in terms of power,
Wang Ping was eventually worn down and died alive. He was devoured by the
Blood Demon avatar in despair and resentment, making it even more
powerful.
At the end of the day, even though the adult Wang Pings attack and speed had reached the standards of the normal Profound Elixir Realm, he still couldn’t withstand a prolonged fight.
Heaven-tier Martial Skills consumed too much Spiritual Essence.
Moreover, the secret skill of the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill could not be sustained for a long time.
“Although 1 know what my shortcomings are, Heaven-tier secret skills are hard to come by. It’s a long road to supplement my recovery ability and defense and to allow me to engage in prolonged battles.”
After watching all this, Wang Ping’s vision returned to reality and he sighed.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.
Five Elements Spirit Fire.
Combat Experience.”
“System, I choose 2.”
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards and made his selection.
As for Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, he could choose it later. Now that he knew how to break through, it was basically guaranteed for him to reach that level.
What Wang Ping was most worried about was not the Half-step Profound Elixir Realm, but how to condense a 1st-tier, or even a Flawless Profound Elixir.
After all, this determined how far you could go.
To condense a top-tier Profound Elixir required a solid foundation, strong Spiritual Essence, powerful Cultivation Skills… it needed everything, it was truly troublesome.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt a multicolored peculiar flame appearing in his Elixir Field.
That was the Five Elements Spirit Fire.
The intensity of the Five Elements Spirit Fire was not inferior to some naturally cultivated Spirit Fires, and might even surpass them.
Of course, the strength of Spirit Fires also varied. Even some extraordinarily strong Spirit Fires couldn’t compare with it.
Besides, this was just a comparison of the different types of Spirit Fires. In essence, Spirit Fires were flames that assisted those in the Transcendent Realm and the Profound Elixir Realm.
Above Spirit Fire, there existed even more terrifying flames.
However, these were obviously levels that the current Wang Ping could not reach.
“With the Five Elements Spirit Fire, my combat power will be slightly stronger. Next, I should simulate again. This time, let’s get the 8-tier
Alchemist reward as well. And at the same time, let’s see if we can get the
8-tier Breaking Disaster Elixir or Sword-type Profound Instrument reward.” Wang Ping thought to himself.
The 8-tier Breaking Disaster Elixir could break curses; it would surely be of great use in the future and could be kept for future use.
Besides, there was the question of weapons.
In the scenes he had just seen, although he was wearing top-tier spiritual armor and the like, his weapon was still the Sea and Sky Staff, which was quite frustrating.
The Sea and Sky Staff was indeed a Profound Instrument, but after all, it wasn’t a sword. It felt really awkward to use it.
Moreover, the Sea and Sky Staff was a water-attributed Profound Instrument, which wasn’t quite matching with his attributes.
Although he was cultivating the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, water wasn’t his main attack element. His primary attack was fire, so getting a fire-attributed Profound Instrument sword was necessary.
Of course, getting one with Five Elements attributes would be the best.
However, the rarity of such Profound Instruments was terrifying even to think about. It was likely more difficult than getting five different attribute Profound Instruments at the same time, so he didn’t get his hopes up too much.
“Today, I’ll simulate one last time. If I remains unlucky, it means that this period is not suitable for paid simulations.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he thought to himself.
“System, I want to conduct a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Paid Simulation payment successful. The Life Simulator is starting, reloading talents…”
The system’s voice rang out in time.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the White Talent: Extroverted Character.”
White Talent: Extroverted Character: The host’s personality will become very outgoing.
“Alright, it seems that this period is really not suitable for paid simulations.”
Looking at the refreshed talent, Wang Ping was speechless.
“Ding, Talent loading successful. Life Simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the familiar words manifested on the luminescent screen..

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 117: The Behind-the-Scenes of the Chat Group! Blood Demon Disaster_6
Translator: 549690339
This simulation was basically the same as the last one, but with a more outgoing personality, there were some funny moments.
Besides, when Wang Ping arrived at Sacred Heart Island, he killed the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master as soon as he appeared.
With Wang Pings fame on the rise, he successfully found two 8-tier
Alchemists to gain Alchemy Experience and discussed Alchemy with them.
Then, ten years later, Wang Ping successfully became an 8-tier Alchemist and refined the Breaking Disaster Elixir.
However, Wang Ping knew that if he stayed on Sacred Heart Island and his cultivation progressed slowly, he would definitely be targeted by powerful forces like Green Moon Sect and suspected of being a Major Sect Successor.
For this reason, Wang Ping decided to leave Sacred Heart Island and go to a secluded place to cultivate.
[Next, you’ll continue to wander between various islands, seeking opportunities. Unfortunately, the chances of quickly breaking through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm are extremely rare, and you haven’t found any yet.]
[You’ve considered leaving this sea region and using the Delivery Array on Sacred Heart Island to go to the Eastern Desolation, but you also thought that the powers connected to the Delivery Array are under the control of Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and going there would be like delivering yourself to the enemy. As a result, you’re frustrated once again for being considered a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’. ]
[Later, you recall Blood Demon Yuan Fengs situation on Profound Turtle Continent, and think that after so many years, he should be weaker, and you, who already have the fighting capacity of the Profound Elixir Realm, might be able to kill him and reveal his secrets.]
[In the end. you decide to return to Profound Turtle Continent. After arriving
at Devil’s Cave, you’re surprised to find that Blood Demon Yuan Feng has already died, and his soul has completely dissipated. You sigh in your heart, even a Life and Death Realm Master can’t escape the ravages of time.]
[You search all over the Devil’s Cave, hoping to find any inheritance left by Blood Demon Yuan Feng. Eventually, you find the Demonic inheritance left by him in the Blood Demon Cave.]
[You’re overjoyed and record all the Demonic inheritances one by one. Then, after making a tombstone for Blood Demon Yuan Feng, you leave.]
[Next, you leave Profound Turtle Continent and return to the many sea islands to cultivate for several decades, but still unable to break through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm. You know that with your Green Talent and
Bone and Root Aptitude, you may be able to reach the half-step Profound Elixir Realm in this lifetime, but the Profound Elixir Realm is probably out of reach.]
[To this end, you plan to use Elixirs or Blood Demon Crystals to break through. After the Blood Demon Cave is opened, you enter it in disguise, hunt Blood Demons, and obtain Blood Demon Crystals. Because you’re low-key this time, you’re not targeted by the Green Moon Sect.]
[When the Blood Demon Cave closes, you see the scene in your memory: Profound Elixir Realm masters are all injured to varying degrees and look miserable, After giving them a cold glance, you choose to leave without alerting anyone.]
[Next, you leave Sacred Heart Island again, come to a remote island to continue cultivating, and finally break through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm 55 years later. After breaking through to half-step Profound Elixir Realm, you keep looking for ways to break through to the Profound
Elixir Realm. You know that there is an 8-tier Elixir called Solidifying Mysterious Elixir that can help people condense Profound Elixirs and enhance their foundation, helping to improve the Profound Elixir Tier.]
[However, unfortunately, the materials required for this Elixir are extremely precious, all 7 or 8-tier, making them difficult to find, even on Sacred Heart Island. Over the years, you’ve only found two 7-tier treasures.]
[In the end, you think that either you cultivate Demonic Skills, or you leave this sea region and go to Eastern Desolation, heading for a wider sky to find opportunities, otherwise, there is no hope of reaching Profound Elixir Realm in this life, and even if you managed to condense Profound Elixir, becoming a Profound Elixir Realm master, it’s estimated that the Profound Elixir Tier would not reach the Upper 3 tier.]
[You’re somewhat hesitant and uncertain about what choice to make.]
[Before long, you hear the news that Sacred Heart Island was almost destroyed, Green Moon Sect, Ice Palace, and many other forces were all wiped out. Luckily, in the end, an elder from Heavenly Sword Divine Land arrived, suppressed the Blood Demon’s avatar, and sealed the Blood Demon Cave, otherwise, this sea region would probably have been destroyed.]
[You’re shocked and didn’t expect that the two major powers would cease to exist. In the end, you give up the idea of cultivating Demons. Cultivating Demons within the power range of Heavenly Sword Divine Land is simply too dangerous, and it’s easy to be noticed by them and die a violent death.]
[Although you can cultivate Bloodthirsty Demon Technique with the help of Sea Clan and Sea Beasts, the Sea Clan is not easy to provoke either. Once you attract the attention of the terrifying Sea Clan, your fate won’t be any better than if you were noticed by Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[Fifty years later, you know you can’t delay any longer, if you continue to do so, you’re afraid you really won’t be able to condense the Elixir. To this end, you plan to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm first, increase your lifespan by 500 years, then figure things out later. At worst, you’ll consider these things in your second life.]
[You attempt to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. In the end, you fail and die due to failure in the breakthrough.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
“Uh, that’s a bit tragic, dying during the breakthrough process. How is this any different from Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun?”
Wang Ping feels a little helpless.
Like Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun, he too failed in his condensing process and left behind incomplete Profound Pills, which were fought over by others.
It seems that his Green Innate Root Talent is even worse compared to Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s talent.
After all, his rapid progress was entirely due to his continuous cultivation of the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, and even then, his cultivation speed in the Spirit Sea Realm was just as slow as a turtle and made him feel restless.
Even with the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, his cultivation speed in the Spiritual Fetus Realm and Spirit Accumulation Realm was not much faster.
Besides that, his comprehension skills are not considered strong, and only got to this point with the help of Green Talent buffs.
Moreover, he only relied on the rewards of the life simulation to pile up his abilities.
In other words, he slightly overestimated his current talent level.
“Bone and Root Aptitude, 1 should upgrade that too. And, the talent for comprehension needs improvement as well. Can’t just rely on Green Sword Dao Talent.’
Wang Ping thinks with some helplessness..

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 118: The Ten Thousand-year Mystery Unveiled! Condemning the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand-year Mystery Unveiled! Condemning the Emperor!
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping sighed again.
When will he get lucky again?
If he could refresh and get a blue Innate Root Talent or a blue Comprehension Talent, that would be awesome.
Maybe with such a talent, the quality of the Profound Elixir he could condense would be higher.
As Wang Ping had various thoughts in his heart, his vision changed and he appeared in an unfamiliar place.
