Then, he saw the whole process of Wang Ping’s breakthrough.
The process of fusing the Five Element Spirit within the body to condense a Profound Elixir was extremely dangerous.
In the end, he failed, his Profound Elixir exploded, and he died completely.
This was even worse than Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun’s breakthrough.
At least Seven Stars Ancestor Nangong Yun was left with an incomplete
Profound Elixir, while Wang Ping, due to the excessive power of his Five Element Spirit, exploded his Profound Elixir, causing him to be blown ashed along with the remote deserted island.
In the end, nothing was left except for a bunch of alarmed Sea Beasts.
“This breakthrough is really dangerous. And there’s no Crossing Tribulation yet. After condensing the Profound Elixir, one has to cross the Tribulation and be baptized by the Heavenly Tribulation.”
Wang Ping’s vision returned to normal, and he sighed secretly.
“Ding, rewards are being generated, the host can choose two from the following rewards:
1.Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.
2.Alchemy Experience.
3.Heaven-tier Cultivation Skill: Bloodthirsty Demon Skill.
4.Combat Experience.
5.White Talent: Extroverted Character.”
“I don’t have to struggle to choose this time. It’s naturally @ and O.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt a huge stream of memory appearing in his mind, leaving him entranced.
After an unknown amount of time, Wang Ping came back to his senses, marveling at the experience.
The experience of an 8-tier Alchemist was indeed much stronger than a 7-tier one.
However, he was just entering the level of an 8-tier Alchemist, and his success rate in refining 8-tier Elixirs was not too high.
This was with the Five Elements Spirit Fire, and without it, his success rate would be even lower.
“However, if I want to refine 8-tier Elixirs, I need a better Elixir Furnace. Otherwise, an ordinary Elixir Furnace won’t be able to withstand the terrifying medicinal power and flames.”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
“Forget it, if I want to get an Elixir Furnace, I have to go back to Seven Stars Archipelago. Even then, I might not find an Elixir Furnace that meets my requirements on the Archipelago. I guess, I have to go to Sacred Heart Island to barely find what I want. It’s too much of a hassle to go back and forth. I’m not in a hurry to practice alchemy in reality, so there’s no rush.”
“Next, I need to think about how to develop the chat group.”
Wang Ping didn’t continue with the simulations and was thinking about the problem of developing the chat group.
This was also a major issue for Wang Ping.
After all, since he was chosen and able to reap enormous benefits from it, he had to do his best to develop the chat group.
Otherwise, if they continued to be as careless as before, with a high death rate among the group members and slow growth, things would definitely go wrong.
In the future, fighting against the various pieces cultivated by the Myriad Heavens Forces wouldn’t be as simple as fighting alone. The strength of the group members must catch up to avoid being beaten up.
Therefore, it was essential to come up with a good development plan.
“Alpha, do I have permission to set up new chat group functions?”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping tried to ask in his heart.
“You can make suggestions, and if they are good, I will use the World Source to create new group functions.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded in Wang Ping’s ear. “All right, as long as you say so, I’ll be at ease.”
Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
What he was most worried about was Alpha being a freeloader and not doing anything, because that would be troublesome for him.
After all, even if he came up with a solution, if Alpha was too stingy, he could only stare helplessly.
As long as he has permission, he can get things done.
A day later, after Wang Ping let Alpha set up a new group function, he opened the chat group.
At this moment, the chat group was still lively.
That’s because the situation of the five new time-travelers had been figured out.
The world Chen Si traversed to was actually the same Swordsman World as Fang Yun.
The reason for this was that Chen Si’s transmigration point was not too far from the asteroid impact site and was learned from the villagers.
By the way, Chen Si’s Golden Finger was an ability called Weakness.
After using it, it could weaken a specific target for one minute, reducing its strength by half.
This ability, to be honest, was quite bugged, as the strength would be cut in half unless it reached a certain level.
Although Chen Si could only use this ability once a day, with a cooldown time of 24 hours, it was still quite overpowered.
Of course, the fact that Chen Si’s traversed world was Fang Yun’s Swordsman World was also quite troublesome because the upper limit of the world’s power was too low.
Fang Yun was stuck at that limit back then.
If it was the previous chat group, Chen Si probably wouldn’t become a powerhouse in his lifetime.
But, Wang Ping felt it was necessary to focus on cultivating Chen Si, the newcomer.
If used well, this ability could definitely turn the tables. Therefore, it was essential to let Chen Si grow up.
As for Luo Weiguo, the first time-traveler who chose Soul Travel, his world also had an ancient background.
However, it was still unclear if there were any special powers in that world..

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _2
Translator: 549690339
Currently, Luo Weiguo is still trying to make a living for his family, and the mysterious veil of the world has not been unveiled.
Xu Yi, the transmigrator’s Golden Finger, has not shown any intention of revealing it, being very cautious.
AS ror tne world ne transmigrated to, It IS very special ancl Interesting to wang Ping.
Because he transmigrated to Earth.
However, calling it Earth, it is actually a parallel world dozens of times larger than Earth.
That is a world invaded by Western gods.
That world has powerful Extraordinary Powers.
The most important thing is that the world has a one-step way to reach the sky.
If a mortal body kills a deity, it can plunder the deity’s power and replace it.
According to the information collected by Xu Yi, the weakest deity has the power to destroy mountains.
These powerful gods can easily destroy a nation like Sakura Nation with one blow, being extremely powerful.
Moreover, this is the case when the real terrifying gods in mythology have not yet descended.
The kings of various gods, such as theGreek Twelve Olympians, have not shown any signs of coming, and once they do, whether that world will be destroyed is a question.
As for Zhao Sihan, who has sadly transmigrated into a cat, her transmigrated world seems to be an Earth with a 21st-century background.
However, it is not an ordinary Earth, but an Earth in the early stages of spiritual revival. She has no idea about the number of powerful beings and the power system.
After all, transmigrating into a cat, it has been hard enough for her to survive.
By the way, Zhao Sihan has also mentioned her Golden Finger.
Her Golden Finger seems to be a very ordinary one, but perhaps it is not ordinary either.
Its name is Wild Growth, which can help her grow rapidly, and in the case of sufficient wildness, can enhance her fighting power.
The last newcomer, Zhang Yueying, also transmigrated to a world that is not an ordinary one.
It is a world similar to the Zombie World.
However, the monsters in that world are not zombies, but another kind of virus.
That is the terrifying virus named JY Virus in her world.
Once infected with this virus, genes will be rewritten, reshaped, and then turned into monsters.
If these viruses carry the genes of other animals during transmission, they will become mixed monsters with these animal characteristics after they become monsters.
These monsters, called mutated beasts in that world, have Frightening Regeneration Skills.
High-level mutated beasts have even more perverted Hyper-Speed Regeneration abilities, and cannot be killed without special equipment and power beyond their regeneration limit.

Of course, the upper limit is probably not as high as Zhang Yueying’s Golden Finger.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _3
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “I made some suggestions to the chat group system and got them approved. As a result, there will be several new features in the chat group soon. The first one is the Revival Function. The Revival Function allows the revival of designated group members by consuming group points. However, the stronger the person, the more difficult it is to revive them. Also, whoever proposes a revival has to use their own group points, so they’ll have to think carefully about it. By the way, already dead group members can also be revived. But the longer they’ve been dead, the more group points it will cost.”
Wang Ping explained.
This function is to prevent potential group members from accidentally dying. Even if they die unexpectedly, at least there is a chance to save them and bring them back to life.
Otherwise, it would be such a pity if a high-potential group member dies unexpectedly.
Apart from that, Wang Ping also had some personal concerns. He was worried about experiencing accidents himself in the future, and this feature at least gave him the hope of being revived.
This function consumes a lot of World Source energy, and although it is paid for by group members, it ultimately consumes too much and doesn’t earn many group points.
Frankly, Alpha almost didn’t agree, but Wang Ping persuaded her eventually.
Liu Mei (15): “Wow, Wang can directly communicate with the chat group system now? That’s impressive…”
Zhang Hu (5): “Holy sh*t, that group function Wang proposed is amazing! Just awesome!”
Not only was Zhang Hu surprised, but everyone else was also overjoyed.
With this group function, there is hope of being revived even after death – it’s simply amazing.
Wang Ping (66): “I just borrowed the revival system from Master Lord Tier Space, it’s not really a big deal. However, it’s indeed a nice benefit. As for those who get resurrected, they will definitely have to pay their debts. Now, let me introduce the second group function.”
Wang Ping (66): “The second zroup function is the Martial Arts Stage. Group members can fight and train continuously in it. At the same time, they can gamble group points in it. Also, there’s the Cultivating Room, where they can cultivate powers from other worlds. You can also consume group points to enhance the cultivation efficiency. This function is suitable for group members who travel to weaker worlds.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “This group function is great for training newcomers.”
Wang Ping (66): “The third point isn’t a new group function, but rather a personal suggestion from me. You can upload all the basic cultivation techniques from various worlds and let the newcomers choose their own paths. Of course, this is just the basics. If they want to learn more advanced skills, they can purchase the cultivation skills and other items in the System Mall.
This will help nurture newcomers in the future and bring you all more income. In addition, as we’ve previously reformed, you can prepare more low-level resources.”
Qin Tian (77): “I have no problem with that. I can even directly give them high-level cultivation techniques. I don’t mind providing other resources either, as they are not worth much.”
Zhang Jun (70): “No, you can’t just give directly. Newcomers can’t just get everything for free. We can help them through the early stages, but they will have to rely on themselves afterward. After all, we all went through the same process. It doesn’t cause a lot of trouble now because there are few of us, but it will be a problem later when there are more people. We need rules.”
Qin Tian (77): “Uh, okay.”
Wang Ping (66): “Zhang Jun is right. However, as an acting master and an alchemist, I should take care of the group members. I’ll treat 1st and 2nd Tier elixirs as a starter gift package for newcomers. For elixirs above 2nd Tier, I’ll try to sell them at a lower price to realize the freedom of elixirs for group members.”
As an alchemist and someone with the Life Simulator to easily level up, he has plenty of time to refine elixirs. He can provide enough elixirs even if he sells them at a slim profit.
Even though it might not be very profitable, with more chat group members in the future, he can earn a lot by refining elixirs and help the group members grow at the same time. It’s a win-win situation.
His prestige will increase over time, making it easier to manage the chat group.
Zhang Jun (70): “Since Wang proposed that, I’ll also prepare some more low-to-mid-level Crystal Stones. I’ll put the low-level ones in the starter gift package, and sell the mid-level ones at a lower price.”
Seeing both Wang Ping and Zhang Jun speak up, the other group members pondered if they had anything abundant and unimportant but could still be helpful to others.
At last, they all fell silent.
Good grief, besides secret techniques and magic stuff, they didn’t really have any resources and could only watch quietly.
Wang Ping (66): “Okay, that’s all for now. If you have any more good suggestions, feel free to share them. As long as they benefit the development of the chat group, improve group members’ growth and survival rates, they can be put forward. If they make sense, I believe the chat group will accept them.”
Chen Yao (71): “I think what we’ve got now is enough. If we rush to reform and develop too much, we may lose sight of the main issue. After all, haste makes waste.”
Xu Yi (84): “Even though I’m new, I agree with what Chen Yao said.” Wang Ping (66): “If that’s the case, then let’s just keep it this way for now..”

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _4
Translator: 549690339
After Wang Ping finished speaking, he went offline.
As Chen Yao said, haste doesn’t get you anywhere. Slow and steady does it.
Alpha was unwilling to make too many changes at once; she really didn’t want to spend the little World Source she had left.
Half a month later, after Wang Ping had refined some Elixirs, he decided to continue with the simulation.
Half a month had passed and Wang Ping felt that his streak of bad luck had probably ended.
Now that the simulation was about to start, he was sure to refresh some powerful talents.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator is starting, refreshing talents…” The system’s voice resounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form.”
Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form: The host’s talent will become extremely extraordinary, comparable to the status of a Great Sect Successor.
“Holy shit! ”
Wang Ping was truly astonished when he saw this refreshed talent. This time, he really had an extraordinary fortune, and precisely what he wanted.
The Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form arguably made up for his deficiency in
Bone and Root Aptitude.
It must be known that the Great Sect Successors are expected to achieve the Life and Death Realm in the future due to their powerful inheritance and excellent training, but this showed the great talent they possessed, which ordinary cultivators could not compare to.
After all, Wang Ping had not had a master to teach him cultivation before, but at least his Cultivation Skills were not weaker than some of the Great Sect Successors.
Even so, he was still stuck at the half step Profound Elixir Realm and was unable to condense an elixir successfully.
In other words, the talents of the Great Sect Successors far exceeded his own.
Even if they became loose cultivators, they had a high probability of becoming
Profound Elixir Realm masters as long as they had access to Heaven-tier Skills.
Even if they couldn’t condense an Upper 3 tier Profound Elixir, they would still be able to condense a mid-tier one easily, and also have the chance of exploring the Yin Yang Mirror in the future.
However, it would be difficult for the loose cultivators who were Great Sect Successors to break through the Life and Death Realm.
Of course, exceptions did exist. Some cultivators with outstanding talents could become Life and Death Realm masters by relying on themselves and establish a Great Sect. There must have been no shortage of such examples.
“With this talent, the Profound Elixir Realm is basically assured, with no more failure. I just don’t know what tier of Profound Elixir I can eventually condense.”
Zhang />Wang Pping’s eyes were filled with anticipation and excitement.
Although he didn’t intend to claim his cultivation level until he found a way to condense a 1st-tier Profound Elixir, if he can break through to the Profound Elixir Realm during the simulation, his strength would soar once more, allowing him to see an even broader sky and gain more chances.
This way, he would be able to learn more about the world and have an even broader vision, which is of vital importance.
“Ding, talent successfully loaded, life simulation beginning.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Immediately after, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and words floated towards Wang Ping, causing him to concentrate on watching the screen.
[Day 1: You are diligently cultivating.]
[Year 5: You break through to Mid-Yun Ling Region.]
[Year 15: You break through to the Late Stage of Spirit Accumulation Realm.]
[Year 20: In the Seven Star Secret Realm, you kill your opponents and gain numerous benefits, then head to Sacred Heart Island and reveal your identity as an 8-tier Alchemist, allowing you to easily obtain the materials for refining a 7th tier : Soul Nourishing Elixir and breaking through to the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm as a result.]
Wang Ping was shocked by the content of the simulation at the beginning.
Goodness, the improvement of this talent was too horrifying.
Previously, it took 140 years and many opportunities before he could break through the Great Perfection of Spirit Accumulation Realm. But this time in the simulation, he only needed 20 years to break through.
This was very unexpected.
It seemed that the Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form not only included Bone and Root Aptitude but also improved all aspects of his being, both soul cultivation and Mana.
This was truly promising.
“It seems that this time I will become a half step Profound Elixir Realm with an unimaginable speed and then break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. However, I can deduce from my own experience how terrifying the cultivation speed of those Great Sect Successors and Holy Land disciples is. Their conditions are beyond the imagination of ordinary cultivators. It’s understandable why the gap between ordinary cultivators and Great Sect
Successors is so big.”
Wang Ping thought silently, continuing to look at the luminescent screen.
[Then you return to the Profound Turtle Continent, take Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong away from the Profound Turtle Continent, and decide to repeat the events in your memory.]
[Year 35: You successfully break through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm and begin to think about condensing an elixir. However, you are aware that it is impossible to condense a high-tier Profound Elixir on Sacred Heart Island. Unless you practice the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, devouring the power of many cultivators, only then can you condense a 3rd Tier Profound Pill. But you are also aware of the consequences of doing so. At the same time, you do not have enough strength to hunt down the Profound Elixir Realm masters of all major forces. You are not arrogant, knowing that these people as old Profound Elixir Realm masters, even if their condensed Profound Elixir tiers are not high, are still not easy to deal with.]
[After thinking it over, you decide to leave Sacred Heart Island and head to the Eastern Desolation. Only in Eastern Desolation would you have the chance to condense a high-tier Profound Elixir.]
[Relying on your powerful cultivation, you cross the sea alone and head to the Eastern Desolation. Along the way, you encounter many dangers, but due to your much higher cultivation level than Bing Ningyue in your memory, you successfully cross the sea without any incidents and step onto the land of Eastern Desolation..]

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 118: The Ten Thousand Year Mystery Unveiled! The conviction of the Emperor! _ 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand Year Mystery Unveiled! The conviction of the Emperor! _ 5
Translator: 549690339
[You are aware that there is a Profound Turtle Spirit within you which must not be detected by members of the Great Sects. As such, you cautiously seek out information and have safely learned about the region in which you have landed.]
[The area you’ve landed in is a remote coastal area in the Eastern Desolate
Sword Domain, ruled by the Heavenly Sea Country. The Heavenly Sword Divine Land is the absolute dominant force in the Sword Domain of the ten major regions in Eastern Desolation, reigning over the whole Sword Domain, an existence of supreme authority.]
However, the Sword Domain is massive, and the Heavenly Sword Divine Land can’t possibly rule all areas thoroughly. There simply aren’t enough personnel, and it’s too complicated to manage. As a result, there are several different-sized kingdoms within the Sword Domain, all vassal states of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, obligated to pay tribute annually.]
[The Heavenly Sword Divine Land doesn’t care about the warfare between its vassal states, but only allows nations of equal standing to wage war against each other, forbidding those with greater might to bully the weaker ones. However, should any other foreign forces intervene and bully the vassal states, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land will step in.]
[The territory where you’ve landed is the Heavenly Sea Country, one of the countries in the Sword Domain. The Heavenly Sea Country is just a mid-tier country, far from being a powerful nation. Nonetheless, it still has a Life and Death Realm Master stationed within its territories.]
[After hearing this piece of information, you’re taken aback. The amount of major forces in Eastern Desolation is overwhelming. Even this remote coastal kingdom has a Life and Death Realm Master stationed here, it’s utterly terrifying. However, you’re also well aware that within the Heavenly Sea Country, the master of the Life and Death Realm barely ever shows himself, the same as the Ancestor of the Heavenly Sea Country, a figure of utmost importance]
[Therefore, within the Heavenly Sea Country, the most powerful individuals on the surface are masters of the Yin Yang Mirror. These are the Ancestors of Heavenly Sea Country, the masters of all the major forces, Supreme Elders, and other high-ranking individuals. Their numbers are limited as well. Under these circumstances, even those in the Profound Elixir Realm could be classified as powerful individuals, they hold a respectable status, and when they step out into the world, they are revered and respected by others.]
[After you carefully memorize the distribution of power in the Heavenly Sea Country, and the number of surface powerhouses, you begin to plan your next step. You aspire to breakthrough to the Profound Elixir Realm, and to condense a High-tier Profound Elixir, you’ll need at least a 9th tier Treasure Elixir or precious 9th tier Treasure Medicine, if not a 10th Tier Treasure Medicine.]
[Of course, you consider yourself to still have a slight chance of obtaining a 9th tier Treasure Medicine, but completely abandon the idea of a 10th tier. That’s because those are things that only Life and Death Realm Masters or those above the Life and Death Realm, the Nirvana Realm Masters, are qualified to possess, and they are hard to find in the world.]
[As for objects above the 10th tier, you dare not even think about them. Rumor has it, such treasures, even in the Holy Land, are extremely hard to come by.]
[For the next ten years, you continue to search for various opportunities in the Heavenly Sea Country, but unfortunately, you’ve gained nothing. Rare treasures of the 8th and 9th tiers are not common in the Heavenly Sea Country. Treasure elixirs that could increase your foundations and assist in enhancing the tier of the Profound Elixir, are even more precious.]
[In these ten years, you’ve been comprehending Sword Spirit and attempting to understand the profound mysteries within. It’s a pity that, even if one has enough talent, without the guidance of a master, it is still hard to make progress.]
[This situation has been making you very frustrated. You are well aware that while you have sufficient talent and strength, the reason you’re wasting time here is entirely due to the influence of the Profound Turtle Spirit. If it were not for this spirit, you would have more ways to find opportunities and you wouldn’t feel so restrained, having to conceal your presence, for fear that the Profound Elixir Realm master born of a Great Sect in the Heavenly Sea Country might detect you.]
[In these circumstances, you learn that the Heavenly Sea Country’s Purple
Moon Secret Realm is about to open. Rumor has it, the Purple Moon Secret Realm was established by a Nirvana Realm Master, opened once every three hundred years. It is said to contain great secrets. Your heart palpitated at the thought, knowing that if you miss this chance, the opportunity to condense a high-tier Profound Elixir would become exceedingly slim.]
[However, you are well aware that entering this place would put you in great danger, the chance of perishing within exceeding ninety percent. Ultimately, you steeled yourself, reasoning that if you keep wavering and your Tao Heart isn’t firm enough, even if you encounter opportunities, you will inevitably be stuck in the Profound Elixir Realm for the rest of your life.]
[You decide to go, concealing your identity and aura. When you’ve arrived at a distant peak from the Purple Moon Forest, you realize that many cultivators have already arrived, each emanating a formidable aura. Profound Elixir Realm masters are seen everywhere, and Yin and Yang Masters are not few either. You are taken aback, realizing that if detected by them, the consequences would be dire.]
[Thus, you intend to wait for this group to enter before you follow them in.]
[Unfortunately, things don’t always go as planned. Before you could wait for them to enter, you are spotted by the Spiritual Sense of the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor. He detected the Profound Turtle Spirit within you and captured you.]
[Alarmed and angered, you realize you have no power to resist. You know you’re in deep trouble.]
[Just as you’re about to cry out in despair, ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, are you truly irredeemable! And prepare to self-destruct, the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor tells you not to panic, as he has no intention of doing you harm. You are extremely surprised and don’t understand why.]
[The Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor explains. Although many Great Sects loathe the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, he doesn’t have any particular feelings about it. The incident that occurred a thousand years ago has nothing to do with the Heavenly Sea Country. Back then, he wasn’t even born yet, and the Heavenly Sea Country wasn’t even in existence yet, so there was no reason to harbour any resentment. Only those sects with a long history would intensely antagonize the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, even if it means involving innocent people..]

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 118: The Ten Thousand Year Secret Revealed! Condemn the Emperor! _6
Translator: 549690339
[You are shocked in your heart, knowing that the secret of the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ is finally about to be revealed. You can’t help but start asking the old man about the matter of the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants.’ The old man recalls the contents recorded in ancient books and answers your ‘questions’. The secrets from ten thousand years ago are gradually revealed by him.]
[As it turns out, ten thousand years ago, the Blood Demon Clan from outside the Purple Spirit Realm suddenly invaded, killing countless cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm, devouring their power, and even a Holy Land was destroyed. This caused the entire Purple Spirit Realm to tremble.]
[In order to fight against the powerful and cruel Blood Demon Clan, the entire Purple Spirit Realm’s forces joined together, and the vast majority of cultivators above the Profound Elixir Realm participated in the battle, engaging in a great war with the Blood Demon Clan.]
[During the final decisive battle, the Blood Demon Clan sent forth a large number of strong fighters. Among them, the Demon Emperor of the Blood
Demon Clan faced the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, the strongest of the Purple
Spirit Realm at the time. That battle turned the sky dark.]
[Rumor has it that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor fought the Demon Emperor, and both suffered heavy injuries. In the end, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, fearing his own demise, fled the battlefield and escaped to the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[As the Guilt-Punishing Emperor deserted in the middle of battle, chaos ensued, and the many cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm were almost wiped out. Fortunately, someone emerged out of nowhere, displaying a terrifying strength and repelling the Blood Demon Clan. Otherwise, the Purple Spirit Realm would have long since become the territory of the Blood Demon Clan, and the many races of the Purple Spirit Realm would have become their blood slave food.]
[Rumor has it that what angered people even more was that a group of people related to the Guilt-Punishing Emperor all escaped to the back of the Profound Turtle on the sea, far away from the Eastern Desolation, in order to avoid responsibility and prevent themselves from being destroyed.]
[This enraged the many cultivators who survived the war to the extreme. They believed that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and his associates were all ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ and would be exterminated once they were born.]
[You are shocked in your heart and never expected such a thing to happen. Then, you ask if any powerful beings had pursued the Profound Turtle back then.]
[Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor answered your question. Of course, there
were. Although many powerful beings fell after the great war, there were still plenty of them left. Strong cultivators from the Holy Lands joined hands, and wanted the Profound Turtle to hand over the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and his associates.]
[However, the Profound Turtle chose to ignore them. In the end, numerous powerful beings banded together to attack the Profound Turtle. Unfortunately, the Profound Turtle is an incredibly unique existence in the Purple Spirit Realm. It has existed for countless years, and is known for its invincible defense. Even with the joint attack of many powerful beings, they were unable to break its defense, and eventually had to retreat helplessly.]
[After hearing about these secrets, your heart is filled with turmoil, and you finally know the great secret from ten thousand years ago. However, you have doubts in your heart. Did the Guilt-Punishing Emperor really run away out of fear of his own demise? If he was so fearful, why would he lead the fight in the first place?]
[In addition, you also recall the terrifying Demon spirit that appeared on the Profound Turtle Continent, and you suspect in your heart that things are definitely not as simple as they seem.]
[However, you do not speak out your thoughts and remain silent. The Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor shakes his head and says that your talent is not bad, and he would be happy to train you seriously if not for the Profound Turtle Spirit. You may even have a chance to reach the Life and Death Realm in the future.
Unfortunately, although he doesn’t hold any grudge against the ‘Sinful
Bloodline Descendants,’ he will not risk the world in sheltering you.]
[You express your gratitude and appreciate the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor for answering your doubts, owing him a favor. The Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor shakes his head, telling you not to worry, and to be careful in your actions. Although there are very few forces within the Heavenly Sea Country that are privy to this secret, any Great Sect that has ever had Life and Death Realm cultivators is eligible for access to these hidden matters, and can recognize the Profound Turtle Spirit. This is because the Divine Skills that all major forces’ Profound Elixir Realm masters must learn are used to hunt down the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’.]
[Your heart is heavy, knowing that if you enter the secret realm, you might die a horrible death.]
[In the end, you are disheartened and can only leave this place. Moreover, you know that the Heavenly Sea Country is not a good place to stay for long, and you quietly choose to leave and return to Sacred Heart Island.]
[After returning to Sacred Heart Island, you know that it is probably impossible for you to condense a high-tier Profound Elixir in this lifetime. In despair, you decide to break through the Profound Elixir directly. You successfully break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. However, due to the lack of firmness in your Tao Heart, you fail in the dangerous process of breaking through, and perish on the spot.]
[But due to the Rebirth tally, you are resurrected. It’s just that when you come back, you are still in the process of breaking through. Caught off guard, you fail again and blow yourself up once more.]
[As you have died, this simulation ends.]
“Well, I still failed in breaking through, which is quite helpless. However, it is understandable.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, sighing in his heart.
This simulation finally revealed the truth about the Profound Turtle Continent and the Sinful Bloodline Descendants.
So, it all originated from the Blood Demon invasion ten thousand years ago.
Blood Demon, indeed a nasty piece of work.
That Blood Demon Cave probably really seals some Blood Demon and has been transformed into a mid to low-tier secret realm.
“The Guilt-Punishing Emperor, a Ceiling-Tier Character from ten thousand years ago, would he run away from battle out of fear of his own demise? I really don’t believe it.’
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
Anyone who could become such a figure would have a Tao Heart that was unimaginably strong.
However, such a thing did happen, and if there were no hidden reasons, he absolutely would not believe it.
“Could it be that the Demon Emperor used some bizarre means to make the Guilt-Punishing Emperor fall into the demon’s control, so he ran away? Because if he didn’t, he might have been demonized and then turned against his own people. If that’s the case, it would explain what happened on the Profound Turtle Continent.
“The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was demonized, and sealed himself inside the Profound Turtle, cooperating with the Profound Turtle to suppress and seal the demonic thoughts within. This also proves that their relationship is definitely not simple. At the same time, it can also explain why the Profound Turtle wants to protect the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’.”
Wang Pings eyes shone brightly as he analyzed the causes and consequences.
If only people knew the truth, they wouldn’t hate the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and the Profound Turtle.
However, one can’t blame them. Wang Ping only knows so much of the truth thanks to the Life Simulator.
Of course, there is also a possibility that the ancestors of all the great Holy Lands know the situation, but they still do this anyway.
This is because the casualties were too high, and many people needed an outlet for their anger..

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that Bai Tianhong is likely a descendant of the Guilt-Punishing
Emperor. Even if he’s not a direct descendant, he must be related somehow. As for Ye Chen’s bloodline, it’s unclear, but it must be extraordinary too.”
Wang Ping silently thought to himself, feeling quite speechless.
The Profound Turtle Continent had a terrifying origin, and the people living there were far from ordinary. Each of them had an astonishing background, making it hard for an ordinary person like him to live.
Oh, he’s just a poser, never mind then.
“l don’t know what the situation is with the Chi Clan. It’s just a pity that by that time, the Chi Clan had already disappeared, and the simulated Wang Ping didn’t have the chance to ask the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor about it.”
Wang Ping thought of the Chi Clan again and sighed in his heart.
He had a good impression of the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor’s temperament and would not panic the next time they met.
At this moment, Wang Pings vision suddenly changed, and he appeared in a strange place. It was clear that the Talent of Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death had been triggered.
It was the situation where the simulated Wang Ping had broken through.
Because he knew the future path might be cut off, Wang Ping encountered a Heart Demon during the breakthrough and ultimately failed, dying several times in a row.
Sighing, Wang Ping couldn’t help but feel depressed looking at this.
By now, even though he knew from the simulation that his situation was miserable, he didn’t feel much. At most, he was somewhat frustrated.
However, the simulated Wang Ping was different. He had already lived for over 30 years and struggled for many years without finding a way forward.
Knowing the cause and effect of countless years, his Tao Heart was unstable.
It just goes to show that the experience of reading about it and living through it are indeed different.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form
Half-step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation
3.Combat Experience
4.Various Secret Skills”
“System, I choose 1 and 2
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards and made his decision.
Although breaking through to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm would significantly increase his simulation costs, Wang Ping realized one thing.
If he didn’t choose it now, he might not be able to choose the half-step
Profound Elixir Realm as a transitional stage cultivation reward in the future.
After several failed breakthrough attempts and finding his path blocked, he might choose to break through directly to the Profound Elixir Realm in the subsequent simulations, without caring about whether or not he forms a 3rd Tier Profound Pill.
Once that happens, he won’t be able to select a cultivation reward.
After all, a mid-tier Profound Elixir is not the ending he wants. In his next simulations, he will search for a way to condensate a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, or even a Flawless Profound Elixir, before choosing to breakthrough.
In other words, his cultivation will be stuck for a long time if he doesn’t choose the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, and will be stuck in the Early Stage of Spiritual Accumulation Realm.
In this scenario, if any unforeseen events or group tasks arise in the future, his chances of successfully completing the tasks will decrease significantly.
As Wang Ping made his decision, his cultivation started to skyrocket, quickly rising from the Early Stage of Spiritual Accumulation Realm to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, with his combat power soaring as well.
In addition, Wang Ping felt that his affinity with Spiritual Energy had improved, and his thinking speed increased significantly.
This was undoubtedly the effect of the Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form, which could grant him talents comparable to those of a Major Sect Successor.
Of course, Major Sect Successors also have their strengths and weaknesses, so it’s hard to know what level his talent would be among them.
“There’s no need to think too much about it. Let’s continue with the life simulation. If it doesn’t work, I’ll have to take that path.”
Wang Ping gathered his thoughts, steadied his breathing, and muttered to himself.
Frankly, Wang Ping was troubled about the matter of that path.
After all, the consumption of taking that path was huge and might bring about uncontrollable factors.
“System, how many Spirit Stones do I need to consume for the simulation Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“Ding, this simulation requires 300,000 mid-tier Spirit Stones or 3,000 top-tier Spirit Stones.”
The system’s voice sounded, making Wang Pings face twitch slightly.
Goodness, it jumped straight from 50,000 to 300,000. The cultivation improvement from the Early Stage of Spiritual Accumulation Realm to the half-step Profound Elixir Realm was huge, and the consumption increased accordingly.
It seems that the Spirit Stones he had left would only be enough for about twelve simulations if he paid for them.
He would have to be more frugal again.
Of course, with his current abilities, obtaining more top-tier Spirit Stones would be extremely easy.
Therefore, while he could save, there was no need to be overly stingy.
“System, start the paid simulation, and use mid-tier Spirit Stones for payment.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator start, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice sounded once more,
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the White Talent: Soccer Genius.”
White Talent: Soccer Genius – The host will become exceptionally talented in playing soccer.
“A White Talent? So after a classical Blue Talent, I’m unlucky once more. Am I the type of person who saves up luck to make a big move later?” Wang Ping comforted himself this way.
“Ding, Talent Loaded Successfully, the Life Simulation begins.”
As the system’s voice rang out again, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
“[Day 1: You choose to rest, sleeping soundly for a night..]”

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_ 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_ 2
Translator: 549690339
[Over the following years, you continued to seek enlightenment, trying to comprehend the mysteries of Sword Spirit, but ultimately fell short. However, you were not in a hurry, continuing to practice cultivation patiently.]
[In the 20th year, you led Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong away from Profound Turtle Continent and teleported to the Seven Stars Archipelago.]
[When your unhidden identity and arrival at the Seven Stars Archipelago were discovered, it caused a sensation. The powerhouses of the archipelago had not expected you to appear again, and each of them feared you to the extreme. However, they also looked forward to your confrontation with Sky Wind Pavilion.]
[Sky Wind Pavilion was also terrified by your emergence, as you had previously killed the Seven Stars Ancestor. However, they were also very interested in the profound instruments on your body.]
[In the end, the desire of the Ancestor of Sky Wind Pavilion was suppressed, knowing that the probability of losing in a battle with you was over 90%.]
[As a result, you easily entered the Seven Star Secret Realm. Moreover, you never let Ye Chen leave during those years, planning to take a chance with Ye Chen’s destiny as the Heavenly Lone Star in the mysterious Seven Star Secret
Realm, hoping to encounter a great opportunity to condense a Ist-tier
Profound Elixir and become a Profound Elixir Realm master.]
[By staying close to Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, and Bai Tianhong, who also had a strong fortune, you encountered many opportunities and gained many good items, more than what you had obtained in any of your previous memories. Unfortunately, these elixirs are no longer of use to you; they are most useful for Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong.]
[Half a month later, the three of you, with Ye Chen’s guidance, found an ancient tower engraved with a pattern of meteor showers, and were drawn inside. You speculated that this should be a Trial Place, and the three of you took on the trial together.]
[In the end, Ye Chen fortunately obtained the inheritance of a Life and Death
Realm master. At the same time, he learned the secret of the Seven Star Secret Realm. It turns out that the Seven Star Secret Realm was not originally called the Seven Star Secret Realm but rather the Falling Star Secret Realm. It was a natural secret realm, but a powerful individual resided in it for a period, leaving their inheritance before passing away.]
[This inheritance not only included the cultivation skills and martial skills of a Life and Death Realm master, but also the most precious item: a Mid-tier Treasure – the Falling Star Sword. Treasures were artifacts superior to profound instruments, and they were also divided into different grades.
Usually, Yin and Yang Realm masters used Lower-tier Treasures, while Life
and Death Realm masters used Mid-tier Treasures.]
[It could be said that Mid-tier Treasures were extremely precious. If their existence was made known, even Yin and Yang Realm masters would go crazy for them, and Life and Death Realm masters would be tempted to seize them, disregarding their image.]
[After hearing Ye Chen’s explanation, you sighed in your heart, thinking that this secret realm was indeed prepared for Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune. In your memory, Ye Chen probably obtained the Life and Death Realm inheritance every time, which allowed him to soar to great heights.]
[Although you were very interested in Ye Chen’s inheritance, you ultimately did not have any intention of taking it for yourself. After all, seizing someone else’s possession was not your style.]
[Afterward, Ye Chen, in gratitude for your nurturing over the years, gave you an 8-tier Treasure Elixir, Ningxuan Grass, which he had obtained. This is a treasure capable of helping to condense high-tier Profound Elixirs, and is also the main ingredient in 8-tier Elixirs – the mistery-cohesion Elixir. It is extremely precious.]
[You were very surprised, you didn’t expect Ye Chen to be so generous, and felt that your years of nurturing him was not in vain. In the end, you accepted the treasure that would greatly help you.]
[After leaving the secret realm, Ye Chen decided to leave and train alone. You were also ready to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. Hiding your identity, you went to Sacred Heart Island with Bai Tianhong.]
[On Sacred Heart Island, you sold the Sea and Sky Staff, which enabled you to buy many elixirs and also obtain the Elixirs-refining Prescription for the 8-tier Elixir – mistery-cohesion Elixir. However, you were also targeted. You were forced to fight with a Profound Elixir Realm master who attacked you. The terrifying strength you displayed repelled the mysterious Profound Elixir
Realm master, shocking everyone.]
[You knew that the attacker was likely from the Green Moon Sect or the Ice Palace, but you didn’t care. They would only care about self-preservation, and as long as you didn’t forcibly expose them, they wouldn’t attack you again. They would also be very suspicious of your identity, fearing that you were a successor from a major sect from the Eastern Desolation.]
[Next, you found a secluded place and successfully refined an 8-tier Elixir the mistery-cohesion Elixir. Afterward, you began your retreat for the breakthrough.]
[With the help of the 8-tier Elixir – the mistery-cohesion Elixir, you successfully broke through to the Profound Elixir Realm and condensed a 4th Tier Profound Elixir. You smiled bitterly in your heart; with your talent and practicing a Heavenly Mid-grade Cultivation Skill, you still only managed to condense a 4th Tier Profound Elixir, even after preparing an 8-tier mistery-cohesion Elixir. It was hard to imagine how difficult it would be to condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. No wonder that Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master only condensed a 9th-tier Profound Elixir.]
[Finally, you recalled your cultivation of the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique; with Blood Demon Yuan Fengs help, you had easily condensed a 3rd Tier
Profound Pill. You still remembered how unsatisfied you were, and how Blood
Demon Yuan Feng mocked you. It seems that Blood Demon Yuan Fengs mockery was indeed justified.]
[After breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm, you returned to Sacred Heart Island and quietly practiced cultivation with Bai Tianhong, as well as refined elixirs and gathered cultivation resources for the Profound Elixir Realm masters.]
[However, fifty years passed, and your cultivation only increased by one level, reaching the 2nd Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm. To increase cultivation speed in the Profound Elixir Realm, you needed to use top-tier Spirit Stones as support. However, a place like Sacred Heart Island didn’t have many top-tier Spirit Stones, so your cultivation speed was really slow. As for 8-tier Treasure Elixirs, they were even rarer, being considered peerless treasures..]

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 119: The Great Opportunity of the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Rapid Increase in Cultivation_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity of the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Rapid Increase in Cultivation_3
Translator: 549690339
[You have doubts. Cultivation becomes more challenging as one progresses, and without appropriate resources, even if you reach the Profound Elixir Realm and have a thousand-years lifespan, it may still be uncertain whether you can reach the 7th-Tier Profound Elixir Realm at your moment of death while cultivating on Sacred Heart Island. The Great Perfection of the Profound
Elixir Realm would almost be an impossibility.]
[You surmise that the cultivation levels of the Profound Elixir Realm masters on Sacred Heart Island probably haven’t exceeded the 4th-Tier Profound
Elixir Realm. In such a resource-poor place, cultivation is indeed difficult.]
[Although you’re aware of these circumstance, you have no solutions. Unless you venture to the Eastern Desolation, or change to cultivate the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, you’ll have to endure slow progress in your cultivation.]
[Of course, it’s somewhat too late for you to cultivate the Demonic Skill now.
The Bloodthirsty Demon Technique requires the cultivation of a specific Demonic Body during the Spiritual Fetus Realm, to ensure better progress.
Current you, who’ve reached the Profound Elixir Realm and practiced the Demon Technique without the help of Blood Demon Yuan Feng, surely wouldn’t experience the terror you remember from the past. Not to mention, your previous self in your memory had the Blue Talent of Demon Cultivation Chaos.]
[Three years fly by, and although your cultivation has seen a bit of improvement, it isn’t much. Far from enough to make a breakthrough to the 3rd-Tier Profound Elixir Realm. However, the white-haired Old Lady from your memory appears this year, intending to take Bai Tianhong away.]
[You ask the white-haired Old Lady if Bai Tianhong is a descendant of the revered Guilt-Punishing Emperor. She’s surprised you know such secrets.
However, she doesn’t answer your question but takes Bai Tianhong away.]
[When you’re feeling regret, the Old Woman’s incarnation appears here, landing a palm strike that kills you. Obviously, she wants to eradicate a future threat and prevent any possible leaks of the secret, simultaneously not wanting Bai Tianhong to know she killed you. You die, but then resurrect.
Anger fills your heart, and you feel the white-haired Old Lady is too domineering.]
[Nevertheless, you’ve confirmed something: the white-haired Old Lady is indeed associated with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. And Bai Tianhong may very well be a descendant, or at least share the same bloodline.]
[Subsequently, to prevent the white-haired Old Lady from making an unexpected attack, you choose to leave Sacred Heart Island.]
[You roam among many islands, seeking opportunities. Unfortunately, opportunities that could aid Profound Elixir Realm cultivators are rare in this region. Despite your relentless search, you can’t find any, which brings you dismay.]
[Sixty- seven years later, you choose to live in seclusion on Storm Island. You expect the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master to make an appearance, only to discover he doesn’t show. An epiphany clears your mind; the Shadow
Profound Elixir Realm master must be aware of your actions on Sacred Heart Island and understands your capability to challenge Profound Elixir Realm cultivators and decides not to walk into his own demise.]
[After all, he’s only consolidated a 9th tier Profound Elixir and possesses only the most average fighting strength in the Profound Elixir Realm. He suspects he probably won’t be a match for you.]
[You are somewhat disappointed. You were hoping for a chance to seize the opportunity from the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master. Yet, you missed this opportunity. But a thought crosses your mind, since he doesn’t seek you out, you might as well go look for him yourself, especially as you remember his face.]
[You take action. First, you intervene and successfully obtain the Sea and Sky Staff from a cultivator who had stolen it from the Sea Ape Clan’s territory.
Then, aided by the memory of his appearance, you deftly track the Shadow Profound Elixir Realm master.]
[You confront him, demanding he hands over the Secret Skill he possesses in exchange for his life. Defiantly, he chooses death over surrender and self-destructs. You’re speechless, never expecting him to take such drastic action.]
[Seeing no option to obtain the Secret Skill, you depart in disappointment. You return to Profound Turtle Continent and continue your secluded cultivation there. As for the cultivation resources you require, by this point, you’ve accumulated and painstakingly cultivated them over the years.]
[Under these circumstances, time slips by swiftly, and three hundred years pass in the blink of an eye. Within these three centuries, your cultivation improves, reaching the 3rd-Tier Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Also, during these three hundred years, you regularly venture out to procure the necessary cultivation resources and to look for news of sword-type profound artifacts, hoping to obtain one. Regrettably, you return each time with only disappointment. Even on Sacred Heart Island, the only ones to possess sword-type profound artifacts are the Ice Palace, and they only have one ice-attribute Profound Sword. As you bear no grudges against the Ice Palace, you naturally refrained from using force to obtain it.]
[Your cultivation continues, and nearly fifty years go by. Knowing that a great calamity will befall Profound Turtle Continent- -a horrific Demon spirit will engulf everything- -you choose to leave ahead of time.]
[Shortly after your departure, the Demon spirit sweeps out and consumes everything. You’ve narrowly escaped a catastrophe. However, you ponder- -if you follow the Demon Path, perhaps you could utilize the remnants of these Demon Spirits to condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir.]
[Despite the idea, risking your life to return and conduct experiments isn’t an option. Let alone the fact that the Profound Turtle has surely suppressed the Demon spirit by now, leaving no chance for you to conduct any experiments.]
[Besides, something else comes to mind. The Demon spirit is so terrifying that the Stele Array was likely destroyed. You have even less probability of returning now. Aside from the major powers, probably no one could find Profound Turtle now..]

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 119: The Great Opportunity in the
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity in the
Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_4
[Following this, you continued to wander among the islands, ultimately unable to acquire any significant opportunities. You returned to the Sacred Heart Island once. The Sacred Heart Island, which had undoubtedly been destroyed due to the Blood Demon disaster, could no longer be considered the strongest among the islands as the major forces had been wiped out by the
Blood Demon’s avatars.]
[Feeling disheartened, you finally chose to buy a map, cross the sea, and head to the Heavenly Sea Country. Although you didn’t intend to find any great opportunities to quickly become strong in the Heavenly Sea Country and become a Yin Yang Mirror expert, you also had the idea of exploring higher realms of Sword Spirit. After all, to this day, you still do not know the mystery behind the Great Perfection Sword Spirit, and it is too difficult to comprehend it alone.]
[Due to your 3rd-tier Cultivation of Profound Elixir Realm, you smoothly and easily crossed the sea and arrived in the Eastern Desolation. After arriving in the Heavenly Sea Country, you heard about the many significant events that had taken place there over the years. The first big event you heard about completely shocked you.]
[About 450 years ago, the Purple Moon Secret Realm unexpectedly revealed a legacy left by Nirvana Realm Masters, along with a Nirvana Fruit born from the place where a Nirvana Realm master had transformed. Its value was enough to drive Life and Death Realm Masters insane. Because of this, the masters of the Heavenly Sea Country fought for it. This battle was extremely brutal, with numerous masters perishing.]
[However, in the end, a young man with the surname Ye, who merely had Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, picked the fruit and left unrestrained. You guessed that this young man with the surname Ye might be Ye Chen, who had disappeared for a long time. You truly didn’t expect that he would appear in the Heavenly Sea Country, let alone enter the Purple Moon Secret Realm and seize the greatest opportunity in it.]
[Besides this, you also couldn’t understand how Ye Chen managed to conceal the Profound Turtle Spirit on his body. You were eager to find Ye Chen and ask for an explanation.]
[However, you quickly calmed down. Ye Chen’s whereabouts were unknown, and you wouldn’t be able to find him even if you tried. With the Profound Turtle Spirit on your body, if you walked recklessly through the Eastern
Desolation, death would be the only outcome.]
[Next, you continued to learn about the major events that had taken place in the Heavenly Sea Country, wanting to contribute to another timeline.]
[After the Purple Moon Secret Realm closed, a long period of unrest occurred because many powerful beings had fallen, including several elders of the Life and Death Realm in the Royal Family of the Heavenly Sea Kingdom.
Fortunately, at that time, the seventeenth Princess emerged and performed well in the War of a Hundred Nations, successfully joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and being taken as a disciple by an elder there. Otherwise, the position of the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s Royal Family might have been unstable and faced invasion from neighboring countries.]
[You were very interested in the Hundred Dynasties War of the Sword Domain and continued to read the ancient history you had bought. The Hundred Dynasties War was one of the ways the Heavenly Sword Divine Land recruited disciples from its affiliated countries. If the talented geniuses of these countries could achieve good results or impress the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s elders, they could join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[You found that that Hundred Dynasties War was quite exciting, with its top performers not even 30 years old and already being late-stage experts of the Profound Elixir Realm, which you couldn’t help but admire. Such people were even respected by the successors of the Great Sect.]
[However, the truly monstrous figures were even more terrifying. One was named Ji Bingyue, and the other was called Ye Canghai. Both were less than 50 years old and had cultivated to the Half-step Yin Yang Realm. Thinking of how you currently only had 3rd-tier Cultivation of Profound Elixir Realm, you couldn’t help but smile bitterly.]
[However, you were also very clear that the reason they were able to achieve such accomplishments was not only their amazing talent, but also the fact that they had the backing of powerful individuals who had spared no effort in cultivating them.]
[Of course, you were even more aware that even if you had the full support of such powerful people, you would never be able to reach the Half-step Yin
Yang Mirror level before the age of 50.]
[You wanted to find Ye Chen’s tracks and see if he had participated in the Hundred Dynasties War. In the end, you were disappointed, as you didn’t find any record of Ye Chen participating in the Hundred Dynasties War. Perhaps Ye Chen, even if he could conceal his Profound Turtle Spirit, couldn’t recklessly appear in the sight of real big shots.]
[Next, you read about the various opportunities that had appeared in the Heavenly Sea Country in these years through ancient history books. Lastly, you discovered that Blood Demons had also appeared in the Heavenly Sea Country thirty years ago, causing chaos and making some people in the
Heavenly Sea Country panic, which alarmed you.]
[Following this, you also learned what the realm above Great Perfection Sword Spirit was. It was called the power of Mysteries. It was the sublimation of Sword Spirit, the perfect combination of Mysteries and Martial Skills.
Mysteries were unique, and unless one’s Cultivation Skill, Martial Arts, and
Realm of Conception were completely the same, the later generations couldn’t learn them.]
[However, even if they were learned, it would just be walking in someone
else’s path and could only be regarded as fake Mysteries, unable to exert the power of the original Mysteries. Of course, even so, it was still much stronger than most Great Perfection Realms of Conception.]
[To create Mysteries, one must combine their Cultivation Skills, Martial Arts, and Realm of Conception and integrate them seamlessly. Once Mysteries are comprehended, one’s strength would truly be unparalleled among their peers. A genuine Mystery, even if it is based on Earth-tier Cultivation Skills and
Martial Arts, combined with the ordinary Great Perfection Realm of Conception, would still surpass the power exerted by the Great Perfection Realm of Conception combined with Upper-tier Heavenly Martial Skills..]

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_5
Translator: 549690339
[In the Hundred Dynasties War, those truly monstrous geniuses have all without exception comprehended their own mysteries. Ji Bingyue and Ye Canghai are not only exceptional among their peers in terms of cultivation and possessing unique physiques, they have also created their own mysteries, and they are not ordinary ones. That’s why they have left others far behind, and once they enter the Holy Land, they can become the quasi-True Successor
Disciples of the Holy Land.]
[You understood the path and felt excited, but you were also somewhat discouraged. After all, compared to the true monstrous geniuses of the Sword Domain, even with the talent of a Major Sect Successor, you are still too ordinary.]
[Next, you planned to find a hidden place for assisted cultivation with some top-tier Spiritual Stones, as you’ve received the information you wanted. At the same time, you wanted to see if you could comprehend your own mystery.]
“How about opportunities? Life Simulator, why don’t you list them all for me?”
Wang Ping looked at the series of simulation content with an agitated heart while also feeling a bit of toothache.
Didn’t it know that these things were the most valuable?
If he knew the location of various opportunities in history, he would have the chance to snatch them.
As a result, you just brushed over everything. It’s simply outrageous!
“Fine, I’ll assume that you didn’t list them because there’s too much content and it would seem too watered-down. Or maybe all the opportunities other than the big ones are carefully hidden, and they weren’t recorded in these ancient books.’
Wang Ping sighed and could only comfort himself in this way.
“However, Ye Chen, you’ve truly given me a surprise.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and murmured.
It seems the solution to the Profound Turtle Spirit could be found in Ye Chen.
In future simulations, he must start with Ye Chen and obtain the secret method that he had acquired so that he could wander safely in the vast land of Eastern Desolation.
Although following Ye Chen would definitely be dangerous and constantly threatened with death due to his Heavenly Lone Star fate, it didn’t matter as long as he could obtain the secret method. Even if he had to stack it with the number of simulation times, he would still stack it up!
Wang Pings heart was swaying, fantasizing about the many opportunities beckoning him after solving the Profound Turtle Spirit problem.
Ist-tier Profound Elixir, Flawless Profound Elixir—these weren’t just dreams!
Immediately after, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, wanting to see if he had comprehended his own mystery.
[In the blink of an eye, three years had passed, and you still hadn’t gained anything, finding it difficult to comprehend. However, this was quite normal. After all, from the information you had learned, even a Yin and Yang Master might not be able to comprehend the mystery, so it was indeed too difficult for you.]
[Nevertheless, you didn’t plan on giving up. It’s just that the Heavenly Sea Country has recently been very turbulent, with Blood Demons appearing more and more frequently. To be more precise, it seemed as though the entire Eastern Desolation was shrouded in a layer of haze, as many cultivators recalled the terrifying war from ten thousand years ago.]
[You also had a bad feeling in your heart, wanting to escape the Heavenly Sea Country and return to Sacred Heart Island to avoid being implicated and killed. You thought about the matters of the Profound Turtle Continent and the destroyed Delivery Array on it, feeling helpless. If only the Stele Array was still there, then the Profound Turtle Continent might be the safest place.]
[Of course, this assumed that there was no resurgence of the Demon spirit. If the Demon spirit were to surge again, even you would still be killed.]
[Next, you take action, trying to leave the Heavenly Sea Country and return to
Sacred Heart Island. Unfortunately, on your way to escape, you encounter a
Great Sect Cultivator. He coldly attacks you, and you choose to resist. Sadly, the gap in cultivation between you is simply too large, and you are easily killed with a slap.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
“This simulation content is really long. But there’s also plenty of valuable information in it.’
Wang Pings eyes twinkled.
It seemed like the whole Eastern Desolation…
No, maybe the entire Purple Spirit Realm was facing a catastrophe.
It appeared that the Blood Demon Clan, who had been repelled ten thousand years ago, was showing signs of resurgence.
Perhaps the eruption of Demon spirit on the Profound Turtle had something to do with this situation.
If that were the case… there might be no safe place left in the whole Purple Spirit Realm.
“Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, might have been born to confront this calamity.”
Wang Ping also thought of Ye Chen and murmured to himself.
Ye Chen’s emergence was too much of a coincidence. There was no other explanation.
Ten thousand years ago, after the Guilt-Punishing Emperor deserted the battlefield, someone took his place, defeating the Blood Demon Clan.
That person was probably the Son of Fortune of that era, an existence born to confront the calamity.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been such a coincidence.
“However, the Son of Fortune is not omnipotent. If they’re beyond the influence of fate, they can die too. I don’t know if Ye Chen can withstand this calamity. If he can’t, it’ll be troublesome and will greatly affect my future simulations.’
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
“If Ye Chen rises up and leads the Purple Spirit Realm to repel the Blood
Demon Clan’s invasion again… it’s time to completely remove the label of
Sinful Bloodline Descendants. Then, we won’t have to worry and cultivate secretly, fearing being discovered by powerful people and killed..”

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 119: The Great Opportunity in the Seven-Star Secret Realm! Cultivation Soaring_6
Translator: 549690339
“Other than that, Bai Tianhong…might also play a crucial role.”
Wang Ping thought of Bai Tianhongs identity again, his eyes shining, his emotions subtle.
So many tough characters in one Profound Turtle Continent, it’s quite unreasonable.
The key point is, these two people currently have quite a deep involvement with him.
Bai Tianhong, can be considered his disciple.
As for Ye Chen, he should now be considered to have replaced Jiang Huai and become his initial guide, right?
Although it’s an irresponsible guide.
Wang Ping ridiculed himself a bit in his heart.
At this moment, Wang Pings vision changed, and he appeared in a strange sky.
Wang Ping saw the scene of a middle-aged looking Wang Ping being slapped to death by an old man dressed in a grey robe with a Profound Bird pattern on it.
“This old man must at least be at the late stage of Profound Elixir Realm cultivation. Or even higher?”
Wang Ping had not seen many high-level Profound Elixir Realm masters, let alone a Yin Yang Mirror master, so he could only judge uncertainly.
“Never mind, his level has nothing to do with me. Although he killed the simulated Wang Ping once, there were so many people who killed the simulated Wang Ping, I’ve gotten used to it.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself, and his vision returned to normal.
Following that, Wang Ping heard the system’s notification sound.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
3rd-tier Cultivation of Profound Elixir Realm.
Elixir-refining Experience.
Football Talent.
A bit of insight about secrets.”
“l guess I don’t need to choose. 1 definitely can’t choose Profound Elixir Realm cultivation, after all, I don’t want to condense a 4th Tier Profound elixir. The only available choice is 4.’
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, thinking quietly.
To be honest, he’s very interested in secrets.
Apparently, based on the information obtained from this simulation, those who can comprehend secrets are qualified to be considered the best among their peers, it’s like taking the first steps on their own path, far ahead of others.
At least, among the younger generation, this is the case.
Those who comprehend secrets, their combat power far exceeds their peers. Those who haven’t understood the secrets, are probably only temporarily on par with them because of a special bloodline or body, or other major opportunities. But as long as they don’t understand the secrets, this temporary advantage will gradually disappear with the passage of time, and then they will become ordinary.
“So, in the Profound World, comprehension is really important, even more so than Bone and Root Aptitude. Of course, if there’s no Bone and Root, comprehension alone is useless. After all, not everyone is that ruthless female empress, who reached the pinnacle with an ordinary body.”
Wang Ping sighed quietly in his heart.
Wang Ping was considering, whether he can rely on the accumulation of time, spend the simulation times, to comprehend his own secrets.
Or is it that if comprehension isn’t enough, it’s hard to comprehend, no matter how much time is spent. “System, I choose 4.
Wang Ping quietly said in his heart.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt a stream of information emerging in his mind, which allowed him to enter into a wonderful state of realization.
Who knows how long it has been, Wang Ping opened his eyes, unable to calm his mind.
About the comprehension of secrets, it was quite shallow for the simulated Wang Ping side, not to mention creating it, he can’t even understand a little bit of it.
The secrets is really difficult to comprehend.
You could say, it’s really difficult to start walking your own path.
The talent of the successors of the Great Sects, is just the Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form, in the future, they have the hope for the Life and Death Realm.
Whereas those who stood out in the Hundred Dynasties War and comprehended secrets, they’re probably destined to reach the Life and Death Great Sect Cultivator. He coldly attacks you, and you choose to resist. Sadly, Boundary.
The gap between the two, who were both considered prodigies, is too great.
The gap in talent, starts to show its true colors at the comprehension of secrets.
Who is the real genius, who is average, it’s clear at a glance, even if you have opportunities that move the world, without comprehending the secrets, maybe you can only be considered average.
Wang Pings expression was a bit complicated.
He relied on the Life Simulator to get ahead, and even so, he had such a difficult journey. It’s hard to imagine how tough characters who have grown up to destroy the original chat group have grown up.
Probably, their stories could be written into an extremely wonderful Profound Fantasy novel.
Other than that, he doesn’t know whether they are still alive in the world or not.
“He’s so powerful, he might really still be alive. Maybe, we really have a chance to meet one day. Actually, not just him. There must be quite a few members of the previous chat group spread out in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.’
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
Thinking of the future when he would face these people, Wang Pings heart was far from calm, but surprisingly, he didn’t fear, and even had a bit of anticipation.
Afterwards, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and quietly said in his heart,
“Alpha, how many Group points will it take to resurrect Cai Yonglong?”
“To resurrect Cai Yonglong, it will cost 200,000 group points. If you continue to delay, the group points consumed will only increase over time.
Alpha’s cold, ruthless voice rang in Wang Pings mind.
“200,000 huh…lt’s more than I thought. But, it’s still acceptable.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered.
Truth be told, Wang Ping initially planned to continue the simulations, to see if he could find a way out on his own.
It seems, it’s quite uncertain.
Although he learned from Ye Chen that there exists a way to conceal the Profound Turtle Spirit, it might not be successful.
Wang Ping didn’t want to waste too many chances on probing.
Of course, the main reason is that the longer he delays, the more group points he will have to spend to resurrect him.
So, he absolutely can’t hesitate. Hesitation will lead to defeat.
“Cai Yonglong oh Cai Yonglong, once I resurrect you, you must not plot against me.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
Action in Life Simulation cannot control Cai Yonglong very well, and he was betrayed by Cai Yonglong last time.
Plus, having two people in one world can easily cause problems.
So, he’s a bit hesitant about it.
But, it’s now the time when he has to resurrect him anyway. After all, Cai Yonglong can become a decent combat power, and it’s very helpful for him.
It’s more beneficial than harmful to resurrect him..

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 120: Resurrect Cai Yonglong! Triple Chain Group Task!
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 120: Resurrect Cai Yonglong! Triple Chain Group Task!
Translator: 549690339
“Alpha, use my group points to resurrect Cai Yonglong.” Wang Ping sighed softly, speaking in his heart.
“Hmm.” Alpha coldly uttered this word, then started to act.
Soon, the system prompt sounds of the chat group rang in Wang Pings ears and the group members who had never done anything.
“Ding, acting group owner Wang Ping (66) consumes 200,000 Group Points to resurrect group member Cai Yonglong (1).”
With the sound of this system prompt, Cai Yonglongs grayed-out avatar in the chat group lit up once again.
At the same time, in Swordsman World, the high pile of grass on the tomb suddenly began to move.
Then, Cai Yonglong shook off the mud on his body and climbed out of the ground with a blank face, startling a passing villager into unconsciousness.
“What’s going on…?”
Bare Cai Yonglong looked at his own hands in a daze, feeling somewhat at a loss.
Wasn’t he killed by the weird dream?
Why would he be resurrected?
Soon, a system prompt sounded in Cai Yonglong’s mind, making everything clear to him.
For a moment, he was extremely grateful to Wang Ping.
Before this, the chat group had already gone crazy.
Many diving group members who were doing their own tasks were all blown out of the water.
Zhang Hu (5): “Holy shit, Mr. Cai is resurrected? I just finished my cultivation, and I heard the prompt sound. I was so surprised that I sprayed the wine in my mouth right out.”
Wu Jun (20): “WUwUwU, Mr. Wang is so awesome! Mr. Cai, Mr. Cai, you’re back! ”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Cai Yonglong… Is he the one who died miserably as the first transmigrator? I didn’t expect Mr. Wang to resurrect him, QAQ.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Mr. Cai, you’re alive, that’s great! Fang Yun, where is Fang Yun?”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Mr. Wang is still so generous…”
Ye Xiaofan’s eyes flickered, and it seemed that he had misjudged Wang Ping in some way.
Honestly, the smart people in the group had considered resurrecting Cai Yonglong.
After all, as the first group member, Cai Yonglong had the most experience and was not weak in strength, so resurrecting him was the best choice.
However, in Ye Xiaofan’s view, Wang Ping would never resurrect Cai
Yonglong.
After all, the two were in the same world, and it was better for Cai Yonglong to be dead than alive.
Looking at it now, he thought too much.
For a moment, Ye Xiaofan admired Wang Ping very much.
As for Wang Shuqi and Wu Jun, who had experienced missions with Cai Yonglong, there was even more joy for them.
Of course, what made them even happier was that Wang Ping set a good example.
This means that if they accidentally die in the future, there is a real chance of being resurrected by Wang Ping.
It can be said that their sense of security has increased a lot.
Liu Mei (15): “Mr. Cai… Congratulations on your resurrection!”
Zhang Jun (70): “The sudden news shocked me to the point of almost being bitten by a zombie. But, I have to say, Mr. Wang is amazing. And, Mr. Cai, congratulations on your resurrection.”
Qin Tian (77): “Hahaha, another powerful force has been added to the group. It’s worth celebrating.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Mr. Wang, I can’t thank you enough. If you ever need my help, I’ll be there for you, no questions asked. Of course, I’ll do my best to repay you the 200,000 group points I owe you. And, thank you all!”
Wang Ping (66)@Cai Yonglong (1): “Just do your best to get stronger. We face many challenges ahead, and your strength needs to catch up quickly!’
Cai Yonglong (1): “l know!”
Wang Shuqi (74): “What about Fang Yun? Should we pool some group points to resurrect him too?”
