Zhang Jun (70): “Although it’s very realistic, Wang Shuqi, don’t put Mr. Wang in a difficult position. Fang Yun is too weak in strength, resurrecting him would only waste group points.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “But…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Looking at the bigger picture, it is true. However, when I have enough points, I’ll resurrect him. As a friend who has been together for so long, it’s the right thing for me to do.”
Wu Jun (20): “l have points here. Although Fang Yun was always teasing me, he also spoke up for me in the Zombie World. I’ll just resurrect him directly!’
Wang Ping (66): “Jun, you’re better than me.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed, resurrecting Cai Yonglong was the result of weighing the pros and cons.
But, Wu Jun didn’t think that much.
Of course, the two had different situations, naturally they couldn’t be generalized. Wang Ping had to consider the bigger picture.
Chen Yao (71): “Although I don’t know Fang Yun very well, I think everyone might be underestimating him. Fang Yun’s golden finger is to speed up cultivation efficiency. This golden finger may not be very useful in the previous chat group. But now the chat group has opened the martial arts stage function and cultivation room. In the cultivating room, you can cultivate the power of other worlds. This means that his golden finger may be shining now.”
Zhang Jun (70): “That makes sense.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “l can only shiver as the big shots chat, QAQ.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Actually, Fang Yun’s golden finger is quite good. He may only be an Innate Master, but he has become the Innate Master of his world in a very short time. Before that, he was just looking for Cultivation Skills. Being able to practice to the Innate Realm with ordinary Cultivation Skills in such a short time, and frequenting brothels… To be honest, his golden finger is very strong in assisting cultivation, and I sometimes envy him. Of course, more often than not, 1 just feel frustrated..”

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 120: Reviving Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks !_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 120: Reviving Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks !_2
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Hu (5): “Well, I can testify to that too. However, in his world, I guess it’s indeed impossible to become too strong.”
Chen Si (83): “Silently bubbling, are big shots from my world all climbing out of their coffins one by one?
Wu Jun (20): “I’ll revive him now.”
“Ding- Group member Wu Jun (20) consumes 150,000 group points to revive group member Fang Yun (3).”
As the system notification rang, everyone showed surprised expressions.
Xu Yi (84): “Why did it cost different group points to revive two people? Wait, is it because of the difference in strength?”
Wang Ping (66): “Strength is indeed a factor. However, the biggest factor is the time of death, followed by strength.”
Ye Xiaofan (75)?? “I see, it seems dying sooner and reviving faster is the way to go. Time is money. Also, show your value more, right?”
Ye Xiaofan directly exposed the unspoken rules in the group.
The ability to revive, but aside from group members with good relationships who are willing to pay a large price to revive you, if you want people in the group to advocate resurrection, you must show enough value.
Either be smart and powerful, or have a strong Golden Finger.
Otherwise, without value and no good relationships, and no rich friends, no one would be willing to revive you.
It’s cruel, but that’s the reality. Having been in this group for so long, it’s time to understand these rules.
Qin Tian (77): “l have nothing to say.”
While the group was discussing, Fang Yun also revived from the meteorite crater.
Fang Yun (3): “Wu Jun, from now on, you are my life and death brother. I won’t say much, even if I have to die for you, I’m willing! Also, Mr. Cai, you too. Also, thank you, Mr. Wang, for changing the chat group!’
Fang Yun was truly moved to tears.
He had experienced many cycles of death and return, and the moment he revived, he thought he was still in the cycle of death.
It wasn’t until the system notification that he became aware of everything.
He never expected Wu Jun to spend so much to revive him.
Mr. Cai’s words also touched him.
Cai Yonglong (1): “It’s good to be revived, it’s good to be revived.”
Cai Yonglongs mood was also hard to calm down. He never thought they would see each other again after reviving.
Wang Ping (66): “You can reminisce later. I’m thinking about a problem…Cai
Yonglong, can you come back if you revive in the Swordsman World where Fang Yun is?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “….Um, I guess I can’t. Unless 1 use the delivery function.”
Wang Ping (66): “Okay, I see.”
Wang Ping felt a bit weary.
Although he had guessed this possibility, he didn’t expect it to really turn out this way.
Then, Wang Ping checked the cost of transferring the two people.
It wasn’t expensive, but it still required 20,000 group points.
20,000, what a painful figure.
“Alpha, I’m doing this for the development of the chat group. Can you let Cai Yonglong come back for free?”
Wang Ping said earnestly in his heart.
Alpha: “…When the anomaly was detected and players were transported, the travel expenses were borne by that world. Now it’s long past the time limit.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
Oh, the travel expense was paid by that world?
Alpha sure was stingy.
Alpha: “This is an exception.”
At this moment, Alpha’s cold and emotionless voice sounded again.
Next, Cai Yonglongs figure suddenly disappeared and returned to the Purple
Spirit Realm.
This left Cai Yonglong a bit dumbfounded. Then, his face became even more awkward.
It was because he found himself appearing naked in front of Wang Ping.
Wang Ping: .
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and fell silent.
Of course, it wasn’t because of Cai Yonglongs nakedness that he felt awkward.
Two grown men, what’s there to be awkward about?
He was speechless.
“Alpha, I didn’t ask you to send Cai Yonglong to my side.” Wang Ping felt tired, really tired.
Don’t you know this is the Profound Turtle Continent?
By sending Cai Yonglong here, he will also be contaminated with the Profound Turtle Qi.
In this way, he can’t do anything. Cai Yonglong was supposed to do things, but now he can’t.
Alpha: ‘
Alpha was silent for a moment before saying, “You didn’t specify the location.”
Wang Pings face twitched, and he wanted to swear.
Alpha, are you sure you’re the artificial intelligence of the chat group, not artificial retardation?
With this way of doing things, it’s no wonder the chat group has been destroyed so many times.
“Warning, don’t insult me.”
Alpha gave a cold and emotionless warning.
“……” Wang Pings face darkened, saying in his heart: “What happened to freedom of speech?”
Alpha remained silent, seemingly diving underwater.
“Mr. Wang, it seems my clothes were stripped off when I died. It’s normal to have no clothes when 1 just revived.” Seeing that Wang Ping didn’t speak and looked a bit dark, Cai Yonglong felt embarrassed and could only explain.
“No, I didn’t care about those things.”
Wang Ping sighed and took out a few lower-tier spirit artifacts from his storage spirit ring, casually throwing them to Cai Yonglong.
“Lower-tier Spirit Artifact!?”
Looking at the items in front of him, Cai Yonglong widened his eyes and gasped in astonishment.
Good guy, casually giving out a few lower-tier spirit artifacts, and even robes and shoes, what a luxury..

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 120: Reviving Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks !_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 120: Reviving Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks !_3
Translator: 549690339
“Mr. Wang, what is your cultivation level now? You’re so generous with your actions. ”
Cai Yonglong said somewhat fanatically.
“Stop talking nonsense, hurry up and put it on,” said Wang Ping speechlessly.
Hearing this, Cai Yonglong finally came back to his senses and put on the robe and shoes with some embarrassment.
“Is this the place you crossed over to, Mr. Wang? Why does it feel like the spiritual energy here is much thinner than where I was? It’s impressive how you were able to grow so quickly in such a place.”
Cai Yonglong said with emotion after putting on the robe.
“You should have guessed the truth about my Golden Finger, so there’s no need to act like this.’
Wang Ping shook his head.
“Life Simulator, right?” Cai Yonglong hesitated for a moment and said, “The only thing I can think of are the mini-games and web stories about Life Simulator prior to my crossing. Otherwise, it’s hard to explain how your cultivation could improve so quickly just by predicting the future.”
“That’s right.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Everyone is not a fool. They have experienced so many tasks and they know that his previous claim of ‘predicting the future’ was a cover-up.
However, since the current transmigrators take him as their leader, they don’t want to expose this matter and upset him before he willingly clarifies it.
Of course, he didn’t really care that much either.
“So that’s how it is,” Cai Yonglong muttered, “It seems that I can help you a lot in the life simulation.’
In the past, he was still somewhat troubled, afraid that he would become Wang Pings tool.
Because in the life simulation, Wang Ping could use his Golden Finger to find opportunities and then monopolize them.
But now, he doesn’t care anymore.
After all, it was Wang Ping who saved his life.
As a result, he will do whatever Wang Ping asks and doesn’t have any other thoughts.
“No, you didn’t help me in my life simulation, but you did create trouble once.”
Wang Ping said with a strange look in his eyes.
“Um…”
Hearing this, Cai Yonglong was embarrassed and didn’t know what to say.
“However, that was an accident, and you don’t have to worry about the simulation. But in the future, you can’t act recklessly without my command. As long as you don’t act recklessly, following me will definitely help you quickly improve your cultivation.”
Wang Ping smiled softly and patted Cai Yonglongs shoulder, drawing him a big picture.
“l understand!” Cai Yonglong nodded seriously.
Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say anything more.
Human nature is complex, and now Cai Yonglong is very grateful to him, listening to everything he says.
As for the future, it’s uncertain.
So, how things will develop in the future remains to be seen in the life simulation.
Wang Ping only hopes that Cai Yonglong won’t let him down.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would have suffered a huge loss.
Next, Wang Ping introduced Cai Yonglong to the Supreme Elders of the Sword Spirit Sect, allowing Cai Yonglong to also become a Supreme Elder.
This made Cai Yonglongs mood quite subtle.
In his original sect, he was only an Inner Sect Disciple.
Wang Ping didn’t bother with Cai Yonglong anymore, gave him some cultivation resources, and told him to work hard on cultivation, intending to continue the simulation.
However, before Wang Ping could proceed with the simulation.
The sound of the chat group system rang out again.
“Ding, it is detected that Liu Mei (15Ys world has the presence of reincarnators from the Master Lord Space, with a total of five people. Their individual strength is determined to be 2-Star tier. Eliminating one person can earn 1,000 group points. The task level is 2-star tier, and it is recommended for group members of the same 2- star tier to participate in the task.”
“Ding, the combat power assessment of group member Liu Mei (15) is determined to be a 4-Star tier. This group task changes into an individual task, and other group members do not need to be transferred to the world of group member Liu Mei (15).”
“A new group task? And, has the strength rating finally come out? Although
Alpha’s work efficiency is not great, it is still doing practical work.”
Wang Ping was slightly stunned, and then entered the chat group again.
He then discovered that Alpha had published a Group Notice about the task difficulty rating and the strength rating of the Myriad Heavens and
Thousands of Realms.
The task difficulty rating has been temporarily divided into ten categories by Alpha.
As for the strength rating of the Myriad Heavens, there are only the first ten levels for now.
No-Star tier: Combat power within the range of ordinary people’s understanding.
Ist-tier: Stepping into this level, one can easily destroy a regular modern army.
2-Star tier: Possess the power to destroy a street within a short period of time.
3-Star tier: Possess the power to destroy a small town within a short period of time.
4-Star tier: Possess the strength to destroy a small mountain within a short period of time.
5-Star tier: City-destroying tier, possessing the strength to destroy an international metropolis with a diameter exceeding one hundred kilometers within a short period of time.
6-Star tier: Mountain range tier, possess the power to destroy a mountain range within a short period of time.
7-Star tier: Nation-breaking tier, possess the power to destroy a country within a short period of time. The reference for this is the Fusang Country.
8-Star tier: Continent tier, possess the power to level the Eurasian Continent or even sink it within a short period of time.
9-Star tier: The surface tier, possessing the power to cleanse the earth’s surface within a short period of time.
10-Star tier: Star-breaking tier, possessing the power to shatter a planet within a short period of time. The reference for this is an ordinary Earth.
Warm reminder: The combat power assessment system only calculates destructive power, which is expressive power, and special powers are not included within the range of calculations.. As a result, it is for reference only, and if you blindly trust the assessment function, there may be a risk of death!

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _4
Translator: 549690339
“Wow, the classification is really detailed.”
Wang Ping scanned these level divisions, muttering to himself.
Then, Wang Ping looked at his own strength assessment.
His current strength assessment was still at the six-tier level. Being at the Spirit Sea Realm meant possessing the power to destroy mountains, equivalent to the six-tier level.
He is now half- step into the Profound Elixir Realm, his strength had grown immensely but the assessment was still at the six-tier level.
It just goes to show, even at the same level, the gap between the floor tile and the ceiling is huge, you mustn’t underestimate this.
Of course, with this new feature, group members can execute tasks better and earn more group points.
That is to say, not all tasks required him to step in.
Otherwise, he would have been worn out sooner or later.
At this moment, the chat group was buzzing again.
Liu Mei (15): “Even though Mr.Wang had previously spoken about the Master Lord Tier Space, the Reincarnation Space, the Abyss Lands, and such, I didn’t expect the first one to appear would be the world I am in . . . . ”
Zhang Hu (5): “Well, I feel pretty good. After all, the chat group has implemented a new strength assessment feature, which allows us to carry out tasks more securely. And, the Reincarnators you ran into this time are only at the 2nd Tier, just an ordinary 2 Tier squad, with your strength, the task will be a cakewalk, it’s like picking up 5000 group points free!”
Wu Yueming (79): “Just me curious about Miss. Liu’s four star-level strength?”
Chen Yao (71): “Although the world Miss. Liu has traversed to seems quite ordinary, she has earned a lot of group points from eliminating the bizarreness in the High Martial World where Wang Shuqi resides, not to mention the cultivation resources Mr.Wang obtained. It’s normal for her to have this level of Dower.’
Qin Tian (77): “Chen Yao is right. While those resources aren’t really useful for me, they are indeed useful for common people like Miss. Liu. And furthermore, the chat group now has an enhancement feature. Most importantly, Miss. Liu’s strength can’t be measured by the strength assessment. In terms of unique abilities, I guess Miss. Liu is the top amongst us.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Changing faces, combined with Charm Skill and three chances of resurrection, it’s basically a bug….”
Wu Yueming (79): “Uh, what I mean is, Miss. Liu, being the 15th old group member, why is your level only at the 4 Tier.”
Wang Ping (66): “Good guy, Wu Yueming, you’re pretending, aren’t you? Tell me, what is your current strength assessment tier?”
Wu Yueming (79): “Urnm, I am also four star, not as good as you all.”
Liu Mei (15): ‘
Fang Yun (3): “mmp, we’re being outshined by the rookies, huh? The newbies are getting more and more outrageous. As an old senior who has died once, my current level isn’t even at the No Star tier, it’s giving me a toothache.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Aww, I’ve been dead for a while, 1 can’t understand the chat group anymore. My strength assessment is also only at four-tier level.”
Wang Ping (66): “You all should know that the world he traversed to is Beast Taming World, his golden finger is Beast Taming Ring, he must have obtained some rare potent beast taming skill, only then he could have become this strong in a short time.”
Wu Yueming (79): “Err, Mr.Wang, you guessed it exactly right.”
Fang Yun (3): “Tsk, still not in a good mood. After all, it’s luck. And me, I had to die, now I’m in debt, my mentality has collapsed.”
Xu Yi (84): “Err, aren’t you all concerned about the group task? This is the first task related to Master Lord Tier Space.”
Wang Ping (66): “There’s nothing to be concerned about. After all, the enemys strength assessment is only two- star level. A two- star level squad, Liu Mei can crush them through sheer strength alone. Let alone, Liu Mei has abilities. However, I’m quite curious about what will happen to this reincarnation squad after Liu Mei uses her charm skill, whether they would stay in this world, or get eliminated because of mission failure, or return to Master Lord Tier Space and become our pawn in that space.”
Liu Mei (15): was also thinking about it. Let’s try and see.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Come to think of it, if the people in the Master Lord Tier Space give us a chance to enter, could we become Reincarnators too? Or would we be discovered by the Master Lord Great Light Ball and be directly eliminated?”
Ye Xiaofan (75),? “It’s too risky, I for one wouldn’t dare to try.”
Qin Tian @ Ye Xiaofan (77): “You really are timid, despite possessing a Sacred Body and aspiring to be like Ye Hei No. 2. Are you still holed up in your small cave? With your talent, staying here would only be a waste of time.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “My Sacred Body has shortcomings, it requires numerous resources, they can’t afford it and had bad intentions, so I ran. At the moment, I’m being chased.”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn it, why didn’t you speak up? Let me know, I’ll come to your aid. Come to my Thunder Realm Holy Land. Holy Land, so beautiful!”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “….Holy Land may not be able to afford me, there might be trouble. It was the same with Ye Hei.’
Qin Tian (77): “Damn it, what are you scared of? You aren’t Ye Hei, you don’t have his opportunities, you won’t make much progress in your whole life.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Let’s talk about it later. To be honest, Cultivation is about spiritual roots, it’s about cultivating laws. The path of body Training has long been neglected, the Sacred Body seems out of place. I’m considering switching to the system that Mr. Wang practices..”

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _ 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _ 5
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “You can try. Our world still values one’s innate talent, and resources are abundant too. Perhaps, with your Sacred Body, cultivating in our world’s system could lead to great achievements.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “That’s what I was thinking too.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80) @Wang Ping (66): “Speaking of which, Mr. Wang, actually,
I have an unspoken request…”
Wang Ping (66): “What is it?”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “The world I come from has a relatively low power ranking. The strongest person is only at the Mountain-bursting tier. Although I easily reached this tier with my abilities, I can’t make any further progress. As for the Pope’s power, because of the absence of Magic Elements, his strength has been greatly weakened.”
Wang Ping (66): “So, you want to come to my world to hunt?”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “That’s what I mean… Otherwise, I find it hard to make
further progress. Bitter-smile.jpg.”
Lin Yuanyuan was genuinely helpless.
Her power was strong, but it required a male powerhouse to provide support.
If no one engages in intercourse with her, her strength will stagnate.
Therefore, going to other worlds is quite necessary.
Wang Ping (66): “You have a good idea, and I don’t mind you coming to my world. However, there are two issues. First, without a mission, you can only stay for three days if you use group points to cross over, and you’ll be forcefully sent back after that. Second, the powerhouses in our world don’t care much about women, so you might fail and even face danger.”
What Wang Ping said was true,
He had studied the Delivery Function, and the time he could stay by himself was very short. At least, for now, he didn’t know whether it would change later or not.
As for the problem of powerhouses being obsessed with women, it was true as well.
In their world, unless they were lascivious, normal cultivators wouldn’t care much about women once they reached the Transcendent Realm or higher.
The pleasure of that aspect couldn’t compare to the joy brought by the growth of cultivation and enlightenment.
Even if they really needed that kind of activity, it wouldn’t be for pleasure, but for dual cultivation to improve their cultivation, or for the offsprings sake, making their family prosper.
This became more apparent as they advanced.
Only when both parties saw each other and became Tao Companions would they have a normal physiological response because of their mutual love and support.
However, even so, they would use some dual cultivation techniques which would allow them to cultivate together, rather than just pursuing pleasure and wasting precious time.
Therefore, Lin Yuanyuan’s ability might not necessarily be miraculous, and she might not become stronger quickly.
Qin Tian (77): “Actually, it’s pretty much the same with the cultivators in our world. They don’t really care about women. Cultivating is also about cultivating the heart. Of course, my case is special, and I haven’t reached that level. Last time, I lost myself in Zhang Hu t s world… Zhang Hu is truly sinful.” Zhang Hu (5): “Screw you, it’s your fault for not having a firm Tao Heart.”
Zhang Hu (5): “But it’s true that the powerhouses in the Profound World and the Cultivation World are strong in all aspects. Our world’s powerhouses aren’t like that; they don’t care about cultivating their mind and indulge themselves.
Of course, it’s impossible for Lin Yuanyuan to come to my world either. After all, the human world’s ceiling is limited and drained by Lin Yuanyuan. Moreover, the Light Lord God is still furious; coming here means delivering one’s head.’
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Okay, I guess we’ll put that on hold for now.”
Lin Yuanyuan really wanted to say that Wang Ping could knock out a few powerhouses like he did in Zhang Hu t s Fantasy World, so she could forcibly take advantage of them.
However, that was during a mission.
Now, Wang Ping is under no obligation to help her. After all, Wang Ping isn’t considered a top powerhouse in his world, and doing so would come with great risks.
Wang Ping (66): “Lin Yuanyuan, for now, focus on trying to control your own power. Otherwise, with great strength and nothing else, you would still be a target for those seeking battles across realms. As for getting stronger using the Golden Finger, let’s wait until there’s a mission or when I have time to capture some powerhouses for you. Then, you can trade with me using group points.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Okay, thank you, Mr. Wang!’
Lin Yuanyuan’s eyes lit up.
It’s not good to freeload all the time; she has already been lucky enough to do so once, and can’t be freeloaders all the time.
Although it requires using group points, as long as she can become stronger, she won’t care too much.
Zhao Sihan (87): “l always feel like you guys are talking about something weird. As a junior high school student, I dare not say anything, ask anything, and can only quietly hold the fish snack that my owner gives me, shivering.”
Wang Ping (66) @Zhao Sihan (87): “You’re not homeless anymore, you got adopted?”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Yeah. I met a super cute big sister who took me home. Now
I’m enjoying all the good food and drink. Picture.jpg.”
With the picture uploaded by Zhao Sihan, everyone saw a girl dressed in a Hanfu with a transcendent temperament holding a cute tricolor tabby cat, stroking her head, and the tabby cat gnawing on a fish snack.
This scene would no doubt dazzle many ordinary people, but everyone here felt it was a bit strange..

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 120: Resurrecting Cai Yonglong! Three Consecutive Group Tasks! _6
Translator: 549690339
Everyone here is a traverser, but Zhao Sihan somehow ended up becoming a pet, and she even seemed to be enjoying it.
Wang Ping (66): “Ahem, as long as you’re fine. You guys can chat first. I’m going to lurk for now.”
However, just as Wang Ping said those words, a few system prompt sounds rang out again, leaving everyone silent.
“Ding, it has been detected that seven reincarnators from the Reincarnation Space have appeared in the world where group member Wang Shuqi (74) is, with individual strength judged as two at the Six Star Tier and five at the Five Star Tier. Eliminating all of them could yield 200,000 group points. The task level is classified as Six-Star Tier, suggesting that either three group members with a combat evaluation above Six-Star Tier should form a team, or a combination of two Six-Star members and five with Five-Star Tier evaluations should participate in the group task.”
“Ding, it has been detected that monsters from the Abyss Lands have invaded the world where group member Zhao Sihan (87) is. The monster level cannot be fully determined, estimated to be Six-Star Tier, possibly close to Seven-Star Tier. Eliminating all of them could yield a reward of 500,000 group points. Acting Group Owner Wang Ping (66) will select four members to participate in this group task.”
Wang Ping (66): “These group tasks… aren’t they coming too frequently? But, there are easy scoring tasks and difficult ones. It seems that group tasks will appear more and more frequently in the future.”
Zhang Jun (70): “To be honest, this is a good thing. Having many group tasks that most members can participate in allows us to quickly earn enough group points to become stronger.”
Xu Yi (84): “Although I’m a newcomer, I think so too.”
Fang Yun (3): “l don’t want to experience that cycle of death again, and I want to become stronger. But, as a No Star, I can’t participate in these strangely simple tasks. What a bummer! It seems that I can only focus on cultivating to become stronger.”
Wang Ping (66): “The strength of the reincarnators in Wang Shuqi’s world is very strong. There is a huge gap between the Six-Star Tiers, to the point that the ceiling can easily slap a bunch of Six-Star floor tiles. However, since the chat group didn’t ask me to go there, it shouldn’t be a major issue, and it’s unlikely to involve powerful combatants within the Six-Star Tier.”
Wang Ping (66): “In addition, Wang Shuqi is already the disciple of the strongest combatant in that High Martial World, Lin Zhan. He can rely on Lin Zhan’s power to mobilize the Martial Saints of that world to complete the task. So, the difficulty of the task should not be too high.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “l was scared just now, but now I feel relieved after seeing
Brother Wangs words! ”
Chen Yao (71): “That’s what I was thinking too. Let me lead the team this time. I’ll participate in the task in Wang Shuqi’s world to exterminate the reincarnators. My combat evaluation is now at Six-Star Tier as well. However, I should be considered one of the stronger Six-Star members.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Count me in. I’ve also reached the Five-Star Tier in strength and can use some forbidden curses to help. This time, I’ve prepared a big one, the Mana God Forbidden Curse, hehe.’
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “My combat evaluation is also Six-Star. However, my combat experience is insufficient, and my fighting ability will be reduced without magic elements. So, I don’t know whether to go to Wang Shuqi’s world or follow Brother Wang…”
Wang Ping (66) @Lin Yuanyuan: “You go to Wang Shuqi’s world, where strong fighters are available, and you don’t need spiritual energy or magic elements to become stronger. But remember not to harm the innocent, just kill some evil Martial Saints. Of course, it’s best to drain the reincarnators of their power.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Alright, I’ll go to that world.”
Wang Ping (60): “Then, Chen Yao, Lin Yuanyuan, and Zhang Hu go to Wang Shuqi’s world. Who else wants to go?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “There are only a few members in the group with combat evaluations above Five-Star Tier, so we can’t gather more people. However, considering the local strong fighters, this lineup should be enough.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright then, let’s do it. If you encounter any danger, wait for me to finish dealing with the monsters in Zhao Sihan’s world, and then come to our aid. Sure enough, Liu Mei, you should try to settle it as soon as possible. Your combat ability within the group is special; you can completely defeat enemies across multiple levels.”
Liu Mei (15): “Okay, I’ll do my best to find and control them.”
Qin Tian (77): “All the high-end combatants are going to Wang Shuqi’s side, what will you do on your own, Brother Wang? You can’t fight alone.”
Wang Ping (66) @Chen Si: “l have an idea. Chen Si, do you want to join me in the task? With your ability, you can assist me very well in defeating purely powerful opponents.”
Chen Si (83): “l, I’m a little scared… I’m most afraid of monsters.”
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t worry, I’ll protect you.”
Chen Si (83): “In that case… but…”
Zhang Jun (70) @Chen Si (83): “Girl, don’t hesitate. This is a great opportunity to resurrect your brother. As long as you earn enough group points, you can resurrect him. Besides, Brother Wang has never lost anyone on his team; there’s really no need to be afraid.”
Chen Si (83): “In that case, I’ll go! I want to resurrect my brother!”
Wang Ping (66): “Your courage is commendable, and I will train you well in the future.’
Wang Ping also showed a smile.
This Chen Si, although a bit timid, is a girl after all, so having a soft personality is normal.
However, even though she’s terrified, she’s willing to stand up bravely for the sake of resurrecting her brother. This conviction is excellent and definitely worth cultivating.
If Chen Si can perform well during the group task, Wang Ping won’t mind cultivating her into his exclusive support, helping her grow quickly alongside him.
Wang Ping (66): “Chen Si is one, then. Who else would like to participate in the mission?”
Wu Jun (20): “Can I go? But, I’m very weak…Although I’ve grown a lot with group points, my combat evaluation is only at the 3th-Tier.”
Wang Ping (66) @Wu Jun (20): “Your Golden Finger is very powerful and could potentially turn the tide in desperate situations. Participating in the group task is absolutely no problem. Not to mention, you must be reluctant to spend group points, right? Otherwise, with your amount of group points, you could easily pile up to Six-Star Tier.”
Wu Jun (20): “Ahem, Brother Wang saw through me… I was planning to save my group points to buy a Golden Finger Optimizer to optimize my Golden
Finger….”

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Obtaining Treasures Continuously
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Obtaining Treasures Continuously
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66) @Wu Jun (20): “You should definitely save up more group points to buy a Golden Finger Optimizer. Once you get that thing, you can optimize your perverted golden finger, which might be when it truly shines.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Speaking of which, I’m reminded of the bizarre Dream mission… If it weren’t for Wu Jun’s lucky summoning of a meteorite, we would’ve all died.’
Cai Yonglong (1): “Speaking of which, I don’t even know how you guys managed to complete the mission.”
Fang Yun (3): “Me neither. But from Zhang Jun’s tone, it seems that Wu Jun finally used his golden finger, right?”
Wu Jun (20): “Mhm. For the specific situation, you can check your own death videos.’
Cai Yonglong (1): “Watching one’s own death video… That’s really weird…”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, stop talking so much. Next, there are two slots left.
Anyone else who wants to participate in the group task, feel free to sign up.”
Qin Tian (77): “I’ll go. I feel like I’m becoming Mr. Wangs exclusive mission partner. amusing.jpg.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “My strength isn’t that great, can I go?”
Qin Tian (77): “Huh, Ye Xiaofan, did you take the wrong medicine? You’re actually willing to participate in a mission?”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “We’re not facing anything bizarre this time, so there’s nothing to be scared of. More importantly, I’m tired of being hunted down and want to relax in another world. I haven’t been back to Earth in a long time. I really want to eat some barbecue and drink tons of cola.”
Zhang Jun (70): “1 originally wanted to join Mr. Wang for the mission.
However, since Ye Xiaofan wants to go, I won’t go this time.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, then our team for this mission will be me, Chen Si,
Qin Tian, and Ye Xiaofan.”
Chen Yao (71): “On my side, it’s me, Zhang Hu, and Lin Yuanyuan. Whoever wants to join can sign up.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “The remaining people are not strong enough, and their golden fingers are not of the special capacity type, so they can’t help much. So, it’s better not to hold others back.”
Luo Weiguo (85): “Wait, can I go? I developed my golden finger and found out
I can absorb a living beings vitality, condense Life essence for healing.”
Chen Yao (71): “Alright, you can join the mission as a healer.”
Xu Yi (84): “It seems like golden fingers need development too. Previously, we all thought Luo Weiguo’s golden finger wasn’t strong, but it seems we were wrong.”
Qin Tian (77): “Although 1 really want to say that there are no rubbish golden fingers, only rubbish world-hoppers. Forget it, I’d better not say it; it’s easy to make enemies. Not to mention that this statement is nonsense.’
Everyone was speechless. Hadn’t he already said it?
Wang Ping (66): “So, let’s prepare to cross over.”
After Wang Ping quietly sent this message, he began to operate.
The group mission function had also changed, or rather, it had been optimized by Alpha.
If other group members, like Chen Yao, willingly step up to lead the team, they can also control the input of team members and go through the crossing to complete the mission, without Wang Ping filling out anything.
Apparently, this is also one of the many pieces of evidence showing that more and more missions will appear in the future.
“As usual, let’s simulate once before crossing, just in case.”
Before crossing, Wang Ping chose to directly pay for a simulation.
Although the simulation reward from last time wasn’t used, that doesn’t mean it won’t be useful this time,
Anyway, there will always be a time to use it, and it might be the key to break the situation.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing…” The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Green Talent: Hyper-Speed Regeneration.”
Green Talent: Hyper-Speed Regeneration: With this talent, the host’s recovery ability will become quite impressive. However, if facing attacks that exceed the recovery limit or abilities that weaken undying nature, it might lose its effect.
“A recovery-type green talent, huh? It’s finally been refreshed for me. Even though it’s only green, it barely makes up for a little weakness.”
Wang Ping looked at this talent and thought to himself.
At this moment, white light surged around Wang Ping, and he was teleported away from the world he was currently in.
At the same time, the group members participating in the group task in other worlds also began their teleportation one after another.
When Wang Pings vision was restored, he found himself in a room filled with a girlish style.
At this moment, a sweet-looking black-haired girl was playing with a three-colored cat, Zhao Sihan.
The sudden appearance of Wang Ping startled the girl.
Subsequently, three more rays of light appeared, and Chen Si, Qin Tian, and Ye Xiaofan also appeared here.
The trio also saw the black-haired girl and the three-colored cat in her arms, Zhao Sihan.
For a moment, the atmosphere was somewhat awkward.
“Meow meow meow-“ Zhao Sihan also looked at the black-haired girl, and then at Wang Ping and the others, calling out awkwardly.
As a newcomer, she had never participated in any mission and never expected to be transmitted directly to her side.
As a result, she wasn’t prepared at all. Now, things were awkward for Meow.
“You… who are you?”
The black-haired girl looked at Wang Ping and the others in fear. Although Wang Ping, Ye Xiaofan, and Qin Tian were all wearing robes, their demeanor was extraordinary, giving the impression of otherworldly immortals..

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Obtaining Treasures in a Row 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Obtaining Treasures in a Row 2
Translator: 549690339
If it were any other time, she would definitely come up to ask for a contact number.
But now, since such a strange phenomenon had suddenly emerged in her room, she felt shivers down her spine.
As for Chen Si, an elegant-looking girl wearing glasses with an artistic air, she was totally overlooked by her.
“Mr.Wang, do you need me to cast a Mana spell to hypnotize her? Or should we just erase her memory?”
Qin Tian glanced at Wang Ping and said.
“It’s not necessary. Considering her relationship with Zhao Sihan, she is also a related party. Since Zhao Sihan recognizes her, she is also qualified to know some things.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and stopped Qin Tian’s action.
This is a world of spiritual revival.
Although at present the spiritual revival phenomenon has just appeared, and ability users have just emerged on the surface and have become known to some people, as the spiritual revival intensifies, the world will inevitably undergo great changes.
As for Zhao Sihan, whether as a traveler from another world or simply a native of this world, she is destined to be unable to avoid exposing her uniqueness.
In addition, Zhao Sihan is just a junior high school student with a naive personality, which means she definitely cannot leave the girl in front of her unattended.
Of course, Wang Ping thinks that the most crucial point is that it is more conducive for her to survive with someone accompanying her.
Otherwise, she might suffer a sudden death due to an accident.
Aside from that, Wang Ping feels that it is necessary to have a few more people to interact with in this world for any further visits on upcoming missions.
“Hypnosis? Erasing memories?” The black-haired girl listened to Qin Tian’s conversation, her face instantly turning pale, and she shivered, “Don’t do anything to me, my brother is an ability user, and he’s very powerful.”
“What a trouble.’
Wang Ping sighed and directly told the black-haired girl the origins of him and the others.
Suddenly, the black-haired girl was dumbfounded.
Her kitten, unbelievably, had the soul of a human being from another world. Luckily, this soul belonged to a female junior high school student, or else the girl would have been completely creeped out.
If she thought about all the times she had been hugging a cat with the soul of a greasy middle-aged man, she would probably want to throw up.
However, after learning about Wang Ping and the others’ purpose for coming to this world, the black-haired girl was even more stunned.
“Saving the world? That sounds incredible.”
The black-haired girl Lin Qiuqiu said blankly.
Her brain was really crashing at the moment.
Transworld travelers, monsters of the Abyss Lands, saving the world- -all these things shattered her view of the world instantly.
The last time her worldview was shattered was when she found out about the spiritual revival.
“We’ll be staying here for a while temporarily. In addition, we need to use your computer. I hope you don’t mind.”
Wang Ping said with a smile.
“Don’t worry, once we’ve figured out the specifics of this world, we’ll leave.”
As for Wang Ping, although their current combat power is already capable of crushing this world that has just experienced spiritual revival, he still has no intention of acting blindly.
Only by being cautious can they ensure their safety.
Whether it’s facing the strange or the powers of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, they must take everything seriously.
“Um, okay.” After Lin Qiuqiu came to her senses, she hesitated for a moment before nodding her head.
Facing Wang Ping and the others, she obviously had no ability to resist.
Instead of doing so, she might as well lay down and take a Zen approach.
After all, they were here to save the world, so they probably wouldn’t do anything weird to her, a weak girl.
“Can I talk to my brother about it?” Lin Qiuqiu asked cautiously.
“No, at least not now. It would cause some trouble.” Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Fine.” Lin Qiuqiu nodded helplessly.
“MeowQ’ Seeing that Wang Ping and the others hadn’t made things too difficult for Lin Qiuqiu, Zhao Sihan breathed a sigh of relief, meowed, and expressed her gratitude.
Though she was a junior high school student, she was no fool. She knew that it was because of her that Wang Ping had spoken so much to Lin Qiuqiu and been so gentle, rather than immediately resorting to spells like Qin Tian.
“Ye Xiaofan, your cultivation is a bit low, huh? You’re only at the Qi cultivation fifth-tier realm. With such a low cultivation level, it’s amazing that you managed to escape from those people.”
Upon seeing that Lin Qiuqiu has been dealt with by Wang Ping, Qin Tian patted Ye Xiaofan on the shoulder and said with a grin.
His current cultivation level is at the middle period of the elixir refining realm.
Of course, this was the result of his master’s fear that his rapid cultivation improvement may cause his state of mind to be unable to catch up.
Otherwise, even reaching the Primordial Infant realm wouldn’t have been a problem for him.
“Those big shots didn’t actually go after me. It’s just that the small fry were annoying. It was just some small fry; I was still able to run away if I wanted to.”
Ye Xiaofan brushed off Qin Tian’s hand and calmly said.
“Tsk, you really like showing off, making even running away sound so impressive. ”
Qin Tian was speechless.
“Alright, as usual, you guys search the internet for information first. As for me, I need to use the Golden finger to do something.”
Wang Ping looked at the three people and the cat, as well as Lin Qiuqiu, who had been staring at him, and said.
“Alright.”
Qin Tian nodded.
Then he directly borrowed Lin Qiuqiu’s laptop.
Ye Xiaofan was also watching by the side.
Zhao Sihan, in the form of a cat, couldn’t help but be intrigued.
As for Chen Si, she was watching the others somewhat nervously.
Although they had just gone through a brief self-introduction, they were still strangers to each other, making her feel uneasy, and she could only glance at Wang Ping from time to time..

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Treasures Obtained_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Treasures Obtained_3
Translator: 549690339
However, Wang Ping closed his eyes.
As Wang Ping closed his eyes, the luminescent screen created by the Paid Simulation also appeared, and words began to surface.
[Day One, you calmly cultivated.]
[Day Two, you took Cai Yonglong to the Black Wind Forest, found the Devil’s
Cave, and met the Blood Demon Yuan Feng. You suddenly remembered that Blood Demon Yuan Feng was also born in Profound Turtle Continent, and he has cultivated to the Life and Death Realm. He must possess a secret method, otherwise, he could not have reached this step.]
[Blood Demon Yuan Feng did not answer your question, but attacked you directly. However, your strength is now far more than before when you met Blood Demon Yuan Feng in your memory. You easily blocked his attack.] [Blood Demon Yuan Feng was very surprised, and was very interested in the reason for your rapid cultivation improvement. But, you showed no intention of answering.]
[Blood Demon Yuan Feng admitted that he indeed possessed such a secret method, but he would not teach you. He promised to teach you only if you let him go.]
[You chose to ignore Blood Demon Yuan Fengs deal. You clearly understood that even with the seal, Blood Demon Yuan Feng demonstrated such great strength. Should he be send abroad, you would certainly stand no chance against him. At that time, you would definitely be manipulated, let alone obtaining the secret method from him. You would even end up dead.]
[Next, you took Ye Chen and Cai Yonglong and left the Profound Turtle Continent, heading for the Seven Stars Archipelago. Meanwhile, following the opportunity line on Ye Chen’s body, you and Cai Yonglong began to look for corresponding opportunities, hoping to grasp his opportunities.]
[However, you were quickly disappointed. Although there were many opportunities on Ye Chen now, aside from the opportunity line connected to the Seven Star Secret Realm, the other opportunities were very beneficial for Ye Chen now, but they were of little use to you. At that point, you had a realization that the opportunities on Ye Chen seemed to be determined by his current level of cultivation.]
[As such, you could only wait for Ye Chen to grow up before more opportunity lines could appear on his body.]
[Soon, nearly twenty years passed. During these years, you also brought Bai
Tianhong out from the Profound Turtle Continent. At the same time, you, along with Ye Chen, also obtained some opportunities. As Ye Chen’s cultivation improved, the opportunities you got became greater, albeit most of them were useful to Ye Chen. Due to Cai Yonglongs low cultivation, he also reaped quite a few benefits, improving his cultivation to the Spirit Sea Domain
Perfection.]
[However, due to your high cultivation level, you didn’t get any substantial benefits. Even the greatest opportunity on Ye Chen was the Cultivation Skill and Martial Arts taught by you.]
[Meanwhile, you began to complain about Cai Yonglong. You originally thought that Cai Yonglongs golden finger could bring about great effects, but from what you see now, following Ye Chen basically just helped him get some opportunities earlier, without any significant effect.]
[Of course, you were well aware that being around the Son of Fortune would be just like that. If you took Cai Yonglong to the Eastern Desolation to search for various opportunities, there would be greater gains. However, that also means you might face greater dangers.]
[Next, when the Seven Star Secret Realm was opened, you entered it. Ye Chen successfully obtained the inheritance of the Life and Death Realm Master, Falling Star Ancestor. To repay vou. Ye Chen gave you all the Coagulating Profound Grass that Falling Star Ancestor had prepared for him. You chose to accept.]
[After that, Ye Chen bid you farewell, intending to part ways. You suspect that
Falling Star Ancestor has not completely fallen and is now in Ye Chen’s body as a soul body, serving as Ye Chen’s new ring grandfather.]
[You asked Ye Chen whether there was a secret method to conceal the
Profound Turtle Spirit. Ye Chen was surprised at your question, never expecting that you had long known the secrets of the ancient times. He shook his head to indicate that he didn’t have that. You expressed disappointment and asked if Ye Chen could return and give you a copy whenever he acquires such a secret method in the future.]
[Ye Chen nodded seriously, promised you that if he obtained such secret methods in the future, he would definitely give you a copy.]
[Ultimately, you parted ways. Ye Chen embarked on his new journey. Cai Yonglong asked you why you didn’t follow Ye Chen. You shook your head expressing that the probability of dying was high if you followed Ye Chen.
Plus, even if you knew he had opportunities, it would be useless as you didn’t want to seize them nor could you seize them.]
[Cai Yonglong thought what you said was very reasonable, and felt helpless.]
[Next, with your help, Cai Yonglong broke through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm in ten years, becoming a Spiritual Embryo Stage Cultivator. Soon after,
Cai Yonglong discovered an opportunity line on a half-step Profound Elixir
Realm Cultivator. You followed it, finding a treasure in a huge storm at sea.]
[With your extensive knowledge, you recognized the treasure. It was an item known as the Heart of the Storm, 8-tier in rank. If absorbed by
Wind-attribute cultivators, it could increase the grade of coagulation and speed.]
[Although you were not Wind-attribute cultivators, you still took it away. After all, 8-tier treasures are extremely rare and incredibly valuable, and should not be missed.]
[In the eleventh year, Ye Chen returned to Sacred Heart Island through someone and found you. He gave you a secret method. You were very pleased and very emotional. Ye Chen, now really shining brightly, even the cultivators he delegated to send the message were all Profound Elixir Realm masters. And they were not just ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters..]

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Treasures Obtained_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 121: The Biggest Problem Solved! Treasures Obtained_4
Translator: 549690339
[Next, you cultivated the Secret Skill that Ye Chen sent, successfully concealing your Profound Turtle Spirit. This made your mood extremely pleasant, with all your frustrations swept away. Now, you can finally venture into the Eastern
Desolation. As long as you do not encounter those ancient Great Sects or the 1st-tier Holy Land Masters, you will not be easily discovered and casually killed.]
[Therefore, you made up your mind to go to the Heavenly Sea Country’s Purple Moon Secret Realm in the Eastern Desolation nine years later; it is something you absolutely do not want to miss. After all, this is crucial to whether you can condense a Top 3 tier Xuan Dan or not. You believe that with Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger’s help, there is still a great chance of obtaining astonishing opportunities.]
[However, you thought of Bai Tianhong’s situation. If Bai Tianhong goes to the
Eastern Desolation with you, he might not be found by the white-haired Old Lady again, and miss out on great opportunities. In view of this, you give Bai
Tianhong a large number of cultivation resources and warn him to stay on Sacred Heart Island instead of roaming around. In a few decades, someone will appear and inform him of his background.]
[Bai Tianhong considered you his second master, your status even higher than the First Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect, so naturally, he trusted your words and vowed not to leave.]
[You were very satisfied with Bai Tianhong’s answer and chose to leave Sacred Heart Island. This time, instead of risking crossing the sea again, you openly stepped into the Delivery Array, using the Ice Palace’s Delivery Array to teleport, your heart completely at ease.]
“I didn’t expect it to be so easy to obtain the secret method to conceal my aura… Indeed, the solution was with Ye Chen. Although Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, has been somewhat hindered by the Heavenly Lone Star’s fate, he can still bring me benefits.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and sighed.
Of course, it would probably be impossible for the simulated Wang Ping to follow Ye Chen to the Eastern Desolation.
As there is no one on Sacred Heart Island with the power to threaten Wang Ping, the ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ fate has no opportunity to be triggered. However, it might not be the same in the Eastern Desolation with many powerful people who could easily kill Wang Ping just by provoking Ye Chen.
At that time, it would be another instance where his fate activated Ye Chen’s ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ buff, allowing him to level up madly once again.
“I wonder if there will be a big harvest this time.”
Wang Ping secretly pondered in his heart.
[After you and Cai Yonglong used the Delivery Array to arrive in a coastal city of the Heavenly Sea Country, you began to learn everything about the Heavenly
Sea Country and search for great opportunities.]
[In the twelfth year, you successfully saw an opportunity line on a Profound Elixir Realm master. Cai Yonglong was very excited, knowing that an opportunity useful to Profound Elixir Realm masters must not be simple. As a result, you followed the opportunity line to snatch the opportunity.]
[Eventually, you successfully followed the opportunity line to find the opportunity. It was a place where a Profound Elixir Realm master had passed away. You found this Profound Elixir Realm master’s Storage Spirit Ring in the cave and obtained a large number of top-tier spirit stones and some top-tier spirit stones.]
[In addition, there was a sword-type Profound Instrument and a defensive
Profound Armor. Seeing this harvest, your heart was filled with excitement. You were very grateful that Cai Yonglong survived; otherwise, it would have been impossible to find such an amazing opportunity immediately upon arriving in the Heavenly Sea Country.]
[As a powerful swordsman, you were always troubled by the issue of sword-type Profound Instruments. Although you could refine elixirs to earn spirit stones to purchase them, it would still be time-consuming. Not to mention that there was also a defensive Profound Armor. In the end, it is more pleasing to get something for free than to buy it yourself.]
[After quickly dividing the spoils, you chose to leave the place. The Profound Elixir Realm master who arrived later was very depressed after discovering that they seemed to have missed the opportunity.]
[Next, you and Cai Yonglong traveled all over the Heavenly Sea Country, searching for various opportunities. However, it was a pity that opportunities were not common, and not everyone could encounter one every day. As a result, your harvests were not as significant as before.]
[Feeling disappointed, you calmed down and realized that Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger was not an omnipotent treasure-seeking device, deciding to wait patiently for the opening of the Purple Moon Secret Realm. Before that, you planned to cultivate well and try to improve your strength as much as possible..]

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 122: Entering the Purple Moon Secret Realm! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 122: Entering the Purple Moon Secret Realm! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country
Translator: 549690339
[Nine years later, the Purple Moon Secret Realm is about to open, and the entire Heavenly Sea Country is buzzing with excitement. Countless cultivators are joining in the action, including you and Cai Yonglong, who are heading to the Purple Moon Secret Realm.]
[When you and Cai Yonglong arrive at the mountain range near the Purple Moon Secret Realm, you can see a large number of powerful cultivators transforming into divine halos. Even before this, the major powers of the Heavenly Sea Country had already boarded their precious Spirit Boats or rode formidable monster beasts in the sky, waiting for the secret realm to open. Even powerful cultivators from outside the Heavenly Sea Country have appeared.]
[Such a grand event greatly amazes Cai Yonglong, and you too find it hard to remain calm. However, what excites you both even more is that you see a lot of opportunity lines on many cultivators. Among them, the opportunity lines on Yin Yang Masters and Life and Death Realm Masters are very tempting, but deep down, you know that these big shots’ opportunities are not something you can covet.]
[If you forcibly try to seize the opportunities on their bodies, even if you’re lucky enough to discover the opportunity before them, there’s a high chance that you won’t be able to take it away. Opportunities often come with danger. The monster beasts guarding the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures are at least of the Yin Yang Mirror realm or above. If you’re discovered by these monster beasts, you’ll only be casually swatted to death and become their food.]
[Therefore, you focus more on those who are at the half- step Profound Elixir Realm and above. You are well aware that only the opportunities on these people can be seized by you. Among them, the opportunities on the bodies of the young cultivators who are famous throughout the Heavenly Sea Country are certainly better. If you can snatch more such opportunities, you will have a promising future.]
[However, Cai Yonglong greatly regrets that if only his opportunity line could distinguish specific levels, it would be perfect. Now he can only judge the thickness of opportunity lines.]
[You don’t have much opinion on Cai Yonglongs words. Anyway, it’s good enough for now. Of course, if you could optimize the Golden Finger sometime in the future, that would be even better.]
[As the Purple Moon Secret Realm is about to open and you are about to enter it, you come across a young man with numerous opportunity lines, which greatly astonishes you.]
[Then, you remember Ye Chen’s story. As far as you recall, Ye Chen made a huge stir in the Purple Moon Secret Realm by taking away the most valuable Nirvana Boundary Inheritance and Nirvana Fruit under the noses of a group of masters.]
[You guess that this young man must be Ye Chen. However, he has concealed his identity, changed his appearance, and is very cautious. Of course, you have also exercised due caution, changing your appearance and disguising your identity. However, your measures are definitely not as good as Ye Chen’s, especially since a few of them are effective even in front of a Yin Yang Master.]
[However, your target this time is not on a Yin Yang Master, so as long as you’re careful, there should be no big issues.]
[In the end, you don’t greet Ye Chen, and as the Purple Moon Secret Realm opens, you enter it. A large number of cultivators also rush into it.]
[However, as soon as you enter, you are separated from Cai Yonglong and forcibly teleported to different locations. You were prepared for this and had already bought a treasure that could confirm both your positions, planning to regroup quickly.]
[Your plan is good, but unfortunately, things don’t always go as planned.]
[Three hours later, you encounter a Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast, and a fierce battle erupts between you two. This Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast is very powerful, and it takes all your strength to kill it. Even so, if not for your Hyper- Speed Regeneration talent, you might have lost and squandered a Rebirth Tally.]
[After slaying the Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast, you are still in shock. You didn’t expect to encounter such danger as soon as you arrive in the Purple
Moon Secret Realm. Later, you find an 8-tier Treasure Elixir in the Demonic
Beast’s nest, which is one of the main ingredients for refining the 8-tier Profound Spirit Elixir. However, your heart is not too overjoyed but instead becomes heavier.]
[Because it seems that the level of the Purple Moon Secret Realm is too high and not suitable for cultivators below the Profound Elixir Realm to explore. Cai Yonglongs cultivation is only at the Spiritual Fetus Realm, and he is in danger of falling whether he encounters monster beasts in the secret realm or other cultivators.]
[Not to mention, Cai Yonglongs Same Realm Battle Power is definitely at the bottom of the secret realm. No matter who he encounters, if they have ill intentions, he is in danger.]
[However, even though you know this, there is nothing you can do, as you are in danger yourself and can’t take care of Cai Yonglong.]
[Five hours later, you find that Cai Yonglong’s Soul Tablet has shattered, meaning he has undoubtedly perished. You sigh in your heart, thinking that Cai Yonglongs fate is too tragic, and your illusion of seizing opportunities is shattered.]
“This development….”
Wang Ping is at a loss for words.
Although he had guessed that the Purple Moon Secret Realm would be dangerous, as this is a secret realm where even the Yin Yang Masters and Life and Death Realm Masters would enter, it was not comparable to the Seven Star Secret Realm and seizing opportunities there would be difficult.
However, he didn’t expect Cai Yonglong to die not even a day after entering, and he himself also had a close escape.
“Perhaps, we can consider letting the simulated Cai Yonglong cultivate a Demonic Skill..

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 122: Entering the Purple Moon Secret Realm! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 122: Entering the Purple Moon Secret Realm! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country_2
Translator: 549690339
An idea suddenly emerged in Wang Pings mind.
Cai Yonglongs talent was to seek opportunities. In the Profound World, the Golden Finger was quite useful.
However, he was different from Wang Ping because he didn’t have the Life Simulator to refresh his talent and improve his comprehension and Bone and Root Aptitude. He could only rely on Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures from the outer world to enhance his abilities.
Such Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures were extremely rare and difficult to find, especially those of high quality, which were even more extraordinary.
Even masters above the level of the Yin Yang Mirror would covet such treasures.
It could be said that the probability of Cai Yonglongs Bone and Root Aptitude and comprehension improving quickly was not high.
However, relying solely on his own cultivation, it would be difficult for him to advance quickly within a short time.
Of course, Cai Yonglongs talent was actually not bad, as he had managed to reach the Spiritual Origin Realm within two or three years on his own.
Although the Golden Finger had helped him find opportunities, it could not erase the fact that Cai Yonglongs own Bone and Root Aptitude was quite good.
After all, Wang Ping was far inferior to Cai Yonglong before he refreshed his talent.
As for Saber Intent, Cai Yonglong had comprehended it on his own, which wasn’t something ordinary opportunities could help with.
It could be said that Cai Yonglongs Bone and Root Aptitude and comprehension were already stronger than many others.
However, although Cai Yonglongs talent was not bad, it was still difficult for him to grow quickly and keep up with Wang Pings pace.
It was even more difficult to become an apex force in their group, as it was hard to catch up with people like Wang Ping and Chen Yao who had great advantages.
“But then, Demonic Skills…
Wang Ping hesitated again.
He himself did not practice Demonic Skills, as although this technique could quickly improve cultivation and condense the top 3 tier Xuan Dan by devouring enough powerful enemies, it also had obvious side effects, such as making people extremely bloodthirsty and changing their personality.
Besides, cultivating Demonic skills would not be tolerated by heaven and earth, and major forces would ruthlessly hunt down and kill those who practiced them without mercy.
There was no way around it. Many years ago, the Blood Demon disaster had likely caused numerous members of the Human Race to join the Demon Clan and practice Demonic Skills, leading to chaos.
“Cai Yonglong probably couldn’t resist the temptation of Demonic Skills. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have unsealed Blood Demon Yuan Feng in that life simulation, then screwed me over.’
Wang Ping sighed.
“So, I’ll just have to see how things go. After all, I can use the Life Simulator to see how Cai Yonglong will perform after practicing Demonic Skills. There’s no need to be too anxious.’
Then, Wang Ping reined in his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
As he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, more text appeared.
[Next, you venture alone into the Purple Moon Secret Realm, experiencing several dangerous situations. In the most dangerous one, you are forced to die with your enemy, and only manage to survive by using a Rebirth tally to revive yourself.]
[At that time, you feel truly desperate because you realize that your combat power within the Purple Moon Secret Realm is really too low.]
[Although it can be said that your strength is greater than many True
Inheritor Disciples cultivated by Great Sects, and even those with half step
Profound Elixir Realm are no match for you, those disciples have Profound
Elixir Realm masters as leaders, which provides safety that you cannot match.
You can only bully those who, like you, are lone cultivators in the half step Profound Elixir Realm or those foolish Mortal Realm cultivators who have ventured into the Purple Moon Secret Realm.]
[On the third day, you hear about the appearance of a 10th Tier Treasure Medicine in the Purple Moon Secret Realm, sparking a battle between two Life and Death Realm Masters. The aftermath kills many Profound Elixir Realm practitioners and even a Yin Yang Mirror master, causing you to be secretly alarmed.]
[The 10th Tier Treasure Medicine is too valuable, driving even Life and Death Realm Masters to madness. However, when treasures are born, they are accompanied by bloodshed. Those in the Profound Elixir Realm do not even have the qualifications to spectate the battles, let alone take part. Even some minor Yin Yang Mirror practitioners lack the qualifications. After all, even a
Yin Yang Mirror master was killed by the aftermath, which is truly terrifying.]
[On the fifth day, you are severely injured once more. Thankfully, you possess the talent of Hyper-Speed Regeneration and, combined with the various Elixirs you have prepared as an Alchemist, you manage to survive.]
[Feeling bitter, you are no longer willing to take risks and vie for opportunities. You decide to hide in one place, waiting for the closure of the Purple Moon Secret Realm and for it to automatically teleport you out.]
[But, just because you are unwilling to seize opportunities, doesn’t mean others won’t. On the seventh day, two Yin and Yang Master have a fierce battle not too far from your hiding place. The terrifying aftermath sweeps the sky.]
[Although you are far away, and the two are fighting in the sky, the terrifying aftermath still injures you. You flee to the distance like a frightened bird.]
[After you finally manage to reach safety, you fall silent. It seems that hiding is not an option. If you have the misfortune of encountering a battle between powerful beings, you could end up dying as collateral damage. This time, you were far away and considered lucky, but it might not be the case next time.]
[Next, you decide to continue searching for opportunities. At this moment, you are prepared to either succeed or perish.]
[Of course, you are well aware that you may not be able to find an opportunity to help you successfully condense a top 3 tier Xuan Dan. Hesitation will lead to failure, so you no longer hesitate and directly swallow a Solidifying
Mysterious Elixir that you had prepared, choosing to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. Only by breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm will your combat power increase significantly, granting you greater safety.]
[You successfully condense a Profound Elixir and attract Heavenly
Tribulation. After the tribulation refines the Elixir, you successfully condense a 4th Tier Profound elixir. You have become a Profound Elixir Realm master..]

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 122 Entering the Purple Moon Secret Region! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 122 Entering the Purple Moon Secret Region! Princess of Heavenly Sea Country_3
Translator: 549690339
The girl arrived here during your breakthrough process and had been watching you with considerable surprise. It was only after you had successfully achieved your breakthrough that you noticed her presence, triggering a sense of awe within you and a desire to leave.
She, however, stood directly in your way, preventing you from leaving. The speed at which she had moved stunned you, as you had not realized it at all. At the same time, you found yourself unable to discern her cultivation level.
The girl quickly introduced herself, revealing that she was Ling Xue, the Seventeenth Princess of Heavenly Sea Country, wishing to befriend you. You were surprised, not expecting to encounter the seventeenth princess of the Heavenly Sea Country here. After all, your memory attests to the dazzling performance she would undertake in the upcoming Hundred Dynasties War, which will make her a disciple of an elder from the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
After some thought, you concluded that given her status, she had no reason to covet anything from you, and you chose to agree.
Ling Xue was very pleased with your acceptance. She inquired whether you were a loose cultivator and what your name was. You elected to answer her question, though you chose to give her a pseudonym, telling her your name was Bai Tianhong.
Ling Xue was profoundly surprised by your answer. Although she surmised that you were a loose cultivator, she didn’t expect that you really were. With this in mind, she expressed great admiration for you, finding it rare for a loose cultivator to be able to condense a 4th Tier Profound Elixir.
You give a helpless smile. The 4th tier was not what you desired. Ling Xue chuckled at your response, curiously asking if you aimed to condense a 3rd Tier Profound Pill. You decided to answer her.
Ling Xue, being a straightforward person, patted your shoulder, telling you not to daydream while it was still daylight. You were taken aback by the character of the seventeenth princess of the Heavenly Sea Country, and began to feel a certain fondness towards her.
Then, you asked Ling Xue about the grade of Profound Elixir she had condensed. Ling Xue did not hide anything and directly told you that she had condensed a 3rd Tier Profound Pill.
For a while, you felt extremely envious. Ling Xue consoled you, explaining that she was able to condense a 3rd Tier Profound Pill because she had once consumed a 9th tier Treasure Medicine. Otherwise, she might have only been able to condense a 4th Tier Profound Elixir.
You were very curious as to what kind of medicine could aid in the condensation of a 3rd-Tier Profound Pill. Ling Xue told you that it was a
Golden Spirit Fruit – a 9th-tier treasure medicine, capable of enhancing one’s Bone and Root Aptitude and reinforcing their base. At this point, Ling Xue expressed regret, saying that she had been careless in her consumption of it. If she had used it to refine a 9th Tier Elixir Golden Yuan Pill, the effects would have been even more potent.
You asked curiously, could it be possible to condense a 2nd Tier Profound
Elixir? Ling Xue looked at you with irritation, rhetorically asking if you think a
2nd Tier Profound Elixir was as common as a cabbage? She clarified that a
2nd Tier Profound Elixir can only be achieved by genuine prodigies. Anyone who manages to condense a 2nd Tier Profound Elixir, even if they were in Holy Land, could be expected to become a true disciple.
You were profoundly shocked by this reveal, as you hadn’t realized that there was such a huge significance behind a 3rd Tier Profound Elixir and a 2nd Tier Profound Elixir. You then curiously asked Ling Xue about the level that the True Disciples of Holy Land could achieve in the future if they did not perish prematurely.
After some contemplation, Ling Xue shared the answer with you. Different Holy Lands yield disciples with different potential. But if a quasi-true disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land were to survive, they would most likely reach the Life and Death Realm in the future and have a high chance of stepping into the Nirvana Boundary.
As for the true disciples of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, if they were to survive, they would surely reach the Nirvana Boundary in the future, and each of them would have the potential to become a King. However, potential alone doesn’t make a King: that was something only time could tell.
You were shocked to know that the King Realm was a level above the Nirvana Boundary.
Next, you asked Ling Xue, whether the ones who managed to condense a 1st-Tier Profound Elixir were on par with the Saint Sons, and if they would surely reach the King Realm in the future.
Ling Xue rolled her eyes, telling you that you were overthinking. The King
Realm was a significant threshold, and not even the children of the Holy Land could necessarily condense a 1st Tier Profound Elixir. Even if they did manage to condense a 1st-Tier Profound Elixir, they couldn’t necessarily guarantee a place in the King Realm. After all, the Profound Elixir Realm was merely a
level of attainment. The quality of one’s Profound Elixir was important, but couldn’t definitively gauge a prodigy’s potential.
Moreover, there were numerous Holy Lands in this world, birthing countless
Saint Sons. New Saint Sons emerged from the Holy Lands from time to time. But, in the grand scope of the Purple Spirit Realm, a King Realm Master might only appear once in a decade.
After a pause, Ling Xue continued, saying that those at the Nirvana Realm had a lifespan of five thousand years. You need to consider how many former geniuses and prodigies had been stuck at the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection or the quasi-King Tier. It might seem a short period, but the fact that many are stuck at the bottleneck, and a King Realm Master emerges only once every decade shows how difficult it is to attain.
You were awestruck, finally understanding just how formidable the King Realm was and how hard it was to make a breakthrough into it. A great longing surfaced in your heart for this unprecedented level of strength.
Subsequently, Ling Xue sighed, stating that the difference between Saint Sons and True Disciples lies in the fact that they had defeated their peers, the True Disciples, representing the face of their respective Holy Lands. However, this didn’t necessarily mean that the Saint Sons were much stronger than the True Disciples—the gap between them could be vast. Naturally, some Saint Sons were so monstrous that their peers could not catch up, and there were quite a few such examples.
Those truly prodigious Saint Sons who had not died prematurely were the ones who would eventually advance into the quasi-King Tier, with a high probability of stepping into the King Realm. They were the ones whom the major Holy Lands would spare no effort to cultivate.
After listening to Ling Xue’s words, you finally understood just how vast the world was and how naive your previous thoughts had been. Even those Saint Sons cultivated by the Holy Lands might not be able to condense a 1st-Tier Profound Elixir, and yet, you, a loose cultivator, without cultivation techniques, resources, or a master to guide you, were dreaming of condensing a 1st-Tier Profound Elixir, even a Flawless Profound Elixir. How laughably foolish that was..

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 122: Entering the Purple Moon
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 122: Entering the Purple Moon
Secret Realm! Heavenly Sea Country’s Princess_4
Translator: 549690339
[At the same time, you came to understand more deeply why Blood Demon
Yuan Feng mocked your naivety back then. Even the Holy Land’s Son might not be able to do what you were determined to achieve, making your devotion and delusion overly naive and laughable.]
[Feeling a bit lost, you fell silent. Ling Xue, seeing your state, comforted you by saying that you are already strong enough as a loose cultivator and don’t need to compare yourself to the abnormal beings of the Holy Land.]
[You asked Ling Xue why she befriended you and patiently told you so much, and she candidly replied that as a loose cultivator, you possess great potential and might be able to step into the Life and Death Realm in the future. Such people are rare, and it’s useful to make friends and have more connections.]
[Besides, she thought that with your potential, there is a good chance of you performing well in the Hundred Dynasties War and possibly joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land as a disciple.]
[You understood her point but bitterly told her that you wouldn’t participate in the Hundred Dynasties War. Ling Xue was astonished and asked why.
Hesitating, you didn’t answer.]
[Ling Xue became somewhat dissatisfied upon this and insisted on getting an answer from you. She claimed that it wasn’t fair since she shared so much information with you, yet you were hiding things from her.]
[Unable to refuse Ling Xue any longer, you figured that since the Heavenly Sea Country Ancestor didn’t care about the Sinful Bloodline Descendants matter, the kind-hearted Ling Xue definitely wouldn’t take it to heart either. In the end, you told her the truth, that due to certain reasons, you have been labeled a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’ and participating in the Hundred Dynasties War would be suicide.]
[After hearing this, Ling Xue was very surprised and discontented, complaining that those big shots were being petty and holding onto things that happened so many years ago. You were taken aback by her words, feeling gratitude towards her, but you also advised her to speak cautiously.]
[Ling Xue, however, didn’t take your advice to heart. From then on, you joined forces to fight in the secret realm, searching for opportunities. Accompanying Ling Xue, you became aware of her astonishing strength. Ling Xue, at just thirty years old, had reached the Profound Elixir Realm 3rd Tier Peak and comprehended the Great Perfection Water Spirit. She had also learned the
Heavenly Sea Country’s Inherited Divine Powers. Her strength was far beyond your level.]
[On the twenty-fifth day, you and Ling Xue found an opportunity and teamed up to defeat the guarding monster beast. However, you were attacked by Zhao Feng, a disciple of North Sun Sect from the Heavenly Sea Country, during the fight against the monster. In order to protect you, Ling Xue was seriously injured.]
[You were both shocked and angered, attacking Zhao Feng. However, Zhao Feng coldly laughed at your attempt, treating you like an ant and completely ignoring you. Your attack was easily intercepted by one of Zhao Fengs followers, leading to a fierce battle. Although you had the advantage in Profound Elixir Tier and spirit comprehension, the gap in cultivation levels kept you from defeating him.]
[Ling Xue also fought fiercely against Zhao Feng. The Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family and the North Sun Sect, the first Great Sect, had longstanding grievances, but the Royal Family did not want to start an open war and have other forces take advantage of them. However, Ling Xue didn’t expect Zhao Feng to dare attack her, attempting to take her life.]
