[For the first time, you saw Ling Xue enraged, like a Female Valkyrie, using her full power. Despite being injured by the ambush, she still suppressed Zhao Feng. Even when Zhao Feng unleashed his full strength, Ling Xue effortlessly dominated him.]
[Witnessing this scene, you were deeply shocked, realizing that Ling Xue was even stronger than you had imagined. At the same time, it was the first time you had witnessed the power of Divine Skills.]
[Both Ling Xue and Zhao Feng were using Divine Skills, and their incredible power was astonishing. Through analyzing the situation, you concluded that Ling Xue, who was only at the Profound Elixir Realm 3rd Tier Peak, could exert the terrifying power to kill ordinary 7th Tier Profound Elixir Realm cultivators after using her Divine Skills.]
[And you were well aware that the two of them had only inherited the Divine Skills from their predecessors, rather than comprehending them on their own. Hence, they could only be called Pseudo Divine Skills. Even so, they could still unleash such terrifying power. You couldn’t imagine the extent of the horrifying power those true monsters could unleash by using their self-comprehended Divine Skills..]

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 123: Astonishing Reward! A Firstgrade Opportunity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 123: Astonishing Reward! A Firstgrade Opportunity!
Translator: 549690339
[A long while later, you finally come back to your senses, sighing in your heart, thinking that the gap between different geniuses might be even larger than the gap between a genius and an ordinary person. The world of true geniuses, those protagonists of the era, is probably something you won’t be able to reach in this lifetime.]
[Zhao Feng was suppressed, feeling extremely stifled, and his Tao Heart was somewhat unstable. However, when Ling Xue was about to kill Zhao Feng, the
shadow of Life Death Realm Master appeared, blocking Ling Xue’s attack. The terrifying pressure swept across the entire scene, and you felt a deadly pressure.]
[Nevertheless, Ling Xue sneered coldly, and another shadow of a Life and Death Realm Master appeared as well. The two Master shadows confronted each other. In the end, the shadow of the North Sun Sect Master rescued Zhao Feng, the heir of the North Sun Sect and his followers, and the battle came to a halt.]
[As the shadows of the two Life and Death Realm Masters disappeared, you finally breathed a sigh of relief and your body relaxed. At the same time, you sighed inwardly, realizing the gap between you and these Major Sect
Successors. Not only were they exceptionally talented, but their Cultivation
Skills and Martial Arts were also very powerful. They could even cultivate
Divine Skills, backed up by the protection of Life and Death Realm Masters.]
[Even if some loose cultivators were able to compete with these young geniuses in terms of combat power and even kill them, what then? These powerful individuals had various hidden trump cards; the moment they revealed one, it would be enough to kill a loose cultivator.]
[In this day and age, one’s background is of great importance. Without a solid foundation, one truly treads on thin ice in the World of Cultivators.]
[As you were feeling disheartened, Ling Xue clicked her tongue, annoyed that she couldn’t eliminate Zhao Feng, the despicable sneak attacker. You snap back to reality and point out that it’s difficult to kill someone with a powerful master guarding them.]
[Ling Xue nodded in agreement, stating that she could forcefully kill him, but it wasn’t necessary. A single Zhao Feng posed no threat to her and the Heavenly Sea Country. However, if she killed him now, the North Sun Sect would likely go berserk.]
[After some reflection, you recalled the Hundred Dynasties War and understood the potential troubles of killing a Major Sect Successor at this time. After all, Zhao Feng would surely participate in the Hundred Dynasties War. Even if the other sect heirs weren’t carefully nurtured by the Holy Land, at most, they would assume the position of a Deacon.]
[However, even if they didn’t enter the core circle of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, fighting against many geniuses from the Sword Domain during the Hundred Dynasties War would bring them significant benefits, increasing their chances of breaking through to the Life and Death Realm. If they performed exceptionally well, it would bring countless benefits to the North Sun Sect, allowing them to make a name for themselves in the entire Sword Domain.]
[If Zhao Feng died, it would be inevitable that the North Sun Sect would be enraged, possibly leading to a major war.]
[Of course, you were also aware that the upcoming inheritance of the Nirvana Realm Masters peerless treasure, the Nirvana Heart, would cause the Yin and Yang Masters and even the Life and Death Realm Masters to fight like mad. During this process, several Life and Death Realm Masters would even fall. Therefore, in reality, killing Zhao Feng wasn’t an insurmountable issue.]
[Naturally, you knew that such thoughts should not be spoken aloud, so you kept them buried deep within your heart, not daring to express them openly. Ling Xue sensed your concerns but didn’t inquire further.]
[Subsequently, you and Ling Xue continued to explore the secret realm and made some more gains. You successfully broke through to the 2nd Tier Profound Elixir Realm, further enhancing your combat power. Meanwhile, Ling Xue advanced to the 4th Tier Profound Elixir Realm, reaching the mid- stage of the Profound Elixir Realm, greatly increasing her combat power.]
[Not long after, you and Ling Xue heard huge movements coming from the depths of the Purple Moon Secret Realm. The terrifying energy fluctuations and Divine Skills spread out, affecting a vast area. Ling Xue was shocked, not expecting such an uproar, and wondered what opportunities had arisen.]
[In your heart, a chill ran down your spine, knowing that the real battle had just begun. During this process, Ye Chen would directly pick the peaches off these powerful individuals and leave in a relaxed manner.]
[Ling Xue, excited, suggested going to watch the battle. You recalled the events concerning the fierce competition among the great masters from your memory, which led to the deaths of many Profound Elixir Realm masters due to the aftereffects. You knew that getting too close would likely result in a gruesome death and quickly objected.]
[Ling Xue understood your worry, stating that you wouldn’t approach too closely and that she possessed treasures for self-protection, so she wouldn’t join the fight. Unable to dissuade Ling Xue and recalling her safe survival and impressive performance in the Hundred Dynasties War, you decided to accompany Ling Xue to watch the battle, eager to witness the epic clash between the Yin and Yang Masters and the Life and Death Realm Masters.]
[The two of you arrived at a place far from the battleground. Ling Xue used a secret skill to observe the situation from afar, clearly seeing the fighting scene, You marveled at Ling Xue’s many abilities, recognizing that she was indeed the Princess of the Heavenly Sea Nation and that her talents were beyond comparison to ordinary loose cultivators.]
[Subsequently, you witnessed the terrifying battle and the various Divine Skills unleashed to their full power in their hands. You speculated that if the
Life and Death Realm Masters were on Earth, they might be considered 9th Tier Experts, capable of cleansing the surface of the Earth in a short period of time, possessing a horrifying combat power.]
[Soon after, you saw the various powerful individuals unleash their full strength, using numerous forbidden techniques and killing moves, one after another. The usually rare Yin and Yang Masters began to fall one by one, even Life Death Realm Masters who were involved in the chaos started to take a hit, turning the sky blood red.]
[Ling Xue’s expression grew heavy upon seeing this scene, and even her usually cheerful demeanor was somber. She realized that something was wrong – the powerful individuals from all sides seemed to be deliberately joining forces, surrounding and attacking her ancestral master..]

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 123: Astonishing rewards! Ist-tier opportunity! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 123: Astonishing rewards! Ist-tier opportunity! _2
Translator: 549690339
[Keep in mind that although the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s royal family is the strongest, other forces within the country are not weak. For example, the North Sun Sect has Life and Death Realm Masters, but there are only two such old monsters in the sect, while the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s royal family has four Life and Death Realm Masters.]
[However, even if the Purple Moon Secret Realm is open, it is impossible for all the Life and Death Realm Ancestors of the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s royal family to come out. Therefore, only two Life and Death Realm Masters have come this time, while the North Sun Sect, together with the Fengyuan Gate, which also has Life and Death Realm Masters sitting there, plus a loose cultivator from outside the Heavenly Sea Kingdom who is also a Life and Death Realm Master, can be described as a three-on-two battle. This situation is very unfavorable.]
[Although Ling Xue was anxious, she couldn’t help at all, so she could only watch. Then, you saw Ye Chen, who suddenly appeared with a changed face, burst out terrifying power, broke into the battlefield when several Life and Death Realm Masters released their final moves, broke the Great Array, took away the Nirvana Realm Inheritance and the Nirvana Fruit, and went away leisurely.]
[All of the Masters were furious, but they could only watch as Ye Chen left. Because the Yin and Yang Masters couldn’t catch up, the Life and Death Realm Masters could only take care of themselves just after using their ultimate moves.]
[In the end, two Life and Death Realm Masters of the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s royal family perished, and the remaining three Life and Death Realm Masters also suffered extremely severe injuries.]
[You looked in the direction of Ye Chen’s departure, and your heart began to stir. Although you know that you may not be able to get the Nirvana Fruit, if you let Ye Chen give it to you for a touch, it may have a huge benefit for you’.]
[For this reason, you parted ways with Ling Xue and went after Ye Chen’s footsteps. This time, you were very lucky, or perhaps Ye Chen had already noticed your presence and was waiting for you. You successfully found Ye
Chen.]
[After some pleasantries with Ye Chen, you expressed your desire to take a look at the Nirvana Fruit. Ye Chen hesitated for a moment, but finally took it out. He trusted you and didn’t think you would snatch it. Of course, the bigger reason was that he felt that even if you had any ideas, it would be impossible for you to snatch the Nirvana Fruit under his watch.]
[You were pleasantly surprised, and as you looked at the Nirvana Fruit, you touched it under Ye Chen’s gaze, then quickly let go. Then you said that seeing such a treasure is enough for your journey.]
[Next, Ye Chen invited you to leave the Purple Moon Secret Realm together, and after thinking it over, you didn’t choose to go with Ye Chen. You knew very well that if you were with Ye Chen in his current situation, you would likely become cannon fodder and die without leaving any trace.]
[After you refused Ye Chen, you began to act on your own. However, it didn’t take long before you ran into the furious Yin Yang Mirror Master. Because of the lingering aura of the Nirvana Fruit on your body, he wanted to capture you alive for interrogation. Knowing that you were in trouble, you immediately activated your Berserk State and chose self-destruction.] [Because of your death, the simulation ends.]
“Good guy, interacting with Ye Chen really doesn’t end well.”
Wang Pings eyes looked strange.
“However, not even a Saint Son could necessarily condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, so I’m in trouble now.”
Wang Ping remembered this problem and felt a headache.
It seemed a bit unrealistic for him to try to condense a Ist-tier or Flawless Profound Elixir.
“It doesn’t seem impossible.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and started thinking.
In this simulation, his touching of the Nirvana Fruit was obviously intended to help him get rewards.
If he could really get the rewards, then that would be awesome.
Perhaps he could use the Nirvana Fruit to condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir.
Even if it wasn’t a Ist-tier, a 2nd-Tier should be within reach.
As long as he reached the 2nd Tier, with the help of the group score enhancement, it would definitely be possible to reach the Ist-tier.
“Thinking about it this way, I don’t think I need to worry. After all, I have group points. Group points can enhance various things, and it’s not impossible to enhance a Profound Elixir. Of course, if I use the group points more reasonably, I should enhance my Bone and Root Aptitude instead.”
Wang Pings eyes shone with determination, muttering to himself.
Then, Wang Pings vision changed, showing the scene where Wang Ping in the simulation was caught by the Yin Yang Mirror Master and was forced to self-destruct.
Soon, his vision returned to normal.
Next, the system prompt sounded.
“Ding, reward generation successful, you can choose one from the following rewards:
1.2nd Tier Profound Elixir Realm cultivation.
Nirvana Fruit.
Green Talent: Super Speed Regeneration.
Combat Experience.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward and couldn’t help but blurt out an expletive.
Although he had this idea, he never expected that the reward would actually appear.
The Nirvana Fruit was really refreshed!
This thing is a world-shocking treasure medicine, which can only appear in the place where a Nirvana Realm Master dies. Even Life and Death Realm Masters would go crazy for it, fighting to the death for it. Its value is terrifying to the extreme.
As an 8-tier Alchemist, he naturally knew about all kinds of strange things in the world.
The Nirvana Fruit is said to enable a person to achieve Nirvana rebirth, regenerating flesh and bone from death. Furthermore, it can greatly increase a person’s Bone and Root Aptitude and martial arts foundation, and even allow them to obtain some Nirvana Skill, making their recovery ability extremely terrifying.
If he could swallow the Nirvana Fruit before condensing the Profound Elixir, Wang Ping felt that the probability of him condensing a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir was really high..

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 123 Astonishing Reward! First-class Opportunity! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 123 Astonishing Reward! First-class Opportunity! _3
Translator: 549690339
Moreover, the recovery ability brought by the Nirvana Fruit was definitely much stronger than the Green Talent: Super Speed Regeneration.
This time, he had indeed been extraordinarily lucky.
“System, I choose option 2!”
Excited, Wang Ping hastily made his choice.
In an instant, Wang Ping felt an additional golden, strange fruit appear in his Storage Ring.
However, this time the Life Simulator was very considerate. It even provided a Jade Box to store it, preventing it from losing potency.
Looking at the Nirvana Fruit, Wang Ping found it hard to calm his excitement.
However, Wang Ping clearly knew that in this task world, it was not the time to upgrade, and it would be too wasteful to consume it in reality.
As long as he did not consume it, he would have this treasure every time during the simulation and could use it repeatedly. That would be the most satisfying.
Wang Ping opened his eyes, smiling broadly.
“Mr. Wang, you seem pretty happy. What good news have you received?” Seeing Wang Pings cheerful smile, Qin Tian was curious.
“Haha, I will soon break into the Profound Elixir Realm, it’s not a big deal.”
Wang Ping replied, laughing.
“Profound Elixir Realm….” Qin Tian’s face twitched.
Damn it, he was fooled by Mr. Wang.
“The Profound Elixir Realm, you should have a Seven-Star Combat Power, right?”
Ye Xiaofan exclaimed in surprise.
“Once I have made a breakthrough, I should have it. Even if not, it will be almost seven stars.’
Wang Ping nodded.
The Seven Star Tier is rated at the Nation-Destroying Tier. Wang Ping was unsure whether he would reach there after his breakthrough.
However, there should be a fair amount of hope.
“I’m so jealous.” Qin Tian muttered.
As for Chen Si and Zhao Sihan, they didn’t know much about the level of the world where Wang Ping was in. They just looked over curiously.
Let’s not even talk about Lin Qiuqiu. She didn’t know anything about what the Profound Elixir Realm or Seven-Star were.
“How is your research going?”
Wang Ping asked.
“Research what, we don’t have a super hacker in our group.” Qin Tian muttered: “I prefer soul-searching than searching online.”
“Um, if you want to know any information, you can ask me. My brother is a high-potential ability user, and he knows a lot.”
Lin Qiuqiu gently suggested. “No need.’
Wang Ping shook his head.
This world is ultimately different from Wang Shuqi’s world. They are not dealing with hidden strange entities, but enemies that only know destruction. They didn’t need to know too much.
They just needed to know when they would arrive.
Kill them, complete the mission, and leave. It’s as simple and straightforward as that.
“System, I want to go for the free simulation.” After some thought, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice echoed.
Then, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text came into view.
[On the first day, you quietly waited. On the second day, a massive canine monster appeared from a spatial crack in the sky above your city.]
[Its appearance shocked all the people in this big city and attracted global attention. Upon seeing it, every person’s body began to twist and deform, growing scales and turning into similar monsters.]
[Even Lin Qiuqiu, Chen Si, and Zhao Sihan transformed into monsters instantly when they saw it, forcing you to kill them.]
[As for Qin Tian, he resisted the transformation due to his cultivation level but started to mutate. On the other hand, Ye Xiaofan was the most normal one. His Sacred Body was resistant to the curse, and he was largely unaffected.]
[As for you, you avoided abnormalities thanks to your stronger cultivation. But you knew that if you continued to stare, something would definitely go wrong. So, you yelled at Qin Tian, asking him to stop looking.]
[Qin Tian was startled and hastily closed his eyes, daring not look again.]
[Next, you let Qin Tian teleport Ye Xiaofan away. You rose into the sky and engaged the monster from the Abyss Lands in a fierce duel. The remnants from your fight destroyed the entire city below.]
[The monster from the Abyss Lands was extremely powerful. Even with your full strength, it was hard to kill it. Gradually, you fell into a disadvantage. In the end, you severely wounded it by fighting recklessly and sacrificing your own wellbeing. After resurrecting once with the Rebirth tally and going all out again, you finally killed it completely.]
[After killing it, you were overwhelmed and started to mutate due to the curse.
You regretted not creating the 8-tier Breaking Disaster Elixir in advance.]
[Therefore, you had to return to your original world swiftly and plan to consume the Nirvana Fruit. Although you felt it was a great waste, you had no other choice.]
[With your return, this simulation ended.]
“Uh, 1 managed to complete all tasks in one go, this is the first time this has happened….”
Wang Ping’s feelings were somewhat complicated.
However, he soon became relieved.
After all, though the monsters from the Abyss Lands were terrifying and strong, they were still incomparable to the strange entities.
One annoying quality of the strange entities was their ability to hide, needing you to find out who the strange entity was.
But in the face of these monsters, if your strength was sufficient, you could easily resolve the situation.
“Mr. Wang, how did it go?”
Seeing Wang Ping open his eyes again, Qin Tian asked impatiently.
“l now know the abilities of the monster from the Abyss Lands and how to deal with it. Moreover, I have the power to kill it..”

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 123 Astonishing Reward! First-class Opportunity! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 123 Astonishing Reward! First-class Opportunity! _4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian and the others and spoke.
“Of course, in this simulation, Chen Si and the others died because of the monster’s power, so it was tough for me. We still need to find a way to get through without any injuries.” After a pause, Wang Ping spoke again.
“That’s how it is…
Qin Tian breathed a sigh of relief and showed a smile after hearing this.
As long as they could pass the mission, it was a good thing.
Regarding casualties, he believed Wang Ping could solve this problem as well.
“Dead, huh…” Chen Si r s face turned slightly pale.
Having such a strong team leader dead, this mission was too dangerous.
“Don’t panic, my dear ladies. As long as Mr. Wang still has usage times for his ability, we have plenty of chances to try and fail.” Qin Tian comforted with a smiling face.
“That’s a relief.” Chen Si and the other girls relaxed.
“Let me simulate again.”
Wang Ping nodded and activated the free simulation again.
[On the first day, you took action and found a way to evacuate the people in the city in advance.]
[On the second day, you waited for the monster to appear. You had countermeasures in advance, used the Great Array to isolate the breath, and let Chen Si use her power to weaken the monster. Then Qin Tian teleported Chen Si and the others away from the scene.]
[You fought the monster in a fierce battle. Because the monster’s combat power was forcibly weakened by Chen Si, you managed to kill it relatively easily without wasting the resurrection ability of the Rebirth Tally.] [You successfully completed the mission and left the world happily.]
[Due to your departure, the simulation ends.]
“As long as you know the enemy’s abilities, there are plenty of ways to deal with them.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and could not help but smile.
When they saw Wang Pings smile, Qin Tian and the others also showed their smiling faces, knowing that this group task was basically a sure thing.
“Great, no casualties, a perfect pass.” Wang Ping swept his gaze over everyone and chuckled.
“Hehe, Mr. Wang, you’re truly invincible!” Qin Tian grinned and showed a thumbs-up.
“Stop flattering me. We have things to do now.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes, repeated the simulation content, and then spoke.
Upon hearing Wang Ping’s words, Lin Qiuqiu was stunned. A chill ran from the soles of her feet along her spine to the top of her head.
This was way too dangerous.
The monster easily destroyed a city upon its appearance, turning all the people into monsters.
If Wang Ping and the others hadn’t shown up, would she not have turned into a disgusting monster and then died completely?
Just thinking about it made Lin Qiuqiu’s scalp numb, and she felt grateful for the appearance of Wang Ping and the others.
Zhao Sihan was also shocked.
Such a strong team leader died once. It was too dangerous.
“Mr. Wang, what do you plan to do?” Ye Xiaofan asked meaningfully. “What else can we do? Use a strong power to make people believe what I say and let the Profound Country’s authorities cooperate with our actions.” Wang Ping glanced at Ye Xiaofan and calmly said.
He believed that, in the simulation, he must have also used this simple and crude method to solve the problem.
After all, he didn’t have much time to waste.
And the monster wouldn’t give them much time either.
“l agree. That’s the best way.” Ye Xiaofan nodded. “In that case, let’s take action. I’ll be back in a moment.’
Wang Ping nodded and spoke.
As the words fell, Wang Ping flew away directly.
Profound Country, Spiritual Skill Bureau.
The Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau looked at the scenery outside the window, feeling worried.
Though they knew about the spiritual revival beforehand and took various measures in advance, they still didn’t know what the world would become after the revival or how many people would die. He wasn’t particularly optimistic about it.
After all, at this point in time, the number of mutated animals in the wild was increasing. Although the military currently suppressed them, it might not work when these creatures further mutated and become immune to modern weaponry.
He wanted to train martial artists as soon as possible to face the challenges of the New Era.
But the current cultivation skills were not perfect and still in the theoretical stage. They could make people practice, but the effects were minimal.
At the moment, human extraordinary power still relied on awakened individuals and ability-users. However, there were too few awakenings, and it was entirely dependent on luck.
As a result, there was a shortage of combat power.
Humans were racing with the Death God.
“If humanity had a perfect martial system and evolved faster than those creatures, we could usher in a brilliant New Era instead of facing extinction,” sighed the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau..

chapters.title: Chapter 270 124: The Battle that Shook the World! Red Talent! (10,000-word chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 270 Chapter 124: The Battle that Shook the World! Red Talent! (10,000-word chapter)
As the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau was troubled, there was a sudden knock on the door.
"Come in."
At this, the Director's expression returned to normal, and he spoke.
The door was pushed open, and his deputy walked in, bringing Wang Ping with him.
The Director gazed at Wang Ping, looking slightly startled, not knowing who Wang Ping was and why he would be personally brought here by the deputy Director.
"Zhang, who is this young man?"
The Director stood up, asking in surprise.
"My name is Wang Ping. I am a transmigrator from another world, and my goal in seeking you out is to request that you do something."
The deputy didn't answer Wang Ping's question, but left in a somewhat confused manner, closing the door behind him, while Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
"A transmigrator?"
The Director frowned, his eyes becoming strange.
His deputy's demeanor just now had clearly been hypnotized or controlled.
Since the other party could do such a thing in the Spiritual Skill Bureau, it meant that their ability had already reached the point where it could ignore all the awakened within the Spiritual Skill Bureau.
However, since the other party had no intention of taking action against him, the Director wasn't afraid of anything either.
It's just that what Wang Ping said made him feel somewhat subtle and unable to accept it.
Wang Ping noticed the Director's gaze, and without saying anything more, his figure flashed a little, casually forming a hand seal, and poured a series of information into the Director's brain.
This method was much more straightforward and simple than speaking.
Wang Ping didn't want to waste too much breath on this matter.
"Transmigrators... world-ending monsters."
After the Director absorbed the additional information in his mind, his heart shook to the extreme, and although he still had many doubts about Wang Ping's words, he chose to believe seventy percent of it.
"If you are a cultivator from another world, I have an unkind request."
The Director hesitated for a moment and spoke.
"You want a cultivation method, I can give it to you."
Wang Ping looked at him and spoke indifferently.
"However, in return, you must focus on cultivating a junior of mine in the future. In this world, there has always been an equivalent exchange. What I give you, you must repay with a matching return in training her."
For Wang Ping, the cultivation method was given away as soon as it was handed out.
Even if he didn't give it away, he believed that Zhao Sihan would bring it out in the chat group after knowing the difficulties of this world.
In this case, it's better for him to bring it out and instruct the Director on some matters to secure more resources and protection for his Junior Transmigrators.
Although this was a world of spiritual revival, Wang Ping wouldn't underestimate it.
Perhaps the potential of this world was high, and it was just at its beginning stage.
As for whether or not the world would go astray because of the Cultivation System he provided, it didn't concern him.
Even if it did go astray, they could just change it back in the future when a more suitable system for their world emerged. He believed in the wisdom of the people of this world.
As for the Cultivation System he provided, it would suffice to get them through the difficult early years.
"Thank you very much!"
The Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau showed a grateful expression.
"So, what kind of cultivation system do you want?"
Wang Ping smiled faintly and asked.
"Uh, are there many types?"
The Director showed a shocked expression.
In their world, finding a single cultivation system was already so difficult, yet Wang Ping knew multiple cultivation systems?
However, the Director soon realized that he had asked a foolish question.
The man before him was a transmigrator, traveling between different worlds to save them-how could he only be familiar with one system of power?
"I'm sorry, it was a foolish question." The Director smiled bitterly.
"Your purpose for seeking me out isn't just about these matters, is it?"
The Director asked seriously.
He didn't believe that Wang Ping had come to see him just to pass on martial arts and secure benefits for his Junior Transmigrators in this world.
"Tomorrow, a monster will appear in your world. Its presence will turn all the humans in the city it emerges in into monsters, and it itself possesses a Terrifying Skill. A single strike from it is enough to level an international metropolis, or even a mountain range. It's not something that the humans of your world can handle-even nuclear weapons wouldn't be able to kill it."
Wang Ping nodded and said calmly.
"We've come to this world to deal with it."
At these words, the Director's expression changed instantly, and cold sweat poured down.
No wonder a transmigrator like Wang Ping appeared in his world-it turned out to be like this.
A monster capable of destroying a mountain range in a single blow was truly horrifying.
Faced with such a monster, humans at this stage indeed couldn't handle it.
"So, the reason I'm here is to ask you to evacuate the humans of that city in advance to prevent them from being turned into monsters. I will then take care of the monster myself."
Wang Ping looked at the Director and spoke lightly.
"On behalf of all humanity, I am grateful for your arrival in our world and your help in exterminating the monster."
The Director took a deep breath, saluted Wang Ping solemnly and spoke earnestly.
"Hmm," Wang Ping nodded and smiled, "Director, you won't mind the destruction of a city, will you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter)_2
Translator: 549690339
The Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau’s expression stiffened, and he forced a bitter smile.
Although he really wanted to say that he minded, he minded very much.
The destruction of a metropolis would cause huge economic losses and many homeless people.
But considering the horror of the monster, Wang Ping would undoubtedly be risking his life in the battle. If he said he minded and asked Wang Ping to find another battlefield, it would be quite inappropriate.
“You can fight with all your might, no need to worry about the destruction of a city,” the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau sighed.
“Then there’s no problem,” Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Next, after Wang Ping left some inheritance of the Cultivation System, he left the place.
At the same time, Wang Ping also talked about Zhao Sihan’s situation.
With the director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau present, Zhao Sihan’s future life should be very comfortable.
Of course, Wang Ping would not let Zhao Sihan get complacent.
Although he did not want the group members to die, each member was a valuable combatant and could continuously earn him group points. However, he would not tolerate Zhao Sihan becoming complacent.
If that were the case, it would be a waste of his efforts.
“Which path should I choose among so many cultivation systems?”
After Wang Ping left, the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau was having difficulty choosing.
“Hm, I guess I’ll take them all,” the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau made a decision. ,
Next, the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau began his actions.
Lin Qiuqiu’s Hope Citys residents were all notified, they must evacuate the city with the cooperation of the military.
For a time, it caused a huge commotion.
As the spiritual revival was already exposed, everyone was anxious or looking forward to the future.
This sudden large-scale official action, evacuating city residents, really made people think wildly.
National panic was inevitable.
Even the eyes of the entire world were focused on Hope City, and the heads of other countries started contacting Profound Country to ask what they had discovered.
However, Wang Ping wasn’t concerned about the developments in the world. They stayed in the skyscrapers of Hope City, waiting quietly for the monsters from the Abyss Lands to appear.
At the same time, they looked down at the city, watching the 10-million-level population evacuate one by one, feeling a lot of emotion.
Before the crisis, ordinary humans were really too insignificant and could only drift along.
At least they had appeared, otherwise, all these people would have died.
Sunset and sunrise, the next day arrived, and the bright sunlight illuminated the earth and the city.
The once prosperous and bustling Hope City had now become empty and eerily quiet, no longer having the noise of the past, like a dead city.
At this moment, countless people focused on Hope City.
The satellites of other countries were also silently watching this place, trying to see what would happen to Hope City.
“Meow…”
Zhao Sihan meowed nervously in the arms of the already evacuated Lin Qiuqiu, watching the live broadcast.
She is now very weak and will only hinder her progress, so Wang Ping let her follow Lin Qiuqiu and leave.
“Brother Wang, it seems that some people still haven’t evacuated,” Qin Tian looked down at the city, with his powerful Spiritual Sense scanning the city and frowned.
“Even with the army’s involvement, it’s difficult to evacuate tens of millions of people in one day, and they’ve already done well enough. The people who stayed behind didn’t believe in the situation and refused to leave. Therefore, they will lose their lives here,” Wang Ping said calmly. Qin Tian nodded and didn’t say anything more.
*Crack! *
At this moment, the sky shattered like glass, as if some terrifying monster had broken through the spatial barrier and tried to invade this world.
This horrifying scene made everyone watching the satellite live stream turn pale, showing fearful expressions.
“Has it started?” The Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau took a deep breath, murmuring to himself.
Evacuating tens of millions of people from a city was not a small matter, especially in the current time of spiritual revival, mutated beasts frequently appeared in the wild, making things even more troublesome.
He had borne a lot of pressure to accomplish these tasks.
Now that things were happening as Wang Ping predicted, he was relieved.
However, as long as monsters truly invaded, he could only hope that Wang Ping could kill them, or else humanity would be doomed.
This was also the reason he arranged the satellite live broadcast.
Such a thing couldn’t be concealed.
Since it couldn’t be hidden, there was no need to hide it. It was better to boldly use the satellites for global broadcasting and let everyone see hope.
Although Wang Ping and others would eventually leave, as long as Wang Ping appeared and killed such a terrifying monster, it would reassure everyone.
We, humans, have powerful people, invincible people. Even if the spiritual revival is intense, humanity can still be as firm as Mount Tai.
In the Chaotic Era, it is essential to have hope in mind. As long as there is hope, the evil thoughts of humans won’t burst out, and miracles can be created.
“Is it here?” Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, gazing at the sky and feeling the Terrifying Aura leaking from the Spatial Crack, mumbling to himself.
“Qin Tian, set up the formation. Chen Si, prepare to use your Golden finger. Ye Xiaofan, as a precaution, be ready to bleed,” Wang Ping said to the three.
Ye Xiaofan has a Sacred Body, which has a terrifying resistance to curses. In theory, his blood should also be effective against curses..

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter)_3
Translator: 549690339
That’s why he didn’t let Ye Xiaofan and Zhao Sihan leave.
“Understood.” The three answered one after another.
Qin Tian took out a powerful Array Plate and activated it directly, its range covering this area and isolating any trace of aura.
Ye Xiaofan directly cut open his artery, letting out his blood.
Chen Si r s palms were sweaty with nervousness, ready to activate the power of the Golden Finger at any moment.
“Crack! ”
At that moment, the sky shattered completely.
Under global attention, a dog-like beast shrouded in black fog, fifty meters in length, appeared in the sky.
Right after its appearance, people in the city saw this terrifying scene, cursed, sprouting scales or black hair, and turned into hideous monsters that howled.
With these howls of the mutated beasts, the ground cracked open and the glass of high-rise buildings shattered.
Some individuals were even mutated inside the buildings, erupting with power, causing the building to collapse and creating a horrifying scene.
Humans who were watching the live broadcast all turned white, their expressions filled with disbelief.
This gigantic beast hadn’t even attacked yet, but just seeing it turned people into monsters. And these monsters, transformed from humans, had reached a terrifying level of power, capable of casually destroying high-rise buildings.
Everybody’s scalp tingled, faces turned pale, hearts filled with fear.
It didn’t matter whether they were ordinary people, awakened ones, or elites from various countries. They all reacted the same.
“Chen Si, do it.’
Seeing that Chen Si had her eyes closed but seemed to be frightened by the
monster’s howl, Wang Ping couldn’t help but shout.
“l, I got it.” Chen Si bit her lip, quickly using the Golden Finger towards the sky, following the position Wang Ping had indoctrinated into her mind.
An enormous halo appeared in the sky covering the Abyss Dog.
In an instant, the Abyss Dogs aura suddenly dropped by half.
“Reducing the enemy’s fighting power by half directly, that’s too abnormal.” Qin Tian murmured, feeling the aura of the beast with his eyes closed.
Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to Qin Tian’s nonsense. He flew up into the sky, confronting the Abyss Dog.
The Abyss Dog was initially surprised that its strength had unexpectedly been reduced by half. But when it noticed Wang Ping, it quickly regained its composure. Its malicious eyes dead set on Wang Ping as if spreading a terrifying murderous intent.
“A Taoist from the Order Faction of Chaos? Your noses are even more sensitive than mine, you even knew in advance about my arrival.” The Abyss Dog howled, speaking human language.
“There’s nothing to talk about with a monster like you, die.”
Wang Ping said coldly.
Then, he mobilized the Five Element Spirit in his body, transforming it into the Fire Elemental Spirit. He wielded the Sea and Sky Staff in his hand, swinging it fiercely.
The Great Perfection’s Sword Spirit interweaved on it, and Wang Ping displayed the Sunset Sword Skill, as if a great sun had descended, wanting to annihilate everything.
“Roar! Humans, don’t think that suppressing half of my power allows you to contend with me.’
Faced with Wang Pings attack, the Abyss Dog roared and its massive claw shrouded in black fog smashed towards Wang Ping.
In an instant, the claw and Sunset collided, the Abyss Dogs claw was burned by Sunset and was also wounded by the intertwined Sword Spirit.
However, its recovery ability was astonishing. The wounds were visibly healing at an eye-popping rate.
However, the terrifying shockwave produced by their collision swept across the surroundings.
Under this terrifying shockwave, the clouds were scattered and a horrifying sonic boom rippled out in waves.
As for the city below, it unfortunately suffered the damage immediately, being instantly leveled to the ground, with all living beings instantly killed.
Not only was the city destroyed, the areas outside the city were also affected.
Fortunately, Qin Tian and the others had left early. Otherwise, they would have been within this shockwave. Even with the protection of the Array Mana, it would have been a tragic scene.
At this moment, humans worldwide who were watching the live stream were speechless, their faces full of shock.
For this moment, the world was more silent than ever before. Everyone watching this place was too scared to speak.
A large city was obliterated in an instant.
This was not a small county town, but an international metropolis.
This city was so effortlessly destroyed, and it wasn’t even intentionally destroyed by the fighting parties, but caused by the aftermath of their battle.
This completely shattered human’s worldview.
The nuclear weapons that humans took pride in seemed completely powerless in the face of this level of power.
They seriously doubted whether nuclear weapons could kill these types of monsters.
Most likely, it was impossible….
In an instant, all the complaints from the people who had been evacuated from Room H vanished, their hearts filled with relief only.
Luckily, luckily they got out.
Otherwise, they would either become monsters or be flattened to the ground along with the city by the aftermath, not even their bodies remaining whole.
“Is this truly a level of power humans can possess?”
The Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau was totally shocked, muttering to himself.
Then, he remembered the various cultivation systems Wang Ping had given him, and his heart was fired up again.
With this level of power, what counted as a mutated beast? Humanity would usher in its most glorious era!
“As expected of a creature from the Abyss Lands. Even when reduced to half strength by the Weaken spell, it’s taking quite a bit of effort to kill..”

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 124: The battle that shocked the world! Red talent! (10,000-word chapter) _4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping burst out with astonishing combat power, colliding fiercely with his opponent, his eyes shining brilliantly, and his fighting spirit soaring.
Truth be told, he rarely fought others in real life,
As a result, his combat experience was not that extensive.
This time, he could finally have a good fight.
However, using a stick to perform sword moves felt quite awkward.
As expected, he needed to get a sword-type profound instrument as soon as possible. Otherwise, it would limit his combat power.
“Human, is this your limit? With such meager combat power, you dare to think you can kill me?”
The Abyss Dog mocked Wang Ping, trying to make him lose his temper and throw him off balance. “Hehe, no need to goad me. I’ll cut you down.”
Wang Ping sneered.
Then, he directly used the secret skill from the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill.
Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill First Move Five Elements Gradient.
In an instant, the intensity of Wang Pings fire attribute spiritual essence increased exponentially, and his attack power surged several times stronger than before.
“Roar!”
Sensing the danger, the Abyss Dog roared and no longer used its powerful body to clash with Wang Ping. Instead, it spat out a thick, black beam of light that violently collided with Wang Pings attack.
In that moment, a terrifying explosion engulfed the area, causing the ground to sink and shatter the surrounding mountains and lands, creating an apocalyptic scene.
This spectacle made countless people’s scalps tingle.
Wang Pings body turned golden, and spiritual essence formed a protective shield around him, ensuring he wouldn’t be injured by the explosion’s aftermath.
At the same time, Wang Ping used another trump card, activating the Five Elements Spirit Body to become even more powerful.
He stepped on the Illusionary Dragon Movement Step Second Move, crossed through space as if it was nothing, and appeared in front of the Abyss Dog. He swung his stick down, aiming right at the enormous head of the dog.
The Abyss Dog didn’t expect Wang Ping to suddenly burst out with such astonishing speed and had no time to dodge. It took the full force of Wang Pings blow, its skull caving in and producing the cracking sound of breaking bones. A huge burnt sword mark also appeared.
Immediately after, the dogs entire body crashed into the ground, creating a massive crater.
“Human, you’ve enraged me! Don’t think that your speed can give you the upper hand.”
The Abyss Dog roared angrily, its body shrinking to about five meters in length before turning into a black light that charged towards Wang Ping.
Wang Ping sneered, using the heaven-tier inferior body movement skill Illusionary Dragon Step First Move, instantly creating a large number of indistinguishable afterimages, causing the Abyss Dog to hesitate.
It wanted to use its nose to sniff out Wang Pings real location, but Wang Ping had already taken that into consideration and isolated his own scent. “If I can’t tell the real one, I’ll just destroy them all!”
Angered, the Abyss Dog roared, and a large amount of black fog formed dog-like apparitions that charged towards the afterimages created by Wang Ping.
However, using this move greatly exhausted the dog, causing its power to weaken considerably.
“Hehe.’
As the Abyss Dog used that move, Wang Ping took advantage of the opportunity to strike again.
This time, Wang Ping directly used the Second Move of the Five Elements Spirit Fusion Skill, Five Elements Unification, raising his combat power to its peak.
Then, he unleashed his most powerful move.
In an instant, he performed the Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword, creating nine blood-colored sword spirits that appeared in an instant, striking the Abyss Dog and tearing its body apart.
As a heaven-tier superior martial skill, the Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword had extraordinary destructive power and the ability to corrode spiritual essence.
It could not only corrode spiritual essence but also most other types of energy within its range, though the effects varied in strength.
The defensive energy of the Abyss Dog was also weakened.
As a result, its body was torn apart by Wang Ping, severed into several sections, and its vitality gradually faded.
“Foolish savior, don’t think that by killing me, you can rest on your laurels.
Since the coordinates have been exposed, countless invaders will come, whether from my Abyss Lands or other powers. Although the big shots might not bother with coming to a world like this, it’s still a feast for beings like you and me,”
On the verge of death, the Abyss Dog didn’t show a hint of despair. Instead, it stared at Wang Ping and roared.
“Shut up.” Wang Ping frowned, and with a swing of his stick, he shattered the dogs skull completely.
To be on the safe side, Wang Ping added a finishing blow, burning the dogs body into ashes.
“Ding, the invading Abyss monster is dead. The group task is completed, and individual rewards have been issued. Group members may claim their rewards on the Group Reward Page.”
“Ding, the group task has been completed. Members can silently recite ‘return’ in their hearts to return to their own worlds. If they do not do so within twenty-four hours, the system will forcibly return them to their original worlds.’
Upon hearing the notification, Wang Ping showed a smile.
Only when the task completion notification rang out did Wang Ping finally confirm that the creature was completely dead. Otherwise, it would’ve undoubtedly held on stubbornly.
“I wonder how many group points I’ll get this time. Only if I get enough group points can I have a chance of forming a Flawless Profound Elixir.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered, and he pondered quietly.
Qin Tian and the others also heard the system’s notification, their faces filled with joy.
Especially Qin Tian, who had an even wider smile on his face.
It was true that participating in tasks with Mr. Wang was rewarding. Even though they didn’t contribute much, they could still earn some group points..

chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 124: The Battle that Shocked the World! Red Talent! (10,000-word chapter)_5
Translator: 549690339
Little by little, he has a promising future!
Next, Wang Ping didn’t go back directly but went to find Zhao Sihan and Lin
Qiuqiu. He planned to tell them about the Director of the Spiritual Skill Bureau, so that they could be mentally prepared to be intensively trained and not waste the resources he fought for.
At the same time, people all over the world also saw Wang Ping killing the monster through the satellite live broadcast. They all breathed a sigh of relief, feeling awe, excitement, and yearning for Wang Ping.
The power displayed by Wang Ping and the monster was already comparable to the gods in the myths.
If they could reach such a level after the spiritual revival, just thinking about it was exciting.
They were about to usher in a brand new era.
Of course, ordinary people were excited and thrilled after the shock, but the higher-ups of various countries were different.
It was not a good thing for them that there was such a monster in Profound Country that went beyond human imagination at this time.
“Thank you, Mr. Wang. We will work hard!”
After listening to Wang Pings words, Lin Qiuqiu’s face was full of admiration, and she thanked him sincerely.
Wang Ping not only saved her world but also helped her to fight for so many resources. She was truly grateful and respectful from the bottom of her heart.
Of course, Lin Qiuqiu also knew that Wang Ping did all of this primarily for Zhao Sihan, and she was just lucky to benefit from it.
For a moment, Lin Qiuqiu felt that her luck was simply too good.
Her brother is a powerful Awakener, and the three-colored cat he adopted turned out to be a transmigrator, through which she was able to gain the guidance of her predecessor transmigrators.
“Your world will ultimately be protected by yourselves. We can’t always arrive in advance. So, work hard to become stronger, and don’t play so casual anymore.”
Wang Ping seemed to be speaking to Lin Qiuqiu and the others, but in fact, he was speaking to Zhao Sihan.
If Zhao Sihan continued to live so casually and did not show the value of her golden finger, Wang Ping would not fight for any resources for her in the future, as it would not be worthwhile to cultivate her.
In the end, if there were no group tasks and Zhao Sihan encountered danger in this world, Wang Ping felt that the people in the group would not spend tens of thousands of group points to come and save her specifically.
As for accidental death, even fewer people would spend so many group points
to resurrect her.
This world is very realistic, especially in places like the Transmigrator Chat Group, where you have to show your value.
Wang Ping could give newbies one or two chances, get resources for them, help them become stronger quickly, but he would never cultivate freeloaders.
“I, I understand.” Lin Qiuqiu was somewhat embarrassed, while Zhao Sihan nodded with a bit of shame.
Indeed, after her transmigration and being adopted, she had never developed her golden finger nor thought about becoming stronger. She had been signing in, strengthening herself, and playing every day.
Honestly, if it weren’t for the sudden appearance of a monster from the Abyss Lands and the issuance of a Group Task, Zhao Sihan felt that she would continue to live such a carefree life.
Wang Ping nodded slightly without saying much, and silently recited “return” in his heart.
Then, Wang Pings figure disappeared, and he returned to his original world.
Qin Tian and the others also left this world one after another.
After Wang Ping returned, he immediately opened his Group Task Red Packet.
“Ding, congratulations on achieving 80% contribution value in this group task, rewarding you with 400,000 Group Points.”
“Ding, due to your role as the acting group master, congratulations on receiving an additional 50,000 Group Points reward.”
“A total of 450,000? Not bad.”
Wang Ping looked at the Group Points reward and nodded in satisfaction.
Although without Chen Si, he could still complete the task by risking his life and enjoy the task alone.
But it wasn’t necessary.
After all, that way of completing the task would consume a precious Rebirth
Tally.
Moreover, he would be hit by a curse and suffer severe damage.
Therefore, Chen Si’s presence and her role were essential.
“Now my Group Points have reached more than 1,050,000. I wonder if it can help me condense Flawless Profound Elixir.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
However, Wang Ping didn’t immediately try to break through but opened the chat page of the chat group, wanting to see the situation in the group.
Qin Tian (77): “Another 10,000 Group Points, I feel so comfortable, really comfortable. It’s great to follow Mr. Wang, eating and drinking well.”
Ye Xiaofan (74): “Envy, I only have a bottom reward of 1,000 Group Points.” Zhao Sihan (87): “I also have a bottom reward of 1,000 Group Points.
Qin Tian (77) @Chen Si (83): “Chen Si, how many Group Points did you get this time?”
Chen Si (83): “Seems like 90,000…”
Qin Tian (77): “90,000? Envy! Supporting type golden fingers are really good, even useful in high-level situations, and then brush contribution value!”
Chen Si (83): “But… I need 200,000 Group Points to revive my brother. Sad.jpg. ”
Wang Ping (66) @Chen Si (83): “200,000 Group Points? Considering the time Chen Kang has been dead, this isn’t much. Of course, this is also because Chen Kang was an ordinary person; otherwise, it would be a lot more, However, don’t be disheartened. With your golden finger, you just need to participate in a few more Group Tasks, and you’ll definitely save up 200,000 Group Points. Then, you can revive your brother..”

chapters.content:

Translator: 549690339
Zhang Jun (70): “Silently bubbling. It is worthy of Mr.Wang to complete the group task so quickly. However, I still suggest Chen Si to save group points and use them to become stronger, otherwise, even if you have the golden finger, you may still be a burden in the group task.”
Fang Yun (3): “Although Zhang Jun is a bit cold-blooded, what he said is quite reasonable. Becoming stronger is the most important thing!’
Cai Yonglong (1): “Fang Yun, there’s no need to diss Zhang Jun. Of course, becoming stronger is indeed the most important. In this regard, Fang Yun has also gained a deep insight, after all, he had a miserable death last time.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn it, Mr.Cai, you don’t love me anymore, you actually talk to me like this.’
Cai Yonglong (1): “Get lost, kid, when did I ever love you? Don’t come and mess with my eyes, thank you.”
Chen Si (83): “Thank you for your advice, I will work hard to become stronger!’
Wang Ping (66) @Chen Si (83): “Don’t waste the group points on directly
enhancing your combat power. As an 8-tier alchemist, I will cover your initial cultivation resources, and I can also refine some elixirs that can enhance your bone and root aptitude.”
Wu Yueming (79): “Wow, Mr. Wang is so generous!”
Xu Yi (84): “I’m so envious!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “It seems that Mr.Wang intends to train Chen Si into his own exclusive support assistant. Considering Chen Si’s abilities, it’s indeed a good choice!”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, I wish I was a girl, I wish I had a support-type golden finger.”
Fang Yun (3): “Mr.Wang, do you like men? If it’s for you, I’m not against it.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Fang Yun, are you a bit sick with your obsession with becoming stronger? Don’t be like that, I’m getting a little scared….”
Wang Ping (66): “Get lost. First, mute for ten minutes, then if you keep talking like this, mute for a day.”
Wang Ping helplessly gave Fang Yun a ten-minute mute with a full forehead of black lines.
Wu Jun (20): “Um, Mr.Wang, did you forget something? Resentful.jpg.”
Looking at Wu Jun’s popping up, Wang Ping was startled at first, and then felt a little embarrassed.
Damn, he seemed to have promised to let Wu Jun join the group task, but he forgot.
Wang Ping (66): “Ahem, I accidentally forgot. But it’s okay, I’ll definitely take you next time.”
Wu Jun (20): “There’s something a bit strange about ‘next time definitely.”
Qin Tian (77): “Laughing to death, even next time is not guaranteed!”
Liu Mei (15): “Has Mr.Wang also completed the task? That was fast.”
Wang Ping (66): “Liu Mei, how is the situation on your side, did you charm the reincarnators?”
Liu Mei (15): “Yes, I successfully completed the group task by charming the reincarnators. Although I didn’t eliminate them, the chat group still judged that I had completed the task. However, these reincarnators are quite difficult, even though they a_re only at the 2 Tier level, their various abilities make it hard for my 4th Tier self.”
Wang Ping (66): “l see, did you not use your charm skill at first?”
Liu Mei (15): “Yeah, I originally wanted to gain some combat experience through them, but they made me feel a bit embarrassed.”
Wang Ping (66): “A 4th-Tier fighting against a 2-Tier team is definitely a crushing victory; you probably just got a bit embarrassed but managed to kill
them in the end. Of course, this cannot deny the cooperation of the |reincarnators’ team. After all, reincarnators are all dancing on the edge of a knife, they won’t play individualistic heroes and the abilities they exchange are aimed at complementing the whole team.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Mr.Wang is absolutely right. Although we haven’t encountered any reincarnators yet, apart from a few lone rangers among them, their individual combat power is not too strong and their weaknesses are obvious. But they are very strong when fighting as a group, they can even defeat stronger opponents.”
Liu Mei (15): “Well… I was indeed a bit embarrassed by their abilities at first, but in the end, I was able to kill them with brute force. However, if I were to rate them, even a 3th-Tier might also capsize when facing them.”
Wang Ping (66): “That’s how it is. By the way, I’m a bit surprised that charm can also count as completing a group task.”
Liu Mei (15): “When reincarnators return to the Master Lord Tier Space, they will basically have any abnormal spells and abilities on their bodies cleaned up to prevent infiltration. However, my charm skill comes from the intrigue, which is not an ordinary charm and might be able to avoid regular detection in the Master Lord Tier Space. Perhaps this is the reason the chat group can judge that I completed the group task.”
Wang Ping was startled and thought it made sense.
Then, Wang Ping couldn’t help but ask in his heart, “Alpha, is that true?”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded: “Abilities are of different strengths. The abilities of intrigue are of a very high level and cannot be compared with ordinary abilities. Therefore, the Master Lord Tier Space’s regular detection cannot detect them.”
“Of course, if the Master Lord Tier Space conducts a super-normal detection, it might still find abnormalities on her.”
Alpha paused and continued explaining.
“l see. So you want Liu Mei to plant a chess piece in the Master Lord Tier Space. But isn’t that making her work for nothing? Your heart is really black.”
Wang Ping looked strange.
“First, I don’t have a heart, so there’s no such thing as a black heart.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“Secondly, the original intrigue should have been recycled. I only spent a lot of effort and wasted a lot of intrigue because the talent she awakened was very suitable for this skill, so I took the time to disassemble the intrigue and gave her part of it.”
Alpha said coldly.
“Do you think every group member can get the power of intrigue? That’s dreaming. ”
“1 see.”
Wang Ping nodded in understanding.
It seems that the power of intrigue is not something everyone can get; they were just overthinking it back then.
Then, Wang Ping @s the group members who are currently performing the task, such as Chen Yao, and after finding that they have not yet discovered the traces of the reincarnators in that world and still need to spend some time to complete the task, he lurked.
This time, having gained so many group points and also obtaining the Nirvana Heart, he should consider breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, life simulation start, talent refresh in progress…..’!
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the red talent…..”

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent:
True Dragon Form; Red Talent: Unstable Evolver; Green Talent: Array Genius.”
Red Talent: True Dragon Form: Those who possess this talent will match the true disciples of the Holy Land in Bone and Root Aptitude!
Red Talent: Unstable Evolver: After obtaining this talent, the host will have a low chance of triggering an evolution option at specific times, be it weapons, cultivation skills, physique, or profound elixirs. However, the direction of evolution may be either positive or negative.
Green Talent: Array Genius: With this talent, the host will gain a very powerful Array Mana talent.
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was startled as he looked at the talents refreshed this time.
He could not have predicted that he would refresh Red Talent this time.
Moreover, it was not just one Red Talent, but two!
His luck seemed to have rebounded from rock bottom to reach an unprecedented highpoint!
Furthermore, both of these Red Talents seemed very strong.
The Red Talent: True Dragon Form is meant to strengthen Bone and Root Aptitude. It can be said that it’s an evolved version of Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form.
The system also stated that possessing this talent would classify them at the level of a true disciple within the Holy Land.
In other words, with this Red Talent, he was finally not less talented than many true disciples of various Great Sects. He no longer had any significant shortcomings.
Having this Red Talent, in addition to obtaining the Nirvana Fruit, Wang Ping felt that his chances of condensing a Ist-tier Profound Elixir had greatly increased.
If he could condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, he could then use his group points to reach a Flawless Profound Elixir!
Then, in terms of foundation alone, he was confident that among all the
Heaven’s Chosen in the Purple Spirit Realm, those who could match him would not exceed his two hands.
Although being in the Profound Elixir Realm was just one of the stages in cultivation, and didn’t guarantee that he would become a great master or even a supreme ruler in the future, being able to perfect his foundation at this stage was something he could be proud of. The future seemed promising.
At that time, he would have the qualifications to join the ranks of unparalleled geniuses and compete against the Heaven’s Chosen Monsters of this era.
Even becoming one of the protagonist of this era was not impossible.
For a moment, Wang Ping found himself feeling quite elated, fantasizing about the future.
Anyway, Wang Ping had not imagined that this Red Talent would arrive so timely.
This time, he really maxed out his luck.
So much so, that he directly overlooked a very needed Green Talent: Array
Genius.
“However, this Red Talent: Unstable Evolver…..
Wang Ping quickly calmed down and looked at the second Red Talent.
Based on his numerous simulation experiences, he knew that the effect of a
Golden Finger with obvious side effects could indeed rank higher than its tier.
For example, the Demonic Talent brought by the last Demon Cultivation Chaos was definitely more than just ordinary blue in tier. Otherwise, with his situation at that time, he had no qualification to condense a 3rd Tier Profound Elixir.
“Evolution, huh. It reminds me of Wu Jun’s Talent: Unstable Factor. However, Wu Jun’s Golden Finger is much more abnormal than this, as it can affect countless probabilities. This Red Talent can only trigger evolution options when acquiring new things, and the probabilities seem to be still very low.” Wang Ping thought silently.
Honestly, in terms of lower limits, this Red Talent: Unstable Evolver was definitely not comparable to the Red Talent: True Dragon Form.
However, in terms of upper limit, Ping felt that this Red Talent:
Unstable Evolver could wildly beat the Red Talent: True Dragon Form.
The feeling of using this tool was at least at the level of Purple Talent, it was just that the triggering probability was low, and there might be adverse outcomes, so it was only classified as Red Talent.
“It’s so hard to make a decision.’
Wang Ping gave a bitter smile.
Before, he couldn’t refresh any Red Talent.
Now, he was able to get two at once, which made him perplexed and unable to make a choice due to his difficulty in choosing.
“We can’t focus only on the immediate interests, we must aim for the long-term. Although the Red Talent: True Dragon Form is very good and enables my Bone and Root Aptitude to compete with the True Disciples of the Holy Land, at what level of True Disciple am I competing with? There’s still a gap among the True Disciples.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, his eyes were firm, he made a decision.
“Judging from the Blue Talent: Hidden Dragon Form, it says that it can reach the level of a Major Sect Successor. But my current Bone and Root Aptitude, in the Great Sect, is probably not considered at the top level of successors, but is just at the average level at most.”
“The Red Talent: True Dragon Form will be replaced as my strength increases, and various opportunities in the world can also enhance my qualifications.
This Red Talent: Unstable Evolver might not be available if I don’t choose it!”
“So, there’s no need for hesitation!”
“System, I choose Red Talent: Unstable Evolver!” Wang Ping took a deep breath and shouted in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
As Wang Ping spoke, the system’s voice rang again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared, with characters floating out..

chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)_2
Translator: 549690339
[On the first day, after you calmed down, you wanted to take the Nirvana Fruit and make a breakthrough to the Profound Elixir Realm. However, in the end, you suppressed this impulse and did not choose to make the breakthrough.]
[After calming down, you thought of something; if you were to make a breakthrough at this moment, you might only be able to condense a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir instead of reaching the Ist-tier. After all, your cultivation skill is only at the Heavenly Mid-grade level, and there is still a gap compared to those practiced by Holy Land True Inheritance.]
[You thought of Ye Chen. If you could obtain the cultivation skills that Ye Chen had acquired from the Nirvana Realm Inheritance, perhaps you could take a step further and condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir.]
[Although doing so would undoubtedly waste several decades, you could afford to wait. As long as you could condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, waiting for a few decades would be worth it.]
[Next, you began to take planned actions. You didn’t have the idea to bring Cai Yonglong along to look for chances nor did you plan to teach him the Demonic Skill. You wanted to take it steady. As for cultivating Cai Yonglong, you would do it after becoming stronger, otherwise, it would be a bit unstable.]
[You were extraordinarily good to Ye Chen, fully cultivating him and planning for the Nirvana Realm Inheritance decades later.]
[You acted according to your memory, letting Ye Chen obtain the Life and
Death Realm Inheritance in the Seven Star Secret Realm and then parted ways.
Although Ye Chen wanted to team up with you, you chose to refuse.]
[Due to this, Ye Chen left you a copy of the Life and Death Realm Inheritance. You obtained the Heaven-tier Niartial Skills – Falling Stars Slash, and a few top-tier secret skills that only the Life and Death Realm could possess. The Top-tier Secret Skill – Star Attraction, when used, can attract the power of starlight, exponentially enhancing your strength with relatively minor side effects.]
[After you accepted the Life and Death Realm Inheritance given by Ye Chen, you felt that spending all those years fully cultivating Ye Chen was the right choice. This time, Ye Chen’s attitude towards you was undoubtedly different from that in your memory, treating you as a teacher just like Bai Tianhong.]
[Afterward, you and Cai Yonglong arrived at Heavenly Sea Country. In the blink of an eye, nearly twenty years passed, and you had already obtained a matching Profound instrument. Everything was ready. However, you did not plan to let Cai Yonglong enter the secret realm this time. You knew clearly that if he went in, he would only meet his doom.]
[Although Cai Yonglong was somewhat unwilling, he knew that with his current strength, entering the secret realm would most likely result in his death rather than obtaining any fortunes. Therefore, he wisely chose to give up on this Purple Moon Secret Realm journey.]
[After the Purple Moon Secret Realm opened, you entered it. This time, you knew how dangerous the Purple Moon Secret Realm was, so you didn’t try to find any opportunities but proceeded cautiously, not provoking anyone, and avoiding other cultivators as soon as you sensed their presence, not making any unnecessary contact.]
[Perhaps it was because of your fate with Ling Xue, you met her again. Knowing Ling Xue i s character, you took the initiative to befriend her. Ling Xue was very surprised, admiring your extraordinary demeanor and powerful aura, and was willing to be your friend.]
[Later, Ling Xue found out about your loose cultivator identity and was astonished at how far you had come. She invited you to join the Heavenly Sea Country, promising that the Ancestor would cultivate you, striving to let you condense a 3rd-tier Profound Pill. However, you chose to decline tactfully.]
[Ling Xue was somewhat disappointed, but she did not insist. Next, you and Ling Xue teamed up, making your journey much safer. This time, you also encountered an attack from Zhao Feng. Although your cultivation this time was much weaker than in your memory, you were well-prepared and didn’t need Ling Xue to rescue you.]
[In the end, Ling Xue displayed her divine might, killing Zhao Fengs followers in one blow and suppressing Zhao Feng, putting an end to the matter.]
[Several days later, the Nirvana Realm Inheritance and the Nirvana Fruit appeared in the world, causing a sensational battle. You went to check it out. Ye Chen picked the fruit, and you said goodbye to the anxious Ling Xue, following him.]
[Ye Chen was waiting for you, puzzled as to why your cultivation was still at the Half- step Profound Elixir Realm. You gave your answer, not wanting to condense a 3rd-tier Profound Elixir or lower. Ye Chen thought your idea was right.]
[Next, you mentioned your intention to touch the Nirvana Fruit again. Ye Chen didn’t doubt you and let you touch it briefly. Then, you prepared to leave and didn’t actively ask for the Nirvana Realm Inheritance.]
[However, Ye Chen stopped you, voluntarily copying a portion of the Nirvana
Realm Inheritance and giving it to you. It was a powerful skill known as the Wind and Thunder Skill, which could control the forces of wind and thunder and has a Heaven-tier nonsuch grade. In addition, Ye Chen also entrusted you with the Divine Skill – Wind and Thunder Palm Imprint from the Nirvana Realm Inheritance.]
[You were shocked, not expecting it to be a Heaventier nonsuch skill, truly powerful. You also didn’t hypocritically refuse the skill and chose to accept it.]
“Good guy, Ye Chen, I’ve really wronged you. Putting aside the fate of the Heavenly Lone Star, you’re really my wealth-bringing boy.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a strange expression.
It was Ye Chen who had let him obtain the Nirvana Fruit and gave him the Nirvana Realm Inheritance. This was simply more than generous.
One could say that without Ye Chen, Wang Ping didn’t know how much longer he would have to struggle before possibly condensing a Ist-tier Profound Elixir.
Perhaps, in the end, he would only be able to condense a 3rd-tier Profound Elixir and then slowly use a large amount of group points to reach the Ist-tier or Flawless Profound Elixir..

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)_3
Translator: 549690339
If so, it would be a huge loss.
Immediately after, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Then, you curiously asked Ye Chen about the grade of the Profound Elixir he condensed. After hesitating slightly, Ye Chen still told you. He had condensed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. However, with the obtained Nirvana Fruit this time, he can use the Nirvana Skill of the fruit to make up for the deficiency of the Profound Elixir and elevate it to the level of the Flawless Profound Elixir.]
[You were shocked and asked if the Nirvana Fruit had such an effect. Ye Chen gave a positive answer. The Nirvana Fruit is not born in every place where a Nirvana Realm Master dies. Only when a Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier master dies, there is a tiny probability that this treasure can be born. It possesses the unique Nirvana Skill of the Nirvana Realm, which can bring life to the dead and repair the deficiencies of one’s foundation.]
[It can be said that such a treasure as the Nirvana Fruit is extremely precious even in ordinary Holy Lands. Often it is only taken out to help a Saint Son with exceptional talent to make up for their foundation and give them the chance to break through to the Emperor Realm above the King Realm.]
[Ye Chen’s explanation shook your heart. Different levels imply different levels of knowledge. You originally thought Ling Xue knew enough, but now it seems that what Ling Xue knows is probably just a part, and not completely accurate, with many secrets still unknown to her.]
[You asked if the Emperor Realm was a higher level than the King Realm. Ye Chen gave a precise answer, confirming your speculation. At the same time, he also mentioned that the true old monsters hidden in the major Holy Lands, as well as the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and the Profound Turtle, all belong to this level of existence.]
[You were shocked and thought of the title of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, which confirmed your speculation. Then, you asked Ye Chen if he knew the deeper meaning behind ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ and why various Holy Lands hunted them down. If it was just for revenge, it would seem somewhat petty. After all, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor had actually done more good than harm, and his descendants and followers had all participated in the war, suffering heavy casualties. Furthermore, the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land where he was located had been completely destroyed.]
[Ye Chen shook his head, indicating that he currently did not know the hidden reasons. However, after a pause, he expressed solemnly that he had learned some secrets over the years. Rumors say that the ancestors of the major Holy Lands did not blame the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. Those who blamed him were his former enemies and those irrational masters who had suffered heavy casualties among their relatives. These people were strong but could not reach the level of an Emperor, so even when they joined hands, they could not break through the Profound Turtle’s defense force.]
[Otherwise, if all the Emperors took action, even if the Profound Turtle had the greatest defense force in the entire Purple Spirit Realm, it would be impossible to stop them. You understood in your heart and thought it made perfect sense.]
[Ye Chen continued to speak, stating that the Emperors were people with great magnanimity and did not blame the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. However, they allowed others to hunt down the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ for deeper reasons, and there were reasons they had to do so.]
[You were shocked in your heart and felt that the mystery had deepened. The truth of the matter seemed to not be what you had speculated. The Emperors were all people with great magnanimity and would not do such a thing, so the question became even more complicated.]
[Next, Ye Chen had no intention of discussing more with you since this place was not safe. Ye Chen invited you to leave together. You did not refuse. After all, in your memory, you clearly knew that after leaving Ye Chen’s side, you were killed by the Yin Yang Mirror master. It could be said that staying with Ye
Chen was safer than being alone.]
[This time, you did not make a mistake. You did not die while acting together with Ye Chen, which made you breathe a sigh of relief. After leaving the Purple Moon Secret Realm, the two of you parted ways again. Before parting, you asked Ye Chen if he was going to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War. Ye Chen nodded, stating that it was necessary to truly grow up and join the Holy Land. Otherwise, even if he could become a king in the future, it would be difficult to become an emperor.]
[Hearing Ye Chen’s words, you were surprised but couldn’t help but agree. Indeed, the outer world might also have many opportunities and inheritances, but how could they compare to the long-established Holy Lands, which could enable one to lay a solid foundation at every realm and provide nearly unparalleled opportunities to become a king? The difficulty for a loose cultivator to find such opportunities was too great. As for becoming a legendary Emperor, it was even more difficult.]
[However, you were puzzled. By participating in the Hundred Dynasties War, wouldn’t you be recognized for your Profound Turtle Spirit and then be killed by those big shots? Ye Chen shook his head, stating that the big figures of the
Holy Land would not care about people with Profound Turtle Spirit. What they
were concerned about was only the true ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, that is, those who possessed the bloodline of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
