[The rest of the people with Profound Turtle Spirit were actually collateral targets, being hunted for rewards by the Jiuyou Demon Sect, a major power holding deep hatred and enmity for the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. As long as they killed those who came from Profound Turtle Continent, they could obtain rewards. With the added sensitive factor of ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, many major powers not only hunted them down because of the heavy casualties from the past war, but also because of the benefits involved.]
[For this reason, they labeled those who came from Profound Turtle Continent as ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, killing them indiscriminately without any regard for whether they were the real descendants or just unfortunate people with the Profound Turtle Spirit. With additional profits and a chance to gain a good reputation, many cultivators above the Profound
Elixir Realm were naturally willing to do so..]

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
[Ye Chen said in the end, with a mocking expression, he looked down on these forces and cultivators. You understood in your heart and finally got to know many secrets.]
[However, you still had doubts in your heart and didn’t fully believe Ye Chen’s words. After all, in your memory, you had not only encountered the attacks of human cultivators from the big sects but also been attacked by sea beasts.]
[After thinking about it, you still asked the question in your heart: Why did the Sea Clan also want to kill the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ and involve innocent people? Ye Chen sighed and said that during that battle, the Sea Clan had made a great effort and almost mobilized all their high-end combat power.]
[At that time, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor suddenly fled, and the Demon Emperor stepped in, killing a large number of Sea Clan masters, and most of the Sea Clan’s King Realm Masters fell. Therefore, the Sea Clan was the force that hated the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ and their related people the most, without exception.]
[Ye Chen sighed and said that if the Sea Clan’s King Realm Masters hadn’t fallen so much and couldn’t recover for so many years, and the Profound Turtle had the strongest defense in the true sense, the Sea Clan would have killed the Profound Turtle a long time ago because they couldn’t break through its defense, and they didn’t dare to provoke it easily.]
[After hearing these ancient hidden secrets, you were shocked and generally understood the attitude differences between the numerous forces in the
Purple Spirit Realm towards the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and their related people. You also learned about the terrifying sea beasts’ hatred for you, a fake
Sinful Bloodline Descendant, and even their willingness to destroy the Seven
Stars Archipelago in anger, regardless of the dignity of the Heavenly Sword
Divine Land.]
“Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants,’ are the ones being targeted, while others with the Profound Turtle Spirit are just the pitiful ones caught in the crossfire.”
Seeing this, Wang Ping sighed.
However, it was difficult for everyone to understand the mysteries surrounding the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and the ambiguous attitude of the major Holy Lands.
[Next, Ye Chen spoke with profound meaning that although he didn’t know how much of the secrets he knew were true, and he didn’t know why the big shots of the various Holy Lands were so concerned about the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s bloodline, he believed that as long as his strength increased, he would naturally know.]
[You were surprised and thought that what Ye Chen said made sense, and hesitated whether to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War.]
[Ye Chen spotted your hesitation and advised that cultivation is inherently defying the heavens, so you must strive; if you hesitate, you will fail. All you need to do is avoid the detection of the ‘Hunters’ for the ‘Profound Turtle
Spirit’ on your body when the Hundred Dynasties War begins. As long as you reach the Heavenly Sword Divine City, you will be safe.]
[You thought that what Ye Chen said made sense and decided to give it a try. Otherwise, if you kept hiding all the time, it would indeed be hard to achieve anything significant. The state of mind and will are indeed very important in the path of cultivation.]
[Next, Ye Chen said goodbye to you again, wanting to make his combat power rise again before the Hundred Dynasties War began. As for you, you found a remote place and started to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
[However, you were torn about whether or not to change cultivation to the Wind and Thunder skill. If you change to the Wind and Thunder skill, your spiritual body will be wasted, and although you could later use the secret skill with corresponding treasures to transform it into the Wind and Thunder spirit physique, it was, after all, very time-consuming and troublesome.] [After consideration, you still decided to change cultivation to the Wind and Thunder skill. After all, the Wind and Thunder skill was a Heaven-tier nonsuch cultivation skill, ranked two levels higher than the Five Elements
Spirit Fusion Skill, and their difference was significant. Only by cultivating the
Wind and Thunder skill could your chances of forming a Ist-tier Profound
Elixir increase, otherwise, your cultivation skill might hold you back.] [In addition, you thought that it was just a spiritual body, and it was okay if it was wasted. After all, the increase in combat power provided by a spiritual body was only noticeable in the Transcendent Realm. When you reach the Profound Elixir Realm, e power increase provided by the spiritual body will be greatly reduced, and the quality of Profound Elixirs will become the key.]
[Anyway, choose the lesser of two evils and change cultivation first.]
[After successfully changing cultivation to the Wind and Thunder skill, you swallowed the Nirvana Fruit, using its vast Nirvana Skill to condense Profound Elixirs.]
[However, you found that the Nirvana Fruit was a treasure formed after the Nirvana Realm Masters’ sitting transformation. It had the Nirvana Skill, and the senior was also a cultivator of the Wind and Thunder attribute, so it was extremely easy for you to change physiques, and there was no need to find spiritual items in the future.]
[You were excited and began to use the Nirvana Fruit’s Nirvana Skill to transform your spiritual body. However, instead of transforming your Five Elements Spirit Body into a Wind and Thunder spirit physique, you ingeniously added Wind and Thunder attributes to your own physique.]
[As a result, the original five attributes of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth didn’t disappear, but the newly added Wind and Thunder attributes took the absolute leading position. You didn’t know whether doing this was right or wrong, but you believed that if you wanted to truly surpass those monsters, you had to walk your own path. Otherwise, if you encountered high-quality cultivation skills of the Five Elements attributes in the future, would you have to switch back? That would be too troublesome.]
[For this reason, you were very greedy and wanted to walk a path of full attributes, incorporating all attributes into yourself.]
[Next, you started attempting to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm. Due to your previous messing around, the breakthrough process encountered some twists and turns. However, in the end, you successfully condensed a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir and broke through to the Profound Elixir Realm.]
“Is it really just 2nd-tier?”
Wang Ping looked at the outcome, frowning and feeling disappointed..

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!) _ 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!) _ 5
Translator: 549690339
However, this seemed like a very normal occurrence.
Nirvana Fruits are indeed treasured, but the Holy Lands surely have their fair share. However, some weak Saint Sons are only capable of forming a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir.
Of course, there may be chances that those Holy Lands felt that the talents of these Saint Sons weren’t up to the mark and were unwilling to use precious Nirvana Fruits to bolster them to the level of the Flawless Profound Elixir, deeming it a waste.
“It seems that my Bone and Root Aptitude still leaves something to be desired. If only I had the Red Talent: True Dragon Form, I could have definitely formed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir,” Wang Ping thought as he shook his head.
However, there were no ifs, and because he had chosen the Red Talent: Unstable Evolver, he had to bear such consequences.
“Unstable Evolver, please give me some luck. So many years have passed and it hasn’t triggered even once.”
Wang Ping sighed, a little speechless.
However, despite his complaints, he had no regrets.
After all, even if the Unstable Evolver didn’t seem to have much presence, as long as he selected the Red Talent: True Dragon Form for the upcoming reward, he wouldn’t miss any talent he wanted.
Soon, Wang Ping took a deep breath, and after calming his emotions, he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“Although you only formed a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir, you didn’t disappoint yourself. In fact, you were very grateful that you only created a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir. Because after breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm, the Heavenly Tribulation would appear to temper your Profound Elixir. The Tribulation for refining into a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir is terrifying, and it almost killed you.”
“Even though you managed to form a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir thanks to the Nirvana Fruit, your combat power was significantly lesser than that of those who can form a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir. When facing the Heavenly
Tribulation, you barely managed to survive, thanks to the terrifying recovery ability brought by the Nirvana Fruit.”
“If you had formed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, you would have undoubtedly been turned into ashes by the Heavenly Tribulation, dying for sure.”
“Uh…
Wang Ping fell silent as he read this simulation content.
Well this changes things, he overlooked the fact that high-tier Profound Elixir also meant terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.
Considering his current situation of not having learned any Divine Skills, let alone creating Divine Skills, he barely survived the 2nd-Tier Heavenly Tribulation, thanks to the terrifying recovery power brought about by the Nirvana Fruit.
If he had formed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, he would have undoubtedly been severed by the lightning.
Though he did have the Rebirth tally and could resurrect, that probably also counted as failing to break through, right?
“Forming a Profound Elixir without the matching combat power also doesn’t work. This path of cultivation is brutal. The further you go, the more brutal it
Wang Ping sighed, feeling a bit heavy-hearted.
“You successfully survived the Tribulation, and after the Heavenly Tribulation had tempered your Profound Elixir to the 2nd-tier, you surprisingly activated the evolution option of the Red Talent: Unstable Evolver. You were very hesitant, unsure of whether to choose evolution.’
“However, thinking how cultivation is against the Heaven’s will, and you must always strive for the best, you braced yourself and decided to evolve the Profound Elixir. You’re incredibly lucky to win against low odds and successfully evolve your Profound Elixir to the Ist-tier, nearing the Flawless Profound Elixir. This grade of a Profound Elixir is on par with Ye Chen from before.’
“You were thrilled beyond measure, thinking that you were indeed lucky.
However, you really never expected that you would form the top-notch Ist-tier Profound Elixir this way.”
“You are of the belief that after forming a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, your foundation will become unshakeable within the entire Purple Spirit Realm, fearing no monsters. As long as you learn Divine Skills, or comprehend Divine Skills on your own, you will become even stronger, truly participating in the grand spectacle of the Purple Spirit Realm, confronting those Heaven’s Chosen Monsters from Holy Lands.”
“However, recalling that the Divine Skill – Nirvana Great Hand Seal from the Nirvana Realm Inheritance is not a swordsmanship and is basically
unobservable, plus you forcibly maintaining the Five Elements attribute, it now seems even more impossible.”
“But, you have no intention of giving up. Since you cannot observe it, try imitating the Wind and Thunder Giant Handprint Skill and create your own Divine Sword Technique.”
“Red Talent: Unstable Evolver, I am sorry for blaming you. Seems like, you are of the sort who keeps quiet most of the time but shocks everyone when you do flex. ”
Wang Ping was very excited looking at the simulation content.
The Unstable Evolver was indeed the right choice.
This is the true path towards the Flawless Profound Elixir.
Choosing only True Dragon Form, not only would you not be able to successfully form a Ist-tier Profound Elixir, but you would also be struck dead by the Heavenly Tribulation, which is simply too tragic.
Now, he has formed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. As long as he uses group points, he can easily form a Flawless Profound Elixir and break through to the Profound Elixir Realm perfectly. He could go toe-to-toe with Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, in terms of foundation!
“Wait, 1 guess I might not need to use group points.”
Wang Ping snapped back to reality, his eyes sparkling with brilliance.
It’s worth mentioning that he still has a Nirvana Fruit. The Wang Ping of the simulation used his Nirvana Fruit, but that has nothing to do with his current situation.
All he had to do was eat another Nirvana Fruit after forming the reward, which would directly lead him to form a Flawless Profound Elixir. There was no need to use group points.
“Now, that feels really nice.”
Wang Ping was delighted, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“After you came out of your retreat, you discovered that there was significant unrest in the Heavenly Sea Kingdom. The fall of the two Life-Death Realm Ancestors brought significant impacts.”
“Although after that battle, two of the Life and Death Realm Masters from the North Sun Sect and Fengyuan Gate were close to perishing, and that loose cultivator from the Life and Death Realm had completely fallen, the two great Masters of Life and Death from those sects hadn’t truly perished, and their presence threatened the Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family. The entire Heavenly Sea Kingdom seemed to be on the verge of a storm..”

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 125 Twin Red Talents! Ist-tier
Profound Elixir! (Requesting monthly votes for this 10,000 words chapter!)_6
Translator: 549690339
[However, even though a storm is approaching, nobody dares to act recklessly. Everyone knows that the Hundred Dynasties War is about to begin, and starting a battle at this critical moment would be an affront to the
Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Besides, the remaining two Life and Death
Realm Masters from the Heavenly Sea Country are not that easy to deal with.]
[Six months later, the Hundred Dynasties War is about to begin, and the
Heavenly Sea Country is ready to go to the Holy City where the Heavenly Sword Divine Land is headquartered for the grand competition. After some deliberation, you meet with Ling Xue and state your intention to represent the Heavenly Sea Country in the Hundred Dynasties War.]
[Ling Xue is very surprised and delighted at your arrival. She notices that your cultivation has reached the Profound Elixir Realm and curiously asks about the tier of your Profound Elixir. You vaguely mention it is Upper 3 tier. Ling Xue is astonished to learn that you, like her, have condensed a 3rd Tier Profound Elixir. This could mean that the Heavenly Sea Country may perform brilliantly this time and get out of its predicament.]
[With the help of the Delivery Array, you make several transmissions among different countries and cross an astonishing distance to reach the Heavenly Sword Divine City. The sight of the Heavenly Sword Divine City leaves you profoundly shocked. The ancient city, it is said, has been in existence for fifty thousand years, with a long history and countless legendary events recorded.]
[Meanwhile, you also discover that the concentration of Spiritual Energy in the Holy City exceeds your expectations. The entire city is built upon a Spiritual Vein, and there is a powerful Spirit Gathering Formation covering the whole city. As such, the concentration of Spiritual Energy in the Ancient City is more than ten times that in the capital of the Heavenly Sea Country. Ordinary cultivators can make rapid progress here.]
[Next, you witness a large crowd. The whole ancient city is bustling, with the presence of Yin Yang Mirror and Life and Death Realm Masters everywhere. Even Nirvana Realm Masters occasionally appear. As for the geniuses, they abound. This is quite normal, as it gathers the younger generation from the entire Sword Domain.]
[All the geniuses eligible to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War are at least at the Profound Elixir Realm. Those younger than this, no matter how amazingly gifted, are not qualified to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War because they would simply be outclassed here.]
[After all, even if you are a genius, aren’t the other geniuses here as well? At the Profound Elixir Realm, you may be able to defeat other geniuses across several minor stages, but it would be difficult to defeat other Profound Elixir Realm geniuses with Half- step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.]
[You eagerly await the start of the Hundred Dynasties War, feeling anxious and a bit worried that your hidden Profound Turtle Spirit might be discovered by a Master, and they would swat you to death]
[Actually, your worries are unnecessary. The Secret Skill given to you by Ye
Chen is very advanced, even a Life and Death Realm Master can’t penetrate it. Even if the occasionally appearing Nirvana Realm Masters could see right through you, no one dares to take action once in Heavenly Sword Divine City]
[After all, fighting in the Heavenly Sword Divine City is strictly forbidden, let alone that the Hundred Dynasties War is about to begin. Anyone who dares to initiate a fight here and break the rules is challenging the dignity of the Holy Land, the consequences would be grave, even a Nirvana Realm Master would have to face death]
“So that’s how it is. I was overthinking it. But then, could this Ye Canghai be a pseudonym for Ye Chen?”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, slightly stunned.
Then, he recalls the previous simulation content.
In the Hundred Dynasties War, Ye Canghai and Ji Bingyue, both monsters, performed incredibly well. As soon as they entered the Holy Land, they became prospective True Inheritor Disciples.
If they had enough cultivation, they would’ve already become True Inheritor Disciples.
At first, he thought this Ye Canghai, as a member of the Ye’s family, was indeed extraordinary. But now it seems like he is just a smokescreen for Ye
Chen.
After all, Ye Chen said he would participate in the Hundred Dynasties War. It would be strange if Ye Chen didn’t make a name for himself with his capabilities.
“Unfortunately, the simulation content only mentioned that these two had stunning performances as two monsters but did not disclose who was stronger or weaker. However, considering Ye Chen’s fortune and following the typical pattern, he probably won first place.”
Wang Ping muses to himself.
“But, this Ji Bingyue, able to stand alongside Ye Chen’s fame, must have put up a good fight against Ye Chen, or it wouldn’t have been so. Wait, the development of this plot makes me feel like this Ji Bingyue has the flair of Daughter of Fortune.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Pings gaze becomes strange.
It seems, it truly is that way.
As the Son of Fortune, Ye Chen should have a Tao Companion.
Having more than one Tao Companion is somewhat the norm for the Son of Fortune.
In terms of talent and Same Realm Battle Power, this Ji Bingyue is on par with Ye Chen and fully qualified to be the Daughter of Fortune…
According to the pattern, the two of them would compete in the Hundred Dynasties War, develop mutual admiration, become confidants, and then evolve into lovers.
“Tsk, tsk, I have already figured out the plot.”
Wang Ping clicks his tongue, obviously suffering from his occupational hazard as an author before crossing.
Immediately after, Wang Ping regains his focus, continues to gaze at the luminescent screen as more text appears.
[While roaming around the Heavenly Sword Divine City, you find that the items sold in the shops here are astonishingly numerous. Cai Yonglong is also extremely excited – as a minor cultivator, he had never seen such a scene.]
[Very quickly, Cai Yonglong becomes excited. Because he found a thick opportunity line. You are very surprised and also start feeling expectant, following Cai Yonglong to trace the opportunity line.]
[Then, you see a bead for sale in a marketplace. You really want to buy it, but you find that you do not have enough Spirit Stones. For a moment, you are embarrassed. You, who were considered wealthy on Sacred Heart Island, are too poor in this place filled with mighty figures. You can’t afford to buy anything, nor do you have the privilege to pick up bargains.]
[Seeing your embarrassment, the stall owner drives you away. You find that the owner’s cultivation is also at an astonishing Yin Yang Realm, and you can only prepare to leave helplessly.]
[Just as you are about to leave, you see the owner of the opportunity line come over to buy the bead, and another person comes over. When you see her, your face shows astonishment..]

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 126: ‘Pioneer Traveler’! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000-word mega chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 126: ‘Pioneer Traveler’! Breaking through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000-word mega chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
[You are surprised to discover that the newcomer is Bing Ningyue.
Instinctively, you want to greet her, but you remember that you don’t seem to have any relationship with her. You only know of her as your Tao Companion from a past life in your memory.]
[In the end, you give a bitter smile, choose not to greet her, and walk away. Cai Yonglong notices your unusual behavior and curiously asks if you know her. You nod your head and then shake it, not saying much.]
[Bing Ningyue also notices your presence and pays attention to your changing expression. However, after frowning and realizing that she doesn’t know you at all, she puts you out of her mind.]
[Half a month later, the Hundred Dynasties War officially begins. The first round of the Hundred Dynasties War takes place in the Illusionary Dream
Space. Illusionary Dream Space is a space formed by an illusion-type Array Plate of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, which can create various realistic scenes.]
[In the first round of the competition, only those who obtain one hundred Illusionary Dream Points in the first floor of the Illusionary Dream Space are qualified to enter the second floor and pass the first round.]
[After entering the first floor of the Trial Tower’s Illusionary Dream Space, you are surrounded by many Profound Elixir Realm monster beasts of the same realm. Killing one monster beast will earn you an Illusionary Dream Point. Your heart is heavy, having gained a clear understanding of the trials held by the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. This is just the first round, yet it is enough to eliminate those fake geniuses with weak Same Realm Battle Power.]
[After all, some geniuses rely on Elixirs to reach the Profound Elixir Realm. They have impressive cultivation but a shallow foundation, making their battle power weak and pitiful.]
[You engage in the first battle in the Illusionary Dream Space with many same realm Profound Elixir Realm monster beasts. Although you haven’t comprehended Divine Skills and haven’t cultivated the Divine Skills created by your predecessors, your Cultivation Skill is of a high grade. Moreover, with your Ist-tier Profound Elixir, your battle power can be considered strong within the same realm.]
[Thus, even though you have to exert a lot of effort, you still manage to pass the first floor with relative ease and successfully enter the second floor. After passing the first round of the assessment, your name appears on the massive stone tablet next to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land Trial Toxuver, along with your rank. You enter the second-floor assessment space ranked 1,500th.]
[Cai Yonglong is astonished to see how powerful you are, managing to squeeze into the top 1,500. At the same time, he also spots Ling Xue’s name.
Ling Xue ranks 900th, much higher than you.]
[What amazes Cai Yonglong even more is Ye Canghai, the alias of Ye Chen, who enters the second round in the first place, closely followed by Ji Bingyue.]
[Upon arriving at the second floor, you notice a change in space. You appear in a space with a diameter of a hundred miles. In this space, the other twenty-nine participants gradually emerge. At the same time, you learn the rules. You must kill the other participants, and the last three survivors will advance to the third round.]
[Your heart grows heavy as you realize that the second round has already started a battle royale, seemingly not worried about missing out on true geniuses. However, you think you might be overreacting. Real powerhouses would never fail to secure a spot in this kind of melee.]
[Even if they are killed due to their youth, as long as they perform exceptionally, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land might still accept them as disciples. Not to mention, there is always the opportunity to participate in the next Hundred Dynasties War.]
[Next, the chaotic battle begins. A 3rd-tier Profound Elixir Realm genius sees you as an easy target due to your low cultivation and launches a direct attack. You show no fear and engage in fierce combat with them. Employing various methods, you manage to defeat them.]
[Your battle prowess leaves the other competitors somewhat surprised, making them aware that you are no easy target. But by the second round, none of the contenders are weak, so they are not afraid of you either.]
[A large-scale melee ensues, and you find yourself in a challenging battle.
Fortunately, you encounter none of the genius fighters with top 3-tier
Profound Elixirs within this space. Participants in the Hundred Dynasties War have to be under 150 years old and have reached the Profound Elixir Realm to be eligible.]
[After all, for Profound Elixir Realm cultivators, their lifespan is a thousand years. At 150 years old, they are equivalent to 15 years old for ordinary people, still considered young geniuses.]
[As a result, there are many geniuses participating in the Hundred Dynasties War. While some might not have high natural talent, only forming a middle-three-tier Profound Elixir, they have accumulated more experience over time. In the space where you find yourself, there are people with a cultivation of at least the 4th Tier of Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Reaching the 4th Tier Profound Elixir Realm is considered the mid-stage of the Profound Elixir Realm. Even if they only possess a middle 3-tier Profound Elixir and haven’t cultivated any predecessor’s Divine Skills, their battle power is not to be underestimated.]
[Your cultivation is only at the Ist-tier Profound Elixir Realm, but your Ist-tier Profound Elixir gives you the ability to challenge geniuses of higher realms. However, you cannot overcome too many realms. The struggle is exceptionally difficult for you.]
[In the end, you employ every method you know, barely surviving the melee, and secure a spot in the top three, advancing to the third round. However, even as you enter the third round, you understand that you might reach your limit here.]
[The advantage of Profound Elixir Tier is significant in the second round but diminishes in the third round. At this stage, there are no weak opponents. They either have high cultivation or are extremely powerful. You find it hard to deal with them..]

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 126: ‘Predecessor of Transcenders’! Breaking Through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 126: ‘Predecessor of Transcenders’! Breaking Through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000word Chapter!) _2
Translator: 549690339
[Nevertheless, you do not lose heart. You believe that based on your current performance, you should be qualified to enter the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[The third round of competition has changed again. Twelve people appear in a space and compete in tournament-style matches. Everyone will fight against each other once, and only the top three scorers will advance to the fourth round.]
[This time the battles are going to be broadcast live. You look at your opponents and are surprised to find one person you recognize – Ling Xue. You never expected to end up competing in the same small space with her.]
[Ling Xue is also surprised to see you as she didn’t expect you to make it to the third round. Even though you have condensed a 3rd-tier Profound Elixir, your cultivation is too low. Unless you have learned Divine Skills, it would be difficult for you to advance. As a loose cultivator, your chances of cultivating
Divine Skills are slim. For a moment, Ling Xue feels like she has underestimated you.]
[Next, the battle begins again. You start out against a genius who has learned Divine Skills and condensed a top 3-tier Profound Elixir. Fortunately, his cultivation is only at the 2nd Tier Profound Elixir Realm. As a result, although the fight is extremely difficult, you manage to defeat him after using your Ist-tier Profound Elixir and unleashing all of its power.]
[ After you use your Ist-tier Profound Elixir, Ling Xue and the others are all shocked to the extreme, never expecting you to have condensed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. Not only Ling Xue and the others, but also the masters and elders of Heavenly Sword Divine Land who are watching this battle reveal astonished expressions.]
[After all, a Ist-tier Profound Elixir is extremely rare in the world, and those who can condense it have the potential to become Saint Child tier characters. It’s fair to say that even ordinary Saint Children might not be able to condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. And yet, you have condensed such a top-notch
Ist-tier Profound Elixir.]
[For a moment, countless masters all believe that you must have great secrets and opportunities. Even with an excellent foundation, it’s difficult to achieve this. The elders of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land also investigate your information and are quite surprised to find that you are already close to seventy years old.]
[Breaking through to the Profound Elixir Realm at over sixty years old, with no Special Constitution and weaker Same Realm Battle Power, it should be theoretically impossible for you to condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir. You are full of contradictions. In the end, they can only attribute it to your great opportunities. Although they are somewhat disappointed, not seeing a true Saint Child tier genius, they still feel that you have potential and plan to take you into the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[In the end, you rank lower in the third round and are eliminated, not advancing to the fourth round. You feel a little lost but know that you’ve reached your limit, and you’ve done your best. There’s no need for more thoughts.]
“There are really many monsters in this Hundred Dynasties War.”
Wang Ping looks at this simulation content and sighs in his heart.
He condensed a Ist-tier Profound Elixir and ranked only around 1,500 in the same realm in the first round, which could be the result of some people hiding their strength.
In the second round, he was lucky that he didn’t encounter any real genius characters, but the opponents were older and the battles were still challenging.
As for the third round, there’s no need to say, he almost lost to a genius at the 2nd Tier Profound Elixir Realm who condensed a 3rd-tier Profound Elixir.
“Divine Skills, Divine Skills…
Wang Ping shakes his head.
Whether they have grasped Divine Skills or not distinguishes top-tier geniuses from ordinary ones.
And ordinary geniuses who have learned Divine Skills can also crush those who haven’t in terms of battle power.
The competition among geniuses is exceptionally cruel.
Some people might collapse mentally when they see the huge gap after participating in the Hundred Dynasties War.
Of course, some will be inspired by the vastness of the world, rise to the challenge, and surpass their own limits.
“Once I learn Divine Skills, I don’t believe I won’t be able to advance. If I can’t learn Divine Skills, I’ll pile up cultivation.”
Wang Ping clenches his fist, thinking to himself.
Before crossing over, he was just an ordinary person like his name suggests, ordinary in every aspect. He has reached this point only by cheating.
However, ordinary people have their pride. As an ordinary cheater, he would be too embarrassed if he couldn’t defeat his peers.
It should be said that some of his opponents are much younger than him.
For example, Ling Xue is only 31 years old now.
Immediately, Wang Ping takes a deep breath, calms his thoughts, and continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After being eliminated, you begin to watch the battles. When you see the fights of the true monsters, your emotions become more and more unstable. Among them, Ye Chen’s battles can be described as a sweep. No matter what opponents he faces, even princes and princesses from superpowers or monsters with natural Special Constitutions, he still easily defeats them, showing his invincibility.]
[You can’t help but sigh that the Son of Fortune is really amazing, growing so much in such a short time. The future Blood Demon chaos might really depend on Ye Chen. Next, you watch the battles of others. When you see Ji Bingyue, you are stunned. It turns out Ji Bingyue is Bing Ningyue, and you somewhat suspect that you have seen it wrong.]
[When you fully confirm that Bing Ningyue is Ji Bingyue, you cannot calm down. You can’t fathom that Bing Ningyue, who was your Tao Companion named ‘Wang Ping in a previous life, has such a terrifying talent that she rivals Ye Chen..]

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 126 “Predecessor Traveler” !
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 126 “Predecessor Traveler” !
Breaking Through Profound Elixir Realm (Huge Chapter of Ten Thousand Words!)_3
Translator: 549690339
[Then, you remember the identity of Ji Bingyue. Ji Bingyue is the successor of Ice Palace. Ice Palace, a significant power in the Sword Domain, rumored to be anchored by a King Realm Master, has a rather ambiguous relationship with
Heavenly Sword Divine Land. You thought that the Ice Palace on Sacred Heart Island was merely a namesake of the Sword Domain’s Ice Palace, but on second thought, it seemed highly unlikely. A major power would never tolerate another entity sharing its name.]
[Smaller powers wouldn’t dare to share names with major powers either.
Unless, they have some sort of connection. For instance, the Ice Palace on Sacred Heart Island could be a branch of the Sword Domain’s Ice Palace, or perhaps established by someone who deserted the Sword Domain Ice Palace.
This could explain everything.]
[Moreover, remembering how Bing Ningyue disappeared on numerous occasions, you believe you have the answer now. Her disappearing was probably because she was at the real Ice Palace, undergoing training to become the Ice Palace’s successor.]
[Feeling melancholic, you never expected the ‘Flower-picking Thief’ with the Green Talent to bag himself such an outstanding lady. You could only conclude that Bing Ningyue was far too naive back then, otherwise Wang Ping would not have succeeded so easily.]
[Next, you continue to observe round after round of the Hundred Dynasties War. Many well-known Heaven’s Chosen show off their powers, alongside dark horses that make phenomenal progress.]
[The Hundred Dynasties War lasted for a whole week. In the end, the Hundred Dynasties War followed your memory and culminated with the final battle between Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue, deep within a small space. Using all their force for the first time, the appearance of their two Flawless Profound Elixirs shocked the crowd. Their unique Divine Skills likewise astounded everyone.]
[At that moment, all the Heaven’s Chosen monsters felt a large gap. The Masters smiled bitterly, feeling that they don’t understand the younger generation anymore.]
[Among them, Nirvana Realm Masters recollected that there were many talented individuals appearing in other areas too. The once rare physique now emerged frequently. They mumbled about the arrival of the Golden Age, and questioned whether it was a curse or a blessing. After all, before the invasion of the Blood Demon Clan ten thousand years ago, it was a Golden Age, and many extraordinary figures surfaced. But boom inevitably leads to recession; after the Golden Age, there was sure to be decline. This was nothing to joke about.]
[In the end, Ye Chen defeated Ji Bingyue and took first place. After receiving the amazing rewards of the Hundred Dynasties War, they were led away by a big shot from the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. They would directly become provisionary True Inheritor Disciples. Once their cultivations break through to the Yin Yang Mirror, they would become full True Inheritor Disciples and qualify to contest for the positions of Saint Son and Saint Daughter.]
[As for you, an Elder from the Nirvana Boundary of Heavenly Sword Divine
Land took notice of you and wished to take you as a disciple. You were taken to Heavenly Sword Divine Land along with the rest of the Heaven’s Chosen.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, he was envious that you could join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land successfully and made a secret vow to work hard on his cultivation and catch up with you. He wished to participate in the next Hundred Dynasties War and join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[After entering the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you meet the Saint Master of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. This was the opening ceremony chaired by the Saint Master. Looking at the Saint Master, who is an important figure, your heart was disturbed. You hope to become a powerful person like him in the future.]
[What you did not expect was that the Saint Master of the Heavenly Sword, who has a terrifying cultivation level, discovered your true identity. Not that he discovered the ‘Profound Turtle Spirit’ on you but that you are from outside the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[However, the Saint Master of the Heavenly Sword did not say much during the opening ceremony, just glanced at you deeply. After the opening ceremony, he summoned you and directly revealed your identity as a person from outside the realm.]
[Shock overwhelmed you. You wanted to hide your emotions, but your attempts to control your expression were useless in front of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master. You were filled with bitterness, thinking that you were in for a calamity. You never expected that someone of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master’s stature could see right through you.]
[However, what surprised you was that the Heavenly Sword Saint Master did not kill you or search your soul. Instead, he gave you two choices.]
[The first choice was to be honestly sealed inside the Divine Land and never cultivate again. The second choice was to have your cultivation sealed and then leave the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[Feeling heavy-hearted, you question the Heavenly Sword Saint Master about why he is so prejudiced against people from outside the realm. Are there no good ones among people from outside? The Heavenly Sword Saint Master calmly told you that none of the extraterritorial comers so far have been good. A hundred thousand years ago, there was an extraterritorial comer who committed heinous crimes. Ten thousand years ago, the Blood Demon Clan from outside the realm also wreaked havoc.]
[Five thousand years ago, a human appeared who had a similar soul spirit to yours and caused a great commotion in the Purple Spirit Realm. The demon cult he created is still active in this world, causing many killings.]
[The Heavenly Sword Saint Master stated that if it wasn’t for your pure energy, he wouldn’t be so amiable. However, people from outside the realm can’t be trusted, especially at this critical moment.]
[You are shocked. You did not expect that there were so many things happening in the Purple Spirit Realm, all related to people from outside the realm. Finally, you notice the last sentence of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master, about a person with a similar soul spirit to yours. Waves of shock wash over you as you begin to suspect that this person with a similar soul spirit could be another time-traveler..]

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 126: ‘Predecessor of
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 126: ‘Predecessor of
Transmigrators ‘ ! Breaking Through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
[You fall into silence, having nothing to say anymore. So many things have happened, and the mere fact that the Heavenly Sword Saint Master only chose to place him under house arrest or seal his cultivation and let him leave, is already a very friendly act. If it were another unreasonable master, they might just choose to kill him with a slap, without leaving any room for survival.]
[You feel bitter in your heart and choose to be sealed in cultivation, leaving the Heavenly Sword Divine Land in despair. You thought you could join the Holy Land and stand out, but you never expected it to end up being an empty dream, and even ended up being sealed in cultivation.]
[After leaving the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you plan to return to Sacred Heart Island to live out the rest of your life. However, what you didn’t expect happened: not long after leaving the Divine Land, a mysterious strongman covered in black fog appears, intending to take you away.]
[You’re horrified to the extreme and try to resist, but it’s completely useless, even entering the Berserk State doesn’t help. The Berserk State couldn’t even break the Heavenly Sword Saint Master’s seal, let alone break this person’s power. The gap between you two is just too large.]
[Just as you’re about to be captured, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master’s incarnation suddenly appears, battling the mysterious strongman. Due to the horrifying aftermath, you’re killed on the spot.]
[Because of the Rebirth tally, you come back to life. However, the moment you’re revived, you’re instantly turned to dust once more.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends.]
…..This is ridiculous.’
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, his whole body feeling numb.
Well, he thought the Holy Land wouldn’t care about the Profound Turtle Spirit and that he wouldn’t be delivering himself to them, but in the end, that’s exactly what happened.
And the reason is even more absurd.
The Heavenly Sword Saint Master could actually see through his transmigrator identity.
Moreover, in the end, it wasn’t even a case of kindly letting him go; it was clearly a fishing expedition.
The Heavenly Sword Saint Master is truly an old fox.
So that means if the Heavenly Sword Saint Master discovered his unusual identity, others have also noticed it too.
This is most likely related to that predecessor transmigrator, or even the transmigrator himself.
“Transmigrator… Alpha, don’t tell me this transmigrator is one of the group members from the previous Transmigrator Chat Group.”
Wang Ping takes a deep breath and speaks from the bottom of his heart.
“Correct. It’s only been two thousand years since the last chat group was destroyed. I spent two thousand years reorganizing. With just this little time, many of the transmigrators from the previous chat group are still alive in the world.’
Alpha’s cold voice rings out.
“And these people are also the targets you need to eliminate. To be precise, if you don’t kill them, they’ll try their best to kill you once they discover your identity, because they have already taken the opposite side from the chat group.”
Wang Pings face twitches.
Although he had guessed that he would face the ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ at some point, he never thought it would happen so soon, and right here in the Purple Spirit Realm.
Most importantly, this person is a tough opponent.
Being able to make the Heavenly Sword Saint Master, such a big shot, comment on the Demon Cult they created – which is still active in the world and has caused great turmoil and triggered countless killings – is enough to show their terror.]
Wang Ping even suspects that this predecessor transmigrator might have reached the Emperor tier.
“There’s no need to doubt; they were already an Emperor before the chat group’s destruction. Now, after so many years, they’ve only become stronger.”
Alpha’s cold voice resounds again.
Wang Ping: .
“This is such a pervert, reaching this stage all by themselves.”
Wang Ping feels a bit bitter.
Having such a powerful enemy appear in his world is not a good thing.
Wang Ping feels that as soon as he is exposed to the other party’s eyes, the other party will try their best to kill him.
Facing the pursuit and assassination of an Emperor Realm transmigrator, Wang Ping feels a cold chill on his back.
It seems that only hiding in the Holy Land can be considered safe.
But the prerequisite is that the Heavenly Sword Divine Land is willing to shelter him.
But obviously, it’s not feasible. The Heavenly Sword Saint Master doesn’t trust him and is using him as bait for fishing.
“Your Earth is far more complex than you can imagine. The true length of its history goes beyond your imagination. I have deployed tens of millions of transmigrators in the past to your world.”
Alpha speaks coldly and ruthlessly.
“l deployed so many people, and those who survive aren’t ordinary people; they’re Bewitched Kings I raised myself. There’s not a single simple character among them, because the simple ones are already dead.” Wang Ping falls silent, having nothing left to say.
It can only be said that this is the survivorship bias at play.
“Now that you’ve said that, I feel more balanced. If all the ‘predecessor transmigrators’ were this perverse, it would be really tough for me to handle.
But if they’re all Bewitched Kings, then it’s normal for them to be this strong.” Wang Ping sighs, and his mood gradually calms down.
Right after that, Wang Ping feels his consciousness waver, and his vision changes.
He sees another Wang Ping appear in an unfamiliar place, drinking heavily with a completely lost expression, devoid of all fighting spirit.
At this moment, a strange black shadow appears, trying to grab Wang Ping. Then, the incarnation of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master appears, engaging
in a battle with the black shadow.
The instant the two unleash their power, Wang Ping is immediately killed.
Next, Wang Ping is revived, and everything around him, including Wang Ping himself, is instantly shattered into fine dust..

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 126: ‘Predecessor of Transcenders’! Breaking Through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000word Chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 126: ‘Predecessor of Transcenders’! Breaking Through the Profound Elixir Realm (10,000word Chapter!)_5
Translator: 549690339
With God’s perspective, Wang Ping could see that with just a casual move, the two could cause large areas of space to shatter, forming terrifying spatial turbulence, which was horrifying.
“How strong is the real body of this Sword Saint, since this is just his incarnation?”
Wang Ping held this thought, his consciousness and vision returning to the real world, speechless for a long time.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
1.lst-tier Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.
2.Red Talent.Unstable Optimizer. (P.S: Changed from evolution to optimization.)
3.Heaven-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skill.Wind and Thunder skill.
4.Divine Skill – Wind and Thunder Palm Imprint.
5.Premium Secret Skill.Star Attraction.
6.Combat Experience.”
“Well, there are so many good things. But it’s a pity that there’s no Red Talent:
True Dragon Form.”
Wang Ping looked at these rewards, feeling a bit regretful.
He chose the Red Talent: Unstable Optimizer this time, so the reward was also this, which was very normal; he had thought about this when choosing the talent.
Of course, based on previous experience, there was still a small probability of refreshing other talents. but he didn’t refresh it this time. it seems that his
luck had run out.
“However, it’s a good thing that I can choose two rewards this time, otherwise I’d have a headache.’
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, thinking in secret.
If there were only one reward option, he would have to choose Red Talent. Unstable Optimizer.
By that time, he wouldn’t be able to choose cultivation.
And at that time, whether he could trigger the Optimization Option in his next simulation to optimize his Profound Elixir into a top-tier Profound Elixir was an unknown.
After all, the probability of refreshing the Unstable Optimizer was unstable, with a high upper limit and a low lower limit, and everything was full of uncertainty.
To be honest, in reality, Wang Ping would not dare to use this talent unless he was in a desperate situation.
But in the simulation, it doesn’t matter, as it’s more controllable.
Honestly, with this talent, it’s like giving Wang Ping a cheat in the simulation, so he won’t be just an ordinary cultivator. Although, this cheat is quite unstable.
“System, I choose 1 and 2
Wang Ping made a decision after calming his mood.
In an instant, Wang Ping felt his cultivation skyrocket, and the spiritual essence in his body surged, eventually condensing into a white Profound Elixir.
And on this Profound Elixir, there was a faint crack.
This was a Ist-tier Profound Elixir.
One crack on the Profound Elixir represented the Ist-tier.
Two cracks on the Profound Elixir represented the 2nd-tier.
In other words, the grade of the Profound Elixir was determined by the number of cracks.
There was only one small crack in Wang Pings Profound Elixir, which was a top-tier Ist-tier Profound Elixir.
“With one crack, it’s still imperfect; I need to make it a Flawless Profound Elixir.’
Wang Pings eyes flickered, thinking secretly in his heart.
He didn’t know what kind of changes would happen after reaching the Flawless Profound Elixir.
“Alpha, how many group points do I need to use to enhance a Ist-tier
Profound Elixir to a Flawless Profound Elixir?”
Wang Ping contemplated and then asked Alpha in his heart.
He had two ways to enhance the grade of the Profound Elixir.
Group points and Nirvana Fruit.
But the Nirvana Fruit was very precious, and once he used it in reality, it would be gone; he was a bit reluctant to use it.
Although the Nirvana Fruit might be refreshed later in the Life Simulator, the probability of refreshing such items was relatively low.
But group points, although equally precious, could be continuously obtained as long as there were group tasks.
For example, he could get a share of the dividends when other group members participated in group tasks.
He received an additional 500 group points for Liu Mei!s 2th or 3th Tier group task.
In the future, as more group members join and more group tasks are assigned, his group points will increase rapidly.
“To enhance a Ist-tier Profound Elixir to a Flawless Profound Elixir with group points, you will need 2 million group points.”
The voice of Alpha came’
“So much!” Wang Pings face darkened.
“Is it a lot? You killed a monster in the Abyss Lands with just under 7th-Tier Battle Power and got four or five hundred thousand group points. You know how precious the Flawless Profound Elixir is.” Alpha said coldly.
Wang Ping was speechless and had nothing to say.
“Wait, thinking about it this way, you took quite a few group points from us.
At the beginning, when we killed the Cunning Monster, we only got that many group points.”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of something, his face twitching and gritting his teeth as he spoke.
Alpha remained silent and chose to dive.
“So freaking black-hearted.” Wang Ping gritted his teeth.
Now, the current distribution of group points was relatively normal.
Or rather, relatively normal.
Back then, they risked their lives to kill the Cunning Monster and only got that many group points; they were extremely black-hearted.
Perhaps, the distribution back then was 19.
The transmigrators got 1, and they still had to split it among themselves.
Alpha alone got 9.
“No wonder the previous chat group was destroyed. The current Alpha, who has learned his lesson, is already so black-hearted; 1 can’t imagine how much blacker the previous Alpha must have been, probably much blacker than a capitalist.”
Wang Ping criticized Alpha in his heart.
However, Alpha had no intention of surfacing again.
“Considering this, using the Nirvana Fruit might be more cost-effective.” Wang Ping hesitated.
Nirvana Fruit, once used up, still had a chance to be refreshed in the Life Simulator, so he could enjoy the happiness of freebies..

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 126 “Predecessor Traveler” ! Breaking Through Profound Elixir Realm (Huge Chapter of Ten Thousand Words!) 6
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 126 “Predecessor Traveler” ! Breaking Through Profound Elixir Realm (Huge Chapter of Ten Thousand Words!) 6
Translator: 549690339
But he really couldn’t bear to spend two million group points all at once.
Not to mention, he does not currently have enough group points to bolster his Profound Elixir.
After all, his current group points just barely tip over one million.
“Forget it, there’s no rush. The Wang Ping in the simulator can eat without affecting subsequent simulations.”
Wang Ping sighed and decided not to immediately consume, opting to take things one step at a time.
“However, I can’t go to the Holy Land anymore, I must be careful with my ‘predecessor transmigrator’, things are getting dangerous again.” Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping felt somewhat troubled.
“Alpha, don’t tell me that all the worlds we’ve been transmigrating to, or worlds where we’ve yet to establish ourselves, were all previously used to train other transmigrators.”
It suddenly occurred to Wang Ping, who became increasingly apprehensive as he asked.
“Not all of them.”
Alpha’s response was rather elusive.
“Shit.”
Everything went black before Wang Pings eyes.
This Alpha is a trap.
He originally thought his only enemy was the anomalies, but now he is suddenly faced with the Master Lord Tier Space, the Abyss Lands and a whole host of Myriad Heavens Forces.
Although these forces may seem easier to deal with than the anomalies at present, who knows what the future holds?
Now, he also has to deal with the ‘predecessor transmigrators’ from the old chat group, these living conditions are just too harsh!
As owners of a Life Simulator, they were already thinking about quitting. If the other group members found out, they’d be livid. This damn Alpha, just how many landmines have you laid for them to step on?
“Tell me, in which world are there still transmigrators?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in a deep voice.
“I don’t know.” Alpha replied. “After the destruction of the chat group, I don’t know if they are dead or alive, or if they have gone to other worlds.”
Wang Ping was silent, at a loss for words.
However, he was now too lazy to berate Alpha any further.
Since he had been chosen, he had no choice but to clean up this mess.
Though Wang Ping was somewhat frustrated, if he could, he’d want to follow those predecessor transmigrators and tear this wretched chat group apart. “Warning, thoughts of tearing the chat group apart are not allowed.” Alpha’s cold and unfeeling voice rang out.
“Can you stop eavesdropping on my thoughts?” Wang Ping was quite indignant.
“In order to prevent the group members from betraying me again, this is a necessary measure. The chat group has been destroyed so many times, I haven’t remained unscathed.’
Alpha coldly stated.
Wang Ping pouted.
You learned your lesson, my ass.
If you had learned your lesson, the chat group wouldn’t have become this mess that I’m left to deal with.
Subsequently, Wang Ping couldn’t be bothered to argue with Alpha any more, and prepared to execute the new simulation.
However, before Wang Ping could act, a notification from the chat group system suddenly sounded.
“It has been detected that the vitality of group member Wu Yueming (79) is continuously decreasing. Group members can opt to assist in his world!” Upon hearing this, Wang Ping was slightly taken aback.
He had also suggested to Alpha to implement the feature of detecting health crisis and sending a warning notification to the group.
After all, for a transmigrator, danger is omnipresent, not only during group tasks involving anomalies and powerful entities from the Myriad Heavens Forces but also within their original world.
If a group member were to be in danger and lacked the energy to ask for help, it would be such a waste if he were to tragically die.
After all, resurrecting a group member requires a lot of group points, and it would be much more cost effective to go to his world and rescue him. But Wang Ping did not expect the feature to be utilized so soon.
Immediately, Wang Ping entered the chat group.
At that moment, the chat group was bustling with activity, some idle group members who were startled by the news tagged Wu Yueming, but received no response.
Obviously, his situation was dire.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Can someone help? I’m not strong enough and I don’t have enough group points.”
Wang Ping (66): “I’ll go.”
Liu Mei (15): “With Mr. Wang here, we’re safe.”
Without a moment’s hesitation, Wang Ping directly activated the teleportation function to Wu Yuemings world, using up twenty thousand group points in the process.
Though twenty thousand group points is a large sum, Wu Yuemings potential is quite good, making him worth saving.
As Wang Ping was teleported, his consciousness and line of sight underwent a drastic change.
Then, he found himself amidst a city.
The special city was already in a state of chaos, and various types of monsters had formed a terrifying Beast Tide, infiltrating and wreaking havoc.
The Beast Tamers in the city put up a feeble resistance, completely outmatched.
In the face of the Beast Tide, humanity seemed so powerless.
Wang Ping, floating in the air, squinted as he observed the scene.
It seemed that the world Wu Yueming lived in was not as calm as he thought.
“Where is Wu Yueming?”
Wang Ping did not immediately step forward to suppress the Beast Tide, instead, he expanded his Spiritual Sense, hoping to locate Wu Yueming.
After all, his purpose for coming to the Beast Taming World was to save people, not to suppress the Beast Tide for them.
He could lend a hand along the way, but rescuing people was his primary objective.
“Found him.”
The next second, Wang Ping found Wu Yuemings location.
He was in the sky up ahead, unconscious, carried by a large blue bird flying at an astonishing speed towards the distance.
However, it was clear that Wu Yueming was poisoned. His face turned purplish black, he was in pain and had fainted.
And behind him, a pack of ferocious flying beasts was hot on his trail, they were trying to tear him apart.
“No wonder he couldn’t send out a distress signal, he fainted.”
Wang Ping was deep in thought.
Immediately after, Wang Pings figure flashed, instantly traversing a distance of several kilometers, appearing in front of the blue bird.
Wang Pings sudden appearance startled the bluebird. Instinctively, its eyes brimmed with ferocity, and it was ready to kill Wang Ping before continuing its escape with its owner. But when it realized that Wang Ping was a human, it snapped back to reality, it squawked and tried to dodge Wang Ping to continue fleeing.
However, the bluebird was stunned when it discovered that it could not move at all, it was suspended in mid-air.
“Relax, I’m a friend of your owner, I won’t hurt you. I’m here to save you.” Wang Ping shook his head and brought Wu Yueming over to him.
The bluebird was aghast, its eyes human-like, filled with anticipation and trust, believing Wang Pings words. It squawked, hoping that Wang Ping would aid its owner, Wu Yueming..

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that the beast taming system in this world is quite interesting. After signing a contract with a tamed beast, one could obtain part of the beast’s abilities. Physical strength and vitality can also be enhanced.”
Wang Ping scanned Wu Yuemings body with his spiritual sense and got a general idea of the power system in this world, somewhat surprised.
Subsequently, Wang Pings Water Attribute Spirit was mobilized to neutralize the severe poison in Wu Yuemings body.
Then, he transformed it into Wood Attribute Spirit to replenish the lost vitality inside Wu Yuemings body.
While Wang Ping was doing all this, the ferocious beasts from behind were catching up, their eyes vicious and launching various attacks at Wang Ping and the blue bird.
In response, the blue bird revealed an anxious expression.
“Chirp.”
Wang Pings eyes were cold as he looked at these ferocious beasts. Those attacks dissipated mysteriously.
Soon after, these ferocious beasts stiffened and exploded, raining down on the earth.
The blue bird noticed this scene and was completely stunned and astonished.
As a spiritual beast, her intelligence was naturally high. Although not as high as an adult human, she still had the intelligence of a ten-year-old child.
In her cognition, humans could reinforce their physique by obtaining a part of their spiritual beasts’ power through contracts.
Some powerful beast tamers could indeed fight against spiritual beasts with their own strength.
However, that was only for low-level spiritual beasts or ferocious beasts.
As for someone like Wang Ping, who could glance at them and instantly shatter those fourth-rank ferocious beasts, she had never seen anything like it before, and it wasn’t present in her inherited knowledge.
This seemed to go against common sense and broke her understanding of spiritual beasts.
Was this really a human being?
Who exactly was the spiritual beast in this situation?
At this moment, in the besieged city below, some beast tamers had also noticed the situation in the sky and were shocked, some even with their worldview shattered.
However, the intelligence of beast tamers was much higher, and they associated it with some special spiritual beasts.
Therefore, they believed that even if they hadn’t seen Wang Pings spiritual beast, there must be one hidden by his side.
Either it was a special type of spiritual beast or an assassination-type spiritual beast.
Of course, its extraordinary strength which could instantly kill so many fourth-rank ferocious beasts was undoubtedly powerful.
They had begun to suspect that Wang Ping was a fifth-rank beast tamer.
If Wang Ping really was a fifth-rank beast tamer, it seemed like they might be saved.
Although a fifth-rank beast tamer was not able to suppress the Beast Tide, their arrival could still protect and ensure their safe departure from this place. In the Beast Tide, fourth-rank and fifth-rank ferocious beasts also noticed Wang Pings presence, they stopped and stared at him with uncertainty and suspicion.
Especially the fifth-rank ferocious beasts, when they stared at Wang Ping, they felt an instinctual fear.
Ferocious beasts had undoubtedly much keener senses, which were their unique traits.
When a mouse sees a cat, its body trembles in fear.
When other animals encounter a tiger for the first time, even if they have never seen a tiger before, they will instinctively fear it.
As a result, they were getting a little scared.
There was no doubt that this human was extremely terrifying.
For a moment, the ferocious beasts that had initiated the Beast Tide hesitated on whether to retreat.
“Mr. Wang…”
Wu Yueming woke up after he was cured and looked at Wang Ping with astonishment.
Then he remembered his encounters and instantly realized what had happened.
“Thank you, Mr. Wang, for saving me,” said Wu Yueming with gratitude.
If Wang Ping hadn’t come, he might have died this time.
Not long after his arrival in this new world, he had integrated into it and met a benefactor who discovered his beast taming talent and brought him to the Beast Taming Academy in the city below for special training.
However, he never expected the Beast Tide mentioned in the books would appear so suddenly in the city he was staying in.
The city’s defense system was easily dismantled by the terrifying Beast Tide, followed by a massacre.
He could have escaped, but because his benefactor was killed, he fought ferociously against the beasts in anger, and ended up getting poisoned by a poisonous beast and falling unconscious.
“Do you need me to help?”
Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say much but looked at the Beast Tide below that was still wreaking havoc.
“If you can, please help us, Mr. Wang,” said Wu Yueming, gritting his teeth and staring at the Beast Tide below with a face full of hatred.
His friends from these past days, the teachers who taught him cultivation, his benefactors—all of them had died.
Even he himself had almost died.
Undoubtedly, he harbored deep hatred towards these ferocious beasts.
Wang Ping nodded, looking down at the ferocious beasts below and slightly raised his palm.
As he did, the sky was filled with dense longswords made of Spiritual Energy, covering the entire sky, appearing extremely shocking.
At this sight, all the surviving human beast tamers and the ferocious beast were stunned and frightened.
Showcasing humanlike fear, the ferocious beasts stopped hunting humans and chose to flee instead.
However, it was all in vain.
The spiritual energy longswords in the sky suddenly shot out like torrential sword rain, piercing through tens of thousands of ferocious beasts and killing them accurately.
In just one second, all the ferocious beasts were exterminated, and their bright-colored blood stained the ground, making it particularly conspicuous under the setting sun.
“Done.” Wang Ping retrieved his palm and spoke indifferently..

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_2
Translator: 549690339
The Sword Riding Skill was just a Lower Earth-Tier Martial Skill which he hadn’t used for a long time.
Although he could easily suppress and kill these Ferocious Beasts with his imposing aura, there were still innocent people here, so using the Sword Riding Skill to kill them precisely one by one was the best choice.
“So strong!’
Wu Yueming was shocked when he saw this scene.
Although he had already learned in the group chat that Wang Pings strength had reached the Six-Star Tier, he had never witnessed Wang Pings fighting, so his understanding was only based on numbers.
Now, witnessing Wang Pings move, he finally had a clearer concept.
Of course, Wu Yueming didn’t know that Wang Ping had been holding back. Otherwise, with his current strength, he could have destroyed a small nation in an instant.
Right now, Wang Ping was just killing some fourth or fifth-tier Ferocious Beasts. It was as easy as crushing vegetables.
However, not only was Wu Yueming amazed, but the Azure Bird and the other living people had also revealed shocked expressions.
This power was so overwhelming that they suspected Wang Ping must be a 6th Tier Beast Master.
The 6th Tier was a Master-level Beast Master, one of the cornerstones of the Human Alliance.
Now, they were fortunate to see one, feeling truly honored.
“What exactly is the situation in your world? I don’t mind helping you solve some problems before I leave since I came here.” Wang Ping asked with both hands on his hips.
“Actually, it seems that the situation of humans in our world is not optimistic. In this world, humans can make contracts with Spiritual Beasts and some special Ferocious Beasts, commanding them to fight to protect their homeland,” Wu Yueming said helplessly and with hatred.
“However, it’s not just the domestic Ferocious Beasts that humans have to face. Recently, there appeared a Spatial Crack, and some Ferocious Beasts from other worlds also descended on our world, causing the pressure on humans to skyrocket, and many places have lost their defensive power,” he continued.
“l see. Spatial Cracks and Ferocious Beasts from other worlds…”
Wang Ping showed a thoughtful expression.
Ferocious Beasts from the Exoteric World appearing in this world, but there were no Group Tasks?
What’s going on?
“These so-called Exoteric Worlds’ are part of this world, not external domains,” explained Alpha in a cold and emotionless voice.
“l see,” Wang Ping understood the reason and didn’t think any further.
After all, it was the same logic as some secret realms in the Profound World.
Outside the big world, there were many small worlds attached to the big world.
Some of these small worlds were called secret realms and also contained powerful creatures.
“l thought 1 could pick up a task, but it seems I was overthinking,” Wang Ping thought with some regret.
“It’s not a waste. Humans are a special race. If you can save a world where humans are about to be destroyed, you can also earn Group points,” Alpha explained.
“Wait, if you say so, shouldn’t I be able to exploit a bug? Pretend to have an intention to exterminate humans, then save some humans. Alpha, do you think the World Consciousness can be deceived?” Wang Pings eyes lit up, and he was looking forward to it.
Alpha was silent.
You said that l, Alpha, have a dark heart, but you are the one who truly has a dark heart, trying to exploit the resources of various worlds.
“It’s impossible,” Alpha said coldly and emotionlessly. “Self-directed plays are useless.’
“Alright, I was actually just joking, I didn’t mean that,” Wang Ping said casually, unfazed.
Alpha ignored Wang Ping and submerged himself again.
“Wu Yueming, what is the strength of the strongest person in your world? And do the Beast Tamers in your world have any special abilities?”
Wang Ping turned to Wu Yueming with anticipation.
As a post-90s person, Wang Ping was very fond of Pokémon and Beast Tamers in his previous life.
If there were powerful Beast Tamers in this world that could help him, he wouldn’t mind keeping a few.
Having more systems simply meant having more paths to explore, he thought.
With the Life Simulator, it was easy for Wang Ping to walk multiple paths.
“Uh, I don’t have much information, and I don’t know the specific situation,” Wu Yueming hesitated, then smiled bitterly.
“However, according to the standards of the chat group, the high-end combat Skill of our world… might be terrifying,” he added, after hesitating for a moment.
“In our world, Beast Tamer levels go from 1 to 9, then we have the Crown Beast Masters and God-tier Beast Masters. It is said that the God-tier Beast Masters’ beasts have the terrifying power to destroy planets. I wonder if it’s true. ”
“Apart from that, our world’s special Beast Tamers’ abilities are also quite terrifying. Many of them involve time and space, while some even deal with luck and causality.” Wang Ping: .
Wang Ping was silent.
He thought that the level of Wu Yuemings world wouldn’t be too high.
As it turned out, he seemed to have overestimated himself.
Did this look low?
This was simply too exaggerated.
He never expected that there would be Star-breaking tier beings in this world. “l thought I could act cool in this world, and maybe see if I could take a few rare Beast Tamers with me. It seems I should just be good and take my leave, lest I get caught by some perverts and be killed,” Wang Ping thought, feeling a bit tired.
Having just reached the Profound Elixir Realm, he was feeling a bit too confident and wanted to show off..

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 127: The Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 127: The Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_3
Translator: 549690339
Indeed, I should maintain a low profile.
Being pretentious can easily lead to trouble, and he didn’t want to end up suppressed like An Lan.
“Mr. Wang, would you like to stay here for a while? I would like to extend my hospitality to you.”
Wu Yueming politely asked.
“No need, you have just experienced all these things, your mind must be quite tired. You don’t have to worry about entertaining me,”
Wang Ping remained composed, patted Wu Yuemings shoulder, and said.
“Strive to become stronger. I believe in your potential.”
Wu Yuemings Golden Finger was very potent in this world.
Adding that the limit of this world was so high, Wang Ping felt that if Wu Yueming had good luck, he could quickly become a high-end combat skill member in the group.
“Yes, I will definitely strive to become stronger. The recent Beast Tide resulted in the death of all the people close to me, I don’t want to experience such a thing again.”
Wu Yueming clenched his fist.
“By the way, Mr. Wang, how many group points did it cost you to come to my world, I will return double next time.’
After a pause, Wu Yueming spoke.
“Not much, just about twenty thousand, you can pay it back whenever you can. For now, gather some group points to strengthen yourself. Moreover, even though you are a Beast Tamer, you can consider practicing other systems. As for elixirs, 1 have plenty.”
Wang Ping spoke.
“Thank you,” Wu Yueming gratefully nodded.
As expected of the acting group master, Mr. Wang, he truly acted like an elder brother. He not only saved him but also cared for him.
He had to remember all this kindness and find a way to repay Mr. Wang in the future.
“Then, I am leaving first. The next time I have the chance to visit your world, you can entertain me properly.”
Wang Ping smiled and prepared to teleport away.
“Okay, take care, Mr. Wang. By the way, Mr. Wang, if I capture any rare beasts in the future, I will surely reserve it for you.”
Wu Yueming nodded and remembered Wang Pings previous inquiry about unique beasts. He quickly promised.
Wang Ping patted Wu Yueming’s shoulder for the last time, then quietly murmured a few words before leaving the Beast Taming World.
“Did I come too late?”
Not long after Wang Ping left, an illusory figure emerged from the space, looking at where Wang Ping had been and squinting his eyes.
Then, the illusory figure took a deep look at Wu Yueming, and the space around him became hazy, his entire figure disappearing, as if nothing had happened.
At this moment, Wang Ping had returned to his own world and had opened the chat group.
In the chat group, Wu Yueming was expressing his thanks to Wang Ping, boasting about how incredible Wang Ping was, effortlessly annihilating the Beast Tide, which stirred discussions among the group members.
Qin Tian (77): “Humph, that’s nothing, this is not the limit of Mr. Wangs strength. He didn’t even display one percent of his real strength.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “l agree. The last battle was incredible. I suspect that Mr. Wangs cultivation has reached the half step Profound Elixir Realm in their world.’
Xu Yi (84): “The Profound World is so terrifying. Is a half-step Profound Elixir realm so strong? He easily killed a monster with a close to seven-star strength rating.”
Fang Yun (3): “After all, it’s the Profound World, so being so strong is normal. I have to say, the system from Mr. Wangs world that I am practicing now is great. Damn, I never want to touch the internal power of the Swordsman World, it makes me feel like vomiting blood.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Fang Yun, what is your current level of cultivation?”
Fang Yun (3): “Hehe, not too strong, just the Mid-Skin Refining Stage!’
Cai Yonglong (1):”????”
Liu Mei (15): :”????”
Wang Ping (66): “What kind of freakish cultivation speed is that, you’ve only improved this much in a day, you’ve reached the Mid-Skin Refining Stage already?”
As soon as Wang Ping entered the group and peeked, he saw Fang Yun’s message, and was completely shocked.
Although he knew Fang Yun’s Golden Finger was the type that enhanced cultivation efficiency, it was absurd that he could reach the Mid-Skin Refining Stage in just over a day.
Fang Yun (3): “Hehe, to tell the truth, I never thought my Golden Finger was this powerful. Perhaps 1 have a lot of talent for Cultivating in Mr. Wangs world’s system. Besides, the efficiency enhancement from the Golden Finger is really strong. and I regret not cultivating sooner. Of course. this has to do
with me dying once, as the stronger my desire to become stronger is, the more the cultivation efficiency increases.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn, I am so jealous. I used to worry that you wouldn’t take cultivation seriously and would die on a woman’s belly, now with your terrifying cultivation speed, you’ll probably catch up with me soon. I am freaking out.”
Zhang Jun (70): “It seems that some people do need to die once to unleash their true potential…”
Wang Ping (66): ‘Zhang Jun is correct, I totally agree.”
Wang Pings gaze became strange.
He had always felt that although Fang Yun’s Golden Finger seemed simple, it might not be that simple.
Now it seems, his guess was correct.
With Fang Yun’s freakish Cultivation speed, he might actually reach the Spiritual Origin Realm, or even the Transcendent Realm, in a short time.
Is this the bizarre achievement of the dream? Is this Fang Yun’s reward?
If it wasn’t for the capriciousness of the dream which killed Fang Yun numerous times, resulting in his complete death and resurrection by Wu Jun, how could he have such a strong desire to become stronger, and then fully unleash the potential of the Golden Finger..

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_4
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Hu (5): “As soon as I caught a glimpse of the screen and saw Fang Yun’s message, I was stunned. But, Mr.Cai, what does this mean? Are you afraid that your bro isn’t doing well and also afraid of him having a high-end car?
amusing.jpg.”
Mr.Cai (1) : “Enough, let me be still.”
Fang Yun (3) worry, Mr.Cai, I’ll support you in the future. Wait a minute, are you with Mr.Wang? I want to cling to his leg too! Envious.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66) :”Fang Yun, I’ll provide you with the cultivation resources before reaching the Transcendent Realm. However, once you reach the Transcendent Realm, you’ll have to get your own resources. Of course, if you perform well, I’ll fetch them for you and sell them at a discounted price
Wang Ping pondered for a moment, and then spoke.
Fang Yun demonstrated his value, Wang Ping felt it was necessary to cultivate him further.
Otherwise, the lack of high-end combat skills within the group would make future group tasks very dangerous.
