This time, Alpha suggested three Six Tier participants for the task, but the group couldn’t put together a complete team, so Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan had to go instead.
As the acting group master, and the member considered as the older brother by the entire group, Wang Ping needed to train potential group members, while also motivating others.
By doing so, everyone in the group will understand that as long as they exhibit potential, they’ll receive focus and training.
As for the cultivation resource issue…
In Wang Pings current situation, resources before the Transcendent Realm were not that significant in his eyes.
As he continues to grow stronger, resources from the Transcendent Realm and beyond will also become less significant.
Fang Yun (3) :”Wow! I’m grateful, Mr. Wang! You are the only god in my heart! You are the Kami in my heart! Bootlicking.jpg!’
Cai Yonglong (1) :”Look, there’s a bootlicker.”
Fang Yun (3) :”(~- ~) Hmph~~, if you’re jealous, just say it straight,
Mr.Cai.”
Cai Yonglong (1) :”Tsk.”
Wang Ping (66) @Zhang Hu (5) :”Zhang Hu, how are your tasks going?”
Zhang Hu (5) :”To be honest, it’s a little bit troublesome. The Reincarnators are hiding very deep, scheming, so we can only wait patiently”
Wang Ping (66) :”I see, be careful you guys, Reincarnators certainly will not be easy to deal with. 2 Tier Reincarnators can cooperate and fight 3th-Tier powerhouses in Liu Mei’s World, and the Reincarnators in your world have a very high combat skill, so you must be cautious.”
Zhang Hu (5) :”We know. Although we don’t know where the Reincarnators are hiding or what they’re planning, we have made some moves on our side as well. Chen Yao has been adding more forces from High Martial World System, imprisoned evil Martial Master, and became a Martial Master.”
Wang Ping (66) : “That’s not bad.”
Wang Ping felt a bit emotional.
Wang Ping thought he progressed very quickly, but Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan were even more promising.
Lin Yuanyuan’s golden finger was perfect for skyrocketing to success.
As for Chen Yao, as long as resources were plentiful, she could level up and cultivate various power systems at an incredible rate, having amazing potential.
Of course, in this respect, Qin Tian was not inferior either. With his Immortal Tao Fruits, he could also easily reach the Immortal tier as long as he had enough resources, but his master wouldn’t allow him to do so.
Moreover, obtaining resources was also a problem.
Now, Fang Yun had also shown terrifying cultivating speed, his future was bright.
Everyone in the group was getting stronger at a rapid pace, and Wang Ping was feeling the pressure.
Although he hoped that the group members would become stronger, everyone had a competitive spirit, and he had been in the strongest position in the chat group for some time, and he didn’t want to be surpassed.
Not to mention, as the acting group master, he also needed to secure his position as the strongest.
Otherwise, he did not know what kind of idea Alpha would come up with.
However, despite the sense of urgency, Wang Ping was not panicked.
With the Life Simulator and so many resources in his hands, it was quite easy for him to level up quickly.
Next, Wang Ping did not say much, choosing to lay low.
As long as nothing went wrong with Chen Yao’s team, he did not need to go there.
“System, how many Spiritual Stones do 1 need to pay for a new simulation?” Wang Ping asked in his mind after he came back to his senses.
“Ding! Detecting that the host has entered the first tier of the Profound Elixir Realm, a paid simulation will require 50,000 high-tier spirit stones or 500 top-tier spirit stones.”
The sound of the Life Simulator’s system rang out, silencing Wang Ping.
“Damn, that is extremely expensive, escalating a hundredfold.”
Wang Ping was flabbergasted.
It only took 500 high-tier spirit stones for the half step Profound Elixir Realm, but once he reached the Profound Elixir Realm, it jumped to 50,000.
However, considering the gap between the half step Profound Elixir Realm and the Profound Elixir Realm, the cost of 50,000 high-tier spirit stones might be reasonable.
“The spirit stones I have aren’t enough for a paid simulation anymore. It seems I’ll have to go out and earn some spirit stones. The best place to earn a large number of high-tier spirit stones is Sacred Heart Island, I’ll go there.” Wang Ping stroked his chin, deep in thought.
“By the way, I need to get a Profound-tier Longsword as well. Otherwise, it would feel unnatural.’
“But before going to Sacred Heart Island, I’ll try a free simulation first.”
Having thought it through, Wang Ping made a decision and said in his mind.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
“Ding! Free simulation started, host has eight remaining free attempts..”

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 127: Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World_5
Translator: 549690339
The system’s cold voice sounded, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared with the text emerging.
[On the first day, you left the Profound Turtle Continent and went to Sacred Heart Island.]
[You auctioned the Sea and Sky Staff at the Ice Palace Auction on Sacred Heart Island, successfully obtaining 500,000 High-Tier Spirit Stones. Because your cultivation reached the Profound Elixir Realm, no one attacked you, and you received the corresponding Spirit Stones.]
[Later, you bought some Treasure Medicine and Top-Tier Spiritual Stones and other cultivation resources on Sacred Heart Island, and then you returned to Profound Turtle Continent. You cultivated in seclusion on the Profound
Turtle Continent while putting all your efforts into training Ye Chen and Bai
Tianhong, treating them as your own.]
[Of course, you didn’t give up on Cai Yonglong. After thinking for a long time, you finally chose to let Cai Yonglong practice Demonic Skill. However, you didn’t intend to let him practice Demonic Skill immediately but planned to wait until Ye Chen successfully embarked on the path of a Son of Fortune.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly twenty years passed. Over the years, you went back to the Chi Clan and tried to bring Ye Chen to Chi Village, hoping to see if Ye Chen could have any chemical reaction in Chi Village. However, you were disappointed. Although the relationship between Ye Chen and Chifeng developed well, nothing special happened.]
[Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and Ye Chen obtained the Life and Death Realm Inheritance and bid farewell to you.]
[That same year, you took Bai Tianhong to Sacred Heart Island to wait for the white-haired Old Lady. And you took Cai Yonglong to Heavenly Sea Country.]
[After arriving in Heavenly Sea Country, you gave the Demonic Skill to Cai Yonglong to practice. It’s worth mentioning that Cai Yonglong could have broken through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm a long time ago, but you stopped him, intending to let him directly condense a Demonic Body when converting to the Demonic Skill practice.]
[With your help, Cai Yonglong successfully turned to practicing Demonic Skill.
You started to hunt secretly in Heavenly Sea Country. With the help of
Demonic Skill, Cai Yonglongs strength improved rapidly. However, because
you were careful enough, Cai Yonglong’s speed of becoming stronger was still slower than when you followed Blood Demon Yuan Feng.]
[You were careful enough to handle the scenes well. As a result, although powerful individuals disappeared from time to time, causing suspicion and unease among ordinary Profound Elixir Realm masters, it did not attract the attention of the Yin and Yang Master.]
[Twenty years later, Cai Yonglongs cultivation reached the 4th Tier Profound
Elixir Realm. And your cultivation reached the 3rd Tier Profound Elixir Realm. However, even though your cultivation was not as good as Cai Yonglong, who practiced Demonic Skill, your combat prowess was unmatched by Cai Yonglong.]
[Next, you and Cai Yonglong entered the Purple Moon Secret Realm, following the opportunity lines on the disciples of the Great Sects to find opportunities.]
[Relying on Cai Yonglongs Golden Finger, you intercepted many opportunities in advance. You got a lot of good things, including many 8-Tier Treasure Elixirs and even a 9th tier Treasure Medicine. As a result, your cultivation improved. Cai Yonglongs cultivation reached the 5th Tier Profound Elixir Realm due to various opportunities and devouring powerful beings, and you also broke through to the 4th Tier Profound Elixir Realm.]
[Soon after, you followed the opportunity line and found the remains of a fallen Yin and Yang Master in the secret realm, along with the Storage Spirit Ring he carried.]
[Although the Treasure Medicine in the Storage Spirit Ring had lost their spirituality due to the passage of time, there were still a large number of Top-tier Spirit Stones and a Lower-tier Treasure inside. This was something that only Yin and Yang Masters were qualified to possess, and it had immense power for Profound Elixir Realm masters.]
[Your hearts were happy. Because it was a sword-type treasure, you took this treasure, and Cai Yonglong followed your lead without any complaints.]
[When you picked up this treasure, you triggered the option of the unstable Optimizer, which you hadn’t used in a long time. You hesitated whether to optimize it.]
[Finally, you made up your mind and chose to optimize. However, you failed in the optimization, and the Lower-tier Treasure turned into a Profound instrument, causing your mental state to collapse. Cai Yonglong also became confused, staring at you with big eyes.]
[You were very depressed and took out a Profound instrument treasure armor from the Storage Spirit Ring. This time, you triggered the optimization option again and hesitated in your heart. In the end, you felt that a Profound instrument was not worth much and chose to optimize it.]
[This time, you successfully completed the positive optimization. The
Profound instrument treasure armor was successfully optimized into a treasure. You were overjoyed and felt you made a big profit. After all, defensive treasures are more precious than weapons.]
[However, you felt that the unstable Optimizer talent indeed had the potential to turn people into gamblers and reminded yourself to be cautious. In the future, if you encounter something useful to you, you should consider it carefully unless necessary; otherwise, it would be a significant loss.]
[On the contrary, if it’s a relatively low-level item, like a Profound instrument, even though it’s precious, it can still be optimized. Even if it develops negatively, it would only cause heartache, not a devastating loss. And if it’s accidentally optimized positively, it would be getting a treasure for free, making a big profit.]
[Cai Yonglong was surprised to see the Profound instrument turn into a treasure and asked you curiously if you had obtained a new Golden Finger.
You gave a vague answer, and Cai Yonglong didn’t ask any further questions.]
[Just as you were preparing to leave, the real owner of the opportunity discovered you. He also found the remains of the Yin and Yang Master and was shocked and angry, feeling he had missed the opportunity. He immediately attacked you..]

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 127: The Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World 6
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 127: The Flawless Profound Elixir! The Terrifying Beast Taming World 6
Translator: 549690339
[This cultivator is from a Great Sect with strong cultivation, he has reached the 7th-Tier Profound Elixir Realm. However, you, and Cai Yonglong are not ordinary cultivators. When working together, you easily defeated him, forcing him to use his Secret Skill to escape.]
[You never anticipated that his escape technique would be so strong, leaving you no choice but to abandon the pursuit. However, you realized clearly that now Cai Yonglongs identity as a demonic cultivator has been exposed, you must proceed with extreme caution in your future actions.]
[Because the entire Purple Spirit Realm holds extreme hatred towards demonic cultivators, they won’t rest until they have them dead.]
[However, you were not overly worried, because the Secret Skill given to you by Ye Chen was very advanced. Even masters in the Life and Death Realm wouldn’t be able to see through the Profound Turtle Spirit on your body, let alone see through the energy of a demonic cultivator. As long as you did not make a move, it would not be easy to expose your identity.]
[Regarding the issue of appearance and name, you had already changed them and adopted pseudonyms, making it difficult for anyone to trace your identity.]
[Next, you planned to continue snooping on people with opportunities in order to snatch those opportunities. Despite succeeding in stealing some people’s luck, you didn’t garner as much of a harvest as before.]
[In the end, as loose cultivators, the opportunities you could snatch were limited. Those successors from major sects and true inheritor disciples possess various lifesaving techniques given by their elders. Once used, they can easily kill you.]
[After some thought, you abandoned the idea of stealing others’ opportunities. Instead, you chose a secluded place and planned to take some time to assimilate the opportunities you’d obtained and increase your strength.]
[Half a month later, taking advantage of various opportunities you had snatched, you improved your cultivation once again. Your cultivation reached the 5th Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm. As for Cai Yonglong, he felt that as a demonic cultivator, consuming treasures and 8-tier elixirs would be a waste. He preferred to absorb more cultivators, so he didn’t consume any treasures or elixirs, and you did not object.]
[Next, you heard an uproar. You knew the true struggle for great opportunities was about to begin. Since you did not encounter Ling Xue this time, you dared not approach to watch the fight. You even had to stay far away, or you would risk being injured just from the aftermath of the battles.]
[Still, you were not worried about not being able to find Ye Chen. Because you have Ye Chen’s Message Talisman for contact.]
[In the end, Ye Chen successfully seized the opportunity. You met up with him successfully. Ye Chen was surprised that Cai Yonglong had become a demonic cultivator, but he didn’t say much.]
[Next, Ye Chen let you touch the Nirvana Fruit. However, after touching it, you triggered the Optimization Option which made you suspect if the chances of triggering it increase when you come in contact with more advanced objects.]
[However, since it was Ye Chen’s Nirvana Fruit, you dared not attempt optimization and chose to decline. Afterward, Ye Chen passed on a portion of the Nirvana Realm Inheritance to you, and you left the Purple Moon Secret Realm together.]
[You and Ye Chen went your separate ways again. You also found a secluded spot, where you planned to deal with this round of gains. Besides, you were starting to cultivate using the Wind and Thunder Skill as well as consume the Nirvana Fruit.]
[The Nirvana Fruit, you had procrastinated till today to eat it just so you could wait to obtain the Wind and Thunder Skill. Now that you have it, you felt it was the right time to consume the fruit.]
[However, when you were ready to practice the Wind and Thunder Skill and the Optimization Option appeared once again. You stiffened, unsure whether to optimize it.]
[However, you remembered that the cultivation skill could continue to be practiced even after copying, it seemed that the price was negligible. Based on this, you decided to optimize. Eventually, the Wind and Thunder skill was successfully optimized into a Primordial Spirit Skill suitable for you.]
[Although it was still a Heaven-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skill, it now allowed you to cultivate all attributes simultaneously, improving its effectiveness substantially. You had a moment of enlightenment, realizing the improvement brought by optimization was not just limited to boosting the item’s tier; other aspects could be optimized as well.]
[In your heart, you admired it, feeling you had underestimated this Red Talent.]
[Next, you practiced the Primordial Spirit Skill, swallowed the Nirvana Fruit, and successfully elevated your Profound Elixir Tier to the rank of Flawless Profound Elixir, transforming your physical constitution to that of Primordial
Spirit Body. Your current Primordial Spirit Body includes the attributes of
Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, and Thunder.]
[Because your Profound Elixir Tier had risen from Ist-tier to the level of Flawless Profound Elixir, you were amazed to discover that the quality of the Spiritual Essence in your body had increased several times, which was truly terrifying.]
[However, due to your Profound Elixir Tier reaching the Flawless Profound Elixir level, a large number of phenomena appeared in the sky, attracting the attention of many nearby cultivators. Many cultivators were shocked to the extreme when they saw the heavenly phenomena.]
[Then, they became delirious, thinking that Heaven and Earth Treasures were being born, and rushed over here one after another.]
[Coming out of your astonishment over the Profound Elixir Tier, you realized your situation was not good. You quickly took Cai Yonglong and fled far away from there.]
[Shortly after, the place where you were was discovered by many cultivators. They broke the Great Array, and even a Yin and Yang Master made an appearance.]
[You know you can’t stay in the Heavenly Sea Country for now, and even the neighboring countries are not safe. So you decided to return to Sacred Heart Island.]
[Next, you prepared to retreat once more, planning to comprehend the Divine
Skills through the Wind and Thunder Giant Handprint. But you triggered the option again. You hesitated for a long time, but felt that the chance of optimization was rather high, so you chose to optimize.]
[Unfortunately, you failed in the optimization attempt. The Divine Skill –
Wind and Thunder Palm Imprint was destroyed and could not be practiced again. You felt helpless, thinking that you had been too optimistic.]
[However, while you cannot copy Divine Skills and only memories can be passed down, you still have a copy from Cai Yonglong, which can be used to make references, so you were not particularly upset.]
[Half a year later, the Hundred Dynasties War began. This time, neither you nor Cai Yonglong had any interest in joining the commotion. You know very well that meddling might lead to death.]
[Of course, you’ve also considered whether your present Flawless Profound Elixir Tier would draw the attention of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master, so as not to use you as bait anymore. After all, Flawless Profound Elixirs are rare. Any cultivator who could condense a Flawless Profound Elixir would be considered a prodigy with the Presence of a King at the very least in the eyes of ordinary people.]
[Of course, these were just thoughts, you didn’t have the courage to stake your life on it. You didn’t like leaving your fate and safety in the hands of others..]

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
[Next, you and Cai Yonglong returned to Sacred Heart Island. You felt that you had already possessed enough resources on you, and there was no need to continue seeking adventures and opportunities outside. It would be better to focus on cultivation.]
[Because of the Nirvana Fruit, your aptitude had improved greatly, and as a result, your cultivation speed had increased significantly. But because you congealed a Flawless Profound Elixir, although the Spiritual Essence quality within the Profound Elixir was many times greater than that of ordinary cultivators, giving you unparalleled power within the same cultivation realm, it also required a greater amount of energy to improve your cultivation. With both these factors canceling out, your cultivation progress had not improved much compared to before.]
[However, you weren’t worried at all. As a cultivator in the Profound Elixir Realm, you had a lifespan of a thousand years, giving you plenty of time to improve your cultivation and eventually stepping into the Yin Yang Realm.]
[Five years passed, and your cultivation had improved, but you had not broken through to the 6th Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm. As for Cai
Yonglong, during these five years, he had said goodbye to you and went on his own adventure in the Eastern Desolation. Since he took the Demon Path, he had to kill and devour others in order to improve his cultivation quickly. Although he could also cultivate alone, Cai Yonglong, having experienced the ease of improving his cultivation, couldn’t calm down and cultivate anymore.]
[You noticed the changes in Cai Yonglongs attitude and felt that he would sooner or later encounter troubles, easily falling into the demonic state and experiencing a drastic change in his personality. But you also knew that you were no longer capable of persuading Cai Yonglong, and could only hope that he wouldn’t fall into the demonic state completely.]
[Another ten years passed, and your cultivation had improved to the 6th Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm. Meanwhile, even on Sacred Heart Island, you heard the news that Ye Canghai, who was Ye Chen, had become the seventh Saint Son of Heavenly Sword Divine Land, which amazed you.]
[However, what surprised and puzzled you was that Ji Bingyue, who was on par with Ye Chen, did not become a Holy Woman, but had unexpectedly perished instead. This left you very confused because, in your ‘memory,’ such
an event had never occurred.]
[Of course, you also realized that just because your memory didn’t record such an event, it didn’t mean it hadn’t happened in a previous cycle. At that time, you didn’t know that Ji Bingyue was Bing Ningyue, so even if she had fallen, you wouldn’t have cared too much.]
[You remembered your guess that Ji Bingyue might be the Daughter of
Fortune, sighed, and thought that you were overthinking. If she was truly the
Daughter of Fortune, she wouldn’t have perished.]
[Following this, you continued to cultivate with Bai Tianhong, planning to venture out again to gather cultivation resources after you had exhausted your current supply.]
[Time flew by, and another twenty years passed. Your cultivation had steadily progressed to the 7th Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm, becoming a powerful late-stage Profound Elixir Realm cultivator.]
[It was during this year that Cai Yonglong returned to Sacred Heart Island and met you. You looked at Cai Yonglong and found that you couldn’t perceive his cultivation strength, which surprised you. At the same time, you noticed that Cai Yonglongs eyes were even colder, and his demonic aura was becoming difficult to suppress. You knew his situation seemed to be getting worse.]
[Because of this, you advised Cai Yonglong not to be too obsessed with cultivating demons and that he must cultivate his mind to avoid potential dangers. Cai Yonglong didn’t listen but instead revealed that he had reached the Yin Yang Realm. He felt that he was doing well and didn’t need your concern.]
[Amazed that Cai Yonglong had actually reached the Yin Yang Mirror, you sighed in your heart, knowing that Cai Yonglong was likely on the verge of falling completely into the demonic state. However, since Cai Yonglong had reached the Yin Yang Mirror, even if you had congealed an Immaculate Profound Elixir and were capable of battling against heaven-defying talents with Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm, you couldn’t possibly be a match for a powerful Yin Yang Mirror cultivator. You could only watch as Cai Yonglong continued down the path of cultivation demons.]
[Then, Cai Yonglong handed you a Divine Skill Scroll. After opening the scroll, you were surprised to find that it was actually the Sword Divine Skill you needed.]
[Divine Skills were divided into tiers, namely: lower-tier Divine Skills, mid-tier Divine Skills, top-tier Divine Techniques, and Supreme Divine Skills. What Cai Yonglong gave you was a top-tier Divine Technique, a powerful
Divine Skill that even the Great Sects found difficult to possess.]
[You were surprised and overjoyed. You really needed this powerful Sword Divine Skill, and once you’d learned it, your battle power would increase. Even if you practiced someone else’s Divine Skill, which could only unleash a small
portion of its power, it would still be strong enough. At the same time, you could also use this Divine Skill to comprehend your own Divine Skills.]
[Over the years, you had been trying to create your own Divine Skill but found it difficult to achieve Entry Tier. With this Sword Divine Skill, you finally had a glimmer of hope.]
[In the end, after giving you the Divine Skill Scroll, Cai Yonglong didn’t say much and left.]
“Cai Yonglong has ultimately embarked on a road of no return. This Demonic Skill is not something one can casually cultivate.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content and sighed quietly.
Although demonic skills could make an individual become powerful quickly, their price was also apparent. One could easily fall into the demonic state and become extremely cold-blooded if not cautious.
However, Cai Yonglongs performance was still acceptable.
At least, Cai Yonglong was indeed a person who knew how to repay gratitude.
Even though he was obviously in a demonic state, he still thought of returning the favor and brought back a Divine Skill Scroll without intending to make a move against Wang Ping.
If he were truly ungrateful and merciless, once he neared falling into the demonic state after cultivating Demonic Skills, he would certainly attack Wang Ping and devour him completely.
After all, Ping had congealed an Immaculate Profound Elixir and had many valuable items on his person. Devouring him would bring immense benefits.
“l hope Cai Yonglong won’t meet a tragic end. Although the likelihood of that is slim..

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!) _2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping secretly thought in his heart.
With that in mind, he couldn’t let Cai Yonglong practice Demonic Skills in the future and had to ensure he trained normally to become stronger.
The Wind and Thunder skill might be a suitable arrangement for him.
A Heaven-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skill, combined with Cai Yonglongs own talent and the resources provided by Wang Ping, as well as his ‘Golden Finger’, could potentially allow Cai Yonglong to barely keep up with Wang Pings pace.
Even if he couldn’t keep up, as long as he was strong enough not to become a dead-end if he didn’t enter the secret realm, that would be enough.
If he became strong enough, the success rate of the two intercepting opportunities in the secret realm would also be very high.
Soon, Wang Ping converged his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, another four years have passed. The white-haired Old Lady appears on Sacred Heart Island, intending to take Bai Tianhong away.
You choose to risk stopping her. All these years, you have been by Bai
Tianhongs side, waiting for the white-haired Old Lady.]
[Although the white-haired Old Lady has killed ‘you’ in your memory, now that you have Congealed Immaculate Profound Elixir, you might get a chance to be swept away by her, thus learning about Bai Tianhong’s secret and being cultivated by the power behind her.]
[After protecting Bai Tianhong, the white-haired Old Lady doesn’t ignore you this time, but instead gazes at you in utter surprise. Although you didn’t reveal the Flawless Profound Elixir, she easily saw through your details and learned about the Immaculate Profound Elixir you had Congealed.]
[This truly surprised the white-haired Old Lady. A loose cultivator like you managing to Congeal the Flawless Profound Elixir is undoubtedly a shocking feat, as this is something that many Holy Children of the various Holy Lands have a hard time achieving.]
[In the end, the white-haired Old Lady treats you kindly, stating that she has no ill intentions towards Bai Tianhong and only wants to take him to where he belongs and awaken his true power. If you want to go, you can follow as well.]
[You are deeply moved by the words of the white-haired Old Lady. She is clearly very pragmatic. You were once a useless loose cultivator and entirely ignored by her. Now that you have Congealed the Flawless Profound Elixir, she is finally showing you such kindness and even wanting to take you along.]
[You do not refuse, choosing to go with the white-haired Old Lady in order to learn Bai Tianhongs secret and find out if it is as you have guessed.]
[The white-haired Old Lady takes you and Bai Tianhong away, effortlessly tearing apart space and stepping into it. Her skills are incredibly astonishing.
You both marvel at the Old Ladys methods and are curious about her cultivation.]
[The white-haired Old Lady informs you both that her cultivation is only at the Nirvana Boundary, which is nothing special. You are speechless hearing her words, as it’s quite pretentious to claim that the Nirvana Boundary is nothing significant.]
[The white-haired Old Lady shakes her head and smiles, warmly telling you that the Nirvana Boundary is nothing and that with your Congealed
Immaculate Profound Elixir, it’s quite possible for you to become a King in the future.]
[You do not respond, as only you know your true situation. Although you have achieved the Immaculate Profound Elixir through various means and great opportunities, your potential is not that strong. Your comprehension is lacking, and your bones have yet to truly reach the level of a Saint Child. How far you will go in the future is still uncertain.]
[Next, Bai Tianhong asks the white-haired Old Lady why she wants to take him away. After a moment of silence, she states that you will naturally know when you arrive at the location.]
[After a long time, you arrive at a strange valley. The surroundings of the valley are shrouded in layers of great arrays, making the outer world completely different from the inside.]
[After arriving here, you can feel the change in the density of Spiritual Energy.
The richness of Spiritual Energy here, although not as high as the Heavenly
Sword Divine City, is still several times higher than that of the Heavenly Sea
Country.]
[The white-haired Old Lady explains to you where you are. This place is Fengyuan Valley, their hidden home. At the same time, it is also the hidden home of the followers of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
[You shiver inwardly, finally confirming your guess. Indeed, Bai Tianhong was a descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and had the latter’s bloodline within him.]
[From there, the white-haired Old Lady takes you to meet the Valley Master, who is in charge of this place. The Valley Master is an old man named Bai Ya, who also has the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s bloodline. You guess that his cultivation has reached the terrifying King Realm.]
[Next, Bai Tianhong learns about his identity, and you both discover more hidden secrets from ancient times. After the Guilt-Punishing Emperor suddenly fled, his followers did not escape but continued to fight to the death. Most of them died in battle.]
[Hearing the Valley Master’s description, you are puzzled and ask why the
Guilt-Punishing Emperor suddenly fled from the battlefield, which doesn’t fit his character. In addition, you also don’t understand why the major Holy
Lands wanted to chase and kill the remnants.]
[Bai Ya shakes his head, explaining that it was not all of the Holy Lands who were chasing and killing the remnants, but rather some hostile Holy Lands, enemies, and members of the Demon Cult. This was because the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was a righteous man who spent his life punishing evildoers and fighting demons. Such actions naturally offended many powerful people and factions.]
[Bai Ya continues to explain that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s cultivation and combat power were unrivaled, and when he was at his peak, the weaker factions would naturally have to retreat. However, after an accident in his battle against the Demon Emperor and the accusation of fleeing from battle and almost causing the death of all living beings in the Purple Spirit Realm, opportunistic enemies chose to take their revenge.]
[You are shocked to learn the true character of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor for the first time. Bai Tianhong is also shocked, never imagining that his background and ancestor would be like this..]

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 296 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
Chapter 296: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
Translator: 549690339
[Next, Bai Ya sighed deeply, recounting his grandfather’s legendary experience. The Guilt-Punishing Emperor did not come from any major powers; he was initially an ordinary man in a small country. After his parents were wrongly killed, he himself was almost abused to death by evildoers. Therefore, he vowed to become an official to punish the wicked and promote the good once he grew up.]
[Eventually, his grandfather discovered that as an official, he could only save a small part of the people. So, he chose to resign from his post and learn martial arts in middle age. Miraculously, he rose all the way to become the emperor, establishing the most powerful Guilt-Punishing Holy Land. During his reign, the Central Continent was at its most peaceful, with all evildoers being suppressed.]
[When the Blood Demon Clan invaded, his grandfather was always at the forefront, leading the mighty warriors of the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land to fight the blood demons without rest.]
[Listening to the life experience of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, you were awed. The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was indeed a legendary figure. Such a character could never flee in the face of battle.]
[You earnestly asked why the senior Guilt-Punishing Emperor fled in the end.
Bai Ya fell silent and then only uttered four words: Body Possession, Curse.]
[A chill ran down your spine, and you immediately thought of the curse on the Chi Clan. Was it the same situation as the Chi Clan?]
[Next, Bai Ya told you the truth. When the Guilt-Punishing Emperor first battled the Demon Emperor, he was suddenly taken over by a strange entity and almost struck his fellows. As a result, his grandfather wrestled for control of his body, forcibly withdrew from the battlefield, and sealed himself in cooperation with the Profound Turtle inside the Profound Turtle’s internal space, preventing the entity from succeeding in its plot.]
[However, although the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was sealed, another thing emerged soon after: the curse. As long as one has the bloodline of the
Guilt-Punishing Emperor, a mysterious curse would appear. This curse would cause the bloodline owner to become demon-possessed and turn into a ruthless killing machine.]
[Your heart was chilled as you finally understood the reason why all the major powers tacitly allowed cultivators to hunt down the ‘Sinful Bloodline
Descendants.’ It turned out that a curse appeared on the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants,’ and if they were not killed, it would cause great harm to the people.]
[However, another question arose in your heart. Why were Bai Ya and Bai Tianhong not affected? And, why did so many related to the Guilt-Punishing
Emperor flee to the Profound Turtle?]
[Bai Ya sighed, explaining that the only reason he was unaffected was because of his powerful cultivation, combined with layers of arrays and treasures, barely suppressing the curse. Once he leaves this place, the curse will break out within a month.]
[Besides, he must hibernate, only awakening once every hundred years. The reason he asked the white-haired Old Lady to bring Bai Tianhong was that he had just awakened recently and sensed Bai Tianhong, who has the same bloodline, leaving the Profound Turtle. Hence, he sent the white-haired Old Lady to bring him back.]
[As for why Bai Tianhong was not affected, it was because his cultivation had not yet reached the Profound Elixir Realm. Once it does, the curse will immediately erupt, causing him to become demon-possessed.]
[As for some people fleeing to the Profound Turtle, it was because one shouldn’t put all of their eggs in one basket. It’s safer on the Profound Turtle than here.]
[In fact, apart from this valley, there were other Hermit’s Land. However, after so many years, the rest of the Hermit’s Land were discovered and destroyed by others.]
[Upon hearing the truth, you were chilled to the bone. The curse was so malicious that even King Realm Masters had to rely on so many means to avoid demon possession. Moreover, the enemies of the Guilt-Punishing
Emperor really wanted to obliterate his bloodline and the related people.]
[Afterward, the kind-hearted and powerful Bai Ya continued to reveal some secrets to you before letting you go, as he had to hibernate again.]
[It left you feeling a sense of melancholy. A great King Realm Master could only sleep here for a century, awakening at such infrequent intervals. It was truly tragic.]
[Soon after, Bai Tianhongs true bloodline power and abilities were awakened by the people in the valley. You were very curious; wouldn’t activating the bloodline trigger the curse? However, you thought that the people in the valley would surely know about this. Since they had done it, there must be no problem.]
[Or perhaps, the curse was the same whether you activated the bloodline or not. Once you reached the Profound Elixir Realm. the curse would erupt in the
outer world, causing demon possession. As a result, it would be better to have a higher cultivation so one could try to suppress the curse.]
“So, that’s the truth…
Wang Ping watched the simulated scenes, secretly sighing.
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was actually possessed, and a bloodline curse appeared, leaving a terrible legacy for future generations. No wonder those Holy Lands had such an attitude.
As for the related people, they were targeted by the enemies of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was bright and upright, desiring to rid the world of sin. With such a nature, many people would undoubtedly follow him willingly, but he also offended many powers.
At his peak, no one dared to do anything to him.
But, when the Blood Demon Clan invaded, and he was suddenly possessed by a strange entity, he ended up like this. Those evildoers naturally took the opportunity to strike.
Those who couldn’t stand light acted without restraint.
And those Holy Lands with grudges, fearing for their reputation, would not attack him openly but probably made black moves secretly..

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 297 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
Chapter 297: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
As a result, the descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor ended up in such a situation.
Those involved were even more miserable.
“Wait, possessed by the mysterious force!”
Suddenly, it seemed as if Wang Ping thought of something, and his pupils contracted abruptly.
“Alpha, don’t tell me that this world has already encountered the mysterious
force, and the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was possessed by it, which is why this situation occurred.’
Wang Ping felt a chill in his heart and asked inwardly.
“Correct. The Guilt- Punishing Emperor was the target of the mysterious force’s possession. However, the emperor’s cultivation was terrifying, and his path was the most restraining one for evil spirits, so he was not immediately possessed successfully.”
Alpha’s cold and emotionless voice sounded.
“But, the mysterious force is still the mysterious force. Even though the Guilt- Punishing Emperor’s cultivation was terrifying and his path was the most restraining for evil spirits and the Demon Clan, it was still no match for the force’s possession. He could only regain part of his body’s control at the critical moment, escape to the Profound Turtle, and seal himself within it. It was a move against the heavens.” “…So that’s what happened.”
Wang Ping fell silent.
So this was the truth?
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was possessed, and his body was on the verge of being snatched away. He had no choice but to retreat and seal himself inside the Profound Turtle.
If his body were to be snatched away by the mysterious force, the entire Purple Spirit Realm would be doomed.
The Blood Demon Clan was already powerful, and if the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was also possessed, combined with the force’s potential terrifying abilities, no one could resist.
Perhaps even the ‘Son of Fortune! who took over the battle afterward might not be able to turn the tide against the heavens.
“The Guilt m Punishing Emperor, an Emperor of a generation, a hero of his time, ended up like this. This mysterious force is truly despicable.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly, feeling very hostile towards the mysterious force.
They encountered one unsettling mysterious force after another, each time more terrifying than the last.
If it weren’t for his Life Simulator, he would have been done for.
“It seems, Alpha, that you think our strength is far from enough to deal with this mysterious force, which is why you haven’t issued the Group Task.” Wang Ping sighed again.
“Of course. Even if I issued the Group Task, you wouldn’t be able to complete it. Forcing you to complete it would only send you to your deaths.”
Alpha spoke coldly.
“Heh.” Wang Ping chuckled and didn’t say anything more about it.
“In that case, there must be quite a few examples of the mysterious forces being suppressed by the people in the original world.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and asked another question.
“Yes. Some powerful beings in the worlds are not aware of what the mysterious forces are, but they know that they are extremely dangerous and will naturally suppress them once discovered.”
Alpha gave an affirmative answer.
“However, there are also quite a few who, like the Light Lord God, knowingly take advantage of the forces despite realizing their danger.”
“As expected.”
Wang Ping nodded his head, unsurprised by Alpha’s answer.
“I really wonder how many Group points we could get if we could kill this mysterious force.”
Wang Ping thought greedily.
Of course, it was just a wishful thinking.
With his current strength, going there would be, as Alpha said, like sending himself to his death.
Even if he reached the Emperor tier, he wouldn’t be able to easily break the seal within the Profound Turtle.
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor was the strongest emperor of his time, a unique existence.
Even if he reached the Emperor tier, he might not be the Emperor’s match.
Not to mention that the Emperor was possessed by the mysterious force.
“If possible, I’d like to get the mysterious force out of his body. It’s a pity that such a figure has fallen.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
Then, Wang Ping calmed his mind and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, wanting to see the outcome.
Now that he had entered the valley, he might be able to learn the inheritance of the Guilt- Punishing Holy Land.
This was an opportunity against the heavens for Wang Ping.
[Next, you continue to cultivate diligently in the valley. Due to the formation of your Flawless Profound Elixir, the experts in the valley see you as a talent worth nurturing and want you to undergo trials and training.]
[However, an unexpected event happens. Before the valley experts can put you through the trials, a terrifyingly powerful being descends upon the valley, attacking the various Great Arrays.]
[The newcomer is incredibly terrifying, with demonic spirit flooding the sky. With a single palm strike, they shatter all the terrifying layered Great Arrays and flatten the area.]
[In an instant, both you and the hibernating Bai Ya are instantly slain, reduced to dust.]
[Because of the Rebirth tally, you come back to life. Unfortunately, the powerful demon shattered the area’s space with their terrifying strike, leaving the space in turmoil. The moment you are resurrected, you die again.]
[ Due to your death, this simulation has ended…]
“Damn it, the more dangerous the places I go, the more freakish enemies I attract.”
Wang Ping looked at his tragic end and felt extremely frustrated.
When he went to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, he was used as bait to attract the Demon, who was at least at Kings Realm tier.
Now, he came to the valley where Bai Ya, the descendant of the
Guilt- Punishing Emperor, was located and directly provoked a terrifying being at the Emperor tier. It was ridiculously absurd.
The reason he believed that the enemy was at Emperor tier was that even the King Realm Master Bai Ya was reduced to dust.
All the astonishing arrays and even the King tier Bai Ya were turned to dust with one slap — if that wasn’t Emperor Realm Cultivation, then what could it

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 298 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
Chapter 298: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!) _ 5
Translator: 549690339
“How come I ended up coming here by coincidence?”
Wang Ping frowned in thought.
Could it be that all the previous Bai Tianhong had died, so he never came back to find him?
That seemed quite likely.
“Maybe the white-haired Old Lady went out for a while and got noticed by someone, who traced her back here. Or perhaps Bai Tianhong has been watched all along, and when the Old Lady appeared and took Bai Tianhong away, someone followed the clues to find them.” Wang Pings heart chilled.
This Demon Emperor really played a deep game.
“I thought I could gain great fortune, but now it’s all gone.”
Wang Ping felt a little helpless.
If he could control the actions of Wang Ping in the simulation, things would be easier.
But it was difficult for him to influence Wang Pings actions.
To be precise, Wang Ping in the simulation was like a version of him on a nonexistent timeline, with flesh, blood, emotions, fears, and knowledge of avoiding bad luck.
If it was a risk-free thing, he wouldn’t mind doing it.
For the sake of other reincarnated ‘Wang Ping,’ he would take small risks.
But he absolutely wouldn’t do anything that would guarantee his death, and he certainly wouldn’t follow the will of the simulation.
He was also afraid of death, so he knew he wouldn’t do anything that would result in certain death. Instead, he’d run as far away as possible.
“Next time I purchase the Golden Finger Optimizer, I wonder which aspect it might improve. Either it will allow me to control the actions of ‘Wang Ping in the simulation, or it will increase the probability of refreshing higher-tier talents….
Wang Pings eyes flickered, secretly contemplating in his heart.
No matter which direction, he could accept it.
If both appeared at the same time, that would be the best.
However, Wang Ping also knew that this was unrealistic, so he could only think about it.
At this moment, Wang Pings vision changed and appeared in an unfamiliar valley.
Then, Wang Ping saw a black-robed man with a gloomy face mask appearing above the valley, mercilessly suppressing and killing everyone in the valley. Wang Ping in the simulation also died desperately twice.
Soon, Wang Pings vision returned to normal, his face full of shock.
Even though It was only a vision formed by the Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death, and he was watching it from a god’s perspective without being affected by the man’s aura and pressure, it still made him feel terrified. It was hard to imagine how terrifying the man’s aura would be if he faced him directly.
“Emperor.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself, longing for that realm.
“Next, I should go to Sacred Heart Island and earn some Spiritual Stones.”
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and prepared to head to Sacred Heart Island.
This time, he estimated that he would stay on Sacred Heart Island for a longer period, and he wouldn’t return to Profound Turtle Continent anytime soon.
Even on Sacred Heart Island, he didn’t think he would stay too long, as he would eventually go to Eastern Desolation.
Because as his cultivation improved, the top-tier spiritual stones on Sacred Heart Island might not be enough to support his simulations.
If he went to Eastern Desolation and returned on a whim, it would be too troublesome.
“In that case, I’ll take Ye Chen with me.’
After weighing his options, Wang Ping decided to take Ye Chen with him when he left.
As for Bai Tianhong, he had no intention of taking him anymore.
After all, Bai Tianhongs bloodline was special, and through the simulation, he knew that someone was watching him.
Bringing him out would expose them to danger easily.
Although through many simulations, he knew that the terrifying strong man might not care about killing a weakling like him, Wang Ping still wanted to avoid any possible dangers completely.
What’s more, Wang Ping didn’t want Bai Tianhong to die unjustly.
As for whether Wang Ping from the simulation would later return to Profound Turtle Continent and take Bai Tianhong out, that was now a matter for the simulated Wang Ping, and had nothing to do with him.
With this thought, Wang Ping found Cai Yonglong and told him about his plans to leave Profound Turtle Continent.
Of course, Cai Yonglong was delighted to hear this.
Although he had Wang Ping supplying him with cultivation resources, Cai Yonglong didn’t want to rely on Wang Pings resources forever.
Most importantly, staying here rendered his Golden Finger useless, which made him uncomfortable.
“Mr.Wang, once I leave Profound Turtle Continent, I want to go to Azure Abyss Island and talk to my master,” Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but say.
“You have a master?” Wang Ping was surprised.
“Of course. When I first came to Azure Abyss Island, if it weren’t for my master’s help, I would probably be dead.”
Cai Yonglong said with a bitter smile.
“Even though my master’s cultivation is not high, only in the Spiritual Origin
Realm, he will always be my master, one of the people I respect the most.”
“l see. You can naturally go back and visit. If possible, you can even give him some opportunities in the future to help him reach the Transcendent Realm.” Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglongs shoulder and laughed.
In the past, Wang Ping was a bit puzzled about how Cai Yonglongs Golden Finger didn’t offer much help in terms of survival initially, but now it finally made sense.
He met a benefactor, was taken as a disciple, and was able to join a sect and grow quickly in a short time.
“It’s something 1 have to do. However, now that I rely on you for cultivation resources, Mr. Wang, I need to work hard on my cultivation and get stronger.” Cai Yonglong sighed.
“No need to think too much, you have to get stronger as soon as possible. Only when you become strong can you bring out the effectiveness of your Golden Finger and help me become my right-hand man. Otherwise, even if your Golden Finger is good, you won’t be able to enter some secret realms, and if you do, you’ll end up dead..”

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 299 - 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
Chapter 299: Chapter 128: Descendants of the Emperor!
The Truth of Sinful Blood! (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping shook his head and reminded him.
“Uh, is this the future you saw, Mr.Wang?”
Cai Yonglongs face twitched.
‘Yes, I took you to an advanced secret realm, and then you died.”
Wang Ping said with a strange look in his eyes.
“l used my ability again to let you practice Demonic Skill, which increased your cultivation speed, allowing your cultivation level to catch up with mine, so you didn’t die.”
“Demonic Skill?!”
Cai Yonglongs eyes lit up, and he seemed a little excited.
“Don’t think about it, your state of mind is not enough, after cultivating, you will be completely demonized.”
Wang Ping frowned and warned seriously.
“Actually, I’ve always had a question.”
Cai Yonglong hesitated for a moment before speaking.
“What?” Wang Ping asked.
“Mr.Wang, during the simulation process, you can’t use the Life Simulator, right? Otherwise, it would be nesting. So, can I also assume that the presence of the chat group is reduced?”
Cai Yonglong hesitated for a moment and still chose to voice his thoughts.
This was also the conjecture of the smart group members.
“That’s right. The existence of the chat group is indeed weakened.” Wang Ping nodded.
“Wait, do you mean you can practice Demonic Skill, and if you have group points and other means from the group, you can avoid the problem of demonization?”
Suddenly, Wang Ping seemed to have thought of something, his eyes flickering.
“Yes, that’s what I thought.”
Cai Yonglong said hesitantly.
“With my situation, if I practice normally, I’m afraid I would never be able to keep up with Mr.Wangs pace. Only through the Demon Path could I possibly catch up. If I have group points, perhaps 1 can solve the problem of demonization. Moreover, there are Cleaning heart Skill from Zhang Hu t s world and Cleaning heart Tao Skill from Chen Yao’s world.”
“You can try it.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, pondering.
Indeed, the Life Simulator has weakened the presence of the chat group and other group members.
There is a huge hidden danger of demonization, but if the side effects can be solved. it would be amazing.
“However, even if the hidden dangers can be resolved, I don’t think you need to practice Demonic Skill for the time being.”
After a pause, Wang Ping spoke again.
“Why?”
Cai Yonglong was slightly confused.
“The grade of cultivation skills is not good enough; the upper limit is too low.” Wang Pings eyes flickered as he uttered this sentence.
He was currently practicing the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique given by Blood Demon Yuan Feng.
This technique had a heavenly upper-tier grade, which was already quite strong for him at the time.
However, he had grown so much now, and his knowledge was broadened due to the various intel acquired through the simulations…
A Heavenly upper-tier demonic skill was indeed a bit weak and didn’t have a complete inheritance system.
Under such circumstances, Cai Yonglongs future at best would be to condense a 4th Tier Profound elixir and cultivate to the Life and Death Realm.
Although the Life and Death Realm was not bad, Wang Ping didn’t want Cai Yonglong to end at this level.
Through the Life Simulator, Wang Ping knew that Cai Yonglong had a great character, and he was really planning to cultivate Cai Yonglong as his right-hand man.
So even if Cai Yonglong could not condense a Flawless Profound Elixir, Wang Ping hoped that he could condense a Ist-tier Profound Elixir and have the qualifications to become a king, or even an emperor in the future.
“The upper limit is too low? What grade is this Demonic Skill?”
Cai Yonglong was somewhat disappointed but also couldn’t help but ask unwillingly.
“Heavenly upper-tier.” Wang Ping shook his head.
” Pfft! ”
Cai Yonglong was stunned, looking at Wang Ping in shock.
My god, how rich is Mr.Wang now? He thinks a Heavenly upper-tier cultivation skill is rubbish, with too low tier and upper limit.
“If you practice this Demonic Skill, you would easily become demonized, and at best, you would only be able to reach the ordinary Life and Death Realm. ‘
Wang Ping glanced at Cai Yonglong and said.
“Mr.Wan2, can I ask* what realm is above the Profound Elixir Realm?”
Cai Yonglong was silent for a moment, feeling that his knowledge and vision were on a completely different level from Wang Pings.
This made Cai Yonglong somewhat emotional.
He used to explain the realms of cultivation to Wang Ping.
Now, the roles have completely reversed.
“Above the Profound Elixir Realm, from low to high, are the Yin Yang Realm, Life and Death Realm, Nirvana Boundary, King Realm, and Emperor Realm.” Wang Ping explained.
“Life and Death Realm, isn’t that already pretty good?” Cai Yonglong stroked his chin.
“As a transmigrator, can you have some ambition? Even if you don’t become an emperor, at least you should become a king.”
Wang Ping speechlessly patted Cai Yonglongs shoulder and spoke.
“Well, you have a point.” Cai Yonglong felt a little embarrassed.
After dying once and being surpassed by the new group members, he felt somewhat disheartened, as if giving up on himself.
“So what should we do? Is there an even stronger Demonic Skill than this?”
Cai Yonglong asked curiously.
“There isn’t one at the moment. But… I can try to get one.”
Wang Pings eyes flickered.
That transmigrator predecessor established the formidable Jiuyou Demon Sect.
If he could risk his life joining the Jiuyou Demon Sect and get in touch with their Demonic Skill, then use the Life Simulator to learn it for free, that would be amazing.
Of course, Wang Ping knew that the success rate was very low, but he had to try, right?
Without trying, Wang Ping would never be satisfied.
However, Wang Ping soon became discouraged.
He could not control the actions of Wang Ping in the Life Simulator.
With his personality, Wang Ping in the simulation would definitely not follow his will and risk his life joining the Jiuyou Demon Sect to obtain a Demonic Skill, which was simply an absurd idea.
“Tsk, 1 still need to earn more group points and optimize the Life Simulator again. ”
Wang Ping smacked his lips.
“Is it really possible? Mr. Wang is awesome!” Cai Yonglong was excited.
“It doesn’t seem possible, at least not in the short term, I need to wait for my Golden Finger to be optimized again before it’s possible. But at the moment, I still need 9 million group points.”
Wang Ping looked at the excited Cai Yonglong and sighed.
Alpha was so kind to him as the acting group master.
Buying Golden Finger Optimizer was discounted at 90% for him.
So when he bought the Golden Finger Optimizer again, it only cost him 10 million group points instead of the 100 million needed by other group members.
But, even if it only took ten million group points, it was still ten million….

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 300 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)
Chapter 300: Chapter 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping currently has less than a million group points, and he doesn’t know how long it would take to save up nine million group points.
That premise is based on him not spending any group points and having to save them all.
If he spends group points, it will take even longer.
Wang Pings words made Cai Yonglongs expression stiffen.
This feeling of raising hope and then quickly extinguishing it is too uncomfortable.
“In that case, I’ll just continue struggling with my cultivation,”
Cai Yonglong said helplessly.
“Actually, compared to cultivating demons, I still think it’s better for you to cultivate normally. The demon path in this world is really hated by everyone.” Wang Ping shook his head and tried to comfort him.
“So, the best route for you is to cultivate my heaven-tier nonsuch skill and group points to strengthen your roots.””Hey, if there’s no other way, then I can only do that.”
Cai Yonglong was somewhat helpless.
“Actually, 1 always feel that my golden finger is not very useful. If possible, I really want to change to another golden finger.”
After a pause, Cai Yonglong spoke again with a complicated mood.
They say that one can seek opportunities and be very powerful in the Profound World.
He had also seen such themes before crossing over.
The leading character quickly takes off with the golden finger, feeling great.
However, it’s completely different for him.
People with opportunities are not as many as he imagined, and they are not easy to encounter.
Even if they come across someone with the potential for great opportunity, it’s difficult to snatch it before them, and sometimes they risk their lives. Apart from that, whether the opportunity is useful to you is also a problem.
It can be said that everything is unknown.
The greater likelihood is that you have spent time and risked your life to snatch the opportunity, only to find out that it’s not very useful.
So, when Wang Ping initially said that he and him were from the same world and his ability was to predict the future, he was really excited.
Because he thought that when these two abilities combined, they would be invincible, able to avoid all dangers, and see whether it is an effective opportunity or not.
Reality proved that he had thought too much.
Wang Pings golden finger is not a predictor of the future, but a life simulator.
The life simulator is a textual description that cannot see the details, and Wang Pings golden finger is very perverted, not requiring his help.
Apart from that… In the simulated future of the life simulator, it seems that he was not helpful to Wang Ping as well.
This made Cai Yonglong doubt himself. Is his golden finger really useful?
Without the protagonistic halo, this golden finger seems useless and appears quite trashy.
“As for now, it’s indeed not very useful.”
Wang Ping didn’t comfort him with any words of future hope.
Looking at the current performance of Cai Yonglongs golden finger, it’s indeed quite wasteful, belonging to a category that may not have a significant effect even if it is absent.
In their previous simulations, the two of them had gained quite a few opportunities in Purple Moon Secret Realm, but to be honest, these opportunities didn’t change their strength significantly.
It can be said that even Wang Ping himself is somewhat disappointed with this golden finger.
“It turns out that’s the case. So, once I’ve saved enough group points, I’ll replace my golden finger.”
Cai Yonglong said with a bitter smile.
“I’m saying it’s like this for now. The reason it’s useless is that our current cultivation is too low, so it seems trashy. Once we become more powerful, we won’t need to care so much, and we can know the location of various kinds of world- shocking opportunities. ”
Wang Ping spoke with deep meaning.
“Of course, if it’s still useless by then, I still suggest that you replace it.”
After a pause, Wang Ping opened his mouth.
“l see.” Cai Yonglong nodded thoughtfully. “Alright, I’ll listen to Mr.Wang. No matter whether it’s about Cultivating Demons in the future, or about the golden finger, I’ll listen to whatever Mr.Wang says.”
Cai Yonglong was really confused now and too lazy to think more about it.
With Wang Ping, a big shot by his side, he didn’t need to worry too much. All he needed to do was follow Wang Pings arrangement and strive to become stronger.
“Hmm.” Wang Ping nodded, not saying much to Cai Yonglong, and directly took him down the mountain.
Bai Wood Village, the Ye’s family.
With Wang Pings ample resources, the Ye’s family developed quite well.
However, the Ye l s family knows the principle of not revealing their wealth, and they have been developing low-key, forbidding the younger generation from going out, strictly maintaining secrecy, and diligently practicing.
As for Ye Chen, with the resources, his cultivating speed can be described as rapid.
However, Ye Chen was not proud of his own progress.
He wanted to become stronger, join the Sword Spirit Sect, and be accepted as an apprentice by senior Wang Ping.
At this moment, Ye Chen, who was cultivating hard, did not notice that there were two figures in the sky above watching him.
“Is he the Son of Fortune you mentioned, Mr.Wang? Although he seems to have good talent, I don’t see anything particularly special about him, he doesn’t even have an old ring master.”
Cai Yonglong curiously looked at Ye Chen and muttered.
“That’s because the old ring master on him has been taken away and killed by me.”
Wang Ping said indifferently.
“Uh…” Cai Yonglong was stunned, and his eyes became strange.
In the end, he could only hold back a sentence: “My ruthless Mr.Wang doesn’t say much. Even the old ring master of the Son of Fortune dares to take it away and kill it. Aren’t you afraid of causing trouble?”
“What’s there to be afraid of? Didn’t I make it up by becoming a better guide for him?”
Wang Pings mouth slightly rose, and he flew down.
Cai Yonglong also followed with a strange expression in his eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 301 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_2
Chapter 301: Chapter 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_2
Translator: 549690339
Being the ‘Ring Grandpa’ for the Son of Fortune as a transmigrator is really weird.
“Senior Wang Ping!
As Wang Ping intentionally lowered his altitude and released his aura deliberately, the members of the Ye l s family who were cultivating in the courtyard noticed their presence, especially Wang Ping standing on his flying sword.
The expression of the Ye Family Master was a mix of awe and joy.
“Senior Wang Ping.” Ye Chen looked at Wang Ping with a surprised and expectant expression.
“Ye Chen, I have been observing you for some time, and you have indeed great talent and are keen on diligent practice. Therefore, I’m willing to accept you as my disciple and teach you cultivation,” said Wang Ping seriously.
“Are you willing to become my disciple?”
The Ye Family Master was overjoyed and signaled his son to perform the
Inviting Teaching Ceremony.
“Ye Chen, greetings to my master!”
Ye Chen came back to his senses, with joy written all over his face, He knelt on the ground and performed the ceremony towards Wang Ping.
“Well, from now on, you will be my first disciple. I will teach you cultivation wholeheartedly and make you a great Master in the future,” said Wang Ping with a solemn expression.
“Disciple will practice diligently, avoiding disappointing my master,” said Ye
Chen, looking up at Wang Ping earnestly.
“Well then, following me for cultivating together.”
Wang Ping nodded, waved his sleeve to lift Ye Chen into the air, and formed a flying sword under his feet. He said lightly.
“Mrnm!” Ye Chen nodded expectantly, looking curiously at the flying sword beneath his feet and the clan members below. The feeling was strange but made him genuinely happy.
In the future, he would also travel the world on his sword!
“Damn, Mr.Wang is really impressive and dazzling.”
Cai Yonglong, who was watching from the side, felt like he was being blinded by Wang Pings brilliance.
Acting like a superior figure, accepting the Son of Fortune as a disciple with an air of superiority, his aura was fully loaded.
Ah, how envious he was.
Of course, he just felt envious. If he was given the opportunity to accept the Son of Fortune as a disciple, he would not dare to take it. He would be killed if he wasn’t careful enough.
How did he know? Please, it’s always written like this in novels. If you are not fated enough to be associated with the Son of Fortune, you are doomed.
Subsequently, Wang Ping didn’t say much, nodded to the Ye’s family members, and left quickly with Ye Chen, leaving behind even better legacies and resources.
Seeing this, Cai Yonglong hurriedly followed.
“Hahaha, Chewer being accepted as a direct disciple by a senior from Sword Spirit Sect is truly a blessing for our Ye’s family!’
The Ye Family Master was beaming and laughing heartily.
The other members of the Ye’s family saw this and were delighted
Of course, the young people in the Ye’s family were enviously sulking. They wanted to be accepted as disciples too.
It’s just a pity that both big shots didn’t even glance at them.
“Family Master, is this Cultivation Skill…?”
At this point, one of the Ye’s family Elders noticed the grade of the Cultivation Skill; their palms trembling.
Is it… Earth-tier?!”
When the Ye Family Master saw the level of the Cultivation Skill, he was astounded, his eyes wide and his face full of disbelief.
“Is the Senior really a Supreme Elder of the Sword Spirit Sect? Why would he give an Earth-tier Middle-Grade Cultivation Skill? This is something that even the Sword Spirit Sect can’t possess.”
The Ye Family Master’s excited heart, trembling hands, and head were full of questions.
Sacred Heart Island, Sacred Heart City, when Wang Ping came here again, he felt a lot of emotions.
Even though he hadn’t been gone for a long time, he felt as if it had been ages due to the many events he had experienced.
“By the way, 1 haven’t obtained the Secret Skill for concealing my aura yet.”
At this moment, Wang Ping watched Ye Chen beside him, whose face was full of shock and curiosity, scanning the bustling city and the crowd in Green Moon City, he suddenly remembered this important matter.
Though, in each simulation, he got the Secret Skill that Ye Chen gave him. However, he hadn’t gotten that in reality yet.
Apart from that, no prizes had been awarded for much of the time.
“Luckily I thought of this, otherwise, it would have been really dangerous.” Wang Ping felt a little helpless in his heart.
Life Simulator had confused the distinction between reality and virtuality after simulating too many times, making it easy to overlook some details in reality.
“Moreover, not getting this reward in several Paid Simulations is quite a headache. It seems like I will have to choose the option of ‘Learned Secret Skills’ in the future rewards selection. Provided that it comes up, that is.” Wang Ping reminded himself in his heart.
“Sacred Heart Island, Sacred Heart City, I’ve only read about it in sect books before, never thought I would come here one day.”
Cai Yonglong was also looking at the crowd, his face full of emotions.
Sacred Heart City was not a city established by the Green Moon Sect and Ice Palace, the two major powers of Sacred Heart Island. The history of its existence and the ones who controlled it had undergone many changes.
Now, as the Green Moon Sect and Ice Palace being the strongest forces, behind Sacred Heart City are controlled by both great powers together, and the shops of major sects on Sacred Heart Island are located throughout it.
In Sacred Heart City, cultivators were continuous. Innate Realm and Spiritual
Origin Realm practitioners could be seen everywhere. Even the Transcendent Realm cultivators, whose cultivation levels Cai Yonglong couldn’t see through, would occasionally appear.
This scene would definitely not happen in Azure Abyss Island.
“Get used to it. It’s just a Green Moon City. It’s not a big deal. When you go to the Eastern Desolation and see the Holy Cities founded by holy forces, you’ll truly broaden your horizons..”

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 302 - 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_3
Chapter 302: Chapter 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega chapter!)_3
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping shook his head with a smile,
“Mr. Wang, always thinking big!” Cai Yonglong gave a thumbs up.
“Master, where are we going next?” Ye Chen asked curiously.
“First, let’s auction off an item to get some Spiritual Stones, then buy a residence in Sacred Heart City.”
Wang Pings Spiritual Sense scanned and found the location of the Ice Palace Auction and casually said.
Cai Yonglong and Ye Chen nodded in anticipation.
The Spiritual Energy here was much stronger than in the Profound Turtle Continent, which would make cultivation more effective.
After arriving at the Ice Palace Auction, Wang Ping took out the Sea and Sky Staff and directly exploded his Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation.
This shocked the person in charge at the Ice Palace to the extreme and promptly called the highest-ranking person.
However, Wang Ping did not auction the Sea and Sky Staff like in the simulation due to time constraints and instead sold it directly to the Ice Palace.
As a result, Wang Ping received 400,000 top-tier spirit stones.
Although it was 100,000 less than the 500,000 High-Tier Spirit Stones in the simulation, Wang Ping didn’t feel a significant loss as auctions tend to have inflated prices.
After all, he urgently needed spirit stones, and having them would give him a sense of security, so he didn’t want to spend half a year waiting for the Ice Palace Auction to begin.
“Mr. Wang! Check out that girl!’
As Wang Ping and his party left the Ice Palace Auction, Cai Yonglong suddenly brightened his eyes and excitedly sent a message to Wang Ping.
Wang Ping was slightly startled and looked over.
Then, his body hesitated for a moment, somewhat astonished.
Because he saw a familiar face, a woman dressed in a long skirt with waist-length blue hair and an enchantingly beautiful face.
She was no other than Bing Ningyue, who would later become Ji Bingyue and the real successor of the Ice Palace.
Bing Ningyue seemed to have noticed Wang Pings gaze, looked over, and her ice-blue pupils stirred up waves of surprise.
“It’s just a pretty girl. You’ve seen Liu Mei looking beautiful before.”
Wang Ping nodded politely toward Bing Ningyue, then glanced at Cai Yonglong. He sent a silent message.
“Mr. Wang, that’s not what I meant! I meant… she has an opportunity line!”
Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but send a message with a twitching face.
“Opportunity line? Is it thick?” Wang Ping asked with some surprise.
He wasn’t surprised that Bing Ningyue had an opportunity line, as her talent was amazing, and her future achievements showed her extraordinary nature. It was common for such people to have their fortune and destiny tied.
Although Wang Ping was unsure why Bing Ningyue had such a strange fall in the last simulation… this was not the performance of a Daughter of Fortune.
“Very thick.” Cai Yonglong affirmed. “At least, Ye Chen’s opportunity line is nothing compared to hers.”
“I see.” Wang Ping pondered and nodded.
“What do you think, Mr. Wang? Should we snatch her opportunity?”
Cai Yonglong seemed a little eager in his message.
“You really are a straightforward guy.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
“Come on, Mr. Wang, you dare to say that? You used to say you weren’t interested in women. What’s the matter, Wang? Can’t bring yourself to do it?”
Cai Yonglong grudgingly looked at him.
Wang Ping was at a loss for words.
He wasn’t unwilling to act; he simply felt it was not worth it to snatch Bing Ningyue’s opportunity.
After all, she was the future successor of the Ice Palace and had a performance comparable to Ye Chen during the Hundred Dynasties War.
Instead of snatching that single opportunity, it’s better to build a good relationship with her.
That way, there might be unexpected surprises in the upcoming life simulation.
After all, Mang Pings investment in Ye Chen had brought him many benefits.
Investing more in people like Ye Chen and Bing Ningyue could only widen his path.
It was foolish to draw a clear line with them for a small opportunity.
“She’s special, qualified to be the Saintess of Heavenly Sword Divine Land in the future, so don’t sacrifice the big picture for small gains.”
Wang Ping sent a message to Cai Yonglong, then ignored him.
Cai Yonglongs pupils contracted, his heart shaken to the core.
What luck Mr. Wang has! The Profound Turtle Continent had a Son of Fortune.
And now, as soon as he arrived at Sacred Heart Island, he met someone who could become the Saintess of Heavenly Sword Divine Land… Incredible!
“A strange person,” Bing Ningyue silently thought after passing by Wang Ping.
The young man with only Spiritual Origin Realm cultivation had a peculiar look in his eyes. There was enthusiasm and excitement, but not the admiration and evil gazes she was used to.
The other youth was even stranger.
His gaze towards her was clear and ripple-free, but also had a subtle feeling as if they had met before.
Beyond that, she couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s cultivation level.
Bing Ningyue first guessed if Wang Ping had cultivated any secret skill to conceal his breath, but she quickly dismissed the idea.
That’s because he had a strong presence, something that only appeared when facing a Profound Elixir Realm master.
If anything, even the Supreme Elders of the Ice Palace did not have as strong a presence as Wang Ping.
This person was strong, incredibly strong.
So, it’s highly likely that he has a cultivation level above the Profound Elixir Realm..

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 129: The Chaos of Demon Cultivation! Unexpected Development (10k words special chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 303 - 129: The Chaos of Demon Cultivation! Unexpected Development (10k words special chapter!) _4
Chapter 303: Chapter 129: The Chaos of Demon Cultivation! Unexpected Development (10k words special chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
As for the child standing beside the two, he was ignored by Bing Ningyue. His cultivation was too low and he was too young, he didn’t need to be taken into consideration.
“Mr. Wang, what should we do next?”
Watching Bing Ningyue walk away, Cai Yonglong still glanced at her with some reluctance.
“First, we head to the location of the opportunity.”
Wang Ping glanced at Cai Yonglong and spoke indifferently.
“Uh, Mr. Wang, didn’t you say you would not snatch someone else’s fortune?” Cai Yonglong rolled his eyes.
“Not seizing doesn’t mean we won’t go. If we follow them later, wouldn’t that be tailing them? How embarrassing would that be? How could we befriend them then?”
Wang Ping spoke in annoyance.
“That makes sense.’
Cai Yonglong stroked his chin and nodded.
It’s like seeing a pretty girl on earth and suddenly asking for her WeChat.
Unless you are incredibly handsome, no normal girl will entertain you in such a situation.
So, you have to find a way to make something happen together to have a chance to break the ice.
“In that case, Mr. Wang, let’s go now. I am really curious about what her opportunity is.”
Immediately, Cai Yonglong spoke with some impatience.
“Hmm.” Wang Ping nodded.
To be honest, he was also very curious about Bing Ningyue!s opportunity.
If it could be useful to a person of Bing Ningyue!s level, it definitely wouldn’t be something simple.
Next, Wang Ping bought a courtyard in the city center of Sacred Heart City for future residence and cultivation.
Buying a house is not complicated. After Wang Ping directly took out a lot of Spiritual Stones and demonstrated his Profound Elixir Realm cultivation, everything was easily settled.
Then, Wang Ping asked Ye Chen whether he wanted to come with him.
Ye Chen’s answer was no, he wanted to cultivate here, and with his current situation, following his master would only be a hindrance.
As for this, Wang Ping also had no intention of forcibly bringing Ye Chen along, and he left with Cai Yonglong and left Ye Chen alone in the courtyard to cultivate.
The courtyard has an Array Mana in it and only people above the half- step Profound Elixir Realm could break in, Wang Ping was not worried that anything would happen to Ye Chen.
Even if someone really wanted to hurt Ye Chen, in the end, they would probably be strangely killed by Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune.
