Although Sacred Heart Island is said to be an island, its area is not a bit smaller than the Profound Turtle Continent, it’s even larger.
There are continuous mountain ranges here, known as the Sacred Heart Mountain Range, which occupies one-fifth of the area of Sacred Heart Island. It has various mighty monster beasts lurking within.
“Sacred Heart Mountain Range, I remember once in a simulation, ‘Wang Ping discovered an 8-tier Soul-Nurturing Treasure Elixir, managed to divert the Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast, he thought he could pick the treasure medicine, but he was bitten to death by another lurking Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast. These beasts always come in pairs.”
Wang Ping led Cai Yonglong flying unbridled over the Sacred Heart Mountain Range, his mind was full of thoughts.
With his current cultivation, although he can’t do whatever he wants here, he can come and go freely, so he doesn’t have to worry about anything.
“However, the time when that 8-tier treasure medicine appeared was almost two hundred years later, it probably hasn’t appeared now, even if it has, it probably hasn’t matured. I don’t know if it has reached the 8-tier. Never mind, regardless of whether it has matured or not, just pick it first.”
“Mr. Wang, it’s just ahead.”
At this time, Cai Yonglong also spoke.
Wang Ping nodded, cleared his mind, and increased his flight speed.
Soon, Wang Ping brought Cai Yonglong to the target location.
Then, the two saw a crystal-clear four-leaf treasure medicine, Under the sunlight, it was vividly alive.
“Could it be, an 8-tier Treasure Elixir, a Four-Leaf White Jade Flower?” Looking at this treasure medicine, Wang Ping showed a surprised expression.
An 8-tier treasure elixir, which is already precious, but this Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, is even more valuable. Its real value is equivalent to the ordinary 9th tier Treasure Medicine.
Because there is only one medicinal effect of the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, it can increase a person’s enlightenment.
What is most precious in this world is something that can enhance a cultivator’s RootPhysique Enlightenment.
For middle and low-level cultivators, medicines that enhance physique are most valuable.
But for masters, medicines that enhance enlightenment are even more precious.
Therefore, every time a high-quality medicine appears that can enhance RootPhysique Enlightenment, and multiple cultivators discover it at the same time, there will definitely be bloody fights.
After all, to grab such a good thing, one can go farther in the future, no one wants to miss it.
It is not an exaggeration to say that if this Four-Leaf White Jade Flower were discovered by a Yin and Yang Master or some Life and Death Realm Masters with poor enlightenment, they would be excited to the extreme.
Because this Four-Leaf White Jade Flower would be of great benefit to them.
Wang Ping suspects that the later cultivation would need enlightenment to
breakthrough major bottlenecks.
After all, in the Hundred Dynasties War, talent and mediocrity were differentiated by whether divine skills were comprehended or not.
The emphasis on enlightenment is above physique.
“Mr. Wang, what is this treasure medicine?”
Seeing that Wang Ping showed a surprised look, Cai Yonglongs face was full of joy and he asked expectantly.
He had a premonition that they had definitely stumbled upon a treasure this time.
“Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, an 8-tier treasure medicine. It’s a good thing that enhances enlightenment. It’s also one of the main ingredients for refining the 9th-tier elixir, the Four-Heart elixir. If there is a 9th tier Alchemist who has the corresponding prescription, once they find the other ingredients, they can refine the 9th-tier elixir, Four-Heart elixir. This is a top- grade elixir that even Life and Death Realm Masters would be tempted by..”

chapters.title: Chapter 304: 129: Demon Cultivation Chaos! Unexpected Development (10,000 words !) _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: 129: Demon Cultivation Chaos! Unexpected Development (10,000 words !) _5
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping let out a slow sigh and began to explain.
No wonder the opportunity line Cai Yonglong saw was so thick, this opportunity indeed was a good one.
At the same time, Wang Ping remembered something else.
Could it be that Wang Ping, who had the ‘talent’ of the Flower-Picking Thief, caused Bing Ningyue to miss this opportunity because he detoured?
Or was it that ‘Wang Ping became acquainted with Bing Ningyue because of the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower?
“The textual description of the Life Simulator is too exploit-oriented and lacks many details. Now it would be better to have a detailed picture of the future.
Of course, if it’s a picture of the future, then there wouldn’t be the occasional God view in the Life Simulator.’
Wang Ping thought silently to himself.
“Roar!”
At this moment, a roar resounded across the sky, a gigantic beast with wings on its back, white crystals on its body, flew out from the cave, exuding the aura of a Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast, pressuring Wang Ping and the others.
Wang Ping was calm about this, he also released his pressure to counteract it.
“Human, leave immediately; otherwise, die.”
The Profound Elixir Realm beast glared at Wang Ping and roared.
“Heh, I also give you two options. Leave or die.”
Wang Ping looked indifferently at the Profound Elixir Realm Beast and spoke calmly.
“Human, since you seek death, I’ll grant your wish.”
The Profound Elixir Realm Beast’s killing intent exploded, condensing a terrifying white flame in its mouth, burning the sky, then spewing it at Wang
Ping.
Wang Pings face was indifferent, he formed a sword from his spiritual essence and performed the Sunset Sword Skill.
It was as if a huge sun condensed into a sword appeared, directly tearing through the fire pillar of the Profound Elixir Realm Beast and easily splitting it in half.
The two halves of the beast’s body fell to the ground, its pupils wide open, its eyes full of horror.
This human was too terrifying.
His cultivation was clearly only at the Ist-tier of the Profound Elixir Realm, yet he was able to slay this powerful beast that was equivalent to a human in the 2nd Tier of the Profound Elixir Realm with one sword.
“It went down in a second?”
Cai Yonglong, who had watched this scene, was somewhat incredulous.
A beast capable of guarding such a precious 8-tier Treasure Elixir… at least a Profound Elixir Realm beast, right?
And yet, Brother Wang slew it with one sword stroke?
This was just absurd.
“It’s just a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir Realm beast, nothing more. There’s no need to be astonished by it being slain so quickly.”
Wang Ping shook his head, speaking calmly while his hands swiftly moved.
His dreadful Spiritual Essence surged, sucking the corpse of the beast towards him and storing it, along with its beast core, into his Storage Spirit Ring.
The body of a Profound Elixir Realm Beast was quite valuable and not to be wasted.
“Just a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir Realm Beast….”
Cai Yonglongs face twitched slightly as he was left speechless.
What was meant by ‘just a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir Realm Beast’? It was a beast of the Profound Elixir Realm, not the Spirit Sea Realm.
“Brother Wang, what is your cultivation level right now?” Cai Yonglong asked numbly.
“Ist-tier of the Profound Elixir Realm.”
Wang Ping answered casually.
You’re already in the Profound Elixir Realm? That’s fast. And this combat power is too abnormal.” Cai Yonglong wasn’t surprised by Wang Pings answer; he was just extremely envious.
Able to instantly kill a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir Realm Beast with the strength of the Ist-tier of the Profound Elixir Realm, this fighting power was truly abnormal.
After all, in the Profound World, the further you go, the harder it is to fight across levels.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much to Cai Yonglong. After landing, he immediately prepared to pick the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower.
However, just as Wang Ping finished picking and was about to store it in the Jade Box to preserve it, he paused.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully triggering the optimization option. Please choose whether to optimize within twenty-four hours.” “Triggering the optimization option is indeed quite absurd.”
Wang Ping was somewhat surprised and also somewhat hesitant, unsure whether or not to optimize.
After all, the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower was very precious. Wang Ping felt that its medicinal effect should be at least equivalent to two Green
Comprehension Talents and could possibly be even stronger. He shouldn’t be careless.
If the optimization failed, he would be at a great loss.
But if the optimization was successful, he might obtain a 9th-tier Treasure Medicine, and it would even be the kind that boosts comprehension. That would indeed be quite delightful. Wang Ping thought it would certainly have the effect of a Blue Talent.
By then, he would have a chance to comprehend his own Divine Skills.
“Although as they say, ‘Gamble a go, a bicycle can become a motorcycle’. But I’ll play it safe first. I’ll do a simulation first to see if the optimization can be successful.’
Wang Ping silently put the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower into the Jade Box to prevent its medicinal effectiveness from dissipating.
Then he said in his mind: “System, 1 want to do a Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, the current paid simulation requires 50,000 High-tier Spirit Stones. Host, do you need to proceed with the paid simulation?”
The long-absent system notification started again.
“Ding, we detect that the host’s Spirit Stones can’t afford loose paid simulations, do we need to remind you of the costs in the future as we do now?”
It seemed that the Life Simulator believed Wang Ping had grown poor again.
“Pay,” said Wang Ping, the corners of his mouth twitching slightly.
The system of this Life Simulator was a bit too intelligent. He had previously flaunted his wealth, the price had increased since then, and now it seemed to be somewhat disdainful.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations host on refreshing to obtain the Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation; Green Talent: Happy-Go-Lucky.”
Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation: the host will have unrivalled talent in cultivating demons. However, conversely, the host will also become extremely brutal, cold-blooded, and murderously inclined..

chapters.title: Chapter 305: 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega !)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: 129: The Chaotic Era of Magic Cultivation! Unexpected Developments (10,000-word mega !)_6
Translator: 549690339
Green Talent: Happy- go-lucky: The host enjoys watching others suffer and
finds joy in it. With such happiness, the cultivation speed can be increased. However, it is also more likely to be killed by others.
Wang Ping was very surprised by the refreshed talent.
His recent luck seemed to be too good….
He had just refreshed a double red talent last time, and now he actually refreshed a blue one as well.
Moreover, this blue talent was one he really wanted.
With the Demon Cultivation Chaos talent, he might be able to take the Demon Path in the simulator, thus infiltrating the Demon Cult and obtaining genuine demonic inheritance.
At that time, it would be perfect to give Cai Yonglong a taste of it.
“It really seems like whatever I want comes true.”
Wang Ping thought secretly in his heart.
“Mr. Wang, what’s wrong?”
Seeing Wang Ping distracted, Cai Yonglong asked worriedly.
“Nothing, I’ll just run a simulation for a moment. Just stay put here,”
Wang Ping spoke casually.
“Mr. Wang, don’t use that gag.”
Cai Yonglongs face turned black.
Wang Ping ignored Cai Yonglongs complaints and said in his heart: “System, I choose O. Demon Cultivation Chaos.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out again, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text floated before his eyes.
[On the first day, you chose to optimize the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, successfully upgrading it to a 9th tier Treasure Medicine. This surprised Cai Yonglong greatly, as he didn’t expect you to have such a golden finger. As a result of the influence of the Blue Talent: Demon Cultivation Chaos, your temperament became very cold, without offering any explanation.]
[Afterward, you left the place. After you left, Bing Ningyue emerged from the woods. It turned out that she had arrived a little later and hid here by using a secret method to conceal her breath. She had been considering how to pick the 8-tier Treasure Elixir Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, but had not expected you to appear one step ahead, kill the Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast and pick the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower.]
[Bing Ningyue was very surprised by your performance just now. Not only did she marvel at your combat abilities, but she was also shocked by your
methods. Despite being an 8-tier Treasure Elixir, the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower was upgraded by you in an instant, which was astonishing.]
[Bing Ningyue became curious about you and planned to find an opportunity to get to know you.]
[On your side, you returned to Sacred Heart Island. After returning to Sacred
Heart Island, you brought Ye Chen and Cai Yonglong back to Profound Turtle
Continent. Your unusual behavior puzzled the two of them, who had no idea
[For this, you had no desire to explain. After you returned to Profound Turtle Continent, you directly killed Ye Chen in a ruthless manner. Because you had the Blue Talent: Demon Cultivation Chaos and prepared to cultivate demonic Tao, Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, could very likely become your enemy in the future, so it’s better to kill him now.]
[ of course, you’ve thought about taking Ye Chen along the Demon Path, but Ye Chen is uncontrollable and you can’t easily control him. It’s not safe to do so. Only when Ye Chen is dead can the benefits to you be maximized.]
[Cai Yonglong was horrified by your sudden killing of Ye Chen, not understanding why you did it. You had no intention of explaining; you just suppressed Cai Yonglong and sealed off his cultivation. In your view, Cai Yonglong still had great value, so you wouldn’t kill him.]
[However, you didn’t trust him, so you planned to brand him as a slave later on to gain complete control over him. What you needed was just a tool, not a partner or friend.]
“What an unexpected turn of events. This Demon Cultivation Chaos is indeed terrifying. ”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a weird expression on his face.
It seemed like this is the first time Ye Chen has died in all the simulations. It was rather absurd that the first time Ye Chen was killed, it was by his own hand.
It seemed that the Son of Fortune, without the conditions to save himself, would surely meet a certain death. It’s not like the heavens would use various strange methods to save him.
“In this case, I don’t have to worry too much about the Son of Fortune in the future. Even if I encounter other Sons of Fortune, I can treat them calmly, and not be as troubled and cautious as 1 was when dealing with Ye Chen before.” Wang Pings eyes flickered, and he thought secretly in his heart.
To be honest, Ye Chen’s character is quite good. Although he was born under the ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ fate which had caused the deaths of many people, Ye Chen is grateful. He even offered to share his Nirvana Realm inheritance and Divine Skills, which is not something an ordinary person can do.
If it were someone like Lan Yinchan, they would definitely not be like this.
In the past, Wang Ping also worried about encountering someone like Lan Yinchan, or even someone more vicious, as the Son of Fortune.
If he were to encounter such a Son of Fortune and was unable to kill them, it would be truly troublesome.
Now that he knows that the Son of Fortune can die, he feels relieved.
Of course, reality is not like a brainless feel-good novel where the Son of Fortune gets stronger and survives through illogical means.
“Besides, it turns out Bing Ningyue was here earlier than I thought. That’s quite a surprise. But through the simulation, I know that I wasted some time in buying the property, so it’s normal for her to come here first. It seems that she knew there was a treasure elixir here earlier and had even come here before, but she wasn’t confident in dealing with the Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Beast and had prepared some backup before coming again.”
Wang Ping thought of Bing Ningyue and analyzed her motives silently.
At the same time, he looked around without showing any emotion, trying to find Bing Ningyue’s location.
Of course, he didn’t use his Spiritual Sense, as doing so might alert her.
However, Wang Ping thought about it and felt that there was no need to hide. With a smile on his face, he said, “Miss Bing, you’ve been watching for quite some time now. It’s time to come out.”
Wang Pings words stunned Cai Yonglong, who couldn’t help but want to look over through the opportunity line.
Only then did Cai Yonglong remember that his golden finger had a rule.
Once he discovered the opportunity before him, the opportunity line would disappear.
“Senior, the junior didn’t mean to spy on you. It’s just that the junior discovered this treasure elixir before you did, but didn’t take action due to my lack of strength. This time, after preparing carefully, 1 came to pick it, not expecting you to act first.”
Bing Ningyue was startled, not expecting herself to be discovered. After hesitating, she still chose to reveal herself and bowed slightly to Wang Ping.
“Since this treasure is not destined for me, I shall leave now..

chapters.title: Chapter 306: 130: The Nine Nether Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000-word Big Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: 130: The Nine Nether Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000-word Big Chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
“Hehe, Miss Bing, no need to be nervous. I bear no ill will towards you.”
Wang Ping said with a faint smile.
“Also, my name is Wang Ping, and I’m just twenty- six years old. Our ages are not too different, so you can call me fellow taoist, no need to address me as a senior.”
Bing Ningyue is a little older than Ye Chen, but she’s only eighteen years old now.
Frankly, an eighteen-year-old half- step Profound Elixir Realm is indeed abnormal in a place like Sacred Heart Island.
But considering Bing Ningyue’s future achievements, this shouldn’t be surprising.
It’s estimated that this is because Bing Ningyue’s Special Constitution has not yet fully awakened. Once she goes to the real Ice Palace, her true talent will awaken and she will soar into the sky.
Of course, there might be a disaster in her fate, which is also true.
“Twenty- six years old.”
Bing Ningyue was stunned.
She never thought that Wang Ping was only twenty- six years old.
At such an age, having such cultivation, and the profound elixir tier he condensed is obviously extraordinary, which is truly terrifying.
Although she has already reached the Half- step Profound Elixir Realm Cultivation, she is unlikely to break through in a short time in order to condense a High-tier Profound Elixir.
Perhaps, she might not be able to break through to the Profound Elixir Realm by the time she’s twenty- six.
“In that case, I’ll take the liberty to call you Mr. Wang.” Bing Ningyue hesitated for a moment, then said.
Her demeanor and tone carried a cold air, giving others a difficult- to- approach impression.
However, Wang Ping had seen the Bing Ningyue who had been seduced by ‘Flower Picker Wang Ping, knowing that she wasn’t difficult to get along with, and was actually very tender, at least after being seduced.
“This is Cai Yonglong, my friend.”
Wang Ping smiled and nodded, introducing Cai Yonglong as well.
Bing Ningyue glanced at Cai Yonglong and just nodded, not showing the same attitude she had for Wang Ping.
She wasn’t fond of Cai Yonglong, as his gaze had left a bad impression on her when they were in Sacred Heart City before, even though it wasn’t malicious.
Cai Yonglong felt a bit embarrassed when he noticed Bing Ningyue’s cold attitude towards him and thought that his previous performance was indeed lacking.
“Mr. Wang, I wonder if you could part with the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower. I am willing to exchange items of equivalent value in return.”
Bing Ningyue hesitated for a moment, but still mustered up the courage to speak.
Medicines that enhance comprehension are precious, and she needed them very much. She didn’t want to miss out.
If she could obtain this treasure elixir and improve her comprehension, she might be able to comprehend the Great Profound Ice State and then attempt to comprehend Divine Skills.
In half a year, she will head to the real Ice Palace to participate in the grand competition. If she performs well, she will be able to stay there for cultivation and inherit the true teachings of the Ice Palace.
For this reason, she took the risk of asking Wang Ping for a trade.
Although she has a trump card, if Wang Ping turns out to be a cultivator who commits all sorts of evil deeds, she might have to pay a heavy price to escape.
After all, there’s a considerable gap between the two’s cultivation levels. Wang Ping, who isn’t an ordinary Profound Elixir Realm, would be even more difficult to defeat, so even escaping would be a problem.
“Miss Bing, I understand the value of such treasures for cultivators like us.
Please allow me some time to consider, alright?”
Wang Ping didn’t directly reject Bing Ningyue, but instead replied with a smile and a flickering gaze.
“Of course.” Bing Ningyue saw that Wang Ping didn’t directly reject her, and that he didn’t intend to attack her either. She couldn’t help but brighten up and sigh with relief, her impression of Wang Ping improving slightly.
“In that case, let’s meet again at Sacred Heart City in three days. By then, I will give Miss Bing a definite answer.”
Wang Ping said with a smile on his face.
Although, in all likelihood, he won’t trade the treasure elixir with Bing Ningyue, he hasn’t completely ruled out the idea of trading either.
That’s because he took one thing into account.
If he can refresh the blue talent or even red talent for improving comprehension in these three days, then he doesn’t need to take this treasure elixir anymore.
Because this level of elixir, even if it reaches nine stars, wouldn’t have much effect on him anymore.
Actually, it’s only useful for Bing Ningyue at the moment.
Once Bing Ningyue goes to the real Ice Palace and awakens her true talent, this thing won’t be of much use to her either. So, Wang Ping chose to give both parties some time, Everything depends on the situation.
Of course, Wang Ping also considered another possibility.
That is, if the optimization fails… it would be awkward.
Although he succeeded in the simulated future, success in reality is uncertain. Everything is unknown.
Life simulation is just to gain some confidence and psychological comfort.
“Alright. Then Ningyue will visit Mr. Wang again in three days. This is my Message Talisman, I hope Mr. Wang will accept it.”
Bing Ningyue nodded slightly, took out a special Message Talisman from her Storage Ring, and handed it to Wang Ping before quickly leaving the place. Regarding this, Wang Ping accepted the Message Talisman without saying much.
“Brother Wang, now that you have her contact information, do you really plan to invest?”
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping enviously and muttered.
“Invest in what? It depends on the situation. Next, let’s continue searching for treasures on Sacred Heart Island. There are soul-nourishing treasure elixirs inside that can be used to refine soul-nourishing elixirs, which will be of great help to your cultivation once you and the others have reached the Spirit
Accumulation Realm.’ Wang Ping said blandly.
“Oh, I see!”
Cai Yonglongs eyes immediately lit up and he cast any other questions to the back of his mind..

chapters.title: Chapter 307: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_2
Translator: 549690339
Soul nourishing treasure elixirs, what a superb item!
Next, Wang Ping didn’t continue to view the simulation content, he took Cai Yonglong directly to look for the treasure elixir.
Although Wang Ping considered himself to have strong cultivation, he wasn’t about to distract himself in the Sacred Heart Mountain Range, a place that housed numerous Profound Elixir Realm demonic beasts, to watch the simulation content, as that could spell trouble.
Wang Ping wasn’t worried about his death; instead, he was worried that Cai Yonglong might unexpectedly kick the bucket, in which case resurrecting him would be too costly.
The previous simulation was merely so he could see the outcome after optimization, the development of the simulation content certainly came as an unexpected surprise.
Half a day later, Wang Ping found the cave of the Profound Elixir Realm demonic beasts and discovered the 8-tier treasure elixir, although it was yet to mature.
To be exact, it was still a long way from maturity.
Nonetheless, Wang Ping wasn’t picky, planning to dig it up anyway.
For this, he casually killed the two Profound Elixir Realm demonic beasts, picked the elixir, and left the rootstock behind.
After handling all these, Wang Ping brought Cai Yonglong back to Sacred Heart City.
Upon returning to the courtyard of Sacred Heart City, only then did Wang Ping take out the jade box containing the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower in his secret chamber and chose to optimize it.
“Ding, optimization successful. Congratulations host, you have obtained two
Four-Leaf White Jade Flowers.” The mechanical voice sounded.
Then, the Four-Leaf White Jade Flowers in Wang Pings jade box miraculously ended up multiplying into two.
“Eh, optimizations can take place in this manner too?”
Wang Ping looked at the two Four-Leaf White Jade Flowers, his expression peculiar.
The optimization in Life Simulator results in it becoming of 9th tier.
But now, it turned into two.
It seems like, as he suspected, even if the optimization in the simulation is successful, the real world might yield different results.
It could be an optimization failure, or could be that the direction of optimization is different.
Therefore, one can’t easily trust the outcomes within the Life Simulator.
“However, having two treasure elixirs now, 1 can trade with Bing Ningyue, that can be considered an investment.’
Wang Ping looked at the two elixirs, contemplating quietly to himself.
He once again summoned the luminescent screen of the Life Simulator, prepared to watch the next simulation content.
[Next, you switch to cultivating the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, consumed the Nirvana Fruit, and upgraded your Ist-tier Profound Elixir to a flawless one. Also, you transformed your Spiritual Body into the Five Element Demon Body.]
[After you completed all these, you went to Devil’s Cave, met the Blood Demon Yuan Feng, and asked him which demon cult he belonged to, showing your intention to join.]
[Taken aback by your inquiry, Blood Demon Yuan Feng was surprised. He hadn’t thought that the Profound Turtle Continent could produce a Profound Elixir Realm Demonic Cultivator such as yourself, and the Profound Elixir you condensed was impressive. Thus, he became interested in you, stating that if you set him free, he would teach you his demonic inheritance and take you into the demon cult.]
[You accepted Blood Demon Yuan Fengs proposal, slaughtered the people on the Profound Turtle Continent, and used a vast amount of Blood Spirit to break the seal, thus freeing Blood Demon Yuan Feng. What followed was Blood Demon Yuan Feng revealing several secrets to you, the demon sect he joined was called Jiuyou Demon Sect, the strongest demon sect in the Purple Spirit Realm. Its Jiuyou Demon Emperor, in the past three thousand years, had already reached Emperor Realm with battle power that could rank within the top twenty of the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[To your surprise, you hadn’t expected Blood Demon Yuan Feng to be from
Jiuyou Demon Sect. Given that the technique he was cultivating, Bloodthirsty  Demon Technique, was similar to the characteristics of Blood Demons, you initially thought he was related to the Blood Demon Clan. An unforeseen revelation was that it was the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ who established Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[For a moment, you considered whether or not to join Jiuyou Demon Sect. Because the so-called ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ must be an extremely formidable character and once your identity was exposed, you could be in mortal danger.]
[However, since you were destined to walk the Demon Path, you should choose the best one. That’s why you planned to join a demon cult.]
[Under the lead of Blood Demon Yuan Feng, you left Profound Turtle Continent and arrived at the Seven Stars Archipelago. However, Blood Demon
Yuan Feng didn’t immediately plan to recommend you to join Jiuyou Demon
Sect, and preferred to first recover his strength.]
[You didn’t object to this, and silently assisted Blood Demon Yuan Feng in slaughtering several formidable existences to help him recover some of his strength.]
[Meanwhile, you remembered Bing Ningyue was not ordinary, you chose to go to Sacred Heart Island, suppressed her, and utilized the demonic method taught by Blood Demon Yuan Feng to enslave her, similar to Cai Yonglong.]
[Blood Demon Yuan Feng did not think much about your act to enslave Bing
Ningyue, merely considering that you still had some romantic interests.]
[What followed was Blood Demon Yuan Feng using a method to contact a demon from Jiuyou Demon Sect. That was a cultivator from Life and Death Realm. He appeared and was surprised at Blood Demon Yuan Fengs predicament, ridiculing him that his life is really tough, having fallen to such a stage and yet not dying.]
[Blood Demon Yuan Feng didn’t intend to argue with this Life and Death Realm Master, but was introducing you instead, hoping that he could guide you to join Jiuyou Demon Sect. Blood Demon Yuan Feng fervently said that you had condensed a Flawless Profound Elixir and thus had a hopeful future to reach the King Realm, believing that the Demon Emperor would definitely reward them.]
[The Life and Death Realm Master was equally surprised, never thinking that Blood Demon Yuan Feng could actually find such a promising seedling like you. For this reason, he too was pleasantly surprised. But beneath his joy, he revealed a cruel smile and immediately slapped Blood Demon Yuan Feng to death.]
[Then, this Life and Death Realm Master told you that Blood Demon Yuan Feng no longer held any status and connections within Jiuyou Demon Sect, and following him to the sect would result in a loss of many future opportunities. He hoped that you would follow him to Jiuyou Demon Sect instead, and say that you were recommended by him..]

chapters.title: Chapter 308: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_3
Translator: 549690339
[Regarding this, you have no objections. For Blood Demon Yuan Feng, you are merely using each other. It can be said that in your eyes, everyone is a target to be utilized. You believe that the current demonic cultivator is the same.]
[Next, under the guidance of this demonic cultivator, you head to the
Bloodthirsty Demon Sect, one of the subordinate sects of the Jiuyou Demon Sect. The original Jiuyou Demon Sect was founded by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor alone. However, today’s Jiuyou Demon Sect is composed of nine great demon sects. These were formed as a result of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor conquering and integrating other demon sects over the years. Among the nine great demon sects, the Jiuyou Demon Sect is the most prestigious and only true demonic geniuses can join this strongest demon sect.]
[It can be said that the number of people in the Jiuyou Demon Sect is the rarest among all the demon sects, but there is not a single simple person among the demons in the Jiuyou Demon Sect. They are either Nirvana Realm
Masters or demonic geniuses who are bound to enter the Nirvana Realm in the future and have the potential to become kings.]
[Although you have congealed a Flawless Profound Elixir and are qualified to join the Jiuyou Demon Sect, you still need a recommendation from a Sect
Master level person of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect to do so. It is because only
Sect Masters or Supreme Elders know the location of the Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[Since the Jiuyou Demon Sect is an existence that all Holy Lands and Great
Sects fear and seek to destroy at all times, the small world created by the Jiuyou Demon Sect has been irregularly drifting through spatial turbulence in the Purple Spirit Realm. It is impossible to know its location without taking action as a big shot.]
[Not only the Jiuyou Demon Sect, but the headquarters of the rest of the demon sects are all hidden spaces created by a King-realm Master, and are hard to find.]
[After listening to the explanation of the Life and Death Realm Master, you feel amazed. The Jiuyou Demon Sect is truly worthy of its terrifying power, as it can create such large small worlds floating within spatial turbulence at will.]
[Next, you ask when you will be able to go to the Jiuyou Demon Sect. This Life and l)eath Realm Master tells you that in three years, it will be time for the Talent Selection that takes place once every fifty years. Only the fifty strongest disciples under the age of one hundred with excellent talents from the eight great demon sects can enter the Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[This Life and Death Realm Master hopes that you can first learn the powerful heritage of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect within these three years to improve your fighting power, stand out in the talent selection in three years, and join the Jiuyou Demon Sect. Otherwise, even if you are a monster with a Flawless Profound Elixir, and even if you successfully join the Jiuyou Demon Sect, you could still die in the Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[Because the demon sect is different from the righteous cultivators, although the tier of cultivation of Profound Elixir is important, it is not extremely important. After remembering the words of this Life and Death Realm Master, it brings you to meet the Sect Master of the Bloodthirsty l)emon Sect.]
[Bloodthirsty Demon Lord’s cultivation is extremely terrifying, and he sees that you and Cai Yonglong are extraterritorial comer, and are quite curious about you. However, the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord does not do much to you.
To the demon cult, the extraterritorial comer is not a big deal.]
[After all, their Jiuyou Demon Emperor is an extraterritorial comer, which is something that the True Great Powers of the Purple Spirit Realm know. The Bloodthirsty Demon Lord thinks you have potential and plans to list you as one of the True Inheritor Disciples of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect for special cultivation.]
[Later, Bloodthirsty Demon Lord also finds out the extraordinary presence of Bing Ningyue and sees her true identity. It turns out that Bing Ningyue has the Ice Emperor bloodline flowing in her veins, and it has undergone a return to its ancestral state. It’s just that this bloodline power has not yet been awakened and requires earth- shattering means to activate it. In addition to that, Bing Ningyue also has an Ice Profound Body as a natural constitution.]
[Bloodthirsty Demon Lord is very pleased, feeling that he has found a treasure this time. Your existence is a surprise, and Bing Ningyue is even more so. To the point where, in the eyes of the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord, the importance of Bing Ningyue even surpasses yours.]
[The Ice Emperor is not a simple person. Ten thousand years ago, the Ice Emperor participated in the battle of the Blood Demon, and his methods were so strong that they shocked many strong people. At that time, he was a mere Life and Death Realm cultivator, watching this scene from afar, leaving a deep impression.]
[A person with the Ice Emperor bloodline that has undergone a return to its ancestral state has unimaginable future achievements. Not to mention that
Bing Ningyue possesses the special constitution of an Ice Profound Body. An Ice Profound Body is one of the powerful constitutions recorded in the Purple Spirit Realm and can rival the bloodlines of the Imperial Family’s descendants. A returning bloodline combined with an Ice Profound Body makes it hard to imagine how terrifying Bing Ningyue’s talents are. If she does not cultivate her spiritual power, her future achievements may surpass those of the Ice Emperor from ten thousand years ago.]
[Although there is no Ice Palace heritage in the demon sect, it doesn’t matter. If the Demon Emperor personally cultivates her, her achievements will certainly be higher than those cultivated by the Ice Palace. In the future, the Jiuyou Demon Sect will have another extremely powerful emperor.]
“So the Jiuyou Demon Sect now has nine great demon sects; this ‘predecessor transmigrators’ is truly amazing.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, amazed in his heart.
Originally, he thought that the Jiuyou Demon Sect was a single powerful demon sect that could rival the Holy Lands. However, it now seems that his horizons were small.
The Jiuyou Demon Sect has actually unified the other eight powerful demon sects, becoming a truly Jiuyou Demon Sect.
Comparing the strength of the forces, it is believed that the Jiuyou Demon Sect is above any single Holy Land…
That ‘predecessor transmigrator’ is really terrifying..

chapters.title: Chapter 309: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !) _4
Translator: 549690339
No wonder, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master’s evaluation of Jiuyou Demon Sect’s disturbance in the entire Purple Spirit Realm and the endless murderous calamity is true.
This evaluation is not an exaggeration at all.
“However, Bing Ningyue, Bing Ningyue, is actually a descendant of the Ice
Empress, and has a returning bloodline? It’s quite surprising.”
Although Wang Ping had guessed that Bing Ningyue’s identity was astonishing, he didn’t expect it to be this terrifying.
The Ice Emperor, that’s a terrifying existence in the Emperor Realm.
However, it’s very likely that the Ice Emperor had already fallen during the Blood Demon War ten thousand years ago.
As a result, the Ice Palace fell from the level of a Holy Land and became an existence relying on the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
If it weren’t for that, there would’ve been no need for the successor of the Ice
Palace to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War and join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, becoming a true disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
“It seems that I can really obtain a powerful demonic inheritance this time. Even if 1 can’t get the core inheritance of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, the cultivation skill of that ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ in the Demon Path, this strongest Demonic Cultivation Skill of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect, it must be obtained.’
Then, Wang Ping converged his emotions and continued to stare at the luminescent screen, contemplating in his heart.
As Wang Ping gazed at the screen, the text on the screen appeared once again.
[Although you don’t know why the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord stares at Bing
Ningyue with passionate and unmasked eyes, you can guess that Bing Ningyue might be even more extraordinary than you imagined. You don’t have any thoughts about this.]
[Next, the Life and Death Realm Master receives an astonishing reward from the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord and leaves ecstatically. You and Bing Ningyue, together, receive special training from the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord. As for Cai Yonglong, although his talent is not bad, it’s not worth the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord’s personal training, so the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord wants him to become an ordinary disciple in the Demon Sect.]
[However, because of your request, Cai Yonglong eventually becomes your servant, following you left and right.]
[In the blink of an eye, three years have passed. Due to your Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation, your talent in the Demon Path is quite high. Although you haven’t reached the level of a Saint Son, you’re not weaker than the other True Inheritor Disciples of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect. As a result, you have successfully raised your cultivation to the 7th Tier Profound Elixir Realm in these three years.]
[At the same time, you have also learned the true Bloodthirsty Demon
Technique. Originally, the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique that Blood Demon
Yuan Feng cultivated was only the first volume. The true Bloodthirsty Demon Technique is divided into three volumes: upper, middle, and lower. The upper volume is an upper-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skill. The middle volume is a heaven-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skill. As for the lower volume, it’s a legendary king-tier Cultivation Skill, a powerful skill created by a King Realm Master.]
[However, only Life and Death Realm Masters are qualified to cultivate King-tier Cultivation Skills. And the lower volume of Demonic Skill is only available to Demonic Cultivators who have reached the Life and Death Realm or above. Therefore, you are cultivating the middle volume of the Bloodthirsty
Demon Technique.]
[In addition, you have chosen suitable Demonic Divine Skills to cultivate in the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect. Although there are many Divine Skills and Secret Skills in the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect, you have only cultivated the top-tier Demonic Sword Technique.Purgatory Devil Sword. Because for a young genius like you, the higher the quality of other people’s divine skills, the better, as you cannot practice other people’s divine skills to perfection, and can only display part of their power.]
[At the same time, the higher the rank of the divine skills, the more difficult it is to enter a realm, which will waste a lot of time. Therefore, cultivating high-ranked divine skills that are not suitable for oneself is not necessarily stronger than refining low-ranked divine skills that are suitable for oneself.]
[Of course, the ultimate goal of you cultivating other people’s divine skills is not just to increase your combat power, but also to learn from their divine skills and create your own divine skills. In these three years, you have successfully done this and created your own Divine Sword Technique: Demon Sun Afterglow. Although the quality of this divine skill is only at the entry tier, you believe in its potential. As long as you continue to perfect it, in the future, it will definitely become a top-tier or even supreme divine skill.]
“This Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation Talent… is really terrifying.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a look of astonishment across his face.
Impressive. Although cultivating Demons in the early stage of cultivation is much faster than the orthodox path, a Blue Talent allowed him to improve his cultivation to the 7th Tier Profound Elixir Realm in just three years. This cultivation speed is too fast.
Apart from that, with this talent, his comprehension has actually reached an astonishing level. He has learned a top-tier Demonic Divine Skill and created a divine skill of his own in just three years. This is quite outrageous.
One must know that Wang Ping always wanted to comprehend divine skills
before, but couldn’t even manage to enter the realm.
“l didn’t expect that my first self-created divine skill would actually be created while practicing cultivating Demons.”
Wang Pings mood was not calm, and his expression was complicated.
Could it be that he is more suitable for cultivating Demons?
“1 guess I’m overthinking. It’s not that I’m more suitable for cultivating Demons, but this Demon Cultivating Chaos Talent, although only blue in color, discarding its side effect that greatly changes one’s personality, the grade of this talent is definitely at the red level, and not just a single aspect of improving aptitude or comprehension, but a comprehensive improvement.”
Wang Ping quickly took a breath, calming himself down and contemplating in his heart.
The grade of talents with side effects often surpasses their level, and this is fully demonstrated in Demon Cultivating Chaos.
“l wonder if I can use the self-created divine skill later when it refreshes, and if I choose this reward..

chapters.title: Chapter 310: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_5
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping thought of this question again.
In order to use Divine Skills, Cultivation Skill, artistic conception, and Martial Skills, they must all fit together, which was the information Wang Ping had learned in Heavenly Sea Country.
However, Heavenly Sea Country is ultimately just a medium-sized country, and the information may not be accurate.
If such complex conditions were really needed, then wouldn’t the cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm be unable to practice after obtaining the Divine Skills of others?
Wouldn’t the self-created Divine Skills after switching cultivation methods be unusable?
“Perhaos. it’s not that troublesome. lust need to make adiustments by oneself.
This is somewhat similar to the Red Fire Skill.”
Wang Ping analyzed in his heart.
Next, Wang Ping settled his thoughts and continued to watch the luminescent screen.
[After you are ready, you will participate in the trial of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect. In the end, you succeed in standing out among your peers and are selected to go to the Jiuyou Demon Sect. However, Cai Yonglong is not qualified to go to the Jiuyou Demon Sect and can only stay in the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect. There is nothing you can do about this.]
[In these three years, Cai Yonglong has been of great help to you. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have been able to cultivate to the 7th Tier Profound Elixir Realm within these three years without affecting your foundation. However, you didn’t think much about it. After all, when you return from the Jiuyou Demon Sect, you can still use Cai Yonglong to find opportunities.]
[Next, you are taken by the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord to the small world where the Jiuyou Demon Sect is located. Among them, the disciples of the
Bloodthirsty Demon Sect, including Bing Ningyue, are very cold. Especially
Bing Ningyue, who has a hidden intention to kill you.]
[Bing Ningyue, after breaking free from your control, hates you to the extreme. Without you, she wouldn’t have been reduced to joining the Demon Cult, and she might not see the light of day again in this life.]
[After you arrive at the small world where the Jiuyou Demon Sect is located, you also meet the Demon Lords of the other seven major Demon Sects and the disciples they bring. After the Demon Lords of the various major Demon Sects snipe at each other, the Deputy Sect Leader of Jiuyou Demon Sect appears.]
[The Deputy Sect Leader of the Jiuyou Demon Sect also brings the disciples of Jiuyou Demon Sect’s generation and announces the rules of admission. The disciples of the eight major Demon Sects will fight in the Bloodshed Forest.
When the number of people is reduced by half, the survivors will truly join the
Jiuyou Demon Sect and receive key cultivation.]
[You feel a chill in your heart. The Jiuyou Demon Sect is indeed ruthless. Even after selecting talents once, they still want to screen them again in a gu-feeding manner. No wonder the fame of Jiuyou Demon Sect is so terrifying and intimidating. Under such a harsh selection mechanism, whoever bears the identity of Jiuyou Demon Sect is absolutely a true demon, with few opponents in the same realm. Perhaps, even True Disciples of the Holy Land would be beaten upon encountering True Disciples of Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
“Why do I feel familiar with the style of this Jiuyou Demon Sect?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a strange gleam in his eyes.
Isn’t this Alpha’s previous method?
Raising gu of various kinds.
And then raising an extremely perverted ransmigrator, who dismantled it.
This ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ is also playing this game,
Isn’t he afraid that he will raise a terrifying powerhouse like Alpha and be destroyed?
Alpha: ‘
“Humans are much more cunning than me, he must have some control methods, and won’t let things get out of control.” Alpha suddenly appeared and began to explain.
“I also think so.’
Wang Ping nodded his head, fully approving of Alpha’s words.
“By the way, Alpha, what’s the name of this ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ and how did he perform in the chat group at that time?”
Suddenly, Wang Ping thought of something and asked curiously.
“His name is Chu Xiao. His presence in the chat group at that time was not strong because the Emperor tier’s combat power was not worth mentioning in the chat group at that time. However, every time he made a move, he was extremely ruthless and could quickly complete the chat group’s tasks. Therefore, although his presence was not strong and his combat power was not particularly strong, his means of doing things was still very good.”
Alpha silently explained.
“Uh…
Wang Ping was speechless.
Was the Emperor tier’s combat pox,ver really not worth mentioning before the last chat group was destroyed?
It seems that the chat group had developed for quite a long time.
It’s true, without developing like this, the big shots in its group would not be qualified to contact the forces of Myriad Heavens and dismantle the chat group.
“Chu Xiao… Judging from the name, he’s not a simple character.”
Wang Ping thought silently in his heart.
Names like his and those of the people in the group were quite ordinary, the kind seen everywhere.
But Chu Xiao’s name was quite rare, often appearing in various novels as an important supporting character or leading character.
“l really don’t know how strong he is now, whether he’s reached the level of Guilt-Punishing Emperor, or close to that level.”
Wang Ping silently speculated.
“Alpha, what was his attitude towards the chat group? Was he one of the participants, and is it possible to subdue and recall him?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin as he asked another question.
If his combat power surpasses the opponent in the future and he has the ability to completely control the opponent, it would be a good choice to include him in the chat group.
After all, having grown to this point through his own efforts, if he rejoins the chat group, it would be like having an additional top-notch combatant on the team..

chapters.title: Chapter 311: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: 130: Jiuyou Demon Emperor! Terrifying Opportunity (10,000 -word !)_6
Translator: 549690339
“Give up on that idea. No previous transmigrators haven’t been hostile towards me. Once he discovers your existence, he’ll definitely spare no effort to kill you.”
Alpha said coldly and ruthlessly.
“As for controlling him after you surpass him, are you sure you can? I’ve tried to control them many times before, but they always ended up tricking me. Those transmigrators who grew on their own are very good at disguising
themselves. They can deceive themselves first, and then deceive me. Therefore, even though I continuously monitor their thoughts, I still fell for their tricks.’
‘You may have the advantage of the Golden finger, but in terms of personal methods, you newcomers who have only lived for a little while and grown up in a greenhouse can’t compare to them. I’m afraid you will be played to death once you are discovered by them.”
Wang Pings mouth twitched, unable to say anything.
Well, he was indeed naive.
It was true that they were sheltered flowers, growing rapidly through the
Golden finger and Alpha’s concessions.
In terms of cunning, these new transmigrators, who had only lived for a short while, couldn’t compare to their ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ who had lived for an unknown period and whose means even Alpha dreaded.
Not to mention that his current strength was still far behind the others. Even if his strength was much stronger than the others, Wang Ping might not be able to control them.
According to Alpha, he might indeed be tricked to death by the other party.
Therefore, the best choice when facing the other party was to completely kill them.
The other party might think the same way.
Then, Wang Ping settles his mind and continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[You were sent to the Bloodshed Forest for battle. You congealed a Flawless Profound Elixir, had extraordinary strength, numerous means, and were not injured on the first day. However, on the second day, you encountered Bing Ningyue. Bing Ningyue hated you extremely and attacked you without hesitation.]
[Facing Bing Ningyue, who was activated in her talent by the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord, you were under great pressure and not her opponent. You wanted to escape, but Bing Ningyue was much stronger than you and pursued you relentlessly.]
[In the end, you were killed by her. As for your death, none of the Demon Way Bigshots, who appeared to be watching the battle, cared. Although you congealed the Flawless Profound Elixir, your performance was far from the previous Flawless Profound Elixir congealers, so you could only be considered a normal monster. Even the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord didn’t care about your fall.]
[In his view, your performance over these three years was indeed average, not particularly noteworthy. Your talent, in his opinion, was only at the level of a Saint Land True Disciple, who just happened to congeal a Flawless Profound Elixir due to an extraordinary encounter. While your talent may not be bad, it is nothing special either of you died.]
[The many Demon Way Bigshots were even more interested in Bing Ningyue. They recognized her identity and background, and each of them was envious of the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord. They did not expect him to bring such a monster, and they believed that the Demon Emperor would definitely reward him heavily.]
[At this time, you were resurrected because of the Rebirth tally. Bing Ningyue was very surprised by your resurrection and attacked you again mercilessly. You, too, were equally ruthless. Knowing that you were no match for Bing Ningyue, you chose to confront her in a manner that would result in mutual losses.]
[The Demon Way Bigshots present were all very astonished at your resurrection. While there were resurrection methods, they should not have been accessible to a Profound Elixir Realm cultivator. Your resurrection method, which was equivalent to time reversal, was very strange.]
[Therefore, they became interested in you. As you exchanged blows with Bing Ningyue intending to inflict mutual losses, you were eventually defeated and about to be killed by her. Just then, the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord intervened, ignoring space and capturing you.]
[You struggled desperately to no avail, and were about to have your soul relentlessly searched by the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord.]
[Right when you were about to have your soul searched by the Bloodthirsty
Demon Lord, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor suddenly appeared and saved you. You were shocked, not expecting the Jiuyou Demon Emperor to suddenly appear and save you.]
[The other big shots of the Jiuyou Demon Sect also didn’t expect the Demon Emperor to appear suddenly and save you. They all quickly paid their respects.]
[Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao didn’t say much, and after instructing the others to continue watching the trial, he took you away and brought you to his residence.]
[Next, Jiuyou Demon Emperor directly revealed your transmigrator identity. Knowing that you couldn’t deceive him, you chose to admit it. At the same time, you also voluntarily opened your Sea of Consciousness to let Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao view your memories to avoid having your soul searched.]
[Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was very surprised by your cooperation. He chose to check your memories. However, despite finishing reviewing your memories, his expression remained calm and unwavering.]
[You were very puzzled, not knowing why he could be so calm. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao didn’t explain much and intended to accept you as his personal disciple. Upon hearing this, you were astonished, not expecting him to be so peaceful and accept you as his personal disciple, which obviously meant he intended to train you with special emphasis.]
[Although you were uncertain about his intentions, you had no reason to refuse and chose to become his apprentice. Thus, you successfully became Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s personal disciple.]
“What kind of development is this?”
Looking at the simulation content, Wang Ping was somewhat puzzled.
It was understandable tor Bing Ningyue to hate him.
It was also normal for the Demon Path’s Wang Ping to be no match for her. But Jiuyou Demon Emperor knew of his identity, saw his memories, found out that the chat group had been rebuilt, and that the chat group had started issuing Golden Fingers again – shouldn’t he be surprised and envious?
Moreover, shouldn’t he be worried about when the chat group would arrange for the grown-up group members to come to this world and kill him?
Instead, this was his reaction…
Could it be that this is what the real big shots of the Demon Path and
‘Preddecessor Transmigrators’ who have experienced endless storms looked like?
Wang Ping admired this composure.
Next, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, intending to see what kind of ending this time would bring.
[After you became Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s personal disciple, the entire Jiuyou Demon Sect was shaken. This is because Jiuyou Demon Emperor had never taken a personal disciple before, and you were his first. This status was noble, making all the Demon Cult members envious. Moreover, having the personal guidance of Jiuyou Demon Emperor in cultivation also meant limitless future achievements.]
[In practice, your growth speed with Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s personal guidance indeed reached its peak.]
[With the help of the treasures collected by Jiuyou Demon Emperor, your aptitude and comprehension reached a terrifying level, on par with any
Saint-tier characters. At the same time, under the meticulous guidance of Jiuyou Demon Emperor, your Divine Skills were also constantly being perfected..]

chapters.title: Chapter 312: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics! The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A of 10,000 words!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics! The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A of 10,000 words!)
Translator: 549690339
[Eventually, ten years passed, and your cultivation reached the Yin Yang Mirror, making your cultivation and combat power supreme among your peers. You emerged into the world as a direct disciple of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, with a glorious reputation. You even killed the newly appointed
Saint Son of Green Jade Holy Land, shocking the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[The Green Jade Holy Land was furious and dispatched many powerful figures to hunt you down. However, you were protected by the experts of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, and no mishap occurred.]
[Nevertheless, the Green Jade Holy Land was ruthless enough to invest heavily in joining forces with Heavenly Sword Divine Land and Profound Bird Divine Land. They set a trap and attacked you together. You were plotted against by the three great Holy Lands, and even your Dao Protectors were forcibly slaughtered.]
[In the end, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor appeared personally, intending to save you, but the Emperors of the three great Holy Lands took action against the Jiuyou Demon Emperor all at once. It turned out you were nothing but a pawn, and their grand scheme was to draw out the Jiuyou Demon Emperor.
Shockingly, they indeed succeeded in luring him out.]
[Under the aftermath of the battle of the Four Great Emperors, you had absolutely no hope of surviving and you met your absolute death. Even the Jiuyou Demon Emperor couldn’t save you.]
[Due to your death, this simulation comes to an end…. ]
“I’m dead again…”
Wang Ping wore a frown, a peculiar feeling in his heart.
This simulation was undoubtedly the strongest one for Wang Ping.
Not only did he reach the Yin Yang Realm, but he also killed the Saint Son of a
Great Holy Land, a truly renowned feat.
But in the end, he still died.
That being said, it would indeed be anomalous if he had managed to survive in the face of a grand scheme by the three prestigious Holy Lands intended to ensnare the Jiuyou Demon Emperor.
“But something feels off.”
Wang Pings brow furrowed, his heart fraught with unease.
The attitude of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor towards him was too strange, he didn’t mind at all that he was chosen as the acting group master by the Transmigrator Chat Group. He was nurturing him with all his might.
Logically, after soul-searching, he should know about his Golden Finger and the circumstances of the chat group.
“Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he must’ve realized that the Wang Ping in
the simulation is just another version of me from a different timeline, he does not have a Life Simulator, nor can he communicate with the Chat Group. Could it be that Chu Xiao did not regard me as an enemy, but rather as a like-minded individual based on this fact?”
“Or is he intentionally showing goodwill in the simulation, making me believe that he means me no harm, for the sake of playing safe?”
Wang Ping pondered silently.
Something wasn’t right; it couldn’t be that simple.
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes.
This ‘predecessor transmigrator’ achieved where he was all by himself and even single-handedly established the strongest Demon Sect in the Purple Spirit Realm, how could someone like him bend so easily to curry favor with me.
There must be deeper schemes at play.
“Could it be that Chu Xiao is trying to lull me into a false sense of security and testing to see if I think he means no harm to me? Aside from that, he may have tampered with the resources he’s given me. For instance, the resources to enhance my RootPhysique Comprehension, the cultivation he gave, the cultivation skills and martial arts he taught, or even a trap embedded within the Divine Skills I created. Anything I choose from the life simulator award options could be known to the ‘real world’ Demon Emperor.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping thought of a possibility that sent a chill down his spine.
“Once the Jiuyou Demon Emperor in the ‘real world’ knows everything, he can easily find me or trigger something to put me under his control or kill me.”
“Gulp….”
As Wang Ping swallowed, shivers ran down his spine and a cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
This calculation was too deep.
Even if it wasn’t as such, his ambiguous attitude towards him was also a problem.
“Targeting me across parallel universes is terrifying.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath.
Wang Ping initially thought that there would be no dangers in the life simulation…
Now, it seems that this ‘predecessor transmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor has given him a lesson.
If someone assails his soul and learns his secrets, they would be able to scheme against him in his real body.
If he is not careful, he might face a woeful death.
“l will not lightly appear in front of these cunning elderly creatures before 1 have the capability to withstand their soul-searching or the means to be pressured into revealing my secrets.”
Wang Ping clenched his teeth, this iron-clad law added to his heart.
However, even though he had added this rule, there was no guarantee that Wang Ping from the simulation would follow his intentions, and he might encounter unexpected incidents.
This was beyond his control.
“l absolutely cannot follow the Demon Path, it’s too dangerous, too uncontrollable.’
Wang Ping let out a deep breath.
Now, in his mind, he had the information that if he joined the Jiuyou Demon Sect, he could be given the key training of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor.
In the next simulation, if Wang Ping encountered desperation, he might still choose to walk this path.
Therefore…before the next simulation, a safety measure must be added.
As Wang Ping was pondering, his sight shifted abruptly.
He found himself in unfamiliar territory, being hunted by the powers from the three great holy lands. Powerful Dao Protectors were fatally besieged by a joint effort from the three holy lands.
In the end, even as the Jiuyou Demon Emperor appeared personally, he too faced the collaboration of the strong figures of the three holy lands.
There’s no denying that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor is indeed powerful, not falling behind despite facing off against three at a time.
However, he didn’t seem to have the spare energy to save the simulated Wang Ping..

chapters.title: Chapter 313: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics! The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A of 10,000 words!) 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics! The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A of 10,000 words!) 2
Translator: 549690339
In the end, even if they reached the Yin Yang Realm, they could only end up dead and vanished under the aftermath of the battle between these powerful fighters.
Afterward, Wang Pings vision returned to normal.
“Something’s not right…”
When Wang Ping came to his senses, he once again sensed something abnormal.
He didn’t find anything strange about the battle between the Four Great
Emperors; he couldn’t discern anything at his level.
What he found odd was that someone like Jiuyou Demon Emperor would risk appearing and saving him, only to be besieged by the Three Great Emperors?
Apart from that, knowing the dangers of the world, acting so high-profile didn’t match the character and style of a simulated Wang Ping.
It might not even match the way the Jiuyou Demon Sect operates.
The Jiuyou Demon Sect was indeed powerful, but it belonged to the forces that couldn’t be exposed to the light. It was impossible for them to act arrogantly and kill the Saint Sons in the Holy Land.
Even if the Jiuyou Demon Sect wanted to kill, they would definitely do it cleanly without leaving any trace.
Apart from that, after killing the Saint Son, he was still roaming around high-profile instead of hiding and cultivating low-key in the Jiuyou Demon Sect headquarters for a while. As a result, he was found by the Three Great Forces and trapped, which was very strange,
Wang Ping frowned, pondering over it.
“You don’t need to think about it.” Alpha’s voice suddenly rang out: “Your speculation is mostly correct. This guy is plotting against you. He nurtured you, setting you up, but he doesn’t want to train you too strong. Because once you find out, you can go to other worlds or use some methods to deal with his backhand. In that case, he would lose both the chess game and the troops.”
“So, he will try to make you not see through him while reasonably letting you
die. Moreover, although he pretended to be very similar, even if you reach the
Emperor tier, you may not be able to tell. However, he hid a lot of strength. Otherwise, even if he couldn’t kill those three old monsters with one against three, he could easily save you under the noses of the Three Great Emperors and leave leisurely.”
Alpha’s cold and merciless voice made the chill in Wang Pings heart grow deeper.
“Damn, old monsters are just old monsters, they are so good at scheming against people. And this strength is too terrifying. With one against three, he can still save a small shrimp like me and leave leisurely.”
Wang Pings face twitched, and he cursed out loud.
“All this is just my analysis. However, in my opinion, even if he has the possibility of killing one or two Emperors of the Three Great Holy Lands with one against three, it may not be impossible.”
Alpha spoke again.
Wang Ping: .
“Compared to the Guilt-Punishing Emperor of ten thousand years ago, who is stronger and who is weaker?”
After Wang Pings silence, he asked a question.
“The Guilt-Punishing Emperor is an existence above the Emperor tier. He is the one who has half a foot stepped out of the Emperor realm.”
Alpha spoke indifferently.
“Uh…
Wang Ping was dumbfounded.
Although he knew that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was terrifying, he didn’t expect it to be that terrifying.
Half a foot stepped out of the Emperor realm, that’s too abnormal.
“What is the realm above the Emperor? Are there such strong people in the Purple Spirit Realm?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“You are not qualified to know these things yet. Knowing too many secrets only bothers the mediocre.”
Alpha said coldly and mercilessly.
“You should just cultivate diligently for now. When you have enough strength, you will naturally know many secrets.”
“Tsk…
Wang Ping smacked his lips, not asking any further.
Since Alpha didn’t want to say it, it was no use asking him anyway.
“Ding! Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
1.Emperor-tier skill Jiuyou Demon Canon.
2.Emperor-Tier Divine skillJiuyou Demon Domain.
3.Learned Secret Skills.
4.Yin and Yang Mirror Cultivation.
5.Great Perfection Ghost Soul State.
6.Self-created Divine SkillDemon Sun Afterglow.
7.Top-tier Divine Power.Purgatory Demon Sword.
8.King-tier skill.Bloodthirsty Demon skill.
9.Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation.
10.Combat Experience.
10.1.Top-tier Demon Weapon.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards that were refreshed this time, and he was completely shocked.
This was the first time he had refreshed so many rewards.
Furthermore, these rewards were more outrageous than the others.
Not to mention king-tier, even emperor-tier were included.
If it were someone with a big heart, they might be overjoyed by now.
However, although Wang Ping was astonished, he wasn’t delighted, but rather, his heart was heavy.
Because he thought that among these rewards, there might be the calculations of ‘Jiuyou Demon Emperor’ Chu Xiao.
Once he chose any of the rewards related to the Demon Path, he might be calculated to death.
Even treasures like that might be given to him by the other party, with the other party’s backhand inside.
As for the self-created divine skill, considering the other party’s terrifying methods, Wang Ping didn’t dare to choose it either.
“It seems that only choosing the talent and combat experience is the safest?” Wang Ping hesitated a little while thinking.
Although he was tempted by the rewards, Wang Ping felt that these rewards were like poisonous snakes, and he absolutely could not choose them.
Thus, only talent and combat experience seemed to be beyond the reach of the other party.
However, Wang Ping did not want to choose Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation either.
This thing would affect his character and force him down the Demon Path, which was a trap.
The Demon Path, wouldn’t that be like jumping into a fire pit?
“So, can 1 only choose combat experience?”
Wang Ping smiled bitterly.
“But even combat experience might not be without the backhand left by that person. 1 even suspect that Wang Ping of the Demon Path has actually been controlled subconsciously by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor. So, there might be pitfalls in combat experience as well..”

chapters.title: Chapter 314: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (Part 3)
Translator: 549690339
Wang Pings eyelid was twitching, and he felt extremely uneasy in his heart.
For example, Jiuyou Demon Emperor had anticipated that Wang Ping might guess his intentions, but he also knew about the option of combat experience, so he laid the biggest trap within the seemingly safest combat experience.
It could be said that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor had calculated everything he could.
This was the style of a Demon Way Bigshot.
Not to mention that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor is still a living ‘Predecessor Ransmigrator’.
When Wang Ping thought about it that way, he really felt outsmarted by his enemy.
With so many rewards, none of them were safe… “System, can I not choose a reward?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in his heart.
“No. Once an award appears, you must choose one, and you cannot give it up.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Fuck. ”
Wang Ping cursed.
For the first time, he felt that the Life Simulator was so tricky, completely disregarding what he, the master, wanted and just f0110ffing the rules. For a moment, he was desperate to upgrade the Golden Finger again.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have any group points on him. “It seems, there is another way.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and calmed down once more.
He could claim rewards in other worlds, and he would not believe that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could still interfere across worlds.
“No, there is a better way. Alpha, after 1 claim the reward, can you banish it immediately without him noticing?”
Wang Pings eyes flickered, and he said in his heart.
“Yes.
Alpha answered calmly.
“Alright, that’ll work.”
Wang Ping let out a sigh of relief.
Fortunately he had direct contact with Alpha and had many privileges. If not, he would be really troublesome to handle.
At that time, either he would be unable to use the paid simulation temporarily and get stuck on the reward page, or he would have to teleport to other group members’ worlds and toss the dangerous thing over there.
Although there were other ways, it would ultimately be troublesome.
The best way to handle it would be to eradicate or banish it completely.
“System, I choose (100.”
Wang Ping clenched his fist and spoke in his heart.
As soon as Wang Ping made his choice, a black sword appeared in his storage ring.
However, the moment the sword appeared, Alpha transferred it away immediately, directly banishing it to the Boundless Void.
Just after the sword was banished to the Boundless Void, glimmers of light appeared on it.
An illusory figure appeared above the sword.
“l was discovered and banished? It seems like he is not stupid, and he thought of everything he should have.”
The illusory figure muttered to himself in the Boundless Void.
“What a pity.”
The illusory figure sighed, then quickly dispersed into the Boundless Void.
Although he was powerful, this was ultimately just an instrument spirit transformed by a wisp of power. It was impossible to survive in such a place for a long time.
“Congratulations, host, for escaping the disaster.”
Alpha transmitted the image to Wang Ping and said coldly.
Wang Ping remained silent.
Good grief, there really was a hidden trap. Fortunately, he banished it, or it would have been dangerous.
Luckily, he got this item reward refreshingly.
Otherwise, if he could only choose the kind of information flow reward, he might have really been defeated.
“Why are these people so evil!”
Wang Pings face twitched, and he was truly terrified.
Before, he always thought that as long as he had the Life Simulator, he could be carefree.
As a result, even with the Life Simulator, he almost got killed through a ‘parallel timeline’, which was just ridiculous.
And this was just an Emperor tier existence. If he met even more terrifying old creatures in the future, it would be unbearable.
“In the future, never think that having the Golden Finger can make me carefree and reach the peak easily. I must always be cautious.” Wang Ping took a deep breath and warned himself secretly.
It must be said, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, this ‘Predecessor Ransmigrator~’ had truly taught him a lesson.
Without this lesson, Wang Ping felt he would not have survived so easily if he encountered someone who was ten or even a hundred times more terrifying than his enemy. Maybe he would have been directly killed by calculation.
“l told you already, don’t try to control them recklessly. With your fledgling status, it’s already something to be proud of not getting killed by their calculations.’
Alpha spoke again, his voice still cold, putting down Wang Ping.
“In the end…this is a group of monsters you raised, and now we have to clean up their mess.”
Wang Pings face darkened.
Although what Alpha said was true, it did not prevent him from talking back.
Hearing this, Alpha did not respond, and once again went silent.
Next, Wang Ping had no mood to continue the simulation, so he sat in the courtyard on a bamboo chair, basking in the sun and pondering various things.
“Mr. Wang, what’s wrong with you? You look troubled.”
Seeing Wang Pings absent-minded appearance, Cai Yonglong passing by asked in confusion.
“Nothing.” Wang Ping sighed.
There was no point in discussing this matter with Cai Yonglong. He couldn’t help with it, and it would only add to his worries.
“Uh.” Cai Yonglong was slightly taken aback.
“By the way, you’d better not cultivating demons, just honestly cultivate. Don’t mess with those unnecessary things.”
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and waved his hand.
Joking, the Demon Path was too risky. He couldn’t even handle it himself, let alone Cai Yonglong..

chapters.title: Chapter 315: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A chapter of 10,000 words!)_4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping began to suspect that even the possessed Cai Yonglong was calculated in the previous simulation.
Well, he’s a little paranoid now.
“Isn’t this the route you suggested, Mr. Wang?” Cai Yonglong rolled his eyes and muttered.
“What did you say?” Wang Ping glared.
“Nothing.” Cai Yonglong quickly shook his head and said, “Fine, I won’t practice demonic cultivation, I think normal cultivation is pretty good, and it won’t disappoint my master.”
“That’s fine.’
Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say anything further.
Then, Wang Ping opened the chat group, wanting to see if anything had happened in the group.
When Wang Ping opened the chat group page, he found that the group was quite lively.
Chen Yao, Lin Yuanyuan, Zhang Hu, and Wang Shuqi had finally completed the tasks assigned by the chat group.
However, compared to Wang Pings ease, the process of completing the tasks this time was extremely dangerous for them.
Those Reincarnators were truly powerful.
Not only were they individually strong, but the combined combat power they displayed was even enough to kill a Nine Stars Martial Saint.
In addition to that, they still chose to act after plotting their actions, even though they were so powerful.
They turned some Martial Masters against one another, brainwashed the leaders, destroyed the laser cannon, assassinated the Martial Masters, and even tried to cause a terrifying Beast Tide. They played a variety of schemes very smoothly.
If it wasn’t for the fact that Lin Zhan was a cautious player who had discovered their plot, it’s hard to say what would have happened in the end.
Even though Lin Zhan, the strongest martial master, discovered their plot and tried to stop it, plus Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan were very strong, and they were able to strengthen themselves through the Golden Finger, and Zhang Hu even brought an extremely precious Mana God Forbidden Curse scroll with them, it could still have been disastrous for them.
However, in the end, Chen Yao and the others still suffered quite a bit.
Chen Yao was seriously injured.
Lin Yuanyuan’s lack of combat experience almost cost her life.
Zhang Hu, on the other hand, was almost killed by their opponents using tools because his own strength was insufficient.
If Wang Shuqi hadn’t blocked the subsequent wave of damage with his strong defense, he might have actually been killed.
On top of that, the role played by the newcomer Luo Weiguo was also significant.
