If it weren’t for the life essence prepared by Luo M/eiguo, the group might have been defeated or died from their injuries after the battle.
In the end, the Martial Saints of Wang Shuqi’s world died. This caused another reduction in the already scarce high-end combat power of the High Martial World.
“Reincarnators, they really aren’t easy to deal with,” Wang Ping thought to himself.
Chen Yao (71): “Reincarnators… Although they are not as troublesome as the elusive ones, they aren’t easy to deal with either. Their various plots and schemes are terrifying, and their combat power is also very strong.”
Zhang Hu (5): “This is the first time I’ve been so close to death. It was too f* *king dangerous. Luckily Wang Shuqi was tough enough, or else I might have really died.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “The power gap was too big. I was broken through for the first time and almost got wiped out. If it weren’t for Uncle Luo Weiguo’s life essence, we might have been annihilated.”
Luo Weiguo (85): “l never thought that l, a weak person, could play such a big role… dazed.jpg.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “The value of a group member does not lie solely in the strength of their power. In fact, the Golden Finger is the most important thing. I was very weak last time, but I also played a crucial role… However, the main reason why the battle was so difficult for us this time was that we were artificially nurtured to be strong, lacking serious combat experience and not being good at scheming. Without advice from Uncle Lin Zhan, we might have perished even if we were stronger. In addition, the high-end combat power of our group is too scarce.”
Fang Yun         • “I feel the same way! That’s why I’m trying so hard to cultivate! Cultivation makes me happy!’
Liu Niei (15): “If you guys were having such a hard time, why didn’t you say something in the group? Wang Ping and I could have come over.”
Chen Yao (71): “We can’t always rely on Wang Ping and other group members. The continuous missions this time mean that we have to face strong enemies sooner or later.’
Zhang Hu (5): “Though I almost died, that’s what I think too. If we don’t participate in missions ourselves and complete tasks, always wanting to depend on others, we won’t be able to truly grow and become strong in the real sense.’
Qin Tian (77): “Cough cough, I always feel like Zhang Hu is hinting at me.”
Ye Xiaofan (75)•• “It’s just a fact. So, we should strive for self-improvement.”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s really gratifying to see that we’ve all grown.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Beep, Master Ball, catch Wang Ping.”
Wang Ping (66) @Wu Yueming (79): “Wu Yueming, how are things on your side?”
Wu Yueming (79): “l am completely safe now.”
Wang Ping (66): “That’s good. By the way, 1 want to remind everyone of something. Those of you who have been exposed shouldn’t worry about hiding your identity, but those who haven’t been exposed to the most powerful people in your world should try not to,”
Wu Jun (20): “Uh, our world is a tech world. But what does this mean?”
Zhang Jun (70): “Wang Ping, did you see some dangerous future?”
Wang Ping (66): “Hmm, the top powerhouses in our world have the ability to see through my identity as an outsider. Once your identity is discovered, 1 don’t need to tell you what the consequences are. If you’re lucky, your world doesn’t have hostility toward outsiders and it might be fine. But if your luck isn’t good, then you’ll be doomed. Who would dare bet on their luck under such circumstances..

chapters.title: Chapter 316: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A chapter of 10,000 words!)_5
Translator: 549690339
Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn, it’s so dangerous, no wonder you looked so frustrated just now, Mr. Wang.”
Fang Yun (3): “The power limit of the Profound World is high, and the danger is real… But I still want to go. Damn, I don’t want to stay in this Swordsman World and have no power to earn cultivation resources on my own.
Chen Si (83): “Don’t be angry, Senior Sister Fang Yun, I’m here too.”
Fang Yun (3): “…. *cough* , I’m not angry.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Fang Yun, you little bastard, are you after Chen Si, trying something when her brother hasn’t even revived yet? Don’t tease her.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, don’t slander me. How could I make a move on a high schooler? ‘
Chen Si (83): “No, no dating for me. My brother said I can’t date until I’m 24 years old. Shocked.jpg.”
Fang Yun (3):
Wang Ping (66): “Your brother… is pretty conservative.”
Chen Yao (71): “It’s a good thing. This way, she won’t be deceived by some people. ”
Fang Yun (3): “What the fuck…”
Wu Yueming (79): “Uh… Mr. Wang, it seems like you spoke too late… I’ve already been noticed.”
Wang Ping (66): “What’s going on?!”
Wu Yueming (79): “I just received a letter saying that I performed well in the
Beast Tide, and I’ve been specially invited to attend Jingdu Royal Beast Academy… That’s the capital of the Human race, with the most resources and the strongest Beast Tamers.”
Wang Ping (66):
Wang Ping fell silent.
Damn, is this for real?
After the Beast Tide, Wu Yueming was noticed by them.
The Beast Taming World has high power levels and various weird abilities.
If they aren’t careful, Wu Yuemings secrets might easily be exposed.
At that time, the chat group and their secrets would be exposed as well.
Even worse, Wu Yuemings background might have already been exposed.
“Alpha, are there any living ‘predecessor ransmigrators’ in the Beast Taming
World?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in his mind.
“There are. However, when the chat group was destroyed, he was still very weak. I’m not sure if he survived.’
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“So, in all the worlds we’ve traveled through, there were predecessors. Were all the selected worlds based on past records?”
Wang Pings expression darkened as he became more certain of his suspicion.
“Not all. Those worlds where ransmigrators have died aren’t part of the previous records.”
Alpha explained.
“I’ve always had a question. Alpha, can’t you take some security measures? For example, prevent the higher-ups from soul-searching group members, so as to keep our secrets.”
Wang Ping fell silent for a moment before asking again.
“Security measures have always been in place. Group members can’t be soul-searched unless they reach a certain level. Only those with strange abilities of that level can view the memories of group members.”
Alpha’s indifferent voice resounded.
“Then, what about the contents of my life simulation?”
Wang Ping twitched his face and asked rhetorically.
“Your Life Simulator is special, as it greatly dilutes the existence of the chat group. The chat group’s security measures couldn’t be applied to it. As for the Rebirth tally, it’s a condensed item so it can be used.” Alpha’s cold voice rang out, explaining the reason.
“Alright, 1 see why.”
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow, understanding the cause and effect.
“But, can’t you create something that can prevent me from being soul-searched? Or are there some rules you can’t change?”
Wang Ping let out a breath, his tone carrying a profound meaning.
“The chat group’s rules cannot be changed. However, I can create something that can resist soul-searching.”
Alpha spoke calmly.
“But that requires group points. Are you sure you can afford something that can resist Emperor tier soul-searching? Besides, it seemed like you voluntarily opened your Sea of Consciousness in your last simulation, letting others view it. In that case, your protection is useless. Even if you manage to block others from searching your memory, the outcome will be the same if you just give the information away.”
“Although 1 can intervene in the ‘real world’ to prevent you from revealing the chat group’s secrets, there’s nothing I can do in your life simulation.”
Wang Ping fell silent, with nothing left to say.
“Forget it, I’ll just stick to the most primitive method of keeping secrets.” Wang Ping sighed.
Unless it’s for a Group Task, Wang Ping decided to use his brief influence over his simulated self’s consciousness in the Life Simulator to erase all memories of the chat group, Golden Finger, and Life Simulator from his simulated self.
At the same time, he would implant a new memory in himself.
As an uninformed ransmigrator, Wang Ping would only have the defective ‘Unstable Optimizer! Golden Finger.
Although this approach is simple and crude, it’s the safest way to keep his secrets.
While there are still many loopholes in this method and it might arouse suspicion, it’s still much safer than doing nothing at all.
Zhang Jun (70): “Mr. Wangs reaction is quite serious. Is Wu Yuemings world very powerful?”
Wu Yueming (79): “There are all kinds of incredible abilities, and there are known 10th Tier battle strength existences..”

chapters.title: Chapter 317: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: 131: The Demon Emperor’s Tactics!
The Second Predecessor Transmigrators (A chapter of 10,000 words!) 6
Translator: 549690339
Qin Tian (77): “Wow, this is quite a monstrous change. I never expected a
Beast Taming World to be so strong.”
Chen Yao (71): “A world with a high growth ceiling… The higher the growth limit, the more dangerous it is… If even the identity of the traverser is exposed in front of those top powerhouses, it would be troublesome. Although there are quite a few members in the group who have been exposed, those are all special cases. Not to mention, they also encountered danger.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Hmm, although I was exposed, it was Mr. Wang who deliberately revealed it to me. Not only am I safe, but 1 also gained a lot of benefits!”
Wu Yueming (79): “l don’t know what will happen in the future, but for now, I can only take it one step at a time… I hope I don’t run into trouble. I’ll leave it to fate.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): ‘1 1 can only wish you good luck.”
Wang Ping sighed.
He felt that Wu Yueming was most likely exposed, and the outcome probably wouldn’t be very good.
Although the traverser from the spirit beast world was a weakling when the past chat group was destroyed, with so many years passed, if he didn’t die, he must have grown into a big shot now.
Once he notices Wu Yuemings existence, the consequences would be unthinkable.
Apart from that, what the big shots in the Beast Taming World think is also unknown.
Wu Yueming: “Originally, I tried hard not to panic, but with Mr. Wangs tone, I feel like I might be doomed.”
Wu Jun (20): “Ahem, it does seem that way. I’ll pay my silent respects to you for three seconds.”
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t overthink it, anxiety is bad for your health. That’s it then, I’ll log off first.”
After dropping that sentence, Wang Ping logged off.
Speaking honestly, Wang Ping regretted not simulating Wu Yuemings world before leaving.
If he had run a simulation, he could have seen what sort of situation it would
be in the future.
It seems that in the future, when going to other worlds, he still needs to help group members run a simulation, and not be stingy with the number of simulations.
“Next, let’s continue simulating. I hope this time I can refresh a powerful talent.’
After Wang Ping calmed his thoughts, he took a breath and prepared to start a new simulation.
“System, I want to start a new paid simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for not refreshing any talent.”
“Damn it.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
What is this, did his luck run out again?
He started not being able to refresh any talents again.
“Ding, Life Simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared with the text floating out.
[Day 1: You used a secret skill to modify your memory, successfully forgetting the Life Simulator and the chat group. Next, you chose to visit Bing Ningyue, expressing that you can trade with her.]
[Bing Ningyue was very pleased and didn’t expect that you would be willing to part with your treasure. Then, Bing Ningyue took out items of equivalent value to trade with you. You refused, saying that if Bing Ningyue agrees to owe you a favor, you will give her the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower.]
[Bing Ningyue was puzzled by your choice of trade. After some thought, she agreed. Then, you left.]
[When you returned, you swallowed the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower, improved your comprehension, and began cultivating.]
[In the following half year, Bing Ningyue occasionally visited to spar with you.
Both of you were talented individuals, and discussing Tao brought many benefits. Cai Yonglong also made great progress under your guidance.]
[Because of your deep friendship with Bing Ningyue, she bid you farewell before her departure, saying that she was going to the Ice Palace and hoping that you would meet again in the future. You felt regretful, knowing that it would be difficult to see each other again. However, you also remembered Bing Ningyue’s destined calamity and reminded her to be careful.]
[Eventually, Bing Ningyue left Sacred Heart Island and headed for the Sword
Domain Ice Palace. As for you, you continued to cultivate on Sacred Heart
Island.]
[In the blink of an eye, about nineteen years had passed. During these years, you had swallowed the Nirvana Fruit, upgraded your Profound Elixir to the
Flawless Profound Elixir level, and traveled to Heavenly Sea Country with Cai
Yonglong to obtain some resources for cultivation.]
[The Seven Star Secret Realm opened, and Ye Chen received the Life and Death Realm Inheritance and bid you farewell.]
[Another twenty years passed, and the Purple Moon Secret Realm opened. You successfully comprehended your pseudo-divine skill, Sunset Afterglow, just before the opening of the Secret Realm. Although this divine skill was not complete and didn’t reach the lower-tier Divine Skill level, it could still be considered a pseudo-divine skill. As long as you continued to perfect it, it would eventually become a true divine skill.]
[Next, you and Cai Yonglong entered the Secret Realm. Over the years, with your nurturing, Cai Yonglongs cultivation improved quickly, reaching the Spirit Accumulation Realm. Although his strength in the same realm wasn’t weak due to various high-level Cultivation Skills and Martial Skills, it was still unsafe in the Purple Moon Secret Realm. To that end, you prepared backup plans and concealment methods over the years, to ensure that he wouldn’t die.]
[In the end, Cai Yonglong didn’t die, and you successfully found him and started searching for opportunities together.]
[By the time Ye Chen took the Nirvana Fruit, you both found many chances.
Cai Yonglongs cultivation improved to half-step Profound Elixir Realm, ready to condense an elixir at any time. Your cultivation had reached the 5th Tier
Profound Elixir Realm.]
[You touched Ye Chen’s Nirvana Fruit again, but this time you didn’t trigger the Optimization Option. Afterwards, Ye Chen led you out of the Purple Moon Secret Realm and shared the inheritance with you before parting ways once more.]
[Later, you pondered your future, unsure whether to stay in Heavenly Sea Country or take a gamble and go to Heavenly Sword Divine City to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War, to see if you can catch someone’s eye. After all, your comprehension has improved this time, and along with the Flawless Profound Elixir, it’s possible that you won’t become a pavvn and will receive focused cultivation instead.]
[However, you ultimately gave up on the idea, not wanting to take the risk.
You stayed in Heavenly Sea Country, cultivating diligently with Cai Yonglong, planning to wander the Sword Domain for opportunities after digesting these resources.]
[Fifteen years passed, and your cultivation advanced to the 6th Tier of the
Profound Elixir Realm. Ye Chen became the 7th Son of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and Bing Ningyue perished unexpectedly just as you remembered.]
[You felt heavy-hearted. After all, Bing Ningyue wasn’t just a familiar stranger in your memory but a true friend. A friend’s death naturally saddened you. At the same time, you wondered why someone like Bing Ningyue would suddenly die..]

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 132: The Xuan Ice Emperor – Eternal Frozen Soil!
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 132: The Xuan Ice Emperor – Eternal Frozen Soil!
Translator: 549690339
[However, you can only sigh in your heart and continue to cultivate diligently. The Bing Ningyue, whom the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and Ice Palace failed to protect, is beyond your ability to save.]
[Five years pass like this. You and Cai Yonglong successfully find a 9th tier Treasure Medicine to help improve the quality of your Profound Elixir. As a result, Cai Yonglong succeeds in forming his Profound Elixir and forms a 3rd Tier Profound Pill.]
[Although a 3rd Tier Profound Pill is far inferior to the Flawless Profound Elixir you’ve formed, it’s the limit of what you both can achieve now. You can only hope that as you grow stronger, your Profound Elixir Tier will improve along the way.]
[You continue to wander the Divine Land of the Heavenly Sea Kingdom and its neighboring countries in search of opportunities.]
[Twenty years later, with the help of Cai Yonglongs Golden Finger, you’ve obtained several useful fortuitous encounters and your cultivation level reaches Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection. Cai Yonglongs cultivation level reaches the 8th Tier of Profound Elixir Realm.]
[As you snatch fortuitous encounters in the Heavenly Sea Kingdom and neighboring countries, you’re extremely cautious and try to act cleanly. Nonetheless, your notoriety inevitably grows. However, this also attracts the attention of some powerful masters. Some Yin-Yang realm masters notice that your cultivation skills aren’t simple; they resemble the Wind and Thunder skill left behind by the Nirvana Realm expert Wind and Thunder Taoist.]
[Back then, when the Nirvana Realm Inheritance emerged, it caused a great sensation, resulting in the fall of several masters of the Life and Death and
Yin-Yang Realms. In the end, someone took the Nirvana Realm inheritance.]
[As a result, many masters began to search for you and Cai Yonglong. Knowing that you’ve been exposed, you both flee to the Sea region, intending to return to Profound Turtle Continent and escape pursuit.]
[You’re very cautious, but ultimately you make a mistake as a cunning Yin-Yang realm master catches you during your escape. You and Cai Yonglong join forces to fight the enemy, but the gap in cultivation levels is still too vast, and you’re no match for them.]
[At the critical moment, Cai Yonglong chooses to self-destruct, buying you the opportunity to use a self-created Divine Skill. This deals a heavy blow to the
Yin-Yang realm master, and they flee in fear of your power.]
[You sigh in your heart, never expecting Cai Yonglong to die like this. The world of cultivators is truly cruel. However, you don’t have much time to grieve as you continue to escape.]
[You know that if you continue to flee like this, you’ll definitely be targeted by those cunning masters, and you won’t have a chance to escape to the Profound
Turtle Continent.]
[In the end, you choose to use an Incomplete Array Plate that you and Cai Yonglong found together for teleportation. You have no idea where it will send you, so you leave your fate to the heavens.]
“Well, we’ve reached the part where I get hunted again…”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content and is speechless.
In the recent simulations, he has been dealing with various big shots, almost making him forget his previous experiences of being hunted down.
Now it seemed, he was being hunted once more.
Moreover, just like before, it was because their cultivation skills were exposed.
He had to admit, the more powerful items he had, the more he attracted the attention of powerful experts.
Those masters could ignore a loose cultivator’s Profound Elixir Realm skills of Heaven-tier inferior, but if it was Heavenly tier skill, they would definitely attack.
After all, even most of the Great Sects didn’t possess that level of cultivation skills.
For example, the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s Great Teachings and the Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family probably cultivate at most Heavenly Mid- grade skills, and at most upper-tier nonsuch skills.
Heaven-tier nonsuch skills are only for those few powerful Life and Death
Realm Masters or Nirvana Realm members with great fortuitous encounters.
Of course, those powerful Grand Sects also have them, but the ones that aren’t included are lesser forces like the Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family and the Heavenly Sea Kingdom’s Great Teachings.
Wang Ping sighs in his heart, contemplating the situation.
He then gazes at the luminescent screen again, curious about whether he can escape this time or if the Incomplete Array Plate will be the cause of his demise.
[Due to the instability of the Incomplete Array Plate, you die once during the teleportation process, but you manage to cling to life with the help of the Rebirth tally, successfully teleporting to a strange domain, gravely injured and collapsed on the ground. If it weren’t for the powerful recovery ability granted by the Nirvana Skill, you would have died for good, even two lives wouldn’t be enough.]
[You struggle to open your eyes and notice the biting cold of this world covered in ice and snow. Severely injured, you suffer immensely. Knowing that if you continue like this, death is inevitable, you struggle to use your last strength to call out, hoping to be saved.]
[However, this place seems to be an extremely cold and desolate area. Your cries for help receive no response, and your vision gradually blurs.]
[Just before you lose consciousness, you see a girl with blue braids, a bamboo tower in her hand, riding a white fox, rushing towards you at high speed.]
[When you wake up again, you find yourself lying in a tent and on a bed, being fed medicine by the girl with the braids. The white fox is beside you with its tail covering your stomach, seemingly keeping you warm.]
[You stare at the girl, expressing astonishment, and instinctively say, “Bing Ningyue, it’s great that you’re still alive.” The girl shows a puzzled expression..]

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land 2
Translator: 549690339
[The girl gently says that she is not Bing Ningyue that you referred to. She is just a wanderer in this Eternal Frozen Land, and her name is Xue’er.]
[You fall into silence, not knowing what to say. The girl’s appearance is
exactly the same as the Bing Ningyue in your memory, with no differences. If you had to point out a difference, it would be that Bing Ningyue is cold, while the girl in front of you is gentle and lovely.]
[In the end, you can only sigh. There will always be similar things in this world. You just overthought it. Bing Ningyue is already dead, and the person in front of you is just a flower similar to her.]
[After that, you calm down and express gratitude to Xue!er for saving your life. You will repay her later. Xue’er smiles gently, saying that saving a life is better than building a seven-tier pagoda. She has accumulated merit, and you don’t have to worry too much about it.]
[You are touched by the girl’s smile and words, feeling a multitude of emotions. You never thought that there would be such a girl in the world. Then, you don’t argue about this topic anymore, as it’s meaningless. When it’s about repaying a favor, saying it once is enough. What matters is action, not just talking.]
[Next, you find that your body is in a mess, with severe injuries and seemingly invaded by a terrifying cold. If you want to fully recover, it may take a long time.]
[Feeling a bit helpless about this, you don’t have any other choice but to heal.
You ask the girl curiously about this area where you are.]
[The girl tells you that this is the outer area of the Eternal Frozen Land. When you hear this answer, you are shocked, not expecting to have been transported such a great distance.]
[The Eternal Frozen Land is not in the Sword Domain or even in the Eastern Desolation, but in Central Continent.]
[In the Purple Spirit Realm, there are five continents: Eastern Desolation,
Western Desert, Southern Ridge, Northern Wastes, and Central Continent. Central Continent is located in the center of the Purple Spirit Realm, where outstanding people and places are. It has the most Holy Lands and gives birth to the most Heaven’s Chosen Monsters.]
[However, this is only considering the World of cultivators.
Environment-wise, before ten thousand years ago, Central Continent was not cold, and there was no such cold area. Even though cultivators of the ice attribute could create some ice and snow atmosphere within a certain range, there were only a few of them.]
[Not to mention, those who could reach such a cultivation level would have the ability to travel across the Five Continents. Therefore, before ten thousand years ago, most ice-attribute cultivators also chose to go to the Northern Wastes, which was the main base for cultivating the ice path. The weather in the Northern Wastes is cold, and there are many ice treasures, making it the best place for ice-attribute cultivators.]
[However, this changed after the major battle ten thousand years ago. The war, which involved the entire Purple Spirit Realm and various powerful beings. Powerful Emperor Realm experts fought life-and-death battles, which were too terrifying. In order to prevent the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm, many Emperors dragged the Blood Demon Clan into outer battlefields or trapped them in small worlds.]
[But there are always exceptions. The number of Emperors in the Blood
Demon Clan was greater than in the Purple Spirit Realm. No matter how the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm blocked them, some still slipped through.]
[The existence of Emperor tier could not be stopped by those who are below it.
Even King Realm Masters were like ants in front of them and could be easily killed.]
[In the end, a cultivator named Ji Bingyan stood up. She was the sister of the
Ice Emperor and a Quasi-Emperor. However, Ji Bingyan, with only Quasi-Emperor cultivation, relied on her self-created Taboo Secret skill to permanently freeze herself and several Blood Demon Clan Emperor tier existences.]
[The place where she used the Taboo Secret skill was completely frozen and turned into the Eternal Frozen Land, permanently changing the climate.]
[For this reason, people added the title of ‘Profound Ice Emperor’ to Ji Bingyan after the war. She was the first person in the history of the Purple Spirit Realm to kill several Emperors with Quasi-Emperor cultivation and the only person who was called Emperor while being a Quasi-Emperor. The title of Emperor is something that even ordinary Emperors could not obtain! ]
[In the years that followed, the Eternal Frozen Land became a wonder of the Purple Spirit Realm and a forbidden-like area. No one could approach the central area of the Eternal Frozen Soil. Even Quasi-Emperors might face life-threatening dangers. However, the outer area of the Eternal Frozen Land is quite dangerous but not entirely desolate. It has instead become the land of ice and snow, the best cultivation place for ice-attribute cultivators.]
[Here, it is easier to comprehend the Ice Spirit. If you venture deeper, you can more easily comprehend ice-related Divine Skills. If you venture to the deepest part, you may be able to comprehend the path of ‘Profound Ice
Emperor’ Ji Bingyan. However, basically, no one dares to go deep into it.]
[Those who have the qualification to go in have already found their own paths and don’t need to observe others’. And those who don’t have the power to enter would only be courting death if they tried.]
“Damn, this Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan is so powerful, isn’t she?” Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, completely shocked.
The further in the cultivation journey, the bigger the gap between levels.
Although Quasi-Emperors seem only one step away from becoming
Emperors, the gap between them is beyond imagination..

chapters.title: Chapter 320: 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land_3
Translator: 549690339
After all, someone at the Profound Elixir Realm could easily crush one at the half-step Profound Elixir Realm, let alone those at the Quasi-Emperor and Emperor levels.
However, this Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan managed to bring a few Emperors from the Blood Demon Clan down with her with just her Quasi-Emperor cultivation, which was simply unbelievable.
No wonder she had such a title, making her appear extremely remarkable.
If this Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan hadn’t met her end halfway, perhaps she would have grown to the level of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor in the future…
“The Ice Palace was truly terrifying in its heyday. One Ice Emperor, who was highly regarded by the Bloodthirsty Demon Lord despite her death. Another Profound Ice Empress, who needs no further explanation…”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
“It’s a pity that after reaching its peak, the Ice Palace has declined. Now it does not even have an Emperor and has fallen to the level of a Holy Land, relying on the Heavenly Sword Divine Land for survival.”
Wang Ping sighed again in his heart.
He always felt that the current Ice Palace, let alone an Emperor, might not even have a Quasi-Emperor…
[As you recall all the information about the Eternal Frozen Land, you find it hard to keep your composure. You never imagined that you would be sent to such a place. However, you’re lucky to be in the outer region of the Eternal Frozen Land. If you had gone any deeper, you would have been dead for sure.]
[Even in the outer region, you were severely injured and almost froze to death. If it hadn’t been for the young girl Xue’er who saved you, you would have died.]
[Seeing your shocked expression, Xue’er didn’t ask much and fed you medication without even questioning your identity or background. You weren’t used to receiving such careful and gentle care from a young girl, so you told her that you could drink it yourself.]
[Xue’er insisted that you were a wounded person and should just lie there. Feeling helpless, and unable to move your body, you could only awkwardly accept being fed the medicine.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year had passed. During this year, your injuries had healed somewhat, but were still far from complete recovery. You were disheartened, having been injured too severely. Furthermore, your Storage Ring had shattered due to the Spatial Turbulence during the transfer, making it impossible for you to consume any Elixirs. You could only recuperate by resting.]
[Though Xue’er’s herbal medicine had some effect, they were ultimately low-grade and their healing properties were not very significant. However, you had no other choice. Finding herbs in this icy world was difficult to begin with, so having some to drink was already quite good, and you were not going to be picky.]
[In addition, throughout this year, you also learned more about the surrounding powers in the Eternal Frozen Land. There were two major powers in the area where you were located.]
[One power was the Profound Ice Sect, founded by someone who claimed to be a disciple of Profound Ice Empress, their goal was to protect their Master Ji Bingyan.]
[As for the other power, it was the Ice Poison Sect. Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan had gone through the Purple Spirit Realm during her lifetime, winning over many fervent followers. The Ice Poison Sect was founded by her followers. The two powers were neighbors with good relations and formed an alliance.]
[However, what puzzled Wang Ping was that since the founder of Ice Poison Sect was Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan’s follower, why didn’t they join forces to build the Profound Ice Sect? Instead, they established another sect. Perhaps there was a hidden reason.]
[But you weren’t interested in uncovering the secrets. Now, you just wanted to heal your injuries, continue cultivating, grow stronger, attempt to break through to the half-step Yin Yang Mirror, and then the Yin Yang Mirror.]
[Another year had passed, and your injuries had healed significantly once again, allowing you to wield the power of the Profound Elixir Realm. During this period, you curiously asked Xue’er why she didn’t try to join the two major sects to cultivate. Xue’er replied that she had poor talent and, despite being 80 years old, had only reached the Spirit Sea Realm and did not qualify to join two major sects.]
[At Xue’er’s response, you were shocked. It turned out that Xue’er’s age was exactly the same as the late Bing Ningyue, or Ji Bingyue. You even started to suspect if the two were related by blood.]
[However, you were unable to verify this at the moment and had to suppress your doubts.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years had passed. Your injuries were fully healed, and you regained your Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection strength. With your help, Xue’er obtained a Heaven-tier inferior ice cultivation skill and 6th Tier Spiritual Materials, allowing you to successfully help her condense the Ice Spirit Body.]
[However, condensing the Ice Spirit Body was secondary. During these five years, you tried to activate any potential Ice Emperor bloodline within Xue’er but failed every time. You didn’t know if it was because the 8-tier Elixirs you had brought to her were too low-grade and couldn’t activate her bloodline, or if your guess was simply wrong.]
[At the same time, during these five years, you, Xue’er, and the white fox-Xiaobai she had adopted had been venturing in the outer area of the Eternal Frozen Land, hunting and living. Although life was monotonous, you found long-lost warmth in Xue’er and felt a sense of home.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years had passed. You felt that the time was right and considered breaking through to the half-step Yin Yang Realm. Unfortunately, you ultimately couldn’t find a way to do so. It wasn’t your lack of aptitude, nor your lack of foundation, but simply the absence of conditions for a breakthrough.]
[That was because the Yin Yang Mirror was also a unique realm that focused on the forces of Yin and Yang. To break through to the half-step Yin Yang Mirror, one would need to inscribe either the Yin Power or the Yang Power on their Profound Elixir. To break through to the Yin Yang Mirror, one would need to supplement either the Yang Power or the Yin Power based on their half-step Yin Yang Mirror cultivation, forming a complete Yin Yang Diagram on their Profound Elixir.]

chapters.title: Chapter 321: 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: 132: Profound Ice Emperor! Eternal Frozen Land_4
Translator: 549690339
[Just like the Profound Elixir Tier, the quality of Yin and Yang powers is equally important. Moreover, even more demanding than forming Profound Elixirs, the Yin and Yang quality must also be the same. Otherwise, if their intensities are different, the Yin and Yang balance will not be achieved, making it impossible to form a complete Yin Yang Diagram and thus leading to a failed breakthrough. A mild consequence would be the destruction of the Profound Pill, while in severe cases, the cultivator could suffer death.]
[Although it is not crucial for Yin and Yang powers to have the exact same strength, Yin and Yang powers of the same quality have different intensities. Powers of the same tier can still be combined, complementing each other and forming a balanced Yin and Yang. If their tiers are different and the gap is too large, they cannot complement each other, and one would devour the other.]
[It is said that the Profound Elixir Realm is very special, having a great impact on the cultivation limit. This is because low-quality Profound Elixirs are not only weak in power but also fragile. They are fundamentally incapable of inscribing high-quality Yin and Yang powers, and they can easily exceed their limits, leading to destruction and death.]
[As a result, cultivators who have condensed Lower 3-tier Mysterious Elixir Realm find it difficult to break through to the Yin Yang Mirror. Those who have condensed Middle Three tier Profound Elixirs have a limited quality of Yin and Yang powers they can inscribe. Some do not dare to inscribe high-quality Yin and Yang powers, as it would risk the possible loss of their cultivation or even their lives.]
[Thus, the gap between geniuses and ordinary cultivators widens further when attempting to break through to the Yin Yang Realm.]
[You know the secret of the Yin Yang Mirror and want to break through to the realm without engraving an ordinary Yin Yang Diagram. Ordinary Yin and Yang powers are easily found, but breaking through so easily would only waste the potential of the Flawless Profound Elixir and limit your future.]
[However, the problem returns. Your injury has just healed, and you’re only a loose cultivator with no Spiritual Stones or resources. You’re unsure of how to safely search for high-quality Yin and Yang powers and find yourself in a dilemma.]
“So that’s the secret of the Yin Yang Mirror. It’s closely related to the quality of the condensed Profound Elixir. No wonder the World of cultivators values the Profound Elixir Tier so much — not only does it provide more strength, but it also significantly influences the future.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and pondered thoughtfully.
The Yin Yang Realm and the dual powers of Yin and Yang pose another challenge.
“Besides, is that Xue’er actually related to the Ice Queen or Bing Ningyue?”
Wang Ping recalled Xue’er’s matter, filled with questions.
If she were a descendant of the Ice Empress, her innate talents would be quite ordinary.
“No, it’s not right. Without resources, cultivation skills, or guidance, and with her unactivated bloodline, her current cultivation is already considered good. Her talents are not poor at all.”
Wang Ping shook his head again.
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
[Seeing your concerns, Xue’er asked you the reason. After some hesitation, you chose to answer. Over the years, you and Xue’er had grown close. Her gentleness touched you, so it was only natural for you to become Tao Companions. She even carried your child in her womb.]
[Upon hearing your explanation, Xue’er hesitated but eventually decided not to conceal or deceive you. She told you that the Eternal Frozen Land contained the highest quality of Yin Power. Yin stands for sinking, while Yang stands for rising.]
[Thus, high-quality Yin Power often appears in extremely cold regions, while high-quality Yang Power often appears in hot areas.]
[As one of the coldest regions in the Purple Spirit Realm, the Eternal Frozen Land is also influenced by the ice attachment of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. In this area, high-quality Yin Power easily appears. The deeper one goes, the stronger the Yin Power.]

chapters.title: Chapter 322: 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!
Translator: 549690339
[Even Xue’er mentioned that she had heard of a Quasi-Emperor who ventured into the deepest parts to retrieve pure Yin power, which was considered the highest quality Yin power in the Purple Spirit Realm, in order to cultivate their offspring.]
[Hearing Xue’er’s explanation, you were surprised but not shocked because you had already thought about it.]
[However, knowing how dangerous it is to venture deep into the Eternal Frozen Land, you realize that not just a Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection cultivator like you, but even a Life and Death Realm Master could perish there. And you wouldn’t be able to find the high-quality Yin power you need on the outskirts.]
[It should be said that even if you ventured slightly deeper into the outskirts, it would not be a place you could go to. Entering the Profound Elixir Realm would easily result in danger, death, or worse. Even though you are not an ordinary Profound Elixir Realm cultivator, you don’t think you could survive unscathed in such a special place.]
[In the end, you sighed and decided to give up venturing deeper into the Eternal Frozen Land. You are now Xue’er’s Tao Companion and the father of your unborn child; you have to be responsible for both of them.]
[Seeing that you gave up going deeper into the Eternal Frozen Land, Xue’er was relieved, touched, and filled with affection. In response, you both shared a drink.]
[Not long after, following careful consideration, you decided to join the Profound Ice Sect. Over the years, you had been seeking information. The Profound Ice Sect is a prestigious and upright sect that does not suppress or hunt the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants.’ Besides, the Ice Palace has never been at odds with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. You think the Profound Ice Sect would accept someone like you with the ‘Profound Turtle Spirit.’]
[As long as you join the Profound Ice Sect, which is second only to the Holy Land, you will surely find the high-quality Yin and Yang powers you seek. At that time, you can easily break through to the Yin Yang Realm.]
[Regarding the issue of whether your identity as a transverser will be discovered, you have thought about it. In the end, you remembered Bai Ya, the King Realm Master. Bai Ya is a King Realm Master who has not discovered your identity as a transverser, which shows that he is not as competent as the Heavenly Sword Saint Master and Bloodthirsty Demon Lord.]
[You suspect that the Heavenly Sword Saint Master and Bloodthirsty Demon Lord are at the Quasi-Emperor level. This means that only those who reach the Quasi-Emperor or higher realms can discover your transverser identity. The Profound Ice Sect’s Ancestor, who is also a King Realm Master, might not be able to discover your identity.]
[As a result, as long as the other party does not mind the Profound Turtle Spirit on you, you can live in peace and grow up with the help of the Profound Ice Sect.]
[You told your Tao Companion, Xue’er, about your plan, and she thought your choice was right. Although she was happy to be a carefree loose cultivator, she would unconditionally support you if you wanted to become a powerful cultivator.]
[Xue’er’s support made you very happy. However, you didn’t immediately go to the Profound Ice Sect because you thought of the potential negative possibilities. If the Profound Ice Sect truly turned against you, you would have nowhere to be buried. Without a doubt, it would be a gamble.]
[For this reason, you decided to stay with Xue’er, allowing her to give birth to your child peacefully. After that, you would go to the Profound Ice Sect alone.]
[Half a year later, Xue’er successfully gave birth to a child, which made you overjoyed. You named her Wang Yuxin.]
[You initially planned to go to the Profound Ice Sect after the child was born but eventually thought that the child was too young, and you didn’t feel at ease. You decided to stay with the child, teach her cultivation, and wait for her to grow up.]
[Time flies, and a decade has passed. In these ten years, your life has been fulfilling – you dual cultivated with your wife, taught your child Wang Yuxin cultivation during the day, and pondered Divine Skills. You even comprehended the Ice Spirit to the Major Completion Tier and initially created an Ice Attribute Divine Skill.]
[Through your cultivation, you have accidentally discovered that your strongest talent lies in ice attribute cultivation, with a gift far superior to other attributes. This is your most exceptional talent.]
[At this point, you sighed, thinking that you might have taken the wrong path before. Everyone has an attribute that suits them best; your only attribute yet to be cultivated was ice. If you had started cultivating ice attribute skills from the beginning, perhaps you could have taken a different path.]
[Next, you plan to find a 7-tier or 8-tier ice attribute spiritual item and try to blend the ice attribute into your constitution. For this, you are quite regretful that the Wind and Thunder skill did not optimize into the Primordial Spirit Skill, as it would not be so troublesome.]
[In the Eternal Frozen Land, ice attribute spiritual items are not uncommon. You spent three days searching and found an 8-tier spiritual item in the vast ice and snow, hoping to integrate the ice attribute spiritual body into your Seven Attribute Spirit Body. Unfortunately, without the aid of the Nirvana Fruit, your attempt failed.]
[However, you were fortunate enough to accidentally activate an unstable Optimizer, which allows you to selectively optimize your spiritual body. You believe that as long as a spiritual body can be reshaped, there is no need to hesitate. So, with a determined heart, you chose to optimize.]
[Your luck was excellent; you successfully optimized your spiritual body into an Eight Attribute Spirit Body. After finding some cultivation resources for your wife and daughter, you returned home.]
[Upon your return, you found your home empty, and both your wife Xue’er and daughter Wang Yuxin had disappeared. You were furious and anxious, so you used a Secret Skill to search for them.]

chapters.title: Chapter 323: 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!_2
Translator: 549690339
[In the end, you gained nothing, as if the two of them vanished into thin air. You roared with anger, swearing to dismember and burn the souls of those responsible for centuries.]
[After venting your anger, you cooled down and realized that it’s useless to be anxious and furious now. It’s better to earn more Spiritual Stones and buy information from intelligence dealers or join a major power to find your family with their resources.]
[You decided to head to Profound Ice Sect, aiming to become a disciple to grow stronger with their support and use their information network to find your wife and daughter.]
[When you arrived at the Profound Ice Sect and expressed your thoughts, the Sect Master took notice of you. The Sect Master is a Nirvana Realm Master, and he recognized the Profound Turtle Spirit on you but didn’t detect the ‘Sinful Bloodline’ aura on you, so he seems to accept you.]
[The Profound Ice Sect Master admires your potential, and as long as you swear by your Martial Enlightenment Heart not to betray the sect, or else you’ll suffer from mental demons and die, you can become a disciple with the chance to succeed the sect.]
[Without hesitation, you chose to take the poisonous oath to gain the Sect Master’s trust, wanting to become stronger by leveraging the sect’s power and find your family.]
[However, as soon as you took the poisonous oath, the Sect Master changed his attitude, telling you that your identity is sensitive and not suitable to stay on the surface. If hostile forces against ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ discover your existence, both you and the sect may encounter great danger. Thus, he hopes you would join the sect’s special unit and become the hidden blade of the Profound Ice Sect.]
[You stayed silent. Although you knew these old monsters were cunning and suspected that the other party might change their attitude, you didn’t expect them to turn so quickly.]
[Now that you’ve made your vow and need the Sect’s help to reach the Yin-Yang Mirror realm, you chose to endure and agreed to the Sect Master.]
[In the end, you became a member of the Dark Ice Hall, specializing in handling messy affairs for the sect and collecting intelligence as a spy. You know that this kind of place exists in every major power; light brings shadows, and it’s inevitable. However, you didn’t expect yourself to become a member.]
[Regardless, you didn’t dwell on it and wanted to earn more Sect Contribution Points to exchange for higher-quality Yin and Yang power, hoping to break through to the Yin-Yang Mirror realm. You believe that as long as your position is high enough, you can eventually use the resources of the Dark Ice Hall to find your family.]
[In your tenth year within the Dark Ice Hall, you were assigned a dangerous mission. Once completed, you would earn Contribution Points to exchange for 2nd-Tier Yin power.]
[Although it’s only 2nd-Tier Yin power, it’s the best Yin power within the sect’s collection. After all, Upper-3-tier Yin Power is extremely precious, and only the Holy Land can collect 1st-tier power. While the Profound Ice Sect may occasionally obtain it, it’s a once-in-a-thousand-year event. Right now, there’s none available, and you can’t wait any longer.]
[Thus, breaking through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror using 2nd-Tier Yin power is the best choice. Not to mention, even the 2nd-tier power requires risking your life to earn Contribution Points for exchange, so it’s not something you can easily dismiss.]
[Unfortunately, the world always goes against one’s wishes. Although you successfully completed the mission and assassinated an opposing Yin-Yang Mirror cultivator, you didn’t expect another Yin and Yang Master to visit their old friend on the same day.]
[You were already heavily wounded after the assassination, and now you face an even more powerful Nirvana Realm Master, unable to fight or escape and ultimately met your end.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
“This simulation is really unusual. It went directly from Eastern Desolate Sword Domain to the Eternal Frozen Soil in Central Continent. Moreover, without the influence of talents like ‘Flower-picking Thief’, I surprisingly have a Tao Companion and a child now. It’s quite shocking.”
Wang Ping looked puzzled and muttered.
“But I have to admit, Xue’er’s charm is really great. Sigh, I have no resistance against gentle and lovely girls like her.”
Unfortunately, the ‘fatal rule of marrying’ still applied, and he died in the end.
Of course, Wang Ping was playing around and didn’t think that getting married was the main cause of his death.
In the end, he died miserably in every simulation, whether or not he got married, and he had become used to it.
“Speaking of which, where did Xue’er and Wang Yuxin go after they disappeared? Who took them away?”
Wang Ping thought about Xue’er and Wang Yuxin’s situation, frowning.
He couldn’t help but feel like he had the Heavenly Lone Star destiny like Ye Chen, causing any place he goes to be plagued with problems.
Of course, this was just a complaint.
It was just that everyone he encountered was too extraordinary.
Whether it was Ye Chen, Bai Tianhong, Bing Ningyue, or even Xue’er, none of them were ordinary people.
“Could it be that they were taken away by someone like Bai Tianhong? However, Xue’er never appeared in the previous simulations. If she were truly the descendant of Ice Empress like Bing Ningyue, she shouldn’t be so silent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 133: The Red Talent Reappears! One Red is Even Stronger Than the Last!_3
Translator: 549690339
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, but ultimately, he couldn’t come up with an answer.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s vision also changed.
It was clear that the Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death had been triggered.
However, there was nothing interesting in this Death Replay, so it quickly passed, and Wang Ping’s vision returned to normal.
Then, the system’s voice sounded out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm.
Great Profound Ice State.
Combat Experience.”
“System, I choose ② and ③.”
After looking at the rewards, Wang Ping made his choice.
Having experienced so many simulations, it was time for him to choose Combat Experience and improve himself.
Otherwise, he would just have cultivation and secret skills but not be able to use them in battle effectively.
As for the Great Profound Ice State, it was also not to be missed.
Of course, if there were other options, Wang Ping would not have chosen it.
It goes without saying that if he chose cultivation, his strength would increase, and the cost of the simulation would grow, making him worry again.
As Wang Ping made his choice, more insights appeared in his mind.
There was Combat Experience.
Behind it, there was also an understanding of the Ice Spirit, from which he gained a lot.
“Continue the simulation. I don’t believe I can’t refresh a good talent.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
However, the following simulations silenced Wang Ping.
He paid for four consecutive simulations, spending a total of 200,000 top-tier spirit stones, almost emptying his savings. As a result, he didn’t refresh any useful talents; the highest was a mere green talent, which was incredibly outrageous.
Moreover, these White Talents were all freaking death-related talents.
There was “Death Expert,” which made him more prone to death. Every time he reached a near-death state, his cultivation would increase.
Then, there was “Battle Maniac,” who loved fighting and especially level-skipping battles.
And “Disaster Possession,” which made him extremely unlucky.
These crappy talents were even worse than not having any.
It was precisely these crappy talents that wasted Wang Ping’s consecutive simulations. Not even one of them lasted long; they all ended within five years.
Fortunately, he could still refresh other reward options.
There were things like cultivation, combat experience, cultivation skills, and secret skills. Otherwise, Wang Ping would have bled from frustration.
“Forget it, my luck has been unbelievably terrible lately. It seems my recent good fortune has run out. It’s better to wait a while before simulating again.”
Wang Ping gave up the idea of continuing the simulation with a weary heart.
In the blink of an eye, four months had passed.
In these four months, Wang Ping had earned some top-tier spirit stones by refining pills.
However, three months ago, he couldn’t resist simulating again and ended up with a bizarre talent, then died miserably and was forced to pick the Alchemist Experience reward.
This scared him into clenching his teeth and enduring for three months, hoping to accumulate more luck before trying again.
During these four months, a lot had happened in the chat group.
The frequency of group missions had indeed increased, with group members participating in tasks one after another.
As a result, the group members’ strength improved steadily.
Among them, Fang Yun’s progress was the most impressive, second only to Lin Yuanyuan’s initial surge.
It had to be said that Fang Yun was ruthless enough, and his Golden Finger was powerful.
Relying on his Golden Finger, devilish cultivation, resources provided by Wang Ping, and group points earned from completing missions, he had managed to reach the peak of the Spirit Sea Realm in just four months, much to Cai Yonglong’s envy.
Given his current rate of improvement, all he needed were more group points from the next mission, and he could buy 6th Tier Spiritual Materials from Wang Ping, break through to the Spiritual Fetus Realm with ease, and continue advancing rapidly.
Of course, Wang Ping hadn’t been idle during these four months, and he had participated in group missions as well.
Plus, he could also receive special rewards whenever other group members completed missions.
His group points had reached 2 million, enough to strengthen his Profound Elixir Tier to a flawless level.
However, Wang Ping was reluctant to spend 2 million group points on strengthening.
After all, he needed to collect ten million group points to optimize the Life Simulator, which would be more cost-effective.
So, even though he had enough group points, he didn’t use them, nor did he eat the Nirvana Fruit, and just toughed it out.
In fact, Wang Ping had a speculation.
If he broke through to the Yin Yang Realm and received the cultivation of the Yin Yang Realm, would he be able to get the rewards of a Flawless Profound Elixir for free?
After all, in the simulation, his version had condensed the Yin Yang Diagram to break through to the Yin Yang Realm using Flawless Profound Elixir.
Wang Ping thought he could try it out and exploit a bug.
If it worked, he would be comfortable, saving 2 million group points, and also a Nirvana Fruit.
Perhaps the saved Nirvana Fruit would have an even greater use later on.
“Four months have passed; my luck should turn for the better. It’s time for a simulation.”
Wang Ping composed himself and thought in his heart.
“System, I want to start a new paid simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he made his decision aloud.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing. By the way, the host has 100,000 top-tier spirit stones remaining, please be aware of that.”
The system’s voice sounded, causing Wang Ping’s face to twitch slightly.
You damn thing, can’t you not mention that?
After so many bad luck streaks, he was back to being poor, but even if he was poor, you, the system, shouldn’t bring it up.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful! Congratulations on refreshing Red Talent: True Dragon Form and Green Talent: Boxing Genius.”
Red Talent: True Dragon Form – With this talent, the host’s Bone and Root Aptitude and comprehension would rival Saint-tier Characters of the Holy Land.
“!!!”
Wang Ping was astonished as he looked at the talents refreshed by the Life Simulator.
Well, had he finally accumulated enough luck?
Or was it that he had triggered a lifeline, resulting in another Red Talent appearing?
And it was the familiar Red Talent: True Dragon Form.
However, this Red Talent: True Dragon Form, although identical in name to the previous one, was clearly stronger than the first iteration.
The first Red Talent: True Dragon Form only allowed him to compete with True Disciples of the Holy Land, while this one allowed him to compete with Saint-tier Characters.
Moreover, it wasn’t just in the Bone and Root Aptitude that he could compete with the Holy Child tier, but in comprehension as well.
This Red Talent: True Dragon Form was far more powerful than the first one!
Thinking about this, Wang Ping was excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence!
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence!
Translator: 549690339
“System, I choose Red Talent: True Dragon Form.”
After getting excited, Wang Ping said in his heart.
This time, with such powerful roots and comprehension, he might be able to truly rise to prominence.
At that time, when he joins the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, he may not be treated as a disposable pawn anymore.
After all, a loose cultivator who has congealed an Immaculate Profound Elixir and has the talent of a Saint Child in terms of his roots and comprehension is rare indeed.
Such a character would be highly sought after in any Holy Land and receive special cultivation.
However, considering the attitude of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master towards outsiders, Wang Ping was a little hesitant.
The other party doesn’t trust him as an outsider, which is somewhat troublesome.
“Sure enough, a soul secret skill that can hide my identity as a transmigrator is still needed. Or perhaps, I should refresh my talents again. I just don’t know if a red talent can block the scrutiny of someone like the Heavenly Sword Saint Master.”
Wang Ping pondered quietly in his heart.
For now, being a loose cultivator is the most likely option.
Wang Ping, in simulation, would probably play it safe and not risk his life.
“I just don’t know if I can still obtain that incomplete Array Plate this time, so that there is a way to teleport to the Eternal Frozen Land. There, pure Yin power can be found, which is essential for a perfect breakthrough to the Half-Step Yin-Yang Realm.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered.
Of course, there is another possibility.
That is, he acquires 1st-tier Yin power and then activates the unstable Optimizer, successfully optimizing the 1st-tier Yin power into Pure Yin power.
That would be the best way to break through.
If not, how could he, a small loose cultivator with Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm, enter the central area dreaded by even Quasi-Emperors and search for pure Yin power?
Isn’t that like seeking death?
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text surfaced.
However, just as a word or two appeared, the notification sound from the chat group system rang out, causing Wang Ping to pause, stop staring at the luminescent screen, and the text ceased to appear.
“Ding, Group Member Chen Si (83) spends 250,000 Group points to successfully resurrect Group Member (67).”
“Huh, Chen Si has finally saved up enough Group Points to resurrect her brother?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he smiled lightly.
Chen Si, a timid and shy high school girl, is also quite strong-willed. In order to resurrect her brother, she has actively participated in various Group Tasks and accumulated Group Points in these four months.
Wang Ping also helped her once, allowing her to earn 50,000 Group Points.
Unfortunately, Group Tasks are based on contribution value, and not every task offers high rewards.
“Chen Kang, a transmigrator who joined the chat group around the same time as me, refreshed the record for fastest death in Transmigrator Chat Group. I wonder how he feels after being resurrected and what kind of golden finger he can draw.”
These thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he opened the Transmigrator Chat Group’s chat page, curious to see the content.
Sure enough, the chat group was bustling with activity.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Another person has been resurrected in the group, and it’s Chen Si’s brother. Congratulations!”
Fang Yun (3): “Hey, a Spirit Sea Realm big shot has arrived. By the way, congratulations to Chen Si for resurrecting her brother!”
Zhang Jun (70): “This guy is getting more and more pretentious. Just being at the Spirit Sea Realm, in the current chat group is just an average level. He’s not afraid of being beaten.”
Chen Yao (71): “Yeah, it’s better to be low-key. By the way, I’m curious if Chen Sisi’s brother will be resurrected on the spot. It would be very dangerous… after all, that’s Zombie World.”
Chen Si (83): “I don’t know where he will be resurrected. But Zhang-ge contacted me and said to tell him when I am going to resurrect my brother. He will be there to guard. With Zhang-ge around, there won’t be any problem!”
Qin Tian (77): “Uh, Zhang Jun, you really do think a lot of problems. This time, you did the right thing. Given the current situation in Zombie World, I’m afraid mutated zombies are everywhere. Without Zhang Jun protecting him, Chen Kang, even after resurrection, definitely wouldn’t survive a day.”
Zhang Jun (70): “You may have some misunderstandings about my world.”
Qin Tian (77): “What misunderstandings? Am I wrong?”
Zhang Jun (70): “It’s not that he won’t survive a day, but if he can survive ten minutes, I’ll be impressed. All I can say is that our world’s zombie virus is very perverse. At this point in time… zombies are everywhere. 2nd and 3rd-tier zombies are common, 5th and 6th-tier ones aren’t rare either. Even more surprising, these zombies are gradually gaining intelligence and seem to be forming a zombie nation.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Your world is kind of outrageous… With so many powerful zombies, can Earth handle it?”
Wu Yueming (79): “Earth can definitely handle it. At most, it will lead to the extinction of the ecosystem, washing the surface of the earth clean. It’s not that serious. At this level, it’s like humans just scraping their skin. It’s just that for other living things in the ecosystem, it’s lethal.”

chapters.title: Chapter 326: 134: Chen Kang Resurrects! A New Strange Phenomenon Appears! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: 134: Chen Kang Resurrects! A New Strange Phenomenon Appears! _2
Translator: 549690339
Zhang Jun (70): “As I said before…..zombies are starting to develop intelligence now. There are powerful zombies with high intelligence that control other zombies and refrain from meaningless large-scale destruction. Moreover…the hierarchy among zombies is more rigid than humans. The advanced zombies can issue orders to the lower ones at will, they can even use them as food without retaliation. As for zombies of the same level, they used to fight and eat each other, but not anymore.”
Wang Ping (66): “The birth of intelligent zombies chalking them up as a new intelligent race. It feels interesting to see them gradually form their own civilization….”
Luo Weiguo (85): “Only a strong person like you, Mr. Wang, would find this interesting. I feel a chill because they have replaced humans.”
Xu Yi (84): “There’s no such thing as replacement or not, it’s just how this world is. Humans are special, but not the only special ones. Let alone, zombies themselves are also human beings, I suppose. They are a new race formed from viral attacks on genes. In a sense, this is human evolution? The virus wanted humans to evolve, but humans couldn’t stand the power of the virus, so the genes collapsed and turned into zombies, and finally reorganized.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Your perspective is….quite peculiar.”
Zhang Jun (70): “It feels like we’ve veered off-topic. Shouldn’t we be discussing Chen Kang? But while zombie civilization is interesting, it makes my life more miserable. I used to be able to hunt zombies everywhere with my powerful strength. Now, I can’t be so reckless. I’m not afraid of weak zombie groups, what scares me are those terrifying zombies. Damn it, I am a powerful monster, and there are loads of strong zombies under my control.”
Wang Ping (66): “Then you’re really out of luck. However, I feel that your headache will increase because you have to take care of this ‘predecessor ransmigrator’ Chen Kang, amusing.jpg.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Mr. Wang, don’t take delight in others’ misfortune….”
Chen Si (83): “I’m sorry, my brother has caused you trouble.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Don’t worry about it, I’m actually happy. Finally, I have a companion in this world, someone who can talk. Although it’s a bit of a pity that it’s a man, it’s better than nothing.”
Wu Jun (20): “Hey, Zhang Jun exposed his intentions.”
Fang Yun (3): “It’s normal, normal. After all, this guy has been on the verge of madness from being alone in this Zombie World. He used to be so charitable during every mission.”
Zhang Hu (5): “I think, a man isn’t necessarily a bad option, funny.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “Zhang Hu, you’ve gone too far. Go and frolic away, don’t corrupt the girls in the group.”
While the group was in full swing, Chen Kang in the Zombie World had finally come to his senses from his drowsy state.
After soaking in all the information from the group chat, he finally understood his situation.
He had died, and was resurrected by his own sister.
For a moment, he felt very ashamed.
As a big brother, he should have protected his sister. Instead, he relied on her to risk dangerous missions and gather precious points to resurrect him. It was rather embarrassing.
“Zhang Jun, thank you for protecting me. Without you, I would have become zombie food again.”
Gratitude filled Chen Kang’s face as he looked at Zhang Jun.
“It’s nothing. Group members should help each other, that’s what I should be doing.” Zhang Jun earnestly spoke. “By the way, how did it feel when you were eaten by the zombie?”
Zhang Jun’s first half of the statement moved Chen Kang greatly, but the second half froze him silent, his face filled with fear and as black as the bottom of a pot.
“Ahem, just kidding.”
Zhang Jun coughed lightly and started talking.
“Instead of this, you should draw your golden finger first. Every transmigrator can draw their own golden finger. You didn’t draw it and hung yourself, which is a pity.”
“Yeah, I know.”
Chen Kang inhaled deeply and drew his golden finger with high expectations.
Then, his face showed an expression of disappointment.
“So, what’s your golden finger?”
Curiosity sparkled in Zhang Jun’s eyes.
“It’s Restriction.”
Chen Kang spoke in disappointment.
“It can impose a restriction effect on a single specified object, causing it to be unable to move. However, the greater the discrepancy in strength, the shorter the restriction time.”
“Shit, that’s a god-level skill!”
Zhang Jun’s eyes widened in shock, speaking excitedly.
Transmigrators draw their golden fingers randomly. There are ordinary ones and strong ones, but none are weak.
“Is it very strong?”
Chen Kang said in a somewhat confused tone.
“Are you kidding? Of course it’s strong. Can you imagine how important control skills will be when you’re in team fights? Yours is a specified powerful control skill, necessary for challenging matches beyond your level!”
Zhang Jun smacked his lips, exclaiming.
“You and your sister really are of the same type. Your sister can specify an object and reduce half of its combat power, while you can restrict a specific person.”
“Later, when the group’s powerful members undertake a mission, if they form a team with you, the success rate would skyrocket, even a fool would know this. I will reap the benefits of being in the same world as you, aren’t I free to fight whoever I want?”
Zhang Jun stared at Chen Kang with fervent eyes, licking his lips and spoke a bit too pleased.
Hearing this, Chen Kang instinctively clenched his butt. He felt that his ‘Junior Transmigrator’ Zhang Jun was a bit dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence! _3
Translator: 549690339
Next, Chen Kang also chose to speak up in the chat group.
Chen Kang (67): “Thank you, Mr. Wang and all my friends for taking care of me! If you need any help in the future, I will do my best to help you!”
Wang Ping (66): “I’m taking note of this, haha.jpg.”
Fang Yun (3): “Hey, I have a deep impression of you, the junior transmigrator who broke the record for the quickest death.”
Chen Kang (67): “……”
Wang Ping (66): “Stop teasing him. By the way, what kind of golden finger did you awaken?”
Zhang Jun (70): “He awakened the Designated Imprisonment, its effect depends on the power difference between the parties.”
Wang Ping (66): “Nice, the group has another support member. If there is a difficult group task in the future, it will definitely be much useful.”
“Ding, detecting the emergence of weirdness in Lin Yuanyuan’s world, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group mission is a forced mission, with five participants. The acting group master can choose group members to participate. If no choice is made, the system will randomly select group members to join the mission.”
“Ding, the transmission time is in ten minutes, please prepare accordingly, group members.”
Everyone: “???”
Wang Ping:
Wang Ping’s face darkened, and he fell silent.
“Alpha, what do you mean? Why suddenly issue a group task, making me look like a jinx?”
Wang Ping said with a twitching face in his heart.
“Because that world has indeed just discovered a weirdness invasion event. Since it’s weirdness, it must be eliminated as soon as possible, or there will be endless trouble.”
Alpha coldly replied.
“Tsk.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips, not knowing if Alpha was telling the truth or not.
But he only knew one thing.
That was, it was time to get to work.
“Alpha, don’t take too many of our group points this time. Otherwise, dealing with weirdness is difficult enough, and if you still want to take group points, no one will be willing to go.”
Wang Ping reminded Alpha in his heart.
“I know.”
Alpha coldly replied.
“You don’t know sh*t. Even if you have a heart, it’s a black one.”
Wang Ping disdainfully said this and continued looking at the chat group page.
At this moment, the group members had also reacted, and the group chat immediately exploded.
Fang Yun (3): “Mother… it’s been a while since the last weirdness, and now it’s back, I’m a little nervous.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Psychological shadow…it just won’t go away.”
Chen Yao (71): “The weirdness is much harder to deal with than reincarnators. One misstep and you’ll die. If it weren’t for Mr. Wang, clearing the stage would be all about luck.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Yeah, last time, if it wasn’t for Wu Jun’s golden finger, we would’ve all died. It was too risky.”
Zhang Jun (70) @Chen Yao (71): “No, even if there’s Mr. Wang, it’s not necessarily safe…after all, this is the weirdness, it’s too terrifying.”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, Mr. Wang jinxed us. He just said that, and then the weirdness appeared. I’m numb.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Huh? You dare to blame Mr. Wang? Are you tired of living? Eye-catching.jpg.”
Chen Kang (67): “Um, I don’t know about the weirdness, but it seems to be really powerful…”
Chen Si (83): “I’ve never faced weirdness either… but through the Death Replay video, I’ve learned a little about the horrors of weirdness… what should I do?”
Wang Ping (66): “Enough, time is limited. Don’t waste it. If you want to go, let me know so I can choose.”
With Wang Ping’s words, the group chat fell silent, with no one willing to wade into muddy waters.
After all, dealing with weirdness, the input and output are not proportional at all.
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t be scared. The group chat told me that the rewards for dealing with weirdness will be very generous in the future. It won’t be that bad.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Mr. Wang is really directly connected to the group chat, that’s awesome. But considering Mr. Wang’s abilities, it’s normal.”
Fang Yun (3): “Very generous… although I’m tempted, I really don’t want to face weirdness, so just forget it.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “It’s no use if you want to face it. To deal with weirdness, the golden finger is most important, followed by combat power. Your golden finger is useless against weirdness, and your strength is not the strongest either. Going there only increases losses.”
Zhang Jun (70): “It’s a little heartbreaking, but it’s indeed the truth.”
Wang Ping (66): “So, no one’s going?”
Wang Ping asked again.
However, there was still silence, and no one was willing to go.
Obviously, the previous weirdness of the dream had left a psychological shadow on all the old members.
Even the weirdness of the Pope in Zhang Hu’s world was cleared by luck.
Dealing with weirdness is really dangerous. Even with Wang Ping’s golden finger, it’s still very risky. One misstep and you’ll go down without a fight.
Although the group chat has improved a lot at present, even if you die, you can resurrect. But no one wants to die again.
It should be said that death is the best outcome. There is an even greater possibility is being worse than death; that would be a real game over.
As for the newcomers, who didn’t know much about the weirdness, they understood the horror of it, just from looking at the old members’ reactions. Naturally, they wouldn’t think about going to participate in order to earn group points.
So, the group chat was eerily quiet.
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “I didn’t expect my world to have weirdness…”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “To be honest, everyone’s reaction is normal, and I can understand. But now it’s my world that has the weirdness in it. In the future, it could appear in your worlds too. If you don’t actively step forward, what will you do in the future?”

chapters.title: Chapter 328: 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: 134: Chen Kang Revives! A New Bizarre Occurrence! _4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66): “Lin Yuanyuan, there’s no need to say it like that. After going through the last group task, the atmosphere can only change slowly.”
Wang Ping spoke, the words were for both the group members and Alpha to hear.
Look at what you’ve done. The effort and rewards are not proportional, making everyone in the group afraid to participate in group tasks.
“Ding, detecting that the difficulty level against the bizarre is too high, the chat group will improve the reward of group points for defeating the bizarre in group tasks. Even if the contribution value in the group mission isn’t high, you can still get a guaranteed minimum of 200,000 group points as a task reward.”
At this moment, a system prompt jumped out, making all the group members widen their eyes.
Well, the chat group really changed.
Even if there are no contribution points, you can still get a minimum of 200,000 group points as a task reward, this is like free group points.
With these 200,000 group points, whether it’s to buy more rebirth tallies for extra lives or to strengthen themselves, it’s all very comfortable.
For a moment, many people were moved.
Of course, more people were still calm.
Group points are precious, but they are nothing compared to the danger.
Unless, after this group task, they can see real benefits, only then will they choose to actively participate in the next group task involving defeating the bizarre.
Qin Tian (77): “Hehe, how can you miss a troublemaker like me? I, Qin Tian, am the exclusive task partner for Mr.Wang!”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “When it comes to recklessness, it’s always you.”
Qin Tian (77): “You don’t understand, this is taking a chance, turning a bicycle into a motorcycle. Besides, my bottom line is already strong.”
Wang Ping (66): “Qin Tian, count you in, and we still need three more people. Who’s going?”
Chen Yao (71): “I want to watch.”
Xu Yi (84): “Newcomers don’t qualify, old members watch and wait, it can only be random.”
Wang Ping (66): “It seems that we can only randomly draw the remaining members, let’s see what luck brings.”
Wang Ping shook his head and directly chose to randomly draw the remaining members.
“Ding, task member selection is complete. Congratulations to Wu Jun (20), Chen Si (83), and Chen Kang (67) for participating in this group task.”
The system prompt rang.
Those who were not selected, all breathed a sigh of relief.
While the selected ones, had confused expressions on their faces.
Wu Jun (20): “I’m dizzy, why me… My golden finger is too uncertain.”
Chen Si (83): “Wuwuwu, I don’t want to go…”
Chen Kang (67): “Uh, what’s going on? Why do I have to participate in this dangerous mission just after being resurrected? The chat group is really off the charts… Also, can you leave my sister alone?”
Fang Yun (3): “Chen Kang, I admire your luck… I feel like you dragged your sister into this too.”
Qin Tian (77): “To be honest, it’s a bit unreasonable.”
Liu Mei (15): “Good luck to all of you.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, the members have been selected. Let’s move on to the task. We must race against time to deal with the bizarre.”
Wang Ping left these words, and his body was enveloped in white light and disappeared into thin air.
And the others were also teleported away from their original world.
Zhang Jun looked at Chen Kang, who had just been resurrected and teleported away, possibly to die in the mission, and sighed regretfully, choosing to vent his frustrations on the gathering zombies.
In the world where Lin Yuanyuan resides, inside the Imperial Palace, dressed in a dragon robe, Lin Yuanyuan stood on the throne, overlooking her officials, and said: “Soon, my friends will descend upon here. You all should not neglect them, or else, you will be dragged out and executed.”
