As soon as these words were spoken, the officials’ hearts became solemn, anxious, and very curious.
The person who could be friends with this tyrant empress, just who are they? It truly made people wonder.
At this moment, beams of white light appeared, and Wang Ping and the others appeared one after another.
This also shocked the officials present.
The civil officials were fine, thinking it was just a martial arts move.
However, those military officials were frightened.
Because they couldn’t detect how Wang Ping and others appeared.
Moreover, although Wu Jun, Chen Si, and Chen Kang’s auras were not very strong, Wang Ping gave them an unfathomable feeling, which seemed even more terrifying than the tyrant empress who forcibly seized her position with her martial skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: 135: Red Talent: True Dragon Form! Such Terror
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: 135: Red Talent: True Dragon Form! Such Terror
Translator: 549690339
“Is this the world where Lin Yuanyuan lives? Quite interesting.”
Wang Ping glanced at the ministers below and then at Lin Yuanyuan beside him, his eyes becoming curious.
Lin Yuanyuan, you’re playing pretty big, huh?
She has actually become an Empress.
However, considering her strength, as long as she wants to, in this pitifully weak world of top-notch combat power, she can indeed do whatever she wants.
Of course, being weak is only relative.
Shattering mountains with a single blow is already quite powerful for the Swordsman World.
It can only be said that this level of strength is too weak when placed in the Profound World he is in or those powerful worlds.
“Uh, an Empress, how envious,”
Chen Si blinked at Lin Yuanyuan, muttering.
“It does feel a bit cool. Besides that, she’s so beautiful…”
Chen Kang also stared at Lin Yuanyuan without blinking.
Wu Jun heard Chen Kang’s words and rolled his eyes: “Junior, I advise you not to have any thoughts about Lin Yuanyuan. After all, you can’t withstand her Golden Finger.”
Lin Yuanyuan is indeed very beautiful. Although she cannot compare to Liu Mei and has a bit of a gap with Chen Yao, she could still be considered a beauty in the eyes of ordinary people.
Combined with her increased strength and becoming an Empress, she exudes an aura of authority, her charm seems to have increased a lot.
Although Chen Kang is now a member of the Transmigrator Chat Group, this guy died after crossing over and cannot actually be considered a qualified transmigrator, at best he is just a little special (unlucky) ordinary person, being amazed by Lin Yuanyuan is quite normal.
However, Wu Jun really wanted to say, Lin Yuanyuan is not someone anyone can control.
Let alone you, a little shrimp, even Mr. Wang can’t hold her, touching her would mean death.
” Chen Kang was stunned, not understanding why.
“Little Jun, are you asking for a beating?”
Lin Yuanyuan said with a half-smile.
“I don’t want to.” Wu Jun’s face twitched.
Lin Yuanyuan is indeed one of the high-end combat forces in the group, and he can’t afford to provoke her.
Although they have been working together on various tasks for four months and have become quite familiar, he still won’t provoke the big shots in the group.
“That, brother, what is Lin’s Golden Finger…” Chen Si pulled at Chen Kang’s clothes, her face flushed, whispering.
“Pff…” Chen Kang’s eyes widened, looking at Lin Yuanyuan in shock, his soul greatly impacted, his thoughts vanishing for a moment.
“Now is not the time to chat, let us go to a quieter place.”
Wang Ping shook his head with a smile and spoke.
“Alright.” Lin Yuanyuan nodded.
Then, she glanced at the ministers below, and without saying a word, left the palace with Wang Ping and the others under the shivering eyes of the ministers.
After Lin Yuanyuan and the others left, the civil and military officials heaved a sigh of relief, looking at each other in shock and amazement.
Her Majesty’s friends are really extraordinary, especially the three with unique clothes and hairstyles.
As for Wang Ping, they couldn’t see through him.
Moreover, Her Majesty seems to have a lower stance towards him, which is really incomprehensible.
This ruthless Empress, actually lowered her stance like this, it’s a true oddity.
“This place is a bit quieter. Mr. Wang, we’ll leave it to you.”
Lin Yuanyuan brought Wang Ping and the others to a White Jade Pavilion in a garden inside the Imperial Palace and whispered softly.
“Okay, I’ll gather some information first.”
Wang Ping nodded and closed his eyes.
This aroused Chen Kang’s curiosity, but he was tactful enough not to ask.
However, his sister, Chen Si, after admiring Wang Ping, began to patiently explain to Chen Kang.
At this moment, the suspended words in Wang Ping’s eyes reappeared.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate.]
[Five years later, your cultivation reached the 4th Tier Profound Elixir Realm, comprehended your own Lower-tier Divine Skill: Nine Shadow Sunrays, and your strength skyrocketed. At the same time, you accidentally activated the Unstable Evolver, upgrading your secret method of concealing your aura to a level comparable to the secret skill that Ye Chen will give you in the future, making it impossible for cultivators below the Nirvana Boundary to see through your aura.]
Wang Ping was stunned by this simulation content.
Outrageous!
That’s too outrageous!
Is this the Red Talent: True Dragon Form and the kind of talent and comprehension a Saint Child should have?
Just five years…
Without the guidance of a master, without the resources of a Holy Land, relying on himself to reach the 4th Tier Profound Elixir Realm, and comprehending his own Lower-tier Divine Skill, this was something he wouldn’t have dared to think about before!
For a moment, Wang Ping felt that he might have underestimated Ye Chen, who appeared in his previous simulations.
He’s already like this, how strong will Ye Chen be when the Purple Moon Secret Realm opens? What level of Divine Skill will he comprehend?
Although Ye Chen is not a Leading Character like Long Aotian, he is clearly a growth type. In a series of opportunities, his roots and comprehension will slowly improve, but he is definitely not that simple either.
“Maybe, I really chose the wrong Red Talent-Unstable Evolver back then,” Wang Ping unconsciously thought.
After all, the Unstable Evolver hasn’t brought him any qualitative change.
He previously thought that without the Unstable Evolver, he might have been struck dead by the thunder tribulation, but that was just his guess at the time.
From the current situation, even if the Red Talent-True Dragon Form wasn’t as strong, it wouldn’t be too far off.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: 135: Red Talent – True Dragon Form! Such Terror_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: 135: Red Talent – True Dragon Form! Such Terror_2
Translator: 549690339
By the time he broke through to the Profound Elixir Realm, he had definitely understood his own divine skills and easily withstood the Heavenly Tribulation.
“However, at this point, there’s not much to say. Not to mention, if I chose that time and choose now, it would overlap, which is really a waste.”
Wang Ping comforted himself and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[When you comprehend your own divine power, you accidentally trigger the unstable Evolution Device, allowing you to choose whether to optimize your divine power. You have no hesitation in choosing to optimize. For you now, you think that a mere lower-tier divine skill, even if discarded, can be understood again in some time, but if it succeeds in optimization, you will directly obtain a mid-tier divine skill.]
[The value of lower-tier divine skills and mid-tier divine skills cannot be mentioned in the same breath. Moreover, this is your own divine skill, making it even more valuable, potentially saving much time in comprehending.]
[You choose to optimize, and you are very fortunate to have successfully optimized your lower-tier divine skill, Shadow Sun Nine Brilliance, into a mid-tier divine skill: Eclipse. Your mind is filled with many insights, which benefit you immensely.]
“Uh… sorry, unstable Optimizer, I shouldn’t have badmouthed you.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his expression subtle.
He had just complained about the unstable simulator, and now it had played a significant role, which was quite outrageous, totally a slap in the face.
However, for such a slap, please give me more, thank you.
[Next, you lose interest in quiet cultivation, waiting for the opening of the Purple Moon Secret Realm. Because the greatest opportunity in the Purple Moon Secret Realm is nothing more than the Nirvana Fruit and the inheritance of the Nirvana Boundary, and you do not need these two aspects urgently at the moment. Waiting for more than a decade is really a waste of time. Moreover, these chances are for Ye Chen, your apprentice, and you will not compete for them. At the same time, you don’t care about ordinary chances.]
[As a result, you let Ye Chen go freely and let him venture on his own. As for you, you take Cai Yonglong and head to the Eastern Desolation. After getting some Spiritual Stones in Heavenly Sea Country, you and Cai Yonglong start traveling through various countries, looking for powerful opportunities.]
[Five years later, thanks to the opportunities found by Cai Yonglong’s golden finger, your cultivation has reached the 7th Tier Profound Elixir Realm, and your strength has increased substantially. At the same time, Cai Yonglong is also very fortunate, finding his own powerful opportunity.]
[It is an opportunity found in the dangerous Black Light Valley of the large Black Element Country outside of Heavenly Sea Country. In the Black Light Valley, there is a Master hiding from the world. Nearing the end of his life, he discovers Cai Yonglong’s hidden talents in the light element. At the cost of his life, he passes on his lifelong cultivation to him in stages, and leaves him powerful inheritances.]
[As a result, Cai Yonglong’s cultivation actually catches up with you, skyrocketing directly to the Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm. Although the Profound Elixir condensed by Cai Yonglong is only 2nd Tier, it is powerful enough to rival many True Disciples of the Holy Land.]
[It can only be said that many loose cultivators may not have insufficient talent, but they have not discovered their true potential, and the attributes of the cultivation skills they practice may be conflicting. Only the major powers, when their disciples are young, will find the most suitable attributes for them and guide them onto the right path, avoiding a waste of time.]
[You have a lot of feelings about Cai Yonglong’s chance. Indeed, in this world, chances are really important. A powerful chance is enough to make someone quickly become strong and catch up with others. Of course, Cai Yonglong’s approach of quickly gaining cultivation through being imparted has its risks and not everyone can withstand such powerful cultivation. In addition to that, a sudden increase in strength could potentially cause problems in their mindset.]
[Therefore, even if Cai Yonglong quickly reaches the Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm, he still needs to spend a long time consolidating his foundation and settling his mind. The time spent on this is negligible for ordinary cultivators since they may never reach such heights in their lifetime, but for those truly talented individuals, they may be able to reach such cultivation more solidly through their own efforts.]
[As a result, the truly talented people don’t care too much about being imparted cultivation. And you, in fact, just sigh a little, not caring about it, just happy for Cai Yonglong.]
“This cultivation improvement speed feels so great. However, Cai Yonglong finally has a chance to catch up with me. Not bad, not bad.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his lips curling into a slight smile.
As Cai Yonglong’s strength increases, it benefits him even more, and he naturally hopes that Cai Yonglong will quickly become stronger.
However, Black Element Country, Black Light Valley…
That must be a very distant place.
And it’s unknown whether that Master would choose to pass on his cultivation to Cai Yonglong at this point in time.
After all, at this point in time, the man still has more than a decade of life, so he may not be so open-minded.
“Forget it, whether he will be so open-minded or not, I’ll know when I find an opportunity to simulate it. However, since I am still on a mission right now, if I want to know the answer, I can only wait until I return.”
Wang Ping thought secretly in his heart, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Time flies, and in about eight more years, your cultivation has long since reached the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection. You and Cai Yonglong have been searching for a way to get to the Central Continent in order to go to the Eternal Frozen Land to find high-quality Yin Power.]

chapters.title: Chapter 331: 135: Red Talent – True Dragon’s Form! Such Terror_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: 135: Red Talent – True Dragon’s Form! Such Terror_3
Translator: 549690339
[In the end, you failed. The distance between the two continents is too great, even the Yin and Yang Master is not qualified to go to another continent, unable to bear the costs. Although you are not ordinary Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection Cultivators and Cai Yonglong even has some good things left by the Life and Death Realm Master, you are unable to go there.]
[The delivery array that can span continents is only built by forces with a king-tier master at the helm or by the Holy Land. If you sought their help, you might be courting death.]
[When you were distressed, you thought of Bing Ningyue and the Ice Palace. If you borrowed the power of the Ice Palace, perhaps you could go there. At the same time, you also remembered Xue’er, who may be connected to the Ice Palace in some way. If you informed the Ice Palace about Xue’er through Bing Ningyue, you might get their attention and they might help you.]
[Having analyzed everything thoroughly, you believed it was quite feasible. You risked going to the vicinity of the Ice Palace and contacted Bing Ningyue after a long interval. Upon receiving your message talisman, she was very surprised and decided to meet you.]
[After reuniting after such a long time, you had a lengthy chat, sharing some of your experiences. Bing Ningyue was stunned to find that you and Cai Yonglong’s cultivation had reached the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, and you, in return, também were amazed that she achieved the same level, with her bloodline and constitution evidently awakened.]
[However, when you recall that twenty years later Bing Ningyue’s cultivation would only reach half-step towards the Yin Yang Mirror, you believe that the Ice Palace must be hunting extremely high quality Yin and Yang energy to help Bing Ningyue to break through perfectly.]
[Otherwise, with Bing Ningyue’s talent, a half-step breakthrough to the Yin Yang Mirror would be a breeze. Even for the genius and monsters of the Purple Spirit Realm, they wouldn’t settle for a third-tier Yin Power breakthrough, in fact, they might not even consider it significant, promising at least a breakthrough to 2nd tier.]
[Those with extremely high ambitions would even choose 1st-tier. Since treasures are hard to find in the world, they naturally have to spend a lot of time in their search. Because of this, even a genius would spend a lot of time at the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection or the Half-step Yin Yang Mirror, and it’s not uncommon for them to spend decades at a single stage.]
[However, to cultivators and geniuses, several decades seem insignificant. They require the strongest foundation; otherwise, they will hit a bottleneck at some Nirvana Boundary in the future, an outcome they are unwilling to encounter. It’s the king tier that is their ultimate goal.]
[Bing Ningyue was curious about your purpose in seeking her out, so you told her about your intention to go to the Eternal Frozen Land, but your lack of means to get there led you to request the use of the Ice Palace’s Delivery Array.]
[Bing Ningyue was surprised and deduced your thoughts, believing that you are taking a big risk. The Eternal Frozen Land does indeed harbor high-quality Yin Power, but it’s too dangerous, far more than other places.]
[You reluctantly admitted that, being a loose cultivator, you didn’t know a place where you could safely obtain high-quality Yin Power, making your decision your only option. Bing Ningyue became silent for a while, then wondered why you didn’t just join a Holy Land. With your talent, it would be effortless for you to be accepted.]
[It’s known that even within the Holy Land, if you desire to obtain high-quality Yin and Yang energy you need to exchange it with a variety of contribution points. This means that even Inner Sect Disciples in the Profound Elixir Realm of the Holy Land would have to grind for a long time to be able to exchange for it. Moreover, even disciples with the potential of True Inheritor Disciple would need to save contribution points for a long time for an exchange.]
[Regardless of difficulties in exchange, at least you can get Yin and Yang energy in the Holy Land. Unlike loose cultivators, who not only face danger but also uncertainty in obtaining it.]
[You sighed and indicated there were unspeakable reasons for not being able to. Bing Ningyue understood and didn’t probe further. Eventually, Bing Ningyue revealed she had accumulated many contribution points from the Ice Palace over the years and could help you exchange for the precious 1st-tier Yin Power. She considered this as repaying your previous kindness of giving her the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower.]
[Your heart stirred at this, realizing that your previous investment was indeed the right decision. However, you asked her about her status. Bing Ningyue then revealed that her master is a King Realm Master who had been searching for Pure Yin Power for her over the years. Her master asserted that only with Pure Yin Power, combined with Pure Yang Power to create Yin Yang Diagram could she break through to the Yin Yang Mirror.]
[It dawned on you that the big shots of the Ice Palace regarded Bing Ningyue as the hope for the resurgence of the Ice Palace, hence, why they planned her breakthrough in such an optimum way. You also speculated that Bing Ningyue probably had already condensed a Flawless Profound Elixir, which even a typical disciple of the Holy Land couldn’t achieve.]
[After reflection, you accept Bing Ningyue’s goodwill. After all, you really needed this high-quality Yin Power. If you could trigger the optimization option, you could use it to catapultPure Yin Power to a half-step Yin Yang Mirror. This is significant for you.]
[Of course, you well understood that even if you successfully optimized it, it might not turn out to be Pure Yin Power—it could be two instances of 1st-tier Yin Power. However, regardless, you needed this 1st-tier Yin Power.]
[Afterward, Bing Ningyue returned to the Ice Palace to exchange 1st-tier Yin Power for you. You refused to engage the unstable evolution device and failed to optimize it into Pure Yin Power. This deeply disappointed you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 135: Red Talent – True Dragon’s Form! Such Terror_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 135: Red Talent – True Dragon’s Form! Such Terror_4
Translator: 549690339
[Then, Bing Ningyue asked if you still wanted to go to the Eternal Frozen Land. After some thought, you decided to go there because Cai Yonglong had not yet broken through, and perhaps he could find Upper 3 tier Yin power there.]
[Bing Ningyue did not try to dissuade you. After all, every genius has their own ambitions and goals, and cannot be easily persuaded by others. Therefore, she just wanted to help as much as she could, especially since you were a rare male fellow taoist.]
[You were grateful for Bing Ningyue’s help, but although you wanted to tell her about Xue’er, you knew that you wouldn’t be able to explain how you knew about her situation, so you could only shake your head and keep this secret in your heart.]
[You believed that after going to the Eternal Frozen Land and meeting Xue’er, you could then reveal Xue’er’s story and bring her back to the Ice Palace, repaying Bing Ningyue’s help.]
[Of course, you also had many doubts in your mind. You wondered where and by whom the Xue’er in your memory had been taken away.]
[With Bing Ningyue’s help, you and Cai Yonglong successfully entered the Ice Palace and, using the Delivery Array of the Ice Palace, went to the Ice Poison Sect in Central Continent. It turned out that the Ice Palace had always had a close relationship with the Ice Poison Sect.]
[This made you even more puzzled. If the founder of the Profound Ice Sect claimed to be a disciple of the Profound Ice Emperor, why was the Ice Palace closer to the Ice Poison Sect, which was established by the followers of the Profound Ice Emperor?]
[You recalled the style of the Profound Ice Sect in your memory, and couldn’t help but speculate that the Profound Ice Sect must not be so simple; they were likely hiding some secret which made the Ice Palace and the Ice Poison Sect suspicious and unwilling to trust them.]
[However, despite having many doubts, you had no intention of digging deeper. As a small loose cultivator, you couldn’t interfere with their matters, and it would only be asking for trouble and risking your life.]
[When you arrived at the Profound Ice Sect, the Ice Poison Gate Elder enthusiastically received you and noticed your extraordinary talents, even inviting you to join the Ice Poison Sect.]
[After discussing with Cai Yonglong, you felt that joining the Ice Poison Sect might be a good choice. As a result, you both chose to join the Ice Poison Sect. However, you stated that you disliked fighting, so you asked the elder not to reveal your existence.]
[The Ice Poison Gate Elder saw your difficulties and agreed. In the end, you became deacons of the Ice Poison Sect with leisure positions.]
[You sighed at the differences between the Ice Poison Sect and the Profound Ice Sect. After settling down in the Ice Poison Sect, you began discussing with Cai Yonglong about entering the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[However, you believed that it would be better to wait until you broke through to Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror before venturing further. Once you reached the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, your combat power would surge, enough to rival a Quasi-True Inheritor Disciple from Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and even easily suppress them. Such strength would be powerful enough.]
[Cai Yonglong thought your reasoning made sense and decided to wait for your breakthrough before venturing out together.]
[You began your retreat, and after a month, you successfully broke through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, inscribing 1st-tier Yin power onto the Flawless Profound Elixir. Your combat power surged after you broke through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, making you feel exhilarated.]
[However, you also felt a bit of regret for not being able to break through using Pure Yin Power. Of course, you just regretted it, and didn’t take it too seriously. After all, obtaining Pure Yin Power was something that even a Quasi-Emperor might not be able to achieve in the Eternal Frozen Land. So, it was extremely difficult and practically impossible for you to obtain it.]
[Moreover, if you were to attain a breakthrough using Pure Yin Power, you would need to supplement it with Pure Yang Power, but you didn’t know how to find Pure Yang Power. Maybe, you would be stuck at the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror.]

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog!
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog!
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that for the simulated Wang Ping, breaking through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with the 1st-tier Yin power is the best choice.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and thought to himself.
However, breaking through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with the 1st-tier Yin power is not his best choice.
He wants to become stronger, perfecting every realm so that he can go further in the future.
Of course, he can understand why the simulated Wang Ping would think that. Struggling on his own is indeed difficult.
“I have group score enhancement, so there’s no need to worry too much. Moreover, I still have the Nirvana Fruit that I haven’t eaten. I just don’t know whether the Nirvana Fruit can transform my 1st-tier Yin power into Pure Yin Power.”
Wang Ping pondered this question.
However, he soon shook his head. Although the Nirvana Fruit is precious, it probably cannot do this.
If it could, those Quasi-Emperors wouldn’t have risked going deep into the Eternal Frozen Land to find Pure Yin Power.
For those big shots, getting a Nirvana Fruit is much easier than getting Pure Yin Power; naturally, they wouldn’t do things that are thankless and laborious.
[When you broke through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, you alarmed the Ice Poison Gate Elder and even the Sect Master. They were astonished by the commotion you caused during your breakthrough and decided to secretly help suppress the anomalies to avoid attracting attention.]
[After your breakthrough was completed, the Ice Poison Sect Master and many Inner Sect Elders were very enthusiastic about you, hoping you could join the Ice Poison Sect. If possible, they would teach you the sect’s inheritance cultivation skills.]
[After considering, you felt that the Ice Poison Sect should be trustworthy and decided to join them. The Sect Master and others were very happy and imparted the cultivation skill of the Ice Poison Sect, the Ice Poison Skill. This is a king-tier cultivation skill, just like the Bloodthirsty Demon Technique, with the middle scroll being a heaven-tier nonsuch cultivation skill, and the lower scroll being king-tier, but it also requires cultivation at the Life and Death Realm to practice.]
[Of course, there are restrictions, but for some truly monstrous talents, even without reaching that realm, they can still comprehend king-tier cultivation skills and achieve power far beyond others.]
[During the process of cultivating the Ice Poison Technique, you accidentally triggered the unstable Optimizer. You were surprised and wondered whether to optimize or not. In the end, you made up your mind and chose to optimize.]
[In the end, the Ice Poison Technique was optimized into the most suitable Primordial Spirit Skill for you. This time, it was different from the previous Primordial Spirit Skill, as it was at the king-tier level. You were surprised and didn’t expect it to be successful.]
[You should know that you have gained a detailed understanding of the unstable Optimizer over the years. The probability of triggering the unstable Optimizer is very low. At the same time, there is a characteristic that the higher the level of the item, the lower the probability of successful optimization. You and Cai Yonglong have failed every optimization attempt with the treasures over the years, wasting more than a dozen treasures, which has annoyed both you and Cai Yonglong.]
[Eventually, Cai Yonglong even dragged you along and begged you not to optimize anymore. This time, it was a king-tier cultivation skill, and the optimization was successful; you can imagine how lucky it was.]
[In response, your heart was overjoyed, and you began to cultivate the Primordial Spirit Skill. In the end, you successfully cultivated the Primordial Spirit Skill with seven attributes of metal, wood, water, fire, earth, ice, and poison in one body. You were very satisfied with the changes in yourself.]
[Next, you delved into various powerful secret skills of the Ice Poison Sect, enhancing your strength and means to the extreme. Then, with the help of the Ice Poison Sect elder, you obtained detailed maps of the outer and partial inner areas of the Eternal Frozen Land. Once you were ready, you set off.]
[For your safety, the Ice Poison Sect dispatched a Nirvana Boundary Supreme Elder to secretly protect you from behind. However, you were not aware of this.]
“Well, is this the benefit of joining a major power? I really love it.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, with mixed emotions in his heart.
As a loose cultivator, it was too difficult; everything had to be done on his own. Even if he encountered great opportunities, sometimes he didn’t have the strength to compete for them, which was really miserable.
Now things are better; after joining the Ice Poison Sect, he has no shortage of cultivation skills and secret skills.
Even when he goes out, there is a Nirvana Boundary Supreme Elder secretly protecting him, lest he fall.
This is the treatment for genius; it’s simply too sweet.
Thinking of this, he feels that the life of the previous simulated Wang Ping was simply unbearable and hard to look at.
[After entering the Eternal Frozen Land, you experienced a series of twists and turns and found a 3rd Tier Yin Power near the inner area. You were not particularly satisfied and hesitated whether to go further to the inner area.]
[However, before you could enter, an extreme chill emanated from the inner area, possessing the terrifying power to freeze even a Yin and Yang Master. Even now, you felt bone-chilling cold. You understood that if you entered, you would definitely die.]
[In the end, you decided to leave the Eternal Frozen Land. But as you tried to leave, you were targeted by an ice-element demonic beast from the inner area. It was very powerful and had terrifying combat power. Even you, with your huge cultivation gap, were no match for it and were about to die a terrible death.]
[At the critical moment, the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect forcefully stepped in and defeated it, saving your lives. At that moment, you felt fear and realized the dangers of the Eternal Frozen Land.]

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _2
Translator: 549690339
[Now, we are just on the outer area and haven’t stepped into the inner area. There are such terrifying cold gusts sweeping through from time to time and lurking Terrifying Monsters. Even the Yin Yang Mirror might encounter danger. This place is not suitable for people with low cultivation levels.]
[After you express gratitude to the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect, you decide to leave this place. Cai Yonglong also indicates that he doesn’t need you to take any more risks for him. He is merely a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir, and breaking through with 1st-tier Yin power might be dangerous, and even 2nd-tier is hard to find. Therefore, he plans to use 3rd Tier Yin power to break through to the Yin-Yang Mirror, or accumulate enough contribution points in the Ice Poison Sect and see if he can exchange them for a breakthrough.]
[You sigh in your heart and feel you can only do so, without trying to persuade further. However, the Nirvana Boundary Supreme Elder shakes his head, saying that you may have been a loose cultivator for too long, thinking that everything must rely on yourself. In fact, the best method is to complete sect missions and earn contribution points to exchange for high-quality Yin and Yang powers. 2nd Tier, although rare in the Ice Poison Sect, is not non-existent.]
[It is just that the 1st-tier is hard to obtain, and the Ice Poison Sect has no stock. However, ordinary geniuses don’t need 1st-tier Yin-Yang power. Because those who have not condensed the 1st-tier Profound Elixir are not eligible to use the 1st-tier Yin-Yang power to break through. Even the Holy child of the Holy Land may not have condensed the 1st-tier Profound Elixir, let alone the geniuses of other forces.]
[Next, the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect sighs that your demands on yourselves are too high. He is also curious about how you, as loose cultivators, managed to come this far.]
[Hearing the words of the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect, you struggle to calm your heart. Indeed, your demands on yourself are too high. In fact, a 2nd-tier Profound Elixir is already the level of most True Inheritor Disciples in the Holy Land. 2nd Tier Yin power is also only eligible for True Disciples of the Holy Land to use for breakthrough, and in king-tier forces, it is only successor level people who can achieve this.]
[Eventually, you give up your obsession completely, feeling that your current situation is already quite good, and choose to go back home. The Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect says that he can tear through space and go back directly. However, you refuse and decide to continue walking in the icy and snowy world.]
[Although the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect is puzzled, he doesn’t think much of it and decides to continue following you to prevent any accidents.]
[Next, you may have a deep connection with Xue’er. On the way back, you see her again, riding a white fox and searching for resources in the snow.]
[You look at her, feeling complicated. Although you have never met Xue’er before, you know from your memories that you were her Tao Companion, and she even gave birth to a daughter for you.]
[You know that Xue’er is a gentle girl and have always had a good impression of her, despite never meeting her. Now that you see her, whether it’s because of your memories or Bing Ningyue’s influence, you want to keep Xue’er by your side.]
[However, before you can approach Xue’er, the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect appears beside her in an instant, revealing a surprised expression. This is because she recognizes the extraordinary nature of Xue’er. Xue’er not only looks identical to the current Ice Palace successor, Bing Ningyue, but her bloodline shares the same origin as the Ice Emperor and the Profound Ice Emperor. It seems that her bloodline has regressed, but it has not yet awakened.]
[The Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect is overjoyed, believing that heaven favors their sect. The Ice Palace has found the descendant of the Ice Emperor, giving them hope of becoming a Holy Land again. And the Ice Poison Sect has also found another descendant, with the hope of becoming a Holy Land as well.]
[If Xue’er grows up to become an Emperor, they will have the hope of going to the central area of the Eternal Frozen Land. They want to witness it for themselves if their master has truly fallen or is sealed in the ice and can be revived.]
[For the big shots of the Ice Poison Sect, who once followed the Profound Ice Emperor, they have always been waiting for their master, hoping to see the Emperor once again and even witness her resurrection.]
[However, the central area is a place even Quasi-Emperors fear, and they have no ability to enter it. Now that they have found Xue’er, they finally have hope!]
[As for the rumors spread by the Emperor-level Holy Lands that the Profound Ice Emperor has perished, they don’t believe it and don’t want to accept it. How could their master, the once peerless Profound Ice Emperor, have fallen so easily? Only by witnessing it with their own eyes can they make a judgment!]
[You watch the overjoyed Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect and finally confirm your guess in your heart. Xue’er is indeed a descendant of the Ice Empress, and her bloodline may have regressed like Bing Ningyue’s, but it is unknown why she was left in the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[Next, you can’t help but guess that Xue’er and Wang Yuxin in your memory suddenly disappeared, perhaps because they were accidentally found by the elders of the Ice Poison Sect and taken away.]
[Afterward, you return to the Ice Poison Sect, and Cai Yonglong successfully breaks through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with the help of the 2nd-Tier Yin Power of the Ice Poison Sect. However, you cannot conceal your unusual existence forever, and eventually, your identities are discovered.]
[Still, having your identities revealed isn’t much of a problem. Because the Ice Poison Sect has king-tier masters, those who are hostile to the Guilt-Punishing Emperor wouldn’t go to great lengths against a force with king-tier masters for a small fry like you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _3
Translator: 549690339
[However, you are very unlucky. Since the Eternal Frozen Land is a special territory, every few years, kings and even quasi-emperors will enter, searching for high-quality Yin power. Before these strong beings enter the Eternal Frozen Land, some of them will visit the Xuanbing Sect and Ice Poison Sect, the two major eastern hosts, as guests and gather information about recent events in the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[Unfortunately, your identities have been exposed by a visiting quasi-emperor. Due to the battlefield being located in the Central Continent, the damage there was greater than in the other four continents. As a result, the Central Continent could no longer maintain its position as the strongest continent after the battle. Also, the cultivators of Central Continent generally admired the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. For this reason, the quasi-emperor was very hostile to you and exposed your identities.]
[When the higher-ups of the Ice Poison Sect learned that you were actually extraterritorial comers, their expressions changed, and their attitude towards you changed. Although they did not hold any animosity towards Profound Turtle Spirit bearers and even had good intentions, they despised extraterritorial comers from the bottom of their hearts.]
[If it wasn’t for the Blood Demon Clan and the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, the Purple Spirit Realm wouldn’t be in such chaos, and they wouldn’t have lost so many friends and family.]
[You and Cai Yonglong become silent, bitter in your hearts, knowing that you are done for. There’s no chance of survival when facing a quasi-emperor.]
[In the end, the quasi-emperor coldly stated that you don’t deserve to live. However, seeing that your souls are still pure, he didn’t perform soul-searching on you and offered a dignified way to die.]
[You and Cai Yonglong sighed in your hearts, thanked the quasi-emperor for his ‘kindness’. You both knew very well that you couldn’t stop the soul-searching should he decide to do it. If he were to discover your secrets, you’d wish you were dead.]
[Hoping for a quasi-emperor to pay special attention to you after learning about the Golden Finger and diligently cultivate you is impossible. He would only erase your will, turn you into puppets, and then rationally exploit your Golden Finger. Such a life is not what youwish to see.]
[Following this, both of you decisively chose to kill yourselves. Because you didn’t want to use the Rebirth tally to resurrect, you truly died.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
“Ah…”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, speechless.
He never expected that the Ice Poison Sect would have a quasi-emperor descend and directly see through the simulated Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong’s identities. It’s like sitting at home and having a knife fall from the sky.
However, this also proves one thing.
The Purple Spirit Realm is even more hostile to extraterritorial comers than he had imagined.
Last time, Heavenly Sword Saint Master’s words were even more insincere than he had thought, completely misleading people with no bit of truth.
As Wang Ping silently complained in his heart, his consciousness flickered, and his vision changed.
Then, Wang Ping saw the scene where Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong helplessly killed themselves in front of the quasi-emperor, which was truly powerless.
In the face of such strong beings, life and death are entirely controlled by them.
After Wang Ping remembered the scene before him, his vision returned to normal, and the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
. Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror Cultivation.
. Mid-tier divine skill: Eclipse.
. King-tier skill : Primordial Spirit Skill.
. King-tier skill: Ice Poison Skill.
. Various Secret Skills.
. Red Talent: True Dragon Form.
. Lower-tier Divine Skill: Nine Shadow Sunrays.”
“There are so many good things, I really want them all.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards before him, quite tempted.
Each of the rewards was excellent.
However, the Red Talent: True Dragon Form is a must-choose talent.
As for the second reward, Wang Ping was indeed somewhat torn.
King-tier Cultivation Skill: Primordial Spirit Skill; Mid-tier divine skill: Eclipse; Various Secret Skills.
These three are what he wants the most.
The first two were obtained through unstable Optimizer, and various secret skills include his stealth skills and Ice Poison Sect’s skills, both excellent.
As for the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror Cultivation, with 1st-tier Yin power, it was not what he wanted.
“No, I can’t choose right away.”
Wang Ping quickly calmed down.
This time, he was on a mission.
He would face unknown challenges!
Perhaps, it is better to choose the highest value reward under normal circumstances, but not now.
“I’ll save the choices and proceed with the simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought silently in his heart.
Then, Wang Ping spoke in his heart, “System, I want to proceed with the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation started, the host has 14 free simulation chances remaining.”
The system’s voice rang out in Wang Ping’s mind.
Although he should have accumulated 20 simulation times over this long period, Wang Ping had used several free times during his missions in the past few months.
That’s why the number is what it is.
However, this number of simluations is enough.
He only used up to five or six simulations when dealing with the unknown challenge in the past.
[On the first day, you discussed a plan. Finally, you decided to utilize Empress Lin Yuanyuan’s identity to gather forces worldwide and search for the unknown event.]
[During a month, many suspicious events were found among the people, but none of them seemed to be caused by the unknown threat through your investigations.]

chapters.title: Chapter 336  Chapter 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _4
chapters.content:
336  Chapter 136: Generous Rewards! Mysterious Fog! _4
[However, we finally discovered an unusual place. In a valley, there is always a thick fog, and it seems to spread over time, covering a large area.]
[These fogs are not as thin as in the valley, and they don't seem to hinder people. At most, some hunters who want to hunt in the mountains get lost and seem to be trapped.]
[After analyzing this, you finally decided to go and check it out, as staying in the Imperial Palace wouldn't help in unveiling the truth.]
[When you arrived at Fog Mount, you used your Spiritual Sense to cover the area and examine the inside of the mountain. To your astonishment, your Spiritual Sense as a Profound Elixir Realm master was blocked by the fog.]
[You all thought this was very unusual since the power level of this world is not high, so there shouldn't be anything that could block a Profound Elixir Realm Cultivator's Spiritual Sense completely.]
[After discussing, you made a decision. You intended to directly destroy the entire Fog Mount. In that case, whatever secrets Fog Mount held and whether there were anything unusual lurking within wouldn't matter. As long as Fog Mount was destroyed, everything would vanish.]
[You unleashed your full strength, delivering an earth-shattering blow. You expected Fog Mount to be wiped out easily, but to your shock, after your powerful strike, the fog on the mountain surged and blocked your attack with ease.]
[Seeing this situation, you all felt a mix of shock, joy, and fear. You were sure of one thing: there was something unusual hidden in Fog Mount with power most likely related to the fog. However, this mysterious force seemed too terrifying, as it easily blocked your full-strength attack, making it difficult to defeat.]
[You decided to retreat first and plan your next move later. However, just as you were about to leave, the white fog billowed and enveloped you all, compressing around you.]
[In response, you and Lin Yuanyuan attacked in fear and desperation, but it had little effect. In the end, the white fog crushed you all; Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun died first. You, Qin Tian, and Lin Yuanyuan only struggled a bit longer before succumbing to death as well.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ended....]
....
"What...?"
Wang Ping opened his eyes, frowning.
He found the unusual force right away, which was undoubtedly good news.
But, this mysterious force seemed extremely powerful.
He hadn't figured out the enemy's ability, whether it was simply controlling the fog, or some other skill, when the enemy crushed him.
The combat power of both sides was not on the same level.
Honestly, it was somewhat troublesome.
"Mr. Wang, how did it go?"
Seeing Wang Ping frowning, Wu Jun asked first.
"It's a bit troublesome."
Wang Ping shook his head and relayed the simulation content.
"This is indeed troublesome."
Wu Jun felt a headache coming and muttered.
"This mysterious force... is it really that strong?"
Lin Yuanyuan also frowned, her eyelids twitching, feeling as if she had survived a calamity.
Thankfully, the strange fog hadn't spread to her.
If it had, wouldn't the enemy be able to kill her at any time?
"Calm down, calm down. It's always like this when we face strange phenomena. At first, we always die."
Qin Tian waved his hand and spoke.
"Don't be arrogant. When facing a mysterious force, you must stay humble and not be blindly confident."
Wang Ping frowned and warned.
"Uh, I know." Qin Tian scratched his head and didn't talk back.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre
Translator: 549690339
“This weird power is very strong, and if we want to deal with it, we must have higher combat power. Or is this anomaly like the zombie anomaly and Pope anomaly, a developmental type? If we act against it now, we might have a chance to kill it.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, his gaze flickering as he analyzed the situation.
“It’s very possible. However, there’s too little information at present. We need you, Mr. Wang, to continue collecting intelligence.”
Qin Tian also became serious and spoke up.
“Okay.”
“System, I want to start a free simulation.”
Wang Ping nodded and initiated the simulation again.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins, remaining free simulation times: 13.”
As the system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text floated out.
[Day 1: After discussing your strategy, you head to Fog Mount and try to launch a full attack to destroy it, but you are still easily stopped. Right after, you die twice in a row to the white fog’s attack.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
“That was really short.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
This was the first time in all his simulations that it had been so brief.
The problem was that the target was too obvious and could be directly targeted, yet it was also too strong.
It was at this moment that his Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death talent was triggered again.
Wang Ping saw the scene on Fog Mount.
This time, Wang Ping’s attack on Fog Mount was still caught by the white fog, but the effect seemed to be slightly stronger than last time.
Although the difference wasn’t significant and required careful observation to notice, there was still a clear difference.
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, deep in thought.
“Mr. Wang, how is it?” Lin Yuanyuan asked.
“The opponent is indeed a developmental type. However, there’s some bad news. That is, the opponent has already developed to an extremely powerful state. Even if we take action now, they can easily crush all of us.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
“This…”
Qin Tian was slightly annoyed.
This was the first time he had encountered an anomaly that was exposed from the start, but they were completely outmatched.
Of course, the Charm Skill anomaly didn’t count since its power wasn’t strong; its ability was the real issue.
“Um, is it really troublesome?” Chen Kang asked confusedly.
“Of course it’s troublesome. Dealing with an anomaly can easily lead to our annihilation.”
Wu Jun also spoke up helplessly.
Chen Kang fell silent.
Good grief, had he just been resurrected to participate in such a dangerous mission?
Would he have to die again?
If he died this time, who would resurrect him….
“Don’t worry, I’ll increase my strength first and then see what happens.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
It seemed like now he had no choice but to increase his cultivation.
If it still wasn’t enough, he would go to exploit some bugs, teleport back to the Purple Spirit Realm to earn Spiritual Stones through simulations, rapidly increase his strength, and then come back to eliminate this anomaly.
After all, there are always more solutions than problems.
“How do you plan to improve your strength? There’s no Spiritual Energy in this world, right?”
Qin Tian mumbled.
Without saying much, Wang Ping simply brought up the rewards page.
Then, Wang Ping made his choice directly.
“System, I choose ①.Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror Cultivation and ⑥. Red Talent: True Dragon Form.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke from the bottom of his heart.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his cultivation rapidly soaring.
His Profound Elixir had transformed into a Flawless Profound Elixir, with 1st-tier Yin power engraved on it.
“The strength of the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror is indeed extraordinary. However, my current strength is still far inferior to the Wang Ping in the simulation. After all, I don’t have the corresponding Divine Skills and Secret Skills.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
However, the strength of the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror should be enough, right?
If it’s not enough, he would have to make a significant sacrifice, which was something he didn’t want to see.
“Mr. Wang, you…”
Of those present, Qin Tian and Lin Yuanyuan had stronger senses and felt that Wang Ping’s aura seemed to have changed, but they didn’t know how much stronger he had become and couldn’t help but express their surprise.
“It’s nothing. I’ve just improved my strength a bit. Now, I’m equivalent to the level of Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror. According to the chat group’s evaluation, I’ve finally reached seven stars.”
Wang Ping waved his hand and said casually.
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, everyone present, except Chen Kang, showed surprised expressions.
A Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror – that was incredible!
Moreover, the chat group’s 7th-tier combat power evaluation meant he would be able to obliterate a medium-sized country in a short time, as exemplified by Fusang Country.”

chapters.title: Chapter 338: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_2
Translator: 549690339
Lin Yuanyuan didn’t speak. She had improved a lot, but she was still far from the Seven Star Tier.
It couldn’t be helped; the gap between each star tier was too large.
“Brother Wang, who has reached the seven-star level, should be able to get rid of this bizarre thing, right?”
Wu Jun said with anticipation.
“Not necessarily. This bizarre thing gives me a sense of unease.”
Wang Ping frowned as he spoke.
Then, he closed his eyes and said in his heart, “System, I want to continue with the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation starts, host has 12 remaining free simulation times.”
The system’s voice rang out, and a luminescent screen appeared with text floating up.
[Day 1: You went straight to Fog Mount and unleashed terrifying power in an attempt to destroy the mount. This time, your power was incredibly strong, and even the white fog defending the mountain began to be destroyed by you.]
[However, you didn’t manage to destroy the white fog, and a stalemate ensued. In the end, you were unable to destroy Fog Mount, and the mount couldn’t kill you either. Frustrated, you chose to retreat for the time being.]
[When Wu Jun and the others learned about this situation, they were at a loss for what to do. However, Lin Yuanyuan suggested that Wu Jun use his special ability to break the deadlock.]
[Despite feeling awkward, Wu Jun still chose to use his ability. Then, Chen Kang turned into a woman. Seeing this, you all fell completely silent, and Chen Kang was devastated. Indeed, although Wu Jun’s golden finger was outrageously powerful with an incredibly high limit, its low limit was just as ludicrous, making it highly unpredictable.]
[Afterward, you discussed strategies, and Lin Yuanyuan eventually proposed a daring suggestion. She wanted to sleep with you so that she could become stronger. By working together, the two of you might be able to defeat Fog Mount. You had a Rebirth Tally on you, so you should be able to come back to life.]
[Your eyelids twitched, never expecting Lin Yuanyuan to make such a proposal. However, this was indeed a possible solution, and your Rebirth Tally should work beyond the limits of Lin Yuanyuan’s power. If Lin Yuanyuan could become stronger, there was hope in destroying Fog Mount.]
[In the end, the two of you decided to become intimate. After the deed was done, Lin Yuanyuan used her power to drain you completely, killing you in the process. However, your Rebirth Tally failed to bring you back to life.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…..]
“That’s absurd.”
Wang Ping’s eyes filled with bewilderment.
Is the Rebirth Tally really that useless? Being killed by Lin Yuanyuan renders it unable to revive him.
Or is it that the Rebirth Tally, which cost 100,000 Group Points, is a shoddy product?
“Alpha, explain.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“The golden fingers you’ve awakened have varying strengths, but they are not that simple. Their power limit is equivalent to or even surpasses the bizarre entities. In this case, do you think a Rebirth Tally created using 100,000 Group Points could bring you back to life in the face of Lin Yuanyuan’s clearly lethal power?”
Alpha responded coldly and ruthlessly.
“Fine, I have nothing to say.”
Wang Ping fell silent.
It seemed that he had indeed guessed correctly.
The Rebirth Tally was useful, but not to that extent.
Considering its selling price in the chat group was 100,000, it was probably still just the price that Alpha needed to make a profit. Thinking about it further, the actual cost for Alpha was likely even lower.
“But, in that case, can’t you sell the Rebirth Tally at a lower price? Set some restrictions.”
Wang Ping suddenly came to his senses and said in his heart.
“The principle of the Rebirth Tally is to rewind time in a short period. Using it too many times can cause some problems, and requires more World Source to make up for the loopholes.”
Alpha explained coldly and ruthlessly.
“So you mean, regardless of whether it’s the Rebirth Tally or the revival mechanism in the chat group, each additional death would result in the Group Points required for the next revival to increase exponentially?”
Wang Ping stared, questioning in his heart.
“That’s correct,” Alpha replied.
“You should’ve made this clear. People in the group don’t know, and it could cause trouble if they die in the future.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
“Not telling them will let them feel more at ease. Otherwise, they will still be afraid of death.”
Alpha explained.
“By doing this, you’re more likely to cause accidents. Alpha, you really don’t understand human nature,” Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Alpha:
“Forget it, I won’t waste my breath with you.”
Wang Ping frowned tightly, pondering how to break through the situation.
Now, things were truly troublesome.
Even with the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror cultivation, he still couldn’t defeat the enemy; this was preposterous.
Could it be that he really needed to go back and increase his battle power first?
“Brother Wang, is it still not working?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s changing expressions, the others’ faces also shifted.
If even a 7th-Tier Battle Power wasn’t enough, this bizarre thing was simply too strong.
“Indeed, it’s not working.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“But, I’m thinking about one thing. Where is the main body of this bizarre entity? Could it really be within Fog Mount?”
After pausing for a moment, Wang Ping continued.
Bizarre entities had to possess an object from the current world.
Maybe that was their way of avoiding the world’s consciousness.
Therefore, their first priority for each task was to find the bizarre entity’s main body, which would count as half the battle won.
And now, they still had not found the bizarre entity’s main body, because Fog Mount had already died three times in a row, wasting three simulation chances…
The current situation seemed to be even more troublesome than before.
“Brother Wang, I have a suggestion.”
After staying quiet for a while, Lin Yuanyuan spoke up.
“What suggestion?”

chapters.title: Chapter 339: 137: Cultivation Soars! Killing the Strange _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: 137: Cultivation Soars! Killing the Strange _3
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping and the others looked over.
“Kill all the people in the world, spend the time to cleanse the surface, and flush him out.”
Lin Yuanyuan spoke coldly.
Upon hearing these words, Qin Tian’s pupils shrank, reminding him of the debate he once had with Zhang Jun about annihilating all of mankind.
Wu Jun’s complexion also shifted.
As for the siblings, Chen Kang and Chen Si, they turned even paler.
Annihilating all of mankind, was just too brutal.
“Anyway, it isn’t actually happening. No need to be overly concerned.”
Seeing that the others were frightened, Lin Yuanyuan quickly added.
“We can try.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he nodded in agreement.
As long as it could help reveal the oddity within the Life Simulator, any method was worth trying.
The consequences of mission failure weighed heavier than the mental toll elicited by the idea of carrying out such a monstrous act.
Immediately, Wang Ping closed his eyes again and initiated the free simulator.
“[On the first day, you launched your action. After giving yourself a mental suggestion, you prepared to begin the slaughter. You were about to launch an attack to destroy the Imperial City, but a large amount of white fog transferred from Fog Mountain, blocking your powerful strike, and preventing the city from being destroyed.]”
“[You were all astonished, not anticipating the oddity was concealed in the Imperial City. Especially for Lin Yuanyuan, it was enough to make her scalp tingle. The oddity hidden in the city — she didn’t notice until now — could jeopardize her life at any time.]”
“[Next, you started fighting with the oddity. You sensed that the white fog seemed to be weakening, perhaps due to your distance from Fog Mountain. Pleased by this discovery, you launched a fierce attack, fragmenting it.]”
“[However, what you didn’t expect happened. The people in the Imperial City unexpectedly transformed into fog and merged with the white fog, making it even stronger. During this process, Chen Kang, Chen Si, and Wu Jun were almost vaporized. You had prepared for this; ever since confronting the Charm Skill oddity, you didn’t allow things to enter your bodies or get into fights.]”
“[As a result, you warded off the invasion of the fog with an energy barrier and avoided transforming into the white fog.]”
“[However, the white fog became even stronger. Even if you successfully damaged the original form of the oddity and allowed Chen Si to weaken half of its combat power, the oddity was still incredibly strong and difficult to take down. You severely wounded it, but it restored itself by absorbing the fog.]”
“[This gave you a major headache. You wanted to borrow Lin Yuanyuan’s power to kill it, but it’s too powerful, and the host is a woman, making this method impossible.]”
“[At the end of the battle, most of your power was depleted. Although Chen Kang, under your leadership, also tried using his abilities to immobilize the oddity so that you could kill it again, you found this ineffective. Although the energy could imprison it, the fog was unrestricted and could still initiate attacks and defenses. Because of the large gap in power, the immobilization lasted for only a very short time, not even a tenth of a second.]”
“[In the end, you all were mercilessly killed by the fog oddity one by one, failing to defeat it.]”
“[Because of your death, this simulation ends.]”
“Did we die again? Well, at least we gained something this time.”
Wang Ping, looking at the simulation content, revealed a smile.
“Mr.Wang, how did it go?”
Seeing Wang Ping smiling, everyone couldn’t help but have a glint of hope in their eyes.
“We have finally caught his original body. However, you guys wait a moment.”
Wang Ping said.
After these words, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, the view changed, and he found himself in a different place.
In this place, the Imperial City had long disappeared, leaving only a bottomless pit.
In the sky, both parties were in fierce battle.
One party was naturally Wang Ping, and the other was a beautiful woman dressed in a green robe.
After staring deeply at the woman in the green robe, his vision returned to normal when the simulation Wang Ping died.
“Where is the original body of the oddity?”
Lin Yuanyuan hurriedly asked.
Facing the irrational oddity, she had no sense of security at all and just wanted to quickly find and eliminate it.
“The oddity…. is hiding in the Imperial City…”
Wang Ping stared at Lin Yuanyuan strangely and said.
At these words, Lin Yuanyuan’s face immediately froze.
Qin Tian directly spat out the sip of Spirit Tea in his mouth, staring at Wang Ping in disbelief.
Wu Jun’s face twitched, looking at Lin Yuanyuan pitifully.
Chen Kang and Chen Si looked at each other, realizing the severity of the problem.
“It’s actually in the Imperial City…” Lin Yuanyuan murmured, her face paling.
It was just too shocking. It implied that the oddity could kill her at any given moment.
“No, if it’s in the Imperial City, why didn’t it attack me?”
Lin Yuanyuan asked aloud, confused.
“It’s probably ‘fishing’, waiting for us to come over. Or perhaps summoning the white fog from Fog Mount had a cost.”
Wang Ping speculated.
“But, this isn’t the time to talk. There might be her insiders in the court, and our arrival is already exposed. Qin Tian, start the formation and encase the entire Imperial City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 137: Cultivation Soars! Killing the Strange _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 137: Cultivation Soars! Killing the Strange _4
Translator: 549690339
As Wang Ping chatted, he had been constantly spreading out his Spiritual Sense, keeping an eye on the mysterious, naturally noticing some faint white fog stealthily appearing, spreading in their direction. He looked at Qin Tian and calmly issued an order.
Here, Qin Tian was the most knowledgeable about Array Mana.
Wang Ping had always wanted to learn Array Mana, but unfortunately, he had no chance. He couldn’t refresh his talents related to it and couldn’t learn advanced Array Mana.
“Leave it to me.”
Qin Tian grinned, pulling out an Array Plate directly.
In an instant, the Array Plate started to operate, dozens of special flags turned into streams of light and descended to various parts of the Imperial City, gradually forming an extremely powerful Great Array.
Even Wang Ping, looking at the Great Array, revealed an astonished expression.
This Great Array was very profound, and Wang Ping felt that even with his current strength, breaking it would take quite an effort.
That is to say, cultivators in the Profound Elixir Realm had almost no chance of breaking it, and its defense force was undoubtedly very formidable.
“This is something I got from my Master, even a Primordial Infant Peak cultivator using a powerful magical treasure would have difficulty breaking it.”
Seeing Wang Ping’s surprise, Qin Tian proudly said.
“Your Master is really good to you.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Lin Yuanyuan, Wu Jun, and Chen Si all nodded enviously.
Chen Kang also sighed, saying that there are really many powerful people in their group.
“Of course. However, I feel that I need to wait until those masters come out of their retreats before I can fleece them.”
Qin Tian licked his lips, itching to take action.
“Those masters’ cultivation levels are not lower than God Transformation Stage, there must be many good things on them.”
Wang Ping and the others all rolled their eyes.
Qin Tian was really lucky, he had joined the deep-rooted Thunder Realm Holy Land, and he had many treasures on him.
It was just that this time they were dealing with the powerful strangeness, otherwise, in ordinary situations, he could probably handle it.
As the Array was unfolding, the fog no longer concealed anything. The strangeness knew that it had been exposed and quickly spread over, gradually covering the entire city, rolling towards Wang Ping’s side.
Regarding this, Wang Ping calmly used his strong Spiritual Essence to form a barrier around himself and the others. Then he addressed Qin Tian: “Qin Tian, Lin Yuanyuan, protect Wu Jun, Chen Si, and Chen Kang.”
“Chen Si, Chen Kang, use your abilities when I give the command.”
As soon as these words fell, Wang Ping burst out with a Terrifying Skill, directly dispelled the surrounding white fog, and soared into the sky.
Qin Tian also calmly took out another Array Plate.
This time, it was not a trapping array but a defensive one, with a smaller range but stronger defense. Even a Primordial Infant Peak cultivator could not break it.
According to his Master’s words, this was a good thing left by their ancestors during their retreat.
It was just that Qin Tian’s cultivation level was too low, if it was his Master controlling the Array Plate, even ordinary God Transformation Realm cultivators would have to exert a lot of effort to break it.
As Wang Ping soared into the sky, the mysterious fog also flew up, looking at Wang Ping with some surprise, and asked: “How did you discover me?”
“You don’t need to know.”
Wang Ping said coldly.
Although in the last simulation, they were still defeated, and could only force their hands against the strangeness this time, Wang Ping wouldn’t be defeated so quickly.
Therefore, he could simulate and look for chances to win while fighting.
Apart from that, Wang Ping had many methods to deal with the strangeness.
After all, in simulation, many means couldn’t be used.
But in reality, it was different, as all kinds of means could be used.
That is to say, if they could catch the real body of the strangeness, their chances of success would be much higher.
Of course, if possible, Wang Ping didn’t want to see such a situation again.
Just after arriving in this world, he was observed by the strangeness, which made him very uncomfortable.
“Hehe, it doesn’t matter if you don’t say it, you’re going to die anyway.”
The mysterious fog sneered and chose to take action.
In an instant, everyone in the entire Imperial City who had been shrouded in white fog turned into white fog, making it extremely dense.
Then, this white fog rolled towards Wang Ping.
Wang Ping snorted coldly, condensed a sword in his hand, slashed out with Sword Spirit, and tore a part of the white fog.
However, the mysterious fog’s power really was above Wang Ping’s. Wang Ping hadn’t completely torn it apart and had to make another move.
“Chen Si, take action.”
Wang Ping shouted.
As Wang Ping gave the command, Chen Si directly used his ability, forcibly reducing the combat power of the mysterious fog by half.
Noticing that her power had dropped by half, the face of the mysterious fog changed slightly, and she glared at Chen Si intently.
Then, she snorted coldly, and the fog surged, unexpectedly condensing into eerie Fog Beasts, attacking Chen Si.
However, these Fog Beasts, though powerful, ultimately couldn’t reach the level of 7th-Tier Combat Power. With the protection of Qin Tian’s defensive array, Qin Tian and Chen Si wouldn’t be harmed for the time being.
Seeing this, the mysterious fog became even more unhappy.
“Do you think you can kill me by weakening half of my combat power? Na?ve.”
Mysterious fog said to Wang Ping, launching a more violent attack. The white fog swept in, transforming into various weapons, and attacked Wang Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_5
Translator: 549690339
In response, Wang Ping was equally unwilling to show weakness, condensing various long swords, bursting out the Great Perfection Sword Intent, and using the momentum of All Swords Return to the Sect to confront his opponent.
At the same time, Wang Ping also started a new simulation.
[You fight against the fog’s strange, you are not its match, and you deliberately hide your combat power, getting injured by the strange. At the same time, you make Chen Kang suddenly become stronger, greatly extending the binding time. You cooperate with Qin Tian and Chen Kang to catch the strange off guard, and eventually kill it.]
[You successfully complete the task and leave this world.]
[Because you leave this world, the simulation ends.]
…
“I was guessing that there might be a possibility that it’s just a clone, but it seems I was overthinking.”
Wang Ping’s eyes gleamed, and the corners of his mouth curled up slightly.
There were many methods he could think of to kill the fog’s strange, but this was the most cost-effective one, and he didn’t expect to succeed just with this method.
The opponent was smart and knew to separate their ability and body to squat and fish for Lin Yuanyuan, which might also bring out more life-saving means.
And the clone was one of the common means.
Now it seems that either the opponent doesn’t have this ability, or they were caught off guard, directly sealing the city with an array, too far away from Fog Mount, and many methods couldn’t be used.
Regardless, the advantage lies with me.
Immediately, Wang Ping sent a message to Qin Tian and Chen Kang in his heart.
He asked Qin Tian to transfer 100,000 group points to Chen Kang first, letting him strengthen and prolong the binding time, then suddenly bind the strange, and cooperate with him to kill it.
Upon receiving Wang Ping’s instructions, the two naturally obeyed and began the operation without hesitation.
Soon, Chen Kang’s aura began to rise rapidly.
“That guy suddenly became stronger. However, even if he becomes a little stronger, he is still just a weakling.”
The strange in the fog noticed Chen Kang’s change and narrowed his eyes.
Of course, although he thought Chen Kang was a weakling, his ability was still worth being vigilant about, so he put some attention on Chen Kang.
“However, I must first deal with this most troublesome guy.”
The strange in the fog looked at Wang Ping and launched a fiercer attack.
In response, Wang Ping always pretended to be unable to resist, being forced by the strange’s fierce attack into a very embarrassing situation, even coughing up blood from time to time.
This made the strange in the fog feel secure.
Even if its combat power was reduced by half, the strongest combat power on the other side was still not its match.
“Qin Tian, make your move first! Then, Chen Kang will use his ability in the back.”
Just when the strange in the fog became somewhat careless, Wang Ping seized this opportunity and sent a message to Qin Tian and Chen Kang.
In response, Qin Tian took out a talisman, aimed it at the fog’s strange, and directly burned his blood essence to activate it.
Qin Tian’s hair turned white at a visible speed, but the talisman burst into strong light, with a terrifying skill emerging on it.
This caught the attention of the strange in the fog.
Although Qin Tian’s prepared attack wouldn’t hurt it, it would definitely cause some trouble.
If it were an ordinary time, it wouldn’t care, but during the battle with a strong enemy, it needed to be cautious.
Of course, this was only an observation.
Just as Qin Tian completely activated the talisman, transforming it into a purple lightning dragon roaring towards the strange, the strange moved, controlling a part of the fog to block in this direction.
But just then, Chen Kang suddenly used his ability to selectively bind the strange in the fog.
This caused the strange’s expression to stiffen, showing an astonished look, as if it hadn’t expected to be bound by such weaklings.
On the other side, Wang Ping showed his fangs.
Without any hesitation, he activated his spiritual body and entered the berserk state.
Even in order to be more stable, Wang Ping directly burned his blood essence, used a secret skill, and raised his strength even higher.
Immediately afterward, he burst out with the strongest move in the Blood Devil Nine Shadow Sword – nine blood-colored shadow swords slashed towards the strange in the fog one after another.
“Not good!”
The strange in the fog changed its expression, trying to turn into fog and blend into the white fog.
However, to its horror, it found that in its bound state, it couldn’t even use this strongest life-saving trump card.
For a moment, it felt somewhat desperate and could only watch the scorching sun-like sword spirit fall with wide-open eyes.
Although the strange in the fog also frantically gathered fog to defend itself at the critical moment, Wang Ping’s timing was too clever, as his fatal blow exploded the instant it was bound, and it couldn’t block it at all.
In the end, amid the despair, the strange in the fog was completely engulfed by Wang Ping’s sword spirit, its body torn apart by the sword intent in an instant, and finally burned to ashes by the terrifying high temperature.
“Ding, the strange in the fog is dead, the group task is complete, the reward has been distributed separately, group members can claim their rewards on the group reward page.”
“Ding, the group task is complete, members can silently chant in their hearts to return, and then return to their own world. If they don’t return within 24 hours, the system will forcibly return them to their original world.”
Just as the strange in the fog turned into ashes, the voice of the chat group system resounded in the ears of the crowd, making Wang Ping and the others smile.
This time, although it was a bit risky, it was also relatively lucky, and nothing unexpected happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: 137: Cultivation Surges! Slaying the Bizarre_6
Translator: 549690339
“Wang is really powerful!”
Qin Tian excitedly said.
“No, everyone did a great job.”
Wang Ping returned to Qin Tian and the others, laughing lightly.
“Eh, I didn’t do anything… does this count as getting 200,000 group points for free?”
Wu Jun touched his face, and said with some subtlety.
“I didn’t do anything either, even though this is my world. Even more, I was targeted by the anomaly and almost brought down the whole team.”
Lin Yuanyuan also sighed.
“That’s true, it was a bit off. So, if a traveler can keep a low profile, they should. Being the Empress is fun, but it also makes you an obvious target and easily found by others. Even if you are the strongest person in this world, anomalies or other beings from the outer world can easily discover your uniqueness.”
Wang Ping nodded, not indulging Lin Yuanyuan, and spoke objectively.
“I understand.” Lin Yuanyuan smiled helplessly.
She just had the impulse to try being the Empress and relied on her martial skill to rise to power.
Who would have thought that she would be targeted by the anomaly? It was quite frustrating.
“Alright, since the task is completed, everyone can go back to their own worlds.”
After Wang Ping said this with a smile, he chose to return and turned into a white light, disappearing.
Qin Tian, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun also said their goodbyes and chose to return to their original worlds.
Upon Chen Kang’s return, Zhang Jun was shocked, his gaze becoming strange. He didn’t expect Chen Kang to come back so quickly.
For a moment, Zhang Jun felt that the group task seemed very easy.
Then, he asked Chen Kang about it.
Chen Kang, of course, wouldn’t hide anything. Although he doesn’t know many details, he roughly knew the process and briefly recounted it.
After listening, Zhang Jun’s face twitched.
“Good lord, the anomaly actually started to target people? That’s outrageous. Thankfully Wang’s strength has soared to seven stars, and Chen Si and Chen Kang helped, plus Qin Tian’s contribution was not small either. Otherwise, it really might have ended badly.”
Zhang Jun grumbled in his heart.
It should be said that the task was completed quickly this time, even faster than the zombie anomaly incident, but it was also quite dangerous. With Wang’s Golden Finger here, they could suddenly be wiped out.
Therefore, although Zhang Jun envied Chen Kang and the others for getting a lot of group points, he also felt that when dealing with the anomaly, it was better not to go unless they became the top combatants in the group or gained any special abilities.
“Maybe I can save up points and redraw a Golden Finger.”
Zhang Jun couldn’t help but think so.
Although his telekinesis was not weak, it was much weaker compared to the other group members’ Golden Fingers.
So, he really wanted to change it.
In fact, he had already decided to change it, and he was just waiting to accumulate enough group points.
“Chen Kang, how many group points did you get this time?”
Zhang Jun couldn’t help but ask.
“Oh, I just received the group red envelope, and it said I got 400,000 group points. However, I owe Qin Tian 100,000 group points, and I also repaid my sister 200,000, so I only have 100,000 left now.”
Chen Kang honestly answered.
“Damn!”
Zhang Jun went silent.
They got 400,000 group points in one go, and Chen Kang wasn’t even the one with the most contribution.
Now, battling the anomaly in the chat group seemed to be much more profitable than he thought!
Not only was Zhang Jun surprised, but all the others in the chat group who heard about the task process were amazed.
This time was too quick and thrilling.
In addition, the group points earned by those who participated in the task were very enviable.
Chen Si, 400,000 Group Points.
Qin Tian, 400,000 Group Points.
Lin Yuanyuan, the guaranteed reward, 200,000 group points.
Wu Jun, the guaranteed reward, 200,000 group points.
This harvest was extremely substantial, even more than any other time before.
If they had a few more of these, wouldn’t it be easy to optimize or change their Golden Fingers?
Of course, using the points to directly enhance their strength would also be thrillingly delightful.
While the group was in heated discussion about group points and guessing how many group points Wang Ping got, Wang Ping returned to the Purple Spirit Realm and didn’t immediately open the chat group. Instead, he focused on healing himself.
After all, he had been injured this time, and burning Blood Essence was no small harm to him.
“I shouldn’t burn Blood Essence so easily. It takes precious heavenly materials and earthly treasures to replenish it.”
Wang Ping sighed after finishing his healing, still feeling weak.
After raising his cultivation with the help of the bug, his Profound Elixir reached a flawless quality. However, he didn’t seem to possess the Nirvana Skill that comes after swallowing a Nirvana Fruit.
As a result, the damage from burning his Blood Essence was quite significant.
