If he had the Nirvana Skill, perhaps the side effects wouldn’t be so great.
“Nirvana Fruit, this thing, when taken at the time of breaking through to the Nirvana Boundary, can display its full effect. Only then can one perfectly achieve Nirvana and step into the Nirvana Boundary.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but take out the Nirvana Fruit and mumble.
“So I still have to keep it unused.”
Wang Ping shook his head and put it away.
Then, he opened his chat group page and chose to open the red envelope.
At that moment, Wang Ping received a reward of one million group points.
Seeing he got so many group points, Wang Ping’s first reaction was not joy, but silence.
After a few seconds, Wang Ping twitched his face and said in his heart: “Alpha, just how many group points have you been hiding from us before? Or maybe my assumption of a 19% share was wrong.”
As for Wang Ping’s question, Alpha didn’t respond.
Wang Ping was speechless, feeling that Alpha was acting guilty.
However, Wang Ping couldn’t say much about it.
Although Alpha had given him a lot of authority, he was still his boss. He could get cheeky with his boss, but being overly dominant would surely cause problems.
As a result, Wang Ping could only console himself that Alpha was already becoming more generous, and he couldn’t blame him too much, or else Alpha might revert to his old ways.
Wang Ping got rid of his distracting thoughts and then spoke up in the group chat.
Wang Ping (66): “See, I told you that the rewards for dealing with the anomaly would be substantial in the future, so there’s no need to be afraid. Of course, dealing with the anomaly still requires gathering the high-end combat skills or special abilities of the group, and group members with insufficient strength won’t be allowed to go in the future.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Uh, I always feel like Wang is giving us a pie in the sky. But, this pie smells pretty good.”
Chen Yao (71): “I’m curious, how many group points did you get, Wang?”
Wang Ping (66): “Not much, just a million. So, in the future, the high-end combatants in the group need to be more active, and there will be lots of group points. Seductive.jpg.”

chapters.title: Chapter 343: 138: A Hundred Dynasties Battle Show Splendor! Fame Spreads Throughout Eastern Desolation
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: 138: A Hundred Dynasties Battle Show Splendor! Fame Spreads Throughout Eastern Desolation
Translator: 549690339
Fang Yun (3): “Holy shit, one million group points, that’s enough for me to buy a Golden Finger Optimizer. So envious!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Sour, sour, lemon essence.jpg.”
Chen Yao (1): “It seems that we still need to actively participate in tasks. The cost-effectiveness of dealing with the eerie has finally gone up.”
Wang Ping looked at the lively chat group and nodded in satisfaction before closing the chat group page.
He just needed to add fuel to the fire, there was no need for further provocation.
After all, everyone was not a fool, and they all had their own ideas.
“Speaking of which, Alpha, why do I feel like you’re still robbing us of points this time?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and said to Alpha in his heart.
This time, the eerie opponent had grown to a Seven Star Tier level, and even he, who had reached the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, was not its match, let alone needing teammates to assist in victory.
With this level of difficulty, even if it were fighting against someone who had reincarnated, there should be this kind of reward, right?
“Ding, you have received an additional reward of one million group points.”
Alpha did not speak, but the sound of the chat group system rang out.
Wang Ping was speechless.
Damn, it really was like that.
Just how valuable was this eerie thing?
How many group points had Alpha been hiding from them before?
Could it be that his guess of a 19-percent share was wrong, and this guy was actually doing a 1:99 split?
“Forget it, I can’t be bothered with you.”
Wang Ping opened his mouth, wanting to despise Alpha, but he sighed instead.
He was now on the same side as Alpha, receiving more benefits than other group members, and had no right to comment on anything.
“Now I have four million group points, I wonder if I can upgrade my 1st-tier Yin power to Pure Yin power.”
Wang Ping wondered in his heart.
“It’s possible. However, like upgrading a 1st-tier Profound Elixir to a Flawless Profound Elixir, it will also require two million group points.”
Alpha’s voice rang out.
“Well then, forget it, I’ll wait.”
Wang Ping pursed his lips.
Two million points for just a Yin power, it’s too expensive, and he couldn’t bear it.
So, he might as well continue to exploit the life simulator’s bug.
“System, how many spirit stones do I need to spend now for the paid simulation?”
After Wang Ping cleared his thoughts, he asked in his heart.
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror. The number of Top-tier Spirit Stones required for paid simulation is 20,000.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Wang Ping’s face twitched a little.
Well, it’s another four-fold increase.
However, considering the magnitude of his cultivation improvement, it seems that only four times more is already a good outcome.
Of course, the system limited the use of top-tier spirit stones.
That is to say, only Top-tier Spirit Stones can be used for simulation now.
Top-tier Spirit Stones were a rarity on Sacred Heart Island.
So, he was finally going to leave for the Eastern Desolation.
“I’ve always wanted the secret skill to conceal my aura, but I haven’t chosen that reward yet.”
Wang Ping smiled helplessly.
It just means that there were too many rewards for him to choose from, and he always missed the secret skill.
Of course, sometimes the secret skill reward didn’t show up, which was also a problem.
While Wang Ping was considering whether to have a free simulation before heading to Eastern Desolation, he sensed a familiar person visiting him.
It was Bing Ningyue.
“It seems Miss Bing has comprehended the Great Perfection Ice Spirit, congratulations.”
Looking at Bing Ningyue who walked over, Wang Ping’s eyes flashed, and he said with a smile.
“It’s all thanks to fellow Taoist for giving me the Four-Leaf White Jade Flower that I was able to comprehend the Great Perfection Ice Spirit.”
A smile appeared on the cold face of Bing Ningyue, and she spoke softly.
“I wonder what Miss Bing is here for this time?”
Wang Ping didn’t continue to be polite, and asked curiously.
“In fact, the Ice Palace on the Sacred Heart Island is only a branch of the Ice Palace in the Eastern Desolation. In two months, I’ll go to the real Ice Palace and probably won’t return to Sacred Heart Island. So, I came to bid you farewell.”
Bing Ningyue said seriously.
“If you encounter any troubles in the future, you can come to the Ice Palace to find me, and I will do my best to help you.”
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded, not rejecting Bing Ningyue’s kindness.
After all, he knew from the simulations that he would indeed be troubling Bing Ningyue for some matters.
“Fellow Taoist Wang, I’ve always been puzzled as to why a genius like you would choose to live in seclusion on Sacred Heart Island instead of joining those Holy Lands. With your talent, even if you were to join Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you could easily become an inner sect disciple and perhaps even be considered a quasi-true disciple in the future.”
Bing Ningyue hesitated for a moment, but still asked curiously.
“Who said I don’t have the idea of joining a Holy Land? When the time is right, I will naturally join Heavenly Sword Divine Land.”
Wang Ping smiled faintly, speaking calmly.
Although the Heavenly Sword Saint Master had used him as a pawn before, if he could safely join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, he would definitely not miss the opportunity.
However, he needed a chance.
Only when he refreshes a powerful talent that can conceal his identity as a person from outside the domain, or obtains a great opportunity that can conceal his aura, will he go.
Otherwise, even if he goes, it would just be sending himself to his death.
“I see.”
Bing Ningyue nodded thoughtfully, without the intention to keep asking.
After that, the two stopped chatting and began discussing Tao instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: 138: The Grand Battle of Hundred Dynasties Shows Greatness! Fame Spreads Across East Wasteland_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: 138: The Grand Battle of Hundred Dynasties Shows Greatness! Fame Spreads Across East Wasteland_2
Translator: 549690339
What amazed Bing Ningyue was that Wang Ping also had a deep understanding of the Ice Path and had similarly realized the Great Perfection Realm of Ice Spirit. This made Bing Ningyue even more curious about Wang Ping.
At such a young age, he had realized multiple Great Perfection Realm of Conception, and his cultivation had reached the Profound Elixir Realm…
For a loose cultivator to achieve this was truly astonishing.
After a long time, Bing Ningyue gained a lot and, after expressing gratitude to Wang Ping, slowly left.
“Mr. Wang, I think she’s already fallen for you.”
Cai Yonglong approached and said after Bing Ningyue left.
“She’s just a little curious and interested in me; it’s still far from love.”
Wang Ping glanced at him and calmly said.
“Well, curiosity is the beginning of falling in love. Mr. Wang, you don’t understand women.”
Cai Yonglong sighed.
“Discussing this is pointless. Instead of that, Cai Yonglong, your chance may come soon, a great opportunity that can directly elevate you to the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection in a short period.”
Wang Ping sneered and changed the subject, speaking meaningfully.
“Adoptive father, what do you mean?”
Cai Yonglong’s spirits lifted, and he excitedly looked at Wang Ping, even calling him his adoptive father directly.
He couldn’t help it; he was too eager to become stronger.
“You guy, really have no dignity, adopting any father who pays your bills.”
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and complained.
“What’s the big deal? Men, whoever treats them is their adoptive father, let alone such a big opportunity.”
Cai Yonglong chuckled.
“True, it’s always like this in the dorm.”
Wang Ping muttered nostalgically.
“Mr. Wang, please tell me more about this opportunity?”
Cai Yonglong excitedly asked.
“About this opportunity….”
Wang Ping, stroking his chin, recounted the incidents from the Life Simulator.
“Damn! Master Empowerment, 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir, have I taken off?”
Cai Yonglong was excited.
“You’re not taking off.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes and complained.
“That will happen in ten years. Are you sure that if you go now, the Master will empower you?”
“Err….”
Cai Yonglong was speechless.
Indeed, in ten years, the Master would be on the verge of passing away.
If they went now, while the Master still had ten years to live, they might not choose to empower Cai Yonglong, but instead kill them and possess their bodies.
Although for someone who had already performed Body Possession once, performing it again would mean they were no longer their original selves and would fall into chaos, at least they could still dominate with a Master’s personality.
“However, whether it will succeed or not, we’ll know after trying.”
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and spoke.
He now desperately needed Spiritual Stones.
However, obtaining a large number of Top-tier Spiritual Stones was not easy; even if he went to Heavenly Sea Country to sell 7 or 8-tier Elixirs using Alchemy, he still wouldn’t be able to amass enough Top-tier Spiritual Stones for multiple simulations in a short period.
So, going to the Black Light Valley in the Black Element Country – where the Master resided – was the best choice.
If that Master was indeed broad-minded, then they would be in luck.
Once Cai Yonglong obtained the Master’s inheritance, he would acquire a large number of Spiritual Stones, and Wang Ping could naturally conduct simulations with those Spiritual Stones.
Of course, going to the Black Element Country, a major power, was not an easy task and would require the use of a Delivery Array.
If they relied on their own flying, although it could be done, it would still take a lot of time.
Doing so, making such a long journey, would be somewhat dangerous.
Of course, using the Delivery Array, without a Secret Skill to conceal their aura, would expose them instantly and cause trouble.
“It’s a bit troublesome.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly and muttered.
It seemed that he now had to refresh the Secret Skill rewards related to concealing his aura.
Otherwise, he would be exposed instantly and subsequently hunted down.
Though with his current strength, he was already capable of defeating ordinary Yin and Yang Masters, encountering more powerful ones in the Yin and Yang Realm would still be troublesome.
As for encountering a Life and Death Realm Master, needless to say, he would be an easy target.
“It seems that I can’t be too hasty. I have to gather 20,000 Top-tier Spiritual Stones for a simulation first, and refresh the rewards for Secret Skills before deciding.”
Wang Ping silently thought in his heart.
Then, he closed his eyes, preparing for a free simulation to test the waters first.
Seeing Wang Ping closing his eyes, Cai Yonglong naturally didn’t bother him and chose to wait quietly.
“System, I want to conduct a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The sound of the system echoed, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged as well.
[Day One, you chose cultivation.]
[Two years later, due to not needing to increase your cultivation, you can spend more time comprehending Divine Skills. As a result, you quickly comprehend your Lower-tier Divine Skill: Nine Shadow Sunrays, and your strength soars. However, this time, you didn’t trigger the unstable Evolution Device, and your Divine Skill wasn’t improved. Also, your Secret Skill hasn’t been improved.]
[You feel a bit uncomfortable thinking that the Secret Skill to conceal your aura hasn’t been improved. Because, without the Secret Skill, you’ll have to wait for Ye Chen to obtain it before you can get it. However, by then, that Master would have already passed away, and you wouldn’t be able to test in advance if he would choose to empower Cai Yonglong.]
[In the end, after thinking it over, you decide to first take Cai Yonglong and Ye Chen to Heavenly Sea Country, perhaps gaining some opportunities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 345: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shines Bright! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shines Bright! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_3
Translator: 549690339
[As it turns out, your decision was right. When the three of you arrived in Heavenly Sea Country, Cai Yonglong noticed that the opportunity line on Ye Chen had changed. Following Ye Chen’s opportunity line, you successfully found the place where a Yin and Yang Master had passed away. There were no more spiritual stones or treasures in his Storage Ring, as he had obviously converted all his possessions into resources to break through.]
[However, you were delighted to find that there were not only two Lower-tier Treasures in his Storage Ring, but also some Cultivation Skills and Secret Skills. The Cultivation Skills were only Heavenly Mid-grade, which you didn’t care for, but they could still be exchanged for Spiritual Stones. More importantly, the secret skill you needed was among them, which could hide your auras and make it impossible for cultivators below the Nirvana Realm to detect your presence.]
[You have a strong suspicion that this opportunity is the one Ye Chen gained in your memory. You started studying the secret skill and cultivating.]
[In the end, you successfully concealed your auras. However, just as you were about to leave, you were targeted by a powerful Yin-Yang Mirror Demon Beast. In the end, you barely killed it at the cost of a Rebirth tally.]
[You recall Ye Chen’s ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ destiny and know that the conditions to easily kill you have appeared again in Heavenly Sea Country. You realize you can no longer stay with Ye Chen.]
[So, you chose to part ways with Ye Chen, leaving him to cultivate on his own. You and Cai Yonglong exchanged Spiritual Stones and headed to the Black Element Country.]
“Goodness, has Ye Chen started again? He’s really a ticking time bomb.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
Hey, speaking of that, wouldn’t Bing Ningyue, or later Ji Bingyue, be killed by Ye Chen’s fate?
It’s really possible….
“Forget it, no need to think too much. As my strength increases, the truth will naturally be revealed.”
Wang Ping shook his head, cast aside the distracting thoughts and continued to look at the luminescent screen, wondering if he would receive a divine initiation this time.
[You were lucky not to encounter any Nirvana Realm Masters on your way to Black Element Country and successfully arrived at Black Light Valley. However, to be on the safe side, you didn’t enter it, and Cai Yonglong went in alone.]
[Eventually, the Life and Death Realm Master felt that Cai Yonglong was a good seed and still chose to bestow initiation upon him. In just three months, Cai Yonglong became a Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection Cultivator.]
[At this, you sighed in your heart, thinking that this Master was quite generous. After all, most people wouldn’t bestow initiation as the cost was too great. Not to mention, they were only ten years away from death, so initiating others was even less likely.]
“He actually received the initiation.”
Wang Ping was astonished as he watched the simulation content.
“Cai Yonglong, you lucky fellow.”
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and teased.
“Uh, did it succeed?”
Cai Yonglong was stunned and then asked excitedly.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded.
This made Cai Yonglong ecstatic, murmuring: “Thank you, my never-met Master, for giving me hope to become the top powerhouse in the chatting group. Once I grow stronger, I will repay you properly. When I become a big shot in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, I will revive you.”
“Wow, you haven’t even met the person yet, and you’re already making such grand promises. Quite impressive.”
Wang Ping gave Cai Yonglong a strange look and teased him.
“Cough, cough, I’m just happy, you know.” Cai Yonglong coughed.
Wang Ping shook his head with a smile and continued to watch the luminescent screen.
After all, this simulation still hadn’t ended yet.
[Next, you debated where to go. You no longer considered going to the Eternal Frozen Land. Since you have already broken through to Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror, there is no need to go there. As for Cai Yonglong, it’s not impossible to find 3rd Tier or even 2nd Tier Yin power in the Sword Domain.]
[In the end, you decided to first search for opportunities in Black Element Country to see if you could find 3rd Tier Yin power to help Cai Yonglong break through or even 2nd Tier Yin power. Besides that, you also wanted to find 1st-tier Yang Power to reach the Yin-Yang Mirror realm. Once you reach the Yin-Yang Mirror, you will truly become a Yin-Yang Master, and your power will rise once again.]
[In a blink of an eye, ten years passed. In those ten years, you found many opportunities, allowing Cai Yonglong to successfully use 3rd Tier Yin power to break through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Realm. Also, during an opportunity, you accidentally acquired a Lower-tier Treasure Sword, which triggered the Optimization Option. You chose to optimize it and surprisingly, it was successfully optimized into a Mid-tier Treasure.]
[However, while searching for opportunities, you inevitably attracted the attention of some powerful beings. Among them was a Nirvana Realm Master, who spotted something unusual about you and Cai Yonglong. In the end, he noticed the Profound Turtle Spirit in you.]
[Fortunately, this Nirvana Realm Master of Black Element Country didn’t see people with Profound Turtle Spirit as enemies. On the contrary, he valued you and thought you were talents worth shaping. He hoped that you could participate in the Hundred Dynasties War in more than twenty years on behalf of Black Element Country.]
[Although you knew that your identity would be exposed if you participated in the Hundred Dynasties War, you had no choice but to agree as you were found by a Nirvana Realm Master. At the same time, you also hoped that your current talent had improved, so the Heavenly Sword Saint Master would no longer treat you as a pawn and let you join the Holy Land to become a True Inheritor Disciple of the Holy Land.]

chapters.title: Chapter 346: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shines Bright! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shines Bright! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_4
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, more than 20 years passed. During these 20 years, this Nirvana Realm Master often taught you about cultivation, and you made significant progress as a result. Especially you, who successfully grasped your mid-tier divine skill: Eclipse.]
[Finally, the time for the Hundred Dynasties War arrived. You were escorted by the Nirvana Realm Master of Black Element Country to the Heavenly Sword Divine City. The higher-ups of Black Element Country and this Nirvana Realm Master were looking forward to the beginning of the Hundred Dynasties War. They believed that with you participating, you would achieve at least the top five. They even thought, contending for the first place was not impossible.]
[After all, in the previous Hundred Dynasties War, geniuses who congealed Immaculate Profound Elixirs were rare, let alone those congealing 1st-tier Profound Elixirs. Yet, not only did you congeal an Immaculate Profound Elixir, but you also broke through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with the 1st-tier Yin power. Your comprehension and talent were such that few among the young generation of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land could match.]
[At the same time, the Nirvana Realm Master of Black Element Country felt somewhat regretful. Black Element Country, although a major power, had neither the strength nor the resources to obtain a 1st-tier Yang Power for you. If they could have obtained a 1st-tier Yang Power for you to break through to the Yin-Yang Mirror in these decades, then you would surely be crowned the champion, completely shocking the entire Sword Domain and even Eastern Desolation and become the leading figure among the young geniuses of Eastern Desolation.]
[After you arrived at the Heavenly Sword Divine City, you met Bing Ningyue again, who had since been renamed Ji Bingyue by the Ice Palace. You knew that this was the surname of the Ice Emperor and Profound Ice Emperor, and perhaps also the real name of Bing Ningyue.]
[Next, you talked and drank merrily with her, catching up on past events. By that time, Ji Bingyue was astonished at the great changes in you and Cai Yonglong. As you were reminiscing, Ye Chen also arrived here and joined your conversation.]
[The four of you gathered at one table, drinking and chatting with great pleasure. In the end, Ye Chen said that the top three of this Hundred Dynasties War would likely be determined from among you. This statement didn’t go unnoticed and aroused the dissatisfaction of many geniuses in the tavern.]
[One genius snorted coldly, releasing an aura of Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, pressing down on Ye Chen, thinking he was arrogant and in need of a lesson. To this, Ye Chen casually slapped him away, shocking everyone.]
[Seeing this scene, you and Cai Yonglong were at a loss for words. The Son of Fortune was always the Son of Fortune, and no matter where he went, he couldn’t help but attract attention and conflict. Ye Chen truly went further and further down this path.]
[Soon after, the humiliated genius warned you all not to be too complacent, as his brother was the Number One Genius of the Hundred Dynasties Sword Realm and had reached Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror. He would surely suppress all of you.]
[Ye Chen remained calm and slapped him away again. You and Cai Yonglong were speechless. This development felt all too familiar.]
[Before long, the Hundred Dynasties War began. The four of you easily advanced to the third round. During the third round, perhaps due to some fate, you met Ling Xue again.]
[However, this time was completely different from what you remembered. With a casual gesture, you defeated her, leaving the other geniuses present astonished. Ling Xue felt both discouraged and admiring of you.]
[Next, you continued to defeat your opponents, no one could match you. You easily earned a place in the top 16, shocking the Sword Domain’s many experts and geniuses. You also caught the attention of the King Realm Master who presided over the Heavenly Sword Divine Land competition, who rated you, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue highly. As for Cai Yonglong, he was placed in the next tier.]
[During the top 16 matches, you faced the prince who claimed to be the Number One Genius of the Hundred Dynasties Sword Realm. He congealed a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir, and broke through to Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with 3rd Tier Yin power. However, though he was powerful, he was no match for you, and you defeated him with a single strike.]
[This defeated opponent shocked many experts and geniuses in the Sword Domain, who had not expected you to be so strong. Additionally, Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue defeated their opponents effortlessly, displaying a calm demeanor. Cai Yonglong, with slightly weaker strength, met a strong foe but managed to defeat him unscathed, showing his extraordinary talent.]
[Afterward, Ye Chen, Ji Bingyue, and you easily defeated your opponents, advancing to the top four. Cai Yonglong’s advancement, however, wasn’t as easy. Although he had found the path best suited for him and received the support of Black Element Country, learning his Divine Skills, the geniuses able to enter the top eight of the Hundred Dynasties War were no ordinary people. His opponent had also congealed a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir and broke through to Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with 3rd Tier Yin power. This person was a low-key monster, less arrogant than the prince.]
[In the end, Cai Yonglong lost and had to settle for the top eight. He could not accept the defeat and promised to challenge his rival again in the future to claim victory. Owing to the fierce battle, the two became somewhat sympathetic toward each other and eventually formed a friendship.]
[The next day, the semi-finals began, and you faced Ji Bingyue. Ye Chen’s opponent was also a genius of the same caliber as Cai Yonglong, who got defeated easily.]
[You and Ji Bingyue began your battle. The fight was intense; both of you kept revealing one powerful move after another. The Immaculate Profound Elixirs were no longer hidden, shocking all the spectators, even powerful King Realm Masters marveled at your strength when they were young.]

chapters.title: Chapter 347: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shows its Splendor! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Wilderness_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shows its Splendor! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Wilderness_5
Translator: 549690339
[Especially Ji Bingyue, who has actually broken through to the half-step Yin-Yang Mirror with pure Yin power, it is truly shocking. Of course, you are not much worse, 1st-tier Yin power is also strong enough.]
[By the end of the battle, you also began to display signs of fatigue. Because of your bloodline, physique, and the quality of your Yin power, you are not as good as Ji Bingyue, and your foundation is ultimately much weaker, resulting in your defeat by Ji Bingyue.]
[For this, you are somewhat unwilling but also have no intention to give up the pursuit of surpassing her.]
[The next day, the decisive battle began with Ye Chen battling Ji Bingyue. This fight shocked everyone even more as Ye Chen used pure Yang power to break through to the half-step Yin Yang Mirror. Moreover, Ye Chen’s specialty was of the fire attribute, meaning that in a certain sense, he was the complete opposite of Ji Bingyue in every respect.]
[The battle between the two of you also shocked you. Because you have now become so strong, you were able to see some of the nuances. Ye Chen’s physique is also not simple, it is a rare one, perhaps even more potent than Ji Bingyue’s Ice Profound Body. Eventually, Ji Bingyue was narrowly defeated by Ye Chen, and thus, Ye Chen ascended to become the leader of the Hundred Dynasties War and gained fame across the Sword Domain.]
[Upon receiving the awards from the Hundred Dynasties War, you were brought to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land by the King-realm Master.]
[Upon arriving at Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you met the Heavenly Sword Saint Master. The Heavenly Sword Saint Master easily saw through you and Cai Yonglong’s identities, which surprised him greatly.]
[In the end, after the opening ceremony, he summoned you alone and directly exposed your identity as trans-world travelers. Regarding this, both you and Cai Yonglong remained unfazed, if somewhat helpless.]
[In response to this, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master was quite surprised and, learning that you had long guessed that your identities would be exposed, could not resist asking you why you willingly walked into the trap. You answered that you had no other choice, to climb the Martial Peak, you had to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[The Heavenly Sword Saint Master was interested in your answer and told you about the xenophobia of the Purple Spirit Realm. However, he was willing to accept you as disciples of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, considering your decent talents. However, to be safe, a mark of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land must be inscribed on your bodies, and your lives would be under his control.]
[You and Cai Yonglong did not want your life controlled by others, but you had no choice. Especially in your case, knowing this was the result of being valued after increasing your potential, if you were still an ordinary person, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master would still use you as bait to draw out the strong from the Jiuyou Demon Sect. That outcome would be too miserable.]
“I’m so strong, but I still can’t compare to Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue? It seems that I do indeed lack in fundamentals.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly as he watched the simulation content.
The 1st-tier Yin power, after all, was somewhat lacking.
Apart from that, he doesn’t have any special bloodline or physique, which can’t truly compare to the two monsters.
However, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master did not regard him as a pawn this time, which proves the realism of this world’s rules.
Only by possessing enough capital can one be taken seriously and avoid becoming disposable chess pieces or cannon fodder.
Of course, as it stands, the simulated Wang Ping has not become cannon fodder, but the future is still uncertain.
If the simulated Wang Ping does not display the value he should have, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master might change his mind.
It is not that there is a shortage of monsters in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
People like him, although uncommon, only emerge every few hundred or thousand years.
And this does not take into account those disciples nurtured by the Heavenly Sword Divine Land itself, let alone the descendants of the masters.
If they were included, his status might be even lower.
Not to mention, in this Hundred Dynasties War alone, there emerged people like Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue who were even more monstrous than him….
Even though the two of them are in a somewhat special situation, the fact that they are more monstrous than him is undeniably true.
“I wonder which level I can reach this time.”
With twinkling eyes, Wang Ping thought quietly to himself and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After you and Cai Yonglong successfully joined the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you became preliminary True Inheritor Disciples and were each taken as disciples by a King-realm Master. Although the Heavenly Sword Divine Land chiefly practices swordsmanship, there are also other inheritances, although they are not as powerful as the sword.]
[Your Master is known as Xia Yuanyang, known as Yuanyang King, and he is known as a formidable figure among the King-realm. After you became his disciple, he began to teach you diligently about cultivation.]
[Under the teachings of the Yuanyang King, you made much progress and your understanding of Sword Skills improved even more. At the same time, you also learned about a higher realm of comprehension. Divine Skill, similar to Martial Skill, is just stronger and on a higher level than Martial Skill. Beyond comprehension, there is domain.]
[However, not everyone can grasp the concept of domain. Some King-realm Masters have yet to comprehend a true domain, and there are not a few that have only understood a Domain Embryo. Below the King-realm, even fewer have comprehended a domain, and those who have understood a Domain Embryo are scarce. It can be said that people who can comprehend a Domain Embryo below the King-realm are equivalent to paving the way for the King-realm. As long as their cultivation reaches it, the probability of stepping into the King-realm in the future is above seventy percent.]
[The reason for this is that comprehending the Domain Embryo is one of the important stepping stones to the King-realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 348: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shows its Splendor! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: 138: The Hundred Dynasties War Shows its Splendor! Fame Spreads in the Eastern Desolation_6
Translator: 549690339
“[You’ve understood in your heart. No wonder so many Heaven’s Chosen Monsters are stuck in the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection or the Quasi-King Realm. It turns out that stepping into the King Realm requires such strenuous conditions. At the same time, you fully understand why the Holy Lands value aptitude above all else.]
[Cultivation in the end relies heavily on understanding. Without understanding, one cannot break through and will become stuck at a certain realm. This applies to the King Realm, and probably even more so for the Emperor Realm.]
[Then, you think back to the situation in Ye Hei World, agreeing that understanding is most important. You cannot help but sigh – regardless of the path taken, all roads lead to the same destination in the journey of cultivation.]
[Next, your master, the Yuanyang King, provides you with some important knowledge about cultivation, and then brings you an extremely precious sword embryo. He tells you that for a cultivator, only their life-bound weapon can complement them perfectly. If you use other people’s weapons, you will never fully utilize its potential.]
[Therefore, you need to nurture this sword embryo with your own vitality, allowing it to grow into a Supreme Treasure and eventually into a King Artifact. Among the Holy Lands, every Master nurtures their own life-bound weapon. Once you reach the King Realm, you will have to rely on your life-bound weapon for fighting. Because in the Purple Spirit Realm, there are no craftsmen capable of forging King Artifacts. Only powerful cultivators can cultivate life-bound weapons, and through exposure to Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures and Heavenly Tribulation, can King Artifacts and even Emperor Artifacts be born.]
[Basically, the King and Emperor Artifacts of the outer world have all been nurtured by cultivators, not forged.]
[After listening to the explanation from your master, the Yuanyang King, you are greatly shaken. At the same time, you can’t help but admire and appreciate the benefits of joining the Holy Land, with a powerful master to guide you, and access to all kinds of good things and hidden secrets. If you had to struggle on your own, you would have to take many detours.]
[Especially this sword embryo, even the ordinary kings might not be able to obtain it, but your master, the Yuanyang King, gave it to you without hesitation. That kind of thing is unthinkable when you’re struggling on your own.]
[Lastly, your master, the Yuanyang King, asks you a question – whether you choose to wait. If you choose to wait, then don’t attempt to break through to the Yin Yang Mirror yet. He will find the Pure Yin Power and Pure Yang Power for you, revert your cultivation to Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, and then allow you to break through to the Yin Yang Mirror using the Pure Yin Power and Pure Yang Power.]
[However, if you choose not to wait, he can provide you with the 1st-tier Yang Power right now, allowing you to break through to the Yin Yang Mirror using the Yin Yang Diagram.]
[Upon hearing your master, the Yuanyang King’s words, you are greatly shocked. First, you are surprised and grateful for your master’s generosity and extravagance. Second, you are surprised that there’s also an operation to regress one’s cultivation and start over.]
[Your master, the Yuanyang King, chuckles, explaining that ordinary kings also don’t have the perfect ability to do such things. However, he is powerful in cultivation and has a Secret Skill that can accomplish this.]
[Hearing this, you can’t help but feel fortunate to have such a powerful and good master. Then, you decide to take the path of breaking through with Pure Yin Power and Pure Yang Power. Since you are to break through, naturally, you should choose the best breakthrough method.]
“Well, I must say, what a surprise….”
Wang Ping was shocked as he watched this simulation content.
Damn, he knew being part of a Holy Land was appealing, but this is beyond his imagination.
For a moment, Wang Ping gained a deeper understanding of how splendid Qin Tian’s life must have been in the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
It was simply having anything you could ever ask for.
However, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land where the simulated Wang Ping was located seemed to be stronger than the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
At least, according to Wang Ping’s speculation, the King Realm definitely held 10th Tier battle power.
And the God Transformation Realm in Qin Tian World, or even the higher Integration Realm, could never reach this level.
Although his world was strong, it was not as exaggerated as this one.
“Ah, what a detour.”
Wang Ping chuckled bitterly, whispering to himself.
If during the last Paid Simulation, the simulated Wang Ping had taken this path directly, participated in the Hundred Dynasties War, joined the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, there wouldn’t have been so many issues.
Probably, he would have taken off on the spot….
At that time, dealing with Guiyi would have been a piece of cake. He would have just overwhelmed him with his battle power….
Of course, Wang Ping was just letting his mind wander. He understood that, under normal circumstances, the simulated Wang Ping would never dare to take risks.
This simulation was just ‘unlucky’ to be caught by a Nirvana Realm Master from the Black Element Country, and was forced to participate in the Hundred Dynasties War, leading to such development.
If not, the simulated Wang Ping would only stay low and avoid making any big moves, and would not go to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, allowing others to control his life at will.
“However, if I don’t join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, does that mean no one will control my life? Joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land just means that my life is controlled by the Heavenly Sword Saint Master… But if I don’t join, any powerful Master I encounter can control my life as they wish, which is even more miserable.”
Wang Ping thought about this again and sighed in his heart.
Initially, he said he had taken the wrong path, but that wasn’t entirely accurate.
However, in the last Paid Simulation, he definitely took the wrong path.
But talking about this now doesn’t make any difference. Wang Ping only wants to know how far this simulated Wang Ping can grow.
[After your master instructed you on various matters, he left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land to find Pure Yin Power and Pure Yang Power for you. And the news of you becoming a quasi true inheritor disciple of the Holy Land, and being accepted by the Yuanyang King as his direct disciple, spread throughout the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, becoming well-known throughout the Eastern Desolation.]
[Some busybodies even ranked the Heaven’s Chosen Monsters who appeared in this Hundred Dynasties War across the major regions of Eastern Desolation. In the end, Ye Chen ranked third, Ji Bingyue ranked fifth and you, ranked tenth. At this, you were speechless. It truly is a golden era of imminent chaos, with an abundant emergence of Heaven’s Chosen Monsters.]
[A talent like Ji Bingyue would definitely have ranked first in the past. Even you would have had a chance to compete for a position among the top three in Eastern Desolation. However, you are only ranked tenth now.]
[But when you think about the bonus content from the cheat, you can’t help but shake your head in bitter amusement. Your ranking seems to be too high. If it were an ordinary Saintly Child’s Appearance, they probably wouldn’t have made their way into the top ten.]
[At this, you do not lose heart. You had no desire to outshine others. You only wanted to become stronger and survive in this world. That was it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 349: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, five years had passed. You heard that Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue had successfully broken through to the Yin Yang Realm, becoming True Disciples of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. As for Cai Yonglong, he even broke through to the Yin Yang Realm earlier than Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue. However, in comparison to their foundations, Cai Yonglong was far inferior to the other two.]
[As for you, with the help of your Master Yuanyang King, you successfully rebuilt your Half-step Yin-Yang Realm cultivation, breaking through with the power of Pure Yin. This realization gave you some clarity that, for the Holy Land, Pure Yin and Pure Yang powers, although precious, could be easily obtained.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years had passed, and you succeeded in breaking through to the Yin Yang Realm, becoming a True Disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and beginning to access the core inheritance of the sect. You could then choose suitable King-tier Cultivation Skills and Secret Skills for your cultivation.]
[In the end, you chose the King-tier Martial skill, Heavenly Sword skill, for your cultivation and began trying to comprehend your own top-tier Divine Techniques.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years had passed, and you had some understanding of the top-tier Divine Techniques, but there was still a distance from full comprehension.]
[In these five years, you did not just blindly cultivate. You also teamed up with Cai Yonglong to successfully seize many opportunities, raising your cultivation to the third tier of the Yin-Yang Realm.]
[It has to be said that people in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land have their own opportunities to seize, making it easy for you to do so. Of course, there are still very few opportunities useful to you, and it’s impossible to rise to the heavens with a single step. However, you were not greedy, as reaching the Yin Yang Realm is already quite impressive, even for genius cultivators, who would need at least 20-30 years to advance a single stage without opportunities.]
[In just five years, you had already advanced two minor realms, which was impressive.]
[Of course, this is based on the fact that you have never left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, because you knew very well that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor must have been watching you. If you leave the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor will definitely send powerful experts to capture you and Cai Yonglong.]
[With such a level of powerful experts, even the Heavenly Sword Saint Master might not be able to protect you. In other words, leaving the mountain is equivalent to death.]
[In these five years, many changes took place in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. However, the most shocking event was Ye Chen passing the Holy Child Assessment not long ago and becoming the seventh Holy Child of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, making him the youngest to become a Holy Child in this generation.]
[As for Ji Bingyue, under your schemes, she had not left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land in the past two years, instead sparring and discussing Tao with you. Therefore, she hadn’t fallen like you remembered.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 20 years had passed, and you successfully broke through to the 4th tier of the Yin Yang Realm, entering the mid-stages of the realm. At the same time, your comprehension of the top-tier Divine Techniques had greatly progressed, and with just a little more time, you would be able to create your own top-tier Divine Technique.]
[In these 20 years, Ye Chen had advanced rapidly, defeating the previous Holy Children one after another. Apart from the top three Holy Children with cultivation at the Life and Death Realm, all the rest had been defeated by Ye Chen. At the same time, the peerless geniuses of the Eastern Desolation were no match for him, making him the most dazzling Saint-tier character of the Eastern Desolation and the first among his peers.]
[As for Ji Bingyue, she had also become the Holy Woman of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land 18 years ago. Although not as dazzling as Ye Chen, she was still quite famous.]
[You felt a mix of emotions for the two of them, but you weren’t surprised. Although you also had the idea of competing for the title of Holy Child, you didn’t attempt the trials before creating your top-tier Divine Techniques. After all, you were very cautious and wanted to pass the trials in one go.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, his talent was good, but in the end, he could only be considered an ordinary True Disciple of the holy land. As a result, he gradually became an ordinary True Disciple of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[Although such a level was still unattainable for Inner Sect Disciples, Outer Disciples, and the peerless geniuses of the outer world, it was ultimately somewhat lacking.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years had passed. Ye Chen’s cultivation had reached the Half-step Life and Death Stage, and with cultivation at this level, he killed a Life and Death Realm Master, shocking the world. After all, it is very rare for a Half-step Life and Death Realm cultivator to kill a Life and Death Realm Master, and it’s not something ordinary Saint-tier characters can achieve, especially since this Life and Death Realm Master was from the Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[In the same year, your cultivation reached the 6th tier of the Yin Yang Realm, and you created the top-tier Divine Technique, Myriad Swords Unification. You then easily passed the trials of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and became the eighth Holy Child. However, the glory that should have belonged to you and spread your name throughout the Eastern Desolation and even the entire Purple Spirit Realm was taken away by Ye Chen.]
[Compared to you becoming the eighth Holy Child of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, the news of Ye Chen killing a Life and Death Realm Master from the Demon Cult was even more sensational.]
[However, you didn’t care and kept a low profile. When Ye Chen returned, he, along with Ji Bingyue and Cai Yonglong, attended your Holy Child ceremony, congratulating you on becoming the new Holy Child of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]

chapters.title: Chapter 350: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm_2
Translator: 549690339
“What a guy, things went so smoothly this time… He has even become the Holy child of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Although not as dazzling as Ye Chen, he has become a big shot.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
This time, how far would he go? Would he immediately become a Nirvana Realm Master?
Wang Ping couldn’t help but imagine.
Of course, he was just thinking, as it was not so easy to become a Nirvana Realm Master.
Talent potential is talent potential, and its relationship with future achievements is not exactly the same.
From ancient times to the present, countless heroes have fallen midway through their journeys.
Even some people who were not weaker than Ye Chen in their youth and even more dazzling, were said to possess Emperor Potential.
However, some of them fell in the Nirvana Realm, and even more tragically, some fell in the Life and Death Realm.
The path of cultivation is uncertain.
Immediately, Wang Ping retracted his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, another year has passed. This year, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm in the Central Continent is about to open, and the major powers in the Purple Spirit Realm have begun to take action.]
[The secret realms left behind by Kings are not enough to cause significant upheaval among the major Holy Lands, but Emperors are different. Emperors rarely appear once in a thousand years, and their legacies are extremely important. If a Holy Land can possess two Emperor’s Legacies, they would undoubtedly be superior to other forces.]
[It can be said that no Holy Land will give up a chance at Emperor’s Legacy, even the long-established Heavenly Sword Divine Land, which ranks in the top ten in the entire Purple Spirit Realm, is no exception. The Heavenly Sword Divine Land has given birth to three Emperors, possessing three Emperor’s Legacies, but they also desire to obtain the fourth Emperor’s Legacy.]
[Therefore, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, left behind by the Flaming Fire Emperor after his ascension, is enough to stir the winds and clouds of the whole Purple Spirit Realm, and involve forces with King Realm Masters and even all Holy Lands.]
[However, the inheritance secret realm left behind by an Emperor is naturally not that simple. The Flaming Fire Secret Realm only allows cultivators below the Life and Death Realm to enter. If cultivators above the Life and Death Realm enter, they will be suppressed and killed. Unless a powerful cultivator above the Life and Death Realm chooses to self-seal their cultivation, and lower their cultivation to below the Life and Death Realm.]
[In addition to this, those who reach the Quasi-King or King Realm will be directly suppressed and killed without any mercy.]
[Although the major Holy Lands have the ability to forcefully break open the secret realms, an inheritance secret realm left behind by an Emperor is obviously not that simple. If a powerful person forcefully attacks, it would trigger the prohibitions, and the entire secret realm would be destroyed, and no one would be able to obtain anything from it.]
[Because of this, the legacy inheritance secret realms like the Flaming Fire Secret Realm have been preserved to this day. Unless someone has already obtained the inheritance, the opening of a secret realm will always stir the winds and clouds of the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[As for the opening of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, you are weighing whether or not to go. After all, you think that this secret realm is most likely Ye Chen’s opportunity, and you cannot compete with him.]
[But then, you think about some things, and martial artists must compete. If you hadn’t become the Saint Master of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and were still a loose cultivator, you wouldn’t have to rush forward with all your strength, but now you must compete. If you don’t, you’ll likely be eliminated in the future.]
[For this reason, although you feel that it’s impossible to compete for the biggest opportunity, there must be many good things in the Emperor’s Secret Realm, and it’s time for Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger to truly come into play, and it will definitely bring huge gains to both of you.]
[In the end, both you and Cai Yonglong choose to go to the Flaming Fire Secret Realm. Even this time, you are joined by Ji Bingyue. With her around, you are even more secure.]
[After all, this time, the secret realm is gathering Yin Yang Realm geniuses from the entire Purple Spirit Realm, and there are even Half-step Life and Death Realm figures among them. Moreover, there are not a few Life and Death Realm Old Monsters who have lowered their cultivation.]
[Although these Old Monsters have lowered their cultivation, their strength is still not to be underestimated.]
[Soon after, a Quasi-Emperor ancestor of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land emerges, leading the team to the Central Continent. When you arrive at the destination, you witness a shocking scene.]
[In the sky, there are various flying ships and flying mounts. There are even powerful forces that directly have dragons and kirins pulling their ships, descending onto this land. Though there are no true-blooded Dragon Clan or Kirin in the Purple Spirit Realm, it is already terrifying enough. That’s because these monster beasts with Dragon Clan or Kirin bloodlines have Quasi-King Tier cultivation.]
[As the big shots of various forces are chatting, you are also sizing up the peerless geniuses of the Purple Spirit Realm, and an instinctive desire for battle arises in your hearts, wanting to compete with them.]
[Not long after, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opens, and you enter it, being teleported to different places. However, you have Array Plates that can locate and teleport each other. After entering the secret realm, you directly gather and start to act together.]
[The Flaming Fire Secret Realm is a very peculiar secret realm. The fire element here is extremely rich and there are various kinds of flames. Even more, terrifying Fire Spirits are formed here to attack those who enter the secret realm.]
[The strength of the Fire Spirits is not weak, and they can pose a threat to Yin Yang Realm masters. Some powerful Fire Spirits can even hunt down Half-step Life and Death Realm geniuses. However, killing Fire Spirits also has its benefits, such as Refining Spirit and improving cultivation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 351: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: 139: The Eighth Saint Son! Emperor’s Secret Realm_3
Translator: 549690339
[From ancient times to the present, there have been numerous cultivators who have enhanced their cultivation significantly just by hunting Fire Spirits in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, without finding any major opportunities.]
[On the first day, you encountered a powerful Fire Spirit with the combat power of a regular 7th tier Yin Yang Realm master, but thanks to your strong abilities, you easily killed it. However, you and Cai Yonglong were a bit disappointed because the other cultivators you encountered during the day didn’t have any opportunity lines.]
[On the second day, while hunting Fire Spirits, you met the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 5th Holy Son. Cai Yonglong saw a thick opportunity line on him, so you both followed it and discovered a rare treasure medicinal herb.]
[In the end, you divided the herb; you consumed half, and Cai Yonglong consumed the other half. You successfully broke through to the 7th tier Yin Yang Realm, while Cai Yonglong also reached the 6th tier. As for Ji Bingyue, since her cultivation is stronger than both of yours and she had already achieved the Yin-Yang Realm Great Perfection, the herb was useless for her.]
[When the Purple Thunder Holy Child arrived, he saw you and realized he had missed the opportunity, which made him feel very unlucky.]
[Next, you continued searching for opportunities. Two hours later, you met the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 5th Holy Son again, and surprisingly, a new opportunity line appeared on his body.]
[Following the opportunity line, you successfully found a top-tier treasure. When you took the treasure, the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land appeared again and was extremely frustrated.]
[At this point, Cai Yonglong noticed another opportunity line on Lin Qiu and acted strangely as he transmitted a message to you.]
[Upon hearing Cai Yonglong’s message, you also found it strange, thinking that this guy really must be a luck-bearer.]
“Good grief, taking advantage of only one person like this is really ruthless,” Wang Ping said while watching the simulation content with a strange look in his eyes, unable to hold back his comment.
This 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land was too unlucky. Despite his high destiny, he continually encountered opportunities, but they were all snatched away by the simulated Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong. In the end, he feared he would become a tool for their benefit.
[Over the next three days, you’ve discovered that this 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land indeed had immense fortune. You had deliberately targeted him, and successively stole seven opportunities from him, even including two or three items that could move the hearts of Nirvana Realm Masters.]
[However, this attracted Ji Bingyue’s attention. She felt that Lin Qiu must have been following you with some malicious intent and suggested finding a place to beat him up. As long as he wasn’t killed, the big shots of the Purple Thunder Divine Land wouldn’t cause trouble.]
[You and Cai Yonglong looked at each other strangely, claiming that Lin Qiu was just taking the same route and that it wasn’t fair to bully him. Ji Bingyue shook her head, thinking both of you were too kind-hearted.]
[You had mixed feelings in your heart and didn’t know how to answer her question. Later, you stole yet another opportunity from Lin Qiu. This opportunity was the biggest you had encountered yet – it was the Enlightenment Soul Grass, an item that could result in a huge increase in comprehension for a genius like yourself.]
[This could be considered an insanely valuable treasure, even for quasi-Kings. After all, some quasi-Kings lacked sufficient comprehension, which prevented them from stepping into the King Realm. If they obtained this treasure and enhanced their comprehension, they might be able to take that step, comprehend the Domain Embryo, and become a King.]
[You and Cai Yonglong were both very surprised, finding it hard to believe that this 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land possessed such incredible luck and opportunities.]
[However, it seemed that due to the fact Lin Qiu had been robbed of his opportunities so many times before, he was unable to control his emotions and became frustrated. As a result, he quickly sensed the presence of the herb. When he saw it, he went completely mad.]
[He coldly demanded that you leave, threatening to suppress both of you if you didn’t. Ji Bingyue became angry at his domineering attitude and engaged in a fierce battle with him.]
[It must be said that the strength of this 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land was incredibly powerful, able to fight against Ji Bingyue without being defeated instantly. Although Ji Bingyue wasn’t completely serious, the fact that he was strong enough was undeniable.]
[Through analysis, you reached the conclusion that you wouldn’t be able to defeat him easily if you faced him one-on-one. The Profound Elixir he condensed should be 1st-tier and the Yin Yang Diagram should also be 1st-tier, so he was not your equal. However, his cultivation was very advanced, reaching the Great Perfection stage of the Yin Yang Realm, which was several minor realms higher than you.]
[Eventually, Ji Bingyue became somewhat serious, and she sent the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land flying with a single blow. Lin Qiu knew how powerful Ji Bingyue was and fled in great humiliation.]
[Secretly, you asked Cai Yonglong if there were still opportunities on him. Cai Yonglong shook his head, indicating there were none. You realized that Lin Qiu’s resources had finally been completely exploited by you both.]
[Of course, this could also be a chain reaction. Because you had seized his prior opportunities, you hadn’t allowed him to become stronger. Without becoming stronger, he wouldn’t have been qualified to obtain the subsequent opportunities. In addition, the serious injuries inflicted by Ji Bingyue might have also played a role.]
[However, you didn’t pay much attention to these aspects. This guy had been robbed of his opportunities and seemed pitiful, but Ji Bingyue had caused him even more severe injuries. Continuing to act against him would have been embarrassing even for someone as thick-skinned as you.]
[Afterward, you digested your gains and started distributing the Enlightenment Soul Grass among yourselves. In the end, Ji Bingyue chose not to take the grass, stating that this was payback for the Four-leaf White Jade Grass you gave to her before.]
[You were touched by Ji Bingyue’s generosity and didn’t refuse. Instead, you directly split the herb with Cai Yonglong and consumed it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges
Translator: 549690339
[After swallowing the precious elixir, you enter a wondrous state of enlightenment. Eventually, you manage to successfully master the Cultivation Skill of the Heavenly Sword’s lower scroll, which had always eluded you, causing your power to skyrocket again.]
[You are extremely pleased with this. On the other hand, Cai Yonglong also gains a lot, taking the opportunity to comprehend his own top-tier Divine Techniques. You exchange a smile, feeling that seizing this lucky chance is amazing since it allows you both to experience a combat power surge and expand your horizons.]
[Next, you prepare to leave this place. However, just as you are about to leave, you are blocked by Purple Thunder Divine Land’s Fifth Holy Son Lin Qiu. This time, he has brought with him the Third and Seventh Sons of Purple Thunder Divine Land.]
[The Third Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land is already at the Half-step Life and Death Stage, with unparalleled strength. As for the Seventh Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land, he belongs to the same generation as you and Ji Bingyue, both being extraordinarily talented. You originally ranked tenth, while the Seventh Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land ranked seventh.]
[Now, it seems as though they have also encountered great opportunities. Their cultivation has reached the 7th tier of the Yin Yang Mirror, equal to yours. A battle breaks out between the two sides directly. Ji Bingyue finally unleashes her full power, engaging in an intense battle with the Third Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land, who has reached the Half-step Life and Death Stage using the Great Perfection of Yin Yang Mirror.]
[However, Ji Bingyue is still Ji Bingyue, once known to be on the same level as Ye Chen. Despite her cultivation being lower than her opponent, she is still formidable, impressively holding her own in the fight.]
[Initially, Ye Chen, with his Half-step Life and Death Realm cultivation, defeated the Life and Death Realm Master of the Demon Cult, shocking the entire Purple Spirit Realm. However, that Life and Death Realm Master of the Jiuyou Demon Sect may be powerful, but he is ultimately not a Saint-tier Character. Defeating an opponent of the same level who is a Saint-tier Character would be even more shocking.]
[Ji Bingyue is on such a path. If she can defeat the Third Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land, who is at the Half-step Life and Death Stage using the Great Perfection stage of the Yin Yang Mirror, the shock it would create would be no less than Ye Chen’s defeat of the Life and Death Realm Master.]
[Of course, if one could defeat a Holy Child tier character with a Life and Death Realm cultivation with their Half-step Life and Death Realm cultivation, the sensation created would be even greater than these two events.]
[A fierce battle breaks out between you. As Ji Bingyue and the Third Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land fight, you and Cai Yonglong engage the Fifth Holy Son Lin Qiu and the Seventh Holy Son.]
[You find that the Seventh Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land is not falsely ranked, having the qualifications to be ranked seventh among his peers. He is incredibly powerful and has broken through to the Yin Yang Mirror with Flawless Profound Elixir and perfect Yin Yang Diagram. He is a formidable opponent.]
[It could be said that without the Enlightenment Soul Grass, defeating your opponent would be a fifty-fifty chance. However, your epiphany has greatly increased your prowess; you have successfully mastered the King-tier Cultivation Skill’s lower scroll, resulting in a substantial combat power surge.]
[As a result, you easily suppress the Seventh Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land, making him look very miserable, and leaving him feeling very upset. He knows his ranking is above yours, but he is still not your match, making him feel humiliated.]
[However, Cai Yonglong does not have such an easy time. Although his cultivation is also at the 7th tier of Yin Yang Mirror, and he has comprehended his own top-tier Divine Techniques, his foundation is lacking, having only condensed a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir and breaking through with a 3rd-Tier Yin and Yang Diagram. As the Fifth Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land is a double 1st-tier with even higher cultivation, Cai Yonglong is naturally not his match.]
[The reason Cai Yonglong has not been defeated in just a few moves is that the Fifth Holy Son Lin Qiu was seriously injured by Ji Bingyue previously, causing a severe decline in his combat power. However, even with a weakened state, Cai Yonglong is still not his match, and defeat is only a matter of time.]
[You notice Cai Yonglong’s plight and also notice that Ji Bingyue and the Third Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land are unable to determine the winner for the time being. Therefore, you decide not to hold back and use your full strength, taking out the top-tier treasure you had previously obtained to quickly defeat the Seventh Holy Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land.]
[Your sudden outburst puts intense pressure on the Seventh Son of Purple Thunder Divine Land, forcing him to grit his teeth and hold on, but he is well aware that he won’t be able to hold on for much longer.]
[The intense battle between you attracts some cultivators, who are alarmed by your strength, which includes Saint-tier characters.]
[More and more people gather to watch the battle, so you all desperately try to defeat your opponents quickly, not wanting anyone to take advantage and seize the opportunity.]
[Unfortunately, the opponents are too tenacious and have various hidden trump cards, making it impossible to defeat them instantly. It is while you are fighting for your lives that a shadow enters the battlefield and slaps you with a palm.]
[You are shocked and angry, trying to hurriedly defend yourself, but you fail to block the attack, gravely injured and nearly killed.]
[This sudden turn of events alarms everyone. Ji Bingyue repels her adversary and stands in front of you, staring at the person who suddenly attacked you, recognizing the attacker’s identity.]
[The attacker turns out to be the Sixth Demon Child of Jiuyou Demon Sect, whose cultivation level has frighteningly reached the Half-step Life and Death Stage. With a casual strike, he almost kills you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_2
Translator: 549690339
[Everyone present was shocked, not expecting someone from the Jiuyou Demon Sect to have infiltrated the secret realm unnoticed. Truly, the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s methods were remarkable.]
[Next, the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s 6th Demon Son coldly stared at Ji Bingyue, ordering her to leave. Ji Bingyue,fuming at the opponent, showed no intention of moving aside.]
[In the end, a fierce battle erupted between Ji Bingyue and the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s 6th Demon Son. The 6th Demon Son’s strength surprisingly surpassed that of the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 3rd Holy Son. In a short exchange, he suppressed Ji Bingyue.]
[Seeing the situation, you realized that if he had wanted to, he could have killed you instantly. It was clear that their goal was to capture you and Cai Yonglong alive. You knew that the situation was very bad.]
[There were too many powerful people at the scene. Although Purple Thunder Divine Land held a grudge against you, they wouldn’t abandon their principles and help the 6th Demon Son deal with Ji Bingyue. However, they would definitely ignore the two fights and take the opportunity to kill you and Cai Yonglong.]
[While disciples from the various Holy Lands attempted to avoid mortal combat, once engaged in such battles, neither side would show mercy. No one Holy Land would fear another. At the same time, without experiencing life-and-death battles, even Saint-tier characters could not fully mature. Hence, there were many unwritten rules between the Holy Lands.]
[You and Cai Yonglong knew that you might be doomed today. With that in mind, you wanted Ji Bingyue to leave, so she wouldn’t die with you. You sent her a message, asking her to leave to find reinforcements.]
[However, Ji Bingyue saw through your intentions and refused to leave. Resolute in your decision, you faced the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s three Holy Sons and burned more than half of your Blood Essence, unleashing a suicidal attack.]
[Your sudden eruption shocked everyone, not expecting you to be so decisive. The Purple Thunder Divine Land’s three Holy Sons were caught off guard and hit directly by your attack.]
[In the end, the already injured Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 5th Holy Son, Lin Qiu, and 7th Son fell to your attack and perished. As for the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 3rd Holy Son, he barely blocked the attack thanks to his overwhelming strength.]
[Cai Yonglong suffered a more tragic fate, although he managed to escape a bit earlier. Since he was too close when the attack occurred, he got caught in the blast, suffered severe injuries, and was forced further away.]
[Meanwhile, Ji Bingyue had already received your message, and she evaded the blast without being affected.]
[Just as everyone thought you were doomed, burning most of your Blood Essence in a near-death state, you recklessly devoured a Nirvana Fruit to restore your injuries and replenish your Blood Essence. With this, you returned to your peak strength.]
[After recuperating, you had no intentions of fighting to the death with the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 3rd Holy Son. Taking advantage of everyone’s stunned reactions, you fled.]
[The Jiuyou Demon Sect’s 6th Demon Son tried to pursue and kill you, but Ji Bingyue blocked him.]
[As the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 3rd Holy Son regained his composure, he began a frenzied pursuit. Cai Yonglong, the little shrimp who had escaped earlier, was actually ignored.]
[Just as everyone thought you had a chance to evade capture escaping by luring Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s powerful members to come to your aid, you were blocked by three demonic shadows.]
[They were from the Jiuyou Demon Sect. Although they weren’t at the Demon Child Level, they were still Life and Death Realm powerhouses who had suppressed their cultivations. Once, they were the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s True Inheritor Disciples, with 2nd Tier Profound Elixirs. They were not ordinary Life and Death Realm cultivators.]
[Confronted by the three Life and Death Realm powerhouses who had suppressed their cultivations, you found it difficult to fight back. The threat they posed was not weaker than the Purple Thunder Divine Land’s 3rd Holy Son. The Jiuyou Demon Sect is infamous for their ruthless attacks, making them difficult opponents among cultivators of the same level.]
[In the face of the onslaught from the three powerful opponents who had suppressed their cultivations, you could only despair as they severely injured you, planning to capture you alive.]
[Realizing the consequences of being captured alive, you steeled your resolve and chose to self-destruct.]
[As your death marked the end of this simulation…]
“I still died, but it was an expected outcome.”
Wang Ping muttered while examining the simulation content.
However, the development of this free simulation was quite impressive, far surpassing other simulations.
He had joined the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, became a Saint, entered the Emperor’s Secret Realm, and killed two Saint-tier characters.
Even though he died in the end, it was only because he encountered people who were stronger than him.
If he had fought against someone at his level, only monsters like Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue would stand a chance against him.
In this scenario, Wang Ping had become the sixth-most powerful amongst the Eastern Desolation’s peerage, ranking just after Ji Bingyue.
Alas, his death was premature, as the Jiuyou Demon Sect had set their sights on him and Cai Yonglong.
Even if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and other Demon Lords made no move against them, they would seize any opportunity to act.
There was no other choice, given Wang Ping’s unique identity. As soon as he rose to prominence, he would immediately be noticed.
And then, targeted by the so-called “Predecessor Transmigrators.”
To avoid being used as a pawn and manipulated from afar, Wang Ping could never allow himself to be captured alive.
“The opportunities presented within this Emperor’s Secret Realm are astounding. Treasures that are rare to come by in the outside world are common here. Even by just plundering Purple Thunder Divine Land’s Fifth Holy Son, Lin Qiu, I managed to acquire so many valuable possessions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 354: 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_3
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping collected his thoughts, muttering to himself.
“It’s a pity that this is a free simulation, not a paid one, otherwise, I really would have gotten a lot out of it.”
Wang Ping thought with a bit of regret.
The good things in this simulation were genuinely numerous, and he really was a bit disappointed.
Of course, it was just a bit of regret.
As long as he knew a good simulation route, he could still easily get to this point in the next paid simulation and then refresh various rewards, and soar directly.
Besides, in this simulation, Wang Ping only achieved the third place in the Hundred Dynasties War, which was also a bit of a disappointment.
He decided that in the future, he would go crazy for rewards, participate in the Hundred Dynasties War with Yin and Yang Realm cultivation, and bring a shocking performance to Ye Chen, Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and the entire Purple Spirit Realm like a time traveler.
Wang Ping’s mouth curved up slightly, really looking forward to that scene.
It was when Wang Ping was daydreaming that his consciousness seemed to flicker, his field of view changed, and he appeared in an unfamiliar place.
Then, he saw the scene of the simulated Wang Ping being besieged, and then desperately self-destructing.
“Rest in peace, the next Wang Ping will avenge you,” Wang Ping shook his head and muttered to himself.
Then, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his field of view returned to normal.
“Cai Yonglong, let’s go. It’s time for us to go to Heavenly Sea Country. Once we get to Heavenly Sea Country and collect enough Spiritual Stones, we can go to Black Element Country to get that Master’s inheritance,” Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong, who was still feeling uneasy, and said with a smile.
“Yeah!” Cai Yonglong nodded excitedly.
“What should we do about Ye Chen?”
Immediately, Cai Yonglong looked at the place where Ye Chen was cultivating and asked.
It’s not appropriate to just leave a child who is not even twelve years old alone.
“Don’t worry, I’ll take him to Heavenly Sea Country. However, once we get to Heavenly Sea Country, we’ll have to separate from him quickly. He is the Son of Fortune, so he won’t have any problems. You’d better worry about whether we’ll be killed by him when we take him to Heavenly Sea Country. In places like this, it’s nothing, but if we go to places where there are many powerful figures, it’s easy for him to kill us. After all, in the last simulation, we were almost killed by him,” Wang Ping rolled his eyes and complained.
“Uh, okay,” Cai Yonglong opened his mouth, but couldn’t say anything else.
“Of course, we probably just go away for a while and then come back. It’s not like we’re really gone forever. Once you’ve accepted the inheritance and become stronger, I think we might be able to return to Heavenly Sea Country to pick him up and take him to Black Element Country. Or, just stay in Heavenly Sea Country,” Wang Ping said with a slight smile.
For him, as long as there were enough Spiritual Stones for simulation, it would be the same wherever he was.
The Master who imbued Cai Yonglong was of high worth.
If Cai Yonglong inherited from him, Wang Ping probably wouldn’t need to go all around earning Spiritual Stones for a long time.
As for whether the spiritual stones belonged to Cai Yonglong?
Hey, Cai Yonglong was his ‘righteous son’, and he had saved his life; it wouldn’t be a problem to use some of his Spiritual Stones.
As for the issue of staying in Black Element Country, although it was quite good in the simulation, and the Nirvana Realm Master had a good temperament, Wang Ping didn’t like staying in places where there were too many powerful figures. He felt that it was too dangerous, and his life would not be his own. There would be a higher chance of a plot deviation leading to danger.
Anyway, the simulated Wang Ping could take that action, and with paid simulations, he could refresh even higher-level Cultivation Skills and Secret Skills. The inheritance in Black Element Country was useless to him, so he wouldn’t take the risk.
“Okay,” Cai Yonglong nodded, feeling that Wang Ping’s words made a lot of sense and didn’t have any intention to refute them.
Afterward, Wang Ping took Cai Yonglong and Ye Chen directly on their journey.
Because Wang Ping still didn’t have a Secret Skill to hide his aura, he didn’t dare to use the Delivery Array for transportation and could only take the sea route.
However, Wang Ping had already reached the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror Cultivation level, and his strength was formidable, so he didn’t encounter any danger.
This was quite a normal occurrence.
After all, when Wang Ping had not even reached the half-step Profound Elixir Realm cultivation and set sail with Bing Ningyue, who was at the Half-step Profound Elixir Realm, they barely managed to reach the Eastern Desolation.
His strength now was many times stronger than it was back then, so it was natural for him to easily cross the sea.
When they arrived at the Eastern Desolation, Wang Ping asked Cai Yonglong to check whether there was an opportunity line on Ye Chen.
Soon, Cai Yonglong gave a definite answer.
Ye Chen’s body had an opportunity line that appeared when the three of them reached Heavenly Sea Country.
Wang Ping did not hesitate at all and followed the opportunity line to find the opportunity.
Three days later, Wang Ping and his companions found the opportunity, and just like in the simulation, it was something left behind by a Yin and Yang Master after failing the breakthrough.
