Naturally, the secret method to hide his aura was found among them.
“With this Secret Skill, I can finally feel relieved. At least, in this Heavenly Sea Country, I don’t have to worry about being seen through,” Wang Ping looked at the secret book and smiled.
“Next, let’s see if I can trigger the optimization option,” Wang Ping took out other items and wanted to see if he could trigger the optimization option.
Unexpectedly, he really managed to trigger one this time.
Lower-tier Treasure Sword successfully triggered an optimization option.
“Why does it have to be a sword?” Wang Ping was somewhat speechless.
He doesn’t even have a proper weapon now, and this lower-tier treasure is perfect for his half-step Yin-Yang Mirror cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: 140: Double-Killing Saint-tier Characters! The Demon Cult Re-emerges_4
Translator: 549690339
To be honest, he was a bit reluctant to optimize.
Once the optimization failed, he might not find a suitable weapon for a long time.
“It doesn’t seem right. As long as there are spiritual stones to simulate, following the previous path, not to mention a lower-tier treasure, even a top-tier treasure might be refreshed as a reward, and even the sword fetus is not impossible.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, thinking in his heart.
“System, I want to optimize.”
Wang Ping hardened his heart and chose to optimize.
“Ding, optimization successful, congratulations on obtaining a mid-tier treasure for the host.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, under the astonished gazes of Cai Yonglong and Ye Chen, the lower-tier treasure sword began to glow and transformed into a mid-tier treasure.
Although the two of them had limited knowledge, and didn’t know what level of treasure this was, they also knew that the current sword was obviously much stronger than before.
“Brother Wang, this is…”
Cai Yonglong stared, asking uncertainly.
“It’s a talent that the Life Simulator has refreshed, just think of it as a strengthening function in a game, it has a high failure rate, but if successful, the grade increases by one, or the quantity increases by one.”
Wang Ping transmitted his voice to Cai Yonglong.
Although Ye Chen was also trustworthy, there were many things Wang Ping couldn’t tell him.
“Damn!”
Cai Yonglong stared and envied Wang Ping.
Wang Ping’s golden finger was more perverted than he had imagined.
Although he had guessed that Wang Ping’s life simulator could definitely refresh talents and rewards, after all, it was the classic setting of a life simulation novel genre.
However, he never thought that it could refresh such talents.
Similar to the strengthening function in a game, this was definitely at the level of a golden finger for the chat group members.
This was really outrageous!
“Don’t be too excited, this thing is not as awesome and useful as you think. High-level items rarely trigger options, and even if they do, they are likely to fail. Moreover, the failure rate for the low and mid-level items isn’t low either.”
Wang Ping transmitted his voice to Cai Yonglong and complained.
“Uh…”
Cai Yonglong came to his senses and balanced his feelings.
At the same time, he felt a bit regretful.
If this talent were stronger, they would spiral upward.
“Enough, don’t worry about it too much, just quickly practice this secret skill. Otherwise, if the Profound Turtle Spirit on our bodies were to be detected, there would be a lot of trouble.”
Wang Ping looked at the two of them and said seriously.
His combat power was now very powerful, and he should be able to fight against ordinary cultivators in the Yin-Yang Mirror middle-stage, but within the Heavenly Sea Country, there were also late-stage experts and masters in the Life and Death Realm.
Although the number of these strong people wasn’t high, who knew if they would encounter them by bad luck?
Wang Ping felt that it was unlikely for him alone to come across them, but once he was with Ye Chen, the probability increased greatly.
If discovered, they would be in trouble.
“I got it.”
Cai Yonglong reined in his emotions and nodded seriously.
Although Ye Chen was full of doubts, he did not ask further questions.
Anyway, he would do whatever his master told him to do.
Besides, if his master didn’t want to talk about it, he wouldn’t ask more about it either.
This was the basic etiquette of a good disciple!
For the next half month, the three of them cultivated this secret skill.
Wang Ping and Ye Chen had the strongest comprehension and succeeded quickly.
It took Cai Yonglong half a month before he barely succeeded.
Although his innate talent was amazing, he was no match for Wang Ping and Ye Chen.
“Speaking of which, there will be some twists and turns later.”
Just when Wang Ping was about to leave with Cai Yonglong and Ye Chen, he remembered this matter.
In the last simulation, they were about to leave when Ye Chen’s ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ fate manifested, causing them to be attacked by a Yin-Yang Mirror Demon Beast.
Because of this, he had used up a Rebirth Tally and barely managed to keep the three of them alive, which was quite miserable.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple
Translator: 549690339
However, Wang Ping found that this time they did not encounter any Yin Yang Realm monster beasts attacking them.
This might be due to the difference in the time they arrived or because his current strength was strong enough that the Yin Yang Realm monster beast would only come to die, so it did not trigger Ye Chen’s ‘Heavenly Lone Star’ destiny.
Wang Ping did not care too much about this; the fewer troubles, the better.
Next, Wang Ping led Ye Chen and Cai Yonglong away from the mountain range and arrived at a big city in Heavenly Sea Country.
Although it was called a big city, it was actually just a city that was relatively stronger than Sacred Heart City in terms of cultivators. However, there was still no Yin Yang Realm Master presiding over it; the strongest was only at the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror Realm cultivator level.
This was quite normal.
Although in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, Yin Yang Realm cultivators could barely qualify as Deacons and could not even achieve the position of Outer Sect Elder, that was in the Holy Land, which could not be compared to the likes of the Heavenly Sea Country.
In Heavenly Sea Country, Yin Yang Realm cultivators could be considered Masters and were Supreme Elders-level figures in all major forces. They would not be seen everywhere.
This time, Wang Ping still used his familiar routine of selling several Profound instruments.
These Profound instruments were all found in Storage Rings of the fallen Yin Yang Realm masters.
Although they could not be exchanged for Top-tier Spirit Stones on Sacred Heart Island, it was different in Heavenly Sea Country.
In Heavenly Sea Country, Top-tier Spirit Stones were not scarce and could be easily obtained.
Thus, Wang Ping sold several Profound instruments and successfully acquired 40,000 Top-tier Spirit Stones.
Of course, this amount of Spirit Stones was not enough for travel expenses, but it was enough for Wang Ping to simulate twice now.
Only by simulating twice with the Paid Simulation and getting some powerful rewards could Wang Ping continue to gather Spirit Stones in Heavenly Sea Country and head to Black Element Country.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
In a guesthouse, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, this Paid Simulation requires the consumption of 20,000 Top-tier Spirit Stones. Will the host pay immediately?”
The system kindly reminded Wang Ping.
“Pay,” Wang Ping’s mouth twitched slightly, and he replied.
“Ding, payment successful. Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing ….”
The system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent – Sword Profound Body; Green Talent – Flower-picking Thief.”
Red Talent – Sword Profound Body: With this talent, the host will have smooth sailing in the field of Sword Skills, making it easier to achieve Sword Enlightenment, and the combat power will surge when utilizing the physique.
Green Talent: Flower-picking Thief:….
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was genuinely shocked when he looked at the talents refreshed this time.
He did not expect to refresh the Red Talent once again.
Upon further thought, since his spending had increased, the probability of refreshing higher-ranked talents seemed to be higher as well.
Could it be that the quality of talents is tied to spending?
Wang Ping couldn’t help but consider this problem.
Of course, it’s useless to think too much about it now; he would find out sooner or later.
“System, I choose Red Talent – Sword Profound Body.”
Wang Ping smiled, and without the slightest hesitation, he said in his heart.
Even though the Flower-picking Thief talent had some uses, compared to the Red Talent – Sword Profound Body, it fell far short, and Wang Ping looked down on it a bit.
“Ding, Talent Selection Successful. Life Simulation Begins.”
The system’s voice rang out, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the words began to emerge.
[Day 1, you chose to cultivate.]
[One year later, you have comprehended your inferior divine skill – Fall Sky, and your strength has soared. At the same time, during this year, you have also collected enough travel expenses and are ready to go to Black Element Country. Of course, you have actually collected the travel expenses long ago, but you feel that it is safer to go after comprehending the divine skill and becoming even more powerful.]
[In the end, you and Ye Chen went separate ways, letting him cultivate alone, and went with Cai Yonglong to Black Element Country.]
[You successfully met that Master. The Master felt that Cai Yonglong was a good seedling and still chose to bless him. Cai Yonglong’s cultivation improved to the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, condensing a 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir. Thinking about it, you felt that Cai Yonglong’s strength should not be too low, otherwise, he might hold you back like in your memory.]
[Therefore, you directly took out the Nirvana Fruit and let Cai Yonglong swallow it. It must be said that the effect of the Nirvana Fruit is indeed amazing, forcibly raising Cai Yonglong’s 2nd-Tier Profound Elixir to the level of a Flawless Profound Elixir.]
[Seeing this scene, you concluded that the effect of the Nirvana Fruit is greater than you imagined, a perfect Nirvana Skill.]
[After Cai Yonglong’s transformation was completed, you both left.]
“Is the Nirvana Fruit really that awesome? Well, it’s one of Ye Chen’s biggest opportunities during his loose cultivator period, so it must be powerful to not be a strange thing.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, utterly amazed, and thought to himself in his heart.
It seemed that some of the resources not needed in the future could still be used to cultivate Cai Yonglong.
After all, the effect of Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger might be more significant later in the game.
If Cai Yonglong’s strength couldn’t catch up, it would be a problem.
Even if Cai Yonglong’s combat power couldn’t be raised, he would still have to build a solid foundation for Cai Yonglong’s cultivation and improve it as much as possible.
In this way, he could barely keep up with his progress, and together snatch opportunities to quickly become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple _2
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping shook his head and continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you returned to the Heavenly Sea Country and provided Ye Chen with a lot of resources. After spending several years teaching him cultivation, you let him go on his own journey. As for you, you went to the Ice Palace, where you found Bing Ningyue.]
[Then, with the help of Bing Ningyue, you successfully arrived at the Ice Poison Sect in the Eternal Frozen Land and joined it discreetly, becoming a deacon.]
[With the help of the Ice Poison Sect, Cai Yonglong managed to obtain 1st-tier Yin power, which helped him break through to the Half-step Yin-Yang Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years passed. During this time, you received special attention from the authorities of the Ice Poison Sect and were taught by their Nirvana Realm Master. Even the King Realm Ancestor of the Ice Poison Sect taught you cultivation from time to time.]
[Because of this, you only spent ten years creating your own Mid-tier Divine Skill: Blazing Sun Crimson Shadow.]
[However, because you expressed that you would participate in the Hundred Dynasties War and join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land in the future, the Ice Poison Sect didn’t teach you their core inheritances. Although the Ice Poison Sect and the Ice Palace both have a relationship with the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, their relationship is not as close as the Ice Palace’s. They would allow you to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, but they wouldn’t teach you their core cultivation skills.]
[In addition, the Ice Poison Sect’s Ancestor felt that their way was not suitable for someone like you who follows the Sword Skill path. If you were to change your cultivation, it might hinder your progress. After all, the most important thing about a cultivation skill is that it suits the cultivator.]
[You were not surprised by this, as you had already heard about it from Bing Ningyue when you arrived.]
[In a blink of an eye, more than twenty years passed, and you successfully comprehended your own top-tier Divine Skill: Heaven Burning Sun Slaying. In addition, you changed your cultivation skill to a sword skill, used the Optimization Option to optimize it, and upgraded it to the heaven-tier supreme sword skill that best suited your cultivation.]
[You figured out that the Hundred Dynasties War was about to start. So, you used the Ice Poison Sect’s Delivery Array to return to the Ice Palace. As for Xue’er, she had already been sent back to the sect by the Master of the Ice Poison Sect. The Ancestor of the Ice Poison Sect owed Wang Ping a favor for this.]
[Soon after, you joined the team from the Ice Palace to the Heavenly Sword Divine City and reunited with Bing Ningyue and Ye Chen. This time, Ye Chen spoke about dominating the top four, but since you had a private room, there was no scene of Ye Chen showing off his prestige.]
[After the Hundred Dynasties War began, the four of you progressed easily, making it to the top 16. This time, thanks to Cai Yonglong’s great improvement, the four of you secured the top four positions.]
[In the semi-finals, you met Ji Bingyue as you remembered. You and Ji Bingyue had a shocking battle that drew the attention of many legendary figures. The Flawless Profound Elixir and Sword Profound Body’s appearance also caused a sensation. In the end, you barely defeated Ji Bingyue with your self-created Superior Divine Skill, making up for the gap in foundations.]
[This victory earned you the admiration of many legendary figures. The King-realm Master of the Ice Palace didn’t expect you to defeat their chosen one, Ji Bingyue, who possesses the Ice Emperor bloodline and Ice Profound body. Finally, he could only sigh that it is indeed the Golden Age that gave birth to such outstanding talents.]
[Your strength surprised Ye Chen as well but he didn’t doubt your capabilities as his first master, even though he never truly understood you. Next, Ye Chen fought Cai Yonglong in a battle with no suspense. Although Cai Yonglong had also condensed a Flawless Profound Elixir and 1st-tier Yin power, his foundation and combat power were far from Ye Chen’s, and he was easily defeated, stopping at the top four.]
[However, Cai Yonglong was already very satisfied. After all, he never thought he would be able to shine in the Hundred Dynasties War and reach the top four. In fact, with his foundation, if he hadn’t met the three of you, he probably would have been the champion in previous Hundred Dynasties Wars.]
[The next day, the final battle between you and Ye Chen began. This disciple-master battle was even more shocking to everyone. You tried your best, but you couldn’t defeat Ye Chen. The battle between you and Ji Bingyue had revealed too many of your cards, while Ye Chen easily defeated Cai Yonglong without showing his true strength.]
[In the end, although your powers were evenly matched, you reluctantly lost to Ye Chen. You felt some regret but didn’t take it too seriously.]
[Because you had proven one point: your talent now is no inferior to Ye Chen’s, and perhaps the only thing lacking is providence. As for courage, it can be cultivated.]
[Afterward, you received the awards from the Hundred Dynasties War, and were led by the King-realm Master to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. From then on, you, Ye Chen, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong became well-known figures in the Eastern Desolation. You, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue were named the Three Swordsmen of the Sword Domain, outstanding figures who were capable of suppressing the younger generation of the Eastern Desolation.]
[The Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s sudden acquisition of three such disciples made other Holy Lands extremely envious. They knew that one such talent was strong enough, but three at once was something they could not even think of. Even the appearance of a genius like Cai Yonglong would have made them happy for days.]

chapters.title: Chapter 358: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: 141: The Red Talent Appears Again! The Emperor Takes a Disciple _3
Translator: 549690339
[After arriving at the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you met the Heavenly Sword Saint Master, just like in your memories, the Heavenly Sword Saint Master did not expel you but treated you as chess pieces. It can be said that the attitude of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land towards you, is more enthusiastic than it was in the last simulation.]
[Because you’re a monster destined to become a king if you do not fall halfway, even becoming a quasi-emperor is not impossible. Such a person, no Holy Land would ignore.]
“So, at our level of talent, if we don’t fall halfway, we are destined to become kings in the future, and even hope to become quasi-emperors?”
Wang Ping thought thoughtfully.
With this in mind, I don’t know what conditions are required to become an emperor. It’s probably not as simple as just needing talent and aptitude…
Perhaps, opportunity is the most important.
Immediately, Wang Ping converged his thoughts, continued to stare at the luminescent screen, wanting to see how far this simulated Wang Ping could go.
[After successfully worshipping into the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you thought you would become the disciple of the Yuanyang King as in your memories. But who would have thought that the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s Emperor Realm Ancestor – Sky Emperor would choose to come out and personally teach you cultivation. The constitution of Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue is actually not the most suitable for the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, although the two have astonishing talents in the Sword Skill, they are ultimately not as good as you with the Sword Profound Body.]
[You with the Sword Profound Body, are the heavenly prodigy that the Heavenly Sword Divine Land has been longing for, able to perfectly accept the swordsmanship inheritance of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[You were very shocked, never expecting that you would be accepted as a personal disciple by the Emperor Realm Ancestor. Doesn’t this mean that your generation is instantly elevated, becoming the martial brother of the Heavenly Sword Saint Master. Your heart is very strange, but also very delighted.]
[With a King Realm Master personally teaching you, you believe that your future achievements will not be inferior to Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune.]
“Good guy, is this the treatment gap brought about by different talents?”
Wang Ping was truly shocked by the simulation content.
What is this, is he finally going to follow Long Aotian’s path?
Wang Ping thought with a strange look in his eyes.
“This time, will I truly skyrocket and reach an unimaginable cultivation level… If that’s the case, should I make a choice or not.”
Wang Ping finally had the happy trouble, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[With the help of Sky Emperor, you easily condensed the Yin Yang Diagram with the power of Pure Yin and Pure Yang, and broke through to the Yin Yang Realm. Then, you easily passed the Saint Son test and became the seventh Saint Son of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, ahead of Ye Chen.]
[However, although Sky Emperor helped you break through to the Yin Yang Realm, gave you a Sword Fetus, and directly helped you cultivate to the level of a top-tier treasure, and allowed you to become a Saint Son, and personally taught you cultivation, he did not give you any additional help.]
[Cultivation cannot rely solely on the resources given by the master, that will only cultivate a huge baby, you must fight on your own, get opportunities and grow. The help that a master gives to the disciple is to help them lay a solid foundation.]
[You believe that Sky Emperor’s approach is right, and you didn’t plan to rely too much on him. As for the rest, you want to rely on yourself. Anyway, you are now Sky Emperor’s personal disciple and the seventh Saint Son of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Even Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘transcender’ senior, probably can’t hurt you easily.]
[Therefore, you can finally relax your mind to a greater extent, and you don’t have to worry too much about being killed by a strong Demon Cult when you go out casually.]
“Having an emperor level master is really cool. Now, the path should be completely widened, right?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed, thinking in his heart.
Now that he knows the attitude of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, Wang Ping thinks he doesn’t need to wait for the Hundred Dynasties War decades later, he can go directly to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land to pay respects to the mountain, and the Heavenly Sword Divine Land will also directly accept him as a disciple.
Just when Wang Ping felt that this idea seemed quite good, words continued to emerge.
[In the blink of an eye, five years passed, Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue successively became the Saint Son and Holy Woman of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and Cai Yonglong was slightly inferior, but he was also striving to become a Saint Son.]
[As for you, five years have passed, and you have already changed your cultivation to the king-tier Heavenly Sword Skill of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and successfully practiced its lower scroll. Apart from this, your cultivation has reached the 4th tier Yin Yang Mirror, which can’t be said to be a big improvement.]
[In terms of Divine Skills, you are comprehending other divine skills, wanting to create supreme divine skills. This is not an easy task, because supreme divine skills are often created by ordinary Nirvana Realm Masters, but you have the teaching of the emperor, and now you have amazing talent, confident in creating it in the Yin and Yang realm, it’s only a matter of how much time it will take.]
[In the blink of an eye, another five years passed, you made some progress, but it was still a long way from truly creating supreme divine skills. As for your cultivation, it has reached the 6th tier Yin Yang Mirror and is about to break into the 7th tier Yin Yang Mirror.]
[In a blink of an eye, more than 20 years passed, your cultivation directly upgraded to the Yin-Yang Realm Great Perfection, and you are only one step away from stepping into the Half-step Life and Death Stage. At the same time, your understanding of the Supreme Divine Skills has made significant progress, and you are confident that it will only take some more time to successfully create your own Supreme Divine Skills.]
[During these 20 years, Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue also made rapid progress and are comparable to your cultivation realm. All of you have fought through the same generation of Saint Sons from various Holylands and easily defeated all the Saint Sons behind the top three in the ranking, who have already reached the Life and Death Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 359: 141: Red Talent Reappears! Emperor Takes a Disciple_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: 141: Red Talent Reappears! Emperor Takes a Disciple_4
Translator: 549690339
[Meanwhile, the outstanding talents of your generation in Eastern Desolation were no match for you three. You successfully captured the top three thrones of your peers in Eastern Desolation, admired and envied by numerous Masters. It’s amazing that Heavenly Sword Divine Land has produced three such monstrous Saint Sons at once.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, he has also made tremendous progress because he has been discussing Tao, comparing notes and seeking opportunities with you three all these years. His cultivation has reached the 7th Tier of the Yin Yang Mirror, and he has become the ninth Saint Son of Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[However, Cai Yonglong, who should have been famous throughout Eastern Desolation, was overshadowed by your three dazzling halos and seemed to have no presence. Cai Yonglong didn’t care about this, for he valued practical benefits rather than empty fame.]
[In the blink of an eye, several years had passed, and the cultivation of you, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue had all reached the Half-step Life and Death Stage. Cai Yonglong’s cultivation had also reached the 9th-tier Yin Yang Mirror. As you remember, Ye Chen, with his Half-step Life and Death Stage cultivation, killed a Life and Death Realm Master, shocking the world.]
[Ji Bingyue was similarly strong, slaying an evil Loose Cultivator in the Life and Death Realm. Although the loose cultivator was just an ordinary Life and Death Realm expert and not a member of the Demon Cult, it was still astonishing.]
[Among the three great monsters of Heavenly Sword Divine Land, only you didn’t make any big moves in these years and devoted yourself to closed-door cultivation. Finally, you successfully comprehended the Extreme Divine Skill: Ice Sun Sword Song. At this moment, your strength finally surpassed Ji Bingyue to a significant extent.]
[After coming out of seclusion, to test your own strength, you chose to have a match with Ye Chen. Under the watchful eyes of Ji Bingyue, Cai Yonglong, and many Heavenly Sword Divine Land Masters who sneaked peeks, you fought in a separate space.]
[In the end, you and Ye Chen fought to a draw. Although you realized your Extreme Divine Skill, Ye Chen had secretly comprehended his own Extreme Divine Skill. Without a life-and-death battle, you couldn’t decide the winner.]
[Regarding this, while you did not defeat Ye Chen, you were still very happy. After all, you were already strong enough to become one of the Leading Characters of the Golden Age.]
[As for Ji Bingyue, she took a hit, as only she among the three Eastern Desolation’s notorious figures of your generation haven’t comprehended an Extreme Divine Skill.]
[For this reason, Ji Bingyue planned to die in seclusion and not leave until she had created her Extreme Divine Skill. As for Cai Yonglong, he could only marvel. Although he had a good foundation with your help, he ultimately fell far behind, and his biggest goal was to catch up and not be completely left behind.]
“Wow, this time it went well… so smoothly.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, stunned once again.
Well, Simulated Wang Ping has grown again, truly having the demeanor of a protagonist of the era, even battling the Son of Fortune, Ye Chen, to a draw.
With this, could it be considered taking off completely?
“The Sword Profound Body is too powerful. Or perhaps, this constitution is too suitable for Heavenly Sword Divine Land, allowing Simulated Wang Ping to keep up with Ye Chen’s footsteps.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
The Simulated Wang Ping with the Sword Profound Body was truly too strong.
“However, this is just the result of combining two Red Talents. If it were Purple Talent, how powerful would it be?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but fantasize.
“If it were Gold… how powerful would that be?”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 142: The Real King’s Blood Essence! The Price of Acting Pretentious
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 142: The Real King’s Blood Essence! The Price of Acting Pretentious
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, another year went by. During this year, you focused on mastering various secret techniques of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land while also starting to study the power of the domain, intending to comprehend the domain.]
[Of course, you are well aware that comprehending your own domain is extremely difficult, and it is absolutely impossible to succeed in a short period of time. After all, many King-realm Masters haven’t comprehended their own domain, only grasping the Domain Embryo.]
[To comprehend the domain below the King Realm is even more difficult than ascending to the heavens. Therefore, your goal is to comprehend the Domain Embryo, which, although a little less difficult, is still hard. After all, many quasi-Kings are stuck because of the Domain Embryo, unable to become true kings.]
[Those quasi-Kings, with their long lifespan, have yet to succeed. If you want to comprehend the Domain Embryo in a short time, it’s impossible unless you encounter a miraculous opportunity. However, your goal is just to comprehend the Domain Embryo within a thousand years, not blindly maximizing it.]
[During this year, Ji Bingyue also succeeded in understanding her own Supreme Divine Skills, once again standing on the same level as you and Ye Chen. Although Ji Bingyue’s fighting power is still slightly inferior to you and Ye Chen, she is enough to suppress the same generation’s geniuses of Eastern Desolation.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, he successfully stepped into the Yin-Yang Mirror Great Perfection Tier with the help of an opportunity, preparing to break through the Half-step Life and Death Stage. This level of cultivation has reached the height of Ji Bingyue in your memory.]
[All I can say is that a competitive spirit can really catalyze growth, like desperately catching up with others or not being left behind. Of course, this is also due to Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger. Otherwise, no matter how hard he tried to catch up, he would inevitably be left behind.]
[Now, a year has passed, and the Flaming Fire Secret Realm in the Central Continent is about to open, and the major powers of the Purple Spirit Realm have begun to take action.]
[However, before the opening of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm,
an Eastern Desolation rumor arose due to your disappearance for several years,
claiming that you were far behind Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue, questioning whether you were still on par with the two and whether you could easily suppress other geniuses of Eastern Desolation.]
[In the face of this rumor, although you didn’t take it seriously, someone eventually sought you out.]
[Outside the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, under the watchful eyes of numerous geniuses and Masters, the 7th Son of the Profound Earth Holy Land, currently ranked third among the same-generation Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s geniuses, directly challenged you, wanting to test your strength.]
[As the 7th Son of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you naturally wouldn’t avoid the battle, as that would disgrace the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s reputation. You chose to fight coldly. Admittedly, the 7th Son of the Profound Earth Holy Land is very powerful, having been rumored to have killed Life and Death Realm powerhouses across levels before, but he is still a bit too tender in front of you now.]
[You didn’t hold back at all, forcibly suppressing him. If it weren’t for one of the Profound Earth Holy Land’s Masters stepping in, he would have been severely injured or even killed. In the end, the 7th Son of the Profound Earth Holy Land fell completely silent, choosing to admit defeat but asserting he wouldn’t always lose in the future.]
[At this, you couldn’t help but recall Emperor Huangtian’s words and quoted the classic line, “Enemies who lose to me will never be considered opponents. I’ll give you time to catch up, but I’ll eventually be so far ahead that you won’t see me.”]
[As soon as your words came out, the 7th Son of the Profound Earth Holy Land’s expression stiffened, thinking you were too arrogant, filled with resentment. Yet as the loser, he had no grounds to refute anything.]
[The Profound Earth Holy Land, as well as the numerous onlooking Masters, stared dumbfounded at you, even transmitting a message to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s Quasi-Emperor Ancestor who led them. They thought not only did the Heavenly Sword Divine Land have great luck, finding the Sword Profound Body, but they also inherited this style of arrogance, even more so than the Founding Ancestor, which was incredibly outrageous.]
[At this, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s Quasi-Emperor Ancestor was quite complacent, believing you had truly brought honor to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. He loved seeing the envious and jealous expressions of those old fellows.]
[As for Ye Chen, his eyes brightened up, genuinely not expecting you to say such a forced and pretentious phrase. He admired his master’s greatness and felt inspired to say similar such words in the future.]
[Only Cai Yonglong was left speechless, thinking your act of plagiarizing was nothing short of disgraceful. Of course, it was only because he was incapable of saying such words himself that he would have wanted to say them!]
[In the end, this battle made the hearts of the Saints and True Inheritor Disciples of your generation sigh in admiration and unwillingly accept. You, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue remain the Three Outstanding Figures of the same generation in Eastern Desolation – no one can shake your position.]
[As for the Heavenly Genius characters from the previous generation, they looked solemn, also somewhat apprehensive of your strength. Though their current cultivation is in the Life and Death Realm and they can easily kill you, it is ultimately just relying on cultivation to suppress you. In a battle of the same cultivation level, they have no confidence in defeating you, and might even be suppressed by you in return.]
[For this trip to the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, cultivations can only be made to stay at Half-step Life and Death Stage. For them, they have no advantage in facing you.]
[This is not only the thought of the previous generation’s genius characters, but also the ordinary Life and Death realm cultivators, who feel even more bitter. They, facing you all, can only be killed in seconds. Those who weren’t suppressed by cultivation level are not capable of killing you, weaker Life and Death realm can be slain by you across levels, which is too miserable.]

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 142: True King’s Essence Blood! The Cost of Pretending to be Cool_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 142: True King’s Essence Blood! The Cost of Pretending to be Cool_2
Translator: 549690339
“In the end, they could only sigh. The world of cultivators really is too cruel. They cultivated for thousands of years, yet they can’t match those who are barely a hundred years old.”
“Damn, even the simulated Wang Ping is getting arrogant, acting so cocky.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content, his gaze becoming peculiar.
Good heavens, flaunting in front of many masters and geniuses of the Purple Spirit Realm, he was indeed flaunting too much.
Sure, flaunting felt good. Just imagining that scene told him how pleasurable it would’ve been, possibly even enough to dazzle numerous holy maidens, and perhaps even earn the admiration of some Holy Women…
But there’s a saying, ‘act cocky and you’ll be struck by lightning’ …
Not everyone can bear the cost of arrogance.
Look at An Lan. He acted cocky and ended up kneeling in the Sin Continent
Look at Wang Teng acting cocky with his ‘my son has the bearing of a great emperor’, he got directly smacked down.
“I hope nothing goes wrong.”
Wang Ping muttered in his heart, continuing to watch the simulation content.
“Next, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened, and you entered it.”
“On the first day, you, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong chose to act as a team. As for Ye Chen, he chose to act alone, and you guys did not stop him.”
“Perhaps it’s because you guys were very lucky, or perhaps it was just that you were very well matched with the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu, you actually encountered him one day early and started to snatch his fortune.”
“After you intercepted his blessings, the Fifth Holy Son of the Purple Thunder Divine Land was always a step late, very frustrated, but when he knew about your terrifying battle power and realized how powerful you guys were, he remained calm.”
“In the following three days, you kept intercepting Lin Qiu’s fortunes and eventually found the ‘Enlightenment Soul Grass’ in your memories – a precious medicine that could heighten one’s enlightenment, it could even make a quasi-King go mad.”
“This thing, even for you and Ji Bingyue right now, is also of great benefit. After finding this thing, even the cold-natured Ji Bingyue was a bit surprised and happy.”
“After that, you began to split your spoils. As you were dividing the spoils, Lin Qiu reappeared. Seeing the precious plant, he was shocked and excited, and wanted to seize it, but recalling your strength, his face turned black. He had no choice but to leave slowly, planning to call his companions to compete for it.”
“However, you did not let him leave. Because in your memory, you were killed because you let Lin Qiu escape last time. Although it was the Jiuyou Demon Sect that took action, his contribution was not small.”
“Therefore, in order to be safe, you decided to eliminate him. Because once he broadcasts your news about harvesting the ‘Enlightenment Soul Grass’, you are likely to be besieged by geniuses.”
“Because this thing is too precious. Many geniuses, who might be stuck at the Great Perfection of the Nirvana Realm or the quasi-King Tier for their entire lives, would have much higher chance of stepping into the King Realm if they had this crop. For the martial arts, they must compete. These people would not miss this opportunity.”
“Although both you and Ji Bingyue have nothing to fear in terms of battle power, you are after all weak in strength. It will still be very dangerous if you are besieged by a large number of powerful cultivators suppressing their cultivation stages. You might possibly fall. Not to mention, Cai Yonglong is still only at the Great Perfection of the Yin Yang Mirror.”
“In the end, you chose to take action and aimed to kill the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu fiercely. Lin Qiu never expected you to turn against him. He was in disbelief and anger, trying to resist. But his resistance was futile, your cultivation level was higher than his, and your battle power in the same realm was overwhelming him.”
“As a result, Lin Qiu was directly killed by you in a single strike, his Divine Soul completely erased with no chance of survival.”
“For your behavior in killing Lin Qiu, Ji Bingyue had no opinion. After all, she had long felt that Lin Qiu had some ill-intentions, always following you.”
“As for Cai Yonglong, he had even less to say. After all, Lin Qiu no longer had a fortune, having been completely drained. He felt since they had already offended him, it was better to be thorough.”
“My goodness, they sheared wool off a person until his wool was completely gone and then killed him directly. What a pitiful Lin Qiu.”
Looking at the simulated content, Wang Ping murmured.
But, Wang Ping also didn’t feel sorry for him.
Since he snatched people’s fortunes, and they planned to call people over, the simulated Wang Ping not taking decisive measures could be dangerous instead.
Whether it was for himself or for his teammates, he had to be ruthless.”
“Money can move anyone’s heart. I have no room to criticize others.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and sighed.
While Wang Ping was lost in thought, more texts appeared on the luminescent screen.
“In the following week, you continued robbing the opportunities of various geniuses, acquiring quite a few good things, each of you getting rich. Even more so, you managed to obtain another Nirvana Fruit. For this, Cai Yonglong had no intention of sharing with you and directly relinquished his share.”
“As for Ji Bingyue, she indicated that the Nirvana Fruit was of fire attribute, so she didn’t need it, and thus, the Nirvana Fruit fell into your hands.”
“The next day, when you continued to seek geniuses to steal their opportunities, you heard a huge commotion and rushed over together.”
“When you arrived at the destination, you saw a blood pool. In the blood pool, there was a large skeleton, and a blood-red flower grew from it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 142: True King’s Blood Essence! The Cost of Pretending to be Cool_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 142: True King’s Blood Essence! The Cost of Pretending to be Cool_3
Translator: 549690339
[When you saw this scene, all of your faces turned pale. That’s because from this enormous skeleton, you could feel a strong king’s majesty, the remains left after a king’s fall.]
[As for this blood pool, it is very likely the blood of this monster beast king, while the treasure flower at its core has absorbed the king’s blood, and possibly even its Blood Essence, making it extremely valuable, enough to make kings of the same realm covet it.]
[At this moment, your hearts are burning with desire, knowing that this opportunity is truly a once-in-a-lifetime extraordinary occasion. If you could obtain this treasure flower, it will definitely broaden your path, allowing you to go even further in the future and truly surpass your peers.]
[However, even though your hearts are passionate, you don’t act rashly, because there are many cultivators who are attracted here by the soaring bloody light just as you arrived.]
[Among them, there are ordinary Life and Death realm cultivators with suppressed cultivation, Half-step Life and Death realm cultivators, Yin Yang Mirror cultivators, and even True Inheritor Disciples and Saint-tier Characters from major powers. With so many powerful cultivators present, anyone who dares to act rashly will inevitably be attacked by the group.]
[All those who become powerful cultivators are not fools. They know that whoever dares to take the lead will die. And for that reason, you all remain at an impasse.]
[But inevitably, someone wishes to break the deadlock, knowing that more people will come. The third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land, which is hostile to Heavenly Sword Divine Land, secretly communicates with everyone else, saying ominous predictions about you three, convincing them that they must deal with you first before they can compete for the treasure.]
[However, everyone present is like an old fox, and they naturally won’t be fooled into being used by others, so they remain unmoved.]
[Seeing this, the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land is very unhappy. He coldly snorts, communicating with the cultivators from the various Holy Lands, saying that those from lesser backgrounds here are too obstructive and have no qualifications to participate in the competition for treasures. They should collectively get rid of them first.]
[To this, you all also remain unmoved. It was then that suddenly, huge waves appeared in the blood pool, and a terrifying monster beast appeared out of nowhere, instantly killing a Half-step Life and Death strong cultivator, which shocked everyone.]
[You and Ji Bingyue remain very calm, having already guessed that there were hidden monster beasts in the blood pool. After all, wherever there are Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, there will inevitably be powerful guardians present. Otherwise, these Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures would have long been devoured by the attracted monster beasts, and there would be none left for you to compete for.]
[After that, the Blood Pool demonic beast kills several strong cultivators in succession, causing the cultivators present to regain their senses and tacitly join forces against this terrifying monster beast.]
[The cultivation of this monster beast hidden in the blood pool has definitely reached the Life and Death realm, and it is not an ordinary Life and Death realm at all. At least, neither you nor Ji Bingyue are confident in dealing with it, and the likelihood of getting killed in action is extremely high.]
[As expected, even under your joint efforts, you are still no match for the monster beast, and it continues to kill cultivators. Some Life and Death realm cultivators are very resentful, as they cannot use their real cultivation in the secret realm, but the monster beast’s cultivation has reached the Life and Death realm, making them extremely frustrated.]
[Seeing that the situation is not good, the 3th Saint Child of Hanghai Sacred Land cannot help but shout, saying that if you continue to hide your strength, you will not only fail to obtain the opportunities here but also die in this place.]
[After the 3th Saint Child of Hanghai Sacred Land spoke, the strong cultivators present no longer hide their strength, using one trump card after another. You, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong no longer hold back, and attack the Blood Pool demonic beast with all their might.]
[Despite its power, the Blood Pool demonic beast is put on the defensive under your combined onslaught, eventually getting suppressed. The next step would decide who could hold out the longest.]
[After all, many people have forcibly increased their strength using Secret Skills, and their trump cards cannot be used indefinitely.]
[In the end, many people can no longer withstand the onslaught and are killed by the Blood Pool demonic beast. Your and Ji Bingyue’s breaths also weaken, but in the end, you triumph over the Blood Pool demonic beast and kill it completely.]
[Although the Blood Pool demonic beast killed some cultivators in a last-ditch attempt before it died, the three of you still manage to survive without sustaining too severe injuries.]
[Nevertheless, you did not take this situation lightly. After all, with the monster beast dead, there are still other competitors present. A moment of carelessness could possibly lead to death.]
[Next, the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land stirs the pot again, insisting that you three pose the greatest threat and that you must be eliminated to reduce competition. This time, he does convince quite a few people because you and Ji Bingyue performed exceptionally well in the previous battle, both being the main forces, and Cai Yonglong also put on a decent performance.]
[Everyone feels that the three of you, being from Heavenly Sword Divine Land, pose too much of a threat in the upcoming battle for the treasures. For this reason, they listen to the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land and choose to attack you.]
[The three of you are both shocked and enraged, but well-prepared. You immediately defend yourselves and plan to break through the encirclement without directly battling the group. Since the opponents are numerous and powerful, if you really fight, there’s a high risk of you falling here.]

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 142: True King’s Blood! The Cost of Pretense_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 142: True King’s Blood! The Cost of Pretense_4
Translator: 549690339
[However, the cultivators present were all experienced and did not give you any chance to break through. The third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land clung to you and engaged you in an intense battle. Although he was not your match, he managed to hold you back.]
[Ji Bingyue and Cai Yonglong were surrounded and attacked by even more people, and their situation was extremely dangerous. Cai Yonglong, in particular, was far weaker than you and was on the verge of falling at any moment.]
[However, just as Cai Yonglong was about to fall, a figure appeared on the battlefield — it was Ye Chen.]
[The appearance of Ye Chen was a pleasant surprise to you and Ji Bingyue. With his fighting strength still at its peak and endless cards up his sleeve, you felt confident in dealing with this group of people.]
[However, the scene that unfolded next left you, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong utterly astonished and speechless. Ye Chen had grown even stronger during this period and had clearly made significant gains. He had subdued the Earth Fiend Blazing Fire, the 10th-ranked Exotic Fire in the world.]
[The Earth Fiend Blazing Fire was a powerful flame once possessed by the Flaming Fire Emperor. Although Ye Chen’s Earth Fiend Blazing Fire was not as strong as the one previously held by the Flaming Fire Emperor and had yet to be nurtured, it ultimately originated from the same source, making it incredibly formidable and bestowing Ye Chen with a fighting strength far beyond yours.]
[As a result, under your gaze, Ye Chen singlehandedly routed the many powerful cultivators present, even forcefully killing a Holy Child tier character and displaying a peerless demeanor.]
[Seeing this, you sighed in your heart, knowing that Ye Chen had once again surpassed you. However, there was no helping it, as Ye Chen was the Son of Fortune. The Flaming Fire Secret Realm was likely a huge opportunity prepared specifically for him. After all, Ye Chen was walking the path of fire, and the real treasures of this secret realm, left behind by a Fire Attribute Emperor, were bound to be fire-related.]
[You could glean that from the exotic fire Ye Chen obtained. According to your speculation, Ye Chen had probably only acquired a portion of the treasures thus far. The Earth Fiend Blazing Fire was definitely not the most precious item. The inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor would be Ye Chen’s greatest opportunity.]
[Once Ye Chen obtained this opportunity, it was estimated that he would outdistance his fellow geniuses, and even you would have trouble catching up. He would then challenge the genius characters of the previous generation, and even those ancient figures would be trampled under his feet.]
[As you felt a sense of loss, the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land became frightened. He hadn’t expected a formidable person like Cheng Yaojin to suddenly appear, and Ye Chen’s strength exceeded his imagination. It was unthinkable that Ye Chen, who was ranked alongside you as a genius, could become so overwhelmingly powerful like a cheater.]
[So, the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land wanted to escape. You came to your senses, snorted coldly, and charged towards him once more. With nothing holding you back, you unleashed your full fighting strength. The self-titled cultivation of the third saint of Hanghai Sacred Land was no match for you, and you quickly killed him with a fierce strike.]
[As for Ye Chen, he swept through the powerful cultivators on the scene like an autumn breeze scattering leaves, leaving no one alive.]
[This scene shocked the strong cultivators who arrived occasionally. They were extremely frightened. Although they were covetous of the Blood Treasure Flower and blood pool, they dared not approach for fear of being killed by you.]
“Has it started? Ye Chen is cheating again.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a subtle expression on his face.
Honestly, the cheat level he activated was nowhere near as great as that of Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune.
Through the Life Simulator, he averted various dangers, while Ye Chen didn’t have to deal with them at all.
Regarding other areas of cheating, he had to painstakingly refresh his talents to barely keep up with Ye Chen’s configuration, and that only happened after he recently refreshed his Red Talent: True Dragon Form enhancement and the Sword Profound Body.
Even so, his overall configuration was still inferior to Ye Chen’s, with his current benchmark being Ji Bingyue.
That’s because Ye Chen’s greatest advantage was not his talent, but his fortune…
Fortune was really critical, as it could transform danger into safety, turn the tide in dire straits, and grant him numerous great opportunities.
Such opportunities were even more important than the talents Wang Ping refreshed.
And simulated Wang Ping obviously didn’t have much fortune.
It could be said that it was already quite good not to be targeted by this world.
“Perhaps only by refreshing a talent above the Red tier can I truly rival or even surpass Ye Chen.”
Wang Ping sighed softly to himself.
Otherwise, he would still be left behind in the simulation once a great opportunity arose.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 143: A Reward Beyond Imagination! Suppressing Ye Chen!
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 143: A Reward Beyond Imagination! Suppressing Ye Chen!
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping shook his head, calmed his mind, and continued to watch the simulation content.
[Just after reminiscing with Ye Chen, and preparing to pick the Blood Treasure Flower, an unexpected change occurred again. Several shadows appeared and attacked you, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong.]
[Although you were always on guard to prevent someone from sneaking on you, the methods of these shadows were extremely bizarre. Cai Yonglong was unable to defend and was directly killed.]
[The seriously injured Ji Bingyue was also covered in blood and was killed. You, too, failed to block the attack and were directly slain.]
[As for Ye Chen, although he reacted faster and intended to protect you, he, being attacked by the two strongest figures, had no time to look after you and could only watch helplessly as you were killed.]
[Ye Chen then exploded with rage and fought a devastating battle with the shadows. As for you, with the help of the Rebirth Tally, you came back to life and saw their battle. You found out that the person who fought Ye Chen was the Second Demon Son from the Jiuyou Demon Sect, whose cultivation is rumored to have reached at least the 7th-tier of the Life and Death Realm, with astonishing means. Even though he suppressed his cultivation, he was still extremely powerful, strong enough to fight Ye Chen hard, only slightly suppressed, and not defeated in a short time.]
[The person who killed you was an old acquaintance, the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s 6th Demon Son, who had attacked you in your memory. Enraged, you knew there was no way out and hesitatedly launched a fierce attack against the 6th Demon Son.]
[The 6th Demon Son didn’t expect you to come back to life, but wasn’t afraid of you and started a fierce battle with you. However, his strength wasn’t as good as yours, and he was directly suppressed by you. Nevertheless, the 6th Demon Son sneered, not worried at all, because there were others here as well.]
[As the 6th Demon Son sneered, the other members of the Jiuyou Demon Sect took action one after another, starting to surround and attack you. Although your combat strength was unmatched at the Half-step Life and Death Stage, with only Ye Chen able to surpass you, you were still struggling when facing so many opponents.]
[However, the people from Heavenly Sword Divine Land were not easy to deal with, and they came one after another, joining the battle. At the same time, you shouted angrily, demanding that everyone punish the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s members. Were other people in league with the Demon Cult? These words made many people’s faces change. Being accused, they could no longer stand idly by. Eventually, some joined the battle, and the Jiuyou Demon Sect members were on the verge of defeat.]
[But, to everyone’s surprise, a terrifying Great Array appeared here, enveloping the entire area, sealing the space, and unleashing terrifying power, instantly killing many people.]
[You felt a chill in your heart and knew that the Jiuyou Demon Sect members had arrived earlier and had been preparing the Great Array all along. They were really ruthless and cunning.]
[Seeing the unfavorable situation, Ye Chen’s face turned serious, and he instantly teleported to your side, using his trump card to break the spatial blockade and forcibly leave the place.]
[However, the teleportation process was very unstable, and you and Ye Chen were separated and sent away. You were directly teleported to a terrifying flame area, where your body was instantly incinerated into nothingness. Before dying, you saw an illusory and elusive purple flame swaying and floating in front of you, playfully burning your soul to ashes as well.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ended…]
“Still died, huh? The Jiuyou Demon Sect is really ruthless.”
Wang Ping frowned and muttered to himself.
The other party really put a lot of effort into killing him and Cai Yonglong; their preparations were very thorough.
Even though he was vigilant and had Ye Chen by his side, the enemy still seized an opportunity.
In the end, Ye Chen used the trump card to teleport away together, but still couldn’t escape the fate of death.
“Did I drag down Ye Chen this time?”
Wang Ping’s gaze was subtle as he pondered this question.
If he hadn’t been there, the Demon Sect might not have gone to such great lengths. The Blood Treasure Flower that absorbed the True King’s Blood Essence might have been taken by Ye Chen, and he wouldn’t have had to use his trump card.
As a result, the treasure flower ended up in his hands, only to be burnt to ashes, and Ye Chen even lost his trump card.
“Oh well, it’s meaningless to think about these things. I really look forward to what kind of good things will be refreshed as rewards this time. What is that purple flame?”
These thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he whispered with anticipation.
It was at this moment that Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision changed.
He appeared in a sea of fire and saw a swaying, dreamy purple flame that was very beautiful but also gave off a strange and dangerous feeling.
“This flame…”
Wang Ping stared at the flame, his eyes widening in astonishment.
As an 8-tier Alchemist, Wang Ping certainly knew of the various strange flames in the world.
Ye Chen’s Earth Fiend Blazing Fire was famous and ranked tenth on the Exotic Fire list, directly raising Ye Chen’s combat power by a level.
Furthermore, as Ye Chen’s cultivation improved, the power of this flame would also grow in proportion, remaining useful even at the Emperor tier.
The flame before Wang Ping’s eyes was also a kind of Exotic Fire.
Its name was Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, said to be unique to the Purple Spirit Realm. It was ranked third on the Exotic Fire list, capable of creating illusions and stealthily burning people’s souls with its enchanting power.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 143: Unimaginable rewards! Suppress Ye Chen!
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 143: Unimaginable rewards! Suppress Ye Chen!
_2
Translator: 549690339
This was a terrifying flame, one that even emperors would be moved by and would not hesitate to rob.
If the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire were to appear in the world, it would likely cause emperors to wage war and bring bloody storms to the Purple Spirit Realm.
“Does Flaming Fire Secret Realm actually have such a terrifying flame?”
Wang Ping thought in disbelief.
“This fire, it can’t be Ye Chen’s too, right? If so, then Ye Chen is really living the dream. Getting two exotic fires at once—one ranked tenth and another ranked third.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
However, he quickly expelled this thought from his mind.
It’s possible, but not very likely.
At least Ye Chen couldn’t obtain this kind of flame at this stage.
Because his cultivation was simply incapable of subduing such a high-level flame.
Even the Son of Fortune has to make sense.
This opportunity might be Ye Chen’s, but by the time he subdued this flame, his cultivation would have to be at least in the Nirvana Boundary or even the King Realm; otherwise, he would have no qualifications to subdue the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.
“If I could refresh and get this flame, that would be awesome.”
Wang Ping was excited and couldn’t help thinking as his consciousness flickered, and his vision returned to normal.
Just then, the system’s voice sounded, making Wang Ping snap back to reality and unable to control his facial expression, revealing a look of ecstasy.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
. Half-step Life-and-Death Realm Cultivation.
. King-tier Martial skill, Heavenly Sword Skill.
. Supreme Divine skill, Ice and Fire Sword Song.
. Nirvana Fruit.
. Life-bound Sword Embryo (Near-Supreme Treasure).
. Various Secret Skills Practiced.
. Enlightenment Soul Grass.
. Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.
. True King Blood Flower.
. Red Talent – Sword Mystery Physique.”
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping stared at this reward list, his eyes bulging, and he completely lost his composure.
It couldn’t be helped, as this time the rewards were too terrifying. There was not a single simple item on the list.
The most mediocre item was the previous Nirvana Fruit, which he had considered a supreme treasure.
“Did my simulation use up all my luck for this time?”
Wang Ping was suspicious of this.
After all, he directly refreshed the Red Talent and then the rewards also directly refreshed a bunch of item rewards.
Among them was the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, which he had just marveled at how powerful it was.
It was outrageous— he was burned to death by the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, but somehow managed to touch it, then a bug occurred, and it was directly refreshed as a reward. What kind of luck was this?
“Never mind, even if my luck runs out and I have bad luck for a while, these rewards are too enticing!”
Wang Ping came to his senses, muttered, and felt a great pity.
How annoying—all these rewards, he wanted them all.
Although one should not be too greedy, it was difficult to resist when treasures were right in front of you.
“System, I choose ⑧. Purple Spirit Illusion Fire and ⑩. Red Talent – Sword Mystery Physique.”
Wang Ping sighed, and in the end, he could only choose two, making the best choice.
“Ding, detecting that the level of Purple Spirit Illusion Fire is too high, the Life Simulator will automatically process it, sealing it to a level the host can control. As the host’s cultivation improves, the maximum power within the range of his cultivation can be displayed.”
The system’s voice sounded again, making Wang Ping raise his eyebrows.
Well, wasn’t this a nice setting?
Life Simulators could be tricky at times, but they also had their thoughtful moments.
“It’s really nice. If it were the original Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, I might be gone as soon as I received it.”
Wang Ping shook his head and muttered in the bottom of his heart.
At this moment, Wang Ping felt a warm current surging inside his body. His physique changed directly, becoming the Sword Profound Body—a powerful constitution that even an Emperor Realm Ancestor of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land would value.
At the same time, a purple flame intertwined with illusory chains also appeared in his body.
After the appearance of the purple flame, the other elemental attributes in Wang Ping’s body changed instantly, being completely suppressed by the fire attribute, making fire supreme.
“So domineering.”
Wang Ping, seeing this scene, was left speechless.
However, Wang Ping didn’t pay too much attention to it. His path was still relatively clear for now, with sword skills as the main focus and other attributes as auxiliary. It didn’t matter which attribute gained a temporary advantage.
Once he started cultivating the Heavenly Sword Skill, the elemental spiritual essence in his body would probably disappear, leaving only the sword as the primary focus.
Using the artistic conception, he would purely use the mysteries of the various artistic conceptions, without the augmentation of spiritual essence.
And that little addition would not make much of a difference.
“With the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, even though I am currently only at the Half-step Yin-Yang Realm cultivation, and my martial skills and divine skills are not as good as Wang Ping’s configuration in the simulation, I can still kill the true inheritor disciples of the Holy Land.”
Wang Ping flicked his palm open, and the dream-like purple fire swayed out of his palm, making the corner of his mouth curve slightly.
The true inheritor disciples of the Holy Land had Yin and Yang Mirror cultivation and were all geniuses.
Attempting to cross the Great Realm and kill them was very, very difficult.
But with the Sword Profound Body and Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, even though his cultivation and divine skills were inferior, Wang Ping still had the confidence to battle them across the Great Realm, or even kill them.
Of course, Wang Ping had this confidence, but he didn’t blindly overestimate himself.
He knew very well that in any troop of geniuses, even a single small realm could bring a considerable gap in combat power.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: 143: Unimaginable Rewards! Suppressing Ye Chen! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: 143: Unimaginable Rewards! Suppressing Ye Chen! _3
Translator: 549690339
He is now able to kill those disciples who just entered the Half-step Yin-Yang Mirror not too long ago. However, if the cultivation gap is too big, it would be extremely difficult.
But, Wang Ping was not in a hurry at all.
Next, he only needs to perform a few more simulations. Whether it’s cultivation skills, divine skills or cultivation level itself, he would be able to catch up with ease.
Well, that’s not entirely correct. Wang Ping didn’t plan on increasing his cultivation level in a short time.
Because once he did so, the resources needed for him to simulate would skyrocket again.
He wanted to accumulate more simulation times to obtain more Blue Talents or even Red Talents, not to blindly increase his cultivation level. That would not be worthwhile.
Besides, Wang Ping thought about a critical issue.
That is, once his cultivation level gets too high, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s attitude towards him might change again.
Reached half-step Yin-Yang Mirror in his tens, he could be considered an extraordinary talent. If he used Pure Yin and Pure Yang power to form the Yin Yang Diagram to reach the Yin Yang Mirror Realm, it might be frightening to some extent, but still tolerable. There were examples of this in the world, and quite a few of them at that.
However, these examples weren’t easily attainable by ordinary talents of loose cultivators or forces under sacred lands. They were usually accomplished by top-notch Saint-tier characters.
This degree of achievement was acceptable. Wang Ping was just extremely fortunate.
But if he, as a loose cultivator and being only in his twenties or thirties, reached the Life and Death Realm or even the Nirvana Boundary, that would be terrifying.
By that time, any normal person could tell that something was off.
These people might not come to the conclusion that he had a cheat like a life simulator, but they would certainly guess that there was some astonishing fortune on him, thus generating unusual thoughts.
Besides, once his cultivation level gets higher and he tries to enter sacred lands, the sacred lands might not even accept him anymore.
Mighty talents nurtured from a young age by the sacred lands create a sense of home, but if someone was already powerful and sought to join the sacred lands to become a Saint Son, that would definitely raise suspicion.
Aren’t you joining the sacred lands just to knowingly take advantage of their legacy?
This was a reasonable suspicion.
By then, if he tried to join the sacred lands, he might instead end up walking into the trap.
Human nature is not to be tested.
Even if he thought positively, if he joined the sacred lands, the sacred lands might not harm him, but they might not let him be the Saint Son, and instead make him a person like a Guest Elder.
If he became a Guest Elder with his extraordinary talents, to win him over, the sacred lands might let him practice king-tier cultivation skills, but the thought of more advanced emperor-level skills and Emperor’s Legacy was unimaginable.
“Actually, once I have earned enough rewards from the sacred lands, there isn’t much sense in joining them.”
Thought Wang Ping quietly to himself.
“I just hope that the sacred lands could accept simulated Wang Ping in the Life and Death Realm as a Saint Son. The Nirvana Boundary is probably out of the question. However, if I hide my age when joining, things might not be as easy and I worry that it could be seen through. Those old monsters have eyes like a Fiery Golden Glance, they can see through anything.”
Finally, Wang Ping shook his head and decided not to think too much about it.
Just take one step at a time.
As for the danger of using the sacred land’s inheritance after failing to join the sacred land, he didn’t want to think about it right now.
“Of course, after thinking about it, not increasing my cultivation level to above the Life and Death Realm in a short time is the best choice.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and murmured.
There are many benefits to not breaking through to the realm above the Life and Death Realm.
The suspected danger in the sacred lands that he speculated was one of them.
Besides, once he reached the Life and Death Realm, the cultivation resources needed for the simulator would definitely skyrocket, giving one a headache.
The increase in the consumption of Spiritual Stones after improving the Great Realm is terrifying.
Wang Ping, is not even sure how many Spirit Stones are needed to breakthrough to the Yin Yang Mirror Realm, not to mention the Life and Death Realm.
Plus, there are so many opportunities in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, he must spend more time there and grab everything valuable.
Of course, as long as his cultivation level does not reach the Nirvana Boundary, entering the Flaming Fire Secret Realm is not an issue. If he reached the Life and Death Realm, he could choose to suppress his cultivation level to enter.
“Precisely speaking, maintaining my cultivation level at the Half-step Life and Death Stage is the best choice.”
After thinking it through, Wang Ping added another sentence.
In this case, he hoped that the next simulation could refresh a reward of Half-step Life and Death Cultivation.
Unfortunately, what level he could eventually reach was not in his control, but depended on when simulated Wang Ping fell.
Simulated Wang Ping wouldn’t just kill himself once he reached the Half-step Life and Death Level.
“Ah, what a hassle, if only I could freely choose how much cultivation to increase.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but complain.
The golden finger needs to be optimized. It’s imperative!
Otherwise, many things are not perfectly controlled, which makes him uncomfortable.
“There is one last simulation chance left; I’ll use the remaining Spirit Stones for the last time. Then, further simulations will depend on circumstances.”
After calming his thoughts, Wang Ping said inwardly.
“System, I want to make a paid simulation.”
“Ding, payment successful, the host’s remaining Top-tier Spirit Stone balance is 70, the Life Simulator starts running, Talent refresh in progress…”
The system’s familiar voice echoed in his ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: 143: Unimaginable Rewards! Suppressing Ye Chen! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: 143: Unimaginable Rewards! Suppressing Ye Chen! _4
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for not refreshing any talents.”
“It’s here, it has really begun.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
As expected, his guess was spot-on.
The previous round of simulations had completely exhausted his luck.
Frankly speaking, he was not surprised at all that he did not refresh any talents.
Or rather, not getting any talent through refreshing was already the best outcome.
He was genuinely afraid of refreshing some weird talents that would instantly cause him to explode and prevent him from gaining anything.
“Ding, life simulation begins…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared, with words floating up on it.
[Day one, you chose to cultivate.]
[In the blink of an eye, several decades have passed. You acted according to your memories, and there were not many unexpected occurrences.]
[During the Hundred Dynasties War, your performance shocked many masters.]
[In the semi-finals, you fought with Ji Bingyue, defeated her, and advanced to the finals.]
[In the final battle, a thrilling war broke out between you and Ye Chen. At the most crucial moment, you finally used your biggest trump card—the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire. Once the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire was released, Ye Chen was easily defeated by you, and you won the championship of the Hundred Dynasties War.]
[However, the emergence of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire shocked many people. After all, this is the third-ranking Exotic Fire in the Purple Spirit World, extremely famous, something that even emperors are crazy about, yet unexpectedly, it was obtained by you.]
[With your cultivation level, you could not possibly subdue this terrifying fire. However, you did it, breaking the norm. Many masters were tempted, and kings were no exception; they wished they could seize it from you on the spot.]
[But this is the Heavenly Sword Divine City; they did not dare to rob you. They could only look at you helplessly. You have anticipated this and felt helpless, but you did not regret using Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.]
[Because once you reach the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, it would definitely be exposed. It’s better to use it now and defeat Ye Chen. Honestly speaking, defeating Ye Chen has always been your goal. As a transmigrator, being suppressed by Ye Chen always makes you somewhat uncomfortable.]
[After Ye Chen was defeated by you, he also regained his composure. While shocked, he was also somewhat envious. After all, he wanted to enhance himself by acquiring various exotic fires, and all the flames on the Exotic Fire List were his targets, but unfortunately, he has not obtained one yet while you have already controlled the third strongest flame on the Exotic Fire List.]
[Of course, Ye Chen was just envious and did not have any other feelings about it, because, after all, you are his first teacher and guide. He respects you very much and could only sigh in admiration.]
[On the other hand, Cai Yonglong just complained that you were cheating again and had no other thoughts.]
[In the end, you were all brought to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land by a king-realm master of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and met the Heavenly Sword Saint Master. The Heavenly Sword Saint Master praised you even more, and just like in your memories, you successfully became the personal disciple of Sky Emperor.]
“Did I finally defeat Ye Chen?”
Looking at the simulation content, Wang Ping couldn’t help but smile.
This could be considered his first time defeating Ye Chen at the same cultivation level.
Although he had defeated Ye Chen once before when Ye Chen had fallen into delusion, Ye Chen’s cultivation level was probably much lower than his.
This time in the simulation, Wang Ping fought against him head-on, not to a draw but to an effortless victory.
This goes to show how awesome the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire is. It is worthy of being the third-ranking flame on the Exotic Fire List. It is much more powerful than the Earth Fiend Blazing Fire, which is tenth on the Exotic Fire List and which Ye Chen later obtained in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm.”What will unfold next… I’m truly eager to see.” Wang Ping whispered, his gaze still fixed on the luminescent screen.
[With the help of the Sky Emperor, you’ve managed to strike a balance between Yin and Yang, becoming the Saint Son, nurturing the Sword Fetus, and beginning rigorous cultivation. ]
[However, during this process, you didn’t choose to cultivate the Heavenly Sword Skill. Instead, you selected a Fire Attribute and sword cultivation skill. It would have been a waste not to cultivate the Fire Attribute skill because then, you wouldn’t have been able to wield the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire’s power. ]
[Following this, around thirty years passed in the blink of an eye, and your cultivation level advanced to the Half-step Life and Death Stage even faster than in your past memories. This progression is due to your new use of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire to forge your mental fortitude, which has shown immense improvement and greatly benefited your cultivation. ]
[In addition, your comprehension of Divine Skills is faster than the simulated Wang Ping in your memories. Currently, you have successfully comprehended your Supreme Divine Skills. This time, it’s not the Extreme Divine Skill: Ice Sun Sword Song, but the Illusionary Flame Sword Song, a Divine Skill that you’ve developed based on the properties of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire. ]
[This Divine Skill, when used alone, is already powerful. Combined with the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, its might skyrockets, pushing the boundaries of the Supreme Divine Skills rank. ]
[During these twenty years, Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue were also spurred by you, reaching the Half-step Life and Death Stage earlier and both comprehending their own Supreme Divine Skills. ]
[Both of them have sparred with you time and time again. However, with the boost from the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, you’ve become too strong for them, resulting in them never scoring a win against you all these years. Even after they reached the Half-step of Life and Death Stage and comprehended their Supreme Divine Skills, they were still no match for you. ]
[The two of them combined can’t even defeat you and can only make it tough for you at best. It’s fair to say that your combat power is supreme among your peers in the entire Purple Spirit Realm. Provincial elites from the Eastern Desolation, Northern Wastes, Southern Ridge, Western Desert, and Central Continent—none of them can match you.]
“Wow, is it really that scary?”
Wang Ping marvelled, gasping as he looked at the simulation content.
This Purple Spirit Illusion Fire seemed even stronger than he had thought, allowing him to directly become the top of his generation in the Purple Spirit Realm. Even the combined forces of Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue were no match for him, a truth that was quite unnerving.
“This is what it feels like to game the system, how satisfying.”
Wang Ping’s lips curved slightly upwards, a smile gracing his face.
Having been consistently pressed by Ye Chen during the simulation, he could finally suppress him this time.
Of course, Wang Ping was not overly confident.
He realized that once the Flaming Fire Secret Realm was opened, things might change.
But, even if Ye Chen obtained the Earth Fiend Blazing Fire, he would still be no match for him.
As for the treasured flower that absorbed the True King’s Blood, that too, belonged to him. At worst, Ye Chen was only equal to him and could not surpass him.
Based on the current information available, the only way Wang Ping could foresee Ye Chen surpassing him again was if Ye Chen obtained the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance.
The value of the possessions the emperor left in the secret realm was unimaginable considering how many treasures it contained.
“It seems that this Flaming Fire Emperor was not an ordinary entity among emperors.” Wang Ping’s eyes twinkled as he spoke softly to himself.
Would an ordinary emperor possess the Earth Fiend Flaming Fire?
And even nurture a Purple Spirit Illusion Fire?
