Obviously, the answer was no.
Furthermore, the secret realm created by a normal emperor after death might not even be able to attract the interest of the entire Purple Spirit Realm, let alone remain unbroken despite concerted efforts to crack it open securely.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement
Translator: 549690339
[Next, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm will open. You once again acted all high and mighty in front of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, but didn’t continue those arrogant lines, preventing yourself from falling due to excessive arrogance.]
[After the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened, you entered it. This time, the place you were teleported to was different from the previous two times. This time, you were lucky enough to be teleported near the blood pool.]
[You were very surprised and didn’t expect your luck to be this good. Immediately, you wanted to pick the True King Blood Flower and collect the King’s Remains.]
[When you made this move, the monster beast in the blood pool attacked you. You had anticipated this and defended yourself. An astonishing battle broke out between you two.]
[Although the Blood Pool demonic beast was powerful, after using the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire and deploying the Top-notch Divine Skill – Illusory Flame Sword Song, you succeeded in killing it, slaying it single-handedly.]
[After picking the True King Blood Flower and putting the King’s Remains and the blood pool into the Storage Ring, you prepared to leave. However, an unexpected event happened.]
[Before you, a spatial crack appeared directly, and a dreamlike purple flame appeared in front of you. It was the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.]
[The Purple Spirit Illusion Fire stared at you in surprise and doubt, seeing through the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire within your body. As the third-ranked fire on the Exotic Fire List, it was unique in this world unless it disappeared, only then could a new Purple Spirit Illusion Fire be born.]
[However, now a second Purple Spirit Illusion Fire appeared, and its aura was almost identical to the first one but sealed.]
[Soon, the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire noticed the second Purple Fire’s spiritual intelligence had been erased, and it immediately became furious, turning you into ashes.]
[Due to the Rebirth Tally, you resurrected, utterly terrified and wanting to escape, but you were ultimately too weak in front of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire and died tragically once again.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
“This…”
Wang Ping fell silent.
What kind of situation was this? He finally became stronger with the help of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, becoming the best among his peers, even able to comfortably defeat Ye Chen.
After entering the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, he was also very lucky to be teleported to a location near the blood pool, getting the chance to enjoy so many treasures all by himself.
However, it was precisely because he used the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire that things became even more dangerous.
He used the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire and was sensed by the existing Purple Spirit Illusion Fire in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm. It directly tore the space and appeared before him, killing him.
“The rules in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm are somewhat tricky.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
The rules stated that cultivators above the Nirvana Boundary were not allowed to enter.
Those in the Life and Death Realm had their cultivation suppressed upon entry.
However, there were Life and Death Realm monsters in the secret realm, as well as the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, which was at least at the Nirvana Boundary, and possibly even on the King Realm level.
Did this not mean that as long as the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire wished to, it could easily wipe out all the talented cultivators in the secret realm?
Of course, the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire had spiritual intelligence and knew the backgrounds of the people in the secret realm. It would not do so.
If it took such actions, it would anger all the major powers, which was a price not even an Emperor could bear, let alone the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.
Therefore, not only did it dare not kill indiscriminately, but it also had to hide itself to avoid being discovered.
If someone found out that the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire was inside, it would be in big trouble.
Of course, if someone was unfortunate enough to encounter it, they would only meet a gruesome death and couldn’t possibly spread the news.
“What a hassle.”
Wang Ping frowned.
Although he could use the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire freely in the outer world, not being able to use it in the secret realm would greatly reduce his advantages, making him unable to be truly invincible among his peers.
“Forget it, I actually don’t need to think so much. My current advantage is the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, but I can also crush them by accumulating other aspects of strength through simulations.”
Wang Ping shook his head and muttered to himself.
With the help of paid simulations to refine rewards, he had much more time for enlightenment than the other talented cultivators.
Moreover, his target was not limited to his peers. Ye Chen, who was part of the simulation, would eventually be left behind by him.
Only those who take shortcuts will be the strongest!
As Wang Ping was lost in his thoughts, his vision changed, and the scene where he was burned to death by the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire appeared.
With the simulated Wang Ping’s death, his vision returned to normal, and the system’s voice sounded at the right moment.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
. Half-step Life-and-Death Realm Cultivation.
. King-tier Cultivation Skill – Burn Yuan Sword Manual.
. King-tier Secret Skill.
. King-tier Divine Skill – Black Flame Burning Heaven.
. Supreme Divine Skill – Illusionary Flame Sword Song.
. Combat Experience.”
“System, I choose . Half-step Life-and-Death Realm Cultivation and the Supreme Divine Skill – Illusionary Flame Sword Song.”
Wang Ping glanced at the reward list and made his choice.
This time he could choose Half-step Life and Death Realm Cultivation, but he might not be able to choose it next time.
Since simulated Wang Ping died twice in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, the subsequent simulations would definitely be more cautious and not die easily.
That meant that Wang Ping’s cultivation in future simulations might reach the level of the Life and Death Realm.
By then, choosing would mean that paid simulations would consume too many resources, not choosing would mean that his cultivation would get stuck at the Half-step Yin-Yang Realm, which would be troublesome.
Having Half-step Yin-Yang Realm Cultivation would be a hidden danger for both his upcoming journey to the Black Yuan Country and any potential group tasks.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement_2
Translator: 549690339
As for the other rewards, there was no need to consider them. The Illusory Flame Sword Song, his self-created supreme divine skill, could maximize his combat power.
The rest of the stuff, though precious, could be obtained by continuing to run simulations.
Even so, Wang Ping had already begun to think that as the simulations progressed, king-tier cultivation skills, king-tier secret skills, and king-tier divine skills would become redundant.
The next time they appeared, they might be emperor-level.
With emperor-level skills, who would need king-level ones?
Why not learn the best, right?
As Wang Ping made his choice, his cultivation began to skyrocket.
The Yin Yang Diagram, directly transformed into a Yin Yang Diagram made up of pure Yin and pure Yang power, becoming increasingly clearer and stronger.
In the end, he even took that step and reached the half-step Life and Death Stage.
At the half-step Life-and-Death Stage, one could begin to understand the profundities of life and death, making it much more powerful than the Yin-Yang Realm.
“So this is the Half-step Life-and-Death Stage? It’s really powerful.”
Wang Ping felt the surging power within his body, in a very comfortable state of mind.
The difference between the Life and Death Realm and the Yin Yang Realm lies in the understanding of the mysteries of life and death.
The Life and Death Stage is also the most dangerous stage.
Because in the Life and Death Stage, one would switch between life and death repeatedly.
In the Life and Death Stage, one’s vitality and recovery ability were extremely tough. Even if the heart were exploded and limbs were severed, they could still regenerate. This was related to the power of life.
The power of death, on the other hand, only appeared during the small realm breakthroughs, and served as the deadly tribulation of the Life and Death Stage.
If one could not overcome the deadly tribulation, their body and divine soul would be corroded by the power of death, leading to complete death.
Therefore, the Life and Death Stage was a powerful and dangerous stage that should not be dealt with lightly.
If one were to unleash too much power or use too much of the power of death, they might trigger their own deadly tribulation and perish completely.
“The Life-and-Death Stage, I’m afraid, is the most dangerous stage. I wonder how many genius cultivators have fallen in the deadly tribulation of the Life-and-Death Stage, including the monster-like figures like Ji Bingyue.”
Wang Ping sighed somewhat.
The more talented one was, the more terrifying their death tribulation would be, and the more dangerous.
But on the other hand, once they passed their tribulation, the benefits they gained compared to ordinary Life-and-Death Stage cultivators were astonishing.
One could only say that blessings and disasters were inseparable.
Ordinary Life-and-Death Stage cultivators were timid in the face of each death tribulation, fearing their own demise, and sometimes even choosing to suppress their own cultivation.
Those true seekers of the dao, however, were fearless in the face of death tribulations and treated them as a means for personal growth.
In a certain sense, the Life-and-Death Stage and the Nirvana Boundary were two realms where ordinary cultivators could make a comeback.
In the Life-and-Death Stage, one could comprehend the mysteries of life and death, be reborn amidst life and death, and by increasing the difficulty of their death tribulation and then overcoming it, they could greatly make up for the defects in their Profound Elixir and Yin Yang Diagram, enhance their foundation, and broaden their path of cultivation.
As for the Nirvana Boundary, there was even less to say. Through Nirvana rebirth, one could undergo a sublimation.
These two realms could allow ordinary cultivators to strike back, as well as enable the talented to push further and catch up with the stronger cultivators. It was very profound.
Only, it was a pity that the vast majority of cultivators did not have the courage to strengthen their death tribulations, be reborn in life and death, and sublimate in Nirvana.
“If I were an ordinary cultivator, I probably wouldn’t take that risk either. Their choices can’t be said to be wrong.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
How many cultivators could directly face life and death?
With the Life-and-Death Stage cultivator having a lifespan of three to four thousand years, they could enjoy the many wonderful things the world had to offer. How many people would be willing to take that risk?
Wang Ping felt that even the Wang Ping in the simulations would not choose to make his death tribulation stronger in order to truly surpass others.
Wang Ping liked stability the most.
Immediately, Wang Ping calmed his thoughts and didn’t want to think about it anymore. Instead, he prepared to accept the memories of the divine skills.
As expected, the next second, numerous memories appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
It was the divine skills he had comprehended.
It had to be said that this reward was quite substantial, like getting four items for the price of one.
He not only had the insight of the top-notch divine skill – Illusory Flame Sword Song.
He also had the self-created superior divine skill – Heaven Burning Sun Slaying, the mid-tier divine skill – Blazing Sun Crimson Shadow, and the inferior divine skill – Fall Sky.
“With the four divine skills in hand, I can now selectively use them.”
Wang Ping opened his eyes and smiled slightly.
Divine skills, naturally, the more the better, as they could be selected for use.
After all, the higher the divine skill level, the more it consumed energy.
If one didn’t have any lower-level divine skills, using a supreme divine skill against an enemy would be like using a cannon to kill a mosquito, wasting one’s own energy.
“By the way, system, now that I have reached the half-step Life-and-Death Stage, how much will it cost for a paid simulation?”
After calming his emotions, Wang Ping asked in his heart.
Honestly, he was quite nervous.
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation level has reached half-step Life and Death Stage, the cost of paid simulation is 300,000 top-tier spirit stones, or thirty pounds of inferior spiritual liquid.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Wang Ping’s face twitched when he heard the amount.
Although he knew that from half-step Yin-Yang Realm cultivation to half-step Life-and-Death Stage cultivation, leaping an entire great realm along with many minor realms, the cost would definitely increase significantly.
But an increase of fifteen times was still outrageous.
The number of required top-tier spirit stones skyrocketed to 300,000. The sheer amount of them was headache-inducing just thinking about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 144: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fishing Law Enforcement_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 144: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fishing Law Enforcement_3
Translator: 549690339
Besides, a new ‘currency’ has emerged.
Lower-tier Spiritual Fluid, this is something far more precious than top-tier spirit stones, something that can only be used by masters in the Life and Death Realm in their cultivation.
If given to a Yin-Yang realm master for use, it would be used to break through bottlenecks, making it exceptionally valuable.
One could say that in the Heavenly Sea Country, the annual production of lower-tier Spiritual Fluid definitely wouldn’t be too much; only the Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family and those Great Sects with Life and Death Realm Masters can get hold of it.
“Ah, as my cultivation improves, the cost of these simulations really continues to rise.”
Wang Ping seemed troubled.
Of course, no matter how high this cost, it was still better than the initial simulator.
The expenditure at that time was truly life-draining.
A few more simulations, and a mountain of spirit stones from the entire universe would not be enough.
“Thinking about it, maybe I can expand other systems. Enhancements in other systems don’t increase expenses, but they can still make me stronger, saving many spirit stones.”
Wang Ping quietly thought to himself.
This idea, is not the first time it’s appeared…
However, what he considered is that none of the systems currently emerging in the chat group are too powerful.
Wang Shuqi’s World’s High Martial System is good, but a Martial Master is only comparable to the Transcendent Realm.
Of course, that world has relics of alien civilizations, so its upper limit must not be low.
However, it has not yet reached a higher level and needs to wait.
As for the Beast Taming World, this world has a decent upper limit, but training beasts requires resources from the indigenous world, in addition to the simulator not generating real creature rewards.
“Uh, that doesn’t seem right.”
Wang Ping jolted back to reality, muttering.
He previously thought that they could not be generated.
But the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire gained spiritual intelligence, could it be considered as a creature?
If so, it seems achievable.
“However, once generated, having their spiritual intelligence erased, would make Taming Beasts meaningless.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows, mumbling to himself.
“The Beast Taming World where Wu Yueming resides, I advise you to best avoid it in the short term.”
At that moment, Alpha’s voice abruptly resonated, causing Wang Ping to pause.
“What do you mean…” Wang Ping frowned, then quickly reacted: “Wait, you mean, that world’s ‘predecessor ransmigrators’ have noticed me?”
“Not them, but you have been noticed. To be precise, after your last visit, you were discovered.”
Alpha’s cold and unfeeling voice resonated.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping desperately looked.
“Using a power not of their world, ordinary Beast Tamers may not think much, but to top experts who command strong beasts in their world, it is noticeable.”
Alpha explained.
“Honestly, you just left a step early, if it were a bit later, you would likely be in a certain danger.”
Wang Ping was left speechless.
He stayed in the Beast Taming World for only a short while, yet he almost ended up stuck there. This is absurd.
What else could he say? As expected of a world with 10th tier battle power, it’s very powerful.
“Isn’t Wu Yueming in danger then? Last time he said he was pulled into the top Beast Taming Academy, it can be inferred that he was noticed.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows and said.
“Wu Yueming’s talent is destined to have him fare well in that world, but you are different, their attitude towards you is unknown, thus it’s necessary to be cautious.”
Alpha explained indifferently.
“I see.” Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully, then said: “Let it be, it doesn’t really matter if I don’t visit the Beast Taming World for now. After all, I can consider Qin Tian’s Cultivation World.”
“The power system of that world is inferior to yours, so there’s not much significance for your visit. Besides, these two systems will conflict.”
Alpha’s cold and ruthless voice echoed once again.
“Therefore, the High Martial System is the most suitable for dual cultivation. Since it’s the path of Qi and Blood, primarily refining the physical body, the energies surely will not conflict.”
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded, feeling helpless.
It seemed that, in the short term, he won’t be able to rely on other world systems to become stronger, thus achieving his purpose of saving spirit stones.
However, he could consider making a proactive simulation visit to Wang Shuqi’s world.
By simulating the future, he could get advanced systems from that world, which is also a good choice.
To be more precise, the feasibility seems very high.
“Once the main issues in my world are resolved, I can give it a try.”
Wang Ping thought quietly to himself.
“Cai, we can head to the Black Element Country now.”
Later on, after Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he found Cai Yonglong and spoke directly to him.
“Uh, are we going now? Don’t we still lack sufficient travel funds?”
Cai Yonglong asked with a shocked expression.
“Travel funds and such, we can just take advantage of a Great Sect and impose a penalty.”
Wang Ping hinted mysteriously.
They carried the Profound Turtle Spirit. As long as they leaked their spirit, someone would come to start trouble.
Then, they could justifiably counterattack, they were only asking for a sum of compensation from them, nothing excessive.
As for the victim, he felt he could definitely target Zhao Feng’s North Sun Sect.
The bastard in the life simulation has pissed him off before, the old Profound Elixir Realm bastard from North Sun Sect killed him several times when he was weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 144: Cultivation Skyrockets! Fishing Enforcement_4
Translator: 549690339
“Um, entrapment…”
Cai Yonglong’s eyes filled with a strange look.
“Is this really okay? Will anything go wrong? Our current strength is not enough to confront the great sects of Heavenly Sea Country, is it?”
Cai Yonglong hesitated.
“Don’t be scared, I’ve reached the Half-step Life and Death Stage in cultivation. Killing an ordinary Life and Death Realm practitioner is as simple as crushing an ant.”
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and said casually.
“What the hell!”
Cai Yonglong widened his eyes, his face blank.
It’s too outrageous for Wang Ping to have already reached half-step Life and Death Realm.
“Is this the Life Simulator? It’s amazing. All the golden fingers in the group are not as strong as Mr.Wang’s.”
Cai Yonglong muttered enviously.
“It’s not that exaggerated. Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan’s golden fingers are also very strong. Besides, Wu Jun’s golden finger has an insanely high upper limit too.”
Wang Ping said with a smile.
“Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan are indeed strong, but they can’t compare with Mr.Wang. As for Wu Jun… His upper limit is high, but his golden finger’s lower limit is also incredibly low.”
Cai Yonglong complained.
“Honestly, I don’t like these unstable golden fingers.”
“That’s just for now. Once Wu Jun levels up, I think you might not say that anymore.”
Wang Ping shook his head, still very optimistic about Wu Jun’s potential.
“By the way, Mr.Wang, are you sure you can easily kill Life and Death Realm practitioners? That’s Life and Death Realm, not Half-step Life and Death Realm.”
Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but ask again.
As one progresses in cultivation, the gap between realms becomes larger, making it increasingly difficult to surpass levels while fighting.
Even for those top-level saints, he had rarely heard of someone who could kill a Life and Death Realm Master at Half-step Life and Death Realm cultivation.
Could Wang Ping really do it?
After all, he had just reached the Half-step Life and Death Realm.
Even with cheats, there should be some logic, right?
“Don’t worry, I’m confident.”
Wang Ping said confidently.
“If you’re still worried, I’ll simulate it. Although I don’t want to waste a simulation opportunity, it’s better to be safe.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
He knew that the Life and Death Realm Masters of North Sun Sect were only at the 2nd tier of the Life and Death Realm.
To be precise, the Life and Death Realm Masters of Heavenly Sea Country were all quite weak, just like floor tiles of the Life and Death Realm.
Even the strongest Life-Death Realm Ancestor in Heavenly Sea Country was only at the 3rd tier of Life and Death Realm.
For ordinary Life and Death Realm practitioners like them, it was challenging to advance to the middle stage of the Life and Death Realm.
It could be said that the Life and Death Realm Masters in Heavenly Sea Country all had an inclination to muddle through their days.
They didn’t want to risk advancing, and after becoming a Life and Death Realm Master, they could enjoy a good life for three to four thousand years, which was already quite enjoyable.
This was also the mentality of those at the Half-step Life and Death Realm.
So, dealing with ordinary Life and Death Realm practitioners, Wang Ping really can kill them casually.
Of course, simulation was one thing, reality was another. Since they had no enmity, Wang Ping had no intention of slaughtering them or destroying their sect’s inheritance. His goal was simply to entrap them for profit.
“Well, forget it then. Simulation times are so precious, who knows when a task will appear; we can’t waste it.”
Upon hearing Wang Ping wanted to simulate, Cai Yonglong immediately shook his head to dissuade him.
“That’s what I think too.”
Wang Ping nodded slightly.
Now, he didn’t have enough resources to conduct a paid simulation. This made free simulations extraordinarily valuable, so he couldn’t waste any chances on them.
After all, there were many situations that needed a simulation.
A single task would need at least one simulation.
Although with his current strength, he could probably clear most ordinary group tasks with just one casual simulation to ensure safety, it was still necessary to use them sparingly to avoid accidents and running out of simulations.
After that, Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong didn’t waste any more time. After settling Ye Chen, they headed towards the territory where North Sun Sect was located.
Upon arriving at the mountain range where North Sun Sect was located, Cai Yonglong started his entrapment.
Cai Yonglong directly removed his concealment secret skill, blatantly exposing his Profound Turtle Spirit.
Soon enough, Wang Ping sensed a powerful aura approaching.
It was a 7th-Tier Profound Elixir Realm cultivator wearing the robe of a North Sun Sect elder.
“Hmph, ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant,’ you dare to come to the foot of North Sun Sect’s mountain, you’re really seeking death.”
“But, this is good. As long as I kill you, this old man can get some rewards.”
The 7th-Tier Profound Elixir Realm elder of North Sun Sect looked down at Cai Yonglong, snorting coldly.
“Who are you? I have no grievances or enmity with you. Why do you call me a ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’ and want to kill me?”
Cai Yonglong acted and shouted loudly.
“An ant like you isn’t qualified to know my identity. Die.”
The North Sun Sect elder looked down upon him and directly condensed a huge Spirit Element Palm to strike at Cai Yonglong.
Facing this terrifying attack, Cai Yonglong didn’t panic at all. Instead, he calmed down and revealed a mocking expression.
This startled the elder, making him feel quite strange.</p

chapters.title: Chapter 372: 144: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fishing Law Enforcement_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: 144: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Fishing Law Enforcement_5
Translator: 549690339
“A cultivator in the Profound Elixir Realm dares to try to kill my friend; you’ve got quite some courage.”
Just then, the gigantic Spiritual Essence Palm suddenly shattered, followed by an indifferent voice coming out.
Next, a horrific breath appeared, pervading the area.
This breath made the North Sun Sect Elder, with a 7th-tier Profound Elixir Realm cultivation, turn pale and stare fearfully at Wang Ping, who appeared in the sky without warning.
“This is the Yin-Yang Realm… no, wrong, it’s the Half-step Life and Death Realm.”
The North Sun Sect Elder trembled all over, terrified to the extreme.
Their North Sun Sect had a Half-step Life and Death Realm Ancestor, and he had felt the latter’s breath, so he could figure out what level Wang Ping’s breath was.
However, even though he felt that it was a Half-step Life and Death Realm, he couldn’t help but think that Wang Ping was much stronger than the other Ancestor.
For a moment, the North Sun Sect Elder felt goosebumps on his scalp, completely unexpected that the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ had such a powerful character.
Although he knew that they were currently under the North Sun Mountain Range controlled by the North Sun Sect, he didn’t yell out something like, “This is the North Sun Sect; even if you have Half-Step Life and Death Realm cultivation, don’t be too arrogant.”
Once he yelled that out, the other party could easily crush him on the spot, and nobody would be able to save him.
Of course, the North Sun Sect Elder knew that he didn’t need to die threatening anything. The powerful person releasing his breath without any restraint was bound to attract the North Sun Sect’s Ancestor to suppress him.
Sure enough, when the North Sun Sect Elder was having a brainstorm, more than ten terrifying breaths suddenly erupted from the North Sun Sect.
One after another, figures turned into Divine Halos and appeared in the nearby sky in an instant.
Heading the group were the two Life-Death Realm Ancestors of the North Sun Sect.
Behind them were three Half-Step Life and Death Realm Ancestors.
The rest were Yin-Yang realm masters.
These people were the entirety of the North Sun Sect’s foundations.
Wang Ping’s actions had directly startled all of them.
If it was an ordinary Half-step Life and Death realm cultivator, they wouldn’t have the ability to do this, merely startling one or two half-step Life and Death Realm Masters of the North Sun Sect at most.
But Wang Ping’s breath was too terrifying. Even though he was only at the Half-Step Life and Death Realm, he gave these old monsters a feeling that they were facing a Life and Death Realm Master.
Therefore, the Masters who were cultivating in the depths of the North Sun Sect were all alarmed and ran out one after another.
“Who are you? Why do you make things difficult for our North Sun Sect Elder?”
The leading North Sun Sect Life-Death Realm Ancestor stared at Wang Ping, with fear in his eyes, speaking solemnly.
As a Life-Death Realm Master who had lived for so many years, his experience was naturally far beyond that of ordinary people.
He had seen True Disciple of the Holy Land and even Saint Sons before.
However, even when those Holy children of the Holy Land reached the Half-step Life and Death realm, their breath didn’t feel as terrifying as Wang Ping’s and didn’t give him the feeling of danger.
“My name is Bai Tianhong, a humble loose cultivator. I happened to pass by your North Sun Sect and wanted to bring my friends to appreciate the beauty of the North Sun Mountain Range. I didn’t expect that your North Sun Sect Elder would insult us as ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ and try to kill him directly.”
Wang Ping calmly looked at the North Sun Sect Life-Death Realm Ancestor, speaking faintly.
Upon hearing this, the North Sun Sect Life-Death Realm Ancestor glanced at Cai Yonglong and the North Sun Sect Elder, frowning slightly.
‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ were indeed sensitive, and once encountered, killing them wouldn’t be a big deal.
Moreover, they could even gain some benefits, so naturally, they wouldn’t let them go if they encountered them.
But who would have thought that they’d kick on the iron plate?
It was astonishing that someone from the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants,’ to be precise, people from the Profound Turtle Continent, had grown to this level.
As a result, they couldn’t suppress others with their power anymore.
“This might be a misunderstanding. Fellow taoist, please do me a favor and let me apologize to you, and we’ll call it even. How about it?”
The Life-Death Realm Ancestor of the North Sun Sect spoke softly.
“Heh, your face counts for nothing.” Wang Ping sneered and said, “My friend’s life is not so cheap. Either you give us a thousand pounds of lower-tier Spiritual Fluid as compensation, or we go to war.”
Upon hearing this, the many Masters of the North Sun Sect’s expressions darkened, their anger reaching its peak.
A thousand pounds of Spiritual Fluid would practically hollow out the foundations of their North Sun Sect.
One should know that their North Sun Sect had only accumulated a few hundred pounds of lower-tier Spiritual Fluid thus far.
The Spiritual Fluids were simply too precious, having to be extracted from special ore veins by Life and Death realm cultivators through a secret skill, which was very troublesome.
For a moment, the numerous Masters of the North Sun Sect recognized it.
The other party was simply trying to fish using the law and extort them.
The key point was that they were the ones who made the first move.
The other side was completely standing on the moral high ground.
“Hmph, ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ ought to be punished by everyone, and our North Sun Sect did nothing wrong. On the contrary, it’s you, young man, who are despicable, trying to blackmail our North Sun Sect.”
The North Sun Sect Life-Death Realm Ancestor had a freezing cold gaze and spoke coldly.
“Do you really think our North Sun Sect is easy to bully?”

chapters.title: Chapter 373: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move! The True Body of a Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move! The True Body of a Master
Translator: 549690339
“Sorry, we really do think your North Sun Sect is easy to bully.”
Without waiting for Wang Ping to speak, Cai Yonglong muttered.
Upon hearing that, all the masters of the North Sun Sect turned black with anger.
“You are just an insignificant Spirit Sea Realm cultivator, you have no right to speak here.”
The Life-Death Realm Ancestor of the North Sun Sect revealed a murderous intent, directly unleashing the horrifying pressure of the Life and Death Realm, trying to crush Cai Yonglong into a blood fog, to serve as a warning for Wang Ping.
However, as soon as his pressure was released, Wang Ping flashed in front of Cai Yonglong, easily dissolving it away.
“I do not wish to cause unnecessary bloodshed. As long as your North Sun Sect provides us with reasonable compensation, we will drop the matter. Otherwise, don’t blame me for demolishing your North Sun Sect’s gate.”
Wang Ping’s clothes fluttered as he indifferently looked at the Life and Death Realm Ancestor of the North Sun Sect, and coldly snorted.
“You junior, don’t be so arrogant!”
The two Life and Death Realm masters of the North Sun Sect were enraged and suddenly attacked Wang Ping.
This move, neither of them held back. Although they didn’t use the unique power of death in the Life and Death Realm, they still used the most powerful divine skills of the North Sun Sect.
In an instant, two fiery dragons intertwined with the flames of the sun appeared in the sky, rushing towards Wang Ping. Anything in their path was completely destroyed.
“Superior Divine Skill: Heaven Burning Sun Slaying!”
Facing the powerful divine skills displayed simultaneously by the two Life and Death Realm masters, Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged. A mid-tier treasure sword appeared in his hand, and he slashed it out.
In a flash, purple flames filled the sky, attempting to burn everything, then transformed into two purple flame swords, instantly cutting the two fire dragons in half and burning them to ashes.
Fire, ignited by fire.
“What!?”
Seeing this scene, the two Life and Death Realm Masters of the North Sun Sect both had their pupils constrict, revealing shocked expressions.
Their divine skills, though not top-tier, were still mid-tier divine techniques and should not be so fragile.
Even if Wang Ping was a genius using a superior divine skill, it shouldn’t have been this outcome, something even saint-tier characters wouldn’t be able to achieve.
Their cultivation was far superior to Wang Ping’s!
However, this incredible scene appeared right before their eyes, leaving them terrified.
As for the other masters of the North Sun Sect, their scalps tingled, and they were extremely shocked.
It was too terrifying for someone with half-step Life and Death Realm cultivation to easily dismantle the attacks of two Life and Death Realm Masters, breaking their understanding.
“What exactly do you want?”
The Life-Death Realm Ancestor of the North Sun Sect somewhat succumbed, his tone no longer as harsh as before.
“I’ve said it before, I only want some compensation from your North Sun Sect for the sake of justice. You try to kill people without a word and I only ask for compensation. It’s already quite reasonable.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
“Fine! Then we, the North Sun Sect, will compensate you. However, we are not a powerful major sect, and can’t provide a thousand jin of inferior-tier essence fluid. We can only provide 200 jin of inferior-tier essence fluid. I hope you can understand, fellow Taoist.”
The two Life and Death Realm Ancestors of the North Sun Sect exchanged glances, feeling aggrieved, but could only say so with a compromised tone.
Through the recent battle, they understood several things.
Wang Ping’s strength far surpassed theirs.
Even if they risked their lives and used the power of death to fight, they were very likely not his opponents and would be killed by him.
Even if they really used their full power to suppress him, they absolutely couldn’t stop him from leaving.
If they let such a terrifying person escape, they would not be able to sleep at night.
With the growth rate of such a monstrous person, it might not be long before his strength soars again, and he could easily slaughter their entire North Sun Sect alone.
For this reason, it’s better to compromise and offer essence fluid to settle the matter.
If life and the sect’s inheritance were lost, there would be nothing left.
“Ancestor!”
Seeing that the two Life and Death Realm Ancestors were going to compromise, the other masters of the North Sun Sect were astonished, somewhat unwilling.
As for the other cultivators within the North Sun Sect, whether they were Profound Elixir Realm Elders or the disciples, they all wore incredulous expressions.
It could be said that their understanding had been completely shattered.
In their hearts, the invincible-like Yin Yang Realm Supreme Elders and the Life and Death Realm Ancestors, had to make compromises when facing a young half-step Life and Death Realm cultivator. This shook their faith to the core.
Their Tao Hearts were somewhat unstable.
“Silence.”
Seeing the others’ unwillingness, the two Life and Death Realm Ancestors shouted angrily.
At this, the others could only reluctantly shut their mouths, not daring to say anything more.
“200 jin of inferior-tier essence fluid, plus one million top-tier spirit stones, and this matter will be settled.”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows slightly and spoke.
“One million top-tier spirit stones…”
All the Ancestors of the North Sun Sect showed angry expressions.
Essence fluid was extremely precious, but it mostly had a greater impact on Yin Yang Realm, half-step Life and Death Realm, and Life and Death Realm cultivators.
For ordinary Life and Death Realm cultivators, essence fluid doesn’t have many benefits.
Since they would not dare to break through, their cultivation would have to be suppressed once it reached a certain level, preventing it from progressing further.
For the North Sun Sect, the greater use of essence fluid was as currency, or for purchasing treasures from other large countries.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move!
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move!
The True Body of a Master_2
Translator: 549690339
However, top-tier spirit stones were different.
Top-tier spirit stones were used to cultivate Transcendent Realm Cultivators and Profound Elixir Realm Cultivators. They were also needed for the dual cultivation of Yin-Yang Realm and the various businesses of the North Sun Sect, used for capital turnover.
Apart from that, in Heavenly Sea Country, top-tier spirit stones were also the best “currency.”
It could be said that their uses were very extensive.
Although the value of one million top-tier spirit stones was only equivalent to the level of 100 jin of inferior-tier spiritual fluid, the impact of pulling out one million top-tier spirit stones in one sweep due to their use reasons was even more severe than taking away 200 jin of inferior-tier spiritual fluid.
“Fellow taoist, what you’re doing is really excessive. At most I can give you 200 jin of inferior-tier spiritual fluid, plus 300,000 top-tier spirit stones. If you still don’t agree, then I would rather perish together with you.”
The North Sun Sect Ancestor said angrily.
“Then let it be. 200 jin of inferior-tier spiritual fluid, plus 300,000 top-tier spirit stones.”
Seeing the anger of the other party, Wang Ping also knew that his lion’s mouth had completely angered the other party, so he didn’t have any intention to continue making trouble. He agreed readily.
“Hehe, fellow taoist, here is what you want. I advise you, if you commit too many injustices, you will end up burying yourself. You should be careful in the future. Some forces are not as easy to bully as our North Sun Sect.”
Upon seeing Wang Ping agreeing, the North Sun Sect Ancestor finally breathed a sigh of relief. However, his face was still cold; after collecting the items, he directly handed a storage ring to Wang Ping and reminded him with a strange tone.
“Hehe, fellow taoist, don’t bother worrying about me. However, I advise you, trying to take advantage of small profits will lead to big losses. ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ are not easy to bully. In the pursuit of small gains, you hunted down ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’. Be careful when the truth is made public. The lineage of your North Sun Sect may be wiped out by others.”
Wang Ping took the storage ring. After checking the contents, he spoke with the same strange tone.
“Hmph.”
At these words, the North Sun Sect’s Life-Death Realm Ancestor’s face stiffened, and unable to reply, he could only snort coldly. He turned into a stream of light and flew back into the depths of the North Sun Sect.
The other powerful beings of the North Sun Sect saw this, and their faces were filled with anger as they glanced at Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong before turning into divine halos and flying away.
As for the Profound Elixir Realm elder, he was grabbed directly by a Yin-Yang realm master and taken away with them.
However, on the way back, Wang Ping vaguely saw the scene of the Profound Elixir Realm master being slapped.
“Damn, Mr. Wang, we’ve made a fortune this time! 300,000 top-tier spirit stones and 200 jin of primordial liquid!”
After all the powerful beings of the North Sun Sect had completely left, Cai Yonglong spoke excitedly.
“A fortune, yes, but danger as well. Let’s leave here quickly and change our identities to go to Black Element Country.”
Wang Ping shook his head, grabbed Cai Yonglong, and also turned into a divine halo to disappear from this place.
The North Sun Sect would certainly not be willing to be blackmailed just like that. They would spread the news of the appearance of the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’, attracting those terrifying beings to hunt them down.
Of course, the North Sun Sect would not have to do that themselves, as the commotion they caused was significant, and many cultivators had seen the scene. The news would spread sooner or later.
Before long, it would spread all over Heavenly Sea Country, and even to neighboring countries.
However, Wang Ping wasn’t particularly worried.
Because he and Cai Yonglong had changed their appearances, including significant adjustments to their height, weight, and so on. They even gave different names.
For this reason, as long as they were not targeted by a King-realm Master, they wouldn’t have to worry about being targeted.
If a King-realm Master were to target them specifically, Wang Ping would not have lived so long after leaving the Profound Turtle Continent amidst models in the past. He would have died immediately after leaving the Profound Turtle Continent.
As for Bai Tianhong, there was no need to mention him. He was the true ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’, and leaving the Profound Turtle Continent would mean death.
So, there was no need to worry.
Soon, Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong left Heavenly Sea Country through the Transmission Array.
Not long after the two left Heavenly Sea Country, the news of the North Sun Sect being baited and their Life-Death Realm Ancestors all failing to deal with the opponent, and having to eventually compensate 200 jin of inferior-tier spiritual fluid plus 300,000 top-tier spirit stones to settle the matter, spread far and wide, causing a sensation throughout the Heavenly Sea Country.
Many forces mocked the North Sun Sect, and the Heavenly Sea Kingdom Royal Family took pleasure in their misfortune.
However, more powerful beings and forces focused on Wang Ping’s whereabouts.
After all, he was a monster with a talent and same realm battle power surpassing many Holy Land Sons from the Profound Turtle Continent. If they could secretly befriend him, it would indeed be a good thing.
As for the ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendants’ issue, it could be totally ignored.
He simply possessed the ‘Profound Turtle Spirit’; he was not a real sinful bloodline descendant.
Even if he were a real ‘Sinful Bloodline Descendant’, what of it? Such a monstrous person was destined to become a king if he did not fall midway. Even attaining the rank of Quasi-Emperor was not impossible.
At that level, once such a figure had grown up, they would not be someone they could befriend or fawn upon.
For this reason, taking advantage of Wang Ping’s lack of growth, befriending him, giving him enough resources, and holding onto his thigh was the wise choice.
However, these forces were destined to be disappointed.
Because Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong had already left the Heavenly Sea Country, and after spending several days crossing several countries, they arrived at Black Light Valley in Black Element Country, where Nirvana Realm Masters presided.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move!
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move!
The True Body of a Master_3
Translator: 549690339
Black Light Valley, an eerie place in Black Element Country, is known for the occasional mysterious black lights that obscure the blue skies and white clouds. Some people call it the Demon Realm, inhabited by demons and monsters.
However, the big shots of Black Element Country know that there are no demons or monsters living here. Instead, an extremely powerful being is hiding within the valley.
The powerful being cultivates using light attribute methods that often cause the strange black light phenomena. Over time, the valley was renamed Black Light Valley because of this phenomenon.
“Although the Life Simulator described this great being as having cultivation in the Life and Death realm, it must not be ordinary Life and Death realm cultivation. Moreover, their cultivation should be very close to the Nirvana Boundary; otherwise, they wouldn’t have such extraordinary abilities,”
Wang Ping stood outside Black Light Valley, gazing at the strange phenomenon inside, deep in thought.
He was very powerful by now, yet he felt extremely dangerous when facing Black Light Valley.
It seemed as if he would definitely die as long as the Black Light Taoist attacked him.
“Mr. Wang, should we go in now? I have a feeling it’s a bit dangerous.”
Cai Yonglong looked at Black Light Valley and said with some hesitation.
“There’s nothing to be afraid of. Nothing will happen.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
Having simulated so many times already, if anything were to happen, the Wang Ping within the simulation would have encountered it long ago.
Thus, there was no need to be afraid.
“If you don’t dare to take the opportunity in front of you, then you’re destined to be stuck here in this life.”
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and said.
“Yeah, that’s true.”
Cai Yonglong nodded, collecting his thoughts and stepped into Black Light Valley.
As for Wang Ping, he had no intention of going in and waited outside.
“Young friend, it’s rare to come here. Why don’t you come in and have a chat with this old man too?”
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded, and Wang Ping felt a strange force appear, pulling him into Black Light Valley.
This caused Wang Ping’s expression to change slightly.
Although the other party clearly had no ill intentions, this force was too powerful, leaving him without any strength to resist.
Such cultivation truly was astonishing.
In addition, Wang Ping also felt fluctuations in space.
Tearing space apart to form a Space Channel was a technique of the Nirvana Boundary realm!
That is to say, the other party had already detected them, and if they had ill intentions, Wang Ping would have been killed silently before he could react.
As Wang Ping was thinking about various things, his vision changed, and he appeared deep inside the valley.
Deep in the valley, there was a small wooden house with a peach tree in the front courtyard.
Not far away from the small house, there was a clear spring accompanied by the sound of water, and a white crane drinking from it. It was like a paradise, giving people a feeling of tranquility and peace.
When Wang Ping came to his senses, he looked at the white-haired old man sitting in the courtyard.
The old man had a kind face, sitting on a wooden chair, looking at him with great interest.
As for Cai Yonglong, he had not appeared here.
“Born with Profound Turtle Spirit and growing to this level… not bad, not bad.”
The old man stroked his beard, looking at Wang Ping with admiration.
“Senior, my name is Bai Tianhong. May I know how to address you?”
Wang Ping bowed slightly and asked.
“Surname Bai? That’s the same surname as the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. In front of this old man, don’t try to use a fake name. If I wanted to harm you, there would be no way for you to escape, no matter what method you use.”
“Uh…” Wang Ping felt a little embarrassed.
He got used to using a fake name, but he forgot that there is not much difference between using a fake or real name in front of such powerful figures.
Not to mention, the other party clearly knew some information about the Sinful Bloodline Descendants.
“Wait, senior, are you a follower of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor?”
Wang Ping quickly reacted and asked uncertainly.
“In the past, this old man indeed followed the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. However, among his followers, I am nothing special, just a quasi-King.”
The white-haired old man sighed in reply.
Wang Ping was speechless.
A quasi-King who didn’t consider himself much was truly hard to respond to. It could only be said that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was too powerful back then.
Not only was he powerful himself, but his followers were also terrifying.
However, the problem arose again.
Since the white-haired old man was a quasi-King in the past, why did he fall to the level of a Life and Death realm cultivator, not even reaching the Nirvana Boundary realm now?
Of course, this doubt was temporarily set aside. Wang Ping also understood why the other party would choose to give Cai Yonglong his inheritance.
Firstly, it was because Cai Yonglong’s talent was indeed the most suitable for his inheritance.
Secondly, they both had the Profound Turtle Spirit and were recognized by the white-haired old man as their “own people.”
Strictly speaking, they were the descendants of previous followers.
“I dare to ask, have you lived for two lifetimes, senior?”
More thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he asked curiously.
“If I didn’t live for two lifetimes, I wouldn’t have survived until now. I would have died long ago. The lifespan of Nirvana Boundary realm cultivators is only around five to six thousand years, and while a quasi-King can live a bit longer, it’s not that much longer.”
The white-haired old man nodded and sighed.
“You seem very curious about my current cultivation?”
After a pause, the white-haired old man chuckled softly.
“Yes, junior is indeed very curious about senior’s current cultivation.”
Wang Ping didn’t feel embarrassed and nodded honestly.
In front of such powerful beings, his thoughts really could not be hidden. Since he was seen through anyway, it was better to be straightforward.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: 145: With One Move, Two Masters in the Life and Death Realm are Defeated! The Master’s True Form_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: 145: With One Move, Two Masters in the Life and Death Realm are Defeated! The Master’s True Form_4
Translator: 549690339
“Now as for my cultivation, it has reached only a half-step into the Nirvana Realm. My time is drawing near.”
The white-haired old man sighed and spoke.
“That’s strange. Senior, after living a life once again, shouldn’t your cultivation have advanced further?”
Wang Ping asked with some confusion.
“Who told you that you would become stronger in your second life than in your first?”
The white-haired old man shook his head with a smile.
“Living a life again, indeed your understanding of cultivation can help you proceed smoothly at first, but that’s as far as it goes. Cultivation depends largely on your fortune. In your first life, you might have had all sorts of opportunities that aided you in successfully breaking through, but in your second life, those opportunities might not come.”
After a pause, the white-haired old man spoke with a mixture of emotions.
“And the Bone and Root Aptitude of the descendants that you possess might not necessarily be comparable to that of your own body. The third point is that the incompatibility between the body and soul after possession actually has a big impact on cultivation. It won’t seem visible at first, but as your cultivation improves, it will become increasingly evident. The fourth point is that if you join major powers, they will immediately see through the incompatibility between your soul and your body. They won’t cultivate you. And not to mention, my identity is quite sensitive.”
“Hence, the body possession only makes one weaker, and generally, the limit can’t compare to the first life. Of course, there are exceptions, but they are just that – exceptions, rare cases, not the norm.”
Hearing the white-haired old man’s words, Wang Ping also understood a lot of things.
It seemed, possessing a body was not as simple as he thought.
At the same time, he finally understood why in competitions like the Hundred Dynasties War, there were no old monsters participating who had lived a second life. It turns out their soul-body incompatibility would be seen through.
At that time, if you were to go on stage and bully the young, you’d be outright socially dead.
Social death is one thing, more importantly, you might get smacked dead on the spot by an annoyed master.
“Those who possess descendants and live a second life rarely achieve great things. Therefore, in the path of cultivation, one must determine to reach the peak in the first life, or else they’d lose the qualification.”
Seeing Wang Ping deep in thought, the white-haired old man advised further.
“Thank you, senior, for your guidance. I won’t have a fluke mentality.”
Wang Ping bowed slightly and seriously replied.
He definitely won’t have a fluke mind, thinking it’s okay to die once.
As for the simulated Wang Ping, that’s none of his business.
“That’s very good.”
The white-haired old man nodded in satisfaction.
He was genuinely pleased that such a genius like Wang Ping could emerge on the Profound Turtle Continent.
Perhaps, there was hope for the lineage of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
For this, he naturally wanted to give a good lesson and didn’t want these two little ones to take a detour.
“Speaking of which, little fellow, what rank is the Profound Elixir you condensed and the Yin Yang Diagram?”
The white-haired old man then asked curiously.
He could see that Wang Ping was extraordinary, but he didn’t know what level of genius Wang Ping belonged to.
“Flawless Profound Elixir, perfect Yin Yang Diagram.”
Wang Ping hesitated a bit before giving his answer.
He wasn’t the simulated Wang Ping, facing a hopeless situation with not a clue on what to do, only able to wait for death.
He had the Rebirth tally, had Alpha supporting him, had the chat group’s Delivery Function; he could be transported to other worlds to escape.
So, he truly wasn’t afraid of the other party harming him.
“What!?”
Hearing this, the white-haired old man finally couldn’t keep his composure. His eyes widened with his face full of shock.
A Flawless Profound Elixir, a perfect Yin Yang Diagram – even in the Holy Land, hardly anyone could achieve this.
Although, with the Holy Land’s resources, cultivating such a genius would be easy, not every genius is worth the resources of the Holy Land.
To make the Holy Land produce precious resources for cultivation, that person had to be a monster far superior to ordinary geniuses.
And Wang Ping, coming from the Profound Turtle Continent and undoubtedly being a loose cultivator, reaching this step was nothing short of astonishing, completely beyond common reason.
“So it turns out you’re the protagonist of this era…”
The white-haired old man finally gathered himself, stared at Wang Ping, and spoke with awe.
Every era has its protagonist, and not just one.
These people, whether in talent or fortune, are far superior to others. They are destined to become kings and have the potential to become emperors.
In the white-haired old man’s view, Wang Ping was the protagonist of this era, a person who possessed great fortune.
“The protagonist of the era…”
Wang Ping’s eyes revealed his thoughts, but he didn’t explain anything.
He wasn’t any protagonist of the era, and he had nothing to do with any great fortune.
He was just an ordinary person trying to survive.
The true Son of Fortune, the protagonist of the era, was Ye Chen.
“So it seems, there really is hope for the lineage of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor…”
The white-haired old man smiled, continuing to mumble to himself.
“Alas, I can’t help you with anything. I don’t even have the qualification and time to be your Dao Protector.”
After a pause, the white-haired old man spoke with a face full of regret.
Wang Ping had already grown to a half-step Life and Death Stage, and his previous realms were cultivated quite perfectly, not needing any help, and he couldn’t help either.
As for resources, he also didn’t have any treasures.
As for divine skills, although he had his self-created Supreme Divine Skills, but in the white-haired old man’s view, they wouldn’t be of much use to Wang Ping.
Because the paths they tread were different, Wang Ping couldn’t use his Divine Skills, and it was difficult to cultivate his Cultivation Skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move! The True Body of a Master_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: 145: Defeat Two Great Life and Death Realm Masters with One Move! The True Body of a Master_5
Translator: 549690339
Not to mention, in the view of the white-haired old man, Wang Ping, the protagonist of the era, must have also created his own Divine Skills, which might even be stronger than his.
“Senior, don’t worry too much. Although you can’t help me, you can still cultivate my friend. His talent in the light attribute is amazing. I brought him here to see if you would be willing to accept him as a disciple.”
Wang Ping said politely.
“Hmm, I can see that.”
The white-haired old man nodded and made a hand gesture, and a luminescent screen appeared before Wang Ping’s eyes.
In the virtual luminescent screen, Cai Yonglong was undergoing trials, trying to find the path best suited to him.
“It will probably take him another week to get here, we can wait patiently.”
The white-haired old man stroked his beard and spoke.
“When he arrives, this old man will train him well. Meeting someone who is most suited to inherit this old man’s mantle before withering away, I can die without regrets.”
Wang Ping sighed, not knowing how to respond.
After all, he couldn’t possibly stop the white-haired old man from initiating Cai Yonglong.
Their purpose here was precisely this.
But, witnessing the end of a powerful generation, his feelings were still quite complicated.
“Don’t sigh for me, I’ve clung to life for so many years. My friends and family have all died. It’s lonely, boring, and death only means liberation for me.”
Seeing Wang Ping sigh, the white-haired old man shook his head slightly.
“Bored with life…”
Wang Ping mumbled to himself.
He yearned for immortality, but in his previous life, there had always been many debates about immortality.
Your loved ones wouldn’t be immortal even if you were, so after living for a long time, loneliness and boredom would consume many, who would then seek death voluntarily.
Of course, there were also many who, after living for a long time, became numb and indifferent as they witnessed the deaths of their loved ones one after another.
Some of the great emperors of the Ye Hei World protected the common people before they severed their own bodies. However, after living for too long and losing their loved ones, they became numb and chose to fall into depravity just for the sake of becoming immortal.
However, Wang Ping didn’t think he would seek death himself.
With the chat group, he had insight into some events in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms. He would never lack companions and wouldn’t be lonely.
Furthermore, even if he were lonely, he would carry on.
Of course, Wang Ping’s current life was still short. Whether he would change in the future is another matter.
“The topic seems a bit heavy. Speaking of the Emperor, how much do you know?”
Seeing Wang Ping lost in thought, the white-haired old man smiled and changed the subject.
“A lot.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and recounted everything he knew in detail.
“It seems I don’t need to add anything.”
Seeing how much Wang Ping knew, the white-haired old man nodded, not too surprised.
Wang Ping could grow to this point because he had learned everything he needed to know.
If he didn’t know these things, then he wouldn’t have used a Secret Skill to conceal his aura, nor would he have reached his current level. Instead, he would have died long ago.
“People in the world curse the Emperor, but this old man believes the truth will be revealed one day. I also believe that the Emperor will not be possessed by others, but will eliminate that strange soul and be born anew, taking back everything we’ve lost and uprooting all those despicable characters.”
The white-haired old man looked up at the sky with hope and longing in his eyes, which then turned into despair.
“However, I’m afraid I won’t be able to see that day. It’s up to you to bear witness from now on.”
Wang Ping’s mood was extraordinarily heavy, and he couldn’t find words of comfort.
The white-haired old man didn’t know the situation of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, but Wang Ping did. Perhaps he was the only one in this world who knew the truth.
For the Guilt-Punishing Emperor to be born again, it seemed unlikely.
Targeted and possessed by the strange spirit, the fact that he could regain partial control of his body at a critical moment and seal himself, along with the Profound Turtle, was already quite remarkable. But to eliminate the strange spirit was absolutely impossible.
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s current situation was likely that his body was completely under the control of the strange spirit, and because of his various methods, he was completely sealed and unable to emerge.
Of course, saying he was completely sealed was not entirely accurate.
At least, there would be signs of the seal loosening in the future.
That is to say, the strange spirit that possessed the Guilt-Punishing Emperor would reappear, not the Guilt-Punishing Emperor himself.
By then, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s reputation would be completely ruined.
In normal circumstances, that’s what would happen.
“However, I won’t let that happen.”
Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
This wasn’t due to sentimentality, but simply out of concern for his own life and for the group points.
If the strange spirit reappeared, he wouldn’t be able to escape either.
Not to mention, the value of such a powerful strange spirit was immeasurable and was something he couldn’t afford to miss out on.
For the next month, Wang Ping and the white-haired old man kept talking.
Perhaps it was because the white-haired old man hadn’t talked to someone for such a long time, he had a lot to say and told Wang Ping about various things from the past.
Wang Ping was happy to listen.
Meanwhile, the white-haired old man would occasionally discuss Tao with him.
Although the white-haired old man’s cultivation was only at the half-step Nirvana Realm, he had lived for over ten thousand years and had a deep understanding of cultivation that Wang Ping couldn’t match. Some of his insights were very enlightening for Wang Ping.
This allowed Wang Ping to truly experience the feeling of Enlightenment, something very different from the simulated insights he had gained.
As for Cai Yonglong, he had already completed his trials and had also been taught cultivation by the white-haired old man. From time to time, the white-haired old man would initiate him, improving Cai Yonglong’s cultivation.
Of course, most of the white-haired old man’s cultivation was used to temper Cai Yonglong’s foundation and improve his talent, while the improvement of his cultivation was secondary.
This kind of secret method was very rare and came at a great cost.
It was only because the old man had once been a quasi-King and had already seen through life and death that he was willing to try this method.
Otherwise, other masters would not be able to do such a thing, and even if they could, very few would choose to do so.
In the end, the white-haired old man finished refining Cai Yonglong’s foundation and root, as well as raised his cultivation to Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection. Then, he withered away.
Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong erected a tombstone for the white-haired old man, their mood incredibly complex.
Wang Ping had known the white-haired old man for a month and felt a bond that transcended the years between them.
As for Cai Yonglong, there was even less need to say; the white-haired old man had greatly indebted him, becoming his second master.

chapters.title: Chapter 378: 146: Optimization! True Invincibility in the Same Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: 146: Optimization! True Invincibility in the Same Realm!
Translator: 549690339
“Master, once I have the ability, I will definitely bring you back to life.”
Cai Yonglong bowed to the tombstone and said solemnly.
Seeing Cai Yonglong bowing, Wang Ping did not ridicule him for “empty talk” this time.
After all, Cai Yonglong was serious, and he sincerely admired the open-mindedness of the white-haired old man.
“But, does he really want to be resurrected?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but wonder about this question.
After all, the old man was truly tired of living.
Resurrecting the lonely him was, in a sense, a cruel thing to do.
Unless, you bring back some of his loved ones to life as well, that would give him a reason to live on.
“Forget it, there’s no point in thinking too much. What the future will look like is a matter for the future.”
Wang Ping shook his head and stopped delving into it.
“Mr. Wang, where are we going next?”
At this point, Cai Yonglong stood up and asked Wang Ping.
They came to Black Light Valley in order to make him stronger.
Now that their goal had been achieved, it seemed time to consider what to do next.
“We probably need to stay here for a while longer. You should eat this fruit to raise your Profound Elixir Tier to the Flawless level, and at the same time, it can also make up for some hidden dangers after the initiation.”
Wang Ping smiled slightly, took out the Nirvana Fruit, and said.
“Mr. Wang, what kind of fruit is this? It’s amazing!”
Cai Yonglong looked at the Nirvana Fruit with astonishment.
Now that he was no longer a newbie, he naturally knew the concept of a Flawless Profound Elixir.
“Nirvana Fruit.”
Wang Ping casually explained the origin and value of the Nirvana Fruit.
“Damn, Mr. Wang, no, you’re really my real father!”
After hearing the explanation, Cai Yonglong hugged Wang Ping directly, his face flushed with excitement and tears in his eyes.
Damn it, such a precious item, Mr. Wang just gave it to him like that. He was really good to him.
“Son of a bitch, don’t use that expression while holding me, it’s disgusting.”
Wang Ping’s forehead was covered with black lines, and he sent Cai Yonglong flying away.
“Ahem, I was just too excited.”
Cai Yonglong got up from the ground a little embarrassed.
“But, Mr. Wang, I owe you more and more. Words of thanks just seem pale.”
Then, Cai Yonglong sighed again.
“Stop whining, it’s better for you to run errands and do things for me in the future than anything else.”
Wang Ping curled his lips.
“That’s a must.”
Cai Yonglong smirked.
“Well, Mr. Wang, I will continue my retreat. Once I’m out, we will leave this place.”
“Hmm.”
Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say much more.
“By the way, these are some things my master left for me. Although there aren’t many top-tier Spirit Stones and Primordial Liquid that Mr. Wang needs, they might still be of some help to you.”
Cai Yonglong suddenly seemed to have thought of something and handed over a Storage Ring.
Wang Ping did not hesitate and took it directly.
Although he had taken a lot from the North Sun Sect, he would never have too many Spirit Stones and Primordial Liquids.
The more of these things, the better.
“Well, Mr. Wang, you can get busy. I’ll go into seclusion.”
Cai Yonglong smirked and left the place.
Meanwhile, Wang Ping sat on the white-haired old man’s favorite wooden chair and checked the items in the Storage Ring.
It has to be said that the white-haired old man had been in hiding for a long time and didn’t have much good stuff.
There were only about a million top-tier Spirit Stones.
As for the lower-tier Spiritual Fluid, there were only about three hundred catties.
Although these resources were already comparable to the foundation of a sect like the North Sun Sect, they appeared very little to the white-haired old man, who had been a quasi-King in his previous life and was now at the Half-step Nirvana Realm.
It could only be said that the old man had indeed lost interest in many things and didn’t care to compete for them.
Wang Ping didn’t mind these things, though.
After all, they were enough for him to simulate many times, and they were sufficient for the present.
Besides, there were other good things in the old man’s storage ring.
One top-tier Treasure Saber.
Two top-tier Treasures.
There were more than ten middle and lower-tier Treasures combined.
Cultivation Skill manuals and Divine Skills were the most abundant and valuable.
King-tier Cultivation Skill: Black Light Skills, which was the Cultivation Skill practiced by the white-haired old man.
There were also his annotations on it.
Black Light Skills were only Heaven-tier nonsuch Cultivation Skills, but they were improved into King-tier Cultivation Skills by the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
This showed the character of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and how good he was to his followers.
How precious the Emperor’s time was, but he could take the time to help a Quasi-King Cultivation follower improve their Cultivation Skill.
This probably was not an isolated case.
No wonder those followers were so fanatic about the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, worshipping and respecting him from the bottom of their hearts.
“Ding, congratulations host on successfully triggering the Optimization Option. Do you want to optimize the Cultivation Skill immediately?”
At this moment, an option suddenly appeared in front of Wang Ping, making him slightly startled.
Did it trigger an option?
This was quite a surprise.
Wang Ping looked at the Cultivation Skill and hesitated whether or not to optimize it.
After all, this was the most precious legacy of the white-haired old man.
In the end, Wang Ping chose to optimize it.
Because Cai Yonglong had already practiced Black Light Skills, he wasn’t worried about losing it if the optimization failed.
As Wang Ping chose to optimize, the Black Light Skills were enveloped by a burst of white light.
“Ding, optimization successful. Congratulations, host, on obtaining the King-tier skill: Primordial Spirit Skill.”
King-tier skill: Primordial Spirit Skill – Allows multi-attribute cultivation, can freely switch the main attribute, among King-tier Cultivation Skills, it belongs to the top-notch, and has extremely high potential for further innovation.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: 146: Optimization! The Real Unrivaled in the Same Realm! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: 146: Optimization! The Real Unrivaled in the Same Realm! _2
Translator: 549690339
Following that, a piece of information popped up, making Wang Ping reveal a surprised and happy expression.
“It actually worked, and there’s even an explanation! This is really delightful!”
Wang Ping had a full-face smile and was very pleased.
He had always wanted the Primordial Spirit Skill.
However, it never showed up in previous simulations or there were other rewards he had to choose.
Now, his wish was granted, and it was even a king-tier Primordial Spirit Skill.
With this Primordial Spirit Skill, Wang Ping’s strength would definitely increase significantly after switching to this cultivation technique.
After all, this was the most suitable cultivation technique for him, bar none.
At the very least, this was the case among king-tier Cultivation Skills.
More importantly, the explanation even hinted that this skill could be improved to increase its level, with great potential.
Wang Ping believed that the original Jiuyou Demon Art of his transmigrator predecessor, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, must not have been an emperor-level Demonic Skill. It must have been improved step by step.
Those emperor-level skills are also the most suitable skills created by emperors for themselves.
Therefore, Wang Ping would sooner or later have to walk on this path.
There’s no need to constantly switch to higher-level skills. Instead, create your own high-level skills when your abilities are sufficient. This is the right way.
Perhaps the necessary condition for becoming an emperor lies in following one’s own path.
Of course, all of this was Wang Ping’s speculation, and whether this was the case remained uncertain.
Then, Wang Ping touched the other items, wanting to see if they could trigger optimization options.
As a result, Wang Ping was disappointed.
None of them triggered any options.
However, it was a very normal outcome.
After all, the probability of triggering the unstable Optimizer is really low.
Comparatively, the success rate of optimization is not as low as Wang Ping guessed, and it is probably around 40 or 50 percent.
“After more than a month, plus the extra optimization option that I just triggered, my luck should have improved a bit. It should be possible to proceed with the simulation.”
Wang Ping collected his thoughts and quietly thought to himself.
“System, I want to spend 300,000 top-tier Spirit Stones to do the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping spoke up.
“Ding, payment successful. Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice quickly rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations host for successfully refreshing the White Talent·Dance and Sing Rap; Green Talent·Self-Destruction Expert.”
“Uh…”
Wang Ping fell silent.
Well, it looks like his luck is still somewhat lacking.
However, since he has already initiated the simulation, there is no need to be too concerned.
Even if he cannot refresh higher-level talents, being able to refresh various rewards is still pretty good.
“System, I choose Green Talent·Self-Destruction Expert.”
Wang Ping casually selected a talent and wanted the simulation to start as soon as possible.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out again, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged as well.
[Day 1, you chose to practice the Primordial Spirit Skill …]
[One month later, Cai Yonglong comes out of seclusion with a congealed Immaculate Profound Elixir. You both decide to return to Heavenly Sea Country. When you return, you find out that Ye Chen has disappeared. You inquire about the news and hear that someone descended there and took Ye Chen away.]
[Understanding the situation, you realize there must be a butterfly effect. However, you don’t worry too much because, in all likelihood, Ye Chen is not dead. It’s possible that he’s taken away due to a new opportunity that arises for him.]
[Afterward, you consider whether it’s worth wasting decades participating in the Hundred Dynasties War just to show off. Therefore, you decide to go directly to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land with Cai Yonglong, intending to join the Divine Land directly.]
[In the end, your visit to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land attracts the attention of the big shots there, who recognize your powerful talents and allow you both to join. After entering the Divine Land, you unhesitatingly show off your Sword Profound Body, which causes another sensation.]
[This shakes the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, as Sky Emperor personally accepts you as an apprentice, and Cai Yonglong also receives attention from the higher-ups of the Divine Land thanks to you.]
“It seems that going to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land with a cultivation level just below the Life and Death Realm won’t pose any problems. I can be at ease.”
Wang Ping watched the simulation content and silently pondered.
However, he was still pondering a question.
That is, whether or not he should go to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land in advance in the real world.
Joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and then further increasing his strength might be safe.
Of course, there’s also the possibility of exposing his secrets.
Although the emperors are indifferent to many things, they might still be interested if they discern any abnormalities in him.
After all, his secrets are too terrifying, and even people on the level of emperors and higher-ups cannot treat them lightly.
“Forget it, let’s play it safe. I don’t need to take that risk. I just need to keep a low profile, then rely on the simulated Wang Ping to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.”
In the end, Wang Ping shook his head, gave up on the idea, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, several decades have passed. During this time, due to the training from the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, Cai Yonglong’s cultivation reached the Yin Yang Realm early on. However, your cultivation has not changed at all. Although you can break through to the Life and Death Realm early, you choose to suppress your cultivation and not break through in order to enter the Flaming Fire Secret Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 146: Optimization! Truly Unrivaled at the Same Level! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 146: Optimization! Truly Unrivaled at the Same Level! _3
Translator: 549690339
[Thus, you put all your energy into cultivating the Primordial Spirit Skill, cultivating secret skills, comprehending divine skills, and understanding domain embryos over these decades.]
[As for the Primordial Spirit Skill, you have now formed multiple attributes at the same time. The capacity of mana in your body is much stronger than that of other cultivators at the same realm. As for Divine Skills, although you haven’t made further progress and comprehended your own king-tier divine skill, you have learned several king-tier divine skills from Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[The Primordial Spirit Skill grants you unparalleled adaptability. As long as you comprehend a Great Perfection Realm of Conception, you can learn the corresponding king-tier divine skill. It is true that your memory contains knowledge that creating your own divine skills is stronger than cultivating those created by others, but everything is relative.]
[A self-created lower-tier divine skill is naturally stronger than a cultivated lower-tier divine skill created by others, but it is not necessarily stronger than a cultivated mid-tier divine skill created by them. Similarly, at the level of king-tier divine skills, it is much stronger than supreme divine skills, as it is a change in quality.]
[Therefore, once you master king-tier divine skills, they are stronger than self-created supreme divine skills. And since you have a strong adaptability, you are even stronger when using them. Of course, if you use the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire in combination with your self-created supreme divine skill Illusionary Flame Sword Song, it is comparable to the power of an ordinary king-tier divine skill.]
[However, this is also relative. If you use a fire attribute king-tier divine skill combined with the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, it will be even more powerful.]
