[In summary, you are truly invincible in the same realm in the entire Purple Spirit Realm, even without using the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire. No one in the same realm is your match. If you use the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, you even have the confidence to slay Saint-tier life and death realm experts across realms.]
[It can be said that, even the Sky Emperor, who is your master, is extremely amazed by your strength and believes that you are a once-in-ten-thousand-year monster and the protagonist of this era.]
[As for the Sky Emperor’s remark that you are the protagonist of this era, you never responded and just smiled without saying anything. You cannot bear the weight of being the protagonist of an era.]
[Soon after, the Hundred Dynasties War begins, and you and Cai Yonglong both arrive at the Heavenly Sword Divine City to watch this session’s Hundred Dynasties War. Your appearance surprises many people because you and Cei Yonglong are the seventh and eighth Saint Sons of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Especially you, being the direct disciple of the Sky Emperor and having a very high status.]
[For a time, many people are curious about how strong you both are. The reason for this is that you have both been very low-key and rarely taken action in recent years, leaving many people in the dark about your strength.]
[You both don’t care about this and just catch up with Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue. Ye Chen also talks about his experiences over the years. It turns out that you had caused too much commotion, attracting many masters to the Heavenly Sea Country. One of them, a quasi-King, was very capable and traced his way to Ye Chen. Then he took him away forcefully and made him his disciple.]
[Over the years, he has been forced to continuously undergo various grueling cultivation sessions and life-and-death trials with little worldly exposure.]
[You and Cai Yonglong are both speechless about this. It can only be said that the Son of Fortune is indeed the Son of Fortune. Even a butterfly effect won’t cause him any harm, but rather make his life even better.]
[After all, in your memory, Ye Chen, the loose cultivator, should have followed the leveling-up route, supported by a Life and Death Realm-spirit-ring-wearing grandfather acting as his guide. However, the butterfly effect you caused led to a quasi-King taking him as a disciple, making Ye Chen’s path smoother.]
[Next, the Hundred Dynasties War begins, and just like in your memory, Ye Chen takes the first place, defeating Ji Bingyue, and then both of them join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades pass. During these decades, Ye Chen, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong all break through to the Half-step Life and Death Stage one after another, only one step away from the Life and Death Realm.]
[As for your cultivation base, it hasn’t changed and is still at the Half-step Life and Death Stage, but your foundation has reached an astonishing level. You have a premonition that once you break through to the Life and Death Realm, it will definitely not be as simple as the first level.]
[At the same time, your comprehension in other areas has improved over these decades, and you have also comprehended the Great Perfection Spatial Conception. Besides that, you have also confirmed the path you will follow in the distant future.]
[The Primordial Spirit Skill allows you to cultivate many attributes, but doing so will make things too complicated. To return to unity, Chaos encompasses everything.]
[However, following the path of Chaos is extremely difficult, and you still don’t have the qualifications to reach it. After all, you haven’t even touched the domain of time, let alone Chaos. As for the spatial aspect, your master, the Emperor of Kongtian, follows the path of space and swordsmanship, which is why he is called the Sky Emperor.]
[For this reason, you also cultivate the spatial attribute, and the Primordial Spirit Skill contains spatial mana.]
[Of course, your greatest improvement is in the aspect of creating your own divine skills. Although you still haven’t created a king-tier divine skill, you have had many insights, creating several supreme divine skills. Moreover, with just a little more time, you have the hope of creating a pseudo king-tier divine skill. This is a divine skill that surpasses supreme divine skills but hasn’t reached the level of king-tier divine skills. It is situated between the two, equivalent to an incomplete king-tier divine skill.]

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 146: Optimization! Truly Unrivaled at the Same Level! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 146: Optimization! Truly Unrivaled at the Same Level! _4
Translator: 549690339
[In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed, and you chose to leave your seclusion as the Flaming Fire Secret Realm was about to open. Your master asked you to explore the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, and if you could obtain the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, it would be the best outcome.]
[Regarding this, you have no intention of refusing, nor do you fear the challenge. Although in your memories, ‘you’ have died twice in this realm, but now, your strength has surpassed your peers, and even Ye Chen is akin to a child before you, easily defeated by a single hand.]
[With such formidable combat power, if you still dare not go to the Flaming Fire Secret Realm to seize opportunities, then you might as well not cultivate anymore, as the lack of willpower will prevent any significant accomplishments in the future.]
[You went with the Quasi-Emperor Ancestor to the location of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm. Just like in your memories, someone challenged you again. In response, you chose to take action, defeating them with just one move and one strike, displaying an invincible demeanor.]
[This shocked everyone, as all the young talents of this generation realized that they were no longer on the same level as you. Though you are all Saint Sons, there is a massive gap between your abilities.]
[Even Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue were astonished and in full admiration of your strength. The two of them had teamed up to challenge you several times, but just like the others, they were casually defeated by you, and the gap was just too great.]
[Next, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened, and upon entering, you were teleported to different locations. This time, you were not sent to the King’s Corpse Blood Pool but found yourself in a peculiar jungle.]
[Just like in your memories, you joined forces with Cai Yonglong and Ji Bingyue. However, you were not unlucky enough to encounter the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land this time, which was a bit of a regret for you. After all, he had considerable opportunities on him, especially the Enlightenment Soul Grass, which was extremely valuable.]
[Nevertheless, you didn’t pay too much attention to this and planned to search for the King’s Corpse Blood Pool first, aiming to seize the treasures beforehand. At the same time, you also intended to intercept the opportunities of other young talents along the way and obtain some good things.]
[In the blink of an eye, several days had passed, and you successfully intercepted many people’s opportunities and obtained a lot of good things. One of those opportunities even led to your Sword Embryo growing to the level of a top-tier Treasure, unleashing a formidable power that greatly enhanced your combat capabilities.]
[After all, top-tier Treasures are the most suitable weapons for a Nirvana Realm Master to use, and the amount of power they can unleash is incredibly strong. However, under normal circumstances, it is challenging for ordinary cultivators to utilize top-tier Treasures, and they cannot unleash their full potential, making them only slightly stronger than high-grade Treasures.]
[But your life-bound weapon is different, as it can unleash most of a top-tier Treasure’s power, making it a weapon for defeating higher-ranked opponents. It can be said that you have gained another trump card.]
[A few days later, you intercepted another opportunity and acquired a treasure that even Nirvana Realm Masters would be tempted by. Then, you sensed a tremendous commotion in the distance and understood that it was the direction in which the blood pool was located.]
[You felt helpless in your heart, as you wanted to find it in advance, but you couldn’t do so and had to compete with others. However, there was no way around it since the Flaming Fire Secret Realm was too vast, with many dangerous locations where even you dare not act recklessly.]
[To be precise, even if a Nirvana Realm Master came, they would have to behave properly; otherwise, entering those dangerous areas would pose a threat to them.]
[Afterward, you headed towards the direction of the blood pool. When you arrived, you found that many people were already there. Although you possessed the strength to kill or expel all of them, you did not do so. Instead, you waited for the monster beast in the blood pool to take action, helping you to eliminate some of your competitors without drawing gossip.]
[While you were thinking about these matters, Cai Yonglong excitedly informed you that the 5th Holy Son Lin Qiu of the Purple Thunder Divine Land had also arrived. At this, you were surprised, as you located Lin Qiu and wondered if he had consumed the Enlightenment Soul Grass.][If you haven’t consumed it, then you feel it’s necessary to get it in your hands. After all, this stuff is really precious, and it can be of great help to you right now. It can increase your insight and help you comprehend pseudo king-tier divine skills more quickly.]
[However, you don’t seem to have the intention to take the initiative right now, planning to wait and use the monster beast to reasonably deal with him. After all, the people present are not easy to deal with, and if you kill them all, it would offend the forces behind them, and even the Heavenly Sword Divine Land might not be able to withstand the pressure.]
[Soon enough, the Blood Pool demonic beast could no longer contain itself and began its onslaught. You all began to counterattack. Because of your instructions, you, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong have yet to use your true strength, allowing the Blood Pool demonic beast to kill more people. What you did more of, however, was protecting people from the Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[In the end, just as you wished, Lin Qiu, the unfortunate one, was killed by the Blood Pool demonic beast. Seeing this, you took the opportunity to snatch his Storage Ring and only then did you unleash your true power, slaying the Blood Pool demonic beast.]
[Later, you went straight for the True King Blood Flower and other treasures. Seeing this, the 3th Saint Child of Purple Thunder Divine Land and others were shocked and enraged, wanting to stop you, but they were knocked flying by you with a single strike, bleeding in mid-air, and seriously wounded.]
[They were all astonished. Although they had known of your strength and guessed that you had reserved a lot of your power, they didn’t expect you to be so strong that you could wound all of them simultaneously after the actual confrontation.]
[For this, the 3th Saint Child of the Purple Thunder Divine Land and others felt bitter in their hearts, thinking that the gap between them and you was too great and could only give up on the idea of continuing to compete; otherwise, their lives would be at risk. Because during that strike just now, you had already shown mercy.]
[However, after you harvested the True King Blood Flower, the King’s Remains, and collected the blood pool, you planned to immediately leave with Ji Bingyue and Cai Yonglong. You knew clearly that the people from the Jiuyou Demon Sect might have already arrived, hidden in the shadows, preparing a Great Array to kill you.]
[Although your current combat power is incredibly strong, you don’t want to expose all of your cards and have a life-and-death battle with the Jiuyou Demon Sect.]
[Your immediate departure left the people of the Jiuyou Demon Sect empty-handed and very frustrated.]
[After you left, you started to count your gains, discovering that Lin Qiu’s Storage Ring still contained Enlightenment Soul Grass. Obviously, he didn’t consume it directly but planned to take it out instead. This undoubtedly benefited you and made you very happy.]
[Next, you began to study the blood pool. To your surprise, the blood pool was very helpful for body refining and was something that body refiners have always desired. As for the True King Blood Flower, it was considered a divine medicine for body refiners. If one could eat it, they would definitely gain immense benefits.]
[Of course, not only body refiners could eat these, ordinary cultivators could also benefit greatly from eating them, not only increasing their Bone and Root Aptitude and strengthening their bodies, but also enhancing their cultivation.]
[However, the level of this stuff is too high, without a special Secret Skill to process it and slowly absorb its medicinal effects, cultivators below the Nirvana Boundary don’t have the qualifications to directly consume it. Even Nirvana Realm cultivators might not be able to eat it directly.]
[Perhaps only the king-tier can withstand its effects and gain numerous benefits.]
[About this, you plan to wait until you leave the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and leave this matter to your Master, Sky Emperor. Whether you want to exchange it for contribution points for the Heavenly Sword Divine Land or for treasures from their Treasure Vault, both are good choices.]
[Next, you continue exploring the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and intercept opportunities. Unfortunately, the opportunities you intercepted afterward were not as precious as before. Half a month later, an anomaly appeared in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm again, and a giant tower appeared in the center of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm!]

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history
Translator: 549690339
[With the appearance of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, you were naturally attracted by the huge commotion it caused and chose to go to its location without hesitation.]
[You all knew the origins of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower because it appeared every time the secret realm opened, but no one had ever passed the final test of the tower and completed the hundredth floor trial.]
[It was rumored that the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower was the Life-bound Emperor Artifact of the Flaming Fire Emperor, containing many secrets and was extremely powerful. It was also rumored that only by passing the hundred-floor trial of the tower would one inherit the legacy of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[Thinking of the various rumors about the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, you all felt excited and wanted to give the tower a try to see how many floors you could reach. Even if you couldn’t obtain its inheritance, it was an opportunity to compete with many legendary figures from past and present, and it was not to be missed.]
[When you arrived at the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, there were already many geniuses gathered here, and the sky and the earth were filled with people. Among them were also a large number of ordinary Life and Death realm cultivators who only came to watch the excitement and wanted to see who could become the true first person of the Purple Spirit Realm. As for entering the tower and obtaining the inheritance, they never considered it and were not qualified.]
[Many people felt that you were the first person of the younger generation, and even the previous Saint Sons and even more distant geniuses were no match for you. They couldn’t help speculating whether you could reach the hundredth floor and obtain the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[However, more people thought you wouldn’t be able to reach the hundredth floor because, in the 8000 years that the Flaming Fire Secret Realm existed, no one had ever reached the top. The strongest person only reached the 98th floor, and that famous figure had already become a generation Emperor 2000 years ago, creating their own Holy Land in Central Continent, extremely powerful.]
[Although you have already demonstrated enough talent and strength and have Emperor Potential, having potential is one thing, and whether you could actually become an Emperor is another. Throughout history, there were many outstanding individuals whose talents were comparable to yours, but not all of them became Emperors. There were quite a few who perished midway or were stuck at the King Realm or the Quasi-Emperor Tier.]
[You didn’t pay attention to these people’s discussions, but simply observed the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, sensing its terrifying power and marveling at it.]
[Soon after, Ye Chen also appeared here, greeting you. You found that Ye Chen’s harvest was also amazing, and his aura had become much stronger. He had also experienced the Earth Fiend Blazing Fire.]
[However, you were still confident that if you were to fight, Ye Chen would not be your match and would still be easily suppressed by you.]
[Soon, people began to enter the tower, among them were Holy Child tier characters. You watched and did not immediately enter the tower, wanting to see how many floors these people could reach.]
[Quickly, you all had some judgments in your hearts. Indeed, the trial of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower was difficult enough. Even the ones who boasted to be comparable to Ji Bingyue could only make it to the ninety-fifth tier and couldn’t progress further.]
[Ji Bingyue also chose to challenge the tower, but unfortunately, she only reached the ninety-sixth floor, while Cai Yonglong barely reached the ninetieth floor, but didn’t pass the trial of the ninetieth floor.]
[Next, you and Ye Chen also chose to enter the tower, which attracted the attention of many people. After all, you both had done a lot in the secret realm, defeating powerful opponents, and gained a great reputation. Everyone believed you were the strongest, at least in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm where Life and Death realm cultivators had to suppress their cultivation.]
[Soon, you and Ye Chen easily passed the ninety-fifth floor, shocking many people because your speed was much faster than the other geniuses.]
[Quickly, the ninety-sixth floor was also passed by you, astonishing countless people who acknowledged your superiority. When it came to the ninety-seventh floor, Ye Chen’s speed slowed down, while your speed remained fast and you easily challenged the tower.]
[To everyone’s astonishment, when Ye Chen reached the ninety-eighth floor, you had already reached the ninety-ninth.]
[This made it difficult for many people to calm down, as you had already broken history, surpassing the record set by that Emperor. As a result, they were very curious whether you could pass the ninety-ninth floor and reach the hundredth floor.]
[Finally, you successfully passed the ninety-ninth floor and reached the hundredth floor, completely breaking the historical record and shocking countless people, who were also very envious and jealous. After all, you were likely to obtain the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, which was an event that could affect the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[When you reached the hundredth floor, you found that there was no trial on the hundredth floor. Instead, a phantom appeared. You guessed that the phantom in front of you might be the remnant thoughts left by the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[The Flaming Fire Emperor’s remnant thoughts admired your strength and talent, lamenting that even in his youth he was no match for you. However, you were not suitable for accepting his inheritance. In comparison, although Ye Chen was inferior to you, he was the most suitable for his inheritance.]
[At this point, you were quite helpless, knowing that you had no fate with the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance, and that it was indeed reserved for Ye Chen.]

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 147: The Emperor’s Legacy! The Number One Person in History_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 147: The Emperor’s Legacy! The Number One Person in History_2
Translator: 549690339
[Seeing your disappointment, the Flaming Fire Emperor also laughs, saying that it was not easy for you to reach this point. The Flaming Fire Emperor Tower has rewards for those who perform well in the trials. Although he will not give you his legacy, he will give you enough good things.]
[The words of the Flaming Fire Emperor make you very expectant. Then, the Flaming Fire Emperor gives you a reward. With this, you receive three King Artifacts, a Fire Spirit Puppet with quasi-King battle strength, as well as a large amount of resources.]
[Although you are still disappointed that you didn’t get the legacy, your disappointment fades as you feel quite enriched with your rewards.]
“I knew it would be like this. In this Flaming Fire Secret Realm, I can only benefit a little. The legacy has nothing to do with me.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ridicule as he watched the simulation content.
I wonder if Ye Chen will be able to get this Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.
If he could, that would really be amazing.
“I don’t believe it. When I become more powerful, I wonder if you’ll choose me or Ye Chen. I might even find a way to prevent Ye Chen from entering this secret realm. I don’t care about Cultivation Skills, but I must have a King Artifact.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but mumble.
Although Ye Chen is more suitable for this Emperor’s Legacy, it all comes to the fact that his talent isn’t enough to move the Emperor’s pity.
If he could really reach that level, there would be no question of who is more suitable. Even if Ye Chen is the Son of Fortune, this legacy would be his.
“Forget it, talking about this is pointless. If I really want this King Artifact, instead of trying to get it through the Life Simulator, I’d better think about whether I could refresh it as a reward in another way.”
Wang Ping shook his head, threw rid of his stray thoughts, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you leave the tower. Ji Bingyue curiously asks if you have received the legacy. You shake your head, saying that the Flaming Fire Emperor said the legacy wasn’t suitable for you. Ji Bingyue finds it a pity, considering you were the first to pass the trial but didn’t get the legacy.]
[At this time, Ye Chen also reaches the Hundredth Floor, shocking many people again. Ye Chen successfully obtains the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy, the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower starts to glow, and the whole secret realm vibrates. Then, everyone is forcibly teleported out.]
[As all the people in the secret realm are forcibly teleported out, the many Masters waiting in the outer world are also disturbed and ask about the situation. When they learn that both you and Ye Chen have reached the Hundredth Floor, they are extremely shocked.]
[Especially when they learn that Ye Chen might have received the legacy, they are even more astonished, full of envy for Heavenly Sword Divine Land, with many forces’ ambitions being ignited. An Emperor’s Legacy is not a small matter; it can greatly increase the foundation of a Holy Land! Be it the Emperor’s Cultivation Skills, Divine Skills, Secret Skills, or accumulated resources, they are all things that can drive people crazy.]
[Many Holy Lands don’t want Heavenly Sword Divine Land to enjoy the exclusive benefits and want to share in the benefits. This makes the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s Quasi-Emperor Ancestor extremely solemn. Although Heavenly Sword Divine Land is powerful, it is only ranked in the top ten of Holy Lands and cannot hold against numerous Holy Lands alone, let alone those that are even more powerful than Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[It is in this tense atmosphere that your master, the Sky Emperor, appears, along with other Emperors. This leaves many people, including yourself, feeling uneasy. It is extremely shocking to see the usually hard-to-encounter Emperors appear one after another.]
[However, it can only be said that the Emperor’s Legacy is of great significance to the Holy Lands. Even the Emperors had to intervene in the matter; otherwise, Heavenly Sword Divine Land would not be able to take it away.]
[You wonder how the legacy will be divided since Ye Chen hasn’t come out and the legacy hasn’t been taken yet.]
[However, the discussions between the Emperors about how to distribute the interests are none of your business. In the end, you don’t know what happened, and the major powers leave one after another. You are also taken back to Heavenly Sword Divine Land.]
[When you return to Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you curiously ask the Sky Emperor how the matter was resolved. The Sky Emperor simply shakes his head and says that it was dealt with according to the old rules. Some people were recruited to share the benefits, with Heavenly Sword Divine Land getting the largest share and the rest eating the leftovers.]
[At this, you sigh in your heart. Even a Holy Land cannot monopolize such a great advantage. Unless a Holy Land truly stands above others, other Holy Lands wouldn’t dare to covet it.]
[At the same time, you think of Ye Chen. Although Ye Chen obtained the legacy, he isn’t able to make decisions about many things, which is the consequence of lacking strength. Even with the Emperor’s Legacy, he cannot completely control it himself.]
[Next, in order to test your battle strength, you fight against the 3th Saint Child, who is at the 2nd tier of the Life and Death Realm. After an intense battle, you successfully defeat the 3th Saint Child by fighting across realms. This astonishes the watching Masters, who can only marvel at your incredible strength as a monster who reached the top of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.]
[After you defeat the 3th Saint Child, you are very happy because you have finally verified your battle strength. As you suspected, you are able to defeat Saint-tier Characters in the Life and Death Realm by fighting across realms.]

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Chapter 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history_3
Translator: 549690339
[However, compared to your excitement, the great masters of Heavenly Sword Divine Land and others like Ji Bingyue were shocked, while the Third Saint Child was somewhat self-defeated. As a Saint Child, being defeated by someone of a higher and lower realm was too humiliating.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year had passed. During this year, you were in seclusion, no longer suppressing your cultivation, and preparing to break through to the Life and Death Realm in a perfect state. In the end, you seamlessly broke through to the Life and Death Realm, and not just the 1st tier of the Life and Death Realm, but directly reached the 2nd tier.]
[Although crossing two astonishingly powerful Death Tribulations at once left you somewhat battered, you managed to bear it, and your strength underwent a qualitative change.]
[As for Ye Chen, he had already returned to Heavenly Sword Divine Land during this year. However, due to Flaming Fire Emperor’s restrictions on the inheritance he obtained, he couldn’t pass on the cultivation skills or divine skills.]
[Evidently, Flaming Fire Emperor had foreseen this, hence he made such a backup arrangement, silencing the other Holy Lands’ objections. As for other resources and the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, Ye Chen stubbornly denied obtaining these items, and backed by Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s protection, the other Holy Lands had no choice but to back off.]
[In the end, the matter of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance came to an inconclusive end. The reason for this was their fear of triggering a massive impact due to a Holy Land war, the threat of the Demon Cult led by Jiuyou Demon Sect, the sealed ‘Guilt-Punishing Emperor’ that could break free at any moment, and the possible invasion of the Blood Demon Clan.]
[Therefore, under the influence of so many factors, a single Emperor’s Legacy was not enough to incite war among the various Holy Lands. Doing so would only serve their external enemies. Of course, this was because there was no way to duplicate the cultivation skills, divine skills, and secret skills. If there was, the various Holy Lands would have put pressure on Heavenly Sword Divine Land to seize the opportunity.]
“Even the Holy Lands have their difficulties. The world is indeed cruel.”
Wang Ping sighed as he watched the simulation content.
Even the mighty Heavenly Sword Divine Land couldn’t monopolize resources.
Perhaps only the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land at its peak, with no one daring to peek at its power, was the exception.
This was because the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was an existence that surpassed other Emperors, having taken that half-step and being much stronger than other Emperors.
[In the blink of an eye, another three years had passed. Ye Chen, Ji Bingyue, and Cai Yonglong successively broke through to the Life and Death Realm. As for you, you still chose to be in seclusion, diligently improving your cultivation, trying to comprehend your pseudo king-tier divine skill or Domain Embryo.]
[Not long after, you and Ji Bingyue became Tao companions, which filled countless people with envy. After your grand wedding ceremony, it was time for the competition between Saint-sons of Eastern Desolate Sacred Land.]
[During the competition, the Third Saint Child of Purple Thunder Divine Land wanted to fight you. He was always bothered by the fact that you defeated so many people along with him in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, which made his Tao Heart unstable.]
[For this reason, the Third Saint Child of Purple Thunder Divine Land wanted to stabilize his Tao Heart by fighting you. Faced with this, you decided to accept the challenge. Although the Third Saint Child had digested the opportunities in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, his cultivation had greatly improved and he had reached the 4th tier of the Life and Death Realm, his combat power had increased significantly. However, he was still easily defeated by you as if you were sweeping away fallen leaves.]
[This battle shocked the Eastern Desolation, and all people could only sigh that you were still so powerful. With your 2nd tier cultivation in the Life and Death Realm, you easily defeated a Saint Child-tier character of 4th tier, which was truly impressive.]
[Next, someone else wanted to fight you. That person was the Second Saint Child of Purple Thunder Divine Land, whose cultivation was at the 6th tier of Life and Death Realm, much more powerful than the Third Saint Child.]
[Undeterred, you decided to face him. Then, after taking the battle somewhat more seriously, you managed to defeat him. In this battle, you revealed the fact that you had practiced king-tier divine skills, which amazed many people.]
[The First Holy Woman of Purple Thunder Divine Land became somewhat restless, feeling that the reputation of Purple Thunder Divine Land had been tarnished too much and wanted to step in to salvage their dignity. However, she was stopped by the Holy Master of Purple Thunder Divine Land. Although the First Holy Woman’s cultivation was much more powerful, having reached the 7th tier of Life and Death Realm, the Holy Master of Purple Thunder Divine Land thought that it was still not enough.]
[As a Quasi-Emperor, he naturally could see that you still had a hidden, even more powerful trump card. Even a Saint Child or Holy Child at the 7th tier of Life and Death Realm would find it difficult to defeat you.]
[Of course, this was also because the other Saint Child-tier characters’ talents and foundation were inferior to yours. Otherwise, they could have fought you.]
[However, having lost face, they still had to find a way to regain it. So, the Holy Master of Purple Thunder Divine Land brought out a real monstrous figure, the descendants of Emperors among all Holy Lands, who had even stronger talents compared to the publicly known Saint Children. They were nurtured by the Holy Land and acquired Immaculate Profound Elixirs and perfect Yin Yang Diagrams.]
[In addition to their Imperial lineage, they were the most suitable candidates for practicing their Ancestor’s Emperor-level Skills and Divine Skills. Although they may not necessarily be able to practice them, even if they did, they could only exert a little bit of power, but they were still incredibly strong.]
[The Holy Master of Purple Thunder Divine Land brought out a direct descendant of Purple Thunder Emperor who had successfully practiced Emperor-level Skills. This caused various Holy Land Masters to sigh that it was truly the Golden Age, where they were all ready to let real monstrous figures appear.]

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Chapter 147: The Imperial Legacy! The number one person in history_4
Translator: 549690339
[Next, you had a battle with the direct descendant of Purple Thunder Emperor. The cultivation level of the descendant was much higher than yours, reaching the 7th tier of the Life and Death Realm. However, they were extremely arrogant and refused to suppress you with their cultivation level, choosing to suppress their cultivation level to the same 2nd tier of Life and Death Realm as you.]
[An intense battle broke out between you. Undoubtedly, this was the strongest opponent you had encountered, giving you tremendous pressure. Relying solely on king-tier cultivation skills and divine skills, you were no match for them. Therefore, you used your trump card for the first time, unleashing the power of Purple Spirit Illusion Fire.]
[The appearance of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire stunned everyone at the scene. With the help of Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, you successfully killed the direct descendant of the Purple Thunder Emperor, making all the Saint-tier characters submit willingly. They also realized the huge gap between you and them, and couldn’t help but sigh.]
[After losing to you, the direct descendant of the Purple Thunder Emperor was not willing to accept defeat, but did not unseal their cultivation level to regain the upper hand. They only declared that they would win against you next time, claiming that your Purple Spirit Illusion Fire would be useless.]
[You admired their attitude and did not say anything arrogant, agreeing to the next battle.]
[After battling fiercely several times and showing off your abilities, other participants also began to fight. Ye Chen likewise stood out, gaining unlimited glory. Although his performance was not as good as yours, it was still extraordinary, leaving many people in awe, and making them lament that he was indeed the descendant of Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[At the same time, you were well aware that Ye Chen might not have successfully cultivated emperor-level skills and divine skills yet. Once he does, his strength will undergo a qualitative change. At that time, even you might not be able to suppress him.]
[Ji Bingyue also went up to fight. To your surprise, Ji Bingyue’s performance was incredibly stunning, not inferior to Ye Chen’s at all. She had secretly cultivated the Ice Emperor’s emperor-level skill. With the emperor-level skill, her combat power soared to an astonishing level, and she also demonstrated her prowess by defeating various Holy Child tier fighters.]
[This made the other Holy Lands of the Eastern Desolation even more jealous, feeling that the three monsters of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land were truly abnormal.]
[Ultimately, in this competition among Saint Sons, your performance was the most dazzling, followed by Ye Chen, Ji Bingyue, and the descendants of other emperors. Saint-tier characters had to be relegated to the secondary army. Cai Yonglong was among them, and he somewhat lost his sense of existence.]
“Well, this simulated Wang Ping is getting more arrogant. He keeps showing off.”
As Wang Ping watched the simulation content, his expression was very subtle.
These simulations had Wang Ping being increasingly arrogant each time.
Now, he was being arrogant even among the direct descendants of emperors.
Even the direct descendants of emperors who had cultivated emperor-level skills and emperor-tier divine skills couldn’t defeat him. It’s terrifying.
However, this also reiterated the power of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, making him a unique existence among his peers.
In addition, the adaptability of Primordial Spirit Skill also diminished the advantage of the emperor-level skills.
Although the Primordial Spirit Skill was king-tier, it was the most suitable for him. It wasn’t much different from an emperor-level skill, which couldn’t fully display its power.”I wonder, at the end of this simulation, what cultivation level Wang Ping can reach.”
Wang Ping thought of this matter again, looking forward to it, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Time passed, a hundred years went by, your cultivation level has been raised to the 5th tier of the Life and Death Realm. You also thought of Bai Tianhong’s matter, feeling that it was time to take Bai Tianhong away from the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[Before, you couldn’t protect him. If the white-haired Old Lady took Bai Tianhong away, both the Old Lady and Bai Ya, the descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, would have been killed by others.]bool=TrueHowever, now, as long as you tell your Master Sky Emperor about the situation, he would be willing to accept Bai Tianhong into the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and protect him.]
[Although Bai Tianhong’s cultivation level could not reach above the Profound Elixir Realm due to his curse, and would trigger the curse once he reached that level, staying in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land would still allow him to enjoy two prosperous lifetimes even if his cultivation was not high.]
[Soon, you took action. You left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and went to the Profound Turtle Continent. On the way, you encountered an attack from the Jiuyou Demon Sect. The Second Demon Son and Third Demon Son of the Jiuyou Demon Sect ambushed you.]
[As for the old monsters in the Jiuyou Demon Sect, they were intercepted by the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s guardians who secretly followed you.]
[In the end, you fought alone against the Second and Third Demon Sons of the Jiuyou Demon Sect. With your 4th tier cultivation in the Life and Death Realm, you singlehandedly killed the 8th tier Second Demon Son and the 7th tier Third Demon Son. The old monsters of the Jiuyou Demon Sect retreated.]
[This battle shocked the Purple Spirit Realm. Both the then geniuses and the masters of the major forces were astonished by your strength. Especially the Life and Death Realm Masters of the Great Eastern States, they all bitterly smiled, knowing that they were completely overtaken by your younger-generation.]
[Even the Nirvana Realm Masters sighed, feeling that being surpassed by you was just a matter of time. Perhaps in a few hundred years, they would face an embarrassing situation of being defeated by you, becoming a stepping stone to enhance your reputation.]
[Next, your journey went smoothly without encountering any more attacks from the Jiuyou Demon Sect. You were unsure about what the predecessor ransmigrator, known as the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, was thinking.]
[However, with your Master Sky Emperor’s presence, you were not too worried. As long as the Jiuyou Demon Emperor appeared, your Master Sky Emperor would also appear and block him.]
[Furthermore, other Emperors would also appear to besiege them in the name of justice, because a chaotic era was about to come, and the major Holy Lands were eager to get their hands on the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and the high-ranking members of the Jiuyou Demon Sect in order to eliminate the unstable factors within the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[As a result, if the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the predecessor ransmigrator, appeared, he would definitely be besieged, and you would be happy to see this. Because the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was a great threat to you, and you truly wished for this “good predecessor” to die quickly, so you wouldn’t have to worry about him every time you went out.]
[Upon arriving at the Profound Turtle Continent, you left some inheritance once again before taking Bai Tianhong away.]
[Bai Tianhong had completely fallen behind. Now, all of you have become Saint Sons, while Bai Tianhong, who was left on the Profound Turtle Continent, still only had a cultivation level in the Transcendent Realm. This was due to the inheritance and resources you had left for him, otherwise, he would have been stuck in the Spiritual Origin Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 300 years had passed. During these 300 years, the Purple Spirit Realm was turbulent, with a lot of strife and the rise of various geniuses. Among them, you were still one of the most dazzling.]
[In just over 300 years, your cultivation level had reached the Half-step Nirvana Realm, only one step away from the Nirvana Realm. At the same time, you have successfully refined your supreme divine skills to pseudo king-tier divine skills, and learned your master’s emperor-tier divine skill, the Sky-Space Sword Skill.]
[In terms of domain, you have achieved a lot of insights as well, thinking that with some more time, you would be able to successfully comprehend the domain embryo belonging to yourself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 386: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards
Translator: 549690339
[Aside from those improvements, you’ve also embarked on another path, that of body training. You practiced a king-tier body refining skill treasured in the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, using the blood pool and treasured flowers to enhance your physical strength to a horrifying level. With a punch or a kick, you could easily obliterate an ordinary master of the half-step Nirvana Realm.]
[However, while your improvements have been significant, so have Ye Chen’s. After receiving the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, he also learned Emperor-level skills and Emperor-tier Divine Skills against all odds. Although he cannot fully unleash their potential, it is terrifying enough.]
[Ye Chen’s cultivation, like yours, has also reached the half-step Nirvana Realm, ready to break through into the Nirvana Realm at any moment.]
[Over the years, you, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue often exchanged their knowledge. Only you three could stimulate one another, as the rest of the same realm cultivators are no match for you.]
[It could be said, even the Emperor’s descendants are not your rivals. Unless, like you, Ye Chen, and Ji Bingyue, these Emperor’s direct descendants have not only practiced Emperor-level Skill and Divine Skills, but also possess another kind of powerful physical constitution, they could only compete with you under the same realm.]
[Otherwise, just relying on the enhancements brought by the Emperor’s bloodline, is insufficient for them to contend with you, at most they would lose less disgracefully.]
[Looking back at these years of changes, you have many thoughts. Ye Chen, once inferior to you, has grown to be on par with you. He truly is the Son of Fortune; his growth speed is astonishing.]
[Because of this, you can’t help but feel that after Ye Chen received the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, he completely transformed, and his growth rate was truly astonishing, making it hard for you to maintain your advantage.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, you have left him far behind, reaching only the 7th-tier of Life and Death Realm in cultivation.]
[The Life and Death Realm’s 7th-tier, although significantly greater than the other prodigies of his age, the path of cultivation becomes much more difficult the further one progresses. Even for Holy Child-tier characters, if they can advance a minor realm within the Life and Death Realm in a hundred years, it would be quite impressive. For Cai Yonglong to have reached the 7th-tier of the Life and Death Realm is already pretty good.]
[However, it’s unfortunate that the 7th-tier of Life and Death Realm is still too far behind you, and he will only fall further behind in the future.]
[After your cultivation reached the half-step Nirvana Realm, you stepped into the world once more. The reason for this emergence was that the First Demon of Jiuyou Demon Sect had entered the Nirvana Realm and wanted to challenge you.]
[You were undaunted, and engaged in a deadly battle with him. In this fight, you used all your strength, paid a severe price of heavy injuries, but you still defeated him. Although you could not kill the First Demon of the Nirvana Realm and he escaped, this battle nevertheless shook the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[After all, the First Demon of Jiuyou Demon Sect may not be a direct descendant of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, but he is not an ordinary person either. Despite your cultivation being an entire Great Realm lower than his, you defeated him in a higher realm, which indeed shocked many.]
[The further you progress in cultivation, the greater the disparity between realms. The gap between a cultivator at the half-step Nirvana Realm and the Nirvana Realm is enormous. To say nothing of the fact that the First Demon of Jiuyou is not an ordinary person in the Nirvana Realm, he is a genius even more gifted than many Holy Child-tier characters.]
[Your defeating a genius of such a level at a lower realm is indeed horrifying.]
[Your battle has also ignited the fighting spirit of all the monster-level individuals in the entire Purple Spirit Realm, such as Ye Chen. They all started to challenge those master-level cultivators at the Nirvana Realm. Some, like you, successfully defeated a master of the Nirvana Realm, while some failed.]
[Regardless, the outcome of their battles made many ordinary masters of the Nirvana Realm realize one thing: they were no longer opponents to you monsters. Feeling a sense of helplessness, they understood what it’s like to live as lowly as a dog all their lives.]
[As the trend of challenging higher realms emerged in the Purple Spirit Realm, you began to retreat, preparing to break through into the Nirvana Realm and become a master of the Nirvana Realm.]
[However, it was at this time that a major event occurred which swept across the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[This time, it wasn’t a new Emperor’s secret realm that emerged, nor a naturally formed secret realm. Instead, the Blood Demon Clan invaded the Purple Spirit Realm again.]
[The Blood Demon Realm is adjacent to the Purple Spirit Realm. Every few tens of thousands of years, the channels between the two realms will connect. If many Emperors join forces then, it’s possible to forcibly open the channel between the two realms, invade the other’s realm, seize their resources, and occupy their world.]
[Last time, the Blood Demon Clan’s invasion failed, and they were sent back to the Blood Demon Realm. This time, they decided to try again when the interdimensional channel reconnected.]
[Above the Central Continent, vast spaces are fragmented, a channel between realms appears, alerting all the Emperors in the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[At this moment, the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm all tore the space apart and arrived at the Central Continent. As for the quasi-Emperors and king-tier, although a little slow, a large number of Emperors also went to the Central Continent, ready to go to war with the Blood Demon Clan at any time.]
[As for you, you also receive the news, and it creates waves in your heart. You didn’t expect that the Blood Demon Clan would invade the Purple Spirit Realm again so soon.]
[Now, your cultivation is only at the half-step Nirvana Realm. Even if your fighting power is extraordinary, you can’t possibly be a match for those old monsters, they can kill you with a random slap. Having potential talent is one thing, whether you can grow into it, is another matter.]

chapters.title: Chapter 387: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_2
Translator: 549690339
[Once the two planes start fighting, your chances of falling are not low. Moreover, as the recognized top young cultivator in the Purple Spirit Realm, you cannot retreat nor hesitate. You must stand on the front lines and fight against the monsters of the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Soon, the top-level fighters of the Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm collided, testing each other’s strength. However, the simple probing was not enough for both sides to understand each other’s true capabilities, so both sides did not have the idea of ​​initiating a full-scale war yet.]
[It was during the clash of the top-level fighters of the two realms when Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao finally took action. He led the powerful members of the Jiuyou Demon Sect and attacked the base of Heavenly Sword Holy Land, intending to capture or kill you.]
[Although the Heavenly Sword Holy Land has a mountain protection array, it could not withstand these powerful enemies in the absence of the Sky Emperor. The Heavenly Sword Sacred Land was in danger of being destroyed.]
[At this, you felt desperate. You didn’t expect that your ‘predecessor ransmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao would be so ruthless and take advantage of the perfect timing, without considering whether the Purple Spirit Realm would be exterminated by the Blood Demon Realm.]
[You knew very well that you absolutely could not be caught alive. As a result, after realizing there was no chance of escape, you chose to kill yourself without using the Rebirth tally to revive.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
“Ugh, I still died.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, feeling somewhat helpless.
He didn’t expect to die like this.
He had a feeling that the Blood Demon Clan would invade again.
However, he didn’t expect their invasion to be so soon, only five hundred years after the last invasion of the Purple Spirit Realm.
The invasion of the Blood Demon Clan summoned all high-end combat power of the Purple Spirit Realm to the Central Continent.
This left the Heavenly Sword Holy Land exposed, allowing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘predecessor ransmigrator,’ to strike directly.
“He really doesn’t want to let us go.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Of course, Wang Ping could understand the other party’s reasoning.
It wasn’t easy to have enjoyed peace for so many years and have developed such a huge force. But it seemed that the chat group had reassembled and sent new ransmigrators to the world.
If he were the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, he wouldn’t ignore it either. He would try to capture the person and obtain information about the current chat group.
If he couldn’t capture them alive, he would just kill them to ensure they would not grow into a significant threat later on.
Apart from that, Wang Ping also thought of something.
“Would the predecessor ransmigrator Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao be connected with the Blood Demon Clan?”
Wang Ping frowned, considering the relationship between the two.
If the Blood Demon Clan occupied the Purple Spirit Realm, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao wouldn’t necessarily remain unharmed either.
However, he still chose to take advantage of the chaos and strike against the Holy Land.
If there were no connections between the two, Wang Ping would find it hard to believe.
However, even if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao is a demonic cultivator, and the Blood Demon Clan shares the same origin, they probably wouldn’t trust each other. After the Blood Demon Clan exterminates the cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm, there’s no guarantee they won’t turn against him.
“I really don’t know what he’s scheming, but his schemes must not be that simple.”
Wang Ping silently thought.
If this were a novel, the ‘predecessor ransmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao would have the quality of a big boss antagonist.
“No matter what you’re plotting, as long as you don’t notice me, I’ll be able to grow with the help of the simulator. Then, when I’m aware of your sinister tricks, I’ll strike back at you.”
Wang Ping’s eyes showed determination. He was not overly confident, nor did he fear Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘ransmigrator.’
Although he had been caught off guard once, it was because his situation was exposed.
If he didn’t expose information, wasn’t discovered by the other party, there would be no problem, and the other party wouldn’t be able to do anything to him.
As Wang Ping was deep in thought, his vision changed, and he appeared inside the Heavenly Sword Holy Land.
In Wang Ping’s eyes, outside the Holy Land, the dark demon spirit covered the sun, enveloping the Heavenly Sword Holy Land in darkness.
Above the sky, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao looked down at the Heavenly Sword Holy Land, high above. With a single strike, he made the mountain protection array of the Heavenly Sword Holy Land tremble violently, with cracks spreading out.
The Quasi-emperor Ancestor who presided over the array, along with the remaining masters and disciples of the Heavenly Sword Holy Land, all spat blood out as they struggled to withstand the terrifying skill.
In the end, both Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong knew the consequences of being captured alive and chose to self-destruct one after another.
Then, Wang Ping’s vision returned to normal.
“Despite seeing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao not for the first time, even though I’ve become much stronger, I still feel palpitations. This guy is just too strong.”
Wang Ping’s face was serious as he muttered to himself.
As Wang Ping was giving his evaluation, the system’s voice sounded in time.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose one from the following rewards:
11. Half-step Nirvana Realm cultivation.
2. King-tier Body Refining Skill: Divine Firmament Body Refining Skill.
3. Insights on an embryonic domain.
4. Emperor-tier Divine Skill: Sky-Space Sword Skill.
5. Pseudo-King-tier Divine Skill: Illusionary Flame Sword Song.
6. A random learned King-tier Divine Skill.
7. Learned Secret Skills.
8. Combat Experience.

chapters.title: Chapter 388: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_3
Translator: 549690339
9. Understanding of other Great Perfection Realms of Conception.
10. Sword Fetus (Top-tier Treasure).”
“These rewards are too generous, it’s just a pity that I can only choose one.”
As Wang Ping looked at the list of rewards, he covets them greatly, yet feeling regret at the same time.
Finally, after perusing the numerous rewards, he wanted each and every one of them, but if it comes down to the most precious to him currently.
It would probably be the comprehension of Domain Embryo and the pseudo king-tier divine skill he grasped, the Illusionary Flame Sword Song.
Because those are his realizations.
The rest, he could come in contact within the life simulation, cultivate from there, and then refresh them through rewards.
But, that’s it.
These insights are different; if he chooses these rewards and piles them up through simulation times by choosing them every time, he’d eventually be able to understand Domain Embryo, or even create his king-tier divine skills.
Once these two achievements are accomplished before reaching the King Realm, his battle power will once again surge dramatically. Even if Ye Chen completely absorbs the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, he would not be able to catch up with him.
Because cultivating others’ divine skills, although the disparity in level can create a massive advantage over others who cultivate king-tier divine skills, or even ruthlessly crush geniuses who create Supreme Divine Skills, it is ultimately not the right path. It merely provides a temporary increase in battle power, just to maintain the advantage in the early stage.
The truly strong must take their own path and understand their powerful divine skills.
If one can utilize king-tier divine skills that he created, he can perfectly exert its power. By then, its strength will definitely be stronger than using the ancestors’ Emperor’s divine skills.
If paired with the Purple Spirit Phantom Flame, the intensity of its power, just thinking about it is terrifying.
As for the Domain Embryo, there is no need to say more, it is also a standard feature of a king, its difficulty may be higher than creating a king-tier divine skill, and it also has a higher priority.
If he understands the Domain Embryo before becoming a king, it would really be a game-changer. For the genius who has not understood the Domain Embryo, it can form a ruthless crush.
Thinking of this, Wang Ping’s eyes brightened, and he said without hesitation in his heart: “System, I choose ③. Comprehension of Domain Embryo.”
“Ding, choice of reward successful.”
The system’s voice sounded once again.
Then, Wang Ping could feel a lot of insights appearing in his mind.
Those were all insights towards the Great Perfection Sword Spirit extending towards the Domain of the sword.
As a Sword Profound Body, Wang Ping has a great advantage in this aspect. Compared to realizing other domains, the difficulty of comprehending the Sword Domain Embryo is the lowest.
After an unknown amount of time, Wang Ping came back to his senses, his mood not calming down.
The Domain is truly too mysterious, it is astonishings.
Although it’s said that, many realms have a saying, all under a certain realm are ants.
But this sentence, only becomes substantial at the King Realm.
All below the King Realm are ants, only then would it make people admit by word and heart.
That’s because a king not only undergoes metamorphosis in terms of the body, soul, mana, etc., but also possesses a Domain.
Within the Domain, he is the ruler, not only can he weaken the fighting power of others, he can also use the Power of Heaven and Earth of the same attribute as the Domain to assist in the battle, taking the destructive power to a terrifying level.
In the Domain of a king, how can you fight them unless you also have a Domain, to neutralize and compete with it, and only then can you fight them.
“It is very hard to understand the Domain Embryo. But, even if you comprehend some of the mysteries, it is enough to greatly increase your battle power.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, murmuring to himself.
This time, although the simulated Wang Ping did not comprehend the Domain Embryo and would require approximately a thousand years to do so unless he has some sort of epiphany, he still has many insights.
The understanding of the Power of Heaven and Earth, the understanding of the Domain Embryo.
Although he could not unfold a real Domain Embryo to suppress enemies nor muster too much Power of Heaven and Earth, he could cover some Domain Force around his body and enhance his combat power by mobilizing a little bit of the Power of Heaven and Earth.
This effect, though it seems insignificant, is extremely helpful in battles between beings at the same level.
“It seems I made the right choice. Although in more than five hundred years in the Purple Spirit Realm, the invasion of the Blood Demon will occur, making it very difficult to live longer. But, as long as I simulate a few more times, accumulate insights of the Domain Embryo, I will be able to understand the Domain Embryo eventually, exceed Ye Chen, and clear the path to becoming a king.”
Wang Ping’s eyes gleamed, he was thinking and fantasizing about the future in his heart.
“Of course, whether it can be successful or not still depends on the reward refresh mechanism. After all, not every reward will refresh with insights about the Domain Embryo. In the first few simulations, there were no rewards in this aspect.”
Wang Ping shook his head again and calmed down a bit.
“However, if it isn’t refreshed once or twice, it doesn’t matter, at the end of the day, it’s still the problem of accumulating simulation times.”
Just when Wang Ping was about to continue simulating, the chat group system alert sounded abruptly, making him pause and come back to his senses.
“Ding! Detected that group member Xu Yi (84)’s life is under serious threat. Group members can voluntarily initiate rescue operations!”
“Has something happened to Xu Yi?”
Wang Ping squinted his eyes, stopped his actions, and directly opened the chat group chat page.
At this time, the chat group was very lively, all the group members who were not taking part in the chat group tasks or were not doing anything important were all chatting away.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: 148: Blood Demon Invasion! Generous Rewards_4
Translator: 549690339
Wu Jun (20): “Damn, what’s happening? What happened to Xu Yi?”
Zhang Hu (5): “I remember his world is one where Western mythologies have invaded; it’s one we’ve discussed before where you can achieve great power in one go. We too once thought about going there to kill a deity for power, but we never did.”
Wang Shuqi (74) @Xu Yi (84): “What on earth is happening on your end? Respond quickly.”
Xu Yi (84): “….Western mythology has invaded the Divine Land, and the great hero Hercules from Greek mythology has descended. He is currently battling with the Divine Land’s guardian deity. The range of impact is extensive, many were killed in the crossfire, I’m also in danger, but still alive for now.”
Qin Tian (77): “Err… Hercules, huh. Quite a famous character from various works. What’s his power level?”
Xu Yi (84): “Seven Star Tier.”
Qin Tian (77): “Well, the martial skill level in your world is no joke. Just Hercules alone has 7th-Tier battle power. As for the guardian deity of your world, he seems quite formidable, able to go head-to-head with him.”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s to be expected, after all, it’s a world where one can gain the power of a deity by slaying it, having powerful individuals is not surprising.”
Qin Tian (77): “That’s true.”
Wang Ping (66) @Xu Yi (84): “Enough chit-chat, Xu Yi, it seems like we’re the only ones free in the group right now, do you need me to come over?”
Xu Yi (84): “Thank you Mr. Wang, please come! Mr. Wang, this is a small token of my gratitude. It’s not much, but I will make it up later.”
‘Ding, group member Xu Yi (84) has sent you an exclusive red envelope.’
The system’s voice sounded, causing Wang Ping to crack a smile as he opened the red envelope.
Then he received thirty thousand group points.
Xu Yi had also participated in the group points system and had saved some group points.
This red envelope was evidently the fare payment the other party was sending him.
Aside from that, it was a token of gratitude, after all, he only needed twenty thousand group points for the fare.
Of course, a gratitude token of ten thousand group points was somewhat small, but that was all he had.
Wang Ping did not mind this, saving people was the priority.
Immediately, Wang Ping used the delivery function of the chat group and went to the world where Xu Yi was.
In Xu Yi’s world, up in the sky, two figures were clashing wildly.
Each collision created an aftershock that spread across the sky and earth, destroying many places.
The city where Xu Yi was located was within the range of impact. The terrifying force caused buildings to burst apart, and some unlucky people were even killed by the shock.
Only those with power could manage to survive despite the dire situation.
Xu Yi was one of them.
However, as the battle between the two drew nearer this place, this city would eventually be destroyed.
“So that’s how it is, that’s Hercules, huh? Certainly seems pretty powerful.”
Wang Ping appeared beside Xu Yi, cast a glance at Hercules in the sky, who was waving his sword and shooting arrows, causing terrifying explosions, and murmured casually.
“Well, to you, Mr. Wang, he might be a bit powerful, but to me, he’s absolutely formidable.”
Xu Yi was initially startled by Wang Ping’s sudden appearance, but then he reacted and replied with a wry smile.
“It’s just 7th-tier combat power, you guys will eventually reach this level.”
Wang Ping gave Xu Yi’s shoulder a pat and offered some encouragement.
“By the way, how do people in your world acquire their power after slaying a deity? Do they need to slay it individually to gain their authority?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, curiously inquired.
If that’s the case, it would seem similar to some anime settings.
“No, whoever kills the deity gets the power. However, they can’t obtain their authority.”
Xu Yi said in a low voice.
“Additionally, unless there are special circumstances, no one can overcome such a huge power gap to slaughter a deity. Therefore, unless they are hidden talents secretly trained by the authorities, they won’t have the opportunity to take the deity’s head.”
“I see, so it’s a monopolized system.”Wang Ping nodded slightly.
“If that’s the case, it will be easy. I’ll incapacitate this Hercules, then you can kill him and gain his power.”
For Wang Ping, if he could seize the authority, he would be quite interested.
After all, the twelve trials of Hercules allegedly give him twelve lives. If he could seize them, it would be like having twelve Rebirth tallies. It was simply too tempting.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t snatch them away.
Merely seizing his power made little sense. While Hercules’ power was decent, it was far too weak for him.
“Uh…..”
Listenting to Wang Ping’s casual words, Xu Yi was both shocked and excited.
Mr. Wang, this is simply too domineering, speaking of slaying a god like it was as simple as squashing an ant.
What delighted him was that Mr. Wang was willing to give him the kill. It was an opportunity for him to skyrocket into glory.
“Mr. Wang, I will definitely repay this favor in the future.”
Xu Yi said excitedly.
“The gods of your world do not descend frequently. Otherwise, your world could be a place where Group members can rise meteorically. Though a 7th-Tier Combat Power may mean little in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, it’s quite strong in the current chat group.”
Wang Ping was unconcerned with Xu Yi’s words and shook his head.
Xu Yi was dumbfounded, completely at a loss for words.
“Well then, I’ll be back in a jiffy.”
Noticing Xu Yi’s bewilderment, Wang Ping didn’t say much. He patted his shoulder, put an Energy Barrier around him, and then took a step forward.
With this step, Wang Ping disappeared on the spot and appeared in the far-off horizon.
As Wang Ping continued to step forward, he eventually reached the center of the battlefield.
The sudden arrival of Wang Ping took the battling Divine Land Guardian and Hercules by surprise as they stopped their fight, looking at Wang Ping in astonishment.
Because they had no idea when Wang Ping appeared.
In other words, if Wang Ping had decided to ambush either of them just then, they would have been in danger.
“Who might you be?”
The Guardian of the Divine Land noticed that Wang Ping was human and was somewhat uncertain.
Wang Ping was human, he did not have the aura of a deity or the unique aura of a God Slayer, yet he gave off a very dangerous vibe. It was very strange.
He found it hard to believe that a human could be so terrifyingly powerful.
Even though there was also a cultivation system for humans, no matter how one cultivated, being able to destroy an ordinary city with one blow was already very impressive, let alone reaching the heights of a God Slayer or a Deity. It was impossible.
And yet Wang Ping’s appearance had shattered his perception.
“You do not need to worry about who I am. Just know that since you can’t kill him, step back.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Divine Land Guardian and calmly said.
“You!”
As the Guardian of the Divine Land, he was of course a prideful character. Stirred to anger by Wang Ping’s comment, he immediately became furious.
However, he quickly calmed down, deeply peered at Wang Ping, retreated to aside, planning to use Hercules to assess Wang Ping’s strength.
“It’s surprising that a human can reach a level comparable to a god’s. My intuition tells me that you’re dangerous. But as a proud semi-lord, no matter what kind of enemy I face, I will defeat them.”
Hercules furrowed his brow at Wang Ping. Even though he was somewhat taken aback, he unleashed his Terrifying Skill, pulling on his Divine Bow.
“Pearls of grain shimmer too.”
Wang Ping put one hand behind his back, disregarded Hercules, and spoke calmly.
“Don’t talk about you being a semi-lord, even if you were the Master Lord, in front of me, you would be nothing more than little ants that I can easily crush.”
These words left the Guardian of the Divine Land nearby completely baffled.
Who is this guy, why does he talk as if he is astronomically cool…

chapters.title: Chapter 390: 149: Instantly Kill Hercules! The Reverence of the Divine Land’s Venerables
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: 149: Instantly Kill Hercules! The Reverence of the Divine Land’s Venerables
Translator: 549690339
“How bold!”
Hercules was infuriated by Wang Ping’s contempt, and he instantly unleashed a terrifying attack.
Although Hercules gave people the impression of a berserker, his strongest skill was actually archery.
As he pulled the bowstring to the maximum and shot an arrow, it turned into nine dragon-shaped tracking beams.
This attack made the face of the Divine Land Guardian, who was standing nearby, turn pale.
If he were to face this attack head-on, he wouldn’t be able to remain unscathed and might face the danger of falling.
Therefore, he eagerly wanted to intervene and block the attack together with Wang Ping.
However, the next second, something shocking happened.
Facing this terrifying attack, Wang Ping remained calm and simply raised the index finger of his right hand, pointing at it casually.
In an instant, invisible ripples spread out, and the powerful dragon-shaped beams, each exceeding a hundred meters wide, suddenly froze in mid-air before turning into light spots that exploded. They transformed into a rain of light that shot towards the earth, much like a meteor shower, looking incredibly gorgeous.
“Is this the power of a demi-god? It’s useless for killing, but not bad for livening up the atmosphere. Creating a meteor shower for people to make wishes upon is quite impressive.”
Wang Ping’s clothes fluttered as he spoke in a light and airy manner.
Hercules’ power was only at the level of Wang Ping’s half-step Yin-Yang Realm.
Back then, he only had a 1st-tier Pure Yin Power and no king-tier Cultivation Skill, Divine Skills, Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, or control over Domain Force.
It could be said that he was extremely weak.
In front of Wang Ping, Hercules was like an ant that could be crushed anytime, genuinely feeble.
Wang Ping even had to be careful when controlling his own strength, afraid that he would accidentally crush Hercules, depriving Xu Yi of gaining his power.
Compared to Wang Ping’s casual demeanor, the Guardian of the Divine Land was dumbfounded.
What kind of monster is this?
Hercules’ ultimate move, which even he felt the danger to his life, was casually destroyed by a single finger point. And then Wang Ping even commented that the opponent’s move was excellent for creating meteor showers to make wishes and liven up the atmosphere….
This was just too powerful and a bit too showy.
He even doubted who was the human, who was the god slayer, and who was the demi-god.
Such frightening power should not belong to humans, but perhaps not even to a Master Lord Tier deity who had never descended to this world.
The Guardian of the Divine Land was dumbstruck, and the semi-god Hercules was even more so.
Even as a demi-god who had once traversed the Twelve Trials, a man more powerful than many real deities, his psyche was also strained and he began to doubt his own existence.
For a moment, he blankly stared at Wang Ping, unable to speak. The pride of being a demi-god and a great hero was crushed to pieces by Wang Ping.
“Mr. Demi-god over there, according to the myths, you should have twelve lives, right? So that means I’ll need to kill you eleven times before I can capture you alive, correct?”
At this point, Wang Ping spoke again, causing the Divine Land Guardian to be startled.
Wang Ping wanted to capture Hercules alive? Why?
Could it be to cultivate other people?
True, Hercules’ power was meaningless to him, but his abilities were not bad. The Twelve Trials were tempting, but it was not guaranteed that they could be obtained.
“Trying to capture me alive? In your dreams.”
Hercules’ face was ferocious, and he became furious. He transformed into a terrifying ray of light and fled to the distance.
He could accept dying in battle and having his power taken by Wang Ping, but he would never allow himself to be captured alive and have his power taken by weak humans.
So, for the first time, the proud demi-god chose to flee.
“Hurry up and chase, or else he’ll get away soon.”
Seeing this, the Divine Land Guardian became anxious and wanted to pursue.
Existences from myths were extremely dangerous, and if they didn’t intercept or kill them in the first instance, it would bring great harm to the Divine Land, with countless cities being destroyed.
“Don’t worry, he won’t get away.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly, raising his palm and squeezing the air in front of him.
In an instant, under the astonished gaze of the Divine Land Guardian, the sky darkened as if it had turned from a bright and sunny day into night.
Then, in the darkness, an invisible gigantic palm appeared and directly grabbed Hercules, like a human holding a chick. No matter how much the chick struggled, it was useless.
“This kind of power…”
The Divine Land Guardian was horrified.
Wang Ping’s power made him feel suffocated, reminding him of the feeling of oppression and helplessness when he faced deities as a human.
At this moment, the Divine Land Guardian was not the only one astonished; all the humans who witnessed this scene were also shocked.
Those who were strong enough to see what was happening in the sky were completely dumbfounded.
Even those without the power to see were similarly amazed by the sudden change in the sky.
After all, the kind of power that could instantly change day into night seemed to only belong to gods and god slayers.
“Using darkness attribute in broad daylight is quite showy, making it seem like night and day have been reversed.”
Wang Ping casually grabbed the struggling Hercules, his face unchanged, thinking quietly to himself.
“Let me ask you something, Hercules, do you really have twelve lives? Or is it just that your recovery ability is stronger?”

chapters.title: Chapter 391: 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_2
Translator: 549690339
Immediately, Wang Ping turned to the Divine Land Guardian and said.
“According to mythology, he indeed has twelve lives. However, it’s not that he can come back to life once for every kill. Overly powerful attacks can annihilate multiple lives at once.”
The Divine Land Guardian, after gathering his composure, cautiously provided an answer.
“I see, that’s a pretty lame resurrection ability.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
Upon hearing these words, the Divine Land Guardian couldn’t help but twitch.
Only a freak like Wang Ping would dare to say that.
This ability is something everyone would want. In a battle, it can provide a significant advantage, and one could use the tactic of hurting oneself to hurt the enemy.
“Humans, stop your arrogance! A Master Lord is about to descend and the demise of humans is inevitable, the world belongs to us gods.”
Hercules, having been insulted by Wang Ping again, was livid and roared.
“What!? A Master Lord is about to descend?”
Hearing this news, the Divine Land Guardian’s face showed fear.
Although humans have battled with various gods many times and, by cultivating the traditions of Eastern Mythologies, slaughtered some deities to inherit their power, none of these deities were of significant importance.
A Master Lord, has never descended.
As to how powerful a Master Lord is, they have made many conjectures based on mythological ruins.
Without a doubt, if a Master Lord descends, it would have the power to destroy the Divine Land, and no one could stop it.
“A Master Lord, huh? Interesting, killing him should yield some good rewards.”
Wang Ping looked at Hercules, the corner of his lips slightly upturned.
If it were the power of a semi-god or some weak deity, he wouldn’t care much.
But if it were a Master Lord, that would be a different story.
Perhaps, hunting these Master Lords could lead to some unexpected gains.
After all, Alpha once mentioned that if he could solve a problem threatening human survival, he could obtain group points as a reward.
The presence of a Master Lord is already a threat to human survival in this world.
So, killing it would most likely reward him some points.
Even a Semi-lord like Hercules has 7th-Tier Battle Power.
As a Master Lord, it must have at least an 8 Tier Battle Power, right?
If he can kill an 8th Tier entity, not rewarding a million group points would be unreasonable.
“Hahaha! Human, you are too arrogant. Do you think you can kill a Master Lord? Despite your power, you can easily kill me, but your strength is still far below what’s needed to confront a Master Lord.”
Hercules sneered.
“Shut up.”
Wang Ping glanced at him, coldly spat out these two words, and promptly killed him eleven times in a row.
On his last life, Wang Ping eased up a bit and wounded him severely without killing him.
Many times, decapitation doesn’t always successfully kill a god.
These gods, even if they were severely injured by the Divine Land Guardian, have many ways to escape, or even suicide.
Therefore, decapitation is not easy.
But for Wang Ping, it’s not a problem.
The gap in their powers is too big. Wang Ping had his ways to toy with Hercules, making him unable to end his life. Hercules could only watch himself being killed by a human he looked down upon and his power stripped away.
The Guardian on the side, upon seeing this, could only admire Wang Ping’s prowess.
It was his first time seeing a descended god or semi-lord in such a miserable state.
“Thank you for your help, may I ask for your esteemed name?”
The Divine Land Guardian bowed to Wang Ping and asked respectfully.
Wang Ping’s strength struck awe into him.
Moreover, since he now knew about the upcoming descent of the Master Lord, the Divine Land Guardian believed Wang Ping might be humanity’s only hope.
Thus, he had to show the utmost respect to Wang Ping under any circumstances.
“Wang Ping.”
Wang Ping glanced at him and uttered his name.
“Wang Ping…”
The Guardian of the Divine Land was taken aback.
That name… was quite ordinary.
Afterward, Wang Ping ignored the Divine Land Guardian, walking on air as he returned swiftly to Xu Yi’s side.
He didn’t try to hide his actions, and the Divine Land Guardian noticed Xu Yi’s presence, realized he must be the one Wang Ping was cultivating, and hurriedly followed them in surprise.
“Kill him.”
Wang Ping dropped Hercules before Xu Yi and patted his shoulder.
Seeing this, the Divine Land Guardian scrutinized Xu Yi, considering how to win over both Wang Ping and Xu Yi.
“Thanks, boss!”
Xu Yi was thrilled. He mustered his greatest strength and delivered a fierce strike right at Hercules’s neck.
“Clang!”
