Indeed, to everyone’s surprise, despite Xu Yi’s greatest effort on the brink of death Hercules, the attack failed to penetrate his defenses and created metallic collision-like noises instead.
“This is a god. Even on the brink of death, an ordinary human can’t kill him.”
The Divine Land Guardian sighed.
The gap between humans and gods is too great.
Of course, Wang Ping was the exception.
The Divine Land Guardian stole a glance at Wang Ping.
“Boss…” Xu Yi looked embarrassed and didn’t know what to say.
“Small problem.” Wang Ping didn’t mean to ridicule Xu Yi, so he went ahead and completely sealed off Hercules’ power.
Without any hesitation, Xu Yi took another strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 149: Instantly Kill Hercules! The Reverence of the Divine Land’s Venerables_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 149: Instantly Kill Hercules! The Reverence of the Divine Land’s Venerables_3
Translator: 549690339
With a ‘plop’ sound, Hercules was finally decapitated by Xu Yi, turning into a light and merging into Xu Yi’s body.
At this moment, Xu Yi’s body trembled, and he fell unconscious.
Wang Ping sensed that Xu Yi’s body was being transformed, his flesh becoming stronger, and a divine power similar to Hercules appeared within him.
“The rules of this world are really strange.”
Wang Ping sensed all this and couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Killing a god and acquiring their power, although unable to get their authority, is still quite astonishing.
It reminded Wang Ping of a certain anime, making him wonder if there was some secret plot behind it all.
“I forgot to ask this kid about his Golden finger.”
Wang Ping looked at the unconscious Xu Yi and recalled this matter.
In the chat group, very few people hid their Golden fingers.
Xu Yi was one of them, never revealing what his Golden finger was, making him quite mysterious.
However, judging by Xu Yi’s growth rate, his Golden finger was most likely not the type to enhance growth speed.
Wang Ping didn’t underestimate Xu Yi in any way.
Golden fingers like Chen Yao’s that could quickly grow were excellent, but rule-based Golden fingers were just as overpowered.
“How long before he wakes up?”
Wang Ping looked at the Divine Land Guardian and asked.
“Each person is different, but it’s usually around a week.”
The Divine Land Guardian quickly answered Wang Ping’s question.
“A week, that’s quite a while. In that case, take us to a safe place.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly, speaking to the Divine Land Guardian.
“Sure, follow me.”
Seeing Wang Ping say this, the Divine Land Guardian naturally couldn’t refuse, and started leading the way for Wang Ping.
The Divine Capital served as the capital of the Divine Land, gathering all kinds of elites, the lifeline of the Divine Land.
When Wang Ping came here, he saw floating lands, towering buildings, and a blend of mythology and science fiction.
After bringing Wang Ping to the Divine Capital, the Divine Land Guardian invited him to the most central location.
The Divine Land Guardian Tower, a tower that suppressed the dragon veins of the Divine Land, was also the residence of the Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians.
Divine Land Holiness, the leader of the Divine Land Guardians, represented the strongest existence in the Divine Land.
When Wang Ping reached the top floor of the Divine Land Guardian Tower, he saw as many as twenty Guardians sitting in a row.
At the topmost position sat an awe-inspiring man.
It was clear that he was the Divine Land Holiness.
For this, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered a bit, looking at him with astonishment.
This Divine Land Holiness was quite powerful.
Of course, his strength was only relatively powerful.
His aura was far more powerful than the other Divine Land Guardians, but it was only equivalent to the 7th-Tier Yin Yang Mirror.
The Yin Yang Mirror also had various strengths, and his was corresponding to the major powers’ 7th-Tier Yin Yang Mirror.
Not weak, but in Wang Ping’s eyes, quite ordinary.
“Welcome, distinguished guests, please sit here.”
As Wang Ping was sizing up the Divine Land Holiness, the latter was also studying him. When he found that he couldn’t see through Wang Ping, his smile became even warmer, inviting Wang Ping to sit in the seat of honor, next to him.
This indicated that the Divine Land Holiness considered Wang Ping worthy of the same status as himself.
This surprised the other guardians, but they didn’t say much.
Wang Ping didn’t decline the offer, sitting indifferently in the seat of honor, next to the Divine Land Holiness.
“Mister Wang Ping, may I address you this way? Or should I call you a fellow taoist?”
Looking at Wang Ping, dressed in a white robe with an otherworldly temperament, the Divine Land Holiness asked warmly.
“I don’t mind the way I’m addressed, just call me whatever you like.”
Wang Ping looked at the Divine Land Holiness, speaking calmly.
“Moreover, you don’t have to probe my background. I don’t mind telling you, I am a traveler from another world.”
The Divine Land Holiness was no fool.
He knew Wang Ping was a human with such immense power, and analyzing it revealed that it didn’t belong to their world.
Besides, Xu Yi’s exposure could be easily investigated, and they would discover that he suddenly appeared as an outsider.
Also, the power Xu Yi possessed was not from their world.
Thus, it was better to reveal their identities for a better exchange of information.
At the same time, this would make the Divine Land Holiness and Guardians more accepting of Xu Yi, allowing him to become one of the higher-ups in the Divine Land.
In this way, he could obtain more resources and become more powerful.
This would be beneficial for Xu Yi and the members of the chat group.
“Traveler…from Outside the Domain, huh.”
The Divine Land Holiness and the Guardians stared intently at Wang Ping, their eyes showing great astonishment.
They had previously guessed this answer, but when Wang Ping admitted it personally, they still couldn’t help but feel shocked.
After all, their world faced invasions from various mythological beings, which could be considered external invaders from another domain.
However, Wang Ping was a human, different from the gods, and had even helped the Divine Land defeat Hercules earlier.
Thus, they could preliminarily judge that Wang Ping wasn’t an enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_4
Translator: 549690339
“May I ask, can Mr. Wang come to our world anytime?”
The Divine Land Holiness asked carefully.
“I can come, but there will be a cost involved. If my subordinates weren’t in danger and needed my help, I wouldn’t have come here.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Divine Land Holiness and spoke without hiding anything, his words carried a deep meaning.
“I see.”
Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians present understood Wang Ping’s meaning with a chilling realization in their hearts.
He could come anytime, but only needed to pay a small price.
Moreover, there was a connection between the traversers, so don’t think about any crooked ideas.
“We in the Divine Land always relentlessly pursue our enemies, but we are very hospitable to guests. Now, since your subordinate Xu Yi has become a God Slayer, he should become a member of the Divine Land Guardians.”
The Divine Land Holiness then stated with a smile.
Wang Ping nodded with satisfaction.
“By the way, a Master Lord Tier existence will soon descend, I don’t know how long Mr. Wang can stay in our world. If possible, please lend us a hand.”
The Divine Land Holiness changed the topic and asked again.
This question was another reasonable probe, trying to see if Wang Ping could stay in their world for a long time.
Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged, and he calmly replied: “Although I have matters to attend to in other worlds and cannot stay in this world for too long, it’s enough to help you deal with the incoming Master Lord.”
“Thank you very much.”
Divine Land Holiness felt a little disappointed that he did not hear the answer he wanted to hear, but he still thanked Wang Ping sincerely.
In dealing with the Master Lord Tier, he didn’t have much confidence, so it was necessary to ask for the help of Wang Ping, the mysterious traverser.
Afterward, the Divine Land Holiness and Wang Ping had various discussions, and when the appropriate time came, the Divine Land Holiness half-bowed slightly, laughing: “Mr. Wang, I am also very interested in powers from other worlds. I wonder if we could have a match?”
Upon hearing these words, the Divine Land Guardians were also shocked, intrigued, all of them wishing to witness an astonishing battle.
“A match? Are you sure about this?” Wang Ping looked strangely at the Divine Land Holiness. Although he knew the other party wanted to test his strength limits, he still felt a strange sense of unease.
A not-so-ordinary 7th-Tier Yin Yang Mirror-level power wanted to compete with him, who could crush Saint-tier Characters as if he were a Half-step Life and Death Stage Master – this was way too suicidal.
It was like a child holding a toy knife, wanting to have a match with a fully-armed special forces soldier.
“Is it not suitable? If you’re worried about us getting injured before the arrival of the Master Lord Tier, you don’t have to worry. We in the Divine Land have ways to quickly heal wounds.”
Divine Land Holiness was taken aback, then laughed as he thought Wang Ping was worried about injury.
Wang Ping was very strong – Divine Land Holiness admitted that.
Based on the images monitored by the satellites, Wang Ping’s power far exceeded that of ordinary Divine Land Guardians, but Divine Land Holiness thought he still had the power to fight him.
Because he, too, possessed such power.
“No, you misunderstood me. There is no need for us to have a match. Because the gap between our strengths is too wide, it’s not a match, but plain bullying the weak.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke lightly.
Upon hearing these words, all the Divine Land Guardians were shocked.
Wang Ping was blatantly disrespecting the Venerable, treating him as weak and not worthy of a fight.
Even the Divine Land Holiness’s face changed, as he thought Wang Ping was too arrogant, quite unlike his previous modest demeanor.
“How troublesome.”
Wang Ping sighed, and lightly tapped the table.
As the tapping sound echoed, a terrifying aura erupted, covering the entire area in an instant.
At that moment, the entire Divine Land Guardian Tower was affected and began to shake violently.
This caught the attention of the whole Divine Capital, and everyone watched the trembling Divine Land Guardian Tower in astonishment and fear, wondering what had happened.
It was important to know that the Divine Land Guardian Tower stood tall and dominated the dragon veins. Its materials were special, and even an 8th-tier earthquake couldn’t budge it.
Yet now, it was visibly shaking, seemingly at the brink of collapsing.
As for the Divine Land Guardians present, they were all left pale-faced and overwhelmed by the sudden, terrifying aura, feeling like vomiting blood.
Even the Divine Land Guardian himself turned pale and wore a horrified expression.
This was still the result of Wang Ping holding back.
Otherwise, with his current cultivation, he could easily crush some weaker Divine Land Guardians with just his aura.
“Mr. Wang, stop, please stop.”
Divine Land Holiness was sweating in cold fear, and spoke with a wry smile.
With that, Wang Ping withdrew his aura, a smile at the corner of his mouth, and asked slowly, “I wonder if the Venerable still wants to have a match with me?”
“A match… a match my ass!”
Divine Land Holiness cursed inwardly.
Damn it, what kind of monster is this? Just releasing his aura has left me gasping for breath.
How could you even fight?
No way.
If it really came to a fight, saying that he could be killed in an instant would even be an overstatement.
If the other party wanted to kill him, it might not be much more difficult than crushing an ant.

chapters.title: Chapter 394: 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: 149: Instantly Killing Hercules! Respect of the Divine Land’s Venerator_5
Translator: 549690339
“Venerable, I am not worthy of that title, just call me Little Chen by my full name, Wang Ping.”
Immediately, the Divine Land Holiness forced a bitter smile and completely lowered his stance.
Wang Ping’s strength was far superior to his, and he no longer had the courage to communicate with Wang Ping on equal footing.
There was no choice. Initially, he thought their strengths were equal, and Wang Ping was only a little stronger than him at most. But who knew Wang Ping would be so abnormal?
Even a Master Lord might not necessarily reach this level.
“Little Chen, I’m curious, what made the earliest humans able to slay gods and become so powerful? Logically, if there’s no special reason, humans would never be able to kill gods, right?”
Seeing the other party lower their stance, Wang Ping didn’t bother with modesty and asked with a smile.
This caused the below Divine Land Guardians to exchange looks, all sighing inwardly. Today, they were truly broadening their horizons.
It has been said that there are always people beyond a person, and skies beyond a sky; it really makes sense.
“We are not clear about the reasons why the various divine systems came and invaded. The reason we could slay gods is because of the relics left behind by the Eastern Divine System.”
The Divine Land Holiness took a deep breath, didn’t conceal anything, and earnestly explained.
“We obtained some inheritances from the relics that allow humans to cultivate and gain extraordinary power, as well as some tools to kill gods.”
“So that’s how it is.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, deep in thought.
“According to your statement, it is very likely that the gods of other divine systems were intercepted by the Eastern Divine System. To put it more accurately, the two sides are at war, which is why from time to time a deity descends to the world, instead of a full-scale descent, right?”
“Our speculation is indeed so…..”
Divine Land Holiness sighed.
“But, if our speculation is correct, according to Hercules, the Master Lord is about to descend to the world. This suggests that the situation on the battlefield of the gods does not seem to be particularly optimistic.”
“Interesting.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes.
Then, without any change in his expression, he said in his heart directly: “System, I want to proceed with the free simulation.”
He was still somewhat interested in this world. Since he had already come and was prepared to kill the Master Lord, it was only natural to simulate once.
In addition, Wang Ping also wanted to see if there were any reincarnators who slipped through the net in this world or any strange items.
“Ding, Life Simulator starts, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
[On the first day, you ended the meeting and received the warm hospitality of Divine Land Holiness.]
[On the second day early in the morning, the space above the Divine Capital shattered, and a figure descended upon the Divine Land. The figure turned out to be Apollo, one of the Twelve Olympus Gods in Greek mythology.]
[Apollo’s appearance filled the sky with divine radiance, appearing very holy, but it contained destructive power. Light God Apollo pronounced the death sentence of mankind, began to gather power, and unleashed a terrorizing strike.]
[In the end, you chose to take action and stopped him. Light God Apollo was quite powerful, equivalent to a strong half-step Life and Death Stage, but compared to you, it was still nothing.]
[You casually killed Light God Apollo, shocking Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians, letting them know more clearly where your strength lies.]
[After killing Light God Apollo, you discovered that his power seems to want to enter your body to modify your structure. The mana in your Elixir Field strongly repels this power, and the two forces collide in your Elixir Field. Eventually, Apollo’s Divine Power was forcibly expelled from your body by your mana.]
[Surprised by this, you quickly enveloped the power, compressed it, and formed a Divine Bead. Although much of the power leaked out, you believe that as long as you find a special way to integrate the Divine Bead into a person’s body, you can create a God Slayer.]
[Your actions astonished Divine Land Holiness and the others. They had once thought about whether this method was feasible, but their strength was not enough. Killing a god as soon as possible to prevent extensive destruction is already difficult, let alone forming a Divine Bead.]
[At the same time, they lamented how becoming a God Slayer would be a great temptation for ordinary people, yet you seem indifferent to it, and even somewhat disdainful. All they could say was, comparing oneself to others can be infuriating.]
[Next, you did not continue to stay in this world, nor were you able to stay too long. You chose to return, ending this simulation.]
“I’ve returned, it seems I can’t simulate the following plot.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly, his eyes flickering.
There is a time limit for situations where he traveled to other worlds without carrying out tasks; he must leave within three days, otherwise, he will suffer repulsion. The repulsive force will grow stronger over time and reach the critical point after a week.
By then, anything bad could happen, and various unexpected deaths are not impossible.
Therefore, it was normal for the simulated Wang Ping to choose to return.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent
Translator: 549690339
“It seems that I can’t help group members figure out the future. Only when a bizarre group task appears and can’t be resolved for a long time, can I simulate a more distant future.”
Wang Ping thought to himself and gave up the idea of continuing the simulation.
“According to the Heavenly Secrets I observed, Apollo, one of the Twelve Olympus Gods of Greece, will descend in the Divine Capital tomorrow.”
Wang Ping looked around at the people present and calmly said this sentence.
The expressions of Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardian changed instantly, showing surprise and then becoming serious.
They were amazed that Wang Ping could observe the Heavenly Secrets, but in front of the terrifying power Wang Ping had shown before, they all chose to trust him.
At the same time, they were concerned about how soon the Master Lord would come and that the place of descent would be the crucial Divine Capital.
The Master Lord was aiming to strike the enemy’s den directly.
“Don’t worry, leave it to me. Just a mere Master Lord, I’m not scared at all.”
Seeing the group’s serious expressions, Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“Thank you.”
Divine Land Holiness breathed a sigh of relief, his face full of gratitude.
Fortunately, Wang Ping came. Otherwise, they might have been caught off guard by the crisis.
The consequences of a Master Lord Tier existence suddenly appearing in the Divine Capital could be chilling just by thinking about them.
If a war broke out, the Divine Capital might be destroyed, tens of millions of people affected, and countless lives lost in the aftermath of the battle.
If the Master Lord was powerful enough, they might not even be able to stop it with the help of the Divine Land Guardian Tower and the power of the Dragon Veins.
Everything would be over then.
“Prepare a room for me. I will wait for the arrival of Bright Lord Apollo. After I kill him, I will leave. If your world is in danger again and you can pay enough reward, you can ask for our help.”
Wang Ping’s face was indifferent, and his words were profound.
“We…”
Divine Land Holiness hesitated and then nodded resolutely.
Wang Ping’s meaning was clear. Their travelers had an organization.
Not only did they have him, a powerful person, but also other powerful individuals who might be even stronger than him.
“If we encounter a crisis, we will prepare the reward and contact you through your subordinate.”
Divine Land Holiness said with a look of reverence.
“Hmm.” Wang Ping nodded slightly.
Although Bright Lord Apollo’s strength was only at the Half-step Life and Death Stage level, he was not considered powerful among the gods.
War Lord God Ares and Goddess of Wisdom Athena were definitely stronger than him.
God King Zeus, one of the Twelve Main Gods, was even more powerful.
Not to mention, above Zeus, there were also the first and second generation of gods, but it was unknown whether they still existed.
Of course, Wang Ping’s words were also considering the attitude of the Eastern Divine System and Divine Land Holiness hiding some of their cards.
No matter the situation, considering Xu Yi’s safety, it was the right choice to continue increasing their deterrent force.
Day and night alternated, and a new day arrived.
At the break of dawn, Wang Ping stood atop the Divine Land Guardian Tower, his white robe fluttering in the wind, waiting quietly.
Behind him, Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians took flight one after another, accompanying Wang Ping in silence.
This scene was not hidden, and many observant people noticed it, looking at it with surprise, not knowing what had happened.
At the same time, they were also shocked by Wang Ping’s identity. They didn’t know his background, but he clearly made the great Divine Land Holiness and Guardians stand behind him, as their leader.
However, no matter who it was, they didn’t dare to approach or blatantly stare at them. They could only sneak glances from time to time, afraid of being discovered by Wang Ping and his group, but also driven by curiosity.
At this moment, Xu Yi flew out and stood behind them as well.
This surprised Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians.
Receiving power and waking up in just one day was astonishing.
“Strange.”
Wang Ping also looked at Xu Yi with surprise.
He noticed Xu Yi’s abnormality.
Xu Yi seized Hercules’ power.
If he seized Hercules’ power, it was impossible for him to be stronger than Hercules himself.
But Xu Yi was indeed stronger than Hercules, and not just by a little, he was about three times stronger.
“What’s going on with you?”
Wang Ping glanced at Xu Yi with a subtle expression and communicated with him directly.
“Hehe, boss, this is related to my Golden Finger. My Golden Finger is an amplifier. That is, whether it’s the weapons I get, the power gained from cultivation, or other powers, as long as my Golden Finger is triggered, it can be randomly amplified, increasing its quantity.”
“This time I was very lucky to trigger the amplification probability. The amplification rate was three times, so it turned out like this.”
Xu Yi smiled as he communicated back to Wang Ping.
“Amplification…”
Wang Ping’s gaze became a little strange.
This Golden Finger was indeed quite powerful.
Now, the threefold amplification might not seem like much, but once Xu Yi gained more power, the amplification would become even more exaggerated.
This Golden Finger was similar to his Unstable Optimizer, both having trigger probabilities that they could not control. However, the Unstable Optimizer was not as strong as Xu Yi’s amplification.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_2
Translator: 549690339
Multipliers, without the option of Negative Optimization. Besides that, there are other differences, but generally speaking, multipliers are stronger.”
This is actually quite normal.
After all, his unstable Optimizer is a Red Talent refreshed from the Life Simulator, while Xu Yi’s multiplier is the golden finger awakened by this transmigrator, and the two are on completely different levels.
Trying to compare a Red Talent to someone else’s golden finger is obviously unrealistic.
Maybe only higher-level talents can be compared to some golden fingers in level.
“What are you hiding your golden finger for? With your golden finger, you can increase all kinds of resources in the group, and it’s so awesome. At that time, you can make a fortune by taking a percentage, and also sell favors. People in the group can grow rapidly as well.”
Wang Ping transmitted his voice somewhat helplessly.
Unstable Optimizers, he had thought of that too.
However, after he experimented and found that not even one item out of a hundred could trigger it, he chose to give up.
After all, there is also the time cost, and the probability of triggering is too low, which is obviously not worth it.
If you spend time triggering the optimization of some low-level items, it’s better to earn some Primordial Liquid on your own, which has a higher cost-performance ratio.
But Xu Yi is different. He has a higher probability of triggering, and he is not too strong, so he has plenty of time for such operations.
By then, he would definitely become the second richest man in the chat group, only after Wang Ping.
“Holy shit! Why didn’t I think of that!”
Xu Yi’s eyes widened, and he transmitted his voice excitedly.
This left Wang Ping speechless.
Wang Ping originally thought that Xu Yi hid his golden finger as a deep-thinking intellectual, but now he seemed a bit naive.
“Ahem, it’s not that I didn’t think of it, it’s just that it’s not easy to operate. After all, I’m an insignificant character in the group and have a low credit score, just like borrowing money, right?”
Xu Yi regained his composure, seemingly feeling that he had exposed his intelligence a little, and coughed lightly as he spoke.
“Now that you’ve become stronger, people will definitely believe in you, and I can let you operate some of the things I have.”
Wang Ping sighed and continued to transmit his voice.
There are very few people in the chat group, and they still have to go out on missions together often. As long as Xu Yi isn’t foolish, he won’t dare to steal other people’s things.
The principal definitely won’t dare to steal.
However, the amplified stuff… that’s not necessarily the case.
If multiplied by several times, it’s entirely up to him.
If he’s a bit of a black heart, he will definitely choose to take more.
Of course, as long as he isn’t foolish, he won’t go too far, or else everyone would lose trust in him.
Well, that doesn’t seem right.
Xu Yi’s intelligence clearly isn’t high.
It seems that some proper training is needed.
Besides, some transparency is required for the multiplication, and this can be discussed with Alpha.
Various ideas flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
“Okay! I’ll try it later!”
Xu Yi transmitted his excited voice, already imagining his prosperous future.
“By the way, can you multiply Group Points?”
Wang Ping thought of something and asked Xu Yi.
Although he felt it was unlikely, he couldn’t help but ask.
“Uh, I don’t think so. After all, I’ve never triggered my golden finger in that regard.”
Xu Yi shook his head in response.
“I thought so.”
Wang Ping wasn’t surprised at Xu Yi’s answer and didn’t say anything more.
The Divine Land Holiness and Divine Land Guardians could tell that Wang Ping and Xu Yi seemed to be communicating about something, but since they had chosen to transmit voices, they couldn’t just ask more and pretended not to have noticed.
“Crack!”
At this moment, ripples appeared in the sky, and a long, slender crack appeared.
This attracted the attention of the Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians, who felt a chill in their hearts and alerted their spirits, knowing that the Bright Lord Apollo would soon descend.
Many people in the Divine Capital also noticed this scene, their eyes widening in astonishment.
Some people couldn’t even resist taking out their phones for pictures or videos.
However, some clever people felt a shiver from the bottom of their feet all the way to the top of their heads.
The unusual actions of the Divine Land Holiness and the Divine Land Guardians, coupled with the cracked sky, clearly indicated that a major event was about to happen, probably related to the gods.
Perhaps it was an event concerning the survival of mankind.
This place was about to become a battlefield.
They really wanted to flee, but they had no means of escaping in such a short time, so they could only stare at the sky in a daze, trembling with cold, and imagining the horrors of the divine battle that would soon spread through their minds.
“By the way, boss, what are you guys waiting for here so early in the morning? And, Mr. Wang, what’s going on?”
Xu Yi also looked at the sky in astonishment and couldn’t help asking two questions.
“Wait, could it be an Archlord…”
Soon, Xu Yi came to his senses and grew tense.
Although he trusted Wang Ping very much, Wang Ping’s strength shown yesterday was also amazing, but this was an Archlord we’re talking about.
After receiving Hercules’ strength, he felt more and more that the Archlord was definitely a terrifying presence, most likely stronger than Wang Ping’s strength shown yesterday.
If not, Hercules wouldn’t have been shouting about the Archlord’s coming to the very end, saying that they were all going to die.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_3
Translator: 549690339
“It’s just one Master Lord, what are you afraid of?”
Seeing Xu Yi a little nervous, Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
“Uh…” Xu Yi was at a loss for words, not knowing how to respond.
“Yeah, just one Master Lord. With Master Wang Ping here, we can definitely handle it easily.”
The Divine Land Venerable nodded and spoke.
This gave Xu Yi a strange look in his eyes.
Goodness, what happened during the time he was passed out?
Why did the Divine Land Venerable and the Divine Land Guardians, characters he only saw online, trust Wang Ping more than him as a traveler from the past?
Moreover, the Divine Land Venerable and others called Wang Ping ‘Master’ directly, lowering their status, which was outrageous.
“Crack!”
While everyone was chatting, the cracks in the sky became more and more numerous, and finally, they shattered completely, revealing a huge cavern with spatial turbulence coming out of it.
Wang Ping looked at the shattered sky and the space cavern, his face calm and unchanged.
The spatial turbulence in this world was much weaker than the spatial turbulence he saw through the Blue Talent: Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death.
It could only be said that in different worlds, the strengths of space were different.
Wang Ping felt that with his strength, it would be difficult to break space in the Purple Spirit Realm, but in this world, he could easily do such a thing.
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, a figure emerged from the space cavern.
With his appearance, a terrifying divine power began to ripple, and dazzling lights emerged, making the sky and the earth extremely bright, causing the Divine Land Guardian and the Divine Land Venerable and others to feel apprehensive, as if their eyes hurt from the glare.
As for the Divine Capital, a powerful formation was activated instantly, centering on the Divine Land Guardian Tower, protecting the entire Divine Capital and shielding it from the divine light and aura.
If not, all the humans in the Divine Capital would probably be crushed.
Even if they weren’t crushed by the aura, they would be permanently blinded by the divine light, or even die on the spot.
Gods were beings that humans of this world couldn’t directly face. If one tried to forcibly look at a deity who was showing off their divine might without any protection, they would suffer heavy consequences.
“This guy, he really likes to show off.”
Wang Ping’s face was indifferent as he looked at Light God Apollo and furrowed his eyebrows slightly.
However, Wang Ping didn’t intend to make a move directly.
He wanted to earn group points. He had to let Light God Apollo show enough power to destroy humanity, right?
Otherwise, if he made the move directly and killed Light God Apollo, the world consciousness would not acknowledge the danger. If they didn’t buy it, wouldn’t he lose out?
At this moment, Light God Apollo didn’t even give a glance to the Divine Land Venerable and the Divine Land Guardians.
It seemed that in his eyes, these god slayers and ordinary humans were no different, and they could be ignored.
He indeed had such strength.
The 7th-Tier Yin Yang Mirror Combat Skill and the Half-step Life and Death Stage were too far apart. Should a fight break out, Light God Apollo could easily crush the Divine Land Venerable.
Let alone the Divine Land Venerable, even more so for the Divine Land Guardians.
The strength of these people was only equivalent to that of ordinary 1st and 2nd tier Yin Yang Mirror practitioners.
As for Wang Ping, he hid his aura and was also ignored.
“The Eastern Divine System, with the size of one divine system, dares to challenge the Union of Deities. How arrogant and conceited.”
“But after so many years of war, the gods have to admit the strength of this divine system. It has managed to stalemate against the Union of Deities with the power of one divine system, forcing this god to descend and deal with insignificant ants, nipping their lifeblood.”
Light God Apollo’s eyes were as dazzling as the sun as he looked down at the Divine Capital, his face cold and aloof.
“The Dragon Vein of the Divine Land, its connection to mankind and the Eastern Divine System, shall be destroyed.”
Immediately, a bow and arrow appeared in the hands of Light God Apollo, and terrifying divine light began to gather, forming an arrow that shot towards the Guardian Tower of the Divine Capital.
This arrow carried the power of the Master Lord Tier and Light Lord Apollo’s divine authority. Its power was enough to directly destroy the Divine Land.
Facing this arrow, the great array of the Divine Capital was pierced through and was about to be shattered.
In the face of the power of the gods, the City Protection Formation of the Divine Capital was still somewhat fragile.
Just at the critical moment when the Divine Land Venerable was horrified, Wang Ping instantly appeared in front of the Light Arrow and grabbed it with one hand.
“Huh?”
The face of Light Lord God Apollo finally changed, and he looked at Wang Ping, who had suddenly appeared, and the Light Arrow caught in his hand with surprise.
“A human?”
Light Lord God Apollo stared at Wang Ping bewilderedly. After sensing Wang Ping’s aura, his face changed again in disbelief.
A human being actually possessed such immense power, even catching the arrow he had condensed with his divine power.
This was a strike from a Master Lord, a force enough to directly destroy the Divine Land, yet it was caught single-handedly by Wang Ping, something even the crazy War God Ares would have difficulty doing.
“Crack!”
As the Light Lord God Apollo was shocked, Wang Ping’s right hand slightly tightened, and the Light Arrow was directly crushed and turned into light particles that disappeared.
“Too weak.”
Wang Ping gave his evaluation.
The evaluation in the simulator was rather accurate.
The Light Lord God was but a relatively strong Half-step Life and Death Stage.
But, a relatively strong Half-step Life and Death Stage was still just a Half-step Life and Death Stage after all. It couldn’t reach the level of a true Life and Death Realm, and compared to Wang Ping, it was far too inferior.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_4
Translator: 549690339
“Weak? You’re calling me, the Light Lord God, weak?”
Light Lord God Apollo came back to his senses, his face turning ugly.
Gods are proud and arrogant. Being despised by a human who they consider an ant, Light Lord God Apollo was furious.
He unleashed terrifying divine power, causing the sky to become extremely bright, as if nothing else existed in the world besides light.
This horrifying light caused the Divine Land Holiness and Divine Land Guardian Gods to close their eyes involuntarily, feeling as if they were going to be completely blinded.
However, before the Light Lord God could fully burst forth, Wang Ping’s shadow appeared in front of Light Lord God Apollo in an instant. His palm directly gripped Apollo’s cheek, and terrifying mana surged, directly suppressing his divine power back.
“Furious incompetence is fine, but don’t make yourself like a giant light bulb. It’s really blinding,” Wang Ping said indifferently.
Feeling his own power being forcibly suppressed, Light Lord God Apollo’s face changed once again, revealing an incredulous expression.
He could not believe that a human could accomplish such a thing, nor could he accept that his divine power was being suppressed by a human in an instant, leaving him without the ability to resist.
“Watch carefully, I will only demonstrate it once, how to use the power of light.”
As Light Lord God Apollo was on the verge of breaking down, Wang Ping’s voice rang out once more.
Then, Wang Ping mobilized the light attribute mana within him.
In an instant, a large number of light particles emerged and condensed into a light giant in the sky.
“Holy shit!”
Xu Yi stared at the light giant, eyes wide open, and exclaimed in astonishment.
Damn, Mr. Wang knows how to have fun.
Using the power of light to form a light giant to destroy Light Lord Apollo seemed outrageous.
Light Lord God Apollo also looked at the light giant, somewhat dazed.
He didn’t know the inside story of the light giant, but he could sense the powerful energy it contained.
Among them, the power of light was even greater than his.
What a joke.
He was the Light Lord God, and there was actually a human with light attribute power that surpassed his. Where could he put his face as the Light Lord God?
For a moment, the mental state of Light Lord Apollo collapsed even more.
It was also at this time when Light Lord Apollo’s mental state was more collapsing that Wang Ping threw him out.
Immediately afterward, the Light Giant struck an odd pose and directly used a light beam to engulf Light Lord Apollo.
A terrifying explosion occurred in the sky, and beams of light shot out in all directions, forming a bizarre scene with no clouds for thousands of miles, but light particles falling down, astonishing countless people.
“Uh…”
Xu Yi looked at this scene with an odd expression, a very subtle look on his face.
Mr. Wang really knew how to play. The way Light Lord Apollo died was too tragic, it was really embarrassing.
No, it was humiliating for a God.
On the other side, the Divine Land Holiness and the others looked at each other with stunned expressions.
This… was that it?
This was Apollo, one of the twelve main gods of Olympus in Greece. He was killed in an instant without putting up any resistance…
Moreover, he was killed in such a dramatic manner that people didn’t know how to comment.
“Ding, congratulations to group member Wang Ping (66) for solving this human extinction crisis, and earning a reward of 500,000 group points,” the chat group’s voice sounded, making Wang Ping frown slightly.
“What’s going on? Only 500,000 group points? Apollo, the god of light in Half-step Life and Death Stage, has really depreciated.”
Wang Ping was somewhat dissatisfied.
“This is a crisis that occurred within this world and not an invasion from outsiders. Although the world loves humans, it does not mean it will be biased toward humans in all aspects. You have 500,000 group points as a reward, which is already quite good,” Alpha’s cold voice rang.
“Fine,” Wang Ping reluctantly accepted the matter.
Having 500,000 group points was better than nothing.
“The power of the Light Lord God is here,”
At this moment, Divine Land Holiness and others’ spirits were shaken as they looked up at the sky.
After the fall of Light Lord God, a large number of light particles began to move towards Wang Ping, wanting to enter his body.
For this, Divine Land Holiness and others were still quite envious.
After all, this was the power of a Master Lord Tier, and if someone in the Divine Land could obtain the power of a Master Lord Tier, they would be able to sleep soundly to some extent.
Even if another Master Lord-Tier presence arrived in the future, they would still have the strength to fight.
“The power of the Master Lord? Useless to me,” Wang Ping said indifferently when Divine Land Holiness and others looked envious.
Then, Wang Ping used a method to condense these light particles, sealing them with spatial and light concepts, compressing and condensing them with secret skills until they formed a crystal-clear, white bead.
Contained within it was powerful divine power.
Seeing this scene, Divine Land Holiness and others showed astonished expressions as they never thought Wang Ping could pull off such a move.
Everyone present was not a fool; they could guess that the divine bead contained the power of Light Lord Apollo.
Perhaps, it could allow someone else to inherit the power.
At that time, a Master Lord-Tier God-slayer would be born.
For a time, countless people’s hearts were stirred.
“Lord Wang Ping, I wonder if you could trade with us,” Divine Land Holiness took a deep breath, his face solemn, and thickly-skinned asked.
“Trade? What can you offer me for an equivalent exchange?”

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 150: Instant Kill! A New Red Talent_5
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping looked at the Divine Land Holiness and spoke indifferently.
“Uh…”
The Divine Land Holiness fell silent, unable to speak.
Although they had some background, they really didn’t have anything of value that could compare to a Master Lord Tier Divine Bead.
Without the capital to exchange, he wasn’t qualified to trade with Wang Ping.
For a moment, the Divine Land Holiness could only give up with a bitter smile on his face.
At this time, Wang Ping threw the Bright Divine Bead to Xu Yi.
“Boss, are you giving it to me?” Xu Yi exclaimed in surprise.
“You wish, I just want to see if you can activate the multiplication Golden finger, that’s all.”
Wang Ping was somewhat speechless as he communicated with Xu Yi through sound transmission.
Did he really think he didn’t care about anything, and could just give anything away?
Allowing Xu Yi to kill Hercules had already been a great favor, and he had taken extra care of him.
Still wanting the power of the Light Lord God was too greedy.
“Ah, I see.”
Xu Yi awkwardly responded and tried to activate the Golden finger ability.
Unfortunately, he was unsuccessful.
“Did it fail?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
“Not necessarily. If it doesn’t trigger within an hour, it is considered a failure.”
Xu Yi explained through sound transmission.
“That’s fine, I’ll wait for you for an hour.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered.
While Wang Ping and Xu Yi were secretly communicating, the Divine Land Holiness and the others saw that Wang Ping had handed over the Bright Divine Bead to Xu Yi. Envious, they began to value Xu Yi even more.
It seemed that Xu Yi held a good position in Wang Ping’s heart and was most likely a key cultivation target.
Afterward, Wang Ping and the others didn’t continue to linger in the sky and directly returned to the Divine Land Guardian Tower.
“Mr.Wang, I have a thought, I don’t know if I should say it or not.”
Xu Yi looked troubled, unable to hold back from speaking.
“What is it?” Wang Ping glanced at him, signaling him to hurry up and spit it out.
“Actually, I’ve always had a doubt… Our world has a special set of rules, if we leave this world, can we still inherit the power of deities?”
Xu Yi stroked his chin as he spoke.
“I’ve thought about this issue before. In this world, you can kill deities and take their power with the help of world rules. But, the Light Lord God’s situation is different, as his powers are sealed by me.”
Wang Ping nodded slightly and spoke calmly.
“It means that even if we leave for other worlds, we can still try to let others inherit the power. Experimenting isn’t difficult for me.”
He had the Life Simulator, so conducting experiments without wasting the Bright Divine Bead was an easy task.
However, Xu Yi was even more restless than he had imagined.
If he had to describe it in one phrase, he was too greedy.
Even though Wang Ping had made it clear that Xu Yi was daydreaming, he still hadn’t given up on the idea.
“I see.” Xu Yi looked regretful.
Seeing Xu Yi’s regretful expression, Wang Ping’s evaluation of him went even lower.
However, Wang Ping didn’t say anything more, nor did he show any abnormal expression.
Xu Yi’s Golden finger still had some value to it.
But, Wang Ping would not focus on cultivating him anymore.
People with this kind of character can easily cause trouble due to greed.
When trouble arises, it’s a headache.
“Alpha, can you add a function to livestream videos and record them? After every time Xu Yi triggers his Golden finger, he must upload a video or livestream.”
Wang Ping silently spoke in his heart.
Considering Xu Yi’s displayed greed, if they were to truly implement the resource-doubling plan, he would undoubtedly be greedier than Wang Ping imagined, secretly taking resources.
At that time, sustainability wouldn’t be good.
Therefore, Wang Ping planned to make the rules clear and transparent. He could divide the resources, but he wouldn’t be allowed to secretly take more.
Having one black-hearted Alpha was enough; Wang Ping didn’t want a second black-hearted group member to appear in the chat group.
“Of course, it’s possible.” Alpha’s cold voice rang out. “But…”
“What?” Wang Ping frowned.
“But, please stop slandering me in your heart. What do you mean by black-hearted Alpha?”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
Wang Ping snorted disdainfully in his heart and let Alpha experience it for himself.
You know if you’re black-hearted or not.
Also, what about not caring about group members’ words, but now showing such a petty mind?
“Regarding the plan to use your Golden finger to double the resources, I will mention it in the chat group. To make everyone in the group believe it, we must be clear about the distribution of resources after doubling. In addition, you need to livestream when you activate your Golden finger, otherwise, everyone will still have doubts.”
Wang Ping didn’t continue chatting with Alpha and instead stared at Xu Yi, speaking seriously.
“Ah, do I need to livestream?”
Xu Yi hesitated a bit.
“Of course, you need to livestream. Otherwise, if something happens, I won’t be able to guarantee anything for you.”
Wang Ping spoke meaningfully.
“But, the chat group doesn’t have a livestream function, right?”
Xu Yi asked, somewhat puzzled.
“It will in the future. This can be requested from the chat group. As for things that are beneficial to the development of the chat group, they will seriously consider adding such functions.”
Wang Ping calmly took a sip of tea and replied.
“Alright.”
Xu Yi was a bit depressed, but could only nod his head.
An hour later, the Bright Divine Bead still hadn’t changed, and Wang Ping was somewhat disappointed. He took back the Bead and left this world.
Seeing Wang Ping take away the Bright Divine Bead and leave, Xu Yi also felt regretful.
Although he was envious, there was nothing he could do to wrest it from Wang Ping’s possession.
After Wang Ping returned to the Purple Spirit Realm, he directly spoke in his heart: “System, I want to spend 300,000 Top-Tier Spirit Stones for a Paid Simulation.”
He wanted to experiment with whether it was feasible to have the Bright Divine Bead grant others the power of the Light Lord God.
Of course, the experiment was just a minor matter and coincidental.
Even without this experiment, Wang Ping would still continue with the simulation, wanting to quickly stack rewards and comprehend the Domain Embryo, becoming unrivaled in his realm.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on refreshing the Red Talent: Breath Concealment…”

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 151: Blow up the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number One in Both Realms!
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 151: Blow up the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number One in Both Realms!
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations on refreshing the Red Talent: Breath Concealment, and the Green Talent: Boxing Prodigy.”
Red Talent: Breath Concealment – With this talent, the host can freely conceal their own breath, making it impossible for others to gauge their depth. Even Emperors will not be able to see through their soul’s breath from a distance.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping was shocked by the talents he had just refreshed.
Well, it seemed that all the luck he had accumulated was worth it, as he was directly given another red talent.
Moreover, this red talent was something he desperately wanted.
Red Talent level Breath Concealment!
With this talent, he no longer needed to worry about being targeted by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘Predecessor ransmigrator’.
Although according to the description of the talent, it was impossible to see through him from a distance. If the distance was too close, he still couldn’t hide it, but it was enough.
After all, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was unlikely to be so idle as to specifically target a somewhat ‘special’ junior like him.
In the eyes of Emperors, unless they were beings of the same level, or those they recognized as pawns or successors, even if a junior was incredibly talented, it might not catch their attention when their cultivation was low.
There were too many uncertain factors in cultivation. In the Purple Spirit Realm, no matter how talented one was, they might not become an Emperor. They could fall midway due to various unexpected events.
The Profound Ice Emperor was talented enough, but although he was called an Emperor, his cultivation ultimately never reached the Emperor Realm. That’s the outcome.
“Speaking of which, I now have this red talent and don’t need to worry about Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s ‘Predecessor ransmigrator’ targeting me, but it’s not the same for Cai Yonglong. Once he appears, he will still be exposed. By then, he will be targeted again, and I will be implicated.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly as he thought of Cai Yonglong’s situation.
“Forget it, let’s not let Cai Yonglong join the Holy Land this time. Let him develop low-key and not reveal himself. Oh, right, the same goes for Ye Chen. Let’s try not to let him enter the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and see if I can get the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance,”
Various thoughts popped up in Wang Ping’s mind as he said to the system in his heart: “System, I choose the Red Talent: Breath Concealment.”
“Ding, talent selection successful. Life simulation begins.”
The familiar sound of the system rang out, and the luminescent screen appeared with the text emerging.
[Day 1: You choose to return to Heavenly Sea Country, intending to take Ye Chen away before he is taken away by the expert, paving the way for the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[Unfortunately, even if you returned to the Heavenly Sea Country at the fastest speed, you were still a step late. Ye Chen has already disappeared.]
[You felt regretful about this and could only return to the Black Light Valley. When Cai Yonglong left seclusion, you gave him the divine bead condensed by the Light Lord God Apollo and let him try to absorb its power.]
[Cai Yonglong was very surprised and chose to absorb it. In the end, he successfully inherited the power of the Light Lord God Apollo. However, there was a huge flaw. That is, this power was consumable. Once consumed, it diminished and could not be replenished until it was completely depleted.]
“Being able to inherit is good news, but the fact that it’s consumable power is a bit crappy.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a slight frown.
Half-step Life and Death Stage power was not worth much in Wang Ping’s eyes, and the fact that it was consumable in nature made it even less valuable. It could only be used as a one-time item, possibly allowing a group member to turn the tables in a desperate situation.
“Forget it, let’s keep it for now. Maybe it’s because a good inheritance method hasn’t been researched.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and didn’t think about it any further, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you let Cai Yonglong stay in Black Light Valley to cultivate. After explaining many things to him, you leave. Next, you head to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and are successfully accepted as a personal disciple by the Sky Emperor. This time, because of the concealment of your breath, the Sky Emperor has a better attitude towards you, and he trusts you even more.]
[Afterwards, you quietly cultivated, working hard to comprehend the Domain Force. During this time, you rarely made a move, and even though you were a personal disciple of the Sky Emperor, no one knew how strong you really were. Even Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue were unaware. All they knew was that you were strong, but they didn’t know just how strong.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, since he did not join the Holy Land, he was always laying low and growing; there was no need to mention him.]
[Before the Flaming Fire Secret Realm was about to open, Ye Chen could no longer hold back his curiosity and challenged you to a duel. This aroused the interest of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land’s Masters, making them curious about you.]
[After considering, you accepted the challenge. In the end, you only showed a little bit of your strength, and easily defeated Ye Chen. After this fight, the Heavenly Sword Divine Land was shaken.]
[Subsequently, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm began, and you entered. Because Cai Yonglong was not present, you didn’t gain any chances and your harvest was minimal. You didn’t care much about this, because what you were aiming for was the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[You were very clear in your heart that Ye Chen was the biggest obstacle to obtaining the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance. However, since things had gotten this far, you didn’t have any crooked ideas and decided to compete fairly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _2
Translator: 549690339
“Your understanding of the Domain Force has advanced yet another level. You now have some hope of inheriting the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy.”
“At the True King Blood Flower, you concealed your identity and aura, seized the opportunity, and drew great ire. Even Ji Bingyue didn’t recognize you.”
“This time, you deliberately waited for the appearance of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, but they didn’t show up. You confirmed a suspicion in your heart. The group in your memory was indeed deliberately targeting you, the ‘traveler’. Once you obscured your aura, they no longer needed to take risks and lay out a trap.”
“Next, you stationed yourself early at the place where the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower would appear, waiting for the tower and being the first to challenge it.”
“After the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower appeared, this time, you held nothing back. You used the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, Divine Skills, and a slight grasp of Domain Force. You reached the Hundredth Floor at a speed that others could barely match.”
“Because you had been squatting here and had not been out finding opportunities, there were barely any people here. Only a handful arrived a bit later, and seeing someone challenge the Hundredth Floor left them utterly astonished. As for Ye Chen, nobody knew where he was.”
“As for you, who reached the Hundredth Floor, the lingering spirit of the Flaming Fire Emperor was in a quandary about whether to impart his inheritance to you. After all, you possess the Sword Profound Body, a natural Sword Skill Genius, and didn’t major in the Fire Path. You weren’t his ideal successor.”
“However, The Flaming Fire Emperor thought your cultivation technique extraordinary. You gained an understanding of the Domain Force at such a young age. In a few hundred years, you could gain insight into the Domain Embryo. Truly monstrous. In addition, you tamed the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, your talent in the Fire Attribute was not much weaker than that of Sword Skill. In the end, he gave you his inheritance.”
“You received the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance, and you were extremely excited, feeling that arriving earlier and giving all of your power to the tower challenge was a correct choice. Of course, it also had a lot to do with your understanding of some Domain Force. Otherwise, the Flaming Fire Emperor might not have given you his inheritance. After all, at such a young age, understanding the power of insight to such a degree was simply terrifying.”
“Of course, you know better than anyone that you’re cheating the system and are merely taking advantage of accumulated time.”
“Well done, it’s actually successful. As I expected, challenging the tower before Ye Chen arrives is crucial.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his eyes sparkling, a smile on his face.
What is the approach to obtaining inheritance without refreshing talent?
Naturally, it’s by outdoing Ye Chen.
While Ye Chen is searching for other opportunities, and others are also seeking other opportunities, I’ll do nothing and just camp out.
Be the first to challenge the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower as soon as it appears—who could be faster?
Of course, it only applies to him. If it was anyone else, even if you camp out, being the first to challenge the tower would not help.
Not reaching the Hundredth Floor is pointless.
Even if you reach the Hundredth Floor, you won’t be suitable for inheritance and couldn’t convince the Flaming Fire Emperor to make an exception.”
“In any case, the inheritance is now mine, and the only question is whether a reward will appear. Besides, I’ll deal with the reward later. Now that I’ve received the Flaming Fire Emperor’s inheritance, I should have the Emperor weapon. With it, even a King-realm Master would find it hard to kill me.”
Wang Ping murmured with the corner of his mouth slightly lifted.
An Emperor Weapon is the life-bound weapon of an Emperor. Acquiring something this powerful, even if unable to unleash its full power, it’s still enough to provide protection in times of danger.
A Nirvana Realm Master wouldn’t be able to break through the defenses and would probably be killed by the Emperor Weapon’s power.
A King-realm Master also may not be able to break the Emperor Weapon.
As for a Quasi-Emperor, Wang Ping was unsure.
As for an Emperor, needless to say, could a single Emperor weapon fend off an Emperor? It would be shattered within minutes.
“According to the normal plot development, during the coming Chaotic Era, Ye Chen would probably be relying on the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to survive just scraping by as he develops his strength step by step. Soon, he would reach the Emperor Tier. After that, he’d continue to get stronger, leading the Purple Spirit Realm to rise.”
Wang Ping pondered silently.
“It can be said that the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, especially this Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, is definitely Ye Chen’s greatest opportunity in the later stage. It’s also the reason why he could grow steadily.”
“As for whether or not my speculation is correct, let’s continue to watch the simulation, and we will know from Ye Chen’s performance.”
With various thoughts flashing through Wang Ping’s mind, he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.”
As Wang Ping stared at the luminescent screen, the text began to surface again.”
“After you obtained the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, the Flaming Fire Secret Realm began to shake. Everyone was forcibly expelled. As for you, you remained in the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower. The Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, along with the entire Flaming Fire Secret Realm, plunged into the Spatial Turbulence and disappeared.”
“Upon seeing this, the powerful figures in the outer world were greatly alarmed and noticed this anomaly. They even figured out that someone must have received the inheritance.”
“However, when they asked their disciples about who had received the inheritance, everyone looked at each other in disbelief, claiming they had no idea. Just after the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower appeared and they were about to hurry over, they were kicked out.”
“This left every master present flabbergasted and bewildered. The Ancestor of Heavenly Sword Divine Land and others noted your absence and asked Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue where you went. The two of them also looked at each other and confessed they had no idea.”

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _3
Translator: 549690339
[The Ancestor of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land couldn’t sit still upon hearing this and was afraid that you had fallen in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm. So, he wanted to return to the Heavenly Sword Holy Land to ask other old monsters to deduce whether you were alive or dead. As for the soul tablet, it’s a method used to check another person’s life or death by capturing their soul. It doesn’t have much impact on ordinary cultivators, but geniuses always strive for perfection, so naturally, they can’t leave their soul tablet behind.]
[Soon, there was news that several people claimed that they were nearby when the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower appeared. They rushed there quickly and saw someone entering the tower and reaching the hundredth floor in an incredible speed. It was possible that he had obtained the legacy of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[Upon hearing the news, everyone was shocked. What kind of person was that? Wasn’t it too abnormal? Even those who reached the Emperor realm only had records of the 98th floor, yet he managed to reach the hundredth floor at the fastest speed when the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower just appeared. He directly took the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy.]
[The Ancestor of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land was also surprised, thinking that this person was so perverse. If he didn’t fall midway, he might be destined to become an Emperor in the future. Ye Chen and Ji Bingyue frowned, feeling that it could be you. After all, due to your low profile, people from other forces didn’t know about your strength but they had witnessed it. Especially Ye Chen, who even battled with you.]
[Ye Chen felt that even though he had gained many opportunities in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, if he were to really confront you, he probably still wouldn’t be your match. In this situation, there was a high possibility that you had obtained the legacy. At this, he could only sigh and envy. After all, he had long heard of the Flaming Fire Emperor and had been coveting the latter’s legacy for many years.]
[While everyone was alarmed and guessing, you were accepting the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy. With the help of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s Commemoration, the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower recognized you as its master. Although you couldn’t mobilize much of its power, it was only little relative to the entire power of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.]
[In fact, with your current cultivation, using part of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower’s power to kill enemies, no one could resist you below the King Realm.]
[After accepting the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy, without hesitation, you decided to break through to the Life and Death Realm. Eventually, you successfully broke through to the Life and Death Realm, reaching the 2nd tier.]
[In the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, the news that you didn’t fall had already been deduced. They got excited and thought that there was a high possibility that you had obtained the legacy. When you returned to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, the old monsters there finally confirmed this and were extremely ecstatic.]
[However, when they found out that the Flaming Fire Emperor’s Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills could not be passed on, they felt a little regret. In the end, the matter came to an inconclusive end. The ownership of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s legacy became a mystery in the Purple Spirit Realm. Although some Holy Lands suspected that you had obtained it, without evidence, no one could do anything about it.]
[In the blink of an eye, several hundred years had passed. During these hundred years, you diligently cultivated, striving to improve your strength. In this world, you did not become a Tao Companion with Ji Bingyue and practiced asceticism.]
[As a result, you unexpectedly comprehended the incomplete Domain Embryo in a sudden realization. At this level, you had already comprehended the Domain Embryo, only needing some more time to perfect its completion.]
[As for cultivation, your improvement was also tremendous. With the Flaming Fire Emperor’s complete legacy you obtained, you had extremely abundant resources. As a result, you improved yourself comprehensively and became stronger than in your memory. Your body-refining cultivation had reached the Nirvana Boundary level.]
[It could be said that, you have completely surpassed your peers. Even the geniuses of your generation, like Ye Chen, had only reached the Great Perfection Tier of Life and Death Realm, and were slightly inferior to him in your memory.]
[The Nirvana Boundary was a significant checkpoint, and it would be commonplace for even someone like Ye Chen to be stuck for over a hundred years without great opportunities before breaking through from the Half-step Nirvana Realm to the Nirvana Boundary.]
[However, although you had broken through to the Nirvana Boundary, you were well aware of the fact that the tallest tree in the forest would be destroyed by the wind. Thus, you kept your real cultivation and strength hidden and remained very low-profile. Besides your Master Emperor of Kongtian who had discovered some of your details and marveled at your monstrous powers, no one knew how powerful you truly were.]
“Ah this….”
Wang Ping didn’t know what to say after looking at the simulation content.
What was this about? Things had gone too smoothly.
He had directly reached the Nirvana Boundary cultivation, leaving no chance for others to survive.
“If this continues, would there be any hope of becoming a king?”
This thought couldn’t help but appear in Wang Ping’s mind.
But soon, he snapped out of it.
“I can’t think like this, this is like setting a flag. Every time I think this way, I end up dying midway.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself, throwing away his stray thoughts, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Not long after, the Purple Spirit Realm was invaded by the Blood Demon Clan, and all the powerhouses in the Purple Spirit Realm were alarmed and went to the Central Continent to confront the Blood Demon Clan powerhouses.]
[This time, since you didn’t reveal your identity as a transmigrator, Jiuyou Demon Emperor didn’t cause you trouble and didn’t choose to attack the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. So, you breathed a sigh of relief because the pressure that the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao imposed on you was too great. If he attacked you at this opportunity, you would definitely have no chance to live.]

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _4
Translator: 549690339
[However, what you never expected happened. While the powerhouses of both sides were in a stalemate, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao did not attack you but attacked Profound Turtle Continent instead.]
[To Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, all the experts from the Purple Spirit Realm had been distracted by the Blood Demon Clan, making it a perfect opportunity to attack Profound Turtle Continent and the Profound Turtle itself. Once the demonized Guilt-Punishing Emperor within the Profound Turtle was released, the numerous experts of the Purple Spirit Realm would face threats from both sides, leading to devastating consequences and extreme resentments.]
[At that time, he could take advantage of this opportunity to move further and reach a higher level.]
[Jiuyou Demon Emperor coldly attacked Profound Turtle Continent. Due to the appearance of the Blood Demon Clan, the strangeness within the Profound Turtle had become restless, causing him to gather all his force to suppress the strangeness and prevent it from breaking free. At this moment, the Profound Turtle was attacked on all sides, suffering injuries caused by Jiuyou Demon Emperor and the powerful Demon Cult members.]
[Even though the Profound Turtle had the strongest defense force in the Purple Spirit Realm, it was impossible to suppress the strangeness while also withstanding Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s powerful attack.]
[In the end, the Profound Turtle roared, paying the price of its life to reinforce the seal, continuing to seal the strangeness. Although doing so only postponed Jiuyou Demon Emperor and the strangeness from breaking open the seal, he had no other choice but to do it.]
[Finally, the Profound Turtle fell, and Jiuyou Demon Emperor became extremely furious at its actions and began to bombard the seal. However, the seal set by the Profound Turtle was too strong. Even Jiuyou Demon Emperor couldn’t break it open in a short time. He could only take away the seal and disappear.]
[The Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm also sensed the fall of the Profound Turtle and their expressions changed greatly. They wanted to investigate the situation, but they were restrained by the powerful Blood Demon Clan members, and they all felt extreme anxiety.]
[Soon, a shocking war broke out between the Purple Spirit Realm and Blood Demon Clan. Although it did not reach an all-out war, with neither Kings nor Emperors taking action, the lower ranks began the war. It was both a war and a way to train their troops.]
[The war between the two worlds was both a crisis and an opportunity. Although many geniuses and great experts perished, even Kings and Emperors, many geniuses also grew amidst the war.]
[Most of those geniuses who survived the war between the two realms had made astonishing achievements in the development of the Purple Spirit Realm in the next ten thousand years. War was cruel and bloody but could also bring forth strong experts faster.]
[This was like raising bewitched beings; it could ultimately breed a Bewitched King.]
“Good guy, what’s this ‘predecessor transmigrator’ plotting? He even made a move on Profound Turtle directly, trying to release the Guilt-Punishing Emperor possessed by the strangeness.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly, muttering to himself.
According to the simulation content, it seemed that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘predecessor transmigrator,’ had no deep involvement with the Blood Demon Clan. However, he wasn’t on the side of the Purple Spirit Realm either. He was planning something terrifying, intending to reach a higher level through it.
“If he wants to go further and reach a higher level, doesn’t that mean his current strength has already reached the Great Perfection Tier of Emperor Realm…”
Wang Ping squinted his eyes.
If that was the case, this guy was even more terrifying than he had imagined.
Based on Wang Ping’s conversation with the white-haired old man who granted Cai Yonglong his cultivation, he had learned many secrets.
For example, during that Great War ten thousand years ago, there were many Purple Spirit Realm Emperors participating, reaching seventy.
However, whether it was the Blood Demon Realm’s King Realm experts or the Purple Spirit Realm’s Emperors, there were fewer than five top-tier Emperors who had reached the Great Perfection in Emperor Realm.
There were four powerful beings from the Purple Spirit Realm who had achieved Emperor Realm Great Perfection.
On the other hand, the Blood Demon Realm had five, one more than the Purple Spirit Realm.
During that war, if it hadn’t been for one of the Emperors from the Purple Spirit Realm who was extremely powerful and could withstand two Blood Demon Realm’s Emperors, the consequences would have been unthinkable.
That Emperor from the Great Perfection was very mysterious, and no one knew his origin.
Like Flaming Fire Emperor, he followed the fire attribute path, but he was much stronger, mastering the number one Exotic Fire: Ancient Azure Dragon Flame. His strength was only second to the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, a ceiling-tier character who had almost stepped into a higher realm with one foot.
“Not counting the mysterious Emperor, just the number of Great Perfection Emperors in both worlds combined is less than ten, which shows how difficult it is to cultivate to Emperor Realm Great Perfection.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he muttered to himself.
However, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator,’ had reached this level of cultivation, making him truly terrifying.
No wonder Alpha said that when the Three Great Emperors were attacking Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he was confident that they couldn’t defeat him. If he wanted, he might even be able to kill two of them and leave calmly.
As for Sky Emperor, because he cultivated space and sword skills, it would be difficult to kill him even if he lost, so it was only killing two, not three.
“This guy is hiding so deep. No wonder Alpha calls him the Bewitched King raised in the Purple Spirit Realm; his thoughts are too profound.”

chapters.title: Chapter 404: 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: 151: Bursting the Demon Emperor’s Progeny! Number one in Both Realms! _5
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping sighed.
The audacity of the Three Great Emperors to set a trap for Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao shows that they believe they can kill him.
This also indicates that the Three Great Emperors do not know the true cultivation level of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. It is likely that he has been concealing his cultivation, leading the emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm to misjudge him.
Not only has he hidden his cultivation, but he probably has quite a few other tricks up his sleeve as well.
“However, no matter how deep you hide, as the simulation progresses, you’re in the open, and I’m in the shadows. Sooner or later, I will take you down.”
Wang Ping silently muttered to himself, his gaze fixed on the luminescent screen.
[As both sides are figuring out each other’s hidden capabilities, the war between the two realms has really begun. As a genius of the Purple Spirit Realm, whose battle power rivals those of the older generation, you naturally must participate in this war.]
[Despite your worries, you choose to go to battle. You shine on the battlefield, repeatedly killing the geniuses of the Blood Demon Clan and even the direct disciples and descendants of the Blood Demon Emperor.]
[You become a figure that even the masters of the Nirvana Realm fear running into on the battlefield. People in the Blood Demon Clan despise you and want to get rid of you. However, the Purple Spirit Realm is also not weak, and they do everything possible to keep you safe. You become the brightest figure in the war, with a reputation that shakes both realms.]
[Eventually, the Blood Demon Realm could no longer sit still. They sent out their strongest monster, the child of their strongest Demon Emperor. He is extremely powerful, having inherited the bloodline of the Demon Emperor and possessing a powerful demonic body. His cultivation has also reached the Nirvana Realm.]
[He openly challenges you to a death duel, and you do not fear him. You choose to go to battle.]
[Both of you engage in a fierce battle in front of many powerful figures. The Demon Emperor’s child is indeed very strong. Even you, had to exhaust your abilities and even expose your incomplete Domain Embryo to defeat him.]
[This battle shocked the strong figures of the two realms. You were able to comprehend the incomplete Domain Embryo at such a young age, and even defeated the Demon Emperor’s child. If it wasn’t for the Demon Emperor stepping in to save him, you could have killed him.]
[This made you even more noticeable. You became the universally recognized strongest genius in both realms, unmatched by anyone in the same realm.]
[But this made you even more hated in the Blood Demon Realm. They wished to get rid of you as soon as possible, as you greatly affected the morale of the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Finally, the Blood Demon Realm decided they couldn’t wait any longer. Since their genius was completely crushed, continuous training would be risky. Soon, they chose to go full-scale war, intending to conquer the Purple Spirit Realm as soon as possible.]
[Of course, the total defeat of their genius was one thing, but more importantly, they saw through your battle with the Demon Emperor’s child that the Purple Spirit Realm was not as strong as they thought.]
[If the Purple Spirit Realm was strong enough, during the Demon Emperor’s rescue of his child, the powerful figures of the Purple Spirit Realm would have tried to stop him.]
[After all, this was a fair death duel between geniuses. If the Purple Spirit Realm had the ability to stop it, they would have done so, and not allowed this monstrous figure who was destined to become an emperor to survive.]
[The fact that the Purple Spirit Realm didn’t do so indicates that they might not have the ability to stop it. Intervening would expose that the Purple Spirit Realm currently doesn’t have any powerful figures at the Quasi-Immortal Tier.]
[So, faced with the Demon Emperor’s rescue at the Quasi-Immortal Realm, they could only silently watch, unable to intervene.]
[Reality proved that the Blood Demon Realm had correctly guessed the situation in the Purple Spirit Realm. Despite the a huge battle ten thousand years ago and subsequent development, the number of emperors in the Purple Spirit Realm did not decrease, but there were no more Quasi-Immortal Realm powerhouses. Because the ‘leading character of the era’ who rose up during the crisis then and turned the tables for the Purple Spirit Realm, had taken that step and gone to the Upper Realm.]
[So, faced with the renewed emergence of a Quasi-Immortal in the Blood Demon Realm, the Purple Spirit Realm felt immense pressure. They dared not reveal their true state, and could only hope that during the delay, one of the emperors would be able to break through to the Quasi-Immortal Realm.]
“Is the situation in the Purple Spirit Realm so dire?”
As Wang Ping digested the simulation content, he frowned.
There were formidable enemies from the Blood Demon Realm, amongst whom there was a newly born Quasi-Immortal.
Not only was the Purple Spirit Realm lacking such powerful figures, but they also had Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao causing chaos. Just thinking about it was enough to make one despair.
“But, is the realm above an emperor the Divine Realm? So a Quasi-Immortal is a transitional stage similar to a Quasi-Emperor.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he again pondered the issue of realms.
As of now, he finally understood what realm lay above an Emperor.
This was a secret not even the white-haired old man knew.
