Besides, reaching the Divine Realm meant ascending to the Upper Realm, equivalent to becoming an immortal in the world of cultivation.
“In that case, the Purple Spirit Realm truly is a lower plane. Well, I have to say, it’s worthy of being the Profound World.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh again.
The combat power of a lower plane is already off the charts, it’s hard to imagine how powerful the cultivators of the Upper Realm must be.
It wouldn’t really be as absurd as the Ye Hei World, would it?
If it could match a worldview like that, then the power limit of this world would be too terrifying.
He even wondered if he had already been targeted by the big shots.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Prototype Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Prototype Domain
Translator: 549690339
“Alpha, hurry up and tell me, does this Profound World have any experts at that level?”
Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“I don’t know.”
Alpha was silent, and finally gave a cold answer.
“Ha, what do you mean you don’t know?”
Wang Ping was speechless.
Alpha, as the intelligent life of the chat group that spans the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, you’re really letting me down.
“There are some things that even I don’t know. After all, I was also created.”
Alpha spoke coldly and emotionlessly.
“Uh… ”
Wang Ping was speechless and didn’t know what to say.
He knew very well that Alpha had been created.
But the fact that the chat group could be destroyed several times showed that the creator of Alpha didn’t seem to care much about the chat group.
So, Alpha was often making a fool of himself.
“What did you say? Wang Ping, are you getting too arrogant lately, constantly cursing me in your heart.”
Alpha spoke coldly and emotionlessly.
“Forget it, no need to think too much about it. If I, a little shrimp, get targeted by such a bigshot, there’s no way to resist. I might as well lay down and accept my fate.”
Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to Alpha’s words, but calmed his emotions and continued watching the simulation on the luminescent screen.
As expected, the Purple Spirit Realm might be finished.
And he wouldn’t be able to escape either.
The powerful experts of the Blood Demon Realm wouldn’t let him live on.
[After the full-scale war between the Blood Demon Realm and the Purple Spirit Realm, the pressure on the Purple Spirit Realm has greatly increased. With the appearance of the Quasi-Immortal Tier Demon Emperor, the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm begin to fall, revealing their defeat.]
[In order to preserve their heritage, some Emperors began to flee the battlefield, intending to bring the Holy Land to the outer realms. At the beginning of this chaos, you were targeted by the King of the Blood Demon Realm. Although you managed to hold onto your life thanks to the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, the situation was still terrible.]
[Later, your Master, the Sky Emperor, came to your aid and wanted to take you away from here. But as soon as the Sky Emperor appeared, he was besieged by multiple Blood Demon Realm Emperors and couldn’t protect himself.]
[In the end, during this chaos, you were killed by the Blood Demon World’s Quasi-Emperor through the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower. However, due to the possession of the Rebirth tally, you were resurrected once again.]
[But, you still couldn’t escape the fate of being killed.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends….]
“I still died, but that’s also something I expected.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and sighed in his heart.
In a full-scale war, the old monsters would all come out and wouldn’t care about any rules. Killing the enemy’s powerhouses and geniuses was their top priority, and they wouldn’t care about bullying the weak.
Not to mention him, even his Master Emperor of Kongtian would probably fall at the hands of the Blood Demon Realm Emperors.
“It seems I thought wrong. Under this situation, even if Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, grows up in a normal way, he wouldn’t be able to save the Purple Spirit Realm.”
Wang Ping frowned and thought silently.
Even if he developed normally, Ye Chen would at most reach the Nirvana Boundary, the same as him. In the face of the all-out war, with the Purple Spirit Realm already on the verge of defeat, how could he turn the tide? There simply wouldn’t be enough time and conditions for him to grow.
Not to mention, there was Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the mastermind, stirring things up from behind the scenes, even killing the Profound Turtle.
Besides, the strange thing would also be released, making the situation extremely dire.
Or was this supposed to be a story where the Purple Spirit Realm was enslaved, and Ye Chen would rise up and turn the tables later on?
“Speaking of which, why did Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao think that releasing the strange thing would cause the living beings of the Purple Spirit Realm to be in misery and suffering? It’s clear that even without releasing it, the Purple Spirit Realm is doomed.”
Wang Ping thought of Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s actions again and found it hard to understand.
He didn’t believe that this deeply scheming ‘Predecessor ransmigrator’ didn’t know the details of the Purple Spirit Realm.
He should know that there were no Quasi-Immortal strong existences in the Purple Spirit Realm who could block the Blood Demon Realm.
In this situation, his actions were meaningless and would only bring danger to himself.
But he did so anyway, as if he believed that only with the strange thing being released, the plot would go smoothly according to his plan.
“No, could it be that there are hidden cards in the Purple Spirit Realm that can resist the Quasi-Immortal Tier Demon Emperor? I just don’t know about them, and perhaps even the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm don’t know either.”
Wang Ping suddenly woke up and thought of this possibility, his eyes flickering uncertainly.
If that’s really the case, it would mean that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘Predecessor ransmigrator’, knows far more secrets than them.
“I died too early. If I died later, I would know how things would develop.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and sighed.
“If I want to live a little longer… then I can’t continue to show off my splendor next time. I must be low-key and even more low-key.”
In the midst of war between the two realms, the more eye-catching your performance, the more you will be targeted as a thorn in the enemy’s side.
And for the simulated Wang Ping, being eye-catching wasn’t the issue. He was the leading figure of the Purple Spirit Realm, the universally admired and respected genius leader of his generation who even defeated the Demon Emperor’s child.
In such a situation, when the war changes, who else should die if not him?
“Showing off may feel good for a while, but death awaits afterward. In these chaotic times, it’s indeed better to be low-key.”
Wang Ping silently commented and continued to ponder various issues.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Prototype Domain_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Prototype Domain_2
Translator: 549690339
Next time, don’t draw the attention of the Blood Demon Realm, strive to live longer, and figure out the best choice for future development.
Even, if possible, give up the option of joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land temporarily.
If you don’t become a personal disciple of the Heavenly Sword Emperor or a Saint Son of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you won’t be targeted by others.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness suddenly flickered, and his vision changed, appearing in an unfamiliar place.
It was a ruin, with the ground severely sunken, and in the midst of it, a huge tower stood tall.
This tower was the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, and around it were Blood Demon Realm Kings of various shapes, displaying their domain or Domain Embryo and furiously attacking the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, making it tremble.
And the simulated Wang Ping was hiding among them, feeling very uncomfortable due to the terrifying impact.
However, the simulated Wang Ping did not give up and continued to support the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower’s defense, recklessly consuming pools of primordial liquid.
At the same time, the simulated Wang Ping was also bold, and at the brink of life and death, he tried to comprehend the secrets of the domain and tried to perfect his Domain Embryo.
At this time, the stronger he was, the more hope he had of surviving.
In the end, at the critical moment of life and death, he was able to break through the bottleneck and successfully comprehend the complete Domain Embryo.
It was also at this moment that the Sky Emperor appeared, instantly killing several Blood Demon Realm Kings, intending to rescue Wang Ping, but was eventually blocked and surrounded by four Blood Demon Realm Emperors who arrived later.
Apart from this, a Quasi-Emperor also appeared, directly killing the simulated Wang Ping twice.
For this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but shake his head, and his vision returned to normal.
“The Blood Demon Realm is really ruthless, not only are there new Quasi-Immortals emerging, but the number of Emperors is the same as 10,000 years ago. Clearly, they are above the Purple Spirit Realm. This situation is really terrible.”
Wang Ping sighed and once again lamented.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose three of the following rewards as a reward:
1. Sword Domain Embryo.
2. Emperor-tier Divine Skill: Sky Sword Skills.
3. Flaming Fire Emperor Inheritance Technique.
4. Flaming Fire Emperor Inheritance Divine Ability.
5. Self-created Pseudo-King-tier Divine Skill: Phantom Flame Sword Song.
6. Life-bound Sword Embryo (Quasi-King Artifact).
7. Learned Secret Skills.
8. Red Talent: Breath Concealment.”
“The rewards this time are also quite rich, and it’s the first time I can choose three rewards, the system is actually generous. System, I choose 1. Sword Domain Embryo, 6. Life-bound Sword Embryo, and 8. Red Talent: Breath Concealment.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed rewards, pondered for a while, and then made a decision.
Red Talent: Breath Concealment is naturally a must-choose item.
As for the other reward options…
If the next simulation might not enter the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, then he must choose the Life-bound Sword Embryo.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have a suitable weapon. It would be troublesome for him to become a loose cultivator without a suitable weapon.
Besides, it would also be troublesome if there was another mission without a suitable weapon.
As for cultivation techniques, divine skills, secret skills, etc.
Although they are equally precious, he can comprehend them on his own.
Learning other people’s emperor-class divine skills would only be of the greatest significance for reference. The power he can exert is enough to rival his self-created king-class divine skills.
As for cultivation techniques, he has the Primordial Spirit Skill, even if he had an emperor-level skill, he wouldn’t replace it.
Of course, the reason why Wang Ping made this choice was also because the probability of these rewards refreshing was very high.
If he doesn’t choose it this time, he can choose it next time.
“Ding, reward selection successful.”
The system’s voice sounded again.
Immediately after, a large number of insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and he absorbed them wholeheartedly.
In addition, a black sword with purple patterns also appeared out of thin air and entered Wang Ping’s body.
This was a true Quasi-King Artifact-level life-bound sword embryo, an incredible weapon for Wang Ping.
Not even some Quasi-Kings would necessarily have a Quasi-King Artifact, let alone a life-bound sword embryo.
And now, Wang Ping, a being at the Half-step Life-and-Death Realm Cultivation, already had a Quasi-King Artifact-level life-bound sword embryo as a weapon, which was astonishing. If it were spread out, even the Quasi-Kings would envy, hate, and even rob him.
Not knowing how long it had been, when Wang Ping opened his eyes again, he seemed to be integrated into the world. An invisible domain centered on him spread out, covering an area of 100 miles.
In this area, Wang Ping was the ruler, and every grass and tree could turn into sharp swords to help him kill the enemy.
Here was the domain of the sword.
Although it was only a Domain Embryo and not a true sword domain, it was terrifying enough.
“Phew, the Domain Embryo is indeed profound and extraordinary. With half-step Life-and-Death Realm cultivation, having a Domain Embryo would scare a bunch of old monsters if it’s known.”
Wang Ping exhaled and muttered a bit proudly.
Many Quasi-Kings are stuck at the Quasi-King tier, unable to comprehend the Domain Embryo to advance to the King Realm.
But he, a tiny Half-step Life-and-Death Realm being, already had a Domain Embryo, which must have created the history of the Purple Spirit Realm.
From ancient to modern times, who could rival him!
“Damn, Mr. Wang, what have you done? I feel like my whole body is being cut, and even the Flawless Profound Elixir that I’ve just condensed feels like it’s going to be torn apart.”
At this moment, a startled cry sounded, bringing Wang Ping back to his senses, and then he looked over.
He then saw Cai Yonglong’s painful, pale face.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_3
Translator: 549690339
At this, he smiled and withdrew his Domain Embryo.
This meant he had no intention of harming others.
Otherwise, as long as he had even a hint of killing intent, within his domain, no living creatures could survive.
As Wang Ping withdrew his Domain Embryo, Cai Yonglong finally felt relaxed, no longer feeling like he could be sliced into countless pieces at any moment.
“Mr. Wang, what did you just do? It felt really weird,” Cai Yonglong came to Wang Ping’s side with uneasy and asked.
“Sword Domain Embryo,” Wang Ping responded with a faint smile, not hiding anything, and gave him the answer.
“Damn!”
Cai Yonglong’s eyes widened, his face full of disbelief.
Having received the white-haired old man’s inheritance and many others, he naturally knew what a Domain Embryo represented.
That was the most important entry ticket to the King Realm.
And now, Mr. Wang had already comprehended it, which was just too incredible.
“Life Simulator, truly the best Golden Finger to cheat with.”
Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but lament.
“As it stands now, the Life Simulator is indeed the strongest.”
Wang Ping spoke factually.
Some group members’ Golden Fingers were very strong, but their current performance couldn’t compare with his Life Simulator.
Of course, the future was uncertain, maybe some group member would draw an even more perverted Golden Finger or get a round of optimization and take off completely.
“Cai, the plan has changed. You should try to go back to Profound Turtle Continent and cultivate in seclusion as much as possible,”
Wang Ping contemplated for a moment before speaking.
As of now, there wasn’t much Cai Yonglong could help him with.
With the Flaming Fire Emperor as the greatest opportunity, the usefulness of his Golden Finger for finding opportunities seemed insignificant.
Therefore, unless Ye Chen had an even more astonishing opportunity line, and the life simulator didn’t describe from a God’s perspective where Ye Chen obtained the opportunity, Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger could only play a certain role.
Otherwise, it would really be useless, better to just focus on cultivating and avoid being found by the people of Jiuyou Demon Sect.
“Um, why?” Cai Yonglong was somewhat puzzled.
Wang Ping didn’t hide anything, and explained the pros and cons of the situation in detail.
“I see.”
Cai Yonglong’s expression also became serious.
It was the first time he learned about the existence of a predecessor ransmigrator in the Purple Spirit Realm, who had become the Sect Master of the Jiuyou Demon Sect and was a terrifying existence in the Emperor Realm Great Perfection. It was really frightening.
If caught by him, the consequences would indeed make one’s hair stand on end.
“I understand, I’ll go back to the Profound Turtle Continent and cultivate in seclusion. Apart from that, I’ll complete chat group tasks to earn group points and become stronger,” Cai Yonglong said seriously.
“Well,” Wang Ping nodded, patted Cai Yonglong on the shoulder, and smiled, “Actually, you don’t have to worry about anything. With the rate at which I’m getting stronger, it won’t be long before I kill him. Once he’s dead, the Purple Spirit Realm will be our backyard.”
Wang Ping didn’t mention the peculiar things.
If he did, Cai Yonglong might have been scared.
After all, staying on Profound Turtle Continent was like living close to something mysterious. This tremendous psychological pressure could easily cause problems in his cultivation.
“Here are your resources.”
Later, Wang Ping divided the previously obtained cultivation resources with Cai Yonglong.
“Mr. Wang, you need these resources more than I do,” Cai Yonglong hesitated, not taking the Storage Ring.
“It’s indeed important, but your share is also what you deserve. Actually, most of the Primordial Liquid should have been yours,” Wang Ping laughed.
“Well, that’s true. But resources should be allocated to those who need them more. I’ll just take some top-tier Spirit Stones and a little bit of lower-tier Spiritual Fluid,” Cai Yonglong scratched his head and said.
“Speaking of which, without 1st-tier or higher Yin power, I won’t choose to break through. So, my cultivation won’t progress for a long time. Besides, I’ve received an inheritance, and it’s not suitable for me to improve my cultivation in a short time. Instead, I should settle down, comprehend various intents, and practice Divine Skills.”
“Since you said so, forget it. I’ll find Yin and Yang power for you. As for the Spirit Stones, you still need to take some, otherwise, you won’t even have enough for travel expenses,” Wang Ping nodded and felt that Cai Yonglong was more considerate.
Look, what a good personality.
Comparing Xu Yi with Cai Yonglong, there really was no need to focus on developing Xu Yi. Instead, they should be on guard against him causing trouble in the future.
Next, after Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong allocated the top-tier Spirit Stones, Cai Yonglong left Black Light Valley, planning to go directly back to Profound Turtle Continent.
“Wait, let me simulate and see if there’ll be any danger,” Wang Ping stopped him and shook his head.
He would be simulating anyway, so it was just a matter of checking the safety issue of returning in passing.
“Alright, thank you, Mr. Wang,” Cai Yonglong didn’t refuse, and decided to wait for Wang Ping’s simulation.
“System, I want to spend lower-tier Spiritual Fluid for a paid simulation,” Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming 30 pounds of lower-tier Spiritual Fluid, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, Congratulations to the Host for successfully refreshing the Green Gift·Leg Technique Genius.”
Leg Technique Genius: With this talent, the host will have a very good talent in leg techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Chapter 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_4
Translator: 549690339
“Leg Dao? Which leg?”
Wang Ping muttered in disdain.
“Ding, talent loaded successfully, life simulation begins.”
The system didn’t pay attention to Wang Ping’s complaint, as the voice continued, a luminescent screen appeared, and characters surfaced.
[On the first day, you chose to leave the Black Light Valley. Along the way, you protected Cai Yonglong to reach Heavenly Sea Country, without any accidents. Cai Yonglong successfully returned to the Profound Turtle Continent.]
“You can go.”
Wang Ping saw this and said to Cai Yonglong.
“Alright, I’ll set off now. If there are any butterfly effects and I encounter danger, I’ll ask for your help in the group chat, Mr. Wang.”
Cai Yonglong nodded and said with a grin.
“Sigh, I really want to buy a Rebirth Tally if I had enough group points. That would be safer.”
“Asking me for help, no problem. As for the Rebirth Tally, it’s kind of a pitfall, it’d be more reliable to save up group points to buy the Golden Finger Optimizer…”
Wang Ping complained upon hearing this.
“Uh, instant resurrection on the spot, is it really that bad?”
Cai Yonglong said in surprise.
“Exactly. That’s why the cost-performance ratio is low.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Alright, then it’s more practical to save group points and buy the Golden Finger Optimizer.”
Cai Yonglong muttered, then turned into a Divine Halo and left.
After Cai Yonglong was far away, Wang Ping spoke to Alpha in his heart: “Speaking of which, Alpha, can’t you change the pitfall mechanism of the Rebirth Tally? Resurrecting on the spot is too much of a trap.”
“It can be changed, but delayed resurrection requires more group points. Otherwise, what do you think you’d have to pay so little group points?”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“No, even if it’s more expensive, it’s better than the current Rebirth Tally. With the current Rebirth Tally, reviving is just waiting to be killed again, and it’s not very useful.”
Wang Ping said helplessly.
He’d rather have higher-priced, higher-quality items than the current instant resurrection Rebirth Tally.
“That’s because your situation is special. Who would provoke enemies far beyond their own level? In cases of fighting at the same level or against someone slightly stronger than you, the Rebirth Tally is extremely useful.”
Alpha replied coldly.
“What you said makes so much sense that I can’t refute it.”
Wang Ping was choked.
“Anyway, you can change it, you hear?”
Wang Ping coughed and said seriously.
“Are you the superior or am I the superior?”
Alpha snorted.
It always felt that Wang Ping had become more and more arrogant lately and needed to be knocked down a peg.
Otherwise, this guy would always want to take advantage of them, which was simply too much.
“It doesn’t matter. This can make it easier for me to become stronger and lead the chat group to greater heights. You can’t kill even such a good suggestion, it would be tyranny.”
Wang Ping sighed and said somewhat regretfully.
“…Just this once.”
Alpha was silent, thinking that Wang Ping’s proposal did make sense, and eventually chose to consume some group points to modify the resurrection mechanism of the Rebirth Tally.
“Did you change it? Is my Rebirth Tally the original or the improved version?” Seeing Alpha take the bait, Wang Ping’s eyes lit up and asked.
“Improved version.” Alpha snorted.
“Hehe, that’s good.” Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
It was not easy to get some wool from Alpha’s hands.
However, this sense of success was not far from the pleasure of becoming stronger.
Afterwards, Wang Ping calmed his mind and continued to stare at the luminescent screen, watching the simulation content that followed.
[Following that, you began to retreat in seclusion and didn’t plan to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Although you didn’t join Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and no longer have those resources and can’t consult Sky Emperor anymore, you were still able to improve your Divine Skills well.]
[After all, comprehending the Domain Embryo was not just a single improvement in the domain area. It’s a deeper understanding of the Cultivation Path, and the improvement is all-encompassing for you. Therefore, you can also better understand your own pseudo king-tier divine skill.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades passed, the Hundred Dynasties War began, and you didn’t pay attention, continuing to roam the Sword Domain and cultivate in silence.]
[Decades passed again, before the opening of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, you had already transformed your Top-notch Divine Skill – Illusory Flame Sword Song into a pseudo king-tier divine skill.]
[Next, you hid your identity, went to the Central Continent as a loose cultivator. Because there were no King Realm Masters on the scene, no one saw anything unusual about you.]
[After the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened, you entered it and acted as you remembered. You captured the True King Blood Flower and then camped at the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.]
[Eventually, you successfully reached the hundredth floor before Ye Chen arrived. Because of understanding the Domain Embryo, this time Flaming Fire Emperor didn’t hesitate, directly gave you the inheritance.]
[For this, you can only lament that this world is too realistic. Then, the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower trembled, and everyone was kicked out of the secret realm by the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, and you escaped into the Spatial Turbulence.]
[This time, because you were not the disciple of Sky Emperor, but just a loose cultivator, no one knew of your existence. They didn’t know who had received the inheritance, and could only look at each other and be suspicious.]

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Early Stage of Domain_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! The Early Stage of Domain_5
Translator: 549690339
[In the following time, you never entertain the idea of leaving the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and keep cultivating arduously within it. Moreover, you even asked the Flaming Fire Emperor’s residual thoughts to leave the secret realm floating in the Spatial Turbulence, not going out.]
[You want to avoid the impending disaster in the Purple Spirit Realm in this way.]
[Although the residual thoughts of the Flaming Fire Emperor didn’t know the meaning behind your actions, they still fulfilled your request. They used the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower as a base, together with the Great Array and various means, to make it drift aimlessly in the Spatial Turbulence surrounding the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[However, before the residual thoughts of the Flaming Fire Emperor disappeared, they set up a method to let the Flaming Fire Secret Realm reappear in the world and leave the Spatial Turbulence when needed.]
[Regarding this, you have no intention of going out and stay cultivating within.]
[In the blink of an eye, about four hundred years have passed. Your cultivation has successfully reached the Nirvana Realm, incredibly powerful. In terms of divine skills, your understanding of divine skills has deepened, and although there is still some distance before comprehending your own king-tier divine skills, you believe that by spending less than five hundred years more, you can create your own king-tier divine skills.]
[However, at this point in time, the Purple Spirit Realm should have been invaded by the Blood Demon Realm. As for this, you think of Cai Yonglong and wonder whether you should go out and bring him into the secret realm.]
[In the end, you feel a sense of loss in your heart and choose to give up. Because once you leave the Spatial Turbulence and appear in the Purple Spirit Realm, it will definitely cause a huge commotion and attract the attention of many powerful individuals.]
[At the same time, without the help of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s residual thoughts, even if you can return to the Spatial Turbulence, you won’t be able to easily conceal yourself as well as before, and you’ll be tracked down.]
[As a result, you can only pin your hopes on the Purple Spirit Realm being saved and Cai Yonglong not being affected.]
[You continue to cultivate diligently, planning not to leave isolation until you reach the Emperor Realm. However, as your cultivation proceeds, the speed of your progress becomes slower and slower. A hundred years pass, and you still haven’t broken through to the Nirvana Realm 2nd Tier.]
[This is not only due to the fact that it takes more time to improve cultivation in the Nirvana Realm, but also for other reasons. The Nirvana Realm requires nirvana-like rebirth, like a phoenix, making it a very special realm.]
[Once in the Nirvana Realm, the speed of Normal Cultivation is extremely slow, and even geniuses have difficulty in advancing a small realm within two or three hundred years.]
[To improve the cultivation quickly in the Nirvana Realm, the correct method is to experience various death battles and be reborn in the face of death. The more terrifying the danger experienced, the greater the harvest after Nirvana Rebirth. In history, some people have crossed the threshold of death, and after Nirvana Rebirth, they have directly advanced two or three small realms.]
[Moreover, their own foundation has also become stronger. This is the unique characteristic of the Nirvana Realm. At this stage, Bone and Root Aptitude and realization are secondary, and real death and Nirvana Rebirth in the face of death can rapidly improve the cultivation. This is the Nirvana Realm; this is the Nirvana Skill.]
[Because of the special nature of the Nirvana Realm, some ordinary cultivators with strong beliefs have gone through various Nirvana Rebirths, overtaking others as a result, and achieving extraordinary accomplishments in the end.]
[However, in order to survive, you have been hiding in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, lacking that belief and also lacking dangerous situations to overcome. Therefore, the improvement of your cultivation is naturally slow.]
[It is true that even if you carry on with normal cultivation, you can endure until Nirvana Realm Great Perfection, but it is undoubtedly too slow, requiring thousands of years of time.]
“The Life and Death Realm and the Nirvana Realm are known as the realms that allow ordinary cultivators to catch up with geniuses; they are indeed special.”
Wang Ping watched the simulation content and sighed.
Of course, although it is said that ordinary cultivators can catch up, how many people can actually achieve it?
Even if some people are willing to try, most of them end up perishing, and the number of people who survive does not exceed one percent.
“I thought the simulated Wang Ping could hide and quickly become a king, but it seems I was thinking too much. However, spending some more time accumulating cultivation is not a big deal, there’s plenty of time, and I’m not worried at all.”
Wang Ping shook his head again and continued to watch the simulation content with equanimity.
[In the blink of an eye, another four hundred years or so have passed. During these four hundred years, you have continued to cultivate diligently, with no intention of leaving the secret realm. Eventually, your cultivation is improved to the Nirvana Realm 3rd Tier.]
[However, your secluded hard work, the foundation accumulated in the Nirvana Realm, is only average, without any bright spots. Your Nirvana Skill is not particularly strong, not reaching the level expected of a genius like yourself.]
[Soon, while you were cultivating, you sensed something was wrong. The entire secret realm trembled for a moment. Then, just before you die, you witness a terrifying scene.]
[The entire Flaming Fire Secret Realm starts to disintegrate, and the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower begins to rapidly disintegrate. Soon after, your body turns into dust, and you die once.]
[However, due to the Rebirth tally, you come back to life an hour later. But, after you are resurrected, you are immediately killed again by the terrifying power that fills the surroundings.]
[From beginning to end, you have no idea why you died, what kind of power destroyed the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, along with the disappearance of the Spatial Turbulence.]

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 152: Destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm! Domain Embryo_6
Translator: 549690339
[Because of your death, the simulation ends.]
“Ah, crap…”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and fell silent.
What the hell is going on? Even hiding inside the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, I still died.
What on earth happened in the Purple Spirit Realm?
Even if the Blood Demon Realm had invaded the Purple Spirit Realm, it wouldn’t have caused such a huge commotion.
This is clearly an abnormal situation different from the war between the two realms.
“I’ve been grinding so hard, I didn’t even know what’s happening outside.”
Wang Ping thought helplessly.
“It seems that in the next simulation, the simulated Wang Ping can’t just hide in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm to cultivate. It not only affects the progress and foundation of my Nirvana Boundary cultivation but also prevents me from gathering information. I don’t even know how I died. If I continue simulating like this, I’ll make the same mistake.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and muttered to himself.
It was at this time that his Dead Eyes Unwilling to Close talent was triggered again.
Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, his vision blurry, and he found himself in an unfamiliar place.
From a bird’s eye view, Wang Ping saw the destruction of the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, as well as the death of the simulated Wang Ping.
During the loading period after Wang Ping’s death, it was pitch black.
From this bird’s eye view, Wang Ping saw a scene that made his scalp numb.
Because he discovered that his location was incredibly high above the Purple Spirit Realm.
So he could see a part of the Purple Spirit Realm from this high vantage point.
He saw the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm.
The vast Purple Spirit Realm collapsed rapidly under a mysterious black power, eventually disappearing entirely and leaving behind absolute emptiness.
After the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm, the residual power still wreaked havoc in the void, turning it into a forbidden zone for life.
As far as the eye could see, darkness prevailed, with no signs of life, not even a single Emperor or spatial turbulence.
“What the hell is going on…”
Wang Ping looked at this terrifying scene, shivering from head to toe, and couldn’t help swearing.
The entire Purple Spirit Realm was destroyed, and all the Emperors were wiped out.
What horrific event had taken place in the Purple Spirit Realm a thousand years later? What was this black force? Who caused it?
Wang Ping couldn’t comprehend it and had no idea what had happened.
“So, the invasion of the Blood Demon Realm is a trivial matter compared to the great terror that will happen a thousand years later.”
After calming down, Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Nobody could escape this catastrophe, and no amount of time could save them.
Perhaps the only way to survive was to quickly break through to the Divine Realm, ascend to the Upper Realm, and avoid this disaster.
Indeed, Wang Ping believed that even those in the Divine Realm above the Emperor Realm couldn’t do anything so exaggerated.
The whole Purple Spirit Realm was utterly annihilated, not even a speck of dust remained. This was far too terrifying.
It wasn’t like the Purple Spirit Realm hadn’t produced a Divine Realm expert before.
But as of today, the Purple Spirit Realm was still intact, which means that it was highly unlikely that a Divine Realm expert could do such a thing.
Of course, it was also possible that they could have done it but chose not to.
However, regardless of which scenario it was, this catastrophe was incredibly horrifying, and it’d be best to escape the Purple Spirit Realm if possible.
“But, it’s still a thousand years later… I guess there’s no need to be too anxious.”
Wang Ping calmed down a bit and took a deep breath.
Since the catastrophe would happen a thousand years later, he had plenty of room to maneuver.
With a thousand years to work with, he could potentially simulate a way to counteract this catastrophe. Even if he couldn’t withstand it entirely, he should at least be able to save some people.
So there’s no need to panic.Before, he was simply frightened by the terrifying scene, which was only human nature.
Faced with such a terrifying scene, even the long-lived Emperors couldn’t remain indifferent, let alone him.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t have the idea to continue watching, after all, what was going to happen next was just the simulation of Wang Ping’s resurrection and death, without gaining any valuable information.
So, he actively gave up on continuing to watch and returned his consciousness to the real world.
It was when Wang Ping’s consciousness returned that the system’s voice timely rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two from the following rewards:
1. Inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s cultivation skills.
2. Inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor’s divine skills.
3. Learned Secret Skills.
4. Green Talent·Leg Skill Genius.
5. Pseudo-king-tier Divine Skill·Illusionary Flame Sword Song.
6. Combat Experience.”
“It’s a bit strange that the cultivation option didn’t appear both times. But I don’t have any intention to improve right now, so it doesn’t matter if it didn’t appear.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward options and thought to himself.
Then, Wang Ping made his choice directly: “System, I choose 3. Learned Secret Skills and 5. Pseudo-king-tier Divine Skill·Illusionary Flame Sword Song.”
As Wang Ping made his choice, countless insights appeared in his mind once again.
There were self-created divine skills and learned secret skills.
The secret skills he learned were all inherited from the Flaming Fire Emperor, possessing many methods and being very powerful.
After an unknown amount of time, Wang Ping came to his senses and nodded in satisfaction.
The gain this time was equally strong; his strength was getting stronger and stronger.
“However, now each time I receive insights, it takes half a month or even a month. As time goes by and the higher the level I reach, I’m afraid it will only get longer.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
For cultivation, even with cheats, it still takes a lot of time.
Then, Wang Ping didn’t want to continue the simulation, but instead wanted to see if there were any big events happening in the chat group.
After all, he had spent a long time consecutively simulating and absorbing insights, during which he barely paid attention to the chat group.
Soon, Wang Ping finished scanning the previous chat content in the group, and his eyes became serious.
In the past two months, there have been many group tasks in the chat group, and although Wang Ping didn’t participate, the other group members performed quite well.
However, there were still casualties.
Luo Weiguo and Lin Yuanyuan both died once, but were resurrected.
Master Lord Tier Space, Reincarnation Space, Abyss Lands and other hostile Myriad Heavens Forces experts are not beings that they can take on casually, as there are also terrifying experts among them.
If it weren’t for Liu Mei, Chen Si, and Chen Kang choosing to teleport and provide support during that mission, they might have faced total annihilation.
Aside from that, there was one task world that was stuck.
That was the world where group member Zhang Yueying was.
This world was plagued by a rampant virus.
The system hints showed abnormalities.
Then, because Wang Ping was absent, the chat group randomly chose four group members to carry out a group task.
These four group members were Qin Tian, Chen Yao, Zhang Jun, and Cai Yonglong.
At this point, Qin Tian had already reached the Primordial Infant Realm and had a decent strength among the 6th-Tier combat powers. If various trump cards were included, he could play a pretty good role.
As for Chen Yao, there was no need to say more, as she had already reached the 7th-Tier combat power.
Zhang Jun also reached the top-notch level of the 6th-Tier.
It was clear that everyone was working hard to become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of the Newcomer! Changing the Future
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Chapter 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of the Newcomer! Changing the Future
Translator: 549690339
However, among the four, Cai Yonglong took a shortcut with Wang Ping’s help. He had reached the Great Perfection Cultivation of the Profound Elixir Realm and even condensed a Flawless Profound Elixir. Apart from Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong was the strongest among them.
Even considering the relatively weaker Zhang Yueying, the team was still strong enough. If they were to face off against a battler without a fully-developed ability, they wouldn’t have any issues.
The main problem was that without Wang Ping’s simulator, they couldn’t identify who the mysterious opponent was or what their abilities were.
As a result, they could only rely on their previous experience and maintain a low profile, not daring to expose themselves.
In confronting the enigmatic threat, intelligence was the most crucial factor. Once either side was exposed, the situation grew significantly more complicated.
Cai Yonglong and the others had a simple plan: stall and drag the situation out until Wang Ping had time to lend them support.
Alternatively, they could capture the mysterious figure’s real identity and kill them outright.
Barring the enigmatic threat, there were also matters like Xu Yi’s live streaming to stimulate the Golden Finger. However, this wasn’t a major issue, so Wang Ping didn’t pay too much attention to it.
“This mysterious threat is really troublesome, it pops up from time to time,” Wang Ping muttered as he looked at the contents of the chat group.
“It’s a high risk, high reward situation. If it can be resolved, then many group points can be earned, so it’s not to be missed,” Wang Ping rubbed his chin, musing to himself.
If it weren’t for other matters at hand, he would’ve liked to make a trip and earn some group points.
After all, he still needed millions of group points to purchase the Golden Finger Optimizer to further optimize the Life Simulator.
“Speaking of which, how many group points do I have now?” Wang Ping thought of his current group points and checked out of curiosity.
He earned group points from completing tasks, but he also received dividends when other group members completed their tasks, allowing him to passively accumulate points.
“Not bad, not bad! I already have over five million points? With a little more effort, I’ll be able to put together ten million group points,” Wang Ping looked at his own group points and nodded satisfactorily.
Next, when Wang Ping was about to send a message in the chat group and head to Zhang Yueying’s world, the voice of the chat group system sounded again.
“Ding, Group Member Ding Xuan (88) has joined the chat group.”
“Ding, Group Member Zeng Lingdong (89) has joined the chat group.”
“Ding, Group Member Zhou Dawei (90) has joined the chat group.”
“Huh, finally new members arrived after so long? I wonder how many of these newcomers can survive and what kind of Golden Fingers they’ll be able to draw,” Wang Ping perked up as he heard the chat group system’s notification.
He attached great importance to newcomers.
If the newcomers managed to draw good Golden Fingers, the development and future team battles of the chat group would undoubtedly be more advantageous.
Immediately, Wang Ping chose to send a message.
Wang Ping (66): “Welcome, newcomers! Please post a selfie. amusing.jpg.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Oh, there are newcomers? Welcome! By the way, Mr. Wang finally sent a message.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Finally, I’m no longer a newbie! I’ve evolved into a veteran. QAQ.”
Chen Si (83): “No, you’re an old cat now. QAQ.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Uh…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Holy sh*t, Mr. Wang, you finally sent a message.”
Chen Yao (71): “Although it’s embarrassing… When facing the enigmatic threat, we feel more secure with Mr. Wang around.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Ahem, I second that.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Having Mr. Wang around makes me feel relieved for some reason!”
Qin Tian (77): “Mr. Wang, help us fast! I don’t want to spend my days sleepless!”
Wang Ping (66): “I really can’t trust you guys anymore. You don’t seem to have grown up at all. Giving you the side-eye. amusing.jpg.”
Fang Yun (3): “There it is, the classic ‘easier said than done’! amusing.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “Huh? Do you want to be muted? Authority warning. amusing.jpg.”
Fang Yun (3): “Ahem, Mr. Wang, I was wrong.”
Ding Xuan (88): “What a lively transmigrator chat group… If it weren’t for that thing I couldn’t get rid of, making the sound echo in my head, I’d think I entered a middle school disease chat group.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Yeah… Although I’ve read a bit of novels about Master Lord Tier Space, I still don’t know what to say when I actually encounter this situation.”
Zhou Dawei (90): “I’m aware of it, but my hand slipped and clicked accept anyway. I couldn’t resist the temptation of Extraordinary Power.”
Wang Ping (66): “Since you guys are so adaptable, don’t waste time chatting here. After all, you only have half an hour to choose. You can either choose physical travel or soul travel. If you choose physical travel, you can receive the Novice Survival Benefits Package provided by the chat group. It is a gift prepared by us veterans for newcomers to increase your chances of survival.”
Wang Ping (66): “As for soul travel, there’s no need to prepare anything, nor worry about the package or how to use it, since you won’t be able to take it with you. If you choose soul travel, first, you have to determine what you’ll become upon transmigration—human, cat, or even an inchworm.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Grass… an inchworm!?”
Zhou Dawei (90): “Wow, soul travel is that ridiculous?”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “In that case, I’ll choose physical travel…”
Fang Yun (3): “Physical travel? Interesting. Haven’t you guys read the Group Notice? I suggest you calm down and make a decision.”

chapters.title: Chapter 412: 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of a Newcomer! Changing the Future_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of a Newcomer! Changing the Future_2
Translator: 549690339
As soon as Fang Yun said this, the three of them hurriedly went to check the Group Notice.
Then, the three of them all fell silent.
Physical Travel is a bit dangerous, and Soul Travel isn’t safe either.
Is time-traveling really this perilous nowadays?
Zhang Hu (5): “Don’t be scared by Fang Yun’s words. Those were old group notices. In fact, the chat group has changed a lot now, and the danger coefficient of time-traveling and the probability of falling apart can’t be compared to before.”
Fang Yun (3): “Tsk, you exposed me so quickly, no fun at all. It’s just a little joke for the newcomers, lighten up.”
Wang Ping (66): “You haven’t changed your risk-taking attitude even after being revived for some time, have you? I don’t mind helping you loosen up your bones and muscles.”
Fang Yun (3): “Ahem, I was wrong.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “This guy needs to be taught a lesson. Hurry up and make a choice, newcomers. We’re waiting for Mr. Wang to finish enjoying the show and save us.”
Ding Xuan (88): “I’ll choose Soul Travel, I always feel Physical Travel is not very safe. Of course, the main reason is that I’m not handsome. Maybe with Soul Travel, I’ll have a chance to become a handsome guy!”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Um, is it possible to become a beautiful woman too, QAQ?”
Ding Xuan (88):
Fang Yun (3): “Hahaha, this is truly a critical strike to the soul.”
Ding Xuan (88): “No, this isn’t a critical strike, but a blessing from Heaven! No, wait, it should be said as a blessing from the chat group! I’m getting excited!”
Everyone:
Wang Ping (66): “Unbelievable, are people so open-minded about this nowadays?”
Chen Yao (71): “Does our chat group consider this as having an extra pervert…?”
Fang Yun (3): “I give up, you’re really showing off. I, Fang, am willing to call you the number one pervert in this group.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Speaking of changing genders, didn’t we already have a case in the group? amusing.jpg.”
Wu Jun (20): “Damn it, Zhang, you’re not supposed to talk about that. We were still friends.”
Wang Ping (66): “Jun’s situation is an irresistible result of using the Golden Finger. The situation is different and cannot be generalized.”
Wu Jun (20): “Exactly! Mr. Wang is right!”
Zhang Jun (70): “Ahem, I was just joking, don’t mind.”
Ding Xuan (88): “I don’t care if you guys call me a pervert, I’ll decide after Soul Travel!”
Zhang Hu (5): “Tsk, tsk, tsk, a real desperado.”
Zeng Lingdong and Zhou Dawei, the two newcomers, both decided to wait and see Ding Xuan’s situation after Soul Travel before choosing their own time-travel methods.
Soon, Ding Xuan underwent Soul Travel. As expected, he succeeded with his Soul Travel.
However, what caused him to collapse was that although he did Soul Travel into a female body, it wasn’t a human, but a mother tiger instead.
Ding Xuan (88): “Damn it, my mentality just collapsed!”
Chen Kang (67): “Pfft, I can’t stop laughing. Time-traveling into a mother tiger is pretty good, much better than being an ordinary human, amusing.jpg.”
Fang Yun (3): “Chen Kang, you’re laughing? Have you forgotten your own miserable state after time-traveling? And you still have the nerve to laugh at others.”
Chen Kang (67):
Upon hearing Fang Yun’s words, Chen Kang was speechless, feeling very uncomfortable and unable to say anything.
Zhao Sihan (87): “I always feel that the chat group is very keen on cat-related animals. I became a cat, Ding Xuan became a tiger…”
Wang Ping (66): “That doesn’t matter, as long as you’re alive. I’m just simply curious about one thing, the world he time-traveled to. Also, quickly extract your own Golden Finger and report it. The group members will give you some advice on how to survive next.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Forget it, mother tiger it is. When I cultivate into a demon, transform into a human form, I’ll still be a beauty! Now, for my Golden Finger!”
Fang Yun (3): “Well, I have to admit, with such determination, you’re someone who can achieve great things!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Indeed, it’s quite a show.”
While everyone in the group was joking around, Ding Xuan also received his Golden Finger and directly announced it without hiding it.
Ding Xuan (88): “My Golden Finger is a bit ordinary, it just allows me to get additional attribute bonuses. To be honest, aren’t attributes something you only have in games?”
Wang Ping (66): “Interesting, maybe the world you time-traveled to is a Game world. Try thinking about the attribute template in your mind, and your attribute panel will appear? amusing.jpg.”
Ding Xuan (88): “It’s possible, let me try it.”
Soon, Ding Xuan bubbled up again, excited to the extreme.
Ding Xuan (88): “Holy shit, I really feel like I’ve time-traveled into a game world! There’s really an attribute panel, and my attributes are not low either. I’m a BOSS! Even though it’s just a novice village BOSS, it’s still awesome!”
Fang Yun (3): “Good grief, you actually get happy about becoming a novice village BOSS in the game world? Shocked.jpg.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “The 4th Catastrophe·The Game players you’re about to face are the crazy monster hunters! Players, those are the ones who get more and more excited when they can’t defeat a BOSS, trying various ways to kill you. Once you die, I don’t think you’d still have your own consciousness.”

chapters.title: Chapter 413: 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of a Newcomer! Changing the Future_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: 153: The Powerful Golden Finger of a Newcomer! Changing the Future_3
Translator: 549690339
Ding Xuan (88): “F*ck, you make so much sense, I have nothing to say.”
Wang Ping (66): “I’ll just mourn for you for a moment. But there are advantages to your world. You don’t have to act according to the game mechanism. You can travel around, kill monsters, and level up. Maybe you can become a top powerhouse in the chat group by quickly utilizing the game mechanism.”
Ding Xuan (88): “You’re right, I’m fired up!”
Zhang Hu: “So, what do the other two newcomers plan to do? Soul Travel or Physical Travel?”
Zhou Dawei (90): “I’ll go with Physical Travel. I feel that Soul Travel is a bit unreliable.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “I’ll also choose Physical Travel. I prefer my own body rather than possessing someone else’s and possibly not even being human anymore.”
As the two newcomers made their choices, they successively selected Physical Travel.
As a result, the chat group quieted down for a moment.
“Ding, Group Member Zhou Dawei (90) has died. Death Replay video is being recorded…”
Fang Yun (3): “Good lord, what’s with all these people dropping like flies after all this time?”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Yeah, he’s gone before he even had a chance to draw a Golden finger. To be honest, if he could draw a Golden finger before dying and see if it was a powerful one, we might consider reviving him.”
Wu Jun (20): “Let’s mourn for him for three seconds. However, from this aspect, Physical Travel still poses risks, so it must be carefully considered.”
Zhang Hu (5): “That’s really unfortunate. We should encourage newcomers to choose Soul Travel more in the future.”
Wang Ping (66): “He’s indeed quite pitiful. Now I’m just curious about how he ended up dead.”
Qin Tian (77): “Don’t worry; we’ll find out very soon.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “… It seems I’m quite lucky, as I’ve transmigrated to a place with no people. It’s relatively safe for now.”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s good that you know it’s only temporarily safe. Draw your Golden finger right away to prevent any sudden deaths. I was also sent to a relatively safe place initially, but I would’ve died too if I hadn’t drawn a Golden finger.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “I understand.”
Zeng Lingdong, feeling a chill in his heart, immediately chose to draw his own Golden finger.
Then, he showed a shocked expression and shared his Golden finger ability in the group, so that he wouldn’t be unexpectedly abandoned in case of sudden death.
Now, showing his value was undoubtedly essential.
Zeng Lingdong (89): “I got the ‘sign-in system. I can sign in every day, and signing in randomly gives different rewards.’”
Wang Ping (66): “Wow, even a sign-in system has come out? That’s quite something.”
Wang Ping’s gaze became strange.
Although Golden fingers are varied, some of them require resources to use their abilities.
This sign-in system, however, gives rewards out of thin air. It’s not clear where these rewards come from, and whether they can be used to sign in for powerful abilities.
“Alpha, come out and explain,” Wang Ping inquired in his heart.
“This involves core secrets, and I do not have permission to answer. Even if I did, I would not give you an answer,” Alpha’s cold and ruthless voice rang out, making Wang Ping slightly raise his eyebrows.
Core secrets…
It seemed that it was impossible to find out this so-called core secret in a short time. He could only unravel this mystery after he had grown to a certain height.
At this moment, the chat group erupted in chaos.
Fang Yun (3): “Holy sh*t, a sign-in system? That’s pretty awesome. Though the chat group also has sign-in rewards for group points, there’s no comparison between that and the benefits obtained from your own Golden finger.”
Zhang Hu (5): “What does this mean, a new member who gets stronger by lying down? I’m so envious.”
Xu Yi (84) @Zeng Lingdong (89): “Newcomer, let’s cooperate more. If you sign in for something and I try to multiply it, wouldn’t that be fantastic?”
Chen Yao (71): “The sign-in class is indeed a classic archetype. By the way, the newcomer can try signing in and see if he can get something good.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “I tried signing in just now, and I got some kind of Gene Potion. It strengthens human genes and gives me five times the physical strength of an adult. However, this upgrade seems useless. After all, I have a Starter Gift Package prepared by you big shots, and my personal abilities have already surpassed this level.”
Qin Tian (77): “Wow, that’s already impressive. Since you can sign in every day, you’ll be a wealthy man in the future. Once you sign in for something amazing, you’ll take off instantly. It’s truly enviable.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Uh…”
Just then, the chat group system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Death Replay video of Group Member Zhou Dawei (90) has been recorded. Please take this as a lesson and draw from this experience.”
At this, all the members of the chat group, including Wang Ping, clicked on the video to play it.
Then, Wang Ping saw how Zhou Dawei, the newcomer, had died.
The place where he transmigrated was actually not bad; it was a desolate area, which was considered safe.
However, although the place was safe, he had the misfortune of encountering a battle between powerful beings.
Although the distance between him and the two powerful beings was quite far, the battle had a large range of impact, and under the sweep of the shock waves, he was directly killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: 153 Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: 153 Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_4
Translator: 549690339
“This is terrible,” sighed Wang Ping.
The power system of this world seemed pretty good. If it weren’t for the fact that they had landed in a complete mess, and then drew a good Golden Finger, they could surely become high-level combat power in the chat group.
However, the world doesn’t work on ‘ifs’, that’s its cruelty.
Alpha did something to make the transmigration landing points of the new group members better.
But sometimes, there’s nothing you can do about your bad luck, is there?
At this point, the others had also finished watching the Death Replay and were feeling sentimental about the tragic fate of the newbies.
Qin Tian (77): “Speaking of which, Mr. Wang, now that you’ve had your laugh at the newbies, hurry over and rescue us. We’re panicking.”
Chen Yao (71): “I also implore Mr. Wang to come quickly. To be honest, the world of Zhang Yueying is somewhat eerie, not so simple. Plus mysterious entities around, it’s quite troublesome.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “The virus is very tricky, sigh.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, I’ll be there soon.”
After giving his response, Wang Ping dived out of the chat.
“System, activate the Paid Simulation,” he ordered.
Then, he chose to run a routine Paid Simulation so that he had a trump card when he entered Zhang Yueying’s world.
It was a safer approach and it could also save some Group Points for moving back and forth.
“Ding, payment of thirty pounds of Lower-tier Spiritual Fluid successful, Life Simulator booting, Talent Refresh in progress…” The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations host for refreshing the Blue Talent: Light of Hope; Green Talent: Palm Skill Genius.”
Blue Talent: Light of Hope: With this talent, facing a desperate situation, you will remain hopeful and can easily inspire others to do the same, bringing tranquility to their minds.
Green Talent: Palm Skill Genius: With this talent, you will have extraordinary talent in palm techniques.
“Ah, it’s been a while since I got a Blue Talent,” said Wang Ping, slightly surprised.
After all, in all these simulations, if it wasn’t the crappy Green Talent and White Talent, it was the Red Talent, the chances of refreshing a Blue Talent were quite low.
“But this Blue Talent is a little weird. Does such an ability warrant a Blue Talent rating?” asked Wang Ping, rubbing his chin thoughtfully.
“Whatever, why worry so much?, Blue is certainly of higher priority than Green. let’s choose it for now.”
Wang Ping made his choice.
“System, I choose Blue Talent: Light of Hope.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation commencing…” The system’s voice rang out again and familiar text appeared on the luminescent screen.
But Wang Ping didn’t look at the screen. Instead, he opened the chat group again, locked on to Zhang Yueying, and transmigrated.
In an instant, he was turned into a white light and vanished, heading towards the world where Zhang Yueying was located.
At this time, in the world where Zhang Yueying was located, Zhang Yueying, Qin Tian, Chen Yao, Zhang Jun, and Cai Yonglong were all gathered together, waiting for Wang Ping to arrive.
As Wang Ping appeared abruptly from the white light, the five of them showed expressions of joy.
To this, Wang Ping nodded at them with a smile.
At the same time, he gave Zhang Yueying an extra glance.
Zhang Yueying’s soul-travel host is a girl, quite ordinary-looking.
But no matter what she looks like, for Zhang Yueying, who had a terminal illness, a healthy body is the most important thing, isn’t it?
“Share the information you’ve gathered,” said Wang Ping, sitting on the sofa and getting straight to the point.
To this, Zhang Yueying poured a cup of tea for Wang Ping out of courtesy and then gave him a stack of information. Speaking softly, she said, “It’s weird, we weren’t able to figure it out. The situation in our world is a bit tricky.”
As Zhang Yueying spoke, Qin Tian also gave a bitter smile, “I would say it’s super tricky. The virus in this world is too horrifying. Even if you’re powerful, you’ll get infected.”
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow slightly, didn’t say much, and started reading the documents thoroughly.
Shortly after, he finished reading the documents, and his face grew slightly serious.
He had known about the JY virus from Zhang Yueying’s world for a while.
After all, Zhang Yueying had mentioned some things about her world.
This JY virus was capable of rewriting genes, reshaping people into monsters.
The last newcomer, Zhang Yueying, was also in a world unlike any other.
It was a world similar to Zombie World.
However, the creatures in that world weren’t zombies. Instead of a Zombie Virus, there was a different type of virus.
It was a terrifying virus known as the JY Virus in her world.
Once infected with this virus, one’s genes would be rewritten and reshaped
If these viruses carried the genes of other creatures during transmission, they would become mutated beasts, monsters with terrifying regenerative abilities.
These mutated beasts were classified into five tiers, with the 5th Tier mutant beasts being the highest. Not even nuclear weapons could kill them.
Calculations made by humans concluded that unless it can be annihilated in a very short time to leave not a single cell remaining, it would be completely killed.
The regenerative ability of the 5th Tier mutant beasts was that outrageous.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: 153 Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: 153 Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_5
Translator: 549690339
One might say, the daunting power of regeneration of this being was even more hyperbolic than that of Nirvana Realm Masters in the Purple Spirit Realm.
However, the terrorizing recovery ability of the 5th Tier mutant beast, as well as its vast body size spanning thousands of kilometers, are not big deals.
Chen Yao, as a Seven Tier expert, can instantly annihilate it, leaving not even a single cell behind.
It is worth noting that even if Chen Yao does not take any action, anyone else could eliminate it, excluding Yue Ying.
After all, the fighting power at the Six-Tier is no laughing matter.
In their eyes, the 5th Tier mutant beast is nothing more than a moving target.
But, the situation is not that simple.
Because this JY Virus is much more terrifying than they imagined.
Chen Yao and her team got various research data, even used them for their own experiments.
Of course, it’s not about directly injecting the virus, but slicing off a small part of their bodies and infecting it.
Theoretically, Chen Yao’s cells, as a person with 7th-Tier Combat Power, would not be infected by this virus.
However, an odd thing happened. When they came into contact with a large amount of the original virus, Chen Yao’s cells were quickly infected, showing signs of turning into mutant beasts.
This implies, if these powerful beings were injected with a large amount of the virus or the bodily fluids of mutant beasts over a short period, they too would transform into mutant beasts.
Moreover, they suspect that the virus has already taken residence inside their bodies.
After all, this virus is airborne. The amount of virus, though minute, is not deadly.
Well, at least on the surface it is so.
As there have been no abnormalities in ordinary humans yet, only when the infection rate exceeds fifty percent do they turn into monsters.
But, is the reality that the infection rate really needs to exceed fifty percent?
Everything is uncertain.
Therefore, they really dare not take any rash actions.
As for now, they have no idea where the anomaly is.
The terror of this virus alone keeps them awake at nights.
They don’t want to end up getting infected into horrendous monsters even before they find this anomaly.
“Quite interesting.”
Wang Ping spoke out softly after putting down the data.
“Mr. Wang, what are your opinions?”
Zhang Jun couldn’t resist asking.
“Have you ever suspected that this virus is created by the anomaly?”
Wang Ping expressed after pondering for a moment.
“We have suspected so. After all, such a terrifying virus, it’s hard to imagine that it evolved on Earth accidentally or was created by humans. However… we are unable to confirm whether it was created by the anomaly.”
Cai Yonglong frowned and replied with a sigh.
“Honestly, this virus reminds me of the first anomaly. The Zombie Virus in that world was also horrifying and related to the anomaly.”
“The situation is different. That virus was not created by the anomaly.”
Wang Ping rejected Cai Yonglong’s proposition, shaking his head.
If the Zombie Virus was indeed created by the anomaly, his Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons would absolutely fail to hold it off, he would definitely get infected.
That is to say, although the Zombie Virus was powerful, it was not caused by the anomaly.
While it’s true that the Zombie anomaly involved the virus, it merely transferred the Zombie Virus into the organisms, the infection was almost undefendable.
Perhaps, not only the Zombie Virus, but other viruses could also be used as intermediaries in its ability. However, it definitely did not create the virus, this can be asserted.
“Hmm, you’re right.”
Cai Yonglong touched his chin, thoughtfully nodding his head.
“If this JY Virus is truly created by the anomaly, that would be rather terrifying. The upper bound for this virus is absolutely dramatic. Perhaps, not only the beings with 7th-Tier Battle Power would be infected, even the 10th Tier may not escape the fate of being infected.”
Wang Ping scanned the crowd, declaring solemnly.
When these words came out, everyone felt a chill in their hearts, as it sounded highly possible.
When it comes to the anomaly, the upper limit of its abilities is extraordinarily chilling, and even the strong ones could fall prey without noticing.
“Of course, the 10th Tier powerhouses will definitely erase the entire planet once they discover something wrong, that’s beyond doubt.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, speaking slowly.
“If it really reaches that stage, I would do the same too.”
Zhang Jun murmured.
Eveyone fell silent.
“No need to be overly nervous, for now, let me probe the situation first.”
Wang Ping cracked a smile, easing the tense atmosphere. He then closed his eyes.
Seeing this, everyone quieted down, not wanting to disturb Wang Ping.
Wang Ping did not have an immediate plan to simulate the situation of this world, instead he planned to finish viewing the leftover contents of his already initiated Paid Simulation.
As Wang Ping focused, familiar words appeared on the luminescent screen.
[On the first day, you chose cultivation…]
[Next, you did not act according to your memory. After careful consideration, you chose to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, becoming the personal disciple of the Sky Emperor, thus gaining fame.]
[Under the guidance of the Sky Emperor, your understanding of Divine Skills deepened. Before the opening of Flaming Fire Secret Realm, you even managed to comprehend your own king-tier divine skill: Devouring Space.]
“Well, well, he actually comprehended his own king-tier divine skill before the secret realm unfolded, huh? That’s the benefit of having a mentor. Of course, this also depends on the rewards he has received so many times, which enriched his understanding of Dao laws to a great depth, otherwise, it would have taken a lot of time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 153: Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Chapter 153: Newcomer’s Powerful Golden Finger! Changing the Future_6
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and silently pondered in his heart, then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[You have comprehended your own king-tier divine skill, which directly frightened your Master Emperor of Kongtian. After all, comprehending a king-tier divine skill with a half-step Life-and-Death Realm cultivation is indeed too abnormal. Throughout the ages, no one has ever achieved this feat.]
[For a time, your Master Emperor of Kongtian recognized you as the protagonist of the era, who surpassed the past protagonist, and had a great hope for the future to become a monster rising above the emperor.]
[Regarding your master’s evaluation, you feel subtle. After all, although you think you have a great chance to become an emperor without falling midway, taking that step is really too difficult; it depends on luck and opportunity.]
[In the end, your current achievements are entirely due to cheating. Although your RootPhysique Comprehension is indeed extraordinary, it is not much stronger compared to those real monsters.]
[Next, you continue to develop low-key until the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opens, and you remain low-key as well. Even, in order to hide the fact that you entered the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, you did not follow the main force of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land to enter, but chose to hide your identity, conceal your aura and enter, keeping an extremely low profile.]
[After entering the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, you begin to act. At the True King Blood Flower, you didn’t even care about the Enlightenment Soul Grass, and wasted no time in killing the monster beast and taking the True King Blood Flower, leaving people dumbfounded, completely unaware of who had taken action, even Ji Bingyue was shocked by you.]
[Next, you camped at the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, easily obtaining the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, shaking the Purple Spirit Realm. This time, no one knew who had taken the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor. Perhaps, only your Master Emperor of Kongtian guessed that it was your doing.]
[After all, only you have the horror of strength to do such a thing. However, he could not understand why you had to be so low-key, completely devoid of the style of action of the past proud geniuses.]
[After you returned to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, Emperor Kongtian inquired about the inheritance, which you did not hide anything about. At this, Emperor Kongtian sighed that it was indeed you, and advised you to be more high-profile, to fight with the Holy Child of other Holy Lands and even with the descendants of the Emperor, to defeat them and make a name for yourself, which can actually gather momentum and even improve your own luck.]
[In response, you couldn’t explain anything and were unmoved. High profile equals courting death; only by keeping a low profile can you avoid attracting the attention of the Demon Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm. Then, you can lie low and develop, find out what exactly happened in the future, and try to prevent these things from happening.]
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years have passed. During these hundreds of years, your cultivation has successfully advanced to the 1st Tier Nirvana Realm. This point is still only known to your Master Emperor of Kongtian, and others have no knowledge of it.]
[For your cautious behavior, your Master Emperor of Kongtian really didn’t know what to say. However, your cultivation has already surpassed your peers, and going out into the world would only be bullying people, so he doesn’t want to say more and let you cultivate on your own.]
[During these hundreds of years, you have become more proficient in king-tier divine skills. At the same time, you have also created your own secret skills one after another. At the same time, due to experience reasons, you have also comprehended the embryonic forms of two more domains.]
[And that is the embryonic forms of the fire domain and the space domain. With this, you have become the only person who has three domain embryos at the 1st Tier Nirvana Realm.]
[Compared to your low-key, Ye Chen is much more high-profile, with unlimited glory, fighting against his peers and being called one of the brightest geniuses. Although he did not get the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor, which made him unable to lead the fashion and become the universally recognized first heaven’s proud genius, he has also gained many powerful opportunities over the years, which are enough to be dazzling.]
[As the two realms approached each other, the Blood Demon Clan invaded the Purple Spirit Realm once again, and all the strong people of the Purple Spirit Realm were alarmed. You were also awe-stricken, knowing that the most critical moment had arrived.]
[As a result, you told your master, Emperor Kongtian, about the possibility of Jiuyou Demon Emperor, Chu Xiao attacking Profound Turtle in advance. Although he was very surprised why you would guess that Jiuyou Demon Emperor, Chu Xiao would attack Profound Turtle, he still chose to unconditionally believe you.]
[Next, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao launched his action and attacked Profound Turtle. However, this time, thanks to your reminder, Emperor Kongtian had an arrangement in place. In the end, a powerful man of Emperor Realm Great Perfection among the Purple Spirit Realm was stationed there in advance, and a shocking battle broke out after Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao appeared.]
[In the end, Jiuyou Demon Emperor was worried that more powerful people would come to support, so he chose to flee. As a result, Profound Turtle did not die and continued to suppress the strange body-snatching Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
[However, it is a matter of war, and the strong people of the Purple Spirit Realm cannot protect Profound Turtle all the time. As a result, Profound Turtle was exiled to the Spatial Turbulence to protect him from being targeted by Jiuyou Demon Emperor, Chu Xiao.]
“Profound Turtle didn’t die, the strange entity wasn’t released, I wonder if the Purple Spirit Realm will still be destroyed in the future.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content and silently pondered in his heart.
He had previously speculated that the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm was related to Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
It might have been him who took that step, using some means to destroy the Purple Spirit Realm.
Or it could have been the strange entity that destroyed the Purple Spirit Realm.
Either way, it’s absolutely impossible to let Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao take that step or allow the strange entity to break the seal.
Otherwise, everything would be over.
Immediately, Wang Ping converged his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[With the news of Profound Turtle being unharmed, you can also breathe a sigh of relief. Next, you continue to lie low, not caring about your reputation, and have no intention of participating in the war between the two realms. This makes many experts and geniuses of the Purple Spirit Realm despise you, thinking that Emperor Kongtian has taken a soft disciple.]
[Even the many disciples of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land looked down on you as well. After all, you have not exerted any effort over the years, and your strength is unknown. Now you are even avoiding war, making you unworthy of being called a Saint-tier character.]
[In this regard, you still don’t care. Other people’s opinions have nothing to do with you. Besides, your cultivation has reached the Nirvana Realm, so you don’t need to be a saint anymore. After all, once you break through to the Nirvana Realm, you can step down from the position of the Holy Child and become an Inner Sect Elder of the Holy Land, and when your cultivation is sufficient, you will have the qualification to compete for the Position of Saint Master later.]

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 154: A New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (10,000 Words Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 154: A New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (10,000 Words Chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
[As the war unfolded, the Purple Spirit Realm was deeply worried. Because this time without your participation, the two realms’ war, especially the battle of the geniuses, did not have any advantage, and was even suppressed by the Blood Demon Realm geniuses. Thus, the morale in the Purple Spirit Realm was a bit low.]
[In the end, both sides began the scheduled battles. This time, it was Ye Chen who challenged the monsters of the Blood Demon Realm, trying to turn the tide and boost morale.]
[However, the outcome of this battle was not ideal. Ye Chen didn’t even qualify to challenge the strongest child of the Demon Emperor in the Blood Demon Realm and fell into the hands of other monsters there.]
[Although the result was a draw with both sides seriously injured and on the verge of death, Ye Chen was already one of the strongest genius characters in the Purple Spirit Realm, capable of squeezing into the top three, while the monster that the Blood Demon Realm sent only ranked tenth.]
[This battle made the Purple Spirit Realm even less confident. The Blood Demon Realm saw the lack of confidence in the Purple Spirit Realm and seriously doubted that the Purple Spirit Realm’s foundation was not as strong as the Blood Demon Realm, probably lacking any Quasi-Immortal Tier powerhouses.]
[In the Blood Demon Realm, the Blood Demon Clan is supreme. Blood Demons like to use Blood Food as nourishment to help their cultivation, which is extremely vicious. Their style is also domineering and direct. Since they suspected that your Purple Spirit Realm had none of those tier powerhouses, they had no intention of dragging it out.]
[After all, if they gave the Purple Spirit Realm enough time, it was possible that a Quasi-Immortal Tier powerhouse would be born during this time. They did not want to suffer the same loss as they did ten thousand years ago.]
[Therefore, the Blood Demon World’s total attack began. The strongest Demon Emperor personally led the charge, beginning the slaughter of the Purple Spirit Realm’s powerhouses. Faced with this, the powerful beings of the Purple Spirit Realm were terrified and helpless. The gap in their cultivation was too great, and no one could withstand the Quasi-Immortal Tier powerhouses.]
[When you heard this news, you sighed in your heart and quietly left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, planning to find a place to hide. With your Red Talent: Breath Concealment, as long as you were not seen by an Emperor-tier existence at close range, your chances of survival were much higher than others.]
[It was when the various Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm were besieged, and some even unlucky to be crushed to death by the strongest Demon Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm, on the verge of a complete collapse, that a change occurred in the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[A figure that had been sealed in ice for ten thousand years shattered the glacier and reappeared in the world. She was the Profound Ice Empress.
