The Profound Ice Empress had once sacrificed her life to use her Quasi-Emperor cultivation to seal several Emperors of the Blood Demon Realm with ice, achieving remarkable feats.]
[At that time, she indeed perished, and her first life was completely dead. However, she defied the heavens and was reborn, not by Body Possession but by living her second life on her own.]
[After living her second life, she did not make herself known and had been diligently cultivating and comprehending her own Dao. Now, ten thousand years have passed, and during this time, she had not only become an Emperor but had also stepped forward and broken through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier.]
“I knew that the Purple Spirit Realm must have some hidden trump cards that haven’t been revealed yet. However, I never expected that this Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan could actually come back to life… These Masters really have merciless means, one after another.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, feeling quite subtle.
However, it must be said that this Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was indeed monstrous, being able to live out her second life on her own and secretly cultivating to the Quasi-Immortal Tier, which was quite frightening.
He had previously lamented that even Ji Bingyan, a genius like her, had not been able to become an Emperor, and that the growth of a genius was full of uncertainties.
As a result, now his face was slapped again….
Well, it was quite embarrassing.
Of course, Wang Ping also knew that the situation of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was an exception.
Not everyone could live out their second life on their own.
Not only living out her second life but also being able to secretly cultivate to the Quasi-Immortal Tier was even more outrageous.
“But… even though she has become a Quasi-Immortal, she still couldn’t save the Purple Spirit Realm.”
Wang Ping thought of the ending of the Purple Spirit Realm and sighed quietly.
In the end, the Purple Spirit Realm was still destroyed.
Although he didn’t know what had happened, he could analyze that Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan probably had died in battle too.
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, looking forward to the developments that would follow.
[After leaving the Eternal Frozen Land, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was discovered by two Emperor-level beings of the Blood Demon Realm. They were both extremely astonished and had never expected that Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was still alive. They were very wary of Ji Bingyan but still chose to join forces and attack her.]
[Facing the attacks of the two Emperors, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan simply coldly slapped them down with one palm, instantly killing them and displaying an invincible posture.]
[Such fluctuations also caught the attention of many powerful beings in the two realms.]
[The fact that Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was still alive and instantly killed two Emperors shocked the powerful beings of the Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm to the extreme. None of them had expected Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan to still be alive, and her strength had clearly reached an unfathomable level.]
[The strongest Demon Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm was very serious and directly stated the fact that Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan had broken through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier and reached the same realm as him. That made both sides even more shocked.]
[The powerful beings of the Blood Demon Realm were extremely fearful of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. After all, before she became an Emperor, she had sealed the several Emperors of the Blood Demon Realm with ice. Although the Emperors were low-ranked ones, it was still terrifying.]

chapters.title: Chapter 418: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! The Cultivation is Soaring (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! The Cultivation is Soaring (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _2
Translator: 549690339
[Now, the opponent has become a Quasi-Immortal. How terrifying his strength is, it’s unimaginable. This has the many Emperors of the Blood Demon Realm feeling apprehensive, stuck like they’re riding a tiger they can’t dismount.]
[The powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm, however, have cheered up, feeling that they finally have the capital to fight against the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Next, the strongest Demon Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm chose to attack Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan after his silence. In response, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan showed no fear and clashed head-on with him. The two fought so fiercely that the entire Purple Spirit Realm trembled. If it weren’t for them moving their battlefield out of the realm, who knows how many people would have died from the repercussion.]
[In the end, neither side turned it into a fight to the death. By mutual tacit agreement, they chose to continue training their armies through warfare. During the war, the Quasi-Emperors and Emperors were not allowed to intervene. Only the cultivators below the level of Quasi-Emperor could take action until all the geniuses and Masters of the enemy side were killed.]
“As expected, it turned out like this.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, shook his head slightly, and wasn’t surprised by this outcome.
Under normal development, there should have been a Quasi-God on the side of the Purple Spirit Realm, otherwise there would have been no way to withstand the battle, or wait for Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, to grow up.
However, it’s such a pity that even though Ye Chen is the Son of Fortune of the Purple Spirit Realm, it won’t help.
If the Purple Spirit Realm itself is destroyed, what can you, a Son of Fortune, born from the Purple Spirit Realm, do?
All I can say is that the uncertainty brought about by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and unpredictability factors are too significant, distorting the future development.
“Of course, I can’t really say anything, after all, I am also a transmigrator who changed the destiny of Ye Chen.”
Wang Ping thought silently and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, the both of you started the war. You finally no longer hid your abilities and chose to enter the battlefield. After all, if you didn’t make a move, the geniuses of the Purple Spirit Realm wouldn’t be able to beat those from the Blood Demon Realm, resulting in severe consequences.]
[However, even though you chose to make a move, you still didn’t go all out. After all, in your memory, you fell before Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan could arrive. You’re not Ye Chen, perhaps the battle between Ye Chen and the Demon Emperor’s Child would have lasted longer, the meetup time would have been later. Anyway, he had the Son of Fortune’s luck protecting him, which allowed her to wait for Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan to save him. But not you.]
[So, properly hiding your strength can not only better deal with future dangers but also reduce the possibility of being targeted.]
[Of course, even if you hid your strength, you demonstrated tremendous battle power equal to the Demon Emperor’s Child, which shocked both realms and astonished countless people. Who would have thought that you, the despised Son of the Holy Land of the Heavenly Swords, the selected protege of the Sky Emperor, could be so powerful? For a moment, many people lamented their inferiority, feeling a sense of shame.]
[At the same time, because of your strength and dominance, combined with the effect of Blue Talent: Light of Hope, you ignited the hope in the heart of many in the Purple Spirit Realm. Countless people chose to follow you, and many geniuses became your followers.]
[At this point, you exhibited the charm of the Profound Ice Empress from a thousand years ago, and even more brilliantly than her. Because those who followed her back then were not as high-quality or as numerous as your followers.]
[The Demon Emperor’s Child remembered you as well, seeing you as his nemesis, wanting to take you down in the future. But you didn’t care. After all, if you wanted, you could kill the Demon Emperor’s Child right now. However, to prevent the Blood Demon Realm from reacting crazily, you couldn’t kill him for now.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years passed. During these hundred years, wars broke out constantly, affecting the entire Purple Spirit Realm. Everywhere was a battlefield, no one could escape the repercussions of war.]
[In the entire Purple Spirit Realm, only cultivators who have reached the Transcendent Realm and above were obliged to join the war. As for cultivators below the Transcendent Realm, they were no different from cannon fodder. There was no point in them joining the battlefield. It would be better for them to continue cultivation and wait until their cultivation has improved.]
[In these hundred years, you’ve had infinite glory, recognized by the Purple Spirit Realm as the future leading figure. However, while you were celebrated, danger was never far away. Sometimes, even if you gave everything you had, you barely survived.]
[However, through the baptism of war, your cultivation improved at a pace far faster than what you remember. In only a hundred years, your cultivation has already reached the Nirvana Realm 3rd Tier, and you’re not far from the 4th Tier of the Nirvana Realm. Your foundation in the Nirvana Realm is also very solid.]
[Ye Chen was not bad either, also reaching the Second Tier of the Nirvana Realm. However, if it comes to combat power, he was far inferior to you. As for others like Ji Bingyue, they were slightly behind Ye Chen, but also reached the Nirvana Realm.]
[At the moment when the war between both sides intensified, each producing talented figures, an incident that shocked the Purple Spirit Realm happened. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao shockingly found the location of the Profound Turtle, attacked and killed it, taking away its seal.]
[This provoked extreme anger from the powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm, yet they dared not voice it, for fear that it would be noticed by the Blood Demon Realm. Even Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was somewhat silent. She had seen Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao before. He once ventured into the Eternal Frozen Land, wanting to unleash the Blood Demon that she had sealed, but was deterred by her and chose to retreat.]

chapters.title: Chapter 419: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _3
Translator: 549690339
[If it wasn’t for her being in the critical moment of her closed-door cultivation at that time, she wouldn’t have let Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao get away.]
[The talent and methods of the other party are truly astonishing, surpassing other emperors. Even so, the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan felt that the other party might become a Quasi-Immortal Tier character. The other party’s conspiracies are definitely not simple and pose a great hidden danger.]
[Unfortunately, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao is just too cunning and ruthless, never leaving any flaws in his actions, making it impossible to catch him or track his whereabouts. Otherwise, the Profound Ice Empress would have really wanted to personally kill him and put an end to future troubles.]
“Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao have indeed crossed paths before.”
Wang Ping thought silently after reading this.
He had previously speculated that Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s actions were quite strange, as if he was certain that the Purple Spirit Realm had the power to counter the Blood Demon Realm Quasi-divine, and only by releasing the Cunning would the Purple Spirit Realm be utterly ruined, allowing him to advance even further.
Now it seems that this has been confirmed.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao trespassed into the Eternal Frozen Land and was driven back by Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. He realized that Profound Ice Empress was in the process of attacking the Quasi-immortal Tier, so he didn’t dare to act too arrogantly for all these years.
If it weren’t for that, according to estimates by the Heavenly Sword Saint Master and others, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao would have wreaked havoc in the entire Purple Spirit Realm, causing boundless slaughter.
Such a powerful person has actually been somewhat too well-behaved these years, without any major commotions being heard about him.
“As the simulation progresses, various secrets can be unearthed; otherwise, many things may seem hazy. However, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao is still an unrepentant thief. With the release of Cunning, I’m afraid that the Purple Spirit Realm is once again doomed.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
He had previously suspected that the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm was the work of Cunning, as only Cunning had the ability to and the purpose to do so. Naturally, the suspicion was the most significant.
[After hearing about Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s attack on the Profound Turtle, he falls into silence. You know that the Purple Spirit Realm may be destroyed again, and the time left for you is not much. Under normal cultivation, you would definitely end up as a pity victim trapped under the catastrophe.]
[There are only two ways to survive: either crazily improve your cultivation and break through to the Divine Realm within the next few hundred years, ascend to the Upper Realm, or defect to the Blood Demon Realm and flee there. Otherwise, there is not a hint of escape.]
[However, as a seeker of the Dao, you disdain to defect to the Blood Demon Realm. If you really turn to the enemy, your Tao Heart will shatter in an instant, rendering further progress impossible, and even constantly plagued by Heart Demons afterwards, thus rendering you wasted.]
[For this reason, you choose to fight the Demon Emperor’s Child again without hiding your strength, forcefully killing him and shocking both realms. Countless people are horrified that you are so powerful.]
[This thrusts you into the limelight. The Blood Demon Realm is enraged, wanting to eliminate you as soon as possible, and starts launching various assassinations against you. The danger you face now far exceeds that of the past.]
[In addition, you deliberately seek death and attract stronger opponents for fights to the death. Under such circumstances, even someone like you has gone through countless terrifying killing games, almost died many times, and even been legitimately killed once, barely managing a Nirvana Rebirth with the aid of Nirvana Skill.]
[Such experiences have made your cultivation improve extremely fast, reaching the 7th-Tier of the Nirvana Boundary in just fifty years.]
[Your encounter, your ruthlessness, makes Ye Chen shudder, feeling that you are too cruel. However, he is not weak either, also embarking on the same path as you, intending to use such methods to quickly improve his cultivation.]
[Even the geniuses of the two realms get involved, plunging into madness. After all, if they don’t quickly catch up, they will either be surpassed or left far behind. A result like that would most likely lead to being completely killed by someone in the future.]
[The kings, quasi-emperors, emperors, and even quasi-immortals of the two realms watch these scenes in silence. This war, under your manipulation, is even more cruel than the previous one ten thousand years ago. The rate of genius’ falls has greatly increased, but new geniuses rise and enter the killing games.]
[This is the genuine nurturing of gu. Using the geniuses and great powers of the two realms as a foundation, they conduct large-scale gu nurturing. Perhaps, under such circumstances, new quasi-divine beings will appear in the future, and not just one or two as simple as that.]
[In the eyes of the strong beings of the two realms, you are the most likely person to become the Bewitched King with normal development. This is just like ten thousand years ago when the Purple Spirit Realm produced the Son of Fortune, who led the Purple Spirit Realm to a strong comeback. Even your performance is more stunning than the other party’s during their youth.]
[For this reason, the Blood Demon Realm knows that they cannot continue like this. Relying on the fact that they have more quasi-emperors and emperors than the Purple Spirit Realm, they launch an assassination against you. Although the strong people of the Purple Spirit Realm detect the Blood Demon Realm’s actions and try to block them, due to the fact that their numbers of strong people are ultimately fewer, you are still brutally killed by an emperor.]
[This time, you cannot come back to life. The Rebirth tally has already been used up, and the Nirvana Skill, suppressed by the Emperor’s power, couldn’t even have any effect. As a result, the miracle of Nirvana Rebirth does not exist.]

chapters.title: Chapter 420: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
[Because of your death, the simulation ends…..]
“Ah, I’m dead after all. In the end, this way of improving cultivation is too extreme. Without great fortune supporting me, accidents are bound to happen, and death is inevitable. Being able to live for fifty years and raise my cultivation to the 7th-Tier of the Nirvana Boundary is already terrifying enough.”
Wang Ping sighed as he looked at the simulation content.
“Maybe even Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, would have died in this situation where an Emperor attacked him personally. After all, fortune isn’t omnipotent, and it can’t make you survive any situation.”
In the simulation, Wang Ping may have known that his chances of falling were high, but he still chose to do so.
Because he had no other choice.
If he didn’t break through, he would die.
Even if he didn’t choose to join the Blood Demon Realm and tried to escape there with the effect of Breath Concealment, he still needed strong strength to support him.
That strength might not be enough at the King tier; it had to be at least the Quasi-Emperor tier.
Normal Cultivation would be a delusional dream if one wanted to become a Quasi-Emperor within hundreds of years.
Even with such madness, Wang Ping didn’t think he could reach that level.
The only thing he could say was that the difficulty of conquering this broken world was just too damn high.
This was why he had a Life Simulator; if other traversers had traveled through time at this point, their chances of sudden death would be over 99%.
As Wang Ping complained in his heart, his consciousness flickered, and his vision changed.
Then he saw the scene where the simulated Wang Ping was assassinated by the Emperor.
A magnificent Emperor Realm expert actually disregarded the Emperor’s dignity, shamelessly ambushing Wang Ping just to kill him instantly, without giving him a chance to survive. He was extremely cruel.
Soon, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision returned to normal.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
1. 7th-Tier Nirvana Boundary cultivation.
2. Blue Talent: Light of Hope.
3. king-tier divine skill: Devouring Space.
4. Emperor-Tier divine skill: Sky-Space Sword Skills.
5. Emperor-level Skill: Flaming Fire Emperor Skill.
6. Emperor-tier Divine Skills: Red Fire Sky Screen.
7. Learned Secret Skills.”
“The level is high now, there is not a single simple reward.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and sighed in his heart.
However, he didn’t make a choice but decided to wait until he figured out the situation in this world before choosing a reward to ensure safety.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Immediately afterward, the familiar luminescent screen appeared again, and the text emerged.
[Day 1, you begin your actions. This time, you adopt the same method as in Lin Yuanyuan’s world, simply and brutally trying to kill all humans to force out the bizarreness.]
[You split up for your actions. With your strength, it is very easy to destroy all major human survival bases, and everyone except Zhang Yueying can do it.]
[Regarding this, Zhang Yueying holds an opposing attitude, thinking that it is too cruel. However, you do not care. Having experienced so many Group Tasks and knowing how terrifying bizarreness is, you value completing Group Tasks and eliminating bizarreness more than human lives in this world. Eliminating bizarreness is saving the world. It is fair to say that you have saved many more worlds.]
[However, something that silenced you happened. After you killed all the humans in this world without exception, you still didn’t receive a mission completion prompt. It was at this point that Zhang Jun, Qin Tian, Cai Yonglong, and Chen Yao were successively infected and turned into mutated beasts.]
[Even you began to show symptoms of infection, and becoming a monster is only a matter of time. Only Zhang Yueying, due to her golden finger, was not infected.]
[This made you somewhat incredulous and unable to understand, not knowing why or how you were infected.]
[For this reason, you began your final attempt. You started to unleash your terrifying power to cleanse the Earth’s surface. With your current strength, it’s not difficult to cleanse the entire surface of the Earth, it just takes a bit more time.]
[However, during the process of releasing your power, you suddenly noticed that the stronger the power you used, the faster you got infected. And then, you were on the verge of being turned into a mutated beast.]
[At this point, you gritted your teeth, decisively committing suicide.]
[After you resurrected, you found that the virus was still in your body and accelerated the infection. In the end, you could only watch helplessly as you turned into a mutated beast, losing your self-awareness.]
[Due to your ‘death,’ the simulation ends….]
“What….”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with furrowed brows and opened his eyes.
This virus was a bit terrifying. It completely ignored the level of life and infected everyone equally.
Moreover, the more power he unleashed, the faster he got infected. It was as if the virus was devouring his energy to grow.
On top of that, even after he resurrected, the virus hadn’t disappeared, which was outrageous.
However, the mechanism of the Rebirth tally was to reverse time, and at that time, Wang Ping was already infected with the virus. Perhaps that was normal.
“Mr. Wang, how’s it going?”

chapters.title: Chapter 421: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! Cultivation Skyrockets (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _5
Translator: 549690339
Seeing Wang Ping open his eyes, Qin Tian could not wait to ask him.
“It’s very troublesome.”
Wang Ping’s face was solemn as he recounted the situation.
“Uh….”
Everyone fell silent after listening.
They couldn’t eliminate the anomaly nor complete the Group Task even after killing all humans.
This indicated that the anomaly had not possessed humans.
“The anomaly should have possessed other living organisms. Based on past experiences, the anomaly hasn’t possessed ordinary animals before, but that doesn’t mean it can’t.”
Chen Yao said in a deep voice.
“I think it’s more likely that the anomalous beings have possessed the mutated beasts. The objects of possession are often intelligent life forms. Humans are intelligent, and demons are intelligent too, so they can both be possessed. As for other species, I doubt they can bear its existence.”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment before speaking up.
“Otherwise, it would be safer for the anomaly to possess some animals, and we would find it even more challenging to locate.”
“But are zombies and mutated beasts intelligent life forms?”
Qin Tian retorted.
“Zombies are actually intelligent life forms… As I mentioned before, they have evolved intelligence and have even begun to establish a primitive civilization, a zombie civilization…”
Zhang Jun said with an odd look on his face.
“What about mutated beasts? According to the investigation, mutated beasts shouldn’t possess intelligence.”
Zhang Yueying quietly chimed in.
“No, whether they are zombies or mutated beasts, they are all species derived from human genes. It is normal for the anomaly to possess them.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke out.
After hearing this, Zhang Yueying found it reasonable and had nothing more to say.
“But, Mr. Wang, if the anomaly really possesses mutated beasts, then it’s going to be a big problem. After all, mutated beasts are endless.”
Cai Yonglong frowned and said helplessly.
“On the entire Earth, there are countless mutated beasts on land and even more so in the oceans. If we want to find and kill it, our only option would be to resort to the ‘Great Cleaning’ method and cleanse the surface of the Earth.”
“It’s not that simple… Some mutated beasts might be hiding among the humans of the survival bases or underground.”
Zhang Jun fell silent for a moment before speaking.
“Can’t we use some Secret Skill to find it? If we had a search-type Secret Skill when dealing with the zombie anomaly, we could have found it easily.”
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping, attempting to suggest.
Although he had the inheritance of the white-haired old man and similar Secret Skills, he had not yet mastered them.
On the other hand, Wang Ping had the Life Simulator and had even joined the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, so he might have access to the Holy Land’s Secret Skills.
“It probably won’t work.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
If it were possible, simulator Wang Ping would have done it long ago.
However, he still chose the most brute-force method to find the anomaly, which means this method is not feasible.
“I see.”
Cai Yonglong felt slightly headache-inducing.
What to do now?
The virus is terrifying, and there’s no solution to it.
“I’ll try again.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
Before coming to this world, he had prepared in advance by isolating all outer world influences with energy.
Even so, the Life Simulator was still infected.
This indicates that the virus is simply unstoppable.
If they don’t find and kill their opponent, it’s an unsolvable situation.
“We have no other option.”
Cai Yonglong and the others looked at each other and reluctantly nodded.
Next, Wang Ping closed his eyes again and said in his mind, “System, I want to proceed with a free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The familiar system voice sounded again, with the luminescent screen appearing and the text emerging.
[Day One, after discussing, you didn’t take any actions and just waited quietly, wanting to see the future development of this world.]
[During the wait, you also integrated into the survival bases of this world. You saw many dark things. The world was very distorted. Children who were born infected with the JY Virus were extremely powerful fighters against mutated beasts, yet they were deemed as monsters by humans and severely discriminated against, calling them mutated humans.]
[However, humans couldn’t live without their protection. You sighed in your heart, knowing that these children were just too young, none of them older than ten, without their own thoughts. The ordinary humans didn’t allow them to have their own thoughts, so they could train them into ‘warriors’ and exploit them to the fullest.]
[Ordinary mutated children without combat capabilities could only wander and beg to survive, unable to even fill their stomachs. Once their identities were exposed, they would be bullied, and even their parents would despise them.]
[This world was extremely distorted and dark, with many people filled with numbness. Hopelessness and violence filled their hearts, and they believed that humans would not be able to survive forever, sooner or later to be wiped out by the mutated beasts. Therefore, the extinction of humanity was widely accepted.]
[Half a year later, a unique mutated beast appeared, destroying the ‘barrier’ made of special metal, and a large number of mutated beasts rushed into the survival base, turning it into a purgatory. Humans either were eaten by mutated beasts or were infected and turned into mutated beasts.]

chapters.title: Chapter 422: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! The Cultivation is
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: 154: The New Quasi-Immortal! The Cultivation is
Soaring (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _6
Translator: 549690339
“With this, the Survival Base has completely fallen. The news rapidly spreads in other Survival Bases and cannot be suppressed. Eventually, it ignites despair and darkness in everyone’s heart.”
“After all, the theory of despair at the end of the world is prevalent. It’s just that because of the ‘barrier’, most mutated beasts can’t invade the Survival Base’s interior. Only a small fraction slips through the nets but are quickly handled by the military or mutated children. So, they can still live. Despite the desperation, they fear death, they are certain the apocalypse will come, but they hope it will not.”
“Human beings are such a contradiction. But now, something has occurred that even a ‘barrier’ is useless. This undoubtedly represents that humanity can no longer defend against the mutated beasts. The real apocalypse has arrived.”
“For this reason, they naturally fall into complete despair, the darkness in their hearts fully explodes. Countless people begin to give themselves over, venting their dark emotions, committing arson, robbery, and all sorts of atrocities.”
“Only a small number of people can remain calm, wanting to reunite with their families in this limited time, at the same time praying for a miracle.”
“Considering the situation, you think about whether or not to intervene. However, you ultimately choose to continue observing calmly. After all, saving a portion of people doesn’t mean anything.”
“Half a month later, the second Survival Base of humanity is destroyed by the mutated beasts, humans become more desperate, vent their feelings recklessly, and want to enjoy the last frenzied despair before their death. Thus, many innocent people are affected, many young men and women are abused and persecuted.”
“At this moment, a terrifying event occurs. All humans are infected into mutated beasts in a very short period of time. Even you were not spared and were suddenly infected.”
“Because of your death, the simulation ends….”
“What’s this….”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, narrowing his eyes, have some speculations in his mind.
“Mr. Wang, how is it?”
Qin Tian asked in a heavy voice.
“We are getting some leads.”
Wang Ping exhaled slowly and said.
This made Qin Tian and the others’ eyes instantly brighter, they looked at Wang Ping with expectation.
In response, Wang Ping quickly shared the content of the simulation.
“Despair…Mr. Wang, do you think this eerie ability is related to human emotions?”
Cai Yonglong stroked his chin and uttered in a deep voice.
“Yes.”
Wang Ping’s eyes twinkled and he nodded seriously.
The Life Simulator has mentioned despair several times throughout. Coupled with the fact that everyone was infected in a short time at the end, it’s evidently an anomaly.
From this, he could infer that this bizarre ability is linked with emotions like despair.
Looking deeper into it, it could probably also involve negative emotions like fear.
“This means, this eeriness increases the intensity of its power by absorbing negative emotions of despair or fear.”
Wang Ping raised a finger and uttered in a heavy tone.
“Likely so. The stronger the despair or fear produced by humans, the stronger the infection power of the virus. So in the end, they infected us all. I must say, this eccentricity is indeed equal to all. Whether it’s an ordinary person or someone as strong as you, Mr. Wang, we were all infected at the same time.”
Cai Yonglong’s pupils shone brightly, murmuring.
“Equality for all beings….” Chen Yao’s expression was a bit subtle.
“Now that we know some of the eccentric abilities, that makes it easier for us. From now on, we just need to keep the humans from despairing so much and we can deal with the eccentricity!”
Qin Tian clenched his fist, exclaiming excitedly.
“No. Knowing that the eccentric ability is related to despair or fear-type negative emotions, and controlling these emotions only prevents the power of the eccentricity from growing rapidly. In fact, the fundamental problem has not been solved.”
Wang Ping glanced at Qin Tian and said.
“If we can’t find out where the eccentric is, or if we use powerful forces, we will still be infected into mutated beasts.”
“So what should we do? I do have things like Array Plates, which don’t require us to use our power, but the impact of those is nowhere near enough to cleanse the surface of the earth.”
Qin Tian was somewhat troubled again.
“No, there is still a way.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Yueying.
Seeing that Wang Ping was looking at Zhang Yueying, everyone else also looked at her with doubt.
Although Zhang Yueying’s Gold Finger could make her immune to all viruses, her own combat strength can be said to be the weakest in the group. It wouldn’t seem like she can help much with the mission, right?
Zhang Yueying herself was a bit baffled and didn’t understand why Wang Ping was looking at her.
“Honestly, despite your gold finger seems pretty ordinary currently and theoretically doesn’t have much developmental potential, at this moment it is the key to breaking the situation.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Yueying while taking out the Bright Divine Bead from his Storage Ring and sighed.
“I also think my Gold Finger is quite ordinary. Been thinking of accumulating group points to exchange for a new Gold Finger… ”
Zhang Yueying admitted, somewhat embarrassed by Wang Ping rating her gold finger as ordinary.
“Wang Ping, what is this?”
Compared to Zhang Yueying’s embarrassment, Qin Tian, Chen Yao, Zhang Jun, and Cai Yonglong were attracted by the Bright Divine Bead in Wang Ping’s hand.
“After all, they are not ordinary people; they can sense that there is a colossal power in this bead.”
The strength of this power is far stronger than theirs.
They guessed that this might already have reached 8-Tier power or more.”
“This is the Bright Divine Bead, formed after I killed the Bright Lord Apollo in Xu Yi’s world by sealing off his power.”
Wang Ping glanced at the crowd and said.
“Uh, the Bright Lord Apollo isn’t he one of the Twelve Olympus Gods in Greek mythology? He actually got killed by Wang Ping. Wang Ping, how strong are you now.”
Qin Tian commented with a strange look on his face.
“Didn’t Xu Yi tell you about what happened in his world?”
Wang Ping saw Qin Tian surprised and raised an eyebrow.
“He didn’t say anything; the guy didn’t mention anything.”
Qin Tian shook his head and replied.
Wang Ping frowned.
The other party didn’t say anything and just talked about his golden finger, he wondered, what was he thinking about? Theoretically, he should be bragging about his powerful new strength in the chat group.
After all, this was equivalent to achieving great success in one go.
Subsequently, Wang Ping recites the events that occurred in Xu Yi’s world.

chapters.title: Chapter 423: 155: Supernova! (10,000-word !)
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: 155: Supernova! (10,000-word !)
Translator: 549690339
“Damn, this guy is so lucky, he actually picked up a head and got Hercules’ power, reaching 7th-Tier Combat Power.”
Cai Yonglong clicked his tongue.
“Mr. Wang, is this Xu Yi’s personality a bit…”
Zhang Jun frowned, noticing something was wrong.
“Indeed, there is a problem. So, I will not focus on training him anymore.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Forget about him, let’s talk about the main issue. You can also guess, the function of this Bright Divine Bead is to allow people to obtain the power of Light Lord Apollo.”
Wang Ping glanced at everyone, and finally looked at Zhang Yueying, and said.
As soon as these words came out, everyone’s minds trembled with envy looking at Zhang Yueying, but they didn’t say much more.
The power of the Bright Lord Apollo was an 8 Tier Battle Power.
Getting this power is like soaring to the sky; she will be stronger than everyone else except Mr. Wang in the chat group.
However, the thing belongs to Wang Ping, whoever Wang Ping gives it to, they will feel envious, but they will not dwell on it.
“Wang, Mr.Wang, this precious thing, do you really want to give it to me?”
Zhang Yueying said a little at a loss.
“Not giving, but selling. You will have to pay it back later.”
Wang Ping shook his head and reminded.
“I know, I will pay it back later.”
Zhang Yueying hurriedly expressed her stance, and said with a full face of expectation.
This powerful force can make her soar to the sky, and she will no longer be the invisible girl in the chat group.
Furthermore, after completing the Group Task this time, she can also exchange for a stronger Golden finger.
This undeniably changed her destiny.
Wang Ping is her benefactor.
“Well, it’s okay if you know. In addition, I’ll talk about the problem of this Bright Divine Bead as well. It’s not as powerful as you imagined. This thing is a one-time use item. The power is consumable. That is to say, every time you use its power, the total amount will decrease until it disappears completely.”
Wang Ping nodded and reminded seriously.
Upon hearing this, Chen Yao and others felt a little more balanced in their hearts; it turned out not to be soaring to the sky but a consumable item. That would be much less attractive to them.
“I see.”
Zhang Yueying was stunned, feeling a little regretful, but also very content.
“Mr. Wang, if it’s a consumable item, can the power of Light Lord Apollo really cleanse the earth’s surface?”
Cai Yonglong pondered for a moment and asked.
“The criteria for 8 Tier battle power is not about consuming all the power to level the entire Eurasian Continent, but to level and even sink the Eurasian Continent in a short period.”
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and slowly spoke.
“That is to say, the 8 Tier battle power can actually cleanse the earth’s surface. It’s just that compared to the 9th Tier battle power, it takes longer and consumes more power.”
“In fact, in my opinion, if it were in a world without mystery, even 7th-Tier combat power, and even six-Tier battle power would be enough to do these things. It’s just that the time they spend will increase accordingly.”
“I see.”
Cai Yonglong nodded, feeling that Wang Ping made a lot of sense.
Even without 8 Tier battle power, they can actually spend a longer time cleansing the surface of the earth.
However, they can’t do that due to the strange existence that has completely restrained them.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much, directly stuffing the Bright Divine Bead into Zhang Yueying’s body and using a Secret Skill to help her absorb this power.
Of course, other measures were also in place.
Various Great Arrays and barriers were all unfolded to prevent the situation here from leaking out.
After Zhang Yueying’s condition stabilized, Wang Ping closed his eyes and prepared to conduct a life simulation again.
“System, I want to proceed with the free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator starts, free simulation begins.”
The system voice sounded again, and the luminescent screen appeared, with the text emerging.
[Day 1, you launched a campaign, with Zhang Yueying taking action to cleanse the earth’s surface. This action was broadcast live worldwide.]
[Zhang Yueying displayed a Terrifying Skill, easily killing 5th Tier mutant beasts, turning them into ashes, with not even a single cell left.]
[This terrifying power shocked all mankind, and many people’s hearts ignited with hope, worshiping Zhang Yueying as a Deity, believing that mankind had hope.]
[At the same time, research found that the continuously strengthening infectivity of the JY Virus seems to have started to slow down. This astonishing discovery made many Research Institutes extremely delighted, thinking that maybe humans can be saved.]
[Next, Zhang Yueying began to cleanse the earth’s surface. Such an act at first shocked many humans, and many humans thought it was good to kill the mutated beasts. But soon, this action caused human panic and even fear.]
[Because they felt that Zhang Yueying was too crazy, her actions were too out of the ordinary. Killing mutant beasts was fine, but it was incomprehensible to level all places outside the Survival Base.]
[When Zhang Yueying killed all the mutant beasts in the ocean, humans became more terrified. Because even the seawater was evaporated, the earth’s ecological environment became a mess. Some experts believed that it might become unsuitable for human habitation in the future.]

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _2
Translator: 549690339
[At this moment, the infection rate of the virus suddenly skyrocketed, turning everyone except Zhang Yueying into mutated beasts.]
“We failed again.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
Humanity’s negative emotions are really free of charge.
Although he is also human, he couldn’t help but admit that the human’s mentality is indeed complicated.
If you are strong enough to give hope to humans, they will be excited. However, if you become too strong and do something beyond their cognition, they will fear you and be wary of you.
“Mr. Wang, did we lose again?”
Seeing Wang Ping say this, Qin Tian’s face became even more solemn.
He thought they had found a way to break the deadlock, but they lost again. What were they supposed to do now?
“Indeed, we lost. However, this time we missed some points. We will make up for it next time.”
Wang Ping nodded and told them about the content of this simulation.
“Human thoughts are really complicated.”
Chen Yao sighed.
“That’s normal. Human thoughts are inherently complex and multifaceted.”
Zhang Jun shrugged his shoulders.
Before crossing over, he was a rich second-generation, with a colorful life and had seen many dark sides.
Of course, he had also seen many shining people.
However, after going through so many things after crossing over, he was already numb to human nature’s good and evil.
“We can try to eliminate humans first before cleaning the surface.”
Zhang Jun spoke again, making a suggestion.
“Mm.” Wang Ping nodded without saying much.
“Zhang Yueying, can you do it? If not, Qin Tian and I can brainwash you.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Yueying and said.
Simulation is simulation. Once it can pass the level, Zhang Yueying will definitely have to do such a thing.
Therefore, Zhang Yueying must be heartless.
Of course, the simulation also needs to be done this way.
“I… can do it.”
Zhang Yueying was very conflicted, but she clenched her teeth.
Although her moral values were upright, now that she knew the mysterious danger and her companions’ lives were at stake, she would naturally make the right choice instead of being overwhelmed by compassion.
Of course, the reason she could force herself to do such a thing was that she was disappointed in the humans in this world and had no good feelings for them.
Otherwise, she would still be somewhat conflicted.
“However, those children are innocent, can I…”
Zhang Yueying seemed to have thought of something and hesitated.
“We can gather them up and protect them first, brainwash them. Then we can take action.”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment and said.
“But if that’s the case, setting up a large array to collectively brainwash or delete memories and cleanse their negative emotions seems to be a better option.”
Chen Yao looked at Qin Tian and asked.
“Qin Tian, can you do this?”
“Yes, I can. However, do we really need to do it? After all, this is too fancy and may attract the attention of the mysterious force.”
Qin Tian said helplessly.
“No need.” Wang Ping said calmly: “You only need to brainwash your current selves, as this is not real but just a glimpse of the future. This way, there won’t be any psychological burden.”
“Alright.” Chen Yao and Zhang Yueying both nodded.
Next, Wang Ping closed his eyes and carried out another free simulation.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and the words appeared on the luminescent screen.
[On the first day, you took action. You ‘brainwashed’ Zhang Yueying, and she displayed her power. She set up controllable power in every survival base and exploded it simultaneously.]
[Since then, the human race has completely disappeared from this world. Then, Zhang Yueying began to clean the surface of the Earth.]
[However, in the process, you were abruptly infected and turned into mutated beasts.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends.]
“What happened?”
Wang Ping looked at the short simulation content, frowning.
This time, they exterminated all humans at once, giving them no chance to provide despair or fear, so why could the mysterious force still strengthen the infection power and instantly infect them into mutated beasts…
It was indeed strange.
“Mr. Wang, did we lose again?”
Cai Yonglong saw Wang Ping frowning and felt uneasy.
Seeing this, the others also became nervous.
“Yes, we lost.”
Wang Ping sighed and told them about the situation.
After hearing it, everyone was silent.
This mysterious force seemed to be too troublesome.
They had all become stronger, but they were still stuck.
It could only be said that the mysterious force was not something that could be dealt with just by becoming stronger.
“What if we underestimated the mysterious force?”
Zhang Jun spoke after pondering.
“Keep in mind that the mysterious force appeared ten years ago. That is to say, it has already collected enough emotions.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed as he understood Zhang Jun’s meaning and said: “You mean, the mysterious force has actually become powerful a long time ago, and the virus is extremely dangerous. However, it didn’t choose to exterminate humanity, but rather continued with sustainable development?”
Zhang Jun nodded and said: “Yes, that’s what I mean. As for the one time it destroyed all humans in the future, I think it had enough and planned to harvest once more before leaving.”

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _3
Translator: 549690339
“If that’s the case, then it makes sense. Those futures where people were infected earlier were all caused by our actions. Our actions attracted the attention of the bizarre creature, which knew that ‘cleaners’ had arrived in this world, so it stopped slowly harvesting victims and instead launched an all-out attack, intending to eliminate us,”
Qin Tian’s eyes brightened as he understood the key point.
“It makes sense.” Cai Yonglong nodded in agreement.
Chen Yao and Zhang Yueying exchanged glances, their eyes sparkling. Both of them weren’t fools and thought the speculation was accurate.
“However, even if we know the principle, it won’t be easy to deal with. If we expose ourselves, we die. If we don’t expose ourselves, it’s hard to eliminate the creature. It already has the initiative,”
Chen Yao frowned and couldn’t help but speak up.
“Very simple. We leave this world and let Zhang Yueying act alone. She is immune to the virus and can kill the bizarre creature.”
Zhang Jun looked at Chen Yao and spoke.
Upon hearing this, Qin Tian and the others’ expressions grew heavy.
Doing so was indeed a solution.
Although they were in the middle of a mission, the chat group now valued the group members’ lives, and it wasn’t impossible to abandon the task.
However, once they left, and Zhang Yueying acted alone, the humans in this world would indeed be infected into mutated beasts.
The entire world would become a mutated beasts’ paradise.
Everyone didn’t care about the scum, but the innocent people, especially the innocent children, were still hard to let go.
“No, it’s useless.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Jun and sighed.
“Why?”
Zhang Jun was stunned, somewhat unable to understand where he had gone wrong.
“We previously overlooked a crucial piece of information. The bizarre creature can also leave this world. The only condition is that it must first destroy all intelligent life,”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and uttered these words.
Wang Ping’s statement left Zhang Jun stunned, and the others fell silent.
To wipe out all intelligent life, this bizarre creature has completely seized the initiative.
If it wants to, it can wipe out all humans in an instant and then leave.
“Zhang Yueying didn’t die, did she? Can the creature leave even if Zhang Yueying is alive?”
Qin Tian seemed to have thought of something and frowned.
“Although we, as group members of the chat group, are considered enemies by the bizarre creature, and killing us seems to bring them considerable benefits, we are not within their original task scope,”
Wang Ping shook his head and explained.
He had just asked Alpha about this, and Alpha gave a conclusive answer.
“This . . .”
Qin Tian fell silent.
“Then what should we do? This doesn’t work, and that doesn’t work either,”
Cai Yonglong said with a bitter smile.
“As things stand, there’s no good solution. Mr. Wang, perhaps you should consider withdrawing for now?”
Zhang Jun sighed and spoke.
“The current situation is that it’s probably impossible for us to solve the problem on our own. To be honest, this is the first time we’ve encountered such an issue,”
Wang Ping’s face was solemn as he spoke slowly.
They had faced various bizarre creatures before and struggled with them, even dying several times in the life simulation.
But, they eventually managed to find a way to clear them all.
However, this creature was different.
It had developed to a certain extent and had completely taken control.
It could be said that it was challenging to deal with.
Or rather, it was challenging for their current selves to deal with their presence.
Unless there were other group members in the chat group whose power has reached the star-breaking tier, capable of obliterating the entire Earth from outer space in one blow. Otherwise, it would be difficult to kill this bizarre creature,
Worse still, if the attack was too slow, and the creature detected any disturbance, it might still escape before being killed even if their power was at the star-breaking tier level.
“Bizarre creatures that have developed are really overpowered.”
Qin Tian grumbled in pain.
“This is just a small shrimp amongst bizarre creatures. In the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, there are definitely no shortage of fully-developed bizarre creatures. Those are the truly terrifying ones,”
Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian and slowly spoke.
At these words, everyone fell silent once again.
“Let Wu Jun come. At this point, we can only hope that his Golden Finger can play a role,”
Wang Ping sighed and spoke.
It was an uncomfortable feeling.
He had never before encountered the Life Simulator being unable to solve a problem, having to rely on a ‘miracle.’
Of course, this referred to not using the worst method to clear the task and only relying on a ‘miracle.’
If they used the worst method to clear the task, Wang Ping still had a 70% chance of successfully eliminating the bizarre creature.
“Only Wu Jun can come now. His Golden Finger is overpowered. If it can trigger a positive possibility, it’s not impossible to kill the bizarre creature.”
Zhang Jun also nodded.
Suddenly, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate and told the group about the bizarre creature.
For a moment, the entire chat group erupted.
After all, it was the first time they had encountered a group task that even Mr. Wang couldn’t solve.
Wu Jun (20): “Mr. Wang, I’m coming. Please, open the passage authority.”
Wang Ping (66): “Fine.”
Wang Ping nodded and opened the passage.
Soon, Wu Jun’s figure appeared before everyone.
“Wu Jun, has your Golden Finger been optimized?”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun and asked.
“No, I’m still 200,000 group points short.”

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _4
Translator: 549690339
Wu Jun scratched his head helplessly and said.
“I’ll lend you 200,000 group points first, optimize the Golden finger, and then we’ll talk about it.”
Wang Ping nodded and sent Wu Jun an exclusive red envelope directly.
This group task cost him and Wu Jun quite a few group points, so they couldn’t afford to let the bizarreness escape.
If that happens, they would lose all their capital.
As a result, they must increase the probability of eliminating the bizarreness.
Under such circumstances, it’s necessary for Wu Jun to optimize the Golden finger first.
“Thanks, Mr.Wang!”
Upon hearing this, Wu Jun got excited.
Then, after accepting the red envelope, he chose to optimize.
Next, he revealed a surprised and excited expression.
“Wu Jun, what’s the ability of your optimized Golden finger?”
Seeing Wu Jun’s excitement, Wang Ping was also a bit expectant and asked curiously.
Chen Yao and others couldn’t help but look over too.
“After optimization, the probability of a positive development has reached 60%. In addition, the probability of realizing my wishes or benefiting me will also increase among these positive possibilities.”
Wu Jun happily explained the ability of his optimized Golden finger.
“That’s totally overpowered.”
Cai Yonglong said enviously.
Wu Jun’s Golden finger, with its uncertainty, is a genuine Conceptual-Tier Ability.
However, due to the full uncertainty, it is often a pitfall.
But, if you can increase the probability of positive development and fulfill your wishes or be beneficial to yourself, the potential will greatly increase, truly becoming a miracle-making Golden finger.
“What about the usage time? Still once every 72 hours? Are the side effects still there?”
Zhang Jun asked.
“The side effects are still there. The usage time is a 72-hour cooldown time.”
Frustration returned to Wu Jun’s face as he listened to Zhang Jun’s question.
Turning into a woman or something like that had always been a concern for him, and he never knew how to deal with it.
“Don’t worry too much about turning into a woman. As long as we can complete the group task and obtain group points, you can optimize it again in the future, and maybe the side effect will disappear.”
Wang Ping patted Wu Jun’s shoulder, comforting him.
“That’s true, but it needs 100 million group points to optimize the Golden finger again. Where can I make up such a huge amount of group points? After all, I need group points for my cultivation too.”
Wu Jun murmured helplessly.
“Alright, stop wasting time and use the Golden finger’s ability. I don’t want to stay in this broken world for even one more minute. If you fail, we might have to run away.”
Qin Tian rolled his eyes and urged.
“No, if the bizarreness doesn’t die, I doubt that even if we run back to our original world, the virus inside our bodies won’t disappear. Over time, the infection rate will increase until it finally explodes.”
Wang Ping looked at Qin Tian and frowned as he spoke.
“When that happens, not only will we have to die, but our world will suffer as well.”
“Uh… ”
Qin Tian fell silent.
Damn it, a common virus wouldn’t have this ability.
But, this is a virus created by the bizarreness.”
F*ck, crossing worlds and exploding is indeed possible.”
“So, this bizarreness must die?”
Qin Tian said with a grim expression.
“Yep.”
Wang Ping nodded, his expression relatively calm.
“Damn, I’m screwed.”
Qin Tian’s face twitched, and he looked completely messed up.
“Mr.Wang, why can you still be so calm?”
Chen Yao asked with some doubts.
Under the current circumstances, even Wang Ping can’t escape; he’s practically on the verge of life and death.
“Mr.Wang doesn’t need to worry about anything. In the end, the worst case scenario is just to destroy the planet.”
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping and exhaled gently.
“It would be somewhat difficult for Wang Ping to do that, but with the remaining time, he can definitely grow to that level.”
“That’s just the worst case scenario. If possible, I don’t want to smash the Earth or flatten the entire world.”
Wang Ping was silent for a moment, then sighed.
If Wu Jun’s ability isn’t enough, then he’ll have to resort to the most brutal method.
Let the other group members leave this world first.
Then, he would receive the cultivation reward for the 7th-Tier Nirvana Realm.
Finally, relying on the terrifying power of the 7th-Tier Nirvana Realm, he would shatter the Earth in one blow, wiping out the bizarreness along with the Earth.
His current cultivation is at the Half-step Life and Death stage, but his foundation is too solid, and his equipment and Cultivation Skills are too extravagant.
There is also the existence of the Domain Embryo.
At present, his rating in the chat group has reached a 9th Tier rating.
If his cultivation jumps from Half-step Life and Death Realm directly to the 7th-Tier Nirvana Realm, he would be gaining a whole Great Realm increase, plus many Small Realm increases.
Wang Ping had no doubt about his ability to shatter stars.
Although it is said that being so powerful, Wang Ping can’t be sure whether he will be instantly infected by the bizarreness when using his power or not.
But he was absolutely confident that he could wipe out the Earth and the bizarreness in an instant.
Even if the virus in his body accelerates its infection due to the use of powerful forces, it doesn’t matter.
Once the bizarreness dies, the virus is likely to disappear.
Even if it doesn’t disappear, it won’t have such terrifying power of infection.
Even if the infection power hasn’t weakened, it doesn’t matter if he dies once. There are still Rebirth Tally resurrection methods available to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 155 Exploding Star! (10,000-word chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Chapter 155 Exploding Star! (10,000-word chapter!)_5
Translator: 549690339
If that doesn’t work, there are other ways.
Anyway, with the Life Simulator around, he has many opportunities to try and fail.
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, Chen Yao, Zhang Jun, Qin Tian, Wu Jun, and the others were all stunned looking at him.
My God, can Mr.Wang really reduce the entire surface to flat ground, even destroy the planet?
That’s ridiculous.
It’s only been a short while, yet Wang Ping has grown to a 10th Tier strength, which doesn’t leave other group members room to breathe.
“Mr.Wang… this is quite disheartening.”
Chen Yao sighed.
“The only thing you lack is the world’s resources. If possible, you can come to my world and collect resources.”
Wang Ping looked at Chen Yao and spoke.
If Chen Yao is in a world that has a high limit and also many resources.
After improving her Golden Finger, she could use various resources, and grow rapidly.
Chen Yao didn’t say a word.
This is easier said than done; the difficulty is still high.
After all, when she crossed over, she stayed there for a few days. Her strength in that world isn’t strong.
“Regarding resources, I can trade group points with you, Mr. Wang.”
After some struggle, Chen Yao selectively said.
“As for resources, I will trade with you as per the situation.”
Wang Ping nodded.
He didn’t cultivate Chen Yao not because he was afraid that she would rapidly surpass him, but simply because his own resources were not enough.
His Life Simulator is also quite a gold digger.
He spent his resources every other while and had to think of various ways to get new resources to support the consumption of the Life Simulator.
Meaning, he himself doesn’t have enough high-level resources, let alone give them to develop others.
“Alright.” Chen Yao nodded without saying much.
“Mr. Wang, you are truly twisted. 10th Tier, oh my God, I doubt if I can achieve this power level even if I become an immortal.”
Qin Tian couldn’t help but mutter.
“10th Tier is nothing. In our world, it doesn’t count as a top powerhouse.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Surely the Nirvana Realm 7th Tier would mark the 10th Tier evaluation, but in the Purple Spirit Realm, there are other realms like King Realm, Emperor Realm, and even Divine Realm.
To put it simply, although the Nirvana Boundary can be regarded as a Master, there’s still a significant gap from the top powerhouse.
Besides, many in the Nirvana Boundary could just explode a star in this sort of ordinary world.
The strengths of different planes are different. The destructive power that the Nirvana Realm can form in the Purple Spirit Realm is, in fact, much smaller than in such an ordinary world.
“Uhh….”
Qin Tian, Zhang Jun, and Chen Yao were all speechless.
After what you’ve said, we don’t know how to respond.
If the 10th Tier doesn’t count, then it’s absurd.
It’s just that the gap between world and world is as remote as the fingertip galaxy.
“Of course, what exactly the standards are for the 11th Tier, I’m not sure. It’s possible that the King and Emperor Realms are also 10th Tier. After all, there’s a difference between planets. Compared with the Sun, Earth is just a small broken ball. The Sun has a volume 1.3 million times that of Earth, but the Sun is just a medium-sized star.”
Wang Ping shook his head, speaking again.
“That’s true.”
Cai Yonglong, and others nodded, thinking that Wang Ping made a lot of sense.
Of course, it’s sensible, but they still couldn’t calm down when they thought about Wang Ping, who had already reached the power level which could break stars at any time.
Shattering stars, even thinking about it is terrifying.
“Alright, enough talk, Wu Jun, let’s start. If possible, I don’t want to gain such a powerful strength prematurely.”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun and spoke.
He still has some things not yet refined. If his cultivation reached the Nirvana Realm 7th Tier, it might get troublesome.
He will not be able to enter the Flaming Fire Secret Realm anymore.
Once he can’t enter the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower has nothing to do with him.
Besides, a chance of getting things like the True King Blood Flower and Enlightenment Soul Grass, has also nothing to do with him, which is something he can’t tolerate.
“I’ll give it a try.”
Wu Jun took a deep breath and nodded seriously.
Then, he directly activated his Golden Finger ability.
As Wu Jun activated his ability, he directly transformed into a woman.
You have to say, Wu Jun himself is handsome, after transforming into a woman, he’s rather good-looking.
Regarding Wu Jun’s transformation into a woman, Wang Ping and the others were used to it, after all, they’ve seen it in the Death Replay.
However, the newbie Zhang Yueying hadn’t seen it, so she was stumped looking at Wu Jun. She never expected Wu Jun’s Golden Finger side effect to be so ridiculous, even making him change from a man to a woman.
“Let me simulate it and see what possibilities you’ve triggered.”
Wang Ping nodded at Wu Jun and then closed his eyes again.
“System, I want to perform a free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator launched, free simulation started.”
The familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[Day one: You all wait patiently. ]
[Day Three: When you find that nothing has happened yet, you become anxious. After all, although Wu Jun’s Golden Finger is optimized, it is still full of uncertainty. You don’t know what possibilities he triggered. ]
[In the end, after an analysis, you all decide to act. Zhang Yueying begins to deal with the 5th Tier Mutant Beasts, making humans hopeful. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 155: Exploding Stars! (Ten Thousand Word Chapter!) _6
Translator: 549690339
[However, Zhang Yueying’s actions alerted Strange, who sensed it. Strange detonated the virus infection early. In the end, countless people were infected and turned into mutated beasts, with only a small number of people surviving. You are among the survivors. The people you protected and the children who didn’t know the situation in the outside world, likewise didn’t become mutated beasts.]
“Huh? The future has changed?”
Wang Ping watched this development, his heart stirring, feeling somewhat pleasantly surprised.
This unusual situation clearly stemmed from Wu Jun’s Golden Finger, otherwise, a butterfly effect like this wouldn’t have occurred.
Not only did they survive, but also some ordinary people.
However, countless humans were still infected; what was the astonishing thing among them?
What kind of possibilities did Wu Jun trigger?
Various guesses appeared in Wang Ping’s mind as the text on the luminescent screen continued to emerge.
[When you discovered that you hadn’t been infected and the children you protected weren’t infected either, you were all very surprised.]
[In the end, you saved some people and conducted analysis, finally drawing a conclusion. Humans without fear wouldn’t get infected.]
[The reason you were infected in the first life simulation was that all human beings suddenly vanished, so deep down you unconsciously felt fearful emotions, leading to your mutation into beasts.]
[In the subsequent simulations, your hearts were filled with fear from the start, and the various acts of destruction allowed the mutated beasts to discover you first. Naturally, the intensity increased, causing you and all humans to be infected and turned into mutated beasts.]
[However, you quickly thought about your current situation. You were also filled with fear before, but you weren’t turned into mutated beasts. This was likely due to Wu Jun.]
[Wu Jun immunized you against Strange’s ability.]
[After drawing this conclusion, you all began to utilize your powers experimentally. The results were pleasing, as none of you were infected and turned into mutated beasts. Using your powers on a large scale didn’t affect you, and there were no signs of infection.]
[This made you overjoyed to the extreme. It meant that, at last, your lives were no longer in danger, and you could hunt mutated beasts.]
[Just as you were about to take action, Strange discovered that Zhang Yueying wouldn’t get infected by it. Afraid, it wanted to flee this world.]
[However, it soon realized that other humans were still alive in this world, which made it extremely furious, and it decided to increase its power output. In the end, even the fear-free children began to mutate into beasts, although the mutation process wasn’t as fast.]
[Among the children, only a little girl was temporarily unaffected. She had a carefree personality, full of hope, and showed no signs of fear, so her infection speed was the slowest, and the virus infection rate was the least rapid.]
[Regarding this, you once again concluded that Strange could enhance its infectivity and knew that it must be killed completely before the child turned into a mutated beast.]
[So, you all took action. Holding the silver-haired little girl, you unleashed your most terrifying skill, not holding back anymore. For the first time, you used such a powerful force on Earth.]
[As you activated your Divine Skills, the sky above the entire Earth’s surface was engulfed by a purple flame in a short time, then fell like a meteor shower. At this moment, Earth turned into a world of Purple Flame.]
[Under your terrifying skill, there was no hiding place on Earth’s surface. Strange was ultimately killed by your terrifying power, and all mutated beasts on Earth were annihilated, so you completed the Group Task.]
[However, although you killed Strange, the virus on Earth didn’t disappear and still existed. It just wasn’t as powerful, but it continued to exist in this world.]
[Regarding this, you sighed in your heart, watching the JY Virus still slowly infecting the little girl; you couldn’t help her. As time went on, she would eventually mutate into a beast.]
[However, there was nothing more you could do. You left her in Zhang Yueying’s care, allowing Zhang Yueying to take her and survive in this world. Then, you chose to return.]
[With your return, this simulation ends.]
“We finally got through this, but at a great cost.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, opened his eyes, exhaled lightly, and said to everyone.
“Well, as long as we pass, it’s all good. Dealing with Strange, enduring some costs is normal.”
Qin Tian, hearing that they had successfully passed, couldn’t help but show an excited expression and muttered.
“A teachable child indeed.” Zhang Jun looked at Qin Tian with an approving, fatherly expression.
” Qin Tian cursed.
“Mr. Wang, did my Golden Finger come into effect?”
Wu Jun asked eagerly.
“Of course it did, and it had a significant effect. Without your Golden Finger, we would all probably have been doomed.”
Wang Ping patted Wu Jun on the shoulder and said.
Strange was dead, but the virus was still present, which was terrifying.
Though the Life Simulator mentioned that the virus’s power had diminished, its existence was a fact.
As a result, there might be a possibility for him to get infected again if he used brute force to clear the stage.
As for others, there was no need to mention.
Therefore, Wu Jun’s Golden Finger really played a crucial role.
This was the incredible aspect of rule-type Golden Fingers; their upper limit was terrifying, providing everyone with a Group Immunity Magic buff.
“That’s good, that’s good.”
Wu Jun scratched his head, chuckled, and nodded happily.
Although he had optimized his Golden Finger, Wu Jun was genuinely worried about triggering a negative or useless possibility, which would have been embarrassing if it had a negative effect.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t waste any more time and directly relayed the simulation content.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Emperor Tower is Ours!
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Emperor Tower is Ours!
Translator: 549690339
After Wang Ping finished explaining the simulation content, Cai Yonglong and the others finally understood why Wang Ping said Wu Jun’s golden finger played a crucial role.
Without his golden finger, the group immunity magic, it’s like having everyone having Zhang Yueying’s golden finger ability, which is quite amazing.
Although they didn’t know if this group immunity virus was permanent, or had a duration, or could only immunize against one type of virus, it was still terrifying.
After all, this was a rule-level immunity virus!
“If I had such a golden finger, I wouldn’t mind becoming a woman for half a year, or even permanently,”
Zhang Jun couldn’t help but mumble.
“Heh, newcomer Ding Xuan has something to say. This pervert would probably love to be a woman.”
Cai Yonglong said with a strange look in his eyes.
Upon hearing this, everyone rolled their eyes.
For a moment, the atmosphere became much more relaxed.
“Mr. Wang, if possible, it would be better not to kill all humans. After all, I can’t leave this world.”
At this time, Zhang Yueying hesitated for a moment and couldn’t help but speak up.
“Don’t worry, we already have a perfect strategy this time.”
Wang Ping smiled and reassured her.
He joked that the difficulty of this simulation had been reduced to a simple level since the strategy was all laid out.
“Carrying hope, so that humans no longer fear… With the power we’ve shown, we can make many people not be afraid, but how strong this effect can be is still unknown. After all, even that carefree faction girl couldn’t escape the fate of being infected.”
Zhang Jun said with a furrowed brow.
“Why not directly use the Great Array to erase the memories of all mankind?”
Qin Tian suggested.
“…That would be better than killing them, but not much better.”
Chen Yao frowned and said.
“I do have a method.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and looked at the rewards list for the paid simulation.
This Blue Talent: Light of Hope had some effect in boosting morale.
However, Wang Ping initially thought that this talent was just that, not having much use. But now it seemed that was not the case.
This talent could produce amazing results in an idealistic world view, like that of Ultraman.
Even in this world, it might have a significant impact, allowing all humans to cherish hope and no longer fear.
After all, the influence of this talent could affect many strong cultivators, let alone ordinary people.
Therefore, if he appeared as a savior and brought the effect of this Blue Talent to the extreme, then perhaps he could help all humans avoid the fate of turning into mutated beasts.
In addition, it could cleanse the souls of the humans in this world.
“Let’s give it a try.”
Wang Ping thought silently in his heart.
Then, he finally made a choice among these rewards.
“System, I choose ②. Blue Talent: Light of Hope and ⑦. King-tier divine skill: Devouring Space,”
As Wang Ping made his choice, many insights emerged in his mind.
He closed his eyes and began to absorb these insights seriously.
Seeing Wang Ping suddenly close his eyes and sitting down to cultivate, the others looked at each other but didn’t disturb him, beginning to set up an array to prevent any abnormalities from being detected here.
In the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed. When the others were getting anxious, Wang Ping finally absorbed all the insights and gained complete control of his newly gained king-tier divine skill: Devouring Space.
King-tier divine skill: Devouring Space was a much stronger king-tier divine skill created by Wang Ping through his combination of space, Five Elements, illusion, and Sword Skill compared to ordinary king-tier divine skills.
“The insights from divine skills and domain embryos are just too much, and absorbing them takes time. The time needed will only get longer in the future. This isn’t suitable for taking such rewards during tasks, as it could lead to accidents,”
Wang Ping thought silently.
Soon after, Wang Ping stopped pondering and opened his eyes after calming his thoughts.
As Wang Ping opened his eyes, everyone looked at him in unison.
Having waited for more than half a month, they were somewhat nervous.
After all, the mutation was going to trigger the virus in the future.
If dragged down to that point, although they could still complete the group task, the entire human race would ultimately be doomed.
Although they didn’t care about the lives of those scum, they would still choose to save the innocent if they could.
In the simulation, their ruthless and cold-hearted actions were a form of self-hypnosis, but if they could avoid it, they didn’t want to brainwash themselves into unfeeling killing machines.
“It’s ready. I’ll use my ability one more time to find out if this method will work,”
Wang Ping nodded at everyone and spoke.
“Whew, that’s good.”
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing Wang Ping’s words.
Cai Yonglong, on the other hand, looked at Wang Ping thoughtfully, guessing that he must have refreshed a certain talent or obtained some secret skill through the Life Simulator.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much and continued to use the free simulation.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The familiar sound of the system rang out again, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the words surfaced.
[Day 1: You launched your operation, took control of the high-ranking humans, and began to preach the teachings of the deity who will descend to save humanity.]

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Imperial Tower is Within Reach! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Imperial Tower is Within Reach! _2
Translator: 549690339
[As the doctrines spread, all of humanity came to know them, and their reactions varied. After it was popularized that the God was coming, you took action.]
[Under the live broadcast to the entire world, you appeared right on time, showing a divine-like radiance, and vanquished a 5th Tier mutant beast in a manner akin to a savior, shocking all of humanity.]
[At this moment, all of humanity believed that the Deity indeed existed and had truly come to save them. As a result, the overwhelmingly desperate majority of humans became zealots, their followers, and hope swelled in their hearts.]
[And with that, the effect of your Blue Talent: Light of Hope was triggered, making the hope in their hearts multiply, filled with light, and without any fear.]
[At the same time, the mysterious entity sensed that something was wrong and started to unleash its abilities, intending to infect all of humanity.]
[However, the majority of humans were no longer afraid, and their faith gave them hope. As a result, the virus’s infectiousness was significantly weakened within their bodies, and there were no major changes. Only those who were secretly skeptical and had no faith or hope were still infected and transformed into mutated beasts.]
[But these people were quickly eliminated by the armies and mutant children that had been prepared beforehand, as well as by individuals like Chen Yao.]
[Under these circumstances, the mysterious entity was utterly terrified and wanted to escape from this world. Although, in theory, it needed to annihilate all of humanity to break free from this world, it could forcefully do so at some cost.]
[The only thing is that the cost was enormous, and the escaping process took time and caused a significant commotion.]
[In the end, It made a desperate gamble and attempted to forcibly escape from this world. A massive pitch-black light pole appeared, piercing through the world’s barrier. ]
[Naturally, you noticed the immense upheaval, and you quickly rushed over. Just as the mysterious entity was about to flee, you decisively struck with your king-tier divine skill: Devouring Space, which directly penetrated the dark light pole and thoroughly obliterated the mysterious entity within.]
[With that, you all completed the Group Task, and you chose to return.]
[As a result of your return, this simulation has ended.]
Seeing the simulation content on the luminescent screen, Wang Ping’s mouth curled up into a satisfied smile.
This was the proper way to clear this stage.
Of course, all this was built on the foundation of his Life Simulator being able to simulate the future and Wu Jun’s Golden Finger triggering favorable possibilities.
Without them, this group task would probably be locked in a deadlock, making it incredibly difficult to clear.
The other group members in the chat would hardly be enough to sacrifice in order to pass this stage.
“It’s just that these mysterious beings are indeed mysterious; the difficulty of dealing with them far surpasses dealing with the Reincarnators or those monsters from the Abyss Lands. There’s no helping it; the tier of their abilities is just too high; they’re impossible to guard against.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
“Mr. Wang, how is it?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s satisfied smile and sigh, Qin Tian and the others couldn’t wait to ask.
At that, Wang Ping smiled and directly recounted the full contents of the simulation.
For a moment, everyone’s faces were filled with delight.
This was a perfect clearance.
Moreover, they had also managed to clean up some human scum along the way; it was truly perfect.
“Well then, let’s start taking action. We can’t afford to delay any longer.”
Cai Yonglong sighed lightly and spoke gravely.
Hearing this, everyone exchanged glances and nodded earnestly.
