Subsequently, everyone went their separate ways, acting according to the plan in the simulated content.
If they could execute the plan perfectly in the simulator, Wang Ping and the others were even more capable of doing so now.
The plan was perfect.
It started with manipulating the human higher-ups and spreading the salvation theories of a descending deity.
Next, a live broadcast of killing a 5th Tier mutant beast.
By doing this, they successfully filled the hearts of the majority of humanity with hope.
Finally, just like what happened in the simulated future, the mysterious entity panicked and chose to forcibly leave after paying the price and taking the time to do so.
“There it is.”
Wang Ping looked at the towering black light pole that shattered space and sneered.
Without the Life Simulator, he wouldn’t even have known about this move by the mysterious entity.
Now that he knew, it would be all the easier to deal with it in the future.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts surged, his entire being was enveloped by spatial fluctuations, and he disappeared, reappearing in an instant at the location of the black light pole.
Then, Wang Ping directly summoned the Quasi-King Tier sword embryo: Phantom Space Sword from within his body.
Rampant Mana was channeled by Wang Ping into the body of the Illusionary Void Sword, which was then cloaked in a layer of resounding Purple Flames, emitting a humming sound.
“Divine Skill: Devouring Space!”
Wang Ping shouted coldly and slashed with his sword, releasing dazzling purple flame sword spirits that twisted under the effect of space, turning into elusive whirlpools that created strange illusions in people – as if space was being burned and devoured.
This feeling was extremely bizarre.
Watching Wang Ping’s terrifying attack, the mysterious entity within the black light pole wore a face full of despair and could not speak.
How could it have imagined that Wang Ping would be immune to its abilities, and that even while channeling his power he wouldn’t be instantly transformed into a monster? Moreover, it had managed to give hope to the entire human race, so they no longer feared, significantly reducing the infection rate.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Imperial Tower is Within Reach! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Imperial Tower is Within Reach! _3
Translator: 549690339
The next moment, Wang Ping’s attack shattered the pitch-black light pole, cutting the strange creature inside into nothingness and completely killing it.
With that, the pitch-black light pole gradually became lighter and finally disappeared.
The space of the earth gradually returned to normal.
However, the various atmospheres and divine powers in the high sky remained for a long time.
If Wang Ping had left it alone, this power could last for thousands of years, turning this area into a forbidden zone for humans and even affecting the earth’s geomagnetic field and ecology.
For this reason, Wang Ping decided to do everything he could to erase this power as well.
Although, the residues of this divine power, if placed in the Purple Spirit Realm, could absolutely become a place of opportunity, helping countless talented individuals to comprehend the atmosphere and even divine power.
Even for many Nirvana Realm cultivators in the Purple Spirit Realm, it would be a great opportunity and aid.
But for this ordinary Earth, it would be a disaster.
Next, after Wang Ping withdrew his Life-bound Sword Artifact: Illusory Void Sword, his figure moved and disappeared, leaving the humans still in shock for a long time, unable to recover.
However, one thing was certain: humanity would become even more fanatic about Wang Ping and identify him as the only true deity in the world!
“Mr. Wang, we have received the notification sound for completing the Group Task!”
Upon Wang Ping’s return, Qin Tian and others excitedly said.
“And the reward for this group task is really generous. Even someone like me who just watched got 500,000 group points as a reward.”
“I also got 500,000.” Cai Yonglong spoke up.
“So did I…” Chen Yao and Zhang Jun said.
“I got a million.” Zhang Yueying said blankly.
“Wu Jun and I are not the targets of the task, so the group points were divided among you. In other words, the total reward for this group task is three million group points.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke.
It had to be said that this strange being was quite troublesome and also worth the price.
Of course, the previous strange beings were also difficult to handle, but the rewards were taken away by Alpha.
“Mr.Wang, I will give you all my one million group points. After all, without you, we wouldn’t have been able to complete the Group Task. Moreover, you lent me such great power.”
Zhang Yueying was the first to express her position.
Hearing Zhang Yueying’s words, Qin Tian and others also responded.
Without Wang Ping’s support in this world, they wouldn’t be able to complete the Group Task, let alone all of them paying for their lives here.
Therefore, they should give their group points to Wang Ping.
“Let’s distribute the points based on our contributions. You all contributed something too. Plus, Wu Jun’s Golden Finger played a significant role. Zhang Yueying, as for me lending you power, that’s a separate matter. You can pay me back with the group points you earn later.”
Wang Ping didn’t have any intention to accept all of them and said so.
“Alright.” Zhang Yueying nodded.
Cai Yonglong and others exchanged glances and sighed in their hearts, thinking that Mr. Wang was indeed Mr. Wang, fair and just.
After some discussions, Wang Ping received a bonus of 1.8 million group points.
Wu Jun got a bonus of 600,000 group points.
Zhang Yueying got a bonus of 200,000 group points due to her role in the simulation.
As for Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and Qin Tian, since they were mostly just watching, they each only received a participation prize of 100,000 group points.
Of course, they deserved the reward for risking their lives in the mission.
Although they were chosen by the system randomly, rules are still rules. The participation prize was supposed to be 200,000 but was reduced to 100,000, which is already a lot less.
This was the result they requested themselves.
“Alright, the Group Task is complete, we should head back. Remember to clear your bodies before leaving, don’t bring the virus to other worlds.”
Wang Ping looked at everyone and reminded.
“Although the group chat has a hidden feature that automatically cleanses the viruses from other worlds unless it’s the strange being’s power, we still need to be careful not to be infected by special items containing the virus.”
“We know that.”
Zhang Jun nodded.
The virus is so terrifying that if it is brought to other worlds, it will be devastating.
Especially in his world where the Zombie Virus already exists, the fusion of another JY virus created by the strange creature would result in some terrifying beings, the thought of which makes one’s scalp numb.
“Then, I’ll go first.”
Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say anything more, choosing to return.
As for the issue of the virus still existing in this world, and that normal people would slowly increase the infection rate as time goes by, he didn’t care at all.
Not to mention, even if he cared, it would be useless.
In any case, trusting in the wisdom of future generations, believing that a great scientist would eventually solve this problem.
When Wang Ping returned to his world, he received two red envelopes again.
One was from Wu Jun, and the other was from Zhang Yueying.
Wu Jun returned Wang Ping’s 200,000 group points.
As for Zhang Yueying, it was a payback as well.
However, Zhang Yueying also knew that 200,000 group points were not enough to pay for the Bright Divine Bead, so she said that she would continue to pay Wang Ping back later.
Wang Ping didn’t mind it either.
Later, the chat group became very lively, with the JY strange creature being a hot topic, causing the group members to marvel at its uniqueness.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 156: Slaying the King Against All Odds! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 156: Slaying the King Against All Odds! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping just glanced at the chat group and had no intention of participating in the discussion.
“Ding, congratulations on obtaining an additional million group points as a reward share.”
At this moment, the chat group page popped up again, and the system’s voice sounded once more.
This made Wang Ping smile slightly and nod in satisfaction.
Extra rewards sure feel great.
This wave directly earned him two million eight hundred thousand group points.
Now, he’s even closer to ten million group points. With just one more strange group task, he can achieve ten million group points and buy the Golden Finger Optimizer using the ten percent off shopping card.
By then, he wonders what changes the Life Simulator will undergo.
“Of course, if possible, it would be better not to have any strange tasks. Such tasks may offer high returns, but they also come with high risks. Even with my Life Simulator, I could still face life-threatening danger.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, thinking to himself.
Anyway, ordinary group tasks can also earn group points, and little by little, they would accumulate.
Not to mention, he can also obtain a share of the rewards when other group members complete tasks.
Even without a new strange group task, he will just be a bit slower in achieving the achievement of accumulating ten million group points.
“Next, let’s continue with the simulation. No one knows what danger I’ll encounter next time, so it’s best to improve my strength as soon as possible.”
After that, Wang Ping closed the chat group page and summoned the Life Simulator.
“System, I want to conduct a paid simulation.”
“Ding, consuming thirty pounds of inferior Spiritual liquid, payment successful. Life Simulator is starting, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on successfully refreshing the Green Talent: Aloof.”
Green Talent: Aloof — With this talent, the host will become extremely aloof, giving others an annoying feeling. But correspondingly, the host’s combat power will be somewhat improved, and their actions and demeanor will become extremely pretentious.
“Uh, this Green Talent is quite something.”
Wang Ping’s eyes carried a strange expression, as he silently judged it.
“Ding, Talent loading successful, Life Simulation starting…..”
At this moment, the system’s voice sounded again, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[Day 1, you chose to go to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and act according to the memories.]
[After joining the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you became a low-key disciple under the Sky Emperor. However, when you consulted the Sky Emperor, you displayed a triple domain prototype and self-created king-level divine skills that stunned him.]
[At the half-step Life and Death stage, having understood the domain embryo, and created king-tier divine skills—this is simply too incredible. Even someone like the Sky Emperor, an Emperor level expert, is dumbfounded and somewhat suspects that you might be the reincarnation of some old monster.]
[However, he can see that your soul and body are integrated, and you haven’t undergone body possession. As a result, he can only sigh at how monstrously talented you are, unparalleled in the past and present. Even those Divine Realm experts who have ascended in their youth were far inferior to you. Perhaps, there might never be anyone to surpass you in the future.]
[After that, you continued to cultivate low-key, seeking enlightenment in various ways, comprehending the three Emperor-level Skills and Divine Skills of the Sky Sacred Land, and immersing yourself in cultivation, intoxicated by the mysteries within.]
[In the blink of an eye, it was time for the Flaming Fire Secret Realm to begin. Although you still hadn’t made any further progress in comprehending the true domain, you still gained a lot of insights and felt confident that you could comprehend the true domain in a few hundred years.]
[Once the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened, you killed all directions, and continued to squat and snatch the inheritance of the Flaming Fire Emperor.]
[Hundreds of years passed in a flash, and you successfully grasped the Domain of the Sword, achieving an accomplishment that many King Realm Masters hadn’t achieved. However, the domain is divided into a minor domain, great completion domain, and perfect domain. There is a vast difference between the different levels of domains. Therefore, you plan to continue seeking enlightenment and progress even further.]
[Nevertheless, you are also very clearly aware that the Purple Spirit Realm was in danger, and began to consider your escape route.]
[Soon after, the two realms intersected, and the Purple Spirit Realm and Blood Demon Realm went to war. You continued to act low-key. This time, you once again told of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s plans in advance, sparing the Profound Turtle from Chu Xiao’s persecution.]
[When the Profound Ice Emperor emerged, waged battle against the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine, and personally guarded the Profound Turtle afterward, even using quasi-immortal means to reinforce the seal to prevent the Jiuyou Demon Emperor from launching a sneak attack.]
[As a result, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could only curse secretly, not knowing why his actions were always known in advance, causing his plans to fail. Now, with the Quasi-Immortal-level Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan personally guarding, he simply did not have the strength to kill the Profound Turtle and release the demonized Guilt-Punishing Emperor alone.]
[In the end, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor could only continue to lie low and wait for an opportunity. He did not have the idea of seeking cooperation with the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine right now. The Blood Demons were not easy to deal with, and cooperating with them under unequal strength would be very dangerous. As a cautious living traverser, he did not like to act recklessly.]
[Subsequently, the two realms continued to wage war, accumulating strength, and waiting for the final decisive battle in the future. During this time, you also participated in the war, seeking death, raising a storm for the improvement of strength, and causing a fierce internal competition among the talented individuals of the two realms.]

chapters.title: Chapter 433: 156: Slaying the King Against All Odds! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: 156: Slaying the King Against All Odds! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _5
Translator: 549690339
[However, this time, in order to protect yourself from being ambushed by the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Emperor, you specially sought help from Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and got her incarnation to guard you. Besides that, your Master Sky Emperor, knowing that the Purple Spirit Realm lacks high-end combat strength, puts aside his important duties and personally protects you.]
[Be it Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan or the various emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm, they all value you highly and regard you as the key figure in the war between the two realms. Maybe you can lead the Purple Spirit Realm like the protagonist of the era ten thousand years ago to victory. So, naturally, they don’t want anything to happen to you.]
[However, even with so many backup plans, you still don’t trust that you can be safe. After all, these backup plans can only come into play when the opponents have their own monsters attacking you. If you pursue a breakthrough at the limit and fail and die, no one can save you.]
[During the following trials, you have encountered all kinds of dangers and experienced many life and death crises. Sky Emperor couldn’t help but want to take action multiple times, but he restrained himself.]
[In the end, Blue Talent: Light of Hope played a significant role in helping you break through your limits and successfully upgrade your cultivation to the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier.]
[It can be said that the progress of your cultivation has really shocked many old monsters. You reached the Great Perfection Nirvana Realm cultivation at not even twelve hundred years old, which has already shattered records.]
[In the records of the Purple Spirit Realm, the fastest cultivator reached this level of cultivation at the age of fifteen hundred. But you, you advanced the record by three hundred years, which is astonishing.]
[However, when many old monsters thought of your crazy practice of seeking breakthroughs in the extreme, they could only sigh that it would be strange if you hadn’t broken the record.]
[After all, if it were another Nirvana Realm Master practicing like you, they would have died countless times. In fact, even with your various trump cards, you were still close to actually dying. Ordinary people can’t learn and don’t dare to learn from such practice methods.]
[Next, when you were preparing to skip the Quasi-King tier, aiming to break through to the King Realm, an accident happened. Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine knew that continuing like this wasn’t an option. Your existence poses a serious threat to the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Therefore, after discussing with the Various Emperors of Blood Demon Realm, and under the guidance and instigation of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, a full-scale war broke out. With the full-scale war unfolding, the entire Purple Spirit Realm became chaotic. And you, you no longer have peaceful time to attack the King Realm.]
[After all, it is not that simple to break through from the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection to the King Realm, as seclusion breakthrough takes dozens or even hundreds of years.]
[After the outbreak of the war, you were targeted by the Blood Demon Realm’s King Realm Master. To this, you showed no fear and fought him coldly. In the end, you actually killed the King Realm Master with your Great Perfection Nirvana Realm cultivation, shocking the powerhouses of both realms.]
[Whether it was the powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm or the Blood Demon Realm, none of them expected you to be this strong. Not only did you kill the Blood Demon realm’s Kings with the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection cultivation, but it seemed effortless, not receiving any significant damage.]
[This has greatly boosted the morale of the Purple Spirit Realm. However, it also made the kings and emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm sigh secretly, feeling that they had given you too little time. If you had a few hundred or a thousand more years to cultivate, perhaps you could have fully grown up.]
[While on the Blood Demon Realm’s side, their killing intent towards you has reached its peak, trying various ways to assassinate you. However, this time you were cautious not to act alone. The various emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm kept a close watch on the Blood Demon Realm’s emperors, locating all of them to prevent any possibility of assassinating you.]
[However, the emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm could only do their best. After all, the number of strong individuals in the Blood Demon Realm is greater than that of the Purple Spirit Realm, and before the full-scale war, they were good at preventing strong people from assassinating you. But after the full-scale war, this method’s usefulness decreased significantly.]
[You are well aware of this, and with a calm heart, you plan to seize the opportunity to retreat into the Blood Demon Realm to cultivate. After all, the most dangerous place is also the safest place. As for your thoughts, your Master Sky Emperor is extremely supportive and admiring.]
[With your ability to hide your aura, it would be difficult for the emperor to find you unless he observed you from a close distance. Therefore, even if there are guarded quasi-emperors in the Blood Demon Realm, you can rest assured.]
[As long as you don’t fall, even if the Purple Spirit Realm eventually loses and the living beings of the Purple Spirit Realm are enslaved by the Blood Demon Realm, there is still hope for a comeback. When you have grown up completely, you will be able to save the living beings of the Purple Spirit Realm and conquer the Blood Demon Realm in return, exacting revenge.]
[However, your plan is very good but you have overlooked one person. To be more precise, you have not overlooked, but have always been on guard against Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. He incited this full-scale war and had also schemed and cooperated safely with the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Therefore, he had been waiting for you all this time. Soon, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao found the right opportunity and appeared before you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 434: 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: 156: Slaying the King in Reverse! The Emperor Tower is Ours! _6
Translator: 549690339
[After the appearance of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he quickly discovered your identity as a transmigrator, which greatly shocked and angered him. He originally cooperated with the Quasi-Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm to kill you, but he didn’t expect that you were also a transmigrator, and it was very likely that you were related to the Transmigrator Chat Group.]
[Otherwise, you would not have deliberately hidden your aura. This was completely aimed at preventing him from finding you. For this reason, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao changed his mind and planned to capture you alive.]
[At this point, you feel heavily burdened and activate a strand of Incarnation of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, hoping to block Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and buy yourself some time to escape.]
[However, it is impossible for even a Quasi-Immortal like Ji Bingyan to suppress someone as powerful as Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao with just a single Incarnation. After all, he already possesses Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation and is not far from becoming a Quasi-Immortal.]
[Even Ji Bingyan, who possesses Quasi-Immortal Cultivation, might not be able to hold back a well-prepared Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, let alone a single Incarnation trying to defeat him.]
[Seeing that the situation is unfavorable, you directly hide inside the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower. In response, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao coldly tells you to give up resisting and let him brand you as his slave, and he will spare your life. Otherwise, even the Emperor-tier weapon cannot stop him, and you know this very well.]
[You remain silent, quietly waiting, hoping for Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan or other Emperors to come to your aid. Although you know that the chance is slim, you have no intention of giving up.]
[However, your wait is obviously in vain. Both the all-out war and the actions of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao are well calculated. The Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and other Emperors are all occupied by powerful opponents from the Blood Demon Realm, and although they are aware of your predicament, they can only deal with the enemies before them without any distractions, let alone come to protect you.]
[In the end, you realize that the power of Ji Bingyan’s Incarnation is rapidly weakening, you sigh helplessly and choose to willingly die within the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
“This is really difficult.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content with a wry smile.
This time, with experience, he still takes risks to improve his cultivation, but his fate is slightly better than before. He reaches the Great Perfection of Nirvana Realm, kills the King of Blood Demon Realm forcefully, but still dies in the end. Both Ji Bingyan, the Quasi-Immortal of the Purple Spirit Realm, and other Emperors can’t protect him.
There’s no choice. He’s facing formidable enemies on the outside and a terrifying demonic figure within, so it’s extremely difficult to stay alive in such conditions.
“However, just don’t let me catch any opportunities. Otherwise, I will enslave you and ruin your cultivation base.”
Wang Ping exhales gently, sneering.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’, is truly a huge calamity that must be removed at all costs.
“Alpha, does killing this guy grant me any Group points?”
Wang Ping asks quietly in his heart.
“Yes, and a lot of them.” Alpha’s emotionless voice answers.
“Great, now I have one more reason to kill him.”
Wang Ping clenches his fists.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s vision flickers, and he finds himself in an unfamiliar place.
From a god’s-eye view, he witnesses the battle between Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and the Incarnation of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.
No doubt, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan is truly powerful. A single Incarnation possesses the strength to contend with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who has Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation.
However, an Incarnation is just an Incarnation after all, and its power rapidly declines over time. It is far from being an opponent for a real Emperor Realm Great Perfection powerhouse, let alone an exceptional one like Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
Ultimately, it is defeated.
Then, the scene of a helpless, simulated Wang Ping committing suicide appears.
Wang Ping sighs in his heart, taking a deep look at the cold face of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao before his vision returned to the real world.
Immediately after, the system prompt sound rings out in a timely manner.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host, you may choose one reward from the following options:
Great Perfection Nirvana Realm Cultivation.
Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.
Sword Domain (Minor Achievement)
Divine Skill Comprehension Insights.
Learned Secret Skills.
Any one Emperor-Level Skill learned from Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
Any one Emperor-Level Divine Skill learned from Heavenly Sword Divine Land.
Flaming Fire Emperor Inheritance Technique and Divine Skills.
Enlightenment Soul Grass.
True King Blood Flower.”
“Holy sh*t!”
Wang Ping stares at the rewards from this simulation, completely dumbfounded.
At last, the Emperor-tier weapon he has been dreaming of appears in the reward list, which is exhilarating!
“The Flaming Fire Emperor Tower is definitely a must-pick. As for the other items, I can take my time with Domains and Divine Skills, so there’s no need to hurry. Now that my cultivation progress is bottlenecked, I shouldn’t stay stuck for too long. In that case, I’ll get all the benefits from the Flaming Fire Secret Realm and then refresh the rewards from Heavenly Sword Divine Land. This will allow me to improve my cultivation.”
Wang Ping scans the reward list, pondering in his heart.
Of course, Wang Ping also has a more audacious idea in mind.
For example, he could join other Holy Lands and obtain the techniques and Divine Skills from their inheritances as well.
In this way, he would have access to all the inheritances of the various Holy Lands in the Purple Spirit Realm.
By that time, he could use the advantages of these inherited techniques and Divine Skills to create his own Divine Skills and improve his techniques, widening his path even further.
“The feasibility, is high.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkle with anticipation.
“However, once I do this, I definitely won’t be able to choose the cultivation upgrade option in the short term. As a result, I will constantly be stuck in the midst of a decisive battle between the two realms. It seems a bit too risky.”
After all, being stuck at the Half-Step Life and Death Stage Cultivation for a long time would make it difficult when encountering danger in the future.
Moreover, acquiring large amounts of Lower-tier Spiritual Fluid to support his simulations is also a complicated task.
It is better to first upgrade his cultivation, and once he reaches the Emperor-tier Full Circle Tier or even the Quasi-Immortal Tier, he will be granted access to various Holy Lands for their techniques and Divine Skills. At that point, he can absorb all the knowledge in one go and refresh the rewards without having to go through so much trouble right now.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King!
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King!
Translator: 549690339
Next, Wang Ping chose the reward, and the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower appeared directly in his Sea of Consciousness, faintly radiating an imperial aura.
This made Wang Ping reveal a satisfied smile.
Now that he had the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, he didn’t know how powerful it would become if his cultivation reached the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier.
Perhaps, even against those powerful kings, he could put up a fight.
As an imperial artifact, the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower was indeed powerful and could serve as his current trump card.
Afterwards, Wang Ping studied the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower for a while and continued the simulation.
However, in the next few simulations, there were no high-level talents refreshed.
Besides that, the content of the simulations was mostly similar, and he eventually met his demise by the hands of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao or through accidents.
After all, the entire Purple Spirit Realm was in chaos, and unless he didn’t join the Holy Land and hid somewhere, he could only live a few hundred years longer.
But such a living was meaningless, as his cultivation wouldn’t improve, his Tao Heart wouldn’t be firm, and he would still eventually die.
So, in every simulation, Wang Ping went all out, but the results were tragic.
“The rewards I should have gotten are almost all covered. Now, I should conduct the final simulation and refresh the Cultivation Reward.” Wang Ping thought, flashing a glint in his eye.
In many previous simulations, Wang Ping had already obtained the inheritance from all the Cultivation Skills, Divine Skills, Secret Skills, as well as the Flaming Fire Emperor’s Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills.
Additionally, he had also acquired the Enlightenment Soul Grass and chose to receive it.
As for the True King Blood Flower, he didn’t manage to acquire it.
Although it was a pity, Wang Ping wasn’t too concerned.
Even though the item was precious, it was ultimately formed after a king’s fall.
Once his cultivation reached the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier, with his configuration, he could defeat kings beyond his level.
At that time, obtaining such resources would only take a little time and effort.
With that in mind, there was nothing to be regretful about.
Furthermore, because the understanding of domains and divine skills could be obtained at any time in the future and weren’t limited to one power, he didn’t choose them temporarily, planning to consider them later.
“System, I want to conduct a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he looked at the last bit of Lower-tier Spiritual Fluid and began the final simulation.
“Ding, consuming thirty pounds of inferior Spiritual Fluid, launching Life Simulator, refreshing talent…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on refreshing the Green Talent – Stick Dao Genius.”
Green Talent – Stick Dao Genius: The host will have a decent talent in the path of the stick.
“Is it another ordinary talent? Looks like my luck is really used up.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talent and shook his head in disappointment.
He originally thought that since there were no powerful talents in his previous simulations, there should be a rebound, and a Red Talent would appear in the last wave of simulations. However, it seemed like he had overestimated his luck.
“Nevermind, my main purpose is to refresh the Cultivation Reward, and talents are secondary.”
Wang Ping could only comfort himself like this.
“Ding, talent successfully loaded, life simulation beginning…”
At this moment, the system’s voice sounded again, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged as well.
[On the first day, you chose to go to Heavenly Sword Divine Land…]
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years passed. You kept a low profile to the extreme, never showing off. This time, you didn’t even choose to enter the Flaming Fire Secret Realm, leaving your Master Emperor of Kongtian helpless.]
[Due to this, Ye Chen finally got his chance to shine, displaying the grace of the Son of Fortune. As for you, you continued to act low-key.]
[Another few hundred years passed, and the Blood Demon Realm invaded. You still had no intention of participating in the war, allowing Ye Chen to gain all the attention.]
[When you successfully comprehended the Domain of the Sword, Five Elements Domain, and Space Domain, Ye Chen had a furious battle with the Demon Emperor’s Child, both considering each other as mortal enemies. Afterwards, the Quasi-Immortal battle erupted, and even after the conflict, ordinary battles still continued. Throughout all this, you remained indifferent and chose to act low-key.]
[However, since your cultivation had reached the Nirvana Realm, you knew very well that continuing to hide would be detrimental to your cultivation. Therefore, you found your master, the Sky Emperor, and applied to enter the forbidden grounds of the Primordial Sacred Land to temper yourself.]
[Your request surprised and hesitated the Sky Emperor, as the forbidden grounds of the Primordial Sacred Land were not open to outsiders, and were much more dangerous than the outer world’s wars. One wrong move, and you would fall here.]
[Nonetheless, the Sky Emperor couldn’t dissuade you and took you to the Primordial Sacred Land, hoping that it would allow you to enter the forbidden grounds for trials.]
[In the Primordial Sacred Land, you displayed your true strength, shocking even the Emperor of the Sacred Land, who didn’t expect you to be the strongest hidden monster, with your strength far surpassing Ye Chen and the Quasi-Immortal Child.]

chapters.title: Chapter 436: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _2
Translator: 549690339
[Regarding this, the Emperor of the Primordial Sacred Land was very conflicted about whether to allow you to enter the Holy Land. In the end, he considered the current situation not good and needed geniuses like you to grow quickly, so he opened the forbidden land for you.]
[However, he warned you that the origin of the Primordial Forbidden Land was a mystery even to the Primordial Sacred Land over these tens of thousands of years, and it was very strange and dangerous. Even an Emperor may fall within with the slightest carelessness.]
[You’ve already learned about the Primordial Forbidden Land and were not afraid at all, so you chose to enter it. Upon seeing this, the Emperor of the Primordial Sacred Land did not try to persuade you further but simply gave you some instructions before letting you in.]
[When you entered the Primordial Forbidden Land, you found that the entire space was filled with a faint black mist. This mist scorched your flesh and mana, invaded your divine soul, and caused you unbearable pain.]
[You were prepared for this and planned to achieve the perfect Nirvana, putting yourself in the Land of Death before being reborn. To this end, you gradually moved deeper into the land.]
[As you were risking your life to temper yourself, some major events were also happening in the outer world.]
[Ye Chen had once again found an opportunity, which was also an Emperor’s Legacy. However, this legacy was even more powerful than the Flaming Fire Emperor’s Legacy. It was from the mysterious Emperor who had already achieved the Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation a myriad of years ago, controlled the top-ranked Exotic Fire: Ancient Azure Dragon Flame and fought alone against two Emperor Realm Great Perfection Blood Demon powerhouses.]
[After entering the land of inheritance, Ye Chen finally learned the real name of the mysterious Emperor known to the outside world as the Ashy Flame Emperor, whose name was Chi Cang.]
“Chi Cang!? Chi Clan?”
Wang Ping was shocked when he saw this simulation content.
The Bloodline Curse of the Chi Clan is extremely terrifying. Even with his current cultivation, Wang Ping still shudders when recalling the feeling from before, which shows that the curse is not something he could deal with.
Although not described in the Life Simulator, even with the simulated Wang Ping’s ability and background, he was still unable to deal with it.
This shows that the origin of this curse is much more terrifying than he could ever imagine.
Now, he finally found some clues.
A myriad of years ago, that mysterious and powerful cultivator who achieved Emperor Realm Great Perfection was a Chi…
Although it could be a coincidence, if the Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang really was the Ancestor of the Chi Clan, then the Chi Clan’s origin would be astonishing, equally being descendants of the Emperor.
“On the small Profound Turtle, there are so many extraordinary people with exceptional backgrounds; I don’t know what else to say.”
Wang Ping’s expression was nuanced, and he sighed.
Bai Tianhong, the descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune.
Chi Clan, also having an extraordinary background, possibly being the descendants of the Ashy Flame Emperor.
Wang Ping suspected that Xia Yuan’s background might also reveal some extraordinary things if investigated.
This is quite possible, as many followers or related people of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor had fled to the back of Profound Turtle when it all happened.
“No, that’s not right…”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows, noticing some inconsistencies.
According to the information he knew, the Ashy Flame Emperor had suddenly joined the battle a myriad of years ago, and before that, there was no news of him in the entire Purple Spirit Realm.
After the Great War, the Ashy Flame Emperor did not fall, although he was not unscathed, but his injuries were not so severe as to make him perish.
If the Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang truly was the Chi Clan Ancestor… why was the Chi Clan cursed?
What kind of existence could curse the bloodline of a powerful Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivator?
Besides, what was the reason for the Chi Clan never coming out to the world?
And, what was the reason for the sudden disappearance of the Chi Clan?
Various anomalies flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and a chill surged in his heart, feeling as if he had touched upon a shocking secret.
This secret was one that even Emperors were not qualified to touch upon.
“If the Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang is indeed the Ancestor of the Chi Clan… then I can’t help but suspect… that the Chi Clan may be connected to the Upper Realm…”
Wang Ping made such a conjecture after a moment of silence.
Only those terrifying Masters from the Upper Realm could plant such a curse.
Continuing to speculate, if the Chi Clan originated from the Upper Realm, then did they come to the Lower Realm to avoid something?
Apart from that, is the destruction of the future Purple Spirit Realm related to the Chi Clan?
“No, that’s not right. The timeline doesn’t match.”
Wang Ping frowned again, shaking his head to reject his own guess.
The possibility of the Chi Clan seeking refuge in the Lower Realm might exist.
However, the future destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm might not be related to the Chi Clan.
Because the Chi Clan had already disappeared…
“Sigh, even with clues, the mystery just grew even more complicated.”
Wang Ping’s mood was quite nuanced, and he could only sigh.
“Next simulation, try to find the Ashy Flame Emperor’s inheritance land and see if I can get more clues.”
Wang Ping silently thought in his heart as he continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[You tempered yourself in the Primordial Sacred Land’s Forbidden Land, experiencing life and death many times. However, you were full of hope and never gave up on surviving. In the end, you endured it and successfully cultivated to the Great Perfection Tier of the Nirvana Boundary.]
[Nevertheless, even though your cultivation reached the Great Perfection Tier of the Nirvana Boundary, you still had no plans to leave and wanted to use this opportunity to advance further, planning to go out only after becoming a king.]

chapters.title: Chapter 437: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _3
Translator: 549690339
[Therefore, you decided to go deeper into the Forbidden Land. However, this decision put you in great danger.]
[Because the faint black fog suddenly became thicker, engulfing you instantly and turning you into nothingness. Due to the Rebirth Tally, you were resurrected. After your resurrection, you immediately summoned the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and hid inside, scared to the extreme.]
[This bizarre fog has the effect of honing the essence and spirit, but when it becomes too thick, it’ll be terrifying. However, this area should be considered relatively safe. The fog suddenly becoming thicker is completely abnormal.]
[As for this, all you could do is sigh. The Forbidden Land is the Forbidden Land, a place that cannot be explained by common sense. Even the ‘safe zones’ marked by the Primordial Sacred Land, who have studied the Forbidden Land for so many years, may also have abnormal situations.]
[Next, when you tried to move towards the outer area using the power of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, you discovered a shocking thing – the tower showed signs of corrosion. Its spirituality rapidly declined, showing a tendency to drop down to the ordinary level.]
[This scene gave you goosebumps, and you wanted to escape quickly, but it was already too late. The black fog directly ruined the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and surged inside. You could only watch in despair as the bizarre black fog enveloped you.]
[However, just before your death, you felt that this black fog seemed familiar. But you no longer had the chance to ponder, quickly engulfed by the black fog and turned into nothingness.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ended…]
“What the hell is this?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his eyelids twitching.
Although the Forbidden Land of the Primordial Sacred Land, as the first sacred area, must have huge secrets, it was too dangerous. Without even going deep inside, just being in the outer area had brought great terror, something even the Emperor Tower couldn’t withstand.
No wonder the Emperors of the Primordial Sacred Land said that even an Emperor could fall if they went deep inside.
This Forbidden Land indeed has such a terrifying power.
“But, what’s the deal with the familiarity at the end?”
The doubt flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision changed, appearing in a dark space.
From a god’s point of view, Wang Ping saw that the simulated Wang Ping was turned into nothingness by the suddenly appearing black fog.
With Wang Ping’s death, the fog that had become much thicker once again became lighter, as if nothing had happened.
Then, as Wang Ping resurrected and summoned the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to hide within, the black fog thickened again, seemingly sentient as it surrounded the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and began corroding its flame barrier and itself.
“This feeling…”
Wang Ping watched the black fog, feeling that his scalp was about to become numb, and a chill ran up his spine from the soles of his feet.
This feeling was unmistakable, and it was very similar to the black energy he had seen when the Purple Spirit Realm was destroyed through a god’s point of view. It had a similar aura.
However, this black fog was much weaker than the residual black energy at that time.
“It can’t be that the hidden secret within the Primordial Forbidden Land is the source of the destruction in the Purple Spirit Realm. What kind of great terror exists in there?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, his thoughts filled with extreme fear.
He had originally guessed that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao had released something bizarre which destroyed the Purple Spirit Realm.
Now it seems that it has little to do with the two of them.
The real source of the disaster might be deep within the Primordial Forbidden Land.
“This is outrageous… The Purple Spirit Realm, this broken world, really isn’t a place for humans.”
Wang Ping was somewhat annoyed and couldn’t help but complain.
It was only because he had the Life Simulator that he could survive.
Otherwise, if any other ransmigrators replaced him, with such a beginning, they might really be dead for good.
There are simply too many traps.
Especially the continuous big pits that appeared in more than a thousand years, which really gave people goosebumps.
‘Lethal Profound Turtle Spirit’
Predecessor Ransmigrators who want your life at any time, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
The invasion of the Blood Demon Realm.
The sealed strangeness.
And then, the hidden source of disaster in the Primordial Forbidden Land that destroyed the Purple Spirit Realm.
Oh, if other ransmigrators had his start, they might not even be able to find the Delivery Array and would be trapped to death on the back of the Profound Turtle.
Wang Ping crazily complained in his heart, feeling somewhat exhausted.
Then, he had no intention of continuing to watch. With a flicker of his thoughts, he chose to return.
In an instant, Wang Ping’s vision returned to normal, and he returned to the real world.
Soon after, the system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
Great Perfection Nirvana Realm Cultivation.
Green Talent – Stick Dao Genius.
Minor Sword Domain
Minor Five Elements Domain
Minor Space Domain
Divine skill Epiphany.
Skill Epiphany.”
“This reward list has finally become simpler.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list, heaving a sigh and then made a choice.
“System, I choose ①. Great Perfection Nirvana Realm Cultivation and ④. Minor Five Elements Domain.”
After some thought, Wang Ping made his choice.
The Five Elements Domain was like a buy one, get four deal, so it was worth choosing.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: 157: Leap through two Great Realms! The power of the king!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: 157: Leap through two Great Realms! The power of the king!_4
Translator: 549690339
As for the other things, choose slowly later. No need to fuss about it.
With Wang Ping receiving the reward, he entered a remarkable state of cultivation, feeling his cultivation ferociously soaring.
Life and Death Realm.
Half-step Nirvana Realm.
1st Tier Nirvana Realm.
Nirvana Realm 7th Tier.
Finally, Nirvana Realm Great Perfection.
This was all done quietly and without any fuss.
Quietly, Wang Ping’s cultivation level passed two significant realms and many lesser stages, reaching directly to the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection level.
You could say he had made an exaggerated leap.
This is thanks to the Life Simulator System concealing his activity. If any commotion had slipped out, it would probably shake the entire Black Element Country and scare all its Nirvana Realm Masters to death.
“Jumping so many realms at once, this kind of feeling is really pleasing to both body and mind. Moreover, this method of leveling up doesn’t have any side effects, it increases cultivation while offering insights into each realm. Truly remarkable.”
Wang Ping opened his eyes, saying this with a sense of emotion.
“However, time is becoming increasingly worthless. Before, receiving a boost in cultivation meant an immediate increase. Now, I need to spend a lot of time absorbing the insights. In a blink of an eye, it’s been half a month already.”
Wang Ping recognized the changes in time, feeling somewhat melancholic.
Before Wang Ping could calm down, another burst of insights poured into his mind.
It was, astonishingly, an understanding of the Five Elements Domain.
Regarding this, Wang Ping could only collect his thoughts again and continue absorbing this knowledge.
It can be said he’s reaping the benefits of other people’s work.
Just as Wang Ping was absorbing these insights, the Black Element Country also noticed the anomaly in Black Light Valley.
Many Masters of the Black Element Country naturally knew about the formidable Master hiding in the Black Light Valley.
In fact, a Nirvana Realm Master from the Black Element Country once ventured deep into the valley only to be repulsed.
That incident shook the Black Element Country.
After all, many people had witnessed that battle and knew that the powerful being in Black Light Valley was just a Half-step Nirvana Realm.
A Half-step Nirvana Realm being was able to fight against a Nirvana Realm Master and repel it. It was undeniably terrifying.
For this reason, some speculated that this being was an old monster that survived a reincarnation, and its cultivation in its previous life must have been exceptionally terrifying.
As a result, no one dared to disturb this fearful being in Black Light Valley anymore, fearing any fallout might bring disaster to their own forces.
Fast forward to today, the various forces of the Black Element Country could no longer sit still.
Because no abnormalities had been detected around Black Light Valley for a long while, and the power of its Array Mana seemed to be weaker than before.
This seemed to tell everyone one thing.
The terrifying being of Black Light Valley appeared to have encountered a problem.
Considering the being’s cultivation level, appearance and approximate age, it would be normal for it to have passed away.
For the Great Sects of the Black Element Country and even the Nirvana Realm Masters, this was an incredibly tempting scenario.
After all, this powerful being’s previous life could have been a Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier, or even a powerful being of Quasi-King Tier.
If such a being passes on, would it leave any strong legacy?
If it does leave a legacy, the value contained within could drive all Nirvana Realm Masters into madness.
Therefore, the various forces of the Black Element Country acted on the news and started gathering around Black Light Valley.
Those of the Life and Death Realm, rarely seen in the Black Element Country, began to appear in groups, and their numbers reached the dozens.
As for the Nirvana Realm Masters, six emerged.
It can be said that all the forces of the Black Element Country, except for a small number of Masters stationed at their base, had come.
“Hehe, everyone, don’t you think there are too many people here?”
Above the sky, standing on a Golden Battle Chariot and overlooking the monks on the ground and in the sky, he sneered.
He was the Ancestor of the Zhao Family of the Black Element Kingdom.
The Zhao Family of the Black Element Country is the most powerful family in the country, with two Nirvana Realm Masters at its helm, its influence is only second to the Black Yuan Nation Court.
Once these words were spoken, many monks’ expressions changed drastically as they nervously gazed upon one another.
Among them, the more experienced individuals didn’t hesitate to retreat immediately.
“Hehe, I also feel that there are too many people here. In my opinion, forces without a Nirvana Realm Master have no qualifications to compete for this legacy. What do you all think?”
Then, another Nirvana Realm Master spoke.
“Hehe, little guys, leave quickly. This isn’t a place for you to make a fuss. Otherwise, you might be endangering your lives.”
Another Nirvana Realm Master spoke. He was kind and benevolent in appearance, giving people a very warm feeling, but his words were ice cold.
“That’s not quite right. Everyone has the right to compete for this opportunity. It’s not a bad idea to let them stay.”
A very plump Nirvana Realm Master was drinking wine and belching.
“Hmph, fat monk, when did you become so kind-hearted? It wouldn’t be because you want to use these little guys as cannon fodder, right?”
The Nirvana Realm Master of the Black Yuan Nation Royal Family also spoke then.
Everyone knew about the dealings of this pretentious monk. He had offended several major nations and was the most cunning of them all.
But this guy was very tricky, his escape technique was terrific, so it was challenging for the Nirvana Realm Masters of other countries to kill him.
And this guy had caused trouble in the Black Yuan Nation not long ago, so the two Nirvana Realm Masters naturally disliked him.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: 157: Jumping Two Great Realms! The Might of the King! _5
Translator: 549690339
“Ah, this monk had a kind heart, only to be so slandered. How sad.”
Listening to the words of the Nirvana Realm Master from the Black Yuan Nation Royal Family, the fat monk sighed and looked depressed.
Down below, many cultivators who heard the conversation between the Nirvana Realm Masters knew that staying here would bring more harm than good, so they started to retreat one by one.
Although the chance was tempting, they had to see whether they had the fortune to grab it.
Without the cultivation of the Nirvana Boundary, or the presence of a Nirvana Realm Master, staying here would only mean death.
Of course, there were some unwilling Life and Death Realm Masters who did not really leave but watched from a distance, hoping to find an opportunity to seize something.
“Everyone, let’s just take action directly. Although this Great Array is ingenious, now that Black Light Taoist is dead, without his control, we can easily break it.”
At this moment, the Nirvana Realm Master of the Zhao family spoke again.
“Hmph, even if he were alive, what could he do? With all of us working together, even if he had already broken through to the Nirvana Boundary, we could still capture him.”
A Nirvana Realm Master coldly snorted.
Hearing this, the other Nirvana Realm Masters all secretly despised him in their hearts.
You only dared to say this after he had passed away, don’t forget who was the one beaten and fled, losing the face of a Nirvana Realm Master.
If the other party had not passed away but had broken through to the Nirvana Boundary, all of them together would still not be enough for the other party to kill.
However, despite their contempt, the Nirvana Realm Masters present didn’t continue to waste time talking. One by one, they showed their powerful strength of Nirvana Boundary cultivation and fiercely bombarded the Great Array, causing it to cover and tremble crazily above Black Light Valley.
This made Wang Ping’s eyelids twitch and his brows furrowed.
However, Wang Ping didn’t open his eyes. He continued to seek Enlightenment, feeling the mysteries of the Five Elements Domain.
While Wang Ping continued his Enlightenment, the Nirvana Realm Masters in the outer world increased their efforts, fiercely bombarding the Great Array from above.
As they all took action, the Great Array eventually could no longer hold and began to crack.
Then, the scene of the Black Light Valley appeared in the eyes of many Masters.
Their Spiritual Sense discovered Wang Ping first.
At the same time, they also found a tombstone, which belonged to the white-haired Old Man.
“Hehe, he really passed away.”
The Nirvana Realm Master who had been repelled by the white-haired Old Man once said with schadenfreude.
“However, it seems that we are one step too late. Someone has already obtained his inheritance.”
The Nirvana Realm Master of the Zhao family narrowed his eyes, looking at Wang Ping, trying to see through his reality.
However, Wang Ping’s cultivation was above his. Additionally, Wang Ping had the Red Talent: Breath Concealment, so even Ancestor Zhao of the Zhao Family, who was only a small Nirvana Realm Master, couldn’t see through him. Even if a Quasi-Emperor were to come, they still wouldn’t be able to see through Wang Ping’s details.
Because he couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s reality, he furrowed his brows, unsure of Wang Ping’s identity and cultivation level.
“Hehe, even if he got the inheritance, we can make him spit it out. I, the monk, have a Heavenly Secrets Secret Skill that can see through people’s ages. Although I don’t know what kind of Secret Skill this kid has cultivated to hide his cultivation, making me unable to see through him, his age is only over 20, less than 30. With this age, cultivation can’t be very high.”
The fat monk showed a sinister smile and laughed.
“If nothing unexpected has happened, he should be the lucky one who broke into the Black Light Valley, was taken as a disciple by the Black Light Taoist, and obtained his inheritance. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have set up a tombstone for that old man and practiced here.”
“So, we should consider how to divide this inheritance.”
Other Nirvana Realm Masters, upon hearing the fat monk’s words, were moved, thinking it made sense, and their eyes became fiery.
“This kid…”
Although the two great Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Yuan Nation were also tempted, they didn’t act recklessly. Instead, they frowned and sensed that something was wrong.
Since Wang Ping had obtained the inheritance of Black Light Taoist, it was impossible for the Black Light Taoist not to let him leave before he passed away, or leave some backup plan.
After all, he had lived two lifetimes, and in his previous life, he was likely a big shot at the Quasi-King level.
Would such a big shot not think about the fact that once he passed away, the Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Yuan Nation would not be able to sit still?
Obviously, the chances were slim.
For this reason, it seemed too strange for this young man to sit and practice calmly here, even when the Great Array was broken, and his face remained unchanged, continuing to practice with composure.
They couldn’t help suspecting that there was some conspiracy behind this.They couldn’t help but suspect that the Black Light Taoist had set up a trap, waiting for them to jump in and die.
Thinking of this, the two Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Yuan Nation’s Royal Family became extremely uneasy, and not only did they retreat, but they also led other Masters from their court to retreat.
This made the other Masters puzzled, but since their ancestors told them to retreat, they naturally didn’t dare to object and could only follow.
“When did you two old fellows from the Black Yuan Nation become so timid? The opportunity is right in front of you, yet you don’t dare to fight for it.”
Seeing this, the fat monk sneered.
Naturally, he could also see some issues.
However, he was highly skilled and bold, fearing nothing.
It didn’t matter if the Black Light Taoist was dead or not. Even if he was alive, he couldn’t do anything to him with his extremely strong Secret Skill of escape technique.
“Since the two fellow taoists have given up this opportunity, let’s just evenly split it among ourselves.”
Ancestor Zhao from the Zhao Family also took the opportunity to speak.
The remaining two Nirvana Realm Masters also laughed, as they agreed.
Having two fewer competitors was naturally a good thing.
Especially when these two competitors belonged to the same power, the strongest power in the Black Yuan Nation, nothing would be better.
The two Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Yuan Nation’s Royal Family didn’t say anything more, just kept staring at Wang Ping intently, ready to take their people and flee the moment anything abnormal happened.
It was at this moment that the four Nirvana Realm Masters led by the fat monk moved. They exerted their Nirvana Skill and grabbed Wang Ping, intending to capture him alive, perform soul-searching, and obtain the inheritance of the Black Light Taoist.
It was just when the four Great Nirvana Realm Masters made their move that a Domain suddenly opened up, enveloping the entire Black Light Valley.
The Domain displayed five colors.
Gold, wood, water, fire, and earth.
The moment the Domain opened, all the cultivators present were like ordinary people trapped in a quagmire, unable to move. Struggling would only make them feel suffocated.
For a moment, everyone’s face stiffened, showing a look of horror.
“This, this is a Domain Embryo!?”
For the first time, the fat monk lost his previous composure and wildness, his face filled with shock and terror.
“No, no, this is a Domain! A Minor Domain!”
As somebody who had traveled the Eastern Desolation and caused chaos in many places, the fat monk had naturally seen kings in action and had witnessed some of them opening a Domain Embryo.
However, even the Domain Embryo exhibited by that King was not as powerful as the one he was feeling right now.
That is to say, this was not a Domain Embryo, but a true Domain, a Minor Domain.
Moreover, it was not a single attribute Domain but a Five Elements Domain!
Upon realizing this, the fat monk’s mind went blank, his face turning deathly pale, with only one thought in his mind.
It’s over.
A person who could possess a Minor Domain was definitely a King, and not just an ordinary King.
He had actually wanted to capture a King alive and perform soul-searching on him. Ridiculous, truly ridiculous.
Other Nirvana Realm Masters and Masters of the Life and Death Realm were not fools either. They also guessed the existence of a Domain Embryo, but when they heard the fat monk reveal the truth about the Domain, their minds went blank as well, knowing that they were finished.
Even the two Nirvana Realm Masters from the Black Yuan Nation’s Royal Family had pale faces and felt regret in their hearts.
Although he hadn’t attacked before, he had also joined forces to strike the Great Array. Attacking a King was disrespectful and would undoubtedly lead to death.
Even the Heavenly Sword Divine Land wouldn’t say much about it.
Although the Heavenly Sword Divine Land protected the various kingdoms, if you offended a powerful person and were killed, they wouldn’t say much about it either.
“Senior, please spare me, I didn’t know Senior was in closed-door cultivation here…”
A Nirvana Realm Master who had been repelled by the Black Light Taoist earlier revealed a bitter face, wanting to beg for mercy.
However, he had barely opened his mouth when the Five Elements Domain suddenly brightened, and flames surged, burning him directly to ashes. He died without a full body, and even his Nirvana Skill couldn’t make him reborn through Nirvana.
He had completely fallen.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)
Translator: 549690339
Witnessing a Nirvana Realm Master of the same level as them being burnt to ashes in an instant, the other five Nirvana Realm Masters on the scene all felt a chill in their hearts.
As for those Life and Death Realm Masters and the Yin and Yang Masters, they felt even colder, filled with utter despair.
Even a Nirvana Realm Master was crushed like an ant, let alone them.
“Sigh….”
The two Nirvana Realm masters of the Black Element Country could not find words to express their feelings, they only secretly sighed.
They could only quietly wait for this senior to open his eyes and pronounce their fate, since pleading would only accelerate their death.
However, the two Nirvana Ancestors thought of the fat monk’s previous words, and through a secret skill, they observed that the young man in front of them was only in his twenties.
“A sovereign in his twenties? Are you joking?”
The two Nirvana Realm Masters both shook their heads.
They were certain that the fat monk must have been mistaken in his observation.
Indeed, it’s unlikely for someone in the Nirvana Realm to discern the background of a sovereign who has gained a domain.
Not only were the two Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Element Country thinking this, but even the fat monk had some doubts over whether he had made a wrong judgment.
However, all that was secondary. The most critical issue was how to escape.
He was well aware that staying here would undoubtedly lead to certain death.
“Damn it, though doing this would set my thousands of years of cultivation back, as long as I can survive, I can always possess a descendant and live a second life.”
The fat monk’s eyes flashed ruthlessly, and he immediately executed a secret skill.
In a split second, his body caught fire and ignited a terrifying skill, enveloping his Divine Soul with the intent to escape from here.
“Think you can escape? Can you?”
Wang Ping opened his eyes, his gaze icy cold, his expression ruthless, sentencing the fat monk to death.
In a snap, the domain began to shrink, the oppressive force became even more terrifying, wrapping up the Divine Soul of the fleeing fat monk, crushing it directly, and making him completely fall.
Everyone else who witnessed this scene fell into utter despair.
Having two Nirvana Realm Masters crushed successively indicated that their chances of escape were nil.
“I can give you a chance to live.”
Wang Ping scanned the many realm masters present, his gaze finally resting on the two Nirvana Realm ancestors of the Black Yuan Nation Royal Family before he spoke indifferently.
“Senior, please speak up. If it’s something within my abilities, I’ll certainly do my best,” the Nirvana Realm Ancestor of the Zhao family hurriedly declared.
“Did I ask you to speak?”
At Wang Ping’s cold huff, cracks appeared on the body of the Zhao family’s Nirvana Realm Ancestor. He spat out a large mouthful of blood, his face as pale as paper, and he dared not interrupt again.
He harbored not the slightest goodwill for the Nirvana Realm Ancestors who had tried to strike him.
If they didn’t have any more value to extract, he would have killed them all already.
Previously killing two was merely a warning to others.
“Senior, please go ahead.”
The two Nirvana Realm Ancestors of the Black Element Country exchanged a look, feeling that Wang Ping was addressing them. They cautiously responded.
“Since you didn’t lay a hand on me just now, I can spare your lives. However, if you want me to forgive and forget, bring me a lot of resources. Especially, mid-tier Spiritual fluid and top-tier primal fluid,” Wang Ping said calmly.
After consulting with the Life Simulator system, he discovered that for the subsequent simulation, only mid and top-tier primal fluids were needed, thus eliminating lower-tier Spiritual fluid as a consumable resource.
Top-tier primal fluid was usually unobtainable by regular powers. Only those powers supervised by Nirvana Realm Masters had the privilege of owning some.
“If the senior needs mid and top-tier primal fluids, we will certainly go all out to procure them for you,” the two Nirvana Realm Ancestors of the Black Element Country responded, albeit reluctantly.
For them, top-tier primal fluids were also extremely precious resources. But since this senior asked for them, they could only dig deep and empty their coffers.
If they didn’t, their adversary could completely ransack the Imperial City to get them.
Even if he did rob them, they wouldn’t dare to say anything.
The wrath of a Sovereign was not something everyone could bear.
Still, the two Nirvana Realm Ancestors of the Black Element Country were somewhat puzzled.
For a Sovereign, mid and top-tier primal fluids should no longer have much effect in aiding cultivation. They did not understand why this sovereign needed such items.
Despite their confusion, they only dared to ponder over it in their hearts and did not dare to question him.
“Ok.”
Wang Ping gave a nod and no longer paid attention to the two Nirvana Realm Ancestors of the Black Element Country.
He still looked upon the two Nirvana Realm Ancestors of the Black Element Country favorably.
Although he didn’t know if the Nirvana Ancestor in the simulation was one of them, it didn’t matter.
The Black Element Country had treated the simulated Wang Ping quite well in the Life Simulator, so he would not be too harsh on them.
Then Wang Ping shifted his gaze to the Ancestor of the Zhao family and the remaining Nirvana Realm Master.
“Senior, I can also provide primal fluid,” said the Ancestor of the Zhao family with caution.
“Let me plant a slave mark on you, and you may live. Resist, and you die,” Wang Ping declared coldly.
“This….”
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, fear, anger and shock overwhelmed the Ancestor of the Zhao family.
As a Nirvana Realm Master, when had he ever experienced such humiliation?
If a slave mark was planted on him, he would have to serve Wang Ping for life and couldn’t resist him.
Moreover, the Zhao family would become vassals of Wang Ping.
This was too high a price to pay.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_2
Translator: 549690339
However, Ancestor Zhao of the Zhao family quickly regained his composure and fell silent.
If he were to perish and the stronger members of the Zhao family perished as well, then the Zhao family would be finished.
At that point, numerous jackals would definitely pounce on the Zhao family for a bite.
A falling wall is pushed by everyone; this is an unchanging truth in the World of cultivators.
The Zhao family has offended many powerful forces and strong cultivators, but they were only silent and kept their anger hidden because they feared the strength of the Zhao family.
“I am willing to serve the senior.”
Ancestor Zhao of the Zhao family said bitterly.
“I am also willing to serve the senior.”
Another Nirvana Realm Master had a bitter expression on his face and chose to survive meekly.
They are high and mighty in their daily lives, enjoying the world’s prosperity, and are unwilling to perish like this.
“Since you are willing to be loyal to me, I can spare your lives.”
Wang Ping remained expressionless and indifferently spoke.
As his cultivation improved, he would no longer be able to join the Holy Land.
Since he was unable to join the Holy Land, he would have to take the other path of subduing some forces to serve him, which was a necessary thing to do.
Moreover, Wang Ping had another idea: to establish his own sect and even Holy Land.
In this way, it would be more convenient to do anything in the future.
Of course, Wang Ping was not in a hurry to do this.
Without having the Emperor tier fighting power and ensuring his survival in the face of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, Wang Ping did not intend to act ostentatiously.
Otherwise, exposing himself would be no different from seeking death.
He needed to establish power to help him handle some trivial matters and collect resources for the cultivation of the group members in the chat group, to continually enhance his prestige. However, doing these things without the ability to save his life would only put him in danger and not be worth it.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much and directly used a Secret Skill to plant slave marks in the Sea of Consciousness of Ancestor Zhao of the Zhao family, another Nirvana Realm Master, and many other cultivators.
This Secret Skill came from the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, and even Kings couldn’t break it.
Wang Ping had no worries about them betraying him.
Witnessing all of this, the Black Element Country’s ancestor was very grateful that he was not planted with a slave mark but was also very puzzled as to why Wang Ping was so friendly to them.
Seeing the Black Element Country ancestor’s confusion, Wang Ping had no intention of explaining. Instead, he carefully made all the cultivators present swear on their Martial Enlightenment Heart that they would never disclose the events that happened today.
Moreover, Wang Ping still didn’t feel reassured, only thoroughly letting his guard down after using a Secret Skill to plant restrictions in their Sea of Consciousness.
Soon, the Black Light Valley became quiet again, and Wang Ping headed to the Zhao family, intending to live there for some time.
Black Light Valley had become a land of trouble and was no longer a suitable place to stay.
Wang Ping was not afraid that those seeking opportunities would pose a threat to him, but he was afraid that after taking action, too many things would be exposed, attracting the attention of the major Holy Lands or the Jiuyou Demon Sect. In that case, it would be troublesome.
“The harvest this time is not bad, a total of 1000 Jin of Mid-tier Spiritual fluid and 10 Jin of top-tier primal fluid. In addition, Black Element Country’s compensation has not yet arrived. When their compensation arrives, it is estimated that it will double.”
Wang Ping showed a satisfied smile after checking his harvest.
Although after reaching the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier, he now needed 500 Jin of medium-tier spirit liquid or 5 Jin of top-tier primal fluid for each simulation, which was shockingly expensive, these gains could only allow him to simulate a few times, but he was already satisfied.
After all, Mid-tier Spiritual fluid is very valuable, and many Life and Death Realm strong cultivators do not have the right to own it.
As for top-tier primal fluid, it goes without saying that even ordinary Nirvana Realm Masters cannot get too much of it.
The Nirvana Realm Masters of the Black Element Country were relatively ordinary, and their cultivation was not high. The highest cultivation among them was only around the 4th or 5th Tier of the Nirvana Realm.
With this level of cultivation, they obviously couldn’t get too much top-tier primal fluid.
So, including the resources that the Black Element Country has not yet sent, the resources Wang Ping obtained could allow him to simulate seven or eight times, which is already quite good.
“It can only be said that outside of the Holy Land, there are only poor ghosts.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh again.
The Purple Spirit Realm is also very insular and monopolistic.
The Holy Land is high above, commanding a territory, and most of the vital resource veins are controlled by the Holy Land. The other forces are just subsidiary forces that rely on the Holy Land for survival. They are lucky to sip some leftovers.
Under such circumstances, it is really difficult to find any valuable resource veins in the outer world.
Thus, although Wang Ping complained that these people were poor, he had no intention of despising them.
“Next, let’s take a look at the situation in the chat group. After all, a lot of time has passed while I was absorbing and comprehending.”
Wang Ping sorted out his harvest and then opened the chat group.
After that, Wang Ping discovered that there were significant changes in the chat group.
Firstly, new types of Group Tasks have appeared in the chat group.
You can go to other Unknown Worlds to complete group tasks and are no longer limited to the worlds where the group members have traveled.
Moreover, they have even made contact with members of other Myriad Heavens Forces.
These were Myriad Heavens Forces that were allies.
Among them, what made Wang Ping’s feelings subtle was the existence of other chat groups.

chapters.title: Chapter 442: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_3
Translator: 549690339
However, that chat group was quite unique; it wasn’t merely for human transmigrators like the Transmigrator Chat Group but was mostly composed of animals cultivating into demons.
During the completion of a task, Chen Yao formed a friendship with a panda calling itself Tuanzi.
Although it’s uncertain if they will ever have a chance to meet again.
Due to the changes in Group Tasks, they are exposed to more worlds, and the strength of group members like Chen Yao has greatly improved.
Perhaps it’s because Chen Yao accumulated enough group points to optimize her system; Wang Ping, using the acting group master’s permissions, checked her strength evaluation and found that her power had already reached an eight-star level, which was quite impressive.
Of course, compared to him, she still had a long way to go.
Moreover, Zhang Jun chose to spend group points to redraw his Golden Finger.
This time, he had some good luck and got a Golden Finger that allowed him to become stronger by killing others, which boosted his strength considerably to the Seven-Star Tier.
It can be said that the Zombie World was gradually developing a crude civilization due to the presence of Zhang Jun and Chen Kang, and all the zombies were slaughtered.
Following this trend, all those high-level zombies would likely end up as nourishment for Zhang Jun’s growth.
As for this, Wang Ping had no particular thoughts and was just happy for Zhang Jun’s growth.
For those zombies, even though they gained intelligence, they were still zombies after all; it wasn’t a pity if they died.
However, what really annoyed Wang Ping and made him speechless was Xu Yi.
This guy was truly dark-hearted; even though there was a live broadcast in the chat group, he still wanted to forcibly take more shares.
As a result, no one in the group approached him except for initially being keen on having their resources multiplied to see if it was possible.
Moreover, during the group tasks, many people were not interested in joining forces with him, as he had terrible character and gave no sense of security.
“A good hand indeed was played poorly.”
Wang Ping was speechless and despised Xu Yi from the bottom of his heart.
This guy was too greedy.
If he had developed his business normally, he could definitely be the backbone of the chat group, and could become a top-level expert with the aid of resources alone.
However, this guy was full of greed, ruining his reputation and credibility.
This outcome meant that no one would approach him in the future, and even if he encountered danger during mandatory tasks, the group members might not necessarily risk helping him.
Once he really dies, no one would revive him.
“Such a waste of a good Golden Finger by someone who lacks brains.”
Wang Ping shook his head and gave up on him altogether.
If Xu Yi died, he wouldn’t bother reviving him.
The only pity was the Golden Finger.
However, this Golden Finger wasn’t a necessity or irreplaceable, so he didn’t care much about it.
“I’m still short of one million group points? It looks like, after enduring another month or two, I can accumulate enough group points to optimize my Life Simulator.”
Wang Ping checked his group points again, and after seeing that it had reached almost nine million, he nodded with satisfaction.
He wondered what changes would occur after optimizing the Life Simulator this time.
Perhaps, it could increase the probability of refreshing high-level talents.
By then, talents above Red Talent might appear.
Besides, it might also further reduce resource consumption, which would be good as well.
Anyway, it was worth looking forward to.
“For now, let’s do a simulation.”
After closing the chat group page, Wang Ping stroked his chin and started to think.
Although waiting until the optimization of the Golden Finger to do the simulation would certainly make more sense, there was still a month or two left, and not simulating to understand the changes in the future made him uneasy.
After all, since his cultivation had improved so much this time, going to the Holy Land was impossible, so he had to take the loose cultivator path.
Also, going to the Holy Land no longer had any meaning for him, as he had already obtained the most precious inheritance there.
