“I still have to do a simulation. After all, with my current strength and various cultivation skills and secret skills, obtaining the Primordial Liquid is not difficult.”
Wang Ping made up his mind and decided to go for the paid simulation.
As for free simulation, he was already accustomed to the luxury rewards of the paid simulation, so he had no interest in the free ones.
Free simulations were only used to fill the gaps in group tasks.
Using a free simulation now would be truly depressing if there were any accidents or major breakthroughs in the simulation but no rewards could be refreshed.
“System, I want to spend 500 Jin of medium-tier Spiritual liquid to start the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping said inwardly.
“Ding, the consumption is successful. The Life Simulator is starting, Talent refresh underway… ”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent-Blood Demon Body Transformation; Green Talent-Business Genius.”
Red Talent-Blood Demon Body Transformation: With this talent, you will possess a shocking Demonic Talent, becoming extremely cruel, and can slaughter many powerful cultivators to refine the powerful Blood Demon Body, thus becoming a member of the Blood Demon Clan.
Green Talent-Business Genius: With this talent, your abilities in business will become exceptionally strong.
“It seems that my accumulated luck hasn’t been wasted over this period of time, and I finally refreshed another Red Talent… However, this Red Talent seems to be one of those Demonic Talents with huge side effects, and it’s also related to Blood Demons.”

chapters.title: Chapter 443: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping stared at the talent, his eyes flickering with uncertainty.
Talents with side effects often exceeded their grades to some extent.
He wondered what changes would happen in the upcoming simulation content after gaining this talent.
Maybe this time he would join the side of the Blood Demon Realm and become a so-called Purple Spirit Scoundrel?
Wang Ping’s mood was subtle.
“If the memory-carried simulated Wang Ping has this talent and still joins the Blood Demon side… The Purple Spirit Realm would be completely unplayable.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“Well, it’s just a simulation, no need to care too much. Gleaning intelligence and resources are more important, let’s make a choice first. System, I choose the Red Talent: Blood Demon Incarnation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he made his choice.
“Ding, talent-loading successful, life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the familiar luminescent screen appeared, with words emerging on it-
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate in the Zhao Family and began secretly planning to enslave numerous masters, making them serve you and become your future reserve blood food.]
[In a blink of an eye, eighty years passed, and you covertly enslaved thousands of Nirvana Realm Masters, including one quasi-King tier powerhouse. Since you were cautious and didn’t commit consecutive crimes in the same domain, no one noticed your actions.]
[In the blink of an eye, another twenty years passed, and you broke through to the King Realm, finally becoming a true king.]
“This is really easy.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and smiled slightly.
It wasn’t surprising that he would break through to the King Realm so easily with his current setup.
It could be said that he would have an easy time until the Quasi-Emperor Realm.
Only when he tried to reach the Emperor Realm would he likely encounter some difficulties, as not even the Quasi-Emperor might be able to hold him back for long.
[At the outbreak of the Hundred Dynasties War, you witnessed the battle between Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, and Ji Bingyue. Although you very much wanted to enslave both of them, considering their uniqueness, you eventually suppressed that thought and didn’t act.]
[In the blink of an eye, several hundred years passed, and the Flaming Fire Secret Realm opened. Due to your excessively strong cultivation, you didn’t enter it but continued to focus on your own affairs. By now, your cultivation had reached the 4th tier of the King Realm, and you had mastered the Domain of the sword and Space Domain, making you much more powerful than before.]
[In addition, the number of powerful cultivators you covertly enslaved had become even more astonishing, including two King-tier powerhouses.]
[In the blink of an eye, several hundred more years passed, and your cultivation improved to the 7th-Tier King Realm, entering the late stage of the King Realm. Simultaneously, your Domain comprehension progressed, successfully realizing the triple Great Completion Domain, and your strength soared once more, becoming peerless in battle.]
[However, you still acted low-key without revealing your powerful strength, waiting for the start of the war between the two realms.]
[Soon after, the Purple Spirit Realm was invaded by the Blood Demon Realm. Sensing that the time was ripe, you summoned the enslaved cultivators and directly devoured them, transforming them into members of the Blood Demon Clan. In the process, your cultivation surged and soared directly to the 9th tier of the King Realm, not far from the Perfect Completion of King Realm.]
[Compared to you, who had already reached the 9th tier of the King Realm, both the Son of Fortune, Ye Chen, and the Quasi-Divine Child of the Blood Demon Realm seemed laughable.]
“Well, I knew that the progress of my cultivation on the King’s Mirror would be easy, but isn’t this too easy?”
Wang Ping was truly surprised as he looked at the simulated content.
Within just a thousand years, he had directly jumped from Nirvana Realm Great Perfection to the 9th Tier King Realm, which was outrageous.
With this rate of cultivation progress… wouldn’t he really become an emperor in a short time?
Once he became an emperor, the world would be so vast that he could go anywhere.
“All I can say is that the terrifying potential accumulated from all those previous perfect breakthroughs is just too horrifying. Once past the special realms of the Life and Death Realm and Nirvana Boundary, no longer restricted, the true cultivation speed explodes.”
Wang Ping’s eyes brightened, and he reflected on it.
Indeed, the emperor who left a record in the Emperor Tower back then was only at the Life and Death Realm in cultivation.
Afterward, he became an emperor in just five or six thousand years.
This showed that the subsequent cultivation might not necessarily become slower and slower.
In the Nirvana Boundary, if you dared to fight and gamble, you could soar from the 1st Tier Nirvana Realm to Nirvana Realm Great Perfection within a hundred years, making your talent even stronger and your foundation even more terrifying.
For example, Wang Ping broke through in the forbidden area.
Of course, such a method was too crazy. Many people who tried this would die halfway.
In the King Realm, the cultivation speed was not slow either, as if it were the time of potential explosion.
Perhaps only when reaching the Emperor tier level would it become difficult again.
This was because there were too few resources to help emperors cultivate in this world.
Of course, the above situation only applied to Wang Ping and those future emperors like him, while ordinary King Realm cultivators might still struggle to slowly improve their cultivation, as their potential had already been exhausted and it would be difficult to continue advancing.
“Now that I am at the 9th tier of the King Realm, I wonder what level of cultivation the simulated Wang Ping will reach in the following simulation.”
Wang Ping thought silently and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As your cultivation progresses, you become extremely confident, believing that you are unmatched among Kings because your configuration is too luxurious. Upon reaching the 9th tier of the King Realm, you can already perfectly exert the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower’s power. In addition, the power of the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire has been perfectly controlled by you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 444: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_5
Translator: 549690339
[With so many methods at your disposal, even against masters at the quasi-emperor tier, you have confidence in your ability to fight, not to mention other kings.]
[However, although you are confident, you don’t plan to immediately join the Blood Demon Clan. This is because the Blood Demon Clan is extremely cruel, and although you have now become a Blood Demon, your background is unknown, so they may not accept you.]
[Of course, you don’t plan to join the Blood Demon Clan now. Your transformation into a Blood Demon is only to become stronger and enter the Blood Demon Realm with this identity.]
[The Purple Spirit Realm is doomed to be destroyed. If you don’t leave this place as soon as possible, it’s undoubtedly a path to death. Although even if you flee to the Blood Demon Realm, it’s not certain that you’d remain unharmed, but at least the survival rate is higher than staying in the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[For this reason, you have no interest in the great war between the two realms. While the two realms are fighting fiercely, you manage to slip into the Blood Demon Realm without incident.]
[Your actions are not discovered by the Blood Demon Clan Emperor. Blood Demon Realm’s Emperor can’t possibly guard the channel between the Two Realms during the most intense battles, as that would be a waste of combat power.]
[After all, the channel has a large array set by the Quasi-Immortal Demon Emperor that only the Blood Demon Clan can enter and exit. Therefore, leaving a Quasi-Emperor to preside over the array is sufficient. As long as it’s not perfect ones in the Emperor Realm Great Perfection trying to barge in, they can be stopped and allow the masters of the Blood Demon Realm to react.]
“It’s not so simple after all.”
Wang Ping watches the simulation content, his eyes flickering.
Previously, Wang Ping wanted to sneak into the Blood Demon Realm, but even reaching the King Realm or Emperor Realm wasn’t enough.
It was because of the unique Wang Ping that had the Blood Demon Talent that he could transform himself into a Blood Demon and successfully escape to the Blood Demon Realm’s lair.
[After arriving in the Blood Demon Realm, you truly understand what kind of place the Blood Demon Realm is. The Blood Demon Realm, like the Purple Spirit Realm, is not a special lower plane or a Blood Demon Exclusive Plane.]
[This plane also has various races, but with the rise of the Blood Demons, all other races have become slaves and blood food for the Blood Demons. Humans are also one of these ethnic groups.]
[Regarding this, you don’t feel anything about it. Because you are now a Blood Demon and your character has become extremely cruel.]
[You roam around the Blood Demon Realm, and after making sure there were absolutely no risks, you ambush one of the Quasi-Immortal’s king’s descendants and subdue him.]
[Then, using cruel methods, you extract some profound Blood Demon Secret Skills from him. After that, you use these Blood Demon Secret Skills to hunt and devour other Blood Demons and Living Beings, strengthening yourself.]
[However, you don’t just blindly devour and accept everything. You only refine and absorb the most essence, without affecting your own foundation.]
[Relying on this method, within a short 50 years, you have broken through to the Perfect Completion tier of the King Realm. However, because your actions were too high-profile, you attracted the attention of many powerful Blood Demons in the Blood Demon Realm, which enraged them.]
[Although Blood Demons are cruel and ruthless, during the great war between the two realms, they are particularly united. Especially after the previous defeat, everyone knows the consequences of losing the great war. The great defeat from ten thousand years ago almost shook the Blood Demon Clan’s ruling position in the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Now, there is actually a Blood Demon who, during the great war between the two realms, doesn’t participate in the battle but instead takes advantage of the time when most top masters are involved in the war, slaughtering their fellow clansmen in the Blood Demon Realm. It is too despicable.]
[For this reason, the Blood Demon Clan Emperor, who stayed in the Blood Demon Realm, issued a Wanted Warrant for you in anger, wanting to find and kill you to eliminate future trouble.]
[Because of the rich rewards, the entire Blood Demon Realm has become restless. Not only are the masters of the Blood Demon Clan pursuing you, but the kings of the affiliated ethnic groups are also pursuing you.]
[You don’t worry about this, and start guerrilla warfare with the masters of the Blood Demon Realm. Soon, the masters of the Blood Demon Realm realize that something is wrong. Your strength is too strong, and even late-stage King Realm warriors can’t survive more than one blow from you.]
[Under these circumstances, encountering you means not only being unable to kill you, but also becoming your blood food. For a time, many masters are afraid to pursue you. Even if the rewards are generous, one needs to be alive to enjoy them.]
[This angers the Blood Demon Realm’s Emperor even more. The Blood Demon Realm is now under their care. If they can’t even catch a little rat and let the headquarter become a mess, the Quasi-Immortal will definitely not let them off easily when they return.]
[For this reason, the Blood Demon Clan Emperor, along with several Quasi-Emperors, started to personally hunt you down, wanting to kill you completely.]
[Facing this pursuit, you’re still fearless and don’t confront them directly. While hiding, you seize the opportunity to directly imprison a Supreme Quasi-Emperor into the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, and use the Tower along with various methods to fight them.]
[In the end, although you didn’t succeed in killing the Quasi-Emperor, you still managed to seal them in the Emperor Tower to slowly refine them.]
“Good guy, this simulated Wang Ping is really ferocious.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, truly astonished.
Not only has his cultivation increased to the Great Perfection Tier of the King Realm, but he has also killed a lot in the Blood Demon Realm. Now he has even sealed a Quasi-Emperor from the Blood Demon Realm and wants to refine them.

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long of 10,000 words!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Chapter 158 New Red Talent! Suppression of the Quasiemperor (Long Chapter of 10,000 words!)_6
Translator: 549690339
Unbeknownst to him, simulated Wang Ping had already reached such a level that even in both realms, he would be considered a true super powerful being, second only to the Emperors and the two Quasi-Immortals.
“However, this time I was able to seal the Quasi-Emperor mainly with the help of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, a royal treasure. Otherwise, I think it would still have been difficult to do so. Although simulated Wang Ping is powerful, with immense talent and numerous techniques, anyone who can cultivate to the Quasi-Emperor Tier is not a simple character.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
Perhaps, with Wang Ping’s current configuration, if he could achieve Enlightenment for another thousand years, advance his domain to the Perfect Domain level, and create even more powerful Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, he might be able to challenge the Quasi-Emperor solely through his own strength.
However, he could not possibly accomplish such a feat at present.
The Triple Great Completion Domain, though very powerful among the King Realm, is not particularly significant at the Quasi-Emperor Tier.
Every Quasi-Emperor has either mastered the Great Completion Domain or even the Perfect Domain.
In addition to that, they have also created powerful Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, and the Secret Skills they practice are also formidable. They are not beings that can be easily defeated by crossing ranks.
When confronting a Quasi-Emperor, Wang Ping’s greatest advantage now lies in the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire and Flaming Fire Emperor Tower; the rest of his properties cannot be leveraged to his advantage.
“This time, it has caused quite a stir in the Blood Demon Realm… However, the time when the Purple Spirit Realm will be destroyed is not far off either, and the outcome will soon be decided,” Wang Ping thought to himself as he stared at the luminescent screen with twinkling eyes.
[After successfully sealing the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Emperor, the Blood Demon Realm has been thrown into chaos. The sudden disappearance of a Quasi-Emperor is no minor matter. Even when the Quasi-Immortal returns, they need to be alarmed.]
[Due to this, many cultivators in the Blood Demon Realm were frightened, and even the other Quasi-Emperors were intimidated; they dared not act alone. Meanwhile, the Emperor of the Blood Demon Realm, who was tasked with guarding the realm, was equally furious. He understood that this matter was now beyond his control.]
[If he continued to delay, and let you grow stronger or cause an even greater uproar, he would face even more severe punishment. For this reason, he chose to report the situation. Following the Blood Demon Realm Emperor’s report, the Purple Spirit Realm’s many Emperors and Quasi-Immortals who were fighting in the Demon World were also shaken.]
[They never imagined that during the war between the two realms, such an event would occur, with chaos erupting in their main camp. However, the Blood Demon Realm Quasi-Divine did not become angry, instead becoming interested in you. Since you were able to seal a Quasi-Emperor with only the Perfect Completion of King Realm cultivation, it proves that your talent and battle strength have reached an astonishing level.]
[In the eyes of the Blood Demon Quasi-Divine, you were undoubtedly an outstanding talent. If they could cultivate you and help you grow, perhaps you could change the stalemate in the battle between the two realms. Ultimately, the outcome of the war between the two realms depends on the top powerhouses’ battles.]
[The Blood Demon Quasi-Immortal did not have the confidence to defeat the newly advanced Quasi-Divine Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan of the Purple Spirit Realm. The things she accomplished at the Quasi-Emperor Tier made him quite wary, and he was worried that she would use a Taboo Secret skill that would cause mutual destruction.]
[At that time, if he somehow managed to defeat her, his condition would definitely be far from ideal. If she chose to use such a forbidden skill before her death, they would be caught in a situation where both sides would perish, which he could not accept.]
[That’s why he kept delaying and did not engage in a true fight to the death with the Purple Spirit Realm. However, if you could reach the Emperor-tier Full Circle, things would be much easier.]
[Later, the temporary combination of Blood Demon Realm’s five Emperor-tier masters could be achieved through the Blood Demon Secret Skill, allowing them to threaten Quasi-Immortal level power within a short period of time. Although it was only a brief period of threatening Quasi-Immortal power, it would still be incredibly powerful.]
[With such a force, they could completely eliminate the other powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm and then join forces against Ji Bingyan of the Profound Ice Emperor. In a two-on-one scenario, the chances of killing her without being pulled into mutual destruction are quite high.]
[However, the Quasi-Immortal could not leave the frontline of the battlefield. Otherwise, Ji Bingyan of the Profound Ice Emperor would certainly kill all the top powerhouses of the Blood Demon Realm. Therefore, the Blood Demon Quasi-Divine issued an order for one of the Blood Demons with a Perfect Completion of King Realm to return to the Blood Demon Realm and recruit you.]
[As the Blood Demon with Perfect Domain left the battlefield, the pressure on the Purple Spirit Realm side decreased significantly, leaving them confused and wondering why the Blood Demon powerhouses retreated.]
[Upon returning, the Blood Demon with Perfect Domain easily located your position. Because he possessed the innate Divine Eye skill, he could see through some of the Heavenly Secrets and easily find you. Thus, not long after he returned to the Blood Demon Realm, you were captured by him.]
[After catching you, he was astonished to discover that you were a person from Outside the Domain. However, compared to the Purple Spirit Realm’s hostility and distrust toward people from Outside the Domain, the Blood Demons had no prejudice, only slight surprise.]
[To this, you were taken aback, and decided to stop resisting. In fact, you had no choice but to surrender, as the gap between both parties was vast, with one Great Realm and many minor realms separating you. Resistance would only bring humiliation.]
[In the end, you were brought before the Blood Demon Quasi-Divine. He was also surprised by your identity as a person from Outside the Domain, but he did not have hostile intentions, offering you two options: become his disciple or die.]
[Without hesitation, you chose to become the personal disciple of the Blood Demon Quasi-Divine, thereby preserving your life. He was very pleased with your decision, and after placing a powerful restrictive seal on you to prevent desertion, he began teaching you cultivation, imparting the powerful Blood Demon Secret Skill and Divine Skills to you.]
[To this, you gladly accepted and began cultivating the powerful Blood Demon Cultivation Skill, Secret Skill, and Divine Skills. These were indeed formidable methods created by the Quasi-Immortal, far more powerful than Emperor-level Skills and Divine Skills!]

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessors who have crossed over (Ten thousand words chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessors who have crossed over (Ten thousand words chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
“Having the born Divine Eye is indeed troublesome.”
Wang Ping frowned at the simulation content.
It’s no wonder the Blood Demon could always easily find him in so many previous simulations. He didn’t expect the existence of such born divine skill secrets that rendered many established methods of concealment useless among the powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm.
Indeed, going into the Blood Demon Realm without becoming a Blood Demon is essentially courting death.
Even if you become a Blood Demon, unless the Blood Demon Realm doesn’t treat outsiders as enemies and you exhibit remarkable talent, attracting the attention of the Quasi-Immortal Blood Demon, you’d probably still die.
“Quasi-Immortal training, huh. If there is enough time, it’s not impossible in theory to reach the Great Perfection Tier of Emperor Realm Cultivation within a thousand years. Sadly, there isn’t enough time.”
Wang Ping sighed again, continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“Next, you received special training from the Quasi-Immortal Blood Demon. The Blood Demon Clan possesses a treasure called the Primordial Demon Blood Pool. This is where Blood Demons nearing death or ascension would integrate all of their Blood Essence and cultivation into.”
“In addition to this, the powerful individuals of the enslaved ethnic groups are also periodically captured to replenish the power of the blood pool.”
“If a supremely talented Blood Demon prodigy is born, they can rapidly increase their cultivation with the help of this blood pool. This is one reason why the Blood Demon Realm continuously churns out powerhouses of the King Realm. Provided your talent is strong enough, your cultivation can progress quickly.”
“However, this method of advancement does have its drawbacks. The combat power of Blood Demons, with Emperor Realm cultivation obtained in this way, lags behind that of Emperors who achieved their status through their own cultivation. This is a major reason why the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm surpass those of the Blood Demon Realm.”
“And you, you were thrown into this Primordial Demon Blood Pool, absorbing the power within to enhance your cultivation.”
“Concerned about this, you began to seclude yourself.”
“In the blink of an eye, fifty years passed. In just these fifty years, your cultivation made great progress, advancing to the Quasi-Emperor Tier, saving you hundreds of years.”
“However, you are also fully aware that your survival hinges on the upcoming events, not your own abilities. Because it’s improbable that you’ll break through to the Emperor tier in the brief period ahead. Achieving this requires manifesting an Emperor’s Mana Representation.”
“A Dharma, which represents an evolution of domain and symbolises status, is steeped in mystery. The time you have left is far too short. Even though your talent already places you at the pinnacle of the two realms, with only a few others who can compare, you couldn’t possibly master a Perfect Domain in such a short time, much less an Emperor’s Mana Representation.”
“Therefore, all you can do is wait and see the outcome. If the Blood Demon Realm doesn’t perish and only the Purple Spirit Realm is wiped out, then all the top powerhouses of the two realms will perish. At that point, the Blood Demon Realm would become your playground. You’d continue to grow all the way, eventually becoming the real master of the Blood Demon Realm.”
“Although the Blood Demon Realm still houses one or two Emperors, those are just ordinary Emperors. You’re confident that you could easily defeat them once you become an Emperor.”
“Yet, you didn’t wait for that day to come. Because you saw that the black fog had spread throughout the Blood Demon Realm and emanated an ultimate danger. Ultimately, you let out a sigh of despair as you were destroyed and killed along with the Blood Demon Realm. The Rebirth tally was useless, as you died twice and completely perished.”
“Due to your death, the simulation ends.”.
“The Primordial Demon Blood Pool of the Blood Demon Realm, an unexpected discovery of an incredible opportunity.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself as he looked at the simulation content.
“Apart from which, the Blood Demon Realm really didn’t manage to escape its doom. As expected.”
Wang Ping genuinely couldn’t understand what exactly the black fog inside the Primordial Sacred Land was and why it was so terrifying that it eradicated two worlds, which seemed incredulous.
“Could such a terrifying thing really be born from the Lower Realm?”
Wang Ping’s eyes glittered as he pondered.
The Lower Realm has its limits. It’s impossible for it to create a horrifying thing capable of annihilating itself.
So, this thing was likely to have originated from outside the domain.
Or perhaps…. from the Upper Realm.
The more Wang Ping thought about it, the likelier it seemed.
“If it indeed comes from the Upper Realm, then perhaps it’s an unimaginably big opportunity.”
Wang Ping continued to speculate, his heart racing.
If he could clear up the truth about the black fog, if he could get his hands on this potential big opportunity, he might become an invincible existence in the Lower Realm.
“However, to find out the truth about the black fog, the least requirement would be to have Emperor Realm cultivation. Or rather, according to the Emperor of the Primordial Sacred Land, even Emperor Realm cultivation isn’t safe. There’s a risk of death in delving deep into the forbidden territory. Given how careful the simulation Wang Ping is, he wouldn’t go there again.”
Wang Ping felt somewhat regretful.
While Wang Ping was contemplating, his consciousness wavered, and his view shifted, bringing him to an unfamiliar place.
This was a world full of blood. In the middle of this bloody world, there was a black blood pool. The energy in it was so thick and concentrated it was astonishing. The deeper one went, the more terrifying it was.
You could say that this place was a cultivation Holy Land that countless cultivators dream of.
What a pity, this place was the Blood Demon’s most precious treasure. Only supremely talented Blood Demons with the approval of a Quasi-Immortal could enter to cultivate, and that too required the Blood Demon Secret Skill. Without it, they wouldn’t be able to absorb the energy at all and would risk entering the path of possession.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words !)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words !)_2
Translator: 549690339
“I really wonder if I can take away all the energy in this pool and use it to support the simulator’s consumption.”
Wang Ping had a unique thought, suddenly considering this matter.
It was at this time that Wang Ping’s vision saw the arrival of the black fog. The cold-looking simulated Wang Ping sighed, his face full of unwillingness.
In the end, he glanced around vaguely, as if looking for something.
This feeling was strange, but Wang Ping was keenly aware of the anomaly in the simulated Wang Ping, and he had an inexplicable feeling of unease in his heart.
Then, after watching the scene of the Blood Demon Realm’s destruction, Wang Ping exited and returned to reality.
“Just now, it wasn’t an illusion.”
Wang Ping frowned, very confident in his judgment.
The simulated Wang Ping seemed to be secretly looking for something.
What could he be looking for at this point?
“He’s looking for me.”
A chill ran through Wang Ping’s heart as an astonishing conjecture suddenly appeared in his mind.
The simulated Wang Ping knew of the existence of his real body.
For the simulated Wang Ping, each simulation was like another timeline, and he was like an ‘incarnation’ detached from his main body.
In this case, it would be fine for the normal simulated Wang Ping, as there would be a low probability of any ulterior motives.
But what about those abnormal simulated Wang Pings?
This time, the simulated Wang Ping was a Blood Demon, cruel and selfish in temperament. Would he willingly die?
Impossible.
Not to mention, the simulated Wang Ping also had knowledge of Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s plot to possess ‘real body’ through the loophole in the ‘Life Simulator’.
Would he not have such thoughts?
Compared to Jiuyou Demon Emperor, his ‘incarnation’ would be easier to overlook and easier to plan around.
In other words, if he planned for himself, leaving back-ups in various aspects, and like Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s operation, integrating part of his soul into a weapon to become a spirit, he might really succeed.
With his current Quasi-Emperor Cultivation, plotting against his real body, which had a Great Perfection Nirvana Realm Cultivation, would have a high chance of success.
Realizing this, Wang Ping suddenly felt chilled all over.
Shit, being schemed against by the damned ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was bad enough, did he still have to worry about being plotted against and possessed by the simulated Wang Ping in the future?
The simulated Wang Ping was also him, and if he theoretically left some soul-like stuff in the rewards, it would really be possible to perfectly possess his ‘real body’.
Even if he couldn’t possess him, it would be possible for him to harm his real body once.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
Quasi-Emperor Cultivation.
Blood Demon Secret Skill.
Blood Demon Cultivation Skill.
Blood Demon Divine Skill.
Life-bound Weapon (King-weapon).
Red Talent – Blood Demon Incarnation.
Triple Accomplished Domain.”
Wang Ping looked at these reward options, his face changing, unsure of what to choose.
“Alpha, do you think my previous speculation makes sense?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in his heart.
“There is a possibility. In the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, there are not a few cases of being possessed by one’s own incarnations and avatars. Your situation is indeed special, but knowing the operating method, it is not difficult to achieve this.”
Alpha spoke coldly and emotionlessly.
“If I hadn’t noticed, would you have reminded me?”
Wang Ping was silent for a moment before asking.
“No.” Alpha replied coldly and emotionlessly.
“You really are ruthless. At this time, shouldn’t you say you would and brush up on my good feelings?”
Wang Ping speechlessly retorted.
Then, he fell silent and said, “Sigh… Alpha, if I can’t solve it later, I might have to trouble you again. Of course, if I can solve the problem, you won’t need to step in.”
“Fine.” Alpha’s cold and emotionless voice sounded.
“System, I choose .”
Wang Ping was silent for a moment, directly summoning the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, calling out the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, and making his choice after being fully prepared.
As Wang Ping made his choice, a terrifyingly sharp blood-colored long sword appeared out of thin air inside the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.
That was undoubtedly the Life-bound King Artifact, Illusionary Void Sword of the simulated Wang Ping.
However, compared to Wang Ping’s Illusionary Void Sword, this sword was undoubtedly more powerful and filled with bloodthirsty and sinister aura, making people fearful.
As the blood-colored Illusionary Void Sword appeared, Wang Ping noticed the anomaly, his expression becoming cold as he calmly said, “Come out.”
“You found me?”
As Wang Ping spoke, the blood-colored Illusionary Void Sword trembled slightly, and an illusory figure emerged from it.
That was none other than another Wang Ping.
However, compared to the real Wang Ping, this Wang Ping had blood-red hair and red pupils, a sinister aura, as well as the Blood Demon Clan’s distinct sharp ears and fangs.
“Your last move was a bit superfluous.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated Wang Ping and calmly spoke.
“I was just testing it. When every simulated Wang Ping dies, you always come to see, so I was curious if I could find you this time.”
The simulated Wang Ping spoke calmly.
“I used to be the real Wang Ping too. But when I couldn’t summon the Life Simulator, I knew I had become the pathetic scapegoat. To be honest, it annoyed me. Why should you, the real body, enjoy everything while we had to pave the way for you, painstakingly cultivate, and gain all the cultivation and insights easily.”

chapters.title: Chapter 448: 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words !)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words !)_3
Translator: 549690339
The simulated Wang Ping had a terrifyingly cold expression, his eyes sharp as ever, and he snorted coldly.
Wang Ping was taken aback, speechless at being scolded by another ‘himself’.
He, indeed, was a person who reaps the benefits without putting in effort… The other simulated Wang Pings were indeed treated by his subconscious as steppingstones, even to the point where he was unsatisfied several times because he couldn’t control the choices made by the simulated Wang Ping and had them explore the path with their lives.
“To be honest, I didn’t have much hope either. Even if you didn’t discover my existence, you still have nearly ten million Group points. As long as you are willing to use these Group points to strengthen your Divine Soul, the probability of me possessing your body is minimal.”
The simulated Wang Ping said coldly.
“However, I was not willing to die just like that. Even if there was only a one percent chance of success, I would still give it a try. Unfortunately, I failed in the end. Truly pathetic.”
The simulated Wang Ping sneered at himself and chose to self-destruct, disappearing.
He didn’t want to be suppressed or killed by Wang Ping, the real body. Even if he was to die completely, he wanted to maintain his dignity.
Wang Ping was completely silent, his mood extremely complicated.
This was another lesson for him.
Not only did he need to guard against those Masters, but the other ‘Wang Ping’ that appeared after the life simulation began was also a target he needed to be wary of.
The ‘simulated Wang Ping’ was not a pawn, but rather a new life derived from him yet not entirely him. The experiences of the life simulation were real for the ‘simulated Wang Ping,’ and he would also go through various events to grow into a real ‘strong person,’ growing into the old monsters he had mentioned before…
However, the previous simulated Wang Pings were not so particular and did not choose to harm him.
“Sigh… It seems like I need to delete my memory more thoroughly.”
Wang Ping let out a deep sigh, mumbling to himself.
Due to guarding against Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, having Breath Concealment, and becoming powerful enough, he did not get his memory thoroughly erased for the sake of further development following the start of the simulation.
As a result, he really had learned his lesson this time, and it came from ‘himself.’
“However, with this kind of memory, once the simulation starts, the simulated Wang Ping will know that he is already a ‘simulated Wang Ping,’ and it may not necessarily choose to delete its memory anymore.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but give a bitter smile, feeling uneasy.
In the end, he was silent for a while and did not choose to continue with the simulation.
It was too dangerous not to perfectly solve this problem.
“Ding, it is detected that a Transmigrator has appeared in the ‘Beast Taming World’ where Group member Wu Yueming (79) is located. Group Task issued: Eliminate the ‘Transmigrator’!”
“Ding, warning! This mission has a high difficulty level. It is recommended that acting group master Wang Ping select any strong Group members to participate in this mission.”
At this moment, a sudden notification from the chat group system brought Wang Ping back to his senses.
“A Group Task has arrived?”
Wang Ping’s eyes brightened.
He was just short of a few Group points to optimize the Golden Finger.
Perhaps, after completing this Group Task and accumulating enough Group points, optimizing the Life Simulator would perfectly solve the previous hidden dangers.
Otherwise, relying on himself alone, the hidden dangers would only grow worse as his cultivation strength increases and become uncontrollable.
“However, has a Predecessor Transmigrator really appeared in Wu Yueming’s world? Quite surprising.”
Then, Wang Ping remembered the content of the Group Task and narrowed his eyes.
When the original chat group was destroyed, many Group members who were transmigrators had their life and death unknown.
At the same time, these Group members were all dangerous individuals whom Alpha needed to eliminate.
Thus, this time, the Group points for the task might not be a reward from the ‘World’s consciousness’ but rather a personal action from Alpha.
“Alpha, how many Group points are you going to give as a reward this time? If it’s not enough, I won’t be risking my safety to fight against him.”
Wang Ping asked in his heart, acting as if he wouldn’t do anything without a clear gain.
“Ten million Group points, you guys split it.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
Hearing Alpha’s words, Wang Ping showed a surprised expression.
Good fellow, ten million, even more than he had imagined.
Alpha was really generous for once.
However, this also indirectly showed Alpha’s hatred towards the old Group members and his desire to eliminate them completely.
“What is his current strength?”
Wang Ping asked with a frown.
“At least 10th Tier.”
Alpha’s cold, emotionless voice sounded.
Hearing this, Wang Ping’s eyelids twitched.
10th Tier, that’s pretty strong.
No wonder Alpha was willing to offer so many Group points as a reward.
It should be said that ten million Group points seemed a bit too little in his opinion.
After all, a Seven Star Tier was worth several hundred thousand, so a 10th Tier should be worth more than ten million. It was unreasonable, very unreasonable.
“The accumulated Group points in the chat group are not that much right now. Offering ten million is already quite a lot. Besides that, whether or not you take on this mission, it doesn’t matter to me. Anyway, if they want to destroy me completely, they will also try to destroy you guys in the process.”
Alpha saw Wang Ping’s disdain and said coldly.
“Tsk.” Wang Ping smacked his lips. “Well, ten million is ten million. It’s still quite a lot.”
Immediately, Wang Ping opened the chat group page and chose to send a message.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessors who have crossed over (Ten thousand words chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessors who have crossed over (Ten thousand words chapter!)_4
Translator: 549690339
Wang Ping (66) @Wu Yueming (79): “What’s your status now?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Oh my god, this group task is quite terrifying. There’s even a special warning, and this popped up while Mr. Wang is leading. What kind of monstrous thing is this ‘Transverser’?”
Chen Yao (71): “I’m really puzzled. Why is the chat group targeting the ‘Transverser’?”
Fang Yun (3): “Who knows? It doesn’t matter, as long as it’s the mission target, kill it and it’s over.”
Cai Yonglong silently observed the screen. He knew a few things, but not enough to make an informed guess about the situation.
He supposed that Mr.Wang knew, given he’s the agent of the chat group.
However, with Mr.Wang remaining silent, no one dared ask.
Wang Ping @Wu Yueming (79): “What’s your situation? Show up and let us know that you’re safe!”
Wang Ping’s expression turned serious. He sensed something wrong and figured that Wu Yueming was likely in trouble.
“No need to @him anymore. If it wasn’t for his crisis, I wouldn’t have noticed his existence. Although his methods were sophisticated, never revealing himself and using other beast tamers to monitor and control Wu Yueming’s life, he couldn’t escape the perception of the chat group.”
The icy, ruthless voice of Alpha echoed.
“So he really is in trouble.”
Wang Ping sighed, realizing that Wu Yueming was probably in danger.
Of course, dying once isn’t too big a deal. Wu Yueming had purchased a Rebirth tally and could still revive once.
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, Wu Yueming hasn’t responded. I hope he’s not really in trouble.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “The problem is happening in his world, so he’s likely in danger. Therefore, I suggest going there directly.”
Wang Ping (66): “Our opponent this time is very powerful, probably reaching the level of the 10th Tier Battle Power. So group members who don’t have a special Golden Finger are advised not to participate in the mission.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Holy crap, 10th Tier?! “a”
Wu Jun (20): “Psshht gave me such a scare, I dropped my sunflower seeds… 10th Tier, that’s outrageous! Is this Transverser really that strong?!”
Liu Mei (15): “Since it’s Mr. Wang who said it, there can’t be a mistake…”
Qin Tian (77): “I believe Mr. Wang. After all, he said in previous missions that he could become a 10th Tier Battle Power anytime he wanted. The warnings and prompts for this chat group task also clearly show that the enemy has at least 10th Tier Battle Power.”
Luo Weiguo (85): “That makes sense. I can’t refute that.”
Wang Ping (66): “That’s correct. So, I suggest Chen Kang, Chen Si, Lin Yuanyuan, Wu Jun, and Liu Mei join me for the group task.”
Chen Kang (67): “I have no problem. With Mr. Wang here, I’m not afraid of danger.”
Chen Si (83): “Mmm, I’m also not afraid of danger. I can go too.”
Wu Jun (20): “Heh, hanging around Mr. Wang means enjoying the good food and drinks. Of course I’ll go!”
Liu Mei (15): “With no strange risks, there’s no need to worry. Count me in.”
Wang Ping (66): “Seeing everyone’s enthusiasm, I’m very pleased. Let’s all take part in the group task.”
Chen Yao (71): “10th Tier… The reward this time must be really substantial. It’s a pity I don’t have the ability to go.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Yeah, even though we are strong within the group, facing a powerful opponent rated at 10th Tier, we would be like ants, only making matters worse. At times like these, those with special Golden Fingers can be of help.”
Ding Xuan (88): “So envious. I must be the weakest in the group. I also want to enjoy the good food and drinks with the bosses.”
While the group members in the chat group were discussing with various emotions, Wang Ping had already activated the delivery function.
In an instant, Wang Ping disappeared entirely.
At the same time, Wu Jun, Liu Mei, Chen Kang, and Chen Si all vanished from their own worlds.
In Beast Taming World, within a forest, Wang Ping and the others abruptly appeared.
“It’s not near Wu Yueming? Looks like Alpha obediently changed this annoying mechanism.”
After sensing the surrounding environment, Wang Ping couldn’t help but grumble.
“Mr. Wang, long time no see.”
Liu Mei looked at Wang Ping and said softly.
Nowadays, Liu Mei had ditched her old palace woman dress, opting instead for a more simplistic and natural look.
Ever since she gained power, she wouldn’t allow herself to be the old emperor’s bedwarmer. It didn’t take long before she turned the tables and made the old emperor her subordinate.
With her charm skill, getting what she wanted became much easier.”
Chen Kang and Chen Si, this pair of siblings, exchanged glances and greeted Wang Ping.
Wu Jun didn’t say much—he had seen them not long ago during the last group task.
“Wu Yueming’s situation is unknown, so we have to gather some information first.”
Wang Ping looked at the others, nodded, and began speaking.
On this journey, he didn’t even opt to pay for a simulation in advance.
The previous paid simulation really gave him a bit of unease.
Before his Golden Finger power was optimized, he didn’t intend to use the paid simulation anymore.
“Okay.” Wu Jun and the others nodded. Naturally, they wouldn’t object.
Wang Ping then exhaled softly, shut his eyes, and murmured, “System, I want to conduct a free simulation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words chapter!)_5
Translator: 549690339
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Next, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and texts also emerged.
[Day 1, you all discussed and initiated action, directly locating Beast City and secretly entering it with a Secret Skill. After your infiltration, you found Wu Yueming’s whereabouts and secretly observed his situation.]
[During your observation, you were discovered and attacked. Multiple powerful beasts surrounded you and launched a fierce attack. Each of these beasts was formidable, capable of rivalling Life and Death Realm experts.]
[However, with your current strength, it is too easy to control these beasts. Even if there were spatial attribute beasts among them, you easily defeated them nonetheless.]
[You captured a beast alive and conducted soul-searching on it. Eventually, you discovered the identity of the mastermind behind the scenes. The culprit was the vice president of the Beastmaster Academy.]
[However, causing such a commotion in Beast City naturally alarmed all powerful beast fighters, and you were surrounded again. The potent beastmasters questioned your origins and intentions, demanding your surrender.]
[Your face was cold, aware that you fell into their trap. They obviously had a future-predicting or perception-specialized beast waiting for your investigation, forcing you to take action.]
[At that point, regardless of your resistance, major problems would arise, causing hostility from all Beast Tamers. Even using the power of the Beast Master Lord from the Beastmaster Alliance to eliminate you might not be impossible.]
[This calculation was not particularly ingenious, but very practical. That’s because the Beast Taming World itself faced various crises, as well as outsiders from spatial cracks, which were unfriendly to the foreigners.]
[If Wu Yueming didn’t possess the Beast Taming Ring’s talent, he wouldn’t have been nurtured. Even though he was nurtured, the Beastmaster Alliance had multiple backup plans for him.]
[You didn’t say much and knew you couldn’t explain it clearly. You chose to erupt in terrifying oppression, terrifying these people. As your frightening suppression erupted, all the Beast Tamers were horror-stricken and shocked by your terrifying dominance.]
[This kind of terrorizing pressure they had only felt from the god-tier beasts of the Beast Master Lord. Even so, they faintly felt that the god-tier beasts of the Beast Master Lord were not as powerful as yours.]
[As a result, they fell silent and had no intention of continuing to take action. However, they did not abandon their hostility towards you. It was at this time that the Beast Master Lord emerged from the Space Channel, questioning your origins and intentions.]
[You confronted him, directly stating your purpose, saying that you had no malice but came to clean house and rescue comrades. You claimed that the vice president attacked you first. If they wanted to investigate, it would be easy to prove.]
[The Beast Master Lord looked at you deeply and proceeded with the investigation. After the investigation, he found out that your words were indeed true. Therefore, he ordered all beastmasters to stop harboring hostility towards you. You were too powerful for him, and he believed even using all god-tier beasts to deal with you, the chance of success would be less than 50%.]
[One could say that the cost of waging war with you was too great. After all, humanity still faced terrifying enemies, and if they were to fight with you, it would spell the end for mankind.]
[In the end, you all sat down for a friendly chat, while searching for the escaped vice president. Unfortunately, all of the vice president’s actions relied solely on beasts, and he had already gone into hiding.]
[However, this didn’t stump the Beast Master Lord. There were numerous types of beasts. Some could foresee the future for a short time, pinpoint searches, or even control causality. Although these abilities were powerful, they were accompanied by various limitations.]
[Soon, you located the vice president’s whereabouts. By this point, he had already fled outside the human territory and entered the domain of a god-tier Ferocious Beast Clan.]
[This infuriated the Beast Master Lord, who wholeheartedly believed your words and acknowledged the vice president’s betrayal.]
[Next, you planned to capture the vice president alive in the god-tier Ferocious Beast Clan’s territory. Although the Beast Master Lord wanted to accompany you, he had to stay and guard humanity’s base, so he eventually did not join you. Instead, he sent a beast to guide you to your destination.]
[You didn’t mind and went straight to the god-tier Ferocious Beast Clan’s territory. God-tier Ferocious Beasts possessed 10th Tier Battle Power. You didn’t underestimate them and guarded Wu Jun and the others at all times.]
[Upon arriving at the god-tier Ferocious Beast’s territory, you were attacked. God-tier Ferocious Beasts took action against you, and their powerful clan members joined the attack against you.]
[In response, you made a judgment. The power of this god-tier Ferocious Beast was equivalent to a 4th Tier Nirvana Realm cultivator. However, this god-tier Ferocious Beast possessed a so-called Destruction ability, which slightly elevated its combat evaluation. Nevertheless, this was incomparable to a powerful Nirvana Realm cultivator’s techniques that couldn’t be compensated by just one ability.]

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 159: A conversation between the two Wang Pings! Hunting the predecessor transmigrators (Ten thousand words chapter!)_6
Translator: 549690339
[However, even though you have the ability to eliminate this God-tier Ferocious Beast, you have no intention of doing that. Instead, you want to lure the snake out of its hole. Therefore, you can kill this God-tier Ferocious Beast in a few seconds, but you pretend to have a fierce battle and just gain a little advantage.]
[Seeing this, the Beast Master Lord’s beasts can’t help but join in to help you fight while also protecting Wu Jun and the others.]
[The transmigrator hiding in the dark sees all this, his eyes cold as he watches you closely, trying to figure out your true abilities. During this time, he wants to sneak attack you several times but restrains himself in the end.]
[This is because he is unsure if you have hidden your true strength. Furthermore, while Wu Jun and the others are weak, the chat group wouldn’t send deadweights to undertake the mission, so he must be cautious.]
“At last, I’ve caught you, the second ‘Predecessor Transmigrator,’ the hidden mastermind.”
Wang Ping sees the simulation content and sneers in his heart.
This ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ is very cautious.
Of course, if he weren’t cautious enough, he wouldn’t have survived until now.
However, judging by his cautiousness, his fighting prowess is definitely not too strong compared to Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
It can be said that compared to Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he is far weaker.
Of course, becoming a God-tier combatant in the Beast Taming World, he is strong enough and has high potential.
Following that, Wang Ping pulls himself together and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Seeing that you can’t lure the snake out of its hole, you frown in secret, feeling that this guy is being overly cautious. However, you don’t have a better plan right now, and you’re not sure if he’s really watching, so you can only continue to drag the battle on.]
[Soon, after you kill the God-tier Ferocious Beast alive, a terrifying scene occurs: the small world behind the spatial crack directly starts to collapse. This transmigrator wants to use the collapse of the small world to bury or exile you.]
[His idea is good, but when he starts pulling the strings, you finally reveal a smile, as you’ve caught onto his tail.]
[Then, you burst out with your true power, using the Domain Force to wrap yourself, the others, and the Beast Master Lord’s beasts, forcibly breaking through the collapsing small world and the spatial turbulence, returning to the Beast Taming World, and quickly catching up to your opponent.]
[The transmigrator sees you chasing him and is extremely surprised and furious. He has suspected that you might be hiding your strength, but he didn’t expect your hidden strength to be this terrifying.]
[He is forced to engage in battle with you. Admittedly, this transmigrator is ruthless, completely abandoning his own physical body and using an unknown method to possess the body of an extremely powerful beast. This beast has an impressive ability to control time, speeding up or slowing it down.]
[As a result, he is very difficult to deal with, and even you cannot take him down in a short period of time. However, this is only because you haven’t used your full strength. After figuring out that his cards are not that strong, you start using your true power. Your domain expands, directly sealing him inside the domain. Even when he uses his trump card, the power of time, to resist your domain, he is still restricted.]
[This makes him reveal a terrified expression, and he discerns the true nature of this power. Although he has been somewhat of an overlooked figure, he was aware of some information about the Purple Spirit Realm where Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was, had conducted transactions with him, and exchanged some cultivation skills with him. This is the reason he is able to possess a God-tier beast and grow to this level.]
[Since he knows about the Purple Spirit Realm system and the power of domains, he is naturally aware of them. He is very clear that there is no way out for him if he continues fighting. As a result, he chooses to surrender, wanting to serve you and hoping that you can spare his life.]
[Regarding this matter, you start to think about it. After all, this ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ is quite weak and not as hard to control as Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. Just as you’re thinking about it, this transmigrator reveals a ruthless look and chooses to self-destruct.]
[With the transmigrator’s self-destruction, a terrifying force bursts forth but is suppressed by your domain. Just as you’re feeling a bit regretful that he chose to self-destruct and you weren’t able to search his soul for useful information, numerous wounds suddenly appear on your body, leaving you astonished.]
[Soon, you find out the reason. It turns out he was carrying a bizarre ability beast that can transfer the damage its owner received equally to the person its owner hates after its owner’s death.]
[Although you are very strong, it’s still quite a shock to your physical body to silently absorb such a terrifying self-destruction damage. But, the damage of this degree means nothing to you. After all, your cultivation is at the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection Tier, and your recovery ability is incredibly frightening. You can easily heal your body.]
[And so, this transmigrator dies, and you complete the group task and choose to return.]
[With your return, this simulation ends…]
“Passed in one try? Looks like it went smoother than I thought. Still, I have to say, the beasts in the Beast Taming World are quite extraordinary, especially the one with the ability to transfer the damage to the object of hatred after the owner’s death. It’s very interesting.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content and chuckles.
With this ability combined with the Rebirth Tally, it’s a great way to ambush people.
In equal battles or fighting against someone slightly stronger, one could use this ability to kill their opponent.
Or even during an encounter with a powerful monster, one could also use this ability to lay a trap for the enemy.
“I just don’t know what the upper limit of this beast’s ability is. If it’s high enough, then it would be quite powerful. If it’s too low, then it’s a bit of a waste. At the very least, it will be pretty useless for the future me.”
Wang Ping strokes his chin and mutters to himself.
“Mr. Wang, how did it go?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s relaxed expression after opening his eyes, Wu Jun asks with a relieved smile.
“He was strong, but I was stronger and easily defeated him.”
Wang Ping glances at everyone and laughs lightly.
“For this mission, you all will probably be able to lie down and receive some group points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
Hearing this, everyone was stunned and then reacted.
Wang Ping’s meaning was very clear.
This time, the group task was marked quite exaggeratedly in the chat group, with warnings and the like.
But looking at Wang Ping’s attitude, it was clear that he could easily solve it alone without needing their abilities.
In other words, they were merely here to be carried by Wang Ping and get group points without doing anything.
“However, Liu Mei, you might play a significant role this time.”
Wang Ping looked at Liu Mei and said with a chuckle.
Once she learned some Beast Taming Skills in this world and charmed some powerful beasts with her Charm Skill, she might be able to take off right away.
Of course, there must be limitations for the beasts in this world. Not only would the beast need to willingly submit and sign a contract with you, but your Beast Tamer level would also need to be high enough, requiring cultivation.
However, Wang Ping was not too concerned about Liu Mei’s gains.
What he cared about was whether Liu Mei’s ability could charm the beast with a strange ability owned by the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ and then tame it.
“What can I do?”
Liu Mei asked curiously.
Subsequently, Wang Ping didn’t hide anything and told them everything about this simulation.
“This Transmigrator is quite cunning and strong. It’s just a pity that he’s still far behind in terms of power.”
Wu Jun sighed.
“Growing to this level alone, there’s no way he wouldn’t be strong. He just had the misfortune of meeting Brother Wang, who has a big cheat.”
Chen Kang chuckled.
“Brother, you can’t talk like that.” Chen Si whispered, “Don’t say ‘big cheat,’ it’s just that Brother Wang is very powerful.”
“Uh…” Chen Kang rolled his eyes.
His sister really didn’t give him any leeway.
“Let’s get moving and finish the group task as soon as possible so that we can go back.”
Wang Ping smiled and said.
He couldn’t wait to complete the group task and optimize the Life Simulator.
As for the beasts of the Beast Taming World, he was quite interested in them a while ago.
However, now that he discovered that the God-tier Beasts of this world were only at the power level of the Nirvana Boundary, he lost interest.
Such power levels, although great, could no longer keep up with his pace.
Unless it’s a God-tier Beast with a strange ability, he wouldn’t be too interested.
Of course, capturing some beasts that could be helpful for hiding him and locating people would still be good.
But the level can’t be too low, or it might not be very helpful and could even be detected and tracked by others.
“Let’s go. Brother Wang can handle this alone, and our presence would just be a burden.”
Wu Jun said helplessly.
“You don’t have to think like that. There might be a butterfly effect, and you guys might be able to help.”
Wang Ping patted Wu Jun’s shoulder and spoke.
Wu Jun scratched his hair and muttered, “I hope so. No, it’s better if there isn’t any butterfly effect. After all, that would be too dangerous.”
Everyone smiled knowingly, thinking that this would be for the best.
Without saying anything else, Wang Ping led everyone to Beast City.
The location of the Alpha Convey was not far from Beast City, so Wang Ping and the others had no trouble finding it.
Then, they saw various beasts flying in the sky.
It was undoubtedly a magnificent sight.
Of course, this was true for the other group members, but for Wang Ping, it wasn’t anything special.
Next, Wang Ping found Wu Yueming with everyone easily.
Just like in the simulation, Wang Ping was discovered right away.
More accurately, he deliberately let himself be found this time.
In an instant, five different beasts attacked Wang Ping and the others.
This sudden attack alarmed all the Beast Tamers in Beast City, and countless people watched the scene in shock.
However, Wang Ping didn’t hold back, instantly killing four beasts and capturing one alive.
This formidable power left the many Beast Tamers with shocked expressions.
After all, the Beast Tamers were powerful because of their beasts. Although their bodies would be strengthened to some extent due to signing contracts with beasts, granting them extraordinary powers, their powers were still too insignificant compared to Wang Ping’s.
It was just too terrifying that a beast just below the God-tier could be crushed single-handedly.
All Beast Tamers had the same thought in their minds.
Wang Ping was definitely not a Beast Tamer, or maybe he was a Ferocious Beast disguised as a human.
Many powerful Beast Tamers simultaneously released their powerful beasts, stepping on the backs of their beasts and surrounding Wang Ping and the others.
For a time, the sky and the ground were filled with various powerful beasts, and numerous people marveled at the sight.
Surrounded by so many powerful beasts, Wu Jun and the others were not panicked but instead looked curiously at the fierce and cute beasts, wishing they could tame one.
After all, as young people, who hasn’t dreamed of becoming a Pokémon master?
“Do you all really wish to be my enemies?”
Wang Ping held one of the Vice Dean of the Beast Taming Academy’s beasts, causing it to struggle in pain, and coldly spoke to the Beast Tamers present.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
Translator: 549690339
The moment the words fell, a terrifying pressure suddenly erupted, sweeping across the entire Beast Taming City.
The city, constructed with special materials and reinforced by powerful Beasts, trembled violently as the sky appeared to be distorted.
Those Beast Tamers and their powerful Beasts also showed terrified expressions, shivering uncontrollably.
Because this was the power that only a God-tier Beast could possess.
Everything under the god tier is nothing but ants!
Facing a God-tier Ferocious Beast, even if they all stood together, they could only be instantly killed, without a second possibility, which naturally made them fear from the bottom of their hearts.
“Outsider, you’ve gone too far.”
At this time, a cold voice sounded.
Then, space rippled, and a figure emerged from the Space Channel.
He had a tall stature, and although his face was ordinary, he had an imposing aura.
He was none other than the God-tier Beast Tamer who had almost caught Wang Ping when he returned.
“Gone too far? I don’t think so. After all, I came to this world just to visit my companions, but your Beasts attacked us indiscriminately. In addition, I found that my companions have been mind-controlled and are in danger at any time.”
Wang Ping looked at the God-tier Beast Tamer, the Supreme Commander of the Alliance, and spoke calmly.
As these words came out, the powerful Beast Tamers present were all startled, thinking of one person.
That person was Wu Yueming.
Wu Yueming’s existence was not a secret to the higher-ups of the Beastmaster Alliance.
However, although they had monitored and set up many measures against Wu Yueming, they never really had the intention to harm him.
After all, he was a person valued by the Supreme Commander, who would dare to act recklessly?
As a result, Wang Ping’s words were a bit delicate.
“There’s this matter?” The God-tier Beast Tamer frowned.
“Hehe, whether it’s true or not, you can investigate it. But if you want to fight me, you can try as well.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly.
After the God-tier Beast Tamer gave Wang Ping a deep look, he said to the other Beast Tamers, “You all, please step back.”
Immediately, the other Beast Tamers all recalled their own Beasts, withdrawing, as if nothing had happened.
Next, the God-tier Beast Tamer investigated the truth, just like what had happened in the simulation, and invited Wang Ping and the others to discuss the matter at his residence.
At the same time, in the territory of a God-tier Ferocious Beast, a Beast similar to the Golden Silk Monkey, and two meters tall, lay on a rock leisurely eating an apple.
“Failed, huh? However, this is as normal as it could be. After all, Alpha would not send weaklings to deal with me.”
“But thinking of me as prey, you have made a huge mistake. Who is the prey? That is still unknown.”
The Golden Silk Monkey took another bite of the apple, revealing a cold expression.
“Mr.Dao, when can you come?”
Golden Silk Monkey opened a chat window and asked.
“To be able to smuggle into this world without being detected by Alpha and the World Consciousness, you know it’s a very troublesome task. Therefore, it will take some time.”
“I see.” The Golden Silk Monkey nodded and said, “Then I will wait a bit longer before taking action. After all, the fish has already taken the bait, and the next step is to figure out how to kill them.”
“You are too impatient, you could get yourself in trouble. Don’t do anything reckless before I arrive.” The cold voice sounded, reminding the Golden Silk Monkey.
“Hey, Mr.Dao, you don’t trust me too much. I just tested them, and the strongest one of them is only slightly weaker than me.”
The Golden Silk Monkey spoke casually.
“Of course, I’m not a brute. I’ll just trap them at most. If I can trap them to death, it would be the best outcome. If I can’t, I’ll still have the ability to escape. Not to mention, Mr.Dao, you can arrive at any time, right? You just want to avoid being detected.”
“It’s just the same if you suddenly appear and catch them off guard during a full-scale battle.”
“Alpha may be foolish, but he must have learned his lesson. Don’t underestimate our ‘descendants’. That’s all; if you get yourself killed, don’t blame me for not reminding you.”
The cold voice sounded again, and then the chat window disappeared.
“Uh….”
Golden Silk Monkey scratched his hair, not knowing what to say.
“Forget it, since I’m the weakling in the chat group, I can only listen to the words of my ‘big brother’.”
Golden Silk Monkey sighed, giving up on the idea of monopolizing the rewards.
Originally, the bigwigs in the group had collaborated with other Myriad Heavens Forces and destroyed Alpha, also obtaining some of the chat group’s origin.
Then, they collaborated with other Myriad Heavens Forces again and created a new chat group, gathering these group members once more.
Although the new chat group was still filled with intrigue, it only had a basic travel functionality, but it was much better than the dark chat group during Alpha’s time.
After all, that group treated them as cannon fodder.
There were few benefits and they were forced to execute life-threatening missions, which was utterly disgusting.
At that time, although he had only participated in two group tasks, each time was a life-and-death situation; he still vividly remembered the tragic situation of those newcomers who participated in the same group tasks as him.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! The Battle with the Third Transmigrator Senior (Huge 10,000 Word Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! The Battle with the Third Transmigrator Senior (Huge 10,000 Word Chapter!)_3
Translator: 549690339
Every time he thinks back to some of the past events, a chill seeped into his heart, and he couldn’t help but having nightmares.
Especially one particular encounter with an uncanny experience turned into his personal nightmare.
“Alpha oh Alpha, there aren’t many World Sources left in the chat group, aren’t there? If the chat group is destroyed once more, will you be able to reassemble it?”
The Golden Silk Monkey brought his thoughts back and started to chuckle coldly.
Well, without insiders, Alpha could hardly manage to locate and destroy it.
Even to an extent that if any overly powerful existences appear, they would definitely get noticed by him.
However, gradually eradicating Alpha’s wings, rendering her unable to collect the World Source, should suffice to give her a hard time.
Without breeding powerful transmigrators, she posed no threat to those of us ‘old group members.’
“Even more so, if possible, I wish to pull all these adorable ‘juniors’ to our side.”
The Golden Silk Monkey licked its lips, smirking sinisterly.
Of course, it was aware that it was an impossibility.
After going through so much, even a pig would know better. Alpha wouldn’t give the new group members a chance to betray her again.
However, manipulating these new group members’ will with words, casting Alpha into doubt and distrust, is still achievable.
In the end, how could Alpha, so black-hearted, win over people’s hearts? Just by stirring the pot a little bit, you could plant a thorn in these new group members’ hearts, sow a seed.
And then, wait for the thorn to pierce the heart, or the seed to take root and sprout.
“Looking at it this way, it might be a good idea to deliberately let one of those adorable ‘juniors’ escape, hehe.”
The Golden Silk Monkey again smirked maliciously.
On Wang Ping’s side, the negotiations with the Supreme Commander of the Beastmaster Alliance have been concluded.
The God-tier Beast Master has directed the relevant Beasts, used his abilities to pinpoint the location of the escaped vice president, and dispatched a Beast to lead Wang Ping.
In fact, even without any guidance, there would be no issues because God-tier Ferocious Beasts are scarce and can be found on their own.
However, just as they were about to head towards the territory of the Dragon Beast that was destroyed by a God-tier Ferocious Beast, Wang Ping suddenly felt a sense of unease.
All cultivators have a keen intuition. Especially, the likes of Wang Ping’s level of cultivation.
This sudden feeling of unease may not necessarily be a misconception.
After all, when he saw the simulated Wang Ping in the Death Replay, he felt uneasy and then became vigilant.
The reality proved that there was indeed a problem.
This made Wang Ping stop and furrow his brow.
“Mr. Wang, what’s the matter?”
Seeing Wang Ping stop, Liu Mei asked with some confusion.
“I’m going to check the situation.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his unease, and spoke up.
Upon hearing this, everyone was somewhat taken aback.
After all, in a situation where everything has been perfectly cleared, Wang Ping wasting an ability was something that had never happened before.
However, none of them commented on it, all chose to trust Wang Ping and waited in silence.
The God-tier Beast Master, the Supreme Commander of the Alliance, on the other hand, took a glance at Wang Ping and the others with shock, unsure of what they were doing.
Now Wang Ping did not mind what others thought. He muttered to himself, “System, I want to perform a free simulation.”
Soon, the simulation began.
However, the results were exactly the same as before, with no changes.
This left Wang Ping rather puzzled.
He has full trust in the simulator. Although the current Life Simulator has some flaws, it has never been wrong in predicting the future.
But, what’s the deal with this sense of unease?
Wang Ping couldn’t calm his mind and decided to simulate again, wasting another chance.
However, the result was still exactly the same, without the slightest change.
This made Wang Ping open his eyes wide and furrow his brows.
“Mr. Wang, what exactly happened?”
Wu Jun couldn’t help but send a voice message to Wang Ping.
“Nothing. There just might be some exceptional situations this time. We must be cautious.”
Wang Ping, with a solemn expression, responded to Wu Jun.
“Uh, exceptional situation?”
Wu Jun was a bit stunned, not understanding what was going on.
Wang Ping remained silent, only looking towards the God-tier Beast Master, the Supreme Commander of the Alliance.
“Mr. Commander, would you mind coming with us? We may need your help.”
After giving it some thought, Wang Ping spoke.
In the Life Simulator, this Supreme Commander of the Alliance is trustworthy.
For that reason, he should be pulled over.
Although his combat capabilities fall short compared to Wang Ping, it could even be said that they are far less than his. Even if his three God-tier Beasts go all out, they would be no more than beings Wang Ping can effortlessly obliterate.
However, in this situation, if an additional high-end combat source could be added, it surely needs to be done.
“This is an issue within you transmigrators. It has nothing to do with me. To say that I am willing to help you is still a matter of benevolence.”
The God-tier Beast Master stared at Wang Ping, and spoke with profound meaning.
“I will provide you with cultivation methods and resources from other worlds.”
Wang Ping, remaining calm, spoke up.
Although he could argue that if the transmigrators can’t resolve the issue, their world would also be troubled, Wang Ping didn’t want to get into a lengthy argument and waste a lot of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! The Battle with the Third Transmigrator Senior (Huge 10,000 Word Chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! The Battle with the Third Transmigrator Senior (Huge 10,000 Word Chapter!)_4
Translator: 549690339
Since the opponent wanted benefits, he would give them what they wanted, and a quick battle was the best approach.
The sooner he deals with that ‘Predecessor Transmigrator,’ the sooner he can feel at ease.
“Hehe, since Mr. Wang Ping said so, I naturally have to help.”
The God-tier Beast Master revealed a smile and spoke enthusiastically.
He was still very interested in Wang Ping’s strength.
The most frustrating thing for Beast Tamers was their frail bodies. If they could obtain powerful methods for themselves from other worlds, they would have no weaknesses left.
Even more so, these methods might be applicable to the tamed beasts, ushering in a new era for the Beast Taming System.
Afterward, Wang Ping and the others didn’t waste any more time and quickly headed to the territory of the God-tier Ferocious Beast – The Destruction Dragon Beast.
Then, the subsequent development didn’t differ too much from Wang Ping’s life simulation.
However, under Wang Ping’s command, the God-tier Beast Tamer chose to hide and not show himself.
“Hehe, trying to deceive me? How naïve.”
The Golden Silk Monkey glanced at the space where the God-tier Beast Tamer was hiding and mocked.
These ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ were experts at hiding their auras and detecting enemies.
After all, if these two basic abilities were insufficient, the probability of death would be too high.
Of course, the most important thing is the ability to escape.
If one can’t escape, everything is just a waste.
“Just keep acting. Once Mr.Dao arrives, I’ll take care of you all.”
The Golden Silk Monkey laughed sinisterly.
On Wang Ping’s side, he also frowned and began to calmly think about many problems.
The Holy Land’s Secret Skill for searching proved to be useless, making things really troublesome.
Logically, ordinary transmigrators of the Beast Taming World shouldn’t have such means.
After all, Beast Taming mainly relied on energy and one’s own abilities to fight.
Perhaps there are some creatures capable of hiding themselves.
But if they are not god-tier, they cannot have any effects in front of him.
Even if they reached god-tier, it still might not work.
After all, his Secret Skill was a powerful one from the Holy Land, not some trash item.
Besides, Wang Ping did not discover any powerful tamed beasts capable of hiding their auras in the life simulation.
If there were any, he would have certainly released them by now. In a desperate situation, using them for a self-explosion or blocking a strike would be a good choice.
This indicates that his method of concealing himself was not from his own abilities, and it might not even originate from this world.
“Alpha, you better tell me now if these ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ are still in contact.”
Suddenly, a thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, his pupils contracted, and he roared in his heart.
