The only possibility Wang Ping could think of for this feeling of unease and the unusual method of concealment was this.
These ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ were still in contact, and even very closely connected.
That’s why the ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ of the Beast Taming World had such a means of concealment and could possess this God-tier Beast.
After all, previous transmigrators didn’t have a golden finger; they could only rely on their growth. All their means were obtained from local forces in various worlds.
If these ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ were really still in contact and closely connected, that would be a huge pitfall.
In other words, they seemed like hunters, hunting down these ‘Predecessor Transmigrators.’
But in reality, it was the other way around; they were the prey.
All of their previous actions were just fishing attempts, including the ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ of the Beast Taming World, who were merely bait.
It was highly possible that an extremely powerful ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ was on their way to them.
If that’s the case, it could explain why the Life Simulator had no response at all.
Because the opponent had not yet arrived in this world.
Before arriving in this world, the Life Simulator wouldn’t be able to simulate the future after the opponent’s arrival.
Even the Abyssal Beasts from before had actually reached Zhao Sihan’s world, but they just hadn’t completely descended into this world yet.
So, it could be simulated.
Upon understanding everything, Wang Ping was truly furious and couldn’t wait to dismantle Alpha.
This pitfall was too big and could even potentially get them all killed, even with the ability to resurrect.
After all, those were ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ who could even overthrow Alpha!
Although the previous generation’s chat group took advantage of the power of other Myriad Heavens Forces and destroyed Alpha, who could guarantee that these ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ didn’t have powerful individuals among them!?
“I don’t know.”
After a moment of silence, Alpha spoke these three words. Her tone was much weaker than before, lacking her usual coldness.
Even if Wang Ping scolded her severely, she couldn’t retort.
There was no way; Alpha lacked confidence.
“You really are…”
Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged, pretending to continue fighting the Destruction Dragon Beast, but anger surged in his heart. He wished he could dismantle Alpha right away.
This guy might genuinely not know.
However, there must also have been intentions to use the lives of the group members as probes.
The current chat group had just begun, and he hadn’t fully grown yet. This fool created such a mission, which was too bizarre.
Wasn’t this just exposing them all to potential danger?

chapters.title: Chapter 456: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_5
Translator: 549690339
Especially since the other party obviously had some connection with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
That is to say, as long as he didn’t use his true power, it would be fine, but once he used his true power, the other party might recognize that the power he possessed came from the Profound World where the Purple Spirit Realm was located.
Perhaps, the other party wouldn’t necessarily think it was definitely the same world, but with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s character, he would definitely conduct a large-scale investigation in the entire Purple Spirit Realm.
Once discovered by him, the consequences could be devastating.
This was a matter of life and death in the true sense.
Fortunately, his previous actions had been low-key and he had never blatantly revealed his whereabouts. Now he had Breath Concealment and the inherited Secret Skills of Heavenly Sword Divine Land and Flaming Fire Emperor, which could hide his identity and prevent others from finding him.
Unless it was the Blood Demon’s Heavenly Eye Divine Skill of the Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation, it would be very difficult to find him.
Otherwise, he estimated that he would be ambushed by the other party the moment he returned.
Of course, this wasn’t necessarily safe either.
After all, in his previous simulations, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor had never been in contact with All Heavens.
Now, these guys might not have much interest, but they did have a shaking probability.
It could be said that his situation suddenly became much more dangerous.
“Alpha, why are you so stupid.”
Wang Ping was really upset.
“The Profound World where the Purple Spirit Realm is located is not accessible to everyone. You don’t have to worry about being suddenly descended upon by a terrifying transmigrator and being slapped to death,” said Alpha quietly.
“Based on the analysis, it is more likely that they used the origin leakage during the destruction of the chat group to create a new chat group and gather the old group members from the previous generation chat group. Such a chat group may also have the function of traveling between worlds, but the restrictions are definitely much greater than the real chat group, and the possibility of sneaking in without being noticed by the big shots of Profound World is very small.”
Wang Ping’s face twitched.
The chances were small, but it meant there was still a possibility.
However, rebuilding the chat group and so on, he had some guesses before, and now he got some confirmation.
It should be said that this possibility was quite high.
These Predecessor ransmigrators were really ruthless, and their abilities were strong enough to destroy the previous generation chat group directly and then create a new chat group themselves.
To be honest, looking at such a pitiful Alpha, Wang Ping really wanted to do the same.
“Warning, you are now in a completely bound state with me. If I am gone, you will die,” Alpha said, frightened by Wang Ping’s sudden idea and warned coldly.
“Humph.” Wang Ping’s eyes flickered but said nothing more.
“You can threaten me, then I can also threaten you. Can you discuss with me before doing something stupid? Otherwise, if I die, you will have to be ‘buried’ with me.” After calming his emotions, Wang Ping snorted coldly in his heart.
“Yes.” After a silence, Alpha replied: “I will discuss with you some major events related to the future of the chat group.”
“That’s more like it.” Wang Ping sighed in relief.
Damn, now he really understood why the chat group was destroyed repeatedly.
With Alpha’s intelligence, it was really beyond words.
In such a situation, as long as the group members grow to a certain level, with a little calculation, the chat group could be destroyed easily.
He really didn’t understand why the creator of the chat group would create such a silly intelligent program.
Could it be just for fun?
“…Don’t insult me anymore,” Alpha said coldly. “And don’t disparage that adult.”
“Yes, yes, yes.” Wang Ping sighed in his heart, too lazy to say anything else.
Then, Wang Ping pulled himself together, no longer pretending, and directly used his true power, unleashing a Terrifying Skill and slapped the destructive waves of the Dragon Beast to pieces.
In the next instant, he moved to the front of the Dragon Beast and smashed its head to pieces with a single punch.
It could be said that he killed it instantly in an extremely brutal way.
Wang Ping’s cultivation was at Nirvana Realm Great Perfection, but he was not only strong in cultivation. In the simulation, he had practiced body refining techniques and could fight Nirvana Realm Great Perfection powerhouses with just his physical strength.
With such physical strength, it was extremely simple to instantly destroy a small God-tier Ferocious Beast.
However, Wang Ping seemed nonchalant, but Wu Jun and the others were astonished.
As for the God-tier Beast Tamer, he felt his eyelids jump as if he had underestimated Wang Ping’s strength.
Originally, he thought he and Wang Ping were evenly matched.
Now it seemed that there was no question of being evenly matched. Wang Ping, if he were serious, could easily kill him.
He was afraid that even if his Beast Taming beasts attacked together, he would still be torn apart by Wang Ping.
At most, it would be a little troublesome for Wang Ping to kill because of the various abilities of the beast taming beasts.
Of course, this was the situation of a direct battle. If he wanted to run, relying on the ability of spatial attribute beast taming beasts, it would be very easy to escape.
At this moment, the Golden Silk Monkey ransmigrator who was hiding and observing this place also got scared.
He also never expected that Wang Ping would be so fierce, directly punching the head of the Dragon Beast to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 160: The Second Generation Chat Group! Battling the Third Predecessor Transmigrator (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
Translator: 549690339
The power displayed was too exaggerated, much stronger than him.
For a moment, he was very glad that he hadn’t tried to design a trap to kill Wang Ping.
Otherwise, it would have been really dangerous.
“However, no matter how strong you are, when Mr.Dao comes, you’re still going to die.”
The Golden Silk Monkey quickly calmed down and showed a cold smile.
Mr.Dao, in the world he traveled through, he mainly cultivated the Sword Spirit.
After so many years of cultivation, his Sword Spirit had become terrifyingly powerful.
In his view, it would only take one attack from Mr.Dao to kill Wang Ping.
“Mr.Wang, what should we do next?”
Wu Jun was puzzled why Wang Ping suddenly attacked, not following the plan at all.
“It seems that they’re not here. Let’s go.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
“Go? Where?”
Wu Jun and the others were puzzled.
“Let’s go back first, and then we’ll slowly look for them.”
Wang Ping didn’t want to waste words and left the mini-world with Wu Jun and the others.
Just as Wang Ping left the small world, he threw a punch, emitting a terrifying skill, and directly blew up the small world.
The exaggerated power made the god-tier Beast Master’s eyelids jump, and even his God-tier Beasts shivered.
Destroying the mini-world with one punch was too domineering and brutal.
“Not dead?”
Wang Ping sensed with his Spiritual Sense and frowned slightly.
It seemed that the other party was not watching from inside but must have been spying on them from somewhere.
Although Wang Ping could cause widespread destruction, there was no need for that.
After all, this was another world, and they couldn’t just do whatever they wanted.
“Since you want to buy time, I’ll wait. I’d like to see how strong the help you’re waiting for will be.”
Instead of searching, Wang Ping sneered and closed his eyes in the air with the others to restore their energy.
Of course, Wang Ping had already contacted Alpha, ready to forcibly transfer them away as soon as they sensed the enemy’s arrival far surpassing their abilities.
At this, Wu Jun and the others were even more puzzled.
Wang Ping had no choice but to remain silent about these things.
However, Wang Ping was well aware that even if he didn’t say anything now, the secret of the chat group might not be safe in the future.
As long as those ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ were not fools, they would eventually talk about when the chat group had been destroyed.
Soon after, Wang Ping seemed to sense something and suddenly looked up at the sky.
Just as Wang Ping looked up, the sky appeared to be filled with dense cracks, which then shattered, revealing a twisted Space Channel.
A figure wearing a Black Robe and a scarred face emerged from it.
The moment this Black Robe figure appeared, a terrifying aura erupted from his body without any reservation.
This pressure was extremely dreadful, causing the entire earth to tremble violently, with earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and fierce winds ensuing.
For a time, all the Living Beings on the Earth, whether it was humans, Beast Tamers, Ferocious Beasts, or other Ethnic Groups, showed frightened expressions and were terrified to the extreme.
Moreover, some unfortunate Living Beings were too close to the source of the pressure and were crushed to death on the spot.
Among them were two human cities.
All the humans and Beast Tamers in these two cities perished without any survivors.
This was because the Black Robe figure had concentrated his pressure on this area, and the result was only a part of the damage suffered by the other areas.
If it were not for this, the intensity of the opponent’s pressure would have wiped out all life on Earth!
“So you guys are the Junior Transmigrators? Only one of you is of decent strength, while the others are pretty weak, which disappoints me.”
The scar-faced Black Robe man stood at the Space Channel, looking down at Wang Ping from above and said coldly.
“I thought I could catch a big fish, but it seems I can only catch a small fish and some shrimps. My expenditure on transmigration won’t be worth it.”
Wang Ping felt the terrifying pressure of the scarred Black Robe man and his face turned grim, already protecting Wu Jun and the others at the first moment.
Otherwise, with their strength, they might have been directly crushed to death by the opponent’s pressure.
“Heh, you think of us as small fish, that’s really arrogant.”
Wang Ping sneered.
The scar-faced man was very powerful, there was no doubt about that. The opponent had definitely surpassed the level of Nirvana Boundary and Quasi-King Battle Skill, reaching the King Realm.
It was unclear which level of battle power he held within the King Realm.
“Heh, am I arrogant? Are you not arrogant, daring to take us ‘Predecessors’ as prey? Truly courting death.”
The scarred Black Robe man scoffed and stepped towards Wang Ping, reaching out his hand.
“However, considering you don’t know the truth about the Alpha-controlled chat group, I can give you a chance. As long as you leave Alpha’s chat group and join our chat group, I can spare your lives.”
“Alpha? Chat group?”
Wu Jun and the others looked at each other in confusion, not knowing what the other party was talking about.
“Talking too much is useless. Let’s battle. The last one standing has the right to speak.”
Wang Ping replied indifferently and coldly.
“Heh, you’re quite arrogant. But I’ll let you see that arrogance needs power to back it up. Otherwise, it’s ignorance.”
The scar-faced Black Robe man snorted and a terrifying Black Long Saber appeared in his hand.
“Hey, Mr.Dao, I’ll leave this arrogant kid to you. I’ll deal with that old guy and these little shrimps. To be honest, I’ve disliked that old guy for a long time. If I were sure I could kill him, I would have done so.”
At this moment, the Golden Silk Monkey also appeared with the fluctuations of space, laughing heinously.
Wang Ping glanced at him but didn’t say anything more.
As long as the Monkey showed up, Wang Ping would be able to use the Secret Skill to lock onto him.
By then, the monkey wouldn’t be able to escape.
“Attack!”
After instructing Wu Jun and the others, Wang Ping yelled and charged at the scarred Black Robe man, the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’, with the Illusionary Void Sword in hand, as his terrifying Sword Spirit burst forth.
“Foolish juniors, can’t you see the difference in our battle capabilities?”
Mr.Dao snorted coldly and struck with a single blow, releasing a pitch-black Sword Spirit that could split Earth in two.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 161: Optimize the Simulator! First Purple Talent! (Bonus 10,000-word chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 161: Optimize the Simulator! First Purple Talent! (Bonus 10,000-word chapter!)
Translator: 549690339
In an instant, the sword spirit and the blade spirit collided with each other, shattering the space like glass and forming a terrifying spatial turbulence.
However, neither side gained the upper hand in this collision, as their attacks canceled each other out.
“Huh?”
Mr.Dao’s pupils contracted, revealing a surprised expression.
Wang Ping’s aura was clearly weaker than his, yet it managed to counter his attack.
This revealed a fact.
This junior was a genius who could fight across different levels.
“Interesting, your power system seems to come from Chuxiao’s world. Your cultivation has reached the Great Perfection Tier in the Nirvana Realm. Normally, someone with this cultivation should be far inferior to me, who have reached the King Realm, yet you can fight toe-to-toe with me.”
Mr.Dao raised his blade, pointing at Wang Ping, and spoke with interest.
“This shows that you are a genius who can fight across different levels. I’m curious, it’s impossible for you to have reached this level without any opportunities and inheritance. How come Mr.Chu did not discover you? Or is it that you are not from the same plane?”
“You talk too much.”
Wang Ping coldly uttered these words, flipping the sword in his hand. Purple flames began to cover it and directly activated a divine skill.
“Divine skill: Devouring Space!”
The powerful divine skill erupted, twisting the space and sealing off and devouring the space around Mr.Dao.
At the same time, a purple fire-like sword spirit burst out, slashing directly towards Mr.Dao.
“A space type divine skill and illusion, huh?”
Mr.Dao felt the abnormality in the space around him, and suddenly the scene before him changed, and his perception was distorted.
“That’s a powerful divine skill indeed. However, you’re still far from killing me with such strength.”
Mr.Dao snorted coldly, as a surge of blade spirit burst out from his body. Mysterious blade patterns appeared around him, and the pitch-black precious blade also emitted a bewitching glow.
Then, he swung his blade out, shattering everything around him.
Whether it was space, the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire, or the sword spirit, all were shattered by his strike.
This power was pure and unadorned, simply overwhelming.
“Kid, if you have any other tricks, try them. As your senior, I will take them all.”
Mr.Dao sneered, transforming into a black light and charging towards Wang Ping. His precious blade slashed viciously at Wang Ping.
Under the direction of his blade, space shattered layer by layer, like paper, dispersing powerful residual energy that destroyed the Earth.
Wang Ping’s face was cold, and he didn’t say much, continuing to use another hidden card.
The Five Elements Domain opened instantly, enveloping Mr.Dao.
“Huh? Is this a domain?”
Mr.Dao’s body stopped, and his powerful blade spirit was crushed by the domain.
This brought a surprised expression to his face.
“Hehe, you really enlightened me. A mere Nirvana Realm Great Perfection junior actually comprehended a true domain. But so what? A domain still can’t trap me.”
Mr.Dao laughed sinisterly. His body trembled and the blade patterns on him became more concentrated, causing his aura to continue to soar and become even more powerful.
At the same time, his Demon Blade emitted an even more bizarre light, forcibly tearing a corner of the domain and creating a gap in the domain.
This also meant that the suppression of the domain became useless to him.
“Kill!”
Mr.Dao roared and charged towards Wang Ping again.
Wang Ping looked solemn, with no intention of giving in. He clashed with Mr.Dao in a frenzy.
Fortunately, Wang Ping had opened the domain, and the battle between the two took place within it.
Otherwise, the aftershocks of the King Realm-level battle alone would be enough to tear the Earth apart into fragments and turn it into chunks of rubble in the starry sky.
Elsewhere, the Golden Silk Monkey was engaged in a fierce battle with a god-tier beast controlled by the Supreme Commander of the Beastmaster Alliance.
It occasionally glanced in the direction of Wang Ping and Mr.Dao, feeling shocked and more grateful.
It never expected that Wang Ping, a fellow transmigrator junior, had hidden such deep strength, being able to hold his own against Mr.Dao.
With such formidable strength, if it had tried to scheme against Wang Ping, it would most likely have failed, and ended up decapitated on the spot.
The God-tier Beast Master and the other beast masters were also astonished.
Wang Ping and Mr.Dao’s powers were too strong, and for the first time, they experienced the feeling of extreme insignificance.
In the face of these two, even a god-tier beast was nothing more than ants, easily crushed.
As for Wu Jun, Liu Mei, Chen Kang, Chen Si, and the others, they were equally shocked.
Their strength was too weak to see any details in the battle, but they could tell how intense the fight was and how terrifying the two’s strength from the destructed Earth.
Keep in mind, this was not an ordinary Earth, but an Earth expanded many times its size!
Soon after, Wang Ping’s voice appeared in Chen Si and Chen Kang’s minds, instructing them to take action.
At the same time, he also instructed Liu Mei to act and try to charm the Golden Silk Monkey.
Chen Si and Chen Kang looked at each other, not hesitating to follow Wang Ping’s instructions and use their Golden Finger ability.
As Chen Si activated his ability, Mr.Dao felt that his power had been forcibly weakened by half.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_2
This sudden change caused Mr.Dao’s face to pale drastically, and he was immediately sliced in half by a single strike from Wang Ping.
However, Mr.Dao also possessed some kind of restoration Divine Skill, he managed to forcefully regenerate his body, intending to temporarily avoid combat.
But Wang Ping wouldn’t let him get away so easily. Chen Kang’s ability was activated again and Mr.Dao’s expression froze once more.
Because he found himself completely immobilized, unable to budge at all.
“Damn it, how does this kid have so many strange abilities? Is he trying to tear me apart alive?”
Mr.Dao cursed Wang Ping in his heart.
At the same time, he had no idea where Wang Ping got all these strange abilities from, but he could only grit his teeth and employ his trump card.
From his forehead, a black pearl suddenly appeared, radiating a bizarre glow and giving off a feeling of extreme danger.
Wang Ping’s pupils constricted, without hesitation, he summoned the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to shield himself.
The next instant, the black pearl collided with the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower. The terrifying power surged out, tearing apart Wang Ping’s domain.
Without the protection of the domain, if the Earth was hit by this scattered energy, it would definitely explode.
This power, after all, was far superior to that of an ordinary King.
Because of this, Wang Ping manipulated the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to shield the Earth with its royal might, preventing the Earth from exploding.
If it did, Wu Jun and the others would die.
It was at this moment that Wang Ping noticed that Mr.Dao’s aura had disappeared with the Spatial Turbulence.
“Has he escaped? The next time we meet, I must kill you.”
The gleam in Wang Ping’s eyes flickered. He snorted coldly, looking quite displeased.
“Wang Ping, during your battle with him, did you hold back? It seemed like you even had some sort of communication with him?”
Alpha’s voice echoed.
“Did I? I was always on guard against his trump card. How can that be considered holding back? Also, didn’t you see that I used the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and still couldn’t kill him? These Predecessor Transmigrators are too strong.”
Wang Ping responded coldly, sounding displeased.
“You have the nerve to scold me. If you hadn’t done these stupid things, would I stand a chance of being targeted in the Purple Spirit Realm? Also, don’t you know what I’m thinking? You’re constantly listening to my thoughts, aren’t you?”
“Sorry, it was my fault.”
Alpha stayed silent for a moment, since he was at fault, all he could do was apologize.
“Seeing as you’re sincere, I’ll pardon you. Remember what you said, don’t do anything stupid again. Otherwise, it doesn’t matter if it’s you or me, we’ll both die.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, scolding him.
“……I understand.” After Alpha muttered these two words, he chose to remain silent.
For a moment, he was unsure of who exactly was in charge.
Was he really at fault?
Although taking such actions entailed great risks, wasn’t it also for the future of the Chat Group?
All in all, it would be equally dangerous if they didn’t figure out whether the previous Transmigrators were still in contact or not.
“I’ve had enough of you. After we take care of this guy, let’s head back immediately. I should also change my location.”
After Wang Ping took a deep breath, he glanced at the Golden Silk Monkey.
At this moment, the Golden Silk Monkey also noticed the abnormal situation on Wang Ping’s side, especially the miniaturized Flaming Fire Emperor Tower floating in Wang Ping’s palm.
“Damn it!”
The Golden Silk Monkey despaired.
For goodness’ sake, what exactly was up with this kid? Not only could he go head-to-head with Mr.Dao, he even had such a treasure.
Now he was done for. Mr.Dao had run away after being beaten; how could he stand a chance of surviving?
He was much weaker than both of them and did not have such extraordinary treasures at his disposal.
“Damn it. If I’m fated to die, then I want to bring you down with me before I die.”
The Golden Silk Monkey quickly calmed down, had a determined look in his eyes, and charged towards Wang Ping.
He dearly hoped that Wang Ping would kill him using the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.
That way, Wang Ping would endure an equal amount of backlash, there would definitely be a chance of taking him down.
Wang Ping saw through the intentions of the Golden Silk Monkey. Snorting coldly, he struck him with the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower as he wished.
Seeing this, the Golden Silk Monkey was overjoyed. A black hamster emerged from his fur. Its eyes glowed red as it seemed to be manipulating a certain ability.
“Liu Mei!”
Just then, Wang Ping abruptly recalled the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and transferred Liu Mei to the front, shouting loudly.
Liu Mei quickly reacted, adjusting her beauty to the highest level and used her Charm Skill.
As Liu Mei activated her ability, the hamster froze, halted its ability, and flew towards Liu Mei’s side.
As for the Golden Silk Monkey, he too froze, looking at Liu Mei with a lovestruck expression. Obviously, he was charmed by Liu Mei.
But, although Liu Mei’s Charm Skill was powerful, she and the Golden Silk Monkey were significantly mismatched in terms of power. At most, her ability could only enchant him for a few seconds.
For individuals of Mr.Dao’s and Wang Ping’s caliber, it was more or less useless.
Of course, this is only relatively speaking. In actuality, her ability was already frightening enough.
Without wasting any time, Wang Ping immediately slapped the Golden Silk Monkey to death.
With Wang Ping killing the Golden Silk Monkey, a system notification echoed in his ear from the chat group.
“Ding, congratulations on successfully killing Transmigrator·Golden Silk Monkey, you have completed the chat group task and received a reward of ten million group points.”
“Humph, ten million.”
Wang Ping snorted, not the least bit pleased.
Just a mere ten million group points. It was completely disproportionate to the difficulty of this task.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_3
An extraordinary king-tier battle power, a Nirvana Boundary, and two old transmigrators; this difficulty is worth ten million—quite the joke.
“Ding, you have received an additional reward of ten million group points.”
At this moment, the system’s voice rang out again, making Wang Ping’s gaze flicker slightly, but he didn’t say anything more.
Clearly, this was compensation from that Alpha guy.
“Mr.Wang, we’ve completed the Group Task! I got a reward of 300,000 group points! I didn’t do anything but got 300,000 group points, it’s exhilarating!”
Wu Jun exclaimed excitedly.
“We got a bit more, both 800,000.” Chen Si and Chen Kang said joyfully.
“I got a little less, 400,000.” Liu Mei also spoke up.
“Well, as long as there’s a harvest, let’s go back. There’s no need to stay in this world.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and spoke.
He needed to hurry back and move his base now, without even wanting the compensation from the Black Element Country.
“Mr.Wang, what should we do about Wu Yueming?”
Liu Mei, with her delicate thoughts, thought of Wu Yueming.
“Let’s see how it goes.”
Wang Ping was silent for a moment and then spoke.
Now that those ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ knew about the existence of ‘Junior Transmigrators’ in this world, they would definitely keep a close eye on it.
One could say that unless Wu Yueming fled to another world, trouble would eventually find him.
However, if he went to other worlds, his Golden Finger would be practically useless.
“There’s no hurry. If other transmigrators appear, Alpha should sense them in advance. At that time, we can still have him move then. For now, let him grow stronger in this world as quickly as possible. He may not have much time left.”
After a pause, Wang Ping added more.
As soon as these words came out, the faces of Liu Mei and the others became solemn, and they became worried in their hearts.
These transmigrators, who were called Junior Transmigrators, were obviously not simple.
Mr.Wang clearly knew something but didn’t tell them.
If their world encountered such a situation in the future, it would be troublesome.
Wang Ping glanced at the crowd, seeing that they had guessed something but didn’t want to say more. He just nodded to the God-tier Beast Master and then disappeared in a flash of white light.
Now was not the time to elucidate the matter with the group members.
After all, he hadn’t thoroughly thought out what he would do in the future. All he could do was take it one step at a time.
What they needed wasn’t worry and planning, but strength.
Only by acquiring formidable strength can they break through the impasse.
As Wang Ping returned, Wu Jun and the others followed suit.
Then, the group became lively as they discussed the content of this task, making everyone in the group feel shaken and start a discussion.
In the Purple Spirit Realm where Wang Ping was located, he began to move as soon as he returned.
At the same time, as Wang Ping was moving, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao of the Jiuyou Demon Sect saw the chat content from Mr.Dao.
“That is the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, the Life-bound Emperor Artifact of the Flaming Fire Emperor. It looks like the plane that this Junior Transmigrator has traveled to is the Purple Spirit Realm I’m in. What a coincidence.”
Red glints flashed in Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s eyes, and he sneered.
“However, since he’s already grown to this level and obtained the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, he must have been on guard against me the whole time.”
“Mr.Chu, if possible, please don’t kill him. During the battle, he seemed to reveal through his divine skills that he’s willing to cooperate with us. Of course, I don’t know if it’s just my imagination.”
Mr.Dao’s private chat appeared again.
“Hehe, he indeed seems to be a suspect for letting you go. With his performance combined with the power of the Emperor Tower, if he wanted to kill, he would probably have a success rate of 20% to 30%, but he didn’t. His actions were somewhat suspicious. Of course, this doesn’t rule out that he didn’t want to risk his life for Alpha.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao shook the jade cup in his hand and said calmly.
“In the end, in such a chat group, those who would risk their lives for Alpha are the fools. I don’t think a ‘Junior Transmigrator’ who has grown to this level without me noticing is a fool.”
“If he thinks so, he can only use this ambiguous method to express his thoughts. Alpha, who has experienced two destructions, will definitely monitor the mental activities of the chat group members at all times.”
Mr.Dao felt that it made sense and became more convinced in his heart that it wasn’t an illusion.
“He’s very cautious, and even if he has such thoughts, he can still deny it later when he faces us, saying that we stirred up strife. In that case, Alpha would believe in the juniors he’s been monitoring more than us.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor chuckled.
“However, this kid is quite talented. I suspect he also used a similar method to deceive himself. But unlike us, he was probably monitored more closely, so his approach seems a bit more unique. Otherwise, even an Alpha who had learned a lesson wouldn’t be able to detect it.”
Mr.Dao said, laughing.
“Of course, it’s also possible that all of this is just our imagination, and he doesn’t have that intention, and is still willing to be a dog in the chat group.”
“If he truly has that intention, I would consider sparing him. This premise is that he doesn’t pose a threat to me. Otherwise, regardless of his intentions, I will kill him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 161: Optimizing the simulator! The first Purple Talent! (Additional chapter of ten thousand words!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 161: Optimizing the simulator! The first Purple Talent! (Additional chapter of ten thousand words!)_4
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao coldly spoke.
“Of course,” Mr.Dao nodded in agreement: “Among us old-timers, it’s impossible for us to truly trust each other, let alone these younger generations with uncertain loyalties.”
“Hmm,” Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao merely nodded his head, narrowing his eyes and refraining from further comments.
Shortly afterwards, the whole Jiuyou Demon Sect began to mobilize, searching for traces of Wang Ping.
Meanwhile, Wang Ping had directly arrived at the Heavenly Sword Divine City and could finally sigh in relief.
In the Heavenly Sword Divine City, as long as he kept a low profile, no problems would arise.
Even if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao were able to locate him through some means, as long as Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao himself did not take action, Wang Ping had nothing to fear.
If Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao acted personally, Wang Ping might be caught off guard and killed once, but the Sky Emperor would definitely sense it and descend here immediately.
Even if the Sky Emperor could not resist him, he could still buy enough time for Wang Ping. Once Wang Ping revived, he could easily escape to other worlds to avoid being killed again.
Having settled in the Heavenly Sword Divine City, Wang Ping opened the chat group page, used a 90% discount coupon, and several tens of millions of group points, to purchase the Golden Finger Optimizer.
After Wang Ping purchased the Golden Finger Optimizer, a glowing golden light appeared in the palm of his hand, and the system voice chimed in.
“Ding, do you want to optimize the Golden Finger now?”
“Optimize.”
Wang Ping said without hesitation.
As soon as the words fell, Wang Ping felt the golden light merge into his body.
“Ding, the optimization of your exclusive Golden Finger Life Simulator has been successful. The specific functions are as follows, please read carefully.”
After that, the system voice rang out again, and a pale-blue luminescent screen appeared before Wang Ping’s eyes.
Wang Ping looked at it expectantly.
Life Simulator:
Function : The Text Simulation function has been upgraded to Immersive Simulation, the host can become wholly engrossed in the simulation, as if they are experiencing those things personally.
Function : Fast Forward function, during the simulation, if the host feels that the current development is insignificant, they can selectively fast forward. At this time, text simulation will appear, and the picture will also be streamlined into a rapid TV drama-like plot flashing through the host’s mind.
Function : The Talent Refresh mechanism of the Life Simulator has been updated, from now on, talents above Red Talent level can be refreshed.
Function : The Reward Mechanism of the Life Simulator has changed, anything that appears in the simulation, even without touching it, may be refreshed. At the same time, the host can choose to forfeit all rewards from this round.
Warm Reminder: The bugs in the Life Simulator have been repaired. In the future, rewards will not be traps, and the creation of things such as Soul Fragment Replicas in the real world will not happen. Please be at ease, host.
“The optimized Life Simulator really is not bad, it solved every potential problem just as I wished!”
Wang Ping nodded satisfactorily, finally allowing himself a contented nod.
If it’s an immersive simulation, then there’s no need to worry about being stabbed in the back by the simulated Wang Ping because it will be his own self driving the story, not a new simulated Wang Ping.
Besides, the fast-forward feature is also pretty useful.
This way, there’s no need to spend thousands or tens of thousands of years in cultivation every time, which would be utterly tedious.
After all, experiencing it once is fine, but having multiple simulations and continually experiencing the same things would be extremely monotonous.
Especially with such a long time span, it’s even more monotonous.
“But what surprises me most is function ③. I was wondering why even after I had refreshed Red Talents multiple times, I couldn’t refresh a single Purple Talent. It turns out that the previous Golden Finger was of too low a grade. Before it was optimized, it could not refresh Purple Talents at all. Thinking about it, I didn’t seem to have any blue talents before my first Golden Finger optimization, let alone Red Talents.”
Looking at function ③, Wang Ping can’t help but comment wryly.
In this day and age, regardless of where you are, everything requires ‘money’.
The only difference is what ‘money’ is needed.
“System, has the cost for me to simulate changed?”
Immediately, Wang Ping composed himself and asked in his mind.
“No.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“That’s good,” Wang Ping nodded and said: “Well, I want to start the Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, payment successful, the Life Simulator has started, Talent Refreshing in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God; Red Talent: War Soul Enchantment; Blue Talent: Moon Song; Green Talent: Fingering Genius.”
Purple Talent – Enlightenment: With this talent, the host’s understanding will greatly improved, reaching the realm of gods, and can easily comprehend many mysteries of cultivation.
Red Talent – War Soul Enchantment: With this talent, the host can refine their battle will, enchant weapons, and make them unleash terrifying power.
Blue Talent – Moon Song: With this talent, the host can increase a certain fighting power by singing under the moonlight.
Green Talent – Fingering Genius: With this talent, the host will obtain an excellent talent in fingering.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_5
“Holy shit! A Purple Talent!”
Wang Ping stared at the refreshed Talent, and even with his current composure, he was still completely stunned.
He couldn’t help it; he had never refreshed a Purple Talent in his many simulations.
And now, he had directly refreshed a Purple Talent!
Moreover, this was a single-target intelligence-enhancing Purple Talent. One could imagine just how powerful this Purple Talent would be in improving intelligence.
Even more, it wasn’t just a Purple Talent that had been refreshed this time, but also a Red Talent.
The War Soul Enchantment, a brand-new Red Talent, also belonged to the amplification category, but it only amplified weapon strength, and was surely not weak either.
However, the originally dazzling Red Talent seemed somewhat dim in front of the aura of the Purple Talent.
As for the Blue Talent and Green Talent, Wang Ping didn’t even glance at them again, showing disdain.
“System, I choose the Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God!”
Wang Ping said very joyfully and expectantly in his heart.
God is a heavyweight word, a level pursued by countless Emperors.
Enlightenment to God, let him see just how awesome this intelligence really is.
As for the Red Talent, although it was a pity, it had to be discarded now.
After all, he couldn’t choose two talents at the same time.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The familiar voice of the system sounded.
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping felt a flash in his consciousness, as if something had changed.
However, when he looked at his palm, he felt no change at all.
“Now, this should be the fake world created by the Life Simulator. Immersive simulation is really amazing.”
Wang Ping looked at his own palm, mobilizing the power within his body, and sighed in amazement.
“System, use the fast-forward function.”
Wang Ping sighed lightly and said without hesitation.
“Ding, fast-forwarding….”
As the system’s voice rang out, the familiar luminescent screen appeared in front of Wang Ping’s eyes, and the text also emerged.
[Day 1, you are well aware that the upcoming situation is not good, so you are diligently cultivating to become stronger quickly.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year has passed. Due to your astonishing intelligence, you have easily comprehended the Minor Space Domain and the Minor Sword Domain. At the same time, you have had some ideas about improving your Cultivation Skills.]
Wang Ping looked at this simulation content and fell silent.
This was outrageous.
One year!
It took only one year to comprehend the Minor Space Domain and the Minor Sword Domain.
Previously, the simulated Wang Ping needed to spend hundreds of years to achieve this.
“The gap between Red Talent and Purple Talent is even greater than the gap between a dog and a human.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
[At the same time, many things happened during this year. Jiuyou Demon Sect found out what you did on the Archipelago and guessed that you should have come from the Profound Turtle Continent to the Archipelago and then went to the Sword Domain.]
[At the same time, they also found out that Cai Yonglong and you were companions and returned to the Profound Turtle Continent.]
[However, although Jiuyou Demon Emperor had investigated many things and found Cai Yonglong’s location, he did not personally take action. Because once he attacked the Profound Turtle Continent, he would be noticed by the Emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm, who would then gang up on him.]
[Of course, this kind of small matter does not require his personal action. Although there are seals and prohibitions on the Profound Turtle Continent, as long as Demonic Path Cultivators above the Nirvana Boundary don’t cross over, they will not disturb the Profound Turtle.]
[That is to say, it was very easy for him to send people to capture Cai Yonglong alive. As a result, Cai Yonglong was simply and neatly caught alive by the people of Jiuyou Demon Sect. Through Cai Yonglong’s memory, he obtained information about you. Therefore, Jiuyou Demon Sect became more solemn in their hearts, and they had the intention to kill you.]
[Afterward, Jiuyou Demon Emperor tried to use Cai Yonglong to contact you, wanting to catch you with the help of Cai Yonglong. However, you were very clear about what would happen, so before escaping to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, you threw away anything related to Cai Yonglong on the road. As a result, he couldn’t contact you.]
[Finally, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could only send people everywhere to search for you. However, you were hiding too well, and Jiuyou Demon Sect couldn’t find you for the time being. Therefore, in order to prevent things from getting even more complicated, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao found the Heavenly Secret Pavilion, which could speculate about Heavenly Secrets, in order to use their means of divining your location.]
[It’s just that the disciples of the Heavenly Secret Pavilion have always been upright and would never do things for the Demon Clan. As a result, Jiuyou Demon Emperor was turned away, and in his anger he directly destroyed the Heavenly Secret Pavilion. Thus, the inheritance of the Heavenly Secret Pavilion that had lasted for thousands of years was completely lost.]
“The Heavenly Secret Pavilion, what a tragedy.”
Wang Ping admired the actions of the Heavenly Secret Pavilion in his heart and also sighed at their destruction.
“I must quickly gain the power to contend with this guy, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. There’s not much time left for me.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, and his heart became even heavier.
All of this would happen within a year; otherwise, he wouldn’t know how many people would die miserably because of him, and he himself could also be in danger.
After all, the simulated Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could not use external forces, but the real Jiuyou Demon Emperor had contact with the predecessors in the Second-generation Chat Group.
Who knew if he would get some shocking secret methods or treasures from the other ransmigrators and easily find him.

chapters.title: Chapter 463: 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 161: Optimizing the Simulator! The First Purple Talent! (10,000-Character Additional Chapter!)_6
Wang Ping didn’t dare to gamble, nor could he.
As Wang Ping’s emotions surged, the simulation continued.
[In the blink of an eye, twenty years have passed, and you have successfully improved your cultivation skill to the emperor-level, making it more perfect, more accommodating, and easier to switch power.]
[At the same time, during these twenty years, you have successfully comprehended the Great Completion of various domains, such as the Five Elements Domain, Domain of the Sword, Wind Thunder Domain, Ice Domain, and so on.]
[For you now, making progress in the domain is as simple as eating and drinking, and it’s really nothing to brag about.]
[Next, instead of continuing to comprehend domains and divine skills, you choose to find a secluded place and break through to the King realm. After accumulating for so many years, you feel it’s time to break through to the King realm. Once you become a king, your strength will skyrocket again. At that time, you have the confidence to fight anyone below the Quasi-Emperors with your own strength.]
[Soon after, with the help of the Ice Palace’s Delivery Array, you headed to the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[You are well aware that breaking through in the Eternal Frozen Land is the safest option because the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao would not dare to act recklessly in this place. Once he appears, he will definitely be met with a fatal blow from Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.]
[Your breakthrough to the King realm attracted a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. Although you made arrangements beforehand, you still alarmed the region of the Eternal Frozen Soil Area, attracting many masters from Profound Ice Sect and Ice Poison Sect to watch.]
[They were amazed at the horror of your Heavenly Tribulation. However, they were even more shocked by your strength. Facing such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, you effortlessly crossed the tribulation, and in the end, you even managed to blow up the tribulation, causing a resonance between heaven and earth. Finally, you became a king of a region.]
[Among them, the Supreme Elder of the Profound Ice Sect, Profound Ice Taoist, who claimed to be the disciple of Profound Ice Emperor, stared at you with flickering eyes.]
[At the same time, Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Emperor at the center of the Eternal Frozen Land, also noticed your Crossing Tribulation and was very surprised by your talent. As a Quasi-Immortal, she could see your background and knew that you were very young, perhaps not even a hundred years old.]
[Becoming a king of a region in under a hundred years was indeed astounding; even she couldn’t match that during her younger years. It could be said that no one in the entire Purple Spirit Realm could compare to you throughout history.]
[She became curious about you and wanted to invite you over for a visit. However, she seemed to sense something and decided to continue watching silently.]
[On your side, you keenly sensed Profound Ice Taoist’s gaze and slightly frowned. Without saying much, you chose to leave quickly and headed deeper into the Eternal Frozen Land.]
[Seeing you entering the depths of the Eternal Frozen Land, Profound Ice Taoist panicked, fearing that you might escape, making it difficult for him to find you later on. Therefore, he chased after you.]
[Seeing this, the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect also chased after you.]
[Soon, the three of you kings delved deep into the Eternal Frozen Land.]
The simulation paused here, and the various scenes quickly passed through Wang Ping’s mind.
There were scenes of his cultivation and other scenes.
In the end, his vision changed, and he found himself in the Eternal Frozen Land.
Then, Wang Ping felt as if he had taken over the body of the ‘simulated Wang Ping.’
At the same time, he also sensed Profound Ice Taoist and Ice Poison Daoist following closely behind him.
“This immersive simulation experience is indeed much better than just text simulations.”
Wang Ping felt the power within him and sighed.
The immersive simulation had various scenes that allowed him to directly see what happened during the simulation.
Moreover, the insights and combat experiences of the simulated Wang Ping were swiftly absorbed by him in a gentle manner.
That is to say, the insights of the simulated Wang Ping were also synchronously obtained by him.
Even if he didn’t choose the Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God this time, he could still gain insights on enlightenment.
As for insights into cultivation skills, divine skills, and domains, they were also available.
This benefit was practically a complete package.
Later, he wouldn’t even need to choose rewards related to his own enlightenment.
Of course, things like cultivation skills that he didn’t personally comprehend, he probably still had to choose to possess them.
“I have to say, this Purple Talent is really overpowered. Creating emperor-level cultivation skills, comprehending so many Great Completion domains in just over twenty years is simply terrifying.”
Wang Ping sighed again and then looked down with a chuckle.
After that, Wang Ping collected his thoughts, stopped flying, turned around, and looked at the two people behind him indifferently: “Fellow taoist, I don’t know your intentions for following me.”
This is another advantage of immersive simulation.
In important subplots determined by the Life Simulator, he can choose how to react autonomously.
In other words, in the future, he can take risks at any time in the past text simulations that were previously impossible.
In past simulations, the ‘simulated’ Wang Ping wasn’t willing to take risks, so he didn’t dare to venture.
However, Wang Ping, from now on, can take risks and gain more significant opportunities.
After all, this optimization changed even the reward mechanism. He doesn’t have to touch it; as long as it appears, even if he only sees it, it may refresh as a reward.
For this reason, sometimes taking risks is essential.
“Haha, fellow taoist, I have no ill intentions. I just wanted to congratulate you on successfully crossing the tribulation and becoming a king. Therefore, I would like to invite you to be my guest at the Profound Ice Sect.” Profound Ice Taoist said, looking friendly and bowing.
“I am also just curious about you, fellow taoist. I want to invite you to be a guest at my Ice Poison Sect, so I followed you here, and I meant no harm.”
Ice Poison Daoist similarly bowed and said.
“No ill intentions?”
Wang Ping sneered coldly and sharply gazed at the Profound Ice Sect’s Supreme Elder, the Profound Ice Taoist.
If it were still just text simulations, Wang Ping would not have thought much about it. He might even have considered visiting the two sects as a guest.
However, now it was an immersive simulation, and Wang Ping had caught the keywords “escaping” from the text simulation during the fast-forwarding process.
The Profound Ice Taoist was afraid of Wang Ping running away, so he chased after him.
That is to say, Profound Ice Taoist had malicious intentions towards him.
“Fellow taoist, I really have no ill intentions. I don’t know why you are so suspicious of me.”
Profound Ice Taoist forced a smile.
“What’s wrong with wanting to befriend a talent like you, fellow taoist, who has great potential to become an emperor in the future?”
“Wrong, very wrong.” Wang Ping raised his Illusionary Void Sword, pointed it at the Profound Ice Taoist, and calmly said.
Now, the Illusionary Void Sword had also been turned into a King Artifact after being tempered by the Heavenly Tribulation during Wang Ping’s tribulation, revealing its sharp edge.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned.
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned.
“What did I do wrong?” Profound Ice Taoist said in bewilderment.
The Ice Poison Daoist standing aside was also puzzled.
Although he considered Profound Ice Taoist to be of suspicious origin, there was nothing wrong with his previous statement.
Who wouldn’t want to seize the opportunity to become acquainted with a potential future emperor? He had the same intentions.
That’s why he had followed along.
“I have a secret skill that detects malice. You have been staring at me with an unusual gaze throughout my Crossing Tribulation, and your malice was all too evident,” Wang Ping said coldly.
At his words, Profound Ice Taoist’s pupils contracted, and his complexion noticeably changed.
His gaze indeed had been unusual.
Logically, Wang Ping, who was in the process of crossing the tribulation, shouldn’t have been able to notice it.
Besides, a secret skill that detects malice, does such a skill even exist?
Why had he never heard of it before?
At the side, the Ice Poison Daoist also observed the change in Profound Ice Taoist’s expression, and his face subtly shifted, becoming more alert.
The origins of Profound Ice Taoist were suspicious. He had never trusted him or the Profound Ice Sect he had created.
But what he could not understand was why the Ice Poison Daoist had targeted Wang Ping with such intense malice.
Harboring malice toward someone who might become an emperor in the future, how is that different from seeking your own death?
“Haha, have you discovered it? In that case, I won’t pretend anymore.” The expression on the face of the Profound Ice Taoist had reached a point of extreme coldness, and his aura was completely revealed.
It was the formidable cultivation of the King Realm 7th Tier.
The disparity between each realm becomes larger the further one advances in cultivation.
Especially when one reaches the King Realm.
The King Realm 7th Tier is already in the latter stages of the King Realm, with incredibly strong combat power.
Therefore, he was fully confident that he could kill Wang Ping, the newly ascended king who had just crossed the tribulation.
Even if Wang Ping was a gifted youngster, there was no way he could fight him across so many sub-realms.
As for the Supreme Elder of the Ice Poison Sect, Ice Poison Daoist, he also did not consider him a threat.
Though the King Realm 6th Tier was strong, it still fell far short of him and could be manipulated at will.
“Before me, no matter what monster you are, you will be suppressed by me.” Profound Ice Taoist did not bother to explain why he was targeting Wang Ping. He gave a cold cry and unveiled his Minor Ice Domain, enveloping the entire space.
Seeing this, the face of the Ice Poison Sect’s Supreme Elder changed immediately. He quickly activated his own domain, countering the pressure and flashing to one side, for fear of being affected by the Profound Ice Taoist.
“A tiny pearl also shines.”
Wang Ping sneered and likewise utilized his Great Achieved Ice Domain, suppressing back the Minor Ice Domain of Profound Ice Taoist.
For a time, the already cold Eternal Frozen Land became even colder, freezing a quasi-King into an ice crystal, unable to move.
Even the space was making cracking sounds, filled with a fog of frost.
“What!?”
This startled both Profound Ice Taoist and Ice Poison Daoist, and their pupils contracted, revealing incredulous expressions.
What a joke. He had just become a king and already had a Great Completion Domain, this was truly beyond belief.
Considering that he must have comprehended this before becoming a King, it was even more outrageous.
Comprehending the Great Completion Domain at the Nirvana Boundary, that was something that many Great Completion Kings couldn’t achieve.
At least, having cultivated for so many years, and with the naturally conducive environment of the Eternal Frozen Land, Profound Ice Taoist hadn’t been able to comprehend the Great Achieved Ice Domain.
“So what if you have a Great Achieved Ice Domain, your cultivation is weaker than mine, I will still suppress you!” Profound Ice Taoist roared angrily, envy seeping out at Wang Ping’s prodigious talent. His mana surged out, and he suddenly struck a blow at Wang Ping. He formed a terrifying icy hand, intending to explode Wang Ping along with his Great Achieved Domain.
“Is the Great Achieved Ice Domain not enough? Then how about adding two more Great Achieved Domains,” Wang Ping said coldly. Two more Great Completion Domains instantly appeared, blending into the Ice Domain.
These were the Illusion Domain and the Domain of the sword.
The combination of three domains made Profound Ice Taoist’s attack struggle like it was stuck in a quagmire, its attack power and speed were greatly reduced, and in the end, it was crushed by Wang Ping’s single hand.
Even Profound Ice Taoist himself felt a great resistance. His body was frozen and seemed to be cut by a sharp sword.
At the same time, the scene in front of him changed, plunging him into various illusions, which made his face change drastically, his heart horrified.
The overlay of three Great Completion Domains wasn’t much weaker than the Perfect Domain.
And at the King Tier, the strength of the Domain has a significant impact on combat power, far greater than the influence of cultivation skills and Divine Skills.
Not to mention, Wang Ping’s other attributes significantly exceed Profound Ice Taoist’s.
Therefore, even if Wang Ping had just entered the King Realm, he could easily suppress Profound Ice Taoist, a relatively common King Realm 7th Tier powerhouse.
The Ice Poison Daoist on the side widened his eyes, his expression was like he had seen a ghost.
An upstart who had just entered the King Realm, had comprehended three Great Completion Domains during the Nirvana Boundary. It was so outrageous.
For other kings, comprehending a Great Completion Domain in their lifetime was quite an accomplishment, three was unthinkable.
Even those Emperors might not have been able to achieve this feat in the King Realm, let alone comprehending three Great Completion Domains at the Nirvana Boundary.
“This child… his talent is astonishing…” In the depths of the Eternal Frozen Land, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan also paused briefly, and couldn’t help but murmur.
She prided herself most on her comprehension abilities.
She had always believed that her comprehension could rank among the top three among all the gifted youngsters from the ancient times to the present and future in the Purple Spirit Realm.
Before, she had only praised Wang Ping’s extraordinary talent, but had not considered him surpassing her in comprehension abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 465: 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_2
Now it seems, she’s not as talented as Wang Ping in terms of comprehension.
This is the demeanor of the Divine Realm.
If Wang Ping doesn’t fall midway, he really has a great chance of entering the Divine Realm.
He may even step into the Divine Realm and fly to the Upper Realm before her.
As Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, was thinking, Wang Ping used his Divine Skills again, directly inflicting heavy injuries on the Profound Ice Taoist.
“Speak, what is your purpose? If you answer my question, I might consider sparing your life,” Wang Ping said coldly, looking at the heavily wounded Profound Ice Taoist.
“Heh, you think I would believe your words?”
The Profound Ice Taoist mocked.
“I didn’t expect you to believe me, I just wanted to give it a try,” Wang Ping spoke indifferently, as he was about to attack and directly kill the Profound Ice Taoist who was a powerful late-stage King Realm cultivator.
Since there’s no hope of getting any information and he has no ability to prevent the other party from self-detonating, it’s better to kill him directly and put an end to any future troubles, as well as to prevent the other party from counterattacking when they are about to die.
However, just as Wang Ping was about to make his move, the space seemed to be frozen, and neither he, the Profound Ice Taoist, nor the Ice Poison Daoist could move at all.
This made Wang Ping’s expression change, wanting to use the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to break the spatial constraint.
However, it was useless.
It seemed like even the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower felt a great Terror-inducing Skill and started to shudder.
Wang Ping’s heart skipped a beat, as if he thought of something and looked toward the Eternal Frozen Land.
At this moment, the space rippled, and a stunning figure with blue hair and blue eyes appeared.
“Master!”
The moment this figure appeared, the Ice Poison Daoist became excited, with a hint of moisture in her eyes.
She always believed that the Profound Ice Emperor had not fallen, and now it finally confirmed her belief.
“It really is her,” Wang Ping sighed in relief when he saw the visitor.
If it were her, Wang Ping would not worry about her hurting him.
Rather, being by her side would be the safest place, and no one would dare hurt him.
As for the Profound Ice Taoist, he was terrified.
He had always claimed to be the successor of the Profound Ice Emperor and had established the Profound Ice Sect, so naturally, he was alarmed when he encountered the real deity.
But what frightened him even more was that he couldn’t even detonate his Mana to self-destruct.
It seemed that his Mana had been frozen, unable to move.
What a terrifying power this was! Even the Emperors didn’t possess such a power!
“Junior Wang Ping, pay my respects to Senior Profound Ice Emperor,” Wang Ping said with a smile as he felt his body relaxed and able to move again, saluting Ji Bingyan.
Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, nodded slightly, not saying much, but looked at the Profound Ice Taoist and directly tore open his Sea of Consciousness, forcibly soul-searching.
The Profound Ice Taoist screamed in pain, his face full of agony.
After all, even a King Realm cultivator could not bear the pain of having their soul forcibly torn apart.
Wang Ping looked at this scene with some astonishment.
As expected of a Quasi-Immortal Master, with just a glance at a King Realm cultivator, she forcibly tore open their Sea of Consciousness to conduct the soul-searching, truly domineering.
“Is it related to that junior from Jiuyou? It seems that he is indeed a disaster. I should have killed him back then. Unfortunately, I was in closed-door cultivation, and he escaped,” the Profound Ice Emperor casually froze the body and soul of the Profound Ice Taoist completely before speaking up.
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes at this statement, gaining a clear understanding of many things in his heart.
It seemed that this Profound Ice Taoist wasn’t as simple as he had guessed, wanting to use Ji Bingyan’s reputation to establish power and obtain cultivation resources; he was a pawn of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao!
No doubt, his establishment of the Profound Ice Sect here was to monitor Ji Bingyan in the Eternal Frozen Soil Area.
If he could provoke Ji Bingyan to come out and destroy the Profound Ice Sect, that would be the best outcome.
After all, it was evident that Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, could not leave the Eternal Frozen Soil Area casually, perhaps this was related to her cultivation.
The reason why the Profound Ice Taoist tried to kill him was now clear as well.
The other party had guessed his identity through the Cultivation Skill characteristics and the Illusionary Void Sword revealed during his Heavenly Tribulation.
Though he had changed his appearance, these two elements couldn’t be concealed.
“There are more pawns of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao than I imagined. Not only did he establish the powerful Jiuyou Demon Sect, but he probably also has many hidden pieces within the orthodox sects. Fortunately, I have been very cautious in my actions since acquiring the simulator, otherwise, I would have been finished,” Wang Ping sighed internally.
“Wang Ping, come with me,” Ji Bingyan said to Wang Ping as he pondered, nodding slightly at the Ice Poison Daoist before tearing open a Space Channel and stepping in.
Without hesitation, Wang Ping quickly followed.
As he entered the Space Channel, Wang Ping appeared in a world covered with ice crystals.
The feeling was just like entering a Door of Anywhere.
Quasi-Immortals were just too powerful, and the space could be manipulated and compressed at will.
Of course, this was in the Purple Spirit Realm, and if it were in the Upper Realm, Quasi-Immortals probably couldn’t do this.
After all, the strength of space was different in different worlds.
“Wang Ping, what are your views on Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who also comes from a foreign domain?” Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, invited Wang Ping to sit on the ice chair opposite her before she slowly spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_3
“Mortal enemy, must be killed.”
Wang Ping fell silent for a moment, then said solemnly.
“It seems that the enmity between you two is not small.”
Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan spoke up.
“To tell you the truth, I also have a negative impression of the People from Outside the Domain. However, I can see that your aura is very pure. You are not a murderous person, so I will not do anything to you.”
“With Elder’s words, I am reassured. I wonder if I can become your apprentice.”
Wang Ping laughed lightly, then asked seriously.
Since he had come here, he would not be satisfied unless he could benefit from Ji Bingyan, who was at the Quasi-Immortal tier.
At the same time, even if Ji Bingyan did not accept him as a disciple, he had the idea of staying here without leaving.
Here, he didn’t have to worry about the danger posed by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. He could cultivate and pursue Enlightenment worry-free.
By the time the great battle between the two realms began, his cultivation would definitely have reached a considerable level.
“All right. Although your cultivation path is mixed, since you have also achieved something in the Ice Path, it would not be a waste to take you as a disciple.”
The Profound Ice Emperor nodded her head and chose to accept Wang Ping as her disciple.
“Master, you’re being modest. With your Quasi-Immortal cultivation, even teaching other aspects of cultivation could be greatly beneficial for me.”
Wang Ping complimented her.
Joking aside, she is currently the only Quasi-Immortal in the Purple Spirit Realm. Even if she specializes in the Ice Path, her understanding of other paths would also certainly be excellent. Ordinary emperors might not even match up to her.
“Quasi-Immortal… I am not considered a Quasi-Immortal yet, I have not truly reached this realm. So, I need to remain in seclusion almost all the time.”
Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan shook her head.
“Uh…” Wang Ping paused.
It turns out that Ji Bingyan is not yet a Quasi-Immortal. No wonder she never appeared, even when the Purple Spirit Realm was invaded in a simulation and every Quasi-Immortal showed up. She didn’t even appear when the simulated Wang Ping was killed.
It seems that she reached the Quasi-Immortal tier at that time, and the timing was very close, making it look like she had just made the breakthrough.
“No problem, now that I have reached this stage, I actually no longer need detailed instruction from others.”
Then, Wang Ping spoke with a smile.
“Yes, it should be so.”
Ji Bingyan nodded.
Next, Wang Ping paid his respects to Ji Bingyan in the Inviting Teaching Ceremony. After Ji Bingyan passed on all her Quasi-Immortal Skills and Divine Skills to Wang Ping and left him with some cultivation resources, she returned to her seclusion.
What could Wang Ping say? This master might be the most irresponsible one, but she was undoubtedly the strongest.
“System, accelerate the process for me.”
Then, Wang Ping took a deep breath and spoke silently in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice responded and simulation text appeared.
[After Ji Bingyan re-entered seclusion, you started comprehending her cultivation skills and divine skills, and continued to cultivate.]
[At the same time, the news of you defeating Profound Ice Taoist naturally reached the ears of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. This made him both surprised and angry, for your growth rate exceeded his expectations. What shocked and enraged him more was that you had managed to summon Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and even got taken away by her.]
[That is to say, unless he also steps into that level and reaches the Quasi-Immortal tier, he can never lay a hand on you. And without eliminating you, a major hidden danger, he would never feel at ease.]
[However, reaching the Quasi-Immortal tier is impossible. The current Purple Spirit Realm would find it hard to produce a Quasi-Immortal in a short period of time. Breaking through to the Quasi-Immortal level requires a huge amount of energy, enough that even an emperor might not be able to gather it in their lifetime. Although cultivation on the Demon Path is somewhat easier, it is also impossible to breakthrough in a normal way.]
[The reason why this has happened is because the ‘leading character of the era’, who led the Purple Spirit Realm to victory over the Blood Demon Realm ten thousand years ago, consumed too many precious cultivation resources of the Purple Spirit Realm in the process of breaking through to the Divine Realm. Even to breakthrough to the Divine Realm, he drained the divine source of the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[With the disappearance of the divine source, the Purple Spirit Realm has lost the conditions to produce ascendants in the Divine Realm. Even to produce Quasi-Immortals has become very difficult and can only be achieved through special means for breakthrough.]
[In the end, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao sighed and gave up the idea of attacking you. He planned to wait for the chance when the two realms would intersect again in a thousand years. When the great battle between the two realms broke out again, he would have a chance to breakthrough to the Quasi-Immortal tier, and even ascending to the Divine Realm would not be impossible.]
“So, there are no conditions for a breakthrough to the Divine Realm in the Purple Spirit Realm… The ‘leading character of the era’ from ten thousand years ago really made a thorough move. He can be said to have shut the door to the future generations.”
Looking at the simulation content, Wang Ping frowned and mumbled in his heart.
Draining the divine source of the Purple Spirit Realm, although Wang Ping did not know how important this divine source was to the Purple Spirit Realm, it must have had a major impact on the Purple Spirit Realm.
Perhaps, the divine source is a renewable resource, but after being drained, it can no longer regenerate.
Besides, it was already difficult to breakthrough to the Quasi-Immortal tier. Without the corresponding breakthrough resources, it became even more difficult.
No wonder Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was so desperate to disrupt things.
With the path gone, how could he not be anxious?
No one wants to be turned into a handful of yellow soil after many years, with all their eons of cultivation coming to nothing.
No matter which world, most cultivators usually pursue the belief of immortality, and this Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao is no exception.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_4
It can be said that because he is a transmigrator, he knows more and is more obsessed with the pursuit of immortality.
“I really don’t know how my master broke through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier.”
Wang Ping thought of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan again and couldn’t help but sigh.
Not appearing for eternity, she broke through from Quasi-Emperor to Quasi-Immortal tier, which is very shocking.
Becoming a Quasi-Immortal under such adverse conditions, her talent is beyond doubt.
Next, Wang Ping calmed his thoughts and continued to watch the simulation content.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was anxious but helpless, which made him very happy.
Now, he is looking forward to the scene of defeating Jiuyou Demon Emperor, the ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’.
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed. During these hundred years, you have been practicing hard, never leaving the heart of the Eternal Frozen Land, and never slacking off in cultivation.]
[In a hundred years, you have successfully advanced your Great Completion Domain to the Perfect Domain. However, the domain is not the focus, it’s just something you comprehend along the way.]
[You spend more time on cultivation and improving your Cultivation Skills. Because you know that increasing your cultivation level is the most important thing. Although other aspects are important too, if you can’t keep up with cultivation, it’s all in vain. The time left for you is not much.]
[The best way you can think of to clear the level is to quickly improve to Emperor Realm, then use the resources of the Blood Demon Realm to rapidly increase your cultivation, and see if you can help in the Quasi-Immortal battle.]
[If you can help Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan kill the Quasi-Immortal Blood Demons and defeat the Blood Demon Realm, maybe you can use the resources of the Blood Demon Realm to make Ji Bingyan break through to the Divine Realm. At that time, she would have the ability to ascend to the world. Maybe you can try to be brought to the Upper Realm by her.]
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years have passed, and it is time for the Flaming Fire Secret Realm to open. Although your physique hasn’t changed much, your cultivation speed is much faster than that of the demonized Wang Ping, due to the fact that you have improved the Primordial Spirit Skill to Emperor-level Skill.]
[Now, your cultivation has reached the King Realm 6th Tier level, and it is not far from the 7th Tier. However, you are not very satisfied with your current cultivation speed. With this speed, by the time the battle between the two realms begins, you would just be Perfect Completion of King Realm at best.]
[Although you have achieved Enlightenment to God with the Purple Talent, and your comprehension is very outstanding, allowing you to comprehensively improve the quality of other configurations; you can definitely defeat a Quasi-Emperor of a higher level, but this level of strength still does not allow you to successfully execute the plan.]
[For this reason, you have been continuing to improve the Primordial Spirit Skill, trying to deduce it to a higher level. You never expected to deduce it to a God-tier. After all, you don’t have any God-tier Skills, and even if your comprehension is amazing, your cultivation level is too low, you don’t have reference skills, so it’s basically impossible to create God-tier Skills in a short time.]
[However, if it’s a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill, with the Profound Ice Divine Skill created by the Profound Ice Emperor as a reference, you are quite confident that you can create it.]
As the simulation content reached this point, many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind; various insights surged into his heart, making him understand the situation.
Because there were two roads in his mind to choose from.
Continue on the right path, continue to improve the Primordial Spirit Skill, and deduce it to a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill.
However, while the Primordial Spirit Skill can make him have no weaknesses in all aspects and his Mana is several times or even more than ten times stronger than Same Realm Cultivators, it is actually not refined enough and requires too much energy to be absorbed in order to improve cultivation.
In the current time-sensitive situation, this Cultivation Skill is not suitable for him anymore.
As a result, another path appeared in his mind.
That is, to follow the path of the ruthless female emperor, create a Demonic Skill based on the Primordial Spirit Skill, which can devour others’ origins and rapidly increase cultivation.
Even if in the future it is improved to the level of God-tier Skills, perhaps without relying on the divine source, there is hope to break through to the Divine Realm.
This path can be taken, but it would definitely make him the public enemy of the two realms.
Even the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan couldn’t tolerate him. Once she discovered that his Cultivation Skill had turned into a Demonic Skill, she would probably cripple him.
One Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao has already brought such a hidden danger.
And his exhibited talent is even more terrifying, reaching an astonishing level of comprehension.
Such a person, if walking the Demon Path, will surely bring disaster to the beings of the two realms if not slain.
“It’s a difficult choice, no wonder it exits the text simulation and enters the immersive simulation. Indeed, this is a huge branching point and a choice must be made.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he began to think.
Now he had already been targeted by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, leaving the Eternal Frozen Land meant certain death.
Remaining in the Eternal Frozen Land to comprehend the Dao, with a Quasi-Immortal Tier master by his side, he would still die if he dared to do so.
“Caught in a dilemma. However, it doesn’t matter. There’s no need to take this path this time, I’ll wait until my cultivation improves. I have the Life Simulator, and the outcome of a simulation doesn’t matter, death is just death. After exiting the simulation, I can pile up my cultivation, and don’t have to fear death like the simulated Wang Ping.”

chapters.title: Chapter 468: 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_5
chapters.content:
