Chapter 468: Chapter 162: Wang Ping’s Terrifying Growth! The Profound Ice Emperor is Stunned_5
Wang Ping glanced at the place where Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was in seclusion and shook his head slightly.
“If it really comes to the point where I can’t break through in a normal way, it won’t be too late to take the ruthless path. At that time, with my improved cultivation, I might be able to fight against Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao myself, so I won’t need to come to Eternal Frozen Land to seek refuge by becoming an apprentice.”
“Not to mention, even though the simulation time was quite tight, in the real world, there are still thousands of years left.”
“System, fast-forward for me.”
After making his choice, Wang Ping spoke in the depths of his heart.
[In the blink of an eye, centuries have passed, and your cultivation has reached the Perfect Completion tier of King Realm. During these centuries, you have spent a lot of effort to further improve the Primordial Spirit Skill and create your own Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill.]
[This is the result of your choice and the balance achieved afterward. This skill allows you to absorb exotic fire, exotic thunder, and other rare items in the world to enhance your cultivation. It is a skill you created by referring to the Burning Skill. This kind of skill can also quickly improve your cultivation, but it requires you to spend time searching for rare items in the world, and the improvement may not be as significant as the other option.]
[Nevertheless, it is still a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill, much stronger than an Emperor-level Skill, and you are quite satisfied with it.]
[As for your successful creation of a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill, even Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, a Quasi-Immortal, was stunned by your feat. A cultivator who has reached the Perfect Completion of King Realm creating a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill is truly outrageous.]
[Do keep in mind that it took her more than ten thousand years to create a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill. Moreover, your Quasi-Immortal Skill is so unique that even Ji Bingyan feels it’s more profound and exquisite than the Profound Ice Divine Skill she created.]
[To be honest, it’s quite demoralizing. She has always been the unrivaled genius since her debut, with her peers only able to chase after her and never able to catch up. To think, she, a Quasi-Immortal, was so easily surpassed by you, a young cultivator. At least in terms of cultivation skills.]
[At the same time, she is somewhat proud. Being able to accept a disciple like you, although she may face the dilemma of teaching you everything she knows and easily being surpassed, it is indeed something to be proud of and flaunt. After all, as a teacher, the higher the achievements of the disciple, the more face she has when boasting among fellow taoists.]e
[In the blink of an eye, another decade or so has passed. In these ten years, you successfully condensed an Emperor Dao Phenomenon with more than a dozen attributes, paving the way for your breakthrough to the Emperor Realm. For this, Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, was once again speechless. To directly condense so many attributes of Emperor Dao Phenomenon with the cultivation of Perfect Completion of King Realm is truly outrageous and makes other emperors feel ashamed.]
[However, once she recalls your creation of a Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill, she doesn’t feel anything anymore. There’s no help for it; she has simply grown accustomed to it, or you can say, she has become numb.]
As the simulation content stopped, various scenes and images once again appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. His vision changed, various insights surged into his heart, and the power in his body also underwent a transformation.
“Ah, directly creating a Quasi-Immortal Skill and easily condensing such formidable Emperor Dao Phenomenon, it’s really terrifying.”
After Wang Ping came back to his senses, his gaze was quite subtle.
His performance in this simulation was truly astounding, making Ji Bingyan, a Quasi-immortal, feel demoralized. It was indeed very subtle.
“Well, what can I say? Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God, it’s amazing.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help muttering in the bottom of his heart.
It was at this moment, Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled like lightning, and he suddenly looked into the distance as if sensing something.
Just as Wang Ping looked over, a certain area in the Central Continent saw the sky turning eerily blood-red, and the space began to distort on a large scale.
Vaguely, one could see bizarre scenes through the distorted space.
Those were scenes projected from the Blood Demon Realm.
Not only did this change occur in Central Continent.
In the entire Purple Spirit Realm, many places displayed strange scenes.
However, compared to Central Continent, the anomalies in other regions were much smaller.
“Has it begun?”
Wang Ping’s figure flashed, appearing in the sky, his robes fluttering. He gazed into the distance and narrowed his eyes.
The boundary between the two realms, the invasion of Blood Demons.
Finally, it had reached this point in time.
“Although I haven’t broken through to the Quasi-Emperor Tier, I’m still much stronger than Demonized Wang Ping. Emperors would not fear me either, so at least I have some self-preservation ability now.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Over the years, he wasn’t only working on improving his skills in all aspects. Some secret skill research and text simulations were not depicted in the process.
In fact, he had also created his own secret skill.
These secret skills could completely conceal his breath, appearance, and soul aura.
It could be said that unless they were Quasi-Immortal Tier powerhouses, Emperors would not be able to see through him.
Of course, the likes of that Emperor Realm Great Perfection powerhouse from Blood Demon Realm, who possessed the Divine Eye skill, still had a certain chance to see through him.
This secret skill, which took Wang Ping many years to perfect, had effects that surpassed those of Red Talent: Breath Concealment.
It can only be said that the Purple Talent is impressive, as possessing such an insight-related talent could help him actively create many effects of Red Talent.
“Master, the Blood Demons are about to invade at the junction of the two realms, and Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao will definitely make a move. If you can leave your seclusion now, you can wait for the opportunity near the Profound Turtle.”
Wang Ping thought for a while and then transmitted his voice to Ji Bingyan under the glacier.
“I’m afraid it’s impossible. My cultivation is at a critical moment, and I can’t leave my seclusion. Otherwise, there’s a possibility of my realm falling.”
Ji Bingyan sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 163: Wang Ping becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s scheme.
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 163: Wang Ping becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s scheme.
“Is it not feasible?”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows slightly.
Even though he had speculated this earlier, hearing the confirmation was still somewhat disappointing.
After all, this could’ve been the perfect opportunity to hunt down Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, a ‘Predecessor Ransmigrator’ of sorts.
Once this opportunity slipped away, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could utilize the Quasi-Divine of the Blood Demon Realm to restrain Ji Bingyan, a Profound Ice Emperor, and then launch an assault on the Profound Turtle.
In the end, the Profound Turtle would still die, and the eerie entity would still be set free.
“In the previous simulations, I didn’t know what the outcome would be after the eerie entity was released, but this time I could give it a try.”
A thought flashes across Wang Ping’s mind.
During the previous simulations, Wang Ping had been avoiding everything and hadn’t seen the result of when the eerie entity was released.
Perhaps, the birth of this eerie entity is related to the descending of the black fog in both realms?
“It’s just one simulation, it’s not a big deal. Since this time it’s inevitably impossible to clear the stage, it might as well be used to explore the route of normal storyline development.”
Wang Ping made up his mind.
“However, I still need to continue cultivating in order to break through to the Quasi-Emperor Tier. That way, I’ll be comparatively safer.”
“System, continue using the fast-forward feature.”
Wang Ping voiced in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding.”
The sound of the system echoed, and the luminescent screen appeared again.
“After making a decision, despite knowing what’s going to happen next, you didn’t have any intention to get involved. Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, has reached a critical point in her cultivation and won’t get involved either.”
“Therefore, you assumed the following simulation would unfold as you remembered, but that’s not the case. Even though you didn’t inform the Six Great Saint Zones about the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s plan to attack the Profound Turtle, because the Demon Emperor had captured Cai Yonglong and knew you possessed the Life Simulator, he had already anticipated that you would’ve known about his plans.”
“For this reason, he didn’t choose to attack the Profound Turtle during that opportunity, because he thought you would use Ji Bingyan to guard the place and kill him in one fell swoop. Instead, he chose to continue to wait.”
“In a flash, the flow of time proceeds, the conflict between the two realms starts, no changes there. However, you did not hear about the Profound Turtle being attacked, that surprised you a bit. Soon though, you figured out the reasons, but it wasn’t a big deal so you didn’t dwell on it.”
“You continued on your pursuit to reach the Quasi-Emperor Tier. Ye Chen’s battle against the Quasi-Immortal offspring, subsequent Quasi-Immortal battles, you had no interest in observing at all, and just continued on with your pursuit.”
“Just as these events were unfolding one after another, finally Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao chose the right time during the Quasi-Immortal battle and the outbreak of comprehensive warfare to attack the Profound Turtle, forcing the turtle to risk its life to reinforce the seal.”
“A few years later, when you were in the process of reaching the Quasi-Emperor Tier, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s men found the right opportunity. They sent out six sect leaders who were at the Quasi-Emperor Tier to kill you. With the Great Array sealing off the space so that the outer world wouldn’t detect anything, they were planning to kill you off completely, cutting off future troubles.”
“Confronted with such strong enemies, you naturally couldn’t continue your retreat and had to come forward to confront them, with a major battle just about to break out.”
The text simulation stopped once again.
Meanwhile, all sorts of scenes appeared in Wang Ping’s mind and his view also changed.
Although he was still in the Eternal Frozen Land, he was now surrounded by six figures emitting demon spirit.”
These six figures were none other than the six demon masters of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, all of them boasting the level of Quasi-Emperors. They were highly esteemed individuals whom the Saint Masters would have to acknowledge.”
“Ha, Chu Xiao is really cautious for having six Quasi-Emperors sent to kill me all at once.”
With Wang Ping treading upon the air, he swept a look at the six Demon Sect Masters, sneering without a hint of fear.
“However, he’s underestimated me. If he wanted to kill me, he should’ve sent over the remaining three Sect Masters as well. Nine against one, you might then stand some chance of winning.”
“Hmph, arrogant young fool! Only Emperors have the right to warrant the collective efforts of the sect Masters of Jiuyou Demon Sect. To kill you, one of us is more than enough!”
The Blood Demon Sect Master took a step forward and snorted, exerting a Quasi-Emperor pressure. He immediately extended the Perfect Blood Demon Realm, covering the entire area.
The entire Blood Demon Realm was dark red and looked extremely eerie. There was also a savage force aimed to suck out Wang Ping’s blood.
“The Blood Demon Sect Master, huh? Interesting.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Blood Demon Sect Master, narrowing his eyes.
Once upon a time, the overlords of the Jiuyou Demon Sect were held in high esteem and could easily manipulate him, the simulator Wang Ping, treating him like an ant.
Now, Wang Ping wouldn’t even give them a second glance.
After all, the two of them were close in their cultivation levels. He was no longer the simulator Wang Ping who had only reached the Profound Elixir Realm in cultivation.
As for combat power, Wang Ping could easily crush him.
“A Quasi-Emperor who has only realized the Perfect Domain is fairly weak.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
Hearing this, the Blood Demon Sect Master’s anger surged.
The other five demon Lords also frowned, feeling that this kid Wang Ping was truly arrogant.
However, the very next second, they no longer found Wang Ping arrogant, but instead looked horrified.
Having lived so long as Demon Bigshots, very few things could move them.
But this time, they were indeed moved.
That’s because Wang Ping, this Emperor, suddenly exhibited an Emperor Dao Phenomenon behind his back. He directly broke through the Blood Demon Sect Master’s domain, causing the Sect Master to turn pale, looking quite miserable.

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_2
And indeed, it wasn’t an ordinary Emperor Dao Phenomenon. It was an Emperor Dao Phenomenon with many attributes, which was much stronger than one with only a single or dual attribute.
As for the three attributes, sorry, there is no such emperor in either realm.
After all, the difficulty grows exponentially with every additional path cultivated. It’s too time-consuming and while it might increase one’s combat power, it might also hinder their cultivation; hence, it isn’t a good thing.
“No wonder the Demon Emperor chose to mobilize us against this junior. He indeed possesses enough merit for us to attack together.”
A Demon Sect Master looked at Wang Ping with a gloomy glare and sneered.
“Let’s launch a combined attack. We can’t be complacent.” Another Demon Sect Master spoke.
As the words fell, the six Demon Sect Masters who were Quasi-emperor Masters simultaneously unfolded their realms.
However, they didn’t expand their realms to cover Wang Ping and his vicinity completely.
To do so would collide with Wang Ping’s Emperor Dao Phenomenon, which was undoubtedly tantamount to cracking an egg against a rock, and they would just end up hurting themselves.
Therefore, covering their own small area with their realm to strengthen themselves is the best combat choice.
“Young man, die for me.”
The Blood Demon Sect Master snapped coldly, holding a blood-colored spear in his hand. It burst with a bloody light and stabbed towards Wang Ping.
Under the attack of the blood spear, space shattered and the power gathered made other Quasi-emperors palpitate.
The other five Demon Sect Masters made their moves as well, unleashing a shocking attack.
Against the horrifiying offensive of the six Quasi-emperors, Wang Ping remained calm. The Emperor Dao Phenomenon behind him fused into his body, lending him some of the majesty of an Emperor.
Then, Wang Ping wielded the Illusionary Void Sword, which had grown to Quasi-emperor tier, and swung it.
In an instant, light filled the area, space twisted, and numerous Dao phenomena appeared. They transformed into six Sword Spirits and collided with the attacks of the six Demon Lords.
A horrific shockwave swept out, shattering countless spaces as if they were made of paper.
“Gurgle!”
The next instant, the six Demon Lords were all shocked, injured, and directly sent flying backwards. They coughed up mouthfuls of blood, looking at Wang Ping in horror.
What kind of Divine Skill was that? It was so powerful that it injured all six of them with one against six.
Wang Ping clearly had no intention of answering their question. His body flashed and crossed the space, appearing in front of one of the Demon Sect Masters. He swung his sword.
“Not good!”
The Demon Sect Master’s pupils contracted, his face changed dramatically, and he tried to defend himself.
Suddenly, his soul was shocked. An illusion appeared in front of him, and he fell into the Illusionary Realm.
This made chills run down his spine as he tried to break out of the illusion.
However, it was of no use. Wang Ping swung his sword again, killed this Demon Sect Master who was trying to break free from the Illusionary Realm.
Under the divine power boosted by Wang Ping’s Emperor Dao Phenomenon, the Demon Sect Master had no way to heal, no matter how capable he was. His Divine Soul and body were both destroyed, and he completely perished.
“What!?”
When they saw a Demon Sect Master being easily slain by Wang Ping, the Blood Demon Sect Master and the remaining five Demon Sect Masters couldn’t help but feel terrified.
A Quasi-emperor Master was instantly killed by a King with a single swing of a sword. Moreover, this Quasi-emperor Master was one of the top three amongst the six, it was simply jaw-dropping.
For a moment, the remaining five Demon Lords all understood one thing.
If they continued to fight, they would only be effortlessly killed by Wang Ping. There was no way out.
Wang Ping was too terrifying.
His combat power had probably completely surpassed the Quasi-emperor tier. They couldn’t deal with him.
Hence, the Blood Demon Sect Master and the remaining five Demon Lords exchanged glances. All of them immediately contacted the Great Array, quickly tearing through space, trying to escape.
“Think you can run?”
Wang Ping snorted coldly, directly summoning the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to suppress the space, making it impossible for them to use spatial shifting techniques.
This made the eyes of the Blood Demon Sect Master and the others contract and their expressions change.
Even though at their level, a single Emperor Tower would struggle to cut off their escape routes, they could puncture space given some time.
However, that time would be enough for Wang Ping to kill them several times over.
“Kid, if you’re not going to let us go, we’ll take you down with us even if we fall!”
The Blood Demon Sect Master roared and attacked Wang Ping.
“Just you, aren’t enough.”
Wang Ping sneered coldly. He once again used his illusion Divine Skill, confusing the Blood Demon Sect Master before effortlessly killing him.
If it were an ordinary Emperor Dao Divine Skill, it definitely wouldn’t have this effect. But what Wang Ping was cultivating was his own Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skill. Along with the Emperor Dao phenomenon, it was simply like slicing through vegetables to deal with the Quasi-emperors.
Wang Ping subtly felt that his combat power had reached the Emperor Realm.
Even if he couldn’t defeat an Emperor, he could remain undefeated.
Next, Wang Ping’s figure flashed, appeared behind another Demon Lord, and killed him with two moves.
In the face of Wang Ping, the strong Quasi-emperor Masters from the Demon Path were as insignificant as mongrels, unable to withstand a single blow.
“Damn it, you forced me into this.”
The faces of the remaining three Demon Lords twisted, they roared, burned their sources together, forcibly raising their combat power, wanting to fight to the death with Wang Ping.
“Haha, bring it.”
Wang Ping was fearlessly delighted. He did not use his illusion Divine Skill, but instead chose to face them head on.
After all, this is a good opportunity to hone battle experience, not to be missed.
What he lacked the most was experience in battling with powerful beings.

chapters.title: Chapter 471: 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_3
For now, it’s still manageable, but if it continues, it will undoubtedly become a hidden danger.
With the fierce battle between the four, terrifying skills poured out, affecting an extremely vast area, and the entire Eternal Frozen Land began to tremble.
This huge commotion naturally attracted the attention of many masters, who were all shocked as they looked in this direction and couldn’t help but rush over.
Several emperors who were closer to the scene couldn’t help but tear through space and come here to observe the battle.
Among them was the Sky Emperor.
As the Sky Emperor followed the path of space, he was the first emperor to arrive here.
“Who is that? He’s actually able to fight three Quasi-Emperors, who have burned their origins, at the Perfect Completion of King Realm. Moreover, he’s the Demon Lord of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, truly powerful.”
Sky Emperor was shocked by the thought.
However, he quickly discovered something unusual.
There were still other auras lingering around this area, which were the auras of the other three Demon Lords.
That is to say, Wang Ping fought against six by himself, had already killed three, and forced the remaining three Demon Lords to burn their origins at any cost in this do-or-die battle.
“The aura of Emperor Dao Phenomenon, along with his Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, are equally terrifying. No wonder he has such strong fighting power. However, why do I feel that the Sword Divine Skills and Space Divine Skills he’s using have some connection to you?”
Another Emperor arrived and asked the Sky Emperor dubiously after marveling at the sight.
“How would I know…” The Sky Emperor frowned, feeling somewhat astonished. “I’ve never heard about this person before. It’s really strange.”
“Besides, isn’t that the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower? Wasn’t it with Ye Chen? Why does he also have one here?”
The Sky Emperor looked at the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower above the sky, and his heart was filled with great astonishment.
This also puzzled the other emperors. It should be impossible for another identical Emperor Tower to exist in this world.
At this moment, the Emperor tier Blood Demons on the other side had also arrived, and they were the ones closest to the scene.
When they saw Wang Ping, they were shocked and their eyes were filled with murderous intent, wishing they could strike him down immediately.
However, they remembered that this was the territory of Quasi-Immortal Ji Bingyan, so they glanced at the Sky Emperor and other Emperors from the Purple Spirit Realm, snorted coldly, and suppressed their thoughts.
Wang Ping also noticed that more and more powerful people were gathering here, and it would be troublesome if he continued dragging this on.
As a result, he no longer held back and used his true strength to kill all three Demon Lords. He then withdrew the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower.
At this point, one of the Blood Demon Realm Emperors, after pondering, showed a murderous look and couldn’t suppress the killing intent in his heart. He suddenly condensed his Emperor Dao Phenomenon and threw a punch at Wang Ping, hoping to completely obliterate him.
Such a genius, if not removed early, might become a threat to the great war between the two realms in the future.
“You dare!”
Seeing that the Blood Demon Realm Emperor had disregarded the rules and made a move, the Sky Emperor and the other Purple Spiritual Realm Emperors were furious and wanted to intervene.
However, once the Blood Demon Realm Emperors had made their move, they were naturally well-prepared, as the other Blood Demon Emperors took action, blocking the Sky Emperor and other Purple Spirit Realm Emperors.
The Blood Demon Realm had a larger number of Emperors, so they managed to achieve this.
As a result, the Purple Spirit Realm Emperors could only watch anxiously.
Although Wang Ping had displayed terrifying combat prowess, it was estimated that he could not withstand a single strike from an Emperor.
After all, when an Emperor wanted to kill a Quasi-Emperor, a casual strike could easily do the job.
Even the Profound Ice Emperor, who had grown to be a Quasi-Immortal thousands of years earlier, had to use a forbidden technique to fight alongside the Blood Demon Realm’s Emperors.
At that time, the Profound Ice Emperor was a Quasi-Emperor, while Wang Ping was only at the Perfect Completion of King Realm.
“Heh, wanting to kill me, you’re not good enough.”
Facing the attack from the Blood Demon Realm Emperor, Wang Ping sneered and directly revealed his Emperor Dao Phenomenon.
This time, without any reservations, all kinds of visions emerged as he unleashed his most powerful Divine Skills, launching a terrifying strike that directly exploded the Blood Demon Emperor’s full-strength attack.
“What!?”
This scene shocked all the emperors present.
Both the Purple Spirit Realm emperors and the Blood Demon Realm emperors were astounded by Wang Ping’s fierceness.
Although the Blood Demon Realm Emperor’s attack was a hasty sneak attack, it still possessed terrifying power.
Yet, it was directly destroyed by Wang Ping, a cultivator at the Perfect Completion of King Realm, which was too shocking.
This had never happened in the history of the two realms.
“Blood Demon Realm Emperor, I’ll remember this attack. When I become a Quasi-Emperor, I’ll slaughter you first,”
While everyone was astonished, Wang Ping looked at the Emperor who had tried to ambush him and said coldly.
“Hehe, to think you can kill me after becoming a Quasi-Emperor, how arrogant!”
That Blood Demon Emperor laughed in fury, exuding a terrifying killing intent that dyed the sky red.
“Since you want to kill me, I’ll wait till you break through to Quasi-Emperor and then fight me to death. At that time, I’ll definitely slap you to death.”
Then, the Blood Demon Emperor sneered as if recalling something.
“Let’s go.”
Following this, those Blood Demon emperors said nothing further. They glanced coldly at Wang Ping and tore through space, leaving this place together.
After all, this was the Eternal Frozen Land, and they couldn’t stay here for long.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_4
Who knows if the Quasi-Immortal of the Purple Spirit Realm will take action to kill them.
After all, they had just broken the rules. If the other party kills them, it would be justified.
Seeing the Emperors of the Blood Demon Realm all leaving, the other Emperors wanted to come over and greet Wang Ping, but remembering the duties they had to fulfil. They gave Wang Ping simple nods before they left.
If they were not to guard, the Blood Demon Realm’s Emperors would take advantage of the opportunity to ambush the other geniuses or Kings of the Purple Spirit Realm, then trouble would arise.
They were aware of Wang Ping’s existence anyway. They could form a friendship with him later when they are free.
Seeing the area quiet down, Wang Ping heaved a sigh of relief, his gaze flickering, contemplating the issue at hand.
“Chu Xiao, what are you thinking about exactly? Could it be that you have merely sent the six Quasi-Emperors to test my current strength?”
Given the character of the transmigrator, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he could not possibly commit such a meaningless act.
After all, if they want to kill him, even if he doesn’t dare to do it personally, sending an Emperor would be the best choice.
After all, he is aware of that.
The Jiuyou Demon Sect has a second Emperor – their first Demon Lord.
“Heh, no matter what you think, your end will still be destruction. Even if I can’t kill you in this simulation, with my cultivation improvement rewards, killing you won’t be much harder than stepping on an ant.”
Wang Ping’s robes billowed as he laughed coldly in his heart. With a flash of his figure, he returned to the depths of the Eternal Frozen Land.
“But this immersive simulation isn’t just for me to show off, right? According to the system, this was also a branching path for me. But the exact branching point is a bit unclear.”
Just as Wang Ping planned to continue the immersive simulation, he remembered something and frowned slightly, confused.
Could it be the option of whether to fight or not, to kill or not to kill?
“Forget it, no need to overthink, just continue fast-forwarding, and the answer will be clear in the future.”
Wang Ping was thinking to himself silently. The luminescent screen appeared again, and text began to surface.
[After this battle, you have become world-famous. Cultivators from the two Realms have not only recognized your existence but also affirmed that you are a person destined to be an Emperor. If you grow further, you won’t be just an ordinary Emperor. Even some Emperors believe you have the potential to become a Quasi-Immortal.]
[For this, the cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm are overjoyed, feeling they have a powerful force that might be able to turn the tables. The people of the Blood Demon Realm are shocked and angry, eager to end your life immediately.]
[However, their powerhouses are being watched closely, so it’s not easy for them to act rashly. They can only slowly plan on how to deal with you.]
After this battle, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan personally intervened, demanding that various Holy Lands provide resources to cultivate you and help you achieve Quasi-Emperor or even Emperor tier in the shortest possible time.]
[No Holy Land would dare to disregard Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan’s proposition. Of course, even if Ji Bingyan is not a Quasi-Immortal, most Holy Lands would do the same. It is common knowledge that having another powerful Emperor at this time would signify a shift in power.]
[During the battle between the two realms, having as many Emperors as possible is the best strategy. Especially given that you aren’t an ordinary Emperor. Instead, you are a figure who is likely to step into Emperor Realm Great Perfection and perhaps Quasi-Immortal tier with sufficient resources, making you truly worth cultivating swiftly.]
[The stakes here are the safety of the Purple Spirit Realm in contrast to the eternal legacy of each Holy Land. They understood the gains and losses.]
[Twenty years later, through the resources provided by the Holy Lands, you’ve successfully advanced to the Quasi-Emperor Tier. After becoming a Quasi-Emperor, you once engaged in a battle with an Emperor from the Blood Demon Realm and killed him single-handedly.]
[This battle shocked both realms. The morale of the cultivators in the Purple Spirit Realm rose, knowing that you indeed have the potential to change the landscape of the conflict in the future.]
[The figures from the Blood Demon Realm, however, grew even more wary of you, wishing to eliminate you as soon as possible. But you have already grown. Unless a Quasi-Immortal or the perfect ones of the Emperor Realm Great Perfection take action, it would be hard for other Emperors to end you in a short time.]
[You continued your closed-door cultivation in an attempt to reach the Emperor Realm and become an Emperor, which, for you, was not difficult. Having already understood the Emperor Dao Phenomenon, you simply needed to refine your mana. Under the resources provided by the Holy Lands, this would be as natural as flowing water, not taking much time.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades have passed. Your cultivation came to the critical turning point and succeeded in making a breakthrough, which attracted an astonishing Heavenly Tribulation. Ultimately, you passed the Heavenly Tribulation effortlessly in front of countless cultivators and became an Emperor.]
[Meanwhile, within these years, you also created your own divine skills at the quasi-immortal level, and during the previous Heavenly Tribulation, you fused the two Life-bound Weapons – Illusory Space Sword into one. Assisted by the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and refined by the Heavenly Tribulation, it became an Emperor level weapon. Even just after being promoted, it was far more powerful than ordinary Emperor level weapons.]
[After becoming an Emperor, you were filled with confidence. Your power was among the top ranks in the two realms. While you weren’t the best of the best, defeating Emperors below the 7th-Tier Emperor Realm wouldn’t be difficult. At the same time, you were confident in your ability to escape from the clutches of the perfect ones in the Emperor Realm Great Perfection.]

chapters.title: Chapter 473: 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_5
[At this point, you no longer fear Predecessor ransmigrator Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. The only concern now comes from that tricky Guiyi. You don’t know that this Guiyi has any strength, but just the fact that they occupy the body of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor is terrifying. Once they emerge, it’ll mean chaos for both the heavens and the earth.]
[Of course, even if Guiyi does not emerge, the black fog that destroys both realms alone is enough to be fatal.]
[Not long after you consolidate your realm, the Blood Demon Realm erupts into full-scale war, unwilling to continue dragging it out. As a result, you join the fight, turning the sky and the earth upside down as you face a Blood Demon Realm Emperor who has reached the 7th-Tier Emperor Realm.]
[In this battle, you finally validate your strength. Although you’ve just become an Emperor, you’ve had perfect breakthroughs in your previous realms and created your own Quasi-Immortal Tier Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills. Combined with your extraordinary Emperor Dao Phenomenon, you’re able to fight alongside the 7th-Tier Blood Demon Realm Emperors.]
[Although you’re not his opponent, he can’t kill you easily either. You can say that holding off one powerful force from the Blood Demon Realm has made a significant contribution.]
“It seems that after using fast-forward function, only when my choices begin to affect the future development will I enter the immersive simulation state again.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, thinking to himself.
If it were just to show off, killing a Blood Demon Emperor of a higher level during the simulation and fighting an old Blood Demon Emperor with a cultivation of Emperor Realm 7th Tier would also be impressive.
However, it still didn’t automatically exit the Text Simulation state and enter the Immersive Simulation, indicating a problem.
“Perhaps the effects of my earlier choice will appear soon.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he had some conjectures in his heart as he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[During your battle with the Blood Demon Realm Emperor, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao finally releases the imprisoned Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
[As the Guilt-Punishing Emperor is about to be released, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao has long since fled to prevent being killed by Guiyi.]
[After Guiyi possesses the released Guilt-Punishing Emperor, the Bloodline Curse of the White family completely erupts, causing them all to fall into demonic possession. Their combat power increases significantly, and they are utterly controlled by Guiyi, transformed into his sub-souls.]
[At the same time, because you killed the six Demon Lords in your last battle, your body shakes violently after Guiyi’s return to the world, instantly plunging into demonic possession and having your soul corrupted, becoming a sub-soul controlled by him.]
[Because your soul was tainted and controlled by Guiyi, the current simulation ends…]
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his pupils slightly constricted.
His conjectures were indeed validated.
Killing the six Demon Lords back then had problems and would affect his future path.
Moreover, Guiyi finally appeared.
However, Wang Ping didn’t understand the relationship between killing the six Demon Lords and Guiyi.
After all, the Demon Lords were subordinate to Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and should have nothing to do with
Guiyi.
Besides, when he killed the six Demon Lords, Guiyi was still sealed…
“Wait, something’s not right.”
Wang Ping slightly frowned.
Although the Jiuyou Demon Sect’s Demon Lords were mysterious figures, it was rumored that one of them was the disciple of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
However, when the Guilt-Punishing Emperor ran into trouble, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao saved his disciple and trained him to become a Demon Lord.
“If that’s true, then there is some clue to Guiyi’s abilities.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, his face somewhat solemn.
He killed the disciple of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and, as a result, had his soul polluted, becoming Guiyi’s sub-souls and controlled by him.
Is Guiyi’s ability domination-based or the unreasonable kind?
Wang Ping suspected that as long as he killed descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, his soul might be polluted and controlled by Guiyi.
Or is it that as long as he killed people related to Guiyi, he would be controlled?
If that were the case, it would be too overbearing.
“However, it’s unlikely. If it were that broad, it would be too absurd. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao couldn’t escape either, considering he killed the Profound Turtle, which also has deep ties with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.”
“If nothing unexpected happens, the only controllable objects should be either the descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor that he tried to possess or the sub-souls manipulated by him. Once killed, their souls will be tainted, turned into new sub-souls and
controlled by him.”
Wang Ping made a guess.
If Guiyi indeed has this kind of ability, then it’s quite disgusting.
This fellow is already outrageously strong on his own and can throw sub-souls at will during a battle, forcing you to attack.
If you accidentally kill one of his controlled sub-souls…
Well, then it’s game over.
Guiyi’s ability limit needs no elaboration; even Quasi-Immortals may not be able to withstand it.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, and he finds himself in a secret location.
He sees the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, shrouded in dark energy.
To be precise, it’s the Guilt-Punishing Emperor possessed by Guiyi.
“Heh, that Jiuyou Demon Emperor, he clearly has the scent of those guys on him, but he released me, quite interesting.”

chapters.title: Chapter 474: 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_6
A strange, eerie laughter.
“Although I don’t know what you’re thinking, since you released me, I will reluctantly reward you by controlling you and making you a powerful warrior under me.”
As he said this, the eerie being activated his power.
In an instant, whether it was Wang Ping or those who had once killed the relatives of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, all of them had their souls tainted, fell into demonic possession, and were controlled by the eerie being.
Even those who had already died and were buried in the ground became demon beasts and crawled out of the soil if they were connected to these events.
As for the other descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, they too fell into demonic possession and were controlled by him.
The scene was extremely horrifying.
“This eerie power is indeed domineering…”
Watching this scene, Wang Ping’s expression became even more solemn.
Anyone connected to these events could be affected, no matter how long ago it had happened.
Even the dead could be resurrected as demon beasts, which was ridiculous.
“Speaking of which, the optimized Life Simulator has a better God’s Eye view. This is clearly unrelated to Wang Ping and not his viewpoint, yet it still appears before me in the form of God’s Eye.”
Wang Ping remembered this detail and muttered.
Then, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his view changed, returning to his initial residence in Heavenly Sword Divine City.
Apparently, this life simulation had come to a thorough end.
However, although the simulation had ended, other aspects had not.
Many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, as well as countless insights from his cultivation.
Emperor Dao Phenomenon.
Quasi-Immortal Skill.
Quasi-Immortal Divine Skill.
Various Secret Skills.
As long as it was something he had comprehended, Wang Ping accepted it all after the simulation ended.
Moreover, Wang Ping found that this time, accepting his insights was different from the past. It was much smoother and easier to absorb, and it didn’t take too much time.
Or rather, the time ratio had changed, making the passage of time in the real world seem not as fast.
If it were the previous Life Simulator, just absorbing so many insights would have taken several months at least.
But this time, it only took about half a month.
“The optimized Life Simulator is really strong.”
After absorbing the insights, Wang Ping opened his eyes and couldn’t help but sigh.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
Emperor Realm 1st tier cultivation.
Life-bound Emperor Equipment: Illusionary Void Sword.
Cohesion Emperor Elixir.
Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God.”
“Although the rewards are few this time, just the many insights gained from the immersive simulation are already quite rich. Not to mention, the rewards this time are not weak, either.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and smiled faintly.
Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God, needless to say, this is essential talent.
As for the Cohesion Emperor Elixir, this elixir is extremely precious, and it can help people break through and have a better chance of reaching the Emperor Realm.
The premise, of course, is that you have condensed the Emperor Dao Phenomenon. Otherwise, even with the Cohesion Emperor Elixir, you cannot successfully break into the Emperor Realm.
This treasure elixir is from the Primordial Sacred Land.
It can be said that during the battle between the two realms, the Primordial Sacred Land was truly generous and worthy of being the first sacred land.
Not only did it allow him to enter the Primordial Sacred Land in his previous life simulations, but it also offered precious Cohesion Emperor Elixirs.
It was because of the Cohesion Emperor Elixir that Wang Ping could break through to the Emperor Realm in just a few decades.
Otherwise, just relying on himself to break through would still take a long time.
After all, his comprehension might be strong, but in the end it was merely strong comprehension. His Innate Root Talent remained at the same level and had not changed much.
“The Life-bound Emperor Equipment: Illusionary Void Sword is not needed. As long as I become an Emperor, it will be easy for me to obtain another Emperor Artifact. So, System, I choose ① and ④.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and made his choice.
The Cohesion Emperor Elixir and the Life-bound Emperor Equipment are both precious. If it were a previous life simulation, he would have chosen them.
But now, he has been targeted by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, and only strength can protect himself.
Therefore, he will improve his cultivation as soon as possible, strengthen himself, and prevent any accidents.
After all, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao in the life simulation had severed his connections with All Heavens.
The Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao in the real world, however, is not disconnected from the outer world.
He can communicate with people in Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, especially with transmigrators in the Second-generation Chat Group.
Although, according to Alpha, it is difficult for these people to enter the Profound World where the Purple Spirit Realm is located, it is still possible for the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to find Wang Ping with the help of some secret methods.
Wang Ping could not take that risk.
It’s just a pity that the Life Simulator still couldn’t simulate the All Heavens factor. But that’s also understandable. After all, All Heavens is so vast that simulation must require some rules and energy. It’s not yet realistic to simulate All Heavens at the moment.
This is like a computer’s computing power. If its computing power is only 1 and you force it to compute content of 100, it would probably crash instantly. It would be strange if it didn’t crash.
“I can only hope that after continuing to optimize the Life Simulator in the future, I can see if it can simulate All Heavens.” Thinking of this, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered and he said in his heart to Alpha,
“Alpha, the Golden Finger Optimizer can only be purchased three times per group member.
Was this limit set by you on purpose? Can it be further optimized?”

chapters.title: Chapter 475: 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 163: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Jiuyou’s Calculations_7
Alpha fell silent for a moment, pondering whether or not to answer Wang Ping’s question.
After all, the implications were indeed too significant, so much so that He could not ignore them.
If Wang Ping continued to optimize the Life Simulator, he might be able to simulate the All Heavens in the future.
Even if he couldn’t simulate the All Heavens, it was not impossible to incorporate some elements of the chat group into the simulation.
By then, Wang Ping would become increasingly uncontrollable.
“It can be optimized. However, it requires a vast amount of group points.”
Ultimately, Alpha gave a vague answer.
“How many group points?”
Wang Ping’s eyes brightened up as he asked persistently.
“It’s a huge amount. You don’t need to know it now. Just strive to complete group tasks and earn more group points.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“Oh.” Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and did not say much.
Only then did he realize that the Life Simulator had issued a reward, and his comprehension became incredibly astonishing.
Apart from that, the cultivation within Wang Ping was also skyrocketing at a terrifying pace.
Quasi-King!
King Realm!
Perfect Completion of King Realm!
Quasi-Emperor!
Up to, Emperor Realm!
“The feeling of becoming an Emperor is truly pleasant. This feeling is something I have never experienced in the life simulation.”
Wang Ping felt the vast Mana within his body and nodded in satisfaction.
Although he had experienced the Perfect Completion of King Realm in the immersive simulation, he had never actively exited Fast-Forward Mode and re-entered the immersive simulation state during the subsequent fast-forwardings.
As a result, he had not experienced the feeling of becoming an Emperor.
“With this in mind, I can actively enter the immersive simulation in the future. This will allow me to better appreciate the mystery of each Great Realm and also to enhance my Combat Experience. Then, when I receive the cultivation later, I won’t just have a static power panel and would be unable to exert all my combat power.”
This idea flashed across Wang Ping’s mind, and he felt it was excellent.
Next, Wang Ping composed his thoughts and opened the chat group, wanting to see what had happened in the chat group.
Half a month passed, and the group members of the chat group were chatting as usual and carrying out group tasks.
However, Wang Ping’s consecutive display of terrifying power greatly stimulated the other group members, making them even more keen to pursue strength internally.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Mr. Wang, help, Mr. Wang! It seems like someone has tracked me to the Profound Turtle Continent, caught me alive, and said they want to take me back to Jiuyou Demon Sect.”
At this time, a message popped up, causing Wang Ping’s gaze to slightly congeal.
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, trouble for Mr. Cai again? What’s the situation?”
Chen Yao (71): “It’s like this in the Profound World.”
Wang Ping (66) @Cai Yonglong (1): “Try to stall for time, I’ll be right over.”
Wang Ping didn’t expect the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to act so fast.
Although he knew through Text Simulation that Cai Yonglong would be caught within a year, it was a vague timeline. Although images appeared, they didn’t give an exact time.
As a result, Wang Ping thought it would be a few months or even half a year later.
Unexpectedly, this happened only half a month later. This was truly terrifying.
All he could say was, the Jiuyou Demon Sect truly lived up to its name, its actions were swift.
“No, I can’t go straight there, I must find a helper.”
Just as Wang Ping was about to move, he paused and narrowed his eyes.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was a deep and ruthless person.
If he went to the Profound Turtle Continent, the other party might be waiting for him somewhere.
Although he was now an Emperor, possessing the power to fight against a 7th-Tier Emperor, compared with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, he was still far inferior and not his opponent.If the other party was to set up a trap and create a deadly situation, it would be very dangerous for him too.
Although he can escape through the teleportation function of the chat group, it would still be troublesome and a waste of group points.
Wang Ping did not wish to flee in such a disgraceful manner.
Immediately, Wang Ping decided to speak up once again in the chat group.
Wang Ping (66) @Cai Yonglong (1): “Cai Yonglong, you just hold on. If necessary, teleport to me through the chat group. Ten thousand group points is nothing.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Uh, but what about the people on Profound Turtle Continent… If I run away, Bai Tianhong and the Chi Clan members might die.”
Wang Ping was slightly taken aback by Cai Yonglong’s words.
The immersion in the simulation for a long time, mostly glossed over as a TV drama image, caused him some confusion.
Although this confusion would certainly disappear soon, because of the urgency of time and sudden incidents, he forgot about many people and events.
Indeed, if he doesn’t hurry over, Bai Tianhong and the Chi Clan might really get into trouble.
Wang Ping (66): “I am coming over right now.”
Without any hesitation, Wang Ping made the choice to use the teleportation function of the chat group.
Although this would consume some group points, Wang Ping, who is now pretty much rich, could easily afford the cost of ten thousand group points.
Using the teleportation function of the chat group was much safer than tearing through space on his own, without alerting Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
With the activation of the teleport function, Wang Ping’s figure turned into a white light and disappeared, appearing above the Profound Turtle Continent in the next instant.
To be precise, he appeared next to Cai Yonglong.
When Wang Ping appeared next to Cai Yonglong, he was startled.
However, he quickly showed a look of surprise and relief.
With Mr. Wang here, there is nothing to worry about.
Although the demon path powerhouse who was chasing him was strong, he couldn’t possibly be stronger than Mr. Wang, could he?
After all, Mr. Wang could now easily shatter stars.
At this moment, Wang Ping nodded at Cai Yonglong and turned his gaze to the black-robed powerhouse who was trying to capture Cai Yonglong alive.
His cultivation was not weak, at the half-step Nirvana realm.
“So you are Wang Ping. The Demon Emperor has commanded me to relay a message to you. If you wish to cooperate, come with me back to the Jiuyou Demon Sect. The Demon Emperor is willing to let you hold the position of deputy sect leader.”
Although the black-robed man was only at the half-step Nirvana realm, he was not afraid of the suddenly appearing Wang Ping, and sneered.
“It seems that you deliberately captured Cai to lure me out.”
Wang Ping did not look at the black-robed man, but instead looked into the distance with a sneer.
No, to be precise, your main goal is to plot against me.
Wang Ping’s eyes were like lightning, and he snorted coldly.
Within the Life Simulator, he was once plotted against and killed by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, using the descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor along with some strange abilities.
Now, the other side definitely has the idea of repeating their old tricks.
The black-robed man in front of him is definitely related to the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, sharing some of his bloodline, probably.
Oh, for Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, this is his first time using this scheme.
I have to say, this guy is ruthless, having planned until even a thousand years later.
He had long planned to kill the Profound Turtle a thousand years later, release the anomaly, and plan everything.
Now, it is just a passing thought to plant a bomb in me.
“Since you know, then just come back with me. The Demon Emperor attaches great importance to you. It is your honor.”
The black-robed man goaded Wang Ping with a cold voice.
“Heh.”
Wang Ping scoffed and waved his hand, slapping the black-robed man away and completely sealing him.
Killing him was impossible, but sealing him for a few thousand years, making his life worse than death, was a breeze.
“You!”
Realizing he had been sealed and couldn’t move, the black-robed man struggled in shock, seemingly astonished at why Wang Ping would chose to seal him.

chapters.title: Chapter 476: 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (10,000-word !)
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (10,000-word chapter!)
“Mr. Wang, are we not going to kill him?”
Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping, who seemed to have no intention of killing the man in the black robe, and felt puzzled.
“Cannot kill.”
Wang Ping didn’t explain much, only uttering these three words.
“I see.”
Cai Yonglong nodded thoughtfully, not saying anything more.
“Mr. Wang, where are we going now? I guess I can’t stay in Profound Turtle Continent anymore.”
Cai Yonglong sighed and asked another question.
“Let’s go to Eternal Frozen Land. Only by going there will Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao have no way to capture you.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke to Cai Yonglong through voice transmission.
“Eternal Frozen Land? Where is that?”
Cai Yonglong was taken aback.
“You don’t know? Well, it’s normal for you not to know.”
Wang Ping looked puzzled but quickly recovered himself.
He knew various secrets through the simulator, but Cai Yonglong’s knowledge couldn’t compare to his. In the Purple Spirit Realm, Cai Yonglong was essentially still a small cultivator in essence.
Although the white-haired old man had given him guidance, most of it was teaching him the knowledge of cultivation, and then talking about how glorious the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s past was.
As for some territories and secrets of the Purple Spirit Realm, the white-haired old man never mentioned them, nor did he have time to study them, so he really didn’t know.
“Eternal Frozen Land… ”
Wang Ping explained to Cai Yonglong through voice transmission where the Eternal Frozen Land is located and that it was the safest place in the Purple Spirit Realm because Quasi-Princess Ji Bingyan was there.
“Holy shit, a Quasi-Immortal…”
After hearing this, Cai Yonglong’s face was filled with shock.
He was currently just a small cultivator of the Profound Elixir Realm, and hearing about the existence of a Quasi-Immortal Tier being was like a mortal hearing about where a god resides. Extremely shocking.
After all, the highest-ranked person he had ever met, aside from Wang Ping, was his master who gave him his initiation. In his first life, the master was only at the quasi-King cultivation level.
“Anyway, it’s definitely the safest place… well, maybe not. It’s only the relatively safest place, not absolute safety.”
Wang Ping continued to speak to Cai Yonglong through voice transmission. Halfway through, he frowned slightly and changed his words.
“Huh? Even with a Quasi-Immortal guarding it, it’s not safe? How can that be possible?”
Cai Yonglong was astonished.
“Could it be that Jiuyou Demon Emperor can defeat a Quasi-Immortal?”
“Of course he can’t. However, like you, he could recruit people through the Chat Group. Even if he can’t recruit people, he might find other ways to deal with us.”
With narrowing eyes, Wang Ping spoke through voice transmission.
In the simulation, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor was a lone wolf and could only act as a lone wolf. In the real world, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor was not a lone wolf. If pushed too hard, he should be able to pay a significant price to get some powerful weapons from the strong members of the Second-generation Chat Group.
“You’re right. This guy really is hard to deal with.”
Cai Yonglong nodded thoughtfully, thinking that what Wang Ping said made perfect sense.
They could recruit people through the chat group; why couldn’t the enemy do the same?
Last time Mr. Wang joined the mission, the enemy had recruited people as well.
“Mr. Wang, I know there are some things I shouldn’t ask, but I’m really confused right now… ”
Cai Yonglong hesitated for a moment and then spoke with a wry smile through voice transmission.
“You don’t have the qualifications to know yet. All you need to know is that they are our organized enemies, and that’s enough.”
Wang Ping shook his head, still having no intention of answering Cai Yonglong’s question.
That’s Alpha’s attitude.
If Alpha doesn’t allow him to tell other group members, they don’t have the right to know.
Unless the Predecessor Transmigrators arrive and tell the other members about these things, and he can’t keep the secret anymore, Alpha would allow him to reveal everything.
However, there was no way around it; this was just Alpha’s character.
“Alright.” Cai Yonglong fell silent.
“Mr. Wang, I feel that my Golden Finger can’t really help you anymore. At the same time, I also feel that it can’t help me. So, I want to change my Golden Finger.”
Taking a deep breath, Cai Yonglong looked at Wang Ping again, his eyes full of determination.
Although he could change Golden Fingers directly, Wang Ping was the one who saved his life, and he had a deep sense of gratitude towards him. Wang Ping was the leader he truly recognized from his heart.
For that reason, he would always consult Wang Ping about major decisions. He would only follow through with it if Wang Ping approved.
“Change it.”
After a moment of hesitation, Wang Ping finally patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder.
Indeed, Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger was not keeping up with the pace.
In the end, as someone with the Life Simulator, Wang Ping didn’t really need Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger
If he ascended to the Upper Realm, Cai Yonglong probably wouldn’t be able to go there, thus becoming even more useless to him.
Considering this, it’s better for him to change his Golden Finger earlier.
Of course, if they used the chat group’s Delivery Function, he would still have the chance to get into the Upper Realm.
Unfortunately, Wang Ping knew that after Zhang Jun changed his Golden Finger and quickly soared into the sky, it had really provoked Cai Yonglong.
The rapid increase of other people’s strength also stimulated him.
Although Cai Yonglong had soared into the sky last time, the biggest cheat for transmigrators is the Golden Finger.
Considering the power of Golden Fingers, the gap between transmigrators with different levels of Golden Fingers is huge… even greater than the gap between humans and dogs.
“However, I hope you don’t regret it. With my current cultivation, it’s easy for me to get various valuable cultivation resources to enhance your strength. Your Golden Finger might shine in the future.”
After a pause, Wang Ping spoke again.
“I won’t regret it. To make it shine and gain some powerful opportunities, it would take a long time to gain Enlightenment and cultivate according to the normal standards of the Profound World. I don’t have that time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 477: 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (10,000-word !) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (10,000-word chapter!) _2
Cai Yonglong shook his head and sighed.
“Besides, I don’t want to rely on you forever, Brother Wang. I can never repay such a favor in my entire life. I hope to get a good Golden Finger to truly help you.”
“Since you’ve made up your mind, I won’t try to persuade you anymore. However, do you have enough Group points? If not, I can lend you some.”
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and said with a smile.
“Yes, of course. I have actively participated in various Group Tasks, so I have enough Group points to exchange for a new Golden Finger.”
Cai Yonglong scratched his head and chuckled.
“Alright.” Wang Ping nodded.
Next, without saying much, Cai Yonglong took a deep breath, paid his respects to the Tathagata Buddha and the Jade Emperor, and began to draw a new Golden Finger.
Soon, Cai Yonglong revealed a subtle expression.
Seeing this, Wang Ping’s eyes brightened, knowing that Cai Yonglong must have drawn a pretty good Golden Finger, and he felt happy for him.
“Cai, what kind of Golden Finger did you draw?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“My new Golden Finger is called Absolute Defense, not the type that can help me grow.” Cai Yonglong explained to Wang Ping with some hesitation: “As the name implies, once this system is used, the target can obtain the effect of absolute defense, whether it’s a physical attack, a soul attack, or effects like curses, all become ineffective, and the protected target absolutely cannot be hurt.”
“Absolute Defense, a Golden Finger of defensive type? Not bad at all. If you use it well, it can be game-changing. The only question is, how high is the current defense limit?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and commented with interest.
“Defense limit? Isn’t it Absolute Defense?”
Cai Yonglong was confused.
“Although it’s called Absolute Defense, it’s only relative in reality. In fact, if the Golden Finger is not optimized, it can still be destroyed by an excessively powerful existence.”
Wang Ping shook his head and explained.
“Cai, what do you think the Golden Finger Optimizer is for?”
“Uh… you’re right.” Cai Yonglong nodded awkwardly.
“Tell me, how long can your defense last?”
Wang Ping asked another question.
“Three seconds.” Cai Yonglong became even more embarrassed.
“Three-second real man? That’s even shorter than the Light Giant.”
Wang Ping teased.
“Three seconds is not short.” Cai Yonglong said with a stiff face.
For a strong person, three seconds is a very long time.
After all, the attack speed of strong people is too fast.
Moreover, the main purpose of this Golden Finger is to block the terrifying attacks that are difficult to defend against.
“I’m just kidding.” Wang Ping shook his head and said: “Now, let me test the defense limit of your Golden Finger.”
“Alright, I will use my ability on this spiritual tool.” Cai Yonglong nodded and directly took out a bead-like spiritual tool.
Wang Ping did not hesitate and unleashed the power of a royal character, squeezing with all his strength.
As Wang Ping squeezed with all his power, the Spirit Pearl crackled, and the surrounding space shattered. However, there wasn’t even a trace of damage on the Spirit Pearl.
This Spirit Pearl remained intact even in the face of Wang Ping’s royal-level power!
“Interesting.”
Wang Ping withdrew his power and smiled playfully.
His power was enough to contend with an Emperor Realm 7th-Tier strong person.
Although he didn’t go all out just now, and didn’t even use Divine Skills, it was still a royal-level power, and not just any ordinary royal-level power either.
However, when he concentrated his power, he couldn’t even destroy a single spiritual tool.
This showed that Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger had a truly terrifying defense.
“It is indeed a defensive-specialized Golden Finger. Although its duration is very short, its defense is far superior to Wang Shuqi’s defensive-specialized and growth-type defensive Golden Fingers even without optimization, so calling it Absolute Defense is not an exaggeration.”
Wang Ping gave his evaluation.
“Not bad, your Golden Finger might be of great help.”
“As long as Brother Wang is satisfied, I’m happy.” Cai Yonglong also revealed a joyful expression, becoming more and more satisfied with his own Golden Finger.
Wang Ping glanced at Cai Yonglong, watching his joyful appearance, and shook his head slightly.
Although he wanted to say that this Golden Finger was good, it was ultimately not as powerful as his previous one. However, since Cai Yonglong had already changed his Golden Finger, Wang Ping wouldn’t say anything more.
“New Emperor, now that you are here, you are a guest. However, please do not unleash such terrifying power on the back of this old turtle of mine, as it will affect my seal. If that happens, it will bring catastrophe to this world.”
At this moment, an ancient voice suddenly rang in Wang Ping’s mind.
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with understanding, realizing that it was the Profound Turtle speaking to him.
His previous attack was too terrifying, and he had clearly disturbed the old turtle that was sealing the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, making it very dissatisfied and thus giving him a warning.
In fact, the Profound Turtle had discovered Wang Ping as soon as he set foot on the island, but seeing that his aura was pure and he was a newly promoted emperor, the Profound Turtle had ignored him.
After all, a new emperor is not enough to threaten the Profound Turtle.
The Profound Turtle’s defense is the strongest in the Purple Spirit Realm.
Even in its current state where it is exerting all its strength to maintain the seal, it would still take someone like the Jiuyou Demon Emperor leading the masters of the Jiuyou Demon Sect to kill it.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Hand! The upper world imperial clan! (Big of 10,000 words!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Hand! The upper world imperial clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_3
However, Wang Ping’s arrival wasn’t the only issue. His brazen display of power greatly annoyed him.
Beyond that, the aura emitted by Wang Ping also stunned him.
He was shocked that a newly crowned emperor could release such a powerful imperial aura.
Even Profound Turtle, an entity that had lived for a very long time, had never seen an emperor like Wang Ping.
“This is my oversight,”
Wang Ping apologized with a flicker in his eyes.
“There is no point in you staying here. You should leave quickly to avoid attracting the attention of more emperors. Profound Turtle doesn’t like emperors coming to his territory.”
Profound Turtle’s voice echoed once more.
“Alright, I’ll leave after I meet some acquaintances.”
Wang Ping replied politely.
Wang Ping had a lot of respect for the Profound Turtle who had sealed away a bizarre existence.
Not to mention, before he fully matured, he often used Profound Turtle Continent as a safe base.
“Hmm.” After Profound Turtle responded, his spiritual sense disappeared. The previously fluctuating aura once again became calm and orderly, inhaling the spiritual energy of the sea region.
“Let’s go, we’re heading to Chi Clan.”
Wang Ping also withdrew his spiritual sense, tore through space, and stepped into a stable space channel.
Seeing this, Cai Yonglong clicked his tongue in envy and stepped in as well.
The next moment, the two emerged from the space channel and arrived at the location of Chi Clan.
“Master!”
As soon as Wang Ping appeared, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, who was lazily enjoying the sun, trembled and stared dumbfoundedly at Wang Ping emerging from the space channel.
Creating a space portal by tearing through space, his mind did not possess such a concept, and he had no idea what level of power it required to achieve this.
After all, the Profound Turtle Continent has been isolated for too long, losing knowledge beyond the Transcendent Realm.
“Young Tiger, you seem quite relaxed.”
Wang Ping looked at the monster beast he had tamed initially out of interest and chuckled lightly.
It was lucky for this young tiger to have formed a connection with him.
“Not at all.”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger appeared somewhat guilty and looked as naive as a button.
“Here are some demon beasts’ elixirs. You can use them to further your training. Don’t let me down.”
Wang Ping threw several demon beasts’ elixirs of different grades at the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger with a smile.
These were the elixirs Wang Ping obtained while traversing the archipelago and Sword Domain. They were of no use to him, but giving them to the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger seemed like a good idea.
“Thank you, Master!”
Upon detecting the powerful monster energy within those elixirs, the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger showed a delighted expression and hastily expressed his gratitude. He even considered extending his large tongue to lick Wang Ping.
However, remembering how Wang Ping used to avoid him, he suppressed that thought.
Next, Wang Ping ignored the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger and appeared in the middle of the Drill Ground of the Chi Clan village.
At this moment, the village chief and Chih Hu were supervising the training of the children in Chi Village.
Chifeng was among them.
His current cultivation level has reached the late stage of Viscera Training.
Honestly, it was a bit slow.
However, considering the special circumstances of the Chi Clan and the fact that Chifeng is only around ten years old, this level of cultivation was commendable.
“Big Brother Wang!”
Wang Ping’s sudden appearance startled the Chi Clan people in the area.
However, when they came to their senses, they all showed joyful expressions.
After all, it had been a long time since Wang Ping had come to visit them.
“Chifeng, it’s been a while. You’ve all grown stronger and finally, show some manliness.”
Wang Ping patted Chifeng’s head, praising him.
“That’s right, I’ve grown a lot taller and put on quite a bit of muscle.”
Chifeng said with a proud look.
“However, I still couldn’t awaken my spiritual body… I’m sorry, Big Brother Wang, I’ve disappointed you.”
Soon after, Chifeng seemed to remember something and said dejectedly.
“Spiritual Body huh…”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered with emotions.
The Chi Clan was no ordinary Spirit Clan. Ignoring their hidden lineage, the mere possibility of their bloodline being related to the former Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang made them extraordinary.
“Don’t worry about it, just continue with your training. You could still become a powerful person in the future.”
Wang Ping comforted him.
“Yes!” Chifeng clenched his fists, his face full of determination.
“Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, you’re back.”
The village chief came over, still as kind as ever.
Ever since their long-standing grudge was resolved, the melancholy and sorrow in his eyes had completely disappeared, making him look even more benevolent.
“Greetings, village chief,” Cai Yonglong greeted with a slight bow.
“Grandpa Village Chief, I’m back.”
Wang Ping also greeted him with a bow and a smile.
He had a sentimental bond with the Chi Village.
Especially the village chief, he held deep respect for him, treating him like a respected elder.
If the village chief had not supplied him with Spiritual Stones as his initial capital, he might not have grown so rapidly.
If he hadn’t grown so swiftly, he would have died if he were dragged into a Group Task early on.
The first bizarre task required considerable power to complete.
Of course, if he wasn’t powerful enough, Alpha probably wouldn’t be so ignorant as to assign them the Group Task.
But then again, Alpha was quite foolish, and he might actually do something like that.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_4
Alpha:
This Wang Ping, it seems like his whole body is itching until the day turns dark…
“Village Chief, I’m back this time to take Chifeng with me.”
Wang Ping looked at the village chief and spoke again.
Now he is already an emperor, but when he just touched Chifeng and wanted to sense his blood, he still felt a palpitation.
This shows that even now, he still doesn’t have the ability to unlock the Bloodline Curse on Chifeng.
This undoubtedly further verifies his speculation.
Chi Clan is most likely from the Upper Realm.
The reason for their disappearance was either total Genocide,
Or they were summoned back to the Upper Realm.
This has made Wang Ping value the Chi Clan even more.
This time, by taking Chifeng away, he also wanted to verify another guess, to see whether the Chi Clan has any connection with Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang.
“During the last simulation, it was a bit of an oversight not to stake out Ye Chen and find the land of inheritance of Ashy Flame Emperor Chichang.”
The thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
Of course, although he thought so, Wang Ping’s situation at the time was very difficult, so he had no choice but to follow Ye Chen to look for opportunities.
But next time, he must not miss the inheritance location during the simulation.
“Of course, you can take him. I’m very at ease with Chifeng following you. It should be said that this is his chance.”
The village chief said with a smile.
They completely trust Wang Ping and have no doubts about him.
Wang Ping nodded, and after discussing some more things with the village chief, he took Chifeng and Cai Yonglong to another place.
That place, of course, was the Devil’s Cave.
In Wang Ping’s memory, during one simulation, Blood Demon Yuan Feng saw the Chi Clan people and showed a ghostly expression, which must have some hidden secret he didn’t know.
In the past, Wang Ping didn’t have the strength to force Blood Demon Yuan Feng to reveal the secret.
But now, Wang Ping has become an emperor, and it is extremely easy for him to force a soul-searching.
For this reason, Wang Ping wouldn’t miss this opportunity.
After all, he had promised Profound Turtle that he would leave soon and wouldn’t be back for a while.
When he returns, it will be time to solve the mystery.
Soon, Wang Ping and the other two arrived at the Devil’s Cave.
The seal on the Devil’s Cave was set by Wang Ping and is now opened by him.
As the three of them entered, they smelled a strong smell of blood.
Then, Wang Ping and the other two saw blood and bones all around and Blood Demon Yuan Feng, who was still in a sealed state.
“This guy looks strong, why is he sealed here?”
Cai Yonglong looks at Blood Demon Yuan Feng and exclaims in surprise.
Although Blood Demon Yuan Feng has been sealed for so many years and his strength has declined a lot, he still has some residual power of the Life and Death Realm, which allows Cai Yonglong to see his foundation.
As for Chifeng, he looked fearfully at this rotting corpse of Blood Demon Yuan Feng.
With such a gloomy and bloody environment and an old monster, it’s already beyond the limits of a ten-year-old child’s capacity for fear.
If it weren’t for Wang Ping being here, he would really be frightened and run away.
“At first, the Demonic Skill I mentioned was acquired from him. In the process, I even died several times.”
Wang Ping secretly told Cai Yonglong.
Some things are not convenient for Chifeng to know, so they could only communicate privately.
“Oh, so it’s him.”
Cai Yonglong looked at him strangely.
“Hehe, it’s interesting. At first, you were just ants who peeped but didn’t dare to come in, and now you’ve brought a Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection Cultivator, so you dare to face me directly?”
At this time, Blood Demon Yuan Feng spoke.
As Wang Ping and the others were examining him, Blood Demon Yuan Feng naturally was examining them as well.
He couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s cultivation and it seemed like he was using some kind of treasure.
As for Wang Ping’s cultivation reaching above the Life and Death Realm, in Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s view, it was absolutely impossible.
After all, it had only been a short time.
In this short period, even if he left Profound Turtle Continent, his cultivation would have just been stagnant or improved by a small realm at most.
“Pfft, Mr.Wang, has he always been this bold?”
Upon hearing Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s words, Cai Yonglong showed a shocked expression.
Wow, a guy who’s barely in the Life and Death Realm.
And it’s only his peak period that he would be at the Life and Death Realm, but he dared to call Wang Ping, who has at least King Realm strength, an ant, which is ridiculous.
“He’s always been pretty bold.”
Wang Ping gave a definite reply.
This guy, back in the Profound Turtle Continent, was killing and committing crimes rampantly, completely unafraid of Profound Turtle killing him, so he’s quite a ruthless character.
On second thought, Wang Ping felt that he couldn’t kill him.
After all, this Blood Demon Yuan Feng was actually from the Profound Turtle Continent, and perhaps he was also related to the bloodline of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
Although the possibility was low, he had to be cautious.
“Hmph, you two juniors, although you are a bit disrespectful to me, you have good talent. If you break the seal and release me, I may consider accepting you as my disciples, teach you the supreme Demonic Skill, and make you powerful Life and Death Realm Masters.”
At this time, Blood Demon Yuan Feng spoke again, trying to bewitch Wang Ping and the others.
“You said you want to accept us as your disciples?”
Cai Yonglong looked strangely, and directly put out the Flawless Profound Elixir.
In an instant, the brilliance of the Flawless Profound Elixir illuminated the gloomy Devil’s Cave, making it no longer so cold.
And it stunned Blood Demon Yuan Feng, who almost bit off his own decaying tongue.
“Fl- Flawless Profound Elixir!”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng stuttered as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_5
Damn, what’s the background of this kid? He actually congealed an Immaculate Profound Elixir, something that not even the Holy children of many Holy Lands or the Demon Children of Jiuyou Demon Sect could necessarily achieve.
It should be said that many Holy children and Demon children couldn’t do such a thing.
For a moment, Blood Demon Yuan Feng was completely silent, finally understanding why Cai Yonglong ridiculed him earlier.
The other party had the qualifications.
“I will ask you some questions, I ask, you answer, I may consider sparing your life.”
At this moment, Wang Ping spoke as well.
His gaze was calm, only exuding a trace of the Emperor’s aura.
“Emperor, Emperor?!”
In a flash, Blood Demon Yuan Feng was like being struck by lightning, his eyes widening, almost scared to death on
the spot.
Although Blood Demon Yuan Feng had never seen an Emperor before.
But, he had seen the Sect Master of Blood Demon Sect.
That was a Quasi-emperor Master.
However, even Quasi-emperors do not possess the Emperor’s majesty.
A true Emperor, even if you’ve never seen them or felt their pressure, you’d understand that they are an Emperor revered by heaven and earth as soon as they reveal a bit of their majesty.
This directly stunned Blood Demon Yuan Feng.
He was just a small Life and Death realm cultivator, why was he receiving such a grand treatment, being interrogated by an Emperor?
However, Blood Demon Yuan Feng recalled the incident two years ago when Wang Ping sealed him and couldn’t help but smile bitterly and feel confused.
He didn’t believe that Wang Ping could become an Emperor in just two years after being a Transcendent Realm Cultivator, that was absolutely impossible.
But, he couldn’t understand why an Emperor like Wang Ping would carefully set up such a weak seal outside two years ago, just to tease him?
