“Emperor, please speak. If I know, I’ll answer all.”
Although Blood Demon Yuan Feng was filled with questions, he didn’t dare to ask more, but humbly and somewhat proudly said.
Although he was a cultivator of the Demon Path, speaking face-to-face with Emperor in his lifetime was the supreme glory.
If he could die by an Emperor’s hands, then he would be content with his death.
Compared to dying in pain, accepting the Emperor’s strike and dying, which was a better choice, any smart person would make the correct decision.
“What do you know about the secrets of the Chi Clan?”
Wang Ping brought Chifeng to his side and said calmly.
“Chi Clan?”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng was startled, only then did he notice Chifeng, the child he had overlooked.
“Emperor, I once entered a forbidden land and learned some secrets from it.”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng looked at Chifeng with fear and said cautiously.
“This secret is related to the Chi Clan.”
“Forbidden land?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with sharp light, and he immediately had some guesses in his mind.
“Yes, forbidden land. That forbidden land is called the Dragon Flame Valley, the most dangerous place in the Purple Spirit Realm. It is said that if you force your way into its depths, even an Emperor might fall.”
“However, when I was being hunted down, I had no choice but to flee into the Dragon Flame Valley. I thought I would fall there and be burned to ashes, but I didn’t expect to be lucky enough to get a red jade stone, which protected me from the flames in the valley.”
“So, I entered the depths and saw some palaces. I learned some secrets from one of them. That was the secret of the Chi Clan.”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng revealed a look of reminiscing and spoke of the secret buried in his heart for many years.
He was overwhelmed by his secret and dared not share it with anyone or speak of it.
However, he could never have imagined that after his killing spree in Profound Turtle Continent, he would be sealed and left with no way out.
Now, at this stage, there was nothing worth hiding.
Of course, he also knew that even if he didn’t say a word, Wang Ping, the Emperor, could still perform soul-searching techniques.
Since he could not resist, why not just speak up?
“Dragon Flame Valley, Chi Clan’s secret.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he instantly understood that the opportunity Ye Chen obtained was probably in this
Dragon Flame Valley.
On the side, Chifeng looked puzzled, wondering how the conversation had turned to his Chi Clan, and he was having a hard time understanding it.
“The Azure Flame Emperor, who was the head of the Chi Clan back then. However, compared to the real secret of the Chi Clan, that’s not much. The true identity of the Chi Clan comes from the Upper Realm.”
At this moment, Blood Demon Yuan Feng continued to speak.
“As I suspected.”
Wang Ping’s face remained unchanged, seemingly validating his guess.
“What the fuck?! What?!”
In contrast to Wang Ping’s calmness, Cai Yonglong was dumbfounded.
Damn, this is really a world-shaking secret.
The Chi Clan actually had an Emperor and was from the Upper Realm.
The Chi Clan was once so powerful, but now they’re in such miserable conditions, having no Spiritual Origin Realm cultivators left, let alone an Emperor.
“However, the fact that the Chi Clan comes from the Upper Realm is not the most terrifying part.”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s voice was somewhat hoarse, as if he was completely recalling the shocking scene he had seen in the past, murmuring to himself.
“The most terrifying thing is that the Chi Clan’s background in the Upper Realm is extremely frightening. They once ruled the Upper Realm, were known as the Imperial Clan, and were revered for an entire era. However, because their ancestors suppressed a great terror and got infected with an unknown disease, it led to the entire Imperial Clan being affected and declining. They had no choice but to send most of their clansmen to various Lower Planes for refuge.”
“The Chi Clan in our Purple Spirit Realm is the offspring of a part of the Imperial Clan that fled to the Lower Plane.”
Upon hearing Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s description, even Wang Ping couldn’t help but be greatly shocked.
What the hell! Although he had guessed that Chi Clan’s background was astonishing, and they probably came from the Upper Realm, he really didn’t expect their background to be so absurd.

chapters.title: Chapter 481: 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big of 10,000 words!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 164: Cai Yonglong’s New Golden Finger! The Upper Realm Imperial Clan! (Big chapter of 10,000 words!)_6
Once leading the Upper Realm and commanding an era, they were called the Imperial Clan. This background is a bit too terrifying.
And now, he’s still struggling in the small Purple Spirit Realm and hasn’t even become the ruler of the Purple Spirit Realm.
As for the Chi Clan, their background is the Imperial Clan, and their ancestors are so powerful.
However, thinking about it further makes it even more terrifying.
The Chi Clan’s Bloodline Curse is too horrible, even the Chi Clan, who were the imperial clan, couldn’t bear it. Even their ancestor, who once ruled the Upper Realm, was tainted with misfortune, which is very frightening.
For a moment, Wang Ping felt that he was courting death by repeatedly wanting to probe the truth about the Bloodline Curse, but in the end, he suppressed the idea.
In the end, this is also because he never had any accidents in the life simulation, so he thought that although the Chi Clan’s Bloodline Curse was terrifying, it would be harmless to him as long as he didn’t provoke the curse.
Perhaps the curse doesn’t bother with weak chickens like them.
Otherwise, once it broke out, the damage would definitely be no less than that of the strange creatures and the dark fog, or even more terrifying.
Of course, Wang Ping believes that this curse will only affect the Chi Clan, otherwise, there would have been no incidents in the Purple Spirit Realm for so many years.
“So, the disappearance of the Chi Clan is because the curse completely erupted, causing them to disappear completely, or because someone in the Upper Realm has solved the curse.”
This thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
After all, according to Blood Demon Yuan Feng, the Chi Clan had transferred a large part of their clansmen to the Lower Realm.
That is to say, some of the clan members still remained in the Upper Realm.
If someone in the Chi Clan had grown up, broken the curse, and summoned all the Chi clansmen in the Lower Realm back to the Upper Realm, it would be possible.
“This is the real secret. However, knowing these secrets, I have new doubts and uneasiness in my heart.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh in his heart again.
It seemed that the Upper Realm was not so calm either.
An Imperial Clan disappeared just like that.
Those who had ruled an era had met with accidents.
“It can only be said that this is the norm for Profound Worlds. In every Profound World, all kinds of ancient monsters are calculating and plotting. It’s really too dangerous.”
Wang Ping shook his head and tried to calm his emotions.
“Holy shit! Holy shit!”
Compared to Wang Ping’s stormy thoughts but remaining silent, Cai Yonglong was completely stunned, and all he could say was ‘holy shit’.
At the same time, he looked at Chifeng as if he had seen a ghost.
The Chi Clan, who he thought had weak cultivation, actually had such a terrifying background, this is totally a golden thigh.
If he hugged it tightly, wouldn’t he soar helically in the future?
“Are we Chi Clan members really that amazing?”
Chifeng was a bit confused and bewildered.
He was young and had limited understanding of many things, but he could still get some gist.
Their Chi Clan used to be super powerful, and they came from the Upper Realm, but they fell into decline.
“Your Majesty, that’s all I know. Back then, I wanted to continue exploring the secrets, but the red stone couldn’t protect me anymore. I sensed the danger and had to leave reluctantly.”
Blood Demon Yuan Feng sighed.
“Let go of your Sea of Consciousness, I need to confirm some things.”
Wang Ping said.
Blood Demon Yuan Feng nodded and directly let go of his Sea of Consciousness.
Wang Ping didn’t say much and let Cai Yonglong check Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s memory.
He was worried that Blood Demon Yuan Feng had some involvement with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, so he had to be cautious.
“Brother Wang, he’s telling the truth, it’s all true. And his background is amazing; he’s from the Jiuyou Demon Sect.”
Cai Yonglong said excitedly.
“I see.” Wang Ping nodded but didn’t say anything more, and turned to leave.
“Your Majesty, please kill me, I don’t want to live anymore.”
Seeing Wang Ping leaving, Blood Demon Yuan Feng bitterly pleaded with a wry smile.
Wang Ping didn’t reply and continued to walk away.
As for Cai Yonglong and Chifeng, they both followed with lingering shock and excitement still on their faces.
“Sigh, in the path of cultivation, life and death are really not up to one’s own will.”
Seeing that Wang Ping didn’t bother to kill him, Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s eyes dimmed, and he said bitterly.
Next, Wang Ping returned to Chi Village and told the village chief and others about the Chi Clan’s background.
After hearing it, the village chief was also greatly shocked, very proud, and somewhat tearful.
He never thought that his ancestors would be so powerful, and the identity of their Chi Clan would be so astonishing.
At the same time, they finally understood where the painful Bloodline Curse came from.
However, now they owed Wang Ping another favor, and they didn’t know when they would be able to repay it.
“Village Chief, stay alive. Maybe, in another dozen years or so, you’ll return to the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping thought of the Chi Clan jade pendant given to him by the village chief and took it out, returning it to the village chief.
He had forgotten about it before.
Because since using the Chi Clan Blood Essence, the jade pendant hadn’t shown any reaction.
And after Wang Ping reached the Spiritual Fetus Realm, he no longer needed it.
Thinking about it now, this jade pendant is definitely not an ordinary thing.
At least, Wang Ping tried to check it out; even with his Emperor Realm cultivation, he couldn’t see what material it was made of or what was special about it.
This is a symbol of the identity of the Chi Clan Master, perhaps when the Chi Clan returns to the Upper Realm, it will be of great use in identifying their lineage.
“This won’t do. Since I’ve given it away, there’s no reason to take it back. Wang Ping, you should keep it.”
The village chief obviously knew the origin of the jade pendant, and he felt that what Wang Ping said made sense, but he still insisted on pushing it back.
“Alright.”
Seeing the village chief’s firm attitude, Wang Ping no longer persuaded and took it back.
This thing might be of great use to him too.
If the village chief didn’t want to take it back, he would have no qualms about accepting it.
Afterward, Wang Ping continued to talk with the village chief and others for a while, then went to the Sword Spirit Sect.
After arriving at the Sword Spirit Sect, Wang Ping looked at Bai Tianhong, who was practicing with the sword, and sighed.
Bai Tianhong had been of great help to him during the Profound Turtle Continent simulation.
Unfortunately, Bai Tianhong ultimately couldn’t keep up with his growth.
Besides, what made Wang Ping feel a headache now was Bai Tianhong’s identity issue.
Bai Tianhong was a descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor…
Once the strangeness came into being, Bai Tianhong would become demonized, turning into a specter under the control of the strangeness.

chapters.title: Chapter 482: 165: First Battle in Jiuyou! Discussing Quasi-Immortal Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 165: First Battle in Jiuyou! Discussing Quasi-Immortal Dao
“I wonder if Cai Yonglong’s golden finger can defend against the bizarre curse.”
Wang Ping silently thought in his heart.
If it can defend against the bizarre curse, it could be used on Bai Tianhong.
At that time, as long as he killed the bizarre creature within three seconds, there would be no problem.
Of course, killing a Quasi-Immortal Tier character like the Guilt-Punishing Emperor within three seconds is very difficult.
Unless he becomes a god, he can hope to do such a thing.
“No… I seem to be in the game as well.”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of something, his face changed, and a chill surged in his heart.
He had killed people on Profound Turtle Continent before.
What he remembered deeply was the first old man in Ye Chen’s ring.
Wang Ping didn’t know his origin, but he was also a person from Profound Turtle Continent, and there might be the possibility of having the bloodline of Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
After all, the bizarre creature’s ability is not limited to direct descendants or people with a strong bloodline.
Perhaps those branch bloodlines or hidden bloodline clans would also be affected.
In the end, no one knows how many generations have inherited the bloodlines on the Profound Turtle Continent and how many people possess them.
“Mr. Wang, what’s wrong with you? Your face suddenly became so serious.”
Cai Yonglong noticed that Wang Ping’s expression had changed significantly and was somewhat surprised.
“Cai, your golden finger may be of great use.”
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and sighed.
He had indeed overlooked this point before, and now thinking about it, there was indeed a great hidden danger.
If he ignored this matter, he might really have trouble in the future.
Even if he escapes to another world, he might be cursed and controlled by the bizarre creature.
As for releasing the bizarre creature in the following simulations and then knowing about this matter,
Sorry, there might not be such a development.
With his personality, since he knew about the bizarre creature’s ability, he would not give the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao a chance to release the bizarre creature.
If the bizarre creature is not released, the other party cannot fully control the body of the Guilt Punisher, and he will not activate the ability or cannot activate it…then it would really be a deadly dark thunder.
“Um.”
Cai Yonglong was somewhat puzzled and didn’t know why Wang Ping suddenly said this.
His golden finger indeed has a significant effect, but not to this extent.
After all, Mr. Wang had already evaluated it before.
Wang Ping smiled and looked at the puzzled Cai Yonglong and Chifeng, but didn’t explain anything, just walked towards Bai Tianhong.
“Tianhong, do you want to know your background?”
Wang Ping said to Bai Tianhong.
This made Bai Tianhong, who was practicing sword in front of the waterfall, startled and only then did he realize that Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong were walking towards him, somewhat surprised.
“Greetings to the Supreme Elders. Supreme Elders, do you already know my background?”
Bai Tianhong bowed and said excitedly.
“Well. But it’s a bit troublesome to explain slowly, I’ll just give you the initiation.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, stretched out his finger, and lightly tapped Bai Tianhong’s forehead.
In an instant, a lot of information about the Purple Spirit Realm was poured into Bai Tianhong’s mind by Wang Ping.
As for his background and the past of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, he had no intention of hiding anything.
“I am actually a descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor?”
After regaining his senses, Bai Tianhong was shocked. He never thought his background was so amazing, nor did he imagine that such a terrifying battle had happened before.
“Supreme Elder, I want to follow you out to cultivate and become stronger!”
Then, Bai Tianhong took a deep breath and pleaded.
“It’s not possible now.”
Wang Ping shook his head in refusal.
Taking Bai Tianhong out had no meaning at all.
He came here and did these things, but it was just out of interest.
“I see.” Bai Tianhong was a little disappointed.
However, he did not give up his desire to go out.
Since the elder was unwilling to take him out, he would work hard to cultivate and leave by himself.
“When I have defeated the great enemy, you will truly embark on the Cultivating Path. Don’t worry; this time won’t be too far away.”
Wang Ping said these words and then left with Cai Yonglong and Chifeng-
After Wang Ping and the others left, Bai Tianhong came to his senses and deeply bowed in the direction where Wang Ping disappeared.
Next, Wang Ping also visited some places on the Profound Turtle Continent and met familiar people like Xia Yuan.
Finally, Wang Ping looked at the Sunset Afterglow and prepared to leave the Profound Turtle Continent.
If he stayed any longer, the old turtle might get impatient.
“System, if I proceed with a paid simulation, what resources do I need to consume?”
However, before leaving, Wang Ping asked the Life Simulator in his heart about the price of the new charging system.
If he didn’t simulate once, Wang Ping would feel unsafe.
Of course, Wang Ping knew very well that he could not afford the resources needed for the paid simulation now, and he planned to carry out a free simulation later.
He just asked about the price of the paid simulation first, so that he would have an idea of what to do next in his heart.
“Ding, it is detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Emperor Realm 1st tier. For paid simulation, you need to consume ten King Artifacts or one Emperor Artifact.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“They actually don’t want Primordial Liquid anymore? But, ten King Artifacts and one Emperor Artifact can only simulate once, this price is just too expensive.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
King Artifact, in Purple Spirit Realm, only when a king nurtures a life-bound weapon, assisted with many materials, and finally undergoes Heavenly Tribulation can it become a weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Chapter 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_2
As for the Royal Artifacts, needless to say, they are even more precious.
The price of ten King Artifacts can’t compare to one Royal Artifact.
Of course, these artifacts like the King Artifacts and Royal Artifacts can be gained through reward refreshments, it just depends on the probability of the refreshment.
If you choose the Royal Artifact as a reward, you can simulate again.
However, sometimes the number of refreshment reward options is not two, and if you choose the Royal Artifact, you can’t choose anything else, so the gains aren’t necessarily that big.
The only gain is probably various cultivation realizations.
After all, although the free simulation is also an immersive simulation, you can’t receive rewards and there is no notion of realization.
Wait, that seems wrong…
“System, is the free simulation also an immersive simulation? Can there be realization benefits?”
Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“No. Even though there will be realizations during the simulation, all realizations will disappear after the simulation ends.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Okay, the free ones are indeed not good products. They really don’t want to give me any benefits.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sarcastically comment, not surprised by the answer.
“Free simulations can only serve as an information gathering tool. If I want to continue with paid simulations, finding a way to collect a large number of King and Royal Artifacts is a problem.” Wang Ping thought with a frown.
However, he didn’t regret choosing cultivation before.
Although it’s true that if he didn’t choose cultivation, he might have been able to simulate a few more times and see if he could refresh some advanced talents.
But he couldn’t refresh many times either.
After refreshing all the available rewards, in the end, you can only choose cultivation.
Furthermore, Wang Ping knew the nature of the Life Simulator. After a high-level talent appears once, don’t try to refresh any other high-level talent for a while, because they will all be green and white junk talents.
In addition to that, if he didn’t choose cultivation, he’d feel really insecure, as if he would be killed by the predecessor ransmigrator Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao at any time.
“Forget it, I’ll think about that later. For now, I need to experiment with a hunch using the free simulation to see if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao has the ability to catch me.”
“System, I want to start a free simulation.”
After thinking, Wang Ping voiced his thoughts.
As his words fell, the Voice of the System sounded: “Ding, the Life Simulator has started, the free simulation begins…”
Following that, with a dizzy sensation, Wang Ping understood that he had entered the state of immersive simulation.
“System, enable fast forward for me.”
After a moment of thought, Wang Ping spoke.
In an instant, the familiar luminescent screen appeared, and words appeared.
[On the first day, you tore through the space and took Cai Yonglong away from Profound Turtle Continent. Soon after you left, you were captured by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.]
[Looking at Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, you understood one thing clearly. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao had definitely obtained some means to accurately find you from the second-generation ransmigrator chat group. However, you either did not receive this method during the simulation, or you did not practice it, so it did not appear in the previous life simulation.]
[For this, although you were serious, you were also glad that you chose cultivation. Otherwise, if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao had caught you, he would have definitely tried to kill you in the Heavenly Sword Holy Land, which would have been a problem.]
As the text simulation got here, numerous images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and his vision changed. He was now in the middle of spatial turbulence.
In front of him, there were two figures, one black and one white.
The leader was undoubtedly the ‘Predecessor ransmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who he’d been dreaming of killing.
As for the person in white behind him, it was clearly the second White Demon Emperor from the Jiuyou Demon Sect.
“Jiuyou Demon Emperor, what are you intending by blocking my way?”
Wang Ping’s eyes shimmered as he shielded Cai Yonglong and Chifeng, speaking coldly.
Although this simulation was meant for investigating and testing, the situation he was most worried about had ultimately occurred.
To be honest, it was quite troublesome.
In this simulation, there was no way to use any other methods.
Otherwise, Wang Ping could have rolled dice, to see if he could have deceived and killed Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
If he had used the golden fingers of Cai Yonglong, Chen Kang, Chen Si, Wu Jun, and Liu Mei at the same time, Wang Ping felt that even though the probability of killing this guy was small, there was still a chance.
Even if he couldn’t kill him, he would still be able to escape.
However, Wang Ping didn’t want to play all his cards just yet.
After all, not revealing Cai Yonglong’s golden finger might still have unexpected effects in the future.
“Junior, I just came to invite you to be a guest at my Jiuyou Demon Sect. I wonder if you are willing.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao spoke indifferently with his hands behind his back.
Truthfully, he was quite surprised that Wang Ping’s cultivation had reached the Emperor Realm.
The fact that one could reach the Emperor Realm without making a name for oneself was indeed being cautious.
Therefore, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao felt that Wang Ping had hidden his strength in some way during the previous events.
Otherwise, there was no way anyone could have upgraded from the Nirvana Boundary Great Perfection to the Emperor Realm in just half a month.
In addition to this, there was another thing he was particularly concerned about and felt gloomy about.
That was, for some unknown reason, he had suddenly lost contact with the chat group and couldn’t call up the chat group anymore.
This made him suspicious that the Group Owner had kicked him out of the Chat Group.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_3
However, the chances of that happening were low, after all, he hadn’t provoked the other party, and they had no reason to kick him out.
Having lost contact with the outer world, he naturally wouldn’t let Wang Ping go. The sooner he dealt with Wang Ping, this unstable factor, the sooner he could be at ease.
“What if I say I’m unwilling?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, ready to make a move at any time.
“Then die.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao said coldly.
“You can’t.”
Wang Ping said coldly.
As he said this, Wang Ping directly summoned the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower and without hesitation, let it self-destruct its Emperor Source.
In an instant, a terrifying explosion swept through the spatial turbulence area, making it even more chaotic.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Wang Ping directly used his self-created secret skill to tear space once again, wanting to escape into the distance.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao had a cold expression as he casually suppressed the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower’s exploding energy turbulence.
On Wang Ping’s side, his face changed as he noticed the abnormality in space.
No matter how he tore space, he couldn’t escape this area.
The other party had used some means to distort and seal this space.
Although he was mentally prepared, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, this ruthless transmigrator predecessor, would never give him any chance to live once he made his move. However, the opponent’s move still made Wang Ping’s heart sink.
At this moment, Wang Ping also noticed that the second Emperor of Jiuyou Demon Sect, White Demon Emperor, did not make a move, but held a pitch-black array plate in his hand, standing silently behind, looking at him coldly.
“This array plate is what’s blocking my escape.”
Wang Ping had this thought in his mind as he began to plan for an escape method.
“I’ve already said, you can’t escape. However, I can give you one more chance. If you return to Jiuyou Demon Sect with me, I can spare your life.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s cold voice rang out, and he suddenly made a move, slapping towards Wang Ping.
In a flash, a black palm print appeared, carrying a terrifying power.
Wang Ping’s face changed as he used all his strength to unleash his divine skill, trying to block this terrifying blow and protect Cai Yonglong.
Among the two worlds, there is no ordinary person capable of reaching the Emperor Realm Great Perfection in cultivation.
But Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was absolutely ranked near the top among these strong people.
Even though Wang Ping’s self-created cultivation skills and divine skills were higher than Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the gap in cultivation was too big, and he was absolutely no match for him.
Only one blow was enough to make Wang Ping turn pale, his body crack, coughing up a large mouthful of blood, and his Emperor Dao aura weakened a lot.
However, Wang Ping barely managed to block it, keeping Chifeng and Cai Yonglong from perishing.
“Heh, to be able to block a casual strike from me, you have some skill. Life or death is just a thought away, what do you choose?”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao placed both hands behind his back, and the terrifying Jiuyou Demon spirit appeared in his palm again as he spoke coldly.
“Having cultivated to the Emperor Realm Great Perfection and established the Jiuyou Demon Sect, you are known as the Jiuyou Demon Emperor. Do you think an Emperor would bow down and cling to life when faced with death?”
Wang Ping sneered after recovering from his injuries.
“Emperors are human too, people can feel fear, why can’t they cling to life?”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao didn’t care about Wang Ping’s ridicule, still cold as ever.
Did he give Wang Ping a chance and talk to him just to waste time and saliva?
Wang Ping was buying time, looking for a chance to escape, and so was he, wanting to completely kill Wang Ping.
He was a careful and ruthless person who wouldn’t make a move unless necessary, and when he did, it would be a deadly blow, leaving no room for the opponent to survive.
Even if his strength was much higher than Wang Ping’s, and he trapped Wang Ping here, other emperors would definitely think Wang Ping was already dead.
But he wouldn’t, even if he was hunting a Nirvana Boundary ant, he would still make many arrangements to ensure a complete kill.
Moreover, Wang Ping was like him, a transmigrator with unknown trump cards, so he had to be careful.
Apart from this, he thought it was worth a try, success would make him happy, failure wouldn’t bother him, after all, it’s just a matter of moving his mouth.
Next, Jiuyou Demon Emperor didn’t say much, and continued to attack.
Wang Ping could see that this guy had not used his true strength, and was testing him step by step, to finally kill him completely.
Otherwise, with the difference in cultivation between them, Chu Xiao would be able to kill him with one hit or force Cai Yonglong to use his golden finger ability.
The difference in cultivation was too great, and he hadn’t acquired his exclusive Emperor-level equipment, making the difference in combat power too big.
As thoughts raced through his mind, Wang Ping made his choice.
Wang Ping’s face turned serious, directly ignoring Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s attack, and quickly rushed towards the White Demon Emperor.
The White Demon Emperor’s cultivation was only at the third level of the Emperor Realm, he couldn’t possibly be his opponent. Wang Ping had a chance to smash the array plate and escape.
“Divine Skill: Purgatory Ghost Knife!”
Seeing Wang Ping turned his back on him, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao snorted coldly, and a pitch-black longsword appeared in his hand as he suddenly slashed towards Wang Ping.
The terrifying knife aura erupted, like a grim purgatory, and the scene of Jiuyou’s ghost domain appeared, carrying boundless death energy as it slashed towards Wang Ping.
Faced with this knife, let alone Wang Ping’s newly promoted Emperor, even Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivators like Jiuyou Demon Emperor, if they dared to turn their back on this attack, their origin would be severely damaged.
However, Wang Ping completely ignored it.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_4
Just as the slash was about to hit Wang Ping, a not-so-solid energy shield appeared.
Normally, this energy barrier could only defend against attacks of a certain level and could never block a strike from an Emperor, let alone a full-strength strike from a top-tier emperor like Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
However, this situation had actually occurred.
The full-strength strike of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao struck the energy barrier and had no effect at all, only causing a slight ripple.
Meanwhile, this terrifying attack actually increased Wang Ping’s speed even further, allowing him to approach the White Demon Emperor even faster.
“What kind of power is this?”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao frowned.
Through the battle between Mr.Dao and Wang Ping, he knew that Wang Ping possessed various strange and bizarre powers.
Such as weakness, shackles, his abilities are truly unreasonable.
Of course, it is also possible that these abilities did not belong to Wang Ping, but to other Junior Transmigrators. This would explain why Wang Ping had brought so many weaklings with him on his mission.
The power this time might be the ability of Cai Yonglong, a weak Junior Transmigrator.
However, no matter who these abilities belonged to, they were all too strange, and they were even able to grant a fragile energy barrier the defense force to block his full-strength strike.
Indeed, something strange had happened to the chat group of the third-generation Transmigrators, and these Junior Transmigrators seemed to have some terrifying skills hidden from others.
Different thoughts flashed through the mind of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao as he continued to attack Wang Ping relentlessly.
However, no matter how strong his attacks were, he could not break through the energy barrier.
“Die!”
At this moment, Wang Ping shouted angrily, swinging his sword at the White Demon Emperor and unleashing a full-strength strike of his own.
His path was very complicated, and his Illusionary Divine Skill was the easiest way to interfere with enemies and create opportunities for killing.
Under normal circumstances, Wang Ping had some confidence in killing the White Demon Emperor in one strike.
However, the current situation was clearly not a normal battle between Emperors, and facing Wang Ping’s terrifying sword, despite being caught in the Illusionary Realm, the White Demon Emperor still had a sneer on his face, held an Array Plate in his hand, remaining unmoved.
“Clang!”
In the next instant, Wang Ping’s sword was blocked by a pitch-black barrier, unable to penetrate it, and even his Space Divine Skills couldn’t pass through it.
“!!!”
Seeing this, Wang Ping’s pupils contracted.
Although he already knew it wouldn’t be that simple and the success rate of killing the White Demon Emperor would be low, he couldn’t help but admire the preparations of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
This fellow had really gone all out in order to kill him.
Both the Black Array Plate that could seal off space in the Spatial Turbulence and make even the most proficient Emperor in Space Divine Skills unable to escape, and the energy barrier that could defend against his full-strength attack, were definitely not ordinary items, which would even make Emperors drool over.
“I told you, you can’t escape. If that’s all the cards you have, then you can die.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao snorted coldly and took action once more.
However, this time he did not use his offensive Divine Skills but rather binding-type Divine Skills.
In the Forest of Ghosts Domain, countless ferocious ghosts emerged, rushing towards Wang Ping, while the Ghost Spirit formed chains, sealing off everything around Wang Ping.
Although the invincible defense status seemed powerful, as long as it was bound, it would be nothing more than a lamb waiting for slaughter. Could you still maintain your abilities indefinitely?
Everything in the world has its limits, and it is impossible to maintain the invincible defense status forever.
“You win. However, it is impossible for you to capture me alive,” sighed Wang Ping, acknowledging Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s victory.
At this moment, the duration of Cai Yonglong’s golden finger had reached its end, and he no longer had any chance of escaping.
It should be said that from the moment he was caught by Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, there was no chance of escape.
This guy attacked with the intent to kill and would not give him any chance to escape.
It seems that his previous thought of being able to contend and escape from the Predecessor Transmigrator after becoming an Emperor was somewhat naive.
Facing a normal Emperor Realm Great Perfection powerhouse, he could escape using his Space Divine Skills.
However, facing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the ‘Predecessor Transmigrators,’ he really couldn’t escape.
“Since you’ve accepted your fate, die. White Demon, do it.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao sneered and said to the White Demon Emperor.
He could sense that the strange barrier had already disappeared.
In other words, Wang Ping could no longer block their Killing moves.
However, even though he had pushed Wang Ping to a desperate situation, he still did not intend to kill Wang Ping himself.
No one knew whether Wang Ping had any ability to drag down his killer along with him in death.
This was not impossible since Wang Ping, like himself, was not an ordinary cultivator but a cultivator connected to the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
Moreover, there were indeed such objects that could cause mutual destruction with enemies in this Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms. It was something that needed to be guarded against.
Following the command of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the White Demon Emperor directly unleashed a Black Bead that had accumulated a terrifying amount of power, and a horrific black beam shot towards Wang Ping.
This attack was extremely terrifying, capable of severely wounding even a top-tier Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivator.
Facing this terrifying attack, Wang Ping was inevitably killed without any suspense.

chapters.title: Chapter 486: 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Semi-Divine_5
A stroke capable of heavily injuring the Emperor Realm Great Perfection isn’t something Wang Ping has the ability to resist right now.
He wouldn’t be able to dodge either, as he was tightly bound by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, struggling to escape.
“Is he dead just like that?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s divine soul and physical body devoured by the black light, not even a speck of dust left behind, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao frowned, staring at the spot where Wang Ping fell, his mood somewhat peculiar.
He had painstakingly prepared numerous trump cards against Wang Ping, guessing how many tricks Wang Ping would pull against him.
In the end, aside from that short-lived pitiful defensive barrier, Wang Ping didn’t manifest any other unusual strategies. Not a single card from the myriad heavens and thousands of realms was played.
“Looks like, I overestimated you.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao frowned, muttering to himself.
While he had little idea about the progress of the Third Generation Chat Group, he assumed Wang Ping wasn’t an important figure within the Group.
This time, he had arguably used a sledgehammer to crack a nut.
Although Wang Ping wasn’t a small fry but a powerful emperor, he counted for little in Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s eyes. Using so many measures was a complete waste.
After all, these things were very expensive.
However, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao didn’t intend to leave directly. He continued to cast powerful divine skills and bombarded Wang Ping’s location for nearly an hour, guarding against any possibility of Wang Ping feigning death.
For traversers like them, finishing off enemies is a compulsory lesson.
“Your Excellency Chu Xiao, we have sealed this space, but your full strike has created such a commotion. I fear an Emperor may have sensed it; we must leave immediately.”
The White Demon Emperor, already accustomed to Chu Xiao’s nearly pathological behavior of finishing off enemies, reminded him.
“That bunch of old things, their noses are still so sensitive.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, bombing the area one more time before stopping, snorted coldly.
“Let’s go.”
As he spoke, both Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and the White Demon Emperor reassembled a space channel and quickly left the place.
Not long after Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and the White Demon Emperor left, figures began to appear as the space fluctuated.
There was the Sky Emperor of the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, the Emperor of the Sea Clan, and there were Emperors who preferred to stay hidden. The Purple Thunder Emperor from the Purple Thunder Divine Land was also present.
Besides, the spiritual sense of the Profound Turtle also stretched this way.
“It’s the aura of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor and the White Demon Emperor. In addition, there is another Emperor aura, but it seems to have fallen.”
The Sky Emperor stated with a solemn expression.
“Jiuyou has kept a low profile for so many years, has he finally reappeared? And as he reappeared, he has slaughtered an Emperor.”
The Purple Thunder Emperor’s face was grave, his eyes filled with apprehension.
The Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s mode of operation was too cruel and ruthless. But he was so powerful that he squeezed into the top twenty of the Purple Spirit Realm three thousand years ago.
How strong he is now, the Purple Thunder Emperor didn’t know, but he was certain he wasn’t a match for him. If they had a face-off, he might be killed in a short time.
“Alas, I didn’t expect the Jiuyou Demon Emperor to target him. Looks like I shouldn’t have made him leave so quickly.”
The voice of the Profound Turtle rang out.
“Profound Turtle Senior, are you acquainted with the fallen Emperor?”
Seeing the Profound Turtle speak, the Emperors were startled and curious.
“I wouldn’t say I know him. I only know that he is a newly promoted Emperor who suddenly appeared on my back. His way of appearing was quite surprising, as there wasn’t even a slight ripple in space, he simply appeared out of nowhere.”
“However, to prevent him from disturbing the seal, I asked him to leave my back quickly. I didn’t expect him to be attacked by Jiuyou Demon Emperor and White Demon Emperor shortly after he left.”
“A newly promoted Emperor…”
Hearing the Profound Turtle’s words, the Emperors were surprised. They didn’t expect that he was merely a newly promoted Emperor.
But why would a newly promoted Emperor be targeted by the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, and furthermore, with the White Demon Emperor joining hands? This level of treatment was not something they were even eligible to have.
“Why Jiuyou Demon Emperor targeted him, I have no idea. All I know is that his age shouldn’t be large. His life vitality is exceptionally vigorous, his age definitely wouldn’t exceed a thousand years. The fall of such a young Emperor is indeed a great loss to our Purple Spirit Realm.”
The voice of the Profound Turtle echoed again, full of regret.
It couldn’t be denied that the Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s means were indeed powerful. The place where they were standing was not too far from their locations, yet they didn’t sense the battle fluctuations at the very first moment. This was indeed daunting.
“What? An Emperor below a thousand years? How is that possible?”
The Sky Emperor and others shrunk their pupils, revealing shocked expressions.
It wasn’t their fault if they couldn’t hold themselves together. To be an Emperor, one couldn’t be a trivial figure, but the words of the Profound Turtle were too shocking. Even for them, as Emperors, it was difficult to hold on.
An Emperor below a thousand years old, how outrageous was that?
One must know, in the Purple Spirit Realm, the fastest one to reach the Nirvana Boundary took one thousand five hundred years.
Now, there was someone who became an Emperor before he touched a thousand years. That was too preposterous.
If anyone else had said this, they would have sneered, thinking they were being played with.
But this was said by the Profound Turtle, which adds a high credence to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Quasi-Immortal_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 165: First Battle of Jiuyou! Discussing the Path to Quasi-Immortal_6
The Profound Turtle, an ancient entity that has survived for hundreds of thousands of years, possessed extremely formidable sense of life, and given its character, it wouldn’t jest about such matters.
That is to say, this mysterious newly crowned Emperor was indeed a new emperor who is less than a thousand years old.
“It is indeed a pity.”
Emperors like Sky Emperor also sighed.
If one were to calculate the time, it would be one or two thousand years left until the merger of the two realms.
If this new emperor were not to die, perhaps there would be an additional Emperor Realm Great Perfection combat power in the future.
Even the possibility of becoming a Quasi-Immortal was faint, but still hope existed.
Having such strong fighting force would give them much more peace of mind during the merging of the two realms.
But unfortunately, he was killed by Jiuyou Demon Emperor, a calamity.
“We must find a way to lure out Jiuyou Demon Emperor and eradicate Jiuyou Demon Sect before the two realms merge. If not, it will be an endless trouble in future—who knows whether he will attack other Emperors.”
The temperamental Purple Thunder Emperor declared.
“We indeed need to discuss a strategy. Based on the lingering aura here, he possibly has reached the Great Perfection Tier of Emperor Realm, which is exceedingly dangerous.”
The Sky Emperor nodded in agreement.
Subsequent to that, the Sea Clan Emperor and the Emperors of Eastern Desolation left the location one after the other.
The Profound Turtle also withdrew its spiritual sense and continued its slumber.
Half an hour had passed, a figure suddenly appeared in this area.
It was none other than Wang Ping.
“Thankfully there was a Rebirth Tally, otherwise, I would have actually fallen this time. Although it was within the simulation, it’s still a pity that I was unable to continue exploring the subsequent developments.”
After his resurrection, Wang Ping murmured to himself.
Nevertheless, the gains this time were not trivial. He now had a clear understanding of many trump cards of ‘Predecessor Transmigrator’ Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, which was extremely advantageous for his next confrontation.
“Next, system, fast forward.”
Wang Ping spoke inwardly.
“Ding, fast forwarding…
The system’s voice echoed once again.
[After you resurrected, to prevent Jiuyou Demon Emperor from learning that you survived and catching you off guard, you decided to purposely release your aura, drawing back the departed emperors. Ultimately, everyone including the Profound Turtle and other emperors sensed your aura, returned with great surprise.]
[They were curious about how you survived from Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s hands and without giving too much explanation, you expressed your intent to go the Heavenly Sword Divine Land as a guest to discuss the strategy against Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.]
[All of them agreed to your idea. Except for the Sea Clan Emperor and the Profound Turtle, the other emperors all went to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land. They were very curious about you, all wanting to know you, while you did not reject them and had a cheerful discussion—among which was the topic on dealing with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.]
[However, you concluded that you could only kill him if you find out his hideout and then launch an attack together.]
[Meanwhile, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao also found out you’re still alive, he guessed that you had some means of resurrection and was very annoyed.]
[However, he wasn’t overly worried about it either. Now that he had a clear understanding of your true strength and trump cards, as long he captured you again, he can easily kill you.]
[Nevertheless, what bothered him was that he only had one Heavenly Secrets Tracking Charm left which he had previously used to track your location, now he doesn’t have any means to gamble on you any longer.]
“I was wondering how that guy was able to locate my position, turns out he had something so useful. It’s almost certain that this is another good stuff he got from other transmigrators in the Second-Generation Chat Group. If we assume that way, the Second-Generation Chat Group should also have a delivery function.”
Wang Ping made assumptions while looking at the simulation.
Of course, it was also possible that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao got this item from the Purple Spirit Realm.
After all, this world had forces like the Heavenly Secret Pavilion that could deduce heavenly secrets.
“No, during one of the simulations, Chu Xiao approached the Heavenly Secret Pavilion to find me. But after being refused by them, he became furious and destroyed the Pavilion. This indicates that the Heavenly-tier Tracking Charm indeed came from other transmigrators.”
Wang Ping thought of the content of a previous simulation and was confident about his deduction.
It had to be said that the immersive simulation and text simulation each had their advantages and disadvantages.
The text simulation doesn’t have much detail in terms of combat, it’ll simply describe how he was killed, it doesn’t explain the details of how strong the opponent actually was.
But the advantage of text simulation is the god’s eye perspective—it can describe the other party’s psychological state and depict the story’s development without Wang Ping’s perspective.
On the contrary, the immersive simulation doesn’t allow him to know what the opponent is thinking or know about things happening elsewhere, he also doesn’t know what others are thinking.
“Heh, with the Life Simulator, your entire deck will be exposed as the simulation progresses. I’d like to see how you’ll compete against me after that.”
Wang Ping sneered in his heart as he continued to focus on the simulation content.
[Soon after, you left the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and went to the Eternal Frozen Land. After all, within the Purple Spirit Realm, apart from the Eternal Frozen Land, you didn’t feel safe elsewhere. Right now, you only wanted to continue cultivating in the only safe place—the Eternal Frozen Land and upgrade your cultivation to Emperor Realm 7th Tier.]
[As long as your cultivation reaches Emperor Realm 7th Tier, in addition to the further enhancement of other aspects, you would have no fear of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. As formidable as the opponent may be, as long as your cultivation caught up, you could face him head on.]
[After arriving at the Eternal Frozen Land, you were sensed by the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. However, she had no intention of coming out, assuming that you, a newly crowned Emperor were here seeking Pure Yin power for your training successors. After all, such events occurred many times, and she was used to it.]
[However, when you directly expressed your desire to meet her, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was taken aback. Eventually, after some contemplation, she chose to condense a force to create an incarnation to see you.]
[You had many discussions, and started discussing the Tao. Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was surprised, not expecting that your understanding of the Ice Path was astonishing, and you even realized cultivation skills that surpassed hers, which piqued her interest.]
[In the end, you two called each other fellow taoists, and became much closer. While you took this opportunity to express your desire to cultivate and seek Enlightenment here.]

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 166: Emperor Realm Great Perfection! Divine artifact! Defeating Jiuyou (Additional chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 166: Emperor Realm Great Perfection! Divine artifact! Defeating Jiuyou (Additional chapter!)
[Despite her doubts, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan accepted your request. She felt that discussing Tao with you would be of great help to her as well.]
[Next, you created a Cave Mansion in the Eternal Frozen Land and settled there.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a millennium passed. During this time, you diligently cultivated and sought enlightenment. Ultimately, you successfully raised your cultivation to the 7th-Tier Emperor Realm within this millennium and forged your own Emperor Artifact.]
[Unfortunately, although you wanted to create god-tier cultivation skills and divine abilities, without any god-tier cultivation skills and divine abilities to reference, it was impossible for you to create them in a thousand years on your own.]
[However, you were not without gains, as you advanced your cultivation skills and divine abilities to a deeper level. Although your cultivation skills and divine abilities were still at the quasi-immortal level, just like the ones created by Ji Bingyan, your strength far surpassed hers, making her admire you.]
[Now, with nearly a millennium passed, you felt that the time was ripe and that it was approaching the time when the two realms intersected. As a result, you decided to bid farewell to Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and leave on your own.]
[After leaving the Eternal Frozen Land, you intentionally waited for Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to find you. However, after a long wait, there was still no sign of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. From this, you deduced that he was not able to track you because he had learned a secret skill, but rather that he had used some kind of one-time-use item.]
[With this in mind, you felt slightly relieved and headed for the Ashy Flame Valley. Upon arriving at the Ashy Flame Valley, you could feel its terrifying power. The flames of the Ashy Flame Valley were indeed terrifying—the deeper you went, the more terrifying they became. Even a cultivator at the Emperor Realm Great Perfection could not withstand the scorching flames.]
[You suspected that the reason the flames were so terrifying was that the people of the Chi Clan had set up a heaven-and-earth array here in the past, gathering these terrifying flames to prevent other cultivators from entering.]
[Faced with such a terrifying flame array, even you could not forcefully barge in. While considering whether or not to go to the Heavenly Sword Divine Land to find Ye Chen and see how he had entered and obtained the inheritance of the Ashy Flame Emperor, the Chi Clan jade pendant in your body began to glow, resonating with the Ashy Flame Valley.]
[In the end, the flames around you became gentler. Seeing this, you were astonished, and after marveling at how extraordinary the jade pendant was, you entered the valley.]
[Once you reached the deepest part, you saw many palaces with banners flying above them, each bearing the word ‘Chi’ filled with divine charm. You sensed the spiritual energy within these palace clusters, and found that the fire attribute energy here was extremely dense, far exceeding other regions, making it a cultivation holy land for fire attribute practitioners.]
[Although this place is a paradise for fire attribute cultivators, where cultivating here would definitely yield twice the result with half the effort, ordinary cultivators simply cannot survive here. To withstand the violent fire attribute energy, one must at least possess the cultivation of the Yin Yang Mirror.]
[As a result, you guessed that the Chi Clan of the past, with the curse growing stronger and their cultivation ceiling growing weaker, knew that staying here would inevitably lead to disaster, so they reluctantly chose to leave this secret world. Of course, the premise of this conjecture is that the environment here was arranged by their ancestors, and the later generations cannot change it—more accurately, they no longer have the ability to change it, so they could only reluctantly migrate.]
[In the end, the Chi Clan struggled to survive in the Purple Spirit Realm, gradually declined, and was forced to flee to the Profound Turtle Continent. Even after arriving on the Profound Turtle Continent, they continued to wither and almost faced genocide.]
[You searched for what you wanted in the nearby palaces. Eventually, you found some hidden records that were not much different from what Blood Demon Yuan Feng had said. Afterward, without wasting any time, you searched for more valuable palaces.]
[Speaking of the most valuable places, they were undoubtedly the Treasure Hall, Inheritance Hall, and Elixir Garden.]
[You first arrived at the Treasure Hall, which had restrictions in place. However, thanks to the jade pendant, you easily entered. This made you wonder about the status of the ancestor of that Chi Clan’s branch in Chi Village, thinking it must have been quite high, or else they wouldn’t have had such great authority.]
[After all, when the Chi Clan left this place, they did not put all their eggs in one basket. Instead, they formed more than a dozen ethnic groups and went to different places.]
[Upon entering the Treasure Pavilion, you discovered that it was already empty, with no treasures left behind. Apparently, the Chi Clan had taken away the precious items when they left.]
[However, you soon found a hidden chamber, and with the help of the jade pendant, you entered. Then, you were amazed by the sight before you. Inside this hidden chamber were enormous resources.]
[Top-tier Spirit Liquid was countless. Various heavenly materials and earthly treasures were also not lacking. In addition to that, there were as many as seventy King Artifacts and even three Emperor Artifacts.]

chapters.title: Chapter 489: 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_2
[Seeing so many treasures, you are shocked and delighted. The Chi Clan has truly left behind an astonishing treasure trove. At the same time, you quickly think of the reasons why the Chi Clan would leave so many valuable things here, while not even a glimpse of middle and low-level resources are to be found.]
[As expected, when they left, the strongest amongst them probably had only Life and Death Realm cultivation left. With such cultivation, leaving with all kinds of treasures would be an act of suicide.]
[After all, treasures are hot potatoes. Once discovered, there would be a calamity. Furthermore, with the Life and Death Realm, trying to activate King Artifacts would come at a heavy price. Under such circumstances, the Chi Clan could at best take only one King Artifact with their group to protect their lives, and they couldn’t possibly take more. As for Emperor-level artifacts, they were even more impossible to take, as they couldn’t use them even if they had them.]
[For this reason, it is better to leave them here, waiting for their descendants to have the ability to break the curse or wait for the curse to disappear, and then return here to retrieve the treasures.]
[After guessing the truth, you can’t help but feel emotional. Now, it seems that all the benefits have fallen on you. Of course, if you hadn’t learned through the Life Simulator that Ye Chen had received the inheritance of the Ashy Flame Emperor and knew so much from Blood Demon Yuan Feng’s mouth, these chances would probably belong to Ye Chen.]
[This is undoubtedly Ye Chen’s biggest opportunity in the Purple Spirit Realm, bar none.]
[Next, after taking all the treasures with you, you head to the Elixir Garden. Upon arriving at the Elixir Garden, you discover that there are no middle and low-level elixirs within it. Instead, only those treasures which are of great use to kings and emperors and can’t be taken away are in there, their growth vigorous, and their age astonishing.]
[Looking at these treasures, you are delighted, but you don’t immediately think of picking them.]
[Then you go to the Inheritance Hall. After entering the Inheritance Hall, you find that there are many cultivation skills and divine skills within. Among them, there are no few king-tier and emperor-tier cultivation skills and divine skills. In the process, you also find the Ashy Flame Emperor’s cultivation skills and divine skills.]
[However, this is not the most powerful cultivation skill and divine skill. You go to the highest level of the Inheritance Hall. On the highest level of the Inheritance Hall, you successfully find the god-tier cultivation skills and god-tier magical powers.]
[This makes you very excited. After all, you are confident that if you can use god-tier skills and magical powers as a reference, then you can create god-tier skills and magical powers on your existing foundation in less than a hundred years, advancing yourself even further.]
[However, you also know that now is not the time for enlightenment, so you begin to record all of these cultivation skills and magical powers, leaving them for your future enlightenment.]
[Finally, you arrive at the central hall. When you enter the central hall, you see a figure sitting there. That is none other than the Ashy Flame Emperor himself.]
[Only, this Ashy Flame Emperor is not a living person, but a body after entering meditation. As you stare at the body of the Ashy Flame Emperor, a true spirit appears on it. This is a true spirit left behind by the Ashy Flame Emperor, intended to guide the next generation.]
[Upon seeing you and the token you are holding, the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor sighs, knowing that the situation of the Chi Clan must be terrible; otherwise, someone like you, an outsider, would not be holding the Chi Clan Chief’s jade pendant and be here.]
[You explain to him that the Chi Clan has not been wiped out, but that the curse is getting worse and worse, making it impossible for them to break through to the Spiritual Origin Realm. However, they are now under your protection and no one will dare to bully them again. The true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor can see that you are not lying, but his emotions are complicated.]
[The Chi Clan of the past, how glorious it was, and now reduced to such a point, it is truly tragic. Next, you start asking about the specific cultivation realms of the Upper Realm, hoping the Ashy Flame Emperor can tell you.]
[In response to your questions, the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor doesn’t conceal anything, and chooses to tell you. It turns out that what is known as the Divine Realm in the Purple Spirit Realm is actually the Void Divine Realm.]
[In the Upper Realm, there are nine realms after the Emperor Realm, also called the Nine Realms of Tao Proving. After the Emperor Realm, there is the Void Divine Realm, True Lord, and God Monarch Realm, which some people like to call the Greater Realm of Lord. After the God Monarch, there is the Saint Realm, Saint King Realm, and Great Saint Realm, collectively referred to as Entering Saint Realm. The final three realms are Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and Emperor.]
[Hearing the explanation from the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor, you feel both happiness from knowing the path ahead and extreme shock. Because, according to the Ashy Flame Emperor’s words, the Chi Clan, which was once called the Imperial Clan, wasn’t it guarded by a family with a great emperor? The ancestor who once suppressed an unknown force could very well have been a great emperor.]
[You feel shaken in your heart and can’t wait to ask the Ashy Flame Emperor about the Imperial Clan. The true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor has no intention of hiding anything and directly tells you the truth. Their Chi Clan is indeed a family that gave birth to a great emperor and once ruled the Upper Realm, with their ancestors invincible in an era. However, in order to suppress unknown forces and protect sentient beings, the ancestor eventually fell. After the ancestor’s fall, their Chi Clan also faced the same unknown forces, resulting in their current predicament.]
[You are shocked and ask what exactly the unknown force is. However, the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor remains silent, saying that he doesn’t know either. After all, they were just ordinary clansmen who fled to the Purple Spirit Realm, only knowing the general situation and unable to access too many secrets.]

chapters.title: Chapter 490: 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_3
[You’re a bit disappointed, but you don’t continue to ask about the Ashy Flame Emperor’s true spirit. These things are not something that can be known at your level, and probing too much will only add to your troubles.]
[Afterward, you continue to discuss some matters with the Ashy Flame Emperor’s true spirit. He says that you have protected the Chi Clan and come here, which means you and the Chi Clan are somewhat destined. Thus, he plans to give you the Supreme Treasure of the Chi Clan who fled to the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[It’s a furnace called the Black Flame Divine Furnace, a lower-tier Artifact, possessing extremely powerful power and also useful for alchemy.]
[You gladly accept. A divine artifact is like a nuclear weapon to the cultivators of the Lower Realm. If used against cultivators of the same realm, it can easily crush the opponent. If your cultivation reaches the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, taking out a divine artifact to battle against a Quasi-Immortal, even if you can’t defeat them, should allow you to fight for some time.]
[Next, the Ashy Flame Emperor’s true spirit says that you can subdue the Ancient Flame of Green Dragon he left behind and then disperse. After properly burying the Ashy Flame Emperor’s body, you find the Ancient Flame of Green Dragon.]
[Perhaps due to the backup left by the Ashy Flame Emperor, you find that you can easily subdue the Ancient Flame of Green Dragon, which ranks first in the Purple Spirit Realm and is powerful enough to contend with 9th Tier of Emperor Realm cultivators, even if your cultivation is only at Emperor Realm 7th Tier, let alone being a king.]
[With the special nature of Primordial Spirit Skill, after subduing the Ancient Flame of Green Dragon, your cultivation directly advances to the 8th Tiers of King Realm. Next, though you really want to continue cultivating here, absorbing all the gains here and turning them into your own power, you are reminded of the imminent merge of the two worlds and Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao attacking Profound Turtle and releasing the strange force. You’re caught in a dilemma.]
The simulation text stops here, and several images appear before Wang Ping’s eyes. After a shift in consciousness and a change in his vision, he appears inside the palace deep within the Ashy Flame Valley.
“Nice, the harvest this time is quite astonishing.”
Wang Ping can’t help but sigh in his heart.
Various King Artifacts, Emperor Artifacts, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, even a Divine Artifact.
This opportunity is definitely enough to pile up a Quasi-Immortal.
“If it were normal development, after gaining the chance here, Ye Chen would definitely rise in one go. As long as he cultivates diligently, he could break through to the Quasi-Immortal realm, smash the Blood Demon Realm, then break through to the Divine Realm and ascend to the Upper Realm in a leisurely manner.”
“Unfortunately, there are too many butterfly effects, and only destruction awaits him and the two realms. Of course, this is only the case if I don’t appear.”
Wang Ping smiles with a smirk, muttering to himself.
“To cultivate or to confront Jiuyou Demon Emperor, do I need to struggle with my choice? I must kill him first. If I don’t kill him and release the strange force, I won’t be able to bear the consequences.”
Wang Ping thinks about the main task again, murmuring to himself.
With Cai Yonglong dead, Wang Ping doesn’t think he has the means to counter the strange force.
Even if Cai Yonglong hadn’t died, he wouldn’t have the power to kill off the strange force in a short period of time. In that case, he would still have to pay the price.
In any case, the strange force must not be released.
Killing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, the predecessor transmigrators, and continuing to cultivate and become stronger are the same in the end.
“However, what is the relationship between the strange force and the dark fog?”
Wang Ping frowns, thinking about this matter again.
In the Blood Demon transformation simulation, Blood Demon Wang Ping was killed by the dark fog.
But from the timeline, the strange force was released before the dark fog.
This means the strange force was released but did not make any major moves.
Otherwise, Blood Demon Wang Ping would not have been unaware of the news.
At that time, it was like nothing had happened, which was very strange.
Or was the strange force lurking, not causing any trouble, and waiting for the right time to release the dark fog, destroying the two realms?
This is very possible.
But if it’s not the strange force that released the dark fog and destroyed the two realms, how did the dark fog erupt?
“No, I have to let him release the strange force this time and gather information.”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping changes his mind again, deciding to let Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao kill Profound Turtle, collect information, and prepare for the next Paid Simulation.
“System, continue to fast forward.”
Wang Ping makes a decision and speaks in his heart.
“Ding, fast forwarding…”
The system’s voice sounds once again.
Immediately after, the luminescent screen reappears with text emerging.
[Next, you continue to cultivate in the Ashy Flame Valley, improving yourself. Meanwhile, you also create an incarnation to go to the outer world to gather information and prevent any information from being missed.]
[Soon, the two realms merge, and war breaks out, unfolding as you remember.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades pass, and you successfully improve the Primordial Spirit Skill to a god-tier skill by deriving from the god-tier skills and magical powers you’ve learned, creating your own god-level magical power:Fire Abyss.]
[At the same time, with the help of the god-tier skills and ancient medicine here, your cultivation further progresses, reaching the Great Perfection tier of the Emperor Realm in less than a hundred years. Although your realm has advanced from Emperor Realm 7th-Tier to Emperor Realm Great Perfection in such a short time, causing some instability in your realm, you don’t care too much. Your unstable realm can be further stabilized later on with more time invested.]
[Not to mention, if you don’t enhance your cultivation, you won’t have the confidence to prevent the emergence of the dark fog. If the dark fog emerges, then everyone will surely die.]

chapters.title: Chapter 491: 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 166: Emperor Realm Grand Completion! Divine Artifact! Exploding Nine Nether (Extra Chapter!)_4
[To put it bluntly, at this time, having insufficient strength is the real problem. You can clearly distinguish which is more important and which is less.]
[However, when you’ve just reached Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation not long ago and through the incarnation monitor, you discovered that Bai Chen, the descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, has suddenly become demonized, and you guessed the emergence of the sinister plot. You also found that your soul has also begun to be contaminated.]
[This made your face change dramatically, wanting to use your powerful cultivation to suppress the contamination. But, it only slowed down the contamination. In the end, you could only smile bitterly, knowing that among the people you’ve killed all these years, there are descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
[Among these people, the possibility of Ye Chen’s first ring grandfather being the person is estimated to be the greatest.]
[For this reason, you can only sigh in your heart, not expecting the worst-case scenario to happen. You have no choice but to end your life to prevent being completely dominated.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended.]
“Damn it!”
Wang Ping stared at the simulation content, feeling like cursing his mother.
Damn, he just felt happy because he reached the Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation effortlessly.
As a result, the ending of the simulation caught him off guard.
Unexpectedly, he had already fallen victim early on.
Even if Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao did nothing and did not deal with him in advance, as long as he releases the abnormality, Wang Ping would be finished.
You have to know that he did not kill Ye Chen’s first ring grandfather in the simulation, but in reality.
To be honest, it’s troublesome, this trap is really big and deep, and the danger factor is very high.
“Damn it, it’s only because I have the Life Simulator. Otherwise, who would know that killing a small character in the past will end his own life when dealing with the abnormal event in the future, that is really wronged.”
Wang Ping cursed and complained.
Then, he thought of the style of his predecessor ransmigrator, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
Although this guy is vicious and ruthless, he is also really cautious.
He could have killed Wang Ping but chose to let the White Demon Emperor take action with treasures in hand, so as not to kill Wang Ping himself.
This way of acting can help him avoid many potential dangers.
“I only have the Life Simulator, which gives me many opportunities to try and fail. Others don’t have this, so this way of action is more suitable for guile.”
Wang Ping admired Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to some extent.
Although this guy is the number one on his current kill list, his ability is still worthy of Wang Ping’s admiration.
“As an object of admiration, I choose to continue with paid simulation, increase strength, and then kill him.”
Wang Ping silently thought in his heart.
“System, use Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to pay for the simulation.”
Next, Wang Ping spoke without hesitation in his heart.
Although using a Daoist artifact for simulation is really extravagant, Wang Ping already knew that there were so many good things in the Ashy Flame Valley. He didn’t care about the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower anymore.
Using them for paid simulation to quickly enhance his strength is the right way.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator is activated, Talent Refreshing in progress…..”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping felt that the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower had disappeared.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Red Talent·Reflective Barrier and Blue Talent·Taunt.”
Red Talent·Reflective barrier: With this talent, you can activate a Reflective Barrier three times a day, reflecting all enemy attacks back to them, doubling their damage power.
Warm reminder: This talent has a limit, do not block overly powerful attacks or suffer the consequences!
Blue Talent·Taunt: With this talent, you can even taunt enemies and make them furious, leading them to attack you, the enemy with taunting capability, first.
“It seems that after the optimization of the Golden Finger, the probability of refreshing high-level talents has increased a lot. I thought that after refreshing the Purple Talent, the following talents would be trash. Unexpectedly, I refreshed another Red Talent. Instead, Green Talent and White Talent are gone.”
Wang Ping looked at the two talents refreshed this time, and his eyes were subtly focused.
This Red Talent is a functional talent. If used well, it can definitely counter-kill powerful enemies.
The effect of this Blue Talent is also good. Taunts can protect teammates well.
If the Red Talent did not refresh this time, this would definitely be the must-choose talent.
“System, I choose Red Talent·Reflective Barrier.”
Wang Ping said in his heart, making a direct choice.
“Ding Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness shook, knowing that he had once again entered the simulation state.
“System, fast forward.”
Wang Ping spoke again.
“Ding, fast-forwarding.”
As the system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text also emerged.
[Day 1: You did not choose to leave directly, instead, you chose to take the initiative to contact Profound Turtle, wanting to know if he has the ability to contact the other three Great Perfection powerful ones in the Emperor Realm. Profound Turtle was once again alarmed, asking you why you did this.]
[In response, you explained that you discovered Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s breath, and the other party intends to do something to you. You hope to attract other Emperors to join hands and kill him.]
[Profound Turtle was very surprised, not expecting you to be targeted by Jiuyou Demon Emperor. In the end, Profound Turtle thought about it and chose to believe you, contacting Primordial Emperor, who had a good relationship with him. As for the other Emperors, Profound Turtle had no way to contact them, they were all recluses, and no one knew where they were.]

chapters.title: Chapter 492: 166 Emperor Realm Great Perfection! Divine Artifact! Blow up Jiuyou (Additional !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 166 Emperor Realm Great Perfection! Divine Artifact! Blow up Jiuyou (Additional chapter!)_5
“Hearing this, you seem regretful, realizing that today, it is impossible to kill the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. If the Three Emperors had joined forces, there would still be a chance of killing him. If Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan had made a move, the chances of killing him would be even higher.”
“Unfortunately, only one of the Three Emperors could arrive, and discussing Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, a Quasi-Immortal, is futile. Due to special circumstances, she cannot leave the Eternal Frozen Land.”
“Soon, the Primordial Emperor got the news and chose to rush here.”
“As for you, after the timing was ripe, you decided to leave proactively, luring the Jiuyou Demon Emperor to act.”
“In the end, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor took action exactly as you remembered, dealing with you alongside the White Demon Emperor.”
“However, although you did not bring Cai Yonglong with you this time, you obtained the Red Talent·Reflective Barrier skill.”
“With the effect of the Red Talent, you successfully put the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao into an awkward situation, causing him to be in a mess.”
“This surprised and enraged the Jiuyou Demon Emperor. He became very wary of you and dared not attack you indiscriminately. He began to order the White Demon Emperor to attack with a precious bead.”
“The White Demon Emperor obeyed and launched a powerful strike at you. In response, you used the Reflective Barrier again, reflecting the attack right back.”
“However, because the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao understood the ability mechanism of your Red Talent·Reflective Barrier, he did not let the White Demon Emperor exert his full power.”
“As a result, although the attack was reflected back, there was a Defense Array Disk in place, protecting against the attack, and the White Demon Emperor was not killed by the reflection.”
“The Jiuyou Demon Emperor sneered, suggesting that your reflection ability was excellent, but he didn’t believe you could keep it up. As long as he used a force that could kill you and would not damage himself after reflection, he could exhaust you.”
“Your reaction to the judgment of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was not surprising, you remained calm.”
“At this time, the Primordial Emperor took action. In addition to the Primordial Emperor, other emperors including the Sky Emperor also arrived. This changed the expression of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. He was harboring dark feelings but had no choice but to retreat.”
“Even if it’s him, facing so many emperors, staying would only lead to demise.”
“With the retreat of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, you regret not making him pay a price.”
“Saint Master Taichu and others also expressed regret. They didn’t expect the cultivation level of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to have already reached the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, and his life-saving ability was so strong that so many people could not kill him, allowing him and the White Demon Emperor to escape together.”
“Next, Saint Master Taichu and other emperors became interested in you. After a conversation, they invited you to visit the Primordial Sacred Land.”
“In response to this, you did not refuse and chose to go.”
“After arriving at the Primordial Sacred Land, you stayed for some time and also taught some disciples of the Primordial Sacred Land about cultivation.”
