“Observing the situation, the Holy Master of the Primordial Sacred Land felt that since you, a loose cultivator, had become an emperor at such a young age, he had to rope you in. He chose to invite you to join the Primordial Sacred Land and become a Supreme Elder of the Primordial Sacred Land.”
“At this point, you were somewhat tempted. After all, joining the Primordial Sacred Land would allow you to better guard the Primordial Forbidden Land and explore its secrets.”
“In the end, you agreed. Your joining the Primordial Sacred Land added another Emperor to their ranks, shaking the Sacred Land and causing an uproar throughout the Purple Spirit Realm.”
“In your free time, you chose to head to the Ashy Flame Valley, where you collected a fortune and began your intense cultivation.”
“In the end, like in the previous simulation, just as the war between the two realms was about to begin, you broke through to the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, and even created God-tier Skills and God-level Magical Powers.”
“Calculating the time, you knew that the moment the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao attacked the Profound Turtle was not far off. If you do not stop him, there would be unexpected events, leading to your death.”
“For this reason, you returned to the Profound Turtle Continent early and quietly waited for the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to walk into your trap.”
“With the juxtaposition of the two realms, the stand-off between the strong forces of both sides, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao found the Profound Turtle as you remembered, intending to kill the Profound Turtle.”
“Faced with this, you, who had been waiting, chose to act. You instantly killed the other powerful beings of the Jiuyou Demon Sect. Even though the White Demon Emperor had ascended to the 4th Tier of Emperor’s Realm after a thousand years, reaching the mid-term of the Emperor’s Realm, he was also instant-killed alongside other Quasi-Emperors.”
“Even the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who was unprepared for your attack, was directly injured and greatly embarrassed.”
“Now you have transcended the combat power of emperors. Except for Quasi-Immortals, you are an invincible existence, and no one is your opponent.”
“The Jiuyou Demon Emperor detected that your cultivation had reached the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, and your combat power was much stronger than his, which was very shocking and a little unbelievable to him.”
“After all, it’s only been a thousand years, and you’ve risen from the Emperor Realm 1st tier to the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, which is unimaginable. You need to know that it took him nearly ten thousand years to achieve this.”
“You did not say much to the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, but acted forcefully, sealing off the space to prevent the Jiuyou Demon Emperor from escaping, then used god-level skills and god-level divine skills to attack the Jiuyou Demon Emperor.”
“The Ancient Flame of the Green Dragon allowed the Ashy Flame Emperor to face two opponents alone. Not to mention you now, who possess the flame and are endowed with superior configuration.”
“Faced with your strong attack, even the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, despite using all his methods, was no match for you. Your self-created god-tier skills and god-tier divine skills were enough to make you completely superior to the other Emperors.”
“In the end, even though the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao used all his trump cards, he could not beat you, and was desperately and unwillingly killed.”
“During this process, you didn’t even use the divine artifact, completely showing your invincible strength.”
“After you personally killed the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, you did not let him go. You started bombing him frantically, incessantly dealing damage and not giving him any chance of survival.”
“In fact, to prevent him from resurrecting like you, you plan to guard this place for another ten days or half a month.”
“Faced with your terrifying combat power and crazy behavior, the Profound Turtle was dumbfounded, only feeling that the younger generation now is very cautious.”

chapters.title: Chapter 493: 167: The Truth Behind the Black Mist! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word )
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 167: The Truth Behind the Black Mist! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word chapter)
[Because of the huge commotion you caused here, the emperors of the Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm have both sensed the anomaly here. Moreover, the emperor of the Purple Spirit Realm even came to investigate the situation.]
[When they found out that you had killed the Jiuyou Demon Emperor and wiped out all the experts of the Jiuyou Demon Sect, they were all astonished. After all, in just a thousand years, your growth from a newly promoted emperor to this level is somewhat terrifying.]
[However, soon, these emperors became excited. Now that the two realms are adjacent and a great war is about to break out, your display of such formidable combat power at this time is undoubtedly heartening.]
[If you can continue to enhance your combat power in the upcoming war and break through to the Quasi-Immortal tier, it would be even more delightful. After all, after the border of the two realms, they just sensed that a new Quasi-Immortal had been born in the Blood Demon Realm, and their pressure was really great.]
[If the Blood Demon Realm finds out that they don’t have a new Quasi-Immortal in the Purple Spirit Realm, it would be really over.]
[Afterward, you had a conversation with the emperors, who then invited you to sit and guard the front. To this, you chose to refuse and continue to squat here to prevent Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao from escaping after being resurrected.]
[Hearing your words, the emperors’ moods were very subtle. After all, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor had already died, leaving not even a trace, and the space here has not recovered for a long time. As a result, you are still uneasy. This is somewhat over-cautious.]
[However, since your mind is already made up, they didn’t say much more and quickly left. After all, as emperors, they couldn’t stay away for too long. If something unexpected happened, it would be troublesome.]
[As for the Quasi-Immortal in the Blood Demon Realm, after sensing your aura, they became apprehensive and thought that the power of the Purple Spirit Realm was indeed deep. So, they planned to wait and investigate the hidden strong players in the Purple Spirit Realm before starting a full-scale war.]
[Once bitten by a snake, the Blood Demon Realm side would be afraid of well ropes for ten years. After all, who knew that during the Great War ten thousand years ago, the Purple Spirit Realm had a second Quasi-Immortal hidden? Moreover, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s combat power was terrifying. If he hadn’t had an accident, even without the intervention of the other two Quasi-Immortals, the Blood Demon Realm would have a high probability of losing.]
[Therefore, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was stronger than Quasi-Immortal Mo Shangli who had saved the Purple Spirit Realm. In addition, he felt somewhat contemptuous towards the Quasi-Immortal Mo Shangli of that time. At that time, he still had the cultivation of Emperor Realm Great Perfection. He could see that the other party deliberately joined the battlefield later, waiting for the Guilt-Punishing Emperor to be mutually injured before taking action.]
[Even so, he was very suspicious that Mo Shang Li was eager for the Guilt-Punishing Emperor to die in battle. Such a person was somewhat too malicious, even more ruthless than the Blood Demon Clan. At least, the Blood Demon Clan was only cruel to outsiders and would not easily harm their own people. They certainly wouldn’t plot against their own people during such a war between the realms.]
“There were so many strange occurrences during the Great War ten thousand years ago?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
Although he had learned about some of the situations from the simulations in the past, he ultimately only knew a part of it, and most of it was from other people’s narratives or recorded in ancient books.
The authenticity of such information is obviously not as reliable as the judgment of an emperor who had participated in the war back then.
Let alone, this is a life simulation, it’s a description of a quasi-immortal’s inner thoughts in a God’s Eye View perspective, and there’s no need nor possibility to sow discord.
It can be said that the authenticity, if not one hundred percent, is at least ninety-nine percent.
“Mo Shang Li…..”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered.
Upon careful consideration, this guy was indeed ruthless enough.
The timing of his appearance during the Great War ten thousand years ago was too coincidental, and he emerged as a savior.
In addition, if the Guilt-Punishing Emperor were still alive, Mo Shang Li wouldn’t have been able to extract so many resources from the Purple Spirit Realm or even drain its divine source just to break through to the Divine Realm. He wouldn’t care about the sustainable development of the Purple Spirit Realm, nor would he bury the future generation’s path.
“This guy is too vicious.”
Wang Ping muttered, and his impression of this predecessor plummeted.
If he goes to the Upper Realm in the future, he must also be on guard against this person.
When your fellow countryman sees you, will his eyes be filled with tears?
Not a chance.
With his temperament, the possibility of stabbing you in the back is greater.
As Wang Ping was lost in his thoughts, the text simulation stopped here.
Then, various images flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and his vision changed.
Although it’s still not far from Profound Turtle, there were still terrifying energy residues and spatial turbulence spreading in front of him, which looked quite horrifying.
“Why did it enter an immersive simulation state? Is this another branch choice?”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows slightly in surprise.
“Yes, it seems to be a branch indeed. One is to leave directly, and the other is to squat here to prevent any possibility of resurrection. I can be resurrected, and Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao has connections with people in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, so he might have the ability to resurrect.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were full of radiance as he quickly thought of the truth.
“Wang Ping in the simulation is right. It’s necessary to squat here, and not just for a while, but for longer than Wang Ping in the simulation thought. After all, I have to cultivate no matter where I go.”
Wang Ping thought to himself at the bottom of his heart.
If it hadn’t presented this branch choice, Wang Ping thought that squatting for half a month or even a month would be enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: 167: The Truth about the Black Fog! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 167: The Truth about the Black Fog! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word chapter)_2
But now that there’s a branching option, there’s no need to say more. It wouldn’t be right not to squat here for ten years.
“System, fast forward for me.”
After making the choice, Wang Ping said in his mind.
With his thoughts surging, Wang Ping continued to stare at the simulation luminescent screen.
[In a blink of an eye, half a month had passed. During this half month, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao hadn’t come to life, and you could breathe a sigh of relief. However, you still didn’t let your guard down and planned to squat for a little longer.]
[After all, it would be meaningless whether you participated in the upcoming war or not. Naturally, Ji Bingyan will save the Purple Spirit Realm at the critical moment. It’s just that some emperors will die in the process. Although that’s a great loss, it’s still not as important as squatting and killing Jiuyou Demon Emperor completely in your heart.]
[If Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao escapes after being resurrected, that would be a real hidden danger, causing great harm to the Purple Spirit Realm. Therefore, even though you have powerful cultivation and confidence to stall for time with a Divine Artifact against a Quasi-Immortal, you continue to squat.]
[Seeing this, Profound Turtle was completely speechless. You were so cautious that even he, who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years and had seen countless strange cultivators, thought it was absurd.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly half a year had passed. During this half year, you consolidated your cultivation and tried to make it less illusory. It was at this time that a phantom appeared in this space, looking at you unwillingly.]
[At this, you also opened your eyes and sneered. It seems that your caution and squatting were the right things to do. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao does have some means of resurrection. Although this method of resurrection isn’t as good as the Rebirth tally, which brings you back to your peak state before death, it leaves behind a weak soul. However, his method of hiding and resurrecting is astonishing.]
[Next, you ask Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao if he has any last words. Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao snorts, saying that he has lost. He can set the longest time for his revival method to half a year.]
[He didn’t manage to deceive Wang Ping with his desperate and unwilling expression before dying, but he really didn’t expect that Wang Ping would squat here for half a year for his death. He deserved it.]
[However, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao sneered again, saying not to think that you can live in peace by killing him. With that, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao chose to self-destruct.]
[You had the intention to stop him before Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao self-destructed, but in the end, you still didn’t succeed. After all, you’re at the same level, and although your combat power is stronger, it’s difficult to capture him alive.]
[Even if you let Cai Yonglong give Jiuyou Demon Emperor invincible defense, it would only delay his self-destruction. Not to mention, Wang Ping didn’t dare to make his defense invincible. Otherwise, there would still be a chance of escape.]
[At this moment, Profound Turtle was stunned. He never expected that your cautious squatting would really squat Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao to death. This guy, who had been blasted to pieces, could come back to life after half a year. It’s already unbelievable.]
[For a moment, Profound Turtle was a bit confused. Had he been asleep for too long, and now all the kings of this era had such strange resurrection methods that they had to squat and finish them off…?]
[You don’t care about Profound Turtle’s confusion and continue to squat and cultivate, setting up various Killing Formations and Illusion Arrays to prevent Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao from pretending to be dead, giving him no chance to live.]
[Seeing this, Profound Turtle was speechless but also thought you had a point. He also thought that he would have to continue to squat and finish off his enemies in the future. Otherwise, it would be troublesome if the enemy resurrects and retaliate against him after he left carelessly.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed. During these ten years, your cultivation stabilized. Meanwhile, there were no signs that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was coming back to life. At this, you can be somewhat reassured. However, you’re still not taking any chances and decided to set up several Killing Formations and Illusion Arrays here, letting Profound Turtle monitor the area.]
[This left Profound Turtle speechless, but he still agreed to your request.]
“This assassin is finally dead.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and muttered.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who topped his to-kill list, was finally killed by him. Since he didn’t enter an immersive simulation state, the possibility of the opponent faking death was very low.
“It’s just a pity that we couldn’t find out what his plot was. According to his calculations, he could have broken through to the quasi-God tier and further reached the ambition of the Void Divine Realm by taking advantage of the calamity in the Purple Spirit Realm.”
Wang Ping thought about this and began to ponder.
“Speaking of which, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao followed the Demon Path, and his Divine Skills were various Forest of Ghosts Domain. Based on the description in the life simulation, could he be trying to collect resentful spirits for a rapid breakthrough?”
Wang Ping quickly made a guess.
This possibility was high.
The opponent seemed to have no other way to go, and it could also explain why he wanted the living beings of the Purple Spirit Realm to suffer devastation.
“Ruthless enough. But with me here, you’ll only fail and die a thorough death.”
Wang Ping evaluated once again before continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.

chapters.title: Chapter 495: 167: The Truth about the Black Fog! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word )_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 167: The Truth about the Black Fog! Cultivation Soaring! (10,000-word chapter)_3
[Seeing the Profound Turtle agree, you can finally leave here with peace of mind and head to the frontline of the Purple Spirit Realm. During these ten years, the Quasi-Immortal battle had already taken place, and although you had sensed it, you did not intervene in the battle.]
[Now, you have come to the frontline and found Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. You directly reveal your thoughts to her, hoping to initiate a full-scale war, joining forces with her to kill the Quasi-Divine of the Blood Demon Realm, and then pushing them back.]
[Your thoughts surprised Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan greatly. As a result, she opened up a separate space, and you two went into battle. You fought with Ji Bingyan for the first time, showing your full combat power, and also used the Divine Artifact as a helper.]
[Your combat power amazed Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, and even more so the Divine Artifact. She could not believe that there was actually a Divine Artifact in the Purple Spirit Realm. At this, she was somewhat envious of you having obtained this Divine Artifact. However, she had no intention of snatching it away.]
[In the end, through your battle with Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, you proved your current strength. You indeed have the power to fight against the Quasi-Immortals. However, if the battle lasts too long, you would still be defeated and unable to compete.]
[But, such power would be enough to help Ji Bingyan kill the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine.]
[For this reason, the two of you decided to directly attack the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine. Soon, the battle began, shocking everyone across both realms. They didn’t expect you to be so powerful. The Purple Spirit Realm was excited, while the Blood Demon Realm members looked extremely unpleasant.]
[The Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine was frustrated. In a two-on-one situation, even as a Quasi-Divine, it was impossible for him to survive. After all, nobody in the lower realms who had grown that strong was weak; defeating two enemies at once was extremely difficult.]
[If he had that power, he would have started a full-scale war long ago and pushed the Purple Spirit Realm aside completely.]
[However, he still had a trump card he hadn’t used. Now, at this point, the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine roared, demanding the Blood Demon Realm emperors to offer sacrifices to him, or they would all die, and the Blood Demon Clan would be wiped out.]
[Facing extinction, the expressions of all the powerful Blood Demons fluctuated. In the end, with fierce light in their eyes, they made a decision and chose to offer sacrifices.]
[Sensing this situation, both you and Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan changed your expressions, and were surprised that the Blood Demon Clan still had such a means hidden. This method did not appear 10,000 years ago.]
[If the Blood Demon Clan of 10,000 years ago had such a sacrificial method, they would not have been repelled by Mo Shang Li back to the Blood Demon Realm, but would have counterattacked the Purple Spirit Realm. Apparently, this was a secret technique the Blood Demon Clan had developed over the past 10,000 years.]
[In your heart, you had a bad premonition. Because according to the normal development route of a fantasy novel, Ye Chen is the Son of Fortune and the protagonist. The biggest antagonist, undoubtedly, is the Blood Demon Clan’s Quasi-Divine. But with Ji Bingyan present, a Quasi-Divine couldn’t possibly be the final boss.]
[In other words, the Blood Demon Realm side is destined to give birth to a real Void Divine Realm Master. Then, Ye Chen would break into the Void Divine Realm, ignite a double divine battle, and finally kill or seal the Blood Demon Realm’s Divine Being, bringing the story of the Son of Fortune to a perfect conclusion.]
[As for the Great War 10,000 years ago, according to normal development, without the interference of strange occurrences, Mo Shang Li would probably be the biggest antagonist, killing both the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine when both sides were heavily injured, and would not have the title of “Savior”.]
[After sorting out your thoughts, you have a heavy heart and want to prevent the Blood Demon Realm side from offering sacrifices. But, it’s too late. The Blood Demon Clan’s secret technique created over the past 10,000 years has its limitations. The Blood Demon Quasi-Divine can only obtain the power of the sacrifices if the Blood Demons voluntarily offer sacrifices. Otherwise, these cannot be forcibly absorbed. But once a large number of Blood Demons voluntarily offer sacrifices, his power will increase at an unimaginable speed.]
[In the end, you found with concern that the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine’s cultivation had soared far beyond the Quasi-Immortal level due to the large number of Blood Demons offering sacrifices.]
[Although you could clearly sense that the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine hadn’t reached the real Void Lord Realm due to the lack of divine sources, he definitely had a power exceeding the Quasi-Immortal level.]
[Facing such a powerful Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine, you were no match for him. For this reason, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan sighed and used the Forbidden Skill of the Ice-sealed Emperor from 10,000 years ago once again.]
[In the end, the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine was frozen, and Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan completely vanished, fell, and was left with no possibility of resurrection.]
[After all, it was already a defiance of heaven for Ji Bingyan to live a second life with her Quasi-Emperor cultivation. There was no way she could live a third life.]
[You looked at Ji Bingyan, who was also frozen, her life force completely gone, and now resembling a beautiful sculpture. In your heart, you sighed, somewhat regretting pulling her into the attack on the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divine.]
[However, you know very well that even if you hadn’t done so, such a thing would happen in the future anyway. The trump card of Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Divinity lies there, and it will definitely be used as long as they’re facing a desperate situation.]
[This was not something you could change. As for continuing your cultivation and making a move after breaking through to the Quasi-Divine level, it was also difficult to achieve.]

chapters.title: Chapter 496: 167 The Truth About the Black Fog! Cultivation Soars! (10,000-Word Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 167 The Truth About the Black Fog! Cultivation Soars! (10,000-Word Chapter)_4
“Even if you have the opportunity to break through to the Quasi-Immortal tier in the years to come, how will you fare when you reach that level? Facing a Blood Demon World Quasi-divine being whose power is already approaching the Void Divine Realm, you’ll be no match, even two against one.”
“It’s absolutely impossible for you to beat a Void Divine Realm master at a higher level than you are now. Unless you have an even stronger hidden card, you might have a chance to counterkill.”
“As for using the Reflective barrier to pit and kill the others. You’ve already tested that. Although the limit of the Reflective barrier can reflect the attacks of the Quasi-Immortal tier, it does not result in a doubling of the attack power, but rather reduces it.”
“Clearly, this Red Talent’s limit is the Void Divine Realm, and it should be unable to reflect attacks from Void Divine Realm masters.”
“Of course, there’s another hidden danger. Although you guessed it might be the black fog made by the strange being, that after all is just a guess—it doesn’t necessarily mean you’re right. If the black fog doesn’t come from the strange being, then the entire process and outcome of the fight will have no meaning.”
“The Ice seal, huh… Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, she really is a tool, isn’t she?”
Wang Ping, looking at this simulation content, was somewhat sighing.
If there were no butterfly effect, her existence would only pave the way for Ye Chen.
Truthfully, it’s a little pitiful.
Of course, in a way, you could say this might be the female lead’s fate.
Perhaps, all his previous guesses were wrong.
Ji Bingyue might not be the lead character, rather Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan might have the qualifications to be the lead.
“Uh, I seem to be getting ahead of myself again. Speaking of which, it seems that there has been no script for Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er.”
Wang Ping murmured, furrowing his brows lightly.
Neither Ji Bingyue nor Ji Xue’er had appeared in the life simulation for a long time; not a single word or image had been mentioned or shown.
Although this was related to his current high status, where all the people he came into contact with were big shots, he still felt a little odd.
In addition, he remembered Ji Bingyue’s unexpected demise in the early simulations.
At the time, he felt there was some hidden secret.
However, as the simulations proceeded, he didn’t pay much attention to it afterward.
“Ji Bingyan and Ji Xue’er look alike, and they both resemble Ji Bingyue a lot. Perhaps the relationship between the three of them is not just the genetic passing down.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ponder, feeling like he had touched upon some secrets.
“Maybe I could explore it further in the future.”
Wang Ping thought privately, continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“Next, you continued to look at this newly born Eternal Frozen Soil Area, your feelings complicated. Just as other Emperors were coming over, amazed and similarly feeling complicated, wanting to say something, they were terrified to find that the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine being had not fallen!”
“Despite being sealed in ice, the Blood Demon World Quasi-Immortal was still full of vitality, and its aura was slowly growing stronger, it was only unable to break free from the seal.”
“Seeing this, all the Emperors were filled with fear, knowing that this Blood Demon would sooner or later break free from the ice and reappear in the world. By that time, who could stop it?”
“You were not surprised by the fact that the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine being had not died but would further improve over the course of time. After all, this was the normal course of development.”
“The normal storyline would be that the Blood Demon was sealed in ice, advanced further, broke the seal and came out, but Ye Chen had, through Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, delayed the fight for so long that he had cultivated to the Divine Realm and faced it in a duel of the gods.”
“Next, without saying much, you left here, wanting to see if you could break through to the Quasi-Immortal Realm in the years to come.”
“With your departure, the other Emperors also scattered one by one, beginning to order the cultivators of the Purple Spirit Realm to hunt down the surviving weaker cultivators of the Blood Demon Realm.”
“As for you, though you intended to break through to the Quasi-Immortal Realm, you didn’t choose to go into seclusion straight away, but headed to the Blood Demon Realm instead.”
“Since all of the Blood Demon World’s high-end combatants had died, no one could stop you. You easily stormed into the Blood Demon Realm and began gathering resources.”
“You found the Primordial Demon Blood Pool and intended to take it away. However, when you arrived there, you found that the Primordial Demon Blood Pool had also dried up.”
“Apparently, the Blood Demons’ sacrifices were not limited to the sacrifices of Living Beings. Something like the Primordial Demon Blood Pool had also been sacrificed by the Blood Demons in some manner.”
“At this, you felt a bit regretful and could only leave.”
“In the blink of an eye, nearly a hundred years had passed. You had worked hard in cultivation during these years, but aside from solidifying your cultivation, you did not make any further progress and reach the Quasi-Immortal tier.”
“You were not surprised by this. If it was so easy to become a Quasi-Immortal, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan wouldn’t have struggled so hard and practiced in the Eternal Frozen Land.”
“Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan stepped forward over a thousand years ago, yet it was only a hundred years ago that she truly entered the Quasi-Immortal Realm. Her battle with the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine being shows how difficult it was for her to break through.”
“Next, calculating the time, you knew that the black fog was about to emerge and destroy the two realms. Therefore, you entered the Primordial Forbidden Land ahead of time, wanting to see what the true identity of the black fog was.”
“After delving deep into the Primordial Forbidden Land, even you felt a strong sense of crisis. However, you still didn’t have the intention of retreating and continued to proceed.”
“Eventually, you didn’t manage to reach the deepest part of the Primordial Forbidden Land. Unable to bear the pervading black fog, you were not able to resist, even with the protection of the Divine Artifact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 497: 167: The Truth of the Black Fog! Skyrocketing Cultivation! (Mega Chapter with 10,000 Chinese Characters) _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 167: The Truth of the Black Fog! Skyrocketing Cultivation! (Mega Chapter with 10,000 Chinese Characters) _5
[You sigh in resignation and halt your progress, gazing from a distance. In this place, you can only rely on your physical sight. Your spiritual sense is hindered and could risk being damaged. But even with physical sight, your vision does not extend far, as if you were an ordinary person shrouded in thick fog.]
[It could be said that even mighty emperors are no different from mortals when they face matters far beyond their understanding. This world is so ruthless – without reaching the extreme realm, dangers to life always exist, filled with too many incomprehensible things.]
[While you wait in silent vigilance, you notice that the black fog in the Primordial Sacred Land begins to thicken, becoming a significant threat. Consequently, you retreat, attempting to avoid annihilation by the fog.]
[Of course, you are aware that not resolving the issue of the black fog simply delays your eventual death. But even a delayed demise could provide valuable information; you certainly aren’t one to squander such an opportunity.]
[This is when you are startled to see two unfamiliar figures appear within the Primordial Sacred Land. You cannot comprehend the aura these figures emanate, which is astounding considering that even quasi-immortals shouldn’t be entirely unknown to you at your current level.]
[Yet, this impossibility has occurred- with two individuals no less. One is a young man holding a folding fan, the other is an elderly man. Your instinct tells you that the one playing a youth is of more distinguished status.]
[While you observe them, they are also observing you. To be precise, the young man glances at you with indifference, after which the elder strikes at you.]
[The elder reveals a force that far exceeds the quasi-immortal tier; the vast power belongs to Void Divine Realm. This revelation sends you into shock; you hadn’t expected him to be a strong fighter of the Void Divine Realm.]
[You struggled to comprehend why such a powerful entity of the Void Divine Realm would exist in the Purple Spirit Realm. And why, instead of confronting the quasi-divine in the Blood Demon Realm, he would suddenly appear in the Primordial Sacred Land’s forbidden territory to attack you.]
[However, before your death, you quickly put together the pieces. These two likely hail from the Upper Realm, not the Purple Spirit Realm, and they have come here for an item deep within the Primordial Forbidden Land. Perhaps this item produced the black fog, making the Primordial Forbidden Land such a secretive place.]
[If that’s the case, the item housed in the Primordial Forbidden Land must be unimaginably precious—an extreme opportunity—otherwise, it wouldn’t have attracted strong entities from the Upper Realm to descend in search of it.]
[In fact, you even suspect that the annihilation of both realms was these two Upper Realm entities’ deliberate plan, not a natural disaster. After all, the Primordial Forbidden Land has existed for so many years without incident. And these two arrive and suddenly, there’s trouble? The timing is too coincidental.]
[Once you understood these things, the elder killed you with a mere slap. But, thanks to the Rebirth tally, you skip into the death countdown. ]
[During this time, the fan-holding youth didn’t even spare you a glance, but proceeded deeper into the Primordial Forbidden Land. It was as if you were an inconsequential ant, unworthy of his attention.]
[Not long after, the Primordial Forbidden Land erupted, black fog dashed out of the Primordial Forbidden Land, obliterating both realms. And you were resurrected. However, even as an Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivator with formidable might, you couldn’t resist the residual black fog and energy. Both your Divine Soul and physical body rapidly fell apart.]
[With that knowledge, you could do nothing but sigh helplessly and perish unwillingly. ]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends….]
With the end of the text simulation, numerous scenes emerged in Wang Ping’s mind.
Finally, his consciousness flickered and his field of view shifted.
This time, his view appeared within the Primordial Forbidden Land.
The scene he beheld was the fan-holding youth and the elder striking him dead within seconds of their appearance.
Wang Ping stared at the two individuals intensely, thoroughly memorizing their faces and auras.
Eventually, the scene receded, and Wang Ping actively chose to exit the immersive simulation, returning to reality.
At this moment, an abundance of insights once again flooded his mind.
The god-tier cultivation skills and god-level magical powers he had created, and insights from other aspects were extensive, and he couldn’t absorb it all at once.
With that, Wang Ping ignored Chifeng and Cai Yonglong. After quickly setting up an Array Mana, he began absorbing all the insights and information with full concentration.
In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.
It took an entire month for Wang Ping to wholly absorb and digest these insights.
“Ding, reward generation successful, you can choose two of the following rewards:
. Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation.
. Red Talent·Reflective barriers.
. Blue Talent·Taunt.
. Life-bound Emperor Artifact: Illusionary Void Sword.”
Just then, the system notification rang, and Wang Ping opened his eyes, a decisive gleam in them.
“System, I choose ①. Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation and ④. Life-bound Emperor Artifact: Illusionary Void Sword.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list, without any hesitation, immediately made his decision.
At this moment, he needed cultivation level to confront Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
So, choosing cultivation was a necessity.

chapters.title: Chapter 498: 167: The Truth of the Black Fog! Skyrocketing Cultivation! (10,000-word )_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 167: The Truth of the Black Fog! Skyrocketing Cultivation! (10,000-word chapter)_6
As for the Red Talent·Reflected Barriers, although it’s a bit of a shame, it’s not a big deal. After all, the upper limit of the reflection strength of this thing is only useful at the Quasi-Immortal level. Once it reaches the Void Divine Realm, it will be of little use, so there’s no need to feel regretful.
In addition, it only cost one Flaming Fire Emperor Tower to get a Life-bound Emperor Artifact, which is a great bargain.
After all, the combat power and value that his Life-bound Emperor Artifact could enhance were definitely much greater than the value of the Flaming Fire Emperor Tower, an external Emperor Artifact.
“If I could keep refreshing the item rewards, maybe I could enjoy the free Paid Simulation. This feeling of getting something for nothing is really great.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his cultivation increasing at an astonishing speed.
4th Tier of Emperor’s Realm.
Emperor Realm 7th Tier.
Emperor Realm Great Perfection.
“To gain the cultivation and perfectly control it, this little benefit is indeed soothing to the heart.”
Wang Ping, feeling his rich cultivation within his body, sighed with emotion.
At this moment, a long sword emitting an imperial aura appeared in front of Wang Ping. This was Wang Ping’s Life-bound Emperor Equipment: Illusionary Void Sword.
“Now I have three life-bound weapons, which is a bit odd.”
Wang Ping held his Life-bound Emperor Equipment: Illusionary Void Sword and took out his other two life-bound weapons, muttering to himself.
The other two Illusionary Void Swords were quasi-King and King Artifacts, their grades were somewhat inferior.
“However, there is no need to despise them. Just focus on training them, make them grow, and then fuse them together. Maybe they can change.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he thought to himself.
Weapons with the same origin were almost non-existent, but his Illusionary Void Sword was obviously an exception formed through the Life Simulator, which had the potential for nurturing and fusion.
Next, Wang Ping put away his artifacts and dissolved the Great Array.
As the Great Array was dissolved, Cai Yonglong and Chifeng looked over.
“I’ll deal with someone first and then take you guys away.”
Wang Ping looked at the two of them and spoke.
Now he knew about Chifeng’s background.
However, the Chi Clan branch that Chifeng belonged to, which had fled to the Purple Spirit Realm, was not a direct lineage, but a distant side branch, somewhat like a distant relative of a clan.
So when they came to the Lower Realm, the greatest foundation they brought was only a god-tier Skill, god-tier Divine Ability, and a lower-tier Artifact.
That’s why, although he was shocked by the Imperial Clan’s name previously, he was relieved after learning the truth through the simulation.
If they were directly related by blood, they wouldn’t be in such dire straits.
Upper Realm Imperial Clan, even if it’s in decline, wouldn’t be in such a miserable state in a Lower Realm. Even if they were cursed, they wouldn’t be on the verge of being wiped out by a small clan.
As such, there wasn’t much meaning in taking Chifeng to Ashy Flame Valley.
There, they couldn’t find a way to relieve Chifeng’s curse either, they could only leave it to fate.
However, since he had already said that he would take Chifeng away, he still had to do so. Perhaps the true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor would reveal more hidden stories considering Chifeng’s identity.
“Uh, deal with someone? Who?”
Cai Yonglong was stunned.
“Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“Pff!”Cai Yonglong stared at Wang Ping, dumbfounded.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao was a Demon Emperor, who, according to Mr. Wang’s previous description, was a top-class Emperor Realm existence. Mr. Wang said he solved it just like that.
Doesn’t this mean that Mr. Wang has also become a top-class emperor?
How long has it been?
Cai Yonglong was dumbfounded. He was merely at the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, only reaching this level due to others’ assistance. Yet Mr. Wang directly became a top-class emperor.
“Life Simulator, the everlasting god.” Cai Yonglong could only sigh in his heart.
After that, Wang Ping didn’t say much, tearing space apart and entering it directly.
At the same time, in a sea region, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao opened his eyes with a cold expression.
He discovered that Wang Ping had already left the Profound Turtle and was using spatial movement.
Through the Heavenly Secret Talisman, he had long found out that Wang Ping was an emperor.
However, a mere Emperor Realm 1st Tier didn’t mean much in front of him.
He was just worried that Wang Ping had other hidden cards.
For that reason, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s eyes revealed a murderous intent, as he tore space and stepped into it, coldly saying, “White Demon, follow me to kill the emperor.”
The White Demon Emperor nodded and also entered the space channel.
Not long after, Jiuyou Demon Emperor and White Demon Emperor blocked Wang Ping’s path.
At the same time, an Array Plate appeared in White Demon Emperor’s hand, sealing off the space.
Regarding this, Wang Ping remained calm, showing no concern as he indifferently looked at Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and spoke faintly, “Jiuyou, if you want to kill me, have you ever thought about the possibility of you being killed in return?”
“If this emperor wants to kill someone, no one can survive. Even if you are an emperor, it is still the same.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao snorted coldly, a pitch-black demon blade appearing in his hand. The terrifying demonic Dharma also manifested, showing his dominance.
“Demon Blade, it’s a pretty decent spoil of war.”
Wang Ping looked at Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s Demon Blade and chuckled.
The Emperor Artifacts of Jiuyou Demon Emperor and White Demon Emperor could also be used in the simulator, and Wang Ping wouldn’t miss them.
“You are quite arrogant! Let me see what skills you have to be so arrogant.”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao shouted and suddenly struck with the blade.
When he made a move, it was his full strength, without any reservation.
This point was different from what happened in the life simulation.
Because Wang Ping was too calm, obviously not afraid of him.
In addition, although he had seen through Wang Ping’s cultivation with the effect of the Heavenly Secret Talisman beforehand, he found that he couldn’t see through it after meeting Wang Ping, and the dangerous feeling Wang Ping gave him indicated that he wasn’t simple.
He was always a cautious person, so he no longer held back, just as he did in the life simulator.
“Divine Ability: Fire Abyss!”
Seeing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao make a move, Wang Ping also held the Illusionary Void Sword, mobilizing the surging mana within his body and slashing out a sword towards Jiuyou Demon Emperor.
At that instant, this space turned into an ocean of flames.
Vaguely, the Purple Spirit Illusion Fire churned within it.
These flames formed an abyss, covering everything, and each wisp of flame carried terrifying sword spirit or the power of space tearing, with various effects that made them difficult to grasp.
Accompanied by the strike of the divine-tier Divine Ability: Fire, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s attack that was like a Forest of Ghosts Domain was instantly swallowed by the flames in the abyss, causing his expression to change drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 499: 168: The Emperor’s Scripture! Unlucky Weirdness (10,000-word Mega Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 168: The Emperor’s Scripture! Unlucky Weirdness (10,000-word Mega Chapter!)
“What kind of Divine Skill is this!?”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s pupils constricted, feeling an extreme sense of danger, and was incomparably fearful.
As for the White Demon Emperor, his face turned even paler.
He was horrified to discover that even with the Array Plate’s protection, the spreading Fire Abyss still penetrated the Array Plate and inflicted damage upon him, cutting through his physical body and burning his core.
At the same time, the defense formed by the Array Plate was also being disintegrated and would soon collapse.
Once it collapsed, he would fall without any suspense.
“Damn it!”
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao felt cold at the bottom of his heart, and without any hesitation, he threw out a treasure to attempt to block the Fire Abyss for a while.
As for himself, he had already fled to the distance.
He had completely underestimated Wang Ping’s strength.
Wang Ping actually had the Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation, and the Divine Skill he displayed was clearly beyond the Emperor grade and absolutely reached the god tier level.
In other words, he was actually calculated by Wang Ping.
The other party began to calculate him from the time Wang Ping was in a confrontation with Mr.Dao.
Apart from that, the other party must have used some method to deceive the Heavenly Secrets Tracking Charm, revealing only Emperor Realm 1st tier cultivation.
All this was just for baiting him.
This Junior Transmigrator was not only powerful but also deep-schemed, making Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s heart cold.
“How weak.”
Looking at the fleeing Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, Wang Ping felt that he seemed to be much weaker than his counterpart in the Life Simulator.
Soon, Wang Ping realized why.
At this point in time, it is a thousand years ago from that time.
The Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao from a thousand years ago must not be as powerful as he was a thousand years later.
On the contrary, him in Life Simulator had virtual Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation while he now had solid Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation, due to the cultivation reward he received before his failure.
Apart from that, his understanding of other aspects was also stronger than when he killed Jiuyou Demon Emperor in the Life Simulator.
With Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao becoming weaker and him becoming stronger, it created this one-sided situation.
In fact, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao may not even have the hidden cards he had got from other Second Generation Transmigrators, which were not mentioned in detail in the Life Simulator, to deal with the unknown or Quasi-immortal level entities.
“If that’s the case, die!”
Wang Ping sneered coldly, unleashing a surge of mana, and urged his Divine Ability: Fire Abyss to maximize its output.
“Aah!”
The White Demon Emperor was the first to be unable to withstand the pressure, the Great Array defense was breached, and he let out a miserable scream, turned into ashes, his physical body disintegrated, and his Divine Soul extinguished.
As for Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, his face changed drastically, feeling a fatal threat.
He desperately wanted to tear through space and escape, but he discovered that although White Demon Emperor had stopped sealing off space earlier, he still couldn’t tear through space to flee.
Because Wang Ping had already used a Secret Skill to seal off the area again, preventing anyone from utilizing spatial techniques.
In terms of spatial attainments, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao wasn’t even fit to tie Wang Ping’s shoes.
Thus, not only could he not escape, even if he did, Wang Ping could easily catch up.
“You forced me to do this!”
The eyes of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao were filled with murderous intent, knowing that he had only one way left – to die. He wanted to find Wang Ping and fight desperately.
Even if he died, he would drag Wang Ping down with him.
Even if he couldn’t take Wang Ping down with him, he would make Wang Ping pay the price for the damage to his origin.
“It’s just a futile struggle. It seems that you guys are not able to easily transmit items here, in this aspect, it is not as good as the chat group created by Alpha.”
Wang Ping looked at Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and sneered.
Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s face was gloomy, and he didn’t respond. He charged into the Fire Abyss while burning his origin to forcibly enhance his strength and attacked Wang Ping without hesitation.
What Wang Ping said was right, their current chat group was simply a degraded version of the Second Generation Chat Group created using the escaped origin after the destruction of the original Second Generation Chat Group, and there were many things they couldn’t do.
Even transferring items required time.
That is to say, if he didn’t request help from the other Transmigrators in the group beforehand and prepared all kinds of hidden cards, he wouldn’t be able to turn the tables during the battle.
However, the Second Generation Chat Group wasn’t some warm and harmonious chat group. There was filled with cunning intrigues and disputes, and every living Transmigrator was a cunning person.
You can’t expect others to exchange good things with you without paying a hefty price and being taken advantage of.
So, under normal circumstances, he would not trade with people in the chat group, nor would he want to expose too many details.
Apart from that, the things he needed at this level couldn’t be exchanged with ordinary items, and he had few things to trade.
Of course, he mainly suffered from a lack of information this time.
Although he had taken Wang Ping seriously, Wang Ping had only shown Nirvana Realm Great Perfection cultivation and King Realm fighting prowess during his battle with Mr. Dao. He had also exchanged Heavenly Secrets Track Charm and several items that could make powerful Emperor Realm experts go bankrupt with others.
He originally thought he could kill Wang Ping without fail, but he didn’t expect Wang Ping to be so powerful, and it really made him want to vomit blood.
He wasn’t cautious enough.
“It’s just a struggle in vain.”
Seeing Jiuyou Demon Emperor ignoring him and wanting to fight to the death with him, Wang Ping sneered and continued to provoke his nerves.
However, Wang Ping didn’t take this lightly. He went all out in the battle with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
As the two fought a fierce battle, the space shattered in pieces, and the terrifying fighting fluctuations affected more than half of the sea region.

chapters.title: Chapter 500: 168: Emperor’s Scripture – The Unfortunate and Strange Incident (Massive 10,000-word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 168: Emperor’s Scripture – The Unfortunate and Strange Incident (Massive 10,000-word Chapter!) _2
Although the spatial blockade prevented significant damage to the outer world, and ordinary cultivators could not detect such fluctuations, it was like a bright light for the Emperors.
As a result, no matter if it was the Profound Turtle or other nearby Emperors, all rushed over immediately.
When they saw Wang Ping fighting the Jiuyou Demon Emperor and repeatedly slashing the body of Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao or burning half of his body to ash, the astonished expressions on all the Emperor’s faces were clearly visible.
Wang Ping and Jiuyou Demon Emperor were too strong, and there were none in the Purple Spirit Realm stronger than them.
However, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor was clearly just an expert on the same level as the Primordial Emperor. Although powerful enough to squeeze into the top five in the Purple Spirit Realm, Wang Ping was obviously even more formidable. They could all see that Wang Ping had already surpassed the Emperor Realm Great Perfection Tier, even more powerful than the Ashy Flame Emperor from ten thousand years ago.
“The Jiuyou Demon Emperor has been arrogant for so many years; it seems his demise is finally imminent. As for the White Demon Emperor, it seems he has already fallen first.”
The Sky Emperor remarked with emotion.
He could see that although the Jiuyou Demon Emperor had recovered his body over and over again, it was nothing more than a desperate struggle. His origin and power were getting weaker and weaker, and it would not be long before he fell.
“They killed so many people and even destroyed a Holy Land. Today, being killed in return is just their retribution.”
Another Emperor appeared here, coldly speaking.
“Once the Jiuyou Demon Emperor is gone, it’ll be time to eradicate the Jiuyou Demon Sect and this malignant tumor. By then, when the Spirit Realms merge, we will have no worries.”
All the Emperors nodded, planning to attack the Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s followers after his demise.
Without the presence of a King Realm Master, it would only be a matter of time to find the headquarters of the enemies.
“Wang Ping! Don’t think that by killing me, you can be complacent. In the future, you will know what despair is!”
Not long after, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao could no longer hold on, and he was utterly blasted into ashes by Wang Ping in an unwilling, angry roar, leaving him to die without a complete corpse.
Wang Ping didn’t care for Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s vicious words before his death, his face still calm.
He knew very well that his fight with the Jiuyou Demon Emperor was very likely in a live broadcast status, just like his fight with Mr. Dao.
Or perhaps, the Jiuyou Demon Emperor had already sent all the information about him to their Second Generation Chat Group.
After those ‘Predecessor Transmigrators’ saw it, they would definitely be wary of him and try to get rid of him.
But what did it matter? Since they were mortal enemies and one side would eventually be destroyed, he had nothing to fear. He would first kill the enemy in this world, Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao.
“I don’t know how friend would like to be called.”
Seeing that Wang Ping had indeed killed Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao without injury, the Sky Emperor, still in shock, approached Wang Ping, slightly cupping his hands, and kindly asked.
“Wang Ping, you can just call me… Heaven Derivative Emperor.”
Wang Ping looked at the Sky Emperor with a smile, slightly pondering, and then replied.
He had the Life Simulator.
Life Simulator, simulating the future, deducing life.
The words “Heaven Derivative” were very appropriate, suitable for his assumed title when he was traveling outside.
Of course, if he grew up in the future and gained the title of Heavenly Emperor, that would be even better.
“Heaven Derivative Emperor…”
Wang Ping’s words surprised the Sky Emperor and others.
The two words “Heaven Derivative” were mysterious and not something just anyone could bear.
They also felt that Wang Ping’s divine skills had nothing to do with the words “Heaven Derivative,” making this title seem strange.
However, considering Wang Ping’s terrifying strength, they did not say anything too explicit.
“Isn’t he a newly-promoted Emperor? Why has his cultivation suddenly skyrocketed, and why is he so powerful?”
At this moment, only the Profound Turtle was confused, puzzled since he started watching the battle.
He didn’t sense anything wrong. Wang Ping was indeed a newly-promoted Emperor at the 1st tier of Emperor Realm before. How did he become Emperor Realm Great Perfection in just a month? And this strength was truly frightening.
Or was it that Wang Ping was deceiving him, the honest turtle, in both cultivation and age, so as to bait Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao and White Demon Emperor like big fish?
Yes, it must be this way.
“Heaven Derivative Fellow, since the demon is eliminated, why not come and be a guest at my Heavenly Sword Divine Land?”
The Sky Emperor enthusiastically said.
“My fellow friends, I have some matters to attend to, so I will visit another day.”
Wang Ping slightly cupped his hands toward the Emperors and politely replied.
“Alright. Then I will go back and prepare some top-notch ancient tea, waiting for Heaven Derivative Fellow to come to my Heavenly Sword Divine Land.”
The Sky Emperor said with a smile, very politely.
Other Emperors also politely expressed similar sentiments when they saw this.
Finally, these Emperors left one by one, and the space became quiet again.
After these Emperors left, Wang Ping easily collected Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao’s Demon Sword and the broken Emperor’s Artifact of the White Demon Emperor into his storage bag.
The battle just now was too intense, and even the Emperor Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao himself was blown up, so their Emperor’s artifacts were naturally damaged.
He didn’t know whether these Emperor’s artifacts could be used to pay for the Paid Simulation expenses or not.
However, Wang Ping was not concerned about the paid simulation issue at the moment but directly said in his heart, “System, I want to do free simulation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 501: 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word !)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word chapter!)_3
Although he was considering staying here longer, Wang Ping still needed to use the simulator to confirm his decision.
If Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao still hadn’t obtained the resurrection item at this point and couldn’t be revived, there was no need for him to stay here for such a long time.
That would be a complete waste of time.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation starts.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping knew he had entered the simulation with a shake of his consciousness.
“System, fast forward.”
Wang Ping hesitated at the bottom of his heart.”
[On the first day, you chose to stake out.]
[In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed, and Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao had not revived, which surprised you.]
[Although you think Jiuyou Demon Emperor is already dead, you still set up various Killing Formations, Illusion Arrays, and traps here to prevent any possibility of his escape. After dealing with these, you went back to the Profound Turtle’s back and brought Cai Yonglong and Chifeng with you.]
[Next, you took the two of them directly to Ashy Flame Valley. As you remembered, you passed through the Great Array and arrived at the depths of the ancient valley. You saw the Palace Cluster and took away many treasures.]
[At the same time, you also took Chifeng to meet the true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor. When Ashy Flame Emperor saw Chifeng, he showed a shocked expression, laughed heartily, and said that the heavens had blessed his Chi Clan, as one of their descendants had a Red Fire Holy Body. If Chifeng could grow up in the future, he could bring glory to the Chi Clan and restore their lineage.]
[You listened to the words of Ashy Flame Emperor’s true spirit, feeling shocked. Although you had long known that Chifeng’s constitution was definitely not ordinary, you thought it was due to his special bloodline. You never realized that he had an unawakened Red Fire Holy Body.]
[Afterward, you curiously asked the Ashy Flame Emperor how powerful the Red Fire Holy Body was and how to awaken it. The true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor stopped laughing and showed a look of sorrow, seemingly returning to reality.]
[He told you that the Holy Body lineage was extremely powerful. If one could cultivate to the Great Completion Tier of the Quasi-Emperor Realm and achieve the Great Completion Domain in their Holy Body, they would have the qualifications to fight with Emperors, becoming a powerful existence that could suppress an era.]
[Not only did Chifeng possess the Red Fire Holy Body, but if his bloodline could regress to the Emperor bloodline in the future, the strength he would possess under the double talent was unimaginable.]
[This surprised you. You never expected Chifeng’s hidden talent to be so terrifying, even better than Ye Hei. Of course, you also thought of Ye Xiaofan from the group who also had a Holy Body but was now low-key and limited to the Cultivation world, not yet growing up.]
[Next, the true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor laughed bitterly and told you that unfortunately, their clan was now affected by an unknown force, making it difficult for them to cultivate. Even with a bloodline and Holy Body, it was impossible to awaken. Worse, they couldn’t even find resources in the Lower Plane that could help the Holy Body grow.]
[Upon hearing this, you were astonished and promised the true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor that if you ever had the ability to ascend to the Upper Realm with Chifeng in the future, you would bring him there and seek out the Chi Clan in the Upper Realm.]
[When Ashy Flame Emperor’s true spirit heard your promise, he felt relieved. As an Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivator, you still had the possibility of ascending. Although it was very difficult for ordinary Void Divine Realm newbies to bring others to ascend to the Upper Realm, there was still some hope.]
[For this reason, Ashy Flame Emperor thought for a moment and gave you a scripture. It was actually an Emperor Scripture, specifically the Mortal Realm Chapter.]
[The Emperor Scripture, Mortal Realm Chapter, recorded the cultivation methods for the Mortal Realm below the Void Divine Realm. In the eyes of the Upper Realm Masters, there were four realms in the Cultivation Path, with many minor ones included: Mortal Realm, Divine Realm, Saint Realm, and Tao Proving Realm.]
[The Mortal Realm was where one was still a mortal and hadn’t truly transformed. Reaching the Divine Realm, one was no longer in the realm of mortals but in the realm of gods. Powerful Divine Realm Experts could easily destroy a Lower Plane.]
[As for the Saint Realm, there was no need to explain its incredible strength. Even in the Upper Realm, entering the Saint Realm meant becoming a big shot. The Tao Proving Realm signified the Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and the Emperor was the true supreme being who had proven their Tao.]
[You received the Mortal Realm Chapter and looked at the many annotations, feeling shocked. At the same time, you also found your shortcomings through the Emperor Scripture’s Mortal Realm Chapter.]
[Although you seemed to have perfected every realm, you were far from complete. It was just that because you were in the Lower Plane and comparing yourself with others, you appeared perfect.]
[The true spirit of Ashy Flame Emperor saw your thoughts and sighed, explaining that in the Upper Realm, only by cultivating the Emperor Scripture could one approach perfection for each realm, with their combat power far surpassing ordinary cultivators. However, the Emperor Scripture was too profound and not everyone could succeed in cultivating it. Only those with truly exceptional talents could successfully cultivate the Emperor Scripture and have unparalleled power.]
[In the Upper Realm, such individuals were the real geniuses who could look down upon their peers. Only those who had also cultivated the Emperor Scripture could fight with them in the same realm.]
[You were shocked and yearned for the Upper Realm even more. Cai Yonglong was also amazed and looked forward to the Upper Realm. Then, curious, you asked the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor why he had the Emperor Scripture but still fell into obscurity, becoming a distant branch and being disregarded.]

chapters.title: Chapter 502: 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word !)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word chapter!)_4
[Ashy Flame Emperor fell silent before eventually giving a bitter smile and admitting that it was because he possessed the Emperor Scripture that he fell to this state. It turned out that one of their ancestors had been infatuated with a witch in his youth, thus causing the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Emperor Scripture to be leaked. Consequently, their branch became a sinful family within the clan.]
[Later on, an ancestor took action and expelled their branch from the family, relegating them to a remote side clan. However, this was already a relatively good outcome. After all, under normal circumstances, even if they had been exterminated, it would have been reasonable, and they would have had no objections.]
[The Emperor Scripture is the Imperial Clan’s most precious inheritance. Even if only the Mortal Realm Chapter had been leaked, the issue was serious enough to be an unforgivable crime.]
[From Ashy Flame Emperor’s words, you finally unraveled many doubts in your heart. You always felt that, as a side family of the Upper Realm Imperial Clan, the Chi Clan, even if it was merely a side clan or just a branch that fled to the Purple Spirit Realm, should not be so desolate with only one God-tier Skills, Divine Skills, and Lower-tier Artifact.]
[After all, while Lower-tier Artifacts are extremely valuable in the Lower Realm and rarely seen, they are merely life-bound weapons for Void Divine Realm cultivators in the Upper Realm. While this would undoubtedly be considered incredibly valuable for ordinary Upper Realm families, even to the point of being a clan’s defining artifact, it was too shabby for Upper Realm Imperial Clans.]
[At the same time, you couldn’t help but feel that bringing Chifeng along really made a difference. Without Chifeng, there was absolutely no possibility for you to obtain the Emperor Scripture. Of course, if Chifeng hadn’t been a Sacred Body, he still wouldn’t have been able to obtain the Emperor Scripture. Ashy Flame Emperor would never have given it to him.]
[In the end, only when one shows enough value can others bring out good things to invest in and repay. Such is the universal truth.]
[Afterwards, you continued to communicate with the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor for a while before his true spirit vanished. You decided to bury his body and then planned to cultivate diligently here.]
“Emperor Scripture, I never thought it would conceal such a great opportunity. It’s simply unbelievable. Without this opportunity, Lower Realm cultivators who go to the Upper Realm would struggle to reach the peak.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Looking at it this way, the Upper Realm is really complicated.
Those Flying Immortals from the Lower Realm don’t have such solid foundations. While they may not become ordinary cultivators, they are obviously far inferior compared to the foundations of the major clans. The Imperial Clans are even more incomparable.
This reminded Wang Ping of some common tropes from fantasy novels he had read before.
Some Flying Immortals, after ascending to the Upper Realm, would discover deficiencies in their foundations and could only helplessly disperse their cultivation and practice anew. Only then would they have the possibility of becoming powerful. Otherwise, their future path would be blocked, and they’d find it difficult to progress.
Wang Ping felt that while he might not be stuck in the Divine Realm, the road ahead would become increasingly challenging.
Of course, this is assuming that he doesn’t refresh and gain more powerful talent, which may cause such problems.
Now that he has obtained the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, he won’t have this issue.
Dispersing one’s cultivation and practicing anew might be a troublesome thing for others, one which could easily lead to accidents. But Wang Ping was different; his cultivation relied on the simulator, so he could easily cultivate back where he started.
At present, he possessed vast resources.
Even if he dispersed his cultivation and practiced anew, he would be able to quickly cultivate back to the Great Perfection Tier of the Emperor Realm.
“I wonder if an Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivated using the Emperor Scripture would allow me to directly defeat Quasi-Immortals and even fight against Void Divine Realm Masters.”
The thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, filling him with anticipation.
Next, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, and words reappeared.
[After some reflection, you brought Chifeng, Cai Yonglong, and others into a palace and carefully set up multiple layers of the Great Array. After all, the fire attribute energy here was too violent. If you were to disperse your cultivation, no one would protect Chifeng and Cai Yonglong, and they would be directly killed by this violent power. As for you, although your physical body would still be strong after dispersing your cultivation, it would ultimately be troublesome.]
[Next, you began to study the Emperor Scripture and attempted to comprehend it. You found, to your headache, that the Emperor Scripture was extremely profound, containing deep Tao Rhymes, making it difficult to comprehend. You sighed in your heart. After all, if it were so easy to comprehend, the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor wouldn’t have said those words.]
[Even in the Upper Realm, those who can cultivate the Emperor Scripture are few, and it’s normal for you to have difficulty getting the Entry Tier in a short time. However, a situation that left you speechless occurred. Chifeng, who had obtained the Emperor Scripture, easily cultivated it as if he had opened up his meridians.]
[Furthermore, he directly awakened the Red Fire Holy Body, and his cultivation reached Innate Perfection Realm in a short period. If it weren’t for the Bloodline Curse blocking him, Chifeng’s cultivation would definitely continue soaring.]
[At this, you could only sigh. Sacred Bodies are indeed terrifying. If Chifeng didn’t disappear after a decade or so and didn’t have his cultivation restricted by the Bloodline Curse, he would likely be high above you in the Lower Realm and even dominate all enemies in the future.]

chapters.title: Chapter 503: 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word chapter!)_5
[As for Ye Chen, he’s even less likely to compare with Chifeng. In comparison to the flawless version of Chifeng, Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune of the Purple Spirit Realm, pales greatly.]
[You were hit hard, but you quickly settled down and continued to comprehend the Emperor Scripture. As for Cai Yonglong, there’s not much to say, he was even more frustrated. He now possessed the Emperor Scripture but felt just like having a treasure mountain that he couldn’t enter. The lines of text filled with astonishing Tao Rhyme seemed like an incomprehensible divine book.]
[This feeling was very uncomfortable, extremely uncomfortable. But he couldn’t bear to give up. After all, this was the Emperor Scripture, the supreme scripture. If he could cultivate it, he would definitely advance rapidly in the future. Although he wouldn’t be able to conquer all enemies, he could be considered to have limitless potential and extraordinary battle power.]
[In just over a decade, Chifeng mysteriously disappeared, leaving you sighing. As for this, you can only hope that Chifeng was summoned back to the Upper Realm and continue to calmly comprehend the Emperor Scripture.]
[These years of comprehension have allowed you to deeply understand the upper limit of the Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God. This Purple Talent is not bad, but it still falls far short of the level of the Emperor Scripture. Of course, you’re not completely unable to comprehend the Emperor Scripture either.]
[It’s just that it requires a long time to comprehend, to understand. With the time spent in the Upper Realm, the speed of his cultivation would have undoubtedly been left far behind by those real monsters in the Upper Realm.]
[In the end, even after spending a thousand years, you were still unable to successfully comprehend the Emperor Scripture, which you found quite regrettable. As for Cai Yonglong, he had given up on comprehending long ago, thinking that he wasn’t cut out for it. Instead of wasting time, he chose to continue on his old path.]
[As a result, after a thousand years and with the help of your many resources, he reached the Nirvana Boundary level. While still weak, it was considered not bad.]
[Next, you chose to leave seclusion because the war between the two realms was about to begin. Due to the fact that you had almost spent all the time in this simulation on comprehending the Emperor Scripture, the improvement in other aspects was minimal, and your combat power had not changed much.]
[As for this, you didn’t feel regretful at all. After all, it would be foolish not to cherish the Emperor Scripture. Not to mention, with the current situation, unless your strength undergoes another qualitative change, you will not be able to rewrite the outcome of destruction.]
[Those two people from the Upper Realm were simply too strong. You had a vague feeling that both the old man and the young man had actually suppressed their cultivation because the Lower Realm could not bear too powerful forces. The Void Divine Realm was acceptable, but experts above the Void Divine Realm descending to the Lower Realm had enough power to destroy the Lower Plane, which would cause the Lower Plane to reject them.]
[Moreover, according to the true spirit of the Ashy Flame Emperor, there were rules in the Upper Realm that did not allow the Divine Realm Experts of the Upper Realm to descend to the Lower Realm at will. That was the reason why the people from their lineage who descended to the Lower Realm did not exceed the level of Quasi-Immortals. A hundred thousand years ago, they had descended to the Lower Realm, and after passing through so many years, by the generation of the Ashy Flame Emperor, they had no Quasi-Immortals left.]
[After that, you had no intention of interfering in the war between the two realms. Moreover, you had some conjectures that needed verification ….]
The text simulation stopped at this point.
Many memories of researching the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and finally, with a shake of his consciousness, his field of vision changed, and he appeared in the palace of Ashy Flame Valley.
“This Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture is so profound that each character is extremely special, containing Tao Rhyme. If one can’t comprehend some of its mysteries, one simply can’t guess its meaning, just like catching a glimpse of a leopard through a pipe.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
Next, an idea also appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
This was also the reason why the text simulation ended, and immersive simulation appeared.
This idea was to destroy the Profound Turtle, release the strange energy, and verify the conjecture.
It’s because his previous speculations had ignored some details.
Due to various simulations, many details had become blurred.
In fact, he would be possessed by strange energy and controlled by demon, not necessarily because he had killed the old man from the first ring of Ye Chen, but because of other reasons.
Because there were two simulations in which he did not become strange and was killed by the black fog in the end.
The first time was when he was hiding in the Flaming Fire Secret Realm while drifting in the Spatial Turbulence.
The second time was when he was hiding in the Primordial Demon Blood Pool in the Blood Demon Realm.
Logically, if he had planted the seeds of disaster by killing the first ring’s old man of Ye Chen, the simulated Wang Ping in these two life simulations would not be able to escape the same fate. He would also be possessed and controlled by the strange energy as it should be.
In addition to this, the strange energy was released first, followed by the appearance of the black fog.
However, in the previous simulations, other than the glimpses of some scenes after the strange energy came into being from the perspective of a god, there was no description in the rest of the simulations, as if nothing had happened, which was also very strange.
There must be something he’d overlooked.
In the face of strange energy, he should be extremely cautious. If he didn’t figure out its full capabilities, Wang Ping wouldn’t dare unseal the strange energy and fight it.
“Old turtle, although it’s a bit cruel, this is just a simulation, and you won’t die for real. I can only wrong you. System, continue to fast forward.”

chapters.title: Chapter 504: 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word !)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 168: Emperor Scripture! Unlucky Bizarre (10,000-word chapter!)_6
Wang Ping muttered to himself, then went on to fast forward.
In an instant, the luminescent screen reappeared, and text followed suit.
[After making your decision, you ponder the details and finally make some guesses.]
[When the two realms adjoined and all the strong beings were attracted, you took the position of the Jiuyou Demon Emperor and started to act against the Profound Turtle.]
[In response, the Profound Turtle was outraged and questioned your actions. You expressed your hope for the Profound Turtle to release the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, promising to stop the attack once the turtle complies.]
[The Profound Turtle was furious, thinking you were too insane and didn’t cooperate with you. Instead, it intensified its defense force. You could only sigh and utilize the Divine Artifact, attacking the turtle with all your might and killing it.]
[However, just before the Profound Turtle died, it reinforced the seal just like in your memory. This is what you wanted.]
[Next, you took the sealed Guilt-Punishing Emperor and left. When an Emperor came to investigate, they were full of rage, but they couldn’t find you anymore.]
[As time passed, though you could have broken the seal earlier, you didn’t do so because you wanted to break it at the point in time in your memory, believing that it would make the experiment more meaningful.]
[When the time came, you went ahead and broke the seal as planned, releasing the strange creature. Before the creature was unleashed, you tore through space, entered the Spatial Turbulence and the small world.]
[Very soon, you realized that your soul hadn’t been contaminated nor controlled by the strange power. This verified your guess. You assumed that although the creature’s manipulation ability is terrifying, it only causes trouble for those who kill the people related to the bloodline of the Body Possession the Guilt-Punishing Emperor has.]
[However, the curse couldn’t be triggered under all circumstances. If the distance is too great, divided by a world barrier, or separated by Spatial Turbulence and a small world, then there would be no contamination.]
[Of course, you also guessed that if the strange creature noticed you and deliberately tried to trigger the curse, it could still contaminate a specific target’s soul and manipulate them into a subordinate soul.]
[This point is akin to the first strange creature you encountered in the Zombie World. If it forcefully utilized its power, the curse’s activation time could be shortened.]
“So that’s how its power works. It explains many of my doubts.”
Wang Ping glanced at the simulation content with sudden realization, then continued to look at the luminescent screen.
There was still one more question to clarify.
Although he already had some guesses in his heart.
[After solving some questions regarding the cursed power, there was still something you needed to verify─why didn’t the strange creature cause any significant disturbances after its emergence, except for the beginning?]
[As a result, you pondered and released a Puppet of King’s tier to investigate the situation.]
[After the puppet went out, you learned about the events in the outer world. Many living beings in the Purple Spirit realm were in trouble, and numerous cultivators became demons. A large number of powerful beings on the Blood Demon side were also manipulated, and even the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine struggled in agony, destined to be controlled sooner or later.]
[As a Blood Demon World Quasi-Immortal who participated in the great war 10,000 years ago, it was only natural for him to be affected after killing the Descendants of Guilt-Punishing Emperor.]
