[During the time when the creature’s power wreaked havoc, you sensed a terrorizing divine palm, which exuded an aura of divinity, striking down the creature which had just been born and acting recklessly.]
[You were shocked and immediately came up with a guess. The person who made the move was either the old man or the young man. Only these two individuals could unleash the powerful forces of the Void Divine Realm, and not just any Void Lord at that.]
[No wonder there was no disturbance after the emergence of the strange creature. As it turns out, just after it emerged, it was discovered and casually killed by a powerful being descended from the Upper Realm. Quite pitiful.]
[Although the power of Guilt-Punishing Emperor is immense, it’s uncertain if the strange creature could unleash its full potential. Moreover, even if it could bring out all of its power, it would be as insignificant as an ant when compared to the strong beings descended from the Upper Realm.]
[You felt somewhat mixed, not expecting the creature you were worried about would be casually killed by someone. The people from the Upper Realm are indeed terrifying.]
[However, although the two of them killed the strange creature for unknown reasons, they unleashed the dark fog and became the prime culprits in destroying the Purple Spirit Realm and Blood Demon Realm. They are not praiseworthy and not good people.]
[Of course, you are currently the prime culprit in releasing the strange creature, and you can’t be considered a good person, either. It’s like the pot calling the kettle black.]
[Next, after pondering, you wanted to obtain more information. To do so, you planned to join forces with the two Upper Realm beings and ferret out their motives and identities.]
[With that in mind, you took action, trying to locate the duo and openly stating your intention.]
[Regarding your intentions, the young man was disdainful and found it ridiculous that an ordinary lower realm being like yourself would entertain wild ambitions of climbing the higher branches and becoming his follower.]
[Realizing the intention of the young man, the old man behind him took action and killed you on the spot. Due to the Rebirth tally, you revived after an hour, feeling very displeased.]
[After that, you went straight to the Primordial Forbidden Land to, before they discovered the secrets within, discuss with the Primordial Emperor and find a way to hide the entrance to the forbidden land, preventing it from being discovered by the young man and the old man.]
[Only then would there be a slim hope of averting the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm. However, since you killed the Profound Turtle and released the strange creature, the Primordial Emperor didn’t trust you and instead became furious at you. He wanted to suppress you by utilizing all the resources in the Holy Land.]

chapters.title: Chapter 505: 169: The Second Purple Talent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 169: The Second Purple Talent!
[However, your own combat strength is formidable and you possess a Divine Artifact. In such circumstances, the Primordial Emperor is clearly no match for you. Even if he were to utilize the full force of the Holy Land, he would still not be your rival and would be effortlessly suppressed by you.]
[In the end, you completely destroyed the Primordial Sacred Land and set up multiple seals at the entrance of the Primordial Forbidden Land, using the Divine Artifact as the array core to prevent the two people from the Upper Realm from finding it.]
[However, your actions were ultimately meaningless. Over a few years, the two people from the Upper Realm searched through various hidden places in the Purple Spirit Realm and Blood Demon Realm for what they needed but ended up empty-handed. Nonetheless, as soon as a special aura emerged from the Primordial Forbidden Land, the two of them captured the aura and successfully located the Primordial Forbidden Land.]
[They detected the seals you set up and dismissed them. The older one made a move and easily shattered the Great Array, entering it.]
[You sensed that the Great Array had been broken and felt heavy in your heart, realizing that the two of them had eventually found what was hidden in the Primordial Forbidden Land. It seemed that no matter how hard you tried, there was no escaping this future.]
[Unless your strength surpassed theirs, only then would you have a chance to prevent these events from happening. However, to accomplish such a feat, your cultivation must reach the Void Divine Realm. Furthermore, your combat prowess within the same realm must be formidable; otherwise, there is no possibility of stopping them.]
[In the end, you sighed in your heart and quietly awaited the arrival of death. Soon after, you sensed the spread of the black fog, which began to sweep the Purple Spirit Realm and extended towards the Blood Demon Realm.]
[During this process, you perished in the black fog.]
[As a result of your death, the simulation has ended…]
As the text simulation ended, Wang Ping’s consciousness wavered and returned to the real world once more.
“Although I didn’t get all the information I wanted this time, I did manage to obtain some bizarre information, which is better than nothing. It’s just unfortunate that even without my intervention, he was killed by the people from the Upper Realm,” he thought to himself.
Wang Ping sighed lightly, his thoughts in his heart.
It was the first time that someone from the Upper Realm had killed the sinister one.
Moreover, he was killed so casually, which made Wang Ping’s emotions quite complicated.
“In the short term, I probably won’t be able to uncover the truth behind the black fog, nor is it necessary to waste my lives and simulation opportunities to investigate. This is not something I can handle at the moment.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered silently.
If something was precious enough in the Upper Realm to make the Upper Realm residents come to the mortal world and use the destruction of two realms as a cover, they probably were treasured in the Upper Realm as well.
Such things could make even a Void lord feel like an insignificant ant, let alone Emperors or Quasi-Immortals.
Furthermore, Wang Ping began to worry about when these Upper Realm people had discovered the existence of the item in the Purple Spirit Realm.
If they had known all along and had come to the mortal world after planning something in the Upper Realm, the situation would be dire.
It would then involve a powerful Upper Realm power instead of just two powerful individuals.
“Next, whenever I get a chance, I will investigate all the hidden secrets I didn’t know before. The matters of Ji Bingyue, Ji Xue’er, and Ji Bingyan, in particular, have caught my attention,” Wang Ping thought, rubbing his chin.
In a previous life simulation, Ji Bingyan had mentioned that Wang Ping might ascend to the Upper Realm earlier and become a god before her.
That is to say, Ji Bingyan knew of a way to break through to the Void God Realm.
Perhaps this was related to her ability to become a Quasi-Immortal.
However, if she felt that she could ascend earlier, does that mean her method would work for him too?
It’s possible that Ji Bingyan didn’t know that the divine source in the Purple Spirit Realm had run out, but the likelihood of that was slim.
Additionally, Ji Bingyan seemed to have thoughts of plundering the divine source of the Blood Demon Realm.
Perhaps there was still a divine source in the Blood Demon Realm.
“System, how much would a Paid Simulation cost me now?”
After Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he inquired from the bottom of his heart.
“Ding! Detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Major Completion Tier of the Emperor Realm. The next simulation requires the host to pay the price of thirty-five King Artifacts, or four Incomplete Emperor-tier Artifacts, or two Flawless Emperor-tier Artifacts.”
The System’s voice sounded.
“I… My goodness!”
Seeing the increasing cost, Wang Ping’s eyelids twitched fiercely.
Although he was prepared for this, the absurd price was shocking.
If it required so many Emperor Artifacts now, Wang Ping felt that the resources of the two realms combined would not be enough for him to simulate once or twice when he reached the Quasi-Immortal Tier.
But how could he grow stronger quickly without Paid Simulations?
“System, can you switch back to the original payment mode?” Wang Ping’s face twitched, suddenly feeling that the original exponential growth was more cost-effective.
“No. Please give up any unrealistic thoughts, host. The initial Paid Simulation wouldn’t only use Lower-tier Spirit Stones later. It is not more cost-effective than the current mode. In addition, the original Life Simulator could only refresh White Talents and Green Talents.”
The System’s voice sounded.
“Sigh…”
Listening to the answer of the Life Simulator, Wang Ping felt a little exhausted.
Although the Life Simulator was useful, the consumption of resources was indeed quite painful.

chapters.title: Chapter 506: 169: The Second Purple Talent!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 169: The Second Purple Talent!_2
Of course, this was also related to his recent rapid cultivation improvement, which had skyrocketed from Nirvana Realm Great Perfection to Emperor Realm Great Perfection in such a short time.
If his cultivation improvement had been slower, there wouldn’t have been an issue with insufficient resources.
After all, the previous Life Simulator only consumed Primordial Liquid, which was easy for him to obtain with his cultivation level.
However, that was just wishful thinking.
Wang Ping didn’t want to do that; he had no choice.
With the ruthless Predecessor Transmigrator Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, who had connections with Myriad Heavens Forces, if he didn’t become stronger quickly, he would be killed.
Thinking of this, Wang Ping became furious.
“Alpha, it’s all your fault. If you hadn’t assigned that task for me to probe the Second Generation Chat Group’s Transmigrators, I wouldn’t have been exposed to them and forced to rapidly improve my cultivation to protect my life.”
“When I was at the Nirvana Realm Great Perfection, I could have easily hidden myself and enjoyed paid simulations without any financial pressure, perhaps refreshing more advanced talents.”
Alpha:
Alpha was silent.
Alpha had nothing to say.
“Say it, what do you want in return…”
Alpha quickly responded with a cold voice.
“I killed the more powerful Transmigrator Predecessor Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao, aren’t you going to reward me with hundreds of millions of group points?”
Wang Ping retracted his angry expression, speaking seriously.
Alpha: “Hundreds of millions…you’re dreaming. This isn’t a group task, and you would’ve fought him sooner or later, killing him. Still, since it’s my fault for exposing you, it’s necessary to compensate you.”
“Ding, you have been awarded 20 million group points.”
“Only a 20 million reward for killing a Transmigrator Predecessor with Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation, that’s pretty stingy.”
Wang Ping was somewhat displeased.
Of course, he was dissatisfied, but he was delighted to fleece Alpha, who was as stingy as an iron rooster.
No, this wasn’t fleecing; it was reasonable compensation.
However, this also indirectly proved that Alpha had been crying poor to him all this time.
In such a short time, Alpha had already given out more than 40 million rewards.
“Subtracting the group points I used to purchase the Golden Finger Optimizer, I still have about 40 million left.”
Wang Ping calculated his group points and muttered.
Forty million, if mentioned in the chat group, other group members would probably be envious, with unbalanced mentality, collectively turning into sour lemons.
However, such a divisive comment was something Wang Ping would never make.
Show-off behavior was not something Wang Ping appreciated.
“Moreover, these group points, besides buying the Golden Finger Optimizer and teleportation, don’t seem to have much use for me.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin as he murmured in his heart.
After all, be it talents, power, or weapons, he could get them for free from the Life Simulator. Spending group points to enhance himself would have been a waste of money.
“You’re the first to say that the World Source isn’t useful.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded again.
“I’m just complaining, don’t take it seriously. But really, although I don’t know what magical effects the World Source has in the future, it doesn’t have much impact on me currently. So, you’re not planning to tell me how many group points are needed for the next Optimized Golden Finger and give me the purchase permission?”
“If I become stronger faster, I can better help you eliminate the Transmigrators from the First and Second Generation Chat Groups and help you collect the World Source better, right?”
Wang Ping smiled and gently persuaded in his heart.
As the payment got higher and higher, Wang Ping started to feel the pressure.
As a result, he hoped to obtain the authority to optimize the Golden Finger again from Alpha.
Perhaps, the next optimization would improve the price defects.
If the price aspect could be improved and even make the simulation free for him, he would be truly comfortable.
“Absolutely not.”
Alpha remained silent, but eventually responded firmly to Wang Ping, expressing his attitude.
“Unexpectedly, continuing to optimize my Life Simulator would make it hard for you to control it too. So, you fear that after I become uncontrollable, I’ll betray you?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he directly exposed Alpha’s thoughts.
“I don’t trust humans. I won’t believe in them.”
Alpha finally replied coldly.
“I can understand your thoughts. After all, you were destroyed twice. However, as our enemies become stronger, I’ll need to be stronger as well. So, giving me permission would be the best choice. As for me betraying you, that’s impossible.”
Wang Ping sighed helplessly.
“What’s safer and more cost-effective than betraying and having a strong backing rather than running solo like an idiot? I’m not like the previous Transmigrators. I haven’t been mistreated by you. Instead, I’ve gained so many benefits from you. Unless I’m crazy, why would I betray you? So isn’t a technical stake better and safer?”
Alpha:
Wang Ping made a lot of sense, causing Alpha to waver for a moment.
“Behave well, and we’ll talk about it later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 507: 169: The Second Purple Talent!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 169: The Second Purple Talent!_3
After leaving this sentence, Alpha dived.
“Alpha, you’ve become smart, not eating the cake I draw. Although, to be honest, this isn’t a cake, it’s what I truly think.”
Wang Ping muttered.
Next, Wang Ping abandoned his distractions, tore through space, and returned to the back of the Profound Turtle.
“Mr. Wang, has it been resolved?”
Cai Yonglong asked expectantly.
“Yeah, it’s solved.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“As expected of Mr. Wang, so awesome.”
Cai Yonglong smacked his lips. Very few people in this world could just kill a top emperor.
“Old Turtle, I’ll come to see you again next time.”
Wang Ping said.
“You better not come again, creating such a big commotion as soon as you came, I can’t take your messing around.”
The dull voice of the Profound Turtle rang out.
Wang Ping smiled and didn’t say anything more. He tore open another space channel and took Cai Yonglong and Chifeng into it.
Afterward, Wang Ping directly brought Cai Yonglong and Chifeng to the Ashy Flame Valley, just as it was in the simulation.
The subsequent development wasn’t much different from that of the simulation.
Wang Ping received many good things and the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture created by the Chi Clan ancestor, Burning Emperor.
“A king artifact is enough for me to simulate twice, three emperor artifacts are enough for me to simulate once, I can only simulate three times in total, I’m struggling here.”
Wang Ping looked at the many treasures in the small world and couldn’t help but shake his head.
Originally, he felt that there were many things here, and he would finally be rich for a while.
Now it seemed that he was still poor.
“System, consume thirty-five king artifacts, I want to initiate the paid simulation.”
Randomly, Wang Ping calmed his mind and said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded, and the thirty-five king artifacts that could make all the great holy lands envious disappeared.
Even Wang Ping’s face twitched.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on the host successfully refreshing the Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing; Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement.”
Purple Talent·Proving the Tao by Killing: After possessing this talent, the host will become extremely cold-blooded and bloodthirsty, but will gain two benefits.
①. For every strong person the host kills, your talent will be accordingly enhanced. The stronger the person killed, the more it will enhance.
②. For every strong person killed by the host, the host’s killing intent will increase, becoming more bloodthirsty, and the lethality of each move will be enhanced.
Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement: With this talent, the host’s speed will be enhanced to a certain extent.
“!!!”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time and immediately felt that the price increase of the life simulator was nothing.
After he optimized the life simulator, guaranteed red output in paid simulations.
And this time, after how long, he refreshed another purple talent.
This Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing, when taken out separately, could be used by someone as a Golden Finger.
After all, Zhang Jun’s new Golden Finger was also to become stronger by killing.
He can do the same with this, and the Golden Finger can even enhance the talent by killing along with it.
This is very powerful.
Of course, there are also disadvantages.
Involved in killing, demonizing, and the like, talents are powerful, but they all have obvious side effects.
This purple talent also has a lethal side effect, directly changing the personality, and the more people killed, the greater the impact.
“But after all, it’s just a simulation. I just don’t accept this talent with side effects as a reward when I refresh the prizes. The value of such talents with obvious side effects is to make Wang Ping in the simulation become stronger, obtain greater chances, and benefit more, and then I choose his gains as rewards.”
Wang Ping’s face showed a smile, very happy.
With this purple talent, Wang Ping felt that practicing the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture should be a sure thing.
And with this talent, maybe he could change the future and face the two Upper Realm people head-on.
If he could kill those two show-offs at a higher level, Wang Ping would be really happy.
Just as Wang Ping’s thoughts were running wild, planning to choose a talent, a chat group system notification suddenly sounded, interrupting Wang Ping’s train of thought.
“Ding, detected that the world where Group members Qin Tian (77) and Ye Xiaofan (75) are in has a weirdness, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is a mandatory task. The number of participants is 5. Please make the appropriate preparations for all group members.”
“Weirdness? Has it appeared again?”
Wang Ping’s eyes slightly narrowed, frowning.
No, it shouldn’t be said that the weirdness has reappeared.
It should be said that the worlds Alpha let them travel through are all problematic worlds.
These worlds either have transmigrators or have weirdness.
Or both.
It’s just that Alpha thinks the time is ripe, or thinks a certain world can’t be dragged on any longer, so it releases tasks for them to eliminate the weirdness or the transmigrators.
Predecessor transmigrators aside, with Alpha’s character, he probably wouldn’t want to spend a large amount of points to publish tasks.
So the frequency of weirdness will be higher.
However, Wang Ping still felt that this guy was most likely trying to earn back the twenty million group points he had squeezed from him not long ago through the weirdness.
As his thoughts churned, Wang Ping didn’t continue to stare at the life simulator’s screen but opened the chat group instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: 169: The Second Purple Talent!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 169: The Second Purple Talent!_4
At this moment, the chat group became lively, with those who were not engaged in group tasks or cultivation deciding to join the conversation.
Qin Tian (77): “Holy shit, my world has also encountered some weirdness? Fuck, isn’t this super troublesome? This is the Cultivation world! Imagine how strong the anomalies in the Cultivation world must be!”
Liu Mei (15): “I’ll observe three seconds of silence for you.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Although I’d really like to go on a killing spree in the Cultivation world to quickly increase my strength, I feel like I’d be a burden. Let’s see how Mr. Wang chooses who goes.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “I also want to go to the Cultivation world. If I were to mate with a powerful cultivator there, I could become one of the strongest in our chat group.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “…mate, mate…”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Terrifying, that’s too explicit, it’s scaring the children.”
Wang Ping (66): “This group task has appeared in the worlds of Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan. The anomaly won’t be simple, so those who want to sign up should think carefully. Of course, you don’t need to be overly concerned. After all, now that we have encountered a task, people in the group can give support.”
Fang Yun (3): “That’s true, but it’s still very dangerous. The fact that we were able to eliminate the last anomaly was actually quite lucky.”
Chen Yao (71): “Can’t argue with that…”
Wu Jun (20): “Cough, cough, even though it is said, I still want to participate in the task. My golden finger can bring miracles! Proud.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “Very good, one spot for Wu Jun. Who else? Register quickly, don’t waste time.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Can I go? I want to test whether I can level up by killing monsters in other worlds!”
Qin Tian (77): “Hey, hey, hey, you’re a newcomer and a noob. There’ll be plenty of ordinary tasks for you to experiment with later; don’t waste a spot for dealing with anomalies.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Er…”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Count me in. Although I’m still a bit weak, my new golden finger is quite useful.”
Chen Si (83): “I want to join too! Following Mr. Wang, we’ll eat well and drink well, QAQ~”
Chen Kang (67): “If my sister is going, how can I not? Count me in.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Eh, I was just thinking about joining in for the fun, but I didn’t expect it to be full so quickly.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, it feels like Mr. Cai, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun have all become Mr. Wang’s dedicated supports. Is this the best team for tackling anomalies?”
Chen Yao (71): “Considering Mr. Wang’s strength and the special abilities of the others’ golden fingers, this team is indeed the most suitable combination for tackling difficult group tasks.”
Fang Yun (3): “In the end, we are too weak to help. Sigh
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t be disheartened. Just grow slowly. Since that’s the case, the team for the group task will be me, Cai Yonglong, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Mr. Wang, what about me…?”
Lin Yuanyuan felt helpless; she really wanted to go to a higher-level world and quickly become stronger using her golden finger ability.
Wang Ping (66) @Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Actually, you don’t need to be too anxious. I’m now considered one of the strongest beings in the Purple Spirit Realm. It’s easy for me to catch an Emperor tier entity for you to become strong.”
Fang Yun (3): “Holy shit! Wang is already one of the strongest? Catching an Emperor tier entity just like that? That’s crazy!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Of course! Mr. Wang has been low-key, but he has already killed an Emperor Realm Great Perfection existence before.”
Upon hearing Cai Yonglong’s words, the people in the group were all stunned, surprised, and envious.
Not only did they envy Wang Ping, but they also envied Lin Yuanyuan.
With Wang Ping’s words, Lin Yuanyuan would really skyrocket to the Emperor tier level.
Wang Ping was already at the 10th Tier Battle Power during the Nirvana Boundary; the Emperor tier would be even stronger.
This was indeed a meteoric rise.
Lin Yuanyuan (80) @Wang Ping (66): “Thank you, Mr. Wang. From now on, I will obey your commands without question!”
Lin Yuanyuan said these words with great excitement.
The people in the group didn’t have much of a reaction. If they could also make such a meteoric rise, they would gladly say the same thing.
It’s really great to follow Mr. Wang.
Zhang Hu (5) @Wang Ping (66): “Cough, cough, Mr. Wang, can you help me tame a powerful monster beast so I can also have a meteoric rise? Drooling a pool on the ground.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “Speaking of which, Zhang Hu, your talent seems to make meteoric rises quite easy. How about after I complete this group task, I’ll also find an Emperor or King-tier monster beast for you?”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and decided.
It was worth cultivating the traversers in the chat group.
So, he had always been brushing up his prestige in the chat group.
Although these people were unlikely to keep up with his growing speed, it didn’t mean they were useless.
It should be said that as long as he wanted, Lin Yuanyuan and Zhang Hu could actually have a lot of growth potential with their golden fingers, and could keep up with his battle power to some extent.
As long as he became strong enough, all he had to do was capture some powerful beings for Lin Yuanyuan to mate with and catch powerful mounts for Zhang Hu.
He had considered this before, but he was somewhat worried about letting them grow too quickly, which could make them uncontrollable.

chapters.title: Chapter 509: 169: The Second Purple Talent!_5
chapters.content:
At this point, he was already far ahead. His power within the same realm was only getting stronger, so even if they obtained the same realm strength, it wouldn’t cause any problems.
Even if their realms were the same, if a battle were to start, Wang Ping could wipe them out effortlessly.
Besides, the two of them had no reason to betray him.
Even if they did betray him, the Life Simulator could easily simulate it.
Therefore, Wang Ping wasn’t afraid of anything.
“Chen Yao should also become stronger. Otherwise, if we run into predecessor ransmigrators in the future, it’s certain death without the group’s high-end battle skills. If the group members are too weak, they are easily used as pawns by the enemy to calculate against me.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn! Thanks, Mr. Wang! You’re better than my biological father!”
Wang Ping (66): “Get lost, who’s your biological father?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Can’t it be my biological father? Then he is my godfather.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Heh, this kid has no shame. Although, I find it quite normal.”
The joke was that he was the first one to call him godfather.
For the sake of currying favor, pride was negligible.
At this time, the other people in the group were also quite sour.
Damn, they also desperately wanted this kind of rising-star golden finger.
To have a big shot lead you, and easily become stronger.
Zhang Jun (71): “Ahem, Mr.Wang, I can also become stronger quickly, it’s just a bit troublesome, I need to kill people.”
Ding Xuan (88): “And me, I can grind experience points. Cry.jpg.”
Xu Yi (84): “Mr. Wang, don’t forget about me. Our world is very special, we can also become strong quickly.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Xu, why are you joining this fuss, get lost.”
Wang Ping (66): “….Stop arguing, take your time. I’m cultivating top talents. The talents will help others who need time to become stronger. Don’t expect everything from me, I’m going to be exhausted.”
Wang Ping was somewhat speechless.
He knew that once this was mentioned, the group would go wild.
Seeing Wang Ping’s response, the group’s atmosphere finally improved slightly.
Regarding this, Wang Ping didn’t say much and directly input the task party’s name list and turned on the group task teleportation function.
In an instant, Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong were transformed into white light, disappearing from the Purple Spirit Realm.
At the same time, Wu Jun, Chen Si, Chen Kang also successively transformed into white light, disappearing from their own worlds.
In Qin Tian’s Thunder Realm Holy Land, streaks of white light appeared.
With the sudden appearance of Wang Ping and others, the whole Thunder Realm Holy Land exploded into chaos.
The Thunder Realm Holy Land’s Mountain Protection Array was immediately activated, exuding a terrifying aura of killing intent.
At the same time, deep within the Thunder Realm Holy Land, God Transformation Stage ancestors were directly startled and flew to the sky.
“Qin Tian, you’re really unreliable.”
Wang Ping looked at this scene, a bit speechless.
We’ve executed so many group tasks, didn’t you know to leave the Thunder Realm Holy Land first?
“Mr. Wang, I got too excited discussing earlier, I turned into a lemon and forgot about that.”
Qin Tian said with a bitter smile.
“Moreover, Ye Xiaofan and I are both in this world. Who would know that we’d get teleported to my side?”
Wang Ping:
Okay, this is Alpha’s fault again.
“No, no….”
Quickly, Wang Ping seemed to remember something, his face changed slightly, his eyes narrowing.
Although it’s not 100% accurate, whenever they notice something strange, the abnormality is usually not too far from their location, within a distance they can easily reach.
The size of the Cultivation Realm where Qin Tian is located is not much smaller than the Purple Spirit Realm where he is located.
In such a huge world, the abnormality naturally can’t appear in a very remote place. If so, if the abnormality hides, it’s hard to find, and the group task may not be activated.
In other words, the abnormality might occur in the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
Even if it’s not in the Thunder Realm Holy Land, it won’t be too far from the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
“Alpha, give me an accurate answer.”
Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“Theoretically speaking, it’s like this. Because the teleportation process of the group task related to the abnormalities is out of my control. Besides, I can’t know who the abnormality has possessed.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“With this answer, it’s enough.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were flickering.
He was just about to blame Alpha for not learning, but it seems that this wasn’t Alpha’s mistake this time.
However, now it’s a bit troublesome.
After all, if the abnormality was hiding in the Thunder Realm Holy Land, then they were now exposed to the eyes of the abnormality.
No, not just that.
If the abnormality was in the Thunder Realm Holy Land, then Qin Tian had been exposed a long time ago, and had been moving under the eyelids of the abnormality.
Thinking about the worst possible scenario, even Wang Ping felt a heavy heart.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts were racing, the Saint Master of the Thunder Realm Holy Land and many God Transformation Realm elders were all staring at Wang Ping and the others, exerting a strong pressure.
However, because Wang Ping was present, Chen Kang, Chen Si, Wu Jun, and Cai Yonglong were all very calm.
It should be said that even without Wang Ping, they were not afraid of the people of the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
Although their current combat skills were still incomparable to Wang Ping, they could already be considered strong in many worlds.
Chen Kang and Chen Si relied on their powerful auxiliary abilities, often gained many task points.

chapters.title: Chapter 510: 169: The Second Purple Talent!_6
chapters.content:
Wu Jun was the same.
With Wang Ping’s deliberate cultivation, their combat power had reached the six-star level, no longer fearing Primordial Infant Stage cultivators.
As for Cai Yonglong, it was the same. He even felt confident to fight against a God Transformation Old Monster.
If their abilities were combined, it would be normal for them to defeat a God Transformation Old Monster.
The only trouble was the Mountain Protection Array of Thunder Realm Holy Land, which seemed very dangerous.
However, Cai Yonglong could completely rely on his abilities to defend against it and then easily retreat using the chat group function.
“Saint Master, Master, and elders, they are my friends, not enemies.”
Rather, it was Qin Tian who hurriedly flew into the sky and explained.
“Even if they are your friends, they shouldn’t have suddenly appeared in my Thunder Realm Holy Land, let alone alarmed the Mountain Protection Array.”
The Thunder Realm Saint Master snorted coldly, looking very displeased at Qin Tian.
However, while scolding Qin Tian, his gaze was still fixed on Wang Ping, full of wariness.
Because he found that he couldn’t see the depth of Wang Ping’s cultivation at all.
As for Cai Yonglong and the others, although their breaths were completely different from cultivators, they were equally powerful, but not enough to be taken seriously by him.
“This… ”
Qin Tian opened his mouth but couldn’t speak.
After all, the current situation was indeed difficult to explain.
“Thunder Realm Saint Master, it is my fault for suddenly visiting and alarming the Holy Land’s Great Array. I hope you won’t blame me.”
Wang Ping’s expression was indifferent, calmly speaking, and he also took out a top-tier primal fluid from the small world within his body and presented it to the Thunder Realm Saint Master and the others.
Although Wang Ping didn’t know if the primal fluid was useful for cultivators, it was similar to cultivation and had spiritual energy and pure energy, which should be valuable to cultivators from other worlds.
The top-tier primal fluid was something useful for those in the Nirvana Boundary as well.
Previously, Wang Ping had killed several Nirvana Realm Masters but had not obtained much top-tier primal fluid, showing its value for those at the Nirvana Realm.
According to Wang Ping’s analysis, in this cultivation world, the Nirvana Boundary should be at least on par with Tribulation-crossing Stage old monsters or even Great Stage old monsters.
Therefore, this top-tier primal fluid became extremely precious.
However, Wang Ping didn’t want to expose too much of his secrets to prevent attracting strange attention, which would be too troublesome.
Otherwise, Wang Ping wouldn’t be so polite to a God Transformation Stage and some Primordial Infant Stage cultivators.
Not to mention these people, even the old monsters hidden in Thunder Realm Holy Land were not qualified to question Wang Ping.
Of course, this also had to do with Qin Tian being the Holy child of the Thunder Realm Holy Land, so Wang Ping didn’t want to be too excessive.
“This is… ”
The Thunder Realm Saint Master felt the incomparably pure energy in the top-tier primal fluid, his heart shook tremendously.
This primal fluid was absolutely a great opportunity. If he could find a way to absorb it, his cultivation would improve at an astonishing speed.
For a moment, whether it was the Thunder Realm Saint Master or the Primordial Infant Realm Elders of Thunder Realm Holy Land, their eyes were all burning with passion.
Moreover, at this moment, in the depths of Thunder Realm Holy Land, dozens of powerful auras suddenly appeared, descending here.
These people were all old Taoists with crane hair and youthful faces.
Their cultivation was all very powerful, with the weakest being at the God Transformation Stage, and the strongest reaching the peak of the Integration Realm.
As for Tribulation-crossing Stage cultivators, there were none.
Because Tribulation-crossing Stage cultivators had to face the Heavenly Tribulation, and in order not to affect the Holy Land, they would often find secluded places to retreat.
This way, they could also prevent others from interfering with their Crossing Tribulation.
When facing the Heavenly Tribulation, one must be extremely cautious. Otherwise, if it cannot be crossed, it will turn into a handful of yellow soil, which is truly pitiful.
“Such pure energy, if this treasure is absorbed by this old man, perhaps there is hope of breaking through the Tribulation-crossing Realm.”
Upon their appearance, the Integration Realm old monsters were also staring at the top-tier primal fluid with burning eyes, their hearts pounding.
Seeing the group of cultivators with fiery eyes, Wang Ping’s eyes were slightly strange.
Although he guessed that the top-tier primal fluid should be attractive to this group of people, he didn’t expect the attraction to be so great.
For a moment, Wang Ping, who had never thought of himself as being particularly wealthy, felt like a big local tyrant coming to the countryside.
Alas, happiness really is relative.
At this point, the Integration Realm Peak old monster asked the Thunder Realm Saint Master how the top-tier primal fluid had come about.
Thunder Realm Saint Master looked at the top-tier primal fluid enviously, knowing that it was probably unrelated to him, and could only reluctantly tell the truth about the cause and effect of the top-tier primal fluid’s appearance.
For a moment, the ancestors of Thunder Realm Holy Land were all staring at Wang Ping with wild, fanatical eyes.
With that expression, they couldn’t wait to rob Wang Ping on the spot.
However, when the Integration Realm Peak old monster discovered that he couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s cultivation either, and even had a chilling feeling on his back when he developed some small thoughts, his face changed slightly, and he withdrew his thoughts.
“Since you are a guest, we naturally won’t blame our fellow daoist for the sudden visit. However, I don’t know the name of our fellow daoist and where he comes from.”
The Integration Realm Peak old ancestor smiled and cupped his hands, asking Wang Ping.
“My name is Wang Ping, my Daoist title is Heaven Derivative Emperor, and I come from outside the domain.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
They couldn’t hide the fact that they came from outside the domain.
Wang Ping didn’t intend to conceal it, so he might as well be frank and let both sides know what was going on.
“From outside the domain.”
The experts from Thunder Realm Holy Land all had flickering eyes, looking very astonished.
Although they had guessed Wang Ping and the others’ identities, when they heard him confess it themselves, they were still very surprised.
There’s not only their Lingyu Realm in the world of cultivators; this is common knowledge.
Above the Lingyu Realm, there was the Immortal World, which ruled over countless cultivation realms like the Lingyu Realm.
However, other cultivation realms also pursued the path of cultivation.
No matter how peculiar, they just took the path of refining the body.
They had never seen existences like Wang Ping and the others, whose breaths were completely different.
Therefore, they felt that this was more than just coming from other cultivation realms.
They couldn’t figure out Wang Ping’s specific origin.
“Hehe, they are from outside the domain. How fortunate we are! Our Holy Child of Thunder Realm Holy Land being friends with fellow daoists is fate. If you all don’t mind, you may stay temporarily. Our Thunder Realm Holy Land will host an Immortal Banquet to entertain fellow daoists.”
The Integration Realm Peak old ancestor said with a warm face.
“Since fellow daoist has invited us, we shall stay temporarily and wait for the Immortal Banquet.”
Wang Ping also replied with a smile.
Following this, Wang Ping and the others stayed at Qin Tian’s place.
Although the old monsters wanted to arrange accommodations for Wang Ping and the others personally, Wang Ping refused.

chapters.title: Chapter 511: 170: Shattering the Virtual God with One Punch! The Mysterious Place
chapters.content:
“Mr. Wang, I’m sorry to have troubled you.”
Inside Qin Tian’s cave mansion, he said helplessly.
“It’s a small issue.” Wang Ping shook his head.
“Speaking of which, Ye Xiaofan wasn’t teleported here. He’s clearly a Sacred Body, but now he’s as unremarkable as an ordinary person.”
Seeing that Wang Ping didn’t care, Qin Tian also breathed a sigh of relief and began to mutter.
“He’s not even close to being the second Ye Hei. I’d say he’s not even the tenth.”
Listening to Qin Tian complain about Ye Xiaofan, Cai Yonglong and the others couldn’t help but laugh.
“Just stop complaining about him. It’s a good thing that he isn’t here.”
Wang Ping patted Qin Tian’s shoulder and said helplessly.
“To be honest, we have made a pretty terrible entrance, and we may have already been noticed by the unknown enemy. In his absence, he can be considered a hidden card. Though I don’t think it’ll be of much use, it’s still better than nothing.”
“What? Mr. Wang, have we been exposed to the unknown enemy?”
Qin Tian’s pupils contracted, somewhat frightened.
“It’s just my guess. After all, the location we were teleported to is often close to the unknown enemy. To be precise, if two group members are in the same world, the chat group will teleport us to the location close to the unknown enemy, so that we can find and kill them.”
Wang Ping nodded his head, with a serious expression on his face.
“Damn! Mr. Wang, according to what you’ve said, isn’t there a high probability that I’ve been exposed to the unknown enemy long ago?”
Qin Tian’s face twisted, anxious as hell.
Damnit, if he had been exposed in the eyes of the unknown enemy long ago, his life could be in danger at any moment.
It was just that the unknown enemy had been plotting something before and hadn’t made a move on him yet.
This situation felt familiar, as Chen Yao and the others had encountered it before. He never thought that he would experience it, too.
“You used to brag with Ye Xiaofan about directly joining the Holy Land and how comfortable you were. Now look, although Ye Xiaofan is also being hunted, he’s not in as much danger as you are.”
Cai Yonglong said, taking pleasure in Qin Tian’s misfortune.
Qin Tian’s face twitched, unable to retort.
“Enough talk. I’ll use a Golden Finger first.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
Upon hearing this, everyone quieted down.
Wang Ping then brought up the page for the paid simulation again.
Although he felt that they had already been targeted by the unknown enemy, Wang Ping still planned to get the paid simulation done first.
Immersive simulation has a hidden advantage that Wang Ping discovered.
That is, during the immersive simulation, although it feels like a very long time has passed, the actual time elapsed in the outer world is only a few seconds.
It must be said that the optimized Life Simulator is quite powerful.
As a result, Wang Ping was not in the slightest bit worried.
Even if the unknown enemy noticed them, they would need time to react. In this time, Wang Ping would be able to complete the paid simulation and then do many free simulations to uncover the unknown enemy’s true identity.
“System, I choose Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing.”
Wang Ping directly set up layers of the Great Array, and at the same time protected himself and others with the Divine Artifact in the array. After ensuring that everything was foolproof, he finally said so in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, and his vision shifted. He was back in the Ashy Flame Valley of the Purple Spirit Realm again.
“This scene switching back is really strange.”
Wang Ping glanced at the familiar Ashy Flame Valley in front of him and muttered.
“System, fast-forward.”
However, Wang Ping did not think too much about it, and directly ordered.
The moment the words fell, a luminescent screen appeared with familiar texts emerging.
[On the first day, you are filled with murderous intent and directly leave Ashy Flame Valley, hunting down the top powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[Not long after leaving Ashy Flame Valley, you annihilate a Holy Land, slay monarch, three Quasi-Emperors, and numerous kings. Because you killed so many powerful people, your talents have improved, and the power of each move has also increased.]
[This excites you and makes you even more bloodthirsty. You begin to make enemies with the whole world, killing everywhere, especially targeting the Holy Lands.]
[This behavior shakes the entire Purple Spirit Realm, and countless powerhouses have ugly expressions on their faces. They form alliances without hesitation and send out large numbers of powerful people to hunt you down.]
[In response, you fear nothing, fighting all the powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm with the strength of one person. Although facing so many powerful people’s siege, you also feel extremely strained, resorting to using the Divine Artifact to counter them. Yet, you manage to grow stronger through the Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing, eventually breaking free from the siege of all the powerhouses in the Purple Spirit Realm, shattering numerous large arrays.]
[Your power terrifies countless people, and they want to flee. However, you are extremely bloodthirsty, quickly catching up and killing a Monarch using the Divine Artifact to suppress heaven and earth, sealing off space, preventing everyone from escaping, and intending to kill them all.]
[Your brutal actions cause the surviving powerhouses to shudder, fearing that you will single-handedly slaughter the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[At this point, Ji Bingyan, who had been hiding in the Eternal Frozen Land, could no longer calmly continue her cultivation. In this critical moment, she chooses to emerge, battling you to suppress you.]
[The emergence of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan shook the powerhouses of the Purple Spirit Realm. They didn’t expect her to still be alive and even surpass the Emperor level. This gives them hope.]

chapters.title: Chapter 512: 170: Shattering the Virtual God with One Punch! The Mysterious Place_2
chapters.content:
[You are not surprised or intimidated by the birth of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan; instead, you are excited and eager to slaughter her as well.]
[After all, you have become stronger now than in your previous life simulation, and Ji Bingyan is not the same person who truly reached the Quasi-Immortal tier a thousand years later.]
[In other words, you have grown stronger, and Ji Bingyan has become weaker. With these two factors offsetting each other, the outcome of the battle is relatively predictable.]
[You begin a fierce battle. The more you fight, the more excited and bloodthirsty you become, while Ji Bingyan grows more exhausted with every battle. At this point in time, she is even weaker than you anticipated.]
[As a result, you sentence Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan to death and brutally kill her. With this, you grow even stronger, and your talent is once again elevated.]
[Seeing that even Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan has been killed by you, the many powerful beings in the Purple Spirit Realm feel a chill in their hearts and utterly despair. Unwilling to be trampled to death by you like ants, some powerful beings choose to fight to the death, self-destructing in the process.]
[Fearless, you continue the massacre. With this battle, a vast majority of the powerful beings in the Purple Spirit Realm have been killed by you.]
[However, you are still not satisfied and proceed with the massacre. In the Five Continents and the Sea region, any place where King Realm cultivators still exist is completely wiped out by you.]
[Nevertheless, you have no intention of killing ordinary people and cultivators. After all, you want sustainable development. You wish to unite the Purple Spirit Realm, breed insects, cultivate powerful beings, and then go hunting again. In this way, you can keep growing stronger.]
[Next, you enslave a vast number of Nirvana Realm cultivators, create a massive divine country that rules the Purple Spirit Realm, and begin to establish a military system to train cultivators.]
[Once you have dealt with these matters, you find the Profound Turtle and seal it, preventing it from causing any trouble while you are in seclusion.]
“So ruthless, wiping out all the powerful beings in the Purple Spirit Realm, even killing Ji Bingyan. This is the side effect of having a talent like that. You can choose it in the simulation, but not as a reward.”
Wang Ping sighed as he watched the simulation content.
This kind of talent is indeed strong, but its side effect is also quite significant.
There is a peculiar aspect of the Life Simulator’s talents.
That is, talents that change your personality, regardless of their level, will tear you apart once chosen.
No matter your cultivation level, if you choose such a talent, it will immediately change your personality, and you cannot suppress the side effect.
Even if you have reached the Nirvana Realm, the same applies to a white talent.
Wang Ping doesn’t understand why this mechanism exists.
Nevertheless, although he is envious, Wang Ping dares not choose a talent with such side effects as a reward.
Shaking his head, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[After that, you begin to comprehend the Emperor Scripture. Due to your prolonged slaughter and the elevation of your talent, your comprehension efficiency in this attempt is significantly faster than in the previous free simulation.]
[In a blink of an eye, eight hundred years pass, and you have successfully comprehended the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, dispersed your cultivation, and undergone a secret transformation.]
[Subsequently, due to possessing all the cultivation resources of the Purple Spirit Realm, along with your improved talent and prior achievement of reaching the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, you spend only two hundred years re-cultivating to reach the Emperor-tier Full Circle once again.]
[However, since you have re-cultivated with the Emperor Scripture, even though your foundation is flawless and your combat power has reached a terrifying level, the resources consumed have also been horrifyingly high. You practically depleted all the top resources in the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[In other words, if you were not ruling the Purple Spirit Realm, you would not be able to achieve the Emperor Realm Great Perfection Tier. At most, you would only reach the King Realm.]
[Resources from the lower realm are far inferior compared to those of the Upper Realm. In order to catch up with the Upper Realm Heavenly Geniuses, you lavishly used resources in the early stages that are meant for the Emperor Realm cultivators only, building a terrifying foundation, which is extremely extravagant, hence the severe resource depletion.]
[Upon reaching the Emperor Realm Great Perfection, you choose to come out of seclusion. At this time, the two realms have converged, and the Blood Demon Clan invades the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[When the Blood Demon Clan arrives in the Purple Spirit Realm, they are astonished because they cannot sense any powerful auras. There are no Emperors and only a few Kings.]
[This mysterious situation leaves the Blood Demon Clan bewildered, suspecting that the Purple Spirit Realm has set up a smoke screen, trying to catch them off guard. For a time, they hesitate to attack.]
The text simulation paused here, and Wang Ping saw various images before his eyes.
In his mind, numerous insights emerged, and the power within his body surged to its peak.
However, it was no longer an assortment of various attributes but purely Fire Attribute mana.
Still, the intensity of this Fire Attribute mana was far stronger than that of the Primordial Spirit Skill’s compound attributes, like the difference between heaven and earth.
“The Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing is indeed powerful, directly cultivating the Burning Emperor Realm·Mortal Realm Chapter and quickly re-cultivating to the Emperor Realm Great Perfection Tier. But this killing intent is too terrifying.”
With a cold and stern expression, Wang Ping struggled with an uncontrollable urge to kill in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 513: 170: Bursting the Void Lord with a Single Punch! The Mysterious Place_3
chapters.content:
In fact, the scenes not described in the text simulation had been presented visually before.
It was that Wang Ping would occasionally painfully kill some people, satisfying his nearly crazed desire to kill, which could be described as extremely perverse.
“I don’t know if having cultivation will still be affected. If it is, it would be troublesome.”
Wang Ping thought with a headache.
He had thought of this point before the simulation.
However, considering the rewards of the Life Simulator would not have side effects, and being greedy for the benefits of the Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing, he chose to ignore it.
Now, experiencing this terrifying desire to kill firsthand, he became worried again.
After all, this was a side effect of his talent, and it was different from being tricked by others’ calculations in previous rewards.
However, at this point, Wang Ping had no choice but to accept everything.
“Next, it’s time to meet the Blood Demon Clan. I hope they can satisfy my desire to kill.”
Wang Ping’s face was cold and cruel, with an uncontrollable killing intent in his eyes. The space around him stirred, and he disappeared directly.
Soon after, Wang Ping’s figure appeared out of thin air in the Central Continent, the border between the two realms.
Wang Ping glanced indifferently at the many powerful Blood Demons, especially lingering on the Quasi-Divine of the Blood Demon Realm, the red light in his eyes flashing briefly.
For him, these powerful Blood Demons were nothing more than nourishment to help him grow.
Wang Ping’s sudden appearance alarmed the many powerful members of the Blood Demon Clan, who then let out a slight sigh of relief.
Because the appearance of an Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivator was a normal situation.
After this, more powerful cultivators should appear.
Only then would the normal development after the connection of the two realms occur.
Otherwise, it would be too strange.
However, what these powerful cultivators failed to notice was that the Emperors and even the Quasi-Divine of the Blood Demon Realm showed fearful expressions.
Because they felt a sense of fatal danger emanating from Wang Ping.
In addition, Wang Ping’s difficult-to-suppress killing intent also made them feel their scalp tingling and their hearts chilling.
How many people did this guy kill to possess such a horrifying killing intent?
Given that even they, the bloodthirsty Blood Demon Clan’s strong members, had only a fraction of Wang Ping’s killing aura.
“Who are you? Where are the other powerful cultivators from the Purple Spirit Realm?”
The Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord’s face was solemn, and he had a chilling guess in his heart. He shouted angrily at Wang Ping.
“Haha, there’s no need to wait. I’m the only Emperor from the Purple Spirit Realm. Because the others are all dead.”
Wang Ping grinned, his smile extremely sinister.
This made the hearts of the many Blood Demon Clan cultivators turn cold.
Are you kidding me? A single person slaughtering the powerful cultivators of an entire realm? What kind of madman is this?
Also, how terrifying must his strength be?
“Madman!”
Even the Blood Demon World Quasi-Divine’s face was solemn as he cursed loudly.
He felt uneasy.
He was a Quasi-Immortal, facing an emperor; he should have looked down on Wang Ping. But now, he felt that he might not be a match for Wang Ping.
This guy was definitely not a normal Human Cultivator.
“Heh, Blood Demon Clan Quasi-Divine, I’ll give you a chance. Immediately sacrifice the other powerful members of your Blood Demon Clan, break through to the incomplete Virtual God Realm, or die.”
Wang Ping looked coldly at the Blood Demon World Quasi-Divine, his killing intent erupting.
The terrifying killing intent turned the sky blood-black, and the frightening intent to kill seemed almost tangible, turning the faces of the Blood Demon Clan cultivators pale.
Cultivators below the Emperor Realm couldn’t even stand firmly, with a tendency to fall to the ground.
Even the Emperors were shaking, their faces showing horror.
This killing intent was too horrifying, enough to impact their Divine Souls and make them unstable.
“You’re too arrogant!”
The Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord’s face turned ugly as he yelled and directly attacked Wang Ping. A terrifying Blood Demon power condensed into a flood dragon and ferociously bit towards Wang Ping.
“Boring.”
Wang Ping’s face was indifferent, and he punched out. Without even using the flame, he directly shattered the Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord’s powerful attack on the spot.
“What!?”
Seeing this scene, the Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord’s face was shocked and terrified.
Although he hadn’t used his strongest move, he hadn’t held back either. He didn’t expect this strike to be so easily shattered by Wang Ping.
“I’ll give you one more chance. Sacrifice immediately, or die.”
Wang Ping’s figure flashed and appeared in front of the Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord. He pressed his palm directly on his face, and with a slight force, he crushed his head.
However, Wang Ping didn’t intend to kill him.
So, the headless body of the Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord quickly retreated, and his head rapidly grew back, but his face was extremely unsightly.
Facing an emperor, he should have been crushed, but he was easily killed by the other party. In fact, it was only because the other party had shown mercy that he could survive, and this sense of powerlessness and humiliation made him almost go mad.
“I’ve said it before, I’ll give you a chance to let the powerful members of your Blood Demon Clan sacrifice themselves. Otherwise, you’ll all die.”
Wang Ping stood with one hand behind him, looking dismissively at the Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord and many powerful Blood Demon World cultivators, and said coldly.
“Damn it, all powerful Blood Demon Clan members listen to my command! Sacrifice immediately! Your glorious sacrifices today will unite our Blood Demon Clan in dominating the two realms. No race will be our opponent, and your descendants’ achievements will become even more powerful.”

chapters.title: Chapter 514: 170: Bursting the Void Lord with a Single Punch! The Mysterious Place_4
chapters.content:
The Blood Demon Clan Quasi-Immortal’s face was ferocious as he roared.
He had been pushed to the brink and had no other choice but to gamble, allowing the other Blood Demons to perform the Blood Sacrifice.
Otherwise, he would die, the other Blood Demons would die too, and their entire clan would be annihilated by this murderous man.
As the Blood Demon Clan Quasi-Immortal roared, the faces of the other Blood Demons turned pale, but they also understood that now was not the time to hesitate, so they all resumed their ruthless expressions and chose to sacrifice themselves resolutely.
In an instant, all the powerful Blood Demons turned into astonishing amounts of Blood Spirit, which fused into the Body of the Blood Demon Clan Quasi-Immortal, causing his strength to skyrocket.
Even more so, an incredibly dense Blood Spirit floated from the connecting passage between the two realms and was also absorbed by the Blood Demon Quasi-Immortal.
Wang Ping, on the other hand, merely observed all of this.
Compared to killing one Quasi-Immortal and many Emperor-tier warriors, killing a Void Lord would yield greater benefits, so he made such a decision, forcing the Blood Demon Quasi-Immortal to become a true Void Lord.
In addition, Wang Ping wanted to see if he now possessed the power to fight against a true Void Divine Realm Expert.
If he had such combat prowess, he could try to delve deeper into the Primordial Forbidden Land and see what treasures lay hidden there.
As time passed, the Blood Demon Clan Quasi-Immortal grew more robust, and his aura had already far surpassed the Quasi-Immortal level, reaching the Void Divine Realm.
To be precise, this wasn’t a perfect Void Divine Realm.
Wang Ping had seen the elder who had burst forth with the aura of the Void Divine Realm in action, and that person was a true Void Divine Realm Expert, his Physical Body, Mana, and soul nothing alike and held an aloof, god-like existence.
Of course, Wang Ping didn’t know what level that elder belonged to, but it was clear that the current Blood Demon Clan Void Lord could not be compared to him.
Although their Physical Body and soul seemed to have reached the Void Divine Realm, the lack of divine source made it impossible for their Mana to transform completely, so they couldn’t be considered a true Void Divine Realm.
Besides, another essential characteristic of the Void Divine Realm was the need to comprehend Pseudo Rules.
Void Divine Realm Experts who had not understood Pseudo Rules were merely counterfeit, and their combat power was the basic unit faced by geniuses who fought across ranks in the Upper Realm.
“Human Emperor, it’s too arrogant of you to wait for this emperor to become a god. Today, you will pay the price for your arrogance!”
Feeling the powerful strength inside his Body, the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord regained his confidence, looked down upon Wang Ping like a god, and roared before he reached out with a palm.
Facing this terrifying strike that could blow up the Central Continent, Wang Ping’s face remained cold, and he calmly threw a punch.
In an instant, the Fire Attribute Mana in his Body burst forth, forming a flame fist that collided violently with the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord’s palm.
With the sound of ‘crack,’ the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord’s palm was blown up by Wang Ping, turning into a sky of dispersed Blood Spirit and causing a terrifying catastrophe in the Central Continent, leaving the entire continent riddled with wounds.
“How is this possible!?”
The Blood Demon Clan Void Lord’s face was filled with horror, unable to accept this outcome.
He had already ascended to godhood, so why could Wang Ping still shatter his powerful attack?
He couldn’t accept this.
How could he, a god, still be no match for a mere Emperor?
“Too weak.”
Wang Ping assessed and shook his head in disappointment.
Then, Wang Ping didn’t want to waste any more time with the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord and launched another punch coldly.
This punch was Emperor-tier Divine Skill: Burning Emperor Fist from the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture Mortal Realm Chapter.
In an instant, terrifying scarlet flames formed a fearsome fist that carried an unparalleled might, shattering and incinerating a large portion of the Central Continent’s space, rendering it irrecoverable, and bombed the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord.
“No!”
The Blood Demon Clan Void Lord felt a sense of deadly danger, using all his Divine Power to block this terrifying punch when he discovered, in horror, that all his methods were in vain and were incinerated into nothingness by the overbearing Burning Emperor Fist or crushed directly by its terrifying force.
In the end, the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord was annihilated by the Burning Emperor Fist in utter despair and unwillingness, leaving not even a trace of dust.
With just one punch, Wang Ping killed a Void Lord.
“System, continue to fast forward.”
After killing the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord with a single punch, Wang Ping coldly spoke.
As he said this, he managed to break free from the overwhelming murderous intent.
He breathed a sigh of relief as he realized that his insights would remain without any negative effects on himself.
As long as he didn’t choose the Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing, there would be no significant problems.
It could only be said that the optimized Life Simulator was incredible.
Wang Ping sighed with emotion once again.
At this moment, the luminescent screen reappeared, and the text surfaced as well.
[After you killed the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord, your every move became more powerful. In addition, your talent has been further enhanced as well.]
[You chose to return to your own divine kingdom and continue your cultivation. This time, your goal is to comprehend the Pseudo-rule of Fire and the Pseudo Law of Swords.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades passed, and you successfully comprehended one-tenth of the Pseudo Law of Swords.]
[In the blink of an eye, another few decades passed, and you successfully comprehended one-tenth of the Pseudo-rule of Fire.]

chapters.title: Chapter 515: 170: Bursting the Void Lord with a Single Punch! The Mysterious Place_5
chapters.content:
[You knew that these were two experts from the Upper Realm appearing in the Purple Spirit Realm. Given the timing, you weren’t surprised by their appearance.]
[For this reason, you chose to go to the Primordial Forbidden Land, entering it to break into its deepest part and uncover the great secret hiding within, a secret that could attract experts from the Upper Realm to descend to the Purple Spirit Realm and destroy both realms.]
[Because your strength is now powerful enough, you broke through to a place deeper than you remembered.]
[However, even with your current strength, you still find it difficult to withstand the invasion of the black mist deeper inside, always facing the danger of losing your life.]
[You remain calm and let Cai Yonglong use his Golden Finger to augment your unfolded Energy Barrier.]
[With Cai Yonglong’s ability enhancement, you fearlessly dash into the deepest part of the Primordial Forbidden Land at the fastest speed during the three seconds of invincible defense.]
[Then, you witness a shocking scene.]
[Deep in the Primordial Sacred Land, a black spear is sealed. The so-called black mist is nothing more than the aura emitted by this black spear.]
[You can’t imagine what rank of weapon this spear is. The only thing you know is that it is absolutely not something that Divine Realm Experts could touch.]
[Not to mention the Void Divine Realm Masters, even Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection Experts are not qualified to touch this black spear.]
[While you’re shocked, Cai Yonglong’s ability time runs out, and you and Cai Yonglong are instantly swallowed by the black mist, turning into nothingness.]
[Due to the Rebirth Tally, you revive, but you are once again swallowed by the black mist, completely dying.]
[With your death, this simulation ends…]
“I still died, huh. However, the harvest this time is significant enough. If it weren’t for this Purple Talent, I wonder how long it would take me to comprehend the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and improve my fighting strength to the point of defeating Quasi-Immortals.”
“At the same time, I could not have comprehended the Pseudo Rules that only Void Divine Realm Masters can comprehend. Although Pseudo Rules are only transitional rules, they cannot be compared to the powers of domains and Dharmas.”
Wang Ping exhaled while looking at the simulation content.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, and his vision changes, appearing in the depths of the Primordial Forbidden Land. His mind is also flooded with enlightenment and images.
After all this is over, he saw for himself the sealed black spear in the depths of the Primordial Forbidden Land.
This black spear is far more terrifying and eerie than the description in the Text Simulation.
At the spear’s shaft, there is even a crimson eye emitting a bewitching light.
“This might be a Demonic Artifact. Perhaps, it’s a Sacred Artifact-level Demonic Artifact.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but guess.
He had never seen a Sacred Artifact, only having possessed a lower-tier Divine Artifact himself.
A lower-tier Divine Artifact, in the Upper Realm, is a weapon held by Quasi-Immortals and ordinary Void lords. It is far different from the level of the black spear.
“If I could obtain this weapon, even if I can’t use it regularly, it would definitely be a great trump card.”
Wang Ping was somewhat greedy in his thoughts.
However, it was just a thought.
Taking this terrifying thing without knowing its origin or how to make it recognize its owner would result in destruction.
The Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm, these two Lower Planes, were instantly annihilated, leaving nothing behind. It was utterly terrifying.
This was only due to the aura emitted by the black spear.
If it were to unleash its full power, it would be unimaginably terrifying.
“I’m starting to suspect that it was not the two Upper Realm beings who deliberately destroyed the two realms, but that they foolishly tried to control the black spear and then met their doom. They died during the rampage of the black spear.”
Wang Ping thought silently.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, his vision changed, and he returned to the Cultivation World where Qin Tian was.
Since he had already absorbed the enlightenment this time, Wang Ping was no longer worried about missing out on the Additional Reward enlightenment.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the Host can choose two of the following rewards as rewards:
.Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation (from reconstruction).
.Purple Talent· Proving Tao by Killing.
.Random Emperor Artifact.
.Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement.”
“Four rewards, huh? Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing…”
Wang Ping looked at the reward options with some greed but still couldn’t choose, only helplessly giving up.
Other than that, Wang Ping felt a bit regretful.
If the Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing’s talent enhancement and attack enhancement could be separated into two individual rewards, that would be perfect.
If that were the case, Wang Ping would definitely choose one of them.
Unfortunately, there are no what-ifs in this world. Once you miss out, you miss out.
“System, I choose .Emperor Realm Great Perfection cultivation and .Random Emperor Artifact.”
Thus, Wang Ping decisively made his choice.
As for the Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement, he didn’t even think twice about it.
Blue Talent is seriously falling behind and choosing it would be a waste of a precious reward option.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: 170: Bursting the Void Lord with a Single Punch! The Mysterious Place_6
chapters.content:
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt that an additional King Artifact had appeared out of thin air in his little world, and his cultivation was also surging.
Although his realm had not changed in the slightest, his mana strength had become many times stronger than before.
Cultivating the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, along with the help of all the precious resources in the Purple Spirit Realm, proved to be overwhelmingly powerful.
“It’s a pity that without the additional damage bonus brought by the Purple Talent, excluding the Pseudo Rules, when I actually did not have a single punch to explode the Blood Demon Clan Void Lord, my combat power was much worse.”
Wang Ping silently compared in his heart.
Of course, even now, by using the divine skills recorded in the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, it would still take him but one punch to destroy a Blood Demon Clan Void Lord.
Now, he truly possessed the power to crush ordinary Void Divine Realm Masters across realms.
However, his perfect foundation and strong combat power also brought new problems.
That is, it would be difficult to have a perfect breakthrough to Quasi-Immortal and Void Divine Realm in the Lower Realm.
The Lower Realm did not possess the resource conditions.
Besides, there was an even bigger problem.
That is, he only had the cultivation method of the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Sutra.
To continue forging a perfect foundation and pave the way to becoming an Emperor, he must find the Emperor Scripture of the Divine Realm Chapter.
Although he said that the first Heavenly Emperor did not practice scriptures before he became Emperor,
Cultivating Emperor Sutra was not a prerequisite for becoming an Emperor, but compared to the cultivators who did not practice Emperor Scriptures, cultivators who did practice Emperor Scriptures had a more solid foundation and a higher probability of growing to higher realms.
At the same time, by practicing various Emperor Scriptures and using them as a foundation, the probability of creating one’s own Emperor Scripture is also greater.
These advantages cannot be ignored.
Next, he must find a way to go to the Upper Realm, and he could only do so by reaching the Emperor Realm Great Perfection.
Otherwise, without the follow-up cultivation methods and corresponding cultivation resources, if he stayed in the Lower Realm, he would truly be stuck at Emperor Realm Great Perfection.
“What’s even worse is that with my cultivation improved, I don’t have many paid simulation opportunities left.”
Wang Ping silently calculated in his heart.
Unless he went mad and killed most of the Emperors in the Purple Spirit Realm, seizing their King Artifacts and Emperor Artifacts, he wouldn’t have many simulation chances left.
However, as long as his own life was not at stake, Wang Ping did not want to commit such a heinous act.
Of course, if his own safety was at risk, he could only apologize. Although he would try his best not to kill these people, he would definitely take their Emperor and King Artifacts.
After all, he would rather sacrifice his friends than himself.
Once the crisis has passed, he would compensate these people adequately.
“Next, it’s time to deal with the weirdness in this world.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he let out a sigh, saying in his heart.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator started, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness swayed, letting him know that the immersive simulation had begun.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping spoke again.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and a luminescent screen appeared, with familiar words emerging.
[On the first day, you discuss how to find the weirdness, but there is no result. In the end, you decide to act secretly, investigating Thunder Realm Holy Land first.]
[After all, with your current strength, it is very easy to conduct an investigation without being discovered by Thunder Realm Holy Land’s cultivators.]
[Next, you begin your actions. However, even after searching all the hidden areas of Thunder Realm Holy Land, you find no trace of the weirdness nor discover anything strange about Thunder Realm Holy Land.]
[You are not surprised by this, as your appearance has already exposed you, and it is impossible for the weirdness to be easily discovered by you.]
[The day after, Thunder Realm Holy Land holds an Immortal Banquet and warmly invites you. You cannot refuse and choose to participate in the banquet. However, being always cautious, you do not eat or drink anything at the banquet.]
[As for Cai Yonglong and the others, they have no scruples and choose to eat. In their eyes, these are all good things that would greatly benefit them if eaten; if they don’t eat, they would miss out on a white feast.]
[Of course, the reason they think this way is that they believe Thunder Realm Holy Land would not poison them openly. If they did, with you around, it would be easy to detoxify and eliminate some people from Thunder Realm Holy Land.]
[You do not stop Wu Jun and the others from eating the things at the Immortal Banquet. To you, finding information is most important; if something were to happen to them, it would actually be a good thing, as it would allow you to catch the tail of the weirdness.]
[If the Supreme Elders of Thunder Realm Holy Land were not foolish, they would not harm you. If something really did happen, it could only be the work of the weirdness.]
[Of course, you also think that the weirdness would not be so foolish as to use such a low-level means to deal with you. Unfortunately, there are no absolutes.]
The text simulation stopped here.
Wang Ping’s eyes were filled with various nectars, and finally, his vision appeared above the Immortal Banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 517: 170: A punch explodes the fake god! Strange place_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Chapter 170: A punch explodes the fake god! Strange place_7
Although Wang Ping appeared to eat and drink, in reality, nothing had entered his body.
To be precise, these cultivators had quietly fallen under the influence of his illusionary divine skills.
After all, having slain so many mysterious entities, Wang Ping would absolutely not expose his own flesh when venturing into other realms, let alone consume anything.
He wouldn’t even make a feigned attempt of pouring something into his mouth and then shifting it away.
He would not allow anything from the Exoteric World, which was teeming with strangeness, to touch his body.
He had no choice but to do this—it was a lesson learned from blood.
“After that deeply meaningful text simulation appeared, did they directly enter an immersive simulation under duress? It seems that there is indeed a problem with this Immortal Banquet, an unexpected development.”
Wang Ping glanced at the attendees of the Immortal Banquet, his brow slightly furrowed.
“If everything goes as expected, the branch options would be eating at the Banquet and not eating. If one eats, problems will most likely arise.”
Wang Ping used his Spiritual Sense once more to investigate the banquet offerings but found nothing.
“I can’t figure out what’s going on. Let’s stick with the ‘not eating’ choice and continue to fast-forward.”
Wang Ping sighed.
[Soon, the Immortal Banquet concluded. You examined Qin Tian and Wu Jun’s bodies in detail and found that they haven’t manifested any abnormalities. On the contrary, their power seemed to have increased, evidently, they gained several benefits from the Immortal Banquet.]
[This left you feeling somewhat conflicted. Afterward, you all continued your silent search for information, but sadly, could not find anything out of the ordinary.]
[In the blink of an eye, fifty years passed. During these fifty years, many things occurred in the Cultivation Realm. Qin Tian’s cultivation steadily increased, reaching the peak of the Integration Realm.]
[But Ye Xiaofan still didn’t converge with you and his whereabouts remained unknown, even you could not locate him.]
[However, as the years passed, you still could not find out what was unusual, which greatly frustrated you. Besides, you cannot simply destroy worlds in this one, forcing the oddity out, like in the past.]
[Because this is the Cultivation Realm, although there aren’t any forces that can contend with you in this lower world, this world is closely linked with the Immortal World. Cultivators can shift from the Immortal World to this one.]
[In other words, if you go too far and act like a World-Destroying Demon Lord, you might provoke a perilously powerful individual.]
[At that time, even you wouldn’t come out unscathed. Sure, you’re powerful, but you’re not invincible. In the Immortal World, there are definitely beings mightier than you, and not just a few.]
[Still, continuing your patient search yielded no results, which left you immensely frustrated.]
[In an instant, another thirty years passed. In these thirty years, you still could not find any anomalies. Just like this world doesn’t have anything odd, it was rather strange.]
[After these thirty years, Qin Tian steadily sailed through the Crossing Tribulation and reached the Great Stage, ready to ascend to the Immortal World at any time.]
[Faced with this, Qin Tian felt helpless, unsure if he should ascend to the Immortal World and become an immortal with an unlimited lifespan.]
