[After thinking it over, you decided to let Qin Tian ascend. You believed that the anomaly might not be in the lower world, but in the Immortal World. If Qin Tian ascends to the Immortal World, perhaps he could bring some valuable information to those of you in the lower world.]
[Qin Tian felt this made sense and chose to ascend to the Immortal World, and thus vanished.]
[You, on the other hand, continued to search for traces of the anomaly in the lower world while waiting for news from Qin Tian.]
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred years passed. You found nothing, not even a hint of abnormality. This caused you to fall silent. You really did not know where the anomaly was hidden or what its abilities were.]
[During your moment of perplexity, you decided to return to the Thunder Realm Holy Land and conduct another search, to see if you had overlooked anything important.]
[Unfortunately, even after returning to the Thunder Realm Holy Land, you found nothing. Finally, with a sigh of helplessness, you left the Thunder Realm Holy Land, and walking outside Mortal City, a thousand miles away from the Thunder Realm Holy Land, in the guise of a mortal. Feeling the mortal atmosphere, you relaxed, something you haven’t done in a long time.]
[It was during this rare moment of relaxation that someone actively came to find you. This person was Ye Xiaofan, who had been missing for many years.]
[At this point, Ye Xiaofan had turned into something akin to a puppet without any consciousness, which shocked and enraged you. After finding you, he asked you to follow him to a place, where ‘it’ was waiting for you.]
[At this, you were filled with suspicion, fear, and a glimmer of joy, for you finally knew where the anomaly was.]

chapters.title: Chapter 518: 171: Two Bizarre! The Doomed World of Cultivation! (Mega Chapter of Ten Thousand Words!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Chapter 171: Two Bizarre! The Doomed World of Cultivation! (Mega Chapter of Ten Thousand Words!)
[It turns out that the strange one is located in this city, running a small shop, which makes you all feel very subtle. When you walk into the shop and see the ordinary-looking strange one, who has no aura and is completely mortal, you become even more astonished.]
[Because it’s the first time the strange one has dared to expose itself voluntarily and invite you over. Moreover, this strange one is the weakest among those you have encountered, at least in terms of its combat power. Perhaps, a slightly trained mortal could defeat it and kill it.]
[However, although you find it strange, you don’t take it lightly. After all, Ye Xiaofan has been turned into a puppet, which shows that the strange one is not simple. Its most powerful attribute is its extremely high-level ability, not its combat power.]
[As you remain on guard, the strange one invites you to sit down and makes tea for all of you. None of you show any intention of drinking. The strange one finds this very dull.]
[Then, the strange one takes the initiative to reveal its ability. Its ability is to turn a shop into a stronghold. This stronghold is invincible, indestructible from the outside and inside alike. At the same time, in this stronghold, he is invincible, and no one can hurt or move him. Of course, he can’t harm his guests with conventional methods either, at most, he can only kick them out.]
[These words make your faces change slightly. It’s the first time the strange one has told you its ability, and if it’s true, it would be quite troublesome because you cannot kill him. And the strange one is obviously capable of dealing with you through unconventional methods.]
[At this, you become cold and try to attack the strange one and the shop. To your silence, even with an attack powerful enough to kill a Void lord, you cannot harm the strange one, let alone destroy anything in the shop.]
[The strange one sees your actions but doesn’t mind, just smiles and says that he forgot to tell you something. As you entered the shop, you must pay a certain price: buying a card from him. In these cards, there are various things, which could be prizes or pitfalls, all depending on luck.]
[Upon hearing the strange one’s words, you all look serious, knowing that he has bad intentions and has been setting traps for you to fall into from the beginning. Yet, you still have to fall into them.]
The text simulation stops there, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, and numerous scenes appear in his mind, finally concentrating on the scene inside the shop.
“What price do we need to pay? How did he become like this?”
Wang Ping’s face is heavy, knowing that it’s time to make a choice, he glances at Ye Xiaofan and speaks in a low voice.
“Him? If I told you that I saved his life, would you believe me?”
The strange one says with a profound meaning.
“What do you mean?”
Wang Ping frowns.
Wu Jun and others also show surprise.
“When he came to this city, he had already been cursed, and though he became a puppet now, without my help, his soul would have been transformed long ago.”
The strange one says calmly.
“Curse?”
Wang Ping’s eyelids jump.
To be honest, Ye Xiaofan hadn’t been active for some time.
He was being hunted down before, so could it be the one who hunted him down had a hand in this?
However, what is soul transmutation?
“By the way, apart from you, everyone around you has also been cursed, and their souls have been transformed. Especially this kid, he is in the worst situation.”
The strange one looks calmly at Wang Ping, scans Chen Kang and others, and finally points to Chen Kang, before slowly speaking.
“What? I am also cursed? And I’m in the worst situation? Why don’t I feel anything at all?”
Chen Kang points at himself, feeling a little creepy.
“Hehe, it would be strange if you did feel something.”
The strange one scoffs.
“Stop playing games, tell us what’s going on?”
Chen Kang eagerly asks.
“My shop is very fair. If you want to know or get something, you need to pay the appropriate price and have a certain amount of luck.”
The strange one takes out a deck of cards, puts it on the table, and speaks slowly.
“If you want to know something, use your ‘money’ to buy cards, and the cards will reveal the truth. Of course, you might also buy some ‘bad cards’, in which case you’ll be miserable.”
Wang Ping remains silent, staring intensely at the strange one.
Then, he looks back at Ye Xiaofan.
In the simulation, the existence of the chat group is watered down, so they can’t contact each other through the chat group.
In other words, Ye Xiaofan can’t contact them in reality.
So after he was brought to the shop by the strange one, he was ensnared by the strange one’s tricks.
He became a puppet due to the strange one’s ability but also because he himself bought a card and took a risk on something.
“How troublesome.”
Wang Ping sighs.
Yes, it’s very troublesome.
For Wang Ping, dealing with this mysterious and unpredictable strange one, who cannot be defeated by combat or simulation, and relies on luck, is the most difficult part.
Honestly, all these things remind Wang Ping of the main characters in some Myriad Heavens novel themes about running sinister shops in his previous life.
It’s just that those main characters are ruthless but not as dangerous as this strange one.

chapters.title: Chapter 519: 171: Two Strange Instances! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Chapter 171: Two Strange Instances! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
No wonder this eerie figure dared to approach them actively, it was because he could only deal with them in this way.
“So, do you want to buy the cards and learn what you want to know?”
The bizarre figure gently enticed.
Facing the gentle persuasion, Chen Kang and the others were somewhat silent.
“You said that besides me, everyone else has encountered problems. In other words, there is something wrong with the Spiritual Energy, Spirit Fruits and cultivation resources of this world, right? That’s why you only possessed an ordinary person, not a powerful cultivator.”
Wang Ping looked at the strange figure, his eyes sharp and piercing, speaking the truth directly.
That was not a difficult guess.
He was the only one without issues, while everyone else had problems? Chen Kang was even the most seriously affected.
What was their difference?
From entering this world, Wang Ping had not absorbed any Spiritual Energy from this world, nor eaten anything from it.
So, he was safe and sound.
On the other hand, Chen Kang, Wu Jun, Chen Si, and Cai Yonglong had all consumed Spirit Fruits from this world over the years.
Chen Kang especially, he had been cultivating enthusiastically over these years.
His cultivation talent was surprisingly good.
As a result, with the help of everyone, he had no shortage of cultivation resources from the Cultivation Realm and had advanced his cultivation to the Primordial Infant Realm.
The higher the cultivation, the deeper the affliction; this was undoubtedly an unusual situation.
So, Wang Ping could only think that everything was wrong with the Spiritual Energy of this world, so the cultivators who had absorbed Spiritual Energy and eaten Spirit Fruit all had problems.
Everything related to Spiritual Energy was a pitfall.
Under such circumstances, Wang Ping thought of some bizarre cultivation themes he had seen before.
“Hehe, you’re very smart, you guessed correctly. Indeed, there is something wrong with the spiritual energy of this world, as long as you use something related to it, there will be problems.”
The bizarre figure laughed sinisterly.
Hearing these words, Cai Yonglong and others felt their scalp tingle and their hearts tremble.
“Was this your doing?”
Chen Kang’s face turned ugly as he clenched his fists.
“Fool, I’ve already told you my abilities at the beginning, how could I do such a thing?”
The eerie figure scoffed and leisurely took a sip of his cold tea.
“If it’s not you, then who is it?”
Chen Kang didn’t believe it and gritted his teeth in anger.
He didn’t believe the strange figure’s words.
“Compared to your leader, you guys are really dumb.”
The bizarre figure sighed.
These words annoyed Chen Kang and the others.
“It’s just that they’re caught in the situation. No one can remain calm once they know they’ve been cursed.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly to appease Chen Kang and the others.
“Oh? It seems that you’ve already guessed the truth.”
Wang Ping’s performance made the strange figure laugh and speak.
“In this world, there exists another bizarre figure, right?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and uttered these words.
Upon hearing this statement, Wu Jun and the others instantly understood everything, feeling their scalps tingle and their hearts chill.
One world had two strange figures, that was too bizarre.
And the other one was obviously more dangerous and had grown even more.
“You’re right. In this world, there’s another mysterious figure.”
The strange figure chuckled and admired Wang Ping, without any intention of hiding the truth.
“Do bizarre figures not get along with each other? You seem quite happy to expose the other one. You even want him dead.”
Wang Ping stared at the strange figure in front of him with sharp eyes and slowly spoke.
“Bizarre figures are all solitary individuals. Apart from those truly big shots, none of us who haven’t grown yet would submit to each other. In fact, we are competitors, wishing for the death of our peers.”
The shop’s strange figure grinned and spoke emotionlessly.
“I came to this world first. Originally, I had set a trap and was about to succeed in destroying this lower realm before leaving. However, that guy appeared. He unreasonably polluted this world, ruining everything I had done, forcing me to stay in this world.”
The shop’s strange figure spoke calmly, revealing the truth.
“Moreover, in order not to be polluted, I had no choice but to abandon my original body and possess a mortal. So, I’m quite unhappy with him. If you can kill him for me, it would be the best thing for me.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he finally learned a piece of information.
Bizarre figures not getting along was a normal situation.
If bizarre figures got along well, that would be terrible.
Of course, it’s also possible that the bizarre figure in front of them was using a smoke screen.
“We can cooperate. You tell me where that Bizarre figure is, and I’ll help you get rid of him.”
All sorts of thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he spoke.
“Get rid of him? Please, I do hope you can help me get rid of him, but you can’t. Your strength is far from enough.”
The shop’s eerie figure looked at Wang Ping with strange eyes, laughing.
“I see, he’s gone to the Immortal World, and he’s even polluted the Immortal World, hasn’t he?”
Wang Ping frowned, quickly thinking of a possibility.
“Hehe, that’s right. All cultivators in this world have been doomed. What makes you think you can deal with him?”
The shop’s bizarre figure shrugged indifferently.
Hearing this, Wu Jun and the others felt chills in their hearts.
Wang Ping also furrowed his brows and fell into silence.
This was the first time he had encountered a bizarre figure who had polluted an entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 520: 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Chapter 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
The Cultivation Realm is not weak, and there must be many strong practitioners in the Immortal World.
However, since even the Immortal World has perished, there seems to be no salvation.
The bizarre creature has grown to such a level that it is no longer comparable to the seedlings Wang Ping encountered before; it’s very challenging.
Unless he is capable of destroying the entire world, it would be possible to kill this terrifying bizarre creature completely.
Of course, even if he could destroy the world, he might not be able to kill the creature because it has already contaminated the world and could leave at any moment.
“You should be grateful that you haven’t absorbed a single bit of Spiritual Energy from this world. Otherwise, you’d be finished, and the world you live in will follow.”
The shop bizarre chuckled as it revealed this terrifying fact.
Wang Ping remained silent.
Neither the shop bizarre nor the bizarre that polluted the Immortal World can be defeated. Their mission to this world seems meaningless.
“Can you show me the real side of this world right now?”
Wang Ping looked at the shop bizarre and asked this question.
“Pay the price, draw a card, and you might get what you desire.”
The shop bizarre pointed at its spread-out deck of cards on the table, suggesting mysteriously.
“Mr.Wang, allow me.”
Seeing this, Chen Kang gritted his teeth and spoke up.
“Since we’re already tainted, it would be more reasonable for us to do it.”
“Alright.” Wang Ping didn’t refuse and nodded.
“To see the true side of this world now, you need to pay all your strength as the price to draw a card. Are you willing?”
The shop bizarre chuckled.
“I’m… willing.” Chen Kang hesitated for a moment but finally agreed to the trade.
“Very good.”
The shop bizarre nodded in satisfaction.
Then, Chen Kang visibly aged significantly and lost his mighty power.
Without his cultivation supporting him, he would inevitably become older, even though his lifespan was still much longer than ordinary people.
Chen Kang felt his weak state and bitterly smiled. He glanced at the many cards and randomly picked one.
“I’m sorry, it seems like your luck isn’t that great. Congratulations on drawing the Doll Card, you’ll be transformed into a doll.”
The shop bizarre looked at Chen Kang pityingly.
Hearing this, the faces of Chen Kang and the others changed.
Immediately after, Chen Kang’s body twisted, and he became a ragdoll that fell to the ground.
“Next, who else wants to try?”
The shop bizarre looked at Wang Ping and the others.
“I’ll do it. However, I want to make a change to what I want. I want to save my brother.”
Chen Si mustered her courage.
“Such touching sibling love, of course, that’s possible.”
The shop bizarre nodded.
Then, Chen Si drew a card. Unfortunately, she still drew a bad card. Although she didn’t turn into a ragdoll, she became a puppet like Ye Xiaofan.
This left Wu Jun and Cai Yonglong silent.
“Want to continue?”
The shop bizarre studied Wang Ping and the others with burning eyes.
“Wu Jun, use your ability.”
Wang Ping ignored the shop bizarre and looked at Wu Jun.
Wu Jun has a bug-level ability that can bring about miracles, so they don’t necessarily have to purchase dangerous cards from the shop bizarre.
Previously, Wang Ping deliberately let Chen Kang and Chen Si test out the cards’ effects.
Now, it seems that there are too many traps among the bizarre.
“Okay!”
Wu Jun took a deep breath and directly used his Golden Finger·Unstable Factor ability.
However, Wu Jun’s ability didn’t bring about any miracles this time, either. It didn’t trigger a deadly effect on the bizarre or any powerful buff.
He only activated one not-so-important possibility: Chen Si and Ye Xiaofan, who had turned into puppets, regained consciousness.
Ye Xiaofan, after regaining consciousness, was first stunned and then bitterly smiled as she thanked Wu Jun.
“Interesting ability.”
The shop bizarre looked at Wu Jun with surprise and commented.
“How about a deal? You pawn your ability to me, and I’ll give you the ability to see the truth directly.”
The shop bizarre smirked.
His words made Wu Jun’s face change. If he were to give his ability to the bizarre, it would be unimaginable.
Moreover, this was the first time they encountered a bizarre creature capable of stripping away their abilities.
This bizarre creature, which seemed harmless-looking, was far more dangerous than any they had encountered before.
“Cai, don’t pay attention to the bizarre. Just draw the cards and try to flip all of them at once. Remember, use your ability at a critical moment.”
Wang Ping looked at Cai Yonglong and whispered.
“Alright.”
Cai Yonglong gritted his teeth.
Then, he drew the cards as well.
However, what stiffened the shop bizarre’s face was that he chose to flip all the cards at once.
In an instant, various “bad cards” appeared. Among the remaining twenty or so cards, only one card was what they needed, and a few harmless cards were mixed in. The proportion of bad cards was horrifying.
Nevertheless, when the effects of these bad cards and the corresponding price he had to pay manifested, he chose to use his Golden Finger·Absolute Defense to protect himself.
It’s no doubt that Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger·Absolute Defense was indeed powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 521: 171: Two Strangeness! The Already Doomed Immortal World! (A Massive 10,000-word Chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Chapter 171: Two Strangeness! The Already Doomed Immortal World! (A Massive 10,000-word Chapter!) _4
The potential of such a special ability that the Golden Finger possesses is really high, much higher than what Wang Ping initially predicted.
Although the protection time is very short, the deep black fog in the Primordial Forbidden Land can’t breach the defense.
Now, even when confronted with a bizarre ability, it is fully defended as well.
The effect of the bizarre ability indeed entered Cai Yonglong’s body, but didn’t take effect, as if a large amount of control effects meeting a person invincible and unfazed, it was all for naught.
However, the effect of augmentations, was in effect.
Cai Yonglong gained a power, known as the Eye of Truth.
“You bastard, you cheated!”
Confusion spat out blood and started to curse at Cai Yonglong.
Damn it, he’s been a crafty businessman for many years and never had his wool shorn. Now, his enemies are shearing his wool, damn it, it’s infuriating!
“Cheating? What cheating? Haven’t I also paid the price? It just so happens that your powers can’t touch me, is this my fault?”
Cai Yonglong looked at Confusion, expressing his innocence.
“I TM….”
Confusion’s shop exploded in anger.
Damn, who knew there would be someone who could be immune to his power, isn’t it cheating?
“So many cards, most are bad ones, there’s only one good card, and you dare to accuse us of cheating.”
Wang Ping also spoke up and scoffed.
Through Confusion’s reaction, he understood that although Confusion’s power was peculiar, there were also certain rules he could not change.
For instance, he could not take back the cards that had been given out as rewards.
Otherwise, there would be no need for him to be furious, he could simply take back the power Cai Yonglong received.
Confusion gave a cold snort and said: “Fine, consider the Eye of Truth as my gift to you. Also, kindly informing you, the ability of the Eye of Truth can be shared with others.”
At the end, Confusion once again displayed a cunning and sinister expression.
“Cai, use your ability, let us see what this world truly looks like.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and spoke to Cai Yonglong.
“I understand.”
Cai Yonglong’s eyes flashed as he looked at Wang Ping and the others.
Then, Wang Ping and the rest felt a slight coolness in their eyes.
Immediately after, Wang Ping’s vision changed.
He saw the abnormalities in the souls of Cai Yonglong and Wu Jun, their souls were no longer their own bodies, all transformed into monsters that twisted and wriggled, emitting ominous vibes.
The spiritual energy flowing within Cai Yonglong and Wu Jun was no longer the purity Wang Ping initially saw, but rather disgusting creatures with compound eyes or indescribable sludge.
This was not only disgusting, but it also emitted an ominous aura, making one feel that their eyes and souls were contaminated.
“Gag….”
Due to the extreme disgust and the inability to accept the transformation of her own soul, Chen Si, the girl, was the first to vomit tremendously.
However, due to her being a strong cultivator previously, she hadn’t eaten for a long time. Even though she lost her cultivation now, her physical body is no longer mortal, she is a spiritual body, closely related to spiritual energy.
Therefore, what she vomited out was also an indescribable worm-like object.
Cai Yonglong and others weren’t faring any better, their faces pale, they felt extremely sick, even had the impulse to commit suicide.
“It’s indeed disgusting.”
Wang Ping was also not calm, and finally understood why Confusion had a cunning and menacing expression.
Because seeing the real side of this world after opening the Eye of Truth is not a fortunate thing, on the contrary, it is unfortunate.
The feeling of seeing your own soul turn into a monster is enough to drive people crazy.
Even powerful beings like Wang Ping who has not yet been corrupted, also felt as if they were spiritually contaminated, it was extremely uncomfortable.
Wang Ping didn’t say much, he stepped out of Confusion’s shop, heading outside.
Then, he saw that the air was no longer filled with pure spiritual energy, but also various types of sludge, insects, and indescribable things.
The occasional cultivators in the city were in the same situation as Cai Yonglong and the others.
This was just weak cultivators, he couldn’t even imagine what these powerful cultivators looked like after being corrupted.
Wang Ping silently tore through space, arriving at Thunder Realm Holy Land.
At Thunder Realm Holy Land, coincidentally an Immortal Banquet was underway, and all the powerful Ancestors were present.
Then, what he saw was no longer the cultivators with celestial demeanor, but monsters that were so corrupted that even Wang Ping felt sick.
The rare and exotic treasures, spiritual water, spirit fruit, spiritual rice at the banquet, were also indescribable objects.
The richer the spiritual energy contained, the more disgusting it was, harboring ominous and terrifying contamination.
Now that Wang Ping was seeing it, looking at the corrupted Ancestors of Thunder Realm Holy Land on the banquet, his stomach was churning, he was extremely uncomfortable, simultaneously feeling as if his soul was polluted.
This was just some cultivators, who were not at the tribulation-crossing stage, it was leaving him, a practitioner of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, a Void Lord slayer, feeling this uncomfortable and polluted.
It is unthinkable, what has the Immortal World now become… it might be an all-out melee with demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 522: 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Chapter 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _5
“Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan are both done for.”
Wang Ping sighed, feeling heavy-hearted.
Until he can solve the strangeness of this world, they cannot be saved.
Unless Wu Jun’s golden finger brings a miracle, such a thing can only depend on luck. There are too many possibilities in the world, and no one knows when the chance of purifying the pollution on them can be triggered.
Other than that, Wang Ping also remembered that Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan had been to other worlds to participate in group tasks before.
If there are issues with their spiritual energy, then… have the worlds they had visited also encountered problems?
Wang Ping felt a chill in his heart.
The current situation was unsolvable.
Wang Ping could only hope that the strangeness had not yet appeared before they came to this world, and that the two had not been polluted.
However, this possibility was very low.
Because when Wang Ping had just arrived in this world, he was directly immersed in a simulation state.
The Immortal Banquet at that time had already gone wrong.
This showed that the strangeness that polluted the Immortal World had already descended, and everyone had been affected.
It’s not such a big deal for other worlds. Chen Yao and Zhao Sihan’s world, however, contained spiritual energy.
The strangeness polluted the spiritual energy.
What have these two worlds become?
Then, what have the worlds Qin Tian and Chen Yao visited during their missions become?
This seemed to have formed a chain reaction.
Wang Ping’s face looked somewhat unpleasant.
He was glad that Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan had not been to his world.
Otherwise, he would be done for as well.
Not encountering the bizarre shopkeeper and learning about these things, he would have been affected without a sound and unknowingly met his end.
Breathing deeply, Wang Ping forced himself to calm down before leaving Thunder Realm Holy Land and returning to the bizarre shopkeeper’s shop.
“How is it? Do you regret unlocking the view of the Eye of Truth?”
The bizarre shopkeeper said with a smile.
“Sometimes, it’s a blessing not to be able to see the true state of the world.”
Cai Yonglong and the others looked ugly, unable to speak.
They still couldn’t accept the fact that they had become monsters.
“True bizarre cultivation, as you said, neither my companions nor this world can be saved.”
Wang Ping spoke slowly.
“That’s why I said, you wanting to help me eliminate him is utterly delusional.” The bizarre shopkeeper sneered while lying on the table.
“This kind of strangeness, if not wiped out from the beginning, the invaded world will eventually come to an end. This guy, after polluting one world after another, will grow into a dominating, bizarre boss across all heavens.”
“Honestly, it is the first time I have encountered such a strangeness that would say these things to us.”
Wang Ping sat down and said.
“I am curious, what is the situation within the strangeness? Do you have contact with each other? What is the hierarchical system among you strange beings?”
“Please, although I told you a lot of things out of interest and wanted you to be desperate, do you really think I’m a talkative weirdo or a traitor to the strangeness?”
The bizarre shopkeeper rolled his eyes and retorted.
“Your mission is simply to destroy the living beings of this lower realm, right? I can help you destroy them, and then you can leave, can’t you?”
Wang Ping didn’t care about the bizarre shopkeeper’s retort and continued to tempt him.
“Heh, I can leave whenever I want.” The bizarre shopkeeper pursed his lips, showing no intention of being tempted by Wang Ping.
“Moreover, if you really take action, you’re dead. Although I don’t care if you live or die, the enemy of my enemy is a friend, so it’s better for you to be alive.”
“You’re certainly straightforward.”
Wang Ping sighed.
He couldn’t trick him, making things a bit difficult.
“Speaking of which, you said you can leave whenever you want? Then why don’t you leave this world?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, as if thinking of something, and said with an ambiguous smile.
“Based on my previous experiences dealing with you strange beings, your mission is to exterminate all living beings. If you don’t achieve a certain extent in destroying living beings, you cannot forcefully leave, right?”
Wang Ping wasn’t sure if his guess was correct, but it was definitely worth a try.
“Uh…”
The bizarre shopkeeper’s expression stiffened slightly, although he quickly recovered, but Wang Ping, with his cultivation, had already captured it in an instant.
Because of this, he gained another piece of information.
For the strangeness to forcefully leave the invaded world, they must complete their mission to a certain level, or else they cannot leave.
So, this bizarre shopkeeper could only hate the pollution strangeness so much, as the guy had taken his mission, ruined his plan, and left him unable to leave this world.
As long as the pollution strangeness does not choose to destroy the living beings of this lower realm, he will never be able to leave.
And will the pollution strangeness destroy it?
No, it has already made this Cultivation Great World its foundation and would never destroy it.
So, this bizarre shopkeeper has been truly locked in this world.
His most tragic fate would probably be seizing a mortal’s body to live on every once in a while.
After all, mortals grow old.
Of course, it is not ruled out that he could survive with a mortal body.
But that would be miserable.
A strangeness with the potential to dominate all heavens, to be locked up in a world so miserably, and to be betrayed by the same kind, it was really too tragic, too suffocating.

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 523 - 171: Two Peculiarities! The Doomed Cultivation Realm! (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
"What's the point of saying all this? You can't destroy this world without dying yourself. And there's no way for me to help you deal with him here."
Shop Strange looked at Wang Ping with irritation, unhappy that he had been called out on his own shortcomings, and snorted coldly.
"You don't have a way? Isn't your power the ability to grant wishes? What if I ask you to generate a purifying force? Can't it be done?"
Wang Ping squinted his eyes, not believing Shop Strange's words, and spoke slowly.
Father used to say, you need magic to fight magic.
Now is the time to make use of the Strange to fight the Strange.
"Ha, you make it sound so easy. My power has rules. You have to pay the corresponding price in order to generate the power to fight him, and you clearly can't afford it."
Shop Strange sneered.
"How much World Source do I need to fight him?"
Wang Ping asked slowly.
"World Source!?"
Upon hearing the words "World Source," Shop Strange was instantly invigorated, rubbing his hands together and giggling.
"If you want to use World Source to generate power, it's not impossible. But, at least this much?"
As Shop Strange said this, he held up one finger.
"How much is that?"
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow.
Damn it, without the connection to Alpha in the life simulation, he had no idea what the unit of World Source was now.
Group points clearly didn't apply in this situation.
"One thousand jin of World Source. Also, you can't let your companions cheat during the trade, they have to draw cards fairly."
Shop Strange grinned and spoke.
"Heh, do you think I'm an idiot?"
Wang Ping sneered.
Although Wang Ping didn't know how many Group points were equal to one thousand jin of World Source, it would definitely not be a small amount. It was clear that this guy saw him as easy prey.
"Take it or leave it."
Shop Strange pursed his lips, looking at him like he was born poor.
Wang Ping's temples throbbed, wanting to slap this guy on the spot.
However, Wang Ping seemed to remember something and directly used his power to reach out to Shop Strange.
Unfortunately, Wang Ping's power dissipated the moment it touched Shop Strange.
"What, if you can't pay, then you want to use force? Like I said before, in the shop, I am invincible."
Shop Strange sneered.
"And, by the way, let me remind you. As I have said before, everyone who enters the shop must draw a card. And you haven't drawn yet."
"Is there no way to forcibly hold you? It seems we need some unconventional methods."
Wang Ping didn't pay heed to Shop Strange's words, frowned slightly, and thought to himself.
"If I want you to sleep with a woman, can this wish be included in the cards?"
Wang Ping looked at Strange and said calmly.
"Pfft."
At Wang Ping's words, Chen Kang, Ye Xiaofan, Chen Si, and Wu Jun were all stunned.
Mr. Wang, this is too audacious, isn't it?
What a bizarre wish.
"Are you serious?"
Shop Strange asked with an amused expression.
"Of course, I'm serious."
Wang Ping spoke calmly, and all you need to do is answer me if it's possible or not.
"Of course, as long as I can accept your wish and it's within the range of my abilities, I can grant it in the form of a card. Once you draw that card, whether I like it or not, I have to do it."
Shop Strange nodded and said.
"But I need you to add one more thing. It must be done in the shop. I will never leave the shop."
Shop Strange said seriously.
"Heh, of course, it will be in the shop."
Wang Ping said meaningfully.
"Well, let's get you started with the card drawing. Your wish is pretty low-grade, so you don't have to pay any hefty price. I'll just randomly draw a little of their cultivation. However, if you draw a bad card, you'll have your hands full with the curse. I'm really looking forward to you becoming my puppet."
Shop Strange spoke sinisterly.
Wang Ping didn't say much and chose to draw a card directly.
He had terrible luck, drawing the card that would turn him into a puppet.
Then, under the excited gaze of Shop Strange, Wang Ping gradually lost consciousness.
At that moment, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text simulation also appeared.
[Ding, because you have turned into a puppet and lost your soul, the simulation ends here.]
With the appearance of these words, Wang Ping suddenly awoke and was freed from the immersive simulation.
"Phew..."
After Wang Ping regained his senses, he took a deep breath.
The feeling of losing one's soul was incredibly strange and palpitation-inducing, enough to make even the current him feel apprehensive.
Fortunately, it was just a simulation; if it were real, he would have had to rely on Wu Jun's golden finger to save him.
However, Wu Jun's golden finger could not always randomly rescue souls.
"Mr. Wang, how did it go?"
Seeing Wang Ping recover, Qin Tian asked worriedly.
"I found a way to kill Strange."
Wang Ping glanced at Qin Tian and replied.
Upon hearing this, everyone showed expressions of delight.
"However..."
Wang Ping hesitated and looked at Qin Tian again.
Right now, Chen Kang, Cai Yonglong, Chen Si, and Wu Jun had not absorbed the Spiritual Energy and were still relying on their own energy to protect themselves.
But Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan were already in deep trouble.
"What 'however'+"
Qin Tian felt a knot in his heart.
"Sigh, Qin Tian, your and Ye Xiaofan's situation is really bad."
Wang Ping sighed and detailed the content of the simulation.
Upon hearing this, everyone's faces changed, and they felt a wave of nausea based on Wang Ping's description.
Qin Tian was especially pale, shocked to the core.
Had he really fallen into the trap?
How could this be possible?
"One world, two Stranges, and one of them has grown into a big boss, it's too dangerous..."
Cai Yonglong looked at Qin Tian with pity and sighed.
"Am I... am I going to die?"
Qin Tian's eyes lost their focus.
"You won't die. You'll just become an indescribable monster that even you won't know."
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
"That's even worse than dying." Qin Tian's mental state collapsed.
Everyone else fell silent, silently thickening their energy barrier to protect themselves, preventing the absorption of any outer world Spiritual Energy and the possibility of contact with it.
"Alpha, Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan have been affected by Strange's power. Can't you detect it? Also, they've been to worlds with Spiritual Energy. Are other worlds contaminated too?"
As Qin Tian was collapsing, Wang Ping quietly asked Alpha in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 524: 172: The Upper World Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Chapter 172: The Upper World Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)
“Don’t worry, during the process of traversing worlds, your bodies will undergo multiple layers of filtration and purification. Any curses or harmful viruses you carry will be completely cleansed.”
After Wang Ping asked, the cold voice of Alpha sounded.
Hearing this answer, Wang Ping finally relaxed.
It seemed that, although the strange powers were dangerous, they were not unsolvable. The chat group system had countermeasures.
His previous worries were unnecessary.
Speaking of which, he once asked Qin Tian for the Array Plate of the Cultivation Realm.
If there were problems, the Purple Spirit Realm and he would have been finished long ago.
“Why didn’t you tell me such important things earlier?”
Wang Ping seemed to have thought of something and said angrily.
If he had known about this mechanism earlier, he wouldn’t have been so bothered in the past, struggling with various headaches.
“If I tell you everything, will there be a chance to train you?”
Alpha said coldly.
“I don’t want you to become overly dependent on me because there might be times in the future when I won’t be able to help.”
“Uh….”
Wang Ping was silent and had nothing to say.
“Forget it, I don’t want to bother with you.” Wang Ping stubbornly muttered in his heart, then looked at Qin Tian and the others.
“Don’t worry, I consulted the chat group system, and the contamination issue isn’t a big deal. As long as you go to other worlds, you’ll be automatically purified.”
Wang Ping patted Qin Tian’s shoulder and spoke.
“Oh, that’s good, that’s good.”
Qin Tian wiped the cold sweat on his forehead and exhaled in relief.
“Mr. Cai, you once died in the Swordsman World where Fang Yun was. After your resurrection, you were neither rejected nor sent back to your original world. Instead, you went back voluntarily, right? If so, theoretically, if I commit suicide in another world, I can stay there forever, right?”
Then, as if Qin Tian thought of something, he asked expectantly.
“Uh… It should be like that. You’re not trying to escape this world by killing yourself, are you?”
Cai Yonglong’s gaze became subtle.
“Of course I have to. How can I not? This world is so dangerous, if I don’t run, I’ll be waiting for death. Even though the process of going to the other world may purify me, who knows if this thing will be completely detonated, and then I’ll become an indescribable monster. Once I become a monster, it’s uncertain whether I can return to my original state.”
Qin Tian said with a frustrated face.
“You can’t escape this world.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
“Why?”
Qin Tian looked at Wang Ping in shock.
“The chat group won’t allow you to leave.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Joking aside, if Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan both left, the chat group wouldn’t be able to extract World Source from this world.
Although the situation in this world was bad, it shouldn’t be completely hopeless as described by the mysterious shop.
Otherwise, the chat group wouldn’t arrange traversers to come to this world to extract wool.
Since it was possible to extract wool, it means that Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Great World was still struggling, still seeking help, and still had some hope.
However, it was unknown how much longer the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Great World could struggle.
Over a hundred years later, it might be fine, but any longer, it could be completely gameOver.
“Why won’t the chat group let me leave?”
Qin Tian’s face was stiff, unable to understand.
Damn, this broken world was clearly problematic, and the chat group wouldn’t let him leave, so wasn’t it sending him to his death?
“There are many things the chat group doesn’t allow me to say. But at this point, I have to tell you some things.”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment and spoke.
“The chat group arranges traversers to go to various worlds to collect ‘protection fees’. If the traversers run away, will these worlds still pay protection fees? It’s definitely impossible. Group points and the like are just the rewards for us traversers to share.”
Wang Ping couldn’t say more, so he could only make obscure analogies.
“Huh? Protection fees? Damn, I’m just a weakling, who can I protect? It’s already nice if others don’t protect me.”
Qin Tian’s face twitched, and he said speechlessly.
“Whether you’re strong or not is not important. What’s important is that you belong to the chat group, equivalent to an envoy, representing the chat group. That’s enough.”
Wang Ping shook his head and slowly spoke.
Qin Tian fell silent.
Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, Chen Kang, and Chen Si also heard about this for the first time and were silent.
Honestly, people in the group could basically guess some of the chat group’s operating mechanisms. It’s just that Wang Ping had blatantly exposed this mechanism today, and spoke even more realistically.
“Hey, I thought I would become superior after traversing, but I’m still just a worker, just a high-level one.”
Cai Yonglong muttered, trying to enliven the atmosphere.
Wu Jun and Chen Kang couldn’t help but smile bitterly.
Damn, it’s too real.
They had just changed from Earth OL poor players to more difficult All Heavens OL bodyguard players.
“One of you, either you or Ye Xiaofan, should be able to leave this world. However, your talent dictates that it’s better for you to stay in this world. Unless a new Cultivation World emerges, your Immortal Tao Fruits can continue to exert their effect.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and continued.
“I’m a bit curious whether your Immortal Tao Fruits are aimed solely at the immortal realm of this world, or at the concept of an immortal. As long as it is a world with an immortal realm, you can easily become an immortal in that world. If that’s the case, it would be pretty awesome if you went to a world like the Primordial Chaos.”

chapters.title: Chapter 525: 172: The Upper World’s Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Chapter 172: The Upper World’s Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
“Um…” Qin Tian hesitated and struggled to say, “There’s still one person who can leave, so let me discuss with Ye Xiaofan.”
Wang Ping made a lot of sense. His golden finger could only be used in the Cultivation World. If he left, his golden finger would be useless.
As for changing the golden finger, he was really reluctant.
Who knows what the next golden finger would be? If he drew an ordinary one like Zhang Yueying’s, it would be a disaster.
After all, he had optimized his golden finger once now.
It had transformed from Immortal Tao Fruit to True Immortal Tao Fruit, which was even stronger.
If what Mr.Wang said was true, going to a powerful Cultivation World, especially the Primordial Chaos, would be amazing.
He really couldn’t bear to change his golden finger.
However, staying in this world was also terrifying for him.
So, leaving while keeping his golden finger was the best choice.
Although, doing so would result in losing the ability to quickly become stronger.
“You still want to escape.”
Wang Ping shook his head, not surprised by Qin Tian’s decision.
“I have no choice but to escape. No one can stay here,” Qin Tian bitterly smiled.
“Indeed, no one can stay. Even I’m afraid of this world.”
Wang Ping nodded, understanding Qin Tian’s thoughts.
He had always thought that the Purple Spirit Realm he was in had the highest difficulty for conquering.
Now that he had come to the Cultivation Realm, he felt that Qin Tian might be in an even worse situation.
“Alpha, can you consider bringing one or two newcomers to this world? Given the current situation in this world, it’s not appropriate to keep Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan, two promising talents, here. It’s better to bring in newcomers,” Wang Ping thought and then had a conversation with Alpha in his mind.
He was more concerned about the lives of his old group members like Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian than how newcomers would fare when they crossed into this world.
Unless the newcomer showed enough value, Wang Ping would protect them.
“I’ll consider it.”
Alpha seemed to think for a while before giving a reply.
She only needed a traveler to stay in this Cultivation Great World. The strength of the group members didn’t make much difference before reaching a certain level.
“Your main goal in this group task isn’t to eliminate the pollution bizarreness, but the shop bizarreness. Killing it and showing the Cultivation Great World that we can eliminate bizarre threats is crucial. So, don’t think about trading with the bizarre; you’ll only fall into their traps,” Alpha reminded after a pause.
“Don’t worry, I had thought about that before. Moreover, I’ve already thought of a way to deal with the shop bizarreness,” Wang Ping’s eyes flashed as he spoke in his mind.
He hadn’t thought that the bizarre polluting the Cultivation Great World was their target this time.
Although Alpha was a bit stupid, the task she arranged was within their ability to tackle, dealing with underdeveloped bizarre minions.
Alpha:
Alpha was silent. It seemed Wang Ping was paying less and less attention to her, openly calling her stupid.
“Forget it, he’s my chosen agent after all. I shouldn’t stoop to his level,” Alpha comforted herself and went silent.
“Qin Tian, don’t worry too much. After all, nothing happened over a hundred years. Just now, I negotiated with the chat group, bragging that you and Ye Xiaofan are both promising talents and should not be placed in danger. So, I suggested that the chat group send one or two newcomers to this world, allowing you to go to other worlds,” Wang Ping said, drawing his attention back to Qin Tian and trying to win him over.
Even though Wang Ping’s prestige was already high in Qin Tian’s eyes, he didn’t mind getting more.
No one would complain about having too much prestige after all.
“Mr.Wang, thank you so much! You’re like my real father!” Qin Tian, excited to the extreme, hugged Wang Ping with tears in his eyes.
Damn, Mr.Wang is so reliable!
With Wang Ping’s support, he would be fine!
“Get away, go away,” Wang Ping disgustedly kicked Qin Tian away.
If Qin Tian was a beauty, it would have been fine, but hugging a big guy like that was really disgusting.
“Well, Mr.Wang has another ‘son.’”
Seeing this scene, Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but make a comment.
This remark caused Chen Kang, Chen Si, and Wu Jun’s expressions to become subtle.
Afterward, Wang Ping and the others didn’t waste more time and directly shared the situation of Qin Tian’s world in the chat group.
For a moment, Ye Xiaofan was rendered speechless.
The people in the group were also dumbfounded, not expecting the situation in Qin Tian’s world to be so terrible.
Everyone once again confirmed that the bizarre they had dealt with before were really just small fries. Faced with the bizarre who had developed and polluted the Cultivation Great World, everyone could only feel their scalp tingling and want to flee as far away as possible.
Perhaps the solution to the bizarre in the Cultivation Great World would involve destroying the entire Cultivation Great World along with it.
But destroying such a world would require unimaginable strength.
Wang Ping (66)  Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Yuanyuan, come to Qin Tian’s world. The shop bizarreness needs you to solve it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 526: 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Chapter 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_3
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Okay, give me permission, I’m coming right now.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Good fellow, you’ve slept with the Pope Weirdo, are you going to sleep with the Shop Weirdo now? Lin Yuanyuan sure is a weirdo killer.”
Fang Yun (3): “What else can I say, big respect. But being killed by a beauty like Lin Yuanyuan, the weirdos are quite romantic even in death. Ridiculous.jpg.”
Chen Yao (71):
Wang Ping ignored the chattering group members and quietly waited for Lin Yuanyuan’s arrival.
Soon, with a flash of white light, Lin Yuanyuan appeared in this world.
“Mr. Wang.”
After Lin Yuanyuan arrived, she smiled respectfully at Wang Ping.
“Let’s go. We don’t need to wait for Ye Xiaofan this time. We don’t need him to deal with the Shop Weirdo.”
After nodding to Lin Yuanyuan, Wang Ping spoke.
Everyone had no objections to Wang Ping’s decision.
After explaining the strategy to Lin Yuanyuan, Wang Ping directly tore through space and left the Thunder Realm Holy Land.
No one noticed that Wang Ping and the others had left.
Soon, Wang Ping and the others found the Shop Weirdo and entered its shop.
Since Wang Ping had already figured out the clearance method in the simulation, he directly asked Lin Yuanyuan to draw cards. She flipped all the cards at once.
Then, he had Cai Yonglong use Absolute Defense to block the negative curse, successfully triggering the wish.
In the end, they easily drained the Shop Weirdo dry.
It had to be said that Lin Yuanyuan was as powerful as ever.
“Ding! The Weirdo has been killed, the Group Task is completed, and rewards have been issued individually. Group members can claim their respective rewards on the Group Reward Page.”
“Ding! The Group Task has been completed. All members can silently return to their own worlds by reciting the word ‘return’ in their minds. If they don’t return within 24 hours, the system will force them back into their original worlds.”
Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction after hearing the voice in his mind.
“Lin Yuanyuan, did you get the Weirdo’s ability?”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and asked.
Lin Yuanyuan participated actively in the Group Tasks and should have accumulated a million group points by now, perhaps she had already optimized her Golden Finger.
“No.”
Lin Yuanyuan shook her head disappointedly.
She had optimized her Golden Finger before and even borrowed 200,000 group points from Liu Mei for it.
After optimization, her Golden Finger’s upper limit had increased, but nothing else had changed.
At first, she thought that instead of the original method, a simple kiss would suffice, but it didn’t work out.
Later, she thought that after the upper limit had been increased, she might be able to obtain the Weirdos’ abilities, but she still couldn’t.
What exactly had been improved?
Just to improve her loneliness?
“You didn’t? It seems that your optimization simply increased the upper limit of your ability. For example, you might have been able to drain an Emperor tier expert before, but after increasing the upper limit, you might be able to drain a Void Lord, True Lord, God Monarch, or even an Entering Saint.”
Wang Ping pondered and spoke.
“I’m disappointed that I can’t acquire the Weirdo’s abilities.”
Lin Yuanyuan muttered.
“Ha-ha, the Weirdos are special after all. There’s no need for you to be disappointed.”
Wang Ping laughed.
Cai Yonglong stroked his chin and asked, “Speaking of which, Mr. Wang, why didn’t you just wish for the Weirdo to enter Lin Yuanyuan’s body directly? That would make it easier to kill, right?”
He had just thought of this point.
“Liu Mei’s case was special; the Weirdo didn’t know her identity. This time, however, the Weirdo clearly knows who we are and wouldn’t allow us to make such a wish.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
“The Weirdo had doubts when Yuanyuan made that wish just now. If it weren’t for Lin Yuanyuan’s superb acting skills, pretending to be a pervert who wanted to taste the Weirdo, it might not have been fooled.”
“Uh, that’s true.”
Cai Yonglong had nothing else to say.
“Sister Yuanyuan, you’re amazing.” Chen Si said with a blushing face.
“Alright, let’s leave now. Staying in this world for too long could be dangerous.”
Wang Ping looked at everyone and spoke.
“Mr. Wang, you must remember that matter.”
Seeing Wang Ping about to leave, Qin Tian pleaded anxiously.
“Don’t worry, it’s under control.”
Wang Ping patted Qin Tian on the shoulder.
Next, Wang Ping turned into a beam of white light and disappeared, returning to the Purple Spirit Realm.
After returning to the Purple Spirit Realm, he opened his red envelope.
“Ding! Due to your 100% contribution in this Group Task, you are rewarded with 5 million group points.”
“Five million, so stingy.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward and curled his lip.
“This Weirdo was easy to deal with, and having this many rewards is already good. Don’t be too greedy. After all, my intention for sending you to deal with the Shop Weirdo is to make the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Great World understand that we have the ability to deal with Weirdos and let Them continue their offerings in peace.”
The cold, emotionless voice of Alpha responded.
“When the time is right, we’ll help Them solve the root problem.”
“So, this is the real purpose.”
Wang Ping listened to Alpha’s answer with a subtle look in his eyes.
Was this considered drawing a pie for the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Great World?
“So, the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Great World at this point in time should not have been completely contaminated, right?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he asked.
“They’re still stubbornly resisting the Weirdos and trying to slow down the contamination process. In addition, the Immortal Emperors of that world are leading other cultivators to cooperate with the Heavenly Tao in their last-ditch struggle.”

chapters.title: Chapter 527: 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Chapter 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_4
Alpha gave the answer.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded, not surprised by the answer.
Next, Wang Ping opened the group chat and sent Lin Yuanyuan a red envelope.
According to the contribution value, Lin Yuanyuan had at least 30% of the contribution this time. Without Lin Yuanyuan, it would have been difficult to solve the mysterious shop.
For this reason, Wang Ping sent Lin Yuanyuan an exclusive red envelope with two million group points, which was a fair distribution.
Wang Ping didn’t care about group points at this point, so he was not going to be stingy.
Lin Yuanyuan was someone he wanted to cultivate, so he needed to be generous.
“Next, continue the simulation. After the simulation is over, let Lin Yuanyuan and the others come to the Purple Spirit Realm, and I will help them ascend in one fell swoop.”
Wang Ping thought silently to himself.
“System, spend thirty-five king artifacts for paid simulation.”
Next, Wang Ping hesitated no more and whispered in his heart.
“Ding, consumption of thirty-five king artifacts, Life Simulator starts, talent refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, talent refresh is successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent·Group Taunt and Blue Talent·Demonic Cultivation Chaos.”
Red Talent·Group Taunt: With this talent, the host can taunt the enemy freely, making other enemies attack the host as a priority.
“Red taunt talent? It seems that the previous blue talent was single-target taunt, red is an enhanced version, group taunt, and the limit of its abilities should be higher.”
Wang Ping silently made a judgment.
As for the Blue Talent·Demonic Cultivation Chaos, Wang Ping had no interest in taking a second look.
“System, I choose Red Talent·Group Taunt.”
Wang Ping whispered in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway as he entered the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he spoke again.
“Ding, fast forward in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded once more, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
“[On the first day, you chose to cultivate in seclusion, continuing to comprehend the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture. After all, the deeper your understanding of the Emperor Scripture is, the stronger the effects you can achieve. At this point, although you have reached the Burning Emperor Realm, your understanding of the mysteries within, especially the Divine Skills, is only scratching the surface.]
“[You are very clear about the horror of the Upper Realm, so you don’t want to be after you gothe Upper Realm, be killed by a higher-level talented person who has never cultivated Emperor Scripture, just cultivated a Holy tier Cultivation Method but has a deeper understanding of Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills. That would be too humiliating.]
“[In a blink of an eye, ten years have passed, and you have been cultivating quietly. However, without the powerful boost of Purple Talent·Proving Tao by Killing, the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture has become much more difficult to understand compared to before, leaving you with a strong sense of frustration.]
“[You know that the level of Purple Talent·Enlightenment to God is still too low. Perhaps for comprehending God-tier Skills and Divine Skills, even the speed of creating those skills by God Monarch Realm powerhouse is equally fast, but this level of understanding is ultimately barely Entry Tier for comprehending Emperor Scripture.]
“[However, you have no idea to give up; you want to comprehend it more profoundly anyway. At the same time, in the comprehension of Pseudo Rules, you have not given up either, wanting to make further progress.]
“[In the blink of an eye, several decades have passed, and you find yourself at the moment when Ji Bingyue is about to die unexpectedly. If there is no intervention from you, Ji Bingyue will fall. For this reason, you choose to leave Ashy Flame Valley and keep an eye on Ji Bingyue while hiding in space.]
“[In this life, you want to know why Ji Bingyue would have an accidental fall and what connection Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er have with the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.]
“[Soon, you get the answer you want. During an adventure, Ji Bingyue encounters a life-and-death crisis, but she successfully breaks through her limits, narrowly escaping death. However, after this brush with death, you notice a significant change in her mood, as if she has become an entirely different person, her demeanor and tone of voice becoming very similar to the Profound Ice Empress, Ji Bingyan, whom you remember.]
“[This leaves you thoughtful and you faintly guess something. Finally, you continue to follow Ji Bingyue and find that she doesn’t return to Heavenly Sword Divine Land. Instead, she tears through space directly and heads to the Eternal Frozen Land, arriving at the deepest part of Eternal Frozen Land.]
“[Because your strength is now far greater than Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, your peeking is not detected by Ji Bingyan. According to your observation, Ji Bingyue begins to cultivate rapidly after arriving at the Eternal Frozen Land.]
“[Not long after, Ji Xue’er also appears in the depths of the Eternal Frozen Land, cultivating in seclusion together with the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.]
“[Seeing all this, you confirm your guess and admire Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan for her secret technique. It is truly powerful, with a trace of the profundity of Qi transformation of the Three Pure Ones.]
“[Without a doubt, Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, will split a part of her soul every once in a while and reincarnate it into the descendants of the Jee family. If these descendants awaken, they will be summoned back to the depths of the Eternal Frozen Land to help her cultivate.]
“[What’s more, when these incarnations grow up, their souls merge together, their cultivation level merges, and their cultivation progresses rapidly. The creativity of this secret technique is excellent, and its potential is astonishing.]

chapters.title: Chapter 528: 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Chapter 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_5
[However, theoretically, even if such a Secret Skill was created, it should not be possible for someone of the level of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan to successfully cultivate it. The mysteries of Reincarnation are something that even a powerful Emperor or an even stronger being from the Upper Realm may not be able to grasp.]
[Besides, you have doubts about whether Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, actually created the Reincarnation Secret Skill. It is more likely that she came across it by chance. Such an opportunity involving the mystery of Reincarnation is truly a rare and shocking one.]
[While you ponder this, your emotions waver and, ultimately, Ji Bingyan notices you. Although you’re powerful, continuously spying like this would make anyone with strong intuition feel uncomfortable.]
[Because of this, Ji Bingyan coldly snorts and asks you to reveal yourself. You don’t try to hide and choose to meet her face to face. After you step out, Ji Bingyan immediately attacks you, as your behavior is undoubtedly a great offense and would potentially anger any cultivator to death.]
[In the face of Ji Bingyan’s full power attack, you manage to block it easily. This leaves Ji Bingyan astonished and extremely wary. She has a vague feeling that your strength has already surpassed the Quasi-Immortal level, meaning she is no match for you.]
[Seeing Ji Bingyan’s caution, you don’t intend to continue fighting and choose to apologize instead. Ji Bingyan frowns, not knowing your origin or purpose and can’t understand why you would act like this.]
[Nevertheless, she accepts your apology and asks you to leave. You smile and refuse, expressing your desire to make a deal with Ji Bingyan.]
[This leaves her puzzled, wondering what kind of deal you want to make. You provide an answer, hoping to exchange God-tier Skills, God-level Magical Powers, and numerous cultivation resources for Ji Bingyan’s Reincarnation Secret Skill and a method to break through to the Divine Realm.]
[Ji Bingyan frowns, also very surprised, not expecting you to see the profoundness of her Secret Skill and know that she has a method to reach the Void Divine Realm.]
[Next, Ji Bingyan tells you that her Secret Skill cannot be taught, so she cannot trade with you. As for the method to break through to the Void Divine Realm, she doesn’t know.]
[Seeing Ji Bingyan refusing to trade with you, you frown slightly…]
The Text Simulation stops here, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, his vision shifting to the Eternal Frozen Land, with numerous scenes and cultivation realizations from the past years appearing in his mind.
“Is it another branching storyline? What sort of branch is this?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker as he looks at the cold-faced Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and ponders in secret.
“Fellow Taoist, if there’s nothing else, please leave. Once my seclusion is over, I’ll properly entertain you. What do you say?”
Seeing Wang Ping frown, Ji Bingyan’s expression remains cold, her words speak a clear message.
This place does not welcome you, please leave.
“Fellow Taoist, I once obtained a secret method that allowed me to glimpse into a corner of the future. In the future I saw, two powerful beings from the Upper Realm will bring destruction to the Purple Spirit Realm. At that time, the Purple Spirit Realm will be destroyed, all living beings will perish, and neither you nor I will be able to escape.”
“So, I must obtain a sufficiently strong power to confront them. Only by breaking through to the Void God Realm within a thousand years can I save the Purple Spirit Realm.”
Wang Ping’s gaze is deep, and he speaks slowly.
Wang Ping now guesses what this branching option is about.
However, if possible, Wang Ping really doesn’t want to do it like this.
Even though this is a simulation, he still doesn’t want to act like that if possible.
He has great respect for Ji Bingyan, the Profound Ice Empress, having once become her apprentice or close friend in the simulation.
However, sometimes, there is no other way to proceed. Everything is done for the sake of exploring new paths and becoming stronger.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would be stuck in the Purple Spirit Realm, and everyone would eventually die after a thousand years.
Moreover, he may even die along the way confronting the enemies from Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
So, Wang Ping hopes that Ji Bingyan can cooperate at this moment.
“Do you think I will believe such nonsense?”
Ji Bingyan coldly snorts.
Seeing the scenes from a thousand years into the future?
Even those from the Heavenly Secret Pavilion who can calculate the Heavenly Secrets may not be able to do so.
And this person in front of her is a shameless peeping tom who spied on her cultivation, so how could he possibly have this ability?
Even if he did have such an ability, he couldn’t just obtain such a great opportunity from her with a few words.
Clearly, that would be impossible.
“I’m sorry, I’ve offended you. I’ll make it up to you in the future.”
Wang Ping is silent for a moment before sighing and unleashing a terrifying Mana force. The Pseudo-rule of Fire also explodes and rushes towards Ji Bingyan.
Now, Wang Ping can face an ordinary Void Lord and still instantly kill them.
And Ji Bingyan is not even a Quasi-Immortal, so she clearly has no chance of resisting Wang Ping’s full effort attack.
Even though Ji Bingyan has always been on guard against Wang Ping, it’s still useless, as she is instantly suppressed by him.
Her physical body is severely damaged, her Mana is sealed, and her soul is suppressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Chapter 172: The Upper Realm Ji Family! The Second Purple Talent! (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
In the face of an absolute gap in strength, even a figure like Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan could end up in such a situation.
Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan’s face turned pale, unable to believe that the strength gap was so huge. She struggled desperately, but it was of no use. She couldn’t even use the taboo secret skill to die together with Wang Ping.
“I’m sorry, I offended you.”
Wang Ping sighed helplessly and said this once again.
As the words fell, Wang Ping directly broke open Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan’s Sea of Consciousness and began soul-searching.
This process was not an easy one.
Although Wang Ping was powerful in combat and proficient in many secret skills from the Upper Realm, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was not weak either. It was extremely difficult to forcibly soul-search.
However, Wang Ping eventually succeeded in discovering the secret hidden by Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.
Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan knew a secret realm to break through to the Void Divine Realm. That secret realm was left behind by a Flying Immortal a hundred thousand years ago, and it contained many divine sources, enough for a quasi-immortal to break through to the Void Divine Realm.
“A Flying Immortal from a hundred thousand years ago? Compared to that ruthless Mo Shangli, this is a truly respectable senior.”
Wang Ping exclaimed.
Even when about to ascend, he still left some hope for future generations.
“But what is that secret skill?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he continued soul-searching.
Soon, Wang Ping discovered extraordinary information.
It turned out that Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan’s previous life was not from the Purple Spirit Realm, but from the Upper Realm Jee’s Family. After her fall, she reincarnated into the Purple Spirit Realm.
The Reincarnation Secret Skill in her mind was a secret skill recorded by the Jee family.
Whenever a direct descendant of the Jee family is born, even if they have experienced reincarnation, when their cultivation reaches a certain level, they might awaken memories of their previous life. This allows them to know their identity and practice the Jee family’s Reincarnation Secret Skill.
“Another descendant of an Upper Realm Imperial Clan.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
What kind of place was the Purple Spirit Realm to have two imperial clan-related families simultaneously?
Apart from that, there was also that terrifying sealed Demonic Artifact…
This was simply outrageous.
At this point, Wang Ping tried to see the secret of the Jee family’s secret skill.
“Who dares to spy on my Jee family’s secret skill!?”
However, just as Wang Ping was about to take action, an authoritative shout sounded, directly shattering Wang Ping’s soul and physical body, causing him to enter a revival state.
When Wang Ping revived, he saw Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, who seemed like a completely different person, looking at him coldly.
“Reverse time and space to revive? Junior, you do have some abilities. However, if you dare to spy on my Jee family’s secret skill, even with the means to reverse time and space, you shall fall completely.”
The cold voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s body stiffened, feeling the time becoming chaotic.
In the end, he completely lost consciousness.
Not long afterward, Wang Ping suddenly woke up, cold sweat dripping from his forehead.
The feeling of having his soul shattered, revived, and then falling into the whirlpool of time was too unbearable. He thought he was really going to die.
“It seems that in the future, when I encounter an unbeatable opponent, it’s better to actively quit the simulation.”
Wang Ping sighed.
He was not a masochist and didn’t want to be abused.
“The Upper Realm Jee’s Family, Reincarnation Emperor, Reincarnation Secret Skill, this confidentiality measure is really awesome. Outsiders who dare to get involved, will directly activate the soul imprint left by the strong, and be hit hard.”
Wang Ping shook his head and exclaimed.
“I really don’t know why Ji Bingyue didn’t cultivate the Reincarnation Emperor’s Reincarnation Emperor Sutra, but instead chose to create her own cultivation skills and divine skills. Is it because she didn’t return to the Jee family and couldn’t cultivate, or is the soul imprint only recorded with some secret skills.”
Wang Ping thought of this matter again, pondering.
“Nevermind, in the future, I’ll try to get closer to Ji Bingyan, and I’ll have the chance to ask her about it. I don’t need to guess on my own. However, doing things I’m not comfortable with in the immersive simulation is not very comfortable. After making a decision, I should turn it over to the text simulation to lessen the guilt. In addition, I’ll have to make up for it in reality with Ji Bingyan.”
It was only after a long time that Wang Ping pulled himself together and murmured.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
. A random Emperor Artifact.
. Red Talent – Group Taunt.
. Blue Talent – Demon Cultivation Chaos.”
“System, I choose ②.”
Wang Ping looked at these ‘meager’ rewards, shook his head, and quickly made a choice.
Although having an Emperor Artifact was good, Wang Ping felt that the Red Talent – Group Taunt had a higher cost-performance ratio.
“It’s a pity that although I found a big secret this time, there’s no progress in my strength. Now, I only have one last paid simulation chance remaining, and I have to continue searching for resources. However, unless I slaughter the Holy Lands of the Purple Spirit Realm, I won’t be able to collect too many King and Emperor Artifacts.”
Wang Ping shook his head, feeling a bit helpless.
“System, consume three Emperor Artifacts, I want to conduct a paid simulation. I hope the last simulation will be a bit more powerful. I don’t ask you to refresh a Golden Talent, but you have to give me another Purple Talent. Otherwise, apart from some functional Red Talents, ordinary Red Talents are of little help to me now.”
However, Wang Ping quickly adjusted his mindset, took out three Emperor Artifacts, and said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, Life Simulator starts, refreshing talent…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Purple Talent – Fate Connection; Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique.”
Purple Talent – Fate Connection: With this talent, the host can forcibly connect their fate with any cultivator below Entering the Holy Realm. If you are injured, the other party will also suffer the same injury. If you die, the other party will also die. Similarly, if the other party voluntarily takes damage, the injury will also appear on you.
Warm reminder: This talent can only be bound to one person, and once used, it cannot be undone. Please use it carefully.
Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique: With this talent, the host’s cultivation in the path of fire will become more convenient. Also, when the physique is activated, it can increase combat power.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping looked at this new Purple Talent, and the whole person was astonished.
The optimized Life Simulator really guarantees that Red and Purple talents appear each time. The refresh rate of Purple Talents is also high.
He had just been thinking about Purple Talents, and it actually came true.
And the ability of this Purple Talent was truly quite overpowered.

chapters.title: Chapter 530: 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)
This Purple Talent – Fate Connection had many applications that Wang Ping could think of right away.
For example, this Purple Talent seemed to only connect to those below the Entering Saint Realm.
In the Upper Realm, the God Monarch Realm seemed to be nothing extraordinary, but that wasn’t necessarily the case.
The Upper Realm also had its Golden Age and Last Dharma Age.
Although in the Golden Age, the God Monarch Realm was just a small fry and didn’t count for much,
In the Last Dharma Age, cultivation was difficult, saints were few, and the people who reached the level of the God Monarch Realm were truly top powerhouses. If those people were transferred to the Golden Age, they would absolutely be counted as geniuses, and their achievements would not be limited.
Besides, this Purple Talent – Fate Connection was not only limited to connecting with God Monarch Realm powerhouses but could also connect with Saint Sons and descendants of the Imperial Clan from the Upper Realm. They would all share each other’s fortune and misfortune.
Under such circumstances, it was definitely a great weapon, extremely useful in the Life Simulator.
Take a simple example: After Wang Ping obtained this talent, he could completely connect with the two Upper Realm people who came to the Purple Spirit Realm.
Whether he connected with the Upper Realm youth with a not-so-low status or the elderly servant, it would help him resolve the current predicament and gain insight into the sealed demonic artifact.
It could be said that if this Purple Talent was used well, it could definitely break the deadlock and be a major asset in the future.
Of course, this was just for use in the Life Simulator. Wang Ping would definitely not dare to use it in reality. Connecting one’s fate with others was too dangerous and prone to accidents.
“System, I choose Purple Talent – Fate Connection.”
After feeling excited, Wang Ping made his choice without hesitation.
As for the Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique, it might help him slightly in cultivating the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, but when compared to the value of this Purple Talent, it was insignificant.
“Ding, talent selection successful. Life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, entering the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping said without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice sounded again, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate.]
[Over two decades later, after Chifeng disappeared, you left Ashy Flame Valley and located the secret realm within Ji Bingyan’s memory, entering it. The challenges within this secret realm were very dangerous even for Quasi-Immortal Realm cultivators, but they were nothing for you now.]
[You used brute force to easily pass the trials and eventually obtained the divine source left behind by a predecessor Void lord. However, you knew very well that although this divine source might help a Lower Realm Quasi-Immortal break through to the Void lord-tier, it wasn’t enough for you, who had cultivated the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture. It was not even enough to fill the gaps in your teeth.]
[Moreover, this divine source wasn’t enough for you to perfectly break through to the Quasi-Immortal tier. So, after putting it away, you had no intention of using this divine source for cultivation. Instead, you thought of using it to gain the friendship of Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.]
[After all, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was the reincarnation of a direct descendant of the Jee family. Once you established a good relationship and she ascended to the Upper Realm, it would be of great benefit to you. Besides, you felt somewhat indebted to Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan and naturally wanted to give her the divine source.]
[Next, you went to the Eternal Frozen Land and met the Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan, who was very friendly. She was astonished by your arrival, as she had never heard of an emperor like you in the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[In response, Profound Ice Empress invited you to sit down. After discussing the path of cultivation, you began thinking about how to reasonably give her some things.]
[Right now, you and Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan were just acquaintances. If you directly gave her all these good things, it would undoubtedly arouse suspicion. However, you could not reveal her identity as a descendant of the Upper Realm Jee’s family, as that would be even more troublesome.]
[After much thought, you could only come up with one idea. You told Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan that you were a junior in cultivation, and when the Purple Spirit Realm was invaded tens of thousands of years ago, your ancestor was saved by Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan. Without her, you would not have been born. So you grew up listening to her stories, respected her, and always wanted to repay her.]
[After saying this, you took out the divine source, God-tier Skills, and Divine Skills, and handed them to Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan.]
[Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan was astonished by what you presented. She didn’t expect such an ancient history and your generous gifts that would drive any Quasi-Immortal mad.]
