[Nevertheless, Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan kept declining, not accepting your gifts, stating that the great battle thousands of years ago was a fight against the Blood Demon, and protecting everyone was her duty. You didn’t need to do this.]
[Seeing Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan refusing several times and not accepting the gifts, you felt helpless and admired her generosity even more. Few people in the Lower Realm could resist such gifts. From the perspective of other Quasi-Immortals, it would be a miracle if you, an Emperor, took out so many good things without being robbed.]
[However, if Ji Bingyan didn’t accept your goodwill, it would be troublesome for you. After all, you wanted to make up for it. Moreover, you also wanted some benefits when Ji Bingyan went to the Upper Realm. Otherwise, relying solely on yourself to survive in the Upper Realm would be extremely difficult.]

chapters.title: Chapter 531: 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)_2
[After much thought, you came up with an idea. It might not be possible to work through Profound Ice Empress Ji Bingyan directly, so you plan to use Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er. You want to take them as your disciples and guide them in their cultivation. After all, you have flirted with both of them before, especially Ji Xue’er, with whom you have even had a child.]
….
“……..”
Looking at the content of the text simulation, Wang Ping’s forehead was sweating profusely.
Damn, his text-simulated self seemed to have completely let loose! All to get closer to Ji Bingyan, he started making moves through Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er.
Are you sure this is about making amends?
This obviously is just an attempt to get closer to the Jee family line, which is quite…shameless.
However, Wang Ping could also understand the simulated Wang Ping’s reasoning.
After all, although Wang Ping had great confidence in his Purple Talent – Fate Connection, it would be a great uncertainty whether he could break through the predicament, and whether he could follow those two Upper Realm people to the Upper Realm after breaking through.
If he relied on himself, Wang Ping believed the likelihood of making it to the Upper Realm would be low.
Flying immortality required Void Divine Realm cultivation, which is a rule of the Upper Realm. It’s not like you can forcibly ascend just because your combat power surpasses the Void Divine Realm.
Concerning the outcome of those two Upper Realm people, Wang Ping also held a pessimistic attitude.
It’s quite reckless for two people who can only exert Void Divine Realm cultivation to provoke that Demonic Artifact.
Maybe their family had given them some good items, that made them confident in subduing the Demonic Artifact, but plans can never keep up with changes.
That Demonic Artifact was too dangerous, even with the means of a Saint, it was difficult to subdue it.
Therefore, having multiple preparations was a necessary thing to do.
After all, whether Chifeng will be summoned back to the Upper Realm or not is still uncertain.
In that case, he could only rely on Ji Bingyan to lend him a hand after ascending, and take him to the Upper Realm as well.’
Once the simulated Wang Ping reached the Upper Realm and became a Void Divine Realm Master, he could then receive cultivation and ascend to the Upper Realm in an orderly manner.
“Now that I think about it, was I too hasty before? There was no need to rush into repairing the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture. If it were normal cultivation, I could become a Void Divine Realm Master relatively easily and then ascend to the Upper Realm. Once in the Upper Realm, I would disperse my cultivation and start over, it wouldn’t be so troublesome.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought of this too.
Finally, he shook his head and abandoned this idea.
Without the strong combat power gained from repairing, he wouldn’t be able to defeat the Blood Demon Realm’s Void Lord, nor would he be able to use his immense power to forcibly soul-search Ji Bingyan and find out about the divine source.
If he didn’t know about the divine source, it would still be difficult for him to break through to the Quasi-Immortal realm.
In the end, he would most likely have to rely on Ji Bingyan’s help, either gaining the divine source from her in a secret realm, or obtaining it from the Blood Demon Realm.
Of course, Wang Ping was also skeptical about whether the divine source exists in the Blood Demon Realm.
If there was divine source in the Blood Demon Realm, the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine would most likely have chosen to break through to the Void Divine Realm earlier.
That is to say, both realms were very likely poor, able to provide only one person breaking through to the Void Divine Realm.
“Haven’t any previous Flying Immortals brought back a large amount of divine source to reciprocate the Lower Realms? Are they unable to come back, or unwilling?”
Wang Ping silently pondered.
He felt that apart from people like Mo Shang Li, most of the Flying Immortals were likely unable to return to the Lower Realm to repay their hometowns.
After all, although Upper Realm people could come to the Lower Realm, they were required to suppress their cultivation. Furthermore, venturing to the Lower Realm not only needed powerful Divine Artifacts to block Spatial Turbulence but also needed travel costs.
Even nowadays, people need to prepare for travel expenses, not to mention Upper and Lower realm issues.
Such costs were probably not something an ordinary Flying Immortal could bear.
After thinking it through, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen and wanted to see what tricks the simulated Wang Ping could come up with.
[With your scheming moves, you successfully took Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er as disciples one after another and diligently guided them in their cultivation. With your help, their cultivation skyrocketed.]
[However, as time went on, you began to waver. Because once Ji Bingyan absorbs Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er, the question remains whether or not the two of them are as good as dead.]
[If they will die, you can’t bear to see your two obedient disciples perish like this. In the end, you hypnotize yourself, convincing yourself that the bigger picture is essential, and forcibly erase your memory of Ji Bingyan’s Secret Skill.]
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years have passed. During these hundreds of years, you have persistently comprehended Pseudo-rule of Fire and Pseudo Law of Sword, successfully realizing 20% Pseudo-rule of Fire and 20% Pseudo Law of Sword.]
[Shortly after you realized the two Pseudo Rules, Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er awakened, learned the truth about themselves being connected to Ji Bingyan’s soul, and their feelings toward you became very complex. They tore space apart and left.]
[You quickly realized what happened and followed. When you saw Ji Bingyan, you confronted her, asking what was going on. Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er remained silent, telling you the truth: they were souls split and reincarnated from Ji Bingyan and had to return to her.]
[You couldn’t accept this, and began accusing Ji Bingyan. She didn’t expect this to happen either and found it a headache, but she could only provide the truth.]
[Unable to accept this, you told Ji Bingyan that if it was for her cultivation, you could supply her with resources to breakthrough to Quasi-Immortal or even the Void Divine Realm, begging her not to absorb Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er.]

chapters.title: Chapter 532: 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Fellow (A 10,000-character Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Fellow (A 10,000-character Chapter!)_3
[Ji Bingyan remained somewhat silent about this. Once this Secret Skill was used, after the right moment, the split soul must be retrieved. Otherwise, an incomplete soul would impede further progression.]
[At that time, she knew that it was impossible to cultivate to the Quasi-Immortal Tier in the Purple Spirit Realm by conventional means, which was why she chose this method of cultivation. Otherwise, she would not have used this Secret Skill, despite its great risks.]
[Seeing Ji Bingyan’s silence intensified your anxiety. You wanted to use your power to stop Ji Bingyan. But Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er protected her, urging you not to act rashly.]
[In the end, you stopped, looking disheartened. After apologizing to you, Ji Bingyan began to cultivate deeply with Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er. Although it was said to be a return to unity, this process was actually very long and required the cultivation of both people to be at a very close level.]
…..
“This development somehow gives me a toothache.”
This simulation content made Wang Ping feel a bit subtle.
If he had known earlier, he would have stayed shamelessly in the Eternal Frozen Land to discuss Tao with Ji Bingyan, improve her favorability towards him and then state his purpose straightforward.
Although it would just be a transaction devoid of affection, the process wouldn’t be this agonizing.
Taking in Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er as his students and developing deep relationships with them only complicated matters.
“Ah, I hope everything goes smoothly. Otherwise, this is not compensation.”
With a wry smile, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years passed. The Blood Demon Realm invaded. You chose to confront it and slaughtered all the Blood Demon Realm Masters effortlessly in front of all the Purple Spirit Realm Experts. This battle made your name and shocked the world.]
[Seeing your terrifying power, Ji Bingyan, who was in critical cultivation stage, was stunned. She had no idea you were so powerful.]
[Next, you went to the Blood Demon Realm to look for the divine source. You discovered there was no divine source in the Blood Demon Realm because the Blood Demon Realm’s Quasi-Immortal had secretly drained it, once tried to break through to the Void Divine Realm but failed, wasting the divine source.]
[You were speechless at this. Trying hard to breakthrough without enough talent and wasting resources deserved heavenly punishment.]
[Then, you returned to the Purple Spirit Realm and finally unlocked the seal within the Profound Turtle, releasing the abnormality and killing it with one punch, eliminating a major hidden danger.]
[After Ji Bingyan advanced to the Quasi-Immortal Tier, you visited her and found that she had taken a surprising action. Instead of completely absorbing the memories of Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er during the absorption process, Ji Bingyan chose to split her personality, preserving their identities, with her original personality serving as the main one.]
[In other words, if Ji Bingyan wanted, she could grant Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er access, allowing them to use her body as their own, which though potentially risky, would save their lives.]
[About this, you were very happy. You presented the divine source, God-tier Skills and Divine Skills to Ji Bingyan as a token of your appreciation. Ji Bingyan wanted to decline, but you explained that it was not just for gratitude, but also because you hoped Ji Bingyan could take you to the Upper Realm after her breakthrough to the Void Divine Realm.]
[Ji Bingyan looked surprised, wondering why you didn’t do the breakthrough yourself. You shook your head, saying that there were not enough resources in the lower realm for your breakthrough into the Void Divine Realm. Upon hearing this, Ji Bingyan thought for a while and finally agreed.]
[In the following decades, Ji Bingyan retreated again for cultivation. With the help of the divine source, she successfully broke through to the Void Divine Realm and underwent a Heavenly Tribulation. After going through the difficult tribulation, she completed her breakthrough into the Void Divine Realm and ascended to the Upper Realm.]
[Ji Bingyan’s breakthrough into the Void Divine Realm and her ascendance to the Upper Realm shocked many cultivators in the Purple Spirit Realm. Yet, you were not envious and tried to enter the Upper Realm through Ji Bingyan’s ascension channel, but failed. You felt a little regretful, but didn’t pay too much attention.]
[After all, you were waiting for the arrival of those two Upper Realm People. Once they appeared, you might be able to enter the Upper Realm through them. This might be a faster way than if Ji Bingyan were to help you ascend, but it was also riskier.]
[In a blink of an eye, several years passed. You successfully waited for the arrival of the two Upper Realm People outside the Primordial Forbidden Land.]
[Seeing this, you welcomed their arrival. The two were very puzzled and raised their eyebrows at your welcome. You looked at them and asked who they were in the Upper Realm and why they knew about the demonic artifact in the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[At your question after the welcome, the two became more puzzled, not understanding your status. Still, the young man was not interested in answering a king’s question and just looked cold.]
[Seeing this, the old servant by his side snorted coldly and decided to make a move against you, slapping you.]
[You were not surprised at the old man’s move, but rather serious. This was because you found the old man’s strength terrifying, definitely not as simple as an ordinary Void Divine Realm Master. Because the Lower Realm only allows for the existence of power below the 4th tier Void Divine Realm, he must have sealed his cultivation. His real cultivation might be above the 7th tier Void Divine Realm, or even the Void Divine Realm itself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 533: 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Fellow (A 10,000-character Chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Fellow (A 10,000-character Chapter!)_4
[In your desperate situation, you chose to use a secret skill to enhance your combat power directly and use the Burning Emperor Fist to confront the attack. As the Burning Emperor Fist erupted, you barely managed to block the opponent’s attack, but still suffered injuries, coughing up blood and cracks appeared in your body.]
[The old man was very surprised to see that you stopped his attack. After all, although he sealed his cultivation, he could still exert the power of the 3rd tier Void Divine Realm. The strike he unleashed wasn’t his full power but was still not to be underestimated; it was definitely not an attack that a king from the lower world could withstand.]
[In comparison to the old man’s surprise, the young man was even more astonished, his eyes burning with excitement. He recognized that you had cultivated the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Sutra, having also learned the Burning Emperor Fist. That is to say, you possessed the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter. If he could acquire the Burning Emperor Sutra·Mortal Sutra Chapter and bring it back to his family, it would be a great contribution.]
[For this reason, the young man showed a friendly expression, indicating that if you were willing to surrender to him and let him plant a slavery imprint on you, he could take you to the Upper Realm and nurture you into a powerful figure.]
[You scoffed disdainfully, exclaiming that the young man was not worthy. This turned the young man’s expression cold, and he ordered the old man to suppress you as he planned to forcibly perform soul-searching. The old man sneered at this, considering you ignorant of your best interest, and prepared to attack you again.]
[You looked at the two with contempt and activated the Purple Heavenly Wind·Fate Connection ability, forcibly linking you and the young man. Suddenly, a black thread connected to the young man, making his pupils contract in surprise and confusion as he couldn’t detect what you had done.]
[Immediately after, the young man felt immense pain and his body started tearing apart, suffering injuries. This changed the young man’s expression drastically, while the old servant’s face paled, he stepped in front of the young man, thinking that you had launched a sneak attack on him.]
[The young man was furious and chose to attack you. The power he unleashed was even stronger than the old servant’s. You were unable to withstand this terrifying strike.]
[However, you didn’t panic at all. Before the attack reached you, you directly chopped off your own arm with a sword. The horrifying pain was transmitted to the young man at the same moment, and his arm also broke off, causing the attack to halt.]
[The scene rendered the young man’s expression stiff, while the old man also revealed a horrified look, guessing the truth behind the black thread.]
[You sneered and explained to the pair the ability of the Purple Heavenly Wind·Fate Connection. At the same time, you stabbed your own heart, causing the young man’s heart to ache severely and he coughed up blood again. This type of injury was nothing to him and could be easily healed, but he felt fear and humiliation.]
[As an Upper Realm Heavenly Genius with a 5th tier Void Divine Realm cultivation, he had been outplayed by a king from the lower world, a profound humiliation. If word of this got out in the Upper Realm, he would undoubtedly become a laughingstock, and his Mo family would be ridiculed as well.]
[Driven mad by this, the young man coldly asserted that his cultivation was higher than yours, and even if you injured yourself, you would die while he wouldn’t. You chuckled, stating that it had nothing to do with cultivation; even if he were at the God Monarch Realm, if you died, so would he.]
[Your words made Young Master Mo’s expression extremely ugly, unable to comprehend how a king from the lower world could possess such a terrifying secret skill. The old man trembled beside him, not daring to utter a word.]
[Seeing Young Master Mo’s ugly expression, he no longer dared to attack. You knew that you had the upper hand and started questioning their identities, their purpose in coming to the lower realm, and the secret of the demonic artifact.]
…
“This Purple Talent – Fate Connection is really ruthless, directly controlling the Young Master of the Upper Realm’s Mo family. Everything should go smoothly from here, right?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, smiling and secretly thinking in his heart.
[Faced with your questioning, Young Master Mo remained silent, as the matter concerned the demonic artifact. If he were to divulge anything, it would bring great calamity to the Mo family.]
[Seeing that Young Master Mo remained silent, you inflicted further harm on yourself, making his expression even uglier and hesitant. He was an Upper Realm Heavenly Genius with a long life ahead of him and didn’t want to perish like this.]
[After thinking it over, he finally told you everything. He was from the Mo family in the Upper Realm, the current young master of the family. The purpose of coming to the Purple Spirit Realm was to accidentally learn that a Demonic Spear was sealed within. The spear was rumored to be the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s life-bound magic weapon, and the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord was said to be engraved upon it. So, he had come to the lower realm in search of this great opportunity.]
[Upon learning the details of the demonic spear, you were very surprised. You hadn’t expected that it would be a supreme life-bound weapon, even surpassing the sacred artifacts you had predicted to belong to Saint Realm powerhouses. It was no wonder that, after coming to the lower realm, these two had destroyed both realms and concealed the news.]
[Of course, there was also the possibility that they would fail to subdue it and both of them would die. You asked Young Master Mo what made him confident that he could subdue the divine weapon of a supreme being like the Heavenly Emperor. His eyes flickered, and he didn’t respond.]
[You pressed on with your questioning. At this point, Young Master Mo seemed to have prepared well and suddenly self-sealed, locking away all his cultivation. This made your expression change because the Purple Heavenly Wind·Fate Connection was a two-way ability; if he sealed himself, so would you.]
[That meant you were now a helpless fish on a chopping board, at their mercy. After all, there was still a Void Divine Realm Master on their side, and you, in your current state, were no match for him. At this moment, you decided to end your life.]

chapters.title: Chapter 534: 173: Wang Ping, truly a shameless man (10,000 words long !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, truly a shameless man (10,000 words long chapter!)_5
“[However, the servant was already prepared. When you were about to commit suicide, you were forcibly captured by him. This made you sigh inwardly, regretting that you let your guard down. If you had known, you should have had Young Master Mo kill the servant first.]”
“[Nevertheless, you were not worried. After all, Young Master Mo would absolutely not dare allow the servant to perform soul-searching on you. Because once you were forcibly subjected to soul-searching, it would likewise affect Young Master Mo’s body.]”
“[Young Master Mo sneered, stating that you, a barbarian from the Lower Realm, daring to fight him, were simply courting death. However, he would not let you die, he would keep you alive, and once back in the Upper Realm, he would invite the Mo family ancestor to naturally break your Secret Skill. By then, he would make you wish for death but be unable to die.]”
“[Your expression was calm, unmoved, and you counter-asked Young Master Mo, now that you had self-sealed, did you still have the ability to subjugate the Demonic Spear? This caused Young Master Mo’s expression to darken, he snorted coldly and did not respond.]”
“[Next, Young Master Mo ordered the void lord realm servant to lead the way into the Primordial Forbidden Land. You entered the Primordial Forbidden Land and delved deep, the terrifying black fog made it hard for even the void lord realm servant to resist.]”
“[However, Young Master Mo had obviously prepared in advance, and took out a Forbidden Artifact crafted by the Mo family ancestor to protect them. In the end, you successfully penetrated deeper and saw the Demonic Artifact.]”
“[Looking upon the Demonic Artifact, Young Master Mo was very excited, fantasizing about his future reigning the Upper Realm after he subjugated the Demonic Artifact. Then, he took out a special Array-breaking Talisman, intending to break a corner of the seal.]”
“[The Array-breaking Talisman successfully broke a corner of the seal. However, just as this corner was broken, the black fog instantly thickened, and the energy contained within was still increasing. The defense brought about by the Forbidden Artifact visibly started to dim.]”
“[This caused Young Master Mo’s complexion to drastically change, and he hurriedly took out another trump card, the Sacred Artifact of the Mo family ancestor. However, since Young Master Mo was self-sealed, he was completely unable to display the might of the Sacred Artifact, and the Sacred Artifact was also unable to provide defence. This terrified Young Master Mo with the horror of the Demonic Artifact, causing him to become anxious and wanting to negotiate with you to undo the seal.]”
“[In response to this, you agreed to him and promised not to harm yourself. Young Master Mo tried to unlock the seal, activating the might of the Sacred Artifact in an attempt to resist the onslaught of the black fog.]”
“[In the end, the brilliance of the Sacred Artifact did manage to block the black fog. After all, the black fog was merely the demonic spirit emanating from the Demonic Artifact, not a direct attack from the Demonic Artifact itself. If it was, even the Sacred Artifact would be of no avail.]”
“[After withstanding the black fog, Young Master Mo entered the Great Array. Eyeing the tightly sealed Demonic Spear, he was fanatically greedy and took out a black stone, pressing it onto the Demonic Artifact, hoping to form a connection before subjugating it.]”
“[However, when the black stone touched the Demonic Artifact, the Demonic Artifact went berserk. The black fog thickened hundreds, if not thousands of times and a terrifying red glow appeared.]”
“[Beneath this black fog, the light from the Sacred Artifact dimmed. Young Master Mo was terrified, muttering that things did not proceed as recorded. You silently watched this scene, aware that it was not Young Master Mo who destroyed the two realms to cover up the news, but the result of the Demonic Artifact’s rampage and the black fog eruption.]”
“[Of course, you were clear that if Young Master Mo had subjugated the Demonic Artifact, he would likely destroy the two realms to cover up the news.]”
“[In the end, all of you were swallowed by the black fog and were completely annihilated. However, due to the Rebirth Tally, you revived. Young Master Mo also revived together with you.]”
“[However, because you were caught in the black fog, you died again.]”
“[With your death, this simulation ends.]”
…..
“Uh, this Young Master Mo is toxic, isn’t he? He was so confident about subjugating the Demonic Artifact but ended up dying straightforwardly, even losing his family’s Forbidden Artifact and Sacred Artifact.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a subtly strange expression.
“Also, this Purple Talent – Fate Connection, it really is outrageous. I thought I could easily solve strong enemies by using the rebirth tally after tricking them into dying. But now you’re telling me they can revive together with me?”
Wang Ping recalled the mechanism of Purple Talent – Fate Connection and his face twitched subtly.
If they could all revive, then this wouldn’t be as good as he had imagined it to be.
Although, if used well, it could still intimidate strong enemies, but it somehow fell short.
“Of course, if we could all revive, it could be linked to people I want to save, and I could save them with the mechanism of the Rebirth Tally. But in doing so, we would be bound by fate, which is still quite bothersome.”
Wang Ping thought of another way to use the Rebirth Tally and the Purple Talent – Fate Connection and his mood became inexplicably complex.
“No need to overthink, use it when it’s useful in the future, and leave it alone when it’s not. It’s a simple principle.”
Wang Ping summarized.
At this moment, Wang Ping quit the simulation mode, and many images appeared in his mind.
Then, many cultivation insights also appeared.
His comprehension of Pseudo Rules went up to 20% naturally.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one from the following rewards:
①. A randomly assigned Emperor Artifact.
②. Purple Talent – Fate Connection.
③. Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique.
④. A divine source.”
“System, I choose ②. Purple Talent – Fate Connection.”
After looking at the reward list, Wang Ping made his choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 535: 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 173: Wang Ping, Truly a Shameless Man (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
Soon, information about the usage of Purple Talent – Fate Connection was added to Wang Ping’s mind.
To put it simply, all he needed to do was look at someone, and a connection would be formed. It was very domineering.
“Done, there are no more resources for paid simulation. Now it’s going to be difficult.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and thought, feeling a headache coming on.
“System, can the lower-tier Divine Artifact be used for a paid simulation? If so, how many times?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ask in his heart.
In response to Wang Ping’s inquiry, the system did not react at all, leaving Wang Ping speechless and complaining, “I give up! You’re so picky; you don’t accept anything but specific highly valuable items.”
“Next, I need to go out and deal with the weirdness. With my current strength, suppressing the Guilt-Punishing Emperor who has been possessed by the weirdness should be a very easy task. In fact, it’s not a bad choice to let Lin Yuanyuan squeeze the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.”
After thinking about it for a moment, Wang Ping made a decision.
With his current strength, suppressing the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was a breeze. During this time, letting Lin Yuanyuan take advantage of Guilt-Punishing Emperor to extract the weirdness would get multiple results with one action.
The Guilt-Punishing Emperor would be liberated, and although he would die in a shameful way, he would still be freed from his predicament.
If the weirdness died, Wang Ping would obtain a large amount of Group points.
In addition, Lin Yuanyuan would gain extreme power, become the second strongest member of the group, and be able to replace him in rescuing other Group members and helping them become stronger.
Wang Ping opened the chat group upon having this thought.
Wang Ping (66): “Lin Yuanyuan, I’m opening up my permissions. Come over, I’ve found a target for you – a Quasi-Immortal.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Quasi-Immortal?!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Damn! Mr. Wang is actually preparing to level at the Quasi-Immortal? That’s so terrifying!”
Qin Tian (77): “Mr. Wang, your strength is changing unexpectedly after every period of time.”
Zhang Hu (5): “I’m so envious! I want to have the Quasi-Immortal level strength too.”
Chen Yao (71): “Well, Yuanyuan is about to become the second-in-command of the group. I’m envious.”
This time, even Chen Yao was genuinely envious. She used to think her point addition system was powerful, but it seems that Lin Yuanyuan’s golden finger of skyrocketing strength is the most attractive as long as someone has powerful support, and their strength could directly jump several levels higher.
Although Lin Yuanyuan paid a great price to become stronger, Chen Yao felt that she seemed to enjoy it to some extent…
Soon, Lin Yuanyuan was sent to Wang Ping’s side.
The moment Lin Yuanyuan appeared, Wang Ping protected her, as Ashy Flame Valley is not suitable for everyone to stay, the spiritual energy was too violent.
Next, Wang Ping brought along the useful Cai Yonglong just in case, and then tore through space to go to Profound Turtle’s place.
“Heaven Derivative Emperor, how come you’re back again? And you brought another woman this time.”
Seeing that Wang Ping had reappeared, the Profound Turtle was somewhat puzzled.
After all, Wang Ping had only been gone for a little more than a month, a short period of time which, for the Profound Turtle, was like a brief nap.
“Profound Turtle Senior, this time I am asking a favor for us to meet the Guilt-Punishing Emperor who you sealed within your body.”
Wang Ping smiled faintly and stated his purpose.
“Meet the Guilt-Punishing Emperor? Absolutely not. He has been taken over by the weird entity and completely turned evil; he is extremely dangerous. If the seal is loosened for a moment and he escapes, the consequences will be unthinkable.”
The Profound Turtle’s tone became serious, and he directly refused Wang Ping.
“What if I have the strength to kill him and eliminate the future threats?”
Wang Ping’s countenance was serious as he spoke.
“Are you sure you can do such a thing?”
The Profound Turtle was full of doubt.
Although Wang Ping had killed the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, the gap between the Jiuyou Demon Emperor’s and Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s strengths was too vast.
Even if Wang Ping had the strength to kill the Jiuyou Demon Emperor, it would be absolutely impossible for him to deal with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
Not even if the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was in a sealed state, it would still be the case.
The difference between an Emperor and a Quasi-Immortal is simply too great.
“Of course.”
Wang Ping smiled faintly and immediately released his terrifying power.
“This power…”
Feeling Wang Ping’s power, the Profound Turtle couldn’t help but shiver.
After all, Wang Ping had cultivated the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, giving him an aura that contained a trace of the Emperor’s Might. It was rather terrifying.
And the Profound Turtle’s perception was very strong, sensing the Emperor’s Might within the aura.
In addition to this, the Profound Turtle also clearly felt that Wang Ping’s strength was extremely frightening.
Not to mention a Quasi-Immortal, even a Void lord wouldn’t necessarily be stronger.
As someone who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years relying on his racial traits and not experienced the Divine Realm experts, the Profound Turtle’s insight was naturally astonishing. He had seen Void Divine Realm Masters and felt their power with his own eyes.
However, in the Profound Turtle’s view, Void Divine Realm Masters might not necessarily be stronger than Wang Ping.
For a moment, the Profound Turtle wondered whether Wang Ping was an Emperor or a Void lord.
However, the only thing he could be sure of was that Wang Ping indeed had the power to suppress the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
It should be said that if Wang Ping really had to fight the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, it would be similar to crushing an ant to death.
“Ah, after all these years, someone has finally grown to the level where they can kill the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.”
Profound Turtle sighed and felt a sense of loss.
He had waited for this day for too long.
However, with his old friend soon to die, he had mixed feelings.
He very much wanted to save the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, but he knew that there was essentially no hope for his current situation.
“Come in.”
With these thoughts in mind, the Profound Turtle moved his head above the surface of water, opened his huge mouth, and the unique spatial fluctuation within it signified the only way to enter his inner space.
“Thank you for your trust, Senior.”
Wang Ping nodded and then entered with the dumbstruck Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong.
“Trust?” The Profound Turtle shook his head and closed his mouth.
He didn’t trust Wang Ping but believed in his strength.
In addition, Wang Ping was so powerful that he had no qualification to refuse him.
If he refused, Wang Ping could instantly kill him and then deal with the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. The hidden danger would be too great, so it was better to lie down and cooperate with Wang Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 536: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!
Soon, Wang Ping and his group found themselves in an odd realm.
There, Wang Ping saw the Guilt-Punishing Emperor who had been sealed layer upon layer.
This place was isolated from the outer world. Even if they released the Guilt-Punishing Emperor here, the outer world would not be affected by his misterious powers.
All in all, dealing with such mysterious beings was not too difficult, as long as they had not fully developed their abilities and as long as one knew what those abilities were.
As various thoughts flashed through his mind, Wang Ping again set up layers of the Great Array to stabilize the space inside the Profound Turtle and protect it from any repercussions. Then he allowed the Profound Turtle to unseal the Emperor.
“Senior, remove the seal from him,” he said.
The Profound Turtle responded with a deep grunt and began working his magic.
Soon, the chains binding the Guilt-Punishing Emperor vanished.
As the chains disappeared, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor opened his blood-red eyes, showing a look of surprise and malice.
“Ha ha, Profound Turtle, it’s surprising that you would willingly set me free. Are you submitting to me?” he sneered.
“Submit?” The Profound Turtle sighed, “No, today is the day of your death. You will finally be free.”
Surprised, he turned his gaze to Wang Ping and the others.
Right after the seal was broken, he had just woken up and didn’t think much of Wang Ping being an Emperor. But it was clear now that the Profound Turtle was relying on something when he set him free.
Wang Ping isn’t just any Emperor.
Thinking this, he activated his abilities and channelled his Terrifying Skill, directing an attack at Wang Ping and the others.
“I’m sorry for this, senior Guilt-Punishing Emperor.”
Wang Ping scattered his attack with ease, then spoke these words.
Then, he unleashed his tremendous Mana, decreeing a Divine Skill even more potent than the Profound Turtle’s, forcefully suppressing the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. He left him without any ability to fight back and his inner power was sealed off.
“What kind of Divine Skill is this?”
He exclaimed in shock.
Even when sealed by the Profound Turtle, he could still use his immense power to challenge the seal. No one else could even approach him.
But now that he was sealed by Wang Ping, he found that all his power had been constricted and he couldn’t even make a move.
“Lin Yuanyuan, go!”
Wang Ping ignored his struggles and spoke to Lin Yuanyuan.
“And Cai, remember to support at any time.”
Then, Wang Ping turned to Cai Yonglong and spoke.
“Understood.” Both Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong nodded.
Next, Lin Yuanyuan ripped open her clothes and threw herself at the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, to the Profound Turtle’s utter confusion.
What the hell was this?
Weren’t they supposed to kill the Guilt-Punishing Emperor? What were they doing?
Even though the Profound Turtle had lived for hundreds of thousands of years and seen astonishing things, this scene left him stunned.
“Cough cough, Yuanyuan is still as fierce as ever.”
Seeing this, both Wang Ping and Cai Yonglong gave a big thumbs up.
Of course, the two of them felt that Lin Yuanyuan’s liberation came after the weird incident with the Pope of the Demon Cult.
Suddenly, the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, now possessed by the strange entity, let out a scream. His body shriveled up at a visible rate, as Lin Yuanyuan drained him dry.
The strange entity and the Guilt-Punishing Emperor were completely dead, while Lin Yuanyuan’s energy surged up tremendously, reaching the level of a Quasi-Immortal and not far from the Void Divine Realm.
“Gulp….”
An audible gulp sounded, and cold sweat broke out on the Profound Turtle’s gigantic head.
What kind of background did the companions of the Heaven Derivative Emperor have?
This ability was too terrifying.
She drained the Guilt-Punishing Emperor dry, absorbing all his cultivation.
Such a terrifying ability was unheard of. Even the most sinister Secret Skills of the Demon Cult couldn’t compare. It could be said that they weren’t fit to even carry Lin Yuanyuan’s shoes.
For a moment, the Profound Turtle even doubted whether Wang Ping had this kind of ability.
If he did, the Profound Turtle couldn’t figure out whether Wang Ping was truly of the righteous path or of the Evil Tao.
“You’re a Quasi-Immortal now, I’m so envious.”
Seeing Lin Yuanyuan’s joyful face, Cai Yonglong was filled with extreme envy.
Damn it, he had been stuck at the Profound Elixir Realm Great Perfection, and that was only because his master had poured power into him.
“What are you envious of? If you want to become stronger quickly, talk to Yuanyuan about it. Let her pour power into you. Then I’ll catch some powerful beings for her in the future. Won’t that form a virtuous cycle?”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
“Eh….” Cai Yonglong was speechless.
Good lord. Could they really do that?
If that was the case, then combining Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan’s abilities, they could boost the entire chat group.
“Brother Wang, is it really possible?”
Cai Yonglong asked excitedly.
“In theory, it’s possible. The biggest drawback to having power poured into you is that the power isn’t cultivated by yourself, and your foundation and Mana are too insubstantial. Normally, a Cultivator receiving this kind of boost would skyrocket instantly, but then it would be easy to stagnate. However, we are transmigrants, we have our group points. As long as we use those group points to enhance our foundation and Mana, we can make up for this defect to some extent. As long as we have enough group points, it won’t be a problem.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, transmitting his voice to Cai Yonglong.
“And once your power increases, will you still find it hard to earn points? Impossible.”
“Damn!”
Cai Yonglong’s eyes went wide and his breath quickened as he began to dream of the future.
“So, having a good relationship with Yuanyuan is necessary, young man.”

chapters.title: Chapter 537: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_2
Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong’s shoulder and said with a smile.
Honestly, ever since Cai Yonglong’s initiation, he had a blueprint for the chat group’s future planning.
However, human nature is complicated. He didn’t quite trust the other group members before.
But as his Golden finger was optimized again and again, Cai Yonglong’s strength improvement speed was always far beyond other group members. Moreover, the enemies he encountered became more and more powerful. In addition to Xu Yi, other group members performed well, so he started implementing this plan.
Truth be told, he wanted to help other people in the chat group fly high. All he needed to do was plan the group members’ Golden finger rationally, which was really easy.
It’s just that he didn’t want to do it before. The benefits for him were not that great, and if his strength wasn’t far stronger than the other group members, they might become less obedient to him.
Now that he has gained enough prestige and confidence that his strength will always be above the other group members, after experiencing so many dangerous Group Tasks, group members have no reason to be his enemies. So he can now safely carry out the plan to truly cultivate other group members.
“Indeed, we must maintain a good relationship with her. However, we shouldn’t be too close, or I’m afraid….”
Cai Yonglong cleared his throat.
Hearing this, Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
You’re afraid of falling in love with Lin Yuanyuan and causing a raging fire, but she might not even be interested in you, you know.
“Mr. Wang, should I go back directly later?”
After reclaiming her power, Lin Yuanyuan returned to Wang Ping’s side and asked in a whisper.
“No rush. Since you can stay in this world for a while, do more things. The capable should do more work.”
Wang Ping said with a smile to Lin Yuanyuan.
“Okay.” Lin Yuanyuan nodded, without asking Wang Ping what she should do.
“Senior, I want to ask you something. Do you know what forces hold grudges against the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land?”
Wang Ping looked at the Profound Turtle and asked.
“You want to help Guilt-Punishing take revenge?”
The Profound Turtle asked rather surprisingly.
“I have some connections with the descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, and my companion has also gained the power of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, inheriting his legacy. It’s only right to help him take revenge, isn’t it?”
Wang Ping’s face carried a slight smile as he spoke.
Of course, he wasn’t that kind-hearted. Helping the Guilt-Punishing Emperor take revenge was just a by-product.
The main goal was to use this opportunity to wipe out some powerful forces and earn more resources.
How could he get so many King Artifacts and Emperor Artifacts if he didn’t destroy some Holy Lands and Great Sects?
Without King Artifacts and Emperor Artifacts, how could he use Paid Simulation?
“Black Bird Holy Land, Fierce Wind Holy Land, Sky Lion Clan, Ape Demon Sect…”
The Profound Turtle greatly admired Wang Ping and felt ashamed that he had previously suspected Wang Ping and his companions of being part of the Evil Tao. He couldn’t help but mention a bunch of forces’ names.
“By the way, this is what Guilt-Punishing left with me. You take it. Although these things may not be useful to you now, they should be decent for cultivating descendants.”
After he finished mentioning the names of the forces, the Profound Turtle took out a bunch of things.
These were clearly the legacy of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor.
One Quasi-Immortal Artifact, three ordinary Emperor Artifacts, three Incomplete Imperial Artifacts, dozens of King Artifacts, and some other Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.
“Legacy, huh.”
Wang Ping’s eyes glinted, and a smile appeared on his face.
This legacy of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was indeed a pleasant surprise.
The Quasi-Immortal Artifact among the items should be the Guilt-Punishing Emperor’s life-bound weapon.
As for the other Emperor Artifacts, there are ordinary ones, which should be left by the Purple Spiritual Realm Emperors whom the Guilt-Punishing Emperor had killed in the past.
The remaining Emperor Artifacts were mostly Blood Demon Realm Emperors’ Artifacts, probably the spoils of war from the big battle thousands of years ago.
“Since it’s a gift from senior, I won’t be polite and accept it.”
Wang Ping said with a slight smile to the Profound Turtle.
Then, he bundled up the items and put them into the space he had opened up within himself.
With so many things, he could have three more simulation times.
After Lin Yuanyuan kills these forces, he might be able to have another two or three chances to simulate.
Well, it’s finally a little more abundant now.
If possible, he hoped to raise his cultivation to the Void Divine Realm through these simulation times and then go to the Upper Realm.
Otherwise, he could only continue to make trouble in the Purple Spirit Realm.
Afterwards, Wang Ping and the others bid farewell to the Profound Turtle, leaving its inner space and returning to the outer world.
“The Heaven Derivative Emperor back then must have hidden his strength. With the power he showed earlier, it would have taken just one move to kill the Jiuyou Demon Emperor. There was no need for such trouble.”
After Wang Ping tore apart space and left, the Profound Turtle began to ponder.
However, it was still somewhat doubtful.
Was that really the case?
“Mysterious human.”
After giving his evaluation, the Profound Turtle didn’t bother to think too much and began to slumber.
This time, there was no need to suppress the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, and it was unprecedentedly leisurely and comfortable.
…
On the following day, Lin Yuanyuan started her hunting operation, while Wang Ping took Cai Yonglong back to Ashy Flame Valley.
“Alpha, I’ve already dealt with the weirdo. Aren’t you giving me the group points reward yet?”
Wang Ping frowned and said inwardly.
“Ding, you killed the weirdo and earned 50 million group points.”
Only after Wang Ping spoke up did the chat group system’s voice sound.
“50 million? More than I expected. I thought you’d still be stingy and give me just 20 million to send me off.”

chapters.title: Chapter 538: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_3
Wang Ping listened to the voice ringing in his mind, his eyes flickering slightly.
“However, 50 million seems a bit low considering the true value of that eerie being. After all, it had Quasi-Immortal combat power and turned the Purple Spirit Realm upside down.”
Wang Ping thought to himself again.
“It was sealed as soon as it appeared, and its Quasi-Immortal combat power was not even its own. The chaos it caused was actually quite small.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“Tsk.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips, too lazy to argue with Alpha.
“System, consume thirty-five King Artifacts; I want to perform a paid simulation.”
Next, Wang Ping thought for a moment and said in his heart.
“Ding, consumption successful, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations Host for successfully refreshing the Blue Talent·Dance.”
Blue Talent·Dance: With this talent, the host’s combat power will be slightly increased after singing and dancing.
“I thought the Life Simulator would at least guarantee a Red after being optimized, but it seems I was expecting too much.”
Wang Ping looked at the talent he had refreshed this time, slightly shaking his head.
This Blue Talent, which could only increase his combat power slightly after singing and dancing, was indeed somewhat mediocre.
However, it was in line with his current situation.
After all, Blue Talents were only useful in Life and Death Nirvana or in his earlier stages. At his current level, these enhancement-type Blue Talents were basically useless.
It could even be said that Red Talents were showing signs of falling behind the pace.
For example, the Unstable Optimizer, a red talent he once had high hopes for, was seldom triggered now, and when triggered, it often failed.
Because the higher the level of the item it came into contact with, the lower the probability of triggering it and the higher the failure rate.
And like his Red Talents True Dragon Form and Sword Profound Body, the root bone stacking provided by these talents was fine for cultivation at the Emperor tier and below, but when he went to the Upper Realm and reached the Void Divine Realm, he would probably become an ordinary genius.
Now, Wang Ping needed to refresh an Purple Talent that increased his root bone or constitution to keep up with the pace.
Otherwise, his future cultivation would be quite difficult.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
As Wang Ping thought, the system’s voice sounded, and his consciousness flickered, entering an immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping said without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding….”
The system’s voice sounded again, and the luminescent screen appeared, with familiar text emerging.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate, and Lin Yuanyuan began taking action against some holy lands, demon cults, and great sects. Her actions were brutal, killing all the higher-ups above the King level in the holy lands and seizing all their treasures, leaving the innocent disciples scattered. As for those demon and evil sects, she commissioned the Heavenly Secret Pavilion to locate their positions and went to completely settle the scores.]
[Lin Yuanyuan’s sudden appearance made a huge commotion that alarmed all holy lands and made them extremely wary. However, her power was very similar to that of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, which left them astonished.]
[Soon, news spread that the Guilt-Punishing Emperor had briefly regained consciousness, passed on all his mana to Lin Yuanyuan, and asked her to act on behalf of Heaven to take revenge for the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land and settle scores with all enemies.]
[For a while, all the forces in the Purple Spirit Realm with guilty consciences panicked, while the other holy lands were relieved since the time bomb that was the Guilt-Punishing Emperor was gone. At the same time, they thought that since Lin Yuanyuan was the chosen heir of both the Guilt-Punishing Emperor and the Profound Turtle, she wouldn’t harm innocent forces, so they all pretended not to see it.]
[Of course, all the holy lands also knew that even if they didn’t choose to ignore it, they would be helpless facing Lin Yuanyuan, who had reached the Quasi-Immortal tier. The remaining followers and descendants of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor who were still alive were also extremely excited, looking forward to the resurgence of the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land.]
[However, Lin Yuanyuan disappeared after settling the scores, with no intention of rebuilding the Guilt-Punishing Holy Land. This left many people in a state of confusion.]
…..
“Sure enough, if I let the group members come to my world and then perform the simulation, there won’t be any time limit on their stay.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and thought to himself.
In this way, many chat group factors could be reasonably added to future simulations.
If there was a deadlock in the future, he could consider spending some group points to bring a specific group member over and let them act as a tool person for a change.
[In the blink of an eye, more than a thousand years passed. Major events proceeded according to your memories. During these years, you had been diligently cultivating, never slacking off. As a result, after more than a thousand years, you finally managed to comprehend 30% of the Sword Pseudo Law and 30% of the Fire Pseudo Law.]
[It’s worth mentioning that Lin Yuanyuan did not waste any powerful beings but captured them alive, drained their power, and bestowed it upon Cai Yonglong, allowing him to rapidly become stronger. However, his foundation and other aspects were a complete mess, leaving him with only cultivation.]
[Cai Yonglong didn’t mind this and was quite content. You also didn’t say much to him about it.]
[Next, the Blood Demon invaded and was defeated by you. Ji Bingyan ascended, and Young Master Mo, along with his servant, found the Primordial Sacred Land. This time, you confronted him once again.]

chapters.title: Chapter 539: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_4
[This time, you didn’t think of testing your strength, you used the power of Purple Talent – Fate Connection right away to forcibly bind yourself with Young Master Mo, making him feel very oppressed.]
[Next, you took a cunning approach by letting Mo family’s servant mate with Lin Yuanyuan. Young Master Mo was both angry and puzzled about what you wanted to do, but he didn’t want to die, so he could only let his servant mate with Lin Yuanyuan.]
[Eventually, under the astonished gaze of Young Master Mo, Lin Yuanyuan forcibly drained his servant’s energy, and her cultivation shot straight to the 8th-tier of the Void Divine Realm. If she didn’t suppress her cultivation promptly, it would have attracted the world’s rejection. As for his servant, he completely perished.]
[This made Cai Yonglong envious of Lin Yuanyuan’s rapid growth, even surpassing Mr. Wang. You couldn’t help but hold your forehead, as this golden finger, which allowed one to ascend to heavens in a single step, was much stronger in the simulation than the various talents you had accumulated.]
[As for Young Master Mo, he felt a chill in his heart, thinking that you were both too strange. Obviously, you were humans and not any special ethnic group, yet you possessed such terrifying abilities.]
[Next, you ignored the thoughts of Young Master Mo and self-titled yourself, causing him to lose any means of response. After that, you forced him to hand over all the valuable things on his body, or you would all die together.]
[Young Master Mo felt extremely stifled, having no choice but to cooperate with you and took out all the treasures he had. And then, all of you were dumbstruck.]
[Because Young Master Mo was truly filthy rich. In the Purple Spirit Realm, it was very rare to find even a few pieces of lower-tier God’s Source, but they were measured by the pound on his body, amounting to over a hundred pounds. In addition, he possessed many lower-tier Divine Artifacts, mid-tier Divine Artifacts, top-tier Divine Artifacts, Forbidden Artifacts, Sacred Artifacts, and countless Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures from the Upper Realm.]
…
“This Young Master Mo is just like a big fat sheep.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation’s description and instinctively swallowed saliva.
It couldn’t be helped, he was truly maddened by poverty, and the resources for the paid simulation had to be obtained by robbery.
Moreover, he had no resources to break through to the Void God Realm now.
As a result, the lower-tier God’s Source carried by Young Master Mo was actually measured by the pound, and there were over a hundred pounds.
As for other good things, there was no need to mention how much he had, this wasn’t just being rich like having an oil well, this was like having an entire oil field.
“Damn, I really want to rob him. It’s a pity that it’s a thousand years in the past now, I can’t rob him, and I can only experience the thrill in the simulation.”
Wang Ping thought of something and cursed.
“Forget it, feeling great in the simulation is also good. With so many resources, I should be able to break through to the Void God Realm, so I don’t need to make any more convoluted plans.”
Soon, Wang Ping took a deep breath, consoled himself, quickly calmed down, and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
[However, while you and your friends were ecstatic over the resources, the Sacred Artifact on Young Master Mo’s body spontaneously awakened. As a Sacred Artifact, it naturally has a Spirit, and it is a Spirit with extremely high wisdom.]
[As a result, the moment the Spirit awakened, Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong were instantly killed, and Cai Yonglong didn’t even have time to react and use his abilities to defend.]
[As for you, you were suppressed by the Sacred Artifact and couldn’t move. This made your face hard to look at, knowing that you were too greedy and shouldn’t have cornered Young Master Mo so much. If that hadn’t happened, Cai Yonglong and Lin Yuanyuan might not have died.]
[Young Master Mo also had an ashen complexion, full of hatred for you. With the awakening of the Sacred Artifact Spirit, his disgraceful deed had been exposed and would be reported back to the Mo family. He feared that his position as Young Master might not be stable. After all, there were other geniuses in the Mo family, and although he had killed his way out from among his siblings, there were still people who were not much weaker than him.]
[Today, he had his life connected to someone else using a secret technique, and he chose to surrender to the emperor of the Lower Realm. This was undoubtedly a great humiliation, and it stripped him of his qualifications to continue being the Young Master of the Mo family.]
[Unless he could successfully bring the Demonic Artifact back to the Mo family today, he would definitely be kicked out.]
[This made Young Master Mo glare at you with hatred and frustration. Because with you suppressed, he would also be suppressed, unless you were willing to release your self-tittle and not mess around, only then could he venture deeper into the Primordial Forbidden Land and carry out his plan.]
…
“It’s really impossible to have high expectations. Just when I had some expectations, a tragedy occurred.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and was speechless.
He had just thought of reaping huge profits, and this breakthrough to the Void God Realm should have been secured.
But before he could even celebrate for a moment, he was suppressed.
This Sacred Artifact was a problem.
“If I go too far, it will stimulate the awakening of the Sacred Artifact Spirit. It seems that the strategy needs to be changed for the next simulation.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and thought secretly in his heart.
As for this simulation, there wasn’t much hope left.
However, Wang Ping didn’t care. There were still several chances to make mistakes, and there would always be one that could overcome the difficulties.
While Wang Ping was thinking this way, the text continued to emerge.
[Next, you chose to negotiate with Young Master Mo and told him that it was impossible to successfully subdue the Demonic Artifact, and that doing so could only result in death. At this, Young Master Mo’s face changed, but in the end, he still didn’t choose to believe you.]
[After all, this matter concerned a huge opportunity and his Young Master status, as well as the future position of the Mo family head. He couldn’t afford to back down here.]
[Seeing that Young Master Mo was stubborn, you couldn’t help but feel speechless. Once again, you negotiated with him to hand over the God’s Source so that you could break through to the Void God Realm, and you would cooperate with him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 540: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_5
[As for your threat, Young Master Mo snorted coldly, completely ignoring it. After all, if you were to break through to the Void God Realm, his situation would only get worse. And if he kept retreating, he would always be threatened by you, so his attitude had to be toughened. Not to mention, the Spirit of Holy Artifact is watching right now, so he can’t back down even more.]
[Seeing that Young Master Mo’s attitude was not swayed, you couldn’t help but feel helpless as well, so you had no choice but to follow Young Master Mo. In the end, the outcome was identical to the one you remembered, and both of you died tragically twice.]
[Because of your death, simulation ends….]
…..
As the text simulation stopped, Wang Ping’s consciousness blinked, appearing in the midst of the Primordial Forbidden Land, with many images and insights appearing in his mind.
After absorbing the insights, Wang Ping looked at the empty Primordial Forbidden Land, shook his head, and exited the immersive simulation state.
It was at this time that the System’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. A hundred jin (pounds) of Lower-tier God’s Source.
②. A random Lower-tier Artifact.
③. A random Imperial Artifact.
④. Blue Talent·Dance.”
….
“!!!”
Wang Ping looked at the list of rewards this time, his eyes full of excitement.
His luck was so good this wave that he actually refreshed the reward of a hundred jin (pounds) of Lower-tier God’s Source directly.
This was equivalent to refreshing all the Lower-tier God’s Source on Young Master Mo’s body.
This was simply an amazing feeling!
With so many Lower-tier God’s Source, he could break through to the Void Divine Realm directly, without having to be so calculated and careful. It could be said to be enjoyable.
“System, I choose ①. A hundred jin (pounds) of Lower-tier God’s Source.”
Wang Ping took a light breath and said in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful.”
The System’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt that there was an additional hundred jin (pounds) of God’s Source in his storage small world, exuding terrifying divine energy.
“With so much God’s Source, how many Void Divine Realm masters can be made?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but feel emotional as he looked at these God’s Source.
Of course, it was just a thought.
If the talent wasn’t enough, even with a large amount of God’s Source, you’d still fail when you should.
For example, Blood Demon World Quasi-divine had drained the Blood Demon Realm of its divine source but still failed.
Of course, the amount of divine source he gained must be incomparable to his own.
“Let’s continue the simulation.”
After thinking for a moment, Wang Ping decided to continue simulating.
With so much divine source, he believed that in the next simulation, he would definitely break through to the Void God Realm.
However, even if he could break through to the Void God Realm, Wang Ping would not choose cultivation in a short time if he could avoid it.
After all, once his cultivation advanced to the Void God Realm, what would be needed to be used for paid simulations in the future would be a question.
By then, he might have to pay astronomical figures, and just thinking about such a scene made Wang Ping’s scalp numb.
For this reason, it would be better to temporarily hold back on improving his cultivation, make use of these King Artifacts and Imperial Artifacts to simulate a few more times, and strive for more Purple Talent or even higher-level talents.
With a few more Purple Talents or even Golden Talents, it’s better to blend into the Upper Realm.
Otherwise, Wang Ping didn’t think he would easily gain a lot of resources for paid simulations in the Upper Realm.
“System, I want to spend five Incomplete Imperial Artifacts to start a Paid Simulation.”
After Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he said in his heart.
“Ding, payment successful, the Life Simulator starts, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The System’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent·Death Whisper; Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement.”
Red Talent·Death Whisper: After the host’s death, this talent will be activated, causing your corpse to explode in an attack surpassing your limits. PS: This talent is a special type of Red Talent, so it will not be affected by the restrictions, resulting in the reduction of ability.
Blue Talent·Speed Enhancement: With this talent, the host’s speed can be enhanced to a certain extent.
“Red Talent·Death Whisper, this Red Talent is not bad, very practical indeed!”
Wang Ping looked at the freshly refreshed talents, his eyes brightening a bit.
This talent, although only red, could burst forth a powerful attack beyond the limit after death, causing the opponent to possibly be taken down in one swoop.
After all, who could know that even after the true death of a person, the body could still explode with a terrifying attack surpassing its peak, simply difficult to guard against?
When facing an evenly matched opponent, even if the others killed him, they also wouldn’t be able to take it easy, and they would definitely be brought down by the Death Whisper.
And when facing enemies much stronger than himself, they might still be taken down in one swoop.
Especially when the opponent was touching the corpse, being hit unexpectedly in that situation would have a high probability of sudden death.
Most importantly, this talent was not restricted by cultivation, and it wouldn’t fall behind, so it could be used all the time.
Though the talent would only be triggered after death, it was already practical enough.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
As Wang Ping pondered, the System’s voice also sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness blurred, entering the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping didn’t hesitate to say in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding….”
The System’s voice sounded again, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words appeared as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 541: 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Chapter 174: Unexpected Joy! Wang Ping Becomes a God!_6
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate….]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed, and you consumed dozens of pounds of Lower-tier God’s Source, successfully breaking through to Quasi-Immortal and the Void lord-tier in succession. When you broke through to the Void lord-tier, you attracted an extremely terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, which shook the entire Purple Spirit Realm.]
[Facing such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, the whole Purple Spirit Realm showed signs of being destroyed. And you, facing such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, also managed to cross the Tribulation with great difficulty, officially stepping into the Void Divine Realm and becoming a Void Divine Realm Master.]
[Then, you felt a sense of being guided from the Upper Realm. However, you forcefully suppressed this feeling, considering whether to wait for Young Master Mo to arrive and fleece him before leaving the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[After thinking about it, you eventually chose to give up. There was no real need, and it was too risky. Rather than taking this risk, it was better to go to the Upper Realm first and return to the Purple Spirit Realm later if there was a chance.]
[Nevertheless, you still had some unfinished business. You found Ji Bingyan, told her some things, and forcefully left a large amount of Lower-tier God’s Source, before directly ascending to the Upper Realm.]
…
“Finally, I’ve broken through to the Void Divine Realm and ascended to the Upper Realm, it wasn’t easy at all.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, feeling somewhat emotional.
He had previously thought that he would be stuck for a long time and never expected to get such an amazing reward. It directly changed everything, and there was no need to continue struggling for survival in the Purple Spirit Realm.
“I wonder how exciting the Upper Realm will be.”
Wang Ping murmured in his heart.
Although he had learned some things about the Upper Realm from Ashy Flame Emperor, that was ultimately just a description from the other party.
In fact, the Ashy Flame Emperor was just a descendant of the Chi Clan who had fled to the Purple Spirit Realm, and many things were told to him by his ancestors. He had never seen what the Upper Realm was like.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts surged, more text continued to emerge.
[You’ve successfully ascended to the Upper Realm. Just as you arrived in the Upper Realm, you discovered that the Spiritual Energy here was much denser than in the Purple Spirit Realm, and it was easier to comprehend the Heaven and Earth for Enlightenment.]
[While you were comprehending Heaven and Earth, three Divine Halos swiftly appeared here, causing you to become alert. Because the owners of these three Divine Halos were not simple, all of them were at the Void Divine Realm level, and not ordinary Void Divine Realm Masters. At least they were in the middle stage of the Void Divine Realm, even having the cultivation level of the late stage of the Void Divine Realm.]
[When you were on guard, the three of them greeted you warmly, and voluntarily revealed their identities. As it turned out, they were members of the Three Great Forces in this region. The three Great God Sects were the Green Spirit Divine Sect, the Whiteflame Divine Sect, and the North Snow Divine Dynasty.]
[The Upper Realm was connected to many Lower Realms, and many of the ascension points were fixed. As a result, many forces would build bases not far from the ascension points. When Flying Immortals appeared, they would rush over as soon as possible, persuading them to join their forces.]
[In the Upper Realm, most forces would not discriminate against Flying Immortals. In fact, many forces were extremely enthusiastic towards Flying Immortals. Being able to cultivate to the Void Divine Realm in the Lower Realm and ascend to the Upper Realm, these people would still be considered Geniuses even in the Upper Realm. With careful nurturing, they might have a good chance of becoming a God King Realm powerhouse and even a Half-step True Lord or a True Lord in the future.]
[True Lord-tier powerhouses, in some regions of the Upper Realm, would also be considered powerful parties.]
[Ever since the Burning Emperor suppressed the darkness a hundred thousand years ago, the Upper Realm had gradually entered the Last Dharma Age, where the rules of heaven and earth changed, becoming more unsuitable for cultivation. In today’s Upper Realm, there are very few saints.]
[Hence, in such an environment, God Monarchs would be absolutely powerful, and Semi-saints would be the truly invincible figures. This situation was not good for Holy Lands, Immortal Dynasties, and Imperial Clans, but for ordinary forces, it would be a good thing because the gap had narrowed, and they had the possibility of competing with these major powers.]
[As a result, during the golden era, the Upper Realm would not discriminate against Flying Immortals. In the Last Dharma Age, there was even less discrimination against Flying Immortals. Every Flying Immortal was a good seedling, and if cultivated well, could add a powerful combat power to their forces.]
…..
“So, the Upper Realm doesn’t discriminate against Flying Immortals. I thought it would be like some of those fantasy novels I read before, where after ascending, you would be despised by the Upper Realm forces and be directly caught and sent to mine.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, his eyes flickering as he couldn’t help but comment.
“On second thought, except for some very strange worlds, this situation would not be likely. People who can ascend from the Lower Realm to the Upper Realm wouldn’t have bad talent. Sending them to mine would be a waste of talent.”
After commenting, Wang Ping continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[After learning about some situations, you were also surprised by the attitude of the Three Great Forces. In the end, you chose to join the Whiteflame Divine Sect. After all, from the name of this sect, you could tell that they cultivated fire-attribute Cultivation Skills, which might be of some help to your cultivation.]
[Of course, you didn’t have any real intention of joining, but wanted to use the Whiteflame Divine Sect as a temporary base, and make a decision of whether to stay or leave after getting a clear understanding of the Upper Realm’s situation. By that time, even if you leave the Whiteflame Divine Sect, you can give some compensation.]
[Seeing that you joined the Whiteflame Divine Sect, the Void Divine Realm experts of Whiteflame Divine Sect were very happy. While the experts of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty were disappointed, they didn’t say much, just feeling a little pity.]
[Next, you followed the Void Divine Realm expert from the Whiteflame Divine Sect to the God Mountain where the sect was located. Along the way, you inquired about the situation of the Whiteflame Divine Sect and the Upper Realm.]
[Soon, you learned more about the situation. Not only did you learn about the fact that the Upper Realm was in the Last Dharma Age, but you also found out where this region was.]
[The Upper Realm consists of a Big Universe surrounded by nine Small Universes. Each universe would only have one Emperor in one era. The place you are now is in the Big Universe of the Upper Realm.]
[To be precise, it is on an Ancient Star called Elemental Star in the Big Universe. The Elemental Star is roughly divided into Outer Area, Inner Region, and Middle Area. The Whiteflame Divine Sect is one of the three major powers in the eastern part of the Inner Region and is a powerful force with a God King Realm powerhouse guarding it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 542: 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Chapter 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!
[After joining the Whiteflame Divine Sect, you became their serving Elder, enjoying a considerable stipend. As such, you chose to temporarily stay and cultivate peacefully within the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[Due to your low-profile nature, no one bothered you, and the Whiteflame Divine Sect members who initially harbored curiosity towards you gradually lost interest due to your frequent periods of seclusion and ardent cultivation.]
[And so, a hundred years quickly passed by. However, despite the passing of a hundred years, you still weren’t able to ascend from the 1st tier Void Divine Realm to the 2nd. The difficulty in advancing through the Void Divine Realm is considerably great, and it demands much more cultivation resources.]
[Under such circumstances, the stipend you received from the elders was hardly sufficient to support your rapid cultivation.]
[If things continue in this way, you can’t even guess how much time it will take for you to advance a minor level. Although the lifespan of a cultivator in the Void Divine Realm exceeds thirty thousand years, which allows for slow and steady advancement, if possible, you would naturally prefer to elevate your cultivation as rapidly as possible.]
[Of course, the more troublesome issue is that you only have the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture for cultivation. You do not have the God Realm Chapter. Hence, you could only cultivate the lower-tier divine technique you created. If this continues, not only will your cultivating speed not keep up, but your foundation will also fail to keep pace, and in the future, you’ll have to contemplate starting over.]
[However, even if this gives you a headache, there is no solution. You must continue practicing. If you don’t cultivate and merely harbor empty hopes of getting the Emperor-tier skill: God Realm Chapter, it would only be a waste of time.]
[After all, obtaining the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture was largely a matter of luck. You can’t possibly be lucky all the time to suddenly acquire the higher-level Emperor Scripture: God Realm Chapter. It would be better to think about how you can obtain an abundance of cultivation resources to increase your cultivating speed.]
[Just as you contemplated how to obtain cultivation resources to rapidly elevate your cultivation, the Whiteflame Divine Sect began to summon elders for a meeting, to which you naturally attended. Soon, you understood the reason behind the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s summoning of the elders.]
[It turns out that in the Eastern Elemental Star, there is a secret realm abundant with divine sources and divine mines, which would greatly benefit the Whiteflame Divine Sect. However, this secret realm is not solely controlled by the Whiteflame Sect but jointly held by the three major forces of the Eastern Elemental Star.]
[The Three Great Forces — the Green Spirit Divine Sect, the Whiteflame Divine Sect, and the North Snow Divine Dynasty — jointly hold this secret realm’s key and open the secret realm every thousand years to mine its divine sources and divine mines.]
[It is precisely because of this secret realm that the three major forces could develop into powerful God Sects and receive fame across the entire Elemental Star.]
[It can be said that every time the secret realm is opened, it’s a significant event for the three major forces, influencing their future development. As such, each force places a great deal of importance on it and doesn’t take it lightly.]
[However, this secret realm is quite special and only allows cultivators in the Void Divine Realm or below to enter. So, the ultimate objective of this gathering is to decide which elders and disciples to dispatch for mining divine sources and divine mines within the realm.]
[Once you knew the ins and outs, your eyes lit up and you became quite excited. With your current strength, while you may not be extremely powerful, you are certainly no weakling in the Void Divine Realm.]
[If you can mine an abundance of divine sources and divine mines and manage to gain extra benefits, it would greatly benefit your future cultivation and expedite your growth.]
[However, you also remembered your previous complaint about flying immortals having to mine, leaving you with mixed feelings. Although no one forces you to mine, you felt that you’ve somehow ended up on this path nonetheless and couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry.]
…
Just then, the text simulation paused. Various images emerged in Wang Ping’s mind, and after a brief moment of disorientation, his viewpoint shifted, placing him in the middle of a grand hall. His thoughts were filled with cultivation realizations from the past years.
Once he had composed himself, his face twitched slightly, feeling rather speechless.
Well, it looks like he has to mine after all, which was rather frustrating.
“However, the fact that I was passively drawn into the immersive simulation again means that I’ve reached another split point, doesn’t it?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, reflecting on the situation, and glanced at the Whiteflame Divine Sect Master and others at the high seats in the corner of his eyes.
The master of the Whiteflame Divine Sect is a True Divine Realm Master.
To be precise, in the current Upper Realm, the leaders of most major powers are all True Divine Realm Masters.
As for those above the True Divine realm, such as the Half-step Lord and the God King Realm powerhouse, they are like the divine dragon – elusive and only showing themselves in times of great urgency.
“The split this time likely hinges on whether or not to enter the secret realm. However, as a Guest Elder, I’m highly likely to have to go. The role of a Guest Elder is to be at the forefront when battles occur or significant events take place.”
Wang Ping pondered silently in his heart.
