A power like the Whiteflame Divine Sect wouldn’t support a Guest Elder without expecting something in return.
Even though you have potential, since they’re providing for you, if anything happens, you are expected to be on the frontlines.
This way, casualties amongst the members of the Divine Sect can be effectively reduced.
Mining divine sources and divine mines from the secret realm wouldn’t be possible without battles. As long as interests are involved, conflicts are inevitable – an unchanging truth.
In other words, he has to go even if he doesn’t want to, unless he doesn’t want to stay within the Whiteflame Divine Sect anymore.
And once he goes, it’s highly likely that a certain event will be triggered – he has no idea whether it’ll be a blessing or a curse.

chapters.title: Chapter 543: 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Chapter 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power! _2
As Wang Ping let his imagination run wild, the Sect Master of Whiteflame Divine Sect began to read the list of elders who would be guarding the mining disciples in the secret realm.
Indeed, Wang Ping’s name was among them.
This didn’t surprise Wang Ping at all.
If he wanted to trigger another branch option at this point, he should decline tactfully. If so, his status in Whiteflame Divine Sect would plummet, and he would probably be despised and disliked.
However, Wang Ping didn’t care about that either.
It’s just that he was now curious about what would happen in the secret realm, so he decided to go there and pave the way to accumulate resources for his future simulations.
“Are there any objections, elders?”
The Whiteflame Divine Sect Master looked around and asked.
Seeing this, the outer sect elders and guest elders who had been named expressed their willingness, Wang Ping included.
“System, fast forward.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, fast forwarding…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the luminescent screen appeared, with text emerging from it.
[With the roster settled, an Inner Sect Elder in the True Divine Realm led the team, taking a Divine Boat to the location of the secret realm. During the ride to the secret realm’s location, you also observed the disciples of the Whiteflame Divine Sect who were going to mine in the secret realm.]
[Mining is extremely dangerous, but it has astonishing rewards. Many daredevil disciples of the Whiteflame Divine Sect wouldn’t miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. However, mining requires strength, or else even the ores can’t be extracted.]
[Therefore, none of the Whiteflame Divine Sect disciples had cultivation lower than the King Realm, and there were even many True Inheritor Disciples with Emperor Realm Cultivation or even Quasi-Immortal Cultivation. But the most eye-catching were the Divine Son and Goddess of the Whiteflame Divine Sect. He was only a few hundred years old but had achieved Void Divine Realm cultivation, making his talent truly terrifying.]
[Of course, you also knew that while the Divine Son’s horrific talent was a factor, the main reason was that the Upper Realm had much more resources than the Lower Realm, resulting in the emergence of such a young Void Divine Realm Master.]
[The reason you paid attention to these disciples was not just because you marveled at their cultivation levels, which could be considered top-notch in the Lower Realm, but because Lin Qinghe, the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Goddess, gave you a rather unique feeling.]
[The reason for this feeling was that during all these years, only Lin Qinghe, the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Goddess, had been seeking you out and discussing Tao with you. You didn’t know what her purpose was, nor could you see through her, but you knew that her strength was formidable, much stronger than the Divine Child of the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[You thought that this trip to the secret realm might allow you to unearth some information about Lin Qinghe.]
[While you were thinking, Lin Qinghe noticed your contemplative expression and gave you a slight smile. Many disciples showed envious expressions, especially the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Divine Child, who snorted coldly and was extremely displeased with you.]
[The Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Divine Child was extraordinarily talented and a descendant of the Sect Master. He had long admired Lin Qinghe, the sect’s Goddess, and to outsiders, they appeared to be a natural pair, destined to become Tao Companions.]
[However, your appearance changed the usually aloof Lin Qinghe. She became gentle and charming in front of you, which greatly upset the Divine Child of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, who felt as if he were being cuckolded.]
[You noticed the Divine Child’s gaze and remained silent, pretending not to see. You had no intentions towards Lin Qinghe, but your indifference wouldn’t stop others from thinking too much. After all, women could be troublesome, especially those femme fatale types, who could easily attract enemies for men.]
…
“Ah, Lin Qinghe, though I saw some images of her during the previous immersive simulation, and her beauty did indeed rival that of Ji Bingyan, I didn’t expect it to cause so much trouble.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with mixed feelings.
After the text simulation, the images displayed still weren’t the same as experiencing everything yourself. They could only present a general idea of events, lacking much detail. Wang Ping hadn’t anticipated such a situation happening.
“However, following the usual plot development, the previous branch option would be that after I go to the secret realm, Lin Qinghe’s fate would change, right?”
Wang Ping thought about the previous branch options and slightly furrowed his eyebrows.
Could one Lin Qinghe possess such capability? It was surprising that his involuntary entry into the immersive simulation would result in branch options.
“Nevermind, I’ll know by continuing to watch.”
Wang Ping thought silently and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After a long time, you all arrived at the location of the secret realm. The representatives of Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty also arrived.]
[After the leading elders of the Three Great Forces exchanged sarcastic remarks, they jointly took out the keys and opened the secret realm.]
[Upon opening the secret realm, you all entered it. While this secret realm was the type where people were randomly teleported upon entering, the Three Great Forces had manipulated it with their Divine Skills.]
[People from different forces would be teleported together for efficient mining and divine source collection.]
[As a result, after you entered, no one got lost. However, the leader of this outing, an Outer Sect Elder, was affiliated with the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Divine Child. He looked at you coldly and assigned you the most dangerous task.]

chapters.title: Chapter 544: 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Chapter 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power! _3
“Thus, you are to guard the outermost rim, blocking anyone from the other two major powers at the first instance, and at the same time, protect against any sudden dangers.”
“It can be said that after each secret realm is initiated for mining, the ones with the most casualties are always the Void Divine Realm Elders who are assigned to the farthest perimeter. Among these, most of them are Guest Elders invited by the Whiteflame Divine Sect.”
“As for this task, you frown slightly, but choose not to protest any further and comply with the order. After all, in the secret realm, if you refuse the assignment, the Divine Child of the Whiteflame Divine Sect will definitely pin a crime on you and find a way to have you killed.”
“Although you are powerful, you are no match for the many elders of the Whiteflame Divine Sect. This is because their cultivation level is generally at or above the 7th tier of Void Divine Realm, especially the team’s leading elder, whose cultivation has reached the Great Perfection tier of the Void Divine Realm.”
“Once you reach the Void Divine Realm, it becomes increasingly difficult to fight above your own rank. Even if you’re cultivating with the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter, it wouldn’t be possible for you to fight across these many realms.”
“After all, the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter still belongs to the Mortal Realm Chapter. When you were in the lower realm, this cultivation method could give you a great advantage before reaching the Void Divine Realm. But once you reached the upper realm, your advantage would no longer be that significant, especially since your life-bound weapon is still an emperor-grade weapon, that can’t keep up with the pace.”
….
“In the lower realm, I was considered a tycoon with luxurious configurations, but once I reached the upper realm, I turned into a pauper.”
Wang Ping sighed while looking at the simulated content.
It’s similar to playing a game.
With an updated version, the level cap is raised, the grade of cultivation skills changes, equipment levels are all upgraded, and all my high-grade gear, while not being downgraded to white, got outdated because of their insufficiency to scale up.”
“The cultivation involves wealth, companion, laws, and land. Currently, I have none of these four. Of course, to me, things like a Tao companion are not a necessity.”
Another grumble came from Wang Ping’s mouth as he continued to watch the luminescent screen, hoping to see how his simulated self would overcome the challenge.
Because the situation is not in his favour.
“Next, after the division of teams and personnel is finalized, they start to act, looking for ore sources and divine sources to start mining, while also repelling dangerous monster beasts in the secret realm.”
“As one of the elders stationed at the outermost rim, you’re under the greatest pressure and would have to fight off powerful Void Divine Realm monster beasts from time to time. Although your strength is formidable, you have not encountered any life-threatening danger yet.”
“In the blink of an eye, a month has passed. In this month, even you have sustained not-insignificant injuries. Of course, the only reason for this is that you deliberately hide your strength.”
“The reason for deciding to hide one’s strength is that you know well, once the fact that you have practiced the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter gets exposed, your situation would become extremely dangerous.”
“Even the mere Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Sutra exerts an unparalleled allure, as was evident from the conduct of Young Master Mo from the Mo family. Young Master Mo’s willingness to offer Holy Artifacts shows that their family has Saint Realm Powerhouses.”
“Over the years, you have been secretly inquiring about the Mo family. The Mo family is a powerful clan in the Middle Area, and as you speculated, they did give birth to a Saint Realm Powerhouse in their ancestry. However, they have gradually declined in the recent years since the Last Dharma Age, and seem unable to maintain their foothold in the Middle Area. When provoked by some God Sects in the Inner Region, they were not able to forcefully retaliate.”
“Based on this, you speculate that the Mo family, upon hearing the news of a Supreme-tier Demon Artifact present in Purple Spirit Realm a thousand years later, took the risk trying to possess the artifact and acquire the Black Abyss Devil Sovereign Heritage.”
“Although the Mo family has been in decline, they once gave birth to a Saint Realm Powerhouse, making them more powerful than the Whiteflame Divine Sect. If Young Master Mo was so fanatic about it, then the same could be expected from other forces like the Whiteflame Divine Sect. If the fact that you cultivated the Burning Emperor Sutra·Mortal Sutra Chapter gets exposed, you will surely not meet a good end.”
“The Whiteflame Divine Sect will take action against you, and even the Holy Land-Tier Powers of the Elemental Star Middle Domain will also come after you.”
“Therefore, you remain very calm, not willing to expose that you have cultivated the Burning Emperor Sutra, even if your life is in danger.”
“In the blink of an eye, another half-month has passed. During this half of the month, as more divine sources and divine ores are mined, the accumulated energy has become terrifхic, attracting more and more monster beasts at an ever-increasing frequency.”
“Even for you, with your strength concealed, the pressure is huge. You have been nearly shredded by Void Divine Realm monster beasts on several occasions. If it were not for the other powerful Guest Elders fighting alongside you, you would surely have died at least once. In the past one and a half months, as many as five Void Divine Realm Elders have fallen, four of whom were Guest Elders.”
“In response to this, you can only sigh. The Upper Realm is much more ruthless than the lower realm. Void Divine Realm Experts in the Upper Realm are strong in the Last Dharma Age, though they do not belong to the bottom, their living environment is not very good. For cultivation resources, they still have to fight for their lives, and they can die if they’re not careful.”
“Of course, this applies specifically to Void Divine Realm Experts below the 4th tier of the Void Divine Realm. As they reach the middle stage of the Void Divine Realm, they will be much safer, and by the time they enter the 7th tier, the later phase of the Void Divine Realm, they will hardly ever fall into the mouths of beasts.”
“Just as you managed to repel to a wave of monster beasts again, something irregular occurred. The followers of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty suddenly appeared and intended to completely wipe out the Whiteflame Divine Sect and seize their resources.”

chapters.title: Chapter 545: 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Chapter 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!_4
“This sudden turn of events made you uneasy, and made you choose to flee without hesitation. After all, the power levels of the three major forces were quite comparable. If two of them teamed up against one, the Whiteflame Divine Sect would definitely be outmatched.”
“Although you are a Void Divine Realm Master of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, you don’t actually have a lot of attachment to the sect and your life is your first priority.”
“When you fled, the leaders and divine offspring of the two major powers showed some disdain. However, they chose not to personally pursue you but sent out some powerful beings to eradicate the weaker elders like you.”
“While you were being hunted, the powerhouses of the North Snow Divine Dynasty and Green Spirit Divine Sect jointly attacked the main team of the Whiteflame Divine Sect. This sudden turn of events shocked the leading elder and the Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect who had not anticipated this collaboration.”
“Even Lin Qinghe frowned slightly, but quickly regained her composure.”
…..
“It’s really troublesome not being able to use real power in the Secret Realm. Now in the Upper Realm, I am again in the helpless situation of not daring to expose my cultivation skills. Although, I had anticipated this.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly as he watched the simulation content.
Back when he was on the Archipelago and still a loose cultivator, he was pursued because he had a Heaven-tier Skill which he didn’t dare to expose.
Now in the Upper Realm, he still doesn’t dare to expose his Emperor-tier cultivation skill. This is the sorrow of small beings with no backing and no reliable means to save their lives.”
“But as expected, things did go wrong in the Secret Realm, and this Lin Qinghe, she’s really not simple.”
Wang Ping thought back to the subsequent simulation content and frowned slightly.
Facing the joint attack of the two major forces, she remained so calm. Is it because she has a good mindset or does she have tricks up her sleeve that ordinary people can’t imagine?
Although Lin Qinghe is powerful and has reached the level of a Void Divine Realm Master at a young age, her cultivation is ultimately only at the 3rd tier of the Void Divine Realm and she still falls short against veteran masters of the realm. It’s impossible for her to turn the tides solely relying on herself.
While Wang Ping was considering this, more words began to emerge.
“Facing the joint attack of the two major forces, the Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect furiously called out, accusing the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty of breaking rules. In response, the Divine Sons of both the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty mocked him. They argue that in this world, there are no rules, only fists.”
“The leading elders of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty also chuckled coldly, stating that it was a waste for the three major forces to have a shared possession of the Secret Realm. It would have been better for just the two forces to claim it.”
“Their words filled the Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect with shock and rage, guessing that the two major forces had truly formed an alliance against the Whiteflame Divine Sect. However, he couldn’t understand how they could dare to do this.”
“After all, among the Three Great Forces, the Ancestor of their Whiteflame Divine Sect is the strongest, holding a cultivation at the 4th tier of the God Monarch Realm while the Ancestors of the other two forces only have a cultivation at the 3rd tier of the God Monarch Realm. As long as the Ancestor of their Whiteflame Divine Sect lives, the other two forces won’t have a good outcome even if they mutually devour the Whiteflame Divine Sect.”
“The fury of a mid-stage God Monarch Realm powerhouse is something the two forces cannot bear. Even if the two forces can jointly counter the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, they will still suffer a great headache if the Ancestor decides to lead a guerrilla warfare.”
“Not to mention a God Monarch Realm powerhouse who is stronger in cultivation, even a newly-advanced God Monarch Realm powerhouse can cause them a great headache.”
“It seems like the Divine Sons of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty had seen through the Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s thoughts and laughed coldly. They had received quite reliable information, rumor has it that something has happened to the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, hence this testing of the waters.”
“Soon, a terrifying battle erupted here. The power of the Void Divine Realm Masters exploded indiscriminately, affecting a large area. Although in the Upper Realm, the destructive power caused by the Void Divine Realm Masters wouldn’t reach the level of influence it does in the Underworld, it’s still very terrifying.”
“As for you, you kept fleeing towards the distance, choosing to keep away from the battlefield to avoid being caught up in it. After you had put enough distance in between, you then made use of your real combat power and successfully killed the two 3rd tier Void Divine Realm Masters that were chasing after you.”
“However, to your surprise, a 5th tier Void Divine Realm Master, having killed the other guest elders, turned to kill you.”
“You had no choice but to engage him in battle. But the Void Divine Realm Masters of the Upper Realm are not easy to deal with. With him being few minor realms higher in level, you had no chance of winning.”
“You were hesitant about whether you should use Purple Talent – Fate Connection. But in the end you gave up. Using such a big trump card on a 5th-tier Void Divine Realm Master instead of on a real genius or God Monarch Realm Master would be a waste.”
“In the end, you were killed once by your enemy. After your death, this Void Divine Realm Master greedily tried to loot your body, after all you had just used the power of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and the Burning Emperor Fist. Although this Void Divine Realm Master did not have in-depth knowledge, he knew for sure that both of these were incredibly fearsome moves.”
“However, as he was greedily looting your body, you activated the Red Talent·Death Whisper, and suddenly unleashed a terrifying blow beyond your normal limits. This Void Divine Realm Master was caught off guard and hit directly by your attack, dying on the spot.”

chapters.title: Chapter 546: 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Chapter 175: Swallowing the Immortal Demonic Power!_5
[An hour later, you are resurrected, and after feeling your own corpse, you start considering what to do next…]
The text simulation paused here once again. Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various images and insights, and his vision finally switched back to the secret realm.
“I have to make another choice. Should I continue running away or go back to the battlefield?”
Wang Ping looked into the distance, felt the terrifying aftershocks of the battle, and furrowed his brow.
Joining the battlefield would greatly increase the chances of dying once, and the probability of dying twice wouldn’t be low either.
Of course, if he made use of the Purple Talent – Fate Connection, theoretically he could change the outcome of the battle.
After all, once this talent has been activated, as long as he connects to an elder from either the Green Spirit Divine Sect or the North Snow Divine Dynasty, it would be equivalent to giving the Whiteflame Divine Sect an additional Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm powerhouse.
If he could also pull off a sneak attack, the possibility of the Whiteflame Divine Sect making a comeback would be quite high.
But, would this be of any great benefit to him?
No, it wouldn’t be.
“Let’s go take a look first and try to gain some advantage if there’s a chance. If Lin Qinghe has hidden any moves that would put both sides in a bad situation, I can step in and maybe obtain some benefits.”
“Of course, gaining benefits is secondary. I don’t think this simulation will go very far, but the main purpose is to gather information, make mistakes, and understand future trends.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he made a decision to conceal his aura and quickly fly back.
Upon his return, Wang Ping saw a shocking scene.
The battle was unexpectedly one-sided.
However, it was not the alliance of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty that crushed the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s cultivators – it was the other way around.
To be more precise, most of the people on the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s side were already dead. Then, Lin Qinghe, the Goddess of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, unleashed her true power and began a massacre against the stronger fighters of the other two major powers.
Her cultivation was now at the terrifying 7th tier Void Divine Realm level, and her combat strength was even more terrifying. The 7th-Tier Void Divine Realm experts from both the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty were unable to withstand even a single move from her.
Even the Major Completion Tier Void Divine Realm experts coughed up blood after taking one of her moves and were directly seriously injured, their faces full of disbelief as they looked at her.
“This woman is terrifying.”
Wang Ping watched Lin Qinghe’s battle with a wary expression.
At the same time, Wang Ping couldn’t figure out why Lin Qinghe hid her true strength until most of the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s cultivators were nearly dead before revealing her true power to slaughter the people of the other two major powers.
While Wang Ping was thinking, Lin Qinghe quickly killed the people from the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty. Her white clothes were blood-soaked, creating a sense of violent aesthetics.
“Cough, cough. As expected of Junior Sister Qinghe, truly powerful. Junior Sister, please save me quickly.”
The Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect was lying on the ground, his energy drained, coughing and begging Lin Qinghe for help.
Faced with the Divine Son’s plea, Lin Qinghe walked over and sighed, “I didn’t want to kill you originally, but who let you see something you shouldn’t have? And, I’ve been wanting your original source for a while now.”
After saying this, under the shocked gaze of the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Divine Son, Lin Qinghe slapped him to death with a single blow.
Next, Lin Qinghe looked towards where Wang Ping was hiding and coldly said, “Elder Wang, come out.”
After a moment of silence, Wang Ping knew that he couldn’t escape, so he bravely came out.
Anyway, he still had the Purple Talent – Fate Connection up his sleeve, so he wasn’t afraid of Lin Qinghe.
“Are you with the Demon Cult?”
Wang Ping stared at Lin Qinghe, speaking solemnly.
Lin Qinghe’s style was indistinguishable from the Demon Cult.
She was clearly the mantis hunting the cicada, waiting for everyone to die before seizing their original sources.
“Elder Wang, you’ve cultivated the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter, haven’t you?”
Lin Qinghe licked her lips without answering Wang Ping’s question, affirming with confidence.
“So what if I did, and what if I didn’t?”
Wang Ping spoke solemnly.
“The Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm also quite tempting to me. Could you please give it to me, Elder Wang?”
Lin Qinghe smiled charmingly.
“If I hand it over, will you let me go?”
Wang Ping asked calmly.
“Of course not, I’ve had my eye on your original source for a long time. The original source of a Void Divine Realm cultivator who successfully cultivated the Emperor Scripture is much more valuable than that of ordinary cultivators. I can’t possibly let it go.”
Lin Qinghe slowly spoke.
“So this is your true purpose for getting close to me?”
Wang Ping sighed.
All his previous guesses were wrong, and Lin Qinghe was not in danger at all. She was just a dangerous and scheming woman.
Entering the secret realm meant death.
Coming this way also meant death.
This was the true meaning of the options.
“Of course. For someone with the Devouring Immortal Demon Body like me, the original sources of geniuses and strong cultivators are the most attractive.”
Lin Qinghe spoke slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 547: 176: The First Golden Talent! Dao Palace!
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Dao Palace!
“This is really difficult.”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Qinghe and sighed.
He originally didn’t want to use Purple Talent – Fate Connection so quickly.
But now it seemed that he had to use it.
However, connecting his fate with Lin Qinghe, who had cultivated a terrifying demonic skill, was not necessarily a bad thing.
In the future, he might be able to get many cultivation resources through her.
With this thought, Wang Ping immediately used his talent to connect with Lin Qinghe.
However, when Wang Ping thought he had successfully connected with Lin Qinghe and began to skillfully threaten self-injury, something happened that made his pupils shrink.
Lin Qinghe was completely unharmed!
“Aren’t you at the Divine Realm cultivation level?”
Wang Ping asked somewhat incredulously.
Purple Talent – Fate Connection could only be resisted by those above the God Monarch Realm, yet Lin Qinghe in front of him was immune. This was quite frightening.
“What did you just do?”
Instead of answering Wang Ping’s question, Lin Qinghe frowned and asked.
She had just felt an strange force connect to her body, and she had not been able to react to it. It was very bizarre.
However, it seemed that it had no effect on her.
“No, you’re definitely not at the Saint Realm cultivation level. If you were, you wouldn’t be interested in the Divine Realm’s origin.”
Wang Ping frowned and began to think.
However, if not for the Saint Realm, why would the talent fail? That was a problem.
“Maybe, I can use the text simulation to draw a conclusion.”
Wang Ping secretly thought in his heart and chose to enter the text simulation state.
[Seeing you not answering the question, Lin Qinghe becomes annoyed and suppresses you directly, forcing you to reveal what you did. You don’t hide it and choose to answer.]
[After hearing this, Lin Qinghe is astonished. She didn’t expect you to have such a terrifying secret skill. Fortunately, she has a dual soul in one body and another ‘Lin Qinghe’ hibernating inside her. Her previous life’s cultivation level reached a terrifying level. If it weren’t for this, she would have really been in trouble after being affected by this secret skill.]
[Immediately, to prevent you from using any more terrifying secret skills, Lin Qinghe decides to kill you and devour your origin.]
[Because of your death, you trigger Death Speech and unleash a terrifying blow. Even Lin Qinghe, caught off guard, is hit and suffers significant injuries, looking very miserable.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends…]
…
“So, it’s a dual soul in one body. However, this awakening of the past life’s soul should be different from Ji Bingyan’s case.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, finally knowing the reason, and frowned slightly.
“This Lin Qinghe is very dangerous. Next time after ascending, I can’t enter the Whiteflame Divine Sect again. To be precise, I can’t join the Three Great Forces. That’s too risky. I have to be a loose cultivator or join a truly powerful force.”
Wang Ping silently pondered.
When he was in the lower realm, he often faced assassination attempts. Later, he joined Heavenly Sword Divine Land and was taken as a disciple by the Heavenly Sword Saint Master, which brought him protection and improved his situation.
If possible, Wang Ping would like to replicate the operation in the lower realm and try to join an Upper Realm power or even become a son-in-law of an Imperial Clan.
If he could achieve that, he would have both cultivation skills and background.
Unfortunately, his talent was not enough. It might be feasible to join, but to be taken as a disciple by those truly big shots, he probably lacked the qualifications.
“I still need to refresh a powerful Innate Root Talent or Physique Talent. Only when my talent catches up can I join a major power or receive protection or investment from a super-strong cultivator.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, looking forward to what good talent he could refresh in the final simulation.
Just then, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and he returned to reality, leaving the simulation state.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one from the following rewards:
①.1st tier Void Divine Realm Cultivation.
②.A random Lower-tier Artifact.
③.Red Talent·Death Whisper.
④.A random Heavenly tier artifact.
⑤.A random share of divine source or divine mine.”
“System, I choose ③. Red Talent·Death Whisper.”
Wang Ping made a quick decision after looking at the reward list.
“System, I want to consume three Heavenly tier artifacts for the Paid Simulation.”
Then, without hesitation, Wang Ping spoke again in his heart.
“Ding, consumption successful. Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations host on successfully refreshing Golden Talent – Scarlet Flame Sacred Body; Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique.”
Golden Talent – Scarlet Flame Sacred Body: This physique is extremely powerful, yet requires an enormous amount of cultivation resources, so much so that even Holy Lands struggle to support it. At the same time, this physique is cursed by an unknown existence and is difficult to enter the Saint Realm.
Red Talent – Fire Profound Physique:…..
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was genuinely surprised at the blinding golden talent refreshed this time.
This was his first time refreshing a Golden Talent, and it was his familiar Scarlet Flame Sacred Body.
“Chifeng has the Scarlet Flame Sacred Body. But was the Scarlet Flame Sacred Body actually cursed by an unknown existence? Is it because of the Chi Clan Great Emperor Ancestor?”
Wang Ping thought of the following introduction and frowned slightly, secretly pondering in his heart.
“It’s normal for the Sacred Body to require a lot of cultivation resources. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so much stronger than others in the same realm. As for being cursed and difficult to enter the Saint Realm…that’s irrelevant for now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 548: 176: The First Golden Talent! Dao Palace! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Dao Palace! _2
Wang Ping shook his head slightly.
Nowadays, it is difficult to achieve sainthood in the Last Dharma Age. Therefore, the difficulty of a sacred body entering saint realm seemed temporarily unimportant. He should first use this physique to become stronger.
As for the future, he could think about it later. He refused to mentally exhaust himself; that would start with him.
“System, I choose the Golden Talent – Scarlet Flame Sacred Body.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
As the system’s voice once again rang out, Wang Ping’s perception blurred, and he knew he had entered the immersive simulation state.
“Next, system, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping hesitated no more and spoke in his heart.
“Ding, fast-forwarding….”
Again, the system’s voice rang, a luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate. Thanks to the Red Fire Holy Body, you effortlessly grasped the Fire Pseudo-rule, making it an extremely pleasant experience.]
[In this moment, you finally enjoyed the same feeling Chifeng had of cultivating as easy as eating and drinking – quite refreshing.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years passed. You successfully comprehended 40% of the Pseudo-rule of Fire, with 50% not far off. Your comprehension speed could be described as terrifyingly fast.]
[However, during these ten years of cultivation, you depleted all the lower-tier God’s Sources in your possession and barely broke through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier. You felt helpless, as the cultivation resources consumed by the powerful Red Fire Holy Body were somewhat terrifying.]
[Now, you’re convinced that even if you were to rob Young Master Mo of all his cultivation resources, it would still be difficult for you to break through to the Void Divine Realm.]
[Of course, although you’re unlikely to achieve Void Lord status, your current combat power is far stronger than when you broke through to the Void Divine Realm in your memory.]
[This is because the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture had an extraordinarily high compatibility with the Red Fire Holy Body. Their combined power was explosive and terrifying to an extreme extent.]
[Continuing on, you cultivated diligently in the lower realm, waiting for Mo Young Master to descend so you could seize their cultivation resources.]
[During your cultivation, you remembered the Xia Forbidden Land on the back of the Profound Turtle. You had a very unique feeling about it back then, so now that you’re stronger, you wanted to see the secrets it held.]
[After some consideration, you chose to enter it. Upon entering, you discovered that although this secret realm is located on the back of the Profound Turtle, the space it connects to is not there – the small world within is astonishing.]
[At the same time, you noticed that a powerful Demonic Path Cultivator should be sealed within. With your interest piqued, you entered the sacred realm.]
[When you started cultivating, you recalled the familiar voice in your memories and the start of the trials. You honestly accepted the trials and discovered the maximum difficulty was nothing; you easily crushed it.]
[Subsequently, finding it troublesome, you forcibly broke the seal to see the being sealed inside. Turns out, the so-called trials were created by the sealed being.]
[The sealed being was indeed a demonic cultivator and a very powerful one at that. You vaguely sensed that their cultivation level had attained a level higher than the True Divine Realm, but they had suffered a decline in power after descending to the lower realm and being sealed twice. Their current strength was probably only at the ordinary 3rd tier Void Divine Realm.]
[Seeing a Quasi-Immortal like you forcibly break the seal to enter, the demonic cultivator was astonished. He then tried to tempt you to release him from his seal with the offer of a powerful inheritance.]
[You didn’t care for it and dismissed the offer. The demonic cultivator grew angry, but restrained himself and tempted you again, claiming he knew about the Demon Lord Inheritance in the lower realm and asked if you wanted to know its secrets.]
[Hearing about the Demon Lord Inheritance, your interest was piqued, and you grew curious about why this demonic cultivator was sealed here.]
[Following that, you listened to the demonic cultivator recount his past. He had accidentally learned that the Demon Lord’s weapon was sealed in the Purple Spirit Realm by a terrifying existence and decided to descend to the lower realm.]
[However, when he descended, he was unexpectedly discovered by the so-called righteous cultivators who pursued him. They couldn’t kill him due to the limitations of the lower realm and could only use various methods to seal him here.]
[You didn’t care for the demonic cultivator’s past, only the Demon Lord Inheritance. The inheritance was that of the Black Abyss Demon Lord. If you obtained it, it would be amazing; there might even be countless heavenly materials and earthly treasures waiting for you.]
[However, the demonic cultivator here had no intention of continuing to talk. He wished for you to release his seal before telling you about the inheritance.]
[Faced with his machinations, you thought about it and chose to remove his seal. You didn’t believe he would tell you, but you were unafraid of him attacking you even if you did.]
[As expected, the demonic cultivator became arrogant after his seal was removed. He became extremely confident, claiming that if you surrendered, he would spare your life.]
[At this, you were left speechless. This guy was being a little too confident in himself. Seeing your silence, he became furious and chose to attack you directly.]
[The demonic cultivator was very confident in himself. He had once been a Half-step Lord, and even with his power reduced to the ordinary 3rd tier Void Divine Realm due to the seals, his comprehended six Pseudo Rules and Divine Skills still allowed him to be terrifyingly powerful. He could even fight those at the 7th tier Void Divine Realm and above.]

chapters.title: Chapter 549: 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _3
[In such a lower realm, dealing with a Quasi-Immortal, even if this Quasi-Immortal is quite strange and has an astonishing battle prowess, should definitely not pose a challenge for you.]
[Faced with the Demonic Cultivator’s confident attack, your expression remains calm as you choose to strike back without holding back, displaying your Sacred Body, 40% Pseudo-rule of Fire, and Burning Emperor Fist. The power you display shocks the Demonic Cultivator, causing him to vomit blood.]
[He feels his scalp tingle, not expecting that there would be such a monstrous existence like you in the Lower World. He wants to flee, but you have no intention of letting him go; you directly use Red Talent: Group Taunt, which has a certain effect on the Demonic Cultivator.]
[You launch another terrifying attack, bursting the Demonic Cultivator’s physical body directly and seizing his soul. The Demonic Cultivator is frightened to the extreme and begs for your mercy, offering to tell you everything he knows.]
[As you look at the pleading Demonic Cultivator, your expression is subtle; Lower World cultivators are mostly ruthless, and when they know they are going to die, they often choose to self-destruct to bring you down with them. This Upper World Demon Cultivator, however, seems to lack backbone.]
[However, you don’t let your guard down and continue to suppress him, not giving him the slightest chance to escape. Seeing that he can’t deceive you, the Demonic Cultivator seems helpless and even tries to bargain with you, vowing to keep his secrets if you don’t agree to his terms.]
[In response, you let out a chuckle, forcefully suppress him and try to completely annihilate him. As for you, not knowing the secret in this lifetime doesn’t really matter; after all, you’ll have plenty of opportunities in the future. As long as you’re strong enough, you can forcibly soul-search him, so the Demonic Cultivator’s attempt to threaten you was futile.]
[Seeing your domineering attitude and your determination to annihilate him, the Demonic Cultivator can only sigh in his heart, knowing that his death is certain. Yet even in death, he refuses to reveal any secrets.]
[You don’t mind, burn his soul to nothingness, and get rid of him completely. Then you start collecting the spoils of war from his body.]
[As a result, you gain nothing, leaving you very disappointed. You suspect that the Upper Realm power that sealed him might have taken everything from his body. This situation is quite similar to that of Blood Demon Yuan Feng when he was sealed.]
[After all, not taking the spoils of war after defeating an enemy would be a strange thing.]
…..
“So, the Xia Forbidden Land contains such secrets. Perhaps, he has the correct method to tame Demonic Artifacts on his body. Of course, the possibility is slim.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content, somewhat astonished.
That being said, you really can’t just barge into some forbidden areas.
Otherwise, you might come across some old monsters sealed within that pose a great danger.
But who could have thought that a Novice Village would be so dangerous? It’s really quite frustrating.
Thinking about how fearless he was when he was weak, entering the real world just for a spiritual tool, he was really courting death.
Wang Ping shakes his head, sighs a bit, and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you leave this place and continue your cultivation while also accepting Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er as your disciples. In this life, you can’t ascend through your own means, so you plan to follow the path you remember.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years pass, and you successfully comprehend the 7-Tier Fire Pseudo Law, completely surpassing the half-step God Lord Realm Demon Cultivator in your understanding of the law.]
[In another blink of an eye, nearly a thousand years have passed. During this time, your understanding of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture deepens, and you have long since comprehended the Great Perfection Fire Pseudo Law.]
[However, it is very unfortunate that this is the Lower World, where comprehending the Pseudo Laws is extremely difficult. It would be against the heavens if you could comprehend the Great Perfection Fire Pseudo Law in just a thousand years. It can only be said that the help your Red Fire Holy Body provides to Fire Attribute Dao cultivation is simply too horrific.]
[As for the laws, even in the Upper Realm during the Last Dharma Age, they were already in the domain of the Saint Realm. Nowadays, with the changes in the rules of heaven and earth, laws have become obscure and difficult to comprehend. Even with a Sacred Body, it is difficult to comprehend them in a short amount of time.]
[Not to mention, there is such a thing as the Sacred Body’s Curse. Therefore, you have long given up on comprehending the laws and continued to deepen your understanding of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture: Mortal Realm Chapter, using it to deduce your own path and create your own Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills for your future.]
[Though your self-created Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills are insignificant compared to the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, you must walk your own path based on your predecessors’ foundation in order to become an Emperor in the future. Otherwise, it would be impossible to achieve the status of Emperor.]
[In order to do that, it is necessary and compulsory to create your own Cultivation Skills and even Emperor Scriptures by learning from various Saint tier methods and Great Emperor Scriptures.]
[As more than a thousand years have passed, the development of the Purple Spirit Realm is somewhat different from your memory, but you don’t mind. You capture all the invaders from the Blood Demon Realm alive and feed them to Lin Yuanyuan.]
[As a result, Lin Yuanyuan’s energy scale has far surpassed that of an ordinary Quasi-Immortal. However, she has a powerful physical body, Mana, and soul but lacks comprehension in cultivation, making it difficult for her to become a god on her own.]
[Maybe this is the drawback of Lin Yuanyuan’s Golden Finger. However, you think that if Lin Yuanyuan’s Golden Finger was optimized one more time, it might be able to solve this problem. Once that’s done, it could extract the comprehension of cultivation from her targets as well. At that time, it would be truly terrifying.]

chapters.title: Chapter 550: 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _4
…
“The Sacred Body is truly powerful. The Great Perfection Pseudo-Law, something that a vast majority of God Monarchs cannot comprehend, was understood by him within a mere thousand years in the lower realms. It’s simply terrifying.”
Wang Ping gazed at the simulation content and found himself in awe.
For the typical cultivator….
A 10-30% understanding of the Pseudo-Law belongs to the domain of the Void lord.
A 40-60% understanding of the Pseudo-Law belongs to the domain of the True Lord.
Comprehending more than 70% of the Pseudo-Law is the domain of the God Monarch.
God Monarchs, with their lengthy lives, spend ages just to possibly comprehend the Great Perfection Pseudo-Law.
Yet, for him, it merely took a thousand years, and this was in a lower world, a place tougher to achieve Enlightenment. Just comparing, one could see how powerful the talents brought by the Sacred Body truly are.”
“Unfortunately, in the Upper Realm, it is the Last Dharma Age. The rules of Heaven and Earth keep changing, making it difficult to comprehend the laws and achieve divinity. Moreover, there’s the curse of the Sacred Body as well. I reckon that for a long time, he will be stuck at the stage of the Great Perfection Pseudo-Law.”
Wang Ping recalled the situation in the Upper Realm and shook his head slightly.
“I just wonder when the rules of Heaven and Earth in the Upper Realm will change again, entering the Golden Age….”
Wang Ping pondered.
While he was lost in thought, the text appeared on the luminescent screen.
[Following this, Young Master Mo and his underling went to the Lower Realm. After they entered the Primordial Forbidden Land, you caught them, and under a guise, you displayed your value, hoping to join the Mo family and ascend to the Upper Realm.]
[Upon hearing this, Young Master Mo was interested in you, a heavenly genius from the lower realms, and proposed that if you let him implant a slave imprint on you, he would let you follow him.]
[Seeing this, you furrowed your brows, realizing that addressing this issue peacefully was impossible. Young Master Mo didn’t trust you, and you couldn’t convince him not to enter the lands of the strong to lift a part of the seal with your words.]
[So, you decided to strike. This time, instead of connecting with him through destiny, you chose to rely on your own strength and launched a strong attack on Young Master Mo and his servant.]
[Young Master Mo’s servant was casually suppressed by you and then utterly drained by Lin Yuanyuan. Young Master Mo was also casually suppressed by you. To him, this was a great humiliation. He, an Upper Realm Heavenly Genius, was trampled upon by a lower realm Quasi-Immortal. It was an utter humiliation that he didn’t even get the opportunity to use his Forbidden Artifacts.]
[It was then that Young Master Mo’s Sacred Artifact awakened on its own, intending to suppress you. The Sacred Artifact was terrifying, and although its self-awakening could not bring out its full potential, it would still easily kill you.]
[However, you were prepared and let Cai Yonglong use the power of the Golden Finger to block the might of the Sacred Artifact, then you directly punched it into the depths of the Primordial Forbidden Land.]
[With the explosion of divine power and the Sacred Artifact falling into the deepest part of Primordial Sacred Land and colliding with the seals, the sealed demonic artifact within the Primordial Forbidden Land was enraged. The demonic artifact, filled with wrath, suppressed the might of the Sacred Artifact.]
[You then handed Young Master Mo over to Lin Yuanyuan to drain him. Thus, the tragedy of Young Master Mo’s fall occured and Lin Yuanyuan once again became stronger.]
[As the two of them fell, all the good things they had became yours. You looked at the valuable items on their bodies and felt very satisfied.]
[Next, you attempted to find a way back to the Upper Realm amongst the items. Eventually, you found the Ascending Talisman.]
[This made you very happy. However, another issue came to mind: where exactly does this Ascending Talisman lead to? You strongly suspected that using this Ascending Talisman to go to the Upper Realm would send you straight to the Mo family’s headquarters, or perhaps there would be a bunch of Mo family powerhouses waiting for you.]
[If you use this Ascending Talisman to ascend, your chances of dying would be too great. In the end, you sighed and gave up your plan to ascend to the Upper Realm using the Ascending Talisman. Instead, you decided to wait for Ji Bingyan’s return to the Jee family before letting her lead you to the Upper Realm.]
[However, you began to consider another issue. That is, if Young Master Mo does not return to the Upper Realm, would the people of the Mo Family send someone to the Lower Realm again? If they do send people again, your situation would not be very good.]
[Though you are currently extremely formidable, your cultivation is, after all, at the Quasi-Immortal stage. If the Mo family sends an old monster to the Lower Realm, even though it would need to suppress its cultivation, it wouldn’t be easy to deal with.]
[Moreover, some old monsters would be able to exert their true power if they came to the Lower Realm together. The Lower Realm may require one to self-tittle their cultivation, but that does not mean that these real old monsters are unable to unravel the seal.]
[Once they unlock the seal, you would definitely be easily squashed to death.]
[Thinking of this problem, you started to think about a way out. It was clearly not feasible to continue staying in the Purple Spirit Realm. You must move to another location.]
[Soon, you thought of the Blood Demon Realm. By heading to the Blood Demon Realm and destroying the Purple Spirit Realm, you could perfectly cover up the issue. Even if the people of the Mo Family came to the Lower Realm, they wouldn’t suspect that you killed Young Master Mo and his servant.]
[Having made a plan, you began to arrange for the major Holy Lands and powerful forces to transfer as many living beings as possible from the Purple Spirit Realm to the Blood Demon Realm.]
[Although you wanted to be wary of the Mo family, you also didn’t want to implicate so many innocent beings from the Purple Spirit Realm. As for the Purple Spirit Realm, you could only apologize.]

chapters.title: Chapter 551: 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _5
[Although the various Holy Lands cannot understand why you say that a great extinction will occur in the future, and the Purple Spirit Realm will be destroyed, they can only obey your command due to your powerful strength, and begin organizing the migration.]
[A year later, most of the living beings were forcibly ordered by you to migrate away from the Purple Spirit Realm, leaving behind only a small part who were unwilling to leave. Regarding this, you didn’t say much and began your action.]
[You activated the forbidden artifact’s terrifying power and destroyed the Purple Spirit Realm directly. Then, you returned to the Blood Demon Realm and sealed the channel between the Two Realms completely.]
[In the blink of an eye, twenty years passed by. Decades have passed, and you still haven’t received any guidance from Ji Bingyan. The Mo Family in the Upper Realm, however, couldn’t sit still. Young Master Mo and the servant from the Moo family had been in the lower realm for so long and hadn’t returned, it was very likely that there had been a problem.]
[For this reason, the Mo Family sent out dozens of powerhouses to the lower realm again. Among these seven powerful beings, the weakest was at the Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm, and the strongest reached the realm of half-step God Monarch.]
[After they descended to the lower realm, they saw the destroyed Purple Spirit Realm, shocked and anxious.]
[This was because the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm meant that something big had happened, and Young Master Mo might have died too. Young Master Mo had a sacred artifact with him if it were lost, the consequences would be unimaginable.]
[Soon, they discovered something unusual. Because the Purple Spirit Realm was destroyed, the entrance to the Primordial Forbidden Land still existed. After discovering the entrance to the Primordial Forbidden Land, they entered it.]
[Relying on their powerful cultivation, they managed to penetrate a certain distance. When the Spirit of Holy Artifact in the Primordial Forbidden Land detected the Mo Family’s arrival, it voluntarily made contact with them and was summoned back by the half-step God King Realm powerhouse of the Moo family.]
[Soon, they learned about the whole story, about you killing Young Master Mo, and were all furious to the extreme, wanting to crush your bones and scatter your ashes.]
[However, because you had already destroyed the Purple Spirit Realm, they couldn’t find your whereabouts and could only speculate that you had ascended to the Upper Realm, wanting to search for you in the Upper Realm.]
…
“This Mo family is really troublesome. If the Holy Artifact can’t be handled, there will be hidden dangers. But, not detecting the existence of the Blood Demon Realm is still a blessing in disguise. It seems that when Young Master Mo was in the Purple Spirit Realm, the Spirit of Holy Artifact was always in a dormant state, so he didn’t know about the Blood Demon Realm.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, frowned slightly, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years passed. During these hundreds of years, you had been cultivating and seeking Enlightenment. However, seeking Enlightenment in the lower realm was ultimately too difficult. Although you had some gains, there was no breakthrough progress.]
[Now, hundreds of years have passed, and you are quite sure that the Mo family people probably didn’t expect that you would come to the Blood Demon Realm, so you breathed a sigh of relief.]
[However, what troubles you is that neither Ji Bingyan nor Chifeng have any intention of guiding you. You don’t know whether it’s because of the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm or if something happened to both of them. Chifeng’s disappearance, in your opinion, the possibility of being taken back is minimal, and it is very likely that the disaster has completely erupted, causing all of them to die.]
[As for Ji Bingyan, you can’t guess the situation. It could be that Ji Bingyan returned to the Jee family, her status was insufficient, and she couldn’t fight for the opportunity to guide you, or she had fallen.]
[Of course, you haven’t given up the idea of continuing to ascend. Since Ji Bingyan and Chifeng were most probably in trouble, then you would continue to cultivate Void Divine Realm Masters, believing that at least one person would be able to guide you to the Upper Realm.]
[Over the years, you have been cultivating Ye Chen. Now, with your all-out effort to cultivate him without considering resource consumption, Ye Chen is about to break through to the Void Divine Realm.]
[As long as Ye Chen enters the Upper Realm and develops for a while, he should be able to guide you to the Upper Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, several decades passed, and Ye Chen successfully broke through to the Void Divine Realm, ascending to the Upper Realm. Before leaving, he promised you that he would definitely guide you to the Upper Realm.]
[Regarding this, you were quite pleased. However, you didn’t fully rely on Ye Chen’s idea. As the saying goes, it’s better to rely on yourself than on others. If Ye Chen fails or fails to grow, you will probably die of old age in the lower realm.]
[For this reason, you chose to forcefully ascend to the Upper Realm along Ye Chen’s ascension channel.]
[In the past, you couldn’t do it, but now you had powerful combat skills and were confident that you had a certain success rate.]
[Faced with your unrestrained behavior, Ye Chen was dumbfounded. In the end, you forced your way into the ascension channel, facing the terrifying spatial turbulence and rule suppression, intending to ascend to the Upper Realm with Ye Chen.]
[However, going against the rules is obviously not that easy. When you successfully ascended halfway, the spatial turbulence became extremely terrifying. Even though you possessed the Red Fire Holy Body and had cultivated the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, mastering the Pseudo-rule of Fire to the Great Perfection Tier, you were still somewhat unbearable.]
[However, even so, you still didn’t give up and continued to forcefully ascend. In the end, you died during the ascension process and entered the resurrection countdown state.]
[Seeing your death, Ye Chen was filled with grief, thinking that you were too overconfident, and continued to ascend with your corpse, intending to bury you in a proper place in the Upper Realm. Because your body turned into a corpse, the ascension channel no longer repelled you, and you were successfully taken to the Upper Realm by Ye Chen.]

chapters.title: Chapter 552: 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Chapter 176: The First Golden Talent! Tao Palace! _6
…..
“Ugh… The normal method of ascension doesn’t work, and this bizarre situation of ascending as a corpse has occurred. It’s truly laughable and frustrating at the same time.”
Wang Ping was staring at the simulation content, his expression subtle as he couldn’t help but rub his forehead.
That scene was just too unbelievable even to imagine.
However, he wasn’t sure if the ascension point in the Blood Demon Realm was the same as in the Purple Spirit Realm.
If the Blood Demon Realm’s ascension point was the same as that of the Purple Spirit Realm, then there would be trouble, and he would need to make a move.
“By the way, why didn’t my death trigger Death Speech this time? If the effects of Death Speech were triggered, Ye Chen would have died too. It seems that this talent only works on enemies and won’t affect allies to a certain extent.”
Wang Ping recalled the effects of Red Talent·Death Whisper and thought about it secretly.
[Not long after, you successfully arrived in the Upper Realm. After arriving in the Upper Realm, Ye Chen discovered that he was being targeted by people from several major powers. They were surprisingly from Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty. In addition, there were people from the Mo family.]
[As for Whiteflame Divine Sect, they didn’t appear. That’s because Whiteflame Divine Sect was wiped out a thousand years ago by two major powers joining forces.]
[However, since you had been turned into a broken corpse and were stored in Ye Chen’s Storage Ring, neither side discovered your existence.]
[In the end, Ye Chen, after some consideration, chose to join the Green Spirit Divine Sect. As for the people from the North Snow Divine Dynasty, they frowned but did not try to stop him.]
[It was only when Ye Chen was being taken to the Green Spirit Divine Sect by a Void Divine Realm Master that your resurrection countdown finally ended. You successfully revived, broke open the storage space, and appeared in the outer world.]
[With your resurrection, the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master was taken aback. As for Ye Chen, he was similarly startled and didn’t expect you to be playing dead.]
[However, Ye Chen was overjoyed by your resurrection, as you were his respected master, and he naturally didn’t want you to truly perish. As for the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master, he was somewhat astonished because he didn’t know how you appeared, nor what your background was.]
[Also, as a Quasi-Immortal, you were able to make him, a 7th-Tier Void Divine Realm Master, feel an intense sense of danger, which was quite strange.]
[You glanced at the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master, slightly frowning. Without any hesitation, you unleashed the most terrifying attack at him. Due to your sudden strike, the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master was directly blasted by you on the spot and his body and spirit were completely destroyed.]
[Ye Chen was totally dumbfounded and didn’t know why you attacked the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master. This was undoubtedly a deliberate attempt to make an enemy of a major power, and there was absolutely no benefit in doing so.]
[As for this, you couldn’t give an explanation. After all, this Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master knew about your existence. If he wasn’t killed, the news of your arrival in the Upper Realm would leak out.]
[By that time, if the Mo family detected your presence, you would face relentless pursuit and an attempt to kill you. Facing the hunt by the Mo family, you wouldn’t have any good solutions to counter.]
[Even though you could rely on Purple Talent – Fate Connection to connect yourself with the fate of a God King Realm powerhouse in the Mo family, the Mo family, as an ancient force with a long heritage and the birth of Saint Realm Powerhouses, would definitely have more than one God King Realm powerhouse.]
[Therefore, if the Mo family found out about your existence, your chance of perishing would be very high. So, even though you didn’t like to kill indiscriminately, for your own safety, you had no choice but to make a move, killing your fellow taoist instead of letting poverty kill you.]
[It turned out that you made the right decision. The Mo family had long posted a bounty hunt on the Elemental Star. The Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Void Divine Realm Master had just been startled and didn’t recognize you at the first moment.]
[If you hadn’t killed him and had waited a bit longer, he would have recognized you as the person the Mo family placed a heavy bounty on hundreds of years ago. Once your whereabouts were revealed, death would be certain.]
[Afterward, you made a few more moves, erased traces, and quickly took Ye Chen away from the scene.]
[Soon, the powerful experts of the Green Spirit Divine Sect arrived here, furious beyond belief. When they learned of the Void Divine Realm Master’s death during Ye Chen’s escorting process, they wanted to find Ye Chen and extract his soul to refine the blood.]
[You didn’t know that Ye Chen had taken the blame for you. At this moment, you were thinking about how to earn more divine sources to break through to the Void God Realm.]
[Although you obtained quite a few divine sources from the previous Void Divine Realm Master, the amount was still far from enough. To break through to the Void God Realm, you estimated that you needed at least several thousands of jin (roughly 1,000 kg) of Lower-tier God’s Source.]
[Cultivating Emperor Sutra and possessing the Red Fire Holy Body, you had become like a gold-swallowing beast. Ordinary God Sects might be able to support your cultivation in the Void Divine Realm, but it would certainly be difficult to support your later cultivation.]
[Don’t even mention God Sects, even a 1st-tier Holy Land would probably struggle to support your terrifying consumption in the God King Realm. However, though you were thinking this way, you still didn’t give up the idea of joining a major power.]
[Only by joining a major power would you have a reliable backing and not be targeted by some old monsters. You could then have a fair competition with your peers and grow up relatively safely.]
[After that, you considered and decided to join a force in the Middle Area of the Elemental Star.]
[This force was called Tao Palace. It was rumored that the Tao Palace had given birth to an Emperor before. However, the era was too distant, so the Tao Palace had become rather desolate.]
[Yet, even though Tao Palace had fallen into desolation, it was still a force that had once given birth to an Emperor and had an Extreme Emperor Soldier to defend it. Ordinary forces wouldn’t dare to provoke Tao Palace.]
[It could be said that as long as you joined Tao Palace, not only would you be able to obtain the Great Emperor Sutra for your later cultivation, but you would also receive protection. If some old monsters wanted to lay hands on you, they would have to think twice. And ordinary forces wouldn’t dare to touch you easily.]

chapters.title: Chapter 553: 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Chapter 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!
[Since you made the decision, you started heading to the Tao Palace with Ye Chen. Because you had anticipated the possibility of being hunted down in the years you spent in the Lower Realm, you have been studying the secret skill of concealing yourself.]
[After years of research, you successfully created a secret skill that even a God King Realm powerhouse could not easily detect your presence and disguise, while also being able to avoid search-related secret skills.]
[As Ye Chen’s master, he naturally learned the secret skill you created. Therefore, although the Green Spirit Divine Sect was searching for you everywhere, even using powerful magical and secret skills, they still could not find you.]
[In the end, you spent all your savings and successfully transferred to a location not far from Tao Palace through a major power’s transmission array.]
[After arriving near the Dao Palace, you went through some twists and turns before successfully reaching the Tao Palace and paying your respects. The Mountain-protecting Disciples of Tao Palace were quite surprised at your sudden arrival.]
[However, they had no intention of driving you away and reported to the elders of the Tao Palace. In the end, the Tao Palace elders decided to meet you both.]
[Next, without any hesitation, you showed your Sacred Body to them. This shocked the Tao Palace elders, who hadn’t expected you to possess such a constitution.]
[Because of this, they reported once again, and you were successfully received by the palace master of the Tao Palace. However, to your disappointment, the palace master sighed and said that he really wanted to let you join the Tao Palace, but he couldn’t do so.]
[You were astonished and asked for the reason. The palace master told you explicitly that the Tao Palace had become somewhat desolate, and the resources required to cultivate a Sacred Body were too huge, making it impossible to reach the Saint Realm in the future. With these resources, it was better to cultivate ordinary God King Realm geniuses at regular intervals to ensure that the Tao Palace wouldn’t continue to decline.]
[Besides, if the rules of heaven and earth change again, the Sacred Body will not become a Saint. Even if their Same Realm Battle Power is far inferior to that of the Sacred Body, once they Enter the Saint Realm, they can easily slap the Sacred Body to death. In other words, the cost-effectiveness of cultivating a Sacred Body is too low.]
[After hearing these words, you felt heavy in your heart but weren’t surprised. However, you felt it was illogical not to focus on cultivating or even accepting you just because of this.]
[Seeing your doubt, the palace master told you the truth after a moment of silence. As a constitution that is targeted by darkness, if you stayed in the Tao Palace, it could bring about destruction to the palace.]
[You were astonished and couldn’t help but ask about the origin of the darkness and what it is. Was it some fallen powerhouses?]
[The kindly palace master explained in detail. The origin of darkness is unknown even to the long-standing Tao Palace, and there are no records of it. It seems that darkness was born with the Big Universe, becoming a symbol of terror and mystery.]
[In areas shrouded by the Source of Darkness, the unknown creatures within it instilled fear in people. Even when observed from afar, people would be polluted and give birth to Heart Demons, even being tempted to embrace darkness.]
[Therefore, the place where the Source of Darkness is located is an absolute forbidden area, and cultivators must not approach it.]
[In addition, the Source of Darkness is terrifying, not only giving birth to powerful monsters called Black Shadows, but also allowing cultivators who embrace darkness to gain power far exceeding their realm.]
[Every once in a while, these monsters wreak havoc in the world, causing endless catastrophes for living beings. When such a Dark Disaster occurs, if there is an Emperor in the world, they will fight a shocking battle against the darkness, suppressing it.]
[But the Source of Darkness is too terrifying, and powerful Black Shadows can even rival Supremes and Quasi-Emperors. Add the existence of those powerhouses embracing darkness, even an Emperor fighting against the Dark Disaster would pay a heavy price and couldn’t solve the fundamental problem.]
[The Burning Emperor was the one who suppressed the Dark Disaster a hundred thousand years ago. He wasn’t just an Emperor but also had a Red Fire Holy Body, reaching an incredibly powerful level.]
[In his twilight years, the Dark Disaster broke out, and everyone was terrified. However, even in his old age, the Burning Emperor was still extremely formidable.]
[The Burning Emperor, even in his old age, still managed to suppress the Dark Disaster. In the end, he forcefully entered the Source of Darkness, trying to suppress it completely in his final moments and bring peace to the world.]
[In the end, the Burning Emperor disappeared, and both the Chi Clan and the Sacred Body lineage were cursed by the mysterious forces from the Source of Darkness. The rules of heaven and earth changed, and the Red Fire Holy Body was no longer suitable for cultivation, making it difficult for them to Enter the Saint Realm.]
[Now in the Last Dharma Age, it goes without saying that the path of the Red Fire Holy Body has long been severed.]
[As a result, some powers may choose to cultivate other Sacred Bodies, but they would never choose to cultivate Red Fire Holy Body or dare to accept it. Because the path of the Red Fire Holy Body has been severed and cursed with something unknown from the Source of Darkness, many powers believe that the Red Fire Holy Body easily brings disasters.]
[Over the years, the cultivation limit of the Chi Clan has continued to decline, and from time to time, they have encountered unknown forces, affecting other people and powers, causing widespread fear.]

chapters.title: Chapter 554: 177: The Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm! Real Terrifying!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Chapter 177: The Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm! Real Terrifying!_2
[Under such circumstances, even the major powers that had given birth to emperors and had Imperial Forces maintaining their fortune, wouldn’t choose to harbor the Red Fire Holy Body. It’s not that they had no affection for the Red Fire Holy Body, quite the contrary, they were fond of it, but for the continuation of their own forces, they have no other choices.]
[In the end, a master determined that the further away from the Source of Darkness, the weaker the curse effect would be. As a result, the Chi Clan secretly migrated and disappeared from the sight of other cultivators.]
…..
“So there’s such a history. The Burning Emperor is even more powerful than I thought… But this world is so bizarre, Alpha, are you sure this Source of Darkness isn’t peculiar?”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, furrowing his eyebrows, feeling somewhat troubled.
He didn’t expect that the pit of the Red Fire Holy Body was so big that no forces dared to take him in. This is undoubtedly a troublesome matter.
However, judging from what the Burning Emperor has done, this Red Fire Holy Body surely belongs to the top-tier constitution among the Sacred Bodies.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be singled out by the Source of Darkness.
The other Sacred Bodies don’t have such ominous curses, but only the Red Fire Holy Body does.
Wang Ping didn’t believe that there weren’t other Sacred Bodies that managed to grow up and quell the dark chaos.
Besides, this Source of Darkness, isn’t it clearly problematic?
It’s just short of directly saying, “Hey, dude, I’m peculiar, come on, do me” kind of words.
“Yes.”
Alpha was silent.
“Damn, is it really peculiar? And such a terrifying one, why haven’t the Myriad Heavens Forces taken it down?”
Wang Ping widened his eyes, mumbling.
“Not that they haven’t, but that they can’t….”
Alpha was silent, speaking ambiguously.
“Uh… what did you say, I didn’t quite catch that.”
Wang Ping paused for a moment, and quietly asked.
“Not that they haven’t, but they can’t….”
Alpha spoke again, his voice still cold, but with noticeable emotional fluctuation.
“Damn it!”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, revealing an incredulous expression.
Damn, how crazy is this peculiarity? Even Alpha says it can’t be defeated, and other Myriad Heavenly Forces have no way.
What situation is this?
Could it be a super big boss among the peculiarities?
Thinking about such terrifying existence being in his world, Wang Ping felt his scalp tingling.
In comparison with this peculiarity, the one in the Cultivation Realm is nothing.
“I was thinking earlier about using world-hopping to erase the ominous curse of the Sacred Body, but now you tell me that this peculiarity is super boss, it won’t be possible to erase this ill-fated curse even with the mechanism of the chatting group.”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, he couldn’t help but blurt out.
“I’m sorry, you can’t, this has already exceeded the purification limit of the chatting group.”
Alpha said silently.
“I, your mother…”
Wang Ping fell silent.
I finally shit out a golden talent, yet you’re telling me there are so many problems. Whether I can still choose this talent is a very serious issue.
“No, if this peculiar thing is so terrible, why hasn’t it annihilated the Ten Great Universes?”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows again, asking with some confusion.
“Because the Source of Darkness in this world is not really its own body, but its tentacles.”
Alpha’s voice remained cold, delivering spine-chilling information.
“Its real power resides in even more brutal world…..”
“…….”
Wang Ping’s face twitched.
Good fellow, turns out the Source of Darkness in this world is just one of its tentacles.
This situation is just like Alpha placing the time-travelers into different worlds.
However, Alpha can only deploy a few time-travelers and “charge protection fees”.
But it can reach out its tentacle at any time, drawing on a world’s nutrients, and even have control over the heavenly rules to some extent.
This is utterly out of the league.
“Alpha, let’s run, we can’t afford to mess with this peculiarity.”
Wang Ping clutched his forehead, unable to stop a bitter smile.
Although the power level of this world is clearly very high, having such a terrifying existence, Wang Ping didn’t feel safe.
He has finally experienced what Qin Tian felt.
The damn feeling of possibly being killed by a peculiar big boss at any time, it’s really unpleasant.
“Don’t panic. It won’t cause any major actions, there are existences that restrain it. While you are growing in this world, the main problems are only four.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out again.
“The first are the indigenous powerhouses of this world; the second is the irregular dark chaos; the third are the second-generation and even the first-generation time-transversers; the fourth are the talents raised by other Myriad Heavenly Forces in this world.”
“So many risky factors, and you call these ‘only’ four?”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, wishing he could drag Alpha out and give him a proper dressing down.
Damn it, the first two are alright as they are threats native to this world. As long as the Source of Darkness is restrained by the bigwig as Alpha said, and won’t cause any major actions, he could accept it.
But what the hell are the last two?
The second-generation time-travelers and even the first-generation ones are in this world?
And, there are talents deployed by other Myriad Heavenly Forces in this world?
This is too messy and dangerous, is it hosting a free-for-all for raising gu worms?!
“Don’t panic, you have Life Simulator, you can easily surpass them and then suppress them. I believe in you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 555: 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: Chapter 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!_3
Alpha rarely offered consolation.
“Don’t be so hard on yourself. You’re not facing them head-on. Just tell me how many predecessor transmigrators there are in the second generation and how many in the first generation.”
Wang Ping grumbled.
No wonder Chu Xiao had that expression on his face when he was dying; he must have thought the transmigrator predecessors from the Upper Realm would avenge him.
But then again, since there were other transmigrator predecessors in the Upper Realm, why didn’t they bother him in the simulation?
In theory, after Chu Xiao was killed, they should have come to the lower realm quickly and killed him quickly, right?
“It’s not that they don’t want to deal with you, it’s that they can’t descend to the lower realm to deal with you.”
Alpha heard Wang Ping’s thoughts and began to explain.
“At the time of the destruction of the Second Generation Chat Group, there were three transmigrators in the Upper Realm, distributed in different universes. To be precise, two were in the Small Universe and one in the Big Universe.”
“The cultivation of the two transmigrators in the Small Universe was at the Semi-Saint level at the time of the destruction of the Second Generation Chat Group. As for the one in the Big Universe, he was very strong, a formidable person in the Second Generation Chat Group, and had witnessed the Burning Emperor suppress the Dark Rebellion.”
“????”
Wang Ping’s eyelids twitched.
It made sense that the two small universe Transcender predecessors had Semi-Saint cultivation and were strong, but he could still accept that.
After all, although Semi-Saints were powerful, given time, he would catch up sooner or later.
But what was going on with that transmigrator in the big universe?
Damn, witnessing the Burning Emperor suppressing the Dark Rebellion, wasn’t that a figure from 100,000 years ago?
Considering the time it took for him to grow, how long had he been alive?
Also, the time scale of the Second Generation Chat Group’s existence greatly exceeded his expectations.
