The Second Generation Chat Group was destroyed three thousand years ago, and he had thought that the Second Generation Chat Group had not existed for long. Now it seems he was overthinking it.
“Just tell me how strong he is and don’t beat around the bush.”
Wang Ping was somewhat annoyed and spoke up.
After all, these transmigrators were really deadly, as they would hunt him down at all costs, and just the thought of them gave him a headache.
“Before the Second Generation Chat Group was destroyed, he was already a Supreme. However, even the Supreme has a limited lifespan. He is currently in self-sealed divine slumber, so he probably doesn’t know about you.”
“That’s good.”
Wang Ping finally let out a slight breath of relief upon hearing this.
Fortunately, he was in a self-sealed slumber and didn’t know about the outside world; otherwise, he would be doomed.
The Supreme would definitely have many powerful subordinates under his command, and he wouldn’t even need to do anything to kill him.
As for the two transmigrator predecessors in the Small Universe, they probably couldn’t cross the universe to descend to the lower realm to hunt him down.
If they could, they would definitely find a way to kill him.
“What about the first-generation transmigrators? Considering the Second Generation Chat Group had existed for so long, it’s highly likely that many people in the First Generation Chat Group are already dead, right?”
After taking a deep breath, Wang Ping remembered the First Generation Traveler Chat Group and asked in a deep voice.
“There weren’t many people alive when the First Generation Chat Group was destroyed, and as time has passed in this timeline, the majority of them probably died. However, there are still a few who could survive.”
Alpha silently explained.
“And those who survived would definitely be the best of the best. In the Ten Great Universes, there was only one transmigrator in the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group. You don’t need to worry about his previous name; you only need to know his title in this world.”
At this point, Alpha paused.
Seeing this, Wang Ping had a bad feeling and a guess.
“In this world, his title is Leng Yue Emperor, an existence that became an emperor millions of years ago. Before the First Generation Chat Group was about to be destroyed, he severed himself with a slash and voluntarily entered the Source of Darkness to slumber.”
After the silence, Alpha quietly said this sentence.
“Damn….”
Wang Ping was speechless.
His guess was actually right.
This guy actually became an emperor.
At this moment, Wang Ping truly felt the sense of one generation being more fierce than the last in the Chat Group.
They, the Third Generation Chat Group, relied on the golden finger to reach this point.
The Second Generation Chat Group had varying levels of power, with the weakest being Nirvana Boundary and the current strongest appearing as the Supreme.
To be honest, it was already against the heavens to grow to this point on their own.
However, the first-generation transmigrants were even more fierce, becoming an emperor on their own in the darkest and most barren first-generation chat group, which was pretty outrageous.
“Alpha, are you sure this kind of character wouldn’t have left any countermeasures against subsequent Chat Group members?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ask again.
These transmigrator predecessors were stronger, and the stronger they were, the deeper their schemes would be, and they would definitely be more ruthless than the local masters.
In such a situation, it was impossible for them not to have any countermeasures against the possible emergence of Alpha and the Junior Transmigrators.
“It might be possible or not. You have to judge this for yourself.”
Alpha said quietly.
“I really give you credit.”
Wang Ping frowned, a variety of thoughts flashing through his mind, and finally sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 556: 177: The Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm! Real Terrifying!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Chapter 177: The Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm! Real Terrifying!_4
At present, he didn’t have any good methods, so he could only take it one step at a time.
However, before he completely eliminated his ability to be seen by this group of people, Wang Ping planned to continue staying in the lower realm for a while.
As long as his cultivation didn’t increase, he could simulate with King Artifacts and Emperor Forces in the lower realm.
If it was in the upper realm, the danger would be too high if he couldn’t completely hide himself. He might accidentally lose the game.
After all, the Life Simulator is not omnipotent and cannot simulate factors outside this world.
Wang Ping had to put in a lot of effort to deal with the Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao in the past, let alone these more powerful Predecessor Transmigrators. He must be extremely cautious.
After calming his thoughts, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, wanting to see the subsequent development.
As Wang Ping stared, words reappeared on the luminescent screen.
[Feeling a bit helpless, you thank the Master of Tao Palace for telling you these things and decide to leave. Seeing this, Ye Chen becomes anxious and chooses to leave with you. In response, you shake your head and laugh, suggesting that he would be better off staying in the Tao Palace to cultivate and that it wouldn’t be appropriate for him to go out as a loose cultivator.]
[Seeing you say this, Ye Chen does not refute and can only sigh, promising that he will grow stronger and help his master.]
[Seeing the deep bond between you and your disciple, the Palace Master of Tao Palace is quite surprised and did not expect that you are in a master-disciple relationship. After thinking it over, he says that he will not let you join the Tao Palace, but since you chose to come here, you have some fate with the Tao Palace. So he plans to give you some lower-tier God’s Source to help you break through to the Void Divine Realm as a simple investment.]
[Although the Tao Palace cannot provide the necessary cultivation resources for the Sacred Body’s later stages, they can still provide the lower-tier God’s Source to help break through to the Void Divine Realm.]
[Hearing this, you are very happy, repeatedly thanking the Palace Master and not refusing his offer. After all, you need a large amount of divine source, and who knows how long it would take to gather on your own.]
[If you continue to walk the world with the cultivation of the Quasi-Immortal Realm, it would be too dangerous. The Palace Master then gives you a lot of divine sources, allowing you to break through to the Void Divine Realm within the Tao Palace.]
[In the end, you forcefully swallowed thousands of pounds of lower-tier God’s Source before breaking through to the Void Divine Realm, causing the Palace Master of Tao Palace to feel a bit of pain. As you break through to the Void Divine Realm, the Heavenly Tribulation of your Sacred Body emerges.]
[Facing the Heavenly Tribulation, you are full of vigor, displaying your Sacred Body’s power and erupting the Great Perfection Fire Pseudo Law, launching the Burning Emperor Fist, effortlessly passing the Sacred Body’s Void Divine Realm Tribulation, leaving the Palace Master of Tao Palace astonished.]
[However, what surprised him wasn’t just the power you displayed, but also the fact that you practiced the Burning Emperor Sutra: Mortal Realm Chapter. He could only sigh thinking that it might be fate that the Red Fire Holy Body has a connection with the Burning Emperor’s Chi Clan.]
[After successfully overcoming the tribulation, you express your gratitude to the Palace Master of Tao Palace. After accepting your thanks, he informs you of another matter. After the Chi Clan faced trouble, some malicious individuals targeted their Emperor Force and Emperor Scripture, leading to them hiding them.]
[He states that since you possess the Red Fire Sacred Body and have a connection with the Burning Emperor, you’re the most suitable person for the Emperor’s inheritance. Unfortunately, the Chi Clan is declining, and its people are nearing extinction. Otherwise, it would be best for you to join the Chi Clan and become their son-in-law.]
[However, while the Chi Clan is in decline and the people are nearing extinction, a small number of them still survive. If you dare to take on the Chi Clan’s karma and help them take revenge, you might be able to obtain the subsequent chapters of the Burning Emperor Scripture.]
[You are amazed and excitedly inquire about the location. You are willing to take on the Chi Clan’s karma and help them take revenge. As you say this, you also take out the Chi Clan’s jade pendant and mention your past connection with the Chi Clan in the lower realm.]
[After listening to your words and seeing the jade pendant, the Palace Master of Tao Palace is also very surprised, exclaiming that you indeed have a connection with the Chi Clan, which is a fortunate thing for them. As a result, he tells you the location of the surviving Chi Clan members: Tianqin Mountain Range.]
[After noting down the location’s name, you bid farewell to the Palace Master of Tao Palace and leave. The Palace Master watches you leave, with a sigh, hoping that you can save the Chi Clan from their crisis. The Chi Clan has suffered too much.]
[After leaving the Tao Palace, you travel towards the Tianqin Mountain Range. Along the way, you encounter a group of Void Divine Realm experts who try to rob you. The leader has reached the 9th tier of the Void Divine Realm but is easily killed by you.]
[After killing the gang of Void Divine Realm bandits, you start to loot their bodies and find many items. Although most of the items are not considered precious, they are quite good for someone as poor as you are now, barely allowing you to get out of poverty.]
[In addition, you find a withered precious herb on the bandit leader’s body. You find this herb to be a bit strange, but since it’s withered, you feel it’s a pity and only take a longer look before letting it go.]

chapters.title: Chapter 557: 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Chapter 177: Upper Realm’s Source of Darkness! The True Great Terror!_5
[Next, you continue on your journey towards Tianqin Mountain Range. However, due to the vast size of Elemental Star and the long distance from Tao Palace, even if you are a Void Divine Realm expert, you cannot fly there in a short time, and dangers may arise on the way.]
[For this reason, you still want to choose to use the great power’s transmission array for long-distance teleportation. However, to your dismay, the money on you isn’t enough to cover the cost of long-distance teleportation. Those thieves were just too poor.]
[After some thoughts, you plan to teleport to a closer place, and then fly there. However, when you arrive at a major power nearby, Xingyue Pavilion, intending to use their transmission array for teleportation, you see a person.]
[That is Mo Shang Li. You have seen his portrait before, so naturally, you recognize him. Although more than ten thousand years have passed and Mo Shang Li has changed a lot, you still recognize him.]
[You didn’t expect to meet Mo Shang Li here. The current Mo Shang Li, without a doubt, joined the Xingyue Pavilion, and he holds a high position; his cultivation has also reached an undetectable level, apparently reaching the True Divine Realm. You just don’t know how many realms he has reached in the True Divine Realm.]
[However, although you recognize Mo Shang Li, you don’t have the intention to greet him and even secretly keep up your guard. After all, Mo Shang Li is a ruthless person and not a good guy. You don’t think that when he finds out that you are a Flying Immortal from the Purple Spirit Realm, he will tear up when seeing an old acquaintance.]
[Soon, you leave the Xingyue Pavilion using their teleportation array. Along the way, Mo Shang Li didn’t notice anything unusual about you. However, to your annoyance, Mo Shang Li also teleported to the same place as you.]
[You aren’t sure if this is a coincidence or not, and become even more vigilant. However, Mo Shang Li doesn’t seem intent on paying attention to you and leaves the area quickly. Seeing this, you decide to…]
The Text Simulation comes to a halt at this point, and Wang Ping enters an immersive simulation state, where he experiences various images, insights into cultivation, created Cultivation Skills, and Secret Skills.
Besides that, Wang Ping’s field of vision also changes.
“Is it time for an option again? Is this suggesting that I should choose whether to follow this guy and see where he’s going and what he’s up to?”
Wang Ping looks at the direction Mo Shang Li left and frowns.
His destination is Tianqin Mountain Range, where he will meet the only remaining Chi Clan member and obtain the remaining Emperor Scripture. Meeting Mo Shang Li on the way was an unexpected incident.
“Since it’s a branching option, it’s worth checking out.”
Wang Ping makes a decision.
He is quite curious about Mo Shang Li and is sufficiently cautious about him.
This guy isn’t a pushover and is on par with Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao. If he can comprehend Mo Shang Li’s present strength and his intentions, it might help the upcoming simulation.
“System, fast forward for me.”
Having made up his mind, Wang Ping speaks to the system.
As Wang Ping speaks, the luminescent screen appears again, and words float up to the surface.
[After making your choice, you follow him. Because your created secret skill is extremely outstanding, Mo Shang Li hasn’t discovered your presence. An hour later, you find that Mo Shang Li has entered an odd valley.]
[After thinking about it, you still choose to follow him in. Once you enter the valley, your complexion changes because you find yourself under a terrifying pressure that makes it hard to move.]
[Immediately afterward, you are hit by a Terrifying Skill that directly crushes you into dust without any mercy. Even after your death, the attack continues to bombard the place where you stood.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends….]
…
“Uh, so this is death?”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the simulation, speechless.
This really proves the saying: if you don’t mess around, you won’t die. If he hadn’t followed Mo Shang Li, he wouldn’t have died.
However, is Mo Shang Li really that powerful? He can suppress a Void Divine Realm like him with just his aura, instantly killing him and turning him into dust.
Also, this terrifying style of relentless pursuit looks somewhat familiar.
“No, it definitely wasn’t Mo Shang Li who killed me. The text simulation has clearly indicated that my Secret Skill is excellent, and Mo Shang Li didn’t notice me, which means that his cultivation level couldn’t have reached the God Monarch Realm or higher. He has only been a Flying Immortal for about ten thousand years, and although he is a big shot himself, it would already be quite impressive for him to become a True Lord during the Last Dharma Age. If he could become a God Monarch, that would truly be a big deal.”
Wang Ping quickly realizes this and thinks to himself.
As Wang Ping ponders, his consciousness flickers, and his field of vision changes again, showing him from a God’s view of perspective what happened.
After entering the bizarre valley filled with white fog, Wang Ping sees a cold woman in the valley’s depth suddenly open her eyes and unleash a horrifying aura that suppresses and kills him without mercy.
“Who is this woman?”
Wang Ping frowns, not understanding why she attacked him without mercy. Is‌ ‌it‌ ‌because‌ ‌he‌ ‌trespassed‌ ‌into‌ ‌the‌ ‌valley?‌
If that’s the case, wouldn’t it be better to capture him alive, interrogate him about some matters, and then kill him?‌

chapters.title: Chapter 558: 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet!
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Chapter 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet!
(ps: Changed the setting in the previous chapter, the Devouring Immortal Demonic Skill has also changed to Devouring Immortal Demon Body…. To be honest, I didn’t expect your reaction to be so big, ε=(´ο｀*))) Sigh.)
“By the way, this familiar finishing move style, she couldn’t be one of the other predecessor transmigrators, could she?”
Wang Ping quickly thought about it, his eyes flickering.
As Wang Ping was thinking about it, his field of vision changed, and he returned to the real world.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Golden Talent – Scarlet Flame Sacred Body.
②. 1st tier Void Divine Realm Cultivation.”
…..
“Choose a reward…”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and sighed, feeling a bit torn.
He didn’t expect there to be only two reward options this time.
If the Scarlet Flame Sacred Body didn’t have so many drawbacks, he would definitely choose it.
But, the Scarlet Flame Sacred Body has been cursed oddly and requires so many cultivation resources to choose, which is a very deadly matter.
In Wang Ping’s conservative style, he didn’t want to choose such a dangerous talent with so many drawbacks. It would be too risky.
“System, I choose ②. 1st tier Void Divine Realm Cultivation.”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping made a painful decision.
Although the Golden Talent – Scarlet Flame Sacred Body is strong, he still prefers to play it safe.
Anyway, as long as he continues to simulate, he will be able to refresh other powerful talents sooner or later.
If he can refresh talents that are stronger than the Scarlet Flame Sacred Body and have no side effects, that would be really cool.
Of course, improving one’s cultivation base to the Void Divine Realm is not a great accomplishment either, but it is also a choice made out of helplessness.
When Wang Ping made his choice, he felt a terrifying power emerging in his body, causing his cultivation to soar.
Soon, Wang Ping felt his cultivation improve to the level of the Void Divine Realm and his mana strength was even more terrifying than he had imagined.
“Right, this is the Void Divine Realm breakthrough with a sacred body, the foundation is much stronger than a normal breakthrough. Although I no longer have a Sacred Body, the choice of cultivation is still based on the cultivation in the Sacred Body situation, in some senses, this is also a bug.”
Wang Ping silently thought in his heart.
“System, how many resources do I need for the next paid simulation?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in his heart.
“Ding, detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the 1st tier Void Divine Realm, the host needs 10 pounds of lower-tier God’s Source for each paid simulation.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“10 pounds of lower-tier God’s Source?”
Wang Ping heard the number and was relieved.
He thought it would be expensive, but it turns out it only takes 10 pounds of lower-tier God’s Source.
However, it doesn’t seem quite right either.
After all, the reason why the lower-tier God’s Source gives him the feeling of being cheap is because he has more than 100 pounds of lower-tier God’s Source on him, plus thousands of pounds of lower-tier God’s Source were consumed in the life simulation when he broke through to the Void Divine Realm with the Sacred Body…
In fact, whether it is in the Purple Spirit Realm or the Blood Demon Realm, there is no God’s Source at all. The one left in the Purple Spirit Realm is left by the previous Flying Immortal, only enough for one person to break through, it weighs less than half a pound.
“Since the next simulations can only use lower-tier God’s Source, although I can get Lin Yuanyuan to stop, but it’s just killing some insignificant people anyway, so there’s no need to stop her. Their deaths would be more beneficial than harmful to the Purple Spirit Realm, and it would also make Lin Yuanyuan stronger and gain some resources to benefit the development of the chat group.”
Wang Ping looked into the distance and shook his head slightly.
“Of course, I still need to make sure she doesn’t kill innocents indiscriminately.”
With this thought in mind, Wang Ping sent a message to Lin Yuanyuan.
“By the way, Alpha, is that woman a member of the Second-generation Transmigrator Chat Group?”
Randomly, Wang Ping remembered the woman he saw in the Life Simulator and couldn’t help asking in his heart.
“Yes. Her name is Ruo Lan, she is one of the two Semi-saints. However, based on your memory, I can tell that she must have become a saint a thousand years later, so she was able to come to the Big Universe from the Small Universe.”
Alpha gave a definite answer.
“No wonder she is a predecessor transmigrator, she’s really ruthless, becoming a saint in the Last Dharma Age. Was it to kill me that she stimulated her potential? Or is there some other situation?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and muttered.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t bother thinking about it anymore. Anyway, she will come to him in the Elemental Star from the Small Universe in more than a thousand years, so there’s no hurry.
Of course, considering the opponents in reality might rely on powerful figures from the Second Generation Chat Group, it’s better to be prepared.
“Right, I need to tell Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan about my world situation and see if they still want to come.”
With that, Wang Ping opened the chat group and started to create a temporary mini group private chat with Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan.
As the two learned about Wang Ping’s world situation, they were completely numb.
Damn it, the worlds they were in were so dangerous, but Wang Ping’s world was far from peaceful either, and the weirdness level was even higher than their worlds, which was bizarre.
For a while, the two were hesitant whether to go to Wang Ping’s world or not.
After all, committing suicide in Wang Ping’s world, resurrecting and wasting a resurrection opportunity, and then facing such terrifying threats is too much for them to take.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: 178: Continuous Gold Release! Space Fleet! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Chapter 178: Continuous Gold Release! Space Fleet! _2
“Mr. Wang, is it okay if we develop ourselves in the Lower Realm?”
After hesitating for a moment, Qin Tian asked.
It should be less dangerous in the Lower Realm, right?
“Once the strange phenomenon breaks out, the Upper Realm will be finished, and do you think the Lower Realm won’t be affected?”
Ye Xiaofan muttered.
“Uh…”
Qin Tian fell silent.
Honestly, facing such a terrifying strangeness, even Qin Tian had lost confidence in Wang Ping.
Could Wang Ping really grow beyond the level of these anomalies?
Their Golden finger originated from the chat group, so it shouldn’t be stronger than the chat group, right?
“You guys can think it over and let me know. Anyway, there are many other worlds to choose from, it’s just that the development power limit is not as good as our world.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, looking serious.
“Apart from that, as new members join the group, there might be worlds stronger than the one I’m in. Who knows what the future will be like?”
“Mr. Wang is right, I’ll wait and see.”
Qin Tian nodded.
Ye Xiaofan frowned, hesitated for a long time, and then said, “No one can predict the future. Honestly, I think the more powerful the world, the more dangerous it becomes with all sorts of old monsters scheming. So, Mr. Wang, I’ll die once and permanently stay in your world.”
“Do you want to go to the Upper Realm or the Lower Realm?”
Wang Ping was somewhat impressed by Ye Xiaofan’s decisiveness and asked.
“Lower Realm. We are all chat group members anyway, so as long as Mr. Wang goes to the Upper Realm, we can use the chat group’s delivery function to transfer there. So, I’ll develop myself in the Purple Spirit Realm first.”
Ye Xiaofan spoke rationally.
“Okay.”
Wang Ping nodded. This was a smart choice.
Seeing that, Qin Tian opened his mouth, but ultimately decided not to be outdone and followed along.
It was at this moment that the chat group system notification rang again, surprising the three of them.
“Ding, new group member Yu Zhengtao (91) has joined the chat.”
“Ding, new group member Zhang Haoran (92) has joined the chat.”
“Huh, new members have arrived.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he entered the chat group’s main page.
At this time, both new members were staring at the Transmigrator Chat Group, looking puzzled.
However, these two new members seemed to be quite smart, as they both went to check the chat group’s introduction first.
Soon, both newcomers came back with twitching faces.
Yu Zhengtao (91): “As I expected, strange things always happen with suddenly appearing chat groups. Isn’t this just a chat group of the Master Lord Tier Space version?”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Nothing more to say, the group notice can be seen to be true just by looking at the member list.”
Wang Ping (66): “You two newbies are not bad, already criticizing the essence of the chat group. Of course, the chat group is much better than before.”
Qin Tian (77): “Mr. Wang is right. Anyway, hurry up and choose your travel method and activate your Golden Finger. I’m very curious about what kind of Golden Finger you two newcomers will get.”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “Thanks for the reminder, but let me calm down first.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “+1 to the upstairs.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Hey, calm down for what? Just simply choose Soul Travel and get it over with. After all, the risk of Physical Travel has been reduced, but it’s still there.”
Fang Yun (3): “Don’t listen to this guy’s nonsense. The risks of Soul Travel and Physical Travel are the same. The risk of Physical Travel is just the external danger, and although Soul Travel is a little stronger in that aspect, you don’t know what kind of creature you will travel into.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Silently bubbling, enviously watching the chat of the great ones.”
Wang Ping (66) @Zeng Lingdong (89): “Speaking of which, you haven’t bubbled for a long time. How’s the situation in your world? Have you figured out what kind of world it is?”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “The situation…I have been silently signing in and developing sneakily, but I still don’t know what kind of world it is. However, the only thing I can be sure of is that this world possesses extraordinary power because there is energy like Spiritual Energy in this world.”
Wang Ping (66): “Spiritual Energy, huh… Maybe you got an urban cultivation alternate world.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Speaking of urban cultivation, I can’t help but think of plots about Immortal Emperors returning and slapping faces in the urban setting. It’s so funny it hurts my stomach.jpg.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Honest opinion, that is indeed ridiculous.”
Wang Ping (66): “What are you laughing at, fools? Maybe Zeng Lingdong’s world really is one of those with a returning Immortal Emperor as the leading character?”
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, everyone stopped laughing.
If that were true, it would be quite terrifying; Zeng Lingdong had drawn a very strong world.
Of course, in a sense, this was good news for the chat group members, as it provided them with another world to choose from.
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Uh, if possible, I still hope that such a situation doesn’t happen…I want to lie low and grow stronger.”
Zhang Jun (70): “…Envious of people who can lie down and grow stronger.”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “I’ve decided, I’ll go with Soul Travel. It’s a bit safer.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Good brother, you go first, I’ll wait and see! Come on, give it your all!”

chapters.title: Chapter 560: 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Chapter 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet! _3
Yu Zhengtao (91): “……”
Yu Zhengtao’s face twitched a bit, not paying attention to his fellow newcomer Zhang Haoran, and decisively chose Soul Travel.
Soon, Yu Zhengtao found himself soul-traveled into the body of a beggar youth.
“Although I’m a beggar, it’s better than traveling to a bizarre animal. Not to mention, I have the Golden finger and the help of other Predecessor Transmigrators. I won’t starve to death.”
Yu Zhengtao was overjoyed, looking around at the retro-dressed crowd and feeling that his gamble had paid off.
Next, Yu Zhengtao drew his Golden finger and revealed a surprised expression.
Qin Tian (77): “How’s the situation for the newcomer? Did you get the Golden finger? Show it off quickly, let everyone judge!”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “Hahaha, I traveled to the body of a beggar youth and feel so great! And my Golden finger is super powerful!”
Wang Ping (66): “Interesting. What Golden finger did you draw?”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “Hehe, I drew the Dou-M System Golden finger. As long as I get beaten up, I become stronger!”
Wang Ping (66): “….Dou-M System….. there’s even such a Golden finger?”
Qin Tian (77): “Show off, this system is weird. By the way, you got this kind of Golden finger and you’re still so happy; do you have a Dou-M inclination?”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “I don’t have a Dou-M inclination, I just think that it’s a good thing to become stronger by getting beaten up compared to the bitter hardships.”
Zhang Hu (5): “Haha, I admire the mentality of this newcomer.”
Fang Yun (3): “Newbie, if you don’t mind, how about coming to the training ground every day? I’ll beat you up and make you stronger. EvilLaugh.jpg.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Ahem, I think if another newcomer gets the Dou-S System, they can pair up directly and spiral upward.”
Chen Kang (67): “Well, your imaginations are quite big, I must say.”
Wang Ping (66): “To be honest, it makes sense.”
Wang Ping (66) @Zhang Haoran (92): “Newcomer, keep up the hard work, try to survive, and awaken a Dou-S System to complement each other and grow stronger together.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Hey, soul travel once more, become a woman, and directly become the Dou-S queen. How delightful would that be.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “I’m not a Dou-S. How can I possibly awaken that kind of system? And I’m not interested in becoming a woman, thank you.”
Zhang Haoran was speechless. The fetishes of this group of seniors were quite strange.
Could it be that the people who survived in this environment have some psychological problems, more or less?
Zhang Haoran (92): “But soul traveling seems like a good choice. I’ll choose soul travel!”
As Zhang Haoran said this, he chose Soul Travel.
Then, something happened that silenced him. He didn’t know if it was because of Ding Xuan’s jinx or not, but he really did end up in the body of a woman.
For a moment, Zhang Haoran was somewhat flustered, afraid that he would actually draw a bizarre Dou-S System.
However, as he drew his Golden finger, he breathed a sigh of relief.
He didn’t draw any weird Dou-S System, and the Golden finger he got was quite good.
Zhang Haoran (92): “Soul Travel was successful… Although turning into a woman is troubling, my Golden finger is strong, which balances my mood a bit.”
Ding Xuan (88): “Holy cow, you really turned into a woman, I’m so envious.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “What’s there to envy about becoming a woman? Are you some kind of weirdo? Scared.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “This guy really is a weirdo. He just wants to become a woman, but unfortunately, he ended up in a tigress’s body instead. His future dream is to turn back into a human.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “…….”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, enough with the nonsense. What is your Golden finger?”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Synthesis System, I can merge two items into a new item, but there’s a probability of failure.”
Wang Ping (66): “Synthesis System? Not bad!”
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up.
He had read novels about synthesis systems before, and this kind of Golden finger has high development potential.
If he gets some good stuff later on and gives it to Zhang Haoran for synthesis, there might be unexpected gains.
Furthermore, Zhang Haoran’s talent combined with Xu Yi’s multiplier is very clever.
“However, Xu Yi is too greedy, untrustworthy, and not worth nurturing. Besides, in one mission, he abandoned his teammates and ran away because the enemy was too strong, causing Chen Yao to die once…”
Wang Ping thought of this and frowned slightly.
“Alpha, can you unlock the restrictions to let me erase his memory, brainwash him, and make him a naive tool man?”
After thinking, Wang Ping asked in his heart.
When in doubt, ask Alpha. It’s always right.
“It’s not quite in line with the rules…”
Alpha responded coldly.
This made Wang Ping frown, feeling somewhat disappointed.
“However, if it’s for the development of the chat group, you can enslave and control such an easy-to-betray person.”
At this time, Alpha spoke again.
“That’s more like it.”
Wang Ping smiled.
Hehe, the Alpha who had been betrayed twice before couldn’t possibly have a high tolerance for such group members. Allowing him to enslave them was the normal response.

chapters.title: Chapter 561: 178: Continuous Gold Release! Space Fleet! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Chapter 178: Continuous Gold Release! Space Fleet! _4
“Xu Yi, you’ll become a tool to make outstanding contributions to the development of the chat group.” Wang Ping thought as his eyes flickered.
In that case, he can spend Group points to upgrade Xu Yi’s Golden Finger first.
As for Zhang Haoran, they’ll see.
If possible, invest Group points in training.
By then, through various syntheses, he’ll directly gain all sorts of good stuff, and it’ll be all smooth sailing.
As Wang Ping envisioned the future, the chat group was also surprised and envious of Zhang Haoran’s Golden Finger, and the chat group’s voice rang out once again.
“Ding, detected Group Member Wang Shuqi (74) in major life crisis, group members may join in the rescue.”
It was at this moment, the chat group’s red alert suddenly sounded, causing everyone in the chat group, including Wang Ping, to pause.
It wasn’t common for old group members to suddenly face life-threatening situations.
Moreover, this was the rare red alert.
Wang Ping (66) @Wang Shuqi (74): “Wang Shuqi, what’s going on over there? Weren’t you just chatting and killing time?”
Wang Shuqi (74): “I don’t know? What major life crisis? I’m a bit confused.”
Wang Ping (66): “It seems like there’s a crisis you’re unaware of. Maybe you’re just one of those affected. Wait a minute, I’ll go to your world.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Yeah! With Mr. Wang coming over, I feel super safe!”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Mr. Wang, even though I really want to say I’ll go, but I’m also killing right now, so forget it.”
Chen Yao (71): “Yuanyuan, are you so confident now? It seems like you’ve gotten much stronger…”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Not much, just a Quasi-Immortal Tier. Covering mouth laugh.jpg.”
Everyone: “???”
As Lin Yuanyuan acted impressed, causing the chat group to explode, Wang Ping exited the chat group, planning to go to Wang Shuqi’s world.
“System, let me have a Paid Simulation.”
However, thinking of the possibility of encountering a situation he couldn’t handle, Wang Ping proceeded as he had before.
“Ding, consuming ten pounds of Lower-tier God’s Source, Paid Simulation successful, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing…”
The System’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing the Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body; Red Talent – Manic Laughing Clown.”
Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body: The Space-Time Dao Body is one of the top physiques in the world. Although this talent can only grant you an Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body, it is still stronger than ordinary Sacred Bodies.
Ps: Of course, if it’s not an Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body, this talent wouldn’t be golden, and the host wouldn’t be able to refresh it.
Red Talent – Manic Laughing Clown: With this talent, the host will get crazed, like to dress up as a clown, and laugh. At the same time, the host can gain a power bonus and infect those around them into clowns.
“Another Gold! Isn’t my luck a bit too terrifying now!?”
Wang Ping looked at the Talents refreshed this time, and the entire person was dumbfounded.
He never expected to get two Golds in a row.
Wang Ping even suspected that after these two runs, he would have bad luck for a long time.
“This Red Talent – Manic Laughing Clown is quite interesting. If it were the old me, I would definitely choose it. But compared to the Gold, it’s not much.”
Wang Ping looked at the Red Talent’s introduction and sighed.
It was at this time that Wang Ping felt a flash in his consciousness, entering an immersive simulation trend.
However, Wang Ping forcibly stopped this feeling and instead opened the chat group and chose to travel.
He needed to go to Wang Shuqi’s world first and save him.
As Wang Ping traveled to Wang Shuqi’s world, he saw Wang Shuqi still looking a bit confused.
“Mr. Wang, you’re here.”
When he saw Wang Ping, he came back to his senses and quickly greeted Wang Ping enthusiastically.
“I know the situation of your world.”
Wang Ping nodded to Wang Shuqi and spoke.
“Huh? Mr. Wang, haven’t you…?”
Wang Shuqi was taken aback, somewhat puzzled.
Wang Ping had just arrived here, and he obviously hadn’t used the Golden Finger yet, so how could he know what life-threatening truth he had encountered?
“My perception is very strong, not only can it cover planets, but it can also explore some situations in space.”
Wang Ping looked up at space, his eyes as sharp as lightning, and he spoke slowly.
“Space…?”
Wang Shuqi was stunned, his pupils suddenly contracting.
“Mr. Wang, you mean the enemy is from space? That’s…”
Wang Shuqi opened his mouth.
“That’s right, alien civilization. Alien civilization invaded the Blue Star.”
Wang Ping nodded, confirming Wang Shuqi’s guess.
“Some of the technology and martial arts of your world are inherited from the relics of alien civilizations. It is normal for alien civilizations to exist.”
“Well, it’s normal, but the sudden invasion by alien civilization caught me off guard. And they’re so strong… I’ve reached the 7th-Tier Combat Power, and my defense force is terrifying, but I can still be killed by the shock waves?”
Wang Shuqi’s mood was a bit delicate.
“They have a space fleet, and I can sense some powerful life auras in the space fleet. In terms of strength, although they haven’t reached the 10th Tier level, they aren’t far off.”

chapters.title: Chapter 562: 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Chapter 178: Continuous Gold! Space Fleet! _5
Wang Ping shook his head and said,
“However, to be honest, their greatest strength is not their individual prowess, but the threat brought by the space fleet. I can feel that, if the fleet wants to, the weapons they carry can easily annihilate Blue Star with what is called the Planet Destroyer Cannon.”
“……..”
Wang Shuqi was speechless, finally understanding why the chat group had issued a red alert.
After all, facing such a powerful space fleet, Blue Star truly had no way to resist, and the possibility of him being affected and killed was high.
“Honestly, in my opinion, their appearance is more like a good thing.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and spoke with interest.
“Why do you say that?”
Wang Shuqi was somewhat confused.
“Since there are powerful beings in the space fleet, it means that the Universe Martial Tao System is very strong, and they might not even be considered strong in the universe.”
Wang Ping raised a finger and slowly said,
“That means, your Martial System can expand. Besides, you can also get in touch with alien civilizations. By then, there might be a technological explosion. How many benefits do you think you can get under such circumstances?”
“!!!”
Upon hearing this, Wang Shuqi’s eyes brightened, and his heart raced.
He was not a fool, he just hadn’t reacted at first.
“Mr.Wang, this is tempting. However, Blue Star is so weak that if we really enter the universe, there won’t be much difference between us and ants. It’s not like you can always come to our aid, Mr.Wang. Moreover, even with your help, we might not be able to hold our own against the civilizations in the universe.”
Wang Shuqi grabbed his hair and muttered.
“Take it one step at a time. I’m not asking you to connect with alien civilizations right away, who knows how many years that will be? When the time comes, …” Wang Ping rolled his eyes and started to complain.
However, in the end, Wang Ping didn’t say the words ‘I don’t know how much stronger I will become’.
The future is unpredictable, even the Life Simulator couldn’t completely predict it, so it’s better not to make any assumptions, lest there be accidents and being made to eat one’s words.
“Anyway, take it slow, don’t worry. I’ll scout the way for you first. A small alien civilization’s space fleet is nothing for me to handle with one hand.”
Wang Ping coughed lightly and patted Wang Shuqi on the shoulder.
“I see, thank you, Mr. Wang!”
Wang Shuqi smiled at Wang Ping’s words.
That’s right, with Mr.Wang’s rapid growth, even if the alien civilization is very powerful, Mr.Wang will surely become stronger than them in the future.
“Well, I’ll be back soon.”
With a flicker in his eyes, Wang Ping directly tore through space and disappeared.
This time, for him, was also an opportunity. If he seized it, he could gain access to the Cultivation System of this High Martial World.
By then, he would have an extra path, to exploit the Life Simulator’s bug. As long as he became stronger, the resources consumed in the simulation would not change, which would be very comfortable.
…..
In outer space, a hundred spaceships were hovering there, with the alien creatures inside looking down at Blue Star.
“What a beautiful planet. If we sell it, we’ll surely make a lot of money.”
Inside the mothership, an alien resembling an octopus said with a somewhat fanatical tone.
The universe is vast, but life-bearing planets are still very rare, making their value astonishing.
As a result, their space exploration fleet was committed to finding life-bearing planets and selling them, expanding their forces, and earning more resources to make themselves stronger.
“How is it? Has the civilization level of this planet been determined? What is the combat power of the strongest beings on it?”
The octopus-like alien captain then asked his deputy.
“The civilization level is very low, they are incapable of interstellar migration, it’s just an Indigenous People’s planet. As for the strongest, they are pitifully weak, the strongest being only at the Golden Body Stage 7 Tier.”
The deputy spoke with disdain.
“Hehe, an Indigenous People’s planet, the strongest being only at Golden Body Stage 7 Tier? It seems we can easily conquer them.”
The octopus-like alien also showed a contemptuous expression.
“In that case, use the weapon to exterminate all the Indigenous People on this planet, consider it exterminating some insects.”
“Understood.”
The deputy nodded indifferently.
To them, such primitive civilizations that haven’t connected with the universe were insignificant, and the intelligent life on them was nothing more than insects. Exterminating insects was something they had done many times before.
In fact, they didn’t even need to exterminate the insects themselves. They just needed to research their genes and drop some viruses targeting their genes. This would allow them to kill them all within a short period of time without damaging the environment of the planet and preserving other life forms.
“Who did you say are insects?”
At this moment, a sudden voice rang out, causing the octopus-like alien captain and the other aliens to change their expressions.
At this time, the energy system of the fleet also began to issue a shocking red alert, detecting just how terrifying the energy within Wang Ping was.
Even the energy detection equipment on the mothership couldn’t completely detect how powerful the energy inside Wang Ping was, only knowing that it exceeded their detection limit.
“Hey? Are you joking, you call this a weak Indigenous People?”
The octopus-like captain’s strange eyes widened, revealing an incredulous expression.
“But the previous intelligence gathering and energy detection did show that… ”
The deputy also couldn’t believe it, unable to comprehend what he was seeing right now.

chapters.title: Chapter 563: 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Chapter 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing
“Damn it, attack! Even if he’s strong, he’ll be completely destroyed under the firepower of the entire fleet’s laser cannons.”
The octopus-like captain’s face looked terrible, paying no heed to Wang Ping’s spiritual message and giving the order.
In an instant, all of the fleet’s laser cannons lit up and began charging, targeting the figure standing in the cold vacuum of space with his physical body.
It was when the laser cannons began charging that Blue Star finally noticed the abnormality. Various satellites captured crucial images, and the terrifying energy reaction made the military leaders on Blue Star’s scalp tingle.
However, when they saw Wang Ping standing in front of the alien fleet, their expressions turned to shock once more.
A human could actually step into space, facing the alien fleet alone – it was simply too astonishing.
“He is…”
Lin Zhan was also startled by the suddenly projected images, recognizing Wang Ping’s identity and revealing a surprised expression. He didn’t expect Wang Ping to come to this world, quietly fighting against the alien fleet for them.
Lin Zhan quickly figured out the reason.
This must have been Wang Shuqi realizing something was wrong and seeking Wang Ping’s help.
“Has he really become this strong in just over two years?”
Lin Zhan mumbled to himself.
When he first met Wang Ping, Lin Zhan felt that Wang Ping was strong, but he was just strong.
However, by today, he felt the gap between himself and Wang Ping was like an ordinary person meeting a deity.
But then again, Lin Zhan remembered that Wang Shuqi was also inscrutable to him, and he could only sigh.
Transmigrators are just different; they can’t be measured by ordinary standards.
“Fire!”
At this moment, the laser cannons were fully charged, and the octopus-like captain gave the order.
In an instant, hundreds of dazzling beams of light appeared, illuminating the dark space, all firing towards Wang Ping.
This was an all-out laser cannon attack capable of completely destroying a Nirvana Realm Master.
However, for Wang Ping, an attack of this level was not significant enough. Even if he stood still and let them hit him, they would not break through his defenses.
Therefore, Wang Ping merely stood calmly, making no move.
When the laser cannons reached within one meter of his body, they were automatically deflected and dissipated into nothingness.
It was as if nothing had happened!
“How is this possible!?”
The octopus-like captain’s heart surged with shock and disbelief.
The volley of laser cannons just now could have destroyed a small planet, with firepower equivalent to the terrifying attacks of Star-shattering Warriors.
The opponent didn’t even move and blocked it all.
What a terrifying skill!
“It’s much weaker than I expected. However, in the worlds I know of, this power is already strong enough.”
Wang Ping gave his evaluation after deliberately taking a hit.
Through the chat group members’ traveled worlds and the worlds they carried out tasks in, Wang Ping learned about many worlds.
Among them, Wang Shuqi’s world was probably just below his own.’
Wang Ping didn’t know the limit of the Cultivation Realm in Qin Tian’s world, but it was probably not as strong as the Upper Realm of the Purple Spirit Realm he was in, let alone even higher worlds.
The Beast Taming World was also quite powerful, possessing star-breaking capabilities, but compared to Wang Shuqi’s world, the difference was still too vast.
After all, this world could destroy stars using only technological weapons.
This was the first world where technological power alone was sufficient to shatter stars.
Aside from that, this world would most likely have not only a strong technological base but an equally powerful cultivation system.
The octopus-like captain might not be a match for Wang Ping, but in terms of power alone, he should be on par with an ordinary Life and Death Realm master.
And for such a powerful creature to be just a part of an interstellar exploration team was quite amazing.
Wang Ping even felt that the strength of this world might not be much weaker than the Upper Realm of his own world.
“However, now that you’ve used up your methods, it’s my turn to take action. Don’t worry, I won’t kill you, or destroy these spaceships. After all, I’m quite interested in these things, and they have great value.”
Wang Ping spread his palms and communicated with them through his spiritual sense.
“No good! Quickly perform a space jump!”
Seeing Wang Ping about to make a move, the octopus-like captain’s heart turned cold, and he yelled furiously.
However, it was too late. All spaceships seemed to be restricted by some force, creaking and unable to move. All their energy was cut off.
This was like a bug accidentally flying into a spider’s web.
“It’s over.”
Seeing this, the octopus-like captain’s face was filled with bitterness. He knew that he was unable to escape, and he could only hope that the opponent would not kill him later.
At the same time, he was cursing in his heart.
Fuck, this was supposed to be just an indigenous planet, right?
But how did this kind of monster appear?
Even some Star-shattering Warriors probably don’t have this kind of power, right?
After all, although a Star-shattering Warrior is powerful and can fight against fleets in the universe, destroying them completely, it’s impossible to suppress the fleet instantly. If they want to escape, there is still hope for some spaceships to get away.
Honestly, the octopus-like captain could not understand why such a tiny planet could produce such a monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Chapter 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_2
This star clearly does not possess the conditions for a strong person to be born.
At this moment, the octopus-like captain felt a blur in front of his eyes, and saw Wang Ping appear in front of him.
This kind of move made him even more terrified.
After all, this is a spatial technique. Even Star-breaking tier and above cannot use their physical body to traverse space.
When the octopus-like captain was panicking, Wang Ping took action, placing his palm on the captain’s head and forcibly soul-searching him.
Soon, Wang Ping learned the general situation of the High Martial World that Wang Shuqi was in.
This made Wang Ping very surprised and excited.
Because the world Wang Shuqi was in was actually much stronger than he had imagined.
In the Blue Star, Martial Masters are the strongest, but in the universe, they are not called Martial Masters. This is a pretentious title changed by Blue Star itself.
In the universe, the hierarchy of power is divided as follows.
Entering Martial Arts, Golden Body, Suppress General, Lord, Broken Star, Bright Star, Day Stage, Star Lord, Universe Stage.
The Golden Body Stage corresponds to Martial Master, which can only be considered just above the weak level in the universe.
The Suppress General Stage is much stronger than the Golden Body and can be considered for leadership on some planets.
The Lord Stage is for those who qualify for their own planet.
The Broken Star Stage can shatter stars.
The Bright Star Stage is above the Broken Star Stage and can blast larger stars. They are considered powerful and highly respected in the universe.
The Day Stage can destroy suns and is considered extremely powerful in the universe.
The Star Lord is far superior to the Day Stage. Being a Star Lord means being the master of a galaxy. Powerful Star Lords can have multiple galaxies as territories.
As for the Universe Stage, it goes without saying that they are the true masters of the universe, and no one knows how powerful they are.
“The gap between realms in this world is not much different from the world I’m in.”
Wang Ping could not help but sigh with emotion.
The gap between the Bright Star Stage and Day Stage is truly terrifying.
After all, the difference between a planet and a sun is unimaginable.
The energy required to destroy a planet and a sun is not on the same level.
“Now, I wonder what kind of power I possess in this universe.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, feeling a little restless and wanting to give Jupiter a try.
However, Wang Ping eventually managed to suppress this urge.
If he goes all out and accidentally blasts Jupiter, it would be a sin.
After all, Jupiter is the protective umbrella of the Blue Star. If it explodes, the Blue Star will also be greatly affected.
As for blasting the sun, it goes without saying that humanity might be in big trouble.
Of course, Wang Ping is not sure if he has the power to blast the sun yet.
“I can try my strength in the simulation, but let’s not do it in reality.”
Wang Ping thought silently to himself.
“In addition, there is another problem.”
Wang Ping thought of a problem and frowned.
Although he can attempt the Paid Simulation in this world, he is not here on a Group Task and cannot stay in this world for long.
Under this circumstance, it is impossible for him to go to other planets to obtain more advanced Cultivation Skills or resources, nor can he practice in this world to become stronger.
“This is troublesome.”
Wang Ping had a headache.
If he can’t stay in this world for a while and gain lots of benefits, the gains from this trip will be too small.
“Alpha, can I stay in this world for a longer time?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and quietly asked in his mind.
When in doubt, ask Alpha. Wang Ping had already developed this good habit.
“No,” Alpha answered.
“Can’t you negotiate with the World Consciousness? We’ve even helped this world solve weird problems.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but say.
“The rules are the rules, there’s nothing I can do.”
Alpha silently said.
“So, the Second Generation Chat Group members who come here can’t stay long either?”
Wang Ping felt a little regretful and curiously asked another question.
“Their stay time will be even shorter.”
Alpha gave a definite answer.
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Then why can Lin Yuanyuan stay in the Purple Spirit Realm for a long time?”
Wang Ping thought of Lin Yuanyuan and asked doubtfully.
Lin Yuanyuan crossed over without participating in a Group Task, but she stayed in the simulation for more than a thousand years.
“Different worlds have different levels of tolerance for outsiders. The world you are in is very strong and has the highest tolerance. It can host any kind of being and allow you to stay for longer periods.”
Alpha explained quietly.
“Ah…..”
Wang Ping had nothing to say.
He thought that when other group members came here, they would have to commit suicide to be reborn in this world.
He didn’t expect that the world he was in had such high tolerance.
Afterward, Wang Ping didn’t continue to ponder.
“It’s alright if it’s not possible. Although it’s a pity, this world’s cultivation technique indeed doesn’t have the same impact on foundation and combat power as the Purple Spirit Realm. The only thing it affects is the efficiency of absorbing energy and converting it into one’s own power.”
“Despite the Cultivation Skill I found in the octopus alien’s mind not being of a high level, it’s enough for now. My cultivation efficiency is not high? I can make up for it with simulation time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 565: 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chapter 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_3
Wang Ping gathered his thoughts, muttered a word, and directly took these spaceships to the Blue Star.
When Wang Ping arrived at the Blue Star with numerous spaceships, everyone who saw this scene was dumbfounded and shocked to the extreme.
Wang Ping was really too powerful, like a god.
After arriving at the Blue Star, Wang Ping didn’t say much. He directly found Lin Zhan and Wang Shuqi and left them several spaceships, as well as handing over the enslaved cosmic beings to them. After giving them some instructions, he left this world directly.
As for whether the free simulation experiment could blow up Jupiter and the sun, Wang Ping thought it was not necessary to waste a chance for a free simulation.
…
After returning to the Purple Spirit Realm, Wang Ping chose to enter the immersive simulation state.
As Wang Ping actively activated the simulation and let the system enter Fast-Forward Mode, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, you feel the power of the Time-Space Body and are overwhelmed. You find that the Time-Space Body not only greatly enhances your combat power but also easily allows you to achieve Enlightenment. Particularly, your comprehension of Time-Space Tao is astonishing.]
[Because of this, you can only sigh. Golden Talent is truly powerful. Especially since this is just an Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, it is even more amazing. You can’t imagine how powerful the complete version Space-Time Dao Body would be.]
[After all, according to the description of the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, the complete version of the Space-Time Dao Body might be the highest level of Seven-Color Talent.]
[Next, you begin to consider whether to ascend or not. After all, there are still some matters in the Purple Spirit Realm that have not been dealt with. If you leave, the Mo family will create trouble, and both worlds will get screwed.]
[However, you eventually choose to find Ye Chen, cultivate him with a large amount of resources, and then ascend. You think that this is just a simulation and don’t need to care so much, so you choose to leave some room and ascend directly. In fact, you didn’t bother much with Ji Bingyan either.]
[In the end, you successfully ascended to the Upper Realm. After ascending to the Upper Realm, you met familiar forces like the Green Spirit Divine Sect, the Whiteflame Divine Sect, and the North Snow Divine Dynasty.]
[For this, you are well aware that joining these forces is troublesome, especially the Whiteflame Divine Sect, hiding a deep and unfathomable Lin Qinghe. Joining would be very dangerous, so you choose to refuse.]
[Seeing your refusal, the people from the Three Great Forces frowned and felt you were ungrateful. In the end, the person from the Green Spirit Divine Sect coldly snorted, wanting to forcibly capture you, plant a slave imprint, and have you mine.]
[Seeing this person change his face and wanting to attack you, you were very angry and directly blew him up on the spot.]
[The frightening power you displayed made the Void Divine Realm Masters from the North Snow Divine Dynasty and Whiteflame Divine Sect shudder. They never thought you were so strong and were very grateful they did not mock or attack you.]
[Next, you just glanced at the two people more, making them extremely frightened. They quickly took poison oaths not to leak a word, fearing you would kill them.]
[When it came to this, you let them open their Sea of Consciousness, directly deleted their memories, and then left straight away. This time’s situation was different from the last. Last time, the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Void Divine Realm Masters knew about Ye Chen joining the Green Spirit Divine Sect, so they knew about Ye Chen but not your existence.]
[This time, you only needed to delete the two people’s memories, and the news that you killed the Green Spirit Divine Sect Void Divine Realm Master would not leak out. For this, you didn’t want to commit unnecessary killings.]
[Soon, you left this place and went to the Tao Palace, planning to join the Tao Palace. Last time, because of the Red Fire Holy Body, you were declined by the Tao Palace. This time, you have the Incomplete Version of Space-Time Dao Body, so the Tao Palace had no reason to refuse you.]
[After all, the Time-Space Dao Body is different from the Red Fire Holy Body. There is no curse, and it doesn’t need as vast resources as the Red Fire Holy Body. The advantage of the Time-Space Dao Body is not a strong physique, but powerful comprehension that makes Enlightenment easy.]
[This constitution undoubtedly matches the path of Tao Palace perfectly. It can be said that with the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, practicing Tao Tian Emperor Scripture in the Tao Palace is a perfect combination, bringing out the greatest power of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.]
[On the way, you were at ease and did not encounter much danger. Finally, you successfully arrived at the Tao Palace, chose to worship the mountain, and met the palace master.]
[You showed your Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body to the Master of Tao Palace, who was overjoyed and took you in without hesitation.]
[Next, the Master of Tao Palace directly declared you the Disciple of Tao Palace. Your sudden appointment as a Disciple of Tao Palace shocked the entire Tao Palace, and even the entire Elemental Star was shaken.]
[After all, the Tao Palace is a major power that has produced Emperors. Although it has declined, its foundation is deep. The appointment of a Disciple of Tao Palace is a big deal, and all major forces want to see who you are on the upcoming Taoist Ceremony.]
[As for the Tao Palace insiders, the True Inheritor Disciples of the Tao Palace were all dissatisfied. After all, the Disciple of Tao Palace is the future successor of the Tao Palace and represents the face of the Tao Palace. If one can sit in that position, the resources one can possess far surpass those of True Inheritor Disciples.]

chapters.title: Chapter 566: 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chapter 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_4
[Originally, the position of The Disciple of Tao Palace should have been determined by these True Inheritor Disciples in another ten years. However, it was suddenly taken by you, and they naturally refused to accept it.]
[As a result, the entire Tao Palace has become lively, and many true inheritor disciples want to challenge you and prove that they are more suitable to be true inheritor disciples.]
[However, the Tao Palace Master directly refused the challenges from the true disciples on your behalf and brought you to the Tao Palace Secret Land to cultivate the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.]
[In the blink of an eye, ten years have passed. In the Tao Palace Secret Land, you not only easily practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture but also ascended to the 7th tier Void Divine Realm under the Palace Master’s all-out nurturing.]
[To reach the 7th-Tier Void Divine Realm in ten years would have been unimaginable before. After all, back when you were in the Green Spirit Divine Sect, you couldn’t even improve from the 1st-tier Void Divine Realm to the 7th Tier in over a hundred years, let alone in ten years.]
[It can only be said that major powers are indeed powerful, and their resources are extraordinary, which can save you years of hard cultivation. Of course, the strength of the Time-Space Body also played a part.]
[In addition, your understanding of pseudo-rules is also extremely terrifying. In just ten years, you understood 70% of the Time Pseudo-Laws and Space Pseudo-Laws. Although these two pseudo-laws only have seven levels, when combined, their power would surpass the Great Perfection Fire Pseudo Law you mastered.]
[It can only be said that the Power of Space-Time is much stronger than other attributes, which is why there is such a huge gap. Not to mention that what you have comprehended is not just space, but also time.]
[Soon after, the Master of Tao Palace, looking radiant, believed that your appearance would save the Tao Palace and restore its ancient glory.]
[He then told you that your Taoist ceremony would take place in a month, and by then, the forces of the entire Elemental Star would send people to congratulate you, and some younger generation may come to challenge you. You need to be prepared.]
[You chuckled lightly, confidently stating that no one among the young generation of the Elemental Star is a match for you. Upon hearing this, the Tao Palace Master laughed heartily, fully believing in your strength.]
…
“Ten years to reach the 7th-Tier Void Divine Realm – I didn’t dare to imagine this before. If it were Red Fire Holy Body, I guess it wouldn’t be possible either, I don’t know how many resources it would’ve devoured. And the Time-Space Body truly lives up to its name, its Enlightenment is really astonishing.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh as he looked at the simulation content.
He had previously experienced the attributes of space and time, but without the corresponding talent, it was difficult to cultivate.
Especially time – even with Purple Talent: Enlightenment to God, he couldn’t break through entry tier.
However, with the Time-Space Body, everything became much easier.
This was still just an incomplete version of the Time-Space Body…
As Wang Ping’s heart surged with emotions, more words continued to emerge.
[Soon, you left the Tao Palace Secret Land with the Tao Palace Master and returned to the Tao Palace. When you came back, the true disciples of the Tao Palace were not convinced and wanted to challenge you.]
[You were not angry but accepted the challenges of the true disciples of the Tao Palace with interest, wanting to see the level of their strength.]
[In the first battle, you faced the 9th True Disciple. He had a good cultivation level, practiced Holy tier Cultivation Method, and reached the same 7th-tier Void Divine Realm as you. However, he couldn’t even withstand a single blow from you, which surprised the Tao Palace elders and other true disciples.]
[Thus, the top three true disciples couldn’t sit still anymore, competing to step forward. Seeing this, you smiled lightly and announced that they can all come together. Your words enraged the top three true disciples.]
[In the end, the 3rd True Disciple snorted coldly, relying on his status as the fastest among the true disciples, he managed to battle you first. A fierce battle ensued between you two.]
[The 3rd True Disciple’s strength was far superior to the 9th True Disciple. He had not only reached the 9th tier Void Divine Realm, practiced the Emperor Body Scripture, but also comprehended sixty percent Thunder Pseudo-Laws, making him the fastest among the true disciples.]
[However, this level of strength was still too weak for you. You effortlessly defeated him with casual moves. This silenced the other true disciples.]
[You challenged the remaining true disciples to join together in battle and vowed to fight them until they submit.]
[Upon hearing these words, the other true disciples felt depressed but knew they couldn’t compare to your strength. After all, the top three true disciples didn’t differ much in strength, and even the third couldn’t survive a few moves against you. It wouldn’t make a difference if they joined forces.]
[In the end, they gave up on challenging you and accepted your superiority wholeheartedly. Your strength, which conquered them, proved that you were indeed qualified to be the Disciple of Tao Palace. No one was more suitable than you.]
[Seeing that the true disciples had truly submitted, you were very satisfied. After all, they would become the higher-ups of Tao Palace and your support in the future, so it was necessary to win them over.]
[Soon, the Taoist Ceremony started, and under the attention of the crowd, you became the Disciple of Tao Palace. Then, a banquet was held, and disciples from other forces also started to compete in martial arts for fun.]

chapters.title: Chapter 567: 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Chapter 179: Soaring Cultivation! Unrivaled Bearing_5
[During the various martial arts competitions, you see Lin Qinghe from the Green Spirit Divine Sect sitting somewhere. You know about her situation, this woman not only has a terrifying Devouring Immortal Demon Body, but she also has dual souls in one body. Although the other soul tablet is in hibernation, it is extremely powerful, and her past life must have been at least at the Saintly cultivation level.]
[Although you feel Lin Qinghe poses a great threat and really want to use the Emperor’s artifact from the Tao Palace to eliminate her, taking action in this situation could easily arouse the concern of other forces, which would be detrimental to Tao Palace.]
[Moreover, although you are now a Taoist, the Emperor’s artifact is not something easily used. As a result, you can only secretly sigh and give up the idea of ​​eliminating her, planning to find an opportunity to kill her yourself.]
[Otherwise, with this woman’s constitution, in the future, she will definitely take action against the Heavenly Talents from various factions, devouring their origins and cultivation, strengthening herself, and eventually becoming a powerful Demon that is difficult to deal with.]
[When you secretly glanced at Lin Qinghe, this woman sensed your gaze, and smiled and nodded at you, seemingly admiring you.]
[As for this, you also smile and nod, but in your heart, you sigh how good this woman is at pretending, as you had been deceived by her in your previous simulation.]
[The banquet continued, a young generation powerhouse challenged you, and he has long been a famous Heavenly Talent on the Elemental Star. In response, you didn’t refuse his challenge and fought with him.]
[This Heavenly Talent’s combat power was very strong, only slightly inferior to the top three true disciples of Tao Palace, and had cultivated a magical Secret Skill. However, you easily defeated him, without revealing your Tao body or many other means, merely using the Divine Skills from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and the 7-Tier Fire Pseudo Law.]
[Even so, it still alarmed the big shots of various forces, and the Heavenly Talents of various factions felt great pressure. After all, Heavenly Talents on the Elemental Star who can comprehend 6-Tier Pseudo Rules are rare at the Void Divine Realm, let alone those who can comprehend 7-Tier Pseudo Rules.]
[Besides, not only are you strong in understanding Pseudo Rules, but you’ve also cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and your comprehension level is clearly not shallow, which is extremely terrifying.]
[Although cultivating the Emperor Scripture may not necessarily make you stronger than other cultivation methods, as it ultimately depends on the level of control, entry-level cultivation may not be much stronger compared to deep cultivation of Holy tier Cultivation Methods. However, your cultivation level is not shallow, creating an obvious gap.]
[In the end, various factions recognized that you deserved to be the Disciple of the Tao Palace, which may rise again because of your advent.]
[Of course, some big shots believe that practicing cultivation in the Last Dharma Age is a waste of potential. The true monstrous talents of various forces are sealed in the divine source, waiting quietly for the arrival of the Golden Age.]
[Only in the Golden Age can these Heavenly Talents truly shine, break into the Saint Realm, or even higher realms, allowing the forces they belong to become glorious and prosperous.]
[As the Taoist Ceremony comes to an end and various factions leave one after another, your life returns to normal. However, you have not given up on your plan to clean up Lin Qinghe.]
[As a result, you chose to discuss this matter with the palace master of the Tao Palace. After all, to someone of your status, there is no need to take action personally many times, and you can completely take advantage of the situation.]
[You are strong, but if Tao Palace takes action, it can definitely be done more cleanly, with a higher success rate than if you acted alone.]
[When the Master of Tao Palace hears your words, he is shocked and develops a strong killing intent for Lin Qinghe. After all, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is too terrifying, and it is said that if it grows up, it can even devour the Immortals. Although this is exaggerated, it still shows the horror of this constitution.]
[The previous generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body had caused a great catastrophe. The growth of the previous generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body was extremely bloody, and many descendants of various Holy Lands, Immortal Great Sects, and even Imperial-tier forces were killed and devoured by it. In the end, even Masters failed to suppress it.]
[In the end, a large number of powerhouses from the Life Ancient Stars were almost completely devoured by it. In that era, even a Supreme Sunset Emperor could not stand it any longer and attempted to eradicate this disaster.]
[However, that battle shocked everyone. The previous generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body actually managed to kill the Supreme Sunset Emperor with its Quasi-Emperor cultivation, intending to devour the Emperor’s origin.]
[Had it not been for another Emperor to appear in the end (I changed the setting, there will not only be one Emperor in an era) and forcibly kill it, it’s impossible to predict how many cultivators would have fallen victim to it, and even the remaining Prime-age Emperors might not have been spared.]
[Therefore, once someone with this constitution appears, they will be unwelcome by all parties and be pursued and killed with all their might. Thus, Lin Qinghe’s possession of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is too dangerous, and she must be killed thoroughly before she grows up.]
[Otherwise, once she grows up, even the Tao Palace may not be safe from her.]

chapters.title: Chapter 568: 180: Seizing the Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Chapter 180: Seizing the Body
“Was the Swallowing Immortal Demonic Body of the previous generation really this powerful?”
Wang Ping stared at the content depicted in the text simulation, his heart shaken.
Then, he also recalled Lin Qinghe being a dual soul in one body, with the other soul in her body surpassing the strength of a God Monarch, its limit unknown.
Wang Ping now somewhat suspects that the second dormant soul is the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.
If that’s the case… Wang Ping felt that the success of the Tao Palace’s operation this time would be difficult.
As Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various thoughts, more text emerged.
[You remember Lin Qinghe’s situation and want the Master of Tao Palace to bring Emperor Force to suppress and kill Lin Qinghe. However, the Master of Tao Palace feels that such a request is a bit excessive. After all, the Emperor Force is an existence that suppresses the luck of the Tao Palace and cannot be taken away from it lightly.]
[If a terrifying powerhouse attacked the Tao Palace during the time the Emperor Force was not in the palace, the consequences would undoubtedly be serious. After all, the enemies of the Tao Palace are also numerous, but these major powers are restrained by the foundation and deterrence of the Emperor Force, so they dare not go to war easily.]
[Upon hearing the words of the Master of Tao Palace, you sigh inwardly and can only abandon the idea of ​​continuing to persuade the Master of Tao Palace to use the Emperor Force. The Master of Tao Palace sees your unease and tells you not to worry too much. Lin Qinghe may have the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, but she is ultimately just a junior who has not yet grown up, with cultivation at the Emperor tier. If God King Realm powerhouse uses a Sacred Artifact to suppress her, the success rate is still very high.]
[Upon hearing this, you can only hope that the Tao Palace’s operation will succeed, nodding your head without saying more.]
[Next, the Tao Palace invites several God King Realm powerhouses to leave the palace with several Sacred Artifacts intent on taking action against Lin Qinghe. With this, you can’t help but sigh inwardly – the Tao Palace is indeed the Tao Palace. The Mo family had lost a Sacred Artifact and became extremely upset, while the Tao Palace easily took out a few Sacred Artifacts.]
[God King Realm powerhouses made their move and soon arrived at the Green Spirit Divine Sect. The powerful members of the Green Spirit Divine Sect were shocked as to why the Tao Palace sent several God King Realm powerhouses. Their Ancestor had no choice but to fly out and inquire about the purpose of the Tao Palace.]
[The God King Realm powerhouse of Tao Palace did not waste words and directly stated that Lin Qinghe possesses a Swallowing Immortal Demon Body and must be eradicated. They asked the God King Realm Ancestor of the Green Spirit Divine Sect to cooperate.]
[Upon hearing this, the God King Realm Ancestor of the Green Spirit Divine Sect was shocked. He had never expected that Lin Qinghe, whom he valued greatly, would be the possessor of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. For a moment, a thought flashed through his mind – even though he wanted to protect Lin Qinghe, if she was left alive, their Green Spirit Divine Sect might have a chance to dominate the Elemental Star and become a major power in the Upper Realm.]
[However, the Green Spirit Ancestor eventually sighed and gave up this crazy idea. After all, he had no chance of winning against the Tao Palace. Moreover, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body is a common enemy in the Upper Realm and must be killed by anyone who obtains it. If he dared to protect her, he would definitely end up dead and dismembered.]
[As a result, the Green Spirit Ancestor could only agree to the request of the God King Realm powerhouse of Tao Palace and hand over Lin Qinghe. Seeing this, Lin Qinghe’s face was gloomy, and she hadn’t expected her possession of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body to be exposed this way.]
[For a moment, Lin Qinghe thought of your existence. Her intuition told her that it was you who saw through her true nature, which was why the Tao Palace powerhouse came to kill her.]
[Next, without any hesitation, Lin Qinghe began calling the other soul in her body, hoping that it could help her escape. Although she was extremely wary of the other soul, she had no choice but to awaken it due to the imminent life-or-death crisis.]
[As Lin Qinghe’s other soul awakened, she directly tore space apart and instantly disappeared. This caused the complexion of the Tao Palace powerhouses to change dramatically. They did not expect that Lin Qinghe would have such a means. They had clearly sealed space with Sacred Artifacts, but she could still tear space apart.]
[The power just now had definitely surpassed the level of a God Monarch and reached the Saint Realm; otherwise, Lin Qinghe would not have been able to do it. However, what they couldn’t understand was how Lin Qinghe, who was only an Emperor, possessed such terrifying power.]
[In the end, the God King Realm powerhouse of the Tao Palace could only return to the palace helplessly, telling the Master of Tao Palace about the failure of the operation. Hearing the news, you sighed in your heart but weren’t too surprised by the outcome.]
[Lin Qinghe’s other soul is not simple; if killing Lin Qinghe were easy, that would be the strange thing. However, you didn’t care too much about the fact that Lin Qinghe didn’t die.]
[Although Lin Qinghe is dangerous, as long as your rate of getting stronger is not weaker than hers, or even surpassing her, there is nothing to fear. What you are currently wary of is just her other soul.]
[After that, you continue your painstaking cultivation, hoping to advance further and quickly improve your cultivation to the Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm or even reach the True Divine Realm. With the help of Tao Palace, your life-bound weapon has also been upgraded to the level of mid-tier Divine Artifacts, complementing your strength perfectly.
