Of course, you have not forgotten Mo Shang Li, the Flying Immortal, and the predecessor ransmigrator mentioned in your memory, who was killed by you.]
[However, that predecessor ransmigrator won’t arrive at Elemental Star until a thousand years later, so you have nothing to fear. After a thousand years, you may not be able to Enter Saint, but with the backing of the Tao Palace, you also have no fear of a single Saint.]

chapters.title: Chapter 569: 180: Seizing the Body_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Chapter 180: Seizing the Body_2
[In the end, no matter how strong the saints are, can they really show off their prowess in front of Emperor Force? In addition, how many old monsters the Tao palace has sealed is still an unknown matter.]
[In the blink of an eye, another thirty years passed. In these thirty years, everything was peaceful, and Lin Qinghe disappeared, never appearing again. Even though the Tao Palace announced that Lin Qinghe had the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and all the major forces of the Elemental Star searched for her together, they couldn’t find her.]
[Although you are somewhat disappointed at not being able to find her, you didn’t take it too seriously. During these thirty years, under the full cultivation of the Tao Palace, your cultivation has been elevated to the Great Perfection tier of the Void Divine Realm. At the same time, during these thirty years, you have been diligently seeking Enlightenment and successfully comprehended the Time-Space Pseudo Laws to the Great Perfection Tier. Besides that, you have also explored the rest of the Pseudo Rules.]
[However, although the resource consumption of the Time-Space Body is not as high as the Sacred Body, it is still much higher than the average cultivator. Nowadays, in the Last Dharma Age, resources are scarce, and the Tao Palace can’t always provide resources for you either. Once you break through the True Divine Realm, you will need to gain experience and collect cultivation resources on your own.]
[This is an inevitable path of growth for a genius. After all, a genius is not a flower in a greenhouse; they must go through trials to grow better and go further in the future.]
[Otherwise, even if the golden age comes, it would be difficult to enter the saint realm. After all, entering the saint realm is not just about having high enough talent, but also involves tests of temperament.]
[It was just when you were preparing to have a period of relaxation and then directly assault the True Divine Realm, a piece of news spread throughout the Elemental Star: A Great Saint Secret Realm had appeared on the Elemental Star, and someone had found the key to open it.]
[Although the Great Saint Secret Realm doesn’t seem to mean much to a power like the Tao palace, which has produced Great Emperors, it is not actually the case. The Tao Palace has existed for too long. Although it has given birth to Great Emperors, Quasi-Emperors, and Supremes, that is all in the past. Today, after its decline, the Great Saint Secret Realm is also of great attraction to the Tao Palace.]
[The Tao Palace does not need the inheritance of the Great Saint. After all, they have countless cultivation skills and divine skills. They have the Emperor Scripture, Quasi-Emperor scripture, Supreme Scripture, and so on; the Great Saint Inheritance is simply not enough. However, the resources in the Great Saint Secret Realm are highly sought after by the Tao Palace.]
[If they can obtain a lot of resources from the secret realm, it would be very beneficial for cultivating geniuses. In addition, there’s the possibility of obtaining world-shocking treasure medicine that can help God Monarchs breakthrough into the Semi-Saint or even Saint Realm.]
[Therefore, whether it’s for the Tao Palace or the other forces on the Elemental Star, the Great Saint Secret Realm is not something they can miss; they must fight for it with all their strength.]
[And you are also contemplating whether to try your luck in this Great Saint Secret Realm. You have some memories of this Great Saint Secret Realm, but they are all fleeting images from previous simulations. You only know that a divine medicine appeared in this Great Saint Secret Realm, causing the various forces to go mad and fight fiercely, with more than a dozen God Monarchs falling.]
[Besides, someone seems to have discovered a Great Saint Inheritance in this Great Saint Secret Realm, but it is not known who obtained it.]
[Because of this, you are very tempted to explore this Great Saint Secret Realm, but you also feel that concentrating on cultivation might be more important…]
The text simulation ends here, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, as his view changes and he finds himself in the Tao Palace. His cultivation has soared to the Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm, with many insights included.
“Did I enter the immersive simulation state again?”
After absorbing the insights, Wang Ping frowned slightly.
This time, the branching path was most likely whether or not to go to the secret realm.
If he goes, based on Wang Ping’s previous experience, it is highly likely that something will go wrong.
If he doesn’t go, he won’t be able to know what opportunities or secrets lie within the Great Saint Secret Realm.
“I still have to go.”
After weighing his options, Wang Ping made his decision.
As of now, he could simulate about ten more times as long as he didn’t choose cultivation, and he could use these simulations to find out exactly what happened in this Great Saint Secret Realm. There was no need to panic.
If he could find out about the great opportunities there, the value gained would be much cheaper than the cost of simulating with ten lower-tier God’s Source—a huge profit.
“System, fast forward.”
With that thought, Wang Ping spoke again to the system.
As his words fell, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text continued to emerge.
[You make a choice to enter the Great Saint Secret Realm. The master of the Tao Palace does not stop you, but instead, gives you many lifesaving trump cards. These trump cards include secret treasures that can resist attacks from God King Realm powerhouses, as well as divine thoughts left behind by a Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection expert.]
[Feeling that this is still not foolproof, the master of the Tao Palace directly gave you a Sacred Artifact for self-defense.]
[In short, the Master of the Tao Palace did his best to protect you and didn’t want anything to happen to you. Accepting the things given by the palace master, you became more confident about your journey to the secret realm. After all, in an era without saints, you could rely on the trump cards on your body to hold out for a while even if you encountered a powerful God King Realm expert.]

chapters.title: Chapter 570: 180: Seizing the Body_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Chapter 180: Seizing the Body_3
[And during this time, it is enough for the powerful cultivators from Tao Palace to come to save you. As for peer-to-peer battles, you haven’t been defeated by anyone yet. Of course, you don’t look down on everyone either.]
[You don’t need to worry about those of your same cultivation level since you can easily suppress them, but you still need to be cautious of those who have grown to the True Divine Realm. Although you are powerful, there is still a gap between cultivation levels, and you may still be in danger.]
[However, you are confident, and even if you can’t win due to a huge cultivation gap, your opponents can hardly kill you. This is not because of the trump card given by the Master of Tao Palace, but because your Time-Space Tao is too powerful, allowing you to come and go freely, making it difficult for ordinary cultivators to kill or trap you.]
[Next, you were taken by the Master of the Tao Palace and the elders to the location of the Great Saint Secret Realm. When you arrived here, you saw that many forces from the Primordial Star had gathered.]
[These forces vary in strength. Generally speaking, the weaker forces are from the Inner and Outer Regions. These forces only have God King Realm powerhouse as their leaders, and the weaker forces only have half-step God Lord Realm powerhouses. In addition to this, their foundation is shallow and cannot compete with the major powers of the Middle Area.]
[After all, the forces that can take root in the Middle Area are at least those that have given birth to semi-saints, with profound foundations. Some of these forces are even much stronger than today’s declining Tao Palace, with a larger number of God Monarch powerhouses and even the existence of semi-saints. In the face of these forces, the only two advantages of the current Tao Palace are the Emperor Scripture and the Emperor Force.]
[It was during the time when various forces and loose cultivators were waiting for the Great Saint Secret Realm to be opened by the forces with the key that the Yuan Family Holy Lady suddenly challenged you. She stated that since she did not participate in the Taoist Ceremony, the result allowed you to defeat the geniuses across the board, especially defeating her brother in one move, causing damage to his Tao Heart, and obtaining the title of the First Genius of Elemental Star. She couldn’t accept it.]
[Not only was the Yuan Family Holy Lady dissatisfied, but the heirs of various strong forces who did not participate in the Taoist Ceremony were also somewhat dissatisfied. After all, as geniuses, they naturally had ambitions for the title of the First Heaven’s Proud Genius.]
[The path of the strong is paved with mountains of corpses and seas of blood, exhausting the same generation to obtain the title of the First Heaven’s Proud Genius. This is extremely beneficial to their belief, allowing them to cultivate an Invincible Heart, making them stronger and able to travel further in the future.]
[In addition, the luck is elusive, and if you defeat your peer geniuses, you can actually snatch some luck from them, which is very beneficial to yourself.]
[Faced with the challenge of the Yuan Family Holy Lady, you frowned slightly and ignored her. After all, fighting here is of no benefit to you, it’s just a waste of time and allows others to figure out some of your secrets.]
[Seeing that you did not respond to the challenge, the Yuan Family Holy Lady snorted coldly, saying that you were all talk and a disciple of Tao Palace was nothing more than that. Hearing this, you were very upset. Just because you didn’t want to fight didn’t mean you would let others step on your face and ridicule you.]
[For this reason, you coldly responded to the Yuan Family Holy Lady, saying you were willing to fight if the stake was a Sacred Artifact and the loser would become the winner’s servant. Would she dare to fight?]
[As soon as these words came out, the various forces all smacked their lips, feeling that you were really ruthless. Hearing your words, the Yuan Family Holy Lady’s expression changed as well. After all, the stakes were too high. Her family could produce a Sacred Artifact, but that didn’t mean they would give it to her as a bet.]
[Besides, if she lost and had to become your servant, it would be a worse feeling than death. For a moment, the Yuan Family Holy Lady hesitated, and the old monsters of the Yuan Family advised her not to be impulsive. Especially her brother, who comforted her not to make a move, saying that Wang Ping was a monster, and she was not his opponent.]
[This remark, on the contrary, stimulated the Yuan Family Holy Lady, making her extremely upset. At this moment, you turned the tables and ridiculed her, provoking her further.]
[Your ridicule at this time directly stimulated the Yuan Family Holy Lady, making her furious and accepting the challenge. This made the various forces even more interested, looking forward to the battle between you two, wanting to see how strong the already famous Yuan Family Holy Lady was, and how strong you really were now.]
[Next, you and the Yuan Family Holy Lady both stepped forward and began the fierce battle. The Yuan Family Holy Lady was very strong, showing her Half-step True Lord cultivation from the beginning, which was higher than yours. Besides, the Yuan Family Holy Lady obviously had some powerful physique that could enhance her combat power, and her comprehension of Pseudo Rules had reached 70%.]
[Seeing this, you became a bit more serious, using 90% Fire Pseudo-Law in addition to the Fire-Elenment Divine Skill derived from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. While you held back your true strength, the battle between the two of you was intense.]
[When everyone saw that you had realized 90% of the Fire Pseudo-Law, and had practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture to such an extent, they were amazed at your comprehension and battle power, which allowed you to fight the Yuan Family Holy Lady with just Void Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation.]
[After all, the gap between cultivation levels becomes larger and larger as you progress. The gap between Void Divine Realm Great Perfection and Half-step True Lord is immense. Not to mention, the Yuan Family Holy Lady is not an ordinary Half-step True Lord, but a true genius whose talent is ranked among the top in the entire Elemental Star.]

chapters.title: Chapter 571: 180: Seizing the Body_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Chapter 180: Seizing the Body_4
[The intense battle continues, with Yuan Family’s Holy Lady feeling more and more shocked and stifled as it goes on. She initially thought that her superior cultivation, Special Constitution, strong bloodline, and her grasp of Pseudo Rules would give her an overwhelming advantage against you. However, she did not expect you to be so formidable, fighting her on equal footing even though you have only reached the Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm.]
[In this battle, even if she wins, there is no glory in it for her. A hard-fought victory instead of a crushing one indicates that she is far inferior to you within the same realm, which makes her furious. Besides, she is also worried that she might lose.]
[Thinking that, the Yuan Family’s Holy Lady becomes even more irritated, resorting to using a secret skill with a severe side effect to forcefully enhance her combat strength and use her hidden trump card to suppress you.]
[You respond with a calm smile and unleash the technique of Small Perfection of the Pseudo-rule of Fire to a draw with the Yuan Family’s Holy Woman. This leaves her dumbstruck and everyone else in great shock.]
[After all, it is an achievement that many God King Realm powerhouses have not yet comprehended. For a moment, various powerhouses can only sigh at your unprecedented comprehension of such techniques in this era, truly making you the number one genius of the Primordial Star.]
[Seeing this, the other talented individuals have no choice but to concede, acknowledging that you indeed deserve the title of the First Heaven’s Proud Genius of the Elemental Star. Your talents alone surpass those of the other geniuses in the Elemental Star during this era.]
[Witnessing the astonishment of the various powers, the Master of Tao Palace is filled with pride, anticipating the glorious future you will bring to the Tao Palace.]
[As the battle continues, Yuan Family’s Holy Lady grows weaker and weaker, unable to maintain her secret technique and getting suppressed by you. Seeing this, the Yuan Family’s formidable old monsters panic. If they lose, they will not only lose their Sacred Artifact but also face utter humiliation. Imagine the Yuan Family Holy Lady becoming someone else’s servant; the mere thought is suffocating.]
[Therefore, the old monster from the Yuan Family begins transmitting divine thoughts to you, hoping that you can pretend to fight to a draw with the Yuan Family’s Holy Lady. In return, the Yuan Family will present a Sacred Artifact and compensate you with numerous divine sources.]
[Hearing the Yuan Family old monster’s divine thought transmission, you secretly gloat but don’t immediately agree, letting the old monster continue to raise the stakes. Reluctantly, the Yuan Family’s old monster can only keep increasing their bid.]
[Receiving a satisfactory reply, you don’t continue to blackmail them, knowing that you should spare them when you can. You don’t want to make real mortal enemies, so you agree to their terms.]
…..
“Wow, I feel like I’ve got some protagonist qualities, stirring up hatred and then reaping benefits… A Sacred Artifact and numerous divine sources are just handed to me like that?”
Wang Ping looks at the simulation content with a subtle expression.
“However, I don’t know if these things can be obtained as rewards later. If they can, that would be great. Both divine sources and Sacred Artifacts are of great use to me.”
Wang Ping anticipates as he continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Soon after, you feign a tie with the Yuan Family Holy Lady, and the battle ends. The crowd senses something strange, and some old monsters detect the divine thought transmission between you and the Yuan Family old monster, their own expressions becoming subtle as if they guess the truth.]
[Meanwhile, the Yuan Family Holy Lady feels both stifled and humiliated. Gritting her teeth and vowing that it’s not over, she returns to the Yuan Family. As for you, you directly inform the Yuan Family old monster that you have sustained some injuries and hope that they could provide some Divine Medicine for treatment.]
[Recognizing your hint, the Yuan Family old monster’s face twitches, leaving him with no choice but to reluctantly hand you a storage ring containing the Sacred Artifact you wanted.]
[Next, the Great Saint Secret Realm officially begins, and you enter one by one. When you enter the Great Saint Secret Realm, you are surprised to find that it did not separate you all in the transportation process.]
[Afterward, people from various forces casually chose a direction and left. As for you, you followed the Tao Palace’s strong individuals for a while before parting ways with them.]
[You don’t know if it’s luck or misfortune, but not long after separating from Tao Palace’s experts, you encounter a powerful monster beast. Due to the huge gap in cultivation between you, you are no match for it. However, you also spot the treasure it guards – the Precious Divine Elixir, the True Immortal Star Flower, which can help true divine realm masters advance a minor realm.]
[As a result, you decide to take the risk and snatch the treasure. In the end, putting your life in danger, you successfully seize the treasure and, relying on your self-created Time-Space Divine Skill, manage to escape.]
[Following that, you continue to venture through the Great Saint Secret Realm, obtaining some opportunities but none as valuable as the divine medicine you previously found. While you feel a bit regretful, you don’t dwell on it too much.]
[After all, your luck in secret realms is notoriously bad. You haven’t obtained any opportunities in the lower realm, relying only on simulations to learn about the locations of great opportunities and intercepting them afterward.]
[Perhaps your grumbling somehow worked, for although you didn’t find the Divine Medicine that triggers a great battle among the God King Realm powerhouses, you accidentally discover an ancient temple.]
[After entering the ancient temple, you are transported to a small world to undergo trials. This revelation causes a great stir within you, as you believe that you have unexpectedly found the land of inheritance within the Great Saint Secret Realm.]
[Judging from your past experience, while the various opportunities in the secret realm are valuable, they are nothing compared to the Great Saint Inheritance, as the strong individuals tend to conceal the real treasures within their inheritances, bestowing them upon the successors they deem worthy.]

chapters.title: Chapter 572: 180: Body Possession_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Chapter 180: Body Possession_5
[Next, you continue with the trials. The trials are very challenging, as expected from this Great Saint.]
[However, such trials at this level are nothing for you now. You easily pass the test of this mysterious Great Saint.]
[Soon, you see the remnant soul of the Great Saint. Unexpectedly, this Great Saint’s remnant soul is not as amiable as you imagined, but rather shows a greedy and fanatic expression, completely different from the seniors you have met before, like the Flaming Fire Emperor and the Ashy Flame Emperor.]
[You sense something wrong and want to summon the Sacred Artifact to fight against it, but it’s already too late. The Remnant Soul of the Great Saint mocks you, saying that a youngster like you holding a Sacred Artifact doesn’t even qualify to resist.]
[As a Great Saint, even with only a remnant soul left, it is not something that Divine Realm Experts can resist. Even if you have achieved the Peak of the God Monarch Realm while holding a Sacred Artifact, it would be useless.]
[You scold the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint, saying that it’s really shameless to plot against and try to possess a Junior like you. For this, the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint mocks you, stating that the demeanor of a Senior is worth nothing, and that he created this secret realm to lure in many cultivators, just to select the most powerful genius for body possession, and return to the real world.]
[Your face turns ugly, knowing that you cannot escape this catastrophe. You can only threaten the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint by saying that if it forcefully possesses you, both of you will perish together, and even after the possession, you won’t be the pure you anymore.]
[To this, the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint scoffs, saying that he has no intention of merging his soul with yours and only needs to suppress and seal your personality, then he can control this body.]
[Hearing this, you fall into complete despair, struggling desperately in vain, only to be forcefully possessed.]
[Due to the abnormal condition of your soul, the simulation ends….]
…
“I knew it wouldn’t be that simple.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and was speechless.
The moment he entered the branch storyline, he knew that something was going to happen in this secret realm adventure.
Well, it did.
However, he didn’t expect that this Great Saint Secret Realm was actually a trap, constructed by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint solely for fishing.
As a result, he took the bait.
In the previous simulation, there must have been another genius who took the bait, but he didn’t know which poor soul it was.
“After arriving in the Upper Realm, the old monsters have become even more terrifying, and their methods of body possession have become more advanced. Such matters would be completely impossible for cultivators in the lower realm.”
Wang Ping shook his head again and sighed.
Immediately after, Wang Ping felt multiple images in front of him, and his figure appeared in an ancient hall. Then, he appeared within the hall and witnessed the final scene with his own eyes.
Next, Wang Ping’s vision changed as he re-entered the real world, leaving the immersive simulation state.
“The Upper Realm is really dangerous. Even the tools given by the Tao Palace can’t save my life. Luckily, this was just an intentional simulation exploration, otherwise, I would have been finished.”
Wang Ping mumbled to himself again.
“Ding, reward generation successful. You can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body.
②. A random amount of Lower-tier God’s Source.
③. A random amount of Mid-tier Divine Source.
④. True Immortal Star Flower.
⑤. Yuan Family Holy Artifact.
⑥. Tao Palace Sacred Artifact.
⑦. Void Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation.”
…..
“The Sacred Artifacts really did refresh, and there are even two of them. It’s so tempting, but unfortunately, I can only choose one reward this time. Isn’t this just whetting my appetite?”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and murmured.
“System, I choose ①. Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body.”
Without any hesitation, Wang Ping made his choice.
The rest of the rewards were also good, but compared to the Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body, they seemed insignificant.
With Wang Ping accepting the reward, he felt a significant change in his constitution, and his mind became so clear that it seemed like he could achieve Enlightenment at any moment.
“That fishing Great Saint, just you wait until I become stronger. I’ll definitely stuff your remnant soul into a pig.”
Wang Ping thought of the Great Saint’s Remnant Soul that mocked him and snorted.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t continue with the simulation and instead opened the chat group page.
After so much time, the two newcomers should have figured out what world they were in by now.
When Wang Ping opened the chat group, he began to read the previous chat records.
Soon, Wang Ping found that the group members’ movements were quite numerous.
Lin Yuanyuan had already avenged the Guilt-Punishing Emperor, gaining many valuable items.
In the process, Zhang Hu, Zhang Jun, and Ye Xiaofan successively entered the Purple Spirit Realm and joined up with Lin Yuanyuan.
Lin Yuanyuan directly helped Zhang Hu acquire a king-tier demonic beast as a mount, boosting his strength.
Zhang Jun was also brought along by Lin Yuanyuan, growing stronger through various battles.
It can be said that there has been quite a change in the cutting-edge strength of the group members.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Chapter 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor
“Is the world that Yu Zhengtao is in the same as mine?”
After Wang Ping scrolled through the chat content, he revealed a surprised expression.
Yu Zhengtao’s world, the cultivating System, is the same as his and is a lower plane similar to the Purple Spirit Realm.
However, this lower plane is much stronger than the Purple Spirit Realm and Blood Demon Realm, with the existence of Quasi-Immortal and a recent Void Divine Realm Master ascending.
Yu Zhengtao knew about these things because he was lucky. He was taken in as a disciple by a king who saw his remarkable bones that strengthened as he fought, so he was able to learn about many things.
“Alpha, is there any point in sending Yu Zhengtao to a different plane in the same world as mine? Don’t tell me, that plane also has some weirdness.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, inquiring Alpha in his heart.
“Correct.”
Alpha responded to Wang Ping’s guess.
“Well, that’s really weird. But this Profound World is really the favorite of the weirdness. All kinds of weirdness have come here.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
“You’re wrong on one point. It’s because this Profound World has the Source of Darkness, so the un-grown weirdness can break in and dare to come here. Otherwise, those un-grown weirdness would easily die in this Profound World.”
“Even so, they are mostly making trouble in the Lower Plane.”
Alpha said quietly.
“Mostly…you mean there’s other weirdness besides the Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm?”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows.
“They exist, but they won’t act recklessly like the weirdness you encountered before. That’s a suicidal behavior.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“The situation in the Upper Realm is getting more complicated.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Then, he concentrated and looked for information about Zhang Haoran’s world.
“The world where Zhang Haoran is, is quite interesting. You can actually get stronger by eating. The people in that world have the blessing of the God of Delicacies, and as long as they eat delicious food, they can strengthen their physical body. The more delicious the food, the greater the improvement.”
“There are countless natural delicacies in this world, and chefs who can process them on the basis of existing food are highly respected. This world is like the dream world for foodies.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips, showing interest in Zhang Haoran’s world.
“I just don’t know how strong the upper limit of this world is. If it’s high, it would be awesome. I want to try the delicacies and get stronger while I’m there.”
“This world is very strong, not inferior to the Upper Realm of the Profound World where you are.”
Alpha’s voice suddenly sounded.
“Huh?”
Wang Ping was dumbfounded after hearing Alpha’s evaluation.
What’s going on?
This world that relies on eating to get stronger can actually be comparable to the Upper Realm?
Isn’t that ridiculous?
“Are you sure?”
Wang Ping was somewhat surprised.
“Yes. However, as the people in this world grow stronger, they can be easily devoured by the desire for delicacies and want to devour everything.”
Alpha said quietly.
“Interesting. If I could, I would love to go there and try it.”
Wang Ping thought excitedly.
“I advise you not to enter that world casually. Because everything can become food, you can no longer be called a pure human. If you go to that world, you might be divided into a type of delicacy by the world’s rules and become someone’s meal.”
Alpha kindly reminded.
“Uh…”
Wang Ping’s face twitched.
He could actually become a delicacy and even become someone’s meal? That’s outrageous.
Seriously, this world is eccentric.
“What if I create an incarnation and let the incarnation go? Speaking of which, I haven’t tried whether I can simulate other worlds using an incarnation.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, asked with interest.
“You have already been labeled by this world. Unless you can draw certain special talents, it won’t work.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“Well, that’s a pity.”
Wang Ping shook his head, feeling regretful.
“Talents, huh. If I could refresh powerful talents and go to that special world, the speed of getting stronger might even be faster than in the Upper Realm. After all, the Upper Realm is still in the Last Dharma Age, and it’s impossible to become sacred. Even in a normal era, it’s extremely difficult to achieve Dao. And in that world, you just need to eat, eat, and eat.”
It was at this moment that the chat group system’s voice suddenly rang, causing Wang Ping to pause.
“Ding, detecting the emergence of weirdness in Zhang Hu’s world, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is a compulsory task, with 5 participants. Acting Group Owner Wang Ping can select group members to participate in the group task. Please prepare accordingly.”
“Again the weirdness, you’re really not giving me a break, are you?”
Wang Ping was a bit speechless.
“By the way, weren’t there weirdnesses in Zhang Hu’s world already? Why are there weirdnesses again?”
“Who said that the presence of weirdness in a world means it won’t happen again? In fact, worlds where weirdness has appeared are more likely to experience them again because their coordinates have been leaked.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Chapter 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor_2
“So that’s how it is.”
Wang Ping had nothing to say.
Immediately, Wang Ping didn’t say much more, and directly pulled the chat group’s messages to the latest page.
At this moment, the chat group was indeed in an uproar.
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, what’s going on? Why did the anomaly appear in my world again? Wasn’t it already eliminated?”
Fang Yun (3): “Who knows what’s going on. By the way, I think I can go for this group task. The power level in Zhang Hu’s world is not high, I can totally blend in for points! Hahaha laughing.jpg.”
Chen Yao (71): “……An anomaly appeared in the same world again? That’s a dangerous sign.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Ah, the magical world… Some memories are still fresh.”
Qin Tian (77): “Hey, of course you remember it well, after all, this is the world where you earned your first pot of gold. amusing.jpg.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Rather than saying it’s my first pot of gold, it’s more like the beginning of me letting go of myself…. So, I’m going to participate in this group task as a nostalgic trip.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “666.”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “Uh, an anomaly appeared so quickly? Fortunately, I’m a newcomer, otherwise according to what the seniors said about the previous chat group situations, it’s really too dangerous.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Shivering as a newcomer… I won’t go.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, let’s stop chatting here. Lin Yuanyuan and Fang Yun have already signed up, anyone else who wants to go, raise your hand.”
Wu Jun (20): “Of course, count me in. I’m going.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “And me, I’m definitely going. After all, I’m Mr.Wang’s task partner.”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn it, Mr.Cai, you took my place. I should be the task partner! Gnashing my teeth.jpg.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “(ˉ▽￣～)Cut~~”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, registration is over. So, the members for this group task are Lin Yuanyuan, Fang Yun, Cai Yonglong, and Wu Jun.”
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much more and went straight into silent mode.
“System, I want to do the paid simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke familiarly in his heart.
Doing a paid simulation before the group task had become Wang Ping’s habit.
“Ding, consume 10 pounds of lower-tier God’s Source, payment successful, life simulation activated, talent refreshing…..”
The System’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Purple Talent: Endless Blade; Red Talent: Ascetic Monk.”
Purple Talent: Endless Blade – With this talent, the host’s attack may trigger a critical strike, dealing double damage.
Red Talent: Ascetic Monk – With this talent, the host will convert to Buddhism and become an ascetic monk, diligently cultivating and increasing cultivating speed.
“One purple, one red?”
Wang Ping was a bit surprised.
After continuously getting gold talents before, he thought his luck would worsen again. He didn’t expect to get one purple and one red talent.
However, Wang Ping was not ecstatic. Instead, he felt a little anxious for some reason. This feeling of good luck seemed to be about to cost him something.
“In the past, when I drew cards, I would have bad luck for some time after having a great stroke of luck. That’s normal. If my luck is always good, I’d definitely take a big tumble.”
Wang Ping had an inexplicable feeling of uneasiness.
“Don’t think too much, maybe I simply changed my luck after becoming stronger.”
Wang Ping touched his temples, forcibly dispelling the uneasy feeling.
Then, he didn’t choose a talent, but instead filled in the group task members’ list in the chat group.
After that, Wang Ping turned into a white light and disappeared into the Purple Spirit Realm.
…
In Zhang Hu’s world, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, Lin Yuanyuan, and Fang Yun appeared one after another beside Zhang Hu.
At this time, Zhang Hu was undoubtedly very relaxed. He was in a private room with several beauties around him.
There were humans, elves, and beastmen.
“Damn, you’re really living it up.”
Wu Jun looked at the flushed Zhang Hu, enviously speaking.
Poor Wu Jun was an honest person. Although he had gained strength, he was very low-key in his own world and had never acted recklessly.
As for the initial conflict between Wu Jun and Zhang Hu, it was resolved long ago through many tasks.
“Tsk, it’s really enviable. No, it’s annoying.”
Fang Yun clicked his tongue.
Although the Swordsman World also had brothels, the fun there was clearly not as fancy as Zhang Hu’s.
Of course, ever since he was resurrected, he had been desperately cultivating and had not visited a brothel for a long time.
“You’re envious of what?”
Cai Yonglong wanted to slap Fang Yun’s forehead, but was caught by Fang Yun’s single hand.
“Hey, Mr. Cai, you’re just a weak Yin Yang Mirror third stage now, while I’m the big boss of Life and Death Realm, you don’t stand a chance fighting with me.”
Fang Yun grinned, laughing uproariously, and felt quite smug.
“You, you”
Cai Yonglong’s face twitched, and he was speechless.
Fang Yun’s cultivating speed was truly outrageous.
With Wang Ping’s help and various resources, Cai Yonglong’s cultivating speed was also outrageously fast. In a short period of time, he had reached the third stage of Yin Yang Mirror.
However, compared to Fang Yun, he was still far behind.
This guy’s golden finger increased his cultivation speed to an astonishing degree.
And this was just his initial golden finger. Once his golden finger evolved, how terrifying it would become was hard to predict.
“Don’t be smug, once Yuanyuan grants me empowerment, your own cultivation speed won’t be much of a big deal.”

chapters.title: Chapter 575: 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Chapter 181: The Inheritance of the Black Abyss Devil Emperor! The Green Bamboo Emperor_3
Cai Yonglong could only say sourly.
“Heh, one’s cultivation can rise quickly, but the comprehension gained from cultivating won’t. As for Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills and stuff, they still have to be cultivated by oneself.”
Fang Yun smiled mischievously.
“Mr. Wang, this kid is too smug, can you beat him up?”
Cai Yonglong said through gritted teeth.
“Yun, you’re quite smug huh, want to compare notes with me?”
Wang Ping glanced at Fang Yun, smiling without actually smiling.
Lin Yuanyuan also glanced at Fang Yun, chuckling lightly: “I can also have a try.”
“Um….”
Fang Yun’s face twitched, not daring to say anything more.
Mr. Wang is a Void lord, and Lin Yuanyuan is a Quasi-Immortal, he, a shrimp in the Life and Death Realm, really can’t afford to provoke them.
“Alright, Zhang Hu, let them leave.”
Immediately, Wang Ping looked at Zhang Hu and the astonished young girls, speaking faintly.
Seeing this, Zhang Hu naturally didn’t dare say anything more and let the women leave.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say anything unnecessary, and directly said in his mind.
“System, I choose Purple Talent: Endless Blade.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Immediately after, Wang Ping felt dizzy, his vision changed, and he appeared in Ashy Flame Valley, entering an immersive simulation state.
“System, give me a fast forward.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping continued to speak.
“Ding, fast forwarding….”
The system’s voice sounded again, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text appeared.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate. Because your Time-Space Pseudo Law has reached the Great Perfection Tier, you didn’t have the desire to continue comprehending. After all, in this era, and in the lower realm, it is difficult to make further progress, to comprehend the Power of Manas that only saints can comprehend.]
[As such, it’s better to comprehend more other Pseudo Rules and lay a solid foundation for future creation of laws.]
[Next, you arranged a lot of back-ups in the lower realm to deal with the future crisis of the Purple Spirit Realm, then chose to ascend to the Upper Realm.]
[After you ascended to the Upper Realm, just like in your memory, you joined Tao Palace. However, the plot development this time was a bit different from your memory.]
[Because the palace master of Tao Palace discovered that you practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and was very surprised and puzzled. In response, you could only say that it was handed down to you by a senior of Tao Palace.]
[This made the palace master of Tao Palace quite surprised, but he didn’t delve too much into it. After all, if it wasn’t passed down by the ancestors of Tao Palace, you wouldn’t be able to practice the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. If you learned it accidentally, you wouldn’t come to Tao Palace and put yourself in the net.]
[Of course, since you possess the Time-Space Body, even if you learned it accidentally and came to Tao Palace, they would naturally treasure you.]
[Subsequently, just like in your memory, you became a taoist of the Tao Palace. With the help of Tao Palace’s resources, you raised your cultivation to the Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm in a few decades.]
[After that, the Great Saint Secret Realm opened. Knowing that the Great Saint Secret Realm was just bait used by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint, you didn’t choose to enter it and instead continued to cultivate.]
[With the end of the competition for the Great Saint Secret Realm, all parties suffered losses. You also learned that Tao Palace had lost a God King Realm powerhouse, which made the palace master very distressed. After all, in this era, God King Realm powerhouses are top-level combat forces and are quite rare, so they are very precious to Tao Palace.]
[At the same time, you also heard about who got the Divine Medicine. The Divine Medicine was obtained by the Zhang Family, currently the number one family in the Elemental Star. As for the person who gained the inheritance, it was also spread out.]
[Rumor had it that this person who gained the inheritance was a loose cultivator who called himself Lin Yan. However, although he was a loose cultivator, he wasn’t an ordinary one; he possessed a powerful Special Constitution that was no worse than the heirs of the major forces, and was even better in some respects.]
[As a result, many forces were looking for this loose cultivator, wanting to gain the Great Saint Inheritance from him. Of course, if they could recruit him, that would be even better.]
[The only one that found out about this, was you, who shook your head and mourned silently for Lin Yan for three seconds. Without your intervention, this Lin Yan would have been the unlucky one originally to be possessed by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years passed, and you successfully broke through to the Half-step True Lord Realm, and created your own god-tier Superior Cultivation Method and Divine Powers.]
[After breaking through to the Half-step True Lord Realm, you didn’t continue to seclude yourself but chose to relax for a while. As for Lin Qinghe, you’ve been watching her all this time.]
[However, this time you didn’t have the idea of startling the snake. In fact, you’ve been thinking about one question. Lin Qinghe clearly has a Devouring Immortal Demon Body, so why is her cultivation level only at the 7th tier Void Divine Realm after a thousand years.]
[With the strength of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, coupled with the other Soul Tablet in her body, it wouldn’t be strange if she cultivated to the 7th tier Void Divine Realm or even reached the Great Perfection in the True Divine Realm or became a God Monarch in a thousand years.]
[The Devouring Immortal Demon Body, though not as helpful in Enlightenment as the Time-Space Body, is second to none in terms of cultivation improvement speed.]
[However, Lin Qinghe just happened to have only reached the 7th-tier Void Divine Realm after a thousand years, as if that were her own cultivation level.]

chapters.title: Chapter 576: 181: The Legacy of the Black Abyss Demon Lord! Emperor Qingzhu_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Chapter 181: The Legacy of the Black Abyss Demon Lord! Emperor Qingzhu_4
“After some thought, you believe that Lin Qinghe has not yet stepped onto the Demon Path and has no intention of using the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to strengthen herself. Instead, she will encounter certain events in the future that will cause her to accept the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and choose such a method to become stronger.”
“Viewed in this light, you think that your actions in the last simulation, where you forced Lin Qinghe to reveal her abilities prematurely, might have led her to accept the Demonic Body earlier, becoming stronger at a speed that goes against your original intentions.”
“Upon reaching this conclusion, you start wondering whether to approach Lin Qinghe to find out what exactly happened to her that would make her choose to accept the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and fully enter the Demon Path.”
…
With the text simulation paused here, various images and cultivation insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
In the end, Wang Ping’s vision changed, and he found himself within the Tao Palace.
“Is it time for another branch in the storyline? Approaching Lin Qinghe… isn’t that courting death?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly, feeling somewhat conflicted.
Last time, simply because of his curiosity, he was possessed by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint.
This time, if he rashly approaches Lin Qinghe, there’s likely to be trouble again.”
“Speaking of which, that Lin Yan, he even has a name…”
Wang Ping remembered the storyline in the text simulation, his expression becoming odd.
Although it wasn’t absolute and there were exceptions, those who were mentioned by name in the text simulation were not mere extras and were certainly more than ordinary.
Logically speaking, as one who was devoured by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint, the Great Saint should be the one with the name, not the victim of its possession.
“Don’t tell me, this Lin Yan, instead of being devoured by the Great Saint, actually eliminated it.”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of this possibility, his gaze becoming subtle.
If this is indeed the case, then this Lin Yan is quite interesting, and the secrets he holds would certainly be astonishing.
“Interesting, I might probe into this in the future.”
Wang Ping chuckled lightly, remembering this individual named Lin Yan.
However, again, Wang Ping thought about the current branched choice and felt conflicted.
“I must use the free simulation for explorations in the future. Even though the Lower-tier God’s Source is nothing to me currently, as long as I do not increase my cultivation, if the subsequent rewards are not refreshing, I will have to go to the Upper Realm in advance, which carries a certain level of risk.”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping decided to abandon the idea of getting closer to Lin Qinghe.
It’s not the right time.
This simulation is meant to refresh good rewards to deal with potential crises. It’s better to be cautious.
With this in mind, Wang Ping said in his heart: “System, continue to fast forward.”
The moment his words finished, the luminescent screen lit up and the text continued to appear.
“After making your decision, you no longer approach Lin Qinghe. Instead, you diligently cultivate, hoping to break through to the True Divine Realm before the Mo family takes action.”
“However, in the Last Dharma Age, reaching the True Divine Realm is not easily achievable. Even if you are talented, the situation remains the same. In the Last Dharma Age, with the suppression of the Heavenly Tao, it is normal for some geniuses to remain at the Half-step True Lord Realm for thousands of years.”
“Perhaps, due to your exceptional talents, you can break through to True Lord status in a notably short period of time. Nevertheless, unless there is a related opportunity, it would be difficult to forcibly break through in less than a thousand years without compromising your foundation.”
“Apart from this, moving from the Void Divine Realm to the True Divine Realm carries a great risk. In the Void Divine Realm, despite the refinement of the Divine Body and the qualitative change of Mana, you are still only classified as a semi-deity. Only when you reach the True Divine Realm can you be considered a true deity.”
“In the True Divine Realm, not only do your essence, energy, and soul undergo another transformation, but more importantly, you establish a Divine Platform. Once the Divine Platform is formed, you can collect the faith of all beings.”
“If the faith of all beings persists, even if a True Lord perishes, there is a slim possibility of rebirth. Many True Lords leave behind back-ups. These True Lords, given the ability to descend to the Lower Plane, choose to perform miracles, spread their faith, form Divine Totems, and receive worship from all beings.”
“Under such circumstances, even if some of the past True Lords have fallen, they can be reborn through the totem, although they may not return to their peak. As totemic divine spirits, they rely on the power of faith to survive, but at least they are alive.”
“Of course, there are very few True Lords who can survive in this way. More often, True Lords cannot activate this possibility and completely fall.”
“Generally speaking, the higher a True Lord’s cultivation, the more divine the built Divine Platform, the sturdier it is, and the greater the faith, the higher the chance of resurrection.”
“In addition to that, it also relates to one’s own foundation and future cultivation limit. For this reason, every Half-step True Lord would not rashly try to break through to the True Divine Realm. They need to find sufficiently good Divine Materials, or spend a long time building their divinity, or both, before attempting to break through.”
“You have high-quality Divine Materials supplied by the Tao Palace. Although they are not the best Divine Materials, they are good enough in this era. You have no complaints. After all, if you were to search for them yourself, there’s a high chance you wouldn’t find such good Divine Materials. Even if you did find them, the probability of obtaining them despite the risk of falling is not high.”

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 181: The Legacy of the Black Abyss Demon Lord! Emperor Qingzhu_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Chapter 181: The Legacy of the Black Abyss Demon Lord! Emperor Qingzhu_5
[This is all due to the painful lessons you learned while searching for resources in the Lower Realm, giving you a clearer understanding in your heart.]
[In a blink of an eye, hundreds of years have passed. During these hundreds of years, many things have happened on the Elemental Star, but you didn’t care and continued to cultivate diligently, accumulating your potential to break through to the True Divine Realm.]
[As a result, after hundreds of years, you still haven’t broken through to True Lord, but the time for you to break through to True Lord is not far off.]
[But by this time, you had no intention of continuing to cultivate and chose to leave your seclusion instead.]
[The reason for leaving seclusion is because it’s already time for the Mo family to descend to the Lower Realm. You plan to take the powerful cultivators from Tao Palace to the Lower Realm to stop the Mo family while also obtaining the Black Magic Stone from Young Master Mo, as well as taking action against the half-step God Lord Realm Demon who had been sealed on the Profound Turtle, conducting a soul-searching on him and discovering the secret of the Black Abyss Demon Lord Inheritance.]
[A secret realm created by the fishing of a Remnant Soul of the Great Saint has attracted so much attention. If you can really get the Demon Lord Inheritance, the gains will undoubtedly be astonishing and not to be missed.]
[When you announced your decision to invite a God King Realm powerhouse to accompany you and bring the Sacred Artifact to the Lower Realm, the Master of Tao Palace was very surprised. However, he didn’t ask too many questions and chose to invite a Divine Monarch Realm Elder for you to accompany you to the Lower Realm.]
[Thus, under the guidance of the Divine Monarch Realm Elder, you obtained the coordinates of the Purple Spirit Realm and directly descended to the Lower Realm.]
[When you arrived in the Lower Realm, you found that the Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm were still at war. Although you had left many backup plans for Ye Chen and Ji Bingyan in the Purple Spirit Realm, it still takes time for Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, to grow up.]
[Initially, when you were in the Lower Realm nurturing Ye Chen, it took him 1500 to 1600 years to break through to the Void Divine Realm. Not to mention after you left for the Upper Realm. At this point in time, Ye Chen is only a King Realm cultivator.]
[As for Ji Bingyan, due to not flirting with Ji Bingyue and Ji Xue’er, and not spending time getting acquainted with Ji Bingyan, she did not accept the resources you provided. She is still at the Quasi-Immortal Tier, confronting the Blood Demon World Quasi-divine.]
[After you descended to the Lower Realm, you directly killed the powerful cultivators of the Blood Demon Realm, leaving the Purple Spirit Realm cultivators dumbfounded. You ignored the shocked Purple Spirit Realm powerhouses, caught up with Ye Chen and others, went to the Profound Turtle, broke the spatial seal, entered the small world, and easily suppressed the Demon.]
[Then, you asked the Elder of the God King Realm of Tao Palace to help you with the soul-searching. After all, this Demon was a half-step God King Realm strongman at his peak. Although he is now weak, and you have reached the half-step True Lord realm, it is still not stable to conduct soul-searching on him. It is safer to let a stronger elder do it.]
[With the action of the Elder of the God King Realm of Tao Palace, the Demon screamed in pain as he was forcibly soul-searched, eventually becoming dull and with an incomplete soul. The Elder of the God King Realm of Tao Palace also obtained a lot of information from his mind.]
[That is, this Demon really knows the secret of the Black Abyss Demon Lord Inheritance. However, the Black Abyss Demon Lord Inheritance is not in the Lower Realm, but in the Upper Realm.]
[Originally, the Black Abyss Demon Lord was extremely tyrannical, but because his style was too brutal and domineering, he was hated by many cultivators. He once fought against the Green Bamboo Emperor at the Supreme Realm, making the sky gloomy and the earth dark, and even the Green Bamboo Emperor had a hard time.]
[In the end, the Black Abyss Demon Lord was defeated, and his original life’s Magic Weapon was taken away by the Green Bamboo Emperor. He suffered a disgraceful defeat and fled in serious injury. Eventually, he encountered problems in his cultivation due to his severe injuries and continuous Heart Demons. After leaving the land of inheritance in the Upper Realm, he passed away.]
[To open the land of inheritance and obtain the inheritance, you must take back his original life’s Magic Weapon. This original life’s Magic Weapon is the key to opening the land of inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.]
[However, at that time, the Green Bamboo Emperor, who was still at the Supreme Realm, sealed this Magic Weapon with the potential to grow into an Emperor Force in the Purple Spirit Realm in order to prevent the Black Abyss Demon Lord from recalling it.]
[The reason why this Demon, who only had a half-step Divinity Realm cultivation at his peak, knew so much was because he accidentally encountered a quirky cultivator who claimed to be the Heavenly Calculation’s Child.]
[This Heavenly Calculation’s Child claimed to be able to calculate everything and told him about the matters concerning the Black Abyss Demon Lord and the Green Bamboo Emperor. Initially, he was skeptical and couldn’t figure out what the purpose of this cultivator claiming to be the Heavenly Calculation’s Child was.]
[However, in the end, he was still attracted by the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s inheritance. His greed and ambition occupied his heart, and he chose to take the risk and descend to the Lower Realm to search for the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.]
[But, once in the Lower Realm, he was caught by the so-called Guardian Wei and sealed here. He never even saw the Magic Weapon of the Black Abyss Supreme and couldn’t help but feel miserable.]
…
“So, the Black Abyss Demon Lord had such a past.”
Seeing the contents of the Text Simulation, Wang Ping marveled.
To fight the Emperor in the same realm, even though he lost, he made it extremely difficult for the Supreme Realm Emperor to win, which was definitely an honorable defeat.
If the Black Abyss Supreme did not die, he would have the potential to become an Emperor. His Magic Weapon could also become an Emperor Force.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 182: Breaking Through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Chapter 182: Breaking Through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness
“However, it’s a pity that even after achieving the Supreme Realm through Cultivating Demonic Tao, one can still fall due to encountering Heart Demons. All I can say is that losing a battle in the same realm, having one’s weapon snatched away, and being forced to flee in humiliation would cause their Tao Heart to collapse.”
Wang Ping thought about the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s cause of death and shook his head slightly.
This was the Cultivation Path, it was too cruel.
“By the way, who is this Heavenly Calculation’s Child? How does he know so many secrets? Can he really calculate the heavens and earth? If he has such an ability, why would he tell a demonic cultivator who is only at the half-step God Monarch Realm about this?”
Wang Ping thought of the Heavenly Calculation’s Child that had appeared in the text simulation and frowned.
Heavenly Calculation’s Child, this person was not simple, what exactly was he planning?
Wang Ping’s intuition told him that this person was very dangerous and that he needed to guard against him, otherwise, something might go wrong.
After that, Wang Ping exhaled lightly, calmed his mind, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen, waiting for the text to appear.
[Next, you went with the Elders of the God King Realm in Tao Palace to Primordial Forbidden Land and saw the Black Abyss Demon Spear of the Black Abyss Supreme. Then, the Elders of the God King Realm in Tao Palace also gave an answer, saying that even if they unseal their power, they would have no chance of breaking the seal. If they were to use Array-breaking Talismans specifically designed for breaking arrays, it might cause severe consequences.]
[Regarding this, you were not surprised by the answer of the Elder of the God King Realm. After all, it was a grand array and seal placed by the Green Bamboo Emperor.]
[Although it was said that back then, when the Green Bamboo Emperor established the seal, he was only at the Supreme Realm cultivation, and the seal had weakened a lot after so many years, but it was not something a God Monarch Realm could break.]
[Then, you didn’t say much and chose to leave the Primordial Forbidden Land. Not long after, Young Master Mo went to the lower realm with his followers and was caught by you on the spot. With the Sacred Artifact brought by the Elder of the God King Realm in Tao Palace, even the Sacred Artifact brought by Young Master Mo could not exert its power and was easily suppressed.]
[After that, you obtained the Black Magic Stone from Young Master Mo’s body and started to study it. You found that this black magic stone had a strange power, which was the same as the material and power contained in the Black Abyss Demon Spear. No wonder Young Master Mo was confident that he could unlock the seal.]
[You asked the Elder of the God King Realm in Tao Palace about the origin of this magic stone, wondering if he knew anything about it. The Elder of the God King Realm in Tao Palace shook his head, indicating that he didn’t know, but he suggested that the Scripture Repository in Tao Palace might have some records.]
[Upon hearing this, you decided to return to the Upper Realm to check the Scripture Repository in Tao Palace for information. At this time, Young Master Mo begged for mercy, saying that if he had known that a Disciple of Tao Palace was interested in the legacy of the Black Abyss Demon Lord, they wouldn’t have made a mistake. He hoped that you could spare him, and he was willing to submit to you.]
[Facing Young Master Mo’s plea, you chose to cast a Secret Skill on him, making him your servant. The Elder of the God King Realm in Tao Palace didn’t say much about it. Young Master Mo was considered a genius in the Upper Realm, and having him submit was not a bad thing.]
[As for whether the incident would be exposed? Even if it were exposed, the Elder of the God King Realm in Tao Palace didn’t think it would cause any trouble. Although Tao Palace had fallen into decline, the Mo family couldn’t take advantage of it. At their peak, the Mo family had only produced one Saint King, which was far inferior compared to Tao Palace.]
[After that, you ordered Young Master Mo to return to the Mo family and tell them that there was no such thing as the Black Abyss Demon Spear in the lower realm, and then let him go.]
[Meanwhile, you ascended to the Upper Realm with your close friends Lin Yuanyuan, Ye Chen, Cai Yonglong, and Bai Tianhong. After all, you didn’t have the ability to take them to the Upper Realm before, but now that you have brought an elder from the God King Realm, you naturally have the ability to take them together. And once in the Upper Realm, they could grow even faster.]
[Upon returning to Tao Palace, Lin Yuanyuan and the others also joined Tao Palace. You then went to the Scripture Repository to find the information you wanted. Soon after, you found information related to the magic stone.]
[This magic stone, called Demonic Heavenly Stone, is one of the mysterious ores for forging demonic weapons, extremely rare and highly sought after by demonic cultivators for its excellent growth properties. Of course, although it is materials specifically for demonic cultivators, forging weapons for righteous cultivators also has a wonderful effect, making it extremely valuable.]
[In addition to this, the Demonic Heavenly Stone also has another special use, which is that it can greatly hone one’s willpower. However, there is also some risk in doing so, as it can easily lead to possession by demons.]
[After learning about the preciousness of the Demonic Heavenly Stone, you marveled at it and decided to use it for cultivation in the future. If you come across any good items later on, you can also use it for exchanges.]
[Next, you leave the Scripture Repository and prepare to continue your cultivation in seclusion. It was during this time that news spread that the Holy Lady of the Yuan Family broke through to the True Divine Realm, defeating various geniuses and even defeating the Sect Master of a God Sect, shocking the Elemental Star.]
[Not only the Holy Lady of the Yuan Family stepped into the True Divine Realm with remarkable achievements, the Holy Son of the Zhang Family, and the descendants of major powers such as the Eternal Source Holy Dynasty also successively entered the True Divine Realm. They started challenging other heroes and conquer their luck, cultivating their Invincible Heart, paving the way to Entering Saint and even the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification in the future.]
[When you heard that these people had broken through to the True Divine Realm and started various fierce battles, you were not surprised. They were all true geniuses, who were all one or two thousand years older than you. When you had just ascended to the Upper Realm, they were already at the Half-step True Lord Realm, so it wasn’t strange for them to break through one after another.]

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 182: Breaking through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Chapter 182: Breaking through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness_2
[Of course, for cultivators of the Upper Realm, especially for Void lord and True Lord Realm cultivators, an age of three or four thousand years is actually equivalent to the age of a typical teenager, so they can still be referred to as young geniuses.]
[It’s just that, cultivators view time differently. Often, hundreds of years pass by in a single period of secluded cultivation.]
[However, you didn’t pay attention to the First Geniuses of the Primordial Star who had begun to battle fiercely, and instead planned to continue your secluded cultivation, aiming to breakthrough to the True Divine Realm before coming out of seclusion.]
[Unfortunately, even though you didn’t want to stir things up, there were others who didn’t respect your wishes. The Yuan Family Holy Lady showed up at the Tao Palace, wanting to challenge you. This left you speechless; she really had a grudge against you. This woman really knew how to hold a grudge.]
[From your perspective, whether it was the last incarnation or this simulation, it was always the Holy Lady’s brother who initiated the challenge, and then got killed by you within seconds. His collapse of the Tao Heart was none of your business. You could only say that his Tao Heart was too fragile; and yet his sister, the Holy Lady, kept seeking opportunities for revenge.]
[In previous years, you heard of the Holy Lady challenging you many times. However, each time she arrived, you were in seclusion trying to break through to the True Divine Realm, hence she was always left disappointed. This time, she probably heard of your exit from seclusion and arrived shortly after your breakthrough.]
[In response to this, you found her to be annoying, but also aimed to obtain a Sacred Artifact from this unreasonable lady. Therefore, you accepted her challenge.]
[Then, under the witness of various masters, an earth-shaking battle erupted between you two. Finally, with a relentless mentality, you pushed the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and the Great Perfection Space-Time Pseudo Law to their extreme. The Yuan Family Holy Lady, who was in the True Divine Realm, was defeated by you who still was only in the Half-step True Lord Realm.]
[After being defeated by you who was still a step behind in the Cultivation Realm, the Yuan Family Holy Lady lost a Sacred Artifact and was somewhat dispirited. Her Tao Heart was on the brink of shattering, and the Yuan Family felt the pain of the loss deeply. As for the Master of Tao Palace, he was laughed heartily.]
[When the result of the battle spread, the entire Elemental Ancient Star was shocked. After all, mastering the Time-Space Pseudo Law at the Half-step True Lord Realm is an unthinkable feat that adds to the terrifying nature of the whole ordeal. Furthermore, defeating the Yuan Family Holy Lady who was a True Lord, is even more absurd.]
[This battle directly established your title as the First Heaven’s Proud Genius and the strongest in the same cultivation level of the Elemental Ancient Star. The other geniuses of the Elemental Ancient Star had to admit defeat in silence.]
[You, however, did not pay attention to the waves caused in the outer world. You did not have the idea of causing further chaos outside, but instead chose to go into seclusion again, continuing your attempt to break through to the True Divine Realm and build your own Divine Platform.]
[In the blink of an eye, twenty years had passed. You came out of seclusion after successfully breaking through to the True Divine Realm, and faced an extremely terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[Despite this, you had no fear, and with your overwhelming power, you crossed the tribulation, successfully stepping into the True Divine Realm, becoming a True Lord, and can now be considered a real powerhouse in the current Upper Realm.]
[After all, the Masters of various divine sects are only of the True Divine Realm, and you have now reached this level, with cultivation no weaker than them. The people of the same generation as you have only reached this level after thousands of years of cultivation.]
[After your breakthrough, the powerhouses of Tao Palace were all congratulating you, and you were very happy. It was at this moment that a horrifying wave of pressure swept over the entire Elemental Ancient Star, causing the entire star to tremble.]
[This terrifying pressure didn’t target the other forces and living beings of the Elemental Ancient Star, but solely targeted the Tao Palace. Therefore, the Emperor Force of Tao Palace was startled and revived, resisting this terrifying pressure.]
[In addition to this, the self-titled ancestors of Tao Palace who were sealed within the divine source were also awakened, breaking out of the divine source, they rushed out, wielding the Emperor Force to confront the source of this pressure.]
[Seeing this scene shocked you to the core. You never expected such a terrifying enemy to descend, targeting the Tao Palace. However, you recalled from your previous incarnation and this simulation that the Tao Palace still existed hundreds of years later. Therefore, you believed that nothing major would happen, and Tao Palace should be able to survive this calamity.]
[However, you had thought too optimistically. The ancestors of Tao Palace emerged, wielding the Emperor Force to confront the Mysterious Powerhouse in the universe. Unexpectedly, they were killed in one fell swoop, unable to even protect himself with the Emperor Force.]
[Then, you were captured by a terrifying force. After you were abducted, you were directly refined by them. Apparently, you were their target all along.]
[During your tribulation, the aura of your Time-Space Body was exposed, detected by this terrifying powerhouse. Hence, he took interest in the original source of your Time-Space Body. Such a physique was greatly beneficial for him.]
[You knew all too well that there was no chance of survival in front of such power, and therefore, chose not to use the Rebirth tally to revive, so as not to give them another opportunity to refine you.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends….]
…..
As the text simulation came to an end here, many images and cultivation realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and his view also changed.
He found himself in a secluded place, where an indistinct, terrifying powerhouse was refining him, absorbing the core of his Time-Space Body.
“This guy, he even managed to fling away the Emperor’s Force, and defeat the self-titled ancestors of Tao Palace with ease. What level of terrifying cultivation has he reached?”

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 182: Breaking through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 182: Breaking through the True Lord! The Undying Strangeness_3
Wang Ping silently looked at this powerful figure, feeling amazed in his heart.
“However, it is the Last Dharma Age now. If he possesses such terrifying strength, it’s probably because he had such cultivation a hundred thousand years ago. For this kind of strong person, living for one hundred thousand years may be quite easy.”
Wang Ping made another speculation.
At the same time, he felt somewhat troubled.
He never expected his Time-Space Body to be so attractive to these old monsters. It made this powerful person ignore the Imperial Force’s Might, forcibly attacking the Tao Palace and abducting him for refining.
“However, considering the uniqueness of the Time-Space Body, this may be normal. It seems I have to be more careful in the future. I can’t just expose my physique. Of course, the reason for this situation is probably because of the Heavenly Tribulation. This strong person sensed me when I used the power of Time-Space Body while going through the tribulation and polished it.”
“Otherwise, he would have come earlier, no need to wait. Besides, there’s also the possibility that the Divine World just happened to cross the Elemental Star and discovered my Time-Space Body. If that’s the case, I’m really unfortunate.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, thinking to himself.
As Wang Ping was thinking, his consciousness flickered, and his vision shifted back to Zhang Hu’s world.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. 1st tier True Divine Realm cultivation.
②. Purple Talent: Endless Blade.
③. Life-bound Divine Artifact (Superior Divine Artifact Tier).
④. Yuan Family Holy Artifact.
⑤. Demonic Heavenly Stone.”
“This Purple Talent really has no presence.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and couldn’t help but complain.
Of course, Wang Ping knew that the reason why this Purple Talent was inconspicuous was that he had too few battles in the simulation.
More precisely, there were too few life-and-death battles that pushed him to the limit.
Otherwise, it would have been a key plot point during the simulation.
As for whether the battle with the Yuan Family Holy Lady triggered the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, it was unknown.
“As usual, don’t pick a reward first. Simulate it to learn more about the strange situation before making a decision.”
Wang Ping collected his thoughts and secretly thought to himself in his heart.
With his current strength, as long as he doesn’t encounter a strange big boss, it’s easy to deal with the newcomers in the chat group.
There is no reason other than having enough strength and information superiority to encounter strangeness and crush it casually.
Moreover, in Wang Ping’s view, the strange that would run to such a weak world couldn’t be anything remarkable.
This mission should not be difficult.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
Wang Ping quietly said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator starting, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, Wang Ping felt his consciousness shift as he entered the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping said again.
“Ding, fast forwarding…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and the luminescent screen appeared, with familiar text emerging.
[On the first day, you chose to start taking action. Your approach was very straightforward–directly covering the world with your divine sense, trying to find the unusual being by brute force. However, you didn’t find anything abnormal.]
[In response, you began to search even more aggressively. That is, you simply blew up the entire world.]
[However, you were surprised to find that you still didn’t hear the Group Task completion prompt. This made you instantly realize that the strange being was not in the lower realm, but in the Divine World.]
[For this reason, after sensing the connection between the lower realm and the Divine World, you didn’t hesitate to take Cai Yonglong and others with you, tearing through the void and forcibly entering the Divine World.]
[When you arrived in the Divine World, you discovered that it had changed drastically. You didn’t sense the auras of many gods, only one deity. This aura was bright and evil, giving a very contradictory feeling.]
[At this, you immediately concluded that it was the aura of the Light Lord God, who had been possessed by the strange being. The strange being who possessed the Light Lord God directly destroyed all the other gods, devouring them.]
[At this moment, the aura of the Light Lord God has become incredibly strong. Even you are surprised by the aura of the Light Lord God now.]
[In your view, without being possessed, the Light Lord God’s strength would only reach the Nirvana Boundary at most. However, the current Light Lord God has reached the level of Void Divine Realm, which is a terrifying increase in power.]
[As you sensed the strength and weakness of the strange being, its arrival didn’t surprise it. Instead, it welcomed you and Cai Yonglong, which surprised everyone and made you frown.]
[To be honest, you were surprised by the strange being’s reaction, but not particularly shocked. Since there have been strange beings in this world and the Light Lord God has cooperated with them, knowing that they have come to participate on a mission means the world has been protected. The appearance of the strange would naturally trigger the world’s self-saving response and ask for help from the outer world.]
[You didn’t waste words with the strange being and directly broke out into an astonishing battle. You easily defeated the strange being. Although it was powerful, it was just a Void Divine Realm level being. For you now, it wasn’t anything special.]

chapters.title: Chapter 581: 182: Breaking through the True God! The Undying Weird_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 182: Breaking through the True God! The Undying Weird_4
“After all, although your cultivation is only 1st tier Void Divine Realm, your other aspects are much more advanced, and your strength far exceeds the average Void Divine Realm.”
“Yet, something serious has happened. Strangely, after you’ve killed him her it, they resurrected again. And this time, its power has become stronger. You once again fought against her it in a great battle, and you killed it again.”
“However, once again, strangely, they have revived again, its power once again greatly advanced, reaching the level of a 7th-Tier Void Divine Realm. You’re suspicious that if you kill it one more time, its power might possibly surpass yours.”
“It turns out, this strangeness can grow stronger each time they are killed. When you ascended to the Upper Realm, the lower realm that you destroyed was left with no followers, there were also no other lives left in the Divine World. In other words, they did not resurrect through their followers.”
“Therefore, you can only speculate that its resurrection has a limit, or to be more precise, its resurrection skill has a limit. Only when you destroy it with a force far beyond its maximum endurance will it possibly die completely.”
“But judging from previous battles, you obviously do not possess such a high power that overwhelms its endurance limit. After all, you used all your strength at the beginning but it still managed to resurrect.”
“As for you killing it again, taking a risk on the number of its resurrections, it’s too risky. Hence, you could only think of one solution: having Lin Yuanyuan forcibly overrun the hell out of it.”
“This is also your repeated solution to deal with strangeness. It can be said that Lin Yuanyuan has become a special weapon against strangeness.”
“Immediately, you explode with a time-space divine skill and forcibly control it. Then, you order Lin Yuanyuan to forcefully possess the body of the Light Lord God’s strangeness.”
“However, something that silenced you guys occurred. The Light Lord God, obviously a male god, turned out to be a female body once undressed. Out of mockery, the strangeness implied that you already killed one of its kind with this method and questioned whether you thought it would fall for it again?”
“Actually, there is a simple way to defeat Lin Yuanyuan’s power. That is, if the target turns into a woman, the usual contact can’t happen. Additionally, cutting off the root of troubles, severing lust, physiological instincts, and the like can also avoid being controlled and killed.”
“Seeing that the direct approach didn’t work, a helpless Lin Yuanyuan encountered this situation for the first time. Cai Yonglong, Fang Yun, Wu Jun, and other people were also dumbfounded, not expecting such a thing to happen.”
“Next, you ordered Wu Jun to activate the potential for a positive outcome and try to solve the strange problem.”
“Hearing your words, Wu Jun was not hesitant at all and activated his power. Then, under the bewildered and horrified gaze of the strangeness, his body turned into ashes, and he died completely.”
“After the strangeness died, you received a Group Task notification, declaring that you have completed the group task. At this, you were a bit speechless, not expecting that after a hard fight and having it under control, Wu Jun simply triggered an instant-death possibility. That is actually quite horrifying.”
“However, this kind of strategy does not count as a regular method and won’t be a great help to kill the strangeness in reality. After all, Wu Jun activated this feature in the simulation, but that might not necessarily be the case in reality.”
“Because you completed the group task, you chose to actively exit the simulation.”
“Due to your choice, the simulation now ends…..”
…
With the end of the text simulation, many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. He then exited the simulation state, and his view returned to the private room.
