“Mr.Wang, how did it go?”
Seeing Wang change his expression, Lin Yuanyuan was the first to ask.
“The situation is a bit tricky.”
Wang Ping said with a furrowed brow.
Hearing this, everyone’s expression became slightly serious.
Mr.Wang is now a Void Divine Realm Master.
If even Mr.Wang is saying it’s a bit tricky, it means that this strangeness isn’t straightforward—it is likely to be more troublesome than those they’ve dealt with before.
Wang Ping glanced at everyone, didn’t waste any time, and directly relayed the simulation content.
After listening to it, everyone exchanged looks of wonder.
This strangeness is actually aware that they are coming and even defended against Lin Yuanyuan’s ability. It’s rather horrifying.”
“Mr.Wang, is it possible that this strangeness is fishing? The developments during the simulation may not necessarily be accurate, just like what happened in Wu Yueming’s world before…”
Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but send Wang Ping a message.
He knew that Wang Ping’s life simulator could not simulate the circumstances of the All Heavens.
If they were to go over now and another strangeness appears, then it would be troublesome.
“I also thought of this possibility, so I’m a bit worried.”
Wang Ping replied with a scowling face.
Even though no other strangeness appears in the simulator, that does not mean they won’t appear in reality.
It’s possible that the stranger is on his way and can break into this world at any time.
If that’s the case, there’s still the possibility of their team being wiped out.”
“Relying on Wu Jun’s golden finger’s strategy is not steady at all. So, what should we do? This strangeness may not have any dangerous abilities, but it revives every time it gets killed and even gets stronger, it’s also quite a headache.”
Zhang Hu said with a bit of a headache.
“Don’t rush. Let me try again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 582: 182: Breakthrough True Lord! The Undying Weirdness_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 182: Breakthrough True Lord! The Undying Weirdness_5
Wang Ping shook his head, closing his eyes once again.
Seeing this, everyone else also quieted down.
“System, I want to undergo a free simulation,” Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation starting.”
The system’s voice echoed once more, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and he reentered the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me,” Wang Ping instructed.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice echoed once more, the luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged.
“[On the first day, you moved once again. But this time, you didn’t annihilate the lower realm. Instead, you went straight to the upper realm. When you arrived, you found the trickster who had been waiting for you.]”
“[This time, you didn’t intend to kill the trickster, but used your powers to seal him away. However, even without killing him, the trickster’s power continued to grow steadily.]”
“[Clearly, the trickster has another ability, which is to grow stronger through the power of belief. And because he had devoured other deities, all the faith of the lower realm belonged solely to him.]”
“[For this reason, you frowned, annihilated the lower realm, and then the trickster’s power stopped growing. However, he still mocked you, for you couldn’t kill him.]”
“[To this, you didn’t bother to argue and simply let Wu Jun use the power of the Golden Finger. But this time, Wu Jun’s Golden Finger didn’t trigger an instant death effect, didn’t kill the trickster, but instead resurrected all the gods.]”
“[As the gods were resurrected, the trickster’s power weakened significantly. Seeing this, you had to admit that Wu Jun’s Golden Finger was incredibly game-breaking, akin to a wish-fulfilling machine. However, this wish-granting machine was random; anything could happen.]”
“[Next, after thinking it over, you attempted to use your strongest secret skill, sacrificing your origin to deal a powerful blow to the weakened trickster. However, after the trickster was killed by you, he resurrected once again.]”
“[You’re out of options to deal with him. As a result, you ended the simulation out of frustration. Continuing the simulation was pointless and just a waste of time.]”
….
“What a nuisance.”
Wang Ping sighed while looking at the simulation content.
The power of the first tier of the Void Divine Realm couldn’t kill this trickster, a fact he had fully realized.
Which meant, the only way he could enhance his combat power to completely eliminate the trickster would be by acquiring the rewards from the paid simulation.
However, as soon as he chose the Cultivation Reward, the price for the paid simulation would skyrocket, making it unbearable.
After all, going from the first tier of the Void Divine Realm to the first tier of the True Divine Realm, advancing a Great Realm, as well as numerous small realms, the resource consumption required for another paid simulation would make him shudder.
The scarcity of resources in the Last Dharma Age was known to him through the words of the Master of Tao Palace in the previous paid simulation. He was going to the Upper Realm, and it was uncertain whether he could acquire enough cultivation resources for a paid simulation in a short period.
“So, it’s not an option to choose Cultivation. That leaves me with two choices.”
Wang Ping considered silently.
Option one was to choose the Sacred Artifact, and option two was the Purple Talent: Endless Blade.
By leveraging the power of the Sacred Artifact, he could suppress the trickster.
If the Purple Talent: Endless Blade could trigger another critical strike, that would be great.
If the power of the Sacred Artifact still couldn’t completely suppress the trickster, then Wang Ping could only retreat.
The trickster was impossible to kill, and too risky to provoke. He might be baiting them; the situation was just too risky.
Therefore, he’d be better off retreating to the Purple Spirit Realm to continue strengthening himself through the simulation before dealing with the trickster.
As for what might happen to Zhang Hu during this period, all Wang Ping could do was to offer him and this world his silent condolences for three seconds.
“Mr. Wang, what’s with that pitiful look in your eyes? It’s freaking me out,” Zhang Hu said, looking slightly terrified under Wang Ping’s gaze.
“No big deal, you just have to move,” Wang Ping comforted Zhang Hu, responding.
“Uh….Damn!” Zhang Hu’s face darkened, realizing that the situation was probably grim.
Wang Ping didn’t hide anything and recounted the situation.
Everyone looked at each other with consternation.
The trickster’s resurrection ability was outrageous. It seemed impossible to kill him. Now, how to handle this?
“Increase your combat power, try one last time, and if that doesn’t work, we’ll prepare for backup from Chen Si in the group. If even that’s not enough, get ready to retreat,” Wang Ping swept his gaze over everyone and said candidly.
Even though he had grown powerful, Wang Ping felt that retreat was not a shameful choice when dealing with a trickster, one’s safety came first.
“Uh……I agree.”
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Only Zhang Hu was a bit melancholic.
This world was quite good. He did not want it to be destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 583: 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand !)
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand chapter!)
Wang Ping did not continue to pay attention to the crowd, instead he muttered silently in his heart: “System, I choose ②. Purple Talent: Infinite Blade and ④. Yuan Family Holy Artifact.”
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt an extremely powerful Sacred Artifact appear in his storage space, which was the Yuan Family Holy Artifact, the weapon of the Saints.
As for the feeling after receiving the talent, there was nothing special. This talent needed to be triggered during battle, so naturally, there was no possibility of actively using it at ordinary times. It was like a passive skill.
Next, Wang Ping let out a light breath and prepared to simulate again.
However, this time Wang Ping was considering whether to go for a free simulation or a paid simulation.
If he went for a paid simulation and managed to refresh a powerful talent, it might become a key factor in breaking the deadlock or give him extra self-protection power when facing a cunning fishing situation.
In the end, Wang Ping decided to give the paid simulation a try. After all, he still had several opportunities for paid simulations, and using one wouldn’t hurt. It was all for the sake of security.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
After making the decision, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, consume 10 jin of lower-tier God’s Source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing in progress.”
The voice of the system sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Purple Talent: Breath Concealment; Red Talent: Bard.”
Purple Talent·Breath Concealment: With this talent, the host can group-hide the perception of those below the Saint Realm when using it. When in action, even Semi-saints will have difficulty detecting your presence.
Red Talent·Bard: With this talent, the host will become extremely talented in creating poetry, and chanting poetry in battle can enhance combat power.
“Huh, Purple Talent·Breath Concealment, it’s the enhanced version of Red Talent·Breath Concealment, right? Not only is it group concealment, but it’s also difficult for even Semi-saints to detect? That’s pretty good.”
“With this talent, if we hide our aura and go to the Divine World to deal with the cunning one, maybe we can catch him off guard and easily eliminate him. That way, even if we get caught fishing, it would be safer with more cunning ones suddenly appearing. After all, as long as we eliminate the cunning one, we will leave without hesitation and not give him any chances to react.”
“Of course, this premise is that the power of the Holy Artifact and the Infinite Blade can truly eliminate the undying cunning one. If they can’t kill it, the Breath Concealment would be useless.”
Thinking of this, Wang Ping spoke in his heart: “System, I choose Purple Talent·Breath Concealment.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out, and Wang Ping felt a flash before his eyes, knowing that he had entered the immersive simulation state.
With that, Wang Ping counted silently in his heart: “System, fast forward for me.”
“Ding, fast-forwarding.”
The system’s voice sounded again, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, you took action, using Breath Concealment and the Concealment Secret Skill to quietly head to the Divine World.]
[Because of the double effect of Breath Concealment and the secret skill, the cunning one, who had already set up a sensing divine technique, failed to detect your arrival.]
[As a result, you found the cunning one who had possessed the Light Lord God and directly used the Holy Artifact to strike him with a thunderous blow.]
[The power of the Holy Artifact was extremely strong, killing the cunning one completely. Apparently, the power of the Holy Artifact exceeded the upper limit of this cunning one’s undying ability.]
[To be precise, it exceeded the current cunning one’s upper limit. If the cunning one’s strength continued to increase, even the power of the Holy Artifact would not be able to kill him. This is because his undying ability’s upper limit increased with his strength, making him extremely difficult to deal with.]
[After killing the cunning one, you received a group task completion prompt and chose to leave this world. Since you chose to leave this world, the simulation ends here.]
Wang Ping looked at the content of this text simulation and couldn’t help but smile.
It seemed that the Holy Artifact was effective, directly killing the cunning one completely.
Of course, the credit goes to the Life Simulator, otherwise, the cunning one’s power would have been really troublesome, and even the power of the Holy Artifact might not have been useful.
After all, he wouldn’t hold back in terms of strength, but he wouldn’t use the Holy Artifact as his trump card right away. He would definitely try it out first. Once he tried to kill the cunning one and failed, he wouldn’t be able to kill him again.
That is to say, according to the description of the text simulation, the cunning one’s strength just needed to increase a bit, and the Holy Artifact would become useless.
At this moment, various images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and he finally exited the simulation state and returned to the private room where Zhang Hu was.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Purple Talent·Breath Concealment.
②. Red Talent·Bard.
③. Ten jin of Lower-tier God’s Source.”
…..
“System, I choose ①. Purple Talent·Breath Concealment.”
Wang Ping silently spoke in his heart.
As he finished speaking, Wang Ping felt that he had gained an additional talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 584: 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand !)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Chapter 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand chapter!)_2
“Mr. Wang, how did it go?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s smile earlier, the others also showed hopeful expressions and asked.
Wang Ping looked at everyone, nodded, and said, “It seems that we don’t need to call Chen Si over. This time, killing the strange thing went very smoothly. However, we still need to be on guard for any new strange things appearing. After all, the possibility of this strange thing being a bait is quite high.”
The others nodded in agreement, thinking that Wang Ping’s words made sense.
Without further ado, Wang Ping discussed some details with the others and then began their mission, fearing that delays might cause problems.
Wang Ping and his team concealed their auras, used secret techniques, and went to the Upper Divine Realm with the others. They found the strange thing that had possessed the Light Lord God, and used the power of the Sacred Artifact to deliver a life-ending blow.
Facing the power of the Sacred Artifact, which was shaking the entire Divine World, the strange thing showed a horrified expression. It did not expect Wang Ping and the others to suddenly appear here and launch such a powerful attack.
Even it couldn’t resist such a powerful attack, and might be killed in one hit.
It never thought that its own bait would be eaten by the fish.
The strange thing that had possessed the Light Lord God was extremely frustrated. It wanted to resist, but couldn’t and was instantly killed by the power of the Sacred Artifact.
Just as Wang Ping was using the Sacred Artifact to suppress and kill the strange thing that had possessed the Light Lord God, a notification sounded in their minds.
Cai Yonglong and the others were visibly excited and said, “Mr. Wang, the strange thing is dead, the Group Task is complete.”
Wang Ping smiled and nodded, not expecting it to go so smoothly.
Although it could be killed with a single blow in the simulator, the real world still had the possibility of being baited, so he had been on guard for unexpected situations.
However, Wang Ping’s smile didn’t last long as he sensed a massive disturbance in the space of this world and a terrifying, evil aura descended.
“Not good, let’s go!”
Wang Ping felt the horrifying evil aura, his pupils shrank suddenly, and after saying these words, he immediately chose to teleport away.
Upon seeing this, the others also changed their expressions and skillfully chose to teleport away from this world.
Zhang Hu also reacted quickly, directly using group points to teleport away.
Just one second after Wang Ping and the others teleported away, the entire Divine World was destroyed and completely annihilated.
Even the lower realms were affected and destroyed.
The entire magic world was completely obliterated.
…..
Within the Purple Spirit Realm, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, and Zhang Hu all appeared.
“Mr. Wang, what just happened?”
Upon returning, Cai Yonglong and Zhang Hu were somewhat uncertain.
“A chilling aura appeared. I felt that if we had been even a second later, we would have been trapped there.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and said in a low voice.
Upon hearing this, Cai Yonglong and the others felt goosebumps.
Just what kind of monster was this that made Mr. Wang say such words, it seemed terrifying.
“Can I go back?”
Zhang Hu said somewhat blankly.
Wang Ping glanced at Zhang Hu and replied with a faint tone, “Go back for what? If you want to die, go back. Although whether your world still exists or not is a question.”
“Uh….”
Zhang Hu fell silent and quietly opened the chat group, wanting to see if he could teleport back.
“The teleportation coordinates are still there? It seems they haven’t been destroyed.”
Zhang Hu hesitated.
“Don’t worry, I’ll ask in the chat group.”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows slightly and said.
As soon as his words fell, Wang Ping asked Alpha in his mind, “Alpha, is Zhang Hu’s world okay?”
“There’s a problem. Zhang Hu’s world has been completely destroyed. As for the World Source, it’s been divided between me and that guy.”
Alpha replied honestly.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping fell silent.
What a good guy, squeezed every last drop of oil.
“It’s actually really destroyed? This is the first time I’ve encountered a world being destroyed.”
Wang Ping sighed and felt a bit complicated.
Although he was now strong enough and had the power to destroy a world, in the grand scheme of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, he was still too insignificant.
Being the strongest among the Transmigrator Chat Group, he was still just a weakling in the vast expanse of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms. It seemed that building the chat group to its full potential would still be a long and arduous journey.
Of course, Wang Ping was not in a hurry.
After all, the Third Generation Chat Group had only been reorganized for a few years, it was just starting out, and couldn’t be compared to the First Generation Transcender Chat Group and the Second Generation Chat Group that had existed for who knows how long.
Nevertheless, Wang Ping was confident in catching up quickly.
After all, the members of their Third Generation Chat Group all had the Golden Finger, which meant they had a high growth potential and could become stronger quickly.
“Mr. Wang, how’s it going?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s change in expression, Zhang Hu’s heart trembled and he couldn’t help but ask.
“Your world, it’s gone.”
Wang Ping patted Zhang Hu’s shoulder, shook his head, and said.
“!!!”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Hu’s pupils contracted and he became completely silent.
“So it really is destroyed? Then my master, my friends, and the woman I like, are they all dead?”

chapters.title: Chapter 585: 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand !)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Chapter 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand chapter!)_3
Zhang Hu muttered to himself, his expression extremely bitter.
“Condolences.”
Cai Yonglong opened his mouth and gave a bitter smile.
As transmigrators, they had once fantasized about the future, believing that they were the main characters.
Later, the cruel reality had slapped them time and time again, making them realize that they were just small fry. Only because of Wang Ping’s existence could they barely survive.
Even so, many of them had died once already.
Now, they were finally facing the destruction of the world.
“We have no way out but to keep getting stronger. When you become strong enough, turning back time in that world might not be impossible.”
Wang Ping shook his head, trying to comfort Zhang Hu.
“That’s what they say, but it’s so hard to become that strong.”
Zhang Hu gave a bitter smile.
“Mr. Wang, it looks like I can only spend my days in your world from now on.”
After a pause, Zhang Hu sighed.
“Yeah. You all just focus on getting stronger in this world.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Next, Wang Ping and the others talked in the chat group and mentioned the destruction of Zhang Hu’s world.
For a moment, everyone in the group was silent.
The destruction of the world was a heavy topic.
Not to mention, it was not just a topic, but something that had really happened. It was too oppressive.
They all thought about whether their worlds would also have such a day.
It seemed that the probability was not small…
However, even if they could guess that the same thing might happen in the future, what could they do? They could only silently grow stronger.
Only then would they be able to protect themselves and the world they were in.
Of course, people like Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan, whose worlds were already in trouble and had a high probability of being beyond saving, could only sigh complicatedly.
…..
On Wang Ping’s side, after closing the chat group, he silently opened the red envelope reward for the completed Group Task.
“Ding, congratulations on your 100% contribution in this Group Task, you have been rewarded with 150 million group points.”
The chat group system’s voice sounded.
This surprised Wang Ping.
After all, he had thought before that he would get no more than ten million group points, but now it was actually 150 million group points.
How bizarre. Was it really that valuable?
Although this guy already had the combat power of a Void Divine Realm, according to Alpha’s previous behavior, it shouldn’t be that much.
Could it be…
“Because this time it’s divided among the World Source, there are additional gains.”
Alpha’s cold voice explained Wang Ping’s doubts.
“I see. It’s a continuous flow…”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, not surprised by the answer, but murmured to himself.
“No wonder so many guys in All Heavens like to loot and run. This way of making money is much faster than slowly earning it.”
“Don’t get any crooked ideas; we have different power standings and can’t do that.”
Alpha reminded Wang Ping.
“I’m not thinking like that. After all, we’re part of the Order Faction, right?”
Wang Ping chuckled.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t continue to chat with Alpha, but decided to continue with the Paid Simulation.
“System, I want to do the Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping said inwardly.
“Ding, consuming 10 kilograms of lower-tier God’s Source, Life Simulator activated, Paid Simulation begins…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent: Little Death-Seeking Expert.”
Red Talent: Little Death-Seeking Expert: Having this talent, the host will love to seek death and believe that the bigger the storm, the more precious the fish. Although seeking death will indeed lead to death, it also increases the probability of getting great opportunities.
“What kind of crappy talent is this…”
Wang Ping was speechless as he looked at the talent he had refreshed this time.
Although he himself may have taken risks multiple times in simulations, he didn’t want to blindly seek death.
This talent was poisonous.
“It seems that my previous bad premonition has come true, and bad luck is starting to show up.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Then, his consciousness flickered and the simulation began.
“System, fast forward for me.”
Wang Ping spoke, not having any expectations for this simulation.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice sounded, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged as well.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate. Then, after setting up a backup plan in the Purple Spirit Realm, you chose to ascend to the Upper Realm.]
[Next, you took actions and cultivated according to your own memory. In the blink of an eye, thousands of years had passed. Your cultivation had greatly improved, reaching the level of Half-step True Lord, not far from the True Lord.]
[Afterward, you went down to the lower realm, caught Young Master Mo, and took his Black Magic Stone. Then, you started to seek death by trying to subdue the Supreme Artifact, the Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[This time seeking death, you almost succeeded, but unfortunately, you failed at the last minute. You were killed by both the backlash from the seal and the black fog that leaked from the Demonic Artifact, and ultimately died.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended.]
….
“Uh, as expected, this simulation was really about seeking death, daring to touch the Demonic Artifact, and eventually failing, dying on the spot.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of this simulation, somewhat speechless.
“But, the text simulation described it as almost successful… It seems that this Red Talent, Little Death-Seeking Expert, is a bit of a pitfall, but it does hold the hope of helping me get big opportunities.”

chapters.title: Chapter 586: 183: Comprehending Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word Chapter!)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Chapter 183: Comprehending Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word Chapter!)_4
Wang Ping stroked his chin and pondered for a moment.
“What a pity. Even so, I can’t possibly choose this shitty talent. If I choose it in real life, it will affect my personality, and actually dying when courting death is not worth it.”
As Wang Ping sighed, many scenes and cultivation insights appeared in his mind, and eventually, he returned to the real world.
At the same time, the system’s voice also sounded.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, Host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. A random Lower-tier Divine Artifact.
②. Red Talent· Little Death-Seeking Expert.
③. True Immortal Star Flower.”
“This reward really sucks.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but complain as he looked at the rewards.
Then, he chose the True Immortal Star Flower, a treasure that could help True Lords raise their realm without side effects.
After getting the treasure, Wang Ping started another simulation.
However, something that left Wang Ping speechless happened.
In the following talent draws, all he got were trash talents, all kinds of bizarre talents and bizarre ways of death.
This reminded Wang Ping of a similar situation that had happened before.
After getting awesome talents, all the rest were trash, reaching the peak level of bad luck.
The refreshed rewards were also trashy.
This time, it was the same, refreshing a bunch of Lower-tier Divine Artifacts was useless.
The only useful one was his Middle-tier life-bound Divine Artifact.
“Sigh, the side effect of continuously getting gold and purple talents is really headache-inducing. However, if I don’t have a few waves of bad luck, this bad luck won’t pass. Now there’s only one chance left for a life simulation, and I can only delay it for a while.”
Wang Ping felt a little helpless.
“After this simulation, I can only go to the Upper Realm. I hope nothing bad happens. Otherwise, I’ll have to rely on the traditional way of escaping through the chat group.”
Wang Ping murmured, thinking somewhat resignedly.
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
During these three months, Wang Ping had been silently cultivating, completing Group Tasks, and accumulating luck.
During these three months, the group was as turbulent as ever.
Wang Ping also controlled Xu Yi and focused on training Zhang Haoran.
It had to be said that the combination of Zhang Haoran and Xu Yi’s golden fingers was indeed interesting.
Double enhancement directly increased Wang Ping’s life-bound Divine Artifact eightfold.
Then, Zhang Haoran’s golden finger merged them, forcibly fusing the Mid-tier Divine Artifacts into a Top-tier Divine Artifact.
A Top-tier Divine Artifact, a weapon that could only be nurtured by powerful God Monarch Realm powerhouses.
As a result, Wang Ping, a Void Lord, directly owned one.
Of course, the reason why Xu Yi could enhance and Zhang Haoran could fuse into a Top-tier Divine Artifact was that Wang Ping had strengthened their golden fingers and increased their limits.
Otherwise, it would be difficult for the initial golden fingers to enhance and fuse Divine Artifacts.
Apart from enhancing resources and fusing high-level resources, the strength of the people in the group also changed drastically.
Zhang Jun went to the Purple Spirit Realm to kill people.
After being taken on a ride, he directly soared to the Quasi-Emperor Tier.
Chen Yao, who had traded resources with Wang Ping, had also rapidly upgraded to the Emperor Tier.
That was also when Wang Ping had depleted his divine source.
If he had given Chen Yao some divine source, she would have been able to continue to get stronger; reaching the Quasi-Immortal or even Void Divine Realm wouldn’t be difficult.
As for the other group members, they had also become stronger. Even if they couldn’t reach the sky with their golden fingers, they could quickly improve their strength with Lin Yuanyuan’s empowerment.
It could only be said that after Wang Ping began to vigorously train other group members, and the group members began to cooperate with each other, the brilliance of their golden fingers finally burst forth.
…..
“Next, I should do the final simulation, hoping to refresh some normal talents. I am really fed up with bizarre talents.”
Wang Ping sighed.
He didn’t even dare to look forward to gold talents again. He just hoped for normal talents.
The last simulation must make his strength improve a bit more.
Otherwise, he would feel uneasy upon entering the Upper Realm.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
As thoughts flowed, Wang Ping said in the depths of his heart.
“Ding, consuming 10 jin of Lower-tier God’s Source. Life Simulator is activated, Talent Refresh is in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations on refreshing Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skills; Green Talent· Leg Technique Genius.”
Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skills: This talent can neutralize the divine skills cast by a specific target. This is a special talent, using it once consumes a 100-year lifespan, and the cooldown time is one year. It can be used against powerhouses above the God Monarch Realm.
“Finally refreshed a normal talent, and it’s even purple-tier! Moreover, this talent is quite interesting.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talent, finally letting out a sigh of relief and showing a smile.
Not a bizarre talent, and a talent with great practical use, this indicated that his luck finally returned a bit.
Divine skill Neutralization, this talent can be used not only in battles among the same realm but also in cross-level battles.
For example, a powerhouse with significantly higher cultivation than him, using a divine skill arrogantly, preparing to fiercely kill him, suddenly finds that the divine skill cannot be used. This would definitely be a bewildering situation.
At this moment, Wang Ping would have already charged up and directly give the powerhouse a fierce hit. Even if the opponent’s cultivation was much higher than his, the opponent would certainly be at least crippled if not dead due to the surprise attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 587: 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Chapter 183: Comprehending the Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word grand chapter!)_5
Apart from that, he also possessed the Red Talent·Death Whisper and the Purple Talent·Endless Blade.
Good fellow, Wang Ping always felt like he had become a cunning old fox….
In addition, he also had the Rebirth Tally, which was the kind of doing things without losing anything.
Of course, the most important thing was that these three talents had no level restrictions.
That is to say, even if he reached the Emperor… he could still trigger their effects.
For a moment, Wang Ping thought of some scenarios and couldn’t help but mourn for some of his future enemies for three seconds.
“System, I choose the Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skills.”
Next, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt a sway in his consciousness, knowing that he had entered an immersive simulation state.
“System, fast-forward for me.”
Wang Ping spoke again.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice sounded, and the luminescent screen appeared, with familiar words emerging.
[On the first day, you chose to act the same way as you did in your memory and then ascended to the Upper Realm.]
[After ascending to the Upper Realm this time, you still managed to get some divine source as you did before, and then went to the Tao Palace, joining the Tao Palace.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades had passed, and the Great Saint Secret Realm opened, and you chose to enter it. This time, perhaps it was fate that you got to know Lin Yan and traveled together.]
[Finally, you witnessed Lin Yan passing the Great Saint Trial, and he didn’t seem to have changed at all. This made you ponder, thinking that Lin Yan was not simple and could actually withstand the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint.]
[After the Great Saint Secret Realm ended, Lin Yan said he would meet again later, then he parted ways with you.]
[Blazing through the years, after the Great Saint Secret Realm, you also earned plenty of resources and started practicing again. Following that, you handled the matter of Young Master Mo descending as you did in your memory.]
[In the blink of an eye, another twenty years had passed, and although you could break through to the True Divine Realm, you still didn’t choose to do so because you were a little afraid of that terrifying strong presence remaining on the Elemental Star.]
[If that were the case, your breakthrough would just be inviting destruction. After all, even if the Tao Palace opened the Great Array to cover up the Heavenly Secrets, it would not be able to escape the notice of such a powerful existence.]
[For this reason, you considered whether to leave the Elemental Star and go to other territories to break through or to delay the time. In the end, you chose to delay time. Because even if you went to other ancient stars, it would not necessarily be safe. On the Elemental Star, with the support of the Tao Palace, it would be safer.]
[You successfully suppressed the flow of time for fifty years without choosing to break through. It was during this time that the palace master of the Tao Palace told you about something. That was that a cultivator had discovered a top-tier divine material called the Elemental Divine Mine in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[The Elemental Divine Mine was a famous divine material even in the entire Upper Realm. If you could use the Elemental Divine Mine to build a True Immortal Divine Platform, you would perfectly break through to the True Divine Realm without any flaws.]
[Unfortunately, the Elemental Forbidden Land had existed for a long time and was very dangerous. Even a God Monarch Realm powerhouse entering the outer area would be in danger of losing their lives. However, the Master of Tao Palace said he would do his best to secure this Elemental Divine Mine for you to help you build a perfect Divine Platform.]
[You were very grateful for the Master of Tao Palace’s words and vowed to protect the Tao Palace after growing up.]
[Soon after, the Tao Palace took action, and the Master of Tao Palace personally made a move, entering the Elemental Forbidden Land to find that extraordinary Elemental Divine Mine for you.]
[Finally, the Master of Tao Palace successfully obtained this Elemental Divine Mine. However, he paid a heavy price and suffered unimaginable injuries. Although he saved his life, he could no longer make any progress in his lifetime. Even his cultivation had regressed.]
[Seeing the Master of Tao Palace like this, your mood was heavy and full of self-blame. Upon seeing this, the Master of Tao Palace told you not to feel guilty, as he might not have achieved the Great Saint status in his lifetime even during the golden age, let alone in the Last Dharma Age. As for you, you are the hope of Tao Palace, and only when you grow up can the Tao Palace reproduce its ancient glory.]
[Hearing the words of the Master of Tao Palace, you firmly vowed that you would definitely protect the Tao Palace in the future and restore its ancient glory. This greatly comforted the Master of the Tao Palace.]
…..
“This Master of the Tao Palace is really a man of character. He has paid too much for the Tao Palace.”
Wang Ping, looking at the content of this text simulation, was somewhat moved, harboring a more favorable impression of the Tao Palace and its Master.
When he grows up in the future, even if he doesn’t join the Tao Palace as he did in the simulation, he would still protect the Tao Palace to the best of his abilities.
“Next, it’s time for the breakthrough to the True Divine Realm.”
Wang Ping thought silently and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[After that, you took the Elemental Divine Mine from the palace master of the Tao Palace and closed yourself off again, intending to break through to the True Divine Realm. This time, you easily broke through to the True Divine Realm level, constructed a perfect Divine Platform with the Primordial Divine Mineral.]
[Soon, the Heavenly Tribulation appeared, and you began Crossing Tribulation. After overcoming the Heavenly Tribulation, you completely entered the True Divine Realm. However, a dilemma arose.]
[That terrifying strong presence was clearly staying on the Elemental Star all the time and didn’t just happen to pass by, discovering the Crossing Tribulation. Therefore, you were once again captured by him.]
[To avoid being refined, you chose to actively end the simulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 588: 183: Comprehending Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Chapter 183: Comprehending Spatial Laws! Ascending to the Upper Realm (10,000-word Chapter!)_6
“[Due to your choice, this simulation ends…]
…..
With the text simulation concluded, many visions and cultivation realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, leaving him speechless.
“This terrifying powerhouse is too cunning, hiding right on the Elemental Star. It seems like I’ll have to leave the Elemental Star next time I break through a great realm. I simply refuse to believe that there’s such a terrifying powerhouse on every ancient star,”
Wang Ping grumbled a bit.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can select two from the following rewards:
①. First-tier True Divine Realm cultivation.
②. Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skills.
③. Primordial Divine Minerals.
④. Demonic Heavenly Stone.
⑤. Random Divine Artifact.”
….
“Without divine sources to facilitate my simulations, I have no choice but to go to the Upper Realm. However, going to the Upper Realm in reality isn’t the same as in a simulation and carries some risks. Therefore, choosing to enhance my cultivation is important.”
Wang Ping was a bit indecisive, looking at this round of rewards.
But, if he chose cultivation, his ensuing simulation expenses would only increase, making it a headache for him.
“I can earn more divine sources, but keeping alive is what truly matters.”
Wang Ping made his choice.
Although Sacred Artifacts are powerful, you need a strong cultivation to unleash their true power. Being in the first-tier of the Void Divine Realm is just too weak. If I had True Divine Realm cultivation, then combined with Sacred Artifacts and various methods, I would be capable of contending against those at the Great Perfection in True Divine Realm or even Half-step God Lord Realm powerhouses.
With this level of fighting capability, even if unexpected situations arise in the Upper Realm, I wouldn’t be left helpless.
Additionally, possessing this level of power, attaining divine sources wouldn’t be too difficult.
“System, I choose ①. True Divine Realm cultivation and ②. Nullification of Divine Skills.”
Wang Ping silently decided in his mind.
“Ding, reward selection successful.”
The voice of the system rang out.
Then Wang Ping felt his cultivation soar at an unimaginable pace.
4th tier Void Divine Realm!
7th tier Void Divine Realm!
Great Perfection of the Void Divine Realm!
Half-step True Lord!
After that, a Divine Platform appeared in his Sea of Consciousness, and his cultivation reached the level of True Divine Realm.
An aura of terrifying divine power spread out.
However, Wang Ping could clearly feel the resistance from the Purple Spirit Realm and adverse reactions from his body.
Obviously, it was the rules of the Upper Realm suppressing him.
In the Lower Realm, anyone stronger than a third-tier Void Divine Realm powerhouse is not permitted, they must seal their cultivation if it’s too high.
As a result, Wang Ping chose without hesitation to seal his own cultivation.
After that, the adverse reaction finally faded away.
In the next month, after leaving some back up plans in the Lower Realm, Wang Ping chose to ascend.
The ascension pillar of light that pierced the sky appeared and shocked all the cultivators in the Purple Spirit Realm.
They did not expect that after many years, another person had reached the Void Divine Realm and was ascension to the Upper Realm.
The rulers all felt great envy.
Within the Eternal Frozen Land, Ji Bingyan also sensed all this, making her heart very restless.
According to the information she knew, there should still be one divine source left in the Purple Spirit Realm.
This divine source could only allow a single person to break through to the Void Divine Realm and then ascend to the Upper Realm.
If someone is ascending now, does it mean that Wang Ping had found that divine source first?
…..
While the people in the Lower Realm were in unrest, Wang Ping swiftly disappeared, being led to the Upper Realm.
All the way, Wang Ping could sense the space’s power outside the ascension channel.
This scene had occurred many times in the immersive simulation.
Each time, he reaped considerable benefits.
After all, the Space Laws here are incredibly concentrated and could aid him with cultivation.
Observing as he did, Wang Ping entered a strange state of enlightenment.
After who knows how long, Wang Ping opened his eyes, revealing a smile.
He faintly so much as lifted his hand and the space’s power in the ascension channel began to fluctuate because of it.
Then, a profound and enigmatic power of Manas emerged around him, the legendary Space Law.
Yes, during Wang Ping’s enlightenment this time, he was able to realize the true Space Law by leveraging the unique space’s power inside the ascension channel.
Under normal circumstances, the power of Manas can only be understood by powerhouses of the Saint Realm.
However, Wang Ping has just reached the True Divine Realm cultivation level, yet he has already comprehended the power of Space Law.
If this were to become known, it would certainly shock many cultivators.
After all, even in the Upper Realm, this would be considered an incredibly astonishing event.
Even those prodigious characters like the Emperor’s Child, can, at most, comprehend the power of Manas in advance when the cultivation reaches the level of Semi-saint, let alone understanding the power of Manas in the True Divine Realm.
Moreover, this is the power of Space Law, not an ordinary Manas.
However, for Wang Ping, this was all very much within expectation.
After all, Wang Ping had a Life Simulator. It wasn’t just a simple enlightenment that led him to realize the Space Law but the accumulation of many simulations.
He, in essence, has comprehended for over 10,000 years.
Of course, the reason why this enlightenment was successful, the bottleneck was broken, and the power of Space Law was realised, was all due to Wang Ping’s upgrades to the True Divine Realm.
After the cultivation level reached the True Divine Realm, entirely transformed, Wang Ping’s comprehension improved a lot; that’s why he could comprehend the space power during the special moment of ascension.
Otherwise, even for Wang Ping, it would have been quite difficult to enter an enlightened state and truly realize the power of Space Law.
“This really is a surprise right after ascension… Having the power of Space Law, even if I face a God King Realm powerhouse, I can still fight. Even if I can’t win, possessing the power Space Law, if I want to escape, he can’t stop me.”
“Now, going to the Upper Realm, I feel extremely secure.”
Thinking about it, Wang Ping couldn’t help but let the corner of his mouth curl up in satisfaction.
While Wang Ping was pleased, a bright light appeared, indicating that his ascension was nearing its end, and he was about to reach the Upper Realm.
As expected, a few seconds later, Wang Ping felt like he was thrown out of the ascension channel and arrived in the Upper Realm.
The Upper Realm’s Spiritual Energy was rich, making Wang Ping feel physically and mentally comfortable.
Just at that moment, Wang Ping felt that three auras were rapidly approaching from afar.
Seeing this, Wang Ping shook his head slightly, knowing that those three familiar figures would be here soon.
However, this time Wang Ping had no intention of seeing them. The space around him distorted as he directly left the area.
Shortly after Wang Ping left, three figures arrived here in succession.”””

chapters.title: Chapter 589: 184: True Divine Realm Great Perfection! Dominating the Upper Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Chapter 184: True Divine Realm Great Perfection! Dominating the Upper Realm!
When the three of them saw that there was no one here, they were all a bit confused.
Logically, someone who just ascended shouldn’t have recovered so quickly, let alone left so soon.
At this moment, the pupils of the Void Divine Realm Master from the Green Spirit Divine Sect contracted, as if he had discovered something incredible.
“Fluctuations of the Space Law…”
The voice of the Void Divine Realm Expert from the Green Spirit Divine Sect trembled.
As soon as these words were spoken, the two Void Divine Realm experts from the Whiteflame Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty were all shocked, and they felt the residual fluctuations of the space laws here, their faces full of astonishment.
The power of Space Law is something that only a saint can touch.
In this Last Dharma Age, not to mention saints, even semi-saints are extremely rare powerhouses.
Now, there were fluctuations in the space laws, does it mean that a saint appeared here just now and took the flying immortal away?
Thinking of this, the three Void Divine Realm masters here looked at each other, somewhat surprised at the identity of the flying immortal, who was able to have a saint take them away.
Immediately, they quickly contacted the forces behind them.
…
In the eastern part of the Inner Region, within the White Flame Divine City belonging to the Whiteflame Divine Sect, Wang Ping arrived here.
“Upon reaching the True Divine Realm cultivation, my single simulation consumes one hundred kilos of lower-tier divine source, and it’s really expensive enough. Next, how to get a large amount of lower-tier divine source is a problem.”
Wang Ping glanced around at the cultivators in the city, stroking his chin, and began to think.
Lower-tier divine sources, although precious, are also quite abundant for some God Sects and Holy Lands.
For example, the Tao Palace took out thousands of kilos of lower-tier god’s source to help Saint Body Wang Ping break through to the Void Divine Realm, which was a big deal.
In addition, Young Master Mo himself had a hundred kilos of lower-tier divine source.
“Whiteflame Divine Sect, Green Spirit Divine Sect, North Snow Divine Dynasty, these three great forces of the eastern part of the Inner Region, are sitting on that secret realm, and there must be a lot of lower-tier divine sources. The key is how to get them.”
Wang Ping had a headache.
The things on him were undoubtedly extremely rare.
Either… it’s like sacred artifacts, Emperor Scriptures, too precious, and as soon as they are taken out, they will definitely be extremely dangerous.
Or, it’s a few middle and lower-tier divine artifacts.
It is estimated that the middle and lower-tier divine artifacts won’t sell for a high price.
After all, middle and lower-tier divine artifacts are used by Void Divine Realm masters or Half-step True Lords, and their value is not high. Whether they can make up the cost of his one or two paid simulations is a question.
“I can only sell the lower divine artifacts first, and see if I can sell them for one hundred kilos of lower-tier divine source. Then, use this fee to simulate, and see if I can refresh talents that will make me a lot of money. Speaking of which, talents like alchemy and refining have never been refreshed. I hope to refresh a purple, or even gold-tier alchemy or refining talent. In that case, I wouldn’t lack divine sources.”
Wang Ping shook his head, flashing various thoughts in his mind, and stepped into the Whiteflame Divine Shop belonging to the Whiteflame Divine Sect.
Then, Wang Ping sold the extra lower-tier divine artifacts and middle-tier divine artifacts on his body, and got a total of two hundred and forty kilos of lower-tier divine source.
Among them, one mid-tier divine artifact was worth two hundred kilos of lower-tier divine source, and the remaining lower-tier divine artifacts only added up to forty kilos of lower-tier divine source, which was too cheap.
“In the lower realm, lower-tier divine artifacts are like treasures, but when they reach the upper realm, they are so cheap. It’s really hard to know what to say.”
Wang Ping sighed slightly.
It was also thanks to his initial excitement when he obtained the divine artifacts from Ashy Flame Valley, that he found out that in the Upper Realm, they were just so common.
It could only be said that the Chi Clan members who were expelled from the Chi family were living too miserably. Of course, this was only one of the reasons. The main thing was that the Chi Clan members who went to the Purple Spirit Realm were only a small part of the outcasts from their clan.
“I have enough chances for two paid simulations, I hope it can give me some surprises. Otherwise, if I want to continue earning god sources, I can only sell some of my self-created cultivation skills and secret skills.”
Wang Ping let out a sigh, feeling helpless.
He always felt that along the way, he was either selling something or on the way to buy something.
Next, Wang Ping found an inn to stay in, arranged for the array, and then said in his heart: “System, I want to carry out a paid simulation.”
“Ding, consuming one hundred kilos of lower-tier divine source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The voice of the system sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth; Blue Talent: Sage Mode.”
Purple Talent · Rolling Wealth: With this talent, the host’s fortune will be enhanced.
Blue Talent · Sage Mode: With this talent, the host will avoid women and enter a saintly mode, and the cultivating speed will be relatively increased.
“Uh, this is really like calling Cao Cao and Cao Cao will arrive. I want to earn divine sources, and the result is a Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth, which is interesting.”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time, and couldn’t help but smile.
With this Purple Talent, he should be able to make a lot of divine sources, right? In that case, he would be comfortable.
As for this Blue Talent: Sage Mode, it’s a bit spoof-like.
Pity that it’s just a blue talent, otherwise, it would be quite useful, and could help him quickly improve his cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 590: 184: The Great Perfection of the True Divine Realm! Dominating the Upper World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Chapter 184: The Great Perfection of the True Divine Realm! Dominating the Upper World_2
“System, I choose Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness flicker, knowing that he had entered the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast forward for me.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, fast forwarding….”
The system’s voice sounded, and the luminescent screen appeared, with familiar texts also emerging.
[Day One, you choose to cultivate and plan to go to the Tao Palace the next day.]
[Day Two, when you prepare to leave for the Tao Palace, you hear the news that an ancient tomb of a God Monarch Realm powerhouse has been discovered in the eastern part of the Inner Region. Many strong people have already gone there, planning to break the seal of the ancient tomb and enter it to seek opportunities.]
[After hearing this news, you are somewhat surprised. After all, in your memory, there shouldn’t be any God Monarch Realm powerhouse’s ancient tomb at this time. Soon, you come to your senses, guessing that this should be the effect of Purple Talent·Rolling Wealth.’
[At this, your mood is subtle, always feeling like you’ve experienced the Heavenly Tao’s prepared opportunities and rewards for you.]
[After calming your mind, you choose to set off to the ancient tomb of the God Monarch Realm powerhouse, seeking to fight for the opportunities inside and gain more divine source. Although an ancient tomb of a God Monarch Realm powerhouse might not have many good things in it, for a poor person like you, it’s definitely still quite good.]
[When you arrive at the ancient tomb of the God Monarch Realm powerhouse, you find that there are already many cultivators here. People from Whiteflame Divine Sect, Green Spirit Divine Sect, and North Snow Divine Dynasty have also arrived here. Even the God Monarch Realm ancestors of the Three Great Forces appear here, wanting to join forces to break the seal of the ancient tomb.]
[After you arrive, you quietly observe, without any intention of revealing yourself. Due to the effect of your Purple Talent·Aura Concealment and Secret Skill, no one can detect you, even the God Monarch Realm powerhouses.]
[If you use Space Law to hide yourself, even a Semi-saint wouldn’t be able to find you. It can be said that now, as long as you don’t court death, you naturally stand on an invincible ground.]
[Not long after, the ancient tomb of the God Monarch Realm powerhouse is opened, and many cultivators want to enter it. However, they are jointly driven back by the God Monarch Realm ancestors of the Three Great Forces, coldly snorting and letting them leave, not allowing them to enter or face death.]
[Upon hearing this, the numerous cultivators are extremely angry, thinking that the people of the Three Great Forces are too ruthless. However, although they are angry, they dare not say much. After all, the gap in strength lies there, and whoever dares to stand out will truly die.]
[However, at the moment when everyone is angry and helpless, two God Monarch Realm loose cultivators arrive here, scoffing at the tyranny of the Three Great Forces. Seeing this, the numerous cultivators think they see hope, that they might have a slight chance to enter.]
[But they obviously think too much. That slight hope doesn’t exist at all. The God Monarch Realm ancestors of the Three Great Forces look at the appearance of the two God Monarch Realm loose cultivators, smiling and saying that fellow taoists are different from the other forces and cultivators, and they can naturally enter.]
[Seeing this, the two God Monarch Realm powerhouses nod and naturally have no intention of standing up for the rest of the cultivators.]
[You see this scene and are not in a hurry. After all, after the Three Great Forces enter, the means they leave behind won’t be able to stop you, and you can come and go freely.]
[After that, the Three Great Forces re-arrange the Great Array, blocking other cultivators from entering. They then enter the ancient tomb with their people. As for you, you also use the power of Space Law to sneak in easily.]
[Upon entering, you see the scene inside the ancient tomb. For God Monarch Realm powerhouses, the tomb left by a Monarch Realm powerhouse is obviously not very grand. With just a sweep of divine sense, they can see the end of it.]
[As a result, all the powerhouses present immediately see the stone coffin in the tomb’s space and the corpse puppets guarding it. These corpse puppets are powerful, capable of resisting ordinary True Divine Realm Masters.]
[However, to the powerhouses present, they don’t amount to much. They easily suppress the corpse puppets, and then push open the stone coffin, revealing the corpse of the God Monarch Realm powerhouse and the burial artifacts inside.]
[As the stone coffin is pushed open, the divine sense left by the God Monarch Realm powerhouse is also activated. The God Monarch Realm powerhouse’s divine sense sees so many God Monarch Realm powerhouses coming to rob the tomb and can’t help but bitterly smile, saying that those present can take the things left behind, but they must not fight here, as all he wants is to slumber.]
[At this, the loose cultivator God Monarch Realm powerhouse coldly says that the corpse of the God Monarch Realm powerhouse could be used to refine top-tier Divine Artifacts, and it’s an opportunity not to be missed. The other God Monarch Realm powerhouses are also indifferent, completely disregarding the thoughts of the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse’s divine sense.]
[Seeing this, the divine sense of the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse sighs, saying that since they are so ruthless, they shouldn’t blame him for being merciless.]
[After that, the divine sense of the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse directly activates the Killing Formation laid out during his lifetime. The terrifying Killing Formation is activated, possessing the power to annihilate God Monarch Realm powerhouses. This makes the God Monarch Realm powerhouses on the scene change their expressions, starting to join forces to resist the Killing Formation.]
[And you are also caught in it, exposed because of the Killing Formation. At your appearance, the God Monarch Realm powerhouses present are all astonished, never expecting a little True Divine Realm rat to have sneaked in so quietly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 591: 184: True Divine Realm Great Perfection! Dominating the Upper World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Chapter 184: True Divine Realm Great Perfection! Dominating the Upper World_3
[Upon hearing this, the God King Realm powerhouses present all snorted coldly, intending to annihilate you directly. Faced with the aggression of these God King Realm powerhouses, you sneered and used the Space Law and the Space Department of God Territory deduced from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture to easily escape from the Killing Formation.]
[This made all the God King Realm powerhouses present show astonished expressions. A 1st tier True Divine Realm ant actually comprehended the Space Law, which was unbelievable to them.]
[Moreover, they also noticed that you practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. The aura of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture cannot be simulated. In other words, you are a part of Tao Palace.]
[For a moment, all the God King Realm powerhouses present were sweating profusely, thinking that they had caused a catastrophe. A Tao Palace member who comprehended the Space Law at the True Divine Realm level must be the reincarnation of an old monster or an old monster re-cultivating. Now that they offended such an expert, they and their companions might suffer a great disaster.]
[Because of this, everyone became anxious, trying to break the Killing Formation quickly, apologize to you, and resolve the conflict.]
[By the time the five God King Realm powerhouses were very anxious, you had already arrived outside of the Killing Formation and met the residual thoughts of God King Realm powerhouse again. Seeing your appearance, the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse’s residual thoughts were also shocked.]
[Then, he bitterly laughed, expressing that he didn’t deserve to be visited by a sage predecessor like you. You realized that he misunderstood something. After all, it’s terrifying for a True Divine Realm powerhouse to comprehend the Law, so others would think it’s normal for a sage to re-cultivate or possess a body.]
[Regarding this, you didn’t bother to explain anything but just asked the God King Realm powerhouse’s thoughts to hand over the items, and you could help him find a good place to bury the corpse.]
[Upon hearing this, the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse’s thoughts sighed and handed over all the items honestly. You took a look and found that there were quite a few good items in it. There were tens of thousands of catties of Lower-tier God’s Source and even about 100 catties of Mid-tier Divine Source. Apart from that, there was one Top-tier Divine Artifact, three top-tier Divine Artifacts, five Mid-tier Divine Artifacts, and a certain number of Elixirs that could help True Divine Realm Masters cultivate and restore Mana.]
[Seeing this, you were extremely satisfied, considering it a fortune. Next, you only needed to cultivate in the Tao Palace peacefully.]
[After that, you took away the corpse of the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse and left the ancient tomb, heading for the Tao Palace.]
…
“I didn’t know that in the Text Simulation, I would lose so much Divine Source. But it doesn’t matter, as these Divine Sources are enough for now. When these Divine Sources are used up, I probably won’t need the compensation from these God King Realm powerhouses.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and smiled.
He was determined to go to this ancient tomb.
With so many resources, he could give them to Xu Yi to see if they could trigger a multiplier effect.
If he could achieve a high multiplier effect, he wouldn’t have to worry about the Payment Simulation for a long time as long as he didn’t increase his cultivation level.
That was very comfortable.
[Just like in your memory, you reached the Tao Palace. This time, because your cultivation had reached the True Divine Realm level, the palace master of the Tao Palace was even more surprised. Although your cultivation was high and your background was unknown, due to your Time-Space Body and the fact that you practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, the palace master of the Tao Palace still accepted you.]
[Thus, you began to cultivate in the Tao Palace, and still became a taoist. In this regard, even the palace master of the Tao Palace felt that the morale of the so-called geniuses on the Elemental Star would be affected if your situation were exposed.]
[In the blink of an eye, decades had passed, and your cultivation had improved a bit, reaching the 2nd tier True Divine Realm.]
[Soon after your cultivation reached the 2nd tier True Divine Realm, the Great Saint Secret Realm was opened. This time, you still chose to enter it, but this time you were not willing to be a spectator.]
[While searching for opportunities in the Great Saint Secret Realm, you also paid attention to the news about the Divine Medicine. Relying on the images from your memory, you successfully found the True Immortal Star Flower, and after swallowing it, your cultivation successfully increased by one small realm, reaching the 3rd tier True Divine Realm.]
[Being at the 3rd tier True Divine Realm, plus your various methods, you were confident in confronting God King Realm powerhouses. Therefore, you had great confidence in competing for Divine Medicine.]
[Soon, you sensed terrifying energy fluctuations as the God King Realm powerhouses engaged in a great battle. In response, you used Purple Talent·Aura Concealment and the Secret Skill of Concealing your Breath, quietly approaching the scene.]
[When you arrived at the location, you saw the battle between the God King Realm powerhouses, with various Divine Skills being used in a dazzling and dangerous display. Seeing this scene, you became serious.]
[Although you were confident in fighting against God King Realm powerhouses, that was only against those with low cultivation levels. Fighting against those high cultivation level God King Realm powerhouses was impossible. In front of them, you could only rely on Space Law and Space Divine Skills to flee.]
[However, you were not worried about anything, as you had no intention of confronting these powerful beings head-on. You only wanted to seize the opportune moment to snatch the Divine Medicine and run.]
[After a long while, the battle between the God King Realm powerhouses finally came to an end. As in your memory, the Divine Medicine was seized by the Zhang Family, which could be considered the strongest family in the Elemental Star at present and were about to escape.]

chapters.title: Chapter 592: 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: Chapter 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_4
“In response to this, you concealed your aura, changed your face, and sneaked over silently. Then, while the other party was on guard against other powerhouses, you used the Space Law to launch a stealth attack on them directly.”
“This time, you were very lucky and directly triggered the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, causing critical damage, and the powerhouse of the Zhang Family from God King Realm was blasted away by you.”
“You also seized this opportunity to snatch his Divine Medicine, utilize the Space Law to instantly tear apart space, escaping from the scene right away.”
“Your sudden appearance using Space Divine Skills to slam a Peak God King Realm expert away, stealing the Divine Medicine, rendered everyone unable to react.”
“By the time they reacted, all of them wore looks of astonishment. After all, such a snatch from the tiger’s mouth was quite shocking.”
“However, when they sensed the Space Law, they all were deeply moved. Yet, they could not believe that a cultivator of the True Divine Realm would comprehend the Space Law. They similarly thought that you are an old monster who is cultivating again or possess someone.”
“Besides, since you intentionally concealed the aura of Cultivation Skill, they couldn’t identify that you were from the Tao Palace.”
“The Zhang family’s experts were furious, but they were helpless and couldn’t do anything but curse and swear, wishing they could find you and chop you into pieces.”
“Thus, the trip to the Great Saint Secret Realm concluded, with everyone having gains and losses. And you, undoubtedly, were the biggest winner of this secret realm trip.”
“After leaving the Great Saint Secret Realm, you discarded your disguise and joined the powerhouses of the Tao Palace, returning to the Tao Palace.”
“After returning to the Tao Palace, you began to continue your cultivation in seclusion.”
“This time, you didn’t have the idea of saving resources, directly taking out the Divine Medicine that can help a Semi-saint improve the breakthrough probability to the Saint Realm, slowly refining it to assist your cultivation.”
“Like this, under these circumstances, you were cultivating bitterly, improving your own cultivation.”
“A hundred years have passed, and you have absorbed part of the essence of the Divine Medicine, and your cultivation has instantly soared to the tier of the 6th True Divine Realm.”
“A hundred years to continuously upgrade three realms, if this were to spread, it would undoubtedly shock many cultivators.”
“After all, cultivation becomes more and more difficult as one advances in their journey. In the True Divine Realm, even the genius who’s destined to step into the God Monarch realm, relying on normal cultivation, it is already quite an achievement to be able to improve a minor realm in hundreds of years.”
“But you, in fact, broke three realms in a hundred years. Moreover, this was the result of you not being impatient and trying to build a perfect foundation.”
“Otherwise, you can completely increase refining speed. At that time, it would not be so simple as improving three realms in a hundred years.”
“In the blink of an eye, another three hundred years have passed. After three hundred years, your cultivation became more and more stable. While slowly refining the essence of Divine Medicine, your cultivation improved to the 9th tier of the True Divine Realm.”
“Another three hundred years have passed, your cultivation steadily promoted to the Great Perfection Tier in True Divine Realm.”
“At this step, the Divine Medicine was almost refined by you, not enough to let you break through to the half-step God Monarch Realm under the circumstance of building a perfect foundation.”
“Because of this, you refined the remaining essence of the Divine Medicine and cultivate the powerful body training methods recorded in the Tao Palace to strengthen your own body.”
“It can only be said that plans can’t keep up with changes. Compared to the skill of the martial arts world, you still prefer the powerful physical training methods recorded in the Tao Palace.”
“The body Training path in this world has a higher limit. Of course, if the body Training path in this world reaches the end, you will still consider practicing the skill of High Martial System.”
“After all, this world is still in the Last Dharma Age, and no one knows when the golden age will reappear. Because of this, the limit is locked.”
“For the body Training path, although the limit is not locked, the lack of resources is actually no different from being locked. After all, the body Training path actually consumes more resources.”
“In the blink of an eye, another 300 years have passed. In these 300 years, the last part of essence of the Divine Medicine was also refined by you.”
“Because of this, your body has now become very strong, strong enough to easily explode a Half-step God King Realm Strongman or to contend against a God King Realm powerhouse.”
“After absorbing the essence of the Divine Medicine, you choose to come out of seclusion because you remember that in several decades, it will be the day when the secret realm controlled by the three big god sects in the east opens.”
“You have been curious before about why Lin Qinghe accepted the Devouring Immortal Demon Body for some reason and completely embarked on the Demon Path, so you thought about whether to explore it or not.”
…
The text simulation stopped here, and various images and insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
In addition to this, he felt that his cultivation had instantly soared to the Great Perfection in True Divine Realm.
He was also invincible in terms of physical strength.
“Good lord, this feeling is awesome.”
Feeling his current great power, Wang Ping couldn’t help but exclaim.
With his current panel strength, even if he confronted Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection Experts, he probably wouldn’t be at a disadvantage.
In this Last Dharma Age, Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection Experts are leaders of major powers like the Master of Tao Palace.
As for Semi-saints, apart from those old monsters that hide themselves and self-tittle, wanting to pass the Last Dharma Age, there are not many Semi-Saints walking out in the whole Elemental Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Chapter 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_5
Under such circumstances, it wasn’t an exaggeration for Wang Ping to claim that he was a top powerhouse on the Elemental Star.
Even with various means, it would still be a debatable issue whether a semi-saint could kill Wang Ping or not.
One could only say that the divine medicine obtained from the Great Saint Secret Realm was truly awesome.
This was the Profound World, where once a startling opportunity was obtained, one’s cultivation and strength would soar rapidly, easily surpassing Same Realm Cultivators.
“With this strength, it’s time to investigate Lin Qinghe’s background.”
Wang Ping knew the reason for suddenly quitting Text Simulation and entering Immersive Simulation, his eyes flickered, and he made up his mind.
Since Lin Qinghe had fled due to the identity exposed by a God King Realm powerhouse from the Tao Palace back then.
Now, if he looks for Lin Qinghe, the probability of something going wrong wouldn’t be high.
After all, it would be tough for a Semi-saint to kill him, and the possibility of Lin Qinghe awakening her Second Soul and killing him wouldn’t be high.
“System, fast forward for me.”
After making the decision, Wang Ping spoke directly in his heart.
“Ding, fast forwarding.”
The system’s voice rang again, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[After making your decision, you leave the Tao Palace and arrive at the Whiteflame Divine Sect as a low-key guest.]
[The White Flame Divine Sect Master is overjoyed and enthusiastically entertains you.]
[For the current Whiteflame Divine Sect, your arrival as a Disciple of Tao Palace is like a lifesaver.]
[After all, the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect has been missing for a long time. If things continue like this, it would be hard not to suspect that something has happened to the Ancestor, and other powers may be ready to make a move.]
[By that time, the situation of the Whiteflame Divine Sect would undoubtedly become extremely dangerous.]
[Now, as a Disciple of Tao Palace, your arrival at the Whiteflame Divine Sect could effectively deter other forces if you could cling to the thighs of the Disciple of Tao Palace, preventing them from attacking the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[You are well aware of the White Flame Divine Sect Master’s intentions and only state that you are there as a guest, wanting to meet the Goddess of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, Lin Qinghe.]
[When you say this, the White Flame Divine Sect Master is overjoyed, thinking that you have designs on Lin Qinghe. If Lin Qinghe could become your Tao Companion, their position in the Inner Region would be as stable as Mount Tai, and other powers would definitely not dare to attack the Whiteflame Divine Sect easily.]
[In such circumstances, the White Flame Divine Sect Master goes directly to Lin Qinghe, informs her of the current situation of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, and asks her to have a good attitude towards you and try to please you.]
[Although Lin Qinghe frowns and feels uncomfortable, she doesn’t say much.]
[Next, Lin Qinghe meets you and serves you tea and water. Under such circumstances, you have a peaceful attitude while discussing cultivation matters with Lin Qinghe, drawing closer the relationship without mentioning any thoughts of men and women.]
[This surprises Lin Qinghe. She originally thought that you came to the Whiteflame Divine Sect specifically because you were interested in her, and now it seems like she was overthinking it.]
[After thinking it over, Lin Qinghe feels that she’s been too full of herself. After all, you are a Disciple of the Tao Palace and the current First Heaven’s Proud Genius of the Elemental Star. Your status is revered, your identity noble, and you are considered a future saint. In such a situation, if you want a Tao Companion, most women would actively approach you, and you could take your pick. Although she has many secrets and is very attractive, there are not few others on the Elemental Star that could rival her.]
[However, although Lin Qinghe thinks she has been overthinking, she is also curious about the secret behind your visit to the Whiteflame Divine Sect and doesn’t know why you came all this way. It’s definitely not as simple as coming to discuss the Tao with her.]
[You don’t care about Lin Qinghe’s doubts and continue to talk with her. In the blink of an eye, several decades pass, and during these decades, you have been discussing the Tao with Lin Qinghe. To be precise, you have been teaching her cultivation while secretly observing her to see her current mental state.]
[The Whiteflame Divine Sect is delighted with your behavior of staying there for decades, thinking that you probably have a crush on Lin Qinghe. This makes them feel at ease, thinking that the potential threats and probes from the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty are nothing.[/p>
[However, only Lin Qinghe grows increasingly suspicious, not knowing your true purpose. Of course, although suspicious, the ten years of interaction has made her develop some fondness and curiosity towards you.]
[Soon after, the secret realm controlled by the Three Great Forces opens, and Lin Qinghe enters it. Regarding this, you self-tittle your cultivation, expressing your intention to enter the secret realm.]
[The White Flame Divine Sect Master is happy to let you join and chooses to let you follow him inside. Once again, the events in your memory happen, only this time you are a Guest Elder, but now you are a Disciple of the Tao Palace.]
[Even if you suppress your cultivation now, it would still be easy for you to eliminate a group of cultivators at the Void Divine Realm. However, your goal this time is still to find out Lin Qinghe’s background, so you have no intention of changing the plot.]
[After entering the secret realm, you leave the team alone. As for the team’s leading elder from the White Flame Divine Sect, he doesn’t dare to say anything and can only let you go.]

chapters.title: Chapter 594: 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Chapter 184: Great Perfection in True Divine Realm! Unrivaled in the Upper World_6
[At this point, just like in your memory, the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s team was ambushed by the two major powers. The intense battle began to unfold.]
[You, on the other hand, were observing everything in secret, wanting to see if Lin Qinghe would act as she did in your memory. If this were the case, then Lin Qinghe’s disguise would be too deep—simply a master of disguising her emotions.]
[This time, something caught your eye. The plot did not follow the development in your memory. From the beginning of the battle, Lin Qinghe showed her 3rd tier Void Divine Realm cultivation, and she still had not used her 7th tier Void Divine Realm cultivation by the time nearly all of the Whiteflame Divine Sect members had fallen. Her understanding of Pseudo Rules was also quite ordinary, just like an ordinary genius.]
[However, you started to ponder whether Lin Qinghe felt that he was watching the battle and therefore dared not reveal her Devouring Immortal Demon Body and her true combat power. This possibility could not be ruled out completely.]
[As a result, you continued to watch the battle without any intention of intervening. Under these circumstances, all the remaining members of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, including the Divine Child, were killed, leaving only Lin Qinghe severely injured and in danger of losing her life. The two major powers deliberately held back, seemingly intending to humiliate Lin Qinghe.]
[In the end, while being observed by you, it was as if Lin Qinghe suddenly transformed into a different person. Although her cultivation remained the same, she displayed the Power of Manas, easily annihilating all her enemies with her Divine Realm Cultivation.]
[However, when Lin Qinghe displayed the Power of Manas, you clearly sensed that she became extremely weak. Obviously, another soul within her body had intervened; otherwise, she would not have been able to wield the Power of Manas with such a significant impact on her body.]
…
