“It seems that the event that changed Lin Qinghe must have happened in these several decades or even as recent as the last 20 years. Otherwise, Lin Qinghe’s cultivation wouldn’t be just 3rd tier Void Divine Realm, nor would it match my previous Text Simulation at the 7th tier Void Divine Realm, but rather above the True Divine Realm.”
Wang Ping silently made reasonable speculations based on the information from the Text Simulation.
“In that case, I can be more precise in my next stalking attempt. If I can intervene in the plot and make Lin Qinghe my asset, that would be a great opportunity. After all, others can’t catch up with my growth rate, but Lin Qinghe, who possesses the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, can.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, his thoughts whirling.
By making Lin Qinghe his right-hand woman in the future, it would be a great help whether dealing with other Myriad Heavens Forces or confronting the seniors from the Second and First Generation Traveler’s Chat Groups.
After all, it would be impossible for him to fight alone in the future, and more powerful companions would always be better than too few.
Although the people in the chat group were also good, and they could grow stronger rapidly with mutual assistance, they were ultimately strong individuals nurtured by others. Apart from their cultivation, they lacked Cultivation Skills, understanding of rules, and so on.
Under normal circumstances, having them complete various Group Tasks to earn Group points would be a good thing.
However, if they were to participate in top-level battles, even if their cultivation levels increased, they would still be the type to be overleveled and killed.
What they could do was basically bully those who were much weaker than themselves in terms of cultivation.
But these capabilities would not be of much use on future battlefields, and they were expendable.
In this case, their cultivation levels could only keep them from dying, and they could serve as support for Wang Ping and Lin Qinghe, who were the true powerhouses, with their Golden fingers.

chapters.title: Chapter 595: 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Chapter 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures
Next, Wang Ping collects his thoughts and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
The text on the luminescent screen also emerges.
[As you ponder various things, Lin Qinghe’s second soul also looks in your direction and asks you to come out. Knowing that you can’t hide, you choose to comply.]
[Lin Qinghe’s second soul looks at you, mocking your cold-heartedness. Seeing your beloved woman in mortal danger, almost violated, you remain indifferent and just watch coldly.]
[Facing the mockery of Lin Qinghe’s second soul, your face remains calm without any change, stating that you and Lin Qinghe are only friends, not a beloved woman. Moreover, you are not Lin Qinghe.]
[Facing your words, Lin Qinghe’s second soul sneers, not denying that you have found out her identity, claiming that you wasted decades getting close to Lin Qinghe just to figure out if she has the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[You don’t deny the words of Lin Qinghe’s second soul, calmly saying that you’ve known about Lin Qinghe’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body. However, you want to know whether Lin Qinghe has fallen to demonic possession, which will determine how you treat her.]
[Devouring Immortal Demon Body, rejected by the world, once exposed, will be hunted down by cultivators from the Upper Realm. However, you state that you are different, you believe that one’s constitution and power are not sinful. The important thing is whether the person using them is evil.]
[Hearing your words, Lin Qinghe’s second soul frowns, not sure if you are hypocritical or genuinely think that way. If it’s the latter, she feels she might have to reevaluate you.]
[Many thoughts flash through Lin Qinghe’s second soul’s head, eventually sneering and asking what your current impression is.]
[You answer Lin Qinghe’s second soul’s question, saying that Miss Lin Qinghe is very kind and unwilling to use the power of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, so you won’t do anything more, nor will you reveal the truth of her constitution. However, you say that the existence of Lin Qinghe’s second soul is obviously different from her, very dangerous, the intent to kill is heavy, and it is clearly Evil Tao.]
[Lin Qinghe’s second soul mockingly asks if you want to get rid of her for this reason?]
[To this, you calmly say that if you can, you would like to try. As soon as your words fall, Lin Qinghe’s second soul controls Lin Qinghe’s body to attack you.]
[Facing the sudden attack of Lin Qinghe’s second soul, you show no fear, and the battle begins. The Space Law you display surprises even Lin Qinghe’s second soul, who is shocked.]
[Because Lin Qinghe’s second soul, unlike the small fries of God Monarch Realm, can see that you are not an old monster reincarnating. In this situation, being able to comprehend the Space Law is truly astonishing.]
[Lin Qinghe’s second soul controls Lin Qinghe’s body and engages in an intense battle with you, lamenting that even in the golden age, few could compare with you. In the Last Dharma Age, you may well be the number one person.]
[However, Lin Qinghe’s second soul’s words quickly turn cold, saying it’s a pity that you met her. Then, she uses terrifying Divine Skills and the Power of Manas to completely devour the cultivator corpses’ origin in the vicinity.]
[Then, under your astonished gaze, Lin Qinghe’s cultivation improves step by step and directly reaches the 9th tier Void Divine Realm.]
[At this, you can’t help feeling that the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is terrifying. You had greatly underestimated the power of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body before.]
[If Lin Qinghe truly lets loose and hunts other cultivators, using the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to devour their sources, she could become even more powerful than just reaching the God Monarch Realm in a thousand years.]
[Of course, this is only possible because Lin Qinghe has a dual soul in one body, allowing her to possess like a ghost.]
[If it were only Lin Qinghe, she would definitely keep a low profile, stealthily devouring others, not daring to cause a big commotion, or she would certainly die.]
[After increasing her cultivation, Lin Qinghe’s second soul wants to start another round of battle with you.]
[However, just as she is about to start, Lin Qinghe fights back and tries to regain control of her body.]
[At this, Lin Qinghe’s second soul is very dissatisfied and unwilling, but she can only give up control of the body.]
[Seeing this, you also know that the battle is over, and you withdraw your aura, apologizing to Lin Qinghe, saying that your intentions for contacting her were not pure.]
[At this, Lin Qinghe has a complex expression, saying that she had guessed as much. Besides that, she says that you don’t need to apologize. After all, knowing that she has the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and not revealing it is already very friendly of you.]
[However, Lin Qinghe only wants to know one thing: whether you truly consider her as a friend.]
[Hearing this, you are slightly startled and say that you naturally count Lin Qinghe as one of your few friends.]
[Hearing this, Lin Qinghe finally relaxes. Your words earlier had greatly touched her, and she didn’t want to lose your friendship.]
[After sorting out the resources, you both leave the secret realm together.]

chapters.title: Chapter 596: 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Chapter 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_2
[After you came out, the leading elders of the Three Great Forces found that only you and Lin Qinghe were alive, and they were all extremely astonished.]
[Next, you took the initiative to shake your head and say that the Whiteflame Divine Sect had encountered a joint surprise attack by the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty. Unfortunately, you were late to look for the opportunities, so you only managed to save Lin Qinghe.]
[Hearing this, the elder of the Whiteflame Divine Sect was shocked, angry, and grateful. He was furious at the actions of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty and fearful for your attack. If anything had happened, their Whiteflame Divine Sect would not be able to bear the responsibility. However, he was grateful for your help as a prestigious disciple of the Tao Palace.]
[As a result, the elder of the Whiteflame Divine Sect repeatedly expressed his gratitude to you. Lin Qinghe was also very moved and grateful to you as well. Your words undoubtedly saved her a lot of trouble.]
[On the other hand, the True Divine Realm Elders from both the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty were shocked and enraged when they saw that none of their people came out.]
[Then, they questioned Lin Qinghe, asking if it was someone from the Whiteflame Divine Sect who had done something in the secret realm.]
[In response, the True Divine Realm Elder of the Whiteflame Divine Sect laughed in anger and said that the two True Divine Realm Elders of the major powers were shameless. They had taken the lead in attacking their Whiteflame Divine Sect, but when things went wrong and they were counter-killed, they still managed to bite back.]
[Faced with the ridicule from the True Divine Realm Elder of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, the True Divine Realm Masters of both the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty remained unmoved and wanted to take action. However, the True Divine Realm Elder of the Whiteflame Divine Sect coldly snorted, completely fearless.]
[Seeing this, the True Divine Realm Masters from the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty couldn’t figure out the details of the Whiteflame Divine Sect and couldn’t guess whether the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect had really encountered an accident. In the end, they could only leave some harsh words before leaving, saying they would settle the matter with the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[Both major powers suffered heavy losses this time, losing so many people and resources, and even the Divine Sons and Goddesses were all dead. There will definitely be great turmoil when they return, and they will also find it hard to blame each other.]
[As for the Whiteflame Divine Sect, they were also heartbroken by the casualties this time. The death of the Divine Sons and the Sect Master’s descendants was a very serious matter. However, he had no choice but to leave with you and Lin Qinghe first to prevent the two major powers from striking back, as he had no confidence in protecting you, the distinguished guest.]
[As for this, you didn’t really care. After all, although you hid your identity and had no intention of taking action, if you really had to, it wouldn’t matter. Killing two ordinary True Lords quietly is as simple as eating and drinking for you now.]
[Afterwards, you returned to the Whiteflame Divine Sect, and the Three Great Forces were greatly shaken by the experiences in the secret realm, with a trend towards war. As for you, you returned to Lin Qinghe’s mountain peak and had a conversation with her.]
[This time, you mainly asked about the situation of Lin Qinghe’s second soul, hoping she could tell you about her second soul so you could help her as a friend.]
[Regarding this, Lin Qinghe hesitated, not knowing whether to tell you or not. After all, this was her biggest secret, and if it were leaked, the consequences would be too serious.]
[Lin Qinghe’s second soul also scolded her, telling her not to foolishly reveal it.]
[In the end, Lin Qinghe sighed and apologized, saying she couldn’t tell you and hoped you would understand. Hearing this, you smiled and said you understood. However, you guessed that the second soul inside Lin Qinghe’s body was the previous owner of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body. It’s just that she had fallen and reincarnated with you, and now her soul is incomplete and her memory is not fully restored.]
[Hearing your speculation, Lin Qinghe fell silent. Her second soul also fell silent, not expecting you to guess the truth so easily. However, Lin Qinghe’s reaction was not slow, quickly hiding her past from you ambiguously.]
[Seeing this, you didn’t care, wondering whether her second soul really was the previous Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s remnant soul. It seemed to have become Lin Qinghe’s auxiliary soul and perhaps a guide for her. You also wondered why this person was so cruel in her previous life – whether it was due to her nature, her addiction to power, or if there was a hidden reason.]
[“Well, it doesn’t matter what the previous Devouring Immortal Demon Body was like, as it’s now in a remnant soul state. As long as I am cautious, she won’t be able to cause any trouble. Besides, as long as I develop a close relationship with Lin Qinghe, our relationship wouldn’t be considered hostile.”]
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, his eyes flickering as he silently pondered.
For Wang Ping, he had the Life Simulator, so he was least afraid of being betrayed.
Therefore, he was still quite confident that he could cultivate Lin Qinghe, who hadn’t turned dark yet, as his right-hand man.
Of course, it still depended on whether Lin Qinghe was a grateful person.
If Lin Qinghe was not grateful, there would be no need to cultivate such a person, even if they possessed great talent. In that case, it would be better to get rid of them sooner rather than later.
As Wang Ping thought about it, the words continued to appear on the luminescent screen.
[Next, you stayed in the Whiteflame Divine Sect for a while longer. As for you now, you’ve reached a bottleneck, and a great opportunity is needed to quickly break through to the half-step God Lord Realm. Unfortunately, such opportunities are rare in the Last Dharma Age.]

chapters.title: Chapter 597: 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Chapter 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_3
[As for the insight into the rules, the Last Dharma Age’s rules are not prominent, making it difficult to comprehend. As a result, you’ve been focusing on cultivation these years to enhance your cultivation level, but your progress in the rules is not great, still staying at the one-tenth Space Rule realm. At most, by comprehending the Space Law, you’ve made significant progress in understanding other rules, and with some more time, it is possible to comprehend them.]
[So, you had the leisure time to stay in the Whiteflame Divine Sect and develop a relationship with Lin Qinghe. After all, the difference in cultivation realization is not very significant for you right now, no matter where you practice.]
[It was during your low-profile stay in the Whiteflame Divine Sect that the conflict between the Whiteflame Divine Sect, the Green Spirit Divine Sect, and the North Snow Divine Dynasty became increasingly evident. Both the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty joined hands to suppress the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[The Whiteflame Divine Sect, having lost its Ancestor and with your ambiguous attitude, coupled with your refusal to allow them to reveal your presence here, could only bear the pressure.]
[Thus, this allowed the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty to firmly believe that the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s Ancestor had really met with an accident, and now it was like a toothless tiger. As a result, after discussions between the two major powers, they directly attacked the Whiteflame Divine Sect during their ceremony to appoint the new Divine Son, which was extremely contemptuous and humiliating.]
[This left the White Flame Divine Sect Master and other strongmen of the White Flame Divine Sect in both shock and anger. Yet you still sat back and watched, curiously asking Lin Qinghe if she wanted your help.]
[After struggling, Lin Qinghe expressed her wishes, hoping that you could save the Whiteflame Divine Sect who had adopted her, and that she would owe you a favor. If possible, she did not want her second soul to awaken and take control of her body, as it felt both strange and dangerous.]
[Not to mention, her current cultivation base was shallower, and even if her second soul took action, it might not be able to bridge such a large gap in cultivation and defeat many enemies. And revealing her physical condition if the second soul took action was another concern.]
[Therefore, only you, Wang Ping, relying on your identity as the Disciple of Tao Palace, could easily deter this group of strongmen.]
[Seeing that Lin Qinghe wanted your help, you also smiled and decided to take action, having her owe you a great favor. Soon, you stepped forward at the critical moment of the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[When you appeared in front of the many cultivators, no longer concealing your face and identity, everyone was shocked. Even the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s cultivators, due to your discreetness over the years, did not expect you to appear as a distinguished guest in their sect.]
[As for the North Snow Divine Dynasty and the Green Spirit Divine Sect, they were terrified and felt tingles on their scalps.]
[After all, although the Tao Palace has declined, it is still a giant in the Elemental Star, not a power they could provoke.]
[And you, as a disciple of Tao Palace, have a respected identity, representing the Tao Palace, and your presence here to protect the White Flame Divine Sect is extraordinary.]
[If they want to act against the Whiteflame Divine Sect, it means challenging the Tao Palace, and they cannot afford the consequences.]
[However, things have come to this point, and they are unwilling to give up destroying the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[Just when the two major powers were troubled and didn’t know what to do, a mysterious powerhouse appeared, and coldly mocked the disciple of the Tao Palace for his arrogance.]
[Then, this mysterious powerhouse erupted with the pressure of a God King Realm power, wanting to suppress you to your knees.]
[This scene surprised many people, who never expected anyone to be so bold as to attack the disciple of the Tao Palace.]
[Even in the Last Dharma Age, God Monarchs were considered top powerhouses, and there were not many God King Realm powerhouses within the Tao Palace, but the deep resources of the Tao Palace, which possessed even the Emperor’s artifact, meant that ordinary God Sects and God King Realm powerhouses wouldn’t dare to provoke the Tao Palace, let alone attack their disciple.]
[This act blatantly disregarded the Tao Palace and was an open provocation, bound to create a deadly feud.]
[In the eyes of the people, this mysterious God King Realm power was either a loose cultivator with a grudge against the Tao Palace, or backed by a powerful force and targeted at the Tao Palace.]
[However, the Whiteflame Divine Sect was completely panicked regardless of the situation, not knowing what to do. After all, their biggest reliance was you, the disciple of the Tao Palace, and you were about to be suppressed.]
[The people of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty, however, were overjoyed, and their ancestors ordered a direct attack. With a mysterious powerhouse confronting you, they could attack the Whiteflame Divine Sect without any concern.]
[Seeing this, Lin Qinghe became anxious, wanting to awaken her second soul to save you and the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[It was at this moment that you coldly looked at the mysterious powerhouse, calmly stating that you didn’t know which faction this strongman belonged to, but since he dared to attack, he should be prepared to fall.]
[This statement startled many cultivators, who thought you had some kind of support and that the powerhouses of Tao Palace had appeared here.]
[The mysterious God King Realm strongman sneered, saying that if you wanted to bluff or stall for time waiting for reinforcements, you were too naive. The strong cultivators of the God King Realm from the Tao Palace were all within the palace and had not left. This place had also been sealed off, and no one would come to rescue you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 598: 185: Slay the God Monarch! Two Treasures_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Chapter 185: Slay the God Monarch! Two Treasures_4
[“You coldly spoke, indicating that there was no need for the Elders of the God King Realm in the Tao Palace to deal with you. As soon as the word fell, you flew over, actively launching an attack on the mysterious God King Realm strongman.]
[This scene shocked everyone. They couldn’t believe that you dared to take action against a powerhouse in the God Monarch Realm. The mysterious God King Level powerhouse was also astonished, not expecting your bravery.]
[He then, sneered, planning to humiliate you, an ambitious disciple of Tao Palace. Just, what he didn’t expect was that a terrifying power struck when he collided with you, directly blasting him away, with his arm exploding apart.]
[This scene shocked everyone, they never expected that you, a young man, could easily blow up the arm of a God King Realm powerhouse. Such power was terrifying.]
[The mysterious god king realm strongman was also shocked, he didn’t expect your power to be so strong. However, his anger was paramount. As a prestigious culture cultivator in the realm of God King, his arm was blasted by you, a young genius who at most had cultivation in the True Divine Realm, which was quite shameful]
[Therefore, the mysterious God King Realm powerhouse roared in anger, restored his arm, activated his divine skills, and wanted to kill you.]
[As for this, you were not afraid, and again did not hold back. Under the stunned expressions of everyone, you directly showed the behavior of Great Perfection in the True Divine Realm, using divine skills and the Great Perfection Pseudo-rule of Fire to fight the mysterious God King Realm powerhouse.]
[You didn’t intend to use the Space Divine Skills and the Space Law. If so, you would have been noticed by many forces on the Elemental Star that you were the one who took away the Divine Medicine. Particularly, the Zhang family, would be even more furious.]
[In that case, you would get into all sorts of trouble. Besides, the Tao Palace would not be spared either.]
[However, even though you concealed the incomplete Space-Time Dao Body and Space Law, you were still extremely powerful, able to contend with the God King and shock the world with just the use of Great Perfection Pseudo-rule of Fire and the Fire-Element Divine Skills derived from the Emperor Tao Tian Scripture.]
[No one ever expected you to be so formidable, your physical body is comparable to a God King Realm, and your cultivation reached the Great Perfection in the True Divine Realm, and you have even comprehended the Great Perfection Pseudo-rule of Fire.]
[With such cultivation skills and combat power, your peers are somewhat weaker in comparison.]
[Lin Qinghe was also shocked, she didn’t understand why your cultivation progressed so quickly. Lin Qinghe’s second soul also woke up and stated that you still hid a lot of strength, otherwise, killing that mysterious God King Realm powerhouse would be simple.]
[After all, that mysterious God King Realm powerhouse, whose cultivation is nothing more than the Second Layer of God King Realm, is not considered too strong in her eyes. Compared to the ordinary God Monarch Realm, you can easily kill him if you really use the Space Law.]
[Right when everyone was watching the fight, you were unable to defeat the mysterious God King Realm Strongman for a long time and had grown a little impatient. You directly used the Space Department of God Territory and the Great Perfection Space Pseudo-Laws to deliver a terrifying strike.]
[This time, you were quite lucky. You activated the effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade.]
[Because of this, with your terrifying attack, the mysterious God King Realm powerhouse was directly seriously injured and extremely frightened.]
[He couldn’t understand why not only had you comprehended the Great Perfection Space Pseudo-Laws, but also, why could your attack power suddenly double at the critical moment, which was indeed unreasonable.]
[Not only was the mysterious God King Realm strongman frightened, but even Lin Qinghe’s second soul, who had seen much and knew well, was surprised. She could not understand your baffling move, which was impossible to defend from.]
[After all, when powerhouse’s fight, they have fine control over their power. After a fight, you can judge how strong your opponent is, and channel corresponding power for defense. This won’t lead to energy waste.]
[However, in the same-realm fights, the sudden doubling of the attack’s power is completely indefensible and absolutely lethal.]
[While everyone was astonished, you did not give up the opportunity to hit a drowning dog again and used a powerful killer move once again, intending to give the mysterious God King Realm powerhouse a fatal blow and completely kill him.]
[This time, you were still quite lucky. You triggered the effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade. Therefore, although the mysterious God King Realm powerhouse was fully defending, he still couldn’t block your attack and was directly killed by you.]
[And so, you, with the cultivation of the True Divine Realm, forcibly killed a God King Realm powerhouse. Moreover, it was not just a powerhouse who had just broken through to the God King Realm, but a second-level God King Realm powerhouse.]
[This scene was indeed a bit shocking. The act of killing a God King Realm powerhouse with the cultivation of Great Perfection in the True Divine Realm, rather than a Half-step God King Realm Strongman, was extremely rare in the Upper Realm.]
[In the history of the Elemental Star, excluding those old monsters who had unprecedented same realm battle power in the early ages due to their re-cultivation, none of the younger generation except Emperor Tao Tian in his early years and his children achieved such an amazing feat.]
[That is to say, your current battle power can be compared with Emperor Tao Tian in his youth and his children. It is simply terrifying.]
…
“Before, the Purple Talent: Endless Blade had no presence, but now it has finally shown its prowess. It provides immense help in battles.”

chapters.title: Chapter 599: 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Chapter 185: Slaying the God Monarch! Two Treasures_5
Wang Ping looked at the content of this simulation and couldn’t help but smile, very satisfied with the performance and description of Purple Talent: Endless Blade.
In the past, when he played games, there were quite a few instances where a critical strike would directly affect his soul.
Especially in the League of Heroes in the past, many players, including him, needed to equip a critical hit rune. If they were lucky, they could deal a critical strike during mutual attrition, which would give them a considerable advantage in terms of health.
If they happened to land a critical strike during a clash, they could potentially overpower or reverse kill the opponent.
That’s the charm of critical strikes.
How could Purple Talent: Endless Blade not have a presence? It’s only because it didn’t have a good opportunity to be showcased before.
“However, with my current combat power, am I already on par with Emperor Tao Tian and the Emperor’s son in their youth? If I were to use Space Law, wouldn’t that be even more overwhelming for their young selves?”
Wang Ping thought about the issue of combat power and couldn’t help but smile, the corners of his mouth slightly raised.
That’s right—even an emperor wouldn’t find it easy to achieve this in the True Divine Realm, let alone comprehend the laws at that stage.
Of course, nothing is absolute. Some emperors might not have comprehended the laws in the True Divine Realm, but some could have.
After all, countless chances and opportunities exist in the world, so it’s certain that opportunities to help comprehend laws exist as well.
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As everyone is amazed, you look at Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty, speaking coldly, ‘Didn’t I tell you to leave? Or are you defying my authority?’]
[These words make the people of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty shudder and hastily express their submission, stating that they have come to attend the ceremony to congratulate the new Divine Son of the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[This scene makes many cultivators sigh—this is the advantage that power and status bring. Even if they are a God Sect or God Dynasty, or old seniors who have practiced for many years, they have to bow down and submit in front of this junior Wang Ping.]
[With this, the conflict between the Three Great Forces comes to an end. In order to appease Wang Ping, the Ancestors of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty hurriedly present their treasured items to win him over.]
[Initially, Wang Ping is not very interested, not believing they have anything valuable to offer.]
[However, to his surprise, they actually present things of great worth—the Green Spirit Ancestor and North Snow Ancestor give Wang Ping a Demonic Heavenly Stone. Incomprehensible even to the Divine Monarch Realm elders of Tao Palace, Wang Ping only discovers its significance after searching for a long time in the Scripture Pavilion.]
[Clearly, the Green Spirit Ancestor doesn’t recognize the stone, only thinking it’s extremely precious due to its unique material—possibly even a material for crafting top-tier Divine Artifacts or even Sacred Artifacts.]
[Wang Ping accepts it when he noticed the Green Spirit Ancestor’s fortune. Once the Demonic Heavenly Stone is placed into his storage space, something amazing happens—the two Demonic Heavenly Stones resonate and fuse into a key.]
[This makes Wang Ping ponder deeply and guess boldly that both the Demonic Heavenly Stone on Young Master Mo and the one on Green Spirit Ancestor are keys. However, only when the two stones appear together and merge can they form the real key.]
[Obviously, this is Green Bamboo Emperor’s brilliant strategy. Who could have thought that the key to unseal the Black Abyss Demon Spear would be two Demonic Heavenly Stones, requiring both to appear and merge into one to obtain the unsealing key.]
[Furthermore, considering Green Bamboo Emperor decided to seal Black Abyss Demon Spear in the Lower World, he clearly doesn’t want the Black Abyss Supreme to have any possibility of unsealing their life-bound weapon. The Green Bamboo Emperor’s action can only be described as absolute.][However, you don’t think that Green Bamboo Emperor did anything wrong. After all, since the two of them are mortal enemies, and the other party’s stumbling block on the road to enlightenment, there’s no need to show mercy.]
[As you find it difficult to calm down, Green Spirit Ancestor is also trying to please you, anxiously asking if you are satisfied. In response, you regain your composure, smiling lightly and expressing your satisfaction, as long as Green Spirit Divine Sect does not do anything out of line in the future, you will not take action against them.]
[Seeing this, Green Spirit Divine Sect’s Ancestor is overjoyed, thanking you repeatedly. On the other hand, North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor becomes anxious, hoping that what he brings out can also gain your favor.]
[Regarding this, you glance at it and find nothing of particularly high value, the most valuable item being a treasure medicine that is somewhat useful for ordinary God Monarch Realm powerhouses.]
[However, you don’t complain and choose to accept it, your expression unchanged. Seeing this, the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor becomes uneasy, believing that you are not fully satisfied with his compensation, and after struggling, he brings out another item.]
[When you see this item, you are once again surprised.]
[Because it is actually the withered treasure elixir you obtained after killing a Void Divine Realm thief in a simulation.]
[Back then, you felt that there was something special about the item, but you didn’t know exactly what it was, so you didn’t care too much about it.]
[You didn’t expect that this withered treasure elixir would end up in the hands of the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor. Calculating the timeline, you can’t help but suspect that there was some connection between the late-stage Void Divine Realm thief and the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor back then.]
[Otherwise, a deity at the God Monarch Realm would not have their belongings fall into the hands of a thief. Moreover, it was very strange for a thief to have such a high cultivation level.]
[No matter what the situation is, you don’t care much about it. What you care about is this withered treasure elixir, which piques your interest again.]
[Back then, you were only at the 1st tier Void Divine Realm and couldn’t see what was so special about it, only feeling that it was extremely tough.]
[Now, you have achieved Great Perfection in the True Divine Realm and possess a Time-Space Body that can rival God Monarch Realm powerhouses, yet you still can’t see what is so special about it. This strongly suggests that there’s something unique about this withered treasure elixir.]
[Seeing your interest, Whiteflame Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor hurriedly states that he obtained it by chance and almost paid with his life for it.]
[However, after he obtained it, although he didn’t find that it helped his cultivation, its material was very tenacious, and even he, as a God Monarch Realm powerhouse, could not destroy it in the slightest. This undoubtedly shows one thing: this withered treasure elixir is not simple, and perhaps it is a powerful divine medicine transformed from withering.]
[The North Snow Divine Ancestor praises its value, saying that if it can be thoroughly researched, it will definitely be of great value.]
[Not caring about the chattering of the Whiteflame Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor, you directly accept the treasure elixir, indicating that the matter between the North Snow Divine Dynasty and you will be resolved.]
[Seeing your position, the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor is overjoyed and relieved. Although he is a little unwilling to lose this strange withered treasure elixir, when compared to the eternal inheritance of the North Snow Divine Dynasty and his own life, these external things really don’t matter.]
[Next, the two major powers’ Ancestors both say they have something to do and bid you farewell.]
[You don’t try to stop them, letting them leave. As for the Whiteflame Divine Sect, seeing that you don’t take action against the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty but let them go, they feel a little disappointed but dare not say anything.]
[After all, you are someone they can’t afford to offend, and they don’t dare to ask you to do too much. Moreover, they don’t know that the reason you took action this time was entirely for Lin Qinghe’s sake; otherwise, you wouldn’t care what happened to the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[Not long after, you say a few things to Lin Qinghe, tell her she can go to Tao Palace to find you in the future, and then leave the Whiteflame Divine Sect, returning to the Tao Palace.]
[Next, you plan to close yourself off and attempt to break through to the Half-Step God Lord Realm or even the God Monarch Realm. You intend to wait until your cultivation reaches the God Monarch Realm before going to the lower realm to unseal and see if you can obtain the Life-bound Magic Weapon – Abyssal Demon Spear of the Black Abyss Supreme.]

chapters.title: Chapter 600: 186: The Second Emperor Force! Two Great Sages
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Chapter 186: The Second Emperor Force! Two Great Sages
[While you were in closed-door cultivation, your accomplishments had spread throughout Elemental Star, shocking the entire Elemental Star. This silenced fellow peers like Yuan Family Holy Lady and Zhang’s Young Master, the geniuses of their generation. Even the strong elders were astonished.]
[The Master of Tao Palace was overjoyed, laughed heartily, and expressed that his disciple had the potential to become a great emperor, which made the people in charge of all major forces extremely envious.]
[With this, you have earned the title of Young Emperor. This means that as long as you don’t fall along the way and wait for the emergence of the golden age, you will have the qualifications to aim for the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification. However, it remains a question whether those with qualifications can become strong in the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification.]
[After all, throughout history, there have been countless talented geniuses in the Cultivation Path. The further one goes, the more dangerous it becomes. If one’s luck is insufficient, it’s easy to fall along the way, and everything will be in vain.]
[Sometimes, those who are not at the peak of talent and are considered mediocre among geniuses can actually make it to the end. In any case, nobody in the Cultivation Path can accurately predict who will be the ultimate winner.]
[Because of this, although the geniuses of Elemental Star were heavily affected, they didn’t give up on trying to catch up to you.]
[In the blink of an eye, five hundred years passed. During these five hundred years, you were constantly in closed-door cultivation, attempting to reach the half-step God Lord Realm. This is not an easy task, but you believe that as long as you spend more time on it, it will be as natural as water flowing to its destination when you succeed in breaking through to the half-step God Lord Realm.]
[And you are never short of time, so you don’t have any psychological burden, and you’re in a good state of mind.]
[However, as they say, the unexpected may happen. While you were in closed-door cultivation, something happened to Tao Palace. A terrifyingly strong enemy carrying Emperor Force crossed the cosmic starry river and targeted Tao Palace.]
[The strong forces in Tao Palace were alarmed, and the Ancestor, who had sealed himself in the divine source, was forced to re-emerge and confront the enemy with Emperor Force. You were also alerted, leaving your cultivation state and witnessing the situation in the outer world.]
[Regarding this, you were very puzzled and had no idea why Tao Palace was being attacked. In response to your question, the Master of Tao Palace bitterly smiled and said that Tao Palace had many enemies. However, those previous enemies were deterred by the Emperor Force and did not dare to make a move against Tao Palace.]
[Now, it appeared that some enemy had acquired a world-shocking opportunity, unexpectedly obtaining an Emperor Force, and had the confidence to obliterate Tao Palace. Hence, they targeted Tao Palace, wanting to erase it completely. However, the Master of Tao Palace assured you that although the enemy also wielded Emperor Force and possessed high cultivation, that Emperor Force ultimately did not originate from his ancestors, so he could not harm Tao Palace.]
[Upon hearing the confident words of the Master of Tao Palace, you didn’t feel relieved. Instead, you felt a slight uneasiness. This was because the Master of Tao Palace was clearly raising a flag.]
[Sure enough, not long after the Master of Tao Palace finished speaking, another terrifying aura appeared and attacked Tao Palace. That was the aura of a present-day Saint. The aura of the Saint was very terrifying, and without Emperor Force threatening it, it could undoubtedly cause significant damage to Tao Palace.]
[The strong enemies fighting with Emperor Force had already shaken the many forces and strong individuals of Elemental Star. Now, with the emergence of a Saint, and the Saint clearly having vigorous Qi and Blood, signifying a breakthrough in this era, the various forces were once again shocked.]
[After all, reaching the God Monarch Realm in the Last Dharma Age is already difficult, and becoming a Semi-saint is even more challenging. However, its difficulty is relative to the golden age. After all, the Last Dharma Age lacks resources, and the spiritual energy is not as dense, thus, cultivating speed is naturally low. The influence on enlightenment is not that significant.]
[But the Saint Realm is different. Entering the Saint Realm not only requires a huge amount of resources for transformation but also the comprehension of Laws. In the Last Dharma Age, the Laws are hidden, making it difficult to comprehend them. The difficulty of comprehending the Laws under such circumstances and stepping into the Saint Realm is imaginable.]
[Such individuals, even in the golden age, could undoubtedly become significant big shots. In today’s Last Dharma Age, if there are no ancient monsters appearing, very few can withstand them.]
[At this moment, many forces began to feel Schadenfreude, thinking that Tao Palace might be doomed. With a terrifying enemy restraining their Emperor Force and the present-day Saint attacking Tao Palace, what could Tao Palace possibly use to resist?]
[Even some forces were itching to make a move. For them, this might be a good opportunity. If they could seize this opportunity and strike against Tao Palace, they might have a chance to share in the spoils and obtain the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture of Tao Palace.]
[If they could obtain the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, they would be truly elated. Their foundation in Cultivation Skill would truly not be inferior to those top forces in the Upper Realm. If they could develop further in the future, they might have a chance to join the ranks of the truly top forces in the Upper Realm, rather than just dominating Elemental Star.]
[However, these forces eventually calmed down and did not bring out their ancestors. After all, there were still too many uncertain factors. No one knew what the strong enemy wielding Emperor Force was thinking, nor could they know whether he could defeat Tao Palace’s Emperor Force.]
[Under such circumstances, making rash moves would only result in the extinction of their own forces. The risk factor was simply too high.]
[While various forces had many thoughts in their minds, on Tao Palace’s side, another Ancestor broke out of the divine source and faced off with the present-day Saint. However, this Ancestor’s Qi and Blood was declining, and his cultivation had regressed. He was no longer at his peak state, and it was evident that he could not easily defeat the present-day Saint.]

chapters.title: Chapter 601: 186: The Second Emperor Force! Two Great Saints_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Chapter 186: The Second Emperor Force! Two Great Saints_2
[Even more so, if the fight dragged on for too long, they might end up being worn down by the enemy.]
[Seeing this, the Master of Tao Palace’s complexion darkened. As for you, your eyes narrowed, focusing unblinkingly on the female saint fighting with the dao ancestors of Tao Palace. This female saint was clearly a member of the second generation of the Transmigrator Chat Group, a predecessor transmigrator, who was once your killer in a simulation. Her name was Ruo Lan.]
[Obviously, she had known that you were at the Tao Palace long ago. This time, she took the opportunity to attack you when the Terrifying Strong was using the Emperor Force against the Tao Palace.]
[This result would not be achievable without the chat group acting as a preventative measure. Otherwise, given your active presence in the Elemental Star, the enemy would have contacted the other transmigrators from the second generation or other forces from All Heavens to take action against you long ago.]
[You ask the Master of Tao Palace, has Tao Palace been completely devoid of self-titled ancestors? Are there no treasures like the Quasi-Emperor Artifact, Supreme Artifact, and Great Saint Artifact left in the Tao Palace?]
[In response to your question, the palace master is silent. He sighs and admits that the Tao Palace had suffered a great catastrophe twelve thousand years ago which exhausted the foundation of the Tao Palace. All of their self-titled ancestors stepped forward with numerous treasures to fight but ultimately, never returned. All the treasures were lost, only the Emperor’s artifact, due to its strength and having been left by Emperor Tao Tian, had the possibility of not being lost.]
[At that time, the Tao Palace was in an extremely dangerous situation, nearly losing its legacy. Fortunately, the relationship between Tao Palace and the Chi Clan was good, and with the Chi Clan stepping in, no one dared to do anything to the Tao Palace. This allowed the Tao Palace some breathing space, and in the subsequent twenty thousand years, saw the birth of a few more individuals Entering the Holy Realm.]
[However, this foundation was clearly insufficient for the Tao Palace to return to its glory days, and it was directly demoted from the ranks of the top forces in the Upper Realm. Later on, when the Burning Emperor suppressed the Source of Darkness, the Chi Clan also encountered difficulties and could not take care of the Tao Palace.]
[As a result, the Tao Palace paid the price and moved from the Central Ancient Star Domain at the heart of the Big Universe to this more remote Life Ancient Star. Even so, the situation of the Tao Palace was not much better. Over the years, there have been many disturbances, and the foundation has been eroded again and again. Now there are only two self-titled ancestors with not much lifespan left.]
[These two ancestors undoubtedly emerged, regardless of whether they successfully defeated the enemy, they will never be able to self-tittle again and will definitely fall. At that time, the situation of the Tao Palace will undoubtedly be even more difficult and dangerous. Even though it has the Emperor Force, without a strong man in the Saint Realm, it will be watched by more forces.]
[Upon hearing this, your heart was seized with alarm. You had not expected that Tao Palace had experienced such a great catastrophe, depleting all of Tao Palace’s resources, and you were even more surprised by Tao Palace’s precarious situation. Originally, you had thought Tao Palace, having given birth to a Great Emperor, had an immeasurable foundation. Even in the worst case, it wouldn’t be too devastating. It seems you have overestimated.]
[You then asked what the powerful people of the Tao Palace had gone to do that would result in all of them falling and no one returning. The palace master shook his head and said he didn’t know what had happened because all the ancestors of the Tao Palace who knew about it had fallen.]
[After a moment of silence, the palace master stated that the ingrained ancient power within the Emperor Force would definitely know what had happened, but he was unwilling to tell—and we can’t force him to.]
[Upon listening to this, you sighed, knowing that it would be difficult to learn about this in a short period of time. Obviously, the Emperor Force thought that the strength of the people in the palace was too weak. Knowing wouldn’t change anything and would only add to the annoyance. Even worse, there might be some taboo involved—if known, it could be extremely dangerous.]
…
“The situation of Tao Palace is so dire… It seems that I cannot be too conspicuous in my actions within Tao Palace in the future. Otherwise, it may not only attract the attention of the predecessor transmigrators but may also attract other powerful enemies.”
Wang Ping, looking at the text simulated content, frowned slightly.
He had initially thought that after joining the Tao Palace, unless he encountered top powerhouses, the Tao Palace would be able to protect him. Now it seems that it is not the case.
Currently, in the Last Dharma Age, the situation of Tao Palace isn’t good. Naturally, it would become worse when the Golden Age comes, when all those old monsters who want to avoid wasting their lifespan will collectively emerge. With the rise of newly ascended talented individuals, the situation of the Tao Palace will definitely deteriorate drastically.
Even excluding these powerhouses, the rest of the forces in the middle area of the Elemental Star seem to be stirring already, wanting to join in and get their piece of the pie. But they are just a bit apprehensive of the Emperor Force and the idea of the Terrifying Strong, they dare not act recklessly.
“Clearly, Tao Palace can no longer help me grow quickly. My stay in the Tao Palace, instead, is causing trouble for Tao Palace. Therefore, I should not join Tao Palace in the next simulation. With my current strength, I could become a loose cultivator. As long as I don’t encounter those old monsters, I should be safe.”
Wang Ping thought quietly.
To be honest, Wang Ping was somewhat suspecting whether the Terrifying Strong who attacked the Tao Palace was also aware of the emergence of such a monster like him in the Tao Palace, and that is why he hurried to attack the Tao Palace.
Otherwise, according to the timeline in Wang Ping’s mind, Tao Palace should not have any problems at this point in time.
As Wang Ping was pondering, the luminescent screen continued to display the text.
[Outside the ancient star, the terrifying war becomes more intense. The power of the Emperor Force reached the ancient star, making the ancient star tremble, and all the cultivators were shivering. They clearly understood that if the Emperor’s power was poured into the ancient star, the entire ancient star would be blown up and there was no possibility for them to survive.]

chapters.title: Chapter 602: 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Chapter 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_3
“On the Ancient Star, the battle between the saints continues to rage intensely. However, keen observers can tell that the Saint Ancestor of the Tao Palace is visibly weakening, his strength gradually ebbing away, shifting from an advantageous position to disadvantageous. It’s a testament to the old saying: youth often overpowers age.”
“This revelation leads to other powers surmising that the Tao Palace might truly lack the foundations required, resulting in a collective sigh of regret. In its heyday, the Tao Palace was renowned across the Upper Realm, a colossal force in the Big Universe that they could only aspire to equal. Its present state is a lamentable one, unable to suppress even a newly ascended saint.”
“The Palace Master of the Tao Palace, witnessing this scene, is consumed by despair. He grits his teeth and commands you to lead a part of the group away from the Tao Palace. He sees you as the real hope of the Tao Palace, believing that if you were to fall, the Tao Palace would be truly finished.”
“You vacillate between despair and resolution, realizing that staying behind would be of no help. So you decide to follow the arrangement of the Palace Master. Soon, you lead some of the important individuals and the bedrock of the Tao Palace in preparation for evacuation.”
“The Palace Master of the Tao Palace and a few other God King Realm powerhouses carelessly clutch onto a few Sacred Artifacts, willing to join the battlefield to help the Saint Ancestor restrain Ruo Lan.”
“Seeing this, Ruo Lan from the Second Generation Chat Group, one of the transmigrators, scoffs coldly, indicating her disinterest in wasting any more time now that the Tao Palace has played all its cards.”
“After declaring this, Ruo Lan from the Second Generation Chat Group unleashes a terrifying Forbidden Artifact, killing the Saint Ancestor of the Tao and all the others including the palace master.”
“Then, just as you are about to flee, Ruo Lan completely seals off the space, immobilizing you. In response, you can only manage a bitter smile. Even though you understood the Space Law, it’s of no use in the face of an insurmountable cultivation gap. The Saint is indeed too powerful.”
“Ruo Lan coldly suggests that if you, the younger generation, confess to certain things obediently she would grant you a swift death. To this, you remain silent.”
“Just when you believe that you are doomed, an unexpected character appears. She is none other than Lin Qinghe.”
“Half a millenium has passed. After your heart-to-heart conversation with Lin Qinghe, she stopped resisting and accepted her Devouring Immortal Demon Body, understanding that only power can defend herself and the people she cherishes. Consequently, she left the Whiteflame Divine Sect, killed some Evil Tao and Demonic Path Cultivators, and devoured their original sources to strengthen herself.”
“As a result, Lin Qinghe has now grown to reach the realm of the Divine Monarch. It’s undeniable that the Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s cultivating speed defies the heavens.”
“Of course, this is related to the incomplete state of your Time-Space Body. Otherwise, you could also increase your cultivation speed by altering the time-space ratio without any side effects, not falling behind the Devouring Immortal Demon Body whatsoever.”
“Even though Lin Qinghe has reached the realm of the Divine Monarch, it is still impossible for her to challenge a Saint. Yet she steps forward to protect you, her friend, indicating her willingness to be possessed by the second soul.”
“Only by relying on the power of the second soul can she possibly rival the Saint and repel them. Although this would come at a high price as she cannot easily withstand the strength and rules of the Saint.”
“Aside from that, if she makes the preceding generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s remnant soul fight on her behalf, she might possibly reveal that she is this generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body. That would undoubtedly lead to severe consequences.”
“Nevertheless, despite the risks involved, she took that step. Seeing this, your affection towards Lin Qinghe increases significantly, convincing you that becoming fellow taoists was indeed a wise choice.”
“As long as Lin Qinghe does not fall to the dark side, her nature is not bad. Moreover, her stepping forward to defend you at this critical juncture is testimony enough.”
…
“I originally planned to nurture Lin Qinghe to become a follower or a right-hand man, but it seems we ended up as friends. That’s right, considering Lin Qinghe’s talent and the presence of the preceding generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s remnant soul, it’s almost impossible to make her a follower or a right-hand man.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, his eyes flashing with surprise.
“Let it be. At this moment, I’m unable to cultivate her as a right-hand man in the simulation. Only when I become stronger can I do so.”
“Before that happens, it’s better to be cautious and stay as fellow taoists. Of course, having a fellow taoist who stands up for you at a critical juncture is not any worse than cultivating a right-hand man.”
Then, Wang Ping shook his head, gathered his thoughts, and continued watching the luminescent screen.
“The intervention of Lin Qinghe came as a surprise to many, but most of them thought she overestimated her abilities. A Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator challenging a Saint is utterly suicidal.”
“Never mind opposing a Saint, even standing in the presence of a Saint’s pressure, a Divine Monarch would instantly be crushed. A Saint undergoes a real metamorphosis, and is far stronger than a Semi-Saint.”
“If it was said that a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse could potentially overcome a Semi-Saint by outleveling it, a Semi-Saint challenging a Saint could only be immediately killed.”
“No matter if you are an Emperor’s Child or the Young Emperor, in the face of a Saint, everyone is nothing more than an ant.”
“It can be said that throughout history, no genius has ever defeated a Saint in a head-on battle while still being a Semi-saint – let alone a cultivator in the Divine Monarch realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 603: 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Chapter 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_4
[Ruo Lan looked at Lin Qinghe with some contempt, thinking she was overestimating her abilities. Then, she mercilessly attacked Lin Qinghe.]
[However, to everyone’s surprise, Lin Qinghe managed to block this strike. A terrifying law erupted, shattering the blocked space.]
[After that, Lin Qinghe’s second soul wanted to take you away from here.]
[But then, something unexpected happened.]
[That was the appearance of another Saint at this crucial moment, plunging you all into a desperate situation.]
[Although Lin Qinghe’s second soul was the true body of the previous generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body and had killed a late-stage Emperor, it was not her true power and understanding of the Dao, but just a remnant soul.]
[Moreover, Lin Qinghe’s cultivation was weak, and she couldn’t fully unleash the true power of her Devouring Law. Under such circumstances, being able to block a casual strike from a Saint and shatter the spatial blockade was already impressive, but trying to face two Saints head-on was nothing more than wishful thinking.]
[Seeing this situation, you sighed, knowing that you would surely perish here today. As a result, you instinctively asked Lin Qinghe to flee and chose to actively quit this simulation.]
[With your active withdrawal, the simulation ended.]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and many images and insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Finally, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and appeared above Tao Palace.
He saw the Emperor Force battling in the starry sky and the terrifying strong man holding the Emperor Force, as well as the faces of Saint Ruo Lan and the abruptly appearing Saint.]
Lastly, there was Lin Qinghe, who tried to save him, risking her own safety.
After watching all this, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and he left the immersive simulation, returning to the Divine City Inn in the real world.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose one of the following rewards:
①.True Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation.
②.Sky Demon Stone Key.
③.A Random Saint Artifact.
④.Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth.
⑤.Random Top-tier Divine Artifact.”
…
“System, I choose ④.Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth.”
Wang Ping glanced at the reward list and rapidly made his choice.
Saint Artifacts were precious, but he already possessed one.
Cultivation was temporarily unselectable, as choosing it would make the future consumption of paid simulations skyrocket.
As for the top-tier Divine Artifacts, they could be ignored.
Having located the two Sky Demon Stones, there was no need to claim a reward to obtain them.
In a sense, Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth had the highest cost-effectiveness.
Wang Ping even suspected that the influence of Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth played a part in obtaining treasures such as God Monarch Realm Ancient Tomb treasures, Divine Medicines, Withered Treasure Elixirs, and Sky Demon Stones in this simulation.
Otherwise, his past simulations hadn’t been this lucky even with sufficient strength.
As Wang Ping made his choice, the talent entered his body.
Although Wang Ping didn’t feel anything, he knew that the talent had secretly begun to take effect.
“Alpha, was that second Saint also a transmigrator from the Second Generation Chat Group?”
Soon after, Wang Ping calmed his emotions and asked in his heart.
“No, he is from the Myriad Heavens Forces, and it seems he cooperated with the people from the Second-generation Chat Group.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded, explaining to Wang Ping.
“People from other Myriad Heavens Forces…”
Wang Ping frowned.
So, did this really involve other Myriad Heavens Forces? Things were getting more and more troublesome.
If he exposed himself to these people, it would be incredibly dangerous.
Although he was now quite powerful, he was still like an ant in front of Saints, unable to contend with them.
Unless his cultivation advanced further, reaching the Peak of the God King Realm or even the Semi-saint Realm, he would have a chance to fight a Saint. Otherwise, it would be impossible for him to fight, or even win, against a Saint with his True Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation.
Not to mention fighting, he might not even be able to escape – the result of this simulation proved it.
“Which force does he belong to?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he asked in his heart.
“Slaughter Paradise. There is a lot of bad blood between us and the Transmigrator Chat Group I control. Dealing with them now will be troublesome.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out again.
“Uh…”
Wang Ping was speechless.
So, was Slaughter Paradise’s level equivalent to the chat group’s normal development without destruction?
That was really dangerous.
“Was the original Second Generation Chat Group destroyed by Slaughter Paradise?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he asked another question.
“Yes. Actually, there’s no need for you to overestimate Slaughter Paradise. If it weren’t for the First Generation Chat Group having been destroyed once and weakened significantly, it would be difficult for transmigrators from the Second Generation Chat Group to team up with Slaughter Paradise to destroy the Second Generation Chat Group.”
After a moment of silence, Alpha spoke.
“Okay, it turns out it’s just a case of weaklings fighting each other. I highly doubt that both of you Myriad Heavens Forces are considered average in the eyes of truly powerful Myriad Heavens Forces. This is just like our previous encounter with Newborn Strangeness.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he retorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 604: 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Chapter 186: The Second Emperor’s Weapon! Two Great Sages_5
“The original Transmigrator Chat Group was no ordinary Myriad Heavens Force.”
Alpha seemed to have been stung by Wang Ping’s words and said coldly.
“But the first-generation was destroyed, and it was the strongest transmigrator under your command who did it.”
Wang Ping snorted.
“Accept the reality, the current chat group is the bottom tier of the Myriad Heavens Forces, at the same level as the newcomers. Let alone comparing it to Slaughter Paradise, I don’t think it can be much stronger than the newcomers. After all, our strongest person is only at the Great Perfection stage in the True Divine Realm and has not even reached the God Monarch Realm.”
Hearing this, Alpha had nothing to say and chose to stay silent.
Seeing Alpha not speaking anymore, Wang Ping did not want to continue hitting him. Instead, he began to think about what to do next.
Initially, he thought it was just the trouble caused by the transmigrators from the Second-generation Chat Group. He never thought it would involve the Myriad Heavens Forces of Slaughter Paradise.
Furthermore, whether other forces of Myriad Heavens would be implicated was also a problem.
“What a bother. Without some powerful life-saving cards, I feel like my life could be in danger at any moment.”
Wang Ping sighed, feeling a headache coming on.
In the simulator, the other side cannot contact other transmigrators in the chat group, and the condition of other Myriad Heavens Forces won’t be simulated either.
But in reality, they can do that.
Wang Ping’s biggest worry was that the opponent had already taken action and wouldn’t come after more than 1,500 years but rather within these few years or even the next few years. That would be fatal.
It was too dangerous after the coordinates were exposed.
Although he could seek refuge in other worlds through the chat group, the enemy was also capable of chasing him through All Heavens, so he couldn’t guarantee they wouldn’t come after him.
“Talent, talent, I hope to draw a Golden Talent that can help me avoid Heavenly Secrets, hide my identity, and evade searches. Otherwise, it would be unbearable.”
Wang Ping shook his head, hoping for something from the chat group.
Purple Talent · Aura Concealment is too low-grade, as it doesn’t work on Saints and only conceals aura. It cannot avoid means such as Heavenly Secrets search, so it cannot give him a sense of security.
Only this kind of Golden Talent could give him security.
“The final simulation, then I have to go mining. After mining, after getting the resources left by the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse, I will make other plans.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought of it.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping directly spoke.
“Ding, consuming 100 kilograms of Lower-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations, host, you have successfully refreshed Purple Talent – Death Puppet; Red Ability – Boiling Blood.”
Purple Talent·Death Puppet: With this talent, the host can designate a God Realm cultivator as a death puppet. When the host suffers damage, the damage will be transferred to the designated puppet in full.
Red Ability·Boiling Blood: With this ability, the host’s combat strength will increase when feeling hot-blooded emotions in battle.
“Eh, this Purple Talent isn’t bad…”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents, his eyes slightly brightening.
Although he did not refresh the Golden Talent he wanted this time, this new Purple Talent was also quite good.
Death puppet, it’s like having an extra life.
Moreover, this thing can transfer damage to a designated target, and it’s a targeted skill that cannot be defended against.
In the future, if he meets an old monster who can’t be defeated, he can designate the monster’s favorite descendants as his death replacement puppet and see if they dare to make a move.
However, this ability and the usage method are somewhat similar to Purple Talent – Fate Connection.
Just that, Purple Talent·Fate Connection is too uncomfortable, as binding with someone cannot be undone, which also restricts him.
Compared to that, this Purple Talent·Death Puppet is obviously a bit more useful.
“It’s a pity that this talent is only Purple. If it were Golden, it could bind Saints, Saint Kings, and even Great Saints. That would be amazing, letting a Great Saint take damage for me, I guess I would never get hurt again.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but fantasize.
“System, I choose Purple Talent·Death Puppet.”
Wang Ping shook his head, gathered his thoughts, and made his decision.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway briefly before entering the immersive simulation state.
“System, fast forward for me.”
Wang Ping silently spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 605: 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement
“Ding, quickly entering…”
The system’s voice rang out, and a luminescent screen appeared, with words floating up on it.
[Day 1, you choose to act. Because you know the location of the Divine Monarch Ancient Tomb, you go there first, using Space Law to sneak in, and easily obtain numerous resources.]
[Next, you’re thinking about whether or not to join the Tao Palace. By joining the Tao Palace, you’ll attract too much attention and will definitely be noticed by the transmigrators in the Second Generation Chat Group, which would be hazardous.]
[In the end, you make a choice and don’t go to the Elemental Star Middle Domain to join the Tao Palace. Instead, you hide your identity and strength, join the Whiteflame Divine Sect as a guest elder very discreetly.]
[In the blink of an eye, it’s time for the Great Saint Secret Realm to open. As in your memory, you quietly leave the Whiteflame Divine Sect and act.]
[However, your luck doesn’t seem to be good this time. You don’t trigger the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, so your sneak attack doesn’t send the God King Realm powerhouse of the Zhang Family flying, and you don’t snatch the Divine Medicine.]
[Your sneak attack angers the God King Realm powerhouse from the Zhang Family, who retaliates. With no other choice, you have to flee. Your speed is very fast, so the Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection Experts from the Zhang Family can’t catch you and can only watch you escape.]
…..
“It turns out that it was the merit of Purple Talent: Endless Blade after all. Now, even if I face Peak of God King Realm experts and use the power of laws, and even start with a sneak attack, it’s still difficult to send them flying or shift them.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of this simulation, his brows slightly furrowed and sighed inwardly.
It seemed that the idea of collecting Divine Medicines without limits to upgrade to the God King Realm or Saint Realm would fall through.
Unless he improved his cultivation and enhanced his strength, he wouldn’t be able to obtain this Divine Medicine.
That would actually be quite easy.
He only needed to forcibly end the simulation during his cultivation at 3rd and 4th tier True Divine Realm, and he could refresh the rewards for the True Divine Realm 3rd and 4th tiers.
Although this would waste one simulation opportunity, it wouldn’t make future simulations too costly. Moreover, he could effectively compete for the Divine Medicine without relying on the critical strike effect brought by Purple Talent: Endless Blade.
“However, this is the last simulation, so I cannot waste it. I still have to simulate normally. After that, I’ll have to wait until I gain an advantage from the Divine Monarch Ancient Tomb before I can do so.” Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought silently.
[You didn’t get the Divine Medicine, feeling very frustrated. You think you overrated the effect of Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth. After all, you initially believed that it was Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth that helped you obtain the Divine Medicine.]
[While you’re feeling frustrated, you accidentally find a Divine Origin Mine and mine quite a few Divine Sources. There are many lower-tier Divine Sources, and not a few middle and upper-tier Divine Sources.]
[This undoubtedly made you rich instantly. As a result, you feel excited and think you’ve wronged Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth. It has to be said; you’re quite biased.]
[Next, you continue to take action and run into Lin Yan, who has already obtained the Great Saint Inheritance. After thinking it over, you decide to test him and see what he’s capable of stopping the Body Possession by the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint and killing it instead.]
[After telling Lin Yan about your intention to compete, a great battle breaks out between you. Lin Yan’s strength is impressive, and he clearly practiced some mysterious Cultivation Skills. Without using laws, he can fight equally with you in the same realm.]
[Although it’s obvious that he’s at a disadvantage and not your opponent, you’re still surprised by his strength and the power of his Cultivation Skills. After all, your fighting power displayed now can rival that of the Emperor in his youth.]
[This also shows that Lin Yan has potential close to that level. However, Lin Yan has always been low-key, whether it is now or in the next thousand years, so you don’t hear him making any noise.]
[You become more and more curious about him, increasing your strength and forcing him to use hidden cards. This also causes Lin Yan to become really angry and fight you fiercely.]
[However, he eventually loses to you, and you choose to stop. Yet, you’re very doubtful. If Lin Yan had only this level of combat power, he wouldn’t have had the strength to kill the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint.]
[Of course, you guess that he must have some unknown, astonishing secrets. These secrets cannot be exposed; once exposed, his situation will become extremely dangerous.]
[Therefore, you become even more curious about Lin Yan. However, although you’re curious, you no longer intend to attack him and decide to wait until you become more robust to see if you can explore Lin Yan’s secrets.]
[Otherwise, with your current strength, it would be impossible to forcibly obtain secrets from him. Not to mention, there’s no grievance between you and him.]
[Unlike the situation with Profound Turtle where you had to act out of necessity to deal with the anomaly, there’s no reason for you and Lin Yan to oppress him and perform soul-searching due to mere curiosity.]
[In such scenarios, even in simulations, you want to avoid it as much as possible. Some bottom lines cannot be crossed, as it could lead to problems in one’s disposition.]

chapters.title: Chapter 606: 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_2
[After bidding farewell to Lin Yan, you left the Great Saint Secret Realm. Lin Yan remembered you, for you were the first cultivator of your generation to defeat him, and evidently, with ease, as if you hadn’t even used your full strength.]
[After leaving the Great Saint Secret Realm, you returned to the Whiteflame Divine Sect and began your discreet cultivation. In the meantime, you secretly observed Lin Qinghe.]
[After all, you wanted to know what had caused Lin Qinghe’s dark transformation. As long as you understood the reason behind her change, you could interfere appropriately and turn her into a close friend, or even more, making her completely obey you.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a thousand years had passed, and you had continued cultivating silently. However, due to the lack of Divine Medicine and not being in the Tao Palace, your cultivating speed wasn’t as fast as before.]
[In close to a thousand years, your cultivation had only reached the peak of the 3rd tier True Divine Realm. Although this speed was fast, it paled in comparison to the speed when you had the Divine Medicine.]
[Not long after you broke through to the peak of the 3rd tier True Divine Realm, you finally learned the reason for Lin Qinghe’s dark transformation.]
[As it turned out, Lin Qinghe was betrayed by a senior sister from the Whiteflame Divine Sect during their shared adventure. That senior sister, who had always maintained a friendly image, was actually extremely jealous of Lin Qinghe. She believed that Lin Qinghe had taken her place as the Goddess, obstructing her path to cultivation.]
[With her talent, she thought that only by becoming the Goddess and receiving the resources that came with the position could she hope to break through to the half-step God Lord Realm or even the God Monarch Realm. Now, without the title of Goddess and unable to receive the full support of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, she would likely be stuck in the True Divine Realm for her entire life.]
[As a result, she planned to kill Lin Qinghe. Only after Lin Qinghe’s death could she become the new Goddess and receive the full support of the Whiteflame Divine Sect. Betrayed by her trusted senior sister, Lin Qinghe experienced the sinister side of human nature for the first time.]
[However, Lin Qinghe wasn’t a pushover. Although she was injured by her senior sister’s sneak attack, she still managed to gain the upper hand in the battle.]
[But what Lin Qinghe learned from her senior sister’s words next completely shattered her worldview. It wasn’t because she was abandoned and picked up by chance by her master, as she had been told, that Lin Qinghe was taken in by the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[The truth was that the master she esteemed so much had their Ancestor annihilate her family, the Lin family, and took her to the Whiteflame Divine Sect for cultivation, ensuring her loyalty to the sect.]
[These words directly caused Lin Qinghe’s mental breakdown. She never expected that the people she trusted so much all had such sinister intentions. Due to her mental breakdown, she lost her focus in the battle and was heavily injured by her senior sister, who was about to kill her.]
[At the critical moment, Lin Qinghe’s second soul, the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, took over her body, mocking the darkness of human nature and Lin Qinghe’s naïveté.]
[Then, Lin Qinghe’s second soul directly suppressed her senior sister. Lin Qinghe struggled to accept all of this, thinking that her senior sister might have done this to make her mentally collapse and then kill her.]
[Seeing this, Lin Qinghe’s second soul sneered and performed a soul-searching on Lin qinghe. And then, Lin Qinghe fell silent.]
[The higher-ups of the Whiteflame Divine Sect all knew about this and helped cover it up. As the descendant of the Grand Elder of the White Flame Divine Sect, her senior sister also knew about it. Only Lin Qinghe had been kept in the dark and manipulated.]
…
“Lin Qinghe’s past is really tragic.”
Wang Ping sighed as he looked at the contents of the text simulation.
Her family had been wiped out, and she had been taken in and turned into a tool to protect the Whiteflame Divine Sect. All those she trusted were actually wolves in sheep’s clothing.
It was fortunate that her senior sister, a descendant of the Grand Elder, out of jealousy and desire for the God Monarch Realm, had done such a thing and exposed everything.
If not, Lin Qinghe would have never known the truth, and like in the previous simulator, she would have done her best to protect the Whiteflame Divine Sect and even asked for his help.
“No wonder Lin Qinghe turned dark and twisted. Anyone would have gone down that path after experiencing such things. It’s no wonder she was nowhere to be found when the Whiteflame Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty were destroyed in the previous simulation. At that time, Lin Qinghe probably didn’t have the power. If she had the power, she would have taken her revenge instead of saving the Whiteflame Divine Sect.”
“Although most people in the Whiteflame Divine Sect were innocent, the core members definitely deserved to die. Especially Lin Qinghe’s master, who deserved to be cut into pieces.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
If he hadn’t intervened, Lin Qinghe might have become the big boss of the Upper Realm, following a path similar to that of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. He just didn’t know if Lin Qinghe would end up like the past Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, killed by an Emperor.
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[After learning about Lin Qinghe’s past, you also felt that she had been through too much suffering. However, you didn’t have any plans to reveal yourself and quietly left the place.]

chapters.title: Chapter 607: 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_3
[Upon your departure, the remnant soul of the previous Swallowing Immortal Demon Body let out a cold snort, not saying much else. She had noticed you long ago, but since you didn’t harbor killing intent nor had the intention to take any action, she didn’t bother to make a move on you either.]
[Of course, this also had to do with Lin Qinghe’s weak cultivation, which meant that even if you intervened, it was uncertain whether you could kill her.]
[After you returned to the Whiteflame Divine Sect, you continued with your cultivation. As expected, Lin Qinghe never returned to the Whiteflame Divine Sect. That’s because the previous Swallowing Immortal Demon Body must have informed her that her secret was already exposed, and naturally, she would not want to return to such a dangerous place.]
[For Lin Qinghe at this stage, the strategy was to develop inconspicuously and then annihilate the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
