[Lin Qinghe’s disappearance, coupled with your senior sister’s death, plunged the Whiteflame Divine Sect into chaos. The Sect Master and others were all shaken, guessing that Lin Qinghe may already know about her past, hence her behavior.]
[For this reason, they were all furious, wanting to kill Lin Qinghe to eradicate the threat once and for all. In the process, Lin Qinghe’s master was blamed. If he hadn’t brought Lin Qinghe back and trained her, this wouldn’t have happened.]
[Lin Qinghe’s master had nothing to say. When Lin Qinghe was born, she had shown extraordinary talents. He knew then that the Lin family, with a half-step Lord powerhouse guarding it, would never send her to the Whiteflame Divine Sect. If anything, she would be sent to influential forces like the Holy Land or the Tao Palace.]
[That’s why he took such extreme measures, mercilessly wiping out the entire Lin family and taking Lin Qinghe back in hopes that she would one day become a Saint, allowing him to reap the benefits and gain a chance to become a God Monarch.]
[At that time, he didn’t possess the power to destroy the Lin family, which was guarded by a half-step Lord powerhouse, so he had to enlist the help of the Ancestor and many True Divine Realm masters from the Whiteflame Divine Sect to erase the Lin family without a trace.]
[Maybe it was precisely because of this that the risk of information leakages occurred. However, Lin Qinghe’s master knew that at this point, Lin Qinghe had to be killed. Otherwise, once she grew up, he would be the first to die.]
[As a result, Lin Qinghe’s master revealed his ruthlessness, claiming that he had anticipated the possibility of information leakage and had secretly implanted a secret technique in Lin Qinghe that allowed him to track her whereabouts at any time.]
[Then, Lin Qinghe’s master showed a sense of regret and helplessness. He had initially hoped for Lin Qinghe to become a Saint and therefore did not implant any secret techniques that could control her life and death. Otherwise, once Lin Qinghe grew up, she would have sensed it, and that would have been difficult to explain.]
[Seeing this, the higher-ups of the Whiteflame Divine Sect were overjoyed, while you, who were secretly listening to everything, revealed a mocking expression. With the previous Swallowing Immortal Demon Body on their side, these Whiteflame Divine Sect members’ delusions of finding and killing Lin Qinghe were nothing but fools’ dreams.]
[However, you also had no intention of staying around to watch, so you quietly left the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[As you predicted, the Whiteflame Divine Sect never found Lin Qinghe and instead became the butt of many jokes. Furthermore, judging by the timeline, it wasn’t too far off from the day when the Whiteflame Divine Sect would be destroyed by the joint forces of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty.]
[Time flew by, and more than five hundred years had passed. During this time, the Whiteflame Divine Sect had been wiped out by the combined forces of the Green Spirit Divine Sect and the North Snow Divine Dynasty. As a loose cultivator, you never lacked cultivation resources, nor took any risks in exploring various places for adventures. Instead, you focused on quietly cultivating.]
[Of course, due to the effect of the Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth, even though you didn’t actively venture to various places for opportunities, every now and then some small chances would come knocking at your door. Although they weren’t too precious, this kind of experience still felt quite pleasant.]
[Now, with more than five hundred years gone by, your cultivation had once again improved, breaking through to the 4th tier of the True Divine Realm. Although this speed was much slower compared to when you refined the divine medicine essences, it was already much faster than the usual geniuses.]
[After all, this is the Last Dharma Age: cultivating is difficult, and the Heavenly Tao suppresses everything. Cultivating speed won’t increase drastically unless there are exceptional circumstances.]
[Once you broke through to the 4th tier of the True Divine Realm, you decided to venture out into the world to relax. Not long after, a terrifying aura descended upon the Elemental Star, as a Terrifying Strongman wielding an Emperor Force attacked the Tao Palace.]
[This made you realize one thing – this Terrifying Strongman wasn’t there purely for revenge against the Tao Palace, as you had speculated in your previous simulation.]
[Watching the shocking battle silently, you couldn’t help but wonder if the Tao Palace could withstand this catastrophe.]
[As you were pondering, the battle intensified. However, since you didn’t join the Tao Palace this time, no Saints took any action against the palace, and the entire Tao Palace remained unscathed.]
[Nevertheless, as the battle unfolded, a turn of events occurred. The Terrifying Strongman who had been hiding on the Elemental Star chose this moment to make a move, assisting the extraterritorial Master in attacking the Tao Palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 608: 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_4
[As this terrifying strong man took action, the Tao Palace was wiped out in an instant, turned into dust. And the master of Tao Palace was forcibly subjected to soul-searching.]
[It is said that people who practice the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture have a means left by Emperor Tao Tian. Once a strong man searches their souls, the memory of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture will automatically be destroyed. However, the purpose of this terrifying strong man was not the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, but to see if he could find a way to control the Emperor Force.]
[However, this terrifying strong man was obviously disappointed and did not find a way to control the Emperor Force. But having taken action, he had to push things to the extreme. Otherwise, he would be retaliated against by the Emperor Force of Tao Tian.]
[For this reason, he took action again, joining forces with the extraterritorial master to deal with the ancestor of Tao Palace who wielded the Emperor Force. If he were to confront the ancestor of Tao Palace alone, he would naturally not dare to face the Emperor Force for too long, and would definitely be killed if the fight dragged on.]
[But since there were others to distract the ancestor, it became easier, and he would be able to significantly influence the course of the battle.]
[You saw this scene, sighed, and knew that no matter whether the ancestor wielding the Emperor Force of Tao Tian could turn the tide and kill the two, Tao Palace was completely finished this time. A million years of inheritance and an immortal Great Sect was destroyed.]
[In the end, with the mournful roar of the ancestor who held the Tao Palace, he perished and was thoroughly killed. The Emperor Force of Tao Tian also went completely berserk.]
[However, because of the restraint and suppression of the Emperor Force, even though the spirit of the Tao Tian Emperor Force was enraged, there was nothing it could do. It could only be jointly suppressed and temporarily sealed away, banished to the Endless Starry Sky.]
[Although, even with the help of the Emperor Force, the two people could not suppress and seal the Tao Tian Emperor Force, and it would eventually break the seal. But there was enough time for them to escape. By the time the Emperor Force became angry again, it could only be powerless and furious.]
[With this, the terrifying battle came to an end, and you sighed for what had happened to Tao Palace. You thought of the Master of Tao Palace’s cultivation of you in the past and felt that it was necessary to avenge him once you had grown stronger.]
[Of course, this was just a simulation. If you could do it, you should do it. If it happened in reality, you’d have to avoid the situation of Tao Palace being destroyed.]
[Next, you planned to continue your cultivation and not leave seclusion until you reached the God Monarch Realm. However, something you were helpless about happened.]
[Because you were directly found by Ruo Lan, the predecessor ransmigrator, and killed. No matter how many talents you had, you were left with no choice but to be suppressed.]
[Whether it was the Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet, the Purple Talent – Fate Connection, or the Rebirth tally, they only gave you a few more lives. But with the way the predecessor ransmigrators of the Second-Generation Chat Group acted, you still had no way to survive. For an enemy like you, finishing you off and camping to prevent you from resurrecting were basic moves.]
[Knowing what was in store, you chose to quit the simulation state of your own accord.]
[As you actively exited, the simulation ended.]
….
The text simulation came to a halt here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various images and cultivation realizations.
Finally, he saw a figure appearing in the seclusion place and saw ‘himself’ being ruthlessly suppressed by Ruo Lan.
“This Ruo Lan, could it be that she, like Chu Xiao, also got her hands on something like the Heavenly Secret Talisman? Otherwise, how could she find me so easily?”
Wang Ping frowned as he watched this scene.
He had speculated that the Heavenly Secret Talisman was a means used by other predecessor ransmigrators in the All Heavens, but he had also guessed that it was a means of those who could calculate heavenly secrets in this world.
After all, there is the Heavenly Secret Pavilion in the lower realms.
In the Upper Realm, there was also Heavenly Calculation’s Child, who had appeared in the text simulation.
That is to say, as long as one is willing to pay the price, it is quite easy to find a person.
Unless that person has a means of counterattacking or hiding from the heavenly secrets, they can avoid being caught.
“I was originally planning to deliberately raise my cultivation to the 3rd and 4th tier of True Divine Realm and end the simulation, but it seems that I overestimated my survival time.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
It seems that this time, something will definitely happen 1,500 years later, as he was sure to be found and hunted down.
It’s just a matter of whether this time will change or not.
It is estimated that even if it changes, it will only be sooner.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the voice of the system rang out again.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful! Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①.4th tier True Divine Realm cultivation.
②. Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet
③. Demonic Heavenly Stone (the one from Young Master Mo)
④. Random Divine Artifact.”
…
“System, I choose ①.4th tier True Divine Realm cultivation and ②. Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet.”
Wang Ping looked at these reward options and made his decision after thinking about it.
In an instant, Wang Ping felt as if he had acquired a new talent and the method to use it.
In addition, his cultivation began to soar.
2nd tier True Divine Realm!
3rd tier True Divine Realm!
4th tier True Divine Realm!
“Now that I’ve reached the 4th tier True Divine Realm, I’m already in the mid-stage of the True Divine Realm, much stronger than the 1st tier. With my current strength, even if I don’t trigger the critical strike effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, I can still deliver a more powerful blow. Of course, if I do trigger a critical strike, it’ll be even more satisfying.”

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_5
Wang Ping felt the change in his cultivation inside his body and nodded with satisfaction.
Although the 4th tier of the True Divine Realm was nowhere near the previous simulated True Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation, it was most suitable for his current state. It could reduce the cost of Paid Simulation while not being too weak to snatch the Divine Medicine.
“Now, it’s time to search for ancient tombs and gain more cultivation resources.”
After Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, his figure moved, and spatial ripples appeared. He disappeared directly inside the inn.
Before long, Wang Ping arrived at the location of the ancient tomb of the God King Realm powerhouse. With a gentle wave of his hand, he discovered the Great Array and found the concealed space.
Then, Wang Ping used the Space Divine Skills again and easily entered without triggering the Great Array.
Although he could easily break through the array if he wanted to, there was no need.
Once inside, Wang Ping didn’t even bother with the ordinary resources in the small world and went straight to the Stone Coffin, lifting it open.
As Wang Ping lifted the Stone Coffin, the divine consciousness of the tomb’s God King Realm powerhouse was revived, looking at Wang Ping with great surprise.
He thought it was a God Monarch Realm powerhouse who had broken in, but it turned out to be just a True Lord.
“You didn’t trigger my Great Array? Junior, your means are really impressive.”
The tomb’s God King Realm powerhouse noticed the condition of the Great Array and spoke with amazement.
“Senior, it’s my fault for disturbing your slumber. However, I lack cultivation resources. If you are willing to give me something, I’ll leave.”
Wang Ping slightly bowed and spoke politely.
“You’re quite honest. I can give you something, but I’m curious how you got in.”
The divine consciousness of the ancient tomb God King Realm powerhouse spoke with a smile.
“How did I get in?” Wang Ping chuckled softly, mobilized the Space Law, and said, “I’ve had some insight into the Space Law.”
As the God King Realm powerhouse of the ancient tomb had already died and his divine consciousness would soon dissipate once activated, Wang Ping wasn’t worried about him revealing his understanding of the Space Law.
Moreover, Wang Ping had changed his appearance and aura during this visit, so he didn’t need to worry even more.
“Uh…” The God King Realm powerhouse’s divine consciousness felt Wang Ping’s manipulation of the Space Law, and his whole person became dumbfounded.
Good heavens, Space Law, you call this a little insight?
No…
Soon, the divine consciousness of the ancient tomb’s God King Realm powerhouse woke up abruptly, filled with helplessness and a wry smile. His attitude became modest, “I didn’t expect a Saint to reincarnate and come here. I apologize for my rudeness earlier.”
Although he was already dead, his reverence for Saint Realm powerhouses could not be erased.
Not to mention, he also feared that Wang Ping might destroy his corpse, which would be too miserable.
Previously, when he had referred to himself as a senior or using “this seat” in front of Wang Ping, it was undoubtedly disrespectful to the Saint.
Having said that, the ancient tomb God King Realm powerhouse handed over some things he had left behind in his lifetime to Wang Ping.
Wang Ping didn’t say much, accepted the items, and put them into his Storage Space. He then nodded slightly, “Continue your slumber. I have other matters to attend to first.”
Finishing his words, Wang Ping used the Space Divine Skills again and quickly disappeared.
At this, the divine consciousness of the ancient tomb God King Realm powerhouse was left gaping, feeling envious and lost.
In his life, he had not become a Saint, just an ordinary God King Realm powerhouse.
He had not even seen a Saint in his previous life.
Now, after dying, being able to see a Saint, interact with one, and experience the infinite mysteries of the Power of Manas up close, he felt somewhat relieved from his previous regret.
“In the next life, I hope to become a Saint.”
The divine consciousness of the ancient tomb God King Realm powerhouse sighed and dissipated.
…
On Wang Ping’s end, he returned to the inn in White Flame Divine City, intending to continue the simulation.
“System, how much Lower-tier God’s Source do I need for Paid Simulation now?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he asked secretly.
“Ding! The host’s cultivation base has reached the 4th Tier of the True Divine Realm. The required Lower-tier God’s Source for simulation is 300 jin.”
The system’s voice rang out.
This amount made Wang Ping raise his eyebrows slightly.
He thought it wouldn’t be much, after all, from the 1st Tier of the Void Divine Realm to the 1st Tier of the True Divine Realm, it had only increased tenfold.
Now, from the 1st Tier of the True Divine Realm to the 4th Tier of the True Divine Realm, it had reached 300 jin, an increase of three times.
Recalling his previous situation, Wang Ping thoughtfully concluded that the consumption of the Life Simulator’s Paid Simulation seemed not to be a fixed increase, but depended on his current situation.
When he had plenty of resources, the price would be higher.
In addition, when no divine sources were available in the lower world, King and Emperor Artifacts were used as consumption for Paid Simulation.
“Life Simulator, should I say you’re ruthless or considerate to your host?”
Thinking about this, Wang Ping shook his head and muttered softly.
“System, I want to start a Paid Simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and spoke secretly.
Although it was more expensive, Wang Ping had more than 10,000 jin of Lower-tier God’s Source now, enough to simulate more than 30 times. He didn’t particularly care about the price.
Moreover, he could try doubling the resources with Xu Yi’s help and attempt to obtain even more resources later.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Chapter 187: Darkening! Cultivation Improvement_6
“Ding! Consuming 300 jin of lower-tier God’s Source, Life Simulator is activated, and Talent Refresh is in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding! Talent Refresh is successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent·Life and Death Extreme.”
Red Talent·Life and Death Extreme: With this talent, the host’s probability of making a breakthrough at the edge of life and death will become greater. However, the host will become fond of trying to make breakthroughs at the edge of life and death, allowing themselves to surpass their limits and progress even further.
“Here we go, misfortune starts again, huh?”
Wang Ping looked at the newly-refreshed talent and sighed.
This time only one red talent was refreshed.
Although this talent seemed good, it would change his personality, and it was too extreme.
This time, he might cool down quickly.
As expected, with the beginning of the simulation, Wang Ping started his new round of life-risking journey.
Then, several lives couldn’t save Wang Ping’s life, and he ended up losing it directly.
Although the several life-risking adventures forced him to the brink of life and death and enabled him to make some breakthroughs, and let him comprehend saint-level divine powers, this was really unnecessary.
After all, Wang Ping spent most of his time in the previous simulations to improve his cultivation, and he stopped working in the aspect of comprehending and creating his own cultivation skills and divine powers.
Otherwise, as long as he spends more time and shifts his focus, it is only a matter of time before he creates saint-level divine powers.
After all, the comprehension brought by the time-space body is extremely terrifying.
Although it is an incomplete time-space body, it is still terrifying and incomparable to ordinary physiques.
“Ding! Reward Generation is successful. The host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. 5th tier True Divine Realm Cultivation.
②. Red Talent·Life and Death Extreme.
③. Demonic Heavenly Stone (the one owned by Young Master Mo).
④. Random Divine Artifact.”
“System, I choose ③. Demonic Heavenly Stone.”
Wang Ping took a glance at the rewards and made his decision.
“Ding! Reward selection is successful.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt an additional Demonic Heavenly Stone in his storage space, emanating demonic breath.
“Next, I can’t continue with the simulation; I need to take a break. Otherwise, I’m definitely gonna have a string of bad luck again.”
Wang Ping had gained experience and wouldn’t stubbornly continue with the simulation, so he rationally chose to wait for a while before trying again.
…
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
During these three months, Wang Ping didn’t encounter any major events. He just silently cultivated and occasionally completed some group tasks.
Perhaps because Wang Ping and the group members became more powerful, the difficulty of the tasks had increased.
As the difficulty of the tasks increased and the enemies they encountered became stronger, the group points they earned naturally became more.
As a result, everyone had made a fortune in these three months.
As the strongest member and also the one who could share extra dividends, Wang Ping earned even more.
His current group points had reached nearly 250 million.
However, Alpha never told him how many group points or what conditions would be needed for the next optimization of the Life Simulator, so he had no choice but to continue accumulating group points.
At the same time, Wang Ping knew very well that even if Alpha told him how many group points were needed, he probably wouldn’t give him a 90% discount coupon again.
After all, even the last optimization required 100 million group points; the next optimization would require at least 10 billion.
If the 10 billion were discounted to 1 billion, it would definitely be cutting into Alpha’s flesh.
The real question was whether Alpha had the capital to spare 9 billion group points for him.
In any case, Wang Ping felt that all he needed to do was continue to earn group points.
After all, group points were the World Source, and although he didn’t know their other stronger uses yet, the more, the better.
“Ding! Detection of bizarre activity in the world where Luo Weiguo (85) is located. Group Task Publishment: Eliminate Bizarreness. This group task is a mandatory task with 5 participants. Please Acting Group Owner Wang Ping to screen the group members as soon as possible, go to the task world and eliminate the bizarreness.”
Just as Wang Ping had just emerged from his cultivation state, a prompt sound from the chat group system sounded, causing Wang Ping’s eyes to flicker.
“Is it bizarreness again? It seems that this bizarreness is quite tricky; otherwise, they wouldn’t have sent me.”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
After the chat group’s major reform, the battle strength of the group members had skyrocketed.
As a result, some childish bizarrenesses no longer needed him to solve personally.
After all, the combat power of the group members had gone up, and even without his life simulation to predict the future, their Spiritual Sense or Divine Sense could easily sweep the entire planet, find anomalies, and identify the bizarreness.
Only when extremely powerful bizarrenesses appeared did they need Wang Ping to solve them personally.
That kind of bizarreness could not be resolved simply by having power, and naturally, it was not something that other group members could handle.
Intelligence was the most important thing.
Even with intelligence and power, they might not be able to kill that kind of bizarreness.
With this thought, Wang Ping opened the chat group and entered the main chat page.
Wang Ping (66): “This task is definitely challenging. Who wants to participate in the group task?”
Zhang Hu (5): “Old Luo’s world is different from other worlds; the power level is relatively high, so I won’t join the excitement. I’ll only hold you back. This kind of group task needs group members with special golden fingers.”
Chen Yao (71): “Although with Yuanyuan’s help, my group points’ strengthening, and the resources provided by Mr.Wang, I have also become a Quasi-Immortal, but my strength is still not enough… I won’t go.”
Wu Jun (20): “Me, me, me, I must go!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “I’ll go as usual!”
Chen Si (83): “I want to go this time…QAQ.”
Chen Kang (67): “If my sister goes, I’ll go too.”
Liu Mei (15): “I’d like to go, but with so many people signing up, I’ll just pass.”
Qin Tian (77): “Am I really out of place for any tasks now?”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Congratulations, you’ve been successfully eliminated.”
Qin Tian (77): “…”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, let’s have me, Cai Yonglong, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun participate in this group task.”
Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan’s banter and directly confirmed the members for the group task.

chapters.title: Chapter 611: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Mega Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Mega Chapter!)
After deciding on the mission candidates, Wang Ping went through the crossing.
In an instant, Wang Ping’s figure disappeared in the white light.
…
At the same time, in the world where Luo Weiguo was located, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, Chen Kang, and Chen Si all appeared here one after another.
The place where everyone appeared was a luxurious palace with no other idle people.
Obviously, Luo Weiguo’s current situation was not bad either.
“Mr.Wang, you guys are here.”
Luo Weiguo looked at Wang Ping and the others, warmly saying.
“Let’s skip the catching-up since we haven’t seen each other for a long time. The mission is more important, so you should talk about the situation in your world first.”
Wang Ping patted Luo Weiguo’s shoulder and said.
The world Luo Weiguo had crossed into was also a Profound World.
However, it was different from Wang Ping’s world.
This world had no concept of the Upper Realm.
According to Luo Weiguo’s description, the power of the Celestial Realm Masters in this world should be close to the True Divine Realm Masters in Wang Ping’s world.
And the God Realm Strongest above the Celestial Realm were the Deities recognized by heaven and earth, and their combat power was estimated to rival the half-step God Lord Realm and even the God King Realm powerhouse in Wang Ping’s world.
In other words, the power level of this world was quite high.
Of course, this was only high compared to the other worlds Wang Ping had crossed before.
However, if compared with the Upper Realm where Wang Ping was, then it was nothing.
After all, the God Monarch Realm, although it could be called a top powerhouse walking outside in the Last Dharma Age, but if those old monsters were included, then it was really nothing.
If placed in the Golden Age, there was even less to be said, although it was not weak, but it would not be too strong either.
“To be honest, I don’t know what kind of anomaly has occurred in my world, and I don’t know what kind of abnormal situation is around me.”
Luo Weiguo scratched his hair and said helplessly.
“This sudden mission really caught me off guard.”
“It’s okay, you just need to tell us how many God Realm Strongest there are in your world.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said indifferently.
“As for the God Realm Strongest, I only know that there are four on the surface, known as the Four Great Gods, who rule over the four major regions of the God Land. As for whether there are any hidden old monsters, I don’t really know.”
“Four, huh.”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment.
Four existences comparable to the God Monarch Realm were quite challenging.
Although with his current cultivation, using Space Law, Sacred Artifact and Talent, it was not difficult to kill a God Monarch, but four were still too many.
Not to mention, there might still be hidden God Realm Strongest.
Of course, he also had Chen Si, Chen Kang, Cai Yonglong, and Luo Weiguo as backup players here.
Control, defense, weakness, healing, all are available, so it shouldn’t be too difficult to handle the Four Great God Realm Strongest at once.
But the most troublesome thing was still the weirdness.
“It seems that it’s difficult to force out the weirdness by directly destroying the world through the previous methods. In that case, we can only slowly search for it after a long absence. Of course, before that, we can first test the strength of those four Gods. If we can kill them, we can directly force out the weirdness in a more brutal way.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Then I’ll leave it to Mr. Wang.”
Luo Weiguo nodded his head.
Cai Yonglong and the others all watched without saying much.
With Mr. Wang present, they only needed to be backup players and be transparent, without even needing to speak.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment before saying in his heart.
“Oh, by the way, after the simulation starts in the future, just go directly into the Text Simulation state.”
“Ding, life simulation started, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt a shimmer of consciousness, entering the immersive simulation state.
Soon, the luminescent screen appeared and the text appeared.
[On the first day, you chose to take action. Although with the effect of the Purple Talent·Aura Concealment, Secret Skill, and your mastery of Space, it would be easy for you to sneak attack and kill a God King Realm powerhouse, but you didn’t do that.]
[This time, you just want to make a big noise to see if you can lure the snake out of its hole and get information. For this reason, you had a great battle with the Eastern God. The terrifying battle fluctuations attracted the attention of the Southern God, Northern Lord, and Western Lord, who quickly arrived here and saw you about to kill the Eastern God.]
[Because of this, the Three Great Gods were furious. After all, they could see that your power didn’t belong to this world and came from extraterritorial. That is, you were an enemy of this world.]
[Since they were dealing with extraterritorial comers, the Four Great Gods naturally discarded their differences and joined forces against you.]
[Facing the siege of the Four Great Gods, you also felt tremendous pressure. Because these four gods were not weak, they were stronger than what Luo Weiguo described, not only half-step God Lord Realm or Divine Monarch Realm 1st tier, but rather equivalent to Divine Monarch Realm 2nd tier, not weaker than the Divine Monarch Realm 2nd tier powerhouse you faced in the previous simulation, but even stronger.]
[At that time, although you didn’t use the law, you were fighting with the True Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation. Therefore, your current combat power, although using the law, was not much stronger than when you fought with the True Divine Realm Great Perfection cultivation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 612: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _2
[At the same time, facing so many powerful beings, you relied on the agility of the Space Law to avoid being killed. However, you remained calm and had Chen Kang use his binding ability to directly restrain the injured Eastern God. Then, you directly killed him.]
[This angered the remaining three great gods, causing them to unleash even fiercer attacks. However, you remained fearless and had Chen Si weaken the Southern God, who only had the god realm second cultivation level, allowing you to execute your most terrifying Divine Skill on him. This time, you were fortunate enough to trigger the critical strike effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, directly killing him as well.]
[It was at the very moment when you killed the Southern God, that the Western Lord and Northern Lord’s attacks were about to strike you. However, upon your command, Cai Yonglong instantly used his power, granting you invincible defense status.]
[As a result, you didn’t suffer any damage. Relying on your invincible defense, you used life-risking tactics and once again triggered the critical strike effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade. Consequently, the Western Lord was killed by you, leaving only the Northern Lord who continued to bitterly fight against you.]
[At that moment, the invincible defense effect disappeared. Having consecutively killed three of the great gods, your strength has been greatly depleted, making it impossible to defeat the strongest Northern Lord in a short time.]
[It was at this point that a powerful and evil divine realm presence emerged.]
[Just as he appeared, you felt a sharp pain in your body, as if your soul had been torn apart, and your body crumbled into countless pieces, leading to your death.]
[Following your death, you did not resurrect, and the simulation thus ends…]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with images that eventually settled on the sky as the perspective shifted.
Wang Ping saw the evil divine realm expert who appeared in the end.
“Is he the mysterious one?”
Wang Ping looked at the evil divine realm expert with some surprise, not expecting the mysterious one to be lured out so quickly.
“No, there’s only a 50% chance he is the mysterious one.”
Soon after, Wang Ping frowned and analyzed inwardly.
He noticed that when the Wang Ping in the simulation died, the evil divine realm expert revealed an astonished expression.
If he was indeed the mysterious one, he shouldn’t have been surprised at all.
Unless it was a disguise.
But, would he need to disguise?
So, Wang Ping believed that there was only a 50% chance that the evil divine realm expert was the mysterious one.
As Wang Ping was thinking, he also exited the immersive simulation state and returned to the real world.
“Mr.Wang, how did it go?” Cai Yonglong asked curiously.
“Old Luo, the gods in your world are quite powerful.”
Wang Ping didn’t immediately answer Cai Yonglong’s question, but instead looked at Luo Weiguo and said with a smile.
“Uh.” Luo Weiguo was taken aback, scratched his head, and cautiously said, “Are they stronger than I described?”
“Yes, they are somewhat stronger. It’s not as simple as being a half-step God Lord Realm. Of course, it’s completely normal for you to make an incorrect judgment since you’ve only heard me casually mention the God Monarch Realm before.”
Wang Ping patted Luo Weiguo on the shoulder and said this.
Then, Wang Ping briefly recounted the content of the simulation.
“Uh, the god realm is able to rival the God Monarch Realm’s second level? I really underestimated the intensity of my world.”
After Wang Ping spoke, Luo Weiguo scratched his head and smiled bitterly.
“Mr.Wang, you suspect that the evil divine realm expert isn’t the mysterious one?”
Cai Yonglong immediately understood Wang Ping’s intentions.
“I do have some doubts. But, whether or not he is the mysterious one can be known after another probe. What I’m puzzled about is why I suddenly died completely.”
Wang Ping nodded and said with a solemn expression.
It was a mystery how his soul was suddenly torn apart and his body crumbled into countless pieces.
As for his complete death and the failure of all resurrection methods, he didn’t care.
After all, this was the mysterious one, and it was normal for him to have a completely deadly ability at the same level as Lin Yuanyuan.
But if the cause of death remains unknown, it would be too dangerous.
“There’s too little information to deduce it.”
“However, Mr.Wang, I think that since he used his ability, it must be because he noticed you. In that case, can we try to fight in a closed environment? If he can’t use his ability, it might indicate that his ability activation condition might be something like staring.”
Wu Jun frowned and said.
“Staring would make the time too long. According to Mr.Wang’s description, he has been fighting the four gods for quite some time, so the mysterious one might have used his ability a long time ago. Besides, with Mr.Wang’s cultivation, it is impossible not to notice a peeper who’s been watching for a long time.”
Cai Yonglong disagreed and didn’t believe that the ability would activate through staring.
“I have a guess.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and said.
“What’s your guess?”
Everyone looked at him curiously.
“You all should be familiar with the Strings puppet, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 613: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
Wang Ping swept his gaze over everyone and slowly began to speak.
“Strings puppet? There are many novels, animations, and movies about this kind of thing… Mr. Wang, you mean…”
Chen Kang raised an eyebrow and quickly caught on.
“Exactly. Strings puppets, cursed dolls and such are quite common in some works. As long as you obtain someone’s hair, blood, or other tissues, you can activate the ability. Then, if you destroy the puppet or the doll, the target will suffer the same damage.”
Wang Ping held up a finger and spoke slowly.
“I have my suspicions that this strange ability is similar. However, its ability is more advanced, as it can even destroy souls, causing the target to die completely and be unable to resurrect.”
“Now that you mention it, it does make sense. Mr. Wang, during your battle with the Four Great Gods, you were also injured. The strange creature could have come during the battle and found your blood or body tissue, allowing it to activate the ability.”
Cai Yonglong spoke up, his eyes brightening.
“At the same time, if we can deduce from this angle that it took the strange creature such a long time to find your blood or other tissues and activate its ability, then it implies that its power is not that high. If it were strong enough, it wouldn’t be so cautious, afraid of being discovered or killed by the aftermath.”
“Exactly.”
Wang Ping nodded with a smile.
“Of course, whether our speculations are correct or not, we still need to continue confirming through Golden finger.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping continued to speak.
Having said that, Wang Ping closed his eyes.
Seeing this, the others also quietly shut their mouths.
“System, I want to start a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping entered the simulation state. The luminescent screen appeared, and the words floated up.
[On the first day, you began your action. This time, like your first simulation, you deliberately attacked the Eastern God, exposing your whereabouts, and started the battle.]
[The process of the battle was replicated as it was in your last simulation. However, this time, unlike your first simulation, you activated the Great Array in advance and did not allow your blood and body tissues to scatter beyond a certain range.]
[During this process, you easily killed the Eastern God, just as in your last simulation, then successively killed the Southern and Western Gods, and battled the Northern God.]
[The Evil Lord appeared once again. However, when this Evil Lord appeared and joined the battlefield to fight against you alongside the Northern God, you did not suddenly die.]
[This made you realize that your previous guess was probably correct. You just don’t know whether this strange ability is as you speculated.]
[Next, you continued to fight against the Evil Lord Realm Master and the Northern God. However, this time, since you used up all your hidden cards, you were at a disadvantage when fighting against the two.]
[Just as you were pushing the two back and considering whether or not to use the Purple Talent·Death Puppet, the Evil Lord Realm Master suddenly stabbed the Northern God in the heart from behind and began to devour his source of power.]
[This enraged the Northern God. Although they always wanted to get rid of this Evil Lord, they could never catch him, and the enmity between them was deep. However, he never expected that the other party would stab him in the heart at this time instead of joining forces to deal with the People from Outside the Domain.]
[With a sinister laugh, the Evil Lord Realm Master said that you had no reason to trust him if he didn’t stand beside you in battle. Then, the Evil Lord Realm Master claimed that if he hadn’t taken action, the Northern God might have already been killed by Wang Ping, so this was a life the Northern God owed him.]
[It was during the Evil Lord Realm Master devouring the Northern God’s source of power that you went for an attack without hesitation, not giving him the opportunity to absorb power and improve his combat strength.]
[The Evil Lord Realm Master was obviously prepared for this and directly squeezed out a treasure to block your attack. Terrifying dark energy spread out. It was at this moment that the Evil Lord finished devouring the Northern God, and his strength was increased, reaching a fighting power equivalent to that of a Divine Monarch Realm 3rd tier.]
[Next, the Evil Lord said that if he killed you, he could devour your source of power as well as the sources of the other three Great Gods you killed, making him even stronger and completely ruling this world.]
[You were fearless, and continued to fight him. However, because the Evil Lord’s power had increased, even you could not directly contend with him. But, as you were proficient in Space Law and Space Divine Skills, he couldn’t do anything to you.]
[This infuriated him. At this point, you decided to use the Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet and bind the Evil Lord. Then, you began to hurt yourself. As you swung your sword at yourself, the Evil Lord started bleeding.]
[This left the Evil Lord stunned, showing an incredulous expression and not knowing how you did it.]
[After you calmly explained the general effect of Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet, you told the Evil Lord to listen to you honestly, or he could just die. This twisted the Evil Lord’s face, and he gritted his teeth and attacked you again, not believing your words.]

chapters.title: Chapter 614: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
[However, after you started to hurt yourself again and the damage was transferred to the Evil Lord Realm Master, he went silent, terrified to the extreme.]
[Cai Yonglong and the others were also stunned upon witnessing this scene. This ability was too powerful! And it was exactly what they had discussed earlier as the bizarre ability. It made them question who was truly bizarre.]
[Afterwards, the Evil Lord Realm Master chose to kneel down and beg for mercy, submitting to you. As a lord realm master, he didn’t want to die like this. Seeing him become obedient, you were very satisfied.]
[Then, you had the Evil Lord Realm Master disguised as yourself, acting on your behalf and leaving bloodstains.]
[He didn’t know the purpose of your actions, but after his expression changed, he still chose to obey, transforming into your appearance and aura and carrying out his actions.]
[As for you, you hid in the space and followed closely, observing everything.]
[Soon, the Evil Lord Realm Master’s expression suddenly froze, his soul was destroyed, and his body was reduced to pieces. You, hiding in space, sensed all of this and quickly locked onto a target.]
[It was a woman with Celestial Realm Cultivation. In her hand, she held a cursed doll with a silver needle piercing its forehead, shattered into pieces. Clearly, your guess was correct – this was Bizarre’s ability.]
[As soon as you had locked onto your target, you took action and easily killed Bizarre.]
[With Bizarre’s death, the task completion notice reached you. After completing the task, you chose to leave this world.]
…..
The text simulation ended there, and images filled Wang Ping’s mind.
In the end, his vision returned to the real world.
“Unexpectedly smooth. However, Bizarre’s strength is great; their ability is also powerful. Without the Life Simulator, it is very dangerous for other group members to face her. Moreover, this world is hostile to outsiders, which is another problem.”
After exhaling lightly, Wang Ping made his assessment.
“Mr.Wang, how’s it going?”
Cai Yonglong asked curiously.
“Very smooth.”
Wang Ping chuckled and told them the content of the simulation.
When everyone heard about the content of the simulation, they were amazed. Wang Ping had guessed Bizarre’s ability straight away.
Not to mention, this time it was unexpectedly smooth.
After all, previous Bizarre cases required Wang Ping’s intervention and were always troublesome.
“I can only say, Mr.Wang is too strong now.”
Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but sigh.
“Don’t sigh here. Let’s act immediately, find Bizarre, kill her, and leave this world.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes and said.
“Right.”
Cai Yonglong scratched his head.
Next, Wang Ping started to act.
Because Bizarre had possessed a Celestial Realm Master, Wang Ping easily found her.
After all, Celestial Realm Masters are not small characters, their numbers are limited, making it easy to find them.
As soon as Wang Ping found Bizarre, he didn’t give her a chance to react. He hid in the space and killed her with a single strike.
“Ding, Bizarre has been annihilated, the group task is complete, all group members please return to your own world within three days.”
As Bizarre was killed, the chat group system’s voice rang out.
“System, return.”
Wang Ping didn’t intend to go back to Cai Yonglong and the others; he chose to return directly.
After all, there was nothing to miss for him in this world.
Of course, this world’s resources were far inferior to those of the Last Dharma’s Elemental Star.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would have considered collecting some resources to see if they could help him.
But since the resources were average, there was no need to waste time collecting them; better leave them for Luo Weiguo of this world.
…..
As Wang Ping returned, he was wrapped in white light and disappeared.
When his consciousness became clear again, he had returned to the Divine City Inn in the Upper Realm.
“I wonder how many group points this Bizarre is worth.”
Wang Ping silently opened the chat group, checking his group task red packet rewards.
“Ding, your contribution value for this group task is 98%, and you can receive a reward of 30 million group points.”
The system’s voice sounded, causing Wang Ping to be slightly stunned.
“Only 30 million? It’s much less than the Bizarre who possessed the Light Lord God.”
Wang Ping frowned and muttered.
The Bizarre that possessed the Light Lord God was worth 150 million group points, while this one was worth only 30 million, which was too little.
“The case of the Bizarre who possessed the Light Lord God was special. That world was destroyed, but obtained World Source afterward, so it gave you more group points.”
Alpha reminded him.
“True.”
Wang Ping remembered this and didn’t dwell on it.
Let it be 30 million.
Although it was still a long way from the 100 billion group points he aimed for, every little bit counts.
“Next, let’s continue with the Paid Simulation. The more talent refreshes, the stronger we are; that’s the essence of it.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, collected his thoughts, and spoke at the bottom of his heart.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 615: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Major Chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Major Chapter!)_5
“Ding, consuming three hundred kilos of Lower-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Golden Talent: Evil of This World and Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.”
Golden Talent: Evil of This World – With this talent, the host will become incredibly evil. At the same time, they can also become stronger by absorbing negative thoughts and emotions. Their cultivation, as well as physical strength, will rapidly improve.
Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique – With this talent, the host will gain certain aptitude in the Ice Path.
“Huh, a second Golden Talent?”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents, blinked, and was somewhat surprised.
“However, it’s not a positive one but a Golden Talent with extremely severe side effects. That means its power might exceed the level of Golden Talents.”
Wang Ping looked at the introduction of this talent, his eyes flickering.
This talent was outrageous at first glance.
I just don’t know how far I can go in this simulation after possessing this talent and how many secrets of this world can be uncovered.
“System, I choose the Golden Talent: Evil of This World.”
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and then he made his decision without hesitation.
The Ice Profound Physique was worthless to him right now.
Although this evaluation seemed rather unfriendly to Ji Bingyue, who possessed Ice Profound Physique.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation starting….”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, knowing he had entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[First person, influenced by the Golden Talent: Evil of This World, you’ve become extremely evil and start plotting how to bring disaster to the Primordial Star to become more powerful.]
[After some thinking, you plan to do many things. But, instead of immediately making a mess, you decide to wait for the Great Saint Secret Realm to open, seize the Divine Medicine, and enhance your strength enough to calmly escape from a Semi-saint before causing trouble.]
[In a blink of an eye, the day when the Great Saint Secret Realm opens arrives. During these years, even though you didn’t stir up trouble, there were already plenty of evil thoughts and negative emotions on the Primordial Star, with no need for you to provoke them deliberately.]
[As a result, you easily enhanced your cultivation to the half-step God Lord Realm. In just about a hundred years, your cultivation skyrocketed to this level without actually doing much. It’s unbelievably terrifying.]
[However, due to the influence of this talent, your evil thoughts have become more frightening, turning you into an extremely evil person, and it is getting harder to suppress. At this point, you realize the horror of this talent. If you continue like this, you will become no longer yourself, your personality will turn purely evil, only leaving your instincts to commit evil.]
[However, even if you want to stop, you can’t. You can only grow stronger and become pure evil without stopping. You’re terrified and afraid of losing your personality in that way.]
[After thinking about it, you believe that Entering Saint may be able to suppress the terrifying evil thoughts to some extent. Therefore, you still plan to enter the secret realm and seize the Divine Medicine.]
[This time, you still participate in the great battle. Yet, you are overly ferocious and trigger the Purple Talent: Endless Blade effect by sneak attacking, killing the Divine Monarch Realm Great Perfection Expert of the Zhang family and shocking everyone.]
[After killing the God King Realm Expert of the Zhang family, you become stronger again due to his negative emotions upon death. You instantly break through to the God Monarch Realm, shocking everyone again.]
[Terrifying Heavenly Tribulation descends. This time, it’s not an ordinary Heavenly Tribulation but a Blood Heavenly Tribulation. The arrival of Heavenly Tribulation scares all powerful beings away, fearing being affected.]
[Furthermore, the Great Saint Secret Realm is considered an obstacle and is directly bombarded by Heavenly Tribulation. You struggle to resist the Heavenly Tribulation. This mutated Heavenly Tribulation, seemingly to kill your evil existence, is too terrifying, even hard for you to defend against.]
[Still, you have astonishing means and manage to use the Purple Talent: Substitute Puppet to bind a Peak of God King Realm powerhouse and make him take a fatal injury for you, enduring the Heavenly Tribulation somehow.]
[In this way, you become a God King Realm powerhouse. After breaking through to the God Monarch Realm, your evil thoughts intensify further, losing most of your personality, and you laugh wildly as you kill the other God King Realm powerhouses in the Great Saint Secret Realm.]
[Unrivaled, the God Monarch Realm you are an unstoppable existence. Other God King Realm powerhouses are like mere chickens to you and get easily killed. As you kill more people, the accumulation of negative emotions and evil thoughts intensifies, making you stronger.]
[After slaughtering that group of people, you once again kill your way to the outer world. You spread terror, unleashing endless malice. The hidden effect of the Golden Talent: Evil of This World appears, and in areas covered by your evil, everyone goes crazy and starts fighting each other.]
[Even the Peak of God King Realm powerhouses can’t escape. When covered by the evil domain, they also fall into madness, dominated by evil thoughts. Even Semi-saints are affected and can only suppress the evil thoughts with all their might.]

chapters.title: Chapter 616: 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Chapter 188: The Third Golden Talent! Terrifying Growth Speed (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
[In just half of the Elemental Ancient Star, everything became a mess, with a rapidly expanding trend. And your cultivation has soared rapidly in this process, effortlessly rising from the initial entry into the God Monarch Realm to the Great Perfection Tier of the God Monarch Realm.]
…..
“This Golden Talent: Evil of This World, is really fierce…..”
Wang Ping was shocked as he looked at the contents of this text simulation.
Damn, how difficult it was for him to cultivate in the Last Dharma Age.
Even with the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, his cultivation was still so difficult, let alone others.
However, after possessing this Golden Talent: Evil of This World, and under some restrictive situations, his cultivation still skyrocketed.
In just a hundred years, it soared directly to the half-step God Lord Realm.
After starting to kill people in the secret realm, it soared to the Peak of the God Monarch Realm in a short period of time.
Besides, that Evil Intent-concealed domain was so terrifying that even those at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm would fall into their evil thoughts, and even a Semi-saint could just barely hold on.
“This Golden Talent: Evil of This World is simply terrifying. If it grows unchecked, it could absolutely affect the entire Upper Realm, becoming a super big boss. Unfortunately, this talent has a terrifying side effect, directly losing humanity and becoming pure evil. In the end, it will inevitably attract the attention of the real old monsters and be killed on the spot.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, and couldn’t help but sigh, seeing the ending.
Although a monster without reason is terrifying, it is not difficult to eliminate it as long as one has strong enough power.
It’s just that the growth of this Golden Talent: Evil of This World is definitely at an exceptional level, even stronger than many bizarre abilities.
But its drawbacks are also too obvious.
Perhaps it is because of these drawbacks that it is a golden talent, rather than a talent of a higher level.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the text simulation continued to emerge.
[The abnormal condition of the Elemental Ancient Star finally attracted the attention of the old monsters, who saw the danger you posed. As a result, a saint appeared. An old saint appeared, wishing to suppress you.]
[However, even the saint was affected by the evil thoughts, and had to suppress his own evil thoughts while battling with you. And you, with cultivation at the Great Perfection Tier of the God Monarch Realm, had an equally powerful physical body, plus practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and your spatial laws and Space Divine Skills were extremely powerful.]
[In such a situation, you actually managed to survive in the hands of the saint. Although you were still being beaten, the old saint could not kill you either. And your strength continued to grow rapidly.]
[At this rate, the old saint will sooner or later be killed by you, or be corroded by evil thoughts.]
[This scene shook the other old monsters. They too could no longer sit still and wanted to emerge together to suppress you.]
[But just as they prepared to show themselves, an even more terrifying being took action. The terrifying strong one who had originally sent the Emperor Force of Tao Tian flying and refined you had been paying attention to you all along. When you experienced the blood-red Heavenly Tribulation, he had discovered your anomaly.]
[You possessed a Space-Time Dao Body, but the evil aura from your body made him hesitate, so he was torn whether to capture and refine you. However, the danger you showed now was too terrifying. Even if he did not refine you, he had to kill you to prevent you from endangering him.]
[With the intervention of this terrifying strong being, you were easily killed outright.]
[Although you were killed, you resurrected again due to the Rebirth Tally. However, resurrection was useless, you were killed again.]
[Due to your death, the simulation is over.]
…..
When the text simulation stopped here, Wang Ping’s mind was also filled with one scene after another.
Even thescenes made Wang Ping feel like he was being infected by the evil intent, but the feeling was not strong.
Fortunately, this was an optimized life simulator, otherwise it would have caused serious trouble.
This evil intent was a bit too terrifying.
After a long time, Wang Ping disconnected from the scenes, saw the scene of the simulated Wang Ping being killed, and then exited the immersive simulation state, gasping heavily and agitated.
“Evil of This World, this talent, absolutely can’t be touched.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
Although he had always been avoiding talents with strong side effects, this Golden Talent was too terrifying and had an inexplicable allure, so he must be vigilant.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Perfect Mastery of God Monarch Realm (Power gained from Evil of This World, choose carefully).
②. Golden Talent: Evil of This World.
③. a Random Saint Artifact.
④. Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.”
…..
“It seems that this time the reward can only be the Saint Artifact.”
Wang Ping shook his head helplessly after looking at the rewards list.
This time there was a Golden Talent. It was invigorating during the simulation, the growth rate was unbeatable, but it didn’t reveal the future developments as he had expected, or reveal many hidden aspects. It was really a pity.
It’s just that the drawbacks were too obvious, and he died too quickly.
Of course, he did learn one piece of information.
That is, that terrifying strong one is hiding on the Elemental Ancient Star at this point in time.
“This guy is really an old schemer. He is so strong, and yet he lurks.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but curse secretly.
“You’re obviously even more scheming. You have the nerve to talk about others.”
Alpha’s voice suddenly rang out.
“Cough cough…” Wang Ping coughed lightly, feeling a little embarrassed.
Well, he was indeed more scheming.
“System, I choose ③. a Random Saint Artifact.”
Wang Ping said in his heart, shifting the topic.
“Ding, reward selection successful…”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt a saint artifact appear in his storage space.
This saint artifact was a white robe, obviously a defensive type of saint artifact.
With two saint artifacts on his body, not many Saints in the world were as luxurious as him.
After all, most Saints only had one saint artifact, and couldn’t compare to him, a True Lord.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme
“Next, System, continue with the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping shook his head and muttered.
To be honest, the Golden Talent: Evil of This World didn’t achieve the effect he wanted, which was quite a pity.
And this time, it consumed quite a bit of his luck. He even doubted whether he would have to continue being unlucky.
“Ding, consuming three hundred kilos of Lower-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing in progress ….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Purple Talent: Unstable Luck; Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.”
Purple Talent · Unstable Luck: With this talent, the host’s luck will fluctuate. At its highest, it can be compared to some era protagonists, and at its lowest, it may become cannon fodder.
Red Talent · Ice Profound Physique: …
“This Purple Talent: Unstable Luck is quite interesting.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, somewhat surprised.
It was another special type of talent whose upper limit exceeded its tier.
Of course, the lower limit was a pitfall.
Back then, Wang Ping trusted the Red Talent: Unstable Evolver so much, but it turned out to be rubbish, not having much effect at all.
Up till now, the Red Talent: Unstable Evolver has not been triggered at all.
After all, the higher the level of items it comes into contact with, the harder it is to trigger, and even if it does, the success rate will be pathetically low.
It can be said that this talent has been completely eliminated.
“I just don’t know if this Purple Talent: Unstable Luck can give me a surprise. Of course, even if it surprises me, I don’t think I’d dare to choose it as a reward. Unstable things are too risky, who knows if it will lead me to my doom.”
“System, I choose the Purple Talent: Unstable Luck.”
Wang Ping muttered and made his choice. As for the Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique, although its talent kept refreshing and always seemed to want to show its existence, he still had no interest in taking a closer look.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
As the system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping felt a flicker of consciousness, entering an immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged.
[Day One: You decided to go to the Whiteflame Divine Sect to build a relationship with Lin Qinghe, intending to reveal the truth after building the relationship and help Lin Qinghe escape from misery.]
[In a blink of an eye, nearly a hundred years have passed. During these hundred years, your luck hasn’t changed much, making you doubt whether the Purple Talent · Unstable Luck has failed.]
[Of course, you think it’s unlikely that the Purple Talent · Unstable Luck has failed. The high probability is that you’ve been hiding in the Whiteflame Divine Sect all this time, lacking the conditions to trigger it.]
[After all, even the Dao of Luck requires some logic, unless the luck is horrendously extreme. It’s impossible that you do nothing, hiding in obscurity, and countless opportunities come knocking, or have luck plummet but inexplicably an enemy comes to kill you without the conditions to do so.]
[Although these two situations can still happen in extreme cases, the probability of them happening is relatively small.]
[After the opening of the Great Saint Secret Realm, you sprang into action. This time, even without triggering the Purple Talent · Endless Blade effect, you easily seized Divine Medicine and calmly left.]
[After leaving the Great Saint Secret Realm, you returned to the Whiteflame Divine Sect and continued cultivation, meanwhile, continuing to teach Lin Qinghe and cultivate your relationship. Gradually, Lin Qinghe began to regard you as a mentor and admired you greatly.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a thousand years have passed. With the help of Divine Medicine, your cultivation has quietly improved to the half-step God Lord Realm. At this level, you are no longer afraid of cultivators below Semi-saint. Even facing the monstrous God King Realm powerhouses, you can still easily leave by relying on Space Law.]
[As a result, you feel the timing is right, and you begin to take action. You directly confront Lin Qinghe’s mentor, imprisoning her cultivation and forcing her to speak the truth of that year. Lin Qinghe is astonished and finds it hard to believe.]
[However, when you forcefully install the memory of Lin Qinghe’s mentor into her mind, Lin Qinghe falls silent, feeling somewhat broken.]
[At this point, she experiences the treachery of human nature and asks you why you want to help her and for what purpose you approached her.]
[In response, you give the answer that you accidentally discovered Lin Qinghe had the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, so you wanted to observe whether she could cause trouble in the world before deciding to cultivate or kill her in advance. But after so many years of company, you find that Lin Qinghe is not evil and genuinely treat her as a disciple.]
[Regarding Lin Qinghe’s background issue, you only accidentally learned about it and want her to see the true face of the Whiteflame Divine Sect.]
[Upon hearing your answer, Lin Qinghe is shocked, not realizing the truth about her Devouring Immortal Demon Body had already been exposed. Then, she is moved and her admiration for you grows uncontrollably, regarding you as her only support.]
[In the end, Lin Qinghe kills her mentor. And you help Lin Qinghe annihilate the Whiteflame Divine Sect. After taking the resources of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, you both leave. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 618: 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_2
[When the news of the overnight annihilation of the Whiteflame Divine Sect began to spread, the entire Inner Region was shocked, and even the forces of the Middle Area were somewhat astonished. After all, although the Whiteflame Divine Sect was not particularly strong, it was still a force with a God King Realm powerhouse in charge of it, yet it had been quietly eradicated in a single night.]
[To wipe out the Whiteflame Divine Sect overnight would require a strength of at least the 7th tier of the God Monarch Realm. Such cultivation was rare in the Elemental Star nowadays.]
[In the blink of an eye, a period of time had passed, and you also recalled that Ji Bingyan was going to ascend. Therefore, you stayed at the ascension site, wanting to take her away. However, even after having agents watching for decades, no sign of Ji Bingyan ascending to the Upper Realm was found.]
[This raised a question in your mind: did Ji Bingyan not ascend to the Upper Realm? Or did something happen during her ascension, causing her to die in the ascension passage, or was she taken away by someone from the Jee family?]
[Although you were puzzled, you didn’t pay too much attention to it. After all, although you wanted to look after Ji Bingyan, that was not your primary goal in this Text Simulation.]
[In the blink of an eye, more than five hundred years had passed. During these five hundred years, you had been cultivating Lin Qinghe. With your help, Lin Qinghe, who had accepted his Devouring Immortal Demon Body, also reached the level of the God Monarch Realm.]
[Meanwhile, on the Elemental Star, you had also established a reputation as a Demon-hunting God Monarch. Although you were only at the half-step God Lord Realm, you were able to exhibit enough power to slay Demonic Cultivators and Evil Cultivators at the God Monarch Realm, making you incomparably strong. And because you only hunted down demons and heretics, many cultivators praised you.]
[However, you did not care about these false reputations and continued to cultivate Lin Qinghe. As for yourself, during these years, you also triggered the effects of your Purple Talent·Unstable Luck, becoming extremely fortunate and obtaining an Incomplete Map which recorded the Emperor Scripture.]
[Besides, you also had very unlucky experiences, nearly dying for no reason. It has to be said that this Purple Talent·Unstable Luck has both risks and rewards. This is also the reason why you would never choose this talent in reality.]
[Soon after, you calculated the time and learned that Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator, would join forces with a saint from Slaughter Paradise and come to the Elemental Star to kill you.]
[To this end, you chose to descend to the lower realm again, hoping to use the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s life-bound weapon, the Black Abyss Demon Spear, to counter-attack. After arriving at the lower realm, you went to the Primordial Forbidden Land.]
[When you arrived at the Primordial Forbidden Land, you used the key synthesized from another Demonic Heavenly Stone obtained from the Green Spirit Divine Sect Ancestor to unlock the seal of the Black Abyss Demon Spear. When you thought that you could subdue the Supreme Artifact, the Black Abyss Demon Spear, after unsealing it, the result left you in silence.]
[Because the Black Abyss Demon Spear did not submit to you, instead, the moment it saw Lin Qinghe, it willingly submitted to him. Clearly, the Black Abyss Demon Spear recognized that Lin Qinghe possesses the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[This scene made your face twitch and left you speechless. You knew that if Lin Qinghe was present, the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord was likely out of your reach and most probably meant for Lin Qinghe.]
[Of course, through normal development, you doubted whether the Black Abyss Demon Spear and the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord were originally prepared for Lin Qinghe, who had the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and great luck.]
[Regarding this, you felt somewhat helpless but didn’t dwell on it too much. After all, your purpose for this trip was to find a way to deal with the two saints.]
[Next, you contemplated whether to return to the Upper Realm-then let Lin Qinghe, with the power of the Supreme Artifact, contend against Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator, and the saint from Slaughter Paradise.]
[As for returning to the Upper Realm, you were somewhat hesitant. After all, the Black Abyss Demon Spear was an extremely valuable Supreme Artifact. Once it was exposed, it might be chased and killed by those hidden old monsters.]
[Moreover, since it was a Demonic Artifact, those old monsters may even suppress Lin Qinghe and you under the guise of righteousness. By then, the fact that Lin Qinghe was a Devouring Immortal Demon Body would probably also be exposed.]
[However, if the battle takes place in the lower realm, it is feared that the entire Purple Spirit Realm would be devastated. After all, not even the Purple Spirit Realm can withstand the power of a Forbidden Artifact, let alone the confrontation between a saint and the Supreme Artifact.]
[By that time, probably even the aftermath would be enough to annihilate the Purple Spirit Realm, leaving nothing behind. This is an absolute certainty. After all, just the Demon Spirit emitted by the Black Abyss Demon Spear destroyed both the Purple Spirit Realm and the Blood Demon Realm, not to mention its actual power when unleashed.]
…..
The Text Simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various scenes and insights from cultivation as his cultivation skyrocketed to the half-step Divinity Realm level.
“Has it reached the branching story?”
Wang Ping scanned his surroundings and thought to himself.
“I’m definitely not going to choose this. After all, going to the Upper Realm would expose me to the old monsters capable of repelling Emperor Force, which would certainly result in death. Although the Purple Talent·Unstable Luck might save me, the probability of triggering it is small, so it’s difficult to rely on.”
After thinking it over, Wang Ping concluded that they must fight in the Lower Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 619: 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_3
Although it feels unfair to the Purple Spirit Realm, this is ultimately a simulation, and since it’s for reconnaissance, he had no other choice.
Now, he just wants to know if Lin Qinghe, wielding the Supreme Artifact, can withstand the two saints.
If he can, then there will be a chance of survival in the future.
If he can’t, then Wang Ping can only think of other ways to break the deadlock.
“System, fast forward,” Wang Ping thought to himself.
[After careful consideration, you chose to confront your enemies in the lower realm. It was during the time when Lin Qinghe took several days to successfully recognize and attempt to unleash the power of the Black Abyss Demon Spear, that two terrifying auras appeared in the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[As soon as they appeared, your expression changed. Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator and the saint from Slaughter Paradise, obviously had no intention of hiding their aura, aiming to annihilate the Purple Spirit Realm and kill you in the process.]
[The aura of the saints was terrifying, something the lower realm could not handle. Even without the saints taking action, the mere pressure killed all living beings in the Purple Spirit Realm, including Ye Xiaofan and Zhang Hu, who had come to this world.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, he survived because you kept him close at hand in case anything went wrong during the Black Abyss Demon Spear’s subjugation.]
[With the destruction of the Purple Spirit Realm, Ruo Lan and the saint from Slaughter Paradise discovered the entrance to the Primordial Forbidden Land and chose to enter it. As soon as they entered, they easily detected your presence.]
[And then, Ruo Lan ordered your execution, directly utilizing the full power of the saints, without any intention of holding back.]
[At this moment, Lin Qinghe’s face turned solemn. He stepped forward and activated the power of the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, blocking the attack. This caused both Ruo Lan and the saint from Slaughter Paradise to reveal surprised expressions before becoming greedy.]
[After all, Supreme Artifacts are extremely precious. If they managed to obtain one, they would have an extraordinarily powerful trump card, capable of battling against higher realms.]
[Ruo Lan scoffed and said that, despite the power of the Supreme Artifact, it was not like an Emperor Force, which could continue to fight independently even after its controller’s death, unleashing the vast majority of its power. Supreme Artifacts, like Sacred Artifacts, also depended on the user’s cultivation to unleash their power.]
[Facing the increasingly aggressive Ruo Lan, Lin Qinghe’s face was cold, stating that killing her would be enough. Then, Lin Qinghe took the initiative to attack, wielding the Black Abyss Demon Spear and aiming to kill the two saints.]
[Facing Lin Qinghe, who held the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, Ruo Lan and the saint from Slaughter Paradise both wore solemn expressions. Although both of them had uttered ruthless words, in reality, they both understood the power of the Supreme Artifact. Even saints had to be cautious, lest they risk perishing.]
[Even though Lin Qinghe, who held the Supreme Artifact, only had a Divine Monarch Realm 3rd Tier cultivation, only able to bring forth a small portion of the Supreme Artifact’s power, it was not something they could easily withstand.]
[However, as saints, their speed, strength, and reaction speed greatly surpassed Lin Qinghe’s. As long as they didn’t face the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear head-on, it wasn’t impossible to fight against it.]
[But Ruo Lan and the saint from Slaughter Paradise clearly underestimated the terror of the Black Abyss Demon Spear. The Black Abyss Demon Spear was not an ordinary Supreme Artifact, but a ferocious Demonic Artifact, and the life-bound magic weapon of the Terrifying Demon Lord who once fought the Green Bamboo Emperor. Thus, its power and spirituality were beyond comparison to ordinary Supreme Artifacts.]
[As a result, when the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear struck, the proud cultivations of Ruo Lan and the saint from Slaughter Paradise were useless, and they were directly sent flying by the range attack. Their saintly bodies exploded, narrowly avoiding complete annihilation.]
[This frightened the two of them immensely. They had greatly underestimated the horror of the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear. Even though Lin Qinghe, who held the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, was just a lowly ant in the Divine Monarch Realm, the power of the Supreme Artifact itself was not something they, as two saints, could resist.]
[As for you, seeing the two saints in such a miserable state, beaten by Lin Qinghe’s Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, you were also astonished. You never expected the Supreme Artifact to be so fierce. At the same time, you lamented once again. This Supreme Artifact that you have coveted for a long time did not fall into your hands, leaving you feeling helpless.]
[At this moment, seeing the situation going awry, the saint from Slaughter Paradise had no intention of risking his life and chose to flee, leaving Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator, behind. This led Ruo Lan to curse in anger. Although their partnership was purely strategic, and it was normal for the other to flee, it didn’t stop her from cursing.]
[Seeing Ruo Lan become furious, you relaxed and teased her, saying she never thought she would become prey someday.]
[In response, Ruo Lan sneered, saying you were celebrating too soon. Immediately, Ruo Lan pulled out an object. When you saw it, your pupils shrank involuntarily.]
[Because this object also emitted the aura of a Supreme Artifact, it was clearly another Supreme Artifact, but it was in a sealed state. At this moment, you knew you were in trouble. At the same time, you also guessed the origin of this Supreme Artifact.]
[Most likely, this was the life-bound weapon of that Predecessor Transmigrator in the Second Generation Chat Group, who had Supreme Realm Cultivation. Otherwise, with Ruo Lan’s ability, it would be highly unlikely for her to obtain a Supreme Artifact. One could say the chances were very slim.]

chapters.title: Chapter 620: 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_4
[This also shows that the transmigrator predecessor, who Alpha said was hibernating in the divine source due to his lifespan, has awakened and is aware of Wang Ping’s situation, and that’s why he lent out his Supreme Artifact.]
[Ruo Lan sneered, saying she originally didn’t want to use the Supreme Artifact, as it would come at a great cost. But since it had come to this point, she had no choice but to use it. As she spoke, the aura of the Supreme Artifact began to spread out, illuminating the entire Primordial Forbidden Land and blocking Lin Qinghe’s attack.]
[With the unsealing of the Supreme Artifacts, the two Supreme Artifacts began to intertwine together. However, it was clear that the Supreme Artifact in Ruo Lan’s hand was much stronger. After all, Ruo Lan had spiritual cultivation and could unleash the power of the Supreme Artifact to a greater extent than Lin Qinghe, who was only at the 3rd tier of the God Monarch Realm.]
[Even if the Supreme Artifact – Black Abyss Demon Spear was slightly stronger, the difference between the Supreme Artifacts wouldn’t be too great. The user’s cultivation level could be a determining factor.
