Under such circumstances, it would be useless for Lin Qinghe to let the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body take over, even if he became possessed.]
[You sighed, knowing that things were going south this time too. But you had no intention of giving up and directed Lin Qinghe to attack Ruo Lan directly without any defense, while Cai Yonglong was ready to use his abilities at any time.]
[The remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body who took over the body for the battle didn’t understand what you were up to, but still followed your instruction and started to fight desperately.]
[This made Ruo Lan suspicious and sneered. Although she didn’t know what Wang Ping and the others were thinking, as a surviving transmigrator, she had always been cautious, not giving Wang Ping and the others any opportunity to harm her, and planned to exhaust Lin Qinghe.]
[After all, using the Supreme Artifact came at a price, which was not something a God Monarch Realm cultivator could bear. A cultivator at the 3rd tier of the God Monarch Realm could only hold on for less than half a minute using a Supreme Artifact before being drained of Mana and soul power. Not to mention that Lin Qinghe was using a vicious Demonic Artifact. Ruo Lan believed she would be the ultimate winner as long as they played it safe.]
[Seeing Ruo Lan’s prudence, you couldn’t help but feel helpless. In the end, even though you used Cai Yonglong’s ability to bluff, it ultimately proved futile. The three of you perished under the power of the Supreme Artifact.]
[And although you had a Rebirth tally, it was apparently useless; you just died one more time.]
[Due to your death, the life simulation has ended…]
…
When the text simulation came to an end, numerous images and insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. His figure was finally transferred to the Primordial Forbidden Land, where he saw Ruo Lan holding a Supreme Artifact.]
“The Supreme Artifact, what a nuisance. I mean, every time my side has a Sacred Artifact or a Supreme Artifact, the enemy always has one too, doesn’t that just cancel each other out? And because the enemy has more power, we’re actually at a disadvantage.”
Wang Ping shook his head and complained.]
Of course, Wang Ping was just venting.]
If he didn’t have a Supreme Artifact while the enemy did, even if his cultivation was higher, he’d still end up being abused by a Supreme Artifact.]
In the past, a Sacred Artifact was like a nuclear bomb, you couldn’t use one but you couldn’t do without it either.]
Now, it has become a Supreme Artifact.]
As for the Holy King Artifacts and Great Holy Artifacts in between…]
Uh, they just don’t seem to have much of a presence.]
Wang Ping looked a little subtle and quietly complained.]
At this moment, Wang Ping felt a flicker in his consciousness, and his vision changed, returning to the real world.]
Following that, the system’s voice also rang out.]
“Ding! Reward generated successfully. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Half-step Divinity Realm cultivation.
②. Purple Talent·Unstable Luck.
③. Incomplete Map.
④. Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.
⑤. Life-bound Artifact (Top Tier Godly Artifact Level).”
…..
“System, I choose ③. Incomplete Map.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, thought for a moment, and made his choice.]
Cultivation and the like could be obtained as long as he followed his current path; it was not a rare reward.]
Purple Talent·Unstable Luck was a mix of good and bad, thus couldn’t be picked.]
As for the Life-bound Artifact, Wang Ping was tempted to try and get it for Xu Yi to see if the rewards could be multiplied, then let Zhang Haoran try to combine it into a Sacred Artifact. But after thinking about it, he decided not to.]
This item wouldn’t change anything for now, and it wasn’t essential.]
As for the Incomplete Map, it might be a necessary item to find the Emperor Scripture or part of the key, so it was worth choosing.]
Besides, this Incomplete Map was actually obtained through the Purple Talent·Unstable Luck.]
If he didn’t choose Purple Talent·Unstable Luck this time, he might not be able to get it next time.]
Of course, even if he had chosen Purple Talent·Unstable Luck, he might not have been able to trigger the effect again and obtain the Incomplete Map.]
After this, Wang Ping planned to simulate twice more and then stop.]
After all, continuing simulations would only lead to worse luck, especially after getting Gold and Purple rewards.]
“This time, let’s change our strategy. Don’t bring Lin Qinghe to the lower realm, I’ll go alone and see if I can get the Supreme Artifact.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought.]
If he had no fate with the Supreme Artifact, he had no choice but to give it to Lin Qinghe in the Life Simulator.]

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_5
So, he could only hope to refresh it from the rewards of the Life Simulator.
Although, the probability of refreshing it was indeed low.
“System, I want to proceed with the paid simulation,”
After Wang Ping had gathered his thoughts, he said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming three hundred kilograms of Lower-tier God’s Source, the Life Simulator has started, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Red Talent·Ghost Face.”
Red Talent·Ghost Face: After the host puts on the Ghost Face Mask, they will gain mysterious power, which can increase their combat power.
“Alright, the bad luck starts.”
Wang Ping looked at the update of his talent and sighed, not particularly surprised.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded again, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway as he entered an immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text also emerged.
[Day One, you chose cultivation. Then, you wanted to act as you did in your memory.]
[Ten years later, during your cultivation, Ruo Lan suddenly appeared in front of you and killed you alive. Although you have the means to resurrect, she killed you several times in a row.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends.]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and a brief scene appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, leaving him a bit baffled.
“What’s going on? Why did Ruo Lan, this predecessor transmigrator, appear just ten years later? Shouldn’t she have appeared only more than 1,500 years later?”
Wang Ping’s expression changed uncertainly, and his face looked somewhat ugly.
The change was too great, and Wang Ping was caught off guard.
“Wait, could it be because of the Second-generation Chat Group…?”
Wang Ping seemed to have thought of something, and his pupils suddenly shrank.
Within the Life Simulator, theexistence of chat groups is extremely low, and the Second-generation Chat Group is no exception.
In the previous simulations, Ruo Lan didn’t have the support of a chat group.
But this time, the change in the simulation meant that she had used the delivery function of the Second-generation Chat Group to rush from the Small Universe to the Elemental Star in the Big Universe without any delay, directly killing him.
And the place where she was sent, should be the location of the Supreme in the Second-generation Transmigrator Chat Group.
Because they were in different ancient stars, it took her ten years to travel.
After all, even saints can travel through the universe with their physical bodies, but it also takes time to travel from one ancient star to another.
“No, Ruo Lan’s aura isn’t as strong as it was in the previous simulation. She barely stepped out of the Semi-saint realm, but she is still a Semi-saint and hasn’t entered the Saint realm.”
At this moment, Wang Ping noticed another anomaly and his eyes flickered.
That is to say, she successfully broke through in the following more than 1,500 years and became a saint. So in the absence of the chat group’s influence, she had the ability to travel from the Small Universe to the Big Universe and cross the starry sky to chase and kill him at the Elemental Star.
But this time, she didn’t enter the Saint realm, and she probably came through a special Flying Saint Artifact.
“They really don’t give me any room for survival. Knowing the location of Purple Spirit Realm and the ascension place of Purple Spirit Realm, they don’t want to give me any chance for growth. The predecessor transmigrators of the Second-generation Chat Group must have guessed something from my performance of killing the Golden Silk Monkey and Chu Xiao one after another.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed, and he thought in secret.
“But doesn’t that self-titled Supreme have any power? Logically, with Supreme’s ability, it’s more convenient to send a native saint to kill me.”
Wang Ping thought of this and pondered silently.
“He is a lone wolf, has not established a power, nor has joined a power. His self-titled place is isolated from the outer world, and no one dares to enter except for those who are above the Supreme level. After self-titling, he doesn’t want to leave and contact some powers to kill you, as the price to pay is too high; he definitely won’t do it.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“Not to mention, he has grown to that step by killing countless people and slaughtering many powers, so he has enemies too.”
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
These old monsters, in order to survive, had definitely chose special places for self-titling and didn’t want anyone to disturb their sleep, affecting their lives.
However, this was also a kind of sealing oneself alive.
“But according to your meaning, if I kill Ruo Lan, he may still come out in the open, right?”
Wang Ping remembered this point and frowned, saying.
“It’s possible. However, when he comes out, if he wants to continue living, he must eat the Life Origin of a large number of cultivators, which has strong vitality from world-shocking treasure medicine. By then, there will definitely be powerful people to clean him up.”
Alpha didn’t deceive Wang Ping and spoke coldly.
“Of course, considering the existence of the Second-generation Chat Group, someone might give him a strong Life Origin, so there may not be a need for slaughter.”
“You’re playing me. If it’s a saint, I still have the confidence to handle it in the following simulations. But if you directly send a Supreme to chase and kill me, and it’s not long after he wants to deal with me, then I have no way to play.”

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Chapter 189: The Fourth Golden Talent! Supreme_6
Wang Ping said somewhat speechlessly.
“Unless, I can quickly flee from the Elemental Star, wander around other ancient stars and find a way to block the heavenly secrets, I might have a chance to avoid their pursuit and grow up quietly.”
“No matter what you think, these are the obstacles you need to overcome. If you can’t even overcome this level of difficulty, then facing the real terrifying beings in the future, you won’t stand a chance.”
Alpha went silent for a moment, with a cold voice once again resounding.
“….”
Wang Ping didn’t complain anymore, frowning instead.
Of course, he knew what he was facing.
The enemies of the Upper Realm actually weren’t much to worry about.
After all, some people could destroy the chat group or join other forces to destroy the chat group together.
However, his Life Simulator could describe the conditions of the world, including the Great Emperors, but could not simulate the chat group.
This meant that the strength of the Great Emperor was far from enough.
Some of the transmigrators in the Second-generation Chat Group and those in the First-generation Chat Group had definitely surpassed this level, and their respective leaders had even reached a terrifying level.
Just as Alpha said, if he couldn’t even deal with a Supreme, there would be no point in playing and he might as well go home and raise pigs.
Of course, he was just complaining out of habit and wasn’t really scared of anything. Although the time until the attack had suddenly shortened from more than 1,500 years to just over a decade, Wang Ping could easily find the time to grow stronger and counter-attack.
It’s just that with the issue of the Supreme in mind, he couldn’t easily kill her for now.
Killing Ruo Lan might lead to even stronger opponents.
Besides, in reality, he couldn’t simulate talent refreshes much longer and should improve his cultivation to get stronger.
“What a shame, Xu Yi only gave me a small multiplier, causing the amount of Lower-tier God’s source in my hand to only increase from ten thousand jin to twenty thousand jin. If there were more, it would have been great.”
Wang Ping thought of the issue with God’s Source, his eyes filled with greed.
“System, I want to pay for a simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping calmed down and spoke from the bottom of his heart.
“Ding, consuming 300 jin of Lower-tier God’s source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on successfully refreshing the Golden Talent·Mandatory Retreat; Red Talent·Lei Profound Body.”
Golden Talent·Mandatory Retreat: With this talent, you can selectively use it on a specific target. The subject you deem as your target will be forcibly repelled to an extremely distant place.
The cooldown time for this talent is one month.
However, this talent can only be used against cultivators below the Supreme Realm.
Red Talent·Lei Profound Body: With this talent, you will gain a decent lightning talent.
“Eh! Another Golden Talent…”
Wang Ping looked at the newly refreshed talent, quite surprised.
The effect of this Golden Talent, Mandatory Retreat, was also quite overpowered, and not worse than the initial Golden Finger of other group members in the chat group.
To be precise, it wasn’t just not worse than the initial Golden Fingers, but it was even stronger than the Golden Fingers that some group members had enhanced once.
“Purple corresponds to the Divine Realm, and gold corresponds to the Saint Realm. It makes sense.”
Wang Ping looked at the talent and thought silently.
However, there was only one seven-color talent left.
If the seven colors corresponded to the Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and Great Emperor in the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, then the upper limit of his Life Simulator would be the Great Emperor tier.
Wouldn’t that be a little weak?
“If there is an optimization next time, then after the next optimization, the Life Simulator may not only cover the Life Simulator in the simulation but also upgrade the talent level once.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking in his heart that this possibility was high.
If the upper limit of Life Simulator was only the Great Emperor, then it would be too low and wouldn’t be feared by Alpha.
However, he needed Alpha to unlock the optimization permissions for him.
“But, there’s no rush, I’m still far from the Great Emperor level.”
“System, I choose Golden Talent·Mandatory Retreat.”
Wang Ping shook his head and calmed himself down, silently speaking.
This time, his luck was both good and bad.
The Mandatory Retreat Golden Talent would be incredibly useful.
However, he wanted a blocking Heavenly Mystery talent even more.
Of course, he still had some time to survive, so he wasn’t picky.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation beginning…”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered as he entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
“[Day 1, after pondering, you head to Tao Palace and choose to join it. In your opinion, although Tao Palace will be destroyed sooner or later, that’s still more than 1,500 years away. Before that, no one would dare to make a move against Tao Palace.]
“[As long as you cultivate in Tao Palace for a period of time, you’ll see a great improvement in your cultivation. With the simulation stacking up your cultivation, facing Semi-saint Ruo Lan will be an easy task.]
“[In the blink of an eye, ten years pass. Since you’ve been low-key in Tao Palace and never competed for the position of Tao Palace disciple, no one except the palace master knows of your existence. Ruo Lan can only expend a Heavenly Secret Talisman to find your whereabouts.]
“[However, when she discovers that you’re in Tao Palace, she falls silent. After all, she can’t afford to provoke an existence like Tao Palace. Even the self-titled Supreme member cannot do so.]
“[Although the might of Emperor Force is powerful enough for the Supreme to resist briefly, the self-titled predecessor of the Second Generation Chat Group has a limited lifespan, and cannot withstand the Emperor Force.] ”
….
“I did gain some new information.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of this simulation, his eyes gleaming.
It turned out that the Supreme could temporarily resist the Emperor Force, but those with limited lifespans couldn’t do it.
If nothing unexpected happened, the terrifying powerhouse hiding in the Primordial Star should be a Supreme.
After all, he had displayed the power to fear the Emperor Force, but had managed to knock the Emperor Force away once, then kidnapped him.
“A Supreme… truly an enviable realm.”
Wang Ping sighed and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.

chapters.title: Chapter 623: 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Chapter 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!
After feeling emotional, Wang Ping calmed his mind and continued to focus on the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, the day the Great Saint Secret Realm opened has arrived. You hid your identity and entered it. This time, because Ruo Lan did not use the Heavenly Secret Talisman, your whereabouts were not exposed.]
[In the secret realm, you obtained the True Immortal Star Flower, which raised your cultivation to the 5th tier True Divine Realm. At the same time, you successfully obtained the Divine Medicine and returned to the Tao Palace to cultivate in seclusion.]
[For safety reasons, you decided not to get involved with Lin Qinghe’s plans and not venture to the lower realm to try for the Supreme Artifact. This time, you wanted to quickly improve your cultivation and strengthen yourself so that you could compete against Ruo Lan, a Predecessor Transmigrator.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly fifteen hundred years passed. Within these fifteen hundred years, you had already refined the Divine Medicine and successfully broken through to the half-step God Lord Realm. Next, you knew that if you attempted to break through to the God Lord Realm, you would be discovered by the Supreme Lord on the Primordial Star.]
[At that time, your death would be inevitable, and there would be no chance of survival. Moreover, with the threat of Ruo Lan, there was even less hope of survival.]
[For this reason, you consulted with the Master of Tao Palace, asking him if there was a way for you to travel to other ancient stars. This surprised the Master of Tao Palace, as he did not know why you wanted to travel to other ancient stars.]
[However, when you revealed your cultivation and expressed your desire to go to a remote ancient star to break through to the God Monarch Realm safely, the Master of Tao Palace was shocked. After all, you had been cultivating for such a short time and had quietly raised your cultivation to the half-step God Monarch Realm, even planning to break through to the God Monarch Realm.]
[Soon after, the Master of Tao Palace became excited, believing that you were indeed the savior of Tao Palace and hoped to return it to its former glory. As a result, the Master of Tao Palace did not hesitate to entrust you with the extremely precious and last Flying Saint Artifact in the Tao Palace.]
[With the Flying Saint Artifact and the coordinates of a starry sky, you could go to the target ancient star and breakthrough there.]
[However, the cosmic starry sky was filled with too many dangers. With only Spiritual Cultivation and half-step Divinity Realm cultivation, it was still dangerous to rely on the Flying Saint Artifact. He hoped that you would break through on some ancient stars closer to the Primordial Star and not go too far.]
[After agreeing to the Master of Tao Palace, you used the Flying Saint Artifact, consuming a large amount of divine source, and went to the cosmic starry sky. The commotion of your departure attracted the attention of many forces on the Elemental Star.]
[They wondered why the members of Tao Palace were leaving the Elemental Star, but they didn’t think too much about it. However, one person noticed something unusual. This person was Ruo Lan. Ruo Lan knew that you were hiding in the Tao Palace and might have guessed that their group of Predecessor Transmigrators from the Second Generation Chat Group would come to kill you.]
[As a result, it was normal for you to want to escape and distance yourself from the Elemental Star. With this in mind, Ruo Lan did not hesitate to use her Flying Saint Artifact to chase after you.]
[Over the years, Ruo Lan had been trying to break through to the Saint Realm and become a Saint. However, the environment on the Elemental Star was worse than the one on some ancient star in her Small Universe. Coupled with her distraction, she had not been able to successfully break through and become a Saint in the Last Dharma Age.]
[Nevertheless, she was not worried. With her Semi-Saint cultivation, it was enough to deal with you as a Junior Transmigrator. Not to mention, she also had a Supreme Artifact by her side and was not afraid at all.]
[As you were traveling through the cosmic starry sky with the Flying Saint Artifact, you detected through the Flying Saint Artifact that another Flying Saint Artifact was chasing you. This made you frown, knowing that Ruo Lan was following you.]
[That is to say, escaping from the Elemental Star was meaningless. Whether you stayed on the Elemental Star or fled to break through elsewhere, the outcome would be the same – death.]
[Of course, your main goal this time was to increase your cultivation, break through to the God Monarch Realm, and then improve your cultivation through rewards. Although you would still die, you didn’t have much regret.]
[However, even though you knew the odds were against you, you didn’t give up on trying to trick Ruo Lan and see if you could find a way to survive. Using the map provided by the Master of Tao Palace, you found an ancient star called the Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[The Purgatory Ancient Star is an extremely peculiar ancient star that is not suitable for human habitation and does not even have any life on it. In fact, it lacks the conditions for the birth of life. The star is filled with terrifying flames, and its fire attribute energy is extremely dense and violent, making it a Holy Land for Fire attribute cultivators.]
[Even in the Last Dharma Age, where the Mana of Fire is not evident, on the Purgatory Ancient Star, the Mana of Fire would occasionally appear at specific points in time.]
[According to the Divine Characters written on the map, many forces would choose to send their talented disciples to the Purgatory Ancient Star for training. Even some fire attribute Semi-Saints, in search of a breakthrough, would risk entering the Purgatory Ancient Star, trying to comprehend the Mana of Fire and rely on this natural environment to help them step into the Saint Realm.]
[However, doing so comes with both risks and rewards. The Purgatory Ancient Star is an excellent place for cultivation and tempering, but it is also extremely dangerous. Not just Semi-Saints, even Saints might be instantly incinerated by the deep flames.]

chapters.title: Chapter 624: 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Chapter 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_2
[You pilot a Flying Saint Artifact, assisted by Space Law, distorting space and flying at a faster speed, leaving Ruo Lan far behind. However, due to the Heavenly Secret Talisman locking onto you, no matter how fast you fly, you can’t escape Ruo Lan’s grasp.]
[Nevertheless, this still causes Ruo Lan to frown, having not expected you to comprehend Space Law, and is quite surprised. As a result, she becomes even more cautious of you.]
[Several months later, you successfully enter the Purgatory Ancient Star and see this terrifying ancient star enveloped in crimson flames, feeling the horror of its flames.]
[Your arrival attracts the attention of some cultivators on the Purgatory Ancient Star, but they don’t pay too much attention. After all, it’s not uncommon for cultivators from other ancient stars to come to Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[However, your actions of directly delving deep into the Sea of Flames on the Purgatory Ancient Star surprise some powerful cultivators. After all, with your half-step Divinity Realm cultivation, such actions are extremely reckless.]
[But when they see you using the Great Perfection Fire Pseudo Law to guide the flames and completely isolate the flames using Space Law, they are all astonished. Then, they think you are an old monster who has regained cultivation and no longer pay attention to you, no one thinking you are courting death anymore.]
[You enter the depths of the Sea of Flames and cultivate, ready to break through to the God Monarch Realm at any time. However, you don’t plan to rush into the God Monarch Realm immediately, waiting for Ruo Lan to arrive.]
[Half a month later, Ruo Lan arrives at the Purgatory Ancient Star and goes straight into the Sea of Flames, intending to find you and kill you completely.]
[However, when Ruo Lan is about to kill you, you sneer and choose to forcibly break through to the God Monarch Realm. With your breakthrough, a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation begins brewing, scaring Ruo Lan away.]
[After all, if she stays in the Heavenly Tribulation area, the power of the Heavenly Tribulation will definitely increase exponentially. If she uses a Supreme Artifact, the power of the Heavenly Tribulation would be so great that it could shatter the Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[At that time, whether it’s Ruo Lan or other cultivators on the Purgatory Ancient Star, they will all die. And although Ruo Lan wants to kill you, she has no intention of sacrificing herself.]
[In the end, she wants to kill you just to protect herself. If she kills you and perishes with you, that’s a fool’s behavior. As a living traverser, she obviously wouldn’t do such thankless things.]
[Seeing that Ruo Lan has no intention of stopping you, you take the initiative to rush towards her, trying to drag her down and rely on the Heavenly Tribulation to kill her, then see if you can drag through the Heavenly Tribulation using the Rebirth Tally’s bug.]
[Seeing you rushing towards her recklessly, Ruo Lan feels involuntarily scared and curses you as a madman before using a divine speed type of divine power to flee desperately, not wanting to get dragged into the Heavenly Tribulation’s range.]
[As the Heavenly Tribulation becomes more and more terrifying, you know that you cannot rely on the Heavenly Tribulation’s power to kill Ruo Lan, and can only sigh with some regret, concentrating on Crossing Tribulation. Your Heavenly Tribulation is too terrifying, even for you, it’s extremely difficult. However, your performance is still impressive.]
[As a result, many cultivators who watch you pass the Heavenly Tribulation are astounded, feeling that you’re a powerful old monster who has regained cultivation.]
[After a long time, you successfully cross the Heavenly Tribulation, using the Divine Platform as a foundation and evolving your inner divine kingdom, truly entering the God Monarch Realm. As you step into the God Monarch Realm, your combat power also rapidly increases.]
[At the same time, due to this breakthrough to the God Monarch Realm and the law of thunder contained in the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation as well as the Mana of Fire hidden in the Sea of Flames of the Purgatory Ancient Star, you have some insights, feeling that if you retreat for a while, you might be able to comprehend the law of thunder and Mana of Fire.]
[Just as you have some insights, Ruo Lan, without any hesitation, attacks you, unleashing the power of a Semi-saint upon you. As someone only a half-step away from the Saint Realm, and with the potential to step into the Saint Realm in the Last Dharma Age, Ruo Lan naturally has her own fortune. She also cultivates the Emperor Scripture, comprehends the Mana of gold, is powerful, and not someone who can be easily challenged across levels.]
[In response, you have no intention of confronting Ruo Lan head-on, just smirking and directly using Space Law and Space Divine Skills to dodge the attacks of this Predecessor Traverser and instantly appear behind her.]
[Then, you directly use the Gold Talent·Mandatory Retreat effect to attack this Predecessor Traverser, Ruo Lan.]
[As you use the Golden Talent: Forced Repulsion, Ruo Lan is directly repelled, unable to control her own body, which horrifies her to the extreme. She doesn’t understand what kind of divine power you used to bridge such a huge gap in cultivation.]
[Seeing herself about to be blasted into the depths of the Sea of Flames, feeling the deadly threat brought by the terrifying flames, Ruo Lan unhesitatingly uses the Supreme Artifact to protect herself and try to kill you.]
[Facing the attack of the Supreme Artifact, you are instantly killed without any suspense. However, because you previously used the Purple Talent·Death Puppet to bind a Demonic Cultivator, the damage is transferred instead, and the Demonic Cultivator dies on the spot.]

chapters.title: Chapter 625: 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Chapter 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_3
[And you, took this opportunity to escape far away, leaving this place. Seeing this, Ruo Lan was both shocked and furious, but she could only rage helplessly, for she had already been trapped in the depths of the Sea of Flames.]
[In this area, even a Saint King could be in danger of perishing. Even though she had a Supreme Artifact protecting her body, she couldn’t hold on for long and had to escape quickly.]
[However, you obviously didn’t want to give Ruo Lan a chance. From a great distance, you used Space Law and Space Divine Skills to blast Ruo Lan through the air, trying to force her to die in the deepest part of the fire domain.]
[Seeing this scene, many cultivators were astonished and puzzled about the enmity between you two. A Semi-saint was holding a Supreme Artifact to hunt down you, a cultivator who had just broken through to the God Monarch Realm. They could only guess it was the enmity you had formed before your recultivation.]
[Just as you were attacking furiously, trying to kill Ruo Lan, a predecessor from the ransmigrators, a Semi-saint quietly appeared behind you and launched a thunderous blow, leaving you on the verge of death.]
[You were very astonished, not expecting someone to ambush you at this time. Seeing your surprise, the cultivator that ambushed you revealed a sneaky smile, stating that a God Monarch Realm cultivator holding two Sacred Artifacts was too extravagant and that it’d be better to hand them over to him for safekeeping.]
[You were both shocked and angry, wanting to resist, but you had already lost your chance. The other party acted again, killing you. After you died, the Semi-saint began to search your corpse. At this moment, you triggered Red Talent·Death Whisper, unleashing a terrifying strike that injured the unprepared Semi-saint.]
[This left him very confused, not understanding what was going on, so he could only curse and snatch your two Sacred Artifacts before escaping far away.]
[As for you, due to the Rebirth tally, you entered a countdown state.]
[Because of your death, Ruo Lan broke free from the depths of the Sea of Flames, staring fiercely at the location where you fell. She started to set up a formation to seal off this area, while going on a killing spree and keeping an eye on the location.]
[Seeing Ruo Lan vent her anger on the corpse, no one dared to provoke her, and everyone quickly left.]
[An hour later, you were resurrected. By the time you were resurrected, Ruo Lan had already put away her Supreme Artifact and no longer had the ability to use it to attack you. However, she was still powerful, unleashing a powerful Divine Skill the moment you were resurrected, wanting to kill you.]
[You snorted coldly, dodging her attack with Space Law and Space Divine Skills, while gathering power to use your most potent Divine Skill. Although your two Sacred Artifacts had been stolen, and your strength had decreased, you were still formidable.]
[Seeing that you did not dodge but chose to confront her head-on, Ruo Lan sneered and began to gather her most formidable power, using her strongest Divine Skill to thoroughly crush you.]
[Soon after, you initiated an instantaneous teleport and unleashed your most powerful strike at a relatively close distance. Ruo Lan was also ready to use her Divine Skill to overpower you.]
[At this moment, you revealed a sharp glint in your eyes and cast Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skill. As you used this Purple Talent, Ruo Lan’s expression froze, because she found that she couldn’t use her Divine Skill, and the power she had gathered for it dispersed completely.]
[She couldn’t understand why you had so many strange methods, but she could only switch from offense to defense in a hurry.]
[However, because the process of changing from offense to defense was too hurried, her defense could not reach its maximum limit and was merely a basic defense. In this attack, you managed to activate the critical strike effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade by luck, doubling its lethality.]
[As a result, even though there was a huge gap in cultivation between you and Ruo Lan, you still broke her defense and inflicted severe damage on her. Even Ruo Lan, who was about to step into the Saint Realm as a Semi-saint, was affected by this attack, coughing up blood.]
[However, her cultivation was ultimately too intimidating, being a non-ordinary Semi-saint who had comprehended the Mana of gold and practiced the Emperor Scripture. She endured this strike without suffering too severe injuries, only looking very disheveled.]
[Seeing this scene, you sighed inwardly, knowing that the gap in your cultivation was still too vast. If your cultivation had reached the Peak of God King Realm, the operation just now would have been enough to kill Ruo Lan, a Semi-saint.]
[Ruo Lan, injured by you, was completely enraged. Knowing she was a powerful Semi-saint and even holding a Supreme Artifact, she could hardly believe she was so disheveled because of you. As a result, she immediately used a secret skill, forcibly increasing her combat power and launching the fiercest area attack against you.]
[By now, you no longer had a way out. All you could do was sigh and voluntarily exit the immersive simulation state.]
[Due to your voluntary exit from the simulation state, this simulation ended…..]
…..
The Text Simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various images and insights, finally settling in the Sea of Flames on the Purgatory Ancient Star.
“What a pity, just one move short. However, it doesn’t matter. Once I choose my cultivation this time and stack another layer of cultivation, killing Ruo Lan, a predecessor from the ransmigrators, will still be an easy task.”

chapters.title: Chapter 626: 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Chapter 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_4
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered in silence.
Although he was close to Entering Saint, he ultimately didn’t, and there was a world of difference between him and someone who had truly become a saint.
Although Ruo Lan, a Semi-saint, was powerful, Wang Ping believed that there was still a high possibility of killing her.
If she had reached the Saint Realm, Wang Ping estimated that it would take a long time before he could counter-kill her.
“You’re not a Saint, but you came to kill me at Elemental Star in 1,500 years instead of waiting. You’re just delivering your head to me.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but comment.
“Of course, no matter what choice you make, it’s just the difference between an early death and a late death.”
Then, with a flash of Wang Ping’s consciousness, his vision switched and returned to the real world.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. You can choose two of the following rewards:
① Golden Talent: Forced Repulsion.
② 1st tier Divine Monarch Realm cultivation.
③ Life-bound Artifact (Top Tier Godly Artifact Level).
④ Flying Saint Artifact.”
….
“System, I choose ① Golden Talent: Forced Repulsion and ② 1st tier Divine Monarch Realm cultivation.”
After checking the reward list, Wang Ping made the best choice.
Last time there was an Incomplete Map of Time-Space attribute Emperor Scripture to be chosen, so Wang Ping chose the Incomplete Map.
Now, the enemy is imminent, and only by quickly improving his cultivation can he break the situation. Wang Ping naturally will not hesitate anymore.
Although improving cultivation will consume more divine sources, reducing the number of Paid Simulations and refreshing fewer talents available, he currently has 20,000 jin of Lower-tier God’s Source, which is still sufficient. Upgrading cultivation can just barely be accepted.
“Ding, Reward Selection Successful…”
The sound of the system rang out.
Immediately, Wang Ping felt that there was a new talent in his mind along with the method of using it.
It was the Golden Talent: Forced Repulsion.
Then, Wang Ping’s cultivation began to rise step by step.
5th tier True Divine Realm!
7th tier True Divine Realm!
9th tier True Divine Realm!
Great Perfection in True Divine Realm!
Half-step God Lord Realm!
And finally, it stopped at the 1st tier Divine Monarch Realm!
“The feeling of increased cultivation, even after so many times, is still addictive.”
Wang Ping felt the surging mana in his body, the powerful physical body, and the stronger Divine Soul, nodding in satisfaction.
“Speaking of which, if it wasn’t for that half-saint who ambushed me, I might have been able to force Ruo Lan to die in the deepest part of the Purgatory Ancient Star Sea of Fire, without having to go through so much trouble. Of course, although the chances of success in this endeavor are slim, it doesn’t mean it’s impossible. That half-saint just ruined my plans.”
Wang Ping thought of the half-saint who had ambushed him and was very displeased with him.
If it continued to ruin his simulations, Wang Ping wouldn’t mind killing him directly.
Not only in the simulation but also in reality.
“System, how much lower-tier divine source do I need for a Paid Simulation right now?”
Then, Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked from the bottom of his heart.
He was already mentally prepared for a huge loss.
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the 1st tier Divine Monarch Realm, the amount of divine source needed for Paid Simulation is 10,000 jin of lower-tier divine source or 100 jin of mid-tier divine source.”
The cold and ruthless voice of the system rang out.
“10,000 jin…?”
Hearing this amount, Wang Ping’s face twitched violently.
Although he was mentally prepared, this price was still beyond his expectation.
God damn it, this price skyrocketed more than thirty times. It’s just too outrageous.
Originally, Wang Ping thought it would be around 3,000 or 5,000 jin, but it turned out to be over 10,000…
For a moment, Wang Ping regretted improving his cultivation.
As expected, maintaining low cultivation and having more Paid Simulations seemed more pleasurable.
Of course, Wang Ping just thought that way.
Since the enemy is pressing close, continuing to gamble on refreshing powerful talents is a bit dangerous, so it’s safer to first improve cultivation.
Not to mention, not improving cultivation might also make it impossible to break the situation, and there is a high probability of dying repeatedly.
If he is even more unlucky and doesn’t refresh any powerful talent, these simulations would be meaningless.
“System…”
Then, Wang Ping prepared for a new Paid Simulation.
However, just as he was about to speak, Wang Ping stopped. He currently only had one chance for a Paid Simulation, and he was still short of some lower-tier divine source in order to have a second chance to simulate.
If he used the Paid Simulation recklessly, it would be too risky.
“Let’s use a free simulation first and scout the way, see if I can kill Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Ransmigrator, and what consequences will follow after killing her.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought secretly in his heart.
“System, I want to perform a free simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulation launched, free simulation begins.”
As the system’s voice rang out, Wang Ping felt his consciousness blurred and knew that he had entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to go to the Tao Palace, intending to obtain another divine medicine and raise your cultivation to the late-stage Divine Monarch Realm before confronting her.]
[When you arrived at the Tao Palace, the palace master was astonished. He had never expected you to be a God King Realm powerhouse, possessing a Time-Space Body, and also cultivating the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.]
[As a result, the Master of Tao Palace did not hesitate to let you join the Tao Palace, treating you as the future savior of Tao Palace. However, due to your low-key nature, you only chose to become an Outer Sect Elder in the Tao Palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 627: 190: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Chapter 190: Skyrocketing Cultivation! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_5
“During your tenure as an Outer Sect Elder, you also diligently cultivated and occasionally disciplined the disciples of the Tao Palace’s outer division. In this process, you actually discovered a promising talent.”
“This disciple’s name is Fang Xingyu. Although his root and bone quality is very mediocre, his comprehension is quite astonishing. As a result, you have taken a liking to this talent and accepted him as your own disciple, teaching him cultivation.”
“You believe that, as long as Fang Xingyu can acquire a treasure medicine to dramatically improve his root and bone quality, or a cultivation method that allows one to metamorphize in the future, his accomplishments will definitely be high.”
“In this way, you will also leave a decent foundation for the Tao Palace.”
…..
“Huh, has the future changed again? However, this time there’s a named supporting character, which is rather interesting.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, watching the content of the text simulation, chuckled softly, and remembered this person called Fang Xingyu.
“In the blink of an eye, a decade has passed. Ruo Lan has secretly moved to the Elemental Ancient Star, but found you staying in the Tao Palace, seemingly helpless.”
“Once again, in a blink of an eye, several decades have passed. Because the Divine Monarch Realm is harder to cultivate, there has been no change in your cultivation, and you remain in the Divine Monarch Realm at the 1st tier.”
“However, you have once again secretly entered the Great Saint Secret Realm and snatched a Divine Medicine. This time, you obtained the Divine Medicine more easily.”
“After obtaining the treasure medicine, you returned to the Tao Palace to continue diligently cultivating.”
“Three hundred years later, by absorbing the essence of the Divine Medicine, your cultivation has steadily risen to the Divine Monarch Realm 4th tier.”
“In another blink of an eye, three hundred more years have passed. Your cultivation has improved again and reached the 7th tier of the Divine Monarch Realm. However, to your regret, after reaching the Divine Monarch Realm, the consumption of resources has increased. This stalk of divine medicine was only able to raise your cultivation to the 7th tier of the Divine Monarch Realm before it was consumed completely.”
“Nevertheless, you were quite satisfied with this. After all, you can brush up your cultivation using the rewards of the Life Simulator, and you can always brush the Divine Medicine, which rapidly stacks up your cultivation.”
“Although you have reached the 7th tier of the Divine Monarch Realm, you didn’t immediately go out to guide Ruo Lan towards the Purgatory Ancient Star. Instead, you preferred to consolidate your progress, intending to understand the laws of thunder and fire first.”
“In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years passed and, during this time, you cultivated conscientiously. You successfully comprehended the laws of thunder and fire, created your own Saint-tier cultivation methods and Divine Skills, and took one step closer towards creating your own method of verification.”
“Next, you believe the time is ripe. You started using the Flying Saint Artifact, left the Elemental Ancient Star, and headed for the Purgatory Ancient Star.”
“Seeing you fly away from the Elemental Ancient Star and head outside the realm, Ruo Lan who had been keeping an eye on the Tao Palace also quickly followed.”
“Three months later, you both arrived at the Purgatory Ancient Star and reached the depths of the Sea of Flames.”
“Following that, you acted as in your memory. Although you did not traverse the tribulation this time, you still used the Space Law and Space Divine Skills to adjust your position, then combined it with your Golden Talent: Forced Repulsion to push her into the depths of the Sea of Flames.”
“Ruo Lan never expected that your cultivation would soar to the 7th tier of the Divine Monarch Realm in such a short time, and that you would have such tricky abilities. She could only reluctantly sacrifice her Supreme Artifact to protect herself and tried to escape from the Sea of Flames.”
“You acted accordingly, beginning to relentlessly bombard Ruo Lan who was trapped in the deepest part of the Sea of Flames, wishing to take advantage of the terrifying flames in the deepest part of the Purgatory Ancient Star to kill her completely.”
“Of course, you were also wary of the sneak attack from that Semi-saint known as ‘assassin’. However, due to your manipulation of time, that sneaky Semi-saint was not currently on the Purgatory Ancient Star. In addition, your displayed cultivation and combat power were already significantly high, thus no one targeted you for a sneak attack.”
“As for Ruo Lan, she was even more in a mess because your combat power is much stronger than in your memory, and the attacks produce stronger effects.”
“Regarding this, Ruo Lan felt very stifled. She could only burn her blood essence, using secret methods to forcibly boost her combat power, maximizing the operation of her Supreme Artifact. She broke free from the terrifying Sea of Flames, killed her way out, and once again used the Supreme Artifact to launch the most fierce attack on you.”
“Facing this terrifying attack, you chose not to use your Purple Talent: Death Puppet to transfer the damage, but instead choose to withstand this terrifying attack with your physical body.”
“In an instant, you were turned into ashes and nothing was left. But because of the Rebirth Tally, you entered a resurrection countdown state.”
“And Ruo Lan continued to bombard your corpse to prevent you from feigning death. Due to the distance, the effect of your Death Speech did not trigger.”
“An hour later, you successfully resurrected, and at this moment, Ruo Lan does not have the ability to continue operating her Supreme Artifact. This Supreme Artifact fell back into a state of self-sealing.”
“However, Ruo Lan still had the confidence to kill you with her powerful cultivation. After all, she is a Semi-saint. Even though she burned a large amount of blood essence and her divine soul was very weak, her combat power fell drastically, she still believed she could easily kill you.”
“After you resurrected, she launched an attack, but you dodged it. You both began a fierce fight within the array.”
“It must be said that, even in a weakened state, Ruo Lan was still very strong. Even though you are at the 7th tier of the Divine Monarch Realm and occasionally trigger critical strikes of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, you are not her match in a head-on fight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 628: 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Chapter 190: Cultivation Soars! Counter-killing Ruo Lan!_6
[However, you were not the least bit panicked. At the critical moment, you used the Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skill effect to erase the opponent’s Divine Skill and dealt the strongest blow.]
[Caught off guard, the weaker Ruo Lan in your memory took the hit directly. As you were lucky enough to trigger the critical strike effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, even as a Semi-saint, her body was directly destroyed, suffering unimaginable heavy damage and struggling to recover.]
[At this, you sneered and started to beat the drowning dog by striking her relentlessly. Amidst her screams, Ruo Lan’s physical body was completely destroyed, leaving only her Divine Soul trying to escape. As for the self-titled Supreme Artifact, it was clearly set with a certain secret skill. When Ruo Lan fell, it tore the space apart and disappeared.]
[You guessed that this Supreme Artifact was heading in the direction of its master, clearly prepared by the Supreme of the Second-generation Chat Group.]
[Although you regretted not being able to intercept the Supreme Artifact, you did not care too much and continued to chase after Ruo Lan. Seeing your relentless pursuit, Ruo Lan became somewhat frantic, claiming that if you continued to push her, it would end in mutual destruction.]
[Your face was cold and unmoved. During the pursuit, you silently used the Purple Talent·Death Puppet to bind a hapless person.]
[Seeing that you indeed wanted to pursue her to the end, Ruo Lan became completely crazy, directly using a terrifying Forbidden Artifact. As this Forbidden Artifact was released, a terrifying force poured out, exerting a terror strike that could heavily damage a Saint.]
[Faced with this terrifying force, although you were on guard and dodged through Space Divine Skills, you were still affected and suffered potentially fatal damage.]
[However, you had bound a hapless person with Purple Talent·Death Puppet, causing all the damage to be transferred to that person. That unlucky person died on the spot, buying you time to escape.]
[With this, Ruo Lan, a Semi-saint and a Predecessor Transmigrator, died in your hands. However, you did not know that Ruo Lan did not have the resurrection capabilities like Chu Xiao had in some simulations and continued to watch, ready to give a fatal blow to the possibly revived Ruo Lan.]
…
“Good heavens, with my cultivation at the Divine Monarch Realm 7th tier, combined with numerous innate talents, I barely managed to kill her. It’s so difficult to kill Semi-saint Ruo Lan. I don’t think I can handle Saint Ruo Lan, a Divine Monarch. Even if I reach the Semi-saint tier, I guess it’s still uncertain. After all, the gap between Semi-saint and Saint is too great.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and marveled in his heart.
The battle this time was especially thrilling. Various calculations and talents were combined, and still, the price of two lives was paid to kill her, which was truly tragic.
“However, does Ruo Lan, the predecessor transmigrator, really have no means of resurrection? It seems that Chu Xiao’s resurrection method was also an accidental discovery, not all predecessors in the Second-generation Chat Group have it. Rather, the Chu Xiao in reality did not have it when I killed him.”
Wang Ping thought of the simulation content and his eyes flickered.
Then, he calmed his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As you kept watch, the cultivators on Purgatory Ancient Star were somewhat dumbfounded. A powerful Semi-saint, who also carried a Supreme Artifact, was actually killed by you, a Divine Monarch, which was astonishing.]
[However, they also noticed that you possessed a Time-Space Body, understood Space Laws, thunder laws, fire laws, and practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and felt that it was somewhat acceptable.]
[After all, comprehending three types of laws at the Divine Monarch Realm in the Last Dharma Age is just too abnormal. Even with the Time-Space Body, it would be very difficult to achieve this.]
[Of course, although many cultivators were astonished, some of them had doubts about your identity and harbored strange intentions.]
[Seeing this, you choose…]
The Text Simulation stopped here, and numerous scenes and insights also appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Finally, his vision changed, and he appeared in Purgatory Ancient Star.
“Another choice, huh? The choice this time is quite obvious – I definitely have to flee far away, or else I’ll die.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he thought secretly.
During the pure Text Simulation, Wang Ping naturally did not know that Ruo Lan had died completely, but as he entered the Immersive Simulation state and knew that Ruo Lan was already dead, there was no need to continue striking and watching, and he should run away.
After all, there were many powerful cultivators on Purgatory Ancient Star, and there were not a few Semi-saints among them. If these people moved against him, he might not be able to withstand their attacks after using all his trump cards.
“System, continue fast-forwarding.”
Wang Ping made his choice and spoke out loud.
[After realizing that Ruo Lan had died, you chose to loot Ruo Lan’s corpse and then immediately flee in the distance. Because of your understanding of Space Laws, the other cultivators couldn’t catch up with you and were left behind.]
[With this, although it was somewhat thrilling, you still managed to successfully escape from Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[At this point in time, you are also aware of the impending disaster for the Tao Palace, and since your identity, strength, and physique have been exposed, returning to Elemental Star would mean delivering your head to your enemies. After thinking it through, you decide to go to other Ancient Stars to cultivate in hiding and not set foot outside until you become a Saint.]
[As you look at the map, you realize that it is impossible to go to the bustling Central Ancient Star Domain of the Big Universe. After all, Elemental Star is located in a remote area, and even if you fly with a Flying Saint Artifact, it would take a long time before you could reach the Central Ancient Star Domain.]
[During this process, you are very likely to encounter fatal dangers. After all, there are countless dangers in the cosmic starry sky that can make even a Saint perish. Traveling in the Flying Saint Artifact is not considered safe.]
[Finally, you determine your next destination: Canglan Ancient Star. This ancient star, although like Elemental Star, belongs to the more remote ancient stars in the Big Universe, but it is far more powerful than Elemental Star and is also an ancient star where Great Emperors have been born.]
[According to historical records, 1.5 million years ago, Canglan Great Emperor was born on Canglan Ancient Star and finally achieved Enlightenment on Canglan Ancient Star one million years ago, stepping into the Great Emperor Realm!]

chapters.title: Chapter 629: 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! The Supreme Artifact is Ours
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! The Supreme Artifact is Ours
“However, even though you have determined your next destination to be the Canglan Ancient Star, you have still underestimated the dangers of the Cosmic Starry Sky. During the process of navigating through the universe using the Flying Saint Artifact, you unfortunately encountered an energy storm.”
“Facing such a terrifying energy storm, even a saint may not escape unscathed, let alone you who relies solely on the Flying Saint Artifact. Hence, you have fallen within this energy storm.”
“Because of your death, this simulation has ended…..”
…..
The text simulation paused here. Numerous scenes appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, with his figure finally appearing in the starry sky, gazing at the void energy storm stirring in the deep starry night sky, filled with both amazement and fear.”
“The universe is indeed quite dangerous. Even in the Profound World, it’s no exception. In fact, the Cosmic Starry Sky in the Profound World might be even more dangerous.”
Looking at this scene, Wang Ping sighed.
Soon after, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and his vision changed. He had exited the immersive simulation state and returned to the real world.”
“This free simulation has finally cleared a possible path for me. However, this path is not quite safe.”
With a gleam in his eyes, Wang Ping pondered silently.
After various calculations and the use of numerous hidden cards to kill Ruo Lan, the Semi-saint, the risk factor was too high and thus not suitable to carry out in reality.”
Only when he could face Ruo Lan in a head-to-head battle and suppress her, could he then truly carve out a lifeline for himself.”
After all, only by sealing Ruo Lan rather than killing her, could he prevent the Supreme from avenging her and pursuing him.”
Of course, the Supreme Artifact was another problem. If he could snatch that Supreme Artifact and seal it, he could buy even more time.”
As for how to survive this catastrophe in the real world, there were only two methods.”
That is, finding a way to the Central Star Realm in the Big Universe and seek protection from a genuine major power.”
Not a declining power like the Tao Palace, but a real major power backed by an Emperor.”
With an Emperor in charge, who would dare to act recklessly? Even the Supreme would have to bow before him.”
If he could join a power led by an Emperor, the dangers he would face then would only be cultivation mistakes and accidental falls.”
The likelihood of being targeted and killed by ancient monsters would undoubtedly be reduced to a minimum.”
“Of course, whether there are still Emperors in this era is another issue.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
However, whether an Emperor exists or not, finding a power that could serve as his protection was necessary.”
With the talent of his Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body, Wang Ping believed that as long as the power he chose wasn’t idiotic, it shouldn’t reject him, a promising seedling.”
“Should I continue with another free simulation and simulate my journey to the Canglan Ancient Star…?”
Next, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and began pondering about the simulation.”
“No, it’s not necessary to use a free simulation for uncertain factors. I may have lucked out and reached the Canglan Ancient Star this time, but that doesn’t guarantee success in the next. Without gaining any significant benefits, and with all insights disappearing after the simulation, there’s no point.”
“The last remaining opportunity for a paid simulation must be used wisely. The journey to the Canglan Ancient Star or other ancient stars is too long and dangerous. I’ll figure it out later.”
Wang Ping made his choice.”
Then, he murmured in his mind, “System, I want to carry out a paid simulation.”
“Ding, deducting 10,000 jin of Lower-tier God’s Source, the Life Simulator is being activated, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.”
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations host on successfully refreshing to Red Talent: Wood Profound Physique and Blue Talent: Pessimist.”
Red Talent: Wood Profound Physique: The host will get a certain talent in the path of wood.”
Blue Talent: Pessimist: The host will become very pessimistic, but will also surprisingly gain a tiny bit of luck.”
“What kind of talents are these? Seems like my bad luck is starting again.”
Looking at the refreshed talents, Wang Ping sighed.”
Indeed, his accumulated luck has been used up by the continuous good talents.”
“System, I choose Red Talent: Wood Profound Physique.”
After some hesitation, Wang Ping made his choice.”
A blue talent can enhance a bit of luck and it may seem attractive, but in reality, it’s a trap.”
A blue talent can increase luck by how much? But becoming a pessimist is really life-threatening.”
One must have strong faith for the cultivation path. Without strong will and faith, a constant pessimistic mindset can easily lead to stagnation.”
Hence, even though Red Talent: Wood Profound Physique might not be practical, at least it won’t hinder his ongoing cultivation.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful. Life Simulation begins….”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and entered the immersive simulation state.”
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar words surfaced.”
“On the first day, you chose to go to the Tao Palace. You successfully joined the Tao Palace… However, this time, although you still exposed your secrets in front of the Master of the Tao Palace, you chose not to become an elder but a normal deacon, maintaining a low profile.”
“Next, you acted according to your memories and successfully cultivated to the 7th-Tier God Monarch Realm. However, this time you did not take the risk to guide Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Ransmigrator, to the Purgatory Ancient Star.”

chapters.title: Chapter 630: 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_2
[Although it’s possible to kill her by doing this, it doesn’t really make much sense. After all, your main purpose in using the free simulation to continue luring and killing her last time was to test your own abilities.]
[This time, you plan to kill Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator, in a more sophisticated way – by boldly asking for the Emperor Force, and using the Imperial Force’s Might to kill Ruo Lan. It may seem like overkill, but you want to give it a try.]
[However, your expectations are clearly taken for granted. The Master of Tao Palace does not agree, nor does he have any intention of bringing out the Emperor Force. One, your relationship with him is not strong enough; two, only a saint can barely control the Emperor Force, and if it is awakened, it will consume too much energy and the cost will be too great; three, using it against a Semi-saint would be overly luxurious, as well as a laughing stock for other major powers, making Tao Palace the butt of jokes in the Upper Realm.]
[Listening to the Master of Tao Palace, you are somewhat helpless. It seems that the situation with the Emperor Force is more complicated than you thought, and not something that could be mobilized at any time.]
[Seeing your helplessness, the Master of Tao Palace curiously asks you why you are in such a hurry to deal with a Semi-saint. If you continue to cultivate for a while, it should be a very easy task for you to kill a Semi-saint with your own cultivation.]
[You can’t explain much, only that not only will she become a saint in the near future, but she also has a big background, a protective Supreme, and a deep grudge between you two. If you don’t kill her now, it will be very troublesome in the future.]
[Hearing your words, the Master of Tao Palace falls silent. After hesitating, he still believes what you say and makes a heavy decision. You are the hope of the Tao Palace’s future and cannot die. For this reason, he decides to ask a Self-titled Saint Ancestor to kill Ruo Lan.]
[Upon hearing the Master of Tao Palace making such a decision, you feel grateful, but you also think it’s not quite secure. Because Ruo Lan possesses a Self-titled Supreme Artifact, and if it can’t be killed in one strike, it will be very troublesome.]
[The Master of Tao Palace shakes his head, saying that a saint’s sneak attack on a Semi-saint should be more than enough to kill them. As for the Supreme Artifact, since it is in a sealed state and needs to be activated, it will take time, and that time will be enough for the saint to kill the Semi-saint countless times.]
[You don’t say anything more when hearing this. In fact, you also think the success rate is very high, but when it comes to dealing with Predecessor Transmigrators, you have always been cautious, wanting to completely kill them, otherwise a 98% probability is no different from courting death.]
[Soon, the Self-titled Saint Ancestor is summoned by the Master of the Tao Palace. And you, too, begin your move, leaving the mountain and luring Ruo Lan to take action. Ruo Lan is somewhat surprised when she detects that you have left the Tao Palace, and she cautiously follows.]
[When Ruo Lan sees you, she bursts out with terrifying strength without hesitation, wanting to kill you in one strike. However, just as she makes her move, you directly apply your Innate Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills. At the same time, the hidden Saint Ancestor also launches a thunderous attack on Ruo Lan.]
[Faced with this sudden situation, Ruo Lan is terrified, wanting to activate the Supreme Artifact, but it is too late. She is directly blasted to death by the terrifying attack of the Saint Ancestor.]
[Seeing all this, you can’t help but be amazed. Saints are indeed formidable. Ruo Lan, who had comprehended the laws and was about to step into the Saint Realm as a Semi-saint, could not even withstand a single attack from the saint, being directly obliterated without a trace left.]
[You can’t help but lament that it is really difficult for cultivators in this world to defeat a saint at a higher level.]
[Following Ruo Lan’s death, her Self-titled Supreme Artifact tears through space and disappears. The Saint Ancestor does not stop it, letting it leave. After all, this is a Supreme Artifact, and even for a saint, it is impossible and extremely suicidal to try to intercept it.]
[Afterwards, the Saint Ancestor sighs, stating that he will do a few more things for the Tao Palace before drifting away. And you, return to the Tao Palace.]
[Not long after, the entire Elemental Star is shaken. The saint of Tao Palace has reappeared, forcibly exterminating two major powers that had once been enemies of the Tao Palace and seized its territory. These two powers also have Self-titled saints at their core.]
[However, the saint of Tao Palace was just too powerful. As saints as well, the saints of the two powers were easily killed by the saint of the Tao Palace, completely perishing. As a result, the entire Elemental Star was shaken.]
[After all, it had been tens of thousands of years since a saint had fallen on the Elemental Star. Now, three saints had emerged at once, with two falling at once, which was simply too shocking.]
[At the same time, many forces once again realized that though the Tao Palace may be a skinny camel, it is still bigger than a horse and not to be trifled with. Powers that dare to provoke the Tao Palace should reconsider their abilities.]
[For a while, many forces with crooked intentions towards the Tao Palace have reined in their ideas, planning to change their attitude towards the Tao Palace.]
[You also hear the news and can’t help but be amazed. The saint of Tao Palace is indeed strong. Although he couldn’t defeat Ruo Lan, the Predecessor Transmigrator, in the previous simulation, upon reflection, Ruo Lan is a ruthless person who stepped into the Saint Realm in the Last Dharma Age, and also cultivated the Emperor Scripture, reaching the peak state. Naturally, the Self-titled Saint Ancestor of Tao Palace couldn’t easily defeat her.]

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Acquired the Supreme Artifact_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Acquired the Supreme Artifact_3
“However, if we’re dealing with a self-proclaimed saint who also has a limited lifespan, then their circumstances aren’t much different, and it will truly show who is stronger and who is weaker. Clearly, the saint from the Tao Palace who has cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture is slightly stronger.”
“Next, the Saint Ancestor of Tao Palace returned to the palace, settled some final affairs, imparted the Way of the Saints to you, and preserved the essence of the flesh and blood from the two saints that he had killed in the Tao Palace for your eventual use in Entering Saint. He then chose to pass away, returning to the cosmos.”
“Seeing this, you feel complicated emotions. After all, in a sense, this saint died because of you. Although it’s true that even if you hadn’t summoned this saint, when the Terrifying Strong with the Emperor Force arrived, the Tao Palace would still have fallen, and no one would have survived.”
“Afterwards, you continued your diligent cultivation, intending to quickly become a Saint, becoming a power who can traverse the starry sky to more expansive heavens and earth. Only if you become stronger can you prevent the Tao Palace from being destroyed in the real world.”
“Because of the essence of the flesh and blood of the saints refined by the Saint Ancestor, the Master of Tao Palace successfully stepped into the semi-saint tier. At the same time, you also rapidly improved your strength using these resources.”
“In just a few decades, you naturally advanced your cultivation to the 8th tier of the Divine Monarch realm.”
“It was at this time that the Terrifying Strong finnaly arrived at the Elemental Star with his Emperor Force and attacked the Tao Palace. In response, the last ancestor of Tao Palace sighed and chose to make a stand, fighting in the starry sky with the Emperor Force.”
“The Supreme of the Elemental Star acted as well, and the palace master was directly captured and died after being soul-searched. Then, after destroying Tao Palace, the Terrifying Strong joined the battlefield.”
“As for you, because of the Rebirth Tally, you entered a countdown state for resurrection.”
“When you resurrected, the great battle had already ended, and the Emperor Force of Tao Tian was sealed and exiled just like in your memories, while the whereabouts of the Terrifying Strong who came with the Emperor Force and the Supreme of Elemental Star were unknown.”
“After resurrecting, seeing the destroyed Tao Palace filled you with complex feelings. All you could do was sigh and leave.”
…..
“The Saint of Tao Palace deserves admiration. Perhaps in the simulation, the method of killing Ruo Lan is the best. However, the Tao Palace was still destroyed. This is a conclusion that currently cannot be changed.”
With a sigh in his heart, Wang Ping read the contents of the Text Simulation.
“However, dozens of years have passed, and the self-titled Supreme Realm ransmigrated predecessor has not appeared yet. He does not intend to make a move against me, does he?”
Wang Ping remembered the Supreme in Second-Generation Chat Group, frowning.
With Ruo Lan dead and the Supreme Artifact returning, he definitely knew what was going on.
However, dozens of years passed without any sign of him which seemed strange.
“Is he afraid of the Emperor’s Artifact of Tao Palace? That’s right, as a Supreme on the verge of death, he has no power to resist the Emperor’s artifact directly. He may not even be able to repel it. That means his current state is weaker than the Supreme hiding on the Elemental Star.”
Quickly, Wang Ping thought of the reason, his eyes sparkling.
“Of course, the biggest reason is probably that in the life simulation, he can’t contact other ransmigrators in the Second-Generation Chat Group. Otherwise, knowing that I’ve soared from the Nirvana Boundary to the Divine Monarch realm in a short time, the true powerhouses in the Second-Generation Chat Group won’t be able to sit still. They’d kill me at all costs.”
“By then, things like Life Origin and various trump cards are likely to go to the elder Supreme ransmigrator to deal with me.”
Upon pondering this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but smack his lips.
Earth’s forces, Wang Ping could avoid if he couldn’t afford to mess with them, but the people of the Myriad Heavens, especially the ransmigrators in the Second-Generation Chat Group, were like hedgehogs, too prickly to handle.
“The best solution is to lessen their fear of me.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, thinking to himself.
“That is, I can’t let these people know that I’m improving so quickly. That way, I won’t attract the attention of the big shots. Although they will still target me, they won’t do so excessively since they’ve weathered many storms. For now, they don’t know that I’m the one acting on behalf of the Third-Generation Chat Group.”
“So, the only option is to start with Ruo Lan. I need to devise a way to make my move when she can’t open the chat group for a livestream, and control her to make her fall into a deep sleep, or enslave her and make her submit to me completely.”
“If I can make her completely submissive to me and gain such a pawn, it would stop the Second-Generation Chat Group from targeting me.”
Thinking about this, Wang Ping’s eyes became increasingly bright.
Of course, even though this is the best choice, it’s not easy to achieve. Controlling a semi-saint isn’t difficult, with his cultivation progressing.”
The difficult part is how to deal with the Supreme Artifact belonging to the Supreme ransmigrator predecessor without letting it spread the news.”
Suppression would naturally arouse suspicion.
“Of course, to achieve this isn’t difficult, as long as I don’t show up and use other Supreme Artifacts to force it to run away.”
Quickly, Wang Ping thought of the demonic weapon: Black Abyss Demon Spear, and couldn’t help but laugh softly.
The elements to clear the level were more than halfway collected.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Obtained the Supreme Artifact_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Obtained the Supreme Artifact_4
Next, Wang Ping needs to refresh a strong enough talent to enslave Ruo Lan, or become strong enough to render her completely powerless.
“Don’t be too naive. The Second Generation Chat Group was created by that guy, and with his cunning and strength, he would surely leave something in the ordinary group members for monitoring. As soon as you enslave Ruo Lan, you’ll be detected.”
Alpha’s cold voice suddenly interrupted Wang Ping’s calculations.
“So you mean that enslaving Ruo Lan or suppressing her with my own strength won’t work, and that I’ll be exposed. The only way is to refresh a golden or higher control talent to solve the problem?”
Wang Ping frowned and asked.
“Exactly. That guy won’t be bored enough to monitor the actions of the group members every moment, and if he does so, he’ll surely incur the displeasure of those who are second only to him. After all, if you dare to monitor their every move in the name of the safety of the group members, wouldn’t you scheme against me in the future?”
Alpha nodded.
“Humans, that’s what they would think, right?”
“So, if you want to obtain information from the Second Generation Chat Group, you must obtain a colorful slavery talent of golden talent or higher to safely control Ruo Lan. That would be very beneficial for both you and me.”
After a pause, Alpha continued.
“Colorful…”
Wang Ping’s face twitched violently.
He hasn’t refreshed any colorful talents until now, and there are only a few golden ones. To refresh a colorful talent, especially a targeted control talent, the probability is too low, and it would take incredibly good luck…
“Without colorful talents, your unilateral actions will only backfire. At present, you are at most regarded with caution by the ransmigrators of the Second Generation Chat Group in this world, wanting to eliminate the potential enemies. If you attract the attention of a betrayer, you will be in grave danger.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out again, giving a warning.
Wang Ping was speechless.
Even the always reckless Alpha gave him a warning, which meant that the ransmigrator who had conspired to destroy the Second-generation Chat Group in the Slaughter Paradise was likely much stronger than he had imagined.
“I’m curious, what’s his name, and what level was he at before the Second Generation Chat Group was destroyed?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“His current name is Dao Yi, and as for his strength… he can destroy the Ten Great Universes with a wave of his hand.”
Alpha paused for a moment and gave a conservative answer.
“Uh…”
Wang Ping was silent.
Alright, he shouldn’t have asked.
Being able to destroy the Ten Great Universes with a wave of his hand, that strength is simply outrageous.
“Indeed, he is a freak, but excluding the time spent in the life simulation, I’ve only been in this world for about three years. In about three years, I’ve reached the God Monarch Realm, and in the future, I may not be weaker than him. So, there’s no need to fear him.”
Wang Ping exhaled and said confidently.
“Confidence is a good thing.”
Alpha left this sentence and then went silent.
As for Wang Ping, he shook his head and stopped thinking, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you continue to cultivate in the Elemental Star in hiding. Because of the remaining Saint Blood, your cultivating speed is not slow, but you’re ambitious and strive for perfection at each realm, leaving no hidden concerns.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed, and your cultivation has been once again elevated, breaking through to the 9th tier of the God Monarch Realm.]
[Time flies, and another five hundred years pass. You’ve exhausted all your resources and successfully broken through from the 9th tier of the God Monarch Realm to the Peak of God King Realm.]
[After reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the God Monarch Realm, you choose to leave seclusion and travel the world. During your travels, you accidentally hear about Ye Chen’s story.]
[It turns out that Ye Chen ascended to the Elemental Star over five hundred years ago and joined the Purple Cloud Divine Place. However, somehow, he offended the descendants of a big shot from the Central Ancient Star Domain and was imprisoned in Purple Cloud Divine Place’s dungeon.]
[It can be said that the young generation of the Elemental Star now ridicules Ye Chen for overestimating his abilities. An unknown lower realm cultivator dares to defy the descendants of a big shot – he’s simply courting death.]
[You frown, inquiring about the whole story. It turns out that after joining the Purple Cloud Divine Place, Ye Chen displayed formidable cultivation talents and was regarded highly by the Purple Cloud Divine Place, even having a past adventure experience with the Ninth Saintess of the Purple Cloud Divine Place and developing feelings for her.]
[However, who would have thought that not long ago, a big shot from the Central Ancient Star Domain arrived at the Elemental Star and was taken in by the Purple Cloud Divine Place. Just like the Mo family, the Purple Cloud Divine Place was weak in the Middle Area of the Elemental Star and couldn’t make a living, and they’d been increasingly oppressed by the rival Holy Land lately.]
