[Now, with the descendent of the big shot from the Central Ancient Star Domain residing in the Purple Cloud Divine Place, the Saint Lord of the Purple Cloud Divine Place wants to curry favor with the big shot’s descendant, so he presents the Ninth Saintess – who’s known as the First Beauty of Elemental Star – as a servant to him, hoping to gain his protection.]
[This apparently infuriates Ye Chen, who wants to flee the Purple Cloud Divine Place with the 9th Saintess and elope together. However, who could have expected that as soon as their escape begins, they are detected by the Saint Lord of the Purple Cloud Divine Place.]

chapters.title: Chapter 633: 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_5
[The Saint Lord of the Purple Cloud Divine Place was furious, inflicting serious injuries on Ye Chen and imprisoning him in the Holy Land’s jail. The Ninth Saintess’ cultivation was sealed, and she was assigned as a servant girl for the big shot’s descendant. The Ninth Saintess seemed resigned to her fate, or perhaps she chose to obey the Saint Lord’s arrangement to save Ye Chen’s life.]
[After learning the cause and consequence, you start considering your next move….]
…
The text simulation paused at this point, and Wang Ping’s mind filled with various images and cultivation insights. His vision also changed, arriving in the place where information is gathered.
“Am I at the branching path again?”
Wang Ping glanced at the content of the text simulation, the corner of his mouth twitching slightly.
“Such a clichéd development… I must say, Ye Chen is truly worthy of being the Son of Fortune; even in the Upper Realm, he can trigger this kind of outrageous plot. However, the Ninth Saintess of the Purple Cloud Divine Place is a devoted woman. Just that this green hat-like development is really hard to complain about.”
Apart from this, Wang Ping hadn’t expected that someone from the Central Ancient Star Domain would come to the remote Elemental Star.
Although the Elemental Star was slightly remote, it was not a completely impoverished place, as there were still many Saint Realm powerhouses and even hidden Supremes, but after all, it was too far away for people from the Central Ancient Star Domain to come here for leisure.
“I wonder what the other party’s goal is. If I can get a safe method to go to the Central Ancient Star Domain from him, that would be great.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, murmuring to himself.
The resources and various opportunities of the Elemental Star seemed incomparable to those of the Central Ancient Star Domain.
If he could go to the Central Ancient Star Domain, he could join a major power and then take off directly.
“No, Ye Chen is my disciple after all; it’s not okay for me to let him be bullied. Well, I don’t have any other thoughts.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping stroked his chin and muttered.
“On the other hand, Ye Chen, my dear disciple, this paid simulation is so precious that I can’t afford to save you and find out about that big shot’s descendant’s situation as well. After all, it’s a branching plot, and going there will definitely be a lost cause.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping muttered once more.
The last time he had a paid simulation, he needed to earn divine source again, so he couldn’t afford to waste it.
For intelligence and the like, free simulations can be used to obtain them.
Precious paid simulations must not be wasted recklessly.
“System, fast forward for me.”
After thinking it over, Wang Ping spoke up.
[After thinking it over, you decide not to get involved in the mess this time and head to the lower realm to search for the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s Life-bound Magic Weapon – Black Abyss Demon Spear. However, although you don’t want to get involved in the muddy water, sometimes muddy water will actively seek you out.]
[When you arrive in the lower realm and enter the Primordial Forbidden Land to see the Black Abyss Demon Spear, you start making promises. After acquiring the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Spear’s master and becoming a great Emperor in the future, you will take revenge for the spear’s master by exterminating the Green Bamboo Emperor and his inherited forces.]
[Because of your promises, and also because you demonstrated the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, the Black Abyss Demon Spear is taken aback by you. In the end, it chose to believe you: as long as you can help it lift the seal, it will recognize you as its master.]
[Seeing this, you are very satisfied, and you use the two Demonic Heavenly Stones combined into a key to unlock the seal of the Black Abyss Demon Spear. Afterward, the Black Abyss Demon Spear recognizes you as its master.]
[After obtaining the Black Abyss Demon Spear, you are extremely happy, laughing excitedly. After all, with the Black Abyss Demon Spear as your trump card, even when facing Saints, you can be fearless.]
…
“Well, I didn’t even consider this path of promising the Black Abyss Demon Spear. I never thought that the simulated Wang Ping would come up with this idea.”
As Wang Ping saw this, his eyes became subtle, and he felt a strange mood.
He had originally thought that obtaining the demonic spear would be a difficult ordeal.
Unexpectedly, it turned out to be so smooth.
With the demonic spear as a trump card, a lot of problems could be resolved easily, which made him feel comfortable.
Wang Ping sighed, then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you return to the Upper Realm. Not long after you return to the Upper Realm, an accident occurs. The Supreme Descendant from the Central Ancient Star Domain comes for you.]
[It turns out that the goal of this Supreme Descendant from the Central Ancient Star Domain is also to obtain the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s Life-bound Magic Weapon – Black Abyss Demon Spear. The reason he knows that the Black Abyss Demon Spear is in the lower Purple Spirit Realm of the Elemental Star is that of the Heavenly Calculation’s Child.]
[At the same time, he has a way to locate the Black Abyss Demon Spear. However, without finding the key to unlock the seal, he has no intention of going to the lower realm. When you bring the Black Abyss Demon Spear to the Upper Realm, he learns that someone has obtained the Black Abyss Demon Spear, taking away his opportunity.]
…
“So, this guy’s goal is also the Black Abyss Demon Spear. But what exactly is going on with this Heavenly Calculation’s Child? He led that Half-step Lord to the Purple Spirit Realm and also lured the Supreme Descendant to the Elemental Star to seize the Black Abyss Demon Spear.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content with furrowed brows.
Before, he was already very wary of this Heavenly Calculation’s Child, and now he was even more cautious.
He always felt that there was a huge conspiracy behind this person.

chapters.title: Chapter 634: 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Chapter 191: The Second Generation Group Leader! Supreme Artifact in Hand_6
“However, right now, it’s almost impossible for me to figure out who Heavenly Calculation’s Child really is, how powerful he is, and what his purpose is. There’s no point in worrying about it for now, and fearing him is useless.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, calming himself down.
“Instead of that, dealing with this Supreme Descendant is more important. With the Black Abyss Demon Spear, a Supreme Artifact, it shouldn’t be a problem to handle him. Even if he is a Saint or has a Dao Protector, facing the Black Abyss Demon Spear, he has only the option to flee.”
“Besides, as long as his cultivation isn’t at the Semi-saint tier, even if he also has a Supreme Artifact, I can protect my own life and force him to take me to the Central Ancient Star Domain with my Purple Talent – Fate Connection.”
Wang Ping was thinking in secret.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the simulation continued.
[You encounter the Supreme Descendant, who suddenly appears and blocks your way, demanding the Black Abyss Demon Spear. You are shocked and furious. However, it’s obvious that you have no intention of handing over the Black Abyss Demon Spear easily. As you prepare to unleash the Black Abyss Demon Spear at any moment, you also launch a terrifying attack on him.]
[With your current cultivation level, you have the confidence to kill even ordinary Semi-saints. Therefore, your only concern is the possible Dao Protector that this Supreme Descendant might have, not fearing him personally.]
[Faced with your attack, the Supreme Descendant is surprised. However, he sneers, saying he never expected that the Elemental Star would have such a genius like you. It’s a pity that you met him.]
[Then, this Supreme Descendant directly reveals his Semi-Saint Cultivation and starts fighting you. You didn’t expect the Supreme Descendant to be a Semi-Saint, and while somewhat troubled that the Purple Talent – Fate Connection cannot be used, you engage in a fierce battle with him.]
[Through this battle, you come to a conclusion. Although this Supreme Descendant is a Semi-saint, his fighting prowess is inferior to Ruo Lan, a Predecessor Transmigrator, far inferior, in fact.]
[Because this Supreme Descendant has not cultivated the Emperor Scripture, even though he has cultivated the Supreme Scripture, it is ultimately no match for the Emperor Scripture. In addition, he has not comprehended the Power of Manas; although he is not an ordinary Semi-saint, he can only be considered a stronger Semi-saint.]
[As you fight him, you unleash three types of Manas power, causing him to cough up blood. This makes his previous arrogance vanish in an instance, his face livid. He never expected that you could comprehend three types of Manas, including Space Law, with your Divine Monarch Realm cultivation.]
[This makes him feel deeply ashamed. As a genius of the Central Ancient Star Domain, he was defeated by someone from a remote star system in terms of talent and severely injured. It’s truly humiliating.]
[However, he is aware that he is no match for you. Even if he uses a suicidal secret skill to win, it would be meaningless.]
[So, he directly has his Dao Protector attack you. Instantly, a powerful Saint appears and launches a terrifying attack on you from up high.]
[A Saint’s attack is incredibly horrific; you are unable to take it, nor can you escape. However, you are prepared for it. As the Saint appears and launches the attack, you immediately unleash the Black Abyss Demon Spear, blocking their attack and injuring them in return.]
[Seeing this, the Supreme Descendant snorts coldly while revealing a Supreme Artifact and handing it over to the Saint.]
[Upon seeing this, you feel somewhat helpless. Every time you have a Sacred Artifact, Supreme Artifact, or Emperor’s Artifact, your opponent has the same. This greatly reduces your advantage.]
[Facing a Saint with a Supreme Artifact, you have no chance of survival. After a brief resistance, you are finally killed by the Saint wielding the Supreme Artifact.]
[However, due to the Red Talent – Death Speech, when the Supreme Descendant is happily about to search your dead body, you suddenly unleash a terrifying attack and activate the Purple Talent – Endless Blade, blowing his Physical Body into nothingness. This makes him furious and frustrated.]
[As you die completely, this simulation ends.]
…..
With the Text Simulation ending, many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. Finally, his figure showed up at the scene, looking at the Supreme Descendant who was a Divine Soul left and the stiff-faced old Saint.
“Still dead, huh. I really celebrated too early before. If the other party knew that I got the Black Abyss Demon Spear but still dared to come right to me, it means they must have a Supreme Artifact as well, or else they’re just giving me their head.”
After seeing this, Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
Of course, there was also a possibility that the other party thought that he would not be able to make the Black Abyss Demon Spear recognize him as its master.
However, this possibility seemed slim.
“Entering Saint, I must hurry up and enter the Saint Realm. Otherwise, it’s really unpleasant to be constantly bullied by Saints.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, becoming more eager for the Saint Realm.
Although he’s currently strong enough to demolish a Supreme Descendant with Semi-Saint Cultivation, he’s still far from being a Saint.
It was somewhat depressing to be constantly slapped to death by Saints.
While Wang Ping was muttering, his consciousness flickered, and he exited the immersive simulation state, returning to the real world.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Perfect Mastery of God Monarch Realm.
②. Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique.
③. Blue Talent: Pessimist.”
…..
“Uh… This time’s rewards are really shabby.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed rewards and couldn’t help but twitch his face.
It’s been so long since he had such shabby rewards, making him not know how to express his dissatisfaction.
“Perfect Mastery of God Monarch Realm… I wonder if I should choose it.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and began to seriously ponder.
He has to earn divine sources next.
With Divine Monarch Realm 1st Tier, it still seemed a bit risky to safely earn a large amount of divine sources.
With Perfect Mastery of God Monarch Realm, Wang Ping might feel a bit safer.
However, upgrading his cultivation would also increase the cost of Paid Simulations…

chapters.title: Chapter 635: 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Chapter 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!
“System, I choose ①. Perfect Mastery of God Monarch Realm!”
After thinking it through, Wang Ping finally made his choice.
After all, this was the last paid simulation, and since he needs to earn cultivation resources anyway, he might as well accept the price increase, and try to earn more.
Right now, power is the most important thing.
“Ding, reward selection successful…..”
The system’s voice resonated.
Then, Wang Ping felt his cultivation rapidly skyrocketing.
Divine Monarch Realm 3rd tier!
Divine Monarch Realm 4 tier!
Divine Monarch Realm 7th tier!
Divine Monarch Realm 9th tier!
Until, Peak of God King Realm!
“Hu, the feeling of perfect mastery of the God Monarch Realm is amazing.”
Wang Ping felt his own power and nodded in satisfaction.
Now, even if he were to face a half-saint who could potentially ascend to sainthood, he could easily kill them.
That is, facing someone like Ruo Lan who has already comprehended laws and cultivated the Emperor Scripture, it would be quite troublesome and not easy to defeat them.
“I’m running low on resources. Next, I will use the free simulation to scout, and see where I can get a large number of cultivation resources.”
Immediately, Wang Ping thought quietly.
“Of course, before that, I still need to inquire about the price. System, how much divine source do I need for paid simulation?”
Wang Ping took a breath and asked.
“Ding, detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the Major Completion Tier of the God Monarch Realm, the required resources for paid simulation are one thousand pounds of mid-tier divine source.”
The system’s voice resonated.
“One thousand pounds of mid-tier divine source….”
Although Wang Ping was mentally prepared, he couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth when he heard the price.
Mid-tier Divine Source is already very precious and rare.
For instance, the Tomb Divine King Realm powerhouse had about ten thousand pounds of lower-tier God’s Source but had only a few dozen pounds of mid-tier Divine Source.
This serves to illustrate their preciousness.
Mid-tier divine source would be quite rare, both during the Last Dharma Age and in other normal eras.
“One thousand pounds of mid-tier divine source for a single simulation, this is like taking my life!”
Wang Ping sighed.
One thousand pounds of mid-tier divine source, likely couldn’t be gathered even if you combined the foundations of the Green Spirit Divine Sect, the North Snow Divine Dynasty, and the Whiteflame Divine Sect, in fact, it would be far from enough.
The Three Great Forces might be a bit wealthier than the loose cultivator God Monarch Realm powerhouses, but at most, they would have around a hundred pounds of mid-tier divine source each, amounting to only around three hundred pounds in total.
Moreover, without any grudges, Wang Ping didn’t want to commit acts of arson, murder, and plunder.
As for the forces like Tao Palace…
Wang Ping has previously simulated many scenarios where he joined the Tao Palace, and since he had higher cultivation, he naturally knew some things about the Tao Palace.
The Tao Palace’s storage of lower-tier divine source was acceptable, but they only had about 1000 pounds of mid-tier divine source.
With even the Tao Palace in such a condition, the ordinary Holy Lands probably wouldn’t fare much better.
“I need to find a way to dig up a saint’s ancient tomb or obtain the inheritance of a powerful being before I can afford this paid simulation.”
Wang Ping was somewhat helpless.
“Ding, detecting that Yu Zhengtao’s world has appeared bizarre, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is a mandatory task, and the number of participants is limited to 2. Acting Group Owner Wang Ping will select group members to participate in the task. Please prepare accordingly if you wish to participate in the group task.”
It was at this moment that the chat group system’s voice sounded, causing Wang Ping to be slightly taken aback.
“Group task? Although I’ve known for a while that there’s something bizarre happening in Yu Zhengtao’s world, I didn’t expect the task to be triggered at this time.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
“You’ve been constantly complaining about resource problems, which is a bit annoying, so I’m giving you a loophole.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping’s eyes became subtle.
“Loophole? Why does going to kill the bizarre relate to a loophole? Although both Yu Zhengtao and I have the same worldview, it has nothing to do with the loophole, right?”
“Although Yu Zhengtao’s Lower Plane shares the same worldview as you, it doesn’t mean it belongs to the same Ten Great Universes and their lower planes.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded again.
“The worldview of your Profound World is vast, and the realm your world belongs to is just one of the stronger worlds.”
“I see. What does that have to do with the loophole?”
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow and asked doubtfully.
“His world, though part of the same world as yours, isn’t as powerful as yours. In that world, the strongest beings are merely saints. The laws of that world are flawed, so they can only give birth to saints.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded again.
“However, that world is not in the Last Dharma Age, and therefore has relatively abundant resources. To be precise, resources related to Divine Realm experts are more abundant. Anything above the level of saints is very rare, much rarer than your Ten Great Universes.”
“It’s just that different worlds have immunological rejection, and the immunological rejection of that world is very strong. You can’t stay there for too long.”
“I see.”
Wang Ping’s eyes became strange.
“So, this sudden activation of the group task is meant to allow me to stay longer for the purpose of completing the task, thus obtaining the resources of that world?”
“Exactly.”
Alpha’s voice rang out once again.
“Hey, Alpha, you’re really great! I’ll definitely never call you dumb again!”

chapters.title: Chapter 636: 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Chapter 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door! _2
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up, and he said with a grin.
He believed that while the Elemental Star was poor, it didn’t mean that other ancient stars in the Ten Great Universes were poor as well, especially the Central Ancient Star Domain, which couldn’t be poor.
But that place was too far away for him to reach.
In order to gather resources on the Elemental Star, he could only rob Holy Lands, but those Holy Lands had Saints guarding them, and it was very troublesome. Wang Ping needed to go to the outer world to obtain a Supreme Artifact to cope with them first.
However, doing that would attract the attention of lurking Supremes and be extremely dangerous.
Raiding those God Sects would at best gather enough resources for one Paid Simulation, which was meaningless.
Moreover, doing so would also attract the attention of many forces and be equally dangerous.
It could be said that Alpha’s move this time was indeed excellent, giving him a back door.
Alpha: “…..”
Wang Ping didn’t continue to tease Alpha, instead choosing to enter the chat group.
Wang Shuqi (74): “Oh, there are only two people who can participate in the Group Task this time. It’s quite rare…..”
Chen Yao (71): “Maybe the task is relatively simple this time. However, tasks requiring Mr. Wang to take action may not be that simple, which is a bit strange.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “No matter the situation, I want to participate in the task this time…..With Mr. Wang ascending, it’s been quite lonely. And in Yu Zhengtao’s world, there seems to be Void lords available for me to plunder power.”
Wang Ping (66): “You can go if you want to. There should be plenty of powerful people in that world for you to plunder cultivation from.”
Wu Jun (20): “Since Mr. Wang and Lin Yuanyuan said so, it seems that the participants of this task have been decided, and I won’t join in the fun.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Add me to the floor above.”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “Mr. Wang is coming to my world, shivering and looking forward with anticipation.jpg. By the way, I have a favor to ask of Mr. Wang.”
Wang Ping (66): “What’s the matter? Just say it.”
Yu Zhengtao (91): “In fact…the power where my master is seems to have offended a Quasi-Immortal Realm expert, and the situation is quite dangerous now.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Quasi-Immortal…I can fight it, but it doesn’t seem necessary for Mr. Wang to take action.”
Zhang Jun (70): “To be honest, I feel that Yuanyuan is a bit too confident. Although you have Quasi-Immortal cultivation, you are quite poor in understanding of Cultivation Skills, Pseudo Rules, and the like. You might even be surpassed by lower-level warriors if you don’t possess any Pseudo Rules.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “…..”
Wang Ping (66): “Although it’s a bit demoralizing, your fighting strength really is the weakest among the same realm. Unless you accumulate more mana to a terrifying level, you can only rely on brute strength to break through.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Understood. In the future, I’ll look for more men with powerful body refining, and forget about understanding Cultivation Skills, Mana understanding, and the like. It’s too troublesome, and I can only wait for the Golden Finger to optimize again and see if I can plunder all that as well.”
Fang Yun (3): “Good fellow, let us mourn for the body-refining experts of the future for three seconds.”
Wang Ping (66): “As for the task, let’s start later. I have something to do now.”
After dropping this remark, Wang Ping went offline.
Since he was going to Yu Zhengtao’s world to obtain resources, he needed to take some precautions.
After all, there were Saints in that world.
Although Wang Ping was not afraid of Saints and could use the chat group to flee if he couldn’t win, it was undoubtedly a trouble in terms of obtaining resources.
So, Wang Ping planned to obtain the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear first and then go to Yu Zhengtao’s world.
With the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, even if he encountered a Saint, Wang Ping could fight against them, or even kill them.
After all, the strongest person in that world was only a Saint Realm cultivator, and it would be impossible to have something like a Supreme Artifact there.
That is to say, with the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, Wang Ping could walk sideways in that world.
“Next, I need to visit the Green Spirit Divine Sect and obtain another piece of demonic stone from the hands of their Ancestor. In addition, I have to get my hands on Array-breaking Talismans. By the way, I should also snatch that Withered Treasure Elixir from the North Snow Divine Dynasty’s Ancestor.”
After some thought, Wang Ping’s figure flashed and merged into the space, disappearing quickly.
…
At the Green Spirit Divine Sect, it was the time for the True Inheritance Competition, which was incredibly lively. All kinds of powerful people were invited to watch the battle.
Because the Green Spirit Divine Sect’s True Inheritance Competition served to announce to the outer world how outstanding their disciples were, and also to recruit more talented individuals into the sect.
It was at this moment that a figure suddenly appeared in the sky above the viewing platform, causing all the experts within the Green Spirit Divine Sect to suddenly shrink their pupils.
Whether they were Void Divine Realm cultivators or True Divine Realm cultivators, they were all stunned to find that they couldn’t see through the newcomer’s cultivation.
“May I ask who you are and why you are trespassing into my Green Spirit Divine Sect?”
The Green Spirit Divine Sect Master’s face darkened as he questioned.
From the sky, Wang Ping looked down on the Green Spirit Divine Sect without answering, simply revealing his calm aura.
In an instant, the aura of a God Monarch Realm covered the entire scene, causing the faces of everyone present to turn pale. Whether they were Void lords or True Lords, they all felt suffocated.
The Green Spirit Divine Sect Master, who had questioned Wang Ping, was even paler, showing a horrified expression.
“God, God Monarch Mid-stage, no… It seems even more than that!”

chapters.title: Chapter 637: 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Chapter 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_3
He spat out these words with a terrified look on his face.
He knew that anyone who dared to barge into his Green Spirit Divine Sect was definitely not an ordinary cultivator; they had to be at least at the Great Perfection of the True Divine Realm, or even a half-step God King Realm strongman.
As for a God Monarch, it wasn’t impossible either.
But, even if it was a God Monarch, he was not afraid.
After all, this was the Green Spirit Divine Sect, and the Ancestor was still cultivating in the depths of the mountains, and the Mountain Protection Array could still be activated.
By then, even if they faced a Divine Monarch Realm 4 tier powerhouse, they could still resist.
But he hadn’t expected Wang Ping’s aura to be so terrifying, far surpassing that of the God Monarch Realm ancestor of the Green Spirit Divine Sect. It definitely wasn’t as simple as the early or middle stages of the God Monarch Realm.
Facing such a strong opponent, his Green Spirit Divine Sect was absolutely unable to resist.
However, fortunately, the God Monarch Realm powerhouse in front of him didn’t seem to have any ill intentions and didn’t get angry because of his previous questioning.
Otherwise, just the aura alone would be enough to kill a large number of people.
“I don’t know why fellow Taoist came to my Green Spirit Divine Sect, but if I can help you, I will do my best to help you.”
At this moment, another God Monarch Realm aura appeared.
Then, an old man in a green robe appeared in the air, facing Wang Ping, with a gentle expression on his face.
“I need a stone from you, and I can exchange something with you.”
Wang Ping looked at the Green Spirit Ancestor and spoke lightly.
“Stone?”
Green Spirit Ancestor’s eyes flickered, thinking of the black stone he had acquired by accident.
Obviously, that stone was not ordinary.
Otherwise, the strong man in front of him, who was at least at the Divine Monarch Realm 7th tier, wouldn’t have come here to ask for it.
For a moment, the Green Spirit Ancestor didn’t want to give it up.
After all, this stone might contain a great secret that could help him advance further.
“My time is very valuable, and I hope fellow Taoist doesn’t make it difficult for me.”
Wang Ping could see the thoughts of the Green Spirit Ancestor, snorted coldly, and directly unleashed an even stronger aura.
In an instant, the aura of the Peak of God King Realm swept across the sky, turning the Green Spirit Ancestor’s face pale.
“God, Peak of God King Realm!”
Green Spirit Ancestor only felt his scalp go numb.
Peak of God King Realm, this was the level of a person like the Master of Tao Palace and the Middle Area Zhang Family Master.
Even many Saint Masters of Holy Lands might not necessarily have such cultivation.
Such a figure, let alone destroying his entire Green Spirit Divine Sect, could not even protect the Combined resources of the North Snow Divine Dynasty and the Whiteflame Divine Sect from destruction.
“Since fellow Taoist likes this stone, I will give it to you as a gift.”
Immediately, Green Spirit Ancestor hurriedly spoke, took out the Demonic Heavenly Stone, and handed it to Wang Ping, fearing that Wang Ping would slap him to death and destroy the Green Spirit Divine Sect.
“I told you, I am here to trade with you. Take this top-tier Divine Artifact.”
Wang Ping took the Demonic Heavenly Stone and put it into his storage space, then casually took out a Top-tier Divine Artifact and threw it to the Green Spirit Ancestor.
The Demonic Heavenly Stone would be useless in Green Spirit Ancestor’s hands, and it would bring disaster to him. Wang Ping taking it away was actually saving his life.
But for outsiders, Wang Ping’s actions were undoubtedly like a robbery. In order not to be slandered and so that he could join forces like the Tao Palace in the future, Wang Ping still took out a top-tier Divine Artifact to compensate the other party.
After all, this top-tier Divine Artifact was won by lottery from his life simulation experiences, which were not very useful to Wang Ping now, and since Xu Yi had multiplied a few more, it didn’t matter much. Giving it away as compensation to the other party was the most appropriate thing to do.
“Top-tier Divine Artifact!”
When the Green Spirit Ancestor saw the top-tier Divine Artifact thrown by Wang Ping, he showed an excited expression.
Top-tier Divine Artifacts were not something that ordinary God King Realm powerhouses could possess in the Elemental Star today.
Only those God King Realm powerhouses from major powers or those loose cultivators with amazing cultivation were eligible to possess a Top-tier Divine Artifact.
As a result, although the Green Spirit Ancestor was a God King Realm powerhouse, he was still using mere top-tier Divine Artifacts, which made him feel very awkward.
Now, after acquiring a top-tier Divine Artifact, he was naturally delighted, and his previous depression was completely dispelled.
As for that piece of stone, although he didn’t know where it came from, compared to the tangible increase in power provided by this top-tier Divine Artifact, it was nothing.
Not to mention, he had no choice in the matter.
Therefore, after putting away the top-tier Divine Artifact with a smile, the clear-minded Green Spirit Ancestor cupped his hands towards Wang Ping and said, “Thank you, fellow Taoist.”
Wang Ping didn’t say much more, displaying Space Divine Skills and disappeared in an instant.
After Wang Ping left, the cultivators below breathed a sigh of relief, looking at each other in disbelief that they had witnessed such a thing.
…..
Next, Wang Ping moved on to the North Snow Divine Dynasty and performed the same operation.
Faced with Wang Ping, who was at the Peak of God King Realm, North Snow Divine Dynasty also complied and handed over the Withered Treasure Flower obediently.
After obtaining these two items, Wang Ping was very satisfied and began to obtain the most important item.
That was the Array-breaking Talisman.
A talisman capable of breaking the corner of the Great Array left behind by the Green Bamboo Array’s inception was obviously not something a regular array-breaking talisman could do.
However, with so many simulation experiences under his belt, Wang Ping naturally knew where Young Master Mo got that Array-breaking Talisman.
On the Elemental Star, there was once an extremely powerful Rune Master who was said to be capable of breaking even the Great Arrays set up by the Supreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 638: 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Chapter 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_4
In fact, he indeed had the ability.
However, this Rune Master had already passed away, leaving only a few runes flowing on the Elemental Star.
The Array-breaking Talisman of the Mo family was obtained from a mountain range in the Middle Area.
To be precise, it was found in a Jiao Dragon’s cave.
That Jiao Dragon was extremely powerful, possessing Semi-Saint Cultivation.
In Young Master Mo’s memory, the Mo family had paid a considerable price to kill this Jiao Dragon. Their only Semi-Saint, wielding a Sacred Artifact, had almost been killed by the Jiao Dragon instead.
“Monster beasts have powerful physical bodies and are very difficult to deal with. Jiao Dragons are even stronger among monster beasts. Although they are not as powerful as the true Dragon Clan, they also belong to the category of powerful bloodlines. It is normal for a human Semi-Saint of the same realm to lose to them.”
Wang Ping used his Space Divine Skills to quickly head toward the mountain range where the Jiao Dragon’s nest was located, his eyes flickering.
However, for Wang Ping, he was still quite confident in suppressing this Jiao Dragon.
After all, he had mastered three Laws, and even that Semi-Saint with Supreme bloodline in the simulation was not his opponent; Wang Ping defeated him easily.
Half a day later, Wang Ping had arrived at the mountain range where the Jiao Dragon’s nest was.
“Fellow taoist, I am Bai Tianhong. I wish to make a deal with you and hope you can come out and meet me.”
Wang Ping looked down at the Jiao Dragon’s nest, his eyes flickering, and spoke.
As soon as Wang Ping’s words fell, the lake where the Jiao Dragon was hiding began to churn.
Immediately afterward, a single Jiao Dragon burst out of the lake, soaring into the sky and blocking out the sun.
“Human cultivator, leave or die.”
The Jiao Dragon hovered in the sky, looking down at Wang Ping, and spoke from a superior position.
As it said these words, a terrifying Semi-Saint divine power erupted, covering the entire mountain range.
For a time, all the monster beasts shivered, and their fear reached an extreme.
In addition, the human cultivators who were either training or seeking opportunities in the mountain range also felt their scalp go numb as they watched this scene.
They thought that Wang Ping was courting death by provoking the overlord of this mountain range.
This Jiao Dragon had once devoured a human Semi-Saint, and was infamous. Even the major powers of the Middle Area wouldn’t dare provoke it easily.
“I give you two choices, give me the Array-breaking Talisman, and I will spare your life; otherwise, I will slaughter you, this worm, today.”
Wang Ping held a Holy artifact long sword that was emitting a terrifying divine power and pointed it at the Jiao Dragon, sneering.
“Arrogant!”
The Jiao Dragon roared, instantly enraged.
Let alone a Divine Monarch Realm human cultivator, even a Semi-Saint wouldn’t dare to be insolent before it.
Now, a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator, relying on his Sacred Artifact, dared to challenge its authority and didn’t take it seriously in the slightest. If it didn’t slaughter Wang Ping, who would fear it?
So, even if the Jiao Dragon thought that Wang Ping might be a cultivator from a major power, it no longer cared and planned to tear Wang Ping into pieces alive and then swallow him whole.
“The Jiao Dragon is enraged! Everyone run!”
Seeing the Jiao Dragon’s rage, the cultivators and monster beasts among the mountains were all terrified to the extreme, turning into Divine Halos and escaping quickly.
Among them, there was even a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator.
“Roar!”
At this moment, the Jiao Dragon roared again, and its terrifying sound waves swept across the entire mountain range, causing the bodies of countless innocent monster beasts and human cultivators to explode, turning into a blood fog, and dying miserably.
Even that Divine Monarch Realm cultivator’s body was blown apart.
However, as a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator, he wouldn’t be shaken to death by the Jiao Dragon’s stray sound waves. His body reassembled, and he fled again with a pale face.
At the same time, his heart was filled with hatred for Wang Ping.
Of all the things he could do, he had to provoke the Jiao Dragon. Now, his own life was in danger because of it.
“Since you’re seeking your own death, don’t blame me.”
Seeing the Jiao Dragon attacking him, Wang Ping snorted coldly, and as the Space Law emerged, he disappeared from the spot, avoiding the Jiao Dragon’s attack. With the Holy artifact long sword in hand, he struck fiercely.
In an instant, a terrifying Divine Skill, wrapped in Space Divine Skills and Great Perfection Pseudo-Law of the Sword, slammed into the Jiao Dragon’s body, cutting through its hard scales. The light golden blood sprayed out violently. Each drop weighed heavily as a thousand pounds.
“This is the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and Space Law… Are you from Tao Palace!?”
The Jiao Dragon was struck by Wang Ping, screaming in pain.
However, what frightened it even more was the Space Law and Tao Tian Emperor Scripture Wang Ping used just now, and it could not help but scream.
The Tao Tian Emperor Scripture was a very peculiar Emperor Scripture that could be described with a thousand changes and countless possibilities.
That was to say, it could deduce numerous divine skills, so no matter which path the cultivator took, as long as they cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, they could deduce divine skills that belonged exclusively to their own path.
Although the strength of these divine skills could not be compared to the offensive divine skills recorded in other Emperor Scriptures, only Emperor Tao Tian himself could use them without losing to the divine skills recorded in other Emperor Scriptures. Still, this adaptability was the most astonishing.
Therefore, the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture was the most powerful Emperor Scripture for cultivating the younger generation and enhancing the foundation and had always been coveted by many forces.
For this reason, even the Jiao Dragon, as a monster beast, knew about the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and had even observed scenes of the Tao Palace powerhouses using divine skills derived from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.
As soon as Wang Ping used the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, the Jiao Dragon immediately recognized that Wang Ping had cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.

chapters.title: Chapter 639: 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Chapter 192: Peak of God Monarch Realm! Alpha takes the back door!_5
In addition to cultivating, Wang Ping had also gained insight into the Space Law, so he couldn’t help but doubt whether Wang Ping was an old monster reincarnated, or a terrifying monster hidden in the Tao Palace.
The latter conjecture was even more frightening than the former.
Great Perfection in God Monarch Realm, understanding the Space Law, this kind of talent is too shocking and not something he could provoke.
Leaving aside the question of whether or not he could defeat Wang Ping now, even if he could, he absolutely could not keep Wang Ping here.
If Wang Ping were to return to the Tao Palace and bring out even more terrifying characters, he would undoubtedly die.
“What’s the difference?”
Wang Ping holds his sword, speaking calmly.
“If it is true, then it’s just a misunderstanding. I have some connections with the Tao Palace, and there’s no need to fight to the death,” the water dragon said as he transformed into a human, covering his difficult-to-heal wound with laughter.
“I don’t know what kind of deal my fellow taoist wants to make with me?”
“Connections?”
Wang Ping’s gaze became strange, knowing that the water dragon was talking nonsense and only softening because it was not good to provoke him.
However, since the water dragon had softened, Wang Ping didn’t have any intention of killing it.
After all, he had no grievances with the water dragon, and he only came here to get the Array-breaking Talisman.
“I wonder what kind of deal my fellow taoist wants to make with me?”
Immediately, the water dragon spoke again, looking serious.
“I need an Array-breaking Talisman, and you have one here,” Wang Ping said.
“Array-breaking talisman? If my fellow taoist wants it, take it,” the water dragon replied, slightly startled, before generously handing the Array-breaking Talisman to Wang Ping.
“Since my fellow taoist is so polite, I accept it.”
Washing ping laughed softly and received the Array-breaking Talisman.
This water dragon was quite generous by giving him the Array-breaking Talisman.
This thing was absolutely worth a fortune and even more valuable than a Sacred Artifact.
“Haha, no need to be polite. As a guest, why not have a drink at my Cave Mansion? I have some top-grade Immortal Brew here,” the water dragon laughed heartily and passionately said.
“Brother Jiao, maybe next time. I still have things to do,” Wang Ping replied with a slight smile as he bowed his hand.
“Alright, next time then.”
The water dragon nodded his head.
Afterward, Wang Ping didn’t say much to the water dragon. Instead, he used his Space Divine Skills and disappeared in an instant.
“Phew, I met a tough guy, but I managed to save my life. In the future, when I encounter a Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator, I should not be too domineering. Who knows if this guy is pretending to be weak to catch a dragon,” the water dragon sighed after Wang Ping left, returning to his Cave Mansion.
At that moment, the God King Realm powerhouse who had escaped watched this scene with his eyes wide open and his mouth agape. He didn’t expect Wang Ping to be a member of the Tao Palace, and even force the water dragon to submit.
However, he didn’t dare to stay any longer, fearing that the water dragon would feel ashamed and come back to kill him.
…..
After obtaining the Array-breaking Talisman, Wang Ping decided to go to the Purple Spirit Realm.
When Wang Ping arrived at the Purple Spirit Realm, he actively sealed his cultivation and went to the Primordial Sacred Land.
After arriving at the Primordial Sacred Land, Wang Ping didn’t intend to visit Saint Master Taichu, but quietly entered the Primordial Forbidden Land. He acted as if the so-called restrictions and Great Array didn’t exist for him.
After entering the Primordial Forbidden Land, Wang Ping unsealed his cultivation.
After all, one didn’t need to seal their cultivation in the Primordial Forbidden Land, which was isolated from the outer world.
However, even with his Perfect Mastery of the God Monarch Realm and having comprehended three different laws, Wang Ping still didn’t underestimate the black fog and had prepared to defend himself in every way possible. He even brought out two Sacred Artifacts.
Then, Wang Ping ventured deep into the Primordial Forbidden Land and saw the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s life-bound weapon – the Black Abyss Demon Spear.
After breaking open a corner of the Great Array with the Array-breaking Talisman, Wang Ping went in.
Next, Wang Ping started to honey-pot the Black Abyss Demon Spear, just like in the life simulation and made it confused.
In the end, Wang Ping took out the key and successfully obtained the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s life-bound weapon – the Black Abyss Demon Spear.
“What a nice spear, it’s a pity I don’t use a spear,” Wang Ping muttered while stroking the body of the Black Abyss Demon Spear.
Of course, although Wang Ping used the sword, he could use the spear in place of the sword.
Not to mention, Wang Ping didn’t use the sword much now. His means were not limited to any specific weapon.
After all, he wasn’t a pure sword cultivator anymore.
Next, Wang Ping had the Black Abyss Demon Spear conceal its aura before putting it into his own body’s divine kingdom. Then, he left the Primordial Forbidden Land.
“Saint Master Taichu once helped me in life simulation. This time, I took the Black Abyss Demon Spear, which, to a certain extent, removed a landmine. However, it essentially destroyed the Trial Place of the Primordial Forbidden Land. So, I should leave something for him as compensation,” Wang Ping thought.
After pondering, Wang Ping left enough Lower-tier God’s Source for Taichu to break through to the Void Divine Realm and a Lower-Tier Divine Technique in Taichu’s palace. Then, he quietly left the Primordial Sacred Land.
After Wang Ping left, Saint Master Taichu emerged from his cultivation state. Seeing this mass of Lower-tier God’s Source emitting a divine aura, as well as the Lower-Tier Divine Technique, he was completely stunned.
With such a pie falling from the sky, he wondered if he was hallucinating and rubbed his eyes vigorously.
When he found that it was all real and was somewhat surprised about where these things came from, he was also overjoyed.
…..
Wang Ping did not know about Saint Master Taichu’s reaction, and would have just laughed it off if he saw it.
At this point, Wang Ping has arrived at Lin Yuanyuan’s side. After saying something to her, he opened the group chat page and prepared to go on a Group Task.
However, Lin Yuanyuan didn’t ask why Wang Ping had taken so long to start the task and even chose to find her in the lower realm.
To cling to a powerful thigh, it’s better to do more and ask less, just shout 666 and get it done.

chapters.title: Chapter 640: 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Chapter 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth
With a flash of white light, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan left the Purple Spirit Realm and arrived in the world where Yu Zhengtao was.
This caught Yu Zhengtao by surprise.
Then, Yu Zhengtao revealed a joyful expression, saying, “Brother Wang, you’re finally here!”
“I was held up by some matters. How’s the situation on your side?”
Wang Ping patted Yu Zhengtao’s shoulder and asked.
“The situation is quite troublesome,” Yu Zhengtao replied helplessly.
“My Holy Land in the Hongwu Continent isn’t considered weak, with an Ancestor in the Emperor Great Perfection Realm. However, we offended a Quasi-Immortal, which is quite problematic, putting our heritage in danger of being cut off.”
“How did your Holy Land offend that Quasi-Immortal?” Lin Yuanyuan asked curiously.
“It’s nothing serious. That Quasi-Immortal’s descendant fancied the Holy Woman of my White Bone Holy Land, shamelessly pursued her, and was beaten up by her. Then, the opponent’s Ancestor showed up, demanding the Holy Woman to be married off to his descendant, otherwise, the White Bone Holy Land would be destroyed.”
Yu Zhengtao said with a bitter smile.
“Now, the Holy Land is prepared to compromise. After all, despite the Holy Woman’s nobility, she has to be sacrificed in order to preserve the Holy Land’s inheritance.”
“Do you like that Holy Woman?” Wang Ping asked with a strange look on his face.
“Ahem…”
Yu Zhengtao coughed, nodding with slight embarrassment.
“If you like her, go after her. There’s no need to be shy.” Wang Ping laughed, “I’ll infuse you with some power later, so you can show off and try to win her heart.”
“Uh…later?” Yu Zhengtao was taken aback.
“White Bone, have you made your decision?”
At this moment, a gloomy voice sounded.
Then, an oppressive aura covered the area where the White Bone Holy Land was located, making numerous cultivators turn pale.
This caused Yu Zhengtao to regain his senses, understanding the meaning behind Wang Ping’s words just now.
It was apparent that Brother Wang noticed the arrival of the Quasi-Immortal in advance, and thus asked him to show off.
“Brother Wang, I want to show off and beat him up later.” Yu Zhengtao clenched his fist and said excitedly.
A Profound Elixir Realm cultivator beating up a Quasi-Immortal would probably make him famous throughout the Hongwu Continent.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded, immediately using a Secret Skill to pour a surge of power into Yu Zhengtao’s body, allowing him to control it at will.
Although this power was consumable and not completely granted to Yu Zhengtao, it was enough for him to use for a while.
“Does this count as a variation of being possessed by a ghost?” Yu Zhengtao mumbled while sensing the tremendous power within him.
“Who are you calling a ghost?” Wang Ping darkened his expression, smacking Yu Zhengtao’s forehead.
“Cough, sorry, Brother Wang, I misspoke.”
Yu Zhengtao scratched his head awkwardly.
Lin Yuanyuan, on the side, couldn’t help but cover her mouth and giggle, feeling that Yu Zhengtao seemed slightly naive.
What happened next was not suspenseful.
Although the White Bone Holy Land’s Ancestor, White Bone Taoist, was aggrieved, he still planned to send the Holy Woman away.
Initially, the Holy Woman of the White Bone Holy Land had given up hope, but after Yu Zhengtao’s sudden appearance, the Demonic Cultivator Quasi-Immortal was subdued. Everyone was shocked, especially the Holy Woman, who had developed admiration for Yu Zhengtao.
“Brother Wang, what should we do next?” Lin Yuanyuan asked curiously after watching the drama play out with relish.
“The show is over, so it’s time to leave. Little Yu’s golden finger involves getting stronger by taking a beating, which won’t help against the cunning ones, so there’s no need to bring him along. Let him continue to develop feelings with the Holy Woman of the White Bone Holy Land.”
Wang Ping stretched lazily and casually spoke.
“Of course, our purpose for coming to this world is not solely to deal with the cunning ones.”
Wang Ping paused for a moment, then continued.
“What do you mean?” Lin Yuanyuan asked with a puzzled expression.
“Since we’re here, naturally we should gather some resources before leaving. My world’s Upper Realm is in the Last Dharma Age, and resources are scarce. I’m currently quite poor, lacking resources to utilize my golden finger ability.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“So, after finding the cunning one, I won’t kill him right away. I’ll head to the Upper Realm of the Hongwu Continent to collect some resources first. At that time, I’ll also help you plunder the power of some God King Realm powerhouses.”
“Although your current golden finger can’t plunder Cultivation Skills, insights into the laws, and so on, as long as your power catches up, you can still secure the chat group’s second or third in command position. I have high expectations for you, hoping that you can become my right-hand man, and help me deal with formidable enemies in the future.”
In the end, Wang Ping patted Lin Yuanyuan’s shoulder, giving her some motivational words.
“Thank you, Brother Wang! I believe that once I’ve saved enough group points to optimize my golden finger again, I’ll be able to plunder insights into Cultivation Skills and such. At that time, I will definitely not let Brother Wang down!”
Lin Yuanyuan took a deep breath, speaking with a serious expression.
“Mm.”
Wang Ping nodded without saying anything further.
Then, Wang Ping closed his eyes and directly said in his heart, “System, I want to start the free simulation.”
“Ding! Life Simulator starting, free simulation begins!”
In an instant, the system’s voice resounded, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, knowing that he had entered the immersive simulation state.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: Chapter 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth_2
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the words emerged.
[On the first day, you took action, using a very crude method, directly using the Sacred Artifact, intending to blow up Hongwu Continent. A terrifying force was brewing, and everyone showed expressions of horror.]
[And on Hongwu Continent, when the strange saw this scene, he felt his scalp tingling and cursed you as a madman. Then, he wanted to forcibly leave the Hongwu Continent before you destroyed it and flee this world.]
[As the strange escaped, an anomaly occurred, and you easily found the strange’s location, learned his true identity, and then blew him up directly.]
[Due to the strange’s death, the simulation ends.]
…..
The text simulation stopped here, and many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, with the strange’s face being particularly clear.
Then, Wang Ping exited the immersive simulation and returned back to reality.
“This time, it was really easy. This strange seems to be just another small figure among the strange ones.”
Wang Ping opened his eyes, his gaze flickering.
His current strength was too powerful that he could directly destroy the world in the simulation, forcing the strange out – An extremely effective tactic.
Of course, this might work against weaker strangers but could be suicidal against stronger ones.
However, there was still hope to force them out, and the goal would be achieved.
On the contrary, this tactic would not work against particularly weak strange ones.
Because they don’t have the ability to meet the criteria for destruction and forced withdrawal.
“Of course, although he is just a henchman among the strange ones, since he can forcibly leave the place, it proves that he already has the ability to destroy the Hongwu Continent. I still need to find out what his capabilities are and how he would destroy the Hongwu Continent.”
Wang Ping thought of this point and closed his eyes again.
Seeing Wang Ping close his eyes, Lin Yuanyuan knew that he was using his abilities again and continued to wait quietly without asking any questions.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, life simulation started, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out, and Wang Ping entered the immersive simulation.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared again, and the familiar words floated out.
[On the first day, you easily found the strange and observed his every move with your divine sense. Because your cultivation level was too high and your divine sense was too strong, the strange did not notice your surveillance.]
[Quickly, you learned what the strange’s ability was. It is Control. This strange can arbitrarily control beings weaker than or equal to himself.]
[And the being this strange possessed has now reached the Quasi-Immortal Tier. In other words, any character at the Quasi-Immortal tier and below can be controlled by him in an instant.]
[However, on the Hongwu Continent, there are Void Divine Realm cultivators who have not ascended due to suppressing their cultivation levels. This world is different from the Ten Great Universes, where the upper and lower realms are not so troublesome, and the lower realms can easily contact the upper realms.]
[Therefore, although the strange can control Quasi-Immortals and those below, he cannot control beings above the Void Divine Realm. Unless his power reaches the caliber of a Void lord, only then can he control them.]
[Of course, this is already enough for the strange. He can control the life and death of those under his control st his whim. Although he can’t kill Void lords, it’s enough to destroy the living beings of the Hongwu Continent.]
[It’s just that the strange wants to slaughter all the living beings on Hongwu Continent, not even leaving a single survivor, so he hasn’t taken action to destroy these beings yet.]
[After understanding the whole story, you become serious. The strange’s ability is extremely perverse. He didn’t need to look at any living being but directly made a rule-level judgment. As long as you are weaker than him, you will be controlled by him. It’s too perverse.]
[Obviously, if this strange grows up, he will become unimaginably terrifying in the future. Therefore, you develop the idea of killing him.]
[However, you didn’t act immediately, but decided to test something first. You directly caught a Void lord, let Lin Yuanyuan plunder his power, and then Lin Yuanyuan became a Void Divine Realm Master.]
[After all, Lin Yuanyuan is only at the Quasi-Immortal Tier now, and she can also be controlled by the strange, which is very dangerous.]
[After making Lin Yuanyuan a Void Divine Realm Master, you forced the strange to activate his ability, killing all those under his control. In an instant, all those controlled by him turned into a blood fog. However, Lin Yuanyuan, who had already become a Void Divine Realm Master, was unharmed.]
[This made you slightly relieved. You originally thought that once controlled, even if your cultivation level becomes higher than the strange’s, something would still go wrong. Now it seems that you were overthinking it. If you’re controlled even after your cultivation improves, that would be too terrifying.]
[Afterward, you sealed the strange and took Lin Yuanyuan to the upper realm where the Hongwu Continent was located.]
…
“This strange’s ability is really powerful. I wish I could refresh and obtain a similar talent in the future.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, feeling envious.
With such an ability, he would have as much fighting power as he wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 642: 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Chapter 193: Destroying the Saint! Extreme Wealth_3
[When you arrived in the Upper Realm, you were immediately surrounded. Many people from various major powers asked about which power’s Flying Immortal you were.]
[In response, you felt rather perplexed, as this was quite different from the Purple Spirit Realm and Primordial Star. You ignored these people and chose to leave with Lin Yuanyuan.]
[These Void Divine Realm Masters watched you use Space Divine Skills and were all dumbfounded, not expecting you to be so powerful.]
[Next, you began to think about how to reasonably obtain large amounts of mid-tier Divine Source and even top-tier Divine Origin in this world.]
[First, you gathered some information and found that the territory of this Upper Realm was much larger than that of the Elemental Star, and the number of Divine Realm Experts, especially the number of God King Realm powerhouses, also far exceeded that of Elemental Star.]
[In Elemental Star, there were less than a hundred openly known God Monarch Realm experts, while in this Upper Realm, there were tens of thousands of God Monarch Realm powerhouses.]
[It can only be said that the resources of this world are too rich. Of course, the Elemental Star is just one of the Ancient Stars in the Upper Realm, and if all the cultivators in the entire Upper Realm were counted, the number of God King Realm powerhouses would definitely far exceed this place.]
[Then, you discovered that the Saints in this world are really rare. There are only five active Saints in this world, and even if you count those who self-titled themselves as Saints, the number will definitely not exceed ten.]
[In response, you were quite astonished. However, when you sensed the rules of this world, you gained a deeper understanding of what Alpha meant when he said that the rules of this world were incomplete.]
[The rules manifested in this world were so incomplete that they couldn’t even be considered rules anymore, although they were still much stronger than Pseudo Rules, but they were far from reaching the level of your Upper Realm.]
[To achieve Enlightenment and become a Saint in this world, you think that the Saints of this world must be ruthless.]
[Finally, you discovered something else. The production of lower and mid-tier Divine Sources in this world is astonishing. However, the top-tier Divine Origin that can only be used by those who reach the Saint Realm is extremely rare. Every time they appear, it triggers a terrifying battle of life and death among Semi-saints. Sometimes, even Saints would wage wars over them.]
[In response, you could only shake your head, thinking your main goal this time should still be collecting mid-tier Divine Sources.]
[Afterwards, you thought about it and decided to take action. You went directly to the auction held by Wood Palace, the strongest power in the eastern Upper Realm, planning to show off your Sacred Artifact and see if you could draw any fish in.]
[However, something unexpected happened. Your Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth was triggered again. Soon after, a terrifying omen soared into the sky in the eastern Upper Realm, attracting the attention of many cultivators in this world, including you, who tore space apart and headed there.]
[When you arrived, you saw a never-ending Divine Origin Mine, with countless lower-tier God’s Source, many mid-tier Divine Sources, and even some top-tier Divine Origins emitting a crystal-like luster, with quite a few in number.]
[This sight made your eyes burn with desire. If you could mine the entire Divine Origin Mine, you would have no lack of resources for a long time, at least enough to support you until you reached the Saint Realm’s estimated expenses.]
[Although it is said that by the time you reach the Saint Realm, the mid-tier Divine Sources might no longer be useful, you don’t want to think so much for now, and plan to get your hands on these Divine Sources first.]
[Just as you were about to take action on the Divine Sources, a series of powerful cultivators appeared, all of them being at least God Monarch Realm masters, and even Semi-saints were among them.]
[You ignored them, acting forcefully. Seeing this, the cultivators were furious and directly launched an attack on you.]
[Facing these attacks, you were fearless. Your Divine Skills erupted, fighting against multiple enemies and repelling all of them. Even with the Semi-saints leading the charge, they were still swept aside by you.]
[You also found that the combat power of this group of cultivators seemed to be much weaker than those from the major powers in Elemental Star. After some careful thinking, you figured out the reason.]
[The strongest beings in this world were Saints. It was estimated that Holy tier Cultivation Methods and Divine Skills were unattainable for them. They couldn’t compare to the Holy Lands and big families in Elemental Star, especially to the Tao Palace, which possesses Emperor Scriptures.]
[Seeing you defeat numerous cultivators by yourself, even sweeping away Semi-saints, everyone present was shocked, not expecting a Peak of God King Realm cultivator like you to be so powerful.]
[Soon, someone exclaimed in surprise, noticing that you were holding a Sacred Artifact. Their eyes burned with desire, especially the Semi-saints, who wished they could use Secret Skills to increase their strength and snatch the Sacred Artifact from your hands.]
[It was then that a Saint descended. The Saint saw that the Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills you practiced were extraordinary and asked you to hand them over along with the Sacred Artifact, promising that he would spare your life.]
[In response, you showed disdain. You found that this so-called Saint was much weaker than the Saints in your memory. Although they were both Saints, the Divine power was much weaker, and the rules intertwined around him were also incomplete.]

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 193: Defeat the Saint! Overflowing with Wealth_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Chapter 193: Defeat the Saint! Overflowing with Wealth_4
[Originally, you thought the saints in this world were all fierce characters, but now it seems that you overestimated them. Perhaps their talent is indeed good, but constrained by the world, their strength is much weaker compared to the saints on Elemental Star.]
[To deal with such saints, you feel it is unnecessary to use a Supreme Artifact and can still fight across tiers.]
[Seeing that you have no intention of handing over your cultivation skills, divine skills, and sacred artifacts, this saint is filled with rage and launches a terrifying attack on you. A single strike from the saint makes the other cultivators revere him to the extreme.]
[However, facing this attack, your complexion doesn’t change at all. You merely sneer, sacrifice two sacred artifacts, and use three Manas, unleashing the divine skills of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.]
[In an instant, you easily crush the saint’s attack, and even wound him. This leaves the many cultivators dumbfounded and somewhat incredulous. A God Monarch wounding a saint is an unprecedented event, but it is happening right before their eyes.]
[However, they also noticed that you used three Manas, which made them even more stunned.]
[The wounded saint is both shocked and angry. He didn’t expect you to comprehend three Manas and unleash such terrifying power. At the same time, he also found that your grasped Manas was far stronger than his.]
[This left the saint puzzled, not knowing why you could comprehend the complete Manas. However, he soon calmed down and even showed some greed, intending to capture you alive and force out the secret of the complete Manas. In addition, he wanted all the cultivation skills, divine skills, and sacred artifacts.]
[Although he was injured just now, it still wasn’t his full strength, and he was confident in defeating you.]
[You see the saint’s greed, sneer, and engage him in battle. In this battle, you fight with great pleasure, triggering the Purple Talent: Endless Blade from time to time, which makes the saint bleed profusely.]
[In the end, you rarely summoned the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, causing it to erupt in a vision, and your strength soared once again. This made the saint’s face pale, exposing a look of fear, and he wished to flee, not wanting to fight anymore.]
[However, you have no intention of letting him escape and unleash a powerful strike, forcing the saint to be completely annihilated, causing his downfall.]
[The saint falls, blood raining from the sky, shocking and chilling many cultivators. It was unprecedented for a Semi-saint to slaughter a saint, but now it has been accomplished by you, which is truly incredible.]
[You pay no heed to the astonished cultivators and directly loot the saint’s corpse, taking away the Divine Origin Mine in front of them all before leaving leisurely. During this process, no one dares to stop you.]
[After you leave, you start counting your harvest. You are pleasantly surprised to find that looting the saint’s corpse earned you millions of pounds of Lower-tier God’s Source, a hundred thousand pounds of Mid-tier Divine Source, and hundreds of pounds of Top-tier Divine Origin.]
[But your greatest harvest is still the Divine Origin Mine, which contains tens of millions of pounds of Lower-tier God’s Source, two hundred thousand Mid-tier Divine Source, and a thousand pounds of Top-tier Divine Origin.]
[With this haul, you’re incredibly rich, gathering almost half the cultivation resources of this world. The saints are the rulers of this world, and their ability to plunder resources can be imagined. However, even the saints don’t have as many resources as in this divine source mine. It’s enough to show that this divine source mine is definitely a unique ore vein in this world.]
[Holding these resources, you can’t help but wonder if you could establish a Great Sect and develop it into a Holy Land after returning to the Elemental Star, becoming a dominant force on the Elemental Star.]
…
“Well, are saints in this world really that weak? They were actually defeated by me across tiers.”
Wang Ping looks at the simulated content, somewhat astonished.
He thought the saints in this world would be strong and hadn’t expected that he wouldn’t even need to use a Supreme Artifact.
It seems like the gap between saints in different worlds is even greater than that between humans and dogs.
“Besides, the harvest this time is simply terrifying. Tens of millions of Lower-tier God’s Source, three hundred thousand Mid-tier Divine Source, and more than a thousand pounds of Top-tier Divine Origin, this should be enough for me to simulate countless times.”
Wang Ping clicks his tongue.
As he is now, his cultivation has reached the Peak of the God King Realm. It only takes a thousand pounds of Mid-tier Divine Source for him to pay for a simulation, and just the Mid-tier Divine Source alone is enough for him to simulate three hundred times.
Even if his cultivation increases a bit, reaching the Semi-saint level, he estimates he will still be able to simulate many times.
After all, Top-tier Divine Source is something only Saint Realm powerhouses can use.
By then, even if his cultivation reaches the Saint Realm, he can still continue to simulate.
“It looks like I won’t need to worry about resources in the short term, which is very comfortable.”
Wang Ping nods in satisfaction and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[It is when you finish counting the harvest and contemplating your next move that you find a strong rejection reaction occurring in your body, which makes you frown. He found it strange that he was obviously still alive, but a rejection reaction had occurred. He suspected that it was because he had killed the saint of this world, plundered too many resources, made the world unhappy, and earned the title of the blacklist.]
[In response to this, although you can forcefully stay in this world, it doesn’t comply with the rules of the chat group. Therefore, you somewhat helplessly choose to return.]

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 193: Blow up the saint! So rich it’s overflowing_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Chapter 193: Blow up the saint! So rich it’s overflowing_5
[Because of your return, the simulation ends now.]
…..
The text simulation stopped here. Wang Ping felt a slight sway of his consciousness and returned to the real world.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping’s expression was subtly strange.
It seems I’ve overdone it, and was kicked out of this world.
“Mr.Wang, how did it go? Was the Guise too difficult to handle?”
Lin Yuanyuan looked at Wang Ping’s complicated expression and could not help but ask with worry.
“Handling Guise was effortless… But we don’t need to deal with him now.”
Wang Ping replied, shaking his head.
“What do you mean?”
Lin Yuanyuan looked puzzled.
“Let’s first gather some resources from the Upper Realm. Maybe this time, you can become a holy person.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, saying this with a smile.
“H-Holy person?!”
Lin Yuanyuan was stunned after blinking her eyes.
Even Mr.Wang is not a holy person, right? The last time he showed off his cultivation, it was only at the True Divine Realm, with only the combat power of the God Monarch Realm.
Can she really become a holy person just like that? Lin Yuanyuan’s brain seemed to short circuit with disbelief.
“The holy people of this world are weak. I can suppress them and let you drain them.”
Wang Ping was quite casual about his plans, as he looked towards Lin Yuanyuan.
“!!!!!”
Lin Yuanyuan was once again shocked at Wang Ping’s words.
Holy people are weak?
Suppress a holy person?
Dumbfounded, Lin Yuanyuan could only say: “Can it really be done?”
“Of course. Killing a holy person is not a big deal. But to suppress him with my own power is a bit difficult, I need exterior help.”
Wang Ping said casually.
As long as he used the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, suppressing the inferior version of the holy person in this world would be a breeze.
Then, after letting Lin Yuanyuan drain him, she would become the second most powerful member of the chat group, only after him.
Maybe she would be able to lend him some assistance soon.
After all, having reached the strength of holy people, although a basic-level holy person, it is more than enough. With Lin Yuanyuan’s abilities, the snowball effect would be accelerating.
“Mr.Wang, you’re so powerful!”
Lin Yuanyuan was excitedly clenched her fists.
She originally thought her gain this time was to reach the God Monarch Realm. She didn’t expect it to be a holy person.
This was really taking off.
Indeed, stick close to Mr.Wang and her strength will surge dramatically!
“Don’t get too excited, we need to take action now. First, seal Guise to a point where we can kill him at any moment. Then we head for the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping patted Lin Yuanyuan’s shoulder, signaling her not to get overly excited.
Once Lin Yuanyuan calmed down, Wang Ping started to act with Lin Yuanyuan.
Soon, Wang Ping found the Guise in the lower realm and suppressed him and sealed him, just like he did in the simulation.
Under Wang Ping’s series of operations, Guise did not even have time to react, and was sealed and fell into a deep sleep, ready to be killed by Wang Ping at any moment.
Then, Wang Ping directly opened the Upper Realm Channel and took Lin Yuanyuan to the Upper Realm.
The subsequent discovery was slightly different from the life simulation, but not much. Wang Ping still received invitations from various forces, just three months ahead of schedule.
During these three months, Wang Ping walked around this world with Lin Yuanyuan, seizing a wicked cultivator at the peak of the God Monarch Realm for Lin Yuanyuan to seize power from.
After all, without the cultivation of the God Monarch Realm Great Perfection, even Wang Ping would find it challenging to suppress the holy people using the Supreme Artifact. Even the aura and immense power of the holy people would be enough to obliterate Lin Yuanyuan.
“What a pity. The rules of this world are incomplete, which affects my cultivation. Although I can cultivate to the Semi-Saint and even Saint level in this world, which is much easier than in my realm, the foundation of this sanctification is too weak and will affect my future path of cultivation.”
Wang Ping opened his eyes, shook his head, and completely gave up the plan to cultivate in this world.
Then, Wang Ping looked into the distance.
Just as Wang Ping looked into the distance, a streak of violet light ascended into the sky, breaking through the clouds. The terrifying energy created an amazing spectacle, stirring countless cultivators and drawing them over instantly.
Wang Ping too stood up, his face beaming with a smile.
Although he knew the location of the divine source mine deep underground, he was intentionally waiting for this moment.
After all, how else would he fish for the law to lure out the holy people?
Without fishing for the law, how could he kill a bunch of people reasonably and gain more benefits?
“Let’s go.”
Then, after saying these words to Lin Yuanyuan, Wang Ping used the Space Divine Skills to disappear from the spot with Lin Yuanyuan.
The next moment, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan appeared above the Divine Source Mine, overlooking the vast mine filled with immense energy.
Shortly after Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan appeared, powerful cultivators started to arrive in succession.
Just like in the life simulation, they were all gods, and even half saints.
All of them greedily eyed the divine source veins, itching to dig them all up straight away.
With so many divine sources, they are enough to turn their forces into hegemony-level powers, and it’s an inexhaustible supply.

chapters.title: Chapter 645: 194: Paradise of All Heavens! Optimization Methods for Simulators
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Chapter 194: Paradise of All Heavens! Optimization Methods for Simulators
“This Divine Origin Mine was discovered by me first. You all can leave now.”
Wang Ping glanced at the cultivators whose eyes were filled with fanaticism and spoke indifferently.
“Hehe, treasures of the world belong to those who can obtain them. It doesn’t matter who discovered it first. You, a mere cultivator at the Peak of the God King Realm, are delusional to think you could monopolize this Divine Origin Mine. You really don’t know what’s what.”
As soon as Wang Ping opened his mouth, a Semi-saint sneered coldly and mocked him.
The other strong cultivators also looked at Wang Ping with contempt, as if they were looking at a dead man.
“Well said, treasures of the world belong to those who can obtain them. So, I’ll give you all a chance. Leave or die.”
Wang Ping placed his hands behind his back, looking down at the many cultivators, and said coldly.
“Arrogant!”
As soon as these words were spoken, the faces of the cultivators present changed, becoming extremely cold. An infuriated Semi-saint directly attacked Wang Ping.
A wisp of divine power erupted, causing layers of space to shatter, and the other God King Realm powerhouses’ expressions changed as well.
Lin Yuanyuan also felt a suffocating sensation.
However, the next second, this wisp of divine power suddenly disappeared, exploding and causing the space around the Semi-saint to twist, instantly turning him into a blood fog.
“!!!”
Seeing this scene, all the cultivators’ faces changed, revealing fearful expressions.
Is this Space Law?!
Why would a God King Realm powerhouse be able to comprehend Space Law?!
Not to mention that this Divine Skill was a bit too terrifying!
Ignoring the cultivators whose expressions had changed, Wang Ping directly collected all the good things that appeared after the Semi-saint’s divine realm shattered and spoke again: “I’m giving you all one more chance. Leave, or die.”
These words made the God Kings present look at each other, no longer daring to sneer. With pale faces, they could only leave with bitter smiles.
Even the lurking Semi-saint had a constantly changing expression and could only back away.
With a terrifying powerhouse like Wang Ping who could instantly kill a Semi-saint here, they had already lost the opportunity to compete.
“Junior, you have some strength, but you’re so ruthless. Today, I will suppress you and make you reflect deeply.”
At this moment, a terrifying divine power suddenly descended, causing the space to become extremely unstable.
At the same time, the faces of all the cultivators present turned pale, showing shocked expressions.
Saints were revered existences who hadn’t taken action for many years.
They never thought that they would be able to witness a Saint take action today.
“Just a fake Saint, yet you dare to try and suppress me. How ridiculous.”
Wang Ping looked up at the sky and saw a figure intertwined with a Saint’s mana and fragmented Laws walk out from the Space Channel. He snorted coldly.
“Hehe, daring to call me a fake Saint, truly arrogant. Today, I will let you understand what a Saint is.”
The voice of the Saint was extremely cold, and the increasingly terrifying divine power demonstrated the Saint’s anger.
Then, the Saint took action, fiercely striking a palm at Wang Ping.
As the Saint’s divine skills erupted, the terrifying Mana of Fire condensed into a giant palm that seemed capable of burning the heavens and suppressing all things.
This made all the cultivators shiver with fear, feeling that no one could survive under this attack.
Even a Semi-saint would be completely wiped out if they came into contact with only some of the flames, let alone withstand the attack.
Everyone thought that Wang Ping was doomed, even comprehending Space Law wouldn’t be enough to survive.
However, facing this attack, Wang Ping remained calm, without the slightest change in his expression. He simply took out a black long spear.
This spear was pitch-black and had a blood-red eye on it, giving people an eerie feeling.
