The moment the black long spear appeared, a terrifying demonic spirit began to spread. The sky immediately turned pitch-black, and the sun’s brilliance was completely obscured.
As for the Saint’s attack, the moment the blood-red eye looked at it, it was instantly extinguished.
Like a feeble spark encountering a torrential downpour.
This caused the Saint’s expression to freeze, revealing a look of horror.
“What kind of weapon is this?”
The Saint looked at the black long spear in Wang Ping’s hand in terror, feeling his scalp go numb and a cold sensation spread from the bottom of his heart.
In this world, the strongest were Saints. Once they became Saints, they would be unparalleled, but they would also have no path ahead of them.
As a result, there were no Supreme Artifacts, let alone Holy King Artifacts. Naturally, Saints couldn’t recognize what level of Artifact this was.
However, this didn’t prevent him from realizing just how terrifying and dangerous this black long spear was.
Immediately, the Saint wanted to escape, unwilling to face Wang Ping as an enemy any longer.
But now, it was too late for him to escape.
More accurately, when this Saint appeared, his fate had already been determined.
“Black Abyss Demon Spear, suppress him for me.”
Wang Ping said coldly.
As Wang Ping gave the command, the blood-red eye on the Black Abyss Demon Spear stared fixedly at the Saint. Blood-colored light intertwined with terrifying black demonic spirit surged out, instantly trapping the Saint, making it impossible for him to move. Even his divine power was suppressed.
This terrifying scene made all the cultivators present shiver in fear and feel unparalleled terror.
This was a Saint, and he was being so easily suppressed. Just what kind of background did this weapon have? It was far too terrifying and evil.
For a time, many people wanted to run, but they were afraid of causing a commotion that would draw Wang Ping’s or the terrifying demonic artifact’s attention, leading to them being instantly suppressed and killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 646: 194: Paradise of All Heavens! Optimization Methods for Simulators_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Chapter 194: Paradise of All Heavens! Optimization Methods for Simulators_2
“Yuanyuan, it’s your turn now.”
Wang Ping ignored the weak God Monarchs, and directly set up a Great Array to block the view of others. Then he looked at Lin Yuanyuan, signaling her to drain this already suppressed Saint.
At this moment, Lin Yuanyuan finally came back to her senses, and her admiration for Wang Ping grew, as did her excitement.
It was a Saint! She would soon possess Spiritual Cultivation.
Although it seemed like this Saint was a bit weak, that was only in comparison to Mr. Wang!
Actually, this Saint was not weak but rather quite strong.
Immediately, Lin Yuanyuan flew over and, as usual, fiercely tore apart the clothes with brute force.
This left the desperate Saint bewildered, not knowing what Lin Yuanyuan intended to do.
Next, without any suspense, the bewildered Saint soon screamed in agony, as Lin Yuanyuan quickly drained his power, turning him into a dried corpse, falling completely.
Meanwhile, Lin Yuanyuan’s body was enveloped by a powerful divine power, showing her newfound strength.
“Not bad.”
Wang Ping looked at the current Lin Yuanyuan, nodding in satisfaction, and then collected the valuable items left behind by the dead Saint.
After that, Wang Ping once again used the Space Law to forcibly transfer the divine source mine to his inner divine country.
After finishing all this, Wang Ping once again activated a Secret Skill, causing the demon, who was sealed in the lower realm, to die on the spot.
This series of actions was smooth and unhindered.
“Ding, detection of the demon’s death, Group Task completed, rewards have been distributed, group members can choose to return voluntarily.”
At this time, the voice of the chat group system rang out.
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction and directly chose to return.
Lin Yuanyuan was no exception. Seeing Wang Ping choose to return, she naturally also chose to return, finally going back to her own world after a long time.
With this power, she now felt at ease.
Even if the demon appeared again, she could easily handle it.
…..
With a flicker of consciousness and a change of view, Wang Ping appeared in the Purple Spirit Realm.
“Am I back? I wonder how many group points I’ll get for killing the demon this time.”
Wang Ping silently opened the chat group and initiated the task reward red envelope.
“Ding, your contribution in this group task is 100%, and you have obtained 55 million group points.”
“55 million, huh? Not bad.”
Wang Ping glanced at the amount, nodding slightly.
After thinking for a while, Wang Ping decided to return to the Upper Realm and continue hiding in the White Flame Divine City.
After all, for Wang Ping, as long as there were resources, it was the same wherever he simulated.
“Ding, detection of a group member with Saint tier cultivation, Myriad Heavens Paradise is now open. Group members can choose to go there voluntarily. Kind reminder, Myriad Heavens Paradise is a place where many forces from the Myriad Heavens gather, offering countless opportunities but also unimaginable dangers. Please consider carefully before making your choice to go.”
At this moment, the voice of the chat group system suddenly rang out, causing Wang Ping to stop.
“Myriad Heavens Paradise? A place where many forces from the Myriad Heavens gather? Alpha, what’s going on?”
Wang Ping asked in surprise.
“Just like the chat group system said, it’s quite literal. To be honest, I didn’t actually want to unlock the Myriad Heavens Paradise just yet. However, once you reach the cultivation level of a Saint, or something similar, this place will be unlocked.”
Alpha’s cold voice echoed.
“You made Lin Yuanyuan a Saint. Although she only has the Saint cultivation while her corresponding assets are pitifully low, she still meets the requirements.”
“Uh…”
Wang Ping fell silent.
“Is that place really dangerous? With my current strength, partnered with the simulator, can I quickly grow there?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“You can grow quickly. However, that place involves forces from the Myriad Heavens, and various powerful beings who can control spacetime exist there. The risk factor of using your life simulator will increase, possibly attracting some terrifying enemies.”
Alpha’s cold voice echoed again.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping sighed.
His life simulator was, after all, a kind of ability. Although he didn’t know the specific working mechanism, it definitely involved rules such as future observation and ability manifestation.
This ability was very powerful, but it was ultimately granted by others. Once a certain level of power was reached, the simulation could be blocked, and even interfered with and misled in return.
“So you’re saying that in that place, I don’t have any advantage at all?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, pondering.
“You still have a significant advantage. You can completely use the simulator in the outer world to grow stronger, gaining various powerful talents, and then collect resources in Myriad Heavens Paradise. Also, in some games, it can be used as a future prediction ability. It can be said that your advantage has already surpassed most people in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
“If your life simulator undergoes another optimization, as long as it doesn’t involve the top figures of the Myriad Heavens, you can simulate anyone, which will give you an enormous advantage in every game.”
Alpha spoke slowly.
“However, for ordinary powerhouses, with a good combination of abilities and luck, many World Sources can be earned in that place. Of course, they might also lose everything and even become a slave. In addition, there are resources there to further optimize your life simulator.”

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Chapter 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_3
Alfa hesitated before speaking vaguely.
“Optimized resources again?”
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up.
Finally, Alfa loosened his lips and revealed something about the optimization of the Life Simulator.
“What kind of resource is it?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“Rule Stone. Your Golden Finger needs at least one complete Rule Stone and trillions of group points for its next evolution. Trillions of group points in Myriad Heavens Paradise is equivalent to 100 million degrees of World Source.”
Alfa fell silent before finally speaking.
“Trillions…..”
Wang Ping’s face twitched hard.
He thought it would only be 100 billion group points, but the amount had multiplied by a hundred, to trillions, which was quite outrageous.
Keep in mind that he had only saved a few billion group points so far.
How long would it take to accumulate these points by completing normal tasks?
Moreover, it’s highly likely that the Rule Stone can only be found in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
“Why is it called Myriad Heavens Paradise? What kind of place is it exactly?”
Wang Ping exhaled softly, calming himself down before asking curiously.
“Land of Myriad Heavens Chaos, playground of the big shots, exchange platform of Myriad Heavens Forces, gambler’s sanctuary, reincarnator’s temple… Dark Game Land… It’s a place of celebration for living beings walking through All Heavens, a graveyard for fools, and a place where the weak can turn the tables through wisdom. It’s a ruthless meat grinder.”
Alfa’s cold voice sounded, describing the general situation of the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
At this point, Wang Ping thought of many things and understood a lot as well.
“So, many experts in the Second Generation Chat Group managed to grow to that extent because of Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and speculated.
“Yes. Without Myriad Heavens Paradise, it would be impossible for them to grow to that level. After all, they don’t have a golden finger, and they’re also limited by their worlds.”
After a moment of silence, Alfa spoke.
“In Myriad Heavens Paradise, wisdom is more important than strength. Therefore, a weak but wise person can become a big shot in All Heavens, while a powerful but foolish one’s best outcome is death.”
“……”
Wang Ping fell silent, various thoughts flashing through his mind, and his emotions were quite complicated.
Wang Ping was quite self-aware and never considered himself a wise person. His growth so far had relied heavily on the Life Simulator.
“If I enter that place, will I be targeted by the big shots of the first and second generations, and then be crushed directly?”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly and asked the crucial question.
“Myriad Heavens Paradise has special rules. Once you go there, as long as you stay within the city, you’ll be protected. Even people of their level will be restrained. If they act against you, they’ll be suppressed by the rules, or even exterminated in more severe cases.”
“Although these rules are useless to the real big shots in Myriad Heavens Paradise, they are still far from reaching that level.”
Alfa gave a definite answer.
“Alfa, can’t the ruthless guy from the disassembled First Generation Chat Group reach that level either?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“No.”
Alfa’s cold voice sounded.
“I see.”
Hearing Alfa’s words, Wang Ping relaxed.
It seemed that Myriad Heavens Paradise was a place where only specific areas allowed the use of power.
This ensured the basic safety of “ordinary people” in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
“Should I go to Myriad Heavens Paradise and take a look?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but wonder.
“Although you can go there by spending ten degrees, or 100,000 group points after opening the passage to Myriad Heavens Paradise, I advise you to raise your strength to its current limit before going.”
Alfa’s cold voice sounded again.
“Although not everyone in that world has a powerful force, most are still ‘ordinary living beings.’ However, the rules are unique, and ‘ordinary living beings’ cannot be underestimated.”
“Uh….”
Wang Ping was dumbfounded.
Myriad Heavens Paradise seemed even more dangerous than he had imagined.
“It seems that although wisdom is more important in that place, power is indispensable, just less significant than wisdom.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“Speaking of which, why did the Supreme in the Second Generation Chat Group fall to the point where his lifespan was almost exhausted, and he could only self-seal? With Myriad Heavens Paradise, he shouldn’t have ended up in such a situation.”
Wang Ping thought of this and asked Alfa curiously.
“It’s precisely because of Myriad Heavens Paradise that he fell to this level. He lost all his World Source and the chance to enter. Furthermore, given his condition, it’s unlikely that anyone would lend him World Source.”
Alfa’s cold voice sounded.
“In Myriad Heavens Paradise, once you enter, you must participate in a game within a year or enter the Life and Death Arena to gamble battle. This is also the reason I don’t want you to go in now. Although your World Source is quite abundant, you still need to be polished in many aspects. If you go in now, you might get trapped.”
“Uh….”
Wang Ping had nothing to say.
“To be honest, your Life Simulator is indeed a powerful Golden Finger, but you rely on it too much. Otherwise, even if your Life Simulator is optimized again, you’ll never become a real big shot in All Heavens.”

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Chapter 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_4
Alpha was seriously warning Wang Ping.
“I know that, of course.”
Wang Ping nodded.
His golden finger was awakened by the chat group, and naturally, it could not exceed the chat group’s limit.
So, after reaching a certain level, the future road was destined to rely on himself alone.
“But with the situation so dangerous now, if I don’t rely on the Life Simulator, should I slowly cultivate myself to become stronger?”
“By the time I become strong enough, I’m afraid I’ll already be slapped to death by those enemies.”
Wang Ping said with a bitter smile.
After using the immersive simulation, Wang Ping had figured out a rule: if you only use the text simulation, the time spent on the simulation is not much.
But if he spends too much time immersed in the simulation, the passage of time in reality would also increase.
That is to say, if he goes through an entirely immersive simulation without using text simulation, it can indeed help hone his skills…
However, after he finishes the simulation, ten years or even a hundred years might have passed in reality—or even more.
By that time, some enemy might have already found him and swept him away in reality.
Immersive simulation is useful, but the danger is real. The time span is too long, full of uncertainties.
“……”
Alpha had nothing to say.
“Once I’m in the Upper Realm, I won’t need to rely on the Life Simulator to become stronger. When there are no powerful enemies chasing after me, I’ll have plenty of time to hone myself and won’t need to worry too much.”
Wang Ping shook his head and skipped over this topic.
Next, Wang Ping opened the chat group, wanting to see the situation in the group, and meanwhile warned the other group members not to foolishly go to Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Of course, Wang Ping thought that even if he didn’t remind them, the group members wouldn’t be so foolish, and they might not be willing to spend 100,000 group points just to take a look.
“However, speaking of group members, it seems that they have a little more advantage than me in Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of this and raised his eyebrows slightly.
His golden finger was the kind to glimpse the future, and he couldn’t use it at will, or he might catch the attention of some terrifying existence.
As for the other people’s golden fingers, there was no such concern.
“It’s not necessarily true. After all, I have various talents refreshed, and the combined effect of all my talents is much better than a single golden finger. In that case, if I brush up on more talents, I can also have a certain advantage in Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
While Wang Ping and Alpha were chatting and pondering, the chat group had already become extremely lively.
Cai Yonglong(1): “Damn, what’s up with this Myriad Heavens Paradise? It looks terrifying. Wang bro, are you already at the Saint level? Isn’t that a bit too powerful?”
Luo Weiguo(85): “Worthy of Wang bro… Last time he was in my world, he was at the True Lord level, and now he’s directly jumped to the Saint tier.”
Chen Yao(71): “We’ve been left in the dust…”
Qin Tian(77): “Heh heh, Wang bro is ruthless and doesn’t say much. Kneeling_and_worshiping.jpg.”
Lin Yuanyuan(80): “…Actually, it’s me who reached the Saint tier, not Wang bro. To be precise, Wang bro suppressed a saint in Yu Zhengtao’s world, and I drained his power.”
Everyone: “……”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, that’s even scarier than Wang bro becoming a saint. Suppressing a saint and draining him, that’s too awesome.”
Fang Yun(3): “Wu wu wu, I’m so envious. Ascending straight to sainthood, that’s too cool! Unlike me, who’s still struggling with cultivation!”
Wang Shuqi(74): “I’m also envious… By the way, isn’t anyone discussing Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wu Yueming(79): “To be fair, I am quite interested in this so-called Myriad Heavens Paradise. Anyone wanna go take a look with me?”
Ding Xuan (88): “Take a look? You’re kidding, I just tried it, and it takes 100,000 group points to teleport there. I was so scared that I dropped my chopsticks.”
Zhang Jun (70): “You’re really looking for death. The chat group clearly warned us to think carefully. And this place only unlocked after the emergence of saints. I always feel that if we’re not saints, going in is just offering our heads.”
Wang Ping (66) @Zhang Jun: “You’re right. Although it’s not like entering means offering our heads, it’s not a place for casual tourism either.”
Wang Ping (66): “As for this place, you should wait until you become saints before considering entering. Of course, if Yuanyuan and I can create a new world first, you can also enter.”
Zhang Yueying(86): “So dangerous… Only saints can enter…”
Ding Xuan (88): “I see, it’s a high-level instance.”
Wang Ping(66): “Indeed, it’s high-level. All sorts of big shots from the All Heavens gather there, and the power of saints is considered ordinary. However, in this place, intelligence and high-level abilities are more important than pure power. There are weak people who earn a lot of group points in there and soar straight up, and there are also strong ones who die miserably.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Terrifying. Hearing Wang bro’s explanation, I suddenly feel the itch.”
Fang Yun(3): “Tsk tsk, Mr. Cai, you’re really floating, thinking of yourself as a wise man.”

chapters.title: Chapter 649: 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Chapter 194: Myriad Heavens Paradise! The Optimization Method of Simulator_5
Cai Yonglong (1): “Get out of here, I just wanted to say that my abilities would be really useful there, at least more useful than you, who can only cultivate.”
Fang Yun (3): “Oh man… I’m taking a mental crit here.”
Wang Ping (66): “You guys keep chatting, I’ll go offline first.”
Wang Ping shook his head at the group and chose to go offline.
Next, Wang Ping took a deep breath and said in his heart, “System, I want to start the Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, 1000 jin of Mid-tier Divine Source consumed, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Red Talent: Wind Profound Physique; Blue Talent: Chaotic World of Demonic Cultivation.”
“Alright, it seems like my luck hasn’t improved. System, I’ll choose Red Talent: Wind Profound Physique.”
Wang Ping looked at the two talents with a bit of disappointment and casually made a choice.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, simulation begins.”
As the system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway, knowing that he was entering the immersive simulation.
Soon after, a luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[On day one, after some thinking, you didn’t choose to join Tao Palace but decided to cultivate outside.]
[In a blink, ten years have passed. You calculated the time and went straight to the area outside the Elemental Star, intending to kill Ruo Lan. Naturally, Ruo Lan pursued and followed you.]
[Quickly, you lured Ruo Lan to an uninhabited asteroid. Although Ruo Lan was somewhat wary of your strange behavior, she relied on the protection of the Supreme Artifact and was not afraid of you.]
[Soon, you started fighting. Due to your cultivation reaching the peak of the God Monarch Realm, you use the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, pushing your strength to the extreme. With the occasional critical strike effect from the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, Ruo Lan was no match for you and suffered a full force attack, making a pitiable mess and bound to die in your hands sooner or later.]
[Ruo Lan was terrified and outraged, not expecting your growth to be so fast. In response, she chose to use the Supreme Artifact. You, on the other hand, sneered and had already taken precautions, using your Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[Ruo Lan was terrified, not expecting you to have a Supreme Artifact as well. In the end, Ruo Lan was forcefully killed by you. The Supreme Artifact escaped again, and you couldn’t stop it.]
[After killing Ruo Lan, you began to search her body. After finishing, you returned to the Elemental Star. Of course, you had no intention of staying there for long.]
[After all, there was still a hidden Supreme presence there. Once you returned and broke through to the Semi-Saint tier, you might attract a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[By then, your possession of the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body would definitely be exposed. That Supreme being would definitely try to take advantage of you, consuming the essence of your Dao body.]
[As a result, you only planned to hold out until the Great Saint Secret Realm opened and snatch the Divine Medicine. In addition, with the Supreme Artifact, you also planned to take revenge on the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint and see if you could gain any advantages from him.]
[After the Great Saint Secret Realm trip is over, you plan to go to Purgatory Ancient Star, cultivate there, and safely break through to the Semi-Saint tier.]
[Apart from that, you also remembered the Chi Clan after a long time. Back then, the Master of Tao Palace told you that some of the Chi Clan people were still alive and had the Emperor Scripture.]
[If you could get the subsequent Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture from the surviving Chi Clan members’ hands, it would undoubtedly be of great benefit to you.]
[After all, the divine powers of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture are stronger in terms of killing power than the ever-changing Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, allowing your strength to become even stronger. In addition, obtaining more Emperor Scriptures will be greatly beneficial for your Enlightenment and creating your own methods.]
[However, although you thought of the Chi Clan, you didn’t rush, planning to cultivate to the Semi-Saint tier before looking for them.]
[Your plan was good, and after the Great Saint Secret Realm opened, you successfully obtained the Divine Medicine. At the same time, you found the Great Saint Inheritance location before Lin Yan and met the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint.]
[The Remnant Soul of the Great Saint still wanted to possess your body. However, this time, the Great Saint miscalculated, having no idea that you were protected by the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[Thus, the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint could only scream in despair, being suppressed and killed by the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear – reduced to ashes. In his peak state, he naturally wouldn’t fear the Supreme Artifact, but now he was only in a remnant soul state, obviously not capable of resisting the artifact’s power.]
[You weren’t concerned about the death of the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint. However, you were disappointed with what happened next. This Great Saint Remnant Soul was too poor. The so-called inheritance’s most precious part was just some Mid-tier Divine Source and a small amount of Top-tier Divine Source. The rest were just some Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills. To you, Great Saint tier Skills and Divine Skills didn’t really catch your eyes anymore.]
[In the end, you could only leave the Great Saint Secret Realm in disappointment.]

chapters.title: Chapter 650: 195: The Long-awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Soaring
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Chapter 195: The Long-awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Soaring
“This time, it’s a massacre.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of this simulation and nodded his head in satisfaction.
He killed Ruo Lan, annihilated the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint, and turned the previously abused enemies into the ones being abused. It finally felt refreshing and satisfying.
As Wang Ping was enjoying himself, the simulation continued.
[Next, you chose to leave the Elemental Star and head to the Purgatory Ancient Star, intending to cultivate there with the help of the Sea of Flames. In addition, there were no overly powerful beings there, and with your Supreme Artifact, you wouldn’t be in danger.]
[Three months later, you arrived at the Purgatory Ancient Star and found an excellent cultivation place, planning to settle there. However, as soon as you entered, you were attacked by a Semi-saint. In response, you sneered and directly blasted him to pieces, causing him to bleed and fall completely.]
[This caused shock among the cultivators on the Purgatory Ancient Star, who had never expected you to be so aggressive. Soon, word of your existence spread, and no one dared to provoke you.]
[Satisfied with this, you began to focus on intensive cultivation. In the blink of an eye, about a thousand years passed, and you still hadn’t stepped into the Saint tier. However, because of your abundant resources, you used mid-tier and top-tier Divine Origin to stack up your cultivation extravagantly. Under this luxurious cultivation method, you saved a lot of time and easily broke through to the Semi-saint tier.]
[After becoming a Semi-saint, you faced a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. This horrifying Tribulation caused panic among many cultivators on the Purgatory Ancient Star. However, you showed no fear and engaged in a spirited battle with the Heavenly Tribulation. In the end, you successfully weathered the Tribulation, firmly entering the Semi-saint tier and becoming a powerful Semi-saint.]
[Moreover, your life-bound weapon also advanced to the Sacred Artifact tier with the help of the Tribulation’s power, which satisfied you greatly.]
[After becoming a Semi-saint, while feeling invigorated, you remembered the matter of Young Master Mo going to the lower realm. If Young Master Mo went down, the Purple Spirit Realm might be destroyed.]
[As a result, you chose to return to the Elemental Star and go to the lower realm. However, after discovering that Young Master Mo didn’t destroy the lower realm after seeing the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear missing, you were relieved.]
[Apparently, Young Master Mo, although extremely arrogant and ruthless, still couldn’t bring himself to casually destroy a realm.]
[However, even though your feelings towards Young Master Mo improved, you still tried to get the Demonic Heavenly Stone from him. After all, having more of such stones would not hurt, and perhaps it could make the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear evolve once again.]
[Next, you returned to the Upper Realm, recalling that Tao Palace was going to be destroyed. You had received the favor of Tao Palace in your previous simulations and had practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, so you couldn’t just stand by and watch Tao Palace be destroyed.]
[For this reason, you went to Tao Palace and informed them of the coming attack, hoping that Tao Palace could move and thus preserve its inheritance.]
[The palace master of Tao Palace was shocked by your words. Although you had cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and were a powerful Semi-saint, he wouldn’t easily believe the words of an outsider like you.]
[However, when you swore upon your Tao Heart, the palace master was moved. After all, there was no need for a genius like you to risk your Tao Heart just to create such a baffling prank.]
[In the end, the palace master did listen to some of your advice. He secretly relocated a part of the inheritance. Although you felt that he didn’t fully trust you, you could only sigh in resignation, without saying much more.]
[Afterward, you left Tao Palace and went to Tianqin Mountain Range. Upon arriving there, you fell into a strange Great Array. Even when you brought out the Supreme Artifact, it was useless. So, you chose to use the Burning Emperor Fist, hoping to attract the attention of the Chi Clan descendants hiding in Tianqin Mountain Range.]
[As expected, when you used the Burning Emperor Fist, the Great Array disappeared, and you were transported to the interior of Tianqin Mountain Range, meeting an old man. This old man was extremely terrifying. You couldn’t see through his aura, and assumed he was a Saint, or perhaps even more powerful.]
[The old man examined you and asked with a serious tone where you had learned the Burning Emperor Fist. In response, you didn’t hesitate to answer, also stating that you had a connection with Tao Palace and that the palace master had told you about Tianqin Mountain Range and the Chi Clan. Therefore, if you could learn the later parts of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, you could help the Chi Clan get their revenge.]
[The old man remained silent. Since you had cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and the Time-Space Body, he chose to believe that you were connected to Tao Palace. However, passing on the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture wasn’t something to be done lightly, and he hesitated about whether to teach it to you.]
[Finally, he sighed and motioned for you to follow him, which you naturally did.]
[Soon, you discovered that there were very few Chi Clan members in Tianqin Mountain Range, and they hardly went out, remaining in a state of self-imposed isolation.]
[After bringing you to the main hall, the old man revealed a shocking truth. He could teach you the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, but seeking revenge was pointless because their clan was indeed guilty.]
[These words greatly stunned you, as you couldn’t understand why the old man would say such a thing.]
[In response, the old man laughed at himself and explained that the story of the Burning Emperor suppressing the evil and entering the Source of Darkness, followed by the Chi Clan encountering misfortune, was just a rumor spread by the followers of their ancestors to maintain the reputation of the Burning Emperor and the Chi Clan’s existence.]

chapters.title: Chapter 651: 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Chapter 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_2
[Back then, when the darkness erupted, their Ancestor, the Burning Emperor indeed took action, suppressed the unknown, but the result was not entering the Source of Darkness, but choosing to actively immerse himself in the Source of Darkness to continue his existence.]
[Because of this, their Chi Clan was disliked by the Heavenly Tao and suffered its curse, not the curse of the darkness.]
[Upon hearing this truth, you fell silent, unexpectedly, the truth turned out like this. In your heart, the Burning Emperor and the Guilt-Punishing Emperor alike were respected figures. It was unimaginable that the Burning Emperor would actively throw himself into the Source of Darkness becoming the root of turmoil.]
[However, you seemed to recall something, expressing your doubt that there were other Emperors who also threw themselves into the Source of Darkness to become the Dark Emperor, and why their ethnic group were not cursed.]
[Hearing your words, the elder of the Chi Clan remained silent, expressing his own lack of knowledge. Regardless, the fact that their Ancestor mingled with the darkness was undeniable.]
[Seeing the elder unable to answer, you buried your doubts in your heart. Then, you asked another question. That is, why would he reveal such secrets to you a stranger?]
[The elder of the Chi Clan sighed, said that they too, couldn’t hold on much longer and instead of taking the regret to their death, they’d rather alleviate the burden on their hearts by speaking out. Moreover, this secret, was in fact, known to all the actual major powers, so there’s no point in keeping it hidden.]
[After hearing this, your emotions were mixed. Your perception of the Chi Clan had always been positive, but you didn’t expect the truth to turn out this way.]
[Next, afer the elder of the Chi Clan passed the Burning Emperor’s Scripture to you, he asked you to leave. Consequently, you likewise didn’t plan on sticking around any longer and chose to depart. After your departure, the elder breathed his last.]
[After leaving the Tianqin Mountain Range, you began contemplating your next destination. Staying in Elemental Star was meaningless unless you could break through to the Saint Realm. If the ripple from your cultivation became significant, it might even catch the attention of a terrifying strong power.]
[For this reason, you planned to again leave the Elemental Star and head for either Purgatory Ancient Star or Canglan Ancient Star to cultivate. Eventually, you made your decision, came to Purgatory Ancient Star, attempting to breakthrough to the Saintly Human Tier here or to use this special environment to cultivate the Burning Emperor’s Scripture.]
[Three months later, you arrived on Purgatory Ancient Star and began your daily cultivation. Just like that, a thousand years went by in a blink. Throughout these thousand years, you successfully learned the Divine Skills documented in the Burning Emperor Scripture. However, a considerable amount of time was still needed for you to break through to the Saint Realm, even though you were holding onto resources, including a stalk of divine medicine.]
[As you were committed to your cultivation, the Sea of Flames in the Purgatory Ancient Star underwent an abnormal transformation. Mana of Fire went wild, and a terrifying flame erupted from within the Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[You were caught off guard and directly turned into ash by this terrifying flame. Not just you, but all the cultivators on Purgatory Ancient Star, none could escape this flame, all were incinerated turning into ash.]
[Because you possessed the rebirth tally, you were plunged into a resurrection countdown status. The moment you resurrected, the Supreme Artifact: Black Spirit Demon Spear was there protecting you, preventing you from dying again right after revival.]
[However, you discovered a terrifying fact. Mana of Fire’s rampage became increasingly horrendous, that horrifying flame also became stronger. No even the defense formed by the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear was able to support, it was melted by the flame.]
[You felt tingles in your scalp, and wanted to use Space Divine Skills to escape there. However to your horror, under the rampage of the Mana of Fire and the burning of that terrifying flame, the space was completely distorted and you were unable to transfer.]
[Consequently, you were still incinerated to nothing. Even the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear also got incinerated.]
[Because of your death, this simulation came to an end….]
…
The text simulation stopped here, many images and realization appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, eventually his figure appeared in the Purgatory Ancient Star.
“What just happened? Why did Purgatory Ancient Star suddenly go berserk, erupted such terrifying flame that could incinerate even a Supreme Artifact?”
Looking at that horrifying white flame, Wang Ping’s heart was filled with fear, his eyelids were twitching uncontrollably.
The force was too terrifying, Wang Ping couldn’t determine the tear of the force, but it likely not belonging to the Saint realm tier.
“I originally considered Purgatory Ancient Star to be an excellent cultivation area, seems like it was my miscalculation. Inside Purgatory Ancient Star, there are also numerous secrets. Perhaps, Purgatory Ancient Star in the past was not a world filled with flame, a place with life, but it turned out this way due to a certain reason.”
Wang Ping looked at Purgatory Ancient Star, his look was flickering and he thought to himself.
While Wang Ping was deep in thought, his consciousness wavered, his view changed and he was back to the real world.
Immediately thereafter, the system’s voice began to play.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two from the following choices:
①. Life-bound Weapon.
②. Red Talent Wind Profound Physique.
③. Blue Talent: Chaotic World of the Demonic Cultivation.
④. Demonic Heavenly Stone.
⑤. Semi-saint Cultivation.”
“System, I choose ①. Life-bound weapon and Semi-saint Cultivation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 652: 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Chapter 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_3
Wang Ping glanced at the reward list and made his choice.
Although improving his cultivation would increase the resource consumption of the paid simulation, Wang Ping was now very wealthy and didn’t care about that much.
Anyway, once the resources were used up, he could earn more after raising his cultivation.
With low cultivation and insufficient strength, Wang Ping felt insecure.
Wang Ping now understood that he needed to quickly increase his cultivation to the Saint Realm tier and his strength to a level where he could contend with self-titled Supremes.
As for the rest, he would deal with it later.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he could feel an additional sacred artifact in his Sea of Consciousness.
That was his life-bound weapon.
Besides that, Wang Ping’s cultivation also skyrocketed rapidly, reaching the semi-saint tier within a short span of time, making him appear somewhat divine.
However, it must be said that the system rewards for cultivation were indeed worry-free, as there was no commotion at all.
Otherwise, he might have been noticed by that terrifying strongman.
At that time, it would have been dangerous.
“Continue the simulation,” Wang Ping thought inwardly and whispered, “System, how many resources do I need now for the paid simulation?”
“Ding, the host’s cultivation has reached the semi-saint tier, the simulation requires 5,000 mid-tier divine sources.”
Only 5,000 mid-tier divine sources, no problem. “System, simulate for me, let me see your limit.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly, quite extravagantly.
“Ding, consuming 5,000 mid-tier divine sources, life simulator activated, and Talent Refreshing…”
“Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Golden Talent: Heavenly Machine Shield; and Red Talent: Song and Dance.”
Golden Talent·Heavenly Machine Shield: With this talent, the host can block most of the heavenly secret techniques targeted at him.
Red Talent·Song and Dance: After singing and dancing, the host’s strength will be enhanced.
“Holy sh*t!”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time, and his eyes instantly brightened.
Goodness, this time he directly refreshed a golden talent.
Moreover, it was the golden talent he had always dreamt of, the one that could block heavenly secret techniques!
That is to say, with this talent, the Predecessor Transmigrators in the Second Generation Chat Group will no longer be able to find him using ordinary heavenly secret techniques.
As long as they couldn’t find him, Wang Ping would remain hidden while the others would be exposed.
In this situation, Wang Ping could grow safely.
Once Wang Ping had grown strong enough, he could deal with them as he pleased.
“System, I choose the Golden Talent·Heavenly Machine Shield!”
Wang Ping said with a smile.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
As the system’s voice rang out, Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway and entered an immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate on the Elemental Star, planning to wait until you had a breakthrough opportunity before going to other ancient stars to breakthrough, becoming a powerful saint.]
[Ten years later, Ruo Lan came to the Elemental Star to find you but discovered that the Heavenly Secret Talisman was useless, which made her suspicious and heavy-hearted.]
[However, even though Ruo Lan couldn’t find you, you actively sought her out. With the Purple Talent·Aura Concealment and Concealment Secret Skill, you unleashed a powerful strike, instantly killing Ruo Lan. As a semi-saint now, you’ve grown much stronger, and can easily kill Ruo Lan in a sneak attack.]
[After killing Ruo Lan, you were somewhat curious whether your current strength had reached the limit to fight against a self-titled saint. Of course, even though you were very curious about this, you didn’t have the intention to provoke a saint and fight them.]
[After killing Ruo Lan, you continued to cultivate. In the blink of an eye, more than 1,500 years passed, and the Tao Palace was still destroyed.]
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred years or so passed, and Ye Chen ran into trouble again. At this point, you remembered this matter. However, after some thought, you decided not to intervene. After all, your main goal in this simulation was to become a saint. You didn’t plan to leave seclusion until you became a saint.]
[However, something unexpected happened. Ye Chen was rescued by a mysterious strongman and didn’t die. This made you couldn’t help but sigh that Ye Chen’s luck seemed to be even greater after he arrived in the Upper Realm.]
[As for that Supreme Descendant, he never expected Ye Chen to escape and was extremely annoyed. What annoyed him even more was that he couldn’t find the Black Abyss Demon Spear, and the heavenly secret technique given to him by the Heavenly Calculation’s Child was also useless. This made him doubt whether Heavenly Calculation’s Child was lying to him.]
[Because of this, the Supreme Descendant felt that it was meaningless to stay on the secluded Elemental Star and chose to return to the Central Ancient Star Domain.]
[You didn’t know that the Supreme Descendant had left and continued to seclude yourself. In the blink of an eye, more than four hundred years passed, and a riot broke out on the Purgatory Ancient Star. You also sensed a strand of opportunity to become a saint.]
[This made you concentrate on cultivating, planning to break through in one fell swoop, reach the Saint barrier, and step into the Saint tier.]
[In the blink of an eye, three hundred years passed. While you were secluded and attempting to break through the Saint barrier, terrifying tremors occurred on Elemental Star, and a dreadful dark breath suddenly descended upon it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Chapter 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_4
[This also awakened you. After all, in such a situation, if you continued to attack, you might be possessed by devils. You were forced to come out and saw the scene in the outer world. Endless darkness enveloped the Elemental Star and even more distant places. Countless Dark Beings emerged from the darkness, surrounding the entire Elemental Star.]
[These Dark Beings, the weakest of which are in the Void Divine Realm, and the best among them have reached the Saint tier. This makes your face extremely solemn, guessing the origins of these Dark Beings.]
[Not only were you disturbed and forced to come out, but all the powerhouses on the Elemental Star were also alarmed. Even the Holy Land and Longevity Clan were horrified, and they hurriedly summoned their self-titled ancestors from within their powers.]
[Soon, the self-titled ancestors all came out. As they looked at the Dark Beings surrounding the Elemental Star from afar, they all fell silent and sighed. The Source of Darkness would erupt every once in a while, and endless Dark Beings would appear, affecting many ancient stars.]
[In this catastrophe, ancient stars with powerhouses guarding them can still hold on, and those with powerhouses above the Supreme Realm guarding them have a high probability of defeating the terrifying Dark Beings as long as they don’t encounter particularly bad luck.]
[However, not every ancient star has a Supreme sitting in it. Some ancient stars, even if they encounter a very weak Dark Being army, are difficult to resist, and most of the living beings will be slaughtered. At that time, it will take a long time for the ancient star to recover its vitality, and the World of Cultivators on it will suffer a heavy blow.]
[This time, the Source of Darkness has erupted again, and the Elemental Star they are on has obviously been affected. In this Dark Chaos, many dao lineages are likely to be destroyed in the battle, and they can only hope that their dao lineage will not be destroyed. At the same time, they hope that the Dark Being army affecting the Elemental Star this time is a small one and that there is no terrifying existence appearing.]
…
“The Source of Darkness, did this mine explode again? It’s really dangerous.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a slight frown and sighed.
“I hope we can get through this crisis this time. After all, there’s only a tiny bit left before becoming a saint, and dying here would be too much of a pity. Even though it’s said that even if you die, with the enlightenment, you can still become a saint in the next simulation, it’s more satisfying to become a saint in one go.”
Wang Ping thought to himself and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Soon, the war broke out. The Saint Realm Powerhouses took the lead in taking action, killing large swaths of Dark Beings. However, after killing a large number of Dark Beings, even more Dark Beings appeared, giving people goosebumps.]
[At the same time, these Saint Realm Powerhouses were quickly targeted by Dark Beings with Saint Realm combat power, and a terrifying battle broke out between the two sides. In addition, Semi-saints, God Monarchs, and cultivators below them also took action one after another, starting a life-and-death battle with the Dark Beings.]
[At this moment, no one can escape, only fighting to the death, killing all Dark Beings, then they can survive. Otherwise, if they were defeated in the battle, hiding anywhere would be useless, and they would be found and killed by the Dark Beings.]
[You watch this terrifying battle with a solemn face, with no intention of joining it, but thinking about how to escape from the Elemental Star. However, through your spatial perception, you discover something wrong. The entire Elemental Star is enveloped in darkness, making it impossible to escape.]
[At the same time, you are also targeted by powerful Dark Beings. These powerful Dark Beings are attacking you. Faced with this, you can’t help but sigh and have no choice but to confront them.]
[Soon, you kill all these Dark Beings, attracting the attention of even more Dark Beings. At the same time, your action greatly shocks the many cultivators on the Elemental Star, as they never expected that there was such a powerful Semi-saint hidden on the Elemental Star.]
[What’s more important is that the Emperor Scripture you practice is clearly the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. This makes them have to doubt that you are the surviving member of the destroyed Tao Palace. You pay no attention to the gazes of others, and continue to fight fiercely, casually killing a Dark Being capable of challenging a Semi-saint.]
[This further shocks everyone, as you, being a Semi-saint, are too powerful. Even the Saintfield Ancestors fighting in the battle cast their surprised gazes on you.]
[Next, the battle continues and becomes even more intense. More and more powerful Dark Beings appear, putting tremendous pressure on the Saintfield Ancestors. Even in the end, the number of Saint Realm Dark Beings that appear exceeds those on the Elemental Star side. If it were not for the major powers to use their hidden resources, they would have really collapsed.]
[Just as the terrifying battle becomes more intense, another Saint-tier Dark Creature emerges from the darkness. While this Dark Creature’s strength is only equivalent to that of an ordinary Saint who has just entered the Saint tier, its terrifying divine power still frightens the cultivators below the Saint tier, scaring them to the extreme.]
[Because they have discovered one thing: all the Saintfield Ancestors have been blocked, and no one can stop this Dark Creature, which is equivalent to a newcomer to the Saint tier. With their combat power, if they fought against this terrifying Dark Creature, they might be instantly crushed to death. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Chapter 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_5
[Seeing this, you frowned, knowing that you couldn’t protect yourself alone. Naturally, you knew that you had to step in at a critical moment. At the same time, you were filled with a fighting spirit, intending to battle this dark being to see what stage your strength had reached, and whether you already possessed the power to defeat a Saint tier being.]
[For this reason, you actively attacked this dark being who was equivalent to an early-stage Saint tier, intending to explode it. When you fought it, you felt immense pressure. However, you were still fearless and unfolded the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, using three types of laws and Divine Skills recorded in the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture to fight it fiercely.]
[This scene shocked many cultivators. They never expected that you would possess the legendary constitution and comprehend three laws, allowing you to fight a dark being of Saint tier. Even those Saints were also casting astonished gazes.]
[As Saint Realm Powerhouses, they naturally knew how astonishing it was for a Semi-saint to fight a Saint tier being. Even if this dark being did not possess any Divine Skills and only had a formidable strength and dark mana that were weaker than ordinary Saint Realm Powerhouses, it was, after all, a power that had entered the Saint tier. The fact that you could fight it proved that your power had reached this level, which was truly terrifying.]
[With such power, very few in the entire Upper Realm could rival you.]
[As everyone was shocked, you continued to fight the dark being that was equivalent to an early-stage Saint tier, occasionally triggering the critical strike effect of your Purple Talent: Endless Blade, causing the dark being to bleed profusely.]
[However, you found that it was difficult to kill it with your current means. As a result, you hardened your heart and no longer hid your trump card, using a more terrifying Divine Skill. That was the Burning Nine Transformations recorded in the later chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture.]
[As you unleashed the Burning Nine Transformations, a terrifying destructive force emerged, coupled with the critical strike effect of your Purple Talent: Endless Blade, instantly exploding and directly annihilating the powerful dark being.]
[This shocked everyone once again, as you had actually managed to slay a Saint tier being, even if it was just a dark being. Moreover, the Emperor-level Divine Skill you used was also quite well-known and controversial.]
[However, it was not the time to focus on these matters as they continued to fight. As for you, who had just exploded the powerful dark being, you barely had time to catch your breath when another crisis emerged.]
[That was the arrival of five terrifying dark beings, each of which was no weaker than the previous one and some of which were even much stronger.]
[Faced with this, your expression stiffened, knowing that if you continued to rely on your own strength, you would eventually die at the hands of these dark beings. As a result, although you hesitated a bit, aware of the consequences of summoning the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, you still decided to take it out.]
[After you summoned the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, the five dark beings that were charging at you were instantly killed. The terrifying power of the Supreme Artifact was undeniably evident. This made all the other Saint Realm Powerhouses stunned and astonished, not expecting you to possess such a treasure as a Supreme Artifact.]
[Among them, the people of the Mo Family were even more shocked, their expressions changing constantly. After all, it was their coveted Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear. It was just that they hadn’t found it in the lower realms before. They hadn’t expected that the Black Abyss Demon Spear had fallen into your hands.]
[However, given your demonstrated terrifying power and the fact that you were holding the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, they dared not say much. To attack you at this moment would be seeking death.]
[Not to mention that at this moment, everyone had to unite and fight against the dark beings; otherwise, they would all die.]
[The other powerful beings were also somewhat envious of your Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, but they ultimately didn’t plan to attack you. Among them, the most powerful, Patriarch Zhang, simply took a deep look at you without taking action.]
[Seeing this, you were slightly relieved. Although you guessed that they wouldn’t attack you at this moment, you still remained vigilant. After all, the Supreme Artifact was too precious, and it was not guaranteed that there wouldn’t be any powerful beings attempting to ambush you and snatch the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[For example, it was rumored that Patriarch Zhang was a Half-step Great Saint Realm powerhouse. Such a powerful person already possessed a speed that you couldn’t respond to. It was not impossible for them to kill you and take the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, and then use its power to help their own people escape the darkness and leave the Elemental Star.]
[Next, you continued to fight the dark beings with the Supreme Artifact in hand. Then, something desperate happened. The dark beings were endless, and powerful dark beings were becoming more and more numerous. Cultivators on the Ancient Star began to fall in droves.]
[Even God Monarchs and Semi-saints couldn’t hold out any longer. Even the Saints had begun to fall.]
[As for you, you were also targeted by dark beings that could rival the Saint King Realm. Such beings were no longer something you could easily kill with a single Supreme Artifact. Moreover, you were not targeted by just one Saint King tier dark being, but several powerful dark beings.]

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Chapter 195: The Long-Awaited Golden Talent! Cultivation Skyrockets_6
…..
“This Dark Disaster is truly dangerous.”
Wang Ping saw the simulation content and sighed silently, knowing that it would be difficult to pass this tribulation.
After all, a weapon is a weapon, and without someone to wield it, the power it can unleash is quite limited.
Although the Supreme Artifact is formidable, it too has its limits.
For the Supreme Artifact, if it were to exert its power by itself, it might make Saint Kings fearful and unwilling to confront it head-on. However, it’s not that easy for the Supreme Artifact to kill a Saint King.
As for the Great Saint tier, it’s even more impossible. A Great Saint can suppress the Supreme Artifact with their own power.
Of course, if two Saint Kings or Great Saints were to battle, and one side had a Supreme Artifact while the other didn’t, the situation would be different. The side without the Supreme Artifact would most likely be overwhelmed and killed by the side with the Supreme Artifact.
In short, weapons are powerful, but they also depend on the strength of their users.
[That is, when you were struggling in battle with several powerful Dark Beings, the situation suddenly changed, and the Half-step Great Saint from the Zhang Family launched a surprise attack on you. Although you were somewhat on guard against him, you ultimately couldn’t react in time due to the intense battle with the Dark Beings, and he successfully ambushed you.]
[As a result, you were killed on the spot, your body shattered. After your death, the Patriarch with Half-step Great Saint cultivation from the Zhang Family wanted to seize the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[However, just as he was about to seize the Black Abyss Demon Spear, your Red Talent·Death Whisper was triggered, and a terrifying blow erupted, striking him. Although the cultivation gap meant that you didn’t hurt him at all even after triggering the passive effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, you did manage to knock him back a short distance.]
[This was enough. After the Half-step Great Saint of the Zhang Family was knocked away, he was once again entangled by the terrifying Dark Beings, preventing him from trying to retrieve the Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[And, after your death, the Black Abyss Demon Spear also fell into a state of confusion. After all, it still remembered the promises you made to it, and didn’t expect you to die just like that.]
[Nevertheless, although the Black Abyss Demon Spear was a Demonic Artifact, it was still a Supreme Artifact that distinguished right from wrong. It knew that it was able to see the light of day again because you set it free. As a result, the Black Abyss Demon Spear, furious, chose to cooperate with the Dark Beings in attacking the Half-step Great Saint of the Zhang Family.]
[The Half-step Great Saint of the Zhang Family was attacked by the Black Abyss Demon Spear. Although his cultivation level had reached a point where he was no longer afraid of the Black Abyss Demon Spear, he still had to deal with the powerful Dark Beings, making the situation extremely dangerous and frustrating for him. He never expected that his attempt to steal the spear would backfire.]
[As for the other Saint Realm powerhouses on the Elemental Star, they began to distance themselves from the Patriarch of the Zhang Family, feeling contempt and dread, fearing that he might stab them in the back.]
[The flow of time swiftly passed, and in a blink of an eye, an hour had passed. During this hour, the cultivators on the Elemental Star were essentially wiped out, ordinary cultivators were slaughtered, and the entire Elemental Star had turned into a hellish purgatory.]
[As for the Saint Realm cultivators, they also couldn’t hold on any longer, and more than half of them perished. Although the Patriarch of the Zhang Family managed to kill the Dark Beings and temporarily seal the Black Abyss Demon Spear, his condition was extremely poor.]
[At this point, you were resurrected. After your resurrection, you saw the miserable state of the Patriarch of the Zhang Family. With extreme hatred, you charged at him without hesitation. You knew that this was a battle with no chance of survival.]
[Seeing you revive and charge at him, the Patriarch of the Zhang Family was shocked and furious, not expecting you to have such a resurrection technique. However, in his opinion, you were just seeking death. Even with his poor condition, killing a Semi-saint like you would still be an easy task for him.]
[But, what he didn’t expect was that during your charge, you broke through the barrier at any cost, summoning the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[As your Saint Calamity appeared, the entire Elemental Star was engulfed in a terrifying tribulation aura, even dispersing some of the darkness.]
[At the same time, due to your Heavenly Tribulation covering the area, the already terrifying Saint Calamity became even more terrifying. After all, Heavenly Tribulation couldn’t be interfered with, and the more cultivators there were within its range, the more powerful it would become, reaching a terrifying level. Even a Great Saint entering the tribulation would inevitably die.]
[Seeing you leading the Heavenly Tribulation towards him, the Patriarch of the Zhang Family’s scalp went numb as he tried to escape, but it was already too late. Both he and the Dark Beings were locked on to by the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[In the end, the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation erupted, and everyone, whether it was you, the Patriarch of the Zhang Family, or the other Dark Beings, all perished within the Heavenly Tribulation. No matter how many lives they had, it wouldn’t have been enough to survive.]
[Due to your death, the simulation ends here.]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various images and insights. Finally, his figure appeared above the Primordial Star, witnessing the horrifying scene of the Heavenly Tribulation shattering everything.
“It seems I still died. However, I wonder if forcing myself to become a Saint will have any effect on the rewards in the simulation.”
Wang Ping watched the scene and thought to himself.
If he only ended up with a reward like a Water Saint, he would be torn.
Well, though he couldn’t complain as he could choose not to accept it.
However, if he couldn’t even choose the almost breakthrough Semi-Saint cultivation, he would be really upset.
As Wang Ping was pondering, his consciousness shook, and he returned to the real world.
Then, the system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Spiritual Cultivation (incomplete Dao Foundation, have not crossed the Heavenly Tribulation).
②. Semi-Saint Cultivation (near breakthrough).
③. Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield.
④. Red Talent: Song and Dance.”
…..
“System, I choose ②. Semi-Saint Cultivation (near breakthrough) and ③. Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield.”
After glancing at the rewards, Wang Ping made his choice without any hesitation.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his cultivation increase once again, and he was not far from condensing his Sacred Body, reaching the Mana and Divine Soul breakthroughs.
At this moment, Wang Ping only needed to endure a little longer before he could achieve a perfect breakthrough and pass the Heavenly Tribulation to become a Saint.
Soon after, Wang Ping felt additional information in his mind.
That was the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield, which would allow Wang Ping to selectively shield himself from the probing of Heavenly Secrets, making it extremely useful.
“Not bad, not bad.”
Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction and prepared to continue with the simulation.
He wouldn’t rest until he became a Saint in a day!

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Chapter 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion
However, just as Wang Ping was about to try and let Xu Yi’s Golden Finger work its magic and see if he could multiply his resources before moving on to the Paid Simulation, the chat group system’s voice suddenly spoke up.
“Ding, group member Xiao Shitian (93) has joined the chat.”
“Ding, group member Xia Daoguang (94) has joined the chat.”
“Ding, group member Liao Lifeng (95) has joined the chat.”
…
“Huh? Three more newbies? Interesting.”
Wang Ping stopped what he was doing, became interested, and directly opened the chat group page.
Then, Wang Ping saw a very familiar scene.
The old group members’ ‘kind reminders’, the confusion of the newcomers, and then the dilemma of choosing Soul Travel or Physical Travel.
Xiao Shitian (93): “I’m so good-looking, it’s such a waste to choose Soul Travel. Brothers, I’ll go with Physical Travel, watch me land easily, get a powerful Golden Finger and take off instantly.”
Xia Daoguang (94): “As a newcomer, why can you be so optimistic?”
Liao Lifeng (95): “I’m screwed, I’m so unlucky usually; I feel like I’ll die whether it’s Soul Travel or Physical Travel.”
Wu Jun (20): “Wow, the polarization of this group of newcomers is a bit severe. The optimistic ones are super optimistic, and the negative ones are especially negative.”
Fang Yun (3): “Newcomers, a kind reminder – whether you choose Soul Travel or Physical Travel, the first thing after crossing over is to draw your Golden Finger and then explain its abilities in the chat group. If your Golden Fingers are useful, we are more than willing to spend some Group points to revive you.”
Wang Ping (66): “Fang Yun is right. Drawing the Golden Finger is the most important thing, and everything else is secondary.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Drip, Master Ball, catch Brother Wang.”
Xiao Shitian (93): “Revive? There’s such a good thing? Understood, I’ll go with Physical Travel.”
After dropping this sentence, Xiao Shitian directly chose Physical Travel.
A second later, the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, group member Xiao Shitian (93) has died, Death Replay Video has been recorded, all group members should take this as a warning and learn from it.”
Wang Ping (66): “…..”
Everyone: “……..”
Zhang Hu (5): “Damn, he’s already dead? That’s too off the wall; he didn’t even last a second.”
Zhang Jun (70): “…..landing and turning into a box….no, there’s a high probability he didn’t even land before he died…..”
Fang Yun (3): “I must say, it’s been a while since something like this happened in the chat group….this death speed is far faster than Chen Kang’s.”
Chen Kang (67): “……”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Really unlucky….thankfully I’m still alive.”
Xia Daoguang (94): “Damn, I’ll choose Soul Travel. Whoever chooses Physical Travel is a fool.”
Liao Lifeng (95): “….I second the person above.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “Terrifying, the newbies are frightened.”
Qin Tian (77): “Can you blame them? I’d be scared too.”
As everyone kept voicing their complaints, the Death Replay Video was finally recorded, and Wang Ping immediately clicked to watch it.
Then, Wang Ping’s eyes became strange.
That’s because the place Xiao Shitian crossed over to was truly miserable, going straight to the central area where two terrifying powerhouses were fighting. The moment he appeared, he was shredded by energy and turned into dust, not even lasting a second.
“However, this world seems very powerful. Moreover, this system is quite interesting.”
Wang Ping looked at the images in the Death Playback Video and stroked his chin.
In the video, both fighters had unique Martial Souls on their heads, which granted the cultivators powerful forces and special abilities as they fought each other.
Their strength had reached the level of the God Monarch Realm.
Wang Ping didn’t think that Xiao Shitian would encounter the most top-level powerhouse battle in this world right after crossing over. There was a high probability that this world had even stronger existences than those in the God Monarch Realm.
“Alpha, how strong is this world?”
When unsure, ask Alpha directly. Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Very strong, the most powerful realm is equivalent to the Saint King in your world, and even more so, it may be close to the half-step Great Saint Tier.”
Alpha replied to Wang Ping.
“A Martial Soul System that can rival a half-step Great Saint? Interesting.”
Wang Ping became interested.
In his world, it was still the Last Dharma Age.
In the Last Dharma Age, even if one could defy the heavens and become a Saint, it was still very difficult to continue improving and advance.
Once reaching the Saint Realm, the dependence on the roots and special constitution for resources would decline.
In the Saint Realm, the most important thing for cultivation is willpower and enlightenment.
With successful enlightenment, one’s cultivation would skyrocket.
If enlightenment failed, one might die and lose the Dao.
This, it can be said, is thrilling at every step.
Of course, although the roots and special constitution would decline in proportion, it does not mean they are useless. Some people who cultivate steadily have deeper foundations and are stronger in the same realm.
Besides, special constitutions and unique bloodlines also have significant enhancements on combat strength.
“In the Last Dharma Age, where the Heavenly Rules are not manifested, even if I have the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, it would be difficult to attain enlightenment, and my advancement speed would not be fast. I might even be stuck at the Saint Tier.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself in secret.
“If it weren’t for the difficulty of cultivation during the Last Dharma Age, the majority of old monsters would not be self-sealed, waiting for the Last Dharma Age to pass before continuing to cultivate. This is because cultivating during the Last Dharma Age is a waste of one’s lifespan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 657: 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Chapter 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_2
“If there are other paths to take, to increase my strength and possess a cultivation higher than the Saint Realm, it would not only alleviate the problem of resource consumption, but also make me more confident when facing those old monsters,”
“I originally wanted to grow stronger through the body refining path of Wang Shuqi’s World, but later I discovered that the body refining path of the Tao Palace was not weaker than that of Wang Shuqi’s World, and was even more powerful. Plus, body refining consumes a lot of resources, so I put aside the High Martial System’s cultivation,”
“Now, if I can explore this Martial Soul System, it would be nice.”
All sorts of thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind,
Then, Wang Ping once again asked Alpha, “Alpha, can I go to this world?”
“No, unless you revive this newcomer, you can’t go there. And even if you do, your stay would be very short,”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded,
“I figured so,” Wang Ping was not at all surprised by this answer,
“It would be nice if I could draw a talent related to incarnations. That way, I could divide my other bodies, practice simultaneously in other simulated worlds, and finally unite all the methods, feeling great,”
Wang Ping said with some regret,
Although he also had the secret skill of creating incarnations, it was not as good as natural talent, and he was also worried about losing control after sending them to other worlds and losing contact.
“To stay in a world for a long time, you can only do so as an ordinary person who has just traveled through time. Because once you have power, you will be labeled as belonging to that world and can easily be rejected. Only ordinary travelers who have successfully crossed over can survive in that world and gradually be given the world’s label,”
Alpha said quietly,
“That’s why I said I need a talent for incarnations, an ordinary version of me might be able to simulate properly,”
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief and spoke,
“Unless you’re extremely lucky, the chances of refreshing this kind of talent are pretty low,”
Alpha’s voice sounded again,
“It’s just a thought. If I can get it, that’s great, but if not, I won’t be too worried about it,”
Wang Ping smiled, not continuing the discussion on this topic,
At this point, in the chat group, the two newcomers had also made their choice and chose Soul Travel,
Then, Xia Daoguang, the newcomer, successfully Soul Traveled into the body of a middle-aged man,
Although he was a somewhat fat middle-aged man, at least he was a man, which was better than becoming a woman or some strange animal,
For this, Xia Daoguang, the newcomer, was quite happy,
As for Liao Lifeng, the new guy, he crossed over into the body of a countryside dog,
This made Liao Lifeng extremely depressed,
Fang Yun (3): “What are you depressed about, you are at least still alive, which is already pretty good. Not like the first newcomer who died directly. Moreover, once you become strong, walking the path of a demon cultivator and transforming into a human form isn’t impossible,”
Liao Lifeng (95): “You make so much sense that I have nothing to say,”
Xia Daoguang (94): “I see, I’ll start drawing the golden finger now,”
Liao Lifeng (95): “I’ll go draw my golden finger as well,”
Soon, both newcomers had drawn their golden fingers and started chatting again,
Xia Daoguang (94): “Damn, I am a bit unlucky, the golden finger I drew is kind of rubbish. It’s called Human Limiters Unlocking, and I can become stronger just by exercising,”
Liao Lifeng (95): “My golden finger seems pretty good. It’s called Power of Laziness. As long as I’m lazy enough, I can become stronger automatically,”
Fang Yun (3): “???”
Qin Tian (77): “…..Xia Daoguang, are you trying to brag?”
Wu Jun (20): “Unlocking human limiters, I’m envious! Uh, for the sake of my hair, I’ll not be envious,”
Wang Shuqi (74): “To tell you the truth, I don’t care about things like hair at all. Being able to become stronger quickly is the most important thing,”
Xia Daoguang (94): “What the hell did I brag about?”
Wang Ping (66) @ Xia Daoguang (94): “Don’t you watch anime and manga?”
Xia Daoguang (94): “I’m not an otaku, why would I watch anime and manga,”
Wang Ping (66): “Based on what he said, it seems he really doesn’t know. Anyway, if it’s the same as what I remember, your golden finger is quite good and can easily become stronger. However, all golden fingers have their limits, and yours is no exception. To break through the limit, you still need to earn group points to upgrade it,”
Xia Daoguang (94): “Uh…..”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, instead of chatting in the group, I think you should hurry up and find a safe place to settle down and figure out the situation in your own world,”
After leaving this sentence, Wang Ping went quiet.
As for the issue of reviving the first newcomer, Wang Ping decided to take it slow.
If he really gets stuck in the upcoming simulations, he doesn’t mind reviving the newcomer.
After all, newcomers are just ordinary people, and even if they become somewhat stronger after receiving the newcomer’s gift package, it’s not much,
With Wang Ping’s current number of group points, even if the newcomer is resurrected a couple of years later, it will not cost very many group points,
“Now that you mention it, it seems that there were quite good worlds among the travelers who died before I joined the group, with some of their golden fingers appearing to be good,”

chapters.title: Chapter 658: 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Chapter 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_3
Wang Ping stroked his chin, suddenly thinking about it.
“Forget it, let’s talk about the resurrection issue later, there’s no hurry now.”
Then, Wang Ping shook his head again, clearing some distracting thoughts from his mind.
Following that, Wang Ping opened Xu Yi’s private chat page and sent him the Divine Source.
It was a pity that the multiplier failed for the mid-tier Divine Source this time, while the top-tier one triggered a two-fold increase, bringing the total top-tier Divine Source in Wang Ping’s hands to three thousand pounds.
After taking back the Divine Source, Wang Ping said in his heart, “System, I want to start a new Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming 5,000 mid-tier Divine Sources, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Purple Talent·Blood Drinking; Red Talent·Inspiration.”
Purple Talent·Blood Drinking: With this talent, the host will gain a certain level of healing effect according to the damage inflicted during a battle with an enemy.
Red Talent·Inspiration: With this talent, the host can inspire the morale of the army and increase their combat power.
“Huh, endurance type talent? Too bad it’s only purple….”
Wang Ping looked at the talents he had refreshed and was slightly surprised.
For Wang Ping now, purple talents, unless they are of special types that can be used regardless of their level, would not really be able to keep up with the pace.
Purple corresponds to Divine Realm.
Gold corresponds to Saint Realm.
Generally, purple talents are useful for the Divine Realm, and gold talents are useful for the Saint Realm.
Of course, some special talents can surpass levels.
As such, Wang Ping was not expecting much from this Purple Talent.
“But it’s better than nothing. System, I choose Purple Talent·Blood Drinking.”
Wang Ping muttered, then spoke up.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
As the system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway as he entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text floated out.
[Day 1, you chose cultivation in seclusion. In the blink of an eye, ten years have passed, you killed Ruo Lan.]
[Time flow speeds up, Great Saint Secret Realm opens, you choose to enter it, easily obtaining the Divine Medicine and Great Saint Inheritance, leaving calmly.]
[Then, you chose to leave the Elemental Star and go to a desolate planet for cultivation in seclusion, using the Divine Medicine and numerous top-tier Divine Sources to break through the Saint Realm.]
[In the end, you seized the opportunity to become a Saint, breaking through that barrier and stepping into the Saint Realm. As you stepped into the Saint tier, a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation began to brew, covering the starry sky.]
[In response, you looked up and laughed, fearless, with all your strength, fighting the Heavenly Tribulation. It had to be said that you had a solid foundation, and in addition to the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, the Saint Calamity was indeed very terrifying, even for someone like you, it was barely manageable.]
[However, you eventually survived the Saint Calamity and became a powerful Saint in the Last Dharma Age. When you became a Saint, a terrifying golden glow swept through the starry sky, extremely dazzling, a strong divine power spreading in all directions, causing the desolate planets not far away to explode.]
[You felt the powerful force within your body and had great confidence in yourself. You believed that in this Last Dharma Age, as long as you didn’t have bad luck in encountering those old monsters wandering outside, your survival rate would greatly improve, and you could go anywhere in the world.]
“Although I anticipated it, it’s finally becoming a Saint, which makes me feel relieved.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and couldn’t help but smile.
To Wang Ping, it was inevitable that he would become a Saint in this simulation.
After all, in the last simulation, he had already touched the bottleneck of becoming a Saint and could break the barrier.
It was only because of a sudden encounter with the Source of Darkness that he was forced to undergo the Tribulation, leading away enemies and some Dark Beings.
