This time, as he was on the verge of a breakthrough, with the presence of Divine Medicine and top-tier Divine Sources, not breaking through was the strange thing, and he would even suspect that he was being targeted by the Heavenly Tao.
Next, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[Just as you were overflowing with confidence, a sudden voice sounded, startling you. You looked towards the source of the sound and saw an interested middle-aged man, who was drinking heartily from a wine pot, praising your accomplishment of becoming a Saint in this Last Dharma Age as surprising.]
[You looked at the middle-aged man drinking heartily, your expression serious. For you realized that you could not see through the man’s cultivation. The other person was clearly not an ordinary Saint. You were very cautious, prepared to fight or flee at any moment, and began to inquire who the other person was and why they were spying on your Crossing Tribulation.]
[The middle-aged man chuckled and said you didn’t need to be tense, he just happened to pass by and sensed the Saint Calamity, coming to take a look. He just didn’t expect that, in this age, a Space-Time Body like yours would actually appear. However, he also pointed out that your Body is incomplete.]
[To that, you could only be silent. Your Space-Time Body was indeed incomplete, and a complete Space-Time Body would definitely not be only evaluated as a Golden Talent. However, you naturally wouldn’t mention the matter of extracting talents.]
[Seeing your silence, the middle-aged man waved his wine gourd at you, asked if you wanted to have a drink. To which, you naturally refused.]

chapters.title: Chapter 659: 196: Wang Pingcheng Becomes Holy! The Mysterious Nine Stars Pavilion_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Chapter 196: Wang Pingcheng Becomes Holy! The Mysterious Nine Stars Pavilion_4
[Seeing your extreme vigilance, the middle-aged man felt quite bored and revealed his identity. He said that his name is Dark Star, and you can call him Dark Star Sage. He comes from the Nine Stars Pavilion. If you’re interested, you can follow him to the Nine Stars Pavilion, where you may have a chance to replenish the origin of your Time-Space Body in the future.]
[Hearing the middle-aged man’s words, you felt surprised that he would say such a thing. After all, replenishing the origin of the Time-Space Body is a great opportunity that would move not only Supremes but even Quasi-Emperors.]
[You searched your mind for information about the Nine Stars Pavilion, but you couldn’t find any information about this powerful organization. You even once read a lot of books in the Scripture Repository of the Tao Palace during a simulation. The ancient books of Tao Palace contain many secrets, but there is no information about the Nine Stars Pavilion, which is astounding.]
[Although today’s Tao Palace could not compare with the past one, it still proves that the Nine Stars Pavilion is mysterious enough.]
[You asked Dark Star Sage what exactly the Nine Stars Pavilion is and where it comes from. While drinking wine, Dark Star Sage answered your questions, saying that the Nine Stars Pavilion has no base and is a completely free and loose organization. Members of the Nine Stars Pavilion include eccentric creatures from major powers or hidden strong beings or mysterious monsters.]
[All of these members were special existences, and there were no weak ones. After all, the minimum requirement to join the Nine Stars Pavilion is to be a Great Saint or a monster genius destined to become a saint. Even ordinary saints are not qualified to join the Nine Stars Pavilion and won’t be invited.]
[Listening to Dark Star Sage’s words, you were shocked. The Nine Stars Pavilion was indeed terrifying, with the minimum requirement to join being a Great Saint or a monster being destined to become a saint. Moreover, ordinary saints were not even eligible for an invitation.]
[Then, you asked what was the purpose of establishing this free and loose organization called the Nine Stars Pavilion. Dark Star Sage chuckled and said that no one knew the origin of the founder or the purpose behind creating the Nine Stars Pavilion. All you needed to know was that no one in the Nine Stars Pavilion knew each other’s true identity, and they all operated under codenames in the world.]
[Hearing this, you frowned and wondered if the purpose of the Nine Stars Pavilion was only to gather strong beings.]
[Seeing your confusion, Dark Star Sage shook his head with a smile, saying that people wouldn’t be interested in joining if that was the case. The reason for joining was the benefits within the Nine Stars Pavilion. Once joined, you would get a scripture for free, allowing you to conceal your own Dao skills and identity.]
[With this scripture, even a Quasi-Emperor would have difficulty seeing through your Dao origin and true identity, making this benefit appealing enough for many cultivators.]
[Besides, the biggest benefit of the Nine Stars Pavilion was that it allowed its members to abandon their real-world identities and work together on certain tasks for even greater benefits.]
[These tasks could be issued by powerful members within the Nine Stars Pavilion or even its mysterious founder. In any case, completing them would result in a lot of benefits.]
[Apart from that, the greatest benefit of the Nine Stars Pavilion was the Nine Stars. If you were able to become one of the Nine Stars, you could gain power rivaling that of an Emperor.]
[Hearing this, you were shocked. Competing with an Emperor was a bit too outrageous considering that Emperors were the strongest existences in the Upper Realm, ruling over cultivation. In this era, it’s debatable whether the total number of existing Emperors across the Ten Great Universes exceeded a hundred.]
[Yet, the Nine Stars Pavilion dared to claim that becoming one of the Nine Stars would make one equal in strength to an Emperor, which sounded ridiculous.]
[Subsequently, you curiously asked Dark Star Sage how to become one of the Nine Stars. Dark Star Sage took a big gulp of wine and chuckled, saying that you didn’t have the qualifications to know yet. First, you had to join the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[Hearing this, you decided to join the so-called Nine Stars Pavilion after some consideration. Whether it was to gather intelligence or satisfy your own curiosity, you had no reason to refuse.]
[Seeing you choose to join the Nine Stars Pavilion, Dark Star Sage nodded in satisfaction, gave you a scripture and a token, then tore through the space and left.]
[Taking the scripture, you found it to be the magical Secret Skill that Dark Star Sage mentioned, which could hide your Dao skill origins and true identity for free for those who practiced it in the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[After researching it with curiosity, you began cultivating it. A year later, you successfully cultivated the Secret Skill. When used, it could conceal your Dao origin, even if you used the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture or the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and their Divine Skills in the future, making them appear as unique star techniques, thereby preventing people from seeing the true nature of your skills.]
[This astonished you. This Secret Skill seemed too miraculous and exceeded the level it should have been at. However, you thought about how the Upper Realm was inhabited by many Myriad Heavens Forces and figured that perhaps this Secret Skill originated from the All Heavens and the Nine Stars Pavilion had been created by a powerful existence from the Myriad Heavens Forces.]
[But all of these were just your guesses, and what the truth was would require further exploration.]

chapters.title: Chapter 660: 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Chapter 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_5
…..
“The Upper Realm’s waters are indeed deep, as a strange force has emerged from the Nine Stars Pavilion,” Wang Ping thought while watching the simulation content.
“However, although it’s somewhat unexpected, being pulled into this Nine Stars Pavilion, as long as I’m not dead, it’s fine,” Wang Ping sighed with relief.
When he saw the Dark Star Sage appear, he thought this simulation would end again.
After all, Great Saints are just too powerful. Even if he breaks through to the Saint tier and holds the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, he can’t possibly contend with them.
Skipping realms must be logical.
A Saint and a Great Saint are separated by two great realms, their strengths vastly different.
Moreover, none of the individuals who can become a Great Saint are simple characters. To skip realms and kill them is nearly impossible – even as a half-step Great Saint, perhaps it wouldn’t guarantee victory.
Maybe, after becoming a half-step Great Saint and wielding the Black Abyss Demon Spear, he could face them head-on.
As various thoughts appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, the simulation continued.
[Next, after thinking it over, you chose to return to the Elemental Star. Although many things will still happen on the Elemental Star, you know what will happen in the future, so you can avoid danger. As such, there’s no need to take risks by running to other Ancient Stars.]
[Of course, the main reason is that your current resources are barely enough. Traveling to other Ancient Stars, where the environment is unfamiliar, you might not be able to obtain valuable resources, so it’s better to stay in a familiar place and plan some things.]
[After you returned to the Elemental Star, you went to the Whiteflame Divine Sect. After arriving, you wanted to take the young and immature Lin Qinghe as your disciple.]
[Surprised by your sudden decision to take a disciple, Lin Qinghe was baffled, and the Whiteflame Divine Sect members were outraged. This blatant poaching behavior was simply too brazen, most especially Lin Qinghe’s master, who was furious.]
[However, after displaying your divine power, all their anger subsided, and they became extremely frightened.]
[Lin Qinghe was also shocked, never expecting you to be a powerful Saint. After all, in the Last Dharma Age, Saints have become legendary beings, and haven’t appeared for over ten thousand years.]
[Nevertheless, Lin Qinghe was shocked by your Saint identity, but she still refused you, indicating she already had a master. The higher-ups of the Whiteflame Divine Sect were all horrified, not only unimpressed, but also afraid that you would kill them all in anger.]
[Hearing Lin Qinghe’s words, you sneered and directly exposed the actions of the Whiteflame Divine Sect. This made Lin Qinghe incredulous, but when you performed a soul-searching and showed her the memory, Lin Qinghe remained silent.]
[Afterward, she unhesitatingly chose to acknowledge you as her master, hoping that you would take revenge for her. Without any hesitation, you took a cold and domineering approach, killing all the Whiteflame Divine Sect higher-ups and leaving with Lin Qinghe.]
[News of the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s higher-ups being wiped out quickly spread, shaking the world. Cultivators of the Elemental Star never expected that a Saint would appear during the Last Dharma Age. They were even more shocked when they inquired about the details.]
[Among them, the Green Spirit Divine Sect and North Snow Divine Dynasty were the most surprised. Because you always used Bai Tianhong’s identity and appearance to move through the world, they recalled that you only had perfect mastery of the God Monarch Realm a hundred years ago. Now, however, you have become a Saint – a truly terrifying development.]
[As various forces were shocked and eagerly seeking information about you, you brought Lin Qinghe to the Tao Palace. The reason you came to the Tao Palace is simple – you wanted to join the Tao Palace. If you could enter the Tao Palace, you would have a chance to obtain control of the Emperor Force of Tao Tian, a precious weapon, in the future.]
[Although the Tao Palace was destroyed and the Emperor Force of Tao Tian was banished and sealed, you were destined to obtain it one day. This was a major opportunity that you couldn’t afford to miss.]
[Regarding your request to join the Tao Palace, the Master of the Tao Palace was quite surprised. He couldn’t believe that a powerful Saint like you wanted to join the Tao Palace. When you showed him your incomplete space-time Dao body and cultivation of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, the Palace Master was even more shocked.]
[However, in its heyday, the Tao Palace would have been fine, since enlisting a Saint to become a Guest Elder would be quite normal. As for the current Tao Palace, allowing you to join presents too many potential dangers. After all, you are too powerful, and the Tao Palace can’t provide you with the resources you need.]
[If you were weak and joined the Tao Palace, perhaps the Tao Palace could cultivate you, creating some sense of attachment. But you are already so powerful that joining the Tao Palace may not foster any emotional ties. Moreover, your mysterious background and purpose for joining the Tao Palace raise suspicions.]
[In the end, after the Palace Master’s silence, he refused your request to join. You sighed in your heart, disappointed but not surprised by his decision.]
[After all, it’s the same with all forces. Whether in the lower realm or the upper realm, it’s no problem if you want to join when you are weak. But when you are too powerful, they must carefully reconsider.]
[Nevertheless, although you couldn’t join the Tao Palace, you informed them of some events that would happen in the future, allowing the Tao Palace to prepare in advance, then left.]

chapters.title: Chapter 661: 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Chapter 196: Wang Ping Becomes a Saint! The Mysterious Nine-Star Pavilion_6
[In the following days, you take Lin Qinghe around the Elemental Ancient Star, teaching her cultivation and developing the potential of her Devouring Immortal Demon Body. Due to your careful nurturing, Lin Qinghe has grown to the Semi-saint level in just a thousand years.]
[This is the result of there not being too many strong source powers on the Elemental Ancient Star for her to devour. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be impossible for Lin Qinghe to become a Saint.]
[During these thousand years, you have been diligently cultivating, but you finally understand the meaning of the Last Dharma Age, where Saints are rare. In this Last Dharma Age, it is difficult to become a Saint, and even more difficult to cultivate after becoming one.]
[After entering the Saint Realm, Enlightenment is the most important thing, and resources are secondary. When you reached the Saint Realm, resources were just enough for you, but not enough for you to use luxuriously. In addition, during the Last Dharma Age, Laws are scarce, making it even harder to achieve Enlightenment.]
[As a result, after a thousand years, you are still at the first tier of the Saint realm and haven’t stepped into the second tier. For a while, you even wanted to self-tittle yourself, waiting for the Golden Age to come.]
[However, you eventually gave up on this idea. After all, no one knows when the Golden Age will come, and self-titling is not without risk. Instead of doing that, you might as well continue exploring the Upper Realm, venturing into various mysterious places and gathering information. After all, you are currently in a life simulation, and have plenty of time.]
[In the blink of an eye, another few hundred years have passed, and the Tao Palace has been destroyed.]
[In addition, Ye Chen arrived in the Upper Realm and joined the Purple Cloud Divine Place, just like in your memories, and had some friction with the Supreme Descendants from the Central Ancient Star Domain. He was locked up by the Saint Lord of the Purple Cloud Divine Place.]
[This time, you chose to go to the Purple Cloud Divine Place, hiding in space to observe Ye Chen, wanting to see what powerful being had taken him away. Because you are proficient in Space Law and Concealment Secret Skill, the Saint protecting the Supreme Descendant didn’t detect your presence.]
[Of course, this also has to do with the fact that the other party is just an ordinary Saint. If it were a powerful Saint, they wouldn’t have appeared in this Last Dharma Age and been assigned as the protector of the Supreme Descendants. However, fortunately, he is an ordinary Saint; if he were a powerful Saint, he might still have been able to detect your presence.]
[Soon, you got your answer. In Ye Chen’s newly acquired ring, a powerful soul force emerged, which was extremely powerful, at least at the level of a Saint. With such power in his soul state, one can imagine how powerful he must have been in his prime.]
[However, while you were amazed, you mostly felt it was a ridiculous coincidence, given that Ye Chen had encountered another “ring grandfather” – he had already switched so many times along the way.]
[But, you were soon proved wrong. This time, it wasn’t a “ring grandfather,” but a “ring grandmother.” At this, you looked at Ye Chen with a strange expression, feeling that he had deviated from the usual pattern.]
[Next, the ring grandmother directly pointed out your presence, inquiring solemnly why you were spying here. You chose to reveal yourself in response.]
[When you emerged from the spatial hiding, Ye Chen was stunned, then overjoyed. After all, he hadn’t seen you, his mentor, for a long time. During his time in the Upper Realm, he had been trying to find news of you but to no avail, which had made him worry that something had happened to you.]
[After catching up with Ye Chen, the ring grandmother learned of your relationship with Ye Chen and was no longer vigilant against you.]
[However, she was mostly shocked because she saw that you were a Saint. According to Ye Chen, you were just a newly ascended Void lord over a thousand years ago. Growing from a Void lord to a Saint in just over a thousand years in the Last Dharma Age was truly astonishing, even for the Imperial Clan’s Emperor’s sons.]
[Only those Emperor’s sons who received a massive amount of resources during the Golden Age could achieve such accomplishments as you have.]
[For a moment, the ring grandmother regarded you with great respect, thinking that you might have a promising future as a Tao Proving character.]
[After some idle chat, you left together. After leaving, the ring grandmother revealed her plan to take Ye Chen to her power, the Thunderflame Valley, for cultivation. She hoped that you would join them, and if you could join the Thunderflame Valley, it would be the best.]
[You listened to the ring grandmother’s words with mixed feelings, but you chose to refuse. After all, you were somewhat familiar with the Thunderflame Valley. It is a powerful force on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, rumored to have a Supreme in power during its heyday. Although you don’t know if there is a self-titled Supreme in the current Thunderflame Valley, it is still a strong power.]
[Nevertheless, even though the Thunderflame Valley is strong, it is still not your goal. Your goal is to join those powers with a Great Emperor in charge. Only by joining such a major power can you avoid being targeted by those old monsters. To be more precise, you can largely avoid being targeted by those old monsters.]
[Seeing your refusal, the ring grandmother was somewhat disappointed but didn’t say much. She chose to take Ye Chen away. Ye Chen was reluctant to leave but said goodbye to you and followed the ring grandmother to the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star.]
[Afterward, you no longer had the mood to stay on the Elemental Ancient Star, since the Dark Disaster would erupt in a while. At that time, even if you have already become a Saint, there would still be a risk to your life.]
[Hence, in the remaining time, going to an Ancient Star with a Supreme sitting in town, or directly to the Central Ancient Star Domain, was extremely necessary.]
[However, just as you were about to take your disciple Lin Qinghe away from the Elemental Ancient Star, a message appeared on your Nine stars Token, giving you a task exclusive to you. This task was to enter the Elemental Forbidden Land and find an Elemental Sacred Stone. Whether to accept this task or not was up to you, and there was no compulsion.]
[As the Dark Star Sage had said, the Nine Stars Pavilion is an absolutely free and loose power that doesn’t force its members to do anything.]
[At this point, you fell into deep thought and indecision….]
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping entered an immersive simulation state, his mind filled with insights and images.
Finally, his figure appeared somewhere on the Elemental Ancient Star.
“So I was forced to enter an immersive simulation again, huh? It looks like it’s time for a branching story. Based on experience, entering the Elemental Forbidden Land is very likely to lead to mishaps.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, his eyes flickering, lost in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 662: 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Chapter 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!
“To go or not to go, that is the question.”
Wang Ping hesitated slightly, feeling torn.
Based on experience, if he went, something would definitely go wrong.
However, by going, he would certainly uncover some secrets that would pave the way for future simulations.
“Let’s go, I won’t be able to increase my cultivation much during this simulation anyway.”
In the end, Wang Ping made the decision.
During this simulation, he had already become a saint, and had achieved his goal. He couldn’t improve his cultivation much afterwards, and even if he could, the slight increase in cultivation wouldn’t be of much use.
Therefore, exploring the Elemental Forbidden Land to see what secrets it hid seemed more cost-effective.
Wang Ping had always been extremely curious about the Elemental Secret Realm.
The palace master of Tao Palace had entered this place and had brought back a god stone for him, which helped him build the Divine Platform and successfully break through to the True Divine Realm.
However, at that time, the palace master of Tao Palace had most likely been in a very peripheral area and hadn’t ventured in too deep.
Otherwise, even a saint entering too deeply into this place might face danger, let alone a cultivator at the peak of the God King Realm like him.
After all, the Elemental Forbidden Land was of mysterious origin. Wang Ping understood from the knowledge he had gained during past simulations that this place had existed in the primordial past.
Its emergence could be traced back to a million years ago, but the ancient cultivators on the Primordial Star did not know how far back it went.
This was because the Elemental Star was only discovered by people half a million years ago. From then on, it began to rise in the Cultivation System, officially connected with the Upper Realm and began to give birth to Saint Realm powerhouses.
Before that, the strongest beings on the Elemental Star were only at the God Monarch Realm.
God King Realm powerhouses knew about the dangers of the Elemental Forbidden Land but didn’t know how terrifying it truly was.
After all, on the Elemental Star, there were plenty of places where God King Realm powerhouses could perish.
Therefore, in the cognitive layer of the God King Realm powerhouses, the Elemental Forbidden Land was just as dangerous as any other dangerous forbidden land.
However, when the Elemental Star began to give birth to saints, Saint Kings, and even Half-step Great Saints, no one who entered there ever returned, which made the cultivators of the Elemental Star realize that they had severely underestimated the danger.
Knowing its true level of danger, the descendants called it the Elemental Forbidden Land — a forbidden area on the Elemental Star where even Saint Kings or Half-step Great Saints would surely die if they entered.
As a result, no one knew what secrets lay hidden in the Elemental Forbidden Land, not the Tao Palace, nor the other forces on the Elemental Star.
Perhaps only those at the supreme level might know some of the secrets hidden there.
After all, at that level, they should be able to navigate the various dangers within the forbidden land without fear.
Wang Ping even suspected that the supreme being who had been hiding on the Elemental Star and refining his Time-Space Body origin during previous simulations was an outsider searching for the Elemental Star’s secrets.
Otherwise, if he was a native, people wouldn’t have been unable to recognize his identity.
“The bigger the waves, the more valuable the fish! Not only do I want the rewards from the Nine Stars Pavilion, but I also want to seize any great opportunities that may exist in the Elemental Forbidden Land. System, fast-forward please.”
Wang Ping thought to himself, then said it aloud.
“Ding, fast-forwarding…”
The system’s voice rang out, and the luminescent screen appeared once again, with words floating in the air.
[After you made the choice, you and Lin Qinghe entered the Elemental Forbidden Land together. During the process, you also asked Lin Qinghe’s second soul, the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, if she knew anything about the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[In response, the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body shook her head, claiming that she had never been to a remote place like the Elemental Star and naturally wouldn’t know any of its secrets. Moreover, her memory was incomplete, and she had forgotten many things.]
[Although you felt some regret upon hearing this, you didn’t dwell on it too much. Soon enough, you both entered the peripheral area. It had to be said that the Elemental Forbidden Land was an extremely bizarre place, with strange energies permeating the air that could cause confusion and even lead one astray.]
[In addition, from time to time, strange creatures would appear, ignoring the divine power on you and Lin Qinghe, and attack you both. This would be impossible in the outside world.]
[After all, the dignity of a saint must not be challenged. Monster beasts at the God Monarch Realm, let alone confronting a saint, would tremble in fear even when encountering a semi-saint, either submitting or fleeing; attacking semi-saints and saints would be impossible.]
[After studying these creatures, you found them quite peculiar. Their power did not come from the Cultivation System of humans or monster beasts but from pure strength. However, despite their formidable power, they lacked intelligence and had only a primal instinct to hunt.]
[This was also a very bizarre phenomenon. After all, even monster beasts with only innate realm cultivation in the lower world would have intelligence comparable to ordinary people, let alone those who reached the level of the God Monarch Realm.]
[Soon, you were about to cross the peripheral area and enter the inner area. However, even before entering the inner area, you felt a terrifying energy rippling in the air that was several times more horrifying than the bizarre energies outside. Even a semi-saint would have to be concerned.]

chapters.title: Chapter 663: 197: The mystery of the forbidden area! Cultivation soars again!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Chapter 197: The mystery of the forbidden area! Cultivation soars again!_2
[This is just the junction between the outer area and the inner area. One can only imagine what dangers one might face if we go deeper in, causing your face to grow more solemn by the minute.]
[At this point, you think it might not be appropriate to let Lin Qinghe continue with you. Even though Lin Qinghe may rely on the power of the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body and express a saint level combat power with her semi-saint cultivation, it may not be safe.]
[However, when you suggest Lin Qinghe leave, she refuses. She thinks it’s too dangerous for you to go in alone. She wants to stay close to you, her mentor. Where you go, she will follow.]
[Seeing that Lin Qinghe cannot be persuaded, you sigh and can only take her along into the inner area. The moment you entered the inner area, your expression changed.]
[Because you feel a profound sense of danger, a chill rising from the soles of your feet and shooting straight to the crown of your head.]
[Instinctively, you want to take Lin Qinghe back to the outer area. However, something alarming happens. You thought you were heading towards the outer area, but you couldn’t make it back.]
[The space here is completely distorted, without any logical order. Moving forward could result in moving backward or to the right. In this bizarre place, even if you have mastered the Space Law through the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, you cannot figure out your direction.]
[At the same time, it’s impossible to perform Spatial Movement here, and even Divine Soul is suppressed.]
[This situation makes you feel heavy-hearted. You finally understand why saints, Saint Kings and even Great Saints who entered the Elemental Forbidden Land couldn’t return. In such a strange environment, the odds of going in and coming out are slim.]
[Besides, you also understand one thing clearly – if you try to break out with force, it’s a mission impossible. After all, even Great Saints have met their end here, let alone a saint like you.]
[You highly suspect that if you tried to make a forceful breakout, you will attract some unclean entities. By then, you will definitely lose your life.]
[Under these circumstances, you can only bring out the Supreme Artifact, the Black Abyss Demon Spear, and always be ready to defend yourself.]
[After discussing tactics with Lin Qinghe, you decide to press on and try to find the Elemental Sacred Stone first. Now you finally understand why those who needed this Elemental Sacred Stone put out the quest and offered such generous rewards instead of taking the risk themselves.]
[In this blasted place, you used to think that a Great Saint entering would die. Now, you suspect that even a half-step Supreme or a Supreme might not come out alive if they entered.]
[However, now that you have entered, there is no turning back, so you might as well try to get the Elemental Sacred Stone first. Although you don’t know what the Elemental Sacred Stone does, its value must be extremely high. If you can acquire it and earn the generous rewards, it will not be a wasted effort.]
[Of course, if you can figure out some information about the Elemental Forbidden Land, that would be even better.]
[Half a day later, you delve in deeper. Along the way, you encounter attacks. These attackers are like evil spirits, without bodies, seemingly formed out of resentment. They target the Divine Soul and their combat power is extremely formidable, none of them are weaker than a semi-saint, and many even reach saint-tier.]
[Facing these evil spirits, even you, a saint-level cultivator, struggle greatly. Fortunately, you have the Supreme Demon Spear – Black Abyss Demon Spear, and thus can easily suppress them.]
[However, the existence of these evil spirits is a blessing in disguise for Lin Qinghe. With her Devouring Immortal Demon Body, she can devour even the essence of these spirits. You cannot help but admire the powerful potency of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[But, you are worried that Lin Qinghe might be affected in some unknown way after devouring these spirits. Lin Qinghe shares this concern. However, she believes in this kind of place, improving her strength is the most important thing. She will worry about side effects later.]
[You agree with her and therefore do not stop Lin Qinghe from devouring these spirits. Soon, Lin Qinghe gains the opportunity to become a saint. However, you do not let her breakthrough, as it would lead to Heavenly Tribulation here.]
[Because to become a saint in here would be insanely dangerous. Besides, you also think that if you ever face a desperate situation, you can let Lin Qinghe Cross Tribulation and use the Heavenly Tribulation to intimidate those terrifying spirits.]
[You continue to go deeper. During this process, even though you have the Black Abyss Demon Spear, you almost lose your life. Because you find this damned place not only has evil spirits but also strange plants that release a terrifying toxin once they entangle you. This toxin is extremely fearsome, even a saint can’t withstand it, and you almost die as a result.]
[Thankfully, before you came in, you had bound a Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator using your Purple Talent·Death Puppet. This allowed you to transfer the toxin away. Otherwise you would have certainly lost a life and entered resurrection state.]
[At that time, without you, Lin Qinghe would certainly have died.]
[In the blink of an eye, a day has passed. During this day, you have faced various battles and strange dangers, leaving you physically and mentally exhausted, as well as severely injured. Despite the strong recovery ability of a semi-saint and a saint like you, the strange creatures in this damned place can suppress regeneration and target your very essence, making your injuries hard to recover.]

chapters.title: Chapter 664: 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Chapter 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_3
[You, with your Purple Talent·Blood Drinking and a relatively stronger cultivation, are still in decent shape. However, Lin Qinghe is in terrible condition, severely injured and close to death.]
[Feeling heavy in your heart, you let out a bitter smile. You didn’t intend to leave this place alive, but now it seems that finding the Elemental Sacred Stone has also become difficult.]
[As you sigh, Lin Qinghe looks at you and asks you to leave her behind, for she has become a burden. You refuse without hesitation, carrying Lin Qinghe on your back, seeking a safe place to heal.]
[During your journey, you vaguely see a huge silhouette roaring at the sky from a distance.]
[This sight shocks both of you. You can’t discern the true identity of this giant shadow, but its terrifying nature is palpable. The figure is definitely not from the Saint Realm.]
[Lin Qinghe’s second soul, the remnants of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, speaks up, saying that this giant shadow is indeed not from the Saint Realm but a Quasi-Emperor.]
[This revelation astonishes you and Lin Qinghe. A Quasi-Emperor appears in the depths of the Elemental Forbidden Land. This place is much more dangerous than you anticipated.]
[As you are both watching in shock, you suddenly see an eerie blood-colored shadow appear before you. You feel a strong sense of mortal danger and without hesitation, you wield your Black Abyss Demon Spear, unleashing a terrifying attack towards the blood-colored shadow.]
[However, this blood-colored figure is extremely cunning. Although you disperse it, it quickly reassembles, releasing a bone-chilling laughter that makes your hair stand on end.]
[This development causes your expression to darken, realizing that this evil spirit is an entity you probably can’t handle. Lin Qinghe sighs and immediately launches herself into the sky in her battered state. She absorbs some divine source, forcefully breaching the Saint Realm barrier, and triggers Heavenly Tribulation.]
[Your face pales in shock and worry. Sensing the power of the Heavenly Tribulation, the blood-colored shadow flees in terror like a mouse facing a cat. Not only does it retreat, but all the filth in a vast area around it, like rats fleeing cats, desperately flee from the vicinity.]
[Lin Qinghe asks you to leave quickly, find a safe place to heal. Clenching your fists, you deeply regret exposing Lin Qinghe to this danger, but you know now is not the time to dwell on it. Biting your teeth, you have no choice but to leave the Heavenly Tribulation’s reach.]
[Ultimately, under your gaze, Lin Qinghe fails to withstand even the first Heavenly Tribulation, her body turning to dust. The Swallowing Immortal Demon Body of this generation falls here.]
[However, you don’t have much time to mourn. You take advantage of the aftermath of the Heavenly Tribulation to deter the evil spirits and search for a relatively safe place. Eventually, you enter a cave and set up a Great Array to hide your aura, intending to heal your wounds.]
…..
“Lin Qinghe, she is really worth cultivating.”
Wang Ping sighs as he watches the simulation content and Lin Qinghe’s actions.
He originally planned to nurture Lin Qinghe in the future.
Now, this plan has only grown more resolute.
Once Lin Qinghe grows, she will be able to do a lot for him.
Apart from that, Lin Yuanyuan’s Golden Finger is optimized once again, as well.
In a sense, if Lin Yuanyuan’s Golden Finger is optimized again, it might be even more domineering than Lin Qinghe’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.
Various thoughts flash through Wang Ping’s mind as he continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[However, to your surprise, inside the cave lies a golden dry bone. It is unmistakably the dry bone left after the Saint Realm withers. After all, the bodies of Saints are incredibly tough. Though flesh may decay due to depletion of Qi and Blood, the bones would remain intact.]
[You sigh, guessing that this is the desperate final resting place of a Saint Realm powerhouse who had entered the Elemental Star and felt that escape was hopeless.]
[While troubled by this discovery, you cannot help but think that you might eventually face the same fate. Though this is just a simulation, it still leaves your heart unsettled.]
[Nonetheless, despite your heavy heart, you never let the opportunity to search the corpse pass by. This time, though, you’re disappointed, finding nothing useful. Evidently, any divine source has been used up by the Saint Realm powerhouse.]
[Even the Sacred Artifact held by the individual has vanished – either destroyed or bereft of its spiritual power.]
[Seeing no gain, you can only calm yourself down and begin healing. Once you recover, you discover a strange phenomenon.]
[It seems that evil spirits have not approached this area. Were they able to, they would have detected it by now with their eerie movements and terrifying perception abilities. The great array wouldn’t be able to stop them.]
[This revelation makes you ponder. At this very moment, you suddenly sense an anomaly deep within the cave, unsettling you.]
[After all, based on your past experiences, if a place is free from other monster beasts, then it must be occupied by an even more terrifying monster beast. This is because it’s their territory, and no other monster dares to trespass.]
[With a serious expression, you decide to venture deeper into the cave. There, in the deepest part of the cave, you witness an astonishing sight.]

chapters.title: Chapter 665: 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Chapter 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_4
[A massive heart was sealed by a mysterious Great Array. However, even with the array and terrifying chains locking it up, the horrifying energy contained within the heart could not be concealed.]
[You even felt a power that transcended the laws coming from this heart. This left you utterly shocked, not understanding whose heart this was and why it was sealed here.]
[According to the time calculations, this heart was likely sealed here a million years ago. The meaning that this represents is enough to make one’s scalp tingle.]
[Separated from its original body and sealed for a million years, the heart still showed such a vigorous beating and contained so much terrifying energy. It was too terrifying; you doubted if an Emperor could do such a thing.]
[Next, you discovered one more thing. The altar and stone pillars around the Great Array were made from Elemental Sacred Stones.]
[The powerful people in the Nine Stars Pavilion issued quests to collect Elemental Sacred Stones. It was so luxurious to find a pile of them here.]
[But, you found out something that disappointed you. You couldn’t take any of these Elemental Sacred Stones with you.]
[When you were helpless, you spotted an Elemental Sacred Stone in a corner of this cave. You were very happy and decided to put it into your inner world.]
[After that, you started planning your next move. You were eager to attempt breaking the Great Array to touch the heart. If you could refresh it as a reward, that would be awesome.]
[Since the Elemental Sacred Stone had been obtained, and you couldn’t possibly enter the depths of the Elemental Forbidden Land, it’s better to take a chance and see if you could get the greatest benefits.]
[As soon as you thought about it, you pulled out the Array-breaking Talisman to break open the Great Array with its power.]
[When you activated the Array-breaking Talisman and tried to break the array, you were swallowed up by it. The Great Array directly rebounded the talisman, destroying it, and suppressing you.]
[Because you had the Rebirth tally, you went into the Resurrection Countdown mode. When you revived, you were suppressed once more.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ended…..]
…
The Text Simulation ended here. Many visions appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and in the end, his figure appeared in the cave, looking at the pulsating heart with Tao Patterns.
“Alright, trying to bite off more than I can chew will get me killed. It goes without saying.”
Wang Ping sighed after he came back to his senses.
This terrifying thing is proof of how powerful the being that sealed it was, so it’s simply not something that can be challenged by an Array-breaking Talisman.
It would be incredible if the Array-breaking Talisman could open the Great Array laid by the Supreme in its early years. Attempting to break this one is entirely impossible.
The Rune Master, though a genius, is merely at the level of Saint Realm Powerhouses. There is a vast difference between him and the level of the being who laid this array.
“I don’t know who the owner of this heart is and why it was sealed. Besides, what is the secret in the Elemental Forbidden Land?”
Many thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, making it difficult for him to snap out of it.
He always felt that if he could unravel these secrets, he would gain tremendous opportunities.
“It’s a pity that no matter how great the opportunity, I need the strength to pursue it. Otherwise, attacking the Abyss in the low-level side missions is just feeding others, and no amount of resurrection coins would help.”
Wang Ping shook his head and complained in the bottom of his heart.
Immediately after that, Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, and his vision changed, leaving the immersive simulation and returning to the real world.
At the same time, the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. 1st tier of Saint cultivation.
②. One Elemental Sacred Stone.
③. Saint’s remains.
④. Purple Talent·Blood Drinking.”
…..
“Two rewards?”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, stroking his chin, thinking about it.
As for the Saint Realm cultivation, at his current level, he could achieve it in every simulation.
One could say that this reward was not that rare.
Moreover, once he became a Saint, the resources needed for his simulations would soar.
At that time, he might have to struggle with the issue of resources again.
After all, resources were hard to find in this Last Dharma Age.
As for the other rewards, the Saint’s remains could be ignored since he had no use for them.
It means he could only choose from Purple Talent·Blood Drinking and the Elemental Sacred Stone, either one or both.
“Purple Talent·Blood Drinking showed some performance in this simulation, so I can select it. However, this simulation took so much effort just to get one Elemental Sacred Stone; it would be such a waste not to choose it, making it seem like I’m all about useless effort. Therefore, the Elemental Sacred Stone is a must.”
After analyzing, Wang Ping decided to choose cultivation and the Elemental Sacred Stone.
“No, I can choose to take cultivation in the next simulation, but it may take one day or several months for the next opportunity in the real world, and I may encounter danger. If I want to survive, I need to increase my strength quickly.”
“I’m really afraid of being poor. I always worry about resources, but with enough strength, will I still be afraid of having no resources?”

chapters.title: Chapter 666: 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Chapter 197: Mysterious Forbidden Land! Cultivation Skyrockets Again!_5
“Not to mention, if things don’t work out, I can always ask Alpha for a shortcut.”
However, Wang Ping quickly came to his senses and couldn’t help but hold his head.
“System, I choose ① Saint 1st tier cultivation and ② Elemental Sacred Stone.”
Then Wang Ping made his decision without hesitation.
As Wang Ping made his choice, his cultivation soared, reaching the level of a Saint directly.
His body, Mana, and Divine Soul all underwent qualitative changes, becoming extremely powerful.
Not long after Wang Ping made his choice and increased his cultivation, a sense of danger suddenly emerged, causing Wang Ping’s face to change slightly, and he didn’t hesitate to use spatial transfer.
“Boom!”
After Wang Ping’s defense, a terrifying burst of energy suddenly appeared in White Flame Divine City, completely destroying it.
“Who attacked me? Why haven’t I encountered such a situation in the simulation?”
Wang Ping’s face was solemn as he sensed the surrounding space, trying to find the person who attacked him.
This kind of attack did not occur in the life simulation.
There were only two possibilities.
Either the attacker targeted him specifically, attacking him after he entered the immersive simulation last time for some reason, which would explain why this event didn’t happen in the life simulation.
The second possibility was that this guy came from somewhere beyond the Upper Realm, which is why the Life Simulator couldn’t simulate him.
Of course, there was also the possibility that the attacker suddenly found him and attacked him for some reason beyond the All Heavens.
No matter what the situation, it was a troublesome matter.
After all, this was the first time he had been attacked in the real world.
This meant that he might face danger when entering immersive simulations in the future.
After all, even though he set up the Great Array during the simulation, he didn’t have much protection himself.
This was a drawback of immersive simulations.
Besides, the time gap caused by immersive simulations was greater than the previous Text Simulations, which was also a problem.
“Haha, I didn’t expect that you actually became a Saint. It seems like the secrets you carry are quite significant. I thought those guys were wasting my talents by asking me to kill you, but now it seems they might have underestimated you.”
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, a gloomy voice rang out.
“They…? You mean my seniors?”
Wang Ping’s face was cold as he spoke tentatively.
“Hehe, I guess it doesn’t matter if I tell you; yes, it’s them. Every once in a while, they’d use the Heavenly Secret Talisman to locate your position. But recently, they suddenly couldn’t locate you and guessed that you might have used some means to shield the Heavenly Secrets. So, they decided to spend a lot of resources to hire me at the last minute.”
The gloomy voice sounded very eerie.
Wang Ping still couldn’t pinpoint his exact location.
“This guy is really strong. He doesn’t seem to be an ordinary Saint, has a high cultivation, and is skilled in assassination Divine Skills. In addition, he might also have tools obtained from other worlds.”
As Wang Ping listened to the other party’s words, this thought flashed through his mind.
At the same time, he became more vigilant.
The other party’s methods were a bit troublesome.
Besides that, the content of the other party’s words also made his mood even heavier.
It was clear that the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield had indeed taken effect.
But what Wang Ping didn’t expect was that the other party would be so extravagant as to use the Heavenly Secret Talisman to locate him periodically.
After the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield took effect and the other party couldn’t locate him, they became even more wary of him, and even decided to spend resources to hire a Saint from the Myriad Heavens Forces to assassinate him on impulse.
Moreover, they almost succeeded in taking one of his lives.
This was the first time Wang Ping faced an attack in the real world after a long time of using the Life Simulator to crazily level up.
All he could say was that he was too careless.
After obtaining the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Shield, he shouldn’t have continued staying at his old location, White Flame Divine City. He should have changed locations and laid low.
“Why are you telling me this? Isn’t protecting your client’s information the creed of you killers? Or do you think I’m a goner?”
Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various thoughts, his voice cold as he remained on guard against the other party’s attacks.
“Hehe, protecting the client’s information is the job of proper assassins; what does it have to do with me? To be honest, I only care about money.”
The cold voice rang out again.
“If you can give me more divine source, I can choose to give up assassinating you. Moreover, I can give you more information and even help you kill them instead.”
“You really have no professional integrity at all.”
Wang Ping sneered.
Did he look like someone who would be so stupid as to give up more divine source?
If he really handed over the divine source, the other party would definitely take action against him without a second thought, kill him, and take the remaining divine source.
Then they could collect their reward, enjoying the best of both worlds.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying's New Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Chapter 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger
“Since you won’t offer a higher price, I have no choice but to kill you,” a cold voice echoed again.
Then, the fluctuation of space emerged, and a black shadow abruptly appeared behind Wang Ping. The chilly blade cut through the space, aiming straight at Wang Ping’s head.
This strike, seemingly harmless, was swift, precise, and ruthless.
Even other Saints would have difficulty reacting in time and would likely be beheaded instantly.
“I’ve been waiting for you to make a move!”
Wang Ping’s face was cold. Flames engulfed him, interweaving with the laws of thunder, the mana of fire, and the Space Law. His Divine Skills were unleashed without hesitation, blasting behind him.
The enemy’s stealth was indeed strong, but in the end, Wang Ping possessed an incomplete version of the space-time Dao Body and had mastered Space Law.
If the enemy hadn’t made a move, Wang Ping might have had difficulty finding him.
But as long as they did, Wang Ping could immediately determine their location and counter it.
In an instant, a terrifying clash erupted. Space ripped apart on a large scale, and a black shadow was blasted out of space, looking rather disheveled.
“You’ve actually mastered three laws, and even practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture!?” the Black Shadow’s voice sounded, extremely hoarse, carrying a hint of astonishment.
“Seems like your cultivation is a bit higher than mine, but as an assassin, your ability to face-to-face fight isn’t strong. If that’s the case then just die.”
Wang Ping did not answer the black shadow’s question but instead looked at the black shadow with a cold expression. His hands clapped together, and once again using the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, he deduced a Divine Skill, directly sealing off the space around them.
Then, with Space Divine Skills, Wang Ping moved and appeared behind the black shadow. He wielded his Holy artifact long sword, slashing ruthlessly towards him.
“Dammit!”
Upon seeing this, the black shadow’s face tensed up, he was forced into battle.
Soon, the black shadow was at a disadvantage.
As an assassin, his strongest asset was his stealth and his ability for a fatal blow. But when exposed under the sunlight, his direct combat ability wasn’t strong amongst those of the same tier.
Because of this, although his cultivation was three minor realms higher than Wang Ping, reaching the level of Saint 4th tier, he was still no match for Wang Ping.
However, the gap between Saint tiers is vast and it becomes increasingly difficult to skip tiers. Even with only three minor realms difference, the gap is enormous.
As such, Wang Ping couldn’t easily defeat him without revealing too much about himself.
For this reason, the two of them waged a fierce battle in the sky. The terrifying divine power exploded wantonly, as different forces of manas intertwined and clashed with each other.
A battle between Saints is terrifying. The range it affected was too vast. The scope of the fight between Wang Ping and the black shadow was wide. Even though Wang Ping had sealed off the space, many living beings were still tragically slain by the aftermath.
The most unfortunate force among them was the Whiteflame Divine Sect.
That’s because the Whiteflame Divine City was the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s territory and one of their main sources of revenue. It was therefore close to the headquarters of the God Sect.
They detected it when the Whiteflame Divine Dynasty was destroyed. Now, they felt the collision of two terrifying divine powers.
For a moment, everyone in the Whiteflame Divine Sect was terrified, and the higher-ups hurried to escape.
Even these powerful beings didn’t have time to take care of their disciples and fled, fearing that even the slightest aftermath would descend on the Whiteflame Divine Sect, directly wiping them out.
After all, let alone the aftermath of a battle between saints, even a smidgeon of divine power from a Saint would be enough to kill them outright.
Among these fleeing people was Lin Qinghe’s master.
Although she wanted to pull Lin Qinghe, who was cloistered in the church, out to escape with her, she still abandoned Lin Qinghe.
Although Lin Qinghe was important, her own life was more so.
Compared to the terror of the Whiteflame Divine Sect, some old monsters on Elemental Star were also awakened.
Although they didn’t leave their self-titled divine sources, they could sense this terrifying battle fluctuation.
“After many years, another battle between Saints has erupted? Both of these Saints seem to have complicated backgrounds.”
“One of them must be the Slaughter Saint, following the Slaughter Way. The other is quite surprising. He’s clearly at the 1st tier of Saint cultivation, but he’s mastered three different laws and seems to have practiced the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.”
“Could he be a Saint from the Tao Palace? The Tao Palace, indeed, has a profound foundation to have secretly cultivated such a powerful young Saint.”
Many old monsters were very surprised and discussing intensely.
The two Saint Realm Powerhouses of the Tao Palace were a little surprised.
After all, they didn’t know when the Tao Palace had produced such a strong, young Saint.
If there was one, the palace master of Tao Palace wouldn’t have kept it a secret from them.
They quickly called the Master of Tao Palace to confirm this matter.
Then, the Master of Tao Palace was dumbfounded.
He didn’t know Wang Ping at all, and there was no such person in the Tao Palace.
Hearing this, the two Saints of the Tao Palace were even more confused. If Wang Ping wasn’t a member of the Tao Palace, then why did he practice the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture? Could it be that the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture was leaked?
While the people of Tao Palace were filled with questions, the battle had already reached a critical point.
“Wang Ping, don’t push me! I come from the Slaughter Paradise, if you kill me, brace yourself for the endless pursuit of the Slaughter Paradise’s powerhouses.”

chapters.title: Chapter 668: 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying's New Golden Finger_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Chapter 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger_2
Slaughter Saint was beaten by Wang Ping quite miserably, and after being bombarded by Wang Ping’s critical strike, his divine body shattered and he roared angrily.
Wang Ping’s abilities were too strange.
Not only was his own combat power more potent than Slaughter Saint’s, but he also had a peculiar ability to suddenly double the damage of his attacks.
Plus, Wang Ping was proficient in Space Divine Skills, so Slaughter Saint simply couldn’t dodge his attacks and could only take them head-on.
As a result, Slaughter Saint could only get beaten, and rarely had a chance to counterattack.
Up to now, he had already suffered severe injuries, and continuing to fight would undoubtedly mean his death.
“Hahaha? Slaughter Paradise? We are mortal enemies, with no room for reconciliation. Killing you would mean one less enemy, which is the most important thing for me. Besides, you’re not even worth the revenge of Slaughter Paradise.”
“Even if I were, so what? One day, I’ll completely destroy Slaughter Paradise.”
Wang Ping showed no mercy, once again unleashing a terrifying divine skill, which shattered a part of Slaughter Saint’s divine body that he had just managed to repair, and sneered.
“You, dreaming of overthrowing Slaughter Paradise!? Far too arrogant!”
Slaughter Saint roared in anger.
Though he growled, he also felt a bit desperate.
He never expected that he would just return from Myriad Heavens Paradise, wanting to relax a bit and bully some weaklings by taking on a mission, but instead ended up nearly losing his life.
Thinking of this, Slaughter Saint hated Wind Demon Supreme to the core.
Wasn’t this guy supposed to be just a godly ant at the Divine Realm?
However, not only had Wang Ping cultivated the Emperor Scripture, but he was also a ruthless person who became a Saint in the Last Dharma Age, mastering three laws and possessing an ability to periodically double his attack power.
Being duped by the wrong information, wanting to bully the weak but getting bullied instead, put him in a desperate situation and left him extremely upset.
“Whether it’s arrogant or not, we’ll find out later. As for now, I’ll slaughter you!”
Wang Ping snorted coldly, unleashing another terrifying divine skill.
The intertwining of space, lightning, and fire, the combined forces of the three divine techniques blasted towards Slaughter Saint.
“Damn it!”
Seeing this, Slaughter Saint’s face contorted in rage as he tried to once again unleash a divine skill to clash against Wang Ping before seeking an opportunity to escape.
However, this time, he miscalculated.
Because he was horrified to discover his divine skills were unusable.
“Not good!”
Realizing this strange situation, Slaughter Saint immediately suspected Wang Ping had used some strange ability and attempted to dodge in panic.
Nevertheless, even under normal circumstances, he would have had difficulty avoiding the attack, let alone now.
In an instant, Slaughter Saint was swallowed by Wang Ping’s terrifying strike.
Even worse for him, Wang Ping’s attack had once again triggered an enormous increase in damage.
As a result, Slaughter Saint only had time to let out a miserable scream before his physical body was destroyed, and his Divine Soul vanished into smoke, completely falling.
Thus, a mighty Slaughter Saint died at the hands of Wang Ping.
After killing the Slaughter Saint, Wang Ping instantly swept the items that burst out from him into his storage space, before tearing open space and leaving the area.
When Wang Ping left, those old monsters who were secretly watching the battle finally came to their senses, looking quite astonished.
A Slaughter Saint had actually fallen just like that, genuinely surprising.
However, what they were more concerned about was Wang Ping’s secret skill that doubled the damage of his divine skills.
Apart from that, they also noticed something was amiss. At the end, Slaughter Saint tried to use his divine skills but couldn’t, indicating something unusual had happened.
Of course, there were countless strange secret skills in the world, so they were merely astonished and didn’t harbor any thoughts of targeting Wang Ping.
After all, Wang Ping was a ruthless figure who became a Saint in the Last Dharma Age, so ordinary Saints might not be able to defeat him.
Perhaps, only a true old monster could capture Wang Ping, but if they stepped out, they wouldn’t be able to Self-title again and could only sit and perish in the Last Dharma Age.
This is something they absolutely did not want to see.
No one would want to risk their lives for some secret skills.
…
“Did the Black Abyss Demon Spear actually recognize him as its master? Interesting, it seems that Black Abyss has finally found a successor.”
On the Elemental Star, at a certain location, an all-powerful monster crossed the space and looked towards Wang Ping’s departing position, muttering to himself.
Despite Wang Ping hiding the Black Abyss Demon Spear well, as a Supreme, he naturally could sense the aura of a Supreme Artifact.
Therefore, Wang Ping deliberately concealing the Black Abyss Demon Spear and not using it during this battle didn’t hold much significance.
In addition, there was one thing Wang Ping didn’t know.
Unless it was a shocking treasure that would greatly benefit their own cultivation, a Supreme would disdain to seize a younger generation’s possessions.
If they did so, they would not need to be a part of the World of cultivators, as it would be too disgraceful and unworthy of being called a Supreme.
Although a Supreme Artifact is precious, it isn’t worth a Supreme seizing it without regard for their reputation.
The other reason was that even if they grab another Supreme Artifact, it wouldn’t be of much use.
For weapons like Supreme Artifacts, if they are unwilling to recognize you as their master, even if you can destroy them, you won’t be able to subdue them. Instead, they would choose to self-destruct and leave you empty-handed.”
Afterward, this terrifying powerhouse closed his eyes again, continuing to cultivate a certain secret skill.
…
“The style of the Whiteflame Divine Sect hasn’t changed, still as repulsive as ever.”
When Wang Ping arrived at Whiteflame Divine Sect, he sneered at the sight of the ordinary disciples abandoning it, while the higher-ups had already fled.
Then, after carefully sensing the surroundings, he found Lin Qinghe.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying's New Golden Finger_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Chapter 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger_3
Previously, the location of the battle was too close to the Whiteflame Divine Sect. Although Wang Ping intentionally shifted the battlefield during the fight, he was a bit worried that the Whiteflame Divine Sect would be destroyed by the aftermath.
To be precise, he was worried that Lin Qinghe would be killed by the aftermath of his and Slaughter Saint’s battle.
In that case, a generation of Devouring Immortal Demon Body would die unfairly.
As for Lin Qinghe, Wang Ping still has a favorable impression of her.
After all, in many simulations, Wang Ping took her as his disciple.
Especially during the last simulation, Lin Qinghe’s performance really moved him a little bit.
A girl like this, with not only good character but also gratefulness and a potential to be his strong ally in the future, Wang Ping didn’t want her to be killed by his own battle aftermath and perish like this.
Just as Wang Ping looked towards Lin Qinghe, Lin Qinghe, who had just come out of the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s core area and was preparing to flee, noticed Wang Ping, who had not concealed his aura and gaze, and showed a surprised expression.
She naturally couldn’t tell what realm Wang Ping was in, and she didn’t know that he was the Saint who had caused such a commotion.
The reason she showed a surprised expression was that her second soul, the remnant soul of the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body, told her that Wang Ping was a Saint and very powerful.
“Qinghe, I’ve met Senior Saint.”
At the moment, Lin Qinghe, still very young and like a little girl, blinked her eyes and bowed slightly to Wang Ping.
“Aren’t you afraid of me?”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Qinghe and chuckled lightly.
“Why should Qinghe be afraid of senior? Is senior a bad person?”
Lin Qinghe asked somewhat puzzledly.
“Of course I’m not a bad person.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but laugh.
“Since senior is not a bad person, why should Qinghe be afraid of senior?”
Lin Qinghe blinked her eyes, looking playful and with a bright smile.
“Hehe, you little girl, you’re quite interesting.”
Wang Ping’s figure flashed, and he appeared three meters in front of Lin Qinghe, hands behind his back, and sighed.
“Little girl, are you willing to accept me as your Master?”
After a pause, Wang Ping spoke directly.
Although he had taken Lin Qinghe as his disciple in the simulations and even done so more than once, their relationship in reality was still that of strangers.
Now, the Whiteflame Divine Sect had made such a mess due to this battle, which might affect the simulation.
For this reason, Wang Ping intended to take Lin Qinghe as his disciple directly to prevent any accidents.
“Ah, taking a disciple?”
Lin Qinghe showed a surprised expression, seemingly not reacting to it.
“Yes, I find you quite nice and want to take you as my disciple. After all, as a Devouring Immortal Demon Body, it’s not appropriate for you to stay here.”
Wang Ping gazed at Lin Qinghe and directly revealed her constitution, without any hesitation in thinking.
As Wang Ping’s words were spoken, Lin Qinghe was stunned, looking at Wang Ping in amazement, apparently not expecting Wang Ping to see that she had the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.
As for Lin Qinghe’s second soul, the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body, it was directly awakened and wanted to immediately take Lin Qinghe and run away.
Although, in front of a Saint like Wang Ping, it would be impossible for Lin Qinghe to escape in her current state.
Even if she took over the body, there was no way she could escape.
“Senior, you don’t see the Devouring Immortal Demon Body as an enemy?”
Lin Qinghe asked in amazement.
“Why would I regard it as an enemy? Whether power is evil or not depends on whether the person using it is evil. If you were evil, I would naturally eliminate a threat. But now you obviously aren’t an evil person, just a little cultivator with the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.”
Wang Ping’s hands were behind him, his voice calm.
“…”
Wang Ping’s words struck deep into Lin Qinghe’s heart, leaving her somewhat dazed.
As for the remnant soul of the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body, it was also silent.
If she had met someone like Wang Ping in her previous life, perhaps she wouldn’t have gone down that path.
Of course, she didn’t entirely believe Wang Ping either.
After all, humans were the most skilled at disguising themselves among all races.
“So, are you willing to accept me as your Master?”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Qinghe, chuckled lightly, and extended the invitation again.
“But I already have a Master. My Master has been very kind to me, and I can’t betray my sect.”
Although Lin Qinghe had very positive feelings towards Wang Ping, she still chose to refuse.
As for Wang Ping, he wasn’t surprised by this either.
This had happened in the Life Simulator.
“The Master you speak of hasn’t done you any great favor. She is, in fact, the one responsible for the destruction of your family.”
Wang Ping shook his head and slowly spoke.
“!!!”
Lin Qinghe’s pupils shrank, she looked at Wang Ping in astonishment, not knowing why he said that.
“When you were born, a strange phenomenon occurred, and your Master saw it. So, she called the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s powerful cultivators to exterminate your family, the Lin family, and took you back to the Whiteflame Divine Sect as her disciple.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently, revealing the cruel truth.
“This…this is impossible. My Master couldn’t possibly be that kind of person.”
Lin Qinghe’s face turned pale.
She felt that Wang Ping couldn’t be lying to her, because Wang Ping was a Saint. Would a Saint need to deceive a small cultivator like her?
But if what Wang Ping said was true, then her faith and worldview would completely collapse, making it unbearable for her.
“You’ll know whether it’s true or not in a moment.”
Wang Ping sighed and looked into the distance.
Seeing this, Lin Qinghe also looked over with somewhat vacant eyes.
Then, she saw her Master and the higher-ups of the Whiteflame Divine Sect flying towards them, appearing in the sky above the Whiteflame Divine Sect.
At this moment, she remembered how the Whiteflame Divine Sect’s higher-ups had abandoned their disciples and fled, and it seemed that her Master had also abandoned her and ran away.

chapters.title: Chapter 670: 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying's New Golden Finger_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Chapter 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger_4
Lin Qinghe bit her lip, falling somewhat silent.
“You are…”
At this moment, the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect saw Wang Ping and couldn’t help but be greatly astonished.
Then, he revealed a joyful expression.
During the previous battle, he had naturally watched from afar, recognizing that Wang Ping was one of the Double Saints, and had even killed another saint.
Now, Wang Ping’s appearance at his Whiteflame Divine Sect made his emotions surge and difficult to calm down.
A Saint, this was a Saint! If they could cling to a Saint’s lofty branch, his Whiteflame Divine Sect would rise rapidly, and who would dare to insult them?
While the Ancestor of the Whiteflame Divine Sect was daydreaming, Wang Ping casually grabbed him and conducted soul-searching on him right on the spot.
Next, he directly infused the memories related to the Lin family into Lin Qinghe’s mind.
This made Lin Qinghe’s face pale and she showed an incredulous expression.
Seeing this, the other strong cultivators of the Whiteflame Divine Sect all changed their expressions, wanting to flee.
This Saint, who was too cruel, suddenly took action and captured their Ancestor to search for his soul.
“Humph!”
Seeing this group of people wanting to escape, Wang Ping let out a cold snort.
Although he only simply snorted, it carried divine power, something these True Divine Realm or half-step God Lord Realm cultivators could not resist.
In an instant, all the people except Lin Qinghe’s master exploded and completely fell.
This directly frightened Lin Qinghe’s master, turning her face pale and not daring to move at all.
“Qinghe, save me!”
Lin Qinghe’s master looked at Lin Qinghe and pleaded.
She could see that Wang Ping’s attitude towards Lin Qinghe was clearly unusual.
Now, only if Lin Qinghe pleaded for her, could she survive.
The words of Lin Qinghe’s master made her come back to her senses, and her eyes gradually grew cold, her face full of hatred.
“Senior, Qinghe would like to ask you to help me seal her cultivation.”
Lin Qinghe’s voice was cold, as she requested Wang Ping.
“Alright.” Wang Ping nodded, and casually sealed Lin Qinghe’s master’s cultivation.
Seeing this, Lin Qinghe took a deep breath, took the longsword in her hand, and flew towards her master.
“Qinghe, I am your master, what do you want to do? Are you trying to kill your master?”
Seeing this, Lin Qinghe’s master screamed in terror.
Lin Qinghe didn’t say anything, she just swung her sword, beheading her master.
Because Lin Qinghe’s master’s cultivation was sealed, this sword was enough to be lethal.
“You’re too kind, people like her should be cut into pieces.”
The voice of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body resounded.
Lin Qinghe did not respond, she just looked at Wang Ping, came to his side, took a deep breath, and knelt down to Wang Ping: “Qinghe is willing to accept Senior as her master, and humbly request that Senior accept me as his disciple.”
“Starting from today, you will be my second disciple.”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Qinghe, chuckled lightly, and nodded in satisfaction.
“The second one?”
Lin Qinghe came back to her senses and was somewhat curious about who her senior brother was.
“He’s still in the lower realm, you will probably meet him after a long time.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Lower realm…? Is Master a Flying Immortal from the lower realm?”
Lin Qinghe was surprised.
The remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was also astonished.
After all, being able to ascend from the lower realm and become a Saint in the Last Dharma Age, this talent and luck were simply terrifying.
“Indeed, I am a Flying Immortal from the lower realm.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“By the way, my real name is Wang Ping, and my Daoist name is Heaven Derivative Saint. However, I usually use a fake name when I’m outside. So, you can call me Mo Fan in front of outsiders.”
After hesitating for a moment, Wang Ping spoke again after pondering.
Bai Tianhong’s name had already been exposed.
Since this was the case, it was time to change his name and continue walking in the world.
Mo Fan was an appropriate choice.
“(⊙o⊙)…”
Lin Qinghe’s gaze became subtle.
Was her master so cautious? He didn’t even use his real name when walking in the world.
“Mo Fan, Mo family? Does Master have any relationship with the Mo family?”
Lin Qinghe was somewhat curious again.
“Indeed, I have some connections with the Mo family. However, it’s not a good relationship.”
Wang Ping said with a strange look in his eyes.
Speaking of which, Mo Fan of the Profound Turtle Continent had the same surname as the Mo family.
Well, he could use the Mo family’s name to bluff in the future.
Wrong, it was to attract hatred.
Ah, no, not right, it was to do good deeds.
Yes, that’s the way it should be.
“That’s how it is.”
Seeing Wang Ping say that, Lin Qinghe nodded thoughtfully, and showed no intention of asking further questions.
Next, Wang Ping took Lin Qinghe away from the Whiteflame Divine Sect, found a quiet place, laid down a Great Array, and then began teaching Lin Qinghe in cultivation.
Although with the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, Lin Qinghe actually didn’t need him to teach anything, but Wang Ping still felt that he should fulfill a master’s responsibilities.
So, he taught her the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture and Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture.
As for whether Lin Qinghe would cultivate them and whether she could master them, that depended on her.
Of course, according to the life simulation experience, Lin Qinghe did practice them, but as for her, the divine skills and scriptures taught by the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body were more useful.
Because Lin Qinghe had a Devouring Immortal Demon Body, walking the path of devouring was most suitable for her.
After teaching Lin Qinghe, Wang Ping was ready to continue his life simulation.
“System, how much divine source do I need to do a Paid Simulation now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Chapter 198: Slaughtering the Saint! Zhang Yueying’s New Golden Finger_5
Wang Ping asked the Life Simulator System inside the small closed-off world he created.
“Ding, it has been detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Saint 1st tier level. The consumption required for paid simulation is 50,000 mid-tier divine sources or 500 top-tier divine sources.”
The system’s voice sounded.
This made Wang Ping’s face twitch slightly.
Alright, it’s a tenfold increase again.
After breaking through the Great Realm, the resource consumption became quite terrifying.
“However, I now have about 300,000 mid-tier divine sources, plus 3,000 top-tier divine sources, which is enough for me to simulate twelve times. Twelve chances, I wonder to what extent it can help me improve my level.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought inwardly.
Just as Wang Ping was about to initiate the paid simulation, the chat group system’s voice suddenly sounded, causing Wang Ping to be slightly stunned.
“Ding, detecting that Group-World member Zeng Lingdong (89)’s world has experienced weirdness. Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task has a higher difficulty, and will be led by acting group master Wang Ping (66), who will select four group members for the task. Please make your choice quickly.”
“Another weirdness?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
Moreover, the chat group said that this time the group task had a higher difficulty. It seems that the world Zeng Lingdong was in was not simple.
Otherwise, there was no possibility of mentioning higher difficulty.
After all, ever since he helped other group members and enabled them to become stronger quickly, especially after Lin Yuanyuan had been “carried” by him, many tasks no longer required his participation.
Even if weirdness appeared, the group members could easily handle the normal weirdness or bizarre events, which hadn’t developed yet.
It could be said that Wang Ping was now much more relaxed than before, when he was the only one who could handle major tasks, and he was comfortably lying down to earn points.
Immediately, Wang Ping opened the chat group to ask Zeng Lingdong about some matters.
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Although I was prepared, it finally got me. My world also has weirdness…”
Zhang Hu (5): “Just get used to it, everyone has gone through the same thing. Take me for example, my world has already perished, and now all I hope is to become stronger quickly to see if I can revert everything.”
Zhao Sihan (87): “Don’t worry, my world has also experienced abyssal monsters and weirdness before, but they were easily resolved by Mr.Wang and Sister Yuanyuan.”
Ding Xuan (88): “This time it’s different, after all, the difficulty is higher and Wang Ping is leading the mission, which is not an easy one. Moreover, this time there’s an indication of higher difficulty.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Yes, don’t be careless.”
Wang Ping (66): “Indeed, we can’t be careless. By the way, Zeng Lingdong, what’s going on with your world? You’re the type who lurks in the shadows, rarely participating in tasks and not talking much about your world.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Cough cough, isn’t that what the sign-in system is for? Living leisurely, I never took precautions, so…”
Wang Ping (66): “You’re really showing off your prowess. Don’t tell me you haven’t investigated your world’s specific information.”
Zeng Lingdong (89): “I have collected some information. As for the specifics, I’ll give it to you when you arrive, Mr. Wang. Now, I feel like we should quickly select the participants for the mission.”
Wang Ping (66): “As long as you’ve collected some information. So, who wants to participate in this group task?”
Wu Jun (20): “Me, me, me! Don’t ask, just want to get points.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Mr. Wang, count me in too. I’m now a Saint, so I should be able to help Mr. Wang.”
Fang Yun (3): “No, no, no. Yuanyuan, even if you’re not a Saint, you can still help, right? After all, the number of strange creatures killed by you is not less than that of Mr.Wang.”
