Qin Tian (77): “To be precise, it’s the number of weird creatures slept to death by Yuanyuan. Amusing.jpg”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “……”
Wang Ping (66): “Stop teasing Yuanyuan, or she’ll beat you up in the future. By the way, Wu Jun and Yuanyuan will participate, any other takers.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Um, can I go? I’ve recently changed my golden finger. My new golden finger should be helpful to Mr.Wang.”
Wang Ping (66): “Huh? You changed your golden finger? What ability does your new golden finger have?”
Zhang Yueying (86): “My new golden finger is called Inspire. When used on oneself or others, it can continuously enhance the target’s attack power.”
Wang Ping (66): “Interesting. This should be a good ability.”
Qin Tian (66): “Ah, this kind of ability is really powerful, a strong support ability. It looks like our group is going to have another powerful support member.”
Fang Yun (3): “No, no, no. I feel like our group is becoming Mr.Wang’s exclusive support group. Grey Wolf complaint.jpg”
Chen Kang (67): “That’s fine, if possible, I don’t want to be the output either, going head to head with people, it’s too tiring. It’s more realistic to cling to your leg and play support. By the way, I also want to participate in the task.”
Chen Si (83): “Yeah, big brother is right!”
Wang Ping (66): “In that case, the participants for this task will be me, Wu Jun, Yuanyuan, Chen Kang, and Zhang Yueying. Chen Si and other members who haven’t participated in other tasks, standby first. In case we need you, you will be sent over.”

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Chapter 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty
Chen Si (83): “Hmm, I’m fine.”
Liu Mei (15): “I’m fine too.”
Seeing the group’s response, Wang Ping nodded and then entered the list of task participants for time travel.
In an instant, Wang Ping turned into a ray of white light and disappeared from his retreat at the Elemental Star.
The next second, Wang Ping appeared in a modern-style house.
Lin Yuanyuan, Chen Kang, Wu Jun, Zhang Yueying also appeared here one after another.
“Mr. Wang, Lin Yuanyuan, Chen Kang, Wu Jun, Zhang Yueying, welcome to all of you.”
Zeng Lingdong looked at everyone warmly and said.
“What about the details?”
Wang Ping nodded and asked.
“Here.”
Zeng Lingdong scratched his head a little, then handed out a pile of data to the five of them.
Wang Ping and his friends took the data and started to go through it.
Then, Wang Ping’s expression began to change, becoming somewhat grave.
The world Zeng Lingdong lives in is not simple. It is a cultivation world set in modern times.
However, the rules of this world are quite intriguing.
Okay, to be exact, the earthly rules are intriguing.
In general, the rest of this universe can’t do much harm to Earth, as if an enormous barrier shields the earth.
“No wonder I felt like I was shackled the moment I arrived. So that’s it.”
Wang Ping frowned.
A king realm or even an expert in the Nirvana Boundary could destroy an ordinary star.
Now, as a saint, if he were to wreak havoc recklessly in the absence of any Extraordinary Power, even blowing up the sun would be easy.
However, he felt his cultivation was being suppressed.
“I wonder how strong I can become now, and how much destruction I can cause on earth.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ponder over this question.
Zeng Lingdong, with the support of his check-ins, now has the power of the Life and Death Realm and has tested his strength in the chat group’s Martial Arts Stage.
However, Zeng Lingdong tested his power on earth and could only demolish a huge stone.
It could be said that his destructive power was severely suppressed.
Being a saint, Wang Ping doubted if he could easily shatter stars anymore.
Moreover, Wang Ping was also uncertain if there is any being stronger than him in this world.
After all, he had read some novels in the past.
The theme of these novels was that the rules of earth are unique because some powerful beings restricted it.
The most memorable one for Wang Ping was when Emperor Qin Shi Huang established the Immortal Qin Empire, blocked earth, and waged wars against the beings from outside the domain in the far reaches of the Milky Way. To prevent his homeland from being discovered, Emperor Qin put a series of measures in place.
“What exactly is happening? All will be revealed after the simulation. I wonder what peculiar ability I will acquire this time.”
A thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and he said to Zeng Lingdong and others.
“As usual, I’ll use an ability first.”
“Okay.”
Everyone heard this and nodded in anticipation.
Then, Wang Ping closed his eyes and said in his heart, “System, I want to start the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator starts, free simulation begins…..”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, entering the immersive simulated state.
Following that, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text started to emerge.
[Day 1, you chose to keep a low profile, planning on using the old strategy after a long time.]
[A year goes by in an instant. Nothing out of the ordinary has happened on earth. You guys have investigated all the Superpower organizations and cultivators on earth, and there are none that are too powerful; the strongest is only in the Primordial Infant Stage.]
[But, even though they’re cultivators in the Primordial Infant Stage, because of these special rules, the destruction they can cause is pitiful, almost the same as Zeng Lingdong, only capable of blowing up a boulder.]
[Indeed, by comparison, the strength of the cultivation system in this world is significantly stronger than that in Qin Tian’s world at the same stage. You feel that Qin Tian should come to this world to cultivate.]
[During this year, you have also tested your own strength. As a saint, you are much more powerful than Zeng Lingdong. Casting all your might, you can destroy a modern metropolis.]
[Although this destructive power is somewhat insignificant compared to your real power, it is also quite terrifying in this world.]
[Unfortunately, you still couldn’t find any traces of anomalies. You don’t know where they are or what they’re planning.]
[Just as you were pondering and were considering how to seek out the anomalies, or when they would show themselves, an accident occurred.]
[A figure appeared from the starry sky, found you, recognized that you were from outside the domain and didn’t hesitate to kill you.]
[However, because you had a Rebirth tally, you came back to life, incredibly furious. Yet, the figure was persistent and killed you again.]
[In the end, you still died by his hands and didn’t even know his name or where he came from.]
[As you die, the simulation ends…..]
…
Wang Ping’s text simulation stopped here. Numerous images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and finally, he saw an armored man in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 673: 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Chapter 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_2
“Who the hell is this guy? He’s too strong. I mean, I’m a Saint, and he killed me so easily.”
Wang Ping looked at the person with a shocked expression on his face.
He had previously speculated that the strength system of the world where Zeng Lingdong was should be powerful. Now it seemed that the cultivation system of this world might be even stronger than he had imagined.
Just a random person walking out of the Starry Sky was able to kill him.
Wang Ping was starting to doubt whether the power level of this world was not weaker than the one he was in.
While Wang Ping was lost in thought, his view changed and he returned to the real world.
“Mr. Wang, how did it go?”
As soon as Wang Ping opened his eyes, Zeng Lingdong curiously asked.
“I didn’t even see the weird shadow before I was killed by someone.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“Huh.”
As soon as he said this, everyone looked at each other.
Mr. Wang has the power to kill Saints, and he was killed? That’s too outrageous.
“Mr. Wang, is this world really that strong? You do have the Supreme Artifact…”
Lin Yuanyuan looked incredulous.
“All I can say is, it’s just that strong.”
Wang Ping shook his head helplessly and recounted the simulation content.
Afterward, everyone fell silent, looking at each other.
This broken world was way too outrageous.
No wonder, the chat group marked it as high difficulty. This was indeed very difficult.
“It seems that the situation in our world is very complicated, and the uniqueness of Earth is related to the mysterious strong man and the power behind him. Besides, the reason why he suddenly returned to Earth and took action against you, Mr. Wang, is probably because you tested your strength and alerted him.”
Zeng Lingdong took a deep breath and analyzed.
“It’s very likely. It seems that we can only act low-key this time. We’ll just have to wait. Wait until the strange shadow reveals itself.”
Wang Ping nodded and slowly spoke.
After saying that, Wang Ping closed his eyes once more.
Seeing this, Zeng Lingdong and the others all closed their mouths, aware that Wang Ping was going to use the Golden Finger function again.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The System’s voice rang again, Wang Ping’s consciousness swayed, and he entered an immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[Day one, you chose to wait and see.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year passed, and there was still no change on Earth. However, this time, no strong person suddenly appeared and killed you. This confirmed your guesses that as long as you don’t make too much noise, there will be no powerful people coming to attack you.]
[Next, you continue to wait. In the blink of an eye, another half a year has passed, and nothing unusual has happened on Earth. This left you frowning, wondering where the strange shadow was and what it was plotting.]
[It was during your agonizing wait when the observant Lin Yuanyuan discovered a strange thing. That was a prophecy about the imminent explosion of Earth that had gone viral on the Internet.]
[This prophecy first appeared two years ago and didn’t become popular back then. It was only because some of the prophecies in it had come true that it became popular recently. The Earth explosion prophecy was widely accepted, with many people giving it likes and even more people expressing their anticipation for the day to come. At that time, true equality for all beings would finally be realized.]
[Lin Yuanyuan felt that the popularity of this prophetic short video was a bit illogical. To this, Wu Jun and others didn’t see any problem. After all, playing Earth OL was really difficult, and it’s normal for many people to be pessimistic.]
[As for this, you didn’t notice any problem either. After all, in your life before crossing, you had suffered a lot, and there were various doomsday theories in the previous world. Many people expressed their anticipation for the day to come, in order to achieve true equality for all beings.]
[Besides, Earth was so unique that it was impossible for it to explode suddenly.]
[Seeing that all of you thought it was normal, Lin Yuanyuan put down her doubts and didn’t think any further.]
[In the blink of an eye, the time for the Earth explosion prophecy arrived. Just as the time for the prophecy approached, a great tremor occurred on Earth, and it really exploded.]
[And you were instantly swallowed by the energy of Earth’s explosion and died.]
[Due to the Rebirth tally, you fell into the Resurrection Countdown state. After resurrecting, you looked dumbfounded, not expecting that Earth would really explode.]
[This made you realize one thing: there must be the shadow of the strange figure behind this prophecy. Only the strange figure would have such power. After all, in a world with such a high power level, and Earth being so unique, only the level of the strange figure could destroy it.]
[You couldn’t help guessing that the strange figure’s ability was something like “Prophecy Becomes True”. As long as the prophecy was widely accepted, it would become reality.]
[While you were pondering, a figure appeared in the outer space, glaring at you. You recognized him; he was the one who killed you in the last simulation.]
[This time, without the Earth’s rules suppressing you, your strength was restored, and you fought him. After decisively defeating him, you chose to end the simulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 674: 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Chapter 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_3
[Because of your initiative to end the simulation, this simulation is over…]
…..
As the Text Simulation ended, many images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, finally stopping with him standing in space.
From Wang Ping’s perspective, Earth had turned into a pile of rubble in the starry sky, completely destroyed.
“Such a bizarre ability, as domineering as always.”
Wang Ping sighed, and his vision changed, returning to the real world.
“This time’s harvest is not bad.”
After opening his eyes, Wang Ping smiled and shared the simulation’s content with everyone.
After hearing Wang Ping’s words, everyone’s eyes lit up.
It turned out that to deal with the bizarre, if one had the ability, they could directly push through it; if not, they would have to wait.
The purpose of the bizarre was to destroy all living beings.
As long as no one stopped it, it would erupt, and by then they would naturally know the bizarre’s ability and be able to catch its tail.
Of course, this strategy only applied to Wang Ping.
If it were anyone else, it would be very difficult.
“I’ll simulate another time. This time, I should be able to find him and kill him.”
Wang Ping smiled as he spoke.
Others also revealed smiles.
Then, Wang Ping closed his eyes again and said in his heart, “System, I want to do a free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation starting…..”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered before entering the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar texts emerged.
[Day one, you choose to act. Through the video screen, you easily find the person who initiated the bizarre and want to kill him.]
[However, you are surprised to find that not only does the bizarre have a powerful ability, but it also has an extremely strong strength, making it difficult for you to confront. It is very difficult for you to kill him in a short time.]
[Knowing that continuing to drag it out will be very dangerous, you decided to let Chen Kang use his binding ability and Zhang Yueying use Golden Finger’s Inspire ability.]
[For a moment, your combat power was strengthened, and the bizarre was restrained. Therefore, you seize the opportunity, activate the power of the Supreme Artifact, and unleash the strongest blow, killing the bizarre directly.]
[With the death of the bizarre, you hear the system’s prompt sound. Hence, you choose to return without hesitation, not giving the Mysterious Powerhouse the chance to find and kill you.]
[Due to your return, this simulation is over….]
….
As the Text Simulation stopped here, various images also appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Finally, his vision changed, returning directly to the real world.
“The bizarre is quite powerful.”
Wang Ping exclaimed in surprise.
No wonder the chat group commented that this mission’s difficulty was relatively high.
Why wouldn’t it be?
Not only was the Upper Realm’s level higher, but even the bizarre was so strong that it wasn’t easy for him to take it down even with the Supreme Artifact.
Fortunately, there were Zhang Yueying and Chen Kang, two great assistants.
Otherwise, it would have been really tricky.
Although, in the end, Wang Ping was confident that he could kill it, if it dragged on for too long and attracted the native powerhouses, it would be disastrous.
Of course, in reality, he could use the chat group to escape, but the mission would definitely fail.
“It seems wrong. If I make a commotion with the bizarre and then leave, the Mysterious Powerhouse will definitely kill the bizarre. Then, would the mission be deemed complete? That’s a question.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he muttered.
“Mr. Wang, how was it?”
Seeing Wang Ping muttering, Lin Yuanyuan and the others asked curiously.
In response, Wang Ping came to his senses and smiled as he recounted the simulation content.
“That bizarre’s strength is so strong, and yet it can only slowly plot by using abilities. It’s no wonder that this world is a huge pit for the bizarre.”
Lin Yuanyuan couldn’t help but sigh.
“Isn’t that the truth?”
Wu Jun nodded as well.
“It seems that I’m just going to freeload points again this time.”
Wu Jun’s eyes were somewhat subtle.
“I’ve already gotten used to it.”
“If we can use your abilities, it means the situation has become very bad. I don’t hope for that situation to happen.”
Wang Ping patted Wu Jun on the shoulder and laughed.
“That’s true.”
Wu Jun scratched his head and smiled.
“Next, let’s take action. Zeng Lingdong, Yuanyuan, Wu Jun, you don’t need to take action, you won’t be of much help. Chen Kang, Zhang Yueying, follow me.”
Soon after, Wang Ping issued instructions.
Seeing this, everyone naturally obeyed.
The subsequent operation went smoothly without a doubt.
Wang Ping found the bizarre just like in the simulation.
However, unlike the simulation, Wang Ping let Zhang Yueying use her ability to increase their combat power to the highest level while on the way, and had Chen Kang perform the restraint immediately, immobilizing the bizarre.
Then, he unleashed his most powerful attack, directly killing the bizarre.
It could be said that the bizarre died miserably.
Enhancement, control, ultimate move – all in one set, Wang Ping didn’t even give the bizarre a chance to counterattack.
However, the destruction caused by Wang Ping this time was enormous. Although he had set up a Great Array in advance, it still damaged a lot of places.
But there was no other choice, Wang Ping could only apologize to those affected.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Chapter 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_4
“Ding, the Group Task is completed. All Group members can silently think about returning to their own world in their hearts.”
“I’ll go back first. You guys should return immediately too, or there might be danger.”
Hearing the System’s voice, Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction. After telling Zhang Yueying and Chen Kang, he directly chose to return and disappeared in a flash of white light.
Seeing this, the others didn’t dare to dawdle and swiftly left.
…
Soon, Wang Ping had returned to the Upper Realm.
Then, he skillfully opened the chat group and activated the red packet.
“Ding, congratulations on contributing 80% in this Group Task, earning you 300 million Group points.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“I actually got 300 million. This bizarre creature sure is valuable. But then again, it was a creature with the combat power of a saint tier, so it would be strange if it wasn’t worth anything.”
Upon hearing the amount of group points he had acquired this time, Wang Ping couldn’t help but smack his lips.
For a moment, he felt like gathering trillions of group points wouldn’t be that difficult after all.
As his strength increased, if he just killed more powerful oddities, his group points would shoot up rapidly.
“Speaking of which, with my 80% contribution, I earned 300 million group points. The remaining 20% of the group points will probably be divided between Zhang Yueying and Chen Kang. They really struck it rich this time, and their strength should increase significantly.”
Wang Ping thought of Chen Kang and Zhang Yueying, chuckling softly.
Most of his group points had to be saved to strengthen his Golden Finger.
With that in mind, the more Group Tasks there were, the more likely it was that group members would catch up by using group points for krypton gold.
Of course, it was highly improbable that anyone would genuinely catch up to him, but closing in on his pace wasn’t impossible either.
…
“System, I want to start a Paid Simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and spoke in his heart.
Time waited for no one, and he planned to continue with paid simulations to enhance his strength.
Humans would never be satisfied.
After reaching the Saint tier, Wang Ping wanted to ascend quickly to Saint King, Great Saint, and even Supreme tiers.
After all, only by reaching the Great Saint or Supreme tier could Wang Ping take down that Supreme Senior from the Second Generation Chat Group and remove this huge threat.
“Ding, consuming 50,000 jin of mid-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations, host, for successfully refreshing the Golden Talent: Transmission; Red Talent: Super Cool.”
Golden Talent·Transmission: Using this skill, the host can easily escape danger and teleport randomly to anywhere in the world. PS: Although this ability is very useful and can also carry others, as long as you can react, even Supreme Realm enemies can’t kill you. However, this skill can only be used once a year. Please be mindful, host.
Red Talent·Super Cool: With this talent, the host will become exceptionally aloof but will have an increased cultivation speed.
“Eh, I actually refreshed a Golden Talent again this time? Not bad, not bad.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents, and his eyes brightened a bit.
Refreshing a Golden Talent was a good thing, and this time, the ability of the Golden Talent was evidently excellent. It could be described as an ultra-strong escape talent.
With this talent, even when facing danger, he could calmly escape.
After all, the talent description even stated that it could block even Supremes, which was simply too awesome.
Although there was a cooldown time, as long as he could escape, he could just lie low for a year and wait for the cooldown to end.
“System, I choose Golden Talent·Transmission.”
Wang Ping made his choice without any hesitation.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins…”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered as he entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words emerged.
[Day 1, you chose to cultivate.]
[Next, after finding that you still couldn’t easily gain Enlightenment, you sighed and decided to bring Lin Qinghe with you to increase your cultivation, then head to other planets.]
[In the blink of an eye, hundreds of years passed, and you successfully raised Lin Qinghe’s cultivation to the Semi-saint tier. Then, you took Lin Qinghe to Canglan Ancient Star.]
[You hoped that after arriving at the Canglan Ancient Star, you could find some great opportunities to quickly enhance your strength. If not, you would either have to choose to self-seal or venture to the Central Ancient Star Domain.]

chapters.title: Chapter 676: 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chapter 199 New Golden Talent! Canglan Emperor Dynasty_5
[With a Supreme ruler in place, White Light Palace rose to prominence, seizing territories and competing with the other two major powers.]
[However, now it is the Last Dharma Age, and the Three Great Forces have ruled Canglan Ancient Star, leaving no room for weaker forces to survive. Nonetheless, there are Semi-saints and some God Monarch Realm powerhouses standing in the open. In addition, the number and strength of the self-titled Saint Realm Powerhouses within the forces absolutely surpass those on the Elemental Star.]
[For a moment, you feel overwhelmed. After all, the Three Great Forces have already divided the territories and resources of the Canglan Ancient Star, making it extremely difficult for you to find any opportunities to help you cultivate and break through realms quickly.]
[About this, you can only lament that no matter what world it is, there is always a monopoly phenomenon.]
[Just as you’re thinking of leaving the Canglan Ancient Star and heading directly to the Central Ancient Star Domain, your Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth is triggered once again after a long time.]
[On Canglan Ancient Star, there are unusual happenings in the border mountains of the Three Great Forces, and a World-Shocking Treasure Medicine is about to emerge.]
[Upon detecting this, you and Lin Qinghe quickly head towards the scene, where you find a Divine Medicine emitting a strong fragrance about to mature.]
[You recognize this treasure medicine from your extensive knowledge. It is none other than the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower, which is said to guarantee enlightenment and sainthood once consumed. If a saint consumes it, their cultivation level would increase by at least three minor realms, making it extremely precious. In comparison, the Divine Medicine set out as bait by the Great Saint in the Great Saint Secret Realm is nothing.]
[Your eyes are filled with excitement and curiosity as you wonder why the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower could appear in the Last Dharma Age and is about to mature. Soon, you learn the reason.]
[It turns out that beneath the soil where the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower grows, lies a corpse. It appears to be the remains of a Saint Realm Powerhouse after reaching the end of their lifespan. This Saint Realm Powerhouse’s cultivation should have reached the Saint King Realm. During their meditation to death, although most of their energy and Taoist law returned to the world, some of their flesh and blood essence was absorbed by the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower, allowing it to grow and soon mature during the Last Dharma Age.]
[Without hesitation, you dig out the Saint King’s remains and store them in your inner world. After all, the remains of a Saint King are extremely precious and an excellent material for refining mid-tier Saint Artifacts, top-tier Saint Artifacts, or even improving the quality of a Life-bound Weapon. It can’t be wasted.]
[Next, you plan to wait for the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower to mature, then pick it and take it away.]
[However, during your wait with Lin Qinghe, the powerhouses from the Canglan Dynasty, White Light Palace, and the Demon race sensed the unusual events and rushed here.]
[Although there are no Saint Realm Powerhouses among them, they should not be underestimated. You watch them without intending to make a move directly, as the Three Great Forces hold the advantage here.]
[If you were to make a move against the three local snakes before the treasure medicine matures, even if you suppress them, you might attract some old monsters from within the Three Great Forces. By then, even if you and Lin Qinghe, who has Saint tier strength with the help of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body’s remnant soul, you might not escape unscathed.]
[Although you possess the Golden Talent: Transmission, if possible, you do not want to kill the people of the Three Great Forces and make mortal enemies.]
[As you ponder various matters, the powerhouses of the Three Great Forces are all staring at you. After all, on Canglan Ancient Star, although there are loose cultivators, their cultivation levels generally do not amount to much. However, they can’t see through your cultivation level.]
[Having a cultivation level that even Semi-Saints can’t see through is undoubtedly surprising. It implies that you either have a world-shocking Secret Skill that conceals your cultivation, or your cultivation has exceeded Semi-saint, reaching the Saint tier.]
[If it’s the latter, it’s not good news for the Three Great Forces. Nevertheless, they are not afraid of you.]
[After all, the Three Great Forces have a deep foundation. Especially the Canglan Dynasty, which has produced a Great Emperor. Although the Canglan Dynasty has declined since the death of the Canglan Great Emperor, it is still a camel that is larger than a horse even when it is thin.]
[The Canglan Dynasty hasn’t experienced accidents like Dao Palace, which caused the loss of its foundation. Although the Canglan Dynasty has experienced various events in these years, they still possess a number of Supreme Artifacts and even Quasi-Emperor Artifacts in their treasury.]
[Because of this, even if you’re a saint, they are confident that they can suppress you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 677: 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Chapter 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!
“As the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower matured, you seized it immediately. However, forces from the Canglan Dynasty, White Light Palace, and a strong member of the demon race were clearly on guard against you. The moment you took action, they simultaneously deployed their Supreme Artifacts in an attempt to suppress you.]
“After all, no one wanted to miss the opportunity to ascend. Naturally, it was safest to get rid of you first, who had the highest cultivation. In the face of the half-saint powerhouses of the Three Great Forces attacking you with their Supreme Artifacts, you were unsurprised and calmly summoned your Supreme Artifact: The Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
“With your saintly cultivation and the power of the Black Abyss Demon Spear, even if the three forces combined had three Supreme Artifacts, they were no match for you, and you sent them flying.]
“Then, you took the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower directly, and left with Lin Qinghe. This rendered the Canglan Dynasty, White Light Palace, and the demon race’s strong expert, shocked and furious. They hadn’t expected you to possess a Supreme Artifact.]
“Soon, the Three Great Forces took action and started searching everywhere for you. If they found your whereabouts, they would summon a Saint Ancestor with a limited lifespan to hunt and kill you. After all, for major powers, exchanging an old Saint Ancestor for a newly promoted saint would undoubtedly be a worthwhile deal.]
“Faced with the hunt of the Three Great Forces, you remained calm. After all, you were a saint, with Heavenly Secret Concealment and various secret skills to hide your aura. Unless you were particularly unlucky, it would be rare for anyone to detect your whereabouts.]
“As for Lin Qinghe, carrying the residual soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, it would be difficult for others to find her as well.]
“Next, you found a secluded place to retreat and began to ingest the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower. It took you a year to successfully refine the Sacred Flower, your cultivation soared by three minor realms, reaching the 4th tier of the Saint level.]
“At the same time, due to the auxiliary effects of enlightening Dao and some manas in the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower, you successfully understood 20% of the Space Law, the law of thunder, and the Mana of Fire, which greatly increased your strength.]
“Afterward, you chose to leave seclusion, intending to leave the Canglan Ancient Star. However, you found that the Ancient Star had already been sealed by the Three Great Forces. As soon as you stepped into the starry sky, you would be sensed. Then, endless killing would welcome you.]
“Faced with such unreasonable behavior from the Three Great Forces, you were somewhat annoyed and decided to fight to slam and to cultivate Lin Qinghe in the process.]
“In the end, you retaliated, successfully destroying an ancient town of the Canglan Dynasty, seizing the treasures within. This caused the Canglan Dynasty to burst into rage, directly summoning a Saint Ancestor holding a Supreme Artifact to kill you.]
“Soon, you fought against each other. The Saint Ancestor of the Canglan Dynasty was very powerful, reaching the 6th tier of Saint cultivation and understanding 20% of the Power of Manas. However, unfortunately for him, you were no longer in the 1st tier of Saint cultivation, but had reached the 4th tier, with 20% comprehension level of three types of Mana. It was not difficult to deal with a Saint of the Canglan Dynasty who had limited life span.]
“In the end, you easily suppressed and killed him, taking his corpse with you. This battle shocked the entire Canglan Ancient Star. After the White Light Palace and the Demon race learned the news, they chose to give up targeting you. After all, their joint closure of the ancient star with the Canglan Dynasty was only for the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower.]
“Now, you have shown astonishing power and your cultivation has reached the 4th tier of the Saint Level. It is clear that you have swallowed the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower. Since the sacred flower is gone, they naturally did not want to provoke a powerful Saint with such astonishing potential like you.]
“And the Canglan Dynasty, having lost a Saint at your hands, was naturally furious, and they held a grudge against you. To this end, they wanted to find you, bring out stronger Ancestors, hold Supreme Artifacts and slaughter you. If possible, they even wanted to suppress you with a Quasi-Emperor’s Artifact.]
“Facing the fury of the Canglan Dynasty, you were still not too concerned, once again finding a place for Lin Qinghe to swallow the Canglan Dynasty Saint’s origin, to see if she could break through to the Saint level.]
“Lin Qinghe swallowed the origin of the Canglan Dynasty’s Saint, successfully breaking through the barrier, and was about to cross the Tribulation. You chose to leave the Canglan Ancient Star with Lin Qinghe and go to the external domain for her to endure the Tribulation.]
“After all, the Saint Calamity was too massive. Even if you set up a Great Array, you could not hide it, it would certainly be detected. Therefore, crossing the Tribulation in the starry sky is undoubtedly much safer.]
“However, when you were on your way to the starry sky, the Canglan Dynasty detected your traces, directly summoning an Ancestor of the Saint 9th tier, holding a Quasi-Emperor Artifact, and coming to suppress you.]
“Seeing this, you knew you could not delay and let Lin Qinghe cross the Tribulation immediately. Thereupon, terrifying Heavenly Tribulation appeared, horrifying the Canglan Dynasty’s Saint Ancestor. He recognized Lin Qinghe’s physique while she was crossing the Tribulation.]
“Upon this, he was greatly shocked and fearful deep down. A Swallowing Immortal Demon Body had appeared again. Not only was the Saint Ancestor of the Canglan Dynasty fearful, but all those on the Canglan Ancient Star who could sense the situation here were also terrified.]
“After all, the massacre caused by the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was too terrifying. Back then, even the Canglan Ancient Star could not escape the disaster. A Supreme had died at the hands of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 678: 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Chapter 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush! _2
[As a result, some self-titled powerhouses on the Canglan Ancient Star couldn’t sit still, feeling the urge to come out and suppress Lin Qinghe. The Devouring Immortal Demon Body was too dangerous, and they absolutely couldn’t allow her to grow.]
[However, although they were impulsive, they still intended to wait until Lin Qinghe had crossed her tribulation. They would see if the Ancestors of the Canglan Dynasty could kill her and then make their plans.]
[After all, once they came out, they wouldn’t be able to seal themselves again. They would have to sit and die during the Last Dharma Age, which was something they were unwilling to see.]
[In addition to this, they felt that it would be easy for a Saint 9th tier powerhouse with a Quasi-Emperor Artifact to kill both you and Lin Qinghe, and that it might not require their intervention.]
[When various parties were considering taking action, Lin Qinghe successfully crossed the tribulation and broke through to the Saint tier. At the same time, the Ancestor of the Canglan Dynasty didn’t hesitate to take action, holding the Quasi-Emperor Artifact and launching a terrifying strike against Lin Qinghe.]
[You wouldn’t be able to block this attack. However, you were well-prepared, and when the attack was about to arrive, you came to Lin Qinghe’s side and directly used Golden Talent: Transmission.]
[In an instant, even the power of the Quasi-Emperor Artifact couldn’t stop you from transferring away. As a result, you successfully escaped from there.]
[Your sudden disappearance left many self-titled experts on Canglan Ancient Star in shock, including Great Saints and Supremes, who were moved by your unexpected abilities.]
[While the various powerhouses were astonished, a cultivator also sighed and regretted not catching Lin Qinghe earlier. If they had captured Lin Qinghe, they could have used the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to obtain a great opportunity.]
….
“This Canglan Ancient Star is more difficult to get by than I thought.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly while looking at the contents of the text simulation.
On Canglan Ancient Star, there was no room for loose cultivators to survive.
In addition, there were too many experts, self-titled Saints, and casually appearing with Quasi-Emperor artifacts, which were difficult to deal with.
At present, there were too many powerhouses on the Canglan Ancient Star, and there weren’t many opportunities he could grasp, so Wang Ping was somewhat disappointed.
“However, that cultivator highlighted in the last column of the text simulation seems to be quite extraordinary. And from his tone, it seems that the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body can obtain a great opportunity. An opportunity that even a powerhouse who has the confidence to capture me and Lin Qinghe easily calls a great opportunity must be astonishing.”
“It seems that after my strength is sufficient, I will have to make a trip to Canglan Ancient Star. However, the most suitable place for me now is the kind of Ancient Star where no Supreme Realm Masters have been born but have abundant resources. Unfortunately, such undiscovered Ancient Stars are rare and difficult to find.”
Wang Ping sighed and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, more text emerged.
[After you had teleported, you discovered that you had arrived on a peculiar ancient star. To your surprise, this ancient star had clear Heavenly rules, and its spiritual energy, divine source, and other resources were extremely abundant, unlike what the Last Dharma Age should be like.]
[Afterward, you inquired about the information of this ancient star and learned its name. This ancient star was called the Eternal Ancient Star, and it was a bizarre ancient star. It had a flourishing cultivation system and plenty of cultivation resources, and its heavenly rules were very complete, but there were no Saint Realm Powerhouses. Even Semi-saints did not exist.]
[On this ancient star, Saint Realm Powerhouses seemed to be a forbidden existence, which left you puzzled. After inquiring and collecting information, you finally understood why Saint Realm Powerhouses were considered taboo on this strange ancient star.]
[Because on the Eternal Ancient Star, several cultivators experienced terrifying extinction events. And before the terrifying extinction events happened, there would always be someone achieving Saint Realm.]
[As a result, some people speculated that the mysterious cultivator extinction events were caused by someone achieving Saint Realm on the Eternal Ancient Star. The act of becoming a Saint was the trigger for the extinction.]
[Therefore, on the Eternal Ancient Star, no one was allowed to achieve the Saint Realm. Even if someone reached the Semi-saint tier, the cultivators on the Eternal Ancient Star would unite to kill them to prevent the entire world of cultivators on the Eternal Ancient Star from facing extinction. According to ancient records, this was not without precedent.]
[As a result, on the Eternal Ancient Star, a Heaven’s Gifted Genius even researched the Slaughter Saint Secret Skill. It could combine the power of numerous Divine Realm Experts and use the power of heaven and earth to gain the power to slaughter Saints.]
[Furthermore, they had a secret method to monitor the entire ancient star. Once a Semi-Saint Tribulation appeared, they could easily find it and eliminate it, even if a great array was used to hide it.]
[You found the situation on the Eternal Ancient Star very surprising and interesting. Cultivating on the Eternal Ancient Star should be twice the result with half the effort, but achieving the Saint Realm would lead to the extinction of the world of cultivators. You suspect this might be the plot of some old monster.]
[Of course, it is also possible that there are some extraordinary rules on a few ancient stars in heaven and earth. However, this possibility is relatively small.]

chapters.title: Chapter 679: 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chapter 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_3
[However, even though you knew there might be danger on this ancient star, you had no intention of leaving. After all, in this Last Dharma Age, finding such an environment was not easy, and once you left, you would once again fall into the difficulty of improving your cultivation.]
[Additionally, you arrived here through the Golden Talent: Transmission, and you don’t know if you will be able to come here again next time.]
[Therefore, even if you believed that becoming a saint would lead to the extinction of the World of Cultivators, you had no plan to leave. Of course, you intended to let Lin Qinghe leave.]
[After all, Lin Qinghe possessed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and had no need to take risks here. Besides, there were no evil Saint Realm powerhouses on this ancient star for her to devour the origins, so staying here didn’t make much sense.]
[Lin Qinghe listened to your words and chose to leave the Eternal Ancient Star, but she hoped that you would follow her. In response, you chose to refuse.]
[In the end, Lin Qinghe left on her own, while you stayed on the Eternal Ancient Star to cultivate and gather its numerous resources.]
[You discovered that the resources on the Eternal Ancient Star were even more abundant than you had imagined, including a large amount of top-tier Divine Origin. However, these top-tier Divine Origins were not popular and were instead extremely despised, with seals set up around the divine origin mine.]
[[Because top-tier Divine Origin can help people break through to the semi-saint realm and also provide some help in breaking through to the saint realm, this undoubtedly touched the nerves of the cultivators on the Eternal Ancient Star. As a result, they set up extra monitoring to prevent abuse.]
[Apart from that, there were also quite a few Divine Medicines on the Eternal Ancient Star. These Divine Medicines were even less popular. Although using them well could help Divine Realm experts slowly refine and quickly improve their cultivation, they also carried the risk of someone becoming a saint.]
[For this reason, the major powers on the Eternal Ancient Star also monitored the Divine Medicines and either put them under surveillance or placed them in their treasuries after harvesting them to prevent anyone from obtaining these Divine Medicines.]
[After learning about these situations, you were truly speechless. The Divine Medicines, which were rare to be seen on other ancient stars, were found everywhere on the Eternal Ancient Star, but the cultivators here despised them and treated them like poison. If the cultivators from other ancient stars saw this, they would probably be shocked, envious, and resentful.]
[After some thought, you took action and quietly obtained the Divine Medicines from the treasuries of some major powers using your Space Divine Skills. Although these powers strictly monitored the Divine Medicines, you, being a saint who was proficient in the Dao of Space, were unmatched by the cultivators on this ancient star.]>
[As a result, obtaining these Divine Medicines and divine sources was not difficult for you. Soon enough, you acquired many Divine Medicines.]
[However, you still underestimated this world’s means of detecting the power of the saint realm. During your course of action, you inevitably exposed your saintly aura, causing the major powers of this world to reveal their fearful expressions.]
[They began to hold conferences, mobilize strong men and search for you. While they were searching for you, you chose to close yourself off and began to try to consume these Divine Medicines to improve your cultivation.]
[As for the fact that continuously improving your cultivation in such a short period of time would cause the foundation of your saint realm to be somewhat shaky, you didn’t want to think about that right now. After all, improving your cultivation was the most important thing. If your foundation was unstable, you could always compensate it with Group points.]
[Besides, spending time consolidating your gains was also an option. For you, time really wasn’t very valuable.]
[Soon, you went into seclusion for ten years. During this time, you refined several Divine Medicines and successfully raised your cultivation from the Saint Realm 4th tier to the Saint Realm 6th tier level. According to your estimation, if you refined all the Divine Medicines in your hands, you would have the chance to break through to the 7th-Tier of the Saint Realm, which is the Saint Realm late-stage.]
[In addition, thanks to the suitable environment for Enlightenment on this ancient star and the help of the Divine Medicines, your Time-Space Body finally achieved its due effect, successfully comprehending 30% of the Space Law, 30% of the law of thunder and 30% of the Mana of Fire. Apart from that, you also comprehended 10% of Time Law.]
[Unfortunately, your Time-Space Origin was incomplete, especially the Temporal Origin, which was more severely damaged. As a result, the Path of Time’s cultivation couldn’t compare to the Space Law. However, time is supreme, and the power of 10% Time Law was far beyond that of an ordinary 10% law.]
[[With the Saint 6th tier cultivation, and the addition of the four laws, you were confident that you could defeat a Saint 9th tier powerhouse. Even fighting a Saint Great Perfection might not be impossible.]
[Of course, your true fighting strength could only be verified through actual combat.]
[Just as you were full of confidence, you suddenly felt an anomaly in your body, as your power was being absorbed by the ground beneath you. Not just you, but all the cultivators on this ancient star were also having their power absorbed, seemingly turning into nourishment for the ancient star.]
[Upon witnessing this, you were greatly alarmed and tried to summon the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear to stop the power from draining and escape the Eternal Ancient Star through transmission. However, when you tried to act, your power drained even faster, and your body turned into a pool of blood.]

chapters.title: Chapter 680: 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Chapter 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_4
“[You have died. However, thanks to the Rebirth Tally, you have come back to life. However, your Transmission cannot be activated, and you have died again.]
…..
The Text Simulation stopped at this point. Numerous images and insights filled Wang Ping’s mind, his figure eventually appearing on the Eternal Ancient Star.
“What’s going on with this planet? Why is it so bizarre?”
Observing the simulation of himself turning into bloody water, as well as sensing the many cultivators who had experienced the same fate, Wang Ping felt his scalp tingle as a chill washed over him.
Is this star truly an ancient star?
Could it possibly be similar to the Profound Turtle Continent and not be an actual ancient star, but rather the body of some terrifying monster beast or creature?
That might explain the abundance of laws and resources here.
As for why there is mass extinction once a Saint Realm Cultivator appears, could it be possible that it awakens the creature who became annoyed by the cultivators crawling all over its body and swallowed them all as snacks?
“I’ve always had a wild imagination, and often accurately so. This might be the case. Regardless, this Eternal Ancient Star harbors an astonishing secret.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
It seems all the ancient stars Wang Ping had come across till now held some big secrets.
There were mysterious forbidden lands on the Elemental Ancient Star.
The Purgatory Ancient Star had the strange phenomenon of fiery upheaval. Its terrifying white flame made the Mana of Fire on the star go berserk, even melting the Supreme Artifact, the Black Abyss Demon Spear.
Although the Canglan Ancient Star seemed ordinary, without any notable forbidden lands or major secrets, it was totally under the control of the Three Great Forces, with numerous strong cultivators, and there was information related to the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.
Finally, there was this even more peculiar Eternal Ancient Star.
The Upper Realm is such a chaotic place. Not only are there entrenched Myriad Heavens Forces, but there’s also a myriad of local monsters scheming and planning. Any carelessness may result in becoming a pawn in someone else’s game, leading to death.
“The lower realm is much better in comparison. Although it’s also difficult, it isn’t filled with danger everywhere.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but grumble.
At that moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision shifted to the real world.
Soon after, the system’s voice timely rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. You can choose two from the following rewards:
①. Saint Realm 4th tier cultivation level.
②. Saint Realm 6th tier cultivation level (slightly unstable foundation).
③. Golden Talent: Transmission.
④. A Random Saint Artifact.”
“System, I choose ②. Saint Realm 6th tier cultivation level and ③. Golden Talent: Transmission.”
After seeing the list of rewards, Wang Ping made his decision without hesitation.
Choosing the Saint Realm 4th tier cultivation level instead of the Saint Realm 6th tier would be foolish.
The issue of an unstable foundation could be resolved by investing time to consolidate.
After further cultivation, getting another cultivation reward could easily make up for the deficiency of the foundation.
As for the Golden Talent: Transmission, considering its performance in the current simulation, it was impossible not to select it.
Following Wang Ping’s choice, his cultivation level began to steadily ascend.
Saint Realm 2nd tier.
Saint Realm 3rd tier.
Saint Realm 4th tier.
Saint Realm 5th tier.
Until… it stopped at the peak of the Saint Realm 6th tier.
Additionally, a method for using the Golden Talent: Transmission appeared in his mind.
“At my current level, I should be able to confront that Half-step Great Saint from the Zhang Family on the Elemental Ancient Star, right?”
Feeling the vast energy within himself, Wang Ping was very confident.
With his cultivation at the Saint Realm 6th tier, together with the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, he should be able to fight against the Half-step Great Saint from Zhang family.
After all, as powerful as Zhang Family’s Half-step Great Saint may be, he is not a true Great Saint. His strength is well below that of a true Great Saint and cannot suppress the Supreme Artifact.
Now that Wang Ping has advanced further in cultivation and wielded the Supreme Artifact, he can utilize most of its power, making it highly possible to fight against the Half-step Great Saint and he might even suppress him.
“As long as that Supreme One leaves, I should be able to walk freely on the Elemental Ancient Star. Of course, this is assuming I don’t enter the Elemental Forbidden Land; otherwise, I’d still ‘game over’.”
This idea flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
“However, considering that I’ve already exposed myself on the Elemental Ancient Star, I shouldn’t stay too long. Otherwise, if someone is after me, it could be extremely dangerous.”
Wang Ping shook his head, discarding the idea of domineeringly touring the Elemental Ancient Star.
In fact, he should also find some time to leave the real world.
“System, how much resources would I need now to run a Paid Simulation?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked this in his mind.
Given the increase in his cultivation level, the cost of running a Paid Simulation would definitely change. All Wang Ping hoped for was a slight increment.
“Ding, it is detected that host’s cultivation level reaches the Saint Realm 6th tier. The resources required for a Paid Simulation are either one hundred thousand jin of mid-tier Divine Source or one thousand jin of top-tier Divine Source.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“A mere double, that’s acceptable.”
After hearing the price, Wang Ping sighed in relief.
“System, I want to run a Paid Simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping voiced out his decision.
“Ding, consuming one hundred thousand jin of mid-tier Divine Source. Life Simulator initiated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Golden Talent: Multiplay; Red Talent: Song Dance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 681: 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Chapter 200: The Mysterious Ancient Star! Continual Gold Rush!_5
Golden Talent: Multiplay – When the host performs an attack, using this talent, the attack can instantly be divided into multiple identical attacks, attacking simultaneously and making it difficult to defend against.
ps: This talent can also trigger critical strikes and can activate up to nine-fold attacks.
Red Talent: Song and Dance: …
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was stunned by the introduction of this Golden Talent.
This Golden Talent was pretty ruthless.
Directly triggering multiple attacks, up to nine-fold activation.
If he activated nine identical attacks, and triggered the critical strike effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, the damage would be terrifying, just thinking about it could make one’s scalp tingle.
Besides, if he added a Divine Skill Neutralization, the opponent might be instantly killed by him.
After all, even before possessing this Golden Talent, Wang Ping had been using this fighting style to kill his enemies.
Now that he had the Golden Talent: Multiplay, Wang Ping felt he might be able to kill a Great Saint even if he fought above his rank.
Of course, Wang Ping was just thinking about it.
To launch such an attack, he would need extremely good luck, trigger a critical strike, and trigger sixfold ensemble or above attacks to kill a Great Saint.
Besides, the Great Saints were not targets, just standing there to be hit.
Although Wang Ping’s attack power might be able to reach the level of killing a Great Saint, he was still much weaker in other aspects compared to a Great Saint, and there was no comparison at all.
It could only be said that Wang Ping’s specialties were now somewhat imbalanced.
“But, a Great Saint facing an attack from a Saint, even if that Saint is holding a Supreme Artifact that can threaten a Half-step Great Saint, they wouldn’t usually take it too seriously, right? Perhaps they would choose to harden up to show off. At that time, directly activating the Multiplay, along with triggering a critical strike, would be quite a spectacle, hehe…”}
Thinking of that scenario, Wang Ping couldn’t help but show a smile at the corner of his mouth.
“Speaking of which, this continuous appearance of gold…feels familiar. I have a feeling that I’m about to become extremely unlucky again.”
Immediately afterwards, Wang Ping came back to his senses and muttered.
“Forget it, who cares? Let’s enjoy this first. System, I choose Golden Talent: Multiplay.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins…”
The sound of the system rang out, and Wang Ping’s consciousness wavered, entering the immersive simulation.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you chose cultivation.]
[After that, you thought about it and didn’t immediately plan to leave Elemental Star. This time, you decided to stay on Elemental Star to see if the Wind Demon Supreme had any further actions.]
[At the same time, you also plan to take advantage of the future arrival of the Supreme Descendants on the Elemental Star to go to the Central Ancient Star Domain. After all, there is no shortcut for you to go there by yourself, so you still want to hitch a ride if possible.]
[The flow of time sped up, and in the blink of an eye, about a hundred years passed. During these years, you have been cultivating diligently, consolidating your cultivation and laying a solid foundation.]
[During these years, your reputation on the Elemental Star has spread wider and wider, and the Tao Palace has been looking everywhere for your whereabouts, wishing to invite you to be their guest and ask you some questions.]
[The Great Saint Secret Realm opens, and you choose to leave seclusion, entering it with Lin Qinghe. You successfully seize the Divine Medicine within, and also help Lin Qinghe improve his cultivation a lot.]
[As for the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint, you still chose to suppress it and refine its Divine Soul into a pure soul essence for Lin Qinghe to swallow.]
[After the journey to the Great Saint Secret Realm, you continued to seclude yourself. You began to refine the Divine Medicine. Although the quality of this Divine Medicine was average, your cultivation was not far from the Saint Realm 7th tier, so you still managed to break through to the late-stage of Saint Realm with its help.]
[After reaching the Saint Realm 7th tier, you spent another hundred years consolidating your foundation before choosing to come out of seclusion.]
[After you came out of seclusion, you were unexpectedly found by the Master of Tao Palace, who invited you to visit the Tao Palace.]
[For this reason, you decided to go. The palace master asked you some questions about the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and you said it was acquired by accident. Hearing this, the palace master sighed and hoped that you would not spread the news.]
[Upon hearing this, you naturally agreed. Then, you stated that since you have cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, you also have a connection with the Tao Palace and once again proposed the idea of joining the Tao Palace and becoming a Guest Elder of the Tao Palace.]
[Now that you are powerful and possess the Golden Talent: Transmission, even if a Supreme takes action, you won’t die. Thus, you no longer fear anything.]
[Upon hearing your words, the Master of Tao Palace hesitated. Your origins were unknown, and he didn’t know if he could trust you. However, it would be a pity to refuse such a powerful Saint who wanted to join the Palace.]
[Just as the Master of Tao Palace hesitated, the voice of the self-titled Saint Ancestor of the Tao Palace rang out, telling the Master of Tao Palace to agree.]
[Seeing this, the Master of Tao Palace agreed to your request to join the Palace. Thus, you became a Guest Elder of the Tao Palace, and after a long time, you once again stayed at Tao Palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 682: 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! The Heavenly Calculator
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Chapter 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! The Heavenly Calculator
“Has he entered the Tao Palace? I wonder if there is a chance to control the Emperor’s artifact.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the simulation and could not help but smile.
If he could control the Emperor’s artifact, this simulation would allow him to go anywhere in the vast world.
“However, the possibility is quite small. The Tao Palace doesn’t fully trust me; it’s just that my strength is strong enough to help the Tao Palace grow better, so they let me join them and become a Guest Elder of the Tao Palace.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, fully aware of the Tao Palace’s intentions.
Now, his reputation was well-known, and the outer world was guessing that he belonged to the Tao Palace.
If the Tao Palace seized this opportunity, they could naturally develop greatly. If genius emerged and grew during this period, there would be hope for the Tao Palace.
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he continued to stare intently at the luminescent screen.
[In the following time, you diligently cultivate, and in the blink of an eye, hundreds of years have passed. Your cultivation has not improved, but your foundation has become increasingly stable.]
[You also remember that there was the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower about to mature on Canglan Ancient Star, so you chose to go there alone.]
[When you arrived at Canglan Ancient Star, you prepared in advance by surrounding the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower with the Great Array, preventing the phenomenon of its imminent maturity from leaking out.]
[A few years later, the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower matured without revealing its aura, and you easily picked it. However, you had no intention of refining it on the spot. Instead, you moved to a safer place, set up the Great Array, and carefully refined it.]
[In the end, you successfully refined the Tri-Profound Sacred Flower, and your cultivation improved once again, reaching the Saint 9th tier. At this, you could only sigh that since you had consumed Tri-Profound Sacred Flower in the past, its efficacy had weakened. Otherwise, you feel that you could have reached the Saint Great Perfection tier.]
[After the cultivation improvement, you chose to return to the Elemental Star and continue to consolidate your cultivation and stabilize your foundation in the Tao Palace.]
[In the blink of an eye, another thousand years had passed, and your foundation had long been solid. At the same time, you learned that a powerful individual from outside the Elemental Star was about to arrive with an Emperor’s artifact and extinguish the Tao Palace.]
[In response, you solemnly informed the Master of Tao Palace in advance, hoping that he could evacuate some people in time to prevent the destruction of the Tao Palace’s inheritance.]
[The Master of Tao Palace was somewhat uncertain but eventually chose to believe your words and decided to relocate the disciples and a portion of the inheritance.]
[Years later, the terrifying strong arrived with the Emperor’s artifact, wanting to annihilate the Tao Palace. The Grand Elder of Tao Palace emerged and fought the enemy with the Emperor’s artifact. At this time, because of your Saint 9th tier cultivation, you could see that the self-titled Grand Elder of Tao Palace had reached the Half-step Great Saint tier.]
[And the powerful individual who came with the Emperor’s artifact had a cultivation level of Half-step Great Saint. However, the two of them fought using the Emperor’s artifact, relying on the artifact’s power to show a strength so powerful that even a Supreme would have to back off three steps.]
[Next, you asked the Master of the Tao Palace to teach you the Secret Skill of controlling the Emperor’s artifact, thinking you could assist in the battle. Upon considering it, the Master hesitated and decided to refuse.]
[Upon witnessing this, you sighed in resignation, without any further disappointment. At this moment, the Supreme on the Elemental Star took action and captured the Master of Tao Palace.]
[Seeing this, you knew that the situation was hopeless. However, you didn’t give up, intending to use one life to gain trust and see if you could win the recognition of the Emperor’s artifact.]
[For this reason, you chose to actively attack the terrifying Supreme. You directly sacrificed the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, using it to unleash the most powerful strike.]
[For your attack, the Primordial Thunder Supreme was full of disdain, thinking that you were an insignificant insect trying to shake a giant tree, overestimating your abilities. Thus, he didn’t plan to defend and continued to soul-search the palace master.]
[In his opinion, not to mention an ant-like Saint 9th tier like you, even a Saint King couldn’t harm him one bit. Even if he didn’t defend at all, it would be the same. The physical body of a Supreme was extremely strong, not something a Saint or a Saint King could shake.]
[But what Primordial Thunder Supreme didn’t expect happened. This time, you were extremely lucky to trigger the Nine-fold Symphony and also triggered a critical strike effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade.]
[Plus, your current cultivation had reached the Saint 9th tier; thus, you were stronger than before the simulation. As a result, this strike of yours was powerful enough to kill an ordinary Great Saint.]
[With your strike, Primordial Thunder Supreme was directly wounded and his defenses were broken. Although this injury was negligible to him and could be healed in the next instant, he was astonished, not expecting you to have such a means. It was truly unbelievable that a mere ant-like Saint 9th tier could hurt him.]
[Not only was Primordial Thunder Supreme shocked, but the old monsters secretly watching on Elemental Star were also dumbfounded and disbelieving. A Saint injuring a Supreme seemed too unbelievable; even with a Supreme Artifact, it shouldn’t be possible.]
[Consequently, Primordial Thunder Supreme became very interested in your secret and wanted to soul-search you to obtain it. But you, prepared in advance, self-detonated first.]
[With your self-detonation, this time you triggered the multi-performance effect again. However, this time it was the Triple Symphony. Without the addition of the Supreme Artifact, the attack power was not strong enough, so it didn’t hurt Primordial Thunder Supreme.]

chapters.title: Chapter 683: 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! Heavenly Calculation's Child_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Chapter 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! Heavenly Calculation’s Child_2
[Seeing your decisive self-destruction, Primordial Thunder Supreme frowned, but didn’t say much. He casually killed the Master of Tao Palace, sealed up the Black Abyss Demon Spear and took it away, and after destroying Tao Palace, he joined the Emperor’s artifact battlefield.]
[In the end, Tao Palace’s Grand Elder died miserably, and the Emperor Force of Tao Tian was also exiled and sealed. The situation didn’t change too much. Perhaps, the only change was that Tao Palace’s legacy wasn’t completely destroyed.]
[An hour later, you were resurrected with a sigh and chose to leave.]
[In the blink of an eye, years have passed, and Ye Chen still ascended to the Upper Realm, offending the Supreme Descendant, but was saved by the Old Lady of the Ring.]
[As for you, you chose to befriend the Supreme Descendant and hitch a ride to the Central Ancient Star Domain. Because you lost the Black Abyss Demon Spear, the Supreme Descendant naturally had no intention of being hostile to you, and instead was very enthusiastic about befriending you, because you were a powerful young Saint.]
[In the end, you went to the Central Ancient Star Domain together. It must be said that the means of the Supreme Descendant were much more than yours. He came from the Central Ancient Star Domain, and it was not by flying through the Starry Sky on a Flying Saint Artifact, but by using spatial transfer.]
[In the hands of the Supreme Descendant, there were some Ancient Star’s Starry Sky coordinates, which could be easily transferred with the Delivery Array Plate, thus returning to the Central Ancient Star Domain in a short time.]
[Next, you followed the Supreme Descendant to the Central Ancient Star Domain and arrived at the Gu family where he was from.]
[The core of the Central Ancient Star Domain is not a planet, but a continent, a boundless continent floating in the Starry Sky, surrounded by many ancient stars. Moreover, the boundless continent is also called the Immortal Continent, which is rumored to have secrets to becoming immortal.]
[As a result, many living beings from the Ten Great Universes, after reaching a certain level of cultivation, choose to come here to seek the opportunity to become immortal.]
[When you arrived at the Immortal Continent, you found that although it was also in the Last Dharma Age, the Spiritual Energy was richer than any other Ancient Star you had seen. You guessed that there must be many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures on the Immortal Continent. Although they definitely can’t compare to the normal era and the golden era, they are definitely many times stronger than other Ancient Stars.]
[However, you didn’t care about that much, and instead followed the Gu family young master to meet the Gu family master. You found that the Gu family master was just a Semi-saint. You were surprised.]
[You originally thought that since the Gu family’s young master, the Supreme Descendant, was a Semi-saint, the Gu family’s master would be at least a Saint. It seems that you were overthinking.]
[However, you soon understood. The Gu family master was not a Supreme Descendant but just someone who was pushed out to manage the family during the Last Dharma Age. Unless they have limited lifespan or have reached their potential, not even a Saint Realm Powerhouse on the Immortal Continent would be willing to venture out in this Last Dharma Age, which is a behavior that completely disdains life.]
[Next, you were invited by the Gu family master and Gu family young master to become the Guest Elder of the Gu family.]
[After hesitating for a while, you ultimately chose to refuse. Seeing this, the Gu family’s young master was disappointed but didn’t make things difficult for you.]
[In the end, you left the Gu family. After you left, the young master’s Dao Guardian Saint asked the Gu family’s young master suspiciously why he didn’t make a move on you. You had a big secret in advancing to the Saint 9th tier during the Last Dharma Age, which could take the Gu family further.]
[In response, the Gu family’s young master shook his head, indicating that someone like you with great luck shouldn’t be provoked. Instead of taking a gamble to see if they can get your secret, it’s better to make friends. Maybe, when you grow up in the future, you can help the Gu family.]
…
“Huh….”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, slightly surprised, and his impression of the Gu family’s young master changed a little.
“We had a conflict due to the Supreme Artifact before, but I didn’t expect him not to be stupid and still be quite rational. That’s right, I was too weak back then and naturally didn’t catch his eye. Now, I have become a Saint, and our previous interactions were good. As long as he’s not stupid, he wouldn’t easily be my enemy.”
Wang Ping chuckled and murmured.
“However, I forgot to ask the Gu family’s young master about Heavenly Calculation’s Child, which was a mistake.”
“Never mind, with the ability of Heavenly Calculation’s Child, he probably didn’t leave any handle for us. The Gu family’s young master most likely doesn’t know his true identity and origin either.”
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping calmed his emotions and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After that, you wandered around the Immortal Continent, trying to find some opportunities. However, your talent for accumulating wealth seemed to have stopped working and never activated again. As a result, you failed to find any opportunities.]
[Because of this, you lost interest in continuing to look for opportunities and started thinking about joining a major power.]
[On the Immortal Continent, there is a complex mix of all major forces, such as Longevity Aristocratic Families, Holy Lands, and Emperor Dynasties. Even forces with living Emperors are as numerous as tens.]
[You should know that these are living Emperors. It’s obvious how formidable the forces on the Immortal Continent are. You guessed that this is still the result of not all the Emperors of the Nine Mini Universes coming over. Otherwise, the situation on the Immortal Continent would be even more complicated.]

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 201: The Golden Age is Coming! Heavenly Calculation Child _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Chapter 201: The Golden Age is Coming! Heavenly Calculation Child _3
[In the end, after deep consideration, you’re too lazy to make a choice. If you’re going to join an Imperial-tier force, you might as well join the strongest of them all. Although no one dares to rank Imperial-tier forces, you can judge for yourself.]
[Among these Imperial forces, the Taiyi Imperial Palace has the most ancient lineage, giving birth to five Emperors in total. Even today, one Emperor still presides over it. This kind of foundation, in your view, is undoubtedly much stronger than other Imperial forces.]
[Therefore, you choose to pay a visit to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Your visit came as a surprise to the people of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Eventually, an Elder of the Taiyi Imperial Palace received you.]
[You find that the Taiyi Imperial Palace is far better than any other force you’ve encountered. This is because all the elders of the Taiyi Imperial Palace are Saint Realm Powerhouses. Moreover, the cultivation of many of them is too profound for you to fathom. Especially the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, brought a sense of unknowable depth.]
[You’re somewhat skeptical that the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace is at least at the level of Great Saint Cultivation, possibly higher.]
[While you know these people are likely Saint Realm Powerhouses with limited lifespan or potential, this still shows just how astonishing the number and quality of strong figures within their force is.]
[Next, you displayed your Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, which somewhat surprised the elder and the palace master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. However, while they were surprised, they weren’t overly shocked.]
[About this, you were quite surprised. After all, in your previous simulations, anyone who saw your Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body would be shocked, even obsessed. Now, while these people were quite surprised, their reactions were far more muted than those you had encountered in your memory.]
[Seeing your surprise, the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace smiled, explaining that the Immortal Continent gathers the majority of the geniuses of the Big Universe. Even in special times, the geniuses and monsters of the Ten Great Universes would gather here.]
[As a result, on the Immortal Continent, there are all sorts of constitutions. Even Saint Bodies appear fairly regularly. Moreover, the talents and added strengths brought by the blood of direct descendants of Emperors, are comparable to innate Sacred Bodies.]
[Unless your Space-Time Dao Body was complete, it could truly surpass the Emperor’s sons and the Saint Bodies. Only monsters who simultaneously possess direct lineage of Emperor’s blood and innate Sacred Bodies, or those with constitutions comparable to the Space-Time Dao Body, can contend with it.]
[Of course, there is another kind of person in this world who possesses various strange methods, with combat powers no inferior to Emperor’s sons and Saint Body Geniuses ]
[Seeing this, you marvel. Lo and behold, this is the Immortal Continent, gathering all of Heaven’s Chosen Monsters. Your incomplete Space-Time Dao Body is no longer surprising.]
[Next, the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace suggested that you should self-seal in the divine source, wait for the golden age to come. Otherwise, you would waste your talent and lifespan.]
[Of course, you naturally agreed. After all, you hadn’t previously self-sealed due to lack of suitable locations and strong forces for protection. Now that you’ve joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace, self-sealing within it will certainly be safe, naturally, you don’t have much to worry about.]
[Soon after, you self-sealed deep within the Taiyi Imperial Palace, waiting for the golden age to come.]
[After your self-sealing, the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace investigated your origins. In the end, he was truly shocked to find out that you came from a lower realm affiliated with the Elemental Star.]
[The Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body made him surprised, which he could take in stride. After all, what the Central Ancient Star Domain and the Immortal Continent had in abundance was monstrous talents. But the fact that you came from the Lower Realm and managed to grow to this extent was truly astonishing.]
[After all, the environment of the Lower Realm is extremely harsh, and your foundations don’t seem to match those of a typical Flying Immortal ascending from there.]
[For this reason, the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace thought that he might have underestimated you. With your talent and the origins you’ve displayed, as long as you don’t perish midway, you have a strong potential to reach the Supreme Realm of Tao Proving in the future and become a powerful Supreme.]
[You should know that it’s one thing to be a Saint Realm, but to attain the Supreme Realm of Tao Proving is not just about having strong talents. Willpower is even more crucial. Otherwise, it’s hard to become a Supreme.]
[Historically, countless geniuses have been stuck at the Half-Step Supreme tier, unable to step into the Supreme tier. Instead, other individuals with above-average talents, with their amazing willpower and some luck, have managed to prove their way to becoming a Supreme.]
[And Supremes, at this level of power in the entire Upper Realm, can rightfully be called big shots, they can hold authority in the vast majority of Ancient Stars and establish powerful forces.]
[Even on the Immortal Continent, all the forces would not neglect Supremes, affording them ample respect.]
…..
“This Central Ancient Star Domain, the Immortal Continent, is really terrifying.”
Wang Ping watched the content of the Text Simulation, licking his lips in awe.
Countless monstrous talents, a plethora of strong beings. Even a few dozen living Emperors, this is utterly absurd.
Add in the Myriad Heavens Forces and it gets even more complicated.
He had been wasting his time back on the Elemental Star and other remote places before.

chapters.title: Chapter 685: 201: The Golden Age is Coming! Heavenly Calculation Child _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Chapter 201: The Golden Age is Coming! Heavenly Calculation Child _4
It didn’t seem quite right either. At that time, it would be difficult for him to go to the Central Ancient Star Domain, so it didn’t seem like a waste of time.
With these thoughts flashing through his mind, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[The flow of time passed in the blink of an eye, almost a hundred thousand years have passed. In these hundred thousand years, history has changed, new powers have risen, and powerful forces have been destroyed. Small-scale Dark Disasters have occurred several times.]
[However, these issues have nothing to do with you now. Because after your self-tittle, you chose to sleep, unaware of the passage of time in the outer world.]
[You don’t know how long it had been, but when you woke up, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was standing in front of you, smiling.
