You noticed that the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace now looked a bit older than he did before your self-sealing sleep, but not by much, giving you a strange feeling as if a dream has spanned eternity.]
[Curious, you asked the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace how long it had been since you sealed yourself. The palace master answered that almost a hundred thousand years had passed.]
[Upon hearing this timeframe, you were greatly surprised. After all, waking up to find that nearly a hundred thousand years had passed was truly astonishing. Although cultivators had a different perception of time than ordinary people, a hundred thousand years was still too long.]
[What surprised you even more was that the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace hadn’t died even after nearly a hundred thousand years, which meant that his cultivation level was more terrifying than you had imagined.]
[Keep in mind, human cultivators are different from monster beasts like Profound Turtles that have long lifespans but cultivate slowly. The lifespan of cultivators in the Void Divine Realm is 20,000 years, True Divine Realm is about 30,000 years, and God Monarch Realm powerhouses have a lifespan of about 40,000 years.]
[The lifespan of Saints is around 60,000 years, while that of a Saint King is around 75,000 years. Even a Great Saint can live for only 90,000 years at most. Consuming Life-extending Saint Elixirs can barely make one live a little over a hundred thousand years.]
[The lifespan of human cultivators is indeed shorter than that of monster beasts. It’s worth noting that the lifespans of most monster beasts aren’t much longer than those of human cultivators. It’s just that the Profound Turtle species is quite special, being able to live for three to four hundred thousand years with Emperor Realm cultivation.]
[Of course, if cultivators choose body possession, their survival time will be much longer than under normal circumstances. However, body possession is risky and will also affect the cultivation limit, an old topic.]
[Because of this, you suspected that the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was a Supreme realm cultivator. Driven by curiosity, you asked him directly if he was a Supreme.]
[In response, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace nodded, confirming that he was indeed a Supreme. Hearing this, you couldn’t help but be amazed; no wonder the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was still alive. It turned out he was a Supreme Realm cultivator.]
[The Supreme Realm represents an even greater transformation than the Divine Realm or the Saint Realm. After all, the Supreme has stepped into the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, which is the preliminary stage of Enlightenment, making them a true powerhouse. As a result, a Supreme’s lifespan is at least over 300,000 years. With such a long lifespan, it is perfectly normal for the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace to still be alive.]
[Next, you asked the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace whether it was the Golden Age now. The palace master nodded, confirming that the Last Dharma Age had passed, and the Golden Age had indeed arrived; Spiritual Energy was revived, and Heavenly Rules were very clear, making it very easy to achieve Enlightenment.]
[As a result, all major forces in the Upper Realm have awakened the geniuses sealed in their divine sources and let them embark on the cultivation path once again, stepping onto the path of proving the Tao.]
[After saying this, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace expressed his high expectations for you, along with the other Ancestors in the palace, hoping that you would be one of the few to reach the Supreme Realm of Tao Proving.]
[Confident in yourself, you feel that you will surely reach the realm of Supreme in the future. In fact, even the Supreme is not your ultimate goal; you want to become the greatest Emperor throughout history.]
[You believe that for you, who possess the Life Simulator, this is not an impossible task.]
[With your arrival, Taiyi Imperial Palace underwent huge changes. Many powerful cultivators and geniuses in the palace who have been self-sealed in divine sources, along with those who still have potential and long lifespans, were all awakened and came out into the world.]
[Not only Taiyi Imperial Palace but also other powers did the same. The Golden Age is not only the heyday of young monsters but also the stage for older powerhouses.]
[With the appearance of these powerhouses, you were also accepted as a disciple by a strong Supreme in Taiyi Imperial Palace. At the same time, you became one of the True Inheritor Disciples of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In Taiyi Imperial Palace, if one wants to become an Emperor’s son, one must either be a descendant of a Great Emperor or pass the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s assessment. This assessment is the Taiyi Sky Road.]
[The Taiyi Sky Road has ten levels, each representing a different challenge. It has little to do with cultivation levels but is closely related to talent and willpower. Only by reaching the 10th Floor can one be qualified to become an Emperor’s son on the Taiyi Sky Road. Very few people can succeed above the tenth level.]
[When you appeared, you chose to challenge Taiyi Sky Road. Your actions caught the attention of other True Inheritor Disciples of Taiyi Imperial Palace who had been unsealed from their divine sources, and they silently observed you, their competitor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 686: 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! Heavenly Calculation's Child_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Chapter 201: The Arrival of the Golden Age! Heavenly Calculation’s Child_5
[You didn’t pay attention to them and chose to step onto the Taiyi Sky Road. Eventually, you struggled to reach the 10th floor. Although it’s still quite far from the highest record of 14 floors in Taiyi Imperial Palace, you have the qualifications to become an Emperor’s son.]
[In the end, your feat of reaching the 10th floor of the Taiyi Sky Road spread throughout the Taiyi Imperial Palace, causing a sensation. Then, you became the 10th Imperial Child of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Subsequently, you started to make a name for yourself on the entire Immortal Continent, attracting attention from many major powers. After all, the children of imperial-tier forces are definitely the peak figures in the younger generation. As long as they don’t fall en route, they are basically capable of proving the Tao to be Supreme, and naturally need more attention.]
[After becoming an Imperial Child, you received rewards, and with their help, you successfully broke through to the Saint Realm Great Perfection Tier.]
[After breaking through to the Saint Realm Great Perfection Tier, you chose to challenge the 9th Imperial Child. Because among the ten imperial children of Taiyi Imperial Palace, only the 9th Imperial Child is in the same Saint Great Perfection Realm as you.]
[In response to your challenge, the 9th Saint Child didn’t refuse and had an astonishing fight with you. In the end, the battle results shocked people. You showed the divine skills from the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and even displayed three peak-level Space Laws, Law of Thunder, and Mana of Fire, defeating the 9th Imperial Child with overwhelming force.]
[Even during the fight, in the name of fairness, you didn’t choose to use talents such as Divine Skill Neutralization. You even voluntarily closed the effects that Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Multi-performance could trigger. This is not only for fairness and to test your true strength, but also to conceal your trump cards.]
[However, your act of defeating the 9th Imperial Child still caused a sensation in Taiyi Imperial Palace. Not only the imperial children but even the powerful elders and the Supreme felt that they seemed to have underestimated your combat power.]
[Soon, you made your name resound on the Immortal Continent once again.]
[Nevertheless, you didn’t become arrogant and complacent, but planned to continue cultivating to become stronger and break through to the Saint King tier as soon as possible. Of course, you also thought of the Demon Lord Inheritance.]
[Although your Black Abyss Demon Spear had been taken away, that doesn’t hinder you from inquiring about the location of the Demon Lord’s inheritance through the intelligence network of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[As long as you find the location, you can find it through future simulations, which has huge benefits for both your present and future simulations.]
[Supreme Inheritance is no simple matter, and even though you have joined Taiyi Imperial Palace, it won’t be overlooked. After all, even as an Imperial Child, many resources and opportunities need to be fought for. The more major powers there are, the less likely they will cultivate the geniuses under their wings into greenhouse flowers.]
[To be successful on the cultivation path, one must strive. Without struggle, it’s difficult to achieve greatness. Such favored individuals, even if they grow up, can’t support the great cause and are meaningless.]
[Soon, you inquired about the whereabouts of the Black Abyss Devil Sovereign Heritage. It must be said that Black Abyss Demon Lord was indeed a heaven-defying genius, setting up the secret realm in an extremely hidden location and laying a very exquisite Great Array. If it hadn’t been for the help of Taiyi Imperial Palace, it would have been difficult to find the location of the inheritance.]
[It can only be said that if many major powers wanted to find the inheritance of a Supreme, they could easily do so. However, it is laborious and unrewarding for these forces to deliberately search for it.]
[After all, the inheritance of many strong individuals has prohibitions. Unless you unlock it yourself, attempting to force a breakthrough will result in self-destruction unless your cultivation and Array Mana surpass the array master.]
[For this reason, these opportunities are often left to the heaven-defying geniuses to find and fight for.]
[This time, you are no exception. Although you found the location of the Black Abyss Demon Lord inheritance, you didn’t have the key, and the Black Abyss Demon Spear had been snatched away, so you couldn’t open the secret realm of inheritance.]
[Because of that, you hated the Primordial Thunder Supreme on the Elemental Star. He had killed you and taken away the Supreme Artifact, and now his whereabouts are unknown.]
[Shortly after, you thought of Heavenly Calculation’s Child. Once again, you used the power of Taiyi Imperial Palace to investigate his situation. Then, you learned about an astonishing fact.]
[Heavenly Calculation’s Child has an extremely mysterious origin. Even the Taiyi Imperial Palace and other forces don’t know his exact background. They only know that his Heavenly Secret Skill is unmatched in the world, and his own cultivation is also very horrifying. In the past, a Great Emperor tried to capture him, but the result was that the Great Emperor failed, and Heavenly Calculation’s Child calmly left.]
[After learning how terrifying Heavenly Calculation’s Child was, you became even more wary of him. However, you didn’t worry too much. Now that you have joined Taiyi Imperial Palace, you can avoid many troubles. And since Heavenly Calculation’s Child hasn’t tried to trouble you in all these years, it’s not necessarily that you two are hostile. Just let it be and maintain a peaceful state of mind.]

chapters.title: Chapter 687: 202: Ye Chen's Trail! Kill the Wind Demon Supreme
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Chapter 202: Ye Chen’s Trail! Kill the Wind Demon Supreme
[Next, you plan to use the power of the Taiyi Imperial Palace to eliminate the potential threat of Wind Demon Supreme. With the information network of Taiyi Imperial Palace, it is quite easy to find Wind Demon Supreme, a predecessor ransmigrator in the Second Generation Chat Group.]
[The Taiyi Imperial Palace did not disappoint you, and soon found the hiding place of Wind Demon Supreme. Wind Demon Supreme was hiding in the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, in the forbidden area of the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star. The Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area is extremely dangerous for Saint Realm Cultivators, and even Quasi Supremes face the risk of falling when venturing deep into it.]
[However, for the Supreme, the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area doesn’t amount to much and is an excellent hiding place.]
[After learning Wind Demon Supreme’s hiding place, you were quite surprised. After all, you knew that your apprentice Ye Chen would be taken to Thunderflame Valley on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star by the Ring Granny. You did not expect Wind Demon Supreme to be hiding there as well.]
[After considering, you went to see your master, wanting to use their power to deal with Wind Demon Supreme. Upon hearing your request, your master did not refuse and chose to agree.]
[If you encounter opponents of your generation or ordinary Saint Realm cultivators, your master would not interfere, as it would help you grow. However, since your enemy is Wind Demon Supreme, things are different.]
[After all, the Supreme are too powerful and not something you can handle. Even the Great Saint Dao Protectorassigned to you by the Taiyi Imperial Palace would not be a match for him and would be casually suppressed. Therefore, if left unchecked, it could threaten your life in the future, and naturally, it is necessary to eradicate him early.]
[Seeing your master readily agreed, you showed a smile, feeling that this was a sure thing. After all, your master, as the Supreme of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, is definitely a standout among their peers, dealing with Wind Demon Supreme, a predecessor ransmigrator, should not be a problem.]
….
“Damn, why don’t you learn to be careful and not jinx things?”
Wang Ping saw the content of the text simulation, his face turned black, and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
Jinxing before would cause trouble…
Wang Ping felt that this operation to eliminate Wind Demon Supreme would not go smoothly.
During Wang Ping’s helplessness, the simulation continued.
[Next, after you made your preparations, you began your mission and quickly arrived at Thunder Spirit Ancient Star. However, after arriving at Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, you did not directly take your master to the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area to eliminate Wind Demon Supreme, a predecessor ransmigrator, but went to Thunderflame Valley first.]
[The reason you came to Thunderflame Valley was to see how well Ye Chen, your apprentice, was doing now. After all, Ye Chen is your apprentice, and you cannot ignore him.]
[Upon arriving at Thunderflame Valley, you were warmly welcomed by the people there. The Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley and even the Ancestor-tier characters were somewhat overwhelmed by the honor.]
[After all, you come from the Immortal Continent and the Taiyi Imperial Palace. The Taiyi Imperial Palace, a terrifying force that has given birth to Five Emperors, is considered extremely powerful even among all the Imperial-tier forces, with few rivals throughout the Upper Realm.]
[Now, the people of the Taiyi Imperial Palace came to Thunderflame Valley, which was absolutely an honor for them. Even the Supreme of Thunderflame Valley had to put aside their pride and treat you, the Emperor’s Son, with enthusiasm, without any pretension of being a predecessor or Supreme powerhouse.]
[You were quite pleased with the attitude of Thunderflame Valley, feeling grateful for the big tree providing shelter and realizing how different it was to have a powerful backer. If you continued to be a loose cultivator, not to mention being treated like this by a Supreme, even a Great Saint would look down on you as an ant, wanting to casually crush you.]
[Next, you inquired about Ye Chen. Hearing your inquiry about Ye Chen, the Supreme seemed surprised and puzzled, while the expression of Thunderflame Valley’s Valley Master became somewhat stiff and unnatural.]
[You noticed the change in the Valley Master’s expression of Thunderflame Valley, and couldn’t help but frown, feeling that something might have happened to Ye Chen. Your expression grew cold as you asked again.]
[Seeing your slightly cold expression, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley couldn’t help but give an awkward smile, without knowing how to answer your question. Seeing this, Thunderflame Supreme frowned and asked the Valley Master to tell the story in detail, without hiding anything.]
[Seeing the situation, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley had no choice but to tell the story of what had happened in the past. It turned out that nearly 100,000 years ago, after Ye Chen was brought back by an ancestor of Thunderflame Valley, they found that his talent was quite ordinary.]
[However, since Ye Chen was the benefactor of that ancestor and also taken as his apprentice, they did not neglect Ye Chen. On the contrary, they made an exception and allowed him to become a True Inheritor Disciple, providing him with many resources for cultivation.]
[Unexpectedly, however, they never thought that Ye Chen would commit such an outrageous act, stealing the taboo skill of Thunderflame Valley.]
[As a result, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley was furious, crippled Ye Chen, and drove him out of Thunderflame Valley.]
[Upon hearing that the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley crippled Ye Chen, your expression instantly turned extremely cold, and anger surged in your heart. Ye Chen stealing the taboo skill of Thunderflame Valley? That was an utterly absurd claim.]
[After all, you had taught Ye Chen everything you knew. He practiced the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture. In addition, you also passed on the cultivation skills you had created yourself to Ye Chen.]

chapters.title: Chapter 688: 202: Ye Chen's Trace! Supreme Wind Killing Demon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Chapter 202: Ye Chen’s Trace! Supreme Wind Killing Demon_2
[You should know that you were not initially taught the Mortal Realm Chapter of the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, but the complete Cultivation Skill of the Scripture. Although Wang Ping never returned to the Lower Realm after obtaining the complete Scripture, Ye Xiaofan and the others were still in the Lower Realm.]
[So it was through Ye Xiaofan that you passed on the Cultivation Skills. Would Ye Chen, who practiced the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, covet the forbidden skills of Thunderflame Valley? That was absolutely impossible. Would Ye Chen, who practiced the Emperor Scripture, cultivate other skills? This is simply laughable.]
[If it were the legendary Immortal Sutra, it would be fine, but Thunderflame Valley is nothing more than Supreme. At most, there is a Supreme Cultivation Skill, and it is impossible for Ye Chen to change his cultivation.]
[Regarding this, you are very suspicious that Thunderflame Valley may have been coveting the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture on Ye Chen’s body and therefore took certain actions. After all, you have been chased by people because of your cultivation skills when you didn’t have a powerful backing.]
[Practicing Tao Tian Emperor Scripture is fine, as people would think you belong to the Tao Palace, but Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture is a Cultivation Skill of the Chi Clan. The Burning Emperor has long been in trouble, and the Chi Clan has disappeared. In the eyes of many people, the Chi Clan has already been exterminated. As a result, many powerhouses have no qualms about attacking those who practice the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture.]
[Seeing your expression becoming colder, the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master is increasingly frightened and can only say that Ye Chen really did steal Cultivation Skills, and he is not lying.]
[The Thunderflame Supreme sighed and asked about the relationship between you and Ye Chen. You coldly stated that Ye Chen is your disciple, your first disciple.]
[Hearing these words, the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master’s heart skipped a beat, and he sensed something was wrong. The Thunderflame Supreme also fell silent, not having expected your relationship to be like this.]
[You are the Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, and Ye Chen is your first disciple. Does this not mean, in a sense, that Ye Chen is also from the Taiyi Imperial Palace? A person from the Taiyi Imperial Palace was crippled here, and the grudge is huge. Now, it is no longer a matter of whether Ye Chen was in the wrong; as a significant person from the Taiyi Imperial Palace was crippled here, they must bear the responsibility.]
[The Thunderflame Supreme could only bitterly smile and admit that their Thunderflame Valley was in the wrong. However, he hoped that you and your master would give him some face, allowing him to investigate the matter thoroughly and find Ye Chen. He will then restore Ye Chen’s cultivation and provide sufficient compensation to give you an explanation.]
[Seeing the Thunderflame Supreme’s attitude, you calmed down a lot. The Thunderflame Supreme seemed to be unaware, which means this was likely done privately by the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master and some important people in the Thunderflame Valley. Therefore, since the Thunderflame Supreme has apologized to you, a junior, with his Supreme dignity, you cannot continue to make things difficult for him.]
[In this regard, you hope that the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master will find the truth soon. At this, the Thunderflame Supreme sighed and nodded. Then, he asked the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master to open up his Sea of Consciousness and allow you to check his memory.]
[Hearing this, you were taken aback. The Thunderflame Supreme is far too decisive. The Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley is the face of their valley. If he has his soul searched, it would undoubtedly be a very humiliating matter.]
[However, when you think of the might of Taiyi Imperial Palace and put yourself in their shoes, you would understand that this move by the Thunderflame Supreme is an act of helplessness. Thunderflame Valley really can’t afford to offend the Taiyi Imperial Palace, nor can they afford to offend you, the Emperor’s son.]
[Otherwise, even if he were a Quasi-Emperor, he would have to die. After all, in the Upper Realm, although the Supreme is powerful and has already entered the ranks of true powerhouses, to the Imperial-tier forces like Taiyi Imperial Palace, they are still somewhat weak.]
[Imperial-tier forces, especially Taiyi Imperial Palace, have existed for a long time and flourished to the present. The number of Supreme and Quasi-Emperors they have is unknown, and their foundation is incredibly terrifying. In addition to that, a Great Emperor is sitting in town. A mere Supreme is nothing in front of them.]
[Even the threat of those hidden terrifying powerhouses of Taiyi Imperial Palace is not enough; facing your master, the Thunderflame Supreme has no confidence in victory. Furthermore, if a fight were to break out, there is a high probability that he would be defeated.]
[Under such circumstances, it is impossible not to submit. No matter how Supreme, they can only give up some dignity when facing a stronger generation.]
[Having thought so much, you sighed in your heart and felt the cruelty of the Upper Realm once again. At the same time, the Supreme seemed somewhat less imposing to you. In the past, you were slapped to death by the Supreme, and you yearned for their power.]
[Now, you feel that the Supreme is nothing in the face of true major powers. If you want real freedom and no restraints, you need only become a Great Emperor. Even then, the Great Emperor may not be truly invincible in the Upper Realm.]
[After all, the Upper Realm has more than a hundred Great Emperors, and this does not even include those Great Emperors hiding and lingering in the Source of Darkness. You feel that to be truly invincible, you must surpass a Great Emperor.]
[Seeing the attitude of the Thunderflame Supreme, the seed of ambition began to truly take root and sprout within your heart.]
[At this moment, the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master showed terror and humiliation on his face, but he dared not disobey the Thunderflame Supreme and opened his Sea of Consciousness with a pale expression.]
[In response, you remained silent and did not choose to soul-search the Thunderflame Valley Valley Master directly, but instead asked the Thunderflame Supreme to do it himself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 689: 202: Ye Chen's Traces! Killing Wind Devil Supreme_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Chapter 202: Ye Chen’s Traces! Killing Wind Devil Supreme_3
[Upon hearing this, Thunderflame Supreme was taken aback, looking somewhat surprised. Then, he revealed a grateful expression towards you. After all, the concept of having his mind read by a stranger and having it read by this Ancestor are entirely different. If he is the one doing the soul-searching, Thunderflame Valley wouldn’t lose face.]
[Seeing your choice, your master was also quite surprised, and then nodded with satisfaction, believing that your conduct was very commendable. Regardless of the real truth, you have won the favor of Thunderflame Supreme.]
[Every Emperor’s son has the qualification to compete for the position of the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace. However, the struggle for the position of Palace Master depends not only on combat power but even more so on strategy. After all, who would dare to act against the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace under normal circumstances? Thus, managerial abilities are more crucial.]
[Let alone that the Palace Masters of Taiyi Imperial Palace are chosen from amongst the Emperors’ sons. Even if that Emperor’s son is not the strongest among the emperors’ sons, he cannot be that weak.]
[And your choice now allows you to draw in a Supreme, in the hopes of making Thunderflame Valley your wings. Undeniably, this will help you vie for the position of Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace in the future.]
[As Thunderflame Supreme started to soul-search Thunderflame Valley Valley Master, his expression instantly darkened. Because the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley did lie, Ye Chen didn’t steal their forbidden skill of Thunderflame Valley. On the contrary, it was the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley who was coveting Ye Chen’s Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and had nefarious intentions towards Ye Chen.]
[Originally, Thunderflame Valley Valley Master intended to entice Ye Chen into giving up the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture and make a contribution to Thunderflame Valley, promising him generous resources and hoping to nurture him into a Saint.]
[However, Ye Chen did not hand over the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture. Therefore, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley became enraged, found an excuse to cripple Ye Chen and intended to steal his skills by soul-searching.]
[Without Ye Chen’s ring having discovered the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley’s plot in time and escaping from Thunderflame Valley with Ye Chen, Ye Chen would have been killed by the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley.]
[In his eagerness to acquire the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, and to keep this a secret, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley personally pursued Ye Chen and his ring to kill them. As the ring’s lineage wasn’t well-accepted in Thunderflame Valley and had been almost wiped out, the Valley Master showed no mercy in his pursuit.]
[Unfortunately, he underestimated the abilities of the ring. Although it was once a Great Saint and had now weakened to the extreme, it still had many tactics, and after burning its soul energy, managed to escape with Ye Chen undetected.]
[Upon seeing Thunderflame Supreme’s grim expression, you immediately deduced that there was something amiss with the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley. Your face turned gloomy, and you couldn’t help but ask Thunderflame Supreme what had happened.]
[After a moment of silence, Thunderflame Supreme told you the truth, which outraged you and caused your enmity towards the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley to reach its peak. Your master also frowned, finding the deeds of the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley indeed too atrocious. The Emperor Scripture is indeed precious enough to tempt those in Thunderflame Valley who cultivate thunder and fire attributes.]
[However, this behavior is truly deplorable, even killing his own disciples and slaughtering the elders in the valley, he was exceedingly ruthless.]
[Thunderflame Supreme’s expression was awful, assuring that he would give you an explanation and suppress all the people in Thunderflame Valley involved in this matter, handing them over to you for judgment. At the same time, he would also find Ye Chen as soon as possible.]
[After calming your emotions, you nodded soberly. After all, Ye Chen was the Son of Fortune, and his fortune seemed to have improved in the Upper Realm. Although he had been living a terrible life, he definitely wouldn’t die easily, instead, he might even obtain great good fortune.]
[With that, as long as he wasn’t confirmed dead, he was highly likely to be still alive. Despite the fact that these events took place nearly a hundred thousand years ago, and later on, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley chose to self-seal and stopped searching for Ye Chen, due to the passage of time, no one knew where Ye Chen was, but you felt that Ye Chen should be alive and well, and his cultivation level may have soared to the Saint tier.]
[After ponderously contemplating over these matters, you handled the people from Thunderflame Valley who were involved in this matter. You showed no mercy and directly suppressed and killed them.]
[In this way, the Valley Master of Thunderflame Valley and some elders fell by your hand. After the matter was settled, Thunderflame Supreme declared that he would assist you if you encounter any troubles in the future.]
“Ye Chen really is a magnet for trouble. Why do I get the feeling that once he got to the Upper Realm, he started to go down the road of the loser?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, his expression was incredibly subtle.
Once Ye Chen got to the Upper Realm, he was thrown into jail by the Purple Cloud Divine Place in Elemental Star.
Then, in Thunderflame Valley, he was crippled and vanished without a trace. It was really pitiful.
On the contrary, as of now he seemed to be back on the path of invincibility. Wang Ping felt that if he were to go all out, no one at the same stage could stand up against him and fighting those above his ability was as easy as eating and drinking.
“There’s nothing bad about being a loser, it might be a little hard, but after hardship comes ease, and in the future, he can still reach the peak. Of course, if I had to choose between invincibility and being a loser, I would definitely choose invincibility. Why suffer for no reason, wouldn’t that be foolish?”
Wang Ping mumbled to himself again.
“However, it really does matter who you know in this world.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping remembered the attitude of Thunderflame Supreme in the text simulation, he sighed to himself, then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.

chapters.title: Chapter 690: 202: Ye Chen's Trail! Kill the Wind Demon Supreme_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Chapter 202: Ye Chen’s Trail! Kill the Wind Demon Supreme_4
[You nodded your head in agreement to Thunderflame Supreme’s promise and decided to enter the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area with your master.]
[However, your master asked you to stay outside before entering the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area. For a Saint like you, the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area is very dangerous, and you could easily fall inside.]
[Although your master is a Supreme, he might not be able to protect you in a fierce battle between Supremes.]
[Seeing this, you didn’t have any intention of showing off and chose to stay outside. Soon, you felt a terrifying aura coming from within the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area.]
[It was a Supreme aura different from your master’s and Thunderflame Supreme’s. Clearly, Wind Demon Supreme, the Predecessor Transmigrator, was revealed and forced to engage in a great battle by your master.]
[You were amazed by the collision of the two Supreme auras. After all, this was the first time you witnessed a battle between Supremes. Although on the Elemental Star you had seen more terrifying power collisions, the clashes between the Emperor’s artifacts were far stronger than those between Supremes. However, this was the first time you saw the collision of Supremes.]
[At the same time, all the cultivators on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star were shocked by the auras generated by the battle between the two Supremes, trembling with awe. After all, on Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, only Thunderflame Valley had a Supreme.]
[A Supreme battle was the first time they had witnessed something like this. Although experiencing a Supreme battle would be beneficial to their cultivation, it could also bring great calamity.]
[After all, Supremes were too powerful. If they didn’t control their force, they could directly obliterate the Ancient Star. Once an Ancient Star was destroyed, the horrific energy it generated could not be survived even by Saints and Saint Kings. Only Great Saints would be able to face it with ease.]
[Even so, as long as the force generated by the battle between Supremes didn’t directly affect them, otherwise, even Great Saints would die.]
[At this moment, Thunderflame Supreme was also watching the supreme battle, lost in thought. He didn’t expect that your visit to the Thunderflame Ancient Star was not only for Ye Chen, but also to deal with Wind Demon Supreme.]
[As the Supreme Ancestor of Thunderflame Valley, Thunderflame Supreme naturally knew that a powerful Supreme had always been hidden in the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area. However, as that Supreme had always kept a low profile, he never thought of provoking the other party and had coexisted peacefully.]
[Now that your master had forced this Supreme out, he recognized the origins of this Supreme. Wind Demon Supreme was once quite famous in the Central Ancient Star Domain.]
[Among different realms, there is a distinction between strengths within the same realm. The Supreme tier realms are divided more clearly compared to the other cultivation layers, classified into Yuan Emperor, Earth Emperor, and Heaven Supreme. Moreover, each realm is divided into early, mid, late and peak stages.]
[Wind Demon Supreme was the most powerful peak of the Heavenly Supreme. This level of cultivation was extremely formidable, and there were few opponents within the Supreme realm. Only an oddity of a Supreme like Black Abyss Demon Lord could easily defeat him.]
[Unfortunately, even Supremes couldn’t escape the five decays of heaven and man. Wind Demon Supreme’s strength had greatly weakened as he neared the end of his life.]
[Hence, even though your master’s cultivation was only at the peak of Earth Emperor, he was able to confront Wind Demon Supreme directly and deplete the latter’s energy to death.]
[In the end, without any accidents happening, the severely weakened Wind Demon Supreme was consumed to death by your master and completely fell. However, your master also suffered serious injuries. A peak Heavenly Supreme remains a formidable opponent, even with his strength diminished by a significant extent.]
[Seeing your master achieve victory and successfully kill Wind Demon Supreme, a senior member of the Second Generation Chat Group, you heaved a sigh of relief.]
[However, you were reminded of something. Chu Xiao had a resurrection item in the past. Although Ruo Lan and Chu Xiao didn’t have one, it was very likely that it was Chu Xiao’s personal opportunity. Wind Demon Supreme, after all, was a Supreme who had been alive for many years, and considering that he had entered Myriad Heavens Paradise, the possibility of having a resurrection item was not small.]
[Though Wind Demon Supreme had once lost everything in Myriad Heavens Paradise, he would undoubtedly have kept at least one such resurrection item. Hence, your complexion changed, and you hurriedly yelled for your master to be careful.]
[However, it was too late, and you were one step slow. Wind Demon Supreme suddenly resurrected, and although his combat power was not at its peak, he still had formidable strength. He launched a sudden attack, sending your master to the brink of death.]
[Then, Wind Demon Supreme relentlessly dealt the finishing blow, killing your master directly. Seeing this, your face changed drastically, and you didn’t hesitate to flee.]
[However, Wind Demon Supreme obviously noticed you, despised you, and didn’t hesitate to chase after you, trying to capture you alive and use you for body possession.]
…
“These guys who entered the Myriad Heavens Paradise are really extraordinary. Some people who mixed up in the Myriad Heavens Paradise before might have got their hands on resurrection items.”
Wang Ping sighed as he read the content of the Text Simulation. It seemed that his premonition had come true, and trouble had indeed arisen for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 691: 202: Ye Chen's Trace! Supreme Wind Killing Demon_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Chapter 202: Ye Chen’s Trace! Supreme Wind Killing Demon_5
Wind Demon Supreme, was even stronger than he had imagined. Although his strength was inferior to Wang Ping’s simulated Supreme Master due to his limited lifespan, he had many hidden cards up his sleeve.
“It seems that this simulation has come to an end. But the information collected this time is more than enough.”
Wang Ping shook his head and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[At this moment, Thunderflame Supreme decided to protect you. Although he is only an Earth Emperor Realm expert, the current state of Wind Demon Supreme is undoubtedly terrible. It is not a problem for him to protect you.]
[Seeing that he couldn’t kill you through conventional means, Wind Demon Supreme resorted to unconventional methods, using a curse-type killing tool. This curse-type killing tool is precious enough even though it can only kill those below the Supreme Realm.]
[However, this tool is one of his few hidden cards for body possession of extraordinary talents in the future. Now he can only use it on you. He also knows that even if he used it, it would be difficult to snatch your body.]
[As Wind Demon Supreme used the curse-killing tool, your soul was directly wiped out by the curse. However, due to the fact that you had preemptively used the Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet to bind a Divine Realm Expert, the curse effect was directly transferred to that unlucky Divine Realm Expert.]
[Since someone took the disaster for you, you escaped once again. Seeing that you were still alive, Wind Demon Supreme was astonished, never expecting that you could be immune to the curse-killing effect.]
[At this point, Wind Demon Supreme had completely run out of ideas, and could only glare at you and Thunderflame Supreme before choosing to leave. His current state was terrible, and he needed to possess another extraordinary monster. Otherwise, he would completely dissipate in the world, which is something he could not tolerate.]
[In addition, he must continue hiding from Taiyi Imperial Palace’s pursuit. Even if he were a Quasi-Emperor, he would face the risk of falling once found.]
[Seeing Wind Demon Supreme escape, you also breathe a sigh of relief. The sudden activation of the Purple Talent·Death Replacement Puppet effect startled you. Apparently, Wind Demon Supreme secretly used another method.]
[For this, you became more serious, wanting to eliminate Wind Demon Supreme as soon as possible. Such a guy is too dangerous, and you cannot be at peace without killing him.]
[Next, you were extra cautious of Wind Demon Supreme’s retaliation and chose to use the Delivery Array to leave Thunderflame Valley and return to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[When you returned to Taiyi Imperial Palace and reported your master’s death at the hands of Wind Demon Supreme, Taiyi Imperial Palace was furious. They deduced the Heavenly Secrets and directly dispatched several Heaven Supremes to hunt down Wind Demon Supreme and have him completely suppressed and killed.]
….
“This old guy certainly has a lot of hidden cards.”
Wang Ping watches the simulation content and curses under his breath.
Damn, these Predecessor ransmigrators are really hard to kill, one after the other.
Especially this Wind Demon Supreme, he has too many hidden cards.
That curse-killing tool is simply disgusting, ruthlessly killing its target. Anyone without Supreme Cultivation will die. This ability can be terrifying.
This is the result of him losing everything in Myriad Heavens Paradise. If he were a Supreme who could continue to participate in Myriad Heavens Paradise, it would be difficult to predict how many hidden cards he would have.
“However, that curse-killing tool should have some usage restrictions. Most likely, it has a distance limitation. Otherwise, Wind Demon Supreme could have directly cursed and killed me without needing Ruo Lan to teleport over.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, calmed down, and thought to himself.
“Of course, it’s possible that he just couldn’t bear to use such a precious tool.”
Wang Ping quickly analyzed in his mind.
After all, in the eyes of the current Wind Demon Supreme, I am just a little shrimp in the Divine Realm. Although my growth rate is fast, having Ruo Lan come to me instead of inviting a Slaughter Saint from the Slaughter Paradise to kill me on Elemental Star already gives me enough credit.
It’s too extravagant to waste a precious tool capable of cursing and killing a Half-step Supreme just for me, a Divine Realm shrimp.
After all, he is now broke, unable to even enter Myriad Heavens Paradise. Such tools are used up one by one.
“However, regardless of the situation, I don’t need to be too afraid of this curse-killing tool in Wind Demon Supreme’s hands. After all, I have many methods of resurrection, and losing one life doesn’t matter much.”
Wang Ping exhaled slowly and calmed down.
Subsequently, Wang Ping also became very interested in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
After all, these tools of Wind Demon Supreme must have been obtained in Myriad Heavens Paradise. Their effects are really powerful, even comparable to Wang Ping’s talents acquired through the Life Simulator.
Especially the effect of this curse-killing tool, it’s even stronger than some Golden Talent effects.

chapters.title: Chapter 692: 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Chapter 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor
Suddenly, Wang Ping gathered his spirit and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[When Taiyi Imperial Palace sent out strong cultivators to hunt down Wind Demon Supreme, you, too, mourned your master and entered closed-door cultivation, preparing to break through to the Half-Step Saint King Realm.]
[Sadly, your breakthrough attempt failed. During the process, you mysteriously encountered a Heart Demon, causing a violent upheaval in the laws and leading to your death.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
…..
The text simulation ended there, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various realizations and memories, making him reveal a shocked expression.
“This death is so random. I was just spending some time, and there was a 90% chance to break through to the Half-Step Saint King tier, but I suddenly encountered a Heart Demon and died.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows, feeling that the development of this situation was very strange.
“Most likely, someone played a trick on me, using some method that I am not aware of.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly and began to feel suspicious.
However, being in Taiyi Imperial Palace who would have the ability to let him enter the devil’s path in the core area of Taiyi Imperial Palace?
“Most likely, it’s a tool or strange power produced by Myriad Heavens Paradise, and it probably has something to do with Wind Demon Supreme.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples.
“This old guy has quite a few tricks up his sleeve.”
“It seems that next time I deal with him, I must ask more powerful people to help, and try to kill him with one blow. Otherwise, if I let him live, he will be a huge disaster.”
Wang Ping shook his head, and his mood gradually calmed down.
At this moment, his consciousness flickered, his vision changed, and he appeared in the real world, with the system’s voice echoing.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two from the following rewards:
①. Saint Realm Great Perfection cultivation.
②. Golden Talent: Multiplay.
③. 10,000 catties of middle-tier divine source.
④. Randomly obtain one Great Sacred Artifact.”
….
“Huh, this time it actually refreshed 10,000 catties of middle-tier divine source? It’s a pity it’s only middle-tier, not top-tier. Otherwise, I would probably choose it.”
Wang Ping shook his head, somewhat surprised and disappointed.
“System, I choose ①. Saint Realm Great Perfection cultivation and ②. Golden Talent: Multiplay.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his choice directly, not even giving the Great Sacred Artifact a second look.
After all, if he has a Supreme Artifact, there is no need to use a Great Sacred Artifact.
“Ding, reward selection successful.”
The system’s voice sounded, and the information of Golden Talent: Multiplay appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
In addition, his cultivation also began to rise continuously.
Saint Realm 7th tier.
Saint 8th-tier.
Saint 9th tier.
Saint Realm Great Perfection.
“Saint Realm Great Perfection cultivation, with such cultivation, few people can compete against me in this Last Dharma Age.”
Wang Ping felt his cultivation and nodded in satisfaction.
“System, how much resources do I need to simulate now?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked in his heart, planning to perform another simulation.
Although he had gotten gold twice in a row, Wang Ping still wanted to try his luck, even if he felt that his luck would worsen.
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Saint Realm Great Perfection tier, the paid simulation requires 200,000 mid-tier divine source or 2,000 catties top-tier divine source.”
The system’s voice rang again.
“Damn…”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but cover his forehead when he heard this amount.
Well, it doubled again.
Now, he can only simulate twice.
This is without counting him choosing cultivation again. If he chooses cultivation, he probably won’t even have a second chance.
“I hope the next simulation can give me some surprises, otherwise, I will have to search for resources with a depressed mood.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said in his heart.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
“Ding, consume 200,000 catties of middle-tier divine source, Life Simulator starts, paid simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger; Purple Talent: Enhanced Counterstrike Armor.”
Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples System: With this talent, as long as the host takes a disciple, they will receive cultivation rewards and some special rewards.
Warm reminder: This talent has strict requirements for disciples’ talent and luck, and will calculate whether they have the qualifications to become the host’s disciple based on their comprehensive quality. Ordinary geniuses, even if accepted as disciples by the host, will not receive rewards.
At the same time, once a disciple is taken in the real world or in any one simulation, they will be recognized as the disciple and not receive rewards again.
Purple Talent: Enhanced Counterstrike Armor – Possessing this talent, the host can counterattack and cause damage to the opponent after being attacked. However, the damage is not significant for Saint Realm cultivators.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents, and his entire person was dumbfounded.
Damn, he actually refreshed a Seven-Colored Talent.
This is the first Seven-Colored Talent, right?
Moreover, isn’t this Seven-Colored Talent a a little too overpowered? Its effect can be called a golden finger, a system-level talent.
After all, Wang Ping had read many novels in his previous life where taking disciples was a way to gain rewards and become stronger.
Then, the leading character would walk on the path of getting stronger by taking disciples and show off their invincibility together with their disciples.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Chapter 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_2
Wang Ping never expected the Seven-Colored Talent to be so strong; it could be considered as an entirely new system.
“If the people in the group knew that my Golden finger refreshed talent could reach at least the level of their optimized Golden finger, and still be considered a very good growing Golden finger… I wonder how they would feel.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, the corner of his mouth slightly raised, thinking that the scene would be quite interesting.
Of course, he wouldn’t show off like that. He was already freakish enough now, continuing to show off would be too much. It was better to stay low-key; otherwise, it wouldn’t be good if the people in the group felt too unbalanced.
“System, I choose the Rainbow Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping composed himself and said in his mind.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping felt a flicker in his consciousness, his vision changed, and he entered the state of immersive simulation.
The luminescent screen appeared, and the text also emerged.
[On the first day, you heard feedback from the Rainbow Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger. Because you accepted Ye Chen as your disciple, your cultivation improved, allowing you to break through to the Half-Step Saint King tier.]
[Then, you received feedback again. When you accepted Lin Qinghe as your disciple, your cultivation was further improved, allowing you to reach the Saint King tier directly.]
….
“My goodness, isn’t this too ruthless? I am at the Saint King tier already. How can others play like this?”
Wang Ping was genuinely surprised while looking at the simulation content.
He thought that his breakthrough into the Saint King tier would have ups and downs.
However, the simulation had only just begun, and he had directly broken through to the Saint King tier, which was unbelievable.
“It takes a thousand days to find a disciple, but only a moment to use them.”
Wang Ping sighed, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After breaking through to the Saint King tier, you were greeted by the Heavenly Tribulation. The terrifying Heavenly Tribulation appeared in the sky above the Elemental Star, drawing attention from many cultivators on the Elemental Star. The self-proclaimed strong ones were also awakened, shocked by your Saint King Tribulation.]
[However, the most surprised was the Primordial Thunder Supreme on the Elemental Star. He didn’t expect that in the Last Dharma Age, there would still be someone who could cross the Saint King Tribulation. When the Primordial Thunder Supreme found out that you were the one crossing the Tribulation, he was surprised once again.]
[He became extremely interested in you. After all, not long ago, you only had a 1st tier Saint cultivation when you fought against the Slaughter Saint. Now, you have improved by a significant realm within a short period, reaching the Saint King tier. This was something even he had never seen before.]
[Because of this, Primordial Thunder Supreme determined that there must have been a big secret on you. If he could get the secret from you, perhaps he could advance even further.]
[While all parties were shocked, your expression stiffened. As you were crossing the Saint King Tribulation on the Elemental Star, you were exposed to the Primordial Thunder Supreme, and the situation was terrible.]
[As a result, you were prepared to flee immediately after completing the Tribulation. As for Lin Qinghe, you told her to run away in advance, leaving the Heavenly Tribulation quickly.]
[Soon, the Heavenly Tribulation got more violent, and you started to cross the Tribulation wholeheartedly. The Saint King Tribulation was truly horrifying. However, you had changed a lot from the past, and you easily endured it, becoming even stronger. At the same time, you used the power of Heavenly Tribulation to transform your Life-bound Weapon into a Holy King Artifact.]
[After the Heavenly Tribulation dissipated, you appeared beside Lin Qinghe in the blink of an eye. Although Primordial Thunder Supreme was a step behind, he didn’t hesitate to attack you. The moment he attacked you, without any hesitation, you used your Golden Talent: Transmission ability, and took Lin Qinghe to escape.]
[With the effect of Golden Talent: Transmission, even a Supreme couldn’t stop your teleportation. As a result, Primordial Thunder Supreme’s attack failed. This made him frown, as he didn’t expect you to have such means to escape from his hands.]
[Because of this, the Primordial Thunder Supreme was even more curious about the secret on your body, so he planned to look for you throughout the Upper Realm and find you out.]
[As for the others on the Elemental Star, they were also amazed as they didn’t expect that you could escape from the hands of a Supreme. As a result of this, you were deeply shocked and became a legend.]
[Meanwhile, after teleporting, you appeared in an unknown starry sky. You found this very troublesome, as you didn’t expect that you wouldn’t teleport to an Ancient Star this time.]
[The starry sky was vast, and Ancient Stars with life were indeed relatively rare. As a result, it’s tough to find a Life Ancient Star in an unknown starry sky without a Star Map and coordinates.]
[Although you had reached the Saint King tier, protecting Lin Qinghe in the starry sky was not a problem, but wandering in the starry sky was not the solution either.]
[Various thoughts flashed through your mind, you took out the Flying Saint Artifact, rode in it, and began locating the nearest Ancient Star using the Star Map in your memory. Unfortunately, you failed.]
[To your surprise, you found that this part of the starry sky did not match any place in your memory. Keep in mind that the Star Map in your mind is the one drawn by the Taiyi Imperial Palace, arguably one of the most comprehensive Star Maps in the Upper Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 694: 203: The First Seven-Colored Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: Chapter 203: The First Seven-Colored Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_3
[Now, I cannot find your current location, it is really strange. While you were deep in thought, Lin Qinghe saw an extremely weird scene and told you fearfully.]
[At this, you couldn’t help but look over. Then, you saw a scene that even now made you feel chilled to the core from within the Flying Saint Artifact.]
[In the pitch-black starry sky, there were white skeletons with ghostly flames in their eyes, lifting a black ancient coffin. These white skeletons were extremely terrifying, and even though you have reached the Saint King tier, you felt an ultimate sense of danger.]
[You strongly suspect that these white skeletons could easily suppress Great Saints. Even a Half-step Supreme might not be their match.]
[Such terrifying existences are actually white bones, undead, it’s hard to imagine how powerful these white skeletons were when they were alive. You suspect that they were at least of the Supreme-tier. However, such powerful beings, were actually floating in the starry sky while carrying a black ancient coffin, which was truly hair-raising.]
[You couldn’t imagine what kind of existence was inside the black ancient coffin if it was a living being and how powerful it could be.]
[Lin Qinghe fearfully asked you if you want to leave immediately. In response, you remained silent. After all, these beings were too strange, and if you left at this moment and made a commotion, attracting their attention, you would likely die without a whole corpse.]
[In the end, you made a decision, to calmly watch the situation and not act rashly.]
[Your choice was undoubtedly correct, as those ghostly-flamed-eyed white skeletons carrying the ancient coffin merely glanced at you before leaving and disappearing into the vast starry sky.]
[At this, your heart was chilled, and a coldness emerged from the core of your heart. Staring into the eyes of such strange beings was truly dangerous. However, you finally heaved a sigh of relief, as they didn’t choose to attack you.]
[If they had attacked, you would have had absolutely no chance of survival. Even though you have reached the Saint King tier and could fully unleash the power of the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, capable of rivaling Great Saints, it wouldn’t have mattered.]
[For those white skeletons, a Great Saint is nothing but a weakling. As for the existence in the ancient coffin, it could probably only be called an ant in their eyes.]
[Lin Qinghe also breathed a sigh of relief, feeling that he had saved his life. Then, you asked Lin Qinghe to awaken the soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, and started to inquire about the identity of these strange existences from the soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]
[The soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body fell silent, pondering for a while before sighing and saying that she didn’t expect you to encounter such terrifying beings. She advised you that it would be better not to ask too much, as some things are safer to not know than to know.]
[Hearing this, you were alarmed and understood that the soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body knew their identity, so you couldn’t help but inquire further. After all, this was a simulation, and collecting information was also an important aspect of the simulation.]
[Seeing your questioning, the soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body told you the identity of these strange beings after remarking on your fearlessness due to ignorance.]
[In the Upper Realm, there are many terrifying forces. The forces that stand at the peak are naturally those with living Emperors, followed by those that have had Emperors, but the Emperor has passed away, and the forces still have Quasi-Emperors.]
[Where there is light, there is also darkness. Dark forces include some Demon Sects, heretical sects, or other strange forces, which are not necessarily weaker than those recognized forces, and some even more powerful.]
[The existence you encountered earlier belongs to the Erebos Demon Sect. The Erebos Demon Sect is a force with an Emperor, and the Ghost Bone Great Emperor is also considered a strong presence among Emperors. The secondary combat capabilities within the Erebos Demon Sect are also stronger than those of ordinary Imperial-tier forces.]
[The Erebos Demon Sect only accepts the strong, and the weakest among them have reached the Supreme level. The existence you encountered inside the ancient coffin was the White Bone Demon Emperor, whose cultivation was at the Quasi-Emperor tier and excelled at refining living beings into powerful white skeletal minions.]
[In addition, he also had a habit of hibernating inside the ancient coffin. As a result, although he had the title of Bone Emperor, he was also called the Coffin Ghost Man.]
[Lastly, the soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body mentioned that the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear in your hand came from the Black Abyss Demon Lord. The Black Abyss Demon Lord was once a member of the Erebos Demon Sect. Perhaps it was because of this reason that they didn’t make things difficult for you.]
[Otherwise, it would have been impossible for you to escape their clutches. After all, the Bone Emperor was not someone easy to deal with and wasn’t as proud as the Black Abyss Demon Lord, not bothering to kill juniors.]
[After learning the whole story, your heart was chilled, as you didn’t expect such a great origin and powerful cultivation, reaching the Quasi-Emperor tier, and even belonging to the same force as the Black Abyss Demon Lord.]
[Next, the soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body said that it was rumored that wherever the Bone Emperor appeared, bloodshed was bound to happen. But there would also be great opportunities or monstrous geniuses emerging. This was because the Bone Emperor’s favorite activity was refining geniuses he took interest in into white skeletal minions.]

chapters.title: Chapter 695: 203: The First Seven-Colored Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Chapter 203: The First Seven-Colored Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_4
[Hearing the words of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, you feel an urge to follow your suicidal impulse, but you eventually choose to give up. The difference in strength is too great, following them would only be giving them your head, which would be too suicidal.]
[However, what you didn’t expect is that although you gave up on following them, the Bone Emperor didn’t give up on you and turned back around to kill you.]
[When you notice that the Bone Emperor, who had already gone far away, has returned and appeared not far from you, your eyelids begin to twitch and a sense of foreboding fills your heart. Even the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body has a slightly changed expression, feeling that things have become troublesome.]
[At this moment, the black coffin opens, and a figure appears before you, emitting an extremely terrifying demonic aura. Although the power is deliberately suppressed, the gap in cultivation is too large. Every move by the Quasi-Emperor carries natural pressure, leaving you feeling breathless.]
[You know very well that if the opponent wants to, they can kill you with just a glance. In this situation, you dare not make any rash actions, knowing that trouble is about to come.]
[At this time, the cold laughter of the Bone Emperor resounds, stating that he was in hibernation and nearly missed two valuable individuals. One with Time-Space Body, although incomplete, can still be refined into a decent bone servant.]
[Next, the Bone Emperor looks at Lin Qinghe, his eyes burning with desire, stating that he never expected to meet the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body of this generation. If he could refine the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, even if he can’t fully display its power, it would be enough for him to advance further.]
[The words of the Bone Emperor cause your hearts to sink, knowing that trouble is approaching. The Bone Emperor clearly intends to take action against you. Facing a Quasi-Emperor, you have absolutely no ability to resist. Even if you were to face the bone servants created by the Bone Emperor, you would not be a match and would be easily suppressed.]
[In response, you can only bring out the Black Abyss Demon Spear, hoping that the Bone Emperor will spare you for the sake of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.]
[However, the Bone Emperor only glances at the Black Abyss Demon Spear with an indifferent expression. Members of the Demon Cult always act independently. Although the Black Abyss Demon Lord was once a fellow taoist he admired, his death means there’s no need to save face. A dead person’s successor has no value.]
[Seeing that the Bone Emperor has no intention of letting you go, you bitterly smile, knowing that you are most likely doomed this time. You wonder if you should end the simulation and conclude the shortest simulation attempt ever.]
[Unexpectedly, something unthinkable happens. From deep within the starry sky, another figure appears. Dressed in white, he possesses an extraordinary temperament. Upon his appearance, he coldly states that this is not a place for members of the Erebos Demon Sect to cause chaos.]
[The sudden emergence of the white-clothed figure changes the Bone Emperor’s expression, revealing a hint of fear and reluctance, exclaiming his surprise that the white-clothed figure had not yet died and is truly lucky.]
[The white-clothed figure indifferently looks at the Bone Emperor, coldly stating either he leaves or dies. Seeing the white-clothed figure’s dominance, the Bone Emperor is extremely displeased, but doesn’t say anything. Snorting coldly, he lies back down in the coffin and is carried away by the bone servants toward the unknown starry sky.]
[Seeing this, you are astonished, never expecting the suddenly appearing white-clothed figure to be so powerful and overbearing, directly driving away the sinister Quasi-Emperor Bone Emperor. As a result, you are highly curious about his identity and the extent of his cultivation and combat power.]
[However, after driving away the Bone Emperor, the white-clothed figure shows no interest in you but only glances at Lin Qinghe and sighs before disappearing.]
[At this, you have a sudden realization. Obviously, the other party had discovered Lin Qinghe, which is the reason he opposed the Bone Emperor and drove him away, not because of you. This makes you wonder if the other party is somehow related to the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]
[In response, you ask the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, hoping she can tell you the identity and origin of the white-clothed figure. Hearing your question, the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body says she does not know the identity and origin of the white-clothed figure, who may have risen after her demise.]
[Of course, it’s also possible that he is a contemporary figure. However, her current self is just a remnant soul with too many fragmented memories after reincarnation, causing her to forget the other party’s existence.]
[Listening to the response of the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, you ponder, thinking that the other party is either related to Lin Qinghe or the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. In any case, there must be some connection.]
[However, you know that now is not the time to worry about these things. You head in a chosen direction, hoping to find the Ancient Star as soon as possible.]
…
“Damn, this is really a rollercoaster.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the Text Simulation, speechless.
Can’t this Golden Talent: Transmission be more reliable?
Last time, he was teleported directly to a dangerous Ancient Star.
Although he gained many benefits from it, he ultimately died.
This time, he was again transported to an unknown starry sky, where he directly ran into the Bone Emperor of the Erebos Demon Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 696: 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Chapter 203: The First Seven-Color Talent! Mysterious Quasi-Emperor_5
Fortunately, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor appeared, otherwise, they would be screwed.
At that time, they might have to refresh the records of quickest death.
To just obtain the Seven-Color Talent and die so miserably, that would indeed be a bit depressing.
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind as he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, ten years have passed. You have good luck and finally found an ancient star named Heavenly Sun Ancient Star and landed on it. Then, you find out why you don’t know the coordinates of this starry sky. It turns out that this place isn’t a part of the Big Universe at all, but one of the Nine Mini Universes.]
[The Nine Mini Universes are collectively called the Nine Profound Mini Universes, surrounding the Big Universe. Now you are in the Profound Universe. After knowing this, you are very surprised and did not expect that you have accidentally come to the first Profound Universe among the Nine Profound Mini Universes.]
[For a moment, you feel that the effect of Golden Talent: Transmission may not be reliable, but the scope of random transmission is indeed wide.]
[However, you just complain, without thinking of going back. After all, to traverse the universe, one must have cultivation at the Supreme Realm. The reasons why Ruo Lan was able to cross the universe were due to the Second Generation Chat Group.]
[Next, you continue to inquire about the situation of Heavenly Sun Ancient Star. Soon, you find out that there aren’t any forces on this ancient star that could threaten you. Because the most powerful family on this ancient star has only ever produced a Great Saint.]
[For you, a self-titled Great Saint no longer poses a threat. Therefore, you can cultivate on this ancient star. Of course, it is now the Last Dharma Age, and your cultivation has reached the Saint King tier. Ordinary cultivation is not enough to improve your strength.]
[For this reason, recruiting disciples and improving their cultivation is the best choice. You are looking forward to the existence of monsters with good talents and fortune on this ancient star, who are eligible to become your disciples.]
[After thinking it through, you decide to establish your own sect. If you were still in the Big Universe, you could have joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace in the Immortal Continent without having to go through such trouble. However, now that you have come to the Profound Universe and have arrived at the relatively weak Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, creating your own force and accepting disciples is undoubtedly the best choice.]
[With many thoughts in your mind, you take action directly. You display your Saint King aura, use Great Magical Power to spread your voice throughout the entire Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, indicating that you will establish the Heaven Derivative Sect. Those with talents can enter and receive your personal guidance.]
[These words make the entire Heavenly Sun Ancient Star tremble. Countless cultivators show surprised expressions and yearn for it.]
[After all, it is the Last Dharma Age. Having a living Saint King appear and establish a sect is an extraordinary opportunity. Even Semi-saints rarely appear before people’s eyes.]
[Now, with a Saint King establishing a sect, if one can join it and receive guidance, the future is limitless. As a result, whether they are young geniuses or established loose cultivators, they choose to head for the mountain range you have selected, hoping to join the Heaven Derivative Sect you have founded and receive your guidance.]
[As for the native forces of Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, they are all very amazed and don’t know where you have come from, yet so high-profiled in establishing a sect on Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, seizing territory and cultivation resources.]
[This undoubtedly touched these forces’ sensitive nerves, and even self-titled Saintfield Ancestors among these forces were very displeased.]
[However, although you are quite arrogant, they cannot do anything to you. After all, they have already sealed themselves and cannot come out into the world. Besides, ordinary Saints cannot deal with you, only Saint Kings and above can contend with you.]
[It’s not worth it for such a level of powerhouses to come out because of this matter and risk their lives. Therefore, even though they are annoyed, they can only turn a blind eye.]
[You can guess the thoughts of the native forces on Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, but you don’t care too much about it. Instead, you quickly transform the mountain range, send people to build it up, and arrange the Great Array.]
[Soon after, people started to arrive one after another. These people thought there would be some examinations waiting for them. However, to their surprise, you didn’t have any intention to test them, nor did you care whether they were genuinely joining the sect or being spies from other forces.]
[Your choice was only one: to proclaim education without discrimination and accept everyone. After all, the Son of Fortune from the bottom feeders started with a bleak appearance and no special features, so you were afraid of missing out on such talents.]
[As time flows, another year passed in the blink of an eye. Due to your actions, the Heaven Derivative Sect expanded rapidly, with a large number of disciples.]

chapters.title: Chapter 697: 204: It's So Happy to Accept a Disciple! Cultivation Soars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Chapter 204: It’s So Happy to Accept a Disciple! Cultivation Soars!
“What the heck? Unlimited teachings, countless disciples? Damn, this is like creating a fantasy version of the Intercepting Sect…”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a strange look in his eyes.
Others might call Babel Leader a saint, standing at the pinnacle of Primordial Chaos.
Although he is a Saint’s King above the saints, the two are not comparable. In this Profound World, he is just an ordinary powerhouse.
Will this really not cause any problems?
“Forget it, it’s worth a try.”
Soon, Wang Ping figured it out, muttered a word in his heart, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[One year has passed, and your cultivation has not improved at all. You are very depressed about this and feel that there are too few geniuses on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, and you can’t find any.]
[You sigh about this, the Tao of Heavenly Secret and Qi Luck is full of mystery, its inheritance has always been hidden, you do not even know where to learn. Even the Taiyi Imperial Palace cannot master these two ways.]
[You feel that if you can refresh a new observation-type golden talent or a seven-color talent, which can easily see who is the genius and who can meet your requirements for accepting disciples, that would be awesome. In this way, you can maximize the effect of talent.]
…
“It’s not that simple after all. It seems like I have to follow the elite route. Although there are waste material stream luck children, they are ultimately a minority. The real geniuses are quite extraordinary from the moment they are born.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content and thought secretly.
[Afterward, you feel that continuing like this is meaningless and will waste your resources and time. As a result, you stop expanding.]
[However, you have not given up on the idea of the Heaven Derivative Sect, and began to focus on training some Divine Realm Experts to manage the Heaven Derivative Sect. At the same time, you also let them establish an intelligence network and find special genius characters on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star.]
[Finally, after a hundred years of development, the various aspects of the Heaven Derivative Sect have finally stabilized, and various reasonable rules have been formulated, making the Heaven Derivative Sect no longer chaotic.]
[Although you are fully aware that some people within the Sect are not particularly loyal, and some are even the internal helpers of other forces, you do not pay much attention to it. After all, the purpose of establishing the Heaven Derivative Sect is just to gather geniuses, as long as they do not cause trouble, you will turn a blind eye.]
[Now, a hundred years have passed, and the internal situation of the Heaven Derivative Sect is extremely complicated. Because of your policy, many people are keen on finding talented or special geniuses off the mountain.]
[As a result, you have heard the prompt tone of the system several times. Although these rewards only allowed you to improve from the 1st tier of Saint King Realm to the 2nd tier of Saint King Realm, it is still quite good.]
[After all, it is absolutely impossible for you to upgrade from the 1st tier of Saint King Realm to 2nd tier of Saint King Realm under normal cultivation, even in the golden age, let alone the Last Dharma Age. It would take at least a thousand years to rely solely on cultivation to upgrade from 1st tier of Saint King Realm to 2nd tier of Saint King Realm.]
[It can be said that the seven-color talent, which allows you to get stronger by accepting disciples, is really powerful. You are very satisfied with this.]
[However, you are not satisfied with the speed of accepting disciples. Therefore, you decide to dig at the walls of other forces. After all, very few geniuses that can meet your standards can be found among the common people.]
[For example, the chances of descendants of major Holy Lands being eligible to become your disciples must be much higher.]
[When you started to think about digging the wall’s foundation, other forces also felt very unhappy with the Heaven Derivative Sect and were speechless about your behavior of accepting everyone as disciples. They even thought that the Saint King’s dignity had fallen to the ground.]
[After all, in the past, Saint Realm Powerhouses were high above others, and it was impossible for them to just accept disciples casually. The whole situation where everyone in a force is the disciple of the Sect Master could never happen, whether in the past, present, or future, they all felt that such a bizarre situation would not happen again.]
[Just as other forces felt speechless about your actions, you started digging at the walls. You went directly to a Holy Land and began to coax the holy child of the Holy Land, making various promises. Cultivating Emperor Sutra, providing top-tier Divine Origin, and entering the Holy Realm in the future.]
[With all these benefits, the holy child of the Holy Land simply cannot refuse and is extremely tempted. Although he is in a Holy Land, its strongest Ancestor is but a saint. His chance of becoming a saint in the future is very minimal. Following you and being your disciple, his chance of becoming a saint would undoubtedly be much greater.]
[Not to mention, the most important thing is that there is an Emperor Scripture to cultivate. That is the Emperor Scripture that countless people dream of, and if one could cultivate it, their battle power in the same realm would soar, and the probability of becoming a saint would be even greater.]
[Although distressed and feeling guilty towards his original Sect, the holy child still chose to worship you as a master and was dug into the Heaven Derivative Sect by you. He comforted himself by thinking that he could atone for the Sect once he became a Saint.]
[When he became your disciple, you received the prompt tone again, and your cultivation had some improvement, although there was still some distance from the 3rd tier of Saint King Realm, however, a few more times like this, and you would certainly break through.]
[This delighted you, and you felt that you had finally found the right way. Accepting ordinary disciples everywhere is much simpler and more direct than digging geniuses from large forces.]

chapters.title: Chapter 698: 204: It's So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Chapter 204: It’s So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _2
[Next, following the same method, you dug out other geniuses from this Holy Land. In the end, you took away the top ten most talented people. Although only three of them triggered a prompt, your cultivation ultimately improved and reached the Saint King 3rd tier level.]
…
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation content and had a forehead full of black lines.
“Well, they really didn’t want a blue lotus; they went straight to digging at the base of the wall.”
