Wang Ping’s face twitched as he began to complain.
“But with this talent, not poaching them would be doing injustice to oneself, right? Improving one’s strength is the most critical; things like morals can be put aside for now since it’s just a simulation.”
Wang Ping sighed and comforted his soul, calming himself down.
“However, it seems that the minimum standard for the Seven-Colored Talent’s recruitment is geniuses who could potentially break through to become a Quasi-Saint or Saint.”
Wang Ping thought back to the circumstances in the simulation content, stroking his chin as he began analyzing.
“But, based on previous performance, rewarding cultivation based on a genius’s overall quality may be affecting the reward. These ordinary geniuses bring only a small cultivation reward, requiring several of them together to break through a single minor realm.
Perhaps, when the bottleneck is reached, disciples who are the true Sons of Fortune and Daughters of Fortune are needed to break through.
For example, at his early stage, Ye Chen was recruited, and through this reward, he advanced from Saint Great Perfection to Half-Step Saint King.
Then, directly because of Lin Qinghe, he reached the Saint King tier.
Clearly, this kind of progress wouldn’t be possible by recruiting ordinary geniuses as disciples.
“Once the wall’s base is dug away, we can consider visiting other ancient stars or choosing self-titling and waiting for the Golden Age to arrive. When the Golden Age commences, true geniuses will be abundant, appearing like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.”
Wang Ping flashes this thought as he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After you took away the genius of this Holy Land, you didn’t let them immediately follow you back to the Heaven Derivative Sect. Because if you did, it would have created a lot of commotion, and it would be troublesome to dig away more geniuses from other forces.]
[Next, you followed the same method and began to go to other forces to scout and madly poach their geniuses. However, the difficulty of improving your cultivation this time has become a bit higher. You triggered ten prompts in total to progress from Saint King Realm 3rd tier to Saint King Realm 4th tier.]
[Apparently, the Saint King Realm 4th tier is already in the middle phase of the Saint King Realm, equivalent to a small bottleneck. It requires more cultivation rewards from disciples to break through.]
[In the end, when you dug into the last force, which was the strongest family in the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, the Yun Family, your cultivation had improved to the Saint King Realm 5th tier peak level, but you were just a little bit away from the Saint King Realm 6th tier.]
[You believe that if you dig away a genius from the strongest Yun Family in the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, you can definitely break through to the Saint King Realm 6th tier level, and not far away from the Saint King Realm 7th tier.]
[However, the Yun Family is different from other forces since they are a family, and family disciples are usually not easily poached. Of course, you didn’t care too much about it because no one can resist the Emperor Scripture, not even the family geniuses. You only need them to become your disciples; that would be enough.]
[Soon, you took action and began poaching. However, this time, when you successfully poached the Yun Family’s heir, you found that there was no reward. You should know that this Yun Family genius is a genius with Special Constitution, and his talent is unparalleled among his peers in the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star. It’s impossible not to trigger a reward.]
[In response, you pondered that you had discovered the hidden rules of the Seven-Colored Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger. That is, not only looking at the comprehensive qualities of the disciples but also whether they genuinely want to become apprentices. If they don’t have a sincere desire to become apprentices, there will be no rewards.]
[In other words, some of the disciples you poached before may have the potential to trigger the reward mechanism. However, those disciples did not genuinely want to become apprentices since their hearts harbored many crooked thoughts, so they were not included.]
[You weren’t surprised about this because, after all, it would be strange if all the disciples you poached in this manner were genuinely willing to become apprentices.]
[However, you didn’t care much; you continued poaching from the Yun Family. The Yun Family people were not all like the Yun Family’s heir, and some genuinely wanted to become apprentices. In the end, your cultivation improved, reaching the Saint King Realm 6th tier level.]
[Although it’s still quite far from the estimated Saint King Realm 6th tier peak, you’re quite satisfied.]
[Next, you took all the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star disciples who genuinely wanted to become apprentices to the Heaven Derivative Sect and planned to train them. Since you’ve already made promises, you must fulfill them, and doing so would live up to your true self.]
[Of course, you don’t think highly of the geniuses who didn’t provide you any benefits. These people didn’t want to become apprentices sincerely and had many crooked thoughts, so you only gave them a few advantages without truly teaching them.]
[However, your actions were finally exposed. For a time, the entire Heavenly Sun Ancient Star trembled, and all forces were so angry that they spat blood.]
[They never imagined that you would be so shameless, poaching away so many of their geniuses. For a time, countless force leaders scolded angrily, calling you shameless.]

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 204: It’s So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Chapter 204: It’s So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _3
[Even the self-titled ancestors of these powers are becoming restless and want to come out and kill you. Faced with the anger of these forces, you argue that they are misleading their disciples. And since these disciples have a connection with you, in order for these promising talents to become saints and protect the world in the future, you have no choice but to act this way.]
[The disciples of the Heaven Derivative Sect also did not expect you to be so thick-skinned, all staring in amazement. Lin Qinghe is also very helpless, not knowing why you are doing these things.]
[Even the soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body is rendered speechless by your actions, not understanding why you would do such thankless tasks.]
[However, when the soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body discovered that your cultivation had reached the 6th tier of the Saint King Realm, they were extremely shocked and somewhat incredulous.]
[After all, your previous cultivation was only at the 2nd tier of the Saint King Realm. In such a short amount of time, you’ve promoted from the 2nd tier of the Saint King Realm to the 6th tier, which is too outrageous, even faster than taking pills. Even with the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, there should be a digestion process.]
[Then, they recalled your strange behavior of recruiting disciples and couldn’t help but suspect that you had practiced some kind of luck-based cultivation, gathering fortune by recruiting disciples and improving your cultivation.]
[In this world, such cultivation methods are not nonexistent. Some countries follow the path of national fortune, and as their national fortune grows stronger, the Royal Family can use the path of national fortune to cultivate, rapidly improve their cultivation, and also assist in battles.]
[However, even with these cultivation methods, the speed of promotion would not be as outrageous as yours.]
[For a time, the soul of the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body felt that your secrets were even more numerous than they had imagined.]
[At this moment, the various powers are directly enraged by you, laughing out of frustration. Even the forces with Saint Realm powerhouses presiding cannot sit still, wanting to come out and suppress you, the troublemaker. Otherwise, if they let you continue stirring up trouble, who knows how many more disciples will be poached?]
[This has already shaken the foundation of their forces, and it is an intolerable matter.]
…
“Goodness, this is quite chaotic. This simulated Wang Ping has really let himself go, truly not caring about his reputation. This time, it has caused quite a stir and I’m afraid it will provoke a beatdown from various forces.”
Wang Ping looks at the Text Simulation, his face twitching slightly.
While it is true that with the simulated Wang Ping’s current cultivation, his combat power is absolutely terrifying to the extreme, capable of suppressing even lower-ranking Great Saints, it is still somewhat awkward.
After all, he really couldn’t justify this matter.
“It’s just a simulation, just a simulation, don’t worry about it.”
Wang Ping continues to mutter to himself, staring at the luminescent screen.
[In the end, the major powers of the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star discussed and decided to join forces against you. However, some weaker forces could only reluctantly accept, because the strongest among them were just self-titled Saints and unable to pose a threat to you. Once they take action, they will be left without any foundation.]
[Because of this, they could only tactfully refuse, saying that they didn’t care about the matter of having their disciples poached. In the end, various forces dispatched a total of two Saint Kings and four Saintly Individuals, carrying Great Saint Artifacts and the Array Flag, and charged towards you.]
[When these powerful figures brought immense pressure towards the Heaven Derivative Sect, many of the sect’s disciples and elders became panicked. The majority of them believed that you had offended all the powers on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, and now that they had come knocking, you were as good as done for.]
[As a result, the majority of them chose to flee the mountain gate. You watch this scene and do not stop them. After all, when you established the Heaven Derivative Sect and recruited a large number of disciples, you never thought about how loyal they would be, nor did you think they would have any sense of belonging to the sect.]
[Now that these people are fleeing, it actually serves as a screening of the members of the sect. While those who remain may not necessarily be utterly loyal, and there might still be spies from other powers among them, the situation is certainly much better than before.]
[After all, once you know the minimum requirements for the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger, you no longer have any interest in ordinary disciples and have no interest in taking them as your disciples.]
[A great army approaches, and the two Saint Kings led by the Yun Family’s Saint King are scolding your unjust actions, telling the irrelevant people to quickly leave the Heaven Derivative Sect to avoid trouble.]
[Faced with this terrifying power, some people waver again and choose to flee the mountain gate. Seeing this, you still show no intention of stopping them.]
[Next, the two Saint Kings led by the Yun Family look down on you from above, saying that you have gone too far, and today they will completely destroy your Heaven Derivative Sect and suppress you forever.]
[In the face of the words of these powerful beings, you remain extremely calm and unmoved. The remaining disciples who haven’t fled suddenly feel a strong sense of security and believe that you may be able to contend with these powerful beings.]
[If you can really use your own power to repel these powerful beings, then the Heaven Derivative Sect will truly be able to stand firm, and the status and benefits they can gain from following you as their master in the future will be beyond imagination. For many people, this is a huge gamble.]
[Afterward, you stepped into the air, expressing your willingness to fight without saying much. Seeing that you are not afraid, the Saint Realm powerhouses led by the Yun Family’s Saint King frown, thinking that you are not simple, but still scold you for being too arrogant.]

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 204: It’s So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Chapter 204: It’s So Enjoyable to Take Disciples! Cultivation Soars! _4
[Next, the two Saint Kings take action first, using their divine skills to press you down. These two Saint Kings have cultivation of Saint King 4th tier and Saint King 5th tier, just like you, already stepped into the middle stage of the Saint King realm, they are not weak.]
[However, faced with the attack of these two Saint Kings, you don’t even bother to use your divine skills, simply brushing off their attacks and dissipating them. This shocked the attacking powerhouses, as well as the self-titled Saint Realm powerhouses secretly watching.]
[At this moment, they find that they seem to have underestimated you. They didn’t expect your cultivation to have reached the Saint King 6th tier. Apart from that, you are clearly not an ordinary Saint King, rumors say you have cultivated the Emperor Scripture, and the rumor of you being a genius Emperor Scripture poached by the Heavenly Derivative Sect may be true.]
[For a time, all the major forces are deeply moved, feeling that a change might arise from this battle.]
[Next, the Saint King from the Yun Family takes the lead with a solemn expression, not underestimating the situation, and directly activates the prepared Great Array, trying to suppress you.]
[With two Saint Kings as the base, four Saintly Individuals as their aid, combined with numerous divine sources and God Realm cultivators, this Great Array is enough to suppress 7th-Tier Saint King powerhouses. For this reason, they have some confidence in suppressing you.]
[However, your subsequent performance silences everyone. Facing such a large array, you still remain indifferent and finally get serious by using the Burning Emperor Fist and Forty Percent Fire Element Mana to explosively defeat them. Those who set up the array spit blood, and that’s only because you had no intention of killing. Otherwise, they would all perish.]
[Compared to the astonishment of the attacking powerhouses and the silence of the spectators, those living beings who haven’t fled the Heavenly Derivative Sect are excited. It seems they made the right bet that your strength as a master is overwhelmingly strong, and their future prospects are bright. As for those who fled, they are now full of remorse.]
[Then, just as everyone is curious about how the situation will be resolved, and the Yun Family has even more powerhouses hoping to make a move, your next words leave everyone dumbfounded.]
[You enthusiastically declare that if the two Saint Kings and four Saintly Individuals are willing to become your disciples wholeheartedly, today’s affairs can be put behind, and you might even pass on the Emperor Scripture to them in the future.]
[Upon hearing this, everyone is dumbfounded. Who are you to try digging into their turf all the way up to the Saint Realm powerhouses? Are the geniuses not enough for you?]
[If even the Saint Realm powerhouses are poached by you, then it would be terrifying, as the forces they belong to would likely merge into your Heavenly Derivative Sect.]
….
“I’ve got to admire this move.”
Wang Ping looks at the text simulation content and rubs his forehead again.
Poaching till you reach the Saintly Individuals and Saint King Ancestors is quite impressive, it’s a unique idea.
However, it is indeed worth a try.
If the disciples grew into powerful cultivators and still get cultivation rewards, then the scope of discipleship would be expanded in the future.
With this in mind, Wang Ping continues to stare expectantly at the luminescent screen.
[Faced with your invitation, the faces of the two Saint King Strong and the four Saintly Individuals contort in madness. As Saintfield Ancestors, they have their dignity; being defeated is one thing, but being asked by the enemy if they want to become his disciples is simply too humiliating.]
[However, they can sense that their age is much older than yours. Therefore, no matter the circumstances, they cannot become your disciples. Even though you just demonstrated your Emperor Scripture and divine skills, it doesn’t change their minds.]
[As for the Great Emperor Sutra or something similar, with your way of recruiting, it’ll be an opportunity to bring those disciples back in the future.]
[For this reason, they choose to reject you. Seeing this, you regretfully take action again, defeating and sealing them one by one with heavy injuries.]
[Although this issue started with your wrongdoing, since the other side has come knocking on your door, you must counterattack. If you do nothing and let them leave, it would easily give people the impression that you are kind-hearted and easy to bully.]
[Since things have reached this point, the only thing to do is to flex your muscles and show the people of Heavenly Sun Ancient Star that you are not to be messed with so that you can continue on your path.]
[At this moment, seeing you seriously injure and seal the two Saint Kings and four Saintly Individuals, the old monsters of the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star are getting restless. The Yun Family members, in particular, have murderous looks in their eyes.]
[After all, one of the two Saint Kings who was seriously injured and suppressed is from their Yun Family. Although the Yun Family has a Great Saint Ancestor, Saint King powerhouses are still rare and precious. There are only three Saint Kings in the entire Yun Family. Suppressing one of them would result in a huge loss.]
[Although the old Ancestors who have come out into the world have limited lifespans and cannot be sealed again after leaving the divine source, they are still Saint Kings. Regardless of body possession or other means of survival, they are ultimately one of the pillars of the Yun Family and must not be harmed.]
[Immediately, the voice of the Yun Family Great Saint resounds, hoping you won’t go too far. If you spare the Yun Family Saint King, this matter will be put to rest.]
[Seeing the Yun Family Great Saint speak up, everyone from the Yun Family is shocked, as well as other forces and cultivators. After all, this is the only Great Saint on Heavenly Sun Ancient Star. They didn’t expect even the Great Saint to compromise with you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 701: 204: The Joy of Taking a Disciple! Cultivation Soars! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: Chapter 204: The Joy of Taking a Disciple! Cultivation Soars! _5
[However, after giving it some thought, they felt that the Yun Family had no choice. After all, in this Last Dharma Age, Great Saints would not likely appear or be willing to appear. And your strength was too powerful, even a 7th-Tier Saint King couldn’t possibly kill you.]
[That is to say, even if the two remaining Saint Kings from the Yun Family joined forces, along with a few other Saint Kings from other major powers, they might not necessarily be able to kill you.]
[The gap between each small realm among Saint Kings is significant. Your cultivation is already the highest among the existing Saint Kings. Add to that the fact that you practice the Cultivating Emperor Sutra, which makes you extremely strong. Without Great Saints, you are invincible. Saying it is uncertain whether they can kill you is actually an optimistic statement.]
[As a result, the Yun Family Great Saint had no choice but to compromise. However, everyone knew that this was only a temporary compromise. As soon as something happened that caused the Yun Family Great Saint to appear or the golden age arrived and the Yun Family Great Saint chose to appear, you would be the first one they would kill.]
[Naturally, you were well aware of this. However, you didn’t pay much attention to it. The Yun Family Great Saint is powerful, but you were not afraid of him at all. As a 6th-Tier Saint King, you could already unleash the full power of the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, which could help you fight against Great Saints.]
[If you add up the Purple Divine Skill – Talent Nullification, Purple Talent: Endless Blade, Golden Talent: Multiplay, and other methods, it wouldn’t be too difficult for you to kill ordinary Great Saints. Even if you faced stronger Great Saints, with good luck, you were confident in killing them.]
[In the end, you decided to let the various major powers compensate you, and the matter was considered settled. You have truly become famous after one battle, becoming the second strongest person on Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, and you didn’t even self-title yourself. Comparatively, as long as you don’t attack the Yun Family, you can freely walk around on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star.]
[In this regard, the disciples of the Heaven Derivative Sect were proud and extremely excited, feeling a sense of superiority. Considering that they were all your disciples, they indeed had seniority, which made them feel a step above others.]
[After this incident, the Heaven Derivative Sect’s recruitment criteria became extremely strict, and internal management was also in good order, truly putting them on the right track.]
[Meanwhile, you were also considering your next plans. After all, on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, it would be difficult for more talented disciples to appear that could help you improve your cultivation.]
[At the same time, you had always been thinking about one issue. Whether the improvement in cultivation is related to your cultivation. If your cultivation was higher, would the cultivation you gained from accepting disciples with a talent and potential limited to the Quasi-Saint and Saint tier be reduced?]
[This is undoubtedly a critical variable that needs to be understood. In the end, after carefully analyzing and examining, you came to a conclusion.]
[That is, it’s not like that. As your cultivation improves, you can still improve your cultivation by accepting disciples with such potential, and the improved cultivation is actually similar. However, after your cultivation has improved, the ‘Mana Points’ required to improve it again will be different.]
[In gaming terms, as the level increases, the ‘experience points’ required for the next level also increase. Thus, although the experience gained from killing monsters is the same, you need to grind more of these monsters to level up. Applied to you, it means that in the same situation, you need to accept more disciples with such talent to improve your cultivation again.]
[Regarding this, you were relieved. Although the experience increases and you need to accept more disciples with such potential to level up, it is still better than being unable to gain cultivation or getting less of it. After all, the talents like Ye Chen and Lin Qinghe, who are Sons or Daughters of Fortune, were ultimately few in number, and it was not easy to find one.]
[Moreover, these kinds of characters often carry various burdens and are very troublesome. Unless you hit a bottleneck and had no choice but to take such disciples to break through, you felt that having a large number of potential disciples, focusing on quantity rather than quality, would be a better way to improve your cultivation.]
[Of course, if you return to the Big Universe and go to the Immortal Continent, it would be relatively easier to find talents and geniuses with both talent and fortune like Ye Chen and Lin Qinghe. The Immortal Continent is not short of geniuses and monsters.]
[However, the problem is that these geniuses and monsters are inheritors of major powers, and their masters are at least at the Supreme level. For now, you trying to take them as your disciples or poaching them is almost impossible.]
[Others would not be willing to follow you, someone whose cultivation isn’t much higher than theirs, as their master. As for cultivation resources, they don’t lack them either. Furthermore, if you dare to poach, their masters, who have at least Supreme Cultivation, would be willing to kill you and scatter your ashes.]
[In the end, you made a decision…]

chapters.title: Chapter 702: 205: The Innate Holy Man! Killing the Great Saint!
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Chapter 205: The Innate Holy Man! Killing the Great Saint!
[You have decided to explore the ancient stars of the Profound Small Universe, trying to persuade all the geniuses on these ancient stars to become your apprentices, thereby improving your own cultivation.]
[Of course, for prudence’s sake, you do not plan to mess around with those forces that possess the Supreme or those established by the Supreme.]
[After all, despite your Saint King Realm 6th tier Cultivation and Supreme Artifact allowing you to fight a match against an ordinary Great Saint, it’s undoubtedly not difficult to kill an ordinary Great Saint considering your other talents. However, there’s no possibility of victory when facing a Supreme.]
[The forces left behind by a Supreme who has already passed away but left a Supreme Artifact are also not to be trifled with. After all, a Great Saint with a Supreme Artifact is definitely stronger than you.]
[Overcoming a greater level of difficulty has become relatively difficult for the present you. Because your cultivation has increased too rapidly, your mana understanding can’t keep up. Indeed, a 40% understanding of principles is stronger than many Saint Kings, but it’s impossible to compare with those of Great Saint tier individuals.]
[After all, such individuals have at least a 70% understanding of principles.]
[In relation to this, this is also considered a disadvantage of the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples Contribute to Strength. That is, you can only increase your cultivation but not the strength of your understanding of principles.]
[Then again, the cultivation path has always been an equal advancement of cultivation and understanding of principles. If understanding principles lags, then you’ll be left like a hollow fatty, who has cultivation level but easy to be challenged by others.]
[In addition, breakthroughs in cultivation are indeed closely related to the understanding of principles. To break through to the Saint King Realm 7th tier, grasping 50% of the principles is an essential prerequisite. Forcing a breakthrough would result to disaster.]
[Although the cultivation improvements brought by the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples Contribute to Strength are not hollow and won’t lead to a lack of foundation, having inadequate comprehension of principles is still no good.]
[Therefore, although you have many thoughts in mind and plan to visit all the ancient stars of the Small Universe and recruit disciples everywhere, you also understand the importance of further understanding principles before you make a breakthrough.]
[After some consideration, you eventually decided on your course, which is to recruit disciples and raise your cultivation up to the peak of Saint King Realm 6th tier, while seeking opportunities to aid your comprehension of principles or enhance aspect of principles.]
[If you can’t find such opportunities, you plan to self-tittle till the golden age comes and then continue recruiting disciples.]
[In the golden age, your comprehension of principles would be much easier, and you can learn 50% of the principles in a relatively short time.]
[By that time, you can continue to recruit disciples and rapidly enhance your cultivation again.]
[Next, you announce that you have begun your actions. Utilizing the star map you obtained on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star, you start to journey to nearby ancient stars.]
[You discover that the power on the ancient star you visited is significantly weaker than on the Heavenly Sun Ancient Star.]
[This makes you ponder, you assume that the number of powerhouses in the Small Universe seems to be much less than those in the ancient stars of the Big Universe, and there aren’t as many forbidden territories.]
[However, upon further thought, you feel that this relationship is quite normal. After all, the relationship between the Small Universe and the Big Universe is similar to the relationship between a satellite and the earth, incomparable.]
[Eventually, you’ve successfully poached quite a few geniuses on this ancient star and take those who are willing to sincerely become your disciples. Your cultivation has also successfully reached the peak of Saint King Realm 6th tier.]
[Your actions have enraged the self-titled Saint Realm on this ancient star, making him want to come out to duel with you.]
[However, after you intentionally showcased your cultivation strength and Emperor’s Mystic Skills, all of them shut up, quite oppressed.]
[There is no way they could win; they simply can’t. You know, the strongest on their ancient star is only at the Saint King 3rd tier. And that’s just an ordinary Saint King, not on par with you, who cultivate the Emperor Sutra. Coming out would just result in being beaten, they might even die.]
[After seeing these individuals being “physically” persuaded by you, you enthusiastically invited them to be your disciples and began to promise them. You spoke of how you were just under a thousand years old and were bound to become an Emperor in the future. If they were willing to become your disciples, you promised them they would definitely advance further in the future. Saints could be promoted to Saint Kings, and Saint Kings could reach the Great Saint level. At the same time, you could also extend their lives.]
[Your promise made these Saint Realm powerhouses stunned. However, they still did not believe you. To this, you were very disappointed. As expected, these individuals have grown up to this point, all old foxes, not easy to deceive.]
[Although you didn’t exactly deceive, because your current physical ‘age’ indeed hasn’t exceeded a thousand years, it’s only over a hundred years old. But if they don’t believe, there’s nothing you can do. Moreover, even if they did believe that you reached the Saint King tier at a thousand years old, this kind of promise would be hard for these old creatures to believe, far less convincing than tangible items.]
[But you also know very well, only the Great Emperor Sutra on you can make them go crazy. However, even if you take it out, these individuals will most likely not sincerely apprentice you. In the end, it’s still a loss.]
[In the end, you were entirely disgusted with these old oddities with too many schemes and whose potential have reached the peak. You gave up the idea of recruiting these old oddities that have grown up.]
[You plan to reach the Supreme tier in the future and then deal with them, hoping they won’t be unappreciative, and quickly kneel and lick your boots. At that time, it’s not you wanting them to be disciples, it’s them begging you to become disciples.]

chapters.title: Chapter 703: 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Chapter 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _2
[You carry such an ambition, and begin to head towards other Ancient Stars. However, you no longer have the desire to keep taking on disciples, for fear that you might suddenly break through to the Saint King Realm 7th tier, making yourself too ‘bloated’. Your main goal is still as planned, to find opportunities for comprehending 70% of the laws first.]
[At this time, you recall Cai Yonglong’s first Golden finger. You sighed in your heart, Cai Yonglong’s original Golden finger for finding opportunities was really useful. If he still had that golden finger, you could help him optimize it twice in a row now. By then, finding the opportunities you needed would likely be a breeze.]
[With such a golden finger, there’s no need for you to go through these Ancient Stars one by one, it’s just a waste of time.]
….
“Cai Yonglong, thinking about it, his Golden finger is really a pity.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and felt very regretful.
Whether Cai Yonglong’s Golden finger was used to find those special prodigies or opportunities, it was extremely useful.
In the mortal world, he didn’t need to rely on his golden finger, and his golden finger couldn’t make him grow rapidly.
Now, he has arrived in the Upper Realm where there are countless prodigies and opportunities, his golden finger could undoubtedly play a big role.
Even in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, the effect would be astonishing.
Unfortunately, he changed it.
“Absolute Defense is good, but it’s always not as good as finding opportunities.”
Wang Ping shook his head, feeling regretful again.
“Forget it, it’s better to rely on oneself than on others. Cai Yonglong’s Golden finger is gone after all. Now, I hope I can refresh a similar talent. It’s not impossible. Obviously, the highest level of Seven-Color Talent touches the level of chat group members’ Golden fingers. Putting it in many fantasy novels, it could be used as a powerful system with no side effects.”
Next, an idea flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[When you were about to reach the sixth Life Ancient Star, you saw an astonishing vision. A terrifying vision, the golden radiance had spread beyond the Ancient Star, where it caught your eye.]
[Immediately after that, you felt a Saintly presence. This surprised you, as you thought that some cultivator may have proven themselves a Saint in this Last Dharma Age. However, you soon realized that something was wrong.]
[Because there was no Tribulation aura on this Ancient Star, even if someone successfully crossed the Tribulation, the aura of the Saint Tribulation would remain and take some time to dissipate. In other words, no one crossed the Saint Tribulation, but a Saint was born.]
[Intrigued by this unusual situation, you sped up using Space Divine Skills and came to this Ancient Star called the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star, finding the source of the Saint aura.]
[Then, you were taken aback. That’s right, even now, having reached the peak of the Holy King’s 6th tier, and being worldly-wise you were surprised. Because the source of this aura wasn’t from any Saint coming through tribulation, it was from a newborn baby.]
[A baby that had just been born aroused such an amazing vision and had reached the Saint tier shortly after being born. He was literally a born Saint, the kind that was naturally gifted. This was something that could make most cultivators envious.]
[After all, their cultivation over a lifetime was difficult, and most cultivators couldn’t touch the threshold of a Saint in their lifetime. Yet, this baby was born in the Last Dharma Age and reached the Saint tier soon after birth, how monstrous.]
[For a moment, you felt a fire in your heart. If you could take this baby as your disciple in the future, what amazing rewards would you get? At the least, it wouldn’t be worse than receiving Lin Qinghe as a disciple. In other words, he is the key to your breakthrough to the Great Saint tier.]
[As long as your cultivation reaches the Half-step Great Saint Tier, you can use this baby to break through the bottleneck and upgrade to the Great Saint Tier.]
[You’ve made up your mind to build relationships with this baby’s family, in preparation for adopting him as a disciple in the future. Of course, before that, you need to perfectly upgrade your cultivation to the Half-step Great Saint Tier; the degree of law comprehension is even more important.]
[When you had this thought, the Ji family, where the baby was born, was also alarmed by the visions formed by the baby’s birth and overjoyed. After all, even though their Ji family is a very powerful family on the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star with self-titled Great Saints, ultimately they are not the strongest.]
[Now that a born Saint has appeared in their family, this is a great sign of prosperity. They believe that as long as this baby does not fall midway, his chances of proving the Tao Proving Supreme in the future are very high, even a quasi-Emperor or an Emperor is not impossible.]
[Under such an exciting fantasy, those self-titled ancestors of the Ji family could barely resist revealing themselves.]
[Compared to the excitement of the Ji family, the other forces on the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star are a bit restless. The Ji family has given birth to a monster, which doesn’t feel much for the middle and lower-level forces, after all, they are dependents of the powerful forces. But for forces at the same level as the Ji family, and those that are slightly stronger, this is not good news.]

chapters.title: Chapter 704: 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: Chapter 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _3
[Once the Ji family gains power, and if their Innate Saint grows up in the future, they might cause big trouble. The entire Primordial Spirit Ancient Star would become their playground, and only the Ji family could dominate. At that time, there would be no room for others to survive. This is not a malicious guess but a very likely occurrence. The world of cultivators is so cruel.]
[In response, the three major powers at the level of Ji family and a little stronger than it had chosen to cooperate. Even the Great Saints and the ancestors of their clans had chosen to make a move, joining hands to attack the Ji family.]
[Upon seeing this, the Ji family’s faces changed drastically, while the other forces were shocked to the extreme. The joint appearance of the three Great Saints in the Last Dharma Age was too harsh to suppress the Ji family. They wanted to annihilate the Innate Saint, showing no intention of leaving any room for the Ji family to live.]
[The Ji family’s Great Saint Ancestor and other Saintfield Ancestors were taken aback by the harshness of these old-timers. As a result, they had no choice but to make a move, planning to fight to the death to give the Ji family time to escape with the baby of the Innate Saint.]
[The Ji family could be exterminated, but the Innate Saint must not die. The ancestors of the Ji family were resolute in their will.]
[You, too, were surprised by these events, but you couldn’t help showing a smile. With something so big happening, it would become much easier for you to accept disciples.]
[Next, both helping the Ji family defeat their strong enemies and sheltering them, or suddenly taking action to flee with the Ji family’s baby, are good choices. Of course, if possible, you would still like to help the Ji family defeat their strong enemies and shelter the Ji family.]
[However, this relies on your ability to judge whether you can rival the power of the three Great Saints. If not, running away with the baby is the best choice. If possible, you don’t want to waste a life or two.]
[It was during your observation of the battle that the great war began. Although the Ji family’s Great Saint, together with their Saint Kings and Saint Realm Powerhouses, formed the Great Array to confront the three Great Saints, the three Great Saints were ultimately too strong to be resisted by the Ji family’s Great Saint alone, let alone with the help of other Saint Realm Powerhouses in the Great Array.]
[What made the Ji family’s experts desperate was that their Ji family had already been sealed off, and the Ji family’s baby could not be moved away, leaving them to wait for death.]
[Seeing this, many cultivator sighed secretly, and the Ji family was finished. The Innate Saint may not be finished, but he will definitely suffer. Sometimes, death can be a release. The value of an Innate Saint is enormous, whether it is for refining medicine or enslavement, it is an excellent choice.]
[It’s a pity that an Innate Saint was born in a small family and it turned into a tragedy. Although the Ji family had a Great Saint, they were not weak, but that was only relative. If the Innate Saint had been born in an imperial-tier force or a quasi-emperor tier force, he could have become one of the protagonists of the era in the Upper Realm.]
[When everyone sighed and thought that the Ji family was doomed, you finally decided to take action. You suddenly burst out, launching a surprise attack on a Great Saint with the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear. This attack triggered the effect of 7th-Tier multi-performance.]
[While this attack did not activate the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, it still blew the Great Saint on the spot, splattering blood in the air.]
[Of course, the Great Saint did not directly fall, but relied on his powerful origin to restore his physical body. However, he still suffered heavy injuries and was frightened as he looked at you.]
[Not only this Great Saint, but the other Great Saints and watching cultivator were also shocked beyond belief. They never expected that a Saint King would appear suddenly. And this Saint King even held a Supreme Artifact, which could exert such terrifying power. The seven-layered simultaneous attacks just now were equivalent to seven times the power of a Supreme Artifact, which was simply too over-the-top. This Secret Skill was something they had never seen before.]
[Immediately, the Ji family’s Great Saint and other cultivator were overjoyed, feeling that there was hope for their Ji family. Although the Ji family did not know why you wanted to help them, such a powerful helper greatly increased their chances of turning defeat into victory. At this point, the Ji family’s Great Saint was very grateful to you, repeatedly expressing his thanks.]
[The faces of the other three Great Saints, on the other hand, were very bad. They questioned why you attacked them unprovoked.]
[In response, you said it was a pity, the Innate Saints were hard to come by, and it would be a shame if they died like this. Also, you expressed your disdain for their actions of a few against many, even trying to strangle a baby.]
[Seeing your mockery, the three Great Saints looked angry. Two of them launched attacks against you without hesitation. The last one continued to hold their ground against the Ji family. Upon seeing this, you were fearless and battled with them.]
[Though facing two opponents, even now you were still under a lot of pressure. After all, although you could wield the power of a Great Saint with the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, you still had the effects of Purple Talent: Endless Blade and multi-performance. However, these two talents were not particularly stable, and their activation depended on luck.]
[Because of this, you were still under pressure. However, you were fearless. After all, your surprise attack had already severely injured one of the Great Saints. If you find the right opportunity to kill one of them, the remaining one would be no problem.]

chapters.title: Chapter 705: Chapter 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: Chapter 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _4
[Next, you seized the opportunity and directly used the Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skills ability, consuming 100 years of your lifespan and a cooldown time of ten years, to nullify the already severely injured Great Saint’s divine skills. Then, you fully exerted the power of the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear to deliver a thunderous blow.]
[This blow, although you only triggered a two-fold effect, dividing the attack into two parts, and did not trigger Purple Talent: Endless Blade’s critical strike effect, you ultimately killed the already heavily injured Great Saint in a powerful blow.]
[Even though this result led to you being attacked by another Great Saint, the intensity of this attack was enough to kill you once. But relying on the effect of Purple Talent·Death Puppet, you found a scapegoat to transfer damage, so you didn’t really die.]
[Seeing that you killed a Great Saint and remained unscathed after taking his full force attack, the other Great Saint ancestor was frightened. Then, he also recalled the secret skill you used to nullify the divine skill of the Great Saint you killed, and it made him even more fearful.]
[Not only was this Great Saint frightened, but the third Great Saint who was fighting and the Ji family Saint King, as well as the Saint King Realm Powerhouses who could see some details, were also shocked or horrified by your means. Ordinary cultivators were simply at a loss for words.]
[After all, a Saint King killing a Great Saint is too terrifying. Even though you are not an ordinary Saint King and possess a Supreme Artifact, killing a Great Saint while facing two enemies and remaining unscathed is excessively extraordinary.]
[You did not pay attention to the reactions of these people, seized the opportunity, and continued to kill the remaining living Great Saint, intending to completely slaughter him. A Great Saint’s body is full of treasure. If you kill him, your gains will be substantial.]
[Facing your attack, this Great Saint felt chills and thought he was in trouble. So, he said it was all a misunderstanding and that things could be discussed peacefully. If you were merely standing up for the Ji family, he would give up attacking them and compensate the Ji family.]
[Regarding the Great Saint’s submission, you turned a deaf ear and continued to fight him, hoping to simultaneously trigger the Nine-fold Symphony and the critical strike effect of the Purple Talent·Endless Blade to achieve a shocking instant kill of the Great Saint. Although, both the Great Saint you killed previously and this one were ordinary Great Saints, killing a Great Saint in an instant is still shocking enough.]
[Unfortunately, you did not get the chance to continue triggering effects, and the Great Saint directly fled after seeing that you were not receptive. When a Great Saint runs away, you cannot catch up.]
[After all, even though you possess the power to contend with Great Saints with the Supreme Artifact: Black Abyss Demon Spear, your speed falls short by a considerable margin. It’s fine during a fierce battle, but chasing would certainly be impossible unless your mastery of Space Law continues to improve, allowing you to compete with the escape speed of a Great Saint with your cultivation as a Saint King.]
[Next, you planned to kill the Great Saint who was fighting the Ji family. Seeing this, the Great Saint felt chills and directly ran away. He made up his mind to move his clan and leave the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star as soon as possible. With you around, staying would make it easier for his clan to be annihilated.]
[The other cultivators saw the two Great Saints being chased away by you, and they were all in awe, feeling that they had broadened their horizons today. A single Saint King, killing one Great Saint and chasing away two others, was unprecedented in the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star.]
[Seeing that all these old monsters had run away, you were speechless and too lazy to continue chasing.]
…
“Good guy, a born Saint, truly outrageous. Besides, it’s really like my estimation of my own strength, that I can match a Great Saint. With my talents, killing ordinary Great Saints is quite easy, not bad at all.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, first exclaiming, then immediately becoming very satisfied with his own performance.
As always, speculation is just speculation, nothing more than delusion, and it’s easy to have significant deviations. Only real combat performance can make people feel more at ease and have a more accurate judgment of their own strength.
“Next, it’s time to take a disciple.”
Wang Ping thought to himself, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, just as you were preparing to chat with the Ji family and liaise with them, intending to choose a Saint infant as your disciple, a sudden change occurred. A cold, familiar voice echoed in your ears that made your scalp tingle.]
[This voice was none other than the voice of the Bone Emperor you had once heard. The White Bone Emperor said that he did not expect to witness such a good performance before taking away the Saint infant, and expressed his interest in having you become his servant.]
[As this voice sounded, the entire Primordial Spirit Ancient Star darkened, and a terrifying coldness enveloped the entire ancient star, causing countless cultivators to shiver from the depths of their hearts, their terror reaching an extreme.]
[Even the two escaped Great Saints and the Ji family’s Great Saint felt their scalps tingling and looked fearfully towards the starry sky. Then, they all saw the scene of the Bone Creatures carrying the coffin.]
[Although they did not know who was in the coffin, they could guess that it must be a terrifyingly powerful figure. After all, even the Bone Creatures carrying the coffin gave them a suffocating feeling. In other words, not to mention who was in the coffin, even the Bone Creatures carrying it were at least half-step Supreme level entities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 706 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 706 205: The Innate Saint! Kill the Great Saint! _5
[For a moment, everyone in the venue, including the Great Saints, could only smile bitterly. They never imagined that a naturally born Saint infant could attract so many powerful beings. Not only did you have the ability to kill a Great Saint with a supreme artifact, but also there appeared a terrifying existence that can even protect the Bone Creatures carrying the coffin, who are half-step Supreme.]
[Now, if not handled properly, this could result in a catastrophic extinction. Such a terrifying existence could easily wipe out an Ancient Star with just a casual wave of the hand, not considering it a big deal.]
[In contrast to the fear and turmoil of other cultivators in the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star, you truly feel helpless. You can understand the Bone Emperor’s intention in his words. Clearly, he had been watching everything before you took action. You never expected that the Bone Emperor would arrive here before you.]
[No, it should not be said like that. You recall the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body’s evaluation of the Bone Emperor and his reputation. It is rumored that wherever he goes, amazing opportunities or monsters emerge. Apparently, he possesses some kind of secret skill.]
[In other words, he knew about the birth of the natural Saint in advance, so he waited here. Perhaps his location was not so accurate, and he had also searched for it, but it was inevitable that he would come here before you.]
[Now, there is real trouble. With the Bone Emperor here, it is impossible for you to take the Innate Saint infant, and even your own life may be lost here.]
[After all, although the Golden Talent: Transmission is very useful and can also teach people, its introduction is also clear. Even a Supreme cannot stop the transmission. But, that’s only against a Supreme. In the face of the Quasi-Emperor, whether the Golden Talent: Transmission will work is a big problem. Most likely, it will probably be intercepted.]
[Golden Talent, after all, belongs to the domain of great talents in the Saint Realm. Some special types can exceed the grade of gold, but ultimately cannot reach the height of the Seven-Color Talent.]
[However, although many ideas flashed through your mind, you didn’t give up on the idea of trying your best to see if you could escape. As for the Innate Saint infant, you know very well that you cannot accept him as a disciple this time. In fact, you can’t even take the Innate Saint Infant away safely as a disciple until you’ve figured out how to deal with the big trouble of the Bone Emperor.]
[Of course, although you feel it’s a pity, you don’t care too much about it. Although you can only think of ways to escape from the Bone Emperor now, and it’s not even certain that you can escape, you believe that when you grow up, you will be able to come to the Profound Universe and snatch the Innate Saint infant before the Bone Emperor.]
[It’s even possible to blow up the troublesome Bone Emperor. You have great confidence in your growth rate.]
[With these thoughts flashing through your mind, you immediately use the Golden Talent: Transmission. However, this time’s transmission obviously did not achieve a miraculous effect. With the astonishing space fluctuation, the Bone Emperor noticed it directly. He sneered, and the Emperor’s Might burst out. The Tao Pattern emerged and directly blocked the space, preventing your transmission.]
[After stopping your transmission, the Bone Emperor’s gloomy voice rang out, remarking that you did have quite a few tricks, including such a stunning space artifact that even Supremacy couldn’t stop you from escaping. Unfortunately, you met him.]
[Listening to the Bone Emperor’s words, you really feel helpless. However, you anticipated this result, so you are not surprised.]
…
“Damn, I inadvertently set another flag again.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation content and was speechless.
“But the Bone Emperor, really clings on like a ghost. I escaped his clutches once, and I didn’t expect to end up in his hands in the end.”
Immediately, Wang Ping pressed his brow and continued to stare at the luminescent screen with a sneer.
[Just as you give up and decide to end this simulation actively, to prevent yourself from ending up being refined, an unexpected change occurs again. ]
[That is, another Quasi-Emperor’s aura appears and ruthlessly attacks the Bone Emperor. The Bone Emperor is enraged. The forces of two quasi-emperors collide. ]
[Quasi-Emperor collision, how terrifying. Beneath the aftermath, the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star is directly blown up. Although the two quasi-emperors protected the Innate Infant tacitly, you are not covered within their protection range.]
[Although you possess the Incomplete Version of Space-Time Body and seem to have many secrets, the importance of you is clearly much lower than that of the Innate Saint in the eyes of the two quasi-emperors. They do not want to divert any strength to “protect you” in this battle, in case the opponent finds an opportunity.]
[As a result, you are blown up along with the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star and fall on the spot. However, due to the Rebirth tally, you enter a resurrection countdown state.]

chapters.title: Chapter 707: 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Chapter 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!
[An hour later, you were resurrected only to find that the two quasi-emperors and the innate saint had all disappeared. The remaining energy in the area was terrifyingly strong, and you were nearly killed by it as soon as you revived.]
[However, upon resurrection, you thought of using the Golden Talent: Transmission. As a result, you successfully escaped this Land of Death through teleportation.]
…..
“This event has truly taken many twists and turns, I actually survived, what a surprise.”
Wang Ping saw this simulation content, raised his eyebrows, quite surprised.
He had deduced from the previous simulation content that the simulated Wang Ping was doomed to die, only for him to survive.
It seems that he can’t be too hasty in the future, he must wait for the simulated Wang Ping to die naturally and end the simulation.
Otherwise, if he arbitrarily determines that he has reached a desperate situation and cannot possibly survive, and voluntarily ends the simulation, he might waste the valuable simulation times.
[After you teleported, you arrived at a place full of chirping birds and fragrant flowers. Then, you were shocked to discover that the location you teleported to, actually had a stalk of Divine Medicine.]
[Furthermore, this Divine Medicine is the incredibly precious Enlightenment Holy Elixir, containing Space Law, enabling one to enter a wonderful state of cultivation, which is extremely valuable, a Divine Medicine dreamed of by many cultivators.]
[You really didn’t expect such good fortune, to be teleported not far from a Divine Medicine. This truly illustrates the saying, ‘Surviving a great disaster will bring great fortune’.]
[Consequently, you wished to pluck the Divine Medicine without any hesitation. However, the Divine Medicine, being sentient, chose to flee. You, naturally, wouldn’t let it escape, so you used Space Divine Skills to seal it, then directly plucked it.]
[After plucking it, you safely stored it and planned to ingest the Divine Medicine and cultivate, after healing your injuries.]
…
“Ah, another unexpected development. I feel like my luck is getting better and better, but I don’t know if it’s just an illusion.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a peculiar gaze.
After continuously getting golden results, he directly received a Seven-Color Talent.
Under the Seven-Color Talent simulation, Wang Ping had several narrow escapes. He also found an Innate Saint, and now he obtained the Divine Medicine that he needed for Enlightenment.
“If it weren’t for the earlier simulations where I died horribly, I would have doubted whether I had become a person of great fortune or had drawn a Golden Talent of fortune at some point.”
This thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind and he murmured to himself.
[Three years later, after successfully healing the injuries caused by the residual energy from your resurrection, you began to ingest the Divine Medicine and commenced your cultivation.]
[In the blink of an eye, three years had passed. During these three years, you entered a wonderful state of Enlightenment. Eventually, you successfully grasped 50% of the Space Law.]
[In the blink of an eye, another three years passed, and with the residual effects of the Divine Medicine, you successfully grasped 60% of the Space Law. Now, your attainment in Laws has surpassed most of the Saint Kings. After all, 70% is the Domain of the Great Saint. 60% is already considered the peak for those Saint Kings who have not yet attempted to become Great Saints.]
[Satisfied with the harvest from this cultivation, you began considering leaving this place.]
[Because this place was extremely safe, you started healing and cultivating after setting up the Great Array, without caring about where exactly this place was, situated on that Ancient Star.]
[Now that your strength has greatly increased, it’s time to leave this place and continue looking for talents to take on as your disciples.]
[Next, you cautiously left this place. However, the moment you stepped out of this place filled with bird songs and fragrant flowers, the view outside changed dramatically into a graveyard, with thick Yin energy and evil entities springing out to attack you.]
[Although, this level of Yin energy and evil entities are nothing to you, you still became serious. After all, the sudden change in environment implies that there is a big secret in this region.]
[You were considering whether you should retreat back into the safe region, or directly flee using the cooled down Golden Talent: Transmission.]
[However, you eventually dismissed both ideas. After all, you will have to leave the safe region sooner or later, it’s impossible to stay there forever. As for fleeing using Golden Talent: Transmission, although it seems like a good idea, the talent should be used for protection.]
[Moreover, you have no idea where you will teleport to next time, it’s full of uncertainty.]
[Therefore, you plan to leave this region using your own strength. You then carefully sensed the fluctuations in space, trying to teleport directly out.]
[However, you discovered that you failed, you couldn’t tear space here. This is undoubtedly a very surprising thing.]
[After all, you have already reached the peak of the Holy King’s 6th tier, in addition to comprehending 60% of the Space Law, there are few places that can stop you.]
[As a result, you grew more suspicious of this place and became even more vigilant, ready to flee at any time using the Golden Talent: Transmission.]
[You walked around this strange graveyard for a day but found that you weren’t able to get out. Meanwhile, the sense of danger in your heart grew stronger.]

chapters.title: Chapter 708: 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Chapter 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_2
[An hour later, you witness a scene that makes your scalp tingle. You see a blood-yellow river filled with countless dry bones. The bones still carry powerful mana and even the Tao rhyme, giving you a feeling of immense strength.]
[However, even such strong characters have turned into dry bones in this mysterious river. It’s truly bizarre.]
[In the midst of your fear, you immediately use your Golden Talent: Transmission without hesitation. However, to your horror, the Golden Talent: Transmission doesn’t work.]
[Your face turns pale, and this place is even more dangerous than you thought. You try to turn back and stay away from the mysterious and dangerous river. But there’s a voice luring you into the river and, before you know it, you find yourself walking towards it slowly.]
[When you step into the river, your flesh that touched the water rots away instantly and turns to nothing. As your entire body sinks into the water, you become another skeleton unnoticed and fall to your demise.]
…..
At this point, the text simulation stopped, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with images and insights.
Finally, with his consciousness shifting, he appeared above the blood-yellow river.
“What kind of river is this? It’s terrifying.”
Wang Ping stared at the blood-yellow river, his eyelids jumping.
Even from his current godlike perspective, the intense palpitations still affected him.
“If I accidentally come to this mysterious place in the future, I must never venture too deep not to mention getting close to this mysterious river. Otherwise, even if I am a supreme being, death has still a chance to find me.”
Wang Ping warned himself in his mind.
Although crises often come with opportunities, this particular opportunity would be better left untouched.
Of course, if he could accidentally learn more about this place via the simulation, that would be another story.
Relying on simulations, Wang Ping will get ahold of the opportunities within.
Soon after, his consciousness shifted again, and he returned to the real world.
The system’s voice rang out right away.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Saint King 6th tier Peak Cultivation.
②. Life-bound Weapon – Illusory Space Sword (Saint King tier).
③. Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger.
④. Purple Talent: Enhanced Counterstrike Armor.
⑤. A random Divine Medicine.”
…..
“System, I choose ①. Saint King 6th tier Peak Cultivation and ③. Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger.”
Wang Ping made his choice after looking at the reward list.
After all, the Seven-Colored Talent: Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger has its drawbacks.
That is, no matter whether he recruited disciples in reality or simulation, he would only get cultivation rewards once from the same disciple.
In other words, his choice of cultivation rewards was locked-down.
It meant that he would need to earn more resources in the future, working hard with both joy and pain.
Regardless of whether he had the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger, he would have to work hard to ‘make money.+’
As Wang Ping claimed his rewards, his mind filled with the info on Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger, and his cultivation soared rapidly.
Half-Step Saint King!
Saint King 1st tier!
Saint King 4th tier!
Saint King 5th tier!
Finally, it stopped at the Peak of the Holy King’s 6th tier!
At this moment, Wang Ping, feeling the power within his body, nodded in satisfaction.
Now, he was much stronger than before.
As his cultivation increased, so did his understanding of mana.
With his current configuration, even without using his talents, he had few rivals within the realm of Saint Kings using only the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body and Emperor’s Mystic Skills.
Of course, if his opponents were also talented descendants of imperial-tier forces, it would be different, and it would still be difficult for him to defeat them.
However, these people were, after all, the minority, with the majority only found on the Immortal Continent and usually consisted of Emperor’s son-tier characters.
…..
“System, how much would it cost for a Paid Simulation next time?”
After Wang Ping calmed down, he asked the system in his heart.
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Saint King 6th tier Peak, the cost for a Paid Simulation is 50,000 jin of top-tier Divine Origin.”
The system’s voice rang.
The amount made Wang Ping gasp.
“50,000 jin of top-tier Divine Origin… you might as well rob.”
Wang Ping’s face twitched slightly, despite being prepared, the amount was still too large.
After all, during his trip to Yu Zhengtao’s world, he barely collected 1,500 jin of top-tier Divine Origin, and with Xu Yi’s doubling, it totaled 3,000 jin.
However, now a single simulation required 50,000 jin of top-tier Divine Origin, which stretched Wang Ping’s limits.
He had no choice but to accept his poor fate.
Though the resources he possessed were ample for other Saint Kings, it hardly made a difference for Wang Ping, who owned the resource-guzzling Life Simulator.
“Next, I need to figure out how to earn top-tier Divine Origin. If only Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth could work some magic and conjure an enormous top-tier Divine Origin mine.”
Wang Ping wished for an easy resource gathering solution, hoping there wouldn’t be any powerful forces in the way to cause complications.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Chapter 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_3
Wang Ping stroked his chin, thinking quietly.
If the Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth had its own consciousness, it probably would have been speechless in response to Wang Ping’s thoughts.
After all, it’s just a purple talent; it doesn’t have that much ability.
…..
“Right, I wonder if recruiting other group members as disciples will also grant me cultivation rewards.”
At this moment, Wang Ping suddenly thought of this, and his eyes lit up.
If he could get rewards from recruiting people in the group as disciples, that would be awesome; his cultivation could be improved even further.
Immediately, Wang Ping opened the chat group and started a private chat with Cai Yonglong, intending to give it a try first.
Wang Ping (66): “Old Cai, why don’t you become my apprentice, and remember to be sincere about it.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Uh, Mr. Wang, what are you playing at? o((⊙﹏⊙))o”
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t ask too many questions, just do it.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Uh, I’ll give it a try… Mr. Wang, I want to be your apprentice!”
Wang Ping (66): “…….”
Cai Yonglong (1): “……..”
Wang Ping felt a bit of a headache, as the whole thing seemed not at all solemn; instead, it felt awkward.
More importantly, his cultivation hadn’t changed at all.
What’s going on?
Is it because Cai Yonglong didn’t sincerely wish to become an apprentice, or are chat group members not included in the service range of the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger?
Or is it that Cai Yonglong doesn’t meet the requirements?
Okay, if there was no chat group, Cai Yonglong’s talent alone would just barely put him at the King Realm level, which is rather weak.
As for luck, do these transmigrators really have any great luck?
After all, without him, many group members would have died countless times already.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Master, is it okay now?”
Wang Ping (66): “Forget about it, I don’t need you as my apprentice, just keep calling me Mr. Wang.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Cai Yonglong (1): “Uh…..”
Next, Wang Ping tried to find other people.
Then he found that neither Lin Yuanyuan nor Chen Yao would work.
This left Wang Ping feeling quite depressed, as he couldn’t figure out what was going on.
“Alpha, are group members special and not included in the scope of the Seven-Colored Talent’s abilities?”
Whenever Wang Ping didn’t know what to do, he turned to Alpha. He let out a sigh and said in his heart.
Alpha: “…..I don’t know what your refreshed talent ability is about either. After all, I’m not an omniscient and omnipotent existence.”
“Nonsense, if you were omniscient and omnipotent, you wouldn’t have ended up in your current state.”
Wang Ping felt disappointed and couldn’t help but roll his eyes and grumble.
Alpha: “……”
This kid Wang Ping seemed to be getting more and more arrogant, constantly talking back to it.
“Speaking of which, Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian should have good qualifications; one has a Sacred Body and the other a Golden Immortal Achievement. Perhaps they can trigger my Seven-Color Talent.”
After pondering for a moment, Wang Ping started private chats with Qin Tian and Ye Xiaofan.
Then, Wang Ping found that his cultivation remained unchanged.
“It should be enough to have the talents of both of them, so it seems like there’s some other reason. The path of recruiting group members seems to be blocked for now. It seems I can only continue to take the old path. Then, I hope to be able to preach to countless realms in the future>>:: “All who practice my Dao will become my disciples.”
Wang Ping shook his head, thinking to himself secretly.
Of course, he doesn’t know where the limit to the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger lies.
After all, the golden talent corresponds to the Saint Realm, and the seven-colored talent corresponds to the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification. There must be a limit.
“However, the Seven-Colored Talent is just the current upper limit of the Life Simulator. If it undergoes another optimization, I’m sure I can refresh for a higher level talent. Unfortunately, Rule Stones can only be found in the Sanctuary. That place is too chaotic, so it’s best for me to wait until I reach my current limit before going there.”
Wang Ping took a breath, and after thinking through these issues, he reined in his thoughts.
In the real world, when faced with uncertain situations, caution should be the main priority, as being stubborn can lead to death.
…..
“Next, I’ll try a free simulation to see if I can get enough top-tier Divine Origin from somewhere. By the way, I must not casually recruit disciples in the simulation; if I accidentally increase my cultivation by recruiting disciples but can’t get the rewards out and back into the real world, that would be a huge loss.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, warning himself.
Regarding where to get large amounts of divine origin, Wang Ping had some ideas.
After all, from his previous simulations, he already knew where the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord lie.
As long as he doesn’t lose the Supreme Artifact, the Black Abyss Demon Spear, on his way there, he would have a high chance of obtaining the inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.
With the inheritance of a Top Supreme, there must be plenty of divine origin.
Moreover, the divine origin was probably the most basic thing, and there must be more valuable things in the inheritance as well.
“System, I want to run a free simulation.”
Upon thinking of this, Wang Ping said in his heart, wanting to find out the possible dangers of going to the land of inheritance of the Black Abyss Demon Lord this time.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation initiated.”
As the system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping felt his consciousness blur, entering the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[On the first day, you decided to take action and left the Elemental Star directly, heading to the outer domain. But to your surprise, something unexpected happened.]

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Chapter 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_4
[When you left the Elemental Star, that terrifying Supreme noticed you. After all, it hasn’t been long since you killed Slaughter Saint, and he hasn’t completely closed off. As a result, he could sense your breath leaving the Elemental Star.]
[After discovering you, he showed a surprised expression. After all, your cultivation had reached the level of Saint King Realm 6th tier Peak. In such a short period of time, your cultivation had undergone such a tremendous improvement, even he as a Supreme was shocked.]
[Then, he became curious about you, thinking there was a big secret on you, and planned to capture you alive and perform soul-searching.]
[In an instant, the terrifying Supreme’s aura erupted, pressing down on you. As a result, your face changed greatly, completely not expecting the Primordial Thunder Supreme would suddenly attack you.]
[However, your reaction was also not slow, knowing that you can’t fight him head-on, you unhesitantly chose to use the Golden Talent: Transmission to leave the place. When you left using Transmission, Primordial Thunder Supreme was astonished.]
[At the same time, you were teleported to an unknown place. Fortunately, this time you were not teleported to a Small Universe but remained in the vast starry sky of the Big Universe.]
[Moreover, you were surprised to find that the location of this teleportation actually saved you a lot of travel time. You came directly to the starry sky not far from the location of the Black Abyss Demon Lord Inheritance.]
[Seeing this, you were very excited, spent a year traveling, and after arriving at the Ancient Star where the inheritance was located, you took out the Black Abyss Demon Spear. When the Black Abyss Demon Spear appeared, the space rippled and the Secret Realm Entrance appeared in front of you.]
[This time, there were no particularly significant fluctuations that attracted the attention of cultivators on this ancient star. It was simply the opening of an entrance that pulled you in.]
[Then, you saw the scene in the secret realm. The space in the secret realm was not large, which surprised you. After all, a King Realm Master could create a relatively larger small world in the lower realm, let alone a Supreme. If a Supreme wanted to, they could create a secret realm the size of an Ancient Star with a wave of their hand.]
[It was while you were amazed that a figure appeared before you. It was the residual thoughts of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.]
[With the emergence of this residual thought, the Black Abyss Demon Spear flew over and fell into the hands of the residual thought.]
[Seeing this, you hurriedly performed a junior’s salutation. The Black Abyss Demon Lord’s residual thought held the Black Abyss Demon Spear and sighed with a complicated mood.]
[Then, he looked at you and said that you were indeed extraordinary for being able to obtain the Black Abyss Demon Spear from Master Qingzhu’s seal, and you had many secrets on you.]
[Hearing the words of the Black Abyss Demon Lord, you were suddenly alert, knowing that his residual thoughts knew many things through the Black Abyss Demon Spear. For a moment, you even worried that he would possess your body. After all, this has actually happened before.]
[Seeing that you were on guard, the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s residual thought shook his head and smiled, saying that if he still had some residual soul, he would definitely choose to possess you. However, now he was just residual thought, and would soon disappear, without the ability to possess.]
[Upon hearing this, your heart was slightly relieved. However, you were not careless and prepared yourself for any resistance and escape.]
[Seeing that you didn’t believe him, the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s residual thought didn’t say much, directly giving you a World Ring, saying it contained what you wanted.]
[Your eyes brightened, and you took it, checking on the contents. Then, you showed a surprised expression. There were so many good things inside. All kinds of Sacred and Demonic Artifacts, elixirs, treasures, ores, and Secret Skills.]
[In addition, there were even more divine sources than you had imagined, which you cared about the most. There were no Lower-tier God’s Sources in the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s World Ring. The lowest was the mid-tier, and their numbers were not many. The most abundant were top-tier Divine Origin and Extreme-tier Divine Source.]
[The top-tier Divine Origin amounted to 20 million pounds, while the Extreme-tier Divine Source astonishingly reached 500,000 pounds. The number of these made your tongue click in amazement and you called out that you were rich.]
…
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the text simulation and was completely stunned.
Although he knew that the Black Abyss Demon Lord, as a top Supreme, must have a thick base, this was too thick even for him.
Twenty million pounds of top-tier divine origin, 500,000 pounds of extreme-tier divine source, that’s enough for him to simulate so many times.
Even if his cultivation increases a bit, it can withstand this consumption.
If he is lucky enough to give Xu Yi a double increase, then the divine source will be enough for him to simulate until he reaches the Supreme Realm.
“However, this is just wishful thinking. Xu Yi’s golden finger is actually similar to my initial Red Talent: Unstable Evolver. The higher the grade, the harder it is to trigger, and the lower the multiplier. Although his golden finger has been optimized once, it’s still impossible to easily trigger a doubling.”
Soon, Wang Ping calmed down again, thinking that he was being too imaginative.
“After all, top-tier divine source can only be used at the Saint Realm level, and extreme-tier divine source is probably used at the 3rd-tier Realms of Dao Verification level. Unless Xu Yi’s golden finger is optimized again, it’s too low a probability to trigger a doubling and high multiple.”
“Unfortunately, upgrading it again requires 100 million group points, and I’m not willing to spend so many group points on optimizing it. Unless I’m really lacking in resources, otherwise it’s a waste of group points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 711: 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: Chapter 206: Great Increase in Strength! Dripping with Wealth!_5
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
These supremes were so rich that if he ever needed resources for simulations in the future, he could easily plunder some from opposing supremes or forces. Acquiring resources for paid simulations shouldn’t be too difficult.
As for the future, who could say for sure? It was not yet time for Wang Ping to optimize the Golden Finger for Xu Yi.
Next, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After you finish tallying up your gains, you express your gratitude to the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord again, vowing to do your best to kill the Green Bamboo Emperor and avenge him.]
[In response, the Black Abyss Demon Lord waves his hand, saying you don’t need to play this game in front of him, as your little tricks can’t deceive him.]
[Hearing this, you feel a bit embarrassed and don’t say anything more. Then, the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord mockingly claim that he no longer bears any resentment towards the Green Bamboo Emperor. They had a fair duel, and he lost. At first, he was stubborn and ultimately perished. It wasn’t until he was about to fall and there was no turning back that he came to understand the truth, which is quite ridiculous.]
