[Afterward, the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord ask you to leave and not disturb his slumber. Seeing this, you don’t say anything further, bowing to the Black Abyss Demon Lord and attempting to leave with the Black Abyss Demon Spear.]
[At this point, the Black Abyss Demon Lord says you rely too much on the Black Abyss Demon Spear, which is detrimental to your growth, so it’s best to leave it behind.]
[Hearing this, you feel bitter in your heart, knowing that the Black Abyss Demon Spear is ultimately the remnants of the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s thoughts, and he wants it to stay at his resting place.]
[As a result, you don’t say anything more, nodding in agreement and choosing to leave. For you now, the Black Abyss Demon Spear is of little use. As long as you progress a bit further, reach the half-step Great Saint cultivation, and increase your understanding of mana, you can have the confidence to rival the Great Saints with your own power alone.]
[On top of that, you continue to nurture your life-bound weapon, which is about to transform into a Great Saint artifact. Your own life-bound weapon, when used, is not much weaker than others’ supreme artifacts.]
[Just as you are about to leave, the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord call out to you, stating that the Elemental Sacred Stone in your storage world is an extremely precious Tool Refining Material that can transform your life-bound weapon into an improved version.]
[If you can obtain more Elemental Sacred Stones, your life-bound weapon can potentially grow into a Supreme Artifact. If you can obtain the extremely rare Elemental Saint Crystal found within Elemental Sacred Stones, your life-bound weapon can potentially become an Emperor’s artifact.]
[Hearing this, you’re quite surprised, not expecting the Elemental Sacred Stones to have such effects. At the same time, you become interested in Elemental Saint Crystals, recalling the scene you saw in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[Over there, there were numerous Elemental Sacred Stones, and even suspecting that you had misjudged the situation, you believe that the structures and Great Arrays sealing the Terrifying Heart may contain Elemental Saint Crystals.]
[At the thought of this, your eyes fill with desire. If you could obtain Elemental Saint Crystals, it would be fantastic, whether for refining your life-bound weapon or for selling.]
[However, you calm down. The place is not the central area, and even with Elemental Sacred Stones, Elemental Saint Crystals, and Terrifying Hearts, you can’t imagine what’s at the deepest part of the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[The Elemental Forbidden Land is far too dangerous, and even now, you would undoubtedly die if you went there.]
[Then, you curiously ask the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord if they know the secrets of the Elemental Forbidden Land. In response, the remnants shake their head, implying it is a place where even Quasi-Emperors dare not enter. Do you think he would have entered such a dangerous place when he was alive?]
[After saying this, the remnant thoughts of Black Abyss Demon Lord express great interest in where your Elemental Sacred Stone came from. Did it come from the Elemental Forbidden Land, by any chance?]
[Your eyes flicker as you think things over. Eventually, you don’t hide it, stating that you indeed visited the Elemental Forbidden Land. You were lucky and obtained an Elemental Sacred Stone before barely managing to escape.]
[Hearing this, the remnant thoughts of the Black Abyss Demon Lord marvel at your incredible luck. After all, even Supremes and Quasi-Emperors do not dare to enter the place where death is certain, but you were able to walk out unscathed. Your luck is truly terrifying.]
[Then, the remnant thoughts of the Black Abyss Demon Lord say that they originally didn’t think highly of your chances of becoming an Emperor and killing the Green Bamboo Emperor. However, looking at it now, there might be some hope. The remnants then hope that after you prove your Emperorship, you will beat up the Green Bamboo Emperor or his direct descendants.]
[Upon hearing this, you roll your eyes. Didn’t the Black Abyss Demon Lord say that he had already understood his situation and reached enlightenment? Hasn’t he completely understood it yet?]
[However, it must be said that the impression the Black Abyss Demon Lord leaves on you is much better than what you imagined. After all, you always thought he was extremely cold, arrogant, and murderous.]
[Of course, perhaps he was indeed like that when he was alive, since he followed the Demon Path and his Black Abyss Demon Spear emanated incredibly terrifying evil energy. He just changed a lot later on.]
[Next, you promise to do your best, and then you leave the secret realm.]
[After leaving the secret realm, you head to the starry sky, find a place, set up the Great Array, and start refining the Elemental Sacred Stone, aiming to make it into a Great Saint Artifact.]
[Several years later, you successfully refine your life-bound weapon and Elemental Sacred Stone, transforming it into a Great Saint Artifact and invoking the Heavenly Tribulation Artifact.]

chapters.title: Chapter 712: 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan.
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Chapter 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan.
“[In the end, your Life-bound Weapon, Illusionary Void Sword, has successfully endured the Heavenly Tribulation and has become stronger, transforming into a genuine Great Saint Artifact. Because of this, you are very delighted.]
“[Next, after pondering, you returned to the Ancient Star of Black Abyss Devil Sovereign’s Heritage, the birthplace of the Black Abyss Demon Lord, planning to cultivate there and breakthrough to Great Saint King 7th-tier before heading to the Immortal Continent in order to join the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
“[However, you recalled your previous eagerness to join the Heavenly Sword Divine Land and the Tao Palace and could not help but worry if your high cultivation level would result in a rejection.]
“[Nevertheless, upon considering it, you realized that the Taiyi Imperial Palace is an imperial-tier force, they wouldn’t be like the desolate Tao Palace who doesn’t dare to casually accept Saints. After all, the emperors’ sons in the Taiyi Imperial Palace are all at the level of Saint Great Perfection, or even Saints King tier. Even if your cultivation level was higher, they would definitely accept you.]
“[Unless, your cultivation reaches the Supreme tier, then even the imperial-tier forces would hesitate, considering whether to let you join. Of course, there’s a higher possibility they would agree to let you join, but you would likely end up an honorary Guest Elder or someone similar.]
“[In the blink of an eye, you have secluded yourself on this ancient star for ten years, successfully breaking through to the level of Saint King Realm 7th tier by your own efforts, thus entering the Late Saint King Realm.]
“[Feeling your own strength, you are very satisfied. Then, you planned to leave this ancient star and head towards the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
“[It was when you were preparing to go to the Taiyi Imperial Palace that you unexpectedly ran into a child.]
“[To your astonishment, you realized the child had awakened the Black Abyss Demon Body. The Black Abyss Demon Body, the constitution possessed by the Abyssal Demon Lord himself. The past Black Abyss Demon Lord climbed to the top supreme ranks precisely due to this constitution. The Black Abyss Demon Body is a Demonic Body on par with the Sacred Body, extremely powerful.]
“[To this, you are very surprised and delighted. You didn’t expect to have such a pleasant surprise. Though you don’t dare to take this child as an apprentice during this free simulation, you can completely wait until the Paid Simulation to do so.]
“[In this way, you can joyfully increase your cultivation.]
“[However, as you are gleeful, you noticed a distinct hatred in the child’s eyes, obviously having a tragic past.]
“[About this, after considering a moment, you approached him and struck up a conversation.]
“[In the end, you learned the child’s name and his past. His name is Wan Yu, born into an ordinary poor family with a bleak background. Not long ago, his father was slain by villains and his mother was humiliated and committed suicide by jumping into a river. Hence, he wished to embark on the path of cultivation to gain great power and avenge his parents.]
“[Listening to his story, you sighed and offered to teach him the way of cultivation. Seeing this, Wan Yu was overjoyed and wished to become your apprentice.]
“[To this, you were startled and stated that you don’t take apprentices, not even in name. Seeing your refusal, Wan Yu was very disappointed and had no choice but to give up.]
“[Feeling that your cultivation level has not increased, you can’t help but breathe a sigh of relief. If by any chance you had fulfilled the conditions to take an apprentice by accident, you would have suffered a big loss.]
“[Next, after leaving some cultivation resources to Wan Yu, you left this Ancient Star to head towards the Central Ancient Star Domain’s Immortal Continent.]
…
“The Black Abyss Demon Body again, this is another powerful constitution. However, it’s ridiculous. The last time, during the simulation, I was looking everywhere for outstanding disciples. This time I met a good seedling, and when he begged to become my disciple, it scared me into refusing.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and couldn’t help but chuckle lightly.
It can only be said that the changes brought about by Seven-Color Talent were too significant. It increased the difference between Paid Simulation and Free Simulation, greatly influencing the direction of the plot.
“If the cultivation increase from taking an apprentice in the simulation wasn’t counted unless you chose the Cultivation Reward, this kind of situation and apprehension wouldn’t happen.”
Wang Ping shook his head and muttered.
However, nothing in this world is perfect. At least he couldn’t encounter perfection at the moment, so he could only sigh in response.
Following that, Wang Ping recollected his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“[After several years, you successfully arrived at the Immortal Continent and came to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. The Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace was astounded by your visit. He was extremely surprised when he found out you possessed the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body and 7th-Tier Saint King Realm cultivation.]
“[After all, a genius loose cultivator who reached the 7th tier of Saint King Realm in this Last Dharma Age is extremely rare. Seeing the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, a Supreme Realm Master, finally show a look of surprise, you are quite satisfied.]
“[The last time you came to the Taiyi Imperial Palace during the simulation, they didn’t have such a reaction, just slightly surprised. You feel gratified in your heart. It is quite enjoyable to impress a Supreme.]
“[In the end, you successfully joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and, like in the last simulation, performed a self-titling, preparing to wait for the arrival of the golden era.]
“[Time flies, and nearly ten thousand years have passed in the blink of an eye. The golden age has arrived, and you have been awakened. Like in the last simulation, you climbed the 10th Floor of the Taiyi Sky Road, becoming the 9th Imperial Child, and were apprenticed to a Supreme.]
“[The only difference is, this time, the master you paid tribute to is even stronger than the last, a Heaven Supreme. To this, you are still overjoyed. After all, the stronger the teacher, the higher the status, and the more benefits.]

chapters.title: Chapter 713: 207: The Tragic Wind Demon Supreme! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Chapter 207: The Tragic Wind Demon Supreme! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_2
[Next, you begin to think about dealing with your senior predecessor ransmigrator from the Second Generation Chat Group, the Wind Demon Supreme, that old undying one. In the last simulation, your cheap master was counter-killed by Wind Demon Supreme. Now that this master is even stronger, he should be able to handle the Wind Demon Supreme alone.]
[However, to be on the safe side, you ask your master to help deal with the Wind Demon Supreme, and you also hope that he can invite another Supreme to gang up on the Wind Demon Supreme. Of course, you naturally include the Thunderflame Supreme in the equation.]
[With the Three Great Supremes ganging up on the struggling Wind Demon Supreme, you think that should be more than enough face for your opponent. If the Wind Demon Supreme manages to escape even from this, you would genuinely have nothing to say and would temporarily give up on dealing with him.]
[Next, you head to the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star and the Thunderflame Valley with your master, winning over the Thunderflame Supreme with Ye Chen’s situation and getting him on your side.]
[Following that, the Three Great Supremes enter the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area together to gang up on the Wind Demon Supreme. In the end, even though Wind Demon Supreme had numerous hidden cards, you knew many of them, especially about his resurrection ability, which you naturally mentioned beforehand.]
[Ultimately, without you intervening, the Wind Demon Supreme was beaten to death with a suffocated face and had no chance to fight back, being blown up twice in a row.]
[Looking at the Wind Demon Supreme’s fall, you can’t help but breathe a sigh of relief. However, you are not careless and plead with your master to continue stalking him, not giving him the slightest chance to recover.]
[To this, the Three Great Supremes are speechless, not knowing why someone of your young age is so cautious and likes to stalk so much. However, considering that the Wind Demon Supreme had resurrected once before, they didn’t reject your proposal and chose to stay on guard.]
[A year goes by with no incidents, the Three Great Supremes conclude that Wind Demon Supreme is truly dead for good and decide to leave.]
[In the end, you return to the Immortal Continent with your master and another Supreme of Taiyi Emperor Palace. Before leaving, Thunderflame Supreme expresses that if you ever encounter any strong enemies in the future, you can contact him and he will assist you.]
[Clearly, Thunderflame Supreme has placed his bets on you, and if you rise to become the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace, his Thunderflame Valley will also benefit. Naturally, you are delighted about this.]
[Although you think that you will not grow up to be the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace in this simulation due to many unexpected deaths in your life simulations, you have already grown accustomed to them.]
[During this time, your luck has been good, but you still feel you have no great fortune, and compared to other monsters, you are more likely to die. In other words, you are more likely to encounter various life-and-death situations.]
…..
“Wind Demon Supreme, my good senior, has finally been killed off. I feel a little relieved. However, this self-criticism is really quite sharp.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation with a somewhat subtle gaze.
Indeed, he is more likely to encounter dead ends.
Perhaps, this is the fate of those with a life simulator type golden finger.
In all the novels of this type he has read, they have all been crazy deaths.
Alright, it’s a case of fantasy reflecting reality.
Wang Ping shakes his head and, after reining in his strange thoughts, continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After you return to Taiyi Emperor Palace, you plan to enter cultivation in seclusion. Cultivating and attaining Enlightenment in the Golden Age is much more manageable than in the Last Dharma Age, and you are confident that you can reach Great Perfection in the Saint King Realm in a relatively short time.]
[If you can go even further and comprehend 70% of the laws, you will have the foundation to impact the Great Saint Realm.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years pass. In just a hundred years, your cultivation has made a breakthrough, directly reaching the Saint King 8th tier. This makes you sigh inwardly at the speed of cultivation in the Golden Age, which is more than ten times faster than in the Last Dharma Age.]
[However, you are well aware that for someone like you with monstrous talent, it is relatively wasteful to spend time raising your cultivation through hard work. To enhance your cultivation quickly, you need to find opportunities.]
[If you can find a decent opportunity, you can easily improve several minor realms. At that time, just spend additional time stabilizing your foundation and settling down.]
[Throughout history, numerous Heaven’s Chosen Monsters have risen to the top by seizing opportunities, surpassing those they could only look up to in the past.]
[The competition between ordinary cultivators is intense, but even more so among talented monsters. They represent their respective powers, and being surpassed or defeated would cause their backing powers to lose face. At the same time, their own Tao Hearts would also be affected.]
[It is fair to say that the Heaven’s Chosen Monsters are not as depicted in novels, caring only about showing off, slapping faces, and drawing hatred. Instead, they cultivate even more diligently. This is why ordinary cultivators struggle to surpass them. With far lower talent and cultivation resources, how could they catch up when they work harder?]
[Only those useless leading characters with great fortune can surpass the successors of these major powers by continuously obtaining opportunities that shock the world.]
[After your cultivation breakthrough, you choose to leave seclusion. Next, instead of gradually raising your cultivation through focused cultivation, you plan to take advantage of your Emperor’s son status to obtain Divine Medicine or Elixirs from Taiyi Emperor Palace to aid your cultivation. In addition, you also want to use the Taiyi Emperor Tower in Taiyi Emperor Palace to help understand the laws.]

chapters.title: Chapter 714: 207: The Tragic Wind Demon Supreme! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Chapter 207: The Tragic Wind Demon Supreme! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_3
[Taiyi Emperor Tower is the life-bound Emperor’s artifact of the founder of Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Taiyi Great Emperor. Not only can it be used for offense and defense, but it is also a powerful tool for cultivation assistance.]
[In the Taiyi Emperor Tower, each floor has its own utility, which can help cultivators achieve Enlightenment. Naturally, this includes assisting in comprehending the mana laws. It can be said that the Taiyi Emperor Tower is the most iconic building in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. All disciples from the Mortal Realm up to Emperor’s sons and even Ancestor-tier characters at the Supreme Realm will enter for cultivation.]
[However, it’s not easy to enter the Taiyi Emperor Tower. One needs to pay with contribution points from the Taiyi Imperial Palace. The longer you cultivate, the more contribution points you have to pay.]
[As the 9th Imperial Child, you receive a generous amount of contribution points every year. So far, after a hundred years have passed, you have accumulated a lot of unused contribution points, which can allow you to enter the middle floor area for one year of Enlightenment.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year has passed. While you were cultivating in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body finally showed its due effect. Your cultivation efficiency far exceeded that of the other disciples.]
[In just one year, your understanding of mana laws has made significant progress. You are confident that if you spend another year in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, you can comprehend seventy percent of the Spatial Laws, and your Thunderfire skills will also advance to sixty percent.]
[You can’t help but feel that joining an Imperial-tier force is really awesome. Various tools to assist in cultivation are available at your disposal. If you were to cultivate outside, even with the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, you believe that achieving an understanding of seventy percent Spatial Laws would take at least several decades.]
[Now, the time has been shortened to just about a year. The increase in efficiency is simply terrifying.]
[Next, you start thinking about how to acquire more contribution points. Being the 9th Emperor’s Son, you do receive a lot of contribution points every year, but it’s still not enough to stay in the Taiyi Imperial Palace for a long time. So, you have to think of other ways to earn contribution points.]
[You come up with two methods to acquire contribution points. One is to take on tasks issued by the Taiyi Imperial Palace, just like the other disciples. Once you complete the tasks, you earn corresponding contribution points. The other method is to improve your ranking.]
[The position of the Emperor’s Sons is not fixed. If you can defeat the Emperor’s Sons ranked above you, you can replace them. The higher the ranking of the Emperor’s Son, the more contribution points you will receive every year.]
[For this reason, you make a choice: challenge the 7th Emperor’s Son first. Although with your current strength, even if you were to challenge the 14th Emperor’s Son, you would still have great confidence in your success. If you don’t limit the use of your innate talent, you think you would inevitably defeat him.]
[However, you don’t want to reveal all your cards, so you play it safe and gradually work your way up.]
[Shortly after, you challenge the 7th Emperor’s Son. Among Emperor’s Sons, if a lower-ranked son issues a challenge to an upper-ranked son, the latter may not refuse, unless he is in seclusion or away on an adventure. But if the junior son loses, he has to pay a price – a considerable amount of contribution points.]
[In the end, the 7th Emperor’s Son accepts your challenge, agreeing to fight. Under the watchful eyes of many Ancestor-tier characters within the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you fight the 7th Emperor’s Son, who possesses Saint King 3rd tier cultivation, defeating him with ease.]
[This frustrates the 7th Emperor’s Son, who didn’t expect you to be so powerful. However, he believes that he lost to you only because his cultivation is lower than yours. With that in mind, he plans to cultivate more diligently before challenging you again.]
[Many Ancestor-tier figures within the Taiyi Imperial Palace have strange looks in their eyes, thinking you are somewhat taking advantage of the situation. With your Saint King Realm 8th tier cultivation, fighting the 7th Emperor’s Son was just bullying. Although you conceal your cultivation level, displaying only that of the Saint King 4th tier, the fact that you are taking advantage is indisputable.]
[After becoming the 7th Emperor’s Son, you launch another challenge. This time, you skip the 6th Emperor’s Son, who has Saint King 5th tier cultivation and directly challenge the 5th Emperor’s Son.]
[This annoys the 6th Emperor’s Son, who thinks you are looking down on him. However, he doesn’t initiate a fight with you either. He just watches coldly, wanting to see what sort of talents you have to be so arrogant.]
[Soon, you face off against the 5th Emperor’s Son, whose cultivation has reached the Saint King 6th tier level. In response, you display the cultivation of the Saint King 7th tier, focusing on overpowering him with higher cultivation.]
[This battle is another easy victory for you. The difference in combat power brought on by having a level higher cultivation is simply enormous. This is even more evident between the Saint King 7th tier and the Saint King 6th tier, as there is a considerable gap between the latter stage and the middle stage.]
[Upon witnessing your 7th tier Saint King cultivation, the 6th Emperor’s Son stops talking. He silences himself, leaves the spectacle, and no longer thinks you are too arrogant. Instead, he considers you to be too low-profile.]
[With the Saint King 7th tier cultivation you displayed, the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, and your five-fold understanding of mana, you would have a great chance of victory against any Emperor’s Son, whether it’s him, the 5th Emperor’s Son, or even the 14th Emperor’s Son.]
[After defeating the 5th Holy Son, you don’t continue to challenge others. Of course, it’s not because you are afraid of the 4th Emperor’s Son. He has a lower cultivation level than you at the Saint King 7th tier. Although tricky to handle, it wouldn’t be too difficult for you to defeat him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 715: 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Chapter 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_4
[However, the 14th Emperor’s son isn’t in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, so you don’t have a chance to challenge him. As for the top three Emperor’s sons, even though the Third Prince is in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you don’t have any intention to fight him yet.]
[That’s because the top three Emperor’s sons are much stronger than those who follow. The Third Prince’s cultivation has reached the Saint King 9th tier level. Not only that, his Mana understanding is said to have reached 70%, and he possesses a powerful Sacred Body along with a Great Emperor Bloodline.]
[Under these circumstances, even with your Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Golden Talent: Multiplay, you might not be able to defeat him. After all, his cultivation is higher than yours, his Mana understanding is better, and he has an additional Great Emperor Bloodline. Even if you use Endless Blade and Multiplay together, you might not be able to make up for the gap in combat power brought about by these aspects.]
[Of course, battles aren’t solely about who looks stronger on paper—weapons, runes, combat experience, and Secret Skills all play a crucial role as well. However, this comparison still seems relatively straightforward. And you prefer not to take risks where your chances of success are low even after putting everything on the line.]
[Just as you plan to continue your seclusion for a while and then accumulate enough contribution points to enter the Taiyi Emperor Tower for Enlightenment, a letter arrives that surprises you.]
[It turns out to be a letter from Ji Bingyan. Ji Bingyan has returned to the Jee family and received their attention. An ancestor from her branch even helped her restore the Jee Family Great Emperor Bloodline, causing her physical constitution to change.]
[Ji Bingyan’s cultivation has now reached the Saint tier level. Although it’s just the beginning of the Saint tier and far below yours, it’s still powerful.]
[Her purpose in contacting you this time is to catch up with you and ask for a favor.]
[This comes as a surprise to you. After all, although you had a good relationship with Ji Bingyan during many simulative interactions, you haven’t met her in the real world since you ascended prematurely. Your relationship with Ji Bingyue is the better one. You didn’t expect that she would find you to reminisce, let alone ask for a favor.]
[However, after some thought, you think this might be related to Ji Bingyue’s memories.]
…
“Ji Bingyan has actually shown up?”
Wang Ping was shocked as he read the simulation content.
He had always thought that something had happened to Ji Bingyan after her ascension.
Now it seems she didn’t encounter any trouble and has even returned to the Ji family and is doing well.
However, Wang Ping was puzzled.
Considering how well Ji Bingyan was doing, why didn’t she help him in the previous simulations by having a powerful member of the Ji family fetch him to the Upper Realm?
What exactly happened?
Wang Ping didn’t think Ji Bingyan was an ungrateful person. If she were, she wouldn’t have risked her life to seal the Blood Demon Clan Emperor and Blood Fiend Quasi-Lord.
“I can ask her when we meet,” Wang Ping thought, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After some consideration, you agree to Ji Bingyan’s request for a meeting. Following the instructions in the letter, you come to Moonlight Immortal City.]
[Moonlight Immortal City was founded by a Quasi-Emperor. It’s a marketplace frequented by cultivators, where you can buy many useful items.]
[When you arrive in Moonlight Immortal City, you meet Ji Bingyan. After catching up with her, you ask her about Ji Bingyue’s soul.]
[Ji Bingyan softly explains that she chose the path of the Three Souls Coexistence. Although it has risks, cultivating together triples their efficiency. After explaining this, she lets Ji Bingyue’s soul take over.]
[Soon, Ji Bingyan’s facial expression changes, and you know that Ji Bingyue’s soul has taken control and assumed control of the body. After reminiscing about the past with Ji Bingyue, you begin to ask her some questions.]
[You inquire, for instance, what happened to Ji Bingyue after she ascended. Ji Bingyue is quite surprised by your questions, not expecting you to ask about these matters.]
[However, she doesn’t hide her thoughts from you. She says she was received by a Jee Family Secret Skill when she ascended, which led her to the Jee family on the Immortal Continent.]
[After arriving at the Jee family, she was first met by an ancestor who used the Jee Family Secret Skill to stabilize her soul and awaken the Jee family bloodline. During this process, she fell into a long slumber.]
[Listening to Ji Bingyue’s words, you ponder that the previous simulations involving Ji Bingyue or Ji Bingyan might have followed a similar course: they fell asleep soon after arriving at the Jee family, possibly unable to convey certain matters in time. As a result, you don’t blame her for anything.]
[Next, you ask Ji Bingyan again about the favor she wanted from you. After some silence, she tells you that a cultivation secret realm is about to open. However, this secret realm is not solely controlled by the Jee family—it’s shared with the Wang Family, and there’s a limit on the number of people allowed in.]
[This secret realm opens once every five thousand years, and only seven people can enter each time.]
[Therefore, before the cultivation secret realm opens, it must be determined which family is qualified to enter. A martial competition will be held for this purpose. The winner will qualify to enter the cultivation secret realm, while the loser will miss the opportunity.]

chapters.title: Chapter 716: 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Chapter 207: The Tragic Supreme Wind Demon! Goodbye, Ji Bingyan_5
[Upon hearing Ji Bingyan’s words, you understood her intentions. Evidently, she wishes to invite you to help the Jee family defeat the Wang family and secure your future kin’s right to enter the secret realm.]
[Despite this, you felt somewhat strange about the proposal. After all, the Wang family shares your surname, and attacking them felt a bit awkward. However, you are more curious about why the Wang family is so powerful that even the Jee family, who once gave birth to a Great Emperor, can’t gain the upper hand?]
[In response to your doubts, Ji Bingyan explained that although the Jee family once birthed a Great Emperor, that was millions of years ago. Today, the Jee family has declined despite having the Reincarnation Secret Skill, but has thankfully not fallen into complete obscurity like some of the age-old Imperial-tier forces.]
[The Wang family, although they haven’t birthed a Great Emperor, is also guarded by a Quasi-Emperor. Somehow, their clan’s elite has obtained the Great Emperor’s inheritance, which includes the Emperor Scripture and an Emperor’s artifact.]
[Thus, in terms of sheer family power, her Jee family didn’t have necessary advantages. Furthermore, similarly among the younger generation, the Jee family didn’t hold any advantages either, which is why they are seeking external help.]
[Upon hearing this explanation, you’re rather contemplative. You hadn’t expected this Wang family to be so powerful, with a Quasi-Emperor and an Emperor’s artifact at their disposal. A force like this would be considered second only to the Imperial-tier forces in the Upper Realm.]
[After some consideration, you agreed to Ji Bingyan’s request. However, you specified that one place in the secret realm would be yours. Hugely delighted, Ji Bingyan immediately agreed.]
[Following this, you curiously asked Ji Bingyan if the Wang family, just like Jee’s family, could also seek help from outside. In response, Ji Bingyan nodded and informed you that the Wang family had actually managed to invite a mysterious Imperial Prince-level character, warning you not to underestimate them.]
[You didn’t care much about Ji Bingyan’s warning. In the current younger generation, you rarely meet a match, fearless of anyone within the same realm, unless it’s a freak who is both a direct descendant of a Great Emperor and possesses the Special Constitution.]
[Afterwards, you followed Ji Bingyan to the Jee family’s residence.]
[Upon your arrival, the Jee family greeted you warmly. As the 5th Emperor’s Son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you are a highly reputed figure even in the Immortal Continent. Even the Jee Family Master, a Supreme figure, dared not treat you with indifference. Even more so, considering that you were here to aid the Jee family this time.]
[Shortly, you became a guest of honor at the Jee family, and they hosted an Immortal Banquet for you, creating quite a lively atmosphere. At this banquet, you noticed a young boy from the Jee family always watching you closely. His gaze changes whenever he sees you chatting and laughing with Ji Bingyan.]
[You didn’t pay much attention to this, assuming that this Jee family’s boy must be attracted to Ji Bingyan. However, out of curiosity, you asked Ji Bingyan about the identity of this young man.]
[In response to your inquiry, Ji Bingyan had no intention of hiding, and she told you the name of the youth — he was Ji Ziqing, a descendant of the Ancestor in her lineage. However, Ji Ziqing wasn’t valued because of his poor innate qualities.]
[If not for Ji Ziqing being a descendent of the Ancestor, he probably wouldn’t even qualify to attend this Immortal Banquet.]
[Hearing this answer, you felt a strange vibe, suspecting that Ji Ziqing might be a Son of Fortune from the trash stream. However, you then concluded that you might have been overthinking it, as it’s not that easy to encounter a Son of Fortune.]
[Afterwards, you curiously asked Ji Bingyan if she’s close to Ji Ziqing. Ji Bingyan nodded, indicating that over the years, she felt slightly responsible for him as she witnessed his hardships.]
[Upon hearing this, you couldn’t help but speculate that the boy was probably experiencing his first love, felling enamoured for the kind-hearted Ji Bingyan. This explained why he was hostile towards you.]
[Despite this, you didn’t care too much about it and soon dismissed it from your mind, continuing to enjoy the party.]
[In the blink of an eye, a month had passed. You often engaged in Discussing Tao with Ji Bingyan, which benefited her greatly and deepened her reverence for you. Meanwhile, Ji Ziqing’s hostility towards you had become more apparent.]
[Finally, it was time for the competition between the two families. You accompanied the Jee family’s entourage and arrived at the secret realm. There you saw a rather familiar face.]
[It turned out, it was the 14th Emperor’s Son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Neither the Jee family nor you expected that both parties had invited the Emperor’s sons from the Taiyi Imperial Palace. With so many Imperial-tier forces, so many Imperial-tier Prince-level characters and monsters on Immortal Continent, it was too much of a coincidence for both parties to have invited the Emperor’s sons from the same Imperial-level forces.]
[In that moment, both the Jee family and the Wang family were momentarily speechless, not expecting that the other party was also connected with the Taiyi Imperial Palace. However, the Wang family seemed to be more confident, considering it was more likely that the 14th Emperor’s Son would be stronger than the 5th.]
[On the other hand, the Jee family was also confident. After all, you had made a name for yourself in a single battle. A difference of one ranking couldn’t possibly represent anything.]
[The 14th Emperor’s Son sighed, not expecting to compete against you. Since things had turned out this way, he would not hold back. You responded, “same here”.]
[Before long, the competition between the two families began. The Jee and Wang family’s prodigies achieved victories and defeats respectively. When it came to the sixth round, the Jee family won three matches, while the Wang family won two. You thought you wouldn’t need to take action anymore]
[However, unexpectedly, the Wang family’s Emperor’s son was ruthless. He directly burned his source, making a life-risking strike, severely injuring the Jee family’s Emperor’s Son and thus winning the match.]
[In the end, the score between the two families was tied at three to three, and the outcome would be determined by a duel between you and the 14th Emperor’s Son.]

chapters.title: Chapter 717: 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Chapter 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars!
[Under everyone’s anticipation, you had a fierce battle with the 14th Emperor’s Son. At first, both of you displayed cultivation at the Saint King Realm 7th tier and used your respective physiques to engage in a terrifying fight.]
[This battle left the Jee family and Wang family in awe, admiring that both of you are truly Emperor’s son-tier individuals from the Taiyi Imperial Palace and are far stronger than the Emperor’s son-tier individuals of the two families.]
[At the peak of the battle, the 14th Emperor’s Son no longer held back and raised his cultivation up a notch, reaching the Saint King Realm 8th tier, while also utilizing a more powerful Secret Skill. This surprised you, and you hadn’t expected that the 14th Emperor’s Son had also reached the Saint King Realm 8th tier. You sighed in your heart, realizing that you cannot underestimate other Emperor’s son-tier individuals.]
[Next, you also revealed your true cultivation level. When you exposed your Saint King Realm 8th tier cultivation, the 14th Emperor’s Son was similarly caught off guard. However, despite finding you difficult to deal with, he still had confidence in defeating you.]
[At this moment, you once again used a hidden trump card, the Space Law at the 6th Tier Peak. While the 14th Emperor’s Son was indeed powerful and had achieved a Mana understanding of six-tier level, he ultimately fell short of the 6th Tier Peak and could not compare to you. Additionally, as the Space Law itself surpassed most other laws, the 14th Emperor’s Son was completely suppressed by you.]
[In the end, even though the 14th Emperor’s Son fought until the last moment, he was still no match for you and was defeated. However, he wholeheartedly accepted his defeat, admiring you greatly.]
[Seeing the 14th Emperor’s Son defeated, the Wang family felt helpless but had no choice but to accept the outcome. After all, it was a fair contest, and the battle between you two was extremely exciting without any hint of pretense. There’s not much to say when outmatched by someone more skillful.]
[On the other hand, the Jee family was overjoyed and began to celebrate. The younger members of the Jee family started to flatter you, and Ji Bingyan also looked at you with admiration.]
[Afterward, you all entered the Cultivation Secret Realm. Upon entering this special realm, you finally understood why the Ji and Wang families were so desperate for it. The Wang family’s Emperor’s son chose to burn his core to secure victory, adopting a kamikaze-style strategy.]
[Because this Secret Realm was quite extraordinary, with clear laws that could help cultivators attain Enlightenment, its effects were much stronger than those of the Taiyi Emperor Tower. Moreover, this secret realm also contained mysterious techniques to enhance cultivation, repair the core, and strengthen the base.]
[Had the Wang family won and their Emperor’s son entered the realm, he would’ve been able to recover the burnt core and even make it stronger. Furthermore, it would’ve been helpful in comprehending laws and reaping numerous benefits.]
[However, this secret realm only opened once every five thousand years, and would be affected by the Last Dharma Age. Otherwise, if it were even more potent than the Taiyi Emperor Tower, it probably wouldn’t have been occupied by just the two Quasi-Emperor-tier forces.]
[Of course, apart from helping people comprehend laws, the Taiyi Emperor Tower was also rumored to assist cultivators in increasing the probability of breaking through to the Supreme realm in its upper tier. This was something the secret realm could not match. After all, this secret realm was ultimately a special realm that was more beneficial for those in the Saint Realm.]
[Next, you found a secluded spot and entered a cultivation state, hoping to absorb the special core energy from the secret realm to strengthen your incomplete Space-Time Dao Body and see if it could be restored to a perfect state.]
[However, you were ultimately disappointed. The level of your Space-Time Dao Body was too high, making this secret realm unable to restore it. You clearly understood that to metamorphose your Space-Time Dao Body into a perfect state, you would need to find the missing Temporal Origin. However, chances of this are incredibly rare and precious.]
[Despite your disappointment, you didn’t let it bother you too much and entered a cultivation state, planning to use this opportunity to comprehend the Seventy Percent Spatial Laws, which would significantly improve your strength.]
[Time flew, and nearly three months passed in the blink of an eye. You successfully comprehended the Seventy Percent Spatial Laws, and your cultivation also made great progress, reaching the Saintly King 8th tier Peak. This was the result of you focusing on Enlightenment; otherwise, your cultivation would’ve definitely been higher.]
[However, compared to raising your cultivation, comprehending laws in this secret realm was undoubtedly the more cost-effective choice. It would’ve been foolish to give up Enlightenment in favor of raising your cultivation.]
[Next, you decided to stop cultivating and consolidate your gains. After all, this secret realm could only be opened for three months, and there wasn’t much time left until it closed. Continuing to cultivate held little meaning and might even create complications.]
[Just as you were consolidating your gains, you sensed a mysterious fluctuation from the pool in front of you, but it quickly disappeared, leaving you astonished.]
[You pondered for a while and decided that the sensation you just felt was not an illusion. As a result, you planned to enter the pool.]
[When you jumped into the pool, you felt that it was extremely strange, as it was incredibly cold. Keep in mind that your current cultivation had reached the Saint King 8th tier Peak, and you were an Emperor’s son-tier individual, not an ordinary Saint King 8th tier Peak cultivator.]
[However, the pool could still make you feel the cold, which seemed terrifying. As a result, you were convinced that there must be a great secret hidden deep within the pool, possibly an unknown great opportunity.]

chapters.title: Chapter 718: 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Chapter 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _2
[Next, without any hesitation, you plunged deeper into the pool. You discovered that as you went down, the water became colder and colder. Even for you, your whole body trembled, feeling as if your essence was about to be frozen.]
[However, you still didn’t give up and forcibly continued to dive until you reached your limit and wanted to ascend. Finally, you saw a special ice-blue crystal floating in the pool, emitting a terrifying chill.]
[You were amazed and recognized what this was. This was a unique ice-type supreme treasure called Heavenly Ice, the most precious treasure in the hearts of ice cultivators. Whoever could obtain it and gain its approval would undergo a transformation to obtain the Heavenly Ice Body, a powerful physique comparable to a Sacred Body.]
[At this thought, you became fervent. If you could obtain this Heavenly Ice and gain its approval, you would possess an additional powerful physique. With the combination of two powerful physiques, your combat power would greatly increase.]
[For this reason, you braved the risk of being completely frozen and forcibly charged towards the Heavenly Ice, attempting to subdue it.]
[However, as soon as you approached the Heavenly Ice, it emitted an even deeper blue light, and the temperature in the strange pool suddenly dropped significantly. At this moment, your body completely stiffened, and even your consciousness was frozen, entering a special state of suspended animation.]
[Due to your peculiar state, the simulation ended here…]
……
The text simulation stopped here, and various scenes appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
“This Heavenly Ice is truly terrifying; it can even freeze one’s soul.”
Finally, his figure appeared at the bottom of the pool, looking at the Heavenly Ice emitting a faint blue light, raising an eyebrow and sighing.
“However, this pool isn’t simple, either. It can remain unfrozen despite the Heavenly Ice’s chilling aura. Of course, it’s possible the Heavenly Ice is doing this on purpose. But even so, it shows that the pool isn’t ordinary.”
Wang Ping gazed at the pool and muttered to himself.
Next, just as Wang Ping was about to exit the immersive simulation, he suddenly felt that there was something deeper in the pool, in the depths of it.
This was because even where the Heavenly Ice was, it still wasn’t the deepest part of the pool.
The pool was still bottomless.
“This feeling is what I sensed when I was on the shore. It is somewhat similar to the essence of the secret realm. Could it be that the deepest part of this cold pool contains the greatest opportunity of this secret realm and is the reason for its formation?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with brilliance as this thought crossed his mind.
It was at this moment that Wang Ping’s consciousness blurred, and he exited the immersive simulation state, returning to the real world.
“It’s a pity that this is a free simulation. Although there are many opportunities and my strength has increased, I couldn’t claim rewards or insights. The biggest problem is not being able to reference what dangers I might encounter when going to the Black Abyss Demon Lord Inheritance site.”
Wang Ping exhaled and shook his head.
“However, there’s no point in me doing any more free simulations. After all, if I leave the Elemental Star in a short time, I’ll be discovered by that Primordial Thunder Supreme, and he’ll attack me. Exposing myself by dealing with that Slaughter Saint has caused me trouble.”
Wang Ping frowned again, feeling a little headache.
“That’s right, I almost forgot that I learned the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method. The Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method can conceal my appearance and cultivation methods, allowing me to evade Primordial Thunder Supreme’s scrutiny and prevent him from recognizing me.”
Wang Ping quickly remembered the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method and couldn’t help but cover his forehead.
In this free simulation, he had been too careless. He had even forgotten to use the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method, still using other secret techniques to change his appearance and aura.
Although those secret techniques were powerful, they might not be effective against a Supreme with a vast difference in cultivation.
Not to mention, he hadn’t changed his appearance and aura in the previous simulations.
“The disadvantage of text simulations is that watching the scenes doesn’t promote my real growth, so I often make some low-level mistakes at the beginning of the simulation. Only after spending a lot of time in the simulation can I grow completely. Each simulation is repeating this process.”
Wang Ping shook his head and exhaled.
Nevertheless, given the choice, he would still only do text simulations and avoid immersive simulations if possible.
After all, the longer he spent in immersive simulations, the more time passed in the real world, and his main body wasn’t very safe.
Besides, Wang Ping hadn’t forgotten some things.
It had been about twenty years since Chifeng disappeared completely.
Also, he had to hurry to rescue the family of the boy with the Black Abyss Demon Body; only then could the boy become less distorted.
After all, hatred could easily lead one to become completely demonic.

chapters.title: Chapter 719: 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Chapter 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _3
Once these preparations were made, he headed towards the depths of the starry sky.
Although this scene was still perceived by Primordial Thunder Supreme, he only slightly furrowed his brows, showing a hint of surprise after a Saint King emerged from the Elemental Star but didn’t pay it any attention.
After Wang Ping arrived in the starry sky and found no attacks, he breathed a sigh of relief. He casually threw the Divine Monarch Realm cultivator back to the Elemental Star and continued to use spatial transfer to head deeper into the starry sky.
He wanted to reach the ancient star where the Black Abyss Demon Lord was located in the shortest time possible.
According to the Star Map, it would still take him about three years to get there.
…
In the blink of an eye, about three years had passed.
During these three years, many things happened.
Firstly, many newcomers joined the Transmigrator Chat Group.
Although many newcomers died during missions, the number of living group members still broke through the hundred-member mark.
However, the golden fingers of these newcomers were not very useful to Wang Ping, so he didn’t pay them particular attention.
During these three years, the growth of many group members was quite impressive.
Many old group members had reached the Divine Realm tier of combat power.
Especially Lin Yuanyuan, with Wang Ping’s help and her own efforts, she had attained the cultivation of the Saint King Realm 6th tier.
The current Lin Yuanyuan was not like the emptily powerful of the past, only having cultivation but lacking combat power.
Lin Yuanyuan, relying on accumulating group points, strengthened her golden finger once again.
After strengthening her golden finger, the improvement in Lin Yuanyuan’s golden finger was astonishing, just as Wang Ping had estimated; she could now absorb others’ insights on cultivation.
In other words, Lin Yuanyuan had caught up with Wang Ping in terms of her golden finger’s configuration.
Even Wang Ping thought that if he continued to help Lin Yuanyuan, or if Lin Yuanyuan had better luck and knew how to sneakily develop her strength, her growth rate might not be inferior to his, and she might even surpass him during certain times.
Lin Yuanyuan’s golden finger, after optimization, was probably even stronger than Lin Qinghe’s speed of improving combat power, which Wang Ping had valued.
Of course, Lin Qinghe also had advantages that Lin Yuanyuan lacked, such as Lin Qinghe’s ability to absorb essence and obtain various physiques, eventually condensing a Chaotic Body.
However, Lin Yuanyuan was unable to extract physiques, which could be considered a flaw.
But Wang Ping believed that if Lin Yuanyuan was optimized once more, she would probably be able to do it.
Unfortunately, even Wang Ping could not optimize any further now, let alone Lin Yuanyuan.
Trillions of group points and Rule Stones as optimization conditions were simply terrifying.
Even though Wang Ping had undertaken various tasks during these three years, in addition to being able to take a share of the rewards from other group members’ missions, he had only saved up 50 billion group points.
In Wang Ping’s view, it would probably take him more than a hundred years to save up trillions of group points.
This assumed that he would become stronger in the future and high-difficulty tasks would frequently appear.
Otherwise, it would take even longer to accumulate trillions group points.
Apart from that, trillions of group points were secondary, the most troublesome thing was the Rule Stone.
This thing could only be found in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, and it was definitely a precious item.
Of course, now neither Wang Ping nor Lin Yuanyuan needed to be in a hurry to optimize their golden fingers again.
After all, both of their golden fingers were useful now, and as long as they didn’t completely fall halfway, they could at least help them grow to the Great Emperor tier.
In addition to Lin Yuanyuan, other old group members also made significant progress.
Among them, Chen Yao and Zhang Hu, who had unique golden fingers, came second only to Lin Yuanyuan.
Chen Yao had reached the Saint tier with enough resources, while Zhang Hu had reached that level of combat power by subduing a Saint tier mount.
Next in line were people like Zhang Jun. Although they could become stronger through killing, even in Wang Ping’s world, the Last Dharma Age environment didn’t offer many strong opponents for them to kill.
Moreover, if they were to recklessly act, it would be very easy for them to encounter danger and be casually killed by a stronger cultivator.
“Finally, I’ve arrived at the ancient star where the Black Abyss Demon Lord is located.”
In the starry sky, Wang Ping looked down at the gigantic ancient star not far away, his eyes filled with determination.
Then, he tore space once again and landed on this ancient star.
When he arrived on this ancient star, the Black Abyss Demon Spear trembled, guiding him to the location of the secret realm laid out by the Black Abyss Demon Lord.
Of course, even without the Black Abyss Demon Spear’s guidance, he could easily locate it through his memories.
“It looks like it’s time to say goodbye to you.”
Wang Ping looked at the Black Abyss Demon Spear and sighed.
Naturally, he was reluctant to part with this Supreme Artifact.
But, well, one must lose in order to gain.
Compared to the resources he would gain later, the Black Abyss Demon Spear didn’t matter that much.
Anyway, with his life simulation, Supreme Artifacts would definitely fall into his hands as he grew stronger, and even Quasi-Emperor Artifacts wouldn’t be impossible.
Of course, the thing Wang Ping coveted the most was the Emperor Artifacts of the Tao Palace.
If he could have the qualifications to wield the Emperor’s artifact of the Tao Palace, that would be true bliss.
Next, Wang Ping collected his thoughts, arrived at the secret realm where the Black Abyss Devil Sovereign Heritage was located, used the Black Abyss Demon Spear as a key, and entered it.
Then, just like in a life simulation, Wang Ping saw the remnant thoughts of the Black Abyss Demon Lord.

chapters.title: Chapter 720: 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Chapter 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _4
Although Wang Ping met the Black Abyss Demon Lord’s remnants earlier than expected, the subsequent developments did not change much.
Wang Ping still gained a huge amount of resources.
At the same time, he also lost the Black Abyss Demon Spear.
“Next, I should go find Wan Yu, this little guy.”
After leaving the secret realm, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he immediately used a Secret Skill to search for Wan Yu’s location.
Soon, Wang Ping locked onto Wan Yu and tore through space, heading straight for his destination.
…
Meanwhile, in a certain farmland, a five-year-old child happily played with mud, making various figurines, looking carefree and happy.
His parents were clearly tired from farming and were drinking water.
Wang Ping looked at this family of three and shook his head slightly.
Who would have thought that a poor farming family would produce a Black Abyss Demon Body?
If left unchecked, this somewhat impoverished but happy family of three would be bullied in the future, with the adults dying tragically and the child awakening the Black Abyss Demon Body, possibly embarking on a ruthless Demon Path in the future.
Perhaps, after taking revenge, Wan Yu may no longer have strong killing intent.
However, Wang Ping felt that after taking revenge, it would be more likely for Wan Yu to be deeply trapped in the Demon Path and slaughter countless living beings.
That’s because the more uncontrollable the Black Abyss Demon Body, the more murderous it becomes, with killing intent as deep as the abyss, hence the origin of the name Black Abyss Demon Body.
Ultimately, either he would completely grow up, proving the Tao to be Supreme, or even Quasi-Emperor, or be suppressed early by a terrifying strong person.
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and he stepped into the air, arriving above the family of three.
With Wang Ping’s appearance, the reactions of the three were different.
Wan Yu’s parents’ water bottles fell to the ground, and their faces were full of astonishment as they stared at Wang Ping.
As for Wan Yu, he blinked his eyes and looked at Wang Ping in surprise and curiosity, pointing at him and exclaiming, “Wow, dad, mom, quick, look, this big brother can fly! Could it be the immortal you were talking about?”
Upon hearing Wan Yu’s words, his parents were shocked and hurriedly knelt in front of Wang Ping while pressing Wan Yu’s head down, saying, “We beg the immortal not to be offended, our child is still young, so he was rude to point at you with his hands.”
Wan Yu’s parents were genuinely frightened.
After all, immortals were high above the common people, and they had once seen an immortal destroy a village without hesitation, which was extremely brutal.
These figures were not people that commoners like them could afford to offend.
“Hehe, don’t worry, my purpose of coming here is to see that your child has potential, and I want to take him as my apprentice and teach him how to cultivate. I wonder if you’re willing to let him become my apprentice?”
Wang Ping chuckled and spoke kindly.
Upon hearing this, Wan Yu’s parents were stunned.
Soon after, they showed joyous expressions and hurriedly said to Wang Ping, “Immortal, please accept our child!”
In their eyes, they had encountered a once in a lifetime opportunity to become immortal.
If their child could embark on the path of cultivation and become an immortal in the legends, they would be able to live a carefree life without worrying about food and clothing, and not go hungry and full from time to time.
Moreover, once they became relatives of an immortal, no one would dare to bully them.
“Yu’er, hurry up and worship your master, don’t miss out on this opportunity to become immortal!”
Subsequently, they quickly spoke to their child.
“Immortal, please take me as your disciple. I want to become an immortal.”
Wan Yu knelt on the ground, staring at Wang Ping with expectant eyes.
“From today on, you are a disciple of Heavenly Evolution Saint King.”
Wang Ping waved his hand casually, allowing all three to stand up and smiled.
At this moment, Wang Ping suddenly felt that his cultivation was rapidly increasing.
Saint King Realm 7th tier!
Saint King Realm 8th tier!
Saint King Realm 9th tier!
Saint King Great Perfection!
“Hiss!”
Wang Ping felt the changes in his cultivation and couldn’t help but be a bit astonished.
This was truly terrifying.
Just by accepting Wan Yu as a disciple, his cultivation increased by four realms directly, which was truly a pleasant surprise.
After all, the higher the cultivation, the smaller the increment later on.
According to his simulated experience of accepting disciples, to advance from the peak of the Holy King’s 6th tier to Saint King Great Perfection would require at least a hundred ordinary talents.
This was truly one person equal to a hundred others.
“Next, if I can find another talented individual like Wan Yu, I should be able to break through to the Half-step Great Saint realm, and even Great Saint realm might not be impossible.”
Wang Ping thought to himself.
“It’s a pity that the Innate Saint in the Profound Small Universe cannot be my disciple with my current strength. Otherwise, I must find a way to go to the Profound Universe.”
“However, there is no need to be too anxious about this matter. There is still more than a hundred years before the birth of the Innate Saint. As long as I become strong enough by the time the Innate Saint is born or find someone with the talent to snatch from the mouth of a Quasi-Emperor, it will be enough.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and after collecting his thoughts, he looked at Wan Yu and the others again.
Then, with a wave of his hand, he teleported Wan Yu to his side.
“From today on, this child will follow me. These are some cultivation skills, elixirs and spirit stones that you can also use to embark on the path of cultivation. Even if your talents are poor, you can still strengthen your bodies and prolong your lives.”
Next, Wang Ping took out some items and spoke to Wan Yu’s parents.

chapters.title: Chapter 721: 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Chapter 208: Great Opportunity in the Secret Realm! Cultivation Soars! _5
“However, never forget that these things must never be revealed to outsiders, otherwise disaster will strike.”
In the end, Wang Ping’s expression became extremely serious.
Although he had left some tricks in place in these matters, some disasters were not things that these tricks could block.
The best way to protect oneself was to never expose them.
“Immortal, don’t worry, we understand the principle of not showing off wealth.”
Wan Yu’s parents were very excited, hastily said.
Wang Ping nodded, did not say much, and quickly left with Wan Yu.
Wang Ping did not have the idea of heading directly to the Immortal Continent.
Although it was not too far away from the Immortal Continent, by making full use of the delivery arrays on various ancient stars, he could get there in about a year.
However, Wang Ping would not take risks in the real world to venture into places filled with strong individuals.
So he planned to stay on this ancient star, carry out simulations, cultivate Wan Yu, and leave when the latter had the ability to protect himself.
Wang Ping’s teaching method has always been to provide enough resources in the early stage, teach some cultivation knowledge, and then let the students freely practice and grow on their own.
Not long after, Wang Ping arrived in a divine city, purchased a cultivating mansion, and moved in. After helping Wan Yu lay a solid foundation, teaching him the initial cultivation knowledge, Wang Ping planned to continue the simulation.
“System, I want to participate in the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming 80,000 top-tier Divine Origin, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Golden Talent: Damage Nullification; Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique.”
Golden Talent: Damage Nullification – With this talent, the host will not be affected by any attack within three seconds. PS: This talent is a special type, can be used once every ten years, can exert capability beyond the gold level, so it is not only useful for Saints but also for the Supreme.
Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique:…..
“Ah, has my luck really improved? So many talents in a row. Two gold, one rainbow, and another gold. Moreover, this golden talent, if Cai Yonglong saw it, he would definitely cry, right?”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time with a strange look in his eyes.
This Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, isn’t it the one Cai Yonglong exchanged for later? Although the name is different, the effect is exactly the same, and the effect is even stronger than the Absolute Defense that Cai Yonglong had before optimization.
After all, it can defend against the Supreme’s attack.
It was estimated that Cai Yonglong would not be able to do this before optimization.
Of course, Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger cooldown time is not this long, it can only be said that each has its own advantages and disadvantages.
However, one thing can be confirmed: the Golden Talent had already reached the level of the original golden finger.
Although… this was a special golden talent.
Wang Ping couldn’t help but feel a thousand emotions once again.
His Life Simulator was indeed too buggy.
Every transmigrator only has one golden finger, but he’s different, as long as his luck is good, he can wholesale all the group members’ golden fingers for himself.
“System, I choose Golden Talent: Damage Nullification.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his choice, his eyes flickering.
This time, with this Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, he wondered if he could obtain Heavenly Ice from Ji family’s secret realm.
Although it needed Heavenly Ice’s approval, simply invalidating the damage would be useless.
Through previous simulations, the possibility of Wang Ping being approved by Heavenly Ice was very low; the probablity was higher that it was for Ji Bingyan in the future.
However, this doesn’t matter, after all, he died before even touching it.
If he could touch it, there was a chance that he could refresh it as a reward.
Although the current Life Simulator doesn’t need to be touched to have a chance to refresh, if he touched it, the probability of it refreshing would definitely be much higher, so it’s worth a try.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the voice of the system sounded, and his consciousness blurs as he enters the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appears, and familiar text emerges.”
[Day one, you choose to continue teaching Wan Yu cultivation…]
[Three years later, you feel the timing is ripe, and you let Wan Yu be free, allowing him to wander outside. At the same time, you start to be eager to take more disciples. First, you go around digging for disciples on this ancient star, causing some commotion.]
[Unfortunately, after reaching a bottleneck, you find that ordinary geniuses can no longer provide you with cultivation, and your cultivation can not be upgraded to the level of Half-step Great Saint.]
[This makes you very helpless. It seems that for breaking through the larger bottlenecks, you still need to take disciples like Ye Chen and Wan Yu, those special talents.]
[Ultimately, after pondering, you give up the plan to wander around the ancient stars and decide to head directly to the Immortal Continent.]

chapters.title: Chapter 722: 209: Wang Ping: Did I F***ing Become the Villain?
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Chapter 209: Wang Ping: Did I F***ing Become the Villain?
[After arriving in the Immortal Continent, you went straight to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, planning to join them.]
[Upon your arrival at the Taiyi Imperial Palace, the palace master discovered that you had cultivated to the Saint King Great Perfection during the Last Dharma Age, practicing the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body. He was deeply shocked, believing that you had boundless prospects and would certainly enter the Supreme Realm in the future.]
[Ultimately, you successfully joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace. This time, you did not choose to self-seal immediately but decided to challenge the Taiyi Sky Road. To your surprise, you managed to climb an extra rank, reaching the eleventh level.]
[This made you pensive, realizing that the numerous simulations you’ve gone through might have other effects on you, or else it would be impossible to make an extra step.]
[Next, word spread of your stepping onto the eleventh level of Taiyi Sky Road, astonishing many people in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. As you wished, you became the 10th Emperor Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Under the advice of the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace, you chose to self-seal yourself. Almost a hundred thousand years passed in the blink of an eye, ushering in the golden age with your return.]
[After coming out of seclusion, you did not immediately enter the Taiyi Emperor Palace to cultivate, but challenged the 14th Emperor’s Son. In the end, you defeated the 14th Emperor’s Son, which shocked everyone in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, successfully taking its place.]
[However, you were not satisfied with the position of the 14th Emperor’s Son. You set your sights on the Third Prince. Finally, you chose to challenge the Third Prince. This battle attracted much attention, with many old monsters of Taiyi Emperor Palace secretly watching.]
[In the end, you fought a big battle with the Third Prince, demonstrating the cultivation of Saint King Great Perfection. However, the Third Prince was not simple either, as his cultivation had reached the Perfect Completion tier of King Realm. Clearly, he was already this strong before self-sealing, making him very formidable.]
[More importantly, he had both strong bloodlines and constitution. For the first time, you found yourself at a disadvantage.]
[Of course, you were not afraid and fought fiercely with the Third Prince. In the end, you unleashed your full power, activating the Purple Talent: Endless Blade and the Golden Talent: Multiplay’s critical strike effect, successfully turning the tide and defeating the Third Prince.]
[Your two talents greatly surprised the onlookers, who couldn’t see the depth of your techniques and didn’t know what secret skills you had used to display such astonishing power.]
[You were aware that you had already exposed many things. However, you didn’t care. After all, you were now the Emperor’s Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, and it was impossible for the old monsters within the palace to harm you. If they were to persecute you just because a junior had some secrets, they wouldn’t have lasted for such a long time.]
[For a force to exist for a long time, internal stability and harmony are necessary. Competition and conflicts may exist, but there are certain boundaries and rules that cannot be trampled upon. Otherwise, even a Quasi-Emperor would meet their end.]
[Besides, revealing your Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Golden Talent: Multiplay at this point wasn’t that big of a deal. As long as your Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skill, Golden Talent: Transmission, and Golden Talent: Damage Nullification were not exposed, you still had many hidden cards to play, allowing you to face most dangers unafraid while venturing outside.]
[After being defeated by you, the Third Prince didn’t accept it lightly. He stated that he would challenge you in the future to take back his position.]
[In response, you laughed and said you’d welcome his challenge anytime.]
[Thus, the battle between the two Emperor’s Sons ended, and you successfully advanced to the Third Emperor’s Son, earning numerous benefits.]
[Next, you directly entered the Taiyi Emperor Tower to cultivate, hoping to comprehend seventy percent of spatial laws with the help of Enlightenment in the tower. That way, you would become even more formidable.]
[After that, you only needed to think of ways to take on more powerful disciples to successfully advance to the Half-step Great Saint and even the Great Saint Tier. These two major and minor checkpoints might keep even Emperor’s Son Tier characters stuck for a thousand or even thousands of years during the golden age.]
[After all, Emperor’s Son Tier characters represent those with great potential to reach the Supreme level, the top tier of the Saint class. The Great Saint is the last realm below the Supreme, and it is not simple to achieve.]
[In the blink of an eye, two years passed. During this time, you successfully comprehended seventy percent of the spatial laws in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, greatly increasing your strength. However, in doing so, you also spent all the rewards you received after successfully challenging the Third Prince.]
[Next, you chose to come out of seclusion, preparing to accept a high-difficulty mission while scouting for disciples. If you could take on a disciple with astonishing potential, you would directly advance to the Half-step Great Saint Tier.]
[At that time, you would return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, challenge the Second Imperial Son and the First Emperor Child, and obtain a large number of contribution points again to enter the Taiyi Emperor Tower for cultivation, forming a virtuous cycle.]
[Soon, you took on a high-difficulty mission to kill an ordinary Great Saint, and headed to a country called the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty. This nation was a subsidiary of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, with its most powerful existence being a Saint tier Ancestor.]
[However, this Ancestor’s lifespan was already running out, and even though they barely held on until the golden age, they did not dare to come out easily. As a result, the power of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty was not that strong. In the entire Immortal Continent, it could only be considered a fourth or fifth-rate small power.]

chapters.title: Chapter 723: 209: Wang Ping: Did I F***ing Become the Villain? _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Chapter 209: Wang Ping: Did I F***ing Become the Villain? _2
[Although the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty, when placed on an ancient star like the Elemental Star, could completely dominate. After all, some ancient stars have Supremes or even Quasi-Emperors, but those ancient stars are ultimately few, and the strongest on most ancient stars are actually Great Saints or Half-Step Great Saints.]
[For example, the strongest on many ancient stars in the Small Universe is just Saint Kings or even Saints.]
[However, this is the Immortal Continent, a place where countless strong individuals from the Ten Great Universes gather. In this place, without a Saint, it’s not worth establishing a power, and even forces with a Great Saint in charge can only be called fourth or fifth rate minor forces, and can only survive by attaching themselves to imperial-tier forces or Quasi-Emperor-tier forces.]
[And this time, your mission is because there is an evil cultivator causing chaos in the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty. This evil cultivator’s cultivation has already reached the level of Great Saint, and the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty is quite troubled by it. Facing a Great Saint evil cultivator, unless their Ancestor comes out, it’s absolutely impossible to be a match for the Great Saint evil cultivator.]
[For this reason, they paid the price to report the issue to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, hoping that the Taiyi Imperial Palace would dispatch strong individuals to suppress the Great Saint evil cultivator and restore peace in the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty.]
[Arriving in the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty, you received a warm welcome and they were very respectful, not daring to be the least bit negligent. They also didn’t expect that you, the newly famous Third Prince of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, would come to their Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty to kill the Great Saint evil cultivator.]
[Afterwards, you traced some clues about the Great Saint evil cultivator through the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty. However, this Great Saint evil cultivator was quite cunning, and even you had to expend a lot of energy to capture him. Then, you had an astonishing battle with him.]
[This time, you didn’t have a reliable Supreme Artifact to rely on. However, your current cultivation has reached the Saint King Great Perfection tier, and you have also obtained your own life-bound Great Saint Artifact, and comprehended 70% of the Space Law. Relying on these numerous advantages, you forcefully killed the Great Saint evil cultivator.]
[This battle shook the heavens and the earth, making your fame even greater and spreading throughout the entire Immortal Continent. For a time, the special neutral force Bai Xiaosheng listed you as the 35th on the Saint King Rankings.]
[This Saint King Ranking was created by Bai Xiaosheng’s list, and only the top 100 Saint Kings can enter. Through this battle, you directly squeezed into the 35th place on the Saint King Ranking, which is terrifying.]
[After all, there are so many imperial-tier forces, Quasi-Emperor-tier forces, emperor’s son tier characters, hidden masters’ disciples, and some people who have stopped at the Saint King Realm due to special reasons but have extraordinary combat power. It’s not an easy task to get into this Saint King Ranking, but once on the list, you’ll truly become the center of attention worldwide.]
[You should know that before your battle with the evil Saint Great cultivator, you were not included in Bai Xiaosheng’s Saint King Ranking, which shows its high value.]
[As a result, countless cultivators set their sights on entering the Saint Ranking, Saint King Ranking, and Great Saint Ranking. And you, directly squeezing into the 35th place, naturally attracted worldwide attention, and your fame spread throughout the entire Upper Realm.]
[Although you were somewhat surprised that you entered the Saint King Ranking, you didn’t take it too seriously, just feeling that there are enough monsters in this world. With your cultivation at the Saint King Great Perfection Realm, after killing an evil Great Saint, you could only squeeze into the 35th place on the Saint King Ranking, so how terrifying are those at the front.]
[Afterwards, you began to calm down and started traveling around, looking for geniuses. However, just as you were about to leave, you unexpectedly witnessed an interesting scene in the Jin Sacred Dynasty.]
[The Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty originally had a marriage contract with Zhu Huowang, the youngest son of the Zhu Family, a powerful family in the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty. However, the Tenth Princess of the Jin Sacred Dynasty believed that Zhu Huowang had no talent for cultivation since he was a child, considered him a waste, and thought he was not worthy of being her husband.]
[This scene aroused your curiosity. You originally thought that Ye Chen’s template was that of the Flame Emperor, but now it seems that this Zhu Huowang might be the one. After all, when Ye Chen was in the Lower Realm, he was a genuine genius, never considered a waste, just constantly running into various old masters.]
[At this moment, this Zhu Huowang has had the head of a waste since he was a child, and has been divorced, causing a strong sense of déjà vu.]
[Suddenly, you were moved, thinking that if you took Zhu Huowang as a disciple, your cultivation might greatly improve, and it wouldn’t be impossible to break through to the Half-Step Great Saint Realm.]
[With that in mind, you planned to find the right moment to appear, take Zhu Huowang as a disciple, and then teach the arrogant Tenth Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty a lesson.]
[At this moment, being observed by you, Zhu Huowang, outraged at the arrogant Tenth Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty, decided to divorce her.]
