[This decision made the Tenth Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty quite angry and disdainful, mocking Zhu Huowang for having no qualification to divorce her, and if he angered her, with a thought, she could completely destroy the Zhu Family. Then, the Tenth Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty let Zhu Huowang pick up the divorce letter and tear it up himself, not wanting the Zhu Family to suffer disaster because of him.][This caused the entire Zhu family to feel extremely stifled, and their family master was also incredibly furious, believing that the Tenth Princess of Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty had been spoiled and had no respect for the hierarchy of elders and youngsters, completely disregarding the grace of Zhu Family Ancestor saving a Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty Ancestor back then.]
[Zhu Huowang was also furious, but more than that, he felt suffocated. He could only resentfully pick up the divorce letter, tear it apart, unwilling to let the Zhu Family suffer because of him. At this moment, he yearned for power more than ever.]
…..
“Well, this really is an unexpected development. However, what the Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty did is really heartless. It’s like she’s ruining Zhu Family’s face. Now, when Zhu Huowang grows up, I’m afraid he’s going to annihilate the entire Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation content and thought to himself.
“Wait, if I think about it, if I didn’t know about this, the normal development wouldn’t have caused trouble for me. After all, beating the junior brings the senior. Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty is affiliated with the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Once the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty is wiped out by Zhu Huowang, Taiyi Imperial Palace would definitely find trouble with him. At that time, wouldn’t I become a villain …?”
Wang Ping’s eyes looked very strange.
“No, there seems to be this path too. For example, Zhu Huowang could join the Taiyi Imperial Palace, return home with honor, and change the dynasty of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty.”
Wang Ping thought of this and touched his chin, feeling that this route was more likely.
After all, a dynasty like the Taiyi Imperial Palace isn’t that easy to destroy, and a Son of Fortune really can’t do it.
Even if Zhu Huowang becomes an emperor, it would still be difficult for him to achieve this.
Just as Wang Ping was pondering, the simulation continued, and the developments that followed caught Wang Ping off guard.
[Next, the Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty continued to mock, telling Zhu Huowang to accept his fate and be an ordinary person, and give up that vain hope. Her future husband should not be someone like him. Zhu Huowang, who is nothing.]
[As soon as these words came out, Zhu Huowang was once again provoked, and his hatred soared, including some resentment towards you as well. He believed that the Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty was an arrogant, ruthless, and unfeeling woman, but your appearance in the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty might have also bewitched her, turning her into an idiot, which is why she would do such a thing in a hurry, in order to climb onto your background with a pure and clean identity.]
[In fact, Zhu Huowang’s guess was indeed correct. The Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty was in such a hurry and even hid it from her own father to forcefully annul the marriage simply because she admired you to the extreme. Yet she had this marriage agreement that made her very unhappy, so she tried her best to get out of it. This way, she could do everything in her power to win you over and become your Tao companion.]
[She believed that with her beauty, talent, and wit, the possibility of making you fall for her was high. The only thing holding her back was this marriage agreement.]
…..
“???”
Wang Ping looked at the unexpected simulation content, and his whole person was dumbfounded.
Well, how did I end up on the villain route?
Also, this Tenth Princess of the Jinyuan Sacred Dynasty is even more narcissistic than he imagined.
It’s strange, even in the Profound World, there are such people.

chapters.title: Chapter 724: 210: A Naturally Born Emperor's Weapon! News of the Immortal Tool!
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Chapter 210: A Naturally Born Emperor’s Weapon! News of the Immortal Tool!
While Wang Ping was critiquing, the simulation continued.
[Hidden observer, you feel the timing is ripe. As a result, you chose to emerge. Your appearance stunned everyone present, prompting them to pay you tribute.]
[The 10th Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty was filled with intrigue and delight at your appearance. Seeing this, Zhu Huowang was convinced that his speculations were indeed correct, further increasing his resentment towards you.]
[Yet, your next actions left everyone on the scene shocked. You directly asked Zhu Huowang if he would consider becoming your disciple, promising that you could help him uphold justice.]
[Zhu Huowang was astounded, he hadn’t anticipated that someone of your stature would be willing to take him under your wing. Zhu Huowang did not imagine that you would joke with him as there was no need to. You are a paragon among humanity, one of the most outstanding presences on the Immortal Continent. There was no reason for you to ridicule such a small character like him.]
[As a result, Zhu Huowang considered that he might have misunderstood you earlier, leading him to feel remarkably embarrassed. After the 10th Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty composed herself, she hurriedly expressed her desire for you to seriously consider her. If we’re talking about aptitude, she significantly surpasses Zhu Huowang and is a far better candidate for becoming your disciple.]
[Indifferent, you suppressed the 10th Princess with nothing more than a glance, and coldly declared the Great Saint of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty had no right to speak with you, so how dared she instruct you on your actions. Upon hearing these words, the 10th Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty came to her senses, revealing a startled expression. Her Dao Protector, even more so, turned snow white in fear, and hurriedly held down the 10th Princess, frantically bowing to you.]
[For you are the third prince of Taiyi Imperial Palace, with a noble status. Should you ever be provoked by the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty, even though you would not deign to personally interfere with them, all it would take is a single remark from you for numerous powerful people to eagerly become your weapons, wiping out the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty without a second thought.]
[As for whether Taiyi Imperial Palace would care if the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty was annihilated. It’s a joke. Anyone with a shred of sense know that provoking the Crown Prince of Taiyi Imperial Palace and then getting destroyed is what they deserve.]
[Seeing the previously high and mighty 10th Princess along with her Dao Protector trembling like mice, Zhu Huowang was deeply moved, his desire for power and authority stirring all the more fiercely.]
[Without hesitation, Zhu Huowang knelt before you, begging you to accept him as your disciple, to which you naturally agreed.]
[With you accepting Zhu Huowang as your disciple, the Zhu Family rejoiced while the 10th Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty was left with a desolate expression. As for you, you received a prompt from your Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples, instantly advancing your cultivation to the Half-step Great Saint Tier.]
[This satisfied you greatly. As expected, Zhu Huowang was indeed the perfect example of a protagonist with the waste material stream template, someone capable of matching geniuses like Ye Chen, Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu, entities who far superseded ordinary people and even compared favorably with Sons of Fortune. They were the ones who could help you break through your limitations.]
[Next, you only need to find another person like this to break through from Half-step Great Saint Tier to Great Saint Tier. Of course, to break through to the Great Saint Tier, you believe that you would probably still need special monsters like Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu. Ye Chen and Zhu Huowang can help you to break through to Half-step Great Saint Tier but breaking through to the Great Saint Tier may be somewhat challenging.]
[In your view, Ye Chen and Zhu Huowang would not achieve as much as Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu in the future. Among them, Lin Qinghe’s achievement would be the highest.]
[As numerous thoughts flashed through your mind, you coldly ordered the 10th Princess of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty and her followers to get lost. As a result, the two of them left in shame.]
[Next, you pondered for a moment before expressing that you hoped Zhu Huowang would diligently cultivate. Once he broke through to the Void Divine Realm, you would bring him to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Upon hearing your words, Zhu Huowang earnestly nodded, swearing that he would reach the Void Divine Realm within a hundred years.]
[As for this promise, you smiled and shook your head, declaring that a hundred years was too long. You were giving him just fifty years. Fifty years to advance to the Void Divine Realm. In your opinion, the current era is a golden age with cultivation being extremely easy. Even fifty years is considered long.]
[After all, if we take the Imperial Prince-level Characters as a standard, they wouldn’t even take fifty years to reach the Void Divine Realm during the golden age. At most, they would only require about twenty years. Some of the freak talents in the group of Imperial Prince-level Characters could even cultivate from an ordinary person to the Divine Realm in less than ten years.]
[Of course, the Imperial Prince-level Characters have strong bloodlines, body types, abundant resources and the guidance of mentors, which is a point Zhu Huowang cannot compare. So, you set a fifty-year deadline.]
[Although you could easily offer Zhu Huowang the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures required for cultivation up to the Divine Realm, you didn’t intend to. You are very curious to know what Zhu Huowang’s cheat, being a waste material stream luck child, is. Is it like Ye Chen’s ring old grandfather, or some Shocks the world opportunity.]
[If you knew what the secret was which enabled Zhu Huowang, a waste material stream luck child, to turn the tables, you could get it for yourself during a simulation, converting it into your own power. After all, it would only be a simulation – so you could visualize it without it being the same as truly robbing your disciple of his opportunity.]

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 210: A Naturally Born Emperor’s Weapon! News of the Immortal Tool! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Chapter 210: A Naturally Born Emperor’s Weapon! News of the Immortal Tool! _2
[Seeing that you want Zhu Huowang to reach the Divine Realm within fifty years, he feels tremendous pressure. After all, he is already fifteen years old and has only reached the first tier of the Mortal Realm. It seems like an impossible task to become a god within fifty years.]
[However, since it’s your request, and he’s extremely thirsty for power, he firmly promises to fulfill it.]
[You are very satisfied with this. Afterwards, you decline the Zhu Family’s invitation to the Immortal Banquet and quietly leave. Of course, you aren’t really leaving, as you leave behind an incarnation to secretly monitor Zhu Huowang’s every move.]
[Because your strength is too strong and the Zhu Family’s strongest is merely a Saint-tier Ancestor, no one can detect your actions.]
[By the time you have done all of this, the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty’s Saint Master learns about what the 10th Princess has done. He is enraged, stripping his favorite daughter of her cultivation and throwing her into the heavenly prison.]
[At the same time, the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty’s Saint Master is terrified and doesn’t know how to apologize to you. After some thought, he goes to the Zhu family to apologize personally, not only to the Zhu Family but also to Zhu Huowang, hoping that Zhu Huowang will speak favorably on his behalf to you.]
[Seeing the humility of the Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty’s master, Zhu Huowang is filled with emotions. He knows that all this is due to the change in his status. Now that he’s your disciple, everything has changed. Otherwise, why would the lofty Golden Spirit Sacred Dynasty’s master apologize to a young man with no qualifications.]
[For this reason, Zhu Huowang is even more grateful to you as his master, and hungers for power and influence even more. It’s this rapidly increasing desire that finally brings forth his world-shocking luck.]
[Zhu Huowang’s life-changing luck comes in the form of a black bead he has worn since he was a child. This bead can absorb Qi and nourish its host, strengthening their physical body, making it quite domineering.]
[Through Zhu Huowang’s use, you discover the unusual properties of the bead. You search through various scriptures in the Scripture Repository of the Taiyi Imperial Palace to find out what it is.]
[Eventually, you identify the black bead. It is said that there are two types of weapons in the world: innate and cultivated. This is true for Supreme Artifacts, Quasi-Emperor Artifacts, or even Emperor Artifacts.]
[This black bead is an Innate Emperor Artifact, called the Devouring Spirit Pearl. It is said to devour the Qi of heaven and earth and store it within the bead. If a cultivator obtains the black bead and gains its approval, they can use the Qi it devoured to cultivate.]
[According to ancient records, every user of the Devouring Spirit Pearl was a terrifying body cultivator specializing in the body Training path. The strongest among them could shatter a Supreme with pure physical Qi and Blood power alone. Even the elite among them, if they could cultivate a Heavenly Tyrant Body, could fight a Quasi-Emperor.]
[In addition to this, the Devouring Spirit Pearl is also the nemesis of other body cultivators. Those who fight against its user will be continuously devoured, rapidly weakening. Even if they are not a body cultivator, they will still find it troublesome to face the Devouring Spirit Pearl. After all, although cultivators who practice magic do not focus on Qi and Blood, it is still crucial. Being devoured can cause significant trouble.]
[Aside from this, there are two similar treasures in the world: the Devouring God Bead and the Devouring Mana Pearl. These two items devour Divine Souls and Mana respectively.]
[Legend has it that if a cultivator obtains the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring God Bead, and Devouring Mana Pearl, and gains their approval, they can make the three Innate Emperor Tools fuse, transcending the level of Emperor Artifacts and transforming them into the legendary Immortal Artifacts.]
[Upon learning the origins of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, your heart trembles, amazed that Zhu Huowang has such a heaven-defying opportunity and has obtained such a mysterious and powerful innate Emperor Artifact while also gaining its approval.]
[With the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Zhu Huowang’s rapid growth would be incredibly simple. As long as he doesn’t fall halfway, his future achievements could easily shatter a Supreme.]
[At this point, you finally understand why Zhu Huowang can make you break through from the Saint King Great Perfection to Half-step Great Saint. He indeed has the ability. In your eyes, Zhu Huowang’s ranking has changed, and you think his future achievements might not necessarily be worse than Lin Qinghe or Wan Yu.]
[As for Ye Chen, you can’t see how far he can go in the future. After entering the Upper Realm, he hasn’t had any remarkable luck. So, in your mind, he still has the lowest ranking for future achievements.]
…”The Devouring Essence Orb, an Innate Emperor Artifact…”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and couldn’t help but envy the good fortune of Zhu Huowang, his newly acquired disciple.
“But he’s also lucky to live in such a small place where no one could recognize the unrevealed Devouring Essence Orb. Otherwise, countless people would go insane for it, and even Supremes and Quasi-Emperors might try to snatch it.”
“As for the future, if he exposes the existence of the Devouring Essence Orb, it will bring lethal disaster upon him. The orb is just too important; as long as he gains its approval and does not fall midway, he can grow to the level of Supreme and even Quasi-Emperor.”
“Even for those who are already Supreme and Quasi-Emperor, possessing the orb is very enticing. After all, if they manage to enhance their physical body along this path, their combat power would significantly increase. Additionally, the Innate Emperor Artifact is a powerful weapon that can greatly amplify their combat power. Who wouldn’t be tempted?”
Wang Ping was filled with emotion.
No need to mention how enticing it would be for the powerful ones; even Wang Ping, who had just taken Zhu Huowang as his disciple in the simulation, found it extremely tempting.
Obtaining the Devouring Essence Orb would be immensely beneficial to him.
If he could gather the other two Emperor Beads in the future, even a Great Emperor would abandon their pride and snatch them from others.
Even those hidden in the Source of Darkness would choose to take action.
After all, it is an Immortal Artifact, and a special one at that, capable of greatly enhancing their combat power.
“Next time I simulate, I will try to gain the approval of the Devouring Essence Orb. If I can succeed, I’ll seize it. If not, I’ll let it be.”
Wang Ping thought, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Your heart is drawn to the Devouring Essence Orb, but ultimately, you suppress the greed within. As tempting as it may be, you are a principled person who does not wish to take your newly-acquired disciple’s belonging. So, you think it’s better to try in future simulations.]
[Of course, it would be even better if it could be obtained through the reward mechanism of the Life Simulator. However, you think the probability is quite low. After all, the current Life Simulator has not been optimized again, and whether or not an Innate Emperor Artifact-level item can be refreshed remains a question.]
[Next, you chose not to continue monitoring Zhu Huowang with your avatar but to recall it and challenge the Second Imperial Son.]
[Facing your challenge, the Second Imperial Son was under great pressure. After all, his cultivation level is at the Saint King Great Perfection Tier. Although he is somewhat stronger than the Third Prince, having realized Seventy Percent Spatial Laws and paved some way to become a Great Saint, your current performance is undoubtedly more powerful.]
[You killed the demonic cultivator Great Saint, demonstrating Seventy Percent Spatial Laws and other powerful methods, currently ranking 35th on the Saint King Ranking. Your ranking is far above his, who was barely able to reach the 90th rank.]
[However, the Second Imperial Son did not shrink from the battle and fought with you. In the end, the result of the battle left all the imperial sons speechless, with the Second Imperial Son being completely stunned by you.]
[That’s because you showed no intention of holding back and directly displayed your Half-step Great Saint Tier cultivation level, defeating the Second Imperial Son with a single move. This dealt a significant blow to him; he never expected that you had already reached the Half-step Great Saint Tier. Your breakthrough speed was astonishingly fast, especially considering that your aptitude is still not as good as his.]
[As for the other veterans watching the battle, they had already seen through your Half-step Great Saint Tier level before the decisive battle, and were amazed by your sudden progress. After all, there wasn’t a trace of a breakthrough before you left.]

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge!
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Chapter 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge!
[As everyone is shocked, you used sound transmission to issue a challenge once again. This time, the target of your challenge is none other than the First Imperial Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, Yu Daohong, the son of the current Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace. He is a true monstrous genius and the face of the younger generation in Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Rumors have it that the First Imperial Son Yu Daohong has never gone all out before, and like you, he defeated the Second Imperial Son with one move. After the Second Imperial Son failed to challenge him, he willingly submitted to the First Imperial Son Yu Daohong and never mentioned the matter of competing for the position of the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace again, becoming a follower-like figure.]
[One can imagine how powerful Yu Daohong is and how terrifying his talent is to make such a monstrous genius, who is also an Imperial Son, willingly follow him.]
[This time when you challenged the First Imperial Son Yu Daohong, you didn’t think that you could defeat him. You simply wanted to see his cultivation and how strong he is.]
[Seeing that you want to challenge the First Imperial Son Yu Daohong, many old monsters shook their heads, thinking that you will lose for sure. The Second Imperial Son’s face also changed, but he didn’t say much, just believing that you would undoubtedly lose.]
[You took note of everyone’s reactions but didn’t care too much. At this moment, the suave First Imperial Son Yu Daohong appeared before you, accepting your challenge.]
[Then, the two of you engaged in a fierce battle. In this battle, Yu Daohong also displayed half-step Great Saint Cultivation. However, what you couldn’t accept was that even as a half-step Great Saint, you couldn’t last more than ten moves against him despite using the Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Golden Talent: Multiplay.]
[Seeing your disbelief after being defeated, Yu Daohong spoke softly, saying that if your Space-Time Dao Body were complete, you could have competed with him. Unfortunately, your incomplete Space-Time Dao Body was only at the level of an ordinary Holy Body.]
[After hearing Yu Daohong’s words, you fell silent. You have an intuition that he may still be hiding his true power. His performance in the previous battle was too relaxed.]
[In the end, you sighed in your heart, admiring Yu Daohong as he truly deserved to be the Emperor’s Child. He not only possessed the richest Great Emperor Bloodline but also had an incredibly formidable constitution that surpassed the level of ordinary Holy Bodies. That was why he was so powerful.]
[No wonder Bai Xiaosheng ranked Yu Daohong fifth on the Saint King Ranking. He was indeed terrifying. You initially thought that after breaking through to Half-step Great Saint, you could easily enter the top ten of the Saint King Ranking. It seems you overestimated yourself.]
[The characters in the top ten of the Saint King Ranking are most likely all at the half-step Great Saint Cultivation level and possess either extremely terrifying bloodline or constitution or both. With Yu Daohong ranked fifth, you can’t imagine what kind of freaks the first four are.]
[The Golden Age truly deserves its name, with so many monstrous geniuses emerging at once, all having the potential to become Emperors. With such thoughts in mind, you admitted defeat and left the place to enter seclusion.]
…..
“Goodness, this Yu Daohong is really not simple.”
Wang Ping sighed in admiration as he read the description of Yu Daohong in the Text Simulation.
“It seems the Golden Talent – Incomplete Space-Time Dao Body can’t catch up anymore, and I must restore its origin as soon as possible.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin while thinking to himself.
In the Last Dharma Age, his Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body was domineering and unparalleled, giving him an advantage in fighting opponents of higher levels.
Unfortunately, now that they have entered the Golden Age, various bloodlines and constitutions are emerging, and there are even Waste Material Stream Luck Children like Zhu Huowang who have obtained Innate Emperor Artifacts by chance. This has made Wang Ping’s advantage of the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body vanish.
Even worse, compared to the real monstrous geniuses in the Immortal Continent, his version has become a weaker choice, something Wang Ping couldn’t accept.
Therefore, restoring the Space-Time Dao Body has become a pressing matter.
“The Dark Star Sage of the Nine Stars Pavilion I encountered in the Last Dharma Age said that the Nine Stars Pavilion has a way to restore the origin of the Space-Time Dao Body. I wonder if he was bluffing.”
Wang Ping thought of the Nine Stars Pavilion and the Dark Star Sage, his eyes shining with determination.
He had joined Taiyi Emperor Palace and had shown outstanding performance. If the Taiyi Emperor Palace could help him restore the foundation of his Space-Time Dao Body, they would not hesitate to do so.
Since the Taiyi Emperor Palace didn’t do it, it meant that they couldn’t do it.
However, the Dark Star Sage claimed that the Nine Stars Pavilion could do it, which made Wang Ping doubt its authenticity.
After all, Dark Star Sage was just a Great Saint, did he really know those secrets?
“Whether it’s true or not, I must join the Nine Stars Pavilion again. Even if there are no solutions in the Nine Stars Pavilion, there may be some clues. After all, the Nine Stars Pavilion is suspected of being a force built by the All Heavens.”
With this thought, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[As you enter seclusion in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, news of your exploits has spread, and you have once again become the subject of heated discussion. Bai Xiaosheng also promoted your ranking on the Saint King Ranking to seventeenth place.]
[Unfortunately, though your ranking has improved, this time you have mostly become a stepping stone for Yu Daohong, the First Imperial Son. People are more interested in discussing how strong he is now, and whether he has made any further progress.]

chapters.title: Chapter 727: 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Chapter 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge!_2
[Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, two years have gone by. With the contribution points you earned from completing tasks and becoming the Second Imperial Son, you successfully cultivated in the Taiyi Emperor Tower for two years. Thanks to the Taiyi Emperor Tower, your understanding of the law advanced, although not achieving an 80% grasp of the space law, you reached the peak level of 70% comprehension.]
[You are confident that if you continue to cultivate in the Taiyi Emperor Tower for another two years, you can truly comprehend 80% of the Space Law, thus further enhancing your combat capabilities.]
[Next, instead of idling in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you chose to continue taking quests from the palace to earn more contribution points and, while on missions, continue searching for individuals with the Son of Fortune’s talent to take as apprentices, assisting you in breaking through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[If you could break through to the Great Saint Tier in a short time, you’d have the chance to challenge Yu Daohong again. You really don’t believe that with a higher cultivation level than him, you wouldn’t be able to defeat him. Though overwhelming people by having a higher realm may seem shameful, as long as it clears your mind, it’s acceptable.]
[However, disappointingly, finding someone like Zhu Huowang, the Son of Fortune, or monsters with powerful physiques like Wan Yu, was not easy. Despite the fact that the majority of Heaven’s Chosen Monsters are gathered in the Immortal Continent, they aren’t easy to come by.]
[Moreover, all the major forces have far-reaching influences; they can sense the birth of a monster to some extent and take them away beforehand, or the monsters are already born into these major powers. It’s extremely difficult for you to find loopholes and take them as apprentices.]
[At this time, you recalled Lin Yan, whom you encountered on the Elemental Star. Lin Yan, who managed to deal with the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint with his Divine Realm Cultivation, must possess numerous secrets and qualify as someone with great fortune. If you took him as your apprentice, you might be able to break through to the Great Saint Tier with his help.]
[However, after careful consideration, you felt that Lin Yan might not be as monstrous as Lin Qinghe and your chances of breaking through to the Great Saint Tier with his help aren’t high. But, once you break through to the Great Saint Tier, you might be able to take him as an apprentice and use that to advance another small realm.]
[Aside from Lin Yan, you also thought of Dao Palace’s Fang Xingyu. Even though Fang Xingyu had no notable performances and seemed mediocre, he had a presence in the Life Simulator, making him non-ordinary. If you took him as an apprentice, you might obtain a Cultivation Reward.]
[At this thought, you felt regretful. As it’s already the Golden Age, their whereabouts are unknown, and taking them as apprentices is impossible. You’ll have to wait for the next simulation to try again.]
[Eventually, after merely completing the tasks assigned by the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you returned home.]
[In the blink of an eye, almost a century passed. During that time, your cultivation didn’t improve much, but with the help of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, your comprehension of the law reached 80% peak level and wasn’t far from 90%.]
[Then, a letter from Ji Bingyan appeared before you once again. After meeting with Ji Bingyan and catching up, you accepted her request to help the Jee family gain a spot in the secret realm.]
[This time, you planned to thoroughly investigate the Cold Pool’s depths and uncover its secrets. Unable to learn about the Cold Pool’s secrets, you hoped to seize the Heavenly Ice, make it recognize its master, and obtain the Heavenly Ice Body.]
[When you appeared, the 14th Emperor’s Son from the Taiyi Imperial Palace had a dark expression on his face. The Wang Family’s faces were also extremely dark as they didn’t expect the Jee Family to get your help, the illustrious Second Imperial Son.]
[In the end, without suspense, even though the Wang Family fought hard and achieved a score of three to three, in the final battle, the 14th Emperor’s Son didn’t bother to compete with you and directly conceded.]
[The Wang Family was helpless but had no choice but to accept their defeat.]
[Afterward, you joined the Jee family’s members and entered the secret realm. Not wasting any time, you began to comprehend the laws within. Finally, by utilizing the secret realm, you successfully understood 90% of the Space Law, significantly boosting your power.]
[When there wasn’t much time left, you chose to venture deep into the Cold Pool. This time, due to your stronger power, diving into the depths of the pool and encountering the Heavenly Ice was much more effortless than before.]
[Therefore, you once again touched the Heavenly Ice, aiming to subdue it. Unfortunately, your actions enraged the Heavenly Ice again. It released terrifying cold air, intending to freeze you.]
[Again, you felt a life-threatening danger, resorting to using the Secret Skill to increase your power and protect yourself with Space Divine Skills. However, regrettably, you found that the Heavenly Ice was genuinely terrifying. As a Heaven and Earth Treasure, even with your current strength, you couldn’t resist such a horrifying chill. The use of Space Divine Skills to transfer it had its limits.]
[In your mind, you speculated that if you wanted to genuinely resist this cold air, you probably need to advance your cultivation to the Great Saint Tier.]

chapters.title: Chapter 728: 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Chapter 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge! _3
[However, you didn’t panic and chose to use the effect of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification to forcefully break through the coldness and grab the Heavenly Ice.]
[The Heavenly Ice struggled violently, releasing even more terrifying coldness, utterly unwilling to accept you. Knowing that your efforts would be in vain, you sighed.]
[You didn’t try to make the Heavenly Ice accept you, but instead planned to escape from here by using Golden Talent: Transmission while the duration of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification hasn’t yet elapsed.]
[After all, if you don’t escape, you will be completely frozen and fall into an abnormal state, which would be a waste of your precious simulation times, something you’re unwilling to see.]
[However, just as you were preparing to teleport, you sensed an unusual aura coming from the depths of the Cold Pool and found your body desperately craving for something below. This left you feeling uneasy.]
[Your intuition tells you that whatever lies beneath is crucial to you. If you can obtain the hidden opportunity, you could truly transform.]
[But you also know that you can’t even pass the Heavenly Ice stage, and it’s nearly impossible for you to dive deeper into the Cold Pool and obtain this opportunity. Insisting on seizing it would only lead to death.]
[Consequently, you let go of your greed and hastily used Golden Talent: Transmission to escape from there.]
…
“This Heavenly Ice is really troublesome. It seems this opportunity doesn’t belong to me.”
Wang Ping sighed at the content of the Text Simulation.
Unless he reached a terrifying level of cultivation to suppress the Heavenly Ice and forcibly refine it, he couldn’t think of obtaining the Heavenly Ice Body.
But at that level of cultivation, a Heavenly Ice Body would be optional to him, which makes it very contradictory.
“Perhaps I should focus more on another opportunity in the Cold Pool.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he thought secretly.
“Right now, I definitely can’t delve into the depths of the Cold Pool. But if Cai Yonglong comes to the Upper Realm and cooperates with his optimized Golden Finger, maybe we can give it a try.”
“After all, Cai’s Golden Finger has been optimized once now, and the duration of Absolute Defense has been increased to one minute. A one-minute invincible defense is actually quite terrifying. Although it’s still insignificant compared to the potential of his original Golden Finger.”
Wang Ping shook his head, sighed softly, and shifted his focus to Cai Yonglong.
If even Cai Yonglong couldn’t help, Wang Ping had nothing else to do.
“The problem is that I need the Jee family to give an extra spot for Cai Yonglong to enter.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he muttered to himself.
“However, with my status and identity, the Jee family will definitely be willing to do me this favor.”
With this in mind, Wang Ping focused on the luminescent screen.
[After you teleported away, the secret realm closed, and Ji Bingyan was shocked to find that you hadn’t been teleported out, causing her great anxiety. Even the Jee family was worried. If you were left in the secret realm, it would be terrible news for the Jee family.]
[As the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you have a noble status and incredible potential. Without an accidental fall, you’re destined to become a Tao Proving Supreme, and even achieve Quasi-Emperor is not impossible.]
[Such a figure is extremely valuable even in a place like Taiyi Imperial Palace and is a part of the palace’s future higher-ups. If something were to happen to you, the Jee family might have to face Taiyi Imperial Palace’s blame, paying a huge price even if it doesn’t lead to Genocide.]
[However, no matter how anxious the Jee family was, you were unaware. At that moment, you teleported to a mysterious place using Golden Talent: Transmission.]
[This place is filled with fog, making it impossible to see where you are. No matter what method you used, you couldn’t escape the foggy area. This made you frown, suspecting that you might have fallen into an Illusion Array.]
[For a while, you felt helpless, thinking that the teleportation destination seemed to be a trap, and that you might be doomed.]
[Just as you were feeling pessimistic about the outcome, your consciousness suddenly flickered, and you escaped from the fog, arriving in a strange village.]
[In front of you stood a cyclops elder, who looked at you curiously with his single eye.]
[You stared at the cyclops elder, astonished, sensing his extraordinariness – an existence you couldn’t possibly contend with. With this in mind, you began to behave respectfully, expressing that your unexpected arrival here was not intended to disturb him and that you hoped he wouldn’t take offense.]
[The cyclops elder laughed and said that he didn’t mind your sudden presence, but he was curious about what had happened to you, allowing you to teleport to this place. After all, even Heaven Supremes could not teleport here.]
[The elder’s words made you realize the likelihood of him being a Quasi-Emperor, and lying to him wouldn’t end well, nor could you deceive him.]
[Therefore, you had no choice but to reveal your secret, that you had a disposable talisman that brought you here upon use.]

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 211 Pure-blooded Phoenix! Law soars! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Chapter 211 Pure-blooded Phoenix! Law soars! _4
[“Your words have made the cyclops elder stare at you for a long time before he finally chuckled, seeming to believe you.”]
[Relieved, you humbly inquire about this place and who the elder is.]
[The cyclops elder responds to your queries with a grin, stating that this is Chrysanthemum Village, a village of hermits. After this, he cautions you not to ask too many questions. If it weren’t for your status as the Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you would have been killed a thousand times over.]
[You are somewhat surprised. Unexpectedly, this is a village of hermits. Could there be more than one Quasi-Emperor, like the cyclops elder, or even Supremes and Quasi-Emperors in this village?]
[At the same time, you finally understand why the obviously unkind cyclops elder did not kill you. He clearly respects the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Otherwise, according to the elder, even the Supreme beings would have perished if they intruded here without permission.]
[Next, you express your intent not to disturb the elders in their seclusion and wish to leave, hoping that the cyclops elder would allow you to.]
[Listening to your words, the cyclops elder chuckles before preparing to teleport you out of the village. At that moment, a pair of twin girls flew into the sky shouting that they are all grown up and no longer want to drink animal milk.]
[Seeing this, you are somewhat astounded as you realize that these twin girls have reached the Saint tier in their cultivation. However, given their youthful appearances, it is quite surprising.]
[Although the age of a cultivator cannot be judged by their appearance, you have studied secret skills like physiognomy, and you can tell a person’s approximate age from their face and life energy.]
[The twins, who appear to be about eleven or twelve years old, have extremely vigorous life energy, so their real age is probably around twenty. A saint at around twenty, although not comparable to the innate saints of the Profound Universe which you experienced, is very formidable.]
[The innate saint was completely a fluke, while the twins in front of you clearly cultivated their way to the Saint tier. Even though these twins are intimately related to the cyclops elder and other hermits, it is still surprising.]
[While various thoughts arise in your mind, the cyclops elder affectionately watches the twins before turning to you with a cold look filled with killing intent.]
[This makes the hairs on your body stand on end as a chill runs from your feet up your spine, leaving your body cold. You realize that the cyclops elder apparently has murderous thoughts for you.]
[All of this is because you have seen the twins. It becomes evident that these twins are very important to the cyclops elder, who does not want you to know of their existence. More accurately, he does not want anyone from the outer world to know about them.]
[While you are surprised, you also become more curious about the secrets of this village and the twin girls.]
[While various thoughts flash in your mind, the cyclops elder retracts his killing intent and does not choose to kill you. Thus, you finally let out a sigh of relief.]
[Although it is just a simulation and there is nothing wrong with dying, it would be a pity to die this way. If possible, you still want to gather more information and become stronger.]
[As you are pondering various matters, the cyclops elder is smiling and says that since you came here and saw these things, he cannot let you leave. From today onwards, you should stay quietly in Chrysanthemum Village. Also, the two kids are short of playmates, better than them constantly pestering their old bones.]
[Upon hearing the elder’s words, you are somewhat helpless, not expecting him not to let you go and planning to imprison you here. However, as helpless as you are, you also become interested in the two girls, thinking that you might be able to uncover the mysteries of Chrysanthemum Village this time.]
[These twin girls are definitely not simple. After understanding many things, you may be able to take them as disciples when you grow to the level of a Quasi-Emperor or even stronger.]
[Even though it is difficult to become a Quasi-Emperor or higher in the real world within a hundred years, you still have enough confidence in the Life Simulator.]
[Next, the cyclops elder seals your cultivation and plants a secret skill in your body. This leaves you in a state of helplessness. It seems you won’t be able to cultivate for a while. However, you won’t be able to break through to the Great Saint Tier in a short time anyway. As long as you don’t meditate and seek enlightenment, it won’t really affect you.]
…..
“This Chrysanthemum Village is truly terrifying. But the name of the village is a bit strange. Is it some old coot’s weird taste?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation with a peculiar look in his eyes.
[Next, the cyclops elder takes you into the village. Then you get to learn how many people there really are in Chrysanthemum Village.]
[Chrysanthemum Village has a total of nineteen people. The identities of some of them are unclear to you, but some you recognize from the ancient books of Taiyi Imperial Palace, they are all legendary figures. All of them are Quasi-Emperors and have notorious reputations.]

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Chapter 211: Pure Blood Phoenix! Rule Surge! _5
[This makes your scalp numb, you never imagined that Chrysanthemum Village would be so terrifying, not even a Heaven Supreme is eligible to be hidden here, all of them are well-known Quasi-Emperors.]
[Then, you also found out the names of the two twin girls, they are called Huan Qing and Huangyin and possess the Pure Phoenix Bloodline, being the True Descendants of the Phoenix Clan. Pure-blooded Phoenixes and the Pure-blooded Dragon Clan are powerful ethnic groups, the strongest amongst the monster beasts’ Imperial Clans, and even human imperial-tier forces would not mess around with these two groups.]
[You never expected Huan Qing and Huang Yin to have such a big background. You can’t help but wonder if the Immortals of the Chrysanthemum Village hid these Phoenix Descendants here and tried to silence him when he discovered them.]
[If so, it would explain the actions of the cyclops elder. After all, if the abduction of two young Pure-blooded Phoenix Descendants came to light, the Emperor of the Pure-blooded Phoenix Clan would personally take action against these hidden immortals.]
[As you despise these immortals for attracting Phoenixes in your heart, Huan Qing and Huangyin are also enthusiastically greeting you. The village is too boring, full of old people, with no fun at all. Now that there is a young person, they are naturally curious and passionate.]
[Seeing Huan Qing and Huang Yin so enthusiastic, and wanting to take you along to play, naturally, you accompany them in their games, bridging the gap between you, not only telling various stories but also adapting some games from home.]
[Before long, your relationship heated up quickly, becoming close friends of the opposite sex. Seeing how much fun you have with the two kids, the Immortals of Chrysanthemum Village were quite surprised, and their regard for you improved.]
[In their eyes, although you are the Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you are not taken very seriously. After all, unless it’s Yu Daohong of Taiyi Imperial Palace, other Emperor’s sons may have a higher chance of becoming Supreme or greater, but as for Quasi-Emperor, it’s not certain.]
[Even if they truly qualify as a Quasi-Emperor, they cannot compare to them and won’t be taken seriously. Even those who become Quasi-Emperors are like that, let alone a young genius just starting to grow.]
[Therefore, your Emperor’s son status and potential don’t concern them at all; their main focus is whether you can make Huan Qing and Huangyin happy, and stop these naughty little girls from bothering them. Besides that, they also hope you can get Huangyin and Huangqing to focus on their cultivation.]
…..
“Pure-blooded Phoenix Clan, good heavens… this identity is truly astonishing.”
Wang Ping looks at the Text Simulation content and can’t help but be amazed.
With such a bloodline and the position they hold in the hearts of these old monsters, Huangyin and Huangqing may be the kind of existence that must become Quasi-Emperors in the future, or even have hopes of becoming Emperors of Tao Proving.
If that’s the case, it would be scary.
Pure-blooded Phoenixes and Pure-blooded Dragons are already powerful in the same realm. Once they Prove the Tao as Emperors, their strength would probably surpass that of many emperors.
Not to mention, this is a set of twins… If both become Emperors, who can be their opponents?
The old monsters of Chrysanthemum Village may be planning a big game.
Wang Ping thinks secretly in his heart, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed. During this time, you managed to maintain good relations with these old monsters, and shamelessly took advantage of resources from Huan Qing and Huangyin, as well as eavesdropping on their lectures on the Tao. As a result, your understanding of mana greatly advanced.]
[Your understanding of Space Law has reached the peak of 90%, just one step away from reaching the Great Perfection tier. Compared to Space Law, the progress of your Mana of Fire is even more astonishing.]
[Since both Huan Qing and Huangyin are Phoenixes and walk the path of fire, the old monsters focus on teaching the path of Fire. You benefit from this, and your understanding of the Flame Law eventually soars to the Great Perfection Tier.]
[Not only did you gain great benefits, but Huan Qing and Huangyin’s growth is even more impressive. In just a hundred years, their cultivation has reached the Saint King Perfect tier, and their understanding of the Flame Law has reached the Great Perfection Tier.]
[Having reached the Saint King Great Perfection at the age of 120, with the Great Perfection of Flame Law, if this gets out, it’s estimated that many geniuses would feel disheartened.]
[Aside from other geniuses, even a prodigy like yourself finds it hard to remain calm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Chapter 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time
[During the time you spent cultivating in secret in Chrysanthemum Village, many major events happened in the outer world. The Jee family has been concealing information for years, searching for you everywhere, but ultimately found nothing, and has become increasingly anxious.]
[However, fortunately, the Jee family hired someone to deduce the Heavenly Secrets and discovered that you did not fall, but just couldn’t find your specific location. This could at least give an explanation to Taiyi Imperial Palace. Even if Taiyi Imperial Palace knew that you disappeared from the secret realm, they wouldn’t blame the Jee family too much.]
[In addition, during this century, many major events have occurred in the Immortal Continent, and many legendary monsters that have been sealed for countless years have successively emerged, causing huge waves throughout the entire Immortal Continent.]
[Among these legendary monsters, there are some as powerful as Yu Daohong, and even surpassing him. The most terrifying one among them is named Lei Wanqian. He possesses the Great Thunder Immortal Physique, which is extremely domineering. The Immortal Physique is extremely terrifying, transcending many physiques and bloodlines, and the talents it brings are beyond the reach of ordinary geniuses.]
[As a result, as soon as Lei Wanqian emerged, he challenged Shi Yuyan, the second on the Saint King Ranking. This battle was extremely terrifying, and the combat power of both parties made many Great Saints silent, and they could only sigh that they were already old, and the strength of these young monsters was already superior to them.]
[In the end, the outcome of this battle was that Lei Wanqian forcefully defeated Shi Yuyan, the second on the Saint King Ranking, and replaced her.]
[After defeating Shi Yuyan, the second on the Saint King Ranking, Lei Wanqian, with the Great Thunder Immortal Physique, challenged Ku Xuan, the first on the Saint King Ranking. Ku Xuan, the first on the Saint King Ranking, comes from the Longevity Ku Family. It is rumored that the origin of the Longevity Ku Family is very mysterious, inherited for countless years.]
[In the recorded history of the Upper Realm, there have been traces of the Ku Family. A great emperor once said that the Upper Realm might have gone through a real Last Dharma Age, with everything withering away. The World of Cultivators that were born before the Last Dharma Age were all buried in the dust of history, leaving no traces, as if they had never appeared.]
[However, only the Ku Family seems to have survived that extremely long-lasting Last Dharma Age, and have been a Longevity Clan since the last epoch.]
[However, few people from the Ku family have traveled through the Immortal Continent, and no one knows what the situation of the Ku family is, even the great emperor can hardly figure out the current situation of the Ku family.]
[However, whether it’s the Great Emperor, Quasi-Emperor, or Supreme, those who can come into contact with some hidden powerhouses all know one thing. That is, when the Ku family has descendants out in the world, they must be extremely monstrous existences, and it also means that a terrifying new era is coming.]
[And now this Ku Family’s descendant, Ku Xuan, has been unbeatable since his debut. No one knows how strong he really is, not even Shi Yuyan, who was second on the Saint King List, had survived only a few moves against him. He is the universally recognized strongest among the younger generation in the entire Immortal Continent.]
[Now, Lei Wanqian, who possesses the Great Thunder Immortal Physique, wants to challenge Ku Xuan, who is first on the Saint King Ranking, which naturally attracts the attention of many cultivators in the Immortal Continent. Not to mention the peerless monsters of the same generation, even those Supremes, Quasi-Emperors, and even Great Emperors are very interested in their battle.]
[In the end, Ku Xuan, the first on the Saint King Ranking, and from the Longevity Ku Family, appeared in front of everyone in a white robe and faced Lei Wanqian, who possessed the Great Thunder Immortal Physique. The result of this battle was shocking to everyone.]
[At the beginning of the battle between the two, they seemed evenly matched. However, towards the end, Lei Wanqian fully activated the Great Thunder Immortal Physique, bringing his combat power to the extreme, but Ku Xuan still maintained a calm expression, easily suppressing him.]
[In the end, Lei Wanqian was defeated, and Ku Xuan continued to sit firmly on the throne of the first place in the Saint King Ranking, with no one able to shake him. In fact, from this day on, a saying began to spread throughout the Immortal Continent: “The world’s geniuses: Ku Xuan alone in one tier, and the rest of the geniuses vie for the second.]
…
“The classic God’s-eye view is here. This golden age is getting more and more exciting, and all kinds of weird things are coming out.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and sighed secretly in his heart.
Now, even Yu Daohong, who can easily defeat him and has unfathomable strength, is probably not even able to be in the top 10 of the Saint King List.
As for Wang Ping’s ranking in this simulation, the 17th place is most likely unattainable. The only question is how far he will fall.
“But it’s good to have talented people. If I can figure out the identities and backgrounds of these geniuses on the Saint King List, there will be a chance to pick up some treasures. Besides, when I become stronger, I can take them as disciples, and it would still be delightful.”
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping’s mouth slightly raised, and he began to imagine the future.
Anyway, he’s done this kind of thing before.
Whether it was Ye Chen or Lin Qinghe, he was initially just their peer, and he wasn’t even as good as them.
As a result, he strengthened himself in a short period with the help of the Life Simulator and then took them as his disciples.
With the Life Simulator, at most, he’s only a peer with these people within a certain period. As his cultivation improves, he can have them as his juniors and disciples.
Even if his age is younger than these people, it’s still the same.
As this thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, he enjoyed the feeling tremendously while continuing to look at the luminescent screen.
[While the entire Immortal Continent was in turmoil, something happened on your side too. Because Huan Qing and Huangyin couldn’t contain their impatience any longer, they began to act coquettishly towards the old fellows in Chrysanthemum Village, hoping that they would be allowed to go out.]

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Chapter 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time_2
[Regarding this, the cyclops elder and the other Quasi-Emperors were somewhat hesitant. If possible, they hoped that Huan Qing and Huang Yin would stay in Chrysanthemum Village to cultivate to the Supreme level before going out. However, as notorious Quasi-Emperors, they naturally knew that self-cultivation would only waste the talents of the two girls and limit their future achievements.]
[Therefore, the two had to go out and make a break for themselves. This would be more beneficial for their growth and would give them a better chance of attaining the title of Emperor, or even finding Immortal Fates.]
[In the end, after discussions among these old monsters, they decided to let Huan Qing and Huang Yin leave. However, they also thought about your existence and couldn’t help but frown. You had been in Chrysanthemum Village for such a long time and knew a lot about the village. If you left like this, many secrets of the village would be exposed.]
[Therefore, in the hearts of these notorious Quasi-Emperors, erasing you directly would be the best option for dealing with this issue once and for all.]
[However, considering your performance in the village over the years, and all the times you made Huan Qing and Huang Yin happy, easing their minds, they decided not to kill you, but instead deal with you in another way.]
[Of course, the main reason for not killing you was not only because of what you had done, but also because Huan Qing and Huang Yin considered you their friend. They didn’t want to break the girls’ hearts.]
[After discussing, the old monsters called you over and warned that if you dared to divulge the secrets of Chrysanthemum Village, the consequences would be dire.]
[Regarding this, you were helpless and could only promise not to reveal anything. These old monsters turned their noses up at your promise, not believing you, so they planted numerous Secret Skills on you.]
[Silent in your heart, you didn’t say anything more.]
[In the end, the old monsters instructed you to protect Huang Yin and Huan Qing when you went to the outer world. Although the two girls had extraordinary talents and were exceptional, their hearts were too innocent. Even though the monsters had taught them a lot over the years, they were still easily deceived. After all, they fully understood how dangerous people could be.]
[Hearing the words of the old monsters, you first patted your chest to guarantee your loyalty, then jokingly said that you were too weak, and that they should give you some Supreme Artifacts, Forbidden Artifacts, or even Quasi-Emperor Artifacts to help defend against powerful enemies.]
[Hearing your words, the old monsters’ faces turned dark. They thought you were treating Supreme Artifacts and Quasi-Emperor Artifacts as though they were cabbages. Soon after, the old monsters directly threw you out. At this, you couldn’t help but despise the old monsters in your heart, scoffing at how stingy they were.]
[Following that, you left Chrysanthemum Village together with Huang Yin and Huan Qing and arrived in the outer world. Then, you finally learned where Chrysanthemum Village was located.]
[In the Immortal Continent, there were many Forbidden Areas and mysterious lands. Chrysanthemum Village was situated in one of these Forbidden Areas, the White Fog Forbidden Area, where even Quasi-Emperors risked their lives by entering.]
[At this, you could only marvel at how powerful the cyclops elder and the other Quasi-Emperors were for hiding in such a place. However, you also felt that they were likely not hiding here, but rather avoiding something.]
[You had to understand that these people had become infamous by causing havoc, not by quietly cultivating. Although it was normal for those who became Quasi-Emperors to have mountains of corpses under their feet, they were still the fierce and ruthless type among the Quasi-Emperors, and forcing them into seclusion would surely make them uncomfortable.]
[As a result, it was most likely that they had offended powerful enemies and entered the White Fog Forbidden Area to escape them, while also sticking together for support.]
[As for the possibility of them kidnapping Huan Qing and Huang Yin, you now believed that the chances of this were extremely low. If they had really kidnapped the two, they would not have let them go.]
[However, even though you had many guesses in your heart, you still needed to search for clues, so you didn’t think too much about it. Instead, you began to wander the Immortal Continent with Huan Qing and Huang Yin.]
[When you asked Huan Qing and Huang Yin about their plans, they said that they wanted to wander around first, and then challenge all kinds of talented individuals to see how powerful the monsters of the outer world, praised by their grandparents, truly were.]
[Seeing this, you smiled and promised not to disappoint them. At the same time, a strong desire to fight welled up in your heart. By now, your strength had also increased significantly. Although you hadn’t broken through to the Great Saint Tier, you should have been able to climb a few ranks in the Saint King Ranking.]
[However, when you learned about the many events that had happened in the past hundred years and found out that even Yu Daohong had lost several battles and fallen from the top-ranked spot, you became silent. Ku Xuan, Lei Wanqian, and Shi Yuyan had all shown terrifying combat abilities, especially Ku Xuan, who was even more outrageous than someone with cheats.]
[Compared to these monsters, you were still slightly weaker. You originally thought of advancing to higher rankings, but now, as your rank in the Saint King Ranking had fallen to the 70th position, it was questionable whether you could even return to the 35th position you once held.]
[In comparison to your silence, Huan Qing and Huang Yin became excited. The numerous monsters in the outer world were eye-opening for them, and they felt that the grandparents in Chrysanthemum Village had not deceived them. Therefore, they planned to challenge each one of them.]

chapters.title: Chapter 733: 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: Chapter 212: Immortal Gate! A Shocking Revelation of the Source of Time_3
[However, Huan Qing and Huangyin were surprised when they thought about your ranking as the 70th on the Saint King Ranking. After all, they didn’t know how strong you were since your cultivation was sealed when you were in Chrysanthemum Village. Now, seeing your name on the Saint King Ranking, they naturally find it quite astonishing and can’t help but clench their fists, wanting to have a battle with you.]
[At this, you couldn’t help but roll your eyes, patting Huan Qing and Huangyin’s heads, indicating that the two of them should break through to the Half-step Great Saint realm before considering a fight with you.]
[Although Huan Qing and Huangyin are indeed monsters, having not only powerful bloodlines but also extremely astonishing comprehension abilities, with few people able to compare with them, their cultivation is ultimately only at the level of Saint King Great Perfection, which is a realm lower than yours, making it very difficult for them to defeat you in a battle.]
[Upon hearing your words, Huan Qing and Huangyin were very unconvinced and still wanted to have a battle with you. Unable to dissuade them, you let out a helpless sigh and chose to face the challenge.]
[In the end, there was no doubt that both Huan Qing and Huangyin lost to you. However, their performance shocked you. The pure-blooded Phoenixes were indeed terrifying. Their physical bodies were much stronger than you had imagined. Moreover, with the powerful bloodline comparable to a complete Time-Space Body from a pure-blooded Phoenix, you were almost defeated by them in a battle across realms.]
[After being defeated by you one after another, Huan Qing and Huangyin were a bit frustrated, but they also felt that their cultivation was somewhat weak. They plan to break through to the Half-step Great Saint realm before challenging you again and then go on to challenge the monsters on the Saint King Ranking.]
[At this, you feel a sense of urgency in your heart, thinking that you must quickly break through to the Great Saint Tier. Otherwise, when these two girls break through to the Half-step Great Saint realm, you might get beaten up by them, which is something you do not want to see.]
[After all, having lived together for so long, you treat them as your own sisters. Being beaten up by your own sisters would be quite embarrassing.]
[Just as various thoughts flashed through your mind, a vast and powerful Dao sound suddenly echoed throughout the entire Upper Realm, leaving many cultivators, including yourself, deeply shocked.]
[The content was ‘Heavenly Calculations predict, the Chaotic Era will come, the Immortal Realm will appear, and the Immortal Mansion will reopen, collecting the chosen ones, nurturing Immortal Seedlings, suppressing the chaos, and opening the gates to the Immortal Realm.]
…..
“Immortal Mansion?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, feeling quite amazed.
From the knowledge gained through the previous simulation, he naturally knew what kind of force the Immortal Mansion was.
In the Upper Realm, the Immortal Mansion was an extremely mysterious force, and it was unclear who created it.
There were rumors that the Immortal Mansion was not created by a Great Emperor, but by an existence surpassing the Great Emperor Tier.
However, many people did not believe this rumor.
After all, the Great Emperor was the most powerful existence in this world, and only the legendary Immortals could qualify to be stronger than a Great Emperor.
Nevertheless, it has been concluded that there are no Immortals in this world.
Countless talented Great Emperors have failed to become Immortals, unable to truly achieve immortality, so they can only actively enter the Source of Darkness and struggle to survive within it, achieving a form of alternative immortality.
Regardless, Wang Ping may not believe that the creator of the Immortal Mansion is the legendary Immortal, but the fact that the Immortal Mansion is extremely mysterious and powerful remains undeniable.
This is because, within the Immortal Mansion, only the Quasi-Emperors can become mentors, while even the Supremes are not qualified.
The purpose of the Immortal Mansion’s creation is also very pure, and that is to seek Immortal Fate and cultivate a true Immortal.
It is said that the area where the Immortal Mansion is located has an Immortal Gate, and when the Immortal Gate opens, it will reveal Immortal Fate.
However, as the Immortal Gate opens and the Immortal Fate emerges, so too will a great calamity.
No one knows what this calamity is, but according to the records from Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Upper Realm has experienced numerous extinction events, all of which are closely related to the opening of the Immortal Gate.
The damage caused by the Source of Darkness pales in comparison to the calamities that occur when the Immortal Gate opens.
Of course, Wang Ping understands that the Source of Darkness is merely a terrifyingly bizarre existence that has extended one of its tendrils into this world and has never truly erupted.
If it had, then the catastrophe brought about by the opening of the Immortal Gate would certainly not match up to the Source of Darkness.
So-called Dark Disasters are merely the Source of Darkness casually stirring up trouble, and whether they are initiated by the Source of Darkness itself remains to be seen.
“The appearance of the Golden Age implies that the great calamity is coming, history repeating itself. The mysterious Ku Family will produce a descendant and give rise to the Golden Age. The ancients did not deceive me.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but exclaim, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As the Immortal Mansion sent out the Dao sound, the entire Upper Realm was shaken. Whether it was ordinary cultivators, monsters, already grown Great Saints and Quasi-Emperors, or even the Great Emperors, they were all deeply moved.]
[Even within the Source of Darkness, there were movements, awakening many Dark Emperors and powerful living beings, all looking in the direction of the Immortal Mansion.]
[As for you, your heart was also stirred, and you planned to go to the Immortal Mansion. Although you do not believe that you will gain Immortal Fate in this life, it’s still a good thing if you can gather information.]
[However, before that, there are still many things you need to handle, and you are not too anxious about it. As long as one meets the criteria, regardless of whether you are a heaven-sent genius from any faction or a loose cultivator with great fortune, you can enter the Immortal Mansion when it reopens.]

chapters.title: Chapter 734: 212: Immortal Door! Astonishing Appearance of the Origin of Time_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Chapter 212: Immortal Door! Astonishing Appearance of the Origin of Time_4
“[However, before the Immortal Mansion has determined the opening time of the mansion’s gate, no one can enter the Immortal Mansion. So, it would be pointless for you to go now.]
“[Next, after the excited Huang Qing and Huang Yin calmed down, you first brought the two to the Jee family. Since the distance from here to the Jee family is not far off, making a detour has no harm. Soon, you met Ji Bingyan, and so on.]
“[Upon your arrival, the members of the Jee family were relieved. At the same time, the Jee family’s old monsters were quite surprised when they saw Huang Qing and Huang Yin, recognizing them as pure-blooded phoenixes. They can’t help but admire your good fortune, being able to be intimate with two pure-blooded phoenixes.]
[At the same time, they also sighed that even pure-blooded phoenixes have appeared, and two of them at once. The Golden Age is truly getting more lively, with the quality and number of emerging talents far exceeding those of the past Golden Ages.]
[Everyone knows that this trend has not yet reached its peak. Many talents definitely exist in the Nine Mini Universes, and the emergence of a few monsters that go beyond common sense is also very normal. With the opening of the Immortal Mansion, the Immortal Gate will reveal itself, and these people will absolutely come to the Immortal Continent.]
“[Perhaps, many monsters in this lifetime will become the Emperor of Tao Proving. The emergence of a true immortal is also a possibility.]
“[As for Ji Bingyan, she doesn’t have as much thought as the old monsters of the Jee family. Seeing the intimate interaction between you, Huang Qing, and Huang Yin, she felt a bit complicated, but she didn’t say much.]
“[Next, after saying goodbye to Ji Bingyan, you plan to head back to Taiyi Imperial Palace. As for the matter of breaking through the Great Saint realm by recruiting disciples, you can only leave it to fate. Unfortunately, you can’t take Huang Yin and Huang Qing as disciples. Although you have tried to use methods like mental mentor to trigger bugs, all attempts ended up as failures.]
[Clearly, for the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to transform stronger, only when you truly take someone as a disciple, go through the Inviting Teaching Ceremony, and the disciple truly regards you as their master in the Cultivation Path, can you trigger its effect.]
“[Shortly after, you left with Huang Qing and Huang Yin to head back to Taiyi Imperial Palace. However, on this journey, Huang Qing and Huang Yin aren’t obedient, challenging the sons of major powers and even the lower ranked geniuses on the Saint King Ranking along the way.]
“[Every battle they fought resulted in a splendid victory, which rapidly propelled them to fame and caused quite a commotion, attracting not a small amount of trouble. Even you were forced to fight a fierce battle with a newly emerged genius from the Saint King Ranking, barely achieving victory.]
“[In the end, your rank on the Saint King Ranking rose to the sixtieth position. However, you weren’t too elated. You discovered something decidedly serious: before going to Chrysanthemum Village, you snatched the seventeenth position on the Saint King Ranking with your Half-step Great Saint Cultivation. Now that your ranking has fallen, you notice that those geniuses from a hundred years ago who hadn’t reached the Half-Step Great Saint Tier have now made a breakthrough to the Half-Step Great Saint Tier as well.]
“[After these people made a breakthrough in their cultivation, they once again demonstrated their constitution and bloodline advantage, becoming terrifyingly strong. Had it not been for your talent and the near-perfect comprehension of Space Law and Perfect Flame Law, you might have had trouble defeating them.]
“[After all, among the top hundred of the current Saint King Ranking, your Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body is at the bottom, becoming a real weak point.]
“[This makes you yearn even more for the Complete Space-Time Dao Body. You urgently want to make up for this weakness.]
“[However, before you could return to Taiyi Imperial Palace, you, Huang Qing, and Huang Yin encountered an attack. Caught off guard by a surprise attack from a Quasi-Emperor, you didn’t even have a chance to use Golden Talent: Transmission or Golden Talent: Damage Nullification. You were ruthlessly suppressed and entered a state of resurrection.]
“[After killing you, this mysterious Quasi-Emperor looked towards Huang Qing and Huang Yin, his eyes filled with greed, intending to take action against them.]
“[It was just when the Quasi-Emperor was about to attack Huang Qing and Huang Yin that the Protective Talismans on their bodies were activated, and the incarnation of the cyclops elder appeared here, his killing intent surging, engaging in a grand battle with this mysterious Quasi-Emperor.]
“[It must be said, the cyclops elder is indeed powerful, with just an incarnation, he was able to suppress the mysterious Quasi-Emperor and protect both Huang Qing and Huang Yin. In the end, the mysterious Quasi-Emperor escaped in disgrace and vanished without a trace.]”
“[Regarding this, the cyclops elder’s incarnation snorted coldly, remarking that the people from Slaughter Paradise are becoming more and more rampant, even daring to touch their disciples.]”
“…..”
“Damn….”
Looking at the simulation content, Wang Ping was truly speechless.
After all this time, Slaughter Paradise finally made its move again.
And its first move was to send out a Quasi-Emperor to assassinate him, a young Half-Step Great Saint. This was utterly shameless.
“It seems that after such a long time, Slaughter Paradise has once again confirmed my identity. Even if they risk retaliation from Taiyi Imperial Palace, they still want to put me in a desperate situation.”
After complaining, Wang Ping frowned, feeling somewhat troubled as he pondered how Slaughter Paradise had managed to determine his identity.
After all, he had both the Golden Talent – Heavenly Mystery Concealment and the secret methods of the Nine Stars Pavilion. Catching him was not an easy task.
“It seems that I’ve somewhat overestimated the Golden Talent – Heavenly Mystery Concealment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 735: 212: Immortal Door! Astonishing Appearance of the Origin of Time_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Chapter 212: Immortal Door! Astonishing Appearance of the Origin of Time_5
In the end, Wang Ping shook his head, thinking that the Golden Talent was still a Golden Talent. It might be of great use to the Supremes, and even for them, it might be difficult to find him, and most of the Heavenly Secret Skills couldn’t find him either.
However, in this current Golden Age, the Immortal gates were about to open, and even Quasi-Emperors and Emperors were emerging. With their means, it would not be difficult to break through the effect of Golden Talent: Heavenly Mystery Concealment.
Moreover, the Slaughter Paradise being one of the Myriad Heavens Forces, had even more means.
The reason why they hadn’t targeted him earlier might simply be because there was no need.
Although he revealed his identity as a member of the Third Generation Chat Group a hundred thousand years ago, and even killed a Slaughter Saint of the Slaughter Paradise.
However, a mere Saint was nothing to the Slaughter Paradise, only a low-level member.
But now, he had joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace, showing great talent and strength, so that was different. He had become a must-kill target.
Thus, it was normal for a Quasi-Emperor to personally take action and want to completely eliminate him.
“But, old man with one eye, aren’t you too pitiful? You just had to wait until after I was killed to make your move. That’s really heartless.”
After Wang Ping figured out many things, he couldn’t help but grumble.
After cursing, Wang Ping continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[When you were resurrected, Huan Qing and Huangyin were also very sad about your death. As for the cyclops elder, he sighed and didn’t expect you to fall like this. Perhaps he shouldn’t have let you go in the first place.]
[As for leaving an incarnation on you and appearing when you are in danger, they did not consider it and would never do that. As a member of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, if they left an incarnation on you, it would be discovered by the old monsters of the Taiyi Imperial Palace when you returned.]
[In the end, under the instructions of the cyclops elder, Huan Qing and Huangyin erected a tombstone for you and then left.]
[An hour later, you were resurrected and didn’t even have the mood or time to check your current situation. You used the Golden Talent: Transmission without hesitation.]
[With the use of the Golden Talent: Transmission, you arrived at a familiar place. This place turned out to be the Cold Pool deep within the secret realm jointly owned by the Wang Family and the Jee family.]
[You came across Heavenly Ice again. You couldn’t believe your ‘luck’ had brought you back to this place. You doubted whether the Golden Talent: Transmission was a great teleportation technique or a great opportunity technique.]
[After all, every time you used the Golden Talent: Transmission, it could teleport you to strange places or in front of terrifying beings. Although every transmission came with danger alongside opportunity, you were really getting tired of it.]
[As you were lost in thought, you wanted to break out of the Cold Pool and save your life. Otherwise, if the Heavenly Ice attacked you, you wouldn’t have the ability to save your life with the Golden Talent: Transmission this time.]
[However, as you rushed upwards, Heavenly Ice found you again and recognized you as the human cultivator who tried to forcibly subdue it previously. As a result, it became angry and unleashed its terrifying coldness at you.]
[At that moment, you felt very serious, sensing a strong sense of danger. Unable to use Spatial Movement in the Cold Pool and with the Heavenly Ice being so terrifying, you couldn’t escape.]
[Thoughts flashed through your mind, and in the end, you clenched your teeth, resisted the coldness of the Heavenly Ice with all your might, and started to go deeper into the Cold Pool.]
[Since you were most likely going to die here, try to figure out the secrets of the deepest part of the Cold Pool so it would be beneficial for the next simulation to get this opportunity.]
[Soon, you couldn’t bear the coldness anymore and had to resort to using the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification to ignore the cold. Then, you ferociously burned your roots and continued to dive deeper into the Cold Pool.]
[In the end, you saw what lay at the deepest part of the Cold Pool. It was a sphere of liquid emitting a crystal-clear sheen. When you saw this sphere of liquid, you seemed to see the past, and also seemed to see the future, feeling very strange and lost in a trance.]
[Soon, you came to your senses, and your body developed a strong longing for this sphere of liquid. At the same time, you also guessed what this sphere of liquid could be.]
[This was Temporal Origin, an extremely pure Temporal Origin. It is considered a Supreme Treasure even in the entire Upper Realm. For you, it was a huge opportunity and something you needed the most.]
[If you could obtain this sphere of Temporal Origin and refine it, you could make up for the incomplete Time-Space Body and make it complete. By then, your talent and strength would skyrocket.]

chapters.title: Chapter 736: 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 736: Chapter 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor
“”Temporal Origin!?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of this text simulation, completely astonished, followed by a surge of ecstasy.
He never thought that the treasure hidden deep in this Cold Pool would be a mass of Temporal Origin.
Originally, he planned to use the Nine Stars Pavilion to find the Temporal Origin, but it seemed that it saved him a lot of time and effort. It was like he stumbled upon a massive opportunity.
