Golden Talent: Transmission, forever amazing!
“If I can obtain this Temporal Origin, I’ll be able to complete my Time-Space Body. However, it’s unlikely that I can do it this time in this simulation.”
Wang Ping calmed down a bit and shook his head.
He no longer had any backup plan, so attempting to absorb this Temporal Origin in the depths of the Cold Pool, risking the attack of the Heavenly Ice, was impossible.
However, Wang Ping wasn’t in a hurry. If he couldn’t do it in this simulation, he could try again the next time and it would still be the same.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts raced, the simulation continued.
[You are ecstatic in your heart, wanting to touch the Temporal Origin, but the effect of your Golden Talent: Damage Nullification has already expired. At the moment the talent’s effect wore off, your body stiffened, turning into an ice sculpture. Your body, inner world, and even your Divine Soul, were all instantly frozen.]
[As you have fallen into this strange state, the simulation comes to an end….]
…
With the end of the text simulation, a barrage of images and cultivation realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, as his figure appeared at the deepest depths of the cold pool, staring at the Temporal Origin.
Finally, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, leaving the immersive simulation state, and his vision returned to the real world. The system’s voice also sounded.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Half-step Great Saint Cultivation.
②. Golden Talent: Damage Nullification.
③. Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique.
④. Life-bound Great Saint Artifact.
⑤. Randomly obtain one Great Sacred Artifact.
⑥. Fifty thousand jin of top-tier Divine Origin.”
“System, I choose ①. Half-step Great Saint Cultivation and ②. Golden Talent: Damage Nullification.”
Wang Ping glanced at the list of rewards and made his choice without hesitation.
“Ding, reward distribution in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt a surge of powerful energy within his body, directly elevating his cultivation from Saint King Great Perfection to the Half-step Great Saint Tier.
In addition, information about the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification appeared in his mind.
“Continue simulating. This time, I must obtain the Temporal Origin.”
Wang Ping suppressed his aura, his eyes glowing sharply.
Just as Wang Ping was about to launch another simulation, the chat group system’s voice suddenly sounded.
“Ding, a life-threatening situation detected for Lin Yuanyuan’s team, would you like to go and rescue them immediately?”
“What!?”
Wang Ping heard the chat group system’s prompt and his pupils slightly constricted.
How could Lin Yuanyuan be in life-threatening danger? How could that be possible?
Keep in mind that Lin Yuanyuan is now at the Saint King cultivation tier. Although she is not as strong as Wang Ping, her cultivation skills, divine abilities, and comprehension of the laws have all been improved since being optimized by the Golden Finger, and she has even comprehended more laws than him.
After all, Lin Yuanyuan can easily obtain the comprehension of laws from other Saint Kings or even Saints, which is very overpowered.
For the past three years, Lin Yuanyuan has taken over many tasks from him.
Basically, she led the team to complete weak and difficult tasks.
Only when the chat group specified that Wang Ping needed to take action on a particularly difficult task would he execute it.
It can be said that only after nurturing Lin Yuanyuan and the other old group members was he able to relax and continue his simulations.
Now, Lin Yuanyuan unexpectedly encountering life-threatening danger surprised him, and his heart felt slightly heavy.
Immediately, Wang Ping opened the chat group to investigate the situation.
Lin Yuanyuan led the team with Chen Yao, Zhang Jun, Zhang Hu, and Chen Si as members, participating in a Myriad Heavens Task to guard a world belonging to the chat group.
In this world, they faced an attack from Abyssal Beasts, which caused great destruction, and more than half of the World Source was plundered.
“Not only Lin Yuanyuan but other powerful group members also went there, and they all encountered life-threatening dangers. This really is troublesome.”
As Wang Ping’s thoughts flashed, he directly used his authority as acting group master to teleport to the Life Universe where Lin Yuanyuan was executing her task.
…
While Wang Ping headed to the Life Universe, Lin Yuanyuan and her team were struggling to hold on atop a broken Ancient Star.
“Yuanyuan, we should retreat. We can’t kill these guys.”
Chen Yao, pale-faced, maintained the Defensive Array alongside Lin Yuanyuan, and said with a bitter smile.
They thought they would only face one Abyssal Beast, with power comparable to an ordinary Saint King, as well as several subordinate Abyssal Beasts equivalent to Saint Tier creatures under its command.
However, both Lin Yuanyuan and Chen Yao, Zhang Hu, Chen Si, and Zhang Jun never expected that this Abyssal Beast had the ability to split itself.
Their blood would splatter and it could split into new entities.
Although these split beings were much weaker than the original body, they could continue to split when harmed, making them extremely hard to eliminate.
What was even more headache-inducing was that these split beings could absorb energy from their battles and the life force from the Ancient Star, rapidly growing in power.

chapters.title: Chapter 737: 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: Chapter 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_2
Although, every individual split off has a growth limit, at most reaching the battle power equivalent to the God King Realm, most of them can only reach the Void Divine Realm.
But there are just too many of them.
Even ants in large quantities can bite an elephant to death, let alone beings in Divine Realm.
With the entanglement of Abyssal Beasts with power equivalent to Saint King tier and Saint tier, these weak split-off Abyssal Beasts can have a startling effect.
Especially in their team, there is still Chen Si with weak combat power, which makes things even more troublesome.
Although Chen Si has been given a boost by Lin Yuanyuan and now has power equivalent to True Lord Tier, this kind of power is too weak in this place. If they don’t protect Chen Si, she will be swallowed up without a trace within a minute.
“Haven’t you noticed? We can’t retreat. As our strength increases and the mission difficulty increases, the enemies we encounter are becoming more powerful. The chat group can allow us to teleport in or retreat, but so can the enemy.”
Lin Yuanyuan smiled bitterly.
“Sister Yuanyuan, you mean, we can’t teleport away?”
Chen Si’s face turned pale.
“Yes, I’ve clearly felt that since we reached the Saint King tier, the rules of the game between the chat group and other Myriad Heavens Forces seem to have changed. Neither side can leave until one side is completely dead.”
Lin Yuanyuan shook her head, took a deep breath, and said with a solemn face.
Upon hearing this, the faces of Chen Yao and others became extremely serious and pale.
Chen Yao clenched her fists, a little restless.
After all, she had already died once, having been deceived by Xu Yi once.
If she died again, she didn’t know how many Group points would be needed for resurrection.
After all, the more times one dies, the more Group points you need to resurrect again.
And the cost of resurrection also has to do with the strength of the Group members.
She has now reached the level of Saint Great Perfection. The increase in the price of resurrection capability is bound to be terrifying.
Not to mention that if this world were destroyed, they would probably have to continue dying after being resurrected.
“What about Mr.Wang? We can ask him for help.”
Zhang Hu rode a Saint-tier monster beast, fighting alongside it, and said anxiously.
“I can’t get in touch with Mr.Wang at all…”
Lin Yuanyuan smiled bitterly.
At this, everyone fell silent.
Wang Ping’s Golden Finger is the Life Simulator, which they all knew.
Nowadays, it seems that Wang Ping spends a lot of time in the simulation every time, so he can’t always be online.
This is also the reason why they have been getting less and less dependent on Wang Ping these three years.
“It looks like we’re going to die here.”
Chen Yao sighed.
The other Group members might be able to come, but there’s no way they could help them turn the tide.
Maybe Wu Jun’s Golden Finger can bring miracles, but if it fails, it’s just adding one more dead person.
Chen Kang, Zhang Yueying, and some of the newcomers have good Golden Fingers, which can help in battles.
But that Abyssal Beast is sly and difficult to kill, even if it’s imprisoned for a while, and Zhang Yueying helps to enhance their power, the probability of them killing it is less than 50%.
Therefore, it’s hard for them to let the other Group members die.
Maybe they can all just die once and then wait for Wang Ping to be online to get them back.
It was at this time when Lin Yuanyuan and others were already feeling a bit desperate, a figure suddenly appeared above this Ancient Star, overlooking everything on it.
However, because Wang Ping was very careful to hide his aura, no one noticed his arrival, even the Abyssal Beast did not detect it.
“This Abyss ability is really disgusting, no wonder Lin Yuanyuan and others can’t deal with it.”
Wang Ping stared at the Abyssal Beast, slightly frowning.
“However, even if the Abyssal Beast has high Defense force, strong vitality, and disgusting abilities, its own attack power is only equivalent to an ordinary Saint King Realm 6th tier, close to the 7th-Tier level, and it’s extremely weak to me, like an ant.”
Wang Ping took a step forwards, appearing directly above the battlefield.
This time, Wang Ping did not continue to hide his aura. The pressure of a Half-step Great Saint released, covering the entire Ancient Star.
In an instant, many split-off Abyssal Beasts were pressured by Wang Ping and burst right open.
However, after these Abyssal Beasts split and burst, they continued to split again, becoming even weaker as they were just birthed and then crushed once more, until they finally disappeared completely.
As for the Saint-tier Abyssal Beasts, although they weren’t crushed to death, they were also unable to move, looking at Wang Ping in the sky with fear.
As for the lead Saint King-tier Abyssal Beast, it stared at Wang Ping, showing a fearful expression, its entire body trembling uncontrollably.
Wang Ping’s aura and energy fluctuations were too strong, far greater than his.
It had a feeling that if Wang Ping made a move, he could completely annihilate him. No matter how strong his ability to split, it wouldn’t save him.
“Brother Wang!”
On Lin Yuanyuan’s side, seeing Wang Ping appear, she first stared blankly, and then showed a surprised and delighted expression.
They didn’t expect that Wang Ping would actually appear at such a critical moment and save them.
Indeed, whether it was the previous chat group or the current one, Brother Wang was the most reliable man.

chapters.title: Chapter 738: 213: Space-Time Dao Body! Young Emperor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: Chapter 213: Space-Time Dao Body! Young Emperor_3
As long as Mr. Wang is here, all dangers are nothing to speak of.
With a smile on his face, Wang Ping nodded to Lin Yuanyuan and others, then gazed at the Abyssal Beast, his body surging with terrifying mana of fire.
It was the Perfect Flame Law.
“You intervened in this fight halfway through and broke the rules. If you dare to kill me, you will be targeted by my Abyss Beast Clan. Then, endless pursuit awaits you.”
Seeing Wang Ping’s Perfect Flame Law, the fur of the Abyssal Beast exploded out in fear as it roared in terror.
Wang Ping was already more potent than it. Adding on this, he now utilized the flame law, which it feared the most, inciting fear from the bottom of its heart.
“There are many forces wanting to kill me; your Abyss Beast Clan is just an added number. Not to mention, we are naturally enemies. Threatening me? Ridiculous.”
Wang Ping spoke coldly and directly showed his Fire-Element Divine Skill.
In the blink of an eye, endless flames erupted, wrapped in the Perfect Flame Law. It immediately incinerated all the Abyssal Beasts, including the one with Saint King-tier Battle Power, to ash and completely exterminated them.
“As expected of Mr. Wang, too powerful!”
Zhang Hu gazed as Wang Ping obliterated all Abyssal Beasts with a wave and wore a shocked expression on his face.
“We’ve said this so many times that it almost feels repetitive.”
Zhang Jun spread out his hands but couldn’t help but smile.
This time his slaughter of the Abyssal Beasts boosted his strength substantially.
Unfortunately, the truly powerful Abyssal Beasts are hard to kill, killing weak ones only provided minor increases in strength. The breakthrough isn’t possible by quantity alone.
For this reason, although his slaughter this time brought him to the tier of Saint Great Perfection, he was still a good distance away from becoming a Half-Step Saint King.
As Zhang Jun and Zhang Hu relaxed and started bantering with each other, Wang Ping shook his head and reminded, “If you two want to chat, do it in the chat group. I will leave first. You guys should head back. Otherwise, potential new dangers may arise. After all, such an incident has happened more than once.”
After speaking, Wang ping immediately turned into a white light and disappeared.
The expression on Zhang Hu’s face also changed slightly, and they both chose to return.
Wang Ping was so right, after completing the task, it was best to return immediately. An extra second spent could mean an extra danger. It was like a lesson learned in blood.
It was only half an hour after Lin Yuanyuan, and Zhang Hu had returned that space in this world shattered again, and a terrifying figure appeared here.
…
At this moment, Wang Ping returned to the Ancient Star of Black Abyss Mozun’s Heritage.
Just as Wang Ping was preparing for the simulation, Lin Yuanyuan and others sent loads of red packets full of abundant group points.
Among these red packets, Lin Yuanyuan’s group point amount was the highest.
Wang Ping didn’t bother too much, had a brief chat with Lin Yuanyuan, and then left the chat group.
“Beep, you have received an additional reward of one billion group points.”
At this time, suddenly the chat group system’s sound rang, leaving Wang Ping slightly shocked.
“A billion?”
Upon regaining his senses, Wang Ping said it out incredulously.
“Alpha, has that world been destroyed?”
“Half an hour after you left, a terrifying Abyssal Beast descended and wiped out that world. So, I divided the origin of that world with that Abyssal Beast.”
Alpha’s voice rang out.
“However, you’ve already been marked by the Abyssal Beast Clan, avoid randomly participating in group tasks against the Abyssal Beasts in the future. It would be hazardous.”
Alpha icily reminded Wang Ping.
“I naturally know about the dangers. If possible, I don’t also want to dive into these tasks. But, for people like Lin Yuanyuan, they need to be saved. Otherwise, the high-end combat skill of the chat group will be wiped out.”
Wang Ping sighed with some helplessness.
“Without Yuanyuan and others, the other new group members can’t be heavily relied upon. As for people like Wu Jun, without Lin Yuanyuan, they would find it challenging to become stronger quickly. Then, I’ll be busy again.”
“I’m merely reminding you a bit, not implying you did anything wrong.”
Alpha’s cold voice echoed again.
“But, remember, no matter how important other group members are, they are still less important than you. I am staking everything on you.”
“Well, based on what you said, should I feel delighted or should I feel the pressure is tremendous.”
Wang Ping chuckled.
“Don’t worry, I cherish my life.”
After pausing for a while, Wang Ping spoke again.
Indeed, he needs Lin Yuanyuan and others to help him develop the chat group. He also intends to groom them into his future aides.
But, if Lin Yuanyuan encountered formidable enemies, he wouldn’t risk his life to rescue them.
This time, it was the chat group that reminded him that he could go there and needed him to go there. That was why he went.
The chat group is secretly controlled by Alpha. If there really were life-threatening dangers, Alpha surely wouldn’t let him go.
“Mhm”, Alpha acknowledged briefly and then dived back in.
“Next, let’s continue with the paid simulation. Becoming stronger is the most critical.”
Wang Ping also focused his mind and thought to himself.
“System, how many top-tier Divine Origins do I need to undertake the paid simulation now?”
Wang Ping inquired in his heart.
“Ping, the host’s current cultivation is a Half-Step Dacheng Tier, the resource consumption for the paid simulation is 150,000 jin of top-tier Divine Origin.”

chapters.title: Chapter 739: 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Chapter 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_4
The system’s voice rang out.
“Fifteen million is still bearable. System, start the paid simulation for me.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Ding, consuming fifteen million pounds of top-tier Divine Origin, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing Red Talent: Earth profound physique.”
Red Talent: Earth profound physique: ….
“Well, I finally started to have bad luck. If it continues to be gold, I doubt if I’m really breaking my life.”
Wang Ping looked at the talents he had refreshed this time without any disappointment. Instead, he felt it was very normal.
After all, he had previously drawn a gold and a seven-color gold consecutively. If there were more gold and seven-color gold, Wang Ping would be even more worried.
“Ding, Talent loading successful, life simulation starting…”
While Wang Ping was feeling emotional, the system’s voice sounded again, and he felt his consciousness sway, entering an immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you thought about your plans for the future. You wondered if you should go back to the Elemental Star and take on two apprentices. After all, Lin Yan or Fang Xingyu might give you a surprise, allowing you to break through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[However, you gave up on this naive idea. Talents like Lin Qinghe and Ye Chen, who have terrifying talents or some luck, are not everywhere. The Elemental Star had already produced so many such talents, and it would be too abnormal if more appeared.]
[You still think it’s better to first find a way to break through to the Great Saint Tier, then return to the Elemental Star and take Fang Xingyu and Lin Yan as apprentices. This might help you advance a small realm and maximize your benefits.]
[After figuring out these things, you decided to go back to the Elemental Star. After all, you need Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger·Absolute Defense to help you get the Temporal Origin. Otherwise, you will have a hard time getting through the Cold Pool challenge.]
[As for getting a life-saving card from the old monsters in Taiyi Imperial Palace, you haven’t even considered it. After all, the Temporal Origin and Heavenly Ice are very precious, and the treasures are tempting. If some old monsters left any conscious avatars as a backup, like the previous incarnation, it would be troublesome.]
[Therefore, you can only rely on yourself to seize these opportunities and find Cai Yonglong for help.]
[Later, you returned to the Elemental Star and found Cai Yonglong directly. At this point, Cai Yonglong had already ascended from the Purple Spirit Realm to the Upper Realm, so you didn’t have to go to the lower realm again, saving a lot of energy.]
[Following that, you took Cai Yonglong away. As for Lin Qinghe, you didn’t plan to take her away but gave her a lot of life-saving items and resources. After all, you were going to Taiyi Imperial Palace next.]
[You didn’t know if Taiyi Imperial Palace would accept Lin Qinghe, who has the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and the remnants of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body’s soul. If they do not accept Lin Qinghe, carrying Lin Qinghe to Taiyi Imperial Palace would mean carrying her head to be delivered to them.]
[A few years later, you took Cai Yonglong to the Immortal Continent and joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[This time, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was even more shocked. You had reached a Half-step Great Saint Tier, a level that is difficult to achieve in the Last Dharma Age, which was undoubtedly somewhat beyond the norm. As for Cai Yonglong, he was too weak, but the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace allowed Cai Yonglong to join the palace because you said he was an important follower. Then, you both performed self-titling.]
[In an instant, nearly a hundred thousand years passed, the Golden Age arrived, and you and Cai Yonglong emerged from your self-titling and reached the 11th floor of the Taiyi Sky Road, becoming the 10th Emperor Son. Then, you directly challenged the Second Imperial Son, forcefully suppressing him, seizing the position of the Second Imperial Son, and shocking the world.]
[After that, you went to the Taiyi Emperor Tower to seek Enlightenment. In the end, it took you two years to successfully comprehend the Major Completion Tier of Space Law, further improving your strength.]
[After comprehending the Space Law, you decided to challenge the First Emperor Child, Yu Daohong. This battle, you performed much better than in the last simulation, and also forced out more of the First Emperor Child’s secrets.]
[It turned out that he had also comprehended the Major Completion Tier of his law. However, this time he beat you, it was not as easy as in the previous simulation. If it wasn’t for his better physique and bloodline plus your bad luck of not triggering a Triple Symphony or more continuous attacks and causing a critical strike, it would be really hard to say who would win.]
[Of course, you’re not sure if Yu Daohong is still hiding any trump cards. However, this battle has greatly benefited you and increased your confidence. After all, you have Space Law and Mana of Fire both reaching the Great Perfection Tier, giving you an advantage over Yu Daohong, who only focused on single cultivation.]
[Next, if you can replenish the origin of your Time-Space Body and transform it into a Flawless Tao Body, you are confident that you will be better than Yu Daohong in terms of physique and even cultivate Time Law. At that time, you believe you can easily defeat Yu Daohong.]
[Even, you are confident that, in this monster-filled Golden Age, only the monsters in the top 10 of the Saint King Ranking can compare with you in the same realm. As for Ku Xuan, you can’t see through his situation at the moment, so you don’t have much confidence in surpassing him in terms of talents. After all, Ku Xuan’s performance was so horrifying that even Lei Wanqian with his Great Thunder Immortal Physique was easily suppressed by him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 740: 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Chapter 213: Time-Space Body! The Young Emperor_5
[Following that, a Quasi-Emperor from the Taiyi Imperial Palace emerged, intent on accepting you as a disciple. However, you refused, stating that you had no plans to become an apprentice yet. This surprised the Quasi-Emperor since most Emperor’s sons are usually taken in by Earth Supremes or Heaven Supremes as disciples.]
[It’s rare to see a Quasi-Emperor taking an Emperor’s son as a disciple. After all, most Emperor’s sons only have a high chance of achieving the Supreme or entering the Supreme realm, and only a very small portion of Imperial-Prince level characters have a chance to become a Quasi-Emperor. But that’s just a hopeful possibility.]
[As such, it would be an honor for an Emperor’s son to be taken in by a Quasi-Emperor. Your refusal was unexpected by the Quasi-Emperor. However, he just smiled wryly, didn’t say much, and praised your high ambitions before disappearing.]
[You felt slightly awkward about this. Indeed, your ambitions are high. The reason you chose to refuse the Quasi-Emperor as your master is because you have your sights set on the current Great Emperor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[In your view, as long as you absorb the Temporal Origin, perfecting your Time-Space Body, you are qualified to seek apprenticeship with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. By then, becoming the disciple of a Great Emperor would be much more appealing than being the disciple of a Quasi-Emperor.]
[However, your thoughts are clearly seen through by the Quasi-Emperor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, which is why he said you have great ambitions, making you feel a bit awkward.]
[Afterward, you traveled the outer world as the Second Imperial Son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, helping Cai Yonglong acquire many resources and grow rapidly.]
[In a blink of an eye, nearly a hundred years have passed. Although you still haven’t found a monstrous disciple to help you break through to the Great Saint Tier, you remain calm and composed.]
[Of course, you’ve considered taking the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s powerful to the Profound Universe to compete for the Innate Saint. But in the end, you chose to give up.]
[After all, even if you took the Quasi-Emperor from the Taiyi Imperial Palace to seize the Innate Saint, it wouldn’t be possible for you to make them your disciple. You would essentially become a tool, at most earning various rewards.]
[Compared to those rewards, the biggest problem is that you cannot explain how you knew the Innate Saint would be born. After all, your movements have been mostly within the observation range of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, with a Half-step Supreme Dao Protector protecting you. It is difficult for you to explain these things.]
[Therefore, you think it’s better not to add another problem and wait until you’re strong enough to monopolize the situation.]
[Meanwhile, a century has passed, and with your help, Cai Yonglong has successfully grown to the Quasi-Saint level. Although he is only an ordinary Quasi-Saint, he is much stronger than many regular cultivators.]
[Next, Ji Bingyan’s letter arrives, and you go to the Jee family to participate in the martial competition. The process is not much different from the previous simulation, but you managed to secure a spot for Cai Yonglong.]
[The Jee family is somewhat reluctant, but they give Cai Yonglong the spot in consideration of your reputation.]
[In the end, you both entered the secret realm to cultivate. This time, you have no intention of cultivating in the secret realm but instead took Cai Yonglong directly to the Cold Pool and entered it with him.]
[Then, you encountered the Heavenly Ice. However, since you didn’t attack the Heavenly Ice this time, it didn’t attack you either, allowing you to breathe a sigh of relief.]
[Nonetheless, due to the terrifying cold air at the depths of the Cold Pool, you asked Cai Yonglong to use the Golden Finger·Absolute Defense. After that, you made your move on the Time-Space Origin.]
[Perhaps it’s because this Temporal Origin is naturally close to your Time-Space Body, the process of subduing it went unexpectedly smoothly.]
[Eventually, you successfully obtained the Temporal Origin, took it into your inner world, and rushed out of the Cold Pool with Cai Yonglong, arriving in the outer world.]
[Following that, you told Cai Yonglong to cherish the opportunity of the secret realm, work hard to achieve Enlightenment, strengthen his Origin, and break through to the Saint tier. As for you, after some thought, you decided to absorb the Temporal Origin within the secret realm.]
[After all, the environment here is excellent, and the Origin is abundant, which can serve as an auxiliary effect.]
[In the end, you managed to absorb and refine the Temporal Origin just as the secret realm was about to close, successfully perfecting your Time-Space Body!]
[At the moment when your Time-Space Body became perfect, the secret realm closed, and you were thrown out. The terrifying Heavenly Tribulation appeared as soon as you arrived outside the secret realm, causing numerous cultivators to show fearful expressions.]
[Even the Supremes and Quasi-Emperors of the Jee family were astonished, looking at the terrifying Tribulation with disbelief. As experts, they are very familiar with Heavenly Tribulation. When a cultivator breaks through a Great Realm, they will inevitably face the Heavenly Tribulation. The stronger the Tribulation, the stronger the foundation and potential of the person undergoing it.]
[However, they rarely see such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. The intensity of this Tribulation is already on par with the Tribulations faced by those who were Great Emperors in their youth when they broke through to the Great Saint realm. No, it’s actually even more powerful.]
[For this reason, they couldn’t help but wonder, whether a Young Great Emperor has emerged and is going through the Great Saint Tribulation here!]

chapters.title: Chapter 741: 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Farewell, Ye Chen
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: Chapter 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Farewell, Ye Chen
[As everyone was startled, your complexion changed as well. You never expected that after making up for the missing origin of your Time-Space Body, achieving perfection would attract such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[However, you quickly recalled some secrets recorded in the ancient books of Taiyi Imperial Palace that you once read. It is said that some extremely powerful Special Constitutions will be tested by the world and attract frightening Heavenly Tribulations.]
[If one successfully passes through the tribulation, they can use its power to become even more formidable. If they fail to survive the Heavenly Tribulation’s tempering, everything will turn into nothingness, disappearing completely.]
[Undoubtedly, a perfect Time-Space Body has reached such a level, a realm that even the most powerful Sacred Bodies cannot touch. You realized that perhaps this complete Time-Space Body has touched the realm of immortality. If you can survive this Heavenly Tribulation and temper your Time-Space Body with its power, perhaps you can compete with Lei Wanqian’s Great Thunder Immortal Physique.]
[Next, you took a deep breath, your eyes filled with intense battle intent and you laughed loudly, rushing towards the Heavenly Tribulation, wanting to endure this terrifying tribulation.]
[As for Cai Yonglong and the others, they quickly fled in fear, in case they were engulfed by the fully formed Heavenly Tribulation, which would undoubtedly annihilate them.]
[The Supremes and Quasi-Emperors noticed your existence, and they were shocked. They never thought that your Time-Space Body would become perfect, and that you would so boldly rush towards the Heavenly Tribulation. If you can survive, the world will witness the birth of another terrifying monster. As long as you don’t fall along the way, you will likely become an Emperor in the future.]
[If you become an Emperor, you will be a prominent figure among the Great Emperors, unequaled in your realm. Even if you don’t reach the Emperor of Tao Proving tier, as long as you achieve the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection stage, you can compete against the Great Emperors with your complete Time-Space Body, and it’s not impossible to defeat them.]
[Throughout history, only monsters with special constitutions have been able to challenge and possibly defeat Great Emperors across tiers. Otherwise, merely possessing a Sacred Body, even the most exceptional ones like Red Fire Holy Body or Extreme Cold Holy Physique, would be inadequate for truly competing with Great Emperors. Even developing their constitution to the Great Perfection tier would only allow them to briefly contend with Great Emperors, and they would inevitably be defeated over time.]
[Only the Time-Space Body and the Great Thunder Immortal Physique holders, once they advance their cultivation and reach the Great Completion state of their constitution’s development, can exhibit incomparably terrifying combat power. Of course, achieving such a powerful constitution is extremely difficult. One could say that there are advantages and disadvantages to everything.]
[Regardless, before reaching the 3rd-tier Realms of Dao Verification, the Time-Space Body and the Great Thunder Immortal Physique holders undoubtedly have an overwhelming advantage against Sacred Body holders. The two cannot be compared.]
[As everyone was in shock, you began to Cross Tribulation. It must be said that this Heavenly Tribulation was truly terrifying. Even with your perfect Time-Space Body and surge in combat power, you almost couldn’t withstand it.]
[However, that is only because you are supplementing your Time-Space Body and haven’t comprehended Time Law yet. Otherwise, you definitely wouldn’t be in such a sorry state. Only by comprehending both spacetime laws, with the support of Emperor-tier space-time cultivation skills, can you truly maximize the advantages of your Time-Space Body.]
[Regrettably, you currently lack not only Time Law but also the corresponding Emperor-tier cultivation skills, so you can only utilize a portion of your Time-Space Body’s power, leaving you in such a sorry state. You can’t match Lei Wanqian, the monster possessing the Great Thunder Immortal Physique.]
[Of course, you aren’t particularly worried. After all, you can comprehend Time Law, and as long as you spend time on it, you will eventually master the Time Laws at the level of Great Perfection. And regarding the Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra, you have some clues.]
[In previous Text Simulations, you obtained an Emperor’s Sutra Fragment, and you even gave up other rewards for it.]
[After years of research and Taiyi Imperial Palace’s records, you have successfully learned the location of the Emperor’s Sutra recorded on this fragmented map, as it is about Time Law.]
……
“Holy shit! Is that Broken Map really this important?”
Wang Ping was astonished upon reading the content of the Text Simulation.
At that time, he only wanted to learn more Emperor Scriptures to increase his foundation, so he gave up talents and chose that Broken Map; otherwise, he would have nothing.
Who would have thought that the origin of this map would be so significant, and it even contained the information about the cultivation method he needed the most.
“I’ve really hit the jackpot! With both Time and Space Secret Skills and a perfect Time-Space Body, how strong will I be? Can I surpass Lei Wanqian, who possesses the Great Thunder Immortal Physique?”
Wang Ping excitedly thought.
“No, that’s not right. I must be able to suppress him. My Perfect Space-Time Body is already on par with his Great Thunder Immortal Physique. What I lack now is only the compatibility of the cultivation skills. He is cultivating a thunder-based Emperor’s Scripture, which is most suitable for him, and I can’t catch up with him on that front. But if I also cultivate Time-Space Emperor Scriptures, I might gain an advantage!”

chapters.title: Chapter 742: 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Goodbye Ye Chen_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Chapter 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Goodbye Ye Chen_2
“In addition, I also possess enhancement type talents such as the Purple Talent: Endless Blade and the Golden Talent – Ensemble! Although, as my level gets stronger, the probability of triggering them is significantly lower. In the end, these are only purple and golden talents, which are not enough for the Great Saint Tier, especially the Purple Talent: Endless Blade. However, as long as either of them triggers once or twice, it’s inevitable that I’ll beat Lei Wanqian with ease.”
The more Wang Ping thought about it, the more excited he became, looking forward to the future.
“Nevertheless, having obtained the Time Emperor Sutra and dual-cultivating the Path of Time-Space, although I can suppress Great Thunder Immortal Body Lei Wanqian, it might still be difficult to fight against that Ku Xuan. What is his Special Constitution, and what scripture is he cultivating? It’s really hard to figure it out.”
Soon after, Wang Ping calmed down and thought of Longevity Ku family’s Ku Xuan.
The Longevity Ku family is the only Longevity Clan that has survived the long Last Dharma Age. Their foundation is unfathomable, and they must have produced many emperors. In that Last Dharma Age, when everything withered, the Longevity Ku family still prevailed, and they might have even swept all the cultivation methods of the previous era.
As a result, no matter which faction, none can compare with the Ku family in terms of Emperor Scriptures, Divine Skills, or Secret Skills.
However, this is not enough to completely elevate the Ku family above other monstrous geniuses.
“Either he possesses a Constitution or bloodline that is even more terrifying than the Great Thunder Immortal Body, or the scriptures he is cultivating surpass the tier of the Emperor Scripture… which is the legendary Immortal Sutra…”
These bold guesses emerged in Wang Ping’s mind, making it difficult for him to calm down.
If Ku Xuan really cultivates the Immortal Sutra, then it’s too terrifying. Who can be his opponent within the same realm?
However, if this is the case, it would also explain why he is so powerful. Lei Wanqian was easily suppressed by him.
“Phew, it seems like I’m overthinking it… As for the secrets of the Longevity Ku family and Ku Xuan, I’ll be able to gradually reveal them as I continue the simulation. No need to worry too much. Now, I haven’t even gotten the Broken Map pieces, so my Temporal Scriptures aren’t fully in my grasp yet.”
Wang Ping exhaled, calmed himself down, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the Upper Realm, there was once an extraordinarily powerful Emperor who walked the Path of Time, known as the Dark Time Emperor. He was considered a king among Emperors, with few Great Emperors as his rivals, and his talents and combat power were absolutely intimidating across the ages.]
[We can say that once you gather all the Broken Map pieces and obtain the Emperor Scripture of Dark Time Emperor, you can truly unleash the power of your Time-Space Body, and the two will complement each other to increase your combat power to a terrifying level.]
[As for the Emperor Scripture concerning the spatial aspect, it is relatively easier to find. Although there are not many Great Emperors who have followed the Space Path in the vast Upper Realm, several have appeared. Even at this point in time, there is a Great Emperor known as Emperor Devouring Space who follows the Space Path and possesses astonishing talent, his fame resonating throughout history.]
[However, Emperor Devouring Space didn’t create his own Imperial-tier force and is a very aloof existence. He has always been elusive like a Divine Dragon. Trying to find him and have him impart the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra to you is not an easy task.]
[Of course, there is also a very crucial issue: Since you’ve joined Taiyi Imperial Palace, it’s clearly impossible for you to obtain the Emperor Scriptures of other Great Emperors.]
[On the other hand, you don’t need to be anxious. Even if you can’t join the Devouring Space Emperor Palace and acquire the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra through the simulation this time, you can search for Emperor Devouring Space during the next simulation.]
[As long as you have the simulations, you have an infinite number of choices and possibilities.]
[In the meantime, while your thoughts are flowing, you continue to temper and strengthen your Time-Space Body with the power of the final tribulation thunder. Furthermore, your physical strength has increased significantly. When the Heavenly Tribulation is over, you feel exhilarated.]
[At this moment, a quasi-emperor makes a move against you, wanting to capture you. Clearly, a perfect Time-Space Body is extremely rare. If obtained, it would be a great opportunity.]
[Therefore, even if it offends the Taiyi Imperial Palace to death and may even incur the personal pursuit of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, this quasi-emperor can’t care less about it.]
[Just when the quasi-emperor makes a move, the Jee Family’s Quasi-Emperor also reacts, snorts coldly, counters, and blocks the quasi-emperor, protecting you.]
[As the two quasi-emperors clash, terrifying power spreads, chilling your heart. At the same time, your anger is ignited. You stare intently at the quasi-emperor who attacked you, wanting to remember their aura for future revenge. No matter if it’s in reality or in the simulation, you are determined to leave your enemy with no burial ground.]
[Unfortunately, when the quasi-emperor made a move, they obviously used the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret technique to conceal their identity, and you can’t see their true identity. Apparently, this person is also a cultivator who joined the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[Of course, you’re not disappointed. You may not be able to see their identity, but as long as a Great Emperor steps in, their identity can certainly be uncovered. After all, although the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret technique is against the heavens, it’s not completely insoluble. As long as one’s cultivation is high enough, they can definitely see through the hidden faces and the Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills they practice.]

chapters.title: Chapter 743: 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Goodbye Ye Chen_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: Chapter 214: Suppressing Yudao Hong! Goodbye Ye Chen_3
[In an instant, the Quasi-Emperor saw that the Jee Family’s Quasi-Emperor was actually protecting you and even considered using the Jee Family’s Emperor’s artifact. He was secretly furious and could only flee from here.]
[After that, peace returned to this region, and you were no longer attacked, which allowed you to breathe a sigh of relief. If possible, you certainly didn’t want to use your Golden Talent: Transmission to escape during a fight between two quasi-emperors.]
[Even though your Golden Talent: Transmission has brought many surprises, you haven’t forgotten that it’s also sent you to some deathly situations before.]
[Once you breathed a sigh of relief, the Wang family also did the same. Your close relationship with the Jee Family was not good for the Wang Family, but they didn’t dare to attack you. After all, once they did, even if you died, the Wang family would definitely be uprooted by Taiyi Imperial Palace, with no chance of survival.]
[Soon, everything settled down. After stabilizing your own condition in the Jee Family, you bid farewell to Ji Bingyan, left the Jee Family, and prepared to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[On your way back to Taiyi Imperial Palace, you encounter a person who surprises you quite a bit.]
[This person turned out to be Ye Chen. His current cultivation had reached the Saint King 3rd tier, which was a whole Great Realm higher than the Saint tier you had estimated in your previous simulations.]
[However, at the moment, Ye Chen’s condition wasn’t very good, as he was being pursued by a Great Saint. Although it was apparent that his strength had been enhanced due to the granny’s ring, he was still no match for this Great Saint.]
[Seeing this, you quickly stepped in and instantly killed the Great Saint. This scene shocked Ye Chen and the granny in the ring. After all, the cultivation you showed at the moment was just a Half-step Great Saint.]
[A Half-step Great Saint casually killing a Great Saint with one move was overly terrifying. Only monsters in the top 10 of the Saint King Ranking could probably achieve this feat.]
[After some brainstorming, Ye Chen and the granny in the ring recognized your identity as the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Tao Palace and hurriedly thanked you for your help.]
[You found this quite interesting. After leaving the Elemental Star, you had been concealing your identity with the Nine Stars Pavilion’s Secret Skill, and using a false name. As a result, very few people could recognize your true identity.]
[As for how Ji Bingyan knew that you were the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Emperor’s Palace, it could only be said that women were more attentive to details and figured out your identity by examining your life-bound weapon.]
[When you left the Purple Spirit Realm, you left some precautions behind and naturally met Ji Bingyan. Perhaps it was at that time that she saw the design and name of your life-bound weapon, which led her to make some connections and attempt to contact you.]
[Next, you let the Half-step Supreme who was secretly protecting you temporarily leave and revealed your true identity. When Ye Chen saw your true face, he was dumbfounded. He never thought that the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Emperor’s Palace would turn out to be his long-lost Mentor.]
[As for the granny in the ring, she was also shocked, never expecting Ye Chen’s Mentor, who he always boasted about, to be the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Emperor’s Palace. The Second Imperial Son was a prominent figure, a future Supreme, and a monster with the potential to step into the realm of Quasi-Emperor.]
[As a result, such an extraordinary person actually ascended from a lower realm a hundred thousand years ago was quite terrifying. For a time, the granny in the ring felt that the Purple Spirit Realm, this small place in the lower realm, was indeed a land of outstanding people.]
[Next, you and Ye Chen began catching up. Ye Chen also bitterly recounted the tragic experiences he had undergone over the years. Since ascending to the Upper Realm, he had been imprisoned and hunted down constantly, with several near-death experiences. Although he eventually survived and gained many opportunities, increasing his strength tremendously, the memories still haunted him.]
[In response, you sighed and said that fortune and disaster go hand in hand, and without these difficulties, you could not have grown to this point or have your physique evolve to be just below the Sacred Body.]
[Hearing your words, Ye Chen also sighed, saying that he was lucky to have obtained a secret skill that allowed him to strengthen himself by devouring powerful flames. Over the years, he had relied on this secret skill to enhance his talent to such an extent.]
[At this point, Ye Chen asked you curiously if you knew about the Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[Hearing the name Purgatory Ancient Star, you were somewhat surprised, thinking back to the scenes from your previous simulations when you set foot on the Purgatory Ancient Star. Among those scenes, the white flame that erupted from the Purgatory Ancient Star, which could even melt the Black Abyss Demon Spear, still made your heart race.]
[That flame had undoubtedly reached the level of Supreme power and was likely to be far beyond the scope of a normal Supreme.]
[As various thoughts flashed through your mind, you nodded and said that you had been there but didn’t encounter anything special. Hearing this, Ye Chen smiled bitterly, revealing a look of both fear and yearning, and said that he obtained his secret skill on the Purgatory Ancient Star. However, he almost perished there, utterly reducing to ashes.]

chapters.title: Chapter 744: 214: Suppressing Yu Daohong! Goodbye Ye Chen_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Chapter 214: Suppressing Yu Daohong! Goodbye Ye Chen_4
[On the Purgatory Ancient Star, there exists more than one terrifying flame. Among them, a white flame is the most dreadful. Ye Chen stated that after many years of investigation, he found out that the white flame might be a kind of Emperor Flame with a great secret hidden within it. If he could refine that flame, he would become a formidable figure in the Upper Realm.]
[Hearing Ye Chen’s words, you are quite surprised. You hadn’t expected Ye Chen to have discovered so much, including unraveling a part of the truth about the white flame that you didn’t know. Keep in mind that when you first saw the white flame, even with a Supreme Artifact protecting you, you still perished instantly, let alone uncover the details about it.]
[Therefore, you can’t help but admire Ye Chen’s fortune, which many cultivators envy.]
[Next, after talking with Ye Chen about some matters, you invite him to join the Taiyi Imperial Palace and help the Old Lady in the ring rebuild her physical body with the help of some Alchemy Elders.]
[Overjoyed, Ye Chen naturally agrees to your proposal. The Old Lady in his ring is also thrilled and grateful to you for this opportunity. She hadn’t expected to have a chance to join Taiyi Imperial Palace, let alone have you ask for help to rebuild her physical body.]
[Originally, she had hoped Ye Chen would achieve the Supreme or Half-step Supreme status and then help her rebuild her body. But after experiencing so many hardships with Ye Chen, she began to doubt whether she could live long enough to see that day. Now, she can finally breathe a sigh of relief.]
[Afterward, you smile and don’t say much, choosing to summon the Dao Protector and head to Taiyi Imperial Palace together. At the same time, a piece of news makes its way throughout the Immortal Continent before you.]
[That is, Bai Xiaosheng publicly discloses your latest status, explaining how your Time-Space Body has become complete and how you survived the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. Bai Xiaosheng confirms your identity as the Young Emperor, placing you in the third position on the Saint King Ranking.]
[For a moment, numerous forces and cultivators across the Immortal Continent are shocked by the news, amazed by the Second Imperial Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace’s incredible destiny. Many Imperial-tier forces and Quasi-Emperor-tier forces are envious of the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s prosperous fortunes.]
[After all, two positions in the top ten of the Saint King Ranking are occupied by Taiyi Imperial Palace, with one at third and the other at currently sixth, previously fifth – a terrifying feat.]
[Compared to other forces’ envy, the old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace are also stirred, bursting with joy. They hadn’t expected Taiyi Imperial Palace to produce another outstanding figure. Perhaps, in this lifetime, Taiyi Imperial Palace could have the glory of having three Emperors in its ranks!]
[The various Imperial Sons are shocked and envious of your opportunities, but they are also excited, looking forward to future developments.]
[In their view, you had previously been defeated by Yu Daohong. Now that your Time-Space Body is complete and you’ve been ranked third on the Saint King List, you would undoubtedly challenge Yu Daohong once you return to Taiyi Imperial Palace. The intensity of such a clash is unimaginable and will greatly benefit their cultivation.]
[As everyone pays attention, you return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Upon your return, you don’t immediately challenge Yu Daohong but instead take on the Taiyi Sky Road.]
[Under everyone’s watchful gaze, you successfully reach the fifteenth floor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, breaking the previous record of the fourteenth floor set by Yu Daohong and the Great Emperor Ancestor. This news shakes everyone in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[As for the Quasi-Emperor who wanted to accept you as an apprentice, he is also full of emotions, thinking that your ambitions are as grand as the qualifications to possess such aspirations. He indeed lacks the qualifications to be your master.]
[Just as everyone is astonished and the Quasi-Emperor is feeling a myriad of emotions, an anomaly occurs. The Emperor’s Might appears, shaking the entire Taiyi Imperial Palace. This is the arrival of the current Great Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Under everyone’s gaze, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor first praises you before asking if you’re willing to accept him as your master. Hearing this, you are overjoyed and without hesitation, choose to become an apprentice of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Thus, you become the personal disciple of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, elevating your status significantly. Subsequently, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor bestows some treasures upon you, awards you a considerable amount of Sect Contribution Points, and then disappears.]
[Seeing this, you feel pleased and leave the Taiyi Sky Road. At this moment, the First Imperial Son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s own son, Yu Daohong, stares at you with burning eyes, challenging you to a duel.]
[In response, you laugh heartily, not afraid at all, and choose to confront him. Although it would be the best choice to cultivate in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, understand more than 70% of the Time Law, and then challenge Yu Daohong, you do not have any fear and believe that you are already capable of suppressing Yu Daohong.]
[Under everyone’s watchful gaze, a world-shaking battle ensues between the two of you. In a small world created by the old monsters, you fight intensely, causing massive destruction. Yu Daohong is forced to reveal all his hidden powers. In the end, you narrowly emerge victorious, triumphing over the formidable opponent Yu Daohong.]

chapters.title: Chapter 745: 214: Suppressing Yu Daohong! Goodbye Ye Chen_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Chapter 214: Suppressing Yu Daohong! Goodbye Ye Chen_5
[Seeing this, everyone was extremely astonished, feeling that a complete Time-Space Body was indeed formidable enough to cause your combat power to surge significantly. This is still considering that you have just acquired the complete Time-Space Body and haven’t had the time to comprehend the Time Law. If you comprehend the Time Law, you might be able to suppress Yu Daohong even more easily.]
[Even more, there is a high probability that you can defeat Shi Yuyan, who is currently ranked second on the Saint King Ranking. It is important to note that Shi Yuyan also possesses a constitution that far surpasses the Sacred Body. Although her constitution is not as powerful as the Time-Space Body, it is still incredibly strong. Coupled with her lineage as a direct descendant of a Great Emperor, she possesses the most concentrated Great Emperor Bloodline, making her much more powerful than Yu Daohong, consistently ranking her second on the Saint King Ranking.]
[If the first rank of the Saint King Ranking were not occupied by the Longevity Ku Family’s Ku Xuan, Shi Yuyan could undoubtedly become the number one on the Saint King Ranking. It is fair to say that even in other golden eras, she would be eligible to contend for the first place.]
[In the minds of the old monsters, your strength surpasses that of Shi Yuyan. This is undoubtedly a very high evaluation. Of course, they still believe that you are not as good as Ku Xuan, and they think that no one in this world can compare with Ku Xuan, even those self-titled Monsters who have been sealed for many years.]
[As the old monsters sighed with emotion, Yu Daohong sighed and admitted his defeat wholeheartedly. However, he declared that in the future, he would regain the position that was taken from him, and then left the small world.]
[Regarding Yu Daohong’s words, you didn’t care. Since you have already surpassed Yu Daohong, you are confident that he will never have the opportunity to surpass you again.]
[With that, the Emperor’s Child battle came to an end, and you became the new First Emperor Child of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Your reputation spread throughout the Upper Realm, becoming one of the many targets people chased after.]
[Ye Chen, too, basked in your glory and became the object of envy amongst many in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. After all, Ye Chen is the apprentice of this monster who has the potential to become the Emperor of Tao Proving in the future. Now, not only are you so dazzling, but you have also become the disciple of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. In other words, Ye Chen has also become the grand-disciple of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Such status and background are truly terrifying. If one could replace it, their Cultivation Path would be much smoother, avoiding the majority of troubles.]
[You didn’t care about the thoughts of others and chose to enter the Taiyi Emperor Tower for cultivation directly.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly fifty years have passed, and with the help of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, you successfully comprehended the Time Law to the Great Perfection Tier. At this point, both your Time-Space Laws are complete, and your strength has soared once again.]
[When you left the seclusion, you discovered that many things had happened in the outer world. However, most events were similar to those in the previous simulation in your memory. The only difference was that many of the Monsters born later chose to come to the Taiyi Imperial Palace to challenge you.]
[Due to your retreat, these Monsters naturally couldn’t challenge you, so they chose to challenge Yu Daohong instead.]
[Perhaps because of his defeat to you, Yu Daohong didn’t refuse any challengers and fought them one by one. In the end, although he lost two battles, he also upheld the prestige of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[As for Ye Chen, although he was cultivating in these years, his cultivating speed slowed down upon arriving at the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Regarding this, you were speechless. In your opinion, perhaps Ye Chen is more suited to be a loose cultivator and continue on the path of a waste material. Coming to the comfortable environment of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, on the contrary, made him somewhat slack off and unable to grow stronger quickly.]
[For this reason, you directly expelled Ye Chen from the Taiyi Imperial Palace and instructed him to go out and gain experience so as not to just cultivate safely in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[With regards to your actions, Ye Chen felt helpless but also didn’t dare to defy you, his esteemed master. He could only rub his nose and set off to gain experience.]
[Soon, the news of you leaving the seclusion spread, and Monsters came to challenge you quickly. In response, you didn’t refuse any of them and suppressed all challengers with ease, without any intense battles taking place.]
[This made many people shudder, realizing that your strength had once again improved significantly. Yu Daohong watched your actions in silence on multiple occasions. Then, without hesitation, he left the Taiyi Imperial Palace to experience life and death. He didn’t plan on returning until he broke through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[As for you, you also prepared to leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace to search for Monsters to take as your apprentices, saving time for the major challenges in breaking through the Great Saint barrier. At the same time, you were seeking the Emperor Devouring Space and the Temporal Scriptures.]
[However, before you could leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you were called over by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Upon seeing you, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor first nodded in satisfaction and then presented two items to you. The first item was a skull that belonged to the Quasi-Emperor who attacked you after you underwent the Crossing Tribulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 746: 215: Battle of the Dual Emperors! Heavenly Calculation's Child's Arrangement
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Chapter 215: Battle of the Dual Emperors! Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s Arrangement
“Goodness, Emperor Sky Feather is really protective of his people! He’s actually seeking revenge for them. A Quasi-Emperor was beheaded just like that and brought before me.”
As Wang Ping watched the simulation content, he felt a mix of emotions.
It seemed that during his retreat, Emperor Sky Feather had been searching for this Quasi-Emperor and personally killed him.
Otherwise, a Quasi-Emperor would not die so miserably, beheaded and unable to self-destruct even if defeated by another powerful Quasi-Emperor.
“I have a feeling I’ve been quite strategic with my choice of factions.”
Wang Ping laughed softly.
Although there had been a bad apple in the Seven Star Palace, the subsequent factions he joined, be it the Heavenly Sword Divine Land, Dao Palace, or Taiyi Emperor’s Palace, were all good ones and had helped him a lot.
“No, I almost forgot that disgusting Whiteflame Divine Sect. However, the sect has already been annihilated, so it’s not worth it for me to specifically remember them.”
Wang Ping recalled the Whiteflame Divine Sect and shook his head slightly.
Most of the factions he had encountered were decent overall.
While Wang Ping was deep in his thoughts, the text simulation continued.
[Looking at this Quasi-Emperor’s skull, you feel a surge of gratitude toward Emperor Sky Feather. After all, this enemy had attacked you before, and you wanted to kill him. However, you know very well that unless you also cultivate to the Quasi-Emperor tier, it would be difficult to kill him on your own.]
[Without killing him, this guy would definitely keep an eye on you and look for opportunities to strike. You already have various powerful individuals tracking you, and having a Quasi-Emperor would only give you more headaches.]
[Emperor Sky Feather then says that there’s no need for you to thank him, as this is what a Master should do. Anyone who dares to target his disciple, even if they are a Grand Emperor, would have to pay the price, and he would not hesitate to kill them if possible.]
[Hearing Emperor Sky Feather’s dominating words, you feel a strong sense of security.]
[Next, Emperor Sky Feather takes out something. This item is none other than the Devouring Space Emperor’s Sutra that you desire so much, making you overjoyed.]
[Seeing your excitement, Emperor Sky Feather laughs and says that Time-Space Body is best suited for cultivating both the Path of Time and Space. However, Time Emperor Sutra and Space Emperor Sutra are too rare and difficult to find, and even Taiyi Emperor’s Palace doesn’t possess them. Therefore, over these years, he has made some deals with Emperor Devouring Space to obtain the Devouring Space Emperor’s Sutra for you.]
[Upon hearing this, you’re moved beyond words and express your gratitude. Although you don’t know what price Emperor Sky Feather has paid to obtain another Emperor’s Scripture, it must be a whopping one. After all, who would willingly trade away their own Emperor Scripture? If another Emperor of the same realm were to study it, they might be able to find the owner’s weakness.]
[Emperor Sky Feather shakes his head, saying that as your Master, it’s his responsibility to do these things for you, so you don’t need to be grateful. He then adds that just possessing the Devouring Space Emperor’s Sutra is not enough to fully unleash the power of your Time-Space Body. Since the Time-Space Body places Time above Space, the fusion of Time and Space is even more powerful. Therefore, you have to cultivate Time Emperor Sutra in conjunction. As for the Time Emperor Sutra, he has been searching for the location of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture for years and hopes you won’t be too anxious about it.]
…
“Emperor Sky Feather is truly dependable.”
Watching the text simulation content, Wang Ping felt a surge of emotions.
“It seems that I will have another person to protect in the future. Once I’m fully grown, I’ll definitely support Taiyi Emperor’s Palace if it ever runs into trouble.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
Of course, even though he thought that, the possibility of a significant crisis occurring in the long-standing Taiyi Emperor’s Palace was minimal, and he wouldn’t be able to help them anytime soon.
That is unless he could ascend to immortality. In that case, he could lead them to even greater heights even without any major crises happening.
“As for the Dao Palace, I’ll wait a bit longer. As long as my cultivation improves further and I attain Supreme Cultivation, I can suppress Primordial Thunder Supreme and that Great Saint with the Emperor’s artifact that attacked. At that time, no one will be able to destroy the Dao Palace.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he clenched his fists.
Not only would he defeat these two individuals in the simulation, but he would also uncover and eliminate them in reality to prevent any accidents from happening to the Dao Palace.
Furthermore, providing protection to the Dao Palace was necessary.
As Wang Ping pondered over these thoughts, the text simulation continued.
[Hearing this, you feel a great deal of emotion in your heart. This is the advantage of having a Great Emperor as a master. There’s no need for you to do much or search for opportunities, as he arranges everything for you. If a Great Emperor is searching, it’s bound to be much faster than searching on your own.]
[For this reason, you directly take out a broken map that records the location information of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and give it to Emperor Sky Feather, hoping it will be of some help in his search.]
[Seeing that you’ve taken out the broken map with the location information of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, Emperor Sky Feather is startled, then laughs. He says that since you possess the Time-Space Body, it seems that you’re indeed destined with the Dark Time Emperor. So you were able to obtain this opportunity.]
[Afterward, Emperor Sky Feather says that with this broken map, things will be much easier. He will either seek Heavenly Calculation’s Child or the Divine Calculation Man who’s in hiding within the Immortal Mansion. With their abilities, they should be able to deduce the specific location of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture using this broken map.]

chapters.title: Chapter 747: 215: Battle of the Two Emperors! Heavenly Calculation's Child's Arrangement_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Chapter 215: Battle of the Two Emperors! Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s Arrangement_2
[Hearing this, you felt overjoyed, thinking that the Dark Time Emperor Scripture was now within reach. However, you remembered something else: the matter concerning the Heavenly Calculation’s Child. You asked Emperor Heavenly Feather about the true identity of the Heavenly Calculation’s Child.]
[In response to your inquiry, Emperor Heavenly Feather pondered for a moment and said that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child had a mysterious origin, seemingly not from this realm, and although his cultivation was only at the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection, even a great emperor would find it difficult to defeat him.]
[Besides that, Heavenly Calculation’s Child was most powerful in his Heavenly Secret Skill, which was extremely profound and could calculate the heavens and earth and predict the past, present, and future. His calculations had hardly ever been wrong.]
[Upon hearing this, you felt a chill run down your spine. The cultivation of the Heavenly Calculation’s Child astonished you, as Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection was only a step away from being a great emperor. As for his identity, it made you even more concerned. The Heavenly Calculation’s Child was not from this realm, which meant that he was likely from the All Heavens.]
[A being from the All Heavens undoubtedly had a higher status and seemed more dangerous. In addition, you realized that Emperor Heavenly Feather was clearly aware that there were many cultivators and forces from outside the Upper Realm in the Upper Realm itself, which left you quite surprised.]
[However, you then thought that it was normal for Emperor Heavenly Feather, as a great emperor and the current ruler of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, to know about the All Heavens. Perhaps the founder of the Nine Stars Pavilion came from outside the Upper Realm and their existence was not a secret to these big shots.]
[As you were deep in thought, Emperor Heavenly Feather spoke again, asking why you were so interested in the Heavenly Calculation’s Child. Was it because, like him, you were also from outside the Upper Realm?]
[At those words, you were suddenly startled and astonished, not expecting Emperor Heavenly Feather to see through your true identity. However, you also bitterly laughed, thinking that it was a perfectly normal occurrence.]
[After all, when you were in the Lower Realm, even emperors could tell that you came from somewhere other than the Purple Spirit Realm. How could a great emperor not see that you were a traverser? Even with the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method and the Golden Talent – Heavenly Mystery Concealment, you could not hide your identity. Nevertheless, in the Upper Realm, these cultivators were much more accepting of traversers and visitors from outside their domain than you had ever imagined.]
[Following that, you admitted to it and spoke about some of your previous experiences. This greatly surprised Emperor Heavenly Feather. He hadn’t expected the Heavenly Calculation’s Child to have calculated so many things and have such immense ambition.]
[Subsequently, Emperor Heavenly Feather became pensive and said that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child was very peculiar and had made grand schemes. No one knew his true objectives. Some emperors felt that his existence was dangerous and had tried to capture him, but who would have thought that he could effortlessly escape from the hands of a great emperor?]
[After saying this, Emperor Heavenly Feather spoke again, stating that although they did not know the Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s objectives before, they could deduce from your description that he was aiming for the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[Although he wasn’t sure whether the Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s schemes would allow him to successfully enter the Elemental Forbidden Land, it was evident that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child intended to do so and knew many secrets unknown to others.]
[Feeling amazed, you couldn’t understand how planning the Black Abyss Demon Spear could be related to the Elemental Forbidden Land. Could it be that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child had calculated you into his plans and intended to help you?]
[At this moment, Emperor Heavenly Feather’s gaze flickered, and he spoke again, assuring you that there was no need to worry too much. With him around, even if the Heavenly Calculation’s Child had calculated you in his plans, he would do his best to protect you. Upon hearing this, you chuckled and felt incredibly secure.]
[After a pause, Emperor Heavenly Feather spoke again and mentioned that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child had been missing for over 100,000 years. Rumor had it that he had mysteriously gone mad, but no one knew whether this was true or false.]
[Hearing this, you were amazed and felt that the timing was quite coincidental. If it was about 100,000 years ago, it would have been around the time you had just arrived in this world.]
[Could it be that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child wasn’t calculating you, but rather someone like Ye Chen? He had laid out his plans, but your appearance had disrupted them.]
[Moreover, because of your Life Simulator, the future could change in myriad ways. If it didn’t involve you, it wouldn’t matter, but if it did, his Heavenly Secrets would likely become very chaotic. There was even a high probability that he would be bitten back by the Heavenly Secrets.]
[Countless thoughts flashed through your mind, and you felt that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child might have truly been bitten back by Heavenly Secrets. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have suddenly disappeared for so many years and rumors of him going mad wouldn’t have surfaced.]
[Thinking of this, you recalled the Divine Calculation Man and wondered whether he had been affected as well. However, since he had made an appearance and spoken in the Immortal Mansion several decades later, it meant that he was unharmed.]
[As you were deep in thought, Emperor Heavenly Feather saw your ever-changing expressions and shook his head with a smile, saying that you really didn’t have to worry so much. Hearing this, you snapped back to reality and nodded, suppressing the various speculations in your heart.]
…
“Heavenly Calculation’s Child, I hope you’ve truly been bitten back by Heavenly Secrets. Otherwise, your existence is far too dangerous.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Text Simulation and thought to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation's Child's Strategy_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Chapter 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s Strategy_3
The thoughts in the text simulation are still not comprehensive.
Wang Ping feels that perhaps the reason why nothing happened to the Divine Calculator of the Immortal Mansion is that he did not involve the calculation of his Heavenly Secrets…
But Wang Ping believes that the greater possibility is because, in the simulation, Wang Ping could not use the Life Simulator, so the Divine Calculator was unharmed.
For Heavenly Calculation’s Child, however, who was arranging his plans and Wang Ping deeply involved in the key areas, the changes in Heavenly Secrets would naturally attract his attention, so he would definitely calculate the Heavenly Secrets in reality as well.
But Wang Ping, who has the Life Simulator, has countless futures, chaotic Heavenly Secrets, making the chance of Heavenly Calculation’s Child being backfired almost 100%.
The Dao of Heavenly Secrets is incredibly powerful, able to calculate everything, but it’s also very prone to accidents. A little carelessness could lead to a backlash of Heavenly Secrets, and it’s normal for one to die and lose his way.
After quietly cursing Heavenly Calculation’s Child, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you asked curiously about the Elemental Forbidden Land. You naturally searched the archives of Taiyi Imperial Palace about the Elemental Forbidden Land. Unfortunately, although Taiyi Imperial Palace’s archives record many secrets of the Upper Realm, it’s not an encyclopedia that contains everything. There was no record of the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[Originally, you thought Taiyi Imperial Palace did not pay attention to the Elemental Forbidden Land, an unremarkable Ancient Star. Now it seems that this is not the case. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor obviously knows about the Elemental Star and Elemental Forbidden Land, and even knows some big secrets in it.]
[Seeing your questions about the Elemental Forbidden Land, the expression of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor rarely became serious, indicating that although you and Elemental Ancient Star have a deep connection, the you at present is not qualified to know the secrets of Elemental Forbidden Land. Knowing the secrets could be more harm than good for you.]
[Seeing the expression of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor become so serious, it made your heart shiver in fear. The secrets of the Elemental Forbidden Land are, without doubt, more terrifying than you imagined. The heart you once guessed to be a Quasi-Emperor or Great Emperor’s heart, seemed not to be that simple.]
[In addition, the massive dark figure that appeared deep in the Elemental Forbidden Place, the second soul of Lin Qinghe, the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, said that the huge dark figure had the aura of a Quasi-Emperor, and you didn’t doubt it. Now it looked like that massive figure was absolutely not only a Quasi-Emperor.]
[If the heart sealed in the inner region is already so terrifying, let alone the enormous shadow appearing in the deeper part.]
[In the end, you chose not to pursue further. After all, the secrets of the Elemental Forbidden Land, as your Teacher Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said, are not something you can investigate now. Forcing inquiries could put your life in danger.]
[Next, you had a nice chat with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor who gave you a jade pendant and a Quasi-Emperor Artifact for self-defense which left you amazed.]
[The Jade Pendant has his incarnation in it, and will be activated when you are in a life-and-death situation. If there is no life-threatening danger, even if you are in a perilous situation, it will not be triggered.]
[The Quasi-Emperor Artifact doesn’t need much explanation, its valuable nature is self-evident, and it can significantly increase your combat power. However, in order to temper you, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor also imposed many restrictions on this Quasi-Emperor Artifact. For example, in battles of the same level, you can’t use this Quasi-Emperor Artifact.]
[If you want to use the Quasi-Emperor Artifact, only when another Quasi-Emperor Artifact appears or when you encounter an old monster whose strength is much stronger than yours, then you can use it.]
[You don’t have any objections to this, and think it’s quite reasonable. If you can use it anytime, then you will indeed become reliant on the Quasi-Emperor Artifact. When you first had Black Abyss Demon Lord’s Life Bound Weapon – Abyssal Demon Spear, you were indeed very dependent on it. Black Abyss Demon Lord also pointed this out, and you naturally would not repeat the same mistake.]
[Next, you chose to leave. You decided to first practice the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, then go out looking for opportunities or a monstrous disciple to help you break through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[In the blink of an eye, another twenty years passed. During these times, you successfully mastered Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, and your combat power improved again. As for Time-related Divine Skills, you had no feasible method at the moment, and could only resort to extrapolating a part of it using Tao Tian Emperor Scripture in these twenty years.]
[Although the Divine Skills derived from Tao Tian Emperor Scripture have diverse characteristics, they are indeed weaker than other Emperor-level Divine Skills, let alone compared with Dark Time Emperor Scripture.]
[However, you don’t have a Time-related Emperor Scripture now, so doing this is inevitable. As long as you can first enhance your combat power, that’s enough.]
[Next, you chose to leave seclusion. After you left, you heard the news of Great Thunder Immortal Body Lei Wanqian’s recent emergence, directly challenging Shi Yuyan, the second ranked on the Saint King Ranking.]
[You were quite interested in this and chose to go to their agreed fight location. Since you only heard the news afterwards in your previous memories of their grand battle, you didn’t see the actual fighting, naturally you couldn’t miss it.]
[When you arrived here, you also found that many of Heaven’s Chosen Monsters from the Upper Realm had gathered here. It was a shocking scene. Among them, not only were the Heaven’s Chosen Monsters from the Saint King Ranking present, but powerful ones from the Saint Ranking and Great Saint Ranking had also come.]

chapters.title: Chapter 749: 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation's Child's Strategy_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Chapter 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s Strategy_4
[Although the Saint Ranking is undoubtedly much weaker than the Saint King Ranking, there are still many gifted monsters among them. Their talents are no less than those of the Saint King Ranking; they simply lack time and accumulation.]
[As for the Great Saint Ranking, it is even more needless to say, compared to the monsters on the Saint King Ranking, they stand a whole Great Realm higher, their strength far more formidable.
