Although it’s said that the monsters in the Great Saint Ranking don’t possess talents stronger than the top five monsters on the Saint King Ranking, they have deeper accumulation and longer cultivation times, which makes them equally formidable.]
[The path to enlightenment is filled with competition and uncertainty. No one knows who will win or lose.]
[After you arrived here, you attracted the attention of many people. Many of them looked at you with sharp eyes, among them were Heaven’s Chosen Monsters but also a large number of powerful cultivators.]
[However, they are only guessing about your current strength, and they don’t have any ulterior motives nor dare to have any. After all, just decades ago, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor directly entered the Erebos Demon Sect, showing off his domineering and powerful abilities while violently fighting against Erebos Emperor and also slaughtered the Quasi-Emperor of Erebos Demon Sect.]
[In the end, the result of that battle saw the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor kill people, engage in a great battle with Erebos Emperor, destroy a Starfield, and return unscathed. Although Erebos Emperor was furious, he could do nothing but let it go, not daring to fight a deadly war with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Erebos Emperor, possessing a Demonic Body and having reached a Perfect Domain, was among the Absolute strongest Emperors. While the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had always been low-key, giving people the impression of an Ordinary Emperor. The decisive battle between the two ended in such a result, which shook the Upper Realm and reestablished the position of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[At the same time, the Upper Realm cultivators realized how powerful the current generation of Taiyi Imperial Palace truly is and how protective they could be.]
[The Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace was attacked but didn’t die. If it were other Emperors, they might have confronted Erebos Emperor, making him pay the price, but they wouldn’t have directly fought him. After all, the influence of an Emperor’s battle is too significant and could cause the entire Upper Realm to destabilize.]
[Especially in the current Golden Age, such a fierce battle could easily provoke a deadly war between the two major powers. When that time comes, nobody will benefit, and they may even miss the opportunity to become immortals.]
[In the eyes of the many cultivators from the Upper Realm, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s direct attack on the Erebos Demon Sect and his battle against Erebos Emperor and slaughtering the Quasi-Emperor along the way was an extreme and crazy act.]
[However, as crazy as it was, the results were remarkable. In the present Upper Realm, the vast majority of cultivators wouldn’t dare to provoke the disciples of Taiyi Imperial Palace easily. Especially for the Imperial Prince-level Characters, even if there is a deep-rooted aversion by powerful cultivators, most of them wouldn’t dare to act. They can’t bear the revenge of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and nobody wants their hundreds of thousands of years of cultivation to go in vain.]
…..
“It turns out that so many things happened back then. I thought it was just a single incident where a Quasi-Emperor had been caught and instantly suppressed.”
Wang Ping watched the simulation content, slightly startled and very surprised.
At the same time, his admiration for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor increased.
After all, it wasn’t easy for someone to go to such lengths for their disciple.
“As Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is so powerful, it’s no wonder he said I shouldn’t worry about Heavenly Calculation’s Child. If Heavenly Calculation’s Child dares to make a move, he will either die or end up running away in utter devastation.”
Wang Ping thought about Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s situation and couldn’t help but laugh.
He didn’t know the relative strength of Emperors before.
Now, the life-simulation had given him some hints.
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Erebos Emperor are among the most powerful Emperors in the present world, with few rivals.
If Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had been the one to deal with Heavenly Calculation’s Child back then, it would have been a real question whether the latter could escape or not.
As Wang Ping silently thought, the simulation continued.
[Unfazed by the attention from all sides, you simply closed your eyes to rest and waited for Great Thunder Immortal Physique ·Lei Wanqian and the Rain Spirit Imperial Daughter·Shi Yuyan to arrive and engage in the most splendid battle of the Heaven’s Chosen.]
[However, what you didn’t expect was that before Lei Wanqian and Shi Yuyan arrived to fight, you were challenged by someone else.]
[The person who challenged you was none other than the personally-taught Emperor’s son of Erebos Emperor and the First Demon of Erebos Demon Sect. It’s said that the Erebos Demon Son had been sealed for many years. In the past, he fought against cultivators in the same realm and was considered unbeatable. He was also regarded as a young Emperor with the potential to achieve enlightenment.]
[Now, in this Golden Age, he has been unsealed and included in the Saint King Ranking by Bai Xiaosheng, ranking No.5, effectively seizing Yu Daohong’s previous position.]
[Clearly, he is confident and doesn’t think he’s any weaker than you if not stronger. At the same time, he is also very unhappy about the fact that his master lost face to your master, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and wants to regain their reputation.]
[Faced with this, you’re fearless, snorted coldly, and indicated that you are ready for battle. Seeing this, the interested parties all became excited. After all, this is a battle between the top five of the Saint King Ranking.]

chapters.title: Chapter 750: 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation's Child's Strategy_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Chapter 215: Battle of the Twin Emperors! Heavenly Calculation’s Child’s Strategy_5
[None of the top ten in the Saint King Ranking are simple opponents, and it goes without saying for the top five. However, before the appearance of the self-titled Monsters, Kuxuan, Shi Yuyan, and yourself were the top three in the ranking, facing challenges from the later-born geniuses.]
[If defeated and their position on the Saint King Ranking replaced, their fate would undoubtedly be devoured, their Tao Heart affected, and it would have a significant impact on their future.]
[Therefore, many people believed that today was truly bustling. Lei Wanqian challenged Shi Yuyan earlier, and now the Erebos Demon Son challenges you in a battle of destiny.]
[Soon, you both engaged in a terrifying battle, which devastated the land. You didn’t take Erebos Demon Son lightly, as his inclusion in the fifth place on the Saint King ranking by Bai Xiaosheng meant he was extraordinary.]
[As it turned out, the Erebos Demon Son was indeed powerful, and even you couldn’t defeat him without showing a substantial portion of your strength. However, you still hid some of your power, preparing for the upcoming battles against Lei Wanqian or Shi Yuyan.]
[The hidden trump card you possessed was the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, and you only used the Time-Space Divine Skill derived from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture in battle. The fact that you employed the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture came as a surprise to many geniuses and old monsters alike, especially the observing Quasi-Emperors and Great Emperors who couldn’t help but feel sentimental.]
[Emperor Tao Tian had long been sitting in meditation, and the Tao Palace had been destroyed. Over the years, few inheritors of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture had emerged. Seeing the Scripture again disturbed their emotions. Even Great Emperors couldn’t escape death, and even imperial-tier forces couldn’t survive forever in this world.]
[While seeking unconventional immortality and falling into depravity at the Source of Darkness was an option, they wouldn’t resort to that unless absolutely necessary. Not to mention, the Source of Darkness was not entirely safe.]
[Perhaps only by becoming immortal can one truly achieve eternal life. Alas, the path to immortality is elusive and exceedingly difficult!]
[As various factions contemplated complex emotions, you continued to fight against the Erebos Demon Son. In the end, he was no match for you despite possessing the Erebos Demonic Body, along with terrifying Secret Skills he learned directly from the Erebos Emperor. You defeated him decisively.]
[During this battle, you relied on your own strength to beat him without triggering the Purple Talent: Endless Blade or selectively closing the Golden Talent – Ensemble. By doing so, you aimed to test the extent of your power.]
[As it turned out, your strength was indeed formidable, and the Time-Space Tao was sufficiently disgusting. Although Erebos Demon Son was powerful, he spent most of the fight being beaten by you and was only able to take a passive defensive position with few opportunities to counterattack.]
[All in all, your current battle prowess did not disappoint you. You were confident that even without obtaining the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, you would have had a chance of victory against Lei Wanqian.]
[However, just as you were about to suppress the Erebos Demon Son and inflict significant damage once more, a terrifying aura appeared, saving him.]
[Erebos Demon Son was saved by a Quasi-Emperor from the Erebos Demon Sect. You were somewhat disappointed but not surprised by this outcome.]
[To be honest, you never intended to kill the Erebos Demon Son in the first place. Under these circumstances, assassinating someone like him was impossible. Even if Taiyi Imperial Palace’s own Quasi-Emperor helped him block the Erebos Demon Sect’s Quasi-Emperor, he wouldn’t have succeeded in killing him.]
[The Erebos Demon Son certainly had Quasi-Emperor Artifacts for protection, and it wasn’t impossible for the incarnation of Erebos Emperor to be within him. Just as the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor values you, there’s no way the Erebos Emperor wouldn’t value a monster disciple like Erebos Demon Son, who could potentially prove his worth in the Dao in the future.]
[Furthermore, if you had truly killed Erebos Demon Son, the situation would have been bad. The Erebos Demon Sect would have certainly declared war on the Taiyi Imperial Palace. That would have led to catastrophic casualties for the Taiyi Imperial Palace, even in the event of victory, likely following in the footsteps of the Dao Palace.]
[Initially, the Dao Palace met its downfall after an unexpected demise of powerful members. You don’t want the Taiyi Imperial Palace, to whom you owe a profound debt of gratitude, to suffer severe losses and be taken advantage of by other imperial-tier forces.]
[While you contemplated various thoughts, the Erebos Demon Son, filled with resentment and rage, began to spew ruthless words at you, claiming that while he may have lost this time, he would definitely win the next time after completing the cultivation of the strongest secret skill of the Erebos Demon Scripture, which will cause his strength to soar.]
[At this, you looked bemused, thinking that the Erebos Demon Son’s mental state was really lacking. This piqued your interest, and amidst a sea of staring eyes, you spoke those long-forgotten words once again.]

chapters.title: Chapter 751: 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Chapter 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, initially satisfied with his own combat performance, but when he saw the last line of text, a knot formed in his heart.
“Please no, stop acting so full of yourself. Have you forgotten what happened the last time you were so arrogant during the simulation?”
A twitch appeared in the corner of Wang Ping’s mouth as he silently began to grumble.
However, no matter how much Wang Ping grumbled, the text simulation would obviously not stop.
[Under the watching eyes of the multitudes, you said, ‘Those defeated by my hand have never been considered my opponents. I give them time to catch up until they can’t see me.’]
[At your words, whether they were the Heavenly Chosen, the Supremes, the Quasi-emperors, or even the Emperors, were all stunned. Even your master, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, had strange eyes and couldn’t help but smile. He commented that you really are good at making a show of yourself.]
[Upon hearing your words, Erebos Demon Son went into a rage, glaring at you. It was one thing that you defeated him, but to take him as mere background in your arrogant show? That was simply intolerable.]
[However, although Erebos Demon Son felt hatred, like the other Heavenly Chosen, he silently memorized your impressively arrogant words, planning to tweak and use them later. At the same time, he planned to defeat you after becoming stronger and throw these words back at you to swell your face in humiliation.]
[Next, amidst the various discussions, the two parties who had their limelight stolen finally appeared. Both Thunder Immortal Lei Wanqian and Princess Shiyu Yan of Emperor Rain Spirit looked at you carefully.]
[In response, you just slightly nodded at them, showing no awkwardness at all.]
[Soon, under your watchful eyes, Thunder Immortal and Princess Shiyu Yan began their fight. They both fought fiercely, making your face serious. Their combat power was even stronger than you imagined.]
[You estimated that if you were to go all out against Shiyu Yan, you would have about a 95% chance of winning. As for Lei Wanqian, if you were to fight him now, the chances would only be about fifty-fifty. However, if you could cultivate the Dark Time Emperor Scripture instead of substituting it with the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, your chances of defeating Lei Wanqian would certainly be over eighty or ninety percent.]
[Of course, this does not take into account the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade. Although the Endless Blade is just a Purple Talent, its trigger probability is getting lower and lower at your level. However, under intense battles, there are thousands of clashes every minute. If the effect triggers once among the ten thousand times, it would give you an advantage.]
[If you’re lucky enough to trigger the effect when using a strong move, you could directly secure the victory. Not to mention, you also have the Purple Talent·Nullification of Divine Skill, which surpasses the purple ranking, the bug-level defensive Golden Talent: Damage Nullification and the Golden Talent: Multiplay which at least doubles your attack…]
[Considering your full capabilities, if you fully reveal your trump cards against Lei Wanqian, you wouldn’t even need to find the Dark Time Emperor Scripture to win easily. You are even confident enough to try going against Ku Xuan of the Longevity Ku Family.]
[But, you’ve always been a careful player. Though it’s possible to reveal all your tricks, it isn’t necessary. Exposing all your trump cards for your ranking in the Saint King Ranking would undoubtedly be a very stupid thing to do.]
[Although the Battle of the Heavenly Chosen is a fight for fate and achieving Tao, it is really stupid to reveal all your cards unless it’s a battle of life and death.]
[While many thoughts were flashing through your mind, Lei Wanqian and Shiyu Yan’s battle reached its peak. In the end, just like the last simulation, Lei Wanqian defeated Shiyu Yan.]
[However, after Lei Wanqian defeated Shiyu Yan, he turned to you, seemingly eager to challenge you next.]
[At this, you frowned, thinking that this Lei Wanqian is a real battle maniac.]
[Although you think battling Lei Wanqian is meaningless, you now represent the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and cannot show fear as it would be a loss of face for the palace and your master, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[As a result, under the watchful eyes of everyone, you calmly accepted Lei Wanqian’s challenge. However, you stated that you didn’t want to take advantage of him and allowed him to recover to his peak condition before fighting.]
[Lei Wanqian laughed heartily at your words, thunder roving wildly, stating that the battle between you and Erebos Demon Son must have drained you too, so there’s no need to rest, and that this would be fair.]
[You shake your head, explaining that defeating Erebos Demon Son didn’t take much effort, but Lei Wanqian had just defeated the powerful Shiyu Yan, which took a great deal of energy, and he was also injured, which was not fair.]
[Your words left Erebos Demon Son once again defenceless, his face grim and murderous, wishing to tear you apart. As for the others, the Heavenly Chosen and the old monsters, their gazes also became strange.]
[Your words were truly poisonous. They felt that if things continued like this, Erebos Demon Son would be so angry that his Tao Heart would become unstable. Once that happened, unless he defeated you within a day, the Heavenly Chosen Erebos, who had hope of proving to be the Emperor of Tao, would probably be ruined.]

chapters.title: Chapter 752: 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Chapter 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_2
[Lei Wanqian also laughed heartily, agreeing with you and not showing any respect for the Erebos Demon Son. He started to recover his strength, and so did you.]
[When facing Lei Wanqian, who possessed an Immortal Body, you didn’t let your guard down. You thought your various talents would be enough to secure your victory.]
[An hour later, under everyone’s watchful gaze, you both showed an intense fighting spirit and engaged in a fierce battle. This battle was even more shocking than the previous two fights. The collision between the Great Thunder Immortal Physique and Time-Space Body caused astonishing phenomena to appear in the heavens and earth. Thunder and time-space anomalies appeared simultaneously, stirring together, leaving countless cultivators in awe.]
[The fight between you and Lei Wanqian was equally terrifying. Thunderbolts pierced through time and space, skewing the laws and Divine Skills, making it hard to follow. Lei Wanqian’s speed and attack power were unparalleled due to his Great Thunder Immortal Physique and the cultivation of the Wild Thunder Emperor Scripture. Few could keep up with him.]
[However, the advantages of speed and power could not be fully utilized against your Time-Space Body. You controlled space, manipulated time, and were incredibly agile, with a bizarre fighting style that was difficult to deal with.]
[This angered Lei Wanqian, who roared and unleashed a terrifying Divine Skill, directly destroying time and space for a vast and violent area attack.]
[In response, you didn’t dare to be careless. You used your left hand to unleash the most powerful Divine Skill from the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, and your right hand released a Time Divine Skill deduced from the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. Combining the two, you unleashed a bizarre and terrifying force.]
[This collision was incredibly frightening, sending a chill down the spine of many Heaven’s Chosen Monsters, who were shocked by both your powers. Even Shi Yuyan was silent, realizing that Lei Wanqian had held back some of his strength during their battle.]
[As for the Erebos Demon Son, he almost bit through his molars. He didn’t expect that you had hidden so much combat power when you fought him. It was as if he was being played with like an insignificant child without any seriousness.]
[In the end, under the watchful gaze of everyone, your clash with Lei Wanqian resulted in a draw with both of you injured. Frowning, you realized that it would be impossible to defeat Lei Wanqian without using some hidden cards, especially without drawing attention.]
[However, at this point, you had no intention of backing down. A draw was out of the question, and neither you nor Lei Wanqian would accept it.]
[As you were pondering, Lei Wanqian laughed heartily, expressing his enjoyment of the fight. Then he continued attacking you relentlessly. In response, you pulled yourself together, snorted coldly, and decided to use the effect of Golden Talent: Multiplay under the watchful gaze of the crowd.]
[In an instant, you triggered a duet, doubling your Divine Skill attacks, and fortunately activated the effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade, launching it at Lei Wanqian. Caught off guard, Lei Wanqian’s face changed drastically. He tried to dodge but was too late, leaving him no choice but to withstand the attack.]
[However, if he were to withstand it, he would undoubtedly die. This left Lei Wanqian somewhat in disbelief, not expecting that you had hidden such a powerful card. He was caught off guard.]
[The spectators, whether they were Heaven’s Chosen Monsters or old monsters, were equally shocked. They didn’t expect that you could add such a twist even after displaying your most potent Divine Skills. Not even the Emperor Scripture that specialized in deception could achieve this, could it?]
[Furthermore, those old monsters didn’t sense any traces of Secret Skills on you. This situation was very strange.]
[However, among those old monsters, only the Emperor and a few Quasi-Emperors had their eyes flickering, deep in thought as they stared at you. Naturally, they knew some things beyond the Upper Realm, and the strong individuals of all major forces had captured some cultivators who had visited Myriad Heavens Paradise for interrogation. They, of course, knew about Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Those cultivators from the forces of All Heavens had mysterious objects and abilities in Myriad Heavens Paradise that could achieve such feats. However, those objects and abilities that also benefited Quasi-Emperors and Emperors were rare and precious, so they seldom saw them.]
[For a moment, they deduced that you might have visited Myriad Heavens Paradise and probably visited the place that made them envious. If only they could enter that place, they wouldn’t have to worry about their Immortal Tao.]
…..
“It seems that Wang Ping’s judgment in the simulation was correct, and my previous speculation was wrong. I can now fight Lei Wanqian evenly, and if I acquire the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, I will completely surpass him.”
Wang Ping watched the simulation content and smiled.
It seemed that the Time-Space Body was not inferior to the Great Thunder Immortal Physique and was even stronger considering its uniqueness.
Moreover, this was just the Time-Space Body in this realm. If it could evolve into the Time-Space Immortal Body, how terrifying would it be? The Great Thunder Immortal Physique would probably be nothing more than a younger brother in front of it.
Well, most likely, it would indeed be a stinky little brother, not even worth comparing in the same breath.
“Moreover, are these big shots of the Upper Realm even aware of things like Myriad Heavens Paradise? I don’t know whether to say it’s reasonable or surprising.”

chapters.title: Chapter 753: 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Chapter 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_3
Wang Ping thought of the other content in the Text Simulation and muttered to himself.
“But, can’t they enter Myriad Heavens Paradise? It seems that only those under the Myriad Heavens Forces are qualified to go there. I just don’t know why the Myriad Heavens Forces don’t really absorb some stronger native beings from other worlds.”
Wang Ping pondered with many questions in his mind.
In the end, he gave up thinking and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
After all, thinking so much was meaningless. Once his power became strong enough and his level high enough, all secrets would naturally be revealed.
[When various thoughts are taking place, Lei Wanqian’s Dao Protector makes a move, easily dissolving your attack and saving Lei Wanqian. At this, you smile faintly, having expected it and not caring.]
[Lei Wanqian looks at you with complicated emotions, cupping his hands in concession to his defeat.]
[With this, today’s Battle of Geniuses has come to a complete end. As for Ku Xuan, you don’t know where he is or if he is watching this side. However, you have no interest in challenging him like Lei Wanqian did in the last simulation.]
[As long as Ku Xuan does not bother you and challenges you, you have no interest in fighting him for now.]
[Next, more geniuses become interested and various challenges are exchanged, making the place still lively. However, the battles between these geniuses, although exciting, are ultimately not on par with the battles between you, Erebos Demon Son, Lei Wanqian, and Shi Yuyan.]
[After thinking about it, you decide to leave.]
[However, just as you are about to leave, you see an unexpected figure. This figure is none other than Zhu Huowang. At this moment, although Zhu Huowang’s cultivation is not strong, his physical strength has reached a shocking level, almost rivaling some Quasi-Saint List geniuses who are just below the Saint King Ranking geniuses.]
[In the end, Zhu Huowang defeats him with sheer force, shocking everyone and arousing curiosity in many forces about the sudden emergence of Zhu Huowang.]
[This moves you deeply. After all, counting the time, it has been less than 170 years since Zhu Huowang grew from a waste to a genius capable of rivaling the Quasi-Saint List. Such a short time is impossible for a normal cultivation, even for a Saint King Ranking monster at the bottom.]
[However, Zhu Huowang has achieved this feat, which is truly astounding. This makes you marvel at the strength of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, an Innate Emperor Artifact.]
[While marveling, you also feel that Zhu Huowang’s actions are somewhat irrational. After all, by challenging geniuses here and making a name for himself, someone will surely investigate his background.]
[Once it is discovered that he was a waste more than a hundred years ago and suddenly became strong to this level, he will definitely get targeted and suspected of having obtained some shocking great opportunity.]
[Even now, Wang Ping is somewhat suspicious as to whether any Quasi-Emperor and Emperor have detected the Devouring Spirit Pearl in Zhu Huowang. Although the Innate Emperor Artifact’s concealment ability is certainly strong, it is not easy to conceal them with the strength and means of the old monsters.]
[Thinking of this, you feel more and more that Zhu Huowang is too reckless. At the same time, you start to worry about him. Although in this life, he has nothing to do with you, and you forgot to go to the Zhu Family to accept him as a disciple, he is after all someone who worshipped you as his master in the last simulation and was approved by you as a disciple. You would not feel right if something happens to him.]
[With that in mind, you teleport directly to Zhu Huowang’s side, very enthusiastically talking to him. This makes everyone quite surprised, wondering why you treat Zhu Huowang so warmly.]
[After all, although Zhu Huowang is not bad and is a rare pure body cultivator, he shouldn’t catch your eye; his existence is completely distinct from yours.]
[Zhu Huowang is also quite astonished but politely chats with you. Once you get familiar with each other, you directly invite Zhu Huowang to visit Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[This makes everyone even more surprised. As for Zhu Huowang, he is also quite astonished. He hesitates whether to accept your invitation to visit Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[It is at this moment when Zhu Huowang hesitates that another genius steps forward, inviting Zhu Huowang to be a guest. This includes Lei Wanqian, Shi Yuyan, Erebos Demon Son, and others.]
[This leaves Zhu Huowang somewhat astonished, not expecting so many geniuses to invite him. Only you feel solemn, knowing that the old monsters behind these geniuses have most likely discovered something and seen the secret of Zhu Huowang.]
[If that’s the case, then trouble is big. After all, the Devouring Spirit Pearl is so precious that even Emperors would be moved by it; it is a refining body treasure. If these people take Zhu Huowang away, his fate can be imagined as miserable.]
[Although you feel Zhu Huowang is a Son of Fortune, the Son of Fortune is not Undying. You don’t think Zhu Huowang can be safe and sound in the face of so many big shots.]
[Of course, this does not rule out that these old monsters genuinely want to cultivate Zhu Huowang and are not targeting the Devouring Spirit Pearl in his body.]
[While you are lost in thoughts, Zhu Huowang hesitates and finally makes a choice. He cups his hands to everyone, expressing his wish to visit Taiyi Imperial Palace first and to visit the other geniuses in the future.]

chapters.title: Chapter 754: 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: Chapter 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_4
[Seeing Zhu Huowang say that, you think this kid is pretty smart, and you let out a slight sigh of relief, but you don’t let your guard down too much. After all, Zhu Huowang’s thoughts don’t matter much; what’s important is the attitude of those old monsters, especially the thoughts of the Great Emperors.]
[However, you can’t help but feel puzzled. You haven’t heard of Zhu Huowang challenging anyone in the last text simulation, which led to his exposure. Maybe it’s because your two epic battles inspired an atmosphere of genius wars, and Zhu Huowang can’t resist the urge to test his own strength.]
[The facts prove that your guess is correct. Zhu Huowang had no intention of taking action initially. But influenced by the atmosphere, he eventually chose to do so, to fight various outstanding geniuses, to verify how strong he is now, and to make friends.]
[At this moment, after Zhu Huowang speaks up, many people’s expressions change, especially Erebos Demon Son, whose gaze becomes colder and snorts, indicating that today is not as easy to go as you’d like. If you want to leave, you can, but you have to hand over the Devouring Spirit Pearl first.]
[Hearing this, Zhu Huowang’s face changes drastically, not expecting the Devouring Spirit Pearl inside him to be discovered. He once had a face-to-face conversation with a Quasi-Emperor, who didn’t find the Devouring Spirit Pearl.]
[The Devouring Spirit Pearl has a hidden effect, and he believes that no one can detect it. Now that it’s exposed to everyone’s eyes, he’s in real danger.]
[While Zhu Huowang is panicking and Erebos Demon Son sneers, various outstanding geniuses also cast their flickering gazes, staring closely at you and Zhu Huowang.]
[Soon, the voice of your master, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, appears in your mind. The Devouring Spirit Pearl is a great opportunity, and even a Great Emperor might be tempted. However, those above Supreme won’t take action. Whether you can get it depends on your skills. If there’s danger, give up immediately.]
[Hearing your master, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, you feel slightly relieved. If the appearance of the Devouring Spirit Pearl causes a terrifying battle between Supremes, Quasi-Emperors, and even Great Emperors, you’d doubt whether the Immortal Continent would fall apart.]
[Apparently, although the Devouring Spirit Pearl is precious, it hasn’t reached the point where Great Emperors would lower their dignity to snatch it themselves, nor would they engage in terrifying Emperor battles for it.]
[Perhaps only when the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Soul Pearl, and Devouring Mana Pearl appear together, would they drive the Great Emperors mad. After all, when it comes to the level of Great Emperors, there aren’t many things that can significantly increase their combat power. Immortal Artifacts that can greatly enhance a Great Emperor’s combat power are definitely coveted items.]
[While your thoughts are racing, many geniuses have subtly surrounded you and Zhu Huowang. Even those Great Saints and the powerful figures on the Great Saint Ranking are eyeing you with greedy intentions.]
[Seeing this, you secretly sigh in your heart, knowing that it’s impossible for you to protect Zhu Huowang from their grasp. Although under the same circumstances, dealing with Ku Xuan’s mysterious strength doesn’t frighten you, facing these much stronger geniuses or old monsters, you don’t stand a chance.]
[Not to mention, you’re not up against just one person, but a group of people.]
[At this moment, Erebos Demon Son speaks up again, telling you to get lost. If you want to continue hogging, he’ll kill you along with Zhu Huowang.]
[You look at Erebos Demon Son, snort coldly, saying that even a defeated subordinate dares to be arrogant. If he were to fight you again, he would fall with just one hand. ]
[These words infuriate Erebos Demon Son, his face turning red with anger, but he’s unable to refute. Eventually, he can only angrily order his Dao Protector to attack you and Zhu Huowang.]
[Seeing this, your Dao Protector also takes action, blocking Erebos Demon Son’s Dao Protector.]
…..
“This foolish disciple, what a careless nerve, thinking that all cultivators are like me, his master, not grabbing such a great opportunity right in front of them.”
Wang Ping sighs while looking at the content of the text simulation, somewhat doubting whether Zhu Huowang is the Son of Fortune or not.
If he is the Son of Fortune, why would he fall into such a desperate situation? Without him, Zhu Huowang might have died already.
It should be said that even with him around, it’s tough for Zhu Huowang to survive this time.
However, Ye Chen has also died many times in the lower realms….
Well, then it doesn’t matter.
Wang Ping shakes his head and continues to stare at the luminescent screen, sensing that Zhu Huowang is likely in grave danger this time.
With so many powerful figures present, the Golden Talent: Transmission won’t work, and even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can’t protect him.
[At the same time, you directly grab Zhu Huowang’s arm and perform Time-Space Movement, fleeing towards the distance.]
[Seeing that he has fallen into a dangerous situation and seems to have implicated you as well, Zhu Huowang knows he made a big mistake. With a bitter smile on his face, he apologizes and thanks you with great regret and guilt.]
[You don’t say much about it as you flee for your lives. After all, the existences on the Great Saint Ranking are not opponents you can handle, especially the Half-step Supremes, who could kill you with just one palm strike.]
[However, you’re not without advantages. Your Time-Space Tao is best for escaping, and even Half-step Supremes might not be able to catch you in a short time.]
[So, you just need to run away desperately, escape this region, and then you can have a chance to survive with Zhu Huowang. After all, the farther you flee, the more time it takes for the Quasi-Emperors to react, giving you hope to use the Golden Talent: Transmission to help Zhu Huowang turn danger into safety.]

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Chapter 216: Suppressing Lei Wanqian! Returning to the Forbidden Area_5
[Although, if you abandon Zhu Huowang directly, you would most likely be safe, and other cultivators would choose to snatch the Devouring Spirit Pearl rather than continue to chase you. However, under such circumstances where there is still a chance to survive, you don’t want to abandon one of your cherished disciples.]
[Soon, countless powerful cultivators begin to chase you crazily. No one wants to miss out on such a great opportunity. The Devouring Spirit Pearl, if they can obtain this Innate Emperor Artifact, then they would have a high probability of becoming a Quasi-Emperor in terms of combat prowess. For the vast majority of cultivators, this chance and this stroke of fortune are tremendous.]
[Had it not been for the three rules set by the Great Emperors, forbidding Supremes from making a move, even the Supremes would have joined in the scramble for this treasure!]
[You flee with Zhu Huowang, avoiding countless attacks from the cultivators chasing you. However, considering the gap in cultivation levels and the sheer number of them, it is quite impossible for you to avoid every single one of them, even with your mastery in Time-Space Tao being impressive.]
[As a result, you still find yourself in danger. Seeing your predicament, Zhu Huowang bites the bullet and activates the Devouring Spirit Pearl. Although his current body refining strength is not enough to unleash the full potential of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, all he can manage now is a part of the pearl’s power.]
[Besides, once the power of the Innate Emperor’s Artifact, the Devouring Spirit Pearl, is used, there will be a considerable price to pay. However, there’s no time to worry about these concerns now.]
[As Zhu Huowang unleashes the power of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, the forces of the powerful cultivators are blocked to some extent, and some are even converted into energy stored within the Devouring Spirit Pearl.]
[This amazes you. No wonder the Devouring Spirit Pearl is an Innate Emperor Artifact—with such capabilities, it is indeed terrifying. You are not the only one astounded; even the Great Emperors are moved, and other cultivators become even more fanatic, chasing after you with even more determination. No matter who gets this Innate Emperor Artifact, it would give them tremendous advantages.]
[At this very moment, you realize that you can’t drag things out any longer. Zhu Huowang can’t hold on for too long. Moreover, by unleashing the force of the Innate Emperor Artifact-Devouring Spirit Pearl, he has violated some unspoken rules.]
[Although his current cultivation is weak and the force of the Devouring Spirit Pearl he can use can’t contend with the force of a Supreme, violating the rule is still a violation. Thus, others can take advantage of this situation to use the power of Supreme Artifacts and Quasi-Emperor Artifacts against him.]
[Therefore, without any hesitation, you use the Golden Talent: Transmission ability, bringing Zhu Huowang along with you as you teleport away. Your actions leave many old monsters feeling quite amazed.]
[Among them, some old monsters want to intercept you, but with a cold snort from Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, they have no choice but to stop and not break the rules.]
[However, they don’t worry too much; as long as you haven’t returned to Taiyi Imperial Palace, they will have the ability to track you down. At that time, you won’t be able to monopolize the Devouring Spirit Pearl.]
…..
“Did we actually escape? Master is truly reliable.”
Wang Ping looks at the Text Simulation, feeling quite surprised and even smiles.
As expected, having a Great Emperor as your master gives you a sense of security.
Even in such a situation, he can still handle it.
Although he didn’t completely tackle the problem, and it was still up to Zhu Huowang to save himself, as long as the old monsters did not make a move, he could escape using the Golden Talent: Transmission ability, bringing them with him.
This could also be considered exploiting a loophole in the rules.
Who would have thought that he, a Half-step Great Saint, would possess such a powerful transmission ability, which only a Quasi-Emperor could intercept?
While Wang Ping is brainstorming, the simulation continues.
[After the teleportation, you find that you and Zhu Huowang have been sent to a familiar place. This causes you to fall into silence and feel extremely frustrated.]
[This place is exactly where the eerie Blood-Yellow River is located. Although you don’t see the blood-yellow river right now, the graveyard environment before your eyes is different from what you saw in the previous simulation. You feel the strange atmosphere, and you know exactly where you are.]
[For a moment, you feel at a loss, unsure of what to do. If you wander around, you might encounter the eerie Blood-Yellow River again. At that time, it would be an undoubtedly hopeless situation.]
[And if you choose not to wander, staying here won’t guarantee your safety either. Moreover, even if the Golden Talent: Transmission ability cools down here, it still remains unusable—it won’t help you escape this place.]
[As you feel extremely frustrated, Zhu Huowang looks at you with amazement, not knowing how you managed to escape the pursuit with him.]
[At this, he feels very excited and, with a pale face, retracts the Devouring Spirit Pearl. He bows his hands to you in gratitude, saying that he owes you his life and will repay you a hundredfold in the future.]
[Hearing these words, you sigh and tell him that there’s no need for a future repayment, as both of you are likely to die soon.]
[At these words, Zhu Huowang looks at you with a baffled expression, unable to comprehend why you would say such a thing. Since you both managed to escape the pursuit of so many powerful cultivators and he has an Innate Emperor Artifact with him, your chances of survival should be high. Unless you encounter an attack from a Supreme, of course.]
[Moreover, Zhu Huowang firmly believes that you, the first child of the Taiyi Emperor Palace and the direct disciple of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, must possess a life-saving method given by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Even if you were to encounter an attack from a Supreme, there is still a high probability that you would survive and not be annihilated. There might even be a possibility of counter-killing a Supreme.]
[You look at the bewildered Zhu Huowang and reveal the cruel truth to him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 756: 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Spatial Temporal Divine Medicine
chapters.content:
Chapter 756: Chapter 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Spatial Temporal Divine Medicine
[After listening to your description, Zhu Huowang’s facial expression stiffened, revealing an incredulous look. What a joke, if even Supremes and Quasi-Emperors could possibly fall there, how could these two little shrimp possibly survive.]
[For a moment, Zhu Huowang felt extremely depressed, feeling that your transmission skill is ultimately too much of a pitfall. It would be better to let some great emperor catch him and bring him back.]
[However, Zhu Huowang quickly calmed down, saying that they might not necessarily be teleported to the place you mentioned; it could just be a similar place. Moreover, although some rumors are a bit frightening, they are not necessarily true.]
[Seeing Zhu Huowang still holding on to the lucky thought, you sighed and didn’t say much, just thinking about what to do next. Staying in place is definitely impossible. If you can find a place similar to when you first picked the Divine Medicine, maybe there will be a glimmer of hope.]
[Here, it’s not the absolute Land of Death. There are safe places, but you don’t know where these safe zones are. At the same time, you cannot judge whether it is absolutely safe or not.]
[While you were thinking, Zhu Huowang looked at you with hopeful eyes again, saying that you could still use that transmission skill to help them escape from here.]
[You glanced at Zhu Huowang and said that your Divine Delivery Skill can only be used once a year, and it is impossible to use it here. Upon hearing this, Zhu Huowang’s expression stiffened again, and he looked at you with some resentment.]
…
“I actually came to this ghostly place again, it’s really life-threatening. It seems that this life simulation is coming to an end. I just don’t know if I can figure out the secrets of this place next.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, his eyes flickering, thinking secretly.
Although Wang Ping in the simulation carries the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation, it will only be activated once he encounters a life-and-death situation, thus saving his life.
But… whether the Emperor’s Incarnation can save him in such a strange place is really a question.
Although the Great Emperor is powerful, he is not an invincible existence.
In the Upper Realm’s Ten Great Universes, there are still some strange forbidden lands that even the Great Emperor must stop at.
There are a total of ten of these forbidden lands that have been discovered so far, known as the Ten Forbidden Lands, the Ten Absolute Lands.
If they forcefully enter, even the Great Emperor will face the risk of falling.
Wang Ping could clearly see this from the books of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
It is not known how these strange forbidden lands were formed, or whether they are related to the All Heavens, but they exist there. If you don’t provoke these forbidden lands, they seem not to harm the Upper Realm.
But if a cultivator enters them, these forbidden lands will bare their fangs, letting the cultivator know what the dead lands and the great horrors are like.
Of course, these forbidden lands are not merely absolute lands and lands of doom. There are some examples.
For instance, some cultivators who entered the forbidden lands not only survived, but also gained great benefits. They went from being ordinary cultivators or common geniuses to Quasi-Emperors, and even surpassed many monsters in their era and became Emperors of Tao Proving.
Therefore, there is a strange custom in the Upper Realm.
That is, some old monsters who are about to die will choose a forbidden land that even the Great Emperor must fear, enter it, try to gain opportunities within it, and then defy the heavens, prolong their lifespan, and even become Emperors of the Tao Proving.
Besides that, there are the ruthless people with great ambitions but insufficient talents. They know that by relying solely on themselves, they are doomed to be stuck at a certain level for a lifetime and can only linger in the middle and lower reaches of the Upper Realm’s World of cultivators. So they choose to take a desperate shot.
Unfortunately, in the end, only a handful of people from the Ten Forbidden Lands who lived and gained great opportunities are recorded in the Upper Realm. There are less than a hundred of them recorded in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
In the Upper Realm, among the tens of millions of years of history, at least trillions of cultivators have entered these places. But less than a hundred have survived, a ratio that is chilling.
“As for the place in front of me, there is no record of it in the books of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Perhaps it is an undiscovered forbidden land with a danger level comparable to the Ten Forbidden Lands. Or perhaps the Great Emperors knew about this place but did not record it, and it remained unknown to the external cultivators.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were flickering, thinking secretly.
If it was the latter, it would be even more frightening.
As Wang Ping pondered, the Text Simulation continued.
[You coughed lightly at Zhu Huowang’s resentment, saying not to worry too much. You were just scaring him earlier. Although this place is dangerous, it doesn’t mean certain death.]
[Upon hearing your words, Zhu Huowang finally breathed a sigh of relief, bitterly smiling and saying that Mr. Wang shouldn’t be joking at a time like this.]
[You smiled and said that even though this place isn’t certain death, the probability of death is still 99%, so he shouldn’t be careless. Be prepared to use the Innate emperor’s instrument· devouring pearl to fight powerful enemies at any moment.]
[Hearing your words, Zhu Huowang became resentful again, feeling that you were really too bad. Damn it, it’s better not to say that. What’s the difference between a 99% death rate and certain death?]
[Next, you didn’t continue teasing Zhu Huowang, and directly took out two dice, throwing them into the sky. Zhu Huowang looked confused, not knowing what you were doing.]

chapters.title: Chapter 757: 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Spatial Temporal Divine Medicine_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 757: Chapter 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Spatial Temporal Divine Medicine_2
[As the dice fall, you let out a faint laugh, indicating that you are deciding which side is safer to go.]
[Hearing this, Zhu Huowang’s eyes gleam with excitement, and he joyfully asks if you can calculate the Heavenly Secrets. If so, their chances of survival will be even greater.]
[You smile, and after the dice fall, you say that you don’t know how to calculate Heavenly Secrets; you’re just trying your luck. One, two, three, go east; four, five, six, go west; seven, eight, nine, go north; ten, eleven, twelve, go south.]
[Listening to your explanation, Zhu Huowang’s face stiffens, his eyes darken, and he almost loses his breath.]
[Damn, in such a dangerous place, you’re using this method to decide which way to go; it’s too much of a gamble. For a moment, Zhu Huowang’s heart shatters all the filters he had for you.]
[Previously, after witnessing the battle, his impression of you was that of a young man from the Upper Realm, full of First Heaven’s Proud Genius. Even Ku Xuan of the Longevity Ku Family, who was rumored to be unparalleled and ranked first on the Saint King Ranking, might not be able to compare with you. At the same time, you are also a righteous man, someone whom he admires greatly.]
[But now, he only feels that you are a super reckless and scheming man, and following you on adventures may not be enough even if you have ten lives.]
….
Wang Ping looks at the Text Simulation and is quite dissatisfied. He mutters, “What do you mean, I’m a super reckless and scheming man, and even with ten lives, following me won’t be enough? Am I really that bad?”
“When people go on adventures with me, they always end up with a big harvest and become winners in life… Fine, next time I simulate taking Zhu Huowang as a disciple, I will make sure to temper him more under the name of my master.”
Wang Ping snorts softly, shamelessly saying that, without any intention of self-reflection.
[You don’t know that Zhu Huowang is grumbling about you in his heart. After the dice fall, you decide on your direction and go straight to the west side.]
[As for the decision to go west, Zhu Huowang is extremely flustered, feeling that you should change direction. After all, going west is associated with death and seems inauspicious.]
[In response, you pat Zhu Huowang on the shoulder and tell him not to be so superstitious, and to trust in his luck. This leaves him speechless once again.]
[You smile and don’t say anything more. In fact, you have a faint suspicion in your mind that no matter which direction you go in, they might somehow end up heading towards the Blood-Yellow River.]
[If that’s the case, this time it might be certain death. However, getting some information is still good. Last time, you were confused by the Blood-Yellow River and walked straight in. This time, you can try to experiment a little.]
[Afterward, you warn Zhu Huowang that some monsters here are very dangerous, so he should close his senses, shut his eyes, and just follow you. He’s hesitant about this but eventually chooses to trust you.]
[Of course, he doesn’t fully trust you and remains vigilant, ready to escape and use his Innate Emperor’s Artifact·Devouring Spirit Pearl at any moment.]
[Next, you start moving aimlessly, leaving markers as you go. According to your calculations, you will return to where you started.]
[However, what happens next makes you sigh. Rather than returning to your original location, you arrive at an unfamiliar place. It seems to confirm your suspicion that the directions here are indeed chaotic and equally dangerous, making it even more hazardous than the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[But there’s nothing you can do but keep moving forward. Half an hour later, you see the Blood-Yellow River from afar, making you shiver and quickly look away.]
[For you, this is the worst-case scenario, as your guess has all become true. In this strange place, no matter where you go, you’ll eventually end up at the Blood-Yellow River. Perhaps this is why there are so many dry bones in the river, and even supreme beings and Quasi-Emperors have perished here.]
[A chill runs through Zhu Huowang as he opens his eyes. Soon, he sees the Blood-Yellow River ahead, and his eyes are wide with shock. The cold sensation in his body intensifies. He trembles as he asks you if that is the mysterious river you mentioned, where even a Quasi-Emperor can perish.]
[You nod your head. Then, you remember something and quickly tell Zhu Huowang not to stare at the Blood-Yellow River for too long.]
[However, your reminder is already too late. The easily-entranced Zhu Huowang has been mesmerized by the Blood-Yellow River, and he walks towards it with lifeless eyes.]
[Seeing this, your face changes dramatically, and you use your Time-Space Divine Skill to try to stop Zhu Huowang. However, your Time-Space Divine Skill is ineffective and cannot stop him.]
[This situation makes you even more terrified. You can only forcefully grab Zhu Huowang, hoping he won’t step into the Blood-Yellow River. But it’s all in vain; no matter what method you use, you cannot stop his advance, as if an invisible force is controlling everything.]
[In the end, Zhu Huowang steps into the Blood-Yellow River. As soon as he does, the flesh and bones of his lower body disappear instantly. Despite this, Zhu Huowang doesn’t feel any pain.]

chapters.title: Chapter 758: 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Temporal and Spatial Holy Medicine_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Chapter 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Temporal and Spatial Holy Medicine_3
[As for the Innate Emperor Artifact·Devouring Spirit Pearl within Zhu Huowang, it was clearly alarmed. It burst forth with a terrifying power, trying to shield Zhu Huowang and carry him back to shore.]
[However, all of these efforts were in vain. Even the Devouring Spirit Pearl, which has the power to consume everything and transform them into spirit energy, could not consume the waters of the Blood River. The power it erupted with was actually being corroded in return.]
[Seeing this, the Devouring Spirit Pearl could only abandon Zhu Huowang, the host it had acknowledged, and escape from his body, rushing towards the distance.]
[However, a terrifying scene took place. Even an Emperor’s artifact, it seems, was within the hunting range of this blood-yellow river. Numerous black mists appeared, like a hundred demons marching in the night, rushing towards the fleeing Devouring Spirit Pearl, forcibly seizing it and pulling it back into the blood-yellow river.]
[With the Devouring Spirit Pearl being seized and falling into the blood-yellow river, Zhu Huowang had already become one of the dry bones in the river. As for that Innate Emperor Artifact, the Devouring Spirit Pearl, although it wasn’t completely corroded, it continued to struggle intensely, but it was all obviously in vain. It would eventually become nothing.]
[It seems, anything that has given birth to sentience and possesses life, within this blood-yellow river, only death awaits them.]
[Seeing this scene, you can’t help but shiver all over, instinctively wanting to get as far away from here as possible.]
…
Wang Ping’s expression was changing unpredictably as he looked at the content of the Text Simulation.
“This is crazy. This blood-yellow river, it’s too bizarre, even an Innate Emperor Artifact can’t escape and will have its life force extinguished.”
“I just don’t know if the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can manage to lead the simulated Wang Ping to safety, the chances seem slim. But, with the incarnation of the Great Emperor Heavenly Feather present, he should be able to unravel some of the secrets of the blood-yellow river.”
Thinking this, Wang Ping continued to fix his gaze on the luminescent screen.
[It was at this moment that you felt a call, your eyes became lifeless as you began to walk towards the blood-yellow river, stepping into it.]
[The moment you stepped in, the power of death transmitted to you, the Quasi-Emperor Artifact was activated, trying to shield you, but it was quickly corroded. Then, the incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was similarly activated.]
[A terrifying Emperor’s might erupted, stirring up a terrifying wave in the calm blood-yellow river. The incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor succeeded in saving your life.]
[However, the expression of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation was extremely grave, completely not expecting that you would actually run to such a ghostly place.]
[Next, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation infused a surge of power into your body, breaking you out of that strange state.]
[Upon waking up, you became extremely frightened. Even though you had already anticipated not being able to escape, still, being caught without making a sound was too difficult to guard against.]
[Afterwards, you, looking at the grave expression of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation, asked if he, as your master, could lead you out of here.]
[Hearing this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation was silent, shaking his head, indicating that even he, once he fell into this river, could not escape. Perhaps, if his true body was here, there would be a slight chance of carving out a path of survival.]
[Hearing the words of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation, you couldn’t help but gasp. What the hell is this place, where even a Great Emperor would only have a slim chance of survival? You should know that this is the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, your master, who is a very powerful Emperor among Emperors.]
[Comparatively speaking, if an ordinary Great Emperor were to come here, I’m afraid they wouldn’t have even a slim hope of survival, they would completely perish.]
[At this time, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation knocked on your head and expressed helplessly how you ended up in a place like this. Can’t you control the direction at all with your transmission secret skill?]
[With this, you feel extremely awkward and don’t know how to respond. The Golden Talent: Transmission talent is very peculiar. It seems to disregard everything and can forcibly move to places where spatial movement is impossible. However, once you teleport over, it’s unable to teleport back.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation sighed, indicating he couldn’t hold on for much longer. He could only do his best to help you resist the power of the blood-yellow river. Whether you could find a way to survive depended entirely on you.]
[With this, you can’t help but smile bitterly. You knew that the chances of survival were slim, so you didn’t have any immediate plans to escape. Instead, you took this opportunity to ask about what the blood-yellow river actually was, and what is this place.]
[After the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was silent for a while, he spoke a sentence that made your heart shudder.]
[Those words were, ‘Life and Death Realm, River of Forgetfulness, Bridge of Helplessness. The end of all life, and also the beginning of all life.’]
[Your heart quaked with an inner turmoil. You didn’t think that this world would actually have a River of Forgetfulness and a Bridge of Helplessness. Could it be that, in this world, there would be an underworld and a heavenly court as well?]
[While you were shocked, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor explained. The Life and Death Realm is the boundary between life and death. Once one stepped into the Land of Death, they would be entwined with death and then die soon after. However, powerful cultivators could resist the power of death and save their lives with their strong cultivation.]
[However, the Land of Death is just a beginning. Regardless of the level of cultivation, once one steps into the Land of Death, it is extremely difficult to leave here. There is a high probability that, due to the distorted space, one would arrive at the riverside of the River of Forgetfulness.]

chapters.title: Chapter 759: 217: Obtaining the Broken Map Again! Time-Space Sacred Medicine_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 759: Chapter 217: Obtaining the Broken Map Again! Time-Space Sacred Medicine_4
[Once you come here, even Supremes and Quasi-Emperors will lose their consciousness, step into the river, turn into dry bones and resentful spirits, and float in the river. The only way to find a way out here is to find the Bridge of Helplessness.]
[Only by finding the legendary Bridge of Helplessness can one avoid falling into the River of Forgetfulness. However, once you set foot on the Bridge of Helplessness, you will gradually lose your memory and undergo reincarnation.]
[As you listen to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s narration, you are secretly frightened and ask if this place was naturally formed or created by someone. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation remains silent, indicating that no one knows how this place came into being, but he doesn’t believe it was created by Upper Realm cultivators.]
[Such a bizarre place, not to mention the Great Emperor, even the legendary immortals would be unable to create it, right? Perhaps only those beings that are superior to immortals from All Heavens can create such a weird place.]
[You frown, with many thoughts in your head, unable to calm down.]
[As you think, the River of Forgetfulness surges again, with terrifying waves of bloody yellow water coming towards you, and countless evil spirits rushing towards you.]
[At this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s expression changes, unleashing a terrifying power to block it, and aims to use his power to send you away from here.]
[At this moment, you suddenly see something in the waves of the River of Forgetfulness. It is a Broken Map. The Broken Map rolled up by the waves has some resonance with your Broken Map.]
[This makes you very astonished and then very overjoyed. You never expected to see another Broken Map here. This is undoubtedly the second Broken Map marking the location of the Dark Time Great Emperor’s Emperor Scripture heritage.]
[As long as you get this Broken Map, you can find the third Broken Map’s location and know where the Dark Time Great Emperor’s Emperor Scripture heritage is! By then, your combat power will rise by a large margin. Even if longevity Gu Family’s Ku Xuan cultivates the Immortal Sutra as you guessed and has extraordinary combat power, you will not be afraid of him.]
…..
Wang Ping is also very excited after looking at the content of the Text Simulation, but as an observer, he has no sense of crisis, only more annoyance.
“Damn! It turns out there’s a Broken Map in the River of Forgetfulness, which is probably brought in by some unlucky cultivator who ventured into the Land of Death. If not, how could this Broken Map appear in such a place?”
“That is to say, if it weren’t for me coming back to this place through the Golden Talent: Transmission and luckily arriving at the shore of the River of Forgetfulness where the Broken Map is, I might have never found this second Broken Map in my entire life. It would also be impossible to obtain the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.”
“No, in this situation, even without the Life Simulator, I still wouldn’t run here to die even if I knew where the second Broken Map was. In other words, there’s no chance to cultivate the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.”
Wang Ping complains crazily in his heart, filled with emotion.
However, he does have the Life Simulator. As long as the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation can bring the Broken Map from the River of Forgetfulness, and he can memorize its content, he can just draw it out as a reward. That would be comfortable.
If he can obtain the second Broken Map, he believes he can quickly obtain the third Broken Map.`
With one Broken Map, maybe the Divine Calculator can’t figure out the location, but with two, as long as he’s not incompetent, he should be able to calculate it.
A Divine Calculator who is an important figure in the Immortal Mansion can’t possibly be incompetent.
“Although I’m doomed this time, next time in the simulation, the Dark Time Emperor Scripture will be mine!”
Wang Ping’s eyes are filled with determination, and he is very excited about it.
As he thinks about it, the simulation continues, and there’s no suspense anymore.
[Next, you anxiously tell Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation that there’s a Broken Map in the waters of the Bridge of Helplessness, recorded with the location of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, hoping that he can retrieve it.]
[Hearing your words, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation takes notice of the Broken Map with the Dark Time Emperor Scripture’s heritage and looks quite surprised. At the same time, he also feels a bit helpless. At this critical juncture, you’re still worrying about the Broken Map instead of seizing the last chance to escape. You’re really bold, sacrificing your life for an opportunity.]
[Still, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation doesn’t say much and chooses to grab the Broken Map containing the Dark Time Emperor Scripture’s location and hand it to you.]
[Then, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation swings again, directly throwing you out of the River of Forgetfulness, shooting towards the distance.]
[You’re wrapped in a layer of light, and due to the terrifying speed, even your dynamic vision can’t see the outer world’s view. However, you don’t care, instead taking out the Broken Map and frantically looking at its content, trying to memorize it.]
[After all, you aren’t sure whether this reward will be available after the Simulation Ends. If it can’t be refreshed, trying to come here next time and take the Broken Map would undoubtedly be very difficult.]
[Soon, you memorize all the content on the Broken Map and put it away. At this moment, the light membrane disappears, and you appear in a cemetery area.]
[Here, there is not much difference from when you visited before, but it is a different place. You don’t know how long the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation can hold on, so you choose to flee to the distance, preventing the evil spirits in the River of Forgetfulness from jumping on you and dragging you back into the River of Forgetfulness.]

chapters.title: Chapter 760: 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Temporal and Spatial Holy Medicine_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 760: Chapter 217: Obtaining the Fragmented Map Again! Temporal and Spatial Holy Medicine_5
[Just as you were about to take a few steps, the tombstones around you shattered collectively, and a large number of skeletons emerged from the ground. Their eyes flashed with ghostly fires as they stared at you intently.]
[Then, they all launched their attacks on you.]
[This made your face extremely solemn, and you had no intention of fighting these skeletons head-on. Instead, you used your Time-Space Divine Skill to dodge their attacks and quickly escape the area.]
[Although these skeleton monsters were very powerful, and even a powerful Great Saint would perish if they fell into the grasp of these creatures, you possessed the Time-Space Body and had cultivated the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, making you second to none in escaping danger within your realm.]
[As a result, you successfully escaped from this area. Of course, it was mainly because the dangers within this Land of Death were far less severe than those of the River of Forgetfulness. If it had been the dry bones and resentful spirits from the River of Forgetfulness attacking you, even a Quasi-Emperor would have fallen. After all, the Devouring Spirit Pearl had been previously dragged back there.]
[You fled desperately, hoping to find the Realm of Life and a glimmer of vitality.]
[In the blink of an eye, a quarter of an hour passed. You noticed that the movements in the River of Forgetfulness were growing fainter, and the escaped Emperor’s Might was also rapidly weakening. This made you realize that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation might not have been able to escape from the River of Forgetfulness and would likely vanish completely.]
[This made you even more terrified, so you directly burned your origin and sped up your flight. Although you didn’t know where you were headed or if you would end up back at the River of Forgetfulness, it was the only thing you could do.]
[At that moment, perhaps as a rare effect of your Purple Talent: Rolling Wealth, you saw a bright light up ahead, along with a vibrant world filled with life.]
[This brought you great joy, as you were fortunate enough to see the Realm of Life. You increased your speed and rushed toward it.]
[As you charged forward, countless strands of dark energy surged toward you. This made your scalp tingle as you continued to pick up speed.]
[Finally, in a life-and-death situation, you seized the opportunity and broke into the vivid world of life. As soon as you entered, the dark energy and river water hesitated for a moment before retreating.]
[Seeing this, you could finally breathe a sigh of relief and felt extremely lucky that your fortune had been so good.]
[Next, you discovered something even more astonishing. You noticed that your injuries and burnt origin were all recovering automatically, with a terrifying amount of vitality being infused into your body.]
[The Realm of Life, a world filled with vitality, and it seemed that you were beginning to understand the characteristics of this world. It was the opposite of the Land of Death, a world filled with frightening life force.]
[The life force in this place was much more vigorous than the world you had broken through in your previous simulations. Perhaps, just like the Land of Death, the intensity of death qi in different areas of the Realm of Death varied, and the strength of the life force in the Realm of Life also varied between different regions.]
[Various thoughts flashed through your mind as you looked around, only to see a scene that left you shocked – in this area, there were countless Divine Medicines!]
[Even more surprisingly, you saw existences that transcended the level of Divine Medicines – incredibly rare World-Shocking Treasure Medicines that could greatly benefit even Supreme Realm cultivators!]
[This filled your heart with ecstasy. The Realm of Death was filled with death and despair, whereas the Realm of Life was filled with life and hope. Perhaps the Realm of Life was a place of peerless treasures and countless world-shocking opportunities.]
[If you stayed in this place, you might be able to cultivate in seclusion all the way to the Supreme Realm or even the Quasi-Emperor Realm. Once you reached that level, you could venture out again to see if you could escape this Life and Death Realm.]
…
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content, overjoyed.
“Damn, is it really that amazing? There are even treasure medicines useful for Supremes! In that case, there might be treasure medicines useful for Quasi-Emperors here as well.”
“No, wait. If the Land of Life were so great, why wouldn’t the Great Emperors come here?”
However, Wang Ping quickly calmed down, and an ominous feeling arose in his heart.
As it turned out, his premonition was correct.
[While you were rejoicing inwardly, you failed to notice that vines had started wrapping around your body, and roots had grown from your feet, planting themselves into the ground.]
[When you tried to take a step, you discovered this and your face turned pale. You realized that you were unable to move, and your origin had merged with the ground.]
[You swiftly transformed into a divine medicine, shocking and horrifying you. You began to understand why this place had so many divine medicines.]
[Every one of these divine medicines seemed to have been transformed from a powerful living being, assimilated into a medicine! And now, you’ve fallen into the same fate.]
[In the end, you struggled furiously but found it futile. With a sigh, you gave up resistance and completely turned into a divine medicine swaying under the law of time and space.]
[Due to your strange condition, this simulation has ended….]

chapters.title: Chapter 761: 218: Synthesize a Miracle! The End of the Immortal Cultivation World
chapters.content:
Chapter 761: Chapter 218: Synthesize a Miracle! The End of the Immortal Cultivation World
As the text simulation came to an end, Wang Ping’s mind was filled with numerous images and cultivation insights, ultimately finding himself in the Realm of Life. Upon seeing the self-transformed Saintly Medicine and the many swaying Saintly Medicines, he looked serious.
In the end, Wang Ping sighed softly and murmured, “Well, my intuition was pretty accurate, something really went wrong. This damn place, whether it’s the Realm of Life or the Realm of Death, is too dangerous. It’s a real dire place.”
“However, this time I was able to obtain the second broken map and learned some secrets about this place, which is not bad. It can help me prepare for future chances when I return here.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, pondering to himself.
In Wang Ping’s opinion, although this place was extremely dangerous, it definitely concealed great secrets.
Throughout history, fortune and misfortune have coexisted. If he could figure out the secrets of this place and seize the greatest opportunity within, then he would truly be in an awesome position.
Wang Ping had an intuition that the opportunities here were enough to drive Great Emperors mad.
Of course, Wang Ping was still very weak now, and he had no plans to waste his simulation attempts to challenge this place. He would rather become stronger first.
Only when he becomes a Great Emperor would he challenge this ‘dungeon’.
Unless, like the last few times, he was involuntarily teleported here, in which case, he would risk his life to give it a shot and see if he could obtain more information.
…
As Wang Ping was lost in his thoughts, his consciousness flickered, his field of vision changed, and he left the immersive simulation and returned to the real world.
At the same time, the system’s voice also rang out.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Emperor’s Sutra Fragment.
②. Red Talent: Earth profound physique.
③. Life-bound Sacred Artifact: Illusory Void Sword.
④. Randomly obtain one Great Sacred Artifact.
⑤. Holy Spirit Stone.”
…
“This reward list is quite meager. But it’s better than nothing. The most important thing is that the broken map was refreshed.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and shook his head slightly.
Although he had already taken note of the information on the broken map, it was still better to have the map than not to have it.
After all, in many fantasy novels he had read, the main character would obtain the broken map left by a powerful being, and when a secret realm appeared, the map would have a secret technique left behind by the powerful being, playing a significant role and helping the main character obtain great opportunities.
“System, I choose ①. Emperor’s Sutra Fragment and ③. Life-bound Sacred Artifact: Illusory Void Sword.”
After considering his options, Wang Ping made his choices.
The other rewards were not of much use. Although the Holy Spirit Stones were valuable, his Life-bound Sacred Artifact had already been used, and choosing the Life-bound Artifact directly was undoubtedly more profitable.
Of course, the most important thing was that if he could obtain another Life-bound Sacred Artifact, he might be able to use Zhang Haoran’s synthesis system to synthesize the artifacts into a Supreme Artifact.
If this were to happen, he would have his own Life-bound Supreme Device.
By then, his combat power would have a significant increase.
After all, using someone else’s Supreme Device in battle and using one’s own Life-bound Supreme Device were completely different.
Others’ would always belong to others and could never fully display their power.
But by using your own Life-bound Supreme Device, you can perfectly display its power and even go beyond its limits.”
As Wang Ping made his choices, a new Emperor’s Sutra Fragment and a Life-bound Sacred Artifact appeared in his storage space.
Then, without any hesitation, Wang Ping opened the chat group, first sending the Life-bound Sacred Artifact to Xu Yi, trying to let Xu Yi double its power.
Unexpectedly, the triple multiplier effect was successfully triggered this time.
Wang Ping’s Life-bound Sacred Artifact instantly increased to three pieces, plus the one he had, it directly reached four pieces.
This felt absolutely fantastic.
After that, Wang Ping retrieved his Life-bound Sacred Artifact and contacted Zhang Haoran.
Wang Ping (66): “Haoran, I have a task for you, help me synthesize my Life-bound Sacred Artifact.”
Zhang Haoran (92): “Mr. Wang, your stuff is too high level. I might not succeed. If the synthesis fails, it will be scrapped. Hesitant.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s fine, don’t worry if it fails, it’s just a try.”
Wang Ping didn’t hesitate or waver, maintaining a firm attitude.
If all four Sacred Artifacts were scrapped, he would be in pain, but he wouldn’t say much about it.
After all, in the simulation, he could still use the resources of Taiyi Imperial Palace to cultivate new Life-bound Sacred Artifacts.
If he could possess his own Supreme Device, then that would be fantastic.
So, it was worth taking a gamble.
Zhang Haoran (92): “Since you say so, Mr. Wang, I’ll give it a try! Struggling.jpg.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, I’ll send you the stuff now, no need to be nervous.”
After saying this, Wang Ping directly sent the four Sacred Artifacts to Zhang Haoran.
On Zhang Haoran’s side, after taking a deep breath, he began to use the synthesis system to operate.
In the first synthesis attempt, Zhang Haoran’s face turned green because it failed.
Zhang Haoran looked at the remaining two Sacred Artifacts, quite hesitant, but still decided to try synthesizing them.
In the end, to his surprise, the synthesis succeeded, and these two Sacred Artifacts turned into a Supreme Artifact.
Zhang Haoran (92): “Mr. Wang, I failed once and succeeded once, I managed to synthesize your Life-bound Sacred Artifact into a Supreme Artifact! Excited.jpg.”

chapters.title: Chapter 762: 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 762: Chapter 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_2
Wang Ping (66): “Haha, not bad, not bad! I’ll send you a big red packet later, as a reward for this time.”
Wang Ping looked at Zhang Haoran’s words, full of smiles, very pleased.
He was just trying it out, he didn’t expect Zhang Haoran to really synthesise a Supreme Artifact for him, his combat power really doubled this time.
Zhang Haoran (92): “Mr.Wang, No, no, no. You’ve helped me so many times before, you even saved my life. Giving me a reward isn’t appropriate, it’d make us seem too distant.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, forget about it then.”
Wang Ping smiled and didn’t say much.
The group indeed owed him a lot, and Wang Ping wasn’t being modest, insisting on giving red packets and all that.
As the saying goes, small favors breed great men, big favors breed enemies.
He had to give the other group members some chance to return the favor.
Otherwise, if one keeps receiving favors without the opportunity to repay, it’s also likely to cause problems.
There’s no helping it, it’s human nature.
Next, Zhang Haoran returned the Supreme Artifact.
Wang Ping was very satisfied with this, took the red packet, and relinked with the artifact again, the process very relaxed.
