“Next, continue with the simulation, I need to find a way to break through to the Great Saint Realm.”
After feeling the power of his Supreme Artifact, Wang Ping put it away, his eyes gleaming as he thought.
In this life simulation, he had learned about the backgrounds of many Saint King List Geniuses and possible candidates.
While most geniuses are born into major powers and can’t be picked by him, there are still one or two that can be.
To that end, Wang Ping just needs to stake out as soon as this genius is born.
As long as he takes this genius as his disciple, Wang Ping has a high probability of breaking through to the Great Saint Tier.
Once he breaks through to the Great Saint Tier, Wang Ping plans to suppress Ku Xuan with his cultivation once, forcing Ku Xuan to reveal everything to see how powerful this guy actually is.
With many thoughts flashing in his mind, Wang Ping then said in his heart: “System, I want to go for Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consume 150,000 top-tier divine sources, Life Simulator Activation, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulate the host on successfully refreshing the Red Talent: Water profound physique.”
Red Talent: Water profound physique: ….
“Another unlucky one with only Red Talent, I can understand, but, why another profound physique. These profound physiques are appearing too often.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents this time, quite speechless.
“If I choose all these profound physiques, maybe they won’t appear anymore, right? They can increase the chance of refreshing higher-grade talents? Besides, what if I collect all the basic element profound physiques, would there be a qualitative change?”
Wang Ping slightly frowned, thinking privately.
But, Wang Ping felt that it’s unlikely. With so many talents, if not this red one, it would refresh another type of red.
As for whether all the basic attribute profound bodies will undergo a qualitative change, Wang Ping also found it somewhat dubious.
After all, Red Talent is Red Talent, it just has a greater advantage in the Emperor Realm, The collection of profound bodies can only increase by one and a half at most, it can’t reach the level of the Sacred Body, I should say it’s far inferior.
Compared to selecting bodies, Wang Ping was more looking forward to collecting all basic attribute Sacred Bodies, that’s a qualitative change.
Unfortunately, whether it’s the Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body or the Sacred Body, the guarantee is gold, and not just any gold, it’s likely already touching the ceiling of gold, even exceeding some, it’s really hard to refresh, can’t be forced.
While many thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Loading Successful, Life Simulation Starting…..”
The system’s voice came again.
Just as the Life Simulator System was about to pull Wang Ping’s consciousness into the immersive simulation state, the sound of the chat group system also rang in sync.
“Ding, Anomaly Detected in the original world that Qin Tian (77) traversed, the Cultivation Realm will be fully invaded….Task Release: Save the Cultivation Realm.”
“Ding, This task is extremely difficult, Acting Group Owner Wang Ping (66) can select any group members to participate in the task to save the Cultivation Realm.”
“What the hell? Qin Tian’s world is about to end?”
Wang Ping suppressed the immersive simulation state on his own, his expression fluctuating.
It’s commonly known that there is a problem with the Cultivation Realm where Qin Tian travelled.
However, Wang Ping had simulated it before, several hundred years later, it had not completely perished. The Heavenly Tao of the World of Cultivators and all the Immortal Emperors were resisting the strange invasion.
Now, only five or six years have passed, how come it’s about to end.
“It looks like, there is an anomaly, and this anomaly is coming from All Heavens.”
Wang Ping’s expression was very serious.
“This task is dangerous, should I go?”
Wang Ping hesitated a little.
The chat group system has already stated it was very dangerous and did not intend to enforce participation in the task.
He could choose not to go.
“Alpha, can I not go?”
Wang Ping asked in his heart.
Perhaps, by saving the Cultivation Realm, he could earn billions or even tens of billions of group points at once, getting closer to the goal of trillions of group points.
But he is rapidly becoming stronger now… Once he becomes Emperor of Tao Proving, collecting group points will undoubtedly be easier. He doesn’t need to risk his life to participate in the group task.

chapters.title: Chapter 763: 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: Chapter 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_3
That way, the disadvantages would outweigh the advantages.
“You can choose to go or not to go. Dealing with the strange has no transfer restrictions. Even if you can’t handle it, the chat group will help you forcefully withdraw.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“I see. However, dealing with the strange still involves risks, even if you can forcibly escape. It’s just that my life simulator can help me bypass a lot of danger in advance. So, should I go or not?”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he contemplated.
“It seems there is no need. The destruction of one world and the demise of countless living beings may be cruel, but their lives are not worth more than mine. I always value my life more than anything.”
Wang Ping’s expression gradually calmed down, and he made up his mind.
“Although I also think your life is more important and the destruction of a cultivation world is nothing, I would actually recommend you to go.”
At this moment, Alpha’s voice sounded again.
“Why?”
Wang Ping furrowed his brow, asking.
“I once told you that Rule Stones can only be found in places like Myriad Heavens Paradise, right?”
Alpha said coldly.
“You did mention that…” Wang Ping squinted and slowly said, “You mean there’s another way to get Rule Stones?”
“No, there isn’t. At least the worlds you have access to now cannot produce Rule Stones of such a level.”
Alpha denied Wang Ping’s speculation but didn’t entirely refute it.
“The worlds I can currently access… Then the Cultivation Realm must be out of the question, so why do you want me to go?”
Wang Ping asked with confusion.
“Although you currently can’t access that level of world and it is difficult to obtain Rule Stones in the outer world, this time it’s an opportunity.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“Opportunity? What opportunity?”
Wang Ping’s eyes brightened with curiosity.
“Not everyone can participate in the game of obtaining Rule Stones, and having enough World Source doesn’t guarantee entry. A special entry ticket is required.”
Alpha’s cold voice explained.
“This special entry ticket is the origin of a certain level of the strange. And the level of the strange in the Cultivation World barely meets the requirement. Although it’s unlikely you’ll directly participate in the game to obtain a complete Rule Stone, you can participate in the game for Rule Stone fragments. As long as you keep winning, you’ll eventually obtain a complete Rule Stone.”
“As long as you keep winning and obtain a complete Rule Stone, you’ll evolve your Golden Finger Life Simulator once again. By then…”
Alpha paused towards the end and didn’t continue.
“I see. In that case, it’s necessary to go.”
Wang Ping pondered thoughtfully.
Alpha is undoubtedly treating him well now, as their fates are intertwined, with shared fortunes and misfortunes.
Therefore, Alpha wouldn’t deceive or betray him now.
Since Alpha has said so much about it, he naturally needs to make an effort to prepare to further optimize the life simulator in the future.
“By the way, what will happen then?”
Then, Wang Ping asked curiously.
“Nothing.”
Alpha gave a vague answer with no intention of elaborating.
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, not asking more questions or indulging in further thoughts as it was pointless.
Then, Wang Ping opened up the chat group and entered the chat channel.
At the moment, the chat group was undoubtedly boiling.
Both old and new group members who were not performing tasks or in special situations like deep cultivation were all active.
Qin Tian (77): “Holy shit, is my original world going to be destroyed? That’s terrifying. I thought it would take hundreds of years before it gets completely destroyed… Sure enough, anything can happen in the multiple heavens.”
Ye Xiaofan (75): “…Fortunately, we moved early, otherwise, it would indeed be too dangerous. Now we don’t even know the situation down there.”
Fang Yun (3): “Since the chat group asked Mr. Wang to take action, it means that it can be saved, right?”
Chen Yao (71): “That’s true, but the situation must be very critical by now.”
Wang Ping (66): “This group task will involve my choice of participants, and it seems there’s no limit to the number. So, I will choose some group members who can help me. The rest of you group members can decide whether to participate voluntarily in this group task.”
Wang Ping (66)@all members: “Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, Liu Mei, Zhang Yueying, Chen Si, Chen Kang, Lin Yuanyuan, you guys follow me and participate in this group task, ok?”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Since Mr. Wang asked me to go, I will definitely go. However, I am currently participating in another group task… BitterSmile.jpg.”
Chen Kang (67): “Um, I’m also in the middle of a group task…”
Wang Ping (66): “You can temporarily pause other group tasks and temporarily transfer over. As for the lost group points, I can compensate you.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Mr. Wang, don’t say that. No matter what task I’m doing, as long as Mr. Wang needs my help, I will go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 764: 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Chapter 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_4
Cai Yonglong (1): “Yuanyuan is right, it’s the same for me.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “I didn’t mean that, I’m just worried about whether the mission can be interrupted or not. I’m not talking about being reluctant to give up points or something like that.”
Chen Kang (67): “Add one more upstairs.”
Qu Zhong (201): “Um, Mr. Wang, can I go? I think I should be able to help.”
The sudden appearance of this group member surprised the people in the group.
Wang Ping was also somewhat surprised, his eyes flickering.
Over the years, many newcomers joined.
However, perhaps because Wang Ping and other surviving group members had been blessed with a survivor bias, resulting in good luck and strong golden fingers, they all had forgotten what Cai Yonglong said at the beginning, that most golden fingers were ordinary, with only a few being very powerful.
As a result, the vast majority of subsequent newcomers were quite miserable.
This misery has two aspects.
First, quite a few people died.
Second, the luck of newcomers who revealed their golden fingers was very bad, and the golden fingers drawn were very ordinary and not much use.
As a result, Wang Ping and other old members of the chat group treated these newcomers with a laissez-faire attitude, offering them initial growth resource packages, but leaving them to fend for themselves afterward.
If they had any questions, they would answer them if they had time, sometimes even help them, but not too much.
Unless these newcomers could accumulate enough group points by their own ability, draw new golden fingers, and obtain good ones.
In that case, Wang Ping and other old group members would do their utmost to train them.
This is not cold-blooded, but realistic; whether you have potential or are worth cultivating are things that seniors need to consider.
Good steel should be used on blades, and wasting resources is shameful.
Of course, even if you haven’t drawn other golden fingers, if you have a good talent, you can still be cultivated.
However, most newcomers have neither, and some even have low EQ, so they have no choice but to let them roam free.
In addition, there are some newcomers who are very cautious, do not expose too much of their details, and do not trust Wang Ping and other predecessor transmigrators, quietly developing themselves instead.
Regarding this, Wang Ping and others didn’t force them. After all, being cautious is the norm.
Now, this Qu Zhong (201) group member, who is one of the cautious types, suddenly wants to participate in such a dangerous group task. This surprises Wang Ping.
In this situation, Wang Ping could only guess that this newcomer may have encountered difficulties in his transmigrated world.
Or he knows what this level of group task entails.
If they can perform well in this group task and gain a large enough contribution, they can earn a lot of group points in an instant and take off in one go.
Wang Ping (66): “Daring to participate in the group task is admirable. What is your golden finger and what ability does it have?”
Qu Zhong (201): “Mr. Wang, my golden finger is called Purification. It can purify negative conditions like curses. I’ve already read about Qin Tian’s world situation in the group files, and I think I’m quite suitable to participate in this group mission.”
Qu Zhong is also going all out. He did encounter big trouble in his own world, and if he doesn’t gain a large amount of group points to Krypton gold, raising his strength, he will be done for.
If he doesn’t show his value or earn group points, he doesn’t believe that those powerful predecessor transmigrators will spend their group points to save him in his world.
After all, they have never taken care of those newcomers who have no value and were destined to die.
So, Qu Zhong doesn’t trust Wang Ping and the others.
If it weren’t for the trouble he encountered, he would still want to keep hiding his abilities.
Qin Tian (77): “Holy shit! Purification, damn, such a great golden finger, and you’ve been hiding it! That’s too outrageous!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Such a good golden finger, if you had just mentioned it, us old members would definitely take you to soar. You’ve wasted a lot of time.”
Chen Kang (67): “Yeah, my sister and I both have support-type golden fingers, and we got carried.”
Qu Zhong (201): “…”
Wang Ping (66): “Being cautious is very normal, and it’s not his fault. Qu Zhong, your golden finger is good, and it may have miraculous effects in this group mission, so you can go.”
Wang Ping was also quite surprised, not expecting Qu Zhong’s golden finger to be so good.
With this golden finger, facing those disgusting and weird abilities would definitely be useful.
Even if they don’t face those weird abilities, it’s still useful.
After all, curse-type divine skills or curse-imbued special regions are definitely not scarce in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms. With this golden finger, they can avoid many pits, achieve miraculous results at critical moments, and avoid annihilating outcomes.
Of course, there is also a problem: having the golden finger ability is one thing, but if the ability level is not raised, it’s useless.
So, if they really want to fight against those extremely powerful curses or negative states, they still need to be optimized one or two times.
However, Wang Ping has amassed billions of group points, and helping him optimize twice is more than enough.
The premise is that his ability can be used in this group mission. Otherwise, Wang Ping wouldn’t spend so much group points to train him without figuring out his character.
Qu Zhong (201): “Thank you, Mr. Wang! In this mission, I’ll try my best not to be a drag!”

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 765: Chapter 218: Creating a Miracle! The End of the Cultivation Realm_5
Wang Ping glanced at Qu Zhong’s comment, didn’t say much, and asked the group again to see if there were any old or new members willing to participate in this group task.
However, the old members basically knew that this group task was suitable for those with special abilities, and there was not much significance for those with strong strength.
How strong could they be compared to Mr. Wang?
In the current chat group, only Lin Yuanyuan might be able to help Mr. Wang a little by relying on her strength.
As for newcomers, apart from Qu Zhong revealing himself, the others still showed no intention of coming forward, possibly watching secretly or perhaps not even seeing the message.
Wang Ping didn’t mind this.
After that, Wang Ping reminded the group members not to inhale the Spiritual Energy of the Qin Tian World after they cross over, and then directly input the list of participants for this group task.
As Wang Ping input the list of group members, he disappeared in a flash of white light.
Apart from that, Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, Liu Mei, Zhang Yueying, Chen Si, Chen Kang, Lin Yuanyuan, and Qu Zhong also vanished one after another, being transported to the Cultivation World.
When Wang Ping’s vision cleared again, he saw a horrifying scene.
In Wang Ping’s eyes, the whole world had turned into twisted monsters, with countless tentacles and disgusting bugs on their bodies, and indescribable creatures.
Obviously, the Cultivation Realm where Qin Tian was located had been completely contaminated, and the previous lower realm that they had traveled to had become part of that bizarre body.
“The lower realm is already like this, I don’t know what kind of ghostly figure the Upper Realm has turned into, nor do I know what caused the anomaly to break out early.”
Many thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind.
While Wang Ping was thinking, the others had also crossed over.
This time, there was no need for the eye in the sky; everyone directly saw this terrifying scene and almost vomited.
At the same time, the weak Qu Zhong’s Energy Barrier quickly twisted and turned into bugs and tentacles.
Even his body started to grow tendrils.
Apparently, he was also contaminated.
Wang Ping frowned slightly, immediately used a Secret Skill to form a space-time barrier, protecting Qu Zhong and the others.
“Cleanse!”
Qu Zhong’s face changed drastically as soon as he reacted, and he immediately used the cleansing ability on himself.
Instantly, a white rain of light enveloped Qu Zhong, and the tentacles that had appeared on his body quickly vanished.
Qu Zhong breathed a sigh of relief, his face pale, panting frantically.
He almost died as soon as he crossed over.
This world was too dangerous.
“Are you sure this isn’t Cthulhu?”
Qu Zhong looked at the monster-formed world, felt his stomach churning, and couldn’t help but vomit.
“Maybe. Whether it’s an evil god or an anomaly, they are all dangerous existences. If you encounter them, either eliminate them or find a way to escape.”
Wang Ping spoke calmly.
“And our goal this time is to eliminate them.”
“Uh….” Qu Zhong was speechless.
“Mr.Wang, I guess it’s been a long time since we’ve had a big group gathering. Except for the first time we dealt with the Zombie anomaly, it’s the first time we’ve had more than six people on a group task.”
Cai Yonglong laughed and said.
“We only had eight people during our first group task. This time, it’s nine.”
Wu Jun also sighed.
“The anomaly we’re dealing with this time is probably the most dangerous of them all. However, we are no longer who we used to be.”
Liu Mei’s expression was serious as she spoke.
Zhang Yueying, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Lin Yuanyuan didn’t say anything because they joined later and hadn’t experienced the first encounter with the anomaly.
“Yeah, we’ve all grown a lot and become stronger. Of course, combat power is secondary, what’s more important is the growth and diversity of our abilities.”
Wang Ping smiled.
Then, Wang Ping’s expression paused, looking down at the monster sweeping towards them, and said lightly, “However, let’s talk about this later. For now, let’s destroy this world that has been contaminated into a monster.”
With that said, Wang Ping stretched out his palm.
He didn’t use any Divine Skills, no laws, and didn’t use the Supreme Artifact. He simply stretched out his palm and gently pressed it down.
Then, under the shocked gaze of Cai Yonglong and the others, a giant hand made of flames descended from the sky and suppressed the entire world.
Countless monsters wailed and turned to ashes.
Even the world that had been contaminated into a monster was destroyed in the process.
This area turned into a Void, and everything ceased to exist.
“It’s still Mr. Wang, a Half-step Great Saint, truly terrifying.”
Cai Yonglong clicked his tongue.
As for Qu Zhong, he was too shocked to speak.
He had always known that the old members of the group were very strong, especially Mr. Wang, synonymous with invincibility, but he didn’t realize that he was so powerful that he could easily wipe out a whole world with just a casual move.
“It’s not a big deal, even Yuanyuan can easily do this now.”
Wang Ping chuckled softly, shook his head slightly, and looked deep into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House
chapters.content:
Chapter 766: Chapter 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House
“Mr. Wang, what do we do now? Shall we go straight to the Immortal World?”
Lin Yuanyuan didn’t want to interrupt, but she asked solemnly about the important matter at hand.
“No, let’s follow the old rule and simulate the situation first. Yuanyuan, protect me.”
Wang Ping exhaled softly and became serious as well.
Nowadays, even without entering an immersive simulation state, simulating with the Life Simulator still takes a considerable amount of time.
Therefore, Wang Ping needs to find a safe place to use the Life Simulator.
Going directly to the Immortal World, the center of the big battle, would be too dangerous to perform the simulation.
“It could be possible. However, Mr. Wang, you just destroyed this corrupted world. I’m a little worried that we might have been detected by that strange force.”
Lin Yuanyuan nodded, hesitatingly said.
“Hehe, it’s normal to be detected. Even if I hadn’t made a move, it would have found us already.”
Wang Pingping calmly said.
“So, Cai, remember to use your ability to protect all of us at any time. As for Qu Zhong, I’ll lend you one million group points in advance. Prepare for purification.”
Wang Ping paused, then continued seriously: “Lastly, and most importantly, be prepared to escape and teleport at any time.”
“Understood!”
Hearing this, everyone felt a chill and quickly nodded.
Wang Ping closed his eyes, and whispered in his heart: “System, start the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation commencing.”
As the system’s voice rang out, Wang Ping felt a flash in his consciousness and entered the immersive simulation state.
Soon after, the luminescent screen appeared and familiar characters emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to tear through the Void and forcibly enter the Immortal World using the connection between the two realms.]
[The moment you arrived in the Immortal World, you saw a terrifying sight—the entire world was filled with even more twisted monsters, as if the entire Immortal World had turned into monsters.]
[As soon as you appeared, all the monsters launched attacks at you. You remained calm, instantly incinerating the monsters attacking you and suppressing the world’s monsters underfoot.]
[However, you didn’t want to engage with them further. You chose to use a Secret Skill to find any remaining life force in the Immortal World, then used a Time-Space Divine Skill to take everyone to another area in the Immortal World.]
[In that area, you saw numerous Immortal World Cultivators working with ten Immortal Emperors to set up a Great Array, resisting the strange erosion alongside what’s left of the Cultivation Realm Heavenly Tao.]
[Despite their desperate efforts, they still couldn’t stop the erosion. The remaining Cultivation Realm was shrinking at a visible rate.]
[When you appeared, the Immortal Emperors all looked your way, expressions of surprise and delight on their faces.]
[This shocked you, as it was the first time you’ve seen such expressions from indigenous people in a world after crossing over. Generally speaking, you were treated with caution as People from Outside the Domain. Especially in a world on the brink of destruction, they were even more hostile towards those from outside.]
[Soon, you found out why. It turned out that the Heavenly Tao of this world had informed the Immortal Emperors of the Cultivation Realm about seeking assistance from outside the Cultivation Realm. Your arrival, being People from Outside the Domain, clearly made you the help they were waiting for.]
[Of course, there’s one more thing. When you appeared, the Heavenly Tao also informed them, otherwise they would have been hostile, as they couldn’t determine your identity immediately.]
[After all, someone from outside the domain had appeared before and attacked them. It was because of that person that they became disorganized, unable to hold on much longer.]
[Next, you learned about the specific situation in the Cultivation Realm and the existence of the attacker from outside the domain. At the same time, you found out about the power levels of the Immortal Emperors in this world and the power level of the attacker from outside the domain.]
[The power of the Immortal Emperors of this world was roughly at the level of an ordinary Great Saint. As for the attacker, he was far more powerful than the Immortal Emperors, instantly killing two of them after breaking into the realm, causing problems in the Cultivation Realm’s Great Array.]
[If it hadn’t been for the Heavenly Tao’s rage—brewing terrifying power to suppress the attacker—he might have continued killing people.]
[After hearing the situation, you became grim. This world indeed experienced other incidents as you guessed, incidents from the All Heavens.]
[This person from beyond the All Heavens ran to this world to help the strange force in killing Immortal Emperors. It’s excessively cruel and breaks the rules.]
[After all, everyone can punish that strange force. Helping it destroy a world is a grave offence. If it’s someone from the Chaotic Orderly Forces, they will definitely be dealt with. Even if it’s someone from the Chaotic Evil Forces, they won’t easily side with this strange force.]
[Next, you feel that if you want to deal with this strange force, you need to find and eliminate that person from beyond the All Heavens first.]
[To do so, you once again enter the strange world with your team, using the information given by the Heavenly Tao and employing a secret method to track him down.]
[However, you didn’t need to find him intentionally. As soon as you entered the strange world, you were ambushed. The person from All Heavens led a large number of monsters to attack you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 767: Chapter 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_2
[These monsters possess power comparable to an Immortal Emperor, and due to their tenacious vitality and terrifying contamination abilities, they are even more difficult to deal with than an Immortal Emperor.]
[However, you have no fear and take action with thunderous means, instantly killing this monster that is on par with an Immortal Emperor on the spot. At present, although you haven’t formed a complete Time-Space Body due to the lack of Time-Space Origin in the rewards, you still possess the cultivation realization from your previous Paid Simulation.]
[That is to say, right now, you have comprehended the Great Perfection Time-Space Laws and cultivated the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra, making you incredibly powerful.]
[Upon witnessing your dominance, the All Heavens powerhouse is shocked as well. Nevertheless, he isn’t afraid and starts a fierce battle with you.]
[I must say, this All Heavens powerhouse is extremely strong, even formidable among the Great Saints, so that even you, with all your combat power, can’t suppress him easily. The battle is incredibly intense.]
[Seeing this, you don’t hesitate and directly use the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification effect, forcibly resisting his attack and unleashing your most potent divine skill.]
[This time, although a critical strike isn’t triggered, it does have a duet effect. Caught off guard, the All Heavens powerhouse is severely wounded by you, and the item on his face is shattered, revealing his true appearance.]
[When you use your divine eye skills to see his real face, your pupils suddenly contract. To your surprise, this guy turns out to be a Predecessor Transmigrator from the Second Generation Chat Group.]
[Having engaged with the Second Generation Predecessor Transmigrators multiple times, you naturally let Alpha inform you of all the transmigrators’ information in the Second Generation Chat Group, remembering them to avoid any future encounters and slip-ups.]
[The Predecessor Transmigrator before you is a transmigrator named Yi Liantao from the Second Generation Chat Group. According to the information Alpha told you, his combat power was only on par with Saint King’s tier when the Second Generation Chat Group was destroyed.]
[Now, he has demonstrated formidable strength among the Great Saints, having grown significantly over the years.]
[Of course, that isn’t the main issue. The key is his collusion with the eerie forces here, which is extremely terrifying. You can’t help but doubt that this is part of a grand scheme by some big shots from the Second Generation Chat Group.]
…..
!!!
Wang Ping, looking at the content of the Text Simulation, suddenly contracts his pupils, also feeling somewhat incredulous.
Dealing with the sinister presence is one thing.
This time, dealing with the sinister forces is overt, and as long as you are strong enough, you may be able to help the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Realm turn the tide against the wind.
At worst, it’s just a Mission Failure and escape.
Now that a Predecessor Transmigrator from the Second Generation Chat Group has emerged, the problem becomes severe. The task’s difficulty has sharply risen, and Wang Ping needs to consider whether this is a massive conspiracy targeting him.
“No, right now, to the Predecessor Transmigrators of the Second Generation Chat Group, I’m still just an insignificant shrimp in the Divine Realm. Sending Ruo Lan or the Slaughter Saint of Slaughter Paradise to deal with me was already serious enough, and they wouldn’t put in so much effort. Even if Wind Demon Supreme has found out about the death of Slaughter Saint in Slaughter Paradise, he would only guess that I have Saint Realm tier combat power.”[
“Though this combat power is astonishing and the leveling speed is terrifying, it’s not enough to warrant collaborating with the sinister forces. Besides, how could they know that the world of Qin Tian had a Group member, and I would definitely fall into the trap?”
Wang Ping murmured, and various thoughts flashed through his mind while he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.]
[You recognize Yi Liantao, but he doesn’t seem to recognize you because you have already uploaded the Nine stars Pavilion’s secret method to the group. Lin Yuanyuan and others have learned the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method using Group points, so they won’t be recognized. As for Qu Zhong, being a newcomer, he won’t be recognized even if he doesn’t know the Nine Stars Pavilion’s secret method.[
[Of course, this is only in the simulation. If it were in the real world, and Yi Liantao is live streaming with big shots from the Second Generation Chat Group watching, your secret method would be exposed without a doubt.]
[At this moment, although numerous thoughts flash through your mind, you don’t miss the opportunity to attack the vulnerable Yi Liantao, launching fierce attacks on him.]
[Ultimately, under your relentless assault, Yi Liantao is left on the verge of death, losing the ability to fight back. You then hand him over to Lin Yuanyuan.]
[Upon receiving Yi Liantao, Lin Yuanyuan doesn’t hesitate, using her Array Mana to block their vision before extracting all of Yi Liantao’s power. Her combat power skyrockets to a level comparable to yours, making her one of the stronger powerhouses among the Great Saints.]
[Next, without any delay, you kill Yi Liantao and begin to cooperate with the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Realm to deal with the sinister forces.]
[Sensing danger, the sinister presence starts to go berserk. The transformed sinister force gathers terrifying power across the majority of the Cultivation Realm, a power that surpasses the Great Saints.]

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 768: Chapter 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_3
[At this point, your face turns solemn as you directly display your Life-bound Supreme Device. At the same time, you let Chen Si and the others take action.]
[For this, Chen Si directly uses her Weakening ability and puts it on the bizarre creature.]
[Because Chen Si’s Golden Finger has been optimized once before, the Weakening ability has doubled, leaving the bizarre creature with only a quarter of its power.]
[While Chen Si applied the Weakening, Zhang Yueying also used her ability, causing your fighting strength to gradually increase, surpassing your current level.]
[As for Cai Yonglong, Liu Mei, Qu Zhong, and the others, they are also ready to use their abilities to assist in battle.]
[Zhang Yueying’s enhancement, along with the Life-bound Supreme Device in your hand, has raised your fighting strength to a level that can contend with a Half-step Supreme. Each move is filled with devastating power, and your Time-Space Divine Skill is even more domineering, wanting to tear apart the majority of the polluted Cultivation Realm.]
[Your burst of power greatly shocks the Immortal Emperors, who feel that you are incredibly powerful, as strong as a monster.]
[The bizarre creature also didn’t expect you to be so powerful and didn’t expect Chen Si to forcefully suppress three-quarters of its power, making it very uncomfortable.]
[The most troublesome thing is that the Heavenly Tao of the Cultivation Realm has also begun to counterattack at this opportunity, which has made the bizarre creature feel a long-lost sense of crisis.]
[At this, the bizarre creature found itself left with one choice: to gather all its power to suppress you. As for the remaining part of the Cultivation Realm, it can only give up.]
[Originally, it intended to completely pollute the Cultivation Realm and turn it into its own base. Now it seems that it cannot do that. Since it cannot, it has resolved to cut off the powerful enemies before it proceeds.]
[Soon, the polluted Cultivation Realm began to squirm and gradually shrink, turning into a mini version of a tentacle monster. The moment this tentacle monster appeared, even your face changed as the energy fluctuations of this tentacle monster were too powerful, surpassing the Half-step Supreme level.]
[Facing a monster beyond the Half-step Supreme level, even with the fighting strength boosted by Zhang Yueying’s Golden Finger, you cannot compete with it. Unless you happen to trigger the Purple Talent: Endless Blade and the Nine-fold Symphony, there is no chance of victory.]
[Just as you were terrified, the bizarre creature launched an attack, locking onto you and maximizing its polluting power. In an instant, the energy barrier you set up was unable to block this bizarre creature’s polluting power, and the bodies of Cai Yonglong and the others began to transform.]
[At this point, upon seeing the situation, Cai Yonglong hesitated no longer and immediately used the Golden Finger of Absolute Defense to protect Qu Zhong and the others. Once Qu Zhong reacted, he immediately allowed Qu Zhong to use his purification ability to cleanse the pollution from everyone’s bodies.]
[However, it was obvious that the level of ability had changed, and even Qu Zhong’s optimized Golden Finger could not initially purify as cleanly and effortlessly, though it was still cleansing, the process was much slower.]
[Seeing this, your face turned solemn, knowing that you could not drag things on any longer; otherwise, your group would all die here. For this reason, you let Chen Kang use his Restraining ability to keep the bizarre creature in place.]
[Then, with your Life-bound Supreme Device in hand, you launched your most intense attack, attempting to simultaneously activate the effects of Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Nine-fold Symphony.]
[However, to your dismay, the talent effect was not triggered during Chen Kang’s restraint. Without triggering the effect, your previous attack was like scraping, useless against the bizarre creature.]
[Knowing that it will end this way, you let Wu Jun, out of necessity, use the power of his Golden Finger.]
[This time, Wu Jun was fortunate enough to trigger a positive effect. The bizarre creature’s body froze, and then it began to collapse, dying conceptually.]
[Seeing this scene, you were shocked, feeling that Wu Jun’s Golden Finger was incredibly powerful. However, you also bitterly smiled, thinking that the possibility of triggering the bizarre creature’s sudden death in the simulation might not happen in reality, and the problem remains unresolved.]
[Because you killed the bizarre creature, you chose to return.]
[Due to your return, the simulation ends…..]
…
After the Text Simulation ended, countless images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind before his view returned to the real world.
“Mr. Wang, how are things?”
Cai Yonglong asked eagerly.
“It’s dead, but….”
Wang Ping sighed and told them what happened.
“This….”
Everyone looked at each other, not expecting the bizarre creature to be so monstrous, that after going berserk, it condensed a body that surpassed the Half-step Supreme level.
Although its real body appeared and only had to be killed, avoiding the trouble of cutting it down from Heavenly Tao, it was too powerful to defeat.
“With my sister’s Weakening ability, it only had a quarter of its power left, and the result was still so strong. How can we fight this?”
Chen Kang said with a headache.
“Moreover, its pollution ability is so strong that if it is not resolved within the effective time of my Golden Finger, we will all be polluted into monsters.”
Cai Yonglong also frowned, his face uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 769: Chapter 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_4
“Well, my purification ability, if it evolves once more, would it have any miraculous effects?”
Qu Zhong cautiously asked.
“No use.”
Wang Ping glanced at him and had no intention of spending another 100 million group points to strengthen him.
Unless he could use the Golden finger ability to directly purify the weirdness and kill it, the significance of continued optimization wasn’t too big.
“The key is still power. I can continue to simulate and improve my own strength. However, the biggest problem with immersive simulation is the passage of time.”
Wang Ping frowned, feeling a headache.
If he continued the previous paid simulation, given the minimum time length of 100,000 years, even if he didn’t immerse himself, the real world would have passed for at least a few months.
If he lived longer, the time passed in the real world would be even longer.
By then, the weirdness would definitely not let them go.
The weirdness already knew of their existence, and the one called Yi Liantao in the Second-generation Transmigrator Chat Group most likely knew they had arrived.
If Yi Liantao reported the situation, Wang Ping and the others would have to deal with more than just Yi Liantao and the weirdness. The big shots from the Second Generation Chat Group might also be on their way there.
“Get ready to abandon the mission.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and made this decision.
He would never do anything risky.
Although the value of this weirdness was huge, serving as his entry ticket to the Myriad Heavens Paradise in the future, he was not in a hurry now.
When his strength became even more powerful, it would be easier for him to hunt down weirdness on this level in the future, wouldn’t it?
Although this level of weirdness was not common, Wang Ping had plenty of time and could afford to wait.
“Uh… ”
Seeing Wang Ping say this, Cai Yonglong and the others looked at each other in surprise, not expecting Wang Ping to make such a decision.
After all, in the past, even if the weirdness was dangerous, Wang Ping had never given up. He would find a way to clear the level through multiple simulations, and finally win the mission.
“Indeed, there is no need to continue the task. After all, this time the situation is different. We have to face other transmigrators who might also shake our group. This could be a conspiracy.”
Lin Yuanyuan’s eyes flickered, agreeing with Wang Ping’s determination.
Seeing this, everyone else naturally wouldn’t object.
“Wu Jun, use your Golden finger and try to see if you can trigger an instant death effect. If we can take advantage of the situation, it would be great.”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun and spoke.
“Alright, I’ll try.”
Wu Jun hesitated for a moment and then nodded.
“Wait.”
At this moment, Wang Ping seemed to have thought of something and looked at Cai Yonglong.
“Cai, use your Absolute Defense to protect all of us. I’m worried that Wu Jun might trigger something bad and wipe us all out together.”
Wang Ping exhaled and spoke earnestly.
“Alright.”
Cai Yonglong also felt that Wang Ping’s words made sense and did not hesitate to use his Golden finger to bless the light shield above him, activating Absolute Defense.
Wang Ping went even further, preparing to use Golden Talent: Damage Nullification when Wu Jun activated his ability.
With double protection, even if Wu Jun’s Golden finger triggered any negative effects, he could still be unscathed.
Soon, Wu Jun used his Golden finger.
In an instant, Wu Jun turned into a woman under everyone’s watchful eyes.
However, everything seemed very calm, as if nothing had happened.
“Mr.Wang, I think I failed.”
Wu Jun spoke somewhat awkwardly.
“… Even if you failed, it’s fine. Let’s prepare to leave. The longer we stay in this world, the more danger we face.”
Wang Ping frowned and spoke.
“Alright.”
Hearing this, everyone felt somewhat helpless and chose to teleport back.
In an instant, Wang Ping and the others turned into white light and disappeared, returning to their original world.
However, just a few minutes after Wang Ping returned, the chat group system’s prompt tone suddenly rang out, startling them.
“Ding, the weirdness is dead. The group task is completed, and rewards have been issued separately. Group members can collect their respective rewards on the Group Reward Page.”
“The weirdness… is dead?”
Wang Ping was somewhat astonished.
Could it be that Wu Jun had also triggered the instant death effect before?
If that was the case, then Wu Jun’s luck was just too incredible.
“To deal with this difficult-to-solve weirdness, Wu Jun’s Golden finger is still the most powerful, completely ignoring everything and directly killing.”
Wang Ping sighed with emotion.
In Wang Ping’s view, his Life Simulator was powerful, but Wu Jun and Lin Yuanyuan were not inferior to him.
If one day, Lin Yuanyuan directly slept with a Supreme or even a Quasi-Emperor, and Wu Jun directly triggered the possibility of gaining terrifying power…
Then, those two would undoubtedly surpass him easily.
“You’re overthinking it. Wu Jun didn’t activate his Golden finger to kill the weirdness directly.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“So, what’s the reason?”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping was slightly startled.
“This time, Wu Jun’s ability may have only weakened the pollution of the Heavenly Tao. The one who really dealt with the weirdness was someone from the Second Generation Chat Group.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded, seemingly unchanged, but rarely a bit unusual.
“What, people from the Second Generation Chat Group?”
Wang Ping’s eyes widened slightly, astonished.
“Isn’t this their plan? Why would they kill the weirdness? Or did they wipe out the entire Cultivation Realm along with it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 770: 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 770: Chapter 219: Reappearance of the Predecessor Crosser! Cleaning House_5
“There are two purposes: to kill the Guaiyi and to purge his group.”
Alpha’s voice rang out again.
“Purge his group…?” Wang Ping frowned slightly, guessing: “You mean, cooperating with the Guaiyi this time was based on Yi Liantao’s unilateral decision and not the scheme of the Predecessor ransmigrators in the Second-generation Chat Group?”
“That’s right.” Alpha spoke slowly: “It seems that there are still principled people in the Second Generation Chat Group.”
“…”
Wang Ping nodded.
Both Chu Xiao and Yi Liantao planned to use the Guaiyi to achieve their goals, which could be said to be extremely crazy.
Wang Ping originally thought that this group of ransmigrator predecessors were all ruthless characters who acted without considering the consequences.
It seems that this is not necessarily the case.
“Who is he? How strong is he now?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“Chen Mu, based on the strength he displayed before, he should be on par with a Quasi-Emperor.”
Alpha gave an answer.
“Chen Mu, a Quasi-Emperor level powerhouse… Alpha, did you snatch the origin of the Guaiyi from his hands?”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, and he asked curiously.
“I got some of it, so I distributed rewards to you guys. However, since it wasn’t you who killed Guaiyi this time, I guess you won’t be getting the entry ticket.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out again.
“Hehe, it doesn’t matter, there’s no hurry. When I reach the Great Emperor tier, as long as you detect Guaiyi, I can go and crush him to death.”
Wang Ping laughed lightly, speaking confidently.
“Mhm.”
Alpha responded once and then went silent.
…
Seeing Alpha go silent, Wang Ping put the previous matter behind him, accepted the rewards casually, and found that there were several billion Group points as rewards.
He was quite satisfied with this.
Next, Wang Ping closed the noisy chat group and planned to enter an immersive simulation.
This time, he must break through the Great Saint level.
And then, the most important thing.
He is eager to refresh out the Temporal Origin or a complete Time-Space Body.
If he can’t refresh it, he will still suffer in the real world and can only move with an incomplete Time-Space Body.
“If it really doesn’t work, I can only wait until my cultivation is up, then directly look for the Jee and the Wang Family in the real world, and try to enter the secret realm through trading to obtain the Temporal Origin.”
Wang Ping thought silently.
This is the easiest to achieve.
After all, it is the Last Dharma Age now. As long as Wang Ping takes out something of astonishing value, it won’t be difficult to go to the secret realm.
As for the issue of life-threatening danger.
In the simulation, he cannot use the chat group, but he can in the real world.
Even if he encounters life-threatening danger, he can escape thanks to the Delivery Function of the chat group, and even Quasi-Emperors won’t be able to stop him.
“Thinking about it this way, it’s much easier all of a sudden. I can struggle, but there’s no need to struggle too hard. In the real world, what needs to be contested must be contested.”
Wang Ping laughed and entered the immersive simulation.
The luminescent screen and text appeared.
[Day 1, you chose action and took Wan Yu back to the Elemental Star first, where you met Lin Qinghe.]
[In the previous simulations, you were unsure whether the Taiyi Imperial Palace would accept the Demonic Body prodigies, so you didn’t plan on bringing Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu to the Taiyi Imperial Palace; it was too dangerous. You chose to let them go their own way.]
[After letting them go, you haven’t seen both of them shine in the previous simulations and are still somewhat worried.]
[Now that you know Taiyi Great Emperor’s character and have a strong affinity for Taiyi Imperial Palace, you think you can give it a try to see if the Taiyi Imperial Palace will accept these two Demonic Body prodigies.]
[If the Taiyi Emperor Palace is willing to accept them, you’ll be relieved. If Taiyi Imperial Palace is not willing to accept them, it would be more convenient for you to bring them to the Immortal Continent for growth. With you watching over them, if they encounter bullying from old monsters, you can help them out as well.]
[Subsequently, you found Cai Yonglong and took the three of them away from the Elemental Star together.]
[During this process, the Primordial Thunder Supreme also had his eyes on you guys. However, after thinking it over, he ultimately did not make a move.]
[At this point, you relaxed. Following that, you took the three of them to the Immortal Continent and paid a visit to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was very surprised by your talent and cultivation, and naturally let you join. As for Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu, he didn’t see their talents but let Lin Qinghe, Wan Yu, and Cai Yonglong join the Taiyi Emperor Palace on your account.]
[At this point, you breathed a sigh of relief. Although you have a great impression of Taiyi Imperial Palace, especially the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor whom you respect and believe in his character, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s whereabouts are unknown now, and you don’t have a complete Time-Space Body. If the Palace Master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace dislikes Demonic Bodies, it would be quite troublesome.]
[Fortunately, the Supreme could not recognize the incomplete Devouring Immortal Demon Body and the Black Abyss Demon Body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 771: 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint!
chapters.content:
Chapter 771: Chapter 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint!
[Next, under the arrangement of the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace, you all chose to self-tittle, waiting for the arrival of the Golden Age.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a hundred thousand years have passed, the Golden Age has arrived, and you have all unsealed yourselves.]
[The first thing you did after unsealing was to step onto the Taiyi Sky Road. This time, because you didn’t have the complete Time-Space Body, you could only reach the twelfth floor, but it was enough to make you a Taiyi Emperor Palace Prince.]
[Following that, you shocked many cultivators in Taiyi Emperor Palace by challenging the First Emperor’s Son of Taiyi Emperor Palace, Yu Daohong. Yu Daohong didn’t expect the newly-joined Prince to dare challenge him directly, so he became curious about you and accepted your challenge.]
[And then, this battle shocked the entire Taiyi Emperor Palace. Although you do not have a complete Time-Space Body now, the eruption of the Great Perfection Space-Time Laws is also very strong, enough for you to engage in a fierce duel with Yu Daohong without falling behind, even a bit stronger.]
[In the end, Yu Daohong was defeated by you, and you became the First Emperor’s Son of Taiyi Emperor Palace. This shocked everyone in Taiyi Emperor Palace, as they didn’t expect you to be so powerful.]
[This also alarmed the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor of Taiyi Emperor Palace, who never expected that there would be such a talented person capable of defeating his own son, Yu Daohong. So, he decided to take you as his disciple.]
[You were very pleased with this. This time, you’ve become the Emperor’s Inherited Disciple in advance, which gives you a higher status than last time, making many things easier, and the Quasi-Emperor wouldn’t dare to act against you.]
[After all, some Quasi-Emperors might dare to attack Imperial Prince-level characters, but the Emperor’s Inherited Disciples are really untouchable because their status is too prestigious, and they might have the Emperor’s protection.]
[Next, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor gave you some treasures, including a Jade Pendant with one of his incarnations, saying that it would only activate in case of life and death.]
[You were very happy about this, so you accepted it. Then you told Heavenly Feather Great Emperor about Wan Yu and Lin Qinghe. Although both of them had Demonic Bodies, their nature was not evil, so you hoped that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would not expel them.]
[Hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor chuckled, saying that when they joined Taiyi Emperor Palace, he already knew about their existence. To be precise, he knew about the existence of three people.]
[Finally, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed, saying that he didn’t expect the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body to still be alive, existing in this way within the current generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]
[You were surprised, not expecting Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to discover this so early, even knowing about the residual soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. But then you thought about it and realized that it was quite normal for a powerful figure like Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to know this.]
[At this point, you breathed a sigh of relief. Since Heavenly Feather Great Emperor knew about this from the beginning and still acted this way, it was clear that he intended to protect and cultivate them as disciples of Taiyi Emperor Palace. Indeed, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was reliable and broad-minded.]
[However, you were still curious and asked Heavenly Feather Great Emperor if accepting Demonic Bodies would cause other forces to despise them. Would it bring trouble to Taiyi Emperor Palace?]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor laughed and answered with an overbearing statement: ‘In the Upper Realm, who dares to cause trouble for Taiyi Emperor Palace? Even if he has accepted unawakened demonic bodies, or completely demonic bodies, who dares to discredit him? Who dares to act against Taiyi Emperor Palace?’]
[Hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s overbearing words, you couldn’t help but marvel. He appeared to be humble and low-profile, but deep down, he was always very domineering and protective of his own. In the last simulation, he dared to confront the Erebos Emperor, and in this simulation, he even spoke such words.]
[As you marveled, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor laughed softly, suggesting that you shouldn’t worry about these issues. After all, in this world, power reigns supreme; the right path and the demon path are just different branches of cultivation, and there is no opposition between the two sides. It’s only those superficial lower-level cultivators who like to make a fuss and make distinctions. What can cause opposition between the two sides is only resources and the battle of the Great Path. Even among the so-called right paths, they still fight against each other for their own interests, don’t they?]
[Hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words felt like gaining wisdom from a decade of reading. Although you vaguely knew this truth, your way of thinking was still influenced by novels from your previous life, subconsciously considering the relationship between right and evil paths as opposing. Coupled with the chaos caused by the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, you were even more certain of this point. Now, you’re awakened by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Seeing that you’ve understood these principles, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was very satisfied and warned you solemnly, ‘Whether on the right path or demon path, they are just different ways to step onto the Immortal Path. However, you must remember, never go down the road of Evil Tao. Evil Tao is too brutal, their cultivation ideology is to refine all living beings, which is not tolerated by Heaven and Earth. Although they grow at an astonishing speed, they are detested by Heaven and Earth and will face calamity. In the future, when you encounter evil cultivators, feel free to kill them, for they are a scourge.]

chapters.title: Chapter 772: 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 772: Chapter 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _2
[A sense of solemnity fills your heart and you nod seriously. In the past, you always equated the Demonic Path with the Evil Path. Now it seems that the two are not the same thing at all. The cultivators you used to think were Demonic Path Cultivators cannot be called that; they should be called Evil Cultivators, using the refinement and absorption of living beings as a means of improving their cultivation.]
[Soon, you think of Lin Qinghe’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body, and considering its special nature, you wonder if it would be regarded as evil by others.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shakes his head. Although the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is terrifying, it only refines and absorbs the origins of the strong and heaven’s chosen, not ordinary living beings, so it does not belong to Evil Cultivators. However, because of its special nature, it is dreaded by countless cultivators, who are especially targeted towards it.]
[As a result, once the Devouring Immortal Demon Body emerges, it will be hunted down by countless cultivators until it is completely killed. This is because these cultivators are afraid that the Devouring Immortal Demon Body will attack them and devour their origins.]
[Hearing this, you have some speculation and curiously ask the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, was the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body forced on this path, becoming the enemy of the Upper Realm in the process of being hunted down crazily and for self-preservation, devouring cultivators’ origins, and eventually becoming an enemy that the Upper Realm cultivators could not tolerate?]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor nods his head and then shakes his head, implying that this is both true and false. This surprises you.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed lightly, saying that the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body was indeed forced on the path of devouring cultivator’s origins, but if you say she became the enemy of the Upper Realm and was rejected by the Upper Realm cultivators, that would not be the case.]
[In the Cultivation Path, one should mainly focus on oneself. The growth rate of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is extremely fast, and after reaching a certain cultivation improvement, the threat it poses to ordinary cultivators is not significant, even virtually non-existent. This is because their origins aren’t of much use to the Devouring Immortal Demon Body. The Upper Realm is ultimately dominated by ordinary cultivators, and you think those ordinary cultivators would target the Devouring Immortal Demon Body for the so-called greater good? Those who target the Devouring Immortal Demon Body tend to be limited to a certain region and stage.]
[Listening to the words of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you ponder carefully. Indeed, if the Devouring Immortal Demon Body were to appear in the Divine Realm, the cultivators in that region would panic and fear, wanting to eliminate it in advance. For example, you initially wanted to lead the Tao Palace to the Whiteflame Divine Sect to kill Lin Qinghe. But would powerful cultivators of the Immortal Continent make a special trip to the remote areas of the Elemental Star just to target her? Probably not.]
[Those cultivators who are not threatened have no need to take such risks. After all, if they fail to kill the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, they will undoubtedly die once it grows. Those who target the Devouring Immortal Demon Body either feel threatened themselves or covet its origin, so they besiege and intercept it. This treatment is similar to what he experienced as an Incomplete Version of the Space-Time Dao Body, with no significant difference.]
[So, what the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said is all true. The Devouring Immortal Demon Body becoming the enemy of the Upper Realm is an impossible thing. That is to say, there must be some hidden truths, just like the Burning Emperor, where either the rumors are wrong, or someone is deliberately guiding them.]
[Seeing you deep in thought, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor then tells you all about the experience of the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body. The previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body never killed innocents, but an Imperial-tier force wanted to possess her, so they attacked her. Facing the Imperial-tier force, her family was completely powerless to resist and was wiped out in an instant.]
[However, the family of the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body was once strong, and they had some connections with some powerful individuals. As a result, a quas-emperor intervened, fought off the powerful enemies, and saved her.]
[Hearing the words of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you suddenly think of the white-cloaked quasi-emperor who deterred the Bone Emperor. You can’t help but speculate that the identity of the white-cloaked quasi-emperor was the one who rescued the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body. No wonder he saved you and Lin Qinghe in that simulation; the relationship with the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body was deeper than you had imagined.]
[Out of curiosity, you ask who the quasi-emperor who saved the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body is, and what he looks like. Seeing your inquiry, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has no intention of concealing and directly shows the appearance of the quasi-emperor, while also telling you that he is Emperor Bai Chen, an extremely powerful quasi-emperor, unmatched among quasi-emperors. It is a pity, however, that his Tao Heart has a flaw. He had a chance to prove to be Emperor of Tao Proving, but now he is stuck at the Quasi-Emperor tier.]
[Hearing the somewhat regretful tone of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, your heart is shaken. This is because the white-cloaked quasi-emperor is indeed the one you saw that day. No wonder Bone Emperor was so afraid of him, choosing to retreat without a fight, as he is so powerful that even your master, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, holds him in such high regard.]
[Feeling shaken, you can’t help but wonder if the Elder Emperor was an Imperial-tier force targeting the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body, but she could survive unharmed because the Da Bai Chen came to her protection, which allowed her to grow under the flames of hatred. After the previous generation Devouring Immortal Demon Body had grown, she attacked the Elder Emperor and finally killed him, taking her revenge?]

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 773: Chapter 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _3
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor chuckled lightly, admitting that you were indeed very clever and that the truth was exactly as you said. It is not because the Elder Emperor personally took action to suppress the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body as a calamity, as rumored in the outer world, but instead, he was killed in retaliation.]
[In the end, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor paused again, his eyes deep and mysterious, expressing that the death of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was indeed something that all the major forces were happy to see. Because a Swallowing Immortal Demon Body that had grown to that extent would no longer be feared by cultivators below the level of Quasi-Emperor, as their origins would now be useless, and it would be the Emperors who would be under threat. Although the Emperors didn’t fear the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, the death of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was more beneficial to them than the living ones.]
[Listening to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, you remained silent. It seemed that the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body killed the Elder Emperor and took revenge to the extreme, only to be killed by the young Emperor for this reason.]
[Although the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was not despised by Upper Realm cultivators and was not considered an enemy of the Upper Realm, the situation was not as good as you had imagined. With this in mind, your master Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s imposing air was even greater than you thought.]
[What your master meant was that the majority of ordinary cultivators did not actually care about the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. In their hearts, the threat posed by the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was similar to the one posed by those lofty cultivators; they may be killed by a casual strike if they had a bad mood or become collateral damage due to powerful battles, leading to their death. Therefore, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was not considered the enemy of the Upper Realm.]
[However, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was more feared and dreaded by those major powers and formidable cultivators. Hence, adopting the current generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body would surely bring great external pressure, making Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s initial domineering remark even more weighty.]
[As you contemplated many thoughts in your mind, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed again, stating it was because the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was killed by Emperor Fengxin that resulted in a problem in Emperor Bai Chen’s Tao Heart, making it impossible for him to step into the realm of the Emperor of Tao Proving in this life.]
[Hearing this, your gaze turned somewhat subtle. According to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s description, the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body should have been Emperor Bai Chen’s disciple. However, would a disciple’s death affect a master’s Tao Heart? Should it have affected it to this extent?]
[Regarding this matter, you were quite suspicious that there might be some hidden secrets between the two, perhaps even with a hint of master-disciple romance. For a moment, your gossip-loving soul burnt fiercely, thinking it was necessary to find an opportunity to inquire about the remnant souls of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]
[Following that, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor didn’t say much else, only advising you not to worry too much about Lin Qinghe’s situation. As long as she didn’t fall into Evil Tao or accidently died in some forbidden lands or secret realms, no one would dare to target her. Whoever dared to target his, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s, disciple, he would go and teach them a lesson on a physical level.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words made you smile knowingly, once again admiring his domineering and protective nature towards his disciple.]
[Afterwards, you and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor chatted about a few more things, and after he urged you on several matters, he let you leave.]
…
“Surprisingly safe, I should say it’s too safe.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the text simulation, his heart not very calm.
It seems that he no longer needs to worry about anything in the future; as long as he doesn’t bring in a disciple who is intolerable by Heaven and Earth, he can bring them to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“I just don’t know if the Taiyi Imperial Palace will accept me when I reach the Great Saint tier. When I reach the Supreme tier, can this master-disciple relationship last?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ponder this question.
“Maybe, I can consider joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace in the real world and try to become an apprentice to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. If I delay further, and my cultivation improves, whether I can still join the Taiyi Imperial Palace and become the son of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor becomes a problem.”
“Moreover, joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace in the real world would also help avoid many dangers. Even if there are some dangers from the All Heavens that I can’t simulate, I’ll have Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to handle them… In that case, my situation would undoubtedly be much safer.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and the more he thought about it, the more feasible it seemed.
He had always been worried about various matters before, so he was unwilling to expose himself to the sight of those powerful cultivators in the real world.
Now, having gotten to know Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s nature, he seemed to have no need for such concerns anymore.
“I can go. However, I should also prepare for the worst.”
Wang Ping made up his mind, intending to go to the Taiyi Imperial Palace after this simulation ended, join the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and become an apprentice to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
“By then, I’ll bring Cai Yonglong, Ye Xiaofan, Qin Tian, Zhang Hu, and Lin Yuanyuan with me. As for Ye Chen, it would be better for him to continue being a Waste Material Stream Luck Child. He will grow faster on his own path than if he joined a major power and lived an easy life.”
Wang Ping’s gaze turned somewhat subtle, unsure of how to criticize it.
But, wouldn’t the number of people he brought be too many?
As Wang Ping pondered incoherently, the text continued to appear on the luminescent screen.
[Next, you began your cultivation. Because both of your Time-Space Laws had been cultivated to the perfect level, you had no intention of entering the Taiyi Emperor Tower for cultivation and enlightenment. Therefore, you chose to hone yourself in the special secret realm of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, engaging in extreme battles, comprehending Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, and deepening your understanding.]

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 774: Chapter 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _4
[While you were practicing hard, the outer world was shaken by your defeat of Yu Daohong, making you the First Emperor’s Son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Your ranking on the Saint King Ranking also soared to the fifth place, taking over Yu Daohong’s position.]
[In the blink of an eye, thirty years passed, and you chose to come out of seclusion. After leaving seclusion, you went straight to a Demonic Beast Mountain Range in the Immortal Continent.]
[A month later, a shocking vision appeared, and a large expanse of sky turned blood red. This attracted the attention of numerous monster beasts and cultivators nearby, all of them bewildered.]
[Then, countless monster beasts and cultivators began to converge towards where the vision appeared, wanting to seize the Heaven and Earth treasures. After all, whenever a vision appeared, it often meant there were amazing Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, and it would be too much of a pity to miss out on them.]
[While these living beings were on the move, you had been lying in wait there, witnessing the birth of a creature. It was a baby with blood-red horns on its head and blood-red wings on its back.]
[This baby was the genius you had been waiting for. She was not of the Human Race but belonged to the Demon Race. She had no parents and seemed to have been born from the demonic energy of this monster beast mountain range, belonging to the Innate Demon Clan with a Heavenly Demon Blood Body. As a result, her talent was extremely terrifying, and she had the potential to step into the top 30 of the Saint King Ranking.]
[In the previous simulation, the Heavenly Demon Blood Body was born too late, just like Huang Yin and Huang Qing, and there was some gap in the time of cultivation with those monsters. Otherwise, it would have been easy for her to squeeze into the top 30 of the Saint King Ranking. As for Huang Qing and Huang Yin, they probably had the potential to be in the top 15 or even top 10.]
[Next, you approached the baby, picked her up with a warm expression, and intended to take her back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace to raise her and then take her as your apprent‌ice to break through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[Your Dao Protector also looked at the Heavenly Demon Blood Baby with astonishment, not knowing how you knew that such a gifted Innate Demon Clan would be born here. However, you were Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s personal disciple, and although he was Supreme, he dared not question these things before you initiated an explanation, so he kept silent.]
[Then, you were about to leave with the Heavenly Demon Blood Baby, but before you could, a large amount of spatial fluctuation appeared, and several formidable figures appeared before you.]
[Among these powerful figures were Great Saints, Half-step Supremes, and Supremes, and they belonged to different races. Seeing the Heavenly Demon Blood Baby, they initially showed instinctive fanaticism in their eyes.]
[However, they quickly saw your and your Dao Protector’s presence, their expressions changed slightly, and they hurriedly retracted their gaze and demeanor, showing considerable respect for you, claiming that they were just passing by.]
[Seeing even Supremes being so humble, you couldn’t help but shake your head. In the past, Supremes were so mysterious and powerful. However, in front of you today, they didn’t amount to much. You were the personal disciple of the Great Emperor, ranked fifth in the Saint King Ranking and regarded as one to become a Quasi-Emperor with the potential to prove yourself as the Emperor of Tao Proving. You were not an existence that Supremes could provoke.]
[Next, you didn’t have any intention of making things difficult for this group of people and let them leave hastily. Seeing this, these powerful figures heaved a sigh of relief and immediately bade farewell, quickly leaving the place.]
[Afterward, you instructed your Supreme Dao Protector to carry out spatial transmission to return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Before long, you returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[However, you found that your master, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, seemed to have left and wasn’t in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. But you didn’t particularly mind this. After all, once you reach the Great Emperor Tier, it’s impossible to always stay in one place for bitter cultivation. You’ll regularly explore some forbidden places and great secrets, both to further improve yourself and for the sake of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In the following time, you took great care of the Heavenly Demon Blood Body and even gave her a name – Wang Xiaoyao. As Wang Xiaoyao’s intelligence was fully awakened and she learned various knowledge, you finally took her as your apprent‌ice.]
[In the end, Wang Xiaoyao became apprenticed to you. As a result, your cultivation had a tremendous increase, breaking through the bottleneck and reaching the Great Saint Tier.]
[Seeing this, you were delighted and began to cross the Great Saint Tribulation. When you were crossing the tribulation, the entire Taiyi Imperial Palace was in an uproar. They never expected you to cross the Great Saint Tribulation so soon.]
[After all, as far as they were concerned, the geniuses of your generation, like Ku Xuan and Shi Yuyan, were stuck at the Half-step Great Saint Tier and would probably need another two or three hundred years to break through to the Great Saint Tier. They never expected you to break through to the Great Saint Tier first.]
[However, the old monsters of the Taiyi Imperial Palace were soon filled with joy. After all, you took the initiative to break through to the Great Saint Tier before Ku Xuan and others, seizing an advantage. Perhaps you could use your cultivation to defeat them once, thereby seizing some of their luck.]
[Upon seeing you crossing the tribulation, Bai Yu Daohong had mixed feelings, not expecting you to cross the tribulation so soon and become a Great Saint, leaving him behind, unable to catch up. After all, for a genius, even a small realm difference could make a huge difference in combat power, let alone the difference between a Half-step Great Saint and a Great Saint. The gap in combat power brought about by such a significant difference in realms was like an insurmountable chasm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 775: Chapter 220: Swallowing Immortal Cause and Effect! Breaking through the Great Saint! _5
[Next, the old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace made their moves, concealing the unusual phenomena and heavenly secrets to prevent outsiders from detecting them. Then, you engaged in a fierce battle with the Heavenly Tribulation. In the end, you successfully survived the tribulation and broke through to the Great Saint Tier.]
[However, although you broke through to the Great Saint Tier and your strength greatly increased, you felt a sense of imperfection that made you frown.]
[For a genius like you, every Crossing Tribulation is risky but also a great opportunity. You can use the power of the Heavenly Tribulation to strengthen your origin. The stronger the tribulation, the more gifts you will receive from the Heavenly Tao.]
[Although the intensity of your tribulation was astonishing, it was undoubtedly not as strong as when you initially achieved the Perfect Space-Time Tao Body. That is, it did not reach the level of the Young Emperor. As a result, the benefits you gained were not as great.]
[This made you feel somewhat helpless. You think that you might have been a bit impatient. If you had waited for the Jee Family’s Secret Realm to open, obtain the Temporal Origin, achieve the Perfect Space-Time Tao Body, and then break through to the Great Saint Tier, you would have gained the greatest benefits, become more powerful, and have a brighter future.]
[However, although you felt regretful, you didn’t care too much about it. After all, this was just a simulation, and you had many more chances to try and make mistakes, so there was no need to be too upset.]
[Next, you closed off your aura, cultivated in seclusion, and stabilized your realm.]
…
“The Heavenly Demon Blood Body is indeed powerful. As expected, only taking a talented disciple like this could help me break through the Great Realm. Ordinary geniuses simply can’t do it.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and thought to himself.
Geniuses with the potential of the Saint King Ranking are the best when breaking through the bottleneck of the Great Realm by taking disciples.
If you take disciples at ordinary times, you will only increase a few minor realms. Although it’s also astonishing, it’s ultimately not as good as it could be.
“However, once I reach the Great Saint Tier, I don’t know if taking ordinary genius disciples will still have any effect. I guess…it’s doubtful.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought silently.
Wang Ping knew that, the higher he went, the lower the effect of low-level talents and resources would be in his cultivation.
Therefore, at the Great Saint Tier, he felt that the possibility of increasing his cultivation by taking ordinary disciples was quite low.
Even if they could increase his cultivation, he would probably need a huge number of disciples.
To increase by one minor realm would require taking ten thousand ordinary geniuses who were qualified to be saints as disciples.
