In that case, the cost-effectiveness would not be as good as taking Saint King List geniuses and Quasi-Saint List geniuses as disciples.
“However, the problem is that there are too few geniuses on the Quasi-Saint List and the Saint King List. Or rather, too few wild ones.”
Wang Ping thought with a headache.
If it really doesn’t work, he might have to take a large number of disciples.
However, as the First Emperor’s Son of Taiyi Imperial Palace and the direct disciple of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, he felt that spending his days not cultivating diligently and constantly taking ‘average talent’ disciples would be degrading and would embarrass his master Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts raced through his mind, the text on the luminescent screen continued to appear.
[In the blink of an eye, ten years passed. You completely stabilized your cultivation and chose to end your seclusion. After leaving seclusion, you discovered that Lin Qinghe, Wan Yu, and Wang Xiaoyao have all grown significantly.]
[Now, Wan Yu has truly awakened his Black Abyss Demon Body, and his cultivation has reached the God Monarch Realm Tier. In just over forty years, he has grown from a mortal to the peak of the God King Realm, an undeniably strong achievement.]
[Wang Xiaoyao is not far behind, having reached the Void Divine Realm Tier. In a little over ten years, she has grown to the level of Void lord, which is testament to her extraordinary talent. It’s a pity that Wang Xiaoyao is naturally mischievous and not fond of cultivating, otherwise, her cultivating speed might be even faster than Wan Yu’s.]
[As for Lin Qinghe, her growth rate is the most terrifying, having reached the Saint King Great Perfection Tier. All she needs to do is devour the origins of powerful beings in order to rapidly become stronger. In a place like Taiyi Imperial Palace, there is no shortage of powerful beings serving their sentence.]
[Some of these powerful beings have committed heinous crimes and were captured alive by Taiyi Imperial Palace’s powerhouses, who then threw them into the heavenly prison. Some are cultivators from opposing forces, and some are Taiyi Imperial Palace’s cultivators who have violated taboos.]
[Of course, although the Taiyi Imperial Palace can provide her with many powerful beings, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not allow her to indiscriminately devour the origins of these powerful beings to rapidly increase her cultivation.]
[The proper development of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is not to devour powerful beings to rapidly increase cultivation, but to devour their origins to strengthen one’s own origin, refining a more powerful and diverse physique, and greatly enhancing one’s foundation. That way, future combat power would be stronger, and achievements would be higher.]
[Otherwise, if it is just about increasing cultivation, it would create a strong dependency. Perhaps with the aid of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, one could quickly reach the Quasi-Emperor Tier, and even the Great Emperor Tier. But at the Great Emperor Tier, attempting to devour other Great Emperors would be delusional.]
[If you rely on the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to quickly grow, your battle power in the same realm would not be considered strong. In fact, you could be called a weakling, and daring to challenge other Great Emperors would only lead to being killed by them.]
[Not to mention, if Lin Qinghe really loses her bottom line and unreasonably attacks other Great Emperors, even if other Great Emperors do not make a move, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor will clean house himself. He can protect Lin Qinghe. Who dares to make a move, he will go to settle the score. But this does not mean he will indulge Lin Qinghe’s whims unconditionally. Some taboo matters must not be done, otherwise, they will incur public wrath.]
[Of course, if other Great Emperors make the first move against Lin Qinghe, the situation would be different.]
[In addition, the most important point is that quickly becoming a Great Emperor is not the goal for people like them on the Cultivation Path. The most important thing is to ascend. With that method of improving cultivation, it is absolutely impossible to ascend.]

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 221: Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soaring!
chapters.content:
Chapter 776: Chapter 221: Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soaring!
[In the blink of an eye, several decades have passed, and the Immortal Continent has become increasingly lively. You quietly continue your cultivation, waiting for the right time to challenge Ku Xuan.]
[Soon after, Ji Bingyan sends a letter, and you go to the Jee family. When the Wang Family discovers that you, the first Emperor’s Son of Taiyi Emperor Palace, decided to assist the Jee family instead, they are terrified and lose their will to fight, choosing to surrender directly.]
[Because of this, you smoothly enter the secret realm. Although you have already broken through to the Great Saint Tier, you still bring Cai Yonglong with you to be on the safe side and provide him with an opportunity.]
[Soon, you dive deep into the Cold Pool and encounter Heavenly Ice. This time, you have no fear and directly attack the Heavenly Ice. As it senses your threat, the Heavenly Ice unleashes a terrifying cold aura, attempting to freeze you.]
[Facing the cold aura of the Heavenly Ice, you coldly smile and effortlessly dissolve it. As for now, Heavenly Ice is nothing to you. Next, you begin to try to subdue the Heavenly Ice.]
[Though the Heavenly Ice violently resists, causing you some headache, you eventually suppress and seal it, storing it in your inner world, ready to absorb it later or exchange it with the Jee family or an ice-aligned expert for some benefits.]
[After all, the Heavenly Ice doesn’t have much use for you. With your impending Perfect Space-Time Tao Body, the Heavenly Ice, which only allows you Heavenly Ice Body on par with a Sacred Body, is rather useless in increasing your combat power.]
[As a result, trading it away is undoubtedly the best choice. As for giving it to Ji Bingyan, you don’t owe her anything, and you can’t bear to part with something so precious. Perhaps only when you become extraordinarily powerful in the future will you consider doing something for her. For now, your priority is yourself.]
[Next, you go deeper into the Cold Pool to find the Temporal Origin and take control of it. However, you don’t have any intention of refining it here; you plan to return to the Taiyi Emperor Palace first.]
[Because once you refine the Temporal Origin again, you’ll inevitably face Crossing Tribulation. By that time, you won’t be able to hide your Great Saint Cultivation. If you can’t hide it, it would be impossible to show off freely while challenging Ku Xuan.]
[Although you don’t go through the tribulation, when the secret realm closes, Cai Yonglong does cross the saint’s tribulation and successfully becomes a Saint. He is delighted and extremely grateful to you. Although he doesn’t know why you chose him to obtain this opportunity instead of Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu, he doesn’t ask and silently remembers your kindness.]
[Afterward, you return to the Taiyi Emperor Palace and begin to absorb the Temporal Origin in its secret area. Finally, you succeed in acquiring the Perfect Space-Time Tao Body and start Crossing Tribulation.]
[The terrifying Heavenly Tribulation appears, even more frightening than the previous simulation. After all, you have now reached the Great Saint Tier, much stronger than before. However, you have no fear and even hope for the Heavenly Tribulation to be more powerful.]
[While you Cross Tribulation, the many old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace are alarmed, expressing shock upon witnessing such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. Soon, they see the clues and learn that you have acquired the Temporal Origin and formed the Perfect Space-Time Tao Body.]
[This makes these old monsters even more amazed, followed by great joy. You, now, truly deserve the title of Young Emperor and have the potential to surpass Ku Xuan and compete for the opportunity to become an immortal in the future.]
[Finally, you successfully pass the tribulation, perfect your Space-Time Tao Body, and become even stronger. Simultaneously, you use this Heavenly Tribulation to break through a minor realm, reaching the Great Saint 2th Tier.]
[Now, you laugh heartily, full of spirit, feeling that no one among your peers is your match, not even Ku Xuan.]
[At this moment, Yu Daohong comes forward with mixed emotions to congratulate you. In response, you smirk and ask if Yu Daohong would like to become your disciple, so you can help him become an immortal later.]
[Hearing your words, Yu Daohong’s face darkens and tells you to get lost before transforming into a Divine Halo and disappearing.]
[Upon seeing this, you shake your head slightly. This child told you to leave but rolled away himself, which is quite amusing.]
[Next, you plan to consolidate your gains before challenging Ku Xuan and defeating him. Although you think it would be more secure for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to find the Divine Calculation Man to locate the Dark Time Emperor Scripture so you could practice it afterward, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor hasn’t returned from this simulation, leaving you perplexed and with no choice but to give up on that idea.]
[However, you’re not worried. If you could still be defeated by Ku Xuan in your current state, it would be too disgraceful, and there would be no point in continuing.]
[In the blink of an eye, two months pass. During this time, Wan Yu becomes a Saint, and Wang Xiaoyao reaches the Half-step Saint realm. They choose to travel the Taiyi Sky Road together. In the end, both of them reach the 12th Floor, becoming the new Emperor’s Son and Emperor’s Daughter of Taiyi Emperor Palace.]
This development has the people in Taiyi Emperor Palace sighing in admiration. Your disciples are so fierce, becoming Emperor’s Son and Emperor’s Daughter at such a young age. Among their peers, it’s probable that only you have such Imperial Prince-level Characters as disciples.]

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 777: Chapter 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _2
[As the crowd was in awe, they were oblivious to the fact that Lin Qinghe, in order to avoid causing trouble for the Taiyi Imperial Palace, deliberately kept a low profile and pursued her cultivation diligently. She never intended to take the Taiyi Sky Road and become an Imperial Princess. Otherwise, given Lin Qinghe’s current potential and combat power, her becoming the fourth or even the third prince would be an effortless task.]
[Next, after you consolidated your cultivation, you chose to come out of seclusion and challenge Ku Xuan.]
[This challenge shook the entire Immortal Continent, and many cultivators held anticipation for Ku Xuan’s response and your impending duel.]
[Before long, Ku Xuan accepted your challenge, agreeing to battle with you at the mountain top of Ziyue in half a month. Consequently, a massive number of cultivators began heading to the peak of Ziyue, including those hailing from beyond the Immortal Continent.]
[Under the watchful eyes of thousands, Shi Yuyan was very resentful. She thought you were too arrogant, completely ignoring her and directly challenging Ku Xuan. This was a blatant disregard of her!]
[After all, you were only ranked fifth on the Saint King Ranking, plus you merely possessed an incomplete Time-Space Body. The fact that you were able to defeat Yu Daohong and claim your current position was largely due to your advantage in mastering the dual laws of time and space. Your odds of winning against Shi Yuyan would not be high.]
[Meanwhile, Shi Yuyan was confused as to why the typically aloof Ku Xuan would accept your challenge.]
[Therefore, while you were waiting for Ku Xuan, Shi Yuyan challenged you directly, claiming that if you wished to fight Ku Xuan, you would have to pass her first.]
[You looked at Shi Yuyan, said nothing, and, with Half-step Great Saint Cultivation, you executed the Time-Space Divine Skill. Simultaneously, you utilized the effect of Duet.]
[In the face of your relentless attack, Shi Yuyan simply could not defend and would be defeated instantly on the spot. This shocked her, as she did not expect you to be this formidable. Once again, she felt the sense of powerlessness and despair she experienced during her battle with Ku Xuan.]
[In the end, Shi Yuyan was saved by her Dao Protector, which left her blushing in embarrassment. She never expected to be in such a sorry state, unable to even withstand one of your attacks. Thinking back to her previous words, it was indeed deeply embarrassing.]
[The numerous prodigies were equally shocked, remarking on your strength, and speculating whether you might indeed be capable of challenging Ku Xuan of the Longevity Ku Family. The old monsters were even more astounded that your Time-Space Body had completed its essence, reaching a state of perfection. They all secretly cursed the old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace for having hidden you too deep.]
…
“This woman, she’s just asking for trouble. The present me, how could you compare with me?”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation and murmured to himself.
Well, in consideration of you ranking second on the Saint King Ranking, I won’t hold this against you. Once you’ve grown stronger, I’ll take you as my disciple and ‘teach’ you about cultivation.
As Wang Ping was mumbling to himself, the simulation continued.
[Next, Ku Xuan of the Longevity Ku Family arrived, and you, filled with fighting spirit, immediately launched an attack. Ku Xuan took it calmly. This didn’t surprise you, and instead of using your real cultivation, you decided to start by fighting him at the same level.]
[Facing your full strength, Ku Xuan took things slightly more seriously, bursting forth an astonishing combat power, easily suppressing you. Even if you utilised your Golden Talent: Multiplay, occasionally triggering Duet, you still could not gain the upper hand.]
[This made you marvel at Ku Xuan’s robust strength. The spectating crowd was also stunned by Ku Xuan’s ability, absolutely deserving to be ranked first on the Saint King Ranking. They all felt that your loss in this battle was a foregone conclusion. After all, Ku Xuan clearly had many trump cards he had yet to play.]
[Just when everyone thought you were bound to lose, you finally unleashed your true cultivation. Although you could use the Divine skill Neutralization and Damage Invalid talents to surprise Ku Xuan and achieve a flexible victory, you preferred to keep these two cards in hand, aiming to suppress Ku Xuan with your cultivation for a more satisfying win.]
[As you revealed your true cultivation, everyone was shocked. Whether they were the prodigies or the old monsters, no one expected your cultivation to have reached the Great Saint Tier, and not just freshly broken into the Great Saint Tier, but reached the 2th Tier of Great Saint.]
[Such cultivation, undoubtedly, was unparalleled among your peers. For a moment, everyone felt that Ku Xuan might lose. Although such a loss would not be disgraceful, it would still be a loss. Of course, they did not consider your suppressing Ku Xuan with superior cultivation shameful. After all, among peers, having a higher cultivation was a result of personal cultivation. No rule stated that peers must have equal cultivation to fight.]
[As everyone marvelled, the old monsters of the Taiyi Imperial Palace grinned wickedly, finding amusement in the changing expressions of the other cultivators.]
[Ku Xuan’s expression also changed unexpectedly. He didn’t think that your cultivation had made it to the 2nd tier of the Great Saint. Because of this, he no longer kept any pretenses, detonating his true combat power. Immediately, the phenomena of the heaven and earth appeared, causing numerous cultivators to be shocked.]
[Ku Xuan surprisingly possessed a Dual Emperor Bloodline and had immortal bones not inferior to those with the Great Thunder Immortal Physique. However, despite the shock this elicited, it was still within expectations. After all, the Ku family had always been mystical, with two Emperors coexisting, it was normal for their bloodline to be extraordinary. If Ku Xuan, the heir of the Ku family did not possess such a monstrous talent, it would be strange.]

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: Chapter 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _3
[What shocked many old monsters even more was that the scripture Ku Xuan cultivated was clearly not an Emperor Scripture, but an Immortal Sutra. As Ku Xuan made his move, the sound of the Immortal Sutra echoed, making the world’s anomalies even more terrifying and unleashing an unimaginable power.]
[As for Ku Xuan’s cultivation of the Immortal Sutra, although you were surprised, it was not unexpected. After all, you had speculated about it beforehand, so now it has simply confirmed your guess. You laughed out loud, saying that even if it was an Immortal Sutra, with such a huge gap in cultivation, you could easily break it.]
[In the midst of speaking, you unleashed a terrifying power, simultaneously using the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra and Tao Tian Emperor Scripture, and the Time-Space Divine Skill was deployed to suppress everything.]
[The terrifying divine skills collided, and even though Ku Xuan had cultivated the Immortal Sutra, he was easily suppressed by you, coughing up blood and suffering serious injuries.]
[This result caused sighs from all around. Although the Immortal Sutra was powerful, Ku Xuan, who had only reached the Half-step Great Saint tier, could not comprehend its deeper levels. Even so, it was still powerful enough to unleash terrifying powers. Even if a monster ranked around the 15th place on the Saint King Ranking broke through to the Great Saint tier, it would still be slain by Ku Xuan across levels. However, you were different, as you were ultimately an exceptional genius who far surpassed other monsters, so much so that even Shi Yuyan, who ranked second on the Saint King Ranking, could not withstand a single move from you. Not to mention, your cultivation was not just at the initial stage of the Great Saint tier, but at the Great Saint 2th Tier.]
[For this reason, even if Ku Xuan had cultivated the Immortal Sutra, he could only be easily suppressed by you, with no exceptions. If Ku Xuan wanted to defeat you now, he would have to break through to the Great Saint tier as well. In that case, a small gap in realm wouldn’t matter much to Ku Xuan, who had cultivated the Immortal Sutra.]
[Under the gaze of everyone, Ku Xuan calmly wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and admitted his defeat. However, he did not utter any harsh words and turned to leave directly.]
[This made everyone quite surprised, as they did not expect Ku Xuan to be so calm. You felt the same way, thinking that Ku Xuan’s calmness was excessive, making you feel that he was even more unfathomable and that he might be hiding something else.]
….
“It feels so good to suppress others with my cultivation. No matter what level of genius you are, as long as your talent and foundation don’t surpass mine too much, trying to defeat me across levels is just a dream.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a smile on his face.
How high was Ku Xuan’s image in the previous simulation? It was all about Ku Xuan being number one, with everyone else fighting for second place.
Now, upon breaking through to the Great Saint tier, he easily defeated Ku Xuan without using many techniques.
This was the advantage of a higher cultivation level.
“Sure enough, on the foundation of consolidating my roots, I still need to quickly improve my cultivation as the right path. What’s the point of battling with these geniuses? I am one or two Great Realms ahead of them in terms of cultivation, so they have nothing to fight me with. If I become an Emperor of Tao Proving several years earlier than them, these geniuses will just be valued apprentices in my eyes.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, his mouth curled slightly, muttering to himself and looking forward to the future.
“However, if I want to quickly improve my cultivation, it’s not difficult to achieve it through Rainbow Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger, which can quickly bring my cultivation to the Great Saint Perfect Tier. The difficult part is the Half-step Supreme and Supreme Tier, which not only require genius disciples but also Enlightenment. Without enlightenment, recruiting disciples is useless.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping sighed again.
However, he didn’t need to be anxious. His growth speed was already fast enough, and unless Ku Xuan cheated or the mysterious Longevity Ku Family used some precious resources to train him and forced his growth, it would be extremely difficult for Ku Xuan to catch up to him.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts stirred, the simulation continued.
[Next, you chose to leave and didn’t stay here any longer. Seeing that you and Ku Xuan had both left, the rest of the geniuses no longer wanted to fight. You and Ku Xuan were so strong, if they continued to fight, they would seem too weak and disgraceful.]
[Soon, the news of you breaking through to the Great Saint tier and defeating Ku Xuan, the number one on the Saint King Ranking, spread throughout the Immortal Continent. Although many people still believed that Ku Xuan was the strongest in the same realm, the fact that you defeated Ku Xuan also made you the number one of their generation.]
[Although your title as number one of your generation was built on the advantage of your cultivation level and, once Ku Xuan and the others also break through to the Great Saint tier, your advantage will disappear and you won’t be able to maintain the position, at this point in time, no one can refute your position as number one among your generation.]
[However, due to your breakthrough to the Great Saint tier, your ranking on the Saint King Ranking disappeared, and Yu Daohong returned to the fifth place, making him feel very conflicted.]
[This also provoked many geniuses and made them want to break through to the Great Saint tier as quickly as possible. Otherwise, no matter how powerful their same realm battle power was, if their cultivation was left behind, they would still be crushed, which would be very frustrating.]
[One could say that, because of your intervention, the geniuses on the Saint King Ranking started to make a stir. To be precise, the stir became even greater.]
[As for these issues, you didn’t pay much attention to them. After defeating Ku Xuan, your next move was clear: continue recruiting disciples, rapidly improve your cultivation, and maintain your advantage.]
[In your mind, of course, there would still be the information about the remaining wild genius. However, the situation of this wild genius was rather troublesome, and it would be difficult to find him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 221 Suppressing Gu Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 779: Chapter 221 Suppressing Gu Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _4
[The reason I say this is because he has been self-sealed for a very long time, and during his self-sealed period, the power he belonged to was completely destroyed, and he has been wandering outside ever since.]
[It is said that when he was born, it was already thirty years later. At this point in time, it is impossible for you to know where he has been wandering and where he was born.]
[In addition, his cultivation is already quite high, and when he was born, he already had spiritual cultivation. With your current cultivation, it is still very difficult to take him as an apprentice.]
[However, you don’t care too much about it. Even if you can’t find him and take him as an apprentice in this simulation, as long as you have a good relationship with him, ask him where he was born, and your next move will be much more convenient.]
[In addition, even if you can’t take him as an apprentice next time, as long as your cultivation is improved to the supreme level, it will be easy to take him as an apprentice in the future. There will still be some gains, and you won’t lose out in any way.]
[For this reason, you sent your followers to inquire about the whereabouts of this monster while also targeting the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. After all, in the previous life, she had reached the level of killing an Elder Emperor, and if you could take her as an apprentice, your cultivation would definitely improve greatly.]
[Even though the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body is only a remnant soul now, you still believe that you will have great gains.]
[Knowing the past of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, you begin to coax her, saying that if she sincerely worships you as her master, you can help her be reborn in the future and even regain her memories.]
[Upon hearing your words, the previous generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body’s remnant soul’s expression darkens and tells you to get lost. You don’t mind, knowing that it will take some effort to win this woman over. Although it’s hard for you to take her as an apprentice right now, knowing her specific past, as long as your cultivation improves, let her see the hope, and start from the key points, she will eventually be moved.]
[Next, you plan to continue cultivation in seclusion, intending to further improve your cultivation. However, you soon think of something you have overlooked. Instead of collecting apprentices all over the Big Universe, which would make things difficult for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you can go to the Small Universe.]
[In addition, there is an innate saint in the Profound Universe. Although at this time, the innate saint has long gone, and under the competition between those two quasi-emperors, no one knows whether he is alive or dead, you still think it is necessary to inquire about the intelligence.]
[For this reason, you invite one of the quasi-emperors from the Taiyi Imperial Palace to lead you to the Profound Universe. In response to the request of you, the First Emperor Child, the quasi-emperor from the Taiyi Imperial Palace naturally won’t refuse and gives enough importance.]
[Soon, you are taken by this quasi-emperor to cross the universe and arrive in the Profound Universe.]
[After arriving in the Profound Universe, instead of immediately inquiring about the information, you start collecting apprentices in the Profound Universe.]
[As the Big Universe gradually enters the Golden Age, the Small Universe is no exception. As a result, many self-sealed Heaven’s Chosen Monsters and veteran cultivators have all been born.]
[Therefore, it’s not difficult for you to take the Heaven’s Chosen with saint, Saint King, and Great Saint potential as your apprentices. However, disappointingly, now that you have taken the Heaven’s Chosen with saint potential as apprentices, the gains are really small.]
[According to your estimates, in order to break through from the Great Saint 2th Tier to the Great Saint 3th Tier, you need to have more than 100,000 apprentices with saint potential, who probably won’t even be able to help you cross the small bottleneck from the second tier to the third tier.]
[As for those with Saint King potential, they are indeed stronger than those with saint potential and have more cultivation improvement, but you also need to have thousands of apprentices to break through a small stage.]
[Only by taking apprentices with Great Saint potential can your improvement be much greater. Most likely, you need 100 apprentices to improve a small stage.]
[This makes you fall into deep thought because it is different from the improvement you had before when you were a saint and a Saint King. After analyzing, you come to a conclusion. Now, your cultivation is higher, your talent is much higher than before, your foundation is also much stronger, so you need more people.]
[Considering this, you feel a bit regretful, thinking that trying to quickly improve your cultivation by quantity is a very troublesome task. Although it’s feasible, the cost-effectiveness is really not as good as taking in the true Heaven’s Chosen Monsters as apprentices.]
[Unless you possess a talent that can truly test other people’s talents, can easily scan these people, and then create a major power to take them under your wing, otherwise, the cost-effectiveness of quantity is very low.]
[In addition, you also know that the accompanying quasi-emperor’s face has turned as black as charcoal. After all, whether in the lower realm or the upper realm, taking apprentices is a very serious matter.]
[After you arrived in the Profound Universe, you took various apprentices, including digging up the foundation of others, not just taking some monsters, but also ordinary living beings. This made him unbearable to watch.]
[After all, the impression you give people is like playing around, which completely discredits your First Emperor Child’s status, and it also makes the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor lose face. After all, not everyone has the right to be the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s grand-apprentice.]

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 780: Chapter 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _5
…..
“As expected, it has become like this. Still, the situation is a little bit better than what I expected. Taking common disciples as apprentices, I can still accumulate cultivation, just a little bit less.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, his eyes flashing.
“But, the Ten Great Universes are so vast, there are countless common geniuses with Saintly potential, even without the corresponding talent for selection, efficiency will be slow. Still, you can stack it up with the simulation.”
“Of course, this is just a method when my cultivation is low, the real high efficiency is not to look for one gifted talent after another, or to take disciples to start a sect. The real method is to spread my teachings!”
“When I attain Supreme and Quasi-Emperor, just by spreading my self-created Supreme Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills out there, then setting one condition would easily allow me to lay down and increase my cultivation, slowly accumulating little by little, and occasionally picking up some leaks. After all, although most of the Monsters able to step onto the major lists are from major powers, there are still some within the populace.”
Wang Ping was filled with excitement, his mind racing with new ideas, he thought of methods that even the simulated Wang Ping had not considered.
As long as I set a restriction that anyone who wishes to cultivate this technique must sincerely acknowledge me as their master, then the whole Upper Realm will be set ablaze.
Although Supreme level Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills are not of interest to those major powers, how many cultivators in the Upper Realm are cultivating Supreme Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills?
Supreme Mana is really nothing in the eyes of Imperial Prince-level Characters, but for ordinary cultivators and even those Holy Lands, it is a huge opportunity.
Take the Elemental Star as an example, even the Elemental Star, such a special Ancient Star, apart from the extraordinary Tao Palace, other powers cannot even bring out Great Saint Methods, let alone Supreme Mana.
If there is free Supreme Mana to learn, would they not learn?
Not to mention these forces, even forces with a Supreme in charge would still be tempted.
After all, getting a new Supreme Mana for free, only a fool would refuse.
The most important point is when even ordinary cultivators have begun cultivating Supreme Mana, if they don’t practice it, they will be swept away.
At that point, where would the advantage of the Supreme forces lie?
“Ah, thinking about it this way, if I really spread the technique, I might be thoroughly despised by those major powers. Afterward, it won’t be so easy for disciples and big shots of the major powers to overcome the loose cultivators above their level, and it would also take away the sense of superiority from the disciples and elders of these major powers.”
Thinking of this, Wang Ping’s expression was particularly subtle.
“Forget it, it doesn’t matter. As long as I can benefit from it, the rest is not my concern. Moreover, this is just a simulation, it’s not like I have to do it this way in reality, that would attract too much hatred. At that time, whether the Taiyi Imperial Palace can hold up is a big question.”
Wang Ping shook his head, murmuring softly.
Right away, Wang Ping chose to actively enter an immersive simulation state, intending to try this method in the Profound Universe to see if it works.
Although Wang Ping has only created his Great Saint Methods now, and is still a bit away from creating Supreme Mana, his Great Saint Methods aren’t something ordinary Great Saint Methods can compare to, enough to drive many people mad.
As for why not to spread Emperor Scripture and stuff, Emperor Scripture isn’t something Wang Ping could change if he wanted to, nor could he add restrictions whenever he wants.
Let alone Emperor Scripture, many of the Quasi-Emperor Skills and Supreme Mana of the Taiyi Imperial Palace also have backhands, these are measures set up by the ancestors of the major powers to prevent the leakage of their teachings.
So, if he wants to spread the teachings, he can only rely on himself.
“System, continue fast forward.”
After briefly entering an immersive simulation state and changing the simulation Wang Ping’s rigid awy of taking disciples, Wang Ping entered the text simulation state again.
In an instant, the text continued to emerge.
[When you changed your mind, the Quasi-Emperor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace also reminded you to pay attention to your image and not to take in ordinary geniuses as disciples ubiquitously.]
[Upon hearing this, you laughed, gave your assurance. Then, you did not choose to take disciples everywhere, instead, you intended to retreat and refine your Secret Skill, adding restrictions.]
[Before you went into seclusion, you also asked the Quasi-Emperor and your Supreme Dao-Protector to leave your side. After all, with them there, it is inconvenient for you to do many things, and it easily exposes too many secrets.]
[Seeing that you asked them to leave, the Quasi-Emperor and your Supreme Dao-Protector frowned, they were somewhat unable to understand your thoughts and did not want to leave. As the First Emperor’s son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, if you were to stay in the Profound Universe alone, it would be too dangerous. If anything happens to you, they can’t take responsibility.]
[Seeing that the two were unwilling to leave, you were somewhat troubled and could only let them continue to stay in the Profound Universe. However, you still didn’t let them stay by your side. This way, if anything happens to you, you can seek help from them right away, and they cannot spy on too many of your secrets.]
[In the blink of an eye, several months passed, and you successfully added many restrictions to your self-created Cultivation Skill. Then, you took action and started spreading the teachings in the Ancient Star where you were.]
[When you started spreading teachings in the Ancient Star, many cultivators were surprised and somewhat doubtful. However, when someone sincerely acknowledged you as their master and really got the cultivation method of the Great Saint Method, the news quickly spread. Both the big families and the Holy Lands were overjoyed and began to practice your Great Saint Method in large numbers.]

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Chapter 221 Suppressing Ku Xuan! Cultivation Soars! _6
[Ultimately, you find that with this method, your cultivation begins to grow. Even those old antiques with spiritual cultivation and Saint King cultivation are willing to sincerely become an apprentice for a while.]
[After all, for them, they have not seen you in person, and kneeling in the air to perform the Inviting Teaching Ceremony is not a big deal since no one sees it and it isn’t embarrassing. Not to mention, even if someone sees it, what about it? Such a powerful Great Saint Skill is just too tempting, losing some face is nothing much.]
[You feel your growing cultivation and you are quite satisfied. Although this level is still far from reaching the breakthrough to the Great Saint 3th Tier, this is only an Ancient Star. As the Cultivation Skill quickly spreads in the Profound Small Universe, little accumulates more, and you will sooner or later have great harvests.]
[Soon, you take action again, quickly going to one Ancient Star after another, spreading your Cultivation Skill. In fact, you even feel that your spreading speed is too slow, so you start to hire other cultivators to help you spread the Cultivation Skill.]
[As a result, like a spark starting a prairie fire, your Great Saint Skill begins to quickly spread across the various Ancient Stars, and given time, it will eventually spread to the heart of the Profound Universe.]
[That’s right, although the Profound Universe is much smaller than the Big Universe, it too has a central region.]
[It must be said that compared to the Immortal Continent of the Big Universe, the central regions of the Nine Mini Universes each have their own unique characteristics. To be precise, they represent the nine major attributes: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, and Darkness.]
[The central regions of the Nine Mini Universes are suitable for cultivators with corresponding attributes to practice. Therefore, it can also be said that they are the Holy Lands for cultivators with corresponding attributes, and there are even cultivators from the Big Universe who specifically go to the central regions of the corresponding attribute Small Universes to practice.]
[However, even though you spread your Cultivation Skill, you have no intention of going to the central region of the Profound Universe for the time being. After all, there are quite a few major powers there, and it is not convenient to act, so you prefer to spread it on weaker Ancient Stars to surround the cities from the countryside.]
[In the blink of an eye, a year has passed. Your cultivation improvement is tremendous, directly skyrocketing from the Great Saint 2th Tier to the Great Saint 3th Tier Peak.]
[Just when you thought you would hit a bottleneck and need to accept a high-quality disciple or rely on yourself to break through the bottleneck, your cultivation made another breakthrough, soaring directly from the Great Saint 3th Tier Peak to the Great Saint 5th Tier.]
[This surprised you quite a bit, guessing that you must have accidentally passed the technique onto a talented wild loose cultivator, which led to your cultivation directly leaping two small realms.]
[In the blink of an eye, another three years passed, and your cultivation made another significant improvement, directly promoting from the Great Saint 5th Tier to the Great Saint 6th Tier Peak.]
[However, after reaching the Great Saint 6th Tier Peak, your cultivation hits a wall and does not continue to improve. This makes you ponder and guess that from the Great Saint 6th Tier Peak to the 7th-Tier is also a not-small bottleneck, requiring a talent with a very high aptitude to help you break through the bottleneck.]
[Of course, you’re not simply relying on the luck of passing the technique onto a gifted wild genius again, so you start your retreat to attempt to breakthrough the bottleneck with your own strength.]
[Otherwise, if you always search for a genius to breakthrough, your own cultivation will eventually weaken. Not to mention, the probability of finding one by yourself is very low. After all, the speed at which you search yourself is far slower than transmitting the technique.]
[Both passing the technique and searching yourself are difficult. As a result, relying on yourself is more reliable. With this thought, you temporarily slow down the rate at which you pass on the technique to prevent wasting too many talented resources.]
[In a blink of an eye, almost thirty years passed, and you were frantically working on your retreat. In the end, you successfully relied on your own strength to break through to the Great Saint 7th Tier. As your cultivation breaks through, your combat strength once again soars a great distance, making you feel extremely refreshed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 222: The Disappearance of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor! Tea Party of Enlightenment
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Chapter 222: The Disappearance of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor! Tea Party of Enlightenment
“So this is the Great Saint 7th Tier, it seems my idea was indeed correct.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and was very satisfied with the results of his plan.
“My cultivation has reached the Great Saint 7th Tier, completely surpassing the likes of Ku Xuan, Shi Yuyan, Lei Wanqian and other talented peers. Next, I’ll aim for the Great Saint Ranking. However, the people on the ranking are all monsters, and I cannot contend with them for the time being.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
In this Golden Age, many major powers seemed to have calculated something and sent their most monstrous self-titled Emperor’s sons into the world.
As a result, the Saint Ranking, Saint King Ranking, and Great Saint Ranking were filled with monsters.
Although the most monsters were on the current Saint King Ranking, it was this group that included Wang Ping, Ku Xuan and Lei Wanqian, who stood out among other monsters.
In fact, the monsters on the Saint and Great Saint Rankings were not inferior to those on the Saint King Ranking.
And these people, their cultivation was generally at the Great Saint Perfect Tier, with the top-ranked even reaching the Half-step Supreme level.
With such cultivation, unless his cultivation progressed further, it would be very difficult for him to defeat them.
Just as he could suppress Ku Xuan with his cultivation, other monsters could naturally suppress him with their cultivation as well.
“However, concerning my cultivation, it won’t be long before I reach the Great Saint Perfect Tier with my current rate of improvement. By that time, getting on the Great Saint Ranking will be a piece of cake.”
Wang Ping chuckled lightly.
At that time, Ku Xuan, Shi Yuyan, Lei Wanqian, and other peers would all be silenced by him.
Other cultivators, whether they were talented geniuses or old monsters, would be dumbstruck in awe.
After all, upon reaching the Great Saint Tier, even for monsters like Shi Yuyan, it would take hundreds of years to advance even a minor realm.
As for Wang Ping, in just over a hundred years, he accelerated from the Great Saint 2nd Tier to the Great Saint Perfect Tier, with an incredibly solid foundation, completely unlike someone who relied on medication, which seemed somewhat absurd.
Not to mention the need for time to simmer and digest the medicinal effects, even if he relied on medicines, a digestion process would still be necessary…
In such a short time, it would be extremely difficult to raise one’s cultivation from the Great Saint 2nd Tier to the Great Saint Perfect Tier, basically impossible to achieve.
“Others can’t achieve it, but, who am I, the ultimate overachiever.”
Wang Ping muttered in his heart, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you will continue to pass on the method to others, improving their cultivation. Although at the Great Saint 7th Tier, the rate of cultivation improvement has obviously decreased, some progress can still be made, and you are not too greedy. After all, who would complain about getting stronger while lying down.]
[But, you no longer plan to stay in the Profound Universe, and will allow it to pass on the method freely. Now, you plan to return to the Immortal Continent.]
[After all, at this point in time, the self-titled genius has already emerged, and it’s time for you to brush up on his goodwill and find out where he came from.]
[Next, you will prepare to summon the Quasi-Emperor and Supreme Dao Protector of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[When the Quasi-Emperor and Supreme Dao Protector of Taiyi Imperial Palace arrive, both of them are strong in 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, with unparalleled mental toughness and vast knowledge, they both reveal astonished expressions.]
[After all, they had only left for a short while, and you have already reached the Great Saint 7th Tier. This cultivating speed is simply too outrageous.]
[After the shock, they both burst into laughter, believing that you might be the true protagonist of this Golden Age, with everyone else serving as mere green leaves to complement you. If you maintain this cultivating advantage, one day you may truly ascend to immortality, leading the Taiyi Imperial Palace to Religion Ascension.]
[Upon hearing their laughter, your face twitches slightly, feeling somewhat melancholic, as if these two predecessors are setting flags for you, foreseeing all your achievements will come to nothing and that your downfall is imminent.]
[Next, the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace takes you back to the Immortal Continent. Upon your return, you were noticed by someone with ulterior motives.]
[However, as you have a secret treasure given by the palace to conceal your cultivation, no one could see through your true cultivation. As a result, your outward appearance still remains at the Great Saint 2nd Tier.]
[Soon, you returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Upon your return, you noticed, with a sense of uncertainty, that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has not yet returned. It was very strange since such a thing has never happened in your previous simulations.]
[This made an inexplicable sense of unease rise in your heart, so you started asking Yu Daohong if he knew where his father, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, had gone.]
[In response to your inquiry, Yu Daohong shook his head, indicating that he didn’t know, which greatly disappointed you.]
[Yu Daohong, puzzled, asked you why you wanted to know his father’s whereabouts. You didn’t tell the truth, feeling it would be ridiculous to voice your concern for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s safety.]
[Next, you planned to leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace and search for the Self-titled Genius: Bu Jinghuan. However, just as you were about to depart, Yu Daohong stopped you, saying he wanted to have a battle with you.]
[At this, you were quite surprised, feeling that Yu Daohong was masochistic, as it was unlike his personality. However, you had no intention of refusing and prepared for a battle with Yu Daohong.]

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 783: Chapter 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_2
[Soon, a great battle erupted between you two. To your surprise, Yu Daohong had reached the Great Saint realm when you left the Immortal Continent. However, even after breaking through to the Great Saint realm, Yu Daohong was still no match for you and was easily defeated.]
[For this result, Yu Daohong had no feelings, but calmly said, ‘I fought you just to remind you that under the pressure you bring, many geniuses chose to advance to the Great Saint realm ahead of time. If you don’t make progress in these hundred years, you will be surpassed by Ku Xuan and those newly-emerged monsters.’]
[Hearing Yu Daohong’s words, you were quite surprised and felt that this kid had a good personality, reminding you of this matter at the cost of being beaten up.]
[Then, with a light chuckle, you claimed that those who are surpassed by you can only look at your back from afar, until they can’t see you anymore. After finishing these words, you left.]
[Seeing this, Yu Daohong was quite speechless, thinking that you were too pretentious and would get beaten up sooner or later.]
[Afterward, you left Taiyi Imperial Palace to find Bu Jinghuan. After coming to the world, Bu Jinghuan was taken away by another Imperial-tier force, the Universe Imperial Palace, and became an Imperial Prince-level character.]
[As a result, it wouldn’t take much effort for you to find him. All you needed to do was to visit the Universe Imperial Palace directly.]
[Soon after, you arrived at the Universe Imperial Palace. The palace master was quite surprised by your arrival and chose to warmly receive you.]
[When you revealed that you were there to see Bu Jinghuan, the palace master was surprised and puzzled, not understanding why you were looking for Bu Jinghuan.]
[Although Bu Jinghuan had decent talent, he hadn’t grown up yet and was far from your level. However, despite having many doubts in his heart, the palace master did not ask for your reasons and let you meet with Bu Jinghuan.]
[After meeting Bu Jinghuan, you started discussing Tao with him, which made him admire you greatly. After becoming more familiar, you began to ask him some questions. Bu Jinghuan was puzzled by your inquiries, but felt there was no need to hide the past, and decided to tell you. In response, you took note, saying that you had Immortal Fate with Bu Jinghuan and might enter the Immortal Mansion to pursue immortality together in the future.]
[Your words left Bu Jinghuan baffled, not understanding what you were thinking. He could only politely respond. Next, you didn’t intend to stay long in the Universe Imperial Palace. After inviting Bu Jinghuan to visit Taiyi Imperial Palace if he had time, you left.]
[After you left, the palace master of the Universe Imperial Palace appeared and asked Bu Jinghuan some questions. In the end, they couldn’t figure out the purpose of your visit – was it to gain Bu Jinghuan’s support for the upcoming battle for Immortal Fate? It had to be said that this was very possible.]
[After all, these major powers had internal information that the Immortal Mansion would soon open, and the Immortal Gate would open as well. At that time, no one could stand alone, and forming alliances was necessary. However, the palace master couldn’t understand why you would want to gain Bu Jinghuan’s support instead of their First Emperor Child.]
[After leaving the Universe Imperial Palace, you prepared to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace. Next, you planned to seriously pursue Enlightenment. After all, there were three conditions to breaking through to the Half-step Supreme realm. The first was to refine the Supreme Body, transforming the internal world. The second was to change the nature of one’s Mana. The third was to grasp Tao, condensing illusory Tao patterns representing one’s path.]
[The third point was the hardest – Tao patterns transcended the realm of laws and were incredibly powerful, not something laws could match.]
[As for how to break through to the Supreme realm, it would be to condense complete Tao patterns into a Supreme Tao Fruit, gaining the approval of Heavenly Tao, and thus entering the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, acquiring a power far beyond the Saint Realm.]
[Therefore, you planned to pursue Enlightenment and comprehend the illusory Tao patterns first. After all, you were still far from reaching the other two points… When it came to laws, you’d been stuck at the Great Perfection Law for quite some time. Continuing with Enlightenment could take you further.]
[However, this advancement was extremely difficult. Many geniuses on the Saint King Ranking had comprehended the Great Perfection Law when they were at the Half-step Great Saint stage, but by the time they reached the Great Sage Consummation, they still only grasped the Great Perfection Law, unable to make further progress.]
[Tao patterns, which were a preliminary contact with some mighty power of Heavenly Tao, and a preliminary touch of the power of the Supreme tier, were not easy to comprehend. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so many geniuses stuck at the Great Saint realm, unable to advance further.]
[To step into the Half-step Supreme realm, or even the Supreme Realm, both talent and luck were indispensable. Although it was true that for those real monsters, even without sudden Enlightenment through luck, they could still comprehend it given more time, which was a steady approach to cultivation.]
[However, for geniuses at this level, time was the most precious thing. If you fall behind, you’ll be beaten, and Immortal Fate waits for no one. The struggle for Immortal Fate involved not only these unripe geniuses but also the Supremes, Quasi-Emperors, and Emperors who craved Immortal Fate the most – and they would not reason with the younger generation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: Chapter 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_3
[Fate is just around the corner. Unless you’re a part of their power, it doesn’t matter what generation you come from; they’ll suppress you first and ask questions later.]
[So, for the heavenly chosen ones, they must become stronger as quickly as possible. Otherwise, they are easily suppressed by their peers and bullied by older cultivators. They may even miss out on their immortal fate.]
…..
“Other genius talents have to work hard, while I make them work even harder. But I don’t have to, fortunately.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and chuckled.
He had the Life Simulator, so he had much more time than the other heavenly chosen ones and became stronger much faster. He didn’t need to be as desperate as them and feel the same urgency.
Even if he missed an immortal fate opportunity, it would only be in the simulation. He still had countless opportunities.
After all, in reality, he was still far from the appearance of an immortal fate!
As Wang Ping felt a myriad of emotions, the simulation continued.
[Just as you were about to enter closed-door cultivation to gain enlightenment, something unexpected happened. Because your cultivation was constantly improving, you couldn’t enter the state of enlightenment. This made you somewhat depressed, and for the first time, you felt the drawbacks of a pampered cultivation method which you couldn’t turn off.]
[Unfortunately, there’s no way to turn the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples on and off at will. With a sigh, you gave up on the idea of enlightenment.]
[After all, if you suddenly advanced a small realm or even two during the enlightenment process, something could go wrong, and it might even lead you to the demonic path. Interruptions during enlightenment are strictly taboo, let alone your own cultivation making such significant progress.]
[Now, your choices are limited: either practice until you reach the Great Saint 7th Tier Peak and pray that your Cultivation Skill doesn’t spread to a talented wild genius, which would give them the opportunity to become your disciple and allow you to stagnate at this point; or improve your cultivation to reach Great Sage Consummation before even thinking about enlightenment.]
[In your opinion, the former option isn’t very reliable. After all, geniuses capable of helping you break through to the Great Saint 8th Tier bottleneck aren’t rare, and there’s a high probability that one will appear as you pass on your Cultivation Skill. As for reaching Great Sage Consummation, the situation will be different. In your view, even the monsters at the bottom of the three major lists may not meet this condition, which would help you break through this bottleneck.]
[However, even these monstrous disciples need to be found by yourself. Few wild ones roam the world. Even if there are, they are mostly like Wang Xiaoyao and Bu Jinghuan – either born with anomalies, quickly taken away by powerhouses before you can intercept them, or self-titled monsters like Bu Jinghuan who cultivate the Emperor Scripture and wouldn’t bother learning the Great Saint Skill or sincerely becoming an apprentice.]
[As for those who follow the path of mediocrity, yet their future achievements can rival some top talents on the Three Saints List, they are undoubtedly rare. There aren’t even a handful in the entire Upper Realm. Even Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune you know, may not surpass them; it’s still a question.]
[Next, you chose to venture into the world again to find opportunities or try to pick up monstrous disciples.]
[However, as soon as you left Taiyi Imperial Palace, you were blocked. Shi Yuyan appeared in front of you, challenging you. She had also broken through to the Great Saint Realm, not the 1st Tier of Great Saint, but the Great Saint 3rd Tier.]
[This surprised you a bit. It seems Shi Yuyan either gained a massive opportunity or her ancestor provided valuable resources to enhance her, otherwise, such a change wouldn’t be possible.]
[But either way, you didn’t care too much. After all, it’d be strange if scions of major powers couldn’t obtain such resources. As for you, your cultivation already soars fast enough. Otherwise, if you asked the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor or other ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace, they could provide you with valuable resources to help you quickly advance in cultivation.]
[Of course, this would only happen if they believed it wouldn’t damage your foundation and accumulation.]
[At this moment, you chose to refuse Shi Yuyan’s challenge, not wanting to crush her too harshly, because in your eyes, this girl will sooner or later become your disciple so you should be ‘kind.’ Had it not been for your past beating, she wouldn’t have desperately used her clan’s resources to break through to the Great Saint 3rd Tier.]
[The goal of doing so is undoubtedly clear. She wants to defeat you once, regain her dignity, and gain stability in her Tao Heart and inner peace.]
[Seeing you refuse her challenge, Shi Yuyan frowned, asking if you were afraid to fight her.]
[You were speechless in response and revealed only a part of your cultivation. The aura of the Great Sage 6th Tier broke out in an instant, silencing Shi Yuyan, shocked at how you had advanced four small realms in such a short time.]
[You should know that she had used a drop of Sacred Stone Milk, which took ten thousand years to produce in her clan, and had her ancestor help her refine it. Only then could she quickly break through to the Great Saint Realm and rapidly advance to this level over the years.]

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 785: Chapter 222: The Disappearance of Heavenly Emperor Tianyu! Enlightenment Tea Party_4
[Seeing Shi Yuyan silent, you chuckle lightly, indicating that you still want to try one more fight?]
[Hearing this, Shi Yuyan didn’t say anything, and just turned around and left. She originally wanted to learn from you, using her cultivation as an advantage, to try to defeat you once. But the result is that your cultivation is so much higher than hers, there is nothing left to fight for. After all, the same realm was overwhelmed by blood, let alone fights between weaker and stronger cultivators.]
[Seeing Shi Yuyan about to leave, you laugh casually and jokingly say that next time she challenges you, she should remember to bring a wager, such as the loser becoming the winner’s apprentice or something.]
[Hearing this, Shi Yuyan’s expression turned dark, and after glaring at you, she quickly disappeared. And her Dao Protector looked at you with a strange gaze. Even if it’s a joke, you dare to say that you want to accept an Emperor’s daughter as an apprentice, which is really something.]
[Next, Shi Yuyan’s Dao Protector also shook his head and planned to leave.]
[However, at this moment, Shi Yuyan ran back, which surprised you. You teased her, asking if she really wanted to try another fight.]
[Shi Yuyan glared at you unhappily, stating that she came not only to challenge you but also to invite you to the Enlightenment Tea Party in the Immortal Continent.]
[You were quite surprised and couldn’t figure out what the Enlightenment Tea Party was really about. You couldn’t help but ask curiously.]
[In response, Shi Yuyan provided an answer. The Enlightenment Tea Party is a gathering organized by Qin Yue, the first place in the Great Saint Ranking. At this tea party, Qin Yue would offer her family’s most precious Enlightenment Tea to the outstanding geniuses from various regions. It should be noted that the Qin family’s Enlightenment Tea comes from the Enlightenment Ancient Tea Tree, which has miraculous effects and can help people to achieve enlightenment. If one is fortunate enough to enter a special state of realization during the process, it can be of great benefit to cultivation, and may even lead to the comprehension of the mysteries of Tao Patterns.]
[Upon hearing Shi Yuyan’s explanation, you were quite surprised. The Qin family is also a Longevity Clan in the Upper Realm, and there are Emperors of the family. However, the Qin family is not part of the Human Race but a special species called the Celestial Race. Their life spans in the same realm far exceed those of the Human Race, and they are truly a Longevity Emperor Clan.]
[Because of this, they have more time for cultivation, more time for enlightenment, and as a result, the overall Same Realm Battle Power of the living Qin family members is quite strong.]
[Of course, there is no such thing as perfection in this world. The people of the Longevity Qin family have life spans far beyond the Human Race, and while the Same Realm Battle Power is incredible, the difficulty of producing offspring is also much higher than that of the Human Race. As a result, they have the smallest population scale among the Emperor Clans.]
[Right after, you asked Shi Yuyan doubtfully why the daughter of the Qin family, Qin Yue, suddenly decided to hold an Enlightenment Tea Party and offer such a precious Enlightenment Tea to all the outstanding geniuses from various regions.]
[On being asked this question, Shi Yuyan shook her head, claiming that she doesn’t know. However, since it’s a rare opportunity to enjoy the precious Enlightenment Tea, one has to join in the fun. As for whether Qin Yue would harm the multitudes of outstanding geniuses, she would not do it as long as she is not suddenly going crazy.]
[After all, while the Qin family is strong, everyone attending the Enlightenment Tea Party would have a strong background. If any mishap occurs, not only one, but even two Qin families would be destroyed.]
[You thought about it and felt that the Enlightenment Tea Party might be interesting. Therefore, you decided to go with Shi Yuyan. Perhaps you would encounter some interesting things at the Enlightenment Tea Party.]
[Seeing that you promised to go, Shi Yuyan hummed lightly and once again transformed into a Divine Halo, disappearing, without any intention of accompanying you. At this, you had an odd expression on your face, feeling that Shi Yuyan was acting a little tsundere.]
[Next, you decided to take your Dao Protector with you to the Longevity Qin family. When you arrived at the Longevity Qin family, you found a large number of outstanding geniuses had already gathered there.]
[None of these geniuses were simple characters, all of them had been in the Three Great Saint Rankings before. Among them were Lei Wanqian, Erebos Demon Son, and Yu Daohong. However, Ku Xuan didn’t come, which surprised you.]
[Upon your arrival, all these geniuses turned their eyes towards you, trying to figure out what level your combat power is at. It was then that Qin Yue, who sat in the first place, invited you to sit down with a smile on her face.]
[When you looked at Qin Yue, you found out that this woman was indeed not simple. But that was normal. After all, being able to hold onto the first place in the Great Saint Ranking, her bloodline and constitution not counted, her cultivation level had long since reached the half-step Supreme Realm.]
[Such a level of cultivation, not to mention the younger generation, even some old monsters couldn’t compare to her. Perhaps Qin Yue could no longer be considered as part of the younger generation. Once someone reached a half-step Supreme Realm, they would no longer belong to the younger generation, in a sense, even though their age might be small compared to the lifespan of a half-step Supreme Realm.]
[Passing through numerous thoughts in your mind, you smiled and nodded at Qin Yue, the host of the event, and took the seat she guided you to. After sitting down, many people greeted you, and you did not neglect these outstanding geniuses. You responded to everyone one by one, showing proper etiquette.]
[Half a day later, Qin Yue said that almost everyone has arrived, and she announced that the Enlightenment Tea Party was officially starting. With her saying this, some Qin family maids brought the already brewed Enlightenment Ancient Tea to all the gathered geniuses, for them to taste it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 222: The Disappearance of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor! Enlightenment Tea Party_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 786: Chapter 222: The Disappearance of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor! Enlightenment Tea Party_5
[As you sniff the refreshing aroma of the Enlightenment Ancient Tea, you can’t help but admire it, and without any hesitation, you drink it all. As you finish the tea, you find that you are no longer affected by the constant improvement of your cultivation, and instead, you enter a wonderful state that brings you closer to the Dao.]
[Not only you, but other heavenly talents also experience the same. Then, some miraculous phenomena of Enlightenment appear in the sky where these talents are, representing the path they follow. The same goes for you; the phenomenon that emerges for you is a gray whirlpool of time and space.]
[You don’t know how long it has been before you finally break free from this wondrous state, and your thoughts are still hard to calm. This time, you have gained a lot, and although you can’t say that you have comprehended your Illusory Tao Pattern, you have gained some insights and saved yourself a lot of Enlightenment time.]
[As a result, you can’t help but marvel at the extraordinary nature of this Enlightenment Ancient Tea. The Qin family possessing Enlightenment Ancient Tea indeed makes people envious. Although every power has its secrets that make other powers covet, the Enlightening Ancient Tree of the Qin family is undoubtedly the type that most cultivators would envy.]
[It is because of the Enlightenment Ancient Tree that the Qin family prospers. In the path of cultivation, the more one advances, the more important Enlightenment becomes, and an invaluable treasure like the Enlightenment Ancient Tree, which can help people with Enlightenment and continuously produce powerful experts within a power, is considered precious even by Emperors.]
[Unfortunately, the Qin family has a deep background, and no one knows how strong it is. Therefore, even other imperial-tier forces would not easily target the Qin family. To put it accurately, unless an imperial-tier force has touched a reverse scale and there is no room for recovery, these forces would rather avoid an all-out war.]
[That’s because no one knows the hidden strength within such a power. If an enemy inadvertently provokes another Great Emperor or a large number of Quasi-Emperors to jump out, it will truly bring despair.]
[This is not without precedent; there have been all-out wars in the past, and an imperial-tier force chose to wage war on an imperial-tier force that had been dormant for many years, thinking it was easily bullied. As a result, the dormant force produced another sleeping Great Emperor and a large number of Quasi-Emperors. In the end, the imperial-tier force that initiated the war was destroyed and disappeared completely.]
[On top of that, no one knows whether there is a Great Emperor Ancestor from a major power or a secretly advanced Great Emperor Ancestor among the cultivators lurking in the Source of Darkness. In other words, there are too many uncertainties in wars between major powers, and unless it is an unbearable mortal enemy, the option of starting a war is naturally avoided as much as possible.]
[Soon, other heavenly talents recover from their Enlightenment state one after another, praising the power of the Enlightenment Ancient Tea, and their eyes grow hot when looking at Qin Yue. Some even express their intentions to purchase some Enlightenment Ancient Tea Leaves, hoping that Qin Yue will agree.]
[In response to this request, Qin Yue gently refuses, explaining that the Enlightenment Ancient Tea Leaves are extremely valuable, and even her Qin family doesn’t have many stored up.]
[Hearing this, some of the heavenly talents look at her with mischievous eyes, wondering why Qin Yue could still generously give away hundreds of Enlightenment Ancient Tea Leaves to entertain them so lavishly if the Qin family doesn’t have much.]
[Upon seeing these inquiries, Qin Yue smiles and explains that she naturally has something to ask of them when inviting them over. However, since the time isn’t right, before revealing what it is, they can take advantage of their gathering to exchange some unique items or even spar with each other.]
[At Qin Yue’s words, the cultivators present are quite puzzled and can’t figure out what she’s planning. However, since Qin Yue isn’t currently interested in explaining, they don’t press further and begin to engage in unique item transactions.]
[The heavenly talents present are the top talents of the Immortal Continent with extraordinary backgrounds, and each has their own fortunes and opportunities, which is why they can pull out all kinds of strange and unusual things.]
[You are surprised and envious of the things they bring out. You can’t help but feel that while you have gained various opportunities through repeated simulations, these people are simply luckier and more fortunate than you. Although you have defeated many talents and accumulated some luck, raising your own fortune from almost negative to beyond most cultivators, you still can’t compare with these people.]
[Afterward, you start contemplating what valuable item you have to trade with this group. While you have many valuable things on you, most of them can’t be traded. For example, your Life-bound Supreme Device, the Lifesaving Quasi-Emperor Artifact given by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and so on. As for the Divine Source, it’s not that it isn’t worth showing, but it’s not suitable for trading here.]
[In the end, after much consideration, you feel that the only thing you can present is the Heavenly Ice you obtained earlier. The value of the Heavenly Ice is still very high and should be able to trade for some valuable items that are useful to you.]
[With this in mind, you feel more than ever that not trading this item with Ji Bingyan or the Jee family was an absolutely correct choice. If you had traded it away, you would be stuck just gazing at the others in this situation, making it difficult to exchange items with anyone.]
[Subsequently, under the astonished gaze of many heavenly talents, you take out the Heavenly Ice, and a terrifying cold aura emerges but is suppressed by you. At the same time, you inadvertently spot an item in the hands of another cultivator that causes an expression of delight to appear on your face!]

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing.
chapters.content:
Chapter 787: Chapter 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing.
[The cultivator in question is holding what appears to be a broken map – the very last piece of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture. With this piece in your grasp, the map can be made whole, which may trigger a special switch or be greatly beneficial for obtaining the Emperor Scriptures in the future.]
…
“It’s a broken map! That’s quite an unexpected delight!”
Wang Ping looked at the information displayed by the Text Simulation and wore a surprised expression on his face.
He had never expected to find the third piece of the Broken Map again.
But here it was, suddenly appearing before him without any effort on his part – a true surprise.
“It will be easier from here on out; the Dark Time Emperor Scriptures will finally be within my grasp, and there will be no need to ask the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor for help from the Divine Calculation Man of the Immortal Mansion to calculate the Heavenly Secrets. Of course, I have no idea where the current Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is.”
Wang Ping’s eyes twinkled as he muttered to himself, his mind filled with various thoughts, all the while still looking at the luminescent screen.
[You then contacted this cultivator to trade with him. Surprised by your eagerness to trade, he deduced that you likely possess the other Broken Map pieces.]
[After all, without any Broken Maps at hand, one wouldn’t take an interest in the piece, nor would they know what exactly it represents. However, after years of searching for other Broken Map pieces, he hasn’t found any. This time, he wanted to try his luck at the Enlightenment Tea Party – and surprisingly, he came across a Broken Map holder.]
[And so, this 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint Ranking burst out laughing, asserting that he had no intentions of trading any other items. Instead, he proposed a bet – you could wager the other Broken Maps against his, and the winner would take all the pieces.]
[Hearing such a suggestion, those prodigies in attendance were astonished and intrigued, clearly recognizing that the Broken Map was no ordinary item and that it must contain some significant secrets – otherwise, you two wouldn’t be so persistent.]
[However, some of them felt that the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint Ranking was rather shameless – as someone who had made it onto the ranking and reached the peak of Great Saint Consummation, his cultivation was far beyond Wang Ping’s. Even though Wang Ping’s talent was just below Ku Xuan and comparable to the Great Thunder Immortal Physique, it was impossible for him to overcome such a cultivation gap in battle.]
[Not to mention fighting against the ranked prodigies, just facing an ordinary Great Saint Realm Perfectionist would result in certain death due to the massive power gap. The higher the realm, the more significant the gap between fighting powers, making it increasingly difficult to bridge. Therefore, the difference in strength resulting from the varying stages of the Great Saint Realm is almost insurmountable.]
[Upon hearing the suggestion from the 98th genius, you frowned, never expecting him to be so shameless. However, you were confident in your odds of winning a battle against him. After all, with the status of a Great Saint 7th Tier facing off against a Great Saint Consummation, the gap was only three small realm levels. Given your current abilities, overwhelmingly defeating this tail-end prodigy on the Great Saint Ranking shouldn’t be an issue. However, doing so would undoubtedly expose your true strength – something you could no longer conceal.]
[Nonetheless, to get your hands on this Broken Map, you had already made up your mind.]
[Just as you were deep in contemplation, the 98th ranked prodigy provoked you, implying that you didn’t dare to face him. He then proposed to suppress two or three small realms to make it an even match, otherwise, it might seem like he was bullying you.]
[Hearing those words, Shi Yuyan’s gaze became more nuanced. She knew that Wang Ping had reached the Great Saint 6th Tier, so if they fought in a real battle, it wouldn’t matter whether this prodigy suppressed his cultivation or not – the odds of winning would still be unclear. If he did suppress his cultivation, he’d only end up getting beaten. With this in mind, Shi Yuyan looked at him with pity in her eyes.]
[You, upon seeing him using this provocation tactic, laughed and pulled out one of the Broken Maps, declaring that you would fight, and let him decide if he wanted to suppress his cultivation or not.]
[Seeing you accepting his terms, the 98th ranked prodigy also laughed aloud and praised you for being forthright. He then asked Qin Yue to activate a small world for the two of you to fight in.]
[To this, Qin Yue cast a profound glance at you before activating the small world, providing ample space for your battlefield. The other prodigies also became interested, eager to see just how strong you were and what gave you the confidence to challenge the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint Ranking.]
[As for Lei Wanqian with the Great Thunder Immortal Body, he frowned. He had initially planned to find an opportunity to fight you to see who was stronger, but now it seemed like there would be no chance.]
[The battle soon ensued. The 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint Ranking knew he couldn’t underestimate you. Hence, he immediately unleashed his full Great Saint Consummation cultivation without a moment’s hesitation, aiming for a swift victory and completely disregarding suppressing his cultivation – much to the disdain of the other prodigies, who thought him a man who didn’t keep his word.]
[However, the next sequence of events left every prodigy – including Qin Yue – utterly shocked. Confronting the overwhelming attack from the 98th ranked prodigy, you effortlessly activated your Great Saint Realm 7th Tier Peak cultivation, and easily countered his strike.]

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: Chapter 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_2
[This leaves the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint List with a shocked expression, finding it hard to believe that your cultivation has reached the Great Saint Realm 7th Tier Peak. During his surprise, you find an opportunity and begin a fierce attack. The Time-Space Divine Skill is skillfully used in your hands, causing this Great Saint List genius to be quite embarrassed, forcing him to fight with all his strength and not dare to be the least bit careless.]
[As the other geniuses watch you madly beat the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint List, they all fall silent. No one had expected that you would be able to increase your cultivation from the 2nd tier of the Great Saint Realm to the 7th Tier Peak in just over 30 years, with your battle strength approaching the Great Saint List, already qualified to step onto it.]
[Great Thunder Immortal Body Lei Wanqian’s face twitched, silently giving up the idea of fighting you. Despite having a similar physique, you are much stronger, making it hard for him to accept.]
[Shi Yuyan was also speechless, not expecting that the cultivation you had shown in front of her was not your highest cultivation, but instead you had concealed something, making it impossible for people to see through. She even suspected that you were still hiding something. At the same time, she became curious about you.]
[As for Qin Yue, she sighed in her heart, feeling that you might be her biggest competitor for the Immortal Fate in the future.]
