[While everyone struggled to calm down, the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint List was feeling very suffocated and chose to use a terrifying Secret Skill that would kill a thousand enemies but harm himself by eight hundred, trying to suppress you.]
[Faced with this, you sneered and showed no fear, going all-out and activating the Golden Talent: Multiplay. This time, you were very lucky and directly triggered the Triple Symphony. Although, at your level, the effect of Multiplay had weakened somewhat; a double attack would still achieve 100% attack intensity, but once it reached triple, only 80% would remain, and it would decrease incrementally. However, even so, such a terrifying attack was not something the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint List could withstand.]
[As a result, in the final confrontation, you blocked all his escape routes and forced him to take your powerful hit. Then, he was completely defeated by you and severely injured. If you hadn’t held back at the last moment, he would have already perished here.]
[Seeing you easily defeat the 98th ranked prodigy on the Great Saint List, the other geniuses present became more solemn and felt that you posed a great threat. Meanwhile, the defeated prodigy with an ashen face directly gave the Broken Map to you.]
[With that, you took it and smiled slightly. This person kept his promise, and it saved you some trouble.]
[Next, the transaction at the scene continued. Someone was interested in your Heavenly Ice and wanted to trade with you. Thus, you struck a deal and finally exchanged a World-Shocking Treasure Medicine from his hands that could help cultivators refine a Supreme Body. With this thing, you wouldn’t have to rely solely on accepting disciples to improve your cultivation in the future, as it helps you refine a Supreme Body.]
[After everyone’s enthusiastic transaction was completed, Qin Yue finally revealed the purpose of the Enlightenment Tea Party. As it turned out, Qin Yue had discovered a special secret realm. This secret realm was very strange, and to open it, a large amount of genius’ luck was needed; otherwise, no matter what method was used, it could not be opened.]
[This made the geniuses present feel very surprised, as they hadn’t expected such a secret realm. Some people also curiously asked, couldn’t even Emperor Qin forcibly break it open?]
[Qin Yue bitterly smiled and said that if it was possible to forcibly break it open without destroying the secret realm, she wouldn’t have held the Enlightenment Tea Party, inviting many geniuses to enter together; she would have chosen to swallow it all by herself.]
[This made the many geniuses present even more curious, calculating various things. And you too, began to ponder.]
[What you thought was different from others. What you thought about was the Enlightenment Tea Party, which didn’t appear in your memory, and you hadn’t heard of this secret realm. Obviously, this was some kind of butterfly effect.]
[However, it’s unclear how this butterfly effect appeared; could it be because you defeated Ku Xuan ahead of schedule? It seems that in this simulation, the biggest change is this.]
[While you were lost in thought, Qin Yue re-invited those who wished to enter the secret realm to express their intentions.]
[In response, the many geniuses present expressed their intentions one after another, indicating that they could go; and you also came to your senses, choosing to go as well.]
[After all, this kind of secret realm that even the Emperor couldn’t forcibly break open and would destroy itself if forced, must have many opportunities and should not be missed.]
[Seeing that the prodigies on the scene agreed one after another, Qin Yue was not surprised and was very satisfied with the outcome.]
[Next, Qin Yue said that she would take everyone to the location of the secret realm tomorrow, and everyone should rest for the night in the city.]
[Following these words, everyone took their leave one by one, and the gathering dispersed. And you, too, prepared to leave. However, just as you were about to leave, Qin Yue stopped you, hoping to have a private conversation with you.]
[At this, you were quite surprised but didn’t refuse, choosing to talk with Qin Yue in the Elegant Pavilion. Soon, Qin Yue revealed her purpose. Qin Yue hoped to form an alliance with you in the future struggle for Immortal Fate, working together for the Immortal Fate.]

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 789: Chapter 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_3
[Hearing these words, you were quite surprised by Qin Yue’s proposal, and couldn’t help asking why she chose you.]
[Qin Yue smiled slightly and explained that the Golden Age was descending, with countless Heaven’s Chosen Monsters emerging in this era. In the future, no one would be able to manage alone. Moreover, fighting alone was undoubtedly disadvantageous. It would be more efficient to find reliable allies to defeat the remaining competitors together, and then to vie for or distribute Immortal Fate more easily.]
[You weren’t surprised by Qin Yue’s answer, but you asked again why she chose you over other talents like Ku Xuan, Lei Wanqian, and Shi Yuyan.]
[Qin Yue stared at you and slowly said that the Ku family was too mysterious and unpredictable, and Ku Xuan’s talents were exceptional, making her character difficult to grasp. Cooperating with her was like seeking a partnership with a tiger. As for people like Lei Wanqian and Shi Yuyan, although their talents were striking, your cautious behavior was more aligned with Qin Yue’s preferences. Of course, if possible, she would also try her best to win them over, but you were her top priority.]
[Hearing Qin Yue’s words, you appreciated her honest and straightforward style. As a result, you didn’t refuse her proposal to form an alliance. After all, although you didn’t think you’d survive long enough to compete for Immortal Fate in this simulation, forming an alliance with Qin Yue wasn’t a bad idea.]
[Especially considering that you were about to enter the secret realm that Qin Yue discovered, forming an alliance with her meant that your journey would be safer, and the potential rewards would be greater. In other words, forming an alliance now was all gain and no loss, so naturally, there was no reason to refuse.]
[Seeing you agree, Qin Yue was both happy and surprised. After all, the Heaven’s Chosen were usually quite proud and not so easily swayed. She hadn’t expected you to agree so easily.]
[Furthermore, this concerned the issues between the Longevity Qin Family and the Taiyi Imperial Palace. After all, she was the first Imperial Princess of the Longevity Qin Family, and you were the first Emperor’s son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Both of you were future leaders of these major powers. If you formed an alliance, it would have a significant impact on the Immortal Continent.]
[Seeing Qin Yue’s surprise, you smiled faintly and hinted that if the Longevity Qin Family ever faced difficulties, you would try their best to have the Taiyi Imperial Palace come to their aid. If the Taiyi Imperial Palace was in trouble, you hoped that Qin Yue would try to bring help from the Longevity Qin Family.]
…
“Is Simulation Wang Ping setting a trap for Qin Yue?”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, his expression subtle.
In this simulation, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had been absent, and Wang Ping actually had a bad feeling about it.
After all, this was an instance of the Butterfly Effect, and he had established some flags when he was in the Profound Small Universe.
Based on previous experiences, the possibility of something going wrong was still quite high.
Although Wang Ping couldn’t guess what could cause the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to be in trouble, it couldn’t hurt to make some preparations.
Of course, Wang Ping also knew that the likelihood of such an oral promise coming true was very low.
It could only be said that having it was better than not having it.
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the simulation continued.
[Qin Yue didn’t overthink your words and didn’t doubt you. She simply nodded earnestly, giving her promise. With that, you hit it off, drank a toast to solidify the alliance, at least verbally, for now.]
[Soon, night came, and many of the Heaven’s Chosen Monsters contacted their respective power bases. As a result, a large number of experts began to gather, ready to take action at any time. However, they made no attempt to hide their tracks and entered the city openly to avoid any misunderstandings with the Qin family.]
[As for this, the Qin family understood and didn’t say much. After all, this kind of thing was bound to happen.]
[In the blink of an eye, it was the next day, and under Qin Yue’s leadership, you headed to the location of the secret realm.]
[What you didn’t expect was that the secret realm was located in the White Fog Forbidden Area. This was where Huang Yin, Huang Qing, and a group of hidden Quasi-Emperors resided. It was a place where even average Quasi-Emperors could easily perish.]
[However, although you were surprised, you didn’t think much about it. After all, you didn’t know much about the White Fog Forbidden Area. When you first entered Chrysanthemum Village, it was only because of your Golden Talent: Transmission. It was quite normal for the secret realm to be located here.]
[The only curiosity you had was whether the Great Emperor of the Qin family had discovered Chrysanthemum Village and the hidden Quasi-Emperors within it. If they had been discovered, things would get interesting.]
[However, judging by the reaction of the Longevity Qin Family, they probably hadn’t discovered them. Otherwise, there would be some chaos happening that wouldn’t be easy to hide from the major forces.]
[Next, with the Quasi-Emperors of the major forces leading the way, you entered the White Fog Forbidden Area. Although it was extremely dangerous and could cause ordinary Quasi-Emperors to perish, the Quasi-Emperors of the major forces were not simple beings. Their cultivation was profound, and they weren’t the kind of Quasi-Emperors who had just entered the Quasi-Emperor tier; this made your journey smooth.]
[Even on your way in, you didn’t encounter the Fog Beasts unique to the White Fog Forbidden Area attacking your team. Apparently, these notoriously difficult-to-kill Fog Beasts were also bullies, realizing that the experts here were not to be trifled with, and stayed hidden.]

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 790: Chapter 223: Wang Ping is really a Lao Liu! Goodbye Feng Yin and Feng Qing_4
[Just when you and your team entered the White Fog Forbidden Area, the old monsters in Chrysanthemum Village discovered the teams entering the area and were quite unhappy.]
[After all, they were hiding here, not wanting to be discovered. As a result, Emperor Qin entered the Forbidden Area some time ago, and now there are so many Quasi-Emperors coming. If they couldn’t handle them, they would have hated to go out and kill this group of people to prevent them from discovering this place.]
[If this group of guys really found out about Chrysanthemum Village, the trouble would be quite big. After all, they had killed quite a few people from Imperial-tier forces, and while they were infamous, they were also the targets of those forces.]
[If someone discovered them, they would be met with the Emperor’s thunderous revenge.]
[Of course, even if these people found them and attracted the Emperor, they wouldn’t be too panicked, just annoyed that they had to move their nest again. After all, moving nests is a troublesome thing, and finding such a good place in the future would be difficult.]
[In the end, your team and Chrysanthemum Village avoided each other, which let the hiding Quasi-Emperors in the village breathe a sigh of relief.]
[Soon after, Qin Yue brought you to the secret realm deep within the White Fog Forbidden Area. After arriving, you discovered the anomalies of space-time and couldn’t help but study them in silence.]
[While you were studying, Qin Yue smiled lightly, asking the Outstanding Geniuses to use the special Secret Skill she had taught before to draw out the Qi Luck Phenomena and activate the entrance to the Secret Realm.]
[Seeing this, the various Outstanding Geniuses all showed sharp glints in their eyes, using their Secret Skills to draw out the Qi Luck Phenomena. You also used a similar Secret Skill to draw out the Qi Luck Phenomena.]
[However, much to the surprise of the many geniuses and Quasi-Emperors present, the Qi Luck Phenomena you brought forth were very shallow, not even comparable to the other geniuses, let alone Lei Wanqian, Shi Yuyan, and Qin Yue. This made the gazes of the people quite subtle.]
[For the crowd, this was a very strange thing. After all, your talent was so amazing, and as the First Emperor Child of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, your destiny should be connected with the destiny of the palace, so you shouldn’t have such a weak Qi Luck Phenomenon.]
[Contrary to everyone else’s surprised reaction, you were very calm. You knew your own luck had always been lackluster; otherwise, you wouldn’t have been stuck without any opportunities and had to rely on simulation rewards to become stronger.]
[Seeing your calmness, the crowd changed their expressions, especially Shi Yuyan, who remembered that you like to hide some things and wouldn’t use your full strength.]
[For a moment, she sighed at how cunning you were, but she felt the need to learn from you in the future – to remain five or even seven points concealed in everything she does.]
[After giving you a glance, Qin Yue didn’t say much and asked the geniuses to use their Qi Luck Phenomena to stimulate the entrance to the Secret Realm.]
[In response, everyone cooperated seriously. Soon, a strong space-time fluctuation appeared in the Secret Realm. Then, a space-time vortex appeared before everyone’s eyes, causing everyone to show excitement, knowing that they had successfully opened the Secret Realm.]
[Next, Qin Yue looked at everyone, smiled faintly, and said that the Secret Realm has been opened. However, no one knows what it contains. Once they enter, life and death will be up to fate, so if anyone falls, they should not blame her and the Qin family.]
[Hearing Qin Yue’s words, everyone laughed and said they naturally wouldn’t blame her.]
[Seeing this, Qin Yue nodded in satisfaction and decided to let some prisoners imprisoned by the Qin family try the Secret Realm entrance first.]
[Soon, Qin Yue’s followers brought the prisoners into the Secret Realm and confirmed some information. After entering the Secret Realm, those with Great Saint Cultivation or higher would be suppressed. If they forcibly used cultivation higher than Great Saint Cultivation, they would be crushed directly by the rules of the Secret Realm, turned into blood fog, and die completely.]
[In addition, it seemed impossible to use powers beyond the Saint Realm tier inside the Secret Realm, so it was unclear whether Supremes and Quasi-Emperors could enter.]
[As soon as this information came out, the faces of the various geniuses and protégés present changed subtly, especially those who had reached the Great Saint Consummation or were half-step Supremes on the Great Saint Ranking. They furrowed their brows even more. After all, their advantage was their longer cultivation time and huge advantages in cultivation.]
[Now, if they had to suppress their cultivation and combat power to enter, they would have no advantage over the geniuses on the Saint King Ranking, and some might even be at a disadvantage. After all, they weren’t as good as Lei Wanqian and the other freaks within the same realm.]
[In contrast to the others’ discomfort, the geniuses on the Saint King Ranking or those who had recently stepped into the Great Saint Tier, like Lei Wanqian, were secretly delighted, feeling that they might make great gains in this Secret Realm journey.]
[As for you, your mood was quite subtle, feeling that this Secret Realm seemed to be good for the Saint King Realm geniuses. At this point, you even questioned whether it was prepared for a specific Son of Fortune.]
[However, the Secret Realm was located in the White Fog Forbidden Area, and it seemed that no one could follow inside.]
[Just as you were lost in your thoughts, two unexpected people arrived. These two were none other than Huan Qing and Huangyin. Their appearance surprised you and made you wonder if the Secret Realm was prepared specifically for these two girls.]

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 223 Wang Ping is really an old fox! Farewell to Huang Yin and Huang Qing_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: Chapter 223 Wang Ping is really an old fox! Farewell to Huang Yin and Huang Qing_5
[As you look on in surprise, the rest of the Heavenly Geniuses are also greatly astonished, not knowing where Huang Yin and Huang Qing have suddenly emerged from. Although their cultivation level is only at the 5th tier of the Saint King Realm, they give off a unique feeling.]
[As for those Quasi-Emperors, one after another, they are in utter shock, recognizing the true identity of Huang Yin and Huang Qing as Pure-Blooded Phoenixes. This level of talent, even in this Golden Age, is second only to your Time-Space Body, Ku Xuan’s Immortal Bone, and Lei Wanqian’s Great Thunder Immortal Physique. It is superior even to Shi Yuyan’s blood lineage talent.]
[These Quasi-Emperors are somewhat curious about where Huang Yin and Huang Qing sprang from. Has the Phoenix Clan, which migrated to the Endless Fire Domain in the Four Profound Universe, reemerged in this Golden Age and stepped foot on the Immortal Continent once again?]
[In response to everyone’s astonishment, Huang Yin and Huang Qing cheekily greet you, their lively eyes sweep over all of you, and they start to roll up their sleeves, seemingly eager to challenge someone.]
[Seeing this, you can’t help but smile. These two young girls, although older than when you led them away from Chrysanthemum Village in the previous simulation, and with a lower cultivation level, are still as lively and belligerent as ever.]
[Next, under everyone’s weird gazes, Huang Yin and Huang Qing express that you are quite good, and they want to challenge you.]
[Upon hearing this, your expression turns subtle. You didn’t expect both girls to set their sights on you so soon. Is this a continuation of past affections?]
[Filled with emotion, you give a light chuckle, and tell the two if they want to challenge you, give it another ten thousand years. After saying this, you reveal your cultivation level at the peak of the 7th tier of the Great Saint Realm.]
[Seeing that your cultivation level has reached the peak of the 7th tier of the Great Saint Realm, Huang Yin and Huang Qing instantly deflate, blaming each other’s poor judgment in choosing such a strong opponent.]
[Seeing the two blaming each other, the other geniuses’ expressions turn quite strange. As they become more curious and fond of the two girls, the old monsters behind them reveal the girls’ true identities, causing their faces to change in surprise. They didn’t expect the two girls to be Pure-Blooded Phoenixes.]
[If they can win over the Pure-Blooded Phoenixes, or even become their Tao Companions, it would undoubtedly benefit their futures. After all, Pure-Blooded Phoenixes are extremely rare and mating with them can bring immense benefits.]
[With two Pure-Blooded Phoenixes right in front of them, and considering their seemingly simple dispositions, many people are naturally tempted.]
[Sensing the strange atmosphere, Qin Yue steps in to ease the situation, noting that the Secret Realm is already open. Any further delays could cause unforeseen issues. Therefore, she advises Huang Yin and Huang Qing to decide who they wish to challenge after they have entered.]
[Simultaneously, with a smile, Qin Yue tries to rope in Huang Yin and Huang Qing, hoping that the two girls would join her.]
[Seeing Qin Yue try to recruit Huang Yin and Huang Qing, the other Heavenly Geniuses also start to vie over the girls, all with smiles. Only you, stay still.]
[As for Huang Yin and Huang Qing, you know them very well. While they may seem naïve, their Pure-Blooded Phoenix Clan’s natural talent allows them to easily sense ill-will. Moreover, under the guidance of those old monsters, the girls are not so easily fooled.]
[Seeing everyone trying to recruit them, Huang Yin and Huang Qing’s eyes dart around, ultimately settling on you. They choose you as their ally and request to team up with you.]
[At this, you are quite surprised. Even though you felt that the girls would not team up with just anyone and didn’t expect them to choose to team up with you.]
[In addition to your surprise, you send a voice transmission to them, curious as to why they chose to team up with you. They respond that most of these people have bad intentions and ulterior motives. However, your aura is vastly different and brings them comfort, suggesting that you mean no harm.]
[Upon receiving their reply, you can’t help but laugh lightly, feeling that you had underestimated them. Not only can they sense ill-will, but they can also detect goodwill.]
[Next, you decide to accept their request and plan to team up with them. Seeing this, everybody else’s expressions change. You were already an extraordinary figure, and now that you have teamed up with two Pure-Blooded Phoenixes, the possibility of future alliances terrifies them.]
[Especially the 98th Heaven’s Genius, who snorts in discontent. You defeated him, took his Broken Map, and caused him to expend his precious Healing Sacred Medicine to recover. Now, he sees you walking off with the two Pure-Blooded Phoenixes, causing him to seethe with envy and irritation.]
[When Qin Yue sees the two Pure-Blooded Phoenixes choose you, while feeling envious, she also breathes a sigh of relief. You are considered her ally, and having you gain the friendship of the Pure-Blooded Phoenixes is better than having others win their favor.]
[Subsequently, everyone stays silent, choosing to enter the Secret Realm one by one.]

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 224: Terrifying Killing Intent! Generous Rewards!
chapters.content:
792  Chapter 224: Terrifying Killing Intent! Generous Rewards!
"I never thought that the secret realm would be in the White Fog Forbidden Area, and seeing Huang Yin and Huang Qing again is really a surprise."
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation's content and thought to himself.
But it was also unexpected that those old monsters were willing to let Huang Qing and Huang Yin out.
After all, compared to their geniuses, the two of them were still too immature and had not grown up yet.
"Perhaps, those old monsters know something about this secret realm. Either they are confident in the life-saving cards given to Huang Qing and Huang Yin, which can protect their lives in any danger they encounter in the secret realm."
Wang Ping's mind flashed through this idea as he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After self-sealing your cultivation and entering the secret realm, you are teleported to a dense forest. As soon as you are teleported, you feel that the spiritual energy in this secret realm is extremely pure. At the same time, the laws in this world are very clear and easy to comprehend.]
[It can be said that as long as you cultivate in this secret realm, as long as you are not as stupid as a pig, you can basically comprehend the laws. The laws in this world are so clear that they seem to be blatantly placed in front of you, allowing you to copy them as if you were copying homework. If you can't even copy homework, then saying that you are as stupid as a pig is not an exaggeration.]
[You are amazed by the conditions of this world, and you quickly analyze the value of the secret realm. Even if there are no exceedingly precious Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures in this secret realm, just the strange manifestation of the laws here is enough to move imperial-tier forces. It can easily cultivate a large number of Saint Realm cultivators for the major powers.]
[Although Saints are like ants in the eyes of the Supremes, Quasi-Emperors, and Great Emperors, the saying "Many ants can bite an elephant to death" is not an empty talk. As long as the number of Saint Realm cultivators reaches a certain level, they can form a terrifying Great Array, gathering their power together, and even killing Supremes, Quasi-Emperors, and Great Emperors is not impossible.]
[You are very clear that whoever can gain control of this secret realm will truly make a fortune, and can exchange it for extremely precious cultivation resources, which will greatly benefit your future cultivation. This will make the geniuses in the secret realm go crazy, fight life and death, and show no mercy.]
[However, you are fearless and plan to participate in this competition. Though you don't know how to gain control of the secret realm and whether you can control it, it is still necessary to explore.]
[After that, you pick the Divine Medicine and start your action. However, you are soon surrounded by hundreds of beast-clothed cultivators. They hold bone clubs and stare at you fiercely, speaking in a language you don't understand.]
[At this moment, your expression is very serious. It's because you find out that all of these hundreds of cultivators are in the Saint Realm. Among them, more than half are Saints, but there are also as many as a hundred Saint Kings. Even twenty of them have reached the Saint King Great Perfection.]
[Such a lineup is undeniably luxurious. It can be said that even those geniuses who have been on the Saint King Ranking and Great Saint Ranking would definitely suffer a great loss if they meet this team. Only a monster like you can handle them.]
[Of course, if someone like Qin Yue, who is a Half-step Supreme, even after self-sealing her cultivation, could easily suppress them. After all, as a Half-step Supreme, Qin Yue has comprehended Tao Patterns. Even if her cultivation is self-sealed, she can still use the power she comprehended.]
[Just as you are looking serious, these indigenous people of the secret realm seem to have discussed something. They show fierce eyes and attack you. You are well-prepared for this, snorting coldly and directly counterattacking.]
[It has to be said that these Saint Realm natives living in such a unique environment have an astonishing comprehension of laws, even the Saints have more than 70% comprehension of laws, and most of them have perfect laws. This makes their combat power much stronger than ordinary Saint Realm powerhouses outside.]
[Although it is obvious that these indigenous cultivators have only Saint-tier cultivation methods and do not have Emperor-tier cultivation skills or Supreme Mana, the sheer number of them can still cause a terrifying amount of power, which is difficult for people to handle. Even you, when facing so many natives at once, must be cautious.]
[However, after all, you have a perfect Space-Time Tao Body, and your Time-Space Divine Skills are unmatched, and after a fight, you easily find an opportunity to wipe them all out.]
[But after killing the group of natives, you don't let your guard down, start lurking, and plan to investigate the situation first before looking for Huang Yin and Huang Qing. After all, you don't know what is going on with this world and how many such indigenous people there are. If you accidentally run into an indigenous tribe and find that it is full of Saint Realm cultivators and get chased by them, then you will really be a muggle.]
[Though with your time-space divine skill, escape is very easy as long as you are not dealing with a Supreme. Even if you encounter a Supreme, you can escape through the Golden Talent: Transmission. However, escaping in disgrace is ultimately somewhat humiliating and not something you want to see.]

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous rewards! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: Chapter 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous rewards! _2
[While you were acting cautiously, other geniuses also encountered powerful native squads. In a short period of time, talented individuals lost their lives in this secret realm.]
[You have to know, these are not ordinary geniuses. They are all individuals who had ascended the Saint Ranking, Saint King Ranking, or even the Great Saint Ranking. They are all renowned outside and guaranteed to become Tao Proving Quasi-Emperor in the future. Some even had a chance to become the Emperor of Tao Proving.]
[These geniuses are the pride of all major powers, and the loss of one could lead to significant damage, potentially affecting future contests for the Immortal Fate.]
[However, these geniuses have lost multiple lives in a short period, it’s quite horrifying.]
[In the blink of an eye, a day passed. During this day, you made substantial gains and found several divine medicines. You discovered that the secret realm indeed had many divine medicines. Although not as many as the Eternal Ancient Star and the Realm of Life where you were unexpectedly transported to, it still had a lot more than the outer world.]
[However, this place is also genuinely dangerous. In just one day, you encountered several native squads that seemed to be looking for something. None of these natives had cultivation lower than the Saint Realm, making you doubt whether there existed any cultivators below the Saint Realm among them.]
…
“Is this secret realm so terrifying?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, frowning.
Such danger was unlikely, even in a strange secret realm like this one.
Even if such secret realms housed numerous Saint Realm Powerhouses, they couldn’t have caused the demise of so many Three St. Praise Genius in one go.
“The movement of these natives is peculiar.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes.
According to the description of the Text Simulation, it seemed as though they were specifically hunting the talented individuals who had entered from the outside world.
Moreover, didn’t each of these talented individuals have trump cards handed down by their ancestors?
Even if this secret realm was dangerous and could suppress the eruption of power from a Quasi-Emperor Artifact, it shouldn’t be able to stop the appearance of the Emperor’s Incarnation, right?
After all, an Emperor’s Incarnation is extremely powerful.
Although the Emperor couldn’t forcefully break open this secret realm, it was because Emperor Qin didn’t want to destroy it. Otherwise, an Emperor could easily obliterate a secret realm.
Therefore, even if the secret realm was special, it couldn’t prevent the manifestation of the Emperor’s Incarnation.
Once the Emperor’s Incarnation appeared, the fluctuations it would generate would undoubtedly sweep the entire secret realm, making it impossible not to be detected.
After all, an Emperor’s Incarnation’s aura would sweep across many Starfields once it appeared in the outer world, unless there was a way to conceal it, it would undoubtedly be discovered by numerous powerful entities, alarming them.
However, all these talented individuals perished here without a trace of an Emperor’s Incarnation, which was very strange.
“There’s something fishy, very fishy. I feel like there’s a plot behind this secret realm. It’s as if the natives had known in advance that the talented individuals from the outer world would come in, so they switched to hunting mode in advance.”
Wang Ping’s expression kept changing, and various thoughts flashed through his mind.
“Could it be that Qin Yue has calculated all the geniuses present? Does she have the nerve to do that? She can’t possibly do that. She wouldn’t dare to do something that even the Emperor of the Qin family wouldn’t dare to attempt. If it’s not Qin Yue and the Qin family, then who is it? Who’s calculating the Immortal Continent Three Saints’ Genius, trying to wipe them all out at once and then blame it on the Qin family?”
“The clues are too scarce, there’s no way of figuring it out…. It seems like the only way is to collect clues through the simulation. However, since the other party dare to calculate in such a way, they most likely won’t risk exposing themselves.”
“The mastermind behind this is ruthless. They want to wipe out the majority of the future competitors for the Immortal Fate in one fell swoop, don’t they?”
Wang Ping fell silent for a moment, suppressed his thoughts, and then deliberately entered the immersive simulation state. After instilling his ideas into the simulated Wang Ping, he let him take action again.
[Next, you wear a stern expression, abandon your initial plan, and begin searching for Huan Qing and Huang Yin, with the intention of protecting their lives.]
[While you were taking action, Huan Qing and Huang Yin also encountered a formidable enemy. Both of them were too young with weak cultivation and their mana understanding had not reached the tier of Great Perfection. Thus, they were at a great disadvantage in this secret realm.]
[Despite their exceptional potential and continuous progress in mana understanding during the battle, leaning on the terrifying vitality and Nirvana Rebirth ability of the pure-blooded Phoenix, they were barely holding on. But their enemies were too numerous and powerful, making it difficult for the duo to hold on for much longer.]
[After all, there’s a limit to everything, and even a pure-blooded Phoenix cannot escape this rule. Especially since the two of them haven’t truly awakened their bloodline force, and haven’t reached the Emperor’s level of cultivation, they are more likely to reach their limits.]
[When they were on the verge of despair, you finally arrived, demonstrated formidable strength, suppressed these natives one by one, and saved Huan Qing and Huang Yin.]
[Simultaneously, you decided to capture a native of the Saint’s realm alive with the intention to conduct a soul-searching. However, the moment you started the process, the individual exploded and their soul perished.]
[This made your face even more serious and you were certain that there was a mastermind controlling everything behind the scenes. However, you couldn’t guess who this mastermind could be.]

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Chapter 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _3
[At a time when you are struggling to remain calm, Huang Yin and Huang Qing express their gratitude to you for the rescue. You laugh lightly in response, saying that teammates should help each other without the need for such solemn thanks.]
[Hearing this, Huang Qing and Huang Yin smile at you, feeling a strong fondness towards you. Then, they express their frustration at not being able to get rid of these annoying indigenous people. To make matters worse, they can’t use the lifesaving techniques given to them by their master, as if they’ve been sealed. It’s very strange.]
[This doesn’t surprise you, because you’ve also tried activating the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation, but the Emperor’s incarnation wouldn’t appear. However, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has disappeared for more than a hundred years and his incarnation might have disappeared as well, making him an unreliable point of reference.]
[Thus, you continue to move with Huang Qing and Huang Yin, intending to find other talented individuals and confirm the situation.]
[However, as you use your Secret Skill to track down a few places where the talented cultivators’ auras are left behind, the result makes you fall silent. There’s evidence of a huge battle, but the talented individuals are gone, and there are no bodies of the Secret Realm Natives.]
[This can only mean one thing—the battle ended with the victory of the Secret Realm Natives, and the talented individual was beaten to death by them. Otherwise, there is no reason for the talented cultivators to collect the corpses of the natives.]
[Though the bodies of the Saint Realm and Saint King-tier natives would undoubtedly be valuable materials for ordinary Saint Realm Cultivators, they wouldn’t mean much to those on the Three Saints List, as keeping them in their inner worlds would bring bad luck.]
[Let alone, even if there are stingy talented cultivators willing to take them away, it wouldn’t be so clean. Only when the natives collect the bodies of their own kind would the scene look like this, taking them all away together.]
[Seeing you fall silent, Huang Qing and Huang Yin realize that the situation might be worse than they thought, and they inquire about it. You explain the situation and offer your speculations about the mastermind.]
[This news shocks and terrifies both Huang Qing and Huang Yin, who can’t imagine who would dare to possess such power.]
[Next, the two suggest that the three of you should leave the secret realm, expose the situation outside, and call for reinforcements. Otherwise, relying solely on yourselves, you would be in real danger if surrounded by more natives, or trapped in an elaborately designed scheme.]
[You are powerful, but still two fists against four hands. If trapped by the Great Array, you face danger equal to losing your life.]
[Regarding Huang Qing and Huang Yin’s suggestion, you shake your head. You don’t believe you can leave the secret realm now. Since there is likely a mastermind behind this, their goal is to eliminate everyone, leaving only Qin Yue to take the blame.]
[In such a situation, the mastermind would not allow anyone to leave the secret realm ahead of time, so they must have sealed the secret realm, preventing people from entering or leaving.]
[Hearing this, Huang Qing and Huang Yin fall silent. They find your reasoning sound and feel somewhat helpless, not knowing what to do next. After all, they’re still young and inexperienced, and it’s normal to panic in such a situation.]
[Seeing this, you comfort the two, assure them that you must find a way to locate the others, and then join forces. Only then can you turn from prey to predator, confront the native forces of the secret realm, and identify the mastermind behind this.]
[Upon hearing this, Huang Yin and Huang Qing nod in agreement. You soon resume your journey to find the other talented cultivators.]
[In the blink of an eye, three days have passed. During these three days, you’ve been ambushed several times but managed to defuse the attacks and escape through the Time-Space Divine Skill.]
[During this process, you also discover that several people were killed by the natives. However, you managed to save two talented cultivators and formed an alliance with them.]
[Next, you plan to continue your journey, but an extraordinary native appears in front of you with many strong natives, surrounding you. A terrifying Great Array is formed, trapping you inside.]
[This causes your expressions to change. You never expected the natives to have someone capable of leading strong natives, concealing their auras, and approaching you so quietly while setting up an array.]
[As the terrifying power of the Great Array erupts, it far exceeds the power of the Saint King tier. You’re no match for it and are suppressed and killed in the array.]
[However, these natives don’t seem intent on destroying your bodies but instead focus on destroying your Divine Souls.]
[Due to your death, you enter a resurrection countdown state.]
[But even as you undergo the resurrection countdown, the natives show no signs of leaving. After absorbing the bodies, they merely watch the place where you died.]
[After you resurrect and try to resist again, your efforts are futile. The Golden Talent: Transmission is unusable, and you’re killed by the natives once more.]

chapters.title: Chapter 795: 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Chapter 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _4
[Because of your death, this simulation ends here…..]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with insights and images, as his figure appeared in the secret realm, staring at the natives and the still terrifyingly powerful Great Array with a God’s-eye view.
“These natives, are they actually proficient in such exquisite array mana? I should say, it must have been taught by the mastermind behind the scene, just to target someone like me with overwhelming power at the same realm.”
Wang Ping’s face was solemn, and he squinted his eyes, murmuring to himself.
“This time, I couldn’t even find out who the mastermind is, not even a clue, which really infuriates me. But no matter how successful your plan is this time, I will slowly expose you in the subsequent simulations.”
Wang Ping exhaled gently, snorting coldly.
It was too dangerous to let someone who dared to lay out a plan to catch all the arrogant talents in the Immortal Continent who have ever been on the Three Saints List. He absolutely couldn’t continue to let them lurk in the shadows; he had to expose and eliminate them as soon as possible.
Otherwise, there will be huge trouble in the future, which will affect his path of becoming stronger through simulations.
Next, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision returned to the real world.
Then, the voice of the system resounded as well.
“Ding, the reward generation was successful. Host could choose two rewards from the following list:
① Perfect Space-Time Tao Body.
② Great Saint Realm 7th-Tier Peak cultivation.
③. Randomly obtain one Great Sacred Artifact.
④. Randomly obtain one Red Talent.
⑤. Randomly obtain one Divine Medicine.
⑥. The Third Demonic Classic Fragment.”
….
“System, I choose ①. Perfect Space-Time Dao Body and ②. Great Saint Realm 7th-Tier Peak cultivation.”
Wang Ping took a look at the rewards, and made his choice without hesitation.
Although the Emperor’s Sutra Fragment was something he wanted, since he knew who had it, it would be easy to get it.
In the upcoming simulations, he could exchange it with them, and easily get his hands on it.
So, it was not necessary to choose it.
As Wang Ping made his choice,
his cultivation started to skyrocket in a straight line.
Great Saint Realm 3rd Tier.
Great Saint Realm 4th Tier.
Great Saint Realm 5th Tier.
Great Saint Realm 6th Tier.
Until it reached the Great Saint Realm 7th-Tier Peak and stopped.
Feeling the immense power within his body, Wang Ping nodded satisfactorily.
Great Saint Realm 7th-Tier Peak cultivation, in this Last Dharma Age, as long as he didn’t bump into wandering strong experts from the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, he could practically walk sideways.
Under the same realm, he was invincible!
Next, Wang Ping felt his body shake again, and a pure original source appeared within his body, repairing the Space-Time Body, making it complete.
Eventually, it was completely perfect.
As the Space-Time Body became complete, a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation began to brew on this Ancient Star, as the black and red tribulation energy gradually condensed, looking extremely oppressive and dangerous.
This terrifying scene shocked many cultivators on the Ancient Star.
Whether it was those God Realm cultivators who had never self-titled themselves or those self-titled Saints, Saint Kings, Great Saints, and even Half-step Supremes, they all showed fearful expressions.
They couldn’t help it; this tribulation was too terrifying, making them feel a tingling sensation on their scalps.
Even a self-titled Supreme opened his eyes and stared at the Heavenly Tribulation, showing a shocked expression.
“This kind of tribulation, could it be that some Young Emperor is crossing the Great Saint Tribulation? No, that’s not right, even the Young Emperor’s Great Saint Tribulation shouldn’t be this terrifying.”
This Supreme had a look of astonishment on his face and murmured in his divine source.
“Not good!”
Compared to the shock of the cultivators on the Ancient Star, Wang Ping’s face changed.
He didn’t expect that after receiving the rewards, he would have to face a tribulation.
Obviously, this reward only gave him the complete Space-Time Tao Body, as for crossing the tribulation, he still had to do it once in the real world.
Although for Wang Ping, crossing the Tao Physique Tribulation would be very easy, doing so would expose his existence to the powerful beings on this Ancient Star, which could cause him some trouble.
Immediately, Wang Ping tore through space, forcefully going into the starry sky, wanting to cross the Heavenly Tribulation in the starry sky.
Otherwise, if he crossed the tribulation on the Ancient Star, he didn’t know how many innocent living beings would be affected.
After all, this was not the Immortal Continent, nor was it the golden age; there were not that many strong beings protecting the lives and sheltering one side. If he forcefully crossed the tribulation on the Ancient Star, this star might most likely be shattered.
After all, at his level, the power of the Tao Physique Tribulation was definitely beyond the level of an ordinary Great Sage Consummation.
Such power was enough to shatter an ordinary Ancient Star.
Even if it couldn’t shatter the Ancient Star, it could destroy most of it.
In that case, it would really be sinful.
Of course, there was another reason; Wang Ping didn’t want anyone to mess things up, which would affect the intensity of the Heavenly Tribulation and might make it quite embarrassing for him.
Just as Wang Ping tore through space and reached the starry sky, the tribulation energy of the Heavenly Tribulation became increasingly terrifying, and soon it was ready.
“Boom!”
Then, a terrifying blood-red thunderbolt tore the sky and fell furiously towards Wang Ping.
“Come on!”
Wang Ping roared, unafraid, and had no intention of holding back. He used his Space-Time Tao Body to its fullest extent, and directly used the Divine Skills of the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra to clash with the blood-red thunderbolt, shattering it.

chapters.title: Chapter 796: 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Chapter 224: Terrifying Kill! Generous Rewards! _5
Seeing this scene, all the self-titled cultivators were shocked.
Especially that self-titled Supreme, his face full of amazement, realizing your constitution is actually the legendary Time-Space Body.
Such a constitution can be likened to an Immortal Body, and once born, it will inevitably become the focus of an era.
If it grows up completely, proving the Emperor of Tao, there will hardly be any rivals among the emperors.
After all, the initial Dark Time Emperor did not possess a Time-Space Body, but only a single Dark Time Physique, which allowed him to walk on the Path of Time, referred to as the supreme among the emperors, with few opponents.
And the Time-Space Body as a combination of time and space constitution, is even more powerful than the Dark Time Physique. Once you become an Emperor, it is hard to imagine how powerful you will be.
For a moment, the Supreme’s eyes flickered, harboring some thoughts of taking action against Wang Ping.
However, thinking that Wang Ping might be the heir of a major power, he hesitated again.
If Wang Ping were the heir of a major power, and the kind that could grow to this level in the Last Dharma Age, his taking action would undoubtedly be a suicidal act.
However, letting go of Wang Ping, this fat sheep, made him feel somewhat unwilling.
After all, the Time-Space Body! If he could refine it, he might even be able to use it to break through to the Quasi-Emperor tier in the future and live another life.
To gamble or not, upgrading from a bicycle to a motorcycle is a dilemma.
“Fearing nothing, after all, I have less than a thousand years of lifespan left. Even if I have been hiding in the divine source, it’s still a question whether I can survive until the next golden era. Why not take a gamble?”, he thinks.
At that thought, the Supreme reveals a fierce light and prepares to take action against Wang Ping after his Crossing Tribulation.
Just as the Supreme sets his sights on Wang Ping, Wang Ping is still undergoing his tribulation.
The Heavenly Tribulation becomes increasingly terrifying.
However, Wang Ping is fearless, confronting the Heavenly Tribulation head-on and using it to temper his Time-Space Body, also trying to break through the bottleneck.
Eventually, under the shocked gaze of the cultivators, Wang Ping unexpectedly triggers the critical strike effects of the Nine-fold Symphony and Purple Talent: Endless Blade, dealing a terrifying attack that surpasses the Great Saint Perfect Tier, and forcibly blows up the Heavenly Tribulation in the starry sky, turning the tribulation clouds into light spots that disappear.
After that, a heavenly pillar engulfs Wang Ping.
This is the baptism of the Heavenly Tao, a reward for crossing the Heavenly Tribulation, and of great benefit to the cultivators.
Under the Heavenly Tao Baptism, Wang Ping’s Time-Space Body became even more powerful, and his cultivation also improved, successfully breaking through a small realm and reaching the Great Saint 8th Tier.
“What secret skill did that kid just burst out, it’s so terrifying, he managed to launch an attack that could severely injure a Half-step Supreme,” the self-titled Supreme says with a shocked expression, somewhat incredulous.
After all, it was against the norm.
Even talented individuals should abide by the basic laws.
From ancient times to the present, he had never seen any talented prodigy who could burst out a strike that could severely damage a Half-step Supreme with the cultivation of a Great Saint 7th Tier.
Even in history, those equally endowed with the Time-Space Body, reaching the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection tier, could not compete with a Half-step Supreme beyond their level.
This Half-step Supreme is just an ordinary one and not those prodigies who have achieved the Half-step Supreme.
There’s no way, as the higher the level, the greater the difference in combat power brought by the realm. The Half-step Supreme and Great Sage Consummation are not on the same level and are too powerful.
Unless this Great Sage Consummation cultivator not only has a terrifying body constitution but also develops it into a Minor Domain, and comprehends the Tao Pattern, then they can hope to fight a Half-step Supreme.
However, Wang Ping broke the norm, bursting out such a terrifying strike that even the Supreme trembled.
“A huge secret! There is a shocking secret on him. If obtained, it’s not impossible for me to prove the Dao in the future,” the Supreme shows an excited expression and without hesitation chooses to reveal himself.
In an instant, the frightening Supreme pressure sweeps across the entire Ancient Star and the surrounding starfields, shocking countless cultivators, and even some cultivators are directly crushed by the unintentionally scattered Supreme pressure.
“The Fire Supreme made a move, he really put all his eggs in one basket,” one of them comments.
“This junior is really abnormal, even if I take a shot, he might be able to counterkill or escape, but no matter how strong he is, he can’t possibly be a match for a Supreme. He is in danger,” another says.
“Not necessarily, he is likely the heir of major powers, and even if he’s not, such a prodigy has great fortune and is not easy to kill,” a third one adds.
When Fire Supreme made his move, the three self-titled Half-step Supremes on the Ancient Star began discussing and silently watching the battle.
“Humph, Fire Supreme, you couldn’t sit still after all,” Wang Ping says indifferently, looking at the emerging Fire Supreme with a nonchalant expression, showing no fear.
Since he often entered this Ancient Star in the simulations, Wang Ping naturally knew that there was a Supreme on this Ancient Star, and also knew his Dao title and cultivation.
Fire Supreme, a loose cultivator with a limited lifespan, has only reached the Early Stage Supreme, equivalent to the most ordinary Supreme, a mere stepping stone among the Supremes, and therefore not worth fearing.</p

chapters.title: Chapter 797: 225: Beating the Supreme! The Second Seven-color Talent! (10,000 Character Long Chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Chapter 225: Beating the Supreme! The Second Seven-color Talent! (10,000 Character Long Chapter!)
Of course, even though Wang Ping was not afraid of the Fire Supreme, he believed that the other person did not have the ability to kill him, but he also did not underestimate the other person.
Even if the Fire Supreme is a Supreme Realm’s low-level, and its lifespan is not much, it is questionable how much combat power can be exerted in its peak period, but it is not a cultivator below the Supreme Realm that can easily challenge it.
Half-step Supreme, in front of it, still exists like ants, and will be easily killed.
To tell the truth, even if Wang Ping’s full combat power is activated, it is impossible to resist the Fire Supreme head-on.
Unless this guy is negligent, like the Primordial Thunder Supreme on the Elemental Star back then, who directly ignored him, took his physical attack, and then suffered a critical strike from him.
In that case, he might be able to kill the Fire Supreme.
However, this is obviously impossible. He had already shown enough strong combat power in the previous Heavenly Tribulation, and he had a deep understanding of the way of devouring space. Once the Fire Supreme faced him, it would definitely go all out and there would be no room for mercy.
It’s just that Wang Ping has many escape methods, so he can face the Fire Supreme so calmly.
“Fire Supreme, you can’t kill me yet.”
Wang Ping sneered and then used the Time-Space Divine Skill to quickly escape.
If possible, Wang Ping did not want to use the uncertain Golden Talent: Transmission.
This annoying talent is enough to use in the life simulation, but it’s better to be cautious in the real world.
“Junior, you are too arrogant. Even if I want to kill you, you can’t escape to the ends of the earth!”
The Fire Supreme laughed coldly, turned into flames, tore the space apart, and quickly caught up.
The distance between the two began to shrink.
If it was an ordinary Great Saint, it would have been caught up, and he had sealed the space, making it hard to move. However, the current Time-Space Body is not so simple, and he cannot seal it, so he can only chase slowly.
However, the Fire Supreme was very confident in himself, and he believed that Wang Ping could not escape from his palm. Sooner or later, he would catch up and suppress him.
During the chase, Wang Ping quickly opened the chat group page and started talking.
Wang Ping (66) @ Chen Si (83) @ Lin Yuanyuan (80) @ Chen Kang (67) @ Cai Yonglong (1) @ Liu Mei (15): “Guys, I’m being hunted down. Come and support me, and let’s do something big.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “???”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Good fellow, who is chasing to kill my Mr. Wang? Shocked.Jpg.”
Liu Mei (15): “If someone can chase and kill Wang Ping now, it must be a Great Saint.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “The Great Saint is not qualified. I suspect it’s a Half-step Supreme.”
Chen Si (83): “It’s so scary, QAQ.”
Chen Kang (67): “What about a Half-step Supreme? If you dare to chase and kill my Brother Wang, then prepare to be beaten by us!”
Wang Ping (66): “No, not just any Half-step Supreme, but a true Supreme.”
Once Wang Ping had said this, the group quieted down for a moment.
Then, it exploded again.
No one expected that Wang Ping would be so shocking that he had actually attracted a Supreme to hunt him down personally.
Moreover, Wang Ping was able to chat in the chat group with ease while being chased by the Supreme, and this represented a very profound meaning.
He truly is Mr. Wang, and their combat powers are becoming more and more distant.
They can’t catch up. They can’t catch up at all!
Liu Mei (15): “Since it is a Supreme, we indeed need to work together. Wang Ping, find a good Delivery Point, and we will be there soon.”
Wang Ping (66): “OK.”
After saying this, Wang Ping once again focused his attention on the Fire Supreme who was still chasing him.
This bastard, he’s really persistent.
“I remember there is a relatively large meteorite nearby. It would be the most suitable place as a Delivery Point.”
After this thought flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, he used his Secret Skill to increase his cultivation and speed and quickly rushed over.
Seeing this, the Fire Supreme sneered and rushed over as well.
“Hehe, are you not running anymore? Are you trying to surrender to me to let me spare your life?”
Fire Supreme sneered, looking down at Wang Ping condescendingly.
Of course, even though he was mocking Wang Ping, the Fire Supreme had no intention of underestimating him, as he remained vigilant, always guarding against Wang Ping using some dangerous trump card to counter-kill him.
“No, I stopped because your end is here.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Fire Supreme indifferently and sneered.
As the words fell, Wang Ping’s body was surrounded by one white light after another.
Then, Lin Yuanyuan, Cai Yonglong, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Liu Mei appeared one after another here.
The sudden appearance of the five people made the Fire Supreme’s pupils suddenly shrink, and his body tensed up.
After all, he had no idea how these five people had suddenly appeared.
However, when he found that among the five, the strongest was only at the Saint King Realm, he remained vigilant, but once again showed a mocking expression.
“The strongest is only a Saint King? Is this your trump card? I’m so disappointed. Die!”
After the mockery, Fire Supreme suddenly exerted its terrifying Supreme pressure, wanting to crush Lin Yuanyuan and the others.
In response, Wang Ping called out his own Life-bound Supreme Device, actively resisting the Supreme pressure, and shouted: “Chen Kang, Chen Si, do it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 798: 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word !) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: Chapter 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _2
Upon Wang Ping’s command, Chen Kang fixed his gaze on Fire Supreme and directly used his Golden finger ability.
In an instant, Fire Supreme’s face changed drastically, finding himself unable to move.
At the same time, he also discovered that his power had suddenly plummeted by three-quarters, leaving only a quarter left.
“What kind of Divine Skill is this? Damn it!”
The unprecedented situation caused Fire Supreme’s face to change drastically.
And this was just the beginning. Wang Ping roared and unleashed all his strength, launching the most powerful attack on Fire Supreme.
This time, Wang Ping was lucky enough to trigger the Sixfold Ensemble.
Although it did not trigger a critical strike, Wang Ping’s cultivation had improved by a small realm compared to when he crossed the Tribulation.
Moreover, his Time-Space Body had become even stronger, which also contributed to the power of this attack.
In an instant, the terrifying attack hammered down on Fire Supreme, causing his expression to tense.
However, he was not worried, but instead scoffed and used a defensive type Divine Skill to protect himself.
Although his power was weakened and he was imprisoned, unable to move, and no matter what method he used, he could not move, he found that he could still use Divine Skills for attack and defense.
As a result, he chose to use Divine Skills for defense cautiously.
“Hehe!”
Wang Ping watched Fire Supreme, just as his Divine Skill was about to take shape, he sneered coldly and signaled Liu Mei to take action.
In an instant, Liu Mei turned her attractiveness up to the highest level.
It should be noted that Liu Mei’s Golden finger had been optimized once, making her attractiveness and the power of her Charm Skill even more terrifying, reaching a horrifying level.
As a result, even the Supreme would be charmed for a period of time.
With Liu Mei’s action, Fire Supreme was charmed in an instant.
This moment was enough for Fire Supreme’s yet to form defensive Divine Skill to disintegrate, and Wang Ping’s attack landed heavily on him.
Even though Fire Supreme was a Supreme, he was ultimately old and his power had been weakened.
As a result, he could not withstand Wang Ping’s all-out attack, with many cracks appearing in his body, being torn apart by space and eroded by time, accelerating his aging.
Fire Supreme had undoubtedly suffered a severe blow.
“Ah!”
After breaking free from the Charm Skill, Fire Supreme felt his current condition and nearly went mad.
He never imagined that he would be bullied like this by a group of ants.
If this continued, he would really be killed by a Great Saint leading a group of Saint Kings and God Monarchs.
This was something he could not accept.
If the news of him being killed by a group of ants spread, Fire Supreme would be truly nailed to the pillar of shame, his name forever synonymous with the weakest Supreme.
“You juniors, you’re courting death!”
Fire Supreme’s eyes were splitting apart, realizing that he had no chance of survival. Even if he managed to escape by luck, he wouldn’t have much time left to live.
As a result, he roared in anger and initiated a self-explosion, burning his Divine Soul, flesh, Mana, origin, and everything, creating the most terrifying self-destruction.
In an instant, a horrifying energy wave swept through the starry sky, making the space in the sky explode like crazy, with nothing being able to withstand this terrifying energy wave.
A Supreme’s self-explosion at any cost, even though this Supreme had been weakened by three-quarters and had been severely injured, its power was still not something an ordinary Supreme could easily block. A wrong move could result in heavy losses.
However, Fire Supreme’s attempt to drag Wang Ping and the others to their deaths with him through self-explosion was undoubtedly impossible.
Just as Fire Supreme self-destructed, Wang Ping hesitated for a moment and immediately let Cai Yonglong use his Golden finger ability to enhance the protective shield.
In an instant, under the effect of Cai Yonglong’s Golden finger, even the self-destruction of the Supreme could not break through the shield’s defense, leaving Wang Ping and the others unharmed.
Cai, I must say, although the duration of your Golden finger is a bit short, the intensity of its defense is indeed amazingly strong.”
After everything had settled, Wang Ping patted Cai Yonglong on the shoulder and said with a grin.
Being able to block a weakened version of a Supreme’s self-destruction with just one enhancement, the defense was truly beyond expectations.
According to the optimized nature of the Golden finger, it usually takes two enhancements to achieve this effect, and the upper limit would be the Great Emperor Tier.
It would take a third enhancement to go beyond the Great Emperor Tier.
However, only he might be able to perform the third optimization among the group at the moment.
“Of course. If it had a short duration and was still that weak, I would really cry to death.”
Cai Yonglong said with mixed emotions.
“Speaking of which, Yuanyuan, it’s a pity this time, you couldn’t pick up the slack.”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and shook his head.
He had called Lin Yuanyuan over for two reasons: one, to be a trump card for precaution, and two, to see if Lin Yuanyuan could acquire the power of this Supreme.
Unfortunately, Supremes were not that easy to kill. Even though they had applied various buffs on Fire Supreme, and Wang Ping had severely injured him with full firepower, they still could not kill him.
Liu Mei’s Charm Skill effect was also broken free.
Under such circumstances, they had actually lost the possibility of killing Fire Supreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 799: 225 Group Beat Supreme! The Second Rainbow-Colored Talent! (Mega Chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Chapter 225 Group Beat Supreme! The Second Rainbow-Colored Talent! (Mega Chapter!)_3
If Fire Supreme uses a defensive Divine skill next, it would be a problem whether Wang Ping could break through it or not.
After all, his Innate Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills was still in its cooling-off period.
Ten years may seem short, but in the real world, it’s quite a long time.
As for the hundred years of life consumption, it’s nothing to Wang Ping and he doesn’t really care.
Regrettably, Fire Supreme was bewildered by their consecutive tricks and was convinced that there was no chance of turning the tide, so he directly detonated himself without concern for consequences.
If Fire Supreme had held on for a while longer, Wang Ping would have really had to run away with Cai Yonglong and the others.
“Mr. Wang, it’s okay, I can slowly grow stronger, there will be more opportunities in the future,” Lin Yuanyuan shook her head and said.
“Alright.” Wang Ping nodded, not saying much.
Then, Wang Ping thought about it and took out divine sources of various ranks from his storage pocket and distributed them among Cai Yonglong and others.
After all, they had come to help, Wang Ping wasn’t going to let them make this trip for nothing, so rewarding them was necessary.
Rather than not accepting red envelopes, it’s better to forcefully give them some resources upfront.
“Hehe, since Brother Wang gives me divine source, then I’ll accept it,” Wang Ping’s attitude was firm, so Cai Yonglong didn’t refuse this time and happily accepted.
Not to mention Wang Ping’s strong attitude, this was divine source, something that can assist in cultivation, who could refuse that?
“Thank you, Mr. Wang!” Chen Kang, Chen Si, and Liu Mei all expressed their gratitude happily.
“Mr. Wang, I didn’t help much, so I won’t accept this,” Lin Yuanyuan shook her head, showing no intention to accept.
She understood the principle of “no reward for no work done.”
Seeing this, Wang Ping just smiled, didn’t say much, and took back the divine sources.
Then, Wang Ping gave it a thought and asked, “Are you going to follow me or teleport back?”
Upon hearing this, Chen Kang, Chen Si, and Liu Mei glanced at each other, indicating that it would be safer to return to their own world.
As for Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong, they didn’t plan on going back at all.
After all, Lin Yuanyuan was venturing into the Upper Realm, and she wasn’t going back to begin with.
As for Cai Yonglong, who had been hiding in the Elemental Star, and had made no progress in cultivation, naturally, it was safer to stick to Wang Ping’s coattails and improve his cultivation faster.
“Brother Wang, I think I’d better not go with you. After all, my situation is a bit complicated, it wouldn’t be good for me to go,” Lin Yuanyuan hesitated a bit but still chose to gently refuse.
Following Wang Ping to a major power like Taiyi Imperial Palace would indeed be safe and easy to get powerful.
However, her abilities were not all above board, and she was currently the mission expert of the group, often disappearing, so it wasn’t convenient to join a major power.
“Alright, be careful. If you can capture some strong men alive, I’ll exchange them with you,” Wang Ping pondered for a moment, didn’t insist on anything, and just told her.
“Alright,” Lin Yuanyuan nodded.
After that, Wang Ping didn’t say much, and took Cai Yonglong to the previous Ancient Star.
After all, he left his disciple Wan Yu there. He couldn’t just leave him behind and go directly to Taiyi Imperial Palace.
When Wang Ping returned to the Ancient Star with Cai Yonglong and the others, the observing Half-step Supreme and Saint Realm Powerhouses were all very surprised.
After all, Wang Ping’s return meant that Fire Supreme had most likely fallen.
The fall of a Supreme was really a terrifying event.
As a result, they were even more convinced that Wang Ping was a descendent of a major power, lamenting that Fire Supreme was too prejudiced, and shouldn’t have taken the gamble.
Unfortunately, there’s no regret in this world.
The numerous cultivators did not dare to stare blatantly at Wang Ping, and silently submerged themselves back into hibernation.
Wang Ping, on the other hand, introduced Wan Yu to Cai Yonglong and others.
Cai Yonglong was surprised to learn that Wang Ping had accepted another disciple.
After all, Mr. Wang was always very cautious when it came to accepting disciples, so Wan Yu was definitely not ordinary.
While Cai Yonglong and the others were curious about Wan Yu, Wang Ping set off for the Immortal Continent with his followers.
As for what to do with Lin Qinghe.
With the remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body guarding Lin Qinghe, there would be no problem.
If this was in simulation, Wang Ping would definitely take Lin Qinghe to the Immortal Continent and join Taiyi Imperial Palace.
However, it would be too much of a hassle if they were traveling in reality.
After all, to return to the Elemental Star, and then depart from the Elemental Star to the Immortal Continent, this would consume at least five years.
Five years in the real world was far too long for Wang Ping and could introduce many variables.
Therefore, it was better to go to Taiyi Imperial Palace first and then bring Lin Qinghe in the simulation, this could minimize risk and time cost.
Half a year later, Wang Ping successfully brought his followers to Taiyi Imperial Palace and met the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“Perfect Space-Time Tao Body! Great Saint Realm 8th Tier cultivation!”
When the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace found out the details about Wang Ping, even as a Supreme being and the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace who had seen the world, he couldn’t help but gasp in surprise, his face full of shock.
After all, a Perfect Space-Time Tao Body was a constitution comparable to the Immortal Body, which was hard to find in this world.
And Wang Ping attaining the Great Saint Realm 8th Tier in the Last Dharma Age was also very against the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 800: 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word !) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Chapter 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _4
Hence, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace did not hesitate to open the back door for Wang Ping and allowed Cai Yonglong and Wan Yu to join the Taiyi Imperial Palace as well.
As for the qualification examination, there was no need at all.
Not to mention that Cai Yonglong and the others had some qualifications, even if their meridians were broken and their Elixir Field was a waste, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace would unhesitatingly accept them into the Taiyi Imperial Palace and then use a large amount of treasure to reshape their meridians and Elixir Field.
There was no reason, just because they were followers of Wang Ping, it was that simple.
Of course, in general situations, it is essential to conduct necessary background checks and swear to the Heavenly Tao with one’s Tao Heart.
After all, Taiyi Imperial Palace did not want to let spies in and cultivate talents for other powers.
However, when a perfect Time-Space Body presented itself, it was natural to accept it first; otherwise, there would be no place to cry if it escapes, and the ancestor would definitely curse at them.
Getting scolded was the least of it, but the most likely occurrence would be a beating and being thrown into some forbidden area.
“Palace Master, I have a question to ask, I wonder if the palace master can enlighten me.”
Wang Ping slightly held his fist and smiled.
“Within the scope of my ability, I will tell you what you want to know.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace smiled lightly, with a gentle expression, but did not overstate his words.
“I want to know if I come here with cultivation reaching the Supreme tier, would you still accept me?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“No.” The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace looked serious and shook his head. “Supremes are already powerful figures in the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification. If they grow up on their own outside, it is difficult for them to develop feelings and loyalty to a power. No major power will accept them. Real major powers will only cultivate their own Supremes. Absorbing Supremes from the outside involves too many hidden dangers and unstable factors.”
“So, it’s really like this.”
Wang Ping seemed thoughtful.
It seemed that it was right for him to come ahead of time.
If he was a little late, it would be impossible to join Taiyi Imperial Palace and other powers.
“If I join and then, relying on my own cultivation, quickly grow into a Supreme, will I be doubted?”
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief and asked another question.
“No. As long as you join Taiyi Imperial Palace, as long as your background is confirmed to be clean, we will trust you. Even if your cultivation grows rapidly, we will trust you.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace smiled faintly.
“I believe you can understand the need for necessary checks. But, once you gain the trust of my Taiyi Imperial Palace, we will do our best to cultivate you into a Quasi-Emperor or even a Great Emperor.”
“That’s good.” Wang Ping smiled slightly, nodded his head, and liked the frank style of the palace master of Taiyi Emperor Palace.
If it were some old foxes, they would definitely say things like “use a man without suspicion, don’t use a man with suspicion” behind their backs and then investigate secretly.
Of course, this was also because his talent was too outstanding; otherwise, whether Taiyi Imperial Palace master could be so honest was also a question.
It could only be said that everything was relative.
“You should be seeking shelter, as for being tempted by the cultivation resources of my Taiyi Imperial Palace, you probably don’t have that idea.”
Seeing Wang Ping asking these questions, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace laughed lightly and revealed Wang Ping’s purpose.
“On the growth path of a genius, talent is secondary, and background is the most important, right? Without a strong background, even if I am a Great Saint, facing ordinary Supremes and Quasi-Emperors, I can only be caught and made into medicine.”
Wang Ping sighed and spoke honestly.
“At the Saint Realm level, you can rely on yourself, but it’s hard to rely on yourself later on.”
“Yes, in the cultivation path, talent is important, but without a strong background, it’s hard to reach the top.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was somewhat emotional.
If it weren’t for him being a son of the Emperor in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, without that identity, he would have died in the face of many dangers.
If he didn’t have that identity, those old monsters would not have any scruples when taking action, no matter who you are, what junior, what bullying the weak, all would be nonsense.
“Next, you should directly self-tittle. Although cultivation during the Last Dharma Age can indeed temper people, it also wastes time. Besides, it is basically impossible to reach the Supreme Realm of Tao Proving during the Last Dharma Age.”
“According to the calculations of the Great Emperor in my Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Golden Age will open in 100,000 years. As long as you self-tittle until that time, you have a great chance to reach the Emperor Realm, even if you become an immortal, it’s not impossible.”
At this point, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace spoke again, giving Wang Ping a pep talk.
This made Cai Yonglong couldn’t help but mutter in his heart.
How could Mr. Wang possibly self-tittle?
If they self-tittled, what would happen to the dangerous missions, and the chat group would probably forcibly pull them out of the divine source.
“I’m sorry, I still have some things to do, so I can’t self-tittle. It will not be too late for me to self-tittle after I have dealt with the matters.”
At this moment, Wang Ping also smiled slightly and said.
“Well, as long as you know in your heart, that’s fine.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace didn’t say much more and just nodded.
Wang Ping could grow to this level, naturally, he didn’t need to be taught anything.
Such people basically have their own thoughts and plans, and getting too involved might not be a good thing and would even make people resentful.
Next, Wang Ping and the others were taken to live on a vibrant and beautiful mountain peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Chapter 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _5
This mountain peak, called Spiritual Dust Peak, was now Wang Ping’s exclusive peak.
Although Wang Ping hasn’t become an Emperor’s son yet, his treatment, under the arrangement of the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace, is at the same level.
The Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace knew very well that once Wang Ping officially set foot on the Taiyi Emperor Road, he would become an Emperor’s son, and as long as he reached the Golden Age, he would easily suppress Yu Daohong, the original First Emperor’s son, and become the First Emperor’s son.
As a result, although giving Wang Ping the Spiritual Dust Peak as a cultivation place directly is not in accordance with the rules, he still made an exception.
…..
“Next, it’s time to continue the simulation.”
After settling in Spiritual Dust Peak, Wang Ping was quite satisfied with the environment.
Of course, the most important thing is that this mountain peak is protected by a Great Array.
Unless Wang Ping permits it, no one can enter this mountain peak, not even Supreme and Quasi-Emperors can peek into its secrets.
It can be said that the Taiyi Imperial Palace highly respects personal privacy.
This is what Wang Ping is most satisfied with.
After all, they, as travelers from another world, have too many secrets on their bodies, and if they are not careful, they might still attract some trouble.
Even in Taiyi Imperial Palace, there are no exceptions.
Wang Ping trusts Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and most of the Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace, but he can’t possibly trust everyone.
Every major power will have some villains, which is inevitable.
Although these villains will not choose to betray the interests of Taiyi Imperial Palace, if there are enough benefits to tempt them, they would be happy to fight for them.
This is an unavoidable thing.
“System, I want to do Paid Simulation now, how much divine source do I need?”
Wang Ping calmed his mind and breathed lightly, then asked in his heart.
“Ding, it is detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the 8th tier of Great Saint Realm. The cost of Paid Simulation is 3 million catties of top-tier Divine Origin or 300,000 catties of Extreme-tier Divine Origin.”
The system’s voice sounded, causing Wang Ping’s expression to freeze slightly.
What the hell! A direct three million top-tier Divine Origin, this is simply outrageous.
Previously, it was only 150,000 top-tier Divine Origin, right? This has directly increased twenty times….
“Uh, it seems that’s not right. Last time the simulation was at Half-step Great Saint, and leaping from Half-step Great Saint directly to the 8th tier of Great Saint Realm, it’s actually quite normal to multiply this much.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“Cultivation, although choosing it has many benefits and allows me to experience the pleasure of overpowering others through cultivation, the consumption really always makes me rant.
