Next, I can only simulate about seven times. This is still based on the premise that I don’t continue to choose cultivation.”
“But now that I know the location of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture inheritance, perhaps there is the inheritance of the Dark Time Great Emperor. If there is, then it will be a fortune.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and calmed his emotions.
Moreover, if it doesn’t work out, I’ll just raise my cultivation to the Half-step Supreme realm and develop the Time-Space Body to the level of a Minor Domain.
By then, I would be slaying Ordinary Supremes like slaughtering dogs. Wouldn’t I still need resources to continue the simulation?
As long as I kill more Ordinary Supremes, collect more divine sources, I can continue the simulation.
“Besides, Wind Demon Supreme, my dear senior, if I’m short on divine sources, it’s time to find you to burst gold coins.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, and he chuckled.
If I raise my cultivation to Half-step Supreme, develop the Time-space Body to a Minor Domain, and refresh a few more golden talents or seven-color talents that assist me in fighting, plus the help of other group members, killing this old guy and making him burst gold coins seems highly possible.
“In a word, my future is promising, and I am a Future Soldier. System, give me the Paid Simulation. I don’t lack this bit of divine source.”
Wang Ping’s face was full of confidence, and he waved his hand.
“Ding, consuming 3 million catties of top-tier divine source, Life Simulator activation, Talent Refresh is in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful! Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack; Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique!”
Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack: With this talent, the host has a certain probability of triggering an instant death effect when attacking. As long as the instant death effect is triggered, the opponent can be killed instantly, whether they are Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, or even Great Emperor.
Warm reminder: This talent can be turned on and off freely, so don’t worry about accidentally killing friends during sparring.
Red Talent: WoodProfound Physique: …
“Damn!”
When Wang Ping saw the text simulation content, he was completely stunned.
He never expected that he would refresh another seven-color talent, and this seven-color talent is so cruel.
Although it is an unstable type of talent again, the effect of this talent is too frightening. As long as the instant death effect is triggered, even if the opponent is a Great Emperor, they can be instantly killed, making them fall on the spot.
This is simply a godly technique for killing enemies at a higher level.
If luck is good enough, it is entirely possible to explode and kill opponents much stronger than oneself and achieve a miraculous comeback!
“Hahaha, with this seven-color talent, I don’t know how many unlucky supremes will die by my hand in the future.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but burst into laughter, as if already seeing that amazing scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Chapter 225: Beating up the Supreme! The Second Seven-colored Talent! (Ten thousand-word chapter!) _6
Immediately, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts, took a breath, and said in his heart: “System, I choose the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins…..”
The system’s voice sounded again, and Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, knowing that he had entered the state of immersive simulation.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, you choose to go back to the Elemental Star first, bringing Lin Qinghe, Ye Xiaofan, and others to the Immortal Continent to join the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After successfully bringing everyone to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you choose to search for the whereabouts of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture according to the information in your memory.]
[When you arrive at your destination, you find the entrance to a secret realm. This secret realm reacts to the two fragments of the Emperor’s Sutra you have. Unfortunately, without the third fragment, the secret realm cannot be opened.]
[This makes you frown and sigh helplessly. Your guess is indeed correct. Even if you know where the Emperor Scripture inheritance is, it is difficult to obtain it without a complete map in hand. This Emperor Scripture map is the key to opening the secret realm, and it is likely to help you obtain the inheritance after the secret realm is opened.]
[After returning disappointed, you become an apprentice of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and do not waste any more time. You choose to self-tittle in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly 100,000 years pass, and the Golden Age appears. You unseal yourself, begin to step on the Celestial Path, defeat Bai Yu Daohong, become the First Emperor Child, and enjoy endless glory.]
[However, during this process, you still maintain your Yin’s old style, letting the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor use a Secret Skill to hide your cultivation, making it difficult for outsiders to see through. Your external performance remains at the Half-step Great Saint Tier.]
[This time, you plan to re-walk the previous plot and find the mastermind who has the intention of destroying the pride of the Immortal Continent.]
[Of course, although you plan to follow the previous plot, you still plan to strengthen yourself first. If your strength does not become strong enough, you will end up in the same situation as in the previous simulation.]
[To this end, you choose to find the young genius ranked 98th on the Great Saint Ranking. At this point in time, many self-titled talents have not yet come out, so his ranking is higher.]
[When you find him and want to trade with him, this genius is quite surprised, immediately wants to bet with you, and shamelessly states that he will suppress his cultivation to the 1st Tier of Great Saint at most.]
[At this, you are speechless, saying that you can do it, but you have one condition: today’s battle is a secret between the two of you, and no one is allowed to disclose it. Seeing your quick agreement and the conditions, the expression of this genius changes, and he suddenly feels that his request is too small.]
[However, now that things have come to this point, he is not in a good position to back down, so he chooses to agree.]
[In the end, you both fight. This genius lowers his cultivation to the 1st Tier of Great Saint, and you only show off your Half-step Great Saint cultivation and still crush him. This makes the genius somewhat skeptical about his life, falling into a state of self-closure, with an unstable Tao Heart.]
[At this, you can’t help but laugh. If you were up against a talent of equal or one level lower than you, you naturally wouldn’t be able to fight across levels. However, this guy’s talent wouldn’t even make it to the Saint King Ranking in the future, so it’s normal for you to defeat him across a greater realm.]
[Of course, this guy should have fought with you for a longer time. Unfortunately, he was too unlucky. During the battle, you directly triggered the Purple Talent: Endless Blade and Triple Symphony. As a result, it was a direct slaughter.]
[Next, after hypocritically comforting him, you choose to take the third Broken Map and leave leisurely under his resentful gaze.]
[This makes the powerhouse behind him not know what to say, and can only lament that a monster has emerged from the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After obtaining the third Broken Map, you choose to go to the location of the secret realm and take out the three Broken Maps. In an instant, the three Broken Maps emit a radiant light, begin to merge into one, and become a complete map.]
[Following that, the entrance to the secret realm is opened. You originally thought that after the secret realm was opened, there would be a lot of noise. After all, most secret realms follow this routine to attract many geniuses to come.]
[However, the secret realm where the Dark Time Emperor Scripture inheritance is located is obviously unconventional, showing no signs after the secret realm is opened, only a terrifying suction force that pulls you in. As for your Dao Protector, they are repelled.]
[After entering the secret realm, you see an astonishing scene.]
[The entire secret realm is not too large, with abundant Spiritual Energy, beautiful mountains and clear waters, like a paradise. The fluctuation of the Time Law is very obvious. In this secret realm, you see a village.]
[In the village, there are tens of thousands of people; old and young, high and low cultivation. However, without exception, they all seem to be cultivating the Path of Time.]
[This surprises you quite a bit. After all, cultivators who practice the Path of Time are very rare in the outer world. Now, in this secret realm, they are everywhere, which is very strange.]
[As you look at the village, the cultivators in the village also look at you, their expressions curious. Soon, two old people appear in front of you, their faces warm, and ask for your name.]
[At this, you feel an inward chill, not knowing when these two old people appeared; you never saw it coming. In your heart, you speculate that these two must be Supreme at least and absolutely a strong force among the Supreme.]
[With a lot of ideas flashing through your mind, you don’t intend to hide your identity, choosing to inform them honestly, saying that you are the First Emperor’s son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and came here because you found the map of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.]
[Hearing your words, both old people show astonishment and lament that, after millions of years, someone has finally found the Emperor’s Sutra map.]
[Hearing the old people’s words, you are amazed and didn’t expect that millions of years had passed without anyone obtaining this map and coming here. However, you remember the location of the second Broken Map and can’t help but feel that this Emperor’s Sutra Fragment might have been lost in the River of Forgetfulness long ago.]
[Apart from you, no one can get it. Under such circumstances, it is quite normal that no one has been able to gather the three Broken Maps in millions of years.]
[Next, you say that you also obtained the map by coincidence and curiously inquire if the two old people are descendants or disciples of the Dark Time Emperor.]
[To this, the two old people laugh lightly, saying that they indeed consider themselves descendants of the Dark Time Emperor. To be precise, everyone in the village is a descendant of the Dark Time Emperor. They have been living here in seclusion for millions of years.]
[Hearing the value of millions of years, you can’t help but be surprised and quite restless.]

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 226: Dark Time Emperor! Soaring Battle Power! (10,000-word chapter!)
chapters.content:
“No wonder there has been no news of the descendants of the Dark Time Emperor in the outer world. It turns out that they have been hidden by the Dark Time Emperor in the secret realm and stayed hidden from the world. I really don't know what the Dark Time Emperor was thinking.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, marveling in his heart.
With the Dark Time Emperor's capabilities, if he wanted, he could easily establish an imperial-tier force, thereby inheriting a very long period of time.
After all, the lifespan of the Imperial Clan cultivating the time-related methods is actually much longer than that of ordinary cultivators. Although it is still not as long as the Longevity Qin Family, it can still be called a Longevity Ethnic Group.
“The thoughts of Emperor Monarch are not something that I can guess right now. Maybe he deduced something, or saw a corner of the future, and made this choice.”
Wang Ping's eyes flickered, secretly thinking, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you are taken into the town by the two elders and treated well by them. In response, you are also very polite. After a long time, you tell them the purpose of your visit. At the same time, you also reveal your Perfect Space-Time Tao Body.]
[This causes both elders to be stunned, not expecting you to possess such an unconventional physique as the Space-Time Tao Body.]
[Then, the two elders smiled lightly and said that since your body has a Space-Time Tao Body, it is most suitable for cultivating the Path of Time. Plus, you brought a map with you as proof, so naturally, you are qualified to cultivate the Emperor Scripture of the Dark Time Emperor lineage.]
[Upon hearing this, you are overjoyed, believing that you should be able to securely obtain the Dark Time Emperor Scripture this time and quickly become stronger.]
[At this moment, the two elders spoke again. They said that although you are qualified to cultivate, their Ancestor, the Dark Time Emperor, left a sentence before he left: whoever wants to cultivate the Dark Time Emperor Scripture must pass the trial set by him, even their descendants.]
[These words, which left you quite surprised, looking doubtfully at the two elders, and seemed to think that there was something wrong with them.]
[Seemingly discerning your thoughts, the two elders laughed lightly, saying that although everyone in the town is cultivating the Path of Time, few of their clan have passed the trial and successfully cultivated the Dark Time Emperor Scripture. Most of them are just cultivating imitations of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.]
[These scriptures range widely in power, with the strongest only reaching the level of Quasi-Emperor Skills, and are completely incomparable to the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.]
[These words make you more surprised and puzzled. You don't understand why the Dark Time Emperor set such harsh conditions, even requiring his descendants to pass the trial to cultivate.]
[This approach will undoubtedly affect the foundation and heritage of his ethnic group. After all, the gap between cultivating the Emperor Scripture and not cultivating it is significant, affecting the foundation and potential, and weakening the Same Realm Battle Power.]
[Although it is said that some ruthless cultivators can reach high levels without cultivating the Emperor Scripture, eventually becoming Emperor and rebuilding themselves, those people are still a minority in the end.]
[In this world, the vast majority of cultivators are standing on the shoulders of their predecessors, laying a solid foundation, and then going their own way.]
[For your doubts, the two elders shook their heads, saying that they didn't know the thoughts of their Ancestor. However, there must be a reason for the Ancestor to do this. Thus, you must take the trial. If you can pass the trial, you will naturally be able to obtain the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, and perhaps obtain other opportunities. If you fail, you will have to leave.]
[After saying this, the two elders comforted you, saying that since you possess the Space-Time Tao Body, your chances of success are more than 90%, so you don't need to worry too much.]
[Upon hearing this, you lightly chuckled, clasping your hands in salute, expressing hope that the two elders would lead you to participate in the trial.]
[In response, the two elders nodded, taking you to the Trial Place.]
[The Trial Place turns out to be an underground passage called the Ancient Time Road by the two elders. You can only obtain the Dark Time Emperor Scripture if you reach the end.]
[At the same time, the two elders also tell you that the Ancient Time Road is not only a trial but also a chance. Because every step you take helps you hone your will and also allows you to comprehend the Path of Time. Perhaps, you can use this to comprehend your own Time Patterns, which will greatly benefit you when you enter the Supreme tier in the future.]
[Listening to the words of the two elders, you are quite surprised and also looking forward to it.]
[Next, you enter the Ancient Time Road. This road is indeed mysterious, making you feel a sense of time disorder. You are unaware of the flow of time, you only know to move forward, comprehending the mysteries of time while also preventing yourself from getting lost in it, leading to the trial's failure.]
[In the blink of an eye, you have spent hundreds of years in it, walking halfway down the road, and even you are starting to suffer and nearly get lost.]
[When you step onto the last part of the road, you find yourself feeling dazed, not knowing whether it is the past, the present, or some future time.]
[However, you eventually sober up, sit down cross-legged, calm your mind, and begin your Enlightenment. Finally, after a thousand years, you successfully take that step, comprehending the Time Patterns.]
[You, astonishingly, have comprehended Time Patterns through the eighth layer of the Great Saint's cultivation, an event which, if spread, would shake the entire Immortal Continent.]

chapters.title: Chapter 804: 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Chapter 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _2
[Once you comprehend the Time Patterns, the Ancient Time Road once again becomes clear in your eyes, and you take a determined step forward.]
[When you take that step and reach the end of the Ancient Time Road, you see a wall with a cold and stern figure carved onto it. That figure is none other than the Dark Time Emperor.]
[Even though it’s only a wall painting, it still shakes your mind and makes you marvel at the Dark Time Emperor’s demeanor.]
[At the moment you marvel, you feel your consciousness waver as if the wall painting pulls you into a bizarre space. In this space, you see a large number of scriptures. This is undoubtedly the Dark Time Emperor Scripture.]
[With this, your heart is filled with joy and excitement as you quickly memorize all of it and begin your cultivation.]
[Unknowing how much time has passed, you eventually succeed in cultivating the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, raising your fighting strength once again, which makes you very happy.]
[At this moment, a phantom figure appears before you, staring at you with a cold gaze. This startles you, as you realize the true identity of this phantom figure.]
[Surprisingly, it is a phantom of the Dark Time Emperor. With this, you are shocked, guessing that it may be an incarnation left behind by the Dark Time Emperor.]
[As you are astonished, the phantom of the Dark Time Emperor speaks. With a sigh, he wonders if it is finally time for you to appear.]
[These words send a shock through your mind, making it hard to calm down. After all, the implications are quite astonishing. It means that the Dark Time Emperor seemed to have known you would come and has been waiting for you all this time.]
……
“What is going on? Has the Dark Time Emperor’s cultivation in the Path of Time reached a realm unfathomable to me, truly seeing a certain future relating to me from countless parallel lines?”
Wang Ping gazes at the contents of the Text Simulation with a mixture of astonishment and uncertainty, finding it hard to calm down.
If this is the case, then just how terrifyingly powerful is the Dark Time Emperor’s cultivation?
Besides, where has he gone in person, leaving behind all these inexplicable actions?
As Wang Ping’s mind races, the simulation continues:
[When you finally calm down a little and want to ask the phantom of the Dark Time Emperor some questions, he stares deeply at you without saying much, then quickly disappears.]
[This leaves you a bit speechless, not knowing what to say. Afterwards, your consciousness wavers and you are thrown out of the bizarre space, returning to the Ancient Time Road.]
[You stare at the wall painting and find that it no longer has the power to pull you in. You then leave with mixed feelings.]
[Soon, you leave the Ancient Time Road and enter the outer world. Upon arrival, you find two elders waiting for you.]
[Both seem somewhat surprised by your distracted appearance, wondering if you failed in your challenge.]
[Because of this, one of them pats you on the shoulder and comforts you, saying that if it’s not meant to be, don’t force it, and you can continue challenging in the future.]
[This snaps you back to your senses and you can’t help but laugh and cry. You explain that you have successfully completed the challenge, comprehended the Time Patterns, obtained the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, and successfully cultivated it. It’s just that you encountered some things that are difficult to understand.]
[Hearing this, both elders are astonished and curiously ask you about your encounter, wondering why you seem so distraught.]
[You look hesitant, but decide to tell them what happened, asking if they know anything about it. Hearing this, both elders are taken aback and shake their heads. They say that their Ancestor’s actions have always been mysterious, and no one knows what he’s thinking.]
[Nevertheless, since he left this message, there must be a profound meaning to it. You are the person he has been waiting for, so they, the Dark Time Emperor lineage, will stand with you in the years to come.]
[Hearing this, Wang Ping is surprised and asks if the Dark Time Emperor lineage should remain in hiding here. Is it really a good idea to take sides like this?]
[The two elders chuckle, saying that since the person their Ancestor has been waiting for has appeared, there’s no need for them to hide any longer. Although they won’t leave this place casually in the future, they will still lend a hand if you need their help.]
[Hearing this, your heart is filled with joy, knowing that you now have a powerful force that follows only you. This is an unexpected delight.]
[The Dark Time Emperor lineage has many formidable members who will undoubtedly help you a lot in the future. Many things that are inconvenient to do within the Taiyi Imperial Palace can now be entrusted to the Dark Time Emperor lineage.]
[Afterward, you nod your head and continue conversing with the elders for some time before remembering your original plan, shaking your head with a wry smile.]
[Although you don’t know how long you spent in the Ancient Time Road, it must have been at least one or two thousand years. After so much time has passed, you don’t know what has happened in the outer world, and the chance to expose the mastermind behind all of this may have been lost.]
[Subsequently, you ask the elders how much time has passed. They laugh and reassure you, saying that the flow of time in the Ancient Time Road is different from the outer world. Only ten years have passed in the outer world.]

chapters.title: Chapter 805: 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: Chapter 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _3
[Hearing this number, you were quite astonished. Such a method is truly magical, capable of making the time ratio reach this degree without hindering enlightenment.]
[You should know that if you were willing, you could also unfold the time domain and change the flow of time within it. However, the time ratio is not that exaggerated, and cultivating in such a domain would do more harm than good. Enlightenment could be biased, leading to great risks. As for improving one’s cultivation, it is possible, but it is also related to enlightenment and has considerable hidden dangers.]
[However, the Ancient Time Road’s time ratio is so exaggerated that it does not hinder enlightenment, which is truly astounding. It can only be said that the Dark Time Emperor is truly remarkable, and his methods are beyond ordinary people’s comprehension.]
[Next, your thoughts became active, and after bidding farewell to the two elders, you left the secret realm.]
[After you left the secret realm, you discovered that your Supreme Dao Protector had been waiting for a long time and was extremely worried. Now that he saw you coming out, he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.]
[Following this, your Supreme Dao Protector curiously asked about your experience in the secret realm, and why you stayed for such a long time. Furthermore, he wondered if this secret realm should be reported to the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Hearing this, you didn’t say much, only indicating that it should not be reported. These words made your Supreme Dao Protector’s eyes solemn, and he nodded gravely.]
[As your Dao Protector, he was undoubtedly tied to you. As such, your interests outweighed everything else. As long as it didn’t betray the Taiyi Imperial Palace, he could stand by your side.]
[After that, you left the place swiftly with your Supreme Dao Protector as if nothing had happened.]
[Following this, you returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. This time, you realized that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had not left like he did in the previous simulation, which made you wonder about the differences.]
[Eventually, you concluded that the strangeness might be the difference of whether you brought out the broken map. Perhaps in the last simulation, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had left to search for the Dark Time Emperor Scripture for you, which was why he had never returned, rather than encountering any accidents.]
[Later, you paid a visit to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. When you saw him, he was quite surprised, as he recognized that you had cultivated the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and formed Time Patterns.]
[For this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could only sigh at your good fortune of acquiring the Dark Time Emperor’s inheritance and forming Time Patterns with the cultivation of Great Saint Realm 8th Tier.]
[The fighting prowess of your current self might have far surpassed the level of a Great Saint, and even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was curious about how powerful you had become.]
[Because of this, he directly called for a Half-step Supreme to fight against you.]
[As for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s arrangement, you didn’t refuse and instead felt your fighting spirit surge. After all, you were also quite curious about your current combat capabilities.]
[Soon, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor casually created a small world for you to fight inside. In response to this, the Half-step Supreme powerhouse couldn’t help feeling somewhat helpless.]
[He thought that even if you were the First Emperor’s Child and capable of fighting across levels, it was impossible for you to contend against him with the cultivation of a Half-step Great Saint. Not to mention a Half-step Great Saint, even if you were at the level of Great Saint Consummation, he didn’t think you could battle against him.]
[After all, the gap between a Great Saint and a Half-step Supreme was enormous, and even the Imperial Prince-level characters couldn’t bridge it.]
[However, this Half-step Supreme soon became dumbfounded. After you had warmed up your muscles and bones, you directly unleashed your true cultivation level. In an instant, the power of a Great Saint Realm 8th Tier erupted, shocking and confusing the Half-step Supreme.]
[As far as the Half-step Supreme was concerned, he had never seen anyone like you before. Usually, people hiding their cultivation would at most conceal one or two minor realms, but you went all out, concealing an entire major realm plus seven minor realms.]
[If he had faced you in a life-and-death battle, he might have been seriously injured or even killed by you due to negligence. After all, who could imagine that a Half-step Great Saint was actually a Great Saint Realm 8th Tier?]
[Furthermore, the Half-step Supreme observed your aura and found it incredibly heavy and oppressive, nothing like any other Great Saints, even the prodigies he had seen on the Great Saint Ranking list, none of them could give him such a feeling when they were at Great Saint Realm 8th Tier.]
[As the Half-step Supreme was shocked, you smiled slightly, announced the start of the battle, and directly launched an offensive without holding back. Your left hand used the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, while your right hand used the Sky Devouring Emperor Scripture,
combined with the Great Perfection Space-Time Laws, unleashing a terrifying skill.]
[This scene made the Half-step Supreme’s heart shudder, hearing alarm bells ringing in his mind, and he quickly retaliated. In an instant, you two collided.]
[However, despite your strength and further enhancing your combat ability through cultivation of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, the Half-step Supreme was still a Half-step Supreme, not being suppressed by you. Instead, your attack was dissolved, and you were forced to retreat slightly, without suffering any injuries.]
[Regarding this, you weren’t too concerned. After all, trying to defeat a Half-step Supreme across levels was no easy task. Since ancient times, the conditions for a genius to defeat an ordinary Half-step Supreme across levels had been clear: achieving Great Saint Consummation cultivation, having a small achievement in Sacred Body, possessing a Life-bound Supreme Artifact, and comprehending the Tao patterns of their chosen path.]

chapters.title: Chapter 806: 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Chapter 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _4
[Without this setup, it would be impossible for you to defeat a Half-step Supreme of a higher level. However, you are ultimately not an ordinary Sacred Body Genius. Your Perfect Space-Time Tao Body, even without reaching the Minor Domain stage, is stronger than a small achievement of the saint body. Additionally, you are cultivating the Time-Space Tao, the most top-notch Time-Space Emperor’s Scripture.]
[As a result, even with a cultivation base that’s only at the Great Saint 8th Layer, even though you might have hidden some of your abilities and didn’t use Time Patterns and various innate abilities, your confrontation with Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Half-Step Supreme still ended with you being recoiled without receiving any damage.]
[Seeing how overpowering you were, the Half-Step Supreme’s fighting intent soared as he launched an even more ferocious counterattack. After all, defeating a genius like you would be an unparalleled glory for him.]
[Should you become an Emperor or even an Immortal in the future, he would have even more bragging rights. For example, he could say, “Look, I once defeated a cultivator who later became Emperor so-and-so or Immortal so-and-so!”]
[In response to the Half-Step Supreme’s fierce offensive, you chuckled lightly, no longer holding back. This time, you used the Time Patterns. As your Time Patterns appeared, time began to distort, making it impossible to distinguish between past, present, and future.]
[This caused the Half-Step Supreme’s expression to change dramatically as he was astonished to the extreme. He had no idea that you, who’s only at the Great Saint 8th Layer, could comprehend Time Patterns. It was just too unbelievable! At the same time, he felt an intense sense of danger and promptly defended himself.]
[Unfortunately, it was already too late. With the use of Time Patterns, your fighting prowess skyrocketed once again. With your most terrifying Time Divine Skill, the Half-Step Supreme was easily defeated by you without any suspense, not even having the ability to put up a decent counterattack.]
[This left the Half-Step Supreme feeling quite dispirited, and he could only wryly smile. It turns out that trying to defeat a monster that could potentially become a Tao Proving Emperor was an unrealistic dream. However, losing wasn’t disgraceful.]
[As for you, you were quite satisfied with your performance, feeling a mix of emotions in your heart. Unconsciously, you had grown to a level where you could easily defeat an ordinary Half-step Supreme. If you were to use all your means, even an Ordinary Supreme could be caught off guard and fall victim to your underhanded tactics.]
[Now, you have truly joined the ranks of the strong. You are no longer weak or just a junior in the eyes of old monsters.]
[At this moment, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was quite pleased with your performance, though not overly surprised. After all, it would be strange if you couldn’t achieve such results with your abilities.]
[Subsequently, he withdrew the Small Universe, releasing you and the Half-Step Supreme. After ordering the Half-Step Supreme not to tell anyone about today’s events, he let him go.]
[As for you, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not hesitate to lavish praise on you, stating that the hope of Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Religion Ascension lies with you. At that time, as long as you grow stronger, he will help you seize the Immortal Fate.]
[Hearing these words, you expressed astonishment, curiously asking whether the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had any interest in Immortal Fate.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor replied with an unconcerned smile, saying that Immortal Fate, of course, is his pursuit. However, he knew that his chances of seizing Immortal Fate were not high. Moreover, Taiyi Imperial Palace’s ideology has always been based on Religion Ascension. As long as you become an Immortal and bring Taiyi Imperial Palace to ascend, he too will naturally have the chance to become immortal. As such, the Immortal Fate should be given to the one with the highest probability of becoming an Immortal.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words left your heart reeling, making you once again appreciate his grand aspirations and broad-mindedness. At the same time, you felt the pressure of the great expectations placed upon you.]
[However, in the face of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s expectations, you did not make any rash promises. After all, no one can guarantee such things. It is challenging to become an Emperor of Tao Proving, and countless mighty heroes die in obscurity. It is not a given that you will become an Emperor of Tao Proving simply because you have talent.]
[Having talent and having more talent than other geniuses can only bring you considerable advantages, making your Same Realm Battle Powers stronger and your breakthroughs faster. However, you might still fall midway. History offers many examples. Some ordinary geniuses with relatively average physiques, or even those without any physique, have managed to turn the tide and prove themselves at the Great Emperor level, becoming unbeatable by other geniuses.]
[Although, without the physique boost, these Great Emperors can only be considered ordinary Great Emperors in terms of their battle power within the same realm. But they are not the type that lower-level beings can challenge easily.]
[Furthermore, given your many deaths in simulations, you have an idea of the probability of becoming an Emperor of Tao Proving or even an Immortal just once.]
[Afterward, you didn’t say much else. Following the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s continued instructions and advice, you decided to leave.]
[Next, you began to take action once more. This time, you planned to continue your journey to the Small Universe to preach and rapidly improve your cultivation to the Great Saint Consummation level. If you could reach the Half-step Supreme level, that would be even better.]
[Of course, you’ve always kept one thing in mind: that you shouldn’t break through to the Supreme tier. The secret realm within the White Fog Forbidden Area can only be entered by those below the Supreme level. If you reach the Supreme level, the consequences of entering would be severe. This was deliberately planned by the mastermind.]

chapters.title: Chapter 807: 226: The Dark-Time Emperor! Power Surge! (Ten thousand word !)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Chapter 226: The Dark-Time Emperor! Power Surge! (Ten thousand word chapter!)_5
[After all, if a Supreme and Quasi-Emperor can enter the realm, it would still be a challenge for the indigenous people to handle it, even if the Supreme’s cultivation is suppressed to the level of a Saint King. In fact, it would be extremely difficult to deal with them, much less defeat them, without paying a heavy price.]
[The target of the mastermind behind the scenes is clearly the promising future talents who are likely to reach the level of Emperor of Tao Proving. He has little interest in Supremes who have reached their full potential, since the risks do not outweigh the rewards.]
[Next, you are asked to bring along the Quasi-Emperor from Taiyi Imperial Palace to the Small Universe. However, this time, you have no intention of going to the Profound Universe.]
[Because in the Profound Universe, you have already preached for a long time during the last simulation. You have shared so many teachings that continuing to preach in the Profound Small Universe would be inefficient.]
[The Small Universe you have chosen this time is the Second Profound Universe. The Central Star Realm in the Second Profound Universe is a paradise for cultivators of the wood elements and also the territory of the Tianmu Clan, a super-powerful Imperial-tier force.]
[The Tianmu Clan is a rare powerhouse openly recognized as a super-imperial force that has two Emperors. Such force, even if placed amidst the Immortal Continent, is matched by few.]
[However, for the Tianmu Clan, it’s wiser to reign in the Second Profound Small Universe, a natural wood-dominated universe, rather than attempting to contend with many forces on the Immortal Continent.]
[Consequently, in the Upper Realm, Imperial-tier forces found in the Big Universe are not necessarily stronger than those in the Small Universe. The Small Universe is filled with terrifying Imperial-tier forces and horrific Great Emperors. They just chose not to stay on the Immortal Continent for various reasons.]
[After you arrived in the Second Profound Universe, you did not seek out the monstrous talents in the Central Star Realm. Although the Tianmu Clan cultivates the Wood Element and Natural Dao and is generally good-natured, they might get upset by your unrestrained teaching.]
[Respecting your original idea, you began to implement the ‘encircling the cities from the rural areas’ policy by preaching the truth on remote Ancient Stars.]
[In a blink of an eye, decades have passed. During these decades, your preaching has been fruitful, raising your cultivation level from the Great Saint Realm 8th Tier to the Great Saint Realm 9th-tier Peak.]
[However, to advance from the Great Saint Realm 9th-tier to the Complete Perfection of the Great Saint Realm and break through this minor bottleneck, you obviously need a promising talent to become your disciple.]
[Of course, you could choose to face the bottleneck yourself. After all, it’s not the first time you’ve dealt with such a situation. However, since it’s almost time for your commitment to the Jee family’s request for battle, choosing to face the bottleneck now would mean missing this opportunity.]
[Although you now possess a perfect Time Tao Body, who would reject the Temporal Origin and Heavenly Ice resources? Gathering enough Temporal Origin could perhaps trigger a further transformation of your Time-Space Body. As for the Heavenly Ice resource, you can trade it for the good things needed to refine the Supreme Body.]
[Therefore, you chose not to seclude yourself for intense cultivation, and continued searching for promising disciples instead.]
[Your persistence finally paid off. You were exceptionally lucky to find a promising talent on an ancient star.]
[However, this promising talent of yours is someone from the Tianmu Clan, which did surprise you a bit. The boy was in a miserable condition, barely hanging on to life, and blind, while being pursued by enemies. Despite the efforts of a man and a woman, both Half-step Supreme tier, who continuously supply him with life energy, he seemed to be on the verge of death.]
[Additionally, what baffled you the most was the fact that the beings chasing the boy were also from the Tianmu Clan. The situation left you perplexed. Clan members murdering their own kind is indeed ruthless.]
[Remembering the experiences of a certain infant, you start to harbor suspicions that perhaps this child walked in the footsteps of Emperor Huangtian by awakening a formidable Divine Eye Talent, causing his fellow clan members to blind and want him dead.]
[If that were true, then probably this child possesses terrifying potential. However, you soon calm down. After all, such matters are not uncommon in this Profound World. This child is not necessarily comparable to Emperor Huangtian.]
[Still, you understand very well that while he may not be as powerful as Emperor Huangtian, his potential is equally astounding. If you can take him as your disciple, your advancement to Great Sage Consummation is guaranteed, and reaching Half-step Supreme may even be probable.]
[For this reason, you didn’t hesitate to take action, aiding the Half-step Supreme tier couple.]
[As you reveal yourself and take action, both parties are shocked.]
[Even in their Half-step Supreme state, the weakest among them being a Great Saint, they were oblivious to your presence, a Great Saint 9th tier, which was undoubtedly peculiar.]
[Though clearly, you were not an ordinary Great Saint, more likely a powerful Imperial Prince-level character, but even so, it shouldn’t be possible for them, themselves comparable to Imperial Prince-level characters and being at the Half-step Supreme level, to be unaware of your presence as a Great Saint 9th-tier cultivator.]

chapters.title: Chapter 808: 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: Chapter 226: Dark Time Emperor! Battle Power Soaring! (10,000-word Chapter!) _6
[Immediately, the Tianmu Clan’s pursuers scolded you and questioned your identity, daring to obstruct their mission to exterminate the remnants of their enemies.]
[At this, the Half-Step Supreme Couple angrily cursed at them, saying that this group took the opportunity to attack their son and steal his Origin Divine Pupil while they were out searching for a Body-Shaping Elixir for him. They couldn’t believe these shameless people were biting back, which made them even more hateful.]
[In response, the pursuers sneered, stating that it was a waste for your side branch clansmen to possess the Origin Divine Pupil. Only when the Pupil is on the young master will it be a perfect match. The Young Master already has the Dual Emperor Bloodline and has awakened the Tianmu Holy Body. If he gets the Origin Divine Pupil, he will undoubtedly compete for Immortal Fate in the future and become an invincible existence across the realms.]
[At these words, the faces of the couple turned ashen with anger, wishing they could immediately suppress and kill these bastards. Especially the young master of the Tianmu tribe and his mother, who would be the most responsible for such vicious acts.]
[However, both of them knew that they couldn’t do anything to the masterminds now, and whether they could escape was still a question.]
[As for you, listening to their conversation, your eyes were widened, and it seemed that the plot was developing just as you expected. The only difference was that the unlucky child was just a descendant of the side branch clansmen. Moreover, the Origin Divine Pupil is nice but slightly inferior compared to many Sacred Bodies.]
[Nevertheless, this genius still has the potential to help you advance further in your cultivation. So, you never considered sitting idly by.]
[Even though this involved the young master of the Tianmu Clan, you were not afraid. If you wanted, you could fight him and beat him up with one hand.]
[It was just that the Tianmu Clan was formidable, which could be troublesome. However, as long as you handle it cleanly, no one would know it was you who did it.]
[As ideas surged in your mind, you stepped forward, standing in front of the Tianmu couple with an unmistakable meaning.]
[Seeing this, the couple was quite surprised, not expecting that you, as a stranger, would choose to protect them, which moved and touched them deeply.]
[However, they knew clearly that your intervention as a Great Saint would be tantamount to seeking your doom. So, they urged you to leave quickly and not get involved in this matter.]
[Because of this, you had a good impression of the couple. Even at such a critical moment, they didn’t choose to run away or use you as a shield. Instead, they didn’t want to involve you, which showed their good character.]
[As for the pursuers, their faces darkened and coldly laughed, claiming that you wouldn’t be able to get away. Since you chose to interfere, they vowed to make you pay, regardless of your origin or power.]
[At that, you frowned. The Tianmu Clan was said to be peaceful and not fond of fighting, but the reality seemed different. It turned out that regardless of the path of cultivation people followed, some were good and others were bad. The way of nature could be both mild and cruel, and so were the trees. They could produce either good medicine or poison.]
[Next, without wasting any time on exchanging words with them, you directly activated your Time-Space Divine Skill, enveloping the entire area into another time-space to prevent anyone from escaping.]
[At this scene, all eyes on the scene shrank, revealing expressions of fear.]
[After all, Time-Space Way was incredibly powerful. Alone, time and space were kings of their respective realms. Combined, they were absolutely terrifying, requiring even Half-Step Supremes to fear and handle carefully.]
[They realized that you were not just a powerful Emperor’s son tier character but a truly monstrous and tyrannical existence. With Time-Space Body and Time-Space Dual Road Law Great Perfection, you had clearly cultivated Time-Space Dual Emperor Classic! Even the current young master of the Tianmu Clan could not compare to you.]
[However, after their fear subsided, they revealed the endless killing intent. With the coming of the Golden Age, the competition among the promising juniors was ruthless, and everyone else would be considered a rival.]
[To put it differently, the more juniors from other powers died, the more advantageous it was for their Tianmu Clan.]
[Now that you were alone here, it was undoubtedly an excellent opportunity for them to kill you and remove a threat for their young master of the Tianmu Clan.]
[Even though you were strong and could potentially fight against Half-Step Supremes, there were four Half-Step Supremes here. If they burnt their origin to fight, they didn’t believe you could withstand their onslaught.]
[As for the Half-Step Supreme Couple holding their child, their feelings were mixed. They didn’t expect you to be so extraordinary yet didn’t want you to fall. If anything happened to you because of saving them, they could imagine the consequences. Even if they escaped successfully, they would face endless revenge.]
[In the midst of everyone’s complex emotions, you coldly took action. The horrifying Time-Space Divine Skill was released, accompanied by Time Patterns. In an instant, you killed a Half-Step Supreme, not even giving them a chance to react.]
[This shocked the remaining pursuers, sending chills down their spines. They never expected you to have comprehended Time Patterns and reached such a terrifying level of combat power.]
[That was a powerful Half-Step Supreme, yet you instantly killed him without even giving him time to react.]
[For a while, everyone’s killing intent vanished in an instant, replaced by fear, as they sought to escape the time-space.]
[However, they were all trapped, and escape was impossible. With a cold expression, you struck again, effortlessly crushing the remaining three Half-Step Supremes and other Great Saints as if they were mere ants.]
[After subduing them, you habitually left behind some precaution to prevent any resurrection.]
[After dealing with them, you turned to the stupefied Half-Step Supreme Couple, giving them an enigmatic smile, implying that their worries were futile as those pests still posed no threat to you.]
[At this, the couple awkwardly smiled. If you had said that before fighting, they would have thought you were bragging. But now, it was genuinely swaggering.]

chapters.title: Chapter 809: 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping's Explosive Killing of the Supreme!
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Chapter 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping’s Explosive Killing of the Supreme!
[Next, the Half-supreme couple became worried again. Although your strength is astonishing and identity is special, you’ll face trouble if Tianmu Clan discovers you killed their people and saved them.]
[Therefore, they told you that you must leave this place as soon as possible. Otherwise, if the Tianmu Clan knows about the deaths of their pursuers, a Supreme might take action.]
[Facing a Supreme, no matter how strong or monstrous you are, you cannot be a match. After all, a Supreme is much more powerful than a Half-step Supreme, not an opponent that a Great Saint can defeat by stepping up levels. As for killing them, it’s even more unrealistic.]
[Upon hearing the Half-supreme couple’s words, you chuckled lightly, saying that it doesn’t matter if it’s a Supreme, you have no fear. If they come, they’ll die.]
[Hearing this, the Half-supreme couple was stunned, thinking you were boasting too much. However, they soon realized that since you’re so monstrous, there must be a Dao Protector. Their ranks must be no less than a Supreme, possibly one of the best among the Heaven Supremes. Such powerhouses could indeed be fearless of the ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan who come to search and kill them.]
[Moreover, it is likely that you have lifelines given by Ancestral Characters on yourself, possibly even an Emperor’s Incarnation. In that case, not to mention an ordinary Supreme, even the Tianmu Clan Quasi-Emperor would be helpless against you.]
[As for whether the Tianmu Clan Quasi-Emperor would come or not, it depends on the situation. Some of the Quasi-Emperor’s factions were ashamed of the young master of the Tianmu tribe and united to protect the collateral branches, allowing them to leave the Imperial Clan to avoid further harm.]
[However, they did not expect that the young master of Tianmu Clan would be so ruthless and secretly send people to hunt and kill them, wanting to eradicate them completely.]
[Next, you didn’t say much, indicating that although you are not afraid of the Supreme, you also know that staying in this place for a long time will undoubtedly put yourself in danger.]
[For this reason, you directly contacted the Supreme Tao-Protector and the Quasi-Emperor that you had recalled.]
[However, the two of them apparently wouldn’t arrive so quickly. To that end, you chose a remote Ancient Star, set up a Great Array, concealed your aura, and quietly waited for their arrival.]
[During the process, the two Half-Supreme husband and wife desperately infused life energy into the child, and also tried to repair his eyes, but all their efforts failed.]
[The Origin Divine Eye connects to the source. Having the Origin Divine Eye scooped out means that his source has been taken away, and life energy cannot be recovered, only sustaining his life.]
[Hence, the eye-scooping process is very complicated and requires various rituals. This is also the reason why the child could hold on until his parents returned.]
[Seeing that they couldn’t save their child’s life, the two Half-Supreme were nearly crying, wishing they could infuse their own source into the child’s body.]
[Seeing this, you sighed, told them to step aside, and let you try.]
[Hearing this, the couple looked at you with hopeful eyes, placing their hope on you.]
[For this, you were full of determination, took out the extreme-tier Divine Source, used the Time Divine Skill, and tried to rewind the past to restore his Origin Divine Eye.]
[The divine skill of rewinding the past was created by the Dark Time Emperor. With your current cultivation, using this divine skill is undoubtedly strenuous and easily countered.]
[After all, the stronger the object to be rewound, the greater the cause and effect you bear. If you were to rewind the past to revive an ordinary person with no luck or connections to big shots, there would be no price to pay. However, as the owner of Origin Divine Pupil and having connections to the young master of the Tianmu tribe, the resulting cause and effect would be too great. Due to the backlash, you might even die.]
[It is only because you have many life-saving skills that you dared to do this, otherwise, even if the child would die, you could only watch coldly.]
[Next, as your Time Divine Skill took effect, the child’s state visibly rewound, and the tear marks on his eyes began to recede.]
[During this process, your aura weakened, your face turned pale, and your body cracked and bled like crazy.]
[Seeing your condition deteriorating to this extent, even your source being severely damaged, the Half-supreme couple was shocked, moved, and horrified.]
[They couldn’t understand why you were trying so hard to help them, two strangers, and their children to such a degree that you were risking your own life.]
[Thereupon, they grew extremely anxious and urged you to stop quickly. However, although they shouted anxiously, they knew they couldn’t interfere at this time, or you and the child would definitely die here.]
[In the end, under their watch, your body exploded, and your source nearly dried up. In contrast, the child was restored to the original state, full of life, and his eyes shone with captivating spirit – the Origin divine eye, capable of seeing through the origin of everything.]
[The husband and wife looked at the restored child, tears streaming down their faces, filled with happiness. However, seeing your condition, they became anxious again and didn’t know what to do.]
[At this, you laughed lightly, showing no concern for your condition, and said that your only purpose in saving the child is his outstanding talent, and you want to take him as your apprentice.]

chapters.title: Chapter 810: 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping's Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Chapter 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping’s Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_2
[Upon hearing this, both the husband and wife were dumbfounded, not expecting your goal to be so pure.]
[Even if their child were not on the verge of death, it would be an honor for him to become the apprentice of someone like you.]
[Now that you are about to die and their child survives, their emotions are difficult to calm down. They hastily have their child become your apprentice and make him swear that he will avenge you in the future.]
[Hearing this, the child knelt down, kowtows to you, tears streaming down his face as he clenches his fists, expressing that he “Tian Yan” will certainly avenge his master.]
[At this, you can’t help but laugh and cry. It’s as if your death is certain. What you’re planning to do next is to commit suicide and then resurrect.]
[Just when you were laughing and crying, you suddenly discovered that your body had reassembled, and your cultivation greatly improved, jumping directly from Great Saint Realm 9th-tier Peak to the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection Tier.]
[Even more, your mana has made a breakthrough, exceeding the level of the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection Tier, reaching the level a Half-step Supreme should have.]
[That is to say, all you need to do next is to refine your body into a Supreme Body, and you will truly become a Half-step Supreme!]
[Of course, besides the significant improvement in your cultivation, what surprised you the most was the recovery of your body and origin.]
[You originally thought that you needed a Rebirth tally, but you never expected that you could recover to your peak state so easily. Obviously, the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger has hidden benefits that you had never noticed before. That is, after the improvement of your cultivation through recruiting apprentices, you can heal your own wounds.]
[This mechanism is somewhat similar to the setting in some games where the state is fully restored to its peak state after leveling up by killing monsters. Needless to say, this benefit is great, very great.]
…
“This hidden ability is quite good. If used well, it can turn the tide in desperate situations and kill powerful enemies.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, eyes flickering, secretly thinking in his heart.
It seems that the Seven-Color Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger is indeed one of the top types within the Seven-Color Talent.
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the simulation continued.
[While you were feeling emotional, the Half-supreme couple were astounded. They never expected you to survive in such a state, let alone have your cultivation improved a lot, reaching the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection Tier.]
[No, the Half-supreme couple quickly realized that they were wrong. You had not only reached the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection Tier but were also close to becoming a Half-step Supreme, as your mana fluctuations had reached the level of a Half-step Supreme, far surpassing that of any ordinary Half-step Supreme.]
[This shocked them both, exclaiming that you are too abnormal. Although there have been many people throughout history who have found a way to survive in desperate situations and become stronger after Nirvana Rebirth, there may not have ever been one like you who achieved such a significant increase in cultivation despite suffering such severe backlash.]
[After all, resurrection from the dead and Nirvana Rebirth, followed by transformation, must also observe basic principles. The fact that you could do such a thing, completely contrary to common sense, with your origin completely dry and your life force about to disappear, was unimaginable.]
[If the Half-supreme couple were shocked and incredulous, Tian Yan, the child, was completely in awe and admired you, his lifesaving Master, to the extreme.]
[After recovering, you looked at the reactions of the three of them, chuckled lightly, and didn’t say much or have any intentions of explaining.]
[Just at this moment, your gaze sharpened, and you suddenly looked towards the outer world.]
[Seeing your reaction, the Half-supreme couple were also taken aback, feeling a sense of foreboding.]
[As for Tian Yan, he also looked over there, his eyes shining with divine light, seeming to see the scene in the outer world, and said that the bad guy had found this place.]
[This surprised you quite a bit, and you had gained an understanding of how powerful the Origin Divine Eye was. This gift of pupil technique is indeed excellent, even allowing a child to see what was happening in the outer world through the Time-Space Array, something even a Half-supreme couple couldn’t detect.]
[Afterwards, you chuckled lightly and assured everyone that there was no need to worry as it was just an ordinary Supreme; you would slaughter him soon.]
[These words made Tian Yan admire and believe in you as his Master.]
[As for the Half-supreme couple, they also laughed. They believed that you could now fight against this Supreme. After all, although you haven’t condensed a Supreme Body yet, you’re actually equivalent to a Half-step Supreme. It’s just that your body is much weaker than a Half-step Supreme. However, as long as you don’t engage in close combat, it won’t affect your combat power.]
[With your terrifying talent, you might be able to fight against a Supreme at the Half-step Supreme Realm and defeating him is not impossible. However, they felt that it would be quite difficult for you to kill him.]
[As you all had your own thoughts, the Time-Space Array began to fluctuate violently and was soon broken.]
[When the Great Array was broken, the ordinary Supreme who came to chase and kill saw the Half-supreme couple, Tian Yan and you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 227: Cultivation Soars! Wang Ping Kills the Supreme!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: Chapter 227: Cultivation Soars! Wang Ping Kills the Supreme!_3
[This froze his face, which was just about to ridicule. He was shocked to find that Tian Yan did not die, but instead revived the Origin Divine Eye and survived.]
[He knew well that the Half-supreme Couple certainly did not have this ability, nor did the earlier Time-Space Array, which was quite exquisite. If he were not a Supreme, and had a way to locate the Half-supreme Couple, he really could have been concealed. ]
[This made the Ordinary Supreme focus his eyes on you and realized that you were not simple. However, since you deliberately concealed your aura and only revealed the Great Saint Cultivation, he could not see through you. As a Supreme, he naturally didn’t think you were an ordinary Great Saint, you had likely hidden some of your cultivation.]
[However, he laughed again, believing that no matter what your identity or cultivation, it was impossible to reach the Supreme tier. If you could reach the Supreme tier, you would not hide through the Great Array, and be so easily broken by him.]
[Thinking of this, the Ordinary Supreme from the Tianmu Clan snorted coldly, indicating that he did not know what method you used to repair the Origin Divine Eye, but this was a good thing, as long as you capture Tian Yan, and seize the two pupils again, merge it with the Young Master’s Origin Divine Pupil, it will definitely make him take another step further and transform.]
[After the words fell, the Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan made a high-handed move towards you, treating you like an ant.]
[Upon this, with an indifferent face, you directly used all your mana, displayed Time-Space Divine Skill, and made full efforts. ]
[In an instant, you blocked the Ordinary Supreme’s blow directly. ]
[This left the Ordinary Supreme astonished, never expecting you to be such a monster, capable of blocking his casual blow.]
[However, he laughed again, noticed your constitution, and believed that by capturing you, the young master could truly become unmatched in the world, and then continued to shoot at you again. This time, he was planning to use his Divine Skills.]
[Upon this, you sneered, instead of defending, you directly burst out with your most terrifying Divine Skill, and killed the Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan.]
[Seeing this, the Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan sneered, thinking you were really foolish, believing that by using a suicidal tactic, he would transfer from offensive to defensive? ]
[In his view, no matter how strong you were, he would kill you first. He would at most suffer some minor injuries. ]
[However, what he found hard to believe happened. When you took his attack head-on, you activated the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, directly taking the hit without any harm.]
[The Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan couldn’t fathom how you could take his strongest blow as a Supreme unscathed, not even a single hair was lost. However, he didn’t have time to think too deeply, because your attack gave him a strong sense of danger.]
[For this reason, he could only discard everything, use Secret Skill to abruptly increase his cultivation, forcefully use Divine Skills for defense, planning to block your attack.]
[However, when he was defending, you sneered, consumed a hundred years of lifespan, used the Purple Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills, and nullified his defensive Divine Skill.]
[As the defensive Divine Skills of the Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan were nullified, his face was filled with astonishment, as if he were defenseless and was hit by your strongest attack.]
[And this time, you were lucky enough to trigger the Quartet in addition to the critical strike effect of Purple Talent: Endless Blade.]
[As a result, under your powerful blow, this Supreme of the Tianmu Clan was directly severely injured, a large portion of his origin was erased, and his aura fell sharply.]
[This made him terrified, never expected that you were so powerful, he wanted to escape immediately.]
[You looked at yourself being unable to kill this Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan in a single blow, quite surprised, could only feel that the Supreme is really not the same as the Supreme, even if the current Ordinary Supreme from the Tianmu Clan and the earlier Fire Supreme are both in the Early Stage Supreme, but he is not the Supreme who is near the end of his lifespan, with a sharp drop in strength, still in a relatively strong state. Plus, the Tianmu Clan itself belongs to the type with very strong vitality, so they were not killed in seconds by you.]
[However, you were not worried about anything, since he had already been severely injured by you and brought to the brink of death, he would not be able to escape your grip.]
[For this reason, you snorted coldly, and directly chased after him, you were proficient in Time-Space Tao, the speed of the Supreme was nothing in front of you.]
[Seeing this, the Half-supreme Couple looked at each other, and were shocked again by your battle power.]
[After all, this was a real Supreme, even if it was just in the Early Stage Supreme stage, it was a real Supreme, not the fake Supreme with the lifespan near the end and a sharp fall in combat power. You made him so embarrassed, and you nearly killed him in a second.]
[This again shattered their knowledge. Perhaps it was because their experience was too small, but in their memory, from ancient times to the present, there has never been an existence of a Half-step Supreme who kills a Supreme across levels.]
[On this, they could only marvel at your abnormality again. Their son was really lucky to meet such a monster of a master. It was his good fortune. Misfortune and fortune depend on each other, truly the greatest truth.]
[At this moment, you have already caught up with the severely injured Supreme of the Tianmu Clan and attacked him again. This time, the effect of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade did not trigger, but still inflicted enough damage, causing the Supreme to bleed again.]

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping's Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: Chapter 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping’s Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_4
[Being furiously attacked by you, the Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan is both terrified and furious, pushed to the brink of desperation. After all, if things go on like this, he will truly perish here. With tens of thousands of years of lifespan left, he does not want to fall just yet.]
[Thus, the Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan roars frantically, saying that if you kill him, you should be prepared to face the crazy retaliation of the Heaven Wood Clan.]
[In response, you remain indifferent, continuing to exert your full strength, intending to completely slay him. Since it has come to this point, there is no need for mercy. When doing things, one should be decisive.]
[Seeing your indifference, the Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan despairs, knowing that he will inevitably fall here today. With a resolute heart, he directly chooses to self-destruct, intending to drag you down with him.]
[It must be said that the self-destruction of a Supreme is indeed terrifying, even more so than the previous Fire Supreme. However, you are most familiar with self-destructing foes. As such, you have long been prepared, avoiding most of the damage with your Time-Space Divine Skill.]
…
“Did he actually manage to defeat a Supreme despite being at a lower level? Wang Ping in the simulation is truly formidable.”
Wang Ping looks at the contents of the text simulation, silently sighing in his heart.
However, this time defeating the Ordinary Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan at a higher level also involves a certain element of luck.
If he had not triggered the Quartet and the critical strike of the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, it would have been impossible to critically injure the enemy in one hit, causing his combat power to plummet.
If he had not severely injured his foe, the upcoming battle would be a slow grind to death, with a slim chance of success.
It can only be said that a Supreme is indeed a Supreme, being incredibly powerful.
Wang Ping’s cultivation in the simulation is still at the eighth level of the Great Saint. When he speculated in the Taiyi Imperial Palace that he might be able to defeat a Supreme, he was overly optimistic, using the weakened Fire Supreme as a reference.
“However, although there is a significant difference between the simulation and my own speculation, it is a fact that Wang Ping’s combat power in the simulation has reached the Supreme tier. If the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack is activated, killing an Ordinary Supreme would be really simple.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker with thought.
Although it is not mentioned in the previous simulation, Wang Ping feels that the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack should not have been activated in this battle.
Otherwise, it would be impossible not to mention it at all. If it had been activated and not triggered throughout the battle, then the probability of it happening would have been too low, overestimating the Seven-Color Talent.
“As for the specifics of this Seven-Color Talent, I will need to get more detailed information from the system after choosing the reward.”
Wang Ping thinks to himself, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping gazes at the luminescent screen, more text continues to appear on it.
[After you killed this Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan, you find an item left behind by him, which surprises you.]
[After all, it is difficult for items hidden within the body to withstand the explosion of a Supreme’s self-destruction. Only extremely miraculous items can survive such a terrifying blast.]
[Immediately, you grab the gold coins that were blasted out by this old item. Then, you discover that it is a jade talisman shining with golden light.]
[After studying it, you find that it seems to have an extremely profound spatial restriction on it, which even you find difficult to see through.]
[This piques your interest, and you have an intuition in your heart that this might be a great opportunity.]
[As a result, you take the jade talisman and decide to study it more carefully after returning to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[At this moment, another fluctuation arrives, and a Quasi-Emperor from the Taiyi Imperial Palace emerges from a spatial vortex. After he comes out, he sees you and the remaining Supreme aura here.]
[This leaves him stunned, seemingly guessing something. When he confirms from you that you indeed fought against a Supreme, forcing him to self-destruct, he is even more astonished.]
[A young generation, forcing a Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan to self-destruct, such a feat, if spread out, would render all the other Great Saint Rankings useless by comparison, including the first place, Qin Yue.]
[Immediately, the Quasi-Emperor bursts into laughter, feeling more and more that you are indeed the person they have been waiting for in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, perhaps truly capable of leading them to ascension in the future.]
[However, the Quasi-Emperor quickly calms down, realizing that staying in the Second Profound Universe after killing a Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan might be troublesome. You must return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace as soon as possible.]
[For this reason, the Quasi-Emperor immediately opens up a passage between the universes, intending to leave together with you.]
[In response, you shake your head, and take the Quasi-Emperor to meet the Tianmu Trio, making him understand the reason behind your confrontation with the Supreme of the Heaven Wood Clan, which leaves him somewhat amused.]
[Fighting a Supreme head-on just to take in a disciple is truly reckless. Although this disciple’s talent is indeed good and could become an Imperial Prince-level character after being taken back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, eventually rising to the realm of Supreme and perhaps even Quasi-Emperor, they simply cannot compare with you.]
[However, since things have come to this, the Quasi-Emperor can’t say much more and leaves together with you. As for your Supreme Tao-Protector, they are straightforwardly ignored by the Quasi-Emperor, leaving just a message behind. After all, they are a Heaven Supreme, and they can return on their own without needing to worry about anything.]

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 227: Cultivation Soars! Wang Ping Kills the Supreme!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Chapter 227: Cultivation Soars! Wang Ping Kills the Supreme!_5
[When you return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you find that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has left, but you don’t pay much attention to it.]
[Next, you start studying the Jade Talisman while waiting for the Jee family’s letter.]
[Soon after, a letter arrives from the Jee family, and you represent them in the battle to enter the secret realm, succeeding in bullying the young.]
[You obtain the Heavenly Ice again, as well as the Temporal Origin.]
[After obtaining these two items, you do not waste time in the secret realm trying to comprehend Spatial Dao Patterns.]
[Unfortunately, although this secret realm is a great opportunity for Saints and Saint Kings, it is not much for you now, and you cannot comprehend Spatial Dao Patterns here.]
[You are somewhat disappointed but not overly surprised. After leaving the secret realm, you return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, wanting to refine the Temporal Origin. However, the refining process does not go smoothly, and the Temporal Origin strongly resists your refining. Moreover, your body does not wish to absorb the Temporal Origin.]
[You are puzzled by this situation, but you soon find the reason. Your Time-Space Body is already complete and does not lack Temporal Origin, so there is no place to contain it.]
[If you forcibly absorb it, your Time Tao Body will become incomplete again, and balance is important. Everything exists in balance, and more strength isn’t always better.]
[To further improve your Time-Space Body, you can only find a Space Origin of the same level as the Temporal Origin, and achieve a new balance, so that you may have the opportunity to absorb and refine it together, and further improve your body constitution.]
[After reaching this conclusion, you sigh. It is difficult to obtain a Space Origin of the same level as this Temporal Origin.]
[You should know that not all Space Origins will do. There are different levels of Space Origin, and some cultivators who practice the Space of Dao have their own Space Origins, but their quality is too low.]
[To meet the requirements, you think you need the Space Origin of a powerhouse at least at the level of Emperor Devouring Space.]
[However, you have learned their cultivation skills and still covet their Origins, which is excessive and shameless. This kind of behavior is the most despicable to you.]
[Not to mention, even if you were truly shameless, you wouldn’t be able to defeat Emperor Devouring Space, even if your cultivation had reached the Quasi-Emperor tier.]
[After all, Emperor Devouring Space is not an ordinary Emperor but a very powerful existence among Emperors, not the kind that can be defeated by someone who has transcended their level.]
[Moreover, even if you could suppress and defeat them, you wouldn’t be able to obtain their Origin, and you would only face Emperor Devouring Space’s dying counterattack. In the Upper Realm, their origins cannot be forcibly taken by others unless the Emperor themselves offer it.]
[Therefore, you eventually give up the idea of ​​improving your Time-Space Body. Since you know where the Temporal Origin is, you can take your time looking for a suitable Space Origin. You have countless opportunities for simulation, and as long as you spend time, you will definitely find it.]
[For this, the most perfect outcome you can imagine is to find a dying Emperor with Space Origins left behind in the secret realm, and this Emperor just happens to walk the path of Space of Dao.]
…
“Well, this is quite a far-fetched idea, but it’s not impossible. Novels still follow logic, but many things in the real world don’t need logic.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the Text Simulation, feeling a thousand emotions.
Before crossing, he read various novels, thinking that some authors wrote stories with many logical loopholes.
Who would have thought that the real world is even more magical, with no logic at all?
As Wang Ping reflects, the simulation continues.
[Next, you plan to follow the path of the last Text Simulation. The mastermind, if not caught, will definitely hinder your progress.]
[For this reason, you choose to hide your cultivation and continue challenging Ku Xuan.]
[Under the watchful eyes of everyone, you continue to suppress and defeat Ku Xuan with your Great Saint Cultivation.]
[Soon, time passes, and the following developments are similar to the last simulation.]
[In the end, you find that you are still challenged by Shi Yuyan, and Qin Yue still holds the Enlightenment Tea Party as promised. You choose to participate.]
[During the process, you drink the Enlightenment Ancient Tea, deepening your understanding of Spatial Dao Patterns.]
[Then, you still trade the Heavenly Ice for a Treasure Elixir to condense the Supreme Body and form an alliance with Qin Yue. The secret realm opens, and Huang Yin and Huang Qing come.]
[Everything develops as you remember.]
[The only difference is that you have obtained more Forbidden Artifacts that are useful at the Saint King and Great Saint Tiers from the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After entering the secret realm, the place where you are teleported is different from the previous time. However, you don’t care too much.]
[Now, you start looking for Huang Yin and Huang Qing directly, but without deliberately avoiding the Indigenous People.]
[With your current power, facing these Indigenous People means that you can kill as many as you want.]
[However, even though you enjoy the killing, you don’t want to expose your trump cards too much, and mainly focus on unpredictable moves.]

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping's Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: Chapter 227: Cultivation Skyrockets! Wang Ping’s Explosive Killing of the Supreme!_6
[As long as you are willing to carry out an assassination now, it’s difficult for any being in the Saint Realm to stop you, and there is absolutely no chance of survival for them.]
[Soon, you will meet up with Huan Qing and her sister Huangyin, and start searching for Qin Yue together.]
[This time, you don’t intend to search for other outstanding geniuses, because your strength is sufficient, and seeking them would seem meaningless. Only the weak need the warmth of a group; real powerhouses always rely on themselves.]
[Unless they are outstanding geniuses on the Great Saint Ranking list who have reached the Half-step Supreme level, they would qualify to be in your team and investigate the truth together.]
[Not long after, you find Qin Yue, but she is not in good shape. Although she has reached Half-step Supreme, she is still being suppressed here and can only use the Tao Patterns.]
