[As a result, her battle prowess is indeed extremely powerful at the Saint King Great Perfection level, easily defeating Great Saints of higher ranks, but the indigenous people don’t only have numbers; they are also proficient in terrifying Great Arrays. Given enough of them, they could surround and kill Qin Yue.]
[After all, Qin Yue is different from you. Her path is of the water element, which is extremely flexible, enduring, and has a strong recovery ability. However, her escaping and attacking abilities don’t rank high among her peers.]
[Soon, Qin Yue’s performance surprises you, as she transforms water into ice with incredible perfection, still using Tao Patterns.]
[Obviously, it’s some kind of Secret Skill or perhaps Qin Yue’s hidden trump card, which can catch her enemies off guard. This time, the indigenous people did not expect Qin Yue to be able to perfectly transform her element, greatly increasing her attack power and changing her attack method significantly.]
[As a result, the Great Array formed by the indigenous people almost collapses, and all of them cough up blood. However, at this critical moment, a unique indigenous person appears, also displaying Tao Patterns, controlling the Array Mana, and forcibly stabilizing the Great Array.]
[This makes you frown, your eyes fixated on this indigenous person who is different from the others. It is quite normal to comprehend the Great Perfection Law in this secret realm.]
[However, in this world, everything is relative. If you can easily comprehend the Great Perfection Law, it means that the difficulty of comprehending Tao Patterns will be several times or even tens of times that of the outer world.]
[Because this group of indigenous people don’t have the experience of hard work required to comprehend the law, they don’t have any strengthening effect and are inherently matured too quickly.]
[Moreover, this secret realm can only accommodate the power at the Saint King Great Perfection level. Theoretically, it is nearly impossible for one of these indigenous people to comprehend Tao Patterns.]
[However, such a person has now appeared, and it seems extremely strange. You somewhat suspect that this is the mastermind, disguised as an indigenous person and hidden among them.]
[Just as you are about to take action, Qin Yue snorts coldly and reveals another trump card of hers ─ the Minor Domain Extreme Ice Saint Body.]
[The Extreme Ice Saint Body, just like the Red Fire Saint Body, is one of the top-tier Saint Bodies. Now, having reached the Minor Domain, it exudes an aura that rivals your Time-Space Body.]
[Of course, this is only comparable to your Time-Space Body, which is not yet at the Minor Domain level. Once you develop your Time-Space Body to the Minor Domain level, the gap between the Extreme Ice Saint Body and yours will continue to grow.]
[With Qin Yue unleashing her Minor Domain Extreme Ice Saint Body, she starts a fierce offensive again, causing the Great Array to become frantic and unstable.]
[You watch and sigh at how deep Qin Yue hid her true self. Those geniuses capable of ranking in the top ten of the Great Saint Ranking seem to be much stronger than you imagined, and cannot be underestimated.]
[Of course, that’s all there is to it. While this version of Qin Yue is powerful, if she were to fight you, you could still easily kill her.]
[Just as you think Qin Yue seems to not need your help, an elusive phrase comes from the mouth of the unique indigenous person.]
[The phrase is “As expected from the top genius of the Great Saint Ranking, if I were to capture you, I believe my master would grant me even more power.”]
[Because this phrase is in the indigenous language, Qin Yue does not understand what the indigenous person is saying. She can only tell that they are getting more fanatical towards her and intensify her attacks with a cold snort.]
[As for you, who also cannot understand the indigenous language, you can’t help but frown.]
…
“Master…isn’t that guy the mastermind?”
Meanwhile, in reality, Wang Ping looks at the contents of the Text Simulation with increasingly sharp eyes.
What kind of person could possibly make so many powerful indigenous people willingly submit and hunt down outstanding geniuses for him?
In addition, the words of this indigenous person clearly indicate that his Tao Patterns were not comprehended by himself but were granted to him.
Otherwise, for an indigenous person who has already reached the level of Saint King Completion, any other power would be meaningless, and only Tao Patterns would be the ultimate power beyond the limit.
What kind of person can allow even indigenous people to comprehend Tao Patterns?
“Also, this indigenous person actually knows that Qin Yue is the top genius of the Great Saint Ranking. It seems that they are well-informed about the outer world and have clear objectives. The more powerful a genius, the more outstanding their talent or the greater their fame, the more obvious their target, the better-prepared they are. That mastermind, their master, is definitely a big shot from the outer world.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker with uncertainty, and his killing intent towards the mastermind who dares to calculate against the top-tier forces and outstanding geniuses grows stronger.
At the same time, he also admires their boldness and methods.
This person is indeed ruthless. If they don’t die, they might grow into a boss-level character.
Without further ado, Wang Ping briefly enters an immersive simulation state, sends the information to the simulated Wang Ping, and then returns to the text simulation state.
[With your newfound knowledge, you decisively decide to sell out Qin Yue, your unfortunate ally, continue to sit on the sidelines, and follow her after she’s captured to find the mastermind behind the scenes!]

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 228: Chess Players and Chess Pieces
chapters.content:
Chapter 815: Chapter 228: Chess Players and Chess Pieces
[When you chose to betray your teammates, the indigenous people made a move again, collectively burning their origins, especially that indigenous person who comprehended Dao patterns burnt the fiercest.]
[At the same time, when these indigenous people burned their origins, they also used a certain Secret Skill, combining their powers into one and making the Great Array erupt in the most terrifying power.]
[Faced with this situation, even Qin Yue changed her complexion, not expecting these indigenous people to be so ruthless and willing to give up their origins for her suppression.]
[Just as Qin Yue hesitated whether to burn her origin in resistance, she no longer had the hope of survival. To hesitate is to be defeated!]
[With the sudden change of the Great Array, turning from a Killing Formation into a Restrain Array and Illusion Array, Qin Yue was captured alive by these indigenous people.]
[Next, these indigenous people burst into laughter. Although they paid a great price and burned more than half of their origins, as long as they could catch Qin Yue, the fat sheep, everything would be worth it.]
[Afterward, these indigenous people tied Qin Yue up and quickly brought her here before heading to the tribe.]
[At this, you remained indifferent, followed quickly with Huan Qing and Huangyin. Because you had already mastered Time-Space Tao to a terrifying extent, no one could detect your tailing.]
[Soon, you followed this group of people to a certain tribe and witnessed an incredible scene.]
[You discovered that there were hundreds of millions of people in this tribe. Although not all of them were in the Saint Realm, there were tens of thousands of Saint Realm Powerhouses.]
[This was just one tribe, and it’s hard to imagine how many Saint Realm Powerhouses there would be in the whole secret realm when all the indigenous tribes were combined. It’s truly a world where saints are less valuable than dogs, and Saint Kings are everywhere.]
[Next, you used an Array-breaking Talisman that could easily break the Great Array without alarming those controlling the Array. This Array-breaking Talisman was an extremely high-quality item, and you had prepared it long ago in anticipation of this situation. The quality surpassed that of the Array-breaking Talisman you obtained in the Elemental Star.]
[As a result, after infiltrating the tribe, no one still noticed your entry. You continued to tail the team that captured Qin Yue and entered the deepest part of the tribe.]
[However, when you reached the deepest part, you were discovered.]
[A figure shrouded in black fog found you, his eyes cold, and suddenly attacked your position in time and space.]
[This made your face change, and without hesitation, you chose to flee with Huan Qing and Huangyin.]
[You were not afraid of this possibly mastermind figure, but being in the enemy’s basecamp, even if you could fight with all your might, you would most likely die here.]
[The terrifying Killing Formation formed by tens of thousands of Saint Realm Powerhouses who had comprehended the Great Perfection Law can easily suppress Supremes. A quantitative change leads to a qualitative change, this is not a joke.]
[Not to mention that prolonging the fight would attract strong indigenous people from other tribes, which would be a hair-raising situation.]
[Seeing you escaping, the figure shrouded in black fog snorted coldly and pursued you, using a Time-Space Divine Skill that was not inferior to yours. Moreover, the Time-Space Divine Skill he used was even stronger than yours.]
[At this, your pupils contracted, and you were a bit shocked. As a result, you did not dare to stay and quickly fled away. The other party also relentlessly chased after you.]
[In the end, you were still caught by him. He had no intention of wasting words and launched a fierce attack on your position using his Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns.]
[In response to this, your face turned solemn, and without any carelessness, you chose to engage in an intense battle with him.]
[However, this existence hidden in shadow was too powerful. Even when you used your strongest power, you were still suppressed. Therefore, you had no choice but to use the Golden Talent: Multiplay, hoping to trigger a fourfold or higher attack and critical strike to turn the tables.]
[Unfortunately, you were out of luck this time and didn’t trigger a high-multiple multi-performance and critical strike.]
[For this reason, you could only skillfully choose to use a combination of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification and Purple Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills to deal a fatal blow. This tactic has achieved numerous victories before.]
[However, this time, because your opponent was more proficient in Time-Space Tao than you and extremely cautious, your tactic failed for the first time, which gave you a headache.]
[But what frustrated you even more about the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack activation mechanism was that with so many high-frequency attacks, you hadn’t triggered it effect even once.]
[You began to doubt if it carried effects upon activating, or if there were prerequisites.]
[The prerequisite was that the stronger the enemy, the lower the probability of triggering. Moreover, your attack must hit the enemy and deal damage to trigger the chance. If you cannot hit the opponent or just scrape their skin after hitting them, then it’s useless.]
[In other words, although this Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack is a rule-level talent, it has many activation prerequisites. It’s not what you think, that you can use it to kill powerhouses far beyond your strength with ease.]
[To kill powerhouses, they have to underestimate you and be hit by a powerful attack that breaks their defense after Divine Skill Neutralization. Only then, with that tiny probability, can you execute a miraculous reversal in a desperate situation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 228: Chess Player and Chess Piece_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 816: Chapter 228: Chess Player and Chess Piece_2
[As for using it against Same Realm Cultivators or enemies stronger than yourself, it is quite useful, as you can play the game through Time-Space Divine Skills, easily break defenses, and it will eventually trigger as long as you keep attacking.]
[Of course, this premise assumes that the enemy is not the cautious type, nor the high-sensitivity type, otherwise, it is still very troublesome against enemies like the one hiding in the black fog and you have to pray for the luck to trigger the probability when breaking the defense occasionally.]
…
“Damn it, I knew it wouldn’t be that easy. This Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack isn’t as strong as I thought. Although it can still rank among the Seven-Colored Talents, it loses a little compared to the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation content and sighed silently.
Then, Wang Ping could not help but think about the mysterious figure shrouded in the shadow, frowning.
The existence that might be the mastermind surpassed him in comprehending the Time-Space Tao Pattern and became stronger in the Time-Space Tao, which he had never expected.
After all, he possessed the Time-Space Body. How could this figure be stronger than him?
It was incomprehensible.
Could it be that this person is the real Time-Space Body that this world should have given birth to, unlike him, the counterfeit?
As all kinds of thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the simulation continued.
[At the moment of your multiple thoughts, you were found the opportunity and suffered a heavy blow from the Black Fog Silhouettes. Although you responded in time, you still sustained significant injuries.]
[This annoyed you, and you didn’t hold back anymore, initiating the Purple Talent·Death Puppet effect, and adopting a desperate fighting style, completely abandoning defense.]
[Your sudden change in fighting style surprised the figure in the black fog. As a result, you took advantage of the opportunity to launch a crazy offensive, breaking his defenses several times.]
[Although the broken defenses don’t cause much damage, what matters is the high frequency of attacks and the many times defenses are broken. You wanted to trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect with this]
[Ultimately, your gamble paid off. You successfully triggered the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect and killed the figure in the black fog directly.]
[As the figure in the black fog was killed, the black fog on its body disappeared, revealing its true appearance.]
[There, hidden under the black fog, was a person wearing a black robe and a black mask. You approached it with sparkling eyes, intending to remove its mask and reveal its true face. However, just as you touched the mask, a horrifying explosion occurred, killing you instantly. If it hadn’t been for the prepared Death puppet to absorb the damage, you would have undoubtedly died once, consuming a Rebirth tally.]
[After the explosion, the masked man turned to ashes, leaving dead without a body. You lost the chance to know his identity.]
[This frustrated you, and you felt a great pity. However, it was also normal for this type of careful person to have such calculations. It could only be said that you were a little careless and should have used an Indigenous Person to reveal the mask.]
[Although you didn’t learn the true identity of the figure hidden in the black fog, you killed him after all. After the death of this dangerous person, your simulation should be more stable this time.]
[As for knowing the true identity of this person, you could only wait for the next simulation. Although you felt that it would be hanging since there was an explosion after this person’s death, you could only try slowly.]
[Just as you were about to leave with Huang Yin and Huang Qing, several more Black Fog Silhouettes appeared, surrounding you.]
[This moment left you silent. You didn’t expect that there would be so many Black Fog Silhouettes, and obviously, the masked man in the black fog wasn’t the mastermind at all, just one of the mastermind’s pawns.]
[Even a pawn could have a Time-Space Body and comprehend the Time-Space Tao Pattern. Most likely, this was the rightful Time-Space Body holder of this era. How terrifying was the background of the mastermind?]
[For a moment, you felt like you had touched upon a great secret of the world and stepped into the terrifying presence of the Upper Realm’s chessboard.]
…
“Things got even more troublesome than I imagined.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulation content with a solemn expression on his face.
If, indeed, a terrifying existence had laid a trap that included even monsters like him, then what he had been plotting and calculating was truly frightening.
That meant an entire chessboard was covering the Upper Realm, turning all living beings, including emperors, into pawns.
In other words, even if this scheme failed and they couldn’t capture all the heaven-sent talents, there would still be calculations for the next time.
Who could escape then?
“No, that’s not right.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping seemed to have thought of something, his pupils slightly constricted.
If their goal was to capture all the heaven-sent talents and set up in the Upper Realm, why would they try to kill him and even know where to lay in wait?

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 817: Chapter 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_3
This kind of behavior was very different from the one used against Qin Yue and the others, a very special treatment in deed.
This was getting quite strange.
“Could this mastermind be from the All Heavens? Only a being from there would know of the resurrection and lay in wait. This means he knows that I’m from the All Heavens, and he probably even knows I’m from that chat group, which is why he’s targeting me specifically and giving me special treatment, leaving me with no way out.”
Many thoughts crossed Wang Ping’s mind.
“This is such a hassle, the truth is hard to find. This simulation is probably going to fail again.”
Wang Ping sighed, reeled in his thoughts, and continued to focus on the luminescent screen.
[Facing a situation like this, you have no choice but to prepare for battle against these strong enemies. However, you’ve already burnt through all your backup plans, and they probably know the effect of the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, so you have absolutely no assurance of victory.]
[Just as you predicted, the moment you prepared for battle, they united to form a Great Array, refusing to fight directly. These black fog silhouettes in fact all had Tao Patterns despite their power being slightly less than the previous black fog silhouette you faced. They were nevertheless formidable, seeming to possess some kind of powerful physique, having honed their Minor Domains to a level not much inferior to Qin Yue.]
[Against an alliance forming a Great Array like this, you were under immense pressure, struggling to hold on. Afterall, you had no tricks left up your sleeve, you had exhausted too much Mana in the previous battle. Your combat power had diminished to only a third of its peak.]
[Seeing the situation, Huan Qing and Huangyin understood the gravity of the problem. They knew you couldn’t hold on alone. Although they felt shy, they made up their minds.]
[Immediately, they sent you voice transmissions, asking if you can create a domain to evade attacks and their gaze, just long enough for an hour, in which you may find an opportunity to turn the tables.]
[Hearing this, you were quite surprised but promised to try your best.]
[Eventually, you used your powerful Time-Space Divine skill and created a region capable of deflecting attacks and buying time.]
[Seeing you put all your effort into creating such a domain, turning pale in the process, Huan Qing and Huangyin were initially somewhat nervous and shy. But now more than ever, they had resolved to teach you the top Double Cultivation Emperor Method of their Pure Phoenix Clan.]
[Seeing this scene, you were taken aback, understanding what Huan Qing and Huangyin wanted to do.]
[However, you are not one to hesitate, you began to practice the Emperor Method taught by the two and started dual cultivation with Huan Qing and Huangyin, every second counts.]
[Eventually, you were able to attain the Phoenix’s Skill from the Pure-blooded Phoenix Twin Sisters, Huan Qing and Huangyin, obtaining a part of the origin of Pure Blood Phoenix.]
[With the help of the partial origin of the two Pure-blooded Phoenix, you successfully recovered from the initial origin damage. You went even further, gaining super recovery ability and the ability of Phoenix’s Nirvana Rebirth. You even gained a Phoenix body on par with the top-tier Red Fire Saint Body.]
[In addition, if it weren’t for the low cultivation of Huan Qing and Huangyin who were not fully grown, and your high cultivation, your cultivation would have seen a significant increase.]
[This is due to the absence of the power of Dragon Clan’s bloodline within you. If you possessed a powerful dragon’s blood, then a Dragon and Phoenix Showing Auspicious scene would be presented, giving you even more benefits.]
[Teaming up with pure-blooded Phoenix really brings lots of benefits. This is why so many gifts are passionate about it. And you’ve got two, which is enough to make countless gifts envy, jealous and hate.]
[As for Huan Qing and Huangyin, they also gained a lot from this dual cultivation process. Their cultivation levels were elevated to the Saint King Perfection Tier. If it weren’t for the restrictions of the secret realm, they might have reached the Half-step Great Saint Tier, and the Great Saint Tier was not impossible either.]
[Their Special Fire Rule skyrocketed during this dual cultivation session, reaching the Great Perfection Tier directly.]
[All I can say is that getting so many benefits from the first-time interactions with a pure-blooded Phoenix, especially when the partner is a half-step Supreme like you and the method practiced is the most top-notch Double Cultivation Emperor Mana, is indeed a huge deal.]
[As your dual cultivation completed, you both gained a lot of benefits. The Time-Space Defense domain you’ve set up started to wobble and show signs of collapse.]
[At this, you narrowed your eyes and snorted coldly, preparing to wipe them all out. If you were weak, you would naturally worry and feel on the verge of death. But now, you’ve recovered to your peak state and went even further, obtaining such strong endurance and recovery abilities. Even if they set up a Great Array, they couldn’t possibly kill you.]
[After all, these black silhouettes were not as strong as the previous black silhouette suspected to possess a Time-Space Body. Even when they combined their powers to set up a Great Array, they could not reach a level that would kill you.]
[With flushed cheeks, Huan Qing and Huangyin gathered their thoughts and prepared to fight alongside you. Although they felt the gap between them and your combat power was still too big, they wanted to at least contribute a little. They did not wish to become a burden to a Tao Companion, useless Phoenix Twin Sisters.]

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 818: Chapter 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_4
[As the Time-Space Defense completely collapses, the three of you take turns and begin to counterattack.]
[This makes the several black shadows astonished. They did not expect you to recover to your peak state and even become stronger, increasing the pressure on them.]
[However, these people are also ruthless. They do not hesitate to burn their origin for battle, continuing to increase the lethality of the Great Array.]
[In response, you sneer and also start to burn your origin. Pure-blooded Phoenixes are different from other races. Other races find it difficult to recover once they have burned their origin, and the chances of recovering the origin are few. Even fewer are things that can restore a Half-step Supreme’s origin. But pure-blooded Phoenixes have the ability of Nirvana Rebirth, and they can recover on their own even after burning their origin. It’s just a matter of how much time it takes.]
[Thus, the fighting method of pure-blooded Phoenixes has always been impulsive, burning their origin for battle whenever necessary. Now, after you and Huang Yin and Huang Qing have merged, you have obtained a part of the origin and the purest blood of the Pure-blooded Phoenix, carrying the ability of Nirvana Rebirth and self-recovery of the origin. Therefore, you can burn your origin wildly in battle, without considering the cost, which is an extravagant fighting method that other cultivators envy.]
[As for Huang Yin and Huang Qing, they also start burning their origin for battle, even more fiercely than you. As true pure-blooded Phoenixes, their recovery ability is stronger than yours, and their fighting methods are even more luxurious.]
[Seeing that you also start burning your origin for battle, the black fog silhouettes are shocked, and they quickly become anxious, full of heartache. After all, you are their prey, your origin is what their master needs, and it cannot be wasted. You burning your origin is burning their profits.]
…
“Is their objective the origin? Who is their master? Why do they need the origins of the chosen ones?”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation, his pupils slightly contracting, his thoughts churning, and a guess arises.
Could it be that both the indigenous people and these black fog silhouettes are here for the origins of the chosen ones?
Is their master the Devouring Immortal Demon Body?
If it is indeed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, that would explain the strange behavior of these people since the Devouring Immortal Demon Body does need the origins of the chosen ones.
The Devouring Immortal Demon Body is theoretically weak in the beginning, but it has the strongest development capability among constitutions.
As long as this type of constitution devours enough powerful origins, it has a chance to refine an Immortal Body and even the legendary Chaotic Body.
The Chaotic Body is an aptitude that stands above all other constitutions. Even looking at the Upper Realm, it is still a legendary constitution with only some rumors and has never actually appeared.
“However, if their master is indeed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and is after the origins, then his cultivation should not be as terrifying as I imagined. Because if he had this ability, there would be no need to scheme against the chosen ones. He would directly attack Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, or even Emperor level beings.”
Wang Ping’s gaze deepens.
After all, the best targets to devour origins are those whose cultivation does not lag far behind one’s own.
Otherwise, it is like a drop of water dripping into a great river, hardly useful.
Therefore, keeping one’s cultivation low and catching all the chosen ones at the same level is the only way to condense the desired Immortal Body or Chaotic Body.
Moreover, the chosen ones are ultimately just young people, much easier to deal with than those fully grown old monsters.
On top of that, this is the Golden Age, with the quality and quantity of chosen ones born far exceeding those of the past.
Although annihilating so many chosen ones at once would enrage all forces, as long as they clean up properly and the mastermind hides well, they can preserve themselves.
At that time, even if these forces are still furious, they can only be powerless in their rage.
“But in this life, are there really two Devouring Immortal Demon Bodies appearing at the same time?”
Wang Ping thinks of Lin Qinghe and can’t help but frown.
Since Lin Qinghe is a Devouring Immortal Demon Body, theoretically, there should not be another one. After all, the owners of such unique constitutions have always been one per generation.
“Lin Qinghe was born in the Last Dharma Age, but that one might not be. Maybe he is a self-titled chosen one from an even more distant era, knowing the uniqueness of this Golden Age and looking to take advantage of it.”
Wang Ping analyzes silently.
“Although my conjecture is reasonable, it is still a conjecture. To determine if this is the case, I need to collect more information. If I don’t catch this guy, the next simulations will probably be filled with death due to his calculations.”
Wang Ping sighs, feeling troubled.
“However, this time I unexpectedly had a dual cultivation with Huang Yin and Huang Qing, gaining such great benefits. I didn’t expect this development. I wonder if this advantage can be refreshed in the reward list.”
Wang Ping thinks about Huang Qing and Huang Yin’s matter, feeling quite subtle in his heart.
Dual cultivations, lovemaking, and such haven’t happened for a long time.
“But the destined death of a Tao Companion… in the end, we can’t escape the outcome of death.”
Wang Ping shakes his head slightly, not holding much hope for the upcoming simulation.
Afterward, Wang Ping gathers his thoughts and continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[At this moment, you, Huang Yin, and Huang Qing are attacking even more fiercely together, intending to blast open this terrifying Great Array. Your attacks are still very effective, as the Great Array has started to shake and is on the verge of collapse, and the black shadows can no longer withstand it even when burning their origin. In the end, they are not as enduring as you are.]

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 819: Chapter 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_5
[Just when you were able to blast open the Great Array and escape, the following events left you in silence. This was because even more Black Fog Silhouettes arrived here, along with a large number of Indigenous People. This situation was truly desperate.]
[However, you are not someone who gives up easily. With great determination, you activated a taboo move that costs you greatly while killing a thousand enemies, successfully breaking open the Great Array.]
[Then, you used your last resort – with a Time-Space Divine Skill, you transported Huang Yin and Huang Qing, the twin sisters with Pure Phoenix Bloodline with whom you shared love, to a random location within the secret realm.]
[Although knowing that even with temporary relocation, their chance of survival was slim, you didn’t like seeing your Tao Companion die before you.]
[Just as you used your last strength to transport Huang Yin and Huang Qing away, your body was pierced by the Black Fog Silhouettes’ attacks.]
[In response to this, you laughed loudly and detonated yourself.]
[The terrifying explosion left the group in a miserable state, with some even dying. You fell into a Resurrection Countdown state.]
[As you were in the Resurrection Countdown, this group stayed near your death point, setting up an even more terrifying Great Array, giving you no chance to survive.]
[When you were resurrected, you saw the Great Array even more horrifying than before, feeling dejected, knowing that you would die today.]
[However, you still did not plan to give up. Even though your condition was not good after being resurrected, you fought with your last breath.]
[In the end, you died within the Great Array and completely fell.]
[Due to your death, this simulation came to an end…]
…
As the Text Simulation ended, Wang Ping’s mind flashed with numerous images and epiphanies.
Finally, his figure appeared in the secret realm, observing the Black Fog Silhouettes and the Indigenous People from a god’s-eye view.
However, there was nothing interesting to see, just as Wang Ping was about to leave this state, he suddenly saw a seriously injured Black Fog Silhouette due to his previous self-detonation.
Her black fog had disappeared, and her mask was greatly shattered, revealing her smooth forehead.
On her forehead, there was an extremely mysterious white moon mark, extremely beautiful, and one could see even more exquisite rhombuses composing the moon mark upon closer inspection.
Wang Ping’s eyes widened as he saw this mark.
In the Upper Realm, some Cultivation Skills would produce special marks once perfected, which was not uncommon.
However, among the countless marks in the world, only a few were memorable.
One of them was the Moon Rhombus Imperial Sutra of the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace.
The Moon Rhombus Imperial Sutra was very difficult to cultivate, but once perfected, a mark like this would condense on the practitioner’s forehead.
Therefore, this mark was also a symbol of the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace’s disciples or big shots, and it was basically impossible to counterfeit.
“This woman is from Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace? Did she also join the mastermind?”
Wang Ping’s heart trembled, unable to calm down.
No, that’s not right, there were no female Imperial Princesses in the current generation of Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace.
As for the previous generation, although there was an Imperial Princess, she had disappeared a long time ago, and some big shots from the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace deduced that she had already died and completely fallen…
Regarding the issue of the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace’s Sutra leaked, it was also impossible.
Each Emperor Scripture had special precautions that effectively prevented the leakage of inheritance.
Unless someone from their own clan deliberately leaked it, or something unusual happened, it would be difficult for it to leak.
The Dao Tian Emperor Scripture and the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture, for instance, were leaked due to their decline.
Imperial-tier forces, like the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace, which still had an Emperor sitting at the helm and was at its peak, would never have this issue.
Especially the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace, which rumored to have a certain specific prerequisite required to practice the Moon Rhombus Imperial Sutra, could only be achieved by the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace.
Therefore, there were very few people in the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace who were eligible and able to cultivate the Moon Rhombus Imperial Sutra, and the inheritance leakage situation was impossible.
“However, what’s the deal with this woman? Is the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace involved, supporting the mastermind? And this woman was cultivated in secret.”
“If this is the case, are the other Black Fog Elites also cultivated by other major powers, and supporters of that guy?”
Wang Ping’s face changed, his heart not at ease.
If this was true, the situation in the Upper Realm was even deeper than he had imagined.
The planning of these old monsters, just thinking about it sent chills down one’s spine.
For a while, Wang Ping wasn’t sure how many forces and emperors were pulling the strings.
As Wang Ping’s heart was extremely uneasy, his consciousness shook, his vision changed, and he exited the simulation state.
Immediately after, the system’s voice also rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, Host can choose two of the following rewards as the prize:
①. Half-step Supreme Level Skill.”
②. Rainbow Talent: Instant Death Attack.”
③. A random Supreme artifact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 820: Chapter 228 Chess Player and Chess Piece_6
④. Red Talent · Wood Profound Physique.”
…
Wang Ping glanced at the reward list and made a choice without hesitation.
“System, I choose ①. Half-step Supreme Tier Mana and ②. Rainbow Talent: Instant Death Attack.”
As Wang Ping made his choice, he felt his cultivation soaring.
Great Saint Realm 8th Tier!
Great Saint Realm Perfection!
Finally, in terms of Mana, he also reached the half-step Supreme tier, incredibly powerful!
Apart from that, Wang Ping also learned the usage method of the Rainbow Talent: Instant Death Attack in his mind, realizing that this talent wasn’t as strong as he imagined. It did require dealing damage to have a chance triggering the instant death effect.
Of course, this talent is not weak either, it can bring about miracles.
If he didn’t have this talent, he might not be able to defeat the contemporary Time-Space Tao Physique with dual Time-Space Dao patterns.
“Phew, overall, the gains from this simulation were substantial, but I don’t know if I should continue on this simulation route.”
Wang Ping breathed lightly, quite satisfied with his gains.
However, he became conflicted again.
Based on the information he has obtained so far, this route is not something he could intervene in.
Although most of the so-called information is his own speculation, his speculations are usually accurate.
So, whether it is a waste to delve deeper into the information using the paid simulations is a question worth considering.
“I could try digging for information using free simulations. But as it stands, no matter what method I use, unless I refresh another talent that greatly aids in combat, everything is in vain. Going in would mean death.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, muttering to himself.
Those above the Supreme level cannot enter, and the power above it cannot be used either. Meanwhile, the power below the Supreme level would be useless against these black mists and indigenous forces.
“Although I could try to pull Cai Yonglong and all the other group members to play dungeons, this broken secret realm is poisonous. It not only has a cultivation limit, but also a requirement in terms of luck. And the group members obviously can’t meet that requirement.”
Wang Ping sighed again, realizing that his usual strategy of pulling in group members for dungeons and bosses was not feasible this time, which meant he was missing a significant trump card.
This secret realm was definitely designed this way by the masterminds behind it.
As for why, initially, Qin Yue’s followers and the Qin family could capture prisoners and let them enter the realm. Clearly, it was intended by the other party; otherwise, they wouldn’t have allowed it.
“Anyway, I need to test whether there is a requirement for luck. Although I sensed it while entering the realm, it might be a misconception.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, planning to test the waters with a free simulation.
Shortly after, Wang Ping put his plan into action.
Then, there was no “then.” As he brought Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong to the scene, they were all blocked outside.
And the simulated Wang Ping encountered calamity again without the external support.
“Nevermind, let’s not dwell on it. Let’s switch to a different simulation route, develop low-key, and strive to become stronger.”
Wang Ping shook his head, no longer in the mood to think about these matters.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
After that, Wang Ping spoke again.
“Ding! Detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection level. This paid simulation costs four million top-tier divine sources or 400,000 extreme-tier divine sources. Consume now?”
The system’s voice sounded, leaving Wang Ping quite astonished.
“Huh, it’s only treating my cultivation as if I’m at the Great Saint Realm Complete Perfection level? I’m basically at the half-step Supreme level already, right?”
Wang Ping was quite surprised by the system’s price this time.
“If I choose to exploit this bug, I could save some divine sources. But it’s not necessary. It’s better to become stronger quickly if I can.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking to himself.
Then, Wang Ping smiled slightly and said, “System, consume divine sources and start the simulation.”
“Ding! Consuming four million top-tier divine sources, Life Simulator activated, paid simulation begins, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding! Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Golden Talent · Life for Life; Red Talent · Lei Profound Physique.”
Golden Talent · Life for Life: After using this talent, the host can forcibly exchange lives with the enemy, both dying together.
PS: This talent can only be used below the Supreme Realm, so please be aware, host.
“Golden Talent · Life for Life; isn’t this ability just an upgraded version of Purple Talent · Death Puppet or an optimized version of Purple Talent · Fate Connection?”
Wang Ping looked at the newly refreshed talent and couldn’t help but comment.
This talent would have been extremely useful if it had come earlier.
But now, his cultivation is close to reaching the half-step Supreme level, and there are very few people who can force him to use this talent.
As for when he reaches the Supreme Realm, this talent will be of no use.
It’s a case of being tasteless but too good to throw away.
“It doesn’t necessarily have to be that way. If that Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s cultivation is still below the Supreme Realm, I should be able to take him down with me when I encounter him.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought of this.
He was still wary of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and didn’t doubt his combat prowess.
After all, even the contemporary Time-Space Tao Physique had a higher combat strength than him, and he had only defeated him with the Instant Death effect from the Rainbow Talent.”
And that Time-Space Tao Physique was just a subordinate of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.
In the Upper Realm, it’s rare for a subordinate to be stronger than their master.
Even if there were exceptions, they wouldn’t apply in this case.
“Although it sounds good, the premise is that I can find his location and have a head-on battle with him. Unfortunately, those black fog subordinates and indigenous subordinates of his are too troublesome. I can’t even get past them.”
Wang Ping shook his head, not in the mood to think further, and said, “System, I choose the Golden Talent · Life for Life.”
“Ding! Talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
The system’s voice rang out, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, entering the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged…

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 821: Chapter 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)
[On the first day, you chose to self-seal.]
[In the blink of an eye, almost a hundred thousand years have passed, and the Golden Age arrived. You chose to reemerge. After emerging, you walked on Heavenly Path, suppressing your cultivation to defeat Yu Daohong and become the First Emperor’s Child, accepted by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor as a disciple.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was amazed at your cultivation. After all, you were just a single step away from truly stepping into Half-step Supreme tier. Thus, he directly took out a World-Shocking Treasure Medicine, allowing you to condense the Supreme Body.]
[You were quite surprised by this. However, you were not too amazed by the outcome. After all, although geniuses indeed need to be honed, for someone like you who seems to have grown to this step as a loose cultivator from an outsider’s perspective, there is no need for the struggle to obtain the treasure elixir to condense the Supreme Body.]
[Immediately, you accepted the treasure medicine, closed doors for cultivation, and aspired to quickly condense the Supreme Body.]
[For this reason, in this life, you didn’t care about anything and remained in a closed state. In the blink of an eye, two hundred years had passed.]
[During these two hundred years, many things happened just as they did in your simulation long ago. The geniuses emerged, but without making waves. Stimulated by you, they eagerly broke through to the Great Saint Tier. Lei Wanqian emerged, fighting Shi Yuyan first, and then Ku Xuan, easily suppressed by Ku Xuan.]
[As for the Enlightenment Tea Party, it didn’t happen, and Qin Yue had no intention of holding it. The secret realm did not appear either.]
[You, on the other hand, successfully condensed the Supreme Body in these two hundred years, stepped into the Half-step Supreme Tier, becoming the cream of the crop among the younger generation. You have confidence that few of your peers can compare with you. The geniuses on the Great Saint Rankings are all far inferior to you.]
[Of course, you didn’t become too arrogant. After all, you know that among the Black Fog Silhouettes, there is a Half-step Supreme stronger than you. He also practiced Time-Space Emperor Mana, but his Time Emperor Mana is not as strong as the Dark Time Emperor Scripture you cultivated, and his Space Emperor Mana is on par with yours. However, his comprehension of Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns is too powerful.]
[Even with your current strength, if you don’t rely on your talent, facing him would likely result in defeat. Even with your talent, you would have to trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack. The increase in combat power from Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns is astonishing. Without comprehending Spatial Dao Patterns, you will always be weaker than him in terms of sheer strength.]
[When you emerge from your seclusion, you inquire about the situation in the outer world, furrowing your brows. This simulation is different from the previous ones. Clearly, the difference lies in Ku Xuan.]
[You challenge Ku Xuan and suppress him with your formidable cultivation, triggering another plotline— the appearance of the Secret Realm, the Enlightenment Tea Party, and the defeat of the geniuses all at once. If you don’t suppress Ku Xuan with your cultivation, nothing will happen.]
[This is undoubtedly a weird situation. You can’t help but suspect that Ku Xuan, the young master of the Longevity Ku Family, has a problem. Even the entire Longevity Ku Family has a significant issue. Perhaps the Ku family is behind everything, and only the mysterious family that has survived since the last epoch has the strength and courage to do so.]
[However, you are still somewhat puzzled as to why suppressing Ku Xuan with your cultivation would trigger another plotline. What is their motive?]
…
“Longevity Ku Family…”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation content, his expression constantly changing.
Of course, if the Longevity Ku Family was plotting something, it would be normal for many Great Emperors in the Upper Realm not to know about it.
Besides, it is quite common for many imperial-tier forces to help the Longevity Ku Family cultivate subordinates and collude with the Great Emperors.
Nobody knows exactly how terrifying the foundations of the Longevity Ku Family are.
However, no one doubts that the Longevity Ku Family has the ability to cultivate Great Emperor-tier figures.
“If this world were written as a novel, I would suspect that the Longevity Ku Family is the Great BOSS Tier Power, and this Ku Xuan is framed to be the future boss,” Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
Of course, this is based on the premise of excluding the bizarre Tentacle: Source of Darkness and other All-Heaven Forces.
Otherwise, the Longevity Ku Family doesn’t qualify to be the boss.
“It doesn’t seem right, it’s strange. The Ku family probably can’t be compared, but this Source of Darkness has always been quite static, indicating that it’s been kept in check. You can temporarily ignore its existence. As for those people cultivated by the All-Heaven Forces, they also can’t stand in the Ku family’s way.”
“Longevity Ku Family must be aware of the existence of All-Heaven Forces and has had dealings with them many times, otherwise, they wouldn’t know the various ambushes and backstabbing. Since they dare to plan, they must have taken these factors into account. Some All-Heaven Forces might even be cooperating with the Longevity Ku family, both parties scheming together.”
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and his heart was restless.
“I really like to imagine things. However, the personality of this author profession is really unchangeable. Although, with my imagination, I’ve been helped quite a few times.”
Soon, Wang Ping returned to his senses, rubbing his temples, muttering a sentence to himself.
Then, he converged his thoughts, retracted his far-reaching thoughts, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 822: Chapter 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_2
[Next, you plan to figure out how to test Ku Xuan. If the key point in the development of this plot is that you have attracted Ku Xuan’s attention, then there is a way to get more information and make more accurate judgments.]
[So, you plan to act low-key, not interfere with the subsequent plot development, and try to restore the original plotline. Then, through testing, changing, and comparing in the next simulation, you can draw a conclusion.]
[Thinking of this, you are ready to take action. Next, you contact Yu Daohong directly, asking him to challenge you and take back his position as the first emperor’s child.]
[This leaves Yu Daohong full of confused question marks, not knowing what you’re thinking. Although others don’t know your situation, as the biological child of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, he naturally knows your situation. At this point, you have already reached the half-step Supreme level.]
[With such cultivation, it would only take a breath to crush him to death. At the beginning, when you hid your cultivation and fought him, it made him resentful, and you were really bullying him.]
[Seeing Yu Daohong staring at you with great hatred, you cough dryly, indicating that you have some things to confirm and must act low-key. Therefore, you hope Yu Daohong will have a fake match with you.]
[Yu Daohong falls silent, staring deeply at you. In the end, he chooses to help you once and has a match with you.]
[Eventually, you are defeated by Yu Daohong and lose your position as the first emperor’s child. This surprises many people in the outside world, who didn’t expect that you, the genius who had just emerged and defeated Yu Daohong, shocking the Upper Realm, would be directly defeated by Yu Daohong after many years of closed-door cultivation.]
[For a time, many forces and geniuses think they have overestimated you. At the same time, they believe that closed-door cultivation is not a good thing for geniuses. Geniuses need to grow faster through experience and confrontation with their peers. Blindly closing themselves off will only waste their talent and potential, letting others surpass them.]
[Knowing the reaction of the outside world, you are quite satisfied with the result and wait for the plot to develop.]
[However, although you are very satisfied, Wan Yu, who has already made it to the Saint ranking, is very puzzled and does not understand what you, his master, are thinking and why you are acting so low-key.]
[Of course, he doesn’t ask further, but continues to walk around the world as your disciple, trying to subdue those peers who disrespect you.]
[In the blink of an eye, several years have passed. The Immortal Continent has remained exciting during these years, and you have remained silent. Just at this time, as promised, the voice of the Immortal Mansion resounds throughout the Upper Realm, and the ten great universes reverberate with the news of the Immortal Gate opening and disasters approaching.]
[This piques your interest and makes you look forward to the upcoming developments. At the same time, you have some guesses in your heart that need to be verified one by one.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly fifty years have passed again. During these fifty years, you have been quietly cultivating and seeking enlightenment in Taiyi Emperor Tower in Taiyi Imperial Palace, hoping to comprehend the Spatial Dao Pattern as soon as possible, and still not caring about what’s happening outside, just letting your disciples and followers collect information.]
[Because of your behavior, many geniuses think you are not their competitor, just a greenhouse flower that only knows how to close itself off. As a result, the outside world’s attention to you continues to decline, your ranking on the Saint King Ranking keeps falling, and you become a total mess.]
[During these fifty years, top monsters from the Nine Mini Universes such as the young master of the Tianmu tribe have emerged one after another, flocking to the Immortal Continent, making it even more chaotic and lively. At the same time, many new stars have appeared.]
[Huan Qing, Huangyin, Ye Chen, Zhu Huowang, and others are all shining brightly. Even some unexpected people have emerged.]
[This person is Ye Xiaofan. Although he can’t be considered stunning, he does have a Sacred Body and has optimized it once. With the top-tier Ice Attribute Saint Body, he has joined an emperor’s palace specializing in ice attribute cultivation techniques and started to shine.]
[No one knows how he, as a loose cultivator, rose on the Elemental Star and survived until the Golden Age.]
[As for Qin Tian, although he has the Golden Immortal Achievement, his Golden Immortal Achievement is clearly different from the immortals in this world. Different worlds have different meanings for immortals, so his Golden Finger has not been effective. Not to mention, the existence of Golden Immortals in this world is a question in itself.]
[As a result, although he appeared with Ye Xiaofan and has been self-titled since then, he has long been indistinguishable from ordinary people, just appearing in the public eye as Ye Xiaofan’s follower. Even the world is quite puzzled about why the follower of Ye Xiaofan, a genius who can make the Saint King Ranking, is so weak and not even considered a genius.]
[Of course, Cai Yonglong is no different from ordinary people. However, because Cai Yonglong has always been hiding in the Taiyi Imperial Palace like you, few people know of his existence. However, in one aspect, Cai Yonglong is stronger than Qin Tian. That is, you take good care of Cai Yonglong, using your position in the heart of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to secure him many great resources, allowing Cai Yonglong to grow to the Saint King tier.]

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 823: Chapter 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_3
[ In the end, you don’t know about Lin Yuanyuan’s situation. Lin Yuanyuan disappeared without a trace since she parted ways with you a hundred thousand years ago. No one knows where she went, her cultivation level, or even whether she is alive or dead. ]
[ You have some guesses about this and think that Lin Yuanyuan might have really fallen. After all, the luck of you traversers is not very good. Even joining the Imperial Palace and relying on the Palace’s luck to make up for some defects in the luck aspect, plus defeating other geniuses to plunder some luck, it’s still somewhat lacking. It’s quite normal for them to fall due to various accidents. ]
[ Not to mention you traversers, even among those with local luck, geniuses with the potential of the Three Saints List and Quasi-Three Sages List would still fall and be directly killed by Ku Xuan, who is suspected as the mastermind. ]
[ As for Lin Yuanyuan’s situation, you are not optimistic about it. ]
[ In addition to those familiar or unfamiliar people who begin to make names for themselves, there are two people who catch your attention. These two people are Fang Xingyu from the Elemental Star Taoist Palace and Lin Yan, a loose cultivator from the Elemental Star. ]
[ As for Lin Yan, you don’t know what kind of secret he possesses, but originally you thought he was not simple. After coming to the Immortal Continent, you felt that he became ordinary like everyone else. Now, his talent and strength erupt once again, leaving you shocked. ]
[ Lin Yan seems to have cultivated a very strange Divine Soul Emperor Sutra and Illusionary Arts Emperor Sutra, which makes his combat power terrifying. Even without any special blood lineage or Special Constitution, he still defeated numerous geniuses who possessed Great Emperor Bloodlines or Sacred Bodies, becoming the object of admiration for ordinary cultivators without powerful bloodlines or constitutions. ]
[ As a result, he has many followers. The one with the same treatment as him is Zhu Huowang. Zhu Huowang also has an ordinary background, but he rose against the tide and became the object of admiration and pursuit for many small characters. ]
[ After all, in the Upper Realm, constitution and bloodline are crucial; starting with this advantage, they dominate many ordinary cultivators and cause despair amongst them. Throughout history, the characters who have appeared without special bloodlines and constitution, but have become Emperors and leave their names in history, are all their idols. ]
[ Living in the same era, people like Zhu Huowang and Lin Yan naturally become closer to them and act as their idols, with countless cultivators hoping that the two would soon become Emperors, trampling on those who rely on bloodlines and constitutions inherently, and making their hearts feel thrilled. ]
[ As for Fang Xingyu. His rise to fame is not because he is a monster himself. Fang Xingyu’s talent is also high and for some reason, he awoke the Star Saint Body, a relatively powerful constitution. However, the strength of this constitution ranks low in this era, so Fang Xingyu cannot squeeze into the Three Saints List. Although shining equally as a Quasi-Saint Ranking Genius, it’s still somewhat missing something. ]
[ Fang Xingyu’s fame depends on the Tao Tian Emperor Artifact. That’s right, the self-titled Tao Tian Emperor Artifact was obtained by Fang Xingyu, recognizing him as its master. In the eyes of others, no one among the many geniuses can hold an Emperor’s Artifact except Fang Xingyu. ]
[ After all, it’s an Emperor’s Artifact, which is too precious and powerful. Holding that thing, in terms of Earth, it’s equivalent to Fang Xingyu directly holding a gun while others are still using cold weapons like knives and swords. Under such circumstances, it would be strange if Fang Xingyu didn’t rise to fame. It can be said that Fang Xingyu is an object of envy and jealousy for many cultivators. ]
….
“Interesting, this Golden Age is getting more and more exciting, and all kinds of people are coming out.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, and secretly praised it in his heart.
It was a bit surprising that Fang Xingyu didn’t die, but it was also within reason.
After all, although not absolute, those who appear in the Text Simulation are generally not simple.
It’s normal for Fang Xingyu to survive the catastrophe of Dao Palace and obtain the most precious Emperor Artifact and inheritance from the Palace.
But as for Lin Yan, Wang Ping was somewhat surprised.
He knew that a person with a name might not necessarily be simple, but it was too unusual that Lin Yan not only made it to the Three Saints List but also suppressed many monster characters.
“The Emperor Scriptures are different, and although they have strengths and weaknesses, they are ultimately the same level of cultivation skill. It’s impossible for an ordinary genius without a bloodline or constitution to win against the strong with the weak, suppressing many geniuses. Unless, Lin Yan is cultivating an Immortal Sutra, then it is possible.”
“But is that possible? As for the Immortal Sutra, so far only Ku Xuan has cultivated it. None of the other people cultivated Immortal Sutras, which shows the preciousness of the Immortal Sutra.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, his eyes flickering, and he became more interested in Lin Yan.
However, if there is no Immortal Sutra, how can Lin Yan, as an ordinary cultivator, win against the strong with the weak? Even if he cultivates two Emperor Sutras, it’s also impossible.
Unless, his Divine Soul has a problem, and he has some hidden Divine Soul talent far beyond cultivators at the same level. This talent can make the power of the two Emperor Sutras reach an unimaginable level, that would be possible. This could also explain why he could resist the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint at that time. Because he has a Divine Soul talent and cultivates this aspect of the Emperor Sutra.”

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 229: The Future That Changes! The Emergence of the Devouring Soul Pearl! (A large 10,000-word chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 824: Chapter 229: The Future That Changes! The Emergence of the Devouring Soul Pearl! (A large 10,000-word chapter)_4
“So, this brat had hidden far too many cards during our initial simulated battle.”
“Heh, common cultivators have pursued the wrong hero, this Lin Yan is not worth their admiration, he’s too treacherous.”
Wang Ping shook his head and muttered.
“Something seems off.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping’s eyes narrowed slightly as he thought of a possibility, causing ripples in his heart.
There’s another scenario where Lin Yan doesn’t have any soul-related talent but possesses a technique that enhances his soul’s strength, making it far superior to other cultivators at the same level.
Regarding this technique, Wang Ping thought of something.
The Devouring Spirit tribe, Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Mana Pearl.
Zhu Huowang obtained the Devouring Spirit Pearl. Although his cultivation was mediocre and even considered to be very poor among his peers, he embarked on an invincible path of body refining, using his powerful physical body to overwhelm his enemies, even the peerless geniuses were no match for him.
Therefore, these three innate Emperor artifacts are a massive opportunity for average cultivators to make a comeback.
And Lin Yan might have gotten the Devouring Soul Pearl.
It’s precisely because he obtained the Devouring Soul Pearl, hence he was able to have a soul strength that his peers could not match, bringing the power of the two Emperor Scriptures to an unimaginable extent.
In turn, this also explains more easily why Lin Yan was able to kill the Remnant Soul of the Great Saint even though he was only at the True Divine Realm level.
With such a large gap, his mutation of soul, or any substantially powerful soul-type talent, would not suffice as an explanation. The likelihood of accomplishing this was very low.
After all, no matter how fantastic the talent, it is a basic principle in the face of substantial cultivation.
But things like innate Emperor artifacts don’t care about these, because innate Emperor artifacts themselves already possess vast power.
“If this is the case, then it seems another one of the three Devouring Emperor artifacts has appeared. It’s just uncertain who possesses the last Devouring Mana Pearl. If the three pearls appear together in this era, it may be possible to create an Immortal Artifact. At that time, I’m afraid it will trigger a war.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with a sharp light, a flurry of thoughts crossing his mind.
However, judging from the current intelligence and speculation, if not for my existence, these three Devouring Emperor artifacts will probably fall into Ku Xuan’s hands.
Whether it’s Zhu Huowang, or Lin Yan, or the possible future owner of the Devouring Mana Pearl, they will all serve as pawns for the cunning Ku Xuan.
Therefore, if Ku Xuan is indeed the mastermind and has the Devouring Immortal Demon Body as I surmise, these three devouring types, which could possibly be fused into an Immortal Artifact, would undoubtedly be tailor-made treasures for Ku Xuan.
Besides, my obedient disciple Lin Qinghe, would probably also become a sacrificial tool.
After all, there is nothing better than Lin Qinghe, the other Devouring Immortal Demon Body, to take the fall.
Letting Lin Qinghe be hunted down publicly in order for him to take the blame while Ku Xuan reaps the benefits, wouldn’t that be delightful?
“This Golden Age is indeed getting more interesting, with various types of people appearing one after another. However, if left unchecked, everyone else will ultimately just be a backdrop for Ku Xuan. In fact, even becoming a backdrop would be decent. Most geniuses would probably end up being his food, being completely devoured by him.”
Wang Ping sighed lightly, his heart was quite unsettled as he became increasingly wary of Ku Xuan and the methods of the Longevity Ku Family that he had backing him.
Then, Wang Ping composed his mind and continued watching the luminescent screen in silence, wanting to see how Ku Xuan would arrange things next.
…..
[Next, after you lamented for the Golden Age, you went to meet some acquaintances, and while reminiscing, the Immortal Mansion opened. It would take in the Heavenly Geniuses of the Upper Realm, select the Immortal Seedlings, and when the Immortal Gate opens, they will be allowed in to seek their Immortal Fate.]
[With the opening of the Immortal Mansion, countless cultivators went crazy and rushed towards the Immortal Mansion located on the Immortal Mountain. And you, along with your familiar fellows like Cai Yonglong, eagerly headed for the Immortal Mansion.]
[When you arrived at the Immortal Mansion, you found that a large number of young cultivators had already gathered outside in the Immortal City. These young cultivators were at least Saints. Cultivators below the Saint Realm, unless they are highly talented but haven’t reached the Saint Realm due to their age, the rest that haven’t stepped into the Saint Realm have no qualifications to set foot in the Immortal City, let alone enter the Immortal Mansion.]
[Many cultivators are self-aware. But in this world, there are always some who lack self-awareness, cultivators who harbor foolish hopes. These cultivators carrying foolish hopes were unanimously ridiculed, suppressed, and driven away.]
[This made many cultivators quite indignant, thinking that those from the major powers were too domineering. The opening of the Immortal Mansion signifies an opportunity for everyone. Their domineering expulsion of them is indeed detestable. Perhaps, they are the ones destined to obtain the Immortal Fate. After all, who decreed that the Immortal Fate would certainly choose a genius?]
[However, the disgruntlement of many minor power cultivators was suppressed even more overbearingly. After an irascible supreme casually killed a group of loose cultivators, these cultivators were all as silent as cicadas in winter, frantically fleeing, not daring to think about entering the Immortal City.]
[After witnessing this scene, you felt a myriad of emotions, very melancholic. This is the sadness of weak loose cultivators. When you were in the lower realm, you struggled the exact same way. But you eventually managed to survive thanks to the Life Simulator, standing at the peak.]
[However, that’s just you, as a game cheater. In all heavens, countless living beings are struggling in such a way, only to meet a depressing end.]

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 825: Chapter 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_5
[While you are lost in thought, you find that a little female Taoist with a cultivation level of only True Divine Realm is still stubbornly heading towards the Immortal City, carrying an extremely weak little male Taoist, instead of following the crowd away.]
[This surprises you quite a bit. After all, a True Divine, daring to face such great pressure and risk being crushed by a single glance, requires unimaginable courage that ordinary people would not have.]
[For this reason, you become somewhat interested in the little female Taoist carrying the weak male Taoist. Just as you become intrigued, the Supreme who made a move earlier sees that there are still people daring to come forward, which seems to defy his Supreme authority. This displeases him, and he snorts coldly.]
[The Supreme’s cold snort carries immense power, enough to kill a Saint. Therefore, if left unchecked, the little female Taoist carrying the weak male Taoist will undoubtedly die.]
[Just when you are about to break the Supreme’s might and save the little female Taoist, an unexpected figure makes a move.]
[This person is none other than Ku Xuan. He chooses to save the two, breaking the Supreme’s might. This surprises all the Heavenly individuals, wondering why Ku Xuan would save these two loose cultivators.]
[Especially you, narrowing your eyes, silently staring at Ku Xuan. Ku Xuan’s actions must have an unknown purpose. Now that he chooses to save the little female Taoist carrying the weak male Taoist, there must be some ulterior motive.]
[Perhaps, the two little ones have extraordinary talents that Ku Xuan has noticed. Or maybe they are crucial to some arrangements of Ku Xuan. But, no matter which situation it is, you must pay attention to these two little ones. Even in future simulations, you might save people ahead of them.]
[Just when various thoughts flash through your mind, Ku Xuan gives a faint smile, gracefully stating that the Supreme’s actions are too much. The two are still young and have reached the True Divine cultivation. The obvious talent makes them qualified to participate in the Immortal Mansion review. Afterward, Ku Xuan says that in the cultivation path, harmony should be valued, and excessive slaughter makes it hard to achieve enlightenment.]
[Hearing these words, many cultivators admire Ku Xuan, thinking that he is a righteous person, even though he is the young master of Longevity Ku Family. He doesn’t have a haughty temperament and is willing to protect ordinary young cultivators, even scolding the Supreme.]
[Seeing Ku Xuan speak this way, the Supreme smiles and also becomes friendly, not daring to argue with Ku Xuan. With that, this farce comes to an end.]
[As for you, you stare deeply at Ku Xuan, feeling that he is definitely acting, a true smiling tiger.]
[While you are gazing at Ku Xuan, he also glances at you with his peripheral vision, his gaze profound. However, his peripheral vision is so concealed that you don’t notice it.]
…
“This guy… indeed has a problem. Moreover, he seems to care a lot about me. The root of this is definitely not just because I come from All Heavens…”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation and thinks to himself.
However, no matter what you think or plan, as long as you don’t know about my Life Simulator, all your plans will be shattered by me!
Even if you find out about it in the Life Simulator, it’s futile if you don’t know about it in reality.
This is Wang Ping’s biggest advantage. No matter how powerful you are, as long as you haven’t exceeded the maximum limit of the Life Simulator, those masterminds will be waiting for Wang Ping to kill them.
Especially this Ku Xuan guy, who seems to be the prodigy born just when the Golden Age is about to begin.
If I kill his parents or ancestors directly, will he still be born? This is a real question.
What does it matter, even if I can’t beat you, I can still make sure you are never born?
Thinking about this, Wang Ping’s expression becomes subtle.
“Of course, the possibility of not defeating him is very low. As the Life Simulator progresses, I don’t even need to use these kinds of methods to beat him.”
Wang Ping shakes his head, putting away those messy thoughts and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, Ku Xuan acts as if nothing happened, facing the little female Taoist’s admiring gaze, and leads the little female Taoist carrying the weak male Taoist into the Immortal City.]
[As for you, you have no intention of continuing to watch the show and begin to wander around the bustling Immortal City.]
[The current Immortal City gathers the Heavenly prodigies of the Upper Realm, and all kinds of old monsters appear here. Many people start to set up stalls to buy things out of interest. Therefore, there is a chance to get good things at a bargain.]
[While you are strolling around, you accidentally bump into a person. This person is Tian Zhaoyun, the young master of the Tianmu Clan. Behind him are obviously his Heavenly Supreme Protector, his Supreme servant, and some young followers.]
[That Supreme servant is the Ordinary Supreme whom you overpowered in the previous simulation. You obtained a golden light jade charm from him, which left an impression on you. You also speculated that there must be some secret involved.]
[Unfortunately, there was no such reward in the previous simulation. Even if it had been refreshed, you didn’t have three options and could only miss it.]
[However, since you missed it last time, you want to get it this time and continue to study it. Perhaps it holds a great opportunity that could help you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 826: Chapter 229: The Changed Future! The Soul Devouring Bead Appears! (A massive chapter!)_6
[As you gaze at the young master of the Tianmu tribe, he is also staring at you with a kind and warm expression. He greets you, kindly stating that he had heard rumors that the second emperor’s son of the Taiyi Emperor’s Palace was just a person with an empty reputation, but now it seems that it was just a rumor.]
[Hearing the words of the young master of the Tianmu tribe, you squint your eyes and look into his eyes. This Origin Divine Eye is truly amazing, as it can actually see through some of his secrets. You should know, he is carrying a treasure of the Taiyi Emperor’s Palace. The only effect of this treasure is to conceal his aura.]
[With this treasure on your person, unless an Emperor takes a serious look at your details, even if you were a Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection realm cultivator, they wouldn’t be able to see through you.]
[However, the young master of the Tianmu tribe seems to have seen through some of your secrets. Obviously, it is thanks to the Origin Divine Eye. And these divine eyes should have been the natural talent of Tian Yan, the unfortunate collateral member of the Tianmu family.]
[Although you had decided to restore the simulation to its original state for the sake of seclusion and breakthrough, thus Tian Yan didn’t become your disciple in this life, and it’s very likely that he was already killed. However, since you had already formed a master-disciple relationship in the last life and even improved your cultivation because of it, you naturally regard him as your disciple.]
[Now that your disciple’s enemy has seen through some of your details using his eyes, it naturally makes you hold a murderous intent towards him.]
[Seeing your murderous intent, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe reveals a slight change in his expression, knitting his brows, asking if he has offended you unknowingly and is ready to apologize if it’s something he did wrong.]
[Hearing this, you withdraw your killing intent, and your mood becomes peaceful once more. It seems that the Origin Divine Eyes can see through emotions like malice and killing intent. These eyes are indeed very useful.]
[Next, you smile slightly, saying that the young master of the Tianmu Tribe looks like a past enemy of yours, which is why you instinctively reacted and hope he can forgive you for that.]
[The young master of the Tianmu Tribe looks deeply into your eyes, then bursts into hearty laughter. He states that it doesn’t matter, and since you are both destined to meet, you should go for a drink.]
[You give a faint smile and don’t refuse. Accompanied by Cai Yonglong, Wan Yu, and Lin Qinghe, you go to have a drink with the young master of the Tianmu Tribe. During the process, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe doesn’t try to test you. Instead, he discusses the Tao and bonds with you.]
[As for this, you think that this cruel-hearted person is indeed deep and scheming, and he might be a troublesome opponent in the future.]
[After that, you feel that the time is ripe and express your intention to make a deal with the young master of the Tianmu Tribe’s supreme servant. This makes everyone present quite surprised, especially the Supreme Servant, who is even more astonished as he didn’t expect someone as big as you to make a deal with an Ordinary Supreme like him who has reached the peak of his potential.]
[Then he looks at the young master of the Tianmu Tribe, and after gaining his approval, he agrees to make a deal with a bright smile. Next, you propose the requirement to exchange golden light jade charm.]
[This makes the supreme servant of the Tianmu Tribe somewhat surprised. His heart instantly heats up as he guesses that this golden light jade charm must be something incredibly precious, even more than he imagined, or else it wouldn’t have attracted the attention of a person like you.]
[For a while, the supreme servant becomes very active in his thoughts, feigning ignorance about the golden light jade charm, and doesn’t want to make a deal with you.]
[However, at this moment, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe chuckles and asks the supreme servant to hand it over, stating that since you are interested in it, he would consider it as a token of friendship and present it to you. Although he doesn’t know the misunderstanding between you and him, he is very willing to make friends with you, and hopes that whatever disagreements there are, can be resolved.]
[This makes you quite surprised. This young master of the Tianmu Tribe is indeed a talent and someone not to be underestimated. If it were any other heaven’s favored child who didn’t know his details, they might immediately develop admiration and affection for him.]
[To be honest, you are also somewhat admiring this guy’s style. If he doesn’t fall midway, there is indeed a possibility for him to become an Emperor of Tao Proving in the future and one of the heaven’s favored children competing for the immortal fate.]
[As for the supreme servant, although he’s reluctant and helpless, since the young master of the Tianmu Tribe has already said this, if he doesn’t hand it over, he’s undoubtedly slapping his own young master’s face. So, he can only take out the golden light jade charm with a heartache and hand it over to you.]
[At this, you smile faintly, expressing that you accept the young master of the Tianmu Tribe’s goodwill gesture and that there’ll be the opportunity to ‘form an alliance’ in the future.]
[Hearing your words, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe laughs heartily, stating that if there is an opportunity, an alliance can be indeed formed to compete for the immortal fate. After all, once you reach the Immortal Mansion, it’s no longer a place for solo battles.]
[Afterward, you continue to exchange pleasantries, and after a drinking session, you part ways.]
[After leaving, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe’s supreme servant expresses his frustration as to why his young master would try to win over the second emperor’s son of the Taiyi Emperor’s Palace when there are more formidable candidates like Yu Daohong to recruit.]
[Hearing this, the young master of the Tianmu Tribe, Tian Zhaoyun’s, expression becomes cold and detached. He calmly says that he couldn’t see through all your details, but he can tell that your cultivation is definitely not as simple as the surface’s 1th Tier of Great Saint. At the same time, you also give him a very dangerous feeling.]
[Therefore, although he is not afraid of you, it’s better to resolve an enemy when possible. Even if you can’t become friends, you must not become mortal enemies; otherwise, having too many enemies within the Immortal Mansion is not conducive to seizing the immortal fate.]
….
