“So, this kid didn’t see through most of my secrets, just a little bit. I thought the Origin Divine Eye was so heaven-defying.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the Text Simulation with a subtle expression.
“But it’s normal. Even Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection can’t see through me, let alone an undeveloped Origin Divine Eye. If it could, it would be an Immortal eye-tier instead of this level of talent.”
Wang Ping shakes his head and lets out a sigh.
“Getting the golden light jade charm is an unexpected joy. The only thing I don’t know is the whereabouts of that unlucky boy Tian Yan and whether he’s still alive.”
Then Wang Ping’s eyes flicker as he thinks about this problem again.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World
chapters.content:
Chapter 827: Chapter 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World
“Since that kid is following the Huangtian Emperor template, even if it’s just a low-end version of it, it shouldn’t be so easy for him to fall. Back then, if I didn’t take action, he might not have died and would have been saved by a top-notch expert. Of course, this premise is that I’m not his savior. If the Heavenly Tao had arranged me to be his savior, then it would have been all over.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and sighed.
Afterward, Wang Ping didn’t bother to think more about Tian Yan’s matter and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
[You didn’t take the words of the young master of the Tianmu Clan to heart. You two are ultimately enemies. Even though you don’t want to be involved in more things in this life, and your main goal is to secretly investigate the truth and dig out the purpose of Ku Xuan and the Ku family, you don’t want to deal with other matters or confront other enemies for now.]
[Next, you continue strolling around Immortal City. Although you’ve been provoked by many talented youths and been challenged to various fights. Those youths, especially the rising stars, want to defeat you to prove themselves and gain fame and resources.]
[Although your fame in the outer world has weakened, you were once ranked fifth on the Saint King Ranking, so defeating you still has great benefits.]
[For these challenges, you chose to reject them all. As a result, these talented youths despise you, thinking that you don’t even dare to accept a challenge and are not worthy of being called a genius. Some extremists even think that your past position on the Saint King Ranking was a disgrace, lowering its value.]
[Listening to the ridicule and provocations of these talented youths, you remain indifferent, but your disciples Wan Yu and Lin Qinghe are quite upset. Especially Wan Yu, since awakening the Black Abyss Demon Body, his temper has become increasingly cold and domineering. He wishes to fight on your behalf against these people for hundreds of rounds.]
[For this, you calmly stopped his actions, stating that there was no point in bickering with these courageous but impulsive people. This irritated the crowd even more, and they mocked you even more.]
[At the height of anger, Yu Daohong appeared and helped you out, dispersing the other talented youths. Facing Yu Daohong, they dared not be hostile, so after mocking you one last time, they chose to leave.]
[As for Yu Daohong, he looked at you helplessly, not understanding what you were thinking. Despite having unparalleled strength among the younger generation, you chose to be so low-key.]
[You didn’t say much, just chuckled, suggesting that since you two met, you could go shopping together, alright?]
[As for your invitation, Yu Daohong didn’t refuse and agreed. Subsequently, you walked together, and Yu Daohong told you about the current situation in Immortal City, including how many powers and geniuses had gathered. Some powers were hidden, and some monsters had not entered the Three Saints List, but still had the strength to make the cut.]
[Yu Daohong stated that he wouldn’t bother mentioning the well-known and elite disciples nurtured by major powers. Among the monsters who could contend with you for Immortal Fate, there were several who needed your attention.]
[Most of these monsters, like you, came from All Heavens and were disciples they cultivated in the Upper Realm. The Prince Owlslaughter from Slaughter Paradise; Beast Son·Yuan E from Abyss Lands, and the Nine Stars Reserves from the Nine Stars Pavilion. The Nine Stars Pavilion is a special power, with the Nine Stars possessing Emperor-level strength, and their battle prowess is unfathomable.]
[However, the Nine Stars Pavilion’s members have mixed identities. Therefore, although the Nine Stars Pavilion could be considered one of the strongest powers with a double-digit number of Emperor-level combatants, they are not united, harboring ulterior motives, so other powers don’t particularly fear the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[Of course, since Immortal Mansion is about to open, no one knows whether the Nine Stars of the Nine Stars Pavilion and their Nine Stars Reserves will team up for the Immortal Fate or still fight individually.]
[If they still fight individually, each of the Nine Stars Reserves should be equivalent to the top thirty in the Great Saint Ranking. But if they unite, they would probably be able to easily suppress even the first monster in the Great Saint Ranking.]
[Listening to Yu Daohong’s explanation, you found it quite interesting, feeling that he was like a walking encyclopedia. At the same time, you also became interested in the Nine Stars Pavilion. You learned about their existence in your earlier simulations.]
[However, at the time, you just casually joined the Nine Stars Pavilion once, and your understanding of it wasn’t very deep. After that, you were continually investigating other matters, and although you wanted to join the Nine Stars Pavilion several times, you missed the opportunities.]
[Now hearing about the Nine Stars Pavilion again, you have a clearer idea of its strength. The Nine Stars Reserves, none of whom are weaker than those in the Great Saint Ranking’s top thirty, are quite terrifying.]
[After all, the current Great Saint Ranking isn’t like the previous one, full of all sorts of people. The current Great Saint Ranking, like the Saint King Ranking and Saint Ranking, can only be entered by top-notch geniuses. Many geniuses were eliminated by those top emerging geniuses, including Qin Yue, who was defeated several times and is now ranked tenth in the Great Saint Ranking.]
[As a result, there are no weaklings on the Great Saint Ranking, and their cultivation has all reached the Half-step Supreme level.]

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! Glittering Great World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 828: Chapter 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! Glittering Great World_2
“[Ranking among the top thirty is truly terrifying. Nine individuals on par with the top thirty of the Great Saint Ranking hold such immense value that it’s enough to cause any prodigy to feel a chill at their scalp.]”
“[Following that, you’re reminded of the affairs related to Slaughter Paradise. Slaughter Paradise’s exploits in this world are quite formidable, their assassination techniques are eerily effective, causing much fear among cultivators. Well, since you and Slaughter Paradise are mortal enemies, the head of the Imperial Prince Owlslaughter from Slaughter Paradise is as good as claimed by you.]”
“[While you’re chatting with Yu Daohong, you encounter two people. These two are none other than Ji Bingyan and Ji Ziqing.]”
“[The current Ji Bingyan leaves you rather astonished, her cultivation has reached the Saint King level, and her foundation is solid, it’s clearly not a rushed accomplishment. At the same time, you can feel a terrifying cold presence emanating from Ji Bingyan, it’s apparent she possesses an extremely powerful ice ability.]”
“[As for Ji Ziqing, your impression of the child is still of him being Ji Bingyan’s younger brother, a waste material, holding some animosity towards you. However, the current image of Ji Ziqing is clearly different from your past memories.]”
“[The current Ji Ziqing emits a profound aura, his cultivation has also reached the Saint King level, his growth speed is startling. You have a sense that he may be another Waste Material Stream Luck Child, as you’ve encountered several of such characters before.]”
“[Because of this, you can’t help but take a second look at Ji Ziqing. Waste material often conceal great secrets, without which, it would be impossible to grow from a waste material to this level. Like Zhu Huowang, Ye Chen, and Lin Yan, they all have their own Heaven-defying encounters. You’re curious as to what encounter this could be.]”
“[Right as you’re sizing up Ji Ziqing, Ji Bingyan greets you, her attitude quite familiar.]”
“[In response, you chuckle and greet Ji Bingyan in return, introducing Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu to her. There’s no need to introduce Cai Yonglong, of course. During this process, Ji Ziqing continues to stare at you, his eyes flashing with a mix of caution and resentment.]”
….
“Could this child have sister complex?”
Looking at the content on the Text Simulation, Wang Ping’s expression was rather peculiar.
In previous simulations, the child was also unhappy with him.
That time, it seemed to also be because Ji Bingyan appeared rather close to him.
If so, this boy possibly could be jealous due to his affection for his sister, Ji Bingyan.
“What a crafty boy.”
Wang Ping felt somewhat speechless, and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
“[Next, Ji Bingyan introduces Ji Ziqing to you, stating that Ji Ziqing is their Jee family’s hope, moreover, he recently defeated the Jee Family’s Emperor’s Son and became their new Emperor’s Son.]”
“[Hearing Ji Bingyan’s words, think contemplatively as you stare at Ji Ziqing. Your previous feeling of him being not simple has been upgraded.]”
“[After all, even though the present Jee family’s Emperor’s Son is quite average in the Upper Realm, hardly being able to claim a place in the Quasi-Three Sages List, he remains an Imperial Prince-level figure. Being able to surpass him from behind is quite commendable.]”
“[Of course, should he truly turn out to be the Waste Material Stream Luck Child, having this kind of achievement is only natural. Perhaps he’s still hiding a lot more. If not, it is possible that he might reach the Saint King Ranking as Zhu Huowang and Ye Chen did, which holds immense value.]”
“[Naturally, although you think highly of Ji Ziqing, you still don’t pay much attention to him. He can’t be of any help to you in this simulation, and maintaining a good relationship with him serves no purpose. Unless you could find out what kind of encounter he had, and hijack some benefits in future simulations, then there would be some value to it.]”
“[In addition, if you could recruit him as a disciple in advance, that might bring some advantages. However, you feel that to maximize the benefits, it’d be better to wait until your breakthrough to the Supreme Realm.]”
“[Currently, if you want to use the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to breakthrough to the Supreme Realm, you feel like you must at least recruit a prodigy ranked in the top ten of the Three Saints List as a disciple.]”
“[Even if you recruit a monster ranked in the top ten of the Three Saints List as a disciple, there’s no guarantee that you’ll breakthrough. The Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples can only enhance cultivation, not enlightenment. To reach the Tao Proving Supreme stage, transform the Tao Pattern into Tao Fruit, win the recognition of the Heavenly Tao, and prove the Tao, enlightenment is required. It could be said that the proportion of enlightenment is quite large.]”
“[Therefore, you’re skeptical about whether you can breakthrough to the Tao Proving Supreme stage through the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples. You believe that attempting to seek opportunities for Enlightenment yourself, then recruiting disciples to enhance your cultivation after rapidly breaking through to the Supreme Realm is more secure.]”
“[In considering these things, the short-term value of Ji Ziqing to you declines even further. Therefore, there’s no need to pay him any special attention. It must be said that you’re quite pragmatic.]”
“[Next, after chatting and laughing with Ji Bingyan for a while, you promise Ji Bingyan that if she could enter the Immortal Mansion and encounters any difficulties, you can provide some assistance. This promise leaves Ji Bingyan very grateful and elated.]”
“[However, this makes Ji Ziqing even more displeased, he coldly snorts and claims Ji Bingyan does not need your protection, his own protection is enough.]”
“[Ji Ziqing’s exceedingly impolite words cause a frown to form on your face. Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu also frown, feeling that Ji Ziqing is acting too arrogant. Ji Bingyan is quite embarrassed and quickly pulls Ji Ziqing back, apologizing to you.]”

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 230 The Immortal Mansion Opens! Brilliant World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 829: Chapter 230 The Immortal Mansion Opens! Brilliant World_3
[However, Ji Ziqing didn’t show any signs of remorse. After staring at you coldly, he simply walked away. You were speechless at his attitude, but you didn’t have any interest in bothering with this arrogant kid and continued talking with Ji Bingyan while walking.]
[After Ji Ziqing distanced himself from you, he became extremely annoyed. He found the subconscious affection of this body for Ji Bingyan to be very bothersome. If it weren’t for that, he wouldn’t have been so emotional.]
[Ji Ziqing felt that in order to completely eliminate this risk, he might have to truly win Ji Bingyan’s affection and become her Tao Companion, or possibly kill all the men close to her.]
[That being the case, he made a decision to devise a way to win Ji Bingyan’s heart and kill you.]
…
“Huh?”
Wang Ping was quite surprised to see the text simulation suddenly switch to a God’s eye view.
He didn’t expect that Ji Ziqing wasn’t the lucky Son of Fortune who rose from being a waste to a cultivator, but rather, a victim of a Body Possession.
The intense hostility he showed towards Wang Ping was due to the influence of the subconscious of the body he inhabited, not his own intention.
“So, Ji Ziqing was just an unfortunate victim of a body possession?”
Wang Ping murmured, frowning slightly.
However, this guy appearing next to Ji Bingyan wasn’t a good thing at all – continue this way, and trouble would ensue sooner or later.
Plus, it was clear that this guy wanted to kill him.
“In that case, I shall act first. I’ll remove this hidden threat first. I am not interested in always being in someone’s crosshairs, waiting for them to set a trap to kill me.”
Immediately, a murderous intent appeared in Wang Ping’s eyes as he targeted Ji Ziqing.
However, the Jee family has produced an Emperor and their Great Emperor Sutra, which is connected to reincarnation, is very special among all Emperor Scriptures. Unless an extremely long Last Dharma Age occurs, their Great Emperor Sutra can ensure the family lineage perpetuates indefinitely. With it, a ruthless splitting of the soul results in a cultivation speed faster than Same Realm Cultivators. The downside, however, is an insufficient attack strength, which is weaker than other Emperor Scriptures.
In such a family, theoretically, it should be impossible for anyone to get possessed. Once a possession occurs, it would be detected by the family’s Emperor Scripture, which would then eradicate the possessor.
If it fails to eradicate the possessor, it would self-destruct.
However, Ji Ziqing was surprisingly possessed.
This was clearly an abnormal situation.
“According to the plot of novels I’ve read before, this should be considered a case of Rebirth by Possession, an abnormal situation caused by the Heavenly Tao meddling.”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, various thoughts flashing through his mind.
Only the meddling of the Heavenly Tao could bypass the Jee family’s defensive measures.
“I wonder about the cultivation of the guy who possessed Ji Ziqing in his previous life. If his cultivation was very high and his memory is largely intact, then it would really become troublesome. It would be difficult to deal with him in this simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, his expression turning slightly serious.
The most classic type of Rebirth by Possession is the rebirth of an Immortal Emperor.
In this Profound World, if a being at the level of a Great Emperor was resurrected, it would be an overwhelming existence for the younger generation.
This is because an Emperor’s comprehension of the Dao, cultivation levels in the Emperor Scripture, and various methods would all constitute a dimension-reducing attack for the younger generations.
“It can’t be an Emperor. An Emperor wouldn’t have such an impatient disposition. It’s highly likely to be a Supreme being that was reborn.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and made a judgement.
Even if it were an Emperor being reborn, there is no way they would be influenced by the subconscious of a body, especially not that of an ordinary useless child. It’s even more impossible.
If an Emperor was that weak, then it would not be worthy to be called an Emperor. It would be simply too humiliating.
In fact, Wang Ping didn’t even think a Quasi-Emperor would behave this way.
Only a Supreme, especially an Ordinary Supreme, would be affected to such an extent.
Aside from that, only if Ji Ziqing was possessed by an Ordinary Supreme being would it not cause a dimensional reduction attack on the younger generation. Instead, it would continue a fair competition among them.
Otherwise, what’s the point in the younger generation competing? It would simply turn into a show with Ji Ziqing as the attention seeker.
Soon, Wang Ping calmed his mind, actively entered the immersive simulation state, fed the information to the simulated Wang Ping, then exited the immersive simulation and entered the text simulation state again.
[Upon learning of Ji Ziqing’s situation, you began to harbor murderous intentions towards him, contemplating how to get rid of him unnoticed.]
[After your contemplation, you turned your attention to Yu Daohong. After you parted with Ji Bingyan, you were hoping that Yu Daohong would do you a favor.]
[Your abrupt request made Yu Daohong instantly cautious because he thought you were up to no good. The last time, you had him participate in a sham contest with you. Now, he was certain you were up to something again.]
[Seeing how wary Yu Daohong had become, you maintained a warm and friendly demeanor, assuring him that if he helped you, he would be helping the Taiyi Imperial Palace and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. After all, the ideal of Religion Ascension desired by the Taiyi Imperial Palace still needed him to fulfill. If Yu Daohong didn’t help you, could he face the nurturing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had given him?]
[Your words left Yu Daohong’s face darkened, as you emotionally manipulated him making him quite uncomfortable. In the end, he agreed to help, stating this was the last time he would do so, no matter what you asked of him in the future, he wouldn’t agree to it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 830: Chapter 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World_4
[Hearing this, you chuckled and assured him that this was definitely the last time. Seeing that you agreed, Yu Daohong didn’t say much, just asked you to quickly explain the favor you wanted from him.]
[Without hesitation, you expressed your wish for Yu Daohong to probe the background of Ji Ziqing while hiding his identity. If possible, you’d like the assassins from Slaughter Paradise to eliminate him.]
[Your request made Yu Daohong frown deeply and stare at you intently, not understanding why you wanted to kill Ji Ziqing. After all, you had a good relationship with the Ji family, and this shouldn’t be something you’d do. Though Ji Ziqing was rude, his behavior didn’t deserve death.]
[However, Yu Daohong didn’t show any interest in asking why you wanted to do this. Since you were the true first emperor’s son and the hope of Taiyi Imperial Palace, he wouldn’t question your motives for killing. What he needed to do was to assist you in obtaining the Immortal Fate and clear some obstacles for you within his capabilities.]
[After that, Yu Daohong left directly to complete the task given to him, while you continued to wander leisurely around the Immortal City with Lin Qinghe and the others, gathering some intelligence to prepare for the opening of the Immortal Mansion.]
[In the blink of an eye, three days had passed, and the Immortal City grew increasingly bustling, with heavenly music announcing that the Immortal Mansion would open the next day. The geniuses were advised to get ready and face the challenges of the Immortal Mansion, as only those who passed the Immortal Mansion trial could join its ranks.]
[This made the many geniuses of the Upper Realm show their determination, adjusting their state to be at their best, hoping to perform exceedingly well the next day. As for the talents on the Three Saints List and the Quasi-Three Sages List, they showed no concern, cultivating naturally without pressure. If even they couldn’t pass the Immortal Mansion trial, then only a few people would be able to enter the Immortal Mansion.]
[Today, Yu Daohong returned with some news. According to his investigation, Ji Ziqing was not a simple character. He should have hidden his cultivation, reaching the Great Saint Tier in actuality.]
[Besides that, Yu Daohong also noted that Ji Ziqing’s combat power was extremely terrifying, not only proficient in various Great Arrays, but also suspected to be skilled in Alchemy and comprehending the Tao Pattern. Yu Daohong himself was no match for Ji Ziqing and almost got heavily injured. If it weren’t for his Dao Protector’s intervention, his identity might have been exposed.]
[In the end, Yu Daohong said with great solemnity that being able to comprehend the Tao Pattern at the early stage of the Great Saint Tier was extremely rare, and almost no one had accomplished it before. He felt that Ji Ziqing might become your formidable opponent.]
[Listening to Yu Daohong’s words, you pondered thoughtfully. Ji Ziqing really seemed to be a supreme being reborn through Body Possession. In his previous life, he might have been a master of Array Mana and Alchemy. That’s why Ji Ziqing became so strong in such a short time, even helping Ji Bingyan improve her cultivation.]
[In the Upper Realm, there are many Alchemists, but powerful Alchemists are rare. Because refining elixirs is also related to cultivation, to make a Supreme-tier Elixir, one must have Supreme-tier Cultivation or possess an extremely terrifying flame.]
[Because of these harsh conditions, there are few Supreme Alchemists in the Upper Realm, and even the Imperial-tier forces have only a handful of them. If a faction had a Supreme Alchemist, it would be much easier to cultivate disciples.]
[After all, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures that can help cultivators effortlessly improve their cultivation, refine their Physical Body, and assist in Enlightenment are hard to find. However, high-quality Alchemists can turn decay into magical elixirs, refining those not-so-precious treasured medicines into elixirs that greatly benefit cultivation.]
[However, high-quality Alchemists were basically monopolized by the Elixir Tower. The influence of the Elixir Tower throughout the Upper Realm was extremely terrifying, unmatched by most factions.]
[If Ji Ziqing was a Supreme Alchemist in his previous life, combined with the special Secret Skill of the Jee family, he would be able to swallow pills like crazy and rapidly improve his cultivation. After all, the Jee family’s Secret Skill allows them to split their souls—one to consume the elixir, one to expel the elixir toxins and consolidate their cultivation, and another one for enlightenment.]
[The Jee family of the past lacked high-quality Alchemists, and if they had them, they wouldn’t have reached their current state.]
[Seeing you deep in thought, Yu Daohong assured you that you didn’t need to worry too much since he had concealed his identity during this mission and hadn’t been exposed. However, the Ji family had noticed his actions, and they began to comprehensively protect Ji Ziqing, making it difficult to try anything again.]
[You chuckled, indicating that you didn’t care as you had obtained enough information already. Then, you asked Yu Daohong if he had registered a bounty on Ji Ziqing’s head at Slaughter Paradise.]
[Hearing this, Yu Daohong’s face darkened. He had incurred injuries while doing your bidding and almost exposed his identity, but you didn’t care about him. Not only had you not provided any medicine for his wounds, but you also went directly to ask about the bounty. It was simply ruthless.]
[After that, Yu Daohong grumpily said that he would place the bounty if you paid him the money. If you didn’t pay, then he wouldn’t do anything.]
[Seeing Yu Daohong annoyed, you coughed awkwardly, admitting that you currently faced financial difficulties. You asked him to cover the cost first and promised to pay him back later.]

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 831: Chapter 230: The Opening of the Immortal Mansion! A Dazzling World_5
[This made Yu Daohong’s face twitch, wishing he could really quit on the spot. However, in the end, he gritted his teeth and glared at you, indicating that this would be the last time, or else he would kill you.]
[You laughed and assured him that this was the last billion times, and as a fellow Taiyi Imperial Palace Prince, you considered him like a close younger brother, so you wouldn’t keep tricking him.]
[Yu Daohong’s face darkened, and he left after muttering a curse word. Seeing this, Cai Yonglong looked at you with a strange expression, admiring Mr. Wang’s unique charm.]
[In the blink of an eye, another day passed. The Immortal Mansion was opened, and numerous people turned into Divine Halos to fly to the Immortal Mansion. The big shots in the Immortal Continent were gazing into the direction of the Immortal Mansion, their eyes deep, lost in thought.]
[Among them, some Emperors even thought about testing the Immortal Mansion to see if it could still hold the scene like it did in ancient times. However, in the end, he suppressed the idea. The Immortal Mansion was too mysterious and powerful. If its foundation was still intact, even an Emperor could fall if they acted against it.]
[Therefore, unless all the Great Emperors joined forces, or someone figured out the details of the Immortal Mansion, attempting to forcibly attack the Immortal Mansion would be a self-destructive action and not worth it. So, it would be better to let their disciples enter the Immortal Mansion first, compete for the Immortal Fate, and investigate the Immortal Mansion further.]
[As various thoughts were buzzing around, you arrived at the gate of the Immortal Mansion with others, only to see a barrier like Immortal Light enveloping the gate of the Immortal Mansion.]
[At that moment, another immortal-sounding voice came from within the Immortal Mansion, saying that the first threshold for entering the Immortal Mansion was age. Only the young ones were qualified to enter, while those who were practicing again, body possession practitioners, and those who were older were not allowed to enter.]
[Hearing this, some cultivators thought this threshold was too low and began to fly in. You, Cai Yonglong, and others entered effortlessly without encountering any obstacles. Most of the geniuses also encountered no obstacles.]
[However, you witnessed a shocking scene. A large number of geniuses were stopped outside. The heads of the older ones would display the word “exceeded age limit,” while the heads of those who were practicing again and body possession practitioners would also display corresponding words. The Immortal Light was truly miraculous.]
[This surprised you, as you didn’t expect so many people who were practicing again and body possession practitioners to be mixed in, hoping to enter the Immortal Mansion with a stroke of luck. You couldn’t help but admire their boldness.]
[In this era, no matter the force, the management of body possession practitioners and those who were practicing again was extremely strict. They were not allowed to compete with the real younger generation, as it wouldn’t be fair and could easily stifle the growth of true geniuses.]
[Just as you were amazed, some people from the relevant forces discovered that there were problems within their own forces. Their faces instantly turned gloomy, and they captured those body possession practitioners and those who were practicing again one by one. You could only imagine the miserable fate awaiting them.]
[You looked at Ji Ziqing’s direction and found that he seemed to be a bit scared, seemingly not expecting the Immortal Light to be so bizarre. However, he showed a hint of joy, apparently realizing that his situation was special, and he didn’t have to worry so much in the future.]
[Seeing this, you narrowed your eyes, thinking that Ji Ziqing was indeed favored by the Heavenly Tao, and was a true Reincarnation Seizing Destiny Child.]
[As you were lost in thought, a monstrous Demon spirit appeared outside the Immortal Mansion, attracting the attention of many cultivators who hurriedly looked over. Then, someone exclaimed that the Erebos Emperor had arrived.]
[You were also surprised, having not expected the Erebos Emperor to come personally even though the Erebos Demon Son was already in the Immortal Mansion. This situation was obviously very unusual.]
[Soon, you found out the reason. You saw a young man with demonic energy surrounding him next to Erebos Emperor, and on the young man’s forehead, there was a Golden and Dark Interwoven Mark.]
[This mark was very familiar to you. You had seen the Innate Saint with this mark on his forehead when you were in the Profound Universe, which seemed to be the symbol of Innate Saints.]
[However, the mark you saw now had turned into a mix of gold and darkness, showing that some change had taken place. Perhaps it was because this Innate Saint had fallen into the Demon Cult and became the disciple of Erebos Emperor.]
[It seemed that the Bone Emperor from the Erebos Demon Sect had won the Quasi-Emperor battle, defeated the other Quasi-Emperor, and taken away this Innate Saint.]
[You pondered the current cultivation and combat power of this Innate Saint. After all, he was a figure from 100,000 years ago. Even though he might have been sealed and his cultivation time might not be longer than geniuses like Lin Qinghe and Wan Yu, his cultivation was definitely terrifying.]
[You thought that the Innate Saint’s cultivation should have reached the level of Half-step Supreme, but as for his combat power and how much he could rank in the Great Saint Ranking, you were not so sure.]
[However, being valued so much by the Erebos Emperor, who personally escorted him here, he should at least be able to break into the top 20, or even the top 10.]
[As you were lost in thought, the Innate Saint’s figure flashed, crossed the Immortal Light, and entered the Immortal Mansion.]
[Afterward, the Erebos Emperor cast a deep glance at the depths of the Immortal Mansion and disappeared into the black fog. This amazed the other cultivators who never thought they’d have the chance to see the legendary Erebos Emperor in person. At the same time, they grew intensely curious about this genius, the Innate Saint, whom the Erebos Emperor had personally escorted.]
[As you all focused on the Innate Saint, Ku Xuan just glanced at the Innate Saint before turning to Lin Qinghe, his eyes deep.]

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 832: Chapter 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent!
“The development has become more and more exciting since the Immortal Mansion opened. Moreover, in the simulation, Ku Xuan has apparently started targeting Lin Qinghe, increasing the likelihood that he’s the mastermind.”
Wang Ping thought to himself as he looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, looking forward to the next developments.
[Next, another Immortal Melody emanated from the Immortal Mansion, indicating the start of the second test, which is on battle power. Those with insufficient Same Realm Battle Power will be eliminated.]
[At these words, many cultivators changed their expressions slightly, looking somewhat anxious. Soon, the test started and another beam of Immortal Light fell, enveloping everyone on the field, encompassing everyone within.]
[Then, you found yourself in a special space due to a flicker of consciousness. You faced an enemy corresponding to your cultivation. Without hesitation, you slayed it with a single strike, easily clearing the test.]
[Once you had defeated the enemy, your vision returned to the real world. You noticed that the geniuses on the Three Saint Ranking and Quasi-Three Saint Ranking had all opened their eyes, evidently having easily defeated their enemies.]
[However, it was only those of your caliber who were able to take out their opponents with ease. Other prodigies, on the other hand, wore serious expressions, with some even turning pale, drenched in cold sweat, clearly having encountered trouble.]
[You turned your gaze to Cai Yonglong, only to find him looking extremely upset. All you could do was shake your head slightly, hoping that Cai Yonglong could effectively use his Golden finger ability to pass the test. Otherwise, there would be nothing you could do to aid him.]
[Soon, a large number of people were eliminated. This round of elimination accounted for more than ninety percent, and only the characters who were True Inheritor Disciples of Quasi-Emperor-tier Forces or the Loose Cultivator Geniuses with grand secrets successfully passed the test.]
[Cai Yonglong narrowly passed the test using his ability, Golden Finger, which caused him to chuckle bitterly – the tests of the Immortal Mansion were indeed difficult.]
[After expelling the eliminated prodigies, the Immortal Mansion initiated the third test, which involved breaking into the Immortal Mansion Secret Realm. Only those who made it through the Immortal Mansion Secret Realm would truly join the Immortal Mansion.]
[Additionally, the Immortal Mansion informed all the geniuses present that they could obtain Immortal Points by slaying Dream Demons in the Secret Realm. The number of Immortal Points would affect where the Immortal Mansion assigned them to cultivate, which in turn would affect their chances at future Immortal Fate contests.]
[Upon hearing this, all geniuses felt a chill in their hearts. They knew they could not conceal their abilities and had to go all out. It would be a grave pity if they missed out on the Immortal Fate contest.]
[However, you remained calm throughout and did not take it to heart. You considered yourself a bystander for the entire process.]
[Soon after, the Immortal Mansion Secret Realm opened and a Spacial Vortex appeared, which you entered. However, the moment you set foot in it, you sensed something amiss and your expression changed.]
[Because this wasn’t the Dream Demon Secret Realm that the Immortal Mansion used for testing, but the Secret Realm that had appeared in the previous simulations, manipulated by the masterminds to exploit and kill numerous prodigies.]
[What’s more, this time’s Secret Realm’s delivery point was different. You noticed that half of the prodigies were transported together. These prodigies were mainly from the Saint King Ranking and Great Saint Ranking, along with Quasi-Three Saint Geniuses, and a minority of Saint Geniuses.]
[At the same time, the rules of this Secret Realm had clearly changed. They did not defeat the Great Saints, or Half-step Supremes instantaneously, but silenced their cultivation abilities. Clearly, the masterminds had made some minor modifications.]
[Whilst many prodigies frowned, taking in this odd Secret Realm that could suppress them to the Saint King tier, you too were taken aback and planned to flee immediately.]
[Just as you were ready to flee, an array of light poles appeared all around you from near to far, completely sealing up the space. A compound Killing Formation was quickly set up, eliminating any chance of your escape.]
[This scenario startled all of the prodigies present. They weren’t fools — what was happening now clearly exceeded the scope of a test. This was clearly an attempt to put them in a perilous situation. Even though the Immortal Mansion wanted to choose the Immortal Seedlings, it would allow the prodigies to fail during the tests. But it would never be this extreme, as that would offend the forces of the entire Upper Realm.]
[At this moment, Ji Ziqing, an expert in Array Mana, felt his scalp tingle, for he had noticed the terror of this Great Array. This was an Ancient Killing Array, which given a powerful master at helm and a multitude of cultivators supporting it, could unleash the power to kill even Emperor-level cultivators.]
[Even though the sense of danger emanating from this Great Array could not compare to the Ancient Grand Array described in the texts, it was more than capable of easily annihilating them.]
[Immediately, Ji Ziqing roared, revealing the origins of this Killing Formation and urging everyone to join in on destroying the formation, otherwise they would all perish here.]
[The words shrank the pupils of everyone present. They stopped holding back and started to unleash their terrifying skills to counterattack the Killing Formation.]
[However, you did not take immediate action, but continued to stare intensely at a figure in the crowd. That figure was none other than Ku Xuan.]

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 833: Chapter 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _2
[Ku Xuan has actually appeared here, apparently trying to clear his suspicions through this method. This makes you sneer in your heart, wanting to see what tricks he wants to play.]
[Next, you also start to take action, intentionally or unintentionally fighting side-by-side with Ku Xuan, resisting the terrifying Killing Formation together.]
[It is during your explosive battle that a large number of Saint Realm indigenous people appear, providing support for the Ancient Grand Array and infusing power into it. At the same time, hundreds of Black Fog Silhouettes appear, standing at a relatively central position of the Great Array.]
[At the Array’s core, a dark shadow also appears, with an aura of terror. He holds a blood-red bead in his hand and stares at you, saying in a hoarse voice that no one should try to escape.]
[This scene makes you frown, somewhat confused about whether or not this guy is the Time-Space Body you fought against earlier.]
[At the same time, the changes in this secret realm are too great, and there are more indigenous powerhouses. You are somewhat suspicious that when you simulated entering the first two times, the secret realm was still evolving, and those masterminds were not fully prepared. However, because of your unexpected appearance, they have decided to take action early, killing numerous geniuses. Their real plan should be like now, waiting for the Immortal Mansion to open, and then kill most of the monsters in one fell swoop.]
[After all, it is at this point in time that the geniuses of all upper realms have truly gathered, whether they are contemporary or have been self-titled for an extremely long time. Calculating everyone in one swoop would indeed be the most thorough. The types of geniuses they want to hunt should be available in plenty and completely at their disposal, just like ordering dishes.]
…
“These masterminds are ruthless. And how were they able to deceive the Immortal Mansion and change the test secret realm to this one? Could it be that there are traitors within the Immortal Mansion? If so, these masterminds’ methods are too terrifying.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation, his expression very solemn.
Wang Ping now feels that it is no longer just about Ku Xuan himself.
No matter how strong he is, he is just part of the young generation. No matter how deep his concealment, he is still nothing but an unripe Devouring Immortal Demon Body that may eventually develop into some terrifying physique. He is probably the main focus of those masterminds, but he is ultimately weak compared to the entire Upper Realm.
Perhaps as the story unfolds, Ku Xuan may become the last boss in the end, but for now… the real dangers Wang Ping is wary of are those big-shot emperors behind the scenes.
These people, who manipulate the entire Upper Realm, are the real dangers, to a large extent hindering his growth in the simulation and can easily crush him like a big shot.
“What a headache. It looks like it will be another cold outcome this time. Since they have already made their move, they definitely won’t let their planned prey escape. ”
Wang Ping sighs, collects his thoughts, and continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping gazes at the luminescent screen, more text emerges.
[It is at this moment of turbulent thoughts that the Killing Formation suddenly erupts with tremendous power, killing many geniuses. Their bodies explode and their Physical Bodies, Mana, and their source are all absorbed by the layered Great Array. This causes the complexions of many geniuses to become very ugly, knowing that if they don’t fight with all their might, they will really be finished.]
[Because of this, these geniuses start using their real trump cards, using tactics that would hurt their opponents while also hurting themselves. They want to quickly break the Great Array and escape from here.]
[You secretly observe Ku Xuan and consider whether or not to take action against him. However, you choose to give up, hide your strength, follow the flow of people attacking the Killing Formation, and then make your move.]
[This battle is extremely fierce, with the vast majority of geniuses being gruesomely killed on the spot, blood fog fills the sky. However, due to the sheer number of geniuses, their intense resistance seems to have an effect, eventually breaking open the layered Great Array.]
[At the moment when the Great Array is shattered, the remaining geniuses all turn into Divine Halos and escape at the fastest speed of their lives. And you are one of them.]
[However, your escape direction is the same as Ku Xuan’s. This guy survives the Great Array, but although he appears to be severely injured, you always feel that he is pretending.]
[After reaching an unoccupied place, Ku Xuan stops and takes out an Array Plate, directly arranging it into a Great Array and sealing off this space-time. Then, he looks at you in the direction where you are hiding and calmly asks you to come out.]
[In response, you narrow your eyes, knowing that Ku Xuan had long since discovered you, so you come out without hesitation. You directly tell him that all of this was Ku Xuan’s plan and that the purpose was to devour the geniuses’ origins, trying to probe Ku Xuan.]
[Upon hearing your words, Ku Xuan sneers and claims not to know what you are talking about. However, you have been secretly following him, obviously harboring ill intentions. Therefore, today, he will have to cut you down.]
[You narrow your eyes, thinking that Ku Xuan is indeed cunning and has no impulsive reactions. Since that is the case, you have nothing more to say, and without hesitation, you unleash your true combat power, wanting to suppress Ku Xuan.]
[In face of this, Ku Xuan snorts coldly, his body radiating a mysterious light, and his injuries heal in an instant. Then, he directly starts a fierce battle with you. Ku Xuan’s hidden strength is terrifying, having also comprehended Tao Patterns.]

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 834: Chapter 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _3
[However, this should be within your expectation. You strongly suspect that in the previous simulations, when you defeated Ku Xuan with your cultivation, it was also a result of him not wanting to reveal his underlying abilities. Otherwise, the outcome, of a battle which was supposed to be an absolute victory due to cultivation level, remains uncertain. He has hidden his abilities really deep.]
[During the match of the same realm, you felt immense pressure from Ku Xuan, unable to gain an upper hand even if you were to use all of your skills. The current Ku Xuan gives you the impression of being even more formidable than the Time-Space Body who understood the Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns in the previous simulation.]
[Clearly, your judgment is right. The leader can’t possibly be weaker than his subordinates. Ku Xuan has hidden his abilities way too deep. Furthermore, Ku Xuan’s combat experience is horrifyingly vast. He doesn’t give you a single chance to harm him as he engages you in an extreme tug-of-war, making it difficult for you to trigger the effect of the Seven-Color Talent – Instant Death Attack.]
[Obviously, Ku Xuan and his Ku family understand the Myriad Heavens Paradise much more than other forces do. They are well aware that people from All Heavens may possess some bizarre abilities and tools, hence the need to be extremely cautious when fighting, not giving their opponents the slightest opportunity.]
[This bothers you a lot. You clearly understand that if you continue to fight in this way, once Ku Xuan figures out your combat limits, unless your luck is great and you manage to play out a devastating Nine-fold Symphony combined with a critical strike, bringing about an instant death effect, it will be hard for you to turn the tables.]
[Therefore, you began to use a method of combat where you are willing to sacrifice yourself massively just to kill your enemy. At this, Ku Xuan sneered and took out a weapon directly, forming a terrifying defense to block your attack.]
[This startled you. The tool didn’t show any fluctuations of dao patterns or aura of the Array Mana, clearly it was not of this world, but from the special items of Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[You find the existence of this tool rather aggravating. Meanwhile, you reckon the Ku family, which has existed for ages, understands the situation in Myriad Heavens Paradise more than others do, and they have hoarded a lot of strange tools through various means.]
[As the battle went on, your condition deteriorated. The tactic of self-sacrifice diminished your combat ability. Knowing this can’t go on, you decided to use the effect of the Golden Talent – Life for Life.]
[Upon the appearance of the effect of Golden Talent – Life for Life, Ku Xuan’s pupils shrank, and he froze and lost his life essence directly. You too, lost your life essence. But due to the activation of the effect of Purple Talent – Death Replacement Puppet, your death was passed onto a poor God Monarch Realm you arranged in the outer world.]
[Looking at the dead Ku Xuan, you heaved a sigh of relief, feeling the effect of Golden Talent – Life for Life was a very useful move. It’s certainly much more useful than the Seven-Color Talent – Instant Death Attack. The Instant Death Attack has many limitations, albeit its capacity can reach the Emperor level. Once triggered, even the ‘Emperor’ would be doomed. But the Golden Talent – Life for Life could only work on those below the Supreme Realm. At present, Golden is evidently more useful.]
[All in all, the Seven-Color Talent – Instant Death Attack feels like an embarrassment within the seven-colored ones.]
[While you had a lot of thoughts in your heart, you didn’t let your guard down and continued to attack Ku Xuan’s body, in case he came back to life to attack you.]
[Following your crazy attacks, Ku Xuan’s body was completely blasted apart, seemingly totally dead. However, you were still not at ease and wanted to continue the onslaught. But you were reminded that the secret realm might belong to Ku Xuan and hence you should not stay there for long. Thus, you wanted to leave.]
[Just as you were about to leave, Ku Xuan resurrected and directly said something that made your expression freeze. Although you had previously thought that Ku Xuan might have the means to resurrect, you still fell into the trap. You just have to say that your condition was too bad, you were still weak.]
[Ku Xuan coldly stated that your ability is strong, it can directly cause his instant death. However, you should be familiar with items like resurrection items, right? If you want to kill someone from All Heavens, you only need to use those abilities that can help people really die to feel relieved.]
[After he finished speaking, he didn’t wait for you to reply, he directly killed you. Because you had the Rebirth tally, you entered a resurrection countdown. Meanwhile, Ku Xuan was coldly keeping guard here.]
[During this period, black fog silhouettes found this place and started attacking the Great Array set by Ku Xuan. However, Ku Xuan did not move. As soon as you were revived, Ku Xuan, who had already arranged a deadly killing move during your revival period, made a strong move and killed you once again.]
[Because of your downfall, this simulation ends here…..]
…..
When the text simulation came to the end, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and many images and insights appeared in his mind.
In the end, he appeared in the secret realm, staring intently at Ku Xuan, and furrowed his eyebrows.
“What’s going on with this Ku Xuan? Why would the Black Shadow attack him too? Is it possible that he is not the mastermind and my guess was wrong? Or is this all a play? But I’m already dead, why would he keep acting?”
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, and he began to analyze the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 835: Chapter 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _4
In dealing with this guy, one cannot use common sense. Once he takes action, he will definitely not leave any traces of exposure.
Perhaps, he is afraid that after my death, there is a way to leak the information, so he will not expose any flaws. It could also be that he is still putting on a show for the other geniuses.
Wang Ping does not believe in Ku Xuan. His intuition has always been accurate. Even if Ku Xuan appears innocent, Wang Ping does not trust him.
Dealing with such a guy, it’s better to kill wrongly than to let him go. One must dig out his background thoroughly.
If he is indeed wronged, simply leave him alone in future simulations.
Of course, Wang Ping doesn’t really need to care that much.
The struggle for the Tao has always been ruthless, regardless of hatred and right or wrong. They are all enemies of each other. Finding a way to eliminate each other won’t evoke any criticism. The important part is how clean they do it.
As Wang Ping’s heart struggled to calm down, his consciousness flickered, and his vision changed, returning to the real world once again.
Then, the sound of the system rang out.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two items from the following rewards:
①. Golden Talent: Life for Life.
②. Random Supreme Artifact.
③. Golden Light Jade Talisman.
④. Random Great Saint Artifact.”
…..
“System, I choose ①. Golden Talent: Life for Life and ③. Golden Light Jade Talisman.”
Wang Ping glanced at the list of rewards, somewhat surprised that he didn’t refresh the Supreme Body. After that, he made his choice.
As for the Supreme Body, it can be condensed in the simulation if desired and isn’t important. Wang Ping simply didn’t care about it.
Not to mention, if the Supreme Body did appear, raising his cultivation to a truly Half-step Supreme tier would actually be more of a disadvantage than an advantage.
After all, once his cultivation reaches a true Half-step Supreme realm, his combat power won’t change much, and it won’t help much in the Immortal Mansion Trial. Instead, the cost of his simulation would increase again, and it will be a significant increase.
Under these circumstances, it would be a real grievance.
As Wang Ping made his choice, a piece of information appeared in his mind, which was the method to use the Golden Talent: Life for Life.
Apart from that, in his storage world, an additional object appeared.
That object was none other than the Golden Light Jade Talisman, which even the simulated Wang Ping could not uncover any secrets.
“I don’t know what secrets this thing hides, and I don’t know if the secrets within can bring about a qualitative change in my strength.”
After Wang Ping took out and studied the Golden Light Jade Talisman for a while, he threw it back into his storage world.
Next, Wang Ping planned to conduct a new simulation.
This time, he gained quite a bit of information.
However, there was still a long way to go before he could break through. To thoroughly investigate Ku Xuan, he needed some external help.
“Relying on the power and influence of the Upper Realm alone is probably difficult to get to the bottom of Ku Xuan. Since they’ve done all these things, and the Divine Calculation Man of the Immortal Mansion couldn’t figure out anything, it shows that they have a way to counteract the deduction of Heavenly Secrets. As a result, I don’t think anyone will believe me if I snitch, so I can only rely on myself.”
“And the method I can rely on… unless I get a Seven-Color Talent that can help me, breaking through is basically impossible. If I give up entering the Immortal Mansion and linger in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, perhaps I can live a little longer and improve my cultivation.”
Various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, but in the end, he let out a bitter smile.
Is he going to take the same route as before, focusing on survival, and cultivating?
If that’s the case, it’s really uncomfortable.
“Forget it, if I have to survive, then I’ll survive. I’m used to it anyway.”
Wang Ping sighed and was about to start a new paid simulation.
“System, I want to carry out a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping said softly in his heart.
“Ding, consuming four million top-tier divine sources. Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The sound of the system rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful! Congratulations, host, you’ve successfully refreshed the Seven-Colored Talent: Broken Origin Heavenly Eye and Red Talent: Moonlight Roar.”
Seven-Colored Talent: Broken Origin Heavenly Eye: An advanced version of the Origin Divine Eye talent, capable of seeing through illusions and breaking open the origin. It can also brew the astonishing Divine Skill: Breaking Origin Tribulation Light.
Red Talent: Moonlight Roar: The host can roar under the moonlight, slightly increasing combat power.
“Holy Crap!”
Wang Ping stared at the talents he refreshed, completely stunned.
Is his luck really that good now? It seems he really is getting what he wants.
Now, he’s actually refreshed another Seven-Color Talent, which is even the advanced version of the Origin Divine Eye, and it’s extremely useful for him to see through Ku Xuan’s bottom line.
“I wonder if my luck has been boosted by joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace. But then, all my luck was used in refreshing talents. Is that why I’m having such bad luck in life simulation?”
Suddenly, Wang Ping thought of this possibility.
As he gets stronger and stronger, especially after joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace, a huge power, and becoming an Internally Appointed Emperor’s Son, his luck becomes more entwined with that of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. That’s why his chances of refreshing high-quality talents are much higher than before.
Theoretically, in life simulation, since he is now the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s First Emperor Child, his luck should be even more prosperous. Moreover, he ranks so high on the Saint King Ranking and has defeated many geniuses. After all this is taken into account, even if his foundation is so bad, his luck should not be worse than those top Three Saints List geniuses.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 836: Chapter 231: Changes in the Immortal Mansion! The Third Multi-Colored Talent! _5
That’s why Wang Ping had this guess.
Just as Wang Ping was about to choose this talent for simulation, the chat group system’s prompt tone suddenly sounded, making Wang Ping slightly stunned.
“Ding, detected group member Ding Xuan (88)’s world has an anomaly, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate Bizarreness. This group task is of high difficulty and will be led by Acting Group Owner Wang Ping (66), who will choose four group members for the task. Please make your choice quickly.”
“Uh, has another problem that needs my intervention arisen?”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows slightly as he heard the chat group system’s prompt tone.
Nowadays, the chat group is full of strong players. Lin Yuanyuan, Zhang Jun, Chen Yao, and others can all hold their own. As long as it’s not a bizarre situation that has gradually grown in the Cultivation Realm, they can basically handle any minor anomaly.
“Ding Xuan, as I recall, he’s traveled to a game world. Is it possible for anomalies to appear in a game world? Or is the world a nation-wide game type?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, deep in thought.
While pondering various issues, Wang Ping also opened the chat group page.
Wang Ping (66) @Ding Xuan (86): “Ding Xuan, have you noticed anything unusual? Also, I don’t think I’ve ever seen you upload specific information about your world.”
Ding Xuan (86): “Uh, I’m baffled. I don’t know what’s going on…Suddenly there’s a group task, and I’m a little confused. As for the issue of information about my world…cough, about that, I’ve been in the novice village all the time wrecking the players, making them unwilling to go online…”
Wang Ping (66): “…….”
Everyone else: “……”
That Ding Xuan, really showing off. While everyone else is doing their best to figure out their traversal world, he’s just using the chat group to grow stronger and torment players, occasionally participating in not-so-difficult tasks. He doesn’t even know what his world is like. His life is too laid-back.
Wang Ping (66): “For those interested in participating in this task, you can sign up.”
Wang Ping, speechless, chose to focus on the main issue.
Since there was no intelligence, he could only rely on his Life Simulator for a simulation.
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “I want to go… But I’m currently in a task.”
Chen Yao (71): “Same here.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Hehe, I’m definitely going with Mr. Wang for the task.”
Chen Si (83): “And me, QAQ.”
Chen Kang (67): “Following the old rule, if my sister goes, I have to go as well.”
Wu Jun (20): “Me me me, I want to go too.”
Zhang Yueying (86): “Alright, I was too late to say something. No spot for me.”
Fang Yun (3): “Classic, another bunch of support players going with Mr. Wang for the group task.”
Qin Tian (77): “Ah, I can’t keep up anymore; my position as an errand boy is gone, o(╥﹏╥)o.”
Wang Ping (66) @Qin Tian (77): “You, lad, just lack a powerful Cultivation World.”
Wang Ping (66): “Alright, enough talk, let’s get ready to traverse.”
Wang Ping shook his head and stopped chatting in the group, the names of the people participating in the task were inputted directly.
Soon, Wang Ping, Cai Yonglong, Chen Si, Chen Kang, and Wu Jun all turned into a white light and disappeared, heading to the world where Ding Xuan was located.
When Wang Ping and the others arrived in Ding Xuan’s world, their gazes became quite subtle.
Because Ding Xuan wasn’t their usual ferocious impression, but rather resembled a beastman.
“Hehe, Mr. Wang, you didn’t expect it, but I recently managed to change into a human form. Yay! The female body of my dreams.”
Ding Xuan said, somewhat pervertedly.
“Speaking of perverts, it has to be you, kid.”
Wang Ping’s forehead was full of black lines, rendering him speechless.
Although he already knew this guy was a pervert, wanting to travel as a woman during Soul Travel, seeing this mischievous expression on him still made him want to throw a tantrum.
Cai Yonglong, Wu Jun, and Chen Kang all looked at Ding Xuan with great reluctance, their faces twitching.
As for Chen Si, she retreated several steps in fear.
At this point, Ding Xuan came to his senses, coughed lightly, and returned to normal.
Then, his expression became serious, and he said, “Mr. Wang, I may not know the specifics of our world, but you should have noticed changes in your body by now. Besides that, you can also think about the attribute panel in your mind.”
Wang Ping squinted, of course aware of the changes in his body since arriving in this world.
To be precise, it feels like he is not as strong as before, having an unrealistic feeling.
Immediately, Wang Ping thought of the attribute panel in his mind.
Then, an attribute panel appeared in front of Wang Ping, raising his eyebrows slightly.
Name: Wang Ping
Level: 999
Race: Human Race
Super God-level BOSS
Strength: ???
Speed: ???
Endurance: ???
Agility: ???
Spirit: ???
Mana: ???
Skills: ???
ps: A unique BOSS from outside the domain, with a mysterious origin. Killing it will yield an incredible reward.
“Interesting, I’ve become a BOSS.”
Wang Ping looked at Ding Xuan and slowly spoke.
“Mr. Wang, we seem to have become BOSSes too. And our talents have turned into exclusive skills.”
Wu Jun couldn’t help but speak up.
Cai Yonglong, Chen Kang, and Chen Si all nodded in surprise.
“That’s how it is. When people come to our world, they’re likely to become NPCs or BOSSes. In this world, only players are special.”
Ding Xuan sighed and said.
“So, I’ve been massacring these players to prevent them from leaving the novice village in order to avoid being killed by them. Otherwise, when they grow up, it will be a real disaster, even possibly grinding me to death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Chapter 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace
“Uh… Then you’re really amazing.”
Cai Yonglong looked strange and teased.
“But, this approach is indeed correct. After all, players do pose a danger, since they can revive infinitely and are entirely fearless of death. As long as there are enough people, various tactics can be used. Even if they can only deal a little forced damage, they can still grind down the BOSS.”
“Enough talk, let’s solve the problem first. As usual, I’ll simulate once.”
Wang Ping took a breath and said.
Hearing this, everyone closed their mouths, looking forward to it.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
In an instant, the system’s voice rang, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, entering the immersive simulation state.
Then, a luminescent screen appeared before him, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, after considering your options, you followed Ding Xuan to Novice Village, killed online players with a fluke mentality once again, and discussed the next step. You believed that it was necessary to leave the Novice Village and go to the outer world. Otherwise, without any information, you would face a slow death.]
[However, after you decrypted the teleportation mechanism of the Novice Area and arrived at the outer world, you found yourselves surrounded. To be precise, you were surrounded at the Delivery Point from the Novice Village to the Main City. In the square, players were packed tightly. They first looked puzzled and then excitedly gazed at you.]
[Then, a player shouted that the BOSS had entered the city and urged his fellow players to attack. At these words, the players became excited and began to bombard you relentlessly.]
[At this, you thought to yourself ‘MMP’. Although you guessed that there wouldn’t be only one Novice Village, you were still surprised and troubled by the development of the game world. After all, as far as you could see, the levels of these players generally exceeded 500 or 600. Although there were also lower-level players, they were relatively rare.]
[For this reason, you concluded that these players were not top-tier players but rather ordinary ones. You didn’t know what level and strength the top players in this world might possess. However, you were well aware that the current situation was already challenging enough.]
[Under numerous skill beams, you were submerged. Even you were overwhelmed. You found that this game world was entirely data-based, unable to show the speed, power, and destructive force that could come from the conversion of cultivation into levels.]
[Although there were differences in destructive power according to level strength, it was apparently not enough to bring about a qualitative change.]
[However, you quickly calmed down. Because you realized that the reason why your level was 999 should be that the game world’s highest level was indeed 999, and not that you could only reach 999.]
[As for your data panel, it was unreadable in this world, full of question marks. So, when these players attacked you, besides occasionally seeing a red “-1” floating above your head, your health bar seemed to remain unchanged.]
[Cai Yonglong and the others, although their levels were also high, reaching 999, were apparently broken through their defense and took higher damage, occasionally causing more than two-digit damage values. They were also continuously controlled by various control skills, though the duration was short.]
[Obviously, in terms of the players’ control skills, the duration was determined by some data rather than a fixed time. Probably, only special God-tier Skills would have a fixed control time.]
[Immediately, without hesitation, you used the space-based Divine Skills that had been converted into skills to kill all players in the square, leaving none alive.]
[As you killed all the players in the square, the place finally quieted down, and Ding Xuan and the others breathed a sigh of relief, albeit frustrated. After all, getting beaten up just now was quite unpleasant.]
[Next, Cai Yonglong asked you what to do. After a brief consideration, you said you would stay here and continue to slaughter game players.]
[These words left Cai Yonglong and the others baffled, unsure of the reason for your actions.]
[You shook your head, not explaining further. Since the players in this game world are the 4th Catastrophe and so special, it might be related to the eerie. In that case, just keep killing them. Anyway, considering your past experience, it’s challenging to actively find the eerie without the ability to destroy the entire world.]
[Thus, it’s better to go on the offensive, expose yourself, and see if you can draw out the eerie. In your opinion, after all, there are plenty of trial-and-error opportunities in the Life Simulation, so you can take your time dealing with the eerie.]
[Seeing you didn’t want to explain, Cai Yonglong and the others also closed their mouths, ready to join you in slaughtering players. But you shook your head, telling them to leave, or they would most likely be killed by players and drop gold coins. That would be embarrassing.]
[At this, Cai Yonglong and the others were speechless and swiftly fled to a safer place. Compared to you, they were indeed weaker, and even players at level 500 could breach their defense. If they stayed here, they would be in trouble when high-end players arrived.]

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: Chapter 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace_2
[Soon, the news of you and your fellow bosses appearing in the city has spread throughout the game world. Many players are surprised and curious about how you, a super god-level BOSS with several quasi-immortal tier BOSSes, are wreaking havoc in the main city. This has prompted them to start scheming, wanting to kill you and collect a bounty of gold coins.]
[Among those players who want to kill you for gold coins, the powerful guilds at the top are even more eager. They are the real top-tier players, with all of their levels surpassing 900.]
[Before long, you and the guild players began an intense battle. You have to admit, these high-end players are quite strong, possessing various control skills and weakening abilities. Their teamwork is impressive, with seamless control coordination. Even you found them to be a bit challenging.]
[However, you are still you, a special character with question marks all over your profile. Once you found an opening, you unleashed a massive range of space-time skills, triggering terrifying multiple attacks and critical strikes, instantly wiping out these players.]
[This scene stunned the other players, who believed you to be a ridiculously overpowered super god-level BOSS and a fitting first boss of this caliber to appear in the game world.]
[However, the remaining players are no pushovers. They believe that since you’ve already used your ultimate move, there’s nothing more to be afraid of and continue their assault. Even if they can’t kill you, they’ll wear you down. According to them, as long as there’s a health bar, no BOSS is unkillable!]
[Seeing this group of impassioned and fearless players makes you slightly uneasy. It’s troublesome, as these players can revive and repeatedly challenge you to the death.]
[Unexpectedly, the players you killed didn’t revive, and their game accounts were even wiped out. This news quickly spread, causing the remaining players to retreat in fear, no longer daring to attack you recklessly.]
[The reason these players can afford to run amok in this fully virtual game is that they can be resurrected with minimal loss – just some experience points and game equipment. There is no real fear.]
[However, now that they are unable to resurrect after being killed and their game accounts deleted, this is considered a true death. After all, this game only allows one account per player, and without it, there’s no way to create a new one, effectively dying in the game.]
[They can’t afford this consequence. This game brings them much joy and even some income, and no one is willing to quit.]
…..
“When I kill players, they can’t resurrect? Has Heavenly Tao given me some special buff?”
Wang Ping narrows his eyes as he looks at the text simulation.
It’s worth mentioning that their designation as bosses in this world is quite odd.
Logically, the chat group must have communicated with this world’s consciousness and not intentionally put them in trouble.
Otherwise, that would be equivalent to self-destruction.
As for the question of whether the world consciousness has intelligence, Wang Ping believes it does.
After all, it’s not just any world capable of a strange invasion that requires his intervention.
Moreover, the birth of this game itself is somewhat suspicious.
Wang Ping suspects that this world follows the path of making games a reality.
Once the game players achieve certain conditions in the game, everything in the game melds into reality, and they obtain the corresponding power from the game.
Or it could be that the world merges with the game, and everyone has to start leveling up again, with these players being the beta testers.
This can be seen from the fact that Ding Xuan can become strong in the game and retain his power in other worlds after leaving.
That is to say, although this world appears to be virtual at the moment, it is also a real world with some unique rules.
“One thing is certain: bizarre things are likely hiding among the players. The world consciousness wouldn’t have given him boss status if it weren’t for this. Having a boss status attracts all players to attack me. Since the bizarre things are hiding among the players, I get the special buff that can kill them permanently.”
Wang Ping quickly makes sense of the situation.
This gives him a slight smile and confidence in the upcoming simulation.
As long as he catches the tail of the strange things, what he has to do next is pretty simple.
That is, to kill every single player without fail and force the strange things to reveal themselves.
Immediately, Wang Ping voluntarily enters an immersive simulation state, sending this information to the simulated Wang Ping.
Subsequently, Wang Ping re-enters the text simulation state. The luminescent screen appears, and text emerges.
[After learning the information, you began slaughtering players relentlessly. The terrified players started to flee, but you didn’t give them the chance. You directly activated space-time sealing skills, trapping the entire main city.]
[This drove the players mad. You then ascended to the sky, unleashed wide-ranging destructive skills, and went on a rampage.]
[Upon being killed in such a manner, players began cursing, accusing the game’s designers of creating such a ridiculous BOSS that deliberately left no chance for players to survive.]

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 232: The Shame of the Fourth Disaster! Returning to Dao Palace_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Chapter 232: The Shame of the Fourth Disaster! Returning to Dao Palace_3
[You ignored the players’ clamor and continued your killing spree. As you slaughtered crazily, some players suddenly stiffened, transforming into streams of data that floated towards a specific location in the city.]
[Meanwhile, enormous data flowed into the city from the outside world. Instantly, you realized that the schemer must be hiding within this city, possibly wielding the power to absorb specific player data, which was disturbing news.]
[After all, the number of players was massive. If this schemer could absorb all of their data, the aftermath would be terrifying and unpredictable. There was a strong possibility that you wouldn’t stand a chance against them.]
[Soon, you spotted a female player where the data floated towards. In frenzied absorption of incoming data, the light wings on her back went wild.]
[Frowning, you memorized the identity and features of this female player and immediately launched your attack.]
[However, to your surprise, shadowy figures appeared in your path, blocking your attack.]
[True, these moving shadows were obliterated instantly by your assault, but they successfully disrupted your attack. You realized that those information files appearing above the shadows were of the bosses in this world.]
[This unexpected discovery wrinkled your brow. It appeared that the schemer even had control over the world bosses and could summon them for protection.]
[While you pondered this revelation, you continued your attack, only to find an alarming increase in the number of bosses and ordinary monsters appearing. Their numbers even surpassed the players in the main city.]
[Some of these monsters were transforming into streams of black data, integrating into the schemer’s body.]
[This development rattled you. Undeterred by your surprise, the schemer smirked and continued absorbing data, becoming stronger by the second.]
[She hated you immensely. She had the ability to grant hidden powers to her guild members. A power that allowed her to convert any monster killed by her guild members into undead creatures. These creatures were under her control and could be absorbed to strengthen her.]
[She had planned to accumulate massive amounts of data, wipe off the living beings in this world when the two worlds merged and capture the World Source in one fell swoop. Your interference had thrown her plans into disarray, forcing her to initiate the absorption and cohesion ahead of time, rendering her years of scheming futile.]
…
“So that’s how her powers work. No wonder she could absorb some of the players, summon monsters to protect herself and gain strength from the monsters.”
Having read the scenario set by the Text Simulation, Wang Ping had an enlightened look on his face as he finally understood the situation.
“Now that I know what’s up, it should be easier to deal with her. Even if I can’t kill her in this simulation, it won’t matter. As long as I know her true identity, I can catch her off guard in the real world before she absorbs all that data and deal with her then.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were sparkling as he pondered privately.
Despite his superior strength even under normal circumstances, he didn’t find it dishonorable to defeat the schemer by any means necessary.
In fact, it’s never dishonorable to employ any means, as long as it ensures the enemy’s defeat.
Soon after, Wang Ping composed his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[You didn’t give the schemer an opportunity to grow stronger and launched a relentless attack. Consequently, the schemer had no choice but to fight while simultaneously absorbing data.]
[Needless to say, post-absorption, the schemer had grown significantly stronger. In terms of capabilities, she was now a worthy adversary, and what’s more, she was still gaining strength.]
[Nevertheless, you remained composed and dealt high damage. This type of enemy wasn’t hard for you to deal with.]
[Soon, as you expected, the effect of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack was triggered. The schemer’s expression froze in the midst of her power surge, and she died instantly. All of her data dispersed into nothing.]
[Upon defeating the schemer, you realized that the mission had been accomplished. She did not have the Undying ability, or rather, the special buff granted to you by the world’s consciousness had counteracted the players’ Undying ability. As a result, your mission was completed easily.]
[With no further delay, you decided to return to the real world.]
[With your departure, the simulation ended.]
…..
As the Text Simulation ended, various scenes flooded Wang Ping’s mind. With a whirl of his consciousness, he found himself back in the real world.
Upon his return, Wang Ping broke into a smile.
This task was unexpectedly easy.
The schemer was indeed not weak, especially in this specific world where she was overwhelmingly powerful.
However, the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack allowed for a fatal first strike. As long as Wang Ping caught his enemies off guard and inflicted damage, there would be a strong chance of triggering the effect and killing the enemies in a blast.
“Mr. Wang, have you located the schemer?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s smile, Cai Yonglong and the others lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Chapter 232: The Shame of the 4th Catastrophe! Returning to the Dao Palace_4
“Caught him, and even directly killed him.”
Wang Ping nodded, then quickly recounted the simulation content.
“Uh, it looks like we got some easy points again. As expected, when following Mr. Wang, we have a high probability of becoming point-scavenging monsters.”
Cai Yonglong scratched his head and began to complain.
“Cough cough, scavenging points is so addictive.”
Chen Kang coughed lightly.
