When they used to follow Lin Yuanyuan, they would still encounter danger, even though they would always resolve it, but it was still nerve-wracking.
Following Mr. Wang, all they had to do was lie down, which was quite comfortable.
Chen Si, Ding Xuan, and Wu Jun couldn’t help but laugh.
“Next, I’ll be right back, you guys don’t have to come, so you don’t scare the snake away.”
Wang Ping looked at the others and left quickly after dropping this sentence.
This time, Wang Ping didn’t have the idea of going to the Main City to kill people in a grandiose manner.
After all, since they found out the weird thing’s true identity, there was no need to make it so complicated. Doing so would be relatively dangerous.
For this reason, Wang Ping tried to find their location first and then mercilessly launched an all-out attack, killing them directly.
Because Wang Ping concealed himself and struck swiftly, accurately, and ruthlessly, the weird thing didn’t react before Wang Ping killed it in an instant. The terrifying critical strike damage was dumbfounding.
“Ding, the weird one has died, the Group Task has been completed, the reward has been sent separately, the group members can choose to return to the original world on their own.”
At this time, the system’s voice also rang out, making Wang Ping quite satisfied.
It was when Wang Ping was quite satisfied that the other players stared at Wang Ping excitedly, as if they saw Wang Ping’s Super God-level BOSS title and wanted to slaughter Wang Ping for equipment.
Wang Ping was somewhat speechless and quickly left, not intending to kill them either.
However, this time Wang Ping didn’t have the idea to return to the original world directly but went back to the novice village to meet Cai Yonglong and the others.
“Mr. Wang, I have a bold idea, do you think it’s feasible?”
At this moment, Ding Xuan suddenly smirked.
“What idea?”
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow, thinking this kid might be up to no good.
“Mr. Wang, let me kill you, maybe I can get an unimaginable reward. Plus, the experience would be great too.”
Ding Xuan stared hungrily at Wang Ping, jokingly.
“Get lost! Do you believe I’d kill you to see if I can get gold coins?”
Wang Ping’s face turned dark, and he wished to slap this guy to death.
Although he had thought about whether he could burst out some awesome equipment this way, he eventually decided against it.
After all, it would mean dying in real life.
This price was not something Wang Ping was willing to try.
He was always the most careful with his life.
With the talent refreshed in the Life Simulator and the items rewarded in the Life Simulator, Wang Ping didn’t lack the equipment and tools that might be exploded in this world.
“Cough cough, I was just joking, joking!”
Ding Xuan shuddered in fear and quickly said.
“Mr. Wang, don’t be angry, I’ll let you play with it, how about that?”
“Get lost!”
Wang Ping’s mouth twitched, and he lightly waved his robe to flick this pervert away.
Although Wang Ping held back a bit, the health bar above Ding Xuan’s head dropped by 80%, clearing more than half of it.
This made Ding Xuan’s expression stiffen, and he didn’t dare to babble anymore.
Being mouthy with Mr. Wang could really be fatal.
Seeing Ding Xuan suffering like this, Cai Yonglong and the others rolled their eyes, but had no sympathy for him, thinking he deserved it.
After all, being reckless could really be deadly.
Afterwards, Wang Ping didn’t say anything more, and after a brief farewell, he opted to return to his world.
…
After returning to the Spiritual Dust Peak, Wang Ping opened his red envelope.
And then, Wang Ping got 100 million group points.
It could only be said that the higher the strength of these weird things, the greater the rewards.
However, adding another 100 million group points still left Wang Ping a long way from the trillions he needed. He could only continue to work hard.
“By the way, can this weird thing meet the conditions for me to play the game after entering the Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wang Ping seemed to think of something and asked curiously in his heart.
“No, it must be a special type that is about to erode the world, or an incredibly powerful weird thing that has already grown.”
Alpha’s voice sounded, making Wang Ping somewhat disappointed.
“Oh, I see.”
However, he didn’t mind too much, and soon forgot about it.
Then, Wang Ping used his mind to quickly enter the immersive simulation of the paid simulation.
After that, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[On the first day, you chose to cultivate. This time, you’ve decided to try some experiments and make some changes. For this reason, you didn’t immediately decide to self-tittle but chose to go to the Elemental Star.]
[However, before you go to the Elemental Star, you hope that the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace can provide you with a treasure elixir for condensing the Supreme Body.]
[At this, the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace is quite alarmed. After all, in his opinion, you are still far from reaching the Great Sage Consummation and have no need for this precious item.]
[However, although somewhat puzzled and torn, the Taiyi Emperor Palace Master still uses his authority to help you get a treasure elixir for condensing the Supreme Body from the treasury.]

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 232: The Shame of the Fourth Disaster! Returning to Tao Palace_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: Chapter 232: The Shame of the Fourth Disaster! Returning to Tao Palace_5
[After all, you can’t catch a wolf without sacrificing a child. You’ve just joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace; how will you feel a sense of belonging to it if you aren’t given some benefits?]
[Seeing the generous offer from the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you nod in satisfaction, and after expressing your gratitude, you leave.]
[Next, you arrive at the Elemental Star and quietly begin to wait. In a blink of an eye, several decades have passed, the Great Saint Secret Realm opens, and you choose to enter.]
[Then, you find Lin Yan, a genius with the Devouring Soul Pearl, and wish to accept him as your disciple. When you express your intention to recruit, Lin Yan doesn’t seem happy at all, and he chooses to refuse without hesitation.]
[Seeing this, you are not surprised. You’ve learned through these simulations that Lin Yan is a cautious type, who also likes to keep a low profile. Even in the Golden Age, he remains a loose cultivator, seemingly being protected by a powerful figure in the background.]
[Therefore, Lin Yan, who possesses great secrets and has this kind of personality, will not casually accept a master. It doesn’t matter if you are a Great Saint or even a Half-step Supreme, he would not easily accept you, even if you were a genuine Supreme or Quasi-Emperor.]
[As for Lin Yan’s refusal to become your apprentice, you don’t have the slightest intention of forcing it. It’s useless to force it, as only a sincere apprenticeship from a genius can trigger the effect of the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger.]
[However, in this simulation, the primary purpose of looking for an apprentice and increasing your cultivation is secondary, mainly to test several things. For that reason, you don’t hesitate to attack Lin Yan, intending to snatch the Devouring Soul Pearl.]
[In the face of your behavior of attempting to rob if unsuccessful in recruiting, Lin Yan is enraged and wants to activate the Emperor’s artifact to resist. Regrettably, his cultivation is too low, making it difficult for him to activate the artifact.]
[In the end, Lin Yan is suppressed by you, and you take the Devouring Soul Pearl from his body. However, once the Devouring Soul Pearl is in your hands, it begins to struggle violently. A terrifying Emperor’s Might is awakening, causing you to feel a life-threatening sense of danger, especially in your Divine Soul, as if it will be devoured.]
[Obviously, this Devouring Soul Pearl has no intention of recognizing you as its master; forcibly seizing it would only result in being backfired. For that, you are speechless and realize that fate has granted Lin Yan the Devouring Soul Pearl, which is not an opportunity that anyone can easily take away.]
[Perhaps, regardless of whether it’s Lin Yan or those who are bestowed with fortune by the Heavenly Tao like Zhu Huowang, they might do favors for someone else in the future, but for now, no one can forcibly snatch this pearl. Even Quasi-Emperors and Great Emperors may be able to seal this Innate Emperor Artifact by relying on their powerful forces, but whether they can make it recognize them as a master is another question.]
[Then, without saying much, you simply toss the Devouring Soul Pearl back to Lin Yan and let him go. This leaves Lin Yan completely astonished, not knowing what you are thinking. After all, if you wanted to kill him, you could have done so easily. However, it seems that you didn’t have that intention.]
[Regarding Lin Yan’s confusion, you have no intention of explaining anything and just float away. As for whether Lin Yan will seek revenge in the future, you are not concerned. After all, even if Lin Yan grows up, he still won’t be your match in the Golden Age, so there’s nothing to fear.]
[Moreover, it won’t be long before you have to face Ku Xuan and hit a dead end, forcing you to enter the next simulation. Even if Lin Yan holds a grudge in this simulation, he will no longer have it in the next.]
[Therefore, it’s better to let Lin Yan go rather than risk making the Devouring Soul Pearl angry by killing him, possibly causing it to go berserk and waste your trump cards.]
[Following that, you continue to travel around the Elemental Star, visiting many places, overlooking the Elemental Forbidden Land, and finally stopping in front of the Tao Palace.]
[After contemplating, you decide to enter the Tao Palace. Upon arriving, you have no intention of concealing your identity. As a result, when you reveal that you are the future Emperor’s son of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and your cultivation has reached the terrifying Saint King tier, the palace master becomes alarmed and nervously lets you sit in the first place.]
[Even the two self-titled ancestors in the depths of Tao Palace find it hard to remain calm as they receive the news and observe the situation.]
[After all, the Taiyi Imperial Palace is an Imperial-tier force, and there are few in the entire Upper Realm that can rival it. Now that its Emperor’s son has come to their Tao Palace, it’s indeed intriguing.]
[Seeing the nervous emotions of everyone in Tao Palace, you shake your head, feeling the passage of time. Unconsciously, your status has undergone a drastic change, and in front of you, the Tao Palace and its master who once protected you and showed great kindness to you in the simulations now seem so timid and apprehensive. It’s sigh-inducing.]
[Afterward, you state your purpose, expressing your intention to accept a disciple in the Tao Palace and to cultivate in seclusion for a thousand years, hoping that the palace master will agree.]
[Upon hearing this, the Tao Palace master is astonished. He didn’t expect that someone like you would choose to cultivate in seclusion for a thousand years in their small Tao Palace and even recruit a disciple here.]
[For this reason, the Tao Palace master is overjoyed and hurriedly agrees. Although he doesn’t know your true purpose, someone of your stature wouldn’t have any need to seize anything from the Tao Palace. Nowadays, the Tao Palace has only a few people, and even a small treasure you casually take out would be more valuable than everything in the palace treasury combined.]
[Seeing the Tao Palace master’s agreement, you nod slightly without saying much and start residing in the Tao Palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 233: Killing the Primordial Thunder Supreme! Obtaining the Emperor's artifact!
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: Chapter 233: Killing the Primordial Thunder Supreme! Obtaining the Emperor’s artifact!
“So the experiment to seize the Soul-Devouring Bead did indeed fail? As expected, it isn’t easy to get a hand on the exclusive fate of the Son of Fortune.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation and thought to himself.
“Well, if I can’t get my hands on it, I can’t get my hands on it. Anyway, I was just giving it a try.”
Wang Ping shook his head, not minding it at all.
“Next, I should protect the Tao Palace and resolve its troubles. Then it’s time to accept Fang Xingyu as my disciple, and see if it’ll help me break through.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you didn’t directly choose to take Fang Xingyu as a disciple. Instead, you decided to close yourself off to absorb elixirs and temper a Supreme Body.]
[In the blink of an eye, around two hundred years passed. Through the help of elixirs and a large amount of divine source, you finally succeeded in cultivating a Supreme Body, breaking through to the Half-step Supreme Realm.]
[After breaking through, you chose to step out of seclusion, found Fang Xingyu, and wanted to take him as your disciple.]
[Hearing that you, a mysterious visitor, wanted to take him as your disciple, Fang Xingyu was very excited and naturally agreed. However, after taking Fang Xingyu as your disciple, you found that your cultivation level didn’t change. This left you disappointed.]
[As you suspected, a genius like Fang Xingyu really can’t help you break through to the Great Realm. Or perhaps truly gaining Enlightenment, cultivating a Tao Fruit, and receiving Heaven’s tests really require one’s own efforts and can’t rely on the effects of the Seven-Color Talent·Recruit Disciples to Get Stronger.]
[However, since you’ve already taken him as your disciple, you didn’t give up on Fang Xingyu. You started teaching him cultivation and gave him some resources.]
[During this time, a Saint Realm powerhouse from the Taiyi Imperial Palace came and carried the Palace Master’s orders. He asked you why you chose to stay here instead of self-titling. In response, you shook your head slightly, saying that you had your own ideas and would return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace to confer your title when the time was right.]
[Hearing this, the Saint Realm powerhouse had no further objections and chose to leave.]
[Next, you continued to cultivate in the Tao Palace, focusing on Enlightenment and creating your own laws. This was something you never gave up on while simulating your cultivation. After all, the laws created by oneself are the best laws. If you could combine the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and the Devouring Space Emperor Scripture to create your own Space-Time Emperor’s Sutra, your combat power would truly rise above the rest.]
[By then, even Ku Xuan who cultivated an Immortal Sutra might not be your match. The advantage of the Immortal Sutra would be nullified. After all, the Immortal Sutra at its strongest is still someone else’s law and not your own, so it can’t exert its full power. Only by creating your own laws can you embark on the right path.]
[Of course, combining the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and the Devouring Space Emperor Scripture to create your own Space-Time Emperor Mana isn’t an easy task. Your cultivation level is too low and your foundation too shallow. To create your own Space-Time Emperor’s Sutra is extremely difficult.]
[However, you never gave up. You even had some ideas in mind, such as using the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture as a bridge to merge the subtleties of the three Emperor Scriptures, and perhaps there’s hope for successfully creating your own law.]
[As you closed yourself off to ponder and gain insight, time quietly passed. In the blink of an eye, more than a thousand years had gone by. You were both lucky and unlucky. During your secluded contemplation in the Tao Palace, you fortunately entered a miraculous state of Enlightenment and had many ingenious ideas regarding creating your own laws, making some progress.]
[However, you were also unlucky because, in this Last Dharma Age, the laws are hidden and there are no conditions for creating your own Emperor Scripture. Relying solely on comprehending the three Emperor Scriptures will always leave you rootless.]
[Just when you were thinking hard and struggling to make further progress, a terrifying aura suddenly appeared from outside the domain, descending on the Elemental Star and wanting to erase the Tao Palace.]
[This undoubtedly alarmed the self-titled ancestors dwelling in the Tao Palace. One of them angrily roared, directly emerging and taking control of the Emperor’s artifact that automatically revived within the palace. He went beyond the ancient star, colliding with the invading powerhouse wielding his own Emperor’s artifact.]
[You looked at the starry sky from afar, witnessing this scene, your eyes flickering. In the past, you would have been astonished at such a display of power, thinking that it was terrifying. However, your current self thinks that while this power is strong, it’s not so strong as to be fearful of it. You are now able to face it calmly.]
[Of course, this power is still very formidable. Even ordinary Supremes who confront it might be killed by the Emperor’s artifact. After all, only a Supreme using their full power in an ambush could temporarily repel a just-revived Emperor’s artifact with only a little of its power awakened and then flee immediately. If they clashed head-on, only death awaited them.]
[Back then, the Primordial Thunder Supreme of the Elemental Star successfully attacked the just-awakened Emperor’s artifact using her full power. However, her actual realm was only that of Supreme Middle-stage. The Primordial Thunder Supreme followed the Path of the Thunder System, which is powerful in destruction and speed. Additionally, her cultivation level was a small realm higher than the Supreme from the Tianmu Clan, so her record appeared much better.]

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 233: Explosive Kill Primordial Thunder Supreme! Emperor's Artifact in Hand!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: Chapter 233: Explosive Kill Primordial Thunder Supreme! Emperor’s Artifact in Hand!_2
[But it only looks impressive to a certain extent. After all, the Primordial Thunder Supreme at the time was just assisting the Half-step Great Saint wielding the Emperor’s artifact to fight against the Tao Palace’s Emperor’s artifact. If he had to face an awakened Emperor’s artifact with more power, he would have died long ago.]
[Next, you were deep in thought, waiting for something.]
[As the two sides clashed fiercely, you waited for the perfect timing to act. The Primordial Thunder Supreme chose to make his move. With the bursting of the Supreme pressure, the Elemental Star began to tremble.]
[And you, you narrowed your eyes without hesitation and chose to make your move, blocking the Primordial Thunder Supreme. Your appearance surprised him.]
[However, he soon snorted coldly, thinking that you were overestimating your abilities. A mere Saint Realm cultivator daring to block him, a Supreme.]
[Immediately, the Primordial Thunder Supreme casually slapped towards you, trying to squash you like a bug.]
[This scene felt quite familiar to you, and you couldn’t help but shake your head and chuckle. Then, you chose to act, with your Time-Space Body fully unleashed, your Time-Space Divine Skill exploding, and the Time Patterns erupting, ready to battle the Primordial Thunder Supreme.]
[Your outburst shocked the Primordial Thunder Supreme, who didn’t expect that you were actually a Half-step Supreme and possessed a Time-Space Body, with Time Patterns condensed that could bring him danger.]
[For a moment, the Primordial Thunder Supreme felt very bad. He didn’t think that you could defeat him across realms. He believed you were a monster, but no matter how monstrous you were, it was impossible to defeat him, a strong Supreme in his prime. But he didn’t believe that you, as a talented cultivator, didn’t have a powerful background.]
[If he killed or even injured you, he would most likely suffer the consequences, being killed by the strong cultivators from the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and falling completely.]
[At the moment when the Primordial Thunder Supreme was deep in thought, you unexpectedly triggered the effect of Nine-fold Symphony and a critical strike. This change allowed the Primordial Thunder Supreme to snap back to reality, feeling his scalp go numb, a chill running from the soles of his feet to the top of his head, and the shadow of death lingers in his mind.]
[He never thought that you, a Half-step Supreme, could unleash such a terrifying attack. If he took this head-on, he would undoubtedly fall; there was no second possibility.]
[With the cultivation of a Half-step Supreme, you managed to launch an attack that could defeat a Mid-Superme Cultivation Supreme in his prime, becoming the unparalleled cultivator in the history of this realm.]
[When the Primordial Thunder Supreme was shocked, his actions were swift, quickly evading, defending, and counterattacking with smooth execution. It must be said that as a seasoned Supreme, his fight instinct was impeccable.]
[Besides, the Primordial Thunder Supreme was a mid-Superme Middle-stage Thunder attribute cultivator, making his evasion and counter capabilities far superior to the ordinary Supreme from the Tianmu Clan. The Tianmu Supreme only had inexhaustible vitality for long-lasting battles, making him exceptional among Ordinary Supremes, but he lacked burst power and speed.]
[Due to this, the Primordial Thunder Supreme was able to avoid part of your attack and defend against another part. However, your attacks were still too terrifying, and he couldn’t completely dodge them. After all, Time-Space divine skills were the most difficult to deal with, and his speed couldn’t outpace Time-Space even though his cultivation was much higher than yours.]
[In the end, the Primordial Thunder Supreme suffered heavy injuries, and his origin was severely damaged. This filled him with fear, and he didn’t hesitate to try to escape.]
[Seeing this scene, the countless spectators were incredibly shocked, dumbfounded, and didn’t expect that you would be so powerful. Even the two fighting with Emperor’s artifacts paused, never thinking you would be this formidable.]
[Because of this, the Tao Palace’s Grand Elder was overjoyed, feeling that your emergence was truly saving Tao Palace from disaster. As for the Half-step Great Saint wielding the Emperor’s artifact and killing his way here, his face was gloomy like water, staring at you with death in his eyes.]
[As for you, you ignored everything around you, snorted coldly, and directly chased after the Primordial Thunder Supreme, determined to eliminate him completely.]
[After all, the saying goes – weeds should be burned to the ground, for they’ll revive with the spring breeze. A Supreme, who’s your sworn enemy, could still cause you some minor troubles if left alive. Of course, you were secondary, and a Supreme could only bring you some minor troubles at most. The main concern was the Tao Palace, who would no longer have the means to resist a Supreme once you left.]
[After all, the Emperor’s artifact required time to regain its power. As long as the Primordial Thunder Supreme fought with guerrilla tactics and constantly retaliated against Tao Palace, hunting down their disciples and elders, Tao Palace would have no means to resist.]
[With this in mind, it was natural to beat him mercilessly and eradicate him completely. Most importantly, you were extremely curious about what a Supreme, who managed to stay on the Elemental Star during the entire Last Dharma Age, was thinking and whether he could drop a lot of gold coins for you.]
[If you could burst out a large number of gold coins, it would be incredibly enjoyable.]
[Seeing that you were about to exterminate him completely, the Primordial Thunder Supreme was furious, asking if you really wanted to be so ruthless. After all, there was no grudge between you two.]
[In the eyes of the Primordial Thunder Supreme, although he wanted to make a move against the Tao Palace, it didn’t happen yet, right? He only unleashed the Supreme pressure, and you, who appeared out of nowhere, brutally beat him to the point he almost died.]

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 233: Annihilation of Primordial Thunder Supreme! Emperor's Artifact Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Chapter 233: Annihilation of Primordial Thunder Supreme! Emperor’s Artifact Obtained!_3
[One could say that the reason Primordial Thunder Supreme scolded you was completely justified in his opinion.]
[As for this, you sneer coldly and of course, do not explain that you had crossed paths with Primordial Thunder Supreme in previous simulations, and he had killed you several times. You merely express that you’re in a bad mood and want to slaughter a Supreme for fun. This statement leaves countless people speechless, thinking you’re absurd. Wanting to slaughter a Supreme for fun just because you’re in a bad mood is simply too ostentatious.]
[If Primordial Thunder Supreme really dies in your hands like this, you might become the most domineering Half-Step Supreme. And Primordial Thunder Supreme might become the shame of all Supremes.]
…..
“The shame of Supremes? Not necessarily, not necessarily, after all, there is still Fire Supreme to cushion you.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and couldn’t help but smile.
“However, this time, Simulation Wang Ping seems to have never thought of trying to seize the Emperor’s artifact of Tao Palace.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
After all, if you want to find an opportunity to obtain the Emperor’s artifact of Tao Palace, the best method is to watch the events unfold and make a move at the last moment.
“Forget it, I can’t do such ungrateful things. Even in the simulation, it’s better not to do it if possible.”
Wang Ping sighed lightly, muttering to himself.
“But if I can get the Half-Step Great Saint’s Emperor’s artifact, that would be comfortable. Rather than always thinking about the Emperor’s artifact of Tao Palace, which has been good to me, I’d prefer to covet other Emperor’s artifacts.”
Wang Ping thought about this point and secretly pondered.
Of course, the Emperor’s artifact is not that easy to obtain, and the current Simulation Wang Ping also lacks the strength to suppress the Emperor’s artifact.
To this end, he could only leave it to fate.
One could say there is hope, but it is not a big hope.
Soon after, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Your words infuriated Primordial Thunder Supreme, making him almost vomit blood with rage and wishing he could turn back and fight with you on the spot. However, for his own life’s sake, he endured it.]
[After all, having cultivated to Supreme, he has experienced countless hardships and does not want to disappear between heaven and earth. He still wants to seek the method of longevity, so as to live forever in this world.]
[Just as Primordial Thunder Supreme completely abandoned his Supreme dignity and was chased by you like a dog, you launched another attack. This time, your attack was not particularly strong, nor did it trigger a Triple Symphony or higher attack and critical strike damage.]
[The intensity of this attack could only wound the already heavily injured Primordial Thunder Supreme. Even with such injuries, he could easily recover from them, and it was nothing serious.]
[For this reason, Primordial Thunder Supreme chose to ignore your attacks and continue to flee for his life. In his opinion, that strike must have consumed a lot of Mana and power, making it impossible to use continuously, otherwise, you wouldn’t just use such a weak attack.]
[The purpose of this attack was to hold him back, disgust him, and provoke him to come back and fight with you.]
[To this end, Primordial Thunder Supreme naturally wouldn’t be easily fooled and believed that as long as he kept running, everything would be fine.]
[However, Primordial Thunder Supreme really thought too much. The real reason you attacked this way was not because you lacked power, nor was it to disgust or provoke him. It was simply to trigger the effect of the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[Not long after, you successfully triggered the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect, causing Primordial Thunder Supreme’s body to stiffen instantly. In that instant, both his Physical Body and Divine Soul died in the blink of an eye. Primordial Thunder Supreme fell.]
[Seeing Primordial Thunder Supreme killed by you, you were quite satisfied with the result, thinking that Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack was somewhat useful.]
[After all, Primordial Thunder Supreme had Mid-Superme Cultivation and was stronger and more difficult to deal with compared to the Ordinary Supreme of the Tianmu Clan. If you hadn’t killed him in one attempt, it would have actually taken a long time to continue fighting him in a normal way. You could only slowly grind him to death.]
[Unless you were again fortunate enough to trigger the Nine-fold Symphony and a critical strike, but that probability was too low to rely on.]
[And spending time grinding him to death might cause changes. After all, the Half-step Great Saint holding the Emperor’s artifact was still watching you with covetous eyes, even if Tao Palace’s Grand Elder held him back.]
[If you were attacked by the Emperor’s artifact, you could lose your life, wasting a resurrection method. More importantly, it might lead to Primordial Thunder Supreme’s escape, which was something you couldn’t tolerate.]
[With the fall of Primordial Thunder Supreme, his Supreme aura disappeared from the universe. The self-titled Saints who looked up at the Starry Sky were all shocked. They never thought that you would actually crush Supremes all the way and forcefully kill him, achieving the feat of cross-level killing of Supremes with Half-Step Supreme Realm Cultivation.]
[The ancestors of Tao Palace also laughed heartily, feeling that you, the Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace, were truly powerful. Although they still didn’t understand why you wanted to come to their Tao Palace for seclusion, judging from your current performance, you obviously had genuine affection for Tao Palace, which was enough.]
[As a result, the people of Tao Palace were grateful to you and felt indebted for your great kindness. This was the gratitude for protecting the dao. If it weren’t for your presence, Tao Palace might have been exterminated today, losing their legacy of eternity.]

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 233: Killing the Supreme Yuan Lei! Obtaining the Emperor's Artifact!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Chapter 233: Killing the Supreme Yuan Lei! Obtaining the Emperor’s Artifact!_4
…..
“Another Supreme has been killed by me. I can only say that the Nine-fold Symphony and critical strikes are just too vicious. Every time I fight a Supreme, the effect of multiple-performance and critical strikes are triggered. I feel like I have a luck bonus against Supremes. I am the nemesis of Supremes in their lifetime.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, his eyes full of strangeness.
It must be said that his record against Supremes is really good.
The Golden Talent: Multiplay and the Purple Talent: Endless Blade have achieved remarkable feats time and again.
Now, with the addition of the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack, it’s even more extraordinary.
Supremes of this realm, especially Superme, are almost losing their dignity by being killed by him.
As Wang Ping crazily commented on his achievements, the simulation continued.
[It was just when Tao Palace’s Grand Elder laughed loudly, the Half-step Great Saint who held the Emperor’s artifact sneered, indicating that they were celebrating too early.]
[Then, he actually used blood sacrifice on himself, allowing the Emperor’s artifact to fully resurrect and unleash its terrifying power, shaking the universe.]
[This terrifying power fluctuation made Tao Palace’s Grand Elder’s face change greatly. After all, he was already old and weak, and he originally thought he could join forces with you to slay this Half-step Great Saint.]
[However, he never expected that this Half-step Great Saint would harbor such hatred towards Tao Palace, so much so that he would rather blood sacrifice himself to destroy Tao Palace. Of course, this might also be because he knew he couldn’t escape.]
[Cultivators like this are always the most entangled when it comes to a life and death situation, choosing to break the net even at the cost of their own lives.]
[Immediately, the ancestors of Tao Palace gritted their teeth as they prepared to blood sacrifice themselves, hoping to completely resurrect the Tao Tian Emperor Artifact and contend against the enemy.]
[However, the ancestor of Tao Palace knew very well that even if he truly blood sacrificed himself, the outcome wouldn’t be good. The consequence of two out-of-control Emperor’s artifacts colliding without any regard for the cost would be too severe, and everything in the vicinity of this star-filled sky would be destroyed.]
[Moreover, the Elemental Star was not far from here. In other words, once the two artifacts collided, the aftermath of their explosion would be enough to destroy the Elemental Star, and all living beings on it would still be annihilated, and the legacy of Tao Palace would still be severed.]
[The only thing that Tao Palace’s Grand Elder could think of was to let the two Emperor’s artifacts fight, while you protect some of the people of Tao Palace and escape from here to preserve some of the inheritance. In this way, although most of the inheritance would still be severed, at least there would be some hope for a resurgence.]
[As the living beings on the Elemental Star trembled in fear, and Tao Palace’s Grand Elder prepared to blood sacrifice himself and entrusted you to take care of the descendants of Tao Palace, you used your Time-Space Divine Skill to arrive in front of the fully resurrected and increasingly terrifying Emperor’s artifact.]
[This scene made Tao Palace’s Grand Elder anxious, telling you to leave quickly, otherwise, you would be crushed into ashes by the Emperor’s artifact. After all, a completely resurrected Emperor’s artifact is too horrifying, and only an artifact of the same level can suppress it and temporarily seal it.]
[Of course, if a powerful Quasi-Emperor makes a move, it can also achieve this. After all, a fully resurrected Emperor’s artifact is ultimately a weapon, and no matter how strong it is, the power it can burst out on its own has an upper limit. Only when held in the hands of a powerful wielder can its power be pushed to the limit, and even beyond.]
[You didn’t respond to Tao Palace’s palace master’s call, but instead, stared at the Emperor’s artifact, approaching it proactively, communicating with it and began painting a picture.]
[You told the Emperor’s artifact that following a Half-step Great Saint was too weak, and even if that Half-step Great Saint blood sacrificed himself, he could not bring out its power. Are you willing to lose the dignity of the Emperor’s artifact like this? If possible, you hoped that the Emperor’s artifact would follow you, and by then, you would become a Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, Emperor, and even immortal, allowing it to show its mighty power again and tell the world that even though its former master had passed away, it could still suppress the Heavenly Emperors of the Upper Realm.]
[Hearing your words, Tao Palace’s Grand Elder and the numerous cultivators on the Elemental Star stared in disbelief, thinking you were too crazy to start cheating the Emperor’s artifact recklessly. Emperor’s artifacts are not easily deceived.]
[At this moment, the Emperor’s artifact began to emit a dazzling light, and the terrifying pressure of the Emperor’s artifact erupted, frightening countless people.]
[However, what happened next shocked everyone, including the Master of Tao Palace. Because this Emperor’s artifact unexpectedly retracted its light, wavering as if it was considering and hesitating about something.]
[This made everyone look at each other, wondering if the Emperor’s artifact would really be deceived. If so, couldn’t they also deceive it?]
[Immediately, these people laughed at themselves. They dared to do this, but it was only because they were courting death. After all, they were ordinary cultivators, whereas you were an unparalleled genius who could slay Supremes with only half-step Supreme Realm cultivation. You indeed had the strength and talent to say such things. This was definitely not a mere pie in the sky.]
[If a person like you doesn’t fall halfway, the possibility of becoming an Emperor in the future is truly very high. Of course, they didn’t believe in becoming immortal and things like that. After all, immortality is nothing more than a legend, never appearing in the world before. No one can become immortal, and it’s not an empty talk.]

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 233: Annihilating the Primordial Thunder Supreme! Obtaining the Emperor's Artifact!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Chapter 233: Annihilating the Primordial Thunder Supreme! Obtaining the Emperor’s Artifact!_5
[In their view, even the most monstrous individuals couldn’t achieve immortality. Reaching the level of an Emperor, a ruler among emperors, was already considered an unparalleled achievement.]
[As everyone watched with deep emotions, the Emperor’s artifact truly converged its radiance, approached you, and took the initiative to display its friendliness, signaling for you to drip your blood for recognition.]
[At this, you heartily laughed, completely satisfied with the outcome, and promptly recognized it as your own, acquiring this sword-type Emperor’s artifact that matches your spatial attribute, christened the Void Constant Imperial Sword.]
[You fondled the Void Constant Imperial Sword, your lips curled into an irrepressible smile full of delight. After all, this was an Emperor’s artifact, a rarity in the world. Among the younger generation, few possessed an Emperor’s artifact. Now, you held one such artifact in your hand, a tremendous advantage indeed.]
[Besides, you had the Godbreaking Divine Eye and Time-Space Body. You believed that within your generation, there weren’t many who could match you, perhaps only Ku Xuan, who may be lurking with more unknown trump cards, could rival you. Other than him, even the current Time-Space Body was far inferior to you.]
[In the golden era, you would have another showdown with Ku Xuan to see who would win. If you could defeat Ku Xuan, then you would truly be unrivaled in your generation and could cultivate the Invincible Heart.]
[As for the older generation, with the Emperor’s artifact in your possession, you could face anyone below the Quasi-Emperor without fear. Supreme, even the Heaven Supreme, would not hold importance in your eyes.]
[Even a Quasi-Emperor, if careless, could be injured by your artifact. Once injured, should the effect of the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack be triggered, the Quasi-Emperor might also be doomed. When imagining this scene, you felt extremely delighted and exhilarated.]
[Witnessing you genuinely being recognized by the Emperor’s artifact, all present respected and admired you. The Tao Palace’s Grand Elder didn’t know what to say, he had never envisioned this outcome.]
[For this reason, he retracted the Blood Sacrifice secret skill and congratulated you. To this, you laughed off as it was nothing for a person who was about to become immortal like you. This show-off attitude made the Tao Palace’s Grand Elder visibly twitch his face.]
[However, it has to be said that you’ve grown arrogant and again set a challenging objective.]
…
“Holy cow, I actually got the Emperor’s artifact! It’s an unexpected success. That Half-Step Great Saint who didn’t even have a name has served as my equipment support. I’ve hit the jackpot this time.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, his expression was wonderfully awestruck.
Of course, Wang Ping knew clearly that the reason he so easily won the recognition of the Emperor’s artifact was primarily his previous outstanding performance.
With a Half-step Supreme Realm cultivation, he unleashed an attack that almost annihilated an opponent with Mid-Superme Cultivation. Even the knowledgeable Emperor’s artifact spirit may never have seen such a feat before.
In addition, Wang Ping cultivated the Space of Dao, and even gained the Path of Time. He was a perfect match for the Emperor’s artifact with a spatial attribute, a match made in heaven.
All these factors added up, like drawing a pie to attract the Emperor’s artifact, and it voluntarily offered itself to him. It was quite reasonable.
“However, at the end, I got a little too excited and started showing off. I have a feeling that I’m about to get in trouble again.”
Wang Ping started to complain again.
The artifact had just arrived in his hands, and hadn’t even warmed up before everything goes down south.
After his complaints, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you and Tao Palace’s Grand Elder returned to Tao Palace. From this day on, Tao Palace would become the supreme ruler of the Elemental Star, unopposed.]
[Tao Palace’s Grand Elder enthusiastically invited you to a banquet to show gratitude and celebrate your success. You didn’t reject his invitation.]
[In the end, you proposed to take your leave. This made the people of Tao Palace pretty reluctant, but they knew they couldn’t keep you.]
[Before leaving, you left some treasures and the divine source that could help the Master of Tao Palace breakthrough to the Saintly Human Tier, then with Fang Xingyu, you quietly disappeared.]
[A long time after your departure, the Grand Elder of Tao Palace noticed you’d left. This made him sigh, thinking that if Tao Palace had you, there would be no worry about returning to imperial-tier forces.]
[But he laughed at himself in the end, thinking that he had become too greedy. You had helped Tao Palace so much and even took Fang Xingyu away, potentially cultivating him into a Supreme in the future. That favor, Tao Palace might find it hard to repay.]
[For this reason, the Tao Palace Grand Elder felt if you needed the Emperor Force of Tao Palace for battle in the future, Tao Palace should without fail lend it to help you destroy your powerful enemies. This was the only way Tao Palace could repay you.]
[While the people of Tao Palace were filled with deep thoughts, you didn’t take Fang Xingyu directly to Taiyi Imperial Palace, but instead, you came to the Purgatory Ancient Star, wanting to explore the great secret hidden by Purgatory Ancient Star. Because, you had once been burned to death, an experience you remembered vividly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: Chapter 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!
“Damn, don’t be a hero.”
Upon seeing the text-simulation content, Wang Ping felt quite unwell.
If the simulated Wang Ping had previously set himself up for trouble, it’s one thing, but now he dares to actively go to dangerous places, which is really outrageous; it’s clearly a suicide mission.
Or is it because the simulated Wang Ping has become conceited after conquering the Emperor’s artifact?
Indeed, with the protection of the Emperor’s artifact, unless it’s a Quasi-Emperor-tier power, it is really hard to kill him. Coupled with various talents, Wang Ping’s ability to escape is really strong now.
But Wang Ping is quite sensitive to dangerous places that have burned him before in such scenarios. If possible, he doesn’t want to go to such places.
If it were a normal forbidden area, it would be fine, but this place is not detailed in Taiyi Imperial Palace’s classics.
All we know is, this place is very dangerous. Even if the Supreme dares to enter here, they can expect a grim fate.
Because this place contains secrets related to the Emperor.
As for why there are secrets related to the Emperor in here, without any major powers decrypting and gaining opportunities from it, Wang Ping doesn’t know.
For a moment, Wang Ping hesitated whether to go back to the immersive simulation state and let the simulated Wang Ping change his mind.
“Forget it, sooner or later, I will have to solve the mystery here and get the opportunities in here. So observing a little now wouldn’t hurt.”
However, after grappling with his decision, Wang Ping still decided to watch from the sidelines.
[Next, you ventured deep into the Purgatory Ancient Star, entered the depths of the Sea of Flames, provocatively inviting the white flame to come out.]
[In response to your provocation, the entity within the Purgatory Ancient Star raged, the Sea of Flames stirred up, trapping all the unfortunate cultivators on the Purgatory Ancient Star and reducing them all to ashes.]
[This made Fang Xingyu tremble with fear. If he did not know how monstrously strong you, his master, were, he would very much like to leave this place there and then. Of course, at this point, even if he wanted to, he couldn’t; his power is simply not enough to allow him to leave on his own.]
[You saw the Purgatory Ancient Star causing a riot, but the white flame did not appear. You slightly raised your eyebrows, aware that your provocation was not enough. As a result, you began to recklessly provoke, using all your trolling skills from before crossing.]
[With your series of provocative maneuvers, the Purgatory Ancient Star became even more riotous, and the white flames began to emerge, intending to burn you to nothing.]
[However, these white flames, which once could have reduced even a Supreme Artifact to ashes, are somewhat inadequate for you. Although you would still face annihilation if you were to face these white flames head-on.]
[Yet, you don’t need to face these white flames squarely, you can use the Time-Space Divine Skill to teleport and protect yourself. This caused the Purgatory Ancient Star to shake even more, the white flames increasing in intensity, trying to burn you to nothing.]
[At this, you finally took things seriously, and pulled out your newly acquired Emperor Artifact, the Void Eternal Emperor Sword, to block the white flame.]
[With the emergence of the Emperor’s Artifact, it was as if a strange switch was flipped, causing the entire Purgatory Ancient Star to shake even more violently, and it seemed to be transforming in some way.]
[This caused you to squint your eyes and fly towards space. Seeing you trying to escape, the white flames soared into a giant hand, reaching out to grab you.]
[In response, you used the Time-Space Divine Skill to evade, successfully reaching outer space.]
[Then, you saw a truly shocking sight – the entire Purgatory Ancient Star, which no longer resembled any planet, but a skull instead.]
[This made you gasp in surprise – you suspected that the Purgatory Ancient Star was a planet formed from an Emperor being beheaded. This Emperor probably practiced the Fire attribute.]
[Your heart couldn’t help but race, as if you were witnessing the terrifying battle of the past. At the same time, you also wondered what existence could behead an Emperor and cause such an undignified death.]
[However, even though you say he is dead, there was clearly consciousness. You somewhat doubted whether this Emperor had truly passed away, or did he still possess some power.]
[Of course, now isn’t the time to think about that. Your previous provocation seems to have completely enraged the entity inside. The white flames were still heading your way, determined to burn you to death.]
[Seeing this, you squinted your eyes. You had no intention of going head-to-head with it and planned to use your Golden Talent: Transmission to escape. Otherwise, with the white flames growing stronger, you seriously doubted if you could escape. You must admit, you really went too far this time.]
[As you used the Golden Talent: Transmission, your and Fang Xingyu’s figures disappeared from this place, teleporting to an unknown location.]
[With your disappearance, the white flame paused. In the vagueness, a phantom remnant on the Purgatory Ancient Star seemed to be staring hard at the direction Wang Ping left in, sneering. If it weren’t for his special circumstances, this daring ghost who provoked him could never get away.]
[But wait, the day he reappears, he will…]
[The phantom remnant had a cold killing intent in its heart. Then it gradually disappeared along with its entire figure. The Purgatory Ancient Star returned to calm again, as if nothing had ever happened.]

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: Chapter 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_2
…
“This Purgatory Ancient Star is indeed strange. It seems that it’s not just the head of the Great Emperor.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, his eyes flickering, and thought to himself.
The living beings within seemed to harbor great resentment; it’s unclear whether they were provoked by him or held deep hatred naturally.
“However, it’s difficult for you to come out. It’s been a hundred thousand years since Ye Chen visited the Purgatory Ancient Star, and it still looks the same. Clearly, this guy hasn’t broken the seal and come out.”
Wang Ping shook his head, muttered, and didn’t care about the living beings on the Purgatory Ancient Star at all.
As they couldn’t even stop the transmission abilities, the power they could control must be below the Quasi-Emperor level. As long as they don’t break the seal, they’re not worth caring about.
“But, this time, I’ve set a flag and went looking for death but didn’t die; that’s a bit…impressive.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping couldn’t help but mock, and then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[At this moment, you’ve been teleported to the Immortal Continent. This is quite unexpected, considering how accurately you arrived, saving you quite a bit of travel time.]
[However, Fang Xingyu feels as though he’s been scared out of his wits, his calves trembling, tearfully begging you, his master, not to take him to such dangerous places in the future, his poor little heart can’t stand it.]
[At this, you can’t help but roll your eyes, slapping Fang Xingyu on the forehead, feeling he’s truly useless, scared like this over such a small matter.]
[Being scolded by you, Fang Xingyu doesn’t dare to talk back; he can only complain in his heart.]
[Next, you plan to take Fang Xingyu away from here and return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. But just when you’re about to leave, you see someone unexpected.]
[This person is the Dark Star Sage, who invited you to join the Nine Stars Pavilion when you first advanced to the Saint tier.]
[You’re quite surprised to see him here and feel nostalgic. You were initially very fearful of him, afraid that he could squash you like a bug. Now, however, you’re far more powerful than him.]
[While you reminisce, the Dark Star Sage notices you, his eyes brightening, and quickly approaches.]
[After approaching you, the Dark Star Sage grins and claims that your bone structure is extraordinary, a rarely seen cultivating genius, and asks if you want to join Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[This causes your gaze to become subtle. This Dark Star Sage really enjoys promoting his organization. Last time, he enthusiastically invited you to join the Nine Stars Pavilion, which granted you access to their secret methods and many benefits.]
[So even though you could easily join the Nine Stars Pavilion with your current status and don’t need the Dark Star Sage’s recommendation or persuasion, you decide to agree.]
[However, just as you’re about to agree, your expression changes. You’re shocked to find that you can’t see through the Dark Star Sage. It’s highly unusual that you, at a Half-step Supreme level, can’t see through him. He even gives you a strong sense of danger.]
[This situation is quite strange. You’re definitely at the top of your level, and even Ku Xuan might not be able to defeat you now. But a Great Saint gives you this feeling, which means only one possibility: he’s hiding his cultivation.]
[Thinking of this, you secretly use the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see his true power. You know this is your trump card and hadn’t used it even on the Purgatory Ancient Star.]
[Of course, you also know that the undeveloped Breaking Origin Sky Eye might not be able to see through the Purgatory Ancient Star’s true nature, and only expose your secrets instead.]
[When you activate the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, your vision changes, allowing you to see the Primordial. Then, you see the terrifying dark power within the Dark Star Sage.]
[However, this feeling disappears in an instant. Even with the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, the Dark Star Sage still seems ordinary.]
[This leaves you silent. That feeling was definitely not false. The Dark Star Sage must be at the Quasi-emperor tier, and not just any Quasi-emperor, but one of the most powerful. ]
[It’s just that he’s been hiding too well. You sigh, thinking it’s the first time you’ve met someone more cunning than you. Such a top-tier Quasi-emperor disguises himself as an ordinary Great Saint.]
[In this situation, if anyone treats him like an ordinary Great Saint, they’d be eaten by him without even leaving a trace. Who would know that a Great Saint’s grandmother was a top-tier Quasi-emperor?]
[While you’re feeling a myriad of emotions, the Dark Star Sage is also quite surprised, smilingly saying how deep you’ve hidden your abilities, possessing even the legendary Breaking Origin Sky Eye. It’s not much different from the Time-Space Body, a gift on par with the Sacred Body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: Chapter 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_3
[He clicked his tongue in amazement, stating that you possess a Time-Space Body and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, and your talent is probably the strongest in the world, so much so that even in the Golden Age, there might not be anyone who could compare to you. Such talent is truly enviable, and it makes people want to gouge out your eyes and refine your origin.]
[As soon as the Dark Star Sage said this, your heart clenched, and you instantly became more cautious. However, your expression remained relaxed. Because you know very well that when facing such a powerful person, it doesn’t matter that your Golden Talent: Transmission is now on cooldown. Even without it, your chances of surviving are extremely slim, almost zero.]
[There are only two possibilities for you to survive in front of such a person: the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor appears to save you, or the Dark Star Sage was just joking and trying to scare you.]
[Then, you laughed and said that the senior shouldn’t joke around, as you could not stand being threatened, and you might accidentally summon the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[The Dark Star Sage laughed and said that you have guts, daring to use the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to scare him. However, he also said that even if the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor came, it wouldn’t be useful. But he didn’t want to kill anyone today, so he was not interested in attacking you.]
[At these words, you secretly rolled your eyes, suspecting that he was afraid of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Even if he’s a Quasi-Emperor, he would still have his head twisted off like a soccer ball when facing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Of course, although you were slagging him off in your heart, you didn’t express it. Instead, you praised the Dark Star Sage for his seniority and for not lowering himself to the level of a junior.]
[The Dark Star Sage waved his hand, telling you to cut the crap. Then, he took out an item and handed you the Nine Stars Pavilion’s token and Secret Skill.]
[This left you deep in thought. This token was clearly different from the one you obtained in the previous simulation. Its material was special, clearly a higher level. As for the Secret Skill, it seemed to be the same, but only more complete.]
[Next, the Dark Star Sage looked at you with some regret and said that if he had met you earlier, before the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor took you away, he might have been able to train you as a Nine Stars Candidate.]
[Hearing this, your heart moved, guessing that the Dark Star Sage’s position in the Nine Stars Pavilion was higher than you had imagined. After all, he has the authority to train Nine Stars Candidates.]
[In fact, you even wondered if the Dark Star Sage might be one of the current Nine Stars. If he is, then he would possess legendary combat power that could rival a Great Emperor, as he had previously stated that he didn’t fear the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[As you contemplated the many possibilities, the Dark Star Sage waved his hand, looking very unhappy, and asked you to leave, seemingly full of regret.]
[Not hesitating, you chose to take your leave.]
[However, just as you were about to leave, the Dark Star Sage stopped you again and said that after the Golden Age, he would find you again and take you to a place that would be of great benefit to you. You shouldn’t refuse.]
[Hearing this, you were quite surprised, and you nodded your head without agreeing or refusing. Then, you left directly with Fang Xingyu.]
[After you left, the Dark Star Sage continued to shake his head and mutter what a pity it was, eventually disappearing entirely.]
“This Dark Star Sage, does he really have such a big background? It seems that I should be more cautious in the future. Unless the other party has already exposed themselves, I can’t underestimate any cultivator. Maybe, a God Monarch is actually a Heaven Supreme or even a Quasi-Emperor who likes to play the pig to eat the tiger.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation and was speechless.
He originally thought that there weren’t many people like him, the lucky number six, in this world. Now it seemed he had overestimated the situation.
Ku Xuan is a lucky six, Dark Star Sage is also lucky six, and his master, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, is also one who treads the cautious path, low-key all the way.
Seeing so many examples before him, Wang Ping was genuinely worried that one day he might accidentally encounter someone who is playing the pig to eat the tiger and is not as easy-going, thereby directly beating him to death.
“Well, survival is indeed the most important thing. In reality, I’m not going to take any risks unless I become a Great Emperor or I’m really broke.”
Wang Ping rubbed his forehead and sighed.
If the Life Simulator didn’t charge fees and was based on time refresh, then he would certainly be extremely cautious.
However, there was no choice; he had to spend money, and he had to make money. That’s why he had to take risks from time to time.
Of course, his so-called adventures were actually based on the safety of the life simulation. In the eyes of other cultivators, his risks were as good as nothing.
But for Wang Ping, all the uncertainties of the Life Simulator meant that he couldn’t be 100% safe, making it only 98% safe.
If a 98% safety factor isn’t considered risky, then what is? It’s just too dangerous!
Next, Wang Ping put away his many thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[It wasn’t until you were completely away from the Dark Star Sage that Fang Xingyu cried out with a mournful face, saying something that made your expression stiff. He lamented that following you made him feel like he didn’t have enough lives. In just a short time since leaving, he had encountered life-threatening situations multiple times, and he really didn’t know when he would actually die.]

chapters.title: Chapter 850: 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: Chapter 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_4
[Listening to Fang Xingyu’s words, you couldn’t help being annoyed and slapped him, sending him flying. You suddenly feel that Fang Xingyu, this little rascal, is the most cowardly of your apprentices, even fearing death more than you, the master. Nevertheless, you still prefer Wan Yu’s hot temper and Lin Qinghe’s calm and composed demeanor, both of whom are resolute in their actions.]
[Next, you scolded Fang Xingyu and told him not to be so scared of death and to be more courageous. Then, after he reluctantly agreed with a bitter face, you continued your journey with satisfaction.]
[Upon arriving at Taiyi Imperial Palace, the palace master was quite satisfied to see you return. He glanced at Fang Xingyu without paying much attention to his talent or identity as a disciple of the Tao Palace, and allowed him to join the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Not long after, you chose to self-titled and quietly awaited the arrival of the Golden Age.]
[In a blink of an eye, nearly a hundred thousand years passed, and as the Golden Age arrived, you decided to come into the world and take a high-profile path. You defeated Bai Yu Daohong, took Zhu Huowang as your disciple, obtained the Temporal Origin and Heavenly Ice from the Jee family, challenged Ku Xuan, exhibited your Great Saint cultivation, and overpowered him with your cultivation strength, showing your true colors.]
[Afterward, the subsequent developments didn’t differ much from your memory. The Enlightenment Tea Party took place as planned, where you drank tea and deepened your understanding of the Spatial Dao Pattern. You thought if you could attend a few more Enlightenment Ancient Tea events, perhaps you would have a chance to comprehend the Space Dao Pattern.]
[Of course, this is based on the fact that your Breaking Origin Sky Eye can still help you gain enlightenment. Otherwise, relying solely on Enlightenment Ancient Tea would require much time and long-term consumption.]
[But only the Qin family’s Qin Yue could indulge in such luxurious behavior. Other forces couldn’t, as they didn’t have the Enlightenment Ancient Tea Tree or the foundation.]
[Next, you still made a trade at the Enlightenment Tea Party. However, due to no need to obtain the Emperor’s Sutra Fragment, you didn’t bully the 98th Ranked Heavenly Genius on the Great Saint List, and simply traded your Heavenly Ice with Qin Yue for some Enlightenment Ancient Tea Leaves.]
[Qin Yue was very generous regarding this, saying she could gift them to you as long as you would become her ally. However, you chose to reject her offer and insisted on making a trade.]
[After all, for you, this time’s simulation did not provide much help from Qin Yue, as she might still become your bait. Therefore, it’s best not to form an alliance. Betraying your allies once would be enough, and any more would gradually erode your moral bottom line, which is unthinkable. Even in a life simulation, the same applies.]
[The next day, you went to the White Fog Forbidden Area as you remembered, and with the help of your fortune, you opened the secret realm and entered.]
[After entering, you narrowed your eyes, thinking that the secret realm at this time is much easier to deal with. If you wait until the Immortal Mansion opens, it will become truly troublesome. Even with your Breaking Origin Sky Eye, you might not be able to survive.]
[In such a place, under the calculations of various masterminds, whether you can survive or not depends on whether your opponents want you to live and if you are the lucky one.]
[However, even if you were low-profile in that simulation, your survival chances would still be slim, as those old monsters would likely see through you. Not to mention that you were so high-profile this time, it would be even less likely for you to survive, as they would target you.]
[As a result, you had no choice but to seize this secret realm in advance, eliminate as many of the mastermind’s minions as possible, and ensure your survival during the Immortal Mansion event.]
[Of course, your main goal is still to find out why defeating the hidden Ku Xuan prematurely would trigger this plotline.]
[However, this time, you didn’t cause any trouble right away. Instead, after saving the pure-blooded phoenix sisters Huang Yin and Huang Qing, who might provide a significant battle boost for you, you began cultivation in seclusion, intending to comprehend the Spatial Dao Pattern and maximize your combat power.]
[As for whether you would be found by the black fog silhouettes and the indigenous people, or if they could approach you quietly, there was no need to worry. After all, now that you possess the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, they wouldn’t be able to use their stunning secret skills to sneak up on you.]
[This is the subtlety of pupil-based talents. Of course, not all such talents are so powerful. If their level is low, they will still be unable to see through the astonishing secret skills prepared by these masterminds.]
[In the blink of an eye, a month passed, and you continued to taste tea and comprehend the Dao, occasionally changing locations.]
[Finally, you successfully comprehended the Spatial Dao Pattern, fulfilling the conditions for Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns, which allowed you to further exert the power of your Time-Space Body.]
[This is attributed to the Enlightenment Ancient Tea and the accumulation of your many simulations, especially this time where you secluded yourself in the Tao Palace for more than a thousand years, which proved to be especially critical.]
[Just as you comprehend the Spatial Dao Pattern, you’re finally found and surrounded. At this moment, almost all the other Heavenly Geniuses in this secret realm have been wiped out. They have been captured alive by this group of people and had their origins extracted.]
[Soon, the indigenous people, led by the black fog silhouettes, set up a Great Array to trap and kill you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 851: 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: Chapter 234: The Secret of the Ancient Star! The True Unbeatable At The Same Level!_5
[With a cold smile, you activated your Breaking Origin Sky Eye, easily detecting the flaws in the yet unformed Great Array. Using force to break it apart, you fought alongside Huang Qing and Huang Yin in a guerrilla warfare.]
[Given your current flexibility, unless you get trapped in the Great Array, it is impossible for the opponents to use numerical advantage to battle you. Even those Black Fog Silhouettes, unless there are more than ten of them led by the Time-Space Body, would still struggle to threaten you.]
[Even more so, with your current combat power, you could potentially fight against ten at once.]
[Consequently, during the fight, you killed most of the indigenous people without them even touching your hair. This left the Black Fog Silhouettes restless. They trapped you by using secret skills, with no regard for the cost, and sought to launch a ruthless group attack against you.]
[However, facing this group attack, you remained panic-free. The current you is not the same as the person from the previous simulations – you have enough power to face the onslaught.]
[Quickly, you unleashed a horrifying Time-Space Divine Skill, killing this group one by one. Even the Black Fog Silhouettes, who also have Time-Space Bodies like you, failed to stop your onslaught.]
[After killing this group, you encountered the Time-Space Body. This time, you had a one-to-one duel with him. Without suspense and without the need for the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, the Contemporary Time and Space Tao Physique, who once had the upper hand and forced you into using the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack to kill him, was firmly killed by you. He didn’t even manage to launch a decent counterattack.]
[For a while, you felt the loneliness of being invincible. You have become too strong.]
[Seeing this, Huang Yin and Huang Qing, were impressed. They might be naive, but as the pure-blooded Phoenixes, they are quite proud and strong. Undoubtedly, your strength has won them over, turning them into your little fangirls.]
[Just as you were deep in thought, your Breaking Origin Sky Eye suddenly spotted a figure, and it was Ku Xuan. You narrowed your eyes with a cold smile, finally confirming that Ku Xuan was also one of the masterminds.]
[Although you’re not sure if Ku Xuan is one of the pawns to these people, or the flag bearer himself, it’s sufficient to know that he is from the same side. This confirms that your suspicion was not unfounded, and you were not wrong in targeting him.]
[Next, you didn’t hesitate to rush towards Ku Xuan, intending to kill him.]
[Seeing you rushing towards him, Ku Xuan, engulfed in the black fog, remained calm, his face revealing no change in expression, waiting quietly for your arrival.]
[Soon, you reached nearly in front of him, gazing at him, signifying that his disguise was of no use in front of your Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[This caused Ku Xuan to sigh and reveal his true identity, impressed by your unpredictability.]
[Hearing this, you furrowed your eyebrows, forming some suspicions in your mind. You coldly suggested that Ku Xuan might know some future happenings hence he had been making arrangements. However, your appearance disrupted their plans, provoking them to remove you and the other talented ones, by leading everyone into this secret realm.]
[Ku Xuan remained silent, stating that you, a guest from All Heavens, knew too much. He didn’t know whether to say you had a keen intuition or the ability to foresee the future as well.]
[Here, Ku Xuan withheld some words, not speaking them aloud. You were testing him, and he was testing you as well.]
[Hearing Ku Xuan’s words, you narrowed your eyes, finding answers to the many doubts in your mind. Clearly, if he did not intervene, Ku Xuan or his backers had calculated everything correctly, waiting for the Immortal Mansion to open and then to reap the benefits.]
[However, your appearance and the fact that you exposed the true details of Ku Xuan, is totally different from what they had predicted. Therefore, they became cautious, took it seriously and acted ahead of time to eradicate you, an uncertain element.]
[Yet, this also indicates one fact. It indicates that the individuals hiding behind Ku Xuan are not as dreadful as you imagined, and are not a group of emperors shaping the scheming.]
[Otherwise, why would Ku Xuan need to use this way to kill you? Perhaps he also wanted to deal with other talents in one sweep, but that is not a solid evidence. After all, they could wait until the Immortal Mansion is opened to do so.]
[If the strength behind Ku Xuan was really that powerful, disregarding the protection of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor behind you….even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor himself would have to be attacked, along with the Taiyi Imperial Palace being wiped out.]
[Therefore, it can only be explained that the forces behind them are not that powerful, there are things they dare not reveal, actions they dare not take too far, fearing to be noticed by other major powers and great emperors.]

chapters.title: Chapter 852: 235: Killing Ku Xuan! The Chaotic Tongxian Continent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: Chapter 235: Killing Ku Xuan! The Chaotic Tongxian Continent!
[Next, you didn’t say much to Ku Xuan, and a shocking battle erupted between you. It must be said that Ku Xuan is indeed very strong, with many hidden trump cards. In the outer world, you defeated him by suppressing your cultivation, not wanting to reveal too much.]
[However, now Ku Xuan is no longer your match. You have comprehended the Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns, and even without using any talents or even the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, your strength is not much weaker than Ku Xuan. If you use those talents to assist in combat, Ku Xuan would be easily suppressed by you.]
[Not to mention that now Ku Xuan, unlike in the text simulation before, still has some distance from the opening of the Immortal Mansion. He has lost some growth time and is weaker than in the previous simulation.]
[As a result, when you become serious and stop suppressing your talents, Ku Xuan is easily defeated by you, dying once.]
[However, you know that Ku Xuan has a means of revival, so you wait quietly. Soon, Ku Xuan revives, and with murderous intent in your eyes, you don’t hesitate to attack again, intending to kill him on the spot.]
[Faced with such a dangerous situation, Ku Xuan suddenly bursts into laughter, saying that he will die here today, but what awaits you will not be a good outcome either, and he will wait for you below.]
[Hearing Ku Xuan’s words, a chill runs down your spine, and a myriad of thoughts flashes through your mind, leading you to launch a powerful attack that triggers a multi-performance effect, aiming to forcefully kill Ku Xuan.]
[At this moment, Ku Xuan sacrifices an item and activates it. The moment he activates it, you blast him directly, completely killing him. However, the activated item transforms into an eerie rainbow light that tries to burrow into your body.]
[At this, your heart trembles, and without hesitation, you defend against it using your power, and also employ Golden Talent: Damage Nullification to guard against it.]
[Relying on the brief effect of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, you avoid the curse effect of the item, but you are also marked by it, and an unusual red pattern appears on your wrist that is difficult to hide.]
[This makes you frown.]
…..
“Finally, the truth is revealed, Ku Xuan has problems. The powers behind them are not that strong, which is great news. However, Ku Xuan, what exactly is going on with him…. Although I forcefully killed him this time, which is worth celebrating, his smile and words are indeed chilling.”
Wang Ping narrows his eyes as he looks at the Text Simulation content.
If Ku Xuan is the mastermind, the master of these Black Fog Silhouettes, there seems to be no need for him to enter this secret realm.
After all, this is an act that could expose him, and no cautious BOSS would easily expose themselves, putting themselves in danger.
Besides, that laughter and those words are really unsettling, not the reaction a BOSS should have before dying.
Could it be that Ku Xuan, just like the others with black fog, is merely a member of the Black Fog Warriors, with a slightly more special and stronger identity than the others, including the Time-Space Body, and that’s it?
“If that’s the case, then the mastermind behind this is absolutely terrifying, able to use the Ku family’s heir as a subordinate? Can the Ku family agree to this? In that case, there’s a great contradiction with your previous inference that the mastermind isn’t that strong.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker uncertainly, and more doubts arise in his heart.
If the other party does not even care about the Longevity Ku Family and dares to have the Young Master Ku be a subordinate and pawn, then why would they use this method to kill him, they could directly dominate and truly kill the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor along with him.
“Solving some questions only seems to have created more riddles.”
Wang Ping shakes his head, feeling a little headache.
“By the way, of all the genius entering the secret realm this time, only me, Huangyin, and Huan Qing survived. If I go out, I won’t be considered the murderer, will I?”
Wang Ping thinks about it again, his face turning solemn.
It’s not an impossible situation, entering the secret realm with everyone else dead, and only him, Huangyin, and Huan Qing surviving, it’s simply shocking enough to shake the entire Upper Realm.
After all, the number of Imperial-tier forces and Quasi-Emperor-tier forces involved is enormous, and the sudden death of their heirs is enough to drive these forces insane.
For this reason, even if Wang Ping is not at fault, he might be targeted.
“Whatever, I’ll cross that bridge when I come to it. If worst comes to worst, I’ll die and start over with another simulation.”
Wang Ping exhales lightly, and after calming his mood, he continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you begin to calculate the gold coins exploded by the likes of Ku Xuan and other geniuses. It has to be said that Ku Xuan, as a member of the Longevity Ku Family, really has a lot of good things on him. He’s incredibly wealthy.]
[Although other geniuses also come from extraordinary backgrounds, the good stuff they explode with is just as exciting, but Ku Xuan is far stronger than the others. He has 40 million jin of top-tier Divine Source and about a million jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source. Not to mention the dazzling array of various treasures, medicines, and equipment.]
[You should know that what the Black Abyss Demon Lord gave you before was merely 20 million jin of top-tier Divine Source and 500,000 jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source. Moreover, there weren’t many other good things.]

chapters.title: Chapter 853: 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: Chapter 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_2
[Black Abyss Demon Lord is a Heavenly Venerable, a top Heavenly Venerable who could compete with the Green Bamboo Emperor at the Supreme Realm. Yet, his wealth is only half of Ku Xuan’s, and his collection of rare and exotic treasures is also incomparable. This is simply unbelievable.]
[Although it might also be because the Black Abyss Demon Lord has consumed a lot of resources, it still amazes Wang Ping. You think that compared to Ku Xuan, you are really poor. Many other genius cultivators are even less fortunate than you, making the gap even wider.]
[At this moment, Huang Yin and Huang Qing are staring at these fantastic items with bright eyes, almost drooling. Although they have many Quasi-Emperor masters, their masters haven’t given them so many incredible things. While they have various life-saving items, they haven’t really seen such a large amount of ‘money,’ which directly turned them into little money addicts.]
[In response, under the two’s gaze, you tidy up the items, categorize them, and then put them directly into your storage world.]
[This made Huang Yin and Huang Qing a little envious and reluctant. They could only swallow their saliva and stop themselves from thinking too much. After all, this is your personal achievement; not only did they not help, but they were also saved by you. Instead of talking about sharing resources, they should think about how to repay you.]
[Next, you start discussing with Huang Yin and Huang Qing whether to continue searching for all the Indigenous Tribes, looting them all, and then leaving, or simply leaving the secret realm directly.]
[Secret realms that appear on the Immortal Continent are usually deciphered by humans regarding their rules. Some will automatically kick people out when the time comes; others will close automatically after a certain period. Once closed, if you want to leave, you can only wait for the next opening.]
[However, by then, the trapped cultivators might have died already. After all, it’s not uncommon for secret realms like this one to open every hundred thousand years. A hundred thousand years is just too long.]
