[As for this secret realm, it is an unseen realm used by Ku Xuan and his companions to set up their plot. You are unsure which situation it falls into or if there’s a third possibility. Therefore, you cannot stay for too long and should leave as soon as possible.]
[After making your decision, you start searching for the entrance you used to come in. Soon after, you find the entrance and leave the secret realm.]
[When you guys come out, all the strong cultivators present are staring at the three of you, their eyes flickering as if calculating something. As for the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace, he secretly inquires whether you encountered any danger in the secret realm and what kind of harvests you had.]
[In response, you do not answer this question but instead express solemnly that this secret realm was a plot. The specific events that occurred will be discussed after you return.]
[Upon hearing this, the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace becomes more serious, nods his head, and leaves with you.]
[This scene is witnessed by the other powerful cultivators present, making them frown slightly. However, they don’t think too much about it. After all, they don’t know if you have any significant gains, and they have no reason to intercept. If they were to forcibly intercept, they would indeed offend the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[The powerful cultivators present all have their own hidden agendas and are not united in their actions, so they won’t break ties with Taiyi Imperial Palace over this matter.]
[As for Huang Yin and Huang Qing, they also want to leave, but these powerful cultivators become restless, wanting to invite them to their forces as guests and ask about their experiences in the secret realm.]
[However, before these old monsters make their move, more than a dozen Quasi-Emperor auras suddenly arrive, causing the complexions of many old monsters to change and making them quickly retract their thoughts. They didn’t expect that Huang Yin and Huang Qing would have such close relationships with so many notorious and fierce Quasi-Emperors.]
[As a result, Huang Yin and Huang Qing also swaggeringly leave.]
…..
“In this day and age, it’s essential to have someone backing you. Otherwise, it would be tough to deal with situations like this.”
Wang Ping sighs as he looks at the content of the Text Simulation.
It’s because he is the Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace that no one dares to question him.
As for Huang Yin and Huang Qing, it was because they had so many powerful Quasi-Emperors backing them, that these old monsters didn’t dare to be presumptuous.
Otherwise, both of them would encounter incredibly complicated problems and even face life-threatening situations.
After sighing, Wang Ping continues to stare at the luminescent screen. The following plot is the most critical – it’s uncertain whether it’s life or death.
[After you return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you reveal what happened in the secret realm. However, due to the absence of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you don’t disclose everything in front of this Quasi-Emperor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Instead, you say that you barely escaped by using your Time-Space Divine Skill, rather than annihilating the enemy.]
[At the same time, you also say that you don’t know how the other geniuses fared, only telling that you saw many genius cultivators being killed during your escape.]
[But even so, the most crucial detail mentioned still changed the complexion of the Quasi-Emperor. After all, this matter has too significant an impact. If too many other talented cultivators die and only a few survive, the forces with fallen heirs will definitely rage. They may even implicate the forces with surviving heirs if they cannot find the real culprit.]

chapters.title: Chapter 854: 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: Chapter 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_3
[Although the Qin family stood in the forefront before this, the situation was still extremely troublesome.]
[Moreover, the most crucial point was that there was no Great Emperor in the Taiyi Imperial Palace at the moment. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had gone out and had not returned ever since.]
[If the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor were in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, perhaps he could withstand the pressure, after all, you did nothing wrong and fought desperately to return. If other forces were to cause trouble, the Taiyi Imperial Palace could also strike back at them. But all these premises rely on having sufficient strength to back up them.]
[You could see the changing complexion of the Quasi-Emperor, and you knew that this trouble might be bigger than you thought, so you couldn’t help but have a headache. After all, you haven’t mentioned the worst-case scenario yet. In the secret realm now, the only ones who survived, I’m afraid, are you, Huan Qing, and Huang Yin.]
[Under these circumstances, it would be strange if these forces didn’t unite to cause trouble for the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Even if their grounds are weak, they still can question what happened and doubt why only one person survived.]
[In addition, these forces could send other talented individuals to investigate the situation. If they learn that both the indigenous experts and the talented ones had all died, his reputation would be irreparable.]
[After all, it is only a matter of time before he and the two pure-blooded Phoenixes are the only ones left alive, while everyone else is dead. It would be odd if no one had doubts.]
[Wang Ping really doubted whether the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could hold on this time. There was no choice, as there were just too many forces and experts involved this time.]
[At this point, you couldn’t help but ask the Quasi-Emperor what the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had gone to do and why he had not returned. As for the different performances of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor in the simulations, Wang Ping had previously attributed them all to the butterfly effect.]
[After all, even though he controlled the uncertainty factor, it was impossible for him to have complete control, and there would naturally be differences. The overall plot might be the same, but some small, insignificant storylines could be different.]
[Hearing your query, the Quasi-Emperor shook his head and said he didn’t know. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s actions were always unpredictable, and no one knew what he would do. It could be said that all the emperors were like this, with their actions difficult to fathom.]
[This answer left you quite disappointed, and you could only ask the Quasi-Emperor if he could contact the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Regarding this, the Quasi-Emperor hesitated for a moment and said he might be able to, but if the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was exploring some forbidden land at that time or cultivating somewhere, it would not be wise to make contact suddenly, as it might affect the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[After a pause, the Quasi-Emperor smiled wryly and said that now was the time, and it seemed like they could only contact the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Otherwise, they, these quasi-emperors, would have no means to resist the pressure. After all, this trouble was far too significant.]
[In response to the Quasi-Emperor’s answer, you were not surprised. If there were no means of contacting the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor under normal circumstances, that would be the real oddity. The only thing you were concerned about was whether the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could withstand the pressure this time. Otherwise, you might have to face a game over(G)-ed situation.]
[But what happened next left you silent. Because after the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Quasi-Emperor opened a meeting to try to contact the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, they discovered that he had vanished and could not be contacted at all.]
[This situation was undoubtedly terrible and very strange. After all, the means of contacting the Emperor were still useful even in the Ten Forbidden Lands, and it was impossible for him not to be reachable.]
[This meant that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had either fallen or was in a situation where he could not respond. Regardless of whether he had fallen or was in a state of no response, it was a horrendous situation. After all, a situation where even the Great Emperor can’t respond is not much better than falling.]
[Without the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s support, the atmosphere in the Taiyi Imperial Palace seemed somewhat heavy as they faced the immense pressure that was about to come. And you, having learned of this news, were also silent and extremely helpless.]
[At this point, you felt that your initial guess might be true, that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor hadn’t returned because something had really happened, but you didn’t know what caused it. You felt that you probably wouldn’t get the answer to this mystery in this simulation and would have to wait until the next one when the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor hadn’t left yet to ask him about his upcoming journey.]
[As for why the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor didn’t leave during one of the simulations, you felt that it might be because you had brought out the Broken Map of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra. He wanted to help you get the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra and the Dark Time Emperor Scripture first, so you could grow better and then go on to deal with his own matters.]
[This explanation was quite reasonable. After all, in the simulations that followed, you had already obtained the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra and knew the situation of the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, so there was no need to show the Broken Map and have the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor help you search. Even later on, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could see that you had obtained both Emperor Scriptures, marveling at your amazing fortune, and thus there was even less need for his help.]
[In other words, when you first joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace and showed your talent, you actually saved the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor once. To be precise, you might have delayed the time he encountered trouble. It is possible that, regardless of your existence, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would have encountered trouble; it was just a matter of time.]

chapters.title: Chapter 855: 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: Chapter 235: Killing Ku Xuan! Chaotic Immortal Continent!_4
[Next, you plan to wait and see how the strong ones of the Taiyi Imperial Palace will arrange things. If they can make proper arrangements and solve the problems, you can choose to stay. However, if they can’t arrange things properly and can’t solve the troubles, you already have an idea in your heart.]
[You plan to leave early so as not to cause trouble for the Taiyi Imperial Palace. If the Taiyi Imperial Palace is in danger because of you, you will feel guilty and leave behind a heart demon. Although this is just a simulation, you still don’t want to harm the forces that have been kind to you.]
[Thinking of this, you mock yourself again, thinking that you are really a disaster, causing trouble wherever you go. You used to complain that Ye Chen was the Heavenly Lone Star, but now you think you are even more suitable for the title than Ye Chen. Of course, this is only true in the simulation. In reality, you think you, Wang Ping, are still very normal and do not harm those around you.]
[Next, the quasi-emperors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace started to argue, think about strategies, make arrangements, and take many situations into consideration. As the first emperor child of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you naturally know that the situation is not very good.]
[Because you don’t have much time left. If you continue to delay for a while, when the strong ones find out that no one has come out of the secret realm, or the secret realm entrance is directly closed, other forces should react.]
[Sure enough, one month later, some forces vaguely noticed something was wrong. The secret realm entrance never closed, but no one came out. So, they found a new Heavenly Pride who was qualified to enter and investigate the situation.]
[In the end, the truth was revealed, and many old monsters were furious, their faces rigid with anger. They first confronted the strong ones from the Qin family, questioning them whether they knew the situation, intending to trap and kill all the Heavenly Prides.]
[In response, the strong ones of the Qin family were wronged, saying that they really didn’t know about it. They accidentally found this secret realm, and if it wasn’t necessary to gather the fortune of the Heavenly Prides, they would definitely swallow it alone, instead of gathering Heavenly Prides openly and starting the Enlightenment Tea Party. Moreover, their Qin Yue from the Qin family also perished in it. Would they do such a stupid thing as to trap and kill the daughter of their Great Emperor?]
[Hearing this, everyone was silent, thinking that what the Qin family’s strong people said made sense. However, these strong ones still coldly snorted, saying that it wasn’t over, and then left one after another. In this matter, it involved too much, and they had to go back and ask for more identity and strength, and even invite the Great Emperor, which was a must.]
[After all, in the Golden Age, the heirs they had designated died, which had already affected the Immortal Fate Struggle. Although they could continue to cultivate another Heavenly Pride, it would take too long. Moreover, it is not easy to find a Heavenly Pride at that level, and it is estimated that they can only cultivate a second-rate one.]
[Seeing the others leave, the strong ones of the Qin family also had heavy and ugly expressions on their faces. They didn’t dare to delay and quickly returned to the Qin family to report the matter.]
[During this process, all the forces thought of you and Huan Qing, Huangyin’s existence, and they all planned to come to the door to question. However, these forces also planned to denounce the Qin family at their door before doing so, and demanded an explanation from the Qin family.]
[For a time, the entire Immortal Continent was shaken, and many cultivators were shocked to find that more than ten Great Emperor auras exploded in a short time! And then, the Great Emperors personally led the terrifying army to press towards the Qin family.]
[Even the forces just a step below the Imperial-tier could not help but feel emboldened during this time, no longer fearing the Qin family. They also had quasi-emperor ancestors leading the army to press towards the Qin family, boldly wanting to share in the spoils.]
[This scene made many strong ones feel uncertain, and some even suspected that these forces were ganging up to annihilate the Longevity Qin Family.]
[The old monsters of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, naturally, knew about this matter, and they were all extremely serious, watching the development of the situation, already prepared for the worst.]
[And you, you also found Yu Daohong, sighed, and said that the future of Taiyi Imperial Palace is in your hands, which made Yu Daohong feel heavy. He didn’t go on the secret realm trip, but as the son of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, he naturally knew the causes and consequences of the situation.]
[At this time, he didn’t doubt that you were planning to run away, but guessed that you wanted to break away from the Taiyi Imperial Palace, clear the relationship, and prevent the Taiyi Imperial Palace from being involved. You can say that your behavior is to seek your own destruction.]
[Next, after you and Yu Daohong had a drink, you instructed him to take good care of your disciples, and then you said goodbye to Yu Daohong. After that, you chose to leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[However, before you even left, you were stopped by a quasi-emperor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. He said solemnly that the Taiyi Imperial Palace would not abandon any emperor’s son, and they would not do such a shameful thing. If they could do this at will, the Taiyi Imperial Palace would not have the cohesion it has today and give birth to the Five Emperors.]
[Hearing the words of the quasi-emperor, you were moved, but you still shook your head, deliberately indicating that you hope the quasi-emperor could let you go. You don’t want to live and die with the Taiyi Imperial Palace. There is still a way to survive if you leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace, but if you stay, everyone will die together.]
[Hearing your words, the quasi-emperor sighed and knew that your intentions were determined, and he was unsure whether or not to tie you up to prevent you from doing anything foolish.]

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 235: Killing Gu Xuan! Chaos in Tongxian Continent! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Chapter 235: Killing Gu Xuan! Chaos in Tongxian Continent! _5
Seeing the Quasi-Emperor’s hesitation, you bowed and left, causing the Quasi-Emperor to snap back to his senses and try to stop you. But another Quasi-Emperor appeared, expressing with complex emotions that the Taiyi Imperial Palace indeed couldn’t protect you well now. Letting you go might be the best choice. In your body existed an incarnation left by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, leaving in advance, perhaps there really is a way out.
These words silenced many Quasi-Emperors, all clenching their fists, feeling powerless for the first time. In this world, power is the ultimate respect. Even the Taiyi Imperial Palace, which had given birth to five Emperors, had its day of decline. It’s just that no power can remain prosperous forever.
What they need to consider next may be to deal with various terrible situations after the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s accident at any time. It’s indeed the most dangerous moment. Even without those powers knocking on the door for this matter, once the fall of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is confirmed, there will definitely be Terrifying Strong take action against the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
After all, it’s impossible for the Taiyi Imperial Palace to have not offended any major powers and strong individuals, nor is it possible to have not annihilated any powers. These powers and strong individuals were restrained due to the strong and prosperous state of Taiyi Imperial Palace, which was protected by the Great Emperor. Now, the Great Emperor no longer presided over the Taiyi Imperial Palace, these entities would certainly be eager to move, then pounce and bite.
Besides, the Taiyi Imperial Palace will also have to guard against other explicit powers. These powers might also pounce and take a bite.
When you left Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Qin family was also in a turbulent situation, with the Qin family descendants in great fear. The Longevity Qin Family, though with few clan members, was extremely powerful. However, strength has a limit. They might be stronger than the same-tiered cultivators from major powers in a one-to-one fight, but the number of the invaders was hundreds or thousands of times more than them. It’s like hitting their heads.
Even Emperor Qin, faced with so many emperors, showed extreme heaviness in his expression. At this moment, the dignified Emperor’s face was secondary. He could only try to swallow his pride, stabilize this group of strong people, because if he didn’t, the Qin family would be destroyed today, and he, as an emperor, would also fall.
Soon, negotiations between both sides began. During this negotiation, the Qin family had no room for bargaining. Other major powers knew that the Qin family could not be the mastermind behind the numerous major powers inheritance. The Qin family was not so stupid as to use such low-level tricks to even harm their own Imperial Princess.
However, even though they knew this, the Qin family was responsible for initiating the Enlightenment Tea Party and leading the excavation of the secret realm, and thus had to shoulder the anger of the many major powers. If they didn’t offer enough benefits, these major powers would dare to annihilate the Qin Family and divide it.
In this situation where so many major powers are taking action together, every single power can easily destroy the Qin family without any cost. Who would choose to just watch?
In the end, after the negotiation between Emperor Qin and the many forces, the Qin family paid a heavy price. More than half of the treasures in the Qin family treasury was cleaned out, including the two Enlightenment Ancient Tea Trees, and the Qin family lost all their industries.
It can be said that after today, the Qin family might not show any changes for a short time. However, as time goes by, it will definitely become the weakest imperial-tier force. After all, without enough high-level resources, it would be fatal to maintain the operation of the Qin family and cultivate descendants. Especially after the fall of Emperor Qin, if there is no one to succeed the Qin family, the Qin family will truly be finished, possibly following in the footsteps of the Tao Palace.
As the Qin family chose to save itself by cutting off its tail, the descendants of the Qin family, watching the major powers leaving in a noisy crowd, felt constrained. Emperor Qin also had a gloomy expression, his eyes full of murderous intent. He resented the mastermind who dared to harm his family the most, wanting to dig him out and completely annihilate him.
Considering the miserable state of the Qin family, many strong individuals who were watching from the side fell silent. In this world, even Great Emperors have times of constraint, which is really dispiriting. Indeed, to truly transcend the rules, one must become a cultivator. Only by becoming a cultivator can one become invincible in the world, with no one daring to provoke.
Next, to the surprise of the cultivators, the major powers that suppressed the Qin family and forced the Longevity Qin family to save itself by cutting off its tail, were actually advancing towards the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
This surprised many major powers, they didn’t know what had happened during this period that caused the major powers to join forces and act against the Qin family, even planning to act against the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Upon seeing that these armies of major powers were really coming towards the Taiyi Imperial Palace, the strong individuals from the Taiyi Imperial Palace all showed solemn expressions. However, before this, they had already carried out the fire seed inheritance plan. Even if something really happened to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, they wouldn’t have to worry about complete annihilation.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 236: Immortal!?
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: Chapter 236: Immortal!?
“It has come to this after all. Although I have some evidence, the key issue now is not finding the truth.”
Wang Ping frowned as he read the contents of the text simulation.
None of these old monsters from the various forces were fools. They knew who was scheming against them and targeting these geniuses.
Moreover, Wang Ping did not destroy the bodies of the black fog silhouettes in the secret realm, meaning they must have also discovered that these black fog silhouettes and the indigenous people attacked the geniuses.
As for who the mastermind is behind it all, further investigation is needed.
However, finding the truth can wait. This is an unspoken understanding.
What they want to do now is seize this once-in-a-thousand-year opportunity to take over the resources of the Qin family and the Taiyi Imperial Palace. After all, whether it’s the Qin family’s Enlightenment Ancient Tea Tree and other Supreme Treasures, or the treasures of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, they are all highly sought after by other forces.
If it were in the past, no force would easily go to war with other imperial-tier forces.
Especially against the deep-rooted imperial-tier forces like the Longevity Qin Family and the Taiyi Imperial Palace. It would be nearly impossible due to the numerous constraints.
But now it’s different. The Qin family has suffered a huge setback, and they can use the excuse of collusion to take the moral high ground and force the Taiyi Imperial Palace to hand over the First Emperor’s Child for soul-searching.
In this way, they can not only further understand what exactly happened in the secret realm, but also directly cripple this Emperor’s Child of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, eliminating a threat.
Our geniuses are gone, so the only one that survived must also go. This way, everyone will be even.
As for the two pure-blooded Phoenixes and those ferocious Quasi-Emperors, that can be dealt with later.
They are not imperial-tier forces, and the benefits that can be gained from them are limited.
Although such a behavior might be shameful, for not finding the mastermind and instead targeting the other two forces that were also targeted, what does being shameful matter? On the eve of the Immortal’s opening, weakening two extremely powerful imperial-tier forces and using their resources to strengthen oneself is a necessary thing to do.
As long as they can become Immortals, anything is worth it.
“Of course, not all Great Emperors think this way.”
Wang Ping sighed softly, murmuring to himself.
There are dozens of existing Great Emperors in the Immortal Continent.
Now, only eleven or twelve Great Emperors have taken action.
As for those forces who dared to attack the Qin family, they are most likely affiliated with the imperial-tier forces, otherwise they wouldn’t have the guts.
In other words, the other Great Emperors haven’t taken action, refusing to engage in such things, clearly focusing on investigating the mastermind and not wanting to involve the innocent.
Of course, they also have no reason to stop these forces from taking action as it would only be a thankless task.
“Perhaps among these acting Great Emperors, there are also those who have ulterior motives and are stirring the waters.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, reaching a conclusion.
Then, he continued to stare at the luminescent screen, watching the text simulation.
[As these forces descend on the Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Palace Guardian Emperor Array is truly activated, ready to resist any attack at any moment. Although such efforts are futile. No matter how strong the array is, it cannot possibly withstand a Great Emperor’s attack, let alone when so many Great Emperors have descended together.]
[Next, an elderly Great Emperor takes a step forward, coldly demanding Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to come out and give everyone an explanation as to why, out of this trip to the secret realm, only Huan Qing and Huangyin survived with him.]
[In response to the elderly Great Emperor’s command, a Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Ancestor from the Taiyi Imperial Palace stepped forward, stared at the elderly Great Emperor, and explained that in the secret realm, various lifesaving skills couldn’t be used, and even an Emperor’s incarnation couldn’t be activated, which undoubtedly was the doing of the mastermind. Since everyone was being played, there’s no need to make things difficult for the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[The elderly Great Emperor snorted coldly, asserting that all their Emperor Children had died, and only the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Emperor Child survived, which was obviously suspicious and perhaps they even colluded with the mastermind.]
[The Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Ancestor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace fell silent, knowing that without paying a heavy price, this matter wouldn’t end peacefully today. Besides, if these people found out that something had happened to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, the entire Taiyi Imperial Palace might be finished.]
[As the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Ancestor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace fell silent, an incarnation appeared above the Taiyi Imperial Palace, coldly staring at the many cultivators. The faces of the Palace’s elders turned to you, realizing you might be sacrificing yourself.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation coldly stared at the numerous cultivators, its gaze so oppressive that numerous cultivators nearly exploded and died. If not for the intervention of some Great Emperors, they might have perished.]
[Seeing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s attitude, the elderly Great Emperor snorted again coldly, asserting that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had some nerve. With the current situation, he didn’t appear in person, and even dared to attack their people with his incarnation.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation looked indifferently at the elderly Great Emperor, stating that he and his Taiyi Imperial Palace were innocent, and that the man had no right to demand his true presence.]

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 236: Immortal!? _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 858: Chapter 236: Immortal!? _2
[The words infuriated the older Emperor, feeling underestimated by Emperor Tianyu. As a result, he angrily attacked the incarnation of Emperor Tianyu.]
[Upon seeing this, the incarnation of Emperor Tianyu sneered and struck back, colliding with the older Emperor. In an instant, terrifying powers clashed, leaving the many onlookers stunned.]
[The clash ended with Emperor Tianyu’s incarnation winning, as the older Emperor’s body was cracked by the impact. Though he healed instantly, it was clear that he was at a disadvantage.]
[The older Emperor’s face darkened at this outcome. Clearly, he and the others had underestimated Emperor Tianyu. Despite not being at his peak and lacking a Special Constitution, he had still managed to become an Ordinary Emperor. It was extremely difficult for another Emperor to injure him with just an incarnation.]
[The fact that Emperor Tianyu’s incarnation could achieve this demonstrated how powerful his true body must be.]
[At this thought, the older Emperor and other Emperors present became more somber, somewhat wary of Emperor Tianyu. It seemed he had been too undervalued. They had previously believed him to be the most ordinary of the five Emperors born from the Taiyi Imperial Palace, but clearly, they had been mistaken. His strength might only be second to the Taiyi Great Emperor himself.]
[Emperor Tianyu’s incarnation coldly stared at the other Emperors, warning them that if they wanted the truth, his disciple would oblige, but if they continued their current course of action, they couldn’t blame him for seeking revenge in the future at any cost.]
[Such unyielding attitude made people doubt whether this was really just an incarnation or the true Emperor himself; it was exceedingly domineering.]
[Seeing all this, you couldn’t help but feel many emotions. Emperor Tianyu was as overbearing as always, providing a sense of security. Unfortunately, no one knew where his true body was and what dangers it must be facing.]
[As you marveled at this, the other Emperors present also narrowed their eyes at Emperor Tianyu’s words. His strong stance was somewhat out of their expectations. If an Emperor decided to disregard the consequences and seek revenge, it would be extremely dangerous, causing them some hesitation.]
[After all, the Taiyi Imperial Palace was unlikely to be the mastermind. Their purpose here was merely just to suppress it and acquire numerous resources.]
[At this moment, Emperor Qin watched the scene, laboring deep in thought. The Longevity Qin Family had been comfortable for too long, and as the older Emperor Qin, he was now plagued by too many concerns, lacking the strength he once had. If he had chosen to hide his true body like Emperor Tianyu and appeared with an incarnation ready to fight to the death, perhaps the outcome would be different.]
[But in the end, Emperor Qin just laughed at himself. For everything had already passed, and it was too late. He was indeed old, no longer as proud and overbearing as in his youth. What he wanted most was to preserve the Qin family and produce a new Emperor during his lifetime.]
[Initially, the Qin family had two hopes, but Qin Yue fell, disabling one. Risking everything now would result in the true annihilation of the Qin family, leaving nothing left.]
[Although he could take refuge in the Source of Darkness, it was not an easy place to hide in. Once an Emperor entered, few remained completely rational upon exiting, forced to consume numerous Living Beings.]
[If he became like that, the Qin family could still be wiped out, and he might even be killed by other Emperors.]
[So unless all hope was lost or an individual was especially cold-hearted and had nothing left to lose, no one would willingly enter the Source of Darkness due to the great pitfalls.]
[While Emperor Qin was consumed by thoughts and the opposing sides were deadlocked, one Emperor stepped forward. It was the Wind Heart Great Emperor, who had killed the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body of the previous generation. He stared at the incarnation of Emperor Tianyu and calmly uttered a shocking statement to the other Emperors.]
[The Wind Heart Emperor declared that they needn’t worry about Emperor Tianyu’s threat. Even if he hid and attempted to retaliate against them and their factions, it would be futile; he could locate Emperor Tianyu and lock onto his position. Once found and killed, the threat would be extinguished forever.]
[Upon hearing this, you and the other Emperors became more determined. If the Wind Heart Emperor could do as he claimed, they could simply put an end to it all by annihilating the Taiyi Imperial Palace, killing Emperor Tianyu, and taking the palace’s resources for themselves.]
[Those who had participated in this conflict held grudges against the Qin family and Taiyi Imperial Palace. Although some, like the Wind Heart Emperor, had no such personal feud and their motives for joining the fray remained unknown, none of that mattered. If they could destroy the Taiyi Imperial Palace and Tianyu Emperor, they would dare to take action.]
[Seeing the tables turn, the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s people changed expression; the incarnation of Emperor Tianyu was shaken. As for you, you stared intently at the Wind Heart Emperor, sensing that something was off with him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 859: 236: Immortal!?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 859: Chapter 236: Immortal!?_3
[Then, you stepped forward, even though you knew your next words wouldn’t do any good. You still said that you had already left Taiyi Imperial Palace and hoped that the seniors would not target it anymore. Hearing this, everyone shook their heads, thinking you were too naive.]
[However, many cultivators were quite surprised, thinking that you, as an Emperor’s son, were very bold to face everyone and say these words, intending to sacrifice yourself in order to protect the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After that, under the astonished gazes of the crowd, you spoke again. You said that the seniors only wanted evidence. In that case, you would provide some evidence, letting all the major powers of the Upper Realm know who the mastermind was behind the scenes.]
[Then, you directly took out the corpse of Ku Xuan from your storage world.]
[As Ku Xuan’s corpse appeared, the cultivators who were paying attention all gasped in shock. They didn’t expect that Ku Xuan, who was known as the First Heaven’s Proud Genius of the Immortal Continent, would also have fallen. It was too tragic that someone who was destined to become an Emperor of Tao Proving and had a chance to ascend to immortality was also fallen.]
[Many cultivators sighed, feeling that the path of cultivation was truly cruel. No matter how high one’s talent was, there were too many accidents in cultivation. Even the most monstrous people could fall halfway, and the level of talent did not represent the future achievements. Only those who could stand at last were the winners.]
[The cultivators present were not fools, especially the Great Emperors and Quasi-Emperors. After seeing the corpse, their expressions instantly darkened, and they thought of many things.]
[As a result, they stared hard in the direction of Longevity Ku Family with murderous intent. They knew very well that Ku Xuan of the Longevity Ku Family had not entered the secret realm but was rumored to be cultivating in seclusion, trying to comprehend Tao Patterns.]
[However, Ku Xuan appeared in the secret realm, which raised huge questions. It indicated that the Ku family had problems, and they were most likely the real mastermind behind everything.]
[They had always been wary of the mysterious Longevity Ku Family. However, the Ku family dared to do such things, which undoubtedly offended all the major powers in the Immortal Continent. Naturally, they no longer needed to fear the Ku family and could join forces to confront them, demand an explanation, and figure out the truth about the Ku family.]
[Seeing the atmosphere change, you sighed in relief, feeling that the situation was finally under control.]
[But at this moment, Emperor Fengxin spoke again, asking how you managed to escape and demanded that you provide a clear explanation and restore the truth. Since the Longevity Ku Family had planned everything, they must have had many tricks up their sleeves. How were you able to kill all your enemies and escape unscathed with the two not-yet-grown pure-blooded phoenixes, Huang Yin and Huang Qing?]
[Facing Emperor Fengxin’s question, you cursed him in your heart, feeling that he was really troublesome and became even more convinced that there was something wrong with him.]
[However, although you cursed Emperor Fengxin in your heart, there was no change in your facial expression. You simply stepped forward calmly, revealing your Half-step Supreme Cultivation and Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns.]
[Seeing this, the powerful figures who were unable to see your cultivation level all quivered in shock. They didn’t expect you to hide so deeply, that you had already cultivated to the Half-step Supreme tier. Then, they recalled the scene where you defeated Ku Xuan with your Great Saint Cultivation, and they couldn’t help but feel a subtle sensation- this was undoubtedly bullying the weak with your strength.]
[Emperor Fengxin looked at your revealed Time-Space Dual Dao Patterns without surprise, saying calmly that it was still not enough.]
[You showed no emotion, unveiling your final trump card. Since you couldn’t show your talent, you had no choice but to reveal your Broken Origin Heaven Pupil. Although you felt that revealing this talent might trigger an overreaction from the crowd, you had no other choice.]
[When you revealed your Broken Origin Heaven Pupil, everyone was shocked, including the Great Emperors. They couldn’t help it, since the talents you revealed were too terrifying — the Time-Space Body combined with the Primordial Eye. With such talents, even Ku Xuan, who possessed Immortal Bone and Dual Emperor Bloodline, couldn’t compare with you.]
[Without a doubt, leaving aside the guests from All Heavens, you were the most monstrous genius in the Upper Realm thus far. Throughout history, no one could compare to you.]
[For a moment, many Great Emperors felt a mixture of emotions, feeling that you were too monstrous, a pity that you were not their disciple. At this moment, many Great Emperors were quite envious of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[Next, you directly displayed your memory images through your Divine Skills. The scenes you showed included entering the secret realm, being attacked, rescuing Huang Yin and Huang Qing, cultivating in seclusion, comprehending Tao Patterns, improving your strength, being besieged, counter-killing, fighting Ku Xuan, killing him, all very clear… Of course, you deliberately concealed some conversations between both parties.]
[After presenting the evidence, you fearlessly scanned the Great Emperors, fixing your gaze on Emperor Fengxin, and arrogantly declared that you had enough strength to kill the enemies with Huang Yin and Huang Qing, break free, and leave the secret realm. Was there anything else the seniors wanted to say?]
[Emperor Fengxin was questioned by you and rendered speechless. Indeed, with the things you showed, you had the strength to kill anything, and none of your peers were your match. You didn’t need any tricks. Besides, your memory images were also evidence.]

chapters.title: Chapter 860: 236: Immortal!? _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 860: Chapter 236: Immortal!? _4
[For a moment, the attacking Emperors felt a bit uncertain about advancing or retreating. After all, regarding the Qin family, though everyone was aware that they were most likely innocent and that it couldn’t have been the Qin family’s scheme, the fact that the Qin family led various geniuses into the secret realm meant that they had to shoulder responsibility and couldn’t completely get rid of suspicion; the pressure on the Qin family seemed reasonable.]
[However, now that you’ve presented evidence casting suspicion on Ku Xuan and Ku Family, plus your own strength is enough to prove your innocence. If they continue to persecute, they’d be truly making a laughing stock of themselves before all the cultivators in the Upper Realm.]
[Besides, without having the strength to truly transcend everything, there are still basic rules they need to abide by; otherwise, how would other forces perceive them? At that time, their situation would become quite delicate.]
[As the atmosphere grew oppressive, a somewhat strange laughter echoed, drawing the many cultivators’ attention. Then, you all saw a person wearing a Starry Mask appearing in the field and playfully saying a sentence.]
[That sentence was, given that the innocence of the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Emperor’s son has already been proven, if all of you still insist on targeting the Taiyi Imperial Palace, that would mean that there must be ghosts among you, perhaps connected to the Ku family, who want to strike first to clear suspicion, while at the same time weakening the forces that are obstructive to your plans.]
[The moment these words were spoken, the expressions of the Emperors present all sank. They dared not take up this accusation. And, the emergence of one of the Nine Stars, did it represent that some of those from the Nine Stars Pavilion had also participated, siding with the Taiyi Imperial Palace? This was something they hadn’t expected.]
...
[As for you, looking at the masked man, you somewhat suspect that this guy might be the Dark Star Sage; otherwise, it seems that there was no reason for the Nine Stars Pavilion to help you. Only that guy, the Dark Star Sage, had invited you to join the Nine Stars Pavilion during the end of the Dharma era and also wanted to take you somewhere in the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
…
“This situation is truly frightening, with more and more strong beings being involved.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, sighing in his heart.
However, there was no other way.
So many geniuses died at once; it was like poking a hole through the sky.
However, the fact that the Dark Star Sage also appeared and chose to help him was quite surprising.
He just didn’t know what the purpose of establishing the Nine Stars Pavilion was, and its position in the Upper Realm.
But regardless of the situation inside the Nine Stars Pavilion, the probability is that its foundation doesn’t fall short of the Longevity Ku Family’s.
Soon after, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, wanting to see the outcome.
[As the man with the Starry Mask made his appearance and spoke, the situation changed subtly, making everyone extremely tense.]
[It was at this moment that another Emperor stepped forward. This Emperor turned out to be Emperor Qin, who stated, expressionless, that since the Ku family had problems and Taiyi Imperial Palace was innocent, his Qin family was also calculated against. Why don’t everyone head to the Longevity Ku Family together to seek an explanation? In this internal strife, do you really want to let the mastermind behind the scenes have a good laugh?]
[As Emperor Qin spoke, the observing Emperors stepped forward one after another, their attitude very clear, equally intending to seek an explanation from the Longevity Ku family.]
[The development of the situation eased Emperor Fengxin and other powerful experts’ expressions, causing them to instantly chuckle, claiming that they also lost their rationality due to the deaths of their disciples and created a lot of misunderstandings. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have done such foolish things, hoping that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Emperor Qin could be more understanding.]
[Upon hearing these words, you cursed these shameless people in your heart, noting that their ability to change their faces was quicker than flipping through a book.]
[However, you also breathed a sigh of relief. It was initially thought to be challenging to find a good ending, but unexpectedly, you managed to survive. All you could say was the tough attitude displayed by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation and the appearance of the Dark Star Sage was crucial. Otherwise, they would not have that many scruples and would have acted directly.]
[Following that, under the leadership of the various Emperors, countless powerhouses marched towards the Longevity Ku family, intending to hold the Ku family accountable and test the truth of the Ku family’s situation.]
[If the Ku family isn’t as powerful as they imagined, they will directly take action against it, making the Ku family pay the price they deserve. At the same time, the foundation of the Ku family will fall into their hands.]
…
“The Longevity Ku family, is it finally time to lift the veil of mystery?”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, his eyes flickering uncertainly.
If the Ku family is not so powerful, then they would indeed be wiped out.
The wrath of so many Emperors is not easy to withstand.
Whether it’s to muddy the waters or genuinely seek revenge, the Ku family must contend with these Emperors; otherwise, they won’t even have the right to negotiate.
“However, I always feel that it won’t be that smooth.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows, feeling a sense of unease.
Although his intuition was not completely accurate and there were many times when he was wrong, there were also times when it was very precise.
As a result, Wang Ping felt that the following developments might take an unexpected turn.
While Wang Ping was lost in thought, the simulation continued.
[Many powerhouses, arriving at the Longevity Ku family, attracted the attention of numerous cultivators. Today’s melon was simply too big; they couldn’t finish eating it, not at all. One could say that today marked a complete change.]
[Soon, an Emperor reprimanded the Longevity Ku family, demanding them to give an explanation. In response to the Emperor’s scolding, a person from the Longevity Ku family came forward.]

chapters.title: Chapter 861: 236: Immortal!? _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 861: Chapter 236: Immortal!? _5
[He is also a Great Emperor – an entity that many cultivators have never seen. However, his imperial majesty far surpasses most other emperors.]
[Nevertheless, in the past, other emperors would have been extremely cautious when confronted with this emperor from the Ku family. But today, with dozens of emperors uniting against him, even if he is powerful, he will not be able to match them.]
[Therefore, these emperors are still displaying homicidal intent, questioning the Ku family on why they plotted against their heirs. If they do not receive a satisfactory answer today, they will raze the Ku family to the ground.]
[Emperor Ku scanned the crowd with a calm expression, showing no fear; he simply stated that Ku Xuan is his son.]
[At these words, everyone froze and furrowed their brows at Emperor Ku. As for you, it was the same. This Emperor of the Ku family is very arrogant to come forward on such an occasion and casually say these words, as if he isn’t afraid of the wrath of the emperors causing them to kill him on the spot.]
[While you entertained many thoughts, Emperor Ku calmly stated that this matter had nothing to do with the Ku family, and there was a high probability that his son, Ku Xuan, was also manipulated by someone. Therefore, the Ku family is also hunting for this mastermind, planning to execute them.]
...
[At these words, all the emperors looked coldly at him, not believing Emperor Ku’s statement. If Young Master Ku could be manipulated so easily, it would be too incredible.]
[After all, who could easily manipulate Young Master Ku, and even quietly turn Young Master Ku into his subordinate? This seems a bit far-fetched. If the other party had this ability, they wouldn’t have to be so calculating.]
[Facing the doubts of numerous cultivators, Emperor Ku calmly stated that they would uncover the truth and hoped that everyone would leave the matter at that. If anyone wished to make a move against the Ku family, they could certainly try.]
[Seeing Emperor Ku’s defiant and domineering attitude, everyone furrowed their brows, pondering the truth of Emperor Ku’s words.]
[Now, the fog was too thick. If the Ku family is not the mastermind, then who is? Who has such great capability?]
[However, after careful consideration, you found it inconceivable that the Ku family would turn Ku Xuan into a Black Fog Silhouette to face danger. It didn’t seem like something a normal father would do.]
[But you can’t figure out who has the ability to manipulate everyone. After pondering it over, it seems like only forces from All Heavens could do this.]
[Only these kinds of forces, by relying on special abilities or tools gained from the Myriad Heavens Paradise, could accomplish such a feat. Or perhaps the mastermind himself came from another world, possessing special abilities on par with a chat group optimized by the Golden Finger.]
[If that was the case, it would explain why he was able to subdue so many talented individuals. It seems like even Ku Xuan has become his subordinate.]
[While you are brainstorming, some emperors angrily denounced the Ku family, considering Emperor Ku’s words irrational, and began to invite fellow taoists to join them in vanquishing the Ku family first, promising that the truth will naturally be revealed later.]
[Hearing this, many emperors looked cold and prepared to strike. After all, Ku Xuan’s appearance in the secret realm was too suspicious. In addition, they couldn’t possibly trust what the Ku family said. To clear their name, they need evidence. Clearly, the Ku family had no intention of presenting such evidence, or it could be said that they couldn’t.]
[In such a situation, they can naturally only remain firm. No matter what, they must make the Ku family pay the price. Their goal is not just to accuse and discover the truth but also to uncover the secrets of the Ku family.]
[As the emperors joined forces to put pressure, Emperor Ku’s expression also became slightly serious, but his complexion remained calm as he spoke solemnly: ‘Since fellow Taoists are so determined to move against my Ku family without considering the facts, then if they perish here, my family cannot be blamed.’]
[When saying this, Emperor Ku did not look at the gathered emperors but gazed toward the Immortal Mansion.]
[This scene caused a chill to run through the spines of some people, an ominous premonition forming in their hearts.]
[At that moment, a terrifying aura appeared – an aura that surpassed the Great Emperor Tier. It was unknown whether it was something divine or if someone from the Ku family had achieved immortality.]
[With the appearance of this terrifying aura, even the emperors present had their expressions change, a mix of surprise, fear, and elation clouding their faces, their emotions incredibly complex.]
[As for you, you were equally shocked, staring intently at Emperor Ku, completely taken aback that the Ku family actually had an immortal presence. It was said that immortality was a mere legend and didn’t exist in this world. Yet it appeared that the Ku family had an immortal presence, which was simply too astonishing.]

chapters.title: Chapter 862: 237: The Mastermind Revealed! The Reason for Emperor Tian Yu's Disappearance!?
chapters.content:
Chapter 862: Chapter 237: The Mastermind Revealed! The Reason for Emperor Tian Yu’s Disappearance!?
“Is the Ku family hiding this deep? There actually exists an Immortal? Should we say that it’s no wonder they can endure from the previous era to the present as a Longevity Clan? Their foundation is indeed too terrifying.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, and was also extremely astonished.
“However, with the Ku family’s reaction, could it be that the Ku family is not the mastermind behind this, but rather a force being manipulated? If that’s the case, who exactly has such great capabilities to manipulate so many forces and powerhouses, and even prevent them from deducing who is behind it?”
Immediately after, Wang Ping furrowed his brow, his gaze flickering uncertainly.
It should be known that at the level of a Great Emperor, one can already deduce certain things. Not to mention there are existences like the Child of Heavenly Calculation and the Divine Calculation Man who can perform Heavenly Secret Calculations.
With so many powerful existences not detecting anything unusual, the ability to do so is truly astounding.
...
“The Ku family is wary of the Immortal Mansion. Does the Immortal Mansion have a problem, or is it simply that the Immortal Mansion also has an Immortal presence?”
Wang Ping recalled the reaction of the Ku family’s Great Emperor and pondered for a moment.
“No, that’s not right. Whether it’s the Ku family or the Immortal Mansion, neither should have an Immortal being born. After all, if there really is an Immortal, then the Immortal Mansion wouldn’t open the Immortal gates to nurture an Immortal….. In other words, whether it’s the Ku family or the Immortal Mansion, there’s a high probability that they possess Immortal Artifacts or have hidden powerhouses that have surpassed the Great Emperor Tier and already possess a part of Immortal strength.”
“Although it’s not a real Immortal, it’s still terrifying enough. Even so, they still haven’t sensed it. It can only be said that the means of the mastermind behind it are just too amazing, and it reminds me of the Myriad Heavens Paradise….”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, thinking of a possibility.
The ability of Myriad Heavens Paradise is truly high, and it can still grow.
If allowed to develop, no one knows what level of strength he can reach.
If it really turns out that Myriad Heavens Paradise is the one behind all of this, then Wang Ping can understand why so many powerhouses can’t detect anything unusual. Everything seems reasonable.
Myriad Heavens Paradise’s strength is very high. It can quietly control those Heavenly Talents in the dark fog, or nurture those of that level of strength, and it can also Block Heavenly Secret Calculations.
However, the strength of Myriad Heavens Paradise is not enough to directly confront the entire Upper Realm, so he uses various calculations and cannot directly attack him, the meddling party.
“Myriad Heavens Paradise….”
Wang Ping’s eyes shone brightly and as the speculation progressed, he felt the likelihood was indeed high.
At the same time, Wang Ping also wondered if killing this Myriad Heavens Paradise would satisfy the conditions mentioned by Alpha.
If it can, then he won’t have to wait any longer when he goes to the Myriad Heavens Paradise in the future, and he can put his mind at ease.
After all, who knows when that level of Myriad Heavens Paradise will appear, and the type of special capacity it possesses might not necessarily be able to resolve it.
If the current Myriad Heavens Paradise can only calculate, it means that its strength is very strong, but it’s not the type that will instantly get caught and die if you’re not careful.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t need to be so meticulous in his calculations. As long as he can figure out his strength and more specific abilities, it would be easier to deal with.
“Of course, all of this is just my speculation. Whether or not it’s Myriad Heavens Paradise remains to be verified. Besides, the most crucial question is whether this Myriad Heavens Paradise has become strong enough in the real world and has simply chosen to self-title itself to the Golden Age. If it’s not strong enough, then finding and eliminating him in the real world may not satisfy the conditions.”
Wang Ping then thought of this point and shook his head slightly.
After that, he concentrated his thoughts and stared at the luminescent screen.
[Soon, a strong sense of something wrong is sensed by some. Although the Immortal aura of the Ku family is very powerful, making them, as Great Emperors, feel a sense of fatal danger, it does not completely transcend the Great Emperor Tier.]
[If it’s a real Immortal, even a Great Emperor should be like an ant in front of it. After all, as one’s cultivation progresses, the gap becomes larger. A Quasi-Emperor is like an ant in front of a Great Emperor. Therefore, the gap between a Great Emperor and an Immortal would only be more terrifying, a complete qualitative change.]
[In such a situation, perhaps an Immortal can stare a Great Emperor to death in a single glance, or it may be an exaggeration to say that suppressing a Great Emperor with just Immortal Strength, but it shouldn’t just be at this level.]
[Immediately, a Great Emperor spoke disappointingly, saying that the Ku family had no Immortals, but only possessed an Immortal Spirit. This made the many Great Emperors present react and show disappointment.]
[If this world can really become Immortal directly, they don’t need to place their hopes entirely on Immortal Fate or wait for the Immortal Domain Channel to appear.]
[Unfortunately, there are no Immortals in this world. The one in the Ku family should have obtained an Immortal Spirit after the opening of the Immortal gates, refined it, gained some of the Immortal Spirit’s origin, and possessed a power above the Great Emperor Tier.]
[Although Immortal Spirits are extremely rare and legendary, making the Great Emperors on the scene quite envious, the shock they bring is much smaller compared to having an actual Immortal.]
[The Ku family’s Great Emperor calmly stated that there was indeed no Immortal in their family. However, after refining the Immortal Spirit, their family now has a quasi-Fairy. If anyone dares to make a move against their family, they will perish here.]

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 237: The Mastermind Revealed! The Reason for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Disappearance!?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 863: Chapter 237: The Mastermind Revealed! The Reason for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Disappearance!?_2
The idea made the Great Emperors at the scene frown and cast their gazes in the direction of the Ku family, somewhat wary. The Ku family had a Quasi-Immortal, and Ku Xuan’s talent was also high, so it seemed that there was indeed no need to scheme against their descendants, and the disadvantages would outweigh the benefits.
This meant that the chances of the Ku family being manipulated were also quite significant. Under the circumstances where a Quasi-Immortal was sitting in the Ku family, if they really fought, they would have to pay a heavy price. Moreover, under such circumstances, the Great Emperors present were not united, and no one was willing to confront the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal head-on and see how strong the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal was.
For this reason, one of the Great Emperors casually suggested that since the Ku family had also been schemed against, everyone might as well take the time to deduce together and find the real culprit.
As soon as those words were spoken, it gave both sides a way out, so that neither would lose face. The Great Emperor of the Ku family also narrowed his eyes and slowly nodded his head in the end.
In this way, a terrifying battle came to an end, leaving the cultivators of the Immortal Continent unable to calm down. And you, too, breathed a sigh of relief and entered the Longevity Ku Family with the incarnation of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
As for the Great Emperor Council, how to find the real murderer, for the time being, has nothing to do with you. It’s possible that they will call you there after the end of the Great Emperor Council when all Emperors cannot deduce the results together.
...
Soon, the detailed information spread throughout the Upper Realm. For a time, the Upper Realm was shaken, not expecting that the geniuses on the Saint King Ranking and Great Saint Ranking would almost be wiped out together. There was a mysterious existence scheming against all Imperial-tier forces in the Immortal Continent, and among them, the Qin family suffered the most, even involving the Ku family.
However, what followed was your complete rise to fame. Your performance in the secret realm was spread throughout the realm, earning you the title of the greatest genius of all time, far surpassing even those Great Emperors when they were young.
Of course, while many people acknowledged your title and status as the number one genius, they did not, to a great extent, associate talent with future achievement as much as they used to.
While it was known before that talent did not necessarily mean the ability to prove themselves in the future, this time the event of the extinction of almost all geniuses was a bit too shocking, profoundly affecting the concept that the winner is the one who stands to the last.
As a result, some cultivators paid slightly less attention to geniuses, contemplating not putting all their eggs in one basket, and perhaps investing all their resources in nurturing a genius with too much uncertainty, it would be better to use these resources to cultivate two or three second-tier geniuses.
It was during the tumultuous External World events and the Great Emperor Council that you chose to close yourself off, consolidating the Spatial Dao Pattern you had realized in the Secret Realm and attempting to combine the two Dao Patterns into one, forming a true space-time Dao Pattern.
Yet as you were doing this, the red pattern on the back of your hand suddenly lit up, causing a change in your face.
Then, you felt a sharp pain in your Sea of Consciousness, as if a force was eroding it.
As soon as you were in trouble, the wills of the Great Emperors descended, and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation was among them. They all stared at you, not hesitating to take action.
These people must have guessed that you were hiding something and had been secretly watching you during the meeting. Now that you had a problem, they had found some clues as well.
However, to the surprise of the Great Emperors, even they were unable to erase the force that was eroding your Sea of Consciousness.
Immediately, one of the Great Emperors wanted to use brute force to suppress this force and soul-search you to find more information. However, the incarnation of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor roared angrily, trying to stop them.
Unfortunately, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation, no matter how strong, could not stop so many Great Emperors, let alone a Great Emperor who was not elderly.
However, just as the two sides were arguing, a burst of Rainbow Light suddenly erupted, completely eroding your Sea of Consciousness.
Due to your special state, the simulation ended at this point…
…..
The Text Simulation came to a halt here.
Many images and insights from cultivation appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Then, his figure appeared in the Longevity Ku Family.
“It really did cause trouble, that red pattern formed by Ku Xuan’s attack and drilled into my body isn’t a good thing after all.”
“But what is this guy thinking, why is he so impatient to detonate the red pattern and silence me? You know, if this guy isn’t stupid, he should know that I’m probably being watched by the Great Emperors right now.”
Wang Ping looked at the scene and muttered to himself.
Wang Ping thought silently, not getting an answer for the time being, shook his head helplessly, and exited the Immersive Simulation state.
As his vision switched back to the real world, the System’s voice sounded as well.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
“①. Seven-Colored Talent Broken Origin Heavenly Eye.
②. Heavenly Ice.”
③. A Random Supreme Artifact.
④. Life-bound Supreme Device.”
…
“System, I choose ①. Seven-Colored Talent Broken Origin Heavenly Eye and ④. Life-bound Supreme Device.”
After looking at the reward list, Wang Ping made a choice without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 237 The mastermind appears! The reason for Emperor Tianyu’s disappearance!?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 864: Chapter 237 The mastermind appears! The reason for Emperor Tianyu’s disappearance!?_3
As Wang Ping made his choice, his eyes changed, mysterious rings of light appearing within his pupils, but they quickly disappeared again.
At the same time, his life-bound Supreme Artifact also appeared in his storage world.
“I have two life-bound weapons again. If I can double them and then merge, that would be great. However, the abilities to double and merge haven’t been optimized further, so triggering the ability is risky. I’d better wait.”
Wang Ping took out the weapon and looked at it for a moment before putting it away.
Next, Wang Ping closed his eyes in contemplation, continuing to think about the many issues in this simulation.
“If that red pattern allows the mastermind to read my memory, then he should understand my danger and quickly eliminate me. The possibility of not allowing Wang Ping in this simulation to continue gathering intelligence is very high.”
...
“It’s also possible that he can shield calculations, but if I’m brought in front of people like Heavenly Calculation’s Child and Divine Calculation Man, he might be exposed. After all, there were no preconditions for calculations before. If there are conditions now, he might be caught, and the possibility of killing to silence me is also there.”
“But why would he wait until now to detonate the red pattern? A normal person would detonate it as soon as it enters the body, right? Or, does this red pattern have a range limitation, and only when the distance between him and me is shortened to a certain level can he detonate it?”
“If so, he might be in the Longevity Ku family or have secretly come to the vicinity of the Ku family during this time. I’ve encountered similar methods when dealing with the weird.”
Wang Ping considered all kinds of possibilities.
Suddenly, he frowned again.
Since the mastermind was able to arrange such a peculiar secret realm, let Ku Xuan enter, and even replace the Immortal Mansion’s secret realm, then the correct method for him would be to sneak in and erase me.
However, he didn’t do that.
For this reason, these two possibilities are wrong and have too many flaws.
The greater possibility is that due to my Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, the red pattern created some bug, which caused the time to be delayed or the detonation range to be shortened. Of course, the possibility of both situations happening also exists.
“Phew, I’ve gained quite a bit of information this time and am one step closer to the truth. Next, I’ll do a normal simulation, and there’s no need to defeat Ku Xuan in advance, triggering such a dramatic plot. I just need to cultivate slowly and explore, and I can gradually find his tail.”
A few minutes later, Wang Ping exhaled and threw the distractions out of his mind, murmuring to himself.
“I’ve seen your memory, the red pattern on the back of your hand indeed has a weird power fluctuation.”
At this time, Alpha’s voice, which had been silent for a long time, suddenly sounded.
“Is it really weird?”
Wang Ping was slightly surprised by Alpha’s words, and then narrowed his eyes.
“If it is indeed weird, then just as I guessed earlier, everything seems reasonable. By the way, Alpha, does this weirdness meet the criteria?”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping asked again.
“Judging by the manifestation of the weirdness and the red pattern, if it’s the weirdness from the Golden Age, it naturally meets the criteria. However, at this point in time, the probability of it meeting the criteria is only 40% to 50%.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“That’s about what I expected. If it doesn’t meet the criteria at this time, then I might as well cultivate it a bit.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking to himself.
As for whether cultivating the weird would backfire, Wang Ping felt the probability was almost zero.
He had enough combat experience with the weird. As long as he grasps all the abilities and strength limits of the weird, there would be nothing to fear.
Of course, the premise was that the information was fully controlled, and his own strength was far stronger than the weird.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would not act rashly.
In short, killing the weird in advance wouldn’t get him to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, so it was meaningless.
“Let’s continue the simulation. This time, I hope to survive and make a significant improvement in my strength.”
Immediately, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and prepared for a new simulation, murmuring in his heart.
“System, I want to conduct a new Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming four million top-tier divine sources, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Red Talent·Light Profound Physique; Red Talent·Dark Mystery physique.”
“I really can’t get over these Profound Bodies, huh? How much do you want me to choose a Profound Body?”
Wang Ping wasn’t surprised by this nonce, as refreshing continuously to get a Seven-Color Talent would be a strange thing.
However, the frequency of appearance of these Profound Bodies was absurd; this time, there were two at once.
“Choose, choose, choose. What if I choose all the Profound Bodies, can I undergo a super evolution and upgrade to a Seven-colored Physique Talent?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but tease as he casually chose the Light Profound Body.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, entering the immersive simulation state.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 237: The Mastermind Appears! The Reason for Emperor Tianyu’s Disappearance!?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 865: Chapter 237: The Mastermind Appears! The Reason for Emperor Tianyu’s Disappearance!?_4
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text began to emerge.
[On the first day, you chose the same action as last time in the simulation and went to the Tao Palace. Ultimately, you obtained the Emperor Artifact · Void Eternal Emperor Sword just like in the previous simulation.]
[However, this time, you didn’t choose to go to Purgatory Ancient Star but directly went to another place. This place, surprisingly, was the Canglan Ancient Star.]
[Previously, when you were in the simulation, you were hunted down by all sorts of people in Canglan Ancient Star, forcing you to flee. Of course, you didn’t come here to snatch gold coins from the Canglan Dynasty, but to think of something else.]
[This matter, is the fact that a cultivator on Canglan Ancient Star once said that if one could obtain the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, they could have a great opportunity.]
[Before, because of various reasons, you had forgotten this matter and never looked up what this opportunity was. Now, you intend to figure out what this great opportunity that requires the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is, and perhaps have your disciple Lin Qinghe get a good inheritance to grow rapidly.]
...
[Of course, if this opportunity is also of use to you, you would naturally not mind claiming it for yourself and using it first.]
[Your arrival in the Canglan Dynasty was not noticed by any cultivator. After all, the strongest on the Canglan Ancient Star are no more than three Supremes. Among them, the Supreme of Canglan Dynasty is the strongest. This is not because this Supreme is the most powerful, but because the Canglan Dynasty has an Emperor’s artifact and Quasi-Emperor Artifact.]
[Before, you were quite apprehensive about the Canglan Dynasty, but now you can completely ignore it. After all, you yourself can already fight against Supremes, and some ordinary Supremes are easily defeated by you. Now, you also have Emperor’s Artifact, so the Canglan Dynasty really doesn’t amount to much in front of you.]
[Next, you begin to think about how to draw out the cultivator who knows about the great opportunity. After all, in the original simulation, it was just mentioned in the Text Simulation, and it wasn’t specified who knew the secret.]
[In the end, you think that searching one by one is too troublesome. So you decide to go straight for the kill.]
[To do this, you show off your aura very high-profiled, and also display Divine Skills with the Emperor Scripture of Taiyi Imperial Palace, causing a ripple throughout the entire Canglan Ancient Star.]
[In an instant, all self-titled cultivators are awakened, looking at you in fear, recognizing the Emperor Scripture of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and guessing you should be a strong person from the Taiyi Imperial Palace. However, they don’t understand what a big shot like you is doing here.]
[The self-titled Supreme of Canglan Dynasty is also awakened, and he notices you, even sensing the atmosphere of the Emperor’s artifact that you deliberately display. This makes him very afraid, and he quickly communicates with you, asking if there is any cultivator in Canglan Ancient Star who has angered you, if there is anyone, the Canglan Dynasty is willing to help find and uproot them.]
[At this, you give a faint smile, holding the Emperor’s artifact without paying attention to the Supreme of Canglan Dynasty, just calmly announcing to the Ancient Star that you are looking for someone who knows the secret related to the Devouring Immortal Demon Body. If they come forward voluntarily and reveal the secret, you will withdraw your power, and no one will be harmed. However, if they do not come forward, they will be reduced to ashes along with the Ancient Star.]
[This ruthless action caused all cultivators to be very frightened, praying for the cultivator who knew the secret to quickly come forward. Even the Supreme of Canglan Dynasty is quite troubled, not expecting you to disregard him and say such insane words.]
[Although he can protect the Canglan Dynasty with the Emperor’s artifact, they will also have trouble if the Ancient Star is destroyed. Moreover, he would also be forced to break his self-imposed seal, making it difficult to endure the Last Dharma Age.]
[Under the scrutiny of the crowd, that cultivator also cursed in his heart, thinking that you were crazy. However, he didn’t want to be buried with the Ancient Star, so he had no choice but to quickly communicate with you and tell you the secret, hoping that you would spare him.]
[Thus, you came to know the secret he knew. It turned out that he had found the inheritance land of a certain generation of Devouring Immortal Demon Body. However, the inheritance land was very special, and it required the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to open it, so he would search for an unbloomed Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[Unfortunately, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body was not easy to find. He searched for many years but ultimately found nothing. So, he had to seal himself in his hometown, hoping to have a chance to find the Devouring Immortal Demon Body and obtain its blood once the Golden Age arrives, opening the inheritance land and obtaining the inheritance therein.]
[Hearing that cultivator’s words, you are quite surprised. You never thought it would be the inheritance land of a certain generation of Devouring Immortal Demon Body. So, it’s understandable that this cultivator regrets not taking action against Lin Qinghe before.]
[However, you still think that this cultivator is too greedy. Since it’s the Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s inheritance, it definitely won’t be that simple. If only relying on the blood of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, the chances of merely entering are likely. After entering, there must be tests, and if one is not a true Devouring Immortal Demon Body, the probability of dying horribly is high.]
[Of course, you think again about how this guy has cultivated for so many years, but only has a Half-Step Great Saint cultivation, and also has a short Lifespan, in a self-titled state, so it’s normal to try desperately. If he wins the gamble, he could possibly become a Great Saint, or even a Tao Proving Supreme. If he loses the gamble, it’s just an early demise.]

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 237 The Puppeteer Appears! The Reason for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Disappearance!?_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Chapter 237 The Puppeteer Appears! The Reason for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Disappearance!?_5
“Following which, you grin, pull back the Emperor’s artifact, and declare that you were just pulling their legs and hope they don’t mind. After saying these words, you left the Canglan Ancient Star with Fang Xingyu.”
“Reacting to this, the cultivators on the Canglan Ancient Star all had twitching faces as they cursed under their breath, complaining how was that meant to be a joke with your demeanor back then?”
“As the cultivators on the Canglan Ancient Star grumbled, Fang Xingyu also started to roll his eyes exasperatingly with non-stop complaints in his heart.”
“Afterwards, you show no signs of heading elsewhere, proceeding straight to the Immortal Continent and returning to Taiyi Imperial Palace with Fang Xingyu.”
“Upon reaching the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you did not immediately take Lin Qinghe to find the inheritance in the land of inheritance, but rather chose to self-title.”
“In the blink of an eye, the Golden Age arrives, you decide to step into the public eye, and you become the apprentice of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, asking him if there are any places he plans to go next. This puzzles the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, leaving him intrigued as to why you’re asking about his plans. If there’s anything you need him to take care of, he offers to handle it before getting on with his own matters.”
...
“In response, you shake your head, explaining you’re merely curious. Seeing your persistence, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor hesitates. Although he feels that this isn’t something you should be privy to, he decides to give a response.”
“It turns out, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s cultivation has hit a bottleneck, and within the Guimo Sea, one of the Ten Forbidden Lands, lies what he needs. Furthermore, his daughter has gone missing. He has been searching for her all these years and after years of investigation, discovered she had entered the Guimo Sea for an unknown reason.”
“Hearing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s response, you understood why he disappeared. He had ventured into the Guimo Sea.”
“Although the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor mentioned that his cultivation has hit a bottleneck and he needed to go to the Guimo Sea to find what he needs, all while looking for his missing daughter, you feel that he had only gone there to specifically find his daughter.”
