“In your opinion, the likelihood that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s daughter, who’s been deeply immersed in the Guimo Sea all these years, has fallen is really high. Nevertheless, as a father, he would never give up searching unless her death is confirmed.”
“Looking back at the simulations, the reason he decided to help you find the Time-Space Dual Emperor Classic before searching for her was most probably because he didn’t want to delay your cultivation and wanted to leave some hope for Taiyi Imperial Palace.”
“Perhaps, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor also predicted the risks he might run into. After all, even Emperor-level entities face the risk of falling when venturing into one of the Ten Forbidden Lands.”
“The actions of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can unquestionably be considered slightly irresponsibly towards Taiyi Imperial Palace. A better course of action would be to raise a new emperor before going. But as a father, one can understand him having certain personal sentiments.”
“Not to mention, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was obviously in a rush to find his daughter, but decided to delay his plans for your sake. He treated you incredibly well, and thus you didn’t think he did anything wrong whatsoever.”
…..
“So this is why the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor disappeared. He went to find his daughter. Even though it’s the Guimo Sea, one of the Ten Forbidden Lands, he still bravely ventured into it.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, and couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
Both as a father and a mentor, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is undoubtedly exceptional.
“But if something happens there, we won’t know whether he’s dead or alive. Therefore, we can’t let the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor go.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and continued gazing at the luminescent screen.
“After knowing the cause and effect, your face turned serious. You solemnly informed the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor that you had some future prediction abilities. If he went, his safety would be unclear and he wouldn’t return even on the day the Immortal Mansion opens. There would also be a complete loss of contact with him.”
“Hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was silent. Now he knew why you asked him about his plans and fell into contemplation.”
“In the end, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shook his head saying he had to go. Yu Daoyi is his most beloved daughter, the one who held his high hopes. He had to go.”
“Hearing the words of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you bitterly smile, acknowledging that you can’t persuade him. Although you respect Heavenly Feather Great Emperor a great deal and have a deep bond with him, as for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you are merely his newly adopted disciple. Your opinion cannot sway his will.”
“Seeing your bitter smile, The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shakes his head and reassures you that he will leave enough resources for the Taiyi Imperial Palace and you so even if he encounters danger, you wouldn’t suffer any losses during competition with other geniuses.”
“In the end, you could only nod and failed to persuade the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Therefore, you decided to put this matter aside and continue your cultivation in seclusion.”
“This time, you plan to keep a low profile until the opening of the immortal mansion, hoping to change something.”

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 238: The Secret of the Nine-Star Pavilion! Farewell, White Rainbow
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Chapter 238: The Secret of the Nine-Star Pavilion! Farewell, White Rainbow
[Since you decided to take the low-profile route, you chose to stay secluded, not even challenging Yu Daohong. To outsiders, you seemed like the most ordinary Emperor’s son in Taiyi Imperial Palace. Only the old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace knew how talented you were, capable of sweeping all monsters of your generation and representing their hope of achieving Flying Immortal.]
[In the blink of an eye, about a hundred years passed. After settling your cultivation, you chose to come out and took Lin Qinghe to the land of inheritance of a certain previous generation of Swallowing Immortal Demon Body.]
[When you arrived here with Lin Qinghe, you saw numerous tombstones. This scenario reminded you of that ghostly place in the Life and Death Realm. However, you knew that although this place was somewhat similar to the realm of the dead, it wasn’t the realm of the dead, just a somewhat gloomy and dangerous place.]
[Although this place could be considered a deathtrap for cultivators below the Saint Realm, it wasn’t too dangerous for those above the Saint Realm. Many powerful beings above the Saint Realm would often venture here in search of opportunities, slaughtering Corpse Stiffs and acquiring cultivation resources.]
[With no hesitation, you and Lin Qinghe entered, and because you were powerful enough with the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, nothing could halt your progress. Eventually, you came to the depths of the place and found a tombstone.]
[As Lin Qinghe dripped her blood onto the tombstone, it began to glow, and space warped, drawing you both into it. During this process, you tried to resist, but to no avail.]
...
[Soon, your vision changed, and you found yourself in a pitch-black palace. In the palace, a man sat on the throne with no signs of life, looking as if he had completely perished.]
[However, you didn’t let your guard down and cautiously took out the Emperor’s artifact, mentally preparing for a fight at any moment. You were well aware that the man before you was most likely the owner of this place and a former owner of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. Such beings, even in death, could leave behind remnants of their souls, which could potentially reanimate their corpse.]
[After all, this kind of action was not just limited to a previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. Even a King Realm Master in the lower realm could easily accomplish this.]
[Sure enough, as you remained on guard, the man opened his eyes. His scarlet-red pupils looked at Lin Qinghe and then at you, quite surprised. He commented on how excellent this generation’s Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was, and how she even brought him an outstandingly talented little snack when coming to receive the inheritance, demonstrating utmost sincerity.]
[At these words, Lin Qinghe’s complexion changed, and she instinctively stepped in front of you.]
[As for you, your pupils constricted slightly as you began to unleash the Emperor’s artifact’s power. This Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was indeed up to no good, planning to swallow you up directly. However, you quickly regained your composure. The Swallowing Immortal Demon Body before you was, after all, only a remnant soul or the like. It may have retained a lot of power, but after being worn down by time, being able to exert Quasi-Emperor tier power would already be quite impressive.]
[On your person, you not only had the Emperor’s artifact but also Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation. The combination of these two made it so only an Emperor personally taking action or some terrifying tool or ability from the All Heavens could potentially kill you. Otherwise, even the aged Ordinary Emperors couldn’t hope to kill you.]
[Thus, you had no reason to fear this Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. Realizing this, you coldly sneered, saying that he wasn’t afraid of breaking his teeth by considering you a snack.]
[Your words prompted the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body to chuckle, saying that you indeed had the boldness and arrogance of his past self. However, you indeed had the capital to be so arrogant.]
[Next, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body laughed again, saying that he was merely joking with you both and not to be too nervous. He had already perished, and there was no point in swallowing you.]
[You didn’t respond to this, only calmly stating that the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body didn’t have the power to swallow you anyway. And besides, if the remnant soul of the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body dared to do anything to your disciple Lin Qinghe, you would never let him off the hook.]
[At these words, the male Swallowing Immortal Demon Body looked rather taken aback, surprised to find that you two weren’t Tao Companions but had a master-disciple relationship instead. However, regardless of whether someone became a Tao Companion with the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body or dared to accept one as their disciple, none had ever had a good ending throughout history.]
[At these words, Lin Qinghe was taken aback, not understanding the meaning behind the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body’s words. The remnant soul of the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body within Lin Qinghe was also feeling quite emotional.]
[You also frowned, asking the male Swallowing Immortal Demon Body the meaning behind his words.]
[The male Swallowing Immortal Demon Body chuckled, saying that there was no doubt that the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body was the constitution with the most potential, surpassing even your Time-Space Body. Perhaps in the beginning, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body couldn’t measure up to even a Sacred Body. But as time went on and the number of fundamental sources and various constitutional sources it devoured increased, it would gradually undergo a qualitative change, possibly even forming a Chaos Body by swallowing myriad fundamental sources.]
[Furthermore, even a Chaos Body wouldn’t be the end. In his opinion, the Swallowing Immortal Demon Body could live up to its name by swallowing even immortals should such beings exist. In the future, devouring everything and forming a Chaos Immortal Body wasn’t impossible.]

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 238: The Secret of the Nine Stars Pavilion! Goodbye Bai Tianhong_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Chapter 238: The Secret of the Nine Stars Pavilion! Goodbye Bai Tianhong_2
“[This might come as a big surprise to you, and you slightly frown, wondering if the male Devouring Immortal Demon Body is exaggerating the potential of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body. If it really has such enormous potential, it would surpass the Seven-Color Talent level, which I reckon the Life Simulator can’t even refresh now.]”
“[After pondering, you start to question where does the Devouring Immortal Demon Body come from. Was it really born from this universe? And why does it seem like anyone entangled with the Devouring Immortal Demon Body end up with misfortune?]”
“[In response to your query, the male Devouring Immortal Demon Body chuckles, explaining that this constitution does not originate from the Upper Realm but from the All Heavens and the Source of Darkness. A powerful being from the All Heavens once infiltrated the Source of Darkness, using a certain tool to extract part of the power of the Source of Darkness, and successfully created the special physique of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body by combining the way of devouring with the tool.]”
“[Although it may not be the case that each Devouring Immortal Demon Body is evil, those tainted with darkness are deemed unacceptable by the Heavenly Tao and naturally cursed. Therefore, no Devouring Immortal Demon Body meets a good end, and anyone who has close relations with them is also affected.]”
“[Upon hearing the explanation from the male Devouring Immortal Demon Body, you fall into silence, surprised at the unexpected origins of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]”
…..
...
“Is the loophole of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body really that big?”
Wang Ping, seeing this, also turned serious and was somewhat helpless.
After coming to the Upper Realm, although he had elevated his talent to an astonishing level, he was still constantly unlucky in the simulation. Could it also be due to this reason, because the Heavenly Tao disapproves, thus his luck could not improve.
“I have a feeling I might be overthinking this. It seems like I wasn’t unlucky before I took Lin Qinghe as my disciple.”
Wang Ping was silent for a moment, shook his head, not wanting to lay the blame on his obedient disciple, Lin Qinghe.
“If the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is so strong, then I’m at a great loss.”
Wang Ping frowned again, murmuring to himself.
He had earlier just used the Devouring Immortal Demon Body just to break through the bottleneck of the Saint King level. It was such a waste.
After all, if he took the Devouring Immortal Demon Body as his disciple later, when he reached the Supreme tier or even the Quasi-Emperor tier, perhaps he could have advanced many more minor realms.
“Never mind, thinking so much is useless. I need to focus on the present.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, threw the strange thought out of his mind, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
He’s now very curious about which of the Myriad Heavens Forces has such capability to go into the Source of Darkness to extract part of the power and create the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, and pass it down.
Theoretically, this constitution that the Heavenly Tao abhors should not continue to exist.
Unexpectedly, it should be that someone from those forces had secretly used a certain method to keep the Devouring Immortal Demon Body in the world, and over a period of time, a ‘fortunate person’ would be selected to gain this physique.
“[Next, you start to contemplate and ask the male Devouring Immortal Demon Body if he knows which of the Myriad Heavens Forces created the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]”
“[In response to your query, the male Devouring Immortal Demon Body wasn’t surprised, but answered with a profound gaze. The three words he said were ‘Nine Stars Pavilion’.]”
“[Upon hearing ‘Nine Stars Pavilion’, you are astounded and greatly surprised, never expecting that Nine Stars Pavilion was behind all this. However, it seems reasonable if the creator of Nine Stars Pavilion was the one who created the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]”
“[Based on the information you’ve obtained so far, among the Myriad Heavens Forces appearing in the Upper Realm, only Nine Stars Pavilion is the most powerful and can be said to crush other forces. Even the Abyss Lands and Slaughter Paradise that you’re familiar with only have a Great Emperor tier force. Although you’re not sure if these two forces still have anything concealed, even if they do, they can’t possibly surpass the monumental Nine Stars Pavilion.]”
“[As for the other Myriad Heavens Forces, Wang Ping is very unfamiliar, but their situations are probably the same. Therefore, it’s reasonable for the powerful creator of Nine Stars Pavilion to be capable of doing such a thing.]”
“[However, you still can’t understand what exactly is the purpose of the creator of Nine Stars Pavilion. Why would he go through the trouble of entering the dangerous Source of Darkness to obtain part of the dark power and create the Devouring Immortal Demon Body?]”
“[Bear in mind, since he is from All Heavens and is the strongest among the beings from All Heavens in the Upper Realm, he should clearly understand what exactly the Source of Darkness is. It’s the real Bizarre Boss, which even Alpha declared that the forces from All Heavens it came into contact with couldn’t eliminate it, a terrifying entity.]”
“[Although the Bizarre Origin of the Upper Realm is just a tendril extended, equivalent to a strand of hair or something, with someone surely restraining its main body, it’s not something anyone can mess with.]”
“[Not to mention the Great Emperor tier entities, even if an immortal ventured inside, they would probably risk dying or being tainted. If they caught its attention, they might die without even knowing how they died.]”
“[However, the creator of Nine Stars Pavilion dared to venture in and even came out alive, taking such a great risk, they must have paid a staggering price. Paying such a big price just to create the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, their purpose is worth pondering over, they must have a shocking plan.]”

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 238: The Secret of the Nine Stars Pavilion! Goodbye Bai Tianhong_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Chapter 238: The Secret of the Nine Stars Pavilion! Goodbye Bai Tianhong_3
[Countless thoughts flash through your mind, and you sigh inwardly. The Upper Realm is truly too dangerous. As your cultivation improves, your strength increases, and you come into contact with more powerful beings and secrets, you increasingly feel the danger. Various terrifying existences scheme against each other, and it is almost impossible to guard against them.]
[You find it difficult to calm down. If even the Upper Realm is like this, what scenes could unfold in the Immortal World or Myriad Heavens Paradise? The higher you climb in the All Heavens, the more dangerous it becomes. Unless someone can truly transcend and ascend above the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao to look down upon the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms…. Only when one reaches that level can they perhaps experience true freedom and leisure.]
[Next, you compose yourself and ask the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body if he knows so much about the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion’s purpose.]
[In response to your inquiry, the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body shakes his head and laughs, saying that if he had such great abilities, he wouldn’t have ended up as a pawn and eventually died.]
[Hearing this, you have nothing to say. Indeed, if the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body had such great capabilities, he wouldn’t have withered away in disgrace here, waiting silently for the next Swallowing Immortal Demon Body to arrive and provide some information and inheritance.]
[Immediately afterward, you curiously ask the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body about the level he had reached in his lifetime. He answers that he had already attained the status of Emperor in his lifetime and was once glorious. Unfortunately, he was too arrogant and discovered something he should not have known, which led to his death. ]
...
[Hearing this, you, Lin Qinghe, and the remnant soul of the previous Swallowing Immortal Demon Body all wear solemn expressions, understanding what he means. Because he knew those secrets and chose to investigate, he died and was killed by the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion. It’s possible that he wasn’t even killed by the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion, but by some other existence within the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[Next, the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body looks at Lin Qinghe and says that she is fortunate to obtain the most complete inheritance of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body here. However, she is also unfortunate, as she might forever be reduced to the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion’s pawn, not knowing when she will die.]
[These words leave Lin Qinghe with a heavy heart and mixed feelings. Nevertheless, she ultimately resolves herself, stating that no one would willingly become a pawn for their entire life. She will become strong enough to overturn the chessboard.]
[You look at Lin Qinghe and nod in satisfaction, thinking that she is indeed worthy of being your disciple. Although she is a woman, her spirit is second to none.]
[The Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body looks at Lin Qinghe and chuckles, saying that he had thought the same way, but in the end, it was all for naught. After saying this, he adds that it’s a good thing to have courage, so he wishes Lin Qinghe success in getting rid of her status as a pawn.]
[After saying this, the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body doesn’t continue to prattle, and directly condenses a ball of light, which enters Lin Qinghe’s body. Then, Lin Qinghe receives the complete inheritance of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, as well as the Emperor’s Artifact of the Male Devouring Fairy Demon Body.]
[However, there are no Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures. You are somewhat disappointed by this, but you understand. After all, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body doesn’t actually need any cultivation resources. For them, their cultivation resources are other cultivators and the core sources of those prodigies.]
[Afterward, once Lin Qinghe has thoroughly assimilated the inheritance, the two of you leave this place together.]
……..
“The Nine Stars Pavilion, a very mysterious force that created the Devouring Immortal Demon Body. I wonder what their purpose is.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation, frowning slightly.
He has an intuition that the danger level of this Nine Stars Pavilion may not be lower than that of the mysterious schemer targeting the great emperors and prodigies behind the scenes.
“Since I have already formed a mentor-disciple relationship with Lin Qinghe in the real world, it seems that I am destined to stand in opposition to the Nine Stars Pavilion, with both sides being unlikely to avoid confrontation.”
Wang Ping considers this with some headache.
He now suspects that he may have been noticed by the Nine Stars Pavilion due to Lin Qinghe.
If that is the case, it would indeed be troublesome.
Although they haven’t taken any action in these numerous simulations, it doesn’t mean that they aren’t scheming something.
Being targeted by such dangerous existences, even joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace wouldn’t be able to guarantee his safety.
“However, there’s no need to worry too much. Since they have calculations, they won’t act hastily and will definitely wait for the right opportunity. According to the simulations, they haven’t taken any action or targeted me even a hundred thousand years later. Even the Dark Star Sage encountered by chance didn’t target me too much and even spoke on my behalf. Although this doesn’t mean anything, it’s still good on the surface, and that’s enough.”
Soon, Wang Ping calms down and becomes very composed.
He grows at a rapid pace, and as long as the other party doesn’t detect any abnormalities about him, he doesn’t need to worry too much.
It’s possible that the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion is indeed calculating something through the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, but he might not have noticed Lin Qinghe, who hasn’t yet grown into a big fish. The possibility of him being noticed through Lin Qinghe may not be high.
Even if the situation is really bad, he can escape through Alpha in the real world, teleport to other worlds or enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise to avoid danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 238: The Secret of the Nine-Star Pavilion! Farewell, White Rainbow_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: Chapter 238: The Secret of the Nine-Star Pavilion! Farewell, White Rainbow_4
Then, with his growth rate, it wouldn’t be long before he could come back and confront them head-on.
Although it’s true that even an Emperor realm might not be enough to take them all out in one go, Wang Ping was still very confident in his own growth potential.
If an Emperor isn’t enough, then become an Immortal!
Wang Ping didn’t believe that he couldn’t kill these old monsters.
Soon, Wang Ping calmed his emotions and continued to focus on the luminescent screen.
[On your way back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, Lin Qinghe hesitated and decided to resign from your service. She felt that staying by your side might bring trouble to you. At the same time, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body indeed needed to devour other powerful cultivators and heaven’s chosen to grow perfectly. Under such circumstances, it was even more inappropriate for her to stay by your side and remain in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
...
[After hearing Lin Qinghe’s words, you frowned and remained silent for a while. To break free from being a pawn’s fate, Lin Qinghe needed to become stronger at all costs, and you are not strong enough to protect her yet, and neither is the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In the end, you sighed and didn’t stop Lin Qinghe, allowing her to leave. You knew very well that Lin Qinghe was a very decisive person, once she made up her mind about something, she would move forward unswervingly, and no one could stop her.]
[Afterwards, Lin Qinghe expressed her gratitude and chose to leave. You looked at the direction in which Lin Qinghe left, and shook your head, unsure of how strong she would be when you meet again. Maybe, Lin Qinghe, who truly embarked on the Devouring Immortal Demon Body path, would surpass your level in a hundred years or so.]
[This is not an impossible thing. People like Lin Qinghe and Lin Yuanyuan, once they let go completely, their growth speed is truly incomparable to that of regular cultivation. Lin Qinghe in the past, without a complete Devouring Immortal Demon Body inheritance, still had to worry about Enlightenment. Now, Lin Qinghe has obtained the complete Devouring Immortal Demon Body inheritance, has even saved the trouble of Enlightenment, and can truly unleash the terror of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[After returning to Taiyi Imperial Palace, you continued your low-profile cultivation, completely ignoring what happened in the outer world. However, you still reported Lin Qinghe’s situation to the Palace Master of Taiyi Emperor Palace and other higher-ups. As a result, Lin Qinghe was expelled from Taiyi Imperial Palace by the higher-ups. This was the intention of both you and Lin Qinghe.]
[In the blink of an eye, it was time for the Immortal Mansion to open. Numerous cultivators gathered in the Immortal City as the Immortal Mansion opened, and you saw that scene again.]
[It was the scene of a little (female) Taoist carrying a weak little Taoist into the Immortal City. This time, you smiled slightly, stepped in front of Ku Xuan, and protected them by confronting the Supreme head-on.]
[This scene surprised many people who did not expect you, an ordinary Emperor’s son from the usually low-profile Taiyi Imperial Palace, to have the courage to confront the Supreme head-on. However, they soon realized that it was no big deal.]
[After all, you did not confront the Supreme by your own ability but relied on your identity and your Dao Protector to make them not dare to act recklessly. There was no need to argue with you. They could do the same easily, as every heaven’s chosen had powerful backing. It’s just that protecting two loose cultivators like them was not something they were interested in doing.]
[As for Ku Xuan, upon seeing you step in front of him, he frowned and looked deeply at you, wondering what you were thinking.]
[You naturally noticed Ku Xuan’s gaze, so you smiled warmly and nodded to him as a greeting. You knew that saving the two ahead of Ku Xuan might draw his attention and make him and the mysterious people behind him think that the development of events was a bit off and possibly attract their attention, but you still did it.]
[Because at this point, whether you attract their attention or not is no longer important. After all, once the Immortal Mansion opens, their plan will be implemented, and you cannot stop it. If you reveal their plan, nobody would believe you, and you would just become prey like other heavenly chosen.]
[Unless, of course, you choose to hide and not enter the Immortal Mansion, you could avoid being transported to that secret realm.]
[To be honest, you indeed planned to do so. Entering the secret realm would be too risky, and even now, you might not be able to guarantee your own survival. Instead of going in, it would be better to sit back and watch the situation unfold while trying to break through to the Supreme tier.]
[The purpose of your arrival at Immortal City was for the little (female) Taoist and the little Taoist she carried on her back. Since they were valued by Ku Xuan and perhaps even the mysterious people behind him, it meant that they must have something special.]
[To this end, intercepting them was necessary. Perhaps, it could open up new storylines and find clues about the mysterious people.]
[With many thoughts flashing through your mind, you brought the little (female) Taoist and little Taoist into the Immortal City amidst their gratitude. As for Ku Xuan, he narrowed his eyes slightly, with many thoughts running through his mind.]
[After all, this was a plot that should have been done by others originally, and he also wanted to step in before them, but he didn’t expect you to snatch it from him. Besides, you noticed his gaze, which also surprised him and made him feel that you were not as ordinary as the rumors suggested.]
[However, the plan was about to unfold, and even though he missed the little (female) Taoist and the little Taoist, Ku Xuan didn’t care much, focusing on the main task at hand. As for the little (female) Taoist and the little Taoist, he could get them back from you once the plan was successfully completed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 238: The Secret of Jiuxing Pavilion! Seeing Bai Tianhong Again_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Chapter 238: The Secret of Jiuxing Pavilion! Seeing Bai Tianhong Again_5
…..
“It seems that Ku Xuan will save those two out of his foreknowledge of some future events. I just wonder who would have saved them if Ku Xuan and I hadn’t taken action. What kind of secrets do they hold that Ku Xuan values them so heavily?”
Wang Ping was watching the content of the Text Simulation, thinking to himself in silence.
“This time, I’m not planning to enter the secret realm, so it’s probably a day trip to the Immortal Mansion. Judging from the simulation of my action plan this time, during the second round of the exam, the Secret Realm trial, I definitely intend to pull something tricky by purposely not entering it. But doing so, I feel like the simulated Wang Ping might not be able to enter the Immortal Mansion.”
Wang Ping thought of the Immortal Mansion and shook his head subtly.
Well, if I’m not going in, then so be it. Although it’s a bit sorry for Taiyi Imperial Palace, it’s better than being killed inside.
...
The final goal of this time is to reach the Supreme tier.
Of course, it would be better if I could reach a higher realm.
But, judging from the luck of the simulated Wang Ping, it’s probably pretty tough.
While Wang Ping was complaining internally about himself, the simulation continued.
[Next, you still met Ji Bingyan and Ji Ziqing. You treated Ji Ziqing as indifferently as before. While Ji Ziqing was extremely cold towards you and wanted to seize the opportunity to eliminate you, an ordinary Emperor’s son.]
[After contacting Ji Bingyan, you unexpectedly bumped into familiar people like Ye Chen, and started to communicate with them one by one. Ye Chen complained to you about how miserable his life was. You found it amusing, and you didn’t sympathize with him. After all, his cockroach-like vitality and great luck were envied by most cultivators.]
[However, what surprised you was that while you were chatting with others, you bumped into two familiar faces in the Immortal City.]
[These two were Mo Shang Li and Bai Tianhong. Mo Shang Li’s cultivation level had miraculously reached the Saint King tier, and Bai Tianhong’s cultivation had also astonishingly reached the Saint King tier.]
[You were quite shocked to find that they had come together and both reached the realm of the Saint King. In your previous simulations, Bai Tianhong never appeared. As for Mo Shang Li, he only appeared once or twice, and his cultivation was merely at the True Lord tier.]
[Next, you used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see through their secrets. This caused you to frown and your expression to become serious.]
[You found that Mo Shang Li’s physique had miraculously changed to become a strong saint body. As for Bai Tianhong, his physique had also changed and become the Supreme Sword Body, a powerful body that was said to easily become a sword and step into the Supreme tier, not losing to the saint body, even superior to some saint bodies.]
[This made you feel strange. You didn’t think both of them lacked this opportunity. There might indeed be some opportunities or secret skills that can awaken or refine a special constitution in this world later on. After all, Heavenly Ice is one such opportunity that helps cultivators obtain powerful bodies. Besides that, Ye Chen’s Cultivation Skill is the same.]
[The reason why you find it strange is that you felt a familiar sensation from both of them. This feeling was similar to when you battled with the Secret Realm Natives, the Black Fog Silhouettes, and Ku Xuan, using the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see the same situation, all with similar auras. You didn’t know what this aura was before, but before the simulation, you confirmed it was connected to Ku Xuan and the bizarre.]
[That is to say, this aura might have been created by the bizarre and is related to the bizarre’s ability.]
[This made you have to suspect that the two might have encountered the bizarre in this simulation and been recruited. Therefore, they were able to obtain such powerful bodies and easily elevate their cultivation to the level of Saint King Great Perfection.]
[This rate of advancement reminded you of that Secret Realm. After all, cultivating in that Secret Realm could easily elevate the cultivation to this level.]
….
“After repeatedly encountering Bai Tianhong in the simulations, I didn’t expect this kid somehow made it to the Upper Realm, and even threw his lot in with the bizarre. I really don’t know how to comment.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and couldn’t help but feel somewhat speechless.
What is this?
He is the savior set to eliminate the bizarre.
His apprentice is the lackey of the bizarre, wishing to oppose him and kill him?
This is quite ludicrous.
“However, in a sense, this can also be considered a good thing. After all, it provides an opportunity to gather more information.”
Wang Ping steadied his mind, his eyes flickered, and he silently pondered.
Don’t mention getting information about the bizarre from Bai Tianhong. Even from the current Text Simulation, Wang Ping had already analyzed a lot of things.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: Chapter 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!
“If nothing unexpected happened, the trickster should have the ability to snatch away the origin of others and then give it to other people. It’s even possible that they can also snatch the power and insights of the other party and give it to others.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, making a judgment.
If this is the case, it would explain why Bai Tianhong and Mo Shang Li have become so powerful and possess such special constitutions.
The possibility of the two of them encountering such a great opportunity at the same time is extremely small. Coupled with the hidden eerie aura around them, Wang Ping believes that it is most likely due to the trickster’s deeds.
Apart from that, Wang Ping could also analyze that the powers of the Black Fog Silhouettes and the Indigenous People might be due to the trickster’s abilities.
After all, in that secret realm, it is difficult for the Indigenous People to comprehend the Tao Pattern on their own.
...
The Indigenous People and the Black Fog Silhouettes hunted the talented for the purpose of capturing them alive and taking their origins.
As for the Black Fog Silhouettes, they may not be genuine geniuses, but ordinary talents who have been given power by the trickster.
Even Ku Xuan may not have been such a monster before this, and it’s very likely that he only obtained the Immortal Bone and became the First Heaven’s Proud Genius of this age because of his cooperation with the trickster.
Of course, there is also the possibility that Ku Xuan was deceived by the trickster and was controlled by them.
However, no matter which possibility it is, Wang Ping is almost certain that the trickster has the abilities to snatch and give.
Besides, during the previous simulations, the indigenous person who burned his origin also said that if he caught Qin Yue, his master would grant him greater power, which proved this point again.
“The question is, what other abilities does the trickster possess, and who is the target of their body possession?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought secretly.
The tricksters’ most troublesome points are their high upper limits of abilities and their ability to quietly possess others.
Some grown tricksters can easily possess the strong, making them almost impossible to guard against.
Therefore, Wang Ping must find out who the trickster possessed. As long as he doesn’t catch their true identity, it’s difficult to kill them.
“However, this trickster is extremely cautious, and it’s challenging to capture him in a short time. I just don’t know if I can obtain any information from Bai Tianhong’s body… But probably not considering the trickster’s style, even more so likely that it’ll startle the snake.”
Wang Ping sighed, converged his mind, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After pondering, you did not directly look for Bai Tianhong; instead, you went to find Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian. You don’t intend to confront Bai Tianhong personally; you want to use Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian to talk to Bai Tianhong and gather information.]
[Regarding your request, Ye Xiaofan and Qin Tian naturally wouldn’t refuse, especially since it’s related to the trickster. As a result, the two of them went to Bai Tianhong and Mo Shang Li together. Qin Tian distracted Mo Shang Li as Ye Xiaofan began talking about old times with Bai Tianhong.]
[Soon, Ye Xiaofan learned about Bai Tianhong’s life experience. It turns out that Bai Tianhong had been cultivating in the lower realm all along, barely reaching the Void Divine Realm with the cultivation resources you provided.]
[After breaking through to the Void Divine Realm, he chose to ascend. After ascending, he struggled in the Elemental Star and didn’t fare well. Later, he unexpectedly encountered Mo Shang Li. Because you didn’t tell Bai Tianhong that Mo Shang Li was a malicious schemer, Bai Tianhong joined Mo Shang Li, who was also from the Purple Spirit Realm.]
[Bai Tianhong was very grateful to Mo Shang Li; if it weren’t for him, Bai Tianhong might have perished in the Elemental Star. Later, the Dark Disaster broke out, and he was almost killed.]
[Fortunately, during the Dark Disaster, the Emperor’s artifact of Tao Palace was resurrected, suppressing the Dark Disaster, and he and Mo Shang Li managed to survive by luck.]
[After that, Mo Shang Li felt that they couldn’t survive the Last Dharma Age like this. So, Mo Shang Li thought that since Bai Tianhong cultivated the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture of the Tao Palace, he must have a relationship with the Tao Palace; might as well join the Tao Palace together, use the Tao Palace’s resources, and self-tittle to the Golden Age.]
…
“So that’s how it is, is this the butterfly effect?”
Wang Ping looked at this, and his eyes flickered.
Unexpectedly, because he had killed the sage of Slaughter Paradise before, Ruo Lan didn’t come from the Small Universe.
As a result, Mo Shang Li didn’t have the opportunity to seek refuge with Ruo Lan, instead struggling in the Elemental Star, and may have even become a loose cultivator later on.
In the end, Mo Shang Li met Bai Tianhong, recognized that Bai Tianhong was from the Purple Spirit Realm, and even more so, he was a descendant of the Guilt-Punishing Emperor. As a result, Mo Shang Li, who claimed to be a senior, fought alongside the Guilt-Punishing Emperor against the Blood Demon Realm, got along well with Bai Tianhong, and won Bai Tianhong’s respect.
As for the few life-and-death crises that Bai Tianhong mentioned, Wang Ping didn’t know whether they were all staged by Mo Shang Li himself…
Wang Ping thought that the possibility of self-staging still existed. After all, Mo Shang Li was a ruthless and scheming person, and it would be impossible for him to risk his life to save Bai Tianhong genuinely.
Even the fact that he didn’t kill Bai Tianhong in the process was good.
“That’s right, this guy can tell that Bai Tianhong has the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture that I gave to Ye Xiaofan and Bai Tianhong. In other words, Mo Shang Li had been scheming since the beginning. He wanted to get along well with Bai Tianhong, then use Bai Tianhong’s Emperor Scripture and their relationship to join the Tao Palace.”

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Chapter 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_2
“The possibility of stealing the Emperor Scripture should be something he knows is difficult to achieve. After all, the Emperor Scripture has its own safeguards; unless the person learning it is willing to teach others sincerely, it is impossible for others to forcefully learn it through soul-searching. They will only be backfired. And Bai Tianhong obviously isn’t stupid enough to teach Mo Shang Li the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture.”
“So, his goal from the beginning was to join Tao Palace and use it for his Self-tittle. Only Tao Palace has the safest environment for a Self-tittle. With the Emperor’s artifact to deter others, along with the prestige left behind by Wang Ping, it is the safest place among the ancient stars in the Elemental Star River.”
Wang Ping’s eyes showed a keen gleam, and his analytical insight revealed Mo Shang Li’s thoughts.
This kid could also be considered a talent. Not everyone could have reached this point from the Purple Spirit Realm.
After all, even he and Ye Chen, the Son of Fortune, had experienced bumps and hurdles along the way, let alone ordinary Flying Immortals.
“Next, it should be Bai Tianhong and Mo Shang Li encountering something strange, obtaining a Special Constitution and improving their cultivation. I just don’t know where they encountered it.”
...
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Eventually, after some hesitation, Bai Tianhong chose to go to Tao Palace and join them. The palace master of Tao Palace found that Bai Tianhong might be related to you because of his cultivation of the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. So, they chose to accept both Bai Tianhong and Mo Shang Li.]
[With the help of Tao Palace’s resources, both of them successfully lived through the Golden Age.]
[After entering the Golden Age, they planned to travel and explore the Upper Realm, looking for opportunities. On their way, they encountered unimaginable dangers. Fortunately, they met a woman claiming to be Lin Qinghe. Lin Qinghe had a bit of goodwill towards Bai Tianhong because of his cultivation in the Tao Tian Emperor Scripture. As a result, Lin Qinghe saved them.]
[In the end, they continued their adventures and found an opportunity on an Ancient Star, which brought them to their current level. Hearing their answers, Ye Xiaofan couldn’t help but sigh at their good fortune.]
[Ye Xiaofan then asked Bai Tianhong what kind of opportunity he had obtained. Hesitant, Bai Tianhong eventually chose to remain silent and bitterly smiled, saying he couldn’t tell.]
[Not surprisingly, Ye Xiaofan asked Bai Tianhong where he had obtained the opportunity. After hesitating for a while, Bai Tianhong revealed something—the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star.]
[As Bai Tianhong’s head uttered this word, Ye Xiaofan fell into deep thought. It was during Ye Xiaofan’s contemplation that Bai Tianhong took his leave, and Ye Xiaofan informed you of the conversation’s content.]
….
“To think that this is related to Lin Qinghe too… It’s truly a wonderful fate.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation with a strange expression.
If nothing unexpected happened, the reason why these two appear in this simulation is that Lin Qinghe left the Taiyi Imperial Palace and became a loose cultivator again.
Without the accidental rescue by Lin Qinghe, both of them would have died in the previous simulations.
They would not have died in the Dark Disaster but during their time exploring the Upper Realm.
There’s nothing they could do about their weakness.
Of course, Wang Ping didn’t care about whether Mo Shang Li lived or died, but Bai Tianhong’s death would be a bit more regrettable.
“Before, I overlooked Bai Tianhong— even though I gave him some resources to practice well in the lower realm, I also forgot that he would eventually ascend. In the previous simulations, his ascension must have ended in falling.”
Wang Ping shook his head, muttered a word, and mourned for Bai Tianhong.
Of course, this was just a simulation, and he didn’t care too much about it.
If it were real, he would never let such a thing happen.
However, this simulation served as a wake-up call to pay more attention to the development of certain people in reality, such as the time the people of Chi Village disappeared getting closer.
From his rise in the lower realm to his journey in the Upper Realm, he had already spent seven or eight years.
Now there were less than twenty-three years left until the disappearance of the people of Chi Village.
“But, the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, wasn’t it where Ye Chen joined Thunderflame Valley and where the Undying Wind Demon Supreme of the Second Generation Transmigrator Chat Group resided? Could it be that the strange event is also related to the Undying Wind Demon Supreme?”
Wang Ping recalled Bai Tianhong’s words and narrowed his eyes.
If that’s really the case, it would be a bit troublesome.
Honestly, in so many simulations, because Wang Ping had grown up and had been focusing on Ku Xuan and other masterminds, he had somewhat neglected Wind Demon Supreme, never targeting him.
In other words, he had allowed him to linger until the Golden Age.
He did not expect that, having overlooked this guy, he might have plotted something.
Is he not afraid of being wiped out by the people in the Second Generation Chat Group?
After all, the predecessor from the Cultivation Realm who had cooperated with the strange event was ruthlessly wiped out by a Quasi-Emperor-tier predecessor within the Second-generation Chat Group.
“In the simulations, after finding contact severed, he dares to do such a thing. It’s normal since he’s reaching the end of his life and will use any means to survive. By collaborating with the strange event, only then can he prolong his life and even become stronger.”

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 239: The Birth of the Chaos Body!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: Chapter 239: The Birth of the Chaos Body!_3
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with acuity, analyzing in silence.
“Besides that, he previously used the Heavenly Secret Talisman against me. However, due to my Golden Talent, he was unable to use it. Now that I’ve joined the Taiyi Imperial Palace and have the countermeasures of the Palace’s Heavenly Secret Skill, he can’t target me anymore, otherwise the Taiyi Imperial Palace won’t hesitate to show him cruelty.”
“However, after the Wind Demon Supreme discovered Bai Tianhong and Mo Shang Li, and saw their people from the Purple Spirit Realm, he probably thought of my ascension from the Purple Spirit Realm and decided to recruit them. It’s also possible that the Wind Demon Supreme already discovered a connection between Bai Tianhong and myself. Otherwise, the two of them wouldn’t really qualify to be recruited by him.”
After contemplating many things, Wang Ping rubbed his brow, shaking his head helplessly.
Before crossing over, he was an author, his imagination becoming larger and larger. He liked to make assumptions, simulations, and deductions without sufficient evidence.
Peculiarly, the things he deduced were sometimes accurately on point.
...
Although he guessed wrongly about Ku Xuan and those emperors being the mastermind, the real mastermind was Guai, he still got some things right, Ku Xuan indeed had problems.
Now, he started to feel that the Wind Demon Supreme was problematic, and had connections with Guai.
He didn’t know whether this line of thought was correct.
“However, whether it’s correct or not, collecting information on this path certainly won’t pose any problems.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself again, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After learning many things from Ye Xiaofan, you have analyzed a lot and started to utilize the information network of Taiyi Imperial Palace to investigate what happened on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star and the whereabouts of the Wind Demon Supreme.]
[It must be said, the efficiency of Taiyi Imperial Palace is high. In just two days, they investigated what happened on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star. Someone ascended to the Quasi-Emperor tier thirty years ago.]
[This ascended cultivator is suspected to be the Wind Demon Supreme. In addition, based on the intensity of his Heavenly Tribulation and his performance during the tribulation, the Ancestor of Taiyi Imperial Palace speculated that Wind Demon Supreme may have acquired a powerful Wind Elemental constitution.]
[After receiving this information, you narrowed your eyes, basically confirming that Wind Demon Supreme had connections with Guai and had gained a lot of benefits from him.]
[Unfortunately, it’s unknown where the old rascal, Wind Demon Supreme, is hiding. Even the information network of Taiyi Imperial Palace can’t find him in a short time.]
[However, you’re not particularly anxious. Even if you can’t catch him in this simulation, you can always stake him out in the next simulation. You firmly believe that he can’t escape your trap.]
[Following that, nothing special happened as you started taking care of the Little Taoist boy and girl. You have used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to observe the two of them many times, but still couldn’t find anything special about them, and were puzzled about why Ku Xuan and Guai would value them so highly.]
[Just as you were pondering, Ku Xuan paid you a visit, stating that he has a strong bond with the two children and hoped that you could take them as your apprentices. He also hoped you could give him a chance.]
[If it were someone else, they would be very fond of Ku Xuan, who is gentle and well-mannered, quite unlike Young Master of the Longevity Ku Family. Perhaps, they would hand over the two children to him for the sake of favoring him.]
[However, you knew the truth about Ku Xuan. You smiled, stating that you also had a bond with the two children and wanted to take them as your apprentices, hoping that Young Master Ku Xuan could understand.]
[Hearing this, Ku Xuan frowned slightly, giving you a deep look. In the end, he didn’t say much but expressed with regret that it seemed the bond between you and the two children was indeed greater. Then, Ku Xuan chose to leave.]
[You didn’t mind Ku Xuan’s departure and continued to take care of the two children. The Little Taoist boy was extremely weak. Unfortunately, you didn’t know the root cause of his weakness, even with your Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[This only made you pay more attention to the two of them. The mysteries surrounding them might be more than what you initially assumed.]
[Next, the Immortal Mansion opened. You easily passed through the first Immortal Light, as did the Little Taoist girl with the Little Taoist boy on her back, staying quietly by your side.]
[Following that, the second Immortal Light appeared. You passed through it easily too, However, you deliberately delayed and didn’t show off too much, continuing to keep a low profile.]
[Surprisingly, both the Little Taoist girl and boy, who you considered very weak, passed the same-realm battle power test of the second round, even when Cai Yonglong had such difficulty.]
[This was very strange. After all, by your estimation, with their ability, entering the second round of the exam would definitely result in them getting killed instantly by their test opponents.]
[Curious, you asked them how they managed to pass the test. The Little Taoist girl and boy shyly explained that just as they entered the Illusionary Realm for the test, the test opponent suddenly disappeared.]
[Their words left you with a bemused expression, suspecting there was a bug in the illusion array. But then again, you thought it was impossible. After all, this was an assessment of the Immortal Mansion. If it could so easily malfunction, it would be too underwhelming.]

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Chapter 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_4
[However, as you recall, the Dream Demon Secret Realm in the Immortal Mansion was mysteriously switched, making you feel that the Immortal Mansion is indeed quite embarrassing. Various problems emerge, and you don’t know if it’s intentional or just that low.]
[Next, the third round of assessment comes, and the Dream Demon Secret Realm opens. You know very well that the entrance to the secret realm has been tampered with and switched to another dangerous secret realm.]
[For that reason, when all the heaven’s chosen flew in eagerly, you still calmly stood in place, having no intention of entering. During this process, even Cai Yonglong and the little female and male Taoists went in. This scene made the cultivators who noticed you cast strange glances.]
[Yu Daohong also frowned at you, not understanding what you were thinking. However, he did not hesitate or inquire, and also chose to enter.]
[When everyone else went in, you outside appeared particularly conspicuous. However, you still had no intention of entering, making the cultivators in the outer world cast strange glances, doubting whether there was something wrong with your brain.]
[Even the Ancestor from Taiyi Imperial Palace was speechless, not knowing what you were up to and becoming anxious in his heart. After all, you are their hope in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
...
[Just as all parties were paying attention, a celestial sound appeared from the Immortal Mansion, asking why you were not entering. In response, you very frankly stated that your strength was weak, afraid of death, and didn’t want to enter.]
[These words made countless cultivators laugh out loud, believing that Taiyi Imperial Palace had lost face big time. Although you are not the First Emperor Child but just an ordinary Emperor’s son, you still represent the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and it’s very shameful to say such words.]
[The Ancestors from the Taiyi Imperial Palace were grimacing with rage, looking disheveled in the wind, not knowing what tricks you were playing.]
[In the Immortal Mansion, the person who sent out the celestial sound was silent for a moment before saying that death in the Dream Demon Secret Realm would not truly result in perishing, and that you could safely venture there. Moreover, with your strength, if you were to die there, then no one would be able to pass.]
[These words made many cultivators stunned, not expecting that the Immortal Mansion would give you such a high appraisal. The meaning of these words was almost like saying that you were the strongest heavenly pride of the era, with no one being your opponent, even the one ranked first on the Great Saint Ranking.]
[You were not surprised by the appraisal given by the Immortal Mansion. Although your body was covered with the Secret Skill set up by Taiyi Great Emperor and the treasures of Taiyi Imperial Palace, it would definitely not be concealed in the eyes of the Immortal Mansion Strongmen.]
[However, even though you were exposed, you still had no intention of entering. Seeing this, everyone was speechless. The Immortal Mansion Strongmen were also at a loss for words.]
[Then, you suddenly felt a Terrifying Skill approaching, directly sweeping you into the secret realm. Seeing this, you cursed in your heart, feeling that the old man was not acting chivalrous, completely disregarding your personal opinion.]
[As you were swept in, the secret realm closed, and you were teleported to a certain spot within the secret realm.]
[You found that, unlike the previous time you entered, you weren’t sent to some place with many other chosen ones, then attacked by the Indigenous People led by the Black Fog Silhouettes with a Great Array.]
[Obviously, this time you delayed a lot of time before coming in, causing Ku Xuan’s strange people behind him to miss your presence. Of course, maybe you did not attract their key attention, which might be one of the reasons.]
[After entering the secret realm, you pondered if the strange people had also entered. If they had, then this time you could fight them, see their true bodies, and kill them.]
[Of course, you were also thinking about whether to continue playing it safe or not. In this case, as long as you can survive, you can stay in the Immortal Mansion and break through to the Supreme tier.]
[After thinking about it, you still chose to keep a low profile. After all, your goal from the beginning of the simulation was very clear: playing it safe and breaking through to the Supreme tier. As for investigating the truth and the strange people, you’ll deal with it later.]
[However, half a month after you decided to keep a low profile, you sensed Huang Yin and Huang Qing, along with Ji Bingyan. The three of them were being pursued and killed frantically and looked extremely miserable.]
[In response to this, you sighed helplessly and still chose to rescue them. Fortunately, your quick and ruthless action this time did not attract much attention.]
[Next, you plan to continue laying low with the three of them. However, often things don’t go as planned. In the blink of an eye, another half a month passed.]
[During this half a month, you clearly noticed that there were far fewer cultivators in the secret realm. Based on the intelligence you gathered previously, you estimated that most of the prodigies participating in the Immortal Mansion assessment had been hunted down. As for the remaining ones, they were probably those who were deliberately let go by the strange people and Ku Xuan. Otherwise, with their methods, no one would survive in this secret realm.]
[As for why they let the others go, it was probably to help Ku Xuan and the other Black Fog Silhouettes get rid of suspicion and stay in the Immortal Mansion. On the other hand, the strange people might still have some plans for the Immortal Mansion.]
[As you were thinking, you suddenly sensed a terrifying breath emerging, a breath that seemed like a piece of Chaos, much more terrifying than when you first condensed the complete Time-Space Body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: Chapter 239: The Birth of the Chaotic Body!_5
[This made you feel apprehensive, and you had some guesses in your mind. You could no longer keep lying low, and felt the need to investigate.]
[Soon, you brought the three of them to the place where the aura emerged, witnessing an astonishing scene.]
[Heavenly Proud Bones, piles of Indigenous Corpse Bones like mountains, and hundreds of merciless Black Fog Silhouettes guarded around a man in a black robe with a single horn on his forehead.]
[The chaotic aura came from this single-horned Black Robed masked man. This made you squint your eyes, guessing that this guy was the real mastermind, the strangeness that calculated everything.]
[Now, this strangeness was about to condense the legendary Chaotic Body. Obviously, the reason why he hunted so many Heavenly Prouds was not only to enhance his power but also to make himself strong enough to make his physique transformed into the legendary Chaotic Body.]
[About this, you were curious whether this strangeness had possessed a Devouring Immortal Demon Body or he condensed the Chaotic Body with his ability.]
...
[If it was condensed by his ability, you wouldn’t think much about it. But if he possessed the current Devouring Immortal Demon Body and used its power to condense the Chaotic Body, it would be a huge joke.]
[After all, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body was created by the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion. If the strangeness didn’t know and possessed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, it might benefit the Nine Stars Pavilion, leading to a mantis catching the cicada while the oriole is behind.]
[Just as you were thinking, you found that the Chaotic Body condensed by the strangeness was not perfect. Therefore, the strangeness shouted and directly absorbed most of the Black Fog Silhouettes.]
[This method was quite familiar to you, and it should not be the power of the strangeness itself, but the power of the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[As the strangeness devoured the Black Fog Silhouettes, his Chaotic Body became more perfect, making him laugh triumphantly.]
[Just as the strangeness was laughing, many Heavenly Prouds attracted by the Chaotic Body also showed jealousy and killing intent. They were not fools, and they naturally knew that they had been calculated, and the Devouring Immortal Demon Body in front of them was the mastermind behind it all.]
[Therefore, they naturally would not allow the Devouring Immortal Demon Body to condense the Chaotic Body and annihilate themselves here, turning their origin into nutrients for the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.]
[In the end, some Heavenly Prouds took the lead and attacked the strangeness together.]
[Because the strangeness had devoured all his indigenous subordinates and even most of the Black Fog Silhouettes, the remaining Black Fog Silhouettes were no match for the Heavenly Prouds’ army and were quickly defeated.]
[As for this, the strangeness didn’t waste any effort, directly devouring all of his subordinates and condensed a complete Chaotic Body, leaving only Ku Xuan mixed in the crowd.]
[Then, the strangeness and the remaining Heavenly Prouds had an intense battle. You witnessed an astonishing scene.]
[Despite both parties’ cultivation being suppressed to the Saint King Great Perfection Tier, the strangeness was actually able to dominate the situation by fighting a thousand against one.]
[It should be known that the Heavenly Prouds here were not ordinary; the weakest were Emperor’s son Tier characters, including top-ranked Heavenly Prouds on the Saint King Ranking and Great Saint Ranking.]
[However, so many people working together still could not gain an advantage. Although the strangeness did not intend to fight head-on with the Heavenly Prouds, it was enough to illustrate their strength.]
[Seeing this scene, your heart was amazed. The Chaotic Body was too powerful, even the Time-Space Body seemed too weak before it.]
[Only by possessing a Chaotic Body could one be called the first in talent, unmatched by anyone. Perhaps, even in the Immortal Domain, only an extremely rare Immortal Body could compete with it.]
[As for the further developed Chaos Immortal Body, it would be the truly strongest physique, with nothing comparable. However, in the Upper Realm, even the Chaotic Body had never appeared before, being only a legendary physique, let alone the Chaos Immortal Body, it was a question whether it existed in the Immortal Domain.]
[While you were thinking, Huangyin and the other two asked you whether to participate in the battle to kill this mastermind who calculated everyone.]
[Regarding this, you nodded and joined the battle. Since you had seen the strangeness and saw him condensing the Chaotic Body, there was no point in continuing to lie low. Instead, you might as well see if you could cooperate with the other Heavenly Prouds to defeat the strangeness and see his true face.]
[In that case, even if you died here, the gains of this simulation would be enough.]
[As you joined the battlefield, unleashing your true strength and launching a fierce attack on the strangeness, the strangeness, which originally had the advantage, lost it, becoming cautious and no longer reckless.]

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: Chapter 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind
“This mysterious figure has really possessed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body… and even managed to condense a Chaotic Body.”
Wang Ping frowned as he looked at the content of the Text Simulation.
In terms of combat strength alone, this mysterious figure had surpassed him and could be considered the strongest among his peers in the true sense.
This was still based on the premise that he had just acquired the Chaotic Body, had not cultivated the corresponding Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, and had not comprehended the Chaos Tao Pattern.
If he could proficiently control the Chaotic Body, create Chaos-type Cultivation Skills and Divine Skills, and comprehend the Chaos Tao Pattern.
Then, his combat strength would probably increase greatly, and he would be able to defeat anyone at the same level as soon as he saw them.
...
At that time, how powerful he would be is hard to imagine.
“This time, it’s going to be difficult.”
Wang Ping sighed, taking a pessimistic attitude toward whether they could kill the mysterious figure with a numerical advantage.
Since the other party dared to show up so brazenly, they must be very confident, and it’s unlikely they would die recklessly.
Moreover, this mysterious figure is mostly an unkillable cockroach; it’s hard to kill him unless you find his weakness.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts raced, the Text Simulation continued.
[As the mysterious figure stopped being reckless, the pressure on your side increased suddenly, and many geniuses died in the mysterious figure’s hands, being blown into a blood fog, and their origins were taken.]
[At this point, you became alarmed and felt that this couldn’t continue. If you all continued to fight like this, you would definitely be killed one by one by the mysterious figure. In addition, there must be traitors among the crowd.]
[Although the mysterious figure obviously didn’t want to expose Ku Xuan and his subordinates, wanting them to enter the Immortal Mansion for scheming, if it was a real danger, with the mysterious figure’s style, they would not hesitate to let them sneak attack everyone. Therefore, you had to be on guard.]
[As for asking other geniuses to join forces and deal with Ku Xuan and others first, you felt the possibility was low. Others might not believe you, and probably only Ye Chen and others would trust you. Moreover, taking action at this time would undoubtedly make the situation on your side even worse.]
[After thinking it over, you made a decision, sent a message to Ye Chen and others, and then used a very powerful Time-Space Divine Skill to temporarily trap the mysterious figure in another space and time, wanting to fight him one-on-one.]
[This scene surprised the others, thinking that you were reckless. However, some people were shocked by your strength, thinking that you had hidden too deeply, and had always shown the same performance as an Ordinary Emperor’s Son. But when you finally erupted, your strength surpassed all the Three St. Praise Geniuses.]
[It was at this moment when you confronted the mysterious figure in another space and time, and the others were very surprised. Ye Chen and the others suddenly attacked some people.]
[This scene angered the other people, who didn’t know what Ye Chen and the others meant and why they would attack their teammates and create internal strife at this time.]
[Ye Chen and others shouted that you had the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, which could see through everyone’s details. The people they attacked were all the mysterious figure’s subordinates and were like the Black Fog Silhouettes. They had to be cleaned up first.]
[Then, Ye Chen pointed out the mysterious figure’s hidden minions among the crowd. Everyone was shocked by this and did not know whether to believe Ye Chen’s words.]
[Those who were pointed out by Ye Chen and his companions refuted angrily, claiming that Ye Chen and the others had a conflict with them and were taking revenge at this time.]
[As arguments and battles broke out, the scene became chaotic, making other geniuses more hesitant and unsure which side was telling the truth.]
[At this time, the young master of the Tianmu tribe stood up, saying that he also had the Origin Divine Eye. Although it was not as good as the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, when the people in question took action, he could see similarities in their aura.]
[When these words came out, everyone frowned. The Tianmu Clan had nothing to do with the Taiyi Imperial Palace, so it would not lie. For a moment, everyone looked at Ku Xuan and others, revealing a fierce light, and started taking action.]
[At this time, hesitation was not allowed. It was better to kill ten thousand and not let one escape. Even if they really killed the wrong people and were being used by others, they accepted their fate. Anyway, they would all compete for the Immortal Fate in the future, and it wouldn’t matter if Ku Xuan and others died.]
[As the other geniuses joined the battlefield, Ye Chen and others, who had originally been hammered and suppressed by Ku Xuan, were in danger of losing their lives at any time. A fierce battle broke out between both sides.]
[During the time of the outer world battle, you were also engaged in a fierce battle with the mysterious figure. The mysterious figure mocked your arrogance and found you, as one of the Guardian Wei’s, really annoying. That’s why he wants to seize your origin and turn you into his dog.]
[You ignored the mysterious figure’s words and continued to fight. However, although you fought at full strength, using your Golden Talent Ninefold Ensemble and Purple Talent: Endless Blade without reservation, and even used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see through his origin and divine skills, you still couldn’t gain any advantage and were even in an absolute disadvantage.]
[You marveled at the power of the Chaotic Body, and your eyes were envious of it. You also hoped that you could draw such a constitution as the Chaotic Body in the future to become even stronger.]
[Of course, even though you were envious, you knew that now was not the time to be envious. You had to find a way to kill the mysterious figure and turn the tables against the wind.]

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 878: Chapter 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_2
[In the end, you managed to injure Kueiji by utilizing the abilities of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification and Purple Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills, along with a strategy of exchanging life for damage, in hopes of triggering the effects of the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[Unfortunately, although you were lucky to trigger a sixfold ensemble and a critical strike effect, you ultimately did not trigger the effects of the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[This left you feeling somewhat helpless, and you could only choose to use the ability of Golden Talent: Life for Life to exchange lives with Kueiji. You believed that although Kueiji had the ability to break through to the Supreme Realm and even beyond that easily, he would definitely not choose to do so.]
[Because once he breaks through, he would be unable to harness the origin energies of the Upper Realm geniuses to condense a Chaotic Body. Therefore, he must have been suppressing his cultivation before that.]
[As expected, Kueiji was indeed suppressing his cultivation, and his true realm was only at the Half-step Supreme Realm. As a result, the effect of Golden Talent: Life for Life was successfully triggered, and Kueiji died. However, you also consumed one of your own lives.]
[Nevertheless, concerning the consumption of a life, you cleverly utilized the Purple Talent: Death Replacement Puppet to transfer the death effect to an unlucky God King Realm powerhouse.]
...
[But regrettably, something within your expectations happened. Kueiji died, but he was immediately resurrected, looking at you mockingly with a smirk on his face.]
[Kueiji sneered, saying that your abilities were not bad, as you somehow managed to kill him silently, catching him off guard. However, he regretted to inform you that you were still not qualified to kill him completely.]
[You didn’t care about Kueiji’s mockery and, instead, analyzed the principle of his resurrection with a frown. Based on your experience dealing with Kueiji, the principle behind his resurrection might be transferring the outcome of death to the beings he had given power to.]
[This effect was similar to your Purple Talent: Death Replacement Puppet, but the level of ability and effect were much more overbearing. The formerly admired Kueiji also had this kind of resurrection ability, which made him very difficult to deal with.]
[You were not sure how many more subordinates Kueiji had left. If it were you, you would have scattered your subordinates across the Ten Great Universes, amassing as many as possible. This arrangement would be the safest option.]
[In other words, if Kueiji truly possessed this ability, it would basically be impossible for you to kill him. Perhaps only a being far superior to Kueiji could kill him over and over again until all of his death replacements were extinguished. Only then might Kueiji be truly dead.]
[However, to achieve this, you thought even a Supreme Realm master wouldn’t be enough, and even an ordinary Quasi-Emperor might not necessarily be able to kill Kueiji. After all, Kueiji could break through to the Supreme Realm at any time. And with Kueiji’s strength after breaking through, even an ordinary Quasi-Emperor might struggle to kill him, let alone having to kill him repeatedly until he was exhausted to death.]
….
“I knew Kueiji wouldn’t be that simple.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation and shook his head.
“But this isn’t the worst part. After all, Kueiji still has his curse ability. When he killed Ku Xuan, Ku Xuan shot out a red light that entered the simulated Wang Ping’s body, forming a red pattern, which was later detonated by Kueiji.”
“Besides that, I don’t know if Kueiji has other abilities. Although I want to force out all his cards, it’s not possible this time. However, the gains from this time aren’t bad either. With the Breaking Origin Sky Eye’s ability, Kueiji’s disguise of his face and figure is useless, as they have been seen through, and his aura has been recorded too. Now, I can slowly look for him.”
“Of course, the appearance can be disguised, and the body can be disguised too, so we can’t rely solely on that as a reference. The most critical aspect is still his aura.”
“However, trying to find Kueiji based on his aura is also going to be quite difficult. It will take a lot of time and patience.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and as he thought about these matters in his heart, he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, Kueiji unleashed a terrifying combat power, directly injuring you and no longer giving you the slightest chance. However, Kueiji never intended to kill you, but was instead slowly wearing down your power.]
[This caused your expression to change, and you realized Kueiji’s intentions and abilities. It seems that Kueiji needs two prerequisites to seize others’ origin energies and control them.]
[These two prerequisites were that the enemy must be weakened to a certain extent and that he must have obtained a part of their origin energy, or he has granted them origin energy. Of course, it’s also possible that Kueiji only needs the enemy to be weakened to a certain extent, and he can then use his abilities to control them without any trouble. After all, this is Kueiji – his abilities have always been very disgusting and overbearing.]
[In order not to be worn down and controlled by Kueiji, you had a moment of determination and initiated self-destruction to explode everything and unleash your most powerful attack.]
[Kueiji didn’t expect you to be so desperate, and he was injured by your explosion. Then, you triggered the effects of the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack, and Kueiji died once more.]
[However, Kueiji revived once again, with great annoyance on his face. He felt that your trump card was not bad either since it managed to kill him again, making him feel somewhat embarrassed.]
[Just as Kueiji was preparing to keep watch over you, preventing your resurrection and escape, his expression suddenly changed. This was because after condensing his Chaotic Body, he had engaged in such an intense battle that his Chaotic Body was now becoming unstable.]

chapters.title: Chapter 879: 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 879: Chapter 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_3
[Apart from that, the birth of an unconventional physique always incites Heavenly Tribulation. It’s just that, in this secret realm, it temporarily evades the tribulation, making it look so calm.]
[However, no matter how powerful the secret realm is, it ultimately cannot defy the rules of the Upper Realm, and therefore, the Heavenly Tribulation still appears.]
[If he continues to stay within this secret realm, he will be met with devastating attack. The terror of this Heavenly Tribulation is unimaginable. Besides, the secret realm is not small, but it’s only relative to the Saints and Saint Kings, his cultivation is actually Half-step Supreme Realm.]
[Heavenly Tribulation is generated based on his true cultivation and Chaotic Body. The terror of it can be imagined, and it will definitely destroy this secret realm along with it. This secret realm was obtained through his painstaking efforts, and its destruction would break his heart.]
[Because of this, although Guises wanted to camp and kill you badly, they eventually let you go and chose to move themselves without hesitation, leaving the secret realm, destination unknown.]
[And you were resurrected an hour later. When you were resurrected, seeing the disappeared Guises, you let out a slight sigh of relief, but also furrowed your brows. After all, you didn’t think Guises wouldn’t even camp.]
...
[It can only be said that Guises must have encountered a situation in which they had to withdraw, so they left in such a hurry.]
[However, you can’t control where Guises went now, you returned to the time and space where the secret realm was located and saw that the two sides were still fighting.]
[It can only be said that although Ku Xuan was not a match for you, he was really strong. With his other Guises subordinates, he pressed on Ye Chen and the other talents, making the numerical advantage on Ye Chen’s side useless.]
[Although it has become like this because Guises set up a trap when the talents were teleported in and killed the real Monsters, causing most of the top talents to die or be injured, and then a part of them died due to Guises’ intervention, the fighters now participating in the battle have few talents ranked higher on the Great Saint Ranking. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be like this.]
[However, no matter what, Ye Chen and the others finally managed to survive relying on various trump cards. With you joining the battlefield, people other than Ku Xuan were killed one by one. Mo Shang Li was also on the list of those killed.]
[As for Bai Tianhong, you still didn’t want to do it yourself. Although you knew Bai Tianhong was completely controlled by Guises, you didn’t do it yourself. Eventually, other talents killed him.]
[Next, you face Ku Xuan again. Naturally, you know the details of Ku Xuan. Hence, you’re in a bit of a dilemma as to whether or not to kill him. If you kill him, you’ll surely be cursed, and you’ll have to start over.]
[But if you don’t, there probably isn’t anyone brave enough to attack Ku Xuan. During the previous battles, no one actually helped Ye Chen and the others attack Ku Xuan. It has always been Ye Chen, Zhu Huowang, Huangyin and others besieging Ku Xuan, with others dealing with other opponents.]
[Everyone is very clear that without solid evidence, if they attack Ku Xuan and kill him, they may face revenge from the Longevity Ku Family.
