No one can overlook the Longevity Ku Family, which even the Emperor has to be extremely wary of, let alone these so-called talented people who have not yet grown up.]
[As a result, no one can afford the price of killing Ku Xuan, and they will not act. You also cannot bear the consequences of doing it. After all, you are now different from the one in the last simulation, and you have no way of proving that Ku Xuan has a problem.]
[Besides, you won’t be able to resist Ku Xuan’s dying counterattack if you kill him.]
[However, although you are struggling with how to deal with Ku Xuan, you do not idle and directly attack him, decisively defeating Ku Xuan and then subduing him with the Time-Space Divine Skill.]
[Although Ku Xuan was subdued, his expression was still very calm. He stared at you, full of emotion, and said that he really didn’t expect you to hide so deeply and be so powerful.]
[In response, you chuckled and said that it’s the same for both of us. Then you looked at the crowd and began considering how to get out of here. You didn’t ask Ku Xuan for ideas.]
[You are well aware that Ku Xuan would never answer you, and you have to find your own way out. However, this time is different from the last. This time, Guises may not intend to release you all, after all, things have reached this point, and it is undoubtedly the best choice to keep the secret by wiping out everyone.]
[Guises’ whereabouts are unknown now, but after they solve their problem, they will definitely come back to annihilate you here.]
[It can be said that you don’t have much time left, and you must find a way to survive as soon as possible.]
[In the end, after thinking, you asked everyone to search for a solution together. No one objected to your words, after all, you were the strongest here, and with their lives at stake, no one would cause a scene at this time.]
[Unfortunately, you searched everywhere, but you didn’t find a way out. Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, another month had passed, making you anxious.]
[While you were running out of options, Ku Xuan’s expression suddenly stiffened, and then his body exploded.]

chapters.title: Chapter 880: 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 880: Chapter 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_4
[This makes you very astonished, for you don’t know why Ku Xuan would suddenly die so abruptly. However, you quickly think of the deception. Deception has the ability to replace death. In other words, deception encounters a life-threatening situation and is forced to let others die for itself.]
[However, if that is the case, how bad must the situation of deception be? After all, Ku Xuan can be regarded as the strongest Heavenly talent under its control, and with a great background, there is a high value in using him. It can be said that unless it is a matter of life and death, deception would never do such a thing.]
[But didn’t deception already get the Chaotic Body and escape from here? Why would he encounter such a dangerous situation, which does not match his cautious character.]
[While you are surprised, Ku Xuan is resurrected once again. He is indifferent to his own death and resurrection, looks at you calmly, and slowly speaks a sentence, ‘Heavenly talents are only pawns and eventually become dry bones.]
[As these words fall, Ku Xuan’s expression stiffens once more, and finally his Divine Soul shatters, turning him into a corpse.]
[Looking at the dead Ku Xuan, you fall silent, your feelings quite complicated. Obviously, Ku Xuan did not join the deception but instead was controlled by deception and turned into a pawn, a pitiful and lamentable fate. No matter how Heavenly the talent, with no strength, there is only empty sorrow.]
...
[Next, you reflect on whether deception has actually died, and if so, how it died.]
[However, you will never get an answer and start to wonder when the group of slackers in the Immortal Mansion will actually discover that their secret realm has been tampered with and come to save you.]
[At the same time, you start to worry about how to explain the death of Ku Xuan. Without evidence, the Ku family is not easy to deal with. All you can hope is that the Ku family can see the abnormality in Ku Xuan’s body.]
[If not, the current situation of the Taiyi Imperial Palace cannot withstand the anger of the Longevity Ku Family. Of course, even if the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is still in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, he could not withstand the anger of the Ku family either.]
[After all, the Ku family has a Terrifyingly Strong presence who has refined the Immortal Spirit, making them one of the most powerful in the world. Only the existence of the old monsters in the Immortal Mansion can rival them.]
……..
“This development is indeed a bit unexpected. Deception just obtained the Chaotic Body and is already suspected of being dead.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the Text Simulation, his expression somewhat subtle.
This deception, it wouldn’t be targeted by the Heavenly Tao, then struck by a horrifying Heavenly Tribulation which then killed it, right?
If so, he could only say he got what he deserved.
Of course, this possibility is quite small.
Wang Ping is more suspicious that a certain powerful figure caught deception and tortured him to death time and time again.
As for why deception was caught, it naturally had to do with the origin of the Chaotic Body.
“Good guy, if you think about it, deception is like a sweet pastry, being refined time and time again, and continually squeezed.”
Wang Ping’s eyes are very subtle.
“If deception really is being repeatedly squeezed, I don’t know if I should gloat or gloat.”
Wang Ping can’t help but laugh at the thought of that scene, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[While you are contemplating all sorts of things, within the secret realm, a sudden terrifying space fluctuation appeared. And then, your body was involuntarily sucked out.]
[Not only you, but all the Heavenly talents in the secret realm were also sucked out.]
[During this process, you are very clear that the Immortal Mansion should have noticed the anomaly and chose to take action.]
[Taking more than two months to find out the anomaly and the solution is simply disgraceful for this Immortal Mansion. While leaving, you still criticize the Immortal Mansion in your heart.]
[After you leave, the cultivators paying attention to the Immortal Mansion are all full of astonishment, doubt, and anger. So many Heavenly talents went in, but less than a thousand came out, which is a very horrifying thing.]
[Moreover, didn’t the Immortal Mansion say that people won’t die in the secret realm trial? Why are there so few people coming out, and they all seem severely injured?]
[At this moment, the Mansion Master of the Immortal Mansion is also looking at this side with a heavy expression. To be honest, they didn’t expect this kind of thing to happen. The secret realm entrance set by the Immortal Mansion was unexpectedly replaced by someone else, which was a shocking move.]
[In addition, they monitored the Dream Demon Secret Realm but didn’t notice any abnormalities, and the Heavenly talents were undergoing normal assessment and trials. If it weren’t for his suspicion that something was wrong after two months without anyone passing the assessment, appearing very strange, and fully investigating it, they would still be kept in the dark.]
[The Immortal Mansion Master believes that there are several reasons for someone being able to do such a thing. The mastermind behind it comes from Outside the Domain, as only People from Outside the Domain can rely on such magical abilities and tools to make them, such strong figures, unable to detect the secret realm entrance being transferred to another secret realm while forming an illusionary projection in the Dream Demon Secret Realm that even they cannot see through.]
[The second point is that there might be a mole within the Immortal Mansion; otherwise, even if the other party had magical abilities and tools, they would still need the opportunity to use them.]
[The third point is that the other party also has a powerful figure of quasi-Fairy Realm comparable to the Ancestor of the Immortal Mansion. Otherwise, they could not set up such a special secret realm that even the Emperor cannot break through, making the Emperor’s Incarnation and the Emperor’s artifact unable to appear. Of course, it is not ruled out that the other party also created this with abilities and tools.]

chapters.title: Chapter 881: 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 881: Chapter 240: The Mantis Hunts the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind_5
[Point four, the opponent likewise possesses a master of the Heavenly Secret Skill that is on par with or even surpasses their Immortal Mansion’s Divine Calculator. Otherwise, it would be impossible to arrange all of this without detection and without causing any changes in the Heavenly Secrets.]
[Of course, this is also not ruling out that the opponent has used abilities or artifacts to block the Heavenly Secret calculations.]
[It can be said that the above conditions are necessary, and the preparations of the opponent are undoubtedly extremely sufficient. The means of the mastermind behind the scenes are bone-chilling. To scheme against all the forces in the Upper Realm, including their Immortal Mansion, is just too ruthless.]
[The Immortal Mansion Master’s mood was heavy as he scanned the surviving living beings, especially those in the Abyss Lands, Slaughter Paradise, you, the Nine Stars Reserve of the Nine Stars Pavilion, and those related to the All Heavens, lingering on them for a long time.]
…
“It seems the Immortal Mansion Master has considered this more thoroughly. It appears that their ability to accomplish this is even more difficult than I imagined.”
...
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, frowning as well.
“The mysterious ability is special, but it is also impossible to have so many abilities and artifacts. In other words, behind the mysterious, there is also someone supporting them, a person from All Heavens who is planning all of this.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking silently.
He thought of a person.
This person was the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
Could it be that all of this was planned by the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion?
If it is his doing, then this guy’s scheming is too deep.
Creating the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, using the mysterious abilities, various calculations, scheming against all forces, sweeping up all the geniuses in one pot, making them become fodder to help the mysterious successfully condense the Chaotic Body.
And then, something went wrong with the mysterious as well.
Wang Ping could not help but suspect that this was also the doing of the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
If it really was the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion who acted against the mysterious, then his goal is the Chaotic Body as well.
It can be said that he has been plotting all of this for a long time.
It’s a chain of schemes that tightly traps everyone.
For a moment, Wang Ping was extremely wary of the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
This guy is too dangerous, and his true identity is unknown, which force he comes from among the All Heavens.
“That’s right, if it is the Nine Stars Pavilion, as long as some high-ranking members of the Immortal Mansion have joined the Nine Stars Pavilion, the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion can summon them out. Then, in cooperation with the mysterious abilities, it would be quite easy to place a mole within the Immortal Mansion. After all, the mysterious can easily control others, and even the most loyal people of the Immortal Mansion can’t withstand the mysterious abilities.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, thinking of another critical point.
Considering this, Wang Ping sighed deeply: “These old monsters are really too sinister, and it’s exhausting to deal with them. It can be said that if it weren’t for the Life Simulator, I wouldn’t have enough lives to play with them.”
“In the real world, I have to tell Alpha that if I really encounter danger, he should teleport me away the first time.”
Wang Ping rubbed his brows again and muttered to himself.
Before, Wang Ping thought that the possibility of the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion targeting him was relatively low…
Now, he doesn’t think so anymore, the possibility has directly surged up a lot.
This ruthless and cunning old man is too dangerous, and it’s never too much for Wang Ping to be prepared against him.
Even outside the simulation, Wang Ping is a little uneasy, let alone immersed in the immersive simulation, where the time in the outer world still passes, it’s too risky.
So, he has to rely on Alpha’s help to make sure he has the ability to escape in an emergency. Otherwise, being killed in the simulation would be too tragic.
“Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion… feels like a shocking enemy. If the story of the Upper Realm were to be made into a novel, perhaps he would be the big boss of the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
Before, he thought Ku Xuan was the big boss. Undoubtedly, he had overestimated him.
Ku Xuan was just a minor boss, and he was clearly a pitiful person being controlled. Most of his actions were not his own will.
Otherwise, with his identity as the Young Master of the Longevity Ku Family, it is really unnecessary for him to conspire with tigers. The cost-benefit ratio is too low, and it is simply a brain-dead act.
Subsequently, Wang Ping converged his thoughts and continued to watch the luminescent screen, wanting to see how the Immortal Mansion dealt with the troubles that followed.
With so many geniuses dead, Wang Ping felt that all the forces in the Upper Realm would be furious. By then, Ku Xuan’s death should not cause too much trouble.
[When the Immortal Mansion Master’s expression was heavy, some Emperors could no longer sit still, questioning the Immortal Mansion as to what they were up to, why only so few people came out, and all of them were injured, obviously escaping from death.]
[As Emperors stepped forward, all forces began to speak up, questioning the Immortal Mansion with displeasure in their expressions. After all, those who entered were the heirs of their forces, the hope for their future. If they were to fall here, they would really want to vomit blood.]
[Faced with the questioning from the outside world, the Immortal Mansion Master was quite troubled and unsure of how to explain. After all, although they were schemed against this time, it was ultimately the fault of the Immortal Mansion. They could not shift the blame, nor should they. They must make up for the mistakes.]
[Just as the Immortal Mansion Master was feeling quite troubled, Ye Chen stepped forward and spoke about what had happened in the secret realm.]
[As Ye Chen described the events, all the forces were shocked, never expecting such horrifying things to happen in the secret realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking through to the Supreme!
chapters.content:
Chapter 882: Chapter 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking through to the Supreme!
[No one expected that there would be a mastermind controlling everything, trying to eliminate all of the Upper Realm’s talents at once. It’s just too ruthless.]
[What’s crucial is that they succeeded – they tampered with the secret realm entrance and slaughtered most of the talents who entered the secret realm, absorbing their essence, and successfully refining the legendary Chaotic Body.]
[According to Ye Chen’s description, the Chaotic Body is extremely terrifying, able to stand against the remaining talents single-handedly, gaining an overwhelming upper hand. If you hadn’t intervened and dragged them into an alternate space-time, all the talents would have died.]
[At this point, everyone’s gaze turned to you while their expressions changed. The mastermind’s scheme sent chills down everyone’s spines, but your performance was just as shocking, as you managed to survive a lone battle against the Chaotic Body and even suppress Ku Xuan, who had similar combat strength before you intervened. Your strength is truly amazing.]
[However, before this, you appeared to be ordinary, known as an ordinary Emperor’s son and the most disgraceful one in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. One could say that you’ve hidden your true strength well, a master of deceit.]
[Subsequently, everyone questioned the Immortal Mansion as to why they failed so miserably, falling into one trap after another, causing their heirs to die tragically. They demanded an explanation, otherwise, they would never let this go.]
...
[Faced with accusations from various forces, the Immortal Mansion Master had a grave expression, asking everyone to calm down and give the Immortal Mansion some time to investigate and find the culprit, promising to give everyone an explanation.]
[The response from the Immortal Mansion Master left everyone dissatisfied, with some mocking that there must be an issue within the Immortal Mansion itself, possibly even involved in the conspiracy, as no one else could have pulled off such a feat.]
[Facing the mockery of the various parties, the Immortal Mansion Master had nothing to say. Even he didn’t believe that there were no issues within the Immortal Mansion. However, the Immortal Mansion Master was well aware of the true intentions behind the various forces’ aggressive stances.]
[Their goal was not only to hold the Immortal Mansion accountable but also to exert pressure. Since the talents have already died and nothing can change this outcome, they could only look forward and cooperate in seeking the murderer. At the same time, they wanted to use this opportunity to probe the Immortal Mansion’s secrets and uncover why it was so mysterious, controlling the Immortal Realm and the mystery of Immortal Fate.]
[This time, the various parties have seized the Immortal Mansion’s weakness, and if the Immortal Mansion does not compromise, this matter will become more troublesome. However, the Immortal Mansion is not likely to compromise and reveal many secrets, let alone hand over important assets.]
[Just as the atmosphere began to grow oppressive, a terrifying aura descended, and the Family Master of Longevity Ku Family appeared, who happened to be Ku Xuan’s father.]
[After the Family Master of the Ku family appeared, everyone cast their gaze towards him, with their expressions turning solemn, showing some trepidation, but their thoughts also became more active.]
[After all, in this secret realm event, Ku Xuan was also identified as part of the mastermind’s side. Though it was only Ye Chen’s testimony, Ku Xuan was ultimately labeled as such, and he is now deceased.]
[Once someone dies, they can no longer defend themselves. If the various forces wanted to, they could use this to target the Longevity Ku Family.]
[Of course, after some consideration, they decided against it. At this time, probing the Immortal Mansion was more important, making the strength of the Longevity Ku Family indispensable. In the Upper Realm, only the Longevity Ku Family could vaguely stand up against the Immortal Mansion.]
[Although this was the speculation of the various forces, there was no conflict between the Longevity Ku Family and the Immortal Mansion, but if the Longevity Ku Family took action, things would be more stable.]
[Subsequently, the old monsters of the various parties looked at you, thinking you’d be a good pawn to win over the Ku Family. After all, you suppressed Ku Xuan, who died at your hands. Although Ye Chen claimed that Ku Xuan’s unexplained death was the doing of the Chaotic Body, this kind of thing requires evidence, so anything could be said.]
[Noticing the gazes of the old monsters, you felt a sense of crisis in your heart, knowing that these people had already targeted you. You took a deep breath, stood up without humility or arrogance, and displayed your memory of the events through Divine Skills, trying to prove your innocence.]
[At the same time, you revealed much of what you knew and made some speculations. Of course, you didn’t mention the possibility of the mysterious figure being dead, as you hadn’t entered an immersive simulation state and didn’t possess a god’s-eye view. As you explained, the expressions of the various parties changed once more. If what you said is true, the situation would be dire.]
[As for the mysterious figure, the Myriad Heavens Forces knew some information due to their involvement. The mysterious figure is extremely dangerous and must be eliminated if discovered. If the being who refined the Chaotic Body using the Devouring Immortal Demon Body is indeed the mysterious figure, then it would make sense for them to control Ku Xuan and so many talents without alerting the various powerful individuals.]
[Given the situation, the time isn’t right for strife or probing the Immortal Mansion. Instead, the mastermind behind all of this, the mysterious figure, must be found and killed. Any forces potentially collaborating with the mysterious figure must also be identified and dealt with.]

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through to the Supreme! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 883: Chapter 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through to the Supreme! _2
[Otherwise, once the anomalies are fully developed, it will become a disaster for the Upper Realm. After all, the purpose of anomalies is to destroy all living beings and even the world itself.]
[There is no doubt that this is a moment concerning the survival of all forces and must be treated with caution. At this time, internal strife constitutes extreme foolishness.]
[Thus, after the old monsters from the Myriad Heavens Forces, such as Slaughter Paradise and Abyss Lands, have proven the existence of anomalies through your memory images and the intercepted abnormal breath, as well as verifying the presence of anomalous breath within Ku Xuan’s body, the vast majority of forces have put aside their previous grievances and private grudges, and the big shots have begun to enter the Immortal Mansion to discuss important matters.]
[After taking Ku Xuan’s corpse away, the Family Master of the Longevity Ku Family looked deeply into your eyes. The unfathomable gaze of a great Emperor left you under immense pressure, but you still showed no fear. After all, Ku Xuan’s death in this simulation has nothing to do with you, and your conscience is clear.]
[In the end, the Immortal Mansion assessment came to a halt, as the number of Heavenly Talents who managed to survive was too small and they were all taken into the Mansion. This made some of the surviving Heavenly Talents feel both terrified and relieved. After all, if it were a normal assessment, their chances of entering the Immortal Mansion would be quite slim.]
[However, most people sighed in their hearts, their emotions mixed. The so-called Golden Age hadn’t even truly unfolded, and there was no scene of all the Heavenly Talents attaining Dao, leaving only desolation.]
...
[It was said to be the most glorious era from ancient times to the present, but in the end, it became the most desolate era, with the quantity and quality of Heavenly Talents far inferior to the previous Golden Ages.]
…
“It seems that the weaker forces don’t know about the anomalies, but the great emperors do know about their existence. They should be clear in their hearts that the Source of Darkness is related to the anomalies. However, since there has been no movement from the Source of Darkness for so many years, there is no need to pay too much attention to its existence.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and thought to himself.
“Of course, the Upper Realm’s big shots paying attention to the Source of Darkness is useless. Even if they care, can they destroy it? It’s impossible for the great emperors to accomplish what the Master Lords of All Heavens couldn’t. Though this is just a strand of hair that formed from the true body of the anomaly, surely the Master Lords of All Heavens have a way to destroy it, but there is no need for that. The great emperors truly have no way to deal with it.”
“However, judging by the reactions of the emperors, if they become aware of the anomalies’ existence, they would still abandon their prejudices and try to kill the anomalies first. Obviously, in the past eras, the anomalies must have caused a great upheaval and brought about massive destruction. Otherwise, their reactions might have been similar to the Light Lord God in Zhang Hu’s world, thinking of using the anomaly instead of uniting to destroy it.”
Wang Ping analyzed a lot of information in his mind and felt slightly relieved.
His biggest concern was that the great emperors would not care about the anomalies and would think of using them. It seems now that he was overly worried.
However, the ones who wanted to use the anomalies still came from the Myriad Heavens.
Yet, in the Myriad Heavens, the anomaly is a public enemy. He dares to act so crazily, not afraid of being cleaned up by others.
“It seems not right…”
Wang Ping frowned, suddenly thinking of something.
He had assumed that the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion was the big boss, having utilized the existence of anomalies.
However, the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion came from the Myriad Heavens and should have been able to blend into the Heavenly Paradise with his status and background.
If his goal was to become immortal and grow stronger, it seemed unnecessary to take such great risks to do these things.
“Perhaps, the development in reality and the simulation are completely different. In reality, everything is normal. The Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion and forces like Slaughter Paradise from the Myriad Heavens can interact normally and travel to and from the Heavenly Paradise. But in my simulation, they have lost contact with the outside world.”
Wang Ping made this assumption.
“That is to say, they may panic, thinking that something big has happened. In the simulation, they have lost the advantage of going to the Heavenly Paradise and using the resources of related forces. This means that in the simulation, they can only rely on themselves and use the resources of the Upper Realm to achieve their goal of becoming stronger. If they don’t, they will grow old. However, they will not enter the Source of Darkness like the great emperors who had no choice.”
“These people are even more aware of the terror of the Source of Darkness and will not rely on it to remain dormant indefinitely. Therefore, they will try every means to become stronger, become immortal, and go to the Immortal Domain. Only in that way can they achieve eternal life and escape this world.”
“With such speculation, it can be said for sure that the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion’s actions and the thoughts of other forces from the Myriad Heavens are vastly different in the simulation world. Perhaps, in the normal course of events in reality, the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion will not use the anomaly, and the anomaly will naturally not harm Ku Xuan and other people, killing so many Heavenly Talents.”
“Although the existence of the anomaly is still a significant hidden danger, without support from a big shot like the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion, it has no power to cause such a big disturbance and will be killed once discovered.”

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through Heaven Supreme! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 884: Chapter 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through Heaven Supreme! _3
Thinking about this, Wang Ping let out a silent sigh inside.
After all the trouble, he realized that it was his fault.
This really was something to grumble about, but he didn’t know how to voice his complaints.
“Forget about it. All of these are just conjectures. It might not necessarily be my fault. It could be that either the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion or someone else had originally planned this.”
Wang Ping held his forehead, quietly setting his fault aside, exhibiting a ‘non-stick’ quality.
Next, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, eager to see what was coming.
...
[In the blink of an eye, a year had passed. During this year, you quietly cultivated in the Immortal Mansion. The cultivation environment inside the Immortal Mansion is much better than that of Taiyi Imperial Palace, and there are even secret places that help with Enlightenment.]
[You’re confident that if you continue to cultivate in this secret realm for about another hundred years, you will successfully condense the Tao Fruit, breaking through the Supreme Realm bottleneck and achieving Enlightenment of Heaven and Earth.]
[Unfortunately, this near extinction of the proud geniuses has brought many benefits to you survivors. If it had followed the normal development, these secret places would require enough Immortal Mansion contribution points to practice in. Now, they are free for you to use.]
[Of course, this also benefits from your significant contribution in the secret realm and the crisis felt by the Immortal Mansion. The mastermind is terrifying and has also joined forces with the Weird One, forcing the Immortal Mansion to quickly cultivate more geniuses, or even quickly cultivate Immortal Seedlings, to counter them.]
[Over the past year, the Immortal Mansion Alliance and other forces have been investigating the truth. They have reaped many rewards. They have learned that the Heavenly Calculation’s Child seems to have awakened from his Mad Demon state and has cooperated with the Weird One and the mastermind. However, this is quite normal. Without the Heavenly Calculation’s Child, it would be impossible to resist the Heavenly Secret Skill practiced by the Immortal Mansion’s Divine Calculation Man.]
[In addition, the Immortal Mansion Master in the Immortal Mansion has also thoroughly investigated and found a Quasi-Emperor Spy, killing him. It can only be said that the power of the Weird One is truly terrifying. Even a strong man of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection was unnoticeably controlled by him.]
[However, this has also allowed the Immortal Mansion Master to catch the tail of the mastermind. In his view, only the Nine Stars Pavilion can control a Quasi-Emperor away from the Immortal Mansion and have the strength of a quasi-Fairy.]
[In other words, the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion is highly suspect. This has made many forces increasingly wary of the Nine Stars Pavilion. They are extremely hostile, and the majority of them have left the Nine Stars Pavilion to avoid being calculated by it.]
[However, although the Immortal Mansion Alliance wants to find and kill the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, during this year, they have not been able to find the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion and its Nine Stars. Despite destroying numerous Nine Stars Pavilion strongholds, it was all meaningless.]
[After all, if the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion does not die, the Weird One does not perish, and it doesn’t matter how many lackeys die.]
[However, these matters are beyond your control, and you can’t handle them either. The only thing you can do right now is to work hard to cultivate to become stronger.]
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred years passed. During this time, the Nine Stars Pavilion was suppressed, daring not to show its head. However, not many key figures of the Nine Stars Pavilion have been captured, causing the Immortal Mansion Alliance to be somewhat irritated. The Divine Calculator performed a calculation, sighed, found that Heavenly Secrets were in chaos, and a significant change was imminent; great disaster might arrive ahead of time.]
[This made the many powerful beings become extremely serious and desired to find the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion and the Weird One, regardless of the cost. Even the Divine Calculation Man wanted to borrow the destiny of other forces to use The Forbidden Skill of Heavenly Secret.]
[After a discussion, it was finally accepted by many forces, and the condition to use the Forbidden Skill of Heavenly Secret was gradually met by using destiny as fuel.]
[As the top powerhouses made significant movements, you also made a breakthrough on your side. With the successful help of the Immortal Mansion’s secret realm, you condensed the Supreme Tao Fruit, broke through the Supreme Realm bottleneck, and attained Tao Proving Supreme Tier.]
[At this moment, the terrible Heavenly Tribulation brewed, alarming the Old Monsters of The Immortal Palace and shocking other proud geniuses to come out of isolation and gaze at the terrible Heavenly Tribulation formed in the sky. Their emotions were mixed as they didn’t expect you to be the first to attain Enlightenment and achieve Tao Proving Supreme.]
[However, they remembered that you are the strongest among them. The proud geniuses that survived from the secret realm and attained Half-step Supreme tier were all impressed, thinking that this was a matter of course.]
[Next, you looked at the Heavenly Tribulation, laughed heartily, fearless, and clashed with the Heavenly Tribulation. You used the power of the Heavenly Tribulation to temper the Supreme Tao Fruit, making it more perfect. In the end, you successfully crossed the Heavenly Tribulation, becoming a powerful Supreme.]
[Although you just broke into the Supreme tier and your cultivation is at the early stage of Supreme, your physique is strong, and you have the Divine Eye and Talent. You feel that it is very easy to defeat ordinary Earth Supremes.]
[After you broke through to the Supreme Realm, the Old Monsters of The Immortal Palace were all relieved. The other geniuses also came to congratulate you with mixed emotions. You answered them one by one.]
[Then, you continued to close off and cultivate, wanting to solidify your cultivation and perfect your realm.]
[Soon, a year passed, and your realm finally stabilized. When you came out of seclusion again, an unexpected incident occurred; you sensed a terrifying aura of destruction.]

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Break through to the Supreme!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 885: Chapter 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Break through to the Supreme!_4
[This destructive aura makes your complexion drastically change. You look through the Breaking Origin Sky Eye and witness a horrifying scene. You discover the entire Upper Realm is vanishing, as if something is refining it.]
[Whether it’s the Upper Realm or the cultivators, they are all being refined. You can’t help but suspect that the Source of Darkness is unstable.]
[However, the unexpected happens. It’s not the Source of Darkness causing the turbulence, but someone refining the Ten Great Universes.]
[In your shock, whether it’s the Longevity Ku Family, or the Immortal Mansion, or even the strongest of other forces, they are all furious. They never expected someone to commit such a crazily monstrous act to refine the Ten Great Universes, and in the process, refine them as well.]
[Even though those at the Great Emperor Tier could seek survival in the Source of Darkness, no one willingly wants to do this. What they prefer to do is to kill the perpetrator thoroughly.]
[However, the Forbidden Skill of Heavenly Secrets activated by the Divine Calculation Man has begun, all the Emperors can’t make a move because they are the primer of fortune. Their reckless withdrawals would result in a backlash from the fortune, which will also lead to the failure of the Forbidden Skill of Heavenly Secrets.]
...
[All of this makes people suspect that the perpetrator must have chosen this opportunity to act. Of course, it might also be a coincidence.]
[At this moment, the Divine Calculation Man is also extremely serious and speeds up the Heavenly Secret Calculations. Finally, he spits out a mouthful of blood, angrily shouts out the names of the Heavenly Calculation’s Child and the Creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[It turns out that all of this is the ‘good work’ of the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion and Heavenly Calculation’s Child. Whether it’s cooperating with the strange or their present refining of the Ten Great Universes, everything is within their plot, and their plan is being carried out successfully step by step.]
[The creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion gained the Chaotic Body, stood as the eye of the array in the Big Universe, and the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, which is the first of the Ten Forbidden Lands, simultaneously let the Nine Stars appear in the Nine Great Forbidden Lands, using the Power of the Nine Stars, surrounding the Big Universe, and formed the shocking Great Array to refine the Ten Great Universes.]
[The purpose of the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion is to refine the Ten Great Universes to become an immortal and let his Chaotic Body perfect itself directly. By then, his fighting strength and potential will skyrocket to unimaginable levels.]
[This method is too ruthless. It calculates everyone and recklessly envisions wiping all people out.]
…
“Good guy, I made the right guess again. This creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion is truly the big boss, and his method is ruthless enough to want to directly refine the Ten Great Universes, become an immortal, and make his Chaotic Body reach the Great Perfection. If he succeeds, I wonder how terrifying he would become.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the Text Simulation, greatly surprised.
“But, what in the world does this Heavenly Calculation’s Child want, and what’s his purpose? To cooperate with such person as the creator of Nine Stars Pavilion, it’s like making a deal with a tiger. Can he, a quasi-emperor, truly escape the control of the Nine Stars Pavilion’s creator? Once the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion becomes immortal, he will surely be dealt with. And even before that, he might be killed.”
Soon after, Wang Ping recalls matters about Heavenly Calculation’s Child and mutters.
“Forget it, it doesn’t matter what he is thinking, what I need to do is very simple, to kill this group of people in advance.”
Very quickly, Wang Ping stopped thinking and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
Unless something unexpected happens, this simulation should end now.
Unless the Immortal Mansion Alliance can stop the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, which is undoubtedly an unlikely event.
With the schemes and tricks of the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, since he had made his move, he must be fully confident.
[The Immortal Mansion Alliance soon deployed. The Ancestor of the Immortal Mansion and the Ancestor of The Ku Family, these two quasi-Fairies took action together, leading many emperors to kill the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion. At the same time, other emperors also went to kill the Nine Stars in the Nine Great Universes, wanting to destroy the Great Array and stop it from refining the Ten Great Universes.]
[However, they ultimately failed, unable to stop the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion. In the end, the Ten Great Universes were refined by the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, you were also refined and thus fell.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends here….]
…..
The text simulation stops here. Wang Ping’s mind is filled with many understandings and memories, and his figure also appears at the location where he fell in the simulation.
“Sure enough, they couldn’t stop the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion. All I can say was that the creator of the Nine Stars Pavilion employed really strong methods.”
Wang Ping sighs, feeling slightly restless.
The Heavenly Tao has set so many Sons of Fortune, perhaps it is trying to save itself.
It’s a pity, the Sons of Fortune can’t grow quickly, and they can also fall.
I can only say that this world is too chaotic.
The strange and the Myriad Heavens Forces have ruined so many things, the plot is thoroughly destroyed.
While Wang Ping was sighing, his consciousness wavered, his vision changed, and he was back in the real world.
Then, the system voice also rang.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host must choose one from the following rewards:
①. Early Stage of Superme Realm Cultivation.
②. Light Profound Body.
③. Dark Profound Body.
④. A random quasi-Emperor Artifact.”
…..
“Huh, this time they have created a mandatory reward selection? I wonder what the Life Simulator is up to.”
Wang Ping looks subtly at the reward list and mutters a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through to the Supreme! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 886: Chapter 241: Refining the Upper Realm! Breaking Through to the Supreme! _5
Then, Wang Ping started to feel a bit conflicted.
He always felt that something was off about this situation, and he might have to choose cultivation this time, otherwise there could be trouble.
Perhaps the Life Simulator was trying to warn him.
However, if he chose cultivation, the cost of his Paid Simulation would increase to a headache-inducing amount.
“Forget it, I’ll trust my instincts. System, I choose ①. Supreme Realm Cultivation!”
After wrestling with his decision, Wang Ping finally made his choice.
...
“Ding, reward selection successful, issuing…”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, Wang Ping felt an extremely powerful force emerge within his body, transforming his physical body, Mana, and Divine Soul.
At the same time, he condensed a Supreme Tao Fruit, earning the Heavenly recognition.
“Is this the power of a Supreme? Compared to a Half-step Supreme, the increase in power is too great. It seems I underestimated myself.”
Wang Ping felt his own strength and compared it to the scenes of ordinary Earth Emperors fighting that he had seen before, his eyes flashing with brilliance.
He always felt that if he fought against an ordinary Earth Emperor, it would be even easier than he had expected before.
Of course, this was only for fighting against ordinary Earth Emperors. If he faced those Heavenly Chosen who were eligible to become Tao Proving Quasi-Emperors or even Emperors, it would still be very difficult to defeat them.
However, this difficulty in defeating them was based on the premise that he did not use his talents and relied solely on his own strength; otherwise, the situation would be different.
Just as Wang Ping was analyzing his own combat power, a strange beam of light suddenly descended on Taiyi Imperial Palace, directly slamming into the Great Array of the palace.
However, even with the defense of the Great Array, the strange beam of light still entered.
To be precise, the beam of light mysteriously penetrated through, shooting towards Wang Ping’s direction, and directly pierced through his body.
Even though Wang Ping was already at the Supreme Realm Cultivation, he failed to react and was directly pierced by the strange beam of light.
By the time Wang Ping reacted, he was covered in cold sweat and hurriedly checked his condition.
“Alpha, what was that thing just now? Why did it appear here and penetrate my body? Could it be some kind of curse?”
Wang Ping couldn’t find any problems, so he asked in his heart with an ugly expression.
“It’s not a curse, but a rare item for targeted assassination with precise location tracking. This kind of item is extremely rare. What you just experienced should be an item capable of assassinating cultivators below the Supreme Realm. Even beings surpassing the Emperor level would find it difficult to obtain one of these items in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. Obtaining this item has nothing to do with cultivation; it’s purely dependent on special games and luck.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“In other words, if your cultivation was below the Supreme tier just now, you would have already died. This assassination item has taken targeted killing to the extreme, allowing for the killing of enemies regardless of distance, and after killing the enemy, they cannot be resurrected. Unless, they have a resurrection item or ability of a higher rank than this item.”
“!!!”
Wang Ping fell silent after hearing Alpha’s words.
Damn, are there such items in the Myriad Heavens Paradise?
Targeted assassination, that’s outrageous.
Fortunately, this item is extremely rare; otherwise, Wang Ping would really be uneasy.
“Why are you so calm? I almost died just now.”
Wang Ping rubbed his brows and said somewhat speechlessly to Alpha.
“You won’t die. Although the talents you possess now cannot withstand the attack just now, as long as you consume enough World Source, I can still protect you.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“Um…”
Wang Ping was silent.
Well, consider it a costly way to avoid disaster.
Although he didn’t know how much World Source it would consume, it would definitely be an astronomical number. Just Wang Ping’s own World Source would probably be insufficient.
Now, he had only raised his cultivation to the Supreme Realm, avoiding the cost of exhausting the World Source, which was considered a big gain.
“But this also shows that my Life Simulator is even more special than I had imagined. What is its true nature?”
Wang Ping thought of the subtle changes in the Life Simulator reminding him of the danger, and couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow.
Although this kind of subtle change would be overlooked by careless people, Wang Ping had always been very cautious and would not overlook it. This was what allowed him to avoid bankruptcy.
“The true nature of the Life Simulator is probably unclear to me for the time being. Instead of thinking about this, it’s better to think about who would be so ruthless as to spend such a precious item to kill me.”
Wang Ping shook his head, his expression darkening.
Could it be Senior Wind Demon Supreme?
Didn’t he go bankrupt already? How could he have such a precious item.
Or was it that after the simulation started this time, Senior Wind Demon Supreme just learned that the Saint of Slaughter Paradise had been killed by me, and my situation was exposed to him?
In that case, Senior Wind Demon Supreme revealed the matter in the Second Generation Chat Group.
As a result, the seniors in the Second Generation Chat Group felt that my growth rate was too abnormal, so they were willing to spend a fortune to get this precious item and even more powerful Heavenly Secret Talismans to detect my position and launch this assassination.
Although it’s just speculation, Wang Ping felt that the truth was very likely to be this.
After all, Leng Yue Emperor from the first generation chat group was still in the Source of Darkness, unaware of his situation.
Only people in the Second Generation Chat Group, especially Wind Demon Supreme, had been targeting him all along.
“Senior Wind Demon Supreme, you forced my hand. I was originally planning to lay low until I reached Heaven Supreme before killing you, but now it seems I must kill you immediately.”
Wang Ping’s face darkened, filled with killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 242: The Pitiful Wind Demon Supreme! The Great Change of the Taiyi Imperial Palace Palace Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 887 - 242: The Pitiful Wind Demon Supreme! The Great Change of the Taiyi Imperial Palace Palace Master
"I hope that after killing this old bastard, I'll get a bunch of gold coins. Although I've killed him several times in the simulation with the help of others, I didn't get any of the loot because it was their power."
Wang Ping's eyes shone as he secretly thought, looking forward to the rewards after killing Wind Demon Supreme.
He had never gotten anything good from killing Supremes before; the only thing he had gotten was a golden light jade charm, which he still hasn't fully understood.
Perhaps, when his Breaking Origin Sky Eye reaches the Minor Domain level, he could see through it and unlock the restrictions on it.
"Speaking of which, although I can borrow the Emperor's artifact from Taiyi Imperial Palace to deal with Wind Demon Supreme, it's still a bit troublesome to prevent him from self-destructing."
Wang Ping hesitated for a moment and muttered.
These old bastards, when driven into a corner, would self-destruct at any moment, which greatly reduced his gains, something he could not tolerate.
It seemed that he still needed help from his group members.
With that thought, Wang Ping wasted no time in finding the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace.
The Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace found himself increasingly unable to see through Wang Ping and was quite surprised.
However, he didn't ask further and instead curiously asked what Wang Ping wanted from him.
"Palace Master, I would like to borrow the Emperor's artifact from Taiyi Imperial Palace to kill a Heaven Supreme. He is my great enemy, and I can't rest easy unless he's dead."
Wang Ping saluted with his hands, speaking earnestly.
"Borrow the Emperor's artifact? Since it's you, you naturally have the authority to use the Emperor's artifact of my Taiyi Imperial Palace. You don't need to say 'borrow,' that's what outsiders say."
The Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was taken aback for a moment before laughing and speaking.
This made Wang Ping laugh as well.
It could be said that the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace had a high level of eloquence, which made people feel comfortable and gave them a sense of belonging.
Although Wang Ping knew that the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was so generous and willing to let him, a newcomer, use the Emperor's artifact because of his talent and strength, and because the Emperor's artifact had restrictions so it was impossible for him to take it away.
However, everyone understood these things, and Wang Ping was still grateful for the Palace Master's approach and had a good impression of him.
After casually selecting an Emperor's artifact, Wang Ping left Taiyi Imperial Palace directly and headed for Thunder Spirit Ancient Star through the Taiyi Imperial Palace's Delivery Array.
On the way to Thunder Spirit Ancient Star, Wang Ping also spoke up in the group chat.
Wang Ping (66) @Liu Mei (15): "I'm planning to kill a Heaven Supreme. Those who have time can come help. Liu Mei, your ability is essential; if possible, please come."
Liu Mei (15): "No problem, I can come."
Qin Tian (77): "Wow, Brother Wang is going to take down a Heaven Supreme. I, a non-rules-based abilities player, can't catch up."
Wang Shuqi (74): "I feel the same."
Zhang Yueying (86): "Brother Wang, I also have time. Do you need me to go?"
Wang Ping (66): "Your presence would be best. I mainly don't want him to have a chance to self-destruct, so we need charming and strong control abilities. As for how to kill him, we'll need external forces, as I'm not a match for a Heaven Supreme yet."
Chen Si (83): "I can go too, QAQ."
Chen Kang (67): "And me, hehe. Having us siblings there will surely make it easier to kill."
Wang Ping (66): "Alright, you guys come later. Wait for me to arrive at the destination."
After saying this, Wang Ping temporarily closed the chat group.
The distance between the Immortal Continent and Thunder Spirit Ancient Star was quite far, and even with the help of the Taiyi Imperial Palace's Delivery Array, it would take a day or two.
"The chat group nowadays has developed quite well, but unfortunately, none of the newcomers who joined later have rules-based abilities that can help me."
Wang Ping shook his head slightly during the transfer.
Most of the newcomers had ordinary talents, and they could only rely on their own efforts, cultivation, participating in tasks, earning group points, and gathering enough group points to exchange for the Golden finger.
Unfortunately, some people were just unlucky and still got a useless Golden finger after repeatedly drawing.
It made Cai Yonglong feel even more afraid of his reckless choice to exchange for the Golden finger in the past.
It could only be said that those who survived in the chat group got good Golden fingers, causing the group members to misjudge the probability of getting a good Golden finger.
This was a normal occurrence.
Group members who survived would have good luck, and their Golden fingers would naturally not be too bad - this was survivorship bias.
As for the newcomers who survived later, the support from the old group members played a significant role, allowing some originally impossible-to-survive newcomers to survive.
The Novice Gift Package and various tech items that appeared one after another made newcomers delighted, and the risk of instant death was reduced a lot.
They could survive as long as they didn't cross into extreme environments or terrifying worlds.
However, this led to varying qualities among newcomers.
"Myriad Heavens Paradise..."
Wang Ping thought of the existence of Myriad Heavens Paradise again.
Both in the real world and in the simulation, Wang Ping had fallen victim to items from Myriad Heavens Paradise, making him increasingly curious about this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 888: Chapter 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_2
These magical items were now no less remarkable than his innate talents, perhaps even surpassing them.
Especially the fixed point sniper tool he encountered before, which was horrifyingly powerful. It disregarded distance and defenses; as long as your cultivation was below Supreme Realm, you were doomed to die. Even if a Great Emperor or even a quasi-Fairy was protecting you, you still had to die, a total death at that.
In other words, once this tool was applied, as long as the conditions were met, unless someone like Alpha was behind you, it would be truly lethal.
This type of tool was extremely dangerous.
“Although Alpha has mentioned that in Myriad Heavens Paradise, intelligence is more vital than strength and the ability to analyze intelligence is of paramount importance, the Life Simulator can give me a massive intelligence advantage, but I still needed to slow down. I must act judiciously and not rush,”
Wang Ping stabilized his emotions and began to meditate.
...
After an unknown amount of time, Wang Ping felt the vibrations of time and space, and then he was ejected from the time-space passage, appearing in the starry sky outside the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star.
Upon arriving here, Wang Ping directly contacted Liu Mei and others, granting permissions for everyone to teleport over.
Soon, Liu Mei and the others who had long been waiting, chose to teleport and beams of white light appeared around Wang Ping.
The cultivation of everyone was now above the Saint tier, they didn’t need Wang Ping’s protection in the starry sky anymore.
It could be said that the growth of these old group members was quite impressive.
Of course, among this, one couldn’t help but mention the remarkable contribution of Lin Yuanyuan, draining other cultivators, pouring in resources, group points’ enhancement, compensating defects; she had gotten more and more adept at completing this process.
“Yue Ying, first give me some buffs, then we’ll go hunt down that old thing for gold coins.”
Wang Ping looked at everyone, did not bother with pleasantries, and began giving instructions directly.
“I understand.”
Zhang Yueying nodded, and then used her Golden Finger ability, which continuously boosted Wang Ping’s combat power.
“Let’s go.”
Then, Wang Ping directly led everyone to the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star.
Because Wang Ping was extremely cautious, he did not alert the Wind Demon Supreme in the forbidden land, nor did he alert the Thunderflame Supreme on the Thunder Spirit Ancient Star.
As a result, when Wang Ping had already penetrated deep into the Thunder Spirit Forbidden Area and found the Wind Demon Supreme, the Wind Demon Supreme finally woke up in shock. He revealed a stunned expression, as he did not expect someone to get so close to him before he noticed.
Right when the Wind Demon Supreme was stunned, Wang Ping immediately made his move without hesitation, launching a dreadful attack at the Wind Demon Supreme.
This attack changed the Wind Demon Supreme’s complexion as he sensed the terror of the time-space divine skill exhibited by you.
This was an assault that was absolutely threatening to a regular Earth Supreme, and even enough to defeat him.
If it was him at his peak, he could have easily dealt with such an attack as he could shatter it with a wave of his hand.
However, his current self was in a self-titled state. His lifespan was running low, and his condition was extremely poor. Even a cultivator in the peak Earth Emperor stage could fight him, he naturally couldn’t ignore this attack.
The Wind Demon Supreme immediately shouted angrily and stepped out of his divine source. The Supreme Tao Fruit emerged. He used the terrifying Storm Divine Skill to block your attack and destroyed the turbulent space-time.
“You guys are from the Third Generation Chat Group, right? I can sense a similar aura from you,” the Wind Demon Supreme coldly looked at Wang Ping and the others, and spoke in a deep voice.
“So what if we are? We came here today to invite you to your death,” Wang Ping softly retorted, squinting his eyes.
He was not surprised that the Wind Demon Supreme could see their identities.
But judging from the Wind Demon Supreme’s reaction, it seemed he did not recognize his true identity.
Apparently, the Wind Demon Supreme has not obtained higher grade items like the Heavenly Secret Talisman.
In other words, the big guys in the Second Generation Chat Group didn’t give him such things; they simply used a tool to kill him.
If that’s the case, perhaps Wang Ping should be grateful.
This proved that he hadn’t exposed his current identity or his cultivation level, so he could continue to stay in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Otherwise, staying in the Taiyi Imperial Palace could be dangerous.
“Youngster, you’re way too arrogant!”
The Wind Demon Supreme huffed and immediately released the pressure of a Heaven Supreme, attacking Wang Ping.
While Wang Ping had just demonstrated combat strength enough to kill an early-stage Earth Emperor, even though his energy levels were now poor, he could still fight with a peak Earth Emperor. Killing Wang Ping and others would not be difficult.
Of course, the Wind Demon Supreme wasn’t careless.
After all, they were all from the same chat group and knew about the existence of the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Everyone’s cultivation was above the Saint level, and Wang Ping had even reached the Supreme tier.
If Wang Ping and others had also been to Myriad Heavens Paradise and obtained various tools there, he had to be on guard.
Therefore, in this battle, he absolutely could not carelessly use his trump cards. He needed to keep his moves in reserve to defend against strange tools and abilities.
“You’re quite cautious. However, your vigilance is in vain.”
The light flickered in Wang Ping’s Broken Origin Heaven Pupil. He easily saw that the Wind Demon Supreme was conserving his strength while making a move, and he couldn’t help but smirk.
The Wind Demon Supreme’s combat experience was indeed amazing, but no matter how amazing his combat experience was, his strength was still a bit weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: Chapter 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_3
Even if Wang Ping were to fight the Wind Demon Supreme on his own, he was fully confident in wearing him down, let alone with Wang Ping’s group members helping him now, and even having the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Emperor’s artifact on hand.
“Attack!”
As Wang Ping easily blocked the Wind Demon Supreme’s strike, he issued the order to Chen Si and Chen Kang.
In an instant, Chen Si used his ability, directly applying the Weakness debuff to Wind Demon Supreme.
In a flash, Wind Demon Supreme’s combat power plummeted to a quarter.
This made the Wind Demon Supreme’s face change drastically, and a sense of crisis surged crazily.
...
An ability that directly weakened three-quarters of his Supreme combat power was extremely disgusting, even among the lower layers of Myriad Heavens Paradise.
However, it didn’t end there. Wind Demon Supreme’s expression froze once more.
That’s because he found that his body couldn’t move and seemed to be forcibly immobilized.
This made the Wind Demon Supreme want to curse, and his mental state completely broke down.
In a decisive moment, Wind Demon Supreme planned to self-destruct, hoping to keep his dignity and take Wang Ping and the others down with him as a last resort.
However, just as he was preparing to self-destruct, Liu Mei increased her charm skill to the maximum.
Source: , updated on Ɲ0νǤ0.сο
In an instant, Wind Demon Supreme was momentarily charmed.
Although Liu Mei could only charm for a very short time, that was enough.
Wang Ping was already prepared and directly sacrificed the Emperor’s artifact, unleashing a terrifying blow.
Now Wang Ping had reached the Supreme tier, with his terrifying combat power, the power he could unleash through the Emperor’s artifact was no longer limited to killing the Superme-level cultivators, as it was when the Tao Palace’s Grand Elder used it.
As a result, with the terrifying power of the Emperor’s artifact, Wind Demon Supreme was ruthlessly suppressed and killed.
As Wind Demon Supreme was mercilessly killed by a series of continuous attacks, without even time to react, his internal world collapsed, and countless things burst out.
When a Supreme normally dies and sits, their internal world often forms a secret realm.
The place where they die also turns into a cave with many blessings.
However, if the Supreme falls, his small world will collapse, and the things inside will either be swept away by spatial turbulence or destroyed.
Wang Ping naturally wouldn’t let this happen; he captured everything with his Time-Space Divine Skill and placed it in his storage world.
“To think that Wind Demon Supreme would die so easily, I’m not even used to it.”
Only after Wang Ping had taken all the items did he lament.
Originally, Wang Ping thought that Wind Demon Supreme would put up some resistance, but it seemed that he had overestimated him.
It seemed that the big shot from the Second Generation Chat Group only gave him the targeted assassination tool.
“Uh….”
Hearing Wang Ping’s lament, Chen Kang couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
Wang Ping was really becoming more and more pretentious.
Even after killing a Heaven Supreme, he still complained about how easy it was. Wind Demon Supreme would surely die with Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death.
“By the way, Mr. Wang, what’s the deal with the Third Generation Chat Group? And why do some people have to call us juniors?”
At this time, Chen Kang seemed to think of something and asked curiously.
“About that… ”
Wang Ping looked at Chen Kang and felt that there was less and less need to hide this secret; it wouldn’t be possible to hide it for much longer, and he didn’t know whether to reveal it or not.
However, Alpha didn’t want him to speak.
“Just say it. There’s no need to hide it any longer.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
In Alpha’s view, Wang Ping was on the same wavelength as her, and the growth of the other group members was good, they were quite respectful to Wang Ping and relied heavily on the chat group.
Now, the chat group was also very good to the group members.
Under such circumstances, the possibility of betrayal was relatively small, and there was indeed no need to hide it. Explaining everything clearly might be better.
When he heard that Alpha had chosen to let him reveal the secret, Wang Ping was a bit surprised.
However, Wang Ping didn’t intend to speak out directly. Instead, he said to Chen Kang and the others, “Let’s talk about this matter after you guys return. This place is a forbidden area and quite dangerous.”
window.toString()=”okay.”
Seeing that Wang Ping was no longer hiding the secret, Chen Kang and the others’ eyes brightened up.
After that, they chose to return to their original world one after another.
As for Wang Ping, he waited for Wind Demon Supreme to resurrect in a remnant soul form and killed him thoroughly before preparing to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace first.
After all, only by returning to Taiyi Imperial Palace would he be safer. Wang Ping didn’t feel secure wandering around alone.
Although he could go to other worlds, he still preferred to stay in places where strong people gathered.
However, Wang Ping didn’t have the stupid idea of relying solely on his own way of returning.
Since Cai Yonglong was in Taiyi Imperial Palace, he acted as a transport point for the chat group anyway. Wang Ping planned to spend Group Points to return directly, as that would be more convenient and safe.
After Wang Ping left, the cultivators on Thunder Spirit Ancient Star were still in shock.
Even the Thunderflame Supreme of Thunderflame Valley was shocked by the events that had just transpired and had difficulty calming down.
In the Last Dharma Age, the great battle between the Supremes, and even the emergence of an Emperor’s artifact, was astonishing.
However, the Emperor’s artifact just now seemed to belong to Taiyi Imperial Palace, didn’t it?
That means Wang Ping was a big shot from Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“It’s a pity that I can’t go out and invite him to my Thunderflame Valley. If I could establish a good relationship with him, it would bring extraordinary benefits to Thunderflame Valley.”

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Chapter 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_4
Thunderflame Supreme felt somewhat regretful.
Of course, he was well aware that someone who could control the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Emperor’s artifact was unlikely to pay attention to his invitation.
Although they were both Supremes, there was a huge difference in their status and positions.
….
After Wang Ping returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, he did not immediately return the Emperor’s artifact but instead asked the Life Simulator system in his heart.
“System, how much divine source do I need for my next paid simulation?”
...
“Ding, detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the early stage of Supreme, and the required consumption for paid simulation is 5 million jin of extreme-tier divine source or five Supreme Artifacts.”
The system’s voice sounded.
This answer made Wang Ping’s mouth twitch slightly.
Good heavens, 5 million jin of extreme-tier divine source or five Supreme Artifacts, this is too outrageous.
You must know that counting the divine source Wang Ping obtained from killing Wind Demon Supreme, he only had about 1.5 million jin of extreme-tier divine source.
It was clear that although Wind Demon Supreme had more extreme-tier divine source than that left by Black Abyss Demon Lord, it wasn’t much more.
Such a small amount of divine source wasn’t enough for Wang Ping to simulate once.
As for the five Supreme Artifacts, that was also difficult.
“Although I killed Fire Supreme, I did not receive his Supreme Artifact. Supreme Artifacts are not easily diminished. As for Wind Demon Supreme, although I killed him with the Emperor’s artifact and suppressed his Supreme Artifact, that’s only one. As for my Supreme Artifacts, I have two, but I obviously can’t use my life-bound Supreme Device for simulation. Even if I used it, the quantity still wouldn’t be enough.”
Wang Ping was somewhat speechless.
System, couldn’t you be more specific?
Not all Supreme Artifacts are the same.
Ordinary Supremes’ Supreme Artifacts have quite a difference in value compared to those of Black Abyss Demon Lord and Wind Demon Supreme.
“It seems I have to trouble the palace master again.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
“But since I have joined Taiyi Imperial Palace and am the future first child of the Emperor, I am the hope for the ascension of the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s religion, asking for some resources shouldn’t be too much.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and thought silently.
Although the resources required were not a small amount, but a huge sum, in this Last Dharma Age, the palace master guarding the Taiyi Imperial Palace might not necessarily be able to give it to him.
The authority of the Last Dharma Age’s palace master and the Quasi-Emperor palace master who took over the position after the Golden Age were definitely different.
Anyway, he must at least try. If possible, he didn’t want to go out and search for resources on his own again.
“It seems wrong, I think I can go to the Dark Time Imperial Clan. With my situation, going to the Dark Time Imperial Clan and getting a lot of resources from them seems easy. After all, in the simulation, they claimed to be my followers.”
“The only thing is Dark Time Emperor’s final words made me quite concerned, I don’t know if there will be any changes in reality. Moreover, I still lack a broken map.”
Wang Ping thought of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, his eyes brightened a bit, but then he thought of the troublesome part and frowned again.
Dark Time Emperor should not harm him.
Even if he really wanted to harm him, Wang Ping could just let Alpha take him to escape, so there was no need to worry about anything.
Wang Ping’s headache was the matter of the broken map.
Although in the simulation, he could easily get the broken map from a Great Saint Ranking genius right after the beginning of the Golden Age, but now in reality, the possibility of obtaining that piece in the Last Dharma Age was not high.
“Still need to do paid simulation, by refreshing the rewards through paid simulation, I hope I can brush it out. Otherwise, it will be troublesome. If possible, I really don’t want to be a freeloader again.”
Wang Ping smiled bitterly.
He could still remember his days as a freeloader in Chi Village clearly.
At that time, he was quite awkward asking for spiritual stones.
Now, he has arrived at the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and as soon as he joins, he has to ask for resources again, which is truly embarrassing.
The key point is that if he only asked for a small amount it wouldn”urls”:[]}-

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: Chapter 242: Poor Wind Demon Supreme! The Major Change in Expression of the Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace_5
“Divine source? With your talent, you’re destined to become the first Emperor’s son of my Taiyi Imperial Palace, and we will naturally provide you with plenty of divine sources regularly. By the way, how much divine source do you want this time?”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace laughed and spoke.
“If possible, could I have ten million pounds of extreme-tier divine source… is that okay?”
Wang Ping coughed lightly, somewhat embarrassed.
“???”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace fell silent.
...
He looked at Wang Ping with a subtle expression and asked tentatively: “Sorry, I didn’t hear clearly just now, how much did you say?”
“I said, ten million pounds of extreme-tier divine source…”
Wang Ping said, somewhat embarrassed.
“What do you need so much divine source for?”
The expression of the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace started to twitch, feeling that he had spoken too confidently before.
It’s motherf*cking ten million pounds of extreme-tier divine source, that’s the equivalent of the net worth of ten Heaven Supremes.
Wang Ping, a cultivator at the Great Saint eighth layer, demanding so much extreme-tier divine source is really too much.
This really made the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace uncomfortable, somewhat hesitant.
After all, although he was chosen to be the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace in the Last Dharma Age, his authority wasn’t really enough for him to mobilize so many resources.
Moreover, it didn’t comply with the rules.
Even the first Emperor’s son should only receive mid-to-high grade divine sources on a regular basis, not extreme-tier ones, and the amount shouldn’t be this huge.
After all, this is an amount that can only be accumulated by ten Heaven Supremes.
“Ten million pounds of extreme-tier divine source really is too much, I am asking for too much.”
Wang Ping saw the palace master’s reaction and was a little helpless.
“Palace Master, three million five hundred thousand pounds of extreme-tier divine source, is that okay?”
Wang Ping pondered a bit, then spoke again.
“Three million five hundred thousand pounds of extreme-tier divine source…”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace still hesitated, although the amount was much less than before, it was still too large.
“I need to know what you need so much extreme-tier divine source for; with your cultivation, you shouldn’t need to use extreme-tier divine source, let alone so much.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace couldn’t help but ask further.
“Actually, besides my Time-Space Body, I have two other Special Constitutions. One is my Breaking Origin Sky Eye, and the other is my Devouring Source Body, which can raise my cultivation quickly by absorbing divine source. In addition, my cultivation has reached the Supreme tier.”
Wang Ping laughed and displayed his Broken Origin Sky Eye and his true cultivation.
Since the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was having a hard time, Wang Ping could only expose his cards and increase the stakes.
If the palace master was still unwilling to give, Wang Ping would have to figure out a way to gather five million pounds of extreme-tier divine source from the outer world.
Although doing it themselves would be a bit difficult, time-consuming, and accompanied by some risks, it’s a situation without any other option.
“Breaking Origin Sky Eye… Devouring Source Body… Supreme Cultivation!?”
As Wang Ping revealed his cards, coupled with a casual deception, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace could no longer remain calm, and his eyes widened in disbelief.
Perfect Space-Time Tao Body, Breaking Origin Sky Eye, and that unheard-of Devouring Source Body that can swallow divine source to enhance cultivation, this talent is just too incredible.
He had never heard of such talent before, and it could be said to be unprecedented.
Without a doubt, Wang Ping was far more of a monster than he had imagined.
Moreover, what shocked the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace even more was that Wang Ping had managed to reach the Supreme tier quietly.
Keep in mind that this is the Last Dharma Age.
In the Last Dharma Age, it’s not just proving the Tao to become Supreme, but even breaking through to the Saintly Human Tier is very difficult.
Becoming a Supreme in the Last Dharma Age is a truly heaven-defying feat, likewise never before seen.
It could be said that Wang Ping had started a new precedent.
“Did you break through to the Supreme tier before joining Taiyi Imperial Palace?”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace asked doubtfully.
“No, I broke through within the palace. It’s just that I used some means to not make any noise.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
“I see.”
The palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace looked deeply at Wang Ping.
He had felt that Wang Ping had many secrets all along.
Now, he felt even more that he had never seen through Wang Ping in the slightest, and the secrets he had were enough to scare a Supreme like him to death.
Moreover, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace suspected that Wang Ping was still hiding even more secrets.
Someone like him voluntarily pledging allegiance to his Taiyi Imperial Palace was truly a stroke of luck for the palace.
As for doubting whether Wang Ping had ulterior motives or was a spy planted by other forces, that was absolutely impossible.
Who would send such a monstrous genius as a spy? That would be too foolish.
If their Taiyi Imperial Palace had this kind of peerless prodigy, they would devote everything to nurturing them, and they could never bear to let them be a spy.
Not to mention, although Taiyi Imperial Palace is powerful, there are still several forces stronger than them; Taiyi Imperial Palace isn’t qualified enough for those forces to send such a genius as a spy.
Apart from that, Wang Ping revealing his secrets so openly doesn’t seem like something a spy would do.
Alright, you say it’s the reverse strategy, that this would make it easier to gain trust?
Fine, even if Wang Ping is really a spy, he’ll accept it, and he believes that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would also begrudgingly accept it.
Such an insane genius, who cares if he’s a spy or not? They’ll nurture him first and find ways to make him feel attached to Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“Hahaha, ten million pounds of extreme-tier divine source seems to be a bit too little, let me give you more, is twenty million pounds of extreme-tier divine source enough? If it’s not enough, just come to me again, I’ll do my best to fulfill your demands.”
After recovering, the palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace laughed heartily, speaking with great enthusiasm.

chapters.title: Chapter 892: 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea!
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Chapter 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea!
Witnessing such generosity from the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace, Wang Ping momentarily felt as if he had asked too little.
Of course, Wang Ping quickly discarded these nonsensical thoughts from his mind.
One should not be too greedy, as it could easily cause trouble.
“Then I will accept twenty million units of extreme-tier divine source. I will remember everything the Imperial Palace bestows upon me. If I could ever achieve immortality, I will surely take Taiyi Imperial Palace with me in the ascension.”
Wang Ping bowed slightly, speaking with a serious expression.
“Ha ha, ascending with the teaching, it is a dream of Taiyi Imperial Palace. We old folks have been unable to achieve this. You have the greatest potential to do so. You must cultivate diligently and not waste your extraordinary talent.”
...
The Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace spoke contentedly.
“Hmm.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Next, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace did not waste time. He directly used his authority to transfer twenty million units of extreme-tier divine source to Wang Ping.
Having received twenty million units of extreme-tier divine source, Wang Ping expressed his gratitude once again and returned to his own peak, planning to continue with the paid simulation.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke inwardly.
Twenty million units of extreme-tier divine source could allow him to simulate four times. He hoped that within these four simulations, he would refresh the ‘Broken Map’ reward.
Then, hopefully, he could find a direct path to becoming a Heavenly Supreme peak or even a Quasi-Emperor.
If that happened, Wang Ping would be able to directly choose Cultivation in the fourth simulation and become a powerful Heavenly Supreme or Quasi-Emperor.
This would be the best way to maximise resource utilisation.
“Ding, the consumption of five million units of extreme-tier divine source, the Life Simulator is starting. Talent Refreshing… ”
The system voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations host on refreshing the Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade; Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.”
