Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade: Upon activating this talent, each of the host’s attacks will result in a critical strike, with the minimum damage being four hundred percent and maximum being one thousand percent. PS: This talent is similar to the Purple Talent: Endless Blade, the higher the level of battle, the lower the probability of triggering high multiple critical damage. Moreover, once you possess Burst Blade, the Purple Talent: Endless Blade will no longer trigger, and the two will not overlap.
Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique: …
“Well, well, it actually refreshed another Seven-Color Talent, and this talent is an upgraded version of the Purple Talent: Infinite Blade. Although compared to the Time-Space Body and Broken Origin Heaven Pupil, this Seven-Color Talent is inferior, it’s still strong enough.”
Wang Ping looked at the description of the Seven-Color Talent Burst Blade, grinning from ear to ear, pleased with himself.
“System, I choose the Seven-Color Talent·Burst Blade.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his choice.
“Ding, Talent selection successful. Life simulation begins….”
The system voice sounded again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness blurred as he entered the immersive simulation.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text surfaced.
[On the first day, you did not choose to self-seal but remembered the matter of the Innate Saint. As of now, you have broken through to the Supreme tier and can restart the strategy of getting stronger through accepting disciples.]
[Although at the Supreme tier, cultivation still involves Enlightenment. At the Supreme tier, what you are understanding is the True Spirit of Heavenly Tao. If you can comprehend two percent of the Heavenly Tao’s true spirit at the Peak of Superme, you will be able to break through to the Earth Emperor Tier. If you understand three percent of the Heavenly Tao’s true spirit at the peak of the Earth Emperor, you can then break through to the Heavenly Supreme-tier.]
[For this reason, you do not intend to directly surge to the Earth Emperor Tier but plan to accumulate to the Peak of Superme before discussing further. As for Enlightenment, that will have to wait until the Golden Age. This is not the time for Enlightenment.]
[You have a clear understanding of many things in your heart and have once again thought about Lin Yan and the Innate Saint. These two are the most likely geniuses of the Last Dharma Age who can take you in as a disciple and increase your cultivation.]
[As for casting a wide net, you still plan to do it, after all, it’s also an income. Even though, at the Supreme tier, you feel that ordinary geniuses can no longer meet your requirements, the small increase in cultivation is too shabby.]
[However, even a mosquito is still meat, you can’t waste it. As such, you once again approached the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace for the authority to use Emperor’s artifact. This time, you didn’t ask for one artifact, but two.]
[If it weren’t for the fact that you could only control two Emperor’s artifacts at the same time, you would have wanted to borrow a third one. You had no choice but to gear up and fight head-on with the Bone Emperor for the Innate Saint, so it’s never too much to be prepared.]
[As for your actions, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace truly did not understand it. After all, you had just returned with the Emperor’s artifact and asked him for resources. You did not cultivate seriously or self-sealed, but instead wanted to go out and wander around, not knowing what to do.]
[However, since the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace had decided to trust you, he naturally wouldn’t doubt you. He generously gave you the right to use two Emperor’s artifacts, advising you to be careful and come back early to self-seal.]
[Simultaneously, the Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace felt uneasy, so he gave you a Jade Talisman as well. As long as you burn this Jade Talisman, you can contact him directly. If Wang Ping encounters danger, he can ask a self-titled Quasi-Emperor Ancestor to rescue.]

chapters.title: Chapter 893: 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Chapter 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _2
[Although there are quasi-emperors in the Taiyi Imperial Palace who have not self-titled themselves or cannot self-title themselves again, they are all elusive divine dragons, not knowing where they have gone. Naturally, it is safest to invite the self-titled ancestors first. Although this consumes the lifespan of the quasi-emperor ancestors, it is worth it for your safety.]
[Next, you leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace again. However, this time, you choose to bring Cai Yonglong along and contact Lin Yuanyuan, making full preparations.]
[After that, you choose to come to the Elemental Ancient Star first. However, you don’t wait for the Great Saint Secret Realm to open before finding Lin Yan; instead, you scan the Elemental Ancient Star directly with your divine sense in an attempt to find him directly.]
[Finally, bypassing the Elemental Forbidden Land, you find Lin Yan successfully. At this moment, Lin Yan is much younger and more naïve than the one in your memory, with a cultivation only at the Quasi-Immortal Tier.]
[To this, you are no exception, as the timing is not right, almost a hundred years earlier. In the Last Dharma Age, Lin Yan could rise from Quasi-Immortal to True Lord Tier in just about a hundred years, which is already very strong. After all, he is a loose cultivator, not a young disciple from a major power. It can only be said that he is a man of great fortune.]
[Next, you don’t hesitate to reveal your identity and cultivation, referring to yourself as the main character, stating that Lin Yan’s roots are extraordinary and that it’s a pity for him to continue as a loose cultivator. You want to take Lin Yan as a disciple. You failed to do so in the past, but now that you have become a Supreme, you want to see if there will be any change.]
...
[This time, when you ask Lin Yan to become your disciple, he is very delighted and does not refuse. This surprises you, as you didn’t expect it to be so simple to take Lin Yan as a disciple.]
[This makes you speculate that you have now reached the Supreme tier, which is equivalent to the legendary strongman, while Lin Yan is just a Quasi-Immortal, weaker than in previous simulations and perhaps not having experienced any setbacks, hence the easy acceptance of becoming an apprentice.]
[Of course, there’s another possibility, which is that Lin Yan has not yet acquired the Devouring Soul Pearl. Since he doesn’t have the Devouring Soul Pearl, Lin Yan is just an ordinary loose cultivator. Suddenly being accepted as a disciple by a Supreme, he naturally feels lucky, and not accepting would be a fool’s behavior.]
[You don’t know which behavior Lin Yan is exhibiting, and you don’t ask him if he has obtained the Devouring Soul Pearl. Instead, you simply instruct him to go through the Inviting Teaching Ceremony.]
[As Lin Yan sincerely becomes an apprentice, you successfully accept him as a disciple, activating the effect of the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger. Your cultivation breaks through, reaching the Mid-Superme Realm.]
[Although you only advanced by one small realm, you are still quite satisfied and do not feel disappointed.]
[Next, you do not immediately take Lin Yan to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Instead, you impart some cultivation skills and divine arts to him, as well as provide some cultivation resources before directly leaving.]
[This perplexes Lin Yan, as he has no idea what your intentions are and why you would abandon him after accepting him as a disciple. However, he soon thinks of a reason, believing that you want him to gain experience so that he can grow stronger faster, not wanting him to be a flower in a greenhouse.]
[While Lin Yan is imagining, you have already traveled to the Profound Small Universe. This time, you rely on yourself to traverse the universe, feeling quite peculiar.]
[After arriving at the Profound Small Universe, you begin preaching, continuing your previous practice of casting a wide net and accumulating small gains. However, you don’t have too high expectations. After all, you have preached in the Profound Small Universe quite a few times before, and unless you encounter a great talent during the preaching process, the gains cannot be too big.]
[Having settled the preaching matters, you proceed to the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star where the Innate Saint resides, planning to camp there directly and not give the Bone Emperor a chance to snatch anyone.]
[After all, the Bone Emperor is, after all, a quasi-emperor, and if possible, you do not want to confront him. Even if you hold two Emperor’s artifacts, you still don’t have the confidence to fight the Bone Emperor.]
[The quasi-emperor is much stronger than the Supreme, and the Bone Emperor is not an ordinary quasi-emperor who has just entered the realm. He is not someone your Supreme can rival.]
[Although in previous simulations, you speculated that the Chaotic Body’s strangeness could grind the quasi-emperor to death with numerous lives, that was still just your personal speculation.]
[In reality, a quasi-emperor is not someone whose strangeness can be challenged just by entering the Supreme realm, even if they have a Chaotic Body. To defeat a quasi-emperor at a higher level and kill them, they would need to reach the Heavenly Supreme Peak level with their Chaotic Body; otherwise, fighting a quasi-emperor is impossible.]
[After all, most of those who can become quasi-emperors have extraordinary talents. They are likely to have a special constitution as well, although not as good as the Chaotic Body, it is still strong enough. At the same time, these quasi-emperors usually develop their constitutions to the Minor Domain, or even a few to the Great Completion Domain.]
[For example, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor has not only reached the Quasi-Emperor Great Completion Tier, but he has also developed his constitution to the Great Perfection Tier. As such, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor is considered a prominent figure among quasi-emperors, with very few contenders, and has the qualifications to fight against ordinary emperors who lack a special constitution and have luckily achieved Dao.]

chapters.title: Chapter 894: 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: Chapter 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _3
[Because of this, even if you hold two quasi-emperor artifacts, you do not want to fight against the Bone Emperor. The risk factor of fighting him is still too high.]
[Of course, you are not afraid of him. After all, you have various talent skills to aid you. Once the high-multiple critical strike damage effect of Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade is triggered or the effect of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, it is not impossible to kill the Bone Emperor.]
[During your contemplation, you bring Cai Yonglong to the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star and find the family where the Innate Saint is located, and settle into it.]
[The family where the Innate Saint is located is very excited about your arrival. After all, as a Supreme, it is their honor and great benefit to have you stay in their family.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a hundred years has passed. During these hundred years, your cultivation has improved due to preaching, reaching the bottleneck of the Superme Middle-stage, only one step away from entering the Late Stage Superme Realm.]
[This is due to preaching to a genius, which has skyrocketed your cultivation progress. Otherwise, it is unknown how long it would take to make such progress with the cultivation amplification provided by those ordinary geniuses.]
...
[However, the genius disciple you have never met is ultimately a bit inferior to Lin Yan, who can top the Three Saints List and cannot help you break through the small bottleneck and raise your cultivation to the Late Stage Superme Realm.]
[Of course, you don’t feel disappointed. After all, there is plenty of time to take it slow.]
[At the same time, during these nearly a hundred years, you have not been idle. In addition to cultivation, you occasionally study the golden light jade charm and an item obtained from the hands of the Wind Demon Supreme who you had killed.]
[As for the Golden Light Jade Talisman, even at the Supreme Realm, you still cannot see through it. However, this is quite normal. After all, in the last simulation, you showed this item to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. This is something even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor cannot see through.]
[Although the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can forcibly break the restrictions, he judges that forcibly breaking it will cause the internal contents to be completely destroyed. Therefore, the only way to unlock the restrictions is to find the key or wait for your Breaking Origin Sky Eye to develop to the Minor Domain or even the Great Completion Domain level, otherwise, it will be a useless item.]
[As for the items you obtained from the Wind Demon Supreme, some are props from the Myriad Heavens Paradise, which once took advantage of you. However, now these items are too low-level for you, completely useless, and can only be used as toys.]
[However, among the things that the Wind Demon Supreme exploded, there are also good things, one of which particularly interests you. Over the years, you have been studying this item as well.]
[It is a jade stone with a strange texture and extremely magical. However, you cannot sense any energy fluctuations or Tao Rhyme on it. You speculate that this item is not from the Upper Realm but from the Myriad Heavens Paradise or other worlds.]
[Unfortunately, you are now in the simulation and cannot contact Alpha. Otherwise, you could ask Alpha, the encyclopedia, to tell you what this item is.]
[Soon, under your expectant gaze, the family of the Innate Saint finally gives birth to a son. With the birth of this child, astonishing phenomena appear, shocking the entire starfield.]
[At the moment of the child’s birth, you announce that this child is the person you have been waiting for, your destined disciple, who you will teach cultivation to, so that he may become the Emperor of Tao Proving, and you hope that his family will let you take him away.]
[Upon hearing these words, his parents are somewhat reluctant but also very happy. After all, there is no doubt that this is a great opportunity for both their child and their family and should not be missed.]
[Immediately, they agree. You also generously take out some resources and Cultivation Skills and prepare to leave.]
[However, before you can leave, Bone Emperor’s voice resounds, gloomily saying that he didn’t expect you to have the same means as him to discover talents in advance. But to take away the Innate Saint from him, you are still not capable.]
[The appearance of the Bone Emperor makes you frown, but you are not flustered. After all, this is something you expected. You have always suspected that the Bone Emperor, like you, had already arrived and only appeared a little later than you, just never revealing himself. Now, this point has been confirmed.]
[However, the Bone Emperor appears, so the other Quasi-Emperor should also appear. At this time, you think there is no need to fight them and might as well look for opportunities to leave.]
[Just as you are thinking, the Bone Emperor makes a move against you. He is very domineering and does not hold back, attacking you with a terrifying Divine Skill.]
[In response, you snorted coldly and let Cai Yonglong use his Talent Skills to enter the Invincible Defense state. This surprises the Bone Emperor, who never expected you to have such means.]
[When the Bone Emperor is about to make another move, another Quasi-Emperor aura descends, attacking the Bone Emperor. At this, the Bone Emperor is very unhappy and can only fight the attacking Quasi-Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 895: 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: Chapter 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _4
[However, the two quasi-emperors did not engage in a battle to the death. Instead, they kept their eyes on you to prevent you from doing anything to the Innate Saint and to prevent your escape.]
[At the same time, both of them had rich combat experience and knew that the Energy Barrier of Absolute Defense, which appeared weak under Cai Yonglong’s support, could defend against the Divine Skills of quasi-emperors. It was very likely to be a power or tool from All Heavens.]
[Although such a thing was weird and had amazing effects, it definitely had a time limit. They just needed to wait for the time to come while fighting, then eliminate you and compete for the Innate Saint.]
[Of course, you were well aware of what the two quasi-emperors were thinking. As a result, you sneered at them and directly brought out two Emperor’s artifacts.]
[As soon as the two Emperor’s artifacts appeared, both quasi-emperors were surprised. They had never imagined that you would take out two Emperor’s artifacts at once so openly.]
[Meanwhile, both of them figured out the origins of the two artifacts and understood that you were from the Taiyi Imperial Palace and held an astonishing status.]
...
[However, despite their surprise, they still intended to attack you. How could an Emperor’s artifact matter? An Emperor’s artifact was extremely dangerous for cultivators below quasi-emperor level, but for the relatively powerful quasi-emperors, it posed no threat unless another quasi-emperor wielded it.]
[However, what they did not expect was that you didn’t intend to clash with them directly using the two Emperor’s artifacts. Although you had confidence that relying on the artifacts, you could fight against them and even had the possibility of killing them by luck, it was not necessary.]
[Next, you activated the long-unused effect of Golden Talent: Transmission, intending to take the Innate Saint and Cai Yonglong and flee from here.]
[Golden Talent: Transmission naturally had fluctuations. Supremes could not intercept it, but a quasi-emperor could. However, that was under normal circumstances.]
[After you brought out the two Emperor’s artifacts, you protected yourself with their terrifying power and repelled the opponents.]
[As a result, although the Bone Emperor and the other quasi-emperor reacted and wanted to stop you from escaping, with the terrifying power of the two Emperor’s artifacts controlled by you, they ultimately failed to intercept you.]
[Thus, you directly took the Innate Saint and Cai Yonglong and escaped from here. Although this meant leaving the two Emperor’s artifacts behind.]
[However, you didn’t worry about it. Emperor’s artifacts could be summoned back, and even a quasi-emperor could not destroy them. Although a quasi-emperor could seal them for some time, they generally wouldn’t do so because it would be a thankless task.]
[Moreover, the Taiyi Imperial Palace had a profound heritage, and neither the Bone Emperor nor the other quasi-emperor wanted to go too far.]
[For this reason, although the Bone Emperor and the other quasi-emperor were furious and wanted to hunt you down and kill you, they could only rage in vain. With a roar, they shattered the Primordial Spirit Ancient Star and shocked the galaxy.]
……
“Facing these old monsters, even with full preparation, it’s Wang Ping’s consistent style to avoid fighting if possible.”
Wang Ping smiled as he looked at the text simulation.
However, this smooth result was an unexpected joy.
It seemed that the usage method of Emperor’s artifact + Golden Talent: Transmission was not bad, allowing the simulated Wang Ping to escape from the quasi-emperor.
In the past, before joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace, facing a quasi-emperor would have been a headache.
Of course, even without this method, once the incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was available, there would be no need to fear quasi-emperors.
However, in any case, escaping with this method now opened a new usage method that could be referenced in the future.
If possible, directly refreshing a stronger teleportation talent would be even better.
“However, it’s difficult to refresh such a talent. After all, only a seven-color talent can meet the requirements. Now, I can only make do with continuing to use the Golden Talent: Transmission. I wonder where I’ll be sent this time. Hopefully, it’s not some forbidden area.”
Wang Ping shook his head, sighed, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As you teleported, you discovered that you had arrived in a strange ocean. In this place, there was no Spiritual Energy, only endless eerie Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit, giving an extremely dangerous feeling.]
[After arriving here, you were speechless. You knew that you had been very unlucky to have teleported into a forbidden area.]
[Because you had read various books and understood the forbidden areas of the Upper Realm, you could recognize where this place was. If there were no accidents, this place should be the Guimo Sea, one of the Ten Forbidden Lands in the legends.]
[It was said that the Guimo Sea was located in the Four Profound Small Universe among the Nine Mini Universes. The central area of the Four Profound Small Universe was water, and its corresponding forbidden land was the Guimo Sea.]
[Then, you also remembered that each of the other eight small universes had their own dominant and related properties of forbidden areas, and in the last simulation, the Nine Stars Pavilion used the nine major forbidden areas of the nine small universes as nodes for their formations.]
[This made you suspect that there was a great secret behind it. Moreover, the nine stars of the Nine Stars Pavilion represented the nine major attributes of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, and Darkness, which made people even more curious about the cause and effect relationship.]

chapters.title: Chapter 896: 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Chapter 243: The Fourth Seven-Color Talent! Ghost Demon Sea! _5
[However, these secrets are beyond your reach now. What you should be thinking about is how to escape from the Guimo Sea, and you don’t have much confidence in that.]
[After all, the Guimo Sea is such a broken place that even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor hasn’t been heard from since he came here. It’s too difficult for a Supreme like you, along with Cai Yonglong and the Innate Saint, to survive.]
[At present, it is only the Golden Finger of Cai Yonglong that is still sustaining you guys. Otherwise, you would have doubted that you would already be dead by now.]
[Next, you should take advantage of the remaining time of Cai Yonglong’s Absolute Defense, which can shield the potential harm caused by the Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit. You randomly chose a direction and rushed towards it quickly, trying to find a possible land in the Guimo Sea.]
[While you were flying, the frightening Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit surged, and terrifying demon beasts flocked towards you. These demon beasts were everywhere and in astonishing numbers.]
[At the same time, their combat power was also extremely terrifying. None of them were lower than the Saint Tier. Some even reached the Half-Step Supreme and Supreme Tier.]
...
[It should be noted that the size of the Guimo Sea is unknown, and just one area can generate such demon beasts. It is hard to imagine how terrifying the demon beasts they could create would be.]
[It can only be said that the Ten Forbidden Lands are well-deserved as the absolute forbidden area for cultivators. Even Supremes are doomed to die once they enter. Even for a Quasi-Emperor, the chances of survival are extremely slim. As for Emperors, it depends on their luck.]
[Relying on Absolute Defense, you desperately fled and flew across the endless sea while ignoring the attacks of those demon beasts.]
[However, at this moment, you noticed something unusual on the originally calm black sea surface. Terrifying whirlpools were forming, tearing through space, and their strange gravitational force was pulling you in, wanting to drag you into the whirlpools.]
[This change caused your face to turn pale, and you tried your best to break free. Absolute Defense may be useful for blocking damage, but it seems to have no effect against these whirlpools. Eventually, you barely escaped as you tried your best to fight the whirlpool while fleeing.]
[But before you could even catch your breath, an even bigger shadow emerged beneath the dark sea surface, and an ultimate sense of danger surged in your heart.]
[This made your scalp tingle. Using the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, you saw a fish-like creature entwined with Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit beneath the sea. Its breath was so terrifying that it was far more horrifying than a Quasi-Emperor. If it attacked, you might have a hard time surviving.]
[For this reason, you directly burn your Primordial Essence without any reservation, and use all your strength to bombard the creature that is about to emerge from the sea. You hope to trigger the High Multiple Critical Strikes and the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack to kill it on the spot.]
[However, you were disappointed. Although you managed to trigger the Quartet and six-fold Critical Damage this time, your attack didn’t hurt the monster. Thus, the conditions for triggering the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack were not met.]
[Just when you were feeling helpless, the creature that was coming out of the sea opened its huge mouth and shattered space and time around you, swallowing you into its stomach.]
…
Looking at the Text Simulation content, Wang Ping was speechless.
It really was a case of whatever he was afraid of was coming true.
He worried about being teleported to some forbidden place, and as a result, he was really transported to a ghostly place like the Guimo Sea.
「It seems like I’ve failed again.」
Wang Ping sighed.
Wang Ping didn’t think that he, as a Supreme, could lead two Saint Realms out of the Guimo Sea alive.
Not to mention that they had already been swallowed by the monster at the bottom of the sea, and there was no way out.
However, something unexpected by the simulated Wang Ping happened.
[When you were swallowed by the demon beast, a force appeared within it, trying to digest you. But because of the last three seconds of Cai Yonglong’s talent skills, you all were still barely alive.]
[For this reason, you thought you couldn’t miss this chance. Since you couldn’t hurt the monster from the outside, you didn’t believe you still couldn’t hurt it from within its body.]
[At once, you burst out with all your strength and launched an attack, trying to injure the monster and trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack to find a way out in this desperate situation.]
[However, you were speechless. Your full attack inside its body didn’t hurt it either. Its inner hardness was as tough as its outer skin and had energy protection as well.]
[Obviously, this monster was intelligent, daring to swallow people directly, and naturally had the ability to protect itself from being broken from within.]
[At the moment when you became utterly desperate, the space around you suddenly distorted and formed a Spacial Vortex. Then, a jade hand appeared and directly pulled you into the Spacial Vortex.]

chapters.title: Chapter 897: 244: Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping's Enlightenment!
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: Chapter 244: Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment!
[In the next moment, you are suddenly pulled into a strange space, where there are mountains and waters, filled with Spiritual Energy, a vibrant world. It looks like a hidden secret realm.]
[This has taken you by surprise. However, the woman in front of you, even more surprising due to her stunningly beautiful face and gentle demeanor, looks very familiar.]
[Soon enough, you recognize her identity as she looks exactly like the paintings you’ve seen. She is none other than the daughter of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, specifically, the long-lost daughter.]
[Throughout the simulations, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had forcefully entered the Guimo Sea in an attempt to find his daughter, eventually vanishing without any news. Now you see the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and are saved by her; it’s hard to stay calm.]
[As you’re observing the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, she’s looking at you too, marveling, suggesting that you must be an inheritor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, with truly astonishing talent that even she cannot match.]
[You’re not surprised that the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can recognize your identity. After all, you’ve also practiced the Emperor Scripture of Taiyi Imperial Palace, though it was merely to absorb knowledge, enhance your foundation, and enrich your means. Moreover, you carry the lingering aura of the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Emperor’s artifact, so it’s normal to be recognized.]
...
[Subsequently, you smile bitterly, expressing that no matter how high the talent, it’s futile if there’s no growth.]
[This statement resonates with the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. There are so many geniuses, and although your talent is the most astonishing one she’s ever seen, without becoming an Emperor or an Immortal, it’s ultimately in vain.]
[Of course, even as an Emperor, there are times when one feels powerless, which can be depressing. Perhaps in the Upper Realm, only by becoming an Immortal can one truly live freely and eternally, looking down on all beings. Unfortunately, nobody has been able to become an Immortal.]
[As the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighs, you make a slight bow and mention her identity, curious about why she ventured into the Guimo Sea and eventually disappeared without a trace.]
…..
“This development was beyond my expectations. I didn’t expect to meet the daughter of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, Yu Daoyi, in the Guimo Sea. I wonder how she managed to get into the Guimo Sea and survive there.”
Wang Ping looks at the contents of the Text Simulation, quite astonished.
After all, the Guimo Sea, as one of the Ten Forbidden Lands, is a terrifying place where even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor went and disappeared without a trace.
Logically, as a daughter of the Great Emperor, Yu Daoyi’s cultivation should be no more than a Quasi-Emperor; surviving in such a place should be impossible.
However, not only did she survive, but she also saved him from the stomach of a terrifying underwater Demon Beast.
This kind of ability is not a simple feat.
“We’ll know the reason soon. Just keep reading.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping composes himself and continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In response to your question, the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, Yu Daoyi, doesn’t give a direct answer. Instead, she looks at you curiously, wonders how you ended up in the Guimo Sea as well. With your current cultivation and with two weak Saints, you shouldn’t have ventured so deep into this place, and should have perished not long after entering the Guimo Sea.]
[Hearing Yu Daoyi’s words, Cai Yonglong is quite embarrassed and helpless. Although he has become a Saint, he is indeed a weak one, which is quite frustrating. As for the Innate Saint, just born a minute or two ago, his spiritual intelligence is still vague. Although he’s more spiritually active than ordinary babies, he can’t understand the meaning of the conversation, he’s just giggling.]
[In response, you shake your head and state that Cai Yonglong is not a burden. Without him, you wouldn’t have made it this far. As for how you ended up in the Guimo Sea, you admit it openly, explaining the cause and effect of the Transmission.]
[These words make Yu Daoyi ponder as she looks at Cai Yonglong, guessing some things. Both you and Cai Yonglong emit a foreign aura, possibly having some special abilities.]
[However, Yu Daoyi doesn’t inquire further; instead, she gently taps your forehead, expressing that it’s not worth risking your life for an Innate Saint, as your life is much more important than his.]
[You respond with a chuckle, unfazed, and don’t offer an explanation. After all, the ability of Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger is something you can’t reveal. Also, you truly didn’t expect the Golden Talent: Transmission to send you to such a dreadful place. You can only say that you’ve been quite unlucky.]
[Of course, meeting the daughter of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor now, you think this might not necessarily be a bad thing. If you can obtain information about her current situation and the reason she came to the Guimo Sea, you might be able to help the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor rescue her. In that case, he won’t suffer any misfortunes.]
[As for how rescuing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi might not greatly impact the future, you don’t care too much. Infact, it could be seen as a way of repaying a favor.]
[Moreover, as long as you can find a way to stop the eerie plots and assassinate the plotters of the Nine Stars Pavilion, delay their plan to refine the Upper Realm, then the deterrence power of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor will prove useful, giving you a reliable backing in the Immortal Mansion.]

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 244: The Emperor’s Daughter! Wang Pings Enlightenment! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: Chapter 244: The Emperor’s Daughter! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _2
[At the very least, you are not weaker than any heaven-defying talents except for those from the Ku family. As for the Ku family, as long as Ku Xuan dies, they do not pose a great threat to you. Of course, if you can save Ku Xuan from the strange hands, there may be different changes, and you can win over the Ku family.]
[When you were lost in thought, Yu Daoyi didn’t continue to inquire about your intentions. After all, everyone has their own secrets, and she won’t force you to say anything.]
[Then, Yu Daoyi talked about how she fell into the Guimo Sea. It turns out that she had once joined the Nine Stars Pavilion and mixed in to reach the position of a candidate for the Water Star. In order to become one of the Nine Stars – Water Star, the Creator of Nine Stars Pavilion, who is also the Pavilion Master, gave her a test and asked her to enter the Guimo Sea to retrieve an item.]
[In order to become the Water Star, Yu Daoyi resolutely went to the Guimo Sea. She was very clear that if she told her father, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, he would definitely stop her. So she didn’t tell anyone and set off alone.]
[Originally, she thought that with her Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation, she could easily complete the trial without encountering any incidents, as long as she didn’t go deep into the Guimo Sea.]
[The Guimo Sea was indeed terrifying, and she almost perished there with her strength. However, she was ultimately strong and got that item. But when she was about to leave the Guimo Sea, she didn’t expect that the previous Mercury would suddenly appear and attack her. In the end, she was seriously injured and had to backtrack deeper into the Guimo Sea.]
...
[Yu Daoyi said that after she chose to go deep into the Guimo Sea, the previous Mercury stopped chasing her. She was quite puzzled by this, as the opponent had the ability to kill her but didn’t do so.]
[In the end, when she was about to die in the Guimo Sea, she came up with an idea and chose to be swallowed by a demon beast voluntarily. She then created a small world within it to hide and heal her wounds until today.]
…
“Is Yu Daoyi really that powerful?”
Wang Ping was quite surprised after looking at the content of the Text Simulation.
With the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation, she can fight against the aging Ordinary Emperors who have barely reached the Emperor of Tao Proving level._with such strength, she wouldn’t be much weaker than the white-cloaked quasi-emperor.
No wonder the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor claimed that his daughter was someone he had high hopes for. This kind of talent and strength is indeed strong enough, and if she reaches the Emperor of Tao Proving level, she would be a powerful Great Emperor.
By that time, Taiyi Imperial Palace would have two Emperors, which would be a sign of great prosperity.
“So it seems that our struggle among the younger generation after the Golden Age is opening is still a small fight.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought of this.
Like Lei Wanqian and Ku Xuan, they actually belong to young people and are not that old.
That kind of age is just a drop in the ocean in the life of a Great Emperor.
A Great Emperor usually has many offspring.
Although not all of the offspring can be outstanding those who were sealed in the Golden Age are all exceptional talents among their descendants. However, they couldn’t catch up with their elder brothers and sisters since their cultivation time is too short.
There must be a lot of figures like Yu Daoyi who have already fully grown up.
Although not everyone among them can reach Yu Daoyi’s level, they are definitely not to be underestimated.
“In this way, the path of cultivation is really difficult, and the word ‘struggle’ runs through every realm. When you reach a new level, you will face new challenges.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
“However, why did the Nine Stars Pavilion elect a new Mercury when the former Mercury of the Guimo Sea is still alive and well? Besides, why did the former Mercury attack Yu Daoyi? Is it to keep their position? I feel like it’s not that simple.”
Wang Ping started to think about the matter of the Nine Stars Pavilion again and fell into deep thought.
If it were to protect their position, the former Mercury wouldn’t have let go of Yu Daoyi later.
“By the way, why did Yu Daoyi, who had such a promising future, go to the Nine Stars Pavilion to fight for the position of Mercury?”
Wang Ping was also doubtful about Yu Daoyi’s actions.
With Heavenly Feather Great Emperor as her father, and the strength to fight against an aging Ordinary Emperor, as long as she reaches the Emperor of Tao Proving, she would be one of the top existences in the Upper Realm.
However, she chose to join the Nine Stars Pavilion and fought for the position of Mercury, even ventured into the Guimo Sea for this, the drawbacks outweigh the benefits of such behavior.
“So the answer should be coming soon.”
Wang Ping concentrated his mind and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, believing that the simulated Wang Ping could also think of this and ask Yu Daoyi about it.
[Many doubts flashed through your mind, and finally, you asked Yu Daoyi why she wanted to join the Nine Stars Pavilion and fight for the position of Mercury. As for this, Yu Daoyi remained silent, apparently not wanting to tell you the reason.]
[You were quite helpless in the face of this but didn’t want to pursue it further.]
[However, when you were about to give up on asking, Yu Daoyi sighed, thinking that her chances of surviving the Guimo Sea were slim. Instead of keeping these things in her heart all the time, she decided to share her story.]
[It turns out that Yu Daoyi’s mother was killed by the Destructing tao emperor. She wanted to avenge her mother, but Heavenly Feather Great Emperor remained silent in the matter and didn’t choose to take revenge.]

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 244: The Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: Chapter 244: The Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _3
[Because of this, she was somewhat disappointed in her father, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. However, she doesn’t think that what her father, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, did was wrong.]
[After all, in her heart, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has always been just an Ordinary Emperor. At the same time, despite being her father and an Emperor for the Taiyi Imperial Palace, he also had the responsibility of protecting the Imperial Palace.]
[If Heavenly Feather Great Emperor chose to wage war against the Destructing Tao Emperor, there was a high probability of annihilation. In such a case, the Taiyi Imperial Palace would also be destroyed. If that were to happen, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would be viewed as the culprit for the Palace’s downfall.]
[However, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, as her father, chose to remain silent for the greater good, and didn’t declare war on Destructing Tao Emperor. But Yu Daoyi couldn’t swallow her anger. She wished to become stronger, seek authentication as an Emperor of Tao Proving, and then challenged Destructing Tao Emperor to a fight to the death.]
[Of course, Yu Daoyi was well aware that Destructing Tao Emperor was not a mere Emperor, he was a ruler in emperors: like the Dark Time Emperor, his power far surpassed that of other Emperors. Therefore, even if she obtained the rank of Emperor of Tao Proving, she could not match him.]
[Therefore, Yu Daoyi thought of leveraging external power. If she could become an Emperor of Tao Proving and at the same time obtain the legendary Power of Nine Stars, she would stand a chance in a fight against Destructing Tao Emperor.]
...
[After all, the Power of Nine Stars from the Nine Stars Pavilion allows one to have combat power on par with an Emperor, but it’s not that simple in reality. Once one obtains the Power of Nine Stars, they truly possess Great Emperor Combat Power – and not just that of an Ordinary Emperor.]
[Yu Daoyi firmly believed that with dual Emperor combat power, she could manage to fatally wound the Destructing Tao Emperor and avenge her mother.]
[Listening to Yu Daoyi’s account, you and Cai Yonglong both sighed. You didn’t expect Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi to be burdened with such heavy grudges. It is no wonder that Yu Daoyi would choose to act so recklessly and why someone who seemed so gentle would behave so aggressively.]
…..
“So such events had happened….”
Wang Ping, observing the simulation content, could hardly keep calm.
At the same time, he gained a clearer understanding of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
The Nine Stars Pavilion was more terrifying than he had imagined.
“However, if this is the case, why would they choose to act prematurely after I defeated Ku Xuan? Why choose to deal with me in the secret realm? With the combat power of nine great Emperors and the inscrutable Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, they could easily overrun any Imperial-tier forces.”
Wang Ping thought back to the events that had occurred in the simulation and was quite puzzled.
“Since such a development has occurred, there must be a reason for it. But, never mind, there’s too little information available now; it’s useless to think about it.”
Soon afterwards, Wang Ping quickly discarded these questions from his mind, continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you were reminded of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and couldn’t help but sigh. You think that given Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s personality, he would certainly not resign himself to silence and forgo revenge. It’s likely that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was building up his power in silence, waiting for the day when he was strong enough to take revenge against Destructing Tao Emperor.]
[But, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor didn’t live to see that day. You’re not aware of how strong Heavenly Feather Great Emperor became after the onset of the Golden Age, but it’s highly likely that he hadn’t reached the Emperor Monarch Tier. After all, Erebos Emperor is very powerful, but he’s not an Emperor Monarch. Since Erebos Emperor isn’t, it’s likely that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor isn’t either.]
[In addition, there’s another reason. Based on your memories from the previous simulations, Destructing Tao Emperor seems to rarely appear. Even after the onset of the Golden Age, he hasn’t been seen, and neither have his descendants.]
[Perhaps, this is one of the reasons why Heavenly Feather Great Emperor didn’t fight him – how can one fight and seek revenge if they can’t find the person? Therefore, upon finding clues regarding his daughter Yu Daoyi, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor didn’t hesitate to venture into the Guimo Sea.]
[After all, he had initially chosen to hide and forego revenge for his Tao Companion. Now that he had found a clue about his daughter, he naturally couldn’t ignore it. Even if it meant death – even if he would have to face the Imperial Palace’s condemnation, he had to make the attempt.]
[As a result, he vanished without a trace. The Taiyi Imperial Palace lost their Great Emperor-tier combat power and was put in a passive position in the Golden Age. Although there was an incarnation, it couldn’t exist for long; its powers weren’t potent and would gradually deplete.]
[Following this, after a brief moment of silence, you asked Yu Daoyi about her injuries after all these years here and whether it was truly safe here.]
[In response to your question, Yu Daoyi shook her head, indicating that her inner source had been hurt. Unless she had access to a Pure-blooded Phoenix’s Blood Essence at the Quasi-emperor Tier or exceptionally rare Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, it would be challenging to recover.]
[As for whether it was safe here, Yu Daoyi also responded. Although it could be considered safe, it wasn’t absolutely safe.]
[After all, this place was in the belly of a Demon Beast. Yu Daoyi opened a space to hide using a special Secret Skill. Due to the low intelligence of the beast coupled with her power surpassing that of the beast, it had not noticed anything strange. But if a stronger Demon Beast attacked and devoured this beast, there was a possibility of exposure.]
[Once exposed, the consequences would be severe, and her life would be in danger.]
[Listening to Yu Daoyi’s words, you, too, felt helpless. The higher one’s cultivation level, the more difficult it is to recover if the source is damaged, mainly because treasures that could be helpful to them are scarce. Therefore, when involved in a battle of powerful beings at the Emperor Tier, they generally avoid a fight to the death unless they are confident of crushing their opponents.]

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 244: The Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Chapter 244: The Daughter of the Emperor! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _4
[However, the battle of the Emperors had too significant an impact. Ignoring the hidden powers within other forces, nobody knew what sort of trump cards the other side had. Even an ordinary Emperor might have an astonishing last resort, and it’d be normal for a powerful Emperor’s foundation to be damaged during their dying counterattack.]
[Because of this, unless there’s a deep hatred, very few Emperors would fight to the death with another Emperor or someone at the Emperor tier recklessly. Of course, if they could gang up on them, then it’s acceptable to make a move.]
[The commotion during the previous simulation occurred because a seldom seen alliance of Emperors took place, which then put pressure on the other Emperors and the Ku family.]
[Subsequently, you started to feel a headache. You were not surprised by Yu Daoyi’s answer. After all, she had never appeared until the opening of the Golden Age, when Heavenly Feather Great Emperor went to look for her. This meant that either she had been trapped here all along, or she had perished completely within the next 100,000 years.]
[Under such circumstances, it was impossible for you to escape Guimo Sea relying on Yu Daoyi. Therefore, you thought you might have to start over again, but you did not know how long you could linger this time.]
[Perhaps, the only value of staying alive now is to judge how much longer Yu Daoyi can survive, and to make preparations for rescuing her in the future.]
...
[Afterwards, you continued to chat about some things, and then Yu Daoyi arranged for accommodations for you. She advised you not to worry too much, as thinking more wouldn’t change anything. Instead, it would be better to focus on cultivation and grow stronger slowly, hoping for a slim chance of survival in the future.]
[In response, you naturally nodded, planning to focus on your cultivation. However, you thought of something and asked Yu Daoyi if she could escape from Guimo Sea with their help if she possessed your Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[Yu Daoyi was quite surprised by your question. After all, not everyone would be willing to dig out their own eyes for someone else’s use, let alone the rare Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[Then, Yu Daoyi shook her head, indicating that it would be meaningless. Even with the Breaking Origin Sky Eye at her current level, it wouldn’t improve her strength by much. Although it would allow her to see through some dangers, it wouldn’t be of much use in Guimo Sea.]
[The only exception would be if she acquired a Breaking Origin Sky Eye with Great Completion Domain or even at its utmost limit. In that case, her combat power would significantly improve, and she would genuinely be able to see through illusions, increasing the hope for survival.]
[However, developing any Special Constitution is incredibly challenging. Back then, she spent an unknown amount of time developing her Heavenly Water Saint Body into the Perfect Domain, and it took a considerable opportunity for her to achieve that.]
[Now, in such a perilous environment, it is impossible to develop the more powerful Breaking Origin Sky Eye into the Great Completion Domain or reach its limit.]
[Upon hearing this answer, you couldn’t help but feel helpless. Without saying much more, you prepared for the worst.]
[In the blink of an eye, three years had passed. In these three years, you devoted yourself to cultivation, but it wasn’t of much significance. To advance at the Supreme tier, it was challenging to improve a single minor realm by relying on self-cultivation without great opportunities.]
[Nevertheless, your cultivation did improve. After the Innate Saint grew older, you took him as your disciple. As a result, your cultivation increased from the Late Stage Superme Realm to just a step away from Superme Realm Peak.]
[Subsequently, without the conditions to continue your advancement, you planned to break through by yourself. Of course, the Profound Universe was still undergoing automatic enlightenment, and it would be best if you happened to come across a Great Talent to directly elevate yourself during the process.]
[In the blink of an eye, 3,000 years had passed, and you didn’t pick up any Great Talent during the natural enlightenment. However, through your efforts, you successfully raised your cultivation to the Peak of Superme Realm in these 3,000 years.]
[At the same time, you also made other gains during these 3,000 years. These gains allowed you to develop Time-Space Body into the Minor Domain and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye into the Minor Domain, causing a qualitative change in your strength.]
[The reason for these continuous breakthroughs was Yu Daoyi’s guidance and the jade stone given by the Wind Demon Supreme.]
[You didn’t know what the jade stone really was. However, when you took it out, Yu Daoyi was greatly surprised and said it was an astonishing treasure that could help with the development of Constitutions, a tool from the Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[She had also obtained this item before, which allowed her to develop her Heavenly Water Saint Body into the Great Completion Domain. Although your jade stone was not as big as the one she had previously gotten, it had similar effects.]
[With Yu Daoyi revealing the function of the treasure and how to use it, you were able to make such breakthroughs in 3,000 years. It could only be said that the Predecessor ransmigrator, Wind Demon Supreme, was kind of useful.]
[Initially, you thought the things he exploded didn’t have any use and was a failed attempt at exploding gold coins. Now, you feel you have wronged him.]
[It turned out that Wind Demon Supreme still had some reserves. Unfortunately, he didn’t have a Special Constitution himself, and that rendered this item completely useless to him. He probably had planned to find a way to acquire a Special Constitution and use it on himself afterward. As for selling the item to gamble in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he most likely didn’t dare to.]

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 244: The Emperor's Daughter! Wang Ping's Enlightenment! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Chapter 244: The Emperor’s Daughter! Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! _5
[All I can say is, hesitation leads to defeat, and he was ultimately just a loser, so this treasure is a bargain for you.]
[Next, you chose to leave seclusion, planning to fight Yu Daoyi without using your talents, to test your current combat ability.]
[As for this, Yu Daoyi didn’t refuse either. She was also very curious about your combat ability after reaching the peak of the Superme Realm, and developing the Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Minor Domain level.]
[As your battle began, Yu Daoyi was amazed. After her test, your current combat ability is enough to crush ordinary Heaven Supremes, and only Quasi-Emperors could suppress you.]
[If you were to wait until your cultivation reached the peak of the Heavenly Supreme realm, you might have the qualifications to fight against an ordinary Quasi-Emperor.]
[This evaluation surprised you. However, you weren’t too arrogant, after all, you only achieved this strength by developing your double talents to the Minor Domain level. The Chaotic Body’s evaluation is that as long as one’s cultivation reaches the Heavenly Supreme Peak, they can fight against old Quasi-Emperors. They don’t even need to develop their physique to the Minor Domain level to achieve this.]
...
[Although there is a big difference between you fighting against ordinary Quasi-Emperors and Chaotic Bodies fighting against old ordinary Quasi-Emperors, it still shows the terror of the Chaotic Body. Once the Chaotic Body also develops to the Minor Domain level, the gap is estimated to widen again.]
[Of course, you’re not afraid of anything. After all, you still have your talents. With the Seven-Color Talent – Burst Blade guaranteeing four times critical hit damage, anyone who fights you would be nervous.]
[Despite thinking this way, you still longed for the Chaotic Body. If you could obtain the Chaotic Body, you would really enjoy it, and your combat power would soar again, easily able to cross levels in battle.]
[After testing your combat ability, you both resumed your individual cultivation.]
[In a blink of an eye, thirty thousand years passed. During these thirty thousand years, you were always cultivating and Enligtenment.]
[You weren’t comprehending the Heavenly Dao’s true spirit. After all, it is still the Last Dharma Age. You can’t comprehend anything, and forcefully trying to comprehend would just be wasting time. In other words, it’s impossible for you to comprehend two aspects of the Time-Space Heavenly Dao’s true spirit, and your cultivation can’t be promoted to the Earth Emperor tier either.]
[You spent time in perfecting your own cultivation skills and Divine Skills. You previously tried to integrate the Dark Time Emperor Scripture and the Devouring Space Emperor Sutra with other Emperor Scriptures, hoping to merge and improve them into your own Emperor Scripture.]
[Before, you always failed and didn’t have enough time to create methods in peace. But now that you’re trapped here, it is undoubtedly an opportunity.]
[Furthermore, your current Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye are developed to the Minor Domain level, giving you a deeper comprehension of their origins and better analysis of various Emperor Scriptures’ secrets. So you gained a lot.]
[Thirty thousand years have passed, and you are not far from creating your own Space-Time Emperor’s Scripture, your own Space-Time Emperor Scripture.]
[However, during these thirty thousand years, Cai Yonglong and the Innate Saint were forced to self-tittle early because they couldn’t cultivate. Otherwise, they risked dying of old age.]
[In the blink of an eye, another ten thousand years passed, you were still in closed-door Enlightenment, just half a step away from comprehending your own Space-Time Emperor Scripture. Under such circumstances, you immersed yourself in it, motionless like a stone, completely ignoring everything outside.]
[Your Enlightenment creation made even Yu Daoyi marvel. If you could truly comprehend your own Emperor Scripture at the Superme Realm, your combat power would double again.]
[After all, cultivating other people’s Emperor Scriptures and fighting with them ultimately cannot unleash their full power. By the Quasi-Emperor tier, there isn’t much difference between using your own created Quasi-Emperor scripture and using other Great Emperor’s Emperor Scripture.]
[Because your own created Cultivation Skills can perfectly unleash their power, using other Great Emperors’ Scriptures in battle will ultimately not be able to unleash all of their power. Many times, even half of the power cannot be unleashed.]
[As a result, the gap between Quasi-Emperor scripture and Great Emperor scripture does not seem very large. In fact, the gap between the two is substantial. If you can comprehend your own Great Emperor Scripture at the Superme tier, even without your various physiques, even if you were just an ordinary body, you would still be unparalleled in your realm. Only a few great talents could fight you, and your strength would have truly transformed.]
[Unfortunately, it is difficult for cultivators without such physiques to comprehend the Emperor Scripture at the Supreme level, which seems somewhat contradictory.]

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 245: Yu Daoyi's determination! Farewell to Emperor Tianyu
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Chapter 245: Yu Daoyi’s determination! Farewell to Emperor Tianyu
“This time, after slowing down the pace, my strength has improved quite rapidly. In the Golden Age, I have to fight for everything, and everything is dangerous, leading to quick deaths, making it hard to improve my strength.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and thought to himself.
However, although the Last Dharma Age provided him with enough time to comprehend, it was only useful in terms of comprehending the law.
In the Last Dharma Age, it was impossible to comprehend the principles or the Heavenly Tao True Spirit, and it was difficult to make significant improvements in cultivation, which was also a headache.
“But, if I use this hundred thousand years to explore the Upper Realm, gather information, try to find Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures that can transform my constitution, or try to improve my constitution to the Great Completion Domain, it is a good choice. This can also be considered a way to become stronger.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, analyzing.
...
If fully utilizing the hundred thousand years of the Last Dharma Age, each of his simulations would be equivalent to having an extra hundred thousand years.
However, once he reached the Golden Age, without self-titling, he probably wouldn’t be considered a young generation anymore.
“It seems like it doesn’t matter. After all, I have already become a Supreme, so I can’t be considered a young generation in terms of cultivation. Continuing to compete with Ku Xuan and the others would simply be bullying the young.”
Wang Ping shook his head, murmuring.
Moreover, after reaching the Supreme Realm, he couldn’t even enter the secret realm anymore.
Because the secret realm only allowed those below the Supreme level to enter, Supremes couldn’t enter.
That is to say, he now had no way to resolve the oddity from inside, and he had to find other ways to solve the oddity in advance.
It could only be said that those guys had calculated everything. The geniuses entering couldn’t win, and the Supremes were very strong, but the genius Supremes with amazing talents were even stronger. Even if their cultivation was sealed to the Saint King tier, they were not something the younger generation could touch.
Therefore, they couldn’t enter, and neither the Nine Stars Pavilion nor the oddity would let them in.
“However, these things don’t matter. There is plenty of time, and I will eventually find ways to kill them. There is no need to think about solving them in the secret realm.”
After calming Wang Pingping’s mood, he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[While you were immersed in enlightenment, an accident happened. The small world created by Yu Daoyi began to shake. This caused Yu Daoyi’s complexion to change, and without hesitation, she protected you, preventing you from leaving your state of enlightenment.]
[Then, she investigated what happened in the outer world. Soon, she learned the reason.]
[It turned out that the sea monster she was hiding in encountered an attack from other sea monsters. A more powerful sea monster was ruthlessly fighting her, causing terrifying aftershocks that affected them here.]
[According to Yu Daoyi’s speculation, the sea monster she was hiding in was definitely going to lose and soon fall prey to the other sea monster. That’s because the strength of that sea monster approached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier, which was too powerful to handle.]
[Immediately, Yu Daoyi made no hesitation and bundled up the closed-door practice room where you were, as well as the divine sources of Cai Yonglong and the Innate Saint who had self-titled themselves, and began to move their position.]
[Otherwise, this place would be swallowed up by the sea monster whose strength approached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier. If they fell into the stomach of that sea monster, they were likely to be discovered, which would be extremely dangerous.]
[However, Yu Daoyi’s judgment was correct, her escape action was fast, but she was ultimately discovered by the powerful sea monster, which then made a terrifying roar and began chasing after Yu Daoyi.]
[At this point, Yu Daoyi frowned, feeling a headache. Fighting in a place like the Guimo Sea and causing too much movement was extremely dangerous. Of course, this was also related to her origin being damaged and her combat strength being severely impaired, making her unable to quickly defeat the enemy. If it were her heyday, it would only take her one move to kill the sea monster whose strength approached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier.]
[In the end, Yu Daoyi reluctantly chose to avoid the battle, intending to use various Divine Skills to shake off the sea monster. However, the sea monster clung to Yu Daoyi, making it impossible for her to escape.]
[In the process, Yu Daoyi also attracted the attention of other sea monsters, one after another attacking her. The Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit of the Guimo Sea began to take shape, attacking Yu Daoyi’s body and mind.]
[At the same time, they also wanted to attack you. The Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit had no physical form, so they could attack the Sea of Consciousness. Once attacked, you would definitely be pulled out of the state of enlightenment.]
[Upon seeing this, Yu Daoyi frowned, hesitated no more, and dealt with these monsters formed by Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit as a priority.]
[However, Yu Daoyi knew very well that the current situation was getting worse and worse. Continuing like this, there would be no hope for you to escape, and you would die at the hands of these sea monsters.]
[This would still be the best outcome. If you accidentally bump into the big horror of the Guimo Sea, you would die even more miserably.]
[At this time, Cai Yonglong finally reacted, and he quickly contacted Yu Daoyi, stating that he could launch Absolute Defense.]
[Hearing Cai Yonglong’s words, Yu Daoyi was quite surprised and chose to cooperate with him.]
[In the end, with the help of Cai Yonglong’s Absolute Defense, Yu Daoyi, who had completely abandoned defense, shook off those sea monsters and prepared to hide once again inside the stomach of a stronger sea monster, creating a small world within.]

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 245: Yu Daoyi's determination! Farewell to Emperor Tianyu_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Chapter 245: Yu Daoyi’s determination! Farewell to Emperor Tianyu_2
[However, just as Yu Daoyi was about to take action, another change occurred. A terrifying demon shadow appeared in the Guimo Sea, and the aura it emitted was comparable to that of a Great Emperor.]
[Because of the horrifying nature of the terrifying demon shadow, even the powerful demon beasts under the sea dared not approach, making the area eerily silent. Even the Ghost Spirit and Demon Spirit seemed to disperse as if having their own intelligence, making this area slightly brighter and no longer the previous dark gray color.]
[This made Yu Daoyi’s face extremely heavy, knowing that real trouble had emerged this time.]
[Then, Yu Daoyi looked at you and found that you were obviously on the verge of successfully reaching Enlightenment. She could not help but grit her silver teeth and made a decision. She gathered you and took you into her inner world. Then, she began to flee.]
[The terrifying demon shadow naturally wouldn’t let Yu Daoyi escape and began to hunt her down. In response, Yu Daoyi tried to buy as much time as possible. When she could no longer delay, she unhesitatingly burned her already incomplete source, temporarily boosting her strength to the peak state to fight against the terrifying demon shadow.]
[However, even if she temporarily recovered her peak state, she could not match the terrifying demon shadow. She was merely trying to buy time.]
...
[While she was buying time, you finally understood your own Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra. As the Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra emerged, a vision descended in the Guimo Sea, bringing with it a new emperor’s aura.]
[This made Yu Daoyi slightly relieved, as she had managed to hold on until your successful Enlightenment. She had witnessed history, as reaching the Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra at the Supreme Realm was groundbreaking and would be praised by future generations.]
[Unfortunately, this happened in the Guimo Sea, and no one knew about your Enlightenment. If you died here, it would all be in vain.]
[With that thought, Yu Daoyi’s gaze became resolute again. She decided to take a gamble and try to fight for your survival.]
[She was already targeted by the terrifying demon shadow, and her chances of survival were extremely slim. Since that was the case, she might as well give you the hope. If you were extremely fortunate and managed to escape the Guimo Sea, you would be the hope of the Taiyi Imperial Palace and the hope for avenging her.]
[With this in mind, Yu Daoyi took advantage of the distraction caused by the newly emerged Emperor Scripture’s vision and took action again. She conjured countless water avatars and dove into the Guimo Sea.]
[Seeing this, the terrifying demon shadow roared and launched an attack, intending to completely kill Yu Daoyi.]
[As she dealt with the terrifying demon shadow’s pursuit, Yu Daoyi cut a part of her small world, wrapped it with her source, and fused it into one of the water avatars, allowing it to escape.]
[Then, Yu Daoyi’s original body and the other water avatars fought against the terrifying demon shadow one by one, buying time.]
[Moments later, all of Yu Daoyi’s water avatars were destroyed, and her original body suffered unimaginable injuries. Her aura rapidly declined, and she could no longer maintain her strength.]
[However, she did not fear death. Instead, she stole a glimpse in a certain direction, breathed a quiet sigh of relief, and then bravely faced death, launching a final suicide attack.]
[In the end, Yu Daoyi fell in the Guimo Sea, dying at the hands of the terrifying demon shadow. As for you, you were taken away by one of Yu Daoyi’s water avatars and escaped far away. You hid inside a weaker sea demon beast and once again opened a secret realm.]
[When you learned about these events, you fell silent. Having spent over 40,000 years with Yu Daoyi, although you spent most of your time in seclusion, the bond between you and her was intimate. Yu Daoyi’s gentle, big-sister demeanor made you feel very comfortable.]
[Even though you were deep within the Guimo Sea and life-threatening dangers lurked at every corner, you remained relaxed because of Yu Daoyi.]
[Now, Yu Daoyi died to save you, leaving you heartbroken, furious, and filled with hatred towards the terrifying demon shadow. You swore in your heart that you would definitely kill that terrifying demon shadow and avenge Yu Daoyi and her mother.]
[But soon you laughed bitterly at yourself. After all, as a Supreme, you only barely survived before with Yu Daoyi’s sacrifice. The idea of taking revenge now seemed impossible.]
[You definitely had no chance during this simulation. You could only hope for the next simulation. However, you would never set foot in the Guimo Sea again.]
…..
Sigh…..
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation with mixed feelings.
Attaining the Emperor Scripture should have been a happy and even exciting event.
However, with such a tragedy occurring, it was impossible to feel happy about it.
Yu Daoyi died just like that, and it was for saving him.
Originally, Yu Daoyi should have had a slim chance of survival on her own. Even if she did survive, her source would be damaged to such an extent that her cultivation would likely fall below the Quasi-Emperor level, but at least there was hope for survival.
However, she chose to give the chance of survival to the simulated Wang Ping. This woman’s actions were truly touching.
Even the original Wang Ping, who was just watching the Text Simulation, was deeply moved, so one could only imagine the emotions of the simulated Wang Ping.
Perhaps, he was very unwilling.
Although the simulated Wang Ping was still Wang Ping, they were ultimately different and changed based on the plot development.]

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 245: Yu Daoyi's determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Chapter 245: Yu Daoyi’s determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor_3
Although the optimized Life Simulator no longer generates emotions like betrayal and fear of death, and I can control their actions after entering the immersive simulation, each simulated Wang Ping eventually becomes a different individual as the story progresses.
“Unless I personally experience these plots, the feeling is ultimately different with just text simulation and subsequent TV-like image playbacks and rough memory footage.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and sighed.
“But don’t worry, I’ll destroy the Terrifying Demon Shadow and find and kill the Destructing Tao Emperor. Although I have no grievances with him, I will do this for Yu Daoyi and also for the ‘simulated Wang Ping’.”
After pausing for a moment, Wang Ping silently thought in his heart.
Simulated Wang Ping also needs to be cared for, and if his obsession and unwillingness can be satisfied, maybe he could have a better development.
...
This can also be considered as fulfilling the last wish of another self.
Although such a statement sounds a bit strange…
“It’s a pity that the limitations of the Golden Talent: Transmission are too great. Even the White Fog Forbidden Area, which is not among the Ten Forbidden Lands, cannot be teleported to, let alone the Guimo Sea, one of the Ten Forbidden Lands. Indeed, I still need a stronger teleportation talent.”
Wang Ping thought of the teleportation talent again and shook his head helplessly.
However, although he has always thought this way, talent extraction is not something he can get what he wants, he can only slowly refresh.
Afterward, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
As expected, Wang Ping felt that this simulation was coming to an end, and the simulated Wang Ping couldn’t last many more years before it ended.
[After a long time, after calming down your emotions, you continued your diligent cultivation, trying to become stronger. Even if you knew very well that no matter how hard you tried, you could not possibly escape from Guimo Sea on your own, and it would be difficult to break through to the Earth Emperor tier, let alone the Quasi-Emperor tier.]
[However, even so, you did not want to give up, you did not want to waste time, nor did you want to leave any regrets. You just hoped that during your diligent cultivation, you could last until the opening of the Golden Age and until Heavenly Feather Great Emperor entered the Guimo Sea.]
[Perhaps, after Heavenly Feather Great Emperor enters the Guimo Sea, you will be able to meet him and escape the Guimo Sea. There is no news of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s arrival, but you still have Cai Yonglong’s Absolute Defense Ability. If Absolute Defense is applied to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, maybe it can change something.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly 60,000 years have passed. It must be said that you are very lucky, as the demon beast you hid in the bottom of the sea has not encountered any accidents. Of course, the final protection of Yu Daoyi is also indispensable.]
[Nearly 60,000 years have passed, and your cultivation remains at the peak of the Supreme Realm, unable to break through. This has left you quite frustrated. In the Last Dharma Age, you cannot comprehend the Heavenly Tao True Spirit, let alone comprehend 20% of it, so naturally, you cannot break through the bottleneck. Your cultivation is locked.]
[However, you’re not without gain. During these nearly 60,000 years, you have been continuously Enlightenment, making the Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra more perfect and stronger.]
[At the same time, your Breaking Origin Sky Eye has also bred a terrifying skill: Breaking Origin Tribulation Light, which has a powerful prohibition-breaking effect, and is an enemy of great arrays and banned formations.]
[For this reason, you have been using this ability to bombard the bans on the Golden Light Jade Talisman. Although the bans on the Golden Light Jade Talisman are too powerful and your cultivation is too low, Breaking Origin Tribulation Light still has an effect.]
[After all your years of effort, many bans have been eroded away by you, greatly weakening their effects.]
[However, you know very well that in order to truly break the ban, you will likely need a long time. And you obviously don’t have the time anymore.]
[According to your calculations, plus the fact that the laws of the world are quickly manifesting themselves, the Last Dharma Age in the outer world should be coming to an end, and the Golden Age is about to come.]
[However, this also means that the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s plan is about to be launched, and it will be successfully implemented, and ultimately everything will be refined. And you, too, will inevitably die.]
[What you most hope for now is for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to appear at the last moment and take you out with him, then maybe there is still hope for some changes.]
[Perhaps it’s because your prayers have had some effect, not long after, you suddenly sensed a huge commotion in the outside world. Terrifying Emperor’s Might spread throughout Guimo Sea, causing countless demon beasts to be frightened.]
[And the demon beast you were in was also very frightened, wanting to get away from the Emperor’s Might. At this, you also showed a look of surprise, thinking that the time was ripe, and without hesitation, you let Cai Yonglong and your Innate Saint disciple wake up from the seal.]
[Then, you directly broke open the small world and escaped from the demon beast’s body with the use of the Time-Space Divine Skill, quickly rushing towards the direction of the Emperor’s Might.]
[Because your combat power has now transformed, and your methods have become even more powerful, you did not encounter any danger as you journeyed forward.]
[Of course, this is also because those powerful demon beasts are busy moving away from the Emperor’s Might and did not make any moves against you. Otherwise, if you were to confront Quasi-Emperor-tier Demon Beasts head-on, you would still be unable to escape the fate of having Cai Yonglong activate Absolute Defense.]

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 245: Yu Daoyi's determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Chapter 245: Yu Daoyi’s determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor_4
[In the end, you successfully approached the location where the Emperor’s Might was. As you drew closer, you also felt enormous pressure.]
[As the distance closed, facing the true Emperor’s Might without any protection from a powerhouse, even you felt a heaviness in your body. As for Cai Yonglong and the Innate Saint under your shelter, although you had done your best to protect them, their bodies began to exhibit numerous cracks, like fragile porcelain dolls, which could explode at any moment.]
[In the face of this situation, you could only sigh in your heart, acknowledging the great power of the Emperors. You were still far from the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and the Emperor’s Might wasn’t deliberately targeting you, but your situation was dire. If you were closer, or if the Emperor explicitly targeted you, the consequences would be unthinkable.]
[It could only be said that the further one progresses in cultivation, the greater the gap becomes. For an Emperor to deal with a Supreme, just unleashing their Emperor’s Might would be enough to crush them to near death. If it were an ordinary Supreme, they would likely be killed outright.]
[At this moment, you suddenly discovered that another Emperor’s aura appeared. This Emperor’s aura was extremely unfamiliar, able to stand up against the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Their Emperor’s Might collided, and without either side intentionally restraining it, this area became the forbidden zone within the forbidden land.]
[This filled your heart with terror, and you hastily retreated to put more distance between you and the conflict. The clash of two Emperors’ Might was already beyond your ability to withstand easily. As for Cai Yonglong and the Innate Saint, if not for your quick reaction to activate the effect of the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, and using all your strength to protect them, they would have likely died instantly.]
...
[Even so, although the two of them didn’t die instantly, they were near death. The Innate Saint probably had no chance of surviving. As for Cai Yonglong, although he was still barely alive, his Physical Body had collapsed, and his Divine Soul had burst, leaving him beyond salvation.]
[In response to this, you sighed and felt complicated. Your disciple, the Innate Saint, was really dead. However, it was fortunate that Cai Yonglong, like you, had also purchased a Rebirth tally, granting him a second chance at life.]
[From a great distance, you gazed at the site of the clash of the two Emperors, wondering who the other Emperor that fought against the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor might be.]
……
“Fine, I didn’t expect to actually endure until the Golden Age and wait for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. This luck is too good. However, the one opposing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, could he be the reason for his disappearance?”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, quite astonished.
