“Could this person be the previous Water Star of the Nine Stars Pavilion? If it’s true, it seems that this person never left the Guimo Sea.”
Then, Wang Ping thought of something and narrowed his eyes.
If it were really the Water Star, one of the Nine Stars, then there was a deep enmity between this Water Star and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s family.
After he deceived and killed Yu Daoyi, he confronted the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
Wang Ping’s thoughts raced, and he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you sensed the two Emperors beginning to fight. The aftermath of their battle was terrifying to the extreme, causing even the Guimo Sea to tremble. You could feel your scalp turning numb, and you continued to flee, burning your source energy, fearful of being involved.]
[Unfortunately, the Emperor’s battle inevitably affected a vast area, and you ultimately failed to escape. You and Cai Yonglong were killed by the aftermath of the battle between the two Emperors.]
[However, both of you possessed Rebirth tallies, thus entering a Resurrection Countdown state together.]
[While you were in the Resurrection Countdown state, the terrifying Emperor battle continued in the Guimo Sea. Eventually, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor gained a significant advantage in the fight.]
[Finally, the other Emperor chose to retreat. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, too, showed no intention of pursuing him, opting to stand down.]
[After all, although the Water Star of Nine Stars Pavilion targeted him intentionally just now, neither side had reached the point of a life-and-death struggle. An Emperor’s battle had far-reaching effects, and he would not force the other Emperor into a desperate situation.]
[Following that, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor prepared to depart. As the clash of Emperors left him unable to divert his attention, his focus had been solely on the other Emperor, not daring to let down his guard. Consequently, he had not discovered your existence.]
[However, just as he was about to leave, he finally noticed you and his expression changed. Then, in an instant, he appeared at the site of your fall, his face grave.]
[Although the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor of this lifetime had not met you, he knew of your existence as an Unparalleled Genius who had joined Taiyi Imperial Palace in the Last Dharma Age, and it was through the palace master who stayed behind that he remembered your aura.]
[Since you sneaked into the Profound Small Universe and snatched someone away from Two quasi-Emperors with two Emperor’s artifacts, you had disappeared. This had prompted Taiyi Imperial Palace to look for you.]
[Unfortunately, even with Taiyi Imperial Palace’s intelligence network, they had found nothing. Therefore, while the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor searched for his daughter, he also looked for you.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor never expected that you would appear in the Guimo Sea, and your evident demise was due to the aftermath of his battle with the other Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 245: Yu Daoyi's determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Chapter 245: Yu Daoyi’s determination! Farewell to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor _5
[This left Heavenly Feather Great Emperor silent, not knowing what to say. You had survived in the Guimo Sea for a hundred thousand years and were eventually killed by the aftermath of his battle—truly a cruel twist of fate.]
[In the end, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor let out a sigh, filled with guilt and sorrow. However, his face quickly changed to a look of surprise.]
[Because Cai Yonglong suddenly came back to life. Afterward, you were resurrected as well.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor looked at you both after the resurrection, and after his initial surprise, he couldn’t help but smile. It wasn’t particularly shocking or unusual for people of the Myriad Heavens like you to have a rare Resurrection Item.]
[Your resurrection spared Heavenly Feather Great Emperor from the embarrassment of killing his own genius, eliminating a stain on his life and also providing a true successor for the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Having Supreme Cultivation and surviving so many years in the Guimo Sea was indeed a miracle. With your existence, you could be expected to become immortal in the future.]
...
[However, looking at Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you couldn’t help but feel guilty. In your eyes, perhaps Yu Daoyi wouldn’t have died. With her ability, she might have been able to survive until Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s arrival.]
[Even though in your simulations, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had always been incommunicado and might not have been able to save Yu Daoyi, you still felt that you were responsible for her death.]
[Upon detecting your emotions, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor looked at you with confusion. After a moment of silence, you recounted some events.]
[After listening, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor fell silent, his emotions complex as he looked at you, not expecting his daughter to have fallen into the hands of the Terrifying Demon Shadow in the Guimo Sea.]
[Seeing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s silence, you expressed your guilt, apologizing for causing Yu Daoyi’s death. Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shook his head, saying it wasn’t your fault, and that it was the path his daughter, Yu Daoyi, had chosen.]
[After saying this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor closed his eyes in pain, lamenting that Yu Daoyi’s temperament remained the same – gentle and soft like her mother on ordinary days, but impulsive and resolute once faced with a situation. Why couldn’t she wait for some time before seeking revenge?]
[Hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, you couldn’t help but smile bitterly. You felt that communication between a father and daughter was genuinely necessary. Perhaps if he had explained that he was in hiding earlier and asked his daughter not to act rashly, this could have been avoided.]
[Of course, there was no point in dwelling on this now. Your only hope was that the simulated Wang Ping would prevent such tragedies from happening in the future.]
[Next, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor quickly put his thoughts away and returned to his usual demeanor, saying that he would first take you out of the Guimo Sea, and then find the Terrifying Demon Shadow that had killed his daughter and exterminate it.]
[Hearing this, you understood Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s thoughts. In the past, when his Tao Companion was killed, he chose to hide. Now, although knowing that staying in the Guimo Sea and pursuing the Terrifying Demon Shadow was not responsible for the Taiyi Imperial Palace and would put himself in danger, he still made this choice. Without doing so, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s heart wouldn’t be at ease.]
[In the end, you didn’t say anything more nor tried to persuade Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, as you weren’t in a position to do so.]
[Afterward, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor took you out of the Guimo Sea. Though there were many dangers encountered along the way, they were easily suppressed by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, as these dangers weren’t significant even to a Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection.]
[Soon, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor brought you out of the Guimo Sea. Then, without hesitation, he plunged back in, rushing towards its depths.]
[Sighing, you chose to leave the area with Cai Yonglong and set out on the path back to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Upon returning to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you met the Supreme Palace Master who had stayed behind in the Last Dharma Age. Seeing you, he wore a shocked expression as if he had seen a ghost.]
[After all, you had disappeared for a hundred thousand years, and he genuinely believed that you had fallen. At the same time, he couldn’t help but wonder if you were a spy for another force and had found an opportunity to abscond with their funds.]
[He thought so because it was only natural for people to have such doubts. After all, you hadn’t stayed in the Taiyi Imperial Palace for long after joining, only borrowing Emperor’s artifacts and requesting resources before wandering away and eventually disappearing.]
[Now that he saw you had returned, he was naturally astounded and somewhat uncertain.]
[Seeing the Supreme Palace Master’s reaction, you felt embarrassed. You knew your actions were unusual and understandably suspicious.]
[Next, you recounted your experiences, trying to prove your innocence.]
[However, after hearing your story, the Supreme Palace Master was dumbfounded and began to doubt his understanding of life.]

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 246: Deep Fog! The Origins of the Top Ten Forbidden Areas!
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Chapter 246: Deep Fog! The Origins of the Top Ten Forbidden Areas!
[The Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace never thought that you would end up going to a place like Guimo Sea, surviving there for a hundred thousand years and ultimately returning alive.]
[That’s Guimo Sea, a ghostly place, where even a Great Emperor would be in danger, let alone a Supreme. Your fate, in the eyes of the Supreme Palace Master, is truly unmatched.]
[As for the shock of the Supreme Palace Master, you shake your head, not saying much. After chatting a few more times, you bid farewell. You decide to keep the matter regarding Yu Daoyi and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor a secret. It can’t be helped; there are too many secrets involved.]
[Although the Supreme Palace Master is the one who stayed behind during the Last Dharma Age, there was no need to reveal anything to him. Of course, more than that, you were unwilling to speak. Thinking of Yu Daoyi, your heart aches.]
…..
“Well, this really is a slap in the face. I never thought that simulated Wang Ping would actually return to Taiyi Imperial Palace alive.”
...
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, filled with emotions.
The plot development really doesn’t follow the usual pattern.
He thought he was dead several times, but he managed to survive each time.
“Although it’s a slap in the face, it’s also a good thing, worth being happy about.”
Wang Ping shook his head and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you don’t remain too low-key, but you don’t become high-profile either. Because you are already a Supreme and due to your age of over a hundred thousand years, you do not become an Emperor’s son of Taiyi Imperial Palace but an elder instead.]
[You don’t care about becoming an elder, and continue doing your own thing, accepting disciples like Zhu Huowang and watching the Tianjiao War silently. This time, you observe their battle from the perspective of an elder, which brings a different set of emotions.]
[Once the Immortal Mansion is about to open, you still manage to save the little female Taoist and little male Taoist before Ku Xuan. You have some interactions with Ku Xuan.]
[This time, Ku Xuan comes to you again. Regarding this, you don’t treat Ku Xuan as you did in the last simulation, but instead, you hint that you and Ku Xuan have a good affinity and should become brothers. If Ku Xuan is in danger, you will definitely help him.]
[Listening to your words, Ku Xuan frowns, feeling that there is a hidden meaning in your speech. After giving you a deep look, he chooses to decline.]
[You regret this, but you don’t force the matter. In the end, you still refuse Ku Xuan’s request, choosing to keep the little female Taoist and little male Taoist.]
[After Ku Xuan leaves, you continue to research what is special about the little female Taoist and little male Taoist. However, to your disappointment, you still haven’t discovered anything special about them, even though your cultivation has now reached the Superme Realm Peak, and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye is developed into a Minor Domain. You still can’t see anything special about them.]
[At the same time, although you really want to accept the two as disciples and see whether they could help improve your cultivation, you cannot improve your cultivation now without comprehending two-fifths of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit; taking them as disciples would be a waste of talent. Hence, you can only suppress your thoughts, hoping that after entering the Immortal Mansion and quickly gaining Enlightenment with its resources, you can then accept the two as disciples.]
[As for the issue that you are too old and being a Supreme, you can’t enter the trial, you don’t worry about it. The Immortal Mansion is not only open to young talents. Those Tianjiaos who are_expected to enter the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification can actually enter without need for assessment.]
[Because being able to enter the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification already proves their talent and potential, there is no need for further testing. You should know, these Tianjiaos undergoing normal assessments, although many of them claim to have Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and even Great Emperor talent, whether they can become Supremes is a question, incomparable to those who have already stepped into the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification.]
[Therefore, this time you intend to prevent the two from entering the Immortal Mansion for assessment. During their last trial, both were teleported to the secret realm along with you and then disappeared. You suspect they were either captured or killed by Ku Xuan and the Black Fog Silhouettes.]
[As the Immortal Mansion is about to open, you stand outside, quietly watching the Tianjiaos undergo the first two rounds of assessment. You know what will happen next, but you can’t say anything.]
[If you say something, the future will change drastically. Of course, you don’t mind changing the future, but you are afraid that if you unravel the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s plan, he will kill you in advance.]
[You are unwilling to bear the consequences of dying early. After all, you want to use the remaining time to break through to the Earth Emperor Realm, continue accepting disciples to become stronger, and work hard to increase your cultivation.]
[Soon, time quietly passes, and the secret realm of the Immortal Mansion has been open for a long time. You know that the Immortal Mansion should be aware of the trouble inside, and a similar event to what you remember will occur next.]
[However, you are skeptical about how many Tianjiaos will be able to come out this time. After all, in the last simulation, it was because of your presence that about a thousand Tianjiaos were left.]
[This time, you are not inside, and it is unknown how many people can survive. With no one to hold off the anomaly, it absolutely has the power to kill everyone.]
[As you ponder, the results come out. As the Immortal Mansion takes action, you find that there are only a little over five hundred Tianjiao survivors this time, all of them in a miserable state.]

chapters.title: Chapter 908: 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Areas!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Chapter 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Areas!_2
[At the same time, you noticed Ku Xuan among them. This narrows your eyes because you know Ku Xuan is putting on a show. He is an odd pawn placed by the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion inside the Immortal Mansion.]
[However, you feel that this pawn could be removed. After all, when the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion successfully refines the Upper Realm, he will become truly invincible. He won’t need to plant a pawn inside the Immortal Mansion as an insurance policy or to investigate its secrets.]
[Of course, those big shots often like to prepare many backups and you can understand. Besides, from the perspective of the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, refining the Upper Realm definitely has significant risks. Even he would not assume that he would definitely succeed.]
[While you are thinking, with a genius dying horribly, all the forces are enraged once again. This time, without your revelation of Ku Xuan’s secrets, the Ku family was not targeted, and therefore the Immortal Mansion bore the wrath of all the forces.]
[Even Ku Xuan’s origin suffered a huge blow, which caused the Ku family to step forward. This time, they, together with various factions, exerted pressure on the Immortal Mansion. The Immortal Mansion, this time, struggled under the pressure from all sides.]
…
...
“Strange…”
Wang Ping looks at the text simulation’s contents, frowning feeling extremely strange.
In this simulation, even without his intervention, why didn’t Ku Xuan die?
Normally, once the trickster successfully obtains the Chaotic Body, he would be caught and refined by the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
Then, Ku Xuan will become a death puppet, being consumed by the trickster.
However, in this simulation, Ku Xuan didn’t die? This means the trickster didn’t die.
Why didn’t the trickster die?
Wang Ping doesn’t think it’s because the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion has suddenly turned kind.
“Wrong, the previous simulation provided correct information, but there’s a big issue.”
Wang Ping thinks about it and quickly realises something.
That the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion is the mastermind behind everything, and he is working with the trickster, seems to be his speculation.
Although his speculation seems close to the truth, and everything could be reasonably explained, it still remains a speculation and might not be accurate.
Is the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion really calculating everything? Is he really cooperating with the trickster?
Would the trickster, who is not a fool, be so foolish to cooperate with the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion who can toy with him at will?
The trickster should know how powerful and dangerous the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion is, right?
Moreover, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion is from the All Heavens, so the trickster would naturally be more wary of him.
Under these circumstances, it doesn’t seem like there are any preconditions for the two sides to cooperate.
As for why the trickster, after acquiring the Chaotic Body and escaping, initiated the Great Array after more than a hundred years, it may just be a coincidence.
Because it’s a coincidence, it only gave rise to my seemingly reasonable speculations last time.
Only, there is still a question, why does the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion also have a Chaotic Body?
Did he accidentally see the trickster Crossing the Tribulation and just picked up the leftovers?
If that’s the case, then the trickster is really unlucky.
Or is it that the Devouring Immortal Demon Body has really been monitored, and the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion is not involved in the plot, he just watched the trickster’s struggle, and took advantage of the situation?
“The sudden butterfly effect has really confused me. However, my speculation this time might not be correct either…
Wang Ping massages his forehead, feeling somewhat helpless.
Next, Wang Ping composes himself and continues to stare at the luminescent screen, eager to see the plot progression and whether the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion would still refine the Upper Realm.
[Eventually, with all sides continuing to exert pressure, the Immortal Mansion could no longer withstand it and began to apologize to all sides, discussing a range of matters.]
[You don’t know what these old monsters discussed. You just thought about the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and whether he is still alive. After all, he has disappeared again and has not returned.]
[However, all you can do is sigh – you are incapable of changing anything. After all, when the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor plunged deep into the Guimo Sea chasing after the Terrifying Demon Shadow, you couldn’t stop him, you could only pray for him.]
[Not long after, you find that each faction has Quasi-Emperors emerging who reside in the Immortal Mansion and became teachers there. Besides, the Immortal Mansion once again recruited prodigies from all different forces. This time, the age limit has been greatly loosened, and the quota for entry after the opening of the Immortal Door has also been compromised.]
[Clearly, this is a compromise by the Immortal Mansion. Facing the oppression of various forces from the Upper Realm, led by the Ku family, the Immortal Mansion had no choice but to let the forces infiltrate like this.]
[This is the best outcome. If a war breaks out, no matter how strong the Immortal Mansion is, it is impossible to withstand the collective pressure from all factions in the Upper Realm.]
[Of course, although all factions stand on the same line for their own interests, it’s unlikely they would truly go to war with the Immortal Mansion. Once a deathmatch with the Immortal Mansion truly occurs, with the capabilities of the Immortal Mansion, even if the Longevity Ku family were present, they could still suffer heavy losses.]
[After all, no one knows what trump cards the Immortal Mansion holds, nor who is hiding inside and how powerful they are. No one wants to force the Immortal Mansion into a deathmatch without assurance.]
[Not long after, you also entered the Immortal Mansion. However, you didn’t use that special allocation place but entered by your own capabilities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 909: 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Areas!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 909: Chapter 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Areas!_3
[After entering the Immortal Mansion, you want to enter the secret realm of the Immortal Mansion for cultivation. This time, you are not a heroic character, so you won’t be treated specially.]
[However, because this matter has blown up, with the involvement of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you still manage to enter it without any difficulty. ]
[Of course, this isn’t because of the compensation for Yu Daohong’s fall, but because of the benefits gained through the joint efforts of Taiyi Imperial Palace and other forces.]
[You are aware that the entrance to the Dream Demon Secret Realm is a trap, so naturally, you stop Yu Daohong and others from entering it, stating that even if you don’t enter, you can still enter the Immortal Mansion. Yu Daohong doesn’t understand this, but he still listens to you.]
[This incident also makes Yu Daohong and the old monsters of Taiyi Imperial Palace quite astonished, after all, your knowing in advance about the dangers within the secret realm is quite extraordinary. However, they don’t intend to question you. After all, you couldn’t possibly harm Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Following that, you cultivate and seek enlightenment in the secret realm of the Immortal Mansion. This secret realm is even stronger than the one you entered previously, allowing you to better comprehend the Heavenly Tao True Spirit.]
...
[As a result, you successfully comprehend two-tenths of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao within a hundred years. Of course, this is also due to your constant seeking of enlightenment in the previous hundred thousand years, though you couldn’t comprehend the Heavenly Tao True Spirit, you still laid a solid foundation for yourself, reaching a bottleneck. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been so easy to comprehend.]
[However, to your disappointment, after your enlightenment, accepting the little female Taoist and little male Taoist as your disciples did not bring about any breakthrough in your cultivation. You remain stuck at the Supreme Realm Peak.]
[This makes you quite puzzled. Logically, the special nature of the two should have allowed your cultivation to make some breakthroughs.]
[In the end, you really can’t understand what is going on with the two of them, so you can only put those thoughts aside, planning to break through to the Earth Emperor Tier by yourself. Of course, you also know that you probably won’t be able to break through to the Earth Emperor Tier in this simulation.]
[After all, at this point in time, it is already very close to when the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion plans to refine the Upper Realm.]
[So, what you need to think about is how to protect your own life. In the previous simulation, although the text simulation described the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion successfully refining the Upper Realm, this does not mean that everything in the Upper Realm was refined by him.]
[In your opinion, there are still a few places that he probably couldn’t refine. Among them, the Source of Darkness is definitely impossible to be refined, and the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion wouldn’t dare to provoke the Source of Darkness, so he would definitely avoid it during the refining process.]
[However, the Source of Darkness is too terrifying, and you can’t possibly enter it either, so it’s not a place where you can save your life.]
[The second one is the Elemental Forbidden Land. In your eyes, there is still something odd about this place. When you were very weak, you only felt that the giant dark shadow within it was extremely powerful, and the sealed heart was extremely powerful, but you didn’t know how powerful it actually was.]
[Now, with your cultivation reaching the Supreme tier, plus your Breaking Origin Sky Eye, which has reached the Minor Domain, you believe that the terror of the heart and the giant dark shadow is beyond the level of an ordinary Emperor. Even when stored in your memory, you still feel a palpitation when you recall it. To be precise, the stronger you are, the more palpitation you feel.]
[Because of this, you suspect whether the existence in the Elemental Forbidden Land is related to the immortals. The Elemental Forbidden Land itself is a special forbidden place that exists to seal the immortals. If it is related to immortals, it may not be able to be refined, and hiding in it might save your life.]
[The third one is the Life and Death Realm. The Life and Death Realm is an existence above the Ten Forbidden Lands. In your opinion, it is even more eerie and dangerous than the Elemental Forbidden Land and is very likely to be an area that cannot be refined.]
[However, no matter which place it is, all of them are extremely dangerous, with entrance possibly resulting in little to no chance of survival.]
[But even if the forbidden lands are dangerous, you don’t want to sit idly by waiting for the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion to refine you. You want to hold on to that slim chance of life.]
[Therefore, after much deliberation, you secretly disclose the plans of Nine Stars Pavilion, hoping to attract the attention of the powerful beings in the Upper Realm and make them interfere in advance. As long as they kill the Nine Stars hidden in the Nine Great Forbidden Lands, perhaps they can stop the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion from refining the Upper Realm.]
[In addition, you return to Taiyi Imperial Palace and tell them what you know, hoping that the Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace will believe in your ability to foresee the future and cooperate with you to go to the Elemental Forbidden Land to escape the deadly tribulation.]
[In response to your words, the Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace are also astonished and torn. After all, you previously predicted that something would go wrong in the secret realm, so they have to listen to you and won’t think of it as a prank.]
[However, giving up everything and relocating the entire sect is a decision of enormous consequences, and it must be carefully considered.]
[When the Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace are undecided, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor unexpectedly returns.]
[At this time, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has suffered heavy injuries, his aura is unstable, and people are worried. The Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace are also astonished, not expecting the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to be so severely injured.]

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Lands!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 910: Chapter 246 Deep Fog! The Origin of the Ten Forbidden Lands!_4
[In fact, you didn’t seem surprised, but even relieved. The return of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is certainly better than no news as in the previous simulation. Apparently, due to the incident with you and Yu Daoyi, the script has changed.]
[Thinking of Yu Daoyi again, you fell silent and felt quite uneasy.]
[Next, you asked what the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor experienced in the Guimo Sea and why he sustained such severe injuries. In reply, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor calmly stated that he forced his way into the depths of the Guimo Sea and killed the Terrifying Demon Shadow.]
[Impressed with this, you felt that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor truly lived up to his name. He was magnificent enough to kill the Terrifying Demon Shadow in the depths of the Guimo Sea, something not every Emperor is capable of.]
[Then, you guessed whether the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s injuries were related to his battle with the Terrifying Demon Shadow or was it an attack from other emperors. Heavenly Feather Great Emperor nodded and then shook his head at your guess.]
[Indeed, he was injured in battle with the Terrifying Demon Shadow. As the Guimo Sea was the Terrifying Demon Shadow’s main territory and there’s more than one such demon, he was considerably wounded after annihilating three of them. However, the reason for his severe injuries was something he found afterwards.]
...
[With a deep gaze, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor revealed that he had discovered some secrets of the Guimo Sea, and subsequently, was attacked by Mercury of the Nine Stars Pavilion. This led to his severe injuries, and he nearly fell in the Guimo Sea.]
[Listening to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, you understood it all. You were not surprised with his answer. You had previously guessed that the Emperor who battled the Heavenly Feather Emperor was most likely Mercury from the Nine Stars Pavilion—the one who betrayed Yu Daoyi.]
[As the plan of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion is about to unfold, Mercury would certainly remain in the Guimo Sea. The closer it gets to the starting point of the plan, the more ruthless he becomes, probably targeting anyone who enters the Guimo Sea.]
[As for why he betrayed Yu Daoyi during the Last Dharma Age, that remains a mystery.]
[Next, you asked the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor what the secret of the Guimo Sea was. In response to your inquiry, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not refrain but decided to reveal it.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor expressed that the Guimo Sea is highly likely not a natural forbidden land, but a manmade one, born out of the stolen World Source of the Tri-Profound Universe. And the one who possibly stole the World Source of the Tri-Profound Universe could be Mercury from the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[In the end, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor paused for a moment and stated that Mercury couldn’t have accomplished it by himself, and it was probably the doing of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion. Only the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion who came from All Heavens, with immeasurable power, could possibly possess such ability.]
[Hearing this answer, you were stunned. You never expected the Guimo Sea, a forbidden area, to be artificially created, let alone by stealing the World Source of the Tri-Profound Universe. Such a method is indeed horrifying and crazily audacious.]
[After all, stealing the World Source would first provoke Heavenly Tao; Heavenly Tao would never tolerate such acts. Then, those who commit such deeds could easily be labeled as Chaotic Evil Forces and be hunted down by the Chaotic Orderly Forces.]
[Of course, in the Upper Realm, there are all kinds of forces. Even if they were discovered and their actions were not overly excessive, no major issues would likely occur. After all, as Alpha described, more powerful beings than the Emperors cannot descend into this Profound World easily. With the strength of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, if they are not targeted by the powerful beings of All Heavens, they won’t be in any trouble.]
[Would the powerful beings of All Heavens care about a minor character like the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion and his actions? Clearly, it’s impossible.]
[Nevertheless, what concerns you more is whether the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion carries out such deeds without any consequences from Heavenly Tao? Even if the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion is a quasi-Fairy, Heavenly Tao should not allow him to run amok. A quasi-Fairy shouldn’t possess the capacity to confront the Upper Realm’s Heavenly Tao.]
[At the same time, you thought of the other forbidden lands. There are ten forbidden lands in the Upper Realm altogether. Since the Guimo Sea of the Tri-Profound Universe was artificially created, what about the other Nine Great Forbidden Lands? Were they also created in such a manner by the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion?]
[If that was the case, it’s truly horrific upon deeper thought. You can’t help but suspect that there must be something wrong with the Heavenly Tao of the Upper Realm.]
[I should say, there’s a high chance that there has always been a problem. After considering it carefully, the existence of the terrifying Source of Darkness in the Upper Realm surely would have agitated the Heavenly Tao of the Upper Realm, it cannot possibly remain unaffected.]”If the Heavenly Tao of the Upper Realm is continually corroding and weakening due to the influence of the Source of Darkness, it would make sense that the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion could do something like this.+”
“He can steal the World Source, creating Forbidden Lands, and then use the Ten Forbidden Lands as a foundation to lay down a shocking Great Array to refine the Upper Realm. His strength and astonishing plans are one thing, but more importantly, the Heavenly Tao itself is in a weakened state, unable to resist him.”
“In addition to this, the emergence of Sons of Fortune like Ye Chen, and even the reborn Ji Ziqing, can be understood more clearly. This could be the Heavenly Tao attempting to save itself, or it could be a system bug that appeared after the Heavenly Tao had a problem.”
….
“Damn it, this is really outrageous, but I should have guessed it sooner.”
Wang Ping rubbing his forehead as he read the contents of the Text Simulation.
He could not possibly have imagined the origins of the Ten Forbidden Lands.
But not thinking about the abnormality of the Heavenly Tao was indeed careless.
The presence of the dangerous Source of Darkness meant that trouble with the Heavenly Tao was inevitable. Even if the Forces of Chaos were probably restraining the main body of the Source of Darkness, making it seem less harmful, it does not change anything.”
The level of the Source of Darkness is too high. Even if it is not causing outbreaks and instead exists quietly, it is not something that a single world can easily bear.”
Let alone the fact that the Source of Darkness has indeed caused outbreaks. The occurrences of Dark Disasters serve as evidence.”
Dark Disasters could be caused by an Emperor within the Source of Darkness, or they could result from a minor outbreak from the Source of Darkness itself.”
Regardless, the Source of Darkness is an entity that cannot be ignored, and Wang Ping had indeed been neglectful of the influence of the Source of Darkness before. It was really careless and an elementary mistake.+”
However, Wang Ping thinks that this may also be related to the low presence of the Source of Darkness.”
In the previous simulations, the only time the Source of Darkness was represented was when Wang Ping was at Elemental Star running a simulation of a minor Dark Disaster. After that, it was mostly about the Emperors who entered in order to self-seal and save their lives.”
And then there was the Master of Nine Star Pavilion daring to collect Dark Energy to create the Devouring Immortal Demon Body.”
All of this led one to instinctively think that the Source of Darkness was temporarily harmless.”
“But, knowing these secrets, it’s not possible to destroy the Forbidden Lands. The bigger issue is…if the Forbidden Lands were really created by the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion through stealing the World Source, do they have means to control the power of the Forbidden Lands? If they do, even many Emperors may not be able to kill Mercury.”
“No, that’s not right. Since they were successful in the end, there must be a way to control the power of the Forbidden Lands. However, whether it was dealing with Yu Daoyi or the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, they did not use this control. More than likely, they thought it was not worth doing, as the time to activate was not yet here. Such a method could only be utilized when refining the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping sighed lightly, finding it difficult to remain indifferent.”
Once again uncovering the secrets of the Nine Stars Pavilion, and even deeper secrets at that, was truly something difficult to remain calm about.”

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 247: Taiyi Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 911: Chapter 247: Taiyi Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars!
[Next, Emperor Tianyu made a decision, preparing to move to the Elemental Forbidden Land at any time. As for the Life and Death Realm, that place was too dangerous, and certain death awaited those who went, so it was naturally not within the range of choices.]
[Seeing that Emperor Tianyu had made a decision, the other Quasi-emperor Ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace naturally wouldn’t say much. And you, too, breathed a sigh of relief. After all, having Emperor Tianyu in charge would be much stronger than you.]
[However, you also thought about the matter of the Elemental Forbidden Land and asked Emperor Tianyu again, hoping that he could provide an answer. You had asked about this in a previous simulation, but Emperor Tianyu didn’t answer you because your cultivation was too low. Now that you have become a Supreme and reached this moment, Emperor Tianyu would certainly not hide it anymore.]
[In response to your inquiry, Emperor Tianyu provided an answer after pondering for a while, and the content shocked you.]
[As it turned out, the Elemental Forbidden Land really had something to do with immortals. The existence of the Elemental Forbidden Land might date back even further than the Ku family and the Immortal Mansions and could be traced back to several epochs ago. The Elemental Forbidden Land did not appear on the Elemental Ancient Star, but rather, it was the exact place where the Elemental Ancient Star was formed, which is why it was called the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[In fact, no one knows the real name of the Elemental Forbidden Land. According to his research on the relics, the Upper Realm was able to give birth to Divine Realm Experts in the distant past, and the channel to the Immortal Domain was also open. Just as Void lords could normally ascend to the Upper Realm, if someone became immortal in the Upper Realm, they could also normally ascend to the Immortal World. Even perhaps, one didn’t need to become immortal; just becoming a Supreme could allow them to travel to the Immortal Domain through the channel between the Two Realms.]
...
[However, for some unknown reason, the Immortal Domain Channel was closed, and the environment in the Upper Realm made it impossible for cultivators to become immortals, with immortals gradually becoming legends, making many cultivators doubt their existence.]
[The Elemental Forbidden Land is one of the places that prove the existence of immortals. Within the Elemental Forbidden Land, there is a sealed immortal. Its body was severed, and its internal organs were extracted and sealed in different places. The purpose of the Elemental Forbidden Land’s existence is to seal the immortals. It is very likely that, in the distant past, this immortal committed unforgivable acts that incurred the wrath of an even more powerful being, who used this method to dismember and seal them.]
[However, perhaps the vitality of the immortals was too tenacious. Even after being dismembered, having their innards extracted and sealed for so many years, the immortal in the Elemental Forbidden Land still did not die. Even single organs had power that terrified even the Emperor.]
[Once, there were Emperors who entered the Elemental Forbidden Land, wanting to break the seal, seize the organs of the immortals, refine them, and become immortal themselves. Unfortunately, all these Emperors failed, and none of them survived.]
[As a result, if they were to enter the Elemental Forbidden Land, there might be a chance of preserving the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Of course, the risks involved were also great. However, as long as they didn’t tamper with the seal or provoke the sealed immortal, there was still some hope of survival.]
[Listening to Emperor Tianyu’s description, you were deeply shocked. You never imagined that there would indeed be an immortal in the Elemental Forbidden Land, an immortal from a far-off era, from a time when the Upper Realm could still give birth to immortals.]
[Then, you recalled that you had once entered the Elemental Forbidden Land in a simulation when you were still a saintly shrimp, and couldn’t help but feel a bit peculiar, thinking that you had really courted death. Even an Emperor would perish in there, and you, a saint, entered to obtain a piece of stone and even tried to break the seal to touch the heart. If this got out, people would surely laugh you to death.]
[After Emperor Tianyu finished speaking, he instructed the Ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace to make various preparations.]
[As for you, you wanted Emperor Tianyu to intervene and persuade the Immortal Mansion Alliance to march together towards the Ten Forbidden Lands to disrupt the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s plan.]
[Upon hearing this, Emperor Tianyu naturally wouldn’t refuse. After all, it would be a better choice to successfully sabotage the plan of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion than to escape to the Forbidden Land.]
[For this reason, Emperor Tianyu stepped forward and began discussing various matters with the experts of the Immortal Mansion Alliance. In the end, the experts of the Immortal Mansion Alliance chose to believe in Emperor Tianyu and launched an attack on the Forbidden Guimo Sea in the Tri-Profound Universe, attempting to make the first move by killing Mercury.]
[The actions of the Immortal Mansion Alliance did not escape the attention of the Nine Stars Pavilion. In response, the Nine Stars Pavilion initiated a Great Array without hesitation, connecting the Ten Forbidden Lands into a single entity.]
[In the end, the raid by the Immortal Mansion Alliance still failed.]
…
“Logically, a conference with only the Emperor participating should not have leaked any information. There’s a traitor within the Immortal Mansion Alliance… I have a feeling that Emperor Fengxin is very likely the traitor.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, raising his eyebrows slightly.
In the next simulation, try to kill Emperor Fengxin first to see if the plot changes.
“In the end, it will have to step into the Elemental Forbidden Land.”
Wang Ping shook his head again and looked at the luminescent screen somewhat helplessly.
[Due to the failure of the Immortal Mansion Alliance to stop the Nine Stars Pavilion, the Taiyi Imperial Palace relocated to the Elemental Forbidden Land for the first time.]
[When the Taiyi Imperial Palace came to the Elemental Forbidden Land, the whole Upper Realm began to be refined, and there was not much difference from the last simulation. The difference was that you hid in the Elemental Forbidden Land this time and were not refined.]

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Increased Cultivation! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 912: Chapter 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Increased Cultivation! _2
[It must be said that the Elemental Forbidden Land is indeed special, as a place for sealing immortality. It is very extraordinary, and the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion has no power to refine it. He also chose to avoid this place.]
[In the end, you managed to survive on the outskirts of the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[However, you and the Ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace cannot be happy even though you managed to save your lives. That is because the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has fallen, and the entire Upper Realm has disappeared. The Upper Realm has been refined, and everything ceases to exist, making future cultivation impossible. In other words, although you have saved your lives, you have no way to advance.]
[It is said that there is still some secret land and treasures in the Taiyi Imperial Palace that could help your cultivation, even if the Upper Realm is gone, but it will eventually be like rootless duckweed, and the resources would be exhausted sooner or later.]
[While you are feeling heavy-hearted, a loud laughter rings out, and the terrifying Chaos Light illuminates the boundless darkness of the Void. Terrifying Immortal Strength ripples in all directions.]
[Obviously, this is caused by the metamorphosis of the Chaotic Body after the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion succeeded in refining the Upper Realm. At the same time, he also became immortal.]
...
[You felt the breath of this event, and your heart was heavy, struggling to breathe.]
[However, this breath soon disappeared, and the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion had just broken through and intended to retreat and consolidate his cultivation. Maybe when he completely stabilizes his cultivation, it would be time for him to forcefully breach the Immortal Domain Channel and go to the Immortal Domain.]
[Of course, he might also make a move against Elemental Forbidden Land and other places before going to the Immortal Domain. After all, if it were the past, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion and his peers would not dare to take such risks. However, now that he has become immortal and possesses a Perfect Chaotic Body, he no longer needs to fear the immortals in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[Because of this, you feel that although you have escaped the first wave of disaster, you are still not safe. You must not only deal with the potential dangers in the Elemental Forbidden Land but also face the thunderous blow of the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[After pondering, you suppress the negative emotions in your heart and ask the Quasi-emperor Ancestor of Taiyi Imperial Palace if there are ways for you to become stronger quickly.]
[The Quasi-emperor Ancestor hesitates for a moment before giving an answer. On the highest floor of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, there is a small world called the Supreme Heavenly Path left by the Taiyi Great Emperor. It is said that there are many mysteries within it. If one enters, they will fight against numerous Supremes from the past and the present Supremes, including those who successfully proved the Tao.]
[Of course, facing those powerhouses who have proved the Tao, the battle would be fair and in the same realm.]
[If someone can pass through the Supreme Heavenly Path, they will receive many benefits, with their cultivation soaring directly to the peak of Heavenly Supreme. However, if they cannot pass through the path, they will fall completely.]
[Since the Supreme Heavenly Path in Taiyi Emperor Tower is extremely dangerous, it is rarely opened by Taiyi Imperial Palace. From ancient times to present-day, the Emperor’s Sons who entered have basically fallen and very few have come out alive.]
[Even in the past, when Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was at the Supreme Realm, he wanted to enter and try his luck, but he was stopped by the predecessors of Taiyi Imperial Palace and was not allowed to enter.]
[Listening to the words of the Quasi-emperor Ancestors, your heart is shocked. You never thought that there was such a secret hidden in the Taiyi Emperor Tower, it could actually manifest the many Supremes that have ever existed and fight with them.]
[Being able to fight with the many extraordinary Supremes of the past and present, even if there weren’t any rewards that could allow your cultivation to soar to the peak of the Heavenly Supreme realm, Wang Ping still believes that this is a great opportunity. After all, fighting with so many remarkable people and their laws colliding with yours would provide great benefits and broaden your path.]
[Immediately, you express your desire to challenge the Supreme Heavenly Path to increase your strength.]
[Regarding your determination, the Quasi-emperor Ancestors sigh and do not stop you. After all, at this point, there is no need to prevent you from trying. No matter what you do next, there will be crises everywhere, so it is better to let you try the Supreme Heavenly Path and maybe create a miracle to increase your cultivation.]
[If you can go through the Supreme Heavenly Path and receive the rewards, perhaps the Taiyi Imperial Palace could add a Quasi-emperor level powerhouse to their ranks.]
[Next, as the Taiyi Emperor Tower opens, you proceed directly to the highest floor and begin your trial in the Supreme Heavenly Path.]
[It must be said that the Supreme Heavenly Path is indeed terrifying. The manifested Supreme beings become stronger one after another, and after defeating one, you will only have a limited time to rest. Even if you stay in the same place and don’t go deeper, a new Supreme will appear, and this Supreme will be even more formidable.]
[This tests not only the battle power in the same realm but also endurance and willpower.]
[However, you are very strong. Your battle power, within the same realm, is definitely the most outstanding existence. Even a Chaotic Body won’t be your opponent if they haven’t achieved a Minor Chaos Body. If you use all your talents unreservedly, you can even confidently fight against a Minor Chaos Body face to face.]
[As a result, as you delve deeper into the Supreme Heavenly Path, Great Emperor Tier characters have already appeared, but you remain fearless and confront them head-on. What’s a Great Emperor? As long as it’s in the Supreme cultivation realm, Wang Ping is not afraid to fight in the same realm, with an invincible heart, and can kill with a single punch.]
[Even toward the end, you have encountered the shadows of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, Erebos Emperor, Dark Time Emperor and other familiar and more powerful figures. Nonetheless, you remain fearless and continue to strike them down forcefully.]

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 913: Chapter 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _3
[Finally, you forcefully defeated many powerful Supremes from ancient times to the present, and broke through the Supreme Heavenly Path. During this process, although you were injured from the continuous battles and almost exhausted, you eventually made it through and were tempered in various aspects.]
[As you stepped onto the end of the Supreme Heavenly Path, a figure appeared, which surprised you greatly.]
[Because this figure was the Taiyi Great Emperor, the Ancestor who created the Taiyi Imperial Palace. After seeing the Taiyi Great Emperor, you solemnly paid your respects.]
[After the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor saw you, he was also quite pleased and full of praise, stating that after so many years, someone finally broke through the Supreme Heavenly Path and came to meet him.]
[You were quite surprised at this and then curiously asked the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor why he set the Taiyi Sky Road so difficult and that failing would result in their fall, which seemed to have no benefits for the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In response to your question, the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor had a deep gaze and slowly stated that some things were not bearable by ordinary heaven’s favorites. Therefore, high-difficulty assessments must be set. In this way, true successors with both determination and talent could be screened.]
...
[Although this would inevitably lead to the untimely death of many talented individuals from the Taiyi Imperial Palace, as time went on, those who dared to challenge the Supreme Heavenly Path would become more and more outstanding.]
[You shook your head, saying that the difficulty was too high, and that even characters who could become an Emperor Monarch would not be able to break through this level of difficulty.]
[The phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor smiled and said that he just saw how strong you were and raised the difficulty to the highest level, wanting to see your full strength.]
[Hearing this, you were speechless and understood why the Supreme Heavenly Path was so perverted.]
[At this time, the Taiyi Great Emperor also stated that although he did increase the difficulty, the normal difficulty was not something that a junior with the potential to become an Emperor-Level character could pass. After saying that, the Taiyi Great Emperor highly praised you for being the most incredible character he had ever seen.]
[You were quite surprised at the words of the Taiyi Great Emperor and appreciated his evaluation. Then, you remembered the matter of the reward and started to inquire.]
[The phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor nodded and directly gave you the reward. In an instant, a large number of light orbs appeared and entered your body.]
[Then, you entered a wonderful state of Enlightenment and gradually comprehended three-tenths of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao. At the same time, your cultivation began to skyrocket, directly rising from the Peak of Superme to the peak of the Heavenly Supreme realm, soaring through eight minor realms.]
[This terrifying improvement made you exclaim to the extreme when you came back to your senses. After all, raising so many cultivation levels in succession is something that the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples couldn’t do, but it was achieved after passing through the Heavenly Supreme road.]
[It can only be said that you hadn’t been able to obtain the great opportunities that the Upper Realm had before due to your lack of luck, so you didn’t have much expectation of the opportunities in the Upper Realm. Now, you have truly tasted the sweetness.]
[In your opinion, if you can get more such opportunities, there is no fear that you will not become a Quasi-Emperor or even a Great Emperor in a short period of time. Of course, you also know very well that such opportunities can only be encountered and not sought after, so for now, you can only fantasize about it.]
…
“Wow, the speed of this cultivation improvement is really scary, I’m afraid it directly saved more than 10,000 years of cultivation time.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, and was amazed in his heart.
“However, this is probably not the biggest opportunity. If it were a normal opportunity, the Taiyi Great Emperor wouldn’t make such a harsh trial. Perhaps, the biggest opportunity is not Enlightenment and cultivation improvement, but something else.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought secretly, and he had a faint guess in his heart.
[While you were exclaiming, the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor nodded with satisfaction, indicating that your foundation was very good and there were no flaws after the upgrade. Then, he said that it was time to give you the biggest chance.]
[This surprised and excited you greatly. Soon, the Taiyi Great Emperor talked about the matters related to the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the secret skill to control the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[It turned out that the Taiyi Emperor Tower was not the Life-bound Imperial Tower condensed by the Taiyi Great Emperor, but an Innate Emperor Artifact. After being cultivated by the Taiyi Great Emperor, it had reached a level close to a quasi-Fairy Artifact.]
[Apart from that, the power of the Taiyi Emperor Tower was not due to its high level, but its inherent meaning. The Taiyi Emperor Tower was a key, a key to opening an Ancient Secret Realm.]
[To open this Ancient Secret Realm, one must first obtain the Taiyi Emperor Tower, pass through the Supreme Heavenly Path within it, and completely make the Taiyi Emperor Tower recognize its owner.]
[Back then, although the Taiyi Great Emperor had obtained the Taiyi Emperor Tower, he did not pass through the Supreme Heavenly Path. To be precise, it was not that he couldn’t pass, but he never tried to challenge the Supreme Heavenly Path.]
[Because the Supreme Heavenly Path can only be entered by Supremes, those who exceed the Supreme tier cannot participate in the trial, even if they are Self-titled.]
[As a result, although the Taiyi Great Emperor made the Taiyi Emperor Tower recognize him as its owner and could control the Taiyi Emperor Tower in battle, he could even intervene in some of the rules of the Supreme Heavenly Path, but he himself was not recognized by the Supreme Heavenly Path, nor was he considered to be truly recognized by the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 914: Chapter 247: Taiyi Great Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _4
[This result means that the Taiyi Great Emperor couldn’t enter the ancient secret realm, which is quite a regret for him. He had a premonition that there were incredible secrets hidden within the ancient secret realm, but unfortunately, he missed the opportunity.]
[After listening to the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor, you were shocked. You never expected that the Taiyi Emperor Tower was an innate Emperor’s artifact and even close to a quasi-Fairy Artifact, containing such a great secret.]
[This makes you feel excited. Now that you have obtained the Taiyi Emperor Tower and have been recognized as its master, you have the opportunity to enter the ancient secret realm and seize a tremendous opportunity.]
[It must be said that the benefits you gained this time are enormous.]
[However, you soon feel helpless. After all, the Upper Realm has already disappeared, and you cannot leave the Elemental Forbidden Land. In addition, it is also questionable whether the ancient secret realm has been refined together.]
[As a result, it seems that you can only wait until the next simulation before exploring the secret realm again to see if you can obtain any earth-shattering opportunities from it.]
...
[Afterward, the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor didn’t say much, and after explaining a few things, it disappeared. And you, have now obtained complete control over the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[This leaves you feeling emotional. This is the second Emperor’s artifact you have obtained in all the simulations, and it’s also the strongest one. Unfortunately, in this life, you can never let the Taiyi Emperor Tower show its true brilliance.]
[Next, you leave the Taiyi Emperor Tower. When you come out, the Quasi-emperor Ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace are all shocked, never expecting that your cultivation has reached the Heavenly Supreme Peak level.]
[In other words, you have passed the Supreme Heavenly Path, which is truly shocking. After all, many talented individuals with the potential of a Great Emperor have entered the Supreme Realm, only to perish within. Yet, you have passed it so easily.]
[After that, you take away the Taiyi Emperor Tower, further shocking them. They’re curious about what opportunities you gained but ultimately decided not to ask.]
[Subsequently, you inquire how long has it been since you entered the tower in the outer world. To this, an Ancestor gives you an answer: around one hundred years.]
[At this, you feel emotional again, being so satisfied with the harvest from a hundred years. But then you are reminded of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion and can’t help but feel heavy-hearted.]
[Afterward, you inquire if there have been any unusual occurrences in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[At your words, the expressions of the Quasi-emperor Ancestors become serious. They say that although they are only in the outer area of the Elemental Forbidden Land, they have been encountering more frequent and powerful attacks from Evil Demons. The demons’ methods are bizarre, and they have been on guard, but some disciples have still fallen to these Demons.]
[This makes you frown. The Elemental Forbidden Land is indeed not simple. Even if only staying in the outer area and not venturing deeper, the longer you stay, the more dangerous the environment becomes.]
[After pondering, you extend your senses. Soon, you discover something wrong. The Elemental Forbidden Land’s space seems to have shifted silently, and the Taiyi Imperial Palace is no longer in the outer area.]
[If anyone else, even a Quasi-emperor, might not notice anything unusual and feel that nothing has changed, but you are different, you have ventured into the inner area and know its environment.]
[And the current environment overlaps with your memories.]
[Apparently, the Elemental Forbidden Land’s space is more terrifying than you thought, capable of moving the Taiyi Imperial Palace from the outer to the inner area without anyone noticing.]
[If you continue like this, something bad will definitely happen. You take a deep breath and then inform the Ancestors of the situation. Instantly, all the Ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace are shocked and start to reinspect.]
[Soon, they come to the conclusion that they have indeed been moved, and their situation is even more dangerous than they imagined.]
[Your face is grave, suggesting that you cannot just sit and wait for death. Therefore, you plan to enter deeper alone to find a way out, while also digging out the secrets of the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[Hearing this, the Quasi-emperor Ancestors nod without hesitation. However, they insist that you must form a team instead of acting alone. Of course, the Taiyi Imperial Palace also requires strong cultivators to stay behind.]
[After discussing, you start taking action. You team up with a Quasi-emperor Ancestor and leave the Taiyi Imperial Palace, heading towards the depths of the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[With your Quasi-emperor cultivation, you should have been able to easily cross the Elemental Forbidden Land, but this place is just too mysterious. Your divine senses are suppressed, and no matter how you move, the environment remains monotonous, and you are unable to reach the end no matter how far you fly.]
[At the same time, you encounter even more terrifying attacks. These Evil Demon attacks are getting more and more fearsome, far greater than when you first entered. You begin to doubt if the intensity of these Evil Demons adjusts according to the power of you cultivators.]
[If there had been so many terrifying Evil Demons when you entered last time, you might have already perished and would not have had the chance to escape to the cave where the giant heart was.]

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 247: The Great Taiyi Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 915: Chapter 247: The Great Taiyi Emperor Appears! Cultivation Soars! _5
[In the blink of an eye, a week has passed. You’ve all been injured. If it weren’t for your sacrifice of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, you would’ve faced life-threatening danger. However, if you continue like this, you will definitely die in this place.]
[But perhaps because of your fate with that heart, you once again entered the cave and saw the throbbing heart.]
[You were even more amazed at the energy and faint immortal aura contained within this heart. The Quasi-Emperor Ancestor who teamed up with you was equally as shocked.]
[However, a strange event occurred. As the heart beat, a strange rhythm blurred your consciousness, attracting you towards the throbbing heart.]
[Then, the Quasi-Emperor Ancestor stretched his hand toward the restriction. The moment his hand touched the restriction, it melted into a blood fog, absorbed by the heart. Following this, the Quasi-Emperor Ancestor’s body turned into blood fog, entered the restriction, and was absorbed by the heart.]
[Seemingly because of absorbing the Quasi-Emperor Ancestor, the heart’s beats have grown stronger. Although the change is not significant, it has indeed grown stronger.]
...
[Next, just as you were about to touch the gigantic heart, the Taiyi Emperor Tower emitted a glow that awakened your consciousness.]
[This made your spine shiver and cold sweat streamed down your back, realizing you almost perished. You narrowly escaped death this time. As a result, you quickly retreated, extremely wary of the heart.]
[Afterwards, you wanted to leave the cave. Staying near the heart that swallowed the Quasi-Emperor Ancestor made you feel like your life is in danger at any time. You’d rather face the heart than battle with the evil spirits.]
[However, as you chose to leave, the heart’s beat rate noticeably sped up, and a voice in your heart tempted you to touch the restriction, promising a supreme immortal fate.]
[You warned yourself in your mind, trying to drive away the strange voice. The Taiyi Emperor Tower also began to exert its power, intending to help you suppress the tempting voice.]
[Nevertheless, the gap between you and the gigantic heart was just too large. Even with the restrictions and seals on the heart, you ultimately couldn’t resist the tempting voice and touched the restriction.]
[Then, you too turned into a blood fog, absorbed by the gigantic heart, and perished.]
[Due to your death, this simulation has ended…]
…
The system’s voice sounded, and many images and insights appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. Finally, his figure appeared in the cave and saw the throbbing heart.
“This heart is truly dangerous. In fact, any fairy’s limbs and organs in the Elemental Forbidden Land are dangerous things.”
Wang Ping murmured while looking at the huge heart.
“But the gains from this simulation are quite astonishing, so I can consider it a satisfactory conclusion.”
With that, Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway, and his vision changed. His entire being returned to the real world.
The system’s voice then sounded again promptly.
“Ding, reward generation successful. The host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade.
②. Temporal Origin.
③. A Random Quasi-Emperor Artifact.
④. The second fragment of the Dark Time Emperor’s Sutra.”
…..
“Eh, there’s no cultivation reward this time? But it doesn’t matter. As long as I know that passing through the Heavenly Supreme Road can directly boost my cultivation to the peak of the Heavenly Supreme realm, I can improve it at any moment. There’s no need to rush for cultivation rewards now. It would be a waste of money to directly improve my cultivation and would let me simulate fewer times.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and thought to himself.
“System, I choose ①. Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade and ④. The second fragment of the Dark Time Emperor’s Sutra.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his choice.
In an instant, information about the Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
At the same time, the second fragment of the Dark Time Emperor’s Sutra appeared before him.
With the fragment in hand and all three fragments collected, he could now go to the secret realm where the Dark Time Imperial Clan resided in the real world.
By then, he could gain control of the Dark Time Imperial Clan and obtain many resources.
“Although I wasted the resources on taking a disciple this time, it’s not a big deal. Let’s continue with the simulations.”
After reviewing some details, Wang Ping was ready to keep simulating.
This time, with the foundation of his previous simulations, he had some new ideas that might change many things.
“System, I want to do a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he spoke from the bottom of his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons
chapters.content:
Chapter 916: Chapter 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons
“Ding, consuming 500 million catties of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator activation, Talent Refreshing…”
After Wang Ping spoke, the system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound; Red Talent: Lei Profound Body.”
Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound: When the host’s luck reaches its nadir, there is a certain chance that it will rebound, and for a certain period of time, the host’s luck will be incredibly strong.
Red Talent: Lei Profound Body: …
“System, I choose Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound.”
...
After seeing the two talents, Wang Ping unhesitatingly chose Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound.
This talent is interesting and may be a talent that can bring about miracles.
However, this talent should be difficult to trigger, which is Wang Ping’s conclusion based on his previous experience.
One can only hope that this talent will be somewhat useful in the upcoming simulation.
“Ding, detected Group Member Wu Jun (20) encountering strangeness in his world, Group Task Publishment: Eliminate the Weirdness. This group task is extremely difficult and highly dangerous; it will be carried out by Acting Group Owner Wang Ping (66) who will select four group members to participate in the task, please make your choice quickly.”
Just as Wang Ping entered the immersive simulation state, the chat group system’s prompt suddenly sounded, making Wang Ping freeze.
“Is the chat group’s assessment a bit too scary?”
Wang Ping was somewhat shocked by the chat group’s assessment this time.
What extreme difficulty and extremely dangerous, it caught Wang Ping a bit off guard.
“Wang Ping, this is an opportunity, but it is indeed dangerous.”
At this moment, Alpha’s voice suddenly sounded.
“What opportunity?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, asking.
“The bizarreness that appears in this group task is extremely terrifying, but it is not impossible to eliminate it. If you can solve it, you can directly gather trillions of group points; even if it’s not trillions, it’s probably just a little bit short.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“However, I suggest you give up this task…because it’s really dangerous.”
“Directly trillions?”
Wang Ping’s face was shocked upon hearing this.
He originally thought it would take a long time to gather trillions, but he never expected that there would be such a valuable bizarreness.
What’s this, after being divided up, how much would it be worth if it weren’t divided up?
“Do you know what that bizarreness is?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, asking in his heart.
“This bizarreness is something that even immortals can’t deal with, but it might also be dealt with by ordinary people. In the past, the main powerhouses of the Second-generation Chat Group encountered it but suffered great losses and were wiped out.”
Alpha gave an explanation after a moment of silence.
“By the way, the main powerhouses of the Second-generation Chat Group at that time, if compared to your world in terms of combat power, were all at the Emperor Tier, and even one beyond the Great Emperor Combat Power.”
“!!!”
Wang Ping was somewhat astonished.
The main powerhouses of the Second-generation Chat Group actually encountered it and were wiped out, which was a little too outrageous.
Keep in mind that these were Emperors, and there was even one beyond the Emperor Combat Power.
Such a lineup was actually wiped out …
“What exactly is that bizarreness, why is it so powerful? And why does it say that even ordinary people might be able to deal with it?”
After Wang Ping calmed down a bit, he asked somewhat astonished.
“The ability of that bizarreness is rather special, in the world it appears, all extraordinary powers will disappear, and all extraordinary living beings of Cultivation Systems will become ordinary. That is to say, in its world, it will only become an ordinary world or a technological side world.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“You mean… before the predecessors of the Second-generation Chat Group went to that world, they were forcibly suppressed and turned into ordinary people, and then they were easily wiped out by its technological means?”
Wang Ping’s face changed constantly, becoming extremely solemn.
He didn’t expect that there would be such a bizarreness, which was simply the nemesis of the cultivation world.
“That’s right. Because they were suppressed, they were easily killed by the robots controlled by the bizarreness. It’s a shame that such powerful fighters at the Emperor Tier and even one beyond the Emperor Tier would die at the hands of firearms.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded, with a hint of fluctuation in his tone, obviously not calm.
“I see…”
Wang Ping fell silent for a moment.
Indeed, it was a miserable death for those powerful beings to die at the hands of firearms.
“Alpha, can that bizarreness only possess humans? Or has it likely evolved over the years?”
Wang Ping took a light breath and asked.
“Over the years, it must have grown stronger. Its ability to affect the range, which used to be limited to galaxies, can now affect the entire universe or even larger areas.”
Alpha’s voice slowly sounded.
“That’s why it’s so valuable. The trillions I mentioned are just a conservative estimate. As for whether it can only possess humans… this kind of bizarreness is not just limited to humans now.”
Wang Ping was speechless as he listened to Alpha’s evaluation.
Damn, a bizarreness that could affect the entire universe, and even beyond a single universe, was indeed perverted.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 248 New Mysterious Big Boss! The Second Generation Boss Wiped Out_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 917: Chapter 248 New Mysterious Big Boss! The Second Generation Boss Wiped Out_2
Moreover, Its abilities do not only affect a particular range; even when It is not fully grown, It can suppress Emperors and combatants who surpass the Emperor Tier.
In other words, wherever It appears, unless an entity has rule-bending abilities that surpass Its own, they would be suppressed to the level of ordinary people.
If Wang Ping participates in this Group Task to counter the anomaly, his cultivation will be suppressed, and he will not have the power to overcome this anomaly.
Of course, considering the rate at which the anomaly grows, if It is not of this special type but is one with immense intrinsic power, Wang Ping’s cultivation would suffer even more.
On the contrary, Wang Ping has the upper hand here because the information advantage brought by the Life Simulator could be the Achilles’ heel of such anomalies.
“Can my Life Simulator and the group members’ Golden fingers be used?”
...
After pondering, Wang Ping asked again.
“They can be used. However, only your Life Simulator can be used normally. As for the other group members, they may experience some effects unless they optimize it again.”
Alpha gave a definitive answer.
“I see, that’s fine then. Let me ask another question, if we encounter danger, can we teleport back? And, is the Rebirth Tally useful?”
With a gleam in his eyes, Wang Ping questioned again.
“Under the influence of this anomaly’s abilities, the teleportation function cannot be used normally, and the Rebirth Tally cannot be used either. However, I can protect you. As for the other group members… not so.”
After a pause, Alpha gave her answer again.
Apparently, when the main forces of the Second Generation Chat Group encountered problems, Alpha was quite indifferent back then. She didn’t choose to save them at a great cost when they died.
The second reason could be that they were killed by the anomaly before they could react.
“Fighting the anomaly with science and technology? This indeed is an intriguing experience.”
Upon receiving Alpha’s affirmative answer, Wang Ping smiled, and he had already made up his mind.
“Are you really planning to participate in this Group Task?”
Alpha asked seriously.
“The opportunity to gain trillions of group points at once is right in front of me, naturally, I can’t miss it. Otherwise, even if I become an Emperor, I don’t know how long I would have to save group points.”
Wang Ping clenched his fist, with a serious expression on his face.
“However, time is running out, and I can’t wait. The number of Upper World’s secrets I’ve encountered is increasing, and my situation might become increasingly dangerous. If I wait until I become an Emperor and spend time accumulating group points, something might happen. In addition to that, there are some people I’ve sworn to save, and they can’t wait that long.”
“Therefore, since you can protect me, naturally, I have nothing to hesitate about. This is the best moment to gain trillions of group points at once.”
After a pause, Wang Ping stated with determination.
“Since you have made your decision, I won’t stop you. However, if an emergency arises, I will forcibly teleport you. The result would be your group points reducing to zero, and I will have to give you a lot in return.”
Alpha’s voice was ice cold, but it was clear she cared for Wang Ping a lot.
“Hahaha, then I’ll have to depend on you. Don’t worry, I will not lose.”
Wang Ping laughed and said.
“You just jinxed yourself.”
After a silence, Alpha warned him quietly.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping was startled, and he couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
Does even Alpha notice that he has just set himself up?
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much to Alpha, and directly opened the chat group.
At this point, the chat group was undoubtedly bustling. Those who had the time were basically discussing the group task.
The words “Extremely Difficult” and “Extremely Dangerous” were too eye-catching.
Wu Jun (20): “Damn brothers, I’ve discovered a terrifying thing, my cultivation has disappeared all of a sudden, and I’ve become an ordinary person, I’m stupefied.”
Fang Yun (3): “???”
Cai Yonglong (1): “What’s going on? Why has your cultivation disappeared? It couldn’t be the anomaly’s doing, could it?”
Liu Mei (15): “This kind of abnormality is probably the anomaly’s doing…..it seems Jun is in danger, probably detected by the anomaly.”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “Move your location quickly, staying in place is too dangerous.”
Zhang Hu (5): “If you turn into an ordinary person…..running won’t get you anywhere. At this point, only teleporting to another world can save you.”
Wu Jun (20): “Damn it, I can’t even f***ing teleport right now, I’m numbed!”
Seeing Wu Jun’s statement, whether it was the old group members or the new ones, all of them were taken aback.
What’s happening? Teleportation unable to function, this only happens when confronting the Myriad Heavens Forces.
This has never happened when dealing with anomalies.
Wang Ping (66): “The ability of this new anomaly is to forcibly turn a world into an ordinary world, all extraordinary powers of any cultivation system will be suppressed. Therefore, Wu Jun, there’s no need to panic. You might not have been spotted by the anomaly, but have simply been affected by its ability.”
Wu Jun (20): “Oh right, that’s a relief then, I almost had the life scared out of me, QAQ.”
Fang Yun (3): “Damn, is there such an anomaly? It’s simply a nightmare for cultivators.”
Zhang Jun (70): “Indeed, it is a bit scary. If we were to encounter such an anomaly, we wouldn’t even know how we died.”

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: Chapter 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons_3
Wang Ping (66): “Haha, not just you guys, even the transmigrator predecessors from the second-generation chat group couldn’t escape. A group of high-end combatants died in their hands, mercilessly wiped out. These predecessors, each with emperor-tier strength, and even one surpassing emperor-tier. However, they were all ruthlessly suppressed and killed by firearms. How pathetic.”
