Cai Yonglong (1): “Pfft, even emperors and those surpassing emperors got killed? That’s a bit crazy.”
Chen Si (83): “By the way, Mr. Wang, I’ve always been curious about the story of our transmigrator predecessors. You said you’d tell us the next time you come online, but you never did. (｀・ω・´).”
Chen Kang (67): “I’m super curious about that too!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Count me in.”
Wang Ping (66): “About that, let me just explain it now…”
...
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he recounted the events of the second-generation chat group and the first-generation chat group, as well as the reasons for their destruction.
After hearing the story, everyone was speechless.
No one expected the previous transmigrators’ chat groups to be even darker.
If it weren’t for the chat group being destroyed twice and restructured, as well as Mr.Wang fighting for their benefits, they too might have ended up following the same disastrous path.
At the same time, they all admired the leaders of the first and second-generation chat groups.
They destroyed the chat group so impressively.
Especially the ruthless one from the first generation who destroyed the chat group by himself – how twisted must one be to pull that off?
Wang Ping (66): “That’s the whole story. So, we and our transmigrator predecessors are mortal enemies. They want to destroy us, and if we encounter them, we must kill them, or else we invite endless calamity.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Cough, so that’s how it is. The Supreme we attacked together last time must have been a predecessor transmigrator. And that Jiuyou Demon Emperor Chu Xiao must be one too.”
Wang Ping (66): “Yes, they were indeed from the second-generation chat group, which is why they targeted me many times, causing me a lot of trouble.”
Wang Ping (66): “Anyway, speaking of this mission, because it’s highly dangerous, I personally don’t recommend participating. Even if the mission fails, I have enough group points to save myself. However, you all don’t have enough group points to guarantee your lives.”
Fang Yun (3): “Since Mr. Wang said that, I won’t go.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Haha, as if you’d go if Mr. Wang didn’t say anything. →_→.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “I’m just curious about how many group points this challenging mission will reward. QAQ~!”
Wang Ping (66): “At least tens of billions.”
After some thought, Wang Ping gave a very conservative estimate.
Qin Tian (77): “Holy shit! Tens of billions! I’m drooling.jpg.”
Chen Yao (71): “So many group points… I’m tempted to go…”
Wang Ping (66): “Actually, in my opinion, two people are more suited for this mission. One is Chen Yao, and the other is Liu Mei. Chen Yao’s golden finger is adding points, which might produce amazing results in intelligence and technology development if used. As for Liu Mei, although she can’t use her extraordinary power, her beauty and charm skill can be very useful in the ordinary world.”
Wang Ping (66): “Of course, this is a one-way ticket. Once you go, unless you kill the mysterious enemy, you can’t teleport back. There’s a risk to your life. If you don’t want to go, I won’t force you.”
Chen Yao (71): “…..I’ll go, with so many group points at stake, it’s a pity to miss out.”
Liu Mei (15): “Can’t miss out on the chance to get rich! Although there might be life-threatening risks, I believe Mr. Wang can solve the problem.”
Cai Yonglong (1): “Honestly, I want to go too. What a great opportunity to get rich suddenly. It’s a pity I can’t help much in this kind of mission. (¯﹃¯).”
Wang Ping (66): “Don’t be disheartened, your time will come. So, it’s decided that Chen Yao and Liu Mei will join me in the group mission. As for the others, you can help us depending on the situation.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Okay!”
…..
Afterwards, Wang Ping went offline, without making any more comments in the chat group, and filled out the mission participant list.
Soon, Wang Ping turned into a beam of white light and disappeared from his world.
As for Liu Mei and Chen Yao, they also transformed into white light and were teleported to Wu Jun’s world.
When Wang Ping and the others opened their eyes, they found themselves in a luxurious mansion, with Wu Jun sitting on the couch.
“My power, it’s really gone…”
Wang Ping felt anxious and uneasy as the power within his body had vanished without a trace, as did any sense of safety.
After all, changing from being an all-powerful supreme being to an ordinary person is a drastic and unbearable change.
“It seems like we’re not exactly ordinary people either. Our bodies are still stronger than normal people, similar to the Viscera Training Realm level.”
Wang Ping then noticed something else wrong and raised his eyebrows a fraction.
It seems that the Body Refining Stage is not considered part of the extraordinary realm, and within the mysterious ability classification, it’s still within the range of what ordinary people can achieve through training.

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: Chapter 248: The New Mysterious Big Boss! The Annihilated Second-Generation Tycoons_4
“Body Refining Realm, huh? That would be considered a little superhuman in normal human society, but it can still be killed by guns.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples, unsure whether to be happy or helpless.
Ever since he had grown up in a short period of time, he had not experienced this kind of stifling feeling, and now he needed to compare the power of the Body Refining Realm with ordinary humans to gain some sense of superiority.
“Mr.Wang, we are in the same situation.”
Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao also spoke up, all with a hint of helplessness.
“Let’s not talk about it, the first thing we need to do now is to simulate. After all, we don’t even know if there is any danger around us.”
...
Wang Ping sighed and went straight to the point.
Upon hearing this, Wu Jun and the other two nodded solemnly.
Then, Wang Ping sat down on the sofa and said in his heart, “System, I want to start a free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver, his vision shifted, and he entered the immersive simulation.
Next, the luminescent screen appeared, and words emerged.
[Day One, you discuss mysterious matters, asking Wu Jun if there have been any abnormalities on Blue Water Star. Wu Jun shakes his head with a bitter smile, saying he hasn’t paid attention and can’t find anything unusual. The planet he is on is similar to Earth before crossing, just much bigger and slightly more technologically advanced.]
[As for his identity in this world, since he has been very low-profile, only buying mansions and frequently participating in tasks, he hasn’t gotten control of any high-Tier humans.]
[Hearing Wu Jun’s answer, you are quite helpless, but not surprised by his response.]
[After some thought, you plan to first use Liu Mei’s beauty and Charm Skill to enchant some high-Tier humans and see if you can find anything through Heaven Net.]
[Fortunately, there are only three countries in this world: Profound Aqua Country, Eagle Country, and Red Sun Country. It is not too difficult for you to achieve your goal by charming the high-Tier humans.]
[Of course, you can also follow the idol route like you did against the Charm Grassroots. But doing so, you feel a bit too high-profile.]
[Under the premise of having no intelligence, keeping a low profile is king. Only by not being discovered by the mysterious force can you be the safest. Besides, you are also worried about another issue.]
[This issue is that you suspect that the mysterious force may not be on Blue Water Star and may not have possessed any humans. If that’s the case, it would be even more troublesome.]
[It means that killing the mysterious force might be an empty talk. After all, with the current human technology, it is impossible to venture into the Starry Sky. Even if you could enter the Starry Sky, finding the mysterious force in the vast universe is extremely difficult.]
[Another point is that even if you find the mysterious force, what if it holds a high position in an alien civilization? The probability of human space fleets not being able to win against it is also very high.]
[The most important thing is that even if we can win, we have to consider the time cost in the real world. In the simulation, you can develop technology and explore the path to clear the game. In the real world, you don’t have much time to follow the path in the simulation to clear it.]
[However, even though you have many concerns, you can only suppress them, hoping to find the mysterious force directly on Blue Water Star and eliminate it.]
[Soon, the headache-inducing problem arises: Although you have physical strength that surpasses ordinary people, you don’t have enough intelligence network to find the heads of the three major countries, let alone charm them.]
[As a result, you can only let Liu Mei start from the bottom, charm the grassroots and then work her way up until she meets the king of Profound Aqua Country.]
[In the end, you succeed in charming the king of Profound Aqua Country using this method, and then meet the kings and many high-Tier humans of Eagle Country and Red Sun Country in the name of the king, successfully charming them.]
[However, to your disappointment, even though you have used the highest authority of the three major countries to investigate many matters, you haven’t found any abnormalities on Blue Water Star or discovered the mysterious force.]
[As a result, after discussion, you launch a new plan. This plan is to support Liu Mei to quickly become a world-class idol with the power of the three major countries, enchanting all humans. Although doing so is extremely high-profile, you have no other choice but to do it and hope to catch the mysterious force’s tail.]
[Soon, the plan begins. Liu Mei’s beauty and charm ability are already very powerful, coupled with the terrifying support. Within three days, Liu Mei enchants the entire human race, making them her fanatical fans.]
[At this moment, Liu Mei regains her former glory. She then orders all humans to collectively commit suicide. The fans follow her command without any hesitation.]
[At this moment, all humans commit suicide, and the human race on Blue Water Star is extinguished.]
[However, even though the human race on Blue Water Star is extinct, the Group Task is still not completed, which makes you very troubled. If the Group Task is not completed, the high probability is that the mysterious force is not on Blue Water Star, with a small possibility that it has possessed ordinary animals or that there are some fish that escaped the net.]
…..
“The text simulation description refers to all humans…meaning there is a high probability that there are no fish that escaped the net on Blue Water Star. The mysterious force is not on Blue Water Star.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, his heart sinking, knowing that the worst situation might be about to happen.
However, although Wang Ping is troubled, he can only continue to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you begin to consider what other strategies you have. Unfortunately, in this situation, you seem to have no other options left.]
[It seems that the only thing you can do now is either wait for the mysterious force to destroy the universe or choose to end this simulation actively; otherwise, you would be wasting time meaninglessly.]
[Of course, there is one more hopeful method, which is to rely on Wu Jun’s Golden Finger ability to bring miracles. Wu Jun’s Golden Finger does have an unreasonable ability to kill the mysterious force.]
[In the end, Wu Jun grits his teeth and makes a decision, using his Golden Finger ability, hoping to raise the possibility of killing the mysterious force to 100%.]
[However, as Wu Jun uses his ability to turn into a woman, the prompt for completing the Group Task still doesn’t appear.]
[This makes you helpless, knowing that there is a high probability that you haven’t triggered this possibility. Now, all you can do is to survive and then collect the final piece of intelligence. This piece of intelligence is to calculate when the mysterious force will destroy the universe or you.]
[As a result, you don’t intend to end the simulation prematurely.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly half a year has passed. During this period, you and the other three have been living in solitude on Blue Water Star. It is not until September 1st, almost half a year later, that abnormalities finally occur.]

chapters.title: Chapter 920: 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite
chapters.content:
Chapter 920: Chapter 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite
[On the first day of September, Chen Yao, Liu Mei, and Wu Jun suddenly bled from all orifices and experienced rapid organ failure, dying on the spot. Only you survived.]
[You were somewhat terrified about the sudden deaths of Chen Yao, Liu Mei, and Wu Jun, but you quickly regained your composure and began analyzing the cause.]
[In your view, this manner of death could have likely been caused by a virus. In your investigation, you found that the deaths of all three were indeed caused by a virus.]
[Besides the three of them, the same fate befell animals, all of whom died suddenly from a viral infection.]
[You suspected foul play, specifically a virus inflicted by some malevolent entity aiming to eliminate you all. Its target could potentially be the entire human race.]
[Besides, you also had some doubts that maybe Wu Jun’s golden finger had played a role and triggered this unfortunate outcome, causing all living creatures to be infected and drop dead on this day in September.]
...
[As for why you were not affected, it was all because of your Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons. After your cultivation was sealed, it was your Talent Skills that started to play a vital part. Even though it was only a green talent, its resistance against diseases was still considerable.]
[Of course, you also had doubts whether this Talent could reach the realm of the extraordinary and whether it escaped the suppression of the malevolent entity. Otherwise, even Golden Finger would be affected, let alone the Talents gained from the Life Simulator.]
[These Talents were not bad, but the Golden Talent: Transmission that could affect the Upper Realm’s forbidden lands was no match against the malevolent force.]
…..
“The game’s afoot. But, is this really the power of the malevolent entity? I have the feeling that Wu Jun’s Golden Finger got influenced by its power, triggering a higher likelihood of negative outcomes.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but ponder while observing the Text Simulation.
“Forget it, regardless of which possibility, this simulation probably won’t conclude. Next, I need to discuss with Wu Jun and the others and continue to gather information.”
Wang Ping sighed and dismissed the random thoughts from his mind, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Going forward, you led a solitary existence in this world, and in the course of time, the corpses began to decompose. Escaping to the countryside was of no avail.]
[As all animals had died suddenly, the ecosystem took a hit and fell into chaos.]
[However, you didn’t concern yourself with these developments, waiting for the malevolent force to make another move and get rid of you.]
[But, what you hadn’t expected happened. Merely three months later, your Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons was no longer able to resist the virus. Apparently, the toxicity of the virus had continued to increase, exceeding the ability limit of your Talent. As a result, you were infected by the virus that caused you to bleed from the orifices and your organs failed; you died.]
[Due to your death, the current simulation is over.]
…
The Text Simulation stopped at this point. Various scenes appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, his figure appearing at the place where his simulated self had died.
“Although viruses by nature continue to mutate, this virus’s mutation speed is unusually fast. Just within three months, it has exceeded the tolerance range of my Talent’s effects.”
Wang Ping was somewhat speechless.
He had originally expected to see the malevolent force make another move, but ended up dying at the hands of the virus.
As Wang Ping became speechless, his consciousness flickered, his vision shifted back to the real world, and he opened his eyes.
“This is a bit troublesome.”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun’s trio and, frowning, recounted the contents of the simulation.
“This…”
Upon hearing this, Liu Mei fell silent.
“Did my ability cause this?”
Considering this possibility, Wu Jun felt somewhat embarrassed.
“Whether it did or didn’t, we’ll know after comparing the next simulation.”
Chen Yao declared quietly.
“Yes, that’s the right approach. In the next simulation, if Wu Jun does not use his ability, we can make a comparison.”
Wang Ping nodded his agreement.
“Chen Yao, can you add any more points in this world?”
All of a sudden, Wang Ping remembered this point and turned to inquire Chen Yao.
“The divine source is all inside the inner world and can’t be extracted due to the suppression by the malevolent force. Apart from that, my ability to add points doesn’t specifically add intelligence, so we are in real trouble this time.”
Chen Yao responded with a bitter smile.
“I see.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly. Even though he wasn’t surprised by this outcome, he was still somewhat disappointed.
“Sorry, it seems like I’m a burden now…”
Chen Yao apologized, seeming somewhat guilty.
“It’s not like you’re a burden, everyone can play their role. Even if your Golden Finger doesn’t work.”
Wang Ping shook his head and comforted Chen Yao.
“Brother Wang, I wanted to know how many remaining free simulation times you have.”
Wu Jun cut in to ask.
“Free simulation, there’s no end to it.”
Wang Ping replied casually.
He seldom takes tasks now and frequently uses Paid Simulations in the Upper Realm.
Therefore, the countless free simulation chances that he had accumulated have long exceeded a hundred.
“That’s a relief.”
Upon hearing this, Wu Jun let out a sigh of relief.
This time the malevolent force was blatantly dangerous, and no measure of simulations would suffice.

chapters.title: Chapter 921: 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: Chapter 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_2
Wu Jun was getting worried too, unable to solve the problem even with a dozen simulations.
If Wang Ping didn’t have enough free simulation times, then it would really be troublesome.
“Do you have any speculations about our cause of death?”
Wang Ping looked at the three of them and asked.
“No.” Wu Jun shook his head.
“Most likely it’s one of the two reasons you mentioned, Wang. Although it’s not impossible that it’s a naturally occurring virus, according to your theory, these animals might have died at the same time. I can’t think of any naturally born virus that could kill all animals at the same time.”
...
Chen Yao thought for a moment, then spoke.
“So, it’s either caused by Wu Jun’s unreasonable ability or some weird human intervention, setting the virus to activate its toxicity at a certain time.”
“Chen Yao’s added details are great. So, if it’s a weird intervention, then I can suspect one thing. The weirdness might not be on the Blue Water Star, but rather, they utilized the technology of alien civilizations to manipulate the Blue Water Star.”
Wang Ping nodded and continued.
“Mr. Wang, you mean the technology of the Blue Water Star isn’t advanced enough to control the virus and set it to explode simultaneously.”
Liu Mei’s eyes sparkled as she analyzed.
“That’s right.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“Mr. Wang, if we proceeded as you said, isn’t it possible that Blue Water Star has long been targeted by alien civilization? Or perhaps, a spaceship has already arrived in the Solar System?”
Wu Jun was not stupid and expressed his doubts.
“If it’s not due to your ability, then there’s a high probability that we have already been targeted by an alien civilization, or maybe they have even arrived in some way.”
Wang Ping nodded and looked at the sun outside the window, sighing.
“If that’s the case, we might also be exposed. Of course, we are very low-profile, and if the other party looks down on the humans of the Blue Water Star, they might simply poison them and watch humanity perish. For this reason, they may not have discovered our unique existence.”
“……”
Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao all felt chills in their hearts as they listened to Wang Ping’s words.
They were just ordinary people now, and if they were discovered, they would follow in the footsteps of their Predecessor Ransmigrators from the Second Generation Chat Group.
Thinking of that outcome, the mood of the three of them sank to the bottom.
Although they had experienced many life-and-death situations, even Chen Yao had died once. But because they had faced death and experienced it, they cherished life even more and feared permanent death.
“Of course, you don’t have to worry too much. The current situation is not that bad. Even if the virus is related to the weirdness, there’s a high probability that They haven’t noticed us, otherwise we wouldn’t have lived so long in the simulations.”
Seeing that the three of them were silent, Wang Ping spoke in a relaxed tone.
“And let me say something unpleasant, it might not even be the Weirdness that did it. Because this Weirdness isn’t the same small fry we dealt with before, its goal can’t be just to wipe out humanity on the Blue Water Star. The goal of this big boss Weirdness might be to destroy the entire universe and take everything in it.”
“That’s true.” Wu Jun and the others came back to their senses and calmed down again.
“I’ll continue the simulation and hope to get some useful information.”
After taking a light breath, Wang Ping closed his eyes and said in his heart.
“System, I want to start a free simulation.”
“Ding, the Life Simulator is activated, the free simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered as he entered the immersive simulation state.
Soon, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, after discussing, you decide to do nothing and not interfere with the plot, just like in the last simulation when you became a national idol and charmed all of humanity.]
[All you can do is wait and see if the plot development will still be the same as last time without your interference.]
[In the blink of an eye, half a year has passed, and it’s now September 1st. Then, the mutation happens again, all humans and other animals suddenly bleed from their orifices, their organs fail, and they die on the spot. The entire Blue Water Star has once again become a dead star, leaving only you and the plants.]
[Seeing this scene, you become quiet and realize that the appearance of the virus has nothing to do with Wu Jun’s Golden Finger, but rather, it would have appeared anyway. However, in this simulation, you still cannot find the answer. You cannot tell if this is done on purpose by Weirdness, or if Blue Water Star is targeted by other alien civilizations and has been poisoned.]
[In the blink of an eye, another three months have passed, and just like in the last simulation, you die because of the outbreak of the virus.]
[As you die, this simulation ends….]
…..
The text simulation stopped here, images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and he finally exited the immersive simulation state.
“It’s not caused by Wu Jun’s ability.”
Wang Ping looked at everyone and said this sentence.
“That’s good, that’s good.”
Wu Jun breathed a sigh of relief, worried that he had screwed up his teammates last time.

chapters.title: Chapter 922: 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Chapter 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_3
“However, this also means that it was done by something bizarre or an alien civilization. If possible, I hope it’s the work of the bizarre.”
After recounting the content of this simulation, Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“We all hope it’s like that. But there’s too little information right now, so we can only continue investigating.”
Liu Mei sighed.
“In the process of executing the Group Task, experiencing such frequent quick deaths and continuous simulations really hasn’t happened in a long time,”
Wang Ping nodded and said with emotion.
...
“That’s true. But it’s not a good thing.”
Chen Yao laughed bitterly.
Wang Ping rubbed his brows and said, “Indeed it’s not, but nothing can be changed. Anyway, I’ll continue the simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping closed his eyes and whispered in his mind, “System, I want to do a free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, and Wang Ping’s consciousness shook as he once again entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, a luminescent screen appeared, and the text emerged.
[Day One, you discuss countermeasures again. After some discussion, you felt that continuing like this would still lead to the same outcome. Therefore, you must add enough variables to the upcoming events.]
[You believe that these variables can either come from using Wu Jun’s Golden Finger again or through Liu Mei’s methods, building shelters in advance to save some of the human race. At the same time, add more variables in this process to test whether you have already been infected by the virus at this point in time or if the virus has not yet appeared.]
[After discussing it, you decided not to use Wu Jun’s uncertain Golden Finger and instead try to create various variables. ]
[Thanks to Liu Mei’s Golden Finger, you easily accomplished this, using the authority of the Three Great Kings to quickly establish many Sealed Ecological Shelters that are isolated from the outer world and can operate with internal circulation.]
[At the same time, many human elites entered these shelters. Then, all the clues about these shelters were completely erased.]
[In addition, the high-Tier humans and the participants who knew about these matters were made to self-hypnotize and forget about them using Liu Mei’s Charm Skill.]
[In this way, as time went by, nearly half a year passed in the blink of an eye, and September 1st came once again.]
[With the arrival of this day, the humans and animals in the outer world on Blue Water Star died suddenly, just like in your memory. However, you humans hiding in the Sealed Ecological Shelters did not have any accidents. To be more precise, shelters all around the world did not have any accidents.]
[This means that the virus had not yet appeared on Blue Water Star before you entered the shelter. This is something worth celebrating.]
[However, the better news comes later. That is, the subjects of your experiment also showed different changes.]
[That is, under your arrangement, an experimental subject from a Sealed Ecological Shelter that started contacting the outer world after April 1st midnight died suddenly on September 1st. However, other experimental subjects in shelters and the experimental subjects in contact with the outer world did not die suddenly. ]
[This situation can lead to a conclusion. That is the virus probably appeared on Blue Water Star around May 1st. However, the virus did not spread across the entire Blue Water Star when it first appeared; it had a process of spreading. ]
[This spreading process could be through air transmission, water transmission, or human-to-human transmission. Of course, it’s more likely that all of these factors contributed to the spread. In the end, the virus took almost four months to spread throughout Blue Water Star, entering the bodies of all animals, and detonating punctually on September 1st, causing all animals to suffer a terrifying viral infection and die.]
[This experimental result makes you happy but also leaves you with a heavy heart. Although the virus will not appear in the real world for another two months, two months pass quickly, and you must find a solution. Otherwise, this will truly become a death sentence.]
[Once the two months are up, the virus will probably just be an appetizer, and the real danger will be the alien civilization that deploys the virus.]
[But, you also thought about one thing. That is, what kind of alien civilization is this world and what are the laws of survival in this universe? If it’s like Wang Shuqi’s World, that wouldn’t be so bad since there’s room to maneuver.]
[After all, the purpose of that kind of alien civilization is to find living planets for sales, and there’s still room for maneuver. Liu Mei has the potential to charm aliens.]
[What you’re most worried about is the cosmology in your memory, which is something like the dark forest worldview. If it’s a dark forest kind, then it’s really explosive, and the difficulty of solving it will multiply.]
[However, although you’re worried, you also know that worrying won’t solve the problem. Therefore, you start to assemble scientists to research, trying to develop a vaccine to defend against this terrifying virus.]

chapters.title: Chapter 923: 249 Terrifying Virus! Huge Meteorite_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Chapter 249 Terrifying Virus! Huge Meteorite_4
[However, a situation that leaves you helpless occurred. This virus, before it erupted, the medical scientists could not determine who got infected, and now after the outbreak, they finally found the virus, started research, only to find there was no solution.]
[Luminaries in the medical field, virologists, biochemists, and other human elites, all agreed on one thing. That is, this virus cannot be solved with the current level of human medical and scientific technology.]
[Not to mention this alien virus, named MR virus, let alone the native viruses on Blue Water Star, humans have not completely conquered any of them. The viruses that human history have completely conquered are basically due to mutual restraint among viruses, just coincidentally discovered by humans and thus conquered.]
[Apart from this, conquering viruses, and the fight against viruses, basically rely on human immunity.]
[Hearing this answer, you fell silent. You have heard about this knowledge on earth before crossing. You didn’t expect to hear it on this planet similar to earth, the Blue Water Star.]
[Indeed, sciences such as virology and genetics are too profound, and hard to delve into. In this regard, humans are still like naive children, knowing only that such a thing exists, but unable to study its essence.]
...
[After your consideration, you let these scientists continue to study the MR virus, and you also start to have scientists study things like gene potion or energy liquid.]
[You think, since it needs human immunity to fight against the virus, you can find a plan that quickly enhances physical strength for everyone.]
[However, using the cultivation method from the Profound World, the Body Refining Stage is useless, this point was already demonstrated in the previous virus infection, you need stronger physical bodies.]
[Since the Cultivation System doesn’t work, then let’s use technical measures to increase human body strength. This kind of enhancement perhaps won’t be suppressed by strange abilities.]
[After all, in the field of technology, gene potions improve human genetic strength and even break the gene lock. Transforming the physical strength of organisms and human intelligence is a very normal thing. This belongs to the path of evolution in the aspect of technology, and the possibility of not being affected by bizarre abilities is quite high.]
[Moreover, you think mechanized ascension could also be considered. As they say, the flesh is weak. Mechanized ascension is also a classic statement in science fiction themes.]
[Of course, you would not consider letting yourself undergo mechanized ascension in reality, but doing so in a simulation, if it helps advance the plot to deal with the strange threats, you can do so.]
….
“Gene potion, I remember Zeng Lingdong once signed up to receive a gene potion, which could be used as a reference for scientists to research. Other than that, there’s energy fluid and space ships from Wang Shuqi’s World.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, his eyes twinkling, thinking to himself.
If it were the normal development of technology, it would undoubtedly be very troublesome, especially given the current situation, time is overly urgent.
However, if we can leverage external forces, that’s another story.
Taking advantage of the gene potion that Zeng Lingdong signed up for, and the space ships and technology information seized from Wang Shuqi’s World, there’s hope that humans in this world can quickly become genetically enhanced beings and elevate human technology swiftly to the space age.
Of course, this method feels like we’re forcing growth which might affect the future development of humans.
“Time is pressing, I can’t worry about that much now. Let’s solve the current problem first.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself, then continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, sixty years passed. During these sixty years, no other crisis occurred. It seemed like the alien civilization thought that humans were extinct and didn’t continue to target the organisms on Blue Water Star anymore.]
[This is the only thing to be happy about. But you still dare not leave the shelter. After all, the outside is still full of viruses, and you would die if you went out.]
[You have no choice, for sixty years, human scientists have been trying to develop gene potions and virus vaccines. Unfortunately, due to the technological gap and lack of a favorable research environment, sixty years have passed, and there hasn’t been any significant progress.]
[In addition, within these sixty years, many scientists dying of old age is also an issue. In the shelter, there aren’t enough outstanding successors to take up the mantle.]
[Aside from the already aged scientists, even you guys, after enduring sixty years, have become extremely old. If it weren’t for the fact that your physical condition is stronger than regular humans, at the age of over eighty, you might have died of old age.]
[This leaves you feeling very disappointed. How brilliant your lives had been; you were ordinary people on earth, accidentally joined the chat group, experienced an incredible eight or nine years, and turned into a powerful being beyond ordinary people’s imagination.]
[Yet, after coming to this world, you again became ordinary people, hiding away in the shelter just to survive secretly, until your bodies grew old and you died.]
[Just as you were feeling disappointed, Wu Jun also thought of using his Golden Finger for the last attempt. These years, Wu Jun had been trying to use his Golden Finger to see if he could trigger a miracle.]

chapters.title: Chapter 924: 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Chapter 249: The Terror Virus! The Huge Meteorite_5
[But you’ve been stopping him. After all, once Wu Jun uses the abilities of the Golden Finger, unpredictable variables will arise, which will hinder Wang Ping’s chance in the next simulation. So, even if it means growing old and dying, you absolutely cannot use the abilities of the Golden Finger for a final struggle.]
[You stop Wu Jun again, leaving him feeling helpless and frustrated, sitting dejectedly in place. Clearly, even after all these years, Wu Jun still listens to you, his big brother.]
[It is during your time of drinking away your sorrows that an accident happens again. In space, a huge asteroid is heading towards Blue Water Star, eventually breaking through its atmosphere and crashing into it.]
[For a moment, the surface of Blue Water Star shakes from the energy released by the asteroid’s impact, causing a terrifying shock to the ecosystem. You all, hiding in the shelter, are also affected and ultimately die horribly from the chain reaction caused by the asteroid impact.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends…]
…
...
With the end of the text simulation, many images appear in Wang Ping’s mind, and his figure appears in space.
From his perspective, a huge asteroid comes from space, crashing into Blue Water Star, creating a terrifying energy that shakes the entire planet, causing a mass extinction.
“A mere asteroid impact, this kind of scene, for my past self, would have been considered trivial. Now that I have become an ordinary person, it seems awe-inspiring and shocking when viewed from space,”
Wang Ping watches the scene, murmuring with sentiment.
Next, without waiting for Wang Ping to think more, his consciousness flickers, and he leaves the immersive simulation, returning to the real world.
“This simulation is better than before, gathering quite a bit of information, but…”
Wang Ping looks at Wu Jun and the others, shaking his head, summarizing the situation.
“There are still two months left, which is a silver lining in our misfortune…”
Wu Jun feels quite fortunate.
Although getting infected two months later isn’t something to be happy about, it’s better than already being infected by the virus now.
“Even though we’re safe now, the problem of the virus remains unresolved. We can’t just keep hiding. And what’s the deal with that asteroid? Was it an accident, or were we targeted again?”
Wang Ping shakes his head, sighing.
“This…”
Listening to Wang Ping’s words, Wu Jun falls silent.
Liu Mei and Chen Yao also frown, feeling troubled and restless.
It’s just one problem after another.
They haven’t even solved the virus problem, and now they’re hit with a massive asteroid…
Whether it’s man-made or a natural phenomenon, it seems like their fate is to be hunted to extinction.
This predicament leaves one in despair, unable to see any hope of breaking through.
No wonder the Chat Group labels this as extremely difficult and highly dangerous.
Keep in mind that they have Mr.Wang here; without him, how would they clear the challenge?
Just the thought leaves them suffocated and desperate.
No wonder the Predecessor ransmigrators of the Second-Generation Chat Group were mercilessly wiped out.
This strange foe, directly sealing off their Extraordinary Power and forcibly turning the others into ordinary people, is much harder to deal with than other foes.
“Don’t worry too much. Even without the asteroid impact, we would still die of old age anyway.”
Wang Ping looks at the silent trio, consoling them.
“That’s not something to be happy about.”
Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao laugh bitterly in succession.
“Try to find amusement in adversity.”
Wang Ping looks at the three and shakes his head.
He’s actually not feeling pressured.
Even if they indeed reach an impasse and truly cannot resolve the anomaly, he can still escape.
Although that outcome means losing all the hard-earned Group points and having his prestige in the Chat Group somewhat affected, he faces no real life-threatening danger, and he can calmly deal with the anomaly through simulations.
“Mr. Wang is truly worthy.”
Wu Jun flatters him a bit.
“Alright, enough nonsense. It’s time to ask for help from the group. We need to get Gene Potions and technology materials. With these, we should be able to break through.”
Wang Ping pats Wu Jun’s shoulder, laughing as he speaks.
“Yeah, we can still ask for help from the Chat Group!”
Hearing this, Wu Jun’s eyes light up.
“Unfortunately, no one in the Chat Group has transmigrated to a world with advanced technology, nor has anyone acquired a Golden Finger related to it, otherwise, this would have been much simpler.”
Liu Mei says regretfully.
“I wonder if Qu Zhong’s purification ability is of any use.”
After some thought, Chen Yao speaks up.
“It purifies curses and other negative effects. I don’t know if the virus is considered a curse.”
Wang Ping also thinks of Qu Zhong, considering the possibilities.
“However, we can try it out.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping opens the Chat Group, explains the situation, and asks Zeng Lingdong and Wang Shuqi for help. He also @’s Qu Zhong, hoping he can come over.
Zeng Lingdong (89): “Mr.Wang, I’ve signed for an upgraded version of Gene Potion which might help you guys.”
Wang Shuqi (74): “Mr.Wang, no problem. You were the one who captured the alien civilization’s spacecraft and technology in the first place, so it’s only natural to exchange them now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 925: 250: Innate Emperor Flame! The Schemes of Emperor Fentian
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: Chapter 250: Innate Emperor Flame! The Schemes of Emperor Fentian
Qu Zhong (201): “Well, Mr. Wang, I won’t go, I’m currently doing a Group Task….”
Wang Ping (66): “It’s fine, it doesn’t matter if you don’t go, don’t worry about it.”
Having said that, Wang Ping was waiting for Zeng Lingdong and Wang Shuqi to make their group-item exchange.
Soon, Wang Ping received the Gene Potion exchange from Zeng Lingdong and extracted it from the chat group.
As for the spaceship, there was none.
Wang Shuqi (74): “Damn, Mr. Wang, the chat group shows that it can’t be traded in the form of a red envelope, this is totally an abnormal situation.”
...
Wang Ping (66): “Can’t it be sent? It seems to be affected by a weird ability, limiting the original Delivery Function too much. People can’t teleport away, and large items can’t be sent over.”
Wang Ping looked at Wang Shuqi’s words, frowned, and quickly figured out the reason.
This strange situation was really troublesome, and various external aids were also limited.
Next, Wang Ping once again closed the chat group and told Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao the unfortunate news.
“This….”
This news was undoubtedly a thunderbolt, making Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao even more upset.
They had nothing on hand to deal with the Weird BOSS now.
Not to mention dealing with the Weird BOSS, they hadn’t even seen its face in several simulations, as they kept falling to the virus and meteor factors.
“Mr. Wang, can’t we withdraw temporarily?”
Wu Jun said with a bitter smile.
“You need enough group points to leave, I have them, but you can’t.”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun, knowing that he wanted to leave the task and escape to another world to survive.
In fact, Wang Ping had the same idea.
When participating in the Group Task, he had thought that the Weird BOSS would be difficult to deal with, but he never expected that, after so many free simulations, they hadn’t even seen its face.
Now, it was clear that there was no hope of passing the task anymore.
For this reason, Wang Ping had made the worst plan: to temporarily withdraw and deal with this Weird BOSS when the time was right.
While it’s true that the weird monster’s ability was disgusting, even if Wang Ping became an Emperor, it wouldn’t be much different from dealing with it now; at most, there would be a few more Golden Talents and Seven-Color Talents, but having them is better than not having them.
“this….” Hearing Wang Ping’s words, Wu Jun, Liu Mei, and Chen Yao all looked a little desperate.
“Unless I lend you 100 million group points to optimize the Golden finger so you can kill the Weird BOSS with the help of the Optimized Golden Finger or resist the Weird BOSS’s ability to limit the Delivery Function, then we can survive.”
Wang Ping looked at Wu Jun and spoke again.
“Mr. Wang, please let me try. I’ve made miracles before, and I believe I can do it again this time.”
Wu Jun gritted his teeth and said.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded, then directly lent Wu Jun 100 million group points, allowing him to optimize the Golden finger.
“Mr. Wang, after optimizing my Golden finger, the usage limit has changed to once a day, and the probability of triggering something favorable to me has also increased. Also, I don’t have to turn into a woman after using it.”
Wu Jun said excitedly after optimizing the Golden finger.
“Once a day is not bad. But, is not turning into a woman really something to be happy about?”
Wang Ping teased him.
“Compared to these optimizations, I’m more concerned about the improvement of the power limit.”
“Uh, you’re right….”
Wu Jun awkwardly rubbed his nose.
It seemed that only he himself cared about the fact that he would turn into a woman after using the ability, which could be considered his own heartache.
“So, should I use my ability now?”
Wu Jun looked at Wang Ping and asked.
“Go ahead. Let’s see what changes it brings.”
Wang Ping pondered for a moment and said.
Although using the ability in the real world was a little risky, it was the only way to temporarily leave this world, so they had to try, and there was no alternative.
Immediately, Wu Jun took a deep breath and used his ability.
After Wu Jun used his ability, he looked surprised.
Because he found that after using his ability, he actually knew what kind of possibility he had triggered and raised it to 100%.
“Mr. Wang, I triggered the possibility that we can escape. But I don’t know how long this effect will last.”
Wu Jun excitedly said to Wang Ping.
“You really won? It seems that after optimizing the Golden finger, the probability of Wishful Thinking has increased.”
Wang Ping looked at the excited Wu Jun in surprise.
For a moment, Wang Ping wanted to let Wu Jun try to wish in his heart for the Weird BOSS to die instantly.
Of course, this was just a thought, even if it was Wishful Thinking, there was still a difference in difficulty.
For Wu Jun, the chance of triggering the possibility of the Weird BOSS dying instantly was too difficult.
“Mr. Wang, are we leaving now?” Liu Mei asked with an excited face.
“We really need to leave quickly, but before we go, I need to try another simulation to see if we can leave some hope for the people of this world.”
Wang Ping sighed after shaking the Gene Potion in his hand.
“Otherwise, after we leave, the humans of this world will die from the virus in half a year. By then, even if we return to this world and continue to fight the Weird BOSS, there will be no more humans to use.”

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 250: Innate Emperor Flame! The Calculations of Emperor Fentian_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: Chapter 250: Innate Emperor Flame! The Calculations of Emperor Fentian_2
“Mr. Wang is right.” Chen Yao had also calmed down a lot, sighing.
Next, Wang Ping nodded and didn’t say much. He used the free simulation ability again.
He wanted to see if after injecting the gene potion, it could resist the virus invasion.
However, the final result disappointed Wang Ping.
Because the strengthening effect of the gene potion was indeed good, but it still couldn’t resist the horrifying virus.
Instead, after being infected with the virus, those who had injected the gene potion had their lives extended by just two months.
...
Two months, which really wasn’t of much use.
Not to mention, whether the gene potion could be mass-produced was a problem.
“The human beings of this world are beyond saving.”
After opening his eyes, Wang Ping uttered these cruel words.
Hearing this, Wu Jun was slightly stunned. He looked at the pedestrians outside the window with a bitter smile on his face.
They were indeed saviors, but they could not necessarily save the world successfully.
Throughout many missions, they had witnessed many failures and destroyed worlds.
Now, it was the turn of the human beings in their world.
“Before leaving, we can let humanity build shelters and save some fire seeds.”
Wang Ping patted Wu Jun’s shoulder, comforting him a little.
“Yeah.” Wu Jun nodded.
Next, Wang Ping and the others began their operation. Liu Mei used her Charm Skill on the high-Tier humans and issued such an order.
After resolving these matters, the three of Wang Ping chose to teleport away without any hesitation.
After all, how long Wu Jun’s ability could last was unknown, and staying any longer would mean more danger.
….
“This scene of fleeing back in disgrace seems familiar.”
After returning to the Upper Realm, Wang Ping rubbed his temples, quite speechless.
He remembered that during the last mission in the Cultivation world where Qin Tian was, they had gone to deal with the bizarre problems enthusiastically, only to find out that they couldn’t kill the enemy, and then they had to flee back in disgrace.
In the end, it was the Predecessor Transmigrators of the Second-generation Chat Group who managed to kill the bizarre enemy.
“Forget it, don’t think too much about it. Getting stronger is the main priority.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, threw the worries out of his mind, and actively entered the immersive simulation state of the paid simulation.
In the blink of an eye, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, his vision slightly changed, a luminescent screen appeared in front of his eyes, and familiar words emerged.
[On the first day, after thinking about it, you chose to directly break through the Supreme Heavenly Path. The staying palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was greatly astonished at your request and immediately refused.]
[In his opinion, your attempt to break through the Supreme Heavenly Path is simply seeking your own death. The Taiyi Imperial Palace has finally produced such a powerful monster like you, and he doesn’t want you to die riskily in the Supreme Heavenly Path.]
[Seeing the staying palace master of Taiyi Imperial Palace refusing you, you chose to display a part of your combat power. After knowing a part of your combat power, the staying palace master was quite shocked.]
[However, he still said that he couldn’t make this decision and needed to consult with the self-titled Quasi-emperor Ancestors in the palace.]
[In the end, these self-titled Quasi-emperor Ancestors were also shocked by your combat power, exclaiming that you are a freak. Then, they allowed you to challenge the Supreme Heavenly Path.]
[Shortly after, you started to challenge the Supreme Heavenly Path. It’s like the last simulation challenge you had done. This time, you found it easier than the last time.]
[Although this time you don’t have the Minor Time-Space Body and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, but your cultivation is lower. With three-tenths of the Time-Space Heavenly Tao True Spirit comprehension and your memory from the last paid simulation, you know the strength, divine skills, and trump cards of these opponents, which naturally make it easier for you to deal with them.]
[In the end, you easily passed the Supreme Heavenly Path and met the virtual image of the Taiyi Great Emperor. The virtual image of the Taiyi Great Emperor marveled at you, thinking you are truly a freak. Even the legendary Chaos body shouldn’t be a match for you.]
[Hearing this, you just chuckled and started bragging with the virtual image of Taiyi Great Emperor, stating that the Chaos body was nothing and that you could suppress it with one hand.]
[Seeing your ‘arrogance,’ the virtual image of the Taiyi Great Emperor hesitated for a moment and then laughed, saying that you’re great and similar to him back in his days.]
[Afterward, the virtual image of the Taiyi Great Emperor explained the Taiyi Emperor Tower’s matters to you like he did during the last paid simulation and also gave you rewards. After almost a hundred years, your cultivation level has been directly upgraded from the Peak of Superme to the Peak of Heavenly Supreme. This cultivation improvement feels extremely satisfying.]
[At the same time, your gains are even greater this time. Because you had comprehended three-tenths of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao in the last paid simulation due to the rewards from the Supreme Heavenly Path, this time, your reward was to further strengthen your comprehension. Although it didn’t allow you to comprehend four-tenths of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit and step into the Minor Domain, the gains were still astonishing.]
[Feeling this, you wondered if you could quickly comprehend four-tenths of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao after clearing the Supreme Heavenly Path several more times. Also, you were curious whether your cultivation would still improve if you cleared the Supreme Heavenly Path when you were already at the peak of the Heavenly Supreme.]
[However, you can only find out these things in future simulations. For now, after consolidating your gains, you left the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[Of course, although you have become the sole master of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, you didn’t take it away directly. After all, the Taiyi Emperor Tower is a symbol of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Moreover, the Taiyi Emperor Tower is often used to train the disciples of Taiyi Imperial Palace, so taking it away would have a significant impact on the palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 250 Heavenly Born Emperor Flame! Emperor Fen Tian’s Calculations_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: Chapter 250 Heavenly Born Emperor Flame! Emperor Fen Tian’s Calculations_3
[“Therefore, you plan to take the Taiyi Emperor Tower only when needed, and at other times, let it stay here, aiding the disciples and elders of Taiyi Imperial Palace in their cultivation.”]
[“Soon, your accomplishment of completing the Supreme Heavenly Path spread through the higher ranks of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. As for the cultivators beneath them, they were not privileged to know this affair.”]
[“For a moment, all the ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace were taken aback. They had never imagined you could achieve something even the Emperor could not—it was indeed a shock.”]
[“Suddenly, the ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace held you in even higher regard.”]
[“In fact, because of this event, the ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace relayed the news to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, who was away. Upon receiving the news, he rushed back and was all praises for you, believing that you were the hope of the Taiyi Imperial Palace for nurturing a flying immortal.”]
[“Seeing this, you laughingly proposed to apprentice under the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. The Emperor was quite surprised since you had already paved your own path and reached the peak of heavenly supreme cultivation. You no longer needed his teaching nor the need for apprenticeship.”]
...
[“At your stage, even the Emperor lacks the power to teach you anything. Forced guidance might affect your path since each cultivator’s path is unique. The best approach is to comprehend the mysteries of others’ paths and integrate them into your own.”]
[“Upon hearing this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor explained the situation and refused to take you as a disciple . Understanding this, you were somewhat helpless, knowing that your chances of becoming his disciple had disappeared.”]
[“However, you clearly understand that this is an unavoidable issue. You have experienced this several times and have become accustomed to it.”]
[“Seeing your disappointment, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor laughed and said you need not worry about it. Even if you don’t become his Emperor’s son, the ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace wouldn’t do anything to you. More precisely, all the ancestors, including him, would stand behind you, supporting you to become the real palace master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace and lead it forward.”]
[“Upon hearing this, you felt the urge to retort. Obviously, you were being misunderstood. Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words clearly implied they believed in you. Without any concerns or worries, they would entrust you with the real power in the future. You just had to concentrate on your cultivation and nothing else mattered.”]
[“In the end, you didn’t explain anything, merely nodded without mentioning the apprenticeship again.”]
[“Afterward, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor reminded you of a few things, and after discussing some matters with the ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace, he prepared to leave. You understood that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was looking for Yu Daoyi.”]
[“After some thought, you let him know about Yu Daoyi’s situation—that she was trapped inside a Quasi-emperor Tier sea demon creature in the Guimo Sea.”]
[“Upon hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was quite astonished. He didn’t expect that you would have guessed he was looking for his daughter, Yu Daoyi, and even know her specific situation.”]
[“Curious, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor asked how you knew this. You responded that you come from All Heavens, possessing an unstable ability to see the future. If Heavenly Feather Great Emperor believed you, he could go look in the Guimo Sea.”]
[“After a deep look at you, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor patted your shoulders, expressing his willingness to trust you. Then, he gave you an incarnation for protection before leaving Taiyi Imperial Palace.”]
[“After the departure of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, you closed yourself off again for over a hundred years. Once your cultivation had solidified thoroughly, you planned to operate on your own.”]
[“Next, you decided to take the Taiyi Emperor Tower and head towards the Elemental Star, bringing Bai Tianhong, Ye Chen, and others from the Lower Realm to the Upper Realm for training. At the same time, you revealed your Supreme aura and established a dominating presence in Tao Palace, letting other forces understand Tao Palace is not to be trifled with.”]
[“Then, you set off towards the Taiyi Imperial Palace with Ye Chen and others. On the way, you had the Supreme Servants arranged by the Taiyi Imperial Palace to bring Bai Tianhong and the others back to the palace, while you headed alone to Purgatory Ancient Star.”]
[“Once, you escaped from the white flame of Purgatory Ancient Star in a pitiful state. Now, your cultivation has reached the Supreme peak, and you possess the Taiyi Emperor Tower, your combat prowess has transformed significantly.”]
[“Under these circumstances, you were confident you could unlock the secrets of Purgatory Ancient Star. If you could do so, you believed it might propel you even further.”]
[“Upon arriving at Purgatory Ancient Star, you drove away the cultivators there. With the arrival of a Supreme, no one dared disobey your decree, and they all hastily departed.”]
[“Once everyone had left, you began to provoke the mysterious living being deep within the Purgatory Ancient Star, igniting a relentless mockery.”]
[“This infuriated the being inside, causing terrifying white flames to surge out, aiming to reduce you to ashes.”]
[“However, you remained unshaken and effortlessly blocked these white flames. Once, you were burned and forced to flee in panic. But now, you could resist these white flames with your own power.”]
[“After all, although these white flames were terrifying and not even a Supreme would dare touch them, you were not an ordinary Supreme. You were a monstrous Supreme capable of challenging a Quasi-Emperor. To defend against these white flames was all too easy for you.”]

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 250 Innate Emperor Flame! Burning Emperor’s Calculations_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Chapter 250 Innate Emperor Flame! Burning Emperor’s Calculations_4
[Upon realizing that the white flames did nothing to you, the living beings within the Purgatory Ancient Star become furious, attempting to break free from their seals and burn you to death.]
[If they weren’t sealed within, they wouldn’t be subjected to such humiliation. You, a mere Heavenly Venerate, have managed to bully them. Although you are not an ordinary Heavenly Venerate, they possess power that even Quasi-Emperors dare not provoke if they were not sealed.]
[Using your Breaking Origin Sky Eye, you notice the rage of the living beings inside the Purgatory Ancient Star. You know that under the seal, this is all they can do.]
[You also analyze that even if they were truly released, they probably won’t be able to hurt you. Even if they are extremely terrifying, and you are no match for them, you can still summon the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation.]
[An incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor possesses power exceeding that of an ordinary elderly emperor. Suppressing the living beings inside the Purgatory Ancient Star would be a piece of cake.]
[Upon thinking about this, you decide to take action. Using the power of the Breaking Origin Sky Eye, you begin to break the seal. It must be said that this seal is genuinely terrifying, even the prowess of the Breaking Origin Sky Eye can’t easily shake it.]
...
[Of course, if given enough time, breaking the seal would be inevitable for you. On that matter, you are not hurried; you have plenty of time to accomplish this task.]
[At this moment, the living beings within the sealed Purgatory Ancient Star see your actions. First, they are surprised that you possess the Breaking Origin Sky Eye in its early stages. Then, they sneer coldly, thinking that you are courting death. Once the seal is broken, they can kill you directly. When the time comes, refining you will bring great benefits to them.]
[Just as both of you have your own thoughts, decades pass by. Surprisingly, while attempting to break the seal, you trigger the effect of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, breaking the seal directly.]
[This makes you quite astonished. You didn’t expect the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack to have an impact on a non-living entity like the seal.]
[Afterward, you complain a bit about the absurdly low trigger probability of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack. In your previous paid simulation, you tried to break open the seal on the jade talisman. So many years have passed, yet it has never been triggered.]
[Of course, you remember that this time, an additional Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound appeared in your simulation. You can’t help suspecting that it triggered the effect of Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound. In other words, you haven’t triggered the effect of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack in the previous decades. It was judged to be extremely unlucky, then your luck rebounded.]
[If that is the case, then Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound and Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack are quite the perfect match. Of course, this Golden Talent pairs well with other talents that require probability activation.]
[Your only complaint is that the cooldown time of Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound is too long, a full hundred years. Otherwise, you think this talent could be on par with the level of Colorful Talent.]
[While you are lost in thought, the living beings within the Purgatory Ancient Star are also stunned. They didn’t expect you to suddenly break the seal, and you didn’t use any unimaginably powerful forces during the process.]
[This makes the living beings inside the Purgatory Ancient Star suspect that you are hiding a horrifying method, making them somewhat wary of you.]
[Next, the living beings within the Purgatory Ancient Star burst into laughter, believing that although you have some tricks up your sleeve, once the seal is broken, you won’t stand a chance against them. As long as they are careful, you will be their meal.]
[As the living beings inside the Purgatory Ancient Star laugh, you start to inquire about their origins and whether they are a kind of living being that evolved from the head of a Great Emperor.]
[Your inquiry enrages the living beings within the Purgatory Ancient Star. They declare that they are not living beings originating from the head of a Great Emperor, but Innate Emperor Flames born from the fire’s origin, the first fire in the Upper Realm.]
[Hearing the living beings within the Purgatory Ancient Star, you are quite surprised. You didn’t expect that the living beings inside are Innate Emperor Flames born from the fire’s origin. Although you are somewhat doubtful of their claims to be the first fire in the Upper Realm, thinking they might be exaggerating and boasting, you still believe that this Emperor Flame is an extraordinary existence.]
[With this, you are interested in subduing it, as it may bring significant benefits to you. Following that, you mock them deliberately once more, stating that since they’re Innate Emperor Flames, why were they sealed here? Without you breaking the seal, they might never escape.]
[Infuriated by your mockery, the Innate Emperor Flame reveals that it was attacked and ambushed by the Burning Emperor. That damned Burning Emperor sealed it within the specially constructed Great Array made from the heads of Great Emperors to assimilate it, intending to grind it down and transform it into the purest source of fire from Heavenly Tao.]
[After finishing their explanation, the Innate Emperor Flame grits its teeth, stating that if it weren’t for the Burning Emperor’s ambush, it would never have fallen to such a state, and its power would not have been so greatly diminished.]
[You never expected that the Innate Emperor Flame would reveal its secrets after being provoked by you. You think that the Innate Emperor Flame might still be quite naive, only recently born before being ambushed by the Burning Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 250 Innate Emperor Flame! Burning Emperor's Calculations_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Chapter 250 Innate Emperor Flame! Burning Emperor’s Calculations_5
[At the same time, you feel very emotional. You never expected that all this was because of the Burning Emperor. Burning Emperor, the ancestor of the Chi Clan, this name has not been heard for a long time.]
[However, now that you’ve dealt with the Innate Emperor Flame and want to subdue and refine it, it’s likely that you’ll have to face the Burning Emperor, the fallen ancestor of the Chi Clan who has been engulfed by the Source of Darkness.]
[Of course, you don’t care about such things since you already have enough enemies to deal with, and the powerful Dark Emperor, Burning Emperor, is no exception.]
[Following this, you directly attack the Innate Emperor Flame. Seeing your move, the Innate Emperor Flame snorts coldly, directly forming a white flame giant.]
[This white flame giant, the aura emanating from it, can actually rival a Quasi-Emperor. This existence is enough to obliterate other Heaven Supremes with ease.]
[However, you look at this white flame giant without fear, but instead, with overflowing intent to fight. You are very curious whether you can now fight against a Quasi-Emperor tier existence with your current strength.]
...
[Soon, you began fighting against the flame giant directly. It must be said that the flame giant, possessing Quasi-Emperor-tier combat power, is truly powerful. Even with your full strength, it’s still not its match.]
[Of course, since the flame giant is just a flame puppet-like thing condensed by the Innate Emperor Flame, with low intelligence, it’s unable to harm you who’s cultivating the Road of Time and Space.]
[You feel regretful about this result, regretful that you still cannot contend with a Quasi-Emperor. Naturally, you’re not too surprised by this outcome. After all, if you want to contend with a Quasi-Emperor, aside from using the hidden cards of your talents, only through achieving minor success in both Breaking Origin Sky Eye and Time-Space Body can your combat power greatly increase, allowing you to fight or even defeat an Ordinary Quasi-Emperor.]
[In terms of your current personal combat power, there is still a significant gap between you and Quasi-Emperor level. Of course, although there’s a gap, with the help of your Time-Space Divine Skill, you still have some leeway.]
[However, while you are quite unsatisfied with your combat performance, the Innate Emperor Flame is shocked. It never expected you to be so powerful, able to contend against the flame giant it had condensed with your Heavenly Supreme peak cultivation, and without suffering any damage.]
[After the shock, the Innate Emperor Flame becomes even more covetous of you, feeling that you’re an extremely rare human treasure beneficial to it.]
[As a result, the Innate Emperor Flame intensifies its output. In response, you no longer wish to further test your strength and decide to fully utilize the effects of Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven-Color Talent – Burst Blade.]
[With the activation of double attack and four times critical strike damage, your combat power surges significantly, catching the flame giant off-guard.]
[Finally, as you trigger the terrifying effect of eight times critical strike damage, you directly exploded the flame giant. This greatly shocked the Innate Emperor Flame, which never thought you could unleash such terrifying power.]
[Afterward, the Innate Emperor Flame’s temper flares up. As the Innate Emperor Flame, it’s one of the most unique existences in the Upper Realm, able to contend with the Burning Emperor at its peak. It should not be challenged by you, a Heavenly Supreme, beyond its rank now that it’s weakened. Such an outcome would be humiliating, and if it spreads, it would tarnish the reputation of the Innate Emperor Flame.]
[Nevertheless, the Innate Emperor Flame wants to unleash its terrifying flame power and fight you personally, but you have no plans to continue testing your own strength, as you directly sacrifice the Taiyi Emperor Tower, which is close to the quasi-immortal level.]
[As the Taiyi Emperor Tower appears, the Innate Emperor Flame’s complexion changes, not expecting you to have such a hidden card. In its current weakened state, fighting against you, who holds the Taiyi Emperor Tower, would undoubtedly not yield any benefits.]
[As a result, the Innate Emperor Flame claims to remember you and the Taiyi Imperial Palace, vowing to settle the score with you in the future. As it says this, it plans to flee.]
[At this, you smirk coldly, naturally not intending to let the Innate Emperor Flame escape. You channel strength into the Taiyi Emperor Tower, fully reviving it, and suppressing the Innate Emperor Flame.]
[Seeing this, the Innate Emperor Flame secretly curses and attempts to use its great-consumption Divine Skill to escape the place. However, you see through its intentions with the Breaking Origin Sky Eye and directly consume your lifespan to use the Divine Skill Neutralization ability.]
[The Divine Skill that the Innate Emperor Flame used at a great cost suddenly becomes ineffective, leaving it dumbfounded and suppressed by the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[After being suppressed by the Taiyi Emperor Tower, the Innate Emperor Flame erupts with terrifying flames, wanting to struggle and break free from the suppression of the Taiyi Emperor Tower. However, it’s ultimately too weak, and coupled with the Taiyi Emperor Tower being close to a quasi-immortal artifact, it’s not something the current Innate Emperor Flame can contend with.]
[As a result, the Innate Emperor Flame is suppressed by your Taiyi Emperor Tower and sealed within it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 251: The Emperor's Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body!
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: Chapter 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body!
“Suppressed the Innate Emperor Flame, but I don’t know what use does this Innate Emperor Flame exactly have that could make the Burning Emperor do so much work.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and thought to himself in his heart.
In order to obtain the Innate Emperor Flame, the Burning Emperor had used an emperor’s skull as the main formation and secretly attacked the Innate Emperor Flame.
Such a character expending so much energy and calculation must be no simple matter, hiding within it a great benefit to even Great Emperors.
If the simulated Wang Ping could figure out the secrets, he might be able to transform his combat power once again.
Additionally, breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor realm with this opportunity was also possible.
...
As Wang Ping pondered secretly, the Text Simulation continued.
[You suppress the Innate Emperor Flame, wanting to refine it. However, you find yourself completely unable to refine the Innate Emperor Flame. But this is normal. After all, even the Burning Emperor needs to set up a formation to grind it down.]
[Even after a hundred thousand years, when you meet Ye Chen, the Innate Emperor Flame remains ungrounded, returning to the pure source of fire.]
[After thinking it over, you decide to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace first and then consider how to deal with the Innate Emperor Flame.]
[However, just as you prepare to leave, an anomaly occurs. At this moment, a powerful Great Emperor’s might and terrifying darkness burst forth from the depths of the universe, spreading out.]
[This attracts the attention of countless powerful cultivators, who are surprised and even frightened. Even Quasi-Emperors are extremely apprehensive, while Great Emperors are all looking towards the Source of Darkness with narrowed eyes.]
[The appearance of the Great Emperor’s might and the spread of darkness indicate that a Dark Emperor has fallen into the Source of Darkness and is about to be born, causing a Dark Disaster in the process.]
[However, it is unknown why this soon-to-be-born Burning Emperor is so furious and appearing so suddenly.]
[You too feel this Great Emperor’s might and are astonished in your heart. After all, this is something that has never happened in previous simulations and is an anomaly.]
[Soon, you think of the Innate Emperor Flame and the Burning Emperor. You speculate that the Burning Emperor is likely about to be born. After all, you took action against Purgatory Ancient Star, breaking its prohibition and suppressing the Innate Emperor Flame. You have ruined the Burning Emperor’s chessboard and coveted his treasures, which is something he can’t tolerate.]
[Immediately, you put away the Taiyi Emperor Tower without hesitation, preparing to use the Golden Talent: Transmission ability to escape.]
[However, you underestimated the means of the Burning Emperor. You find that the space around Purgatory Ancient Star has long been sealed off, and you can’t use your Golden Talent: Transmission.]
[This realization weighs heavily on your heart, knowing that trouble is brewing. So, you flee towards the depths of the starry sky, trying to escape this area.]
[At that moment, a Crimson-Black Great Emperor Tao Fruit phantom appears in the entire universe. The entire universe seems to turn blood-red, and terrifying flames are brewing.]
[Clearly, this is a sign of the Great Emperor’s birth. You’ve seen scenes like this before, only that those Great Emperors weren’t as high-profile as the Burning Emperor.]
[Still, you don’t pay too much attention and continue to flee away from the Source of Darkness. At this moment, a cold voice rings out, stating that a junior like you who stole from him and even dared to run away is truly too presumptuous.]
[Then, the Emperor’s Might of the Burning Emperor directly oppresses you, and a terrifying flame palm large enough to cover the entire galaxy also grabs at you.]
[Faced with the oppressive Emperor’s Might, you find it extremely uncomfortable, and you have no ability to resist the terrifying flame palm that is large enough to cover the galaxy.]
[At this point, all you can do is sigh, knowing that only the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation can save you. Just as you think so, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation appears, blocking this terrifying strike.]
[The auras of the two emperors collide, shaking the universe, and many powerful cultivators marvel at the sight, never having expected that they would be able to witness a battle between two Great Emperors in the Last Dharma Age.]
[Seeing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation block him, The Burning Emperor steps on the galaxy, looks down on Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation and coldly says, “Heavenly Feather, do you want to fight me with just an incarnation?”]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation indifferently states that since the Burning Emperor has chosen to fall into darkness and become a lapdog for the darkness, he should not make a reappearance. Once he reappears, he must be prepared for his demise.]
[The Burning Emperor laughs in anger, stating that even the real body of the Heavenly Feather Emperor wouldn’t have the qualifications to say such words to him, let alone a mere incarnation. Trying to fight him and annihilate him is truly laughable.]
[Immediately after, the Burning Emperor and Heavenly Feather Emperor’s incarnation begin to fight once again. However, the Burning Emperor is ultimately not an ordinary emperor, but a powerful one. Even if the Heavenly Feather Emperor’s real body comes, it may not be able to defeat him, let alone an incarnation.]
[Therefore, even you can feel the power of the Heavenly Feather Emperor’s incarnation rapidly weakening, eventually it will burst.]
[Seeing this scene, the other Quasi-Emperors and Great Emperors are quite surprised by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s strength. After all, this is the Burning Emperor, a powerful Great Emperor second only to Emperor Lord tier characters. It is truly unexpected that one incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor can contend with him, indirectly reflecting the real strength of the Heavenly Feather Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 251: The Emperor's Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: Chapter 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _2
[However, everyone shook their heads, thinking that it was impossible to stop the Burning Emperor without the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s true body. At the same time, they were also very astonished and doubtful, wondering what kind of ability this little Heavenly Venerate had to break the great array laid by the Burning Emperor, making him so furious.]
[Aside from that, some Emperors were also tempted by the Innate Emperor Flame sealed by the Burning Emperor in those years. After all, it was an Innate Emperor Flame, and the Burning Emperor had chosen to launch a shameless surprise attack for it, even killing another Great Emperor. Even if they weren’t Fire Attribute cultivators, the Innate Emperor Flame would still be of great benefit to them. So, some Emperors began to consider whether to intervene in this battle and capture you.]
[It was at this moment that two terrifying auras suddenly descended. Unsurprisingly, these two auras were the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s true body and Yu Daoyi.]
[Obviously, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor successfully rescued Yu Daoyi from the Guimo Sea. Your intervention changed the fate of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi.]
[After the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor appeared, he withdrew his incarnation and began to fight with the Burning Emperor. He displayed terrifying combat power, astonishingly no weaker than his opponent, which was shocking.]
[Yu Daoyi came to your side, blocking the aftermath of the terrifying battle for you, reducing your pressure. Otherwise, even if you utilized the Taiyi Emperor Tower to defend yourself, the pressure would still be immense.]
...
[The battle between two Emperors had an increasingly significant impact, affecting a wider and wider range. In the end, those Emperors who saw Yu Daoyi appear gave up their plans to intervene and capture you.]
[After all, Yu Daoyi had been famous for a long time, with formidable combat power. Even ordinary Emperors couldn’t easily subdue her. So, they decided it was better to abandon their plans to attack. Otherwise, if they angered the Burning Emperor, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and Yu Daoyi, and provoked them to take forceful actions against the third-party forces they belonged to, it would be troublesome.]
[Just as all parties gave up their thoughts and didn’t want to help the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor repel the Burning Emperor, the voice of the Immortal Mansion Strongman resounded.]
