[The Immortal Mansion Strongman coldly stated that if the Burning Emperor continued to stay in the outer world, causing billions of living beings to die tragically, their Immortal Mansion would take action and kill the Burning Emperor. So, the Burning Emperor had two choices, either retreat back into the Source of Darkness or die.]
[When the Immortal Mansion intervened, all parties were alarmed, and the Burning Emperor’s expression changed as he looked in the direction of the Immortal Mansion.]
[Then, the Burning Emperor sneered, saying that he wanted to see what ability the Immortal Mansion had to make such a statement. Next, to everyone’s surprise, the Burning Emperor chose to stop fighting the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and unleashed a terrifying Divine Skill against the Immortal Mansion.]
[This scene enraged the Immortal Mansion Strongman. Immediately after, Immortal Light appeared, tearing apart the Burning Emperor’s attack and continued towards the Burning Emperor without losing momentum.]
[Faced with the Immortal Mansion’s forceful counterattack, even the Burning Emperor’s expression changed as he quickly defended himself. However, he underestimated the strength of the Immortal Mansion and suffered severe injuries as the Immortal Light hit him, causing blood to splatter across the starry sky.]
[Nevertheless, the Burning Emperor’s reaction was also swift, retreating into the Source of Darkness the moment he was injured.]
[Many cultivators in the Upper Realm never expected that the Immortal Mansion would be so formidable, managing to seriously injure the Burning Emperor with a single attack without even revealing their strongmen. For a time, all powers in the Upper Realm were extremely wary of the Immortal Mansion.]
[As for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, after glancing in the direction of the Immortal Mansion, he came to your side, bringing you and Yu Daoyi back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
…
“I really didn’t expect the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to come back so timely. I thought this time would be another losing battle.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation content, thinking to himself in his heart.
However, the Burning Emperor was really reckless, daring to attack the Immortal Mansion directly, doing something other Emperors dared not to try easily.
Of course, the Immortal Mansion probably feared the Source of Darkness as well.
After all, the Burning Emperor had fallen into darkness and become the Dark Emperor, possibly establishing some connection with the Source of Darkness.
So, the Immortal Mansion wouldn’t easily kill the Burning Emperor, for fear of provoking an undesirable response from the Source of Darkness.
If not for that, with the foundation of the Immortal Mansion, killing the Burning Emperor would definitely be an easy task.
The gap between an Emperor and a quasi-Fairy is simply too wide.
Not to mention, there is an Emperor Monarch in between them.
Although Emperor Monarch is also an Emperor realm but just a different title, it certainly must be much stronger than the Ordinary Emperor.
“However, are the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Burning Emperor both top-tier Emperors below Emperor Monarch? Their positions seem to be clear now. Speaking of which, the curse on the people of Chi Village is due to the Burning Emperor, who is also the Ancestor of the Chi Clan. If I kill the Burning Emperor, will the curse on the people of Chi Village disappear?”
After Wang Ping sighed, he thought of another matter.
Although he didn’t know why there were no curses when other Emperors fell into the Source of Darkness, and only the people of the Chi Clan suffered a curse because of the Burning Emperor falling into the Source of Darkness, Wang Ping believed that if he killed the Burning Emperor, the source of the curse, perhaps the Heavenly Tao would revoke the curse on the people of Chi Village.
Of course, it’s not that simple to kill a top-tier Emperor like the Burning Emperor. Only when Wang Ping steps into the Great Emperor Tier will he have a chance to accomplish it.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 251: The Emperor's Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: Chapter 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _3
“Speaking of which, the Heavenly Tao had a problem, and the Heavenly Curse was something unsolvable for me in the past. But if I were to bring the people of Chi Village to Taiyi Imperial Palace, with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s capability, he should definitely be able to suppress it, right?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself, planning to try it out during the next simulation.
If it was feasible, Wang Ping would immediately have the powerful beings of Taiyi Imperial Palace descend to the lower realm and retrieve people, just like in this simulation, bringing all the familiar faces from the lower realm to the Upper Realm.
Afterwards, Wang Ping focused his mind and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[After returning to Taiyi Imperial Palace, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was grateful for the information you provided. Without it, he did not know how long it would take to investigate his daughter’s whereabouts and rescue her. In a place like Guimo Sea, if it took too long, an accident could happen, resulting in a separation between the heavens and the people.]
[Yu Daoyi was also grateful to you with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and was quite curious about you. After all, your talent and performance were astonishing, and you even had the ability to predict the future.]
...
[Although you felt that you owed them more, you couldn’t say it during this simulation, so you could only accept their gratitude, saying that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others also saved you, so there was no need to be so polite.]
[Next, you took out a jade stone, hoping Yu Daoyi would help you upgrade your Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Minor Domain level.]
[Naturally, Yu Daoyi agreed.]
[In the blink of an eye, two thousand years had passed. During these two thousand years, Yu Daoyi had been helping you with your cultivation, successfully assisting you in advancing your Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Minor Domain level, greatly increasing your combat power once again.]
[After helping you finish your cultivation, Yu Daoyi went into seclusion. After all, her origin had been injured, and she couldn’t recover in a place like Guimo Sea, but in Taiyi Imperial Palace, she could at least stabilize her injury.]
[Although Taiyi Imperial Palace did not have any precious medicines that could help a powerful being at her level recover from such a severe origin injury, at the very least, it could prevent the injury from continuously worsening and restore some of her strength.]
[During Yu Daoyi’s seclusion, you pondered the matter of the pure-blooded Phoenix Quasi-Emperor. Unfortunately, Huang Yin and Huang Qing were too young during the opening of the Golden Age, so they couldn’t meet the requirements.]
[You thought that either you would prevent the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s plan in the future, allowing Huang Qing and Huang Yin to have enough time to grow to the Quasi-Emperor tier, or you would go to the Four Profound Small Universe to ask the Phoenix Clan for their Origin.]
[Speaking of the Phoenix Clan in the Four Profound Small Universe, you were somewhat puzzled. After all, the Phoenix Clan was extremely low-profile, and even if pure-blooded phoenixes like Huang Qing and Huang Yin appeared, they showed no intention of reaching out to them, pretending not to notice them.]
[Obviously, the Phoenix Clan in the Four Profound Small Universe might also have some secrets or encountered some incidents that caused them to ignore the existence of Huang Yin and Huang Qing.]
[Of course, although you were curious about the Phoenix Clan’s secrets, you weren’t interested in exploring them at this time. What you needed to do now was to become stronger.]
[Next, you found the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and told him the story of how you sacrificed the Taiyi Emperor Tower to suppress the Innate Emperor Flame.]
[At this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed with emotion, saying that Burning Emperor probably never expected a Heavenly Monarch like you to break his prohibition. After all, the prohibition was extremely terrifying, and even an Emperor would have difficulty breaking it. If they forcibly broke it, the Great Array would turn into the Terrifying Flame Array.]
[Although such a large array couldn’t confront an Emperor, it would be enough to hold them off. At that time, the Burning Emperor would emerge and kill the Emperor who had taken action.]
[That was why many powerful beings knew that Purgatory Ancient Star held a great secret, but they dared not take action against it. As for the Emperor Monarch tier characters who could ignore the Burning Emperor, they either didn’t care about this great secret or had long disappeared.]
[After all, Emperor Monarch tier characters were much rarer than Emperors and were generally very elusive.]
[Speaking of Emperor Monarch tier characters, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s expression changed slightly.]
[Seeing this, you knew that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was thinking about the matters of Destructing tao Emperor. However, at this time, you didn’t intend to inquire further, but turned to the main topic, asking Heavenly Feather Great Emperor if he knew the purpose of Innate Emperor Flame that could actually cause Burning Emperor such a fuss.]
[After pondering for a while, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor told you something. Rumor has it that the existence of Innate Emperor Flame and Innate Emperor Water is very special, related to Heavenly Tao, and they are the favored children of Heavenly Tao. Their power is enough to contend with an Emperor as soon as they are born. Some powerful beings speculated that they are special living beings created by Heavenly Tao to suppress the Dark Disaster.]
[After all, the powerful beings of the Upper Realm tend to have strong private interests and mostly seek to become immortal. As a result, although the Dark Disaster causes great harm to the Upper Realm, many Emperors choose to ignore it.]
[If there was no Dark Emperor emerging from the Dark Disaster, the Emperors would naturally suppress it easily. However, if the Dark Emperor appeared, many Emperors would choose to ignore it all.]
[This is because fighting between Emperors had a huge impact, and there was no benefit for them in doing so. Furthermore, they might be stabbed in the back by their enemies.]

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Chapter 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _4
[Listening to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s explanation, you remain silent, understanding the meaning behind his words. Cultivators are too selfish and unwilling to cooperate for the greater good, leading the Heavenly Tao to think these powerful beings are unreliable. That’s why they created beings like the Innate Emperor Flame to help suppress the Dark Disaster in the Upper Realm.]
[At the same time, you also guess the reason for the Heavenly Tao’s hatred of Burning Emperor and the curse placed on his descendants might be because he ambushed the Innate Emperor Flame and suppressed it.]
[During your silence, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor reveals the truth. In a major Dark Disaster battle a hundred thousand years ago, the Innate Emperor Flame fought against the darkness. The Burning Emperor and another powerful Emperor, who had a good relationship, chose to fight together.]
[However, something unexpected happened. The Burning Emperor ambushed the Innate Emperor Flame, suppressed it, and killed the other Emperor he was friends with, taking his head as a formation body to seal the Innate Emperor Flame.]
[Since then, the Chi Clan has been cursed by the Heavenly Tao and faced suppression from other forces, especially the family of the ambushed Emperor, who hated the Burning Emperor and the Chi Clan, wanting to exterminate them completely.]
[Unfortunately, that Imperial Clan also faced attacks from opposing forces due to the fall of their Emperor, ultimately disappearing from the river of history.]
...
[After listening to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s story, you sigh, never expecting such things to have happened. The Burning Emperor is even more ruthless than you thought, no wonder the Chi Clan had such a special fate, being cursed by the Heavenly Tao.]
[Soon, you begin to think about another issue. Since the Innate Emperor Flame is so special and you have suppressed it, will you face retribution from the Heavenly Tao as well?]
[Regarding your concerns, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shakes his head, not knowing if you’ll face the Heavenly Tao’s retribution. This answer leaves you conflicted, wondering whether to release the Innate Emperor Flame. After all, it’s like a hot potato that could easily create trouble.]
[Seeing your dilemma, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor ponders for a moment, then says that there might be some problems with the Heavenly Tao in the Upper Realm. If you have the ability to refine the Innate Emperor Flame, it might not necessarily cause problems. As for the benefits of refining the Innate Emperor Flame…rumor has it that you could acquire a powerful physique that rivals the Red Fire Holy Body and is comparable to the Time Tao Body.]
[Upon hearing this, you are a bit puzzled. If the benefits are only this much, it shouldn’t be enough to make a character like the Burning Emperor take such drastic measures.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor smiles, saying that it’s just a rumor. In fact, there’s another rumor that if one can collect the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, and Darkness, it seems you could obtain the legendary Chaotic Body through some means. Of course, that’s still a rumor, because no one has been able to collect the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits, so this rumor could be nonsense.]
[Your heart trembles as Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words remind you of many things. The Master of Nine Stars Pavilion might have acquired the Chaotic Body by plundering the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Origins and using the Devouring Immortal Demon Body or some other method.]
[That is to say, both the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion and the mysterious character might have obtained the Chaotic Body. However, you highly suspect that the Chaotic Body obtained by the mysterious character is not complete or as powerful. In the end, the Chaotic Body condensed from the numerous talents of the Golden Age cannot rival the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[After all, that person robbed the Heavenly Dao Origins and created the Ten Forbidden Lands, their Chaotic Body could be considered the true Chaotic Body.]
[As you are stunned by these revelations, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor adds that you shouldn’t underestimate the Emperor Flame Body that can rival the Time Tao Body. To become an Emperor-Tier Character, several requirements need to be met.]
[First, one’s cultivation must reach the pinnacle of the Emperor Realm; second, one must possess a powerful physique far superior to the Sacred Body, such as the Time Tao Body, Space Tao Body, or Destructing Tao Body, and develop it to perfection; third, one must comprehend the Great Perfection of Heavenly Tao True Spirit.]
[In other words, by obtaining the Emperor Flame Body, the Burning Emperor had the qualifications to advance to Emperor Monarch tier and fight for Immortal Fate in the future with a significant advantage.]
[After hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s explanation, you feel a bit embarrassed. Due to the Life Simulator, you have already encountered three quasi-Fairies and two Chaotic Bodies, one of which is the perfect Chaotic Body of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion. So you’ve somewhat neglected the likes of Time Tao Body and Emperor Flame Body.]
[Indeed, you are very formidable, possessing the Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye. But that doesn’t mean that these physiques aren’t powerful. These physiques are equally strong, and for those who possess them to be top Emperors, the importance is even more significant.]
[For a moment, you learn your lesson and remind yourself not to be too picky with your opponents, and not to see the Chaotic Body as the only threat.]
[Next, you ponder over the issue of the Innate Emperor Flame. If you can refine the Innate Emperor Flame, there would be numerous benefits. If the rumors are true, you might try to plan for obtaining the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits and cultivating the Chaotic Body.]
[After all, a Chaotic Body is feared to be even superior to the Seven-Color Talent and isn’t available in the current Life Simulator. Most likely, only after the Life Simulator is optimized, there will be a chance to refresh and obtain the Chaotic Body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Chapter 251: The Emperor’s Battle Reappears! The Method to Obtain the Chaotic Body! _5
[However, you still have a long way to go before you can optimize the Life Simulator again. For now, it’s impossible to acquire the Chaotic Body through the simulator. Thus, if you can obtain it with the resources from the Upper Realm, that would be much more comfortable.]
[But soon, you sigh, feeling that you’re being too imaginative. After all, the Innate Emperor Flame calculated by the Burning Emperor has been suppressed and refined for so many years and is still so powerful. You barely took advantage of it by suppressing the Innate Emperor Flame, but it led to the Burning Emperor’s fury, almost costing you your life.]
[Although the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor took action to block the Burning Emperor, and the Immortal Mansion severely wounded him, you also understood the dangerous nature of the power you held. Moreover, even if you had it, it would still be difficult to refine.]
[You think again, the other Heavenly Tao Life Spirits are unknown and may be powerful. To acquire them, you’d undoubtedly be engaging in wishful thinking.]
[Don’t mention that you’re currently a Heavenly Supreme, even if you became a Great Emperor, it’s uncertain if you could collect all Heavenly Tao Life Spirits. In addition, you don’t know some methods mentioned by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. It may be a secret known only to the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[The Master of Nine Stars Pavilion is a quasi-Fairy, so trying to obtain secrets from him is undoubtedly wishful thinking. Unless, you can completely conceal your true identity, join the Nine Stars Pavilion, and attempt to become a high-ranking member to gain access to those secrets.]
...
[However, such a thing is clearly impossible to achieve. Unless you obtain an extremely special Seven-Color Talent, then there might be a chance to deceive others.]
[Therefore, you ponder back and forth, and feel that instead of trying to refine the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Life Spirits, it’s more reliable to think about refreshing a Seven-Color Talent that can plunder the constitution of others.]
[In that case, once you obtain a low-end version of Chaotic Body through strange means, you can snatch it away with this Seven-Color Talent.]
[Of course, you quickly think of another method. This method is to try to get Lin Yuanyuan to drain the strangeness and then transfer the extracted origin to you.]
[For a moment, you feel that combining this method with Lin Yuanyuan’s is worth trying. For this reason, your thoughts become more active, planning to try it in this life simulation.]
[However, you soon become disheartened again. After all, your cultivation has reached the peak of the Heavenly Supreme level, so it’s impossible for you to enter that secret realm again.]
[Unless, you steel your heart and directly reduce your cultivation to the Half-step Supreme tier to enter and confront the strangeness.]
[However, directly reducing your Heavenly Supreme peak cultivation to Half-step Supreme comes with a huge price, causing you great pain. For a moment, you somewhat regret not considering this issue earlier.]
[If you had thought about it later, you could have waited until the Golden Age began before doing so, without having to advance to the Supreme Heavenly Path in advance.]
[After all, the Supreme Heavenly Path is a one-time event, and once you take the challenge earlier, there’ll be no rewards to obtain afterwards. Even if your cultivation is promoted to the Early Stage Supreme again, you won’t be able to directly raise your cultivation level from the Early Stage Supreme to the peak of the Heavenly Supreme.]
…..
“So there are so many secrets. Now, I have more and more understanding of the secrets of the Chaotic Body. I have to say, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is really an encyclopedia-like existence.”
“Perhaps, I should gossip with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and ask all about the secrets of the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and couldn’t help but feel emotional.
Of course, although he said that, without obtaining the relevant information, unlocking these hidden explanations would still be impossible.
Some things only become accessible once you’ve had contact with them; otherwise, asking aimlessly wouldn’t produce any meaningful answers.
Subsequently, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you plan to seal yourself and wait for the Golden Age to unfold your plan.]
[Of course, before sealing yourself, you also instructed the Supreme Servant to not only lead Ye Chen and others in cultivation but also to find Lin Yuanyuan and bring her to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly a hundred thousand years have passed, and the Golden Age has arrived. After you emerge, the first thing you do is choose to abolish your cultivation and reduce it to the Half-step Supreme tier.]
[This confused the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, who didn’t understand why you would do such a foolish thing. After thinking about it, you decided to reveal some things about the Immortal Mansion Secret Realm, the devious calculation of the geniuses, and the Nine Stars Pavilion Master’s grand plan.]
[Hearing your words, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was shocked and somewhat doubted the truth. However, he ultimately chose to believe in you and began to think about how to stop the Nine Stars Pavilion Master.]
[You don’t know what the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is going to do, choosing to keep a low profile and, at most, accepting a few disciples.]
[In the end, things developed just like in your memory. The Immortal Mansion opened, and you successfully reached the third round. The secret realm appeared, and you chose to step into it.]
[This time, when you entered, there was no solemnity as before; your mindset was very calm.]
[After all, although you weakened your cultivation to the Half-step Supreme tier, you could not fake the fact that you had comprehended 30% of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit. Not to mention that your Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye were already partially successful. With those talents, you were confident that you could beat the strangeness to a pulp.]

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Cold Moon Appears!
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: Chapter 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Cold Moon Appears!
[After entering the secret realm, you were transferred into a trap. However, you didn’t notice Lin Yuanyuan being transferred into the trap.]
[Regarding this, you weren’t surprised. After all, Lin Yuanyuan had always been hidden by you, never making a high-profile appearance, and never made it onto the Three Saints List. Of course, this also included the fact that she couldn’t completely drain top-tier geniuses.]
[As a result, Lin Yuanyuan’s current level could pass the second Immortal Mansion Trial, but she wasn’t worthy of being targeted by the mysterious figure.]
[This time, you still chose to follow the same strategy as before, staying low-key, waiting for the various parties to join forces and break the formation. Then, you found Lin Yuanyuan, saved Huangyin and Huang Qing and other acquaintances, and continued to observe the developments quietly.]
[In the end, the mysterious figure still obtained the Little Chaotic Body, just like in your memory, becoming arrogant and fighting against thousands of geniuses.]
[Seeing this, you finally decided to take action. With your intervention, the situation shook everyone.]
...
[Because the originally extremely powerful Chaos Body Mysterious figure turned out to be as helpless as a naive child in front of you, having no power to resist and being beaten by you.]
[For a moment, everyone was a bit shocked, not expecting such a monster like you to exist and be hidden so deeply among the peers. Achieving a small Time-Space Body, Breaking Origin Sky Eye, and comprehending the Heavenly Tao True Spirit at the Half-step Supreme Realm, how could other people compete with you?]
[The mysterious figure didn’t expect that you, such a monster, would suddenly appear to suppress him so easily, which alarmed and angered him.]
[However, even though the mysterious figure was easily suppressed by you and greatly shocked and angry, he still didn’t worry about his own safety, merely sneering and launching a suicidal attack.]
[He is the mysterious figure. Not only can he steal and grant other people’s origins and control them, he can also unleash a curse. As long as he is killed, the curse would be activated. At that time, you would fall, and your monstrous origin would become his possession.]
[Regarding the mysterious figure’s use of the suicidal attack, you remained calm and didn’t care. You could naturally guess his thoughts and some of his abilities, knowing you couldn’t kill the mysterious figure easily.]
[At the same time, the mysterious figure could have escaped long ago if he wanted to, but he was also coveting your origin.]
[Therefore, you only used 10% of your Heavenly Tao True Spirit, not using your comprehended Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra and other talents, and kept many of your trump cards.]
[After all, if you showed all your cards, it would definitely scare the mysterious figure and might cause him to escape out of stress. Furthermore, with your current abilities, dealing with the mysterious figure now, you don’t need to use so many trump cards. In the same realm, the combat power of both parties is no longer on the same level.]
[Without exaggeration, in the current Upper Realm, you’re invincible under the Supreme Realm. Even though you had reduced your cultivation to the Half-step Supreme Tier, you would still be invincible within the Supreme Realm.]
[The mysterious figure found that his suicidal attack still couldn’t defeat you, and he couldn’t help being depressed. He had schemed for so long to obtain the Chaotic Body. As a result, he had just obtained the Chaotic Body and hadn’t been arrogant for long before being beaten by you, which truly frustrated him.]
[It was said that the Chaotic Body was the strongest and unbeatable in the same realm, and no one was his match. Yet, this was a real slap in the face. For a moment, he even doubted whether his schemes were worth it or not.]
[However, when the mysterious figure discovered that you started to switch from offense to defense, he was overjoyed again, believing that his tactics were still effective, and the gap between you and him wasn’t that big. As such, he could completely wear you down with multiple lives. Even if you didn’t actively attack him or kill him, he could still defeat you by taking a death-defying approach.]
[At that time, he would only need to expend two lives. And he, the mysterious figure, had many lives to spare.]
[It was just when the mysterious figure was slightly relaxed that you showed a sharp light in your eyes and launched a full-strength attack, directly using the terrifying Divine Skills to distort the space around the mysterious figure and forming a Time-Space Illusory Realm.]
[This made the mysterious figure very fearful, not expecting you to have such a move.]
[However, he soon calmed down and sneered relentlessly. After all, no matter how strong you were, it was impossible for you to completely kill him. Moreover, if you really used a killing move, you would be done for.]
[It’s just that the mysterious figure didn’t expect what happened later. Obviously, he still didn’t know about the existence of Lin Yuanyuan.]
[As Wang Ping controlled the mysterious figure, Lin Yuanyuan launched a powerful attack using her ability.]
[At this point, you couldn’t help but admire Lin Yuanyuan’s fierceness, and also realized how terrifying her ability was, not even requiring the opponent to have any physiological response.]
[Soon, the mysterious figure noticed something was wrong, as his power and vitality were being drained by someone.]
[However, it was useless for him to react now; once Lin Yuanyuan got hold of someone, the process couldn’t be stopped.]
[In the end, the mysterious figure was completely drained by Lin Yuanyuan, turning into a dried corpse, completely dead. No matter how many Death Replacement Puppets he had, it was useless, and he couldn’t revive.]
[You sensed the mysterious figure’s complete death and once again marveled at Lin Yuanyuan. You felt that she was the real nemesis of the mysterious figure. The number of mysterious figures that died at her hands was several times more than yours, and all of them were troublesome.]

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 252: Violent and Mysterious! Emperor Cold Moon Appears! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: Chapter 252: Violent and Mysterious! Emperor Cold Moon Appears! _2
[After feeling the power of her own strength, Lin Yuanyuan handed over the Little Chaotic Body Origin she had extracted to you.]
[You were quite satisfied with Lin Yuanyuan’s generous act and felt that your previous investment in her was indeed the right choice, and you didn’t help the wrong person.]
[After all, it’s a Chaotic Body, albeit only a Little Chaotic Body, which is far superior to the Time-Space Body. Lin Yuanyuan giving it up so generously without any hesitation is not something an ordinary person could do.]
[You know, the Burning Emperor did such cruel things just to get the Innate Emperor Flame—killing fellow taoists and abandoning his family. If a Little Chaotic Body were placed in front of them, you believe most of the great emperors would go crazy.]
……
“Yuanyuan’s move really made people’s affection for her soar.”
...
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and chuckled lightly.
It seems that it’s difficult for other group members to catch up with his pace, but Lin Yuanyuan can.
At the same time, Wang Ping felt that he could also take Lin Yuanyuan with him when he went to Myriad Heavens Paradise.
As for the Rule Stone, once he is strong enough, he could also secure one for Lin Yuanyuan.
Wang Ping planned to cultivate Lin Yuanyuan into his right-hand man.
[After obtaining the origin of the Little Chaotic Body, you thought you could obtain a Little Chaotic Body yourself, but a startling thing happened.]
[This is that the Little Chaotic Body Origin resists you and is incompatible with your physique. If you forcefully refine the Little Chaotic Body Origin, you risk exploding and dying.]
[This makes you feel annoyed and puzzled about why this is happening. Soon, you recalled Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s description of how to obtain a Chaotic Body.]
[You suspect that to carry a Chaotic Body, one might need the Nine Major Attributes Special Physique, which could match the Chaotic Body and serve as a fundamental carrier for integration. Besides that, there may be other conditions you don’t know about.]
[And the strange thing that devoured so many talents’ origins and condensed a Chaotic Body using the Devouring Immortal Demon Body might have met this condition inadvertently.]
[As for Lin Yuanyuan, she extracted it through the golden finger ability, which might not have the same hidden danger.]
[Of course, all of this is just your guess, whether your guess is right or wrong, it remains uncertain.]
[At this moment, you have no choice but to think too much and decide to give the Chaotic Body’s Origin back to Lin Yuanyuan.]
[In the end, Lin Yuanyuan obtained the Little Chaotic Body, and you were kept busy for nothing. This made you quite annoyed.]
[It was at this moment that Lin Yuanyuan found out that she was about to be hit by a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[As the tribulation appeared in the secret realm, Lin Yuanyuan panicked, and your pupils shrank as well.]
[After all, the Heavenly Tribulation of the Chaotic Body is not simple. If it appears in this relatively small secret realm, it will cover you all in the range of Heavenly Tribulation. At that time, the intensity of the Heavenly Tribulation will be enough to shatter the secret realm and kill all of you.]
[However, no matter how anxious you are, it’s useless. Because in this secret realm, you can’t leave as you wish. To leave, you have to wait for the Immortal Mansion Strongman to detect the anomaly.]
[Unfortunately, by the time the Immortal Mansion discovers the anomaly, it will be a month or two later, by which time it will be too late.]
[At this moment, the remaining talents also came back to their senses from their shock and panicked as well.]
[They never expected that so many things would happen after entering the secret realm. They were first targeted and attacked, then witnessed the Devouring Immortal Demon Body swallowing the talents and condensing the Chaotic Body, slaughtering all around them.]
[In the end, they saw you forcefully suppress the Chaotic Body, allowing Lin Yuanyuan to extract it. What’s even more shocking is your behavior of exchanging the Chaotic Body Origin with each other, making their scalps tingle and their eyes turn red with envy.]
[And now, they were implicated and faced a life-threatening situation, which is simply annoying.]
[For a moment, the surviving talents ran as far away as they could, like frightened monkeys, trying to get as far away from Lin Yuanyuan as possible.]
[However, there was one person among them who chose not to run away.]
[This person was none other than Ku Xuan. Ku Xuan looked at you and Lin Yuanyuan with a complicated expression.]
[You also noticed Ku Xuan, smiled slightly at him, and congratulated your fellow taoist on breaking free from the strange control and regaining his freedom.]
[Hearing your words, Ku Xuan was astonished, not expecting that you knew about what happened to him.]
[Immediately, Ku Xuan solemnly bowed to you with a full face, grateful that you saved him. He engraved such great kindness as Ku Xuan in his heart and vowed to repay it in the future.]
[Upon hearing this, the light in your eyes flashed, and you didn’t expect to forge a friendship with Ku Xuan in this manner. In this way, you might be able to learn some secrets about the Chaotic Body from Ku Xuan.]
[At the same time, you think that maybe this time you can escape the secret realm with Ku Xuan and avoid the continuous devastating punishment from the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[Next, you said that the expression of gratitude should be discussed over wine. For now, you hope that Ku Xuan will tell you how to leave the secret realm.]
[Ku Xuan laughed and agreed that they need to express their gratitude by drinking the Immortal Brew together at the wine table. For now, they should get out of here first.]
[When he finished speaking, Ku Xuan performed a hand seal and opened the passage of the secret realm.]
[As the passage of the secret realm opened, Lin Yuanyuan rushed out first.]
[Then, you and Ku Xuan left the secret realm one after another.]

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Leng Yue Appears!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: Chapter 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Leng Yue Appears!_3
[After leaving the secret realm, you find yourselves transported to an unknown starry sky. In the distance, Lin Yuanyuan appears, the Heavenly Tribulation brewing around her growing even more terrifying.]
[You all watch the unfolding scene, each lost in your thoughts. Finally, Ku Xuan sighs, expressing his awe for such an extraordinary woman that exists in this world.]
[Hearing Ku Xuan’s words, you look at him with an odd expression, suspecting that he may have taken a liking to Lin Yuanyuan – if that is the case, Ku Xuan’s taste in women is truly admirable.]
[However, in the end, you do not ask whether he has fallen for Lin Yuanyuan. Instead, you bring up the main issue and ask Ku Xuan how he ended up being tailed and controlled by the tricky culprit.]
[Your questions make Ku Xuan’s eyes flicker. He guesses that you probably know he was controlled by the tricky culprit, but you do not know about his past.]
[Considering this, Ku Xuan meditates for a moment and decides there is no need to hide anything, especially now that the tricky culprit is dead.]
...
[Hence, Ku Xuan tells you the reason. It turns out that after the Golden Age appeared, he emerged into the world. Originally, as the heir of the Ku family, he wanted to battle all the world’s heroes and cultivate his Invincible Heart.]
[However, he was frustrated right after his first battle. As soon as he left his family, he met the tricky culprit.]
[At that time, he didn’t know that the person was the tricky culprit. During that battle, they fought fiercely, and in the end, both of them were severely injured.]
[Due to their mutual injuries and his damaged origin, he was controlled by the tricky culprit’s power. Not even his Dao Protector noticed this. The tricky culprit’s ability is truly terrifying.]
[As such, he has been forced to obey the tricky culprit and has done many things for him.]
[To make it worse, to prevent any accidental discovery, the tricky culprit made him kill his own Dao Protector, who had witnessed this battle.]
[Upon hearing this, you seem subtly taken aback. You didn’t expect Ku Xuan to be so unlucky, to have met the tricky culprit on his very first trip out.]
…
“Poor kid, Ku Xuan. However, the tricky culprit is even more careful than I thought. This also implies that he was worried about the strength of the Ku family discovering his existence and about his control over Ku Xuan. So, all his measures like changing the entrance to the secret realm couldn’t possibly have been provided by the Ku family.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation, his eyes gleaming as he analyzes silently.
Initially, he thought that the tricky culprit and the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion had a partnership. However, he later overturned this assumption through subsequent simulations.
If the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion didn’t have a partnership with the tricky culprit, then there must be other forces involved.
Otherwise, the tricky culprit wouldn’t have dared to be so bold.
Now having ruled out the Ku family, it’s time for the true mastermind to show up.
Wang Ping finds Emperor Fengxin very suspicious.
After all, his conduct during the previous simulation, particularly targeted at him and the Taiyi Imperial Palace, is highly suspect.
Of course, even if Emperor Fengxin isn’t the mastermind, Wang Ping doesn’t intend to let him go. He must be caught and severely beaten.
Many thoughts flash through Wang Ping’s mind as he continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you ask Ku Xuan which force or powerhouse is behind the tricky culprit. Ku Xuan clenches his fists, his eyes filled with murderous intent, and coldly spits out the words – “Slaughter Paradise” and “Emperor Fengxin”. The space tool to move the Secret Realm Entrance is from Slaughter Paradise. As for Emperor Fengxin, he is the emperor backing the tricky culprit.]
[Hearing Ku Xuan’s answer, you frown. You guessed right about Emperor Fengxin being the mastermind. However, you didn’t expect the tricky culprit to be backed by Slaughter Paradise. Slaughter Paradise, too, comes from All Heavens; their actions undoubtedly breaks the norms.]
[In the end, after some thinking, you realize that Slaughter Paradise shouldn’t have the guts to team up with the tricky culprit. The reason for their extreme behavior is probably that they couldn’t contact their headquarters, and they can’t go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise either. So, they resorted to such drastic measures.]
[In this case, all of this traces back to you. Most likely, this is the cycle of cause and effect.]
[Next, you ask Ku Xuan whether the tricky culprit has any connection with the Nine Stars Pavilion, and if he has any connection with the Pavilion Master.]
[Ku Xuan shakes his head, saying that the tricky culprit has no relation to the mysterious Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion – a man who works behind the scenes and is unknown to the public. Even his own Longevity Ku family has difficulty figuring out his intentions.]
[Not surprised by Ku Xuan’s answer, you further inquire whether Ku Xuan knows which of the Myriad Heavens Forces the Pavilion Master comes from.]
[Ku Xuan finds the growing list of your questions a bit irritating and rolls his eyes at you. However, in the end, he answers your question. The Pavilion Master appeared a long time ago, his emergence can be traced back to the previous epoch. That is to say, the Pavilion Master and his Longevity Ku family originated from the same epoch.]
[Ku Xuan’s answer shocks you. You didn’t expect the Pavilion Master to come from the previous epoch. This information is truly shocking.]
[However, you quickly identify a blind spot. If the Pavilion Master comes from the previous epoch, then he’s been alive for too long. After all, the previous epoch can be traced back to a hundred million years ago. Unless quasi-Fairy Tier individuals can live that long.]

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Leng Yue Appears! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Chapter 252: Brutal and Mysterious! Emperor Leng Yue Appears! _4
[If that’s the case, doesn’t it mean that the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion was a quasi-Fairy Tier figure a hundred million years ago?]
[Detecting your doubt, Ku Xuan shakes his head, indicating that it is impossible for quasi-Fairies to live for that long. However, it seems that the Pavilion Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion has a method to prolong his life. As for which of the Myriad Heavens Forces he comes from, even his own Longevity Ku Family is not clear. They only know one thing: the Pavilion Master of the Nine Stars is not from any known Myriad Heavens Forces and is like a lone wolf.]
[Hearing this, you frown, feeling that the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion is too mysterious and elusive.]
[Nevertheless, you quickly give up thinking and look in the direction of Lin Yuanyuan. At this moment, Lin Yuanyuan began Crossing Tribulation. However, even though Lin Yuanyuan also possesses the Little Chaotic Body and has absorbed the strange power and Divine Skills, her use of power is still inferior to the mysterious character.]
[For this reason, the horrifying Heavenly Tribulation that was powerful enough to kill the mysterious character left Lin Yuanyuan struggling to survive, looking very pathetic and in danger of losing her life at any moment.]
[Seeing this, your frown deepens, wanting to help Lin Yuanyuan, but you hold back your thoughts. After all, the Heavenly Tribulation is too terrifying; if you forcibly intervene, the Tribulation will only become even more horrifying. By then, you will also be killed by it.]
...
[Thus, you can only hope that Lin Yuanyuan can survive. Lin Yuanyuan has also bought the Rebirth Tally and should be able to make it through. Even if she is killed by the Heavenly Tribulation once, she can resurrect and avoid the Tribulation. Although doing so would result in her Little Chaotic Body not being refined by the Heavenly Tribulation to become stronger and not being perfect, surviving is a good outcome.]
[On the other side, Ku Xuan, seeing Lin Yuanyuan’s miserable state, also becomes anxious and wants to help her, even considering summoning his Ancestral Incarnation.]
[Just at this moment, a figure suddenly appears here with a cold face, wearing a white robe that has a peculiar moon pattern. Upon his appearance, he looks down at Lin Yuanyuan, completely ignoring the presence of the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[When this scene unfolds, both Ku Xuan and Lin Yuanyuan are extremely shocked, not knowing who this white-robed figure is and what he intends to do.]
[As for you, upon seeing the newcomer, your pupils suddenly constrict, betraying your astonishment. This person is the existence that Alpha once told you about: a Predecessor Transmigrator from the First Generation Chat Group, commonly known as the Leng Yue Emperor.]
[You never expected that the Leng Yue Emperor, a member of the First Generation Traveler Chat Group, would suddenly appear here and target Lin Yuanyuan.]
[For a moment, you feel that you are in big trouble. After all, the Leng Yue Emperor is a powerful figure, not someone you can oppose. Even with the Emperor’s Incarnation, you are likely not a match for him.]
[As you tremble inside, the Heavenly Tribulation also detects the presence of the Leng Yue Emperor and becomes furious, causing its energy to multiply and intending to shatter the Leng Yue Emperor as well.]
[However, facing this terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, the Leng Yue Emperor merely claps his hands, and a mysterious crescent-shaped Divine Skill is condensed, illuminating the universe, directly freezing and suppressing the Tribulation before crushing it.]
[Thus, the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation formed by the Little Chaotic Body, after being strengthened, is crushed by the Leng Yue Emperor in such a simple manner.]
[Seeing this, your expression becomes even more serious, feeling extremely wary of this Predecessor Transcendental. Although this fella has never appeared in previous simulations, he clearly is an extremely powerful Emperor.]
[However, because Alpha mentioned that he had been lurking in the Source of Darkness and had never appeared before, you have always overlooked his existence. Now that he has appeared for the first time and displayed such formidable strength, you are very cautious.]
[Next, the Leng Yue Emperor looks down at Lin Yuanyuan and grabs her in one hand. Then, he looks in your direction, calmly revealing your identities and addressing you as juniors.]
[As for the Leng Yue Emperor seeing through your and Lin Yuanyuan’s identities, you are not surprised. After all, although you are well disguised, it is difficult to hide in front of such figures. Not to mention, as a member of the First Generation Chat Group, the Leng Yue Emperor is more sensitive to the chat group’s aura.]
[Unexpectedly, Ku Xuan is quite surprised that you and the Leng Yue Emperor are acquainted. For a moment, he wants to say something, but after opening his mouth, he says nothing, only looking at the Leng Yue Emperor with great trepidation.]
[As for you, after calming down, you put on a warm expression and perform the junior salute to the Leng Yue Emperor, suggesting that since you are all part of the chat group, you should work together rather than be enemies.]
[The Leng Yue Emperor looks at you, calmly stating that he is different from many Transcenders in that he does not resent the chat group or Alpha. After all, without Alpha, he wouldn’t be where he is today. As for the brutal tasks and deaths, in his opinion, as long as you want to gain power and live a colorful life in all Heavens, it’s the proper price to pay. There is no gain without sacrifice. As for those who died, it’s simply because they were incapable.]
[Hearing the Leng Yue Emperor’s words, you somewhat agree. Your previous self was too naive, unable to see the essence and only speaking from your own perspective. Indeed, without Alpha, there would be no exciting lives for any of you. Although Alpha is quite dark-hearted, it is foolish to think that someone can have a comfortable and happy life among the Heavens without giving anything in return.]
[Without Alpha, many group members would probably still be poor, starving people, miserable NPCs in Earth OL.]
[At the same time, you have to admit one thing: compared to the ruthless people in the First Generation Chat Group, the Transcenders in your Third Generation Chat Group are indeed more like flowers in a greenhouse, and there’s a sense that they’re just playing house. That’s why, even with the Golden Finger, you think most group members probably can’t grow up. If it weren’t for Lin Yuanyuan, becoming Emperor, let alone Supreme or even Emperor, would likely be a problem for them.]
[Following that, the Leng Yue Emperor doesn’t show any intention of attacking you but gazes deeply at you and leaves directly with Lin Yuanyuan, disappearing into thin air.]
[Seeing this, you sigh, not knowing what Lin Yuanyuan’s fate will be. However, you suspect it won’t be good. The Transcendental Predecessor Leng Yue Emperor seems to disdain targeting juniors like you, but he is clearly very interested in Lin Yuanyuan’s Little Chaotic Body. As a result, Lin Yuanyuan is in extremely dangerous circumstances, with a high probability of being refined.]
[Nevertheless, although you can guess the outcome, you can’t prevent it from happening. So, you prepare to leave this place.]
[However, just as you’re about to leave, you see Ku Xuan activate the Emperor’s Incarnation on his body, roaring angrily for the Leng Yue Emperor to release Lin Yuanyuan.]

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 253: Two Emperors Fall! The True Immortal Weapon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Chapter 253: Two Emperors Fall! The True Immortal Weapon!
“Goodness, could it be that Ku Xuan really has his sights set on Lin Yuanyuan? His fetish is quite terrifying. Could it be that he has a cuckold fetish?”
Wang Ping was shocked by the content of the Text Simulation.
After all, anyone who dares to have thoughts about Lin Yuanyuan is truly a brave warrior.
Not to mention, Lin Yuanyuan had already directly demonstrated her ability to ‘kill’ the strange creatures beforehand.
“No, this guy’s motives aren’t that simple.”
Soon, Wang Ping calmed down.
...
At their level, love at first sight basically doesn’t exist.
Ku Xuan might have a good impression of Lin Yuanyuan because she saved his life, but there’s a much greater probability that he is targeting her Little Chaotic Body and her abilities.
After all, the ability to snatch away the constitution and power of those strange creatures is simply too heaven-defying.
In addition, the talent of a child born with a Little Chaotic Body would be unimaginable.
In other words, Lin Yuanyuan’s value is simply too great and cannot be ignored by anyone.
Perhaps even Leng Yue Emperor would not think of killing Lin Yuanyuan and refining her.
After all, it’s not worth it.
Moreover, Wang Ping had already tested that the Chaotic Body requires a host and other conditions, so Leng Yue Emperor might not be able to absorb the origin of the Chaotic Body.
“I almost got fooled by this kid. This kid’s got quite the cunning mind.”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows and muttered a complaint.
However, this was quite normal.
After all, Ku Xuan was born in the Longevity Ku family and was the First Heaven’s Proud Genius before the appearance of these outsiders. It would be impossible for him to be without a cunning mind.
Soon after, Wang Ping focused his attention on how the matter would eventually be resolved.
[As Ku Xuan activated the Emperor’s Incarnation, you were also very surprised, not expecting Ku Xuan to be so decisive. With the appearance of the Emperor’s Incarnation, Ku Xuan’s father appeared before your eyes.]
[Then, the Emperor’s Incarnation saw the departing Leng Yue Emperor and Lin Yuanyuan in his hands. There was no need for Ku Xuan to explain any further since the Chaotic Body represents everything. Since he saw it, he would want to compete for it.]
[For this reason, the incarnation of Ku Xuan’s father directly stopped Leng Yue Emperor and asked him to hand over Lin Yuanyuan.]
[The Leng Yue Emperor coldly looked at the incarnation of Ku Xuan’s father, questioning if he really wanted to make an enemy of him.]
[The incarnation of Ku Xuan’s father calmly replied that since his son wanted to protect the girl, he would take action. If Leng Yue Emperor wished to be an enemy of the Longevity Ku family, he should be prepared for his downfall.]
[Upon hearing this, Leng Yue Emperor’s expression grew extremely cold, and he directly attacked the incarnation of Ku Xuan’s father, instantly shattering it.]
[Seeing this scene, you and Ku Xuan were both shocked, not expecting Leng Yue Emperor to be so formidable. Although this was only an Emperor’s Incarnation, as a member of the Longevity Ku family, Ku Xuan’s father was definitely not weak among the Emperors. Although his incarnation was weaker than his main body, being instantly killed was still quite astonishing.]
[For a moment, you wondered whether the battle strength of Leng Yue Emperor, the Predecessor Transmigrator, had already reached the same level as Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, both being top Emperors just below the Emperor Monarch level.]
[When your shock faded, two more Emperor-like auras appeared. This was none other than Ku Xuan’s parents. The two Emperors came together, shaking the Big Universe.]
[Immediately, all the powerful individuals turned their attention to the scene. As they looked over, their faces showed surprise.]
[Because you and Ku Xuan had appeared in the universe, the situation was somewhat abnormal. After all, you two should have been in the Dream Demon Secret Realm undergoing trials.]
[Soon, these powerful individuals noticed Lin Yuanyuan in Leng Yue Emperor’s hands and began to formulate what they would do next. After all, this was a Chaotic Body, and whether it was refining her or cultivating her as their successor, there were endless benefits.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi also arrived. Instead of asking about the Chaos Body, they asked why you had left the secret realm prematurely and appeared here without any of the other powerful individuals noticing.]
[In response, you chose to tell them about what had happened in the secret realm. Hearing this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi were silent, not expecting your prophecy to come true—the secret realm was transferred, and there was a strange plot. However, the strangeness was planned by you, ultimately benefiting Lin Yuanyuan.]
[For a time, the two didn’t know what to say. You had gone through great effort and expended your own cultivation to enter the secret realm, only to gain no benefits.]
[Seeing their helplessness, you shook your head, saying that the situation couldn’t be calculated like this. After all, if you hadn’t gone in, Yu Daohong, the other disciples of Taiyi Imperial Palace, and your acquaintances would have been in danger.]
[Hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor thought your point was valid, but he felt that the price you had paid was too high and unnecessary. After all, as long as the disciples of the Taiyi Imperial Palace didn’t enter the Immortal Mansion, these incidents could have been avoided.]
[Next, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others all looked to Leng Yue Emperor. All of the Emperors present were not only astonished by your early departure from the secret realm but were also more interested in the Chaotic Body. Therefore, they all stared at Leng Yue Emperor, sensing that a battle between Emperors might erupt at any moment.]

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 253: Two Emperors Fall! The True Immortal Artifact!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Chapter 253: Two Emperors Fall! The True Immortal Artifact!_2
[At this moment, Ku Xuan’s parents coldly looked at Leng Yue Emperor, indicating that they already knew the ins and outs of the matter. Since this woman was their son’s savior and the Tao Companion he chose, they couldn’t let Leng Yue Emperor take her away. If Leng Yue Emperor didn’t want to fall completely, he should let her go and leave.]
[These words left many cultivators puzzled, not understanding what the meaning of the life-saving grace was, but all of them were interested and wanted to use Leng Yue Emperor’s hand to explore the true strength of Longevity Ku Family and see how many Emperors they had and whether there were powers above Emperor level hidden within.]
[Leng Yue Emperor ignored the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors, and spoke indifferently, stating that no one in this world could threaten him. Even if the Immortal came, he had nothing to fear, let alone the mere Longevity Ku Family.]
[This domineering remark astonished many cultivators, including you, and you felt Leng Yue Emperor, a Predecessor Transcender from the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group, was indeed very overbearing.]
[However, he was facing the Longevity Ku family with quasi-fairy backing and many covetous Emperors. Even if Leng Yue Emperor was a top Emperor, this time he was in danger.]
[Seeing Leng Yue Emperor showing no signs of retreating and even showing contempt for them, Ku Xuan’s parents wore a solemn expression and stopped talking, directly launching their attack on Leng Yue Emperor.]
...
[However, when facing the Divine Skills jointly launched by Ku Xuan’s parents, Leng Yue Emperor still stood with his hands behind his back, completely motionless. This caused the other Emperors to be quite surprised, feeling that Leng Yue Emperor was perhaps somewhat too arrogant.]
[After all, facing two Emperors at once, and these two Emperors were Tao Companions, the combined combat power they exerted was absolutely not inferior to any other top Emperors.]
[At this moment, a ray of Immortal Light suddenly appeared in the Big Universe, casually wiping out the attack of Ku Xuan’s parents. This scene shocked everyone. They never expected the Immortal Mansion to intervene and block the attack of the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors.]
[You were also quite surprised, not expecting such a change and guessing in your heart that this Predecessor Transmigrator, Leng Yue Emperor, might have some relationship with the Immortal Mansion. If that was the case, it would be interesting. For a time, some gossip emerged in your heart.]
[Ku Xuan’s parents were also unprepared for the Immortal Mansion Strongman’s intervention, and couldn’t help but question the meaning of the Immortal Mansion’s actions. In response, a voice echoed from the Immortal Mansion. The gates of the Immortal realm would soon open, and if the Longevity Ku Family did not want to suffer heavy losses when Immortal Fate appeared, they should retreat.]
[Such threats made many powerful people quite surprised, not expecting that the Immortal Mansion would actually choose to confront the Longevity Ku Family for the sake of Leng Yue Emperor, who had fallen into the Source of Darkness.]
[The Ku Family’s Twin Emperors were furious, feeling that the Immortal Mansion was threatening them. Although they were indeed very wary of the Immortal Mansion, it did not mean that the Longevity Ku Family feared the Immortal Mansion.]
[However, while the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors were scolding and questioning the Immortal Mansion, another elusive voice sounded, telling the two to return. This made the Ku family’s Twin Emperors quite astonished, not knowing the intentions of their family’s Ancestor and why they chose to back down.]
[This also made other forces quite surprised, thinking that there must be a big secret between the Immortal Mansion and Longevity Ku Family. At the same time, they believed that Leng Yue Emperor was not as simple as they had imagined.]
[Finally, with no choice, the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors retracted their power, somewhat unwillingly. Leng Yue Emperor calmly watched the three leave, and then also disappeared.]
[Seeing this, the other Emperors frowned and had various thoughts in their minds. In the end, they chose not to take action.]
[Among these Emperors, Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter felt quite heavy. After all, the development of the situation seemed to have gone beyond their expectations. The Chaotic Body was not obtained by the leader of the conspiracy, and Ku Xuan and you left the secret realm early, indicating that something had changed that they were not aware of.]
[They both had some doubts that the leader of the conspiracy had already encountered an accident, and that Ku Xuan had gotten rid of their control. If this was the case, then their troubles would be even greater. Once the matter came to light, they would most likely be targeted by other Emperors, who would take the opportunity to eliminate them.]
[After all, nobody would want to let go of the opportunity to hit a drowning dog. The death of one more Emperor meant one less competitor.]
[Just as Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter were about to retreat, you chose to speak up, asking these two main culprits, Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter, to stay.]
[Your sudden words surprised many powerful people, who didn’t know why you said such things. At the same time, these words were also disrespectful to the great Emperors.]
[Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter’s expressions grew gloomy, stating that you, a Junior, were extremely rude. However, since you were a Junior, they would not hold it against you. After saying this, they intended to leave directly.]
[However, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was not going to let them leave so easily. Without hesitation, he unleashed a terrifying aura, blocking Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter, and stated that since the two of them had plotted against everyone, they should be prepared to be held accountable.]
[Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter sneered, claiming that they hadn’t plotted anything and advised Heavenly Feather Great Emperor not to throw dirty water on them because of personal grievances. As they spoke, the two of them jointly attacked Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, intending to repel him and escape from this place.]

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 253: The Fall of the Two Emperors! The True Immortal Weapon! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Chapter 253: The Fall of the Two Emperors! The True Immortal Weapon! _3
[This turn of events left the other powerhouses even more puzzled. They didn’t understand what Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and you were up to and also noticed something off about Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter.]
[At this moment, Ku Xuan opened up and detailed what happened in the secret realm. Ku Xuan knew very well that he needed to step in now, otherwise, he and his Longevity Ku Family would bear the brunt.]
[Now, the only way to calm the coming fury of the groups is to reveal the truth and join forces to kill Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter.]
[As Ku Xuan revealed the truth, everyone was furious. They couldn’t believe that Emperor Fengxin and Slaughter Paradise would dare to collude with the strange, calculating various power groups, and refining the Little Chaotic Body. If it were not for you and Lin Yuanyuan’s capabilities, the truth would have been concealed, and they would be made fools of.]
[Today, even though the truth has been revealed, the prodigies have suffered heavy losses. There’s a high probability of their heir’s falling, something they can’t accept. For a time, all the forces, including Immortal Mansion, burst with murderous intent towards Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter.]
[Then, numerous powerhouses chose to make their move. Faced with attacks from so many powerhouses, Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter felt their scalps tingle, frightened to the extreme. No matter how strong they are, they can’t withstand so many people at the same realm.]
...
[As a result, Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter were defeated and fell on the spot within a short period.]
[You looked at the two emperors fall and sighed. No matter how great the emperor, if they enraged the masses, they still had to die. Slaughter Paradise, a force that often troubled you, would likely be wiped out.]
[However, you remembered that Emperor Slaughter could visit Myriad Heavens Paradise, and he must have several lifesaving items. Among those, the tool that allowed the strange to shift the secret realm entrance and deceive the world must have been acquired by Emperor Slaughter from Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[As such, you doubted whether Emperor Slaughter had really fallen, or if he had tricked the various powers and survived. After thinking, you started observing carefully with your Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[Regrettably, you didn’t notice anything abnormal. It seems like Emperor Slaughter had indeed fallen completely.]
…
“This uncertain description of the text simulation. Well, I always feel as if Emperor Slaughter will come back to life.”
Wang Ping stared at the content of the text simulation, raised an eyebrow slightly, and muttered.
Of course, this doesn’t exclude the possibility of his complete fall.
However, to be on the safe side, it might be better to temporarily switch to an immersive simulation, making it look like the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and others were lurking.
“Though, even though they may have means to resurrect, this time in the simulation Wang Ping personally witnessed two emperors getting gang-beaten to death. This must be a first in the life simulation.”
Wang Ping exclaimed again.
With the progress of the life simulation, various secrets are exposed, even the Quasi-Emperor seems insignificant, and even the Emperor must fall.
If we further consider the refining Upper Realm’s matters, even quasi-Fairies have to die.
This damn Upper Realm is really too dangerous.
If not immortal, one will inevitably be a fish on the chopping block.
However… Wang Ping suspects something has happened to the Immortal Domain.
If not, the sudden closure of the Immortal Domain Channel is too strange.
Although it is said that the Immortal Domain may be wary of the Source of Darkness, the Source of Darkness already appeared at that time, and the Immortal Domain knew about the existence of the Source of Darkness then as well.
However, the Immortal Domain Channel did not close at that time.
This means that the possibility of the Immortal Domain fearing the Source of Darkness is not high.
“Forget it, I haven’t even passed the Upper Realm yet, thinking about the matters of the Immortal Domain is still too distant.”
Wang Ping shook his head, threw these thoughts out of his mind, and continued focusing on the luminescent screen.
[Next, you thought about the possibility of the two emperors resurrecting and warned Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. In response, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said he was also aware of it. When dealing with powerhouses from All Heavens, they were always careful. Even if they killed them, they would lurk around, leaving the Killing Formation in place.]
[Hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s reply, you also felt relieved. Just like the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said, after killing Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter, all the different powers left a contingency in place, especially powers from All Heavens like the Abyss Lands, who were proficient in this, leaving no chance for the two emperors to escape.]
[In the end, Emperor Slaughter was resurrected. The moment he was resurrected, he immediately suffered a fatal blow and was killed again. Emperor Slaughter, completely fallen.]
[Next is the Slaughter Paradise’s extermination. However, that’s a story for another time.]
[Before this, all the powers began to reproach the Immortal Mansion again, questioning why the Immortal Mansion did not warn about the problems that occurred in the secret realm in advance, and also questioned why the Immortal Mansion covered up for Leng Yue Emperor, a Dark Emperor who fell into the Source of Darkness.]
[However, this time, because Ku Xuan was also a controlled target of the strange, in a sense, he could also be considered a participant, the Longevity Ku Family chose to remain silent and did not choose to participate.]
[Facing the questioning of various sides, the Immortal Mansion chose to admit their mistake, but their attitude was much firmer than in the previous life simulation. In the end, although the Immortal Mansion promised some things to the various forces, they did not concede as much as in the previous simulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 253: Double Emperor falls! The real fairy weapon! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 942: Chapter 253: Double Emperor falls! The real fairy weapon! _4
[With this, the matter was settled. The Immortal Mansion fished out all the surviving formidable talents, and everyone joined the Immortal Mansion.]
[And so did you. At the same time, you capitalized on this event and won over many followers. Many talents willingly became your adherents, including the pure-blood phoenix twin sisters, Huan Yin and Huang Qing.]
[However, you knew all this was pointless. After all, if you couldn’t prevent the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s plan, you’d never live to see the Immortal Gate open, and instead will vanish completely.]
[Last time, you merely prolonged your life by hiding in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[But, you knew one thing for certain; even if the plot of the Nine Stars Pavilion was revealed, you’d be powerless to stop it. Death was a foregone conclusion.]
[You figured that if you were to thwart the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s conspiracy, you might not be able to do it during the Golden Age. You’d have to intervene ten thousand years prior. At that time, perhaps the Nine Stars Pavilion wouldn’t have their plans thoroughly prepared. If you could unite the powerful beings of the Upper Realm to confront the Nine Stars Pavilion, there could be hope of crushing their plot.]
...
[However, you were quite aware, that without the peculiar events that took place in the secret realm, and without pinning the blame on the Nine Stars Pavilion, the parties wouldn’t unite against the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[After all, no one would confront the mysterious and powerful Nine Stars Pavilion based on baseless allegations. Not to mention, they wouldn’t believe that Nine Stars Pavilion could harness the Upper Realm in the first place.]
[Racking your brain, you felt a headache coming, finding it challenging to rely on external forces to stop the Pavilion Master. Maybe, you’d have to advance your cultivation to the level where you could battle with a Great Emperor, or attain Emperorhood through real comprehension. Only then could you have the power to take advantage of time and intel to prevent everything from happening, or even exploit the benefits of the Pavilion master’s efforts to refine the Upper Realm.]
[Eventually, you gave up on your attempts. You didn’t choose to disclose these things to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to persuade him to unite all forces against the Nine Stars Pavilion. Instead, you decided to boost your cultivation to the Supreme tier before proceeding to that secret realm.]
[That secret realm was the same one that Taiyi Great Emperor mentioned, the one that could only be entered with the Taiyi Emperor Tower. You were quite curious about that secret realm. After all, a realm that uses an innate Emperor Artifact like the Taiyi Emperor Tower as a key, must harbor some astonishing secret, something that might even interest Emperor-tier characters.]
[With that thought, you began your secluded cultivation with the help of the secret land within the Immortal Mansion. Since your cultivation already had reached the peak of the Heavenly Supreme, your breakthrough to the Supreme tier was not challenging.]
[Decades passed, and you accomplished your breakthrough, becoming a Supreme again, drawing astounded gasps of admiration. Only those who knew your true ability, like the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, shook their heads.]
[Next, you went straight to the location of the secret realm. With the Taiyi Emperor Tower as your key, you opened the secret realm. As the realm opened, a light pillar soared heavenwards, caused a tremendous anomaly, shaking the entire Big Universe and even reaching the Nine Mini Universes.]
[This horrific sight attracted all cultivators’ attention, especially those who were at or beyond the Supreme level, who rushed over immediately.]
[You watched this terrifying scene, a little dumbfounded. You hadn’t anticipated this much commotion. Logically speaking, the nature of such a secret realm seemed like a more private instance.]
[With this kind of commotion, wouldn’t all the powerful beings from the Upper Realm come to snatch the resources that should belong to you? You felt extremely frustrated for a moment. However, despite your frustration, you were powerless to stop it. All you could do was watch the pillar of light in silence, throwing up the middle finger at it.]
[Soon, the great Emperors arrived, among them Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi of the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Many powerful beings were interested in this secret realm.]
[After all, few secret realms ever caused such a huge commotion. Such realms often contained elements of great use to Quasi-Emperors. As for Emperors, they are so powerful that few treasures from these realms can help them.]
[To this end, Emperors mainly focused on their cultivation in order to become stronger. Apart from that, they would try their luck in some famous forbidden lands from ancient and modern times to find their fortunes. These lands were dangerous, and even Emperors might not escape unscathed. But dangers often came with opportunities, and if luck was on your side, you could find a world-shaking opportunity that would be useful even to Emperors.]
[While everyone was considering their options, the entrance of the secret realm opened, and you entered without hesitation. Seeing this, all the powerful individuals squinted their eyes. Some Supremes also followed in, and the Quasi-Emperors tried to enter, finding they could do so as well.]
[However, the Emperors were denied entry. As it goes, strong as they were, they were restricted from entering, as they could potentially destroy the secret realm, just like in many other secret realms.]
[Of course, there have been instances where the secret realm was so formidable that it could suppress and kill Emperors, who forced their way in. Although that particular realm only killed ordinary Emperors, it informed the cultivators that while most secret realms act as land of opportunities, some are equally perilous and can kill even Emperors.]

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 253: The Fall of the Two Emperors! The True Immortal Artifacts! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 943: Chapter 253: The Fall of the Two Emperors! The True Immortal Artifacts! _5
[As a result, ever since then, whenever a secret realm appeared that refused the entry of emperors, they would not easily choose to force their way in, opting to wait and observe instead, and let their younger generations explore for opportunities.]
[It was when the cultivators below the emperors decided to enter the secret realm, a terrifying aura suddenly appeared, and a frightening tribulation was brewing.]
[This left the emperors quite surprised, because this was an Emperor’s Tribulation, meaning someone was on the verge of becoming an emperor.]
[For a moment, many cultivators were curious about who would become an emperor at this critical moment.]
[Soon, they received their answer. It turned out that the white-cloaked quasi-emperor became an emperor. Apparently, the fall of Emperor Fengxin allowed the white-cloaked quasi-emperor to let go of his mental obstacles and achieve the Dao with one stroke.]
[This made many emperors frown, feeling that they had gained another powerful competitor.]
...
……
“So the white-cloaked quasi-emperor has become an emperor? This is another butterfly effect.”
Wang Ping read the contents of the text simulation and thought to himself.
For someone like the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, who could compete with an ordinary, old emperor at the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection cultivation level, once he became an emperor, he would be among the powerful emperors and indeed a favorable competitor for acquiring Immortal Fate. It was understandable why other emperors would be wary of him.
“Unfortunately, even becoming an emperor or a quasi-Fairy would be useless for the white-cloaked quasi-emperor.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
Of course, becoming an emperor qualified one to struggle for life within the Source of Darkness, something no other cultivator could achieve.
Even the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion—who had a perfected Chaotic Body and had already become an immortal—dared not provoke the Source of Darkness.
“I hope I can fully explore the secret realm before I die this time. Otherwise, it would be quite a pity.”
Wang Ping muttered again, then continued to watch the luminescent screen.
[As various emperors were paying attention to the white-cloaked quasi-emperor crossing tribulation, you were also teleported to somewhere within the secret realm.]
[You were astonished to discover that this secret realm was truly vast. Although it appeared in the form of a continent, its size was definitely no less than that of the Nine Mini Universes. Such a size would take some time for even Supreme and quasi-emperors to explore.]
[However, disregarding its size, what you were most curious about was the incredible opportunities that existed within this secret realm, making it so unique.]
[After pondering, you randomly chose a direction and began your exploration of the secret realm.]
[It must be said that this secret realm was terrifying, and Supreme realm Ferocious Beasts appeared from time to time. Ferocious Beasts were different from monster beasts. Once monster beasts achieved a certain level of cultivation, they would become demons of the Demon race, one of the many races.]
[But Ferocious Beasts, even with high cultivation, valued their animalistic nature over their humanity, were extremely vicious, and would attack any living beings they encountered.]
[These Ferocious Beasts caused you quite a bit of trouble, but you managed to kill them one by one. You still felt somewhat distressed about it. After all, your current cultivation was only just restored to the early-stage Supreme level, not at the peak of the Heavenly Supreme. You had weakened too much and had some difficulty dealing with these powerful Ferocious Beasts.]
[Besides, you had strong suspicions that there might be quasi-emperor tier Ferocious Beasts in this secret realm. This secret realm could be said to be dangerous and might not be inferior to the Guimo Sea you had once entered.]
[However, unlike the troublesome Guimo Sea where you struggled to find opportunities, there were indeed more opportunities in this secret realm. Rare ores and precious medicines that could greatly benefit Supremes, which were difficult to see in the outer world, were found by you in just a few decades.]
[Although a few decades might seem like a long time, it was nothing compared to the lifespan of a Supreme. These precious medicines could save thousands or even tens of thousands of years of cultivation time, making their cost-effectiveness unbeatable.]
[You were pondering how big of a harvest you could have if you fully explored this secret realm. Unfortunately, you also knew that the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion should be taking action soon.]
