[The timeline for the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion to refine the Upper Realm was not fixed, as it could change due to the butterfly effect. This time, the butterfly effect you caused was not small, and you suspected the timeline might also have been brought forward.]
[You had guessed correctly. At the time you were refining the precious medicine, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion began to refine the Upper Realm. Although various powerful individuals tried to stop her, they all failed.]
[In the end, the secret realm you were in could not escape the calamity and was refined as well. However, just before you died, you saw an astonishing sight.]
[That was a stout pagoda standing unwavering in the secret realm, emitting the Immortal Rhyme, seemingly unaffected.]
[Your heart trembled, suspecting this to be the rumored Immortal Artifact. In other words, there was an actual Immortal Artifact within this secret realm! If your guess was correct, the value of this secret realm would be more than terrifying.]
[Afterwards, you died along with the secret realm being refined. However, due to the Rebirth tally, you were resurrected. But after taking a look at the still undamaged pagoda, you died again.]
[Because of your death, the simulation ended here…..]

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 944: Chapter 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower
As the Text Simulation ended, Wang Ping’s mind was filled with scenes and insights, and his body appeared at the place where Wang Ping had fallen.
“This pagoda is somewhat similar to the Taiyi Emperor Tower. No, it should be said that the Taiyi Emperor Tower is somewhat similar to this pagoda,” Wang Ping looked at the pagoda exuding an Immortal Rhyme, his eyes shining, and sighed.
“However, the area around this pagoda seems to be a world of its own, unaffected by the outer world,” Wang Ping then noticed the surroundings of the pagoda and was quite surprised.
“It’s truly an Immortal Tower, such a miraculous thing. If I could get it as a reward, it would be amazing,” Wang Ping sighed once more, feeling quite envious.
“Unfortunately, the level of the Life Simulator is still too low. It has a very low probability of refreshing high-level items. I have never refreshed any Emperor’s artifacts, let alone Immortal Artifacts,” Wang Ping paused and lamented, his thoughts fading.
At present, the Life Simulator hadn’t reached the level to be compared with the Immortal Realm. The Seven-colored Physique Talent only corresponded to the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, and it was unable to refresh higher-level talents.
...
Similarly, the rewards would be the same, and it was highly unlikely to refresh rewards beyond the Emperor Tier level.
Immortal Artifacts were clearly beyond the limit.
However, even if the Life Simulator couldn’t refresh it, there would still be a chance to obtain this Immortal Artifact in the real world.
Of course, obtaining this Immortal Artifact in reality would also be extremely troublesome.
After all, the commotion caused by the opening of this secret realm was too huge, and it would be noticed by all the powerful figures in the Upper Realm.
If someone found out that he had obtained an Immortal Artifact, they would definitely attempt to snatch it.
At that time, not even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could protect him, and it might even attract the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.
If the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, a quasi-Fairy, were to be provoked, the outcome for Wang Ping would not be pleasant.
Unless, Wang Ping immediately fled to another world the moment he obtained the Immortal Artifact.
“There is a possibility to operate, but it cannot be guaranteed that I will not be chased down. Besides, I don’t know if I will be locked by their breath, and I must also consider the factors that may involve the people around me,” Wang Ping rubbed his brow, feeling a headache coming on.
Considering this, the Immortal Artifact was indeed a hot potato. Wang Ping could not touch it without becoming an Emperor.
Even after becoming an Emperor, he would have to find a way to obtain the Chaotic Body before touching it.
Otherwise, facing figures like the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, a quasi-Fairy, there would be no chance of winning.
“Forget it, there’s no point in thinking about it too much, let’s take it one step at a time,” Wang Ping shook his head and gave up thinking.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s consciousness swayed, and he was freed from the immersive simulation and returned to the real world.
Then, the voice of the system sounded.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound.
②. Red Talent·Lei Profound Body.
③. A random quasi-Emperor Artifact.
④. A random Supreme Treasure Elixir.
⑤. A random Supreme artifact.”
…..
“System, I choose Golden Talent·Rock Bottom Rebound and Red Talent·Lei Profound Body,” Wang Ping hesitated for a moment, then made his choice.
Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound had only played an astounding role once in the simulation, but it was still a good talent worth choosing.
As for the Red Talent·Lei Profound Body, Wang Ping thought of the previously mentioned possibility of collecting all the attribute Profound Bodies and fusing them into a Seven-colored Physique Talent.
Perhaps, these Profound Bodies could serve as carriers for the Little Chaotic Body.
Of course, Wang Ping felt that Profound Bodies might not be enough. If he could capture all kinds of Sacred Bodies with various attributes, it would be the best choice.
However, obtaining various attribute Sacred Bodies was actually very troublesome.
Without the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, it would be impossible to be compatible with these origins. It was impossible to acquire the physique of other talents through perfect refining.
Refining would cause losses, and it wouldn’t be possible to perfectly absorb and be compatible, only making the physique incomplete.
This was also the reason why the various forces cultivated talents rather than refining them in various ways.
An incomplete powerful physique was not much for a growing powerhouse. They couldn’t improve their combat power much with just one incomplete physique.
After all, an incomplete physique would be difficult to reach the Minor Domain level. Sacred Bodies that couldn’t reach the Minor Domain or Great Completion Domain level wouldn’t make much difference for Quasi-Emperors.
Instead of capturing and refining talents, cultivating talents was the most worthwhile endeavor, the best choice for inheriting power.
Of course, this was all aimed at those powerful forces. For loose cultivators or Supreme powers who were not too strong, encountering a talent could lead to ulterior motives.
This was because such physiques were precious for them and very useful indeed.
“I can only try. After all, refining other people’s physiques is Evil Tao. Only the physiques that I can refresh through the Life Simulator are complete and can be used with peace of mind,” Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking secretly.
If collecting the Nine Profound Bodies was not enough, he would have to think of other ways.
In any case, he would not miss this Chaotic Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 945: Chapter 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower_2
“Next, let’s continue the simulation. System, I want to do the paid simulation.”
Wang Ping took a light breath and spoke slowly.
He still has two chances for paid simulations, and he hopes to maximize the benefits.
Anyway, no matter what, he must choose cultivation for the fourth paid simulation.
“Ding, consuming 5 million catties of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
...
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations Host for successfully refreshing Red Talent: Gold Profound Body; Red Talent: Ice Profound Body.”
Red Talent: Gold Profound Body: …..
Red Talent: Ice Profound Body: (｡•ˇ‸ˇ•｡)
“Uh….”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents this time, and the emoticon of the Ice Profound Body’s introduction, his gaze was very subtle.
Before refreshing his talent, he was incredibly disgusted with all kinds of Red Talent Profound Bodies, but now it seemed quite familiar.
“System, I choose Red Talent: Ice Profound Body.”
Wang Ping chuckled and made his choice.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping’s consciousness swayed, and he entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the text also began to emerge.
[On the first day, you chose to go to the Elemental Star to save people from the lower realm. After saving people, you chose to go directly to the Supreme Heavenly Path.]
[The reason for choosing the Supreme Heavenly Path is that you don’t want to go on the same path as in the previous simulation. Since you can’t get the Little Chaotic Body now, you might as well try the secret realm that has Immortal Artifacts first.]
[Nearly a hundred years later, you successfully reached the Heavenly Supreme Peak level. The following events were not much different from the previous simulation, you still told the rushing back Heavenly Feather Great Emperor about Yu Daoyi’s incident.]
[After the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor left, you didn’t choose to open the secret realm right away, nor did you have the idea of going to Purgatory Ancient Star to snatch the Innate Emperor Flame. After all, the current Innate Emperor Flame is useless to you, and it will cause trouble, it’s not worth it.]
[Your choice was to wait for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to return before opening the secret realm. After all, with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor around, you would have a backer, and even if you got the chance, you would have a better chance of keeping it.]
[After thinking about it, you went to the place where the Dark Time Imperial Clan was located and entered it. The arrival of the Dark Time Imperial Clan was a surprise to you.]
[Soon after, the elder of the Dark Time Imperial Clan took you through the Ancient Time Road. In the past, it was difficult for you to pass the Ancient Time Road, but now you have come a long way since then, and naturally easily passed.]
[In the end, you saw the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom once again. When the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom saw you, it sighed.]
[And you, before the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom spoke, preempted the conversation, asking the Dark Time Emperor not to say a word like ‘You have come after all’ and then disappear directly, acting like a riddle man.]
[Your words completely disrupted the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom.]
[In the end, he could only look at you with a subtle gaze, saying that it’s no wonder you are a difficult-to-grasp existence, capable of reading the thoughts of an existence like him.]
[Upon hearing this, you rolled your eyes, indicating that you don’t want to be ambiguous about these things, and you just want to know what the purpose of leaving trials for the Dark Time Imperial Clan to listen to you is.]
[The phantom of the Dark Time Emperor looked deeply at you and said that in the River of Time, there are many fish. Some fish can never leap out of the water and see the truth deep in the time. Some fish have a little ability, and they can do their best to leap out of the water, seeing a glimpse of the truth.]>
[The Dark Time Emperor’s words made your brows frown. The meaning of his words was obvious, the Dark Time Emperor compared himself to a fish that could only leap out of the water and see a part of the truth when he had a little ability and tried his best.]
[But, what exactly did the Dark Time Emperor do, what did he see, and why did he have such a special attitude towards him and liked to be a riddle man.]
[After pondering, you asked him directly, hoping that the Dark Time Emperor would give you some explanation.]
[The phantom of the Dark Time Emperor was silent, his pupils turned gray, as if the ashes remaining in time, vicissitudes and loneliness. In the end, he still told you some things.]
[At his peak, he tried to become an immortal against all odds. Unfortunately, things didn’t go his way, and his failure caused him a huge blow, and it was difficult to recover even after many years of recovery.]
[In the end, he reached his twilight years. The Dark Time Emperor in his twilight years didn’t want to fall into the Source of Darkness, nor was he willing to sit idly. Therefore, he made a decision.]
[He wanted to do everything he could, see all the past, present, and future, and find out the truth about why he couldn’t become an immortal. Even if doing so would make him completely fall, he would do it for the sake of seeking a path or finding a way out for future generations.]
[In the end, the Dark Time Emperor burned his own origin and saw some scenes from the past, present, and future through his self-created Great Divine Skill.]
[However, he still couldn’t figure out the reason for the closure of the Immortal Domain Channel, and he only looked through time and space and met a living being once. That living being was guarding the Immortal Domain Channel, his expression weary, his eyes vicissitudes, and even some numbness, as if he had experienced unimaginable catastrophes.]

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 254: Gaze Across Space-Time! Battle for the Fairy Tower_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 946: Chapter 254: Gaze Across Space-Time! Battle for the Fairy Tower_3
[That creature must definitely be an Immortal, likely from the Immortal Domain. However, the Dark Time Emperor wasn’t sure why the creature looked so fatigued. He didn’t understand why it was guarding the Immortal Domain Channel, as though it had intentionally sealed it off.]
[Just as the Dark Time Emperor became puzzled and shocked, the creature let out a sigh and with a wave of its hand, sent the Dark Time Emperor back to the present, preventing him from further probing into the past.]
[After a period of silence, the Dark Time Emperor tried to look at the ultimate future to see what would happen and whether the Immortal Domain would be opened.]
[However, he was unable to see any images of the Immortal Domain opening. Instead, he saw you.]
[At this point, the illusory figure of the Dark Time Emperor paused and gazed at you intensely. In the end, he sighed deeply, entrusting the care of the Dark Time Imperial Clan to you. After finishing these words, his illusory figure disappeared.]
[This left you bewildered and speechless. This illusory figure of the Dark Time Emperor really likes to be enigmatic, leaving his words hanging. It was as if he wasn’t afraid of being killed.]
...
[Nevertheless, you were reminded that the Dark Time Emperor was already dead. Shrugging slightly, you decided not to dwell on it further.]
[However, the words of the Dark Time Emperor were still itching at you. You couldn’t comprehend what role you’d play in the future the Dark Time Emperor saw. Which version of the future did he witness?]
[Aside from that, you were also puzzled about the Immortal in the Immortal Domain Channel. Why was he so exhausted and numb? He was a monstrous existence that could detect the presence of the Dark Time Emperor across time and drive him away. Such an entity must be incredibly powerful among the Immortals.]
[Furthermore, an additional thought struck you. Considering the immense power of this Immortal, he must be aware of the events in the Upper Realm. However, he did nothing to protect the Upper Realm in the future, suggesting that he didn’t care about the fate of the lower dimensional planes within his domain. Nor did he seem to mind whether new Immortals would be born.]
[Or was it that he couldn’t leave? That he was unable to leave the Immortal Domain Channel or display his Divine Skills? That he could only quietly watch everything unfold? Then, if the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion ascends to immortality and forcefully enters the Immortal Domain Channel seeking entrance to the Immortal Domain, will a battle ensue? Will this guardian of the Immortal Domain kill the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion?]
[Numerous speculations appeared in your mind, fueling your curiosity about the future.]
[Eventually, you shook your head to clear your thoughts, then left the Ancient Time Road. You then began discussing the matter of resources with the Dark Time Imperial Clan, wanting to know how many resources they could provide you.]
[Upon hearing your request, the elder of the Dark Time Imperial Clan claimed that they would willingly give you all the resources of the Dark Time Imperial Clan. However, as their clan had been in seclusion for a long time, they didn’t have many resources to offer. They had only 50 million pounds of extreme-tier Divine Source available, and not many other medicinal resources.]
[Hearing this, you were quite helpless. You hadn’t expected that the Dark Time Imperial Clan had only 50 million pounds of extreme-tier Divine Source. Nonetheless, you were understanding of their situation. After all, they had been in seclusion for a long time, rarely venturing out and also supporting their own cultivations. Perhaps it was solely through controlling their population size that they had been able to survive all these years. Securing 50 million pounds of extreme-tier Divine Source was already quite an achievement. You couldn’t be overly demanding.]
….
“Fifty million pounds… It seems enough for ten simulations. But once I break through to the Heavenly Supreme-tier, the consumption for each simulation will multiply. I doubt it will last me for more than a few rounds.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, frowning in deep thought.
It seemed that he had to seriously consider whether or not it paid off to improve his cultivation.
“However, having previously encountered crises, I can’t keep holding back my cultivation. The only way to feel secure is to rapidly increase my cultivation.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly, feeling helpless.
However, Wang Ping also knew that things to do with resources could not be rushed. If need be, he would first improve his cultivation, then ask Heavenly Feather Great Emperor for resources.
If Taiyi Imperial Palace also couldn’t supply anymore, then Wang Ping would have to rely on himself to earn money.
Even though making money was really hard.
Wang Ping heaved a sigh and continued staring at the luminescent screen.
[Afterward, you asked several Quasi-Emperor Elders of the Dark Time Imperial Clan to come out of seclusion and led them back to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[When Heavenly Feather Great Emperor arrived with Yu Daoyi, you first asked Yu Daoyi to help you enhance your Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the stage of Minor Domain.]
[Then, you revealed the matter about the Taiyi Emperor Tower and its secret realm. When Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi learned that the Taiyi Emperor Tower hid such secrets, they were quite astonished, thinking the secret realm was not simple at all.]
[You questioned Heavenly Feather Great Emperor about his capability to shield the strange phenomena and monopolize the secret realm. He responded with a shake of his head, stating that he couldn’t guarantee success. However, he agreed to give it a try.]
[So, you started your operation. Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was the first to lay down the Great Array in an attempt to conceal your movements. Then, you opened the secret realm using the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[However, you underestimated the terrifying nature of the secret realm’s phenomena. Once it erupted, it tore through the Great Array. The strange phenomena swept over the Upper Realm, shaking the faith and the strong.]

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 254: Gaze Across Space-Time! Battle for the Immortal Tower_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 947: Chapter 254: Gaze Across Space-Time! Battle for the Immortal Tower_4
[For a moment, many powerful beings rushed towards this place. Even those who had chosen to self-tittle themselves came out into the world. Although they were able to survive until the Golden Age by self-sealing, the appearance of such an anomaly showed that there were incredible opportunities waiting to be seized. If they didn’t compete for them, it would be a waste.]
[Although they were afraid of death, they also had the desire to become a Taoist. If there were no opportunities, they would continue to hide. However, if there were opportunities to achieve Tao, they would not ignore them.]
[You looked at the anomaly in the sky indifferently, extended your middle finger towards the light pole, and then entered it with Yu Daoyi.]
[After entering, you were transported to an unknown place, directly confronted by a Ferocious Beast attack. This beast was very powerful, with the strength of a Heaven Supreme. However, for you at this point, such power was nothing. With a casual move, you killed and skinned it.]
[Next, following your memory, you headed towards the direction of the Immortal Tower, wanting to seize the opportunity and get the Immortal Tower first.]
[However, when you abandoned the other opportunities in the secret realm and arrived at the location of the Immortal Tower, you found that the Immortal Tower did not exist. This made you frown, wondering if the timing was wrong or if the Immortal Tower was hiding.]
...
[You didn’t know what the situation was, so you could only explore slowly without leaving this area.]
[As you were exploring the secrets of the Immortal Tower, more and more powerful beings appeared in the secret realm, with Supremes and Quasi-Emperors pouring in to seek opportunities. Some even engaged in earth-shattering battles.]
[You remained unmoved by this, quietly waiting. You believed that as long as the time was right, the Immortal Tower would definitely appear. Once it appeared, you could seize the opportunity and take the Immortal Tower first.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed. During these hundred years, the situation in the secret realm became increasingly chaotic, with terrifying battles becoming more frequent. You even got involved in it.]
[This was because a passing powerful being realized you were from the Taiyi Imperial Palace. He had a grudge against the Taiyi Imperial Palace, so he launched an attack. This person’s cultivation was not weak, with the peak of the Heavenly Supreme realm and a small achievement of the Sacred Body.]
[However, against you, he was still too weak. In the end, you casually struck him down, shocking several nearby Supremes and even an Ordinary Quasi-Emperor. The shocked Supremes quickly retreated, and even the Quasi-Emperor was quite wary of you, not expecting such an abnormal Heavenly Supreme from the Taiyi Imperial Palace. They felt that even if they faced you, victory would be rare.]
[You didn’t care about the departure of these powerful beings, simply searched the body and set up a Killing Formation to prevent it from coming back to life.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 150 years had passed. During this time, many powerful beings died and others found shocking opportunities, leading to a combat power surge or directly breaking through their bottlenecks.]
[Frowning, you started to doubt if you were wrong about the Immortal Tower not appearing naturally. Last time it appeared was due to the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion refining the Upper Realm, forcing it out. If that was the case, continuing to wait would be wasting time. Considering that you opened the secret realm and didn’t get anything, while others gained a lot of opportunities, you were only making things easier for them.]
[For a moment, you couldn’t sit still and wanted to leave an incarnation here, then leave to seek other opportunities. If all went well, you might be able to become a Quasi-Emperor.]
[Just as you were thinking this, a beam of Immortal Light suddenly burst into the sky, illuminating the entire secret realm. Immediately after, a tower filled with Immortal Rhyme appeared before your eyes.]
[Seeing the Immortal Tower appear, you rejoiced and took out the Taiyi Emperor Tower. In your opinion, since the Taiyi Emperor Tower looked similar to this Immortal Tower, there must be some connection, and perhaps you could use the Taiyi Emperor Tower to make the Immortal Tower recognize its master.]
[Once you had the Immortal Artifact, it would become your biggest trump card.]
[However, what you didn’t expect was that the appearance of the Taiyi Emperor Tower had no effect. The Immortal Tower still emitted Immortal Light and didn’t care about the Taiyi Emperor Tower or you. Even the Immortal Light Barrier suddenly appeared and repelled you.]
[After being repelled, you were quite embarrassed and frustrated that the Taiyi Emperor Tower, which was the key to opening the secret realm and resembled the Immortal Tower, was of no use at all and was completely ignored by the Immortal Tower. This meant that you had lost your biggest support.]
[Looking at the Immortal Light Barrier, you felt that if you wanted to enter the Immortal Tower and subdue it, you probably had to break through this barrier first. Perhaps this was the first test of the Immortal Tower.]
[However, you knew very well that you alone could not break through this barrier. Although you were unmatched in the Supreme Realm, your cultivation was ultimately only in the Supreme Realm, and you could not compare to those truly powerful beings.]
[As a result, you could only wait for top Quasi-Emperors like Yu Daoyi and other strong beings to arrive, and once they broke the barrier, you could think about subduing the Immortal Tower.]

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 948: Chapter 254: Time-Space Crossover Gaze! Battle for Immortal Tower_5
[Soon, due to the strange phenomenon of the emergence of the Immortal Tower, numerous strong cultivators all approached from various directions, arriving one after another.]
[After these powerful cultivators appeared, they all stared at the Immortal Tower with burning eyes. Their vision was very high, and they could naturally see that this was an Immortal Artifact surpassing the Emperor’s artifact. If they could obtain such a heaven-defying destiny, their future would be promising.]
[Especially for those who are already at the peak of the Quasi-Emperor realm, their hearts are surging even more. If they were to obtain this Immortal Artifact, they could use it to contend against Great Emperors even without breaking through to that level, and even potentially kill them.]
[During this time when everyone’s hearts were burning with desire, Yu Daoyi also arrived here. After her arrival, she asked you about the matters regarding the Immortal Tower. After hearing your explanation, she was somewhat puzzled, not knowing why the Immortal Tower rejected you, who possessed the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[However, now is not the time to think about these questions, but rather to consider how to break open the Immortal Tower and seize it.]
[At this moment, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor stepped forward, stating that everyone could join forces to break open the Immortal Light barrier. As for who could obtain the Immortal Tower, it would depend on everyone’s abilities.]
...
[When he said these words, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor had a determined look and his Sword Spirit soared. He wanted to get this Immortal Artifact. With this Immortal Artifact, he would have the power to get revenge against Emperor Fengxin. Once that happened, he could break free from his Heart Demon, repair his Tao Heart, and ascend to become an Emperor.]
[The white-cloaked quasi-emperor’s words received the agreement of the powerful cultivators present. Everyone was not a fool, and naturally understood that to obtain the Immortal Artifact, they had to break the Immortal Light barrier first.]
[Soon, the strong cultivators on the scene launched a joint attack, and terrifying divine skills erupted together. The power they released was enough to kill an ordinary Emperor. After all, there were a lot of powerful cultivators present, including those like the white-cloaked quasi-emperor who could contend with aging, ordinary Emperors.]
[However, to everyone’s disappointment, despite their joint attack, they were unable to shake the Immortal Light barrier at all, let alone break it. They couldn’t even make a single crack appear.]
[Seeing this scene, you were speechless and unsure of what was going on with this Immortal Tower. If things continued like this, you would have a great opportunity but wouldn’t be able to obtain it, which was even more frustrating than not discovering the opportunity at all.]
[Just when everyone was frowning and feeling somewhat helpless, more powerful cultivators arrived. It was also after these powerful cultivators appeared, that a change occurred.]
[Golden Light Jade Talismans floated out of the worlds within some of the powerful cultivators, including yourself. In addition, the Taiyi Emperor Tower also appeared once more. The Golden Light Jade Talismans circulated around the Taiyi Emperor Tower, transformed into golden key-like items, and emitted dazzling light.]
[With this strange phenomenon appearing, the Immortal Light slowly dissipated, and the lowest door of the Immortal Tower also slowly opened.]
[This scene filled the numerous powerful cultivators with great surprise. They hadn’t expected this kind of change. You were also very excited, feeling as if there was suddenly a new hope in the midst of darkness.]
[However, your expression quickly changed as an intense sense of danger arrived, and you prepared to use Golden Talent: Damage Nullification.]
[Your intuition was correct, as a powerful Quasi-Emperor launched a terrifying attack on you at this moment. This kind of attack was not something you could handle right now.]
[Yet, before you could use Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, a figure stepped in front of you, helping you block the attack. They glared at the Quasi-Emperor who attacked you, scolding him for being shameless and attacking a junior like yourself.]
[You also snapped back to your senses, staring at the Quasi-Emperor who attacked you, recognizing his identity. He was none other than Qingyu Quasi Emperor, the child of the Green Bamboo Emperor, and a famous Quasi-Emperor for many years. In the past, you had promised the Black Abyss Demon Lord to teach a lesson to the descendants of the Green Bamboo Emperor, thinking that you would casually beat them up when you had the chance. But now, you wished you could kill him on the spot.]
[In the face of Yu Daoyi’s scolding, Qingyu Quasi Emperor was unmoved. Instead, he mocked Yu Daoyi, saying that it was laughable for her to call you a junior when she herself was already at the Peak of the Heavenly Supreme.]
[Hearing this, Yu Daoyi sneered, saying that your current cultivation was just over 3000 years old. Compared to Qingyu Quasi Emperor, who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years, you were indeed a junior. She then criticized Qingyu Quasi Emperor for bullying juniors and losing the dignity of the Green Bamboo Emperor.]
[Upon hearing Yu Daoyi’s words, the powerful cultivators present were shocked, not expecting that you were so young. At just over 3000 years old and already at the Peak of the Heavenly Supreme, it was truly too monstrous. However, they were also very puzzled as to why you had no fame at all.]
[Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s face darkened, and he coldly snorted, saying that Immortal Artifacts were precious, and only real powerhouses were qualified to compete for them. The Jade Talisman and Taiyi Emperor Tower were wasted in your hands.]
[With these words, the enmity reached its peak. The powerful cultivators present all set their sights on you, who possessed the Taiyi Emperor Tower and Golden Light Jade Talisman, as well as the other cultivators who had Golden Light Jade Talismans.]
[Everyone present was an old monster, and for most of them, they did not care about right or wrong. They only knew one thing: whoever had the Taiyi Emperor Tower and Golden Light Jade Talisman would have an advantage in the competition for the Immortal Tower.]
[Seeing these powerful cultivators targeting you, Yu Daoyi’s expression became serious. Even if she were at her peak, she would not be able to deal with these people, let alone in her current battle-damaged state.]
[Meanwhile, your expression was also very ugly, knowing that the situation ahead would be extremely dangerous. Soon, an idea came to you, and you looked at the white-cloaked Quasi-Emperor, sending him a message saying that the remnant soul of his disciple was within Lin Qinghe’s body. Right now, Lin Qinghe had become your disciple and was staying in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]

chapters.title: Chapter 949 03-25 - 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals!
chapters.content:
Chapter 949: Chapter 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals!
“Well, this move is brilliant, directly involving the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, a top quasi-emperor. Given his relationship with the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body, it’s impossible for him not to choose to help.”
Wang Ping, looking at the content of the text simulation, also couldn’t help but smile, feeling that there was a turnaround and that the simulated Wang Ping should not have to die.
“It’s not necessarily so. Although the white-cloaked quasi-emperor is strong, there are other quasi-emperors who can match him. The situation is still very troublesome.”
Wang Ping calmed down again, shook his head slightly, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After receiving your message, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor is also quite surprised, not expecting that he would learn about the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body at this time.]
[As a result, after giving you a deep glance, he chose to step in and help you block some of the attacks from the quasi-emperors. It’s not that he believes you, but he knows it’s pointless to question you at this time. Rather than asking first, he may as well help first and then figure it out later. If he finds out you lied to him afterwards, he can take revenge on you.]
...
[Seeing the white-cloaked quasi-emperor stepping in to help, the faces of the other quasi-emperors changed instantly, showing their fear. Even Qingyu Quasi-Emperor’s expression turned ugly. After all, although they are all quasi-emperors, the gap between them is insurmountable. The white-cloaked quasi-emperor is definitely ranked among the top ten quasi-emperors in the Upper Realm, with few quasi-emperors being his match.]
[Yu Daoyi was also surprised that the white-cloaked quasi-emperor would step in to help at this time, but she didn’t ask questions, just expressed her gratitude and remained vigilant against the many powerful warriors present.]
[It was during this standoff that two quasi-emperors made a move and seized two other golden light jade charms. Seeing this, the other strong warriors were somewhat unwilling to give in, but they didn’t intend to take action either, because these two quasi-emperors were also top quasi-emperors who could resist aging Ordinary Emperors with their Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation level.]
[After giving it some thought, Qingyu Quasi-Emperor invited these two quasi-emperors to stand on their side with a smile, hoping to join forces to deal with the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, Yu Daoyi, and other Taiyi Imperial Palace quasi-emperors. After the success, the Taiyi Emperor Tower would be divided among them.]
[The two top quasi-emperors ignored Qingyu Quasi-Emperor, indicating that he wasn’t qualified to drag them down. Even if his father were there, it might be more feasible.]
[Having said that, these two top quasi-emperors flashed their figures and directly entered the Immortal Tower with their golden light Jade Talisman.]
Source: , updated on ɴονǤᴑ.ƈο
[Seeing this, Qingyu Quasi-Emperor was somewhat displeased but couldn’t say much. After all, the gap in their strength was too great, and he couldn’t win. Moreover, it wasn’t certain that the others would cooperate with him completely. At present, they were targeting Yu Daoyi and you simply because of their interest.]
[Now that the white-cloaked quasi-emperor has stood on your side, the others will surely waver and not truly form alliances. After all, they are all old monsters with their own schemes, never truly trusting the people of other forces. Temporarily forming alliances is merely for their own interests. No one can guarantee that others and their forces won’t stab them in the back during the chaos.]
[It was at this time that another figure appeared, stepping through the void, causing quite a surprise to the strong warriors present. This person was none other than the Destructing tao emperor’s own offspring, his first son, known as the Destruction Quasi-Emperor. His strength also reached the level of top quasi-emperors, even more powerful than the white-cloaked quasi-emperor.]
[After seeing the appearance of the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, the expression of the white-cloaked quasi-emperor turned solemn, knowing that the situation had become more troublesome. And your face was serious, preparing for the worst.]
[As expected, after the Destruction Quasi-Emperor appeared, he looked at the golden light jade charms and the Taiyi Emperor Tower and calmly declared that they now belonged to him.]
[As soon as he said this, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor reached for the golden light jade charms, causing your expression to darken. After all, although ordinary quasi-emperors couldn’t take away something like the Taiyi Emperor Tower, it didn’t mean that a powerful figure like the Destruction Quasi-Emperor couldn’t take it away. Even if he couldn’t become the master, just suppressing it and possessing it would give him an advantage within the Immortal Tower.]
[Not to mention, he was so greedy that he wanted to take away the golden light jade charms as well, leaving nothing for you.]
[At this moment, you were furious and prepared to fight him to the bitter end. You didn’t believe that you couldn’t hurt him. As long as you could hurt him, you would have a chance to trigger the effect of the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, causing him to die on the spot.]
[Just as you were enraged, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor made a move, directly shattering his palm with an indifferent remark that if he wanted to take away these items, he would have to get through him first.]
[Seeing this, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor sneered, telling the white-cloaked quasi-emperor that if he wished to die, he would oblige. With that said, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor directly attacked the white-cloaked quasi-emperor.]
[In an instant, the two of them began a terrifying battle, the aftermath of which was extremely dangerous, making your expression change. Yu Daoyi responded quickly, protecting you and attempting to rush into the interior of the Immortal Tower.]
[Seeing this, you also responded quickly, wanting to take back the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the golden light jade charms.]
[Unfortunately, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor and the other strong warriors present were not going to let that happen and tried to stop you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 950 03-25 - 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 950: Chapter 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _2
[These powerful beings come from all over the Upper Realm, many of them are terrifying old monsters of various generations. Although it is true that having a long cultivation time and survival time doesn’t necessarily mean they are powerful, they can’t be too weak either.]
[As a result, the power that erupts under such a large number of people is extremely terrifying, and it’s impossible for Yu Daoyi and the quasi-emperor ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace to stop them.]
[Seeing the situation, you feel bitter in your heart, and have already prepared yourself mentally to give up on the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the Golden Light Jade Talisman. Otherwise, it doesn’t matter if it’s you, Yu Daoyi, or the quasi-emperor ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, all of you will perish here.]
[At this moment, a series of gloomy voices sounded, stating that so many old monsters were being shameless by bullying the weak.]
[As the words fell, more than ten quasi-emperor auras suddenly appeared, and all of them were extremely powerful quasi-emperors. When these quasi-emperors appeared, they blocked the attacks of the powerful people present, causing quite a shock.]
[Soon, everyone saw the identities of these suddenly appeared quasi-emperors and were taken aback. You saw them and felt the same astonishment. That’s because these quasi-emperors were surprisingly the ones hiding in the White Fog Forbidden Area and establishing Chrysanthemum Village.]
...
[These quasi-emperors, who had adopted Huangyin and Huang Qing, all had well-known reputations. Although their strength is not as high as the white-cloaked quasi-emperor and the Destructive Emperor, they are still very powerful. Among them, the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor could even be ranked in the top ten among quasi-emperors.]
[In the past, you had seen the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor’s incarnation in action, crushing the Quasi-Emperor of Slaughter Paradise, displaying incredible strength.]
[Now, you didn’t expect them to appear here, and even chose to stand by your side and help you fight other powerful beings.]
[Regarding this, you were very confused, not knowing why they wanted to help you. However, this was not the time to question their motives. Instead, you seized this opportunity to get back the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the Golden Light Jade Talisman.]
[After retrieving the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the Golden Light Jade Talisman, you didn’t directly enter the Immortal Tower to sell out your comrades. Instead, you stared down at the other powerful beings along with Yu Daoyi and the others.]
[Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s face was difficult to look at, not expecting so many Cheng Yaojins to appear out of nowhere. He knew that it would be impossible to continue fighting to the death as others would definitely choose to stop their battles, not willing to fight alongside him, and some might even betray him directly.]
Source: , updated on Ɲονǥ0.сᴑ
[Sure enough, with the appearance of these powerful people from Chrysanthemum Village, the powerful beings from other forces chose to keep their distance from Qingyu Quasi Emperor and the powerful beings from the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace, claiming they weren’t really enemies and blaming it on Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s manipulation.]
[Seeing this, your expression became subtle, and you didn’t bother with these old monsters as you stared at Qingyu Quasi Emperor and his companions with cold, murderous eyes.]
[Next, you hoped that Yu Daoyi and the many powerful people of the Taiyi Imperial Palace would eliminate Qingyu Quasi Emperor and his powerful beings, and exterminate all future troubles.]
[Regarding this, Yu Daoyi had nothing to say and attacked the powerful beings of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace, with the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s powerful beings doing the same.]
[Seeing this, the people of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace shouted, accusing the Taiyi Imperial Palace of wanting to meet mutual destruction and let others benefit from their losses.]
[You remained expressionless, stating that the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace was not worthy of meeting mutual destruction with the Taiyi Imperial Palace. While speaking, you joined the battlefield and fought against one of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace’s quasi-emperors, with the battle being too close to call.]
[This scene shocked many powerful beings, as they didn’t expect you, at such a young age, to not only reach the peak of the Heavenly Supreme, but also possess terrifying combat power to fight against a quasi-emperor across the ranks. Although this was just an ordinary quasi-emperor, it was still terrifying enough.]
[For a while, many quasi-emperors wanted to take you down, but they were wary of the old monsters like Cyclops Quasi-Emperor from Chrysanthemum Village and chose to stop their hands, silently watching the battle.]
[As for you, you continued to battle this ordinary quasi-emperor from the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace, unleashing various Divine Skills, and giving quite a headache to this ordinary quasi-emperor. In the end, he was provoked.]
[After all, being a quasi-emperor ancestor of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace, he was challenged by a junior across the ranks and was being pressured by you. This was indeed quite humiliating. Because of this, this ordinary quasi-emperor from the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace used a secret skill to enhance his strength, intending to forcefully slay you.]
[At this, you sneered in your heart and also used a trump card, which was Divine Skill Neutralization. You should know that in previous battles, you hadn’t used any of your innate gifts, only your original battle strength.]
[Now, even relying on your own strength, you can contend with an ordinary quasi-emperor. With all your trump cards, you would fear no stronger quasi-emperors.]
[As a result, when you used the ability of Divine Skill Neutralization to directly neutralize this ordinary quasi-emperor’s divine power from the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace, you also unleashed your most terrifying Divine Skill. This was also your usual fighting style.]
[With the explosion of that terrifying divine skill, the quasi-emperor ancestor of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace was forcibly destroyed by you and fell completely.]
[This battle greatly shocked all the powerful beings. They never thought that you were so ferocious, using your cultivation at the peak of the Heavenly Supreme to forcibly destroy a quasi-emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 951 03-25 - 255: Successive assassinations of the Quasi-Emperor! What about the immortals! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 951: Chapter 255: Successive assassinations of the Quasi-Emperor! What about the immortals! _3
“Even though this is just an ordinary Quasi-Emperor, whose cultivation is only at the 1st-tier Quasi-Emperor level, he is not the elderly type of 1st-tier strongman. His battle strength is formidable. Throughout history, there has never been a cultivator who could beat a Quasi-Emperor beyond their cultivation tier, and you undoubtedly have broken the precedent.”
“To be precise, there has never been any such outrageous event in the history of the current era. As a result, including the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, and the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor, the top Quasi-Emperors are all extremely shocked.”
“While it might seem more unbelievable that the likes of the white-cloaked quasi-emperor and the Destruction Quasi-Emperor can confront an elderly ordinary Emperor with Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation, it’s not so in practice. Facing up to and forcefully killing are completely different things.”
“Their fights with the elderly ordinary Emperors are only confrontations, they wouldn’t be able to kill them. Like what you did, dominating the opponent throughout and killing without injury, is impossible. Most of the time, they are at a disadvantage, just dragging out the battle against the ordinary Emperor whose vitality and Qi and Blood are declining.”
“If they were faced with an Emperor in his prime, the outcome would be certain destruction, let alone overpowering them and killing them without injury.”
“Therefore, your fighting record is really shocking, even if it reaches the ears of Emperors, it is enough to shock them and stimulate them.”
...
“While everyone else is shocked, you haven’t shown any sign of stopping. It seems like you aren’t satisfied, and, without hesitation, you directed your attack towards another Quasi-Emperor of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace.”
….
“This is really a plot twist after another. I just don’t know why the people of Chrysanthemum Village would help simulated Wang Ping. Could it be because I had dual cultivation with Huangyin in the simulation? However, if they could even figure that out, that would be too absurd.”
Watching the content of the Text Simulation, Wang Ping had a subtle expression, largely puzzled.”
“However, killing a Quasi-Emperor in front of all the strong characters this time is truly impressive. I just don’t know to what extent it can be done.”
Wang Ping laughed lightly upon recalling his battle with the Quasi-Emperor.”
Source: , updated on Ɲ0νǤο.сο
Because simulated Wang Ping was too cautious in the simulation, he rarely fought against powerful opponents.”
As a result, Wang Ping also had no idea about the ultimate strength of simulated Wang Ping.”
Under the bonuses from so many talents, Wang Ping was absolutely hopeful that he could defeat a 3rd or 4th-tier Quasi-Emperor.”
He just didn’t know if his judgment was correct.”
While Wang Ping was thinking, the simulation continued.”
“Seeing you approaching, this ordinary Quasi-Emperor felt his scalp tingle, extremely fearful. His battle strength is a bit stronger than the one before, but if he were to face you, there is a high probability of perishing.”
“At this moment, Qingyu Quasi Emperor stepped forward, glaring at you with astonishing killing intent in his eyes. Your Talent Skills are too terrifying and your battle strength is too domineering, and now that you have made mortal enemies, he absolutely cannot let you leave here alive.”
“As a result, Qingyu Quasi Emperor directly unleashed his incarnation to attack you. For himself, he brought out an Array Plate, using it to temporarily trap Yu Daoyi, who was fighting him.”
“Seeing this scene, many strong characters shook their heads, thinking that Qingyu Quasi Emperor was kind of bullying, actually going after you, a Supreme himself. As you know, although Qingyu Quasi Emperor is not a top Quasi-Emperor, he is not weak.”
“He has the cultivation of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection. It’s just that, because his constitution is weaker than top Quasi-Emperors like Yu Daoyi and he has not reached the Major Completion Tier, plus his comprehension of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit isn’t that high, he has not become a top-tier Quasi-Emperor. But he is definitely not weak and can be considered a first-class strongman among the Quasi-Emperors.”
“Although, the one who attacked Wang Ping this time was only the incarnation of Qingyu Quasi Emperor, the strength is not particularly strong, only equivalent to the strength of a 3rd or 4th-tier Quasi-Emperor, but this is also powerful enough.”
“After all, the later you get in cultivation, the bigger the gap between the realms, especially in the Quasi-Emperor tier. Although you have demonstrated the strength to easily suppress and kill a 1st-tier ordinary Quasi-Emperor, they don’t believe that you can defeat Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s incarnation.”
“However, to the surprise of many old monsters, you faced the attack of Qingyu Quasi Emperor without any fear, but instead with full fighting spirit, directly releasing the Talent Skills of Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade, and began to clash with Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s incarnation.”
“However, even though you unlocked these two talents, you are not a match for Qingyu Quasi Emperor’s incarnation. The gap in cultivation is just too great. Of course, because of the effect of the guaranteed dual-performance and Burst Blade, you were not easily killed by him.”
“This type of warfare was shocking enough. No one expected that you were still hiding a trump card and managed to dramatically improve your battle strength, making the fight with Qingyu Quasi-Emperor’s incarnation a deadlock. He could not easily kill you either.”
“For a while, many old monsters grew more wary of you, believing that you were too monstrous. If you don’t perish, becoming an emperor will be inevitable, and there’s even a high chance of becoming an immortal.”
“Seeing this, the main body of Qingyu Quasi-Emperor also looked grave, not expecting that even his incarnation couldn’t take you down. Those strong characters from Taiyi Imperial Palace, such as Yu Daoyi, didn’t know you were hiding such a move either and were greatly admiring, feeling relieved.”

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 952: Chapter 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _4
[The old monsters of Chrysanthemum Village were also amazed, feeling that they had witnessed a monster. Their intervention was undoubtedly profitable this time. They took action because they held a grudge against the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor and could not stand the strong bullying the weak, which was disgraceful.]
[Now, your monstrous performance has indebted them to you; if you become an Emperor or Immortal in the future, they can also benefit greatly.]
[While everyone was astonished, something even more outrageous happened. You accidentally triggered an eight-fold critical strike effect and counterattacked, directly injuring the incarnation of the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor who had the upper hand.]
[Being injured wasn’t a big deal, as the injury of the Quasi-Emperor’s incarnation could be healed in an instant. However, your luck was extremely good, as you directly triggered the effect of Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, causing the incarnation of the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor to explode on the spot and die instantly.]
[This scene shocked the strong people present, who couldn’t believe that you could actually destroy the incarnation of the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor. Moreover, they were all experienced individuals, so they naturally understood that the attack just now couldn’t possibly kill the incarnation of the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor. However, after the attack, it was as if an Instant Death effect was triggered, resulting in direct death.]
[This ability was simply too terrifying. Even the items and abilities from All Heavens could scarcely compare to it. As a result, they were extremely wary of you.]
[With such an ability, if they were to fight you and get injured, they might perish. So they had to do their best to avoid being injured by you to prevent this situation from happening. But who could guarantee that they wouldn’t be injured in such a high-intensity battle unless there was a huge difference in strength between the two sides?]
[What’s more, your cultivation was only at the Peak of the Heavenly Supreme, yet you achieved something like this. If your cultivation improved to the Quasi-Emperor tier, it would be unimaginable how powerful you could become, and what kind of combat strength could burst out combined with your strange ability.]
[The expression of the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor was extremely ugly, as he never thought that his incarnation would be killed by you in such a disgraceful manner. At the same time, due to the destruction of his incarnation, he was also affected. Yu Daoyi took this opportunity to directly break the Great Array and counterattacked, injuring the Qingyu Quasi-Emperor.]
[Seeing the situation turning unfavorable, the Green Feather Quasi-Emperor immediately called for the people of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace to retreat. You wanted to catch up and kill them all, but you remembered not to chase an impoverished enemy and decided to give up due to the Immortal Tower Opportunity.]
[However, just as you gave up, the strong people from Chrysanthemum Village grinned and chose to take action, viciously chasing after the Quasi-Emperors and Supremes of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace and killing more than half of them. Only Qingyu Quasi-Emperor and a few other Quasi-Emperors with profound cultivation managed to escape by burning their essence.]
[Upon seeing this, you quickly bowed in gratitude to the Quasi-Emperors from Chrysanthemum Village, such as the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor, for their help. You knew very well that without their assistance today, not only would you not be able to display your prowess and continually kill your enemies, but you, Yu Daoyi and the others could also have been left behind.]
[The Cyclops Quasi-Emperor laughed heartily, indicating that you didn’t need to be polite. He also found the people of the Green Bamboo Emperor Palace displeasing and, added to the coincidence that brought you together, they were naturally willing to help.]
[Next, the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor asked you if you wanted them to go and deal with the Destruction Quasi-Emperor.]
[Upon hearing this, you were quite tempted. Without the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, things would never have escalated to this extent. Therefore, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, the son of the Destructing Tao Emperor, deserved to die.]
[Hearing the words of the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, who was originally fighting fiercely with the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, had a darkened expression and without hesitation repelled the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, directly fleeing, abandoning the Immortal Tower Opportunity.]
[If it was a one-on-one battle, he wouldn’t fear anyone, but facing so many powerful beings, including two top Quasi-Emperors who weren’t much weaker than him, he would only be left with a dead end if he stayed.]
[As for the escape of the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, you had no intention of pursuing. Killing someone like him was quite difficult. Instead of chasing him down, it would be better to continue competing for the Immortal Tower. After all, two top Quasi-Emperors had already entered before, and you had wasted quite a lot of time; you couldn’t afford to waste any more.]
[Subsequently, you once again expressed your gratitude to the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor, the white-cloaked Quasi-Emperor, and other powerful beings. After conversing with them, you entered the Immortal Tower.]
[Upon entering the Immortal Tower, you found yourself transported to a strange place. You saw a huge stele with many names and rankings on it.]
[These names included both familiar and unfamiliar ones. Examining them carefully, you saw the familiar names of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the Dark Time Emperor.]
[However, what shocked you was that these familiar names were ranked quite low on this stele. The stele had only ten thousand names, with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor ranking at an entry-level position of ten thousand.]
[As for the Dark Time Emperor, he was somewhat stronger but only ranked eight thousand seven hundred.]
[This ranking left you in awe. After all, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was a top-tier Emperor, while the Dark Time Emperor was even an Emperor Monarch-tier figure. It was incredible that they ranked so low on this list.]

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 953: Chapter 255: Consecutive Assassinations of Quasi-Emperors! What About Immortals! _5
[However, you will soon know what this stele ranking means. The names recorded on this stele represent the rankings of all the outstanding talents born in the Upper Realm. Even if one barely makes it onto the list, it is something to be proud of.]
[After learning about this, your emotions surged as if you had witnessed all the battles that the talents of the Upper Realm had fought. In particular, the scenes of battles between the talents and the Great Emperors when the Immortal Domain Channel was not yet closed ignited a fighting spirit within you, making you want to fight these powerful beings.]
[As your fighting spirit stirred, a figure appeared in your consciousness. This figure was none other than the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. However, his cultivation was at the Peak of the Heavenly Supreme, the same level as you.]
[This made you realize that the trial of the Immortal Tower was probably similar to that of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, where you had to battle numerous powerful beings, advance steadily until you reached the summit and defeated all formidable opponents to pass the trial.]
[However, this Immortal Tower was different from the Taiyi Emperor Tower. The Taiyi Emperor Tower could only manifest figures from this era, while the Immortal Tower seemed to have existed for a long time and could manifest numerous strong beings since the birth of the Upper Realm. To be precise, it could manifest the powerful beings who were recorded on the list to assess those who entered the tower.]
[As for those talents who had not made it onto the list, they did not even qualify for being manifested. In other words, this was an opportunity to battle against the most powerful talents throughout history. Similar to the Taiyi Emperor Tower, regardless of whether there were rewards or passing the assessment, the benefits that one could gain from fighting these formidable opponents were immense.]
[As various thoughts emerged in your mind, the illusory figure of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor launched an attack on you. In response, you counterattacked and easily killed him.]
[At this moment, your name appeared on the stele, replacing the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s position and becoming the new 10,000th rank.]
[This scene made Yu Daoyi, who hadn’t entered the tower yet, roll his eyes, after which he went to challenge the tower as well.]
[Next, you continued to break through the ranks at a rapid pace. The formidable beings from the lower ranks posed no threat to you. However, you did not crush them directly but instead battled them, feeling their Dao methods and filling yourself with their knowledge.]
[During your tower challenge, many powerful beings entered here one after another, discovering the stele and the names on it, knowing the significance and likewise feeling astonished.]
[For this reason, they also chose to challenge the tower. However, many of them were defeated and withdrew shortly after entering, unable to pass even the first trial.]
[This caused them to bitterly smile, realizing that the gap between them and the beings on the stele was too wide.]
[Then, they watched as your ranking steadily rose, feeling nothing but astonishment. Of course, remembering your terrifying battle achievements before entering the tower, they thought that all of it was as it should be.]
[After all, your record of defeating the Qingyu Quasi Emperor while being at a lower cultivation realm was something that had never happened in this era, and it was unlikely that anyone else could compare to you even in the ancient times before the Immortal Domain Channel was closed.]
[Now, they were only curious about how high you could rank and whether you could pass the trial and obtain this Immortal Tower.]
[Under their gazes, you continued to push through the tower with increasing difficulty. Relying solely on your own battle power, you struggled when you reached the 1,000th ranking, finding it difficult to quickly defeat your enemies. There was no helping it, as your opponents also had terrifying talents and abnormal battle power.]
[It could only be said that each era had its own monstrous beings; you may be unrivaled in this era, but not necessarily in others. Especially when the Immortal Domain Channel was not yet closed, that time had the guidance of immortals, an immortal body was not considered rare, immortal bloodlines were not uncommon, and resources were abundant, beyond what this current era could compare to.]
[Therefore, you gritted your teeth and started using your Talent Skills to continue challenging the tower. As you activated Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade, your battle power soared once again. Under the shocked gazes of the numerous powerful beings, the speed of your rise in ranking accelerated.]
[Finally, you successfully reached the 300th rank. The titles of the top 300 competitors on the stele had all changed to have the suffix “Immortal.”]
[In other words, all the top 300 competitors were terrifying existences that had become immortal in the history of the Upper Realm. How powerful these beings were! If you could defeat them, it would mean that your Same Realm Battle Power at the Heavenly Supreme realm had surpassed the power of these immortals when they were younger.]
[After a long battle, your ranking advanced again, as you cut down one of the immortals and replaced their rank.]
[This caused even Yu Daoyi to marvel at your monstrous abilities once more, as even the immortals in their youth were no match for you. The other powerful beings were also in awe, believing that they had witnessed history.]
[However, these powerful beings believed that this should be the end for you. After all, it had been so difficult to defeat the 300th ranked immortal, let alone those ranked even higher.]

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 256: The Fifth Seven-Color Talent! Acquire the Little Chaos Body!
chapters.content:
Chapter 954: Chapter 256: The Fifth Seven-Color Talent! Acquire the Little Chaos Body!
[Indeed, just as the outer world masters had predicted, your battles have been extremely difficult. This is because the people who have reached this ranking were once Immortal beings. Such individuals were incredibly powerful even in their youth, not only possessing extraordinary Special Constitution but also cultivating it to the Great Completion Domain. The difference between Minor Domain and Great Completion Domain is completely incomparable.]
[As a result, despite your Talent buffs, you continue to struggle in your battles. It was only by triggering the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack that you were able to defeat the Being ranked at 300.]
[Yet, you continued to fight using the same method. Of course, it wasn’t due to pure vanity that you aimed for a higher ranking; in the process of battling them, you were also gaining insight into their ways and improving yourself. This was how you have been fighting since you first entered the tower.]
[Now, you have indeed reaped great rewards with many insights into the Heavenly Tao. In the end, you didn’t trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack in this battle, but instead understood 40% True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao during the fight. This allowed you to have a significant increase in your combat prowess, and you defeated your enemy decisively.]
[After that, your battles became easier, and you advanced rapidly. To the astonishment of everyone, you broke through to the 230th rank. At this point, your battles became difficult once more, and you couldn’t gain the upper hand.]
[However, you remained composed, continuing to gain insights into the ways of your powerful opponents and incorporating their knowledge within yourself, while trying to break through your limits and reach the Great Completion Domain in your Time-Space Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[In the end, because you occasionally triggered the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, you managed to reach the 200th rank, entering the top 200. This left everyone in shock and disbelief.]
[After all, reaching this point means that you have defeated 100 Immortals. Although this is just a battle at the same realm, similar to defeating the Immortals in their youth, it is still incredibly terrifying. In today’s Upper Realm, Immortals are legendary beings, known only by their name, not their presence. Everyone dreams of becoming an Immortal, but no one can achieve it.]
[And yet, you have already defeated 100 Immortals, which is utterly terrifying. In contrast, they can’t even pass the first level, and the gap between them and you is enormous. For a moment, some people thought they were witnessing the rise of a new legend, while others felt their Tao Heart wavering, deeply affected by this astonishing achievement.]
[Only people like Yu Daoyi, who are on the same side as you, are delighted and excited, making others envy your group.]
[Just as everyone was having mixed feelings, they were shocked to discover that your speed in breaking through the rankings had started to surge once more, reaching an incredible pace.]
[This left everyone speechless, feeling numb. No one expected that you still had hidden cards up your sleeve. After breaking the 200th rank, your speed in advancing through the levels increased instead of decreasing.]
[However, some Quasi-Emperors seemed to have guessed something and sighed, claiming that you must have had another breakthrough during high-intensity battles. This latest breakthrough was clearly astonishing, causing a qualitative change in your combat prowess.]
[Upon hearing this, everyone else came to the same realization, feeling even more shocked and envious. They were once prodigies themselves, and they understood the advantages of breaking through limits at the last moment. It was quite normal for you to gain insights into the ways of so many legendary figures from the past and present, then break through your limits as you fought them.]
[Everyone understood that this was a great opportunity, but they couldn’t help feeling envious, as their strength was not enough to battle each of these legendary figures.]
[As everyone expected, you broke through your limits during these continuous battles, upgrading your Time-Space Body from the Minor Domain to the Great Completion Domain, and once again had a qualitative change in your combat power.]
[Thus, you were able to continue advancing rapidly, passing through one level after another and enjoying every battle.]
[After a long time, under the astonished gazes of Yu Daoyi and others, you finally broke through the top 100 ranks. At this point, you had defeated 200 Immortals.]
[Upon reaching the top 100, your progress slowed down, but you still continued to steadily advance in rank. Witnessing this, the powerful figures present looked at each other, wondering if it was possible for you to reach the top rank.]
[Although they found it incredible and somewhat unbelievable, they had to admit that you might be able to achieve such a feat. If that were true, it would mean that you were the number one person in the realm since the birth of the Upper Realm – an incredible accomplishment indeed.]
[In the end, under everyone’s watchful eyes, you were stuck at the 50th rank. This made everyone realize that you had most likely encountered a formidable opponent again, and if you couldn’t break through your limits in the process, your journey would end here.]
[As everyone predicted, you indeed encountered a formidable enemy. She was far too terrifying, not only possessing Immortal Lineage, but also an unbelievably formidable Immortal Body cultivated to the Great Completion Domain. Moreover, she had cultivated a terrifying Immortal Sutra, gaining 60% True Spirit of Heavenly Dao. In this situation, even if you went all out, you would still struggle to compete with her.]
[Under such circumstances, if you want to defeat her, you can only trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack. Otherwise, you would need to break through your Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Great Completion Domain or comprehend 50% True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao to have a chance at victory.]

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 955: Chapter 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _2
“[In the heat of a fierce fight, you attempted to breakthrough at your limit. Unfortunately, you could not comprehend the 50% True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao or evolve the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Great Completion Domain, and were defeated.]
[Since it was a trial, your resurrection methods were rendered useless. Eventually, you ended up in the 51st position and were expelled from the trial space of the Immortal Tower.]
[Upon your exit, you were rather frustrated. If you had endured a little longer, you definitely could have comprehended the 50% True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao. Even though, in your state, the likelihood of you turning defeat into victory after gaining this understanding was low. But any achievement in comprehension is a good thing.]
[Of course, you didn’t pay too much attention to it. This time, you were unable to comprehend, but you have a foundation. As long as you cultivate slowly, you will be able to grasp it. Besides, not being able to top the list this time, you believe that you will eventually reach the top in your future simulations.]
[You were lost in your emotions when numerous strong contenders began focusing on you. Some admired you, others feared, their expressions complex.]
[As for people like Yu Daoyi, they were extremely delighted and congratulated you sincerely on reaching the 51st position. The Cyclops Quasi-Emperors also marvelled at your achievements, claiming that you were truly extraordinary.]
[In response to their congratulations, you simply smiled and said that being 51st wasn’t much to be happy about, as you didn’t even manage to top the list.]
[With this comment, everyone fell silent. They thought you were being overly modest. After all, you were ranked 51st among all the living beings since the birth of the Upper Realm – an extraordinary feat. Yet, when you stated, ‘Just the 51st, didn’t make the top, nothing to be happy about’, they couldn’t help but feel an urge to chastise you.]
[However, they were all old monsters and quickly composed themselves. Each of them looked at the Immortal Tower with a furrowed brow. Initially, they thought they needed to defeat everyone on the stone tablet rankings to acquire the Immortal Tower, but on further contemplation, they deemed it an impossible task.]
[After all, the Immortal Tower had existed for so many aeons. If it could be won that easily, then the person currently ranked first would already be eligible to receive the Immortal Tower.]
[Of course, it’s not ruled out that the Immortal Tower recorded numerous powerful beings through the Heavenly Tao and produced a ranking. After all, it’s highly likely that famous strong contenders like the Dark Time Emperor have never entered this secret realm, yet their names are listed. This indicates that the chance of Heavenly Tao recording and the Immortal Tower itself ranking is quite high.]
[However, they also didn’t know whether this secret realm had ever been opened in the distant past. If it had, then it’s likely that someone had already attempted the Immortal Tower trial.]
…..
“To think I made it to the 51st position is beyond my expectation. I initially thought I’d barely make it into the top 100.”
Wang Ping glanced at the Text Simulation content and gave a faint smile.
“But, it looks like I ended up showing off again, truly incorrigible. Showing off often leads to trouble.”
Wang Ping remembered the simulation of him showing off, his gaze subtly shifted and he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[When everyone was at their wits’ end, wondering how to subdue the Immortal Tower, an Immortal Light fell and a fruit appeared before you. At the same time, a celestial melody sounded, declaring that all contenders ranked would be rewarded, but those in the top 100 would be given an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit.]
[With the appearance of this fruit, the eyes of the many strong competitors present widened and turned red with greed. After all, this was an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit, a precious item that aids in Enlightenment. If they possessed this item, they would reap countless benefits.]
[Once, an Ordinary Quasi-Emperor accidentally obtained an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit. After consuming it, he entered a miraculous state of Enlightenment, and eventually even comprehended Emperor Scripture and elevated the Heavenly Tao True Spirit to the 7th-Tier. This laid the foundation for him to become an Emperor.]
[In the end, this Ordinary Quasi-Emperor managed to turn the tables, surpassing his peers with far greater talent, becoming an Emperor, and carving out his own legend.]
[For the strong contenders present, this Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit was equivalent to a pass to becoming an Emperor. As long as they obtained this fruit, they might have a chance of becoming Emperor in the future.]
[As such, this temptation was extremely immense, causing even the Top Quasi-Emperors to lose their cool. They had been stagnant at the Quasi-Emperor stage for a long time, needing the opportunity and enlightenment to become Emperor. If they obtained this Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit, they would definitely be able to achieve Emperor status.]
[It was said that the opportunity to become Emperor had appeared in front of them.]
[For a moment, even the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor couldn’t help but feel conflicted. As for other Quasi-Emperors like the White-Cloaked Quasi-Emperor, he too felt conflicted. He glanced at you, recalled your words, and ultimately decided to keep silent.]
[He also wanted to become an Emperor, but he understood very well that his inability to do so was due to deficiencies in his Tao Heart. If his Tao Heart was complete, he was confident that he could become an Emperor even without the aid of the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit.]
[Because of this, the White-Cloaked Quasi-Emperor sent you a message, inquiring about the previous generation Swallowing Immortal Demon Body. You gave him an affirmative reply and explained everything, which calmed his heart.]
[You were very clear that the current situation has complicated things again. It was essential to keep the top fighters steady; otherwise, you would surely meet a tragic end.]

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 956: Chapter 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _3
The white-cloaked quasi-emperor sighed when he heard this, standing up straight, and declared his position in front of the many envious powerhouses. He stated that if anyone wanted to make a move, they would have to go past his sword first.
The Cyclops Quasi-Emperor also scratched his head, thinking it unnecessary to make an enemy out of you just for an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit. He thought it better to continue to incur favor. After all, you are a figure with the potential to become an Immortal in the future, and having you in his debt could be more valuable than an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit.
As the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor and others like the Chrysanthemum Village Pre-Emperor and the White-Cloaked Quasi-Emperor once again stated their positions, Yu Daoyi and the other quasi-emperors of Taiyi Imperial Palace let out a sigh of relief. However, everyone was still on guard.
After all, the current situation inside the Immortal Tower is different from outside. Here, there are two top quasi-emperors, and all the quasi-emperors have gathered together, even more than when they were outside the tower. Even with the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor and other Quasi-Emperors on your side, you’re no match for the many strong opponents.
At this moment, the quasi-emperors present were quite torn, unsure whether to take action. The chance to become emperor was right before their eyes, and they weren’t willing to give up the fight.
However, if they fought and let you escape, they would be restless. After all, your talent is too terrifying, you could very likely kill them all in a short amount of time, and if you were to become emperor and immortal in the future, they and their respective forces would be obliterated no matter where they hid.
