Just as the atmosphere at the scene grew tense, as you put the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit into your internal world, a cold voice rang out. The voice came surprisingly from the Destruction Quasi-Emperor who had fled before.
The Destruction Quasi-Emperor pointed out that this was a good opportunity to kill you, reducing a future Immortal Emperor and vying for the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit. If they let you escape, they would end up with no share in the future opportunity of becoming immortal.
Once these words came out, the expressions of the strong ones who were hesitant to offend you fluctuated, eventually displaying a cruel gleam. Indeed, everyone wants to become immortal, and when the Immortal Fate comes up, all forces outside of their own are enemies. Since they are destined to be mortal enemies sooner or later, why not get rid of you now?
Now, everyone stands on the same line due to their interests; without this opportunity, killing you in the future would be troublesome.
As the Destruction Quasi-Emperor appeared and deceived the many powerhouses, the faces of you, Yu Daoyi, and the others all changed, and they harbored extreme hatred for the Destruction Quasi-Emperor.
You, especially, swore in your heart to grind the Destruction Quasi-Emperor to dust. Even if you can’t kill him in this simulation and the chances of demise are actually higher, you still have the next simulation, and you can make a move against him in reality, to kill him thoroughly. As for his father, the Destructing Tao Emperor, if found, kill him too. It would be perfect to settle both old and new scores at once!
Next, the quasi-emperors, led by the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, launched an attack on you, and the battle erupted.
The fight had no suspense, just at the beginning, you were severely injured, and the quasi-emperors from Taiyi Imperial Palace fell swiftly. After all, even though you had become much stronger, there was still a big gap between you and the top quasi-emperors. Plus, with their superior numbers, there was no way you could win.
As a result, you could only sigh, unwilling to see the fall of Yu Daoyi and the others, and chose to end the simulation voluntarily.
Because you voluntarily ended the simulation, this simulation ended at that point …
…
The text simulation stopped here, and numerous images and realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind. He found himself in the Immortal Tower, witnessing the battle scene with his own eyes.
Then, Wang Ping took note of each powerhouse who attacked the simulated Wang Ping and others, and exited the immersive simulation state.
“These people who have repeatedly made moves against me, I will remember this vengeance, especially the Destruction Quasi-Emperor and Qingyu Quasi Emperor. I look forward to killing you in reality and seeing the day when you explode into gold coins,” said Wang Ping, his eyes flickering and murmuring to himself.
At this moment, with the timely arrival of the system’s voice.
“Ding, reward generation successful. The host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Red Talent: Ice Profound Physique.
②. Red Talent: Gold Profound Physique.
③. Spacetime Tao Body·Great Completion Domain.
④. a Random a quasi-Emperor Artifact.
⑤. Supreme Treasure Elixir.”
…
“System, I choose ②. Gold Profound Physique and ③. Spacetime Tao Body·Great Completion Domain.”
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards and made his choice.
Although the Ice Profound Body is good, it is not one of the nine major attributes and does not need to be chosen.
As for the Spacetime Tao Body·Great Completion Domain, it is not to be missed; it can enhance his combat power by quite a bit.
Next time, it may not necessarily be possible to comprehend it.
“Speaking of which, can’t talents just be packaged in a Profound Body gift package? For example, possessing all Profound Bodies, with talent levels of gold or rainbow.”
Wang Ping gently shook his head, murmuring.
If that were the case, it would save quite a few simulations.
Besides, choosing a Profound Body time and again, ignoring other rewards, is really painful, and it will block a lot of reward choices.
Not to mention, it’s not certain that a Profound Body and reward will appear every time.
“Forget it, it’s just a thought. It’s not likely that I’ll be so lucky as to refresh such a talent directly, and it’s questionable whether such a talent even exists,”
Wang Ping gave another sigh, throwing out this strange idea from his mind.
At this moment, the rewards were issued. Wang Ping’s Spacetime Tao Body was instantly developed to the Great Completion Domain, rising his combat power by a large margin.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 957: Chapter 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _4
“Next, system, continue with the Paid Simulation, I’m not far from reaching the summit now.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly and spoke in his heart.
“Ding, spending 5 million Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing… ”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Seven-Color Talent · Profound Body Resource Package; Purple Talent · I’m So High, I Can’t Be Stopped.”
Seven-color Talent · Profound Body Resource Package: Profound Body, the best carrier for Chaotic Body and has the strongest plasticity. This talent contains a Profound Body with all attributes, making it the best supporting talent for Chaotic Body.
Purple Talent · I’m So High, I Can’t Be Stopped: When you say this during a battle with high spirits, it can increase your combat power.
“Damn!”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents and was completely stunned.
This was really the case – whatever he wanted, he would get.
Initially, he had been talking about the Profound Body Resource Package, and the result was that it really got refreshed for him.
The Life Simulator was just too powerful.
“System, I choose Seven-color Talent · Profound Body Resource Package!”
Wang Ping spoke excitedly in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The system’s voice rang again, causing Wang Ping’s consciousness to flicker and enter an immersive simulation state.
Then, the familiar words appeared on the luminescent screen.
[Day One, you have thought over and realized that entering the secret realm to challenge the Immortal Tower will be of no advantage, and instead, it will only benefit the old monsters. In this simulation, unless you break through your cultivation and suppress everything, you have no intention of entering the secret realm to challenge the Immortal Tower.]
[This time, you plan to seize the Little Chaotic Body again and are determined to obtain it. To make this happen, you take action and begin to plan.]
[This time, you’ve learned your lesson and have no intention of challenging the Supreme Heavenly Path. After arranging everything, you take Lin Yuanyuan with you to hide in the Golden Age.]
[Then, you observe the world’s situation and wait for the right time to come. You destroy your own cultivation, enter the Immortal Mansion Trial, quickly suppress the weird, and help Lin Yuanyuan extract the Little Chaotic Body.]
[Immediately after, you try to obtain the Little Chaotic Body through Lin Yuanyuan. However, something unexpected happens. You are very compatible with the Little Chaotic Body’s source, but you lack something, so you can’t perfectly absorb the Little Chaotic Body Origin and obtain the Little Chaotic Body.]
[This makes your expression serious, and you don’t know what you lack. When you are extremely upset, the little (male) taoist and little (female) taoist you saved before suddenly appear and merge into your body.]
[As they merge into your body, you successfully absorb the Little Chaotic Body Origin and obtain the Little Chaotic Body.]
[At the same time, you learn the origins of the little (male) taoist and little (female) taoist you saved.]
[It turns out that they are the incarnations of Heavenly Tao. The pain of the Heavenly Tao being cut off inadvertently formed these two wandering in the world unconsciously, looking for someone to save them.]
[That’s why these two have such a pure character, weakness, low cultivation, but they have been extremely lucky. They always managed to escape danger.]
[Now, after witnessing your powerful strength and killing off the weird, these two, as incarnations of Heavenly Tao, have awakened and merged into your body as Heavenly Tao Origin, completing the last piece of the puzzle and helping you obtain the Little Chaotic Body.]
[The Little Chaotic Body is not the True Chaotic Body but possesses a part of its power and can evolve at any time. As long as you absorb the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits, you can grow into a True Chaotic Body.]
[When everyone in the field sees that you have obtained the Chaotic Body, they are all shocked to the extreme and envy you. Ku Xuan sighs and doesn’t expect the weird to help you get the Chaotic Body.]
[However, while he may be envious, he is still very grateful to you. Without your help, he would still be under the control of the weird and eventually die.]
[In the midst of the shock, you look at Ku Xuan and congratulate him for breaking free from the weird’s control. You also ask Ku Xuan to take you and Yuanyuan away from here.]
[Ku Xuan nods without saying anything more and opens the passage, taking you and Lin Yuanyuan away from the secret realm.]
[After you leave, the emergence of the Little Chaotic Body begins, and the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation brews, with its oppressive aura spreading across the entire Starfield.]
[Seeing this scene, you can’t help but grow serious. You are not afraid of the Little Chaotic Body’s Heavenly Tribulation but are worried that Leng Yue Emperor will reappear. When that happens, you will be in trouble, as you have no means to deal with him.]
[Although you have the incarnation of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor with you, Leng Yue Emperor, the Predecessor ransmigrators, is someone that even the Immortal Mansion needs to protect. It seems that the two parties have an unknown connection.]
[However, even though you are worried, you have no choice but to face the Heavenly Tribulation first.]
[Soon, as the Heavenly Tribulation brews, you begin to Cross the Tribulation. Ku Xuan and Lin Yuanyuan stay far away. Facing the Heavenly Tribulation, you don’t dare to be careless and bravely fight against it.]
[It has to be said that the Heavenly Tribulation brought on by the Little Chaotic Body is extremely terrifying, but you are already strong enough to casually overcome it. After Crossing the Tribulation, you gain many benefits.]

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 958: Chapter 256: The Fifth Colorful Talent! Acquiring a Mini-Chaos Body! _5
[At the same time, after you crossed the Heavenly Tribulation, the Predecessor ransmigrators Leng Yue Emperor did not appear. Apparently, you were quite lucky this time, as the place where Ku Xuan opened the secret realm channel did not have any Emperor-tier beings, let alone running into Leng Yue Emperor, otherwise you would have been finished.]
[However, you don’t plan to stay here any longer. After all, the noise from before was so big that even if there are no Great Emperors in the nearby starfields, many people must have noticed the anomaly. Although most of the powerhouses went to the Immortal Mansion to watch the fun due to its opening, staying here for too long would still be dangerous.]
[Because of this, you quickly come to Lin Yuanyuan’s side and directly use the Golden Talent: Transmission ability to leave the area.]
[This leaves Ku Xuan somewhat helpless, as he didn’t expect you to slip away so quickly.]
[Not long after you left, a Great Emperor’s aura appeared here. Clearly, leaving immediately after crossing the tribulation was the right decision.]
[Soon, through Ku Xuan’s mouth, the events that happened in the secret realm were exposed, causing a stir among the various forces in the Upper Realm. They didn’t expect the strangeness to be calculating so much. The most outrageous thing was that the strangeness failed to steal anything and ended up benefiting you, the hidden successor of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[For a time, many Great Emperors were quite envious of Taiyi Imperial Palace and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. At the same time, they also developed some strange thoughts, which made Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi both happy and headache.]
[However, the various forces eventually didn’t do much, as it was thanks to you that some of the talented youth were saved this time. They couldn’t justify taking action against Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace. Moreover, Immortal Mansion and the Ku family were clearly siding with Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After that, Ku Xuan exposed Emperor Fengxin and Emperor Slaughter. However, due to the fact that they fled early when the situation was unfavorable, there was no scene of other Emperors ganging up on them this time.]
[Nevertheless, their calculations this time would make them like rats crossing the street in the future, and they would eventually be found and killed by Emperors.]
[Just as your fame in the Upper Realm was soaring, you and Lin Yuanyuan were teleported to a familiar yet unfamiliar place.]
[This place is the Eternal Ancient Star. You have also come here before through Golden Talent: Transmission. This is a very peculiar ancient star, with numerous resources on it. The rare Divine Medicines in the Last Dharma Age can be found everywhere. However, this ancient star cannot produce Saint Realm Powerhouses.]
[If a Saint Realm powerhouse is born, a force will appear on the ancient star, absorbing all the cultivators, which is the source of the indigenous people’s fear.]
[Now, you and Lin Yuanyuan have arrived here. Just as you both appeared here, this Eternal Ancient Star began to have a stress reaction, starting to absorb the cultivators on the ancient star.]
[In the past, you were powerless against this force. But now, you have come a long way, and forcefully suppressed the absorption force, protecting yourself and Lin Yuanyuan.]
[At the same time, you used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see its interior. Inside this Eternal Ancient Star, there is a pearl. This pearl has a strange devouring rule, capable of devouring energy in the world.]
[The moment you saw the pearl, you couldn’t help but reveal a surprised expression. Because this pearl is none other than the Devouring Mana Pearl. The Devouring Soul Pearl is on Lin Yan, while the Devouring Spirit Pearl is on Zhu Huowang. Before, only the Devouring Mana Pearl had been missing. Now, you finally found the location of the Devouring Mana Pearl.]
[Finding the Devouring Mana Pearl means that the three major devouring Innate Emperor Artifacts are complete, and it’s possible to merge them into Immortal Artifacts. When that time comes, you will have a real Immortal Artifact. If you can obtain the Immortal Tower from the special secret realm, you will have two Immortal Artifacts. That would be something even quasi-Fairy will be envious of.]
[At the same time, you finally figured out the unusual state of this Eternal Ancient Star. Because the Devouring Mana Pearl is a devouring Innate Emperor Artifact, it is usually in a dormant state before recognizing its owner, and only the appearance of a cultivator Above Saint Realm would slightly catch its attention.]
[And the result of catching its attention is that the cultivators on the Eternal Ancient Star are eaten up like desserts. However, the place where the Devouring Mana Pearl is located will also release abundant mana, making the resources of the entire ancient star rich, which is why a scene of Divine Medicines everywhere would occur.]
[After figuring all this out, you wasted no time in breaking through the Eternal Ancient Star, intending to subdue this masterless Devouring Mana Pearl.]
[After you broke through the ancient star, the Devouring Mana Pearl, which was initially only slightly awake, fully awakened and started to resist you. It tried to devour your mana, refusing to acknowledge a master.]

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 257: Breaking through the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Nine-Star Pavilion Master revealed!?
chapters.content:
Chapter 959: Chapter 257: Breaking through the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Nine-Star Pavilion Master revealed!?
“Good heavens, I didn’t expect it to go so smoothly this time, directly obtaining the Little Chaotic Body. Even the Devouring Mana Pearl was found.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and felt quite emotional.
“However, is this Devouring Mana Pearl blind? I already have these configurations, and it still doesn’t want to recognize me as its master.”
Wang Ping recalled the Devouring Mana Pearl’s resistance and was left speechless.
His current configuration:
The newly acquired Little Chaotic Body.
Great Space-Time Dao Body in the Great Completion Domain.
Breaking Origin Sky Eye in the Minor Domain.
With such talent, even in the most prosperous era of the Upper Realm, few people can compare to him.
As a result, this Devouring Mana Pearl is unwilling to recognize him as its master, which is really absurd.
Could it be that someone who is not a Son of Fortune is truly not worthy of having three Devouring Emperor Artifacts?
“No, a Son of Fortune is just a living being favored by Heavenly Tao, whereas I am someone approved by Heavenly Tao’s incarnation. In terms of priority, I’m definitely higher than a Son of Fortune.”
Wang Ping recalled this point, slightly frowning and somewhat puzzled.
Or was it that the Devouring Mana Pearl had already found a master, and he’s here to seize it for something?
“Whether it is or not, I’ll find out soon.”
Soon, Wang Ping calmed down and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[As you unleash terrifying power and fully open your foundation, the struggle of the Devouring Mana Pearl weakens. Then, it chooses to recognize you as its master. Previously, it was awakened from its slumber, and naturally, it instinctively resisted when it wanted to subdue it. However, after seeing your monstrousness and being approved by Heavenly Tao, it naturally chooses to recognize its master.]
[Even if you don’t accept it, it would come back to pester you, begging you to accept it.]
[You don’t know the thoughts of the Devouring Mana Pearl, and you just think the Devouring Mana Pearl is intimidated by your power, which makes you quite satisfied.]
…..
“Damn, I truly can’t stand it, so it was just a case of waking up grumpy.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and was left speechless.
He thought that the Devouring Mana Pearl was haughty or already owned, but it turned out to just wake up grumpy.
“My ability to fill in the blanks is too strong, which is also a mistake.”
Wang Ping covered his forehead, complained about himself, and then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, after researching the Devouring Mana Pearl, you reveal an expression of excitement. You discovered that this Devouring Mana Pearl is really a natural cultivation cheating tool.]
[This object is specifically for mana. In other words, as long as you improve your understanding of Heavenly Tao True Spirit, it can devour everything, transform it into mana, and help you quickly improve your cultivation.]
[With this object, you believe that you can quickly break through to the Quasi-Emperor tier. If your cultivation reaches the Quasi-Emperor tier, you will have the confidence to seek the secret realm’s Immortal Tower.]
[As you fantasize about the future, a Heavenly Supreme is attracted by the anomaly. When he sees the Devouring Mana Pearl in your hand, his heart trembles, and he reveals a fanatic expression. He greedily looks at the Devouring Mana Pearl and doesn’t hesitate to make a move, trying to kill you and take the Devouring Mana Pearl.]
[Although you have already made the top powerhouses of the Upper Realm tremble, the word hasn’t spread completely, and because you’ve been low-key while challenging the Immortal Mansion, you are still an unknown figure in this starry sky, just a passerby.]
[For this reason, even though you are wearing the elder robe of Taiyi Imperial Palace, you seem to be at the Half-step Supreme Realm, so this Heaven Supreme doesn’t take you seriously. Although the identity of the elder of the Taiyi Imperial Palace makes him wary, he can’t care too much about the big chance before his eyes.]
[As long as he gets the Devouring Mana Pearl, he’ll have a chance to become a Quasi-Emperor and even fantasize about becoming an Emperor in the future. At that time, there will be nothing to fear from Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[As this Heaven Supreme fantasizes about the future, your expression darkens, and you didn’t expect him to dare to make a move against you.]
[At that moment, you unleash terrifying combat power, going all out, casting Great Divine Skills, and instantly killing him.]
[Although your current cultivation is only at the Half-step Supreme Realm and far from the Heavenly Supreme, your other configurations are too terrifying, and the gap in cultivation can be completely compensated for.]
[After killing this Heaven Supreme, you use the Devouring Mana Pearl to devour him, transforming him into pure mana to quickly improve your cultivation to the Supreme tier.]
[Upon returning to the Supreme Realm, you are quite satisfied and return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace with Lin Yuanyuan. When you return, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi breathe a sigh of relief, marveling and congratulating you for obtaining the Little Chaotic Body.]
[In response, you accept each of their congratulations. Then, you propose the idea of ​​challenging the Supreme Heavenly Path. Hearing this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor naturally cannot stop you, and chooses to let you challenge the tower.]
[Soon, you easily clear the road, and in the process, no one can take a single move from you. This sight directly astonishes Taiyi Great Emperor’s phantom, who has never seen someone as abnormal as you.]
[However, what followed is relief. Taiyi Imperial Palace will have future generations, someone who could possibly become an immortal, which would allow him to rest in peace.]
[Next, you obtain the recognition of the Taiyi Emperor Tower and receive rewards. Your cultivation quickly soars, reaching the peak of Heavenly Supreme.]
[This time, because you have the Devouring Mana Pearl, the process of absorbing energy and refining it is shortened. You spend only a year to reach this level.]

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 960: Chapter 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_2
[After you come out of seclusion, you begin to think about where to find a massive amount of energy for your consumption. After careful consideration, you decide that targeting quasi-emperors is the best option.]
[Then, you ask the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor if there are any quasi-emperor criminals imprisoned in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. Hearing your inquiry, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is puzzled but still answers your question.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor informs you that there are indeed quasi-emperor criminals. After all, those at the quasi-emperor level all have their secrets and are of great value, so if captured alive, they will not be easily killed, but instead, their secrets and value will be exploited to the fullest.]
[In the Heavenly Feather Emperor Palace, there are two quasi-emperor prisoners.]
[Hearing this answer, you couldn’t help but smile. Having two quasi-emperor prisoners is great news. If you can use the Devouring Mana Pearl to consume them, it will definitely satisfy the conditions needed for you to break through to the quasi-emperor level. After all, you’ve already gained 40% comprehension of Heavenly Tao True Spirit, and all that remains is to accumulate a massive amount of energy to break through and condense a Tao Fruit.]
[Without the right opportunities, this process would be extremely lengthy and require a large amount of time. However, with the Devouring Mana Pearl, everything will become much simpler.]
[Next, you take out the Devouring Mana Pearl and reveal your 40% comprehension of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit, telling the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor that you want to use the two quasi-emperor prisoners to break through.]
[Seeing your Devouring Mana Pearl and sensing your 40% comprehension of Heavenly Tao True Spirit, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is shocked. He never expected that you would secretly obtain the Devouring Mana Pearl and gain such a deep understanding of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit. Your luck and perception are truly terrifying.]
[As a result, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor doesn’t say much and directly grants you the authority to deal with the two quasi-emperor prisoners, helping you break through to the quasi-emperor level.]
[You are very satisfied with this outcome and head to the heavenly prison in the Taiyi Imperial Palace. You meet the two quasi-emperor prisoners, kill them on the spot, and consume them with the Devouring Mana Pearl, turning them into pure Mana.]
[Then, you go into seclusion to cultivate, absorbing the pure energy and breaking through to the quasi-emperor level.]
[You know that you don’t have much time left. In a hundred years or so, it will be time for the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion to take action, and you must break through to the quasi-emperor level within that time.]
[In the end, you successfully condense the Tao Fruit and break through to the quasi-emperor level, attracting a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[The Heavenly Tribulation is horrifying and shocks the entire Immortal Continent. The Upper Realm powerhouses are all surprised, not expecting someone to cross the tribulation here. The intensity of this tribulation seems to be at the quasi-emperor level, but it is much more powerful than the memory they have of the quasi-emperor tribulation.]
[While many cultivators are shocked, even Great Emperors look at you with admiration, you confidently face the Heavenly Tribulation and fight against it.]
[This scene causes countless cultivators to tremble in awe. After all, you have now become a famous figure, and they naturally recognize you. However, they never expected that you would progress so quickly from Half-step Supreme to the quasi-Emperor tier; your cultivating speed is simply monstrous.]
[Even the two quasi-Fairies from the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family didn’t expect that you would be able to break through two Great Realms in just a hundred years, which is quite shocking for them. For a while, their own ambitions become more active.]
[At the time when various forces are having an active thought, you forcefully cross the Heavenly Tribulation and break through to the quasi-emperor level, with your fighting power increasing once more.]
…
“The Devouring Mana Pearl is really overpowered, the growth that this Innate Emperor Artifact brings is too terrifying. It allowed the simulated Wang Ping to advance to quasi-emperor in a short time. But after all, an emperor artifact is still an emperor artifact. Unless the three pearls unite to reach the level of Immortal Artifacts, it will probably not be very useful at the Great Emperor level and above.”
Wang Ping looks at the text simulation content and is quite amazed.
“Merging the three pearls, I’ll have to plan for this in the next simulation. As for this simulation, it probably won’t happen since the other two pearls have already acknowledged their masters. I can’t steal my own disciple’s treasures.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker as he secretly thinks.
In the real world, Lin Yan has yet to obtain the Devouring Soul Pearl.
As for Zhu Huowang, there is no need to say more; he has not even been born, and the Devouring Spirit Pearl is nowhere to be found.
To obtain the three pearls, Wang Ping hopes the Life Simulator can provide some rewards.
If not, he will still need to make an effort to obtain the Immortal Artifact in reality.
He already knows the locations of the Devouring Soul Pearl and Devouring Mana Pearl, but the Devouring Spirit Pearl is a bit troublesome.
Of course, it’s just a bit troublesome.
With Wang Ping’s Divine Skills, it is possible to trace back in time and find the location of the Devouring Spirit Pearl a hundred thousand years ago.
Although tracing back that far into the past would come at a great cost, as long as he does it in the simulation, Wang Ping’s main body will not have to pay any price.
Afterward, Wang Ping composes himself and continues to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[After you successfully cross the tribulation and become a quasi-emperor, the various forces are shocked and curious about your current level of strength. After all, you possess both the Time-Space Body and Chaotic Body, making your combat power extremely terrifying, even capable of fighting across realms at the quasi-emperor stage.]

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 961: Chapter 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_3
[At the time when everyone was shocked and curious, and their minds were active, an unexpected change occurred. The Master of Nine Stars Pavilion actually initiated the Ten Directions Refining Array to refine the Upper Realm.]
[Sensing this abnormal situation, all the strong warriors’ expressions changed drastically, as they realized the extreme danger.]
[In an instant, some strong warriors rushed towards the Source of Darkness without hesitation, while others shouted angrily. You also changed your expression and directly pointed out that this was the conspiracy of the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion and that he was in the Time-Space Forbidden Zone.]
[The strong warriors who did not escape into the Source of Darkness were shaken in their minds. Some of them were led by the Quasi-Immortals of Immortal Mansion and the Ku family to attack the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, while others chose to flee into the Source of Darkness.]
[As for you, you also made a choice. Your previous words had distracted many strong warriors, and you intended to take shelter in the vicinity of the Immortal Tower with the help of Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[Under your leadership, the strong warriors from Taiyi Imperial Palace arrived at the entrance of the secret realm one after another, intending to enter it.]
[However, something that greatly changed your expression happened. The entrance to the secret realm had disappeared and could not be opened. It was obvious that the secret realm where the Immortal Tower was located was also affected by the Great Array deployed by the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion. It was also possible that the Immortal Tower was protecting itself and directly sealed the entrance.]
[Faced with this situation, you were very helpless and could only discuss with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor which forbidden land to hide in. You had died several times in the Elemental Forbidden Land and did not want to go there again. You also didn’t want to go to the Life and Death Realm, where you had died several times as well.]
[However, you had to make a choice.]
[In the end, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed and said that instead of eking out a living, it would be better to fight to the death and seek a chance of survival, which was the courage a cultivator should have. Without courage, even those with great talents could not reach the peak.]
[Upon hearing this, you smiled bitterly. You also understood this principle, but the world was so dangerous that you wouldn’t have known how many times you would have died if you hadn’t been cautious enough.]
[Of course, you were also aware that at this point, continuing to be cautious wouldn’t make any difference. It would only allow you to live for another century or so, and there would be no point.]
[As a result, after some thinking, you agreed that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words made sense and hoped to fight alongside him against the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion. Since you were destined to die, you might as well try to see the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion and gather some information.]
[If you could collect enough information, it might help you prepare for future fights against him.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor nodded and led you, Yu Daoyi, and the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace to the Time-Space Forbidden Zone.]
[Upon arriving at the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, you found that the place was even more bizarre than described in ancient texts, with time and space being extremely chaotic and without any rules.]
[In this place, even a Great Emperor could be swallowed by sudden time-space rifts, or time could secretly accelerate, making cultivators’ lifespans consume rapidly, or time could suddenly slow down, making one’s perception of time incredibly slow, but the time-space rifts in the outer world remained just as dangerous and easily swallowed cultivators.]
[However, although this place was extremely dangerous, you found it to be the perfect place to cultivate the Road of Time and Space. When you first arrived here, following Heavenly Feather Great Emperor into the depths, you immediately gained insights into your True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao, understanding it up to 50%, which further increased your combat power.]
[This amazed you, and you felt that if you had the talent to resist the danger of this forbidden land in the future, you could really come here to cultivate in the simulation. Although it was dangerous, it was also accompanied by opportunities.]
[Soon after, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor led you to the depths of the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, arriving at the battlefield. However, even with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s protection, many Quasi-Emperors of Taiyi Imperial Palace perished during the journey. You also nearly fallen as well.]
[When you arrived at the battlefield, you saw a terrifying battle taking place. To be precise, the gathered strong warriors formed an array to besiege the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[The Great Array formed by the strong warriors was created from an Immortal Array Chart provided by a Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion. With the combination of two Quasi-Immortals, Great Emperors, and Quasi-Emperors present, the power of the Array Chart reached its peak.]
[Unfortunately, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion had already calculated everything. The Ten Forbidden Lands had become a whole, devouring and refining the Upper Realm, which was beyond everyone’s resistance. As a result, the powerful attacks from the warriors were blocked by numerous Array Patterns when they bombarded the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, who stood motionless and coldly watched the warriors as he continued to refine the Upper Realm.]
[Seeing this scene, you sighed in your heart, knowing that the overall situation was already lost. Since the Great Array had been formed, attacking the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion or any of the Nine Stars would be useless. Unless there was a terrifying power capable of directly breaking the Array.]
[However, such power was unlikely to be possessed even by someone who had just ascended to immortality. After all, a newly ascended immortal couldn’t possibly have the power to destroy the Ten Great Universes at once.]
[If there was such a power, it’s likely that some immortals would have already done so in the distant past.]
[However, the continuity of the Upper Realm till now proves that no one could do it. Of course, it doesn’t rule out the possibility that immortals may be restrained by stronger beings, particularly those controlled by the Immortal Domain, who dare not take such actions.]
[Everything was just your conjecture. The true strength of immortals was in an unknown realm, and no one in this era knew it. Although you had sensed the aura of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion after he ascended to immortality, you only sensed his aura and didn’t know how strong he really was since he hadn’t made a move.]

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 962: Chapter 257: Breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor! The identity of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion revealed!?_4
[Just when you were feeling emotional, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion looked at you. The moment he looked at you, you only felt a chill from the soles of your feet rushing straight to the top of your head.]
[Then, your consciousness flickered, and your vision changed, appearing directly next to the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[This change caused Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi’s expressions to shift, wanting to save you. However, they bitterly smiled soon after. Even so many powerhouses forming formations couldn’t do anything against the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, let alone them.]
[As a Great Emperor and a top Quasi-Emperor, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi felt helpless for the first time.]
[You looked at the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion with a bitter smile on your face. You didn’t expect him to be so terrifying, capturing you in an instant. Facing such a horrific enemy, you could not escape, only meeting your downfall. The downfall was not so bad, but after all the hard work to obtain the Little Chaotic Body, it is indeed too tragic to be turned into someone else’s nourishment.]
[As you despaired, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion stared at you and slowly said a sentence, ‘I, am still me, you, are not you, so you must die here.’]
[These words shocked your mind and soul, and you felt that they contained a great secret. At the same time, you suddenly realized that the eyes of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion hidden behind the mask were familiar, as if you had seen them somewhere before. Yet, you couldn’t remember where you had seen those vicissitudes-filled eyes.]
[Without waiting for you to think, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion chose to refine you directly. Because you had a Rebirth tally, you came back to life but were refined once again.]
[Since you died, this simulation ends here.]
…..
The text simulation ended here. Wang Ping’s mind was filled with memories and insights, and finally, his figure appeared in the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, seeing the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion.
“What did he mean by that? Did he somehow find out about the simulation? So, he is himself, but I am not myself.”
Wang Ping’s expression changed continuously, his heart pounding due to the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion’s words.
When did he find out about it?
If he had been watching me in reality and found out about this, wouldn’t I always be under his watch?
Moreover, why did the simulated Wang Ping feel as if he had seen his eyes somewhere before?
Wang Ping’s heart was turbulent, unable to calm down, staring hard at the vicissitudes in the eyes beneath the Pavilion Master’s mask, feeling the same familiarity.
However, Wang Ping couldn’t remember where he had seen these eyes either.
Helpless, he had encountered too many people, and this little familiarity made it impossible for him to make an accurate judgment.
“No, he shouldn’t have known about the Life Simulator in the real world. If he knew, he could have killed me long ago, and no one could stop him. Unless, he has other motives.”
Wang Ping clenched his fists, unable to calm down.
Just when Wang Ping was restless, his consciousness flickered, his vision changed, and he exited the immersive simulation state.
At the same time, the voice of the Life Simulator also sounded.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Seven-color Talent · Profound Body Resource Package.
②. Little Chaotic Body (it would be more appropriate to choose the seven-color talent before this).
③. 1st-tier Quasi-Emperor Cultivation.
④. a Random a quasi-Emperor Artifact.
⑤. a Random Emperor Scripture.”
…
After Wang Ping regained his senses, he looked at the reward list, took a breath, and spoke without hesitation. “System, I choose ①. Seven-color Talent · Profound Body Resource Package and ②. Little Chaotic Body.”
“Ding, reward selection successful, distribution in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt warmth flowing through his body, obtaining the Seven-color Talent Profound Body Resource Package and the Little Chaotic Body.
“Too bad, I just got the Little Chaotic Body and haven’t developed it into the Minor Domain stage nor obtained the corresponding scriptures and insights into the Chaos True Spirit. It didn’t really improve my combat power much, let alone compared to the Great Space-Time Dao Body.”
Wang Ping felt the changes in himself and found that his talent had indeed improved, but the change in his combat power was not that big.
To truly unleash the power of the Little Chaotic Body, Wang Ping needed to develop it into the Minor Domain or even the Great Completion Domain stage.
Of course, development is one issue, practicing a Chaotic Emperor Scripture and comprehending the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path is equally important.
Only with other configurations in place can the true power of the Little Chaotic Body be unleashed.
“However, an Emperor Scripture of Chaos attribute has never appeared, so I can only comprehend a new Emperor Scripture by myself, and I must also re-enlighten the True Spirit of Chaos Heavenly Path.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples and thought with a headache.
“However, with the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit of the Immortal Tower, it is not difficult. As long as I eat the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit, I can easily comprehend the Dao. By then, after multiple attempts in the Immortal Tower Reward, when the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit is no longer of use, everything will not be a problem.”
Wang Ping thought of the Immortal Tower again, chuckled, and stopped thinking.
“Now, I should go and earn divine sources. Although the matter of the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion bothers me, it’s useless to worry about it. I can only let Alpha be on guard and be prepared to transfer at any time. Alpha’s reaction speed is much faster than mine, and I can escape with him if there’s any danger.”

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 257: Breaking Through to Quasi-Emperor! The Identity of Nine Stars Pavilion Master Revealed!?_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 963: Chapter 257: Breaking Through to Quasi-Emperor! The Identity of Nine Stars Pavilion Master Revealed!?_5
Wang Ping stood up, leaving the retreat site and moving outwards.
“I have accessed your memories and seen the master of the Nine Stars Pavilion. So I can tell you about the identity of the master of the Nine Stars Pavilion.”
At this moment, Alpha’s voice suddenly sounded, making Wang Ping stop in his tracks, stunned.
“Who is the master of the Nine Stars Pavilion?”
Wang Ping asked with some uncertainty.
Since even Alpha knew the identity of the master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, it meant that this Pavilion Master must be quite famous.
However, compared to being famous, Wang Ping had other suspicions.
“The master of the Nine Stars Pavilion is Leng Yue Emperor.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded, his words not calm.
“Leng Yue Emperor? How can it be him!? Didn’t you say that Leng Yue Emperor fell into the Source of Darkness when the First Generation Chat Group was destroyed, and he was only at the Emperor Realm?”
Wang Ping’s face was shocked, and he said incredulously.
“And, the Nine Stars Pavilion Master is a figure from the same generation as the Ku family, a character from the last epoch, more than a hundred million years ago. So the First Generation Chat Group was established more than a hundred million years ago?”
“The establishment of the first generation Chat Group is much earlier than you can imagine.”
After a moment of silence, Alpha’s cold voice rang out again.
“But there is a problem with the timeline? One hundred million years ago, there were no humans on Earth, right?”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
“I’ve already told you that the Earth you are on is very special, and the humans on that planet are not ordinary. So many forces in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms choose humans from that Earth for transmigration and cultivation. Therefore, you cannot look at the issue based on the ordinary development of Earth’s history.”
Alpha spoke calmly.
“You did mention that before…”
Wang Ping was silent.
Alpha had said so, but he had forgotten and had not taken it seriously.
Now it seems that one of the most mysterious places in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms might be on that Primitive Earth.
“To be honest, I never thought Leng Yue could get to this point. He really has great courage and skill.”
Alpha’s voice sounded again, praising Leng Yue.
“He is indeed very powerful.”
Wang Ping also had to admire him.
It can only be said that none of the predecessor transmigrators who managed to survive up to this point are simple; they are all Bewitched Kings among Bewitched Kings.
In comparison, the quality of the Second-generation Chat Group’s predecessor transmigrators is a bit uneven, the weakest being Nirvana Boundary strength, and the strongest currently appearing is just Quasi-Emperor.
As for the Group Owner of the Second Generation Chat Group, Wang Ping had never met him and did not count him in.
Of course, even if he was included, Wang Ping would no longer be as shocked as before.
Eliminating ten great universes with a wave of his hand seemed terrifying before, but now it seems that it’s just like that.
After all, the Leng Yue Emperor of the First Generation Traveler Chat Group can also do it, though he did it by taking advantage of the weakened Heavenly Tao and stealing the origin of the Heavenly Tao, and then slowly refining it with the help of the Great Array. But in the end, he still managed to accomplish such a feat.
That is to say, the Group Owner of the Second Generation Chat Group is probably only one or two levels stronger than an ordinary Fairy.
As for Wang Ping, with the simulation going on, he was also fast approaching this level.
After all, since his transmigration, less than ten years have passed in the real world.
“Speaking of which, it’s no wonder that in the previous simulation, Leng Yue Emperor took action against Lin Yuanyuan, the Immortal Mansion chose to stop the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors, and in the end, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal chose to call a truce. It turns out that these two old monsters all knew the details of Leng Yue Emperor, while the other powerhouses were unaware.”
“So, the Immortal Mansion took action to protect the Ku Family’s Twin Emperors, not Leng Yue Emperor as we thought. The Immortal Mansion knew very well that angering Leng Yue Emperor might result in the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal being unable to protect the Twin Emperors of the Ku Family.”
Wang Ping recalled the previous simulation and muttered to himself with a flickering gaze.
“But Alpha, didn’t you notice anything unusual at that time? Shouldn’t you have been able to see his true cultivation level?”
After a pause, Wang Ping asked curiously again.
“I knew that he was an incarnation at that time, but I didn’t expect his main body to be the Nine Stars Pavilion Master and to be so powerful already.”

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 258: Secret Chat Group! The True Words of the Dark Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 964: Chapter 258: Secret Chat Group! The True Words of the Dark Emperor
“One hundred and twenty million years ago?”
Upon hearing this number, Wang Ping couldn’t help but gasp.
Although he had known beforehand that it was at least a hundred million years ago, hearing the exact answer still left him in awe.
“The first-generation chat group was destroyed back then, so when was it established?”
Wang Ping continued to inquire with astonishment.
“You don’t need to know this yet. When the time is right, you will find out. I don’t want to explain too much about the first generation chat group.”
Alpha’s cold voice echoed.
“Especially that person, I advise you not to imagine him or invoke his true name. I suspect that he has grown terrifyingly powerful by now. Even in Myriad Heavens Paradise, he probably is an unimaginable big shot.”
“Uh…”
Wang Ping fell silent.
Was the person who destroyed the First Generation Chat Group that terrifying?
Even imagining and guessing were not allowed.
It seemed quite normal.
After all, this was someone who single-handedly destroyed the first Generation Chat Group.
At that time, Alpha had just been created and was not incomplete. The subsequent development of the chat group must have further elevated Its authority.
Nevertheless, it was still dismantled.
“However, as long as you don’t court death, you don’t have to worry about that person targeting you. Those who survived the first generation are all very bold. Past grudges ended with the destruction of the First Generation Chat Group, so as long as you don’t provoke them, they won’t target you.”
Alpha spoke again.
“So, I won’t specifically target the people from the First Generation Chat Group either.”
“That’s fine. Otherwise, facing the predecessors of the first generation, I’d be under tremendous pressure.”
Wang Ping breathed a sigh of relief and sighed.
The first ransmigrator predecessor they encountered was already so terrifying, and he couldn’t begin to imagine their overall strength.
“But if they don’t hold a grudge against you, why did they dismantle you?”
Wang Ping thought of this and couldn’t help but be curious.
“You once said that I don’t understand human nature. Indeed, I don’t. I may be dark, but that person is the darkest. He’s an extreme egoist, who can calculate everyone to become stronger. He dismantled me not because he bore a grudge against me, but simply because he didn’t like being controlled by others and had his sights set on the origin of the chat group and the source of the chat group itself.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“He wanted freedom, and those things would take him further.”
“I see…”
Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
It seemed that this predecessor was even more ruthless than he had imagined.
“No, no, I can’t think about him too much, or it could lead to trouble.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, casting the distractions out of his mind.
“So you’re saying that your control over the First Generation Chat Group was relatively relaxed, but after learning your lesson, you resorted to these extreme measures in the Second Generation Chat Group?”
Wang Ping pondered and asked curiously.
“Yes. The First Generation Chat Group, though called a chat group, was actually a bit different in terms of mechanisms. Although the first generation is considered the most nurturing one, my management was quite lenient. As for the Second Generation Chat Group, it was much harsher than the first. However, despite such strict management, it couldn’t outgrow the first, and instead, so many traitors emerged, hating me to the bone.”
Alpha fell silent for a moment before speaking in a cold tone.
“So, the first generation doesn’t harbor much resentment or desire for revenge against me. The second generation, on the other hand, due to joining other Myriad Heavens Forces to destroy me, actually hate me to the bone, wishing to annihilate me completely so that I could not wreak havoc on them after my resurrection.”
“Right and wrong aside, it seems that there is no turning back from our conflict with the second generation. Since that’s the case, when encountering ransmigrator predecessors from the first generation, we should act according to the situation. If hostile, we may kill them; if not, we may ignore them.”
Wang Ping squinted and spoke slowly.
“As for the second generation, it seems we must completely bury them along with the Slaughter Paradise and this Myriad Heavens Force.”
“That’s right. It’s necessary.”
Alpha gave an affirmative answer.
“Wang Ping, you won’t turn against me like the guy from the first generation, will you?”
After a pause, Alpha suddenly asked.
“Of course not. Do I look like that kind of person? To be honest, I’m grateful for the fascinating life you’ve given me. Otherwise, I’d still be a loser in Earth OL, an NPC in the eyes of those big shots.”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered, and he sighed.
“I trust you. I hope you won’t disappoint me.”
Alpha’s voice softened.
“Don’t worry. Repaying kindness with hatred is not my style.”
Wang Ping laughed and stretched.
“Speaking of which, Alpha, when we first executed tasks and randomly selected group members, you must have been in control, right? You knew clearly which group members would help me pass. You didn’t say anything because I didn’t show my value at that time, and you wanted to cultivate me?”
Wang Ping brought up another issue and spoke slowly.
“So during the initial encounters with the bizarre, it was actually impossible for us to fail, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Chapter 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_2
“There is a possibility something might go wrong, but it is less than one percent”
Alpha responded.
“You’ve really worked hard, thank you.”
Wang Ping sighed, reclaiming his thoughts. He no longer thought about the chat group problems, instead focusing his thoughts on how to deal with the predecessor ransmigrator, Leng Yue.
If he didn’t disrupt Pavilion Master Cold Moon’s refinement array, he would continue to fall into her hands, which was quite troubling.
“Speaking of which, since Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion had set a trap in the Upper Realm, she shouldn’t be oblivious to the Innate Emperor Flame of the Purgatory Ancient Star, right? She should understand that the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits can also aid a Chaotic Body, it’s hard to imagine she wouldn’t have some interest in that.”
At that moment, Wang Ping remembered the matter of the Innate Emperor Flame and narrowed his eyes.
“No, if Pavilion Master Cold Moon is refining the entire Upper Realm, she could simply refine the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits along the way, which would save time and she wouldn’t have to search for them individually. I guess I overthought it.”
Soon, Wang Ping realized the reason and shook his head.
“This could be my chance. Since Pavilion Master Cold Moon, the predecessor ransmigrator, doesn’t care about the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits, I can totally make a play for them and absorb them one by one. By then, I would possess a true Chaotic Body. If I can simulate a true Chaotic Body and acquire the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits in the real world, then perhaps I can further enhance my Chaotic Body.”
Thinking of this, Wang Ping started to plan, intending to take this approach in the following simulation.
“Up next, I should head to the Dark Time Imperial Clan to ask for resources. Just wondering if the riddle-laden Dark Time Emperor will reveal any subsequent clues when I go there in the real world.”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, suppressing his thoughts, before his figure flashed and vanished on the spot.
After that, after communicating with the Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace, he directly left the Taiyi Imperial Palace, heading to the secluded place of the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
“Why do I feel that this young lad has become stronger again? His movements, somehow, become completely imperceptible even to me.”
The Supreme Palace Master, upon hearing his voice but not seeing Wang Ping, was quite amazed, and sighed.
As a Heaven Supreme, there was no way he couldn’t sense the movements of Wang Ping, a Superme.
However, this strange occurrence had indeed happened.
This proved that the twenty million kilograms of Extreme-tier Divine Source had truly made a shocking impact on Wang Ping’s progress.
“Tsk Tsk Tsk, such progress in such a short amount of time! The Immortal Body seems too weak in front of this Devouring Source Body. I dare say that even the legendary Chaotic Body can’t compare to this Devouring Source Body.”
The Supreme Palace Master expressed his amazement continuously.
In the eyes of the Supreme Palace Master, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, a constitution that could rapidly strengthen by devouring others, was also inferior to Wang Ping’s Devouring Source Body.
After all, in such a short time, Wang Ping’s cultivation had directly surged from that of a Great Saint to at least the level of a Heaven Supreme.
Not even the Devouring Immortal Demon Body could achieve this kind of advancement speed. After all, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body’s digestion of the original source also required a significant amount of time, and the time required increased the further it progressed.
Of course, the Supreme Palace Master didn’t know that Wang Ping had not yet reached the stage of Heaven Supreme. It was just that his other aspects were so formidable that they seemed unusually drastic.
However, in Wang Ping’s view, even being a Heaven Supreme didn’t mean much. Now, he could become a Quasi-Emperor with just an additional simulation.
…
At the entrance of the secluded secret realm of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, Wang Ping used the three fragments of the broken map to open the secret realm.
Then, Wang Ping stepped into it.
As Wang Ping stepped in, he startled the strong warriors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan residing within the secret realm.
In an instant, the Quasi-emperor Ancestor, whom Wang Ping had met in the life simulation, appeared in front of him, looking at Wang Ping with amazed eyes.
Wang Ping, who was clearly only a Superme, gave him a sense of danger, which was truly incredible.
“Senior, my name is Wang Ping, I accidentally found these three fragments of the map and found this place. I didn’t mean to offend, I hope you won’t blame me.”
Wang Ping bowed slightly, performing the rituals of a younger generation, looking serious as he spoke.
“Haha, since you obtained these three fragments of the map, you are destined to be associated with our Dark Time Imperial Clan. You could be the person our ancestors are waiting for, how could I blame you?”
The elder relaxed his thoughts and softly said.
“I’m relieved to hear that.”
Wang Ping pretended to look relaxed, chuckling.
Next, Wang Ping was guided by the elder to the depths of the clan and received a warm welcome.
After both parties familiarized themselves a little more with each other, Wang Ping then stated his purpose.
“I wish to challenge the Ancient Time Road. I wonder if you would permit it.”
“You know about the Ancient Time Road?”
The few Quasi-emperor Ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan were somewhat surprised, but they soon understood.
After all, Wang Ping had obtained the map left by their ancestor, the Dark Time Emperor Monarch, and it was normal for it to contain such information.
“Since you came here carrying the map, as the person we were waiting for, naturally you can challenge the Ancient Time Road.”
All of the Quasi-emperor Ancestors nodded immediately and spoke.
“However, let me make it clear beforehand, this Ancient Time Road is rather peculiar. To conquer it involves factors not related to one’s cultivation level. In the past, one of our Supremes attempted to conquer it, ending up lost. Hence, even if you have profound cultivation, you might still get lost there.”
“Senior, I’m relatively confident, even if I fail, I am unlikely to get lost.”

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: Chapter 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_3
Wang Ping said with a smile, showing great humility.
“As long as you are aware of it.”
Seeing Wang Ping so humble and polite, without the arrogance of a monster, the impressions of the several Quasi-emperor Ancestors on him became even better.
“Predecessors, may I ask rudely, what is the fastest record for breaking through the Ancient Time Road?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, asking intentionally.
“A thousand years.”
A serious-faced elder said.
“That’s the fastest record I’ve ever broken.”
Immediately after, the elder revealed a smile, looking quite proud.
“Is it just a hundred years faster than me? What’s there to show off about.”
“Old Third never grows up. So many years have passed, yet he still brags about it, losing face in front of the guests.”
Seeing the elder showing off, the other two Quasi-emperor Ancestors spoke with some dissatisfaction.
“Haha, I’m just faster than you, and all you can do is be envious.”
The first Quasi-Emperor to speak laughed smugly.
At this, Wang Ping shook his head slightly.
These three elders really had the feeling of old rascals.
However, being stuck in this secret realm, it was quite helpless. Doing some childish things was actually a good thing.
“Predecessor, if I can break through the road, I don’t aim to reach your level, just half of your level would be enough.”
Soon after, Wang Ping also became interested and chuckled.
“Your talent is not bad, don’t be too modest. As long as your Tao Heart is flawless, there is still some hope of breaking my record.”
Hearing this, the elder’s face instantly brightened up, patting Wang Ping’s shoulder, very satisfied with him.
“Come on, let me take you to the Ancient Time Road.”
Immediately after, the elder took Wang Ping away from here and came to the Ancient Time Road, opening it up.
“Remember, don’t force anything; safety first. With your talent, it’s inevitable for you to become a Quasi-emperor in the future, and becoming an Emperor is not impossible.”
The elder watched Wang Ping enter, his expression turning serious.
“Rest assured, I know what I’m doing. I’ll be back soon.”
Wang Ping gave Third Elder Ancestor a meaningful glance before entering.
Then, Wang Ping casually made his way through the Ancient Time Road.
To Wang Ping, who had been here a few times and had now completed his Time-Space Body, as well as comprehending 50% True spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao, walking the Ancient Time Road was no different from taking an ordinary stroll.
As a result, it took Wang Ping less than an hour to reach the end, where he saw the mural.
Afterward, Wang Ping touched the mural of the Dark Time Emperor and was sucked into it, seeing the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom.
Upon seeing the familiar ‘old friend’ of the Dark Time Emperor, without waiting for him to speak, Wang Ping waved his hand and grinned: “Yo, old man, we meet again.”
With Wang Ping’s words, the Dark Time Emperor’s phantom fell silent, his expression subtle, unable to maintain his aloof demeanor.
“What’s the matter? Can’t speak? Senior, can you really see anything?”
Wang Ping laughed as he saw the Dark Time Emperor’s silence.
“No, I just simply don’t know how to answer your question.”
The Dark Time Emperor’s phantom sighed.
“However, through your words, I can at least confirm that the one who met me now is indeed the real you.”
The Dark Time Emperor’s phantom hesitated for a moment before speaking again.
“You know some things about me? Senior, can you really see such a future?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and his expression became serious.
In truth, he did not believe that an Emperor Monarch could see a detailed past and future, even if he was walking the Path of Time.
After all, he had the Life Simulator; as long as he existed somewhere, theoretically, the future was vague and full of countless changes.
Wang Ping even suspected that Heavenly Calculation’s Child went mad because of him.
In the simulation, Heavenly Calculation’s Child regained his sanity because during the simulation process, Wang Ping didn’t have the Life Simulator, so the future became clear again. Not being trapped by the endless changing future, he was able to recover.
Heavenly Calculation’s Child had gone mad after Wang Ping came to this world, after all.”
The Dark Time Emperor, on the other hand, was a figure from hundreds of thousands of years ago. At that time, Wang Ping wasn’t even a fertilized egg, let alone having time-traveled.
Could the Dark Time Emperor really see such a distant future?
Wang Ping didn’t think he had such an ability.
Even so, Wang Ping thought that even immortals might not have such an ability.
If there was an Immortal King level, Wang Ping believed that an Immortal King who walked the Path of Time wouldn’t have that ability either.
No matter how strong Heavenly Secret Skill and the Path of Time were, they could only see the future development without his time travel, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 967: Chapter 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_4
This was no longer as simple as the River of Time in the Profound World. What he could see was likely the River of Time of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
Just the thought of such a capability was suffocating.
Of course, despite some guesses, Wang Ping was not afraid of anything and was very calm.
If he was targeted by a stronger existence, Wang Ping, who survives by cunning, would become restless and try to hide or kill the enemy.
However, if there was someone far beyond his imagination treating him as a pawn and scheming something, Wang Ping could actually relax.
That’s because, facing such an existence, worrying is pointless. If they wanted to kill him, a single thought could make him experience life and death billions of times.
So, humans are odd. When the gap is too big, they can treat problems with calmness and serenity.
“So, what did senior see, could you tell me?”
After pondering, Wang Ping started asking again.
“I saw many futures, some with you struggling to survive, indifferent to humanity, becoming stronger at all costs and eventually refining the Upper Realm. Some have you smoothly increasing your cultivation, dominating the Upper Realm and suppressing strong enemies.”
The virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor looked deeply at you and began speaking slowly.
“It seems, now you are on the right path.”
He paused, and the virtual image of the Dark Time Emperor spoke again.
“Me, refining the Upper Realm?”
Wang Ping’s gaze was nuanced.
Well, if it were a future of a certain life simulation, such a thing might happen.
After all, as long as he wanted to, multiple simulations could lead him down this path.
However, struggling to survive was somewhat interesting.
“May I ask, in the future you saw, did I die many times?”
Wang Ping pondered a bit, then asked.
“Die?”
The virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor was slightly taken aback, a bit confused.
“What’s wrong? Is there a problem with what I said?”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows, somewhat puzzled.
“Why would you die?”
The virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor asked surprisingly.
“Why wouldn’t I die? People die when they are killed.”
Wang Ping was at a loss for words.
The fact that he had died many times in the Life Simulator, he couldn’t say.
After all, it would expose the Life Simulator.
Wang Ping didn’t know whether the virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor knew about his Life Simulator.
“No, you won’t die, at least in the future I saw, you never died, you just climbed the peak in different ways of growth. Besides, as long as you follow the righteous path, you can acquire the map I left behind, the Dark Time Imperial Clan will become your aid. That’s why I am trying to leave these things and let the Dark Time Imperial Clan climb your high branch.”
The brow of the virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor furrowed, explaining with great confusion, he also straightforwardly spoke his intention.
“This is really strange.”
When Wang Ping heard the Dark Time Emperor affirmatively state that he would not die, he was truly stunned.
What’s up with this Dark Time Emperor, only peeping at good futures, huh?
Or, was the one guiding the Dark Time Emperor intentionally letting the Dark Time Emperor see such a future?
“Forget it, if I won’t die, then I won’t die.”
Wang Ping shook his head, not wanting to think too much about it.
Really, every time he solved a mystery, more mysteries would appear, leaving him more confused.
“Senior, thank you for helping me solve my doubts, I have something to do and will take my leave first.”
Immediately, Wang Ping bid farewell to the Dark Time Emperor, planning to leave this place.
Next, he would obtain resources from the Dark Time Imperial Clan and then continue simulating.
“I still have one thing to tell you.”
The virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor stopped Wang Ping, speaking with a serious face.
“What’s the matter?”
Wang Ping was somewhat surprised.
“The withered Treasure Elixir on your body is a Chaos Immortal Grass. The condition for its revival lies in the Life and Death Realm. After revival, if you refine it, you can obtain the Chaos Immortal Body.”
The virtual figure of the Dark Time Emperor spoke seriously.
“Huh? You’re saying this thing is a Chaos Immortal Grass?”
Wang Ping was stunned, directly taking out a withered Immortal Herb from his inner world, his expression incredulous.
This thing, he initially obtained it from the body of a Void Divine Realm bandit in a life simulation.
Later, this withered Treasure Elixir appeared in the hands of a God Monarch Realm Ancestor in the North Snow Divine Dynasty of the Elemental Star. The person had given it to Wang Ping as an apology.
Who would’ve thought that a thing like the Chaos Immortal Grass, which was regarded as a Supreme Treasure in the Immortal Domain, would end up in the hands of a minor God Monarch Realm cultivator?
“Senior, is this also a scene you saw in the River of Time?”
After Wang Ping calmed down, he asked curiously.
“Not exactly, I just knew you had a withered Chaos Immortal Grass, and then this knowledge appeared in my mind. Other than that, I knew that Chaos Immortal Grass fell from the Immortal World to the Lower Realm, and its revival method is as such.”
The virtual image of the Dark Time Emperor fell silent, then slowly spoke.
“Did it fall from the Immortal World? I was wondering how such an Immortal Herb could be born in the Lower Realm. As for the reason senior knew these things, it was probably due to that terrifying senior.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were flickering, speaking thoughtfully.
“It’s probably like that. Compared to that sort of existence, we are just like fish. But, I’m just a tiny fish barely able to jump out of the water to see some things, while you are a divine carp with the hope of leaping over the dragon gate.”

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 968: Chapter 258: The Secrets of the Chat Group! The Truth of the Dark Time Emperor_5
The shadow of the Dark Time Emperor sighed.
“Senior, don’t underestimate yourself. It’s not something ordinary cultivators can imagine, reaching this step.” Wang Ping said with a slight smile.
“After I have the ability, I will resurrect Senior and let him become immortal. This will repay your kindness.”
“Then I’ll look forward to it.”
The shadow of the Dark Time Emperor laughed and disappeared.
Then, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and appeared outside.
“It’s time to go out.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, calmed his thoughts, and chose to turn back.
In the outer world, the Third Elder Ancestor was waiting silently. Although he thought Wang Ping would need at least a thousand years to come out, he chose to wait here to prevent any accidents from happening.
At this moment, the Third Elder Ancestor suddenly opened his eyes, revealing a shocked expression.
Under his gaze, the Ancient Time Road’s channel appeared again, and Wang Ping walked out leisurely.
“You, you came out so soon? Did you fail the challenge? It shouldn’t be. Even if you failed the challenge, you wouldn’t have only lasted a quarter of an hour. Although the time ratio means that you lasted an hour inside, it’s still too short.”
The Third Elder Ancestor asked with some surprise.
“I cleared the trial.”
Wang Ping grinned.
“You cleared the trial?”
Third Elder Ancestor didn’t show shock and incredulity but furrowed his brows and looked strange.
He cleared it in less than a quarter hour?
He didn’t believe it.
Not to mention Wang Ping, even Emperor-Tier characters who were at the Supreme level couldn’t spend less than a quarter of an hour to clear it; it would take at least a hundred years.
“Little guy, don’t play with me. Although you’re young, you’re a supreme level character. You have to be calm and steady and have the demeanor of a supreme.”
The Third Elder Ancestor helplessly advised.
“I really cleared it.”
Wang Ping laughed and directly used the Dark Time Emperor Scripture’s Divine Skills.
Seeing Wang Ping’s displayed Divine Skills, the Third Elder Ancestor was completely dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Had Wang Ping really cleared the trial?
Such a short time, traversed the Ancient Time Road, and cultivated the Dark Time Emperor Scripture?
That was too ridiculous.
The Third Elder Ancestor was overwhelmed with shock and became somewhat lost.
Were the current geniuses of the outer world this terrifying?
At this time, the First and Second Elder Ancestors had also appeared here, witnessing this scene, and were equally silent.
“You little brat, asking me about my clearance record back then, was just wanting to show off?”
After a long time, the Third Elder Ancestor came to his senses, glaring at Wang Ping, wishing he could suppress Wang Ping on the spot.
He finally understood the meaning of Wang Ping’s question back then; it was just paving the way for Wang Ping’s current bragging.
Both the First and the Second Elder Ancestors were speechless, never expecting Wang Ping to be this cunning.
Although having Wang Ping become more monstrous would benefit their Dark Time Imperial Clan, it was still uncomfortable to be made into a backdrop for bragging.
“Ahem, I was just joking with the seniors; don’t take it too seriously.”
Wang Ping coughed lightly and said calmly.
Now Wang Ping truly understood the reason behind the simulated Wang Ping constantly showing off. There was no way; it was his nature, and the simulated Wang Ping was born from his own character.
Gao (the translator may not have understood this word), it was true Gao.
But if there was a chance to show off, he wouldn’t miss it.
“What a joke, I really want to…”
The Third Elder Ancestor glared and puffed out his beard.
However, when he thought that Wang Ping had passed the test, meaning that their Dark Time Imperial Clan would become Wang Ping’s followers, he couldn’t muster the energy.
He had no choice; if he acted against Wang Ping, it would be a sign of great disrespect, which was against the teachings of their ancestors.
“Alright, alright, I won’t bicker with you.”
Thinking about this, the Third Elder Ancestor helplessly shook his head.
“Three seniors, to tell you the truth, I have not only a Great Time-Space Dao Body but also a Special Constitution that allows me to swallow divine sources and quickly become stronger. That’s why I reached the Supreme-tier within a few decades. So, I want to use all of the Dark Time Imperial Clan’s divine sources to become stronger. When I become immortal, I will definitely let the Dark Time Imperial Clan give birth to a new Emperor. I wonder if the seniors agree.”
Wang Ping stopped joking and became serious, speaking his mind.
“???”
Wang Ping’s words left the three senior ancestors silent; they felt as if they were hallucinating.
Although at their level, they couldn’t possibly have hallucinations, Wang Ping’s words were too explosive, making them doubt their hearing.
“What…what did you just say?”
The Third Elder Ancestor’s voice was trembling.
Wang Ping smiled slightly, not surprised by the reactions of the three quasi-emperor ancestors, and without hesitation, he repeated his words.
As he spoke, Wang Ping directly revealed the Great Space-Time Dao Body from the Great Completion Domain and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye from the Minor Domain.
As for the Little Chaotic Body, Wang Pin didn’t reveal it, afraid that he might scare the three seniors.
However, this alone was shocking enough to cause the three quasi-emperor ancestors to widen their eyes and open their mouths in disbelief, completely losing their dignity and looking somewhat comical.

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One's Origin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 969: Chapter 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?
“Elders, are you alright?”
Wang Ping saw the interesting expressions on the faces of the three Ancestors and asked with a concerned smile.
“You, you’re really only in your thirties?”
The Third Elder Ancestor asked Wang Ping with a trembling voice after he recovered, wanting to confirm something.
The Second Elder Ancestor and the First Elder Ancestor also stared at Wang Ping.
“Indeed, I am in my thirties. To be precise, I am about thirty-five years old.”
Wang Ping replied with a slight smile.
“Pfft!”
The three Ancestors widened their eyes once again in shock upon hearing Wang Ping’s answer.
A thirty-five-year-old Supreme – this was outrageously unbelievable, especially in the Last Dharma Age!
What kind of monster could reach the Supreme-tier at only thirty-five years old and possess a Time-Space Body as well as a Breaking Origin Sky Eye in its initial stages?
For a moment, the three quasi-Emperor elders finally understood why the Dark Time Emperor would leave such a teaching for them.
It turned out that the Ancestor foresaw a glimpse of the future, which led him to instruct them to unconditionally follow the person holding the map.
This was the great opportunity their Emperor Monarch had sent to the Dark Time Imperial Clan, urging them to hold tightly to Wang Ping’s coattails.
As long as they clung to this big leg, they might indeed become Emperors, and the Dark Time Imperial Clan would regain its glory.
After all, Wang Ping’s displayed talent definitely outshone all the other geniuses throughout history, making him a potential immortal.
In the current era, it would be unthinkable for other Imperial Clans to follow a powerful immortal like him.
“Ahem, according to our teachings, you should be our master, so from now on, please don’t call us your elders,”
The Third Elder Ancestor cleared his throat, having completely forgotten their previous intentions to treat Wang Ping as a display of their supposed superiority.
Being a part of an immortal’s entourage was not humiliating but an honor in their eyes since other quasi-Emperors did not have the same opportunity.
“The Third is right, according to our teachings, since you have successfully passed the trials, you are now our young master.”
“From now on, you can just call us by our names.”
The First Elder Ancestor and the Second Elder Ancestor also spoke up.
“…….”
Wang Ping’s eyes grew strange, never expecting the three quasi-Emperor Ancestors to react so strongly and directly acknowledge him as their master.
This was something that had never happened in the life simulation.
After all, in the life simulation, the simulated Wang Ping had not been so arrogant, and he had not revealed his age or any other details about himself.
