Thus, in the simulation, the three Ancestors basically followed the teachings and were impressed with Wang Ping’s ability to pass the Ancient Time Road in such a short time. They treated him with respect, but not to this extent.
“It seems that one should indeed show off when one has the chance, as it can also bring benefits to oneself,” Wang Ping thought to himself.
“About the divine source issue…”
Wang Ping then looked at the Third Elder Ancestor and started speaking slowly.
“We, the Dark Time Imperial Clan, currently have 80 million jin of top-grade Divine Source stored. You can take it all if you want.”
The Third Elder Ancestor laughed heartily and said generously.
“80 million jin of top-grade Divine Source.”
Wang Ping’s eyes became strange.
In the previous simulation, the three quasi-Emperor Ancestors had mentioned 50 million jin, but now it had become 80 million jin.
Apparently, the Ancestors had concealed some things and had personal motives in the life simulation.
After all, they were still human, and although they could not defy the teachings, the simulated Wang Ping didn’t reveal everything about himself, so they couldn’t fully trust him. They needed to cultivate, as would their descendants.
Therefore, it was understandable that they would keep some things in reserve.
Now that Wang Ping had flaunted his abilities in front of the three Ancestors, they no longer had any reservations and offered all the top-grade Divine Source that the Dark Time Imperial Clan possessed.
“Is 80 million jin of top-grade Divine Source not enough?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s strange gaze, the three quasi-Emperor Ancestors were quite surprised.
“If you think it’s not enough, we three old fellows can take action and rob… ahem, I mean look for some divine source in certain ancient lands.”
The First Elder Ancestor then slowly spoke, but halfway through, he realized he had let something slip and quickly corrected himself without changing his expression.
“…….”
Wang Ping looked at the First Elder Ancestor with an odd expression.
Who would have thought that the seemingly gentle First Elder Ancestor would be so fierce, wanting to resort to robbery?
It seemed that Wang Ping had given these three quasi-Emperor Ancestors such a significant shock, making them somewhat lose themselves.
This was truly a pity, a pity indeed.
“It’s not urgent right now. The current resources will be sufficient for the time being,” Wang Ping said after shaking his head in an attempt to prevent the First Elder Ancestor’s reckless move.
“Temporarily sufficient is not enough. We must be prepared for the uncertain future. Some forces we have grudges with, and others owe us something, so we should settle the score now.”
The First Elder Ancestor said with a solemn face.
“Come to think of it, it’s been a long time since we’ve actually done anything. It’s just as well to stretch our muscles a bit.”
The Second Elder Ancestor and the Third Elder Ancestor also chuckled.
Upon hearing their words, Wang Ping felt somewhat speechless.
It turned out they just wanted to find something to do.
Initially, Wang Ping had believed that the three Ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan were relatively gentle and well-behaved. However, it seemed that none of them were truly content staying inactive, given their status as quasi-Emperors.

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One's Origin?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 970: Chapter 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_2
These three ancestors had been staying in the Dark Time Imperial Clan for a long time and were obviously feeling stifled. They had been wanting to go out for a breather for some time.
So now, they were going to look for resources for Wang Ping, but they were also just trying to find an excuse to take a stroll.
As expected, one should just listen to the words of old monsters; there is a high probability that they have other hidden intentions.
“In that case, I won’t stop you, seniors. I wish for your triumphant return.”
Immediately, Wang Ping smiled and spoke.
Although the three quasi-emperor ancestors had told Wang Ping not to call them seniors anymore, he didn’t know if they were just being polite or what, so he still called them seniors.
Anyway, it was just a simple matter of saying a few nice words which, without costing him anything, could increase others’ affection for him. Why not do it?
Seeing Wang Ping still referring to the three of them as seniors, the other ancestors were quite happy, making their gazes toward him even more amicable.
“Haha, thank you for your blessings, young master!”
All three ancestors smiled. Then they took out 80 million extreme-tier divine sources from their clan collection and gave it to Wang Ping.
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up on receiving so many divine sources at once, and he was very happy.
With so many divine sources, he could have multiple simulation chances.
After giving Wang Ping the divine sources, the three ancestors said a few words to the clan members and then left the secret realm one after another without saying where they were going to.
They were not worried about anyone attacking this secret realm.
That’s because the secret realm was created by their ancestor, the Dark Time Emperor Monarch, and it was protected by a terrifying Great Array. Unless a Great Emperor took action personally, it was absolutely impossible to breach the realm.
Even an ordinary emperor wouldn’t be able to break through this realm in an instant.
As long as it couldn’t be broken within a short period of time, the backup plan in the secret realm would be activated, and the clan members would be transferred to a safe place.
Therefore, it wasn’t important whether they stayed in the clan’s homeland, allowing the three of them to go out ‘looking’ for resources together.
When the three ancestors left, Wang Ping thought for a while and decided not to leave the secret realm just yet. Instead, he wanted to try a simulation first.
…
In the closed-door training room, Wang Ping let out a soft breath and then slowly said in his heart, “System, I want to start a paid simulation.”
“Ding, Consuming 5 million pounds of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh successful. Congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing into Red Talent – Moon Drinking.”
Red Talent – Moon Drinking: Drinking with the moon can help you enter a strange state. It provides a tiny bit of help to your current cultivation.
“Well, well, has the unluckiness started again? This time only one red talent was refreshed. Moreover, this description is really outrageous. A tiny bit of help sounds like nothing.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, looking at the refreshed talent.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation starting.”
As Wang Ping lamented, the System’s voice rang again.
Then, Wang Ping’s consciousness faltered, and he entered the state of immersive simulation.
Immediately after, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words floated up.
[On the first day, you thought it over and chose to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Then, you chose the same path as last simulation: wanting to self-seal yourself until the Golden Age. In your view, if you could refresh the Little Chaotic Body’s Origin multiple times, it might be a way for it to transform.]
[Of course, before self-sealing this time, you still had some matters to deal with – obtaining the three Devouring Emperor Artifacts.]
[First, you went to the Eternal Ancient Star, shattered it, and obtained the Devouring Mana Pearl, making it acknowledge you as its master.]
[Then, you returned to the Elemental Star and watched Lin Yan’s growth trajectory. Finally, you saw Lin Yan obtain the Devouring Soul Pearl from a cliff.]
[After noting down the location, you chose to leave and didn’t have the intention to take away Lin Yan’s Devouring Soul Pearl. After all, Lin Yan was your disciple, and taking away a disciple’s chance was not a good idea.]
[Of course, if it were in the real world, it would be another matter. As long as Lin Yan hadn’t obtained the Devouring Soul Pearl, you wouldn’t feel guilty about taking it away first. In any case, you were going to cultivate Lin Yan well in the future, so you wouldn’t owe him anything.]
[However, something unexpected happened. You had no intention of taking away the Devouring Soul Pearl, but it didn’t want to recognize Lin Yan as its master and chose to fly towards you, acknowledging you as its master willingly.]
[Therefore, you didn’t continue searching for the Devouring Spirit Pearl in the Last Dharma Age. Instead, you brought Lin Yan and the others back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace and self-sealed yourself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 971: Chapter 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_3
[Soon, you entered the Golden Age, choosing to make a low-key debut. Then, at the right time, you found Zhu Huowang and took him as your disciple.]
[Without waiting for you to do much more, the Devouring Spirit Pearl eagerly flew to your side, circling around you. At this moment, you were full of emotions, never expecting that one day you would experience the feeling of Emperor’s artifacts presenting themselves one after another. Indeed, the feeling of being a Son of Fortune recognized by Heavenly Tao Daddy was truly wonderful.]
[Upon seeing the Devouring Spirit Pearl fly to you, Zhu Huowang was quite puzzled. However, he didn’t overthink it, only shamelessly stating that he was gifting it to his master and asked for some cultivation skills in return.]
[At this, you laughed and gave him the Emperor’s Scripture and resources, taking him back to Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Next, you began researching how to fuse the three Innate Emperor Artifacts into Immortal Artifacts. However, the merging of the three artifacts was just a legend, no one had ever seen it before, and you didn’t know the specific method, which gave you quite a headache.]
[Soon, it was time for the Immortal Mansion to open, and you continued to cripple your own cultivation, entering it to defeat everything in your path, waiting to mysteriously obtain the Little Chaotic Body.]
[However, something surprised you this time: the mysterious figure did not successfully acquire the Little Chaotic Body. He failed and was unable to condense it successfully.]
[This left you very puzzled, not understanding why the mysterious figure failed. After some thought, you suspected that in this world, only one Little Chaotic Body and Chaotic Body could be born, as they were unique physiques. Since you had already obtained one through the rewarded refresher, the mysterious figure could never succeed.]
[At this thought, you were quite disappointed. If you could infinitely refresh and obtain the source, it would be incredibly enjoyable.]
…
“It is indeed a pity. However, if the simulations of Wang Ping’s conjectures are correct, then to obtain the Chaotic Body, I can only kill Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator and the current Master of Nine Stars Pavilion. Otherwise, if he possesses the Chaotic Body, I won’t be able to obtain it.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, frowning with a slight headache.
It seemed that, whether for self-preservation or for obtaining the Chaotic Body, he had to confront Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator.
It wasn’t about enmity, but simple conflicts of interest.
Leng Yue blocked Wang’s path, so Leng Yue had to die.
If Leng Yue did not die, Wang Ping would not be able to achieve the Dao, obtain the Chaotic Body, let alone the Chaos Immortal Body.
“However, it’s worth being happy about that I’ve easily obtained the three Innate Emperor Artifacts. The way I obtained the Little Chaotic Body allowed me to gain the favor of Heavenly Tao. Now, in terms of luck, I must be higher than even a Son of Fortune like Ye Chen.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but smile as he thought of the three Devouring Emperor Artifacts.
He had always complained about luck issues, but now he was catching up.
“However, at this point in time, my luck in the Upper Realm is no longer important. After all, even the Upper Realm has been refined, and it won’t do any good to have stronger luck. It can’t change anything. In the end, I still have to rely on various simulations to break through the situation.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping shook his head and continued to watch the simulation.
[The mysterious figure did not obtain the Little Chaotic Body, and he was both shocked and furious, unable to accept this fact. However, no matter how furious the mysterious figure was, this was already an established fact and couldn’t be changed.]
[At this, you lost interest in continuing to watch and decided to suppress the mysterious figure, allowing Lin Yuanyuan to seize his power.]
[With the mysterious figure’s death, Ku Xuan gained his freedom, owing a great deal of gratitude to you and many others. At the same time, Ku Xuan’s attentions were drawn to Lin Yuanyuan again. Although she did not gain the Chaotic Body due to the mysterious figure’s failure, her ability to directly kill the mysterious figure and seize his power still moved Ku Xuan.]
[Unfortunately, Lin Yuanyuan was very arrogant in the face of Ku Xuan and didn’t pay him any attention. After all, in Lin Yuanyuan’s eyes, only Mr. Wang was the most reliable man, and no other man could compare.]
[Ku Xuan was snubbed by Lin Yuanyuan, appearing calm on the surface, but feeling rather frustrated. Seeing this scene, you couldn’t help but find it hilarious.]
[Afterward, following some time spent in the secret realm, the Immortal Mansion Strongman noticed the anomalies and brought you out.]
[Then, your fame spread throughout the Upper Realm, and once again, there were negotiations between the Upper Realm Powers and the Immortal Mansion. You didn’t care about this and chose to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace, using the Devouring Mana Pearl to devour prisoners of the Supreme Tier, allowing you to regain the Supreme Tier.]
[Next, you ventured on the Supreme Heavenly Path in Taiyi Emperor Tower, elevating your cultivation to the Peak of the Heavenly Supreme. Once settled, you used the Devouring Mana Pearl to consume the three Quasi-Emperors, pushing yourself to the Quasi-Emperor tier once more.]
[Upon reaching the Quasi-Emperor Realm, you shocked the Upper Realm. However, just like in the previous simulation, Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator and the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, began to refine the Upper Realm.]
[This time, you didn’t follow Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to the Time-Space Forbidden Zone but chose to trace back the past to learn the location of the Devouring Spirit Pearl a hundred thousand years ago.]
[It’s safe to say that your choice was extremely wise. Because when you broke through to the Quasi-Emperor level and used the Secret Skill to trace back, you were on the verge of death. If you had tried to trace back with your Supreme Cultivation to find the position of the Devouring Spirit Pearl a hundred thousand years ago, you would have definitely failed, unable to find its location and causing your own demise.]

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 972: Chapter 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_4
[The reason for this is that the causal connection of the Devouring Spirit Pearl is too great for someone like you, who is not at the Supreme-tier, to bear.]
[Eventually, you learned of the location of the Devouring Spirit Pearl 100,000 years ago and were shocked. Then, you were refined. Due to the Rebirth tally, you came back to life, and you were refined again.]
[Because of your fall, this simulation ends here.]
……
With the end of the Text Simulation, many insights and images appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, and in the end, his figure appeared at the place of his demise.
“I originally planned to attempt to refine the Innate Emperor Flame during this simulation and find the other Heavenly Tao Life, but I didn’t take a shot at the Innate Emperor Flame, and I didn’t know the whereabouts of the other Heavenly Tao Life either.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and sighed.
“However, it’s not without gain this time. I learned that the Little Chaotic Body and Chaotic Body are unique, and I also learned the location of the Devouring Spirit Pearl 100,000 years ago.”
“It’s just that the location where the Devouring Spirit Pearl was 100,000 years ago is a bit troublesome.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping recalled the information he had obtained and frowned.
It would be easy to obtain the Devouring Mana Pearl and the Devouring Soul Pearl in the real world.
But the Devouring Spirit Pearl is different… In the real world, at this point in time, the Devouring Spirit Pearl is located in the treasury of the Phoenix Clan.
The Phoenix Clan knew the value of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, but the pearl was too arrogant, and no one could make it recognize a master.
Thus, the Phoenix Clan had no choice but to seal it away in their treasury.
As for why the Devouring Spirit Pearl was scattered 100,000 years later, Wang Ping also knew the reason.
It turned out that the daughter of the Phoenix Clan leader fell in love with a male cultivator who deceived her.
This male cultivator accidentally found out that the Devouring Spirit Pearl was in the Phoenix Clan. In order to obtain the bloodline of the Phoenix Clan, and also the Devouring Spirit Pearl, he had the daughter of the Phoenix Clan leader steal the Devouring Spirit Pearl and then the two of them eloped.
However, he didn’t expect the Phoenix Clan to find out about this so quickly.
In the end, the leader of the Phoenix Clan was furious, and ordered the two to be hunted down.
As a result, this male cultivator abandoned the daughter of the Phoenix Clan leader, letting her threaten the Phoenix Clan masters with her life while he escaped with the Devouring Spirit Pearl.
However, the Phoenix Clan was not so easily provoked. Even though this male cultivator was very cunning, and his cultivation was extremely strong, reaching the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier.
Nevertheless, the masters of the Phoenix Clan caught him and seriously injured him.
Finally, this male cultivator fled into one of the Ten Forbidden Lands, the Fire Demon Ridge.
As for the Fire Demon Ridge, the Phoenix Clan didn’t want to enter, so they decided to give up the pursuit.
At the same time, the Phoenix Clan believed that this male cultivator entering a place like the Fire Demon Ridge was doomed to die anyway.
After all, even an Ordinary Emperor who entered this place was very likely to perish, let alone a severely injured Quasi-Emperor, who would undoubtedly die upon entering.
As it turned out, this male cultivator did indeed perish.
However, he did not perish in the Fire Demon Ridge. He was very fortunate to have escaped the Fire Demon Ridge.
Unfortunately, when he escaped from the Fire Demon Ridge, he had reached his limit and fell outside the Fire Demon Ridge, where he was burnt to ashes by the terrifying flames that wrapped around his body.
Eventually, the Devouring Spirit Pearl went through various hands and finally ended up in Zhu Huowang’s possession.
“Fire Demon Ridge, like Guimo Sea, is one of the Ten Forbidden Lands created by Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, a Predecessor Transmigrator, located within the Four Profound Small Universe. The best time for me to make a move is undoubtedly when that male cultivator calculates the Phoenix Clan and steals away the Devouring Spirit Pearl, fleeing towards the Fire Demon Ridge.”
Wang Ping’s eyes twinkled, and he muttered to himself.
“Otherwise, I’ll have to go to the Phoenix Clan and trade with them. In that case, I’m afraid that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would have to step in. If it were just me, it definitely wouldn’t work, the Phoenix Clan wouldn’t give me that face.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping thought of something else and looked puzzled.
Speaking of which, this love-crazed woman named Huangqin wouldn’t happen to be the mother of Huang Yin and Huang Qing, would she?
If that’s the case, then it’s quite incredible.
A phoenix and a human interbred, resulting in a pair of Pure-blooded Phoenixes.
What is this, bloodline regression?
Besides, this might explain why Huang Yin and Huang Qing were not welcomed by the Phoenix Clan.
After all, they are the descendants of that wicked man who killed several Phoenix Clan Quasi-Emperor Ancestors.
Such bloodlines are born, and it’s already kind of the Phoenix Clan to not immediately destroy them.
Pure-blooded Phoenixes may be precious, but when it comes to a matter of principle, the larger the clan, the less tolerant they become.
That’s probably why Huang Yin and Huang Qing were adopted by Cyclops Quasi-Emperor and other prestigious Quasi-Emperors.
Of course, it’s also possible that Huangqin, the woman, found out that she was pregnant after her infatuated Dao companion died and fled from the Phoenix Clan.
Otherwise, these two children wouldn’t even have a chance to be born.
“Ah, I’ve started to imagine things again. Just a little bit of information, and I’m speculating so many things.”
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping shook his head, feeling that his old problem had relapsed.
At this time, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and his vision changed, appearing in the real world.
Then, the system’s voice also sounded timely.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①.1st-tier Quasi-Emperor Cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 973: Chapter 259: The Sixth Seven-Color Gift! The Mystery of One’s Origin?_5
②. A random Quasi-Emperor Artifact.
③. Crimson Talent – Toasting the Moon.
④. A Life-bound Supreme Device.”
…
Wang Ping looked at the reward list, frowning slightly, feeling a bit conflicted.
This time, a cultivation talent was finally refreshed, but whether or not to choose it was an issue.
After all, if he chose it, the cost of his paid simulation would skyrocket to a headache-inducing level.
“However, I can’t not choose it. I seem to be stuck right now.”
Wang Ping sighed again.
This simulation didn’t have much new plot, and he was just treading old ground.
Now, it seemed, it was time to improve his cultivation and combat capability, trigger new stories, and attempt to break the deadlock.
“Once my cultivation reaches the Quasi-Emperor tier, I can protect the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit in the Immortal Tower Secret Realm. At that time, I can become stronger again.”
“Not to mention, there are so many Quasi-Emperors, what a great excuse to slay them all! As long as I kill them all and devour them with my three Devouring Emperor Treasures, my strength will skyrocket. What could be more thrilling than that?”
Wang Ping’s eyes grew brighter and brighter, looking forward to the upcoming developments.
“However, it seems like I don’t necessarily need to choose cultivation talents, as it would be a loss. After all, if I didn’t greedily pursue the strange origin of the Little Chaotic Body, I wouldn’t have to wait for the Golden Age to make a breakthrough and then be refined.”
“That is to say, I can completely break through the Supreme Heavenly Path in the Last Dharma Age, swiftly advance to the Quasi-Emperor tier with the help of the Devouring Mana Pearl, and then activate the Immortal Tower Secret Realm to rise quickly. Then, when the simulation ends, I can choose the cultivation talent and become fat in one swoop!”
Wang Ping’s mind stirred and he gave up on the cultivation talent this time.
Then, Wang Ping looked at the other reward options and sighed.
There really wasn’t much to choose from.
He wasn’t interested in the Quasi-Emperor artifacts.
As for his own Life-bound Supreme Device, it was even more out of sync.
Nevertheless, among the rewards, these two were the best; the Crimson Talent – Toasting the Moon was even more rubbish.
“System, I choose ②. One random Quasi-Emperor Artifact and ④. A Life-bound Supreme Device.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke in his mind.
“Ding, reward selection successful, distributing.”
The system’s voice sounded again.
Then, a Quasi-Emperor Artifact and a Life-bound Supreme Device appeared in Wang Ping’s Life Realm.
“Next, System, continue the simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes gleamed as he spoke in his mind.
“Ding, consuming five million pounds of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator is starting, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations host for successfully refreshing the Seven-Color Talent – God of Escaping and Crimson Talent – Drunken Ghost.”
Seven-Color Talent – God of Escaping: With this talent, the host can randomly teleport when in danger. The teleportation range is not limited to this world but can also escape to other worlds. At the same time, once this talent is activated, even Great Emperors cannot stop it.
Crimson Talent – Drunken Ghost: With this talent, once the host becomes drunk, their combat power will be slightly increased.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping was quite surprised to see the talents refreshed this time.
He had always wanted a Seven-color escape talent, but he never refreshed one until now.
Moreover, this Seven-color talent – God of Escaping was more complicated than the Golden Talent: Transmission it allowed Wang Ping to teleport to other worlds.
Although it was impossible for these worlds to be outside the Profound World, but it was enough to be considered very powerful.
This also meant that Wang Ping no longer had to suffer under Master Leng Yue’s bullying and refining at the Nine Stars Pavilion.
In other words, the possibility of staying alive had increased, and Wang Ping could develop in other worlds before returning to beat up his good senior brother Cold Moon.
“However, this teleportation is not as reliable as I would like, and I still have to rely on luck. I can only hope that it will not be as unreliable as Golden Talent: Transmission.”
Wang Ping quickly calmed down again and thought to himself.
“System, I choose Seven-color talent – God of Escaping.”
After Wang Ping gathered his thoughts, he spoke in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
[Your sudden visit made the Phoenix Clan quite surprised.]

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the Way with Power!
chapters.content:
Chapter 974: Chapter 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the Way with Power!
[Next, the Phoenix Clan did not neglect Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and you, choosing to warmly entertain you. After that, the Phoenix Clan tried to probe the reason for the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and your arrival to their Phoenix Clan.]
[As for this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not hide anything, saying that the purpose of coming here was for the Devouring Spirit Pearl, and Taiyi Imperial Palace could exchange a Supreme Treasure for it.]
[Upon hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor was quite astonished, never expecting Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to come for the Devouring Spirit Pearl. For a moment, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor wondered who had spread the news about the Devouring Spirit Pearl.]
[Although the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor had many doubts in his heart, he did not question Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and began to calculate how to increase the bargaining chip and gain more benefits.]
[For the Phoenix Clan, the Devouring Spirit Pearl was useless. After all, if the Devouring Spirit Pearl does not recognize its master, it’s nothing more than a trash with the title of Emperor’s artifact, and the Phoenix Clan still has to spend resources to seal it. In this situation, it’s a waste to either eat or discard it.]
[Next, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor began negotiations. In the end, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor paid a considerable price and obtained the Devouring Spirit Pearl. Seeing that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had spent such a high price to get the Devouring Spirit Pearl for you, you were quite touched.]
[However, when Heavenly Feather Great Emperor obtained the Devouring Spirit Pearl, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor spoke up again, stating that the two parties had made an exchange, but if no one in Taiyi Imperial Palace could make the Devouring Spirit Pearl recognize its master, it would have nothing to do with his Phoenix Clan.]
[Upon hearing this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said that the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor need not worry, and if they fail, they will bear the consequences themselves. As for you, you just laughed and said that as long as the Devouring Spirit Pearl appeared, it would voluntarily acknowledge you as its master.]
[Your words left the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor quite surprised, unable to understand why you were so confident, even arrogant. At the same time, he became curious about you. After all, your cultivation seemed to be only at the Supreme Realm, but an ordinary Supreme Realm cultivator could not have such a strong imposing manner, capable of directly facing an Emperor. Moreover, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor let you stay by his side, allowing you to listen to the conversation between the two Emperors, which was even more surprising.]
[For this reason, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor did not say anything about you being too arrogant, but instead summoned the suppressed Devouring Spirit Pearl and unsealed it in front of you.]
[As the seal on the Devouring Spirit Pearl was released, it cheerfully circled around you in front of the astonished eyes of the two Emperors, begging you to recognize it as its master like a bootlicker.]
[At this, you chuckled and caught it, choosing to accept its master recognition behavior. Seeing this scene, both Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor didn’t know what to say. The proud Devouring Emperor Artifact, which even the talented cultivators with Emperor’s talent and the Emperor himself looked down upon, turned out to be so humble in begging a certain cultivator to recognize it as its master.]
[One could only say that the contrast was too significant. However, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor thought of your situation and felt that the behavior of the Devouring Spirit Pearl was acceptable. It’s just that it really left the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor speechless. After all, the Devouring Spirit Pearl was very arrogant when it was with his Phoenix Clan. It looked down on everyone and even dared to attack him, the Emperor.]
[In the end, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor looked deeply at you, feeling that you were even more extraordinary than he had imagined, and chuckled before suddenly bringing up the matter of a marriage alliance. He stated that the previous transaction could be nullified, and if you married his daughter, the things from the previous transaction could be returned the same way, and they would also prepare many gifts.]
[Upon hearing this, your expression became strange, never expecting the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor to pull such a stunt. However, you would never agree to this kind of thing. After all, you don’t have a fetish for being cuckolded.]
[Of course, if Huangqin had not been taken away by someone, it could be considered a good thing. After all, this is just in the simulation, and you can take this opportunity to get the Phoenix Clan’s quasi-emperor’s origin and even the Phoenix Emperor’s origin. At that time, there might be an opportunity to obtain the powerful vitality of the Phoenix Clan. More importantly, Yu Daoyi’s injury to his origin could also be repaired.]
[At this moment, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor made the decision for you and tactfully declined the marriage proposal. After all, in his eyes, the marriage alliance was unnecessary and would only expose your background, with more disadvantages than benefits, which would not be conducive to becoming an Emperor and achieving immortality in the future.]
[Seeing that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor directly declined the marriage proposal for you, you laughed and echoed, saying that you didn’t want to find a Tao Companion at this point in time.]
[Upon seeing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s direct refusal, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor was somewhat disappointed, but he did not become angry. He no longer mentioned the matter, simply praising your monstrous talents and warmly inviting you to be their guest if you have time in the future.]
[At this, both you and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor responded very politely. Finally, having achieved your objectives, you chose to leave.]
[After you left, the Phoenix Clan’s Emperor sent people to investigate your background. At the same time, the news of the Devouring Spirit Pearl being taken away by you also spread among the higher-ups of the Phoenix Clan and became known to Princess Huang Qin, a quasi-emperor tier Imperial Princess of the Phoenix Clan.]
[At this, the quasi-emperor tier Imperial Princess became anxious. After all, the Devouring Spirit Pearl was something that her secretly-found Tao Companion desired. She had been thinking about how to get it, only for someone to get ahead of her.]

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Prove the Way with Power! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 975: Chapter 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Prove the Way with Power! _2
[However, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor took you away, and Princess Huang Qin of the Phoenix Clan couldn’t stop him. She could only helplessly sigh and inform her Tao Companion.]
[Upon hearing Princess Huang Qin’s words, that Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Master was very annoyed, not expecting that you would obtain the Devouring Spirit Pearl first. However, he still had not given up.]
[He didn’t believe that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would stay by your side to protect you forever. As long as you traveled alone one day, he could seize the opportunity to ambush you, kill you, and then take the Devouring Spirit Pearl.]
[You didn’t know that you had been targeted by the Tao Companion of Princess Huang Qin of the Phoenix Clan. After leaving the Phoenix Clan and returning to the Big Universe, you parted ways with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. He went to the Guimo Sea to save his daughter, while you chose to go to the Elemental Star to search for the Devouring Soul Pearl.]
[In the end, you successfully found the Devouring Soul Pearl on the Elemental Star and made it acknowledge you as its master. Then, you went to the Eternal Ancient Star and had the Devouring Mana Pearl inside acknowledge you as well. At this point, you once again had all three pearls, and compared to the last simulation, collected them more than a hundred thousand years earlier.]
…….
“This development is rather unexpected. I have to say, the Phoenix Emperor has good taste and great courage to choose marrying his daughter right away.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation with deep emotions.
“However, the Phoenix Emperor doesn’t know that his daughter has already been kidnapped and is willing to betray the Phoenix Clan for the kidnapper. I don’t know if my change of the plot will affect whether Huang Yin and Huang Qing will still be born or adopted by the Cyclops Quasi-Emperor.”
Wang Ping thought of this matter and his eyes became strange.
If it was due to his interference that the twins couldn’t be born, then it would really be his fault.
After all, Wang Ping was quite fond of the two little girls.
“However, I can be concerned about this in reality, but there’s no need to worry about it in the simulation. Of course, it would be best if Huang Qin is already pregnant at this point.”
Wang Ping sighed and then continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[However, this time when you obtained the Devouring Mana Pearl, you were attacked once again. Different from the last simulation, the one who attacked you was not the Supreme Master but the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Master, the Dao Companion of Huang Qin.]
[Facing this Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Master, you had no chance of winning. Therefore, you were prepared to activate Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Incarnation. Naturally, you don’t have to activate it voluntarily. Once you face a life-threatening danger, the incarnation will automatically awaken.]
[Just as you were looking serious, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion burst into laughter, looking extremely fanatic, saying that he didn’t expect you to know the location of the Devouring Mana Pearl. With the Devouring Mana Pearl and the Devouring Spirit Pearl taken from you, all he would need is the Devouring Soul Pearl to obtain a Supreme Immortal Artifact. When that time comes, becoming an Emperor would be a possibility, and even ascending to immortality could be expected.]
[Hearing Huang Qin’s Dao Companion’s words, you were left speechless, thinking that he must be out of his mind, dreaming of becoming an Emperor and ascending to immortality. With his pathetic appearance, the three Innate Emperor Artifacts would never acknowledge him. Even if he got all three Innate Emperor Artifacts, in the end, he would still die at the hands of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, the Predecessor Transmigrator.]
[Seemingly noticing your disdain, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion snorted coldly and chose to explode with terrifying Quasi-Emperor’s Might, trying to suppress you with a condescending attitude.]
[However, you remained indifferent. A mere Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Master’s might was nothing in your eyes. Even though your current cultivation was only at the Supreme level, you remained unshaken.]
[Your calm expression made Huang Qin’s Dao Companion feel humiliated, and he became enraged, wanting to crush you to death.]
[Just then, you pulled out something. It was none other than the Devouring Soul Pearl. The appearance of all three pearls astonished Huang Qin’s Dao Companion, causing him to laugh even harder, becoming even more excited. He hadn’t expected that you also had the Devouring Soul Pearl and had already collected all three Innate Emperor Artifacts. It all seemed to come with little effort.]
[Immediately, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion asked if you wanted to exchange your life with the three Innate Emperor Artifacts. If so, he could choose to spare your life.]
[Of course, although that was what he said, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion actually had no intention of sparing your life, and had already made preparations to kill you. However, him snatching the artifacts from you and you giving them to him voluntarily are completely different situations. The latter would be less likely to cause any problems.]
[In response to Huang Qin’s Dao Companion’s words, you displayed a mocking expression and started to ridicule him sarcastically. This drove Huang Qin’s Dao Companion into a rage, and he went all out to attack you.]
[At that moment, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Incarnation was activated, directly blocking the attack from Huang Qin’s Dao Companion.]
[Seeing the appearance of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Incarnation, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion didn’t show any surprise; instead, he sneered. After all, it was quite normal for someone like you to receive an incarnation to protect your life from a Great Emperor. However, in Huang Qin’s Dao Companion’s eyes, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was just an ordinary Emperor, and his Incarnation amounted to nothing.]
[Immediately, Huang Qin’s Dao Companion offered something, releasing a terrifying power. This item could produce enough power to resist an Ordinary Emperor’s Incarnation. This was his confidence to attack you and confront the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s Incarnation at the same time.]

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 260 Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the way with strength! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 976: Chapter 260 Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the way with strength! _3
[As long as you can block the incarnation of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, killing you would just take a moment. Even if you’re a monster with the assistance of three innate Emperor’s artifacts, you’re destined to die facing the absolute difference in cultivation.]
[However, Huangqin’s Tao Companion was shocked the next moment, his face revealing dread. The situation had taken a turn completely out of his expectations; his trump card, strong enough to resist the incarnation of an ordinary Emperor, was shattered instantly when confronted by the incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[This nearly made Huangqin’s Tao Companion collapse. He couldn’t believe what he was witnessing. Wasn’t the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor supposed to be one of the most ordinary Great Emperors? What was happening, how could an Emperor’s incarnation unleash the true power of a Great Emperor?]
[Immediately, the distraught Tao Companion of Huangqin tried to escape. The incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor remained cold and decided to make his move.]
[In an instant, Huangqin’s Tao Companion was suppressed by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. Before the power of a Great Emperor Tier, even a Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection was insignificant. Especially as this one was merely a pretty strong Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection, who did not have the same level as Yu Daoyi’s ability to contend with an ordinary aging Great Emperor.]
[Even at Yu Daoyi’s level – capable of contending against an aged ordinary Great Emperor, facing the incarnation of the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor meant only death.]
[In the end, Huangqin’s Tao Companion was killed in despair by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation. But before he was killed, you spoke up, requesting the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s incarnation to leave behind its flesh and blood, along with the remnant soul, so that you could devour them with the three innate Emperor’s artifacts.]
[Hearing your words, the incarnation of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor paused slightly before choosing to do as you requested. After that, he looked at the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Mana Pearl, and the Devouring Soul Pearl floating around you in utter amazement.]
[The legendary three innate emperor’s artifacts accepting a master at the same time were truly unprecedented. Even though you are monstrous and were recognized by the Devouring Spirit Pearl, this still astonished him. This was not something that could be explained by talent alone; it also required horrifying luck.]
[After returning to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, you directly embarked on the Supreme Heavenly Path and elevated your cultivation to the peak of the Heavenly Supreme tier.]
[Then, after consolidating your cultivation, you let the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Soul Pearl, and Devouring Mana Pearl devour the flesh and blood essence and the remnant soul of Huangqin’s Tao Companion. Consequently, the strength of your physical body increased drastically, and by condensing a quasi-emperor’s body, your divine soul became stronger. At the same time, your cultivation also broke through, as a result of comprehending the quasi-emperor dao fruit, pushing you to the quasi-emperor tier.]
[Your quasi-emperor tribulation was incredibly horrifying, even more so than last time’s tribulation. However, you faced it fearlessly and passed it. Eventually, you successfully crossed the tribulation. However, your quasi-emperor tribulation drew a lot of attention from powerful beings.]
[Some of these powerful beings wanted to make a move against you, but in the end, they suppressed the idea and chose not to. They were still somewhat wary of the deeply-rooted Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After you broke through to the quasi-emperor tier, you took some time to consolidate before waiting for the return of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi. Then, you prepared to unlock the Immortal Tower Secret Realm.]
[Of course, before unlocking the secret realm, you thought of a few things. Like those quasi-emperors who possess the golden light jade charm, you wanted to make a move against them before entering the secret realm, take the golden light jade charms they possessed, and enter the Immortal Tower as soon as it opens.]
[However, you also considered spending more time in the secret realm to hunt down more quasi-emperors and supremes, devour them, and quickly become stronger. Anyway, these people targeted you during the previous simulation, so killing them didn’t weigh on your conscience one bit. Especially Qingyu Quasi Emperor and Destruction Quasi-Emperor, they were certain targets on your hit list.]
[Apart from this, you also thought about the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples to Get Stronger. You thought that at your level, the effect of this talent is really weak and cannot provide you with much of a boost. Unless you can recruit supremes and quasi-emperors as disciples. However, this is obviously a very difficult task.]
[If you only recruit some young geniuses, it won’t help much. However, as they say, a mosquito’s leg is small but still meat, why not take it if it’s free.]
[Therefore, before unlocking the secret realm, you plan not only to seize all golden light jade charms, but also to preach in the Ten Great Universes.]
[And you did as you planned, deciding to preach first. At the same time, you also gathered information regarding the quasi-emperors who possess the golden light jade charms. These quasi-emperors didn’t have any significant background, either being loose cultivator quasi-emperors or the ancestor of quasi-emperor-tier forces. The only one among them with a significant background was a quasi-emperor from the Moon Rhombus Imperial Palace.]
[However, those were all things from the previous simulation, and if you want the golden light jade charms, you obviously won’t hesitate. Of course, it would be best if you could acquire the golden light jade charms through legitimate means.]

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Prove the Way with Power! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 977: Chapter 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Prove the Way with Power! _4
[Because of this, you started to trouble Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi again.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi were both somewhat helpless, but they still helped you with your affairs, collecting the golden light jade charm.]
[After you collected all the golden light jade charms, you began to arrange the preaching of the Ten Great Universes, using this to activate the effect of strengthening your innate abilities. At the same time, you informed them about the Immortal Tower Secret Realm, which finally made Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi understand why you wanted to collect the golden light jade charms.]
[When they were surprised, you also mentioned your hope that Yu Daoyi could recover his strength. In this way, entering the secret realm with a top-tier power would be much safer.]
[After contemplating, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor thought of the Phoenix Clan. For an injury like Yu Daoyi’s, either the origin of a Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Pure Blood Phoenix was needed or the Phoenix Emperor’s origin was required.]
[Whether there were Quasi-emperor Tier Pure-blooded Phoenixes in the present Phoenix Clan was a question. As for the Emperor’s origin, it was exceedingly precious, and even if the Phoenix Clan could regenerate, reaching the Emperor-tier would pose some difficulties. Moreover, consuming the origin would definitely affect their strength for a certain period. For this reason, Phoenix Emperor may not be willing to do this.]
[It should be said that Phoenix Emperor probably would not do this. Because you refused the marriage last time, you had already somewhat offended Phoenix Emperor. Even though Phoenix Emperor did not say anything, being rejected without hesitation when Emperor spoke was somewhat humiliating.]
[Afterwards, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor looked at you and thought it was possible to sacrifice you a little. You gave him a strange look, indicating whether Heavenly Feather Great Emperor wanted you to sell your appearance.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor chuckled and mentioned that sacrificing a little wouldn’t hurt. After all, although the Phoenix Emperor’s Imperial Daughter was inferior to you, she wasn’t too bad.]
[Upon hearing this, you rolled your eyes and said that Princess Huang Qin had already been taken away by someone else, and that person was the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier Masters who attacked you last time. Moreover, Princess Huang Qin might already be carrying the child of that person.]
[Back then, it was precisely because of Phoenix Emperor’s Imperial Daughter Huang Qin revealing information that the person targeted you.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had not expected the person to have such a background. He then laughed. Since such a thing had happened, there was no need for a marriage alliance, and they could directly confront them.]
[After all, the Phoenix Clan was in the wrong, and if they did not give an explanation, his Taiyi Imperial Palace would not let it go. Nowadays, the Phoenix Clan was relatively weak, although they could be considered a ruler in Four Profound Small Universe, they were only ranked in the middle of Emperor-tier forces.]
[Seeing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor become resolute, you knew that he was going to be tough this time. However, you had no intention of stopping him. After all, although you had a good impression of Huan Qing and Huangyin, you had no good feelings for the foolish Huang Qin.]
[Next, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, along with you and Yu Daoyi, went to the Phoenix Clan again. This time, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor revealed his Emperor’s Might instead of visiting, shaking the Four Profound Small Universe, especially intimidating the ancient land of the Phoenix Clan.]
[At this, many Phoenixes showed terrified expressions, and Phoenix Emperor was shocked, choosing to confront Heavenly Feather Great Emperor with a somber expression, asking him the reason behind his actions.]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was adamant and directly mentioned the attack on you, clarifying Huang Qin’s relationship with the attacker, and asked Phoenix Emperor to give an explanation.]
[Upon hearing this, the Phoenix Clan was shaken. They didn’t expect Imperial Princess Huang Qin to secretly find a Tao Companion, and even conspire with the companion to attack Taiyi Imperial Palace’s big shot and steal the Devouring Spirit Pearl. This crime was simply too severe and could provoke a war between the two Emperor-tier forces.]
[At this time, the Phoenix Clan finally understood why Heavenly Feather Great Emperor came to confront them. Everyone in the clan was very dissatisfied with Huang Qin. After all, her actions disregarded the interests of the Ethnic Group, and she harmed the foundation of the Phoenix Clan by both conspiring with outsiders and attacking important figures of other Emperor-tier forces to steal treasures.]
[Even Phoenix Emperor was silent, never expecting his own daughter to do such a foolish thing. However, he did not easily believe Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words. There was a need for evidence for everything, and unless Heavenly Feather Great Emperor could produce evidence about the relationship between the two, he would not believe such a thing.]
[Seeing Phoenix Emperor ask for evidence, you sneered and said to let Huang Qin come out, and the evidence could be obtained, couldn’t it?]
[Phoenix Emperor frowned deeply, stared at you intently for a moment, and then grabbed the hiding Huang Qin. When Phoenix Emperor noticed Huang Qin’s eyes filled with hatred and personally checked her body, he went completely silent.]
[Indeed, Huang Qin was no longer pure, and it seemed that she was even carrying a child. This undoubtedly confirmed what you and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had said. Their Phoenix Clan had indeed made some mistakes.]
[As a result, Phoenix Emperor’s attitude softened immediately, sighed, and asked Heavenly Feather Great Emperor how to resolve this issue.]

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the Path with Strength!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 978: Chapter 260: The Frustrated Phoenix Emperor! Proving the Path with Strength!_5
[Just when the Phoenix Emperor is at his weakest, Huangqin speaks out defiantly, asserting that you’re merely wrenching things out of context. She has a Tao Companion, she has had a child, so what? How can that prove her to be related to the assailant? Huangqin says that you are just trying to find a reason to target her Phoenix Clan. If a war is brewing, then let it be. Her Phoenix Clan is fearless.]
[Upon hearing Huangqin’s words, the Phoenix Emperor’s complexion changes as he guesses his daughter’s intentions. She is deliberately instigating a war. He never thought his own daughter would act in such a way, even going as far as to involve the entire Phoenix Clan for the sake of a deceased person. Instead of admitting her mistakes, she even wants to avenge on behalf of the alleged attacker. This behavior enrages the Phoenix Emperor and makes him regret all the years he spent nurturing her.]
[You watch Huangqin’s clownish behavior, speechless. This woman is indeed outrageous. You seriously doubt whether she is the mother of Huan Qing and Huangyin, or if Huangyin and Huan Qing are not Huangqin’s descendants, but rather descendants of her descendants.]
[As for this kind of woman, you have nothing nice to say. After mocking her for a while, you reveal everything that happened in the past using the Time Divine Skill. The entire sequence of their scheming, hookup, and subsequent fights are all played out.]
[This leaves the Phoenix Clan speechless, and Huangqin doesn’t know what to say. The evidence is indisputable, and further denials will be meaningless.]
[In the end, the Phoenix Emperor sighs and asks the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor what he could do to appease his rage.]
[At this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor simply states his conditions: he wants a portion of the Phoenix Emperor’s original source. Upon hearing this, the Phoenix Emperor’s expression changes repeatedly. Eventually, he decides to hand over a part of his source, stating the matter ends here.]
[The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor doesn’t say another word and leaves with you after obtaining the source.]
[Next, Yu Daoyi begins to heal his wound using the Phoenix Emperor’s source, and the wound starts healing rapidly.]
[As for you, you continue to cultivate, using the three Devouring Emperor’s artifacts to absorb the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s Quasi-emperor prisoners. Consequently, your Physical Body and Divine Soul are strengthened once again. Alongside, your cultivation breaks through and reaches the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[However, you understand that such a rapid increase in strength could lead to instability in your foundations. Therefore, you choose to lay low for hundreds of years, solidifying your foundations once again. As this happens, your cultivation reaches the peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[Once everything is ready, you open the Immortal Tower Secret Realm.]
[As the anomaly emerges, the entire Upper Realm shakes, and countless cultivators swarm in. Amidst this, you, Yu Daoyi, and the other powerhouses from Taiyi Imperial Palace enter first.]
[As soon as you enter, a Quasi-Emperor Tier Ferocious Beast launches an attack on you. At this, you chuckle without using any Mana, and using only your physical strength, you fight it head-on, ultimately exploding it.]
[Today’s you, even solely relying on your physical strength, can easily explode an ordinary Quasi-Emperor. To put it bluntly, you aren’t entirely sure of your maximum combat strength.]
[Then, using Three Devouring Emperor treasures, you devour the Quasi-Emperor Tier Ferocious Beast, further strengthening your Physical Body. You found that devouring Ferocious beasts was more suited to be done using the Devouring Spirit Pearl. Since Ferocious beasts commonly have formidable physical power and relatively negligible mana, the efficacy of the Devouring Spirit Pearl is higher when used on them.]
[Upon realizing this, you get excited, wanting to hunt more Ferocious Beasts and evolve your Physical Body beyond imagination. If one day, you can explode a Top Quasi-Emperor or even a Great Emperor using only your physical strength alone, that would truly be invincible.]
[By then, even if you end up in a world that restricts the use of Mana and Divine skills, you can still rely on your physical strength to plow your way through.]
[Of course, if you encounter a strange existence in the Sci-Fi world, it’s a different story. Against that kind of Rule-tier Skill, no matter what Mana, Divine Skill, or Physical Body, as long as it belongs to the Extraordinary System Power, it will be completely suppressed, turning you into an ordinary person.]
[Next, you start to hunt in various ways, creating a lot of commotion. However, while hunting, you choose to hide your identity. As a result, the powerhouses who gradually enter the secret realm only know of a monstrous beast-slaying maniac lurking in the secret realm, unaware that you are an elder from Taiyi Imperial Palace, a figure who will become an immortal in the future.]
[Simultaneously, because of your actions, a certain force develops a deep interest in you. While seeking fortune in the secret realm, they are also searching for your whereabouts.]

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 261: Emperor Cheng’s Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring!
chapters.content:
Chapter 979: Chapter 261: Emperor Cheng’s Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring!
[The forces seeking you are called the Sky Barbarian Clan. The Sky Barbarian Clan specializes in the body training path. Their physical bodies are incredibly formidable and extremely famous in the Upper Realm. The reason they are searching for you is not because they are interested in your sudden emergence as a loose cultivator with such a formidable physique, but simply because Huangqin let the news of Devouring Spirit Pearl spread out.]
[As a result, in the eyes of the Sky Barbarian Clan, you, who had no fame before and possess a terrifying physique as a loose cultivator, are very likely the one with the Devouring Spirit Pearl, just choosing to disguise it.]
[For the Sky Barbarian Clan, the Devouring Spirit Pearl, an innate Emperor artifact, is regarded as an unparalleled existence with an extremely high status in their hearts. After all, the Devouring Spirit Pearl is of such great significance to body training cultivators. If one gets hold of it, they could potentially reach the peak with its help, prove their Dao with their strength, and fight with Emperors.]
[According to the information obtained by the Sky Barbarian Clan, when you followed Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to the Phoenix clan, you were merely a Supreme. Now, however, you possess a terrifying physical body capable of killing Quasi-Emperor Ferocious Beasts, which further demonstrates how powerful the Devouring Spirit Pearl is.]
[For this reason, the Sky Barbarian Clan targeted you and wanted to snatch the Devouring Spirit Pearl from your hands. With the Devouring Spirit Pearl in their possession, the Sky Barbarian Clan would become the top forces in the Upper Realm and regain their past glory.]
…
“This Huangqin really doesn’t give up, causing trouble for me everywhere.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation and was really speechless.
If it wasn’t for consideration towards Huang Yin and Huang Qing, Wang Ping would want to kill her now.
When dealing with enemies, regardless of gender, Wang Ping would never show mercy.
“I need to find a way to solve this problem in the real world.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, murmuring to himself.
He would definitely make a move against the Devouring Spirit Pearl in the real world as well.
It should be said that his original purpose was to use this simulation to pave the way for seizing the Devouring Spirit Pearl in the real world.
“As long as my strength is strong enough, I can make her give up and not even have the courage to seek revenge. Of course, if I show the strength equal to or greater than an Emperor, the so-called Tao companion of Huangqin’s would have to consider whether he has the guts to try to snatch the Devouring Spirit Pearl from me.”
After Wang Ping made some mocking remarks, he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[You don’t know that the Sky Barbarian Clan has targeted you, and you continue to happily hunt down the Ferocious Beasts. However, although there are many dangerous ferocious beasts in this secret realm, there couldn’t be too many of them at the Quasi-Emperor level. Therefore, your gains are not substantial.]
[For a moment, you even wanted to make a move against the Quasi-Emperors in the Upper Realm who held grudges against you. However, if you were to take action against them, you would have to carefully plan everything. After all, those old monsters are not easy to provoke. Even with your current strength, you wouldn’t be considered a strong contender among the Quasi-Emperors.]
[It can only be said that you were able to fight above your level, but when it came to the Quasi-Emperor stage, the difficulty of fighting above your level had increased again. It’s impossible for you with the 3rd-tier cultivation of Emperor Realm to defeat a great perfection old monster at the Quasi-Emperor level. And this kind of great perfection Quasi-Emperor is just an ordinary one, not including those with Special Constitution.]
[If you come across a top-tier Quasi-Emperor like Yu Daoyi, you would be instantly killed. As a result, you must carefully plan everything; otherwise, the chances of failure are high. This time, you don’t want to escape without entering the Immortal Tower and directly use the Seven-color talent·Running God to save your life.]
[Just as you were thinking about all this, you suddenly noticed that several Quasi-Emperor auras appeared nearby, surrounding you.]
[You slightly frowned, recognizing their identities as members of the Sky Barbarian Clan, and questioned their intentions.]
[A Quasi-emperor Ancestor of the Sky Barbarian Clan didn’t pay attention to your words. He silently set up the Great Array to conceal the situation and then directly attacked you, stating that he wanted to borrow your head for a short while.]
[Seeing this, you became furious and engaged in a fierce battle with them. This Quasi-emperor Ancestor was very formidable, his physical body could rival a 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor, but you were not weak either, also able to fight against opponents of this level. As a result, the fight between you two was extremely intense.]
[However, due to the Devouring Spirit Pearl’s ability to consume Qi and Blood, your strength increased as the battle went on, while the Quasi-emperor Ancestor’s power diminished rapidly.]
[Nevertheless, faced with this situation, he showed no fear, but instead displayed a fanatical gaze, laughing loudly and exclaiming how worthy the Devouring Spirit Pearl was, as it was the supreme treasure of their Sky Barbarian Clan and how powerful it was.]
[The old man’s words brought a sneer to your face, and you finally understood their motive for suddenly attacking you. With that, you mockingly said that it was really amazing that they could claim the Devouring Spirit Pearl as their supreme treasure, as their faces must be really thick-skinned.]
[In response to your mockery, the Sky Barbarian Clan’s Ancestor didn’t care and just coldly laughed, stating that no one could save you today. Then, the other Quasi-Emperors of the Sky Barbarian Clan also attacked you with various cultivation realms – 3rd-tier, 4th-tier, and 6th-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[Faced with the siege of four Quasi-Emperors, even a powerful 6th-tier Quasi-Emperor would be terrified. However, you faced their attacks calmly and coldly, not giving in.]
[You didn’t hide any longer and directly unleashed your true fighting power. Possessing a Great Space-Time Dao Body, Breaking Origin Sky Eye at the minor completion stage, 50% True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao, and 3rd-tier Cultivation of Emperor Realm, you revealed your full strength. With all your power unleashed, you instantly killed the Quasi-emperor Ancestor who had fought with you before.]

chapters.title: Chapter 980: 261: Emperor Cheng's Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 980: Chapter 261: Emperor Cheng’s Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _2
[This scene made the Sky Barbarian Clan extremely terrified. They didn’t expect you to have such a terrifying cultivation and battle power. At the same time, they also realized that they had kicked an iron plate.]
[You are not the fish on their chopping board, not their prey. Instead, they might become your prey.]
[However, things have come to this point, and there is no possibility of retreat. As a result, the remaining three Ancestors of the Sky Barbarian Clan continued to attack you with their red eyes, wanting to kill you. As long as they could obtain the Devouring Spirit Pearl, it would be worth even if two more quasi-emperors died.]
[However, their thoughts were too naive. With your full strength, your battle power is no longer something that ordinary 6th-tier Quasi-Emperor could match. You struck forcefully, successively killed a Sky Barbarian Clan Ancestor with 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor power and 4th-tier Quasi-Emperor power.]
[This scene made the remaining Sky Barbarian Clan Ancestor with 6th-tier Quasi-Emperor power extremely terrified. He knew he couldn’t be your opponent, and he sobered up from his greed, wanting to escape.]
[However, it was ridiculous for him, a body-refining expert, to try to escape in front of you, a Quasi-Emperor who had mastered the Time-Space Tao. As a result, you easily caught up with him, continued to fight him, and then killed him in a very short time.]
[Next, you used the Devouring Spirit Pearl to absorb the Qi and Blood of these Sky Barbarian Clan experts, making your physical body even stronger. It must be said that the effect of devouring these body-refining Quasi-Emperor experts is much stronger than that of Ferocious Beasts. After absorbing the four body-refining Quasi-Emperors, your physical strength has soared again, reaching the level of ordinary 4th-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[Even if you absorb all the remaining Qi and Blood, you estimate you can reach the level of fighting against ordinary 5th-tier Quasi-Emperors with your physical strength.]
[Of course, because the energy is too huge, you also need to take some time to digest and settle it. Not to mention absorbing all the Qi and Blood stored in the Devouring Spirit Pearl, even now, you have already reached the bottleneck, and continuous absorption will only lead to body explosion and death.]
[Therefore, you plan to retreat for a period of time and wait for the opening of the Immortal Tower. As for hunting other powerful people, you can only stop here.]
[After that, while you were in seclusion, the secret realm was still turbulent, with constant battles appearing. You didn’t care at all.]
[When your seclusion ended, you calculated the time and felt that it was time for the Immortal Tower to appear. Therefore, you chose to go to the place where the Immortal Tower was located.]
[When the Immortal Tower appeared, you immediately used the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the Golden Light Jade Charm to form a key, opened the Immortal Light Barrier, and entered it. After entering, you began the Immortal Tower trial without hesitation and started to challenge.]
[Because your cultivation has reached the peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor, you found that the cultivation of your opponent also reached the level of the peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[You were astonished to discover that at the peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had comprehended his Great Emperor Sutra, making his Same Realm Battle Power much stronger than at the Supreme tier.]
[This made you shake your head slightly, knowing that your ranking in the tower this time might not be higher than when you were at the peak of the Heavenly Supreme. Because your configuration, at the peak of the Heavenly Supreme, was undoubtedly luxurious and top-of-the-line. However, as your cultivation improved, your configuration did not change, but your opponent’s configuration did improve, which undoubtedly increased the difficulty of your attack.]
[However, although you knew that the difficulty of the attack had increased, you were not afraid at all and continued to challenge the tower. The higher the difficulty, the greater the benefits after the battle. What’s more, as long as you can break into the top 100, you can get Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit. Therefore, even if your ranking in the tower this time is lower than last time, you don’t need to worry about it. Just make sure you can enter the top 100. You still have full confidence in this.]
[It was while you were challenging the tower that the cultivators in the secret realm also noticed this amazing anomaly, rushing over here one after another, entering the Immortal Tower.]
[When they entered the Immortal Tower, they found that someone was challenging the tower, and your name was revealed on the stone tablet. This made many cultivators quite surprised, not expecting that someone had already challenged the tower and had broken through to more than 8,000, reaching the level of Emperor-tier Characters.]
[However, they were completely unfamiliar with your name, not knowing from which power you, this Quasi-Emperor, came, and they had never heard of you before.]
[Only a small part of the forces had a huge reaction to your ranking in the tower. Taiyi Imperial Palace, for the time being, didn’t matter, they were all excited. Just like Huangqin, she also entered the secret realm, and when she saw you, she revealed an incredulous look.]
[After all, in her mind, you were nothing but a Supreme. Although you were somewhat mysterious, being recognized by the Devouring Spirit Pearl, and favored by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, in her opinion, you were just a Supreme, and you couldn’t reach the top level among the Supremes.]
[However, your ranking this time broke her perception. She didn’t expect that you had already reached the Quasi-Emperor Stage and even suppressed many Emperor Lord tier characters.]
[Soon, as you continued to challenge, you broke through from more than 8,000 all the way to the top 1,000, then to the top 300, suppressed an immortal, Huangqin became silent and trembling. She finally realized how big a mistake she had made, and how terrifying an enemy she had provoked for the Phoenix Clan.]

chapters.title: Chapter 981: 261: Emperor's Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 981: Chapter 261: Emperor’s Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _3
[Initially, Huangqin was very hostile towards Taiyi Imperial Palace and you, even resenting her father for not helping her out but instead giving her a lecture. In Huangqin’s view, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was just an ordinary emperor, far inferior to Phoenix Emperor. She also believed that the strength of her Phoenix Clan would not be overshadowed by Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[Now it seems that she was really overthinking things. The strength of Taiyi Imperial Palace is far more terrifying than she had imagined. Particularly, your presence has broken her previous understanding.]
[For a moment, Huangqin’s heart was filled with fear, regret, and hatred that eventually turned into a terrifying killing intent. In her eyes, even though you are a Quasi-Emperor, she, being a 7th-tier Quasi-Emperor master, should be far superior to you. She only needs to ambush you after you exit the tower. Killing you would eliminate future threats for both herself and her clan and avenge her Tao Companion.]
[However, by the time Huangqin prepared to ambush you when you came out of the tower, Yu Daoyi had already noticed her. She snorted coldly and directly attacked Huangqin.]
[The terrifying attack shocked Huangqin to the core. She wanted to resist but found she couldn’t, and was on the verge of being killed by Yu Daoyi.]
[Fortunately, the quasi-emperors of the Phoenix Clan didn’t just stand by. They stared angrily at Yu Daoyi, questioning her about her sudden ambush on the Imperial Princess.]
[In response, Yu Daoyi mercilessly and coldly stated that Huangqin was showing no remorse and still wanted to target you. Since she refused to change her ways, there was no need to keep her alive.]
[The Phoenix Clan was furious. They didn’t expect Yu Daoyi to be so domineering. They also looked at Huangqin and asked her in secret whether she really had such thoughts. If she did, it would be too stupid to continue to offend someone so powerful.]
[Huangqin expressionlessly claims that Yu Daoyi is slandering her. Everything had already passed, and she believed that Yu Daoyi was merely looking for an excuse to kill her.]
[Yu Daoyi mocked Huangqin, saying she didn’t have such prestige. If Taiyi Imperial Palace wanted to get rid of her, they could have done it easily and wouldn’t have needed to wait until they were in this secret realm. Not to mention, even if they didn’t make a move now, once you fully grow, killing her would only take an instant. However, the Taiyi Imperial Palace was magnanimous, not wanting to stoop to Huangqin’s level, but she remained unrepentant.]
[Upon hearing this, Huangqin’s face turned red, unsure of how to refute the accusations. The quasi-emperor ancestors of the Phoenix Clan were silent, inwardly sighing and believing it necessary to report this matter when they returned. They needed the Phoenix Emperor to completely suppress Huangqin. Otherwise, she would be a calamity that could harm the entire clan.]
[Other major powers enjoyed the arguing between the two great forces, which enlivened their thoughts. At this time, Huangqin spoke again, suggesting that Taiyi Imperial Palace would be a future threat to each force’s path to immortality due to your presence, and it would be wiser to kill you before you fully grow.]
[Upon hearing this, Yu Daoyi became enraged, as did all the strong individuals of Taiyi Imperial Palace. The killing intent towards Huangqin skyrocketed, and they did not hesitate to make a move against her, intending to kill her.]
[The Phoenix Clan was scared, not expecting Huangqin to be so insane as to try to bring all the forces together against Taiyi Imperial Palace and you.]
[However, they also knew that Taiyi Imperial Palace’s anger could not be quelled, so they had no choice but to fight and try to settle the conflict within the battle.]
[Of course, Huangqin’s words did indeed have some effect, stirring the minds of many forces, making them feel that she had a point. If they could strangle your growth in advance, their forces and their own chances of claiming the Immortal Fate in the future would be greater.]
[However, these old foxes didn’t want to be sacrificed for nothing, so they all decided to observe the battle before making any decisions.]
[In fact, some of the forces or masters believed that this was a good opportunity to build a connection with you. If they could help Taiyi Imperial Palace and you suppress the Phoenix Clan’s masters, they might receive numerous benefits in the future. After all, you were capable of defeating immortals, having limitless potential.]
[Seeing that she couldn’t incite the hatred she wanted, Huangqin became truly desperate. She never expected her efforts would lead to this outcome.]
[Witnessing this, the Phoenix Clan’s masters realized that if the current situation continued, they might face complete annihilation here. Even the entire Phoenix Clan could be wiped out. After all, Yu Daoyi and the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s masters were too powerful. If they were to fall, the Phoenix Emperor would be left helpless.]
[For this reason, the Grand Elder of the Phoenix Clan glared fiercely, and surprisingly took action, suppressing Huangqin and pushing her towards Yu Daoyi for your punishment, all in front of everyone’s astonished gazes.]
[This situation led to some masters mocking and provoking the Phoenix Clan’s masters. Yet, many more forces and masters agreed that the Phoenix Clan was making the right decision by cutting off the problem at its source to avoid chaos. As long as they could calm Taiyi Imperial Palace’s anger, the price of an Imperial Princess was not significant.]
[Yu Daoyi hadn’t expected the Grand Elder of the Phoenix Clan to be so decisive, opting to suppress Huangqin and leave her punishment in Yu Daoyi’s hands. This kind of action was undoubtedly a slap in the face for the Phoenix Clan.]
[Considering this, Yu Daoyi hesitated for a moment. She didn’t want to be too excessive. After all, a life-and-death struggle with the Phoenix Clan wouldn’t be easy due to their terrifying recovery ability. While the Grand Elder of the Phoenix Clan wasn’t as strong as her, he would have no problem stalling her. Additionally, the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s other quasi-emperors battling the Phoenix Clan’s quasi-emperors wouldn’t have a significant advantage.]

chapters.title: Chapter 982: 261: Becoming an Emperor by Chance! Combat Power Surge!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 982: Chapter 261: Becoming an Emperor by Chance! Combat Power Surge!_4
[Once a deadly battle commences, if she manages to kill the Phoenix Clan’s Grand Elder, the Taiyi Imperial Palace would also lose some quasi-emperor ancestors, which is something she does not want to see.]
[Therefore, Yu Daoyi chose to accept the Phoenix Clan Grand Elder’s plea for peace and agreed to deal with Huangqin herself, putting an end to the matter.]
[Upon seeing this, the Phoenix Clan’s Grand Elder let out a sigh of relief. However, Huangqin’s face was full of despair and madness, unable to believe she would end up like this.]
[Next, after suppressing and sealing Huangqin, Yu Daoyi did not kill her. After all, Yu Daoyi wanted to hand over Huangqin to you. She also knew that you possessed the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Mana Pearl, and Devouring Soul Pearl. Handing Huangqin to you would undoubtedly help you greatly.]
[As the great battle came to an end, a cry of surprise was heard. The crowd looked at the stone stele again and found it even more shocking since you had now advanced to the 150th place. Although your progress had significantly slowed down, there was no doubt that you were still steadily climbing.]
[Meanwhile, as the external cultivators were in awe and admiration, the pressure on you was mounting, because as your cultivation improved, the opponents became much more powerful.]
[Especially when dealing with those who had attained immortality around the 300th rank, it was even more so. However, you still did not give up and engaged in a terrifying battle to hone yourself.]
[Eventually, you succeeded in reaching the top 100, but you were somewhat at your limit. The composition of the top 100 was better than yours, and you could not take advantage.]
[Nevertheless, just like before during the text simulation, you forcibly broke through your limits and finally advanced your Breaking Origin Sky Eye to the Great Completion Domain and comprehended 60% of True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao. In the end, your combat power surged, and you continued to defeat your opponents, advancing to the 50th position, breaking the previous simulation record.]
