[However, the further you went, the more challenging it became. Even with your luxurious configuration, you only advanced to the 31st position. The opponent in 30th place had an even more incredible composition.]
[Not only did they possess the bloodline of immortals, but they also had a formidable immortal body that had reached the Great Completion Domain. They had cultivated a much stronger Immortal Sutra than the previous opponent, comprehending 70% of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit. With 70% Heavenly Tao True Spirit, they had reached the Great Completion Domain—the realm of great emperors—and the boost to their combat ability was too terrifying.]
[As a result, even though your full firepower was unleashed and your abilities were utilized without holding anything back, you still could not defeat them and were defeated instead.]
[Although you were not satisfied with your own performance, your achievement had left all the strong individuals, including Yu Daoyi, speechless and shocked to the extreme. After all, they knew how difficult it was to climb the tower, and none of them made it to the rankings.]
[You, on the other hand, managed to reach the 31st place, not far from the top. This terrifying talent and combat power would undoubtedly lead you to become not just an ordinary immortal, but an extraordinary one, if you were in the ancient times.]
…
“I thought I wouldn’t make it into the top 50 this time and my rank would be even lower than last time. But I made an unexpected breakthrough, which was a pleasant surprise. However, this woman named Huangqin is really troublesome. If she weren’t the mother of Huan Qing and Huangyin, I’d really like to refine her completely.”
Looking at the text simulation, Wang Ping became increasingly annoyed with Huangqin.
Of course, the fact that Huan Qing and Huangyin were Huangqin’s daughters was just Wang Ping’s speculation. Whether this was true would be another matter.
If this woman weren’t Huan Qing and Huangyin’s biological mother, Wang Ping would also kill her in reality, leaving her without a way out.
Such a woman would be better off dead than alive.
[Afterward, you were kicked out of the Immortal Tower, receiving your award. This time the reward was different than last time. Last time, when you broke through to the 50th position, the Immortal Tower informed you that those who enter the top 100 would receive an Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit.]
[Now, having broken into the top 50, you were informed that those who enter the top 50 would receive an Enlightenment Imperial Fruit. The Enlightenment Imperial Fruit is a legendary treasure known from the records, the existence of which is unknown.]
[Rumor has it that those who consume the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit will enter an even more terrifying state of enlightenment than the Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit, allowing a Great Perfection Quasi-Emperor to achieve 100% enlightenment and become an emperor. Hence, the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit is also called the Emperor Becoming Fruit. A Quasi-Emperor at the Great Perfection level just needs to consume it and can become an emperor.]
[That is to say, acquiring the Dao Enlightenment Imperial Fruit would make it certain to become an emperor. They initially thought that the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit did not exist, as something that could make one 100% certain to become an emperor seemed too heaven-defying.]
[Who would have thought that the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit truly existed and even appeared before their eyes?]
[At this moment, all the ordinary and top quasi-emperors were driven mad. Even the quasi-emperor of the Phoenix Clan had fiery eyes and could barely suppress their thoughts.]
[Seeing this scene, Yu Daoyi and others could sense that something was wrong, and they knew that Taiyi Imperial Palace might be attacked by the crowd. The temptation of the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit was simply too great.]
[You, on the other hand, looked at this group of powerful beings with an expression of indifference and even a mocking smile. You then raised the Dao Enlightenment Imperial Fruit and asked them if they wanted it?]

chapters.title: Chapter 983: 261: Emperor Cheng's Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 983: Chapter 261: Emperor Cheng’s Opportunity! Battle Power Soaring! _5
[As soon as these words came out, the various powerful individuals became even greedier, especially the Destruction Quasi-Emperor, who sneered and said if you don’t want to die, hand it over quickly.]
[You looked at the Destruction Quasi-Emperor with a mocking expression, ridiculing him for saying such foolish words at his age.]
[These words infuriated the Destruction Quasi-Emperor. In front of all the strong people, you swallowed the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit directly.]
[This scene left everyone present dumbfounded, not expecting you to be so decisive and directly ingesting the fruit. It is important to know that things like Enlightenment Heavenly Fruit and Enlightenment Imperial Fruit can only be swallowed in extremely safe conditions. After all, once you enter the state of Enlightenment, and once it is disturbed, you will be pulled out of it, which means you have eaten the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit in vain, a complete waste of resources.]
[However, in the current situation, it is obviously impossible to enter the state of Enlightenment. To forcibly ignore the interference of outsiders and enter that state, there will undoubtedly be many malicious thoughts among the strong ones present, with no lack of people who will take action.]
[However, the next thing that made everyone dumbfounded again happened. Before you entered the Enlightenment state, you directly activated the ability of the Seven-color talent·Running God and escaped from here with Yu Daoyi and others.]
[None of the powerful people present had expected such an incredible move. However, they all breathed a sigh of relief and gradually let go of their greed, fortunately not making a move, or else going against you would doom their future.]
[Following that, these powerful individuals looked at the Destruction Quasi-Emperor and the Phoenix Clan forces with a sense of schadenfreude, thinking their future would be miserable.]
[This made the Destruction Quasi-Emperor’s face difficult to read, and he snorted coldly and left. As for the Phoenix Clan’s masters, they had bitter smiles, knowing that just handing over Huangqin was not enough; they needed to pay a greater price to appease the Taiyi Emperor Palace. In particular, you must be appeased, otherwise, the Phoenix Clan would really be finished.]
[While everyone was preoccupied, you used the Seven-color talent·Running God to teleport to an unknown place. However, you didn’t even have time to figure out where you were before being forced into the mysterious Enlightenment state.]
[Enlightenment takes years. After an unknown amount of time, you finally awoke from the marvelous Enlightenment state, showing an excited expression.]
[The effect of the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit is indeed terrifying. With the help of it, you successfully comprehended 70% of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao, and your combat prowess skyrocketed once again. Not only that, but during the Enlightenment process, you focused mainly on the comprehension of the Chaos Emperor Sutra and the True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path.]
[The result was very gratifying. Relying on the effect of the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit and that terrifying foundation, you successfully comprehended the Chaos Emperor Sutra and 30% of the True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path.]
[The only disappointment was the short time the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit lasted. Although it was terrifying, if you could have had two more fruits, you feel that there is a possibility of understanding the True Spirit of Chaos Heavenly Path to 70%, 80%, or even 90%.]
[Of course, the greatest pity is that the Little Chaotic Body doesn’t have the potential to develop and reach the Minor Domain and the Great Completion Domain. If it could, your fighting power could continue to transform.]
[Therefore, you feel that it is imperative to obtain the True Chaotic Body, and now comprehending the Chaos Emperor Sutra and the Chaos Heavenly Path True Spirit is paving the way for the future.]
[When you came back to your senses, you found that the situation around you was not right. Because Taiyi Emperor Palace Ancestor by your side was extremely weak, even Yu Daoyi had a weak aura and his origin had suffered heavy damage.]
[This made you feel shocked and angry, not knowing what had happened.]
[Immediately, you began to inquire about the cause, and Yu Daoyi gave you an answer. It turns out that through the Seven-color talent·Running God, you sent everyone to an unknown universe.]
[In this universe, there is also a Source of Darkness. However, the World of cultivators in this world is much more miserable compared to the Upper Realm they were in. The World of cultivators is in a semi-destructive state, with few strong individuals, suffering from the massacre of the Dark Disaster that occasionally erupts, and their lives being sucked away by the Dark Emperor. This world can be said to be in an extremely dark era.]
[When they arrived in this world, they were targeted by the Dark Emperor, who launched an attack on them. Faced with this, Taiyi Emperor Palace, led by Yu Daoyi, formed a battle array to fight against the Dark Emperor’s Dark Army.]
[However, despite Yu Daoyi’s strength, even with the assistance of Taiyi Emperor Palace masters, they were no match for the Dark Emperor. Although the formation they set up prevented the Dark Emperor from killing them in a short period, they couldn’t hold on for long, their origins almost exhausted, and close to falling.]
[After hearing this, you fell into silence, feeling speechless about the Seven-color talent·Running God. Although you knew beforehand that this talent could send you to another world, you didn’t expect it to be triggered on the first try, and even put them in such a dangerous situation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 984: 262: Kill the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring!
chapters.content:
Chapter 984: Chapter 262: Kill the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring!
“I really have to admit it, this Seven-Color Talent·Running God is truly surpassing its predecessor.”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation’s content and couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
The Golden Talent: Transmission had flaws, but it only affected this world. The Seven-Color Talent·Running God actually simulated Wang Ping and others being teleported to another world – it’s just absurd.
Teleportation aside, they were sent directly in front of the Dark Emperor as a snack, which made it hard to even complain.
“However, the decision of the simulated Wang Ping was not a mistake, as they would have died if they didn’t run. Now, the current simulated Wang Ping should have the fighting power to kill an ordinary Emperor, right?”
Wang Ping thought of the situation of simulated Wang Ping and secretly pondered.
Before challenging the Immortal Tower, the fighting power of the simulated Wang Ping was only at the Great Space-Time Dao Body stage, with the one Minor Domain Breaking Origin Sky Eye and 50% Heavenly Dao True Spirit, as well as the talent effects added on.
To defeat an ordinary Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection, this configuration was somewhat insufficient, but they could fight, although they would lose more than they win. If the Seven-color talent·Instant Kill effect was triggered, they could kill them.
Although ordinary Quasi-Emperor Great Perfections do not have very strong physiques, their Heavenly Dao True Spirit is at least 60% enlightened, one percent higher than the simulated Wang Ping.
Besides, the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfections have seven more realms than the simulated Wang Ping, especially since the Great Perfection is equivalent to a transformation in their fighting power.
The higher the cultivation, the greater the gap between the realms, and the seven realms gap brings a considerable difference in fighting power.
After challenging the Immortal Tower, the fighting power of the simulated Wang Ping transformed, and the Breaking Origin Sky Eye directly reached its Great Completion, having also comprehended 60% of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Dao.
This configuration is quite luxurious now.
With the double special constitution Great Completion and 60% Heavenly Dao True Spirit, they can easily defeat ordinary Quasi-Emperor Great Perfections. As for whether they can compete with top Quasi-Emperors, it remains uncertain.
A top Quasi-Emperor’s configuration is a Supreme Divine Physique, which has been developed to the Great Perfection Tier, and they have comprehended 70% Heavenly Dao True Spirit, reaching a Perfect Domain in the Heavenly Dao.
The Great Perfection Physique is a true transformation, and the trump card that Quasi-Emperors like Yu Daoyi can rely on to fight against aging Ordinary Emperors.
The combat power increase brought by the Great Perfection Supreme Divine Physique is much more potent than that provided by a Great Completion Time-Space Body.
Only when the Time-Space Body reaches the Perfect Domain can they continue to surpass the Top Divine Physique in terms of attack power.
In addition, the power increase brought by 70% True Spirit of Heavenly Dao is also terrifying, which has reached the realm of an Emperor.
So, the fighting power of a top Quasi-Emperor is entirely different from that of other Quasi-Emperors, for they touch upon the Emperor’s realm and can fight aging Ordinary Emperors.
On the other hand, the post-Immortal Tower Wang Ping relies on the two terrifyingly established constitutions to match the special physique of top Quasi-Emperors in the Perfect Domain, but there is a one percent difference in terms of the comprehension of the True Spirit of Heavenly Dao. Although Emperor Scripture and their Dao cultivation can compensate for some advantage, the assistance of talent effects is uncertain whether they can fight with a top Quasi-Emperor.
As for the Chaotic Body, although the Chaotic Body was strong and performed brilliantly in the secret realm, they only defeated those youngsters with the highest cultivation levels in the Half-step Supreme.
At that time, the younger generation could develop their physique to Minor Domain, and hardly anyone could comprehend the real rules, so by relying on the undeveloped Chaotic Body, they could easily dominate them.
Later, when they developed the Time-Space Body to the Minor Domain, their advantage disappeared in an instant, and Wang Ping defeated them easily.
Although the physique is powerful, it needs to be developed.
No matter how strong the Little Chaotic Body is, if it can’t be developed to a Minor Domain, Great Completion, or even Perfect Domain, it is ultimately challenging to transform.
Of course, there is another reason for the inability of the Little Chaotic Body to display its true power.
That is the lack of corresponding Cultivation Skills as well as the Enlightened Heavenly Dao True Spirit.
For example, Wang Ping has the Time-Space Body with the corresponding Time-Space Emperor Sutra and Heavenly Dao True Spirit, so he can naturally unleash its full power.
As for the advantage of Emperor’s artifacts.
Emperor’s artifacts can’t be considered an advantage.
People have Emperor’s artifacts, and others have more Emperor’s artifacts. Besides, who enters the secret realm as a top powerhouse without bringing their Emperor’s artifact from their own forces?
Also, at this level, Emperor’s artifacts can only play a supporting role in combat, and they do not have a decisive effect.
Therefore, the simulated Wang Ping did not hesitate to choose the Seven-Color Talent·Running God to escape.
Because the level of fighting power they have when compared with those old monsters is far apart.
Top Quasi-Emperors are not the majority; don’t even mention the others.
Taiyi Imperial Palace is no more potent than other forces, but they have to face Quasi-Emperors from nearly a hundred Emperor-tier forces and Quasi-Emperor-tier Forces’ Quasi-Emperors.
Under such circumstances, they would die if they didn’t run.
Only, simulated Wang Ping didn’t expect the Seven-Color Talent·Escaping God to be so flawed, directly teleporting them to the Exoteric World of the Dark Emperor.
Of course, with the current fighting power of the simulated Wang Ping, they might indeed be able to fight against an Ordinary Emperor.
After all, Wang Ping, with the help of the Enlightenment Imperial Fruit, has now comprehended 70% of the True Spirit of the Time-Space Heavenly Dao and reached the realm of an Emperor.
Simultaneously, they have also comprehended the Chaos Emperor Sutra and 30% of the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path from it.

chapters.title: Chapter 985: 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 985: Chapter 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _2
Although his understanding of the True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path was only at thirty percent, it was definitely stronger than thirty percent proficiency in the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao. Besides, Wang Ping had already comprehended the Chaos Emperor Sutra and gained its corresponding Divine Skills.
Under such circumstances, even if his Little Chaotic Body was still in a blank state, without any in-depth development, his combat power could still be greatly enhanced.
Upon such comparison, the possibility of battling against an Emperor seemed quite high.
Yet, he was not certain if the reality would turn out as he had guessed.
As various thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the simulation continued.
[Next, you express your gratitude to Yu Daoyi and others for protecting the path. Then, you turn towards Huangqin. Despite being suppressed, her face is full of joy, seemingly reveling in the danger that has befallen Yu Daoyi and the others.]
[In response, you snort coldly, grab Huangqin directly, ignoring her screams and wails, and extract her origin to aid Yu Daoyi’s recovery.]
[Yu Daoyi shakes her head to refuse, suggesting that you need the origin more than she does. However, you frown and insist that she accepts.]
[Caught off guard, Yu Daoyi finally complies and begins to absorb the origin from Huangqin to heal her injuries.]
[At this point, the Dark Disaster breaks out again, and the Dark Beings launch another attack. You narrow your eyes and see through the darkness with the Great Breaking Origin Divine Eye.]
[In the darkness, the Dark Emperor is nowhere to be found, but countless varied Dark Beings are present. Among them are horrifying Dark Beings of 7th-tier Quasi-Emperor or higher, but you no longer consider them a threat.]
[Afterward, you speculate that the Dark Emperor should’ve returned to the Source of Darkness since ordinary Dark Emperors aren’t capable of residing in the outer world for a long time. Separation from the Source of Darkness for too long will make them prone to becoming Mad Demons.]
[For this reason, you instruct Yu Daoyi and the others not to leave the Great Array and, using your Space Divine Skills, tear open the space to face the numerous Dark Beings alone in the outer world.]
[This surprises Yu Daoyi. Although you performed exceedingly well when breaking into the Immortal Tower, that was a battle against opponents of the same realm. Your current cultivation is only at the Peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor, which is relatively low and quite hazardous to venture out alone.]
[However, Yu Daoyi has already begun to absorb the origins from Huangqin to heal, leaving her no choice but to watch anxiously. The other Quasi-Emperors from the Taiyi Imperial Palace are in the same situation.]
[Shortly thereafter, they express their shock as a Dark Being discovered you and launched a terrifying attack. This Dark Being’s combat power reached the level of an ordinary 7th-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[Yet, faced with this Dark Being’s assault, you remain indifferent, barely giving the creature a glance before annihilating it with a wave of your hand, revealing an invincible demeanor.]
[After casually annihilating a Dark Being of the 7th-tier Quasi-Emperor level, you unleash a terrifying Divine Skill. In an instant, you kill several Dark Beings that were rushing towards you. These Dark Beings were of 7th, 8th, and 9th tier Quasi-Emperors respectively. Despite being at ordinary Quasi-Emperor levels, their strength was terrifying.]
[Killing these powerful Dark Beings proved no more difficult for you than killing chickens. With such immense combat power, you’re not a bit weaker than the Top Quasi-Emperors.]
[Suddenly, Yu Daoyi and the others breathe a sigh of relief, believing that your combat power has reached an unfathomable level, completely beyond their comprehension. Especially Yu Daoyi, who deems you an absolute freak, astonishingly capable of skyrocketing your combat power to her level in such a short timespan.]
[It must be kept in mind that you’re only a few hundred years old. There has never been anyone in history who has reached this level in such a short lifespan, even in the most glorious epochs of the Upper Realm.]
[Next, another Dark Being charges at you, this time a Dark Being at the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection level. Again, you remain calm, annihilating it with a casual wave of your hand, without any difficulty.]
[Then, feeling annoyed by these persistent Dark Beings, you execute a terrifying area-of-effect Divine Skill, instantly wiping them all out. Regardless of whether they were Dark Beings of Divine Realm or Saint Realm, or Supreme or Quasi-Emperor stages, none of them stood any chance, with no possibility of survival.]
[Witnessing your astonishing combat record, all the Quasi-emperors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, including Yu Daoyi, are utterly shocked, deeming you a freak. Even the wounded Huangqin seems stunned. She then harbors much remorse, fearing the Phoenix Clan might well face Genocide due to her actions.]
[You disregard the shocked reactions from everyone and glare in the direction of the Source of Darkness, instructing coldly for the Dark Emperor to come forth and die.]
[Your voice echoes throughout the world, and the cultivators witness the sudden suppression of the Dark Disaster, giving hope to all. Many earnestly kneel down and start praying for you, hoping that as this newly emerged strong warrior, you can suppress the Dark Emperor and restore peace to their world.]
[Their world is under the rule of the Dark Emperor, who is ruthless and mad. Every so often, he would instigate a Dark Disaster, slaughtering cultivators Above Saint Realm not just for their vital essence but also to curb the emergence of ones who become a Taoist.]

chapters.title: Chapter 986: 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 986: Chapter 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _3
[It can be said that in this world, the Hei Cang Emperor was the first Emperor of Tao Proving. Since then, he began a reign of terror, suppressing other Daoist sects and slaughtering all living beings who did not submit to him. When his lifespan was nearing its end, all cultivators thought that the reign of terror would come to an end and the World of cultivators would usher in a new life. It was also the time he first fell into darkness.]
[Since then, the Hei Cang Emperor has gone mad completely, causing frequent Dark Disasters and slaughtering all cultivators who have the potential to become emperors. Because of this, the cultivation world of this world has been in a state of half-destruction, causing countless cultivators to despair.]
[Now, they finally see hope, so how can they not be excited and pray devoutly, worshiping you as an immortal god.]
[You are unaware of the situation of cultivators in this realm, you just look coldly in the direction of the Source of Darkness, and shout again, demanding the Hei Cang Emperor to come out and face death.]
[Your words finally enraged the Hei Cang Emperor in the Source of Darkness. He stepped out of the Source of Darkness, glared at you, claiming that you, a mere Quasi-Emperor, dared to challenge him, the great Emperor, and you were courting death.]
[In response, you show a mocking expression, stating that the Dark Emperor is no longer worthy of being called an Emperor, but a decaying and fallen monster. You pause for a moment, and then claim that the Hei Cang Emperor is nothing more than the most ordinary Emperor.]
[These words make the Hei Cang Emperor furious, as his Emperor’s Might sweeps across the universe and launches a terrifying attack on you.]
[As for this, you snort coldly, not moved at all. You’ve already seen that the Hei Cang Emperor in front of you is nothing more than the most ordinary Emperor, and coupled with the fact that he’s already fallen into darkness, he’s unable to unleash his full combat power. Wang Ping is not afraid of him but instead feels rather excited.]
[After all, you are very curious about your own strength at this moment.]
[Right away, you unleash a terrifying Divine Skill, colliding with the Hei Cang Emperor’s attack. This blow is evenly matched, making the Hei Cang Emperor look incredulous.]
[He never expected that there would be an existence in this world that could fight him as a 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor. He never thought that there would be a day when someone would challenge him across so many Great Realms.]
[At that moment, the Hei Cang Emperor was enraged, and his terrifying murderous intent swept out. He refuses to allow such a monstrous existence to exist in this world and threaten his rule.]
[Thus, the Hei Cang Emperor made another move, unleashing even greater combat power without holding back.]
[As for this, you are not afraid but delighted, laughing loudly, going all out in battle. Your left hand unleashes the Chaos Emperor Fist, while your right hand wields the Time-Space Divine Skill, raising your combat power to its peak.]
[This makes the Hei Cang Emperor terrified. He never thought you would have so many terrifying physiques, especially the Little Chaotic Body, the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path, and Divine Skills that make him tremble to the extreme.]
[Yu Daoyi and others, who witness this scene, are equally shocked to the extreme. She never expected that you would also possess a Chaotic Body, and that your other physiques would reach the Great Completion Domain, allowing you to unleash such terrifying combat power. This kind of combat power completely surpasses her.]
[After all, she can only fight an ordinary aging Emperor, but will still be defeated after a long time. Previously, she teamed up with the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace using the Great Array to defend but still was no match for the Dark Emperor, who consumed her to the point that her foundation was severely damaged.]
[As for this, Yu Daoyi can’t help but sigh, thinking that you are really a monster and the most monstrous existence since the birth of the Upper Realm. If the Immortal Tower arranged opponents based on age, then perhaps no one could be your opponent. After all, an Emperor-level combat power at just a few hundred years old is simply too unimaginable for them.]
[At the moment when everyone is shocked, you and the Hei Cang Emperor are fighting madly. During the fight, you also use the Divine skill Neutralization technique. However, you find that when dealing with an Emperor, the effect of Divine Skill Neutralization is not as great anymore. Because the terrifying recovery ability of an Emperor allows them to immediately recover even if attacked and continue fighting. In addition, even if one of the Hei Cang Emperor’s Divine Skills is neutralized, he can immediately use other Divine Skills. Although the effects are definitely not as good as using them at full power, they are not weak either.]
[However, you don’t care about this, fighting more and more excitedly, and going all out in battle. At the same time, the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures also display their might, trying their best to devour the Hei Cang Emperor’s essence and spirit.]
[Although the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures cannot show their previous terrifying devouring nature when facing an Emperor, they can still have an impact on the Hei Cang Emperor. This impact may not be obvious in the short term, but as the battle becomes more intense, it will grow, allowing Wang Ping to gradually gain a great advantage.]
[As the battle continues, several Starfields have been destroyed due to your fighting, with countless living beings dying in misery. In the end, the Hei Cang Emperor’s sense of crisis becomes even stronger.]
[He discovers that he cannot defeat you. Even worse, if the battle drags on, he may be killed by you. This makes the Hei Cang Emperor afraid.]
[He does not want to fall and certainly does not want to be slain by your hands, a mere 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor.]
[For this reason, he directly tries to repel you and escape into the Source of Darkness. Seeing this, you snort coldly and immediately chase after him, wanting to kill him completely. After all, after you were teleported to this world, you are not sure if you can return to your original world. Under such circumstances, killing this Dark Emperor is a necessary matter.]

chapters.title: Chapter 987: 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 987: Chapter 262: Exploding and Killing the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Soaring! _4
[You’re not one to hesitate. When you decided to kill the Hei Cang Emperor completely, you used the secret skill that sacrifices self to kill a thousand enemies, unleashing a terrifying attack.]
[This time, you were incredibly lucky and accidentally triggered a tenfold critical damage effect. As a result, your terrifying attack shattered the fleeing Hei Cang Emperor’s physical body, causing massive damage to his divine source.]
[Hei Cang Emperor screamed in pain and fear, never expecting you to possess such terrifying power. As a result, he ran even faster.]
[Seeing this, you frowned and continued to chase him. This time, you didn’t use any terrifying divine skills to attack, as it would consume too much energy. The Hei Cang Emperor was already unable to defend against weaker attacks, and you thought it was a good choice to use a continuous offensive strategy to try to trigger Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[After all, it hadn’t been triggered in the previous major battle, and it might be time for Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound to take effect.]
[Yu Daoyi and the others were shocked at seeing you beat the Hei Cang Emperor to such an extent, with the possibility of killing him, and once again marveled at your monstrous strength.]
[In the Upper Realm, there were few examples of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection cultivators killing Ordinary Emperors, even if they were old and weakened. If they did kill an extremely weak Emperor, they might be dragged down with them.]
[The previous generation’s Devouring Immortal Demon Body was a rare example of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection cultivator who killed an old Ordinary Emperor. However, her fate was widely known; after defeating the old Ordinary Emperor, her divine source was damaged, and she was killed by Emperor Fengxin.]
[But you’ve managed to kill a Dark Emperor with 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor cultivation. Although this Dark Emperor is not comparable to a real uncorrupted Ordinary Emperor, he is not as weak as an old Ordinary Emperor either. If your victory is spread back to the Upper Realm, it may amaze everyone and become an eternal legend.]
[As everyone was astonished, you gambled correctly and really triggered Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound and Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, killing the Hei Cang Emperor on the spot.]
[With this, the Hei Cang Emperor perished, and a Dark Emperor fell by your hand. You have achieved the great feat of killing an Emperor.]
[As the Hei Cang Emperor’s fall caused his Emperor’s aura to gradually disappear, all the cultivators in this world who could sense it were shocked, then ecstatic and prostrating with gratitude.]
[After killing the Hei Cang Emperor, you were elated and extremely pleased. Unconsciously, you had come this far, which was both exciting and sigh-inducing.]
[Recalling your various deaths when you had just transmigrated, your current strength could only be described as bittersweet.]
[Next, you didn’t dwell on your past and chose to stay vigilant to prevent the Hei Cang Emperor’s resurrection. Of course, you didn’t destroy his corpse. After all, even though the Emperor’s divine source was severely damaged by your attack, it was still extremely valuable. If the three Devouring Emperor Treasures were allowed to devour it, you could gain many benefits.]
[While you were guarding, Yu Daoyi and the others were completely dumbfounded, unable to believe that you had really killed a Dark Emperor. Then they breathed a sigh of relief and thought they could finally focus on healing their injuries.]
[As Yu Daoyi and the others focused on healing, you guarded for a year without any changes to the Hei Cang Emperor’s corpse. Feeling reassured, you decided to break into his inner world to obtain his hidden treasures.]
[Soon, you reaped astonishing rewards. As the ruler of this world, the Hei Cang Emperor had amassed a vast amount of resources, including countless Extreme-tier Divine Sources and rare Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.]
[Among them, a blood lotus caught your attention. The blood lotus was filled with terrifying blood spirit and resentment, as if it had absorbed the souls of countless living beings, making it extremely eerie.]
[You couldn’t help but suspect that the Hei Cang Emperor committed heinous acts to cultivate this blood lotus. Indeed, during the years you guarded, cultivators from this world came to pay homage and informed you of the situation.]
[So, you were aware of the situation in this world and the Hei Cang Emperor’s notoriety.]
[Observing the blood lotus, you felt that it hadn’t fully matured yet. If it were to fully mature, its medicinal efficacy would be extremely terrifying, perhaps enabling an Emperor’s cultivation to soar considerably.]
[However, the blood lotus was born in a violent manner, and the resentment and curse it contains are extremely terrifying. If ingested carelessly, it could have a terrible impact on an Emperor.]
[After some consideration, you decided not to consume it directly but to find a way to dissolve its resentment and curse before consuming it or allowing the Devouring Spirit Pearl or Devouring Mana Pearl to absorb and convert it into pure mana and vital energy, at the cost of wasting much of its medicinal effectiveness; your priority was safety.]
[Of course, you’re not sure if the Devouring Emperor Artifacts can consume the strange blood lotus without ill effects. However, since it’s a simulation, you can still attempt it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 988: 262: Assassinating the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Skyrockets! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 988: Chapter 262: Assassinating the Dark Emperor! Cultivation Skyrockets! _5
[However, you don’t plan to attempt this now, but to wait until the Blood Lotus is fully matured to try.]
[Next, you seal the body of Hei Cang Emperor and store it in your inner world, then return to Yu Daoyi’s side, pondering how to get back to the Upper Realm.]
[The Seven-color talent·Running God talent has a broader teleportation range than the Golden Talent: Transmission, can teleport more people at once, and even Emperors can’t restrain it. However, its cooldown time is incredibly long, taking tens of thousands of years to fully reset.]
[Therefore, hoping to return to the Upper Realm quickly using the Seven-color talent·Running God is unrealistic. Besides, this ability’s teleportation is entirely random, and you worry it might teleport you to some strange place.]
[After some thought, you decide it’s not necessary to overthink. It’s better to earnestly cultivate in this world. Cultivating to the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier or even the Emperor Tier here would not waste this simulation. As for the future of the Upper Realm, it’s none of your business and you can’t control it anyway.]
[Rather, coming to this world might be a good thing. After all, the Upper Realm is in the Last Dharma Age. It won’t be long before the Golden Age is upon them, and the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion will set a trap to refine them, leading to a tragic end. Staying in this world is more conducive to cultivation.]
[Thinking of this, you explain the situation to Yu Daoyi. Yu Daoyi sighs, feeling that there is no other choice. Although she fears that most of the Quasi-Emperors and Supremes of the Taiyi Imperial Palace fleeing to other worlds might lead to Taiyi Imperial Palace’s weakest period, causing great stress for her father, there’s no solution if everyone can’t return.]
[After discussing, you two plan to establish a doctrine in this world and spread the name of the Taiyi Imperial Palace here.]
[For this purpose, you took action and established a doctrine in the most prosperous starfield in this world. Given that you killed Hei Cang Emperor, your reputation is terrifying to the extreme.]
[As a result, most cultivators in this universe fantasize about joining the Taiyi Imperial Palace and becoming disciples of Taiyi.]
[You anticipated this and set a very high threshold. Only prodigies with saint potential qualifications can become Outer Disciples of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[The entry requirements for this world are undoubtedly very high, but it can’t deter the enthusiasm of cultivators. After all, the Taiyi Imperial Palace, which has Emperor-level combat power and a bunch of Quasi-Emperors and Supremes, is the strongest force ever. If one joins, it will definitely benefit everyone involved.]
[Under these circumstances, the Taiyi Imperial Palace quickly flourished.]
[About this, you have no intention of managing it, leaving it to your Supreme of Taiyi Imperial Palace. You, along with Yu Daoyi and Quasi-emperor Ancestors, all went into closed-door cultivation.]
[Through the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Mana Pearl, and Devouring Soul Pearl, you devour Hei Cang Emperor and turn it into your own power. The process is quite slow because the Emperor is so powerful that the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures must transform slowly. At the same time, although your combat power is strong, your cultivation level is not high enough, and you must slowly absorb and refine it. Otherwise, eating too much at once could easily lead to a disaster.]
[In a blink of an eye, ten thousand years have passed. During these ten thousand years, you have been cultivating hard. Cultivating is mainly about improving your cultivation level, physical strength, and soul strength. You have no intention of cultivating in other areas.]
[Eventually, your cultivation level steadily improved to the 9th-tier Quasi-Emperor over these ten thousand years.]
[If the news of raising your cultivation level from the peak of the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor to the 9th-tier Quasi-Emperor within a mere ten thousand years were to get out, it would certainly shock countless cultivators.]
[After all, at the Quasi-Emperor tier, if one could ascend a minor realm within ten thousand years, they would already be considered freakishly talented. Let alone ascending straight from the 3rd-tier Quasi-Emperor to the 9th-tier Quasi-Emperor, rising six realms at once.]
[Even though this is due to the assistance of the Devouring Emperor’s artifact, it’s still terrifying.]
[But, you’re still not entirely satisfied with your cultivation. Because you’ve realized you might have taken a wrong path on your Dao.]
[During the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, especially when breaking through to Supreme, it’s crucial to refine a Tao Fruit, which essentially determines the future path. Once it breaks through to the Emperor, this path is firmly established.]
[You refined the Time-Space Tao Fruit when you broke through to Supreme, and while it’s powerful, it ultimately can’t compare to the Chaos Tao Fruit.]

chapters.title: Chapter 989: 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 989: Chapter 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!
“Finally, I’ve reached a level where I can beat ordinary emperors, but did I take the wrong path? No, it’s not that I went the wrong way, the Time-Space Tao Fruit was already the strongest I could achieve without the Little Chaotic Body. Without the Little Chaotic Body, it’s impossible to comprehend the Chaos Emperor Sutra and the principles of Chaos, so forming a Chaos Tao Fruit would be out of the question.”
Wang Ping was looking at the text simulation and thinking to himself.
“So, the path ahead should be clear.”
Then, Wang Ping shook his head and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Next, after considering it, you will condense another Tao Fruit, forming a pair of Time-Space and Chaos Tao Fruits. This will undoubtedly be a path that no one has ever walked before, but you want to try it. If successful, your combat power will undoubtedly soar once more.]
[For this, you begin to try various methods, and work hard in your studies.]
[In the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of years have passed, and your cultivation has long been elevated to the Great Perfection Tier of the Quasi-Emperor realm. At the same time, you have an idea of ​​how to condense the Chaos Tao Fruit.]
[For this, you took action by refining the Red Treasure Lotus with the three Devouring Emperor Treasures, using their terrifying energy for various experiments. Finally, after tens of thousands of years and countless setbacks, you were severely injured several times due to experiments. However, in the end, you successfully condensed the Chaos Tao Fruit. To be precise, it was a Little Chaos Tao Fruit.]
[However, when the Little Chaos Tao Fruit appeared, you discovered a strange phenomenon. You originally thought that the appearance of the Chaos Tao Fruit would cause the Time-Space Tao Fruit to exhibit a stress response, but nothing like that happened.]
[Instead of exhibiting a stress response, the Time-Space Tao Fruit revolved around the Little Chaos Tao Fruit and eventually formed a strange fusion phenomenon. This scene both frightened and alerted you of a sense of fatal danger. In response, you attempted to control the situation using all your strength, and the talents of Death Replacement Puppet and Damage Invalid, allowing you to barely survive this change.]
[In the end, your Time-Space Tao Fruit and the Little Chaos Tao Fruit transformed into a brand new Tao Fruit, the True Chaos Tao Fruit.]
[With the emergence of the Chaos Tao Fruit, you heaved a sigh of relief and were ecstatic. You also gained various insights and understood many principles.]
[As it turns out, the True Chaotic Body contains the Time-Space Tao. With this, you finally understood that Predecessor Transmigrator, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, placed himself in the Time-Space Forbidden Zone. It is evident that the nine attributes of the Nine Mini Universes are the basic attributes for forming a Little Chaotic Body, with time and space being the most important attribute, ranked ahead of the other nine.]
[Because of this, the Pavilion Master secluded himself in the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, making it the most critical node in the array, activating the Great Array, refining the Upper Realm, achieving the perfect Chaotic Body, and ascending to immortality.]
[At this thought, you couldn’t help but get excited. If that’s the case, perhaps you can use your Time-Space Body and Little Chaotic Body to attempt to obtain a True Chaotic Body.]
[If it were in the original Upper Realm, it might be impossible to obtain a Chaotic Body since the Upper Realm can only have one Little Chaotic Body and one Chaotic Body, with no conditions for the birth of the first Chaotic Body.]
[But this is another world. Other worlds don’t have this limitation, so maybe, if you study it, you can obtain a True Chaotic Body. Even if you fail to obtain a True Chaotic Body after a successful fusion, you can still have the Little Chaotic Body transform again, without the defect of being unable to develop further.]
[For this, you continued to seclude yourself, studying these matters.]
[In the blink of an eye, another hundred thousand years have passed. During these hundred thousand years, you studied the methods of merging the Time-Space Body and Little Chaotic Body, turning them into a Chaotic Body.]
[In the end, you did not succeed in merging them. Because you discovered something – to merge them, you seem to need to reach the realm of Great Perfection with your Time-Space Body. And to reach the realm of Great Perfection with your Time-Space Body, you need the purest Temporal Origin and Space Origin.]
[You sighed in your heart, not expecting that you would walk in circles and come back to the same point. At first, you wanted to obtain a Space Origin, and then combine it with the Temporal Origin in the Jee Family’s Secret Realm to further evolve the Time-Space Body. However, because you couldn’t obtain the Space Origin, this matter was put on hold.]
[Now, you have another reason to obtain the purest Space Origin or the Emperor’s Origin of a Great Emperor who walks the path of space. Although it’s still difficult to obtain such a thing, you have already become strong enough to have enough combat power to obtain the origin of a Spatial Emperor.]
[Of course, since you are trapped in this world and cannot go back, you can only suppress this idea for now. As for using the Seven-color talent·Running God to try to teleport back, you didn’t have any such idea.]
[After all, the uncertainty of the Seven-color talent·Running God is too great, and it could accidentally kill you all. As a result, instead of risking it, you might as well spend the rest of your life in this world.]
[In the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of years have passed again. During these tens of thousands of years, you have not continued to think about the Chaotic Body, but asked the strong people of the Taiyi Imperial Palace to see if they could find the Temporal Origin and Space Origin in this world.]

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 990: Chapter 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_2
[In addition, you are specifically nurturing spatial talents, hoping that they can prove themselves as emperors in the future. By then, once they become emperors, it would be an option to utilize their source.]
[Apart from that, over these tens of thousands of years, you have re-cultivated the Chaos Emperor Sutra and the true spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path. Previously, you had realized that the Chaos Emperor Sutra and the true spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path were incomplete since you learned that the true path of Chaos integrated spatial attributes, and prioritized spatial attributes. Hence, completing them is vital.]
[However, this is not troublesome. After all, you have studied the Time-Space Tao and the Chaos Dao deeply over the years. As a result, you have completed the Chaos Emperor Sutra, and combined the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao with the original Lesser Chaos Heavenly Tao True Spirit to form the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path, attaining sixty percent mastery.]
[But, due to the lack of Enlightenment Imperial Fruits, understanding the Chaos Path indeed proves difficult and requires a considerable amount of time. Even you, cannot make further progress in a short time, reaching seventy percent mastery of the True Spirits of Chaos Heavenly Path to enter the Great Completion Domain, the realm of Great Emperor.]
[In the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of years have passed. During these years, you no longer secluded yourself in cultivation, and your relationship with Yu Daoyi has made astonishing progress, making her your Tao Companion. Yu Daoyi has also given birth to your descendants.]
[By the way, in these years, Yu Daoyi has fully recovered from her injuries and took that crucial step to become an emperor, becoming the second Great Emperor in this world. The first Great Emperor is, undoubtedly, the fallen Hei Cang Emperor.]
[While you spend time with Yu Daoyi, discussing Tao and raising your children together, an unexpected event occurs.]
[This surprise is the outbreak of the Source of Darkness, leading to the appearance of numerous dark beings. These dark beings are too powerful, with none of them below the supreme-tier. They could be described as the supreme beings swarming around like earthworms, Quasi-Emperors being like dogs.]
[This terrifying change has turned the faces of you and Yu Daoyi pale as you teleport yourselves into the cosmic starry sky, gazing at the raging Source of Darkness from a distance.]
….
“Good fellow, I didn’t expect to accidentally obtain another method to condense the Chaotic Body. In other words, it seems that I no longer need the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits. Or maybe not. Perhaps when the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits are gathered, they can help me develop the Chaotic Body, allowing it to quickly reach the Lesser Completion and even the Great Completion Domain.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of this text simulation and feels a mix of emotions.
This time, it is a breakthrough transformation.
Wang Ping does not know how strong the simulated Wang Ping’s abilities have become now.
However, after becoming Tao companions with Yu Daoyi, the Source of Darkness suddenly erupted. Could it be that there is a real marriage-death rule?
Wang Ping thought of the outbreak of the Source of Darkness and his eyes became mysterious.
“I can’t always blame it on getting married or finding a Tao partner. After all, even if you don’t find a Tao partner, you will die in the end, it’s just a matter of whether it’s sooner or later.”
Immediately, Wang Ping shook his head, gave up the strange idea, and began to think about the right course of action.
Speaking of which, this outbreak of the Source of Darkness, he doesn’t know whether it’s just the Source of Darkness in this world, or all the Sources of Darkness in the lower planes attached to the Immortal Domain. If so, wouldn’t that be a major catastrophe predicted by the Immortal Mansion?
If that’s the case, he would have gotten a good piece of intelligence, figuring out the timing of the catastrophe.
If it’s not a coordinated outbreak across multiple worlds, it would be a purely sporadic event.
As Wang Ping contemplated, the life simulation continued.
[You and Yu Daoyi become grave as you begin to suppress and kill the dark beings that charged towards you. However, due to the overwhelming number of dark beings, even you couldn’t protect all living beings in the universe.]
[As a result, countless living beings were slaughtered mercilessly, left with no chance of survival.]
[At this moment, a new twist occurs: two emperor-tier dark beings were born, gazing at you. They then launched an attack on you.]
[Facing these two emperor-tier dark beings, Yu Daoyi took action and fought fiercely with one, quickly gaining a significant advantage. The strength of these two emperor-tier dark beings is equivalent to that of the Hei Cang Emperor, and cannot be compared with Yu Daoyi’s emperor status. After all, Yu Daoyi possesses a top divine physique, attaining the Perfect Domain and ranks as top tier among the same realm battle power of Great Emperors.]
[As for you, when faced with one of the emperor-tier dark beings, you remained indifferent and destroyed it with a single punch, completely extinguishing it like casually stepping on an ant.]
[However, although you killed one of the emperor-tier dark beings, it seemed to have attracted the attention of the Source of Darkness, and more emperor-tier dark beings appeared, surrounding you and Yu Daoyi.]
[You observed these thousands of dark beings with emperor-level combat power and fell into silence. Even though you were aware of the terrifying origins of the Source of Darkness, this horror was too much; they could casually create emperor-tier dark beings, each one stronger than the previous. Even more so, you sensed some dark beings that were comparable to the Great Emperor Heavenly Feather who had reached the Perfect Emperor Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 991: Chapter 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_3
[Facing such a situation, even if your battle power is strong, there is no chance of survival. After all, even though your same realm battle power is against the heavens, you’ve reached the level of easily crushing ordinary Emperors with a wave of your hand, you still haven’t become an Emperor. Facing these powerful dark beings, you cannot be their opponent.]
[Yu Daoyi also looks at these dark beings and falls silent. However, after glancing at you, she knows your thoughts.]
[Then she came to your side, and you didn’t hesitate to use your terrifying Time-Space Divine Skill to return to Taiyi Imperial Palace. As many dark beings are about to attack, you wanted to use the Seven-Color Talent·Running God to escape with Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[However, the frustrating situation happens, the Source of Darkness erupts, and its existence level evidently far exceeds that of Emperor-tier. Although the Seven-Color Talent·Running God cannot be stopped even by an emperor, in front of the Source of Darkness, the Seven-Color Talent is nothing.]
[In the end, you failed to teleport successfully.]
[Seeing that it was impossible to teleport and escape, you and Yu Daoyi could only fight side by side and battled with the dark beings.]
[As a result, you were beaten to death during this terrifying dark catastrophe and completely fell.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends here…]
…..
As the text simulation ends, various insights and memories appear in Wang Ping’s mind.
Finally, his figure appears in the universe, seeing the scene of simulated Wang Ping and Yu Daoyi falling.
“Still dead, this is really frustrating.”
Wang Ping shakes his head as he watches this scene.
However, this is normal. Faced with the Source of Darkness, not only emperors, even Quasi-Fairies would fall. As for whether immortals could survive, it is unknown.
While Wang Ping is filled with emotions, his consciousness trembles, his vision changes, and he returns to the real world. The system’s voice also echoes.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The host must choose two of the following rewards:
①.Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation (including Chaos Tao Fruit).
②.Seven-Color Talent·Running God.
③.A random Quasi-Emperor artifact.
④.A random quasi-Emperor-tier Treasure Elixir.”
…
Wang Ping looks at the choices for this reward, his eyes shining, and he already has an answer in his heart.
This time, he must choose cultivation. Continuing to hold on to his cultivation has no meaning.
Furthermore, this time the Life Simulator reminds him that he must make a choice.
The last required choice left a deep impression on Wang Ping.
If he hadn’t chosen, he would have been dead.
This time, there must be a hint.
Immediately, Wang Ping makes a choice, whispering in his heart: “System, I choose ①.Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation and ②.Seven-Color Talent·Running God.”
As Wang Ping makes his choice, his cultivation begins to soar rapidly.
Earth Emperor!
Heaven Emperor!
1st-tier Quasi-Emperor!
4th-tier Quasi-Emperor!
7th-tier Quasi-Emperor!
9th-tier Quasi-Emperor!
Until Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection!
When his cultivation skyrocketed to Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection, Wang Ping felt refreshed and invincible.
“Now that I haven’t reached the limit of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection battle power, once I obtain the true Chaotic Body and comprehend the True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path to 70%, my combat power will rise again. At that time, I will definitely reach the top of the Immortal Tower.”
Wang Ping secretly thinks to himself, completely confident in himself.
Of course, even now Wang Ping feels that he can take the top spot in the Immortal Tower.
If someone is still stronger than him with this kind of configuration, there’s really nothing to say.
Just when Wang Ping suppresses his energy and is filled with emotions, a sudden fluctuation in space appears in the secret realm where the Dark Time Imperial Clan is located.
This makes Wang Ping’s pupils constrict slightly, raises his head to look in the direction of the space fluctuation, and frowns.
“It seems that something really happened. My Life Simulator has reminded me again.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker, and he mutters to himself.
The first time the Life Simulator presented a required option, he encountered a lethal threat.
Now, it has reminded him again, and then a real anomaly occurred.
There are so many secrets to his Life Simulator.
It seems that an opportunity must be found to ask Alpha about the origin of the Gold Finger for the transmigrators and how it came to be.
In Wang Ping’s view now, Alpha doesn’t have the ability to grant him such a golden finger.
The uniqueness of his golden finger is clearly unparalleled among the other group members.
As Wang Ping contemplates, a figure dressed in a blue robe steps out from space, standing in the void, looking down condescendingly at the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
Then, a terrifying Emperor’s Might suddenly permeates, wanting to suppress and kill all the members of the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
In response, Wang Ping’s eyes show a cold light, he snorts coldly, takes one step forward, and comes to the Void. He also bursts out with terrifying energy, blocking the Emperor’s Might directly, crushing it, and protecting the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
This sudden situation stuns all the members of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, who look at the sky in horror.
They didn’t expect the secret realm to be invaded by an emperor.
At the same time, they didn’t think you would have such powerful cultivation, being able to block the pressure of an emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 992: Chapter 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_4
“Which Myriad Heavens Force are you from? Why are you attacking the Dark Time Imperial Clan?”
Wang Ping’s face was cold and indifferent, staring at the Emperor who suddenly appeared and attacked the Dark Time Imperial Clan, questioning him.
In the Life Simulator, there had never been a situation where an Emperor intruded into the secret realm where the Dark Time Imperial Clan was hidden and attacked them.
This means, this is an abnormal situation that has occurred during the real-world passage of time after he completed the immersive simulation.
The Emperor before him was definitely from the Myriad Heavens, and very likely just like the Slaughter Saint from Slaughter Paradise, had just returned from the Myriad Heavens Paradise or another world.
So, this Emperor had never appeared in the previous simulations, let alone a situation where he attacked the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
“Junior, do you think I came here for the Dark Time Imperial Clan?”
The Blue Robed Emperor stared at Wang Ping, squinting his eyes and slowly opening his mouth.
“Are you from the Second Generation Chat Group? Are you here to kill me?”
Hearing this, Wang Ping’s pupils slightly constricted, and he said in a deep voice.
That Alpha guy, he said there were only four Predecessor_transmigrators in this world.
The first generation’s Leng Yue.
The two Semi-saints and Wind Demon Supreme of the second generation.
Now, why did another Predecessor_transmigrator come out?
“You’re very smart, you have secrets that even shock me, you were able to grow to this point in such a short time. To be honest, I am somewhat afraid of your growth rate. It seems that Alpha has established the Third Generation Chat Group and made some changes.”
The Blue Robed Emperor stared at Wang Ping, squinting his eyes.
“Hehe, our generation of group members does indeed have a lot of benefits, you get a Golden Finger as soon as you join, do you want to come back?”
Wang Ping’s mouth slightly curled up, and he grinned an invitation.
“Golden Finger? That stingy Alpha actually did something like this? It seems that the destruction of the previous two generations has indeed had a big impact on her, allowing her to see sense. In this regard, you younger generations should be grateful to us predecessors. Without us, there would be no benefits for you now.”
The Blue Robed Emperor frowned slightly and spoke indifferently.
“I am indeed grateful to you for that. So, as a thank you, aren’t I trying to invite you back?”
Wang Ping chuckled and invited him again.
“Hehe, at this point, do you think there’s any chance we’ll be accepted by Alpha? It’s just a matter of life and death between us.”
The Blue Robed Emperor sneered coldly, full of murderous intent.
“No, if you could come back, I think you would like to. After all, the incident back then had nothing to do with you, it was the idea of the Second-generation Group Leader and a few old foxes, and they joined forces with Slaughter Paradise to do such a thing.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“So, you can only oppose us. One, you know that the chance of Alpha accepting you again is extremely low, and you don’t want to be controlled by Alpha again. Finally, and most importantly, you can’t actually leave the Second Generation Chat Group now. With the Second Generation Group Leader’s character, anyone who dares have this idea will mysteriously die.”
“Junior, you’re really smart.”
The Blue Robed Emperor’s killing intent subsided, and he was silent for a while.
Obviously, Wang Ping had guessed their situation correctly.
The Second Generation Chat Group situation is relatively dark, and the Second Generation Group Leader’s control over them is actually greater than Alpha’s control back then.
However, the Second Generation Chat Group would not force them to deal with the strange, but their lives were also in the hands of the Second Generation Chat Group Leader.
Because the Second-generation Group Leader was a traitor, he was even more afraid of being betrayed by his subordinates.
“Unfortunately, you’re still too impulsive in your actions. If you hadn’t killed Wind Demon Supreme, the powerful forces in the Second Generation Chat Group wouldn’t have noticed your abnormal growth rate, and those big shots wouldn’t have spent a great deal of effort to send me to this world to kill you.”
The Blue Robed Emperor sighed and the killing intent surged again.
“So, it was that time when I exposed myself?”
Wang Ping was not surprised by the Blue Robed Emperor’s words.
After all, he had thought of this when he went to deal with Wind Demon Supreme.
Going up against Wind Demon Supreme might have attracted the attention of the Second Generation Chat Group.
However, Wang Ping also remembered what Alpha had once said.
Alpha said that the situation in the Profound World was special, and the strong people from the Second Generation Chat Group couldn’t come over.
Now it seems, that was a big lie.
It wasn’t that they couldn’t come, it was just that he wasn’t worth the effort for the Second Generation Chat Group to spend a lot of effort to come to this world and pursue him.
However, after he showed the strength to kill Wind Demon Supreme, he was noticed by the bigshots of the Second Generation Chat Group, who directly spent a lot of effort to send a Great Emperor level power to come, which really flattered him.
Wang Ping even suspected that after this time, his strength and growth rate would be exposed even more, and next time another kind of Predecessor_transmigrator would come to deal with him.
This really forced him to become stronger quickly.
Not to mention what would happen later, if it wasn’t for the Life Simulator warning him twice earlier on, he would really have to spend a lot of effort to solve the crisis.
“I never said they couldn’t come, I just said that those at the level of Second Generation Chat Group Leader couldn’t come.”
At this moment, Alpha’s voice sounded, clarifying a little.

chapters.title: Chapter 993: 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 993: Chapter 263: Receiving Cultivation! The Real Emperor Battle!_5
This made Wang Ping squint his eyes and recalled what Alpha had said before.
It seemed to be true.
That is to say, immortal level combat powers above the Great Emperors could not easily come to this world.
With that, he felt relieved.
If immortal level combat powers could come, he would be done for and would have to seriously consider running away.
“There’s a flaw!”
As Wang Ping was thinking about various ideas, the Blue Robed Emperor suddenly made his move. Terrifying mana surged out and condensed into a sea dragon that attacked Wang Ping.
With this, Wang Ping frowned.
Instead of counterattacking or defending immediately, he thought of the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
Originally, he had come to the Dark Time Imperial Clan to hide, but these people ended up becoming a burden, making it difficult for him to let loose and forced him to protect them.
However, Wang Ping soon revealed a smile.
Due to the explosion of the Blue Robed Emperor’s Divine Skills, the hidden Great Array laid down by the Dark Time Emperor Monarch was activated, and it began to move the Dark Time Imperial Clan members to safety.
In other words, Wang Ping no longer had to worry about the people of the Dark Time Imperial Clan and could fully engage in a battle with the Blue Robed Emperor.
The Blue Robed Emperor also noticed the transfer of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, but he didn’t care much and only focused his attention on Wang Ping.
When he saw that Wang Ping had no intention of defending, he couldn’t help but frown, thinking that this younger generation was too arrogant and lacked combat experience.
However, remembering that Wang Ping had grown to this point in such a short time thanks to Alpha’s favor, he became a little relieved.
For a moment, Wang Ping was labeled in his mind as a greenhouse flower with only strength and some special capacity.
Such a guy would be easily defeated by him even if they were at the same Great Realm, let alone one Great Realm lower.
However, the next second, the Blue Robed Emperor revealed a surprised expression.
Because when Wang Ping was attacked by the sea dragon, the space-time around him began to distort.
Then, the terrifying sea dragon with enough power to destroy a whole starfield disappeared as if it had never existed.
“A space-time ability? It is a troublesome ability.”
The Blue Robed Emperor frowned, his expression becoming a bit more solemn.
It seemed that Wang Ping was not lacking in combat experience, but was just simply fearless due to his strength.
“Aren’t you curious why I can easily fight you with just a quasi-Emperor Great Perfection cultivation?”
Wang Ping looked at the Blue Robed Emperor and found that he was only a bit solemn and not too surprised, which was quite unexpected.
In the life simulation, other cultivators would have been shocked at his terrifying performance.
“There’s nothing to be surprised about. There are too many freaks in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms. Besides, the strength of cultivation and the amount of energy have never been the key factors in determining victory.”
The Blue Robed Emperor said indifferently.
“Once you go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, you will have a profound understanding of this. The premise is that you still have a chance to go there.”
After a pause, the Blue Robed Emperor spoke again.
As his words fell, he once again used a terrifying Divine Skill to attack Wang Ping.
Wang Ping also kept the Blue Robed Emperor’s words in mind, his facial expression still calm, using Divine Skills to easily block the Blue Robed Emperor’s attack.
As the two attacks collided, a terrifying aftermath erupted, completely destroying the secret realm where the Dark Time Imperial Clan was located.
The two of them also appeared in the Cosmic Starry Sky amidst the Spatial Turbulence.
As the two appeared in the Cosmic Starry Sky, their fearsome auras and oppressive forces instantly spread to extremely distant starfields, causing countless powerful cultivators to look sideways and reveal shocked expressions.
They never expected that an Emperor’s battle would suddenly break out in the Last Dharma Age.
“No, it’s not right. This isn’t an Emperor’s battle. Although there is indeed one Emperor, the other one seems to only have a quasi-Emperor Great Completion Tier cultivation?”
Soon, an Emperor discovered the anomaly and showed a shocked expression.
After all, battles between quasi-Emperors and Emperors were rare.
Usually, it would be top quasi-Emperors fighting against elderly ordinary Emperors.
But the situation before them was different from usual.
The Blue Robed Emperor was not an elderly ordinary Emperor but a prime-age Emperor at his peak.
Although it seemed that the Blue Robed Emperor had no special physique and could be considered an ordinary Emperor, his cultivation had reached the mid-Emperor level.
It must be known that there were only four minor realms in the realm of Emperors: the initial stage, the middle stage, the late stage, and the Perfect Emperor Realm.
Therefore, the gap between each minor realm among Emperors was even greater than in other realms.
A mid-stage Emperor and an early-stage Emperor were not at all on the same level.
However, now there was a cultivator of the Great Perfection quasi-Emperor who could fight against a prime-age mid-stage Emperor, which was truly abnormal.

chapters.title: Chapter 994: 264: Invincible Quasi-Emperor! Cold Moon Takes Action!
chapters.content:
Chapter 994: Chapter 264: Invincible Quasi-Emperor! Cold Moon Takes Action!
“Is that the Young Master?”
“When did the young master’s cultivation reach the Quasi-Emperor Great Completion Tier? And he can even fight with an Emperor.”
“Devouring Source Body, truly terrifying! After devouring the divine source, he can increase his cultivation to this level in such a short time.”
At this moment, the three quasi-Emperor Ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, who were wandering in the Big Universe, also noticed the great battle. Having discovered that one of the people in the battle was Wang Ping, they all gasped in surprise, feeling a chill down their spines.
This Devouring Source Body, it’s truly abnormal. Only a few months have passed, and it has allowed Wang Ping to advance multiple realms.
“That’s not right, the advancement in cultivation can be explained by the Devouring Source Body, but what about this Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra and the 70% space-time great dao true spirit?”
The First Elder Ancestor murmured to himself again.
“This…..”
The Second Elder Ancestor and the Third Elder Ancestor also looked at each other, feeling that Wang Ping was hiding too many things.
However, they could no longer hold him accountable at this time. They could only feel shock and excitement. Following such a prodigy, the future of their Dark Time Imperial Clan was promising indeed.
While everyone was in shock, the intense battle between Wang Ping and the Blue Robed Emperor had reached its climax. The range of the battle expanded, destroying several starfields. The Time-Space Divine Skills twisted the Void and disrupted time and space. The Water Divine Skills created unbelievable phenomena in the starfield. Heavy water covered the Milky Way, shattering time and space.
“Youngster, I have to admit that you are stronger than I had imagined. Creating your own Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra, fully mastering your Time-Space Body and obtaining 70% true spirit of the Time-Space Heavenly Tao, and even mastering the Breaking Origin Sky Eye certainly gave you the power to fight an early-stage emperor and even kill them. Even against a middle-stage emperor like me, you still have the power to fight.”
The Blue Robed Emperor spoke with a solemn expression on his face.
“However, the strength you’ve shown so far is not enough to defeat me.”
After a pause, the Blue Robed Emperor’s eyes became sharp, and with a turn of his words, he unleashed the full power of his Eighty Water-Heaven Spirit.
Every increase in the Heavenly Tao True Spirit marks a complete transformation.
Eighty percent is much more powerful than seventy percent.
Although the Time-Space Heavenly Tao True Spirit is extremely powerful and surpasses the ordinary Heavenly Tao True Spirit, eighty percent is still stronger than seventy percent.
However, what the Blue Robed Emperor relied on the most was his cultivation, which was much stronger than Wang Ping’s.
With the unleashing of his Eighty Water-Heaven Spirit, countless Emperor Water turned black, carrying an unimaginable corrosive power that was extremely heavy and could even corrode time and space.
As a result, the balanced battle began to change, and Wang Ping gradually began to be suppressed.
Although it was only a direct clash that caused the suppression, and Wang Ping could still handle it calmly if they engaged in a guerrilla fight, Wang Ping didn’t want to do so.
Wang Ping had finally become so strong and wanted to fight the Emperor head-on and defeat him.
“The Path of Time and Space is still a bit weaker after all. Since you are serious, I’ll get serious.”
Wang Ping looked at the Blue Robed quasi-Emperor and spoke calmly.
As soon as his words came out, the many strong warriors who were watching the battle became excited, and waves surged in their hearts.
They did not expect that Wang Ping still had something up his sleeve.
Being able to fight evenly with a mid-stage Emperor using the cultivation of a quasi-Emperor Great Completion was already terrifying enough, but he even had hidden reserves. This was quite monstrous.
Such talent, such strength, is indeed rare throughout time.
Soon, Wang Ping put his true trump card into action.
His Time-Space Way started to condense, revealing the Chaos Tao Fruit. The 60% chaos dao true spirit also erupted, causing the entire Upper Realm to shake and exhibit shocking phenomena.
For a time, the Emperors of the Nine Mini Universes all showed shocked expressions, observing the phenomena from afar, not knowing what was happening.
“This is the True Spirit of Chaos Heavenly Path, Chaos Tao Fruit!?”
As Wang Ping got serious and revealed his real trump card, many strong beings contracted their pupils, revealing incredulous looks.
The Path of Chaos has always been only a legend, and no one has ever successfully embarked on this path.
Now, someone has truly walked this path, which is extremely shocking. Even the Emperors couldn’t keep their calm, unable to regain their senses.
Even the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family, who were in a strange state, were shocked awake, casting strange gazes.
“As expected of the Chaos Tao Fruit, even though it’s only a Quasi-Emperor Tao Fruit, it’s comparable to ordinary Great Emperor Tao Fruit. In addition, the 60% True Spirit of Chaos Heavenly Path is even stronger than the ordinary 80% Heavenly Tao True Spirit… It’s really incredible.”
The Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family were amazed.
As Quasi-Immortals, they survived for a very long time and witnessed many astonishing events.
However, they had never seen anyone successfully cultivate the Path of Chaos, let alone condense the Chaos Tao Fruit and understand the 60% True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path.
“The Immortal Gate will open in a hundred thousand years, and now such a monstrous character has appeared. Is this a sign of something?”
The Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family all had various thoughts in their hearts.
“The Path of Chaos….”
At this moment, the Blue Robed Emperor, looking at the power Wang Ping exhibited, also fell silent.
He thought he had highly estimated Wang Ping and guessed that he also didn’t use all his cards, but he never expected that Wang Ping had hidden so much and quietly embarked on this terrifying path of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 995: 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Makes a Move! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 995: Chapter 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Makes a Move! _2
“Since I have already deployed the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path, I invite you to face death,” he said.
Wang Ping stared at the Blue Robed Emperor, his voice icy.
Revealing the Path of Chaos was without a doubt, a foolish decision that would expose him completely to the eyes of all the old monsters around him.
But in Wang Ping’s view, since he had already engaged in battle with the Blue Robed Emperor, his performance would attract the attention of the emperors and emperor monarchs, so he felt he had nothing to lose.
As for the quasi-Immortal.
It was impossible for Wang Ping to conceal the fact that he had condensed the Chaos Tao Fruit from them.
As long as they paid attention to him, they could easily discern that he had condensed the Chaos Tao Fruit.
This was especially true for Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
Therefore, willingly revealing it was not problematic.
After all, Wang Ping still had an escape route. If he genuinely encountered insurmountable danger, he could temporarily retreat, leave the Upper Realm, develop more, return, and annihilate all his enemies.
“You request me to face death? Let’s see if you have the ability to make that happen.”
The Blue Robed Emperor fell silent for a moment before his gaze sharpened.
Then, with a cold snort, he clenched his hands together, choosing to burn his Origin to boost his fighting power to the limit, and display his most potent divine skill.
Immediately, infinite Emperor Water transformed into a cage, completely sealing off the area where Wang Ping and the Blue Robed Emperor were located.
At the same time, a black and red dragon formed and rushed towards Wang Ping with a fierce roar. Wherever it passed, everything turned into nothingness.
Wang Ping remained indifferent, showing no interest in using his Innate Talent: Nullification of Divine Skills.
This time, he wanted to honorably send away the Blue Robed Emperor, a fellow traveler, without relying on any talent.
“Chaos Emperor Fist!”
The next moment, Wang Ping’s gaze became extremely sharp. With his eyes bursting with divine light, he took a step forward, the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path surged, and the anomalies in the whole Upper Realm became even more dazzling.
Immediately after, Wang Ping punched out. Infinite Chaos Spirit transformed into a giant fist, carrying the boundless Emperor’s Might toward the black and red dragon.
As the two collided, space-time disintegrated, and the void trembled.
Finally, the black and red dragon exploded, directly blown apart by Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist. It turned into countless droplets that shot towards the surrounding starfields, devastating many of them.
Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist, after exploding the black and red dragon, continued its unabated momentum towards the Blue Robed Emperor, intending to kill him entirely.
Seeing this, all the Emperors were shocked. Even the top Emperors looked solemn.
The Chaos Emperor Fist displayed by Wang Ping was much too terrifying, far surpassing other Emperor-level divine skills. Even the Immortal Sutras recorded in history might not match the Chaos Emperor Fist.
