“What a Chaos Emperor Scripture, what a Chaos Emperor Fist. Such power, even the Lower-tier Immortal Scripture treasured by my Ku family, is inferior. The Path of Chaos really is the origin of all paths.”
The Ku Family’s quasi-Immortal, on seeing this terrifying punch, was also full of shock, full of praise.
The quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion also felt the same.
Then, the eyes of the two old monsters flickered, and they had many thoughts in their hearts.
As for the Blue Robed Emperor, his face changed dramatically, revealing fear for the first time.
Facing this punch, he couldn’t resist or dodge it, and would be entirely killed, perishing on the spot.
The punch was so terrifying.
However, the Blue Robed Emperor swiftly regained his composure and summoned something resembling a puppet.
With the appearance of this puppet, eerie red light began to emerge, and a figure gradually formed in the red light.
It was a creature that closely resembled a demon from Western myth, its aura was brutal and bloody, yet its power had reached an unprecedented level, far exceeding that of the Emperor Tier.
“Roar!”
After the demon emerged, it let out a roar.
Just one roar shattered Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist. Wang Ping’s face changed, and without hesitation, he activated the effect of Golden Talent: Damage Nullification.
However, the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification obviously couldn’t resist the power of this monster, which exceeded the Emperor Tier. It also failed to produce the desired effect; it didn’t entirely render Wang Ping immune to the damage. He was still shaken, his qi and blood roiling, and his body cracking open.
Even though Wang Ping’s body recovered instantly, he was still injured.
In addition to Wang Ping being injured, the demon’s roar caused the explosion of dozens put starfields in front of him, resulting in their total destruction.
Even an unfortunate ordinary Emperor was affected, with his body also exploding.
Although he quickly restored his body, it was clear that he had suffered severe injuries.
This scene shocked many cultivators. They never thought such a thing would happen.
They originally thought that this imperial war was about to end with a miraculous victory by a cultivator of the Great Perfection quasi-Emperor who was about to overcome the Emperor, which would be the outcome.
But who would have thought that such a twist would occur?
The Blue Robed Emperor summoned a monster far superior to the Emperor Tier. It broke through the Chaos Emperor Fist with just one roar, destroyed dozens of starfields, and almost killed another Emperor who was watching the spectacle.
“This creature is not from our world; it comes from the All Heavens. This terrifying skill, has it reached the realm of Fairy?”
Soon, many Emperors were extremely wary of it. They fully recognized the details of the demon’s bottom line and muttered to themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Takes Action! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 996: Chapter 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Takes Action! _3
Even the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal could not sit still, staring intently at the suddenly appearing demon.
As Quasi-Immortals, they naturally could see more things.
The monster in front of them, judging by its combat power alone, was estimated to have reached the level of a Quasi-Immortal.
Even more so, the two faintly felt that, if they really fought, they might not be a match for this monster.
“What kind of identity does this Quasi-Emperor in front of us have, to actually attract an emperor from outside this realm, and even bring such a terrifying monster.”
All the great emperors and the two Quasi-Immortals had difficulty calming their minds, and began to speculate about Wang Ping’s identity, who was also from the All Heavens.
“Predecessors, you really think highly of me. It was enough to send an emperor to kill me, and now a demon with quasi-Fairy Tier combat power was brought.”
Wang Ping looked at the monster before him, feeling its unparalleled oppressive atmosphere, and sighed.
“I used to think it was overkill too. However, it seems that the greater vision was on that person. I thought that sending me, an emperor, to deal with you, along with this thing, was overrating you and somewhat underestimating me. Now it seems, I was too shallow. To deal with a cheating junior ransmigrator like you, indeed, some big weapons must be prepared.”
The Blue Robed Emperor sighed and slowly spoke.
“Since this thing has been used, junior, you can rest assured to die. I know you want to teleport, but at your level, you should understand that teleportation has a prelude and requires time. Even an emperor can react during this time, let alone a Quasi-Immortal.”
After a pause, the Blue Robed Emperor showed a murderous intent and spoke in a deep voice.
“I’m well aware of that.”
Wang Ping’s expression remained calm, without completely denying what the Blue Robed Emperor said.
He naturally knew the limitations of the chat group teleportation.
However, that would only apply under normal circumstances. If Alpha sacrificed a lot to save him, he could escape from here.
Apparently, Blue Robed Emperor and other Predecessor ransmigrators didn’t think Alpha would care so much about a group member and sacrifice his own interests to save someone.
Perhaps, during the time of the Second Generation Chat Group, these Predecessor ransmigrators had established a fixed impression of Alpha’s actions.
In fact, Alpha was indeed unreliable, there had been so many Great Emperor tier group members who died, and he didn’t care at all.
Maybe, he didn’t even bother when even the Fairy tier died in their missions.
Of course, in Wang Ping’s view, the Blue Robed Emperor was also gambling and trying to scare him.
If his attacking party didn’t know that he was so monstrously powerful and had such advantages before, they would think that Alpha would definitely not protect him.
But with the growth speed and combat strength he showed now, there was a probability that Alpha would change his mind and decide to protect him, and it was not small.
After all, it was obvious that the people in the Second Generation Chat Group could see that Alpha was not the same as before.
“Since you are clear about this point, then die! Kill him for me!”
The Blue Robed Emperor’s face was cold, and he issued a command to the demon.
“Roar!”
Following the Blue Robed Emperor’s command, the demon’s scarlet eyes became even more bizarre. He roared and unleashed a terrifying force, ready to strike at Wang Ping.
At this moment, the many emperors’ eyes were flickering, watching the excitement and not willing to take action.
Even more so, they wished that this monstrous Wang Ping would fall here and now.
Otherwise, once Wang Ping became an Emperor, how strong he would become was unimaginable.
If he did, they could only watch Wang Ping monopolize the Immortal Fate in the future struggle for it.
Such a thing was unbearable for them.
As for the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, he too wore a cold expression and did not take action.
Even if the demon did not appear, once Wang Ping killed the Blue Robed Emperor, he would be tempted to kill Wang Ping himself.
The Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion frowned, thinking about taking action.
However, just as the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion wanted to take action and Wang Ping was preparing to ask Alpha to help him escape, a figure appeared in the universe, blocking the face of the Quasi-Immortal tier demon.
This sudden change left Upper Realm powerhouses momentarily stunned.
Even Wang Ping was taken aback.
That’s because the one who stood in front of him and blocked the attack of the Quasi-Immortal tier demon was none other than Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, a Predecessor ransmigrator.
“Who is that? They can actually block the attack of this monster. Is he a Fairy?”
“If he’s a Fairy, doesn’t that mean immortality is still possible in this world?”
Because Leng Yue wore a mask this time and didn’t reveal his true face, the other emperors did not recognize his identity.
However, because of the terrifying power Leng Yue displayed, they all became excited.
“The Master of Nine Stars Pavilion, why did he come out to save someone?”
As for the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, they naturally knew the identity of Pavilion Master Cold Moon and showed surprised expressions.
After all, in their view, the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion would not do such a thing.
It was already good enough that he did not personally kill Wang Ping, who was such a dangerous person, let alone expect him to save someone, which was supposed to be unrealistic.
At this moment, Wang Ping was unclear why Pavilion Master Cold Moon wanted to save him, and when he came to his senses, he was extremely wary of him. He quickly used the Time-Space Divine Skill to distance himself from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Takes Action! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 997: Chapter 264: Unrivaled Quasi-Emperor! Leng Yue Takes Action! _4
At the same time, Alpha was also prepared to help him escape at any moment.
“If I wanted to kill you, you would have died just now, and Alpha wouldn’t have been able to save you.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion did not stop Wang Ping’s action, but spoke indifferently.
“Why did you save me?”
Hearing this, Wang Ping calmed down and spoke in a deep voice.
Indeed, the words of Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue, the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, were not boasting.
With his combat power and cunning, if he wanted to kill him, he indeed had the ability to make it impossible for him to react in time.
Not to mention, his attention was entirely on the demon earlier. He didn’t observe Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue, the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, and couldn’t have.
Of course, whether Alpha could react in time was uncertain.
“I save if I want to save, I kill if I want to kill; it’s that simple.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion stared at Wang Ping with his vicissitudes of life and said these indifferent words.
This made Wang Ping frown, not quite understanding what this dangerous fellow in front of him was thinking.
At this moment, the Blue Robed Emperor also fell silent, not expecting Cheng Yaojin to appear out of nowhere.
This Cheng Yaojin was also a well-known figure among their Second-generation Chat Group.
The transmigrators from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group could be regarded as his predecessors.
It really was a gathering of the Transmigrators from the Third Generation Chat Group.
“Senior, do you want to protect him? This doesn’t seem to have any advantage for you.”
The Blue Robed Emperor looked at Leng Yue Emperor and spoke in a deep voice.
“As I said, I save if I want to save, I kill if I want to kill. No one else has the right to point fingers at me. You, even less so.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion stared coldly at the Blue Robed Emperor.
“In that case, I’ll kill you along with him.”
The Blue Robed Emperor spoke in a deep voice.
As his words fell, the demon roared and exploded with terrifying energy, rushing towards the Blue Robed Emperor.
“Nothing more than a despicable demon, thinking it can kill me; what a joke.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion had a calm expression and spoke indifferently.
As he said this, he slapped down a palm.
In an instant, endless radiance spilled out, Immortal Spirit lingered, forming a giant palm that struck the demon.
With just this one blow, the demon, which possessed Quasi Fairy King Combat Skill, was blasted to nothingness on the spot.
Furthermore, under this blow, there was no excess force spread out, causing terrifying destruction to the surrounding Starfield.
This was enough to show just how huge the gap between their combat powers was.
“!!!”
The Blue Robed Emperor saw this scene, his face stupefied, revealing a frightened expression.
Although he had thought that this first-generation transmigrator predecessor must be strong, he didn’t expect him to be strong to this extent.
With just one blow, he managed to blast the demon, which possessed quasi-Fairy Tier combat power.
Could it be that this guy had stepped into the Immortal realm?
Not only was the Blue Robed Emperor frightened, but other watching emperors, the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion, and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal were also shocked beyond measure.
Especially the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family, they felt even deeper.
In their view, when they faced the demon with quasi-Fairy Tier combat power, the outcome was nothing more than fifty-fifty.
In the end, Master Cold Moon of the Nine Stars Pavilion killed it with one blow, with a terrifying combat power.
Isn’t this saying that if Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion wanted to, he could completely annihilate all the forces of the Upper Realm by himself?
Wang Ping also fell silent.
He had always known that Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue, the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, was very powerful. However, because he had never really made a move in life simulation, he did not know that Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator, had become so strong at this point in time.
Didn’t this mean that if he wanted to, he could ignore all the other forces in the Upper Realm and directly launch the Great Array?
It seemed that the reason why he started the Refinement Array so late in the life simulation was either because he had not gathered all the relevant conditions or because he still couldn’t understand the strength of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family. Therefore, he chose to act cautiously.
Both of these points were very possible.
Especially the second point, considering the style of action of the Transmigrators, they would not act recklessly unless they had a very high degree of certainty.
The Predecessor Transmigrators of the Second Generation Chat Group were also quite cautious in their actions. They always sent people a few levels above him to deal with him, throwing out various items without asking for money.
But he was a cheater, growing faster than they expected, causing their hunting plans to fail.
If it were any other Transmigrators facing such hunting schemes, they would probably be long dead.
But Wang Ping still couldn’t understand why Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue wanted to save him.
It seemed that there was no benefit for him.
“Junior, do you have any last words?”
At this moment, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion ignored the many gazes and indifferently looked at the Blue Robed Emperor as he spoke.
As he looked at Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, the Blue Robed Emperor’s face turned pale, and he fell silent.
He knew that today, he was going to die and be completely annihilated here.
However, dying in front of a person like this, it wouldn’t be a disgrace.
At least, it would be more dignified than being killed by Wang Ping, the younger generation.
“I was blind. However, this matter will not end just like this.”
The Blue Robed Emperor exhaled lightly and spoke expressionlessly.
Although he still had a natural fear of death after experiencing many hardships, when it came to this moment, he would not really be afraid of death and do something disgraceful.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 264: Invincible Quasi-Emperor! Cold Moon Takes Action! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 998: Chapter 264: Invincible Quasi-Emperor! Cold Moon Takes Action! _5
“Now that my regrets have been spoken, it’s time to send you on your way.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion spoke calmly.
Then, with a casual grab, he seized the Blue Robed Emperor in his hand.
Following this, he took a step forward and disappeared instantly.
When Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion left, Wang Ping also breathed a sigh of relief.
However, even more questions arose in his heart.
Still, he knew that now was not the time to think about these things. After glancing at the strong spectators, he also left this starfield that had been completely destroyed.
Thus, the battle came to an end.
Nevertheless, Wang Ping’s fame would spread throughout the Upper Realm, letting all cultivators know that there was an invincible Quasi-Emperor who could rival Emperors and even suppress Ordinary Emperors.
As for the fame of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, there was no need to say more, as all forces marked him as someone not to be provoked.
…
At this moment, Wang Ping was walking through the starry sky, asking Alpha some questions in his heart.
“Alpha, what’s the deal with Leng Yue? Can you see through it?”
“If I knew everything, I wouldn’t have fallen to this level.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded out.
“Uh, you have a good point there, I can’t really argue.”
Wang Ping was at a loss for words.
“It seems that to figure all this out, I still need to become even stronger. Only by surpassing Leng Yue can I uncover his secrets.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he thought to himself.
“Only by becoming stronger can you know the many hidden secrets.”
Alpha’s cold voice echoed again.
“On the other hand, you’ll come into contact with even more terrifying secrets.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but retort.
“As long as you know. This time, Leng Yue rescued you, and although I don’t know what his purpose was, he revealed one thing. He doesn’t have a Chaotic Body now. This is your opportunity.”
Alpha’s icy voice resounded, causing Wang Ping’s eyes to brighten.
“Leng Yue doesn’t have a Chaotic Body right now?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and muttered to himself.
If it’s true, this would indeed be his chance.
As long as he quickly obtained Time and Space Origin, completed his Time-Space Body, and fused it with Little Chaotic Body, he would be able to acquire the True Chaotic Body.
“However, if I do this, Leng Yue will likely detect it and come after me.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping furrowed his brows and pondered in his heart.
If Leng Yue discovers that he has obtained the Chaotic Body, it will undoubtedly disrupt his plans. With his temperament, there’s no way he would let Wang Ping off the hook.
After all, the core of his plan is to obtain the Chaotic Body, refine the entire Upper Realm, and make the Chaotic Body directly reach its peak stage, all while stepping into immortality.
Without the Chaotic Body, his billion-year plan will be in vain.
If Wang Ping put himself in Leng Yue’s shoes, he would be infuriated to the point of bursting, crushing his saboteurs’ bones to ashes and subjecting them to a million years of extreme punishment.
“That being said, although I didn’t use the Little Chaotic Body during the battle, Leng Yue should be able to see that I already have it. Considering his understanding of the Chaotic Body, he should know that I’m only one step away from obtaining it…”
Wang Ping knitted his brows, suddenly feeling as if this was a conspiracy.
It’s possible that Master Leng Yue, the predecessor ransmigrator, is waiting for him to obtain the Chaotic Body so he can refine it directly.
At that time, Leng Yue would acquire an extra Chaotic Body origin, which would be a great opportunity for him as well.
“Anyway, I still need to explore the path through simulation first. Although the differences between reality and the simulation are becoming larger, the information derived from the simulation is still somewhat useful.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples and thought to himself in his heart.
Then, he reigned in his thoughts and looked into the distance.
At this time, the three Quasi-emperor elders of the Dark Time Imperial Clan also appeared beside him, looking at him like a monster.
“Young Master, are you sure you were only a Supreme a few months ago?”
The Third Elder Ancestor asked in amazement.
“I really doubt that our Young Master was joking with us back then. No matter how twisted the Devouring Source Body is, it shouldn’t be possible to reach such a level of cultivation in such a short time, let alone that you’re walking the legendary Path of Chaos.”
The Second Elder Ancestor also had a subtle expression, exclaiming.
“No wonder you only took a quarter of an hour to come out of the Ancient Time Road. With your strength, you must have been strolling inside for that time.”
The First Elder Ancestor also sighed with emotion.
You can think that way.”
Wang Ping laughed but had no interest in explaining anything further.
There’s no explaining such matters, after all.
“How did you fare after going out for a few months?”
Wang Ping paused and looked at the seemingly injured three quasi-emperor elders, asking questions.
“About that…”
Hearing this, the three quasi-emperor elders were a bit embarrassed.

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 265 Wang Ping assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious traces!
chapters.content:
Chapter 999: Chapter 265 Wang Ping assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious traces!
“So you tried to rob and got beaten up instead?”
Wang Ping looked at the expressions of the three Quasi-Emperor elders, his eyes filled with curiosity.
“We weren’t robbing, we were just collecting debts!”
The Third Elder Ancestor’s face turned red.
“But, it is true that we got beaten up…”
As he spoke, the Third Elder Ancestor’s tone weakened.
“No one expected that the Red Cloud Clan’s Ancestor would become such a powerful Quasi-Emperor, second only to the top-tier. We were no match for him. If it weren’t for you, Young Master, who suddenly engaged in a terrifying battle with the Emperor and attracted his attention, I’m afraid we would have been left behind.”
The Second Elder Ancestor sighed as well.
“For cultivators at the Great Perfection quasi-Emperor level, the appeal of an Emperor’s battle is unparalleled. Perhaps they can gain some insights from the battle and help themselves become an Emperor.”
The First Elder Ancestor shook his head, full of lament.
“The Ancestor of the Red Cloud Clan, huh?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, recalling who that person was.
That Quasi-Emperor had attacked him together with Qingyu Quasi Emperor and Destruction Quasi-Emperor in the Immortal Tower Secret Realm.
He didn’t expect that the Dark Time Clan also had some grudges with him.
In that case, he could settle both old and new scores together.
Right now, his cultivation had improved, and he needed a lot of resources for the Paid Simulations.
Thinking of this problem, Wang Ping silently asked in his heart, “System, how much Extreme-tier Divine Source do I need for a Paid Simulation right now?”
“Ding, it is detected that the host’s cultivation has reached the level of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection. The required consumption for a Paid Simulation is 500 million jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source.”
The system’s voice rang out, making Wang Ping’s face twitch involuntarily.
Holy crap, 500 million jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source… this consumption was simply outrageous. Where could he find so many resources in a short period?
It should be known that this was the Last Dharma Age.
“Sigh, my cultivation has soared from the Superme Realm directly to the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection. It’s normal for my cultivation expenses to increase a hundredfold. However, finding so many resources is indeed a problem.”
Wang Ping thought with a headache.
One Dark Time Imperial Clan could only produce 80 million jin of top-grade Divine Source, and to gather enough for one Paid Simulation, he would need to rob several Quasi-Emperor-tier Forces.
Of course, the Dark Time Imperial Clan had fewer resources due to their hidden status, and other forces might have more. It was possible that the harvests would be bigger.
“It’s a pity I can’t use a Quasi-Emperor Artifact for simulation, otherwise that would be a way.”
Wang Ping looked at the three Quasi-Emperor Elders of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, his eyes becoming subtle.
“Young Master, what is that look in your eyes?”
Wang Ping’s gaze made the three Quasi-Emperor Elders feel a lump in their hearts, making them quite uneasy. They asked hesitantly.
“Nothing, it’s just a pity.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“Uh…”
The three Elder Ancestors looked at each other, not knowing how to respond.
However, their intuition told them that they seemed to have kept something important safe.
“The Red Cloud Clan, huh? Since they are so arrogant, I will personally go to their door to collect debts. If they cannot present satisfactory conditions to me, then I will exterminate the Red Cloud Ancestor.”
Wang Ping collected his thoughts and spoke lightly.
“Young Master, the Red Cloud Clan is backed by Emperor Fengxin and has a good relationship with him. We need to be careful.”
The Third Elder Ancestor reminded.
“Heh, Emperor Fengxin? If he dares to come, I’ll just exterminate him as well.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly and said coldly.
Emperor Fengxin and the Slaughter Saint of the Slaughter Paradise have had dealings with the Enigmatic Side.
Wang Ping didn’t have the strength to cause trouble for them before.
If Emperor Fengxin really dared to appear in front of him to protect Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor, he would truly make a move against Emperor Fengxin.
It just so happened that Wang Ping was severely lacking resources right now.
As an Emperor, Emperor Fengxin would definitely be much richer than the Red Cloud Clan.
As for whether he could defeat Emperor Fengxin or not?
Sorry, let’s not talk about defeating him or not for now. Even if he couldn’t, Wang Ping still had a major summoning technique.
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was a top-tier Emperor, killing Emperor Fengxin would be like child’s play for him.
“Hiss, worthy of being our Young Master, truly domineering.”
The three Elder Ancestors gasped and felt that Wang Ping was great at showing off. It was worthy of being a monster who almost blew up an Emperor and confronted a quasi-Fairy.
Next, Wang Ping did not continue to show off but just led the three Elder Ancestors to the Red Cloud Clan.
At the moment, the Red Cloud Clan’s old monsters, who had yet to self-titled or were unable to do so again, were holding a meeting.
After all, such a shocking event happened suddenly in the Upper Realm, it had a severe impact on the overall situation. A clan meeting had to be held to discuss the future development strategy of the Red Cloud Clan.
However, talking about development strategies mainly meant discussing how to find Wang Ping, the invincible quasi emperor, and becoming friends with him.
This point was not only pondered by the Red Cloud Clan but also by most of the other forces in the Upper Realm.
But before the Red Cloud Clan could discuss a suitable plan to find and befriend Wang Ping, three streams of Quasi-Emperor’s aura suddenly descended upon the Red Cloud Clan’s territory, causing the old monsters’ brows to furrow.
Especially Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor, whose face clouded with displeasure and he snorted coldly, “These three losers really don’t fear death, do they really think I wouldn’t dare kill them?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 265 Wang Ping assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious traces! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000: Chapter 265 Wang Ping assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious traces! _2
“The Dark Time Emperor has been missing for a long time, and it’s likely that he has already perished. It’s bad enough that the Dark Time Imperial Clan does not hide well in this world, but they keep causing trouble for our clan, truly courting death. Since this is the case, let’s completely annihilate them this time, find the location of the Dark Time Clan, and exterminate them all, thereby obtaining the numerous treasures left by the Dark Time Emperor. Especially the Dark Time Emperor Scripture, it is not to be missed.”
Another quasi-emperor of the Red Cloud Clan also revealed a fierce light in his eyes and spoke in a deep voice.
Hearing this, the Red Cloud Clan’s Supreme and other quasi-emperors nodded, feeling that it was a good idea.
An Emperor Scripture related to time is extremely rare. If they could obtain it, the Red Cloud Clan would have an astonishing foundation.
However, before they could go out and battle the three quasi-emperors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, the expression on the face of Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor became stiff, showing a frightened look.
Because when he used a heavenly eye divine skill to look at the three ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan, he saw Wang Ping standing in front of them.
This person was the Invincible Quasi-Emperor who had recently gained a lot of attention. His combat strength and background were both unfathomable.
Previously, they had wanted to find Wang Ping and befriend him, but now he had come to the Red Cloud Clan himself.
However, this was not a cause for celebration, as it was clear that he was here to support the Dark Time Imperial Clan.
Not only did the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor notice this, but the Supremes and quasi-emperors of the Red Cloud Clan, who had been full of killing intent and mocking the three Dark Time Imperial Clan quasi-emperors, all fell silent, and the atmosphere became somewhat oppressive and awkward.
“Contact Emperor Fengxin immediately, let’s first stabilize them.”
The Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor, after all, was an old monster, and he quickly calmed down. He took a deep breath and spoke in a deep voice.
Hearing this, the ancestors of the Red Cloud Clan all nodded and began to take action.
Immediately, the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor led a group of strong cultivators to the outer world, with a smiling face, and spoke respectfully to Wang Ping, “Senior, your presence truly brings glory to our Red Cloud Clan.”
“This old fellow really has a thick face.”
Seeing that the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor ignored them and chose to bow to Wang Ping, the three ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan looked at him with disdainful eyes.
Then, they began to gloat.
They wanted to see how much this old fellow could squirm now.
The more ruthless this old fellow had been earlier, the more miserable his situation would be now, which was indeed very delightful.
This was the feeling of having someone to back them up, something they hadn’t experienced in many years.
“Red Cloud, I am here to seek justice for my three followers.”
Wang Ping’s expression was calm, and no trace of anger or joy could be seen on his face as he spoke indifferently.
“So it seems, senior, we indeed have some misunderstandings between us. If our Red Cloud Clan has done anything wrong, we are willing to compensate for it.”
The heart of Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor sank, but his expression was still very warm as he forced a smile.
Under someone else’s roof, one had to bow their head. Although he had already reached the level of a person very close to the emperor, he still had to put on a smiling face in front of someone who could kill him instantly.
There was no way around it, in this world of the weak being prey to the strong, dignity was secondary, only being alive had dignity.
“Your attitude is not bad, so I will not annihilate your Red Cloud Clan.”
Wang Ping stared at the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor and spoke indifferently.
At these words, the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor breathed a sigh of relief.
However, soon enough, his expression once again became stiff.
“As long as your Red Cloud Clan can pay 100 billion catties of supreme divine source, the grievances between you will be settled. How about it?”
“100 billion catties of supreme divine source?”
The Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor’s expression froze, and he clenched his fists, even feeling the impulse to curse.
100 billion catties of supreme divine source, do you dare to ask for more?
Fuck, even if it were Black Abyss Demon Lord, a top-tier Heaven Sovereign, having 100,000 catties of supreme divine source would be considered good, which was already comparable to the wealth of a very poor quasi-emperor.
Even if a quasi-emperor-tier force were to bring out all their resources, having one billion catties of supreme divine source would already be considered extremely shocking.
Although his Red Cloud Clan was a very powerful quasi-emperor-tier force, their accumulated resources after so many years amounted to only 5 billion catties of supreme divine source.
Even if they were to sell the entire clan’s immovable properties and Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, they would barely be able to gather 10 billion catties of supreme divine source at most.
100 billion was an amount that they could not possibly gather even if they were to be completely wiped out.
Not only did the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor have a stiff expression and an urge to curse, but the other quasi-emperors of the Red Cloud Clan also shared the same sentiment.
If it weren’t for the fact that their strength was inferior, they would really want to fight Wang Ping.
“…….”
At this moment, the three ancestors of the Dark Time Imperial Clan’s faces also twitched.
Good fellow, the Young Master was still ruthless enough.
They had originally thought that Wang Ping would ask for a few billion catties of supreme divine source at most.
As a result, he asked for 100 billion as soon as he opened his mouth.
100 billion catties of supreme divine source was not even something that an ordinary imperial-tier force could gather in one go.
“What, are you unwilling to compensate?”
Wang Ping looked at the expressions of the Red Cloud ancestors and frowned, his expression instantly turning cold.
“Our Red Cloud Clan doesn’t have 100 billion catties of supreme divine source. Even an ordinary imperial-tier force wouldn’t be able to gather so much supreme divine source in one go.”
The Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor could only suppress the frustration and anger in his heart, and apologize with a bitter smile.
“Hehe, it seems that your Red Cloud Clan is not worth that much money. Then, let me ask you, how much supreme divine source is your Red Cloud Clan worth?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001: Chapter 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _3
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and spoke coldly.
As he said this, a terrifying aura erupted from him, causing the faces of the Red Cloud Clan’s Ancestors to turn pale and leaving them gasping for breath.
At the same time, they understood the meaning behind Wang Ping’s words.
You appraise the value of your Red Cloud Clan in terms of top-tier Divine Sources.
If the amount offered is too low, don’t blame him, Wang Ping, for annihilating the clan.
“Ancestor, you should understand how precious the Extreme-tier Divine Source is. Now that we are in the Last Dharma Age, it is even more precious. There are many people in my Red Cloud Clan, and the consumption is also huge. As for development funds, my Red Cloud Clan has only accumulated 4 billion jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source. If Ancestor is willing, we are willing to offer 3 billion jin doubly with both hands.”
Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor took a deep breath, carrying Wang Ping’s pressure, and said firmly.
Although their clan possessed 5 billion jin of top-tier Divine Source, they couldn’t possibly give it all to Wang Ping.
Without enough top-tier Divine Sources, their Red Cloud Clan would be finished.
“Not enough.”
Wang Ping used his Breaking Origin Sky Eye to stare at Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor and spoke indifferently.
“Moreover, do you think you can hide your lies in front of me?”
After a pause, Wang Ping spoke again.
With a chilly gaze, Wang Ping’s stare made the space around Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor distort.
Then, both of Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor’s arms directly exploded.
Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor grunted and couldn’t help but feel terrified. He didn’t dare to look at Wang Ping and could only speak bitterly, “Ancestor, please show mercy to those who deserve it. My clan is not without the backing of a great Emperor.”
“Are you threatening me?”
Wang Ping’s gaze grew even colder.
“Please don’t misunderstand, Ancestor. This is not a threat. It’s just that in the world of cultivators, it’s not only about fighting and killing. There are also sentiments and human affairs. You shouldn’t push things too far.”
Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor seemed to have broken the jar after saying that, and spoke again.
If it were not for him being the ancestor of the clan, he wouldn’t have endured such humiliation, nor would he fear death. Instead, he would have chosen to curse Wang Ping and then go to break the net, directly self-destructing.
In that case, even if they were to fall, they wouldn’t be too embarrassed.
However, ultimately, he was the ancestor of a clan with countless people behind him, and he couldn’t act capriciously.
There was no choice; the clan members were their weak point.
That’s why some loose cultivators who grew to the Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and even Emperor realm through world-shocking opportunities or world-shocking luck did not establish a major power by marrying or setting up a business.
Without creating a family or power, there are no weaknesses.
Of course, without establishing a power, they couldn’t lie back and focus on cultivation while accruing resources. They would need to go to dangerous places to compete for resources.
“When you were dealing with them, did you ever think of not pushing things too far? If it weren’t for my battle with the Emperor, they would have already fallen into your hands by now. Moreover, I heard your discussions just now very clearly.”
Wang Ping’s face was cold and indifferent, mocking.
Hearing this, Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor was speechless.
They didn’t expect that Wang Ping could hear their communication through divine thoughts.
However, this seemed to be a normal thing, given Wang Ping’s overwhelming strength and his obvious special eye that could see through divine barriers.
Of course, they hadn’t detected Wang Ping’s arrival.
If they had known in advance that Wang Ping was coming, they wouldn’t have had such a conversation.
Subsequently, Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor sighed in his heart.
Hearing or not hearing didn’t matter.
After all, strength was supreme, and they were weak, which is why they were at Wang Ping’s mercy.
Now, all he could do was to stall for time and wait for Emperor Fengxin to arrive.
“Ancestor, I will offer all our divine sources with both hands and also present all the treasures in the clan, hoping that you can give our clan some leeway.”
Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor gathered his thoughts and sighed.
“I don’t care what you offer, as long as there is enough divine source. Since you can’t put together 100 billion catties of top-tier Divine Source, then give me 20 billion jin of top-tier Divine Source. If it’s not enough, then find a way to make up for it. My patience is limited.”
Wang Ping spoke emotionlessly.
Of course, Wang Ping was outwardly cold, but his heart was also quite subtle.
Now, he always had the feeling of a great villain.
“This…” Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor’s expression twisted, and he could only anxiously wait for Emperor Fengxin to arrive.
The other powerhouses of the Red Cloud Clan also felt extremely depressed and couldn’t wait to fight Wang Ping.
“Fellow taoist, you’re doing too much!”
At this moment, a burst of Emperor’s Might suddenly descended, and a deep voice spoke.
Following this, the space stirred like ripples, and a figure emerged.
“Emperor Fengxin!”
Feeling this Emperor’s Might, and seeing the newcomer, Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor’s face changed instantly, showing a look of ecstasy and relaxing secretly in his heart.
“Finally, you’re here? You really made me wait.”
Before Emperor Fengxin appeared, Wang Ping had already sensed him first and looked in the direction where Emperor Fengxin would appear.
As someone who had comprehended 70% of the True Spirit of Time-Space Heavenly Tao, it was impossible for late-stage Emperor-level powerhouses to hide any spatial anomalies from him.
Previously, Wang Ping purposely made things difficult for Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor, not because he was idle or really believed that the Red Cloud Clan could produce 100 billion catties of top-Tier Divine Source, but simply to deliberately embarrass them, trying to force Emperor Fengxin to reveal himself.
Now, his goal is achieved.
“Heh, you say I’m going too far, but do you think the Red Cloud Clan was right to slaughter the Dark Time Imperial Clan?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 1002 265 Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1002: Chapter 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _4 Chapter 1002: Chapter 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _4 Wang Ping stared at Emperor Fengxin, eyes slightly narrowed, sneering.
“That’s just the grudges between the two clans from the past, and it has nothing to do with you. If you behave like this, subduing an Imperial Clan and resolving their past grudges for them by exterminating an entire clan, then the Upper Realm would already be in chaos.”
Emperor Fengxin spoke indifferently.
“You’re really good at distorting the truth. It sounds nice when you say it, but can you do such a thing? I know you once took an apprentice and destroyed all of his enemies for him.”
Wang Ping’s face was cold and sarcastic.
“An apprentice is like my own child, not to be confused with followers.”
Emperor Fengxin said without changing his expression.
“Forget it, I won’t argue with you about right or wrong today. Since I am already here, fellow taoist, why not do me a favor? With 4 billion jin of top-Tier Divine Source to resolve their grudges, and then give the Red Cloud Clan a way to survive. How about that?”
Pausing, Emperor Fengxin spoke again.
“Hahaha!”
Hearing Emperor Fengxin’s words, Wang Ping couldn’t help laughing out loud.
This caused Emperor Fengxin’s eyebrows to furrow slightly.
“How much is your face worth? Are you trying to make me laugh to death and inherit my Ant Check Later?”
After Wang Ping finished laughing, his face showed a mocking expression, making fun of Emperor Fengxin.
This made Emperor Fengxin’s eyebrows furrowed tighter.
Although he didn’t know what “Ant Check Later” was, this was undoubtedly a very sarcastic comment from Wang Ping.
Wang Ping did not give him any face.
“Since fellow taoist is so ruthless, we can only fight it out. If I win, you will leave. If I lose, I will let the Red Cloud Clan pay 20 billion jin of top-Tier Divine Source.”
Afterwards, Emperor Fengxin’s expression also became cold and indifferent, speaking softly.
Although the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion saved Wang Ping and there was some obvious connection between the two, it seemed that the other party saved Wang Ping simply out of interest.
In that case, there was nothing to fear.
He didn’t believe that the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion would intervene for Wang Ping again.
As long as he could severely injure Wang Ping, he could let that guy control Wang Ping and they would be able to proceed with their plans more smoothly.
“Interesting.”
Hearing this, Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, his gaze deepening.
With Emperor Fengxin’s character, would he really go this far for the Red Cloud Clan’s sake?
Even if Emperor Fengxin had a good relationship with the Red Cloud Clan in the past and owed favors to them, it would be impossible for him to fight against Wang Ping for their sake.
After all, he had just demonstrated his amazing combat power to kill ordinary Emperors at the mid-stage.
Offending someone like him would mean that even top-level Emperors would fall when he reaches Emperor realm.
Emperor Fengxin wouldn’t be oblivious to this logic.
Moreover, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was a great deterrent when she protected him back then.
As a result, Wang Ping had a hunch.
“Alpha, search and see if the sly one is hiding in the Red Cloud Clan.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke in his heart.
“No need to investigate. There is indeed a strange aura in this area. Unexpectedly, the sly one is hiding deep within the Red Cloud Clan.”
As soon as Wang Ping’s voice fell, Alpha’s voice rang out.
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, and the corners of his mouth curved slightly upward.
This was really smooth sailing and effortless.
What Wang Ping was most worried about was how to find the whereabouts of the sly one.
After all, when he was at Supreme level in the past, he could self-discard his cultivation and enter the secret realm to suppress the sly one.
Now, his cultivation had reached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection tier, and he couldn’t possibly self-discard it again.
Therefore, obtaining the information about the location where the sly one hid 100,000 years ago was challenging.
But, he came to the Red Cloud Clan to settle grudges and fish for some divine sources, not only forcing out Emperor Fengxin, who he could try to burst gold coins from but also accidentally discovering the whereabouts of the sly one.
This was really…double happiness!
“If you want to fight, then let’s fight. It’s a pity that the previous Emperor didn’t fall into my hands. In that case, let’s use you, Emperor Fengxin, as a stepping stone instead.”
Then, Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, and he spoke coldly.
“You have a strong combat power and can be on equal footing with me as an Emperor, so we address each other as fellow taoists. But now you dare to refer to yourself as ‘this seat’ in front of me, you are really too arrogant!”
Emperor Fengxin was also completely angered by Wang Ping’s words. Shouting loudly, he was filled with killing intent, and his Emperor’s Might surged.
As an Emperor, how could he have been humiliated like this?
As Emperor Fengxin’s terrifying Emperor’s Might erupted without a mask, the entire Big Universe shook again, and many powerful people looked in surprise towards this side.
They couldn’t believe that Emperor Fengxin’s aura had just erupted again, indicating that another Emperor’s Battle was about to break out.
“What is provoking Emperor Fengxin? His anger is extreme.”
The other Emperors detected the owner of the aura, and their eyes flickered as they looked towards them.
When they saw that Emperor Fengxin was confronting Wang Ping, they all looked at Wang Ping with strange expressions, speechless.
This guy is really good at making trouble.
Previously, he provoked the Extraterritorial Emperors to come and hunt him down with quasi-Fairy level combat power, and in the end, he was saved by Pavilion Master Cold Moon of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
Not much time had passed, yet Wang Ping had provoked Emperor Fengxin again. This really left them at a loss for words.
This guy was just a trouble magnet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 1003 265 Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1003: Chapter 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _5 Chapter 1003: Chapter 265: Wang Ping Assassinates Emperor Fengxin! Mysterious Traces! _5 Although it is said that monsters in this world are destined to experience various events on their path to growth, there is really no one as ruthless as Wang Ping, who fought two emperors in a single day.
“The monsters in our Taiyi Imperial Palace really make people worry.”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor also returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace due to Wang Ping’s previous actions and learned about some of Wang Ping’s matters from the mouth of the Supreme Palace Master.
He was both amazed and helpless about this.
Judging by Wang Ping’s growth rate and ability to attract trouble, he always felt that the Taiyi Imperial Palace couldn’t cover for him.
No, that’s not right, they couldn’t cover for him before.
After all, his quasi-Fairy Tier enemies before were not something the Taiyi Imperial Palace could handle.
Perhaps only someone like the Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion could cover for Wang Ping.
At the time when all parties were in shock, Emperor Fengxin snorted coldly, took a step forward, and headed towards the starry sky.
On the Immortal Continent, too many forces exist, making it unsuitable to take action.
Emperor-level battles would have too much of an impact and would easily provoke other forces, which is not a wise move.
Seeing Emperor Fengxin heading towards the star field, Wang Ping followed with an indifferent expression.
When the two of them arrived in the vast starry sky, Emperor Fengxin suddenly made his move.
The terrifying true spirit of the wind Heavenly Dao erupted, divine skills emerged, and the raging hurricane swept across the Big Universe, intending to suppress Wang Ping.
Emperor Fengxin’s cultivation was not weak, being in the middle stage of the emperor realm like the Blue Robed Emperor, a fellow traverser of the Second Generation Chat Group.
However, there was one aspect in which Emperor Fengxin was stronger than the Blue Robed Emperor, and that was his possession of the Wind-elemental Holy Physique.
Although Emperor Fengxin’s Sacred Body had not reached the realm of perfection, and his cultivation of his physique was not as advanced as Yu Daoyi’s and the white-cloaked quasi-emperor’s special quasi-emperor realm physiques, he was ultimately an emperor, and the addition of the Great Holy Physique still granted him far greater combat power than the Blue Robed Emperor.
This was the reason why Emperor Fengxin was confident that he could severely wound Wang Ping.
Although Wang Ping had defeated the ordinary emperor-level Blue Robed Emperor, he didn’t think Wang Ping could win against him.
The final result would be a mutual loss.
At that time, as long as he could control Wang Ping via his mysterious ability, everything would be fine.
Of course, another reason for Emperor Fengxin’s confidence was that he still had allies who could help him at any time, like Emperor Slaughter.
“A Great Holy Physique? If that’s the source of your confidence, then you’re done for.”
Wang Ping’s expression was cold, showing no intention of engaging in a fierce battle with Emperor Fengxin.
He had held back in his battle with the Blue Robed Emperor, both to test his own combat power and to be cautious of the latter’s possible trump card.
However, now that he had tested his own combat level, there was no need to hold back.
“Chaos Emperor Fist!”
Wang Ping shouted coldly, throwing a punch that unleashed endless Chaos Spirit, which formed an Emperor’s Fist that bore the power to destroy countless star fields and struck towards Emperor Fengxin.
This time, Wang Ping directly activated the effects of Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven Color Talent: Burst Blade.
Perhaps Emperor Fengxin was just unlucky this time.
This time, the Seven Color Talent: Burst Blade unexpectedly triggered a ten times critical strike effect.
With the ten times critical strike activated, Wang Ping’s punch soared to a terrifying level of power, even splitting into two, which directly shattered Emperor Fengxin’s divine skill and continued to bombard Emperor Fengxin.
This caused Emperor Fengxin’s face to reveal a fearful expression, as he had not expected Wang Ping to still have some reservations in his previous battle.
This punch was too terrifying; if it hit him, he would be crippled if not killed outright.
This was clearly different from what he had imagined.
He had greatly underestimated Wang Ping’s combat power.
However, it wasn’t his fault. Who the hell would know that a quasi-emperor could be so abnormal, possessing such terrifying combat power with Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection cultivation?
Immediately, Emperor Fengxin wanted to use his life-saving divine skill to avoid this strike.
Although doing so would come at a great cost, it would be better than trying to resist those Chaos Emperor Fists and falling on the spot.
However, just as Emperor Fengxin activated his divine skill, his expression became rigid.
That’s because he found that his divine skill had actually failed.
Then he could only watch helplessly as the Chaos Emperor Fists bombarded him, completely engulfing him.
At this moment, the void collapsed, and everything was annihilated. Emperor Fengxin was instantly killed by Wang Ping’s strike and turned into nothingness, without even a chance to restore his physical body.
With Emperor Fengxin’s fall, the entire Upper Realm trembled, a phantom-like Great Emperor Tao Fruit shining and gradually dissipating, eventually turning into nothingness.
Then, all the Life Ancient Stars in the Upper Realm began to rain blood.
An emperor’s death was still quite special in the Upper Realm. Once an emperor fell, such a strange phenomenon would occur, as if the Heavenly Dao were mourning.
This also made the countless living beings of the Upper Realm understand that an emperor had fallen.
For a time, countless living beings across the Upper Realm and the Ten Great Universes, whether weak in cultivation or possessing self-designated titles, all trembled at this shocking event.
The fall of an emperor was a big deal; it hadn’t happened for countless years.
As for the old monsters who had been watching the battle, even the various emperors all fell silent, looking at the figure standing in the starry sky with incredible eyes, unable to come back to their senses.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 1004 266 Wang Pings Face So Fat and Oily
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1004: Chapter 266: Wang Ping’s Face! So Fat and Oily Chapter 1004: Chapter 266: Wang Ping’s Face! So Fat and Oily With a cultivation of Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection, Wang Ping obliterated a powerful Emperor with a single punch. What a spectacle!
Such terrifying combat power, perhaps not even in the most brilliant era of the Upper Realm, or the time when various immortals coexisted, would anyone be able to achieve such a feat.
For a moment, the many Emperors present were quite conflicted. They really wanted to make a move and get rid of Wang Ping before he became an Emperor.
If Wang Ping didn’t die, they would truly have no hope for Immortal Fate in the future.
However, they were also afraid of failing.
Once they failed and offended Wang Ping, their downfall would be inevitable, with no chance of survival.
Moreover, they were uncertain whether Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion would intervene again to save Wang Ping and suppress them.
“There’s no point in fighting for Immortal Fate anymore. An invincible Verge Emperor and a Nine Stars Pavilion Master who is suspected to be a fairy are present. In the face of these outstanding individuals, we don’t have a chance at Immortal Fate.”
Eventually, some of the old monsters felt disheartened and their Tao Heart was affected.
So many things had happened today that it was a real shock for them. They couldn’t help but feel dejected.
If they faced off against peak Emperors or Emperor Monarchs of their own realm, even if they were much weaker, they would dare to think of ways to seize Immortal Fate.
But when confronted with monsters like Wang Ping and the Pavilion Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, they could no longer muster the courage to compete.
As for the Immortal Fate, whoever wanted to fight for it could do so, but they wouldn’t fight anymore. They just hoped to live out their lives safely, and protect their families in the coming Chaotic Era.
“This child is truly astonishing.”
Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion had sharp eyes and a smile on their faces.
As for Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, they wanted to act and kill Wang Ping, but they also hesitated due to Leng Yue and the Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal’s attitudes, so they had no choice but to stay and observe.
…..
Wang Ping didn’t care about the thoughts of the old monsters in the Upper Realm.
At this moment, he also recovered from the shock, feeling a bit melancholic.
He didn’t intend to completely obliterate Emperor Fengxin.
An Emperor’s corpse was extremely valuable, not to mention that Fengxin’s good things were mostly kept in his inner world. Wang Pingihad undoubtedly destroyed them along with Fengxin’s inner world.
As a result, he didn’t gain any advantage.
“Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade, you’ve really ruined my great opportunity.”
Wang Ping clenched his fists, feeling more and more melancholic.
Emperor Fengxin, as a stronger Emperor, would probably have at least 100 billion jin of top-tier divine source in his possession, even though he was a loose cultivator and didn’t establish any forces.
In addition to the rare and exotic treasures he collected, they were worth a significant amount of top-tier divine source.
However, everything was destroyed with just one punch, and he gained nothing.
“Eh? What’s this?”
At this moment, Wang Ping saw something and looked surprised.
In the shattered Void, there was a broken, glowing stone.
This was clearly no ordinary stone.
After all, Wang Ping’s attack had blasted both Emperor Fengxin and his Emperor’s artifact to pieces.
An attack that even an Emperor couldn’t withstand was somehow resisted by a stone, which was a testament to its extraordinary nature.
“What a sturdy stone! Could it be the legendary Immortal Stone?”
Wang Ping reached out and grabbed it, studying it carefully with great astonishment.
However, if it was indeed an Immortal Stone, there was no trace of Immortal Spirit, which seemed quite bizarre.
“Forget it, no matter what it is, I’ll take it for now.”
Wang Ping shook his head, without further thoughts of research, and chose to put the stone into his inner world.
Afterward, Wang Ping casually set up an earth-shattering Killing Formation at the spot where Fengxin had fallen and left.
Although he was certain that Fengxin didn’t have the means of resurrection after the life simulation, it didn’t stop Wang Ping from being cautious and giving him no chance to live.
After all, there might be some differences between the simulation and reality. Wang Ping was guarding against such deviations.
Subsequently, Wang Ping returned to the Red Cloud Clan.
At this moment, the expressions of the Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor and the powerful members of the Red Cloud Clan were extremely pale, and they were terrified of Wang Ping.
“Senior, our Red Cloud Clan is willing to compensate you with 2 billion jin of top-tier divine source. Please spare our clan.”
The Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor fearfully spoke, without hesitation.
“Alpha, where is the mysterious position? Can you feel the general range?”
Wang Ping ignored the pleas of the old monsters from the Red Cloud Clan and asked from his heart.
“The mysterious one is dead. If nothing unexpected is happening, he was hiding in Emperor Fengxin’s inner world and was self-titled. Just now, he was obliterated along with Fengxin.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“I really did solve the mystery along the way.”
Wang Ping’s gaze was subtle.
He had been trying to figure out how to find the mysterious one before ten million years had passed.
It seemed that even if he found the mysterious one, he wouldn’t be able to kill them with his current strength.
After all, they were hiding in Emperor Fengxin’s inner world. The mysterious one could not be dealt with unless Fengxin was killed.
“However, this is strange. Doesn’t the mysterious one have the ability to resurrect? I’ve only killed him once, so how is he dead already?”
Wang Ping thought of the mysterious one’s abilities and frowned.
“If nothing unexpected is happening, the mysterious one’s resurrection ability is not based on consuming a servant’s life after each resurrection. It’s based on the amount of damage they have taken. The more damage you cause, the more servants they’ll need to consume for resurrection. In addition, the number of servants they can control should have an upper limit.”

Chapter 1005: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_2
Chapter 1005: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_2
Alpha’s icy voice rang out.
“As a result, your blow, which is powerful enough to obliterate Emperor Fengxin in an instant, has completely annihilated all his death replacement puppets.”
“So that’s how it is. This does explain everything.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, sighing in realization.
“But, Alpha, what about my reward for killing the Mysterious One?”
Pausing slightly, Wang Ping started to remind him.
“Ding, congratulations on successfully killing the Mysterious One, you have earned one billion group points.”
With Wang Ping’s reminder, the chat group system’s voice was heard.
“One billion group points? This Mysterious One is indeed quite valuable.”
Wang Ping pondered briefly, seemingly content.
“However, Alpha, does this Mysterious One meet the conditions to go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise and participate in the game?”
At this moment, Wang Ping remembered the conditions for obtaining the Rule Stones and inquired about it.
“No. This Mysterious One has not yet grown to that stage.”
Alpha’s icy voice rang out again.
“What a pity.”
Wang Ping was a bit disappointed.
While the Mysterious One in the Cultivation Realm where Qin Tian resides was much weaker than this one, it had already corrupted most of the Cultivation realm, a peculiar case.
This one, however, had barely matured and had a very low impact on the Upper Realm. They had killed it before it had a chance to grow, and nothing could be done about it.
Though, if Wang Ping really had to wait until it matured, he would find it troublesome.
“I still have to focus on the Mysterious One from the Sci-Fi World. If I can kill it, I can gain trillions of group points and an entry ticket to the game.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed as he remembered the Sci-fi Mysterious One.
“However, the Sci-Fi Mysterious One is too difficult to deal with. Without complete preparation, there’s no way I can take it down.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself, giving up pondering about the Mysterious One.
He has plenty of time to grow and there’s no need to rush.
At this moment, the Red Cloud Clan’s powerful beings were in a dire state.
Wang Ping kept silent, adding to their immense pressure, leaving them cold all over.
But they simply couldn’t produce more top-tier Divine Source.
Even two billion jin of top-tier Divine Source would be challenging for them to procure.
To gather this two billion jin of top-tier Divine Source, they had already prepared to sacrifice everything.
When it comes to it, while the status of Red Cloud Clan would drop drastically, it’s still better than being wiped out.
“First, give me all the top-tier Divine Source belonging to your Red Cloud Clan. Then, I will give you one year to gather the remaining top-tier Divine Source.”
Wang Ping glanced at Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor, speaking indifferently.
“Thank you for your mercy!”
Hearing these words, Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor looked grateful, despite the bitterness in his heart.
Next, without another word, Red Cloud Quasi-Emperor gathered up all the top-tier Divine Source in the clan and presented them with both his hands.
Thus, Wang Ping received from the Red Cloud Clan five hundred million jin of top-tier Divine Source, just enough for one run of the Paid Simulation.
Then, ripples appeared in the space around Wang Ping, creating a passage, which he stepped into.
Seeing this, the three quasi-emperor elders of the Dark Time Imperial Clan quickly followed.
After Wang Ping left, the powerful beings of the Red Cloud Clan remained, their faces full of sorrow, eyes dull.
…..
At this time, after Wang Ping had left, another Emperor arrived. He looked at the Red Cloud Clan with a freezing cold expression on his face.
He was Emperor Slaughter, a formidable emperor close to being a Top Emperor, much stronger than Emperor Fengxin.
He could have chosen to ambush Wang Ping and attempt to kill him.
But he didn’t. After all, he wasn’t sure what other aces Wang Ping might have up his sleeve. Acting recklessly would be too risky.
“He’s collecting Divine Source so eagerly; he must have many secrets. The reason for his rapid increase in power might be due to some special talent he has acquired. A talent for upgrading the devouring skill isn’t rare in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. However, a talent like his that allows him to devour such a large amount of energy in a short period of time, and raise other aspects to such a terrifying level, is very rare.”
Emperor Slaughter looked down at the Red Cloud Clan, feeling a deep wariness toward Wang Ping.
With the speed at which Wang Ping is growing, he could surpass him before long.
By then, he himself would be in danger.
To this end, he planned to delay Wang Ping’s growth as much as possible.
At least, he must buy himself enough time to return to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Going to and from the Heavenly Paradise is not as simple as just wishing to go or leave.
Each trip requires the consumption of World Source and also has a time interval.
Now, he is in a state where he cannot go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
So, he must buy time. He has to wait until his cooldown time has ended so he can go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Once he returns to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he won’t have to worry about being killed by Wang Ping for a short while.
Thinking of this, Emperor Slaughter snorted coldly, exploding with a terrifying murderous intent. He launched an attack, completely wiping out the Red Cloud Clan.
Immediately after Emperor Slaughter made his move, all the Emperors in the Big Universe frowned. They hadn’t expected another Emperor to take action.
It wasn’t clear who the Emperor was that made the move, as he had clearly hidden himself to prevent anyone from identifying him.
At this moment, Wang Ping also sensed this Emperor’s Might and found out that the Red Cloud Clan had been eradicated.
“The Red Cloud Clan was exterminated?”
Wang Ping knitted his eyebrows, clearly not pleased.
“They still owe me one and a half billion jin of top-tier Divine Source, and they were annihilated like this.”

Chapter 1006: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_3
Chapter 1006: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_3
This time, it cost him one and a half billion.
Upon this, Wang Ping immediately used his Breaking Origin Sky Eye to try and see through the residual traces of energy and figure out which Emperor had made the move.
“The method of concealing the identity was astounding. However, it does point to something – that the Emperor who made the move is from the All Heavens and harbours enmity towards me.”
Wang Ping retracted his Breaking Origin Sky Eye and chuckled coldly.
His Breaking Origin Sky Eye was able to see through falsehoods. At his level, even the trickery of an Emperor Monarch trying to conceal his identity couldn’t deceive him.
However, he was unable to see through this one.
Under such circumstances, it could only mean that either the quasi-Fairies had stepped in, or the entity originated from All Heavens and possessed items from the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Only these two scenarios could elude his vision.
Quasi-Fairies would not trouble themselves to deal with the Red Cloud Clan.
So, the culprit was quite obvious.
“Emperor Slaughter, it seems like you are scared by me. You’ve guessed some truths about my talents, so you couldn’t wait to hinder my acquisition of resources and prevent me from getting stronger?”
Wang Ping’s expression was cold, his eyes full of murderous intent.
In the Upper Realm, only the Predecessor Ransmigrators from the Slaughter Paradise and the Second Generation Chat Group were aware of his growth trajectory. They knew that he had grown to this level in just a decade and could determine his need for plenty of energy sources to grow stronger based on his demand for resources.
That’s why Emperor Slaughter would resort to such measures.
He was getting desperate. He was afraid.
“If you hadn’t done this, it wouldn’t have been possible for me to deal with you in a short time. It’s a pity, you chose to do this. Do you think that you can stop me from quickly becoming more powerful through this method?”
Wang Ping’s face was filled with mockery as he muttered to himself.
“Rushing to make moves only exposes the fact that you are scared. It also reveals that you won’t be able to go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise in a short time.”
“Perfect. Since Emperor Fengxin didn’t produce any coins, I can try using you.”
Having said that, Wang Ping composed himself, his expression returning to its original state, showing no emotions, as he continued on his way.
…
Soon after, Wang Ping arrived at the Elemental Ancient Star and seized the Devouring Soul Pearl.
Then, Wang Ping moved on to the Eternal Ancient Star and subdued the Devouring Mana Pearl.
Finally, Wang Ping crossed the universe and arrived at the Four Profound Small Universe. He descended upon the Phoenix Clan, preparing to take the Devouring Spirit Pearl.
“Fellow Taoist, you have defeated one Emperor and killed another in such a short time, it’s truly astonishing. However, I’m curious why you came to our Phoenix Clan. If you are here as a guest, we, the Phoenix Clan, will warmly welcome you and treat you as our honourable guest.”
As Wang Ping descended upon the Immortal Mountain where the Phoenix Clan lived, the Phoenix Emperor was alerted and chose to emerge, looking at Wang Ping with gravity.
“Hehe, fellow Taoist, I’m here this time to make a deal with you.”
Wang Ping replied genially.
“Oh? What kind of deal?”
Phoenix Emperor’s eyes sparkled, asking curiously.
“I want the Devouring Spirit Pearl that your Phoenix Clan has been suppressing. I wonder if you would be willing to let go of your affection for it. If you are willing to give the Devouring Spirit Pearl to me, I can offer a satisfying compensation.”
Wang Ping didn’t beat around the bush and directly stated his intention.
“Devouring Spirit Pearl?”
Phoenix Emperor stared at Wang Ping, quite surprised. He did not expect Wang Ping to know the pearl was in his Phoenix Clan.
“Hehe, since you want it, you can have it. Consider it an early celebratory gift from our Phoenix Clan for your impending Emperorship.”
The Phoenix Emperor slightly bowed, speaking generously.
He had a clear understanding of Wang Ping’s potential and power.
Someone like that should never be made an enemy. He must be befriended as much as possible.
If they could gain Wang Ping’s favor by giving an unwanted Devouring Spirit Pearl, it would be a very worthwhile deal.
“Hehe, if you are going to be so generous, I won’t hold back.”
Wang Ping looked puzzled. He really did not expect the Phoenix Emperor to be so generous.
This could be attributed to the terrifying power and talent he had displayed. Even a powerful emperor like the Phoenix Emperor was courteous to him, even showing signs of wanting to curry favor.
Nonetheless, this was not shameful, but rather human nature.
For this reason, Wang Ping did not refuse, nor did he intend to force a trade.
Though Wang Ping had several valuable items, he didn’t actually have anything that could be exchanged for an innate emperor artifact like the Devouring Spirit Pearl.
When the time came, he could probably only offer the Time-Space Emperor’s Sutra that he had comprehended as a trade.
Next, Wang Ping accepted the warm invitation of Phoenix Emperor and stayed as a guest in the Phoenix Clan.
This time, Wang Ping personally saw Huangqin, the daughter of Phoenix Emperor, and the two weak lives in her womb.
Wang Ping despised Huangqin greatly.
However, he held favorable opinions of Huan Qing and Huangyin.
Therefore, Wang Ping didn’t plan to harm Huangqin now.
After all, with his current strength, neither Huangqin nor her Tao Companion were capable of causing trouble.
Moreover, his rising fame, defeating one Emperor and killing another, had probably rendered them too petrified to even have greedy thoughts.
For example, although Huangqin knew that he came for the Devouring Spirit Pearl, her reaction was completely different from the life simulation. There was no resentment, instead she toasted to him warmly.
It only showed that the change brought about by strength was indeed significant.

Chapter 1007: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_4
Chapter 1007: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_4
Such a huge change was something that even Emperor Heavenly Feather could not accomplish by endorsing him.
Only when one is truly strong can they achieve this level of strength.
After the Immortal Banquet ended, the Phoenix Emperor gave Wang Ping the Devouring Spirit Pearl.
Wang Ping expressed his gratitude and his friendly disposition towards the Phoenix Clan, which made the Phoenix Emperor smile brightly. After that, Wang Ping left the Phoenix Clan and returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Upon returning to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, Wang Ping saw the Taiyi Emperor Tower and felt a headache coming on.
To make the Taiyi Emperor Tower completely recognize its master, he needed to traverse the Supreme Heavenly Path.
However, the Supreme Heavenly Path could only be traversed by those with Supreme Cultivation, and he couldn’t possibly give up his own cultivation just for the Taiyi Emperor Tower.
After all, even if he were to give up his cultivation, the prices of the Paid Simulation would remain unchanged.
And now that his reputation had skyrocketed and he had made such a commotion, giving up his cultivation would be too dangerous.
Even though he could do such a thing in the life simulation, it would still be a hassle in the end.
“Fellow Taoist, please come over.”
At this time, the voice of Emperor Heavenly Feather sounded, bringing Wang Ping back to his senses.
Then, Wang Ping collected his thoughts, stopped pondering on the issue of the Taiyi Emperor Tower, took a step forward, and arrived at the mountain peak where Emperor Heavenly Feather was.
“Why did you come to my Taiyi Imperial Palace in the first place?”
After Wang Ping arrived, Emperor Heavenly Feather gestured for him to sit down on the stone chair opposite him, his face serious as he inquired.
Previously, Emperor Heavenly Feather was too shocked to think clearly about many things.
However, after he calmed down, he felt that the notion of such an unconventional physique as the Devouring Source Body was too far-fetched and could not possibly exist.
As a result, Emperor Heavenly Feather believed that Wang Ping must have already possessed such astonishing cultivation when he came to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Thus, the purpose of Wang Ping’s visit to the Taiyi Imperial Palace was worth delving into.
Wang Ping sighed inwardly, knowing that Emperor Heavenly Feather was beginning to doubt him.
However, Wang Ping didn’t think that Emperor Heavenly Feather’s suspicions were unfounded, as his rapid growth and some of his actions did indeed seem very suspicious.
After all, in such a short period, he had directly jumped from the Great Saint Realm spoken of by the Supreme Palace Master to the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection.
His cultivation was one thing, but the terrifying combat power that could kill a top Emperor was even more frightening.
Even if he came from All Heavens, his growth rate couldn’t possibly be this twisted.
At least, in the eyes of emperors like Emperor Heavenly Feather, such things were impossible.
After all, they had seen cultivators from All Heavens, and there was a high likelihood that they had fought with them.
Therefore, Wang Ping could not explain that he had indeed joined Taiyi Imperial Palace as a Great Saint Realm cultivator seeking shelter, so he could only follow Emperor Heavenly Feather’s lead.
“Taiyi Emperor Tower? Why would you think of it?”
Emperor Heavenly Feather furrowed his brow.
The Taiyi Emperor Tower was special, but it shouldn’t be enough to make someone like Wang Ping infiltrate and become a disciple, right?
“The Taiyi Emperor Tower is the key to a certain secret realm. Only by making the Taiyi Emperor Tower recognize its master can one use it to open that secret realm. Within that secret realm lies the Immortal Tower. In addition, the barrier of the Immortal Tower also requires the cooperation of the Taiyi Emperor Tower and some Jade Talismans as keys to be opened.”
Wang Ping hesitated for a moment, and without any intention to conceal the truth, he spoke candidly.
“Immortal Tower!?”
Upon hearing this, Emperor Heavenly Feather’s pupils constricted, clearly taken aback.
Even though he was a top Emperor, learning about the whereabouts of the Immortal Tower was still hard for him to remain calm.
After all, if he could obtain the Immortal Tower, he could avenge himself.
“No wonder you want the Taiyi Emperor Tower so badly.”
Emperor Heavenly Feather stared deeply at Wang Ping.
He felt that Wang Ping was not lying, but the fact that Wang Ping easily revealed such a major opportunity made him suspicious.
“However, how do you know so much about this?
If the Taiyi Emperor Tower is indeed the key, you shouldn’t have been in there, right?”
After a pause, Emperor Heavenly Feather said solemnly.
“It’s because not only do I have the ability to grow stronger quickly, but I also have the ability to predict the future.”
Wang Ping said calmly.
“Moreover, I have no ill will towards the Taiyi Imperial Palace and sincerely wish to join it.”
“…”
Emperor Heavenly Feather frowned slightly, unable to determine whether Wang Ping’s words were true or false.
Seeing this, Wang Ping sighed inwardly, knowing that his fate with the Taiyi Imperial Palace and Emperor Heavenly Feather had come to an end, and it was estimated that he would not be able to stay in the Taiyi Imperial Palace any longer.
However, he still had to strive for the Taiyi Emperor Tower.
After all, it was related to the Immortal Tower.
“That secret realm can only be entered by cultivators below the level of a top Emperor. If the Taiyi Imperial Palace is willing to cooperate with me and help me obtain the Immortal Tower, I can take the Taiyi Imperial Palace to the Immortal Domain when I become an immortal in the future.”
Upon saying this, Wang Ping’s face turned serious.
“An alliance?” Emperor Heavenly Feather looked deeply at Wang Ping, hesitated for a moment, and finally gave his reply: “It’s possible, provided that everything you said is true, and you can subdue the Taiyi Emperor Tower by your own means.”
Other powers would eagerly forge a deep friendship with Wang Ping, and now, this indeed seemed like an opportunity.
If possible, he would like Wang Ping to become an ancestor-tier figure in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, with a status equal to his own.
However, recruiting such a powerful character into the Taiyi Imperial Palace was ultimately too risky, and he had many concerns, so it was safer to adopt this cooperative approach.
As for Wang Ping’s claim of taking the Taiyi Imperial Palace to the Immortal Domain, Emperor Heavenly Feather merely listened and did not take it seriously.
“Thank you for your trust, senior. In that case, I will try to subdue the Taiyi Emperor Tower.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 1008 266 Wang Pings Face So fat its dripping
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1008: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_5 Chapter 1008: Chapter 266 Wang Ping’s Face! So fat it’s dripping oil_5 Wang Ping nodded and then looked at Taiyi Emperor Tower, intending to subdue it.
However, something unexpected happened to Wang Ping and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
Before Wang Ping could make a move, the Taiyi Emperor Tower suddenly shrank and flew towards Wang Ping, floating in front of him and acknowledging him as its master.
“This…”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was at a loss for words.
“It seems like I’ve been saved some trouble.”
Wang Ping was taken aback for a moment and then laughed.
The way the Taiyi Emperor Tower chooses its master is by breaking through the Supreme Heavenly Path.
However, the purpose of the Supreme Heavenly Path is to select the most outstanding talents. In this world, is there a more monstrous talent than him?
Obviously, that does not exist.
At least, among the Supreme and Quasi-Emperors, it is impossible for anyone to be more abnormal than him.
Therefore, it is quite normal for the Taiyi Emperor Tower to surrender voluntarily.
