Moreover, Wang Ping guessed one more thing.
That is, Taiyi Great Emperor was in charge of this matter.
As expected, as Wang Ping thought, a phantom appeared at the scene.
It was indeed the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor.
“Greetings, Ancestor!”
After the appearance of the Taiyi Great Emperor, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor showed a surprised expression and hurriedly saluted.
Wang Ping also slightly bowed and saluted, “Junior has seen the senior.”
“Hehe, Heavenly Feather, what can such a monster plot against our Taiyi Imperial Palace? Let him directly become the actual palace master of the Taiyi Imperial Palace.”
After the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor appeared, he taught the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
The phantom of Taiyi Great Emperor had been paying attention to the development of the Taiyi Imperial Palace and knew that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was a very decisive and domineering junior.
However, when it came to Taiyi Imperial Palace, he did not dare to mess around.
After all, there were too many things to worry about when letting such a person join.
“Ancestor’s teachings are right.”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not dare to refute, laughing as he expressed his stance.
He greatly respected Taiyi Great Emperor, the founder of Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“Kid, the Taiyi Emperor Tower and Taiyi Imperial Palace are entrusted to you. I hope you can fulfill my last wish, and take the Taiyi Imperial Palace to become a Flying Immortal.”
The phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor looked at Wang Ping again and sighed.
“Ancestor, rest assured, I will definitely take the Taiyi Imperial Palace to the Immortal Domain.”
Wang Ping smiled and said these words, looking calm and confident.
“Hehe, with your words, I can rest assured.”
The phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor nodded satisfactorily.
After that, he entrusted Wang Ping and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor with some matters and then disappeared.
“Senior Heavenly Feather, I also know the location of your daughter, Yu Daoyi.”
After the phantom of the Taiyi Great Emperor disappeared, Wang Ping also brought up another matter.
“What!?”
Hearing this, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s pupils shrank, and his spirit became tense.
“Guimo Sea, inside the stomach of the sea monster.”
Wang Ping said.
“Thank you for informing me, palace master. The Guimo Sea is too dangerous, I must go to save her as soon as possible. So, I will leave the many affairs of Taiyi Imperial Palace for the palace master to handle.”
Hearing this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s face changed uncertainly, but in the end he chose to trust Wang Ping.
“There’s no need to be in such a hurry, she won’t be in any danger for the time being.”
Wang Ping shook his head, stopping the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor from immediately going to Guimo Sea.
“That’s good.” Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sighed with relief.
“By the way, senior, if I were to become the palace master, how much Extreme-tier Divine Source in the Taiyi Imperial Palace can I mobilize?”
Wang Ping coughed lightly and asked seriously.
“As the palace master recognized by the ancestor, your status is above mine. As long as you don’t empty the treasury, take whatever you need for your cultivation.”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said without hesitation.
“These are your words, senior.”
Wang Ping’s eyes instantly lit up, very excited.
“Wait, palace master, you’re not really a Devouring Source Body, growing to this level in such a short time, are you?”
Looking at Wang Ping’s strange reaction, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had a bad feeling in his heart, and asked in astonishment.
“What I said is all true. It’s just that sometimes the truth isn’t something people want to believe, and there’s nothing I can do.”
Wang Ping sighed, pretending to be helpless.
“…….”
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s face twitched, not knowing what to say.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to believe, it was just too outrageous.
Growing from a small Saint Realm shrimp to an existence that can blow up Emperors in just a few years, that’s pure fabrication in any era, right?
But now Wang Ping’s attitude is making him unable to refute.
If it’s true, Wang Ping’s monstrous degree is more terrifying than he had imagined by thousands or even millions of times.
As for what becoming an immortal and ancient immortal, compared with Wang Ping, it’s all nonsense.
As for those who have cultivated for millions of years and still become Emperors, their presence seems even more insignificant.
Truth be told, it’s quite a blow.
Even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is a Great Emperor with a strong Tao Heart, he was still somewhat shaken.
“If you want to use the Divine Source, go ahead… But the resources in the Taiyi Emperor Palace’s treasury need to be distributed to the cultivators in the palace for their cultivation, and you can’t take it all away. However, I have some Divine Source here, feel free to use it.”
After calming down, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor took out a huge amount of Extreme-tier Divine Source from his inner world.
There were as many as 200 billion jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source.
Looking at this huge amount, Wang Ping’s eyes couldn’t help but light up.
God damn! If he had known Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was so rich, he wouldn’t have gone to Red Cloud Clan to fleece them. He would have just thickened his face and called Heavenly Feather Great Emperor back for resources.
Of course, this is just hindsight for Wang Ping.
Without stirring things up in the Red Cloud Clan, he wouldn’t have been able to catch Emperor Fengxin so easily and then kill him along with the treacherous man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 1009 267 The Seventh Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1009: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Immortal Origin! Chapter 1009: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Immortal Origin! Next, after Heavenly Feather Great Emperor imparted some information to the Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace and the old monsters, he left the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
This left the Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace with a bewildered expression on his face.
Well, in the blink of an eye, he lost his position as palace master, and he didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
However, since Wang Ping, such a monster, has taken the position of the successor palace master, he did not dare complain about anything.
It should be said that they couldn’t wait for Wang Ping to become the new palace master.
With Wang Ping as the palace master, the Taiyi Imperial Palace would truly enter its most glorious era, and the dream of flying to the Immortal World would not be far off.
By that time, he could retire comfortably and spend his time pursuing longevity in the Immortal World.
However, it wasn’t long before the Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace was happy when Wang Ping directly transferred the tasks to him, asking him to be the acting palace master and handle various trivial matters.
Helplessly, Wang Ping did not have the spare time to deal with all the matters of Taiyi Imperial Palace, big and small.
For Wang Ping, the time in the real world was still very precious.
With no other choice, the Supreme Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace could only continue to carry out those trivial matters.
As for Wang Ping, after he decided to let go of his responsibilities, he came to the secret place of Taiyi Imperial Palace, intending to do a paid simulation once again.
This time, he hoped to reach the top of the Immortal Tower, make the tower recognize him as its master, and then become an Emperor.
That would be absolutely fantastic.
As long as he became an Emperor, the only cultivators in the Upper Realm who would pose a threat to him would probably be the Emperor-Tier Characters and the three quasi-Fairy characters.
Of course, special places like the Elemental Forbidden Land, Life and Death Realm, and Source of Darkness don’t count; Wang Ping calculated the existences among the cultivators that would threaten him.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming 500 million pounds of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Seven-Color Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine; Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.”
Seven-Color Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine: a one-time-use talent that, after using, can designate a target, behead them, and cause them to die completely.
PS: To use this talent, you must see their face and know their name or title. However, this talent is only effective against characters at the Great Emperor Realm and below, so please use it cautiously.
Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword: With this talent, the host can convert some damage received during combat into healing effects.
“Holy crap!”
Wang Ping was amazed by the newly-refreshed Seven-Color Talent.
It couldn’t be helped; this Seven-Color Talent was too overpowered. It could be used against any character, and they would be killed instantly, with no chance of resurrection.
It should be known that Emperor Monarchs are also Great Emperors, just monarchs among Emperors, and not half a level stronger than the regular Great Emperor tier characters.
It’s just that becoming an Emperor Monarch is extremely difficult.
First, one must comprehend the Heavenly Tao True Spirit to the Great Perfection Tier, possess a special constitution higher than that of a Sacred Body, and attain the Great Perfection Tier in that as well.
For example, powerful physiques like Time Tao Body and Destructing Tao Physique.
Thirdly, their cultivation must reach the Great Emperor Realm Completion tier.
Only by meeting these three conditions can one be considered an Emperor Monarch – a monarch among Emperors.
The reason why Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is only a Top Emperor and not an Emperor Monarch is that he lacks the qualifications to become one.
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s physique is inferior to that of a Time Tao Body and can’t compare to the extremely powerful physiques that are stronger than that of a Top Divine Physique.
Moreover, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s comprehension of Heavenly Tao True Spirit has not reached the Great Perfection realm, which is extremely difficult to achieve.
Apart from that, the ordinary Tao can’t compare to Time and Destruction, which also causes some differences.
For this reason, Emperor Monarchs are far stronger than Top Emperors.
Even Wang Ping, if he were to become an Emperor, might not be able to fight an Emperor Monarch with his early Great Emperor Realm cultivation, as the gap in cultivation and the degree of comprehension of Heavenly Tao True Spirit is too vast.
Although the True Spirit of Chaos Heavenly Path is invincible in the same realm, the gap of many levels is still a problem.
As a result, the effect of this Seven-Color Talent is truly powerful, enough to make an Emperor Monarch die on the spot.
This effect should be the top grade among Seven-Color Talents.
After all, talents of the Seven-Color level can affect the Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, and Great Emperor tiers, and it is extremely rare to have talents with a significant effect on Emperor Monarchs.
Furthermore, another use of this talent occurred to Wang Ping.
“Alpha, if I use this talent on the Sci-fi Mysterious, can I kill them?”
Wang Ping’s eyes were filled with anticipation as he asked.
“In theory, yes. However, you need to know the name or code of the person the Mysterious is attached to.”
Alpha pondered for a moment and replied.
“As long as it’s effective. This is another trump card against them.”
Wang Ping’s mouth curled up slightly as he muttered to himself.
“Of course, this talent will also be of great use in the upcoming paid simulation.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping added another sentence.
Then, Wang Ping calmed his thoughts and silently said in his heart, “System, I choose the Seven-Color Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful. Life Simulation begins….”
The system’s voice rang out as Wang Ping felt his consciousness sway and entered an immersive simulation state.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 1010 267 The Seventh Multicolored Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1010: Chapter 267: The Seventh Multicolored Talent! Fairy Source! _2 Chapter 1010: Chapter 267: The Seventh Multicolored Talent! Fairy Source! _2 Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words also appeared.
[On the first day, you chose to find a way to collect the Golden Light Jade Talisman. It must be said that your current status is really useful, no one dares disrespect you. The Quasi-Emperors obediently handed over the Golden Light Jade Talisman to you, even hoping that you would take them away. After all, this is a chance to foster relationships with you.]
[This made you quite satisfied, once again feeling that it’s good to have real power and reputation.]
[After collecting the Golden Light Jade Talisman, you did not directly open the Immortal Tower Secret Realm, but chose to wait, desireing to wait for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to return with Yu Daoyi, and then let Yu Daoyi to go to the Immortal Tower Secret Realm. After all, with the benefits, how could you let Yu Daoyi miss out.]
[When Yu Daoyi and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor returned, you chose to open the Immortal Tower Secret Realm with the Taiyi Emperor Tower.]
[An astonishing phenomenon appeared, attracting the attention of Upper Realm cultivators. The Upper Realm cultivators were shaken. As for this, you didn’t mind them and chose to enter the secret realm.]
[After entering the secret realm this time, you didn’t continue to foolishly wait for the Immortal Tower to appear, then enter it immediately, but chose to explore the secret realm, wanting to find some opportunities.]
[Recalling the past, in the previous simulations, your strength wasn’t enough, and many times you waited for the Immortal Tower to appear, either your strength wasn’t enough, you could only hunt in secret, then enhance your own strength with the Three Innate Emperor Tools, as for seeking opportunities, you didn’t the pay attention to it, you chose prudence, and weren’t interested in competing.]
[Next, you started to roam around in the secret realm, hunting Ferocious Beasts, and absorbing them with the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures. This time, every time a big battle appeared, you hurried over. Because your strength was terrifyingly sufficient, added with a perfect knowledge of time and space and chaos, you could always arrive first.]
[Because of this, many cultivators who wanted to quickly solve the battles and then leave with the treasures couldn’t achieve their goals. When they saw you, they felt worse than eating shit in their hearts, but they couldn’t speak ill of you or say that they found it first, they could only awkwardly greet you and then leave the scene directly, fearing that if they left a step late, they’d be slapped dead by you.]
[As for this result, your expression was rather subtly strange. However, you didn’t say much, just silently noted the location of the treasure, took it away, and then continued to the next destination.]
[In your opinion, there are many good things in this secret realm, as long as all the treasure locations are memorized, you can come over in reality and take them all, which would be very comfortable.]
[However, your behavior of hurrying to the battlefield every time a shocking battle broke out, caused the seniors in the secret realm to complain incessantly, but they didn’t dare to say more. After all, your strength is too powerful, even the Emperor could be killed instantly, let alone them. Plus, you opened this secret realm, they dared not say anything more.]
[Thus, you gained a lot, got numerous good things, even World-Shocking Treasure Medicine that is beneficial for the Emperors’ healing were there.]
[In a blink of an eye, nearly a hundred years passed, at the point when the Immortal Tower was about to appear, you found another opportunity.]
[This opportunity, was actually the Primordial Heavenly Emperor Crystal, the most suitable ore recorded in the Upper Realm for the forging of Emperor’s artifact. When you saw this ore, you showed a look of surprise.]
[After all, although you have the Three Innate Emperor Tools, and have the Taiyi Emperor Tower that’s close to quasi-Fairy Artifact, you even have ideas about Immortal Artifacts, but you still haven’t given up on cultivating your own life-bound weapon.]
[After all, life-bound weapon can best fit one’s own path, at the same level, it can allow you to exert a stronger combat power. Therefore, if you can forge Chaos Emperor Soldiers with this Primordial Heavenly Emperor Crystal, it would undoubtedly be a great thing.]
[After the surprise in your heart, you looked at the Destruction Quasi-Emperor next to the Primordial Heavenly Emperor Crystal, narrowing your eyes, a murderous intention emerged in your heart. You vowed to kill the Destruction Quasi-Emperor in the previous simulations, you haven’t forgotten about this. In addition, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the Destructing Tao Emperor have a deep enmity, you have received so much grace from Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, it is necessary to help him avenge, kill the Destructing Tao Emperor and his other descendants.]
[At this moment, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor still didn’t know that you had a murderous intention, his face changed constantly, in the end, he gritted his teeth and reached for the Primordial Heavenly Emperor Crystal, claiming that he found this Primordial Heavenly Emperor Crystal first, and it should belong to him.]
[Seeing this, you snorted coldly, directly used your divine skills, before the Destruction Quasi-Emperor could react, you twisted his body, causing half of his body to explode.]
[Suffering such an injury, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor grunted, his face was pale. Although his recovery ability is astonishing at his level, it also depends on who is making the move. Even if someone at the top Quasi-Emperor level attacks him, his vital source would be damaged, although it can recover quickly, the damage is also a fact. But facing you, someone who can blow up an Emperor, naturally he can’t recover quickly, a simple strike has caused him heavy damage.]
[Although the top Quasi-Emperor is powerful, after all, he can only fight against an ordinary aged Emperor, after a long fight, he would still be defeated, and he can’t be compared with you now.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 1011 267 The Seventh Multicolored Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1011: Chapter 267: The Seventh Multicolored Talent! Immortal Source! _3 Chapter 1011: Chapter 267: The Seventh Multicolored Talent! Immortal Source! _3 [Immediately, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor looked terrible and shouted that his father was the Destructing Tao Emperor. If you tried to kill him, his father would come out of his closed door state and completely suppress you.]
[Hearing this, you sneered, saying that you couldn’t find the Destructing Tao Emperor and if killing the Destruction Quasi-Emperor would make him appear, it would be another reason to kill the Destruction Quasi-Emperor.]
[After that, you said that you hate being threatened in all your life, so he should just die.]
[Seeing your determination to kill and even attack his father, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor felt desperate. However, as a top Quasi-Emperor, he was not one to fear death and chose to self-destruct without hesitation.]
[Unfortunately, just as the Destruction Quasi-Emperor was about to self-destruct, you used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see the abnormality in his energy and suppressed him, causing him to fail in his self-destruct attempt.]
[This caused the Destruction Quasi-Emperor’s face to change drastically, as he didn’t expect that he couldn’t even self-destruct. He felt suffocated and also knew that he would suffer humiliating things next.]
[The Destruction Quasi-Emperor’s guess was correct. After suppressing him, you immediately took out the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures, which prompted a terrified expression on his face.]
[He was not afraid of death, but if his death would help you become stronger, he would be Eyes Unwilling to Close at Death. Moreover, the Devouring Soul Pearl was too evil, and if you used it to devour his Divine Soul, you would be able to extract his memories.]
[At once, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor attempted to destroy his Divine Soul. However, as soon as he had this idea, it was already too late. You suppressed his Divine Soul with your Great Divine Skills, and then devoured his Divine Soul with the Devouring Soul Pearl, assisted by the Devouring Spirit Pearl and Devouring Mana Pearl.]
[This made the Destruction Quasi-Emperor scream. Even though he was a top Quasi-Emperor with strong willpower, being devoured alive and having his Divine Soul torn apart was simply too painful.]
[Eventually, the Destruction Quasi-Emperor’s everything was devoured by the Three Innate Emperor Tools. You gained his memories, learned numerous secrets, and found out the whereabouts of the Destructing Tao Emperor.]
[You once heard the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor mention that the Destructing Tao had disappeared and wondered where he had gone. Being an Emperor-Tier character, he couldn’t just vanish silently – the likelihood that he was hiding was high.]
[As an Emperor-Tier character, he wouldn’t hide aimlessly, and it was highly probable that he had obtained some great fortune. Now, your guess has been confirmed.]
[The Destructing Tao Emperor found a quasi-Fairy Situational Place in a secret place. After the quasi-Fairy transformed into Immortal Source, that secret place turned into an incredible blessed land. Of course, the blessed land wasn’t the most important part; the key was the Immortal Source.]
[The Immortal Source left behind by a quasi-Fairy transformed was an astonishing fortune. If the Destructing Tao Emperor could successfully refine it, he might break through to the quasi-Fairy tier, becoming the fourth quasi-Fairy in the world.]
[Though it seemed, since the Destructing Tao Emperor had disappeared for so many years and had not emerged even when the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion refined the Upper Realm, the likelihood of him successfully refining the Immortal Source was slim. Either he didn’t have enough time, or he had failed.]
[However, regardless, this fortune excited you. If you could go to that secret place and obtain the Immortal Source, it would be extremely beneficial to your cultivation.]
……
“Good thing, the Immortal Fate hasn’t been revealed, but the Immortal Source has come first. It’s truly a shocking fortune.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and sighed in his heart.
“If it wasn’t for the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine, dealing with the Destructing Tao Emperor would be extremely difficult. Unfortunately for him, I drew this talent, so it’s time for the Destructing Tao Emperor to fall.”
Wang Ping thought of the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine and couldn’t help but smile.
Next, Wang Ping focused his mind and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Afterward, you didn’t choose to absorb the energy from the Three Innate Emperor Tools, but went to the place where the Immortal Tower was located. Soon, the Immortal Tower appeared.]
[When the Immortal Tower appeared, it caused a stir among a large number of cultivators, who all came rushing to it. As for you, you entered the tower directly with the key formed by the Taiyi Emperor Tower and the golden light jade charm and started to challenge it.]
[Because your cultivation had reached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier, your opponents’ cultivation also reached the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Tier, making them extremely powerful. You were prepared for this and did not take it lightly. Nevertheless, you continued to sweep through the competition without any opponent in front of you.]
[Quickly, you advanced into the top 1000, top 500, and charged towards the top 300.]
[This scene shocked the cultivators who had entered one after another. However, they all thought of you first and deduced that it must be you challenging the tower. After all, in the Upper Realm, only you had such an abnormal combat strength. You were so abnormal that everyone believed that even the legendary Fairy couldn’t be your opponent at the Quasi-Emperor stage.]
[Under everyone’s watchful eyes, you continued to dominate and rapidly increased your ranking, killing your way into the top 200 and even the top 100.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 1012 267 The Seventh Seven-Color Talent Fairy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1012: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Fairy Source! _4 Chapter 1012: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Fairy Source! _4 [Once you reached the top 100, your progress slowed down a bit, but you still maintained a strong momentum in passing the levels.]
[Finally, you successfully broke through to the top 50 and top 30, which left many cultivators in awe, thinking that you might reach the peak of the Immortal Tower. Nobody doubted you, after all, your performance was truly astonishing.]
[Thinking of you reaching the peak, these cultivators couldn’t help but feel excited. After all, it was equivalent to them sharing the same world with a person who could suppress the ages, a peerless character who witnessed his own glory. What an honor it was.]
[At the same time, they also believed that you might have the power to forcibly break through the Immortal Domain Channel. If so, they might be able to follow you to the Immortal Domain.]
[As a result, some cultivators who abandoned the pursuit of Immortal Fate eagerly awaited your ascent of the Immortal Tower and even your ascension to immortality.]
[Under the scrutiny of all, you continued to break through and successfully reached the top 10. Once you reached the top 10, the pressure became enormous, as these top 10 monsters of the Immortal Tower were really too powerful.]
[However, you still had no fear and fought them, defeating them all.]
[In the end, you managed to forcefully reach the second place in the Immortal Tower. The second place in the tower was much stronger than the others behind you, and it shocked even you. Because not only did he possess a dual Immortal Bloodline, but he also had an earth-shattering Immortal Body, which was even more powerful than the Great Thunder Immortal Physique and was fully exploited by him. In addition, he comprehended 80% of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit. Having Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation and understanding eight layers of Heavenly Tao True Spirit was indeed extreme.]
[Facing such an opponent, even you felt tremendous pressure and were at a disadvantage for a time. After all, your Great Time-Space Dao body and the blank state of your Little Chaotic Body were no match for this terrifyingly perfect Immortal Body. Although your Chaos Emperor Sutra was incredibly powerful and could give you an advantage in terms of cultivation skills, it still couldn’t make up for the other deficiencies.]
[However, you were not easy to provoke. Under such circumstances, you stubbornly refused to try activating the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, but instead continued to rely on your own strength to fight him, hoping to break through your limits.]
[In the end, you really broke through your limits and comprehended 70% of the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path. With the effect of 70% True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path, you fought him and gained the upper hand. Finally, after an intense battle, you successfully defeated him and took his place in the rankings.]
[Seeing this scene, everyone was astonished. However, they also wondered whether you could reach the top spot, as you had been stuck for too long while fighting the second place contender.]
[You didn’t know what those outside thought, but you just remembered the name of this opponent who only lost to you after you broke through your limits – Lu Daoxian.]
[Next, you arrived at the next level with your full state, and then you revealed a shocked expression because this person’s physique turned out to be a Chaotic Body.]
[This surprised you greatly; you never thought that a Chaotic Body would appear in a distant era. However, you also felt that this was perfectly normal. After all, if Chaotic Bodies had never appeared in this world, there wouldn’t be legends about them.]
[Immediately afterward, you became excited. Although you knew very well that your chances of winning against this Chaotic Body were slim, you didn’t care about the defeat. What you cared about was what you could learn from this Chaotic Body. Perhaps, during the battle against the Chaotic Body, you could grasp the true mystery of the Chaotic Body, which would be of great help to you in the future when you refine and develop your own Chaotic Body.]
[Next, you started a fierce battle with him. From the very beginning, you used all your strength without any reservations. Yet, you still underestimated the strength of your opponent.]
[Facing your terrifying attack, he easily destroyed it and then unleashed an even more terrifying assault. He had also comprehended the Chaos Emperor Sutra, but its content and Divine Skills were clearly different from yours. At the same time, he also comprehended the True spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path, reaching a terrifying 80%.]
[For this reason, even without going all out, he easily took your attacks and made you feel a life-threatening danger.]
[Faced with such a terrifying attack, your face changed drastically, and you quickly used the Golden Talent: Damage Nullification ability to successfully block it. Then, you no longer held back and activated all the Colorful Talent Skills, wanting to fight him.]
[This time, you were extremely lucky and triggered high multiple critical strike damage, along with a double attack effect. However, facing this attack, the Chaotic Body still easily destroyed it, and the gap between you two was truly too great.]
[You were quite unwilling to accept this and had an impulse to use Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine. However, you suppressed that thought and continued to fight him. But this time, your fighting style changed from aggressive to evasive, trying to drag out the battle and buy more time to comprehend his mysterious Dao.]
[However, the gap in strength between you two was still too large; you were no match for him, and you were killed in less than a quarter of an hour. This was still the result of him not taking the fight seriously; if he had, you would have died earlier.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 1013 267 The Seventh Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1013: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Immortal Source! _5 Chapter 1013: Chapter 267: The Seventh Seven-Color Talent! Immortal Source! _5 [After being defeated by him, you didn’t feel down but rather quite excited. That’s because your battle with him brought you a lot of gains, and as long as you went back and reflected, you had the hope of comprehending eighty percent Heaven Spirit, while further perfecting your Chaos Emperor Sutra.]
[Of course, before that, you wanted to obtain a complete Chaotic Body even more. In your opinion, having a complete Chaotic Body not only provides a huge boost to your fighting prowess but also helps you better comprehend the Path of Chaos.]
[Next, due to the Rebirth tally, you were resurrected and continued to battle with him. This time, after thinking about it, you chose to use the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine.]
[Although, this talent was intended to deal with the Destructing Tao Emperor. But now that you are only one step away from ranking first in the Immortal Tower, you are very curious about the reward for reaching the top of the Immortal Tower and whether the Immortal Tower will acknowledge you as its master.]
[Although you think the chances of the Immortal Tower acknowledging you as its master are extremely low, you didn’t give up on trying.]
[In the end, with the domineering effect of the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine, you forcefully killed the owner of the first Chaotic Body in the Immortal Tower, Ye Cang.]
[However, something unexpected happened. After you killed Ye Cang using your talent skill, the Immortal Tower did not determine that you had successfully defeated him and still ranked you second.]
[This made you somewhat helpless. Clearly, the spirit of the Immortal Tower had seen something, so it did not recognize the outcome of the battle. Obviously, to genuinely reach the top, you must rely on your own strong fighting power, defeating the opponent head-on, rather than resorting to such underhanded methods.]
[Feeling disheartened about this, you think you really wasted your one-time use of the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine, feeling somewhat regretful. However, since you have already used it, there’s nothing you can do, so you refocused and learned from this experience.]
[Afterward, you engraved Ye Cang’s appearance in your heart, feeling that you might meet again in the Immortal World. It’s just a matter of how powerful he is now.]
[A Chaotic Body can be considered a top-tier physique even in the Immortal World, only comparable to extremely rare top-tier Immortal Bodies. As a figure like Ye Cang, even in the Immortal World, there’s no way he would remain unknown, surely growing to an unimaginable level.]
[Then, you were teleported outside the Immortal Tower. The people in the outer world saw that you had failed to conquer the tower, and your ranking was only second, showing an unbelievable expression.]
[You have already grown so strong, yet you still couldn’t reach the top of the Immortal Tower. Just how terrifyingly formidable is the first in the Immortal Tower?]
[Yu Daoyi was also very surprised and regretful, asking just what kind of monster the first in the Immortal Tower was, that even you couldn’t defeat it.]
[Regarding this, you didn’t hide it and chose to tell the truth. When Yu Daoyi and the others heard that the existence first in the Immortal Tower actually possessed the legendary Chaotic Body, they were all shocked to the extreme, while also understanding why you had been defeated.]
[After all, as both are on the Path of Chaos, how could one with a Chaotic Body be defeated by a genius like you, who doesn’t possess one? Though you have managed to walk this path without a Chaotic Body, which is already a shocking occurrence, in the end, you can’t compare to a true Chaotic Body.]
[At the same time, the cultivators present finally got to know who the strongest genius of the Upper Realm since its creation is. Chaos Body – Ye Cang is the truly invincible existence that dominates the past, present, and future.]
[It was at this moment that the immortal sound appeared, stating that you had successfully reached second place and were awarded a Cluster of Fairy Source. Then, a very pure Cluster of Fairy Source appeared in front of everyone.]
[As the immortal sound appeared, everyone was shocked and showed fanatic expressions. After all, this is a Fairy Source. Although they don’t know the exact conditions needed to become immortal, having a Fairy Source definitely makes it easier to become immortal than others. Even if they couldn’t become true immortals, there was hope for them to become quasi-Fairys, or Pseudo-Immortals.]
[At that level, they would have an astonishing lifespan, and their fighting power would increase to an unimaginable level.]
[You were also quite surprised, not expecting that the reward for reaching the second place in the Immortal Tower was a Cluster of Fairy Source. Originally, you were planning to find the Destructing Tao Emperor to snatch a Fairy Source, but now you had already received one.]
[Afterward, you looked at the cultivators with fanatical and greedy faces and scoffed. As your scoff echoed, all the cultivators regained their senses and broke out in a cold sweat.]
[After all, you’re the one holding the Fairy Source. Although you couldn’t reach the top of the Immortal Tower, with your fighting power, it would be a piece of cake to wipe out all of them by yourself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 1014 268 The Fusion of the Three Beads The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1014: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! Chapter 1014: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! “This Ye Cang who is ranked first in the Immortal Tower is quite freakish, true to being from the Ye’s family. But, is there really Immortal Source within the Immortal Tower? This is truly surprising. How many good things are hidden within this tower?”
Wang Ping looked at the content simulated in the text, numerous thoughts crossing his mind, growing increasingly eager about the Immortal Tower.
If he could take control of the Immortal Tower, all the good stuff inside would be his. Just thinking about it made him thrilled.
“Nevertheless, this Immortal Source is a hot potato. If word gets out, I fear it will incite all the Great Emperors and even those few quasi-Fairies from the Upper Realm to hunt me down.”
Wang Ping recalled this point once more, furrowing his eyebrows slightly.
Although he has already exhibited enough terrifying talents and combat power, who could ignore the Immortal Source right in front of their eyes?
Those Great Emperors who desperately yearn for immortality, let alone those quasi-Emperors, could barely suppress their inner greed.
In the end, if the simulated Wang Ping hadn’t sneered, they might have actually ganged up on simulated Wang Ping due to their greed.
“Should I kill them all? To hide the Immortal Source.”
This idea flashed in Wang Ping’s mind.
However, after some deliberation, Wang Ping found it highly unlikely.
If all these people were to die in the secret realm, all the forces would definitely still want to cause trouble for him, Wang Ping.
That would be a big problem at that time.
“Forget it. Let’s see what the simulated Wang Ping does, I won’t interfere, just silently observing will be enough.”
Wang Ping shrugged and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Just as everyone was in awe of your presence, something unexpected happened which shocked you and the rest of the cultivators – the Three Innate Emperor Tools you possessed floated out all at once and began revolving around the Immortal Source, devouring it.]
[Seeing this, your face changed. You wanted to stop the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures from devouring the Immortal Source. After all, it was an Immortal Source which is incredibly precious. Once your cultivation reached the Perfect Emperor Stage, you could use the Immortal Source to enter the quasi-Fairy Tier.]
[However, the Devouring Mana Pearl, Devouring Spirit Pearl, and Devouring Soul Pearl soon informed you of a truth. The condition for the three Innate Emperor Tools to transform into Immortal Artifacts was the need for an Immortal Source. Without it, they could never succeed in fusing.]
[Hearing the feedback from the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures, you fell silent, taken by surprise. You hadn’t expected that the fusion of the Devouring Spirit Pearl, Devouring Mana Pearl, and Devouring Soul Pearl into an Immortal Artifact would require an Immortal Source.]
[This made you finally understand the reasons behind the situations in your previous simulations. In your past simulations, you made various attempts but ultimately yielded nothing. It turns out, you were just missing the keycomponent – the Immortal Source.]
[Eventually, you could only sigh in resignation. You stopped trying to prevent the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures from devouring the Immortal Source, hoping that after successfully absorbing the Immortal Source, they would transform into Immortal Artifacts. With Immortal Artifacts in your possession, your combat capabilities would massively skyrocket.]
[At the same time, the appearance of these Immortal Artifacts would help rapidly improve your cultivation level. Once you reached the Great Emperor Tier, the original Three Devouring Emperor Treasures wouldn’t be able to help you rapidly improve your cultivation anymore. But if these Three Devouring Emperor Treasures transformed into a Devouring Immortal Bead, the situation would be completely different.]
[At this moment, it was inconceivable to the cultivators present that you allowed the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures to devour the precious Immortal Source. Their eyes widened, turning red with the envious belief that you were wasting heavenly resources.]
[However, as the Immortal Source was yours, they dared not voice their opinions and could only glare with envy. If they were stronger, they would have liked to join forces to kill you out of greed and take everything.]
[Caught up in various thoughts, you looked at them and scowled upon seeing their intentions through the Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[Originally, you thought that killing all of them would have significant consequences and make you and the Taiyi Imperial Palace public enemies of the Upper Realm. However, it seemed necessary now to kill them all.]
[Only by doing so could you keep the secrets of the Immortal Artifact and the Immortal Source. Otherwise, once you left the secret realm, you would be met by the relentless pursuit of all the Great Emperors and even the quasi-Fairies.]
[Facing the pursuit of these strong beings, even with your unparalleled combat capabilities, you wouldn’t stand a chance. You would be killed and perish completely.]
[With this in mind, you unleashed a murderous intent and used the Time-Space Divine Skill to completely seal off this area.]
[Seeing this, all the cultivators changed their expressions dramatically, inferring your intentions, their faces filled with terror. They warned you that doing so was declaring war on all the forces.]
[You sneered coldly, moving regardless, and killed more than ten quasi-emperors in an instant.]
[Seeing you genuinely taking drastic measures, all the quasi-emperors present became anxious and started to team up against you.]
[However, under your unrestrained power, even if they teamed up, they wouldn’t stand a chance against you.]
[Ultimately, in a short period of time, you slaughtered most of the quasi-emperors and Supremes present, leaving only a few quasi-emperors alive.]
[These quasi-emperors are: the unaffiliated Cyclops Quasi-Emperor from Peach Village, the white-cloaked quasi-emperor, the quasi-emperor who gave you the golden light jade charm, along with Huangqin and other quasi-emperors from the Phoenix Clan. After all, you owed some of them favors and it wouldn’t be right to return kindness with ingratitude. Of course, you didn’t owe Huangqin any favor, but you considered her because she is the mother of Huan Qing and Huangyin.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 1015 268 The Fusion of the Three Beads The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1015: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _2 Chapter 1015: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _2 [In the end, you should also consider the matter of Phoenix Emperor giving you the Devouring Mana Pearl without hesitation.]
[However, even though you didn’t kill this group of people, you didn’t plan to let them go either. Instead, you directly implanted prohibitions on them, indicating that you needed them to stay with you for a longer period. Only after you have gained the power to fight against Emperor Monarchs and even quasi-Fairies would you let them go.]
[In response to your words, these Quasi-Emperors dare not disobey and are extremely obedient. Even the fierce Peach Village Quasi-Emperors are no exception. There’s no choice; your recent massacre of most of the Quasi-Emperors of the Upper Realm was just too brutal. Their own behavior pales in comparison to yours.]
[As for the Quasi-Emperors of Taiyi Imperial Palace, they remain silent and say little. They, too, know what Immortal Source represents – something that would drive all Emperors crazy and must not be revealed.]
[Just when you massacred the strong ones present and warned the surviving ones, the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures began to radiate astonishing light, devouring the Essence, Qi, and Spirit of the fallen powerhouses, thereby accelerating the Devouring of the Immortal Source.]
[At this moment, in the outer world, all Imperial-tier forces and Quasi-Emperor-tier Forces are unable to sit still, and their powerful practitioners look extremely ugly. This is because, at this moment, the Soul Tablets of those practitioners who had Soul Tablets have all shattered.]
[Although it is said that many cultivators wouldn’t leave Soul Tablets behind for the sake of Divine Soul Consummation, some powerful practitioners with maxed potential and cultivation that had reached the limit would still leave Soul Tablets behind.]
[However, within an extremely short time, all Soul Tablets shattered, indicating all these powerful practitioners perished in the secret realm. It’s not hard to guess that those who didn’t leave Soul Tablets behind probably met the same fate as those who did, being more unlucky than lucky.]
[In the end, after comparing their losses, the various forces in the Upper Realm realized that the other forces had also experienced the same thing, which made all the Emperors’ faces extremely ugly.]
[However, forces like Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, Phoenix Emperor, and those spared by Wang Ping discovered that their Soul Tablets hadn’t been shattered. They breathed a sigh of relief, didn’t participate in the topic, lowered their presence, and remained silent.]
[They knew very well that something unimaginable must have happened in the secret realm. If the other forces found out that none of their powerful practitioners had perished during this period, they could become targets.]
[Following that, some Emperors began to work together to deduce what exactly had happened in the secret realm. The Immortal Mansion was directly visited by Divine Calculation Man due to the fact that it had also alarmed the Ku family. The Ku family also brought out a peculiar person skilled in Heavenly Secret Skill, albeit not as talented as Divine Calculation Man.]
[In the end, the deduced Heavenly Secrets revealed that all the forces present had learned about the birth of Immortal Source and your massacre of the powerhouses from various forces.]
[This angered all the powerful practitioners present, who stared at Heavenly Feather Emperor.]
[Seeing this, Heavenly Feather Emperor’s face changed, knowing that the lineage of Taiyi Imperial Palace might be destroyed in an instant. As expected, the various Emperors had nothing good to say to Heavenly Feather Emperor and directly attacked.]
[Faced with this, although Heavenly Feather Emperor was extremely powerful, he was still outnumbered and was completely killed. Even after killing Heavenly Feather Emperor, the various forces went to Taiyi Imperial Palace and destroyed it as well.]
…..
“This…”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation and frowned, falling into silence.
He genuinely didn’t expect Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace to be ruined like this by the simulated Wang Ping.
Immortal Source, such a hot potato.
“However, the choice of the simulated Wang Ping can’t be considered wrong. After all, not killing these people would have leaked information, and both the simulated Wang Ping and Taiyi Imperial Palace would have been targeted, ending with the same outcome. The only difference is that the simulated Wang Ping can try to use the Seven-color talent·Running God to escape with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and others.”
Wang Ping sighed silently, murmuring to himself.
“If possible, I can’t be so aggressive next time. I can try to suppress and seal them first, and then when the simulated Wang Ping leaves, directly take Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace with me.”
After a pause, Wang Ping continued to think to himself.
However, as he thought, a question arose for Wang Ping.
That is, if Wang Ping didn’t kill those powerhouses, would the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures be able to successfully merge into Immortal Artifacts?
After all, during the fusion process of the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures, the Essence, Qi, and Spirit of the powerhouses he killed seemed to play a crucial role.
“It’s a bit troublesome.”
Wang Ping knitted his brows tightly.
Not killing them would allow the information to leak easily, and without the Essence, Qi, and Spirit of so many powerhouses, the fusion might fail.
But by killing them, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace would be wiped out.
It seems necessary to have Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace relocate in advance.
However, the Heavenly Secrets Skill is a hassle.
Although Divine Calculation Man appeared to be useless for most of the time in the previous simulation, that is only in comparison to Heavenly Calculation’s Child; he was not useless.
When dealing with strange affairs, there was probably also support from Emperor Slaughter from Slaughter Paradise and tools like Blocking Heavenly Mystery of Myriad Heavens Paradise, so Divine Calculation Man appeared useless.

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 1016 268 The Fusion of the Three Beads The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1016: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _3 Chapter 1016: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _3 However, the Divine Calculation Man is not actually useless.
If he were really useless, he wouldn’t have such a big reputation and be able to calculate some things about the future, and his position in the Immortal Mansion would be extraordinary.
Wang Ping doesn’t have any means to conceal Heavenly Secret Skills on his body. To be precise, the previous Golden Talent – Heavenly Mystery Concealment had become useless already, it was ineffective at this level.
Therefore, these old fellows have the ability to deduce some things that Wang Ping does.
Though the Heavenly Secret Skill certainly has great limitations and can’t calculate many secrets on Wang Ping’s body, it is ultimately able to deduce what happened in the secret realm, and that is enough.
Unless the Devouring Immortal Bead can be refreshed as a reward, otherwise, it’s like being stuck at a bottleneck.
Wang Ping frowned, feeling a headache.
After becoming an Emperor, he could naturally fear nothing.
But after becoming an Emperor, he couldn’t enter the secret realm anymore.
But without becoming an Emperor, he couldn’t possibly be a match for those top Emperors, Emperor Monarchs, and Quasi-Immortals in the secret realm, even if he obtained the opportunity that shocks the world, it would be easy to give it to others.
Of course, in the secret realm, he could naturally try to escape using the Seven-color talent・Running God, but this talent has many limitations and is not safe. Wang Ping didn’t dare to use it in the real world.
Besides, even if he teleported, as long as he didn’t teleport to other worlds and remained in the Ten Great Universes, he couldn’t escape the clutches of these powerful beings and would eventually be found.
“No, no, I seem to have overlooked something,”
Wang Ping contemplated and thought of a point, his eyes flickering.
Simulation and reality are two different things.
In reality, Heavenly Calculation’s Child went mad, most likely due to him.
In the simulation, Heavenly Calculation’s Child is sober because simulated Wang Ping can’t use the Life Simulator anymore, and the Heavenly Secrets are not so chaotic, so he sobered up.
This point also applies to the Divine Calculation Man in reality.
The Divine Calculation Man’s skills are not as good as Heavenly Calculation’s Child; would he dare to calculate?
If he really calculated Wang Ping’s matters, he might end up with an even more tragic outcome compared to Heavenly Calculation’s Child.
That is to say, it would be safer for Wang Ping to take action in the real world.
“However, all of this is based on my conjecture being correct. If there is an error, there will be trouble. Although I certainly won’t die, Taiyi Imperial Palace and Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, and others, will suffer. If they were to die in reality because of me, it would really be a sin.”
Wang Ping sighed again, calming his thoughts and not daring to gamble in reality.
Wang Ping thought that instead of gambling in reality, it was better to continue simulating a few more times, trying to refresh the Seven-color Talent that could conceal Heavenly Secrets or the kind of powerful talent that can help him break through the situation.
In that case, it would be even safer.
Subsequently, Wang Ping shook his head and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[You don’t know the situation in the outer world; you don’t know that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Imperial Palace are destroyed because of you. You continue to stare at the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures, hoping that they can successfully merge and become Immortal Artifacts.]
[Only Yu Daoyi feels restless, feeling that she has lost something important and becomes inexplicably irritable. This makes her have the impulse to leave the secret realm.]
[Not only Yu Daoyi, but some of the powerful beings from Taiyi Imperial Palace in the secret realm also have such a feeling.]
[However, Yu Daoyi and the others looked at you and the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures, their expressions conflicted. In the end, they suppressed that impulse and continued to watch the scene of the Three Innate Emperor Tools merging, hoping to witness the birth of Immortal Artifacts.]
[That’s right, everyone is not a fool. After being shocked, they thought of the legend that the Three Innate Emperor Tools can be transformed into Immortal Artifacts once collected, and guessed why you allowed the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures to devour the Immortal Source.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed. During these hundred years, the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures have been devouring the Immortal Source. Up until now, the Immortal Source has been completely consumed, and the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures have begun to truly merge.]
[In the meantime, many forces in the outer world are trying to forcibly enter the secret realm by various means but all ended in failure. They also considered letting other Quasi-Emperors go in, but thinking of the gap between other Quasi-Emperors and your strength, they chose to give up this act of sending someone’s head, and could only patiently squat at the entrance of the secret realm, waiting for you all to exit.]
[In the blink of an eye, another fifty years have passed. Fifty years have gone by, and the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures have finally merged perfectly and become an Immortal Artifact.]
[Immortal Artifact・Devouring Immortal Bead is born, with dazzling Immortal Light, and astonishing celestial phantom phenomena appear in the entire Upper Realm, shocking many cultivators. Furthermore, the great emperors, as well as the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortals, cast their eyes on it and became somewhat restless.]
[After all, they have learned about what you have done in the secret realm. That is to say, this is a sign of the birth of the Devouring Immortal Bead. That is an Immortal Artifact. If they can obtain it, it is hard to imagine how powerful they will become. Perhaps with the help of the Devouring Immortal Bead, they could become immortal beings.]
[However, although their hearts are restless, they have no way to forcibly enter the secret realm and can only watch helplessly, feeling quite depressed. In the end, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal chose to come out, shocking the Upper Realm with the pressure of Quasi-Immortal power.]
[This makes all emperors feel horrified, not expecting someone as powerful as the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion to be hidden in the Upper Realm. However, when they found out that the Quasi-Immortal was from the Ku family, they felt a bit relieved. It was quite normal for the mysterious Ku family to have such a powerful person guarding it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 1017 268 The Fusion of the Three Beads The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1017: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _4 Chapter 1017: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _4 [Next, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal chose to take action, intending to forcibly break open the secret realm and seize the Immortal Artifact.]
[However, an unexpected event occurred in the eyes of the Emperors. Even when the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal took action, the secret realm remained unmoved, with no changes.]
[Moreover, it seemed that the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal’s behavior had angered the rules of the secret realm. A terrifying Immortal Light erupted from the secret realm, directly severely injuring the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal.]
[This scene shocked the Emperors, who had not anticipated that the secret realm was so terrifying that even a being surpassing the Emperor would be severely injured if they tried to enter forcibly.]
[For a moment, all the powerful people present furrowed their brows, feeling that if you were to persist in hiding within the secret realm, they would truly have no way to deal with you.]
…..
“This secret realm is truly terrifying. Even the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal was seriously injured. If I were to hide within it, it would indeed offer me another lifeline. I just don’t know whether I could become an Emperor inside this secret realm, and how long this secret realm could remain open.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, feeling astonished and relieved.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the simulation continued.
[After the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal was severely injured, the celestial phenomenon of the Upper Realm became even more astonishing. As a result, everyone lost their interest, and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal’s face turned gloomy. After recovering his body, he withdrew his power, not daring to make another move.]
[On your side, you were pleasantly surprised by the birth of the Devouring Immortal Bead. Thus, you successfully acquired an Immortal Artifact. However, just as you were reveling in your fortune for a short while, a dreadful tribulation began brewing. This was the Immortal Artifact Tribulation specifically targeted at the birth of Immortal Artifacts. Only by successfully crossing this Heavenly Tribulation could the Devouring Immortal Bead continue to exist in the world and evolve further.]
[On the other hand, if it couldn’t withstand this terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, the artifact’s emergence would be for naught.]
[Regarding this, you had no choice but to watch and hope that the Devouring Immortal Bead could cross this Heavenly Tribulation.]
[Just as the Devouring Immortal Bead was about to cross the tribulation, a white light began to radiate around your group, and everyone was teleported out of the secret realm, arriving in the outer world.]
[The Devouring Immortal Bead was also teleported to the outer world. This change caused your complexion to shift. Although you didn’t know whether the Immortal Tower had expelled the Bead due to concern about the Bead causing damage to the secret realm during its tribulation, or if the secret realm had reached its time limit, the current situation was undoubtedly extremely unfavorable.]
[An ordinary Immortal Artifact might not have as great an attraction to the Emperors as the Immortal Source, but an unconventional Immortal Artifact like the Devouring Immortal Bead was another matter altogether. This item was more precious than the Immortal Source, and even Quasi-Immortals would definitely try to seize it.]
[As it turned out, your guess was correct. With the appearance of you, your group, and the Devouring Immortal Bead, both the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal and the other Emperors present showed frenzied expressions. Even the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion couldn’t stay put any longer, choosing to reveal himself and staring intently at the Devouring Immortal Bead.]
[This scene made you extremely helpless. In the face of the Emperors, you could still rely on your Seven-color talent·Running God to escape, but if there were Quasi-Immortals present, the Seven-color talent·Running God would be intercepted and rendered ineffective.]
[It was at this moment that the Devouring Immortal Bead’s Immortal Artifact Tribulation began to erupt. Everyone present, including you, started to distance themselves, fearing being affected.]
[At this moment, you had the impulse to give up the Devouring Immortal Bead, take advantage of the powerful beings not paying attention, and immediately use the Seven-color talent·Running God to leave. If you continued to stay here, your group would likely perish here.]
[You were not indecisive. Without hesitation, you used the Seven-color talent·Running God. However, to your dismay, the Seven-color talent·Running God was intercepted.]
[Although the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family seemed to be paying no attention to you, it was clear that they had been watching you all along, preventing you from escaping.]
[You didn’t know whether it was the doing of the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion or the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, but in your eyes, neither of them was a good person. Especially the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion, who did not seem like the kind of benevolent being who would open the Immortal gates for the common people, and likely had some plans when recruiting Upper Realm Heavenly Geniuses and opening the Immortal gates.]
[Subsequently, the Devouring Immortal Bead successfully crossed the Immortal Artifact Tribulation, transforming once again and making the celestial phenomenon even more intense.]
[At this moment, all cultivators were filled with enthusiasm. Simultaneously, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal took action, trying to snatch the Devouring Immortal Bead.]
[However, before the two of them could make a move, another Quasi-Immortal pressure descended. A figure emerged from the Source of Darkness, and the aura from their body was even more formidable than that of the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family.]
[Moreover, this person was not Pavilion Master Cold Moon, but an unknown face.]
[This scene shocked all cultivators present, including you, making your expression extremely grave. Evidently, the Quasi-Immortal before you had slumbered within the Source of Darkness and awakened when he sensed the emergence of an Immortal Artifact, joining the fray to claim the Bead.]
[As for the existence of fallen Quasi-Immortals within the Source of Darkness, it was not a secret for the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal.]
[After all, the Upper Realm had existed for an ancient period. When the Immortal Domain Channel was still unsealed, naturally, no Immortals or Quasi-Immortals would choose to fall into the Source of Darkness, preferring to go to the Immortal World.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 1018 268 The Fusion of the Three Beads The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1018: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _5 Chapter 1018: Chapter 268: The Fusion of the Three Beads! The Great Disturbance of the Dark Source! _5 [However, after the closure of the Immortal Domain Channel, quasi-Fairy had nowhere to go. A quasi-Fairy’s lifespan is indeed much longer than that of an emperor, but they are ultimately not as immortal as fairies. Therefore, some quasi-Fairy would choose to fall into the Source of Darkness and continue to survive in the world.]
[So, it is common for quasi-Fairy to exist in the Source of Darkness. However, even the Immortal Mansion’s quasi-Fairies and the Ku Family’s quasi-Fairies do not know how many Dark Emperors and quasi-Fairies are sleeping in the Source of Darkness.]
[Because too much time has passed, many things can no longer be traced. Now, they can only hope that the number of quasi-Fairies sleeping in the Source of Darkness is not too high, otherwise, it would be truly dangerous.]
[However, sometimes, the more you don’t want something to happen, the more likely it is to happen. With the appearance of this quasi-Fairy, more and more quasi-Fairies emerged, and the number of quasi-Fairies that appeared this time is as many as nine.]
[That’s to say, over the long years of the Upper Realm, a total of ten quasi-Fairies have been hidden in the Source of Darkness, unknown to external cultivators.]
[This is just a speculation. After all, in the view of the Immortal Mansion’s quasi-Fairies and Ku Family’s quasi-Fairies, when the Immortal Artifacts emerge, the sleeping quasi-Fairies in the Source of Darkness would definitely be alerted and could not help but come out.]
[Seeing this scene, you too fall silent, unable to believe that so many Dark quasi-Fairy were hiding in the Source of Darkness. This time, you’re truly doing a favor for others.]
[It’s just not clear who will be the final winner of this battle, whether it’s one of the Dark quasi-Fairy or your Predecessor Ransmigrator, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.]
[Soon after, the chaotic battle of the quasi-Fairies broke out. The terrifying aftershocks of the battle swept across the Big Universe, affecting distant starfields. As for you, facing the battles of these quasi-Fairies, you try to escape but ultimately fail. The quasi-Fairies are so powerful that the aftershocks of so many chaotic battles are not something you can withstand now.]
[Although you are now powerful in combat, your defense force and vitality are still significantly lower than your attack power.]
[As a result, after being affected, you suffer serious injuries. However, you manage to protect Yu Daoyi and survive together. As for the other powerhouses of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, they are ruthlessly annihilated.]
[However, something that makes you frown occurs. Although you escaped from the central circle of the battle with Yu Daoyi, you are now targeted by many emperors.]
[You knew that you had been too high-profile before and would definitely be targeted. Now that the Immortal Artifacts have appeared, and the great battle has erupted, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, your Predecessor Ransmigrator, is unlikely to protect you in the eyes of others. However, you did not expect to be targeted by all the emperors at this time. This situation is undoubtedly unusual.]
[At the same time, you also discover that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is not present, which changes your expression slightly, guessing that the secret of the secret realm might have been exposed.]
[Sure enough, an emperor stares at you with murderous intent, reveals the events that happened in the secret realm and tells you not to prevaricate. This was deduced by the Divine Calculation Man, and it must be true.]
[Upon hearing this, you sigh and know that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor has truly fallen, and you are probably going to fall here today.]
[However, you still show no fear and confront the emperors present, wanting to fight them. However, even if your same realm battle power is against the sky, it is still impossible to have any chance of winning under this situation. Yu Daoyi is killed by the emperors on the scene, and you are also easily seriously injured by the group of emperors, and finally killed by the sneak attack of Emperor Slaughter.]
[Because of your death, the simulation ends here.]
….
With the end of the text simulation, many insights and images appear in Wang Ping’s mind. His figure also appears in the starry sky, seeing the fall of simulation Wang Ping, and witnessing the terrifying scene of the quasi-Fairy chaotic battle.
“Immortal Artifacts, such hot potatoes, I can’t even protect them. Unless, I can really refresh them through the rewards of the Life Simulator. Unfortunately, according to my current analysis, the current Life Simulator can’t even refresh Emperor’s artifacts, let alone Immortal Artifacts.”
In the end, Wang Ping shook his head, feeling quite helpless.
“By the way, why didn’t Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion appear in this quasi-Fairy melee? Did he disdain to take action? Or did he plan to wait for the melee to enter its final stages before reaping the benefits of the fisherman?”
Wang Ping thought of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, his Predecessor Ransmigrator, and couldn’t help but frown.
Just as Wang Ping was contemplating, his consciousness flickered, and he exited the immersive simulation state.
At the same time, the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, reward generation successful, Host can choose two from the following rewards:
①. Seven-Color Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine.
②. A random emperor-tier artifact.
③. A random quasi-Emperor Artifact.
④. Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.
⑤. Chaos Emperor Sutra (Ye Cang Version).”
…
Wang Ping looked at the rewards refreshed this time, his face twitching and his eyes becoming strange.
Good fellow, he had just complained that the current Life Simulator might not even be able to refresh emperor-level artifacts.
As a result, the Life Simulator directly refreshed an emperor-level artifact reward. This is probably deliberately slapping him in the face.
“Life Simulator, you’re ruthless.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples and grumbled.
Of course, this is also something worth celebrating, at least this shows that he underestimated the upper limit of the Life Simulator’s reward-refreshing ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 1019 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body Secret
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1019: Chapter 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body! Secret of Cold Moon! Chapter 1019: Chapter 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body! Secret of Cold Moon! “System, I choose ①. Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine and ⑤. Chaos Emperor Sutra.”
After glancing at the reward list, Wang Ping made his choice.
Although Emperor’s artifacts are precious, they don’t mean much to Wang Ping now. He doesn’t lack them, and having one more artifact won’t increase his battle power.
Therefore, choosing the Chaos Emperor Sutra is the best choice.
Chaotic Body Ye Cang’s comprehension of the Chaos Emperor Sutra is even more profound than his. If he can absorb its essence, it will definitely help him advance further.
“Ding, reward selection successful.”
As the system’s voice rang out, Wang Ping felt a surge of knowledge in his mind.
That was none other than Ye Cang’s version of the Chaos Emperor Sutra.
Wang Ping eagerly absorbed the secrets of the Emperor Scripture.
After an unknown amount of time, Wang Ping came back to his senses, showing a look of astonishment.
Chaotic Body Ye Cang’s understanding of the Chaos Emperor Sutra was indeed much more profound than his own. As long as he absorbed all of its essence and integrated it into himself, he would successfully comprehend eighty percent Heaven Spirit.
Reaching eighty percent Heaven Spirit would put Wang Ping on par with Chaotic Body Ye Cang as recorded in the Immortal Tower.
By then, as long as Wang Ping obtained the Chaotic Body, he would be able to contend with Ye Cang.
Of course, Ye Cang’s Chaotic Body must have reached the Minor Domain realm.
Therefore, for Wang Ping to completely surpass him, he would not only need to acquire the Chaotic Body but also push it further.
“There’s no hurry. I have plenty of time to polish myself. Even if I can’t acquire the Chaotic Body and upgrade it to the Minor Domain realm in a short time, I can still increase my strength to defeat him by comprehending 90% of Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
“Next time, I can’t be eager to enter the secret realm. I have to find the origin of a Space-type Great Emperor first.”
After having an idea, Wang Ping murmured in his heart, “System, I want to start the Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming 500 million pounds of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh successful, congratulations on successfully refreshing Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill and Purple Talent: Sword to Reach Gods.”
Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill – With this talent, the host can deduce Heavenly Secrets to learn the things he wants to know or use the Heavenly Secret Shield.
However, this talent is a one-time use, has a limit to its talent abilities, and will consume one of the host’s lives after use. Please use with caution.
Purple Talent: Sword to Reach Gods – Possessing this talent grants the host a strong Sword Skill.
“It’s like whatever I want really comes to me. I initially wanted a Heavenly Secrets-related talent, and it actually arrived. But the side effects of this talent are too much.”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows as he looked at the talent he had just refreshed.
A one-time use, limited talent ability, and consuming a life after use – this was very unreasonable.
“Although it’s a Golden Talent, with so many side effects, the upper limit of this talent must at least reach the Multicolored realm, otherwise, it would be too weak.”
After silently evaluating, Wang Ping made his choice.
“System, I choose Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
As the system’s voice sounded again, Wang Ping felt his consciousness waver and entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you continue to comprehend Ye Cang’s version of the Chaos Emperor Sutra, hoping to perfect your own and help you grasp eighty percent of the Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit.]
[In the blink of an eye, a thousand years have passed. During this time, you have been diligently pursuing Enlightenment. Finally, you successfully absorbed the essence of Ye Cang’s Chaos Emperor Sutra and comprehended eighty percent of the Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit.]
[This filled you with joy, as you felt your strength had significantly increased.]
[Afterward, you began to consider your next plan. You thought using the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill to locate a Space-type Great Emperor was a good choice.]
[However, you also felt this would be somewhat wasteful. You knew the whereabouts of one Space-type Great Emperor: Emperor Devouring Space. In the previous simulation, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor had sought him out to trade on your behalf.]
[Now, you thought you could find him and ask him for some of his origin. As for the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill, you believed it would be best used in the secret realm to shield against the joint deduction of the Divine Calculation Man and various Great Emperors.]
[Following this, you tried to contact the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, hoping he would help you reach out to Emperor Devouring Space, as you wanted to trade with him.]
[Upon hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor appeared surprised and curious about your trade with Emperor Devouring Space.]
[After thinking it over, you didn’t hide anything and directly told Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. In your opinion, hiding the transaction of their origin was impossible, so it was better to say it openly.]
[After hearing your words, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor frowned, shook his head, and told you that Emperor Devouring Space would not trade with you. An Emperor’s origin is too precious, and recovering from damage is too troublesome. Besides, you clearly wanted more than just a little.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 1020 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body Secret
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1020: Chapter 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body! Secret of Cold Moon! _2 Chapter 1020: Chapter 269 Wang Ping Gains Chaotic Body! Secret of Cold Moon! _2 [Hence, even if you offer something extremely precious, Emperor Devouring Space wouldn’t trade with you. Not to mention that you clearly don’t have anything that could drive Emperor Devouring Space to the brink of craziness.]
[Upon hearing this, you feel that it makes sense and become a little frustrated. After all, Emperor Devouring Space is not the Phoenix Emperor, whose origin can be regenerated. Other great emperors can’t do that, unless you trade with an Immortal Source, which is clearly impossible.]
[While you are pondering, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor asks if you must obtain the origin of a Spatial Great Emperor.]
[You nod and explain that you possess a Little Chaotic Body. If you want to transform the Little Chaotic Body into a True Chaotic Body, both Temporal Origin and Space Origin are indispensable.]
[Your words shock Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, who never expected you to possess a Little Chaotic Body – you’ve hidden this secret very well. Subsequently, he understands why you are able to comprehend the True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path and walk the Path of Chaos. Having a Little Chaotic Body makes it normal to walk on this path.]
[Afterward, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s eyes reveal a fierce light, saying that he might have a way if you need the origin of a Space-type Great Emperor.]
[You notice Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s fierce gaze and can’t help but feel startled. You make a throat-cutting gesture, asking if he intends to take out Emperor Devouring Space.]
[Hearing this, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor laughs, saying that he has no grudge against Emperor Devouring Space and would never try to kill him. Furthermore, Emperor Devouring Space is a Top Emperor with formidable fighting capacity, making it impossible to obtain his origin through combat.]
[You nod, relieved, and agree with this reasoning. Then, you curiously inquire about the meaning behind Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s previous words.]
[Seeing your curiosity, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor tells you about some past events. It turns out that in the distant past, there was an emperor who pursued the Space Dao. He had an extremely formidable combat ability and was known as Emperor Kongxuan, on par with the Dark Time Emperor.]
[In his later years, Emperor Kongxuan fell into the Source of Darkness. If someone were to attack and kill him, they would obtain his origin.]
[Upon hearing Emperor Kongxuan’s name, you are quite surprised. You have seen his name in the _Xian Tower Stele Ranking_, where it’s ranked somewhat lower than Dark Time Emperor’s. You could never have imagined that Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would target Emperor Kongxuan.]
[Subsequently, you curiously ask Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, “Emperor Kongxuan is an Emperor Monarch, and you are not his opponents. Moreover, the Source of Darkness is far too dangerous, and going deep into it could be life-threatening!”]
[Heavenly Feather Great Emperor shakes his head, explaining that Emperor Kongxuan’s situation is unique. When he fell into the Source of Darkness, he had already been severely wounded by Dark Time Emperor, causing a significant decline in his battle power. Thus, he stays in the outer region of the Source of Darkness, where, if you join forces, there is a good chance of success in killing him.]
