[Hearing Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s words, you feel that they make sense and are willing to give it a try. With Heavenly Feather Great Emperor as the main combatant, you can provide support. As long as the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect is triggered, you should be able to kill him.]
[If there are any unexpected issues, you can use the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine to kill him directly.]
[Afterward, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor warns you to guard your mind and not be influenced by the darkness within the Source of Darkness. Otherwise, you risk falling into darkness.]
[Upon hearing this, you nod in agreement and acknowledge that you understand. The Source of Darkness is actually a byproduct of the mysterious, powerful BOSS contaminating the Upper Realm. The Source of Darkness has never intentionally gone berserk, and all the incidents related to Dark Disaster were caused by the emperor or quasi-Fairies in the dark source.]
[Therefore, the emperor can actually enter the Source of Darkness as long as they are able to maintain their mental strength. However, if they stay too long, they may eventually fall into corruption.]
[Entry into the Source of Darkness is not strictly forbidden, but most of the great emperors refuse to do so, as it is far too dangerous. They not only have to guard against sleeping Dark Emperors but also protect themselves from corruption.]
[Only top emperors like Heavenly Feather Great Emperor have the strength and courage to take a chance with the Source of Darkness. Even then, he only dares to venture into the peripheral areas without going too deep.]
[If it weren’t for the fact that it’s essential for Wang Ping’s future path to becoming a Taoist, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor would not risk entering the Source of Darkness or battle an Emperor-Tier character, even if they were already severely injured.]
…
“Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is still as good to Simulation Wang Ping as ever,” Wang Ping sighed, examining the content of the Text Simulation.
Although the reason for Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s kindness was to lift the Taiyi Imperial Palace’s reputation, Wang Ping couldn’t help but feel grateful for his support.
“I hope there won’t be any accidents. Otherwise, I’ll have to find another way during the next simulation,” Wang Ping thought silently while continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Once you are prepared, you set off together and sneak into the Source of Darkness without attracting the attention of other emperors. Upon entering the Source of Darkness, you immediately feel an eerie darkness that begins to erode your mind.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 1021 269 Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1021: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_3 Chapter 1021: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_3 “With this in mind, you are filled with worry. You use the Eightfold Heaven Spirit and several Emperor’s artifacts to suppress the dark aura, and dare not take any chances. ”
“Next, you and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor journey to the place where Emperor Kongxuan is in hibernation. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, with no intent of wasting words, reveals an intimidating level of combat ability and launches an attack on Emperor Kongxuan, seeking quick resolution of the battle. ”
“However, a situation that you and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not anticipate has occurred. Emperor Kongxuan’s injuries have recovered to some extent, stronger than the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s estimate. More than that, he is pursuing the path of space, making him very difficult to deal with. He can even unleash the power of a top Emperor, not the late stage Emperor’s power as predicted by the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. ”
“This situation is undoubtedly quite troublesome. After all, this is the Source of Darkness, and it would be extremely dangerous if you don’t conclude the battle quickly. It might even attract attacks from other hibernating Dark Emperors. ”
“Seeing this, you don’t hesitate to unleash impressive power. With all your talents in effect, you use eighty percent of the Heaven Spirit. The Eightfold Heaven Spirit, once released, leaves both the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Emperor Kongxuan stunned. ”
“Then, when Emperor Kongxuan finds that your attack has reached a level capable of counteracting that of an Emperor in the late stages with a Special Constitution, his face changes dramatically. He did not expect you, a Quasi-Emperor, to have such immense power. ”
“However, he sneers coldly, showing no sign of panic. While outnumbered, he knows he would eventually lose if the battle drags on, but this is the Source of Darkness. You cannot afford a prolonged battle, and he has the support of other Dark Emperors. Over the years, he has built friendships with several Dark Emperors. ”
“After all, only Emperors are worthy enough to fall into the Source of Darkness and hibernate within. As a result, too many terrifying entities sleep within the Source of Darkness. The internal forces are complicated, and even he has to band together for warmth. Otherwise, a lone fight could easily lead to being devoured by other Dark Emperors. ”
“Very soon, you and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor feel the presence of several Dark Emperors. This causes a shift in your expressions. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor sends you a message, signaling that it’s unwise to continue the battle. You must retreat. ”
“Afterwards, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor says that although you failed to get the Origin of Emperor Kongxuan this time, you should attack the Emperor Devouring Space once you get out. Even though you don’t have any scores to settle, for the sake of your becoming a Taoist, you can’t care too much about it. ”
“Seeing this, you sigh in your heart, knowing that you can’t hesitate any longer. Consequently, you directly use the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine. ”
“With the effect of the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine in place, the expression on Emperor Kongxuan’s face instantly stiffens, and then he is directly slain, completely fallen. ”
“The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is shocked by this scene. He did not expect you to have such an amazing trump card, and quietly, you managed to kill Emperor Kongxuan. ”
“Next, you quickly escape with the body of Emperor Kongxuan, and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor swiftly follows suit. ”
“It’s just when you’re running away, those Dark Emperors who originally intended to support Emperor Kongxuan halt their action, and show no intention of pursuing. After all, Emperor Kongxuan is already dead. Chasing after you for a fight would be an endless thankless task. It’s not something they, the ultimately selfish Dark Emperors, would do. ”
“Eventually, you successfully escape from the Source of Darkness, quietly taking a sigh of relief. Later, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor does not ask why you were suddenly able to slay Emperor Kongxuan. He just gives you a deep look, appreciating the number of secrets you hold, then returns with you to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. ”
“Shortly after your return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, a Dark Disaster erupts. Obviously, it’s a Dark Disaster provoked by those Dark Emperors. Its purpose is to warn you and carry out corresponding revenge. ”
“Since you and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor caused the Dark Disaster, you choose to jointly suppress this not-so-small Dark Disaster, preventing it from affecting too many innocent cultivators. ”
“Once the Dark Disaster is over, you head to the Jee Family and meet with the Wang Family, hoping that they would open the secret realm ahead of schedule. ”
“Although, with your current means, forcefully opening the secret realm and taking the Temporal Origin would be a breezy task, you don’t want to do such a thing. Therefore, you notify the Jee Family and the Wang Family who own the rights to the secret realm. ”
“This puts the Jee Family and the Wang Family in a predicament, but for the sake of forming a relationship with you and not daring to offend you, they act accordingly. ”
“In the end, you successfully obtain the Temporal Origin. The Jee Family and the Wang Family also benefit from you, leaving their ancestors laughing heartily. ”
“Then, having gathered various factors, you return to the secret place of the Taiyi Imperial Palace and start seclusion to integrate the Chaotic Body. ”
“In the end, after a span of ten thousand years, you successfully absorb the Time-Space Origin, allowing the Time-Space Body to reach the perfect domain. ”
“Next is the step of integrating the Little Chaotic Body and the Perfect Time and Space Tao Body. You are well aware that you don’t have the various methods of the Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, the traveler. Therefore, you absolutely cannot merge them into a Chaotic Body in the outer world. Because that would undoubtedly cause a huge commotion, attracting the attention of numerous cultivators.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 1022 269 Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1022: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_4 Chapter 1022: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_4 [In that case, you would be putting yourself in danger again.]
[After considering, you choose to go to the Elemental Forbidden Land. If you are in the Elemental Forbidden Land, you can use the land to hide many phenomena and no one can disturb you. You can live in hiding to obtain the Chaotic Body.]
[Although it’s dangerous to enter the Elemental Forbidden Land, as long as it allows you to successfully obtain the Chaotic Body, it would be worth it – at least better than dying outside. At the same time, you also want to try if you can use the Seven-color talent·Running God in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[If you can use the Seven-color talent·Running God in a place like the Elemental Forbidden Land, it would be awesome.]
[Not long after, you arrive at the Elemental Forbidden Land and enter it directly. Then, you set up the Great Array directly and begin the fusion.]
[After thousands of years, the Little Chaotic Body successfully fuses with the Perfect Domain Time-Space Body, becoming a True Chaotic Body.]
……
“Good job, I didn’t expect it to be so smooth to obtain the Chaotic Body. I thought there would be twists and turns.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, quite surprised.
He had thought that, based on his previous experience, this time would definitely fail, or perhaps there would still be some missing conditions. In the end, he would still need to use the World Source to adjust it.
However, the result was incredibly smooth, making Wang Ping feel a little unreal.
“It seems like I’ve been accustomed to being abused.”
Wang Ping commented subtly on himself with a full-face expression.
It can’t be helped. Previously various methods of him dying, various setbacks encountered would make him feel unaccustomed.
For example, last time when he obtained an Immortal Artifact, it ended in tragedy, which caused him to develop an inertia in his thinking.
[As the True Chaotic Body emerges, terrifying phenomena engulf the entire Upper Realm, shocking all the cultivators in the Upper Realm. Even you are quite surprised. Then, you feel a myriad of emotions and think that Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion is indeed extraordinary. He obtained the Chaotic Body without any phenomena appearing, and no one knew when he obtained the Chaotic Body.]
[However, you can’t care about all of that now because, with the emergence of the Chaotic Body, the Heavenly Tribulation has started to brew.]
[The terrifying Heavenly Tribulation brews in the Elemental Forbidden Land and strikes towards you. Faced with it, you are fearless and confront the Heavenly Tribulation. It must be said that the Chaotic Body’s Heavenly Tribulation is terrifying, even you feel a tremendous pressure.]
[But in the end, you made a crazy move: to let the Chaotic Body transform, you gave up resistance and chose to take the Heavenly Tribulation head-on to cleanse the Chaotic Body. You gained great benefits and let the Chaotic Body reach the Minor Domain.]
[To achieve this, you have to thank the Purple Talent·Death Puppet, Golden Talent: Damage Nullification, and the effect of the Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound. Otherwise, this crazy behavior would only be struck to ashes by the Heavenly Tribulation, leaving nothing behind.]
[However, the result was eventually delightful and brought you great excitement.]
[While you were Crossing Tribulation, the master of Nine Stars Pavilion in the outer world fell silent, and various thoughts flashed in his heart. Then, he stepped towards the Elemental Forbidden Land. Other cultivators in the Upper Realm, even the Quasi-immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, did not know where the Chaotic Body was Crossing Tribulation due to the existence of Elemental Forbidden Land. Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was undoubtedly an exception.]
[As you successfully crossed the tribulation and were in high spirits, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion suddenly appeared at your side, giving you a big scare.]
[Upon this, your smile vanished, and with a serious look on your face, you stared at Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, this Predecessor Transmigrator, and prepared yourself for a battle to the death.]
[You are aware that by obtaining the Chaotic Body, you are obstructing the path of the Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, this Predecessor Transmigrator, and you are destroying all his plans. He will not let you go easily. It will be a battle to the death between you two.]
[However, you also know that even if you have obtained the Minor Chaos Body and your combat power has skyrocketed, you are still no match for the Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion who is a Predecessor Transmigrator. He is a quasi-immortal, and among them, he is extremely powerful and his cultivation is much higher than yours.]
[However, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion did not show any intention of attacking you immediately. Instead, he stared at you and slowly said, ‘I am me, you are not you, but how I wish you were you.’]
[Hearing Master Leng Yue’s words, you looked puzzled, not knowing what he was talking about. After all, what he said this time was different from last time. And, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion didn’t say anything about killing you.]
[After a moment of silence, you question what Master Leng Yue means by his words, and why he would say such things.]
[In response to your inquiry, Master Leng Yue’s face remained stern, and he said, ‘Only the you who possess infinite possibilities are the real you. The you now, who lost those infinite possibilities, are not the person he has been waiting for. Since you are not the one that’s been waited for, you must die.’]
[Hearing Master Leng Yue’s words, you were shaken and became sure that Master Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator, must know something about your Life Simulator. Otherwise, he wouldn’t say such things. At this point, you felt chills down your spine, not knowing what he was thinking or plotting.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 1023 269 Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1023: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_5 Chapter 1023: Chapter 269: Wang Ping Obtains the Chaotic Body! The Secret of Leng Yue!_5 [At the moment when you were uncertain, the master of Nine Stars Pavilion, Leng Yue, made his move, killing you directly.]
[Because of your death, this simulation comes to an end.]
….
With the end of the text simulation, Wang Ping’s mind is filled with numerous realizations and images.
Finally, his figure appeared in the Elemental Forbidden Land, witnessing this scene.
“This situation is getting more and more troublesome…”
Wang Ping fell silent, his expression extremely solemn.
The way the master of Nine Stars Pavilion, Leng Yue, treated the real Wang Ping and the simulated Wang Ping was very different.
To the real Wang Ping, the master of Nine Stars Pavilion chose to save him. Although he seemed cold, he was indeed protecting Wang Ping.
However, in the life simulation, he was so indifferent. Although he wouldn’t deliberately target the simulated Wang Ping, as long as the plan of the predecessor ransmigrator Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion truly began, or if the simulated Wang Ping sabotaged his plan, Leng Yue would be filled with killing intent.
These two attitudes were like the difference between heaven and earth.
To be honest, Wang Ping couldn’t understand what was going on with the predecessor ransmigrator Leng Yue.
“Why is he waiting for me, my real body? What is his reason for waiting for me?”
Wang Ping clenched his fists, his face changing rapidly, and his heart was surging with countless thoughts, unable to calm down.
Could it be that to get through this hurdle, he couldn’t rely on paid simulations, but had to develop in the real world?
“I don’t care, as long as my cultivation improves, I don’t believe I can’t defeat him.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
However, Wang Ping quickly fell silent again.
It seemed that he had encountered another problem.
Even if he refreshed the Chaotic Body reward, it would be detected by the Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
At that time, he would definitely come to find Wang Ping.
Once this happened, Wang Ping would no longer have time to continue with paid simulations.
Unless, at the same time when Wang Ping acquired the Chaotic Body, he raised his cultivation to the Perfect Emperor Stage and chose both the Chaotic Body and the Cultivation Reward. Only then would he have a chance to fight Leng Yue.
However, this was a paradox.
Because once Wang Ping acquires the Chaotic Body, he would be targeted by Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, making it impossible for him to have time to improve his cultivation.
Unless, every time he tries to use the Seven-color talent·Running God to escape to other worlds.
“I can’t hide there in the Immortal Tower Secret Realm either. After all, that place can’t be open for thousands of years to let me successfully fuse with the Chaotic Body. Moreover, even if I acquire the Chaotic Body at the entrance of the secret realm and then go in, it still won’t work. I’m sure I’ll be kicked out by the Immortal Tower. Last time, I was kicked out because of the Immortal Artifact Tribulation.”
“Not to mention, I suspect that Leng Yue, a quasi-Fairy, wouldn’t be afraid of the heavenly tribulation of my Chaotic Body.”
Wang Ping felt a headache.
As his cultivation level rose higher, the troubles he encountered increased.
In the end, Wang Ping could only suppress his thoughts and exit the immersive simulation state.
Then, the system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Minor Chaos Body (Once this reward is claimed, other physiques will be automatically replaced.)
②. Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill.
③. Purple Talent: Sword to Reach Gods.
④. A Random Quasi-Emperor Artifact.”
…..
“I actually refreshed the Minor Chaos Body…!?”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards this time and was quite surprised.
To be honest, with Wang Ping’s understanding of Life Simulator, the probability of refreshing the Minor Chaos Body, whose value is many times higher than that of the Emperor’s artifact, is extremely low.
Unexpectedly, it was refreshed this time, and his luck should be considered excellent.
However, whether to choose it or not was a real problem.
Once he chose it, he would definitely be detected by the Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion and then pursued by him.
If Wang Ping didn’t choose it and tried to obtain the Chaotic Body himself in the real world, it would be really troublesome. It would take a long time, which he couldn’t afford.
“I choose!”
In the end, Wang Ping had a determined expression and made up his mind.
He didn’t believe that the moment he obtained the Chaotic Body, Leng Yue, the predecessor ransmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, would detect it.
After all, the chaotic body was refreshed by the Life Simulator. When obtained, it should not have many manifestations, unless Leng Yue, the predecessor ransmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, also tried to obtain the Chaotic Body; otherwise, it would take some time for him to detect that the Chaotic Body had been snatched away.
Besides, even if he was detected, Wang Ping could choose to escape immediately and go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
For the sake of the Chaotic Body, it’s worth giving it a shot.
As long as Wang Ping wins the gamble, all the problems, whether it’s the Immortal Tower Secret Realm or other issues, will be resolved quickly.
“System, I choose ①. Minor Chaos Body and ②. Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill!”
Wang Ping had made his decision and said directly in his heart.
Choosing the Chaotic Body was the right choice.
As for the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill, even though it didn’t perform well in this simulation and seemed unable to resist Master Leng Yue’s methods, as long as it could stop Divine Calculation Man’s methods, it would be enough.
Moreover, there were no better rewards than the Golden Talent: Heavenly Secret Skill.
With Wang Ping’s choice, he felt his physique undergo a shocking change. His original Time-Space Body and Mysterious Body Gift Pack all disappeared and were replaced with the Minor Chaos Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 1024 270 The First Person in Eternity The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1024: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Realm! Chapter 1024: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Realm! “I have attained the Minor Chaos Body, and now my combat power is already formidable enough. In this Upper Realm, there are very few cultivators who can defeat me.”
Wang Ping felt his own power and nodded in satisfaction.
In the life simulation, simulator Wang Ping’s performance can rival that of a late-stage Emperor with a Special Constitution. This might be slightly weaker than the Top Emperor like Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, but it is still considered a powerful force in the Upper Realm.
After all, among the hundreds of Emperors in the Upper Realm, the number of Emperors that can reach this level is undoubtedly few, it’s uncertain if there are even twenty of them.”Once I become an Emperor and develop a little more, I will be invincible among the Emperors.”
Wang Ping became increasingly confident in his own strength.
But of course, this premise is to not be discovered by the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion that he has already obtained the Chaotic Body, otherwise, he will face a lot of trouble.
“System, continue the simulation.”
After Wang Ping calmed himself down, he spoke again.
He didn’t have much time to dawdle, he must quickly become Emperor and acquire even stronger power.
“Ding! Consuming 500 million jin of Extreme-tier Divine Source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refresh in process….”
The system voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword; Purple Talent·Great Summoning Skill.”
Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword: You can use blood to heal.
Purple Talent·Great Summoning Skill: Once you acquire this talent, you can summon a certain number of Divine Realm Experts to assist in battle.
“Has my luck started to decline? This time there’s not even a single gold.”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time and shook his head slightly.
Then, he casually made his choice: “System, I choose Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded, Wang Ping felt a jolt in his consciousness and entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words surfaced.
[Day 1, You chose to let the Quasi-Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace collect the golden light jade charm while you directly went to the place where the Destructing Tao Emperor is hidden, intending to seize his Immortal Source.]
[After you arrive at his hidden place, you encounter resistance. A shocking Great Array is laid out there, and with your current power, you’re unable to break it.]
[But you’re not anxious, you use the the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack repeatedly, hoping to trigger the instant death effect. Eventually, you successfully trigger the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect, successfully breaking the carefully arranged Great Array of the Destructing Tao Emperor, and infiltrating it.]
[Then, you see a scene that makes your eyebrows furrow. The Destructing Tao Emperor’s condition is clearly very strange, as if he has fallen into madness. You observed it with the Breaking Origin Sky Eye and saw the abnormal state of his Divine Soul.]
[This, made you understand one thing, the so-called Immortal Source, is just a trap, a trap laid down by Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal on the verge of falling. The intention was to lure someone like the Destructing Tao Emperor to come, then corrode his Divine Soul and take his body.]
[In this tribulation, if the Destructing Tao Emperor can withstand it, and turn around to eliminate the will of Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal, he will reap astonishing benefits, becoming a Quasi-Fairy would be a piece of cake. But if he fails to do so, he would either be possessed, or perish together with the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal.]
[Judging by the fact that the Destructing Tao Emperor didn’t appear for the next ten thousand years, he probably chose to perish together with the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal.]
[Thinking this, you can’t help but find the Destructing Tao Emperor very pitiful. He had already become one of the top emperors, yet he still fell for someone’s calculations and became a moth caught in the spider’s web. In the end, he could only try his best to perish together with the will of the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal. It can be said that his cultivation ended in vain.]
[While you find the Destructing Tao Emperor pitiful, he also looks at you. The look in his two eyes is completely different, one is full of pain and anger, the other is full of evil and cunning.]
[Finally, the Destructing Tao Emperor speaks, laughing loudly, exclaiming unexpectedly that prey would deliver themselves to his door, and also possess the legendary Chaotic Body, this is really a pleasant surprise.]
[Listening to this strange words, you remain expressionless, stating that the Quasi-Fairy still falls short of swallowing you. Then, you directly use the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine to deal with the Destructing Tao Emperor.]
[Because of the effect of the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine, the Destructing Tao Emperor’s expression stiffened, his Divine Soul rapidly dissipated. Even the will of the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal is the same. Although he is a Quasi-fairy will, he is now entangled with the Divine Soul of the Destructing Tao Emperor, and thus also entrapped within your range of power.]
[However, you are not particularly happy about the complete disappearance of the Destructing Tao Emperor and the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal. After all, your purpose of coming here was the Immortal Source. In the end, there was no Immortal Source, you didn’t gain anything, and you also wasted the effect of Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine, it was really a big loss.]
[Despite the fact that after absorbing and refining the Destructing Tao Emperor’s physical body and origin using the Devouring Emperor Artifact, you actually didn’t suffer a loss, but compared to the Immortal Source, it is decidedly far from it.]
[Finally, you put the corpse of the Destructing Tao Emperor into your inner world, while also checking out the Destructing Tao Emperor’s stash. Then, you finally show a smile. Because the Destructing Tao Emperor’s wealth is truly astonishing, much stronger than even the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 1025 270 The First Person in Eternity The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1025: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Realm! _2 Chapter 1025: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Realm! _2 [The Destructing tao emperor has as many as 50 billion pounds of top-quality divine sources, in addition to world-shocking treasure medicines and minerals that are effective for great emperors.]
[Next, you will leave this place and prepare to return to the Taiyi Imperial Palace. When the Taiyi Imperial Palace gets the golden light jade charms, you will directly open the secret realm. This time, you have no plans to wait for Yu Daoyi again.]
[For you, time is money, and you must become stronger as quickly as possible before Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion realizes it.]
[Soon after, you opened the Immortal Tower Secret Realm. Then, using your memory, you collected various treasures in the secret realm.]
[When the Immortal Tower opened, you began to challenge the tower. This time, you were truly mad with killing intent, no one could stand against you and was easily slain in seconds.]
[Finally, under the shocked gazes of all the cultivators present, you instantly killed Lu Daoxian and engaged in an earth-shattering battle with Chaotic Body Ye Cang.]
[This time the battle wasn’t like last time, where you were still struggling even when using your talents to their fullest. Instead, you fought extremely comfortably without using any talent. Moreover, because you had fought Ye Cang before and absorbed the essence of his Chaos Emperor Sutra, and could still improve during the battle, your fighting power was even higher than his created phantom.]
[As a result, the battle reached its peak, and Ye Cang was already at a disadvantage. However, you were clear that you would have to pay a heavy price if you wanted to completely kill him. But since injuries or death will have no consequences here, you still had no reservations and did not intend to use your talents.]
[In such a battle of evenly matched opponents, your understanding of the Path of Chaos became even deeper. As a result, at the end of the battle, you unexpectedly comprehended 90% of the Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit, your strength soared once again, and you forcefully killed Ye Cang with a terrifying skill. At this moment, your strength was already far superior to Ye Cang.]
[It was after you killed Ye Cang that you successfully won the top spot of the Immortal Tower. This scene shocked all the cultivators outside the tower, and they realized that they had witnessed a miracle and saw the birth of the strongest monster in the Upper Realm since its creation. You are likely the first person in the past and future to achieve this, with no one to surpass you.]
…
“This time, I finally had a blast, with 90% of the Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit, defeating Ye Cang, topping the first place in the history of the Upper Realm.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the text simulation with a smile on his face.
It’s just uncertain whether he could win the Immortal Tower after reaching the top and what rewards he would receive.
As Wang Ping pondered, the simulation continued.
[Just as everyone was shocked, you heard a voice inside the Immortal Tower. That was the voice of the Immortal Tower Spirit. The Immortal Tower Spirit congratulated you for becoming the number one in this world. Then, it asked you if you were willing to accept the Immortal King Trial.]
[If you accept the Immortal King Trial and pass it successfully, you will become its master.]
[When you heard the Immortal Tower Spirit’s words, you were shocked in your heart. Although you knew that the origin of the Immortal Tower was definitely extraordinary, and that the immortal light that erupted from the secret realm had severely injured the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, this is something ordinary immortal artifacts cannot compare with.]
[After all, the Devouring Immortal Bead, which has just become an Immortal Artifact, could not fight against the Quasi-Immortal by its own power. If the Devouring Immortal Bead could fight against the Quasi-Immortal and even kill him, you would not have fallen in the last simulation. However, this is quite normal, as Immortal Artifacts ultimately require Immortals to exert their true power. They can’t possibly be a Quasi-Immortal opponent by just relying on their power.]
[The same is true in the Upper Realm, Emperor’s artifacts are very powerful, but they can be suppressed by ordinary Quasi-Emperors. It’s just that when a Quasi-Emperor has an Emperor’s artifact in hand, they can gain a great advantage when fighting against a fellow Quasi-Emperor.]
[Immortal Artifacts are even more powerful and cannot be suppressed by great emperors or even Emperor Monarchs. In this respect, they are much better than Emperor’s artifacts. But Quasi-Immortals are different. This tier is too powerful and cannot be suppressed by just any tool.]
[However, the Immortal Tower can severely injure a Quasi-Immortal, which is much more impressive than the Devouring Immortal Bead and you doubt that it was even serious. Therefore, you had suspected earlier that the Immortal Tower must not be an ordinary Immortal Artifact, but you did not expect it to be related to the Immortal King and possibly an Immortal King’s Artifact.]
[Although there are not many records about Immortals in the Taiyi Imperial Palace due to the gap in history, you know that the Immortal Kings must be much more powerful than ordinary immortals.]
[After recovering from the shock, you asked the Immortal Tower about its rank. The Immortal Tower Spirit did not hide anything and directly told you its level. The Immortal Tower is an Immortal King’s Artifact, the Life-bound Fairy King Artifact Tower of the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[Upon hearing this answer, your heart already expected it but was still amazed. You were sure that the Immortal King’s Artifact – Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower didn’t use its full strength against the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, otherwise, he would have been dead without any trace.]
[Then, you asked about the specific ranking of the Immortal World. The Immortal Tower Spirit did not hesitate and chose to inform you. There are not many levels in the Immortal World: True Immortal, Profound Immortal, and Immortal King. Above the great emperors are the Immortals, who can undergo a true metamorphosis, live forever, and have an unlimited lifespan.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 1026 270 The First Person in Eternity The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1026: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_3 Chapter 1026: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_3 [Hearing the Immortal Tower’s answer, you are extremely astonished. You initially believed that the cultivation system in the Immortal World would be similar to the Upper Realm, having many realms. However, you never thought that there would only be three Great Realms in the Immortal World, which is quite surprising.]
[The Immortal Tower Spirit notices your astonishment and calmly explains that becoming an immortal is difficult, whether in the lower realm or the upper realm. Hence, immortals are considered top-tier powerhouses in the Upper Realm, with their numbers never being too many. Even an Emperor would be considered strong upon reaching the Upper Realm. As for Immortal Kings, there have not been more than a hundred of them since the creation of the Immortal Domain, even with the accumulation of hundreds of epochs. In other words, it’s not guaranteed that a new Immortal King would be born after an epoch has passed.]
[Upon hearing the Immortal Artifact Spirit’s response, you feel a subtle mood change. You initially thought that after reaching the Immortal Domain, the scenario of Emperors being no different from dogs and Immortal Kings walking all over the place would happen again, just like when you first ascended after achieving the Void lord status. It turns out, however, that the situation is quite the opposite.]
[In the Immortal Domain, Emperors are still powerful, and Immortal Kings are indeed the pinnacle of power. There have been less than a hundred Immortal Kings since the inception of the Immortal Domain.]
….
Wang Ping looks at the text simulation content, astonished as well.
He didn’t expect that the Immortal Tower was the Immortal King’s Artifact, nor did he expect to learn about the Immortal Domain’s affairs here.
“It seems that going to the Immortal Domain would finally avoid the experience of becoming weak right after ascending. If I could achieve immortality before going to the Immortal Domain, the strength bonus provided by my Chaotic Body should make me a powerhouse among True Immortals. However, transcending levels and fighting at the immortal level could become extremely difficult, and it might not be as rampant as in the lower realm,” Wang Ping thought silently.
Just as Wang Ping was contemplating, the text simulation continued, revealing even more shocking news.
[At this time, you recalled the matter of the immortal who guards the Immortal Domain Channel and curiously asked the Immortal Artifact Spirit. Upon hearing your inquiry, the Immortal Artifact Spirit falls silent.]
[Afterward, it slowly says, “It seems that the situation in the Immortal Domain is worse than I had imagined. Perhaps your decision not to go to the Immortal Domain is, in fact, the correct choice.”]
[These words astonish you, and you can’t quite understand why the Immortal Artifact Spirit would say such a thing. You can’t help but ask further.]
[After a moment of silence, the Immortal Artifact Spirit indicates that you are not yet qualified to know the truth. If you become an immortal in the future, you may have the privilege of learning some secrets. However, once you find out what has transpired in the Immortal Domain, you may choose not to go there at all. Of course, not going to the Immortal Domain might be a good thing.]
[You listen to the words of the Immortal Artifact Spirit, feeling quite speechless. Whether it is the Dark Time Emperor, the Predecessor Ransmigrators like Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, or the Immortal Artifact Spirit itself, they all speak in riddles.]
[However, you also know that no matter how much you pursue, the Immortal Artifact Spirit will not reveal the truth. So you give up on asking further and think of something else.]
[That is, since the Immortal Tower is still here, does it mean that Ye Cang, the prodigy with a Chaotic Body, never passed Celestial Spirit Immortal King’s trial? If so, the difficulty of this Immortal King Trial must be beyond imagination.]
[As if perceiving your thoughts, the Immortal Artifact Spirit responds by saying that the Immortal King Trial is indeed difficult, and not even prodigies possessing a Chaotic Body can necessarily pass it. However, Ye Cang did not fail the Immortal King Trial because he was born much earlier than when his master, the Celestial Spirit Immortal King, came to the lower realm.]
[To be exact, among those ranked on the stele, there are many similar cases like Ye Cang. This stele ranking is created by observing and recording the marks left by the Heavenly Tao.]
[Upon hearing this, you finally feel relieved. If even Ye Cang, who possesses a Chaotic Body, cannot pass the trial, then the difficulty of the trial is indeed too high.]
[However, even more questions arise in your heart. What exactly happened in the Immortal Domain, and why did the Celestial Spirit Immortal King leave behind the Immortal Tower in the lower realm?]
[While you are pondering, the Immortal Artifact Spirit asks you again if you want to proceed with the Immortal Tower Trial. With determination, you nod your head, indicating that you want to participate in the Immortal King Trial.]
[Upon receiving your response, the Immortal Artifact Spirit sends you to an eerie space where there is no light, only eternal darkness. Your expression turns serious, and you feel slightly uneasy.]
[Most trials you have experienced in the past test your combat power and talent, but these aspects have already been tested in the previous Immortal Tower challenge, so it’s unlikely that they will be tested again. As such, this trial must be unique, and you must proceed with caution.]
[However, a surprising event occurs. Even after a year, no enemy appears, and no sound is heard, leaving you utterly puzzled and wondering what the content of the trial actually is.]
[As time goes by, three more years pass, and you finally notice something unusual happening – an evil thought begins to grow in your mind, seeking to erode your will.]
[This makes you extremely vigilant as you guard your mind, determined to crush the evil thought with your willpower.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 1027 270 The First Person in Eternity The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1027: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_4 Chapter 1027: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_4 [In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed. Surprisingly, you were unable to resist the evil thoughts and were completely overwhelmed, being thoroughly corroded by them. It was at this moment that your vision brightened again, returning to the space where you had fought with Ye Cang earlier and regaining consciousness.]
[You were drenched in cold sweat, recalling the scene of being completely corroded, feeling chilled to the bone. There was no choice since the emergence of the evil thought was so silent, making it too strange and unpredictable.]
[The Immortal Tower Spirit looked at you with disappointment, saying that although your talent was astonishing and few people in the Immortal World could compare to you, your will was too weak and not balanced with your talent. In this state, if you ascended to the Immortal Domain after becoming an immortal, you would die.]
[Hearing this, you felt depressed but could not refute. Most of your growth relied on cheating, and some memory scenes ultimately could not significantly enhance your willpower. Although in many simulations, the simulated Wang Ping’s will would grow stronger after the test of time, the current simulation had just started not too long ago, which naturally made no difference from a pure cheater.]
[In the end, you could only sigh with frustration, knowing that there was no hope of obtaining the Immortal King’s Artifact this time. Furthermore, even if you became an immortal, it was uncertain whether you could gain the approval of the Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower Spirit. After all, the test measured willpower, which was unrelated to talent, battle prowess, or cultivation.]
[However, you were somewhat puzzled by the importance of willpower in the eyes of the Immortal King, so much so that it far surpassed talent and combat capabilities. Could it be that to become an Immortal King, willpower was the most crucial factor? Or the situation in the Immortal Domain was more complicated and dangerous than you imagined.]
[While you were thinking, the Immortal Tower Spirit granted you the reward for being the first in the Immortal Tower ranking. It was an Immortal Scripture and a cluster of Fairy Source. The scripture was none other than the Immortal King Scripture created by the Celestial Spirit Immortal King, which was extremely valuable. If you could comprehend its mystery, it would greatly help you in creating the Chaotic Immortal Scripture.]
[Even if you could not comprehend the Chaotic Immortal Scripture in a short time, as long as you cultivated it, your combat power would be greatly improved. After all, the Immortal King Scripture was several grades higher than the Emperor Scripture. Although the Chaos Emperor Sutra was more profound than many Immortal Scriptures, it was still far inferior to the Immortal King Scripture. The Immortal King Killing Skill recorded in the Immortal King Scripture was definitely stronger than the Chaos Emperor Scripture you created.]
[Of course, you knew that you had to forge your own path, so you wouldn’t rely on the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture and choose to switch fully to its practice. Instead, you would use the Immortal King’s Skill to refer to it and comprehend it. The Path of Chaos you understood was ultimately the most suitable for you.]
[After happily putting these two items into your inner world, the Immortal Artifacts Spirit transported you to the outside of the Immortal Tower. You appeared before everyone.]
…….
“It seems I need to find a way to temper my willpower. Of course, if possible, it would be best to refresh a Seven-Color Talent for willpower.”
Wang Ping was looking at the text simulation and thinking silently.
However, whether a Seven-Color Talent for willpower could withstand the tempering of the Immortal King Trial was genuinely questionable.
After all, without optimization, the highest level corresponding to the Seven-Color Talent was only Emperor-class… far from Immortal King.
The Seven-colored Floor Tile corresponded to Supreme, which was even more out of the question.
Although the difficulty of the Immortal King Trial must be much lower than that of the Immortal King level, the hope for Seven-Color to hold up was still pitifully small.
“It seems I have to optimize the Golden Finger.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
“But, does this kind of thinking mean I can never get rid of my dependence on the Life Simulator…?”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping fell into contemplation.
He had to admit that since crossing over, his ontology had experienced some things, but he mostly lived a comfortable life relying on simulation, lacking tempering. The overdependence on the Life Simulator was an inescapable reality.
“Well, I can only take one step at a time. Let’s see what the result of optimizing the Life Simulator will be. If there’s no way forward, then I will try to temper myself.”
Wang Ping shook his head, sighed, and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[With your appearance, all the cultivators present cast in awe, and the ancestors of Taiyi Imperial Palace were ecstatic. After all, you, the Number One Person of All Ages, were their Palace Master of Taiyi Imperial Palace, who could lead their sect to greatness in the future.]
[Next, you didn’t intend to say much to the others and chose to lead the people of the Taiyi Imperial Palace away from here. While they continued their opportunities, you began cultivation in seclusion, planning to become an Emperor.]
[In the blink of an eye, more than a hundred years had passed. During these years, you didn’t have the three Devouring Emperor Artifacts absorb the Fairy Source to upgrade to Immortal Artifacts, as it would cause too much commotion. You wanted to wait until the time was right.]
[Therefore, for more than a hundred years, you utilized the three Devouring Emperor Artifacts to devour the Destructing Tao Emperor’s corpse and essence, hoping to refine the Emperor Physique quickly and then become an Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 1028 270 The First Person in Eternity The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1028: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_5 Chapter 1028: Chapter 270: The First Person in Eternity! The Secret of the Immortal Domain_5 [When you made some progress, you felt a force of space and time, which brought you out of your cultivation state, realizing that the secret realm’s time limit had arrived. Apparently, it wasn’t the Immortal Tower’s disdain for the Devouring Immortal Bead going through the Immortal Artifact Tribulation last time, but the time limit for the secret realm’s opening had come.]
[As a result, you ended your cultivation and waited to be teleported out. However, you remembered something. At this point in time, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion might have already discovered the matter of the Chaotic Body. If you go out now, there’s a high chance of being caught by him and taken away in a single wave.]
[Facing Pavilion Master Cold Moon, a predecessor ransmigrator, even if you use Seven-color talent·Running God, you won’t be able to escape his grasp. After thinking it through, you chose to use the Seven-color talent·Running God to teleport directly, hoping to use this to teleport to another world and grow stronger for a while.]
[You have to admit, you were extremely lucky this time and really teleported to another world. However, the place you teleported to was as always quite a pit, as you were obviously teleported into an extremely dangerous forbidden area.]
[But, you didn’t panic at all. With your current strength, breaking through this forbidden area would just take some more time.]
[It was during your exploration of the forbidden area in the Exoteric World that the cultivators who left the Immortal Tower Secret Realm spread the news of your feats. For a time, your fame skyrocketed, shocking the entire Upper Realm. Eventually, your identity as the Number One Person of All Ages began to spread, fascinating countless cultivators.]
[However, these emperors and cultivators were quite puzzled, not knowing why you hadn’t appeared. Therefore, the Immortal Mansion began to deduce the Heavenly Secrets with the Divine Calculation Man, and Pavilion Master Cold Moon also let the Heavenly Calculation’s Child deduce.]
[The results of their deductions, however, made both the Immortal Mansion and Pavilion Master Cold Moon frown, as the Heavenly Secrets showed that you were not present in this world.]
[You didn’t know about the follow-up developments in your original Upper Realm. Now you’ve finally broken out of the dangerous area of the forbidden land, rushing towards the outside of the land. You didn’t know whether you were still in the Upper Realm or not. After all, a forbidden area doesn’t prove anything, as there could still be undiscovered, dangerous forbidden areas.]
[Just as you were about to leave the forbidden area, you encountered a woman, receiving an answer in advance. This woman’s cultivation was extremely strong, having reached the Great Perfection Tier of the Emperor stage, and she didn’t seem weaker to you than Heavenly Feather Great Emperor. However, you had never seen such a woman in your previous simulations.]
[In other words, you were teleported to another world by the Seven-color talent·Running God. This made your eyes shine with excitement, as in your original world, you would have definitely been killed by Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, a predecessor ransmigrator, escaping would be useless, and there wouldn’t be any time to grow.]
[Now, you have come to another world, where you can completely grow for a while, as long as you have enough time, you can become an Emperor, and even quickly improve your cultivation. In that case, you can completely dominate this world and have the hope of becoming an immortal.]
[As various thoughts flashed through your mind, the Empress in front of you gazed at you, both surprised and solemn. After all, you gave her a very peculiar feeling. Your cultivation is merely at the Quasi-Emperor level, but it gives her a strong sense of danger.]
[This is undoubtedly an incredible thing. A Quasi-Emperor, who can contend with an aging Ordinary Emperor, is already quite amazing, let alone threatening her, a Top Emperor, which is completely a pipe dream.]
[As a result, the Empress became interested in you. After thinking it over, she decided to test your strength by taking a shot at you.]
[Seeing the Empress suddenly attack you, you frowned. However, you didn’t sense any killing intent and guessed that she was probably just curious about you, and that’s why she took a shot at you, wanting to test your strength.]
[But, you just arrived in this world and didn’t understand the situation here. Therefore, you had no intention of using your true abilities, deliberately concealing many trump cards. Right now, you only wanted to grow and quickly become an Emperor.]
[As a result, you only displayed the strength of an early-stage Emperor. This made the Empress think that her previous sense of danger must have been an illusion. However, your performance still amazed her.]
[After all, there are very few people who can achieve what you have done.]
[Therefore, the Empress stopped attacking you and apologized, explaining that she only wanted to practice with you out of pure curiosity. You smiled faintly, indicating that it didn’t matter, since you also had the idea of sparring.]
[Seeing your open-mindedness, the Empress took a liking to you and invited you to her palace as a guest.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 1029 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1029: Chapter 271: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassination of Emperor Monarch! Chapter 1029: Chapter 271: Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassination of Emperor Monarch! “This is truly an unexpected development, being directly transported to another world. Next, it’s time to become an Emperor.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and thought to himself.
“However, the simulated Wang Ping probably won’t look for a Tao Companion.”
While Wang Ping was silently thinking, the Text Simulation continued.
[You are quite surprised by the Empress’s invitation. After some deliberation, you accept her invitation. After all, you are now very powerful and not afraid of being taken advantage of by other cultivators. At this point, as long as you don’t face a quasi-Fairy, even if you confront an Emperor Monarch, you have the confidence to escape.]
[Therefore, accepting the invitation and turning to her ancient books as a source of information about this world seems like a good choice.]
[Seeing you accept her invitation, the Empress is quite pleased and tells you her real name and title – Empress Qingyuan. In response, you also reveal your own title of Emperor Heaven Derivative and your name, Bai Tianhong.]
[Hearing your words, Empress Qingyuan is quite surprised, finding it astonishing that you, yet to become an Emperor, dare to call yourself one and with such an overbearing title. Of course, she then considers your exceptional power and believes that, although you are a Quasi-Emperor, you do have qualifications to call yourself a Great Emperor.]
[Next, Empress Qingyuan doesn’t say much and gives up on exploring the forbidden area. Instead, she takes you to the Qingyuan Imperial Palace she created, which is exclusively inhabited by female cultivators, much to your surprise.]
[After arranging a residence for you, Empress Qingyuan, filled with curiosity, discusses Tao with you. Soon, she becomes more and more amazed by your understanding of Tao and finds your combat capabilities far more profound than what they appear on the surface.]
[Not long after, your discussion of Tao concludes, your relationship becomes considerably closer, and through the discussion process, you learn that Empress Qingyuan is a Great Emperor worthy of being your fellow taoist. As a result, you become more trusting of her.]
[As such, you propose staying at Qingyuan Imperial Palace for a while, expressing interest in perusing the ancient books of the palace.]
[Empress Qingyuan is very enthusiastic and generous, allowing you to freely access Qingyuan Imperial Palace’s ancient books, even offering you her Emperor Scripture to cultivate and create your own techniques.]
[You secretly note down this favor and begin to examine the ancient books of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace to understand the situation of this world.]
[Soon, you become aware of this world’s circumstances. The power structure of this world differs from the Upper Realm and the previously transported world; its scale lies between the two.]
[This world is home to thirty Great Emperors and even an Emperor-Tier Character living among them. However, this world has no legends or stories about fairies, seemingly having experienced a historical disruption.]
[Although you find this world to be relatively safe, allowing you to develop, you are concerned about the possibility of becoming a fairy in this world. If becoming a fairy is not possible here, that would be truly troublesome.]
[Of course, worrying about the issue of becoming a fairy now is pointless because the only common point between the two previous worlds and this one is the presence of the Source of Darkness.]
[In response to this, you can only sigh, thinking the Source of Darkness has truly corrupted many worlds. You even suspect that the Immortal Domain must have been invaded by the Source of Darkness, with the situation there being far more severe than in the Lower Realm.]
[So, it is meaningless to worry about becoming a fairy in this world, as the Source of Darkness will eventually erupt in 200,000 years. Even if you become a fairy by then, you might not be able to survive. After all, you remember clearly those thousands of Great Emperor-tier Dark Beings from the world you were previously transported to.]
[Those Dark Beings are not Great Emperors who have fallen into the Source of Darkness, but merely creatures created by the Source of Darkness. You even doubt whether those Dark Beings were created intentionally by the Source of Darkness. If they were not created intentionally, that would be a truly frightening prospect.]
[Many thoughts flash through your mind, and you note down the secrets of this world. Having internalized your worries about the future, you leave the Scripture Repository, find Empress Qingyuan, and inform her of your desire to depart.]
[Empress Qingyuan is quite surprised and asks why you won’t stay for a while longer.]
[You respond with a faint smile, explaining that you wish to prove and become an Emperor, so you need to find a secluded place to retreat.]
[These words leave Empress Qingyuan rather surprised because becoming an Emperor is no small matter. Considering your demonstrated combat prowess, it’s hard to imagine the level your power would reach after becoming an Emperor. By then, she might not be able to defeat you easily, either.]
[As Empress Qingyuan ponders various thoughts, she congratulates you on your upcoming ascension and insists there’s no need for you to look elsewhere, as she can arrange a secret retreat location.]
[Initially, you refuse, not wanting to impose on Empress Qingyuan. However, after her insistence, you eventually accept and head to the retreat location prepared by Empress Qingyuan.]
[Before long, you enter a state of seclusion, using the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures to devour the body and origin of the Destructing Tao Emperor in hopes of becoming an Emperor quickly.]
[In the blink of an eye, several decades pass. It is during your secluded cultivation to reach the Emperor Realm that an unexpected incident occurs.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 1030 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1030: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _2 Chapter 1030: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _2 [Qingyuan Imperial Palace has been attacked. The attackers, shockingly, are a Top Emperor and a Quasi-Emperor late-stage powerhouse. The arrival of these two emperors rocked the world, causing unprecedented fear among the ancestors of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace.]
[The expression on Empress Qingyuan’s face had darkened. The path to becoming an emperor is fraught with numerous battles, consequently, she had made quite a few enemies. Towards her enemies, she had always been ruthless, eliminating them completely to avoid future troubles. However, sometimes, it’s impossible to wipe out all enemies and some manage to escape.]
[Surprisingly, one of those enemies, who merely had a late-stage emperor cultivation ten thousand years ago, had now surprisingly broken through to the Great Emperor Completion Tier, with strength no weaker than hers. Now, this enemy had arrived with a late-stage emperor powerhouse to completely annihilate her and destroy her Qingyuan Imperial Palace.]
[Empress Qingyuan, therefore, was rather anxious. Although she was powerful, she couldn’t possibly win against two. While she had her fellow Daoist, Wang Ping, in the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, he was currently attempting to break into the Emperor Realm, and she couldn’t disturb him at this time.]
[For this reason, Empress Qingyuan chose to fight alone, trying to buy as much time as possible.]
[The battle of the emperors erupted, the combat of the three great emperors shook this world and garnered the attention of many powerful cultivators. It was apparent, however, that Empress Qingyuan, facing two enemies alone, was at a disadvantage, her defeat seeming inevitable.]
[However, in such a fierce battle, it’s not easy to kill an emperor. Empress Qingyuan could persist for a long time and might even make a desperate counterattack forcing them to pay a high price.]
[Seeing this, the two emperors sneered, as more cultivators appeared to attack Qingyuan Imperial Palace, intending to kill everyone within and disrupt Empress Qingyuan’s focus.]
[In the blink of an eye, a month had passed. Empress Qingyuan had suffered significant injuries and was showing signs of weakness. The Qingyuan Imperial Palace was also on the brink of falling.]
[Just when the Upper Realm cultivators, all thought that Empress Qingyuan was finished and the Qingyuan Imperial Palace would be destroyed, a surge of Power of Space-Time suddenly appeared, killing all those attacking the Qingyuan Imperial Palace below the Quasi-Emperor tier.]
[Then, a figure stepped through the Starry Sky and appeared in the battlefield. It was none other than Wang Ping.]
[This development surprised all the onlooking cultivators, also causing the two Emperors to furrow their brows, sensing the danger from Wang Ping, but they couldn’t quite understand why this strange Quasi-Emperor would aid Empress Qingyuan.]
[Seeing this, Empress Qingyuan revealed a remorseful expression. Clearly, she felt guilty as she could tell Wang Ping was still at the Quasi-Emperor tier and it seemed her trouble had disrupted his cultivation, influencing him adversely.]
[At this moment, Wang Ping didn’t pay any heed to Empress Qingyuan’s apologies. Afterall, he had emerged from seclusion at this time because he was ready to ascend to become an emperor and then face the Heavenly Tribulation. Otherwise, he would not have come out at this time.]
[You looked indifferently at the two emperors, commanding them to roll over and die. This statement was overly domineering, causing all the cultivators to be taken aback, while the emperors frowned, feeling that Wang Ping was too arrogant to disregard emperors.]
[The two emperors, who were insulted by you, were even more furious. The late-stage emperor powerhouse shouted angrily saying that Wang Ping was too arrogant and today he would be defeated.]
[However, as soon as he made his move, Wang Ping coldly snorted and punched out. His Talent Unleashing along with his Minor Chaos Body and 90% Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit were no longer concealed. He unleashed his Terrifying Skill and directly smashed the emperor with one punch.]
[Seeing this, all the cultivators were taken aback, showing expressions of disbelief. They couldn’t believe what they had witnessed, a Quasi-Emperor casually wielding a fist to kill a Great Emperor. And this was not an ordinary aging Emperor. It was a late-stage powerhouse with a Special Constitution. This level of combat power was simply abnormal and defied logic.]
[As a result, even Empress Qingyuan, a top-tier Great Emperor, and the only Emperor Lord Tier character in this world were shocked and horrified. Wang Ping’s performance exceeded their understanding.]
[At this moment, Wang Ping didn’t care what others thought, instead he stared coldly at the top-tier Great Emperor who had been fighting with Empress Qingyuan, he commanded him to come over and die.]
[The top-tier emperor felt a chill surge in his heart, which discouraged him, and he immediately abandoned Empress Qingyuan, intending to escape. A top Great Emperor was actually scared off by Wang Ping, a Quasi-Emperor.]
[Seeing this, the watching emperors fell silent again. However, they didn’t feel that the top-tier Emperor’s actions were disgraceful. After all, Wang Ping’s performance was indeed excessively abnormal, even a Top Emperor couldn’t achieve what he did. If he didn’t run, he would surely die.]
[At this, Wang Ping showed a sarcastic expression. The Time-Space Divine Skill was released, blocking the Emperor’s escape. The Chaos Emperor Fist was once again launched, intending to thoroughly obliterate him.]
[Seeing this, Empress Qingyuan also regained her senses and joined Wang Ping to attack this top-tier Emperor, intending to completely kill him.]
[Facing the joint attack of Wang Ping and Empress Qingyuan, this top-tier Great Emperor roared in anger, unable to escape. As a result, he too was thoroughly enraged and decided to take Empress Qingyuan down with him.]
[At this moment, another terrifying aura appeared, astounding all the emperors. This is because it was the aura of the only Emperor Monarch in this world, the Honglian Emperor.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 1031 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1031: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _3 Chapter 1031: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _3 [The Emperor Monarch’s appearance is not to help you and Empress Qingyuan slay this Top Emperor, but to deliberately make a move against you, intending to suppress and kill you. Clearly, this Emperor Monarch has set his sights on your Chaotic Body, thinking that suppressing and refining you will bring him great benefits.]
[Seeing this, you snort coldly, disdainful of Honglian Emperor Monarch’s behavior. Then, you exchange a blow with him.]
[It has to be said that Emperor-Tier Characters are indeed powerful. Even you are no match for him now; a simple exchange of blows leaves your body exploding apart and almost suffering heavy injuries. After you recover your body, you mock Honglian Emperor Monarch’s sneak attack and ridicule him for being an undeserving Emperor Monarch.]
[In response, Honglian Emperor Monarch remains unmoved, with an indifferent expression, stating that any means can be used on the path to becoming a Taoist. Your appearance may help him take that step and perhaps help him enter a higher realm. Therefore, he will suppress and kill you using any means necessary, and then refine your origin.]
[Hearing this, you develop an intense murderous intent towards Honglian Emperor Monarch and add him to the must-kill list. Other Great Emperors sigh, not expecting Honglian Emperor Monarch to do such a thing. At the same time, they think you are too flamboyant and that this outcome is quite normal. After all, tall trees catch much wind. If you could hide until after becoming an Emperor, they believe the Emperor Monarch would definitely suppress you.]
[At that time, the world will be up for grabs, and there will be no such life-threatening danger.]
[Empress Qingyuan’s face changes dramatically, thinking she has brought disaster upon you and feeling increasingly guilty. She secretly sends you a message, saying she will try to block Honglian Emperor Monarch while you seize the opportunity to escape.]
[As for the Top Emperor who was heavily injured by you and Empress Qingyuan, he sneers, thinking you deserve it.]
[Just when various parties have all sorts of thoughts, you assure Empress Qingyuan not to worry first, then you ignore Honglian Emperor Monarch, saying that today’s success in becoming an Emperor will be celebrated with the blood of Emperor Monarch.]
[Upon saying this, you break through the long-suppressed bottleneck, condensing the Great Emperor Tao Fruit and achieving Emperorhood.]
[In an instant, an astonishing Emperor phenomenon appears in the world. At the same time, the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation also quickly brews. This scene shocks everyone and makes them doubt their lives, never expecting you to become an Emperor so easily. They say it’s outrageous to become an Emperor without giving anyone time to react.]
[When they became Emperors, they all retreated to extremely secretive places and were very cautious in their breakthroughs. Who would engage in a battle when they were about to become an Emperor? That would only lead to failure in their breakthroughs. Moreover, becoming an Emperor on command has never happened before. They have truly witnessed history.]
[Honglian Emperor Monarch’s face changes constantly, wanting to make a move on you before crossing the tribulation, but the tribulation of a freak Quasi-Emperor like you will surely reach the extreme of terror. If he takes action and gets involved, perhaps he will face the risk of falling.]
[Therefore, he can only watch you unwillingly, choosing to withdraw and not wanting to be caught within the range of the Heavenly Tribulation.]
…….
“Finally becoming an Emperor, it’s been a long journey.”
Wang Ping, looking at the content of the Text Simulation, also feels quite emotional.
From entering Chi Village until now, it’s really not been easy. Although it’s only been about ten years in the real world, the time spent in the life simulation has been far too long, and he’s died too many times.
“I wonder if I’ll be able to defeat Honglian Emperor Monarch after becoming an Emperor. In theory, becoming an Emperor is a transformation that should bring a significant increase in combat power, allowing the simulated Wang Ping to surpass an Emperor Monarch as a normal event.”
Afterwards, Wang Ping starts guessing his own combat power after becoming an Emperor, filled with anticipation.
While Wang Ping is looking forward to it, the Text Simulation continues.
[Next, your Ascension Tribulation begins. The range of your Ascension Tribulation is extremely wide, and it is the epitome of terror. Even you are seriously injured several times. But still, you laugh loudly, resisting the Heavenly Tribulation without any intention of dodging or delaying the duration of the tribulation until it ends.]
[In the end, under the shocked gaze of the many Emperors, you successfully cross the Heavenly Tribulation and become a Great Emperor. In this world, your Great Emperor Tao Fruit begins to manifest, announcing to this realm that a new Great Emperor is born.]
[It is at this moment of pride that Honglian Emperor Monarch’s eyes reveal a cold glint, and he attacks you again. He knows that since he has already made a move against you earlier, it is now a situation of either life or death. Before you became an Emperor, you already had the power to fight against Top-level Emperors, and now you may have the power to threaten him.]
[Therefore, he must kill you before you progress further while you are still injured and not at your peak. It is the best opportunity to kill you.]
[Just as Honglian Emperor Monarch makes a move, you snort coldly, declaring that if Honglian Emperor Monarch seeks death, then let him die. As you say this, you also unleash terrifying power, facing Honglian Emperor Monarch head-on.]
[Your confrontation with Honglian Emperor Monarch ends in a stalemate. Clearly, even without using your talents, you now have the horrifying power to rival an Emperor Monarch.]
[This makes Honglian Emperor Monarch’s expression extremely gloomy, and he uses even more powerful combat strength, holding nothing back.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 1032 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1032: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _4 Chapter 1032: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _4 [At this, you sneer coldly, no longer holding back either. You activate Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven-Color Talent: Explosion Blade, along with the previously suppressed effects of Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[As your full combat power is unleashed, the complexion of the Honglian Emperor, who had assumed he’d have the upper hand after reaching his full strength, changes greatly. He never expected you to have such a powerful hidden card. In a short time, the Honglian Emperor is injured by you, falling into an absolute disadvantage. Defeat is only a matter of time.]
[Seeing this, the emperors present are silent, none of them expecting things to turn out this way. Despite just ascending to the throne, you brutally beat the Honglian Emperor and seem capable of killing him.]
[The top-tier Great Emperor who was battling Empress Qingyuan is even more fearful of you and chooses to flee.]
[Empress Qingyuan angrily shouts, wanting to give chase but is met by a pair of Chaos Emperor Fists that directly bombard and kill her. This scene leaves the emperors in awe. You are too powerful. While you are engaged in a fierce battle with the Honglian Emperor, you can still spare some attention to casually kill a top-tier Great Emperor. This level of combat prowess and dominance is unmatched.]
[The expression of the Honglian Emperor becomes unsightly to the extreme. It’s not just that he feels smothered by his absolute disadvantage, but he also feels humiliated because you casually kill other Great Emperors while fighting him. After his debut, everything went smoothly for him; he suppressed all enemies and became an invincible Emperor. He cannot bear such humiliation.]
[Because of this, the Honglian Emperor becomes desperate, choosing to directly burn his origin and perform a terrifying Secret Skill. He wants to turn the tide and counterattack you.]
[To this, you mock and reply that burning his origin won’t save him, and no one can save him today.]
[As soon as the words fall, you trigger the effect of a tenfold critical strike, directly causing the Honglian Emperor’s body to explode. Although he quickly recovers his body, he is undoubtedly much weaker and frightened, not anticipating that you still have secrets hidden.]
[As a result, he gives up the idea of fighting to the death with you, believing that he will definitely die, and your chances of falling are very low. Therefore, he intends to flee to the edge of the universe and lie low until he breaks through the limit, takes that step, becomes an existence transcending the Great Emperor Realm, and then seeks revenge on you.]
[At this point, the Honglian Emperor begins to flee, causing the other emperors to sigh, not expecting that a once-great emperor would have such a humiliating day. However, this is what he sought, after all, since he was the one who provoked you, a freak.]
[Seeing that the Honglian Emperor wants to flee, you sneer with a mocking smile, calling him a worthless Emperor Monarch. Then, you begin your pursuit. During the chase, you use Divine skill Neutralization directly. And again, you inflict heavy damage on him.]
[This time, you finally trigger the combination effect of Golden Talent: Rock Bottom Rebound and Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack. As a result, the Honglian Emperor dies on the spot, falling immediately.]
[Seeing this scene, all the emperors are silenced, not expecting a generation’s emperor to not even be able to escape and be killed by you on the spot, becoming a laughingstock.]
[Following this, a Great Emperor sighs, stating that the era of the Honglian Emperor has ended. It’s now the era of you, the new rising Emperor. The emperors present fall silent, unable to deny this fact.]
[Facing the Honglian Emperor, they could join forces and have the resources to contend, but if they have to face you, the freak, there is no chance of success. Moreover, given your growth rate, you’ll soon become an existence they can’t even resist if they join forces. They would be killed in seconds.]
[Because of this, in their opinion, it’s your ruling era from now on, even possibly a dictatorial era.]
[You don’t concern yourself with their thoughts and continue on your path. After killing the Honglian Emperor, you apply multiple seals and prohibitions to his body before storing it in your inner world, once again setting up a Great Array to avoid any accidents.]
[Following this, you step beside Empress Qingyuan, present her with a Healing Treasure Medicine, and inform her that you’ve just broken through and need to continue your seclusion. It’s up to her to handle the subsequent matters.]
[Feeling apologetic and even more affectionate towards you, Empress Qingyuan assures that she’ll handle those matters and that she’ll remember your great kindness.]
[You shake your head without saying much, leaving the area for more seclusion.]
[Before long, your name resounds throughout this world, known as Heaven Derivative Emperor, and even as the Primordial First Emperor. You are the only cultivator with such terrifying titles just after ascending the throne.]
[However, you still don’t pay much attention to it and continue your cultivation. Once your cultivation and injuries are stable, you begin to consider your next steps, debating whether to let the Three Devouring Emperor Treasures devour the Immortal Source, becoming Immortal Artifacts, and helping you quickly improve your cultivation.]
[Although the ancient records do not document the existence of Immortals in this world, nor even knowledge of the Immortal realm, you’re still not too careless. After all, it’s unknown what kind of monster lurks in the Source of Darkness. It’s possible that, like the original Upper Realm, quasi-Fairy beings exist. In that case, you’d have a lot of trouble.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 1033 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1033: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _5 Chapter 1033: Chapter 271 Wang Ping Becomes Emperor! Assassinating the Emperor Monarch! _5 [After all, the difference in strength between an Emperor Lord tier and a quasi-Fairy is too vast. Even if your cultivation reaches the Great Emperor Realm Completion, whether you can fight against a quasi-Fairy is questionable. Of course, all of this is just your speculation. Until the battle actually takes place, it’s hard to tell who is stronger.]
[After some thought, you decide to play it safe, preferring to postpone the creation of Immortal Artifacts and slow down your cultivation progress rather than putting yourself in danger. If there really is a dormant quasi-Fairy, the existence of the Immortal Artifacts would definitely awaken them.]
[Thus, you make a choice to follow the old path, aiming to preach in this realm and rapidly advance your cultivation. This time, you plan to learn from Hongjun.]
[Before long, using your Great Magical Power, you create the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative. Then, your voice echoes throughout the world, stating that you are going to lecture on the Tao to all people with the desire to become a Taoist, be they Emperors or ordinary cultivators, and they are all welcome to come to the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative.]
[Upon hearing this, the world is shocked, and countless cultivators become extremely excited. They flock to the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative, eager to listen to your lecture as the Primordial First Emperor. Even the Emperors are no exception. Although they are already Emperors, they still fall short when compared to you. If they could listen to your lecture, they might gain a lot from it.]
