[However, when they arrive at the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative, they find that it is not accessible to just anyone. There are trials that test their talent, luck, and willpower. Sometimes, even Great Saints cannot pass, but little cultivators at the Divine Realm level succeed.]
[As the number of people in the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative increases, you are filled with mixed emotions. In the past, you used to be the one being tested and trialed by various old seniors. Now, you have reached this position and are even more successful than most old seniors. At this moment, you are testing the multitude of cultivators of this realm, and even the Emperors fall within your range of examination. Although generally, Emperors can pass.]
[Five years later, when the number of people in the Emperor Realm Heaven Derivative is large enough, you are content and begin your lecture. You state that those who listen to your lecture must become your disciples, and if they are unwilling, they can leave.]
[Upon hearing your words, the cultivators below the rank of Emperor naturally cannot leave, but some of the Supremes and Quasi-Emperors belonging to certain powers find it a bit awkward, and they look to their respective Emperors for guidance. These Emperors fall silent.]
[Being Emperors themselves, they are extremely proud and would not easily become an apprentice to others. Even though you are very strong, you are ultimately of the same rank as them. For them to bow down to you as a newly ascended Emperor would be a blow to their pride.]
[As for Empress Qingyuan, she is torn, unsure whether she should become your apprentice. After all, you are fellow taoists, and now the relationship might change to that of master and apprentice.]
[Seeing the Emperors silent, you smile and say that you know of realms above that of the Emperors. If they are interested, you can also explain a bit about it.]
[Upon hearing this, all the Emperors are astonished, not expecting you to know about realms beyond their own. Momentarily, all of them have to make a choice. Pride? What’s that worth compared to the realms above the Emperor level?]
[Seeing that all of them have accepted this, you nod in satisfaction. Then, you begin your lecture. Soon, everyone is captivated by your words, listening intently.]
[As your lecture progresses, some people even make a breakthrough on the spot, feeling ecstatic. However, they quickly suppress their emotions and continue listening to your lecture, not wanting to miss any valuable insight.]
[In this situation, your cultivation level quietly and rapidly increases. As your lecture becomes more profound, your cultivation progresses directly from the initial stage of the Emperor realm to the middle stage, and finally to the late stage.]
[At last, you introduce the realm of immortality, telling all the cultivators that above the Emperor realm is the immortal realm, where one’s lifespan is boundless and death by old age does not exist. Hearing this, all the cultivators reveal fervent expressions, and the Emperors become excited as well, eager to achieve immortality.]
[Following that, the Emperors lead the way, bowing deeply to you. Imparting the Tao, solving their doubts, and receiving your teachings is the greatest kindness, and they genuinely appreciate you, recognizing you as their master.]
[It is at this moment that your cultivation level advances once more, directly soaring to the Great Emperor Completion Tier, reaching the pinnacle of the Emperor realm. It’s safe to say that the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples is quite powerful. Your current preaching method is also the proper way to utilize the Seven-Colored Talent – Recruiting Disciples.]
……..
“Killing the Emperor Monarch, learning from Hongjun’s lecture, and advancing my cultivation straight to the Great Emperor Completion Tier, this feels insanely exhilarating.”
Wang Ping gazes at the content of the Text Simulation, feeling a surge of emotions.
After leaving the simulation of the Upper Realm, Wang Ping, no longer plagued by the schemes and death threats of the old monsters, feels a sense of boundlessness and unbridled ambition. He also experiences an incomparable growth rate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 1034 272 Kill The Quasi-Fairy Rich Rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1034: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards! Chapter 1034: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards! “I hope I can directly become a quasi-Fairy next. But the possibility is not great.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, contemplating in his heart.
Becoming a quasi-Fairy is not easy. Wang Ping has yet to comprehend the Great Perfection of Perfection Chaos True Meaning, and he’s still far from the level of a quasi-Fairy.
Moreover, Wang Ping doesn’t even know what conditions are needed to break through to the level of a quasi-Fairy, or whether a greater understanding of the Dao is required.
While Wang Ping was thinking, the text simulation continued.
[After the lecture on the Tao ended, you became an Emperor, implying an Emperor among Emperors, the noblest of all Emperors. At this moment, your prestige has reached a peak.]
[However, you are not proud or arrogant. After the lecture, you continued to cultivate in seclusion, honing your cultivation, continuing to seek enlightenment, hoping to develop your Minor Chaos Body into the Great Completion Domain, or comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred thousand years went by. In these hundred thousand years, you have been tirelessly cultivating, but you still can’t comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit. Alas, you’ve had it too easy in the past. Understanding the spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path quickly, thanks to the Immortal Tower’s trials, was a boon.]
[Now, you are in this world, relying only on your own understanding and devoid of life-and-death battles, your cultivation progress has returned to normal. It naturally becomes slower. Moreover, the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit is a qualitative change, naturally, it is not so easy to comprehend, let alone the spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path. So while you have some insight, you are still a distance away from comprehending the Great Perfection of the Perfection Chaos True Meaning.]
[As for the Great Chaos Body, there’s also no progress. After all, Pavilion Master Cold Moon, a predecessor ransmigrator, refined the Ten Great Universes to bring his Chaotic Body to a complete state. You merely hope to achieve the Great Completion Domain through enlightenment, which is evidently unrealistic.]
[Nonetheless, you remain calm and continue to cultivate. Although during this time, Empress Qingyuan has been surreptitiously courting you, hoping to become your Tao Companion, you have consistently rejected her, having no intention of becoming her Tao Companion. You are solely focused on becoming a Taoist and growing stronger.]
[Faced with this, Empress Qingyuan is utterly helpless, but there’s nothing she can do but give up. Inspired by your dogged persistence in cultivation, she also submerged herself in cultivation.]
[In a blink of an eye, another hundred thousand years passed, and you still could not comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Chaos True Spirit. This got you somewhat anxious. After all, the time until the Source of Darkness erupts is dwindling.]
[Upon reflection, you ultimately decided to give up on your enlightenment and focus on making the three Innate Emperor Tools become Immortal Artifacts instead.]
[Eventually, the three Innate Emperor Tools successfully devoured the Immortal Source and became Immortal Artifacts. The Immortal Artifact Tribulation manifested in this World, and the great Emperors of this world felt the aura of an Immortal for the first time. They were astounded, and their zeal was overwhelming.]
[In the end, the Devouring Immortal Bead Successfully crossed the Tribulation, becoming a legitimate Immortal Artifact, under your control. Seeing this, the other Emperors could only give up their aspirations, acknowledging that you truly deserved the title of ‘the greatest among Emperors,’ as you had even procured an Immortal Artifact.]
[Just as the Emperors were marveling at your power, the Source of Darkness went berserk. Seeing this, your face paled and your gaze grew intense. According to your memory, there should still be some time before the eruption of the Source of Darkness. The sudden outbreak could only mean that the Immortal Ascension Tribulation had affected the Source of Darkness in this world.]
[But soon, you gave up on that notion. You found that this eruption was far less severe than the one you remembered. Though a swarm of Dark Beings, even Great Emperor tier Dark Beings, emerged, they were nowhere near the thousands that had appeared the last time.]
[So you eliminated them all with a casual strike. However, you had no intention of letting the Devouring Immortal Bead absorb them. After all, these are Dark Beings coalesced from the Dark energy of the Source of Darkness. Even if they were not purposely assembled by the enemy, their Dark aura wouldn’t be easy to refine, and you feared the Devouring Immortal Bead would be contaminated. As for the Dark Emperor, though fallen, his source and Tao Fruit had not been thoroughly contaminated, making them still usable and partially refinable.]
[Just as all the beings were praising your power, having restrained the terrifying Dark Disaster in a flash, an aberration occurred again. An overwhelming aura descended. It was the aura of a Fairy, but not a true Fairy, rather a quasi-Fairy.]
[A quasi-Fairy emerged from the Source of Darkness.]
[Sensing the terrifying pressure and power fluctuations of this quasi-Fairy, the Emperors looked horrified. They had learned about the quasi-Fairy realm from your teachings. Originally, they believed their world had no quasi-Fairies. Who would have thought that such a being exists and had emerged from the Source of Darkness?]
[This was undeniably a bad sign. It meant the only reason they were still alive was that the other party had not yet decided to take action against them. If the quasi-Fairy were to act, they would all surely perish.]
[Facing this quasi-Fairy, you felt no fear. You stared at him, coldly remarking, did he grow weary of his hibernation in the Source of Darkness and came seeking death?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 1035 272 Kill The Quasi-Fairy Rich Rewards_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1035: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_2 Chapter 1035: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_2 [Facing your mockery, this quasi-Fairy’s expression remains unchanged. He only sighs at how fast time has passed, and the end of an era has arrived. It is time for the World of Cultivators to restart. He says that this era is quite good, as it has produced an astonishing genius, and it can provide him with a nice harvest.]
[At this point, you frown, feeling that there is too much information hidden in the other party’s words, and the content is somewhat terrifying upon further reflection.]
…
“Could it be that the turbulence at the Source of Darkness is not caused by the will of the Source of Darkness itself, but rather controlled by these fallen quasi-Fairies behind the scenes?”
Wang Ping’s expression changes as he looks at the content of the Text Simulation.
If this is the case, then these quasi-Fairies would clear out the strong cultivators in the World of Cultivators during each end of the era.
No, it shouldn’t be called clearing out. Instead, they might be devouring their life essence to make themselves stronger or to practice some secret skill.
After all, after becoming a quasi-Fairy, it is genuinely hard to become stronger in the Lower Realm.
However, if that’s the case, why are the times of the turbulence of the Source of Darkness in different worlds almost the same?
Could it be that the Source of Darkness in the Lower World under the jurisdiction of the Immortal Domain is connected and can be crossed from one world to another, albeit with some difficulty?
If this is the case, then the number of hidden powerhouses in the Source of Darkness would reach hair-raising digits.
“Forget it, thinking about this now is meaningless. I should watch how the simulated Wang Ping deals with this quasi-Fairy instead. Although the current simulated Wang Ping is already very strong, it should still be quite difficult to fight a quasi-Fairy. Perhaps only by comprehending the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit and achieving a perfect Chaos Body could I have a chance to fight and possibly kill this quasi-Fairy.”
Wang Ping regains his composure, shakes his head slightly, and continues to focus on the luminescent screen.
[During your contemplation, the Emperors are also shocked. They never thought that you would be so domineering, still exuding an imposing aura even in the face of a quasi-Fairy. At the same time, they are also horrified by the words of the quasi-Fairy.]
[Subsequently, the quasi-Fairy doesn’t say much more and just sends an attack towards you. The power of the quasi-Fairy is too strong; you look serious, not daring to take it lightly, and unleash your full combat power. Your talent is fully activated, and the Chaos Emperor Fist explodes, trying to obliterate this attack.]
[This time, you are extremely lucky, triggering a tenfold critical strike effect and taking this attack head-on. You manage to block this Dark Psuedo Immortal’s attack.]
[Seeing this, the Dark Psuedo Immortal is quite surprised and becomes even more interested in you. It is a shock that a mere Emperor would be able to block his attack. Although it was just a casual strike, it is enough to show how powerful Wang Ping is.]
[Afterward, the Dark Psuedo Immortal’s expression becomes a bit more serious, and he launches another attack, unleashing an even more powerful combat power. Faced with this, you look grave, and you bring out the Devouring Immortal Bead to confront him using the power of this Immortal Artifact.]
[Although during the previous simulation, the performance of the Devouring Immortal Bead was somewhat unsatisfactory—it couldn’t even get close to you—it was a situation where you were facing more than a dozen quasi-Fairies and it was unmanned. Now your cultivation has reached the Perfect Emperor Stage, and you can utilize the power of the Devouring Immortal Bead to a great extent, pushing your combat power to a soaring and unimaginable level.]
[As a result, while you use the Devouring Immortal Bead in battle, you devour the essence of the Dark Psuedo Immortal, affecting his combat power and turning it into your own strength; devouring his attack and reducing the power of his Divine Skills.]
[Under this situation, you surprisingly don’t go into any disadvantage. This makes the Dark Psuedo Immortal even more covetous of the Devouring Immortal Bead. The Devouring Immortal Bead, this Immortal Artifact, is far stronger than ordinary Immortal Artifacts he knows, and its devouring skill is particularly suitable for Dark Psuedo Immortals like him.]
[Eventually, after the Dark Psuedo Immortal praises you and the Devouring Immortal Bead for a while, he no longer holds back, becoming completely serious and unleashing his full combat power. The power of a quasi-Fairy is fully displayed, striking awe into all the Emperors.]
[As for you, your expression becomes extremely grave, and you once again fall into an absolute disadvantage. At this point, you sigh in your heart, as you are still somewhat lacking. With the help of an Immortal Artifact, if you could comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit, you wouldn’t need the Chaos Body Great Completion to fight and even kill this Dark Psuedo Immortal.]
[Unfortunately, comprehending the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit is too difficult. While you believe that given enough time, you could understand it, time, unfortunately, waits for no one. Right now, you can only find a way to overcome the current predicament first.]
[Fortunately, you still have some tricks up your sleeve. Over the years, you have been on guard against the existence of Dark Psuedo Immortals and have done a lot of things to prepare for this day.]
[Next, you activate a hidden card directly. You transform yourself into the Eye of the Array, with countless stars shining in the cosmic starry sky, and a large amount of Chaos Spirit manifests, forming a Great Array in the Cosmic Starry Sky.]
[As you create the Chaos Star River Array, your combat power begins to rise rapidly, making the Dark Psuedo Immortal’s expression change slightly, as he didn’t expect you to have such a trick.]

﻿Chapter 1036: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_3 Chapter 1036: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_3 [However, he remains calm and continues to fight you fiercely, sneering that the Great Array cannot last forever, and he does not believe you can persist for long. In terms of stamina, as a quasi-Fairy, he is much stronger than you, an Emperor.]
[As for the mockery of the Dark Psuedo Immortal, you are not affected. With the enhancement of the Great Array, your combat power is undoubtedly soaring rapidly. You begin to turn the tide, and even suppress the Dark Psuedo Immortal, wounding him. After gaining the advantage, you launch a frantic attack, trying to kill him.]
[However, you even more hope to trigger the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack’s effect, directly causing the quasi-immortal in front of you to die instantly.]
[But as the battle continues, the effect of the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack has not been triggered, which makes you frown and have a bad premonition in your heart. That is, the tier of the Seven-Color Talent is ultimately only the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification, capped by Emperor Monarchs. It seems incapable of taking effect on quasi-Fairies who are out of this level.]
[Thinking about it this way, you suddenly feel that this special capacity category of the Seven-Color Talent is not as useful as the Seven-Color Talent – Burst Blade that can enhance your combat power. Of course, you are also well aware that if you reach the quasi-Fairy Tier or become a Fairy, the effects of this Seven-Color Talent might not work. By then, you can only hope for the Life Simulator to refresh and generate more powerful talents after optimization.]
[Of course, this is not a question for the simulated Wang Ping to think about, but a question for Wang Ping himself.]
[At this moment, as the battle drags on, the Great Array you set up begins to fluctuate, and the quasi-Fairy remains extremely powerful. Although his consumption is also huge, his recovery ability is fast, so he’s not weakened too much. This makes the Dark Psuedo Immortal sneer, believing that he will soon regain the advantage and completely kill you.]
[It is at this time that you put aside your distractions and use a trump card. You proclaim to the world, asking all the Emperors and Quasi-Emperors of this realm to join the battle and assist you in killing the enemy.]
[Upon hearing your words, most Emperors and Quasi-Emperors, led by Empress Qingyuan, step into the array without hesitation to provide you with their strength. A small number of Emperors and Quasi-Emperors are somewhat conflicted, but remembering your favor of preaching, they finally sigh and choose to join the array. Only a very small number of Emperors and Quasi-Emperors remain unmoved, choosing to quietly watch the battle, planning something.]
[You don’t mind this. As most of the powerful join the array, your combat power once again increases substantially, intensifying your attacks, and shattering the body of the Dark Psuedo Immortal several times, then devouring a part of his power using Devouring Immortal Bead.]
[This infuriates the Dark Psuedo Immortal, and he harbors hatred towards those Emperors and Quasi-Emperors who joined the battle. However, the Dark Psuedo Immortal never expected why these Emperors and Quasi-Emperors would follow your orders and cooperate so well. This level of cooperation is not merely about self-preservation. After all, Emperors can also fall into the Source of Darkness.]
[However, there is no point for this Dark Psuedo Immortal to think about it now, because if this continues, he will really fall here and be killed by you.]
[Therefore, the Dark Psuedo Immortal refuses to care about his dignity, shouting at you to see how long you will last, and if you do not make a move, the next to die will be you.]
[As this remark comes out, there is movement again within the Source of Darkness. Your pupils contract and your face changes slightly. You know that the worst-case scenario has occurred – this world does not only have one Dark Psuedo Immortal but other Dark Psuedo Immortals as well.]
[Although the number of Dark Psuedo Immortals in this world is definitely not as many as those in your former Upper Realm, two Dark Psuedo Immortals are enough to be fatal. After all, you’ve exerted your full strength to deal with one Dark Psuedo Immortal, and another one will undoubtedly lead to your demise.]
[However, you have no choice now but to resist, asking all Emperors and Quasi-Emperors who entered the array to burn their sources frantically, raising your power to the highest. Then, you launch an attack regardless of the consequences, no longer using the Chaos Emperor Sutra you’ve understood yourself, but for the first time using the Immortal Skill from the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture. You want to kill the First Dark Quasi Immortal before the Second Dark Senior Immortal makes a move.]
[Over the years, although you’ve put most of your energy into cultivating the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit, you’ve also taken the time to practice the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture. After all, that’s what will enhance your combat power after cultivation.]
[As the Immortal King Skill is used, a terrifying Immortal Rhyme emerges, accompanied by a fearsome attack, possessing the power to slaughter Immortals and Buddhas. This also exposes a horrified expression on the face of the First Dark Quasi Immortal, who did not expect you to hide such a trump card.]
[This strike makes the Dark Psuedo Immortal feel the danger of his life. If he can’t withstand it, he will indeed fall here.]
[Therefore, this Dark Psuedo Immortal also turns a blind eye, directly using a self-mutilating Secret Skill to increase his combat power, trying to block your attack.]
[As you increase your offense regardless of the consequences, the Second Dark Psuedo Immortal appears, displaying an indifferent countenance and looking down at you with an air of superiority. Then, he chooses to take action.]
[With this Dark Psuedo Immortal attacking the Great Array from the outside, the Array immediately shows signs of being broken open.]
