﻿Chapter 1037: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_4 Chapter 1037: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_4 [At this moment, your attack has also collided with the First Dark Quasi Immortal, causing a terrifying explosion. Then, the First Dark Quasi Immortal’s body bursts open, and you’ve completely killed him. Thus, under your many arrangements, a Dark Quasi Immortal has finally fallen into your hands.]
[Although it’s not solely due to your own power that such a thing was accomplished, you’ve outsmarted the opponent and, with the support of numerous powerful beings from this world, completed the kill. Killing a Dark Quasi Immortal with the cultivation of a great emperor is enough for pride.]
[At this moment, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal launches another attack, directly breaking open the Great Array.]
[As the Great Array is broken, all cultivators, including you, cough up blood from the backlash. These cultivators, already weakened to the extreme due to burning their origins to provide you with power, are now unable to bear the force of the backlash as the array breaks, causing the majority of them, Quasi-Emperors and Great Emperors alike, to die on the spot. As for those who survived, they are wiped away by the Second Quasi Immortal.]
[As for the Great Emperors who didn’t join the battlefield earlier, their faces also change as they try to escape into the Source of Darkness to save their lives. However, before they can do so, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal makes a move against them, capturing and refining them on the spot.]
[At this point, you are the only one left in the starry sky, confronting the Second Dark Quasi Immortal. With no cards left to play, you are no match for these two Dark Quasi Immortals.]
[Nevertheless, knowing that you’re in a desperate situation, your expression remains unchanged. Seeing this, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal also puts away his aloof expression and begins to admire you greatly. Although you relied on external forces, your previous performance truly astonished him, being able to kill a Dark Quasi Immortal with your Great Emperor cultivation. Thus, you are a worthy opponent for him to respect.]
[However, after the admiration, his expression turns cold again, asking you to hand over the Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Sutras, and then commit suicide to avoid torture.]
[In response, you remain indifferent and unyielding, launching an attack against him with the courage to face death, hoping to break through the limit in this desperate situation and comprehend the Great Perfection.]
[However, you no longer have the support of the Great Array nor the many cultivators helping to provide power to you, and your previous usage of the Immortal King Skill has drained most of your power too. Your current strength is just a fraction of your peak, making you no match for the Second Dark Quasi Immortal.]
[As a result, you are easily suppressed and killed by him. Thanks to the Rebirth Tally, you come back to life, but the Second Dark Quasi Immortal seems to have anticipated your revival to camp you and kill you once again.]
[Due to your death, this simulation comes to an end.]
…..
As the Text Simulation ends, Wang Ping’s mind is filled with many insights and memory images, finally appearing in the starry sky, watching everything.
“I still died, huh. But this time, it wasn’t my fault.”
Wang Ping looks at the Dark Quasi Immortal and sighs quietly in his heart.
This time, the simulated Wang Ping performed well enough, knowing that the Immortal Artifacts could attract the Dark Quasi Immortals and making many preparations in advance.
His preparations were indeed worthwhile, and he successfully killed a Dark Quasi Immortal.
However, the appearance of the Second Dark Quasi Immortal exceeded the scope of the simulated Wang Ping’s abilities; there was really nothing he could do.
Thus, the simulated Wang Ping claimed an honorable defeat.
It is at this moment of mixed emotions that Wang Ping’s consciousness flickers, and he exits the immersive simulation status, returning to the real world.
Then, the system’s voice promptly sounds.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The host may choose two of the following rewards:
①. Perfect Emperor Realm Cultivation.
②. Devouring Immortal Bead.
③. A random emperor-tier artifact.
④. A random quasi-emperor artifact.
⑤. Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.
⑥. Purple Talent·Great Summoning Skill.”
…
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping, looking at the rewards refreshed this time, is utterly astonished.
Refreshing the cultivation is something to be happy about, but the probability of refreshing cultivation is indeed quite high, so it’s a pleasant surprise, but still an acceptable result.
However, the surprise appearance of an Immortal Artifact truly leaves him in awe.
After all, since he obtained the Life Simulator, he’s never refreshed an Immortal Artifact as a reward before.
Initially, he thought Immortal Artifacts couldn’t be refreshed, or even Emperor Artifacts for that matter.
Now, it has given him another surprise.
Thus, the Devouring Immortal Bead is a must-have.
In the previous battle against the Dark Quasi Immortal, if it weren’t for the Devouring Immortal Bead, he wouldn’t have been able to fight the Dark Quasi Immortal to such an extent, and using the Immortal King Skill with the help of the Great Array might not have been enough to kill him.
It can be said that the increase in combat power brought by the Devouring Immortal Bead is quite significant.
As for cultivation…
Honestly, Wang Ping is a bit torn about whether to choose cultivation or not.
This time he can be directly upgraded to the Perfect Emperor Stage Realm, but he might not be so lucky in the next simulation.
After all, being teleported to such a world this time is already extremely lucky, and he might not have this luck in the future.
Although he can rely on the number of times he uses the Life Simulator to gamble, the situation in the real world is terrible, and he might not have enough time for that.
His current situation is still quite delicate, truly afraid that Pavilion Master Cold Moon, the Predecessor Transmigrator, will come knocking at their door.

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 1038 272 Kill The Quasi-Fairy Rich Rewards_5
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1038: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_5 Chapter 1038: Chapter 272: Kill The Quasi-Fairy! Rich Rewards!_5 After all, the plot in life simulation can be used as a reference, but it cannot be entirely trusted.
The real world has All Heavens and Myriad Heavens Paradise, the situation is too complicated, and life simulation has its flaws.
If Wang Ping were cornered, he would be in real trouble.
As a result, quickly increasing his strength is a necessity.
As for the issue of the Immortal King’s Artifact, the Tower of Celestial Spirit, and the increase in fees for paid simulations after increasing his cultivation, it is something he has no choice but to accept.
Although the Tower of Celestial Spirit is tempting, Wang Ping doesn’t think he can train his willpower to pass the Immortal King Trial in a short time. Only by optimizing the Life Simulator might he be able to refresh similar talents.
Other than that, Wang Ping really doesn’t dare to truly accept this Immortal King’s Artifact.
After all, he has too many secrets. Unless it’s a weapon he can control, or one he has truly tamed or trained, leaving other powerful people’s life-bound weapons close to him is too dangerous. His secrets might be spied on.
By then, he would be planting a bomb close to him, and if the spirit in the Immortal King’s Artifact has ideas about him, he might really run into trouble.
For this reason, no matter from which perspective, Wang Ping must temporarily give up on the Tower of Celestial Spirit and prioritize enhancing his own cultivation and combat power.
As for the charging issue, who cares, just find a way to get some more Extreme-tier Divine Sources.
Isn’t that big idiot Destructing Tao Emperor just waiting to be harvested by him?
“System, I choose ① Perfect Emperor Realm Cultivation and ② Devouring Immortal Bead.”
With his thoughts clear, Wang Ping made his choice directly in his heart.
“Ding, reward selection successful, issuing now….”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, Wang Ping felt his cultivation rapidly rising.
Early Emperor Realm!
Mid Emperor Realm!
Late Emperor Realm!
Until Perfect Emperor Stage!
“Hah, no matter how many times I experience this cultivation increase, it always feels so good.”
Wang Ping felt the immense power within him, very satisfied and with a great sense of accomplishment.
Just then, Wang Ping was surprised to find that the Devouring Immortal Bead had not appeared, which made him frown, not understanding what was going on with the Life Simulator. He suspected it might have bugs.
Just as Wang Ping was thinking about this, he was surprised to find the three Devouring Emperor Treasures within his inner world floating out.
At the same time, an Immortal Source also mysteriously appeared here, and under Wang Ping’s gaze, it was quickly absorbed and refined by the three Devouring Emperor Treasures.
Then, the three Devouring Emperor Treasures combined directly into the Devouring Immortal Bead, turning into an Immortal Artifact.
This scene made Wang Ping’s pupils suddenly contract, with no joy, only fear.
After all, the way this reward was issued was too strange. It didn’t create an additional Devouring Immortal Bead, but rather used his existing three Devouring Emperor Treasures and a suddenly appearing Immortal Source to form an Immortal Artifact.
Obviously, this reward was not created out of thin air by the Life Simulator but accelerated a certain process.
This made Wang Ping have some guesses in his heart.
Low-level items might be created or replicated by the Life Simulator, but at the level of Immortal Artifacts, the current Life Simulator is unable to create or replicate them, so it uses existing materials from the real world instead.
The rules involved in the Life Simulator are related to space-time, creation, cause and effect, and the like.
These rules are not the Dao understood by the Profound World.
In the Profound World, there are thousands of great Daos, all of which lead to great power.
Meanwhile, the rules and conceptual abilities of All Heavens are abilities that defy logic.
The Talent Refresh mechanism and reward mechanism might be like this.
If that’s the case, Wang Ping thinks he has touched upon some truths about the Life Simulator.
Perhaps, once he reaches Myriad Heavens Paradise, he will have a deeper understanding of the workings and principles of his Golden Finger.
It is also possible that an optimized Life Simulator will provide him with a different experience, no longer operating in the same way as before.
Wang Ping’s heart is restless, with many thoughts swirling in his mind.
Just as Wang Ping was going through these thoughts, a Heavenly Tribulation aura suddenly began to brew, bringing him back to his senses and his expression changing once again.
“This is, Immortal Artifact Tribulation? Damn, Life Simulator, you’re screwing me!”
Seeing the brewing Immortal Artifact Tribulation, Wang Ping was completely caught off-guard and couldn’t help but curse.
If he had known the Life Simulator’s limitations in creating Immortal Artifacts as rewards and chose this compromise, he would not have made this choice now.
Even if, without making the choice, he wouldn’t be able to obtain the Devouring Immortal Bead for a long time, he still wouldn’t choose it.
After all, once the Immortal Artifact Tribulation emerges, it means his true background will be exposed to all powerful people in the real world.
At the same time, those quasi-Fairies would also come out early to snatch the Devouring Immortal Bead.
That is to say, unless Wang Ping runs away, he really can’t hang on in this realm any longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 1039 273 Soaring Combat Power A Tough Clash
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1039: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! A Tough Clash with the Immortal Lord! Chapter 1039: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! A Tough Clash with the Immortal Lord! Running away was definitely an option, and he could even return afterward.
However, doing so would also draw the attention of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, a Predecessor Ransmigrator.
The most troublesome problem wasn’t Wang Ping’s own safety, as he himself wasn’t in much danger.
After all, he had too many ways to escape, and even a Quasi-Immortal couldn’t catch him.
The most troublesome problem lay with the forces and individuals connected to Wang Ping, such as the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
If Wang Ping ran away, those related to him would definitely suffer and be utterly destroyed.
At that time, it would truly be Wang Ping’s fault.
Wang Ping owed them so much grace and favor, yet not only could he not repay them, but he also led to their annihilation, which was truly a grave sin.
However, without running away, Wang Ping couldn’t think of any good solution unless he abandoned the Immortal Artifact.
“It seems I can only abandon the Devouring Immortal Bead.”
Wang Ping thought over and over, but couldn’t think of a perfect solution. He sighed in his heart, and the previous joy of becoming an Emperor vanished instantly.
He was still too weak; he couldn’t even protect the Devouring Immortal Bead and the Taiyi Imperial Palace and had no right to be complacent here.
“It’s just a Devouring Immortal Bead. It doesn’t matter. As long as I further improve my strength, I’ll take back whatever is mine, twofold.”
Wang Ping looked towards the direction where the Devouring Immortal Bead was crossing the tribulation, with a cold glint in his eyes.
As for the Quasi-Immortals who tried to snatch the Devouring Immortal Bead, whether they were from the Immortal Mansion, the Ku Family, or the Dark Psuedo Immortal, Wang Ping wouldn’t let any of them off and would demand justice one by one.
Just as countless thoughts flashed through Wang Ping’s mind, the Immortal Ascension Tribulation of the Devouring Immortal Bead truly began, affecting the entire Big Universe.
Although the Tribulation area was only a single Starfield, the terrifying visions and tribulation aura covered half of the Big Universe, making many formidable cultivators feel suffocated.
At this moment, all of the Emperors looked towards the Devouring Immortal Bead with sharp glows and fervent gazes.
Even the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal were awakened, staring at the direction of the Devouring Immortal Bead with extreme jealousy.
As for the Dark Emperor and the Dark Quasi-Immortals in the Source of Darkness, they also began to stir.
It could be said that the entire Upper Realm was in chaos.
In the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, Pavilion Master Cold Moon of the Nine Stars Pavilion gazed at the Devouring Immortal Bead with a calm expression, showing no fluctuations.
It was as if an Immortal Artifact was nothing to him.
A few days later, when the Immortal Artifact Tribulation was completely over, the Devouring Immortal Bead successfully crossed the tribulation like in the life simulation, becoming a real Immortal Artifact. The Upper Realm was filled with various immortal mists and visions, as if celebrating the birth of this Immortal Artifact.
At this moment, Wang Ping was not hesitating to sever his connection with the Devouring Immortal Bead, setting it free.
However, what Wang Ping didn’t expect happened.
The Devouring Immortal Bead, which was a bit confused after the sudden termination of its contract, became anxious and flew directly towards Wang Ping.
Following Wang Ping as a powerful owner had great prospects.
As long as it stuck with Wang Ping, becoming a True Immortal Artifact wasn’t its limit; it might even have the chance to become an even stronger Immortal Artifact in the future.
Wang Ping saw the Devouring Immortal Bead flying towards him at a terrifying speed, arriving in front of him in the blink of an eye, and his expression stiffened.
“Master, I’ve become a True Immortal Artifact. Aren’t I amazing?”
The Devouring Immortal Bead, still unaware of the seriousness of the situation, bathed in Immortal Light, showing off in front of Wang Ping.
“What the…!”
Wang Ping looked at the Devouring Immortal Bead showing off in front of him and almost choked on his rage.
He chose to give up to protect himself and the Taiyi Imperial Palace, as well as the many people connected to him. But this thing flew over on its own, completely sticking to him.
Such loyalty would usually be a good thing, but at this point in time, it broke his plans completely.
Now, the forces and beings related to him were in extreme danger.
Next, even if he continued to give up the Devouring Immortal Bead and declared his intentions, it would be useless.
As long as those Quasi-Immortals knew this thing was his, their first thought after snatching it would be to kill him without mercy.
Otherwise, would they leave him to grow up and take revenge on them later?
Apart from that, Wang Ping’s physique and cultivation base would probably not be hidden anymore.
Having grown to this level in a short period, as well as obtaining a True Chaotic Body, what would those old monsters think?
Wang Ping’s value was undoubtedly higher than that of the Devouring Immortal Bead, countless times higher.
Especially Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, who was likely already calculating how to deal with him, his junior.
In this situation, even if Wang Ping acted like an ingrate and abandoned the Taiyi Imperial Palace and others who had helped him to run away, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion would likely chase him to the ends of the All Heavens Realm using every means at his disposal.
If he was willing to pay the price, it might be possible to find him.
After all, teleportation definitely left traces of time and space fluctuations, and there must be location tracking tools in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
So, being exposed to the sight of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion and other Myriad Heavens Forces, even if he escaped, he might not be completely safe anymore.
In the past, he wasn’t worth enough for people like Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion to pay such a price to chase and kill him across the All Heavens Realm. But now, it might not be the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 1040 273 Soaring Combat Power Clashing with
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1040: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Master! _2 Chapter 1040: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Master! _2 “You damn bead!”
Wang Ping was so irritated that he couldn’t help but grind his teeth, wishing he could shatter the Devouring Immortal Bead right on the spot.
At the same time, he truly regretted his decision. If he had known that this reward option would be such a huge trap, he would never have chosen this terrible prize.
In the end, he was blinded by the allure of an Immortal Artifact and overestimated the capabilities of the unoptimized Life Simulator he possessed at the moment.
“Master, how am I a lousy bead? I am an Immortal Artifact!”
The Devouring Immortal Bead retorted with a sense of grievance when Wang Ping scolded it.
“……”
Wang Ping was silent, his face twitching uncontrollably, and could only order the bead to recognize him as its master once more.
At this point, there was no use in doing anything else. He could only think about finding an exit strategy.
“Alpha, if I consume all of my World Source, can it help my Chaos Body reach Great Completion or allow me to comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and inquired deep down in his heart.
“Your current amount of World Source is far from enough to achieve Great Completion of the Chaos Body. However, it might be possible to help you comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit. After all, you are only lacking a slight chance to do so. The twenty million years of pondering you experienced within the previous simulation was not a waste of time. That being said, even obtaining that tiny bit of chance will still require consuming all your remaining World Source. To be honest, it feels like a waste of World Source. The correct choice for you now would be to abandon everything and run away immediately.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
“I want to run too… But I, Wang Ping, am not an ungrateful, white-eyed wolf.”
Wang Ping forced a bitter smile.
“As long as using up the World Source can help me comprehend the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit, I should have the confidence to confront a Quasi-Immortal.”
Pausing for a moment, Wang Ping said solemnly.
The upgrade from having 90% Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit to achieving Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit constitutes a qualitative change.
Particularly considering how the Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit is significantly more powerful than other Heavenly Dao True Spirits, once the Great Perfection of Heavenly Tao True Spirit is achieved, the increase in combat power is absolutely terrifying.
By then, Wang Ping would indeed have the confidence to confront a Quasi-Immortal, and if coupled with the Devouring Immortal Artifact, Wang Ping would be confident in killing a Quasi-Immortal with his own power.
At that time, he would no longer be vulnerable prey for others, but a formidable crocodile. Whoever wants to try and take the Devouring Immortal Bead from him should be prepared to be killed in return.
As long as he can demonstrate enough power to deter these ancient monsters and have the ability to flee at any time, who would dare to easily target forces and living beings related to him?
Meanwhile, during Wang Ping’s conversation with Alpha, numerous Great Emperors and Quasi-Immortals were all looking in the direction of the Taiyi Imperial Palace and staring at him intently.
However, the various Emperors were very wary of Wang Ping and did not make any rash moves.
After all, his previously demonstrated strength was extremely powerful, and it was suspected that Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was protecting him. If they attacked him, their situation would become extremely dangerous.
Moreover, the Emperors had to admit a fact: setting aside whether they could defeat him or not, even if they managed to defeat him and seize the Immortal Artifact, how could they survive in the face of invincible powerhouses like Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, who had surpassed the Great Emperor Tier?
Since one such powerhouse had appeared, they did not believe that Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was the only one who had surpassed the Great Emperor level in this world.
Next, they would only become bystanders, hoping to take advantage of any loopholes, but actively making a move would be tantamount to seeking death.
As for the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal, they frowned, completely astonished.
As Quasi-Immortals, they could discern the changes in Wang Ping’s cultivation level, unlike the various Great Emperors.
Although they did not detect Wang Ping possessing a Chaotic Body, the changes in his cultivation level alone were enough to shock them.
After all, this had only been a short period, but Wang Ping’s cultivation level had skyrocketed from the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection to the Great Emperor Perfection Tier. This cultivating speed was simply outrageous, and even they didn’t know what words to use to describe it.
Keep in mind that these two Quasi-Immortals had also taken more than a million years to elevate from the Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection to the Great Emperor Perfection Tier.
However, it took Wang Ping less than a year. This kind of gap was no longer describable as simply an exceptional talent or a monster.
If described in the words of those extraterritorial comers, it would simply be an act of cheating, an enhancement.
“Has it been one epoch since the cultivators of the outer world have become this timid? The Immortal Artifact is right before their eyes, and they dare not try to snatch it.”
At that moment, when everyone had their own thoughts, a cold voice echoed from the Source of Darkness.
Then, a figure emerged from within the Source of Darkness.
This figure projected an extremely powerful aura, and his cultivation realm had astonishingly reached the Great Emperor Perfection Tier.
Very soon, one of the Great Emperors recognized his identity.
This figure was none other than the Emperor of the Heavenly Prison who had fallen into the Source of Darkness millions of years ago.
Upon seeing this, all the Emperors and the two current Quasi-Immortals were quite surprised.
Although the Emperor Monarch was powerful, he was insignificant in front of a Quasi-Immortal who had surpassed the Great Emperor level, appearing extremely weak.
But the Emperor of Heavenly Prison dared to ridicule Wang Ping and seize the Devouring Immortal Bead at this time, which was no simple implication.
It meant that behind the Emperor of Heavenly Prison, there must have been a Quasi-Immortal in control, and it was very likely that the Dark Psuedo Immortal asked him to take action.

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 1041 273 Soaring Combat Power Clashing with
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1041: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _3 Chapter 1041: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _3 Otherwise, he wouldn’t have come out at this critical moment to probe Wang Ping and try to snatch the Immortal Artifacts.
After all, no one who has reached this point is a fool; everyone knows that pushing themselves to the forefront is risky.
“Emperor of the Heavenly Prison? His stele ranking is not even comparable to Emperor Kongxuan, just a mere ant.”
Wang Ping glanced indifferently at the Emperor of Heavenly Prison and spoke lightly.
At these words, the other Emperors looked puzzled.
Since when did Wang Ping look down on even Emperor Monarchs, treating Emperor Kongxuan as a measure of combat power, and even mocking the Emperor of Heavenly Prison for being inferior to Kongxuan?
They admitted that Wang Ping was strong, but his combat power was far from Top Emperors, let alone the level of Emperor Monarch.
Although Wang Ping had gained an Immortal Artifact and his combat power had definitely increased a lot, how much power could he exert without reaching the Emperor level?
With only quasi-emperor cultivation, it would be difficult to contend with Emperor Monarchs even with the help of Immortal Artifacts.
So, they had some difficulty understanding Wang Ping’s extremely pretentious words.
Or was Wang Ping merely putting on a tough act, trying to intimidate his opponents with his status as the Master of Nine Stars Pavilion?
At the same time, when the Emperors were thinking about their own thoughts, the face of the Emperor of Heavenly Prison turned extremely cold, filled with murderous intent. He coldly opened his mouth: “Very well, you are the only one who dares to disrespect this Emperor so much. Since you insist, then you will fall here!”
With that, the Emperor of Heavenly Prison directly displayed his Great Divine Skill. Countless pitch-black chains appeared out of thin air as if they had the power to imprison everything.
At the same time, a terrifying prison illusion appeared, as if it contained endless scenery within.
Seeing this, the faces of the other Emperors turned serious, with deep apprehension.
As an Emperor Monarch, the strength of the Heavenly Prison Emperor was truly formidable. If any of the Emperors were to face him, they felt they would definitely die and none could withstand his attack.
However, in the face of this terrifying divine skill, Wang Ping remained unmoved and indifferent, taking a step forward and preparing to shatter the divine skill of the Emperor of Heavenly Prison.
But just as Wang Ping was about to make his move, countless silver feathers appeared, and the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor appeared in the starry sky, wanting to take the hit in place of Wang Ping.
“Seeking death.”
Seeing this, the Emperor of Heavenly Prison sneered coldly, thinking that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was overestimating his own abilities.
There was a huge gap between top-tiers emperors and Emperor Monarchs. The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor facing his blow would result in his demise.
Even if he were lucky enough to survive, he would be on the verge of death, with damage to his origin, making it difficult to recover.
“Senior Heavenly Feather, it’s just an Emperor Monarch. There’s no need for you to take action. I can handle it myself,” Wang Ping said with a smile, as he saw the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor suddenly appear and try to take the blow for him.
As he spoke, Wang Ping no longer concealed anything. His Great Emperor Realm Completion cultivation was fully revealed.
At the same time, 90 percent of the true spirit of the heavens exploded without any concealment.
Then, Wang Ping punched out, and the Chaos Emperor Fist stirred up endless Chaos Spirit, fiercely blasting towards the Heavenly Prison.
“Crack!”
In an instant, the Heavenly Prison exploded, and Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist continued unabated towards the Emperor of Heavenly Prison.
This caused the face of the Emperor of Heavenly Prison to change drastically, as he didn’t expect Wang Ping to possess the cultivation of Perfect Emperor Stage and comprehend 90% Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit.
With such power, he had completely surpassed the Emperor of Heavenly Prison, and a sense of death arose in his heart.
Therefore, the Emperor of Heavenly Prison shouted: “Immortal Lord, save me!”
However, his call for help received no response. There was no movement, no one came out to save him from the Source of Darkness.
“This Emperor won’t accept it!”
Upon seeing this, the face of the Emperor of Heavenly Prison became twisted, and he could only use his own power to resist Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist. However, it was evident that Wang Ping’s fist was not something he could block.
As a result, the Emperor of Heavenly Prison was directly blasted by Wang Ping’s punch, falling completely.
Seeing this scene, the other Emperors fell silent, not expecting Wang Ping to be so powerful.
Not only had his cultivation soared to the Great Perfection Tier in a very short time, but he also punched out and killed the Emperor of Heavenly Prison as easily as stepping on an ant.
Such combat power and record were indeed too outrageous.
For a moment, the other Emperors felt like frogs at the bottom of a well, unable to understand the magic of this world.
“Wang Ping, you…”
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor also stared blankly at Wang Ping, completely taken aback.
He had just gone to the Guimo Sea not long ago when he discovered the strange phenomenon of Immortal Qi and hurriedly rushed back to the Big Universe, only to see Wang Ping being attacked.
Therefore, he chose to take action.
But he didn’t expect Wang Ping’s strength to have become so terrifying now.
“The Devouring Source Body is so terrifying. Can such a constitution really be born in this world? Or is it from the All Heavens? No, it must be from the All Heavens. After absorbing the two billion catties of top-tier divine source, Wang Ping has become so powerful.”
Afterward, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor came to his senses and thought of the Devouring Source Body. With even greater shock in his heart, his gaze also heated up.
With Wang Ping’s presence, there was no worry about Taiyi Imperial Palace not being able to go to the Immortal Domain.
“A 90% Chaotic Heavenly Dao True Spirit, truly terrifying. His power has already completely surpassed the Emperor Monarchs, but there is still a vast distance from the quasi-Fairy. Even if he has the Immortal Artifact, he is no match for me and will be easily suppressed by me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 1042 273 Soaring Combat Power Clashing with
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1042: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _4 Chapter 1042: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _4 “Since we have already probed his background, there is no need to worry anymore.”
Compared to the shock of the Emperors, the Quasi-Immortals hidden in the Source of Darkness were surprised, but felt more at ease.
For this reason, the Dark Quasi-Immortals chose to reveal themselves.
In an instant, as many as ten Dark Quasi-Immortals appeared, with their Immortal Strength sweeping across the Big Universe, terrifying phenomena emerged, causing all the cultivators to be extremely frightened, even the Emperors were scared.
As for the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family, they fell silent and hesitated whether or not to reveal themselves after recovering from their shocked state caused by Wang Ping.
On Wang Ping’s side, facing as many as ten Dark Quasi-Immortals, his expression remained unchanged, but he was extremely serious in his heart.
He was well aware that if he made any mistakes, he could run, but the forces like Taiyi Imperial Palace would be finished.
“Alpha, consume all my World Source and let me comprehend the Heavenly Tao True Spirit of Great Perfection.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and murmured in his heart.
“Ding, by consuming all the World Source, you have entered a state of etherealness and your comprehension has rapidly improved for a short period of time.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, Wang Ping felt that he had entered a wonderful state, where he could easily comprehend things that were previously difficult to grasp, as if everything was falling into place.
This feeling was very strange, allowing Wang Ping to easily comprehend the Great Perfection True Spirit of the Chaos Heavenly Path.
Although it was built on the foundation of Wang Ping’s own strength, this state was also powerful enough.
“Is this the feeling of spending Krypton gold? It’s truly enjoyable.”
Soon, Wang Ping left the ethereal state, but he didn’t regret it; he only felt a bit emotional.
In the past, he was always reluctant to use the World Source, but now he has finally indulged himself.
However, it can be considered as good steel applied on the blade, it was really worth it!
“Hand over the Immortal Artifact. It’s not something that an Emperor like you can touch.”
While Wang Ping was feeling emotional, the ten Dark Quasi-Immortals were also confronting each other. However, one of them looked at Wang Ping and said haughtily.
“Touch? This originally belonged to me, there is no need to talk about touching. On the contrary, you chose to fall into darkness to prolong your lives and claim to be Quasi-Immortals. You even try to make robbery sound so righteous, it’s truly ridiculous.”
Wang Ping looked at the Dark Quasi-Immortal who spoke and sneered.
These words caused the Dark Quasi-Immortal to frown, with murderous intent rising in his eyes.
The Emperors of the Upper Realm, the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal, and the Immortal Mansion’s Quasi-Immortal were all amazed by Wang Ping’s toughness.
He was facing Quasi-Immortals and still able to be so domineering and powerful, completely disregarding them. Such courage was truly admirable.
“Haha, Immortal Lord, he killed your subordinate and mocks you like this, can you bear it?”
At this moment, another Quasi-Immortal spoke, mocking the Dark Quasi-Immortal who had spoken before, seemingly trying to provoke the Immortal Lord to make a move and kill Wang Ping.
Regarding this, the Immortal Lord frowned but still had no intention of taking action.
“So, you are the Immortal Lord, the master of the Emperor of Heavenly Prison? However, as a Quasi-Immortal, you can’t even protect your own subordinates, yet you dare to claim to be the Immortal Lord. How ridiculous.”
Wang Ping looked at the Immortal Lord and said sarcastically.
Since these Dark Quasi-Immortals were each harboring their own intentions and no one wanted to make the first move, Wang Ping had to proactively provoke one of them.
Otherwise, if the Quasi-Immortals chose to make a move together and kill him, the holder of the Immortal Artifact, it would be really troublesome.
No matter how strong Wang Ping was, he couldn’t possibly fight against ten Dark Quasi-Immortals at the same time and emerge victorious.
“Junior, you are too arrogant!”
The Immortal Lord’s expression was extremely gloomy since even he could not endure Wang Ping’s extreme mockery any longer.
If both of them were of equal strength and confronting each other, that would be fine, but he was much stronger than Wang Ping, yet Wang Ping dared to mock him like this in front of so many Quasi-Immortals. His pride was really on the line.
Thus, in anger, the Immortal Lord immediately launched an attack on Wang Ping, throwing a casual punch at him.
This punch did not utilize any Divine Skills, it was merely a casual strike.
However, even this casual strike was enough to easily kill an Emperor-Tier character.
Apparently, the Immortal Lord wanted to maintain his dignity as a Quasi-Immortal by killing Wang Ping with a single blow.
“Heh, just a casual strike? That’s quite arrogant. Immortal Lord, are you aware that the last Quasi-Immortal who tried to kill me with such a method is already dead?”
Wang Ping sneered, showing no regard for the Immortal Lord’s attack.
Then, Wang Ping no longer held back and directly revealed his Minor Chaos Body.
As the Minor Chaos Body appeared, chaotic phenomena occurred, suppressing the extraordinary signs of the Quasi-Immortals’ emergence, causing shock among the people present.
The Quasi-Immortals at the scene also changed their expressions, all of them extremely astonished.
After all, they never expected that Wang Ping actually possessed the legendary Chaotic Body, and obviously, it had reached the Minor Domain.
Only Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion remained calm, without any surprise on her face. She just quietly looked at Wang Ping from a distance, her gaze fixed on him, not knowing what she was thinking.
At this moment, after Wang Ping used the Minor Chaos Body, he released the Chaos Emperor Fist again, blocking the Immortal Lord’s strike.
“Immortal Lord, if this is all you’re capable of, then you will become the first Quasi-Immortal to die by my hands!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 1043 273 Soaring Combat Power Clashing with
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1043: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _5 Chapter 1043: Chapter 273: Soaring Combat Power! Clashing with the Immortal Lord! _5 After Wang Ping blocked the attack of the Immortal Lord, he shouted loudly, and to everyone’s surprise, he actively charged towards the Immortal Lord.
“So what if you have a Minor Chaos Body? Today, this seat will let you know how wide the gap is between a Great Emperor and a quasi-fairy!”
The Immortal Lord’s face was gloomy, he snorted coldly, and started using his full power without holding back. A terrifying Divine Skill was unleashed, Immortal Light filled the sky, transforming into strange mythical beasts with terrifying power and attacking Wang Ping, intending to completely tear him apart.
“Chaos Emperor Fist!”
In the face of these beasts, Wang Ping still chose to throw a punch. The Chaos Emperor Fist erupted, showcasing its horrifying power and shattering a large number of strange beasts.
However, after these beasts were shattered, they were reassembled once more, as if possessing an undying body, they continued to attack Wang Ping.
“It’s useless. Although you are very strong, merely relying on your current power to challenge me is just not enough.”
The Immortal Lord touched his hands together, condensing even more mythical beasts, and sneered coldly.
“If the nine-fold Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit is not enough, how about the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit?”
Wang Ping looked indifferent, roared loudly, and directly used the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit. The Chaos Emperor Fist was unleashed again, and a single punch completely burst the numerous strange beasts, truly displaying the power of a quasi-Fairy.
This time, the beasts didn’t regenerate and were completely eliminated.
Apparently, Wang Ping’s attack had exceeded the damage threshold of these beasts.
“What!?”
Seeing this, whether it was the Immortal Lord or the other quasi-fairies, all of them changed their expressions and showed shocked looks.
They had never expected that Wang Ping had actually comprehended the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao Spirit, displaying the power of a quasi-Fairy.
A Perfect Emperor Stage, releasing the power of a quasi-Fairy, was indeed too terrifying.
After all, the higher one’s cultivation, the more difficult it became to challenge those of a higher level.
For instance, the Great Emperor challenging a quasi-Fairy had only occurred in the most glorious era of the Upper Realm.
Even in that era, according to the records, only one or two freaks had accomplished such a feat.
In other words, Wang Ping’s current achievements had reached that level, and he might have even surpassed those one or two people.
Wang Ping had the qualifications to become the Number One Person of All Ages.
“This seat has really underestimated you.”
The Immortal Lord’s face was extremely ugly, and he said in a deep voice.
He now regretted that he was the first one to send an Emperor Monarch to test Wang Ping’s bottom line.
After all, who could’ve predicted that Wang Ping would be such a freak?
“However, don’t think that just because you have reached the level of a quasi-Fairy, you can challenge me. Quasi-Fairies are not that easy to defeat.”
Soon after, the Immortal Lord calmed his emotions and coldly shouted, condensing even more mythical beasts again.
Then, with his hands together, a mysterious connection was formed between him and the numerous magical beasts.
“Ten Thousand Beast Immortal Array, activate! Ten Thousand Spirit Immortal Beast, come forth!”
The Immortal Lord shouted loudly, and a beast with an Immortal Rhyme appeared before everyone.
It was a strange beast with the head of a tiger, tail of a snake, and wings of a phoenix.
Although its appearance was peculiar, its power fluctuation was terrifying, causing the complexions of the quasi-Fairies present to become serious.
The reason the Immortal Lord was called the Immortal Lord was because he walked the path of the Ten Thousand Beasts, condensing and commanding ten thousand beasts.
Nowadays, his Way of the Ten Thousand Beasts had already reached such a point that people even mistakenly thought he had condensed a real immortal beast.
Although the strangely exquisite beast with an immortal rhyme was clearly different from a real immortal beast, its power level was still frightening enough. Ordinary quasi-Fairies would have a headache facing it.
Not to mention, the existence of the Immortal Lord was not a mere decoration. Although he himself had mediocre combat power, fighting alongside the Ten Thousand Spirit Immortal Beast would still give the enemy a headache.
“You picked the wrong person if you want to use me as a warning to others.”
The Immortal Lord rode on the Ten Thousand Spirit Immortal Beast and sneered coldly.
It wasn’t hard to guess Wang Ping’s intention based on his previous performance. He clearly wanted to provoke him to make an example of him.
If Wang Ping forcefully killed him, then the others would have to really weigh the consequences when competing for the Immortal Artifacts.
“Picked the wrong opponent? No, I don’t care who I face. It’s just that you are too conspicuous, so you need to die here.”
Wang Ping’s clothes fluttered, his expression indifferent, and he still showed no fear even when the Immortal Lord summoned a terrifying mythical beast.
Through the previous battles, Wang Ping had understood the power level of himself after realizing the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Tao True Spirit.
Now, he could fight a quasi-fairy head-on. If he used the amplification of his talent, he would definitely be stronger than an ordinary quasi-fairy.
Perhaps only when facing someone similar to a Predecessor Ransmigrator like Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion would he suffer a great loss.
“Kid, you’ve been constantly disrespecting this seat, you’re really too arrogant. Since that’s the case, I’ll tear your physical body to pieces and burn your soul for ten million years.”
The Immortal Lord was furious and directly controlled the Immortal Beast to kill Wang Ping.
In response, Wang Ping snorted coldly, and immediately activated the talent effects of Golden Talent: Multiplay and Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade, and directly unleashed the Chaos Emperor Fist.
It had to be said that Wang Ping’s luck was very good, and this time he actually triggered a Nine-fold Critical Hit effect!

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 1044 274 Killing the Immortal Lord The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1044: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Cold Moon! Chapter 1044: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Cold Moon! With Wang Ping triggering the effect of a Nine-fold Critical Hit, his Chaos Emperor Fist’s killing power surged to an incredibly terrifying extent.
Its formidable power was enough to easily obliterate a Dark Pseudo Immortal.
This scene horrified the Emperors. Even though they did not face the punch directly, a shadow of death still appeared in their hearts. They felt a cold shudder all over their body, feeling as if they were as insignificant as dust in front of this force.
Even the Quasi-Fairies present on the scene changed their facial expressions, showing a scared look. They hadn’t expected Wang Ping to have any hidden strengths that could explode with such terrifying power that threatened their lives.
At this moment, all Pseudo Immortals hesitated no more and distanced themselves from the fight, fearing they would be affected.
As for the Immortal Lord targeted by Wang Ping, he was also terrified. However, he had been locked in and unable to evade the punch. With no other choice, he decided to resist.
For that reason, the Immortal Lord gritted his teeth, directly controlling his ten thousand Spirit Immortal Beast to meet this punch.
As for his own body, he chose to retreat quickly.
Clearly, at this critical moment, the Immortal Lord made the right choice—letting his spirit beast take the brunt of the Chaos Emperor Fist.
“Boom!”
In an instant, the Ten Thousand Spirit Immortal Beast collided with the Chaos Emperor Fist, creating a terrifying collision that could shake the Big Universe.
The result was that the Chaos Emperor Fist easily shattered the Spirit Immortal Beast.
However, when the Spirit Immortal Beast exploded, it suddenly burst open, blocking the Chaos Emperor Fist.
The horrifying force from this collision and explosion directly swept across hundreds, even thousands of Starfields nearby, leaving nothing of these Starfields intact.
And the cultivators in these starfields were completely wiped out. Even the Emperors were not spared and were killed in the aftermath.
Only the starfields behind Wang Ping survived the ordeal, thanks to Wang Ping’s protection.
This terrifying scene made all powerful cultivators below the Quasi-Fairy level fearful.
As powerhouses, their battles had affected many innocent living beings, but like today, they became the ones affected. Many cultivators were experiencing this for the first time.
What’s crucial was that they couldn’t dodge. Under such Quasi-Fairy Tier battle, they felt that the entire Big Universe was unsafe.
Unless they fled to the border wasteland of the Big Universe or the Small Universe, it was their only chance to preserve their own lives.
For this reason, many Supreme beings and Quasi-Emperors had no choice but to leave the world. They lost interest in watching the battle and began to escape.
“Immortal Lord, it seems like you have some skills, at least in terms of escaping, other Quasi-Fairies are not your match.”
At this moment, Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to the situation of other cultivators, but looked at the frightened Immortal Lord and began to mock him.
“You!”
Being mocked by Wang Ping, the Immortal Lord’s face turned green. He didn’t have the confidence he had before, and felt only fear. He dreaded Wang Ping to the extreme.
Previously, Wang Ping’s power had erupted at the Quasi-Fairy level, and he didn’t fear it.
After all, he had confidence in his own power and believed that he could kill Wang Ping.
As a Quasi-Fairy, he was very confident in himself, and it was normal to have an invincible belief.
But, Wang Ping’s punch just now completely shattered his invincible belief.
He, a Quasi-Fairy, was almost killed instantly by Wang Ping’s punch.
The shadow of death made him frightened to his core.
Since his birth, he had experienced this kind of feeling before and had encountered situations where he had nine chances in ten of dying. But like today, where he was almost killed across ranks, he had never encountered this before.
Therefore, he was really broken, and his Tao Heart became a bit unstable.
“What are you saying? What? You dare not make a move at me anymore?”
Wang Ping stared at the Immortal Lord, mocking him.
“If you don’t dare to fight with me, I’ll take the initiative to kill you, and let you, the pathetic fallen one, fall completely.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Ping took one single step at a time towards the Immortal Lord with his hands resting behind him. Each step covered a vast distance, with an invincible momentum.
The stronger Wang Ping is now, the better.
Only by showing enough dominance, which made people unable to gauge his true power, could he deter these Dark Pseudo Immortals.
The Nine-fold Critical Hit before was entirely luck. Wang Ping didn’t think he could trigger a Nine-fold Critical Hit every time.
If he couldn’t deter the other Dark Pseudo Immortals and let them see some of his details, he might not be able to retreat safely.
To put it bluntly, he was sure that he would be able to retreat safely, but the Taiyi Imperial Palace and other forces would definitely be destroyed.
Even Bai Tianhong and others who stayed in the Purple Spirit Realm would die.
This was something Wang Ping did not want to see.
Although Wang Ping was confident that once his cultivation reaches a terrifying level in the future, he could resurrect them, the future is full of uncertainties, and naturally, it is the most secure to avoid a death outcome.
“What are you waiting for? If you wait until he kills me, you won’t be able to retreat safely. A person like him living in the world, when he further advances, you will all become ghosts under his fist. Even if he doesn’t kill you, there won’t be a chance for you to become immortals in the future.”
Seeing Wang Ping steadily approaching himself, the Immortal Lord felt cold to the depths of his heart. He couldn’t help but clench his fist and roared at the other Dark Psuedo Immortals.
Upon hearing this, the other Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals’ eyes flickered uncertainly, staring closely at Wang Ping.
Since they had already made their moves, wanting to snatch Wang Ping’s Immortal Artifacts, this feud was already settled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 1045 274 Killing the Immortal Lord The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1045: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_2 Chapter 1045: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_2 It should be said that even without any conflict, they still couldn’t tolerate the existence of someone like Wang Ping.
No one would willingly leave their fate in the hands of others. The threat Wang Ping posed to them was just too great. The safest thing to do was to kill him thoroughly before he broke through to the quasi-Fairy tier or his strength advanced any further.
Apart from that, if Wang Ping were not eliminated, their chances of seizing the opportunity to become immortals in the future would indeed be reduced.
However, it was impossible for them to directly serve as cannon fodder for the Immortal Lord.
None of the quasi-Fairies present were fools. Even if they were to take action, they preferred to do so after seeing the Immortal Lord being killed by Wang Ping.
Apart from that, they also wanted to see Wang Ping’s strengths and weaknesses through the Immortal Lord.
Whether the terrifying punch just now was casually thrown by Wang Ping, or it was brought about using some secret skill with great side effects, they couldn’t tell.
If he had used a secret skill with great side effects or couldn’t use it continuously in a short period, then they would consider taking action.
If not, they’d rather just watch.
After all, once they made a move, it would mean an endless fight with Wang Ping, and they might be used as cannon fodder by other Dark Psuedo Immortals.
Everyone among the Dark Psuedo Immortals present was a cunning person; none of them would act recklessly.
“Hahaha, since you all won’t help me kill this Chaotic Body and want to see me die, then I’ll wait for you to join me on the road to death!”
Seeing that he couldn’t persuade these Dark Quasi-Fairies, the Immortal Lord’s expression darkened to the extreme, his face filled with mockery.
His path was the Way of Ten Thousand Beasts, and one could say that more than half of his combat power was concentrated in the ten thousand Spirit Immortal Beasts.
With the ten thousand Spirit Immortal Beasts summoned by him, his combat power ranked in the middle-upper level among the Dark Quasi-Fairies.
Without the ten thousand Spirit Immortal Beasts, his current strength would only rank at the bottom among the Dark Quasi-Fairies, and other Quasi-Fairies could easily kill him.
At present, the ten thousand Spirit Immortal Beasts had already been smashed by Wang Ping, and it was absolutely impossible for him to be Wang Ping’s opponent.
Even if Wang Ping had just burst into an attack and couldn’t bring out that terrifying second punch, it would still be the same.
With such a terrifying Chaotic Body in front of them, even if the opponent couldn’t unleash that Terrifying Skill again, the Immortal Lord didn’t believe that these Dark Quasi-Fairies could really kill Wang Ping after killing him and seizing Fisherman’s profits.
After all, he could see that Wang Ping came from All Heavens and might still be hiding other means of escape.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have the courage to face so many Dark Quasi-Fairies at the same time.
However, in the face of the Immortal Lord’s mockery, the other Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals still remained unmoved, looking on with indifference.
Seeing this, the Immortal Lord was completely desperate, knowing it was impossible to make this group of cunning foxes take action.
Thus, the Immortal Lord’s face was ferocious as he roared and actively charged towards Wang Ping, wanting to fight a deadly battle with him to find a way to survive.
“Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill: Celestial Spirit Turbid.”
Facing the charging Immortal Lord, Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged. Coldly, he uttered these eight words and used the terrifying killing Immortal Skill from the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture, intending to kill the Immortal Lord in one strike and deter the other Dark Quasi-Fairies.
As Wang Ping executed the Immortal Skill, a beam of extreme light appeared, illuminating the pitch-black Cosmic Starry Sky, making the entire Big Universe seemingly brighten up.
Then, this beam of extreme light transformed into a terrifying figure sitting in the midst of the Cosmic Starry Sky, frightening the whole world.
It was the illusory figure of an Immortal with the terrifying might of an Immortal King who could destroy the universe with just a flick of a finger.
Seeing this astonishing scene, all the Emperors present were shocked, even the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals, the Ku family’s Quasi-Fairies, and the Immortal Mansion’s Quasi-Fairies had their pupils suddenly contract, their faces full of shock.
After all, the Immortal Rhyme of this illusory figure was just too intense, giving people a feeling as if a True Immortal had descended.
With such a powerful presence in just an illusory figure, it was hard to imagine just how terrifying the original figure would be.
This was a genuine Immortal Skill, towering above Divine Skills and terrifying in every way. Moreover, it was not an ordinary Immortal Skill, but one that manifested the illusory figure of an invincible powerhouse.
“Immortal King Skill…”
Soon, some Dark Quasi-Fairies with extraordinary insight exclaimed the rank of this Immortal Skill, their faces filled with disbelief, amazement, and fervor.
Immortal King, what a terrifying existence that was. Even during the time when the Immortal Domain Channel had not been sealed, they were superior beings.
No, to be precise, regardless of which era, whether it was in this realm or in the Immortal Domain, Immortal Kings were always superior beings.
If a True Immortal could destroy a universe in a short amount of time with their full strength, then an Immortal King, a big shot that only existed in legends, could probably destroy a universe with just a flick of a finger.
If an Immortal King put forth all their effort, just how terrifying would it be? It was something these Dark Quasi-Immortals could hardly imagine.
After all, True Immortals were the realm they aspired to reach, unreachable to them, let alone Immortal Kings.
Now, they saw the appearance of an Immortal King Skill in the lower realm, and this was just too shocking for them.
Therefore, even the Quasi-Fairies couldn’t calm down. They wished they could suppress Wang Ping immediately and seize the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture.
However, they soon regained their calm.
After all, Wang Ping had too many hidden cards. No one knew what other methods he had and decided to wait and see.
Among the Quasi-Fairies, only Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion remained expressionless, showing no signs of emotional fluctuation.
It seemed that even the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture was nothing remarkable to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 1046 274 Killing the Immortal Lord The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1046: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Cold Moon_3 Chapter 1046: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Cold Moon_3 Just as everyone was shocked, Wang Ping looked indifferently at the Immortal Lord and said coldly, “Immortal Lord, I’ll send you on your way!”
As soon as the words fell, the Immortal King Illusion opened its palm and patted it towards the Immortal Lord, intending to suppress him.
Facing this terrifying attack that was enough to shatter the sky, the Immortal Lord was shocked, unwilling, and desperate, finally turning into madness and laughing wildly: “Hahaha, dying by your hand, I have no grievances! But, that group of cowards are really pitiful, claiming to be quasi-Fairies! Immortal Artifacts and the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture are right in front of them, but they dare not act rashly, laughable! It’s really laughable! With this kind of courage, they delude themselves into becoming Immortals, it makes me laugh my head off!”
“Pfft!”
Just after the Immortal Lord finished his speech, he was suppressed and killed on the spot by Wang Ping’s Immortal Skill, completely falling.
After his fall, the scattered essence was ruthlessly swallowed by the Devouring Immortal Bead, becoming its nourishment.
A Dark Psuedo Immortal was killed so easily in front of everyone, it was too shocking. All the cultivators in the Upper Realm were staring blankly at Wang Ping, unable to speak.
At this moment, they had witnessed history.
As for the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals, they were quite unhappy with the Immortal Lord’s dying words, but they couldn’t refute anything.
Because they were indeed very wary of Wang Ping and did not dare to act rashly.
“I don’t need Immortal Artifacts to suppress Quasi-Fairies, do you still want to be enemies with me?”
Wang Ping looked indifferently at the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals and shouted coldly.
Wang Ping’s attitude was extremely overbearing, making the faces of the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals change unpredictably, somewhat uncertain about their decisions.
Upon seeing this, the many great Emperors were astonished beyond words. Who could have imagined that an Emperor could suppress and kill a Dark Quasi-Immortal with just two moves and even intimidate the remaining nine Quasi-Elderly not to act recklessly.
This kind of prestige, even if it was a true Immortal Descent, wouldn’t be much more than this, right?
“Hehe, little one, you are indeed very strong, and I have to admit this. But your methods are still too immature. You want to deter us, which is not a mistake, but unfortunately, you are too eager. This instead exposes the truth that you lack confidence.”
A dozen seconds later, an extremely Elderly Quasi-Immortal spoke, his sinister smile staring at Wang Ping as he slowly opened his mouth.
At these words, Wang Ping’s heart sank, but his face remained unchanged, scoffing: “I lack confidence? You can just try. Today, I don’t mind getting my hands stained with the blood of a second Dark Quasi-Immortal.”
“Don’t be anxious, let me explain in detail. The power you burst out with your first fist is indeed terrifying, enough to kill a Dark Quasi-Immortal. Unfortunately, you picked the wrong opponent. The Immortal Lord’s life-saving methods are still very strong, and you couldn’t kill him. It’s precisely because you didn’t kill him that you had to take action again. This time, you didn’t use the same power, but used even more terrifying Immortal Skills.”
The Elderly Quasi-Immortal spoke calmly, showing no change in his expression.
“Why would you go to the trouble of exposing Immortal King Tier skills? You should know what Immortal King Tier skills mean. They may arouse our greed and spying, increasing the reasons for us to take action against you.”
“However, you still did so. This can only show that your previous burst of power was an accident, perhaps some power or prop from the All Heavens, or some secret skill that you couldn’t use again. So, you had to use the more powerful Immortal King Tier skills to create a one-shot kill effect.”
“That is to say, you are strong, but you are not that strong, you are just barely holding on. Now, after using such a huge amount of power in succession, how much combat power do you have left? At this point, you have no guarantee of winning against any of us, let alone all of us.”
When the Elderly Quasi-Immortal spoke to the end, his expression became extremely sinister, and his killing intent gradually rose.
“Besides, it seems that you also want to protect the Starfield behind you, to be precise, the power you belong to. The terrifying aftermath of that punch just now was not easy to block, and the correct approach should have been to dodge and prevent being implicated, thus consuming your own power for no reason. However, you had the power to protect, so you had to choose to resist the aftermath, guard the Starfield behind you, and consume your strength.”
As the Elderly Quasi-Immortal spoke, the Cosmic Starry Sky became dead silent, and everyone looked at Wang Ping.
The Elderly Quasi-Immortal’s words made sense.
About Wang Ping coming from the Taiyi Imperial Palace, the Dark Quasi-Immortals sleeping in the Source of Darkness might not know, but the cultivators of the Upper Realm certainly did.
Wang Ping was indeed guarding the Taiyi Imperial Palace just now.
Moreover, the Elderly Quasi-Immortal’s analysis of the previous battle situation was extremely reasonable.
That is to say, Wang Ping might really be forcibly bursting out with power, trying to make a display of his power.
Unfortunately, all this was seen through by the Elderly Quasi-Immortal.
“Old ginger is still spicier.”
Wang Ping’s face became gloomier and his fists clenched.
These old undead really had a sharp eye and saw through the truth in an instant.
Indeed, in his first Chaos Emperor Fist, he had already used a large amount of Mana, combined with a lucky triggering of a Nine-fold Critical Hit effect, to unleash such an exaggerated power.
And the second time he used his full power to cast Immortal Skills was because he didn’t believe he could trigger a high multiple critical hit again.
The facts prove that his thinking was indeed correct, as the second time, he did not trigger a high multiple critical hit, just the most basic Four Times Critical Hit Damage.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1047: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_4 Chapter 1047: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_4 If he hadn’t used the Immortal King Killing Skill, it would have been impossible to suppress the Immortal Lord.
After all, Wang Ping had experienced just how tenacious the vitality of a quasi-Fairy was in the Life Simulator.
Now, his true strength had been completely seen through, and his situation was extremely terrible.
Because of this, Wang Ping could only prepare for the worst.
“Little guy, this seat doesn’t want to be your enemy either. Why don’t you hand over the immortal artifact and the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture, and this seat can stand on the same side with you and deal with the other Pseudo-Immortals? How about it?”
The elderly quasi-immortal’s expression suddenly became benevolent, speaking with a pleasant tone.
“Heh heh, do you think I am a three-year-old child?”
Wang Ping looked at the elderly quasi-immortal and sneered.
“It’s a pity, since you are so stubborn, I and others can only join forces to suppress you. Then, all the people related to you will be wiped out by us, leaving no survivors.”
The elderly Quasi-Immortal said regretfully.
As he said this, he looked at the other dark Quasi-Immortals, implying that they should work together to suppress Wang Ping.
In response to the Elderly Quasi-Immortal’s gesture, the other Dark Quasi-Immortals narrowed their eyes, staring at Wang Ping, finally taking a step forward, directly using their methods to seal a large area of the Void, preventing Wang Ping from having any chance to escape, and clearly showing their attitude.
Since things had reached this point, there was no room for reconciliation between the two sides. Only by killing Wang Ping could they feel at ease.
After they killed Wang Ping, they would each compete for the immortal artifact and the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture.
Of course, the premise was that the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture could be found on Wang Ping’s body. Otherwise, it would be in vain.
However, they couldn’t care about so much now, they would kill first and then talk about it.
Witnessing this scene, the Emperors of the Upper Realm sighed. Wang Ping’s performance had been good enough, against the heavens, but he still lacked too much in cultivation to reverse the situation.
Would the Invincible Emperor of this generation, the Number One Person of All Ages, fall here?
The Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family were also emotional and full of feelings.
However, they only felt sorry for him and had no plans to save Wang Ping. With their strength, they couldn’t save Wang Ping either.
In this world, no one could face the nine Dark Quasi-Immortals at the same time and survive.
“Wang Ping, leave quickly! Don’t worry about Taiyi Imperial Palace, as long as you are still alive, it will be enough to avenge us later. By the way, if possible, help me kill the Destructing Tao Emperor and save my daughter.”
At this moment, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor’s face was filled with anxiety, and he could not help but transmit his voice to Wang Ping, urging him to try to escape and no longer care about the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
“Is this the end? I’m still too weak now.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart, feeling extremely helpless.
He had done well enough, and his luck had been good enough, but he still lacked strength in the end.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s joy of becoming an Emperor had completely vanished, and his heart was once again filled with a longing for power.
Being an Emperor was far from enough, not even close.
He wanted to become an Immortal!
He wanted to become a king among Immortals!
Just when Wang Ping was about to retreat, a Quasi-Immortal aura suddenly appeared in the Cosmic Starry Sky.
This Quasi-Immortal pressure was even more powerful than the nine Dark Quasi-Immortals that had appeared before, and even much stronger.
Immediately afterward, an even more shocking Quasi-Fairy Phenomenon appeared: a full moon illuminating the Big Universe.
The full moon suppressed all other phenomena, as if it were a king reigning over the world.
Then, a figure in a white robe and a mask stepped out onto the Starry Sky under the full moon phenomenon.
“Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion…!”
The Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family were both shaken, muttering to themselves.
Because of Wang Ping’s terrifying performance, they almost forgot that the relationship between this Lord of the Nine Stars Pavilion and Wang Ping seemed unusual. He had helped Wang Ping earlier.
Now, it seemed that he intended to save Wang Ping again?
“Wait, something isn’t right…”
At this moment, the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family suddenly thought of a problem.
With Wang Ping’s current display of strength, did he need Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion to save him then?
Could it be that there was some hidden secret about it?
As for Wang Ping raising his strength from the late emperor stage to the level of suppressing quasi-Immortals within a short year, they absolutely did not believe it.
They firmly believed that Wang Ping had been playing the pig to eat the tiger, intentionally hiding his strength in order to make the many strong people in the Upper Realm misjudge his power. In this way, it would be much more convenient for him if he planned anything in the future.
While the quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family were frantically thinking that Wang Ping had been playing the pig to eat the tiger, Wang Ping also looked at the Predecessor Transmigrator, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
Wang Ping was not so naive to believe that Master Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, had come to save him like last time. Instead, he was extremely wary of Master Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
With the Life Simulator, Wang Ping knew many secrets and had seen through many cultivators, but Master Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, was someone he truly couldn’t see through.
Wang Ping didn’t know how strong Master Leng Yue was when he hadn’t obtained the Chaos Body Refinement of the Upper Realm, nor did he know how strong the current Master Leng Yue was.
More importantly, it wasn’t just strength that mattered. What made people even more wary was whether Master Leng Yue had any abilities or tools from the All Heavens. That was what made people even more apprehensive.
Back then, Master Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator of the Nine Stars Pavilion, had brazenly claimed that even Alpha couldn’t protect him. Perhaps it wasn’t about his strength reaching a level that Alpha couldn’t react to, but rather that he possessed a terrifying tool.

chapters.title: Chapter 1048 - 1048 274 Killing the Immortal Lord The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1048: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_5 Chapter 1048: Chapter 274: Killing the Immortal Lord! The Overbearing Leng Yue_5 After all, that thing is the most dangerous of all.
“Cold Moon, do you want to meddle in this too?”
At this moment, the Elderly Quasi-Immortal also looked at Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, revealing a wary expression and spoke in a deep voice.
Not only the Elderly Quasi-Immortal, but other Dark Quasi-Immortals also reacted in the same way.
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, this person from the All Heavens, was equally inscrutable to them.
As Quasi-Immortals, there were also differences in strength, and Leng Yue’s combat power was undoubtedly the most powerful among all the Quasi-Immortals in the Upper Realm.
Apart from that, it was even more frightening what this person had done in the past.
Leng Yue had once ventured deep into the Source of Darkness and somehow intercepted some dark power from the Source of Darkness.
This was something they absolutely could not do.
These fallen ones relied more on the special nature of the Source of Darkness to keep themselves alive, rather than truly absorbing the power of the Source of Darkness.
Let alone them, these Quasi-Immortals, even a True Immortal wouldn’t dare to do so.
Even the courage to intercept the power of the Source of Darkness was lacking.
After all, the Source of Darkness was too dangerous, and nobody knew how terrifying it was.
However, Leng Yue had the courage to do such a thing, and even managed to successfully intercept some of the power of the Source of Darkness.
The most shocking thing about this was not the fact, but rather, Leng Yue was even able to rid himself of the identity of a fallen one and return to being a normal Quasi-Immortal.
This was truly a rare occurrence, something that no one had ever been able to do before.
Because Leng Yue had accomplished many incredible things, all the Quasi-Immortals couldn’t see through him and were extremely wary of him. If possible, no one wanted to be his enemy.
“I give you two choices, and you have ten seconds to consider.”
“Either, you sever your own origin with one strike and return to the Source of Darkness; or, you all die here.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion had cold eyes and an indifferent expression as he stared at the Elderly Quasi-Immortal and other powerful beings, and spoke lightly.
As Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion uttered these words, the Upper Realm cultivators, whether they were Emperors, Quasi-Immortals from the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family, or Wang Ping, all froze in shock. They hadn’t expected Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion to say such words.
It had to be said, this was simply too domineering.
In the entire Upper Realm, there was probably no one more domineering than the current Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
As for the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals, their expressions instantly darkened, staring fixedly at Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion. The pressure of a Quasi-Immortal exploded, and they all spoke with anger and mockery.
“Leng Yue, you are too arrogant! Although we are wary of you, we are after all in the same realm as you, and not someone you can easily humiliate!”
“Leng Yue, you are strong, but do you really think you can fight the nine of us at the same time? If you don’t give us an explanation today, even if we have to pay the price of heavy injuries, we will still kill you.”
“Hehe, I’ve always found him annoying, why not take this opportunity today to kill him.”
“Leng Yue, I don’t understand why you would risk being an enemy of the nine of us to protect him. Is he your illegitimate child?”
…..
Facing the angry shouts and mockery of the Nine Dark Quasi-Immortals, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion remained unmoved, completely ignoring them, treating them like clowns, and spoke lightly.
“3.”
“Leng Yue, don’t be too arrogant!”
Seeing that Leng Yue had actually started counting down, the nine Dark Quasi-Immortals’ foreheads bulged with veins and they became even angrier.
If they were just scolding Leng Yue before in hopes of making him back down, now they were truly enraged.
As Quasi-Immortals, they had never been humiliated like this before.
“2.”
The Master of the Nine Stars Pavilion, Cold Moon, continued to ignore them and uttered another word.
Seeing this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but admire the domineering aura of his Predecessor Transmigrator, Cold Moon.
When it came to showing off, Wang Ping felt that he was no match for this predecessor transmigrator.
“1.”
At this moment, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion spoke another word.
As the word fell, the atmosphere of the entire universe instantly became extremely oppressive, and all the cultivators felt a chill in their bodies, as if their souls were being frozen.
As for that round moon mirage, it also became even brighter and more dazzling, white enough to make one’s heart palpitate.
“Since you all chose death, then I will grant it to you.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion looked at the nine Dark Quasi-Immortals who still showed no signs of backing down. His gaze was cold, his voice icy, and without any emotional fluctuations, he slowly spoke these words.
“Hmph, I’d like to see how you plan to kill us!”
A Quasi-Immortal with a height of ten thousand feet and ancient bronze-colored skin coldly snorted.
“Ice Moon.”
In the instant he spoke, Leng Yue suddenly appeared in front of him, a white palm print on his chest, and casually uttered two words.
As the two words fell, a terrifying cold air instantly covered the Quasi-Immortal’s entire body, freezing him completely.
Then, centered around him, a huge blood-red crescent moon appeared!
