﻿Chapter 1049: Chapter 275: Dark Psuedo Immortal Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Asking for Monthly Tickets for this 10,000-Word Chapter!) Chapter 1049: Chapter 275: Dark Psuedo Immortal Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Asking for Monthly Tickets for this 10,000-Word Chapter!) (ps: This chapter fills a big hole, must read, QAQ~}
Leng Yue suddenly made a move, and all the Quasi-Fairies present couldn’t react in time.
By the time they reacted, they saw the Ancient Bronze Quasi-Fairy had already been encased in a giant blood-red crescent moon of ice.
This caused the remaining eight Dark Quasi-Immortals to have their pupils constrict, revealing a horrified expression. Their bodies instinctively retreated, increasing their distance from Leng Yue.
At the same time as they retreated, the huge blood-red crescent moon exploded, turning into tiny ice shards.
As for the Ancient Bronze Quasi-Immortal, he died without leaving a complete corpse, completely fallen.
Seeing this scene, everyone felt even more frightened.
A powerful Dark Quasi-Immortal was instantly killed by Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion so easily that it was shocking.
This was an even more exaggerated and shocking performance than when Wang Ping killed the Immortal Lord.
That’s because Leng Yue’s move had no exaggerated energy fluctuations affecting many starfields. All there was, was swiftness, calmness, and a casual instant kill of a Dark Quasi-Immortal.
This also meant that Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was far superior to ordinary Quasi-Fairies, reaching an unimaginable level.
At the same time, this also meant that Pavilion Master Cold Moon’s words just now were not arrogant. He indeed had the ability to fight against nine alone and completely suppress the nine Dark Quasi-Immortals.
What he offered before to these Dark Quasi-Immortals were two choices, which were both opportunities for these nine Dark Quasi-Immortals to survive.
However, these nine Dark Quasi-Immortals did not cherish this opportunity to survive.
“So strong…”
Wang Ping was also full of astonishment.
“Alpha, when the First Generation Chat Group was destroyed, are you sure he was only an Emperor and had fallen into the Source of Darkness?”
Immediately after, Wang Ping couldn’t help but ask in his heart.
“Positive…” Alpha remained silent for a moment before slowly speaking, “I didn’t expect that more than a hundred million years have passed, and he could come this far even after falling into the Source of Darkness.”
“The Predecessor Transmigrators of the First Generation Chat Group who have survived until now are indeed incredibly powerful…”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh again.
“No, I always feel that he is different from the other First Generation Transmigrators. Perhaps there is a big secret on him, or maybe it’s because I’ve become too weak, I can’t see through him anymore.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded, somewhat puzzled.
“Who doesn’t have any secrets? For him to achieve this, the secret he has must be astounding. The only thing is, I don’t know what his attitude towards me is like.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and sighed.
Pavilion Master Cold Moon did not target him in the Life Simulation, but when it came to killing him, there was no mercy either.
However, when they reached the Real World, this attitude made a complete 180-degree turn. Not only did he not kill him, but he even protected him, giving a sense of a Dao Protector.
Wang Ping couldn’t figure out what he was thinking.
What was this Predecessor Transmigrator calculating about him?
“Cold Moon, don’t be so ruthless!”
The expressions of the other eight Dark Quasi-Immortals became extremely ugly as they angrily shouted.
Seeing a fellow strongman killed effortlessly by Cold Moon, it caused fear in the hearts of these Dark Quasi-Immortals, which led to feelings of awe towards Cold Moon.
They wanted to retreat, but they knew that even if they escaped back to the Source of Darkness, it would be useless against Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
If Cold Moon wanted to kill them, unless they escaped to the Life and Death Realm, they would die wherever they went.
However, if they went to that ghostly place called the Life and Death Realm, they would die just the same.
It can be said that they really have to fall here unless they make Cold Moon stop.
“I have given you opportunities, but unfortunately, you have not cherished them.”
Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion spoke indifferently.
“Since you want to kill us, then we won’t make it easy for you. Let’s go together. Even if we fall here, we will make him suffer heavy losses, making it difficult for him to advance any further.”
The Elderly Quasi-Immortal revealed a murderous intent as he furiously shouted.
With his words, the Elderly Quasi-Immortal charged up first.
At this time, escape was useless, and hesitation would lead to defeat.
Seeing this, six other Quasi-Fairies also revealed ruthless expressions and attacked Pavilion Master Cold Moon together.
However, another Dark Quasi-Immortal chose to escape while the others took action.
“I said, all of you will die.”
Leng Yue spoke indifferently.
The moment his voice rang out, Leng Yue appeared behind the escaping Dark Quasi-Immortal.
Then, another blood-red crescent moon formed, signifying another Dark Quasi-Immortal losing their life and completely falling.
“As a fellow Quasi-Immortal, why do you have such terrifying space means? You obviously aren’t walking the Space of Dao!”
Seeing Cold Moon ignoring them and casually killing the escaping Dark Quasi-Immortal, the Elderly Quasi-Immortal looked ugly and spoke in disbelief.
“I come from the All Heavens.”
Leng Yue said faintly, making the Elderly Quasi-Immortal fall silent.
“Haha! All Heavens! All Heavens! What a grand All Heavens!”
The Elderly Quasi-Immortal laughed mockingly.
There are too many secrets in the All Heavens. Unfortunately, the All Heavens rejected them, and they could not enter that wider world. They could only linger on in this Upper Realm.
It was reasonable for Cold Moon, who came from the All Heavens, to have such an incredible means.
“I don’t understand! Since you come from the All Heavens, why do you stoop to survive in this world like us fallen ones! With your power, it should be easy for you to achieve immortality in the All Heavens, or even go further.”

﻿Chapter 1050: Chapter 275: The Complete Annihilation of the Dark Pseudo Immortals! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Tickets with a 10,000-word Mega Chapter!)_2 Chapter 1050: Chapter 275: The Complete Annihilation of the Dark Pseudo Immortals! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Tickets with a 10,000-word Mega Chapter!)_2 The Elderly Quasi-Immortal roared unwillingly.
This roar brought everyone back to their senses, and they all thought about this issue with great confusion.
Given Leng Yue’s performance, he shouldn’t have achieved only this much, nor was there any reason for him to stay in this world.
“What is Leng Yue thinking?”
Wang Ping finally realized that he had overlooked something.
Leng Yue’s behavior was very strange. With his means, becoming an immortal or even advancing further in the Myriad Heavens Paradise should be a matter of course.
Perhaps, he might not be as good as the acting group master of the Second Generation Chat Group or the first generation one, but he shouldn’t be too far behind the acting group master of the Second Generation Chat Group, right?
However, he remained in this world, maintaining his quasi-Fairy cultivation, which was very strange.
If it was said that he was aiming for the Chaotic Body, it could not be possible either.
Previously, Wang Ping thought that Leng Yue had not taken any action because he was cautious of the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal and Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion.
Now it seemed that Leng Yue would not be cautious of these two.
Not to mention these two, even if all the Dark Psuedo Immortals and Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal joined forces, they could only end up being easily killed by Leng Yue.
That is to say, Leng Yue had not started the Refinement Array all this time and waited until a hundred thousand years later to start his plan, as if he was waiting for something.
What was he waiting for?
“What I want to do has nothing to do with the likes of you.”
At this moment, Leng Yue’s gaze was cold and indifferent, with no emotional fluctuations, and he spoke faintly.
As his words fell, Leng Yue stepped forward and appeared in front of the Elderly Quasi-Immortal. With a flick of his palm, he casually killed another Quasi-Immortal.
It should be noted that the Elderly Quasi-Immortal was much stronger than the other Quasi-Immortals, being the strongest among the Dark Psuedo Immortals.
However, even he couldn’t escape the fate of being killed instantly.
Leng Yue’s spatial ability was simply too overpowered.
Compared to Leng Yue’s spatial ability, the Space Divine Skills Wang Ping had comprehended before seemed rather unremarkable.
“Leng Yue, since you won’t let us live, we won’t make it easy for you either!”
Seeing Leng Yue kill the Elderly Quasi-Immortal instantly, the other six Dark Psuedo Immortals all had bloodshot eyes and simultaneously charged in different directions, choosing to self-destruct.
How terrifying was it for Quasi-Immortals to self-destruct?
If six Quasi-Immortals self-destructed together, tens of thousands of Starfields would be affected, turning into dust and ceasing to exist. A huge void region would be formed in the Big Universe, becoming a forbidden zone for life.
At this moment, all the other cultivators had their souls on edge, and even the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion had their faces turn pale, knowing that they were about to be implicated.
Wang Ping’s face also changed.
The six Dark Psuedo Immortals were pushed to the brink and wanted to self-destruct. If he stayed here, he would be affected and couldn’t possibly survive.
Although he had resurrection means, the cost was ultimately too high.
Not to mention, the Starfield where the Immortal Continent was located was just behind him.
Apart from that, looking farther away, forces such as the Tao Palace were also within the affected range.
“Immortal Skill: Blood Moon Ice Seal.”
Leng Yue looked at the six Dark Psuedo Immortals about to self-destruct, his eyebrows slightly furrowed, and the terrifying Immortal Rhyme surged from his body.
In an instant, a large area of the Endless Starry Sky was frozen, and blood-colored ice crystals sealed the six Quasi-Immortals that were about to self-destruct in different directions, turning them into an elliptical blood-colored ice crystal.
The reason it was elliptical instead of circular was simply because Leng Yue wanted to avoid affecting Wang Ping and the Immortal Continent behind him, so he chose to stagger it.
Otherwise, everything would be frozen.
“He can instantly freeze even the Dark Psuedo Immortals that are about to self-destruct? What kind of skill is this?”
The faces of the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion were extremely solemn, and they had a clearer understanding of Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion’s strength.
Leng Yue was simply too strong. Was this really the level that ice power could achieve? They could hardly understand it.
“The gap between me and him is too big now.”
Wang Ping watched this scene and felt the terrifying power, sighing in his heart.
If he faced Leng Yue now, he would also be instantly killed.
However, Wang Ping wasn’t discouraged. After all, it took the predecessor ransmigrator Leng Yue a long time to reach this point.
As for him, he had only spent about ten years.
Next, as long as he was given some more time, once he broke through to the quasi-Fairy Tier, he would have the confidence to fight against this predecessor ransmigrator Leng Yue and defeat him.
“Crack!”
Just as Wang Ping was having many thoughts in his heart, numerous ice moons cracked and shattered, and the Dark Psuedo Immortals within them completely disappeared, falling in the process.
With the demise of these Dark Psuedo Immortals, various phenomena gradually disappeared.
At this point, the entire Big Universe fell into a deathly silence. Even the Emperors and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, as well as the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion, did not dare to take a breath, fearing that Leng Yue would casually erase them.
Wang Ping also remained silent, quietly looking at Leng Yue’s back.
As for Alpha, it was always ready to take Wang Ping away from this place.
“You’ve already become an Emperor. From now on, using Talent Skills would be pointless. Don’t rely on it too much.”
At this moment, Leng Yue turned around, took a step forward, and appeared in front of Wang Ping with a faint opening remark.
“!!!”
At the sound of these words, Wang Ping’s pupils suddenly contracted, and he instinctively clenched his fists.
Although he had suspicions earlier, Wang Ping was still somewhat shocked.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1051: Chapter 275: The Complete Annihilation of Dark Quasi-Fairies! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Tickets for this 10,000-word Chapter!)_3 Chapter 1051: Chapter 275: The Complete Annihilation of Dark Quasi-Fairies! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Tickets for this 10,000-word Chapter!)_3 Leng Yue, indeed, knew about his talent.
If that was the case, the dramatic change in attitude from reality to the simulation could really be understood.
“What exactly is your purpose? Why do you want to protect me?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and said in a deep voice.
“If you want to know the truth, follow me to the Time-Space Forbidden Zone.”
Leng Yue’s gaze was cold and indifferent, speaking softly.
As the words fell, Leng Yue tore open space and stepped into it.
Seeing this, Wang Ping hesitated for a second, but still stepped in.
Following Wang Ping’s entrance, the Spatial Crack also disappeared.
Only after Wang Ping and Leng Yue left did the many strong people unanimously sigh with relief, coming back to their senses from the shock.
However, today’s events were destined to go down in history. Whether it was Wang Ping or Leng Yue, they would both go down in the annals of the Upper Realm’s history as legendary figures.
…
Time-Space Forbidden Zone, Wang Ping and Leng Yue arrived here.
This was also Wang Ping’s first time in reality coming to such a forbidden place where even top Emperors could risk their lives.
However, Wang Ping’s strength is now beyond compare, capable of killing even quasi-Fairies. This level of danger is nothing to him.
“Why do you think I protect you?”
Leng Yue’s clothes fluttered as she strolled through the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, ignoring many Time-Space rifts. Her calm voice emerged from her mouth.
“Because I’m your pawn? You’ve had your eye on me since I crossed over?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly, and after thinking it through, gave this answer.
“Pawn? No, I do not have the courage to treat you as a pawn.”
Leng Yue turned her head, looked at Wang Ping, and spoke indifferently.
“What do you mean by that?” Wang Ping’s eyes flickered with surprise.
“There are some things I cannot, and dare not say.”
Leng Yue’s voice remained calm, but Wang Ping noticed a change in her tone.
“……..”
Wang Ping remained silent.
The information in Leng Yue’s words was too much to process.
Could it be that it’s not Leng Yue calculating him, but someone else?
This person was someone that even Leng Yue didn’t dare to provoke.
At this time, Wang Ping thought back to the encounter with the Dark Time Emperor in the Long River of Time and Space, and his pupils couldn’t help but contract slightly.
If the one who guided the Dark Time Emperor was also a person that Leng Yue didn’t dare to provoke, then it seemed reasonable.
The real conspirator was not Leng Yue, but a more terrifying existence.
However, since this person had instructed Leng Yue to do these things, it also meant that the two most likely had some connection.
For a moment, Wang Ping thought of the big shots in the First Generation Chat Group.
However, he couldn’t be sure and had no way of asking Leng Yue.
Leng Yue’s attitude and words had already made it clear that she would not tell him the truth.
“In that case, let me ask a question. Are you a Dao Protector arranged for me by a certain existence?”
Wang Ping exhaled lightly, stared at Leng Yue and said in a deep voice.
“Dao Protector? I guess so.”
Leng Yue looked at Wang Ping and nodded slightly, not intending to hide it.
“Really a Dao Protector?”
Wang Ping was quite astonished.
If Leng Yue was a Dao Protector, he could understand why the Dark Time Emperor said he wouldn’t die.
It’s laughable, with a big shot like Leng Yue protecting him, how could he possibly die.
Even more so, Leng Yue was arranged by a certain big shot himself!
Perhaps only if the Source of Darkness truly revolted and targeted him, would he risk dying accidentally.
“I don’t understand, what value do I have that makes you all do this?”
After Wang Ping calmed down his emotions, he said in a deep voice.
Although his Life Simulator is now bugged, it might not be worth much in the eyes of the existence behind Leng Yue.
Or is it that they want the optimized Life Simulator?
“Your talent is indeed very strong. But I don’t care about your value, I just do what I should do.”
Leng Yue’s voice was cold and aloof, once again showing no intentions to explain.
“Is that the reason for killing me so many times? What happened to the Dao Protector you promised?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
“So, I killed you many times, huh? In parallel futures, you’re just an ordinary cultivator. If you don’t meet the growth expectations, I naturally won’t care about you, and will do things that benefit myself.”
Leng Yue looked at Wang Ping, her voice once again becoming cold and ruthless.
“…Growth expectations?”
At this, Wang Ping furrowed his brow, and according to Leng Yue’s attitude, thought of some things.
It seemed that only when he became an Emperor would he meet some kind of condition.
And in the life simulation, he once again became ordinary. If he did not meet the requirements of Leng Yue or the existence behind her, he would trigger a death option. Leng Yue would no longer protect him but would even kill him because it affected her plan.
“I’m still me, but you’re not you, so you have to die.”
Wang Ping recited this sentence.
“Now, have I reached your growth expectations?”
Wang Ping sighed and spoke.
“I guess so.”
Leng Yue nodded slightly, stepped out, and came to a stone platform.
Wang Ping followed and came here as well.
He was not unfamiliar with this place, as in the life simulation, simulated Wang Ping had visited this place, and had many impressions of it.
“Now that you have the Chaotic Body, all you need to do is sit in the center of this stone platform. When I activate the Great Array, it will help you refine this world. By then, you can become an immortal and obtain the Perfect Chaotic Body. Then, you can try to go to the Immortal Domain or adventure in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. As for me, I will also gain freedom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 1052 275 Annihilation of the Dark Quasi-Fairy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1052: Chapter 275: Annihilation of the Dark Quasi-Fairy! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Votes with 10,000-word Chapter!) _4 Chapter 1052: Chapter 275: Annihilation of the Dark Quasi-Fairy! The Beginning of Everything! (Seeking Monthly Votes with 10,000-word Chapter!) _4 Leng Yue pointed to the center of the altar and said calmly.
“The Refinement Array is prepared for me?”
Wang Ping looked astonished and found it hard to believe.
Leng Yue had put so much effort and planning into it, and in the end, it was all for him?
However, because Wang Ping became ‘ordinary’ in life simulation, he didn’t meet Leng Yue’s expectation as a Predecessor Transmigrator. In addition to the fact that the simulated Wang Ping wasn’t the real Wang Ping, Leng Yue chose to use it himself?
Apart from this, Leng Yue’s words also answered many of Wang Ping’s questions.
As the Elderly Quasi-Immortal said, he couldn’t understand why Leng Yue, a terrifying figure from the All Heavens, would stay in this world as a quasi-Fairy. With his abilities, it would be easy for him to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise and become a Fairy or even go further.
Now, he had finally found the answer.
It turned out that Leng Yue was indeed waiting for him, and all the various arrangements, including setting up the Refinement Array, were for him.
Although it was clearly a task given to him by the mysterious big shot, which required Leng Yue to protect him and help him achieve immortality. Only by doing so could Leng Yue obtain his freedom, but the truth was enough to make Wang Ping’s emotions complicated.
It turned out that both he and Leng Yue were pawns in this scheme.
He had originally believed that Leng Yue was the big BOSS.
Leng Yue did all this for freedom.
In addition, Wang Ping finally understood what the Dark Time Emperor Monarch said about him refining the Upper Realm’s parallel lines.
“Is the Refinement Array a means given to you by him?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he tried to probe indirectly.
Leng Yue shook her head slightly but didn’t answer Wang Ping’s question.
As a result, Wang Ping was somewhat helpless.
However, based on his understanding of this Predecessor Transmigrator, it should be a method of Leng Yue himself.
Otherwise, if that powerful person gave him something, there would be no reason for Leng Yue to make it so complicated.
“Go inside, I’m going to start the Refinement Array.”
At this moment, Leng Yue looked at Wang Ping and urged him.
“I won’t refine this world.”
Wang Ping sighed after a moment of silence.
He wasn’t a three-year-old child, believing whatever Leng Yue said.
Perhaps all of this was fabricated by Leng Yue. Once he entered, Leng Yue might be able to ignore Alpha’s power and annihilate him directly.
Besides, Wang Ping was not interested in helping himself become a Fairy by refining the Upper Realm.
After all, Taiyi Imperial Palace and many other forces were here. If the Upper Realm were gone, they would all be finished.
As for taking everyone to the Immortal Domain, Wang Ping didn’t think he could deal with the existence guarding the Immortal Domain Channel right after becoming a Fairy.
That existence was definitely not as simple as just a True Immortal.
Last but not least, although Wang Ping was not a good man, he wasn’t evil either. He couldn’t bring himself to refine the Upper Realm and slaughter countless living beings there.
“You are too naive.”
Leng Yue furrowed her brows and spoke in a deep voice.
“Perhaps, but becoming an immortal that way is not what I want. I want to become an immortal relying on my own strength.”
Wang Ping shook his head with determination in his expression.
“You won’t force me to refine the Upper Realm, right?”
After a pause, Wang Ping said, half-jokingly.
“If you don’t want to do it, I won’t force you. However, I will give you a time limit. If you don’t become an immortal within the designated time, I will use all means to make you refine the Upper Realm.”
After looking deeply at Wang Ping, Leng Yue finally spoke these words.
“……”
Wang Ping was helpless.
This development was really unexpected.
Other cultivators were desperate to become immortals, but for him, it had turned into being forced to become an immortal. This was too dramatic.
“Don’t worry, I will definitely become an immortal.”
Wang Ping exhaled softly and said in a deep voice.
“Maybe.”
Leng Yue responded indifferently.
“More importantly, can you let me see your true face under the mask? I always feel like we’ve met somewhere, especially your eyes, they feel very familiar.”
Wang Ping laughed and suddenly asked.
He was curious about the true face of Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator.
Of course, what was more important was that he wanted to confirm something.
“I must say, your intuition is sharp.”
As if guessing Wang Ping’s thoughts, Leng Yue put her jade-white hand on her mask and removed it.
Then, an indifferent face appeared in front of Wang Ping.
However, this was just the beginning.
Quickly, the face changed into an old and familiar appearance for Wang Ping.
This face was none other than the village chief of Chi Village.
“It’s really the village chief. It turns out that everything had been arranged since I started transmigrating.”
Wang Ping looked at Leng Yue, who had become the village chief of Chi Village, and smiled bitterly.
“The Chi Village Chief is a manifestation of my will. If I hadn’t created him to help you, you would have died in the forest after transmigrating.”
Leng Yue changed back to her original appearance, her voice still cold and distant with quite a stark contrast to the kindly Chi Village Chief.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping fell silent.
Now he understood why the Chi Village Chief was so kind to him when he was a stranger who mysteriously entered the village. The precious Spiritual Stone was given without hesitation.
Thinking back, his excuse of being attacked and guarding the palace was full of flaws, and no normal person would believe it, let alone the Chi Village Chief who had experienced the extinction of his family and Innate Realm Martial Warrior.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1053: Chapter 275: The Grand Chapter of All Dark Quasi-Fairy Being Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_5 Chapter 1053: Chapter 275: The Grand Chapter of All Dark Quasi-Fairy Being Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_5 Aside from this, Wang Ping finally understood why the village head often looked at him with a meaningful gaze.
Previously, he thought that the village head found him mysterious and was merely curious, but now it seems, it wasn’t that simple.
“What about the Chi Clan’s curse? Did you also arrange for the Burning Emperor to fall into darkness?”
Immediately after, Wang Ping asked another question.
“I have no interest in scheming against a mere Burning Emperor.”
Leng Yue responded indifferently.
“I only disguised myself as the head of Chi Village. The other residents of Chi Village are not my illusions. If you want to save them, kill the Burning Emperor and lift the Heavenly Curse.”
“I understand.”
Wang Ping’s expression was complex.
At this point, he had no idea what was real and what was fake.
He had the illusion that everything he has experienced was prearranged.
However, Wang Ping quickly calmed down.
Perhaps Leng Yue knew some things and had arranged some events, but he couldn’t possibly predict everything.
The majority of his life simulation experiences were real and were adventures he had embarked on himself.
“Senior Leng Yue, you’ve been predicting my circumstances through the Heavenly Calculation’s Child, haven’t you?”
Wang Ping took a light breath and asserted.
“If the Heavenly Calculation’s Child is in a state of madness, then you remain yourself. If the Heavenly Calculation’s Child recovers, then you are not you. However, even without this method, I could deduce things from the speed at which you grow stronger, just less accurately.”
Leng Yue nodded, confirming Wang Ping’s conjecture.
“I thought so.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
Now that numerous doubts in his heart have been answered, in the midst of his complicated emotions, he felt a sense of relief.
“Since you have refused to use the refining array, it’s time to leave this place.”
At this moment, Leng Yue spoke again.
“Then, I will take my leave.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping nodded and prepared to leave.
“To achieve Perfect Chaos Body, you need the ability to refine the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits and a more powerful Time-Space Origin. The so-called more powerful Time-Space Origin refers to the quasi-Fairy Origin who cultivates the Time-Space Tao. If you want to achieve a Perfect Chaos Body, in this realm, the only way to do it is to refine the Ten Great Universes with my method.”
Right when Wang Ping was about to leave, Leng Yue’s voice abruptly rang out again, causing Wang Ping to halt.
“Thank you for the guidance, senior.”
Wang Ping slightly bowed in thanks. After thanking him, he quickly left the place.
Only after Wang Ping had completely departed did Leng Yue recollect his gaze, close his eyes, and continue to sit on the stone platform in the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, lost in thought.
…
Meanwhile, Wang Ping, upon leaving the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
When Wang Ping returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, all the Ancestors of the Taiyi Imperial Palace held Wang Ping in extreme awe.
The previous Supreme Palace Master was particularly reverent, pondering the terror of the Devouring Source Body and becoming utterly obsessed with it. He was convinced that the Devouring Source Body was the strongest physique in the Immortal World.
Although Wang Ping had displayed the terrifying Chaos Body, in the Palace Master’s mind, the Chaos Body only enhanced his combat power. It was nowhere near as powerful as the Devouring Source Body.
“Palace Master, did you really grow stronger through the Devouring Source Body?”
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor looked at Wang Ping, becoming somewhat restrained and asked cautiously.
At this moment, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor instinctively lowered his posture. He was no longer as domineering as Wang Ping remembered.
He had no choice. Wang Ping’s performance was too outrageous.
“If I said it was true, would you believe me, senior?”
Wang Ping smiled and countered.
“Palace Master, stop calling me senior, just call me Heavenly Feather.”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor gave a bitter smile.
“Sure enough, you still don’t believe.”
The statement of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor made Wang Ping shake his head slightly, which turned out to be within his expectation.
He had experienced changes in status brought about by strength several times.
The change in the attitude of Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was expected.
At the same time, it indicated that the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor did not believe he had grown stronger in such a short time, and thought he had been hiding his strength all along.
However, there wasn’t much Wang Ping could explain.
“After all, energy must be conserved. Two billion catties of top-tier divine source can promote you from Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection Cultivation to Perfect Emperor Stage Cultivation? This is somewhat absurd. Besides, comprehending the Heavenly Tao True Spirit, Immortal King Cultivation Scripture, and alike can’t simply be achieved by absorbing energy.”
The Heavenly Feather Great Emperor gave a bitter smile.
“Conservation of energy…”
Wang Ping looked strange.
He always had the feeling that this phrase was propagated by those who crossed over.
Otherwise, it would be very strange to hear from Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.
“Fine, you can think that I’ve been hiding my strength.”
Wang Ping sighed, too lazy to explain further.
“Helpless, if I don’t think so, even I will be disturbed in my Tao Heart.”
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor gave a wry smile.
Breaking through from Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection to Perfect Emperor Stage in just a year, and even slaying a quasi-Fairy?
This speed of growth, if true, would indeed strike people hard; even an Emperor would feel discontented.
It could be said that not only him, an Emperor, but even a quasi-Fairy would feel extremely discontented.
After all, for them to reach this point, they had spent countless years and been through numerous fights of life and death.
As a result, Wang Ping had reached this level in just a year…

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 1054 275 The Grand of All Dark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1054: Chapter 275: The Grand Chapter of All Dark Quasi-Fairy Being Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_6 Chapter 1054: Chapter 275: The Grand Chapter of All Dark Quasi-Fairy Being Annihilated! The Beginning of Everything! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_6 Facing this situation, those who don’t breach defense are really a rare breed.
Of course, even though the defense has been breached, the fact that Wang Ping could control his Taiyi Imperial Palace is still a matter of joy.
With Wang Ping around, the dream of lifting the whole religion into Flying Immortal seems just within reach.
Next, after a bit more conversation with the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, Wang Ping returned to his own palace.
“Alpha, how credible do you think Senior Leng Yue’s words are.”
Wang Ping restrained his expression, deployed numerous secret skills, and set up several Great Arrays before asking his heart.
“I don’t know. If it’s really calculated by someone else behind him, then this person’s identity could very well be the person who destroyed the first generation chat group. Perhaps, only he has the ability to do such a thing.”
Alpha gave this answer after several seconds of silence.
“This is consistent with my guess. The calculations began before even my transmigration, they even targeted the exact location of my transmigration, such a means is too terrifying.”
Wang Ping was overwhelmed with emotion.
He is not afraid at present.
After all, when faced with such an entity, fear is useless. If the other side wanted to kill him, he would’ve died long ago and wouldn’t have survived to this day.
If the other person really wanted to kill him, they wouldn’t need to calculate so much, just as Leng Yue said, without his words, Wang Ping could’ve died in the woods as soon as he transmigrated.
Alpha at that time was incredibly cold-blooded, he might not have protected him.
Moreover, Alpha at that time was genuinely poor, too stingy, even if he did protect him, to what extent he could protect him was questionable.
“Forget it, no need to think that much, once I become strong enough, the truth will be revealed one by one. Sooner or later, I’ll be standing in front of him and uncover the truth.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself with glimmering eyes.
“System, how much Extreme-tier Divine Source do I need to start the paid simulation now?”
Immediately afterwards, Wang Ping restrained his emotions and asked at the bottom of his heart.
“Ding, upon detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the Great Emperor Realm Completion, paid simulation requires two billion catties of top-tier divine source.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, kindly note that the current Life Simulator is nearing its simulation limit and needs to be optimized again. Otherwise, even if the host obtains the quasi-Fairy cultivation in the simulation, it may be difficult to refresh due to the upper limit.”
“Well, it seems that Senior Leng Yue’s reminder was indeed correct. I can no longer rely on the paid mode of the Life Simulator to become stronger.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly.
The Golden Finger of the chat group has always had an upper limit. He was clear about this long ago. The normal optimization limit of Golden Finger is Great Emperor Tier, it cannot exceed Great Emperor Tier.
The previous Immortal Artifact reward was even more deceiving. It wasn’t a created reward, but a real condition formed, it nearly fooled him to death.
His Life Simulator was like this, Lin Yuanyuan’s Golden Finger was the same. At most, it could exhaust the power of the Great Emperor. The quasi-Fairy level is impossible to reach.
Unless, it is optimized again.
“It seems that next, I have to complete more Group Tasks and earn Group points, then find a way to kill the Sci-fi Mysterious, get the entry ticket to Myriad Heavens Paradise. It is now time for me to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping let out a sigh, and formed a plan in his heart.
“Of course, even though the Life Simulator has reached its limit and I can’t rely on paid simulation, I can still continue with paid simulation, try to refresh more Seven-Color Talent, to add some cards to my hand to confront the sci-fi mysterious.”
“Just not sure if Leng Yue would still try to kill me in the Life Simulator. I always feel like, unless I become immortal, he will make a move on me whenever I’m in simulation given his previous attitude.”
After a pause, Wang Ping began calculating again.
This predecessor, Leng Yue is really a love-hate character.
“Forget it, whatever. Even if I get killed by him, as long as I can refresh my talent, that’s all that matters.”
Wang Ping shook his head, not wanting to think any further.
Next, Wang Ping used the free simulation to carry out a test.
The result of the test was that he would indeed be targeted.
After all, the simulated Wang Ping isn’t the real one, but Leng Yue doesn’t feel that he is fake, so he would choose to target Wang Ping, in order to obtain the Perfect Chaotic Body and then become an Immortal.
“Sigh, this really dashes my last whimsical idea.”
Wang Ping gave up his final glimmer of hope, stood up, shattered the space, and left the Taiyi Imperial palace directly to go to where Destructing Taoist Emperor was located, planning to first detonate gold coins from Destructing Taoist Emperor.
As for the Qingyu Quasi Emperor and Green Bamboo Emperor, he will seek them out one by one.
Wang Ping has always been a man who keeps his promises, since he made a promise to the Black Abyss Demon Lord and others, he will keep his promise.
Soon, Wang Ping arrived at the secret place where the Destructing Taoist Emperor was located.
Then, with a single strike from Wang Ping, his Great Array was broken, completely unnecessary to rely on triggering the Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack to break through as in the previous simulations.
When Wang Ping stepped into it, he attracted the attention of the Destructing Taoist Emperor and the quasi-Fairy will that was currently eroding the Destructing Taoist Emperor’s divine soul.
However, this time is also different from the simulations.
In simulations, the quasi-Fairy will was overjoyed the moment he saw Wang Ping, thinking Wang Ping came to offer his head.
The quasi-Fairy will now, on seeing Wang Ping, was greatly alarmed, he feared Wang Ping to the extreme.
This also caused Destructing Taoist Emperor’s right eye to violently contract.
As for Destructing Taoist Emperor’s left eye, it was filled with pain, astonishment, and joy.
After all, the quasi-Fairy war that swept over the Big Universe, even though they were in a secret location, they were still aware of it.
For this reason, whether it was Destructing Taoist Emperor himself or the quasi-Fairy will, both recognized Wang Ping and knew he was the real Chaos body who had previously slayed the quasi-Fairy.
“Senior, save me, if you are willing to save me, I am willing to follow you.”
The Destructing Taoist Emperor strived to control his body and spoke these words.
“Heh, for a Taoist Emperor, you are truly pathetic, for the sake of survival, you actually chose to submit to others.”
The quasi-Fairy will sneered.
“Submitting to a great being like Chaos Emperor is not shameful, it’s my honor, and your existence that would even snatch other people’s body to stay alive, as a quasi-Fairy, is foolish.”
Destructing Taoist Emperor roared.
It has to be said, the present scenario was really dramatic, Destructing Taoist Emperor gave off the feeling of being schizophrenic, arguing with himself.
“Boring.”
Wang Ping uttered these two words with a cold expression, then directly brought out the Devouring Immortal Bead.
With the emergence of Devouring Immortal Bead, an overwhelming devouring force swept out, wanting to devour Destructing Taoist Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 1055 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1055: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! Chapter 1055: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! Seeing that the Devouring Immortal Bead was about to devour him, the Destructing tao emperor was startled at first, but then burst into laughter: “Well, instead of being possessed and becoming neither human nor ghost, it’s better to die.”
“Damn it, I’m not satisfied with this.”
However, the quasi-Fairy intention sighed and was very unwilling, but not afraid of death.
At this point, both of them were swallowed by the Devouring Immortal Bead. Their bodies turned into essence and qi, their divine sources and mana turned into energy, and their divine souls turned into pure soul energy.
As for the things in Destructing tao emperor’s inner world, they were spit out by the Devouring Immortal Bead.
“Quite a character, not wanting to die, but not begging for mercy when faced with certain death.”
After retrieving the Devouring Immortal Bead, Wang Ping gave the Destructing tao emperor a fairly fair evaluation.
Next, Wang Ping absorbed a portion of the soul energy after collecting all the extreme-tier divine sources and treasures into his inner world, wanting to see if there were any secrets hidden in the Destructing tao emperor and that quasi-Fairy intention.
A Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal who has fallen to such a state must have a story, Wang Ping wanted to see what he had been through.
Soon, Wang Ping got the answer.
The Destructing tao emperor did have a secret, but it was not useful for Wang Ping.
As for the secret of this Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal, it was quite surprising and delightful to Wang Ping.
This Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal was not from the Upper Realm, but from another world.
Like the Purple Spirit Realm, the Upper Realm also has different worlds, some far apart and some relatively close.
This Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal came from a world relatively close to the Upper Realm.
He was already invincible in that world, and there were no secrets left for him in that world, so he made an extremely domineering choice to forcibly break through the world and go to other worlds.
His combat power was indeed terrifying, much stronger than the ten Dark Pseudo Immortals that Wang Ping had seen before, and he really accomplished such an outrageous thing.
However, when he broke through the Upper Realm Barrier and came to this world, he was attacked. The attacker was a Dark Psuedo Immortal hidden in the darkness.
This Dark Psuedo Immortal was extremely powerful, walking the Time-Space Tao, and had a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body.
He lost the battle against this Dark Psuedo Immortal, his physical body was destroyed, his divine source severely damaged, and more than half of his divine soul was destroyed. He finally managed to escape by using a Secret Skill.
In the end, he created this secret land, attracting powerful people to refine it in a low-key manner, helping himself to heal.
Unfortunately, his injuries were too severe, and even refining the Great Emperor provided little help. He would eventually perish if this continued.
For this reason, he had the idea of body possession.
Latter on, Destructing tao emperor was tricked and came here. This Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal thought Destructing tao emperor was a suitable candidate, so he wanted to possess him and live another life.
“Destructing tao emperor is really unlucky. But, it turns out that there really are other Dark Psuedo Immortals in this world? Even a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body Dark Psuedo Immortal.”
Wang Ping sighed and pondered.
It seems that the ten Dark Pseudo Immortals who had emerged before were not all the Dark Pseudo Immortals sleeping in the Source of Darkness. There was a high probability that there were other Dark Pseudo Immortals.
That Dark Psuedo Immortal with a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body was one of them.
However, he was really patient, even ignoring the emergence of Immortal Artifacts and his Chaotic Body, and not having the idea of coming out.
“Or could it be that these Dark Psuedo Immortals who didn’t come out are more aware of Senior Leng Yue’s details, and are quite wary of him, so they didn’t want to make a move.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought of this point, which made sense to him.
It seems that in this era, the Upper Realm can be safe and sound without any Dark Psuedo Immortals causing trouble, and Senior Leng Yue has played a great deterrent role.
“With my strength, I can fight and even kill an ordinary Dark Pseudo Immortal. However, if I face that Perfect Time and Space Tao Body Dark Pseudo Immortal, I am most likely not their opponent.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows and thought to himself.
However, for his Chaotic Body to reach the Great Completion Domain, he needed the divine source of a quasi-Fairy who was cultivating the Road of Time and Space.
Now, there is no better fit than the divine source of that Dark Psuedo Immortal with a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body.
But he can’t defeat him now, which is quite frustrating.
“It seems that Senior Leng Yue knew about the existence of this Perfect Time and Space Tao Body Quasi-Immortal early on, and deliberately told me the conditions for the Great Chaos Body. This is also a test for me.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, guessing Leng Yue’s intentions.
If he couldn’t even kill a Dark Pseudo Immortal, then he was daydreaming about becoming an Immortal on his own.
“To kill him, either I draw a seven-color talent that greatly enhances my combat power, or I break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier. Unfortunately, breaking through to the quasi-Fairy Tier requires refining Immortal Spirits or Immortal Source. I don’t have those conditions now.”
Wang Ping sighed and felt a headache.
The Seven-Color Talent was a matter of luck.
As for Immortal Spirits, there were some in the Immortal Gate of the Immortal Mansion, but it could not be opened now.
Immortal Source was available in the Immortal Tower, but Wang Ping was already at the great emperor cultivation level, and he simply couldn’t enter.
Maybe, he really chose the emperor cultivation too early.
“I originally thought that Leng Yue, this predecessor ransmigrator, would block the door at any time, but who knew that he was a Dao Protector, scaring me into crazily improving my cultivation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 1056 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1056: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! The Great Chaos Body! _2 Chapter 1056: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! The Great Chaos Body! _2 Wang Ping couldn’t help but complain.
“Master, don’t forget about me. As long as you give me enough Emperors and even quasi-immortals to devour, their massive energy can help you condense a quasi-immortal physical body and divine soul. I can also help you condense the essential Immortal Source, assisting you in breaking through to the quasi-immortal cultivation level.”
At this moment, a crisp voice chimed in.
Then, the Devouring Immortal Bead floated out, displaying a somewhat ostentatious appearance.
“Can you really condense the Immortal Source?”
Wang Ping’s eyes brightened, and he asked excitedly.
“I have swallowed Immortal Source before. After analyzing its composition, I can indeed condense it through the help of quasi-immortals.”
The crisp voice of Devouring Immortal Bead rang out again, quite proud and delighted.
“Hahaha, great!”
Upon hearing these words, Wang Ping burst into laughter, extremely overjoyed.
It seemed that apart from enhancing his combat power, the Devouring Immortal Bead’s most significant effect remained unaltered – being a cultivation cheating device.
With the Devouring Immortal Bead, he could now smoothly challenge the quasi-immortal realm.
As for becoming an immortal, he probably couldn’t rely on the Devouring Immortal Bead anymore. Even if he wanted to breakthrough by devouring a massive number of Quasi-immortals, this world didn’t have the conditions for that.
Besides, becoming an immortal might require Enlightenment, something the Devouring Immortal Bead couldn’t help with either.
“With the extreme-tier Divine Source I have, I can simulate three times. I hope I can refresh the Seven-Colored Talent. Then, use the Life Simulator to experiment and see how many Dark Emperors and Dark Psuedo Immortals I need to kill to condense the Immortal Source. Moreover, I need to learn the location of the nine Innate Living Beings and the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal through the simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed with determination as he thought inwardly.
Then, he sat down with his legs crossed and said in his heart, “System, I want to start the Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming two billion catties of top-tier divine source, the Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing in progress…..”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations Host for successfully refreshing the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty; Golden Talent: Mad Clothing Blast.”
Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty: Upon activating this talent, the Host’s power will skyrocket to a terrifying level within an extremely short period. However, this burst is also very brief. Once it ends, the Host will lose one life.
Ps: Due to the severe side effects of this talent, its effects have surpassed the scope of the Seven-Colored Talent to some extent.
Golden Talent: Mad Clothing Blast: With this talent, the Host will love to burst clothes during battle. After bursting their clothes, the Host’s combat power will increase slightly.
“I couldn’t have asked for more!”
Wang Ping looked at the newly refreshed Seven-Colored Talent, his face filled with surprise.
The Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty allowed him to obtain a terrifying power for a short time. Although the side effect was significant, costing him one life per use, he had the Rebirth Tally that could withstand the loss of a single life.
He didn’t know how powerful this talent, which claimed to surpass the Seven-Colored Talent category to some extent, was and whether it could grant him the strength to defeat the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.
As for the Golden Talent: Mad Clothing Blast… this talent was truly a bizarre one, and it was incredible that he could reach the level of the Golden Talent.
“System, I choose the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty.”
After complaining, Wang Ping didn’t hesitate and spoke in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins….”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness wavered as he entered the immersive simulation state.
Immediately, a luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text appeared in front of Wang Ping, making his gaze flicker uncertainly.
“There is not much time left for me. As soon as they find out I’ve entered an immersive simulation state, Senior Leng Yue will make a move on me. The timing of this simulation is even earlier than the previous ones, giving me only one year. Presumably, Heavenly Calculation’s Child will wake up a year later, informing the simulated Senior Leng Yue that I’ve undergone another life simulation.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
The simulated Senior Leng Yue did not think of himself as a fake being, so he would attack the valueless simulated Wang Ping for his own benefit, seizing back his belongings.
Therefore, the predecessor transmigrator Leng Yue was indeed quite annoying.
Going from a Dao Protector in reality to a big boss in the simulation, these two identities were ridiculously different.
Wang Ping quickly calmed his thoughts and focused on the luminescent screen.
“[Day 1, you chose to start taking action immediately and headed to the Purgatory Ancient Star, breaking Emperor Flame’s seal directly and releasing the Innate Emperor Flame. After releasing the Innate Emperor Flame, it wanted to escape, but you easily suppressed it.]
“[This time, taking the Innate Emperor Flame from you did not result in an attack from the Burning Emperor. He hid in the Source of Darkness and had no intention of coming out. Obviously, the Burning Emperor did not have the courage to fight you. However, this is quite normal, as your previous performance was too overbearing, making even quasi-immortals fear you, let alone a Top-Tier Great Emperor like him.]
“[But while the Burning Emperor had no intention of seeking you out, you chose to actively pursue him. As a result, you broke into the Source of Darkness.]
“[Your intrusion of the Source of Darkness caused the many Dark Emperors inside to be frightened and flee, fearful of being wiped out by you. Although you wanted to eradicate them, your main goal right now was to kill the Burning Emperor and lift the curse on Chi Village first.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1057 - 1057 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1057: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! The Great Chaos Body! _3 Chapter 1057: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! The Great Chaos Body! _3 [For this reason, you casually grabbed a Dark Emperor, asked him about the location of the Burning Emperor, and to save his life, this Dark Emperor directly betrayed the Burning Emperor and revealed his whereabouts.]
[Upon hearing the location of the Burning Emperor, you casually crushed the Dark Emperor to death and let the Devouring Immortal Bead absorb him. This process was easy and leisurely, just like crushing an ant.]
[Soon, you found the Burning Emperor and killed him on the spot, letting the Devouring Immortal Bead absorb and refine him.]
[Then, feeling that your purpose had been achieved, you began a killing spree in the Source of Darkness, targeting all the Dark Emperors living in the darkness.]
[Your crazy actions angered many Dark Emperors. As Dark Emperors, even though they were afraid of your combat power, they knew at this moment that running away was useless and they had to unite to fight against you.]
[For this reason, tens of thousands of Dark Emperors joined forces, forming a Great Array, trying to suppress and kill you. To your surprise, you never expected so many Dark Emperors to be lurking in the Source of Darkness.]
[However, on second thought, the Source of Darkness had existed for an unknown number of years, experienced countless eras, and even if there were thousands of emperors falling into it in each era, it would be normal for so many Dark Emperors to be hidden in it after years of accumulation.]
[At the same time, you also discovered many Emperors recorded in ancient books. Among them, there was even the third Emperor of Taiyi Imperial Palace. Apparently, not all Emperors of Taiyi Imperial Palace were as proud as the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Taiyi Great Emperor, who chose to sit and die rather than fall into darkness when they grew old.]
[Regarding this, you didn’t have any interest in discussing it with them. Since they had fallen, they were enemies, and all you had to do was kill them.]
[Thus, your battle with these tens of thousands of Dark Emperors erupted. It has to be said that tens of thousands of Dark Emperors were indeed terrifying. Even a quasi-Fairy facing so many Dark Emperors would be in great danger. But you were much stronger than ordinary quasi-Fairy. Most importantly, Emperors were still Emperors, and within the range of effect of your Seven-Color Talent: Instant Death Attack.]
[Next, in the process of fighting against them, you repeatedly injured them. Although you also suffered, as you triggered the effect of your Seven-Colored Talent: Instant Death Attack, a large number of Emperors who were injured by the backlash perished instantly.]
[After this battle, you gained another achievement of defeating thousands of enemies alone. Next, you took advantage of the Devouring Immortal Bead to absorb all these Dark Emperors. Although it couldn’t fully refine them in a short time due to their large number, you were not in a hurry.]
[Just as you were considering whether to retreat and absorb the harvest of this battle, a quasi-Fairy appeared in front of you. This quasi-Fairy was none other than the Dark Psuedo Immortal you were looking for, the one who possessed a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body.]
[Upon seeing you, the Dark Psuedo Immortal’s eyes were cold, stating that you went too far.]
[Hearing this, your face was indifferent; you scoffed and refuted his words. Fallen ones were the cancer of this world, and they deserved death. There was no such thing as going too far.]
[Filled with murderous intent, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal solemnly stated that since you were stubborn and cruel, and even if Leng Yue protected you, he had to make you pay the price.]
[You sneered, claiming that the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal wasn’t standing up for the Dark Emperors, but was just looking for an excuse to deal with you for his own protection. After all, once you continued to grow, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal would also become restless.]
[With his intentions exposed, the expression on the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s face grew even darker. He dispensed with any further talk and attacked you directly.]
[It has to be said that the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal with a Perfect Time and Space Tao Body was truly much more powerful than the Dark Psuedo Immortals you previously encountered. Even if you used all your means and Immortal Skills, you were still no match for him.]
[Of course, this was based on the premise that you had not triggered a tenfold critical strike. If you had, you felt confident in injuring him. But to kill him, there was still a long way to go.]
[Without hesitation, you activated the effect of your Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. In an instant, your power soared at a terrifying rate, reaching the quasi-Fairy Tier in a short time.]
[This scene shocked the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, and even you were startled. You never expected the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance to be so powerful, directly raising your cultivation to the quasi-Fairy Tier.]
[Initially, you thought that the effect of Moment of Elegance would only elevate your power to a level beyond an Emperor, but still far from quasi-Fairy. Now, however, it directly elevated you to the quasi-Fairy Tier.]
[This time, you finally understood the value of the Seven-Colored Talent. You also determined that this Seven-Colored Talent should be the ceiling of the Seven-Colored Talents.]
[Next, without waiting for the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal to react or intending to waste the duration of the talent effect, you began a frenzied offensive.]
[Facing your frenzy attack, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal no longer appeared as calm as before but was terrified, sensing the danger to his life. After all, when you were at the Perfect Emperor Stage, you already possessed Immortal-level combat power. Now that your cultivation had directly risen to the quasi-Fairy Tier, your combat power had increased in an abnormal way, representing a qualitative change.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1058 - 1058 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1058: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Achievement Chaos Body! _4 Chapter 1058: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Achievement Chaos Body! _4 [For this reason, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal is not even a match for you, and is defeated by you in a short period of time. Although he recovers quickly, his strength weakens with each recovery.]
[In other words, he could fall completely at any moment. This makes him even more terrified. He cannot understand what kind of secret skill could allow your cultivation to soar so much.]
[However, he also realizes that this is not the time to think about all this, he must escape immediately, otherwise, he will undoubtedly die.]
[As for the idea of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal trying to escape, you naturally notice it. For this reason, you coldly smirk, not playing around anymore. In your previous attacks, you were just testing your skills, not using the critical strike effect of Golden Talent: Multiplay or Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade, let alone the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill.]
[For this reason, you no longer hold back this time, directly activating the talent effect and using the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill.]
[However, to your surprise, the multi-performance effect was not triggered this time, and even the Explosion Blade effect was only triggered twice.]
[This makes you frown, realizing that at this level, Golden Talent: Multiplay has been completely phased out, and as for Explosion Blade, although it can still be used at the quasi-Fairy Tier, it seems to start losing its power.]
[However, at your level, a double critical strike is terrifying enough. As your full-strength Immortal Skill is unleashed, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal is extremely terrified, trying to escape and defend, but all to no avail, as he is easily killed by you.]
[Thus, an incredibly powerful Dark Psuedo Immortal has fallen into your hands. With the fall of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, the Devouring Immortal Bead is excited and begins to crazily devour the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[At this point, you hurriedly stopped it, preventing it from directly swallowing the Time-Space Source of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[However, the Devouring Immortal Bead is somewhat aggrieved but still did not swallow the Time-Space Source. Instead, it devoured the shattered body of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, saying that after refining it, maybe some Time-Space Source can be squeezed out.]
[Upon hearing this, you are quite surprised, and then think about the fact that the Time-Space Body can also refine the Time-Space Source, feeling that the Devouring Immortal Bead is indeed useful and can really help you with a lot of things.]
[At this moment, your body trembles, feeling your life rapidly slipping away, about to die. You know that this is the side effect of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty.]
[For this reason, you try to use Purple Talent·Death puppet to transfer the damage, but unfortunately, Purple Talent·Death Replacement also seems to have exceeded its capability limit, which makes you quite helpless.]
[In the end, you are still going to die. However, just before you die, you quickly leave the Source of Darkness to prevent being sniped when you resurrect with the countdown.]
[After you leave, there are three Dark Psuedo Immortal presences appearing in the depths of the Source of Darkness. They are no weaker than the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, watching the direction you left, their eyes flickering, showing some fear. They never expected that you actually had hidden cards. Your combat power displayed just now was simply too terrifying.]
[Although it is obviously a trump card with huge side effects, it is still true that your cultivation has reached the quasi-Fairy Tier and quickly killed the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal. Faced with the likes of you, even if they take action, they would probably only meet death.]
[For this reason, even though you seem to have weakened, they dare not chase after you, only allowing you to leave, fearing that they will fall into your trap.]
[In the end, the three Dark Psuedo Immortals look at each other, sighing. There are only fourteen Dark Psuedo Immortals in the world’s Source of Darkness. Previously, one was killed by you, nine were killed by Leng Yue, and now one more was killed by you; only the remaining three old fellows are left.]
[They are very clear that if they continue to stay in the Source of Darkness, their lives will not be guaranteed once you grow stronger. Therefore, the three of them made a decision to break through the World Barrier and go to other worlds to avoid destruction. They couldn’t stay here for even a second more.]
[You don’t know that the only three remaining Dark Psuedo Immortals in the Source of Darkness are already preparing to flee. Now, you have arrived in a hidden location. When you arrive, the side effects hit you, and you die.]
[Because the way you died has exceeded the limit of the Rebirth tally’s resurrection, you could not resurrect and died completely.]
[Due to your death, this simulation is over.]
…
With the text simulation stopping here, Wang Ping’s figure also appears, his face speechless.
“Well, after the cultivation and combat power has been improved, various talent items can’t be used anymore, it’s really helpless. However, the failure of the Rebirth tally this time should be due to the death being too strong, it seems that the side effect of this Seven-Colored Talent is even greater than I imagined.”
Wang Ping complained.
However, he could understand.
After all, Talent Skills always have their corresponding limitations.
As for the Rebirth tally, being useful up to the Emperor Tier is already quite amazing. After all, it was initially created with 100,000 Group Points.
Being able to use a resurrection item that was created with 100,000 Group Points up until now, is already quite an incredible thing. Wang Ping feels that Alpha has given him benefits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1059 - 1059 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1059: Chapter 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! _5 Chapter 1059: Chapter 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! _5 Just as Wang Ping was feeling emotional, his consciousness flickered and his vision changed, returning him to the real world.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
1. Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty.
2. Golden Talent·Mad Clothing Blast.
3. A random Quasi-Emperor Artifact.
4. Random Treasure Elixir.”
….
“System, I choose 1. Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty.”
Wang Ping looked at the list of rewards, shook his head slightly, and made his choice directly.
As Wang Ping made his choice, the usage method of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty also appeared in his mind.
“This talent is strong, but the side effect is really huge. The Rebirth tally can’t even revive me. It seems that unless I refresh a seven-colored revival talent, I can’t use it casually.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he muttered to himself.
“Alpha, how many Group points do I need to strengthen the Rebirth tally so that I can revive?”
Wang Ping thought for a moment, feeling that it would be better to rely on Alpha to create a new Rebirth tally than to expect himself to refresh a seven-color revival talent.
“In Myriad Heavens Paradise, talents and abilities have corresponding levels. The previous Rebirth tally was indeed secretly strengthened by me, otherwise it would have been invalid long ago.”
Alpha’s voice sounded, confirming Wang Ping’s guess.
“Uh, so how many Group points do I need to strengthen it now to restore its effect so that it can revive me after I use the Seven-Colored Talent?”
Wang Ping was stunned for a moment, then asked with a smile.
“Fifty billion Group points.”
Alpha’s voice sounded again.
“Wait, how much did you just say?”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, thinking he might have experienced auditory hallucinations.
“I said fifty billion Group points.”
Alpha’s voice sounded again.
“I bid you farewell, sorry for the disturbance.”
Wang Ping’s face twitched again, and he said silently.
After his previous krypton gold spending spree, Wang had become completely broke.
Nowadays, even Lin Yuanyuan, the crazy task doer, was richer than him. It was impossible for him to come up with fifty billion Group points.
“Next, let’s continue the simulation. This time, first try to collect information on the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits, and then take action against the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, and after calming his mind, he planned to continue the simulation.
“System, I want to perform a Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming two hundred billion catties of top-tier divine sources, Life Simulator starting, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, host successfully refreshed the Red Talent·Drunken Fist.”
Red Talent·Drunken Fist: After the host gets drunk, their combat power will increase slightly and perform Drunken Fist.
“What’s the use of this broken talent?”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talent and couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
However, he had no choice but to accept it.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
Then, the system’s voice rang out again, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered and he entered the state of immersive simulation.
Suddenly, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text appeared.
[Day One, you didn’t collect Emperor Flame and kill the Burning Emperor like in the previous simulation. Instead, you visited Immortal Mansion directly.]
[In response to your arrival, Immortal Mansion was greatly shocked and dared not to not receive you, treating you very politely. In fact, they had a Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion come out and personally talk with you in order to entertain you.]
[In response, you stated your purpose, hoping that the Immortal Palace Divine Calculator would help you observe the Heavenly Secrets and see the locations of the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits.]
[Upon hearing this, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion was quite surprised and chose to sell you this favor, allowing the Divine Calculator to perform Heavenly Secret calculations. However, this involved the affairs of the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits, and the calculation of Heavenly Secrets was not an easy task. As a result, you and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion joined forces to help with the calculations.]
[Eventually, after the Heavenly Secrets calculation, you finally learned the whereabouts of the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits. It has to be said that the Nine Great Heavenly Dao Spirits are quite miserable. Except for two still being free, the rest, like the Innate Emperor Flame, were sealed. Among them, the Ku family alone suppressed four Heavenly Dao Spirits.]
[However, the Ku family did not imprison and refine them like the Burning Emperor, but simply captured and trapped them in the family. Therefore, they did not suffer from the Heavenly Curse. Of course, by the time they reached the realm of Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, they might have been able to deal with the current Heavenly Curse.]
[Next, after thanking the Divine Calculator and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion, you began to collect the Heavenly Dao Spirits scattered in the outer world. After the Heavenly Dao Spirits in the outer world were all collected, you went to the Ku family.]
[Your sudden visit also greatly surprised the Ku family. As a result, the Ku family also chose to receive you in the same manner as the Immortal Mansion, with their Quasi-Immortal showing grave courtesy and friendliness towards you.]
[After a pleasant conversation, you directly stated your intention, hoping that the Ku family could hand over the four Heavenly Dao Spirits to you, and you would provide satisfactory compensation.]
[On hearing this, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal was quite surprised, not expecting you to come for the four Heavenly Dao Spirits. As a result, he had many thoughts in his mind, but he still smiled and agreed to hand over the Heavenly Dao Spirits to you, but he had a condition – if the Ku family did not provoke you in the future, he hoped that you would not eliminate their lineage.]
[For this transaction condition, you naturally agreed and chose to promise. With that, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal was very happy and handed over the four Heavenly Dao Spirits to you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 1060 276 The Eighth Seven-Color Talent Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1060: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! _6 Chapter 1060: Chapter 276: The Eighth Seven-Color Talent! Great Chaos Body! _6 [At this point, you have easily and happily collected the nine Heavenly Tao Life Spirits. Now, you only lack the origin of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[After much thought, you expressed your desire to make another deal with the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, hoping that he would help you kill the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal and seize his origin.]
[Upon hearing your words, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal’s expression subtly changed, tactfully refusing you while reminding you that the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal is extremely powerful, and even if he and you joined forces, it would be impossible to defeat him. Unless, you also breakthrough to the Quasi-Immortal realm or complete the Chaotic Body, only then can you surpass him.]
[After saying this, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal tentatively suggested that if you could ask Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion for help, it would be a different story, as even the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal would have to fall when confronted by Master Leng Yue.]
[In response, you chuckled and said that you had your own plans. Then, you stopped mentioning the matter and chose to leave.]
[After you left, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal pondered over the nature of your relationship with Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion. After all, if one wanted to deal with the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, asking Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion for help would undoubtedly be the most appropriate course of action, unless you could not convince Master Leng Yue to help and had to resort to him instead.]
[You didn’t care about the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal’s subsequent thoughts and went alone to the Source of Darkness to begin a massive slaughter, killing the Dark Emperor.]
[This slaughter also attracted the attention of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal and the other three Dark Quasi-Immortals. However, you had no intention of fighting the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal this time, merely warning that if he made a move, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion might intervene.]
[Your threat made the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s expression uncertain. Finally, with a cold snort, he let you go, and you left with ease.]
[After leaving, you calculated the time and realized that Leng Yue should be causing you trouble soon. As a result, you thought about it and decided to use the Seven-color Talent· Running God to escape to a suitable world first. After refining the corpses of the Great Emperors in the Devouring Immortal Bead, you planned to return to this world and make your move against the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[Unfortunately, you miscalculated, and the Seven-color Talent· Running God failed to teleport you to another world, leaving you in this realm.]
[Accepting this, you shook your head and chose to break the World Barrier with your own strength to go to another world. Fortunately, you had some memories of the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal, knowing the coordinates of his world.]
[As a result, you took action, broke the World Barrier, and set off to develop in another world.]
[Regrettably, the disturbance from breaking the World Barrier was too large, and you were detected. Leng Yue once again confronted you, looked at your situation and discovered your intentions.]
[However, this time, he chose not to kill you but let you follow him to the Source of Darkness.]
[As for this, you chose to follow him. After arriving at the Source of Darkness, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion made his move against the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[This change of events startled the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, who claimed that he did not take any action against you before and that your actions were unreasonable. This made you look at him strangely, because you didn’t ask Senior Leng Yue to take action in the first place, and he had done so on his own initiative.]
[At the same time, you were confused as to why Leng Yue’s attitude was different from the free simulation. After all, during that time, Leng Yue had directly killed the simulated Wang Ping after discovering him a year later.]
[As for this, you could only speculate that the plot development was different this time, and Leng Yue decided to help you once because he discovered the nine Heavenly Tao Life Spirits on your body. Or perhaps, he wanted to wait until your growth was complete and then strike, providing a quick death.]
[While you were deep in thought, the other three Dark Quasi-Immortals could no longer sit still upon witnessing the imminent death of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal by Leng Yue’s hands, and took action, one by one, to deal with Leng Yue.]
[However, it must be said that Leng Yue was truly too powerful. Even when facing four formidable Dark Quasi-Immortals at once, he remained in complete control, easily defeating them all.]
[Thus, the four Dark Quasi-Immortals fell to Leng Yue’s hands. It could be said that he single-handedly annihilated the Dark Quasi-Immortals dwelling in the Source of Darkness, except for the one you killed.]
[Next, he entrusted you with the corpse and origin of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, allowing you to devour and assimilate them in an attempt to reach the Great Completion Domain of the Chaotic Body.]
[Naturally, you wouldn’t pass up this opportunity and began to use the Devouring Immortal Bead to assist you in absorbing and refining the nine Great Heavenly Tao Life Spirits along with the Time-Space Origin of the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.]
[Eventually, after almost ten thousand years, you managed to completely absorb and integrate them into your Chaotic Body.]
[At this point, your Chaotic Body reached the Great Completion Domain, filling you with excitement and curiosity about your current battle power.]
[As a result, you turned your gaze to Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion, a Predecessor Transmigrator, and challenged him to a battle to see how strong you had become.]
[In the face of your challenge, Leng Yue did not refuse but coldly stated that if you defeat him, you may live; if you lose, you will die and become his nourishment.]
[Unafraid, you and Leng Yue left the Source of Darkness together to fight in the outer world.]
[It must be said that Leng Yue was simply too powerful. Even though your Chaotic Body had reached the Great Completion Domain and gave you a significant advantage in terms of constitution, you were still no match for him. Fighting against higher-level opponents was not always feasible, depending on the adversary. At this point, defeating the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal would be a breeze for you, but facing Leng Yue, you still fell short. This was because Leng Yue had created the Devouring Immortal Demon Body, becoming stronger using it, and had comprehended the Immortal Sutra. It was even suspected that he had grasped something beyond the Heavenly Tao True Spirit.]
[That is to say, Leng Yue could no longer be considered as a pure Quasi-Immortal. He remained in this world, or rather, in the Upper Realm’s environment because of its limitations. If he were placed in the Immortal Domain, his current state might allow him to become an immortal at any moment.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 1061 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1061: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!) Chapter 1061: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!) “This Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue is seriously too freakish. Even with the Great Chaos Body, my simulated Wang Ping wasn’t his opponent, and that was without him even trying his best. If he went all out, even if they fought within the same realm, whether my simulated Wang Ping could defeat him would be an unknown factor.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and sighed inwardly.
“Are all the still alive Predecessor Transmigrators of the First Generation Chat Group this amazing? If so, that’s really terrifying.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but comment again.
He had to admit that he, as Wang Ping, was just an ordinary person, and it was by cheating that he had gotten to where he was today. In terms of means, he still couldn’t compare to these Predecessor Transmigrators now.
After all, they reached this point on their own, so it was only natural that they would be awe-inspiring.
