Of course, this specifically refers to the still alive First Generation Chat Group’s Predecessor Transmigrators. As for those fallen transmigrators of the first generation, like Wang Ping, they were probably just ordinary people or slightly more outstanding ordinary people.
It’s just that those people didn’t have the Golden Finger, while Wang Ping possessed a very powerful Golden Finger, and that was it.
Although Wang Ping was addicted to cheating, he always believed that he was essentially an ordinary Earthling. If he wasn’t an ordinary person, he wouldn’t have been so miserable back on Earth.
If you really had to say that Wang Ping had any advantages, it might just be that he was a little luckier. If he wasn’t lucky, he wouldn’t have been able to awaken the top-tier Golden Finger of Life Simulator.
As Wang Ping was filled with emotions, the text simulation continued.
[Coldly, Leng Yue fought with you, saying that if you only had this much skill, then you would be a disappointment to him, and today you were destined to die here.]
[Hearing this, your face became serious, and you no longer hid your trump card. You directly used the effect of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. In an instant, your cultivation skyrocketed to the quasi-Fairy Tier, and your combat power surged greatly.]
[As your cultivation improved to the quasi-Fairy Tier, Leng Yue’s eyes sparkled, and he praised you a bit before becoming more serious and engaging in a great battle with you.]
[This time, after raising your cultivation to the quasi-Fairy Tier, you gained the upper hand. At the same level, the advantages of the Great Chaos Body truly showed, coupled with your Seven-Color Talent – Burst Blade providing double critical strike effects, you started to press on Leng Yue.]
[Of course, you were very clear that your current advantage was built upon the foundation of the Great Chaos Body, the Chaos Tao Fruit, and the Seven-Color Talent·Explosion Blade. The Chaos Emperor Sutra and Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture didn’t actually have an advantage against Leng Yue.]
[Because the Immortal Sutras Leng Yue himself had comprehended, although far inferior to the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture, were something he had personally enlightened and could perfectly display his power. Furthermore, you didn’t match well with the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture and hadn’t studied it deeply, so you could only display a very small amount of power. Therefore, both sides were actually similar in terms of the combat power added by their Immortal Sutras.]
[However, even though you had gained the advantage in the collision of power after using your trump card, you didn’t feel the slightest bit of joy, because you found that Leng Yue was simply too agile. Unable to overpower you in terms of strength, he used his terrifying spatial power to completely nullify your attacks.]
[As the saying goes, no matter how strong the power, if it doesn’t hit someone, it is useless. Now, you were experiencing this kind of thing, and the battle process once again became very stifling. Going on like this, with the effects of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance ending, you would unquestionably die. Even if you defeated Leng Yue, death would still be the outcome.]
[However, since you were dead either way, you really wanted to defeat Leng Yue. At the very least, you wanted to force Leng Yue’s real power, not wanting to be killed by him in such a dragging manner.]
[For this reason, you began to use the strategy of goading, mocking Leng Yue if he was afraid of you and didn’t dare to face you in a head-on battle.]
[Regarding your provocation, Leng Yue indifferently stated that your power was far stronger than his, but your combat experience was severely lacking, wasting too much power. Besides, this kind of provocation had no use against other powerful enemies.]
[After saying this, Leng Yue paused for a moment, implying that you should be thankful that your opponent was him so he would show you the true power of the Immortal Domain.]
[Upon hearing this, your eyes sparkled, knowing that the Predecessor Transmigrator Leng Yue was teaching you again, and that he was about to get serious. Of course, you were also aware that he wasn’t teaching you, but rather your true self.]
[Next, Leng Yue directly showed the Dao intent superior to the Heavenly Tao True Spirit – the power of the Immortal Tao. With the extremely cold Immortal Tao power appearing, you were both shocked and delighted. As the saying goes, even if you die this evening after hearing about the Tao in the morning, it’s still worth it. You didn’t know how to proceed after reaching the quasi-Fairy Tier, but now you had experienced it yourself. This would be of great help to Wang Ping’s future cultivation.]
[Even though it’s certain that you would be able to experience the power of the Immortal Tao if you went to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, you couldn’t go there for your quest of achieving the Immortal Domain. Wang Ping’s main body can go, but you can’t.]
[In the end, after feeling the power of the Immortal Tao, you were extremely satisfied and were effortlessly sealed in ice by Leng Yue, instantly falling.]
[Due to your fall, the simulation came to an end…..]

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1062 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1062: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_2 Chapter 1062: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_2 ….
With the termination of Text simulation, many images and insights surged into Wang Ping’s mind, eventually making him appear in the combat scene.
“The power of Immortal Tao is formidable. To defeat Leng Yue, it looks like I will not only have to possess the strength of a quasi-Fairy but I also need to comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao. Otherwise, it’ll be hard to confront him. Besides, I might need to refine the Chaos Emperor Scripture and deduce the Chaotic Immortal Scripture, essentially, I must enhance myself in every aspect.”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he pondered to himself.
Of course, if the Life Simulator could be optimized to spawn more outrageous talents, he wouldn’t need to take so much trouble.
However, optimizing the Life Simulator was also a bumpy road.
Afterwards, Wang Ping, with a shift in consciousness, disengaged himself from the immersive simulation state and returned back to the real world.
“Alpha, is Leng Yue’s space capability also considered a golden finger ability like ours, the Third Generation Transcenders?”
After pondering, Wang Ping finally asked.
“Yes. Every earthling has a chance to awaken their unique talent which varies, from strong to weak.”
Alpha paused for a moment before providing an explanation.
“So you mean, these talents are not bestowed by you, Alpha, but are powers that we inherently possess? You merely expedited the awakening through the World Source. So in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, awakening talents and obtaining the so-called golden finger is not that difficult?”
Wang Ping’s gaze sharpened, speculating the truth behind the talents, which refers to the real truth of the Chat Group’s Golden Finger.
“No, awakening talents, even in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, is not an easy task. There are plenty of regular players in Myriad Heavens Paradise who might never have the chance to awaken their talent in their lifetime.”
Alpha rebuffed Wang Ping’s conjecture.
“I see, this technology, or to say, the resources for awakening, are only possessed by the Myriad Heavens Forces who have achieved a certain level, right.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes while speculating more.
“In that case, it’s a bit strange that all the group members of the Third Generation Chat Group can actually awaken their talents. Alpha, did you just muddle through? For those whom can’t awaken their talents, you randomly used the World Source to create some capabilities for them, hence their so-called golden finger. That’s why most group members’ golden finger abilities are so ordinary.”
“Yes, after all, not everyone can awaken talents. That’s why you’re so special. Your potential talent, even in Myriad Heavens Paradise, is absolutely rare.”
With a cold voice, Alpha affirmed.
“Maybe, that’s why you’ve attracted the attention of ‘that person’.”
Alpha paused, with complex emotions.
She initially thought Wang Ping was someone under her, her future hope. Who would’ve known, Wang Ping was already someone else’s target, and she has become his pawn.
From being her pawn to reaching a level where she was manipulated like a pawn, it must be said, that person was truly monstrous.
Of course, whether this was all covertly controlled by that person is still uncertain but, Alpha felt there was a 70 percent probability that it was him.
“I see. Your explanation makes me feel relieved.”
Wang Ping didn’t care about being at someone else’s mercy, after all, he had already suspected it.
Even from the very beginning when he first traversed time, Wang Ping had resigned to his fate.
He merely transitioned from being Alpha’s pawn to that person’s pawn.
Given the massive difference, should he not resign, how else could he confront it?
To resist, he must first strengthen himself.
Just like that person, from being a pawn to vanquishing Alpha and the First Generation Chat Group, he could also take this path in the future. Even if he couldn’t reach that extent, he could attempt to transform from a pawn into a player.
Whether he could successfully transition or not, would rely on his own luck.
“Speaking of which, why can Golden Fingers be swapped? Would that be considered a secondary awakening?”
Wang Ping remembered the operation of Cai Yonglong and others changing their Golden Fingers, it raised his eyebrows in curiosity, leading him to ask further.
“No, the so-called re-draw of the Golden Finger is just my secret manipulation, a way to earn group points. In reality, not many valuable group members would get a good Golden Finger when they swap. As for Cai Yonglong and the others, I just replaced their original talent, using the stored talents to swap.”
The voice of Alpha echoed again.
“Good grief, you really are ruthless”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
It seems like he underestimated Alpha’s tactics to accumulate group points. Everywhere was full of ‘exploitation’.
“However, can talents also be traded?”
After thinking about the transfer of talents, Wang Ping asked with a frowning expression.
“In the Myriad Heavens Paradise, anything can be traded – power, talent, weapons, even one’s ownership.”
Alpha replied coldly.
“Many people lost power, talent, and tools in Myriad Heavens Paradise. However, the most bemoaned ones are those who lost their ownership. Once someone owns you, you become their slave, you must follow their orders. Not even the big shots in the Myriad Heavens Paradise can alter this contract,”
“Is it that horrific?”
Wang Ping’s eyes twitched.
It looks like the Myriad Heavens Paradise was more fanatical than he had initially imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 1063 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1063: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_3 Chapter 1063: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_3 At the same time, the rules were extremely terrifying. Once the ownership was lost, those big shots would not be able to forcibly break the contract.
Of course, that being said, those big shots wouldn’t need to forcibly break the contract to obtain someone’s ownership from a weakling.
“Myriad Heavens Paradise is even crazier than you can imagine, but it indeed possesses unimaginable opportunities. The weak can sharpen their wisdom and achieve prominence through wisdom.”
Alpha once again emphasized the importance of wisdom.
“Wisdom, huh…”
Wang Ping found it somewhat headache-inducing.
Although he was a little clever, it was just limited to that. His past growth was basically dependent on cheating. In terms of wisdom, he could never outsmart those old monsters.
It seemed that he would have to rely on the Life Simulator after all.
In the end, Wang Ping felt that the reason why he was favored by the first generation was probably because his talent was quite special.
His talent, the Life Simulator, might still possess many untapped potentials.
Once he went to the Myriad Heavens Paradise and optimized his skills, everything would become apparent.
“Since talents can be exchanged, why didn’t you take away my talent? Or do I have to agree to an exchange or obtain a golden finger again for you to take it away?”
Wang Ping thought of this and asked Alpha.
“Yes.” Alpha did not hide anything and nodded honestly. “In addition, there are no particularly clever individuals in the Third Generation Chat Group. It would be better to cultivate you, the original owner of this talent.”
“You’re really honest. This pitfall is really huge.”
Wang Ping was speechless, finally realizing how difficult it was for him to grow up smoothly and live until now.
He was watched both by Alpha and the person from the First Generation Chat Group, which was quite frustrating.
Of course, without the ability to resist, the weak could only silently bear it all.
Just like Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator, he did not hate Alpha, nor did he hate the chat group. It was because of Alpha’s existence that he could live an extraordinary life, instead of slowly rotting away and turning into dust on Earth.
Just as Wang Ping was lost in his mixed emotions, the system’s voice finally rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. Host can choose one of the following rewards:
①.Great Chaos Body
②.Random Quasi-Emperor Artifact
④.Random Emperor-tier Artifact.”
…..
“Huh, even the Great Chaos Body has been refreshed this time? By rights, the breakthrough condition for the Great Chaos Body should not be refreshable by the current Life Simulator.”
Wang Ping was quite surprised at the rewards that had appeared this time.
However, he quickly came back to his senses, remembering the Devouring Immortal Bead incident.
The Devouring Immortal Bead reward was a huge pitfall that had trapped him once.
It was possible that something similar would happen with this Great Chaos Body.
If he were to choose it, a change would occur in reality, collapsing time and reversing cause and effect, allowing him to obtain the Great Chaos Body.
At that time, perhaps all nine Heavenly Tao Living Beings would be transferred and absorbed by him.
And then, a huge mess would be created.
He just didn’t know if the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal would die or not.
Wang Ping had various speculations and some concerns in his heart.
However, Wang Ping thought to himself, who cares.
If he didn’t choose this Great Chaos Body, what was the difference between him and a fool.
Anyway, there were already a few people in this world who could be his opponents.
Not to mention, Leng Yue, the Predecessor Transmigrator, was also his Dao Protector in the real world. Why should he be afraid?
“System, I choose ①. Great Chaos Body.”
Wang Ping said silently in his heart.
Upon making his choice, Wang Ping found that he had not received the Great Chaos Body.
This made him narrow his eyes, feeling that his guess might be about to come true.
Sure enough, the innate Emperor Flame on Purgatory Ancient Star quickly underwent a change, just like in the life simulation. The seal was rapidly disintegrating, and the Emperor Flame was transferring towards Wang Ping.
Not only the Emperor Flame, but other Heavenly Tao Living Beings were doing the same.
All the sealed Heavenly Tao Living Beings of the Gu Family suddenly disappeared uncontrollably, flying towards Wang Ping.
This made the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal extremely shocked and wanted to stop it but was unable to. In the end, they could only follow behind.
Finally, these nine Heavenly Tao Living Beings all appeared in front of Wang Ping, entering his body one by one and being absorbed by him.
Then, Wang Ping obtained the Great Chaos Body, and terrifying chaotic phenomena began to emerge in this world.
“It seems that there is still a process to go through. Perhaps because the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal is beyond the scope of the Life Simulator, I’ll have to kill him myself to complete this cause and effect, then I can truly obtain the Great Chaos Body. The current Life Simulator has already begun to influence the real world in various ways.”
Wang Ping felt the imbalance within his Great Chaos Body and lamented.
At this moment, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal also arrived here, looking at Wang Ping in amazement.
“Fellow Taoist, it’s not my fault that your Heavenly Tao Living Beings flew towards me on their own.”
Wang Ping looked at the astonished expression on the Quasi-Immortal’s face and joked with a smile.
“Hehe, Fellow Taoist, what are you talking about? Since the Heavenly Tao Living Beings are destined to be with you, our Gu Family will naturally not say anything. It can even be considered a blessing to witness the birth of the Great Chaos Body.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1064: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_4
Chapter 1064: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_4
The Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal smiled warmly and let out a hearty laugh, speaking generously.
“I, Gu, would like to congratulate fellow taoist on your successful breakthrough and achieving the Great Completion Domain in your Chaotic Body.”
“Hehe, fellow taoist, you’re too polite. Since you’re so courteous, even if there is an Immortal Fate chance in the future, I won’t attack the Ku family casually.”
Wang Ping laughed as he looked at the tactful Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family, openly speaking.
“With fellow taoist’s words, I am truly reassured. Rest assured, my Ku family will not participate in the fight for Immortal Fate. If we are lucky enough to obtain it, we will offer it to you with both hands.”
The Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family spoke with a serious expression.
“Hehe, there’s no need for that. Immortal Fate is for the capable ones. Fellow taoist, your words make it seem like I’m bullying you.”
Wang Ping, of course, would not believe the empty promises of this old fox-like Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family, and he teased.
“Ahem, fellow taoist, I have some matters to attend to, so I’ll take my leave. Whenever you have time, you’re welcome to visit my Ku family as a guest. At that time, I will personally receive you and serve you with our treasured Immortal Tea.”
The Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family realized that continuing the conversation would only backfire, so he found an excuse to leave without any intention.
“Since fellow taoist has matters to attend to, you may go ahead and get busy.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Upon hearing this, the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal bowed slightly and hurriedly tore through space, leaving this place, fearing that Wang Ping might take action to detain him.
However, his concerns were quite normal.
After all, who doesn’t know that Wang Ping holds the Devouring Immortal Bead in his hand?
If Wang Ping wanted to break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier, killing the other quasi-Immortals in this world, and then using the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead to refine them would be the fastest way to break through the quasi-Fairy Tier.
Because of this, being alone with Wang Ping in a secret realm made the Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family feel very insecure.
“I, Wang Ping, have never been one to kill innocent people. Although you have attacked me in the life simulation, your crimes are not punishable by death.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, talking to himself about the concerns of the Quasi-Immortal of the Ku family.
Then, Wang Ping moved his figure and stepped onto the Starry Sky, heading towards the Source of Darkness.
Today, he was going to the Source of Darkness, kill the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, end the karma, and truly obtain the Great Chaos Body.
At this moment, due to the anomaly of Wang Ping’s Great Chaos Body, the Upper Realm was shaken once again, all Emperors were shocked, and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion was also incredibly amazed. Yet, they did not pursue like the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal due to the existence of Heavenly Tao Life.
Soon, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and a few powerful Great Emperors discovered Wang Ping’s figure heading towards the Source of Darkness. They were all very surprised, wondering why Wang Ping would head to the Source of Darkness after creating such a huge anomaly.
Apart from that, their moods were quite strange.
After all, how many years had it been since the Upper Realm had been quiet? In such a short period of time, one incident followed another, and many Great Emperors and Quasi-Immortals have fallen.
All of this started with Wang Ping’s rise.
It could only be said that Wang Ping was truly a troublemaker.
Of course, they could only mutter these feelings in their hearts. If they were to offend Wang Ping by saying them out loud, they would not dare to, even the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion would not dare to.
Helplessly, Wang Ping was someone even Quasi-Immortals could not afford to offend.
Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to the gaze of the strong Upper Realm beings, and he entered the Source of Darkness by himself.
After Wang Ping entered the Source of Darkness, all the Dark Emperors appeared like mice seeing a cat, fleeing in panic.
As for this, Wang Ping wasn’t interested in killing them all now. Dealing with the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal was the most important thing at the moment.
“But before that, there is one more thing I need to confirm.”
Wang Ping took another step forward, heading directly to the place where the Burning Emperor was hiding.
He wanted to see if the Burning Emperor had died because of the life simulator’s influence.
“Not dead?”
Soon, Wang Ping got the answer and showed a thoughtful expression.
It seemed that the Burning Emperor had no direct connection with the reward option, so he was fine.
Otherwise, with the life simulator’s ability, even if it couldn’t do anything to a Quasi-Immortal, it could still kill a Great Emperor.
“Senior, may I know why you are looking for me?”
Seeing Wang Ping find him and not say a word, only showing a thoughtful expression, the Burning Emperor’s face was solemn and he asked very cautiously.
“Hehe.”
Seeing the Burning Emperor’s appearance, Wang Ping found it very amusing.
In the previous life simulation, the Burning Emperor was extremely arrogant, not giving the Immortal Mansion any face, and chose to test the Immortal Mansion.
Although, in the end, he was almost killed by the Immortal Mansion and ended up in a miserable state, at least he took action.
Now, he was so humble in front of Wang Ping.
It could only be said that the Burning Emperor in the life simulation was also short-sighted, not knowing that there was a Quasi-Immortal in the Immortal Mansion.
It should be said that whether it was the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion or the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, or the ten Dark Quasi-Immortals in the Source of Darkness, their existence was very secretive, hidden in the dark. Apart from a few people, other Great Emperors were not really aware of them.
So, in their minds, Emperor Monarch was the strongest, which was why the Burning Emperor dared to be so bold.
“Burning Emperor, you and I can be considered fated after all.”
Next, Wang Ping’s mouth curved up slightly as he suddenly used the Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture.
This made the Burning Emperor quite surprised.
Soon, he let out a slight sigh of relief.
It seemed that Wang Ping had also practiced his Burning Emperor Incinerating Scripture during his growth process. In that case, they were indeed fated, and Wang Ping shouldn’t make things too difficult for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1065: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_5
Chapter 1065: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_5
“It’s a pity that I have a good relationship with your descendants, and they have been cursed because of you. Only when you die can they live.”
Wang Ping said this again.
Although with his current ability, it is easy to suppress the curse, he still prefers to kill people. It’s relaxed and enjoyable.
“!!!”
Wang Ping’s words made the Burning Emperor’s pupils suddenly contract, and a chill rushed from the soles of his feet to the top of his head.
“Predecessor, I know a secret to become immortal, please don’t kill me!”
Immediately, the Burning Emperor instinctively said this.
This caused Wang Ping to raise his eyebrows slightly.
In the life simulation, the Burning Emperor never said this.
However, it’s no wonder, after all, Wang Ping in the life simulation directly killed the Burning Emperor after seeing him, without any intention of talking with him.
Now, after some idle talk, he got a piece of information, which was an unexpected joy.
Otherwise, without this talk, even if he killed the Burning Emperor, he would not deliberately read his memory.
After all, there are too many Dark Emperors and Quasi-Fairies he needs to kill, and the vast memory would affect him if he takes them all in, even without the influence of the soul imprint.
“Killing you, I can still get the secret. So, you still have to die.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently, and with a casual blow, he exploded the Burning Emperor, causing him to fall completely.
Then Wang Ping used the Devouring Immortal Bead to devour, refine, and read the Burning Emperor’s memory after screening.
“So that’s it. The so-called secret is related to the Elemental Forbidden Land? No wonder the Burning Emperor moved some of his clan to the Elemental Star after rising.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, looking rather surprised.
By chance, the Burning Emperor obtained a peculiar stone tablet, which recorded some information about the Elemental Forbidden Land.
The Elemental Forbidden Land seals an ‘Immortal’. This ‘Immortal’ is not an ordinary immortal, but a Demon Immortal. In the distant past, he committed a heinous crime that angered an even more powerful immortal who dismembered and sealed him. As time went on, this sealing place became a forbidden land due to the resentment of this ‘Immortal’.
The so-called opportunity for becoming immortal is completely fabricated by the Burning Emperor.
In the Burning Emperor’s view, since the Elemental Forbidden Land seals an immortal, if he can get its secret and find the body of the immortal from it, he may be able to become an immortal by refining it.
As for the issue of whether it can be refined or not, the Burning Emperor believed that this immortal had been sealed for so many years and must be weak by now, and after waiting for millions of years, he might be able to start.
“Too wild a fancy.”
For the Burning Emperor’s thoughts, Wang Ping could only give this evaluation.
According to the Burning Emperor’s memory, Wang Ping found the aura on that stone tablet to be familiar. Wasn’t it the Celestial Spirit Immortal King’s aura?
Well now, an immortal that requires the Immortal King to personally seal it must be at least a Profound Immortal, right?
A Profound Immortal, even sealed and after so many years, is not something a mere Top Emperor can provoke.
In addition, in the previous life simulation, when Leng Yue, the predecessor transmigrator, refined the Upper Realm, she couldn’t do anything about the Elemental Forbidden Land and chose to avoid it deliberately.
This means that the Refinement Array wouldn’t work either.
They can’t provoke this thing.
Comparing this way, it’s even more obvious how naive the Burning Emperor was.
Of course, the Burning Emperor didn’t know how terrifying this immortal was, so perhaps it’s quite normal for him to think this way.
“It seems that to enter and exit the Elemental Forbidden Land safely, at least one needs to have the strength of Leng Yue. To unlock the secret of the Elemental Forbidden Land and release or refine that immortal, one needs at least the cultivation of a True Immortal.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he analyzed secretly.
In the previous simulation, he had fallen into the Elemental Forbidden Land, and Leng Yue had chosen to enter to attack him, which showed that Leng Yue could calmly leave.
He just didn’t know whether Leng Yue had the confidence to do so based on her own strength or relying on her awakened space-type talent.
“Forget it, there’s no need to care. Now that my strength is not enough, trying to explore the secrets of the Elemental Forbidden Land and the secrets of that Profound Immortal would be a path to self-destruction.”
Wang Ping shook his head and threw all his miscellaneous thoughts out of his mind.
Then Wang Ping continued to go deeper into the Source of Darkness.
It was only when Wang Ping left and went deeper into the Source of Darkness that the Dark Emperors, who were watching, let out a sigh of relief, feeling that the evil star Wang Ping had finally left.
At the same time, they also mourned for the unfortunate Burning Emperor for a moment.
Not long after, Wang Ping arrived at a deeper part of the Source of Darkness in this world and found the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.
“Fellow Taoist, what is the purpose of your visit?”
Wang Ping’s appearance made the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s expression quite serious as he asked in a deep voice.
“The purpose of my visit is to borrow your life for a use.”
Wang Ping’s clothes fluttered as he spoke casually.
“Fellow Taoist, we should have no grievances or grudges between us. Your actions this time are too reckless.”
The Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s expression instantly turned gloomy and he reprimanded.
“You don’t die, I can’t achieve my goal, so you have to die. It’s a very simple truth.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“Not to mention, you are a Dark Psuedo Immortal who has done too many outrageous things and has already earned your way to death. Killing you is acting on behalf of heaven.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - 277 The Secret of the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1066: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_6
Chapter 1066: Chapter 277: The Secret of the Golden Finger! (Requesting Monthly Tickets!)_6
“Hahaha, what a great act of standing in for heaven, at our level, there’s no need to worry about the Heavenly Tao.”
The Time-Space Quasi-Immortal laughed loudly, mocking Wang Ping.
“Since fellow taoist wants to take my life, there’s no need to find such an excuse. Let’s see who is stronger. Don’t think that just because Leng Yue is protecting you, I won’t dare to kill you. If I kill you, I have the power to break the Upper Realm Barrier and flee to other Upper Realms. Even Leng Yue can’t stop me.”
Pausing for a moment, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal spoke coldly.
“You’re afraid of Senior Leng Yue, but aren’t you afraid of me?”
Wang Ping mocked.
“Hmph, arrogant junior, even with some strength, how can you handle me if you can only kill ordinary Quasi-Immortals?”
The Time-Space Quasi-Immortal snorted coldly, no longer wasting words, and directly unleashed his terrifying Quasi-Immortal pressure. Time-Space Divine Skill intertwined in his palm, stirring up a storm of wind and clouds.
This area began to tremble, attracting the attention of many Dark Emperors, all with trembling hearts and jumping nerves.
They never expected that after ten Dark Quasi-Immortals died in the Source of Darkness, there was still a hidden Dark Quasi-Immortal, and this one was obviously stronger than the previous ten fallen Dark Quasi-Immortals.
At the same time, they never expected that Wang Ping came here for the Dark Quasi-Immortal.
For a moment, all the Dark Emperors were filled with fear and excitement.
After all, witnessing such a high-level battle again was greatly beneficial to them.
“Do you think you can handle me? I only need one punch to kill you!”
At this moment, Wang Ping ignored the spying gazes of the many Dark Emperors and the three Dark Quasi-Immortals, taking a step forward. The Great Chaos Body was revealed, and the terrifying phenomena actually made this area shine brightly.
“Arrogant!”
Wang Ping’s words infuriated the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal to the extreme, and he directly used his terrifying Time-Space Divine Skill.
In an instant, this area twisted and warped; time and space were distorted and broken like a mirror, chaotic and disordered, transforming into a forbidden place that devoured people, intending to strangle Wang Ping.
“Chaos Emperor Fist!”
Facing this terrifying Divine Skill, Wang Ping’s eyes shone with a sharp light, and he was incomparably domineering as he punched out.
In that instant, boundless chaos energy erupted, forming an invincible Emperor Fist that directly rushed towards the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.
At the same time, the effect of Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade exploded, causing the power of Wang Ping’s punch to instantly double.
As a result, Wang Ping’s punch blasted apart the terrifying Time-Space Divine Skill and numerous Dark Auras.
Then, the momentum of the Chaos Emperor Fist didn’t diminish as it continued to smash towards the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal.
This made the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s pupils contract violently, as he tried to escape with the help of the Time-Space Divine Skill.
However, Wang Ping revealed a mocking expression.
The Chaos Emperor Fist also contained the Time-Space Tao, which could interfere with time and space, but its primary explosive form was simply a terrifying power.
As a result, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal couldn’t escape.
“I’m finished!”
When the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal discovered that he couldn’t escape, he revealed a desperate look and was directly shattered by the Chaos Emperor Fist, falling completely.
Wang Ping’s punch had already exceeded his limit for recovery.
Seeing this scene, all the Great Emperors were shocked. They never expected Wang Ping to become even stronger, killing a Dark Quasi-Immortal even more powerful than the Immortal Lord with a single punch.
At this time, the three Dark Quasi-Immortals that hid in the shadows had simultaneously chosen to attack Wang Ping.
In their view, since Wang Ping had spoken of his great path and had the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal go to his death, his goal was very clear – he had come to slaughter them.
After slaughtering them, using the Devouring Immortal Bead Refining to become enlightened and break through the Quasi-Immortal realm.
Since that was the case, they had no way out and had to fight Wang Ping to the death.
Even more, they were somewhat regretful that they hadn’t worked together with the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal to deal with Wang Ping earlier, and had wanted to use him to sound out Wang Ping’s details.
However, Wang Ping had managed to kill the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal with a single punch, leaving them without a top-tier combatant on their side.
Nevertheless, they were still confident in dealing with Wang Ping. After all, they had figured out some of Wang Ping’s background. He had killed the Immortal Lord by using his trump card to unleash such a powerful force, but that force couldn’t be used continuously.
To them, Wang Ping’s punch just now was a manifestation of his trump card.
Therefore, this was an excellent opportunity to take advantage of Wang Ping.
“Hmph, three against one, huh? Since you want to die early, I’ll grant your wish.”
Facing the sneak attack of the three Dark Quasi-Immortals, who were only slightly weaker than the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal, Wang Ping remained indifferent and unmoved, directly casting the Immortal Skill from the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture.
Although it was hastily cast for defense, it was still powerful enough to help Wang Ping block the attacks of the three Dark Quasi-Immortals.
The only price was that Wang Ping was sent flying, coughing up blood. That was all.
“Hehe, you really don’t have any trump cards left. In that case, this Sovereign wants to see who will die here.”
“Don’t count on Leng Yue to save you. In the battle within the Source of Darkness, even Leng Yue won’t be able to detect it.”
“Arrogant junior, die!”
The three Dark Quasi-Immortals roared simultaneously, continuing to attack Wang Ping.
“Hehe, to kill you, this Sovereign needs no one else to save me.”
Wang Ping sneered coldly.
Then, Wang Ping swung another punch.
This punch was also the Chaos Emperor Fist.
As the Chaos Emperor Fist came out, its power was not reduced in the slightest, causing the three Dark Quasi-Immortals to show a look of fear. They hadn’t expected this outcome.
However, the three were still Dark Quasi-Immortals after all, with extremely fast combat experience and reaction speed. They acted together to resist Wang Ping’s Chaos Emperor Fist.
It must be said that the three of them working together were indeed much stronger than one-on-one, and they actually managed to block Wang Ping’s punch.
However, they still paid the price of their bodies exploding, coughing up blood, and suffering injuries for it.
This result left their faces very ugly.
After all, it was hard to accept the fact that they, three against one, were nearly killed in return, especially considering that Wang Ping was simply a Great Emperor and they were Quasi-Immortals.
“All emperors, heed my command, form a formation and slaughter the Chaos Emperor! If the Chaos Emperor slaughters us three, you will all have to die. Even if the Chaos Emperor doesn’t kill you, the two old undying from the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family will take action against you once we are dead.”
In an instant, one of the Dark Quasi-Immortals roared angrily with a furious face.
When a Quasi-Immortal roared in anger, it was truly terrifying. It directly spread throughout the realm’s Source of Darkness, shaking the hearts of all the emperors.

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - 278 The Special System of the Heavenly
chapters.content:
Chapter 1067: Chapter 278: The Special System of the Heavenly Paradise! Astonishing News!
Chapter 1067: Chapter 278: The Special System of the Heavenly Paradise! Astonishing News!
The expressions of the numerous Dark Emperors kept changing.
If possible, they really didn’t want to get involved in this terrifying battle and offend Wang Ping.
However, what this Dark Psuedo Immortal said made sense. They were Dark Emperors, destined to be the enemies of ordinary cultivators. If these Dark Psuedo Immortals were to die, there would be no good days ahead for them, and external cultivators would be able to attack them freely.
That is based on the premise that Wang Ping and the others will not make a move against them first.
If they waited for Wang Ping to kill these three Dark Psuedo Immortals, they might also be eliminated by Wang Ping, becoming fodder for his growth.
As a result, after a short period of hesitation, these Dark Emperors finally chose to help.
“You want to use the power of the Dark Emperors to form an array against me? How naive.”
Wang Ping sneered.
As soon as his words fell, Wang Ping directly used the Immortal Skill of the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture.
The Immortal King Illusion appeared, waving its hand, and endless Immortal Light emerged, beautiful yet dangerous, overwhelming the sky and killing the Dark Emperors.
However, because his attack was too fast and too scattered, Wang Ping’s attacks couldn’t kill the Dark Emperors.
Of course, this also puzzled the three Dark Psuedo Immortals, as they couldn’t understand why Wang Ping would use such a meaningless tactic.
Not only the Dark Psuedo Immortals, but the numerous Dark Emperors were also equally puzzled.
However, they soon understood the reason for Wang Ping’s actions. As countless Immortal Lights fell like raindrops, striking the various Dark Emperors, they were instantly injured.
Although these injuries could be quickly recovered from and were considered insignificant, the high frequency of these attacks kept them in a state of constant injury.
As a result, the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack was triggered under this extremely high-frequency stacking of damage.
The numerous Dark Emperors died one after another, killed inexplicably.
This scene made the three Dark Psuedo Immortals pale, and their hearts felt cold.
In addition, a few Dark Emperors who were lucky enough not to encounter the Instant Death Attack were also terrified to the extreme.
Those who had come this far were not fools. They all guessed the truth of Wang Ping’s attack just now.
It seemed that Wang Ping had some sort of bizarre ability that triggered an instant death effect as long as he could inflict damage.
That is to say, they couldn’t allow themselves to be injured by Wang Ping. If they were attacked by Wang Ping at a high frequency, they might die instantly, inexplicably, and be absolutely frustrated.
This ability was just too dangerous!
Anyone who fought with Wang Ping had to avoid being injured. To not be injured, one must have far greater strength than Wang Ping. How could they not be injured otherwise?
Not to mention that their strength was significantly weaker than Wang Ping’s.
“Run!”
The few surviving Dark Emperors had this idea in their hearts and chose to flee without hesitation, losing the courage to continue fighting.
It should be said that now that there are only a few of them left, participating in the battle has become meaningless.
“Pfft!”
However, before they could get far, the Immortal Light appeared once more.
This time, the attack was not like the previous light, weak attacks, but a true deadly blow.
As a result, those fleeing Dark Emperors were instantly killed on the spot and completely perished.
At the same time, the three Dark Psuedo Immortals also took action while Wang Ping was killing the Dark Emperors.
This time, they didn’t take advantage of Wang Ping’s attack to sneak up on him, but rather chose to escape in three different directions without hesitation, disappearing cleanly.
“Want to run? Can you escape?”
Wang Ping scoffed, punching out.
In an instant, the Chaos Emperor Fist reappeared in the world, directly killing a Dark Psuedo Immortal on the spot.
At the same time, the Immortal King Illusionce again brewed an attack, and a nimble white dragon appeared, instantly chasing and devouring another Dark Psuedo Immortal.
As for the third Dark Psuedo Immortal, they had some means of escape and had completely disappeared without a trace, thoroughly blending into the darkness.
However, this did not trouble Wang Ping, as the Immortal King Cultivation Scripture also contained an Immortal Skill for tracking enemies.
As a result, when Wang Ping used the tracking Immortal Skill, the eyes of the Immortal King Illusion radiated the light of the Immortal Light, directly illuminating the darkness and forcing the Dark Psuedo Immortal out.
Then, the Immortal King Illusion slapped down, directly killing the Dark Psuedo Immortal on the spot.
With that, the three Dark Psuedo Immortals, and countless Dark Emperors, all died at Wang Ping’s hands.
It could only be said that the battle power brought by the Great Chaos Body was too astonishing, turning Wang Ping into a person capable of slaughtering Psuedo Immortals like slaughtering dogs.
Although, during the previous simulation, the simulated Wang Ping with the Great Chaos Body was ultimately killed in a battle against the Predecessor ransmigrator Leng Yue, it did not mean the Great Chaos Body was weak, but that Leng Yue, who had comprehended the Immortal Tao, was too powerful.
“Slaughtering Emperors and Immortals in the world, there is no one like me.”
Wang Ping, with his clothes fluttering, felt extremely refreshed, and couldn’t help but utter this extremely arrogant statement.
“Master, why don’t you wait until you defeat Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion before saying that?”
At this time, the Devouring Immortal Bead flew out, excitedly devouring the bodies of numerous Dark Emperors and Psuedo Immortals, and also muttering this sentence.
“Little Bead, are you asking for a beating?”
Wang Ping’s face darkened, and he gritted his teeth in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 278 The Special System of the Heavenly
chapters.content:
Chapter 1068: Chapter 278: The Special System of the Heavenly Paradise! Astonishing News!_2
Chapter 1068: Chapter 278: The Special System of the Heavenly Paradise! Astonishing News!_2
“Cough, cough, Master, I was just joking earlier. My master is unrivaled in the whole world, who can possibly be a match for him? Even that so-called Leng Yue is as insignificant as an ant in front of my master, will be easily killed with just one punch.”
Seeing Wang Ping getting angry, the Devouring Immortal Bead quickly made amends by praising Wang Ping.
“Forget it, I can’t be bothered to argue with you.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
Next, after the Devouring Immortal Bead had devoured the numerous corpses, so that they could be slowly refined later, Wang Ping stepped out and left the Source of Darkness.
It was only after Wang Ping’s departure, a pair of strange blood-red eyes appeared deep within the Source of Darkness, staring at the direction Wang Ping had left.
In the end, those bloody pupils slowly closed once again.
Thus, the Source of Darkness fell back into silence as if nothing had happened.
…
At this moment, in the outer world, when Wang Ping stepped out of the Source of Darkness without a scratch, expressions of astonishment came over the faces of the attentive Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal and Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal as well as some of the powerful Emperors.
Previously, there was an explosion of a very intense quasi-Fairy aura within the Source of Darkness. It seemed as if a great battle had erupted.
However, since the Source of Darkness had blocked their sensing and most of the power fluctuations, they did not know what had happened inside.
Now, Wang Ping left the Source of Darkness without a single scratch, appearing very calm and composed, making them extremely puzzled.
If there had been a quasi-Fairy battle, there was no way Wang Ping could have been so relaxed. It would have been like taking a casual stroll in the Source of Darkness.
Eventually, the Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal and the Ku Family Quasi-Immortal came to a decision after pondering and entered the Source of Darkness to investigate the situation.
When both saw the deathly silence within the Source of Darkness, with no trace of Dark Emperors and Dark Quasi-Immortals, they revealed expressions of shock and even horror.
Those Emperors did not know the situation inside the Source of Darkness. But as Quasi-Immortals, having existed for a very long time, they naturally knew it.
Inside the Source of Darkness, there were countless Dark Emperors. If these Dark Emperors joined forces, even Quasi-Immortals would have a headache.
Besides, there were not only those ten slain Quasi-Immortals in the Source of Darkness, but also four deeper-hidden and more powerful Dark Quasi-Immortals.
Such a lineup was wiped out by Wang Ping alone, and it didn’t take him too much time.
This was incredibly alarming.
“The Great Chaos Body is truly terrifying.”
The Ku Family Quasi-Immortal said with trepidation in his face.
“So, that’s it. The shocking anomaly was caused by the breakthrough of the Chaos Emperor’s Chaos Body to the Great Completion Domain?”
The Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal also had an astonished look on his face, clearly feeling cautious.
“Chaos Emperor? No, we should be calling him the Chaos Emperor Venerate, someone whom even we Quasi-Immortals need to revere.”
The Ku Family Quasi-Immortal said in a mixed mood.
“…..”
The Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal remained silent, unable to refute these words.
From now on, the Upper Realm would probably become the domain of Wang Ping’s authority.
As Wang Ping was now, with the Chaos Body at Great Completion, his combat power was already on par with Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion.
In addition, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was on Wang Ping’s side and very protective of him.
With these two around, Wang Ping would be the uncrowned king. His words must be taken seriously, and even ignored.
“It seems that this Immortal Fate is his.”
The Ku Family Quasi-Immortal looked at the Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal, speaking with deep meaning.
“Hehe, the Immortal Fate is for those who have the fate. Once the Immortal Gate opens, the chance for the Chaos Emperor to gain it is indeed the highest.”
The Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal chuckled and uttered these words.
Afterward, the Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal did not say anything more to the Ku Family Quasi-Immortal and left with a flicker of his figure.
Seeing this, the Ku Family Quasi-Immortal also chose to leave.
…
Wang Ping was unaware of the events of the Immortal Mansion Quasi-Immortal and Ku Family Quasi-Immortal investigating the Source of Darkness and communicating with each other. He had already returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace and was now taking stock of his gains from this adventure.
With so many Dark Emperors in the Source of Darkness swallowed by the Devouring Immortal Bead, plus the four Dark Quasi-Immortals, Wang Ping felt that the Devouring Immortal Bead condensing Immortal Source would have a high probability of helping him break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier.
“Master, there’s something wrong with the corpse of that Time-Space Quasi-Immortal. The Time-Space Origin is all gone! Master, please believe me; I haven’t swallowed it.”
The voice of the Devouring Immortal Bead suddenly rang out, anxiously explaining.
“Don’t worry about it. You just keep refining the corpses of the others.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, not caring about it, and spoke apathetically.
Apparently, the Time-Space Quasi-Immortal’s origin had compensated for the cause and effect.
Now, he had genuinely obtained the Great Chaos Body.
“Mm, I understand.”
The Devouring Immortal Bead heaved a sigh of relief, continuing its diligent work. They could be considered a model worker, the preferred type of worker for capitalists.
“Given the Devouring Immortal Bead’s expertise, refining the Immortal Source and helping me break through to the quasi-Fairy Level is practically a done deal. However, once I activate the life simulation, Senior Leng Yue will try to kill me. I need to rely on my own strength to break through to the quasi-Fairy Level. Although the Devouring Immortal Bead can speed up this process, the process of breaking through from the Emperor Realm to the quasi-Fairy Level obviously isn’t something that can be done in a few years. It may take thousands of years.”
As the Devouring Immortal Bead worked hard, Wang Ping was also considering the problem of breaking through.
A thousand years seemed like a long time. Although it wasn’t much in the simulation, it was too long in reality.
After all, from the time he had grown up until now, he had only spent a little over a decade.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 278 The Special System of Myriad Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 1069: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _3
Chapter 1069: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _3
A thousand years, that’s a hundred times this amount.
By the time he spends a thousand years in the real world making breakthroughs, the chat group may have changed beyond recognition. Perhaps some familiar group members will have fallen, and new members risen.
Besides, after a thousand years, he kept feeling that the mysterious power in the Sci-Fi World would evolve fully and destroy that cosmos.
“If you want to save time on breakthroughs, you can visit Myriad Heavens Paradise. There, there are cultivating chambers that can alter the flow of time without affecting the breakthrough.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“Really? Is it expensive?”
Wang Ping’s eyes lit up, and he asked curiously.
Changing the flow of time is a basic operation for him at this point.
However, changing the passage of time for cultivation doesn’t help much because understanding the Heavenly Tao True Spirit will distort with the change in the flow of time, making it easy to go astray.
As a result, Wang Ping was a little surprised to hear that there were such cultivating chambers in Myriad Heavens Paradise, but more curious about their price.
“Depends on the level. For your level, spending ten years in a cultivating chamber with a hundred-fold time speed should cost about 100 billion group points, which equates to one million scales of the world.”
The cold voice of Alpha sounded.
“Damn, 100 billion, why not just rob me.”
Wang Ping was speechless at the price.
Damn it, he had worked hard to earn World Source and had yet barely amassed 100 billion group points. The idea of spending 100 billion group points for a single cultivation session was outrageous.
“Indeed, it’s like robbing you. But, the price is reasonable. After all, the higher the level of the cultivator, the higher the requirements for breakthroughs, the cultivating chambers that meet the conditions of higher multiple time flow speeds are naturally expensive.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded again.
“Besides, the number of cultivators who still sincerely cultivate in Myriad Heavens Paradise is actually in the minority. Because the fastest way to gain power has never been cultivation, but by taking others’ power through games. Of course, the prerequisite for participating in games is having something for equivalent exchange. Without it, not only can the game of stakes not proceed, but those who fail to qualify can’t participate in the clearance games.”
“So, this thing actually seems a bit unimportant in Myriad Heavens Paradise, few people use it, so it’s also one of the reasons for its high price. After all, they would kill the goose that lays golden eggs.”
Alpha concluded ruthlessly in the end.
“I see.”
Wang Ping’s eyes also became a little strange, unsure of what to say.
Are the people in Myriad Heavens Paradise so impetuous? Though not everyone, most people seem to dislike cultivation, preferring to gain power through games.
“The Wind Demon Supreme, whom you’ve killed, was quite miserable in the game of stakes. If he hadn’t been so obsessed with the game of stakes, his future achievements might have been greater.”
Alpha brought up a character that Wang Ping had killed long ago, giving an appraisal.
“Of course, without Myriad Heavens Paradise, he might not have grown to this point. You could say, it’s all about timing and fate.”
“It seems that many of my predecessors have been hanging around in Myriad Heavens Paradise, and are also addicted to games.”
Wang Ping was touched by Alpha’s words and couldn’t help but sigh.
At the same time, he warned himself that when he went to Myriad Heavens Paradise, he must not be reckless and engage in overly dangerous games.
Unless his Life Simulator could still come in handy and help him establish a significant advantage.
Otherwise, he still needs to focus on safety first.
“So, what do you plan to do? Stay in this world for breakthroughs? Or go to Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded again, asking Wang Ping for his upcoming plan.
“I want to know one thing. That Sci-fi Mysterious can suppress cultivators and turn them back into ordinary people. But if I set up an Extraordinary Power in advance before transporting there and release it in the form of Energy Beads, would that work?”
Wang Ping pondered before speaking.
“No. Any Extraordinary Power will be suppressed. In his world, only some innate abilities and technical measures are useful.”
The cold voice of Alpha sounded again.
“Honestly, there’s a big difference between your current talent level and his. Wu Jun’s innate talent was effective last time, allowing you to teleport back, because his talent isn’t targeted at the mysterious. Otherwise, it would have failed.”
“This Mysterious is really hard to deal with.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
It seems that in the short term, he cannot grasp the Sci-fi Mysterious, going to Wu Jun’s world would be no different from offering his head on a platter.
“I might as well continue to develop. I can consider earning World Source in Myriad Heavens Paradise. As for the entry ticket for games related to Rule Stone, I’ll just play it by ear.”
Wang Ping sighed, thinking so.
“Your choice is correct. Actually, if you want to participate in the games, you don’t necessarily need to hunt down a very powerful Mysterious, there are other ways. However, compared to hunting a Mysterious, that method is less cost-effective for you.”
Alpha’s voice sounded again, making Wang Ping quite curious.
“What are the ways?”
Wang Ping asked directly.
“Bet on your own innate talent or your ownership.”
Alpha’s cold voice sounded.
The words caused Wang Ping’s face to tense.
He had just said to avoid participating in overly dangerous games.
Goodness, these other ways are about him betting on his talents and his ownership.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - 1070 278 The Special System of Myriad Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1070: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _4 Chapter 1070: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _4 How could he possibly use his Life Simulator as a stake in gambling?
As for ownership, he would never gamble it away.
The thought of losing his ownership makes his scalp numb.
“Forget it, I’ll take it slow, there’s no need to be too anxious,”
Wang Ping shook his head and dismissed the idea altogether.
“Alpha, what is the true nature of the Peculiarities? Honestly, I don’t see much difference between them and other living beings, they’re just more powerful and dangerous.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help asking as he recalled the topic of the Peculiarities.
“I don’t know, it’s not a secret I have access to. There are rumors that the Peculiarities are the manifestation of the darkness of All Heavens while others say that they were created out of boredom by some terrifying existence,” said Alpha, after a moment of silence.
“You can’t even access the truth? Haven’t you ever asked the creator behind you?” Wang Ping asked, pushing the limits.
“You overestimate my status and level in the All Heavens. As for the creator behind me… I haven’t been able to contact them for a long time,” Alpha replied after a long silence, to Wang Ping’s surprise.
It seemed that due to him falling into calculations at the start, Alpha had become somewhat desperate and laid-back, no longer hiding many things from him.
“It seems that our chat group is really not up to snuff. If the creator were still around, things might be better,” Wang Ping said, shaking his head in lament.
Honestly, Wang Ping believed that the creator of Alpha was probably bored when they created Alpha and lost interest in managing it afterward.
Of course, it was also possible that they were scheming something.
After experiencing so many things, Wang Ping truly had no trust in those old monsters.
Those old monsters in the Upper Realm had all sorts of schemes and ideas, let alone those who lived even longer in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Their motives were absolutely deep and impenetrable. Who knew what they were plotting?
“Wang Ping, don’t be disrespectful to my creator,” Alpha sternly warned.
“I’m not, I’m just giving a genuine evaluation,” Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
“Whatever, let’s continue the simulation. When I gain more talents, I’ll return to Myriad Heavens Paradise. Although, once I’m in Myriad Heavens Paradise, I suppose only the Seven-Color Talent will be useful. The rest of the talents probably wouldn’t even be worth trading.”
Wang Ping then changed the subject and said:
“It’s not worth much indeed. However, it’s still possible to trade them for a bit of World Source,” Alpha said coldly.
“So it really can be traded. It seems my Life Simulator might be a money-making weapon for World Source,” Wang Ping said, his eyes turning strange.
“You’re overthinking it. Only talents above purple rank are worth anything, and the ones below that, even if given away, not everyone would want them,” Alpha huffed and explained again.
“Ugh, aren’t there ordinary people in the Myriad Heavens Paradise? Although the Red Talent is somewhat crappy, it’s still not bad for cultivators below the Void Divine Realm, right?” Wang Ping said, somewhat speechless.
“There is no existence below the Void Divine Realm among the ‘ordinary people’ in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. That place is simply off-limits to those below the Void Divine Realm, as they would be crushed by the rules if they entered,” Alpha’s voice rang out again.
“So you’re saying even the weakest ordinary person in there is a Void lord. Geez, that place really is ludicrous. But don’t people have children in there? Newborn babies can’t possibly possess power above the Void Divine Realm,” Wang Ping frowned and asked.
“Due to the rules, even children born there will have power at the Void Divine Realm level. Of course, the power they receive will be different for different beings. However, in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, there is a new power system, so they don’t use the power levels of various worlds for classification,”
“When you arrive at the Myriad Heavens Paradise, your power will be divided into two aspects: Spirit Grid and Talent. The Spirit Grid is a condensed form of your power. In the Myriad Heavens Paradise, everyone must have a Spirit Grid, whether they are born there or come from the outer world.”
“The Spirit Grid determines your level, which is divided into seven numerical values. Seven-digit Spirit Grids are roughly equivalent to the range between the Void Divine Realm and below the Supreme Realm in your Profound World. Six-digit Spirit Grids are comparable to the Supreme Realm up to the quasi-Fairy Tier.”
“Five-digit Spirit Grids can only be obtained after becoming a Fairy. The further you go, the greater the gap between each digit. The gap between major levels, let alone minor levels within the same digit, is frightening.”
Upon hearing Alpha’s explanation, Wang Ping was speechless.
My god, the Myriad Heavens Paradise was outrageous. Ordinary beings giving birth to children there would automatically reach the Void Divine Realm.
With just one rank, six-digit grid includes the Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, Emperor, and quasi-Fairy, which is just unbelievable.
“I’m curious, do five-digit ranks count as powerful in the Myriad Heavens Paradise?” Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked Alpha.
“The Myriad Heavens Paradise is divided into four circles: Upper-tier, Upper Mid-tier, Middle Floor, and Lower-tier. The upper-tier is where only two-digit big shots can enter; the upper mid-tier is where only those with three digits or above can live; the middle floor is where the four- and five-digit beings live; and the lower-tier is where the six- and seven-digit beings survive. When the three-digit big shots want to enter the lower-tier, they must seal their Spirit Grid to four digits, or else the lower-tier will collapse due to their overwhelming strength,” Alpha explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 1071 278 The Special System of Myriad Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1071: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _5 Chapter 1071: Chapter 278: The Special System of Myriad Heavens Paradise! Startling News! _5 Alpha continued to explain.
“As for whether a five-digit number counts as a strong being, in the lower level, a five-digit number can absolutely be considered a powerful faction. But in the middle level, a five-digit number can only be considered an ordinary strong being.”
“Five-digit numbers represent immortality, and they’re only considered ordinary strong beings?”
Wang Ping’s face twitched slightly, feeling that Myriad Heavens Paradise was too abnormal.
It could only be said that this place deserved to be a gathering place for all the powerful and talented individuals from various heavens, so perhaps this kind of abnormality was quite normal.
“Wait a minute, you didn’t mention the existence of one-digit numbers. Is it possible that there are no one-digit numbers in Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of this and asked with surprise.
“Do you know what a one-digit number represents?”
Alpha asked quietly.
“What does it represent?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly and asked curiously.
“It represents omniscience and omnipotence, it represents eternity. As far as my current information goes, there is no existence with a one-digit number in Myriad Heavens Paradise. In Myriad Heavens Paradise, there is no one-digit number, and there are only thirty-six two-digit numbers.”
Alpha’s voice was very unsteady.
“I once told you that only special Earth people, transmigrators, could enter Myriad Heavens Paradise, right? Actually, I didn’t finish my sentence. Ordinary people do indeed have this treatment only if they are special Earth people, but there are other ways to enter Myriad Heavens Paradise: summoning and entering on their own.”
“For summoning, a special invitation letter is needed. As for entering Myriad Heavens Paradise on one’s own, as long as one reaches the realm of having a four-digit number, they can generally sense the existence of Myriad Heavens Paradise and enter it.”
“So, Myriad Heavens Paradise contains all the strong beings and monstrous individuals in all the heavens. However, even with this, there were only thirty-six at the beginning of Myriad Heavens Paradise. You must know that when Myriad Heavens Paradise was established, it wasn’t long after the opening of the heavens and the earth. How distant those times were! Wang Ping, do you know what this means?”
“Um…..”
Wang Ping couldn’t speak.
Wang Ping originally thought that Myriad Heavens Paradise was just a clone, but it was a very advanced one, still far from the true peak clone.
As a result, Alpha’s answer left him speechless.
Good heavens, he thought that Myriad Heavens Paradise was a transfer clone, but it was actually the top-level clone, the ultimate map?
It should be known that his previous emphasis on the Immortal Domain was equal to that of Myriad Heavens Paradise.
However, this difference has gone beyond the line.
“I don’t know what it means, but I know that two-digit numbers are already big shots in the entire Myriad Heavens. But I am quite curious about how strong two-digit numbers are. Just simply and directly, describe their destructive power.”
Wang Ping thought for a while and then gave his answer.
“Destructive power… you’re really shallow. I don’t know exactly how strong a two-digit number is, but it’s rumored that a two-digit number can destroy all the heavens and redo them.”
Alpha was a bit speechless, but he still gave an answer.
“Damn, that’s kind of abnormal.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips.
Good heavens, even the heavens could be destroyed and redone, that’s just too abnormal.
“So abnormal as a two-digit number, it still can’t be called omniscient and omnipotent, eternal existence?”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
“You’re still too far from these things, thinking about them is meaningless. I don’t have great expectations for you, if you can reach four digits, I’ll be satisfied.”
Alpha said quietly.
“…….”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, feeling utterly speechless.
However, he couldn’t really refute it.
If Alpha hadn’t explained how abnormal Myriad Heavens Paradise was, he would have definitely argued that he, Wang Ping, could never stop at just four digits.
However, now that he knew the gap between the digits and the horror of Myriad Heavens Paradise, he couldn’t really brag anymore.
Bragging requires capital.
And now, it seemed that he didn’t have that capital, unless the Life Simulator talent was also powerful in Myriad Heavens Paradise, and after optimization could let him cheat again, otherwise, he really didn’t have the confidence to reach three digits.
As for two digits, Wang Ping thought he might as well give up and go to sleep. Even if he used to be a cheater, if he could grow to a two-digit number just by relying on one talent, there wouldn’t be just thirty-six of them.
Unless he, Wang Ping, was the illegitimate child of a one-digit number that he didn’t know existed, wanting to become a two-digit number was really just daydreaming.
“Alpha, before the first generation chat group was destroyed, what level were you at?”
After Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he asked another question.
“When I was first created, I was a five-digit number. After growing and developing, I reached a four-digit ranking.”
Alpha was silent for a moment before answering.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 1072 279 The Ninth Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1072: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy! Chapter 1072: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy! “Starting with just five digits and then only growing to four? That’s….”
Upon hearing Alpha’s response, Wang Ping gave a strange look.
“Do you want to say that it’s too weak?”
Alpha’s voice chilled, showing a hint of annoyance.
“I didn’t say that,” Wang Ping responded seriously.
“You thought it. Don’t forget that I can eavesdrop on your thoughts,” Alpha scoffed coldly.
“Despite True Immortals being five digits, the actual difference between the digits is far too large, it cannot be compared to the realms in the Profound World. Just like how six digits include Supreme, Quasi-Emperor, Emperor, and Quasi-Fairy. The passing mark for five digits is True Immortal, and the upper limit is Quasi Fairy King.”
After pausing, Alpha started explaining again.
“Alright, that’s indeed a bit absurd.”
Wang Ping had no words to retort.
Indeed, the gap between the digits exceeds that of the Great Realm in the Profound World by far, they can’t be generalized.
“Four digits, is the threshold Immortal King? That’s terrifying indeed.” Wang Ping sighed. “By that logic, the group owner of our Second Generation Chat Group is classified under four digits right?”
“He hasn’t reached that level yet, he’s still within five digits. But, the five-digit range includes Entry Tier, Elite, Legend, and Ultimate. His Spirit Grid is at the five-digit ultimate level, which, in equivalent cultivation, is on par with the Quasi Fairy King.”
Alpha’s voice was unemotional as she explained.
“Five-digit ultimate, it’s a bit weaker than I imagined, but I guess that’s reasonable.”
A glint flashed across Wang Ping’s eyes as he nodded his head.
It’s been only a few thousand years after the Second Generation Chat Group was disbanded, the group owner of the Second Generation Chat Group wouldn’t have undergone a massive power boost like the one from the first generation.
Of course, it doesn’t rule out the possibility that he participated in a terrifying game that led to a rapid increase in his power, but even if he did, the most he could have achieved would be the entry level of four digits.
And supposedly, Wang Ping only needed to reach the Immortal King-tier to go head-to-head with the group owner of the Second Generation Chat Group, or even kill him.
“Don’t take it lightly. As long as he stays within the cities of Myriad Heavens Paradise, you can’t forcefully kill him. Unless, he agrees to play a game with you, or if you become a Demon King.”
Alpha, detecting Wang Ping’s thoughts, offered a warning.
“Demon King, what’s that?”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows.
“A Demon King is a special entity with the power to force others to play games with them. It’s extremely dangerous to be targeted by a Demon King. However, becoming one is astoundingly difficult. You’d have to win an extremely dangerous game in order to earn that title.”
Alpha, serving as a commentator, was undoubtedly proficient and quickly explained upon noticing Wang Ping’s confusion.
“Besides that, although Demon Kings possess such power, it’s precisely due to the danger of this power that they are feared and seen as adversaries by various forces. When opportunities arise to kill a Demon King, they would not waste it. Of course, this only applies to those below three digits. Among three digits, God, Demon and Fairy, Heteromorphic Beast, there’s hardly any difference.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he couldn’t help but sigh, “Demon King, huh. A special entity in Myriad Heavens Paradise, it indeed sounds quite impressive. If possible, I wouldn’t mind being a Demon King. Of course, that’s assuming I have sufficient combat power, otherwise, I’d just be walking into my own death.”
Wang Ping murmured, leaving Alpha speechless.
Wang Ping dreaming of becoming a Demon King was pure folly.
“Forget it, I haven’t gone to Myriad Heavens Paradise yet, so many things can’t be asked. Once I get there, I can ask if I have any doubts.”
Wang Ping shook his head and with his thoughts gathered, he prepared to continue his life simulation.
After killing so many Dark Emperors and Dark Psuedo Immortals, and looting their wealth, he was now practically overflowing with resources. He had countless quantities of Extreme-tier Divine Sources and all kinds of rare and exotic treasures.
“Oh right, are these things tradeable in Myriad Heavens Paradise? In theory, they should be. Even if I move to Myriad Heavens Paradise and my own power automatically turns into Spirit Grid, becoming part of this special system, these treasures should still remain useful, right?”
Remembering this, Wang Ping asked.
“You can’t sell them. The currency used in trades in Myriad Heavens Paradise is World Source, and this currency can only be used to trade items that were produced within Myriad Heavens Paradise. Items from other worlds can be brought in for personal use, but they can’t be traded.”
Alpha offered an explanation.
“If you could, I would have asked you to do so.”
“Then what kind of place is this, that doesn’t allow trading items from other worlds?”
Wang Ping was a bit speechless.
“Many people have complained about this. However, rules are rules, there’s no helping it. Unless you become a rule-making existence, only then can you change everything. Regrettably, by the time you reach that level, you won’t be concerned about such trivial matters.”
Alpha’s voice was cool and clear.
“Forget it, if it’s not possible, then it’s not. At worst, I can use these resources to trade with the group members in the chat group. They can carry out Group Tasks to earn World Source, and then exchange it for the resources I have.”
Wang Ping pursed his lips and could only say it this way.
“Next, I’ll continue with the life simulation. With so many resources, I want to crazily brush the Seven-Color Talent. At the same time, I’ll explore the last two forbidden places in the Upper Realm through various simulations.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1073 - 1073 279 The Ninth Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1073: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy! _2 Chapter 1073: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy! _2 Afterwards, Wang Ping pondered quietly.
Now, his strength was immense, and the Upper Realm no longer held many secrets for him.
Only places like the Elemental Forbidden Land and Life and Death Realm could still make him wary, harboring secrets that he couldn’t fully uncover.
Especially the Life and Death Realm, which still made Wang Ping’s heart tremble with his current vision.
That ghostly place was not one for Emperors to enter – even just nine deaths out of ten lives. Even if a quasi-fairy went, it would still be ten deaths and no life, with no chance of survival.
“I don’t know what secrets lie hidden in the Life and Death Realm, and I don’t know if Senior Leng Yue knows the hidden secrets.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“You can try asking him in the simulation. If he doesn’t answer in the simulation, ask him the same thing in real life.”
“System, I want to carry out a paid simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping cleared his thoughts and said silently from the bottom of his heart.
“Ding, consuming two billion catties of top-tier divine source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Two billion catties – that’s just a trifle.”
Now that Wang Ping was so fat with resources, he couldn’t help but sneer at the once-cringe-inducing amount.
Just then, the system’s voice sounded again.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing Red Talent·I Love Taming Beasts.”
Red Talent·I Love Taming Beasts: The host’s talent in taming beasts will be enhanced, the more you love, the more it grows.
“Another Red Talent…but it’s not a big deal, just fodder.”
Wang Ping said indifferently.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice continued, Wang Ping’s consciousness trembled and entered the immersive simulation state.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, you want to find a place to break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier. To this end, you choose to use the Seven-color Talent·Teleporting God, intending to teleport to another world.]
[Unfortunately, your luck is bad, and you fail, unable to teleport to another world.]
[Seeing this, you feel somewhat helpless and choose to use brute force to break through the world barrier and forcibly go to other worlds to break through, evading Leng Yue’s pursuit from Predecessor Transmigrator.]
[Unfortunately, just as you take action, Leng Yue makes his move, finds you, and tries to kill you.]
[Apparently, your unusual behavior has caught Leng Yue’s attention, and even without Heavenly Calculation’s Child waking up, he can judge that you are no longer your true self.]
[Faced with this, you have no choice but to give it your all and engage in a breathtaking battle with Leng Yue. Unfortunately, you still fall under Leng Yue’s full strength.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]’
…
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s consciousness trembled, returning to the real world.
This time, the simulation content was too scarce, resulting in no insights at all.
“This is just too tragic.”
Wang Ping smiled helplessly.
It seemed that if he wanted to continue with the simulation breakthrough, Leng Yue, the Transmigrator Predecessor, would stand in his way like a boss, and trying to escape would be futile.
Perhaps only by relying on Seven-colored Talent·Running God would it be possible to find a way out.
Otherwise, it’s a dead-end no matter what he does.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose one of the following rewards:
①. Red Talent·I Love Taming Beasts.
②. Random Supreme Artifact.”
“System, I choose ②. Random Supreme Artifact.”
After taking a look at the meager reward, Wang Ping casually made his choice.
“I don’t believe it. If I can’t do it once, then a hundred times, I don’t believe I can’t get to another world in any of them.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and continued with the simulation.
However, what followed in the simulation left Wang Ping numb.
Because he simulated dozens of times in a row without ever refreshing a Golden Talent, let alone a Seven-color Talent.
Most critically, in these simulations, there was not a single successful teleport to another world.
As a result, no matter how hard he struggled, he would be easily killed by Leng Yue.
As long as he had the idea of running away, Leng Yue would give him a devastating blow.
One could say that his luck was so incredibly bad that the simulated Wang Ping died miserably.
If this was fodder, there were too many fodders – it was about time for some reversal of fortune and to see some luck explode.
