“This is the last time. If my luck is still that bad, I can really give up on simulating. A single simulation consumes 200 billion catties of top-tier divine source, even if I’m rich, I can’t afford this kind of consumption.”
Wang Ping thought somewhat painfully.
These resources, if used in the chat group to exchange for World Sources from other group members, would be the most profitable, rather than being consumed in meaningless simulations like this.
If he continued to consume like this, even if he could refresh the Seven-color Talent, he would not gain anything. In fact, one could even say it would be a massive loss.
For this reason, even if he could refresh the Seven-color Talent in this paid simulation session, he would not continue simulating.
No way, the cost-effectiveness was just too low.
He should wait until the Life Simulator is optimized before doing paid simulations.
“Ding, consuming 200 billion catties of extreme-tier divine source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice rang out once more.
“Ding, Talent Refresh successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the Seven-color Talent·Resurrection of the Dead and Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 - 1074 279 The Ninth Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1074: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_3 Chapter 1074: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_3 Seven-Colored Talent – Dead Revival: With this talent, the host can resurrect after death, and can also define the resurrection time. In addition, this talent ability can also be used on others to resurrect them.
ps: This talent can only be used below the True Immortal Realm. If subjected to a special attack of True Immortal tier or some powerful abilities or tools, it is impossible to resurrect.
Lastly, this talent is a one-time-use talent, so please be cautious when using it.
Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword: ….
“Ah, finally refreshed a seven-colored talent, and it’s the one I wanted….”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed seven-colored talent, his eyes gleaming and revealing a joyful expression.
The Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance that Wang Ping possessed was a very powerful ability, allowing his strength to soar, but the side effect was too great, and he was worried about not being able to resurrect.
This really was a perfect case of getting exactly what one wanted.
“Your luck is pretty good. The effect of this seven-colored talent has reached the upper limit of six-digit Tier resurrection tools. After all, resisting the special attack of the True Immortal tier is not easy to resurrect. In other words, if True Immortal doesn’t have any special means, you can still resurrect after being killed. This is not something ordinary six-digit resurrection tools can do.”
At this time, Alpha’s voice also resounded.
“As expected, tools have detailed level divisions. It seems that this seven-colored talent is even stronger than I imagined, just like Moment of Elegance, which is also a top-tier seven-color talent. The only regrettable point is that this is a one-time talent.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were bright, he sighed with emotion, and said with some regret.
“Don’t be too greedy… resurrection abilities and tools are inherently more valuable than other abilities and tools of the same level. They are usually single-use. If this talent wasn’t a one-time-use talent, but could be used continuously, you could have sold it at a sky-high price.”
Alpha said somewhat speechlessly.
“A continuous use resurrection tool, I believe many big shots would be willing to buy it for their valued juniors as a life-saving charm.”
“I’m just sighing a bit.”
Wang Ping chuckled, quickly brushing over the topic.
Then, Wang Ping said in his heart, “System, I choose the Seven-Colored Talent – Dead Revival.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The system’s voice rang out again, and Wang Ping’s consciousness wavered as he reentered the immersive simulation.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you still chose to use the Seven-Colored Talent·God of Teleportation, hoping to be teleported to another world.]
[I have to say, you were incredibly lucky this time, finally succeeding in teleporting to another world. Moreover, this world is one that you are somewhat familiar with, the world where the Demonic Tao Quasi-Immortal resides.]
[You were overjoyed by this development. In such a world, you could finally cultivate in peace and attempt to break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier. As long as you breakthrough, you have confidence in fighting a match with the Predecessor Transmigrator, Leng Yue.]
[After all, once you break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier, using the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance might be enough to make up for the difference in Immortal Tao levels. Even if you couldn’t completely bridge the gap, you shouldn’t be directly annihilated.]
[Besides, you also planned to cultivate diligently in this world to comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture. Although you thought it was impossible to comprehend Chaotic Immortal Tao, it didn’t hinder your ambition to do so.]
[With these thoughts, you found a random place to close up and began to practice Enlightenment.]
[In a blink of an eye, 1500 years passed, and you successfully broke through to the quasi-Fairy Tier with the help of the Immortal Source refined from the Devouring Immortal Bead. As you broke through to the quasi-Fairy Tier, terrifying phenomena emerged in the world, stunning many cultivators.]
[Despite this, you still ignored it, continued to settle your cultivation after the initial delight, and worked hard to comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly 200,000 years had passed. During these nearly 200,000 years, you successfully condensed your own Chaotic Quasii-Immortal Artifact. However, you still haven’t comprehended the Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture, which left you quite troubled.]
[You could only sigh, in the current Lower Realm, comprehending the Immortal Scriptures and Immortal Tao was too difficult. You felt that Leng Yue’s ability to create laws of Immortal Scriptures and perceive Immortal Tao might be related to living for hundreds of millions of years, and it might also be related to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Next, the Source of Darkness in this world also showed abnormalities, with a large number of Dark Beings appearing and causing disasters. You snorted coldly and destroyed all of them. Eventually, you even entered the Source of Darkness and killed the meddling Dark Emperor and Dark Psuedo Immortal.]
[After dealing with those, you resolutely chose to return to the original Upper Realm. In your opinion, staying in this world to comprehend Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture would be meaningless. Perhaps only by fighting against Leng Yue can you perceive the power of Immortal Dao during the battle and have the possibility of transcending limits and comprehending Chaos Immortal Tao.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1075 - 1075 279 The Ninth Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1075: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_4 Chapter 1075: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_4 [Although you didn’t know whether the Upper Realm you are in now has been refined as it was in the previous simulation, you still decided to take the risk and return.]
[When you returned to the original Upper Realm, you found out that it had not been refined. The Upper Realm was much more prosperous than in the previous simulations, and heavenly geniuses like Ku Xuan, without various conspiracy and calculations, were able to grow safely. Some relatively weak heavenly geniuses were Supremes and Quasi-Emperors. Ku Xuan, on the other hand, had become an Emperor, enjoying immense glory.]
[However, the moment you returned, the Chaos anomaly reappeared, and they were all overshadowed.]
[The Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal were quite surprised as well. They did not expect the long-lost you to suddenly appear, demonstrating the Quasi-Fairy Phenomenon.]
[You stood quietly in the starry sky, waiting for the appearance of Senior Leng Yue, your transmigrator predecessor, wanting to fight him.]
[Soon, Leng Yue appeared. Looking at you, who had already broken through to the quasi-Fairy Tier, his expression was calm and not surprised. He just asked indifferently if you came back to seek death in pursuit of Immortal Tao?]
[You smiled and said that you indeed wanted to ask about the Tao, so you came back specially. However, you didn’t think that coming back meant seeking death. After that, you looked curiously at Leng Yue, asking if there could only be one Chaotic Body born in each era in the Lower Plane of the affiliated Immortal Domain.]
[To this, Leng Yue nodded, saying that in the Immortal Domain and its affiliated Lower Plane, only one Chaotic Body could be born in an era. Sometimes, even an era couldn’t give birth to one. However, once an era gives birth to a Chaotic Body, whether in the Immortal Domain or the Lower Plane, that era cannot birth a second Chaotic Body.]
[Hearing this, you nodded with relief, understanding why Leng Yue was trying to kill you every time, and why he hadn’t refined the Upper Realm this time – he was waiting for you to come back. Only with your death could he activate the Refinement Array, otherwise, everything would be in vain.]
[Afterwards, you jokingly told your transmigrator predecessor, Leng Yue, that if you didn’t come back, he would never be able to achieve the Chaotic Body and refine the Upper Realm.]
[To this, Leng Yue calmly stated that if you didn’t return, he would come to find you. The outcome would be the same either way.]
[You were left speechless, thinking that Senior Leng Yue must have had a way to find you, meaning running to other worlds wouldn’t help. Perhaps, Senior Leng Yue didn’t look for you before because he simply didn’t want to do so for the time being.]
[However, this is quite normal. After all his scheming for so long, it would be strange if he didn’t have any backup plans and let the simulated Wang Ping or other cultivators benefit instead.]
[After that, you two stopped chatting and began the great battle directly.]
[At the beginning of the battle, you demonstrated your quasi-Fairy cultivation and immediately activated the effects of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, unleashing your full power. At this moment, you were incredibly strong.]
[Although your quasi-Fairy Tier cultivation caused the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance to be less terrifying than before, it didn’t raise your power straight into the realm of the immortals, but it was much stronger than the pure quasi-Fairy cultivation.]
[In response, Leng Yue was quite surprised, and became serious, using the power of the Immortal Tao to confront you head-on.]
[There’s no denying that you’re much stronger now. Even facing Leng Yue, you were not instantly killed like last time. Although your full power and critical strike talent were still absolutely inferior, you had reached the level where you could battle Leng Yue fiercely.]
[For this, Leng Yue couldn’t help but praise your performance, saying that it’s no wonder you have boundless potential, as your growth rate is truly astonishing. Of course, the present you is not the real you, but this performance is enough.]
[While Leng Yue praised you, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal were even more shocked by the battle. The power both you and Leng Yue displayed was astonishing, making them question their own existence. Can such a level of power really be achieved by quasi-Fairies? Is this not the power of the immortals?]
[Ignoring the reactions of others, you continued to fight Leng Yue, striving to feel the power of his Immortal Tao and integrate it into yourself, wanting to achieve Enlightenment through this.]
[Unfortunately, although you gained quite a lot, you still failed. You lost the battle, dying due to the side effects of Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. There was no other way, as the duration was too short. Of course, if the battle continued, the final outcome would still be destruction. The side effect of Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance just hastened the time of death, which might be a more dignified way to die.]
[However, because of your Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead, you revived once again. After you revived, Leng Yue didn’t immediately take action but calmly told you that he would give you ten thousand years to understand the Chaos Immortal Tao. If you could not comprehend it, he would not show mercy.]
[Seeing this, you took a deep breath, realizing that the attitude of Senior Leng Yue, your transmigrator predecessor, towards you, had undergone some subtle changes. This happened whether you were the simulated Wang Ping or not.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1076 - 1076 279 The Ninth Seven-Color Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1076: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_5 Chapter 1076: Chapter 279: The Ninth Seven-Color Talent! Breaking Through the Quasi-Fairy!_5 [Taking advantage of the situation, you chose to close yourself off and try to comprehend Chaos Immortal Tao with the insights from this intense battle.]
[Unfortunately, even after ten thousand years, you have made some progress but ultimately failed to comprehend Chaos Immortal Tao. Helplessly smiling at this, you feel that it’s too difficult to comprehend the immortal path in this age where immortals don’t exist.]
[As you feel bitter and disappointed, Leng Yue appears again, appearing somewhat disappointed. As a result, he coldly tells you that you can die.]
[Upon hearing this, you laugh freely, look at life and death with a smile, and choose to commit suicide.]
[Due to your death, this simulation comes to an end…]
…
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various realizations and images as his figure appeared in the same place where the simulated Wang Ping closed off.
“Still a failure, what a pity.”
Wang Ping muttered with some regret.
In the Life Simulator, simulated Wang Ping ultimately had too few trump cards and had to rely solely on himself.
However, in this lower realm where Immortal Tao does not exist, how easy is it to comprehend it? At least a million or even tens of millions of years would be needed.
Ultimately, simulated Wang Ping had too little time to comprehend.
Of course, Wang Ping would not blame Leng Yue, his Predecessor Ransmigrator, who has been kind enough to him and his original body.
This time, his attitude towards the simulated Wang Ping was acceptable, giving him so much time to survive.
As Wang Ping was full of thoughts, his consciousness flickered, and his vision changed as he returned to the real world.
Then, the system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose one from the following rewards:
①.Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead.
②.Purple Talent·Blood Drinking Sword.
③.A Random Quasi-Emperor Artifact.”
…
“System, I choose ①.Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead.”
After Wang Ping glanced at the reward list, he quickly made a choice.
Soon, the information and usage methods of Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t intend to continue the simulation because it was meaningless and would only waste resources with a low cost-performance ratio.
Rather than relying on the number of simulation attempts to accumulate comprehension, it would be better to try in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Afterwards, Wang Ping opened the chat group, planning to earn some Group Points in the group before going to Myriad Heavens Paradise.
After all, he’s penniless now.
If he goes to Myriad Heavens Paradise and can’t even take out a little bit of World Source, it would be too miserable.
Perhaps, as a penniless person, he might not even be eligible to participate in some games to earn rewards.
“It’s been a long time since I opened the chat group page.”
Wang Ping looked at the chat group page he brought up with mixed feelings.
Ever since his growth rate skyrocketed, the presence of the chat group has rapidly declined.
After all, in the past, he would participate in Group Tasks and brag with the Group members.
But after he optimized the Life Simulator, got stronger rapidly, and left the other Group members far behind, he rarely bragged with the Group members.
He couldn’t help it; immersive simulation consumed too much time, and he didn’t have the time to brag or even participate in tasks.
This was because Alpha indulged him, assigning all the tasks to the other Group members.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would still have had some headaches.
Speaking of which, Lin Yuanyuan, the model worker, had to be mentioned once again, as she took on too many things for Wang Ping.
“Well, as a reward, I’ll give her more resources later, and also take her to devour a Great Emperor level character. I think Emperor Slaughter is quite suitable.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, thinking to himself.
There were still some people Wang Ping had to deal with in the real world.
Like Green Bamboo Emperor and Qingyu Quasi Emperor, regardless of their performance in the life simulation or to repay the favor of Black Abyss Demon Lord, he had to teach them a lesson.
As for someone like Emperor Slaughter, there was no room for discussion.
The chat group and Slaughter Paradise were mortal enemies, and Emperor Slaughter had also tried to harm him, so he was definitely on the must-kill list. He’s the perfect candidate to be drained by Lin Yuanyuan.
“Yuanyuan, you really are lucky.”
Wang Ping chuckled and started to chat in the group.
However, he did not directly flood the group. Instead, he posted many good items in the store and directly @everyone, telling them about the good things for sale in the store.
Then, Wang Ping closed the group chat page.
As for the explosion and kneeling down to lick him in the chat group, Wang Ping didn’t bother to look at it.
The flattery of the Group members was no longer enough to satisfy Wang Ping.
After all, he is now someone who even Quasi-Fairies would kneel down to lick upon encountering. So, the degree of licking from the Group members were really nothing to him.
“Yuanyuan, come over for a bit, I have something to ask you.”
Next, Wang Ping privately chatted with Lin Yuanyuan, directly starting a video call and said.
“Mr. Wang, I’m coming right away.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yuanyuan didn’t wait for Wang Ping to say anything, but without hesitation, responded, choosing to forcefully exit her current task and teleport back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1077 - 1077 280 Heading to Paradise Straight to the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1077: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower! Chapter 1077: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower! “Mr. Wang, what did you want to see me about?”
After being teleported back, Lin Yuanyuan asked curiously.
“Yuanyuan, were you just in…”
Wang Ping looked at the somewhat disheveled Lin Yuanyuan, his gaze a bit strange.
“Mr. Wang, don’t worry about it. I was just carrying out a mission and defeating a powerful enemy.”
Lin Yuanyuan stated without changing her expression.
“No wonder you’re the Task King of the chat group.”
Wang Ping praised Lin Yuanyuan.
“I’m looking for you this time because my growth in this world has reached its limit, and I can no longer continue to grow rapidly. So, I need to make a trip to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Then, Wang Ping started talking about the main subject.
“I don’t know how long it will take for me to come back from the Myriad Heavens Paradise this time, so I plan to catch an Emperor to help you improve your strength before I leave.”
“Em-, Em-peror….”
Wang Ping’s words directly stunned Lin Yuanyuan, her mouth agape, and her face full of shock.
She was completely unaware of any major events that happened in this world due to her past task.
The same was true for Cai Yonglong and the others who left this world.
After all, for these chat group’s traversers, it was undoubtedly more efficient to execute various group tasks to earn World Source and improve their strength than to silently cultivate in the Upper Realm.
The fact proved that their approach was correct.
Lin Yuanyuan had accumulated a lot of World Source and, combined with exploiting various opponents through tasks, her strength had soared, reaching the level of a Half-step Supreme.
This was just her strength; Lin Yuanyuan had even more amazing abilities.
However, no matter what, her power was still insignificant compared to the Emperor Tier.
Hence, Lin Yuanyuan was genuinely shocked.
“Thank you, Mr. Wang! As repayment, I’ll give you all the World Source in my possession. Although it may be a bit insufficient, I will slowly compensate you later.”
After Lin Yuanyuan regained her senses, her face filled with excitement, and she quickly said.
“You don’t need to be so polite. I already said before that I would help you in the future. I believe you will become my best teammate even after going to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping patted Lin Yuanyuan’s shoulder and said with a smile.
Although Lin Yuanyuan must have saved up a lot of World Source, probably over a billion, and it would be helpful for Wang Ping, he wouldn’t take it from her.
Since he was cultivating her, taking her World Source would change the nature of their relationship and make it a transaction.
As for Wang Ping’s current problem of lacking World Source…
He was actually not in a hurry about this.
Once he arrived at the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he could sell some useless talents and earn some through the Life Simulator’s games.
Although Wang Ping didn’t expect to earn trillions of group points quickly, earning hundreds of billions would not be too difficult.
“I understand. Whether it’s now or in the future, I will be your loyal subordinate and do my best to be your most useful helper.”
Lin Yuanyuan nodded earnestly and swore.
“There’s no need to be so serious; don’t call yourself a subordinate. I see you as a younger sister, so as family, helping you is only natural.”
Wang Ping said without blushing or skipping a beat.
“Mr. Wang…” Lin Yuanyuan was somewhat moved.
Although she knew Wang Ping’s words had some hidden persuasion to them, Lin Yuanyuan was still moved.
After all, Wang Ping was, indeed, kind to her. He was the only man she trusted and admired.
“Since that’s the case, let’s go.”
Wang Ping smiled and then left the place with Lin Yuanyuan.
Next, he went directly to the Immortal Mansion, found Divine Calculation Man, and requested his precious assistance to calculate the location of Emperor Slaughter.
Divine Calculation Man naturally wouldn’t dare not help with Wang Ping’s request.
Soon, Divine Calculation Man calculated where Emperor Slaughter was hiding and told Wang Ping the location.
Then, Wang Ping brought Lin Yuanyuan and headed straight for Emperor Slaughter’s location.
…
At this moment, Emperor Slaughter was cultivating in a secret place.
Although it was called cultivation, it was merely resting and recuperating.
Emperor Slaughter was currently quite frightened and full of unease.
Because of how incredible Wang Ping’s performance in the past, if he was found by Wang Ping, he would undoubtedly be killed instantly.
Hence, he could only pray that Wang Ping wouldn’t find him and that time would pass quickly.
As long as two more years passed, he could go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Although returning to the Myriad Heavens Paradise would mean he would have to participate in the dangerous Sky Tower Game, it was better than waiting for death here.
At least participating in the Sky Tower Game would give him a slim chance of survival, while staying in this realm would truly be fatal.
Just as Emperor Slaughter was anxiously waiting, the Great Array protecting his secret place suddenly shattered.
Then, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan appeared here.
This scene made Emperor Slaughter’s scalp numb, a chill running from the soles of his feet to the top of his head, as his soul nearly jumped out, reaching the peak of terror.
“Old man, you hid quite well, but you ultimately couldn’t escape the Heavenly Secret Calculations.”
Wang Ping looked at the terrified Emperor Slaughter and taunted.
Admittedly, Divine Calculation Man might have lost face in the Life Simulator, but he still had some abilities.
However, this was normal. If he didn’t have any abilities, he wouldn’t be in such a high position in the Immortal Mansion with just a Quasi-Emperor level of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 1078 280 Heading to Paradise Straight to the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1078: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower!_2 Chapter 1078: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower!_2 “”Chaos Emperor, don’t kill me, I can provide you with information about Slaughter Paradise.”
Emperor Slaughter said, his face pale and stiff.
“Not needed.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
His words left Emperor Slaughter completely desperate.
However, he didn’t give up and tried to escape by turning into a shadow.
“Ridiculous. Even quasi-Fairies die before me, and you, an emperor, think you can escape?”
Wang Ping mocked, striking with a palm that suppressed everything.
Facing Wang Ping’s palm, Emperor Slaughter was forced out of the space and was about to be suppressed.
Emperors were too weak in front of Wang Ping.
Nevertheless, even faced with such a situation, Emperor Slaughter did not give up. He took out an item, attempting to block the attack.
Unfortunately, it was still useless. Wang Ping’s power exceeded the item’s limit.
As a result, the protective barrier formed by the item exploded.
In the end, Emperor Slaughter was still suppressed and unable to move.
“This…”
Seeing this scene, Lin Yuanyuan was completely astonished.
Her brother Wang had become too powerful.
This was an emperor, after all, and he was caught alive in an instant.
“Wait, did Brother Wang just say that even quasi-Fairies cannot escape…”
At this moment, Lin Yuanyuan remembered Wang Ping’s previous words and admired him even more.
Although she had not heard of the quasi-Fairy realm, it must be a realm above the Emperor’s.
That is to say, Brother Wang had become so strong that he could casually suppress quasi-Fairies.
No wonder Wang Ping said that this realm could no longer help him grow quickly.
It seemed like he was already reaching the ceiling, unmatched by anyone else.
“Yuanyuan, go on, drain him.”
After suppressing Emperor Slaughter, Wang Ping spoke to Lin Yuanyuan.
At this, Lin Yuanyuan snapped back to reality and nodded expectantly.
Then, under Emperor Slaughter’s astonished gaze, Lin Yuanyuan came to his side, shattered her clothes and began to perform her practiced moves.
Seeing this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but praise her. Lin Yuanyuan was truly becoming more experienced.
Some time later, Emperor Slaughter completely fell, and Lin Yuanyuan absorbed all of his power, becoming an Emperor herself.
After Emperor Slaughter’s fall, Wang Ping did not waste any time tearing open the inner world of Emperor Slaughter and taking out all of his treasures.
Extreme-tier Divine Source, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, Wang Ping only glanced at them before losing interest.
What intrigued Wang Ping more were the items that Emperor Slaughter possessed.
He remembered that Emperor Slaughter had a resurrection method, but he didn’t know if it was an item or something else.
“Found it, Alpha, is this a Resurrection Item?”
Wang Ping took out a special card, feeling the special power contained within and asked in his heart.
“Six-digit Resurrection Tool, can resurrect beings with a six-digit Spirit Grid. Although it’s the same level as your Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead, its effect is inferior.”
Alpha provided an explanation.
“If I use the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, will this tool work?”
With eyes flashing, Wang Ping asked again.
“Yes, it’s useful.” Alpha gave a positive answer.
“Phew, that’s good.”
Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
The Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance has no usage limit, so if one has enough life, they can use it again after being resurrected.
Thus, this six-digit Resurrection Tool gave him an extra life and another chance to use his talent.
Although, once he becomes a fairy, the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance may become useless. But it doesn’t matter right now.; what matters is that it works now.
Furthermore, if he doesn’t use it in reality, he could trade it or let Lin Yuanyuan use it in the future. In any case, it won’t go to waste.
“Next, Yuanyuan, will you go back to continue your task or follow me to Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and asked.
“I’ll go back and finish my task. After all, I can’t leave my teammates behind.”
Although Lin Yuanyuan was tempted, she shook her head.
Wang Ping smiled.
Well, you’ve left your teammates behind before.
Of course, Wang Ping knew that with Lin Yuanyuan’s character, her teammates were safe when she teleported over.
“With your strength as an Emperor, completing the task should be very easy. I can wait for you.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and then spoke.
The Myriad Heavens Paradise was dangerous, so Wang Ping believed it was necessary to bring along his teammate Lin Yuanyuan.
“Then wait for me, Brother Wang. I’ll be back soon.”
Lin Yuanyuan nodded without hesitation and didn’t think it would be dangerous to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise with Wang Ping.
In Lin Yuanyuan’s mind, as long as Wang Ping is there, everything will be safe.
Even if they can’t deal with the enemies, there will definitely be a way out.
“Alright, I’ll wait for you then.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Lin Yuanyuan took a deep breath, then teleported back to the task world and continued her mission.
However, because she had already become an Emperor, she could directly cover the area with her divine sense, find the enemy and instantly kill them with her pressure.
One had to say, it was simple and efficient.
This operation left Cai Yonglong and the others, who were undertaking the mission with her, completely dumbfounded.
When they learned that Lin Yuanyuan had returned to the Upper Realm not long ago and had become an Emperor under Wang Ping’s guidance, they all felt envious.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 1079 280 Heading to Paradise Direct to a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1079: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Direct to a single-digit Sky Tower! _3 Chapter 1079: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Direct to a single-digit Sky Tower! _3 However, there was no remedy for their envy. Without the kind of talent Lin Yuanyuan possessed, they could only upgrade bit by bit.
Soon, Lin Yuanyuan returned to Wang Ping’s side.
“Alpha, open the channel, we’re going to Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping commanded with a glint in his eyes.
In an instant, Alpha began the operation, and a dark channel appeared in front of Wang Ping.
Upon seeing this, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan exchanged a glance before entering one after the other.
As the two of them went in, the channel closed behind them.
Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and he found himself in a different world, inside a villa.
Simultaneously, when Wang Ping arrived in this world, he found that his power had transformed in an extremely peculiar way. His physical body, his mana, and his Divine Soul were all integrated into Spirit Grid.
The Spirit Grid encompassed all these forces.
As for his Chaotic Body and Breaking Origin Sky Eye, his Special Constitution abilities were categorized as Physique Items.
The Heavenly Tao True Spirit and Emperor’s Mystic Skills he had comprehended were defined as skills.
As for talent, it stood alone.
“What a peculiar sensation. No wonder one could trade anything here.”
Wang Ping contemplated his transformation with a deep sense of wonder.
Moreover, after arriving in Myriad Heavens Paradise, Wang Ping discovered a card resembling a cartoon clown in his hand.
It was a Paradise Pass issued by the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Everyone who arrived in the Myriad Heavens Paradise would receive this.
The Paradise Pass could not be discarded, traded, or destroyed.
As long as one had a Paradise Pass, they could freely enter and exit the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Of course, whether one was coming or going, World Source would be consumed.
The fee was determined based on one’s strength.
“Wang, my power has changed.”
Lin Yuanyuan was quite shocked.
“Don’t worry. No matter what kind of power system one has, upon arriving at the Myriad Heavens Paradise, it will be converted to this system.”
Wang Ping reassured Lin Yuanyuan.
Then, he looked up to see a familiar figure.
White hair with mechanical wings on his back that seemed feminine but didn’t belong to any gender – it was Alpha.
“Alpha, I suppose this counts as our formal first meeting. To be honest, I didn’t expect you to actually have a physical form.”
Wang Ping looked at Alpha, who was sitting above, and spoke with a smile.
“Alpha, is she the manager of the chat group, Alpha, that Wang talked about?”
Lin Yuanyuan also gazed at Alpha above, her face filled with astonishments.
“Indeed, it’s our first meeting. However, you had already anticipated that I have a physical form. There’s no need to say it out loud.”
Alpha’s red pupils fixed on Wang Ping. Her face showed no expression, maintaining her usual cold demeanor
As for Lin Yuanyuan, Alpha acknowledged her with a glance and then paid no further attention.
“Is this our base? I’m curious about your status in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, where do you stand?”
Wang Ping chuckled, avoiding further speculation and asked the important question.
“Having just established the Third Generation Chat Group, I’m in a semi-depleted state, so my position here is not high. Although you all have collected vast amounts of World Source through numerous group tasks, enabling me to recover quite a lot, I’m only at a 5-digit Entry Tier level now.”
Alpha replied after a moment’s silence.
“Therefore, I’ve already moved the base to the lower tier. The lower tier is divided into four areas: East, South, West, and North. We are currently in East District City No. 10086.”
“As for the Transmigrator Chat Group power, the old members are long gone, and no one in the Myriad Heavens Paradise dares to join. So, the only current official members are you two.”
“This is indeed quite troublesome.”
Wang Ping sighed after listening to her.
He thought Alpha was very strong, but it turned out she was only at a 5-digit Entry Tier level, even after recovery.
No wonder Leng Yue said Alpha couldn’t protect him.
Indeed, with Leng Yue’s terrifying power, along with a few terrifying tools obtained from the Myriad Heavens Paradise, Alpha might not be able to protect him.
After all, Alpha was only a 5-digit Entry Tier, equivalent to a True Immortal’s level.
Besides, Alpha’s physical form was not in the Upper Realm, but in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, which made her seem even weaker.
It seemed he had overestimated Alpha, the supposed lifesaver in his mind.
However, there was no helping it. Who would have thought that the mysterious Alpha would be so weak?
“Wang Ping, you’re being too much.”
Alpha’s stern face glared at Wang Ping dissatisfied.
“Ahem,” Wang Ping cleared his throat, composed himself, and asked a new question in a serious tone: “Alpha, is your current predicament because of the owner of the Second Generation Chat Group? Has he been plotting to undermine you, making those in the Myriad Heavens Paradise too frightened to join the Transmigrator Chat Group?”
“Mmm. He has always targeted me, preventing any newcomers from joining the chat group. I have had no choice but to stick to the old method – selecting people to transmigrate through the chat group’s feature to advance.”
Alpha spoke in a grudging tone.
Observing this, Wang Ping realized that Alpha was becoming increasingly emotional.
“What’s the name of the owner of the Second Generation Chat Group, my predecessor? Also, I’d like to know where he is now,”
“His old name was Dao Yi, but everyone in the Paradise now knows him as Cunning Card. That’s because he awakened a talent that allows him to manifest a deck of cards. Each card has a different ability, allowing him to fight very flexibly. Many people have been tricked to death by him, which is why he got the title Cunning Card,” said Alpha.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 - 1080 280 Heading to Paradise Straight to the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1080: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower! _4 Chapter 1080: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Straight to the Single-Digit Heaven Tower! _4 Alpha looked at him with hatred, speaking coldly.
“So, if you face him and play games with him, you must be careful. Even if you have the Life Simulator, you may fall into a trap. After all, there are quite a few bizarre talents in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, and while his talent is not as strong as yours, he is still very hard to deal with.”
“I know that, of course.”
Wang Ping nodded.
How could Wang Ping underestimate the second-generation chat group owner who had once dismantled Alpha?
Although it wasn’t just the owner who dismantled Alpha but rather a cooperation with other forces, the person themselves was undoubtedly a dangerous existence.
Anyone who underestimated him would be essentially courting death.
“As for where he is… the Second Generation Chat Group he created is also located in East District City No. 10086.”
Alpha’s voice sounded again.
“It seems that he doesn’t have the ability to find the Demon King, nor does he qualify to ask the Demon King to make a move. Otherwise, I would have been wiped out long ago.”
“It seems that Demon Kings are indeed scarce. Even Dao Yi, the 5-digit limit Second Generation Chat Group Leader, doesn’t qualify to have a Demon King take action… It looks like Demon Kings all have a 4-digit presence.”
Wang Ping pondered thoughtfully.
“Not necessarily. Some people have obtained the title of Demon King by clearing a certain game when they had a 5-digit or 6-digit number. However, after they become Demon Kings, they hide and grow in strength. Once they make a move, it’s a deadly strike, leaving no survivors. Otherwise, if they are exposed, they will surely end up dead.”
Alpha shook her head and explained.
“So even if Dao Yi were lucky enough to find a 5-digit Demon King, the Demon King would still not take action, but would rather play the game at all costs to seal Dao Yi’s mouth.”
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded, finally understanding Alpha’s situation.
Dao Yi, the second-generation chat group leader, did not have the ability to forcibly force Alpha to play a game, so he could only target Alpha’s forces.
The intimidation and threats of a 5-digit limit powerhouse naturally deter ordinary people from joining the Transmigrator Chat Group.
In the long run, Alpha’s power could not possibly develop.
Wang Ping even thought of something else.
That was, when they were in the Myriad Heavens, they were also targeted by the Second Generation Chat Group.
When they, the people of the Third Generation Chat Group, arrived in Myriad Heavens Paradise, they would undoubtedly be targeted even more ruthlessly.
By then, how much loyalty the Third Generation Chat Group members can maintain towards Alpha would be a real question.
Although it seemed that Alpha had strong control over the group members, Alpha was now so weak that she was even weaker than the second-generation chat group leader.
In other words, it was entirely possible to shift power through gaming.
“No wonder Alpha was dismantled. I finally understand the reason.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, finally realizing the cause and effect.
In a place like Myriad Heavens Paradise, even if all the ownership is in Alpha’s hands, it is possible that it was won on purpose, resulting in a betrayal.
Although people without ownership could not play a game by themselves, they could still participate in a game.
As the members of the chat group became stronger, Wang Ping did not believe that Alpha could listen in on their thoughts perfectly.
Even if she could, the first two generations still managed to deceive her with their various means and abilities.
No wonder Alpha asked him time and time again whether he would betray her.
With his growth rate and potential, once he reached Myriad Heavens Paradise, it would indeed become uncontrollable.
If the Life Simulator were optimized again, it would be even more out of control and could even lead to the guest becoming the host.
Apart from all this, Wang Ping also learned one more thing: when they arrive in Myriad Heavens Paradise, unless they deliberately lost their ownership, even if they were in the same force and Alpha was the leader, she wouldn’t be able to forcibly force them to gamble their ownership.
What’s more, even if they bet, both sides would need to bet something of equal value, and Alpha would have to bet her ownership too.
By then, if Alpha loses, she will be in despair.
Perhaps the ownership of the members of the previous two chat groups was not in Alpha’s hands, which is why their betrayal was so easy.
“…”
Upon hearing Wang Ping’s thoughts again, Alpha’s face darkened a bit.
Wang Ping was becoming more and more outrageous, openly mocking and criticizing her.
However, Wang Ping’s words did resonate with her and struck a chord in her heart.
She didn’t have the ownership of the previous two generations of chat group members in the past.
Gambling ownership was too risky, and she was afraid of losing herself.
Additionally, she was indeed conflicted before, wanting Wang Ping to grow quickly but not wanting him to come to Myriad Heavens Paradise to optimize the Life Simulator.
After all, as Wang Ping grew stronger, her control over him weakened.
But later, she figured it out.
Since she failed to control the first two times, this time might as well take the path of cooperation and wholeheartedly nurture Wang Ping.
She had been watching Wang Ping’s actions.
Wang Ping was not ungrateful; he appreciated kindness and repaid it in spades.
Therefore, Alpha felt that Wang Ping was a suitable person to invest in.
It was because she had this idea that she executed a series of operations later on, giving Wang Ping preferential treatment, protecting him, and even almost becoming his personal spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - 1081 280 Heading to Paradise Direct to a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1081: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Direct to a single-digit Heaven Tower! _5 Chapter 1081: Chapter 280: Heading to Paradise! Direct to a single-digit Heaven Tower! _5 “Well, since I know the situation now. What should we do next? Start studying, understand the situation in this world completely, and then start the game? Or do we have to start the game immediately? As I recall, you once mentioned that anyone who first enters Myriad Heavens Paradise must play a game within a short time.”
Wang Ping, seeing Alpha’s face growing darker, knew he couldn’t continue sneering at Alpha internally, and earnestly asked.
“You guys should go read some books in the Book Repository first. Some things you have to see for yourself. You will understand the compulsory game after you finish reading the books.”
Alpha glared at Wang Ping and spoke in a cold voice.
“Fine.”
Wang Ping chuckled and planned to go read.
As for Lin Yuanyuan, she was still in a state of shock due to the overwhelming amount of information. She couldn’t clarify things in such a short time.
But she didn’t care too much. After all, she just needed to follow Mr. Wang.
Whatever Mr. Wang did, she would do the same.
…
Three days later, in the Book Repository, Wang Ping closed the book in his hands. His eyes flickered with uncertainty. He had come to understand most things about Myriad Heavens Paradise, as well as the various forces and powers present.
Of course, this was what was recorded. Unrecorded powers and forces certainly existed, but Wang Ping didn’t know about them.
Well, he would understand these powers and forces when he encountered them later.
“The Heaven Tower, such a strange place. Unable to apply the power of the Spirit Grid, and can only use innate abilities. It is like a separate system.”
As Wang Ping closed his book, Lin Yuanyuan, who was beside him, had also finished most of her reading and sighed.
“Indeed.”
Wang Ping nodded in agreement.
There are various games in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
But they are primarily divided into six types.
① The games held by major powers, where rewards are given after clearing them.
② Individual gambling games.
③ Compulsory dangerous games under the Demon King’s authority.
④ Trials of special regions.
⑤ Personal trials of Wilderness Lords.
⑥ The Sky Tower Game.
The first two types of games aren’t compulsory, and players can choose whether to participate.
③④⑤ all are compulsory types.
If you lose to the Demon King, you’ll lose all your rights.
However, losing in the regional trial games and personal trial games might not have any danger, but you might even lose your life.
As for your rights, it’s impossible to lose unless you consciously wager them.
If these types of games are cleared, they usually come with astonishing rewards.
As for the sixth game, the Sky Tower Game.
This game category is the most special one in the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Heaven Tower is the center of Myriad Heavens Paradise, and it is rumored that it is the foundation of the paradise.
Heaven Tower has a total of one hundred floors.
It’s said that those who reach the top will become a Number Eternal.
However, the game of the Heaven Tower basically ignores the Spirit Grid, and can only utilize innate talents and special items.
This places an extreme test on wisdom and courage, making the vast majority of dwellers in Myriad Heavens Paradise very fearful.
Because not only is the game itself unique, it’s also because that except for beings with a three-digit number or higher, everyone who first enters must pass the Heaven’s Tower once.
And then, every ten thousand years, they need to challenge the Heaven’s Tower again. The difficulty can be chosen by the player, and the upper limit of reward corresponds to different level of difficulty.
Due to this rule, the number of ‘players’ who died in the Heaven’s Tower was as numerous as the stars. Even those beings with four-digit numbers, or even three-digit numbers, couldn’t guarantee their survival in the Sky Tower Game.
However, although the Sky Tower Game rules that you must challenge it once every ten thousand years, ‘players’ can still use the corresponding World Source to buy delay items to extend time.
Buying an item once could avoid the game when the ten thousand years are up, and delay till the next ten thousand years.
Aside from this, there’s another way, which is to escape from the Myriad Heavens Paradise. However, when they re-enter, they would still need to pass the tower, and can’t choose the easy mode for the challenge anymore.
“The Sky Tower Game, it’s really surprising. Does it provide a shortcut to the one-digit figures?”
Lin Yuanyuan sighed.
“Hehe, a shortcut? It’s more like a road to death. Myriad Heavens Paradise and Heaven Tower have existed for so many years, yet no one has reached the top. Despite the passage of time, only thirty-six two-digit figures exist, and the record in the Heaven’s Tower remains at the 89th floor. The one who holds this record, a two-digit figure, also lost his life there.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shone, and he shook his head.
“You’re right…”
Lin Yuanyuan sighed deeply.
A two-digit figure, she understood now how significant they were, capable of destroying all heavens with a simple notion and creating them with another.
However, even such people have died in the Sky Tower Trial. This was truly terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082 - 1082 281 Abyss Game Wang Ping is Cheating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1082: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? Chapter 1082: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? “According to the intelligence we have, it’s certain that anyone who fails the Sky Tower Trial will die for good, no matter what kind of resurrection methods they have. Otherwise, it would be quite easy for them to resurrect with their two-digit power,”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin and began analyzing.
“The Heaven Tower is truly terrifying, possessing power far beyond two-digit levels.”
Lin Yuanyuan sighed again.
“That’s normal. If it didn’t have this power, it wouldn’t be able to test the two-digit numbers, nor would there be rumors that reaching the top of the tower will make one a single-digit number.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he said with emotion.
“I just don’t know if the tower is a natural formation or if it was created by some terrifying existence. If it’s the latter, then that’s too horrifying, which means they can create beings that are one-digit numbers.”
“But one-digit numbers are said to be omniscient and omnipotent, representing eternity. Can such beings really be created?”
Lin Yuanyuan said with some doubt.
“Who knows? This world is too vast, with too many secrets. Nowadays, we are just six-digit beings, and it’s impossible for us to know so many secrets. We can only strive to become stronger and slowly uncover the truth.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“That’s true.” Lin Yuanyuan nodded.
“Mr.Wang, we’re about to start the Sky Tower Trial soon… The Sky Tower Trial assigns teammates randomly, which means we may have to go through it on our own.”
Lin Yuanyuan worried.
“Don’t be nervous. This is just the 1st Floor. You’ve completed so many Group Tasks and have grown a lot. The First Floor shouldn’t be too difficult for you.”
Wang Ping smiled reassuringly and comforted Lin Yuanyuan.
Due to the rules of the Heaven Tower, the content of the Sky Tower Trial is absolutely confidential.
People who have participated in the Sky Tower Trial cannot reveal its content in any way. If there’s any desire to leak information, they’ll die on the spot, and any information they’ve spread would be instantly blocked.
Nobody can give any help, advice or hints to those who are about to participate in the trial. Any such behavior will also be erased.
As a result, nobody knows what the trial contains. Those who have participated know, but they cannot share this knowledge.
This is one of the reasons people fear the Heaven Tower.
If there were game information and strategies, the difficulty of the challenge would be greatly reduced.
However, there’s no information for the Sky Tower Trial. You can only rely on yourself, so it’s too dangerous.
Fear of the unknown is human nature.
“I will try my best to pass. But, Mr.Wang, should I choose simple mode or difficult mode?”
Lin Yuanyuan bit her lip.
The Sky Tower Trial gets more difficult as progress is made. However, it’s rumored that the first few floors are relatively easy and aren’t that deadly.
Of course, this is true if you choose simple mode. If you choose difficult mode, hell mode, or the most terrifying abyss mode, that’s another story.
The higher the difficulty, the more amazing the rewards, creating a snowball effect.
If you keep choosing simple mode, the rewards will be average, making the subsequent floors increasingly difficult until you eventually die in the Sky Tower Trial.
This applies to both ordinary players and the terrifying beings in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
That’s because in the Sky Tower Trial, you can only rely on your own life-bound talents and special items.
In other words, the Spirit Grid, ordinary items, and abilities are all unusable, making it relatively fair.
However, it’s only relatively fair. Strong players ultimately have access to massive resources, can obtain incredibly powerful special items, and can also strengthen their own life-bound talents to an astonishing level.
Ordinary Myriad Heavens players simply do not have these advantages, and most don’t even have a chance to awaken their life-bound talents.
…
“Choose the difficult mode. The starting point for simple mode is too low, and it’ll have a big impact on your future. Of course, if you’re scared, you can choose the simple mode. After all, your life is your own, and you should think carefully.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.
“Okay.” Lin Yuanyuan nodded.
It was then that the Paradise Pass appeared in the hands of Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan.
After that, the Paradise Pass began to radiate light, enveloping Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan, and taking them into the Heaven Tower.
As Wang Ping’s vision cleared, he saw that he had arrived in a white, empty room. It felt very spacious.
Wang Ping wasn’t surprised, though.
Although the Sky Tower Trial content is confidential, there are still records of it.
This empty room is each player’s exclusive room, and they can use their own will to adjust the layout of the room.
However, this hardly counts as a real benefit. With a cultivator’s abilities, anyone could easily achieve this.
Wang Ping then willed the creation of a chaos opening scene.
However, while the chaos opening scene did appear, it was only illusory, and there was no power of any law behind it.
“What a pointless feature. The Heaven Tower really doesn’t let people take advantage.”
Wang Ping shook his head, somewhat disappointed, even though he had anticipated this.
“Player, please enter your Sky Tower game code.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - 1083 281 Abyss Game Wang Ping is Cheating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1083: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _2 Chapter 1083: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _2 At this moment, a nimble voice rang out.
“Tianyan.”
Wang Ping thought for a moment and felt that it was not appropriate to continue using Bai Tianhong’s name here, so he chose his own title instead.
“Ding, Sky Tower game code selection successful. Player Tianyan, would you like to adjust your height, weight, appearance, and other data?”
The nimble voice rang again.
“Of course, adjust.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke.
In the Sky Tower Game, no one would be foolish enough to use their original body data and information to play.
After adjusting the data, the protection mechanism of the Sky Tower is quite strong, making it impossible for teammates who venture into the game together, no matter how powerful they may be in the outer world, to find you in person.
Unless, the player chose to expose themselves.
However, such daring fools were quite rare, and those who had exposed themselves in the past were basically done for.
After all, the rewards of the Sky Tower Game were astounding, and everyone wanted them.
As Wang Ping adjusted his data, his original handsome appearance due to cultivation became ordinary again, the kind that would be difficult to find in a crowd. His height, weight, and body shape also differed greatly from his real self.
“Ding, adjustment successful. Please choose your game difficulty.”
The nimble voice rang out again.
“Diffi…”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he was just about to play it safe and choose Difficult mode.
However, he was soon dumbfounded.
Because a virtual luminescent screen appeared before his eyes.
On the screen, there was only one mode.
That mode was Abyss mode.
“Damn it, are you messing with me? You said there were four modes: easy, difficult, hell, and abyss. Why did you give me just one abyss mode? How can I choose?”
Wang Ping could no longer stay calm, and said somewhat angrily.
“Ding, please choose from the four modes quickly. If a choice is not made within ten minutes, the system will consider the player as giving up the trial and will be punished by the Heaven Tower.”
The nimble voice rang out again.
“Did you hear me? There’s obviously only one option here. What do you mean by four? How am I supposed to choose?”
Wang Ping became even more furious.
“Please make your choice quickly.”
The nimble voice rang out again.
“I’ll be damned…”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but curse, his expression slightly twisted.
Is this even considered an AI in Sky Tower?
Isn’t it just artificial stupidity? It’s not even as good as Alpha.
“Could it be that the Sky Tower is targeting me? Or is it due to interference from a higher-up?”
However, Wang Ping quickly calmed down and began pondering with a furrowed brow.
His situation was obviously unusual.
Considering that someone had been plotting against him ever since he traveled to this world, it was not impossible for someone to interfere externally.
However, if someone could even interfere with the options of the Sky Tower, how powerful would they have to be?
“Or could it be that they can only interfere with the options of the first few floors? Still, even if they can only interfere with the options of the first few floors, that’s terrifying.”
Wang Ping’s face changed.
It was obvious that the other party was forcing him or perhaps reminding him that only by choosing Abyss mode would he be on the right path. Otherwise, it would be difficult for him later on.
It’s also possible that he had to choose Abyss mode in all his future Sky Tower Trials to achieve the other party’s goal.
“It seems I don’t have a choice.”
Wang Ping sighed and reluctantly made his choice.
“Ding, congratulations to Player Tianyan for choosing Abyss mode. The game map is Rampaging Zombie Tide. The game will begin soon and the Heaven Tower will transport the player to the game world in ten minutes. Please mentally prepare.”
The system’s voice rang out, leaving Wang Ping somewhat surprised.
Rampaging Zombie Tide? It sounds like it has something to do with zombies. Could it be that the first trial of the Sky Tower is so simple?
Wang Ping participated in a group task that involved the Zombie World for the first time.
And in that zombie world, he went on a killing spree.
“No, this time is different from last time. Spirit Grids can’t be used, skills can’t be used, only life-bound talents and special items can be used. In other words, there is a high probability that the trial has to be completed with an ordinary person’s stats…”
Wang Ping’s brow furrowed tighter as he muttered to himself.
His chosen mode, however, was Abyss mode… It probably wouldn’t be that simple, and he had to be extra cautious.
Otherwise, he would likely end up in tragedy.
Next, Wang Ping closed his eyes and began silently waiting for the game to begin.
In the blink of an eye, ten minutes passed, and Wang Ping was enveloped by white light and transported to the game world.
When Wang Ping opened his eyes again, he found himself inside a minivan.
Other than him, there were three other people.
Two men and one woman, all with extremely ordinary appearances.
Clearly, not only Wang Ping, but the others also understood the importance of having an ordinary appearance.
This was normal, as those who dared to choose Abyss mode were obviously not fools, so their wisdom and courage were definitely sufficient.
“Ding, the game will officially start in 30 minutes. Each player can silently recite the mission details in their mind to obtain basic information about the game world and related tasks.”
As soon as Wang Ping and the other three greeted each other, the system’s voice rang, and Wang Ping narrowed his eyes.
Then, Wang Ping silently recited the mission details in his mind, and he acquired basic information and related tasks about this game world called Rampaging Zombie Tide.

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - 1084 281 Abyss Game Wang Ping is Cheating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1084: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _3 Chapter 1084: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _3 The setting of this world is an ordinary Earth background, with no extraordinary abilities.
However, a zombie virus will appear in this world in thirty minutes, quickly infecting humans and spreading.
There are three tasks for the players.
The first one is the main quest: to survive for 24 hours in this world.
After completing the mission, you can choose to exit the world.
At that time, you can obtain the most basic rating and receive corresponding rewards.
The second task is a side quest.
Hunting down zombies, the more zombies you kill, the higher your rating and the more rewards after surviving for twenty-four hours.
The third task is also a side quest.
Killing the behind-the-scenes BOSS can also earn additional rewards and improve the rating.
“It seems similar to the Master Lord Tier Space mode.”
Wang Ping looked at these tasks and thought to himself.
What’s different is that the Sky Tower’s positioning is much higher than a typical Master Lord Tier Space.
Maybe, the so-called Reincarnation Spaces are cultivating objects for the Sky Tower Trial in that way.
After all, that kind of cultivation method is more suitable for breaking through the Sky Tower.
“Hehe, one main quest and two side quests. Is this the Abyss mode? It’s interesting.”
At this moment, the flat-headed guy laughed, looking quite relaxed with no tension on his face.
“We can’t see what’s special about the Abyss mode through the missions. Of course, it’s our first time attempting the tower, so we can’t make comparisons.”
The glasses girl pushed up her glasses and spoke quietly.
“In my opinion, the Abyss mode is likely to enhance the strength of the zombies. To be honest, we should find a suitable hiding spot quickly rather than wasting time here.”
“Instead of that, I think we should introduce ourselves, talk about our talents, and discuss cooperation issues.”
The guy with the mole on his face spoke calmly.
“Please, do you think anyone would reveal their talents in the Abyss mode? Cooperation is just a joke.”
The flat-headed guy sneered and pushed open the car door, getting out.
Seeing this, Wang Ping followed suit, also uninterested in cooperating.
After all, he didn’t feel any sense of security with these people.
What Wang Ping wanted to do now was find a deserted place to carry out the free simulation and gather intelligence.
Intelligence is the most important thing.
Seeing that both the flat-headed guy and Wang Ping left without any concern for others, the guy with the mole frowned but didn’t say anything.
As for the glasses girl, she didn’t leave but chose to stay. She smiled slightly and said, “I think we can discuss cooperation.”
“Hehe, you’re smart. That’s the right choice.”
The guy with the mole showed a smile.
…
After that, Wang Ping didn’t care about the others and went straight into a quiet coffee shop.
At the same time, Wang Ping analyzed the situation and found that the background here should be a city in the Free Country.
“System, I want to carry out the free simulation. By the way, can I do a text simulation, without the immersive simulation?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he silently spoke in his heart.
Having experienced so much and knowing that someone is using him to plot something, Wang Ping’s view of the Life Simulator has changed, and he thinks he could try to change something deliberately.
Sure enough, this time he actually got a response.
“Ding, immersive simulation is turned off, text simulation mode begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Hehe, that’s great.”
Wang Ping nodded satisfactorily.
Immersive simulation is too time-consuming. Once you enter the immersive simulation state, it must take a long time, and thirty minutes may not even be enough for one simulation.
At the same time, his body in reality will be completely defenseless.
In this state, it’s possible for him to be attacked and killed by those three players.
Even if he wasn’t deliberately attacked by the three players, he might be bitten to death by zombies after the game officially started.
That would be a real tragedy.
At the moment when Wang Ping was happy, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words emerged.
[You know the game is about to start, and after thinking about it, you decide to head to the rooftop of a high-rise building as an excellent choice.]
[For this reason, you quickly take action, find a high-rise building, and head towards it. During the process, you also examine your current situation.]
[Through your research, you are pleasantly surprised. Because you find that although your physical strength has become that of an ordinary adult, due to the Life Simulator being your life-bound talent, the talents refreshed by the Life Simulator can also be used.]
[Of course, the talents that can be used are limited to the ability category, and talents that have been classified as physical-category items cannot be used.]
[However, you are not sure whether those low-tier talents can be used or if they will work on zombies. If they do, your advantage will become incredibly significant, making you a bug-like existence in the Sky Tower Game.]
[Soon after, you arrive on the rooftop of the skyscraper, lock the iron door, and wait for the game to begin.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - 1085 281 Abyss Game Wang Ping is Cheating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1085: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _4 Chapter 1085: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _4 [Several minutes later, the game officially begins. Standing on the rooftop, you witness a terrifying scene. On the street, numerous people suddenly fall to the ground, only to climb back up within ten seconds.]
[At this moment, they have turned into zombies, rushing toward the people around them. You grimly notice that their speed has reached the level of Post-Heaven Realm cultivators – incredibly abnormal.]
[In other words, this is a frightening world where even ordinary zombies possess Post-Heaven Realm level strength. If these zombies were to mutate, just thinking about their strength is enough to make one’s scalp tingle.]
[Now, you understand why the main quest only requires surviving for 24 hours. It’s extremely challenging for ordinary humans to stay alive in such a twisted world for that long. Even if someone awakens a terrifying talent, their chance of surviving until the end is still slim if their talent isn’t abnormal enough.]
[Of course, you also understand that the abnormality of these zombies is due to this being an Abyss mode game world. In simple mode or difficult mode, it would not be as terrifying.]
[Thinking of this, you once again curse Sky Tower Intelligence and the puppetmaster behind the scenes for setting you up.]
[While you’re brooding, you notice that all the humans on this street have been annihilated in an extremely short time.]
[Your heart is heavy watching this unfold. At this moment, you notice a huge commotion. Following the sound, you see a giant several meters tall trampling the rapidly increasing number of zombies with reckless abandon.]
[Upon seeing this, you’re surprised, realizing the person’s talent allows them to transform into a giant. If this talent is merely a size transformation, it’s quite useless. But if it increases their physical strength and combat power based on their new size, it’s not bad.]
[Regardless, you don’t know how this talent performs in the outer world, but it seems quite effective in the Sky Tower Trial on the first floor, the Game World: Rampaging Zombie Tide.]
[This makes you ponder the need to differentiate between the strengths of talents in the Sky Tower Trial. Some life-bound talents that may be mediocre in the outer world could perform well in these tower trials with various restrictions. Conversely, powerful outer world talents may lose their edge due to these same restrictions.]
[For example, Cai Yonglong’s Absolute Defense would be effective against formidable attacks from enemies much stronger than him in the outer world. However, in this game world, from the perspective of this giant player, the advantage is barely worth mentioning. Even if they manage to survive a bit longer, they are eventually overwhelmed by the zombies.]
[While you’re thinking, things have changed. The once ultra-tall, powerful, and well-defended giant had no problem stomping and crushing the zombies. But as they kill more and more zombies, you notice the zombies start to mutate rapidly, becoming even stronger.]
[Their strength swiftly progresses from the Post-Heaven Realm to the Innate Realm. As the zombies become stronger, the giant loses its advantage and is eventually overwhelmed, its defense breached.]
[In the end, the giant screams and is also infected, turning into a terrifying giant zombie.]
[You’re utterly speechless at this scene. Although you understand why the player would choose to use their talent to transform into a giant and take on the zombies head-on due to desperation, their recklessness causes them to meet their demise quickly.]
[Initially, when you saw their swagger exiting a minivan, you thought this was a hidden powerhouse. But as it turns out, they were just a reckless brawler.]
[Of course, you’re still grateful for this reckless brawler. After all, they helped you gather a lot of valuable information, the importance of which is beyond words.]
…..
“It’s no wonder this is Abyss mode; the difficulty is outrageous. They’re not giving anyone a chance to live,” says Wang Ping, his brows furrowed while looking at the text simulation.
Just infected zombies already possess Post-Heaven Realm combat power.
It takes ten seconds or less to infect a human, some even in just three to five seconds.
Apart from that, the zombies quickly mutate and become more powerful once they encounter a strong enemy…
As for the players, even though they are free to use their talents, their attributes are no different from ordinary humans. Facing a group of fast-mutating zombies, even a single one is enough to make their scalp tingle.
The only special items they can use are either Sky Tower Rewards or obtained in the particular trials of Myriad Heavens Paradise; normal items can’t be used.
And these kinds of items are obviously hard for rookie players who have just entered the Sky Tower to obtain.
“However, there’s no need to panic. I still have many talents to use. I just don’t know if Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons can block the viral infection. If it can, it would be truly miraculous,” Wang Ping thinks to himself with flickering eyes.
In the first Group Task, it was Green Talent – Immunity to All Poisons that blocked the viral infection, giving Wang Ping the chance to clear the task. Otherwise, it would have been curtains for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086 - 1086 281 Abyss Game Wang Ping is Cheating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1086: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _5 Chapter 1086: Chapter 281: Abyss Game! Wang Ping is Cheating Again!? _5 Perhaps now was the time for Green Talent·Immunity to All Poisons to shine again.
As Wang Ping was pondering, the simulation continued.
[With the giant being infected into a zombie, it noticed your presence and looked in your direction, letting out a roar. This caused your complexion to change slightly. Although you knew you would eventually be discovered by this group of perverted zombies, it still made you feel uncomfortable that they found you so quickly.]
[As you looked serious, the giant zombie burst out with a speed and power far more terrifying than before it was infected, rushing towards you.]
[Having anticipated this, you hesitated no more and activated your Golden Talent: Transmission. As you used the talent, your figure vanished in an instant, leaving the rooftop of the skyscraper.]
[In the very next instant you were teleported away, the entire skyscraper was directly blown to smithereens by the giant zombie and turned into debris filling the sky.]
[At this moment, due to the effects of the Golden Talent: Transmission, you were teleported onto the street. As for this street, there were no living people left, only zombies.]
[At this, your pupils contracted. Based on your observations, there was no building near here like the one you had just left, and even if there were, it would have caused a huge commotion from the giant zombie’s destruction. However, none of that happened, indicating that the place you teleported to was far away from your original location.]
[But even if you were teleported to such a distant place, zombies still appeared. This meant that there wasn’t just one source of zombies, and it could be a premeditated infection event happening simultaneously all over the world.]
[However, you can’t afford to think about so many issues right now, because the zombies have already set their sights on you, who suddenly teleported in, and began to pounce on you.]
[In response, you looked serious and didn’t hesitate to activate the effects of Blue Talent·Berserker, forcibly increasing a portion of your physical qualities and entering a state that ignored negative effects. Of course, the effects of the Blue Talent were limited, and you didn’t expect too much. What you want most now is just the temporary boost to your physical qualities, nothing more.]
[However, you clearly discovered that while Blue Talent·Berserker can be used, the boost it gives you is much smaller than when you were in the Mortal Realm.]
[Back then, you were in the Transcendent Realm, and you still had quite an improvement. Now, you are just an ordinary person, only able to increase your strength to Viscera Training level.]
[Nevertheless, a Viscera Training level strength is enough. After all, your control of power is not something your former self could compete with. Without modesty, even if you only have the power of Viscera Training stage, you can still unleash far greater force than a Post-Heaven Realm practitioner just through skill.]
[However, you can’t fight the zombies because there are too many of them, and killing them would cause them to mutate quickly.]
[Therefore, your only choice is to run away, taking advantage of the talent’s effect while it lasts and escaping frantically. This time, Green Talent·Escape Prodigy also had some effect, making your escape speed slightly faster.]
[This made you sigh with emotion. Once abandoned by you, the low-tier talent had its day to shine unexpectedly.]
[However, as you ran, you quickly discovered a problem. This perverted Zombie World wasn’t like the zombie movies where you could hide in a room and lock steel doors to avoid them. Their strength was enough to effortlessly break through any building, making such an escape route meaningless.]
[At the same time, these zombies didn’t only rely on their hearing to sense human presence; their five senses were all normal and far superior to ordinary people. If they had any flaws, it would be that they only desired to bite others and lacked wisdom.]
[But even without wisdom, you could not shake them off at all. This made you feel anxious in your heart because the effect of Blue Talent·Berserker was gradually fading away. Once the talent effect disappeared, you could only use Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance to increase your combat strength or Seven-Colored Talent·God of Escaping.]
[Once you used the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, you would have to die once. Although you could revive after dying, you would still be dead, and your situation would not change as long as the zombies were not wiped out.]
[However, you remembered something: that Seven-Colored Talent·Dead Revival allowed you to define your own revival time. You thought you might be able to set the revival time at the completion of the main quest, thereby passing the trial.]
[You thought that this should be somewhat feasible and worth trying. But before that, you wanted to find as many possible ways to survive and gather as much information as possible.]
[After all, since you were going to do it, you might as well do your best, get the highest rating, and receive the best rewards.]
[For this reason, at the moment when the effect of Blue Talent·Berserker disappeared, you used the Seven-Colored Talent·God of Escaping, trying to move to another location again.]
[As you used the talent, your figure disappeared again, causing a group of zombies to pounce on empty air. Then, you were teleported to a new place and saw two familiar yet unfamiliar faces.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - 1087 282 SSS-level rating Astonishing rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1087: Chapter 282: SSS-level rating! Astonishing rewards! Chapter 1087: Chapter 282: SSS-level rating! Astonishing rewards! [The two familiar faces are none other than the pockmarked-faced man and the glasses girl. At this moment, both of them are looking at you with astonishment, not expecting you to suddenly appear before them.]
[However, they quickly calm down and congratulate you on your successful escape. Upon hearing this, you let out a wry smile, acknowledging that it was just a stroke of luck.]
[Next, they begin to probe you, asking whether your talent is of the spatial teleportation type, and whether it can transport others. If so, they suggest that the three of you should cooperate, which would greatly increase your chances of survival.]
[You smile, neither admitting nor denying it, only silently observing your surroundings. You find that you are in what seems to be a hidden underground room, which appears quite safe for now.]
[You can’t help but admire the luck and skills of these two, who managed to find such a secret hiding spot in just thirty minutes. Unlike the giant-transforming player, who was caught by the zombies because of an unsuitable hiding place, they were forced into a fight and lost.]
[Afterward, you choose to cooperate with them. They introduce themselves as A Blade of Grass and Little Cow, respectively.]
[They also tell you about their own Talent Skills. The pockmarked-faced man’s ability is Hardening, which can super-harden objects. He confidently states that as long as they hide here without making too much noise, they can potentially hold out until they clear the stage.]
[Glasses girl, on the other hand, says her talent is Dead Revival, enabling her to revive deceased teammates.]
[Hearing about their abilities, you laugh and choose to believe them on the surface, but secretly remain guarded against them.]
[From then on, you maintain a polite, but guarded relationship, hoping to last twenty-four hours without any incidents.]
[Sixteen hours pass quickly without any problems. This eases the tension of glasses girl and the pockmarked-faced man, making them think that the Abyss mode isn’t that difficult to endure.]
[Only you remain troubled, as you have seen the horrifying state of the giant and the terrifying physical abilities and mutation speed of the zombies. You suspect that even without killing any zombies, they will gradually mutate on their own with the passing of time.]
[Once the zombies mutate to a certain degree, you doubt that this place will necessarily remain safe.]
[However, you are also considering another issue— perhaps the safest place in this world is the sky. As long as you fly high enough, you can effectively avoid the threat of zombies. In other words, finding an airport and taking off before the game officially starts might be a way to clear the stage.]
[Of course, you’re not sure whether birds can also be infected. If so, that would be another problem. In Abyss mode, you think anything could happen.]
