[While you’re still contemplating, an unexpected incident occurs. A loud noise startles all three of you, and the pockmarked-faced man says with a grim expression that the zombies have found them, and some have already reached the underground, trying to break the huge iron door.]
[However, the pockmarked-faced man reassures you and glasses girl, saying there’s no reason to panic. Even though the zombie’s strength is quite impressive, it’s still impossible for it to break through the iron door he had hardened.]
[But he is quickly proven wrong as he watches in horror as the zombie’s power increases rapidly with time. Then, the hardened iron door is blasted away.]
[After the iron door was blasted away, the three of you hiding in the basement see five zombies.]
[Upon seeing them, the pockmarked-faced man changes his expression without hesitation and turns himself into a stone-like statue. Obviously, he had previously hidden some of his talent abilities.]
[As for glasses girl, her face shows fear, seemingly without any intention to hide.]
[With no other choice, you have to act quickly, as the zombies are already rushing towards you. If you don’t counterattack now, you’ll die right here.]
[As a result, you directly use Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. Under its effect, you gain amazing strength, and your physical power rises to a level that can counter the Innate Realm.]
[With the strength of the Innate Realm and your own skills, even the Spiritual Origin Realm would be easily defeated by you. A few heavily mutated zombies, no matter how strong they are, stand no chance against you and are easily defeated.]
[However, you know very well that this is just a temporary solution. As the effect of Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance wears off, you will die right here. Then, you can only rely on Seven-Colored Talent – Resurrection of the Dead to come back to life and try to reach the end by buying time.]
[In the midst of your thinking, glasses girl looks at you with an excited face, expressing her hopes of cooperating with you. Only by working with her can you perhaps clear the Outbreak of the tide of zombies in the Abyss mode.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 - 1088 282 SSS-level rating Astonishing rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1088: Chapter 282: SSS-level rating! Astonishing rewards! _2 Chapter 1088: Chapter 282: SSS-level rating! Astonishing rewards! _2 [You look at the glasses girl and calmly state that the premise of cooperation is to reveal her talent’s true ability and demonstrate her own value. Otherwise, there is no need to cooperate.]
[Hearing your words, the glasses girl’s expression changes and she finally reveals her talent’s true ability. It turns out that her gift is called ·Control of Death. As long as she kills someone, she can resurrect them as her servant.]
[In other words, if the glasses girl kills enough zombies, she may be able to hunt other zombies through snowballing, thereby achieving the goal of clearing the level. Moreover, she may even receive a favorable evaluation.]
[Upon hearing the glasses girl’s story, you are very surprised and think her talent is quite good. Maybe in Myriad Heaven’s Paradise or her world, she has already developed a massive force through this snowballing ability. After all, even some critically wounded or hopeless people might willingly be killed by the glasses girl to be resurrected through this method in order to survive.]
[In this game world, her ability is also extremely useful. Unfortunately, she was overconfident and chose the Abyss mode. As a result, the zombies were too mutated, and her ordinary body couldn’t kill the rapidly mutating zombies to snowball, so she could only hide here with the pockmarked face man.]
[Of course, in your opinion, if the glasses girl’s ability is really like this, it has obvious flaws. If the glasses girl were not foolish, she would kill uninfected ordinary people in advance and resurrect them, thus obtaining zombie minions.]
[However, she does not do this, either because she is too dumb to think of it or because the resurrected human servants undergo some changes that do not serve her purpose.]
[After considering many issues, you choose to cooperate with the glasses girl. Now, you want to find out what her ability is.]
[Just as you agree to cooperate with the glasses girl, the pockmarked face man recovers from the Petrification state and offers to cooperate as well, increasing your combat strength through hardening.]
[In response, you chuckle and directly knock out the pockmarked face man. Due to the gap in power, he is unable to react.]
[Next, you let the glasses girl kill the pockmarked face man and then resurrect him. You want to see what her ability really is.]
[The glasses girl looks at you in fear but dares not disobey your order, choosing to kill the pockmarked face man and then resurrect him.]
[With the resurrection of the pockmarked face man, you finally understand why the glasses girl does not kill ordinary people in advance and then resurrect them. The resurrected man is no longer a human but a fleshless Combat Puppet. Although its combat power gains some improvement, it is far from enough. At the same time, it cannot be infected by zombies.]
[That is to say, it is meaningless for the glasses girl to kill ordinary humans in advance. Instead, it would arouse suspicion among her companions and might even lead to her being arrested by the police. After all, it is still a society ruled by law before the zombies appear.]
[However, without saying much more, you take advantage of the remaining temporary power and lead the glasses girl to kill the zombies, trying to see the limit of her ability.]
[As you go on a killing spree in the city, the glasses girl increases her combat strength by taking advantage of opportunities. You both form a strong front. Since the glasses girl’s Combat Puppets have no flesh and don’t attract the attention and attacks of zombies, the zombie-turned Puppets can slaughter other zombies, thus snowballing your combat power.]
[At this point, you can’t help but feel impressed by the glasses girl’s snowballing ability. Perhaps in her design, she could first cooperate with the pockmarked face man, then kill him by surprise and turn him into her combat doll, and finally use the combat puppets to kill other zombies, achieving the snowball effect.]
[However, due to the formidable defense power exhibited by the pockmarked face man, the glasses girl remains silent. Such a teammate is completely unkillable, even unkillable by surprise, and she can only watch. And relying on her alone to kill zombies is as difficult as reaching the sky.]
[As you two are enjoying yourself slaying the zombies, you notice that the time of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance is almost up, so you start setting a respawn time, planning to test if you could clear the level by sticking to the time.]
[With that, your consciousness falls into darkness, and you collapse on the ground.]
[You suddenly falling to the ground brings joy to the glasses girl’s face. After all, to her, you’ve become more threatening. Then, she plans to check your condition; if you only fainted, she’d kill you, resurrect you, and turn you into her powerful puppet.]
[However, just as she is about to take action, a terrifying zombie appears in front of her, choking her neck and injecting her with a drug, causing her to faint.]
[Then, the terrifying zombie takes the glasses girl and your body away.]
[When you wake up again, you find that you didn’t pass the game and are still in the game world. At this, you are astonished, not understanding whether this is a game mechanism to prevent the deliberate stalling of time or whether it is due to the life simulation, causing an abnormal situation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - 1089 282 SSS Level Rating Astonishing Rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1089: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _3 Chapter 1089: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _3 [Nonetheless, no matter which case it is, you now know one thing. That is, the original Wang Ping obviously couldn’t have passed that test through such a perilous and risky method. In other words, you have to find alternative ways to survive.]
[At this time, you also notice your current situation. That is, you seem to be immersed in a special solution, with lasers around you. Moreover, four unusually large zombies are guarding around.]
[In face of such situation, you frown. You know that you are being confined. Perhaps, it has something to do with the mastermind. The mastermind has been focusing on the situation above ground, and maybe, for them, it’s just an experiment.]
[Very quickly, you start to ease your brows with a slight smile. The current situation, for you, couldn’t be better.]
[After all, you can soon figure out who the mastermind is. Once you know who it is, you have plenty of talents to deal with him. Purple Talent – Fate Connection, Purple Talent·Death Puppet, Golden Talent · Life for Life, and Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine.]
[With so many talents, even if he has several lives, they wouldn’t be enough.]
[Quickly, your circumstances were discovered by a monitor staff member, who showed a horrified look and quickly informed the behind-the-scenes BOSS.]
[Then, the behind-the-scenes BOSS appeared before you, expressing surprise at your resurrection. The only reason he had his zombie subordinates bring you back was because he was amazed that an ordinary human like you could demonstrate such incredible power, and thought your corpse was worth studying. He never expected that your are capable of resurrection.]
[In response, the behind-the-scenes BOSS gave a slight smile, hoping that you could reveal the truth of your abilities, and he would consider letting you go.]
[Hearing this, you laughed sarcastically, immediately activated the Purple Talent·Death Puppet ability, and bound the behind-the-scenes BOSS.]
[Then, you started to harm yourself. As you cut your palm with a blade, the palm of the behind-the-scenes BOSS started bleeding directly, making his pupils contract with a shocked look on his face.]
[Next, you smirked and explained the effect of the Purple Talent·Death Puppet talent, telling him to cooperate fully and reveal all of his secrets. Otherwise, he would be waiting for his death.]
[Your words cast a gloomy expression on the behind-the-scenes BOSS’s face. He didn’t expect you to have such a dangerous ability. However, he didn’t fully believe in your words and began to threaten you.]
[In response, you started to harm yourself again, causing the behind-the-scenes BOSS to bleed all over his body. This made his expression look even worse. Even though he had evolved into the Zombie King, with great power and the ability to command countless zombies, he never imagined that you had such a bizarre ability to transfer injury to him.]
[Yet, he smiled again soon, implying that your ability was good, but it would be useless if you were in a permanent sleep.]
[In response to this, you laughed again, telling him to give it a try. Then, you used the Multicolored Talent·Shureya’s Guillotine and caused the nearby zombie to die instantly.]
[This peculiar way of dying completely silenced the behind-the-scenes BOSS. Apparently, you would be capable of killing him before you fell into eternal sleep.]
[Next, you began to persuade him in a seemingly kind and gentle manner, telling him that as long as he lets you go and agrees to cooperate with you, you would become a perfect Evolved Human, you wouldn’t do anything and would also cooperate with the research to make his evolution even more perfect.]
[Regarding your carrot-and-stick approach, the behind-the-scenes BOSS was not pleased, but he didn’t dare to gamble anymore and could only have peace with you and cooperate.]
[Thus, you learned many secrets and got to know that the name of the behind-the-scenes BOSS was Link Sig. He controlled the research institute that developed the Zombie Virus and had deployed Virus Devices all over the world. Moreover, he detonated them all at the same time a day ago, turning the whole world into the Zombie World.]
[Everything was for research. However, as the plan was launched, they didn’t expect that the rate of mutation among zombies would be so terrifyingly fast. Not only among the zombies in the cities, but even the special zombies they cultivated mutated extremely rapidly, even beyond their expectations for the wild zombies.]
[As for these abnormal phenomena, they didn’t know what was happening, but it undoubtedly excited them. After all, this indicated that their research was correct, and this was the direction for rapid human evolution, and they had ushered in a New Era.]
[Moreover, the emergence of these weird power holders attracted their attention and excited them just as much.]
[You listened to everything from the startup of the research institute to the triggering of the zombie crisis, as well as their philosophies and research plans. Everything is now accounted for.]
[Subsequently, you kept repeating the phrase ‘The portal to the underground research institute is near the van in the tall building’ in your mind, hoping to transmit this intelligence to the original Wang Ping in such a way.]
…
“The free simulation still doesn’t work well, missing a lot of details. I wish it could predict the future accurately, with every detail in my mind. Text Simulation, after all, has too many flaws.”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation, frowned, and sighed.
But, this was good enough, at least he now knew the enemy’s lair’s location.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - 1090 282 SSS Level Rating Astonishing Rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1090: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _4 Chapter 1090: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _4 At least, knowing a lot of information, especially the name of the behind-the-scenes BOSS, would help him pass the level well.
After all, as long as he knows the name of the behind-the-scenes BOSS, he can use various talents to kill the BOSS and directly complete a side quest.
As for the main quest and zombie-slaying Group Task, Wang Ping has an idea in his heart once he gets to the research institute.
Then, Wang Ping continues to stare at the luminescent screen.
The next simulation is quite boring, basically simulating Wang Ping’s attempt to obtain more information.
However, in the end, the zombies mutate too quickly, and even the behind-the-scenes BOSS, Link Sig, can’t control them.
Finally, everyone dies.
That’s it, Simulation End.
“System, I want a free simulation.”
Next, Wang Ping begins to take action, activating Blue Talent·Berserker to enhance his physical strength while traveling, and murmuring in his heart.
Although he has many ideas, time is pressing, and he can’t continue to sit leisurely in the cafe for simulation; he must take action immediately.
Of course, it is necessary to simulate while taking action.
Otherwise, if the plan has problems, it will be embarrassing.
Of course, simulations are just for insurance, and the specific situation may change in reality, so they can’t be fully trusted.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s running speed, far exceeding that of a car, leaves countless passersby stunned.
Even those three players noticed Wang Ping one after another, showing a strange expression, not understanding just what Wang Ping was up to.
Exposing part of their trump card and attracting so much attention before the game had even started is a completely suicidal act.
Unable to care about that, Wang Ping runs with all his might, heading straight for the underground research base.
Because of Wang Ping’s full-speed run, he finally arrives at the entrance of the underground research base ten minutes before the game officially starts.
The security measures here are obviously amazing.
However, this doesn’t stop Wang Ping, who forcibly breaks open the door made of special metal.
As Wang Ping charges in, there are dozens of men in black with guns pointed at him.
Besides, there are zombies staring at Wang Ping.
Obviously, zombies have already appeared; it’s just that the behind-the-scenes BOSS Link Sig hasn’t ordered them to spread worldwide yet.
“Move, I want to see Link, and I want to cooperate with him.”
Wang Ping shouts, causing pain in the ears of the men in black.
At the same time, the sound spreads throughout the entire underground research institute.
“Bring him over.”
Link Sig sits in his office, watching this scene through the monitor, narrows his eyes, and speaks in a deep voice.
He initially thought that the superhuman they had researched was strong enough and had started the era of human evolution, but Wang Ping’s appearance astonished him.
Could ordinary humans also become this powerful, or was Wang Ping an evolved person?
As Link Sig’s voice falls, the men in black immediately withdraw their guns, and one of them takes Wang Ping to Link Sig’s office.
Once Wang Ping sees Link Sig, the behind-the-scenes BOSS, he immediately uses Purple Talent·Death Puppet and then commits self-harm in front of Link.
“My ability is to make a designated object bear the damage I receive. In other words, I control your life now. I have only one request, and that is to delay the spread of the virus to twenty-five hours later; otherwise, I will kill you.”
As Wang Ping commits self-harm, causing Link’s wrist to bleed, he speaks in a deep voice.
Link’s expression changes instantly upon hearing this; he looks at Wang Ping, then at his bleeding wrist, and his face darkens.
Truth be told, he genuinely did not expect Wang Ping, the sudden visitor, not only to be physically strong but also have supernatural abilities.
“And you think I’ll believe your words?”
Link Sig looks unhappy and speaks in a deep voice.
“I believe you’ll trust what I say.”
Wang Ping sneers and commits self-harm again.
This time, he starts bleeding from the throat, causing Link Sig’s face to turn pale.
His goal is to evolve himself and become the perfect new human species.
Now that his dream is not yet realized, he doesn’t want to die.
“I can agree to your request.”
Immediately, Link Sig hurriedly speaks to stop Wang Ping from committing further self-harm.
Although he doesn’t know who Wang Ping is or the purpose of delaying the virus’s spread time, he must comply to save his life.
For this, Link directly dials phone numbers, notifying various teams to delay the virus’s spread.
“Very well, Link, fetch me a cup of coffee next.”
Wang Ping sees Link’s cooperation and nods with satisfaction, sitting very comfortably on the office sofa and asking Link to make him a cup of coffee.
Seeing Wang Ping treating him like a servant, Link’s expression becomes ugly.
However, Link really has to comply, making Wang Ping a cup of coffee.
Then, Wang Ping simply waits for time to pass.
If the side quest one is about killing more zombies and getting a higher rating, does his preventing zombies from appearing mean he’s eliminated all zombies and can get the highest rating?
Or is it that because zombies haven’t appeared, no rating points are given at all?

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - 1091 282 SSS Level Rating Astonishing Rewards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1091: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _5 Chapter 1091: Chapter 282: SSS Level Rating! Astonishing Rewards! _5 Of course, it shouldn’t be that bad, anyways, Wang Ping had killed all the special zombies in the research institute, so his score should be higher.
Before they knew it, twenty-three hours had already passed.
At this moment, the three players in the outer world were bewildered, and they couldn’t find any trace of the zombies.
This made them doubt whether there was a bug in the Heaven Tower.
“Hehe, this isn’t bad either. Although we can’t complete the mission, we can lie down and pass through the Abyss mode, which is quite an amazing harvest,” said the pockmarked face man, watching the live stream on the stolen phone with a joyful face.
“Is this really the Abyss mode? Is it a mistake?” Glasses Girl·Little Milk Cow was puzzled.
“Maybe that player did something. If he really did something, then we can think of it as them helping us pass through the Abyss mode without any harm,” the pockmarked face man analyzed with a glint in his eyes.
“That’s true.”
Glasses Girl·Little Milk Cow pondered.
They believed that Wang Ping’s abnormal behavior meant that he had discovered some pass-through method and had done something to prevent the emergence of the zombies.
If this were the case, then that person’s means were truly terrifying.
If they could find him later and stick to his big legs, maybe they could also have a chance to become a big shot in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Glasses Girl couldn’t help but fantasize.
As the three players were deep in thought, Wang Ping checked the time and found that there was only one minute left before the main quest was completed.
“Lin Ke, thank you for your cooperation,” Wang Ping said with a gentle smile.
“It’s my duty, sir. Is there anything else I can do for you?” Lin Ke felt an ominous feeling and squeezed out a natural smile, very politely.
“I do have one last thing,” Wang Ping chuckled.
“What is it?” Lin Ke asked nervously.
“Please die,” Wang Ping’s mouth twitched into a slight smile as he uttered the words.
Then, Wang Ping injured himself once again, smashing his brain and his heart.
And just like that, Lin Ke died on the spot.
“Ding, twenty-four hours have passed, the main quest has been completed, congratulations to the player for successfully passing through the First Floor of the Heaven Tower’s Game World: Rampaging Zombie Tide.”
A few seconds after Lin Ke Sig had died, the lively voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence sounded.
Then, Wang Ping was wrapped in white light and left the game world, returning to his exclusive room.
Soon after, the voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence rang out once again.
“Ding, detected that the player chose Abyss mode, survived for twenty-four hours and completed the main quest, evaluated as A-tier.”
“Ding, detected that the player successfully killed the behind-the-scenes BOSS Link Sig, evaluation raised, evaluation as S-tier, obtained a special treasure chest.”
“Ding, detected that the player perfectly eliminated all the zombies, evaluation raised, evaluation as SSS tier, obtained an SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest.”
“Ding, global announcement, Player Tianyan, chose Abyss mode, passed through the first floor of Heaven Tower’s game world perfectly, obtained SSS-tier evaluation, became the 99th player to receive SSS-tier evaluation.”
…..
“!!!”
Wang Ping looked at the series of messages appearing on his luminescent screen, feeling quite shocked.
Damn, he got an SSS-tier amazing evaluation right away, and it was even a global announcement. This was way too unreasonable.
However, wouldn’t this make him too high-profile?
“Forget it, who cares, I would become famous sooner or later, since it’s a forced announcement, there’s nothing to change, let’s just accept it,” Wang Ping shook his head and muttered.
“But the lowest evaluation for Abyss mode is A-tier. It’s quite amazing that I can get an A-tier evaluation just by surviving. It seems that if I had chosen simple mode, even if I did the same things, I wouldn’t get such a high evaluation,” Wang Ping thought about the ratings again.
It seemed that without choosing the Abyss mode, it was impossible to hope for the highest SSS-tier evaluation and the best rewards.
“Perhaps only by choosing Abyss mode every time can one hope to reach the top of Heaven Tower and become a single-digit existence,” Wang Ping had this thought in his heart.
However, Wang Ping shook his head quickly, feeling that these things were too far away and there was no need to think too much.
Then, he focused on this time’s rewards, wanting to see what good items he could get.
First, Wang Ping claimed the special treasure chest after killing the behind-the-scenes BOSS.
As for the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, he would open it later. Wang Ping liked to save the good things for last.
As Wang Ping claimed the special treasure chest and opened it, a golden light emerged, and a very special stone appeared before his eyes.
Attached to it were some text introductions.
Rule Stone: Can evolve a six-digit Tier Awakening talent to a five-digit tier.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping was dumbfounded when he saw this reward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - 1092 283 Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1092: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! Chapter 1092: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! Wang Ping hadn’t expected that he would directly receive a Rule Stone here.
He knew that the conditions to participate in special games with Rule Stone rewards required killing an unusual creature worth trillions of group points. This, converted into the basic currency of this world, would be equivalent to one hundred million units of World Source.
“Abyss mode, it’s really so rewarding.”
Wang Ping looked at the Rule Stone in his hand, extremely delighted.
Abyss mode was dangerous, but the rewards were indeed great. Wang Ping felt it was worth it.
And this was only a special reward; he hadn’t even opened the actual SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest yet.
If he opened this SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, what kind of rewards could he receive? It was unimaginable.
Immediately, Wang Ping composed himself and directly claimed the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest.
In an instant, a black treasure chest marked with mysterious patterns appeared in front of Wang Ping.
“Open.”
After touching the patterns on the chest, Wang Ping opened it.
Then, the agile voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence sounded, accompanied by some images and text.
“Ding, congratulations on opening the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, you have obtained the following rewards:
①. Sky Tower Game Character · Physical strength +100.
②. Special Item: Rod of Holy Light.
③. Special Item: Curse Doll.”
Special Item: Rod of Holy Light: A five-digit, entry-tier item. Using this item can evoke a powerful Holy Light. Entry-tier five-digit creatures and those below with dark attributes will definitely suffer massive damage; even those above the five-digit entry level will also be harmed, but the damage effect will weaken as the target’s strength rises.
Meanwhile, the Holy Light has healing and purifying effects.
PS: As a special item produced by the Sky Tower, it can be used in the Sky Tower Game. However, the effects of the item will undergo special adjustments when used in the game.
Special Item: Curse Doll: a five-digit intermediate item. Using this item forms a cursed doll. As long as you know the target’s appearance and name, you can curse the target. The curse doll will turn into the target’s appearance; any damage you inflict upon the doll will be suffered by the cursed target in the same way.
PS: This is a one-time-use item, due to which, its effect is extraordinary strong, even a five-digit limit-level powerhouse can be cursed.
Similarly, this item can also be used in the Sky Tower Game, the effect of the item will be adjusted according to the game.
“Two five-digit items, worthy of being from the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, these rewards are indeed incredible.”
Looking at the wonderful rewards he obtained from the Abyss Treasure Chest, Wang Ping was filled with emotion.
These were merely rewards from the first floor of the Sky Tower’s game world. He couldn’t imagine what kind of rewards would be awaiting him as he climbed higher.
No wonder some bold individuals in Myriad Heavens Paradise choose to challenge the abyss difficulty level in the game world. If they managed to clear it by accident, they would rise directly from a bicycle to a motorbike, and have the opportunity to become a big shot in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
“However, the first reward of the Abyss Treasure Chest is a full attribute boost? It seems that the Sky Tower Game won’t let players continue the game with the physical qualities of ordinary people, but it’s possible to enhance the physical qualities of the player’s character through the rewards from the treasure chest. It feels similar to the role-playing games I’ve played before.”
Wang Ping’s gaze was subtle.
Next, Wang Ping tried to call up his attribute panel. To his surprise, it really did appear.
Name: Wang Ping
Game Name: Heaven Derivative
Gender: Male
Age: 37
Race: Human Race.
Attributes: Physical Strength (110)
Mind (10)
Mystery (10)
Special Skills: None.
Special Items: Rod of Holy Light (five-digit, entry-tier item); Curse Doll (five digit, intermediate item)
PS: Physical Strength represents physical prowess; Mind represents mental strength, the consumption of mental strength is necessary to release special skills obtained from the Sky Tower; Mystery represents resistance to mysterious abilities, which can resist the abilities of the monsters in Sky Tower to a certain extent.
“It seems that it’s really like a character development game. This time I directly increased my physical strength by 100 points, which will give me a significant advantage in the next game.”
Looking at his attribute panel, Wang Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Next, Wang Ping was considering how to leave the Sky Tower and return to the base.
Just as Wang Ping thought about this, he was enveloped in a white light and disappeared, reappearing in the library at the base.
“Has Yuanyuan not returned yet? I hope she can clear her level. The Difficult mode shouldn’t lead her to her death.”
Wang Ping looked around, noticing Lin Yuanyuan’s absence, and couldn’t help but silently wonder.
“However, given Lin Yuanyuan’s talent skills, it seems like they won’t provide much of an advantage in this game world.”
Thinking about Lin Yuanyuan’s abilities, Wang Ping began to worry again.
Just as Wang Ping was feeling a bit worried, the whole Myriad Heavens Paradise shook due to a tower-wide broadcast.
After all, someone had cleared the Abyss mode, and even obtained an SSS-tier rating, which was truly astonishing.
Although, this was just the perfect SSS-tier clearance rating achieved in the first-floor game world, it was still amazing enough.
It’s worth knowing that before Heaven Derivative appeared, only 98 players had achieved this, proving its worth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 1093 283 Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1093: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _2 Chapter 1093: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _2 As a result, Wang Ping became famous in Myriad Heavens Paradise, drawing the interest of ordinary players in the lower tier, four-digit powerhouses in the middle tier, and even some three-digit powerhouses in the upper mid-tier. They were all very surprised and curious about him.
After all, in Myriad Heavens Paradise, those who achieved this feat were bound to become terrifyingly strong in the future, as long as they did not perish along the way. They were worth paying attention to.
However, even though they were very interested in Wang Ping, they couldn’t find his true identity due to the rule of Heaven’s Tower. They could only secretly investigate and hope for a breakthrough.
“Heaven Derivative, could it be Wang Ping…”
Alpha was completely shocked.
She never expected that Wang Ping would be so daring to choose the Abyss difficulty directly and even achieve an SSS grade horror evaluation.
“This doesn’t seem like Wang Ping’s character. He is usually so steady and wouldn’t do such insane things,” she thought.
Alpha’s mind was in turmoil, unable to calm down.
“It must be someone else with the same game name, Heaven Derivative,” Alpha thought quietly, believing this was the truth.
Given Wang Ping’s temperament, it was impossible for him to choose the Abyss mode willingly.
Nevertheless, Alpha was not at peace and decided to find Wang Ping.
When she arrived at the library, she saw Wang Ping leisurely sipping Immortal Tea, looking relaxed and carefree like he had not just experienced a life-or-death game.
“Wang Ping, what difficulty did you choose?”
Seeing Wang Ping’s demeanor, Alpha was convinced he most likely chose the difficult mode, but she couldn’t help but ask him.
“Don’t you know what difficulty I chose?”
Wang Ping asked with a strange look in his eyes.
“Heaven’s Tower has strict confidentiality measures. After entering and leaving Heaven’s Tower, any ability to spy on one’s thoughts becomes useless. If I pry into your thoughts, when your achievements surpass mine, it would be tantamount to committing suicide,” Alpha explained after a moment of silence.
“Haha, that truly is stringent. Heaven’s Tower, not bad at all,” Wang Ping laughed.
“Alpha, I chose the difficult mode. However, I feel that for my own safety, I shouldn’t say it. Also, I think it’s time for you to put an end to your monitoring of my thoughts, or else you might put me in danger,” Wang Ping said meaningfully.
He was not threatening Alpha, nor was he looking down on her because of the terrifying five-digit intermediate item, the Cursed Doll.
He was simply stating a fact.
If Alpha knew his secret, he would indeed be in danger.
After all, those old monsters couldn’t find him through various means, but they might be able to use Alpha as an outsider.
For this reason, Wang Ping felt it was better to be cautious.
At the same time, Wang Ping regretted using the game name Heaven Derivative. He thought that once he returned to the Profound World, he would have to change the memories of everyone who knew him by this name.
Although the name Heaven Derivative was common in All Heavens, Wang Ping still wanted to be cautious.
In the end, Wang Ping never thought that he would be forced to choose the Abyss mode and accidentally obtain an SSS grade horror evaluation.
If he had known beforehand, he would have chosen a difficult mode, remaining an unknown nobody nobody would pay attention to.
“!!!”
Wang Ping’s words made Alpha frown and stare at him.
She knew Wang Ping well. He wouldn’t say such a thing casually, especially to her.
However, since Wang Ping said this, he must have his reasons.
Perhaps…
A terrifying guess appeared in Alpha’s heart, but she quickly suppressed it.
“I understand. I won’t eavesdrop on your thoughts anymore. Since I’ve chosen you, I must trust you completely. Wang Ping, I hope you won’t let me down,” Alpha said, looking deep into Wang Ping’s eyes after a long silence.
“Rest assured, when have I ever let you down?” Wang Ping replied with a smile.
“However, just to be safe, let’s have a game. Using the rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise, we can completely avoid information leaks,” Wang Ping suggested after a pause.
“Alright,” Alpha nodded decisively without saying much.
Next, Alpha and Wang Ping swore an oath with Heaven’s Tower and participated in a game.
Then, Alpha deliberately lost to Wang Ping, ensuring she could not leak his information intentionally.
“Does this count as the weak defeating the strong?” Wang Ping mumbled, rubbing his chin as he looked at the unhappy Alpha after the game.
“Hmph!” Alpha glared at Wang Ping and snorted coldly, expressing her dissatisfaction.
Although she had volunteered, the feeling was still terrible.
After all, her previous two masters had dismantled her twice. When she reached Wang Ping, although he did not dismantle her, she indeed felt like she was being defeated by someone weaker.
Although she knew this day would come eventually, as her growth could not match Wang Ping’s, it had arrived too soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 1094 283 Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1094: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization!_3 Chapter 1094: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization!_3 “Alright, let’s continue to wait for Yuanyuan. I hope she’s okay.”
Wang Ping shook his head and sighed.
“If Lin Yuanyuan dies in the Sky Tower Game, she will be completely dead, and there is no way to revive her.”
Alpha’s voice was cold.
“It doesn’t matter if it’s Lin Yuanyuan, even those with two-digit existences are the same. No matter how many backup plans they have in the outer world, as long as they die in the Sky Tower Game, they will be completely dead, and their backup plans in the outer world will be erased.”
“In Myriad Heavens Paradise, rules are the most powerful force, but they also have different strengths. The rules of Heaven’s Tower are supreme.”
“I know this.”
Wang Ping nodded.
He and Lin Yuanyuan had read so many books together before, so he naturally knew a lot about Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Next, Alpha and Wang Ping continued to wait.
A few minutes later, a white light appeared, and Lin Yuanyuan appeared in front of Wang Ping and Alpha.
This made Wang Ping and Alpha finally breathe a sigh of relief.
“Yuanyuan, congratulations on passing the game.”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and congratulated her.
“Just lucky to have a good teammate.”
Lin Yuanyuan shook her head somewhat fearfully.
Those zombies were too terrifying. If she hadn’t met such a powerful teammate, she might really have died in the game.
This Sky Tower Game seemed not too friendly to talents like her.
“Luck is also a part of strength.”
Wang Ping smiled.
“Speaking of which, Mr. Wang….”
At this moment, Lin Yuanyuan hesitated and wanted to ask something.
“Don’t ask, don’t think, just play a game with me.”
Wang Ping knew what Lin Yuanyuan wanted to ask and did the same thing as Alpha.
Hearing this, Lin Yuanyuan was stunned and then obediently cooperated with Wang Ping to play the game.
From now on, Lin Yuanyuan couldn’t possibly reveal Wang Ping’s secret.
“Alpha, how do I use the Rule Stone to optimize the Golden Finger?”
Wang Ping took out the Rule Stone and asked.
“Rule Stone…?”
Alpha was shocked, not expecting Wang Ping to get such a reward.
“It’s simple, just connect your mind to the Rule Stone and silently think about optimizing your talent.”
Alpha gave an answer after the initial shock.
“Oh, that seems easy.”
Wang Ping smiled and performed the operation.
Then, the Rule Stone emitted light, and what appeared to be runes of rules emerged, merging into Wang Ping’s body.
Next, Wang Ping felt his Life Simulator reacted and was optimized, becoming a five-digit tier talent.
As the Life Simulator became a five-digit tier talent, its operation mechanism underwent a significant change that Wang Ping had long dreamed of.
Free simulation remained unchanged.
As for the paid simulation, there was a significant change.
After the text simulation process, a complete memory scene would appear in Wang Ping’s mind, without any omissions of information.
This was a significant improvement compared to before. After all, previously, to achieve this effect, an immersive simulation was needed, but the cost of immersive simulation was the passage of too much time in the real world, putting oneself in danger.
At the same time, it was proven during the Sky Tower challenge that immersive simulation was indeed dangerous. If it weren’t for being able to switch to normal text simulation, Wang Ping would have been in real danger.
Secondly, the talent level no longer adhered to the seven-color scale, but used the mechanism of Myriad Heavens Paradise for grading, ensuring at least six-digit talents and even being able to refresh five-digit talents.
In addition, the reward mechanism had also changed.
For example, with Cultivation Reward, after receiving it, it would no longer be directly infused into Wang Ping, instantly elevating him to that realm. Instead, Wang Ping would have a process of cultivation experience.
However, this cultivation process, with the help of the Life Simulator, would be very short, but it would have a magical effect as if he had cultivated for a long time.
As for the resource consumption problem of paid simulation, that had also changed.
That was, the resource consumption remained the same as the cultivation improvement, but the resources of the Life Simulator were no longer fixed, and could be either resources of the Profound World or World Source.
However, unless in critical situations, Wang Ping thought that the likelihood of using World Source for simulation would be low.
“My talent is truly terrifying.”
After learning about all the evolved abilities of the Life Simulator, Wang Ping sighed with emotion.
Others’ talents only had one, and most were not strong.
As for him, he had a mere five-digit talent but could refresh various talents at will, ensuring at least six digits, and even refreshing five-digit talents, fully capable of mass-producing talents.
Wang Ping alone could form a terrifying Myriad Heavens Forces with full bug talents.
Of course, this was based on the premise that he was willing to give his talents to others.
“Six-digit Talent·To Get Strong by Having Disciples is useless to me now and can be sold. Six-digit Talent·Instant Death Attack seems useless but maybe useful in the Sky Tower Game, so I can’t sell it. Seven-color Talent·Running God…not sure if it still works in the Immortal Domain, whether to sell or not is undecided.”
Afterwards, Wang Ping pondered the issue of his seven-color talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 1095 283 Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1095: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _4 Chapter 1095: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _4 The abilities type is definitely not for sale. However, talents like the Six-digit Talent·To Get Strong by Having Disciples that are no longer useful to him can be considered for sale.
Of course, before selling, he still needs to try if it’s possible to take in disciples in the Sky Tower Game. If it’s also possible, then he shouldn’t sell it. However, he felt that it shouldn’t work.
Besides, although it’s said to be for sale, it’s actually a pity to sell this talent, and it can be completely dealt with through hiring.
After all, as long as one has this talent, theoretically they can become stronger quickly.
Maybe there’s still a problem of Enlightenment in Profound World, but there may not be such a problem in some other worlds.
If it’s really possible to use this Seven-Color Talent to quickly allow people in the Myriad Heavens Paradise to reach the level of a six-digit legend, then the value of this talent is undoubtedly astonishing.
“Wang Ping, how is it going? Has your talent been successfully optimized?”
Alpha looked at Wang Ping lost in thought and couldn’t help but to ask with concern.
Lin Yuanyuan also looked at Wang Ping curiously.
“It’s been optimized successfully. But as for the specific abilities, I won’t say for now. In short, our force will definitely take off.”
Wang Ping smiled and said.
“…..”
Alpha remained silent, feeling very upset.
Now, Wang Ping had completely escaped her control and began to hide everything from her.
“Alpha, I always feel there is more and more emotional change in you. It seems that you finally have a human heart.”
Wang Ping looked at Alpha’s appearance and teased with a smile.
“Don’t worry, I’ve said before that I’m very grateful to you and won’t dismantle you.”
Wang Ping paused and continued.
“And I’ve said before, I believe you.”
Alpha calmed down her emotions and spoke lightly.
Then, Alpha looked at Lin Yuanyuan and asked, “Lin Yuanyuan, what’s your rating? What rewards did you get?”
Seeing Alpha asking Lin Yuanyuan, Wang Ping also looked over, very curious about Lin Yuanyuan’s rating and rewards.
“I… I just got an E-tier rating and got an E-tier treasure chest, which gave me a +5 physique bonus and a special item that’s a seven-digit top tier, which can increase my combat power for a short time.”
Lin Yuanyuan said awkwardly.
“E-tier rating? It’s as expected. But being able to get a seven-digit top tier item reward with an E-tier rating? The Heaven Tower is really generous.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he shook his head slightly.
Seven-digit top tier items seemed useless, but they were special items. Although they might not have much use in the outer world, they were valuable since they can be used in the Heaven Tower.
Of course, this was just a combat enhancement item, not an ability-type item, so its value would be relatively smaller.
“Yuanyuan, you should team up with me to challenge the tower in the future. Of course, if you’re scared, forget it.”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and said.
For the first floor of the Heaven Tower, it was impossible to form a team for the initial trial, but on the second floor, teams could be formed.
However, people generally wouldn’t choose to team up with a weakling to challenge Abyss mode. That would be suicidal.
After all, the number of participants in a game was fixed. Having one more burden meant having one less powerful teammate, which could potentially doom everyone.
As a result, people in Myriad Heavens Paradise hated the behavior of teaming up with weaklings.
But after optimizing the Golden Finger, Wang Ping had enough confidence to think that he could help Lin Yuanyuan soar to the sky.
By then, Lin Yuanyuan would grow faster and gain more rewards.
“Forget it, Mr.Wang, I don’t want to drag you down. Let’s just stay with Difficult mode.”
Lin Yuanyuan said with a bitter smile.
“If you don’t want to, then forget it.”
Wang Ping shook his head and didn’t force Lin Yuanyuan to join him in challenging the Abyss mode.
“Wang Ping, aren’t you going to rest? Are you planning to continue challenging the tower?”
Alpha frowned and asked.
Challenging the tower continuously is a suicidal behavior.
After all, who wouldn’t want to delay as much time as possible, strengthening themselves and trying to acquire various special items before challenging the tower again.
The first floor of the Heaven Tower was an unavoidable matter.
When people first arrived at Myriad Heavens Paradise, they had to challenge the tower within three days, or else they would be punished.
And for those born in Myriad Heavens Paradise, they would also have to challenge the tower after reaching a certain age.
After clearing the first floor, they would have enough breathing room. Many people would choose to delay until the 10,000-year time limit came before challenging the tower again.
Some wealthy people would even buy delay cards to continue dragging the time.
“I won’t challenge the tower continuously.”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes.
Jokingly, although his current foundation was much stronger than other players, Wang Ping wasn’t in a hurry.
Delaying for some time, waiting for him to draw powerful talents to continue upgrading himself, or finding more special items would be great.
After clearing the Sky Tower Game and obtaining an SSS tier rating, Wang Ping was not arrogant or complacent. On the contrary, he had a greater awe for the Heaven Tower.
The Sky Tower Game was not a joke.
“That’s good. I’m just afraid you would seek death.”
Alpha breathed a sigh of relief.
“I won’t seek death, unless I’m careless. Alpha, I’m going back to the Profound World.”
Wang Ping shook his head and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 1096 283 Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1096: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _5 Chapter 1096: Chapter 283: Opening the SSS Abyss Treasure Chest! Golden Finger Optimization! _5 “It’s good to return. Although you can grow rapidly by participating in various games, I am also worried about those guys in the Second Generation Chat Group causing trouble. Before you reach a five-digit level, you are still somewhat in danger.”
Alpha nodded and spoke.
“So, it’s better to return quickly while they haven’t noticed you. Perhaps going to the Immortal Domain would be more conducive to your growth. As long as you become strong enough, powerful talents won’t be able to affect you.”
“That’s what I’m thinking.”
Wang Ping nodded.
In Myriad Heavens Paradise, talent is indeed more important, but the importance of Spirit Grid should not be overlooked either.
Because if one’s Spirit Grid is strong enough, an abnormal-level talent will not affect the person with a powerful Spirit Grid.
For example, a six-digit talent would find it difficult to affect a five-digit powerhouse with a five-digit Spirit Grid. Even if that talent is abnormal and could affect a five-digit powerhouse, it will still be very difficult to directly kill them. Many times, it can only disgust or interfere with the opponent and assist teammates in combat.
“Yuanyuan, do you want to go back?”
Wang Ping looked at Lin Yuanyuan and asked.
“I want to go back and continue doing group tasks. Only by earning a large amount of World Source and then trying to obtain the Rule Stone can I optimize my talent and become stronger.”
Lin Yuanyuan said firmly.
“Yuanyuan, that’s why you are the task model.”
Wang Ping teased with a smile.
“By the way, Wang Ping, didn’t you want to break through in Myriad Heavens Paradise using the special cultivation room? As long as you conceal your identity to participate in games, you can earn World Source and then practice in the special cultivating room.”
Alpha thought of something and said.
“Forget it. It’s meaningless for me to stay in Myriad Heavens Paradise and spend a huge amount of World Source to quickly break through. I’ll go back and practice.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
Although he wanted to earn more World Source to help with his paid simulation,
however, Wang Ping was still a bit wary of the predecessor transmigrators in the Second Generation Chat Group, even though he had already obtained a five-digit mid-tier special item, the Cursed Doll.
Before his strength truly rose, it was better not to take risks for caution’s sake.
Initially, when Wang Ping came to Myriad Heavens Paradise, he didn’t expect Alpha’s situation to be so bad that he was constantly being watched by the predecessor transmigrators of the Second Generation Chat Group.
“Alright then.”
Alpha nodded without saying much more.
Next, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan summoned their Paradise Pass and chose to return to their original world.
Soon, Wang Ping and Lin Yuanyuan were wrapped in a white light and disappeared, leaving Alpha somewhat lost.
…..
“Have I returned? From now on, everything will be under my control.”
As soon as Wang Ping’s vision shifted, he showed a confident expression and thought to himself.
After the optimization of the Golden Finger, he had nothing to fear, whether he was in the Upper Realm or the Immortal Domain.
“Mr. Wang, there’s a new task. I’ll go and do it first.”
Lin Yuanyuan returned and immediately opened the chat group, grabbed a group task, and said.
At this, Wang Ping subtly nodded, then watched Lin Yuanyuan, the task model, leave.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t choose to practice in seclusion but started his paid simulation.
“System, I want to start a paid simulation.”
Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming two billion catties of top-tier divine source, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successfully, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the six-digit Talent: Dragon’s Wrath.”
Six-digit Talent: Dragon’s Wrath: If the host possesses the bloodline of the Dragon Clan, they can thoroughly stimulate the power of the bloodline and unleash the powerful force called Dragon’s Wrath.
“So, it turns out to be the guaranteed six-digit talent. But this six-digit talent is of no use to me.”
Wang Ping looked at the newly refreshed talent and sighed in frustration after admiring it for a moment.
After all, Wang Ping didn’t have the bloodline of the Dragon Clan. Even if he wanted to use it, he couldn’t.
“It doesn’t seem right…”
Wang Ping’s gaze became strange, thinking of what had happened during the life simulation experience.
When he was trapped in the mysterious setup of the secret realm, he had engaged in dual cultivation with Huan Qing and Huangyin.
At that time, by dual cultivating with Huan Qing and Huangyin, he obtained a part of the Phoenix bloodline and source, possessing the ability to undergo the Nirvana Rebirth of the Phoenix.
“Which means if I repeat such an operation and find a pure-blooded Dragon Clan member to engage in dual cultivation, I might also inherit the bloodline of the pure-blooded Dragon Clan, thus having the qualification to use the Dragon’s Wrath talent.”
Wang Ping muttered to himself.
However, he had been to several worlds without encountering a Perfect Emperor Stage pure-blooded Dragon Clan, let alone a quasi-Fairy level mother dragon. The difficulty of using this talent was indeed a bit high.
“Forget it. Let’s not worry about it. I’ll find or cultivate a pure-blooded Dragon Clan with enough cultivation strength in the life simulation. If it still doesn’t work, I’ll give up on this six-digit talent and take it to Myriad Heavens Paradise for trading. No matter what, I won’t lose.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and mumbled.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1097: Chapter 284: Opportunities Are in Hand! Breaking Through to Quasi-Fairy! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly tickets!) Chapter 1097: Chapter 284: Opportunities Are in Hand! Breaking Through to Quasi-Fairy! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly tickets!) “System, I choose the six-digit talent: Dragon’s Wrath.”
Then, Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text also emerged.
[On the first day, you know that after entering the simulation state, Leng Yue will become your enemy, so you must avoid him. However, you don’t want to use the 5-digit mid-tier special item: Curse Doll on Leng Yue, because that would be overkill. After all, this is a terrifying item that can even curse and kill Quasi Fairy Kings, using it against a quasi-Fairy is really a waste. Even if Leng Yue is not an ordinary quasi-Fairy, the same applies.]
[So you decided to resolve the problem of the title Heaven Derivative first, and after settling many causes and effects, you directly used the six-digit talent: God of Escaping, intending to safely go to other worlds.]
[You have to say that you were very lucky this time, as you were directly teleported to another world, and it was a world where Empress Qingyuan, whom you have visited before, resides. Your sudden disappearance caught Leng Yue’s attention. However, he did not do much and just quietly watched. He could feel that after you went to Myriad Heavens Paradise, something astonishing happened.]
[Because of this, he guessed that the day when you could defeat him might not be far away. What kind of fate will he have then? He doesn’t know but is quite calm, having long been prepared to face anything.]
…..
“Senior Leng Yue is still Senior Leng Yue, it seems like he has already mentally prepared for me to kill him after I become stronger, and still has no fear about it.”
Wang Ping watched the text simulation’s content and sighed in his heart.
“But, although I will defeat you after getting stronger, I will not kill you. After all, you are also a pitiful person, and at the same time, a respectable Predecessor Ransmigrator, who has indeed helped me a lot in reality.”
Wang Ping paused, his eyes flickering as he silently thought.
While Wang Ping was thinking, the text simulation continued.
[Stepping across worlds, you came to the world where Empress Qingyuan resides, and the world started to tremble instantly, with various phenomena emerging.]
[No way to avoid it, you were too strong. Although you not a quasi-Fairy, you were far stronger than an ordinary quasi-Fairy. With no intention of concealing it, you forcefully broke through the boundary and naturally triggered the stress response of this world.]
[This caused the powerful cultivators of this world to reveal shock, unsure of what happened.]
[You didn’t care about the thoughts of the cultivators in this world, and with a step, you left the original place and went to the Qingyuan Imperial Palace. When you suddenly appeared in front of Empress Qingyuan, her pupils shrank, and she was startled.]
[Then, she directly erupted with Emperor’s Might, instinctively attacking you. This strike did not hold back at all, displaying the power of a Top-Tier Great Emperor. Faced with this strike, you just smiled, reached out a finger, touched it in the air, and directly shattered Empress Qingyuan’s Divine Skills.]
[This caused Empress Qingyuan’s face to stiffen, filled with disbelief and some fear. She was a Top-Tier Great Emperor, and although her strike just now was hasty, there should be no one that could easily take it like that, not even an Emperor Monarch could do that. Obviously, your power had already surpassed her understanding.]
[Looking at Empress Qingyuan, the old acquaintance that was frightened by you, you smiled and said, ‘Don’t be nervous, I just came here to borrow a place to break through, and help you solve a problem by the way.’]
[To this, Empress Qingyuan looked at you with reverence and curiosity, asking about your origin.]
[You gave a slight smile and told her that her past enemy had reached the level of a Top-Tier Great Emperor and would be coming to kill her along with a Late-stage Great Emperor.]
[Your words made Empress Qingyuan’s pupils tense, and she guessed who you were talking about, causing her some doubts. However, in the end, she chose to believe you.]
[Because a senior like you, whose cultivation seemed to surpass that of Great Emperors and reached an unfathomable level, wouldn’t tell such easily punctured lies. Moreover, you also had no reason to deceive her.]
[For this reason, Empress Qingyuan held various thoughts in her heart and thanked you deeply with a bow, stating that she would be on guard against them.]
[In response, you told her not to worry since they were going to die soon. This remark made Empress Qingyuan slightly stunned, as she didn’t understand the meaning of your words. Because your words now and your previous words seemed very contradictory.]
[Soon, Empress Qingyuan understood the meaning of your words. As you pinched a seal, an illusory figure appeared, emitting Immortal Light. This Immortal Light pierced through the Void and instantly entered the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky.]
[Following that, the blood-rain phenomenon of Great Emperors falling one after another appeared. The process was very fast and did not take more than ten seconds.]
[This scene caused Empress Qingyuan to feel shock and fear, as her scalp tingled. After all, two Great Emperors, who were not ordinary Great Emperors, just fell like that, and they were killed by someone directly suppressing them from such a far distance. It was really terrifying.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 1098 284 Opportunities are all in hand
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1098: Chapter 284: Opportunities are all in hand! Breaking Through to Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for Monthly Tickets – 10,000-word chapter!)_2 Chapter 1098: Chapter 284: Opportunities are all in hand! Breaking Through to Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for Monthly Tickets – 10,000-word chapter!)_2 [For this reason, she is now very grateful, fortunate that you are not her enemy but rather very friendly towards her. Otherwise, with such a person in the world, she would not be able to sleep soundly.]
[Then, Empress Qingyuan couldn’t help but sigh, saying that everyone believes the Emperor is the pinnacle of existence in this world, but now it seems, even an Emperor is just a frog at the bottom of a well, merely an ant that can be crushed by even stronger beings.]
[Hearing this, you also feel some emotion, saying that the world is vast and the Emperor truly doesn’t amount to much. Not to mention the Emperor, even if it’s a Quasi-Fairy, or even a Fairy, they can’t be considered truly powerful.]
[However, in this world, even the existence of Quasi-Fairies is unknown, let alone that of Fairies. Therefore, they believe that the Emperor is the end of their cultivation, and it is normal for Empress Qingyuan to have such feelings after meeting you.]
[The words you speak bring a surprised look to Empress Qingyuan’s face, and she asks if the realm of Fairy is above that of the Emperor.]
[On this matter, you provide an answer. This makes Empress Qingyuan even more curious and admires you greatly. She believes that you must have already become a Fairy, otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to do such amazing things.]
[You notice Empress Qingyuan’s anxiety and lightly say that you have not yet become a Fairy but are still at the level of great emperor cultivation. It’s just that your combat power is a bit stronger, and you came here to break through the Quasi-Fairy Tier.]
[Your words shock Empress Qingyuan. She thought that Wang Ping had already become a Fairy, but it turns out that you have only the cultivation of a great emperor. What is going on with this combat power? She thinks that it’s not just a matter of being a bit stronger, but rather being billions of times stronger!]
[In Empress Qingyuan’s eyes, your terrifying combat power is already superior to that of a Quasi-Fairy!]
[Next, Empress Qingyuan suddenly bows to you, expressing her desire to become your follower and hoping that you teach her the secrets of becoming a Fairy. This scene is also unexpectedly witnessed by a Quasi-Emperor Ancestor of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, who is left dumbfounded and terrified.]
[As for Empress Qingyuan’s request, after some consideration, you feel that Empress Qingyuan could help you with certain things. So, you accept her.]
[Your words bring joy to Empress Qingyuan’s face, and she quickly swears loyalty. For Empress Qingyuan, becoming someone’s follower may seem somewhat humble, but she doesn’t mind. As the saying goes, “It is better to hear the Way in the morning and die in the evening.” She doesn’t have to die and yet has the opportunity to learn the secrets of becoming a Fairy. Could anything be more worthwhile?]
[Moreover, following a mysterious powerhouse like you, who can unleash the Quasi-Fairy King’s combat power with the cultivation of a great emperor, is not a shameful thing at all.]
[Seeing the joyful Empress Qingyuan, you can’t help but sigh at the great temptation of becoming a Fairy. Then, you ask Empress Qingyuan to do something – to obtain the Ghost Valley Stone from Ghost Valley Cliff.]
[According to ancient records in this realm, Ghost Valley Cliff is extremely mysterious, and even a great emperor will inevitably fall once entering it. As a result, the cultivators in this realm are very cautious about it.]
[However, the cultivators in this realm do not know the origin of Ghost Valley Cliff, while Wang Ping does because he has spent a long time in this world and has obtained various treasures offered to him by his ‘disciples’. Among them, he used the Breaking Origin Sky Eye to see the secret hidden in one item and learned the secret of Ghost Valley Cliff.]
[Ghost Valley Cliff was a secret place created by the immortals of this realm before the Immortal Domain Channel was closed. There is a Ghost Valley Stone within it, absorbing the essence of Heaven and Earth. After so many years, the level of the Ghost Valley Stone has risen to an astonishing level, and it can be used to forge Immortal Artifacts.]
[Ghost Valley Cliff appears once every 100,000 years, and there are still 500 years before its next appearance. Previously, the simulated Wang Ping had not gone in and had no ability to do so, but now there is an opportunity to obtain it in order to forge his own Life-bound Immortal Artifact.]
[Of course, to forge an Immortal Artifact, one needs Immortal Source. However, for Wang Ping, that’s not a problem. With the Devouring Immortal Bead, Wang Ping can completely go to various worlds, slaughter the Dark Emperors and Dark Psuedo Immortals of that world, and refine the Immortal Source.]
[Though it also takes some time, that amount of time is nothing in front of the gains. Besides, the original Wang Ping can completely do this with the life simulation, and it won’t take much time in reality. In reality, it can be refreshed through the rewards of the Life Simulator, which has been upgraded and can refresh Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Source rewards.]
[As for the issue of the emperor falling, you don’t see it as a problem. Ghost Valley Cliff is a place of Yin Evil, and you have something to counteract it.]
[At this moment, Empress Qingyuan is also startled, and then expresses with some solemnity that she wants to help you obtain the Ghost Valley Stone, but her strength is too weak and she will definitely fall within it. If she died, it would be nothing, but the key is that she couldn’t complete the task, causing you, her master, to miss the Ghost Valley Stone, which would be a grave sin.]
[Hearing this, you chuckle and reassure Empress Qingyuan that you will provide her with a method to conquer Ghost Valley Cliff, and she doesn’t need to worry about falling there.]
[Afterward, you take out the Rod of Holy Light from your inner world, explaining that it is the Rod of Holy Light and that, in terms of rank, it can be considered an Immortal Artifact, but it’s more powerful than ordinary Immortal Artifacts. With this in hand, all the Yin Evil items in the Ghost Valley Cliff will turn to ashes and cannot hurt her.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 1099 284 The Opportunity is in Hand Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1099: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _3 Chapter 1099: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _3 “The Rod of Holy Light is your exclusive tool. Should you desire, you can reclaim it at will; it cannot be forcibly taken by others.”
“This is the advantage of the special items awarded by the Tian Tower. Protected by the tower, unless the owner dies or loses the game, these special items cannot be forcibly taken by others.”
“Hearing this, Empress Qingyuan, staring at the white rod in your hand, revealed an incredulous look. She was utterly amazed, thinking that you, as her master, were incredibly extravagant. Immortal Artifacts, items only immortals could use, you casually produced one and even let her use it.”
“Subsequently, Empress Qingyuan accepted the Rod of Holy Light, touching it with an air of adoration. She was overjoyed and confident that with the Immortal Artifact within her grasp, she would surely accomplish her mission and retrieve the Ghost Valley Stone.”
“You nodded your head, signifying your belief in her. Then, extending your index finger you lightly touched Empress Qingyuan’s forehead, teaching her the Ghost Valley Cliff attack methods recorded in the ancient books. Then, you disappeared.”
“After you left, Empress Qingyuan reacted, her heart stirred. She respectfully acknowledged you in the direction you had exited. Then, she reminded the Quasi-emperor Ancestor who had witnessed everything to keep silent about what he had seen. Following this, she began preparations to challenge Ghost Valley Cliff after five hundred years.”
“You didn’t pay any attention to the subsequent events at the Qingyuan Imperial Palace. You had already arrived at the secret site of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace and began your secluded cultivation. You consumed the Devouring Immortal Bead, strenuously refining the corpses of the Dark Emperor and the Dark Psuedo Immortal, and concentrating the Immortal Source. In the meantime, you were preparing to break through the quasi-Fairy Tier.”
“In the blink of an eye, five hundred years had passed. You refined the Immortal Source and began your breakthrough with the help of the Immortal Source.”
“Simultaneously, after five hundred years, Ghost Valley Cliff had appeared. Empress Qingyuan intruded into it. Using the Rod of Holy Light and the attack methods you taught her, she calmly entered Ghost Valley Cliff and took away the Ghost Valley Stone.”
“This incident made Empress Qingyuan even more respectful and reverent towards you, her master. Because the ‘Immortal Artifact’, the Rod of Holy Light, was truly powerful beyond her imagination, the absolute nemesis of Yin Evil Items. She even suspected that even an evil spirit that had reached immortality could not resist the holy light from the Rod of Holy Light.”
“And such an overpowering Immortal Artifact was casually given to her by Wang Ping. This relaxed and casual manner was as if he had given her an ordinary item. She wondered if even an immortal could do it like how he did. Therefore, in Empress Qingyuan’s heart, although you her master, were not an immortal, your ability and manipulations had surpassed that of an immortal.”
“Though Empress Qingyuan didn’t know the true strength and methods of an immortal, she had an unshakable conviction about this.”
“When Empress Qingyuan safely left Ghost Valley Cliff, she was attacked by Honglian Emperor. He was also aware of the legends of Ghost Valley Cliff and had seen Empress Qingyuan immediately entering it after its opening.”
“Now that Empress Qingyuan had emerged unscathed, Honglian Emperor believed that she knew the secrets of Ghost Valley Cliff and had received its privileges. Otherwise, how could she, a Top-Tier Great Emperor, manage to survive.”
“Therefore, Honglian Emperor demanded that Empress Qingyuan reveal the method of safely entering and exiting Ghost Valley Cliff and surrender the privileges she had obtained.”
“At this, Empress Qingyuan scoffed and expressed disdain, seeing Honglian Emperor as a contemptuous fool. She then stated that if Honglian Emperor dared to make a move, it would be a direct offense towards her master and he would inevitably perish.”
“Empress Qingyuan’s words made Honglian Emperor’s pupils shrink, feeling a bit unsure. After all, a being that could make a Top-Tier Great Emperor like Empress Qingyuan acknowledge him as her master should not theoretically exist, not even someone of the Emperor Lord tier could accomplish this. Hence, he suspected that someone in this world had advanced to a level above a Great Emperor before him.”
“After all, only beings of that level could possibly make a top-tier Great Emperor willingly acknowledge their master. Additionally, he also recalled the mysterious demise of two Great Emperors five hundred years ago.”
“It was rumored that the late-stage Great Emperor was in the Imperial Palace cultivating when he suddenly died in a bizarre manner. This was beyond the abilities of an Emperor Lord. On top of that, the fact that Empress Qingyuan mysteriously entered Ghost Valley Cliff and came out unscathed made Honglian Emperor feel an ominous premonition”
“But then, Honglian Emperor’s face darkened. He was unwilling to let anyone surpass him to that level. He snorted and summoned a red lotus, ready to attack Empress Qingyuan.”
“This tremendous power fluctuation naturally attracted the attention of nearby Great Emperors. They were astonished that Honglian Emperor would attack Empress Qingyuan”
“Seeing that Honglian Emperor was about to make a move, Empress Qingyuan shook her head. Facing Honglian Emperor’s attack, she had no intention of retaliating or defending, which made him furrow his brows and feel even more uneasy. The watching Great Emperors were confused.”
“And then, an ethereal figure suddenly appeared in front of Empress Qingyuan and casually destroyed Honglian Emperor’s attack. This scene frightened Honglian Emperor and he instinctively retreated a considerable distance. The figure in front of him was clearly just an incarnation, merely the incarnation of a Great Emperor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 1100 284 The Opportunity is in Hand Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1100: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _4 Chapter 1100: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _4 The Honglian Emperor, however, distinctly felt a sense of fatal danger. This inevitably led him to suspect that the entity before him was the master that Empress Qingyuan had mentioned.
Just as the Honglian Emperor had guessed, this figure was indeed your incarnation. After you appeared, you also indicated that since the Honglian Emperor wished to court death, you would be the one to oblige him.
Furious at your contempt, the Honglian Emperor unleashed all his power, coalescing it into his strongest Divine Skill, intent on destroying this particular avatar of yours.
Nonplussed at the Honglian Emperor’s assault, you responded with an evaluation: “An ant trying to shake a tree; you overestimate yourself.”
Then, your incarnation clinched its hands together. The Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill burst forth, giving rise to endless Immortal Light, which transmuted into Celestial Spirit Chains. It broke through the colossal red lotus and simultaneously bound the Honglian Quasi-Emperor, sealing his energy and suppressing him entirely.
The Honglian Emperor is the first emperor cultivated from an astonishing red lotus, a World-Shocking Treasure Medicine. In previous simulations, you didn’t have enough power to easily subdue the Honglian Emperor. You could only kill them and waste such rare medicine.
However, now that you’re strong enough, of course you wouldn’t miss out on this World-Shocking Treasure Medicine. After all, this fellow loves courting his own death. Wang Ping suppressed him, captured him, erased his divine intellect, and kept him in his original form without any psychological burden.
The Honglian Emperor was stunned to discover that he had been instantly suppressed, his power also sealed. The sheer extent of this supreme power left him astonished. He could only sense that this power was above that of great emperors, far surpassing imperial divine powers.
As for the Honglian Emperor’s fear, you responded, stating that it was the superior power over the great emperors he had been yearning for, the power of Immortal Skills. He had spent his lifetime pursuing the power above the great emperors. Now being suppressed by Immortal Skills does technically fulfill his dream.
Upon hearing this, the Honglian Emperor was taken aback, then let out a mournful laugh. The realm and power he had pursued his entire life, the sacrifices he had made for the sake of becoming a god, and now he was being suppressed by the power of a god and seemingly about to be devoured alive — it was tragically ironic indeed.
Your incarnation gazed at the desolately laughing Honglian Emperor, no longer uttering a word. After Empress Qingyuan took the Honglian Emperor back to the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, your incarnation disappeared.
As for this, Empress Qingyuan naturally obeyed your orders and quickly returned to the Qingyuan Imperial Palace.
This fight finally concluded, but it left emperors who watched the battle unable to calm down. After all, they also learned some information about gods and knew that a human-god had appeared in the world. Soon afterward, they also thought of the terrifying spectacle five hundred years ago and speculated in their hearts.
In the blink of an eye, another thousand years passed. During these thousand years, no earth-shattering war occurred in this realm. All the strong beings became quiet because of what had happened a thousand years ago, and they tried their best to visit Empress Qingyuan and improve their relationships.
This created a dominant force at the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, which became the most authoritative power due to the influence of your incarnation’s actions.
However, Empress Qingyuan didn’t pay attention to the development of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace. What she cared the most was when her master Wang Ping would be able to break through to the quasi-Fairy tier.
Just as Empress Qingyuan was deeply worried, a terrifying aura suddenly erupted from a secret place belonging to the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, sweeping across the Cosmic Starry Sky. It was the aura of a Quasi-Emperor.
At the same time, an even more amazing Chaos anomaly also appeared in this world, shocking many cultivators. This made those who knew some secrets speculate that the master of Empress Qingyuan had made another breakthrough, perhaps from a human god to a real god.
In a moment, many cultivators could not calm down, witnessing the joy of the birth of gods again, with the longing for becoming gods and the envy of you becoming gods.
However, they were more in awe of Wang Ping from the bottom of their hearts, and immediately set off for the Qingyuan Imperial Palace. In the eyes of other emperors, since Empress Qingyuan could serve Wang Ping, they could do the same. In order to become gods, they could put down their so-called emperor’s dignity.
At the same time, in the Source of Darkness, two deep sleeping Dark Quasi Immortals were awakened by your breakthrough. When you came to this realm, they sensed something and speculated that a Quasi-Immortal from another world had breached into this realm.
But since there’s no feud or grievance, they naturally would not engage in a fight with this Quasi-Immortal for the so-called protection of this realm. After all, they are Dark Quasi Immortals, not ordinary Quasi-Immortals.
Not to mention, even if they were not Dark Quasi Immortals, in their view, ordinary Quasi Immortals who would go to war with other Quasi Immortals over such trivial matters do not exist. As for when your incarnation suppressed the Honglian Emperor, it was too subtle to disturb them.
But at this moment, such a big movement finally woke up these two Dark Quasi Immortals who had attacked you in previous life simulations.
Because of this, they stepped out of the Source of Darkness together, looked in the direction of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, and looked solemn. The First Dark Quasi Immortal said that this anomaly was similar to the one more than a thousand years ago, but it was much stronger. He speculated that it was done by the same person.
The Second Dark Senior Immortal agreed with the First Dark Quasi Immortal’s words, saying that you were too terrifying. Before breaking through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier, you could stimulate the Quasi-Immortal Tier anomaly and had very strong combat power. Now that you have broken through to the Quasi-Immortal Tier, your combat power would undergo a qualitative change, posing a great threat to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 1101 284 The Opportunity is in Hand Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1101: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _5 Chapter 1101: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _5 [The First Dark Quasi Immortal laughed, suggesting they could strike you at the critical moment of your breakthrough before you’ve completed it, which could result in your failure and even backlash.]
[The First Dark Quasi Immortal stated that you were able to break through to the quasi-Fairy Tier during this era, and you must possess unimaginable secrets. Also, your path is terrifying enough, and the secrets within you might be even more astonishing than he had imagined. If they could kill you, devour your origin, and obtain the secrets within you, they might be able to progress even further.]
