[He paused and then added that besides, if they do not take action, and you successfully break through, they would not have good days ahead.]
[The Second Dark Senior Immortal’s eyes flickered with temptation, clearly moved by the argument. Indeed, if they could devour you and gain your secrets, they might truly advance further. If they could become Immortals, they would no longer need to languish in the Source of Darkness.]
[After all, the Source of Darkness was an incredibly dangerous place, where they could fall completely any time and turn into Dark Beings who only knew how to kill. Only by becoming Immortals could they break free from their dependence on the Source of Darkness and exist in the world forever.]
[Eventually, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal accepted the proposal from the First Dark Quasi Immortal, and together, they crossed a vast distance, appearing in the sky above Qingyuan Imperial Palace. The Dark Pseudo Immortals released their oppressive aura unabashedly, and two Quasi Fairy Phenomenon appeared in the cosmos.]
[This greatly shocked the emperors present, and Empress Qingyuan was so pressured by the Immortal Strength that her face turned pale, and her pupils contracted suddenly, feeling an immense burden.]
[This made her realize that the two before her were beyond the level of Emperor, possibly Quasi Immortals. She genuinely hadn’t expected that her world harbored Quasi Immortals, and not just one, but two…]
[These two were even intending to attack her master. However, Empress Qingyuan quickly calmed down, thinking that her master had already predicted this and must have a backup plan, so there was no need to panic.]
[For that reason, Empress Qingyuan took a deep breath and fearlessly shouted that the two seniors taking advantage of her master’s breakthrough was far too despicable—were they afraid of fighting on equal terms?]
[In response to Empress Qingyuan’s mockery, the two Dark Quasi Immortals were furious. Being scolded by a mere Emperor like Qingyuan was a slander to their dignity as Quasi Immortals, so they angrily attacked, attempting to kill her.]
[However, an unexpected development occurred. Their attacks failed to hit Empress Qingyuan, let alone kill her; they didn’t even break the Great Array of the Qingyuan Imperial Palace.]
[At this, Empress Qingyuan was stunned, then overjoyed, realizing that it was your master’s backup plan at work.]
[At the same time, she realized one more thing. In the face of the pressure from the two Quasi Immortals, everyone in the Qingyuan Imperial Palace should have perished. However, there were no casualties, proving that her master had already protected them.]
[At that moment, your figure appeared before the cultivators in the Qingyuan Imperial Palace, and everyone looked at you reverently. You, with your fluttering clothes, disregarded the two Dark Quasi Immortals, saying that Dark Quasi Immortals who had been defeated by your great emperor cultivation wouldn’t be able to hinder your breakthrough—how ridiculous.]
[Your words made the First Dark Quasi Immortal scoff, accusing you of talking nonsense. He’d never been defeated by you with your great emperor cultivation. You were really good at bragging.]
[The Second Dark Quasi Immortal looked at your figure, squinting his eyes as he assessed the situation. He coldly said you still seemed to be at the critical moment of a full breakthrough. You hurriedly split your power to create an incarnation to intimidate them.]
[Then he sneered, saying that you were utterly ridiculous to try and intimidate them with your incarnation. Did you really think you had become an Immortal?]
[Upon hearing this, your incarnation replied indifferently that even this hastily formed incarnation would be enough to kill them with a single punch.]
[Your words enraged the two Dark Quasi Immortals, who thought you were extremely arrogant. The First Dark Quasi Immortal was about to unleash a Great Divine Skill to blast your incarnation directly.]
[Regarding this, your incarnation looked at him and casually threw a Chaos Emperor Fist, directly crushing him as if smashing an ant. Afterward, you stated calmly that a defeated foe should not make a fool of themselves any longer.]
[This scene left everyone, including Empress Qingyuan, speechless. After all, this was an existence above that of Emperor, who had just been killed by one of your incarnations with a single punch. That was outrageously powerful.]
[Seeing this, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal’s expression stiffened, his face filled with fear. He hadn’t expected you to be so formidable that even a hastily formed incarnation could instantly kill a Dark Quasi Immortal with one punch.]
[Next, without hesitation, the Second Dark Quasi Immortal tried to flee, regretting his decision to attack you out of sheer greed.]
[As for the Second Dark Quasi Immortal’s escape, your incarnation merely sneered and directly summoned the Devouring Immortal Bead. Activating its devouring power, it absorbed the remnants of the First Dark Quasi Immortal’s corpse and the Second Dark Quasi Immortal in the process.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - 1102 284 The Opportunity is in Hand Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1102: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _6 Chapter 1102: Chapter 284: The Opportunity is in Hand! Breaking Through to the Quasi-Fairy! (Asking for monthly tickets for this ten-thousand-word chapter!) _6 [Although Devouring Immortal Bead didn’t show much performance in your previous life simulation, it doesn’t mean that the Devouring Immortal Bead is weak. After all, your cultivation was indeed weaker at that time.]
[Now that you have become a quasi-Fairy, even your incarnation carries power not inferior to ordinary Dark Psuedo Immortals, and may even be stronger.]
[Therefore, with your current strength, you can fully unleash the power of the Devouring Immortal Bead. If you want to use it in battle, devouring a Dark Psuedo Immortal is very easy.]
[As for why in the previous simulation you couldn’t use the Devouring Immortal Bead against Leng Yue and gain an advantage after using Moment of Elegance to raise your battle power to the highest level, it is because Leng Yue was too strong, and she also had Immortal Artifacts.]
[The Second Dark Senior Immortal found that he couldn’t escape and was even dragging space and time with him to be devoured by the Devouring Immortal Bead. His face was filled with terror, and he couldn’t believe that you had such a terrifying Immortal Artifact. He let out an incredible sound.]
[Soon, the Second Dark Senior Immortal was devoured alive by the Devouring Immortal Bead, and he couldn’t even self-detonate.]
[With this, the battle ended, and the world became quiet once more. Everyone was shocked, frightened, and awed; no one dared to speak.]
[Next, your incarnation didn’t pay any attention to the terrified people and quickly disappeared. Not long after, you completely broke through to the quasi-Fairy Tier and ruled the world.]
[However, you didn’t plan to stay in this world for long. After going to the Source of Darkness and killing all the Dark Emperors of this world, you left and searched for new worlds to hunt down more Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals and collect more Immortal Sources.]
[In the blink of an eye, thousands of years had passed, and during this time you went to five different worlds. Among these five worlds, there were both strong and weak ones. Powerful worlds, like the one where Empress Qingyuan resided, had many Emperors and even quasi-Fairies, while in the weaker ones, not even a single Emperor could be born.]
[On this matter, you were reminded of the world where you once visited the group members. In that world, even Saints were rare, and their cultivation was incomplete. This made you realize that the difference between an Upper Realm and another one is much larger than the difference between a person and a dog. There are very few worlds like your original Upper Realm, which has so many powerful beings.]
[In addition, the time spent in searching for worlds was longer than you had imagined.]
[As a result, your previous idea of easily going to many worlds to hunt down large numbers of Dark Emperors and Dark Psuedo Immortals was wrong.]
[However, you didn’t care. As long as Leng Yue, that predecessor ransmigrator, didn’t make a move on you first, you had plenty of time to grind until the Devouring Immortal Bead condensed enough Immortal Sources.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 10,000 years passed, and you went to ten more worlds, finally refining three groups of Immortal Origin.]
[At the same time, during these 10,000 years, your understanding of the Chaotic Immortal Scripture deepened. However, there was still a long way to go before you create it.]
[But you weren’t worried, because the last world you arrived in was a very powerful one and had a great opportunity. This great opportunity was an Immortal Tree.]
[In the center of this world was the main trunk of the Ancient Immortal Tree. Its massive body formed the Central Region, where countless cultivators lived on it.]
[Without a doubt, this world was a paradise for Wood Attribute cultivators. Therefore, wood attribute cultivators dominated this world, and cultivators of other attributes were considered side branches.]
[When you arrived at this world and saw the Ancient Immortal Tree from the Cosmic Starry Sky, you were very amazed. You really didn’t expect that there would be a living, free Immortal in a subordinate plane of the Immortal Domain. To be precise, a free living Immortal.]
[There’s no doubt that in terms of combat power, this world is much stronger than the one you and Leng Yue were in. This is not only because of the existence of the Ancient Immortal Tree but also because there are more than fifteen active quasi-Fairies in this world. As for how many Dark Psuedo Immortals there are in the Source of Darkness, it is an unknown number.]
[Of course, it is also possible that this world has no Dark Psuedo Immortals because the Ancient Immortal Tree has the power to eradicate them, unless there is a Dark True Immortal hiding in the Source of Darkness.]
[However, the probability of this is very low because True Immortals are already immortal and there is no need for them to hide in the dangerous Source of Darkness.]
[After that, you went to the Ancient Immortal Continent to participate in the Immortal Ascension Conference. The Immortal Ascension Conference was initiated by the Ancient Immortal Tree and serves as a grand meeting for cultivators in the world to discuss the Tao.]
[The Immortal Ascension Conference is held once every million years. It is said that whoever stands first place in the Immortal Ascension Conference and gains the approval of the Ancient Immortal Tree will be granted Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves. These Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves are a unique product of the Ancient Immortal Tree, produced only once every few hundred thousand years, and can help people in their Enlightenment.]
[According to historical records, whoever obtains the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and drinks them using a specific method will enter into an astonishing state of Enlightenment and may comprehend the Immortal Tao. There was once a quasi-Fairy who obtained Enlightenment Ancient Tea Leaves, successfully comprehended the Tao, and realized his own Immortal Tao.]
[However, after comprehending the Immortal Tao, that quasi-Fairy’s ambition grew extremely large. He was no longer satisfied with comprehending the Immortal Tao and wanted to become a True Immortal. Unfortunately, there were no resources to become a True Immortal in this world.]
[Therefore, he set his sights on the Ancient Immortal Tree. In his view, he had already comprehended the Immortal Tao and became powerful. The Ancient Immortal Tree was transformed from a treasure and surely had much weaker combat power than a real True Immortal. As long as he set up a Great Array, he had a chance to defeat and refine it, and prove himself as a True Immortal.]
[However, that quasi-Fairy overestimated himself and underestimated the Ancient Immortal Tree. Even if, as he guessed, the Ancient Immortal Tree was not good at fighting and had a gentle nature, it was ultimately an Immortal, and there was an essential gap between it and a quasi-Fairy. No matter how many calculations the quasi-Fairy made or how strong his constitution was, he was ultimately suppressed by the Ancient Immortal Tree like an ant.]
[After that battle, the world was in an uproar. Not only were they amazed by the effects of Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves, but they were also completely convinced by the Ancient Immortal Tree’s combat power. No one dared to have any more mischievous thoughts, and countless cultivators worshipped the Ancient Immortal Tree.]
[As an outsider, you may not develop any faith towards the Ancient Immortal Tree, but you are still very curious about it, and even more interested in Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - 1103 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1103: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!) Chapter 1103: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!) “Never thought there would actually be a True Immortal in the lower realms, despite being transformed from a precious tree, the surprise is still great.” Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, somewhat astounded.
“Nevertheless, it’s rather miraculous for the Ancient Immortal Tree to survive till this day.” Wang Ping thought of this fact.
Before the Immortal Domain Channel closed, there were many strong cultivators. Existences like the Ancient Immortal Tree would have definitely caught the attention of even stronger immortals and would have been taken to cultivate.
However, it was not captured.
It may have been because it went undiscovered before the Immortal Domain Channel was closed, managing to survive, or it might not have been the Ancient Immortal Tree back then.
If it became the Ancient Immortal Tree after the Immortal Domain Channel closed, that would be remarkable, and the secrets it holds would be terrifying.
“Perhaps, Simulation Wang Ping could get some Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves this time, and with them, easily comprehend the Chaos Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Tao.”
Soon after, Wang Ping shook his head, thinking silently in his heart, waiting for the developments to follow.
[Soon after, the Immortal Ascension Conference began, and you arrived at the scene. Your appearance did not attract the attention of fellow cultivators because you kept a low profile and didn’t expose your special characteristics.]
[With your current capability, unless you showcase your specialty, even other quasi-Fairies would not dream of understanding the extent of your true power. Of course, this is why no quasi-Fairy noticed you, or else if they realized they can’t see through you, they will definitely treat you as their kind.]
[A month later, under your watchful eyes, countless cultivators arrived and the Immortal Ascension Conference officially started. The Ancient Immortal Tree began to emanate Immortal Rhyme, leading its branches towards influencing the quasi-Fairies to ascend and observe the whole world.]
[No one was surprised by this scene, Immortal Ascension Conference is indeed for anyone to lecture on the Tao, to explain their own Dao, but it’s ultimately the stage for great Masters. According to historical records, the Immortal Ascension Conference has always been about quasi-Fairies lecturing, gaining the recognition of the Ancient Immortal Tree, with only a few Emperors ever surpassing quasi-Fairies in discussing Tao. Such Emperors would surely become immortals in an era accepting new immortals.]
[However, as the crowd marvelled at the magnificence of quasi-Fairies, to their surprise, the Ancient Immortal Tree extended a new branch that was thicker and possessed more Immortal Rhyme than all previous branches.]
[The quasi-Fairies were also quite surprised, looking towards the direction of the extension, they all noticed you in the end.]
[Upon seeing this, you sighed inwardly and felt helpless. You didn’t figure out the Ancient Immortal Tree’s true nature, originally planning to just watch and see, you didn’t expect to be discovered. It can only be said that a fairy is a fairy, incomparable with a quasi-Fairy like you. Your hiding method doesn’t count for much in front of him.]
[However, you weren’t worried because you had two five-digit Special Items in your hands. Although the Rod of Holy Light could only be used against Yin Evil Items, it also had its cleansing and healing effects, which could assist Wang Ping to solve many predicaments. The 5-digit mid-tier Tool – Curse Doll, it was needless to say. As long as you wish, even a Quasi Fairy King has to die.]
[If the Ancient Immortal Tree tried to harm you, you would not be in a panic, you could easily kill it with the 5-digit mid-tier Tool – Curse Doll. Although it would seem like a waste to use this to deal with a True Immortal, it should be used when necessary.]
[Certainly, in some sense, you don’t perceive it as a loss to use it on the Ancient Immortal Tree. If you destroy the Ancient Immortal Tree, you might be able to become an immortal by leveraging this.]
[Considering this, you suddenly hoped that the Ancient Immortal Tree turns out to be a scheming boss. In that case, you wouldn’t have the slightest guilt when killing it. If the Ancient Immortal Tree isn’t a boss, it would be too despicable of you to kill it without any reason, it won’t suit your style.]
[While you had many ideas in your mind, the Ancient Immortal Tree spoke with its ancient yet Immortal Rhyme-filled voice, welcoming you – a quasi-Fairy from another world – to lecture on the Tao. Of course, it wouldn’t force you if you are unwilling to do so.]
[The voice of the Ancient Immortal Tree made all the cultivators astonished, they didn’t expect you to be a quasi-Fairy from another world. However, the strong beings started pondering and contemplating, after all, they knew the phenomenon of the world breaking not long ago was your doing.]
[Because of this, all the quasi-Fairies became extremely curious about you, wondering what capabilities you possessed to make the Ancient Immortal Tree value you so much. After all, the Ancient Immortal Tree had never treated any quasi-Fairy with such courteousness before.]
[At this point, you composed yourself and subtly smiled, showing your gratitude to the Ancient Immortal Tree for his appreciation, and since he invited you, you were naturally glad to lecture on the Tao.]
[Next, it was time for you to be the first to lecture on the Tao. You did not hold back and shared your understanding of the Dao. This was not just lecturing, but also a self-realization that benefited you greatly.]
[Your lecture left everyone stunned in awe, leaving them enchanted, even the other quasi-Fairies faces fluctuated, as they realized that your understanding of the Dao was far superior to their own.]
[As you continued your lecture, there were many who made breakthroughs. When you finished lecturing, a heavenly miracle occurred and everyone bowed deeply to you in a respectful manner, even the other quasi-Fairies were impressed and finally started to understand why the Ancient Immortal Tree was treating you with such courtesy.]
[No doubt, if you were in an era where one could still ascend to immortality, you would be a unique existence who could easily become an immortal, maybe even surpassing the realm of True Immortal would be an easy task.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 - 1104 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1104: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!) _2 Chapter 1104: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!) _2 [Of course, given your situation, even in this extremely difficult time to become an immortal, you are likely to truly become one.]
[After you finished lecturing on the Tao, the Ancient Immortal Tree was also quite astonished at your Tao and sighed that as a generation of Chaotic Body, you are truly amazing.]
[In response, you smile slightly and do not say much.]
[Next, the other quasi-immortals and some bold Emperors give lectures on their Tao. You do not despise them but listen carefully, gaining a lot in the process.]
[After the lectures are finished, the Ancient Immortal Tree announces the results of this Immortal Ascension Conference, stating that your Tao is the strongest in the world, and as a reward, it will grant you Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves.]
[Hearing the Ancient Immortal Tree’s words, everyone shows envious expressions. However, even though they are envious, they don’t feel unconvincing. In terms of Tao, you are indeed the first, the indisputable number one.]
[After receiving the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves, you look deeply at the Ancient Immortal Tree and express your gratitude for its generous gift. In response, the Ancient Immortal Tree says you’re welcome and that this is the reward you deserve.]
[Then, the Ancient Immortal Tree announces the end of this Immortal Ascension Conference, to be continued a million years later.]
[Upon hearing this, you give a slight bow to the Ancient Immortal Tree and prepare to leave. However, the crowd of quasi-immortals tries to strike up a conversation with you, wanting to invite you to be their guest and make friends.]
[In response, you laugh and decline, then leave. This makes the crowd of quasi-immortals somewhat regretful, but they do not say much and leave separately]
[Soon after, you find an appropriate place, set up the Great Array, and start soaking the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves to enlighten the Tao, hoping to comprehend the Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Tao with the help of the Enlightenment Immortal Tea’s effect.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed. It must be said that the effect of Enlightenment Immortal Tea is indeed amazing, allowing you to enter a wonderful state of enlightenment and save a lot of time in the process.]
[After a hundred years pass, you successfully comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao and also understand the Chaotic Immortal Scripture.]
[After your retreat is over, you are extremely excited, laughing heartily, satisfied with your gains.]
[Now that you’ve comprehended the Chaotic Immortal Scripture and understood the Chaos Immortal Tao, your strength has completely surpassed that of your predecessor ransmigrator, Senior Leng Yue.]
[In your view, if you want, you can kill him. However, you will not kill Leng Yue, the predecessor ransmigrator. Although he killed you many times in the simulation, he is ultimately a pitiful person and has helped the Original Wang Ping many times, counting his kindness greater than his offense.]
[For this reason, you are more willing to form a friendship with him, and grow together.]
[Afterward, you can’t help but smile, thinking you might be too arrogant. Senior Leng Yue has never revealed his true bottom line. As someone who has been to Myriad Heavens Paradise, his fighting abilities must be diverse. However, you have never seen him use special items to assist him in combat.]
[As a result, if you really confront him, it’s better to be cautious, lest you lose face by capsizing in the gutter.]
…..
“At last, I’ve taken this step.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and was filled with emotion.
Chaotic Immortal Scripture, Chaos Immortal Tao.
At the level of quasi-immortal now, the simulated Wang Ping should be considered the best of the best.
As for the Perfect Chaotic Body, this thing cannot be forced.
However, even the Great Chaos Body, among the Lower Realm Quasi-Immortals, is an unparalleled advantage.
Even going to the Immortal Domain might not find many peers.
“Next, I should go back, looking forward to a battle with Senior Leng Yue.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking secretly, feeling very hopeful for this battle, and believed he could make a comeback.
As Wang Ping daydreamed, the simulation continued.
[After steadying yourself, you decide to start forging your Life-bound Immortal Artifact. During your trips to various worlds, you’ve found many powerful materials with side effects, and have even condensed three groups of Immortal Source to be safe. Now is the time.]
[No sooner said than done, you start forging your Life-bound Immortal Artifact with various materials. The process of forging Immortal Instruments is extremely tedious and consumes a lot of energy and time.]
[As a result, thousands of years have passed in the blink of an eye. Over the millennia, you have been fully devoted to forging your Immortal Artifact, continuously merging your Chaos Immortal Tao into it, consuming a great deal of energy.]
[However, your efforts pay off, and after thousands of years, you finally forge your Life-bound Immortal Artifact, the Immortal Clothing, with various materials!]
[As the Immortal Clothing emerges, the Immortal Artifact Tribulation reappears. This time, the Immortal Artifact Tribulation is even more terrifying than when you created the Chaos Immortal Bead. That is because the Immortal Clothing, as your Life-bound Immortal Artifact, contains the Chaos Immortal Tao and is unparalleled among its peers.]
[However, you are not worried that the Immortal Clothing will fail to survive the Immortal Artifact Tribulation, you firmly believe that it will successfully pass, and with the help of the Tribulation, it will become even stronger.]
[While you observe the Immortal Artifact Tribulation, all the Lower Realm Quasi-Immortals of this world also come to watch, showing shocked expressions, not expecting an Immortal Artifact Tribulation to descend.]
[However, when they see the Immortal Clothing, they know that it should be your Life-bound Immortal Artifact. In response, they also guess that you must have understood the Chaos Immortal Tao. Because only those who have comprehended the Immortal Tao are eligible to forge their own Life-bound Immortal Artifacts.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - 1105 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1105: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_3 Chapter 1105: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_3 [Of course, this is just a qualification, a prerequisite condition. Many of those who have comprehended the Immortal Tao are unable to forge their own Immortal Artifacts at the quasi-Fairy Tier. According to records, most quasi-Fairies can only forge their Life-bound Immortal Artifacts after becoming True Immortals. In other words, a cultivator who can forge their own Immortal Artifact at the quasi-Fairy Tier is definitely an aberration.]
[For this reason, they can only envy and do not dare to covet even a little bit. They are very clear that although they are also quasi-Fairies, if they were to face you, they would most likely be easily killed by you. They wouldn’t do something that is akin to seeking death.]
[In this way, the Immortal Artifact Tribulation proceeds smoothly. You find that other quasi-Fairies are only watching and have no intention of taking action, so you smile faintly, feeling that this group of people are very sensible, unlike the previous two Dark Pseudo Immortals who courted death. Of course, this is also related to the fact that your lecture on the Tao made this group of people know more about your strength. Otherwise, someone might still plow forward due to greed.]
[Finally, your Chaotic fairy clothes successfully passed the Immortal Artifact Tribulation, becoming even more powerful and turning into a true Immortal Artifact. It exudes endless Immortal Light and returns to your side, where you wear it on your body.]
[Then, the Immortal Light disappeared, becoming like an ordinary white garment. This scene made you very satisfied.]
[At this moment, many quasi-Fairies were very polite in congratulating you on successfully refining your Life-bound Immortal Artifact. Against this, you didn’t ignore their congratulations with an air of superiority, and responded politely.]
[Next, just as you were pondering whether to return to your original world, the voice of the Ancient Immortal Tree sounded, asking you to come over.]
[To this, you were quite surprised and, after thinking, chose to go to the place designated by the Ancient Immortal Tree.]
[Then, you saw an old man transformed by the Ancient Immortal Tree. The old man looked at you and also congratulated you on obtaining your Life-bound Immortal Artifact.]
[In response, you smiled and exchanged pleasantries with the Ancient Immortal Tree, before asking what he wanted from you.]
[Upon seeing your inquiry, the Ancient Immortal Tree’s expression became serious, expressing his hope that you could go to the Source of Darkness in this realm and eliminate a Dark Being.]
[Hearing this, you were quite astonished and didn’t immediately agree to the Ancient Immortal Tree’s request, but instead solemnly asked what the Dark Being was, why the Ancient Immortal Tree dreaded it, and if the Ancient Immortal Tree as a True Immortal couldn’t destroy it.]
[The Ancient Immortal Tree shook his head, stating that those below True Immortal can still enter the Source of Darkness, but after becoming an Immortal, they would be unable to enter the Source of Darkness. Once they intrude, they would be devoured, so even if he could eliminate that Dark Being, he wouldn’t dare enter.]
[These words caused a shudder in your heart, and you guessed some things. Perhaps the Source of Darkness doesn’t care about beings below True Immortal, but once a True Immortal enters, they might attract the attention of the Source of Darkness and be eaten like a snack.]
[Of course, it might not attract attention, but merely be a natural response like instinctive eating.]
[With many thoughts surging in your heart, you asked the Ancient Immortal Tree why he wanted to eliminate that Dark Being, was it very dangerous?]
[The old man transformed by the Ancient Immortal Tree nodded, stating that the Dark Being was created by someone from All Heavens using a special tool. It draws on the dark power within the Source of Darkness to continuously grow. If allowed to continue growing, it might gain the power of a True Immortal or even stronger.]
[By that time, this world would be doomed. Quasi-fairies may be able to break through the barrier and escape, but the endless Living Beings in this world would be destroyed.]
[Moreover, it’s not just this world that would be in trouble. Once that monster was formed, it could trigger a chain reaction, destroying many worlds affiliated with the Immortal Domain.]
[Upon hearing this, everything became clear to you, and you understood why the Ancient Immortal Tree was so persistent in cultivating extremely powerful quasi-Fairies and even hoped to give birth to a new True Immortal. It’s because the Ancient Immortal Tree wanted to resolve this hidden danger that it held the Immortal Ascension Conference and was persistent in cultivating the strong. It must be said that the Ancient Immortal Tree truly cares for the well-being of the people and is a good Immortal Tree.]
[At this point, you, with your current perception, can now sense this, and since the Rod of Holy Light didn’t react to the Ancient Immortal Tree, it proves that its nature is indeed gentle and kind.]
[After some thought, you asked the Ancient Immortal Tree if it could leave this world.]
[In your view, the Ancient Immortal Tree being rooted in this world might not be able to leave, and perhaps this is one of the reasons why it wants to urgently resolve this hidden danger.]
[The Ancient Immortal Tree shook his head, stating that it could leave, but it would require some cost. However, he felt that resolving the hidden danger would be much safer. After all, once such a thing emerged, with the Immortal Domain Channel closed, there might be no use in fleeing to any world.]
[You nodded thoughtfully, still not immediately agreeing to the Ancient Immortal Tree’s request. After all, that Dark Being was obviously very dangerous, and there was no need for you to risk fighting against it. In any case, as long as you leave this world and return to your original world, there will be no problems for one or two hundred thousand years. Such a long time for cultivation is obviously very beneficial to you.]
[Seeing your hesitation, the old man transformed by the Ancient Immortal Tree smiled helplessly, stating that the Dark Being was still not at the level of a True Immortal, and with your strength, you should be able to completely eliminate it. If you were willing to take action, he could give you more Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and a drop of Life essence that could help you condense a True Immortal body.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1106 - 1106 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1106: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_4 Chapter 1106: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_4 [Subsequently, the Ancient Immortal Tree stated that this drop of Life Essence took millions of years for it to condense, making it extremely precious, and enough to make the heart of True Immortals race.]
[Upon hearing this, your eyes immediately brightened, and you let out a chuckle, expressing that you would take care of this matter.]
[Regarding this, the old man that the Ancient Immortal Tree transformed into was torn between laughter and tears, jokingly scolding you for only acting when there’s a reward.]
[Then, after the old man that the Ancient Immortal Tree transformed into told you some information, he disappeared, stating that he would reward you upon your return.]
[In response, you nodded your head and looked towards the location of the Source of Darkness, stepping forward, heading there.]
[As for the Dark Beings, you don’t particularly fear them. Even if the Dark Beings’ strength is powerful enough to reach the realm of True Immortals, you can deal with them using the Rod of Holy Light.]
[After all, this item is the nemesis of Evil Beings. Though these Dark Beings have been nourished by the Source of Darkness, the Rod of Holy Light is a five-digit special item and it wouldn’t be useless.]
[Your entrance into the Source of Darkness was noticed by the quasi-Fairies who had been paying attention to your actions. They were all a bit surprised, but they soon thought that it must be related to the Ancient Immortal Tree. They shook their heads, thinking you were too reckless and would likely perish today.]
[The matter of the Ancient Immortal Tree wanting to exterminate an existence in the Source of Darkness was not a secret to these quasi-Fairies. However, in their opinion, they could not possibly compete with a being that even the Ancient Immortal Tree dreaded so much.]
[As a result, no matter how many benefits the Ancient Immortal Tree promised, no quasi-Fairy throughout history had ever agreed. After all, they cherished their lives at the quasi-Fairy Tier, and no one was willing to risk a one-in-ten chance of survival to enter the Source of Darkness and kill their enemies.]
[More importantly, the Dark Emperor and Dark Psuedo Immortal within the Source of Darkness similarly filled them with immense fear. They didn’t want to go in and become the nourishment for these creatures. Even if they didn’t become nourishment, they would likely be forced to fall into darkness.]
[You were unaware of the thoughts of the other quasi-Fairies and had no interest in their opinions, entering the Source of Darkness by yourself.]
[As you entered, you frowned because you found that within this world’s Source of Darkness, there was not a trace of the Dark Emperor or Dark Pseudo Immortals.]
[Logically, with this world being so strong, the accumulation of Dark Pseudo Immortals and Dark Emperor would be greater than in other worlds. However, you did not see a single Dark Psuedo Immortal or Dark Emperor.]
[This situation was too strange, making you immediately think of the Dark Being mentioned by the Ancient Immortal Tree. Perhaps it was this Dark Being that had devoured all the Dark Emperors and Dark Psuedo Immortals within the Source of Darkness, which was why the Source of Darkness had become so empty and desolate.]
[This realization made you furrow your brow, your face solemn, on guard against the attack of the Dark Being.]
[However, your vigilance was unnecessary. As you explored deeper, you didn’t encounter any attacks. It wasn’t until you reached the depths of this world’s Source of Darkness, that you understood the reason.]
[For there, in the depths of the Source of Darkness, was a Blood-Black Cicada Cocoon surrounded by numerous tentacles and countless Living Beings. These Living Beings were the Dark Emperor and Dark Psuedo Immortals in their true forms.]
[Among them, the vast majority of Living Beings had their bodies penetrated by the tentacles, turning into mummified corpses, while only a very few are painfully struggling to survive. And all those struggling to survive were Dark Pseudo Immortals.]
[Witnessing this scene, you narrowed your eyes, feeling rather solemn. Capable of capturing all these Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals to absorb their power, the Dark Being’s strength had clearly become extremely terrifying, possibly far surpassing the tier of the quasi-Fairy.]
[Now, it has even transformed into a cicada-like cocoon, likely preparing for a new round of metamorphosis. Perhaps the day it breaks free from the cocoon will be the moment it becomes a Fairy. At that time, it will be invincible, slaughtering the world, becoming the nightmare of numerous worlds.]
[While you were focusing on this, the Dark Pseudo Immortals who were still alive noticed you. They showed an expression of joy through their pain, pleading for help, hoping that you could either save them or kill them.]
[Regarding this, you remained unmoved, your expression still calm, silently observing the cicada-like creature with your Breaking Origin Sky Eye.]
[It was at this moment that the cicada cocoon seemed to sense the threat. It began to vibrate as the tentacles increased their absorption of the Dark Psuedo Immortals’ primordial essence.]
[Seeing this, you snorted coldly, not ignoring them any longer. You directly unleashed your immense power, the Chaos Immortal Tao manifesting, and bombarded the cicada cocoon with the Chaotic Immortal Fist.]
[However, to your surprise, the cicada cocoon was incredibly tough. Even with your current strength, using the Chaotic Immortal Fist, you were not able to destroy it in one blow, only creating numerous cracks.]
[You should know that you have now comprehended the Chaos Immortal Tao, the Chaotic Immortal Scripture, and with the aid of the Chaotic Battle Armor, your combat strength has reached to a level almost close to the peak of the quasi-Fairy Tier. You have the confidence to challenge even extremely weak True Immortals. Nevertheless, even so, you were still unable to break it with a single punch.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1107 - 1107 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1107: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_5 Chapter 1107: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_5 [Soon, you launched another attack. This punch landed on the cicada pupa, causing the cracks on its body to become even denser and on the verge of exploding at any moment.]
[At the same time, you also discovered a problem. The critical strike effect of Seven Color Talent – Burst Blade has been reduced again, from doubling damage to only increasing by 50%. Clearly, after your combat power had greatly increased, the bonus of Seven Color Talent was cut again.]
[However, you can also understand that this is after all only a six-digit talent. For someone like you who has far surpassed the quasi-Fairy tier, it is indeed not able to keep up with the pace. It is estimated that when you become an Immortal, this six-digit talent will become useless. By then, Original Wang Ping can sell it or use it to train people like Lin Yuanyuan.]
[Of course, if you can use it in the Sky Tower Trial, you will still not choose to give it up and will definitely use it yourself.]
[While you have many thoughts in your mind, you once again unleash a powerful attack, forcibly exploding the cicada pupa and killing all the absorbed Dark Psuedo Immortals in the process.]
[After the cicada pupa was destroyed by you, an extremely sharp sound rang out. Then, you saw an extremely ugly insect-like Dark Being staring at you with its crimson compound eyes, looking extremely gloomy.]
[In response, you showed no fear and expresed scornfully at the bug-like Dark Being, saying it’s truly ugly, and it’s an eyesore, so it might as well kill itself.]
[Your words completely enraged this bug-like Dark Being. Its wings trembled, and it burst out with extremely terrifying speed, launching an attack on you.]
[To your surprise, the speed of this bug-like Dark Being surpassed even that of Predecessor Leng Yue. Of course, this comparison assumes Leng Yue is not using his Space Talent. If he were to use his Space Talent, that would be another matter.]
[However, although you were surprised by the speed of the bug-like Dark Being, you remained unmoved and not worried. This was because the power fluctuation on it’s body, although fast, had not reached the True Immortal tier.]
[Although its power fluctuations had far exceeded the quasi-Fairy tier, claiming its power being at Pseudo-Immortal tier was not an overstatement. However, it was still not a True Immortal. Therefore, you only felt excitement when facing this insect-like Dark Being.]
[You were looking forward to battling it to see how terrifying your power had become.]
[Quickly, the bug-like Dark Being discovered that its speed couldn’t scare you or cause you to expose any weaknesses, so it launched an attack.]
[In response, you sneered, unleashing a terrifying force in return, exploding with Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Fist, clashing head-on with the bug-like Dark Being.]
[However, this bug-like Dark Being was indeed on the verge of stepping into the True Immortal tier. Not only was its speed extremely fast, but its power was also extremely terrifying, forcing you into a disadvantage.]
[In response to this, you remained unfazed and continued to fight with it, familiarizing yourself with your own power. As the battle progressed, you gradually gained control of your strength and began to match the insect-like Dark Being evenly.]
[Seeing that it couldn’t defeat you for a long time, the insect-like Dark Being became even more enraged. Its breakthrough was interrupted by you at a critical moment, which was irritating enough, but now it couldn’t even defeat you, making it even angrier.]
[Therefore, this bug-like Dark Being chose to use its real power. Originally, it planned to conserve its strength and, after killing you, absorb your power and continue its metamorphosis. Now, it seemed that it couldn’t conserve its strength.]
[As the bug-like Dark Being unleashed its true power, you were immediately plunged into a dangerous situation, with your life at risk at any moment.]
[This made you frown slightly, realizing that the bug-like Dark Being had been hiding its power. Therefore, you wondered whether to use the Rod of Holy Light or the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance.]
[In the end, you felt that there was no need to waste a life fighting this bug-like Dark Being to test your extreme combat power, as that was a foolish action that would waste your chances of survival.]
[Next, you directly took out the Rod of Holy Light and made it explode with an extremely terrifying holy light. As the holy light appeared, the Yin Evil Items of the True Immortal tier were reduced to ashes, let alone this insect-like Dark Being.]
[As a result, with an extremely miserable scream, this Dark Being turned into ashes and perished completely.]
[Seeing this, you showed a smile, quite satisfied with the effect of the Rod of Holy Light, and felt that it was indeed a special item produced by the Heaven Tower, extremely powerful.]
[However, you clearly celebrated too early. The Rod of Holy Light was a five-digit special item that could emit purifying holy light. But this was inside the Source of Darkness, and releasing such terrifying holy light undeniably disturbed the Source of Darkness.]</p

chapters.title: Chapter 1108 - 1108 285 Wang Pings Enlightenment Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1108: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_6 Chapter 1108: Chapter 285 Wang Ping’s Enlightenment! Battle Strength Soars! (Big Ten Thousand Words Chapter!)_6 [Although this level of Holy Light can only produce a sensation similar to insects crawling on a human’s skin, it is still dangerous enough. After all, when people see insects crawling on their bodies, making themselves itchy, they will instinctively choose to slap them dead. The Source of Darkness will naturally react in the same way.]
[As a result, dark energy appeared instantaneously, consuming you completely. In the face of the Source of Darkness, all your methods of resurrection are useless, hence you have fallen completely.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends here….]
…..
As the text simulation declared the end, numerous memories appeared in Wang Ping’s mind without any mistakes.
Of course, this enormous amount of memory will not affect Wang Ping himself.
It can only be said that the Life Simulator has become much more user-friendly after being optimized again.
“I really underestimated it. Or rather, the simulated Wang Ping became too arrogant.”
After absorbing all the memories in an extremely short amount of time, Wang Ping sighed.
The simulated Wang Ping was holding two five-digit special items, two Immortal Artifacts, and his own cultivation had reached the Quasi Fairy Tier, comprehending the Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Dao.
Theoretically, apart from True Immortals, no one could contend against the simulated Wang Ping.
Perhaps, even if a True Immortal made a move, it might not necessarily kill the simulated Wang Ping completely.
Therefore, the simulated Wang Ping became arrogant, which could be seen from his fantasy of beating up Leng Yue, his Predecessor Ransmigrator, once he returned.
The massive improvement in strength made the simulated Wang Ping lose his previous extreme caution, forgetting the huge instability factor of the Source of Darkness.
Of course, this also has to do with the fact that the Source of Darkness never took the initiative to make a move before.
Even after hearing the Ancient Immortal Tree’s words, that True Immortals entering its realm would be devoured, there was still some negligence.
In the end, this tragedy happened.
Of course, one cannot blame the simulated Wang Ping, as when his true body saw the simulated Wang Ping’s power soaring, he too felt somewhat arrogant, just not as much as the simulated Wang Ping.
“But now that I know the signpost, the next time I simulate and come to this world, I won’t use the Rod of Holy Light against this Dark Being. Even if I arrive a little earlier, this Dark Being’s combat power will definitely not surpass that of the simulation’s end. At that time, even if I don’t use my various trump cards, there is still a good chance to kill it on my own.”
Soon after, Wang Ping shook his head, his eyes flickering as he thought secretly.
While Wang Ping was thinking about various matters in his heart, the system’s voice rang out opportune time.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host must choose two of the following rewards:
①.Six-digit Talent·Dragon’s Wrath.
②.Quasi Fairy cultivation.
③.A Cluster of Fairy Source.
④.Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves.
⑤.Life-bound Immortal Instrument·Chaotic Battle Armor.
⑥.Random quasi Fairy Artifact.
⑦.Ghost Valley Stone.”
…
“Is this the optimized Life Simulator? I really love it.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards refreshed this time, and he was utterly astonished.
Good heavens, even though he had guessed that the rewards would become more abundant and have higher tiers after the Life Simulator was optimized again, this was just too much: Immortal Instruments, Immortal Source, and Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves were all present.
For a moment, Wang Ping’s choice difficulties rarely surfaced again.
“First, eliminate the Ghost Valley Stone, Immortal Source, and quasi Immortal Artifact. Although these three items are precious, they are nothing to me now. Of course, the Immortal Source is still quite valuable and perhaps could be used for paid simulations after cultivation improvement or to help Heavenly Feather Great Emperor break through to the Quasi Fairy Tier.”
“However, since it can be refreshed this time, it will definitely be refreshed in the future, so there is no need to choose it now. It is most important to choose rewards that can help me improve.”
After Wang Ping thought it over, he quickly narrowed down the options and eliminated these three rewards.
Then, Wang Ping looked at the Six-digit Talent·Dragon’s Wrath.
Six-digit talent was quite precious, and if it were the past, Wang Ping would definitely choose it, as the probability of it being refreshed was low.
But now, the Life Simulator has already been optimized, and the guaranteed reward would be a six-digit talent, so its priority for selection has declined.
Of course, that’s also because this six-digit talent seems to be of no use, otherwise Wang Ping would still consider choosing it.
Next, Wang Ping looked at the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves, Quasi Fairy cultivation, and Chaotic Battle Armor.
The Life-bound Immortal Instrument, Chaotic Battle Armor, was something Wang Ping wanted.
Although Wang Ping could easily obtain Chaotic Battle Armor through the Life Simulator, that’s for theSimulated Wang Ping, while his true body hadn’t.
Wang Ping had an intuition that the probability of Chaotic Battle Armor being refreshed would be lower than other rewards.
However, Wang Ping also wanted the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves. This helped the Simulated Wang Ping understand Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Dao. If he chose it, every time Wang Ping would have Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves to drink, and he could also give Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and others a taste.
Wang Ping felt that he should realize the promises he made himself;
“Forget about it, I won’t choose the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves. As long as I go to the Ancient Immortal Tree World, I can ask the Ancient Immortal Tree for them. As for fulfilling the promises I made myself, I’ll deal with it later; when I become stronger, it will only take minutes for me to help Heavenly Feather Great Emperor become an Immortal. The primary goal now is still my improvement.”
After thinking it over, Wang Ping shook his head again.
Finally, Wang Ping decided to choose Quasi Fairy cultivation and Chaotic Battle Armor.
Choosing Quasi Fairy cultivation may seem like a foolish act, but it is not.
After all, Wang Ping already has plenty of resources, and he isn’t afraid that he won’t have enough resources for simulation once he reaches Quasi Fairy Tier.
What’s more, he can earn more resources if he runs out.
What Wang Ping feared most was the group owner of the Second Generation Chat Group throwing a monkey wrench into his progress.
The group owner of the Second Generation Chat Group was a terrifyingly strong person at the Quasi Fairy King Tier and has a 5-digit limit. Since he knew Wang Ping’s growth rate was becoming more and more abnormal, he would not tolerate Wang Ping’s continued growth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1109 - 1109 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1109: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death! Chapter 1109: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death! “System, I choose ②. quasi-fairy cultivation and ⑥. chaotic fairy clothes.”
Having made his decision, Wang Ping spoke without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, reward selection successful, distributing…..”
The voice of the system sounded.
Then, a fairy clothing full of immortal charm appeared before Wang Ping’s eyes, it was the chaotic fairy clothes.
After the chaotic fairy clothes appeared, it expressed endearment towards Wang Ping and actively dressed itself on him.
Next, Wang Ping’s cultivation level began to elevate rapidly.
This elevation was different from previous times.
This time, Wang Ping felt as though thousands of years had passed in a blink of an eye. Even though only less than a minute had gone by, the memories of intensive cultivation were very profound, benefiting Wang Ping greatly.
This feeling was simply too wonderful.
“No wonder it’s called the life simulator, it’s so strong.”
After opening his eyes, Wang Ping’s cultivation successfully settled at the quasi-fairy tier, making him nod in satisfaction.
“Next, let’s continue the simulation.”
Afterward, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and prepared to continue the simulation.
No rest until becoming immortal.
“System, how much resources do I need for the next paid simulation?”
Wang Ping asked in his heart, his gaze flickering.
“Ding. Detecting that host’s cultivation level has reached the quasi-fairy tier, the resource consumption for paid simulation is one trillion catties of best divine source,”
The voice of the system sounds, causing Wang Ping to smack his lips.
One trillion catties of the best divine source, although for Wang Ping now, it’s still nothing much. He has slain so many Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals, he has an abundant amount of divine source that he can never run out of, but this quantity is still astonishing.
After all, a normal Emperor could scrape up 100 billion catties of Supreme Divine Origin at best, one trillion catties is already the net worth of a lower realm quasi-immortal.
“Life simulator, really a money spinner. Of course, the speed of this upgrade is really satisfying.”
Wang Ping sighed and then said.
“System, spend one trillion catties of best divine source, proceed with paid simulation. This time, let’s go big, refresh a 5-digit talent, OK?”
“Ding, spent one trillion catties of best divine source, life simulator started, talent refresh in progress….”
The voice of the system sounded.
“Ding, Talent refresh successful, congratulate the host on successfully refreshing 5-digit talent· Born Demon Immortal; Six-digit talent· Bloodthirsty Emperor Blade.”
5-digit talent· Born Demon Immortal: Having this talent, the host will become extremely ruthless and is more likely to fall into demonic influence. After falling into demonic influence, the host’s battle strength will increase tremendously and more likely to become immortal.
Six-digit talent· Bloodthirsty Emperor Blade: Possessing this talent, the host can summon an emperor-grade weapon. This weapon has a bloodthirsty effect which can heal the host through enemy’s fresh blood.
“Eh, really did refresh a 5-digit talent….”
Wang Ping was somewhat surprised at the talents refreshed this time.
One six-digit talent, one five-digit talent, truly magnificent.
Moreover, the five-digit talent refreshed this time seems to be unusual, it’s the long-missed talent that would lead him to fall into demonic influence.
This kind of talent has appeared numerous times when he was weak, allowing his growth rate to accelerate and helping him acquired some information through various incidents.
“When refreshing rewards, it can be left unchosen, but during the life simulation, this kind of talent is a must-pick if it’s powerful enough.”
Wang Ping thought silently, eyes flickering.
Then, Wang Ping spoke without hesitation in his heart: “System, I choose the 5-digit talent· Born Demon Immortal.”
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The voice of the system sounded.
Then, the luminescent screen appears, the familiar text also emerged.
[Day 1, you successfully fell into demonic influence and became ruthless, filled with the impulse to destroy everything. Because of your demonic influence, the effects of your talent have increased your battle strength.]
[Just at this moment, because you’ve stirred up some commotion due to falling into demonic influence, it caused the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to sense something wrong. He sought you out, wanting to discuss certain matters. However, you got impatient, crushed his head and wrecked Taiyi Imperial Palace, killing everyone around you.]
….
“As expected of a demonic talent, such behavior is truly too ruthless. As expected, this kind of talent could only be used in the life simulator.”
Wang Ping looked at the starting simulation content, his face twitched slightly, feeling somewhat speechless.
While Wang Ping was speechless, the text simulation continued.
[After annihilating Taiyi Imperial Palace, you went directly to the Time-Space Forbidden Zone, found the predecessor ransmigrator, Leng Yue, and ordered him to activate the Refinement Array immediately. You wanted to refine this world, perfect your chaos body and also hoped to become immortal through this.]
[Leng Yue furrowed his brows, noticing your abnormality, his face turned cold and he attacked you without hesitation.]
[To this, you sneered, expressing your belief that Leng Yue was being unnecessarily harsh, and that since it had come to this, he should just die.]
[Immediately, you unleashed terrifying battle strength and engaged Leng Yue in a shocking battle. Just when the battle started, Leng Yue fell into an absolute disadvantage. Your Great Chaos Body, along with the power bonuses from Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Tao, was already far superior to Leng Yue’s base battle strength.]
[If it is a straight-forward fight, he is not your match, although he wouldn’t be instantly killed by you, but if the battle lasts slightly longer, he will be killed by you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1110 - 1110 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1110: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_2 Chapter 1110: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_2 [Your power greatly surprised Leng Yue, who could only avoid direct confrontation by using his Spatial Talent. This time, Leng Yue utilized his talent to an astonishing degree, avoiding direct combat by being extremely agile, which made you very angry.]
[Because he was too agile, you felt that if you could use your Six-Digit Talent·Explosive Blade along with the combat power boost from your Demonic Talent, you could severely wound him with a single punch. However, you just couldn’t land a hit, which was extremely frustrating.]
[In response, you became enraged and directly used your Six-Digit Talent·Moment of Elegance. As you used your Six-Digit Talent·Moment of Elegance, your combat power surged even further.]
[As your combat power surged, even Leng Yue’s agile use of Spatial Talent became somewhat unable to dodge. If this continued, he would eventually be killed by you.]
[Regarding his own situation,Leng Yue’s expression remained cold and collected, fighting calmly without any change.]
[Following a thrilling dodge of your new assault, Leng Yue brought out an item to trap you directly.]
[Suddenly being trapped, you were quite unhappy and exploded with terrifying power, trying to break the binding. However, you found that you couldn’t break the binding of the item. You realized that it must be a powerful Six-Digit Top-Grade Item. Even very powerful quasi-Fairies or those at the Six-Digit Limit would be trapped for a while.]
[Leng Yue coldly looked at you, directly approaching the stone platform and activating the Refinement Array. Even though he didn’t have a Chaotic Body and activating the Refinement Array seemed somewhat wasteful, the Refinement Array could still be used for combat or to aid in becoming an Immortal.]
[As Leng Yue activated the Refinement Array, you sensed a crisis and knew that you couldn’t go on like this. You summoned the Rod of Holy Light to purify Leng Yue.]
[However, Leng Yue was neither a Dark Being nor a fallen Dark Psuedo Immortal, so the Rod of Holy Light had no effect.]
[This made you extremely angry and dissatisfied. In response, you directly used the 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Cursed Doll.]
[As you summoned the 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Cursed Doll, Leng Yue’s pupils suddenly constricted, sensing a fatally dangerous presence.]
[He tried to stop you from using the Cursed Doll, but it was already too late. As a result, he clapped his hands together, turned the array around, and made a decision.]
[Just as Leng Yue made his move, you triggered the effect of your Cursed Doll, attacking it. In an instant, Leng Yue’s body twisted and burned, his soul extinguishing. The damage done to the Cursed Doll was perfectly reflected onto Leng Yue’s body.]
[This kind of damage is irreversible. Even if Leng Yue used a Resurrection Item, he wouldn’t be able to revive himself unless it was a five-figure Resurrection Item.]
[As a quasi-Fairy, Leng Yue had achieved the Six-Digit Limit in Myriad Heavens Paradise and certainly wouldn’t be able to use a Five-Figure Resurrection Item. His limited potential was also due to the fact that he had been ordered to stay in this world for so long, otherwise, Leng Yue would have already ventured into the Myriad Heavens Paradise and wouldn’t still be a quasi-Fairy with insufficient trump cards.]
[As a result, Leng Yue was ultimately cursed to death by your Cursed Doll. However, even in the face of death, his cold demeanor remained unchanged, as if he had no fear of death at all.]
[With Leng Yue’s death, the item that trapped you turned into ashes and disappeared.]
[This made you sneer, feeling annoyed by Leng Yue’s interference. It was obvious that he was just a quasi-Fairy, and yet you had to use a Special Item capable of cursing a Pseudo Fairy King, causing you to lose a major trump card.]
[However, as long as you could refine this world, everything would be worth it.]
[However, what followed disappointed you. As you stepped into the center of the Refinement Array, not only did you not become the eye of the Array, but you were also trapped in it.]
[Obviously, Leng Yue had tampered with it before his death, transforming the Refinement Array into a Trapping Array.]
[This filled you with rage, not expecting Leng Yue to have such a move. Desperate to break free, you discovered that the trapping array was too powerful, and you couldn’t escape in a short period of time.]
…….
“Senior Leng Yue really lives up to his reputation, his methods are truly powerful.”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation content, sighing.
The simulated Wang Ping’s combat power was so powerful that it surpassed the Predecessor Ransmigrator Leng Yue in terms of brute force.
This was normal, as the simulated Wang Ping was now a top-tiered quasi-Fairy, along with the Six-Digit Talent·Explosive Blade, Six-Digit Talent·Moment of Elegance, and the bonus from being demonized. This surge in combat power was outrageous.
It was normal to easily crush Leng Yue in direct combat at this level.
However, even so, Wang Ping encountered some close calls, almost being killed by Leng Yue using the Refinement Array, and finally forced to use the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll to turn the tables.
Even then, he still ended up being trapped in life or death by Leng Yue’s dying move….
Leng Yue’s battle experience and skills as a Predecessor Ransmigrator were truly too strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111 - 1111 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1111: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_3 Chapter 1111: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_3 “Perhaps after becoming immortal, it would be a good choice to explore the Heaven Tower with Cold Moon.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, suddenly thinking of the Heaven Tower in Myriad Heavens Paradise, murmuring to himself.
Cold Moon herself was incredibly capable, and even had Space Talent. If they went through the tower together, she would undoubtedly be a very reliable partner, much stronger than Yuanyuan.
Although Lin Yuanyuan’s talent was also quite abnormal, in the trials of the Heaven Tower, it didn’t give her much of an advantage.
One could even say she was at a significant disadvantage.
At least judging from the results of the first floor, that was the case.
“Forget it, I’ll wait until after I become immortal to invite her. For now, let’s see how the simulated story unfolds. I have a feeling that the demonized Wang Ping is going to be trapped to death in the Great Array before he can fully display his splendor.”
Wang Ping shook his head, collected his thoughts, and continued to watch the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping watched, the text simulation continued.
[After discovering that you can’t break the Array, you become extremely angry. At the same time, due to the side effects of the Six-Digit Talent·Instant Youth, you die once. However, you revive using the resurrection item you took from Emperor Slaughter.]
[Next, you begin to attack the trapped array frantically, trying to break it through attrition.]
[At this moment, no one knows that Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion has died, and that you are also trapped. The outer world is shocked by the destruction of Taiyi Imperial Palace.]
[After all, your current momentum is astonishing, reaching its peak. In theory, no one would dare to provoke Taiyi Imperial Palace, which should have been thriving. However, it was suddenly destroyed, and you disappeared without a trace, making the matter exceedingly mysterious.]
[For a time, many forces fall silent, keeping a low profile. Some even choose to seal their gates to avoid provoking any strange forces that might cause their own to be annihilated as well.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred thousand years pass. Over these hundred thousand years, you remain trapped in the Great Array, unable to escape.]
[As for the outer world, it has entered the Golden Age, with everything developing mostly along its original trajectory. People gradually forget your existence, believing that you might have been killed by a fearsome figure from the Heavens, and the Taiyi Imperial Palace was similarly affected.]
[At the same time, many forces discovered something. That is, Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion and the Nine Stars themselves seem to have disappeared, leaving the Nine Stars Pavilion headless and in chaos. As a result, the Nine Stars Pavilion falls from its pedestal.]
[In the blink of an eye, another one or two hundred years pass. Due to the in-name-only existence of the Nine Stars Pavilion, the Dark Emperor and the Dark Psuedo Immortal are once again exterminated. This world becomes divided between the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family, with the Immortal Mansion’s exam being held as scheduled.]
[This time, Ku Xuan outshines everyone, unmatched, displaying his own brilliance.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 150,000 years pass. Many world-shaking opportunities emerge, and the prodigies born during the Golden Age all grow up._MONSTERS like Ku Xuan, Lei Wanqian, Shi Yuyan, and others have already become Emperors.]
[It is under such a prosperous era that the Immortal Mansion finally announces something – the Immortal Gate is about to open, and the Immortal Fate will soon emerge for those destined to obtain it.]
[This news causes the entire Upper Realm to be in an uproar. As a result, all cultivators in the Supreme Realm and above in the Upper Realm move out, heading for the Immortal Mansion to compete for the Immortal Fate.]
[In this situation, a hundred years pass in the blink of an eye. After a hundred years, the Immortal Gate officially opens, the endless immortal radiance appears, illuminating the world. Some cultivators are astonished, feeling that the other side of the Immortal Gate is the Immortal Domain. However, more people believe that even if the other side of the Immortal Gate is not the Immortal Domain, it must be a small world related to the Immortal Domain.]
[Of course, though it’s called a small world, it’s actually no smaller than the vast Universe of the Upper Realm.]
[Next, the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion make an appearance, stating that in order to enter the Immortal Gate, the fortunes of the contemporary Emperors and many Quasi-Emperors at the 3rd tier Realms of Dao Verification must merge to trigger another space.]
[Hearing this, many cultivators’ eyes gleam with excitement, finally understanding why the Immortal Mansion had recruited so many disciples and put so much effort into cultivating the contemporary geniuses. Clearly, they were not just worried about some terrifying disaster, but also wanted to use the power of contemporary geniuses.]
…
“The simulation of Wang Ping being trapped has, indeed, brought back the long-lost original story plot.”
Wang Ping watched the content of the text simulation, his eyes flickering with surprise and curiosity.
In previous simulations, he had never lived long enough to see the opening of the Immortal Gate.
“Next, I should be able to find out what’s inside the Immortal realm and get a clearer idea of what the Immortal Mansion is plotting.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, a hunch forming in his heart.
Then, Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
[Subsequently, under the combined efforts of Ku Xuan and dozens of contemporary Great Emperors, as well as numerous Supreme Quasi-Emperors, an anomaly occurs in the Immortal Gate, successfully connecting to another space.]
[Then, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion announces that everyone can enter. The world behind the Immortal Gate contains the Immortal Clan, Immortal Spirits, and countless opportunities. Throughout the ages, after entering the Immortal Gate, there have been countless people who have broken through from Quasi-Emperor to Great Emperor, and even some from Great Emperor to Quasi-Immortal.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - 1112 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1112: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death! _4 Chapter 1112: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death! _4 [As for becoming an Immortal, although no one has achieved it in the world after the Immortal Door, there is indeed an opportunity for it. It depends on who has the luck and the chance.]
[After that, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion indicated that opportunity comes with danger, and if anyone dies in it, the Immortal Mansion will not be responsible.]
[Upon hearing this, many cultivators felt a burning desire, but they did not take it seriously. They said it is needless to say that even without the opportunity to become Immortal, on their cultivation path, they have risked their lives many times for other opportunities. The desire to break through limits comes with taking risks, and this is a natural law.]
[Seeing no objections from the crowd, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion chuckled and said that everyone could enter.]
[As the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion spoke, the eyes of the many cultivators were filled with fiery intensity, not hesitating to rush into the Immortal Door.]
[After everyone entered, the kind face of the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion instantly turned cold, becoming expressionless.]
[At this time, the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal also appeared here, with a cold and cruel face, asking the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion how many people he intends to let survive this time.]
[The Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion looked indifferent and said he didn’t know, and it depended on their master’s intention. Then, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion reassured the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal that Ku Xuan would be alright, but how many other Ku family members would survive depended on their master’s mood, which he should also understand.]
[The Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal fell silent and sighed, acknowledging that he understood.]
[Then, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion expressed regret that your sudden death was a pity. If you hadn’t passed away and had been devoured by their master instead, maybe her seal would have been broken much sooner.]
[The Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal sneered and said it wouldn’t be that easy. Master Leng Yue of the Nine Stars Pavilion was very difficult to deal with and had a close relationship with you, so he wouldn’t let you in.]
[Upon hearing this, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion shook his head and thought it was not necessarily true. With Immortal Fate at stake, who could ignore it, especially for a genius like you, it would be even more impossible to neglect.]
…
“That old fellow of the Immortal Mansion really has ill intentions. However, I didn’t expect the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion to be on the same side.”
Wang Ping watched the content of the Text Simulation and couldn’t help but frown.
Previously, he thought the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal were adversaries, but now he learned they were actually a united team.
To be precise, both sides had a common master, and they held the same interests in serving their master.
But usually, they were actually wary of each other.
“But who is the master mentioned by the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal? His purpose seems to be to devour many cultivators to lift the seal. If that’s the case, the reason why only the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal are left after the cultivators from the last epoch were wiped out and underwent the long Last Dharma Age is quite interesting.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered this.
While Wang Ping was thinking, the Text Simulation continued.
[Just as the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal were talking, you went through a long period of time here and finally broke the array set by Leng Yue before her death, regaining your freedom.]
[After regaining freedom, you were very weak. This situation made you even more irritable, and the desire to kill that had been suppressed in your heart for over two hundred thousand years finally exploded uncontrollably.]
[As a result, you began a massive slaughter. The power of the Devouring Immortal Bead was used to its maximum by you, swallowing up numerous Ancient Stars and all Living Beings on them, turning them into your nourishment.]
[This commotion naturally couldn’t be concealed from the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion. The two looked at you in horror.]
[They never expected you to still be alive and seemingly have broken through to the quasi-Fairy Tier. However, it appeared that you have become possessed.]
[At the moment of their astonishment, you noticed their peeping, revealed a bloodthirsty look, and quickly went to the Immortal Mansion.]
[When you appeared in front of the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal, both of them broke into a cold sweat. A chill ran from the soles of their feet straight to their heads, and a natural fear filled their hearts.]
[As Quasi-Immortals who had lived for so many years, their mentality was naturally astonishing, but you are now too powerful, and your momentum is terrifying, giving them immense pressure that is difficult to bear, making them appear this miserable.]
[At that instant, both of them realized that even if they worked together, they would only be killed in the blink of an eye, with no suspense. They were very clear that you were probably far above the Quasi Fairy King Combat Skill, and although not reaching the True Immortal tier, you were not something a quasi-Fairy could take on.]
[As a result, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion took a deep breath, and just as he tried to coax you into the Immortal Door with his words, you exploded him with a casual blow. You were irritable and had no intention of listening to his nonsense.]
[Seeing the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion being blown up, the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal felt like his soul was escaping, wanting to flee into the Immortal Door. However, you sneered, and with a single move, killed him directly.]
[Then, you used the Devouring Immortal Bead to swallow up the remains of the two, turning them into your power to recover.]
[After dealing with them, you looked at the Immortal Door and entered it without hesitation.]
[When you entered the Immortal Door, you discovered that you had arrived in another secret realm. However, this was not any Small World or secret realm, and with your current strength, you naturally saw the truth of the so-called Immortal Door World.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - 1113 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1113: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_5 Chapter 1113: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_5 [In the Immortal World, you are actually inside a certain monster’s body. Those who enter the Immortal World are like wandering around within a monster’s body. If the adversary wants to devour them, it only takes a simple thought.]
[However, you are not panicked. You can sense that the monster seems to be sealed and cannot pose a threat to you for the time being.]
[Because of this, you reveal a bloodthirsty and brutal expression, using the Devouring Immortal Bead to absorb the surrounding energy. You aim to absorb the monster’s power, which might have reached the True Immortal tier, and transform it into your own strength.]
[I must say, this idea is quite insane. But since you have succumbed to the Demon Path, you are ready to do anything.]
[Your actions infuriate the sealed Evil Immortal. He never expected that someone would dare to do anything against him among the small fry who had entered his body.]
[For this reason, the Evil Immortal forms an energy body to stop your destruction.]
[Despite this, you laugh out loud, showing no fear. If the sealed monster were unsealed, you would dread it, but as an Evil Immortal in a sealed state, its power could not be fully utilized. The energy incarnation, while capable of easily killing many quasi-Fairies, is still no match for you.]
[As a result, you domineeringly suppress the Evil Immortal. This enrages the Evil Immortal’s energy body. After swallowing all the Upper Realm cultivators in its body, it forms an even more powerful energy body.]
[Seeing this, you finally take the situation seriously. The strength of this energy body is no weaker than the dark being you remember that was as insignificant as a bug, and might be even more powerful.]
[However, you are still fearless, and without hesitation, you activate the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. Although using this talent would cause you to lose one resurrection opportunity, you have no choice but to use it now.]
