[After all, you cannot use the five-digit special item, the Rod of Holy Light, because you have also fallen into the Demon Path. If you use the Rod of Holy Light, there is a possibility that it will cause massive damage to yourself, and you might die before even killing your enemy.]
[Therefore, you choose to use the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance. With the talent’s effect activated, your combat power soars to a terrifying level.]
[Reveling in this long-lost power, you laugh manically, throwing out your Chaotic Immortal Fist, unleashing a terrifying force.]
[This causes the Evil Immortal’s energy body to be shocked and frightened. It never thought that a quasi-Fairy like you could be so terrifyingly powerful. Such a strong quasi-Fairy would be rare even in the Immortal Domain, let alone in the Lower Realm.]
[For this reason, the Evil Immortal’s energy body knows that it might be in real trouble this time and is very frustrated and unwilling. If it wasn’t sealed, you, no matter how monstrous, would not be a match for this Evil Immortal.]
[Although dying at the hands of a monstrous quasi-Fairy like you is not very embarrassing, who would be willing to be killed out of their league if they could avoid it?]
[However, no matter how unwilling, the Evil Immortal’s energy body cannot change the situation and is completely destroyed by your rampage.]
[After destroying the Evil Immortal’s energy body consecutively, you use the Devouring Immortal Bead to devour it. As for refining the energy, it would obviously take a slow process due to the immense amount.]
[Next, you take advantage of the side effect of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance not yet arriving and continue to consume the Evil Immortal’s flesh and energy, causing them tremendous pain.]
[When it’s almost time, you choose to retreat.]
[This makes the sealed Evil Immortal very happy, as they had guessed that the side effect of your Secret Skill would arrive soon.]
[Therefore, the Evil Immortal knows it cannot let you escape and chooses to conjure another energy body to attack you, which annoys you greatly.]
[In the end, you are drained and unable to leave. The Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance’s side effect arrives, and you are about to die within the Evil Immortal’s body.]
[However, you don’t intend to let your corpse be devoured by the Evil Immortal and allow it to recover its strength. If that happens, it would be troublesome when you revive.]
[For this reason, you choose to self-destruct before your death.]
[As you self-destruct, a horrifying force sweeps over, causing severe injuries to the sealed Evil Immortal, which enrages it.]
[What’s more annoying is that after your self-destruction, you resurrect again and start a new round of devouring with the Devouring Immortal Bead.]
[As for the Evil Immortal, it can only continue to form energy bodies to hinder you. Regrettably, although your strength has declined after resurrection, and you can no longer use the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, the power of the Evil Immortal has also decreased significantly, and the formed energy bodies still pose no threat to you.]
[For this reason, you brazenly bully the sealed Evil Immortal.]
[Thus, after a year, the sealed Evil Immortal seems to have given up resistance, allowing you to take advantage without any fight.]
[At this, you are puzzled but still show no intention of stopping, devouring indiscriminately, repeating the process of devouring, refining, and continuning to devour.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - 1114 286 The First 5-Digit Talent Leng Yues
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1114: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_6 Chapter 1114: Chapter 286: The First 5-Digit Talent! Leng Yue’s Death!_6 [In the blink of an eye, ten thousand years have passed. During this time, you have already devoured all the sealed Evil Immortals and entered a closed-door state, attempting to break through to the True Immortal tier and become completely invincible.]
[However, just as you were about to break through to the True Immortal tier, something unexpected happened. The Evil Immortal’s consciousness appeared, interfering with your breakthrough. He laughed heartily, saying that you really thought you had him under control? He deliberately let you devour him, waiting for this day.]
[Now, you have three choices: either coexist with him, be taken over by him, or die in a self-explosion.]
[This sudden turn of events made your face look awful, and you tried to devour his consciousness with the Devouring Immortal Bead. However, you found this to be useless, which made you extremely angry.]
[The Evil Immortal’s consciousness laughed heartily, mocking you, saying that he had lived so many years, and his means could not be compared with a young child like you. You should just give up on the idea of ​​destroying him. ]
[The mockery from the Evil Immortal caused you to become increasingly irritable, and you chose to gamble with the Rod of Holy Light. Waiting for death was never your style. Before, it wasn’t, and now that you’ve become demonic, you are even less likely to sit back and wait for death. Whether it’s coexistence or being taken over, both are outcomes you would never accept.]
[As you took out the Rod of Holy Light, the Evil Immortal’s consciousness felt a huge threat, and he ordered you to stop immediately, otherwise, you both would die.]
[Seeing the Evil Immortal’s fear, you sneered and said that if he left your body, you would stop; otherwise, you would bring both of you down.]
[Being threatened by you, the Evil Immortal chuckled and said, “At this time, do you think I still have a choice? If you dare, then use it, and let’s die together.”]
[Seeing that the Evil Immortal wouldn’t back down, you snorted coldly, didn’t hesitate, and directly used the Rod of Holy Light, shining it on yourself.]
[It has to be said that your early judgment was completely correct; after becoming demonic, you were still damaged by the 5-digit special items, the Rod of Holy Light.]
[As a result, when you used the Rod of Holy Light, you immediately fell. Similarly, the Evil Immortal fused into your body was also dispersed under the light.]
[With your complete fall, this simulation came to an end…]
….
The text simulation stopped here, and Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various memory scenes and some insights on cultivation.
Of course, after being adjusted by the system, negative emotions and memories couldn’t affect Wang Ping.
“Old monsters are indeed tough to deal with.”
Wang Ping sighed after absorbing the memories.
“I originally thought that Simulation Wang Ping would have a chance to become an Immortal after breaking free from the predicament, but he still failed. In the lower realm, it’s really difficult to become an Immortal. It seems I still have to go to the Ancient Immortal Tree World and maybe, with the help of the resources from the Ancient Immortal Tree, it would be easier to become an Immortal.”
After a pause, Wang Ping thought silently.
“Ding, reward generation successful. Host can choose two from the following rewards:
①.5-digit Talent · Born Devil Immortal.
②.Evil Immortal Flesh.
③.Random Quasi-Fairy Artifact.
④.Six-digit talent · Bloodthirsty Emperor Blade.
⑤.Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves.”
…
“Huh, even though I didn’t go to the Ancient Immortal Tree World this time, the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves reward still appeared? It seems that there are quite a few hidden benefits after the Life Simulator was optimized.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list with gleaming eyes, somewhat surprised.
“System, I choose ④.Six-digit talent · Bloodthirsty Emperor Blade and ⑤.Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his choice.
The talent of Born Devil Immortal is good, but the side effects are too significant, so it cannot be chosen.
As for Evil Immortal Flesh, it isn’t considered precious, not to mention, as long as one knows the secret of the Immortal sect, it can be obtained at any time.
Although the Six-digit talent · Bloodthirsty Emperor Blade isn’t considered precious either, at least it can be used for trading and used in the Sky Tower Trial.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he found that he had an additional talent and its usage method.
At the same time, a jade box appeared in front of him.
After looking at this special jade box, Wang Ping saw the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves quietly lying inside.
Even without brewing the tea from these Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves, a faint smell can give people a refreshing feeling and a desire for enlightenment.
This is not an illusion. If it were smelled by cultivators with lower cultivation, they would definitely enter the state of enlightenment immediately.
It can’t be helped; the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves were produced by the True Immortal tier Ancient Immortal Tree, which is at a very high level.
Next, Wang Ping closed the jade box and put it in his internal world.
“Let’s continue with the simulation. If nothing unexpected happens, as long as I’m stable in this simulation, I should be able to become an Immortal.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought in his heart.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming two trillion catties of best divine source, Life Simulator is starting, refreshing talents…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love.”
Six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love: As long as the host and someone genuinely love each other and become Tao Companions, the host’s luck will be improved; if dual cultivating, the progress of cultivation will be faster, and your Tao Companion will also gain many benefits from this talent.
PS: This talent comes with a passive ability, making it easier to attract the opposite sex, O(∩_∩)O haha~
“Uh…”
Wang Ping looked at this talent, his eyes strangely shifting.
Well, does such a talent even exist? And it’s as high as six digits.
Before, Simulation Wang Ping would surely die if he got married.
Of course, this is actually just a gag.
In fact, no matter whether Simulation Wang Ping has a dao companion or not, the final outcome will always be death, it’s just a matter of sooner or later.
“I hope this strange six-digit talent will be of some use. Of course, usefulness is secondary, I just hope that Simulation Wang Ping won’t fall into the tender township.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and muttered.
“System, I choose the Six-digit Talent · Star Crossed Love.”
Immediately, Wang Ping spoke.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
System’s voice rang out again, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.

﻿Chapter 1115: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof Chapter 1115: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof [On the first day, after pondering, you go with Heavenly Feather Great Emperor to Guimo Sea, where you save Yu Daoyi. Due to your Six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love, the opposite sex is more likely to develop affection for you. As a result, Yu Daoyi developed a high level of affection for you, and became very curious about you.]
[Later, when Yu Daoyi learns about your astonishing achievements from Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, she is greatly shocked and admires you, becoming even more curious about you.]
[You, yourself, already have a strong affection for Yu Daoyi. Meanwhile, under the influence of your Six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love, you no longer have any resistance to the idea of having a Tao Companion, but become very interested in it.]
[Thus, shortly after, the two of you naturally become a couple.]
[As you become a couple, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor is overjoyed, inviting heroes to celebrate. With his invitation, who dares to refuse? As a result, the big shots of the entire Upper Realm gather, including even the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal, presenting extremely precious gifts.]
[Even Leng Yue came to the ceremony. Her arrival made you take things seriously, ready to fight at any moment. But, unexpectedly, Leng Yue didn’t initiate an attack. She just stared at you, seeming to see through something. After leaving a gift, she left on her own.]
[However, before leaving, Leng Yue challenged you to a duel. You responded with a faint smile, accepting this challenge.]
[This scene puzzled both the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family’s Quasi-Immortal, as they couldn’t understand the nature of your relationship, sensing a feeling of being both enemies and friends.]
[You glanced at the two old men, a hint of murderous intent flashed across your heart. However, in the end, you didn’t plan to take action against them. After all, they still had their value while alive. It wouldn’t be too late to deal with them after the Immortal Door was opened.]
[After the Immortal Banquet, you entered the bridal chamber with Yu Daoyi and had a great time.]
[You are surprised to find that during the dual cultivation, your Six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love shows an astonishing effect. Although your current cultivation level has reached the quasi-Fairy Tier, your Mana has been slightly improved, moving a tiny bit towards the transformation of Immortal Skill. Although the progress is small, it still has some effect.]
[You think that this particular six-figure talent may be much higher in potential than other six-figure talents.]
[While pondering, you are even more surprised by the change in Yu Daoyi after the dual cultivation. Her cultivation has made a breakthrough and directly advanced to the level of an emperor.]
[This breakthrough delights Yu Daoyi, who creates clothes and prepares to cross tribulation.]
[You smile in relief, setting up a Great Array to allow Yu Daoyi to focus on Crossing Tribulation.]
[The Emperor Tribulation appears, shocking Upper Realm cultivators; they never thought that someone would ascend during the Last Dharma Age. When they see who has ascended, their expressions become strange. Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, on the other hand, has a joyful expression, laughing heartily.]
[After Yu Daoyi successfully passed the tribulation, a rumor spreads throughout the Upper Realm. Whoever dual cultivates with you can easily achieve emperorship. The rumor drives countless women crazy.]
[Of course, that’s a story for later. After Yu Daoyi becomes an emperor, she retreats to consolidate her cultivation. As for you, you remember the promise to your time-traveling predecessor, Leng Yue, and decide to keep the appointment.]
[Then you have a shocking battle with Leng Yue. This fight is not as brutal as the last simulation; it leans more towards a sparring match. Neither of you uses your hidden cards, relying solely on your inherent strength. Finally, after a fierce battle, you defeat Leng Yue.]
[Leng Yue nods in acknowledgment, saying that although you are not truly yourself, you are close to becoming immortal, and perhaps you can soon fulfill the promise of becoming immortal.]
[In response, you nod slightly, saying you are indeed close to becoming immortal. However, you are also curious if Leng Yue, your time-traveling predecessor, can regain her freedom and leave this world after you become immortal.]
[Leng Yue nods slightly, saying it is indeed possible. However, she soon realizes that Wang Ping’s main body must have optimized the talent once again, as the previous Life Simulator should not have been able to simulate the All Heavens.]
[You nod, acknowledging the event of Wang Ping’s main body optimizing talent. However, you also mention that although the Life Simulator has reached five-figure talent, it is still not able to fully simulate the All Heavens. If it is too far away from this realm, it still cannot be simulated.]
[Leng Yue says calmly that this is normal. If your five-figure talent could fully simulate All Heavens, that would be strange. To achieve this, it would take more than a five-figure talent – at least a three-figure talent.]
[You laugh, not finding any fault with Leng Yue’s words. Then, you ask Leng Yue about her talent level and how many levels she had reached in the Sky Tower.]
[Leng Yue looks at you, realizing there’s no point in hiding anymore. Even if she doesn’t tell this simulated Wang Ping, the main Wang Ping will know eventually. That being the case, she reveals her secrets. She has a six-figure talent and reached the fourth floor of the Sky Tower.]

﻿Chapter 1116: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-Digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_2 Chapter 1116: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-Digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_2 [You were not surprised by this outcome and, being extremely curious, you asked Leng Yue what mode he chose when challenging the Heavenly Tower.]
[Leng Yue frowned, stared at you for a few seconds, and finally answered that he had always chosen Hell Mode.]
[Upon hearing this, you were quite surprised, but also thought it was perfectly normal. Difficult Mode would not be chosen by someone like Leng Yue, with great ambition and courage. As for Abyss Mode, the risk factor was too high. Leng Yue was actually the cautious type, just not as cautious as you. Therefore, Hell Mode was the correct choice.]
[Next, you didn’t ask Leng Yue about the content of the second, third, or fourth floors of the Heavenly Tower, as you knew he wouldn’t tell you.]
[After all, the rules of the Heavenly Tower were not going to reason with you; those who dared to violate them were obliterated. Even in your life simulation, it was the same.]
[Then, you didn’t say anything more to Leng Yue and planned to leave.]
[However, before you left, Leng Yue asked you again if you wanted to use the Refinement Array to become an immortal. If you didn’t want to use it, he would. In the meantime, he would avoid the starfield and Ancient Star you valued.]
[Leng Yue’s words left you stunned, as this was an unprecedented turn of events. However, you quickly understood why. In previous life simulations, Leng Yue might have had his heart set on a Chaotic Body, so he would wait until after he had killed the simulated Wang Ping before activating the array.]
[However, Leng Yue was no longer your match, and even though he had a trump card, he guessed that you also had a trump card. Since he wasn’t confident, he naturally chose to give up on attacking you. However, the Refinement Array must not be wasted; Leng Yue also wanted to become immortal, which was why he said this.]
[At this, you were slightly startled, not expecting Leng Yue to propose using the Refinement Array to you, who was assimilated with Wang Ping. After all, before this point, only the main body of Wang Ping could enjoy such treatment. This made you feel the impact of your improved power and optimized talents.]
[However, you still rejected Leng Yue’s proposal. To become immortal, refining the Ten Great Universes and such was something you couldn’t bring yourself to do, and you couldn’t bear to see Leng Yue do it either.]
[Seeing that you refused, Leng Yue’s expression didn’t change, but he did comment that you were sometimes overly kind. If you didn’t act in your own self-interest, you would be condemned and destroyed. Compared to growing stronger, the lives of other living beings were insignificant.]
[Upon hearing this, you fell silent. You might be naive at times, unwilling to choose such a devastating path without the Demonic Talent. However, everyone’s path is different, and you didn’t feel that you were in the wrong.]
[You then spoke up, stating that you had another way to become immortal, and if Leng Yue was willing, he could join you.]
[Hearing this, Leng Yue was quite surprised, not expecting you to have another path to immortality. However, he remembered the problem with your Golden Finger and shook his head, believing that it might be a normal circumstance.]
[Leng Yue then claimed that if you could become immortal through another method, he could refrain from using the Refinement Array. However, if there was no other way, even if it meant fighting with you to the death, he would activate the Refinement Array.]
[Regarding Leng Yue’s obsession, you felt helpless and could not guarantee that you would become immortal. However, given your current talents, you believed you had a 70-80% chance.]
[Hearing this, Leng Yue frowned slightly but still chose to believe you. He then asked what your method of becoming immortal was.]
[Regarding this, you didn’t conceal anything and spoke about the Ancient Immortal Tree and the sealed Evil Immortal. You stated that as long as you went to the Ancient Immortal Tree’s World, obtained the essence of the Ancient Fairy Tree, and condensed an Immortal Body, you could then wait for the Immortal Path to open and deal with the sealed Evil Immortal together to obtain enough energy to become immortal.]
[Of course, there was one thing you didn’t mention: you had the Rod of Holy Light. If you wanted to deal with the Evil Immortal alone, you could. However, if you could avoid using the Rod of Holy Light, it would be best not to. Once used, the sealed Evil Immortal would be turned to ashes, leaving nothing behind. In that case, you wouldn’t gain anything.]
[If that happened, it would be meaningless for you. After all, you weren’t an absolute Guardian Wei, and your goal was not to kill Evil Immortals. You only sought to kill them to become stronger. If the Evil Immortal turned to ashes and could not be used by you, your actions would be meaningless.]
[However, if you were to act alone, you would not be a match for the Evil Immortal and might not even force them to relinquish their resistance. After all, it was only after Demonization Wang Ping’s battle power was increased that you barely managed to do this. Now, you were much weaker than Demonized Wang Ping, so you couldn’t possibly do it on your own.]
[Even if you refined your body into an Immortal Body, it would not bring about a transformation in your overall strength. An Immortal Body increases physical strength, vitality, and recovery abilities, but the enhancement to your battle power wouldn’t be a qualitative change. Thus, your battle power was still inferior to that of Demonized Wang Ping.]
[Under these circumstances, it was essential to bring Leng Yue over to deal with the Evil Immortal together. Of course, the reason for not wanting to use the Cursed Doll was the same—it would be too wasteful against a sealed Evil Immortal.]

﻿Chapter 1117: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_3 Chapter 1117: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_3 [Instead of using this item, Wang Pingning would rather share the opportunity to become immortal with Leng Yue, a time-traveler predecessor.]
[Hearing your words, Leng Yue is also somewhat surprised. Then, he narrows his eyes and implies that although he knows the Immortal Mansion has many secrets, he did not think the Immortal Mansion had anything to do with the sealed Evil Immortal. As expected, the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion was able to become a Quasi-Immortal due to the Evil Immortal’s grace.]
[Upon hearing that, you nod, having long thought of this. Most likely, both the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal broke through to the quasi-Fairy Tier with the Immortal Spirit granted by the Evil Immortal. Perhaps it is for this reason that both of them had their lives controlled by the Evil Immortal.]
[Next, Leng Yue indicates that he can collaborate with you to breakthrough to the quasi-Fairy Tier by killing the Evil Immortal and achieving Tao Proving Immortality.]
[To this, you give a slight smile, not surprised by the choice of Leng Yue, a time-traveler predecessor. Then, you invite him to go with you to the Ancient Immortal Tree World now to trade with the Ancient Immortal Tree.]
[Leng Yue nods, no hesitation, and prepares to follow you directly out of this world.]
[However, just as you are about to leave, an abnormal situation suddenly occurs. The barrier of the Upper Realm is suddenly broken, and a figure appears in this world.]
[This causes your pupils to constrict, as you look over. Not only you, but Leng Yue also looks over, staring intently at the figure that broke through the barrier.]
[As you look over, the figure also looks down at you, revealing a shocked expression. Then, he sneers, indicating that it was the right choice for the Group owner to spend a great price to have him come and deal with you. In such a short time, you have already become a quasi-Fairy, and even the Chaotic Body has reached the Great Completion Domain.]
[Hearing this, you narrow your eyes, knowing that the person in front of you is a big shot from the Second-generation Chat Group, a terrifying strong who has already become an immortal or reached the five-digit domain above quasi-Fairies.]
[Nevertheless, the existence of five-digit beings cannot easily come to this world, so this time-traveler predecessor from the Second-generation Chat Group must have been sent by Dao Yi at a huge cost, and through some means, he sealed his own cultivation, lowering his power to a level below five digits.]
[Of course, even though the five-digit level is lowered, it is still far superior to ordinary quasi-Fairies, plus the five-digit means, its incredible strength has reached an astonishing level.]
[In addition, it is no surprise that this time-traveler predecessor did not appear in the previous simulation, as he was probably still on his way to this world. Due to the long distance, he was not simulated.]
[Now that he has entered the simulation range, he suddenly appears. Calculating the time, there is probably not much time left in reality before this guy arrives. It is no wonder that the last option was a must choose rather than an optional choice.]
[However, you also know that now is not the time to think about these things. You collect your thoughts, take a step forward with a cold smile on your face, indicating that the people of the Second Generation Chat Group really like to come one after another to seek death.]
[The Second Generation Chat Group’s time-traveler, Mu Xi Cheng, hears your words, his expression darkens instantly, saying that you are too arrogant, like an ant to him, a five-digit Elite. With just a glance, he can suppress you all. Even with his power restricted, killing you would be as easy as flipping over his palm.]
[Hearing these words, you narrow your eyes, not expecting Dao Yi to be so ruthless, thinking that even a five-digit Entry Tier wasn’t safe, he directly sent a five-digit Elite to kill you.]
[However, you are already used to the style of Dao Yi, this time-traveler predecessor. He likes to send people who are a few realms stronger than you to kill you. But every time, he fails to realize that your growth speed is more twisted than he thought, and you have more hidden cards than he imagined, leading to his repeated failures.]
[Most likely, the time-traveler predecessor from the Second Generation Chat Group in front of you is carrying many powerful items to deal with you. Therefore, you absolutely cannot be careless.]
[As you ponder, Leng Yue’s eyes are cold and sharp, he wastes no time launching an attack and aims for the Second Generation Chat Group’s time-traveler Mu Xi Cheng. As Leng Yue makes his move, horrifying anomalies appear, shocking the world.]
[Regarding this, Mu Xi Cheng from the Second Generation Chat Group coldly snorts, indicating that if Leng Yue, a worthless time-traveler predecessor, wants to die, he will comply.]
[As he speaks, Mu Xi Cheng also unleashes a terrifying power, fighting with Leng Yue. His horrifying skill is in no way inferior to that of the most powerful Evil Lord Energy Body and is even somewhat stronger. This is still the result of his power being sealed; otherwise, his power would be truly terrifying and not something a True Immortal could contend with.]
[Mu Xi Cheng’s power makes Leng Yue solemn. However, relying on his Space Talent to evade the attack, he continues to launch astonishing attacks. In response, you also take appropriate action, cooperating with Leng Yue and engaging in battle with Mu Xi Cheng.]
[Under your combined efforts, you have few enemies in the world, but Mu Xi Cheng in front of you is not an ordinary quasi-Immortal. He clearly possesses numerous means, so even with your and Leng Yue’s alliance, you are at a disadvantage.]

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1118: Chapter 287 Five-digit Attack! Three generations under one roof_4 Chapter 1118: Chapter 287 Five-digit Attack! Three generations under one roof_4 [“However, you both were not surprised, propelling into action with your strongest abilities. You immediately utilized the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, elevating your battle strength to terrifying levels. Similarly, Leng Yue, for the first time, resorted to a desperate Secret Skill which had not been used in the last simulation, elevating his battle force drastically.]
[Your eruption of power startled Mu Xi Cheng, pressuring him and overturning his advantage into a disadvantaged position. He was mercilessly assaulted by you and Leng Yue working in tandem.]
[Feeling suffocated, Mu Xi Cheng wondered how it was possible he was being beaten up so badly by you two, who were both at the six-digit limit if his power hadn’t been restricted.]
[Eventually, Mu Xi Cheng roared in rage, unleashing a special item which split him into five selves, each retaining his original strength.]
[Suddenly, you found yourselves transitioning from two against one to two against five, the pressure was back on you.]
[Seeing this, you felt a severe headache and realized that, as you had guessed, Mu Xi Cheng was prepared with more tricks up his sleeve than you knew.]
[Leng Yue also frowned, knowing that the situation was difficult. To this end, he suggested that he could buy you some time for you to activate the Refinement Array, transcending everything. Time was of the essence, and now was not the moment to hesitate.]
[Hearing this, you felt helpless, but you realized the urgency of the situation, and agreed to Leng Yue’s plan.]
[Following this, Leng Yue used a secret tool to control and confine all five Mu Xi Chengs within the same space, then he conveyed the complete activation code of the Refinement Array to you.]
[However, before you could execute your plan, Mu Xi Cheng claimed another item. That item was a control annulment accessory.]
[As he activated this accessory, the confinement over his forms was instantly destroyed. The five Mu Xi Chengs launched another attack at you and Leng Yue before you could reset the Refinement Array.]
[Seeing this, Leng Yue frowned, recognizing the futility of the situation. He considered escaping with you. With his talents, the chances of successful escape were quite high.]
[While Leng Yue was contemplating escape, you interjected and told Leng Yue that you would buy him some time while he activated the Refinement Array.]
[Upon hearing this, Leng Yue, without wasting any time, believed you and did what he needed to do.]
[You smirked, launching a suicidal attack directly at Mu Xi Cheng. The force of your suicidal attack affected all five Mu Xi Chengs, inflicting significant damage on them.]
[This took him by surprise. It was then that Leng Yue seized the opportunity, rushed to the stone platform, and activated the Refinement Array. You were revived.]
[However, the activation of the Refinement Array this time was not to refine the Upper Realm to help him breakthrough to the True Immortal level, that was beyond his time limit. His goal was to try and refine Mu Xi Cheng.]
[As Leng Yue began to harness the power of the Refinement Array, Mu Xi Cheng sensed danger. However, he didn’t panic. He sneered and pulled out something. It was a precious item that could precisely kill a targeted enemy. It was a rare 5-digit item. Once it locked onto an enemy, it could kill the enemy instantly.]
[Seeing this item, your expression subtly changed. You had experienced an attack from a similar item before. At that time, the item could unconditionally annihilate a target at the Supreme Realm or below, preventing their resurrection. That item was a six-digit item.]
[However, the item in front of you was a five-digit item. It could instantly annihilate any living being below five digits and prevent their resurrection – unless they had a five-digit tier resurrection item.]
[This meant that if Mu Xi Cheng used this item, one of you was undoubtedly going to fall here.]
[Realizing the urgency of the situation, you unhesitatingly summoned the 5-digit special item: Curse Doll, to destroy him.]
[The condition to use the Cursed Doll was significantly simpler than using the item that Mu Xi Cheng had. As you obliterated him with the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll, all Mu Xi Chengs froze. Then they turned to ashes and died without leaving any trace behind.]
[Seeing this, you finally breathed a sigh of relief and felt a shudder. Thankfully, you possessed the 5-digit mid-tier special item: Curse Doll, otherwise, you wouldn’t have stood a chance against Mu Xi Cheng.]
[It’s not that your abilities were inferior to his suppressed power. As a matter of fact, it was evident that killing him was not a difficult task given a coordinated effort. However, this time, Mu Xi Cheng was clearly loaded with many valuable tools.]
[In the Myriad Heavens Paradise, a person’s power in combat is not simply a reflection of their personal strength. Talents, items, and skills can significantly affect the balance of power to a great extent. The weak can defeat the strong by leveraging special tools and skills.]
[This time, if you hadn’t used the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll, you might have really lost against him. Who knew how many more horrifying items he still held?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1119 - 1119 287 The Attack of the Five-Digit Number
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1119: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-Digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_5 Chapter 1119: Chapter 287: The Attack of the Five-Digit Number! Three Generations Under One Roof_5 …
“This Mu Xi Cheng is really troublesome. Fortunately, I have the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll.”
Wang Ping frowned as he looked at the text simulation.
At the same time, Wang Ping also understood one thing – he had to take the initiative and act immediately.
Otherwise, if Mu Xi Cheng arrived in this world in reality, there was a possibility of being defeated by him.
“Although using a five-digit Special Item on Mu Xi Cheng seems like a waste, I have to use it for my own safety.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he sighed.
He had just returned from Myriad Heavens Paradise not long ago. It took time to go back there again.
Although his cooldown time was much shorter than others because he had passed the Abyss mode, only a month was needed. Wang Ping didn’t know if Mu Xi Cheng would increase his speed and arrive earlier in reality due to some intuition.
Intuition is mysterious, and no one can be sure.
As a result, Wang Ping felt he must guard against the other party and not save on using items.
“Maybe after killing him, all his items will belong to me.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but comfort himself deep down.
It wasn’t impossible.
Although the possibility of this happening was low because usually, the item’s owner would tamper with it, and once the person dies, the item will be either recalled or destroyed automatically. But if a cursed doll kills someone, there might be an exception.
As Wang Ping was pondering, the text simulation continued.
[Leng Yue also looked at the dead Mu Xi Cheng with a rare surprise, then deeply glanced at you. Apparently, he guessed something, but he had no intention of speaking directly.]
[Next, you searched Mu Xi Cheng’s corpse, trying to find the items he had. However, you were disappointed. His items had all self-destructed the moment he died. This was clearly the method of the Second Generation Chat Group Leader Dao Yi. It had to be said that this guy was a cunning fox.]
[But soon, you showed happiness when you saw an item. It was a special orb-type item. After grasping it, you understood its name and effect through your knowledge reserve.]
[The item was called Phantom Beast Summon, a five-digit item that can randomly summon a phantom beast to help you fight. This phantom beast was of the 5-digit Entry Tier level, so its combat power is quite good.]
[You speculated that it was Mu Xi Cheng’s own item, so it wasn’t destroyed. At the same time, since the summoned Phantom Beast is at the 5-digit Entry Tier, he couldn’t summon it, so he didn’t use it before, making it seem like a waste product.]
[However, you soon despised Mu Xi Cheng’s poverty. As a five-digit Elite, he only had one 5-digit Entry Tier item. It was too humiliating, and you couldn’t help but wonder if he had lost most of his possessions or if he was not doing well in Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Of course, you also doubted that the earlier effect of the cursed doll might have destroyed his own six-digit items, leaving only this five-digit item of decent quality behind.]
[Next, after Leng Yue had slightly recovered from his injuries, he asked you about the Ancient Immortal Tree World.]
[At this, you couldn’t help but admire Leng Yue’s mentality. After using his trump card and being injured so badly, he was still thinking about the opportunity to become immortal.]
[Then, you didn’t say much and directly took out the Rod of Holy Light and healed Leng Yue.]
[Of course, just as you used the Rod of Holy Light, you remembered something. That was whether Leng Yue belonged to the Source of Darkness and whether he would die immediately if exposed to the light.]
[However, when you wanted to take it back, it was already too late. Luckily, it seems that Leng Yue had completely detached himself from the Source of Darkness. After being exposed to the Rod of Holy Light, he was not vanquished. Instead, his injuries recovered mostly, and the rest of them were rapidly healing.]
[At this, you looked at him with a strange gaze, not saying anything. Leng Yue looked at your Rod of Holy Light and deeply glanced at you again. However, he still didn’t have any intention of asking.]
[Following that, you both smoothly reached the world where the Ancient Immortal Tree was. When you arrived in this world, two astonishing visions occurred.]
[With the appearance of these two astonishing visions, countless cultivators were shocked, and even the quasi-Fairy and the Ancient Immortal Tree were caught off guard.]
[Next, you and Leng Yue retrieved the visions one after another, and went straight to find the Ancient Immortal Tree. Your arrival made the Ancient Immortal Tree treat you very seriously, sensing that both you and Leng Yue were extraordinary.]
[As your familiar old man incarnation appeared, you directly spoke about trading with the Ancient Immortal Tree. Meanwhile, Leng Yue stared at the Ancient Immortal Tree, pondering whether or not to just kill it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1120 - 1120 288 Wang Ping becomes a celestial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1120: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! Chapter 1120: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! “Good heavens, just as expected of Leng Yue, she’s really planning to wipe out the Ancient Immortal Tree directly,”
Looking at the content of the text simulation, Wang Ping had an odd look in his eyes and commented.
However, it’s not surprising, considering Leng Yue’s demeanor. Refining the Ten Great Universes wouldn’t even make her frown, let alone killing an Ancient Immortal Tree.
“But, the Ancient Immortal Tree must not be killed. After all, in many ways, this is a good tree, and it would be a terrible loss to kill it.”
Wang Ping shook his head, sighed, and went back to staring at the luminescent screen.
(The text goes on to describe your interaction with the Ancient Immortal Tree’s incarnation. The tree’s avatar is shocked that you know about events in the Source of Darkness and its desire to eradicate the curses therein. This wouldn’t be surprising if you were from this world, but since you’re from another world, it’s quite peculiar.)
(However, after some consideration, the Ancient Immortal Tree decides not to question how you know so much, and agrees to trade with you. If you can eliminate the curse, it will give you some Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and a drop of Immortal Tree Essence.)
(Upon hearing this, you shake your head and say that one portion isn’t enough; you need two. After all, you can’t do this alone; you need Leng Yue’s help. Therefore, naturally, two rewards are required.)
(The Ancient Immortal Tree is speechless at your audacity. Both the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and the Immortal Tree Essence are not easy to produce, they’re extremely precious.)
(Nevertheless, you understand the Ancient Immortal Tree’s hesitation and, with a smile, suggest that given the many years it has lived, even if it could only produce one drop of essence every ten million years, it should have gathered quite a bit over this period. There should be no need to fuss about two droplets.)
(Sighing, the Ancient Immortal Tree’s avatar realizes that you’re hinting at their stinginess, and it’s unbecoming of a True Immortal senior. In the end, the old man avatar of the Ancient Immortal Tree agrees, choosing to give you two portions.)
(At this, you’re quite satisfied. Then, you and Leng Yue journey towards the Source of Darkness.)
(When you arrive at the Source of Darkness, you find a great number of Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals. This situation is quite different from your memories.)
(However, this isn’t surprising. After all, it’s over twenty thousand years earlier than before. That Dark Being hasn’t captured all these Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals as fodder yet.)
(Next, you and Leng Yue start a massacre of these Dark Emperors and Dark Pseudo Immortals, absorbing their energy using the Devouring Immortal Beads. With that, the Source of Darkness in this world is wiped clean by you and Leng Yue.)
(Then, you enter deeper into the Source of Darkness, finding the pupa of that Dark Being. This time, both you and Leng Yue combine your attacks on this much weaker Dark Being, easily defeating it without a hint of suspense.)
(After dealing with the Dark Being, you leave the Source of Darkness, find the Ancient Immortal Tree, and request your reward. The Ancient Immortal Tree doesn’t renege on the deal and gives you both an Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaf and a drop of Ancient Fairy Tree Essence each.)
(Once rewarded, you’re quite satisfied, and you set out to find a place for seclusion to assimilate these items. Leng Yue doesn’t object to this. However, once you find a suitable place, she secretly suggests that you join her in wiping out the Ancient Immortal Tree. That way, you could easily become immortals.)
(You’re rather speechless at Leng Yue’s suggestion and indicate that you don’t want to do that.)
(Upon hearing your words, Leng Yue doesn’t say much, merely indicating coldly that if you don’t want to do it, she’ll do it herself after she becomes an Immortal. She would then utilize the tree to further her own progress.)
(Leng Yue’s words make you want to facepalm, but you don’t say much. After all, you know you can’t stop her unless you stand against her completely. But it’s impossible to become enemies with such a reliable ally like Leng Yue just for the sake of an Ancient Immortal Tree.)
(Following that, you both go into seclusion to start your cultivation. You first soak the two portions of Immortal Tea Leaves in sequence, hoping to use them for enlightenment.)
(However, it’s somewhat disappointing that the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves only have a significant effect when consumed for the first time. The effects of its consumption diminish with the second and third times.)
(So, having consumed two portions of Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves, you’ve only improved the Chaotic Immortal Scripture slightly, but it’s still at the level of the True Scripture. As for the Chaos Immortal Tao, although there’s some progress, it hasn’t reached the level of transformation.)
(At that, you’re somewhat disappointed, but you don’t say much. After all, the Ancient Immortal Tree is just a True Immortal, so you can’t expect too much from its produce. Having the first drink help you comprehend the Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Tao is already quite powerful.)
(Next, you take the Ancient Fairy Tree Essence, combine it with the Immortal Source you’ve refined from the Devouring Immortal Bead, and begin to cultivate your Immortal Body.)
(In the blink of an eye, a thousand years have passed. You’ve successfully cultivated your Immortal Body, enhancing your physical power, vitality, origin, recovery ability, etc. The most noticeable improvement is that you can burn your origin for a longer period.)

chapters.title: Chapter 1121 - 1121 288 Wang Ping becomes a celestial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1121: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _2 Chapter 1121: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _2 [Of course, under normal circumstances, you wouldn’t be able to burn your source, after all, in this lower plane, the chances of recovering source for someone of your level are extremely rare.]
[After you leave seclusion, you find out that Leng Yue had already come out. Leng Yue, has also condensed an immortal body.]
[Next, you leave this world with Leng Yue to find other worlds, hunting Dark Emperor and Dark Pseudo Immortal, refining Immortal Sources, and also trying to gain more opportunities. If you can become an immortal without waiting for the opening of the Immortal Door in more than 200,000 years, then it would undoubtedly be the best thing.]
[Unfortunately, it’s still the same problem, other worlds are hard to find. A hundred thousand years have passed, and although you have found many worlds and gained a lot, you haven’t found the opportunity to become an immortal.]
[As for this, Leng Yue is no longer interested in accompanying you in searching for other worlds to slaughter the Dark Emperor and Dark Pseudo Immortal. There is no benefit for him, and it’s a waste of time.]
[Regarding this, you also feel there is no meaning in continuing this way, so you and Leng Yue return to the Upper Realm where you came from.]
[When you return, you find out that Yu Daoyi has already conceived your child, she has even given birth to the child and sealed it in the golden age.]
[At this point, you feel extremely awkward, feeling that you owe Yu Daoyi too much. After all, not long after you became Tao Companions, you left this world for a hundred thousand years.]
[Yu Daoyi is somewhat resentful of your departure, so after you return, she pulls you into lovemaking and continues with dual cultivation for a year.]
[That once again triggered the six-figure talent – Star Crossed Love. It boosted Yu Daoyi’s cultivation from the middle stage of Emperor to the late stage, and your Mana gradually transformed into Immortal Skill.]
[At this point, you have to admire the effect of the six-figure talent – Star Crossed Love. With this talent, you don’t have to worry about your dao companion aging to death due to a lack of talent.]
[Next, you think of Ji Bingyan. You also have great feelings for Ji Bingyan and feel that you can’t let her stay lonely, only staying at the Great Saint or Quasi Supreme tier for her entire life.]
…
“This six-figure talent – Star Crossed Love has also brought out hidden promiscuous attributes, hasn’t it?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, his face twitching slightly.
He truly never thought that this six-figure talent – Star Crossed Love, would turn the simulated Wang Ping into a womanizer. One Tao Companion Yu Daoyi is not enough; he also wants to take Ji Bingyan.
Think about it, Wang Ping himself is a staunch loner. He doesn’t even want one Tao Companion, but this simulated Wang Ping is so promiscuous, which angers him.
As Wang Ping complains in his heart, the text simulation continues.
[Therefore, you feel that you can help her. So, you take Ji Bingyan as your concubine and start to cultivate her. Yu Daoyi doesn’t say much about Ji Bingyan becoming your dao companion. After all, she knows that Ji Bingyan and you are from the same lower plane and met you earlier than her. Plus, after meeting, she has a good impression of Ji Bingyan’s personality, so she can accept it.]
[From then on, the three of you live an unhurried life, dual cultivating, cultivating your daughters, and your daughters are extremely talented, surpassing their peers. Even Ku Xuan is almost on the verge of self-abasement due to your mischievous children.]
[In the blink of an eye, more than a hundred thousand years have passed. During these hundred thousand years, Ji Bingyan has also given birth to a daughter for you, who is also amazingly talented and outshines her peers. Now your two daughters have become emperors and are known as the Peerless Twin Beauties.]
[At the same time, during this hundred thousand years of dual cultivation, Yu Daoyi has already reached the Perfect Emperor Stage and has become a quasi-Fairy with the help of Immortal Source. Your father-in-law, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, has also become a quasi-Fairy with the help of your Immortal Source.]
[As for Ji Bingyan, she has also reached the Perfect Emperor Stage. As for you, your Mana has already transformed into Immortal Skill. Therefore, to call you a Pseudo-Immortal now would not be an exaggeration. After all, your body has already transformed into an Immortal Body, your Mana has turned into Immortal Skill, and you have also comprehended the Chaos Immortal Tao. The only difference between you and a True Immortal is that you haven’t attained Tao, or the most important True Immortal Tao Fruit.]
[However, as long as you want, the True Immortal Tao Fruit can be condensed over time. Therefore, you don’t need to absorb the energy of the sealed Evil Immortals to achieve your goal of becoming an immortal. It can only be said that the effect of this Six-Figure Talent – Star Crossed Love surprises you, and you didn’t expect such an incredible use from this talent.]
[Of course, the six-figure Talent – Star Crossed Love is only a six-figure talent, and it probably won’t be of any use once you reach the True Immortal stage.]
[As you ponder, the Immortal Door opens, and many cultivators from the Upper Realm enter. Leng Yue also comes to find you, wanting to team up with you to deal with the Evil Immortals.]
[Regarding this, you have no intention of refusing, after all, this is something you have already agreed upon with Leng Yue. In addition, although you no longer need to devour the energy of the sealed Evil Immortals to break through, this massive energy still has other uses and naturally cannot be wasted. After all, this energy might help your two daughters to become Immortals.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1122 - 1122 288 Wang Ping becomes a celestial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1122: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _3 Chapter 1122: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _3 [As you were about to set off with Leng Yue, they gazed at you, feeling that your cultivation was much higher than theirs, and you had gone even further on the road to immortality. However, they didn’t ask about your thoughts and just left with you.]
[Soon, you arrived at the Immortal Mansion, each of you using a move to casually eliminate the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and the Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, swallowing them and entering the mansion.]
[Then, you both began to devour the sealed Evil Immortal by using your own abilities. This made the sealed Evil Immortal furious, wanting to suppress you.]
[However, a terrifying event occurred. Both you and Leng Yue were far too powerful, far from ordinary Quasi-Fairies. This put tremendous pressure on the Evil Immortal. Nevertheless, he had to fight.]
[In the end, you and Leng Yue worked together to annihilate all the energy bodies of the Evil Immortal. This time, due to the two-on-one advantage, coupled with your current strength being no less strong than Wang Ping in the previous simulation, you could even be stronger for several reasons. You were able to handle the Evil Immortal’s energy body with ease, without even using your Six-figure Instant Elegance.]
[After destroying the energy body of the Evil Immortal, you began to search for his intention hidden within the energy. When you found it, you used the Rod of Holy Light to completely annihilate it, eradicating any future threats. As for Leng Yue, it seemed that there was a problem during the devouring process.]
[However, to your surprise, Leng Yue resolved it on their own without your help. Apparently, Leng Yue had a backup plan to deal with this situation.]
[You smiled at this, thinking that it was a very normal thing. With Leng Yue’s temperament, they must have prepared trump cards to deal with various situations, otherwise they wouldn’t risk devouring the energy body of an Evil Immortal.]
[Next, after completely destroying the world of sealing, you left the place and returned to the Upper Realm.]
[Then, Leng Yue nodded slightly at you and left directly, planning to close themselves off and make a breakthrough to become a True Immortal.]
[You shared a similar mindset and chose to close yourself off, wanting to break through to the True Immortal tier.]
[Under such circumstances, fifty thousand years passed in the blink of an eye. After fifty thousand years, you successfully condensed the True Immortal Tao Fruit and became a True Immortal.]
[As you became a True Immortal, the whole Upper Realm seemed to shake, with countless visions appearing and terrifying Immortal Rhymes spreading. This scene greatly shocked all beings. The Emperors, on the other hand, looked up to the sky one after another, becoming even more shocked, followed by a look of admiration on their faces.]
[Although they had never seen someone become immortal before, these terrifying scenes undoubtedly confirmed that someone had become immortal. And that person who became immortal was likely you – the number one person in ancient and modern times.]
[As for Heavenly Feather, Yu Daoyi, Ji Bingyan, your descendants, and your many disciples and friends like Ye Chen, all of them showed astonished and delighted expressions, feeling happy for your achievement of immortality.]
[Leng Yue also sensed the visions but maintained their usual expression, without any thoughts, as if they had expected you to become immortal faster than them. Then, they continued to attempt breaking through to the True Immortal tier.]
[Next, the terrifying True Immortal Tribulation appeared. You were in high spirits, laughing heartily, without any fear at all, confronting the True Immortal Tribulation. In the end, you angrily punched and exploded the True Immortal Tribulation, accepting the Heavenly Tao Baptism. The True Immortal Tao Fruit manifested in the Ten Great Universes, accompanied by endless celestial clouds, as if the Heavenly Tao was celebrating your Tao Proving Immortal.]
[Afterwards, a spiritual rain appeared, blessing countless living beings, who knew the reason. Mortals extended their lifespan and removed diseases, while cultivators broke through their cultivation. This made them overjoyed and grateful to you, the True Immortal of this era.]
[After becoming immortal, you swept your gaze across the Ten Great Universes, which made you feel a mix of emotions. Immortality used to be a legend, but now you have actually become immortal, which is truly amazing.]
[Then, you had some insights, or maybe just interest, as your celestial phantom appeared in the Ten Great Universes. Celestial music emerged from your mouth, stating that you had become immortal and would bless all beings, lecturing them on the Tao.]
[Your words made all beings exhilarated. Even unruly Emperors like Erebos Emperor were overjoyed, directly kneeling down and offering you the highest respect.]
[After all, everyone wanted to know the secret of immortality. However, who had ever spread the secret of immortality throughout history? Such opportunities and favors, not to mention kneeling before you, even becoming a servant by your side, would not be an issue at all.]
[Next, you began to lecture on the Tao. Your Celestial tunes spread throughout the Ten Great Universes, making all beings obsessed, while countless people’s cultivation began to break through. Even ordinary people started to possess cultivation under the influence of the Immortal Rhyme.]
[As your lecture ended, the entire Upper Realm was filled with a thriving and harmonious atmosphere. At that moment, all beings had a common master, which was you. Although they knew that they were just self-proclaimed disciples of you and weren’t even Entry Tier disciples, they still regarded you as their most respected master. The kindness of preaching and passing on the learnings was simply too great.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1123 - 1123 288 Wang Ping becomes a celestial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1123: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _4 Chapter 1123: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death! _4 [Due to the changes in the Upper Realm, the entire Heavenly Dao began to radiate and appeared to come to life, no longer withering. Consequently, the Ten Forbidden Lands also began to disappear one by one, merging back into the Heavenly Dao. The whole Upper Realm became more prosperous, and you could feel that the laws of the Upper Realm were becoming clearer and the spiritual energy was becoming more dense. Evidently, the Upper Realm had entered a golden age within a golden age, making it more suitable for cultivation.]
[While the current Heavenly Dao may not be as glorious as the Ancient Immortal Era, it is still much stronger than other eras. And all of this was brought about by you.]
[For a moment, your heart was filled with pride, and you felt extremely invigorated.]
[And at this very moment, another True Immortal aura appeared in the Upper Realm, followed by the emergence of the True Immortal Tribulation, shocking all living beings.]
[At this, you were somewhat surprised and guessed that Leng Yue had also successfully condensed the True Immortal Tao Fruit and achieved immortality.]
[You were not surprised by Leng Yue’s ascension to immortality and were happy for him. However, you couldn’t help but admire the power of Devouring Immortal Demon Body, as it helped Leng Yue catch up with your progress. Of course, this was not solely due to the Devouring Immortal Demon Body; Leng Yue himself was even more astonishing.]
[After all, the Devouring Immortal Demon Body was nothing more than a special constitution created by Leng Yue, a predecessor transmigrator.]
[Next, Leng Yue successfully passed the Immortal Ascension Tribulation and appeared before you, wanting to have one final battle with you. At this, you laughed heartily and naturally had no reason to refuse.]
[And so, you both began a great battle. The battle between True Immortals was terrifying, causing the entire Big Universe to tremble as if it was about to be destroyed by you both. Seeing this, you and Leng Yue simultaneously isolated the space and continued your duel.]
[Your battle shook everyone, making them fanatical and filled with admiration. This battle would be recorded in history and become a legendary fight.]
[In the end, this battle concluded with your victory. Although after achieving immortality, as expected, the Six-Digit Talent·Explosive Blade became completely ineffective, unable to amplify any damage, and the Six-Digit Talent·Instant Youth was also useless, your overall strength was still superior to Leng Yue, the predecessor transmigrator.]
[As a result, the gap between you two only widened after achieving immortality, rather than narrowing. It could only be said that the advantages brought by your Chaotic Body and Path of Chaos were indeed great, making you almost peerless at the same level.]
[Leng Yue was not surprised by this outcome, nor did he show any signs of disappointment. After bidding you farewell, he vanished without a trace.]
[Next, you pondered whether to explore the Elemental Forbidden Land, the Life and Death Realm, or attempt to venture into the Immortal Domain.]
[In the end, you abandoned all these ideas and decided to take it easy in the Upper Realm. After all, while exploring the Elemental Forbidden Land would not be too risky given your current cultivation, and even if you couldn’t get any opportunities, you would not fall there, the Life and Death Realm was a much more mysterious place, and even after achieving immortality, you had no way to be certain about what dangers lurked there.]
[As for venturing into the Immortal Domain, you didn’t entertain that idea either, as it seemed far too dangerous. Various signs indicated that something might have gone wrong in the Immortal Domain; otherwise, there wouldn’t be that extremely powerful Immortal Guardian present in the channel.]
[If you forcibly entered the Immortal Domain Channel, you might be killed by that extremely powerful Immortal. Even if that Immortal didn’t kill you, you might still perish upon arriving in the Immortal Domain.]
[Therefore, it was safer to stay in the Upper Realm. After all, having achieved longevity, there was no need for you to take further risks.]
…
“Alright, I finally became an immortal. However, it was still too prudent.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the text simulation and couldn’t help but hold his forehead.
Of course, he didn’t think that there was anything wrong with the simulated Wang Ping’s decision.
From the standpoint of the simulated Wang Ping, living cautiously was indeed the safest option.
After all the effort it took to become an immortal and no longer having to worry about inevitable death, naturally, one should cherish and enjoy life.
Although with this mindset, there wouldn’t be much progress on the path of cultivation, the simulated Wang Ping wouldn’t care too much about that.
Rather than reaching the pinnacle, for him, living without external support was what mattered most.
Besides, he now had many attachments.
“However, this doesn’t align with my interests. I must know what the situation in the Immortal Domain is like, and make the simulated Wang Ping as strong as possible so that I can benefit more from it.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered silently.
“So, I’m sorry, simulated Wang Ping, but I have to make you change.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and communicated with the Life Simulator with his thoughts, imparting his ideas into the simulated Wang Ping.
After the Life Simulator had been optimized, this was considered a hidden benefit – there was no need for immersive simulation, he could directly infuse his ideas and make changes.
As Wang Ping infused his thoughts, the simulation content indeed changed.
[The simulated Wang Ping felt a mysterious power, and his thoughts began to change quietly, feeling that merely remaining idle like this was unworthy of being the first person in history and a True Immortal. Therefore, he decided to continue his cultivation and become an Immortal King, or even a being beyond an Immortal King.]
[As a result, the simulated Wang Ping made a decision to explore the Elemental Forbidden Land first.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1124 - 1124 288 Wang Ping becomes a celestial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1124: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death!_5 Chapter 1124: Chapter 288: Wang Ping becomes a celestial! Re-enters the realm of life and death!_5 [Once you had an idea, you immediately set off for the Elemental Forbidden Land. After simulating Wang Ping’s entry into the Elemental Forbidden Land, the strange space tried to influence you, but you had already become an Immortal, so the slight spatial change naturally couldn’t affect you.]
[With a sweep of your thoughts, you instantly located the Chaotic Body of the Demon Immortal who had been dismembered by the Celestial Spirit Immortal King. With a movement, you arrived in front of the huge, familiar heart.]
[Then, you touched the seal, trying to break it. Unfortunately, the seal left by the Immortal King was not something you could break, even though you too practiced the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill.]
[This made you frown. You realized that you could never break the seal nor enhance yourself by devouring the various organs of the Demon Immortal with the Devouring Immortal Bead.]
[It was while you were thinking that a cold voice rang through your mind, saying ‘You, just a little brat who has just become Immortal, want to challenge him? You have no idea what you’re talking about. In his prime, it wouldn’t matter whether you had a Chaotic Body or were an Immortal King’s Descendant, he would have easily suppressed you with one palm.」]
[This cold voice made you frown. You understood one thing – the sealed Demon Immortal had consciousness and was aware of what was happening in the outer world. The reason he had not spoken before was that he found it beneath him. You were so insignificant back then that you were no different from the insects on the ground in his eyes.]
[Obviously, humans wouldn’t waste their time talking to insects; they would simply play with them until they died.]
[Various thoughts flashed through your mind, and then you began to mock, stating that if he were so powerful, he wouldn’t have been gutted and torn apart by the Celestial Spirit Immortal King, left sealed here.]
[At your mockery, the Demon Immortal snorted coldly, saying that you knew nothing, claiming that if it weren’t for the Celestial Spirit Immortal King’s resorting to bullying others with his higher realm, he would never have ended up like this.]
[After saying this, the Demon Immortal arrogantly stated that, even though the Celestial Spirit Immortal King could only seal him but not kill him, if he were killed, the Celestial Spirit Immortal King would also perish.]
[Upon hearing this, your eyes narrowed, and a guess formed in your heart. You surmised that the Demon Immortal sealed before you must have had some significant background, having committed a massive mistake, which led to his being suppressed and sealed by the Celestial Spirit Immortal King in the lower realm.]
[However, due to his powerful background, even the Celestial Spirit Immortal King did not dare to kill him. In other words, there must be at least one Immortal King behind him, one much more potent than the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[Thinking of this, you felt somewhat dispirited. After all, this guy’s background was so vast that even the Celestial Spirit Immortal King dared not kill him and could only seal him away. If you were to kill him, you would undoubtedly create significant trouble.]
[Of course, you couldn’t even break the seal right now, let alone kill him. Thus, the Demon Immortal’s appeal to you had turned entirely negative. This thing was not an opportunity but a massive pitfall, a significant problem.]
[Afterwards, you didn’t say much and simply turned around, intending to leave.]
[However, just as you were preparing to depart, the Demon Immortal’s voice rang out again. He stopped you, stating that if you found the key to release him, he could be your support when you entered the Immortal Domain, allowing you to roam freely there.]
[Regarding the Demon Immortal’s attempt to entice you, you showed no interest and directly ignored him, choosing to leave. This infuriated the Demon Immortal, who wished he could kill you and devour your soul. However, he did not have the ability to devour a True Immortal like you through the Great Array’s seal now. As a result, he could only furiously sense the direction of your departure.]
[After leaving the Elemental Forbidden Land, you thought of the Life and Death Realm and decided to explore it. After some consideration, you chose to go to the Life and Death Realm. Although the place made you feel uneasy, the danger seemed to be lower than going to the Immortal Domain.]
[Soon, you arrived at the Life and Death Realm and stepped inside. Then, you encountered the dangers you had faced before – the deathly aura of the Realm of Death and the life-force of the Realm of Life.]
[However, this level of power was no longer able to affect you, so you seemed quite composed.]
[But your composure quickly vanished because you found that although the space seemed normal, you had strangely ended up near the River of Forgetfulness as you walked.]
[This scene made your pupils contract, your brows furrowed, and a strong sense of danger and unease emerged in your heart. You understood one thing – this broken place was not only off-limits to Emperors, but even True Immortals and Profound Immortals who came here would likely perish.]
[As for Immortal Kings, that level was too far away for you to speculate.]
[As the heaviness in your heart and the sense of crisis intensified, the River of Forgetfulness also stirred, and numerous corpses emerged as if they had come back to life, lunging at you, trying to drag you down with them.]
[In response, you snorted coldly and unleashed a Terrifying Skill, shattering them all. These corpses were all below the level of Emperors, and though they were strange, they were nothing to you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1125 - 1125 289 Wang Ping the One Who Doesnt Respect
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1125: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, the One Who Doesn’t Respect Martial Virtues! Rise of the Flying Immortal School! Chapter 1125: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, the One Who Doesn’t Respect Martial Virtues! Rise of the Flying Immortal School! [However, your expression quickly changed. Because as you killed these corpses, the River of Forgetfulness began to generate a large number of whirlpools. Then, one by one, new corpses emerged from the river. The battle power of these corpses was not below the Great Emperor Tier, even reaching quasi-Fairy and True Immortal levels.]
[This proved one thing: even True Immortal-tier powerhouses were once dragged into the River of Forgetfulness. Of course, there was also a more chilling guess in your heart.]
[Just as you were feeling somewhat afraid, the True Immortal corpse led the other corpses to attack you. However, because you became an Immortal by attaining the Chaotic Body, your combat power far exceeded that of a True Immortal of the same realm. As a result, you easily destroyed the True Immortal corpse and its other comrades.]
[Next, not daring to linger any longer, you tried to leave. Only, the space here was even stranger than you imagined, and no matter what method you used, you couldn’t escape from the edge of the River of Forgetfulness.]
[At the same time, more and more corpses launched attacks on you. True Immortal-tier corpses emerged one after another, as if they were worthless. This weighed heavily on your heart, making you think that your second guess was probably true.]
[The River of Forgetfulness, like the one in your memory, where people who haven’t had their souls extinguished after death or meditation, would step onto the Bridge of Helplessness for reincarnation. Those who were extremely evil would not be able to cross the Bridge of Helplessness and would be tortured after falling into the River of Forgetfulness. In addition, those who wanted to escape and return to the mortal world would be thrown into the river and unable to transcend.]
[If that were the case, it goes without saying that the River of Forgetfulness would be connected to the Bridge of Helplessness. However, you don’t know whether this was naturally formed, encompassing everyone in the Profound World, or created by a Terrifying Strong being. If it were the former, it means that the world indeed has the concept of reincarnation and is somewhat related to Earth’s mythology. Maybe one day, you’ll be able to meet characters from myths.]
[On the other hand, if it were the latter, it might very well have been created by a powerhouse from the All Heavens. Maybe they were conducting some experiment or had a specific target they wanted to reincarnate.]
[However, no matter the situation, the Life and Death Realm, the River of Forgetfulness and Bridge of Helplessness were undoubtedly places you could not easily tread on. Staying a while would pose a danger to your life.]
[For this reason, even though you knew the power of the Life and Death Realm was needed to revive the withered Chaos Immortal Grass, you still decided to retreat. After all, if you continued to stay, not to mention finding a way to revive the Chaos Immortal Grass, you yourself would perish here.]
[Unfortunately, as much as you wanted to leave, you could no longer do so. As the River of Forgetfulness churned once more, an extremely terrifying corpse emerged from it. The aura of this corpse had astonishingly reached a level superior to the True Immortal.]
[This caused your expression to change drastically, wanting to escape, but the gap in combat power between you and the Profound Immortal corpse was too large. As the Profound Immortal corpse struck, you were instantly killed on the spot, with no ability to resist. Moreover, because the corpse was too powerful, you couldn’t even come back to life.]
[Due to your fall, the simulation comes to an end…]
…
As the Text Simulation ended, Wang Ping’s mind was filled with numerous memory scenes and cultivation realizations.
“It seems I have still greatly underestimated the Life and Death Realm. This place is too dangerous. I hope Profound Immortals are not the limit; if Immortal King corpses emerge in the future, it would be terrifying.”
After regaining his senses, Wang Ping rubbed his brow and grumbled in his heart.
“It looks like reviving the Chaos Immortal Grass and obtaining the Chaos Immortal Body in a short time will be very difficult. Unless I draw an extremely powerful 5-digit Talent, plus having good luck, maybe I can survive in the Life and Death Realm and find a way to revive the Chaos Immortal Grass.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping shook his head and thought helplessly.
The Chaotic Body was very powerful, but in the Immortal Domain, there were still a few top-tier Immortal Bodies capable of standing alongside it.
Only by obtaining the Chaos Immortal Body could Wang Ping truly dominate the Immortal Domain. At the same level, no one could rival him. Even if he exceeded his limits, he would be at ease.
Even at the level above True Immortal, surpassing levels would become increasingly difficult. But with the Chaos Immortal Body, Wang Ping felt he could easily overcome it.
“Ding, reward generation successful, host can choose one of the following rewards:
①.Early True Immortal Cultivation Stage
②.A random Immortal Stone
③.Six-figure Talent: Star Crossed Love
④.Ancient Fairy Tree Essence
⑤.A Cluster of Fairy Source
⑥.Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves”
…
“There’s only one reward this time? That’s pretty stingy.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards, frowned, and complained.
However, after complaining, he could only accept the reality and began carefully considering which reward to choose.
Theoretically, Wang Ping shouldn’t choose the Cultivation Reward.
Because it would be a waste of resources; once selected, Wang Ping’s cultivation would improve and he most likely wouldn’t be able to use the Extreme-tier Divine Source for simulation afterwards.
But Wang Ping had an inkling of worry. Although Mu Xi Cheng from the Second Generation Chat Group only arrived a few years later in the life simulation, no one knew if he would suddenly decide to speed up his arrival due to danger intuition in reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - 1126 289 Wang Ping The Man Who Doesnt Talk
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1126: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, The Man Who Doesn’t Talk About Martial Virtues! The Promotion of an Immortal! _2 Chapter 1126: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, The Man Who Doesn’t Talk About Martial Virtues! The Promotion of an Immortal! _2 If he’s coming soon, that would be a bit troublesome.
Truth be told, Wang Ping preferred to keep the 5-figure mid-tier special item: Curse Doll than to enhance his resources.
This thing is his true trump card.
If possible, Wang Ping really didn’t want to use this trump card on Mu Xi Cheng from the Second Generation Chat Group, as it would be a real waste.
“System, I choose option 1: True Immortal Cultivation.”
After thinking, Wang Ping made his choice.
As Wang Ping made his choice, he entered a strange cultivation state, with a sense of time distortion.
Then, his cultivation started to rapidly increase, reaching the True Immortal tier.
After reaching the True Immortal tier, he opened his eyes, feeling satisfied with his power.
Now, as long as he doesn’t recklessly go to dangerous places, he’s truly invincible in the Lower Realm, and no one can do anything to him.
“System, how many resources do I need for the Paid Simulation now?”
Immediately after, Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“Ding, detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the True Immortal tier, the host needs to pay with a True Immortal Artifact for the Paid Simulation.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“How much?”
Wang Ping’s face twitched slightly upon hearing the system’s voice.
“One True Immortal Artifact.”
Again, the system’s voice sounded.
“Show off.”
Wang Ping was speechless.
Wang Ping thought that the following simulations would require Immortal Source, but he never expected it to require a True Immortal Artifact, which caught him off guard.
Although he had two True Immortal Artifacts in his hands, he couldn’t bear to use either the Devouring Immortal Bead or the Chaotic Fairy Clothes for the simulation.
It was a helpless matter, as using them seemed somewhat wasteful.
“It seems like I have to figure out where to go steal, no, look for True Immortal Artifacts. There must be some places with True Immortal Artifacts in the numerous worlds affiliated with the Immortal Domain.”
Wang Ping sighed, feeling a bit helpless and regretted hastily choosing cultivation.
“Crack!”
Just as Wang Ping regretted his choice, the space in the Upper Realm shattered like a mirror, and a figure emitting terrifying aura stepped out from the broken space.
The figure was none other than Mu Xi Cheng from the Second-generation Chat Group.
The sudden change left all the cultivators in the Upper Realm stunned, showing fearful expressions.
Even Leng Yue frowned slightly, staring at Mu Xi Cheng.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping looked at the newcomer, his expression turning strange.
What is this? Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives?
It seemed that his previous sense of crisis was necessary, as the opponent’s actions indeed changed.
As expected, the Life Simulator had given a warning earlier.
Of course, it was still the same old saying that he already knew: Life simulation can only serve as a reference, and people’s thoughts can change at any time.
After feeling sentimental for a moment, Wang Ping quietly disappeared from his original spot.
After Mu Xi Cheng descended, he retracted a part of his power and sensed Wang Ping’s absence in the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
