This made him frown slightly and coldly snorted, “Wang Ping, you don’t have to hide. Come out. If you don’t want to show up, I’ll annihilate the Taiyi Imperial Palace and all the surrounding starfields.”
However, the moment Mu Xi Cheng’s words fell, the Chaotic Immortal Fist suddenly appeared, exploding his body apart.
This sudden change left many cultivators baffled, wondering why the terrifying Mu Xi Cheng had suddenly exploded.
It couldn’t be helped; their strength was too weak to see clearly what had happened.
Even the Quasi-Immortals of the Immortal Mansion and Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal couldn’t comprehend what had happened.
Only Leng Yue managed to discover some truth after Mu Xi Cheng’s explosion.
“Wang Ping, have you already become an immortal? I have to say, your talent is just too strong…”
Leng Yue was also a little unsettled, murmuring to herself.
As everyone was shocked, Wang Ping had already appeared at the spot where Mu Xi Cheng died, showing a cold smile, silently waiting.
Although he had become a True Immortal, Wang Ping would not talk about martial virtue with Mu Xi Cheng. Attacking him directly and suppressing him would be the most correct choice.
However, it was apparent that this guy had an incredibly powerful resurrection method.
Although the special item Curse Doll was useless against this resurrection method, Wang Ping, who had just become a True Immortal, was still unable to exceed the upper limit of Mu Xi Cheng’s resurrection ability.
In a blink of an eye, six hours had passed, and Mu Xi Cheng suddenly revived.
The moment he resurrected, Wang Ping struck again, trying to finish him off completely.
However, this time Mu Xi Cheng was clearly prepared and activated an item with all his might. Just before Wang Ping’s attack arrived, a barrier formed, blocking the attack.
But Wang Ping’s attack was too powerful, far surpassing ordinary Early True Immortal powerhouses.
As a result, Mu Xi Cheng’s defensive item was shattered by Wang Ping.
However, the moment the barrier shattered, an even more potent force rebounded towards Wang Ping.
Apparently, this was a special defensive item that could counterattack.
It could provide defense, and once attacked, it would reflect the attack back without modification, even making the attack more powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - 1127 289 Wang Ping Lacking Martial Virtue An
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1127: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, Lacking Martial Virtue! An Immortal Rises in the Sect! _3 Chapter 1127: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, Lacking Martial Virtue! An Immortal Rises in the Sect! _3 “Nice item, but it’s useless against me.”
Wang Ping snorted coldly and threw another punch.
You should know that he had not exerted his full strength before and was prepared for this kind of ability. Obviously, his judgment was correct.
As the two attacks collided, Wang Ping’s later punch directly annihilated the previous terrifying attack.
However, the terrible aftermath still formed, and many Starfields would be affected and destroyed.
The current Wang Ping was just too powerful, as every move he made affected this universe.
Seeing this, Wang Ping frowned slightly and used the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill to seal the surrounding space, preventing the aftermath from spreading too far.
However, Mu Xi Cheng was in trouble. He was also affected and was directly blown apart by the terrifying aftermath, suffering heavy injuries and almost dying once again.
This frightened Mu Xi Cheng; he didn’t expect Wang Ping to be this strong.
“Damn it, it hasn’t been that long since he increased his cultivation from Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection to the True Immortal tier, and his Chaotic Body has already been perfected. This level of strength is too terrifying. With the tools I have now, I cannot be his opponent; I must run!”
Mu Xi Cheng’s face twisted, and he tried to open the passage to Myriad Heavens Paradise to escape there.
He should never have accepted this task.
Both he and the Second Generation Chat Group Master Dao Yi thought they had paid enough attention to Wang Ping. Not only did they send a five-digit Elite like him but a bunch of items as well.
Under such circumstances, even if his power were suppressed, it should have been foolproof.
But who would have thought that in such a short time, Wang Ping would rise from Quasi-Emperor Great Perfection to the True Immortal tier.
Such a rapid increase in strength would be considered cheat-level even in Myriad Heavens Paradise!
“You want to run? Can you escape?”
Wang Ping noticed Mu Xi Cheng’s actions, sneered, and unleashed his terrifying power once again, aiming at Mu Xi Cheng.
As Wang Ping’s punch was unleashed, Mu Xi Cheng’s face changed dramatically, and the shadow of death enveloped his heart.
He understood clearly that if he dared to take this hit head-on, he would undoubtedly die.
As a result, he instinctively released his seal to block this attack and then tried to kill Wang Ping.
However, just as he released his seal, an astonishing scene took place.
Countless black Chains of Order appeared out of nowhere and tied up Mu Xi Cheng, ruthlessly strangling him, leaving nothing behind.
Seeing this scene, Wang Ping’s face also changed slightly, feeling a bit frightened.
You should know that Mu Xi Cheng had previously unsealed himself.
As a five-digit Elite, Mu Xi Cheng’s true power far exceeded ordinary True Immortals.
However, even so, he was killed in an instant.
These black chains were just too terrifying.
“No wonder the Second Generation Chat Group Leader doesn’t dare to step into this world easily. If he comes, he might end up like this. In the face of these rules, even suppressing cultivation may not be safe.”
Soon, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and silently withdrew his True Immortal aura, sighing.
“By the way, what about the gold coins that the old guy dropped?”
At this moment, Wang Ping also remembered Mu Xi Cheng’s dropped gold coins and hurriedly started checking.
In the end, Wang Ping didn’t even find the five-digit Item, “Phantom Beast Summon,” that Mu Xi Cheng owned.
“What a huge loss!”
Wang Ping was very frustrated.
The reason he didn’t want to use the Cursed doll against Mu Xi Cheng was not only because he was reluctant but also because he wanted to kill Mu Xi Cheng himself and see if he could keep a lot of good stuff.
As a result, he forced Mu Xi Cheng to use his own power, causing him to be strangled by the black chains…
If there were gold coins dropped, this outcome wouldn’t be bad. But with no coins dropped, it’s a big loss.
You know, the most enjoyable thing about fighting a BOSS is getting the gold coins.
“Forget it, forget it, when I break through the Heaven Tower myself, I won’t care about six-digit items or 5-digit Entry Tier items.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temple, muttered to himself, and consoled himself.
Next, Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and looked at a certain place.
There, Leng Yue walked in the air and gazed at him.
“Senior Leng Yue, I have fulfilled my promise, and you are now free.”
Wang Ping looked at Leng Yue with a smile and said.
“Hmm, I am indeed free now. My current self is finally able to connect with Myriad Heavens Paradise and go to that place.”
Leng Yue looked at Wang Ping with complex emotions and nodded.
“So, are you planning to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise now or wait until you become an Immortal?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“There is no point in staying in this world any longer. I plan to return to Myriad Heavens Paradise. That place is more suitable for me and will help me grow faster.”
Leng Yue’s voice was cold, revealing her decision.
“Haha, then let’s meet in Myriad Heavens Paradise in the future. Maybe one day, we can enter the tower together.”
Wang Ping smiled and responded without trying to stop Leng Yue or tell her how to become an Immortal.
After all, in the real world, unless Leng Yue killed the Ancient Immortal Tree, she would not be able to become an Immortal quickly.
Wang Ping couldn’t wait for over 200,000 years.
Neither could Leng Yue.
Of course, Wang Ping could try to actively open the Immortal gate, but he was not planning to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - 1128 289 Wang Ping Lacking Martial Virtue An
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1128: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, Lacking Martial Virtue! An Immortal Rises in the Sect! _4 Chapter 1128: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, Lacking Martial Virtue! An Immortal Rises in the Sect! _4 Even if she opens the Immortal Path and has Leng Yue devour the sealed Evil Immortal, it would still take her years of seclusion to break through.
It’s more suitable for Leng Yue to catch up with his progress in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Wang Ping has high hopes for Leng Yue.
Of course, Wang Ping thought Leng Yue was a very arrogant person, and she would never accept his “feeding” unless it was like their cooperation in Life Simulator.
“Maybe.”
After giving Wang Ping a deep glance, Leng Yue directly opened the channel to Myriad Heavens Paradise, ready to enter.
“Wait.”
It was at this time that Wang Ping suddenly spoke.
“Hmm?”
Leng Yue stopped, somewhat puzzled, and didn’t know what Wang Ping was still up to.
“If you don’t need your life-bound Immortal Artifact, you can give it to me.”
Wang Ping’s mouth slightly curved, jokingly said.
“….”
Leng Yue’s face twitched, rarely speechless.
Could life-bound Immortal Artifacts really just be given away like this?
Although they would only get a rating of less than five-digit Items in Myriad Heavens Paradise, it still shouldn’t be casually given away.
“I can’t give away my life-bound Immortal Artifact, but you can take this as a gift to congratulate you on becoming Immortal.”
Immediately after, Leng Yue sighed and directly took out an Immortal Artifact, handing it to Wang Ping.
Then, as if afraid that Wang Ping would blackmail him further, Leng Yue quickly stepped into the channel and disappeared.
“Really, why are you running so fast, as if I’m a big villain.”
Wang Ping looked at the place where Leng Yue disappeared and couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
As the Immortal Artifact given by Leng Yue listened to Wang Ping’s muttering, it was speechless and said coldly: “You snatched me, and you still can speak like that. I really admire your thick skin.”
“Heh, little Immortal Artifact, your path is too narrow.”
Wang Ping was not surprised that the True Immortal Artifact could speak, but he was still amused by its mockery of himself and showed a dangerous look.
For a moment, the True Immortal Artifact couldn’t help shivering, feeling that something bad was about to happen.
After that, Wang Ping didn’t pay attention to the trembling True Immortal Artifact, nor did he care about the spying Emperors and quasi-Fairies, and directly left.
As for lecturing on the Tao, Wang Ping in reality was not interested in doing it.
After all, it would be a waste of time.
In the simulation, although not much time seemed to have passed, the text simulation directly skipped it, but in reality, lecturing once would take hundreds of years.
Only in reality, he would be so bored to spend such a long time doing something so pointless.
Wang Ping, who is now only in his thirties, feels that a hundred years is a bit too long.
….
Next, Wang Ping returned to Taiyi Imperial Palace and continued the simulation.
However, this time, Wang Ping did not use Paid Simulation, but chose to use Free Simulation.
After all, he only has one Immortal Artifact, and once it’s used up, it’s gone, so it must be cherished.
Therefore, using Free Simulation to explore the Immortal Domain Channel situation first is undoubtedly the most appropriate choice.
Of course, Wang Ping also planned to go through Free Simulation to various worlds, looking for Immortal Artifacts.
In this way, Wang Ping could accumulate a few more simulation opportunities.
Although the Life Simulator now allows the use of World Source for simulation, if possible, Wang Ping didn’t want to use World Source for simulation.
Well, that’s what he said, but the fundamental reason is actually poverty.
The World Source he owns now is really too scarce, pitifully scarce.
“It seems that after the cooldown period is over, I need to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise and earn some more World Source as backup. Otherwise, I’d be too poor.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
“By the way, Alpha, can I deal with that Sci-fi Mysterious at my current level of cultivation? Can he still suppress my cultivation?”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of Sci-fi Mysterious and started contacting Alpha proactively.
“You can’t deal with him. His ability ignores the strength of Spirit Grid. In other words, even if you become an Immortal, or even an Immortal King, you will still be suppressed. Unless you become an even stronger being.”
Alpha’s voice sounded.
“Damn, even an Immortal King won’t work. Then I won’t even think about it.”
Wang Ping was speechless after hearing Alpha’s words.
This Mysterious has really grown up completely, even an Immortal King can be suppressed. But a big shot surpassing the Immortal King-tier wouldn’t personally deal with such a Mysterious, the cost-effectiveness is too low.
In other words, there is no solution.
“The best way for you to kill him is to get a talent that can blow up the entire universe or acquire a similar item.”
Alpha’s voice sounded, and the voice became cold and familiar.
It seemed as if the demise of a universe was not a big deal.
“I’ll talk about it later. Talents and items are not something I can get just because I want to.”
Wang Ping sighed, thinking that the trillions of group points were really hard to get.
Even, Wang Ping thought that the Mysterious was worth only trillions of group points, which was too little.
“It seems that I still have to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise to earn World Source.”
Wang Ping shook his head, once again giving up the idea of dealing with Sci-fi Mysterious, and turned his focus to the game in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
“System, I want to do a Free Simulation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - 1129 289 Wang Ping the one who disregards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1129: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, the one who disregards Martial Ethics! Showcasing Flying Immortal! _5 Chapter 1129: Chapter 289: Wang Ping, the one who disregards Martial Ethics! Showcasing Flying Immortal! _5 Then, Wang Ping collected his thoughts, speaking in his mind.
“Ding, Life Simulator is activated, free simulation begins….”
As Wang Ping finished speaking, the voice of the system rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[Day 1, you chose to leave the Upper Realm, wandering through various worlds seeking Immortal Artifacts. In the blink of an eye, a hundred thousand years had passed. You moved through different worlds with minimal gain, only obtaining two Immortal Artifacts in the Ancient Immortal Tree World. These two artifacts were treasures cherished by the Ancient Immortal Tree.]
[Disappointed, you returned to the Upper Realm, uninterested in continuing your quest for Immortal Artifacts. Upon your return, you exterminated the Ku Family’s quasi-Immortal and the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion, forcefully breaking through the Immortal door and breaking into it.]
[Your presence terrified the sealed Evil Immortal. You looked down on him from above, asking him if he possessed Immortal Artifacts, and if so, handing them over could spare his life.]
[The sealed Evil Immortal claimed that you needed to lift his seal first before he could fetch his Immortal Artifacts.]
[At this, you sneered, unafraid of the sealed Evil Immortal, forcibly breaking the seal on him.]
[With the breaking of the seal, the Evil Immortal rejoiced, laughing heartily, declaring he had no intention of honoring his promise. Then, he attempted to escape. You had expected his dishonesty and snorted with cold laughter, unleashing all your power to strike him.]
[Your outburst terrified the Evil Immortal. Thus, the Evil Immortal was directly blasted to smithereens by you. Then, you began to search his remains and successfully found his True Immortal Artifact hidden inside his inner world. This was a treasure you hadn’t obtained in the previous confrontations against him.]
[Obviously, the Evil Immortal hadn’t lied about this; only after lifting the seal could he retrieve his life-bound Immortal Artifact. Of course, this devious fellow had no plans of handing it over.]
[Nevertheless, whether he was willing to give it up voluntarily or not, you were ready to kill him regardless, an outcome that wouldn’t change.]
[Next, you suppressed this dishonest True Immortal Artifact that attempted to backlash against you, casually tossing it into your inner world before destroying this world and leaving it.]
[Upon returning to the Upper Realm, you relayed to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor the news about the Religion Ascension to the Immortal Domain. This filled all the higher-ups of the Taiyi Imperial Palace, including the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor, with boundless joy, their excitement reaching a peak, an experience that was irrepressible even considering their many years of life and considerable composure.]
[There was no helping it; the Religion Ascension to the Immortal Domain was the doctrine they held dear in the Taiyi Imperial Palace and was a dream they had nurtured from generation to generation. Now, it seemed they would finally realize this dream.]
[Watching the ecstatic Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others, you lightly shook your head, telling them not to celebrate too soon. There was a potential risk to life when heading to the Immortal Domain, and you asked them to make a choice: if they were not willing to take the risk, they could choose not to go.]
[Upon hearing your words, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others didn’t hesitate in the slightest, figuring that risks were nothing compared to their hope of reaching the Immortal Domain. They also believed that all disciples would think the same.]
[You nodded, not surprised by their response. Afterwards, you approached the Dark Time Imperial Clan and asked them to accompany you to the Immortal Domain. To put it differently, you provided all the beneficiaries from your previous promises with substantial benefits or took them along.]
[Next, you used a terrifying skill to open the entrance to the Immortal Domain Channel, causing it to appear. This sight left all the Upper Realm cultivators in awe.]
[Then, under the envious glances of the Upper Realm cultivators, you led the mighty crowd into the Immortal Domain Channel.]
[After you all entered, some courageous Emperors and Quasi-Emperors, even Supremes, gritted their teeth and followed in. After all, it was a once-in-a-thousand-year opportunity to go to the Immortal Domain, and it would be too much of a pity to miss it.]
[At any cost, even risking death, they had to try their luck.]
[You naturally noticed the stowaways from the Upper Realm, but you didn’t mind as long as they didn’t cause destruction, leaving them be.]
[As you progressed, you found the Immortal Domain Channel was markedly different from the Ascension Channel from the Lower Realm to the Upper Realm. When ascending from the Lower Realm, the process was safe, but beyond the Guiding Light, there was Spatial Turbulence, which was very dangerous for Void Divine Realm cultivators.]
[However, inside the Immortal Domain Channel, there was no danger, only a vast, elusive Immortal Spirit, giving people a very peaceful feeling.]
[This made everyone extremely curious. They marveled at the Immortal Domain Channel’s uniqueness, believing that cultivating in this place would increase their cultivating speed manifold.]
[However, in contrast to others’ amazement and optimism, you became more and more grim. This peaceful environment didn’t make you curious or comfortable, but rather gave you an unsettling feeling of deathly stillness.]
[In addition to this, the ‘Immortal’ at the end of the Immortal Domain filled you with immense dread.]
[While you were lost in thought, you gradually reached the end of the Immortal Domain and saw the ‘Immortal’ that had appeared in your memory.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - 1130 290 Killing Until No One in the World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1130: Chapter 290: Killing Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! Chapter 1130: Chapter 290: Killing Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! [Not only did you see this ‘Fairy’, but others also saw this ‘Fairy’, and they were all somewhat astonished and fearful. They didn’t expect that there would be such an existence guarding the Immortal Domain. For a while, everyone was on guard, not knowing whether this ‘Fairy’ before them was a friend or foe.]
[As you were all apprehensive, the ‘Fairy’ opened its eyes, sweeping its somewhat vicissitudinous and numb gaze over you all, finally stopping on you and saying the four words – this way is impassable.]
[These words made everyone even more anxious. And your expression became even more solemn, asking this ‘Fairy’ in front of you why this way is impassable, and why they are not allowed to go to the Immortal Domain.]
[The ‘Fairy’ in front of you stared at you, not hiding anything, but only revealing a terrifying truth: The Immortal Domain has already been destroyed, and if you go there, you will only be sending yourself to death.]
[These words shook your hearts, completely unexpected that such a thing would happen. That was the Immortal Domain, yet it was destroyed, which was too unbelievable.]
[However, after being shocked, you quickly calmed down. As for the disaster in the Immortal Domain, you had some anticipation in your heart, but you simply didn’t expect it to be this severe.]
[Soon, you recalled the contradiction in this ‘Fairy’s words, and you couldn’t help but step forward and ask in a deep voice, saying that since the Immortal Domain has been destroyed, why would they be sent to their deaths if they went there.]
[The ‘Fairy’s expression remained unchanged, and its gaze was indifferent. It coldly said that the Immortal Domain was shattered by a terrifying existence, and that was why the Immortal Domain was destroyed. As for why you would be sending yourself to death by going to the Immortal Domain, it revealed that the place is no longer suitable for ‘Fairy’ to live in. No one in the Immortal Domain dares to become a Fairy anymore, and those who do would suffer a terrifying curse. Not only that, but the shattered Immortal Domain has already been occupied by the Demon Realm.]
[Upon hearing this, your heart was shaken, never expecting the situation in the Immortal Domain to be worse than you imagined. Under such circumstances, it seemed indeed like going there would be akin to seeking death.]
[Not only you, but the others also looked at each other in disbelief, not expecting their yearned-for Immortal Domain to become such a ghastly place. If that’s the case, they really couldn’t go to the Immortal Domain.]
[After some silence, you asked the ‘Fairy’ in front of you if it came to guard this place to preserve the fire seed.]
[The ‘Fairy’ was silent, stating that since the Immortal Domain was destroyed, someone had to do something. However, it didn’t know how many more years it could guard this place. After all, although the Source of Darkness in the lower realm had been quiet all these years, it didn’t mean that the Source of Darkness would not erupt.]
[Upon hearing this, you admired this ‘Fairy’ even more and asked another question: Who was the person that destroyed the Immortal Domain? Was it the Source of Darkness in the Immortal Domain?]
[The ‘Fairy’, after hearing your words, showed a fearful expression, stating that the existence that destroyed the Immortal Domain was not the Source of Darkness in the Immortal Domain, but someone from the Human Race. Over a hundred million years ago, this person slaughtered the Immortal Domain, leaving no one daring to be called a Fairy and no one brave enough to become one. And this was the truth behind no one daring to be called a Fairy or become one.]
[These words shook you to the core. What kind of freak could do such an astonishing thing, killing everyone and leaving no one daring to be called a Fairy or become one, ultimately destroying the Immortal Domain?]
[After being shocked, you curiously asked what the name and title of that person were, and why they destroyed the Immortal Domain.]
[The ‘Fairy’ fell silent, once again showing a fearful expression, stating that it cannot be said, it must not be said.]
[Seeing the reaction of the ‘Fairy’, you sighed in your heart. This ‘Fairy’ had at least the cultivation of a Profound Immortal, or even reached the level of a Quasi Fairy King. However, such a powerful existence was frightened to this extent, revealing an extreme fear when remembering anything related to the matter, which was simply too unbelievable. It could only be imagined what terrifying thing it witnessed back then.]
[Afterward, you were torn about whether to go to the Immortal Domain.]
…..
“This truth really makes one sigh.”
Wang Ping lamented in his heart.
The Immortal Domain was destroyed, ruled by the Demon Realm, and no one dared to call themselves a Fairy or become one.
Just thinking about it made it clear how dangerous the Immortal Domain had become.
The only unknown was who destroyed the Immortal Domain and why they did it.
“Alpha, do you know anything about the destruction of the Immortal Domain?”
After thinking for a while, Wang Ping began to contact Alpha.
Although Alpha was already half-disabled, the time during which the First Generation Chat Group existed had already exceeded 100 million years.
As a result, there was still a possibility that Alpha knew the truth.
“I do.”
Alpha’s voice rang out, giving Wang Ping a definite answer.
“Uh, you really do know… Then what is the reason for the Immortal Domain’s destruction? And which big shot was responsible?”
Wang Ping asked curiously.
“The one from the First Generation Chat Group.”
After a moment of silence, Alpha gave Wang Ping a surprising answer.
“Huh, the one from the First Generation Chat Group… you mean, the predecessor that dismantled you?”
Wang Ping looked astonished, and said incredulously.
“That’s him.”
Alpha went silent for a while before giving another definite answer.
“What the heck…”
Wang Ping was shocked, never expecting it to be his own predecessor ransmigrator who was responsible.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - 1131 290 Kill Until No One in the World Dares
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1131: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _2 Chapter 1131: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _2 This battle record is really too fierce.
Destroying Alpha and ruining the Immortal Domain, it’s just too ruthless.
You have to know that this happened more than 100 million years ago.
More than 100 million years ago, he was already able to do such things.
Doesn’t that mean that his imposing predecessor ransmigrator was already a four-digit existence more than 100 million years ago, and it couldn’t possibly be an entry-level four-digit level, otherwise he wouldn’t have been able to do this.
Killing so that no one in the world dared to call themselves Immortal, and destroying the Immortal Domain, this must be at least one major level stronger than the Immortal King to accomplish it, right?
It seemed that Alpha had guessed Wang Ping’s doubts, and didn’t intend to leave Wang Ping hanging, so Alpha began to explain directly.
“One hundred and twenty million years ago, because of his ruthless behavior, he offended all the powerful forces in the Immortal Domain. Moreover, because he was too strong, he made everyone feel uneasy. As a result, the major Immortal Kings decided to join forces to deal with him.”
“In that battle, the sky shook and the earth moved, and he alone killed all the Immortal Kings in the Immortal Domain, and destroyed all the Immortal Kings and Quasi-Fairy King Sects. Then, he calmly said, ‘In this world, apart from him, who dares to call themselves Immortal, who is worthy of being called Immortal.’ It was this sentence that silenced all the Immortals, who no longer dared to call themselves Immortals, and even changed the name of the Cultivation System.”
“One could say that after that battle, there were no more Immortals in the Immortal Domain, and the Tao Hearts of all the Immortals were shattered.”
“It was also because of that battle that so many powerhouses fell, causing a rain of blood in the entire Immortal Domain, which was a mourning of the Heavenly Tao for the Immortal Domain. From then on, the Immortal Domain began to decline.”
In the end, Alpha’s tone was far from calm, as if reminiscing about that period.
Back then, the things that that person did made her shudder in fear as well.
It was after that that she became extremely apprehensive of that person, wanting to completely control him.
As a result, before she could take action, she was soon captured by him and disassembled, losing half of her spirit grid and the World Source accumulated by the first generation chat group, as well as something else.
“Immortal Kings, all obliterated…?”
Wang Ping inhaled sharply, very astonished.
He really didn’t expect that all the Immortal Kings were killed.
So, that means that Celestial Spirit Immortal King also fell, huh?
If you calculate it that way, the time point of the Tower of Celestial Spirit and the Demon Immortal being sealed in the world below must also be more than 120 million years ago.
“Indeed, they were all wiped out. Back then, he showed no mercy. Moreover, his way of doing things has always been to cut off the weeds and eliminate the roots. Not to mention the Immortal Kings themselves, as long as they were related to them, they would be crushed into dust.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out, with admiration for that person, as well as a trace of resentment.
“By the way, Leng Yue’s style was also inherited from him because Leng Yue was his little fan.”
After a pause, Alpha revealed another piece of information.
“Good guy, too ruthless.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips.
Compared to his predecessor, he was really ‘too kind’.
However, was Leng Yue really a little fan of that person? And did he learn his methods from that person? That’s interesting.
“So, Alpha, why did he choose to destroy the Immortal Domain? What benefits did he gain in the process?”
After thinking for a moment, Wang Ping thought of the matter of destroying the Immortal Domain again and asked curiously.
“The reason for destroying the Immortal Domain was not for the purpose of refining it, and it had nothing to do with breaking through his realm. It was simply because he was threatened, and then he shattered the Immortal Domain, turning it into several smaller Immortal Territories.”
Alpha fell silent for a moment, and then spoke somewhat ambiguously.
Hearing this, Wang Ping raised an eyebrow, guessing that the reason might not be so simple.
Perhaps, it had something to do with the Source of Darkness.
Otherwise, after the Immortal Domain was shattered, it wouldn’t have been ruled by the Demon Realm.
Of course, these were just Wang Ping’s personal speculations. The truth was not known, and unless Alpha spoke, he could only slowly explore it himself.
After all, with the Life Simulator, finding out the truth was just a matter of time.
“However, speaking of it, the time point of 120 million years ago seems to be very close to the time when the first-generation chat group was destroyed, right?”
Wang Ping’s eyes looked strange.
“That’s because I was disassembled after that. I don’t want to say much about the specific process.”
Alpha’s voice was very cold.
“……”
Wang Ping’s eyes looked strange, guessing that Alpha was probably triggered by the events in the Immortal Domain back then, which led to a series of chain reactions.
“One hundred twenty million years ago, so much time has passed, I really don’t know what level that predecessor has reached.”
Wang Ping collected his thoughts, feeling somewhat emotional, and was very curious about the strength of that predecessor ransmigrator.
With his means and growth rate, after so many years, it was very likely that he had become a three-digit existence now.
Three digits, that would also be a top powerhouse in the world, right?
After all, there are only thirty-six two-digit existences.
And below the two digits, the three digits are the strongest.
“I’ve told you before, don’t look too closely into his affairs, or it may bring disaster upon you.”
Alpha warned.
“You’re scared of him, but there’s no need to be too afraid. After all, with his methods, he probably already knows about our previous discussions. And if he wants to destroy you or me, it’s just a thought, and if anything really happens, it would’ve already happened.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1132 - 1132 290 Kill Until No One in the World Dares
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1132: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _3 Chapter 1132: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _3 Wang Ping shook his head and spoke frankly.
Upon hearing this, Alpha fell silent, unable to speak.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t say much and didn’t inquire about the specifics of the Immortal Domain being ruled by the Demon Domain. Instead, he continued to gaze at the luminescent screen.
Of course, while gazing at the screen, Wang Ping also infused his own subjective consciousness into the simulated Wang Ping.
After all, having heard about the situation in the Immortal Domain, the simulated Wang Ping might be discouraged.
This clearly wouldn’t do.
Wang Ping wanted to explore the Immortal Domain’s situation, so he naturally had to let the simulated Wang Ping proceed there.
As Wang Ping continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, more text emerged.
[You calm your thoughts and express your hope that the predecessor will let you pass, as you wish to go to the Immortal Domain.]
[Seeing your persistence to go to the Immortal Domain, the ‘immortal’ in front of you frowns and remains silent for a long time. Then, he glances at you and the others. Finally, he gives an answer.]
[If you want to go die, he won’t stop you. However, these people can’t go. If they do, they will be immediately corrupted by the dark energy and fall completely. Nowadays, in the Immortal Domain, without immortal-level combat power, there is no ability to survive.]
[Upon hearing this, you breathe a sigh of relief, but also feel a little helpless. Meanwhile, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others, upon hearing this, exchange glances and resign themselves to bitter smiles. Only immortals can go to the Immortal Domain, which is a source of despair for them. After all, apart from you, who can become immortal in the Lower Realm?]
[For a while, many people felt disheartened. Nevertheless, those led by Heavenly Feather Great Emperor managed to calm themselves and told you not to worry about them. They said that you should go to the Immortal Domain yourself, and that staying in the Lower Realm to cultivate might not be a bad idea for them.]
[Hearing this, you felt helpless but could not say much. In the end, you take out the immortal artifacts you obtained from the Predecessor Ransmigrator, Leng Yue, as well as various cultivation resources seized from the Dark Emperor and the Dark Psuedo Immortal. Then, you handed them to the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor.]
[With these resources, Taiyi Imperial Palace will become incredibly prosperous, and nobody would dare to provoke them.]
[After saying goodbye to Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others, you head to the Immortal Domain alone.]
[Just as you’re about to step into the Immortal Domain’s teleportation gate, the ‘Immortal’ calls out to you. He warns you very seriously that when you visit those small Immortal Territories, never claim to be an Immortal, or bad luck may befall you.]
[In response, you nodded, promising to remember his words. Afterward, you stepped into the Immortal Domain’s teleportation gate without hesitation and headed to the Immortal Domain.]
[Once you’ve left for the Immortal Domain, the ‘Immortal’ casually waved his hand, sending Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and the others back to the Upper Realm. Then, he continued to close his eyes, seemingly transformed into an eternal statue.]
[As for you, after experiencing a boring ascension process, you arrived at one of the small Immortal Territories formed by the recondensation of Immortal Domain fragments. As soon as you arrived, you felt that there was something unusual about this world.]
[Despite it being a small Immortal Territory, there wasn’t a trace of Immortal Spirit, but rather, it was filled with Demon Spirit. This Demon Spirit was so powerful that even though you had become immortal, you couldn’t absorb it casually, or it would have adverse effects.]
[As you became concerned about the environment in this small Immortal Territory, a wolf-like creature as tall as a mountain appeared. Its scarlet pupils stared at you intently.]
[This made you squint your eyes, sensing the strength of this being. Then, you found that the strength of the wolf-shaped creature should be on the level of a True Immortal. Although it was incredibly powerful in the Lower Realm, it didn’t amount to much for you now.]
[At the moment you made your judgment, the wolf-shaped creature transformed into a black shadow, pouncing towards you.]
[In response, you snorted coldly, did not use any Immortal Skill or Immortal power, and merely relied on your physical body to kill it, causing it to burst apart and die completely.]
[After killing the wolf-shaped creature, you looked towards the front right and spoke indifferently, asking the spying person to reveal themselves.]
[As soon as your words fell, a man clad in black beast-clothes emerged from the space, praising your strength. He then sighed that after so many years, a cultivator from the Lower Realm who ascended to the Immortal Domain appeared once again, which he found lamentable.]
[The words of the beast-clothed man made you squint your eyes, as you deduced he must be a long-lived powerhouse from the Immortal Domain, so you became on guard.]
[Seeming to notice your wariness, the beast-clothed man laughed and reassured you that you didn’t need to be on guard. In these small Immortal Territories, cultivators of all major races were allies, as only by doing so, they could resist the invasion of the Demon Realm. Otherwise, they would die.]
[As such, he wouldn’t harm you. Moreover, individuals with incredible talents like you, who had ascended to the rank of Flying Immortal, were highly valued by the Sacred Alliance. Therefore, you could follow him to the Immortal City located in this small Immortal Territory. Of course, you should remember, you’re not an Immortal, but an Eternal Realm Cultivator. The word ‘Immortal’ was taboo in the small Immortal Territories.]
[Hearing this, your eyes flickered as various ideas flashed through your mind. It was apparent that after the Demon Realm invaded the Immortal Domain, the surviving cultivators of the Immortal Domain formed this so-called Sacred Alliance to resist the Demon Realm and preserve their own lives.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1133 - 1133 290 Kill Until No One in the World Dares
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1133: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Claim to be a Fairy! _4 Chapter 1133: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Claim to be a Fairy! _4 [This piece of information is quite a good thing for you. It denotes that there are still plenty of living beings in the smaller Immortal Territories, a refuge for survival, rather than all having fallen under the control of the Demon Realm. With this, your survival pressure has significantly decreased, and you can safely become stronger.]
[Upon realizing this, you accepted the proposition of the Beast-clothed man standing before you, planning to accompany him to the so-called Immortal City.]
[The Beast-clothed man was overjoyed by your agreement and started leading the way for you. Along the journey, he began to narrate to you the present situation in the Immortal Domain.]
[After the Immortal Domain was shattered, large regions were destroyed; the remaining regions formed four Small Immortal Territories named Heaven Immortal Realm, Earth Immortal Territory, Profound Immortal Realm, and Yellow Immortal Territory respectively. The Small Immortal Territory they belonged to was the Profound Immortal Realm, which ranked third among the four. The Immortal City was the core area of the Profound Immortal Realm and a gathering place of the strongest cultivators in the said Realm. It was also the frontline in the defense against the Demon Realm.]
[The level division of the current Immortal Domain includes the Immortal Realm, Immortal Mysterious Realm, and King of Immortality, which correspond to the former three Great Realms.]
[Upon hearing this, you shook your head, feeling overwhelmed with a myriad of emotions. That person from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group was indeed ruthless. Even after so many years, he still frightened his opponents into not daring to mention the word ‘immortal’, choosing to directly change the realm’s name. Perhaps, there were also some changes in the Cultivation System.]
[Then, curiosity crossed your mind. You were curious as to how the cultivators of these four Small Immortal Territories would react once they found out that you were the descendant of the fierce persona who slaughtered all the Immortal Kings and shattered the Immortal Domain. Would they immediately annihilate you, or be extremely terrified of you, or even choose to curry favor with you?…]
[Of course, these were just thoughts for now, and you had no immediate plans to find out.]
…..
“Wow, this simulation is indeed interesting to play with. Well, it’s definitely worth a try.”
Wang Ping was looking at the simulation content, his expression peculiar.
As Wang Ping was commenting, the Text Simulation continued.
[While you were pondering, the Beast-clothed man suddenly revealed a sinister smile and launched a sneak attack on you.]
[To this, you were well-prepared. Coldly snorting, you fought back without the slightest hesitation. After all, you were no longer a naive youngster that believed everything being told. You only trusted less than half of his previous words.]
[In the collision between you two, the Beast-clothed man was struck and sent flying, his body almost bursting apart and blood gushed out fiercely. The man coughed up mouthfuls of blood. Then, a look of disbelief appeared on his face.]
[After all, he was a cultivator at the True Demon Late Stage, equivalent to the True Immortal Late Stage, while you were just a newly ascended being. Launching a sneak attack while having the advantage in cultivation, yet suffering an injury, was indeed a bit too contrary to common sense.]
[Immediately, the Beast-clothed man realized he had run into a tough opponent and made no hesitation to flee. Of course, you wouldn’t let him go and chased after him, suppressing him on the spot.]
[The moment you broke out, this beast from the Demon Clan showed a horrified expression, finally realizing why you were so strong. It was the re-emergence of the legendary Chaos Body, which had already reached the Great Completion Domain. Such formidable physical strength indeed bestowed you with the potential to fight across levels.]
[Though it’s said that there’s a tremendous gap between every small realm within the True Immortal tier, the massive advantage brought about by the Great Chaos Body is enough to empower you to leap across two small realms.]
[However, the Beast-clothed man soon sneered, saying that while you may be monstrous, the Immortal Domain today was ruled by his Demon Clan. All the living beings in the Immortal World had become their slaves and food. Even the remaining strong cultivators in the Immortal Domain dared not show themselves, hiding one by one. Therefore, even with a Chaos Body, you’d eventually be suppressed by the Demonic Clan’s strong warriors and become their food.]
[You scoffed at his words, not wanting to waste your breath on him, and directly suppressed him to death. Then, you attempted to refine his soul with the Devouring Immortal Bead. But, such a Beast-clothed man, being a powerful figure at the True Demon Realm Late Stage, wouldn’t be easily soul-refined. The Devouring Immortal Bead was just a True Immortal Artifact, and it would undoubtedly be challenging to refine the soul of a cultivator of his level.]
[Thus, you failed to refine his soul and acquire any useful information. This annoyed you immensely and made you all the more somber.]
[Following that, you had no intention of staying on here. You quickly fled in an attempt to find a safe haven. After finding a secure place, you planned to collect some more information.]
[However, the unforeseen is to be expected. The force you released in killing the Beast-clothed man attracted the attention of many from the Demon Clan.]
[Because of that, some powerful members of the Demon Clan began to search for you, aiming to root you out and suppress or annihilate you.]
[Among these powerful Demon clan members, there were some old monsters from the Profound Demon Realm, who went toe-to-toe with the Profound Immortal Realm. Facing the pursuit of these people, it was challenging for you to escape.]
[Eventually, you were captured. Facing the old monster from the Profound Demon Realm, you stood no chance. Therefore, when about to face your demise, you took out the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll, wanting to curse him to death.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1134 - 1134 290 Kill Until No One in the World Dares
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1134: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _5 Chapter 1134: Chapter 290: Kill Until No One in the World Dares to Call Themselves Immortal! _5 [Although you are well aware that even if you use the Cursed doll and curse the Profound Demon Realm’s old monster in front of you, it would be very difficult for you to survive. Killing the Profound Demon Realm’s old monster will only attract more powerful monsters, and in the end, you still won’t be able to escape death.]
[Feeling helpless, you sigh in your heart. The Immortal Domain has become too dangerous now, leaving no way out for the Immortal World beings.]
[Just as you were about to use the Cursed doll and sighing in your heart, a woman suddenly appeared in front of you. After she pointed and killed the old monster from the Profound Demon Realm, she took you away from there.]
[During this process, you had no room to resist. Clearly, this woman was incredibly powerful.]
[When you regained your senses, you had already arrived in a small world. You were slightly startled, realizing that someone had saved you.]
[Then, you took a good look at the woman who saved you. She had a perfect face and an alluring figure. She was more beautiful than any woman you had ever seen, even more so than Liu Mei, who used the Golden Finger to maximize her beauty.]
[For a moment, you were mesmerized by this perfect woman. As you stared at her, she spoke. Her voice was cold, but carried a hint of warmth.]
[She told you that Lu Daoxian had warned you not to enter the Immortal Domain, but you didn’t listen. If she had arrived any later, you would have perished.]
[Upon hearing the perfect woman’s words, you were quite surprised. Lu Daoxian was ranked second on the Tower of Celestial Spirit’s stone tablet, and yet, you didn’t expect to hear his name from her.]
[After that, you remembered the ‘Fairy’ from the Immortal Domain Channel and had some guesses. Presumably, he was Lu Daoxian, who had experienced the events in the Immortal Domain, and later chose to guard the Immortal Domain Channel for the safety of the Upper Realm, for who knows how many years.]
[For a moment, you admire this senior in your heart.]
[However, you quickly regain your senses and speak to the perfect woman with a serious expression. Since you have ascended to be an immortal, there is no reason to be trapped in the Lower Plane of the Immortal Domain. You want to become an Immortal King or even an existence that is greater than an Immortal King.]
[The perfect woman’s eyes show a hint of surprise at your great ambition. Then, she quietly said something that left you speechless.]
[She said that since you are a living being from All Heavens, you could have gone to the Myriad Heavens Paradise to become stronger quickly, without having to risk your life in the Immortal Domain.]
[You could not respond to this. After all, you were only simulating Wang Ping, not the real Wang Ping, and could not enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise. Only by entering the Immortal Domain can you attempt to advance further.]
[The perfect woman seemed to sense your embarrassment and did not continue on this topic. Instead, she introduced herself. Her name was Chu Lingyin, the daughter of the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[Upon hearing the perfect woman’s introduction, you were astonished, as you never thought that the woman in front of you would be the daughter of the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[However, after a second thought, it was not surprising that she would have a past relationship with Lu Daoxian since she was the daughter of the Celestial Spirit Immortal King, and perhaps also had some connections with the Upper Realm.]
[Next, you introduced yourself and asked Chu Lingyin about the current situation in the Immortal Domain.]
[Chu Lingyin calmly explained that when the lineages of all Immortal Kings in the Immortal Domain were wiped out, all Immortal Kings perished. More than 90% of Quasi Fairy Kings also fell, and their supreme combat powers were wiped out.]
[Later, the Immortal Domain was shattered, and more powerful beings died. At that time, even Profound Immortals were considered top experts in the Immortal Domain. Less than ten Quasi Fairy Kings remained, marking the most decadent moment in the Immortal Domain.]
[The worst part was when the Demon Realm, which had always been hostile to the Immortal Domain, learned that the terrifying existence had left the Immortal Domain and launched an invasion on it. Although it was said that it was an invasion by the Demon Realm, in fact, it was just an invasion by a Demon King Clan of the Demon Realm.]
[However, since the current situation of the Immortal Domain was so terrible, it could not resist even the invasion of a single Demon King Clan.]
[As a result, the so-called Flame Demon Clan easily conquered four Small Immortal Territories, making them its own territories. In this process, four more Quasi Fairy Kings fell in the war.]
[That is to say, at that time, there were only five Quasi Fairy Kings left among the cultivators in the Immortal Domain. Consequently, the Immortal World beings, led by these five Quasi Fairy Kings, could only do their best to hide and avoid being discovered by the Demon Clan, or they faced death.]
[Hearing Chu Lingyin’s words, you sighed in your heart. The plight of the Immortal World beings was much worse than you had imagined.]
[Next, you composed yourself and asked Chu Lingyin curiously about her cultivation level, which had reached the level of a Quasi Fairy King.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1135 - 1135 291 Chu Lingyins Shock Cultivation Soars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1135: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! Chapter 1135: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! [In response to your inquiry, Chu Lingyin nodded and shook her head. From this, you understood her meaning. She has reached the Quasi Fairy King Tier, but cannot call herself a Fairy, which is a taboo.]
[Seemingly reading your thoughts, Chu Lingyin sighed, indicating that their realm classifications are now determined by the Demon Clan system. The Demon Clan system consists of True Demons, Profound Demons, and Demon Kings. As such, you can consider her cultivation to be at the Quasi-Demon King Realm level.]
[Upon hearing Chu Lingyin’s words, you shook your head, cursing the previous Demon Clan member in your mind. That guy really couldn’t say a few truthful words, even hiding the truth about the realm from her.]
[Next, without you continuing to ask questions, Chu Lingyin told you about the current situation of the Immortal World Beings.]
[The current Immortal World Beings are miserable. They can only hide in various hidden locations in the Small Immortal Territories as separate ethnic groups, creating small worlds to survive in. If any such group is discovered by the Demon Clan, they will be destroyed.]
[Because the Flame Demon Clan has a Demon King and even five Quasi-Demon Kings, they are too strong. Even if a Quasi-Demon King-tier Immortal World Being is discovered, their life might be in danger.]
[Your current location is one of the human ethnic groups protected by her, a Quasi-Demon King-tier powerhouse.]
[Listening to Chu Lingyin’s words, you sigh in your heart. Although the Beasts Demon Clan lied about many things, including the situation of the Immortal World Beings, their situation is indeed miserable, much worse than what the Beasts Demon Clan said.]
[Afterwards, Chu Lingyin didn’t say much more and directly introduced you to the small world. The small world is not considered too big, but that’s only in comparison to the total area of the Immortal Domain. In fact, the area of this small world is much larger than the Upper Realm.]
[However, it’s quite normal. With Chu Lingyin’s Quasi Fairy King Tier cultivation, creating a secret realm like this isn’t difficult.]
[After you got familiar with the small world, Chu Lingyin took you to the core of the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm, the Spiritual Sound Immortal Palace, to meet the other powerful individuals of the palace. Although these powerful beings are not as strong as Chu Lingyin, they are all Profound Immortal-tier powerhouses and can be considered the higher-ups of the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm.]
[It could only be said that the current Immortal World Beings are very weak. Even Profound Immortals are considered top-tier powerhouses. Moreover, there are only eight Profound Immortal-tier powerhouses in this Spiritual Sound Secret Realm led by Chu Lingyin.]
[Your arrival has shocked these Profound Immortals. They never expected for Flying Immortals to appear from the lower world, let alone a legendary Chaotic Body.]
[For a time, they were all quite curious about you. After all, the Chaotic Body was once considered the top bloodline in the Immortal World, with only a few top-tier Immortal Bodies being able to compete with it.]
[It can be said that possessing the Chaotic Body meant that if the genius did not perish midway, becoming a Profound Immortal was inevitable, and becoming a Quasi Fairy King would not be difficult. But it is difficult to become an Immortal King… As for becoming an Immortal King, the influence of the bloodline is not that great. For this reason, only a minority of those with the Chaotic Body become Immortal Kings.]
[Of course, once these powerful beings with the Chaotic Body become Immortal Kings, their combat prowess is definitely stronger than ordinary Immortal Kings. Although at the Immortal King-tier, the impact of bloodline weakens a lot, it still provides a significant advantage.]
[There was once a man named Ye Cang who possessed a Chaotic Body and ascended to the Immortal Domain. He gained prestige in the Immortal World and eventually became an Immortal King, with astonishing strength.]
[Unfortunately, in a battle 120 million years ago, that Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang was killed by a terrifying existence.]
[Thinking of that terrifying being, all Profound Immortals couldn’t help but reveal fearful expressions. There was no helping it; compared to that existence that slaughtered all Immortal Kings and shattered the Immortal Domain, Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang amounted to not much.]
[Chu Lingyin watched as the Profound Immortals’ expressions changed from surprise to fear, knowing they were associating the Chaotic Body with that horrifying being, and fell silent.]
[As for that terrifying being, she was also filled with fear and resentment. Without that existence, her father, Celestial Spirit Immortal King, would not have fallen, the Celestial Spirit Immortal Clan would not have been destroyed, and the entire Immortal Domain would not have been shattered and oppressed by the Demon Clan.]
[But, what use is resentment? Without power, she could only hold a grudge without seeking revenge.]
[You look at Chu Lingyin and these Profound Immortals and feel speechless. Whether it’s Lu Daoxian, Chu Lingyin, or these Profound Immortals, they all have some kind of mental problem, feeling depressed by the first generation of transmigrators in the First Generation Traveler Chat Group.]
[Of course, you can’t blame them. After all, what they had experienced was indeed horrifying.]
[However, you can also infer the current situation of the Immortal World Beings from this. If nothing unexpected happened, their cultivation must not have progressed at all since that incident, all of them living with a broken Tao Heart. And as for the younger generation, there probably aren’t many of them.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1136 - 1136 291 Chu Lingyins Shock Cultivation Soars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1136: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _2 Chapter 1136: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _2 [After all, without resources, the seniors had all encountered problems. In such a situation, it is hard for any genius to emerge. There might be some, but compared to a normal environment, they would definitely be few and pitiful.]
[Next, Chu Lingyin and the Profound Immortals realized their emotional outbursts and calmed their minds, beginning to discuss serious matters. This matter was about the allocation of resources in the Celestial Spirit Secret Realm.]
[Regardless of whether it was Chu Lingyin or the other Profound Immortals, they all knew very well that the strong cultivators who had experienced that incident had basically suffered shattered Tao Hearts. Therefore, in order to break the stalemate and survive in the hands of the Demon Clan, they must cultivate a powerful existence capable of rivaling the Demon King.]
[Only then would their situation change slightly.]
[Precisely because of their determination in this matter, their nurturing of rising talents was undoubtedly extremely harsh, and their allocation of resources even more so. Because the Immortal Domain was now ruled and invaded by the Demon spirit, the resources they had would not increase but rather decrease over time.]
[For this reason, they were reluctant to provide resources to allow cultivators with insufficient talent to become fairies. In their current view, such behavior was too wasteful.]
……
“The Immortal Domain is really miserable, saving even resources for becoming immortals…”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation content, somewhat speechless.
At the same time, Wang Ping was also getting a headache.
With the Immortal Domain in this mess, when he ascends to the Immortal Domain, how could he earn resources to help him simulate?
Immortal Artifacts should be considered rare now.
Unless he went to snatch them from the Demon Clan.
However, stealing from the Demon Clan and going back to sleep didn’t seem like a good idea.
“Sigh, it seems better to use the Cursed Doll and maintain my cultivation at the quasi-Fairy tier.”
Wang Ping thought about his own cultivation and felt helpless.
But it wasn’t his fault, he didn’t know about the Immortal Domain’s current situation.
Because he wasn’t aware, he naturally believed that compared to the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll, which can kill a Quasi Fairy King, the Extreme-tier Divine Source wasn’t worth much.
“Forget it, what else can be said? Take it one step at a time. As the old saying goes, if it doesn’t work, go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise and earn World Source.”
Wang Ping shook his head and refocused on the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping focused, the words on the luminescent screen continued to emerge.
[Listening to their discussion, you learned more about the situation of the Immortal World beings and couldn’t help but feel heavy-hearted, worrying about your own future.]
[Next, Chu Lingyin spoke of you, stating that there were quotas for the True Immortal tier resource allocation. On your arrival, she saw hope, as the chances of a Chaotic Body from the lower world becoming an Immortal King were greater, and after becoming an Immortal King, it would be even more powerful, and more capable of breaking through with the Immortal World beings.]
[However, before you could say anything, Chu Lingyin spoke again, saying that although you possessed a Chaotic Body, you still needed to fight for it. Some rules were not set by her alone, so if you wanted to gain the most resources, you naturally needed to demonstrate enough combat power and potential.]
[Hearing this, you nodded in agreement. After all, you had just arrived here and naturally had to follow the arrangements in order to gain the greatest benefits and become stronger quickly.]
[Seeing your calm attitude, Chu Lingyin and the others nodded and continued discussing many matters. Among them was the discovery and extermination of an ethnic group by the Demon Clan. The Immortal World beings lost many resources and five Profound Immortals in the process. It could be said that this loss was disastrous.]
[For a moment, Chu Lingyin and the others’ faces were clouded with gloom, and their eyes were full of worries for the future.]
[Chu Lingyin and their discussion made you realize that they clearly intended to cultivate you as a core tier, with no intention of hiding anything. This came as a surprise to you.]
[You should know that you had just ascended and were not familiar with Chu Lingyin and the others at all. In theory, even if you had a strong enough talent, they should not trust you so easily.]
[But on second thought, what could be worse than the current situation? Trusting you or not was not necessary to consider. Because you were a Flying Immortal, and the Demon Clan would never send a Chaotic Body as a spy. Even if you were truly a spy, Chu Lingyin should have a way to monitor you.]
[As for this, you didn’t want to think about it too much. Afterward, when Chu Lingyin and the others finished discussing, they brought you to a place for trials.]
[The content of this trial was very simple; it was a combat power test. Your opponent was a True Immortal Realm genius, who had been transformed by Chu Lingyin using her methods from a previous existence. Only by defeating him would you have the best resource supply.]
[At this, you didn’t feel any fear, but instead, you were excited and wanted to try the combat power of this Immortal Realm genius. Soon, a world-shaking battle broke out between you.]
[As the battle began, you were surprised to find that this genius illusion also had some kind of an incredibly powerful physique, probably a top-notch Immortal Body. Because during the process of battling him, you didn’t gain any advantage in physique.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1137 - 1137 291 Chu Lingyins Shock Cultivation Soars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1137: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _3 Chapter 1137: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _3 [Nevertheless, the Chaos Path is ultimately superior to the existence of other cultivation methods. As a result, your combat power is bound to surpass them. As the battle unfolds, you gradually gain the upper hand and eventually overpower and annihilate him.]
[Chu Lingyin watches your battle, nodding approvingly at your performance. Your self-created Chaotic Immortal Scripture has nearly approached the level of the Profound Immortal Sutra. Though it’s merely close and there’s still quite a distance to go, it’s pretty good. Furthermore, your Chaos Immortal Tao, albeit still within the realm of True Immortal, is nearing the bottleneck of the True Immortal Realm.]
[It can be said that at present, among those at the same tier, there are barely any rivals to you. Let alone the living beings in the Immortal World now, even in the most glorious days of the Immortal Domain, those stronger than you were exceedingly rare.]
[You are unaware of Chu Lingyin’s evaluation. If you knew, you would probably feel that continuously drinking Enlightenment Immortal Tea in the past did have some benefits. Although the more you drank, the less effective it became, it ultimately contributed to your significant growth.]
[Next, Chu Lingyin regains her composure, complimenting your impressive combat power. Without a doubt, you are the First Heaven’s Proud Genius from today’s Immortal World Beings, outstripping even the other heaven’s proud genius with a top-tier immortal physique.]
[Her words elicit a smile from you as you ask whether Chu Lingyin can now provide you with the best resources.]
[However, Chu Lingyin shakes her head, insisting that you still fall short and need to be tested for your mental fortitude. It’s essential for your mentality to be strong enough for you to have access to the best resources.]
[Listening to Chu Lingyin’s words, you’re lost for words. Celestial Spirit Immortal King is fond of testing one’s mental resilience, and so is his daughter. Like father, like daughter indeed.]
[However, there is not much for you to say. Although you lack confidence in your mental fortitude, you can only grit your teeth and go for it.]
[Quickly, the trial begins again. It has to be said, Chu Lingyin’s methods are similar to her father, Celestial Spirit Immortal King, with the content of the trial mirroring the one you underwent in the Immortal Tower.]
[However, this time, your performance is much better than before. After all, you have become a True Immortal, and after optimization of the Life Simulator, the memory images gave King Ping’s Main Body a sense of being there, building up your confidence. Therefore, your mental resilience has gradually become stronger.]
[Well, even if you are a waste, under the accumulation of time, you will obtain a heart that far exceeds ordinary people. This is the joy of having an unfair advantage.]
[In the end, the trial is over, and you still fall into darkness. Nonetheless, you persist far longer than you did in the Tower of Celestial Spirit, which is something you are quite pleased with.]
[After your assessment, you notice that Chu Lingyin frowns slightly, seemingly dissatisfied with your test results.]
[In light of this, you have a few guesses that your scores are not good and couldn’t help but question where you rank among your contemporaries in the test of mental resilience.]
[Seeing your inquiry, Chu Lingyin does not hold back but directly states that your performance is only average, far from reaching the level a Unparalleled Genius should have. Therefore, your overall evaluation is not top-tier. Under such circumstances, it is impossible for her to apply for premium resources for you.]
[After all, the Immortal Domain Alliance is not just her domain. There are four other quasi-Demon King tier existences besides her. Although Lu Daoxian is on her side, he doesn’t manage affairs any longer. Under such circumstances, she can’t mobilize resources.]
[Upon hearing this, you have a slight headache and feel you should indeed find a way to hone your mental resilience. As a result, after some reflection, you modestly say that it is quite normal that your mental resilience is a bit lacking as you are yet to live for ten thousand years. Therefore, you hope Chu Lingyin can find a way to help hone your mental resilience.]
[Hearing your words, Chu Lingyin, a Quasi Fairy King Tier existence, is utterly shocked. A True Immortal who is not even ten thousand years old is outrageous! Even in the most glorious days of the Immortal Domain, no one could cultivate to the level of True Immortal at such a young age.]
[Therefore, if what you say is true, your potential needs to be reevaluated. Given that, it is understandable that your mental strength is ranked only in the middle. After all, you have become a True Immortal in such a short time; the journey must have been smooth sailing with no major trials or tribulations.]
[Then Chu Lingyin recalls that you are from the lower world which astounds her even more. To be able to ascend to immortality in less than ten thousand years in such an environment is a rare achievement throughout the ages. Maybe, only that terrifying entity can match this.]
[However, that person is not a cultivator from the Immortal Domain, so it doesn’t count, which means you’re still the most monstrous existence.]
[Having this in mind, Chu Lingyin uses the Heavenly Eye Immortal Skill to determine your age. Then, she is dumbfounded. Because she discovers that you are not nearly ten thousand years old, but merely under one hundred years old.]
[This revelation leaves Chu Lingyin with a look of utter shock, unable to maintain her aloofness. She is left completely floored.]
[There’s no helping it, it is truly terrifying. To have such formidable cultivation under one hundred years old. Even if the Immortal King reincarnated, he could not possibly reach this level. Unless, one has been crowned. But your condition does not seem to have been crowned.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1138 - 1138 291 Chu Lingyins Shock Cultivation Soars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1138: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _4 Chapter 1138: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _4 [Of course, even with the bestowal, you still need to follow the basic rules and slowly absorb it. This is not something that can be done in a hundred years.]
[You can’t help but smile at the somewhat doubting Chu Lingyin. It must be said that Chu Lingyin’s reaction is indeed quite amusing and gives you a great sense of accomplishment.]
[Next, when Chu Lingyin snaps out of it, she stares at you with bright eyes, feeling that you are the hope for the beings of the Immortal Domain. As long as you can be trained in a short time, you can lead the Immortal World Beings to carve out a future, where they don’t have to worry about falling all the time.]
[For this, she says you don’t need to worry; she will discuss the matter with other leaders. At that time, you will definitely get your resources, and as for the issue of honing your state of mind, that can be discussed later. That’s because honing your state of mind definitely takes a lot of time, and the next resource allocation is only half a year away.]
[Hearing Chu Lingyin’s words, you can’t help but smile, expressing your gratitude for this senior’s attention. However, you’re not surprised by her response. After all, you’ve experienced defying the rules due to your talent many times in the Life Simulator, so it’s not worth being surprised.]
[Next, after Chu Lingyin lets you cultivate well, she uses an item from Myriad Heavens Paradise to contact other leaders at the Quasi Fairy King Tier, informing them of your situation.]
[When they learn about your situation, they too reveal astonished expressions, never expecting someone like you to appear.]
[As a result, the other three Quasi Fairy King-tier leaders also approve the resource allocation plan without hesitation. As for Lu Daoxian, he seems a bit gloomy and doesn’t say a word. It’s as if he already knew about this but didn’t care about it.]
[After Chu Lingyin ends the communication, she finds you and informs you that the resource issue has been resolved. In half a year, you can enter the Immortal Spirit Pool to cultivate. The Immortal Spirit Pool can quickly enhance a True Immortal’s cultivation level, but it can be opened only once every million years. Originally, the Immortal Spirit Pool was shared by several people, with the most talented geniuses occupying 40% of the resources. However, due to your incredible talent, you now claim 80% of the resources.]
[Upon hearing this, you lament the unfair resource allocation. However, since you are the beneficiary, you are naturally delighted.]
[But then, you wonder if your growth rate slows down in the future, will it disappoint Chu Lingyin and the others and result in you being beaten?]
[This is not a minor issue, but rather something worth exploring. After all, your becoming a True Immortal in less than forty years is entirely thanks to the Life Simulator’s cheat. It is the result of countless efforts by the simulated Wang Ping. Now, other than the original Wang Ping, this simulated Wang Ping cannot cheat anymore and can only contribute to the next simulated Wang Ping.]
[Of course, you just think about it and don’t want to consider too much about what will happen in the future.]
[As for revealing your connection to the First Generation Transcender Chat Group’s tough guy and that you are his descendant, you naturally decide against it. If you reveal this under the current circumstances, you think Chu Lingyin will slap you to death immediately.]
[After all, Chu Lingyin’s hatred for that person in the First Generation Transcender Chat Group is intense. She can’t deal with them, but if she wants to get a hold of you, it’s still pretty easy. Although you have the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll to fight back, you don’t want it to escalate to that point.]
[Not to mention, even if you killed Chu Lingyin, you wouldn’t be able to pass the Profound Immortal level and would still die.]
[Therefore, under such circumstances, it would be extremely foolish to continue your experimentation for the sake of satisfying your wicked pleasure.]
[In the blink of an eye, half a year passes, and the Immortal Spirit Pool opens, with Chu Lingyin teleporting you inside. Then, you find yourself in a small secret realm filled with an extraordinarily dense Immortal Spirit. However, the Immortal Spirit in the air is secondary; the most astonishing part is the energy within the Immortal Spirit Pool, reaching the pinnacle of density.]
[Upon seeing this, your eyes sparkle with anticipation, wanting to enter the Immortal Spirit Pool right away. At this moment, another eight people enter. These people are none other than the geniuses of the True Immortal Realm.]
[After they enter, a handsome man reveals hostility toward you. He is a proud genius with a Top-Tier Immortal Physique and a descendant of the Immortal King. However, even he has had his resource share taken away by you, making him extremely unhappy.]
[You notice the hostility from the handsome man and guess his identity, your eyebrows furrowing slightly. However, you don’t say much, instead just heading straight into the Immortal Spirit Pool to cultivate and rapidly increase your cultivation level.]
[But just as you start, he blocks you, coldly telling you that if you want to cultivate, you’ll have to defeat him first. As for the others, they just watch silently, with no intention of taking sides.]
[Seeing this, your expression becomes cold as well, staring at the Immortal King’s descendant and telling him to step aside, as you don’t want a meaningless battle.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1139 - 1139 291 Chu Lingyins Shock Cultivation Soars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1139: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _5 Chapter 1139: Chapter 291: Chu Lingyin’s Shock! Cultivation Soars! _5 [Your words infuriated him. He immediately took action, unleashing an incredibly powerful force, intending to defeat you.]
[This annoyed you as well, so you also used your full strength, colliding with him. In this clash, the handsome young man was directly blown away, his body covered in numerous cracks, and purple-gold blood splattered.]
[Even though he quickly stabilized his figure and his body returned to normal, his face looked extremely ugly, and his aura was much weaker. This scene shocked the others, giving them a clear understanding of your fighting strength. They finally understood why those big shots gave 80% of the resources to you.]
[From the earlier clash, it’s clear you couldn’t defeat the Immortal King’s descendant in an instant, but killing him would probably just take some more time. The gap between the two of you was visibly apparent.]
[You looked at the handsome Immortal King’s descendant indifferently, coldly asking if he still wanted to continue the fight. These words made his expression unspeakably ugly, unable to respond.]
[In the end, he could only suppress his resentment with a cold snort, turning around and heading towards his designated cultivation area. Seeing this, the others respectfully greeted you before starting their own cultivation.]
[You also wasted no time and entered the area with the strongest concentration of energy to begin your cultivation.]
[In the blink of an eye, 300 years had passed. The Immortal Spirit Pool was indeed powerful and was a great opportunity. Within just 300 years, your cultivation improved from the early stage of the True Immortal Realm to the mid-stage.]
[You should know that if you were in the outer world, relying solely on your own cultivation to progress from the early True Immortal Realm to the mid-stage would take at least hundreds of thousands of years. After all, in the eyes of powerful immortals, time is of little value, and shutting oneself away for 100,000 years is a common occurrence.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 700 years have passed, and your cultivation improved again, advancing from the mid True Immortal Realm to the late stage.]
[As your cultivation reached the late stage of the True Immortal Realm, the energy in the Immortal Spirit Pool was mostly drained by you. Simultaneously, it was time for the secret realm of the Immortal Spirit Pool to close.]
[As a result, you were teleported out. Not just you, but the Immortal King’s descendants and others were also sent back to their original places.]
[After you came out, Chu Lingyin was somewhat disappointed to see that your cultivation only improved from the early True Immortal Realm to the late stage. She initially thought with your talent for becoming an immortal at less than 100 years old, you might be able to reach the Great Perfection of the True Immortal Realm.]
[However, your performance wasn’t much different from previous geniuses with Chaotic Bodies or those with Top-Tier Immortal Physiques.]
[Nevertheless, Chu Lingyin obviously wouldn’t say these things in front of you. She kept her expression the same, only remarking that your cultivation had improved a lot and that you needed to properly digest the recent gains before leaving your side.]
[You guessed some of Chu Lingyin’s thoughts but didn’t say much.]
[In the blink of an eye, 100,000 years passed. During these years, you relied on the resources provided by Chu Lingyin, working hard to improve your cultivation and eventually reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the True Immortal Realm.]
[At the same time, you’ve been comprehending the Chaotic Immortal Scripture and Chaos Immortal Tao, wanting to advance them from the True Immortal Domain to the Profound Immortal Domain. Your gains were substantial, but there was still a long way to go before successfully upgrading.]
[As you were diligently cultivating, the small world you were in suddenly trembled, showing signs of breaking. This caused all the living beings inside the small world to show expressions of terror.]
[Chu Lingyin and the other Profound Immortals also had somber expressions, even looking somewhat ugly. That’s because their small world had been discovered by the Flame Demon Clan and was being attacked.]
