[Chu Lingyin immediately issued an order to evacuate, hoping to use a backup plan to relocate. However, something unexpected happened: the small world couldn’t be moved. Evidently, the enemy came prepared, likely knowing that a person with power rivaling a Quasi-Demon King was here, so they used a powerful trump card.]
[Admittedly, Chu Lingyin guessed correctly. The Flame Demon Clan thought they had caught a big fish and came very prepared, intending not to let anyone escape, especially Chu Lingyin.]
[Under these circumstances, unless Chu Lingyin’s strength could break through the current situation, everyone would die here.]
[Thinking of this, Chu Lingyin sighed internally, resolved to fight to the death. She planned to join forces with the seven Profound Immortals to attack, while the remaining Profound Immortal would try to escape with the genius cultivators. As for the ordinary living beings, they would try to bring as many as they could, but most would likely be abandoned.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1140 - 1140 292 The second five-digit talent A
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1140: Chapter 292: The second five-digit talent! A perfect chaotic body! Chapter 1140: Chapter 292: The second five-digit talent! A perfect chaotic body! “Another disaster? Why do I feel like trouble follows me everywhere?”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, his eyes filled with oddness.
This time, was Chu Lingyin, a strong Quasi Fairy King Tier, going to fall?
“It doesn’t seem right. After all, Simulated Wang Ping still has a Special Item: Curse Doll unused. As long as there isn’t a Demon King Tier leading the team personally, even if two Quasi-Demon King tier experts lead the team, there is still hope of escaping.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he secretly thought about it.
As various ideas appeared in Wang Ping’s heart, the text simulation continued.
[At this point, you found Chu Lingyin and learned about the situation. You then asked her how many Quasi-Demon Kings attacked here and if there was any support from other Immortal Alliance Masters.]
[In response to your question, Chu Lingyin did not conceal the fact that two Quasi-Demon Kings had arrived, and no one would provide support as they were also concerned about the conspiracy.]
[Hearing this, you were somewhat disappointed but could also understand. Then, you seriously told her that you had a trump card to kill a Quasi-Demon King. If you could escape from the other Quasi-Demon King, there might be a chance for survival.]
[Upon hearing this, Chu Lingyin was surprised and did not expect you to have such means.]
[However, she thought of you coming from the Myriad Heavens, and you should have been to the Myriad Heavens Paradise. In this case, it is understandable that you became an Immortal before the age of 100 and what you said.]
[As a result, she agreed to try with a serious expression. Although she is not very strong in the Quasi Fairy King Tier, there is still hope for survival if she tries her best to escape.]
[After all, there are no Demon King Realm experts in the Small Immortal Territories. The Flame Demon Clan only dispatched four Quasi-Demon King Tier experts to lead many Profound and True Immortals to guard this place.]
[Upon hearing Chu Lingyin’s words, you were somewhat surprised. You did not expect that there would be no Demon King tier existence in the Small Immortal Territories. However, thinking about it carefully, it seems quite normal.]
[After all, if a Demon King was sitting in town, Chu Lingyin would have encountered trouble the first time she tried to save you. Or rather, she wouldn’t have tried to save you at all.]
[Furthermore, the Flame Demon Clan’s main territory is still in the Demon Realm, and they just treated these Small Immortal Territories as new territories for training their troops.]
[That’s why the Living Beings of the Immortal Domain have the hope to survive in the cracks, instead of being wiped out completely.]
[Next, with time running out, you didn’t waste any more words, and directly joined Chu Lingyin and others in action. Chu Lingyin directly took away the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm with a sleeve-Qiankun-like method and then rushed out of the crumbling Great Array.]
[As Chu Lingyin burst out of the Array, she immediately encountered a terrifying attack. Two Quasi-Demon King Tier experts from the Flame Demon Clan ferociously tried to kill Chu Lingyin.]
[Besides, dozens of Profound Immortals and even more True Immortals were forming arrays, besieging and assisting in the battle.]
[Under such circumstances, even a very powerful Quasi Fairy King would fall here and could not make any waves.]
[Furthermore, Chu Lingyin was attacked and looked very embarrassed the moment the battle began. With one against two and being trapped in the enemy’s Great Array, she couldn’t hold on much longer.]
[You hid inside Chu Lingyin’s inner world, and finally made a move, using the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll’s effect. As the Cursed Doll’s effect appeared, one of the Quasi-Demon Kings’ bodies instantly ignited, and their spirit burned out in a short time, leaving nothing behind.]
[This scene shocked Chu Lingyin and made the other Quasi-Demon King, Profound Immortals, and True Immortals feel afraid. After all, a Quasi-Demon King suddenly falling like this was terrifying.]
[At this moment, Chu Lingyin remained calm, sneered, and stated that if the other Quasi-Demon King wanted to continue fighting, they would suffer the same fate.]
[Hearing this, the other Quasi-Demon King regained his senses and sneered, admitting that your means were indeed extraordinary. However, he guessed that you must have used some precious five-digit item. Such items cannot be too numerous, or else you would not be like a cornered rat hiding all the time.]
[At these words, Chu Lingyin’s expression remained unchanged, but her heart sank. You also knew the conversation and privately sighed. These old monsters were indeed hard to deceive.]
[Furthermore, because Immortal Kings and Demon Kings Tier experts were already at the four-digit level and could enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise, they were no longer frightened by the peculiar items and talent skills, as they were familiar with them and even had them.]
[It turns out your thoughts were correct. At this moment, flames surged, and a figure resurrected amidst the fire. It was the Quasi-Demon King who had been cursed and killed by the 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll earlier.]
[The Quasi-Demon King’s resurrection left Chu Lingyin and you in complete silence, knowing that death was inevitable today.]
[After his resurrection, the Quasi-Demon King was quite upset and filled with anger and dread. The sudden death caught him off guard. Fortunately, he had a 5-digit revival item bestowed by the Flame Demon King; otherwise, he would have truly fallen here.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1141 - 1141 292 The second five-digit talent A
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1141: Chapter 292: The second five-digit talent! A perfect chaotic body! _2 Chapter 1141: Chapter 292: The second five-digit talent! A perfect chaotic body! _2 [However, even though he was resurrected, the consumption of an extremely precious five-digit Resurrection Item still made him furious to the extreme.]
[As a result, he roared in rage and launched a powerful attack on Chu Lingyin, no longer holding anything back. Seeing this, another Quasi-Demon King powerhouse also sneered, and for fear of any changes, he no longer held any cards.]
[In this way, under the siege of the two great Quasi-Demon King powerhouses, Chu Lingyin was overwhelmed and soon blown to pieces, falling to her death. You, too, fell with Chu Lingyin’s demise.]
[On the way, you also attempted to use the Seven-color talent·Running God. However, sadly, it was impossible to use it before and even more impossible now. After all, even a Quasi-Fairy could intercept it, let alone escape in front of a Quasi Fairy King Tier existence. Besides, there are various Great Array blockades.]
[Since you died, This simulation has come to an end….]
….
“Ah, I’m still dead. However, there isn’t really a way to escape in front of powerhouses at this level. This time, it’s a bit troublesome.”
With the end of the Text Simulation, Wang Ping felt somewhat helpless.
The Small Immortal Territories had become the territory of the Demon Clan, and safety was not guaranteed anywhere.
Joining forces with Chu Lingyin and other Immortal World beings also posed a danger. Who knows when they could all be wiped out together.
This was really a difficult situation.
“Let’s take it one step at a time. Continue simulating and see if I can use spoilers to make Chu Lingyin escape in advance and avoid this crisis.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, silently thinking in his heart, and continued to start the simulation.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, the Life Simulator is starting, and the free simulation is beginning…..”
The system’s voice sounded.
[On the first day, you chose the same actions as in the previous simulation. After you ascended, you did not encounter the Beast Demon Clan this time.]
[At this, you breathed a sigh of relief, choosing to walk in the Small Immortal Territories low profile, avoiding as much contact as possible with any Demon Clan.]
[But there are always unexpected changes. The Demon Clan seemed to have a way to search for Immortal World beings. As you walked outside, you got targeted shortly after. Then, endless pursuit awaited you.]
[This made you very depressed. Then, Chu Lingyin appeared again and took you away. At this point, you couldn’t help but suspect that Lu Daoxian had contacted Chu Lingyin, asking her to pick you up, or else this coincidence would be impossible.]
[However, this is normal too. Lu Daoxian knew the situation in the Immortal World and knew what you would face once you get there. Since he let you go, he must have made arrangements and wouldn’t let a genius with potential like you fall into the hands of the Demon Clan.]
[Next, you proceeded to develop as you did in the previous simulation, successfully reaching the Great Perfection of True Immortal Realm. At the same time, you also told Chu Lingyin about the upcoming attack in advance.]
[At first, Chu Lingyin didn’t fully trust you, but because you came from the All Heavens, she listened to some extent and moved to a different location.]
[However, disaster still struck at the fixed time. This left you in silence. Under such circumstances, you couldn’t help but suspect two things.]
[The first point is that the Flame Demon Clan may possess a powerful enemy-searching item. The second point is that there might be a mole within the Immortal Alliance.]
[The existence of a mole is not surprising. After all, where there are people, there is Jianghu. Immortals may be powerful and have eternal life, but in the end, they have their own selfish desires. Many Immortal World beings have a pessimistic attitude towards resisting the Demon Clan, as they seek to survive at the mercy of the Demon Clan.]
[In such situations, it is common for people to submit to the Demon Clan and choose to live on their own terms.]
[Of course, no True Immortal-level existence could be aware of the position of the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm, at least it would require a Profound Immortal. For this reason, if there is a mole colluding, there is a high possibility that one of the eight Profound Immortal is the mole. Besides, it is also possible that there are other ethnic groups collaborating.]
[However, if that’s the case, it would be even worse. A Profound Immortal couldn’t know the positions of other races, only the Immortal Alliance Master could. In other words, it means one of the Immortal Alliance Masters has turned traitor.]
[While you were pondering, the end came, and Chu Lingyin and you both died without any escape route.]
[Because of your death, this simulation has come to an end.]
…..
“I’m dead again. It’s really troublesome.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and furrowed his brows.
This beginning in the Immortal World is so difficult, which is really headache-inducing.
However difficult it is, Wang Ping still needed to find a solution to pass the level.
As a result, Wang Ping still chose to do a free simulation to collect information.
Nevertheless, dozens of free simulations still left Wang Ping in silence.
Because no matter how Wang Ping tried moving Chu Lingyin around or attempting to escape the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm before the Flame Demon Clan attacked, the final outcome was always death with no way out.
It could be said that it was truly desperate.
No matter which route he took, after venturing into the Immortal World, the final outcome was always death.
“Maybe I can only pursue the Paid Simulation now.”
Wang Ping no longer wasted his chances for free simulations, took a deep breath, and made up his mind in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - 1142 292 The Second 5-digit Talent Perfect
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1142: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_3 Chapter 1142: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_3 Now, I have already entered a dead-end. Only by refreshing a powerful 5-digit Talent can I possibly break through this situation.
For this reason, I have no choice but to use the precious Paid Simulation.
“Including the two Immortal Artifacts from the Ancient Immortal Tree and the sealed Evil Immortal’s Immortal Artifact, if I don’t choose the Cultivation Reward, I still have four chances for Paid Simulation. In these four times, I must draw a Talent suitable for breaking through the deadlock. Otherwise, I will have to return to the Myriad Heavens Paradise and earn World Source.”
Wang Ping clenched his fists and thought silently.
“System, consume an Immortal Artifact and proceed with the Paid Simulation.”
Immediately, Wang Ping let out a sigh of relief and said in his heart.
“Ding, consuming an Immortal Artifact, Life Simulator is activated, Talent Refreshing in progress….”
After the system’s voice sounded, the Immortal Artifact given to Wang Ping by Leng Yue disappeared directly, serving as fuel for the Paid Simulation’s activation.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the 5-Digit Talent – Gemini.”
5-Digit Talent – Gemini: With this Talent, the host can create a perfect incarnation under their control that will not betray them. The incarnation’s race can be chosen by the host.
“Damn!”
Wang Ping looked at the Talent that was refreshed this time, revealing a surprised expression.
This is really getting exactly what he wished for.
With this 5-Digit Talent – Gemini, Wang Ping can turn the incarnation’s race into the Flame Demon Clan and then infiltrate the Flame Demon Clan for development and search for methods to break the deadlock.
“I originally thought that four Paid Simulations wouldn’t be secure enough, but I didn’t expect to succeed with just one try. After all, the goddess of luck is still on my side.”
Wang Ping’s mouth slightly turned upward, and he sighed in his heart.
Then, without any hesitation, Wang Ping said: “System, I choose 5-Digit Talent – Gemini.”
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation starting…”
The system’s voice sounded again.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text floated up.
[Day 1, you want to act as you did in the previous simulation.]
[However, after careful consideration, you feel it’s not viable. You must obtain even more powerful strength for the local Wang Ping.]
[Therefore, you made a decision, which was to refine the Upper Realm to make yourself even more powerful and obtain the Perfect Chaotic Body.]
[With your decision made, you began your actions.]
[Of course, before taking action, you naturally did some preparations, gathering some familiar people and forces in a safe place.]
[When everything was ready, you started the Refinement Array to refine the Upper Realm.]
[Your actions made Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and others feel terrified and like they misjudged you.]
[As for their thoughts, you can no longer care about them now. Since you have already started the Refinement Array, you will stick to it to the end.]
[As a result, you eventually refined the Upper Realm, obtained the Perfect Chaotic Body, and your strength once again soared by a large amount.]
[At the same time, due to the refinement of the Upper Realm, your cultivation also improved a lot, directly reaching the late stage of the True Immortal Realm.]
[Such an improvement is already comparable to your improvement in the Immortal Spirit Pool.]
[For a while, you got a taste for it and felt that the future simulated Wang Ping could also do the same to quickly accumulate cultivation.]
[Of course, you are also well aware that this can only be tried a few times, trying to improve quickly later on is not possible.]
[Next, you forcibly opened the Immortal Domain Channel and entered it.]
[Then, you met Lu Daoxian again.]
[At this time, Lu Daoxian’s attitude towards you was undeniably different from the previous simulation. Although he still had that numb look in his eyes, there was a hint of coldness.]
[Because your refinement of the Upper Realm this time was too ruthless.]
[As for this, you also noticed the attitude of your senior, Lu Daoxian, and sighed silently. However, you were not afraid of him; you only wanted him to step aside and let you go to the Immortal Domain.]
[For this, Lu Daoxian did not say much in the end, nor did he remind you of some taboos after entering the Immortal Domain, and directly let you pass.]
[As for this, you did not say much either, and directly crossed by Lu Daoxian, preparing to head to the Immortal Domain.]
[However, in the end, you still stopped and asked Lu Daoxian curiously why he did not kill you since he was disgusted by your refinement of the Upper Realm.]
[You are really curious about this. In theory, Lu Daoxian guards here, so he naturally does not want to see his birthplace destroyed. However, he did not stop Leng Yue when she did it, and he did not stop you when you did it either.]
[In response to your question, Lu Daoxian is somewhat silent, but he still answers your question with a cold and hoarse tone.]
[That is, the current Immortal Domain no longer needs an old fighter without any fighting spirit like him. Instead, it needs ruthless people like you with enough talent to repel the Demon Realm.]
[In the end, Lu Daoxian paused and stated coldly that he could tolerate your actions for the sake of the bigger picture, but your actions still annoyed him.]
[Upon hearing this, you smiled, finally understanding the reasons why nothing happened to Leng Yue and you when refining the Upper Realm.]
[If the Immortal Domain was fine, what you and Leng Yue did would be equivalent to seeking death. But when the Immortal Domain is in trouble, it’s a different story.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - 1143 292 The Second 5-digit Talent Perfect
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1143: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_4 Chapter 1143: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_4 [Of course, this is still under the premise that neither Lu Daoxian nor Chu Lingyin knows the relationship between you, Leng Yue, and the horrifying existence in the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group. Otherwise, you all would not have enough lives to die.]
[Then, without intending to waste any more words with Lu Daoxian, you took a step forward and headed towards the Immortal Domain.]
[Upon arriving at the Immortal Domain, you encountered a monster attack. After killing it, you attracted the attention of a demon from the Beast-Robe Demon Clan.]
[Regarding this, you had nothing to say, and with a punch, you killed the demon. Then by using its characteristics and the talent effect of 5-Digit Talent – Gemini, you created a Flame Demon Clan avatar.]
[This Flame Demon Clan avatar, unlike ordinary avatars, only has the cultivation level of a quasi True Demon. This was intentional on your part, as it would be easier to infiltrate the Flame Demon Clan in this way.]
[After all, both True Immortals and True Demons count as the top powerhouses within the Flame Demon Clan, and their numbers aren’t that many. The sudden appearance of a True Demon Realm Late Stage Demon would be far too conspicuous.]
[Next, after leaving behind your Demon Clan avatar, you began to flee.]
[The subsequent development still involves you stirring things up, with Chu Lingyin taking you away in the process.]
[However, because of your cultivation in the Upper Realm this time, Chu Lingyin’s attitude towards you isn’t as cold as Lu Daoxian’s, but it’s also not as good as it was in the previous simulation.]
[You didn’t care much about this and continued to do your own thing.]
[In the blink of an eye, half a year passed, and the Immortal Spirit Pool opened. You entered it to cultivate.]
[As for your Demon Clan avatar, it has already infiltrated the Flame Demon Clan. Your Flame Demon Clan avatar, like you, also possesses a Chaotic Body. Although Chaotic Bodies are extremely rare, they are not unique to the Immortal Domain. The Quasi-Demon King of the Flame Demon Clan conducted a bloodline test and found that you indeed belong to the purest line of the Flame Demon Clan. Hence, he did not doubt you and chose to nurture you instead.]
[After all, the value of a genius with a Chaotic Body is quite astonishing. They are worth heavily investing in and nurturing. In the future, your growth may add a powerful Quasi-Demon King to the Flame Demon Clan, thereby elevating the Clan’s status in the Demon Realm.]
[You should know that the competition for interests in the Demon Realm is also intense. Due to the inherently brutal nature of the Demon Clan, their internal fights are even more fierce than those in the former Immortal Realm.]
[Under such circumstances, producing a young genius who might one day become a Quasi Fairy King Tier has an extraordinary significance. If the Flame Demon King were to find out, he would definitely attach great importance to you.]
[However, this Quasi-Demon King doesn’t intend to let the Flame Demon King know about you just yet—more accurately, not at this point in time. He plans to cultivate you until you can make a name for yourself in the Flame Demon Clan competition and become the top contender. By then, the benefits his faction would receive would be immense.]
[In a blink of an eye, 500 years passed. You were cultivating in the Immortal Spirit Pool and were not far from breaking through to the Great Perfection of True Immortal Realm.]
[As for your Flame Demon Clan avatar, it has been thriving within the Flame Demon Clan. The Quasi-Demon Emperor Yan Qingchi attaches great importance to you, allowing you to cultivate the Flame Demon Clan’s Demon King Sutra. He also provided you with a plethora of resources that allowed your Chaotic Body avatar to reach the Perfect Domain directly. It could be said that the resources he spent would make a Profound Demon Realm powerhouse green with envy.]
[At this, you couldn’t help but feel emotional, as you never thought there would be a day when you could flourish in the Demon Path and acquire resources even more easily than in the Immortal Tao.]
[However, this Quasi-Demon Emperor Yan Qingchi doesn’t want you to break through to the True Demon Tier.]
[According to him, this is a competition for the younger generation, and only Demons below the True Demon Realm can participate.]
[Apart from the Flame Demon Clan competition, there is also the Demon Realm Grand Competition.]
[The Demon Realm values strength above all else and is more invested in fostering the growth of the younger generation. As a result, the allocation of many resources is tied to the young generation’s performance in martial competitions.]
[Every one hundred thousand years, the Demon Realm holds a Quasi-Demon Grand Competition and a True Demon Grand Competition, with the participating forces being the major Demon King Clans. The Clan whose younger generation achieves better results in the competitions will receive more benefits in resources and interests allocation.]
[However, these competitions have always been life-and-death battles. Participants show no mercy and are not allowed to receive help. The competition essentially has a “raising gu” connotation.]
[As for the Profound Demons, they have already transcended the scope of the younger generation.]
[If we consider the True Demon Tier to have a reasonable number of people due to hundreds of epochs of accumulation, then the number of Profound Demons is much less. Even among the Demon King Clans that have survived for tens of epochs, there are no more than two hundred Profound Demons. The weaker Demon King Clans have an even smaller number, no more than one hundred.]
[Even taking into account the ethnic groups outside the Demon King Clans, as well as loose cultivators, the total number of Profound Demon experts in the entire Demon Realm would not exceed ten thousand.]
[Ten thousand may seem like a lot, but this is the accumulation of hundreds of epochs, or over a hundred billion years. Given this time scale, one can see that the number of ten thousand is not really that significant.]
[As a result, the senior powerhouses of the Demon Realm would not make Profound Demons engage in life and death battles unless they all collectively lost their minds.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - 1144 292 The Second 5-digit Talent Perfect
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1144: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_5 Chapter 1144: Chapter 292: The Second 5-digit Talent! Perfect Chaotic Body!_5 …
“This Demon Avatar is really enjoying a smooth life. Back then, I spent so much effort developing my Chaotic Body to the Perfect Domain, and even my real body hasn’t reached perfection yet. It was only by seizing this chance of refining the Upper Realm that I achieved perfection. But now, this Demon Avatar is effortlessly fed to the level of a Perfect Chaotic Body, making me feel quite ambivalent.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, feeling deeply emotional.
What can be said about this? It just fully demonstrates the importance of having a strong background and abundant resources.
However, the resources obtained by the top talents in the Demon Realm must be no less than those of Wang Ping’s Demon Avatar, and perhaps even more.
If it’s a descendant or disciple personally cultivated by the Demon King, that would be even more astonishing.
“It seems that if I want to make a name for myself in the Demon Realm, I still have a long way to go.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
However, Wang Ping originally thought that Profound Immortals and Profound Demons in the Demon Realm were not a big deal, but it turned out he was wrong.
There are less than ten thousand Profound Demons in the Demon Realm, which he completely did not expect. He initially thought there would be tens of thousands or even more than a hundred thousand.
After all, during the previous simulation, dozens were mobilized to surround and kill Chu Lingyin.
It seems that it was because the Quasi-Demon King attached great importance to Chu Lingyin that he mobilized most of the Profound Demon Realm powerhouses stationed in the Small Immortal Territories.
“However, this is secondary. The most important thing is whether Wang Ping’s Demonic Avatar will be exposed with the current development of the Demon Realm plot… That’s a problem.”
Wang Ping thought of the most critical issue and started to have a headache.
The 5-digit Talent – Gemini is ultimately just a 5-digit Talent. Although its effect is powerful enough to fool even the Quasi-Demon King without finding any abnormalities,
The level of the Demon King is equivalent to the Immortal King, both being in the four-digit realm.
It is very likely that a four-digit existence can see through a five-digit tier Talent Skill.
“Sigh, I can only take things one step at a time and leave it to fate.”
Wang Ping thought about it and couldn’t figure out any solution. He could only sigh helplessly and decide to let things slide.
Then, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[In the blink of an eye, another year passed, and the Flame Demon Clan’s grand competition was about to begin. Quasi-Demon emperor Yan Qingchi personally took your Demon Avatar to participate in the competition held in the Flame Demon Clan’s land.]
[Along the way, your Demon Avatar witnessed the thriving prosperity far surpassing the lower world and was amazed by the power of the Flame Demon Clan. Moreover, you also got to see the Flame Demon King himself.]
[The Flame Demon King seemed to attach great importance to this once-in-a-million-year clan competition, even choosing to appear in person. Although you think the Flame Demon King above is likely an incarnation or something similar, it still shows how much importance he attaches to the competition.]
[Next, the competition began, and you fought your way through it with ease, defeating any opponent with just one punch. Even those Quasi-Demon King’s son and direct disciples of the highest level were unable to take a single move from you.]
[Your performance astonished everyone in the Flame Demon Clan. They highly praised you, thinking that Quasi-Demon King Yan Qingchi had taken on a monstrous disciple this time, which could bring many benefits to his faction.]
[This made Yan Qingchi quite proud, as he boasted with his old friends from various factions.]
[In the field, only the Flame Demon King’s avatar stared at you, seeming to be contemplating something.]
[Finally, you successfully entered the finals. Your opponent was the Flame Demon King’s Own Child, who had a very powerful combat power. However, for you now, the battle of the Quasi-Fairy seemed to have a suspicion of bullying the weak. Even the Flame Demon King’s Child could not withstand a single punch from you and was instantly defeated.]
[This scene amazed everyone. However, no one blamed you for not giving the Flame Demon King face and instantly killing his child with one punch. In the Demon Clan, power is supreme. In a battle between people of the same realm, if one’s skill is inferior, even the Demon King’s child will not receive much preferential treatment.]
[You noticed the reactions of the people and felt quite fascinated by the style of the Demon Clan. As long as you are strong enough, you can obtain a sufficiently high status and benefits.]
[Next, after the Flame Demon King announced you as the champion of this competition, he gave you a generous reward. At the same time, he took you away from the scene.]
[You had no power to resist, and when you came to your senses, you found yourself in a great hall with flame patterns.]
[This made your Demon Avatar slightly nervous. After all, you also worry about being seen through.]
[However, what the Flame Demon King said next surprised you. He said that he didn’t care that you, a person from the All Heavens, had reincarnated as his Descendant of the Flame Demon Clan. If you are loyal to the Flame Demon Clan, he will fully cultivate you.]
[However, he also warned that if you have a different intention towards the Flame Demon Clan, he will let you know what it means to “living is worse than dying” and “eternal pain.”]

chapters.title: Chapter 1145 - 1145 293 The Number One Among the Younger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1145: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body. Chapter 1145: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body. “Sure enough, I was still seen through. It’s no wonder, being a four-digit powered Demon King Realm Master, such methods cannot be completely concealed by a 5-digit Talent. Even if what appears before me is just an avatar, it is unable to deceive them.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, sighing inwardly, somewhat helpless, but not surprised at the result.
“I just don’t know whether I’ll live or die next. If I’m beaten to death this time, I will have to reduce myself to an ordinary demon clan member, and can’t be so high-profile anymore.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought deeply.
Just as Wang Ping was pondering, the Text Simulation continued.
[The Flame Demon King’s words have left you unsettled, knowing that he saw through some of your secrets. However, it seemed that he didn’t know that you originated from Immortal Domain. Perhaps, he had his suspicions, but he didn’t question you.]
[You took a deep breath and pledged your loyalty to the Flame Demon Clan and the Flame Demon King, insisting that you had no ulterior motives and would never betray them.]
[For your words, the avatar of the Flame Demon King waved his hand, indicating that such spoken commitment was unnecessary. If it weren’t for his reluctance to visit the Myriad Heavens Paradise for a short time, he would definitely take you there for the Sky Tower Game and make you surrender your ownership.]
[The words of the Flame Demon King’s avatar made your Demonic Avatar restless, somewhat fearful.]
[After all, if the Flame Demon King really forced you to go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, trouble would ensue. The simulation might be interrupted, and will be forced to end.]
[Although the Life Simulator has been optimized to achieve a 5-digit Talent level, it’s impossible for a talent of this level to simulate the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise. The forced simulation would be discovered by various big shots leading to interference and eventual failure.]
[While you breathed a sigh of relief, you were also able to guess why the Flame Demon King didn’t go to Myriad Heavens Paradise. Because once he went there, he would have to play the Sky Tower Game. The Sky Tower Game was dangerous to four-digit powerhouses like the Flame Demon King, and even three-digit beings, let alone two-digit ones, were in danger of their lives.]
[Although there is an existence such as a delay card, its effect only applies to a time interval starting once every 10,000 years. Upon returning from the Myriad Heavens Paradise, playing the Sky Tower Game is mandatory, a rule that even a delay card cannot change.]
[Under such circumstances, those big shots must contemplate deeply every time they visit or leave the Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Of course, you speculate that three-digit and two-digit beings should have some means to resist this rule. Without that, it would be very difficult to return to the Sky Tower after one trip. After all, at their level, no one wants to risk their lives and blindly rush into the Sky Tower Game.]
[While there are many thoughts in your heart, the Flame Demon King directly leaves various back-up measures in front of you.]
[However, he has no intention of soul-searching. Because soul-searching is an extreme humiliation for any cultivator. Once done, there would be no remaining loyalty.]
[He can protect against you, prevent you from betraying, but the Flame Demon King will not engage in soul-searching, his vision is not that narrow.]
[Seeing that the Flame Demon King did not soul-search you, you can’t help but sigh in relief. Of course, you understand that even if you haven’t gone through soul-searching and your secrets have not been exposed, your situation hasn’t improved much.]
[Under the current circumstances, if you do anything harmful to the interests of the Flame Demon Clan, your life will be worse than death. In addition, after becoming a True Demon, you will become immortal, or rather, as the Flame Demon King’s incarnation has said, you will fall into eternal pain.]
[Next, the avatar of the Flame Demon King announced that you will be his personal disciple from now on.]
[This surprised you. As for Quasi-Demon emperor Yan Qingchi, his face turned black. He didn’t expect his Ancestor to steal his disciple. But, in the end, he had no other choice but to accept it with resignation.]
[From that point on, your reputation spread, making you a person of interest in the Demon Realm.]
[After all, any young generation of a demon clan is in the spotlight. The influence of the Flame Demon Clan is not weak among the Demon King Clans. It has over 105 Profound Demon Realm Masters, and five Quasi-Demon King Realm Masters, which many weaker Demon King Clans can’t compete with.]
[For this reason, you, who possess a Chaotic Body and defeated the Flame Demon King’s son with a single punch and even became a personal disciple of the Flame Demon King, are naturally being noticed, and are watched by all the forces and prodigies of the Demon Realm. Especially the prodigies of your generation in the Demon Realm, they see you as their rival.]
[You don’t care about the changes in the outer world. Now, under the circumstances where you were taken as a disciple by the Flame Demon King, you are being personally trained by the avatar of the Flame Demon King.]
[There’s no doubt that as a Demon King and a four-digit being, the Flame Demon King’s insights on cultivation are completely unmatched by yours. At the same time, the Flame Demon King could easily bring out elixirs that are worth countless times more than Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves to aid in comprehending the Dao.]
[Therefore, although your cultivation still hasn’t broken through to the True Demon Realm under the suppression of the Flame Demon King, you have understood the Chaotic Demon Path and the Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra of the Profound Demon Domain, by learning from the scriptures of the Flame Demon King and under his training.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 - 1146 293 The Number One Among the Younger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1146: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_2 Chapter 1146: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_2 [Of course, being able to achieve this at the level of a half-step True Demon is also due to your comprehension of Chaotic Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture, which provides a foundation and reference.]
[That is, when your Demonic Avatar’s combat power surges and your Daoist skills advance rapidly, you also break through to the Great Perfection Tier of the True Immortal Realm.]
[At the same time, through the feedback from your Demonic Avatar, you have many insights into Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaos Immortal Scripture.]
[You believe that as long as you retreat once, you will be able to comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaos Xuan Immortal Scripture in the Profound Immortal Domain.]
[It must be said that your freeloading of the Flame Demon Clan’s resources has brought you double happiness.]
…
“This development is truly unexpected.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation, feeling a thousand emotions.
Who would have thought that the simulated Demon Avatar of Wang Ping not only did not die, but also received the full support of Flame Demon King, making its strength advance by leaps and bounds.
Even more, it also fed back to the main body of the simulated Wang Ping, making the simulated Wang Ping also have the hope of advancing rapidly.
“According to this development process, it seems that the two maps of the Immortal Domain and Demon Realm could be cleared soon, right?”
Wang Ping touched his chin and muttered.
It took him a long time to reach the Upper Realm.
As a result, he had just used the Paid Simulation to go to the Immortal Domain and soared directly to True Immortal Great Perfection. Moreover, he also comprehended Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra, Chaos Xuan Immortal Sutra, Chaos Profound Demon Dao, and Chaos Xuan Immortal Dao.
At this rate, will the simulation directly be at the Profound Demon or Profound Immortal Tier during this Paid Simulation?
If so, this development speed is a bit too terrifying. I’m not even used to it, and it’s so fast that I’m somewhat scared.
“Ahem, let’s not assume things.”
Immediately, Wang Ping coughed lightly, pulled himself together to avoid setting a flag that would ruin the simulated Wang Ping and Demon Clan Wang Ping.
Then, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
As Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen, the text on the screen continued to emerge.
[Your Demon Avatar’s Enlightenment speed has made the Flame Demon King very satisfied, and he believes he did not misjudge you. It must be said, your performance has been excellent, and you have the potential to become number one in the younger generation of the Demon Clan.]
[Next, the Flame Demon King tells you that the Bloody Battle of the Demon Realm is about to begin, which is why he has made every effort to train you.]
[The Bloody Battle of the Demon Realm concerns the interest distribution of the major Demon King Clans and also the fortune of each major clan.]
[For this reason, you must get first place in this Bloody Battle of the Demon Realm, strive for the greatest benefit for the Flame Demon Clan, and win the fortunes of other Demon King Clans.]
[Hearing this, your Demon Avatar smirked confidently, insisting that he would definitely seize the first place and make the Flame Demon Clan the number one clan in the Demon Realm.]
[Your words made the Flame Demon King very comfortable and satisfied, showing faith in your ability.]
[However, the Flame Demon King also said that while your combat power is indeed strong, you cannot be careless and must be on guard against two people.]
[The first one is Time Demon Cloud from the First Demon Clan·Time Demon Clan, who is the offspring of Primordial Time Demon King. The Time Demon Clan is inherently in affinity with the Path of Time, their bloodline forces are extremely powerful, and Primordial Time Demon King is a Demon King giant, being the strongest in the Demon Clan. As a result, Time Demon Cloud’s Bloodline force is terrifying, and he also has a top-tier Demonic Body. He is definitely not weaker than your Perfect Chaotic Body, and might even be a bit stronger.]
[The second one is Kong Wen from the Second Demon Clan·Kongmo Clan, who is the offspring of Pure Sky Demon King. Similar to the Time Demon Clan, the Kongmo Clan is naturally in affinity with the Space of Dao. Their bloodline forces are equally powerful. At the same time, Kong Wen also has a very special constitution, which is not inferior to the top-tier Demonic Body and top-tier Immortal Body, and must be guarded carefully.]
[In the end, the Flame Demon King said that even though there are other equally talented younger generations among the Demonic Clans, they are ultimately weaker than you and your opponents. As long as they don’t gang up on you, nothing will go wrong.]
[Listening to the Flame Demon King’s words, the Demon Avatar of Wang Ping secretly sighed in his heart. Both Immortal Domain and Demon Clan, as expected of large maps, you have already reached the Perfect Chaotic Body, and there are still people who can rival you, even possibly stronger than you, which is very unreasonable.]
[Perhaps, only by reviving the Chaos Immortal Grass, transforming your constitution once more, evolving the Chaotic Body into Chaos Immortal Body or Chaos Demon Body, can you completely leave those people behind and become the unparalleled genius of the ages.]
[As you have many thoughts in your heart, the Flame Demon King once again reminded you of some things. After engraving them in your heart, you began to ask about the Bloody Battle of the Demon Clan.]
[In response to your question, the Flame Demon King replied that the Bloody Battle of the Demon Clan involves throwing all the younger quasifairies from the major clans into a place called the Blood Domain for an indiscriminate deathmatch. In the Blood Domain, killing other geniuses can enhance oneself by devouring their origins, and this enhancement will not have side effects. At the same time, it can also devour a part of the slain person’s fortune.]
[For this reason, anyone who shines in the Bloody Battle of the Demon Clan each time can increase their chances of being promoted to Quasi-Demon King or even Demon King, and their foundation will be more solid than their peers.]
[Upon hearing this, your Demon Avatar’s gaze flickered, and he secretly sighed in his heart. It really is the Demon Clan; their style is brutal enough. They actually threw so many unparalleled geniuses into the Blood Domain for a deathmatch. This is a true gu-raising method.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 - 1147 293 The Number One Among the Younger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1147: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_3 Chapter 1147: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_3 [If this were to happen in the Immortal Domain, it would be impossible. Who would want to risk their peerless genius in such a big gamble? After all, these are all hopeful to become Profound Immortals, and a few even hope to attain the status of Quasi Immortal King.]
[Of course, you also guess that if a real monstrous genius were to fall unexpectedly, the big shots would find ways to resurrect them. However, this applies only to real unparalleled geniuses. For relatively common geniuses, when they die, they are really dead, and these big shots may not use precious resources to resurrect them.]
[Half a year has passed, Immortal Dao Wang Ping still in seclusion and your Demon Avatar is on his way to the Blood Domain of the Demon Race.]
[Your arrival has attracted the attention of many Demon Race geniuses. Their reactions to you are different, some are wary, some are indifferent.]
[In response, your Demon Avatar doesn’t pay much attention and maintains a cool demeanor, ignoring them all, only glancing at Time Demon Cloud, the offspring of the Primordial Time Demon King and Kong Wen, the offspring of the Pure Sky Demon King.]
[When your Demon Avatar looked at them, Time Demon Cloud showed a strong will to fight. As for Kong Wen, she licked her lips, making provocative moves towards you.]
[In response, your Demon Avatar made a preliminary judgment of the two. Time Demon Cloud is a battle maniac, while Kong Wen is a witch with a very bad personality, not to be provoked lightly.]
[Next, the Blood Domain opened, you entered it and started the bloody battles.]
[As soon as you entered, you were teleported to a dangerous place where a blood beast suddenly appeared and attacked you. However, facing its attack, you merely punched it, completely obliterating it.]
[Then you began your hunt in the Blood Domain. On the way, you encountered a Flame Demon genius in danger and saved them.]
[Soon, you became famous. Many demons became silent in fear of being ruthlessly killed by you after crossing paths with you. Not only you, but Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen also received similar treatment. You three became the three powerhouses in the Blood Domain, terrifyingly powerful.]
[However, these Demon Race geniuses weren’t easy targets either, they were equally brutal. When they realized that acting alone, or even acting together as a group would only make them prey to you, they immediately teamed up to take down you three, then fought amongst themselves.]
[For this reason, you were attacked by hundreds of Demon Race geniuses. The weakest among them were geniuses like Ku Xuan, with the best among them being the heirs of Demon Kings, possessing powerful physiques.]
[However, facing these people’s attacks, your Demon Avatar didn’t show any fear. Instead, it showed a bloodthirsty expression and began a ruthless slaughter.]
[After achieving the Perfect Chaos Body, the boost to your combat power is truly terrifying, it’s by no means anything that your peers can compare with. Unless these people also have bodies that can compete with the Chaos Body and have reached a perfect realm, they are not your match. They seem weak as chickens and dogs in front of you.]
[Of course, even if they have the same physical conditions, they are not enough in front of you unless they have also comprehended the Profound Demon Path and Profound Demon Sutra. In that case, they can barely be considered as your opponents, but after a long fight, they will surely lose.]
[However, to deal with these people, you naturally don’t have to use all your trump cards, just using the Perfect Chaos Body trump card, suppressing other trump cards, you can easily eradicate them.]
[The Demon Race the spectators saw this and, one after another, their eyes started to shine, they were amazed at the strength of the Perfect Chaos Body. However, those Demon Kings remained indifferent and were not surprised by this outcome.]
[What they are more concerned with is how your Chaos Body was born and how it was discovered by Flame Demon King. After all, since Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang was destroyed, the Chaos Body has never appeared again. It’s as if the Chaos Body was cursed after Chaos Immortal King fought that terrifying existence and dared not appear again.]
[To be precise, not only did the Chaos Body stop appearing after that, but all the existing Chaos Body owners also died due to various reasons.]
[Because of this, your emergence as the Chaos Body was very unusual and it might have some secrets. Perhaps, this is the reason why Flame Demon King took the risk to foster you, an evidently transmigrator with identity issues.]
[Various Demon Kings have plenty of thoughts in their hearts, planning something. For this, Flame Demon King has some perceptions, but he chose to ignore them all.]
…
“So, there are such secrets?”
Wang Ping was reading the content of the Text Simulation, his eyes shining.
No wonder the Flame Demon King treated him in such an unusual way, it turns out that he was planning something, wanting to unravel these secrets.
It must be said, his actions were very daring and also very life-threatening.
After all, the other Demon Kings all guessed that the consecutive deaths of owners of Chaos Bodies might be connected to that terrifying existence in the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148 - 1148 293 The Number One Among the Younger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1148: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_4 Chapter 1148: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_4 Under such circumstances, daring to explore the secrets of a Chaotic Body is both commendable for its courage and tantamount to courting death.
“However, if this really has something to do with my senior… it would be quite intriguing.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were deep in thought as he pondered over many things.
If it really was the mastermind behind it, why did he want to eliminate all Chaotic Bodies and allow Leng Yue to acquire a Chaotic Body, and permit him to acquire one as well?
“Could it be…”
Some guesses sprouted in Wang Ping’s heart.
He had always known that there was a terrifying individual behind him schemes, but he didn’t know who the terrifying individual was.
He had guessed that it might be the person from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group, but that was merely speculation.
Now, considering the factors of Chaotic Bodies and Leng Yue, Wang Ping felt that there was at least a fifty percent chance that the person behind him was the big shot from the First Generation Chat Group.
“However, if it is really him, it would be terrifying how powerful he has become by now.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart, admiring that person immensely.
Next, Wang Ping collected his thoughts and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[The thoughts of the Demon Kings are naturally unknown to your Demon Avatar. At this moment, after massacring around, he absorbed the origins and Blood Essence of many talents, feeling that he would be able to break through to the True Demon Tier immediately after going out, with his foundation being unfathomable. At the same time, his fate must far exceed that of ordinary Demon Clan talents.]
[Just as you were very satisfied with your current state, Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen had also counterattacked and killed the Demon Clan talents surrounding them, achieving a terrifying record just like yours.]
[Afterward, you each continued to hunt other talents and finally met not long after.]
[The meeting of the three of you sparked a little interest among the Demon Kings, who wanted to see who would be the strongest among the three.]
[Under the watchful eyes of a multitude of people, Kong Wen was the first to speak, expressing her enthusiasm to join forces with you and deal with Time Demon Cloud first.]
[Time Demon Cloud remained expressionless, stating that if you were to trust this vile woman, you might as well wait for her to backstab you to death.]
[Upon saying that, Time Demon Cloud immediately took action against Kong Wen, displaying terrifying combat power.]
[You laughed and joined the chaotic battle.]
[The three of you fought fiercely, attacking each other and causing a massive upheaval.]
[The combat power you displayed shocked the other Demon Clans, and some True Demon Realm Masters also had their expressions constantly changing. That’s because they found that each of you had the power to threaten and kill them.]
[A Half-step True Demon would generally find it extremely difficult to fight a True Demon, let alone kill at a higher level.]
[However, during this Demon Realm Blood Battle, there were three of them all at once, causing a shocking fact and a sense of frustration. After all, each of them who had become a True Demon was not weak.]
[Yet they could not compare with you younger generation in terms of combat power, and it was indeed a bit of a blow to them, especially since your age and cultivation were also lower than theirs.]
[Nevertheless, they still felt somewhat relieved that they themselves had not become stepping stones for your challenges on the path to fame. Clearly, the three of you had all concealed considerable power in order to participate in the Demon Realm Blood Battle.]
[At this point, your battle had reached a feverish pitch. You noticed that Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen seemed to have truly run out of trump cards, and neither of them had comprehended the Profound Demon Path or the Profound Demon Scripture.]
[For this reason, their combat power was actually much inferior to yours. With this judgment in mind, you went ahead and used your full power without hesitation.]
[As you unleashed the Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra, Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen were instantly injured by you and appeared extremely miserable, which surprised many Demon Realm powerhouses, even the other Demon Kings showed surprised expressions.]
[Achieving Quasi-Demon Cultivation and comprehending the Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra, such talent is truly astonishing. Even though there must be the factors of Flame Demon King’s guidance and the use of the Enlightenment Type Treasure Elixir, it is still terrifying.]
[After all, if the Flame Demon King could cultivate a Chaotic Body in this way, wouldn’t the Primordial Time Demon King and Pure Sky Demon King also have the resources? Moreover, Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen can be better disciplined since they follow the same lineage as the two ancestors, while Flame Demon King follows the Fire System Demon Tao and would only be able to provide guidance based on his higher cultivation.]
[Despite such circumstances, you were still able to comprehend your own Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra, while Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen did not. This difference in talent among the three of you is apparent.]
[As a result, it is not an exaggeration to say that you are currently the number one among the younger generation in the Demon Realm. Although there are monstrous geniuses in the True Demon Realm, they still fall short when compared to you. These talents are theoretically at the same level as Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen, occupying the pinnacle of both the Demon Realm and the Immortal Domain. There may be some gaps, but they are also quite small.]
[But for you, it is entirely exceptional, naturally taking people’s breath away and making even the Demon Kings look sideways.]
[At this moment, Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen had no idea that you were this powerful, and their faces changed constantly. In the end, the two of them made a very tacit decision: to join forces against you. Moreover, they stopped using their self-created True Demon Scriptures to fight you, and instead employed their Demon Clan’s unique abilities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1149 - 1149 293 The Number One Among the Younger
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1149: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_5 Chapter 1149: Chapter 293: The Number One Among the Younger Generation in the Demon Realm! The Secret of the Chaotic Body_5 [Unlike you using the Celestial Spirit Immortal King Cultivation Scripture, the two of them share the same lineage as their Ancestor, and their Demon King Sutra is naturally a perfect match, allowing them to display immense power. These advantages are not something you can compare to. As a result, your advantage in comprehending the Chaos Xuan Demon Sutra is once again offset, and because the two of them teamed up against you, you have been put at a disadvantage.]
[This made you have to admire the terror of these Demon Domain Proud Talents and lament that being in the same ethnic group as a Demon King or Immortal King is really good, as you can fully use the power of your inherited scriptures. However, you smiled and said pretentiously that their choice to use their Ancestor’s scripture ultimately shows that they don’t trust their own path, making it difficult for them to achieve greatness, and their future aspirations to become a Demon King are as difficult as climbing to the heavens.]
[Your words made these two look extremely embarrassed. After all, your words hit the nail on their spine, and awkwardly they couldn’t argue against it. In fact, in battles among the younger generation, it’s rare to use the inherited scriptures from their Ancestors. They usually choose their own created scriptures, which are best suited for their own path.]
[However, their life or death duel with you this time not only concerns their own fortunes and lives, but also their ethnic group’s resources and fortunes. Therefore, they don’t want to be defeated by you and have to resort to such a strategy. In such a situation, there’s no way for them to object.]
[As a result, the two of them could only grit their teeth and launch a furious attack at you, wanting to quickly kill you.]
[Seeing this, you still maintained your calm demeanor. Then, you used your final hidden card, the Chaos Profound Demon Dao.]
[As the Chaos Profound Demon Dao was activated, the existence below the Demon King was once again shocked, and the Demon King once again cast a sideway glance, acknowledging your talent and lamenting how you were a worthy Chaotic Body targeted by the one that was targeting you.]
[As for Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen, their faces changed drastically, not expecting that you still had such a move. The two of them teamed up to unleash a powerful move, wanting to go for one last gamble.]
[However, with the appearance of the Chaos Profound Demon Dao, the gap in combat power between the two of them and you increased even more. Even if they teamed up for a powerful move, you easily defeated them.]
[And so, the two heavenly prodigies were killed by your hands, their essence and blood were automatically absorbed by you, and some of their luck was also absorbed by you.]
[With the defeat of the two great heavenly prodigies, you established your position as the number one among the younger generation of the Demon Realm. Soon after, the Blood Duels came to an end and you successfully reached the top, while those who survived looked at you with awe or admiration.]
[The Primordial Time Demon King and Pure Sky Demon King stared at you and said “not bad” indifferently. Then, they revived Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen. As for the other Demon Kings, they also revived their respective outstanding proud talents.]
[After these proud talents were revived, they were all extremely fearful of you. Even Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen were very cautious of you. Otherwise, the two of them, being unparalleled geniuses, would not be submissive and vowed that they would also comprehend the Profound Demon Dao and Profound Demon Sutra as soon as possible, and have a rematch with you to defeat you.]
[To this, you just chuckled and told them you would be waiting for their challenges.]
[Thus, the curtains were drawn on the Blood Duels of the Demon Realm. As for the issue of resource allocation among the major ethnic groups, you were no longer able to participate.]
[After the Demon King’s meeting ended, Flame Demon King told you that you performed very well this time, and he would give you corresponding rewards after you break through to the True Demon tier.]
[Naturally, you were really looking forward to this and started your closed-door cultivation, intending to break through to the True Demon tier.]
[While your Demonic Avatar was wholeheartedly cultivating, Immortal Tao Wang Ping, on the other hand, successfully comprehended the Chaos Xuan Immortal Tao and Chaos Xuan Immortal Sutra by reference to the Chaotic Demon Path before the Immortal Spirit Pool was closed, causing his combat power to skyrocket to an astonishing level.]
[Then, you left the Immortal Spirit Pool. When you came out, Chu Lingyin saw some of your secrets and was shocked at your talent. Seeing Chu Lingyin, you also knew that the Demon Avatar’s side must have Flame Demon King covering for you, so many old demon monsters couldn’t see your secrets. Otherwise, with their keen eyes, after discovering your secrets and informing their descendants, talents like Time Demon Cloud wouldn’t be so shocked by you.]
[Next, without wasting words with Chu Lingyin, you directly asked her if there were any methods or resources for quickly breaking through to the Half-step Profound Immortal Realm or even the Profound Immortal Realm.]
[After hearing your words, Chu Lingyin remained silent for a while. At first, when she met you, she had a bad impression of you because of your actions in the lower realm. But the talent you showed was indeed terrifying enough that her impression of you improved. In the end, the refining of the Upper Realm might be heinous, but compared to your rapid growth, it didn’t seem like much.]
[However, Chu Lingyin eventually sighed and said that there were no methods that could quickly help you break through to the Profound Immortal Realm. However, there was a way for you to break through to the Half-step Profound Immortal Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1150 - 1150 294 Chaos Demon King Power Skyrockets
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1150: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Power Skyrockets Chapter 1150: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Power Skyrockets [Hearing Chu Lingyin say this, you show a smile and eagerly ask her what the fast breakthrough method is.]
[Chu Lingyin remains silent for a long while before finally uttering the words “dual cultivation” with a blushing cheek.]
[Hearing this, your face is full of astonishment as you never expected the so-called quick breakthrough method to be this. However, you quickly react, realizing that within the Celestial Spirit Immortal King Cultivation Scripture, there is a special method of dual cultivation. If you can dual cultivate with a female cultivator with profound cultivation in a unique way, indeed, it can rapidly improve your cultivation.]
[When you are a bit uneasy, wondering if Chu Lingyin is going to make such a significant sacrifice for the world, she puts on a serious face, stating that although she can help you rapidly improve your cultivation through dual cultivation, she cannot do it with you.]
[For this reason, she will try to persuade a female cultivator who is on par with the Great Perfection of the Profound Demon Realm. If she is willing, you can, by dual cultivating with her, quickly break through to the Half-step Profound Immortal Realm.]
[Hearing this, you are somewhat regretful. If you could dual cultivate with Chu Lingyin, who is a quasi Fairy King, your gains would be even more significant, and you might quickly break through to the Profound Immortal Realm.]
[However, Chu Lingyin clearly has no feelings for you. You have no choice but to suppress these thoughts and ask for her help.]
[In response, Chu Lingyin nods without saying much and leaves quickly. Not long after, she brings a late-stage Profound Immortal female cultivator and pairs you as Tao Companions. From then on, you begin the journey of dual cultivation based on the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture.]
……..
“What a good fellow, this plot development is getting more and more outrageous.”
Wang Ping looks at the Text Simulation content with a very strange expression.
Demon Clan Wang Ping, living a life of luxury in the Demon Clan’s territory.
Immortal Tao Wang Ping, likewise living a carefree life with Chu Lingyin.
Meanwhile, both their cultivations were skyrocketing.
“This time, maybe one simulation will really reap huge benefits.”
Wang Ping’s heart can’t help but come up with such thoughts again.
While Wang Ping was feeling emotional, the Text Simulation continued.
[Just as the Immortal Tao Wang Ping was having a pleasant dual cultivation, Demon Clan Wang Ping effortlessly breakthroughs to the True Demon Tier, attracting the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, which he destroys with a single punch, showing his invincible power.]
[After the Demon Clan Wang Ping broke through to the True Demon Tier, the Flame Demon King summoned him, granting him a Profound Demon Artifact and two precious Resurrection Items. These Resurrection Items were of a five-digit tier, extremely precious.]
[For that, you are overjoyed and grateful to the Flame Demon King. Next, the Flame Demon King nods, stating that since you have already broken through to the True Demon Tier, he will grant you sufficient resources to quickly reach the Great Perfection of the True Demon Realm.]
[Once your cultivation reaches the Great Perfection of the True Demon Realm, you will need to go to a secret realm to snatch a Demon King’s inheritance for the Flame Demon Clan and also fight for your own interests.]
[Upon hearing this, the Demon Clan Wang Ping is astonished and asks what kind of Demon King inheritance is so important to the Flame Demon King.]
[In response, the Flame Demon King doesn’t hide anything and calmly states that it is the Chaos Demon King’s inheritance. The Chaos Demon King, like you, also possesses a Chaotic Body. However, after the Immortal Domain incident and the death of the Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang at the hands of a terrifying existence, many Chaotic Bodies encountered weird accidents and mysterious deaths, including the Chaos Demon King.]
[However, the Chaos Demon King was quite a figure, leaving behind a land of inheritance before his fall. This land of inheritance only allows demon cultivators below the Profound Immortal Realm to enter and cannot be forcibly opened and entered by other Demon Kings, as doing so would destroy the secret realm.]
[As a result, the Chaos Demon Territory is the largest secret realm in the Demon Realm and a hot destination for the True Demon Realm geniuses of the various major demon clans. After all, if they can obtain the Chaos Demon King’s inheritance, their future might be filled with the prospect of becoming a powerful Demon King Realm cultivator. Even if they cannot become a Demon King, they will inevitably become powerful Profound Demon Realm cultivators, and even possibly become quasi-Demon Kings.]
[At the end, the Flame Demon King smiles, stating that with your Chaotic Body, you are undoubtedly the most hopeful demon cultivator to obtain the Chaos Demon King’s inheritance. In other words, once the Chaos Demon Realm opens, if you seize the opportunity, you can rise above your peers.]
[Hearing this, the Demon Clan Wang Ping’s heart is filled with passion. Indeed, if you obtain the Chaos Demon King’s inheritance, the benefits for you would be enormous, and your combat power would soar once more.]
[Subsequently, the Flame Demon King doesn’t say much further, taking you directly to cultivate. With the provision of the Flame Demon King’s resources, Demon Clan Wang Ping’s cultivation rapidly ascends, reaching the Great Perfection of the True Demon Realm within a short span of a thousand years.]
[At this point, Demon Clan Wang Ping is filled with emotion, knowing that having a four-digit tier being personally cultivating you is great, with all kinds of resources readily available. You even reckon that you could be piled up to the Profound Demon Realm with the abundance of resources.]
[Of course, the premise is that you have sufficient talent and demonstrate enough value to be worth the Flame Demon King’s efforts. Otherwise, even his descendants wouldn’t be so intensely cultivated with resources, unless they were equally monstrous talents.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1151 - 1151 294 Chaos Demon King Battle Strength
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1151: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Strength Soars_2 Chapter 1151: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Strength Soars_2 [With your cultivation reaching the Great Perfection of True Demon Realm, the Chaos Demon Realm, a grand secret realm, has also opened not long after.]
[The opening of the Chaos Demon Realm has caused a sensation in the Demon Domain. Numerous Demon Domain proud talents have gathered, and even those rarely seen True Demon Realm geniuses have also emerged. However, even those extremely powerful True Demon geniuses are wary of you.]
[Especially when they think of you being the possessor of the Chaotic Body, the most likely candidate to inherit the Chaos Demon King’s Heritage, they become even more wary of you and even plot against you.]
[Among them, Time Demon Cloud and Kong Wen have also reached the Great Perfection of True Demon Realm under the guidance of their own Demon King Ancestor. Both of them have a lot of respect and fear for you, harboring many thoughts in their heart.]
[Under such circumstances, the Chaos Demon Realm has started. As the secret realm begins, you all enter one after another.]
[Originally, after you entered, you thought you would be randomly teleported to somewhere else, but something unexpected happened. When you entered, you were not randomly teleported anywhere, but were instead teleported to a palace.]
[Inside this luxurious palace, there was an illusion. The illusion, surprisingly, was that of the Chaos Demon King’s shadow.]
[Your Demon Avatar was shocked when it saw the shadow of the Chaos Demon King. However, you quickly calmed down and knew that the moment you entered the secret realm, you were detected by the will left behind by the Chaos Demon King, and he directly teleported you here.]
[However, you did not naively think that the Shadow of the Chaos Demon King brought you here to give you the inheritance directly. The Demon Clan has always been selfish and brutal by nature. You think that the possibility of being calculated and even possessed is higher than inheriting it.]
[Many Demon Clan geniuses know this, they just cannot resist the temptation of the Chaos Demon King’s heritage. After all, before the fall of the Chaos Demon King, he was similar to the Primordial Time Demon King, a giant among demon kings, and was even the strongest in the Demon Clan.]
[Under such circumstances, even if they know the potential danger, they have to give it a try.]
[The Shadow of the Chaos Demon King revealed a smile when he saw you and told you not to worry, as he was already dead and the remaining will cannot possess you.]
[With an unchanged expression, you smiled and said that you never doubted your senior. The Chaos Demon King’s shadow laughed and did not expose your lie.]
[Next, the Chaos Demon King stared at you intently and said he would give you the inheritance, but you have to agree to one thing.]
[Upon hearing this, Demon Clan Wang Ping became instantly vigilant and did not directly agree but cautiously asked what the Chaos Demon King wanted him to do. He knew how powerful the Chaos Demon King was during his life and had been to Myriad Heavens Paradise, possibly obtaining some special items that could trigger effects as long as someone agreed.]
[The Chaos Demon King did not mind your vigilance and said that you must swear by the rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise. If the Text Simulation Wang Ping reaches the Four-digit Limit tier, you must revive him within ten thousand years. If you agree to this, he would grant you a great fortune.]
[To your surprise, the Chaos Demon King was planning for a long-term investment. Swearing by the rules of the Myriad Heavens Paradise seemed intimidating, but it was useless. The rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise only take effect within the paradise, where players gamble by taking oaths and the losing party must fulfill the bet.]
[Therefore, Wang Ping of the Demon Clan thought that he could play along with the Chaos Demon King and agreed solemnly.]
[However, the moment Wang Ping of the Demon Clan swore, the Chaos Demon King revealed a cunning smile, a special item appeared, forming a contract, and then vanished.]
[At the same time, Demon Clan Wang Ping received the content of the contract, causing his face to change drastically. That’s because Wang Ping knew what kind of item this was and how powerful it was.]
[Special Item – Myriad Heavens Oath, Four Digits Limit Tool, as long as someone swears by the rules of the Myriad Heavens Paradise to the holder of this item, the item will take effect. Even if this item takes effect in a special scenario where someone is speculating the future, it will still affect reality.]
[That is to say, since Demon Clan Wang Ping swore, the real Wang Ping would also have to fulfill the promise. If the oath is not fulfilled, the rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise will explode and mercilessly erase the one who swore.]
…
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was numb after reading this Text Simulation.
Are there such items? Even if you swear in the future prediction scenario, it will still work and affect the real body.
Wouldn’t that mean he Wang Ping would really have to find a way to resurrect the Chaos Demon King in reality?
“These old monsters are really ruthless. They really know how to manipulate people.”
Wang Ping was extremely annoyed and itching with anger.
“However, Chaos Demon King, even if you calculated me, by the time I reach the Four-digit Limit level and resurrect you, you won’t be my opponent. I will make you pay the price for calculating me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1152 - 1152 294 Chaos Demon King Battle Strength
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1152: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Strength Soars_3 Chapter 1152: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Strength Soars_3 Soon after, Wang Ping regained his composure and snorted coldly, “Chaos Demon King, you set a ten-thousand-year buffer time in order to be cautious. Perhaps, in your opinion, without this time limit, it would be difficult for me to obtain the tools to revive you. However, ten thousand years is too long for me. If I had to wait that long, I might have become strong enough to crush you at will after reviving you.”
“But this was also a wake-up call for me. These four-digit existences are not easy to deal with. Moreover, the higher I go, the more astonishing and dangerous the effects of these tools become. Indeed, randomly simulating in the Myriad Heavens Paradise is a deadly act, which could easily make me the target of a great figure. It’s safer and more convenient to use it to clear the Heaven Tower levels. At least, this should be the case when I’m not on a high floor.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath to calm himself and learned a lesson from this experience.
Then, Wang Ping continued to look at the luminescent screen.
[Next, after the Chaos Demon King’s phantom encouraged you to work hard, it disappeared. Then, a Square Sky Halberd appeared in front of you in the hall, which was the Chaos Demon King’s Lifebound Demon Forces, a terrifying Demonic Artifact of the Demon King Tool level.]
[However, looking at this Square Sky Halberd, you didn’t feel happy at all, but your face became ugly. You knew it was for the Chaos Demon King to monitor you.]
[Instead of accepting it immediately, you asked where the inheritance was and how you could quickly reach the Profound Demon Realm level.]
[The Chaos Demon Halberd didn’t reply, but teleported you to a room. There, you saw the corpse of the Chaos Demon King.]
[Next, the Chaos Demon Halberd cast a technique, activating a certain array. As the array was activated, orbs of light emerged and merged into your body. These orbs contained the Chaos Demon Scripture created by the Chaos Demon King, as well as insights into Chaos Tao.]
[At the same time, the array seemed to put you into a state of Enlightenment, immersing you in comprehending the Tao. You were mesmerized as you absorbed the inheritance, and your insights into the Path of Chaos skyrocketed.]
[Although you knew there must be some risks in absorbing Chaos Demon King’s inheritance like this, you had no choice but to do it. After all, with the Chaos Demon Halberd watching you, you had to follow the Chaos Demon King’s plan unless you ended the simulation.]
[So, you could only hope that the Life Simulator could eliminate the hidden risks. Of course, even if you didn’t trust the Life Simulator, you trusted the person from the First Generation Chat Group who wouldn’t let you be easily plotted against and possessed by the Chaos Demon King.]
[Eventually, after an unknown amount of time, you opened your eyes. Now, your insights into the Path of Chaos had reached a startling level.]
[This was not only the case for Demon Clan Wang Ping, but also for Immortal Tao Wang Ping. It could be said that both Demon Clan Wang Ping’s Chaotic Demon Path and Immortal Tao Wang Ping’s Chaos Immortal Tao had achieved amazing progress. Although you were far from comprehending the Chaos Demon King Scripture and Chaos Demon King Sutra, you had confidence to be comparable to Profound Immortal Great Perfection experts, but whether you could fight with the Quasi Fairy King, you were not sure.]
[In addition, Demon Clan Wang Ping’s cultivation had also been raised to the Half-step Profound Demon Realm level. It had to be said that Demon Clan Wang Ping had really gained a lot, even surpassing your Immortal Tao Wang Ping’s main body in reaching the Half-step Profound Demon Realm level first. Demon Clan Wang Ping’s resources were abundant, and the development environment was much better than that of Immortal Tao Wang Ping.]
[Next, you asked the Chaos Demon Halberd how to advance your cultivation to the Profound Demon Realm level. In response, the Chaos Demon Halberd made another move, and a blood elixir appeared in front of you. Then, the cold voice of the Chaos Demon Halberd finally sounded.]
[The Chaos Demon Halberd said that this was the Profound Demon Blood Elixir, formed by melting the Origin Essence Blood of five Profound Demon Realm experts and a hundred True Demon Realm geniuses into a treasure elixir, which can help one breakthrough to the Profound Demon Realm without side effects.]
