[Hearing this, Demon Clan Wang Ping was astonished, feeling that the refining method of the Profound Demon Blood Elixir was harsh enough, requiring the Origin Essence Blood of so many experts. Then, you became extremely obsessed with this precious elixir.]
[However, after obtaining the elixir, your Demon Avatar didn’t plan to consume it immediately. After all, your Demon Avatar’s cultivation had soared too much in a short period of time, affecting its foundation. If it kept consuming elixirs for a direct breakthrough without settling down first, it would have adverse effects.]
[Seeing that you didn’t consume the Profound Demon Blood Elixir, the Chaos Demon Halberd didn’t say much, just stayed by your side without showing any intention of being controlled by you.]
[It was during your consolidation of cultivation that Immortal Tao Wang Ping used dual cultivation Secret Skill to break through to the Half-step Profound Immortal level.]
[However, to your surprise, your information was leaked as you broke through to the Half-step Profound Immortal level, causing the Flame Demon Clan to take action ahead of time.]
[The sudden attack of the Flame Demon Clan caught you off guard, and you were unable to escape.]
[This time, you were unexpectedly captured alive by the Quasi Fairy King of the Flame Demon Clan, who turned out to be Yan Qingchi, the previous Master of your Demon Avatar. Yan Qingchi didn’t seem surprised that you were a Chaotic Body; instead, he said that a powerful Chaotic Body had emerged in the Immortal Domain, and it was a great opportunity that you, another Chaotic Body, appeared. Taking your origin might help your Demon Avatar advance further.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1153 - 1153 294 Chaos Demon King Battle Power
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1153: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Power Soaring_4 Chapter 1153: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Power Soaring_4 [“Damn it, but you’ve conveniently killed my real body to nurture your Demon Avatar.”]
[However, before you had time to say anything else, that Quasi-Demon King, Yan Qingchi, just killed you directly and seized your essence.]
[With your death this time, the simulation ends…]
…….
As the text simulation concluded, many memories and cultivation realizations emerged in Wang Ping’s mind.
When Wang Ping recovered his senses, he was speechless.
There was no helping it; the death had come too suddenly.
However, one thing was evident.
There must be a spy in the Immortal Domain.
Otherwise, after Wang Ping’s whereabouts were exposed, there wouldn’t have been such a preemptive attack by the Flame Demon Clan.
Of course, a more significant possibility was that some Profound Immortal in the Immortal Domain had betrayed them earlier.
They must have thought their bargaining chip wasn’t enough when they decided to betray in 100,000 years.
Now, they perhaps believed that having Wang Ping, who was a Half-step Profound Immortal with a Chaotic Body, as their bargaining chip was effective enough.
“Come to think of it, that Female Profound Immortal who dual cultivated with Wang Ping has a high likelihood of being a spy.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
This time, Wang Ping’s intel was confidential and wasn’t known to everyone like the previous simulations, known only to a few Quasi Fairy Kings.
However, his horrifying cultivation progress and comprehension of Chaos Xuan Immortal Tao were only known to his Tao Companion and Chu Lingyin.
That is to say, after excluding various factors, it’s basically possible to determine who betrayed whom.
“It seems that during the next simulation, I can try to get rid of her.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
At this moment, the system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Half-step Profound Immortal Realm cultivation.
②. Profound Demon Blood Elixir.
③. A random Profound Immortal Artifact.
④. A random True Immortal Artifact.
⑤. A random Profound Demon Artifact.”
…..
“What about my talent? Where’s my talent?”
Wang Ping looked at the list of refreshed rewards, and his face twitched.
Damn it, it’s not easy to refresh a breakthrough 5-digit Talent, but you didn’t refresh it? That’s too much.
“Ding, Detected 5-Digit Talent – Gemini has potential hidden danger and cannot be selected; I hope the host can understand.”
At this time, a mechanical voice sounded, making Wang Ping stunned.
“Hidden danger?”
Wang Ping was momentarily taken aback.
Then, he frowned.
It seemed that Chaos Demon King still left many hidden cards, which were not mentioned in the simulation.
“No wonder he’s a four-digit old, shady character, he must have mixed well in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, having various special items.”
Wang Ping hated Chaos Demon King so much that he gritted his teeth.
“Alpha, the Immortal King Giant in the Immortal Domain and the Demon King Giant in the Demon Realm, what are their ratings in the Myriad Heavens Paradise? And have you heard of that Chaos Demon King in the Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and asked in his heart.
“Immortal King Giant and Demon King Giant possess power far surpassing other Immortal Kings. In the Myriad Heavens Paradise, an existence like Chaos Demon King could achieve the rating of a four-digit Legend. As for Chaos Demon King, he is indeed a prominent figure within the four-digit domain of the Myriad Heavens Paradise. He is extremely cunning.”
Alpha’s cold voice rang out.
“A four-digit Legend? They’re stronger than I thought. I thought the evaluation would be a four-digit elite.”
Wang Ping was somewhat surprised.
“You’ve underestimated the Immortal King Giant. I told you before, your Profound World is potent. The further you go, the greater the gap between realms, so it won’t be like before with several realms coexisting within one digit.”
Alpha said quietly.
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded in understanding.
Then, Wang Ping composed himself and continued to gaze at the luminescent screen, feeling conflicted about what to choose.
The cultivation option certainly couldn’t be chosen.
Choosing the cultivation option, the consumption of Paid Simulations would drastically increase, and he couldn’t bear that.
What’s more, the Half-step Profound Immortal Realm cultivation seemed within reach as long as he followed the previous simulation route.
“Profound Demon Blood Elixir, this thing can directly boost half-step Profound Demon stage powerhouses to Profound Demon Realm level. However, that’s for the Demon Path system. If a half-step Profound Immortal consumes it, there’s a high probability of negative effects.”
“But, this thing is precious, and I can try to sell it.”
After considering, Wang Ping felt it was necessary to choose the valuable Profound Demon Blood Elixir.
Then, Wang Ping glanced at the other options and naturally knew that he could choose the Profound Immortal Artifact.
“System, I choose ②. Profound Demon Blood Elixir and ③. a random Profound Immortal Artifact.”
After Wang Ping made his choices, he spoke in his heart.
“Ding, Congratulations to the host for making a choice, the rewards have been distributed.”
The system’s voice sounded again.
Then, a jade box appeared before Wang Ping’s eyes, containing the Profound Demon Blood Elixir.
In addition, there lay a Profound Immortal Artifact peacefully in Wang Ping’s inner world.
This Profound Immortal Artifact was rather peculiar, without a device spirit, just a simple weapon.
Apparently, its spiritual intelligence had been erased.
However, as soon as this Profound Immortal Artifact appeared, the Devouring Immortal Bead became excited and expressed its desire to devour the Profound Immortal Artifact to help improve itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154 - 1154 294 Chaos Demon King Battle Power
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1154: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Power Soars_5 Chapter 1154: Chapter 294: Chaos Demon King! Battle Power Soars_5 In response, Wang Ping rolled his eyes, naturally not intending to let the Devouring Immortal Bead devour the instrument.
After all, Profound Immortal Artifact could most likely be used for Paid Simulation in the future.
Not to mention, even if the Devouring Immortal Bead could indeed elevate itself to the level of Profound Immortal Artifact by devouring it, the time required for such evolution would be too long, rendering it insignificant for the real-world Wang Ping.
In other words, it could be fed to the Devouring Immortal Bead in the simulation, but not in reality, as it would be a waste of time and expression.
Wang Ping did not allow himself to devour it, and after expressing its grievances, the Devouring Immortal Bead remained silent.
Next, Wang Ping began contemplating his future plans.
Now, he no longer had any Immortal Artifacts required for paid simulations, and it seemed that he had to pay a visit to the Ancient Immortal Tree or seek out the sealed Evil Immortal to borrow some artifacts.
“First, destroy the Evil Immortal, and then go to the Ancient Immortal Tree.”
After contemplating, Wang Ping made his choice.
Then, Wang Ping took a step forward, unleashing a torrent of Immortal Strength, astonishing everyone.
For a time, many cultivators were shocked, astonished, and in awe, wondering what Wang Ping, the current True Immortal, was up to.
It was during the confusion that Wang Ping spoke indifferently, “Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion, Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal, you sided with the Evil Immortal, schemed to harm numerous Upper Realm cultivators in the previous age, and turned them into nourishment for the Evil Immortal. You must be punished.”
At these words, the Upper Realm quivered.
Although the Upper Realm cultivators did not know what had happened, the words spoken by this True Immortal must be truthful and could not be lies.
Not to mention, there was no need to fabricate an excuse to destroy these two powers, as doing so would be pointless.
For a moment, everyone was filled with contempt for the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family.
The faces of the Quasi-Immortal of the Immortal Mansion and Ku Family’s Quasi-Immortal turned pale in an instant, and they were somewhat desperate.
Having been sentenced to death by you, the True Immortal, there was absolutely no chance of survival for them.
As the two were in despair, Wang Ping pointed a finger, and two rays of Immortal Light flashed across the universe, directly annihilating them.
However, Wang Ping did not annihilate the Immortal Mansion and the Ku family wholesale; he did not commit an indiscriminate massacre.
That was because the rest of the people in these two forces were innocent, not knowing anything, and only these two ancient monsters from the previous age knew the truth and orchestrated everything.
Next, Wang Ping paid no heed to the astonished Upper Realm cultivators and directly descended to the Immortal Mansion. Under the fearful gaze of the cultivators, he forcibly opened the Immortal Door and stepped inside.
Upon Wang Ping’s entry into the Immortal Door, the sealed Evil Immortal sensed his presence and revealed a fearful expression.
However, before the Evil Immortal could say anything, Wang Ping struck him with a punch, causing him to burst apart.
Now, Wang Ping was extraordinarily powerful, even though he was still at the Early True Immortal Cultivation Stage, he would fully inherit the perception of the simulated Wang Ping due to the special nature of the paid simulation.
As a result, Wang Ping’s current understanding of the Chaos Immortal Tao was on par with that of a Profound Immortal Great Perfection, or even a Quasi Fairy King.
To put it bluntly, Wang Ping didn’t even know how powerful he was now himself. Crushing a sealed Evil Immortal to death was a trivial matter for him, and there was no need to use any Immortal Skill.
Next, Wang Ping forcibly extracted the Evil Immortal’s artifacts and stepped out of the Immortal Door.
When Wang Ping emerged, the Emperors of the Upper Realm sensed the presence of the Evil Immortal Artifact and were fearful.
However, what commanded even more respect was Wang Ping’s Terrifying Aura.
In response, Wang Ping paid them no mind, and after casually destroying the Immortal Door, he returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Upon returning to the Taiyi Imperial Palace, Wang Ping announced his plans for a long journey and left a large amount of cultivation resources behind.
Not only the Taiyi Imperial Palace, but all forces and people related to Wang Ping also received generous blessings.
This made everyone understand that Wang Ping might be leaving for a long time.
As everyone sighed, Wang Ping left the Upper Realm and headed for the world where the Ancient Immortal Tree was located.
If Wang Ping had still been a Quasi Fairy, it would have taken him a long time to reach the world where the Ancient Immortal Tree was located.
This length of time was calculated in hundreds of years.
However, now that he had become an Immortal and his skills were terrifying, Wang Ping took less than a month to reach the Ancient Immortal Tree World.
On the way, Wang Ping also passed through Empress Qingyuan’s world, casually slaying her enemies, which effectively solved her future troubles in the real world.
When Wang Ping arrived at the Ancient Immortal Tree World, an extraordinary phenomenon emerged, which signified that the world was welcoming his arrival.
This left the Quasi-Immortals of the Ancient Immortal Tree World completely stunned, as they never thought that there would be a second Immortal in the world, let alone one who would cause the world to make such a grand display.
Not only them, but even the Ancient Immortal Tree was greatly astonished.
After all, so many years had passed, and it had never seen a second Immortal.
Besides, the spectacle created by the Heavenly Tao of this world was far beyond what it had experienced even when it had just become an Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1155 - 1155 295 The Third 5-Digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1155: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through the Profound Immortal! (10,000-word long chapter seeking monthly tickets!) Chapter 1155: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through the Profound Immortal! (10,000-word long chapter seeking monthly tickets!) As the cultivators in the Ancient Immortal Tree World were shocked, Wang Ping took a step forward, crossing the vast distance and directly came to the core area of the Ancient Immortal Tree.
“I wonder what important matter my fellow Taoist is looking for me for?”
The Ancient Immortal Tree was startled by Wang Ping’s actions, and asked with a hint of surprise and wariness.
When this person came over, he was completely unable to react.
This only meant one thing: Wang Ping was stronger than him, much stronger.
Although he wasn’t very good at fighting, this was still enough to show Wang Ping’s frightening strength.
“Hehe, fellow Taoist, don’t be alarmed. I came to find you for a trade.”
“What trade?”
The Ancient Immortal Tree was puzzled and asked curiously.
“I can give you a Profound Immortal Secret Skill. However, I need two True Immortal Artifacts from you.”
Wang Ping smiled slightly, revealing his purpose.
“Profound Immortal Secret Skill?”
The Ancient Immortal Tree was astonished.
How precious is the Profound Immortal Secret Skill! In all these years, he has never obtained anything related to Profound Immortals.
Even so, let alone a Profound Immortal Secret Skill, he hasn’t found a few of the True Immortal Scriptures.
There was no way. The Immortal Domain Channel was closed, True Immortals did not exist, and many things in this world were missing.
For this reason, the Ancient Immortal Tree really did not expect that Wang Ping was able to produce something as precious as a Profound Immortal Secret Skill.
“If fellow taoist is willing to trade the Profound Immortal Secret Skill, I can give you two True Immortal Artifacts.”
The Ancient Immortal Tree transformed into the familiar old man incarnation Wang Ping knew and hurriedly spoke.
“If fellow daoist doesn’t mind, I can also give away many Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and Immortal Tree Essence.”
Pause for a moment, the Ancient Immortal Tree seemed to feel that he was taking too much advantage and was somewhat embarrassed, so he added more to the offer.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping had a good impression of this honest man, no, this honest tree, and happily nodded.
Although he still suffered a little loss after the Ancient Immortal Tree offered those things, Wang Ping didn’t mind.
After all, his Profound Immortal Secret Skill came from the Immortal Alliance where Chu Lingyin belonged, not from him personally.
In addition, he also had many Demonic Secret Manuals on him, but they were not good for trading.
Next, Wang Ping directly condensed a memory light group and integrated it into the body of the Ancient Immortal Tree.
That was actually a wood attribute Profound Immortal Secret Skill.
After the old man transformed from the Ancient Immortal Tree absorbed it, he showed a pleasantly surprised expression, thanked Wang Ping repeatedly, and then took out two True Immortal Artifacts and a large number of Enlightenment Immortal Tea Leaves and Ancient Tree Essence.
Seeing these resources, Wang Ping felt a little emotional.
How difficult it was to obtain these things in the past.
However, for him now, they are already within reach.
Next, without any intention of chatting with the Ancient Immortal Tree, Wang Ping left directly.
“Senior, you are truly a divine being.”
The Ancient Immortal Tree looked at the direction Wang Ping left and was filled with awe in his heart.
Wang Ping’s casual demeanor when he took out the Profound Immortal Secret Skill didn’t look like a True Immortal at all.
At the same time, he really couldn’t see through Wang Ping…
In addition to the terrifying anomalies when Wang Ping arrived, it proved that Wang Ping was at least at the Profound Immortal-tier level.
“I never thought that under the Immortal Domain, there would be such a powerful existence, it’s truly lamentable.”
The Ancient Immortal Tree sighed again, then went on to study the Profound Immortal Secret Skill.
…
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t leave the Ancient Immortal Tree World right away, but casually found a place and planned to continue with the Paid Simulation.
“System, I want to do a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping silently said in his heart.
“Ding! Consuming one True Immortal Artifact, Life Simulator started, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding! Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery; 6-digit Talent·Extreme Speed.”
5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery: Using this talent, you can 100% teleport to a safe world. At the same time, you can also set a fixed point in that world, so that the next time you use the simulation, you can perform fixed-point teleportation.
Warm reminder: This talent is very powerful, even Quasi Fairy King-tier existences can’t stop it, but this talent is a one-time talent, so please use it carefully.
6-digit Talent·Extreme Speed: With this talent, the host’s speed will be slightly increased.
“Another 5-digit Talent, it seems like my luck is getting better and better. Moreover, this talent is similar to the Seven-color talent·Running God, which is the most suitable for survival.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents this time and showed a surprised expression.
“System, I choose the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made his decision without any hesitation.
“Ding! Talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, just like in the previous simulations, you refined the world and achieved the Perfect Chaotic Body, reaching the Late True Immortal Realm Stage. After that, you went to the Immortal Realm, were saved by Chu Lingyin, nurtured and developed by her, successfully used the Immortal Spirit Pool to increase your cultivation to the Great Perfection of True Immortal Realm Stage.]
[However, this time you kept your existence a secret from Chu Lingyin, so those Profound Immortals didn’t know about you; they only knew that you were a mysterious genius without any specifics.]
[Then, you proposed to Chu Lingyin the rapid breakthrough to Half-step Profound Immortal again. At the same time, you mentioned the spies within the Immortal Alliance and hoped Chu Lingyin would deal with the female Profound Immortal who dual-cultivated with you in the previous simulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1156 - 1156 295 The Third 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1156: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_2 Chapter 1156: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_2 [Your words have made Chu Lingyin frown. Without evidence, it is improper for you to detain a Profound Immortal.]
[However, after you swear by your own Dao, Chu Lingyin somewhat believed you. For safety’s sake, she called upon the female Profound Immortal and used a tool from Myriad Heavens Paradise to probe her.]
[In the end, the female Profound Immortal unveiled some intentions of betrayal. It made Chu Lingyin look just as bad, and she ruthlessly captured her to be your Furnace Cauldron.]
[In this way, you successfully attained the level of a Half-step Profound Immortal. Simultaneously, because the hidden danger of the female Profound Immortal was resolved, you eliminated the risk of being attacked in advance.]
[Thus, you started a long period of cultivation in seclusion. In a blink of an eye, nearly a hundred-thousand years pass, and the two Quasi-Demon Kings of the Flame Demon Clan have appeared and attacked you all.]
[Facing this, Chu Lingyin chose to fight. However, this time, thanks to your arrangements in advance as well, you summoned Lu Daoxian. In a two-to-two situation and with a 5-Digit Special Item·Cursed Doll at hand, you felt that the chance of escaping, or even counter-killing, was quite high.]
[However, to your surprise, the Flame Demon Clan had hidden two additional Quasi-Demon Kings. Clearly, the Flame Demon Clan always played it safe. They had been holding back during previous simulations for safety’s sake.]
[After all, if all four Quasi-Demon Kings acted together, other places would be left unguarded, and could be potentially wiped out by other Quasi Fairy Kings from the Immortal Domain Alliance.]
[Faced with the prospect of the four Quasi-Demon Kings, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian both knew that they were undeniably going to die. They aimed to make a desperate fight, hoping to take down at least one Quasi-Demon King.]
[Nevertheless, at this crucial moment, you sighed, choosing to use the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery.]
[In an instant, you, Chu Lingyin, and Lu Daoxian were all teleported away from there. This caused immense shock and anger among the four Quasi-Demon Kings, who hadn’t expected you to have such an ace up your sleeve.]
…..
“This 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery is indeed really powerful.”
Seeing the content of the text simulation, Wang Ping couldn’t help but smile.
If he could evade the four Quasi-Demon Kings, that speaks volumes about its utility.
“However, it’s back to the days of running for my life. It’s unbearable.”
Thinking about this, Wang Ping couldn’t help but facepalm.
Simulating his life, it was all about running and running. Just when he was finally invincible in one world and could enjoy himself, he was forced to flee for his life in a bigger world. It’s too miserable.
While Wang Ping was silently complaining to himself, the text simulation continued.
[After using the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery, you all found yourselves in a new world.]
[This world is akin to the Immortal Domain and is called the Sward Immortal World. However, this world is not as powerful as the Immortal Domain and Demon Realm. The strongest being here is a Quasi-Fairy King.]
[According to the information you investigated, rumors are that a powerful existence battled darkness, and the aftermath affected the Sword Immortal World, creating a deficiency in its Dao. Hence, the existence of beings on the level of Immortal King couldn’t be conceived in this world. Those at the Immortal King-tier can’t further their progress either.]
[As a result, while this world possesses numerous Quasi Fairy Kings, there isn’t a single Immortal King-tier being. Ever since that incident, it’s been impossible to give birth to an Immortal King. Those Immortal Kings who couldn’t progress any further either entered the Myriad Heavens Paradise or tried to move on to other worlds.]
[Upon learning information about this world, Chu Lingyin had mixed feelings. Although this world cannot produce Immortal Kings, there was no doubt that it is a wonderful world that is much stronger than the Shattered Fairyland and is more suitable for survival.]
[However, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian sighed in their hearts. The departure of the two Quasi Immortal Kings would probably make matters challenging for the Immortal Domain Alliance.]
[But they didn’t have any other choice. If they didn’t leave, they would have died. The fact that they could escape from this predicament was all thanks to you.]
[Compared to their complicated feelings, you were quite calm. After all, you had no particular attachment to the Immortal Domain or the Immortal Domain Alliance. Therefore, it didn’t matter to you where you went. You were quite excited about reaching a world that could help you progress quickly.]
[Afterwards, following some discussions, you all decided to establish your organization in this world, creating a powerful influence all your own. Although being a loose cultivator has its perks, gathering resources at a faster speed is ultimately rather slow, and many things are troublesome when there are no subordinates to handle them.]
[Besides, the survival of the cultivators in the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm is also a problem.]
[For that reason, you all started taking action, finding a decent Immortal Mountain and establishing an Immortal School, with the power named Heavenly Sound Immortal School. The reason for this name was that it took a character from your Dao names. As for Lu Daoxian, he had no interest in participating, so his name was not included.]
[Of course, you’ve also teased Lu Daoxian that having ‘Xian’ in his name is sufficient. To this, Lu Daoxian stayed silent. In this world, he seemed to be regarded as an Immortal, rather than having to change his name.]
[After that, you all began to expand your power. However, this caused dissatisfaction among one of Sword Spirit World’s Quasi Immortal King-tier influences, leading to many frictions between them and you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1157 - 1157 295 The Third 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1157: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_3 Chapter 1157: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_3 [Finally, after investigating, they found out that you were outsiders and began to stir the other Quasi Fairy Kings to collectively eliminate you invaders. However, naturally, the other Quasi Fairy Kings won’t give him this ‘face.’]
[Despite his helplessness in the face of this situation, this Quasi Fairy King could only rely on his own network to search for allies to confront you and prevent his power from being appropriated by you.]
[In the end, he invited another Quasi Fairy King Tier powerhouse to preside over the situation, warning you to leave promptly, otherwise, a war would erupt, causing Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian, the two Quasi Fairy Kings, to perish.]
[In the face of this Quasi Fairy King’s threat, Lu Daoxian and Chu Lingyin were naturally unafraid. After all, since they have established their own schools, they could not retreat just because of a threat made by another Quasi Fairy King. If they really retreated, there would no longer be any place for them in this world.]
[In response, Chu Lingyin came forward with a staunch attitude.]
[After seeing Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian show no intention of retreating, the Quasi Fairy King flew into a rage and directly sparked a war, intending to eradicate Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian.]
[After the war erupted, the Quasi Fairy King didn’t intervene directly. After all, once he did, it would have a huge impact, almost like starting an all-out war.]
[However, this Quasi Fairy King was not in a hurry because, in terms of the number of Profound Immortals, they outnumbered you by one. If a real battle were to occur, he believed that you would gradually retreat.]
[But what he didn’t expect was that he underestimated your Half-step Profound Immortal existence.]
[As soon as the war broke out, you directly challenged a Profound Immortal and engaged him in a terrifying battle. This fight shocked everyone, even the Quasi Fairy King, who was taken aback and displayed an expression of disbelief.]
[Because you, a Half-step Profound Immortal, had managed to defeat a Profound Immortal by leaping levels. This was something that had never occurred before. The gap between a Half-step Profound Immortal and a Profound Immortal was even bigger than the gap between a Quasi Fairy and a True Fairy.]
[However, you managed to defeat a Profound Immortal with the cultivation of a Half-step Profound Immortal, which was astonishingly incredulous.]
[With your move, many forces began to become active, taking sides and currying favor. After all, with your talent, as long as you don’t fall midway, you will grow. Perhaps, there is a glimmer of hope to break the bondage and breakthrough to the Immortal King-tier.]
[Once you become a Quasi Fairy King and even an Immortal King, these favors given would be priceless.]
[Seeing other Quasi Fairy Kings taking sides, even the Quasi Fairy King he had invited to preside over the situation began to recoil, infuriating the Quasi Fairy King who had initiated the war with y’all.]
[However, given the situation, he dares not offend y’all too much. He had no choice but to choose peace and cede territories and resources.]
[In response to this, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian chose to accept the peace agreement. After all, they were foreigners, did not desire to escalate the situation. If they extinguished a Quasi Fairy King-tier power right after they came to this world, they might arouse the world’s suspicion. In that case, their situation would be extremely dangerous.]
[Thus, the matter ended, you gained numerous resources, and your power began to grow rapidly. And you entered a state of arduous cultivation, hoping to breakthrough to the Profound Immortal tier as soon as possible.]
[In this way, fifty thousand years passed. During these fifty thousand years, the Sward Immortal World remained very calm, no major events took place. To be accurate, there were many occurrences, but none of them caught the attention of you, along with the Quasi Fairy King Tier, making it seem calm.]
[However, this tranquillity was soon broken due to the increasing tension between the Ten Thousand Demon Alliance and the Human Race.]
[The Demon race, like the Human Race, is one of the super ethnic groups in the Sward Immortal World, carrying deep-seated hatred toward each other. It is rumored that three eras ago, the King of Ten Thousand Demons tried to break through the bondage forcefully and ascended to the Immortal King-tier.]
[That King of Ten Thousand Demons was indeed monstrous, genuinely trying to ascend to the Immortal King-tier. However, he failed.]
[The reason for his failure was not because he failed in his attempts, no one knew whether he would succeed, but the Human Race did not allow him to succeed. After all, in the eyes of the Human Race, if the King of Ten Thousand Demons truly became an Immortal King, the good days of the Human Race would come to an end.]
[Even the entire Sward Immortal World would become the territory of the Demon race, and they could become the subjects of the Demon race. As a result, the Human Race-led Quasi Fairy Kings, together with the Quasi Fairy Kings of other ethnic groups, stormed into the Demon territory, forcefully disrupting the promotion of the King of Ten Thousand Demons.]
[From then on, the astonishing King of Ten Thousand Demons perished, turning into dry bones, which bred an extreme hatred in the Demon race towards the Human Race, always thinking about exterminating the Human Race.]
[The friction this time was caused by the offspring of the King of Ten Thousand Demons showing terrifying potential and power, reaching the Quasi Fairy King Tier, becoming the new King of Ten Thousand Demons, and unable to suppress the hatred in his heart, started to mobilize troops, wishing to wage war with the Human Race.]
[Under such circumstances, the entire Sward Immortal World experienced a feeling of turbulence. You heard of this matter and guessed why those Quasi Fairy Kings were so tolerant and biased towards you initially. Clearly, the Human Race had the Demon race, an external threat.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1158 - 1158 295 The Third 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1158: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_4 Chapter 1158: Chapter 295: The Third 5-digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (A chapter with ten thousand words, seeking monthly ticket!)_4 [Since there is such a formidable enemy, it is naturally necessary to win you over. After all, two Quasi Fairy Kings and a future Invincible Quasi Fairy King are extremely valuable, enough to influence the balance of the war between the two races and deter other ethnic groups.]
[Seeing you leave the closed-door cultivation, Chu Lingyin feels somewhat regretful, thinking that if you were given more time, you might have been able to break through to the Profound Immortal-tier level.]
[In response, you smile and say that it is not so easy. Although you have already understood the way of Profound Immortal, the transition between Half-step Profound Immortal and Profound Immortal is still quite difficult. After all, many Profound Immortals have been stuck for an epoch or even dozens of epochs and haven’t been able to break through. You want to break through in just tens of thousands of years without any special opportunities, which is difficult to achieve.]
[Following that, the faction led by the Integrated Immortal Sect begins the Human Race council. Your Heavenly Sound Immortal School is naturally among them, starting to discuss how to deal with the Demon race.]
[After all, this concerns the war between ethnic groups, and if the defeat has severe consequences.]
[During the council, the Quasi Fairy King of the Integrated Immortal Sect also intentionally or unintentionally asks Chu Lingyin if there is a way to go to other worlds.]
[Chu Lingyin responds indifferently, stating that she came to this world using a special item from Myriad Heavens Paradise. The item is a one-time use and is no more after being used.]
[Hearing this, the Quasi Fairy King of the Integrated Immortal Sect and the other Quasi Fairy Kings are all greatly regretful. The Quasi Fairy King is unable to cross the Sea of Darkness to reach other worlds. Otherwise, they would not have considered engaging in a deadly battle with the Demon race.]
[As the saying goes, one must always look out for oneself. If they are truly unable to defeat the Demon race, they, as Quasi Fairy Kings, can take their force and flee.]
[However, they cannot run away, so in order to protect their own lives and interests, they must join forces to fight the Demon race.]
[Next, the Quasi Fairy Kings discuss the distribution of resources and strategic materials, prepare merit rewards, and devise ways to win over other ethnic groups.]
[Thus, the war between the two races is about to begin.]
[When Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian return, you learn about the council’s contents, frowning at the knowledge of the Demon race’s greater strength and the immense pressure on the Human race’s side.]
[However, you are just a Half-step Profound Immortal and have no way to solve the problem.]
[While you are thinking, Chu Lingyin takes out an Elixir and hands it to you, stating that it is the Integrated Immortal Elixir which can help a Half-step Profound Immortal to breakthrough to Profound Immortal. Although it is not a guaranteed breakthrough after consuming it, it only increases the probability by 30%, but for you, it should be enough. After all, all you lack is an opportunity.]
[Chu Lingyin’s words surprise you, and you didn’t expect her to produce such a valuable item.]
[Seeing your astonishment, Chu Lingyin explains that this elixir is also extremely precious to the Integrated Immortal Sect; it may take an epoch to find the materials and refine one. However, the more powerful forces the Human race can use in the battle against the Demon race, the better. An additional Profound Immortal would increase their overall strength. Furthermore, your combat strength is exceptional, and if you break through to the Profound Immortal-tier, you are not comparable to ordinary Profound Immortals.]
[Hearing this, you appreciate the nobility of the Integrated Immortal Sect. Of course, you also know that this is also an investment by the Integrated Immortal Sect, and it is also an opportunity for Chu Lingyin to fight for you.]
[In gratitude, you immediately take the elixir and continue your closed-door cultivation.]
[While you are in closed-door cultivation, 500 years pass, and both races are prepared, with the conflict having escalated to the extreme.]
[At last, the all-out war between the races breaks out. In this war, there is no participation from other ethnic groups. After all, no one can predict who will win, and it is better to watch the battle from the sidelines.]
[Even so, many powerful clans hope that both the Human race and the Demon race, these two super clans, will perish together, allowing their own ethnic groups to profit from the crisis.]
[However, for this very reason, both races do not resort to an all-out war from the beginning. The Quasi Fairy Kings of both races are stationed at various battlegrounds, with no intention of taking action yet.]
[The main battle strength of both factions lies below the True Immortals, including True Immortals, Half-step Profound Immortals, and Profound Immortals.]
[In the blink of an eye, a thousand years pass. The Human race does not gain an advantage in this time, and their casualties are quite significant, while the Demon race suffers losses as well, but those losses are much smaller.]
[As the Human race increasingly falls into a disadvantageous position in the war with the Demon race, you finally break through to the Profound Immortal Realm, attracting a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[With the appearance of the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, the Sword Immortal World trembles, not expecting someone to break through to the Profound Immortal-tier at this time, and the intensity of this Heavenly Tribulation is clearly astonishing.]
[Under everyone’s watchful eyes, you start to cross the tribulation. With an incredibly powerful posture, you overcome the Heavenly Tribulation, unharmed throughout the entire process. This performance has many strong individuals in awe, sighing that you truly deserve your reputation as a monster capable of defeating Profound Immortals while being a Half-step Profound Immortal.]
[As for the Demonic Clan Master, he too sensed your power and snorted coldly, believing you to be a great threat to their race, and their killing intent towards you surged.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1159 - 1159 295 The Third 5-Digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1159: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (Seeking monthly tickets for a 10,000-word chapter!)_5 Chapter 1159: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (Seeking monthly tickets for a 10,000-word chapter!)_5 [After you successfully cross the Tribulation and completely break through to the Profound Immortal-tier, you join the battlefield between the Human Race and the Demon race. In your first battle, you confront a mid-stage Profound Immortal-tier Demonic Clan Master. You fight a fierce battle, and with just one punch, you blow him up. Although this Demonic Clan Master recovers his body, he is severely injured.]
[Next, if it weren’t for other Demonic Clan Masters rushing to save him, he would have completely fallen at your hands.]
[Your second battle involves a fight against a late-stage Profound Immortal-tier Demonic Clan Master. This time, the Demonic Clan Master ambushes you in a trap, with no one able to assist you.]
[For this, you laugh heartily, showing no fear, and engage in an earth-shattering battle, easily suppressing the enemy. After fighting for a long time, you unleash your full power, using your strongest attack to forcefully kill the enemy.]
[This greatly shocks the strong warriors from both races. After all, once you reach the Profound Immortal-tier, there are no more mediocre talents, and the gap between small realms becomes extremely large. It can be said that fighting across realms is very difficult.]
[However, you, who have just broken through to the Profound Immortal-tier, managed to forcefully kill a late-stage Profound Immortal-tier Demonic Clan Master, which is truly defying the heavens.]
[Next, the Demonic Clan Masters are furious and begin to assassinate you. The numerous cultivators of the Human Race, of course, will not let the Demon race succeed, and a new chaotic battle begins.]
[In this chaotic battle, you are entangled by two late-stage Profound Immortal-tier Demonic Clan Masters. Despite this, you show no fear, fighting two opponents on your own and not falling behind.]
[This astonishes the many strong warriors watching and leaves the Demonic Clan’s side with an ugly expression, realizing that continuing this way could lead to a heavy loss. Thus, they choose to retreat, giving up their plan to fight a bloody battle with you here.]
[As a result, due to your appearance, there have been some changes in the racial war between the Human Race and the Demon race. Even though your strength, equivalent to a late-stage Profound Immortal, cannot affect the overall battle, it still significantly boosts the morale of your side.]
[Because of this, the Quasi Fairy Kings are very satisfied with your performance, and many Profound Immortals also admire you. You have become the idol of countless cultivators in the Human Race.]
[Under such circumstances, the war continues. It seems that the Demon race also feels that they cannot go on like this. If they continue to give you time to grow, once your cultivation breaks through again, you may pose a threat to Profound Immortal Great Perfection cultivators. Profound Immortal Great Perfection cultivators are also scarce, and each one is precious. If either side has a few more Profound Immortal Great Perfection cultivators, it will have a significant impact on the battle situation.]
[Not to mention that the potential you’ve shown goes far beyond this. If your cultivation increases, sooner or later, you will become an invincible existence below the Quasi Fairy King-tier, which will greatly influence the war between the two races.]
[To this end, the Demon race once again plans to eliminate you.]
[Soon after, the Demon race acts, trying to divert the attention of the Human Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings and directly sends a Quasi Fairy King-tier fighter to assassinate you.]
[However, this Quasi Fairy King-tier Demonic Clan Master is quite arrogant, looking down on you from above, and starts to talk about fragrances without immediately killing you.]
[Seizing this opportunity, you use 5-digit mid-tier special item: Curse Doll to directly curse him to death. After cursing him to death, you feel very fortunate not to have used this card against the Quasi-Demon King in the Small Immortal Territories and instead chose to run away. Otherwise, without this trump card, you’d likely have fallen here.]
[As the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demonic Clan Master falls, the entire Sword Immortal World is shaken and did not expect you to have such a move.]
[For a time, numerous Quasi Fairy Kings of the Demon race are extremely wary of you, and even those on the Human Race’s side are somewhat fearful. Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian are also amazed and didn’t expect you to have such means.]
[Next, the Demon race is enraged, harbouring a deep grudge against you, trying various ways to kill you. Meanwhile, on the Human Race’s side, because the Demon race lost a Quasi Fairy King, their morale skyrockets, and they begin to make things difficult for the Demon race.]
[After all, the Demon race does not value martial arts morality, directly employing a Quasi Fairy King-tier warrior to sneak attack the younger generation, which is utterly shameless and directly breaks the rules.]
[There is a growing trend for the conflict between both sides to escalate further, and the battle at the tier of Quasi Fairy King may soon begin. For a time, everyone in the Sword Immortal World feels threatened. After all, the impact of the battle between the two races’ Quasi Fairy Kings is enormous. Although it can’t destroy the Sword Immortal World, it might cause many regions in the Sword Immortal World to collapse and turn into Lands of Death.]
….
“That’s fantastic! After using the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery, I really feel like I’m flying after escaping to another world.”
Wang Ping looks at the content of the text simulation, feeling a mix of emotions.
Initially, Wang Ping thought there would be several twists and turns, and that he would likely need several Paid Simulations before he could break through to the Profound Immortal-tier.
But surprisingly, he broke through immediately.
It’s not just about breaking through; the formidable combat prowess leaves one in awe.
“I just don’t know what the final outcome of this simulation is. Don’t tell me my cultivation will be directly upgraded to the Quasi Fairy King-tier.”
Wang Ping’s eyes glisten as anticipation rises in his heart.
As Wang Ping’s anticipation rises, the text simulation continues.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160 - 1160 295 The Third 5-Digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1160: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (Seeking monthly tickets for a 10,000-word chapter!)_6 Chapter 1160: Chapter 295: The Third 5-Digit Talent! Breaking Through Profound Immortal! (Seeking monthly tickets for a 10,000-word chapter!)_6 [As the friction between the two sides continued to increase, you obtained numerous resources through your war achievements, made progress in your cultivation, and are not far from the Profound Immortal mid-stage.]
[When your cultivation improved, the battle between the quasi-Fairy Kings of the two races finally broke out. The battle of the quasi-Fairy Kings was fierce, turning day into night.]
[However, the final result was both sides suffering heavy losses, and neither side gained any advantage. It could be said that your use of the cursed doll to kill a quasi-Fairy King of the Demon race had a significant impact on the battle.]
[After all, since this world has been without an Immortal King for a long time, special artifacts are scarce, and even more so are the artifacts that can resurrect a quasi-Fairy King. Perhaps the King of Ten Thousand Demons has such a treasure, but he would certainly not let others use it.]
[After all, it is a lifesaving treasure, and if you still have the means to kill a quasi-Fairy King, he can use it to save his own life.]
[Of course, all this is just your speculation. In your opinion, the King of Ten Thousand Demons most likely does not have such an artifact. Because if he did, the King of Ten Thousand Demons who had forcibly attempted to break through to the Immortal King-tier back then would not have fallen.]
[At this moment, because the quasi-Fairy Kings of both sides fought to a draw, neither side gained an advantage, and they both calmed down again, not continuing their deadly battle.]
[After all, at the level of a quasi-Fairy King, no one wants to perish, and everyone is reluctant to risk their lives.]
[As a result, the war between the Human Race and the Demon Race has once again returned to a relatively peaceful state. It’s not just the quasi-Fairy Kings taking action, even the Profound Immortals are taking action less frequently. On both sides, only True Immortals are leading their armies in battle, using the war to train their troops.]
[It can be said that both races have similar intentions, biding their time. On the side of the Human Race, they hope to wait until you become a powerful force before launching a large-scale war.]
[On the Demon race’s side, they likewise hope that after one or two more quasi-Fairy King-tier powers emerge, they will open a war of attrition. At the same time, they are also thinking about how to kill you. Only with your death can the Demon Race get rid of a major threat.]
[The other races, upon seeing the Human Race and the Demon Race surprisingly stopping their fighting, were all somewhat regretful. However, they did not dare to provoke the fire, fearing that the Human and Demon Races would join forces to eliminate them first.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 300,000 years have passed. During these 300,000 years, with the resources that a quasi-Fairy King invested in you, you have successfully broken through to the Profound Immortal mid-stage.]
[At the same time, your understanding of your own Dao has deepened once more, approaching the Quasi Fairy King Tier. As long as you comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao at the quasi-Fairy King tier, your strength will take another qualitative leap.]
[However, you obviously did not get a chance to comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao at the quasi-Fairy King tier because an accident happened.]
[The unexpected incident that occurred did not come from the Demon race’s sneak attack. Because the Human Race placed great importance in protecting you, the Demon race’s quasi-Fairy Kings had no way to assassinate you. This accident came from outside the realm.]
[From outside the realm, an incomprehensible darkness spread, and countless Dark Beings attacked the Sword Immortal World. This terrifying change left the quasi-Fairy Kings of the Sword Immortal World with a drastically changed countenance.]
[Outside the Sword Immortal World is the Sea of Darkness, which is the source of darkness, an enigmatic incarnation, and a forbidden Land of Death. If one accidentally enters the Sea of Darkness, even a quasi-Fairy King will be completely destroyed.]
[Only an existence at the Immortal King-tier can resist the dark power of the Sea of Darkness and search for other worlds. However, that is only limited to resistance, and even the Immortal Kings who enter the Sea of Darkness are equally in danger of perishing.]
[Now, the Sea of Darkness, which had been calm for several eons, has once again experienced an upheaval, with a large number of Dark Beings attacking, causing fear and trepidation.]
[Upon seeing this terrifying scene, your face grows serious, and you feel a sense of despair. After all, this is the Sea of Darkness. If the Dark Source in the mortal world is merely a terrifying and enigmatic branch of darkness spreading, according to the ancient records you have read, this Sea of Darkness is that enigmatic embodiment, an extremely terrifying existence.]
[In the face of such an existence, even an Immortal King would die, let alone you now.]
[However, you do not give up and begin to fight against the Dark Beings alongside the other powerful Immortal Realm experts of the Sword Immortal World. In the face of life and death, even Human and Demon Races temporarily reconcile, join forces against the Dark Beings, and show a strong desire to survive.]
[You, too, fight desperately, killing a Dark Being as powerful as a True Immortal or even a Profound Immortal. In the end, you confront a Dark Being at the Profound Immortal Great Perfection level.]
[If it were in the past, someone would have come to help you. But now everyone else is barely holding on and can’t possibly help you. For this reason, if you want to survive, you must defeat it yourself.]
[However, you show no fear. After all, your cultivation has improved, and your Dao has similarly advanced, giving you hope to confront a Profound Immortal Great Perfection Dark Being.]
[The fact proves that you are indeed powerful, and you also underestimated your current strength. You engaged in a battle against a Profound Immortal Great Perfection Dark Being, and the result was that you had the advantage throughout the battle, suppressing it and finally killing it at the cost of only a slight loss.]
[Your strength was very dazzling, shocking many people. After all, the difference in power between the Late-Stage Profound Immortal and the Profound Immortal Great Perfection is quite astonishing, even though it seems only a small level gap. This is true in any realm, as Great Perfection is much stronger than the late-stage.]
[However, you managed to defeat a Profound Immortal Great Perfection Dark Being which was truly an astonishing achievement. The Demon race’s Quasi Fairy King was shocked to see you grow so quickly.]
[If it weren’t for the Dark Beings attacking, the Demon race would have been in serious trouble if they delayed a little longer.]
[Nevertheless, compared to your growth, the Demon race still prefers not to have the darkness descend. After all, that means true Genocide, which is worse than losing to the Human Race.]
[Next, the numerous cultivators regained their composure and continued to fight. After all, no one dared to lose focus too much at this critical moment. Once they lost focus for too long, they might be besieged and killed by the Dark Beings.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1161 - 1161 296 Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1161: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King Chapter 1161: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King [On your side, you continue to engage in the fierce battle, seeking to kill more dark beings.]
[However, as the number of dark beings increases and the strong ones in the Sword Immortal World gradually fall, your pressure becomes greater and greater. Eventually, a True Immortal forcibly tries to break through to the Profound Immortal Realm, triggering Heavenly Tribulation, attempting to use its power to destroy the dark beings.]
[On your side, your strength is severely depleted. The Devouring Immortal Bead and Chaotic Battle Armor see the situation and choose to forcibly break through to the Profound Immortal Artifact level, triggering Heavenly Tribulation, attempting to relieve your burden and destroy the dark beings.]
[Unfortunately, although the two Immortal Artifacts are very close to becoming Profound Immortal Artifacts, you have been focusing on improving your own cultivation over the years without upgrading their quality. In the end, both Immortal Artifacts are destroyed in the Heavenly Tribulation and completely dissipated.]
[Seeing this, you sigh in your heart, feeling complicated. However, you can’t afford to be sentimental and can only continue to kill the enemy.]
[As you kill the enemies, a Quasi Fairy King finally falls into the hands of the dark beings.]
[At the same time, you are targeted by a Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being. The Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being attacks you with a condescending casual blow.]
[However, just a casual blow from a Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being still makes you feel a fatal sense of danger. You don’t hesitate to burn your origin and unleash the most potent punch to block it.]
[In the end, under the shocked eyes of many Quasi Fairy Kings, you manage to block the casual blow from the Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being with your mid-stage Profound Immortal Realm cultivation. But you also pay a heavy price, being severely injured and on the verge of death, not far from falling.]
[Although the outcome is bleak, you have created another history, earning the admiration of many Quasi Fairy Kings. The Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being is also quite surprised, praising you and stating that you are indeed talented, but unfortunately, if their master wants you dead, you must die.]
[The words of this Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being surprise you. You instantly guess who the master is in the mouth of this Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being.]
[However, you don’t have time to think about it as the Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being attacks again. Chu Lingyin is very anxious and wants to save you, but it’s too late.]
[In the end, you die at the hands of the Quasi Fairy King-tier dark being and completely fall.]
[Due to your fall, this simulation ends here.]
…..
As the text simulation ends, many memory images and cultivation realizations appear in Wang Ping’s mind.
“The mysterious enemy has finally taken action and targeted me.”
Wang Ping’s expression is extremely solemn and restless.
In previous life simulations, there had never been any movement from the mysterious enemy.
But now, there is movement, which has a very significant meaning.
Perhaps this mysterious enemy has noticed him, discovered his life simulation, and sees him as a threat, so they have started to eliminate him and take action against him.
However, with the power of that mysterious enemy, they must be a three-digit existence.
For a three-digit existence, navigating the River of Time should be a very easy thing. They can easily see through the life simulation and effortlessly kill him in real life.
However, they did not do so, but instead let the small shrimp-level dark beings stop him in the life simulation. This is also meaningful.
Although it is disrespectful to call those Quasi Fairy King-tier dark beings “small shrimps,” they are indeed small shrimps to a being of that level.
“It seems that the existence behind me or some powerful being is really restraining the mysterious enemy, making them unable to act recklessly.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker as he quietly thinks to himself.
“Since that’s the case, I don’t need to worry about the mysterious enemy. Of course, even if I did, it’s not something I can solve.”
Wang Ping shakes his head and sighs.
“Ding, reward generation successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
① Mid-stage Profound Immortal Realm cultivation.
② A random Profound instrument.
③ A random True Immortal Artifact.
④ 5-digit Talent·Fixed Point Transmission.”
…
“System, I choose ② A random Profound instrument and ④ 5-digit Talent·Fixed Point Transmission.”
Wang Ping looks at the reward list and makes his choice without hesitation.
Cultivation cannot be chosen at the moment, unless he really needs to improve his cultivation immediately to break through a situation. Otherwise, the current selection’s consumption is dreadfully high.
If he has to choose, he would wait until the last Paid Simulation to pick, in order to get the best cost-performance ratio.
Therefore, ② and ④ are the best choices.
“Ding, reward selection successful, issuing rewards…”
The system’s voice sounds.
Then, Wang Ping finds that another Profound Immortal Artifact without a spirit has appeared in his inner world.
Besides that, a memory in Wang Ping’s mind contains information about the usage of the 5-digit Talent·Fixed Point Transmission.
There’re also recorded locations in the Sword Immortal World.
That is to say, Wang Ping could teleport to that world now if he wants.
Of course, going to that world and returning is another matter altogether.
In reality, he definitely cannot go.
Otherwise, if he cannot return, it will be awkward. In that world, there is no way to become an Immortal King-tier existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1162 - 1162 296 Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1162: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_2 Chapter 1162: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_2 Although he could try to do something in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, it would ultimately be troublesome.
“System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping decided to perform a paid simulation once again without hesitation.
He wouldn’t stop until he became a Quasi Fairy King.
“Ding, consuming a True Immortal Artifact, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The system’s voice rang out once more.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully obtaining the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter.”
5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter: With this talent, the host’s overall attributes will be greatly enhanced when facing Dark Beings.
“Another 5-digit talent, this is truly amazing luck. And this 5-digit talent is one that helps to increase my combat power, perhaps it will be of great use when facing Dark Beings in the future.”
Wang Ping was quite thrilled with the newly refreshed talent.
The Rod of Holy Light, a tool capable of purifying the darkness, had helped him a lot.
Unfortunately, the Rod of Holy Light was an Entry-Tier 5-digit object, and it could only purify True Immortal-level Dark Beings.
To Wang Ping now, it was a thing of the past.
Now, the appearance of this talent filled the void left by the Rod of Holy Light, and its effect was even more significant.
“System, I choose the 5-Digit Talent, Night Hunter.”
Immediately, Wang Ping said without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, starting life simulation….”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you did the same as in the previous simulation, refining the Upper Realm and traveling to the Immortal Domain. You were saved by Chu Lingyin and broke through to Half-step Profound Immortal with the help of the Immortal Spirit Pool and Furnace Cauldron.]
[After a hundred thousand years, the Flame Demon Clan attacked, and you chose to use Fixed Point Transmission.]
[However, this time you chose to transmit to a new world instead of the Sword Immortal World. After all, the Sword Immortal World would experience Dark Turmoil, which was very dangerous, and you thought it would be better to choose a new world.]
[Of course, you also had some suspicions in your heart and wondered if the Dark Turmoil was not just happening in the Sword Immortal World but might appear in all worlds. In addition, there was another possibility that whichever world you appeared in would experience Dark Turmoil because the target of the Dark Origins was you.]
[Nevertheless, while you had many suspicions in your heart, you couldn’t care less. With your transmission, you successfully arrived in a new world.]
[This world, unlike the Sword Immortal World, was a lifeless place, devoid of any living beings, and filled with Dark Beings everywhere.]
[This made you frown, feeling like the 5-Digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery had cheated you.]
[Fortunately, there were no Quasi Fairy King Tier Dark Beings yet, and under the protection of Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian, both Quasi Fairy King Tier strong existences, you were very safe.]
[With that, you began to establish a base in this lifeless world and explore it for resources.]
[To your surprise, the resources of this world were quite abundant, which was a stroke of luck amidst misfortune.]
[In this way, you silently developed in this world, cultivating throughout. In the blink of an eye, fifty thousand years had passed.]
[With the help of the resources of this world, your cultivation had made a startling breakthrough, reaching the Profound Immortal mid-stage.]
[However, as soon as you reached the Profound Immortal mid-stage, an unexpected turn of events took place.]
[Endless darkness appeared, and countless Dark Beings attacked you. This made your face quite somber. Although you had suspected this day might come, you didn’t expect it to come so quickly, much earlier than anticipated.]
[In the end, you struggled with all your might against the Dark Beings. In the ensuing battle, you unleashed terrifying combat power, killing one Profound Immortal-tier Dark Being after another. Due to the all-round enhancement of attributes provided by the 5-digit Talent·Night Hunter, even Profound Immortal Great Perfection-tier Dark Beings were no match for you.]
[The terrifying combat power you displayed amazed Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian, who began to doubt if you had reached the Quasi Fairy King-tier battle strength.]
[If that was the case, you would be too abnormal. After all, you only had the cultivation of Profound Immortal mid-stage, yet you possessed the combat power to rival the Quasi Fairy King-tier. Such a leap in tiers was too far beyond expectation and broke all norms.]
[However, the two didn’t have much time to be astonished by your strength, as a Quasi Fairy King-tier Dark Being appeared, and they found it very challenging.]
[This also made you very nervous, as you knew you might fall here today.]
[Just as you thought, another Quasi-Fairy King-tier Dark Being emerged, adding pressure to the situation.]
[However, you stabilized your mind, charged forward without fear, and engaged in a fierce battle. This battle was extremely intense and left Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian astounded by your performance.]
[Although they had previously suspected your battle strength might have reached the Quasi Fairy King-tier, they were still astonished when they truly saw you fighting a Quasi Fairy King-tier Dark Being. Although you weren’t a match for the Quasi Fairy King-tier Dark Being based on the battle, it was already a terrifying feat to fight on par with it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1163 - 1163 296 Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1163: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_3 Chapter 1163: Chapter 296: Continuous Brushing of 5-Digit Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_3 [With the attribute upgrade from your 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter, you battle with Quasi Fairy King Tier Dark Beings, admiring the power of this talent and wishing to break through your limits and comprehend the Quasi Fairy King Tier Dao during the battle. With that, you might have a chance to survive.]
[Unfortunately, you eventually fail. You were just a little bit away from breaking through the bottleneck, but you didn’t succeed in the end and were mercilessly killed by the Quasi Fairy King Tier Dark Beings.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
…
After the text simulation ends, many memories and cultivation insights emerge in Wang Ping’s mind.
Only after he has fully absorbed them does Wang Ping reveal an enthusiastic and sentimental look.
The talent effect of this 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter is indeed powerful, and if rated according to Myriad Heavens Paradise, it can at least be compared to the level of high-end 5-digit items.
“What a pity that this talent effect is only aimed at Dark Beings. If it could improve combat power at any time, its rating would definitely reach the 5-digit top tier.”
Wang Ping thought ruefully.
As Wang Ping was feeling regretful, the system’s voice rang again.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①.Mid-stage Profound Immortal Cultivation.
②.5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter.
③.a Random Profound Immortal Artifact.
④.a Random Immortal Stone.”
…..
“System, I choose ②.5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter, and ③.a Random Profound Immortal Artifact.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list and made his choice without hesitation.
As Wang Ping made his choice, information on the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter and its usage methods were added to his mind.
Apart from that, a Profound Immortal Artifact also appeared in his inner world.
“Why does it feel like I’m making a profit without any losses in my paid simulations now?”
Wang Ping looked at the Profound Immortal Artifact in his inner world with a strange expression.
The expenditure for paid simulation is a True Immortal Artifact.
As a result, he could refresh a Profound Immortal Artifact and then select it.
The value of a Profound Immortal Artifact is at least ten times that of a True Immortal Artifact.
It could be said that he made a huge profit.
“However, this should be my last paid simulation.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, planning to continue the paid simulation.
He had only one True Immortal Artifact left, and after using it up, he would have to go to the Immortal Domain to search for resources for more paid simulations.
And going to the Immortal Domain meant he had to maximize his combat power.
So, no matter what kind of development the next life simulation has, and what level the simulated Wang Ping’s cultivation will reach, he will choose the cultivation reward option.
“However, the cultivation option doesn’t refresh every time. Life Simulator, don’t prank me, make sure to refresh the cultivation option this time.”
After muttering in his heart, Wang Ping spoke again.
“System, I want to start a Paid Simulation.”
“Ding, consuming a True Immortal Artifact, starting Life Simulator, Talent Refresh in progress…..”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations Host for successfully refreshing 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater; 6-digit talent: Mental Illness.”
5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater: With this talent, the host’s cultivating speed will be significantly improved. Compared to the same realm, it’s like cheating, hence the name Cultivation Cheater.
6-digit talent: Mental Illness: The host will have mental illness, becoming paranoid, but in such a situation, the host can often perform incredible feats that ordinary people find hard to understand.
“Huh, another 5-digit talent. Are 5-digit talents starting to flood in? Plus, this 5-digit talent is extremely heaven-defying, just the type I need.”
Wang Ping looked at the newly refreshed talents, his eyes full of subtlety.
Right now, what he wants most is to quickly increase his cultivation and break the deadlock.
Now, he has directly refreshed the desired 5-digit talent. This is just incredible luck.
He always felt that once he optimized the Life Simulator again, his luck would turn and he would get exactly what he wanted.
“However, this 6-digit talent is outrageous. How can this Mental Illness talent be considered a 6-digit talent?”
Immediately afterward, Wang Ping looked at the other talent and began to complain.
Of course, complaining aside, Wang Ping was used to the Life Simulator occasionally refreshing some strange talents.
At the same time, Wang Ping also knew that the effects of these peculiar talents were often very powerful, exceeding the talent level to some extent.
However, he, Wang Ping, would definitely not choose any of these strange talents.
If there were no other talents, Wang Ping might still choose some. But now that he has the 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater, there’s no need to consider the others.
“System, I choose the 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater.”
After calming down, Wang Ping said in his heart.
“Ding, Talent Selection Successful, Life Simulation Begins…..”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar words floated up.
[On the first day, you chose the same actions as in your previous simulation, eventually arriving in the Immortal Domain. After arriving in the Immortal Domain, you were saved by Chu Lingyin once again, and brought to the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm for cultivation.]
[Due to possessing the 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater, your cultivation speed is much stronger compared to your previous simulations. Thus, after using the Female Profound Immortal as a Furnace Cauldron, your cultivation has already broken through to the Profound Immortal-tier.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1164 - 1164 296 Continuously Gaining 5-Digit Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1164: Chapter 296: Continuously Gaining 5-Digit Talent! Battle with the Quasi Fairy King_4 Chapter 1164: Chapter 296: Continuously Gaining 5-Digit Talent! Battle with the Quasi Fairy King_4 [It must be said, the speed at which you improve your cultivation has left Chu Lingyin extremely astonished. Although this was related to you having already reached the Late True Immortal Realm Stage when you arrived in the Immortal Domain, entering the Immortal Spirit Pool for cultivation, and using a female Profound Immortal as your Furnace Cauldron, even with these conditions, if it were someone else, it would already be quite amazing if they could reach the Half-step Profound Immortal in such a short time, let alone Profound Immortal, which would simply be impossible.]
[Regarding Chu Lingyin’s shocked reaction, you are very satisfied and deliberately reveal your age, tempting Chu Lingyin to consider whether she should become stronger alongside you. In response, Chu Lingyin is even more astonished but soon becomes extremely annoyed, and sends you flying with a single slap.]
[In the blink of an eye, one hundred thousand years have passed. During this time, although you didn’t have access to the cultivation resources from the Sword Immortal World, you still managed to break through a small realm and reach the Middle Profound Immortal Tier, just one step away from the Late Profound Immortal Realm, thanks to the talent effect of your 5-digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater.]
[This result makes you quite satisfied, once again marveling at the power of your 5-digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater. Your cultivating speed continues to astonish Chu Lingyin, who now sees you as hope for the Immortal Domain, capable of perhaps leading a counterattack against the Flame Demon Clan.]
[Not long after, quasi-Demon Kings like Yan Qingchi from the Flame Demon Clan attacked, forcing you to act as you did in your previous simulation by using your 5-digit Talent: Fixed Point Transmission to transport everyone to the Sword Immortal World.]
[Upon your arrival to the Sword Immortal World, the subsequent events are largely similar to those in the previous simulation. However, because you have reached the Profound Immortal Realm this time, you appear even more domineering. Of course, you do not reveal your true combat capabilities.]
[After all, staying low-key is the golden rule—if detected by some big shots, it would definitely bring hidden dangers.]
[And so, you begin your arduous cultivation. After over fifty thousand years of diligent low-profile cultivation, your cultivation successfully reaches the Late Profound Immortal Realm.]
[That very year, the great battle between the human and demon races completely erupts. However, you pay it no heed, continuing your secluded cultivation and striving to strengthen your combat power.]
[The events that unfold next differ from your previous simulation because of your constants seclusion—the struggle between the human and demon races is even more disadvantaged this time around, much to the headaches of the human race’s quasi-Fairy Kings.]
[As a result, it is not the demon race that instigates the war at the quasi-Fairy King-tier, but the human race, who wishes to turn the tides.]
[However, there is one more quasi-Fairy King in the demon race than in the human race, which puts the latter at an obvious disadvantage.]
[Nevertheless, upon sensing the situation at the quasi-Fairy King-tier, you naturally use the Cursed doll to directly curse and kill the King of Ten Thousand Demons. With the death of the King of Ten Thousand Demons, all the quasi-Fairy Kings on both sides are terrified and cease their attacks.]
[Even so, the King of Ten Thousand Demons possesses a Resurrection Item and revives shortly after. Although he has revived, his complexion is extremely unsightly. After all, the Resurrection Item he obtained from a historical site is a one-time-use treasure—once used up, it’s gone.]
[In other words, if someone from the human race can somehow kill him again through some mysterious means, he would truly be dead. For a moment, the King of Ten Thousand Demons finds himself in a dilemma, unsure whether to continue the battle.]
[Seeing the situation, the strongest quasi-Fairy King of the Integrated Immortal Sect sneers coldly, intimidating the King of Ten Thousand Demons by threatening that if they continue to fight, it will lead to mutual destruction.]
[In response, the King of Ten Thousand Demons snorts coldly, warning his opponent not to bluff. After all, items capable of silently killing him are extremely rare and one-time-use treasures.]
[Hearing this, the strongest quasi-Fairy King of the Integrated Immortal Sect laughs coldly, stating that he may have other precious treasures, and the King of Ten Thousand Demons can test it out if he dares.]
[With an unsightly complexion, the King of Ten Thousand Demons ultimately does not dare to take the risk and is forced to stop his attacks. As a result, the high-end combat forces of both sides once again cease hostilities, and the scale of the war gradually diminishes.]
[When you hear of the situation, you are not surprised, as it is within your expectations. Therefore, you do not pay much attention to it and continue to concentrate on your cultivation.]
[In a blink of an eye, another sixty thousand years pass. With the resources Chu Lingyin has acquired for you and the assistance of your 5-digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater, your cultivation experiences another astonishing breakthrough, reaching the Great Perfection Tier of the Profound Immortal Realm.]
[Not only that, but over the years, your insight into the Tao has made equally incredible breakthroughs, allowing you to finally comprehend the Chaos Immortal Tao within the Quasi-Fairy King domain, and improving the Chaotic Immortal Scripture to match the Quasi-Fairy King Scripture in level.]
[From this point on, your combat power has soared to an unimaginable level.]
[Next, you begin forging your own Quasi-Fairy King instrument. With the help of Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian in obtaining the necessary materials, you successfully enhance your Chaotic fairy clothes and Devouring Immortal Bead to the level of Quasi-Fairy King’s Artifact.]
[It can be said that your current configuration has reached the peak of luxury, giving you the confidence to face powerful beings at the Quasi-Fairy King-tier. If your opponent is a Dark Being, coupled with your 5-digit Talent-Night Hunter, you believe you can easily crush them.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1165 - 1165 296 Breaking Through the Five-Figure
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1165: Chapter 296: Breaking Through the Five-Figure Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_5 Chapter 1165: Chapter 296: Breaking Through the Five-Figure Talent! Battling the Quasi Fairy King_5 [At the time when you were in high spirits, the demon race surprisingly launched another large-scale racial war. This astonished the human race, who couldn’t figure out what the demon race was up to.]
[You were also frowning due to the sudden change. After all, in the previous simulation, there was no large-scale racial war after the ceasefire.]
[Although the development of the story is a bit different from before, the demon race shouldn’t be so reckless.]
