[However, anyway, since the war was about to break out, the human race had no choice but to fight. Thus, the battle at the tier of Quasi Fairy King erupted once again.]
[This time, you didn’t go into closed-door cultivation but chose to join the battlefield. However, you didn’t expose all your details for now, and participated in the war with a cultivation level of Profound Immortal Great Perfection.]
[Though you hid a lot, as you successively killed the powerful beings of the demon race that were at Profound Immortal Great Perfection, you attracted the attention of the demon race, enraging them.]
[On the human race’s side, they were quite surprised, not expecting the Heavenly Sound Immortal School to have someone as powerful as you.]
[When both sides reacted, the quasi-Fairy Kings of the demon race couldn’t stand it anymore, and one of the quasi-Fairy Kings forcibly left his battlefield to come and kill you.]
[Perhaps due to fate, this quasi-immortal king rushing to kill you was the same one you cursed to death with the five-digit special item curse doll in your previous simulation.]
[At this, you had a strange look in your eyes, without any fear, your heart filled with the desire to fight. However, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian were quite worried and wanted to rush to your aid.]
[After all, in their opinion, no matter how strong you were, you couldn’t possibly be a match for the quasi-immortal king. The gap in cultivation was fatal.]
[However, although they wanted to save you, they didn’t have any means to do so. After all, they weren’t considered strong among the quasi-immortal kings, and they couldn’t gain any advantage in a battle of the same level.]
[Just when many cultivators thought you were going to fall, the power you erupted with shocked everyone. Facing the full-strength attack of a quasi-Fairy King tier powerhouse, you didn’t hold back and unleashed the terrifying Chaotic Immortal Fist.]
[When the two collided, the demon race’s quasi-Fairy King was sent flying by you, his immortal body cracking, and he was not lightly injured.]
[This shocked many cultivators and amazed the quasi-Fairy King. After all, your performance was too terrifying. Then, they saw through your background, realizing that you possessed a Perfect Chaotic Body, comprehended the Chaos Immortal Tao and Chaotic Immortal Scripture at the quasi-Fairy King domain, and even had life-bound clothes at the level of a Quasi Fairy King instrument.]
[Thus, you were able to accomplish such an incredible feat, where you, with the cultivation of Profound Immortal Great Perfection, managed to wound a powerhouse at the quasi-Fairy King tier.]
[For a moment, the human race was not only shocked but also overjoyed, thinking that the tide of the battle might turn. The powerhouses of the demon race, on the other hand, wore ugly expressions on their faces, filled with killing intent towards you.]
[As for the demon race’s quasi-immortal king who was injured by you, he was not only surprised but also angry and humiliated. After all, being defeated by someone of a lower level was quite humiliating. It made him lose face among the quasi-immortal kings.]
[However, he was also very wary as your combat power exceeded his expectations.]
[Nevertheless, having already engaged in a battle with you, he had no choice but to do his best to defeat or at least stall you. As a result, this demon race’s quasi-immortal king once again launched a terrifying attack and charged at you.]
[Seeing this, you were fearless and excited, with a strong desire to fight. You laughed heartily as you fought against the enemy, overpowering him.]
[As the battle between the two sides intensified, a series of blood-colored light poles suddenly appeared in the Sward Immortal World. Numerous living beings were refined by the blood-colored great array, and the terrifying Blood Spirit was absorbed by the King of Ten Thousand Demons, causing his power to explosively increase.]
[This scene made the faces of the human race’s quasi-immortal kings change greatly. They angrily accused the King of Ten Thousand Demons of being insanely crazy, daring to resort to such evil and unscrupulous acts, which were against Heaven’s will. They even warned him of facing retribution and dying suddenly.]
[The King of Ten Thousand Demons sneered, saying it didn’t matter if he entered the Evil Tao. As long as he could annihilate the human race, he could do anything.]
[Having paused for a moment, the King of Ten Thousand Demons opened his mouth again, stating that he not only wanted to eliminate all of you but also break through to the Immortal King-tier by using your power. As for the so-called damages to Heaven’s will and the ridiculous Heavenly Tao, he didn’t care.]
[These words made the faces of the human race’s quasi-immortal kings even uglier. They knew that this guy had gone mad. Therefore, they broke free of their opponents and wanted to join forces to kill the King of Ten Thousand Demons directly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1166 - 1166 297 Unstoppable Force Breakthrough to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1166: Chapter 297: Unstoppable Force! Breakthrough to Quasi Fairy King! Chapter 1166: Chapter 297: Unstoppable Force! Breakthrough to Quasi Fairy King! [However, the Quasi Fairy Kings of the Human Race underestimated the countermeasures prepared by the King of Ten Thousand Demons. A defensive artifact was activated, effectively blocking the attack of the Human Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings.]
[This diversion bought the Demon Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings some time, allowing them to retaliate and injure the Human Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings. After all, the earlier attacks on the King of Ten Thousand Demons by the Human Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings had been carried out with reckless disregard for the risks posed by the other Quasi Fairy Kings. They had now been inflicted a retaliation.]
[In an instant, the situation became perilous, and the cultivators of the Human Race were seized by panic. The Quasi Fairy King of the Integrated Immortal Sect showed a grave expression, spreading a message through the Immortal sound, declaring that if the King of Ten Thousand Demons succeeded, all ethnic groups apart from the Demon Race would be exterminated. If they did not act now, it would be too late.]
[Upon hearing the plea of the Human Race cultivators, each Quasi Fairy King from various ethnic groups displayed flickering eyes, calculating their gains and losses. In the end, they still held no intention of moving into action. At least, not yet.]
[After all, they didn’t believe that the King of Ten Thousand Demons could defy the heavens and break through to the Immortal King-tier in the current Sword Immortal World. They would rather continue to let the Human Race and the Demon Race fight against each other. When the timing was ripe, they would assist the Human Race against the Demon Race, reaping the rewards as bystanders.]
[Seeing the undecided Quasi Fairy Kings of other ethnic groups, the countenances of the Human Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings turned extremely ugly, realizing they were headed towards a massive problem.]
[However, at that very moment, you stepped forward, walking towards the King of Ten Thousand Demons. Witnessing your actions, the other Quasi Fairy Kings were startled, unsure of what you intended to do.]
[As for the Demon Race’s Quasi Fairy King who was your enemy, he too was taken aback. However, he didn’t stop you and simply sneered coldly, finding you overconfident.]
[Amidst everyone’s astonishment, you calmly proposed that all the Quasi Fairy Kings of the Human Race assist you by holding back the other Demon Race’s Quasi Fairy Kings. As for the King of Ten Thousand Demons, you would take him on.]
[This declaration left everyone stupefied. They hadn’t expected you to say such words. Your audacity was indeed astonishing. After all, anyone could see that the King of Ten Thousand Demons was becoming extremely powerful and was still quickly growing stronger. In such a scenario, no Quasi Fairy King could possibly match him, let alone a Profound Immortal Great Perfection cultivator like yourself.]
[Even if you, a Profound Immortal Great Perfection cultivator, were exceedingly abnormal, capable of fighting against a Quasi Fairy King and even suppressing them, there was no way you could defeat the King of Ten Thousand Demons. After all, he was one of the most formidable Quasi Fairy Kings and was still getting stronger. In such a situation, even if you broke through to the Quasi Fairy King Tier, it might not necessarily guarantee your victory, let alone now.]
[Therefore, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian showed stressed expressions, urging you to not act rashly.]
[However, you didn’t heed their advice and directly charged towards the King of Ten Thousand Demons. Seeing you attack, the King of Ten Thousand Demons scoffed, looking down on you. He remarked that an insignificant insect like you dared to challenge him, which was utterly foolish.]
[Subsequently, the King of Ten Thousand Demons unleashed a terrifying skill towards you. This attack was so dreadful that it struck fear into the other Quasi Fairy Kings, making them feel that if they were to receive this blow, they would undoubtedly suffer severe injuries, even potentially leading to their demise.]
[However, facing this attack, you remained nonchalant, and similarly unleashed a terrifying skill, effortlessly shattering his attack.]
[Your performance left all the cultivators absolutely astounded. The King of Ten Thousand Demons was also taken aback, his face filled with disbelief. After all, he was already transcending the Quasi Fairy King Tier at this point, and yet his attack was blocked so effortlessly by you. This was preposterous. How could a Profound Immortal Great Perfection have such formidable strength? Even with a Chaotic Body, it couldn’t possibly be this powerful.]
[You didn’t care about the shock all around you. You continued to march towards the King of Ten Thousand Demons, your expression ice-cold. If only the King of Ten Thousand Demons wouldn’t indulge in such evil acts, the battle between the Human Race and the Demon Race would have just been an even match.]
[However, he insisted on courting death. Because of his recklessness, Wang Ping activated the effect of 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter, greatly enhancing all the attributes, which brought his combat strength to an unimaginable level.]
[For this reason, you were confident in easily crushing the King of Ten Thousand Demons.]
[Indeed, as events unfolded, your thoughts were proven correct. Following this, you engaged in an intense battle with the King of Ten Thousand Demons. He was no match for you and he was consecutively defeated by you.]
[Despite his successive rebounds, he was still in a pitiable state, moreover, he felt immensely stifled. He’d never imagined that despite sparing no efforts in growing stronger, he’d still be beaten so miserably. More frustratingly, the one who was tormenting him was a mere Profound Immortal Realm Great Perfection junior. This was utterly humiliating.]
[For this reason, the King of Ten Thousand Demons lost his sanity. He completely transformed into a demonic creature, hoping to gain more formidable power. However, as the King of Ten Thousand Demons transformed into a demon, the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter’s amplification on Wang Ping’s attributes grew even stronger.]
[Resulting in Wang Ping becoming even more powerful, however, the outcome remained unchanged. Ultimately, Wang Ping brutally defeated the King of Ten Thousand Demons, causing his complete downfall.]
[After the downfall of the King of Ten Thousand Demons, the blood-red light poles disappeared, as if nothing had ever happened. Clearly, with the King of Ten Thousand Demons acting as the eye of the Great Array, once he fell, the Great Array was also broken.]
[After killing the King of Ten Thousand Demons, you looked down upon the Quasi Fairy Kings of the Demon Race. You emitted a cold snort, uttering three words, ‘Who’s next!?’.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1167 - 1167 297 Unrivaled Might Breaking Through to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1167: Chapter 297: Unrivaled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _2 Chapter 1167: Chapter 297: Unrivaled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _2 [Your words chilled the courage of all quasi Fairy Kings of the Demon race. Your display of power was too terrifying – even the King of Ten Thousand Demons proved no match for you and was effortlessly slain. Continuing the battle would mean a high probability of defeat for them.]
[The quasi Fairy Kings among the Human Race were also left speechless, never expecting you to be so formidable. Even Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian were stunned into silence by your dominance and were at a loss for words.]
[As for the quasi Fairy Kings of other races, they regretted not aiding the Human Race against the Demon Race earlier. As a result, their current predicament was quite embarrassing.]
[Next, under your icy gaze, the Demon race’s quasi Fairy Kings let out a sigh, and chose to surrender, seeking peace with the Humans.]
[Seeing this, the Human quasi Fairy Kings did not immediately agree but instead turned to you. Clearly, your performance had made you the new linchpin of the Human Race, and your opinion was vital on such a critical issue.]
[As all the quasi Fairy Kings turned their eyes towards you, you responded with indifference, suggesting you valued peaceful cultivation more than bloodshed. Therefore, as long as the Demon Race could provide the Human Race with substantial compensation, the conflict could be considered resolved.]
[Hearing your words, the Demon Race rejoiced and breathed a sigh of relief. Meanwhile, the human side frowned slightly but did not disagree.]
[After all, everyone was not a fool. They speculated that the terrifying power you displayed before might be a trump card that couldn’t be used again in a short time – suggesting your combat power was equivalent to an ordinary quasi Fairy King.]
[Under such circumstances, if they were to continue the war with the Demon Race, they would undoubtedly suffer severe losses. Trying to chew on the tough bone of the Demon Race, they presumed to lose some quasi Fairy Kings and a substantial number of Profound Immortals and True Immortals.]
[Not to mention, other races were fishing in troubled waters. Considering many factors, it seemed ill-advised to continue the war. Therefore, negotiating peace was necessary.]
[However, the Human quasi Fairy Kings were not in a hurry, as long as you reach the quasi Fairy King Tier, they could firmly suppress the Demon Race and dictated the terms as they wished.]
[All parties involved were planning their next move when your cold words echoed again, warning that any further aggression on the Human Race would result in total annihilation.]
[These words not only deterred the Demon Race but also other races. This made these races cautious and they dare not disobey. After all, the speculation that you couldn’t use your trump card in a short time was merely a guess and no one wanted to place a bet on that. All races hoped that you are indeed a kind-hearted person who opposed racial warfare.]
[Next, you didn’t say much, the war between the two races ended, and negotiation commenced.]
[Soon after, the Demon Race compensated with a large quantity of resources, conceded much territory, and agreed to several unequal treaties. Thus, the war between the two races was entirely over, and you returned to the Heavenly Sound Immortal School with a large amount of resources, continuing to cultivate in preparation for the impending Dark Disaster two hundred thousand years later.]
[You believed that only by breaking through to the quasi Fairy King Tier can you have a slim chance of survival in the Dark Disaster in two hundred thousand years. Otherwise, your chance of falling in the Dark Disaster would be extremely high.]
[Of course, you also understood, if as you suspected, the strange entity had noticed you, then even if you broke through to the quasi Fairy King Tier, you still had one path left: death.]
[To say it accurately, even if you broke through to the Immortal King-tier, you would still meet your end facing such an entity.]
[After all, the level of this strange entity was definitely not as simple as a four-digit number. Even an Immortal King would be as insignificant as an ant before it.]
[While you were cultivating intensively, two hundred thousand years had passed in the blink of an eye. With your 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater and the vast resources obtained from the Demon Race, you finally broke through to the quasi Fairy King Tier.]
[With your breakthrough to the quasi Fairy King Tier, your combat power received a significant boost. When you sparred with Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian, neither could withstand a single move from you. Even when they teamed up against you, they were still easily defeated.]
[Both of them could only marvel at your strength. It took you only about three hundred thousand years to become a quasi Fairy King with such formidable power, shattering countless records from the past and future. Perhaps even beings above the Immortal King wouldn’t have cultivated as fast as you did.]
[Just when the two were marvelling at your monstrous cultivation speed and terrifying power, the Dark Disaster finally erupted.]
[With the outbreak of the Dark Disaster, numerous Dark Beings appeared. The entire Sword Immortal World was in chaos, all cultivators were horrified, and started working together to combat the Dark Beings.]
[You, naturally, joined in this war. In fact, because you had already advanced to the quasi Fairy King Tier, you were the main force. With your aid, Dark Beings were easily slain one after another, even the quasi Fairy King-tier Dark Beings were no exception.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1168 - 1168 297 Unparalleled Might Breaking Through
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1168: Chapter 297: Unparalleled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _3 Chapter 1168: Chapter 297: Unparalleled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _3 [Your achievements have impressed many Quasi Fairy Kings who think that you are a real freak. At the same time, they can’t help wondering whether your combat power has reached the Immortal King level.]
[However, they only speculated and quickly dismissed this idea. Because this thought is too shocking.]
[An Immortal King is so powerful that in their memory, throughout history, no Quasi Fairy King has ever defeated an Immortal King. It is absolutely impossible for someone to defeat an Immortal King across levels.]
[At the time when they were thinking about this in their hearts, a powerful Dark Being at the Immortal King level appeared. After the Dark Immortal King appeared, he targeted you and ruthlessly began to attack you.]
[At this, your scalp tingled, feeling a terrifying pressure and a shadow of death in your heart. However, even if you know that you might not be a match for Dark Immortal King, you still choose to face the challenge, wanting to fight the Dark Immortal King and defeat him.]
[However, you’re ultimately no match for the Dark Immortal King. Even if your Five-Digit Talent – Night Hunter can increase your combat prowess a little, facing the Dark Immortal King, it is still too weak. Just a few moves without the Dark Immortal King’s full power, and you’re slain.]
[Although it’s earth-shattering to be able to clash a few times with the Dark Immortal King, you eventually perished.]
[Because of your death, this simulation has come to an end…]
……
With the end of the text simulation, Wang Ping’s mind filled with masses of memory images and cultivation realizations.
“I didn’t expect that this simulation would directly reach Quasi Fairy King’s level. It’s really surprising. However, this is also normal.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought this to himself.
Why did he upgrade slowly before and easily get stuck at specific stages?
In the end, it was because of a lack of talent and resources.
Now, the simulated Wang Ping has a Perfect Chaotic Body, and his talent is among the top in the Immortal Domain, which is by no means an exaggeration.
With such conditions, cultivating speed cannot be slow.
If it’s combined with enough cultivation resources, then the cultivating speed would be even faster.
Not to mention that this time, there is also the 5-Digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater.
Under normal circumstances, for other cultivators, it takes an entire epoch to enhance their realm by one small level, but for the simulated Wang Ping, the terrifying cultivating speed is just natural because of many factors combined.
As Wang Ping was feeling a myriad of emotions, the system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, reward generation successful. You can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Quasi Fairy King cultivation.
②. 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater.
③. Chaotic fairy clothes (Quasi Fairy King instrument).
④. A Profound Immortal Artifact.”
…..
“There are so many great things, even a Quasi Fairy King Artifact comes out… It makes me suffer from choice paralysis.”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards refreshed this time and sighed a myriad of emotions.
“This time, I must choose the Quasi Fairy King cultivation. As for the others…”
After thinking it through, Wang Ping made the first choice.
As for the subsequent choice, Wang Ping wanted the 5-digit talent: Cultivation Cheater, but he felt its usefulness was limited.
After all, a 5-digit talent is just effective within the 5-digit range.
Wang Ping’s current cultivation reached the level of a Quasi Fairy King, which is equal to the 5-digit limit.
That is to say, the effect of the Cultivation Cheater is limited now.
Especially at the Immortal King level, the Cultivation Cheater becomes completely useless.
Therefore, choosing the Quasi Immortal King Instrument: Chaos Immortal Clothes that can enhance his combat effectiveness seems to be a better choice.
“However, this should just be a better choice on the surface. If the 5-Digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater could somehow help me reach the Immortal King level, even just a tiny bit, then it would be a great profit.”
Wang Ping shook his head and laughed softly.
“Not to mention, this talent has great potential value. If I sell it, I can definitely get a pretty good price, or exchange it for a pretty good item.”
With that thought, Wang Ping made his choice and said, “System, I choose the Quasi Fairy King cultivation and the 5-Digit Talent: Cultivation Cheater.”
As Wang Ping made his choice, his cultivation surged at an astonishing speed.
True Immortal Mid-Stage!
True Immortal Late-Stage!
True Immortal Great Perfection!
Half-step Profound Immortal!
Profound Immortal Early Stage!
Profound Immortal Mid-Stage!
Profound Immortal Late Stage!
Profound Immortal Great Perfection!
Quasi Fairy King!
“What a thrilling feeling to suddenly leap nine levels… It’s beyond pleasurable.”
Wang Ping felt overwhelmed by the immense power within him and was filled with emotions.
Now, he should be considered the top existence just below the Immortal King level.
Even if he lacks a Quasi Fairy King Artifact, very few people could be his match.
Subsequently, Wang Ping’s mind accessed more information: the 5-Digit Talent – Cultivation Cheater.
However, Wang Ping didn’t pay much attention to this talent>
After all, the talent works completely passively and doesn’t require active use.
“System, how many resources do I need for my next simulation?”
Immediately, Wang Ping composed himself and asked the system in his heart.
“Ding, as your cultivation has reached the Quasi Fairy King level, the paid simulation requires you to consume a Quasi Fairy King Artifact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - 1169 297 Unrivaled Might Breaking Through to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1169: Chapter 297: Unrivaled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _4 Chapter 1169: Chapter 297: Unrivaled Might! Breaking Through to the Quasi Fairy King! _4 The system’s voice rang out, making Wang Ping’s face slightly stiff.
Although he already knew this would be the outcome, he still couldn’t help but feel a headache.
Increased cultivation meant increased resource consumption for Paid Simulation.
Originally, Wang Ping had planned to rely on the Profound instrument for one or two simulations.
Now, his cultivation had directly been upgraded to the Quasi Fairy King tier, making the Profound instrument useless.
What gives, it’s pain and pleasure combined.
“Forget it, I don’t need to continue with Paid Simulation anymore. The current level of the Life Simulator is just five digits, meaning it would be extremely difficult for me to refresh my cultivation to the level of Immortal King.”
Wang Ping shook his head and calmed his emotions.
In other words, it was time to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise to get the Rule Stone again.
However, this time he needed not a five-digit Rule Stone, but a four-digit Rule Stone.
He had a feeling that it would be difficult to get his hands on one.
After all, according to the records Wang Ping had read, four-digit level Rule Stones were rarely given out as game rewards.
Basically, such precious items were usually consumed internally by the major powers of the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Even if they weren’t consumed internally, they were used for trade with other forces when necessary.
Apart from these factors, there were only three ways to obtain a four-digit Rule Stone.
The first method was to try to join one of the extremely powerful forces in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
After all, those with three-digit cultivation could easily create four-digit Rule Stones, and these forces definitely had some in their collection.
The second method was to obtain them in extremely difficult special area games.
The third method was, of course, the Sky Tower. To get the rewards by passing through the tower.
It was recorded that some people had obtained four-digit Rule Stones in the Sky Tower Game.
People like Wang Ping had obtained five-digit Rule Stones by going through the Heaven Tower.
However, Wang Ping was lucky that he had obtained it on the first floor of the Tower.
Under normal circumstances, even in the Abyss difficulty, this reward probability was still quite small.
“But before I return to the Heavenly Paradise, let’s do some free simulations first and try all the routes I didn’t dare to attempt in the past.”
Soon enough, Wang Ping had an idea and decided to try the free simulation.
However, before Wang Ping could even try the free simulation, he seemed to sense something, furrowed his brows, and looked towards the location of the Upper Realm.
Then, Wang Ping waved his sleeves, took a step, and disappeared on the spot, returning to the Upper Realm.
It was just as Wang Ping returned that large areas of space in the Upper Realm shattered, attracting the attention of many powerful beings.
“Second Generation Chat Group, you never get tired, do you?”
Wang Ping watched this calmly, very upset inside. The killing intent towards the second-generation chat group owner Dao Yi was soaring.
Not much time had passed since the last attempt, and this guy had sent someone to kill him again.
Just as Wang Ping was very annoyed, a figure descended into this world.
The moment this figure descended, a prop was used immediately.
The prop exploded instantly, unleashing a terrifying skill that was equivalent to the power of the Quasi Fairy King tier.
In the face of such power, let alone one Upper Realm, even ten Upper Realms stacked together would be completely destroyed.
Admittedly, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader was ruthless. To kill Wang Ping, such a precious prop was used.
After all, just over a month ago, Wang Ping’s revealed cultivation was only at True Immortal tier.
However, the Second Generation Chat Group chose to use a prop that could injure the Quasi Fairy King tier to deal with Wang Ping.
It must be said, this was ruthless, and they were really scared by Wang Ping’s terrifying growth rate, wanting to get rid of him at any cost.
“If I hadn’t chosen to increase my cultivation, I would probably be killed instantly without even having a chance to react with my True Immortal tier cultivation.”
Wang Ping reached out his palm, his eyes cold.
“Too bad, you still underestimated me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1170 - 1170 298 Facing the Second Generation Group
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1170: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Owner! The Voice of Life and Death Boundary! Chapter 1170: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Owner! The Voice of Life and Death Boundary! It was right after Wang Ping made his move that the terrifying energy wave, which was supposed to engulf the entire Upper Realm and destroy it completely, was instantly suppressed, kneaded, and compressed by Wang Ping into a pitch-black energy ball.
Next, numerous Chaotic Chains wrapped around it and sealed it.
It was only after Wang Ping had done all this that the pitch-black energy ball exploded.
However, such a terrifying energy ball explosion couldn’t even destroy the restrictions formed by the Chaotic Chains, akin to a dud firecracker.
For a moment, the traveler from the Second Generation Chat Group who came to attack Wang Ping showed an incredulous expression, his face filled with fear.
This scene was simply beyond belief.
Keep in mind that this was a terrifying force capable of easily destroying ten Upper Realms, a power belonging to the 5-digit Limit Tier.
Nevertheless, Wang Ping merely caught it with a single hand, turning it into a dud…
This level of strength was simply too abnormal. Even a regular 5-digit Limit couldn’t have achieved it.
That is to say, in terms of pure strength, Wang Ping’s combat power had already surpassed the vast majority of 5-digit Limit Tier powerhouses and even their group owner.
“You’re a monster!”
This traveler from the Second Generation Chat Group, with a pale face, squeezed out these few words through his teeth.
They in the Second Generation Chat Group already took Wang Ping seriously enough. If these attacks were aimed at someone else, it would not be an exaggeration to say they were using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.
However, who could have known that Wang Ping would be such a freak, taking only a little over a month to advance from True Immortal tier strength to a level far surpassing the ordinary 5-digit Limit Tier, breaking all common sense.
This wasn’t supposed to be how someone cheats.
If Wang Ping had developed in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, had been born in a major power, and had rapidly become stronger by following the game rules of the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he could have understood that, as becoming rich or powerful overnight in the Myriad Heavens Paradise was not a rare event.
But Wang Ping had developed in this Profound World.
To cultivate in the Profound World and reach the Quasi Fairy King level in such a short period was simply unbelievable.
“Monster? In your eyes, my growth rate could indeed be considered monstrous.”
Wang Ping spoke coldly and indifferently.
“However, in a certain sense, it’s all because you forced it out of me. After all, without the pressure you brought, there’s no way I’d have been in such a hurry to become stronger.”
“Since I’ve already become this strong, it’s time for me to hunt all of you down. Don’t worry, not a single one of you will escape.”
Wang Ping gazed at the traveler from the Second Generation Chat Group.
Not only was he looking at this person and speaking to him, but he was also addressing all the people belonging to the Second Generation Chat Group who were spying on them.
Other than that, there was nothing wrong with Wang Ping’s words.
If it weren’t for the members of the Second Generation Chat Group targeting him all the time, he could have simply lived comfortably through the life simulation without any pressure.
However, because of the Second Generation Chat Group, Wang Ping was forced to become stronger at a rapid pace, constantly feeling suffocated.
If it weren’t for the Life Simulator, Wang Ping would have died long ago.
Even with the Life Simulator, if it weren’t for the tips and the backing of a powerful figure, Wang Ping might have still died.
The Second Generation Chat Group had targeted him multiple times, with several of the attacks being deadly.
So, there is nothing wrong with Wang Ping’s words.
As Wang Ping’s words came out, the Second Generation Chat Group traveler in front of him felt a chill in his heart, realizing that the Second Generation Chat Group was likely heading towards its end.
As for the group members of the Second Generation Chat Group watching the live broadcast at this moment, they were all similarly shocked to the extreme.
Among them, Mr.Dao, who had fought against Wang Ping before, was terrified to the extreme.
He never expected that Wang Ping, who couldn’t even defeat him at first and had to rely on his teammates, would grow to be at the level of a powerhouse like the Second Generation Chat Group owner Dao Yi in such a short period.
Now, Wang Ping even threatened to wipe out all of the members of the Second Generation Chat Group.
For a moment, Mr.Dao felt that he was as good as dead, with absolutely no chance of survival.
After all, Wang Ping was simply too freakish; he even suspected that after some time, Wang Ping would be able to defeat the Second Generation Chat Group owner Dao Yi in seconds.
“However, being able to fight against such a strong opponent and escape once is something worth boasting about.”
Mr.Dao tried to find joy in his misfortune and showed a complicated smile on his face.
As for the Second Generation Chat Group Leader Dao Yi, who was in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, his face was cold and his heart was filled with murderous intent towards Wang Ping.
“Wang Ping, don’t be too proud of yourself just yet. Who will live and who will die, it’s still uncertain.”
In the end, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader snorted coldly and directly turned off the live broadcast of the Second Generation Chat Group.
It was when the Second Generation Chat Group Leader turned off the live broadcast that Wang Ping made his move again.
To be more precise, it couldn’t really be called making a move. He simply stopped suppressing his power, and with a glance, the Second Generation Chat Group traveler who had invaded the Upper Realm burst into a cloud of blood fog, dying completely.
After taking care of all this, Wang Ping reined in his emotions, stepped forward and returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
Then, as if remembering something, Wang Ping looked towards the location of the Guimo Sea and casually pointed with a finger.
Instantly, the power of space swept over, directly rolling up Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and Yu Daoyi back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace.
At first, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor was taken aback. When he regained his senses and saw the bewildered Yu Daoyi and the indifferent Wang Ping, he seemed to understand what had happened, and couldn’t help but be amazed by Wang Ping’s methods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - 1171 298 Facing the Second Generation Group
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1171: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_2 Chapter 1171: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_2 After all, he was looking for his daughter in the Guimo Sea, but Wang Ping silently moved him from the Guimo Sea back to Taiyi Imperial Palace, even bringing Yu Daoyi along.
Even a True Immortal might not be able to accomplish such a feat.
“Fellow Taoist Heavenly Feather, I thought you were working too hard to find her, so I helped you out. I hope you don’t blame me for being nosy.”
Wang Ping looked at Heavenly Feather Great Emperor and said with a smile.
“How could I blame the palace master? I can’t even thank you enough.”
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor smiled.
“However, Palace Master, please just call me Heavenly Feather. Now that you are an immortal, it is inappropriate to call me a fellow taoist.”
Pausing for a moment, the Heavenly Feather Great Emperor said with a wry smile.
Having a powerhouse far surpassing an ordinary True Immortal addressing him as a fellow Daoist, treating him as an equal, made him feel greatly honored indeed.
“Hehe, there’s no need to care about the strength of one’s cultivation. When I make friends, I never consider their cultivation. After all, none of them will ever be as strong as me. If I were too concerned about such matters, I would probably spend my life without any friends to chat with.”
Wang Ping smiled and spoke.
Heavenly Feather Great Emperor couldn’t reveal what he did in the Life Simulator, so Wang Ping could only offer such comfort.
“Uh…”
Wang Ping’s words left Heavenly Feather Great Emperor at a loss for words.
He had no choice, as these words were meant to be comforting, but they sounded rather arrogant.
“Father, who is he…?”
Yu Daoyi looked at Wang Ping with astonishment. Although she had guessed a little, she was still somewhat unsure.
“The palace master is called Wang Ping and is the unique immortal of this era…”
Seeing Yu Daoyi ask, Heavenly Feather Great Emperor concisely explained Wang Ping’s identity and some of the things that had happened after Wang Ping joined Taiyi Imperial Palace.
This left Yu Daoyi greatly shocked and full of curiosity and admiration for Wang Ping.
After all, the man in front of her was the only immortal in this era, and he had achieved immortality in the Last Dharma Age, which was truly legendary.
“Yu Daoyi, meet the palace master, and thank you for the rescue.”
After Yu Daoyi recovered, she smiled and bowed respectfully to Wang Ping.
“No need to be polite.”
Wang Ping nodded his head.
“You father and daughter must have a lot to say after such a long time apart. I won’t disturb you any further.”
Following that, without wanting to say anything more, Wang Ping disappeared after saying this with a smile.
This left Yu Daoyi somewhat regretful.
Originally, she wanted to have a chat with Wang Ping, to learn more about him and ask about the Immortal Dao as well.
It seemed that it would have to wait until next time.
At this moment, after Wang Ping returned to his Cave Mansion, he started another simulation.
However, this time Wang Ping conducted a free simulation instead of a paid one.
“Ding, the Life Simulator starts, free simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and Wang Ping’s familiar text emerged.
[Day 1: Under the influence of the original Wang Ping, you chose to go to the Life and Death Realm, wanting to find a way to revive the Chaos Immortal Grass.]
[After arriving in the Life and Death Realm, you find that even though you have become a Quasi Fairy King, this realm still feels extremely dangerous and makes your heart palpitate. At this point, you become even more certain of one thing.]
[That is, in the Life and Death Realm, even Immortal Kings can fall. If this place is not naturally formed, then it was definitely created by an existence with four digits or more.]
[Perhaps, this also means that, in this Profound World, there are three-digit existences, and the Immortal King realm is not the end of cultivation. However, even the Immortal Domain and the Demon Realm have no legends about any realms beyond the Immortal King, so it is assumed there is no way forward.]
[Just as you are thinking about all this, you once again repel the attack of the ghosts from the River of Forgetfulness. This time, you have no intention of retreating and continue to venture in deeper.]
[Finally, you see a bridge, which is none other than the Bridge of Helplessness. On the bridge, you see countless ghosts, who are all mindlessly walking on it, moving forward.]
[You are astonished by this scene and increasingly believe that reincarnation may exist in this world. Of course, in a sense, you have already seen the Reincarnation Emperor Sutra situation long ago. Although the Reincarnation Emperor Sutra has a grand name, in your current eyes, it is nothing more than a opportunistic path, not truly Reincarnation.]
[The Reincarnation Emperor Sutra simply turns some soul marks and memories of cultivators into marks, and then randomly places them onto people whose souls have a relative affinity to the Jee family individuals. Essentially, this can be considered a form of body possession, only with a more clever technique.]
[However, whether this method of possession is still the original Jee family individual is a genuine question, and it may not necessarily awaken all memories successfully. In the Sci-fi World, there was a similar argument, saying that after uploading memories, it only replicates a similar consciousness, which is related to the original body but not exactly the same.]
[Furthermore, in many science fiction films, it often occurs that after the upload of memories, the original body is disposed of.]
[As you ponder these various matters, you step onto the Bridge of Helplessness, wanting to see deeper, and learn the secrets inside.]
[But before you can delve any further, an old voice rings out, saying that this is the place for the dead, and the living should go no further.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - 1172 298 Facing the Second Generation Group
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1172: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_3 Chapter 1172: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_3 [As this voice fell, you lost consciousness.]
[When you regained consciousness, you were astonished to find yourself in the outer world.]
[You were shocked and frightened by this situation. Clearly, there was a guardian in the depths of the Naihe Bridge. The power of this guardian reached an incredible level.]
[However, he did not kill you but expelled you. Perhaps he made such a choice because he saw your potential.]
…
“Well, did you really discover some secrets of the Life and Death Realm?”
Wang Ping was also amazed at the content of the Text Simulation.
If there was a guardian in the Life and Death Realm, the probability of it being a natural occurrence would be greatly reduced.
Which meant it was likely created by a three-digit presence.
Three digits…
It was hard to imagine how strong such an existence would be.
“It seems that if I want to go there to revive the Chaos Immortal Grass, I need to become stronger. In addition, upgrading the Life Simulator and extracting even more powerful four-digit talents is also a key factor.”
Wang Ping was thinking silently in his heart.
It was during Wang Ping’s contemplation that the Text Simulation continued.
[Next, you calmed down and settled your emotions, and looked at the direction where the Elemental Forbidden Land was located.]
[Before, you were weak and didn’t know how strong the Demon Immortal in the Elemental Forbidden Land was or what level it was at. Now, you have completely understood the level of this Demon Immortal.]
[Like you, this Demon Immortal possesses a cultivation at the Quasi Fairy King-tier. However, because the Great Array that seals him is so powerful, his influence on the outer world is minimal.]
[On top of that, the Celestial Spirit Immortal King did not kill him out of respect for his father, who was also an Immortal King and indeed stronger than the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[However, now the Celestial Spirit Immortal King has long fallen, and the father of this Demon Immortal has also long perished. You don’t need to worry about dealing with him.]
[In other words, as long as you release and kill him, you will obtain a large amount of cultivation resources and have the hope of obtaining a Quasi-Immortal King artifact.]
[Thinking of this, you took a step and appeared in the Elemental Forbidden Land.]
[When you arrived at the Elemental Forbidden Land, the voice of the sealed Demon Immortal rang out, very wary and polite to you.]
[This attitude was completely different from when you had entered before. It could only be said that the change brought about by strength was so obvious, and you had already experienced it many times.]
[Next, you showed a smile, indicating that you wanted to make a deal with the Demon Immortal.]
[Your words surprised the Demon Immortal. He then became interested and asked what kind of deal you wanted to make with him.]
[You smiled slightly, stating that you could release him, but he needed to give you his quasi-Fairy Artifact and numerous resources on his person.]
[Your words caused the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal to have many thoughts and be quite tempted.]
[However, he was also worried about being deceived by you, so he said he was the son of an Immortal King, and if you dared to deceive him, his Immortal King father would definitely have you torn apart.]
[At the same time, the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal also demanded that you swear by your Tao Heart.]
[In response, you laughed and understood that the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal had been sealed for a long time and did not know that the Immortal Domain had been shattered and all the Immortal Kings were extinct. Otherwise, this Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal would not have tried to intimidate you with his Immortal King father.]
[That is to say, things are much easier to handle next, and the chances of an accident are much smaller.]
[Next, you agreed to the demand of Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal and swore directly with your Tao Heart.]
[After the oath, you asked the Demon Immortal to hand over the Quasi Immortal King instruments and numerous resources and fulfill his promise.]
[Seeing your oath, the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal laughed and said that he was sealed and could not take out the Quasi Immortal King instruments and numerous resources. Only by releasing him and breaking the seal could he fulfill his promise and give you the items.]
[Regarding the words of the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal, you were not surprised and did not waste words with him, but directly took action.]
[Although the seal in front of you was laid down by the Celestial Spirit Immortal King himself, the Celestial Spirit Immortal King was already dead, and the seal had been weakened over the years. With your current strength, you were able to shake this seal Great Array.]
[As a result, after spending a lot of time bombarding this sealing array, you finally broke it successfully and released the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal.]
[With the release of the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal, all his internal organs and limbs returned to their proper places, turning him into a normal black-haired man.]
[Moving his long-held body freely, the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal laughed loudly, proclaiming that he was finally free.]
[You looked calmly at the released Demon Immortal, stating that it was time for him to fulfill his promise and hand over the Quasi Immortal King instrument and the numerous cultivation resources.]
[However, when faced with your demand for a reward, the Quasi Fairy King-tier Demon Immortal feigned ignorance, clearly not wanting to give it.]</p

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - 1173 298 Facing the Second Generation Group
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1173: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_4 Chapter 1173: Chapter 298: Facing the Second Generation Group Leader! The Voice of Life and Death Realm!_4 [Regarding this, you are not surprised. After all, it is difficult for such a person to fulfill their promise. A Life-bound Quasi-Immortal King Artifact is so precious that even a normal Quasi Fairy King would not willingly hand it over.]
[Moreover, when you made an agreement with this guy, you didn’t make him swear an oath or anything. Of course, you think that such oaths are also useless. At the same time, the other party must be thinking of using his Immortal King father to deter you and believe that you would not dare to attack him.]
[In addition, in the eyes of this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal, you letting him go is equivalent to offending the Celestial Spirit Immortal King, which is like taking a dead-end path, and you should instead seek his protection.]
[Regarding this, you have no intention of wasting words with this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal and directly attack him with a punch, smashing his body to pieces.]
[Your combat power is so strong that this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal has just been released from the seal and is no longer at the peak state. Even if he were at the peak state, he could not withstand your punch.]
[As a result, his explosion from your punch is quite normal. However, you don’t have any intention of taking his life for now, lest you accidentally destroy the resources and suffer a huge loss.]
[After being hit and exploded by you, this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal is somewhat dumbfounded, but he quickly recovers, his face full of fear and intense anger, questioning your intentions and daring to attack him.]
[In the face of the questions from this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal, you sneer and say that since he is not fulfilling his promise, he should go to die. With your next punch, you won’t hold back.]
[During the conversation, your power rises to the extreme, startling this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal and making him realize that you are serious.]
[In other words, at this point, it would be suicidal for him to continue threatening you with his backstage connections.]
[Therefore, this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal curses you in his heart for being a madman who has no fear of an Immortal King.]
[However, although he curses you in his heart, he does not dare to show any abnormality on the surface, and instead puts on a smile, hastily explaining that it was just a joke earlier and not to be angry.]
[While saying these words, this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal directly takes out his Life-bound Quasi-Immortal King Artifact and many cultivation resources and hands them to you.]
[You glance at the items taken out by this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal, and find a large amount of Immortal Source, Immortal Herbs, and Immortal Artifacts, and can’t help but sigh at how rich this guy is. At this, you show a satisfied smile.]
[Seeing your satisfied smile, this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal also breathes a sigh of relief, feeling that you should not attack him again. After all, if you still dare to attack him under these circumstances, it would be a life-or-death confrontation with his backing forces.]
[However, what this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal did not expect was that you actually attacked him again, punching him to pieces once more, making it impossible for him to recover and about to fall completely.]
[This made the Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal very astonished and puzzled, not understanding why you dared to act so arrogantly.]
[Seeing this situation, you show an indifferent expression, sneering coldly and saying that the Immortal Domain has long been shattered, and your Immortal King father had already perished.]
[Hearing these words, this Quasi Fairy King Tier demonic immortal could hardly believe it and could not accept all of this. In the end, under such emotions, his Divine Soul completely dissipated, and he fell completely.]
[Afterwards, you casually dispose of the remains of this demonic immortal and leave this place to head to the next destination.]
[The next place you go to is the secret realm where the Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower is located.]
[Back then, you were not recognized by the Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower, and after your cultivation improved, you could no longer enter it. But now, things are different!]

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - 1174 299 The Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1174: Chapter 299: The Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower is chaotic! Alpha’s determination! Chapter 1174: Chapter 299: The Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower is chaotic! Alpha’s determination! [Now, you have reached the level of a Quasi Fairy King, and your combat power is unparalleled. You no longer need the permission of the Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower to forcefully enter it.]
…..
“Well, well, planning to break into the Tower of Celestial Spirit, are we?”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation with an odd expression on his face.
Although influenced by his will, Wang Ping in this simulation was indeed quite unrestrained, doing all sorts of things.
“However, although the Tower of Celestial Spirit is an Immortal King’s Artifact, it’s not much to Wang Ping now. Also, obtaining it wouldn’t significantly increase his combat power.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, making an evaluation.
An Immortal King’s Artifact can only unleash its great power in a cultivator’s hands, under the enhancement of the cultivator’s power. It can be helpful in a battle against the same realm, but without the support of a cultivator’s strength, it is unable to deal with Immortal King-tier beings and can at best deal with Quasi Fairy Kings. Most of the time, even killing them would be impossible.
Therefore, the simulated Wang Ping didn’t value the Tower of Celestial Spirit and forcibly subduing it was entirely possible.
However, even if he obtained the Tower of Celestial Spirit, it wouldn’t grant Wang Ping the power to challenge an Immortal King.
“Of course, once I become an Immortal King, using it for Paid Simulation would be a good choice.”
Wang Ping muttered again.
“Let’s forget about it. After all, the Celestial Spirit Immortal Tower has helped me in the life simulation, and both the Celestial Spirit Immortal King and his daughter Chu Lingyin have also been helpful. Sacrificing them directly would make me feel guilty.”
Subsequently, Wang Ping shook his head again, giving up on this idea.
As Wang Ping contemplated, the text simulation continued.
[Next, you arrived at the secret realm’s location, forcefully broke open the secret realm, and entered it. Upon your arrival, the Tower of Celestial Spirit awoke and was very wary of you.]
[In response, you smiled faintly and expressed your desire for the Tower of Celestial Spirit to submit to you. In that case, you could take it to see a more vast world.]
[Uninterested in your offer, the Tower of Celestial Spirit simply asked you to leave.]
[Seeing that the Tower of Celestial Spirit wasn’t aware of the situation, you sighed and apologized for offending it. Then, you decided to take action and suppress the Tower of Celestial Spirit.]
[This triggered the stress response of the Tower of Celestial Spirit, causing it to resist fiercely. It must be said that Immortal King’s Artifacts are quite formidable. Even relying solely on their power, they can defeat many Quasi Fairy Kings.]
[However, this does not include you. Your combat power surpasses those of other Quasi Fairy Kings.]
[Nevertheless, the more you suppressed it, the more the Tower of Celestial Spirit rebelled, giving you a headache. After thinking about it, you chose to use the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill.]
[As you used the Celestial Spirit Immortal Skill, the resistance of the Tower of Celestial Spirit weakened, and it was surprised to ask why you could use this skill. In response, you laughed and explained that you had accidentally received the inheritance of the Celestial Spirit Immortal King.]
[Your answer rendered the Tower of Celestial Spirit speechless. After thinking for a long time, it said it would give you a chance: if you could pass its test of your mindset, it would become your Immortal Artifact.]
[This proposition caused you to frown. You coldly asked if the Tower of Celestial Spirit was insulting you. No one who could become a Quasi Fairy King was weak, let alone qualified to test you.]
[Hearing this, the Tower of Celestial Spirit was somewhat angry but couldn’t refute your words. After all, you made sense. However, as an Immortal King’s Artifact, it followed the rules and had its own dignity. So, it indifferently stated that if you didn’t want to take the trial, it wouldn’t acknowledge you as its master.]
[At this, you were speechless. This Tower of Celestial Spirit was truly stubborn. Then, you sighed and said that it only wanted to select and cultivate talents through trials. However, now that you, a monstrous genius who reached the Quasi Fairy King Tier in less than a hundred years, had appeared, the Tower of Celestial Spirit was still so inflexible. Telling this would cause the Celestial Spirit Immortal King much embarrassment.]
[Your words stunned the Tower of Celestial Spirit. It incredulously asked if you were not even a hundred years old.]
[After asking this, the Tower of Celestial Spirit mocked you, saying it was impossible for you to become a Quasi Fairy King, let alone a Great Emperor, at such a young age. Were you trying to deceive it like a naive child?]
[Seeing that the Tower of Celestial Spirit didn’t believe you, you laughed and revealed your Life Origin. With the display of your Life Origin, the Tower of Celestial Spirit went silent. It could tell that you were indeed less than a hundred years old, specifically just over thirty-seven years old.]
[This truly stunned the Tower of Celestial Spirit. How could someone reach the Quasi Fairy King Tier at the age of thirty-seven? Even if an Immortal King Giant started over, such a cultivation speed would be impossible. Not even beings above Immortal Kings could achieve this.]
[Even for an Immortal King to pass down their techniques, it would take millions of years to raise someone’s cultivation to this level.]
[While the Tower of Celestial Spirit doubted its own existence, you spoke calmly, asking whether it wanted to acknowledge you as its master. If it refused, you were fine with it. You didn’t like forcing others. Besides, an Immortal King’s Artifact was nothing special to you, especially since you would become an Immortal King yourself soon.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - 1175 299 The Immortal Tower of the Night
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1175: Chapter 299: The Immortal Tower of the Night Spirit is in Trouble! Alpha’s Determination! _2 Chapter 1175: Chapter 299: The Immortal Tower of the Night Spirit is in Trouble! Alpha’s Determination! _2 [Your words shocked the Tower of Celestial Spirit into silence, leaving it feeling rather complicated. However, it managed to control its emotions and brazenly decided to recognize you as its new master.]
[You were quite delighted by this and accepted the Tower of Celestial Spirit as your own. After doing so, you leisurely admitted that your cultivation was won in a wager at Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Upon hearing this, a herd of metaphorical horses seemed to stampede through the Tower of Celestial Spirit’s heart, causing it to regret its actions immensely. Unfortunately, it completely forgot about the existence of Myriad Heavens Paradise. It realized it was very possible for someone of your age to reach such an astonishing level of cultivation in such a place, meaning that it was tricked!]
[Just as the Tower of Celestial Spirit was churning with regret, you casually admitted that you were only pulling its leg. Your power indeed came from your own cultivation, otherwise, it wouldn’t be so complete and solid.]
[The Tower of Celestial Spirit fell into silence, feeling somewhat drained, no longer wanting to deal with you. It finally realized that its new master, namely you, is rather dark-hearted and likes to play around with beings like itself.]
[Seeing the Tower of Celestial Spirit bullied into silence, you chuckled to yourself, finding it merrily satisfying. After all, there was a time when the Tower of Celestial Spirit used to pose as aloof and indifferent towards you, so this was a bit of a payback and training for it.]
…….
“Uh… The simulation of Wang Ping taming the Tower of Celestial Spirit is slightly mischievous.”
Wang Ping looked at the text within the simulated content, his gaze slightly odd.
“However, the process of taming the Tower of Celestial Spirit is truly impressive. Regardless of where, a quasi-Immortal King around 37 years old is absolutely stunning.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but muse, continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen.
Next, one would expect to journey into the Immortal Domain.
The simulated Wang Ping, with his formidable strength, must experience some changes after entering the Immortal Domain….perhaps even becoming an Immortal King?
As Wang Ping was contemplating these possibilities, more text appeared on the luminescent screen.
[Up next, you didn’t bother with idle chit-chat and directly opened the Immortal Domain Channel, entering within. Upon reaching the depths of the Immortal Domain Channel, you encounter Lu Daoxian.]
[When Lu Daoxian saw you, his initially dull eyes abruptly narrowed and his face expressed shock.]
[It couldn’t be helped, your emergence was too shocking. The appearance of a quasi-Immortal King in the lower realm was absolutely outrageous. There is no chance of you being from the lower realm of the Immortal Domain. While there are indeed sealed quasi-Immortal Kings in the lower realm, there are absolutely none like you.]
[In other words, you were most likely a quasi-Immortal King born in the lower realm. However, that’s impossible, as the lower realm doesn’t have the conditions necessary for birthing a quasi-Immortal King.]
[When Lu Daoxian was stunned, you coyly smirked and confirmed that you indeed are a quasi-Immortal King born in the lower realm, possessing a Chaotic Body. You hoped that Lu Daoxian would let you pass and allow you to proceed into the Immortal Domain.]
[Your words left Lu Daoxian momentarily astounded and even more shocked. Afterward, he silently revealed the conditions of the Immortal Domain and instructed you to search for Chu Lingyin.]
[You chuckled at this, expressing you would do as Lu Daoxian instructed, but you had one request.]
[Lu Daoxian was somewhat surprised, promising to help if he was capable of doing so. In his view, the Immortal Domain greatly needed the presence of a being like you. If you could become an Immortal King, you would undoubtedly be able to lead the beings of the Immortal Domain to continue surviving, no longer having to hide and flee.]
[Hearing Lu Daoxian’s words, you nodded in satisfaction, asking Lu Daoxian to hand over his quasi-Fairy King artifact.]
[At your words, a hint of hesitation clouded Lu Daoxian’s expression. After all, his Life-bound Quasi-Immortal King Artifact had accompanied him for many years and couldn’t be given away so easily. But considering his earlier declaration, refusing to give it would seem somewhat inappropriate.]
[Seeing Lu Daoxian’s hesitation, you chuckled and mentioned that you were merely joking, and he shouldn’t be too concerned.]
[Hearing your words, Lu Daoxian was now in an even more awkward position. In the end, he bit the bullet and handed you his quasi-Immortal King Artifact.]
[At this, you seemed a bit surprised, having not anticipated Lu Daoxian’s generosity that even his quasi-Immortal King Artifact could be given away.]
[Immediately, you gave Lu Daoxian’s shoulder a reassuring pat, stressing that you were merely jesting and he shouldn’t take it too seriously. If it were in the real world, the original Wang Ping would consider these matters, but this is a simulation, and to you, Lu Daoxian’s quasi-Fairy King instrument doesn’t hold much value.]
[For this reason, you, of course, would not snatch someone else’s treasure, and decide not to take Lu Daoxian’s quasi-Fairy King instrument. In the end, a life-bound immortal artifact is akin to the offspring of a cultivator, perhaps even closer than that.]
[Hearing your words, Lu Daoxian sighed in relief and dropped the subject. Subsequently, he cleared the way for you to head to the Immortal Domain.]
[Without dawdling, you decided to step right into the Immortal Domain.]
[Upon arriving in the Immortal Domain, you immediately found Chu Lingyin. Your arrival greatly surprised and delighted Chu Lingyin.]
[After all, the arrival of another quasi-Immortal King, especially a powerful one, is good news for the Immortal Domain.]
[For this reason, Chu Lingyin warmly welcomed you. As she did, the Tower of Celestial Spirit appeared to catch up with Chu Lingyin.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - 1176 299 The Immortal Tower of the Night
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1176: Chapter 299: The Immortal Tower of the Night Spirit is in Trouble! Alpha’s Determination! _3 Chapter 1176: Chapter 299: The Immortal Tower of the Night Spirit is in Trouble! Alpha’s Determination! _3 [Chu Lingyin looked at the Tower of Celestial Spirit with mixed feelings. After all, it was something left behind by her father, and she hadn’t seen it for many years.]
[You didn’t prevent her from reminiscing about the tower and left gracefully.]
[After Chu Lingyin and the Tower of Celestial Spirit had their reunion, you found her again, asking if she has a way to help you quickly breakthrough to the Immortal King realm.]
[At this question, Chu Lingyin bitter smiled, saying that there was no such method. Becoming an Immortal King is very difficult. In the entire world, opportunities that can help quasi Fairy Kings breakthrough to Immortal King-tier are so rare that they might not appear even once in an era.]
[It is precisely because of this that the number of Immortal Kings is so scarce.]
[Hearing this, you were somewhat helpless, but not surprised by this outcome. Becoming an Immortal King is indeed difficult. Not only is it difficult to become an Immortal King in this shattered Immortal Domain, but even in a complete Immortal Domain, it is still extremely difficult.]
[So, you began to worry. If you cannot become an Immortal King, then you can only hide from the Demon Clan forever. If you expose yourself recklessly, the Demon Clan will certainly target you once they discover your existence.]
[In other words, if it comes to that situation, you would most likely die without a doubt. That’s because your cultivation and combat power are enough to attract the attention of the Flame Demon King, who will probably take action personally to eliminate you.]
[Facing a Demon King-tier existence, you have no chance of victory. Even if you have the 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery, it would not guarantee your escape.]
[After all, a 5-digit Talent is useless in front of a 4-digit existence, as it can be easily intercepted.]
[You thought about it for a long time and came up with a compromise plan – to first try to comprehend the chaotic Immortal King’s path and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra.]
[If you have these two configurations, along with the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter, you might have a chance to fight against the Demon King of the Demon Clan.]
[Of course, since the Demon Clan is not evil and only has a different Cultivation System from Immortal Domain, you cannot be sure whether the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter will have the same effect as dealing with Dark Beings.]
[However, determining this issue is simple – just test it on a member of the Demon Clan.]
[Thinking of this, you tried your hand directly. However, the result disappointed you because you failed to trigger the effect of 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter on the Demon Clan member you captured.]
[Next, you asked Chu Lingyin if Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang left behind any inheritance, and if so, where was his land of inheritance.]
[At your words, Chu Lingyin fell silent. Eventually, she said that the death of Chaos Immortal King Ye Cang was too abrupt and unexpected, and the entire doctrine was erased, making it very unlikely that he left any inheritance. Moreover, the entire Immortal Domain had also been shattered, with many inheritances lost in the process.]
[Upon hearing this answer, you were very disappointed, but it was also within your expectations. It can only be said that the predecessor of the First Generation Chat Group was ruthless.]
[In the end, you could only abandon the idea of using external forces and try to enlighten yourself on the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra and the Chaotic Immortal King’s path with the passage of time.]
[In the blink of an eye, a hundred thousand years had passed. The Quasi-Demon Kings of the Flame Demon Clan arrived as scheduled, and began to besiege Chu Lingyin.]
[However, this time you didn’t plan to flee directly; instead, you chose to fight back forcefully, defeating the four_QUESPACE_Quasi-Demon Kings of the Flame Demon Clan one by one swiftly. Under your incredible combat strength, Quasi-Demon Kings were no match for you and could be defeated with just a single punch. If one punch couldn’t kill them, then you simply punched them again.]
[After killing the four Quasi-Demon Kings of the Flame Demon Clan, you knew very well that you would be targeted by the Flame Demon King next. So without hesitation, after collecting the spoils of war, you used the talent effect of 5-Digit Talent·Fixed Point Transmission to move you and Chu Lingyin to an_unknown_b_WORLD.]
[That’s right, you did not plan to go to the Sword Immortal World because another_dark_b_disaster would inevitably break out there, only allowing you to live for a little while longer. However, it would still be impossible for you to make progress during that short period.]
[Although you also guessed that other worlds might also be hit by a dark disaster, you can’t worry about everything. Now, all you hope is that you would be lucky enough to transfer to a world similar to a complete Immortal Domain. Only then would you be able to save a lot of time and break through to the Immortal King-tier level.]
[However, this transfer obviously did not achieve the result you wanted. You did successfully transfer to a world with an Immortal King, but this world was also relatively scarce in resources, and there was only one Immortal King. Furthermore, this Immortal King had a domineering personality and controlled this world.]
[As a result, as soon as you arrived in this world, this Immortal King discovered you and relentlessly tried to subdue both of you by asking you to open your Sea of Consciousness, let him plant a servant’s imprint on you, and then submit to him completely.]
[Naturally, you would not agree to such an unreasonable demand. Thus, you and Chu Lingyin joined forces to attack this Immortal King.]
[However, the two of you were only at the Quasi-Fairy King level and were too weak against the Immortal King, who easily killed both of you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - 1177 299 The Night Spirit Immortal Tower is
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1177: Chapter 299 The Night Spirit Immortal Tower is paralyzed! Alpha’s Determination! _4 Chapter 1177: Chapter 299 The Night Spirit Immortal Tower is paralyzed! Alpha’s Determination! _4 “[Your downfall means the end of this simulation…]”
…
“I still died, huh. But this free simulation provided me with a lot of information, so it was worthwhile.”
Wang Ping thought to himself as he looked at the conclusion of the text simulation.
“There seems to be no point in continuing to simulate. The text simulation can’t produce specific memory images. Even if I’m teleported to a great world, I can’t go there, nor can I go in the next simulation.”
“In other words, I’m stuck again. Next, I need to enhance my Life Simulator talent, and then break through by using strong four-digit skills.”
Then, Wang Ping shook his head, collected his thoughts, and planned to go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Wang Ping has never been an indecisive person. When he decided to go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he communicated with his Paradise Pass and opened the path to it.
Then, Wang Ping took a step forward, entering it.
Quickly, the scene before Wang Ping’s eyes shifted, and he appeared in Alpha’s Book Repository.
“I’m back. Even though it’s only been a little more than a month, it still feels like it’s been a long time.”
Looking at the familiar Book Repository, Wang Ping chuckled.
Then, he took another step, his figure disappeared, and he left the place.
The next moment, Wang Ping appeared in the hall and walked over to Alpha.
“Wang Ping, you’re back.”
Seeing Wang Ping, Alpha’s mood was complex.
Indeed, Wang Ping’s Golden Finger was really incredible. In such a short period of time, he had far surpassed her.
Wang Ping’s Golden Finger was practically made for conquering the Sky Tower.
There were talents in the Myriad Heavens Paradise that could predict the future, but the Sky Tower was unique. The ordinary future-predicting talents were not safe and could be influenced.
If there was an intelligence bias, the consequences would be severe.
Wang Ping’s Life Simulator might not be affected by the Sky Tower Game.
Frankly, Alpha didn’t understand the essence of Wang Ping’s talent.
“Yes, I am back.”
Wang Ping replied casually, found a spot, and sat down.
“Alpha, aren’t you a machine? You actually drink black tea?”
Then, Wang Ping glanced at Alpha, who was brewing tea, and teased her.
“Who said machines can’t drink black tea?”
Alpha paused briefly, then spoke lightly.
“Hehe, whatever makes you happy.”
Wang Ping laughed and chose not to continue the topic.
“Congratulations on becoming a Quasi Fairy King. Now you need to go through the Sky Tower again before you can attempt to steal four-digit Rule Stones.”
Alpha paused briefly, then began to discuss the matter at hand.
“As for the Sky Tower Game, I do have confidence. I just don’t know if this round of the game can present me with the Rule Stone.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke.
“The second Floor will not provide four-digit items.”
Alpha replied calmly.
“So, the probability of you getting a four-digit Rule Stone is quite low.”
“Alpha, from the sound of it, you have a solution? Has your master appeared?”
Wang Ping glanced at Alpha, his expression curious.
“I am not aware of the whereabouts of my master. However, I indeed know of a way that you can obtain a four-digit Rule Stone.”
After a pause, Alpha spoke again.
“What’s the method?”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, sounding curious.
“You can choose to leave the Transmigrator Chat Group and join a powerful power with three-digit skills. With your talents, it shouldn’t be difficult to gain their regard.”
Alpha sighed, her expression complex.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178 - 1178 300 Two-digit Number Heaven Tower Second
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1178: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor! Chapter 1178: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor! “What’s up, are you trying to drive me away?”
Wang Ping was taken aback, showing a surprised expression.
“Or are you afraid I’ll take you apart?”
After a moment, Wang Ping spoke again in a joking tone.
“I’m not afraid of you taking me apart, with your character, you wouldn’t do that.”
Alpha was very calm, not caring about Wang Ping’s teasing.
“I just think that staying with me will only hinder your development.”
After a moment, Alpha spoke again.
“Eh, Alfa, I’m surprised and touched that you would say such a thing.”
Wang Ping laughed and continued to tease Alpha.
“I’m seriously talking to you about this, don’t joke around anymore.”
Alpha furrowed his brows and spoke with some annoyance.
Wang Ping smiled awkwardly and then became serious. “Alpha, I’m a sentimental person and I don’t like moving nests, so after leaving the chat group, I’d rather not join other forces.”
“As for the four-digit Rule Stone, I can get it by going through the tower. If the second floor doesn’t work, then the third floor, until I get the reward. If that doesn’t work, I can go to those special regional games.”
“Why do you have to do this, when there’s a safer way, you choose the dangerous one.”
Alpha was silent for a while, then sighed.
“Safe? Is joining other forces really safe? I don’t think it’s that safe. And besides, going through the Heaven Tower is something I have to do sooner or later. Now, it’s just a matter of getting the four-digit Rule Stone along the way.”
Wang Ping shook his head and spoke calmly.
No matter if Wang Ping wanted to go through the tower or not, the person behind him would force him to do so, and they would also choose the Abyss mode.
This was his inevitable fate.
So, Wang Ping didn’t resist going through the tower.
“…”
Wang Ping’s words rendered Alpha silent.
“Since you’ve made up your mind, I won’t persuade you anymore.”
At last, Alpha spoke with mixed emotions.
“But, you’ve become much stronger than me, and you will become even stronger, so I should give up the position of chat group owner.”
“Chat group owner?” Wang Ping looked at Alpha with a strange expression and said, “I hate trouble the most, and if you give it to me, I’ll just be a laissez-faire boss.”
“You can be a laissez-faire boss, and I can continue to manage the chat group.”
Alpha said quietly.
“It seems that I have no choice but to take on the role of group owner, right?”
Wang Ping rolled his eyes and complained.
“Don’t despise it. Although there’s not much profit, there is at least some.”
It seemed that Alpha thought Wang Ping despised the lack of profit, and silently said this sentence.
“No, I’m not despising the lack of profit, just purely hating trouble. But since it’s just like being a hands-off boss in the Taiyi Imperial Palace, I suppose I can accept it.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and smiled.
It was not bad for him to be the group owner of the Third Generation Traveler Chat Group, just like the First and Second Generation chat groups, where the group owner was the strongest person.
“Wait, after the First Generation Chat Group was destroyed, that predecessor transmigrator didn’t establish a new chat group, right?”
Wang Ping thought of the First Generation and muttered.
“He didn’t create a group, but he also has his own forces.”
Alpha quietly said.
“Do you know what that predecessor transmigrator did in the Myriad Heavens Paradise? What kind of force did he establish?”
Wang Ping asked with interest.
“Chenwang Palace.”
Alpha hesitated for three seconds, then silently uttered these three words.
“Chenwang Palace!?”
Wang Ping, who had been leisurely drinking tea, almost spat it out upon hearing these three words.
Wang Ping had reached the level of a Quasi-Fairy King, which put him at the five-digit limit in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
However, these three words shocked Wang Ping so much that he couldn’t even control the tea in his mouth. You could imagine the extent of his astonishment.
Yet, it was not Wang Ping’s fault, it was just that the name Chenwang Palace was too terrifying in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
After all, it was a two-digit level force, and there were only thirty-six two-digit forces in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. Excluding those who didn’t create forces, there were only twenty such forces in the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise.
In other words, this was one of the top twenty strongest forces.
That also meant that their predecessor transmigrator was now a two-digit level existence.
There were only 36 two-digit existences in the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise…
“Hiss…”
Wang Ping took a deep breath, feeling the hair on his scalp standing on end.
Although he had known about the horror of that predecessor transmigrator from Alpha’s words, and Alpha had always warned him not to think about that predecessor transmigrator’s affairs, Wang Ping never thought that the predecessor transmigrator would be so terrifying.
“Alpha, no wonder that predecessor transmigrator won’t target you like the Second Generation Chat Group Leader Dao Yi. Because you’re too weak, and he’s too strong. There’s really no need for him to do so.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
Alpha: “…”
Alpha was a little upset.
Although what Wang Ping was saying was true, it was too direct for Alpha. Didn’t he have any face?
