“It’s his vision, not about strength.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1179 - 1179 300 Two-digit Number Heaven Tower Second
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1179: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_2 Chapter 1179: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_2 Alpha couldn’t help but argue.
“Yes, yes, that predecessor transmigrator has a great vision. Frankly, the first-generation predecessor transmigrators who are still alive today indeed have a high vision, let alone the one who has reached double-digits.”
Wang Ping was filled with emotion.
Truthfully, Wang Ping now genuinely admired that predecessor transmigrator from the bottom of his heart.
After all, that person’s starting point wasn’t as good as Wang Ping’s. According to Alpha, he didn’t even have a golden finger at first.
That means, he didn’t even have awakened talents and started completely bare. Perhaps his talents awakened later on.
As for the backing he had, it most likely wasn’t as strong as Wang Ping’s. There’s even a high probability that he didn’t have any backing when he started.
However, Wang Ping’s support might actually come from that double-digit predecessor transmigrator.
If that person had been scheming all of this behind the scenes, then it would make perfect sense.
After all, a double-digit being has terrifying means and can accomplish many inconceivable things.
Of course, Wang Ping wasn’t entirely certain that it was that predecessor transmigrator who was calculating against him.
He could only say that the probability had increased to 80%.
“I just don’t know what his intentions are and why he’s scheming against me through such a long passage of time.”
Wang Ping’s heart couldn’t be calm.
After all, Leng Yue had been waiting for him since the last epoch.
That is to say, that predecessor transmigrator saw Wang Ping’s existence at least a hundred million years ago and then started to set up a grand game.
“I don’t understand, I don’t understand. But, I can’t possibly figure out the plans of that double-digit predecessor transmigrator no matter how much I think. Perhaps, only when I reach the three-digit or even two-digit realm can I finally face him and learn his intentions.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
However, by that time, it would still be uncertain whether Wang Ping would be alive or dead.
“Alpha, did that predecessor transmigrator really not take any of the first-generation transmigrators with him?”
After Wang Ping collected his thoughts, he asked another question.
“He looked down on most people in the First Generation Traveler Chat Group and didn’t care for them. So after dismantling me, he didn’t create another chat group to bring those group members back. However, he did take some people away with him. These people are now all well-known big shots. It’s just that in Myriad Heavens Paradise, these people generally use aliases or pseudonyms.”
Alpha explained quietly.
“It’s very likely that Leng Yue is also from Chenwang Palace. It’s just that before so much happened to you, I thought Leng Yue was one of those who were abandoned.”
In the end, Alpha sighed.
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
It seems he will encounter Leng Yue again in the future.
After staying in the Upper Realm for more than a hundred million years, Leng Yue’s contributions have been tremendous, so there must be many rewards after returning to Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Maybe, by the time they meet again, Leng Yue’s strength will have greatly improved.
“Forget it, there’s no point in thinking too much. Continuing to grow stronger is the right way.”
Wang Ping shook his head and stopped thinking about it.
“Alpha, how about the Second Generation Chat Group Leader Dao Yi, has he been bothering you recently?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked about another matter.
Not long ago, Wang Ping made a huge uproar in the Upper Realm and directly issued a war challenge.
Under such circumstances, it’s highly likely that the second-generation chat group owner Dao Yi would find trouble with Alpha, given his personality.
In fact, Wang Ping would even suspect that Dao Yi would spare no effort to find the Demon King to attack Alpha and him.
“In the city, he can’t harm me unless both parties start a game. The only thing he can do is have someone do disgusting things at my doorstep. However, he won’t do such boring and disgraceful things.”
Alpha shook his head and said.
“No action? No action is the biggest anomaly. Maybe, the day we fight to the death isn’t far away.”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and said.
“Alpha, time is pressing, I need to go challenge the tower. Only by obtaining more powerful special items can I have the confidence to deal with him. Otherwise, with my current cards, facing him would be very dangerous.”
In Wang Ping’s view, second-generation chat group owner Dao Yi isn’t easy to deal with.
Perhaps, that guy isn’t stronger than him in terms of pure combat power.
But in Myriad Heavens Paradise, fights never depend on the power gap between both parties, but rather on whose cards are more numerous and whose strategy is superior.
Now, although Wang Ping’s combat power has increased, he doesn’t have many five-digit level items, and there isn’t any 5-digit Talent that can assist him in battle.
Although the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter can enhance full attributes, it only works against Dark Beings.
That is to say, it can’t help him deal with the cunning second-generation chat group owner Dao Yi.
After all, Dao Yi can’t be considered a Dark Being.
Compared to his shortage of cards, the number of cards Dao Yi can come up with after being in the five-digit realm for so many years and being known as Cunning Card is a complete unknown.
As a result, Wang Ping doesn’t have the confidence to deal with Dao Yi right now. If the two sides were to engage in a big fight, Wang Ping’s win rate wouldn’t exceed 30%.

chapters.title: Chapter 1180 - 1180 300 Two-digit Number Heaven Tower Second
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1180: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_3 Chapter 1180: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_3 As a result, Wang Ping had to immediately challenge the tower, even repeatedly, to accumulate enough cards.
“Hmm, you go ahead. But don’t overdo it. You are my only hope for survival. If you die in the Sky Tower, I don’t think it’ll be long before Dao Yi sends me to my grave.” Alpha nodded, her expression turning serious as well.
Wang Ping looked at Alpha, went over and patted her shoulder, smiling: “Don’t worry, I’ll be back soon.”
After saying that, Wang Ping took out the Paradise Pass and communicated with it through his thoughts.
Then, Wang Ping appeared in the familiar private space of Sky Tower.
Suddenly, a familiar luminescent screen appeared in front of Wang Ping.
Heaven Tower’s voice then rang out.
“Ding, detected player Tianyan has returned from outside the Paradise. You must participate in a Sky Tower game within three days. Would you like to start the game now?”
“Start the game immediately.”
Wang Ping let out a small breath, his voice heavy.
“Ding, detected Player·Tianyan has cleared the first floor of the Sky Tower. You will now proceed to the game at the second floor of Heaven’s Tower. Please choose the difficulty level.”
The intelligent voice of Sky Tower rang out again.
“Only abyss mode again?”
Wang Ping looked at the displayed game difficulty on the luminescent screen, feeling speechless.
It was totally unreasonable, not giving him a fair opportunity to choose carefully.
“I choose abyss mode.”
Wang Ping sighed, having no choice but to make a decision.
“Ding, congratulations Player·Tianyan for choosing abyss mode. The game map is Menggui Street. Please prepare yourself within the next ten minutes. After ten minutes, you will be teleported to the game world·Menggui Street.”
Once again, the agile voice of Sky Tower Intelligence rang out.
“Tch, Meng Gui Street huh, just from the name it doesn’t sound like a good place, could it be related to something eerie?”
Hearing the name, Wang Ping couldn’t help but frown.
Nevermind, it’s just eerie. I have plenty of experience dealing with that. As long as I’m careful, I should be able to survive.
Of course, although Wang Ping was thinking that in his heart, the psychological pressure on him was still quite heavy.
After all, even though Wang Ping had experience, the Sky Tower game and the outer world were different.
Inside the Sky Tower game, he didn’t have any Mana to protect himself, thereby attaining insulation from the outer world.
At the same time, he no longer had that world-destroying power.
Although his panel attributes were much stronger than other players because of completing the first floor of the Sky Tower game, panel attributes weren’t the most important factor when dealing with supernatural beings.
“Whatever, let’s face them as they come. If I can’t clear it with my current setup, I’ll be a complete waste.”
Wang Ping sighed secretly, calming himself down.
With several times the panel properties of other players, coupled with text simulation capabilities, if he couldn’t pass, he would truly be useless.
At the same time, if he couldn’t pass, other players wouldn’t need to live either.
As Wang Ping closed his eyes to rest, the ten minutes quickly passed by, and he was enveloped in white light and teleported to the game world.
When Wang Ping opened his eyes, he saw a gloomy street before him.
Next to Wang Ping, two men and two women also opened their eyes one after the other.
At first, the four of them looked at the gloomy street in front with wary faces, then turned to one another with the same caution in their eyes, distancing themselves from each other.
In the Sky Tower game, no one is a trustworthy teammate; you can only rely on yourself to clear the stage.
Let alone temporary players, even teammates who entered the game together couldn’t trust each other too easily.
Many players in Myriad Heavens Paradise would do anything to clear the game, raising their ratings and obtaining special items.
Among the five, only Wang Ping remained relatively calm, just giving the other four a quick glance without saying much.
At this moment, Sky Tower Intelligence’s agile voice rang out again.
“Ding, the game will officially begin in thirty minutes. Players can recite the mission details in their hearts to obtain basic information and related tasks for the game world.”
Following the voice, the other four players, after distancing themselves, began silently reciting the mission details in their hearts.
Wang Ping likewise recited them in his mind.
Soon, he received the basic information and related tasks for the game world·Menggui Street in his mind.
The background of this game world was mainly Menggui Street, a gloomy street with no other maps.
In Meng Gui Street, there were ten shops.
In each of the ten shops, there was a supernatural being.
And, the players’ task was simple.
To obtain four eerie coins.
Each supernatural being in the shops had one eerie coin, meaning players needed to randomly enter four shops, taking the coin from the supernatural beings.
As long as they obtained the four eerie coins, they could leave the game world 24 hours later and successfully pass the game, obtaining basic rewards and rankings accordingly.
If they failed to get the four coins within 24 hours, they would be considered failures and be erased from the game.
If they wanted to improve their ranking, they would need to obtain more eerie coins.

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - 1181 300 Two-digit Number Heaven Tower Second
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1181: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_4 Chapter 1181: Chapter 300: Two-digit Number! Heaven Tower Second Floor!_4 “Four eerie coins, this is really challenging.”
Wang Ping squinted his eyes, his heart stirring with waves.
Strange creatures, so hard to deal with.
But, they have to kill four strange creatures before they can pass….
Not only that, this game clearly encourages players to kill each other.
After all, there are only ten strange creatures and ten eerie coins.
However, there are five players participating in this game.
This, there’s not enough to go around.
That is to say, at most, only two players can pass the game and get the basic evaluation.
This, even in the best-case scenario.
Normally, the players who can pass the game certainly want to get more eerie coins and improve their ranking.
That is to say, the other players are all enemies.
“As expected of the abyss difficulty tower game, it’s so dangerous.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
“This is only the second floor, it’s hard to imagine how difficult the floors above must be.”
As Wang Ping sighed in his heart, the faces of the other four players turned sour.
Their eyes, looking at each other, became more and more cautious, even hostility emerged.
But, no one had the idea to directly kill.
After all, they don’t know what tricks the other players have up their sleeves. If they make the first move and expose themselves, it might bring them disaster.
Not to mention, killing now will not maximize their benefits.
Theoretically, the most beneficial scenario for everyone is to pass two strange games each, earning two eerie coins, and then fight each other to decide the ultimate winner.
Of course, this is just the theoretical best-case scenario.
Everyone knows how dangerous and difficult it is to deal with strange creatures.
Strange creatures have a high growth potential and can affect beings beyond their own level.
When they were in the outer world, they could rely on their strength to gain an advantage when dealing with low-level strange creatures.
But, in the Sky Tower Game, they don’t have their powers, only mortal bodies.
As a result, they don’t have the confidence to deal with strange creatures, let alone kill ten of them, which is as difficult as ascending to heaven.
Maybe they don’t even need to fight, other players might die in the strange game.
“I think we should cooperate first, deal with the strange creatures together, what do you all think?”
Wang Ping looked at the other four people, smiled slightly, and said.
In the last Sky Tower Game on the 1st Floor, the players didn’t cooperate very well.
But in Wang Ping’s life simulation, these players still played a role.
So, Wang Ping proposed cooperation at this time.
However, Wang Ping didn’t expect them to cooperate, nor would he reveal his talent. His main purpose was to send a signal to this group of people.
Then, he could make better moves in the life simulation.
“Cooperate? No way.”
Upon hearing this, one male player glanced at Wang Ping and snorted derisively.
“There’s indeed no need to cooperate. Unless, one of you can kill a strange creature, only then can we talk about cooperating.”
One of the women with a somewhat cold expression also spoke up.
The other two didn’t say anything, but their intentions couldn’t be more obvious.
“It seems that cooperation is out of the question. Well, you all can choose a shop to enter first. I’m a gentleman and like to give way to others.”
Wang Ping shook his head, looking somewhat disappointed, and continued speaking.
“Heh, are you staying outside alone, waiting for us to kill the strange creatures and then hunt us?”
The man who spoke before said mockingly.
In this situation, everyone knows that after entering, whoever goes in first might be targeted.
After all, when dealing with strange creatures, no one can guarantee they won’t be injured.
If someone stays outside waiting for them to kill the strange creatures and come out, they’re in danger.
No one who dares to enter the abyss mode of the second floor of Heaven Tower is a fool.
“Either we go in together, or if someone doesn’t go in, we’ll work together to kill them first.”
The cold-faced woman looked at Wang Ping and spoke again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - 1182 301 The Invisible Man The Familiar
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1182: Chapter 301: The Invisible Man! The Familiar Bizarre Chapter 1182: Chapter 301: The Invisible Man! The Familiar Bizarre “Hehe, might as well go in together, I don’t really care.”
Wang Ping laughed and didn’t say anything more.
Seeing Wang Ping say that, the cold woman also stopped talking and quietly waited for the game to begin.
The others also had flickering gazes, looking at Meng Gui Street, not knowing what they were calculating.
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t want to waste any more time, so he turned his back and said in his heart, “System, I want to start the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice sounded.
Then, in front of Wang Ping, a familiar luminescent screen appeared, which only he could see, and the familiar text emerged.
[You quietly wait for the game to begin, and when the game officially starts, you and the other four players all take action, each choosing a store and entering it. You walk into a store, and it turns out to be the First Store.]
[As you enter the store, the door suddenly closes. At this, you frown and try to open it, but find it completely impossible to do so.]
[Just then, a deep blue flame lights up, illuminating the interior of the store, and a gloomy voice resounds, telling you not to bother with these futile efforts. Once you enter, you can’t leave. The only way to leave is to complete his strange game and win Ghost coins from his hands.]
[Hearing this, you narrow your eyes and look at this weirdly dressed figure. You then take action, directly summoning the Rod of Holy Light and shining it at the strange figure.]
[However, in the face of the holy light shining from the Rod, the strange figure remains indifferent. Moreover, he reveals an even more mocking expression, telling you not to waste your effort. Since there are game rules, any items you use won’t hurt him. Only by passing the strange game can you get the Ghost coins and survive.]
[As for the strange figure’s words, you ignore them, instead planting your foot firmly on the ground. With ten times the physical strength of an ordinary person, you burst out with terrifying speed, punching the strange figure’s head fiercely.]
[However, when your fist lands on the strange figure’s head, it passes straight through without causing any harm.]
[Seeing this, you frown, and in your heart, you now believe seventy percent of what the strange figure said.]
[As you frown, the strange figure becomes even more mocking, saying that you’re a real idiot and can’t understand what he’s saying. He already said it’s useless, yet you still insist on making a fool of yourself here.]
[Ignoring the strange figure’s mockery, your expression turns calm, and you casually ask what the strange figure’s name is, what the game is about, and how it starts.]
[At that, the strange figure grins, revealing an evil smile, and says you can call him “Transparent Weirdo.” The strange game here is called Half-Past Ten. In other words, he’s the house, and as long as your final score is higher than his, you win.]
[Hearing the game’s content, you narrow your eyes, not expecting this strange game to be like this. However, though surprised, you understand in your heart that the game must not be that simple, and there must be hidden rules.]
[Next, you ask about the game rules. The strange figure has no intention of hiding them, nor can he conceal the rules.]
[He explains that in Half-Past Ten, he acts as the dealer, dealing cards. After the first card is dealt, if you think your score is low, you can ask for more cards until you don’t want any more. The final result is whoever has the highest score wins. However, if you exceed ten and a half in the process of asking for cards, you lose immediately.]
[If both players’ card values are the same, the player with fewer cards wins. If the number of cards held by both is the same, the player with the highest card wins. If the highest cards are also the same, then look at the suit: Spades are the highest, and so on.]
[Besides, face cards count as half a point. However, although Ten and a Half is the largest, if you draw five face cards, it’s the largest face card combination. If both have face cards, the winner will be determined according to the above rules.]
[Listening to the strange figure’s words, you narrow your eyes, memorize all the rules, and calmly say you’re ready to start.]
[The strange figure smirks and starts shuffling the cards. Then, he begins dealing the cards. You look at your first card and see it’s a 9 of Spades.]
[At that, you narrow your eyes, and after thinking about it, you decide not to ask for more cards.]
[The strange figure looks at you contemptuously and starts dealing cards to himself. His first card is a 6 of Spades. At this, his gaze flickers as he sees the next card is a 6 of Hearts.]
[This means if he continues to ask for cards, his total will exceed ten and a half, making him lose on the spot.]
[However, the strange figure remains calm and directly uses his ability to change the next card to a 4 of Hearts.]
[Then, he calmly calls for another card.]
[As he asks for another card, he reveals the 4 of Hearts and announces it’s time to show the cards. Then, he reveals a sinister expression, saying his score is 10, while yours is only 9. In other words, you lose.]
[The strange figure sinisterly says that since you lost, you should prepare to become his card and be treasured in this place.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1183 - 1183 301 Invisible Man A Familiar
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1183: Chapter 301: Invisible Man! A Familiar Strangeness_2 Chapter 1183: Chapter 301: Invisible Man! A Familiar Strangeness_2 [Upon hearing this, your face became serious. Without any hesitation, you took out the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll and used it, tearing it apart.]
[As you used the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll, the strange expression on the translucent one’s face stiffened, and its body shattered like the Cursed Doll.]
[You looked at the dead translucent one and quietly breathed a sigh of relief. You thought this strange one was really invincible and wouldn’t get hurt. It seems that special items are still effective.]
[However, your headache returned. You’ve used up the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll to deal with the first strange one. How will you deal with the ones that follow?]
……
“The 5-figure mid-tier Special Item, forever divine.”
Wang Ping silently gave a thumbs-up to the Cursed Doll as he read the Text Simulation.
However, he soon narrowed his eyes, feeling like he missed some detail.
After all, the Rod of Holy Light didn’t work on the strange before, but the 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll did.
Could it be that the strange couldn’t be hurt before the game started, but can be hurt once the game starts or after it ends?
Or is it because the level of the Rod of Holy Light is too low and can’t hurt the strange?
“It seems necessary to gather more information during the next simulation. The 5-digit Special Item·Cursed Doll is the trump card, and if it can be avoided, it must not be used.” Wang Ping thought to himself.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the text simulation continued.
[After killing the translucent one, its body gradually disappeared, turning into a black coin that fell to the ground. This was the so-called Ghost Coin.]
[You picked it up and silently left the shop. When you left the shop and reached the street, you found that there was no one around.]
[Seeing this, you concluded that the others must not have cleared the strange game yet. But that’s normal. After all, you only took a short time to play the game, kill the strange being, and others couldn’t possibly take such a short time unless they had special items like you.]
[Next, you didn’t continue exploring the stores. Instead, you quietly waited to see if anyone could pass the strange game and how long it would take them.]
[However, half an hour later, while you were quietly waiting, a sharp dagger suddenly pierced your heart, making your expression stiff.]
[You were furious that you were unexpectedly ambushed. In response, you exploded with terrifying power, trying to smash the attacker. But you hit nothing, as if nothing existed here.]
[Quickly, your consciousness became blurry. You removed the dagger, threw it away, and took out the Rod of Holy Light to heal yourself. The Rod of Holy Light not only has the effect of purifying darkness but also has a healing effect.]
[As you were healing yourself while keeping an eye on your surroundings, a blazing flame suddenly appeared in your heart, exploding from the inside out and turning you into a fiery figure.]
[The intense pain twisted your expression slightly, and your consciousness quickly blurred as you fell to the ground. You were dying.]
[Just as you were about to die, a figure strangely appeared in front of you. It was none other than the cold woman.]
[The cold woman squatted down, looked at you with contempt, picked up the Black Ghost Coin you dropped, and took the Rod of Holy Light from your hand.]
[At this point, your consciousness fell into darkness, and you died once.]
[However, due to your Six-digit Talent: Resurrection of the Dead, you successfully came back to life.]
[As soon as you were revived, you immediately erupted with terrifying speed and attacked the woman furiously.]
[Your physique far exceeded other players, combined with the effect of the Six-digit Talent·Explosive Blade. Thus, your strike was fast, accurate, and ruthless.]
[The cold woman didn’t expect you to come back to life. She showed a frightened expression, wanted to resist, but it was too late. Her head was instantly smashed by your punch, killing her instantly.]
[With the cold woman’s death, you began to check her belongings. You found two items in total. The Six-digit Special Item: Flame Blade’s effect is that once it cuts an enemy, a flame rune is engraved on the cut, and once detonated, it can turn them into a fiery figure instantly.]
[The other item is a defensive-type special item, also a six-digit tier. Using this item can provide defense and offset some damage. This damage-offsetting effect is proportional and quite practical. However, the stronger the attack it faces, the smaller the ratio it can offset.]
[As for Wang Ping being able to smash her head with one punch, it can only be said that the power he had previously exploded was too strong. Wang Ping’s control over his power was already astonishing, plus he had ten times the physique of an ordinary person, and the Explosive Blade’s power amplification effect. The power he wielded was far beyond what any other player at this stage could withstand, even with some of the power reduced, the cold woman couldn’t withstand it.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1184 - 1184 301 Transparent Person Familiar
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1184: Chapter 301 Transparent Person! Familiar Weirdness _3 Chapter 1184: Chapter 301 Transparent Person! Familiar Weirdness _3 “You took these two things, retrieved your Rod of Holy Light, then coldly said, ‘The harm self-inflicted is hard to live with,’ and then used the Blade of Flames to burn the woman’s body to ashes. Next, you planned to continue clearing the strange game.”
…..
Looking at the content of the Text Simulation, a cold light flashed in Wang Ping’s eyes.
“Inside the Sky Tower Game, not a single player seems to be kind. This indifferent woman deceived others with her invisibility ability, giving the illusion of entering a shop. In reality, her strategy was to lie in wait.”
“Indeed, compared to playing dangerous strange games by yourself, ambushing other players, acquiring their ghost coins and equipment, is much safer, and the rewards are large.”
“It seems that before the game begins, it’s necessary to eliminate this woman. Otherwise, if she ambushed and made me lose one life, it would be rather troublesome. Of course, before making a move, it’s important to understand the talents and special items held by other players.”
As Wang Ping silently made his decision, the Text Simulation continued.
“When you reached shop number six, you saw a strange phenomenon that was very familiar.”
“This phenomenon was the shop strangeness that you, Lin Yuanyuan, and others had eliminated in Qin Tian’s world. At that time, if it weren’t for your, Lin Yuanyuan and Cai Yonglong’s talent combination, you wouldn’t have been able to kill it.”
“However, what you couldn’t understand was why a strangeness completely killed by Lin Yuanyuan would appear in the Sky Tower Game. Could it be that the Sky Tower has some mysterious connection with the strangeness? Could all the strangeness eliminated by an Order Faction like the chat group be recycled?”
“When you saw the shop strangeness, it also looked at you. Its eyes widened, showing an incredulous expression.”
“Then, it began to curse, saying that you dared to deceive him. In response, you narrowed your eyes, surprised that this shop strangeness still retained the memory of what happened. This made you even more curious about the relationship between the Sky Tower and the strangeness.”
“Next, with a calm expression, you said that he is a strangeness, and we are on different sides. If someone dies, they can only blame their lack of ability. Besides, humans say that it is glorious to die under the peony flower, and he has also done the same, so he died a glorious death.”
“After hearing your words, the strangeness was infuriated and cursed more, saying that he’s freaking set up. If losing freedom and being farmed by players as an NPC every day is glorie, then he’d rather die for real.”
“Hearing this, you raised an eyebrow, furthering your information. It seems that the Sky Tower does indeed recycle strangeness, setting them up as respawnable NPCs. They can respawn, but they have no freedom, and they’re farmed by players every time the Sky Tower Game starts.”
“Of course, from this, we can also see that each player may encounter different strangeness on Meng Gui Street. After all, the shop’s strangeness had not been dead for long, and the Sky Tower has been there for years. If every player team encounters the same strangeness on the second floor, the time frame wouldn’t line up.”
“Next, you didn’t continue to engage in pointless chatter with the shop’s strangeness but asked him what the strange game was and if he could let you pass easily because of old acquaintanceship.”
“Hearing your words, the shop strangeness showed a gritted teeth expression, saying ‘good old acquaintance, very good old acquaintance, today, for the sake of you, my old acquaintance, I will give you a good beating.”
“Next, the shop’s strangeness explained the rules of his game. His game rules are simple, that’s drawing cards, you draw a card, he draws a card, whatever you draw will produce what kind of effect. Simultaneously, Ghost coins are also inside these cards.”
“Hearing this, you raised your eyebrows, thinking that the game was quite similar to the shop’s strangeness ability. Only, one is paying a price to wish for a card draw, which has items that can fulfill wishes, but there are more pitfalls. Here, there has been a change, the shop strangeness also needs to draw cards.”
“Next, you suddenly lash out, aiming for the shop strangeness’s head. In the end, you find that you can’t hurt him, just like in the past.”
“Seeing your sudden action, the shop strangeness gives a cold snort, saying that you already knew his abilities, yet still tried to do this, a total waste of time.”
“You didn’t care about what the shop strangeness said, slightly furrowing your brows, you began to suspect that these shop strangeness were protected by the rules. Of course, this shop strangeness is different from the first strangeness because its own ability allows it to be immune to damage. The first strangeness, when facing your attack, passed through.”
“Thinking of this, you narrow your eyes suddenly, thinking that the first strangeness’s ability may be to phase through. Because of his ability to phase through, the Rod of Holy Light was useless against him. Perhaps, also because of his phasing ability, he could see what the next card was, hence being able to play the game so effortlessly.”
…..
“No, the first strangeness didn’t necessarily see through what the cards were. He only changed the cards. Besides, there’s no reason to analyze the first strangeness now. Dealing with this strangeness is more important. As for the information, it can be integrated later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1185 - 1185 301 Transparent Person Familiar
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1185: Chapter 301 Transparent Person! Familiar Weirdness _4 Chapter 1185: Chapter 301 Transparent Person! Familiar Weirdness _4 Original Wang Ping watched the luminescent screen, thinking silently, and passed the information to the simulated Wang Ping in Text Simulation.
It was after Original Wang Ping interfered that Simulated Wang Ping received the information.
[Because I received your message, Simulated Wang Ping directly gave up thinking about the first strange game and casually told the shop owner to start the game.]
[At this, the shop owner snorted coldly and directly started the game. A deck of familiar cards appeared in front of you. The shop owner drew a card, then motioned for you to draw one at random.]
[Seeing this, you raised your eyebrows slightly and drew a random card.]
[Then, you flipped over the card with the strange pattern and revealed a weird expression. Because the card you drew turned out to be a black coin.]
[Just as you were looking strange, the shop owner showed a smug smile, flipped over his own card, and said he drew a doll card, gaining a doll. Next, it was your turn to flip a card.]
[Faced with the shop owner’s urging, you silently flipped over your card. As you turned it over, the card’s pattern transformed into reality, and a black mysterious coin appeared in front of you.]
[When the shop owner saw your card, his expression completely stiffened, revealing disbelief.]
[After all, in his current deck of one hundred cards, plus his ability to influence luck, the chance of directly drawing a ghost coin was only one in a thousand. Damn it, how did you manage to draw such a probability in one go?]
[For a moment, the shop owner’s expression twisted. This time, he had a great opportunity for revenge, but he lost the game in such a bizarre way.]
[After a moment of silence, the shop owner cursed and said that you were a damn lucky bastard, telling you to take the ghost coin and leave immediately. He didn’t want to see your face anymore.]
[Regarding this, you chuckled, said ‘let’s meet again if fate allows,’ then casually left Shop No.6 with the ghost coin.]
…..
“Huh, this way of clearing the level is really full of drama. I can only say that luck is also part of strength. However, this clearance method doesn’t provide any reference. Text Simulation has no memory, and the cards are the same; next time the draw might not be this lucky.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation with a strange expression, thinking silently in his heart.
“Forget it, let’s just take it slow.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Just as you were leaving, you saw a male player coming out of Shop No.2. At this moment, he was covered in blood, looking quite miserable.]
[However, it was clear that, despite his appearance, he had successfully passed the strange game.]
[At this, you narrowed your eyes, thinking that the other players were indeed a little capable. But then again, without some ability, they wouldn’t have dared to choose Abyss mode.]
[At this moment, as you were looking at this player, he was also looking at you. At the same time, he glanced at the black ashes and bloodstains on the ground, immediately guessing what had happened.]
[You had previously chosen Shop No.1 and now came out of Shop No.6. That meant that you had already cleared two shops. Although he didn’t know whose corpse it was, there was no doubt that a player had clashed with you, and the end result was you killing them.]
[He didn’t care who started the fight first. He was only interested in one thing: since you survived, you must have at least two ghost coins in your hand. Even more, you might have three strange coins on you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1186 - 1186 302 Annihilation Return
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1186: Chapter 302: Annihilation! Return! Chapter 1186: Chapter 302: Annihilation! Return! [In this player’s eyes, if you have three strange coins in your hand, all he needs to do is kill you to pass the second floor of the Heavenly Tower. For a moment, waves of emotion stirred within this player’s heart, and his eyes filled with murderous intent. He almost lost his life passing the strange game and to be honest, he had no confidence in passing the second, let alone third and fourth strange games.]
[Therefore, attacking you directly was undoubtedly the most cost-effective approach.]
[You also perceived the murderous intent of the player in front of you. In response, you chuckled and beckoned him with a finger, indicating that if he wanted to make a move, he could try.]
[Seeing your provocative gesture, the player snorted coldly. He knew very well that you were trying to infuriate him, causing him to lose his composure.]
[However, he wouldn’t care about such a low-level provocation.]
[Next, the player marched towards you without any intention of taking out a weapon.]
[Just when he was about ten meters away from you, your shadow suddenly squirmed and stabbed towards your back.]
[Reacting instantly, you realized that this guy’s talent must be shadow control.]
[You extended your hand to grab the shadow without hesitation, but failed. You figured that the shadow couldn’t be caught, and you weren’t sure about its penetration ability. If it could ignore one’s cultivation to a certain extent, then that would be a pretty good talent.]
[Of course, although its manifestation was average, the Heavenly Tower often limited the effects of talents and items. So, you couldn’t accurately judge the performance of this player’s talent in the outer world.]
[As countless thoughts flashed through your mind, you immediately abandoned the idea of grabbing the shadow for defense. Instead, you stomped on the ground and charged towards the player controlling the shadow with terrifying speed.]
[With the terrifying speed you had, the player was caught off guard, and his head was instantly blasted by your attack.]
[As you blew up the player’s head, the shadow, which was about to pierce your heart, stiffened. It quickly returned to its original state, becoming your shadow once more.]
…
“Over in a second? It seems that the physical strength reward from the last Abyss mode was really nice. It gives me a huge advantage when dealing with other players.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but sigh as he watched the text simulation.
“However, this player doesn’t seem to have any special items. It looks like they were used up during the game against the strange.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he made another judgment.
Then, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After killing the player, you searched his corpse. However, other than finding a strange coin, you didn’t gain anything else, which left you disappointed.]
[Next, you burnt the corpse and waited quietly, wanting to see if the other players could make it out alive.]
[However, half an hour passed, and still no players emerged from the shops. You thought that the two players had most likely died in the strange game.]
[Shaking your head, you believed this to be normal progression. It would be astounding if everyone could pass the strange game.]
[To pass the strange game, one needed luck, intelligence, and hidden resources. All were indispensable.]
[Afterward, you decided to continue passing the strange game. This time, you chose No.7 Strange Shop.]
[As you stepped into the No. 7 Strange Shop, you saw a very obese, sinister-faced strange chopping meat. His evil face stared at you.]
[Then, the strange indicated that there was only one game in his shop, and that was a cooking contest. Whoever’s cooking was more delicious would win.]
[Upon hearing this, you couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow. There really were all sorts of strange creatures.]
[Afterward, you began to ask the strange who the judges were.]
[The sinister, obese strange gave a creepy smile, saying that both you and he were the judges. You needed to taste each other’s dishes, and the winner would be determined by the body’s natural response. The body’s reaction couldn’t lie.]
[In the end, as he laughed hideously, the sinister strange said that if you lost, you would become his dish to be eaten. Your human skin would be turned into his trophy and hung on the wall.]
[Frowning slightly at the fat, strange creature’s words, you glanced at the human skins hanging on the wall, knowing that those belonged to the players who had lost the game.]
[Like the previous strange, this one’s game was simple and brutal, but there must be some hidden rules.]
[Perhaps this obese strange had the ability to make food delicious.]
[On the other hand, the strange’s cooking could be highly toxic or cursed. If the player ate it, they would die instantly.]
[As long as the player died, it would naturally be a victory for the strange.]
[In other words, no matter which situation it was, honestly competing against the strange in a regular cooking contest would be foolish.]
[After pondering, the obese strange announced the start of the game.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1187 - 1187 302 Annihilation Return _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1187: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _2 Chapter 1187: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _2 The eerie creature starts intently chopping meat, looking like it’s planning to make you some rib soup. It appears proficient in its cutting and soup-making.
You watch with indifference, not taking any action, only quietly observing the creature cook.
Seeing this, the creature frowns and asks why you’re not moving.
You calmly state that even though the game has started, there’s no specified time limit for cooking.
In other words, you could drag this out as long as you want.
You’re met with a cold huff from the creature, who asserts that stalling won’t do any good, as you can’t leave the game even with four ghost coins unless you defeat it.
Its words make you narrow your eyes, as you discover another hidden rule.
You continue to wait, observing every move of the creature.
Around an hour and a half later, the creature announces its soup is ready and starts drinking it, praising its own culinary skills.
You smile upon hearing this.
You seem to have discovered a trait of this creature–it’s cautious when dealing with hot soup, waiting for it to cool before drinking.
This indicates that, unlike the previous creatures you’ve encountered, you can physically harm this one.
The smirk on your face provokes a sneer from the creature, who challenges what you find so amusing.
You stare at the eerie creature with contempt, declaring that the outcome is already determined and it should prepare for its demise.
Your words cause the creature to frown, uncertain whether you’ve discovered the key to victory.
During its uncertainty, you draw the flame blade and slash at the creature.
Your powerful attack divides the creature in half. Immediately after, a flame mark appears on the creature that triggers a horrifying flame, turning both halves of the creature into fireballs.
The creature screams in apparent agony.
Seeing this, you squint. This creature indeed differs from the previous ones—it can be harmed. And it might be vulnerable to high temperatures and fire.
As you think this, the creature insultingly curses at you for attacking it unexpectedly and leaving it injured.
Surprisingly, its bisected body regrows into two distinct creatures.
Seeing this, you frown, uncertain whether you’ve misjudged the creature’s vulnerability to fire.
The moment your doubt starts creeping in, the two creatures suddenly stiffen and fall to the ground, turning into ashes and a lone ghost coin.
The abrupt turn of events leaves you startled, but then you smile.
While you don’t know whether the creature died from your flame blade or the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack, as long as the creature is dead, all else is irrelevant.
Next, you pick up the ghost coin and leave No. 7 shop, ready to move on to the next.
However, when you step outside, something unexpected occurs. More accurately, you’re put to disgrace.
On the street, two players are facing off against each other.
Both players are worse for the wear, but they’re surviving, contrary to your assumption they’d most likely be dead by now.
In light of this, you can only remark that you might have underestimated these players who dared to venture into abyss mode—they’re no pushovers.
As you ponder this, both players simultaneously glance warily at you.
They both noticed the two dead bodies around, but neither of them knows who killed them. Given that someone managed to kill two players, they need to be extremely cautious.
Seeing their wariness, you raise an eyebrow in apathy, showing a benevolent expression, and you inquire how many ghost coins they’ve obtained.
Neither player responds to your question, completely ignoring it.
Noting their reaction, you realize that further conversation is pointless and you’ll have to get serious.
With that in mind, you approach the male player.
Seeing you approach him, the man snorts with murderous intent in his eyes.
Then, his body transforms into a humanoid white leopard, a pair of claw gauntlets equipped.
Next instant, the leopard-man rushes at you at a terrifying speed, his claw gauntlets emanating a green wind vortex.
Undeniably, the leopard man’s speed is impressive, but for you, it’s insignificant. Perhaps his physical strength is now comparable to yours, his speed somewhat surpassing yours, but in terms of controlling strength, he’s no match for you.
It’s obvious that his cultivation in the real world isn’t too high.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188 - 1188 302 Annihilation Return _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1188: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _3 Chapter 1188: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _3 [As a result, when the leopard man attacked you, you moved slightly and dodged his attack, then with a casual punch, you burst his head.]
[However, at the moment you burst the leopard man’s head, a sharp Water Thorn appeared under you and stabbed toward you.]
[The sudden attack was too fast, accurate, and ruthless for you to dodge.]
[In response, your pupils tightened slightly and you activated the effect of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Elegance, greatly increasing your physical strength once again.]
[Then, you easily dodged the Water Thorn and looked at the female player who attacked you.]
[Afterward, you let out a cold snort and charged at her.]
[As you charged, water surged in front of her, seemingly preparing to defend herself.]
[In response, you didn’t care and broke the Water Wall with an effortless punch.]
[However, your pupils suddenly shrank as you saw a glowing sphere in her hand.]
[The next moment, the sphere exploded, creating terrifying energy that swept around.]
[At this point, you couldn’t avoid it and were caught in the blast.]
[Eventually, because you had the defensive item taken from the Transparent Woman that mitigated some of the damage, you survived. However, you were severely injured and close to dying.]
[While your flesh and blood were in a mess, you saw a figure walking out of the shadows of the tenth store. That figure was none other than the female player from before.]
[You looked back at the explosion site and only saw some shattered limbs without any flesh and blood. Understanding the reason instantly.]
[It was evident that what appeared before you was not the real body of the female player but rather some kind of substitute item.]
[As a result, you sighed quietly in your heart, accepting your defeat. As expected, none of those who dared to challenge the Abyss mode were simple. There were hidden ruthless and cunning players.]
[As you sighed, the woman didn’t approach you but quietly waited for your death.]
[In response, you shook your head, knowing that you couldn’t bring her down with you.]
[Not long after, you died completely.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ended.]
…
“Still dead. But that’s normal, I never expected to clear it in one go.”
Wang Ping looked at the Text Simulation content and thought silently in his heart.
Afterward, Wang Ping glanced at the indifferent woman and the seemingly shy woman without a trace.
These two women were wicked enough.
As for the two male players, they were easier to deal with.
Of course, this might be because the two had already used up too many trump cards in the strange game.
However, no matter which player, as long as Wang Ping knew their general details, it would be much easier to kill them effortlessly.
The next thing to consider was just how to maximize the benefits.
“System, I want to do a free simulation.”
After that, Wang Ping calmed his mind and silently said in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text surfaced.
[You quietly wait, waiting for the game to begin. Next, you chose the first store just like in the previous simulation.]
[This time, the development was still similar to the previous one. You were unable to hurt this strange creature and the attacks would pass through it.]
[As the game began, your first card was still the 9 of Spades, which made your eyes twinkle, and you wondered if the sequence of cards would remain unchanged.]
[Next, the strange creature said it wanted to draw a card. In response, you sneered and asked if it really wanted to draw a card. If it did, 6+7 would make it go over.]
[Your words caused the strange creature to stiffen for a moment. In response, you keenly captured this and determined that it could see through the cards.]
[Then, you indicated that it would turn the card into the 4 of Spades, reaching 10 points and winning over you.]
[Your words made the strange creature’s expression even more rigid. However, it soon laughed and said that even if you knew its details and what it would do next, it would still win.]
[After that, it asked for a card and then laid it down. Its cards, as you predicted, were the 6 of Hearts + the 4 of Spades.]
[However, although the strange creature was caught cheating, it didn’t panic and claimed victory for itself.]
[Seeing this, you sighed, feeling that discovering the cheating would not result in any punishment. So, you had no choice but to use the 5-digit mid-tier Tool – Curse Doll.]
[As the Cursed doll was torn apart by you, the strange creature died as well.]
[Next, you picked up the ghost coin, left the store, and counter-killed the indifferent woman. This time, you didn’t even have to use your revival ability since you were already prepared. After killing the indifferent woman, you went to the store where the strange creature was. This time, you were still very lucky to draw the ghost coin card. This made you pensive, suspecting that it might be a benefit given by Heaven Tower.]
[For example, if you had participated in the elimination of this strange creature, you could clear the level for free.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1189 - 1189 302 Annihilation Return _4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1189: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _4 Chapter 1189: Chapter 302 Annihilation! Return! _4 [After that, just like in your previous simulation, you killed the male player who came out of Shop No.2 and then went to the No. 7 shop.]
[After arriving here, although you could have killed him a long time ago, you still delayed for an hour and a half before taking action. The purpose was to keep it consistent with the last simulation.]
[However, this time, you didn’t manage to kill the fat monster right away; he revived and split several times before finally being burned to death.]
[Apparently, the fat monster is indeed afraid of fire, but the reason for its death last time was the triggering of the Colorful Talent: Instant Death Attack effect.]
[After killing the fat monster and obtaining the ghost coins, you came to the outer world and saw those two confronting players.]
[Regarding this, you ignored the two in a standoff and, without any hesitation, directly activated the effect of the Seven-Colored Talent·Moment of Beauty, killing the female player hiding in the tenth store.]
[Your sudden burst was too abrupt, and this battle-minded female player couldn’t react in time and was blown apart by you on the spot.]
[With the female player killed by you, her substitute that was confronting the male player also stiffened. At the same time, four ghost coins dropped from her body.]
[You were quite astonished when you saw these four ghost coins. After all, you only got three ghost coins so far, while this woman obtained four, clearly completing all the strange games in shops 8, 9, and 10.]
[However, she was very greedy, wanting a higher evaluation, even an SSS tier evaluation, and that’s why she stayed back to try to kill other players and take their ghost coins.]
[In any case, now all of it will benefit you.]
[At this moment, the male player didn’t expect that you could burst out with such terrifying speed and directly kill the hidden female player’s main body. This made his face change dramatically, and he knew that even if he went all out, he wouldn’t be your opponent.]
[As a result, he chose to surrender, hoping that you would spare him, and he could become your servant in reality.]
[To this, you sneered in disdain, stating that the value he brings compared to the SSS tier evaluation was too far apart.]
[Immediately after, you didn’t bother continuing the conversation, striking him down directly.]
[Thus, you obtained ten ghost coins, as well as some six-digit special items from these players, becoming the ultimate winner.]
[Because you completed the game, this simulation ends here…]
…
“Well, this went really smoothly.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
Then, he glanced at the seemingly shy female player and marveled at her in his heart.
Who would have thought that this woman was so amazing, clearing four strange games all by herself.
However, it all became his gain in the end.
Following this, Wang Ping didn’t let his guard down and continued to use the free simulation mode to repeat this several times. When he found that the outcomes were all the same, Wang Ping barely managed to relax.
After all, this was the Sky Tower Game, and he couldn’t be careless. If he died accidentally without completing the game, it would be a true death, and no one could save him.
Before long, the Sky Tower Game began, and Wang Ping took action following the pattern in the simulations, swiftly completing the three strange games and killing the other four players one by one.
As a result, he naturally obtained 10 ghost coins and several six-digit special items.
“This time, I must have reached the SSS tier evaluation again. I just don’t know what rewards I’ll get.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were deep, filled with anticipation.
“Heaven Tower, I choose to return.”
Then, Wang Ping spoke.
“Ding, the main quest has been detected as completed. Congratulations to the player for passing the second level of the Tower of Heaven game world·Menggui Street.”
As Wang Ping chose to return, the alert and smart voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence sounded.
Then, Wang Ping was enveloped in white light, leaving this game world and returning to his exclusive room.
Soon after, the smart voice of the Sky Tower sounded again…

chapters.title: Chapter 1190 - 1190 303 The Second SSS Tier Evaluation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1190: Chapter 303: The Second SSS Tier Evaluation! Amazing Rewards! Chapter 1190: Chapter 303: The Second SSS Tier Evaluation! Amazing Rewards! “Ding, detected that the player has chosen Abyss mode to complete the main quest, graded as A-tier.”
“Ding, detected that the player has received an additional six ghost coins, raising his evaluation to SSS-tier, and gained an SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest.”
“Ding, Global announcement: Player Tianyan chose Abyss mode, successfully completing the Game world’s second floor of the Heavenly Tower, earned an SSS-tier evaluation, becoming the 90th player to receive an SSS-tier evaluation for the second floor.”
…..
“Hehe, as expected, an SSS-tier evaluation, that feels great.”
Wang Ping smiled watching the series of messages that popped up on the luminescent screen.
There were 98 people with an SSS-tier evaluation in the Abyss mode of the 1st floor; on the second floor, it’s only 90.
As expected, fewer people chose Abyss mode in the later stages, and there are fewer people who can get high evaluations as well.
However, this time there was another mandatory global announcement, which once again put me in the spotlight.
Afterward, Wang Ping couldn’t help but feel emotional.
“But it doesn’t matter, as long as I don’t show off my in-game name, there won’t be any trouble.”
Wang Ping shook his head, gathered his thoughts, and looked at his reward. He chose to claim the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest and opened it.
As Wang Ping opened the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, a golden light appeared, and Sky Tower Intelligence’s pleasant voice instantly rang out.
At the same time, some images and text appeared before Wang Ping.
“Ding, congratulations on opening the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, and obtaining the following rewards:
1. All attributes of Tower of Heaven game character +50.
2. 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain
3. 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Starry Wings.”
5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain: A one-time-use item, which forms a vast field that seals the abilities of talents and items with below 4 figures. Within the domain, both parties can only fight using their physical strength.
ps: This item comes from the Tower of Heaven Game. It can be used in the game, but its ability values would be adjusted accordingly, so players should use it carefully.
5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Starry Wings: With this item, players can generate a pair of star-like wings behind them, greatly enhancing their speed and providing defense capabilities.
ps: As this item is a special item from Tower of Heaven Game, it can be used in the game, but its effects would be adjusted accordingly.
Players can amplify their speed and get flight capabilities and defense with the Starry Wings, but using this item will consume mental power.
“Another combination of attribute boosts and two special items?”
Wang Ping looked at the items obtained from this Abyss Treasure Chest, thinking secretly.
It must be said that the items opened this time were incomparably better than those from the first floor of the Sky Tower.
The 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain might not be of much use in the outer world, and one could consider it to be quite disappointing. It’s far worse than a similarly-levelled Special Item: Curse Doll.
But in Myriad Heavens Paradise, this item was akin to a super-weapon.
Once this item was used, it would immediately seal off talents and item effects, forcing both sides to fight with their physical strength alone, making it a veritable bug.
“My dear senior, I originally thought I’d have to go through several more tower floors before I could go up against you. Now, it seems that you’ll soon be my defeated opponent.”
Wang Ping’s mouth curved up slightly, thinking in his heart.
Originally, Wang Ping felt that the Second Generation Chat Group Leader’s talent and hidden items were somewhat tricky.
Now, with the 5-figure Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain, Wang Ping could easily deal with him.
After all, not many people in the same level could compare to Wang Ping in terms of physical strength.
At the same time, Wang Ping followed the path of overpowering force, completely different from the cunning path taken by the Second Generation Chat Group Leader.
According to Alpha, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader’s frontal combat power was just average. He was only very good at scheming and dealing with the troubles caused by his Cunning Talent.
The Cunning Talent could draw a card every minute, each with varying abilities.
Some could summon powerful monsters, some had control abilities, some buffed oneself, and some could even set traps.
The Second Generation Chat Group Leader’s ability could be said to be versatile. With the right tactics before a fight or selectively ambushing opponents, he could easily win against stronger opponents.
Facing the constantly changing tactics of the Second Generation Chat Group Leader, Wang Ping, who still lacked an ace, had a slim chance of winning.
However, with the special item Magic-Sealing Domain, the situation would change drastically.
The Second Generation Chat Group Leader’s unpredictable fighting style would be forcibly changed to engage in melee combat with him.
Wang Ping had confidence in crushing him in just a few moves.
“Of course, the specific situation still depends on the simulation. If I can find a way to easily defeat him without using the 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain, then it wouldn’t be necessary to use such a precious item.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were deep, thinking secretly in his heart.
In the previous Tower of Heaven game, Wang Ping had used the 5-figure mid-tier Special Item: Curse Doll to deal with the first Cunning opponent, and he still felt a bit of heartache about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - 1191 303 The Second SSS Tier Evaluation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1191: Chapter 303: The Second SSS Tier Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards!_2 Chapter 1191: Chapter 303: The Second SSS Tier Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards!_2 After all, no matter how strong the Cursed doll is, even though it’s just a five-digit item, it will soon be unable to catch up with his power level, but it’s definitely a big killer against difficult players in the Sky Tower Game.
“However, there’s no way. After all, I can’t think of a way to clear the first Sci-fi Mysterious, there’s simply no flaw.”
Wang Ping sighed and felt somewhat helpless.
Of course, Wang Ping also understood that compared to those experts skilled at strategizing, he wasn’t that smart, so he could only use this relatively crude and wasteful method to clear the stages.
Next, Wang Ping checked out the items obtained from the four players.
Six-digit limit special item: Flame Blade.
Six-digit limit special item: Damage Reduction Charm: Reduces some damage when worn.
Six-digit limit special item: Substitute Puppet: Summons a puppet with the same combat power as the main body, but its power cannot exceed the six-digit limit in the outer world.
At the same time, the substitute puppet can also use the master’s items, talents, and skills.
However, some special talents and skills cannot be used.
Five-digit Entry Tier special item: Star Burst Ball: A one-time item that can instantly blow up a galaxy.
“Goodness, no wonder that female player killed the simulated Wang Ping in a moment of elegance after using this item, who was powerless, plus had the Damage Reduction Charm. If it’s a one-time 5-digit Entry Tier special item, it makes sense.”
Wang Ping looked at the last special item’s introduction and sighed.
Although the power in the outer world and the Sky Tower Game is different, its destructive power from the introduction shows its strength, and it’s normal for the simulated Wang Ping not to be able to withstand it.
“Next, should I continue to challenge the Sky Tower Game?”
After Wang Ping stored these items, he couldn’t help but think.
Although he thought before that with the 5-digit intermediate special item: Demon Forbidden Domain, he could definitely defeat the Second Generation Chat Group Leader.
However, Wang Ping calmed down and still felt something was not stable.
After all, Wang Ping didn’t know if the Second Generation Chat Group Leader had any items in his hand that could nullify his talents.
Therefore, continuing to challenge the tower to obtain more powerful items is undoubtedly more secure.
However, challenging the tower may also accompany consumption and may also consume the items in his hands.
For a moment, Wang Ping felt a little tangled.
“Forget it, it’s better to be stable first, I don’t need to deal with the Second Generation Chat Group Leader immediately. Compared to the risky behavior of obtaining items by challenging the tower, I might as well waste more Quasi Fairy King Instruments and refresh powerful 5-digit talents, that would be even safer.”
In the end, Wang Ping finally calmed down, gave up the dangerous idea of continuing to challenge the tower, and chose to return.
As Wang Ping returned, his figure was wrapped in white light, leaving the Heaven Tower space and returning to the outer world.
“Wang Ping, you’re back.”
Alpha sighed in relief when she saw Wang Ping return safely.
Although she had heard the news of Tian Yan’s clearance of the Abyss mode with an SSS tier evaluation, due to the game of stakes with Wang Ping, Alpha wouldn’t associate Tian Yan with Wang Ping.
So, seeing Wang Ping return safely, she sighed in relief.
“Yeah, I’m back.”
Wang Ping nodded with a smile.
“Alpha, where can I get a lot of World Sources?”
Wang Ping then asked directly.
In reality, there are too few Quasi Fairy King Instruments that Wang Ping can obtain, and he has to go to the Immortal Domain.
As a result, it’s time to use the World Source for simulation.
The two payment methods could be mixed, maximizing benefits.
“A lot of World Sources?”
Alpha was startled, and then her expression became serious as she said.
“First, unlock the Sci-fi Mysterious, which gives you fifty trillion group points, which can be converted into fifty thousand Origin Degrees in Myriad Heavens Paradise. This is a huge amount already.”
“Second, initiate a Myriad Heavens Game between two forces, the winner gets all the resources of the loser.”
“Third, go to Myriad Heavens Casino, where you can win anything, and also lose everything. Wind Demon Supreme, that idiotic fellow, lost all his resources there, fled back to the Upper Realm, and didn’t dare to return to Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
After thinking, Alpha stated three ways to get a lot of World Source in a short time.
“Fifty trillion…”
Wang Ping looked at Alpha with a strange expression in his eyes.
He remembered that Alpha initially said it was close to trillions of group points.
Alpha really pocketed a lot of it.
And this was after he had become much stronger, and Alpha had treated him increasingly well.
God knows how much World Source Alpha had pocketed before to deal with Sci-fi Mysterious.
“The operation of the chat group also requires World Source, and various functions, especially the Delivery Function, consume a lot. At the same time, I need to repair myself, so there was no choice but to pocket those World Sources before.”
Alpha felt a little guilty under Wang Ping’s gaze and explained quietly.
“Let’s forget about the past, I don’t mean to blame you now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1192 - 1192 303 The Second SSS-Level Evaluation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1192: Chapter 303: The Second SSS-Level Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards!_3 Chapter 1192: Chapter 303: The Second SSS-Level Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards!_3 Wang Ping smiled, understanding Alpha’s operation.
In the past, Alpha was emotionless and cold, but now it had made a lot of progress, even knowing to explain reasons and apologize.
“That’s good.”
Alpha nodded.
“Three methods…”
Wang Ping rubbed his chin, thinking.
“The war between Myriad Heavens Forces, between the Order Faction and the Evil Faction, is the risk factor high?”
After briefly pondering, Wang Ping asked curiously.
Myriad Heavens Forces were, within the Myriad Heavens Paradise, two extremely polarized forces.
They were the Order Faction and the Evil Faction.
The ideology of the Order Faction was to protect the various worlds of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms and acquire World Source through a continuous, steady stream method.
On the other hand, the Evil Faction’s ideology was to directly seize the World Source, regardless of the life or death of the world. If they could directly disrupt the predetermined development of the world’s plot and kill the important characters of that world, they would do so. If they could directly destroy a world, they would do so, maximizing the benefits in a short period of time.
As a result, individual forces of the Evil Faction were often stronger than those of the Order faction because their development model ensured rapid growth.
However, the price for this was that they were like rats, vilified by everyone.
After all, people in the Order Faction were very worried that this group of destructive psychopaths would come and cause trouble in their own worlds.
Once someone from the Evil Faction arrived, great disasters might erupt, which they couldn’t tolerate.
Regardless of whether it was due to their innate four-digit strength, sensing the call of Myriad Heavens Paradise and thereby joining as players, or players who had already traversed to a certain world, the worlds they belonged to were their fundamental territories, which must not be destroyed.
Therefore, those who made up the Order Faction were mostly local powerhouse forces or Transmigrators with fixed transmigration worlds.
As for the people of the Evil Faction’s Myriad Heavens Forces, they did not have fixed worlds to reside in, similar to pirates traveling through Myriad Heavens, collecting world information, and dispatching tasks.
“Dealing with the Evil Faction, there’s no such thing as low risk. Even Slaughter Paradise, a relatively insignificant Myriad Heavens Evil Force, has four-digit powerhouses in command.”
Alpha said quietly.
“Four digits…”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows.
It seemed that Slaughter Paradise was stronger than he had imagined.
However, this also provided a rough estimate of Alpha’s strength in different periods.
In the First Generation Chat Group, Alpha was at the peak, possibly reaching the four-digit limit or very close to it.
After being dismantled and reconstructed by a predecessor transmigrator in First Generation Transcender Chat Group, its strength dropped, possibly to a relatively strong five-digit level, then later regained four-digit strength with the help of the Second-generation Chat Group.
Unfortunately, tragedy struck again when Alpha was dismantled by Dao Yi and Slaughter Paradise in the Second Generation Chat Group.
Now, poor Alpha was only a 5-digit Entry Tier.
Perhaps Wang Ping and others had helped her level up by completing various tasks.
Otherwise, Alpha’s strength at the time Wang Ping had just joined the group might only have been six digits.
With a six-digit level, it would have been impossible to support a Myriad Heavens Force or allow Alpha to connect to different worlds, bring people into the group from Primitive Earth, and monitor the group members’ every move.
It could only be said that Transmigrator Chat Group was indeed not simple, and Alpha’s creator was indeed strong.
“In the four-digit realm, I can’t deal with it yet. You should be thinking about going to war with other Myriad Heaven’s Evil Forces.”
Wang Ping gathered his thoughts and said.
“Yes, although Slaughter Paradise is weak, there are even weaker Myriad Heaven’s Evil Forces, like newly emerging forces. You have more than a 50% chance of wiping them out with your current abilities.”
Alpha nodded and confirmed.
“A 50% probability? That’s too low.”
Wang Ping shook his head.
He didn’t want to take risks.
For this, starting a war with other Myriad Heavens Evil Forces could be an option, but not now.
He had to refresh enough 5-digit Talents or acquire enough five-digit Items before going to war.
Otherwise, insufficient preparation would lead to self-destruction.
Although Wang Ping had always believed that he had a strong backer, he wouldn’t completely entrust his life to that backer and be reckless.
Being too reckless and careless about one’s own life could lead to tragedy if the backer found them useless.
“The third method, Myriad Heavens Casino. This place… is a gambling place. You bet on fights and all sorts of gambling games. However, your talents will be limited, so if you want to win money, you can only enter the arena and fight to the death. Betting on yourself, plus the prize money for deadly fights, is a huge income. The premise is that you can keep winning. Otherwise, you’re finished.”
Alpha nodded and continued.
“Gambling? If my talents are limited, I’m not a fan of gambling, so I’ll pass for now. As for the deathmatch, my trump cards are also insufficient at the moment, so I won’t go yet.”
Wang Ping shook his head, dismissing Alpha’s suggestion once more.
“Well, then I can only deal with the Sci-fi Mysterious.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1193 - 1193 303 The Second SSS-Level Evaluation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1193: Chapter 303: The Second SSS-Level Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards! _4 Chapter 1193: Chapter 303: The Second SSS-Level Evaluation! Astonishing Rewards! _4 Alpha frowned and spoke.
“The problem with Sci-fi Mysterious is still that even if you go to that universe now, your powers would be limited and you’ll become an ordinary person. To be honest, it’s difficult to deal with.”
Pausing for a moment, Alpha continued, “However, if you delay any longer without dealing with it, it will destroy that universe and leave.”
“Has it evolved to this level?”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows upon hearing Alpha’s words.
“After all, a considerable amount of time has passed since you left, so it’s quite normal for it to develop like this. The level of your Life Simulator at that time was ultimately too low, and after being affected by the Mysterious power, many simulated contents became inaccurate.”
Alpha nodded solemnly.
“Tsk, I was really a bit too arrogant back then, thinking I could kill the Sci-fi Mysterious.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping smacked his lips and sighed.
Truth be told, he never expected even his Life Simulator to be affected by the other’s power at that time.
However, thinking back now, it was only natural.
At that time, his Life Simulator was at the six-digit Tier talent, while the Mysterious was at least five-digit. Considering the peculiar nature of its power, it could break through levels and affect higher four-digit Tier beings, like the Immortal King.
Being influenced or even suppressed under the circumstances where the ability level was lower was very normal.
If it weren’t for Wu Jun’s Golden finger bringing a miracle back then, allowing them to escape that world in a short time, they would have been in trouble, perhaps even meeting the same end as the powerful travelers from the Second Generation Chat Group, completely wiped out.
“I didn’t expect that Mysterious to have grown to this level either.”
Alpha muttered.
“To be honest, it was only recently that I observed the situation in that universe and discovered the clues.”
“Although the growth of Mysterious is different from that of the Paradise people, they do not need Rule Stones, their growth is essentially unlimited. However, they also need to spend a long time and destroy many worlds to raise their power level. This Mysterious’s growth rate is somewhat abnormal.”
By the end, Alpha sighed wistfully, also feeling a little afraid.
She also bore a significant part of the responsibility for not dissuading Wang Ping at the beginning.
“Forget it, it’s all in the past now.”
Wang Ping waved his hand nonchalantly.
“So, that universe, if nobody takes care of it, there is no hope, right?”
After a pause, Wang Ping’s gaze deepened, and he spoke.
“If no one takes care of it, there is indeed no hope.”
Alpha nodded her head with certainty.
“Wang Ping, do you mean to…”
Alpha hesitated for a moment, guessing Wang Ping’s thoughts.
“That’s right. I want to blow up that universe and completely eliminate the Mysterious. Under this circumstance, we shouldn’t be considered as breaking any rules, right?”
Wang Ping narrowed his eyes and spoke.
“It doesn’t count as breaking the rules, but do you have such a special item?”
Alpha asked with some hesitation.
“I’m in luck. I ‘made friends’ with a girl in the Sky Tower Game and she gave me a nice gift.”
Wang Ping grinned and took out a sphere.
That was the Spoils of War he had obtained from the very smart and shy Female Player.
One-time 5-digit Entry Tier Special Item: Starburst Orb.
“This is the Star Burst Ball…?”
Seeing this item, Alpha showed a very surprised expression.
“Huh? Alpha, you know this thing? Since you know it, everything should be fine.”
Wang Ping laughed, thinking that he didn’t need to explain too much himself.
“Are you sure you made friends with a female player in Heaven Tower, and she gave it to you?”
Alpha’s expression was very serious, questioning him.
“What’s wrong? Is this thing of great origin?”
Wang Ping’s eyelids twitched and a bad feeling arose, suspecting that he might have gotten himself into big trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1194 - 1194 304 New 5-digit Talent Unexpected gains
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1194: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! Chapter 1194: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! “The origin of this thing is indeed quite grand. As we all know, only special items recognized by Sky Tower can be used in the Sky Tower Game. Special items are often rewards in the Sky Tower Game. However, there are exceptions…”
Alpha nodded and started to explain seriously.
“Some powerful forces can produce specific special items. And these forces, none of them are less than three-digit forces, because forces below three digits can’t keep these precious production materials.”
“That is to say, the player you made friends with comes from the three-digit force, Falling Stars Palace. Being able to meet such a person is your luck, seize the opportunity, it should be beneficial for your growth in the future.”
After a pause, Alpha reminded him.
“Uh….”
Wang Ping’s face twitched, falling silent.
Damn, what does all this mean, did I just directly offend a three-digit force?
Wang Ping looked at the Star Burst Ball in his hand, a headache starting.
Was this thing actually produced? Does that mean it might have a tracking function?
No, Sky Tower has shielding capabilities, if it could track other players who got spoils of war like this, it would be in chaos by now.
Wang Ping quickly calmed down, feeling safe for now.
“What’s wrong? Did you steal it?”
Alpha noticed Wang Ping’s expression was a bit off, and started to suspect.
“In order to get a high evaluation, there was no option.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“Did she die?”
After a moment of silence, Alpha asked.
Wang Ping nodded, and coughed lightly, “I blew up her head, then burned it to ashes.”
Alpha: “……”
Wang Ping: “……”
“There’s no big problem, she may have had the Star Burst Ball, but she wasn’t necessarily an important person in the Falling Stars Palace. Plus, with the shielding mechanism of the Sky Tower, Falling Stars Palace may not be able to find me.”
Wang Ping shrugged, saying calmly.
“Ah, the shielding mechanism of Sky Tower is not omnipotent, you may expose some things from other places.”
Alpha said frustratedly.
“But it’s too late to say this. Let’s play the game. The information can’t stay in my mind.”
After a pause, Alpha said.
Alpha now understood, Wang Ping was also a super troublemaker.
Looks like, apart from the second generation who she kept in strict check, the first and third generations were both troublemakers, whose actions scared her.
“Okay.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Next, Alpha and Wang Ping played the game, which sealed Alpha’s memory.
“I’ll go back to the Profound World first, brush up on some five-digit talents, and then tackle the Sci-Fi Mysterious.”
