Immediately after, Wang Ping didn’t say much more, choosing to return to the Profound World.
Just as Wang Ping returned to the Profound World, the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise was shocked by Wang Ping passing the second floor of the Sky Tower game and obtaining an SSS tier evaluation.
After all, it hadn’t been long since Wang Ping breached the 1st floor of Sky Tower and obtained an SSS tier evaluation.
Now, the player Heaven Derivative, surprisingly cleared the tower again and once again obtained an SSS tier evaluation.
This achievement was shocking.
For a moment, more powerful forces wanted to find Wang Ping and bring him in.
Once, it was probably luck.
But twice, it definitely wasn’t luck anymore.
But for now, all of this had nothing to do with Wang Ping.
The current Wang Ping had already returned to the Profound World.
“Next, time to deal with the sealed Demon Immortal.”
After Wang Ping returned, he looked in the direction of Elemental Forbidden Land, took one step and headed there.
However, Wang Ping didn’t immediately enter the Elemental Forbidden Land, but went to Tao Palace first, left some resources and inheritance there and then entered the Elemental Forbidden Land.
“The Immortal King fell, the Demon Immortal is extinct, see the king without kowtowing, is a true death sentence.”
After Wang Ping entered the Elemental Forbidden Land, he felt the fear of the Demon Immortal, so he couldn’t help but curl his lips slightly, and he said this somewhat secondary statement.
The sealed Demon Immortal: “…”
Truthfully, the sealed Demon Immortal was at a loss for words.
Although he had known from the terrifying fluctuations earlier that Wang Ping was an extremely powerful Quasi Fairy King.
Even though you’re a Quasi Fairy King, the words you said are too arrogant.
What does “The Immortal King fell, the Demon Immortal is extinct, see the king without kowtowing, is a true death sentence” mean?
Can’t he just kowtow under the same realm?
You’re not even an Immortal King yet, why are you so arrogant?
Even if you become an Immortal King, you can’t be this arrogant, right?
“Little Demon Immortal, I am giving you a chance. Give me your Quasi Fairy King artifact, and I can let you go, sparing your life.”
Seeing that the Demon Immortal played dead without intending to respond, Wang Ping felt bored and started to get to the point.
What followed was no different from life simulation.
It was the same; releasing the Demon Immortal, revealing the cruel news of the death of the Immortal King, then Wang Ping blasted this sealed Demon Immortal.
Of course, his remains were not wasted, they were collected by Wang Ping for future consumption after the evolution of the Devouring Immortal Bead.
Although Wang Ping himself could refine it, he thought it was troublesome and somewhat discriminatory.
“System, consume a Quasi Fairy King instrument, and initiate a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping suppressed the Quasi Fairy King artifact of this sealed Demon Immortal, he said in his inner thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1195 - 1195 304 New 5-digit Talent Unexpected gains
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1195: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! _2 Chapter 1195: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! _2 “Ding! Consuming a Quasi-Immortal King artifact, Life Simulator starts up, Talent Refresh in progress…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding! Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for refreshing the 5-digit Talent: Intentional Bombardment Fist; and the 6-digit Talent: Star Crossed Love.”
5-Digit Talent – Accumulating Power Punch: With this talent, the host will accumulate anger when injured. The host can selectively convert this anger into power to strike out, causing massive damage.
6-Digit Talent – Star Crossed Love: …
“Wow, the Accumulating Power Punch has finally arrived? Pretty impressive.”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talents, full of emotions.
If nothing goes wrong, this talent should be useful.
Although it is just a 5-digit talent, it can still play some role in enhancing his combat power for now. It’s like a hidden card, which can be used to deal with the group owner of the Second Generation Chat Group.
Of course, if possible, Wang Ping would prefer to refresh some talents that can control the enemy or release control abilities.
On the same level, he is not lacking in strength, but he fears those control-type skills, talents, and items.
“Nevermind, it’s already good enough to refresh a useful 5-digit talent, can’t be too picky.”
Then, Wang Ping shook his head and muttered.
“System, I choose the 5-Digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch.”
Next, Wang Ping made his choice. As for the 6-Digit Talent: Star Crossed Love, he had no interest in it now.
“Ding! Talent selection successful, Life Simulator begins…”
The voice of the system rang again.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text surfaced.
[Day One, you choose to go to the Immortal Domain. The following development is similar to the previous simulations: meeting Lu Daoxian, meeting Chu Lingyin, beginning cultivation, and seeking enlightenment.]
[A hundred thousand years later, when the Flame Demon Clan attacks, you choose to crush them, take the Quasi-Demon King’s Artifact from them, and use the 5-Digit Talent: Fixed Point Transmission to travel to Unknown World. ]
[This time, your luck is not bad, you teleport to a world where Immortal Kings exist but there is no exclusion.]
[You thrive in this world, hoping to gain enlightenment and become a new Immortal King.]
[Unfortunately, after thirty thousand years, you fail and don’t achieve enlightenment.]
[It’s at this moment that the Dark Disaster erupts, and a large number of Dark Beings rush towards the world where you are.]
[In an instant, the world is shocked, and everyone starts to join forces against the Dark Beings.]
[Of course, you can’t avoid this either. After all, you’ve always suspected that the Dark Disaster is targeting you.]
[In the upcoming battles, you show your great power, killing one Dark Being after another. The Dark Beings on the Quasi Fairy King tier cannot withstand your attack. Your combat power amazes the Immortal Kings.]
[However, good times don’t last long, and a Dark Being on the Immortal King tier appears and starts attacking you.]
[Facing the Dark Being on the Immortal King-tier, even with your 5-Digit Talent: Night Hunter, you are no match and are severely injured in a few moves. ]
[However, this time you have the 5-digit special item: Starry Wings, which increases your speed and prevents you from being killed in a few moves like before. ]
[Seeing that you can withstand a few of their attacks without dying, the Immortal King-tier Dark Being praises you before launching another attack, intending to wipe you out completely.]
[It’s at this moment that you choose to unleash the power of the 5-Digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch. In an instant, a terrifying skill erupts with your strongest blow, shocking the entire world.]
[The Immortal King-tier Dark Being did not expect you to have such a terrifying skill, and in a moment of unpreparedness, you manage to blow off one of their arms. ]
[Although the Immortal King-tier Dark Being regenerates their arm immediately, they are shocked by your power.]
[Not only is the Immortal King-tier Dark Being stunned, but also Lu Daoxian, Chu Lingyin, the Immortal Kings of this world, and other strong beings are amazed and shocked as well.]
[However, you don’t have any hint of joy. After all, this is your last attack. This blow merely blew off one arm of the Immortal King-tier Dark Being, leaving you disappointed. You know you’re doomed. It’s not that you’re weak, but the Immortal King-tier Dark Being is too powerful.]
[Following that, without any suspense, you are obliterated by the Immortal King-tier Dark Being, and perish.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends…]
The text simulation stopped here, and numerous memory images and cultivation realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
“It’s a pity, actually, the enlightenment this time was quite a lot. If the simulated Wang Ping was given more than a million years, maybe he would’ve truly understood the Chaotic Immortal King’s path and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra. Once these two are acquired, maybe he may have a chance to fight against the Immortal King-tier Dark Beings.”
As Wang Ping came back to his senses, he shook his head and sighed.
Of course, Wang Ping knew that the Immortal King-tier Dark Beings were not the main issue. The most troublesome thing was the Source of Darkness itself.
If this problem is not solved, he will always be in danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1196 - 1196 304 New 5-digit Talent Unexpected gains
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1196: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! _3 Chapter 1196: Chapter 304 New 5-digit Talent! Unexpected gains! _3 However, to solve this trouble, the cultivation at the Immortal King-tier was far from enough.
He, needed an even more powerful force.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The host can choose from the following rewards:
①. 5-digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch.
②. Randomly select a Profound Immortal Artifact.
③. Chaos Immortal King Sutra (Ye Cang edition).
④. Six-figure Talent · Star Crossed Love.”
…
“Eh!”
Wang Ping looked at the rewards this time, showing a surprised expression.
Although Wang Ping had known that the Life Simulator could refresh rewards for things previously undiscovered, this was the first time it had actually given him precisely what he urgently needed.
“I’ve actually managed to get my hands on Ye Cang’s Chaos Immortal King Sutra, that’s something to be happy about! With this Chaos Immortal King Sutra as a reference, I estimate that I can comprehend my own Chaos Immortal King Sutra and Chaotic Immortal King Dao the next time I do a Paid Simulation. By that point, my strength will increase exponentially, making me more secure against the owner of the Second Generation Chat Group. At the same time, I might also be able to break through in the Life Simulator.”
Wang Ping thought happily about various matters.
Then, Wang Ping made a choice without hesitation, and spoke, “System, I choose ①. 5-digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch and ③. Chaos Immortal King Sutra (Ye Cang edition).”
As Wang Ping made his choice, the usage method for the 5-digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch appeared in his mind.
Following that, the Ye Cang version of the Chaos Immortal King Sutra surfaced in his mind as well.
After Wang Ping absorbed the knowledge from those scriptures, he showed an astonished expression.
It must be said that the Ye Cang version of the Chaos Immortal King Sutra was more profound than the Chaos Demon King Scripture of the Chaos Demon King, and it also aligned better with Wang Ping’s own path.
“If Chaos Demon King is the giant among Immortal Kings, then Ye Cang has stepped halfway out of that level. But still, even someone like Ye Cang was once killed by a ruthless senior from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group, which is quite lamentable.”
Wang Ping couldn’t restrain his feelings in his heart as he agonized over the past.
Whether it’s Ye Cang or that ruthless senior from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group, he wanted to meet them and chat with them.
Unfortunately, there was no chance.
At least, not now.
Ye Cang had long been dead, so unless Wang Ping managed to traverse the River of Time, there was no way for them to meet.
As for the ruthless senior from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group, Wang Ping didn’t have the qualifications to meet them yet.
“The road to becoming stronger is so long and arduous.”
Wang Ping sighed, then collected his thoughts.
“Alpha, I think it’s time for me to deal with that Sci-fi Mysterious issue in the Sci-Fi World. Open the coordinates and Delivery Function.”
Then, Wang Ping contacted Alpha in his heart.
“Wang Ping, I’ll open all the functions of the chat group for you. You don’t have to tell me when you want to use them.”
Alpha’s voice sounded out.
“Alright, that’ll be much more convenient.”
Wang Ping nodded, feeling that Alpha was becoming much more amiable.
“Wang Ping, I don’t recommend you going to that world by yourself. You should consider using a safer method.”
Alpha’s voice rang out again.
“Don’t worry, I won’t take any risks.”
A smile appeared at the corner of Wang Ping’s mouth.
If it weren’t for extraordinary power being suppressed, Wang Ping would have chosen to condense a power incarnation and bring the special items to blow up the universe with him.
However, since his power would be suppressed, Wang Ping had no choice but to use the Substitute Puppet, a special item he obtained from the shy girl.
This type of special item could even be used in Heaven Tower, so it was obviously not going to be suppressed by the Sci-fi Mysterious power.
Immediately, Wang Ping used the ability of the Death Replacement Puppet and replicated an identical version of himself.
Although this replica only had the strength of the True Immortal tier, it didn’t matter because Wang Ping didn’t rely on the replica’s strength to complete the task.
Then, Wang Ping did some operation, opened the transmission channel, and prepared to let the Substitute Puppet carry the Starburst Pearl to Wu Jun’s world.
“Oh, speaking of which, I haven’t sent a message in the group for a long time. Since I’m going to blow up Wu Jun’s universe, I should let him know.”
Wang Ping stroked his chin, and opened the chat group’s page after a long absence.
Wang Ping (Group owner)@ All group members: “Jun, I’m going to blow up your universe soon, just letting you know.”
Wu Jun (20): “Holy shit! Mr. Wang actually sent a message! Shocking!”
Qin Tian (77): “Damn, has Mr. Wang actually reached the level where he can blow up universes? That’s so scary!”
Zhang Hu (5): “Mr. Wang is truly amazing, he’s becoming godly. By the way, Mr. Wang has really become the true group owner! What exactly happened while we were busy grinding missions? Shocking!”
Lin Yuanyuan (80): “We went to the Myriad Heavens Paradise and met Alpha. It should have been a transfer of authority. If Mr. Wang says he’s going to blow up the universe, he must be able to do it. He’s just that amazing!”
Cai Yonglong (1): “As expected of my Mr. Wang, he’s so cool! He’s now really the group owner. Speaking of blowing up universes, that’s quite a spectacle. Please let us watch as well.”
Seeing the seniors from the group showing their support, Wang Ping couldn’t help but laugh.
It’s been a long time since he’s felt this way.
Because of the pressure from the Second Generation Chat Group members, he had to work hard to earn resources and get stronger through simulations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1197 - 1197 304 New Five-Digit Talent Unexpected
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1197: Chapter 304 New Five-Digit Talent! Unexpected Harvest! _4 Chapter 1197: Chapter 304 New Five-Digit Talent! Unexpected Harvest! _4 His life simulator was so extreme that the group members of the chat group simply couldn’t keep up with his pace. They didn’t even have the qualifications to fight bosses with him anymore.
But no matter what, this group had seen him through his toughest times and were considered elders of the chat group.
“It’s been a while, let’s send a big red envelope to boost their power.”
After contemplating, Wang Ping sent a super big red envelope directly.
This super big red envelope contained all kinds of precious cultivation resources and cultivation skills.
However, this big red envelope was only eligible for the old friends Wang Ping knew, for those who joined later, they were not eligible.
Of course, Wang Ping was in a good mood and didn’t overlook the newcomers. Giving them too good resources would only bring disaster to them.
So, Wang Ping sent another big red envelope filled with many medium and low-level resources that anyone could grab.
Even though in Wang Ping’s view these were just medium and low-level resources, it was all relative.
Wang Ping’s standards were too high, his so-called medium and low-level resources were like supreme treasures to those newcomers and even to the old friends.
After all, these resources were incredibly valuable even to those in the Divine Realm, Saint Realm, and even the Supreme ones.
For a moment, the chat group went insane. Both the old and new members were immensely shocked, overjoyed, and praised Wang Ping to the heavens.
“Tsk tsk, the feeling of giving out red envelopes once in a while is quite good.”
Watching various powerful figures in the chat group thanking him and praising him, Wang Ping smacked his lips.
“Regrettably, we have all drifted apart.”
After hesitating for a moment, Wang Ping sighed.
As he became stronger, these people had been left behind. The days of chatting and joking around were now impossible.
Then, Wang Ping didn’t feel like continuing the chat and began his action.
He transported the Death Replacement Puppet to the universe where Wu Jun was located.
When the Death Replacement Puppet arrived in that universe, Wang Ping saw that its power was suppressed to that of an ordinary person.
“Tsk, this Sci-fi Mysterious stuff is really terrifying. I wonder if this Star Burst Ball will work or not. If it doesn’t, it will be a total failure. I’ve already put up the performance, if it doesn’t explode, it will be too embarrassing.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips and decided to let the Death Replacement Puppet detonate the Star Burst Ball.
With Wang Ping’s order, the Star Burst Ball in the Death Replacement Puppet’s hand began to shine brightly and exploded instantly.
The terrifying energy instantly swept over the universe, completely destroying everything.
A universe evaporated instantaneously, leaving nothing behind.
The scene was beyond shocking, not even Wang Ping had seen such a scene in real life.
Although, he had just prevented a much more terrifying explosion not long ago.
“The Star Burst Ball is indeed powerful. It truly deserves to be a special item created by a three-digit force.”
Wang Ping, while using the function of the chat group to witness this scene, exclaimed.
“Ding, detected the death of the Sci-fi Mysterious and the destruction of the universe, currently collecting the Sci-fi Mysterious’s Origin, while uploading the battle record to the Heaven Tower.”
“Ding, upload successful, received response, this chat group obtained a total of fifty thousand Origin Degrees of World Source. Meanwhile, collected the scattered World Source of the universe, additionally obtained ten thousand Origin Degrees of World Source.”
At this moment, the mechanical voice of the chat group sounded, eliciting a quirk of Wang Ping’s eyebrows.
“So, after killing the Mysterious, not only do you gain from the Mysterious itself but also from uploading to the Heaven Tower? The relationship between Heaven Tower and Mysterious is more complicated than I imagined.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flashed as he contemplated.
For a moment, Wang Ping even considered the Mysterious to be released by the Heaven Tower…

chapters.title: Chapter 1198 - 1198 305 Another 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1198: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King! Chapter 1198: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King! “But whether or not the sci-fi mysterious stuff is released by the Heaven Tower doesn’t have much to do with me now. After all, my strength is still too weak, and knowing too much will only bring me more trouble.”
Wang Ping shakes his head and quickly clears his mind of these thoughts.
Next, Wang Ping plans to use the World Source for a paid simulation.
“System, if I use the World Source for a paid simulation, how much World Source will I need to consume?”
Wang Ping silently asks in his heart.
“Ding, detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the 5-digit limit, and 10,000 Origin Degrees of World Source are needed.”
The system’s voice sounds.
“10,000 Origin Degrees… this is really scarily expensive. I barely managed to kill Sci-fi Mysterious, and I can only simulate six times?”
Wang Ping hears this price and can’t help but frown.
For a moment, he feels that using World Source for paid simulation is a very luxurious act.
After all, the versatility of World Source is much higher than that of Quasi Fairy King instruments, and it is also harder to obtain.
Although Quasi Fairy King instruments are also very precious, as long as Wang Ping goes to the Immortal Domain, he can easily obtain them.
“Try a paid simulation with World Source once and see the difference. Then, go for a paid simulation with a Quasi Fairy King instrument. World Source can be used as a backup or in emergencies.”
Wang Ping thinks for a while and then makes a decision.
“System, consume World Source. I want to go for a paid simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping speaks in his heart.
“Ding, consuming 10,000 Origin Degrees of World Source, Life Simulator starts, Talent Refreshing in progress….”
The system’s voice sounds.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations, host successfully refreshed 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack; Six-digit Talent: Curse Breaking.”
5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack: With this talent, the more dangerous the host’s situation, the more powerful the host can burst out.
However, because this talent is only 5 digits, there is a limit to the power it can increase, so don’t expect it to be able to infinitely increase its power.
Six-digit Talent: Curse Breaking: Using this talent, it can break some control-type talents, props, skill effects.
However, because this talent is only six digits, its curse-breaking ability has a limit, so the host must be careful.
“Tsk, what a pity for the Six-digit Talent: Curse Breaking….”
Wang Ping looks at the two talents refreshed this time and can’t help but smack his lips.
If this Curse Breaking talent were 5 digits, Wang Ping would have chosen it without hesitation.
Unfortunately, this thing is just a six-digit talent, and its value is greatly reduced, with a small scope of application.
Although it may be useful in the first few floors of the Sky Tower Game, Wang Ping is now pursuing dealing with the Second Generation Chat Group Leader, and a six-digit talent seems inadequate.
After all, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader is a 5-digit existence, and a 6-digit control-breaking talent might not be able to break the leader’s talents.
“System, I choose the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack.”
Wang Ping thinks for a while and then selects the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack.
Although the talent has a limit, it can still be used to increase his power, and like Charging Punch, it can be used as a trump card.
Furthermore, this talent seems to be passively triggered and doesn’t need to be actively triggered, making it quite practical.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, life simulation begins….”
The system’s voice sounds.
Then, the luminescent screen appears, and familiar text begins to emerge.
[Day 1: You choose to act like your previous simulation, heading to the Immortal Domain and arriving in the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm.]
[After arriving in the Spiritual Sound Secret Realm, you begin your cultivation in seclusion, Enlightenment, and try to comprehend your Chaotic Immortal King and Chaotic Immortal King Sutra.]
[In the blink of an eye, 100,000 years have passed. With the help of Ye Cang’s version of the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra, you successfully comprehended the Chaotic Immortal King in these 100,000 years, and also created your own Chaotic Immortal King Sutra.]
[With this, your combat power has risen to an astonishing level. Now, you are confident enough to fight against entry-tier four-digit powerhouses.]
[Just as you are full of confidence, the Flame Demon Clan attacks. This time, you still easily kill the four Quasi-Demon Kings of the Flame Demon Clan, obtaining many good items.]
[Then, you ask Chu Lingyin to leave. You, on the other hand, stay put, waiting for the arrival of the Flame Demon King. You want to use the battle with the Flame Demon King to gauge your combat power.]
[Your actions are incomprehensible to Chu Lingyin. She anxiously urges you to leave, telling you not to be impulsive. After all, as long as you concentrate on cultivating and breaking through to the Immortal King-tier, everything will be truly secure, and it would be difficult for the Demon Clan to find them easily under the protection of an Immortal King.]
[However, you don’t pay attention to Chu Lingyin’s persuasion and ask her to leave first, trusting your own judgement.]
[Seeing that she can’t persuade you, Chu Lingyin sighs and chooses to leave.]
[Soon after, the Flame Demon Clan learns of the fall of their four great Quasi-Demon Kings, causing shock and anger in the Flame Demon King, who steps out and heads directly to the Small Immortal Territories to find you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1199 - 1199 305 Another 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1199: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_2 Chapter 1199: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_2 [When the Flame Demon Clan arrived, you displayed a fervent desire for battle, saying that you had been waiting for this moment for a long time and hoped that the Flame Demon King wouldn’t disappoint you.]
[The Flame Demon King stared at you, feeling a sense of danger from you, which was quite surprising. After all, it was rare for a Quasi Fairy King to pose a threat to an Immortal King or a Demon King.]
[From ancient times till now, those who were able to threaten Immortal Kings and Demon Kings at the Quasi Fairy King tier were all true aberrations, destined to become Immortal Kings or even reach the upper tier above the Immortal Kings. Once such individuals grow up, they are truly terrifying.]
[The Flame Demon King, thinking of the tragic state of the Immortal Domain, felt a horrifying killing intent and wanted to kill you and eliminate future troubles.]
[Upon seeing the Flame Demon King’s intentions, you laughed heartily, telling him to try and kill you if he could. Then, you took the initiative to attack the Flame Demon King. The Chaotic Immortal King Sutra and Chaotic Immortal King were unleashed without reservation.]
[As you launched the attack, the Flame Demon King also became serious, and his killing intent towards you skyrocketed again. You had already comprehended the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra and Chaotic Immortal King. That is to say, as long as you have some time to accumulate or find a shocking Immortal Elixir, you can easily break through to the Immortal King-tier and become a powerful Chaos Immortal King.]
[By then, you will truly become a threat to the Flame Demon Clan and even the entire Demon Clan.]
[For this reason, the Flame Demon King went all out from the start to completely kill you. It must be said that the Demon King’s battle prowess is indeed terrifying. Even if the Flame Demon King’s cultivation was only at the early stage of Demon King, equivalent to the early stage of Immortal King and the four-digit Entry-tier stage, a Demon King is still a Demon King – when he goes all out, even you who have comprehended the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra and Chaotic Immortal King still felt immense pressure.]
[However, although you felt tremendous pressure, you were not afraid, laughing heartily and fighting harder and harder. Although you were being suppressed, it also proved one thing – that you now have the power to confront Demon Kings and Immortal Kings head-on.]
[If you were to add your other abilities, you might have the power to defeat the Demon King.]
[Next, as the pressure from the Flame Demon King grew stronger, the talent effect of the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack gradually increased, enhancing your combat power.]
[This surprised the Flame Demon King and made him feel that you were very difficult to deal with. Continuing the battle like this, he might indeed not be able to defeat you.]
[At the critical moment, you found an opportunity and unleashed the fully charged 5-digit Talent: Accumulating Power Punch. With the explosion of the Charging Punch, the Flame Demon King was directly blown away, while his body shattered.]
[Although the Flame Demon King recovered instantly, he still suffered considerable damage. This made his face darken and became even more wary of you.]
[Next, the Flame Demon King used an item – an unusual rope quietly appeared and bound you. Your face changed slightly, feeling the suppression of your powers and unable to move.]
[At this, you could only sigh secretly, thinking that those who could enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise were indeed full of various trump cards, making them very troublesome to deal with. It can be said that at this level, strength alone is no longer an accurate measure of one’s capabilities.]
[With various talents, items, and skills to aid them, the weak could also be hidden vipers capable of biting the strong to death.]
[Seeing that you couldn’t break free, the Flame Demon King sneered, saying that you should be proud you forced him to use the precious 5-digit Supreme Item. Next, he would end your life.]
[After saying that, the Flame Demon King began to accumulate power, preparing to unleash his strongest attack to completely annihilate you.]
[Seeing this, your face darkened, knowing that you couldn’t delay any longer and used the effect of the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain.]
[The 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain can seal the effects of talents, items, and skills below four digits. With the effect of the 5-digit Item: Magic-Sealing Domain active, the effect of the rope item binding you vanished instantly.]
[With that, you let out a cold snort and broke free. This surprised the Flame Demon King, who showed an astonished expression, not expecting that you still had such a trump card.]
[Next, the Flame Demon King tried to use other items’ effects but found that none of them worked, making him more cautious. Your trump card was too powerful.]
[At the same time, the Flame Demon King was unable to determine whether the item only sealed his own items or both parties’ items. If it only sealed his, then he would be in big trouble. If both parties couldn’t use items, he could accept that.]
[For a moment, the Flame Demon King’s gaze flickered, not daring to act rashly against you. However, he was not flustered. After all, he had contacted other Demon Kings to come when he started fighting.]
[It would take some time for the other Demon Kings to arrive. He only needed to hold you off, and once they arrived, they could easily kill you together.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - 1200 305 Another 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1200: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_3 Chapter 1200: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_3 [Naturally, you could see Flame Demon King’s intentions, you sneered and turned into a Divine Halo, fleeing into the distance.]
[Seeing this, the Flame Demon King’s expression changed slightly. He wanted to chase after you but was extremely wary of your other trump cards.]
[It was at this moment of hesitation that you quickly fled from the Demon Forbidden Domain’s range and used your 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery.]
[With the activation of your 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery, your figure was instantly teleported away from the Small Immortal Territories to another world.]
[Seeing this, the complexion of Flame Demon King turned extremely ugly, knowing that a catastrophe might descend upon the Flame Demon Clan and even the entire Demon Clan.]
[After all, a monster that can fight against him, a Demon King, and injure him with only Quasi Fairy King cultivation, would be unimaginable when completely grown into an Immortal King.]
[However, even though the Flame Demon King was furious, he was powerless. He could never catch you again]
[Not long after, the story of your battle with the Flame Demon King, injuring him, and successfully escaping from him, spread throughout the Small Immortal Territories and the entire Demon Realm, horrifying countless cultivators.]
[Among them, Chu Lingyin was even more shocked, followed by ecstasy. However, when she tried to contact you, she discovered that she couldn’t reach you, making her worry again.]
….
“I finally grew enough to challenge a four-digit existence, but it wasn’t easy.”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, his heart filled with emotion.
Of course, Wang Ping knew that if any other person heard these words, they would probably scold him.
“What do you mean it wasn’t easy, you’ve been a cheater till now, it wasn’t even difficult for you to reach this level, then we might as well not live.”
“Next, I should break through to the Immortal King-tier. Although, I guess there’s no way to claim the Immortal King cultivation reward.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, pondering in his heart.
As of now, the Life Simulator, with just a five-digit talent, could not obtain Immortal King-tier cultivation.
Unless, he upgrades Life Simulator again and raises it to a four-digit talent, then he would be able to obtain the Immortal King cultivation.
“However, the Four-digit Rule Stone really is a problem.”
Wang Ping thought of the Four-digit Rule Stone and couldn’t help but click his tongue.
Damn it, if he could just pick up a four-digit level Rule Stone, it would be awesome.
“But that’s just wishful thinking, stuff like that only exist in dreams and not in reality.”
Wang Ping once again ridiculed himself and then refocused his attention on the luminescent screen.
[Your chosen destination after using your 5-digit Talent·Fixed-point Delivery was a world with an Immortal King, albeit an inclusive and relatively safe one.]
[Upon arriving in this world, you began searching for information about the Immortal Fruits that could help you break through to the Immortal King-tier. In the past, even if you obtain an Immortal Fruit, you would not have been able to breakthrough. However, now that you have comprehended the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra and the Chaotic Immortal King, you only lack the energy to assist your Tao Fruit.]
[For this purpose, you went all out. To obtain this Immortal Elixir, you even offered three scriptures for trade. And these three scriptures happened to be the Chaos Demon King Scripture, the Chaos Immortal King Scripture, and the Celestial Spirit Immortal Scripture.]
[The emergence of these three scriptures shocked the Immortal World, making all the cultivators go wild with enthusiasm. Even the Immortal Kings had to show interest.]
[At one point, even an Immortal King made a move against you. However, you showed no fear and unleashed terrifying power, fighting against the Immortal King and proving that you have reached the Immortal King-tier strength.]
[This made other Immortal Kings give up on repressing you and seizing your scriptures. After all, if they don’t kill you completely and you escape, you’d become their nightmare. By the time you breakthrough to the Immortal King-tier, they would be doomed to die at your hands.]
[As for the Immortal King who fought against you, he gave up and apologized, providing you with ample compensation. In response, you chose not to continue holding a grudge against him and accepted his gifts.]
[Soon after, an Immortal King found you and offered an Immortal Fruit for trade. However, he did not want your three Immortal King Sutras; instead, he hoped for you to join his Immortal King Palace, and to have you marry his daughter as your Tao Companion.]
[Upon hearing this, you were quite surprised. After some consideration and in order to maximize your chances of survival in the future, you decided to accept the Immortal King’s request, joined his Immortal King Palace, and married his daughter as your Tao Companion.]
[Your decision to join the Immortal King’s Palace sent shockwaves throughout the Immortal Domain. For a time, other Immortal Kings lamented that they didn’t have a spare Immortal Fruit or a suitable female heir, otherwise, having you as their son-in-law would make them the strongest faction. Not to mention, the prospect of having descendants was even more amazing.]
[However, it was too late for regrets. They could only attend your wedding begrudgingly while extending their congratulations. At this point, you felt the advantages that came with having power – without it, these old monsters would never be so amiable and easy to talk with.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - 1201 305 Another 5-digit Talent Breaking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1201: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_4 Chapter 1201: Chapter 305: Another 5-digit Talent! Breaking through the Immortal King!_4 [Following the grand wedding, you began your cultivation in seclusion, devouring the Tao Fruit to breakthrough to the Immortal King-tier.]
[This time, you cultivated in seclusion for a whole 100,000 years. After 100,000 years, you successfully broke through to the Immortal King-tier. Under the terrifying Immortal King Tribulation, you showed no fear and confronted it head-on.]
[In the end, under the astonished gaze of many Immortal Kings, you successfully crossed the Tribulation and became a powerful Immortal King. For a time, your spirit soared to the highest point.]
[At this time, an Immortal King came forward, wanting to challenge you. To this, you laughed heartily, not refusing, and chose to fight with him.]
[Although the 5-digit Talent was no longer useful because you had broken through to the Immortal King-tier, your amazing foundation allowed your strength to still increase significantly after breaking through.]
[As a result, in this battle, you easily defeated this early-stage Immortal King, making all living beings aware of your power.]
[Next, another Immortal King took action. This Immortal King had Mid-Immortal King Stage cultivation, even stronger than the previous Immortal King.]
[This time, you fought with him but were completely suppressed and unable to defeat him. From this, you realized something. Although the Chaotic Body is powerful, other Immortal Kings are not easily provoked. At the Immortal King-tier, the gap between each small realm is extremely large, making it difficult to battle across levels.]
[Unless you acquire a bunch of four-digit Talents, artifact skills, or evolve your Chaotic Body into Chaos Immortal Body, you might be able to once again battle across levels and be unrivaled at the Immortal King-tier.]
[While many thoughts flashed through your mind, the Immortal King fighting you stopped just in time, indicating that he was sparing you from humiliation. To this, you bowed your thanks.]
[After the dust settled, the Immortal World became peaceful once more, and you resumed your cultivation, disinterested in the outer world’s changes and the so-called competition among the world’s geniuses.]
[Truth be told, although you were still young, you had become an Immortal King, which granted you the status and identity of an Ancestor-tier, so there were few things that could catch your eye.]
[In the blink of an eye, nearly 200,000 years had passed. During these 200,000 years, your cultivation had improved, but you ultimately didn’t break through to Mid-Immortal King Stage.]
[However, you weren’t idle. You successfully forged your own Immortal King Instrument: Chaos Immortal Clothes. Regrettably, the Devouring Immortal Bead couldn’t break through to the Immortal King’s Artifact level due to material limitations, leaving you quite disappointed.]
[Soon after, the Dark Disaster eventually broke out, leaving you with a heavy heart. Not only your heart but also the expressions of the Immortal Kings in this world turned very solemn.]
[The outbreak of the Dark Disaster wasn’t unusual, so the Immortal Kings of this world seldom died in battle. Everyone understood that having one more Immortal King would make the world safer when the Dark Disaster struck.]
[However, the intensity of this Dark Disaster seemed to be beyond common sense. Its scale seemed to far surpass that of the past, giving the Immortal Kings a feeling of impending doom.]
[Hearing your father-in-law’s murmurs, you couldn’t help but feel a slight tremor in your eyelids, knowing that you had likely brought misfortune to this Immortal World. It could be said that wherever you went, misfortune followed. There was nothing you could do. The Dark Disaster was aimed at you, and there was no escape.]
[But at this point, you naturally wouldn’t voice your thoughts, as these Immortal Kings might not be able to resist killing you first.]
[Of course, it was already too late to kill you now. The outbreak of the Dark Disaster would not stop unless the invading dark beings died out or the world was destroyed. No third possibility could occur.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - 1202 306 Wang Ping acting pretentious The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1202: Chapter 306: Wang Ping acting pretentious! The shocking intelligence of the Sky Tower! Chapter 1202: Chapter 306: Wang Ping acting pretentious! The shocking intelligence of the Sky Tower! “Finally reached the Immortal King-tier, but it seems my end is near.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the Text Simulation and sighed, then sentenced the simulated Wang Ping to death.
Although Immortal Kings are powerful, they are still too weak compared to the Source of Darkness.
It’s not clear, what kind of Dark Beings will appear this time.
As Wang Ping was thinking, the Text Simulation continued.
[Next, you and other Immortal Kings fought together against the Dark Beings. Surprisingly, the 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter could still provide you with strength enhancement. At least, when you faced Dark Beings, it was so. Although the power increase was much less than when you were at the Quasi Fairy King Tier, it was still pretty good.]
[As a result, you easily killed a Dark Being equivalent to the Early Immortal King Stage, then fought a Dark Being equivalent to Mid-Immortal King Stage and easily suppressed it.]
[Although your fighting power is much stronger than when you first reached the Immortal King-tier, the power enhancement provided by the Night Hunter cannot be ignored. Due to your burst of power, you directly exploded the Dark Being equivalent to Mid-Immortal King Stage.]
[Your achievements amazed the other Immortal Kings, who felt that your growth was too fast and that you could even fight across realms at the Immortal King-tier. Truly remarkable.]
[However, the other Immortal Kings didn’t have much time to marvel at your achievements, as they discovered something terrifying – the Dark Disaster was not weakening but growing stronger.]
[This caused a sense of foreboding in the hearts of all the powerful beings – it felt like a great catastrophe was imminent.]
[Just as they were pondering, a figure slowly walked out from the Sea of Darkness. Its terrifying presence made all the Immortal Kings’ faces change color.]
[Because the aura of this figure had reached the Immortal King Great Perfection Tier. However, if it was just a simple Immortal King Great Perfection, they might still accept it, as they also had an Immortal King Great Perfection powerhouse on their side.]
[What frightened them most was that this Dark Being was obviously not just at the Immortal King Great Perfection cultivation; it was an existence equivalent to an Immortal King Giant. To become an Immortal King Giant, a being needed to reach the Immortal King Great Perfection cultivation and possess a powerful constitution, like a Chaotic Body or its equivalent.]
[Immortal King Giants were the strongest beings among Immortal Kings. Defeating a Top Fairy King might not be a big deal for them, but they couldn’t just kill such beings instantly.]
[The arrival of this powerful Dark Being meant that the Dark Disaster aimed to destroy the Immortal World.]
[For a moment, the faces of all the mighty beings in the battlefield turned extremely ugly, and they felt like escaping with their clansmen. However, they knew that the chances of escape were minimal during the Dark Disaster. While Immortal Kings could travel to other worlds, they could only do so when the Dark Disaster hadn’t erupted.]
[Even so, there would still be a possibility of falling. If they tried to escape during the Dark Disaster, the chances of falling would be absolutely above 99%.]
[As all the Immortal Kings were heavy-hearted, the one at the Immortal King Great Perfection cultivation among them stepped forward, saying there was no need to panic too much. He would hold off this Dark Immortal King Giant, and the other Immortal Kings should assist him, using powerful artifacts to kill the Dark King.]
[If they faced the Dark Immortal King Giant alone, none of them had any confidence in victory. However, the Dark Immortal King could not enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise and obtain those 4-digit artifacts, so there was still hope for victory.]
[Hearing this, the other Immortal Kings’ spirits lifted, and they all nodded. Although they were reluctant to expose their trump cards, now was the time to use them.]
[The ensuing battle saw the united Immortal Kings face the Dark Immortal King Giant, as various 4-digit artifacts emerged, leaving you astonished.]
[The final battle outcome made you both surprised and relieved. With the Immortal Kings working seamlessly together and utilizing various artifacts, the much more powerful Dark Immortal King Giant was killed by them.]
[This again proved that due to the existence of the Myriad Heavens Paradise, the weak defeating the strong was not a rare feat.]
[However, just as the Immortal Kings let out a breath of relief, a terrifying new presence appeared. This time, not one but five Dark Immortal King Giants emerged.]
[This made all the Immortal Kings in this world fall silent. There were only ten Immortal Kings in this world, and you, an outsider, made it eleven.]
[However, there were now five Dark Immortal King Giants. How could they possibly win this battle?]
[For a moment, all the Immortal Kings, including you, were plunged into despair and fear of the power of the Sea of Darkness. You couldn’t help but wonder how many powerful Dark Beings lurked within the sea.]
[As you despaired, a Dark Immortal King Giant spoke up, mockingly looking at the other Immortal Kings and saying that they had really risked everything for you, an outsider. If it weren’t for your existence, such a terrifying Dark Disaster wouldn’t have erupted to destroy this world completely.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - 1203 306 Wang Ping Acting Tough Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1203: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _2 Chapter 1203: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _2 [The words of the Dark Immortal King shook the others to their core, fixing their gazes on you with surprise and disbelief. The cause of the Dark Disaster was this outsider.]
[Even though they did not know why the darkness attached such importance to you, an outsider, they didn’t want to ponder too much at this moment. They hated you deeply.]
[If it were not for you, they would not have experienced this unfolding disaster. Now, their lives were hanging by a thread; their ethnic powers would be thoroughly destroyed. The immense loathing made them wish to tear you apart.]
[What’s more, without waiting for the Dark Immortal King to make a move, the top-ranked Fairy King began to take action against you with a grim expression, intending to suppress you and hand you over to the Dark Immortal King.]
[During this process, your father-in-law showed complex emotions and made no move to help.]
[Seeing this, you sighed. You didn’t blame them. After all, this was indeed your fault. Therefore, you opted to rush to the Dark Immortal King and self-detonate.]
[With your self-detonation, you fell.]
[Due to your demise, this simulation ends here…..]
…
As the text simulation ended, many memories and realizations of cultivation emerged in Wang Ping’s mind, leaving him lost in thought for a long time.
“The Source of Darkness is getting more and more concerned with me. But every time, he makes his move around the same time. Someone must be stopping him; otherwise, he could have crushed me earlier.”
With a frown, Wang Ping came back to his senses.
However, the Life Simulator currently only has a 5-digit Talent, so its simulation content cannot be completely trusted and might have distortions, just like any Sci-fi Mysterious show.
Either the true form of the Source of Darkness might be trying to mislead me, or the time left for me in reality might not be much.
For this reason, I must strive to grow stronger without procrastination.
While Wang Ping was preoccupied with these thoughts, the system’s voice once again sounded.
“Ding, reward generation successful. The host can choose two from the following rewards:
①. Chaotic Fairy Clothes (Life-bound Fairy King Artifact).
②. 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack
③. Six-digit Talent: Curse Breaking.
④. Random Quasi Fairy King Instrument.”
……
“Oh? This time a Fairy King-tier Chaotic Fairy Clothes has appeared? That’s surprising. However, the Immortal Fruit that could help me breakthrough to the Fairy King-tier did not appear. That’s a shame.”
Wang Ping was both surprised and regretful looking at the rewards this time.
If he had that Immortal Fruit, Wang Ping could quickly breakthrough to the Fairy King-tier using the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Also, within the life simulation, he could keep using this Immortal Fruit repeatedly.
However, since it isn’t there, Wang Ping had to give up on that hope quickly:”System, I choose ①. Chaotic Fairy Clothes and ②. 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack.”
“Ding, reward selection successful, distribution in progress….”
The system’s voice sounded again.
Then, Wang Ping felt the influx of information about the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack in his brain.
Meanwhile, a Chaotic Fairy Outfit wrapped in fairy lights appeared in front of Wang Ping.
However, this was Wang Ping’s original Chaotic Fairy Clothes and not those rewarded by the system.
Just as when Wang Ping first obtained the Devouring Immortal Bead, this Chaotic Fairy Clothes started evolving rapidly. Mysteriously, materials flew towards Wang Ping and incorporated into the Chaotic Fairy Clothes.
Apparently, Fairy King-tier Chaotic Fairy Clothes was beyond the creation capability of the Life Simulator. Hence, it chose to reverse causality for granting this reward, just like last time.
However, whether it was due to the Life Simulator reaching five-digit talent, or because no killing was required this time, fortunately, there was no cause-and-effect Wang Ping needed to address personally.
Undeniably, this outcome pleased Wang Ping immensely.
After all, he had no immediate plans to head to that Immortal World.
However, due to the great commotion caused by the birth of Fairy King Artifact, the whole world was filled with enchanting fairy mists. Countless cultivators benefited from it, their cultivation progressing by leaps and bounds, and enlightenment came naturally.
The so-called Last Dharma Age was virtually insignificant under the radiance of the born Fairy King Artifact.
To the extent that, the commotion even alarmed Lu Daoxian in the channel.
Lu Daoxian crossed the channel and was astonished by seeing the situation in the Upper Realm. His fish-like eyes widened, finding it almost unbelievable.
The notion of the Chaos Immortal King Artifact being created in an affiliated lower Immortal Domain was inconceivable.
For a moment, Lu Daoxian couldn’t help but take a step forward, arriving at the Upper Realm, wanting to see firsthand what was happening.
However, as he arrived with the radiance of the Immortal king Artifact, he saw Wang Ping.
Upon seeing Wang Ping, Lu Daoxian was further astonished.
He did not expect at all to find a Quasi-Fairy king in the lower realm.
Moreover, this Quasi-Fairy King was clearly walking in the Path of Chaos.
Besides, the comprehension of the Dao by this Quasi-Fairy King had evidently surpassed him. It seemed he was only half a step away from becoming a Fairy King.
“May I ask senior, did you forge this?”
A multitude of thoughts flashed in Lu Daoxian’s heart. He could not calm down and bowed his hand in salute to Wang Ping.
Even though he had many questions and was unaware of Wang Ping’s situation, in the world of cultivators, respect should be given to the more advanced cultivators. Therefore, Lu Daoxian chose to address Wang Ping as senior, a sign of respect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - 1204 306 Wang Ping Acting Tough Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1204: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _3 Chapter 1204: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _3 Although Wang Ping and he were both Quasi Fairy Kings, Wang Ping, who was about to step into the Immortal King-tier, had become an existence he needed to look up to.
Not to mention, Wang Ping was walking the Path of Chaos, even forging the Chaos Immortal King Artifact ahead of time in the Lower Plane.
This method could be said to be shocking and outrageous.
Wang Ping’s combat power could probably easily kill him in seconds.
Therefore, Lu Daoxian willingly called him senior.
“Indeed, I forged it.”
Wang Ping saw Lu Daoxian’s thoughts and didn’t explain anything. He also found it too troublesome to explain, so he chose to hold the status of a senior expert.
“Congratulations to Senior for successfully forging your life-bound weapon. With you here, the Immortal Domain might be saved.”
Lu Daoxian congratulated with respect and tentatively said.
“Hehe, I understand the situation in the Immortal Domain. However, it’s not time yet. When I am completely invincible in the world, I will naturally take action and lead you to expel the Demon Clan.”
Wang Ping chuckled and revealed his thoughts.
“I will wait for the good news from Senior!”
Lu Daoxian’s face showed joy, and after seeing hope, he no longer showed any decadence.
“My friend, I have a favor to ask, I don’t know if you are willing to help.”
Wang Ping grinned, revealing a discordant expression.
“As long as it is within my power, I will definitely do my best to help Senior.”
Lu Daoxian said solemnly.
“Very good.” Wang Ping patted Lu Daoxian’s shoulder and said, “My Immortal King’s Artifact is still somewhat imperfect and needs some Quasi Fairy King instruments to melt. Inform the Immortal Alliance to bring more Quasi Fairy King instruments. Of course, safety comes first.”
“Senior, although this is the Lower Plane, not the Immortal Domain, it’s still better not to mention the words ‘Immortal King’ for the sake of safety.”
Lu Daoxian’s face changed dramatically upon hearing Wang Ping’s words.
“…..”
Wang Ping was speechless.
What had that senior in the First Generation Transcender Chat Group done to scare Lu Daoxian like this? Just mentioning the Immortal Realm and the Immortal King made him tremble.
“Don’t be too concerned. However, I will be careful.”
Wang Ping sighed and spoke.
“I just want to know if you can get those things.”
“This… “Lu Daoxian revealed a troubled expression.
“Senior, I don’t know if my life-bound weapon will work?” Lu Daoxian gritted his teeth and said.
Hearing this, his Quasi Fairy King instrument trembled, expressing its feelings of grievance.
So love does disappear, doesn’t it?
“Both you and Chu Lingyin’s won’t work. Moreover, I need more than just one or two.”
Wang Ping said indifferently.
“I see.” Lu Daoxian fell into thought.
“Senior, I do know of a place with a few treasures that might be of help to you.”
Then, Lu Daoxian’s eyes sparkled as he spoke.
“Oh? You know of such a good place?”
Wang Ping was quite surprised, his eyes shining.
Wang Ping hadn’t heard Lu Daoxian mention this in the Life Simulator.
However, when Wang Ping thought about it carefully, he realized that in the life simulation, the simulated Wang Ping didn’t need Quasi Fairy King instruments, and it was normal for Lu Daoxian not to mention it since this matter was not brought up.
“The Immortal Domains and Immortal King Secret Territories are indeed few, but they do exist. Although these secret realms disappeared due to the shattered Immortal Domain, I still know of a place with an Immortal King Secret Territory.”
Lu Daoxian hesitated for a moment before speaking.
“Where?” Wang Ping asked curiously.
“Primordial Immortal World!”
Lu Daoxian’s eyes flickered as he said these three words.
“Primordial Immortal World?” Wang Ping raised his eyebrows slightly. He had never heard of this name.
“The Primordial Immortal World is not in the Immortal Domain, but in an affiliated lower plane of the Immortal Domain. It is a legacy secret realm left behind by a Demon King-tier powerhouse from the Immortal Domain in the Lower Plane. I discovered it accidentally while guarding the Immortal Domain Channel and occasionally checking on the lower plane.”
Lu Daoxian said earnestly.
“Since it is a legacy secret realm left by a Demon King-tier powerhouse from the Immortal Domain, there must be quite a few good items. Perhaps what Senior needs is in there.”
“……”
Wang Ping’s eyes were subtle. Although he knew that the Demon King-tier powerhouse in the Immortal Domain mentioned by Lu Daoxian was the Immortal King, the way of talking was really strange.
“Senior, I’ll give you the coordinates immediately. You can go and explore the secret realm when you have time.”
Lu Daoxian bowed and condensed a ball of light.
Upon seeing this, Wang Ping nodded, accepted it, and received the message inside.
“I’ll go and take a look when I have time.”
Wang Ping nodded with satisfaction.
“In that case, I will take my leave first and continue guarding the channel. If Senior has any other requests, please feel free to contact me.”
Lu Daoxian bowed again and said seriously.
“Go ahead, I will contact you if there’s anything.”
Wang Ping nodded.
Lu Daoxian bowed his head once more, expressed his respects, and disappeared.
“Primordial Immortal World, the Immortal King Secret Territory, huh? Not a bad place. However, now is not the time to go there.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he thought to himself.
Now, the Life Simulator only had 5-digit Talent. Continuing the simulation would be a waste of resources, Wang Ping felt it more and more wasteful as he thought about it.
After all, once the Life Simulator is upgraded to four-digit talent, it would be able to refresh various four-digit talents, and that would be truly exhilarating.

chapters.title: Chapter 1205 - 1205 306 Wang Ping Acting Tough Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1205: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _4 Chapter 1205: Chapter 306: Wang Ping Acting Tough! Shocking Intelligence of the Sky Tower! _4 “Let’s head back to Myriad Heavens Paradise. Once back, find a four-digit Rule Stone as soon as possible. Of course, before that, it is necessary to deal with the Second Generation Chat Group Leader Dao Yi.”
Wang Ping’s eyes gleamed with coldness, and he sneered.
Now, having comprehended the Chaotic Immortal King and Chaotic Immortal King Sutra, although he had not yet reached the four-digit level, he already possessed the power to fight against four-digit beings.
Perhaps, once in Myriad Heavens Paradise, his Spirit Grid would be judged as a four-digit one.
By then, facing Second Generation Chat Group Master Dao Yi would be a complete crush.
Without hesitation, Wang Ping chose to summon the Paradise Pass and headed to Myriad Heavens Paradise.
When Wang Ping came back, Alpha looked at him strangely.
Wang Ping had only been gone for a short time, and his strength had surged once again.
It could only be said that as long as he had enough resources, Wang Ping’s rate of getting stronger was shockingly fast.
As Alpha marveled at this, Wang Ping discovered that his strength had transformed into a special power system of Myriad Heavens Paradise.
However, his Spirit Grid still hadn’t reached the four-digit level.
“Looks like I need my strength and physique to catch up to be judged as four-digit. That is to say, breaking through to Immortal King is necessary. But my current strength should be considered a five-digit anomaly.”
Wang Ping felt his Spirit Grid and raised an eyebrow.
The so-called anomaly was surpassing the strength of that level, capable of fighting higher digit beings, without having a higher digit Spirit Grid.
Wang Ping now was a rare anomaly.
Although he was only a five-digit anomaly, this was enough to cause a sensation.
Then, Wang Ping composed himself, looked at Alpha, and laughed softly: “Alpha, I just caught up with you recently, so let’s not chat now. Next, I’m going to challenge the Heaven Tower. Let’s talk more when I’m back. When I come back, it’s time for me to avenge you.”
“Avenge…”
Hearing these two words, Alpha’s eyes were filled with waves of emotion.
“Hmm, I’ll wait for you to come back and avenge me.”
Then, Alpha rarely showed a smile, and said with great anticipation.
“Hehe, I’ll be back soon.”
Wang Ping nodded, using the Paradise Pass to head for the Heaven Tower.
The next moment, Wang Ping appeared in his personal space in the Heaven Tower. A familiar luminescent screen appeared in front of Wang Ping.
The lively voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded again.
“Ding, Player Tianyan, it has been detected that you have returned from outside the Paradise, so you must participate in the Sky Tower Game within three days. Would you like to begin the Sky Tower Game immediately?”
“Start the Sky Tower Game right away.”
Wang Ping’s eyes gleamed, speaking calmly.
“Ding, it has been detected that Player Tianyan has cleared the second floor of the Heavenly Tower – Meng Gui Street. You will now proceed to the third floor of the Sky Tower Game. Please choose the difficulty level from the options below.”
The lively voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded again, and the content on the luminescent screen changed.
However, there was still only Abyss mode, leaving Wang Ping speechless.
“I choose Abyss mode.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, speaking calmly.
Having experienced this twice, he had become completely used to it.
“Oh, Sky Tower Intelligence, from now on, always choose Abyss mode for me. I don’t care about anything else, I’m just stubborn.”
Then, Wang Ping curled his lips and arrogantly uttered these words.
Since he couldn’t resist, he might as well lie down and enjoy it. It’s not bad to use it to show off.
“Surprising! Player Tianyan, are you sure you want to fix your choice on Abyss mode? Once fixed, it cannot be changed!”
The slightly surprised voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1206 - 1206 307 The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1206: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits Chapter 1206: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits “…”
Wang Ping stared at the luminescent screen in front of him, his eyelid twitching slightly.
He uttered that pretentious statement without expecting the Sky Tower Intelligence to really respond, but now that it had, he was in a bit of a pickle.
Could it be that his assumption that some big shot had influenced the Sky Tower was wrong?
For instance, it wasn’t the member of the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group that was influencing the Sky Tower, but the Sky Tower itself was targeting him.
After all, if the Sky Tower was truly responding to him, it shouldn’t overlook the anomaly that he could only choose Abyss mode.
Furthermore, being stuck in Abyss mode was unquestionably problematic.
Once selected, he would lured into the trap of being stuck with Abyss mode forever going forward.
“Dammit, this is really annoying.”
Wang Ping cursed under his breath, feeling like he was riding a tiger and had difficulty getting off.
After all, the pretentious words he uttered earlier would be embarrassing to retract now.
But Wang Ping was just thinking about this and didn’t actually do it.
When it came to safety, saving face was nonsense.
Therefore, Wang Ping was ready to take back those words, trying to act as if nothing had happened.
“Ding, the system has detected that Player Tianyan hasn’t responded, and as such, it is assumed that Player Tianyan has chosen to permanently opt for Abyss mode.”
“Ding, in view of Player Tianyan’s daring choice to permanently select Abyss mode, the Sky Tower will make a full tower announcement.”
“…”
“???”
Hearing the Sky Tower’s Intelligence’s continuous voiceover, Wang Ping was completely dumbfounded.
Holy crap, I only hesitated for three seconds and you’ve defaulted my choice and made a global announcement?
What the hell, this is too much of a scam!
Wang Ping was stunned, utterly stunned.
For a moment, Wang Ping was certain that he was going to be the laughingstock of Myriad Heavens Paradise in the future.
“Ding, Global Announcement, Player Tianyan is commendably brave, permanently choosing the Abyss mode, which cannot be changed henceforth. As a reward, the Sky Tower will increase the reward allocation under corresponding evaluations.”
“Ding, Global Announcement, Player Tianyan is commendably brave, permanently choosing the Abyss mode, which cannot be changed henceforth. As a reward, the Sky Tower will increase the reward allocation under corresponding evaluations.”
“Ding, Global Announcement, Player Tianyan is commendably brave, permanently choosing the Abyss mode, which cannot be changed henceforth. As a reward, the Sky Tower will increase the reward allocation under corresponding evaluations.”
The continuous tower-wide announcements set the whole Sky Tower space and the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise abuzz.
Even the powerhouses that hadn’t returned to Myriad Heavens Paradise received the announcement.
In an instant, everyone was shocked.
“Tianyan, who is this player? They’re really brave, huh?”
“Heh, so many years have passed and there hasn’t been anyone who dared to permanently select Abyss mode, this guy is probably the first in the history of Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
“The first in history, more like history’s first reckless man. I want to see how long this guy can live.”
“How long will he live? I think he will never return to the Heavenly Paradise again.”
Outside of Myriad Heavens Paradise, many powerhouses who didn’t know that Wang Ping had already cleared two levels of the Sky Tower game and had received SSS tier evaluations before, discussed with peculiar looks.
The reactions of the powerhouses within Myriad Heavens Paradise, however, were somewhat different.
The triple-digit powerhouses had a mixed reaction to Wang Ping.
Some people thought Wang Ping was awesome, and admired or even worshipped him.
Some felt sour and thought that, after receiving SSS tier evaluation consecutively in a short period of time, Wang Ping had floated away, not taking Abyss mode seriously anymore. They believed this sort of attitude was bound to fail, and he would die within the Sky Tower.
However, the reactions from entities with a three-digit power level and above had changed.
“This Tianyan really is commendable in his courage. He didn’t waste much time to receive two SSS tier evaluations. But I didn’t expect him to be unsatisfied and started to challenge the Sky Tower game again, this frequency of challenging the tower really is rare.”
“Heh, it looks like he’s quite an ambitious man, let’s just wait and see how far he can go. Maybe, he might be able to converse with us on equal grounds in less than a million years.”
“The Sky Tower is the only place that could lead you to the two-digit realm. So far, no world where one can break into the two-digit realm through one’s own strength has been found. Any ambitious person would not choose difficulty modes other than Abyss mode. Choosing anything other than Abyss mode makes it very difficult to achieve two digits. As for a single digit… selecting anything other than Abyss mode is like giving up the ambition to reach single digits.”
“That is true, but still, no one has ever had the audacity to permanently select Abyss mode. Everyone wants an out. After all, even for us three-digit existence and even those two-digit entities, as we get further, Abyss mode will consume us with despair.”
“Choosing fixed Abyss mode does increase rewards, but you must be alive to receive them. Let’s just wait and see whether he dares to challenge the tower after going through a situation where he barely scraped by after employing all sorts of methods.”
“There won’t be a second possibility. After experiencing that sort of situation, one is bound to harbor fear towards Sky Tower. He will either stop here, delaying time by relying on time cards, refusing to challenge the tower, or he will abandon everything in Myriad Heavens Paradise and never return. There are quite a few people like that.”
…
Wang Ping could guess all the discussions in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, but he now had no regard for other people’s opinions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - 1207 307 The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1207: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_2 Chapter 1207: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_2 His face was very rigid, wishing he could take apart the Sky Tower Intelligence.
Damn it, it really got fixed, and even announced it to him.
Although it seems that there will be additional rewards for choosing Abyss mode, these rewards seem insignificant compared to the risks it brings.
For a moment, Wang Ping really wanted to cry but couldn’t.
As expected, in situations he can’t control, he shouldn’t act cocky, or it will bring unimaginable consequences.
Being cocky should only be done when one is in complete control and facing people who are much weaker than oneself.
“Ding, congratulations player for choosing the Abyss mode. Next, Player Tianyan will enter the third floor of the Heavenly Tower game map called Qishaxing. Player Tianyan, please make preparations within ten minutes. Ten minutes later, you will be teleported to the game world of Qishaxing.”
The Sky Tower Intelligence’s lively voice rang out once again.
This time, Wang Ping clearly heard the schadenfreude in the voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence.
For a moment, his face grew even darker, and the thought of dismantling the Sky Tower Intelligence became even stronger.
However, Wang Ping eventually took a deep breath, calming down.
Disassembling the Sky Tower Intelligence, he wasn’t qualified yet, far from qualified. He needed to take it slow.
“Qishaxing, weird name…”
Then, Wang Ping frowned tightly, analyzing the game world map this time.
However, although the name of the game was strange, the danger of this game was definitely not less than that of Meng Gui Street on the second floor of the Heavenly Tower. It is very likely to be even more dangerous.
Therefore, one must be cautious and then cautious again.
“Tsk, based on the name, it’s impossible to tell what kind of world this is and what kind of game content it will be. I can only adjust my mentality.”
Wang Ping rubbed his temples, smacking his lips.
As Wang Ping quietly waited, the ten minutes passed quickly.
Then, Wang Ping was wrapped in white light and teleported to the third floor of the Sky Tower’s game world.
When Wang’s consciousness became clear again and his vision restored, he found himself in a western-style castle.
Around Wang Ping, there were six other players.
This made Wang Ping raise his eyebrows slightly, glancing at them with some surprise.
It was surprising that so many people chose Abyss mode on the 3rd tier of the abyss mode.
“Tsk, it seems that the waiting time on the third floor of the Sky Tower is longer than the first two floors. But anyway, we finally gathered enough people.”
As Wang Ping glanced at the others, they were also silently analyzing, a man wearing a Ghost Face Mask yawned and smacked his lips.
This made Wang Ping raise his eyebrows slightly, realizing one more thing.
That is, it seems that each level of the Sky Tower game requires a fixed number of people to start the game.
If the number of people is not enough, the game will not start, and players will have to wait until there are enough people.
It seemed that he was quite lucky in his first three attempts, starting the game instantly, being the last one.
Of course, according to the Ghost Face player, there were more people who chose the first two floors of the Sky Tower game. After the third floor, the number of people gradually decreased, and they needed to queue up and wait for people.
“Hey, which of you is Tianyan? If we count the time, it’s highly possible that Tianyan is the last one to gather enough people to start the game.”
Following the Ghost Face player, a chubby player chuckled and scanned Wang Ping and the others.
With these words, the other players’ eyes flickered, and they too began to look at each other.
“Fatty, you’re the first one to say this, it’s a bit suspicious. Maybe you’re Tianyan yourself, and you’re trying to get rid of suspicion by being the first to speak up?”
A female player with a Rabbit Headdress looked at the chubby player and said meaningfully.
“How could I be Tianyan? Your fat master doesn’t change his name or surname, I am from the Food Divine Hall.”
The chubby player felt a little upset and exposed his arm directly.
Then, a unique pattern of crossed knife and fork appeared in front of Wang Ping and the others, surprising them all.
First, they were surprised at the chubby player’s action of revealing his identity, and second, at the identity of the chubby player.
The Food Divine Hall is a rather special force in Myriad Heavens Paradise, gathering many food lovers from Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, taking pride in eating, believing in the supremacy of gourmet food, and practicing the method of cultivation through eating.
It was rumored that all creatures other than humanoids were on their menu.
The Food Divine Hall has not only a peculiar concept but also a powerful force. It is a Three-digit force and is considered very powerful even among the Three-digit forces.
“Wow, so you’re from the Food Divine Hall, really surprising. It is said that the Food Divine Hall can create special spatial items, so no matter where you are, you can carry delicious food with you and make delicious dishes. I wonder if this is true.”
A man in a suit, combing his hair, asked curiously.
“Of course it’s true. Hehe, while we wait for the game to start, why don’t you guys join me for a feast? By then, we’ll be partners, sincerely cooperating to pass the Sky Tower’s Third Floor together.”
The chubby Player chuckled and spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - 1208 307 The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1208: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_3 Chapter 1208: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_3 “Boring. In the Sky Tower, who dares to eat other people’s things?”
A woman, completely shrouded in a black robe, coldly said.
“Hey, are we off-topic? Weren’t we discussing Heaven Derivative?”
The last player, who looked somewhat weak, spoke cautiously.
“I don’t care about Heaven Derivative. He’s just an arrogant maniac in my opinion, not worth paying attention to.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“Instead of that, why not cooperate sincerely like the chubby guy suggested? The Sky Tower Game is already dangerous, let alone the Abyss mode. In the previous two Sky Tower games, I was able to pass without danger by cooperating with other players.”
“Heh heh, cooperate? If you’re willing to swear by the Sky Tower, reveal your real player names and all your talents and skills, I wouldn’t mind cooperating with you.”
The Ghost-faced Man sneered, speaking mockingly.
“Hey hey hey, who are you calling chubby? Remember to call me Fatty, got it?”
The chubby player glared at Wang Ping and yelled.
“It seems that sincere cooperation is impossible. However, I still hope that we can help each other in times of danger and increase the probability of passing.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, pretending to be disappointed.
Of Wang Ping’s words, no one paid any attention except for the weak young boy.
It was at this moment that the agile voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence finally rang out again.
“Ding, the Sky Tower’s Third Floor Game: Seven Killer Surnames will officially start in 30 minutes. Players can silently recite the mission details in their hearts to receive basic information and related tasks about this game.”
With the sound of this message, Wang Ping and others began to recite the details of the mission in their minds skillfully.
Soon, Wang Ping’s mind received the basic information and related tasks for this game map – Qishaxing.
The background of this game world comprises only a mysterious ancient castle, with no other maps existing.
The ancient castle cannot be destroyed.
Within the ancient castle, there are seven different shadows.
And the players’ task is only one – to kill the seven shadows.
If the players kill a shadow within 24 hours, they will pass the game world, and a basic evaluation will be rewarded.
Also, for every additional shadow killed, the score will be promoted.
If all seven shadows are killed, a perfect clearance rating will be awarded.
“Killing the shadows?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he analyzed the situation in his heart.
It seems that this game is different from the second floor of the Heavenly Tower Game: Meng Gui Street, and doesn’t directly push other players to the opposition.
If players cooperate sincerely, they all can pass.
However, all players would only get the most basic rating.
For players with great ambitions, this is likely to be unbearable.
All those who dare to break into the third floor of the Sky Tower are tough and ambitious. If they only aim for a basic rating, they probably wouldn’t choose Abyss mode. They’d be better off choosing a slightly lower level mode and attempting a perfect clearance. The rewards they’d get for a higher rating would be even greater than those they’d get in Abyss mode for a basic rating.
“It seems we are destined to scheme against each other and fight for our lives.”
Wang Ping thought silently.
Well, that’s okay. It’s his best outcome to wipe out all other players, obtain an SSS tier evaluation, and monopolize all the rewards.
As the saying goes, “dead friends don’t die poor.”
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator activated, free simulation commencing…”
The system sounded.
Then the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[You wait quietly for the game to start. After the game begins, you will start to move and scatter to different places.]
[As you move, you also scan the walls of the ancient castle, searching for information about passing the game.]
[Finally, you see a painting on the wall, depicting seven shadows, each with different characters on them: Ye, Li, Wang, Xiao, Lin, Wu, Zhang. A blood-red Long Sword is horizontally cutting through the space above these shadow figures.]
[You look at this odd mural, narrowing your eyes. You think there must be key information about passing the game within this painting.]
[Perhaps, to kill these shadows, you’ll need special equipment. Without it, you won’t be able to kill them.]
[Apart from this, you also have a question: why do these shadows have different surnames?]
[In theory, if they were only game monsters, there would be no need to give them surnames.]
