[After thinking it over, you consider the name of the third Sky Tower Game: Seven Killer Surnames. It may be that this game name also hides important information for passing the game. However, you can’t figure out what the hidden information is for now.]
[While you are pondering, a chilling scream suddenly rings out, making your pupils shrink slightly.]
[Then, after some thought, you rush in the direction the scream came from.]
[When you arrive, you find that everyone else has also gathered here, standing in front of a room with serious expressions.]
[Frowning, you walk over and look inside the room. Then you see a horrifying sight: among the seven, the suit-wearing male player has been already brutally killed, his body chopped into tiny pieces. Blood, visceral pieces, and severed limbs fill the room.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - 1209 307 The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1209: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_4 Chapter 1209: Chapter 307: The Shocking Myriad Heavens Paradise! Hidden Benefits_4 [You watch this scene with a serious expression on your face, asking them if they saw the process of the suit-wearing male player’s death.]
[In response to your question, the other players look towards the ghost-faced male player. Apparently, he was the first player to arrive here.]
[Feeling the gazes of the crowd, the ghost-faced male player snorts coldly, stating that although he was the first one to come, the suited male player was already dead and turned into this ghastly figure when he arrived.]
[Hearing the words of the ghost-faced male player, you look doubtful, not fully believing him. After all, every player has their own agenda. Having one more player would increase the chances of getting a high evaluation.]
[In that case, if the ghost-faced player is extremely confident in himself and believes that he can deal with the seven shadows alone, it’s possible that he would choose to eliminate other players first to prevent them from stealing his kills or backstabbing him.]
[To be exact, it’s not just the ghost-faced player who might act this way, other players could do the same. To some players, the seven shadows of the Sky Tower Game, as well as other players, are all prey.]
[Next, you sigh, stating that the Sky Tower’s Third Floor game is indeed dangerous. A player has already died in such a short time; it would be better if everyone cooperates and faces the challenges together.]
[Hearing your words, the weak young boy hesitates before raising his hand in approval, agreeing that cooperation is indeed a better option since acting alone is too dangerous.]
[After the weak young boy speaks up, the rabbit-accessorized female player’s gaze flickers, considering whether or not to cooperate.]
[Although she wants to achieve a high evaluation, the fact that someone has already died at the beginning of the game signifies that the situation is unusual. Acting alone…is indeed more dangerous. It’s safer to cooperate with other players and keep an eye on their actions.]
[As for obtaining a high evaluation and whether or not to stab others in the back, that would depend on the circumstances.]
…
“It seems that the rabbit-accessorized female player is not the murderer, but she’s definitely not an easy target either.”
Wang Ping watches the Text Simulation content, thinking to himself.
However, it’s quite normal. Those who can make it to the 3rd tier of the abyss mode are not easy targets, no matter how innocent and cute they may appear on the outside.
Not to mention others, even Wang Ping himself is not to be trifled with – he is quite skilled in backstabbing.
“However, an incident occurring right at the beginning is a bit troublesome.”
Wang Ping sighs inwardly, hoping to find a perfect clearing method within the thirty minutes before the game starts.
Otherwise, he will have to give up on achieving a perfect clear and focus on survival instead.
As Wang Ping’s thoughts race, more text continues to appear on the luminescent screen.
[Not only the rabbit-accessorized female player, but also the chubby player and the black-robed female player all choose to cooperate after careful consideration in order to prevent further accidents. But the ghost-faced player just snorts coldly, giving all of you a deep look before he walks away without saying a word.]
[At this, you furrow your brows, finding the ghost-faced player extremely arrogant.]
[The chubby player watches the ghost-faced male player, chuckling sinisterly, and making a throat-slashing gesture. It seems like he’s suggesting that the ghost-faced male player is very suspicious and they should just kill him to eliminate any hidden dangers.]
[Seeing the chubby player’s gesture, you and the others feel your eyelids twitch, thinking that this seemingly kind and previously friendly chubby player is actually more ruthless than anyone else.]
[The chubby player sees everyone staring at him, and he shrugs, saying that he was just joking and hopes you won’t take him seriously.]
[Hearing his words, you snort and don’t take the chubby player’s words seriously at all. Joking? His expression and gaze just now didn’t look like he was joking at all.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - 1210 308 The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1210: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other Chapter 1210: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other [Afterwards, you all cautiously proceeded together, simply sharing the information you had and found that you had all encountered the strange painting. This indicates that the painting, though not ubiquitous, is not a hidden clue, but rather a public one.]
[That is to say, to clear the game more efficiently, it’s necessary to find or decipher the hidden clues.]
[After discussing, you all decided to pursue the Blood Long Knife with your own hidden agendas, as it is undoubtedly a key item to deal with the shadows.]
[After discussing, the rabbit-accessorized female player took out an item, saying that wearing it around the wrist would allow you to know the location of your teammates and would also share the intel you’ve acquired with them.]
[In other words, with this item, you can split up to increase efficiency while also keeping tabs on each other.]
[However, this is merely theoretical. In reality, who would be willing to believe that this is simply an information-sharing tool? If it has any hidden powers that activate when worn, that would mean placing your life in the hands of the rabbit-headdress-wearing player, which is something you all cannot bear.]
[Because of this, both you, the chubby player, the black-robed female player, and the weak young boy player all rejected the proposal from the rabbit-accessorized female player.]
[Seeing this, the rabbit-accessorized female player looked helpless and shook her head regretfully. It’s such a waste to not use this excellent intel-sharing tool just because of trust issues.]
[You chuckled and suggested continuing to act together, and if within two hours you couldn’t find the Blood Long Knife or were not attacked by any shadows, you would split up and not waste each other’s time.]
[Your words were approved by the other players, with no objections.]
[Next, you continued to explore the ancient castle together, carefully opening one door after another, examining the contents of each room.]
[You noticed that the decorations within these rooms were diverse; some were girlish rooms filled with various dolls and a predominantly pink ambiance, while others were extremely cluttered or even filthy, making those with cleanliness obsessions feel deeply uncomfortable.]
[In the blink of an eye, almost an hour passed. In that time, you didn’t encounter the ghost-faced male player, but you did manage to find your target.]
[The Blood Long Knife was found in a room, plunged into a withered corpse, with the character ‘Wu’ engraved on the blade.]
[All of you looked at the dried-up corpse and the Blood Long Knife with solemn expressions.]
[Then, you all had a suspicion: since the Blood Long Knife bore the surname ‘Wu’, could it be that it could only be used to kill the shadow bearing the same surname?]
[If so, that would mean there are six other Blood Long Knives corresponding to the other six shadows.]
[If this is indeed the case, it would be extremely troublesome, as the shadows would become difficult to defeat. Moreover, the issue of allocating the Blood Long Knives and the heads would be magnified, and the possibility of backstabbing would further increase.]
[Of course, if one Blood Knife corresponds to one shadow, it would not be so bad. If there were some sort of restrictive relationships involved, it would send shivers down your spine.]
[Although this rule seems far-fetched, considering this is the Abyss mode, anything is possible, so this possibility cannot be ruled out.]
[As you looked serious, the black-robed female player furrowed her brow and hesitated, glancing at the Blood Long Knife and your group, wondering what to think.]
[The chubby player licked his lips and smirked, noting that the ownership of the Blood Long Knife needed to be determined. He suggested using a simple method like rock-paper-scissors or rolling a dice to determine the ownership and avoid disputes.]
[As the chubby player spoke, the rabbit headdress-wearing player agreed, saying that it could maximize the chances of avoiding bloodshed.]
[The weak young boy said he was fine with any decision as long as they could continue to cooperate.]
[You looked at the group and nodded. In the end, you all chose rock-paper-scissors.]
[After playing rock-paper-scissors, you emerged as the victor and pulled out the Blood Long Knife. As you did, the other players eyed you with strange expressions.]
[You remained calm and suggested that, since time was limited, you should continue searching for the other Blood Long Knives.]
[Just as you stepped out of the room, the door automatically closed behind you. Following this, the light bulbs on the ceiling began to flicker, creating an eerie atmosphere.]
[The sight caused everyone’s expressions to change and become serious. You gripped the Blood Long Knife tightly in your hand, ready to fight at any moment.]
[As you all prepared yourselves, a black shadow slithered eerily into view, staring at you all with its ghastly green eyes.]
[At this sight, you all narrowed your eyes, identifying the bizarre black figure as the monster spawned by the Sky Tower Game and the target you needed to kill.]

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1211: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_2 Chapter 1211: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_2 [However, if you calculate the time, the Dark Shadow only emerged an hour after the game started.]
[Immediately, you suspect that the refresh rate of the Dark Shadows might be one per hour until they all appear.]
[If the rule is really as you guessed, then the cause of the suit-wearing male player’s death can be determined as another player’s action, not the Dark Shadow’s attack.]
[While you are all thinking about this, the Dark Shadow in front of you strikes, its black figure attacking you from an eerie angle.]
[Both of you have a slight change in expression, not daring to directly touch it, and display your Divine Skills.]
[You choose to use your powerful physical prowess to explode with astonishing speed to dodge.]
[The fat player is not as agile as you are, but he directly takes out a strange jade bracelet, which emits light and protects him entirely.]
[The player with a Rabbit Headdress summons a strange giant rabbit to carry her, jumping far away instantly at a speed even faster than yours.]
[Only the weak young boy shows a terrified expression, standing still as if frightened out of his wits.]
[Seeing this, all of you frown, feeling that this weak young boy player is somewhat peculiar. If his character and abilities were really as they appeared on the surface, it wouldn’huïanne=True,True,181205,9,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,True,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,False,False
[No matter what the reason, no one chooses to save him.]
[Just as the weak young boy player is about to be pierced through the chest by the Dark Shadow, the space around him distorts and directly twists and devours the black figure while also dragging the nearby Dark Shadow.]
[Seeing this, all of you look surprised, never expecting the weak young boy to have a space-type talent or item.]
[Although in the outer world, space-type talents or items are only considered powerful, not as supreme as time and conceptual abilities, but in this Sky Tower Game where all players are restricted, space-type abilities are certainly very strong.]
[You look at the dragged Dark Shadow and squint your eyes, choosing to make a move. You flash to the side of the Dark Shadow, holding the Blood Long Knife, and slash at the Dark Shadow.]
[At the moment you slash, a terrifying flame suddenly erupts from the Dark Shadow.]
[Caught off guard, you are directly hit, burnt to ashes, and even damage reduction items cannot resist this terrifying damage. Once turned to ashes, the Blood Long Knife falls to the ground.]
[Seeing this, the fat player sneers and tries to snatch the Blood Long Knife.]
[Not only the fat player, but the Rabbit Headdress-wearing player and the black-robed female player also take action.]
[The Rabbit Headdress-wearing player directly controls her rabbit mount to leap over, spewing astonishing cold air, which extinguishes the flames while attempting to freeze the fat player.]
[Seeing this, the fat player snorts coldly, and his mouth becomes huge, looking quite terrifying. A horrifying devouring power erupts from his mouth, swallowing the cold air almost entirely.]
[At this moment, the black-robed female player somehow manages to get to where the Blood Long Knife fell, picks it up, and slashes at the Dark Shadow.]
[Thus, the Dark Shadow is split in two. However, it twists and is not killed by the Blood Long Knife, restoring its sliced body and spewing flames at the black-robed woman.]
[Anticipating this, the black-robed woman disappears before reappearing a hundred meters away with the Blood Long Knife in her hand.]
…
“None of these people are easy to deal with.”
Wang Ping sighs as he watches this scene.
However, his Life Simulator has a high tolerance for errors, otherwise, he would have died countless times on this journey.
“Right now, things look bad. The Blood Long Knife can’t kill the Dark Shadow, which means that different knives are indeed needed for different Shadows. In order to have the ability to kill the seven Dark Shadows, we need to find seven Blood Knives while also defending against other players’ betrayal.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flicker, and he frowns slightly.
The danger level of these players is higher than that of the Dark Shadows, at least for now.
Wang Ping wonders if he should kill all the other players right after the game starts.
This way, he can deal with the Dark Shadows in peace without worrying about being backstabbed.
As Wang Ping contemplates whether to finish off this group of players, the Text Simulation continues.
[Just as the other players make their moves, you are finally revived.]
[The moment you revive, you don’t hesitate to move away from the Dark Shadow.]
[However, as soon as you make a move, the Dark Shadow targets you again, and both the shadow and the flames come at you once more.]
[In response, your expression changes slightly, finding it difficult to avoid. However, due to this predicament, the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack’s effect massively bursts forth.]
[In this moment, your attributes skyrocket, allowing you to easily dodge the attack and distance yourself from the Dark Shadow.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1212 - 1212 308 The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1212: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_3 Chapter 1212: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_3 [Seeing you resurrect and burst out with such a terrifying speed, the other players all showed surprised expressions.]
[However, they had no time to say much, as the dark shadow’s attack came once again. This time, the target was the chubby player and the weak young boy player, who were too close to the dark shadow.]
[Horrifying flames and shadows rushed towards the two. The weak young boy player remained unmoved, standing in place while the space continued to help him defend against all attacks.]
[As for the chubby player, he resisted the attacks with an energy shield, using his devouring skill to swallow all the attacks.]
[Then, it seemed as if the chubby player lost his patience and charged towards the dark shadow, pushing his talent skill effect to the maximum. As a result, he swallowed the dark shadow forcibly.]
[Seeing this, your eyelids twitched slightly, thinking that this chubby player from Food Divine Hall was quite ferocious.]
[However, you were also curious whether the chubby player could kill the dark shadow without using the blood knife.]
[Under your watchful eyes, the chubby player swallowed the dark shadow and then let out a satisfied burp. It seemed as if the dark shadow had been completely killed and eliminated by the chubby player.]
[However, the chubby player’s complexion changed quickly.]
[Because a mysterious dark shadow appeared in front of everyone once again, and this shadow was obviously much larger than the previous one.]
[No one present was a fool, and they guessed the reason for the change: after being killed, the dark shadow would become even stronger. Of course, through the comparison of cutting the dark shadow with the blood knife earlier, one could deduce that killing the dark shadow with the blood knife, even if the models were different, would not make the dark shadow stronger.]
[While you were speculating in your hearts, the resurrected dark shadow took action again, rushing towards the chubby player and the weak young boy player. The speed and power of the shadows and flames became even more terrifying, and the attack range also became much broader.]
[Seeing this, the chubby player’s complexion changed for the first time. Using his talent skills, he couldn’t last too long as it consumed spiritual power; the stronger the activation, the greater the consumption. Sooner or later, he would not be able to keep up with this.]
[However, he was not the agile type of combat style in Heaven Tower and could not adopt the agile style. So it was impossible for him to escape the range of the attack. If he swallowed the dark shadow once again, the shadow would become even stronger, leading him to inevitable death.]
[For a moment, the chubby player was plagued with a headache, while the weak young boy player still remained the same, making people wonder what he was thinking.]
[Suddenly, the chubby player looked at you all with a ferocious expression, indicating that you must save him. Otherwise, he would continue to devour the dark shadow and make it so powerful that it could not be dealt with, causing everyone to die.]
[The chubby player’s words caused a slight change in your expressions. If he really did as he said, it would indeed be a big problem. If the dark shadow continued to grow stronger, its power would be too much for anyone to survive.]
[For a moment, whether it was you, the rabbit-accessorized player, or the black-robed female player, you all felt annoyed, wishing to tear the chubby player into pieces.]
[Seeing you without any action, the chubby player showed a ferocious expression, took out an artifact with strange runes, and indicated that this object could temporarily seal this space. If you didn’t make a move, everyone would die together.]
[The chubby player’s words only intensified the killing intent in you all. At that moment, an anomaly occurred.]
[The chubby player and his protective energy shield were both suddenly torn apart, with his flesh and blood scattering across the ground, turned into ashes by the interwoven flames and shadows.]
[This sudden development caused your pupils to contract and made you reveal an astonished expression.]
[All of you stared intently at the direction where the weak young boy player was. At this moment, there was no such thing as the weak young boy player. Instead, a robust man with a bloody evil spirit stood there.]
[The range and degree of spatial distortion around him had become even more terrifying. Apparently, the chubby player had been killed by the transformed weak young boy player.]
[For a moment, all of you were extremely wary of the transformed weak young boy player, as he might be the most dangerous existence among the seven of you.]
[While you were all cautious, the transformed weak young boy player looked at you with his cold eyes. There was no killing intent in his eyes, just plain coldness.]
[Then, the transformed weak young boy player made a move, instantly appearing in front of the rabbit-accessorized female player.]
[At the same moment he appeared, the rabbit-accessorized female player’s body twisted and exploded, splashing blood everywhere.]
[This scene caused a slight change on your face, widening the distance between you and the transformed weak young boy player.]
[The black-robed female player’s face also changed instantly. In response, she took action, causing a strange black creature to appear at the feet of the transformed weak young boy player, stabbing upwards with a black sharp knife towards his crotch.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1213 - 1213 308 The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1213: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_4 Chapter 1213: Chapter 308: The True Meaning of the Seven Deadly Surnames! Players Getting More Ruthless than the Other_4 [However, before the black sharp knife could pierce, it and the strange black creature were twisted and burst apart.]
[Then, the transformed weak young boy player looked at the black-robed female player with an indifferent gaze.]
[Just as the transformed weak young boy player looked at the black-robed female player, her face darkened and she disappeared into a white light.]
[After the black-robed female player disappeared, the transformed weak young boy player appeared not far from where she had been, distorting everything around him.]
[This scene made your pupils suddenly shrink, quite startled, as you didn’t understand why the black-robed woman disappeared. Could it be that she also had spatial abilities?]
…
“Something’s not right, totally not right.”
Wang Ping frowned as he read the text simulation’s content.
The two polar reversals of the weak young boy player, although surprising, were still within expectations.
Those who dared to choose the third Tier’s abyss mode of the Sky Tower must not be easy to deal with.
But the disappearance of this black-robed female player was extremely abnormal.
According to the text simulation’s description, her sudden disappearance didn’t seem to register with the simulated Wang Ping, but the real Wang Ping could see it clearly.
The black-robed female player disappeared into a white light.
In the Sky Tower, disappearing into a white light usually meant being teleported into the game world or leaving after completing the main quest.
Right now, the black-robed female player disappeared into a white light, which could mean that she had quietly completed the main quest, obtained the basic evaluation, and could leave at any time.
If that’s the case, how did she complete the main quest and kill a shadow?
Apart from the beginning when they were separated, the black-robed female player and the simulated Wang Ping were always together and never separated.
That is to say, the black-robed female player killed a shadow and completed the main quest in a short time after the game started.
But dealing with shadows wouldn’t be possible without making a sound.
Moreover, the black-robed female player didn’t find the Blood Long Knife before this.
The Blood Long Knife is a special item that can’t be hidden.
“Could it be that this game called Qishaxing is not simply about killing shadows?”
Wang Ping’s pupils constricted slightly as he thought of a possibility.
Qishaxing, the killing of not only shadows but also players.
Seven surnames – if players represent these seven surnames, killing a player with that surname would complete the main quest and obtain the basic evaluation, which would make sense.
He, Wang Ping, represented the surname Wang.
As for the black-robed female player, she killed the suit-wearing male player, killed one surname, so she completed the main quest and could leave at any time.
If the suit-wearing male player’s surname was Wu, then the Wu character on the Blood Long Knife would have some profound meaning.
Perhaps, this meant that after the death of the Wu-surnamed suit-wearing male player, a corresponding surname Blood Long Knife would refresh.
If other players were killed, the corresponding surname’s Blood Long Knife would refresh somewhere in the ancient castle.
“Rather than dealing with shadows, killing other players is the shortcut to clear this game and obtain the highest evaluation. As for achieving the perfect SSS-tier evaluation, you also need to kill more players to deal with shadows. If you kill too few, the Blood Long Knife would not match the shadow, and you still won’t be able to kill it. This involves a lot of luck factors.”
Wang Ping silently analyzed in his heart and secretly sighed.
Although he had known for a long time that wisdom and luck were the most important things in Myriad Heavens Paradise, especially in the Sky Tower, and that strength was secondary, his previous experience had not been that profound.
But now, after three Sky Tower games, he had a deeper understanding of the importance of wisdom and luck.
“Hehe, since I’ve guessed so much, it’s easier to deal with.”
Immediately after, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered and his whole body relaxed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1214 - 1214 309 The Perfect Way to Clear the Level
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1214: Chapter 309: The Perfect Way to Clear the Level! The Reluctant Choice Chapter 1214: Chapter 309: The Perfect Way to Clear the Level! The Reluctant Choice Next, a relaxed Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
On the screen, words continued to emerge.
[After the black-robed female player left the game world, the transformed weak young boy targeted you, intending to kill you as well.]
[At this point, your face darkens, and you decide to use the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain. As long as you use this item, the previously dangerous Spatial Talent will become ineffective.]
[Once the transformed weak young boy loses his reliance on the Spatial Talent, given your physical strength and combat skills, you can easily kill him.]
[However, just as you are about to use the Spatial Talent, something unexpected happens, and the transformed weak young boy’s body suddenly stiffens, seemingly losing his ability to act.]
[This scene surprises you greatly. Shortly thereafter, an even more shocking event occurs: the transformed weak young boy suddenly stops using his Talent Skills, his temperament changes, and his body gradually shrinks back to its original form.]
[Just when the transformed weak young boy changes back, the shadow that was itching to move suddenly attacks him, turning him into a hedgehog. The terrifying power of the flames also erupts, burning him to ashes.]
[This strange scene makes your eyelids twitch, sensing that something is amiss and that perhaps another player has taken action.]
[However, the only surviving players are you and the ghost-faced player. Could it be that he’s the one who did it?]
[Just as you are feeling astonished and confused, your field of vision suddenly changes, from the castle corridor to a green grassland. On the grassland, there are many rabbits hopping around you.]
[Upon witnessing this peculiar scene, your expression changes drastically, realizing you’ve fallen for some kind of illusion. Judging from the style of the illusion, it is probably the work of the rabbit headdress female player.]
[Perhaps, the rabbit headdress female player never actually died. You’ve been affected by her illusion-type Talent Skills, and all your actions have taken place within the Illusionary Realm.]
[If that’s really the case, then it’s truly terrible.]
…
“This is really full of twists and turns.”
Wang Ping’s expression became solemn.
If the previous plot developments were all illusions, then it would be truly troublesome since everything he had deduced earlier would have been wrong.
“This Sky Tower game is really dangerous.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly, continuing to gaze at the luminescent screen, hoping that things wouldn’t turn out for the worst.
[As your thoughts race and your expression changes, without hesitation, you activate the effect of the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain.]
[As the effect of the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain unfolds, your vision changes, reverting back to the interior of the castle.]
[However, compared to before, your field of vision has indeed changed somewhat.]
[The change is that the rabbit headdress female player, who was supposed to be dead, reappears in your sight.]
[At this moment, she is not riding a rabbit. Instead, she looks around with a shocked and even terrified gaze, seemingly trying to figure out who broke her Talent Skills and sealed her ability to use Talents and special items.]
[Looking at the rabbit headdress player, your face darkens, and you become entirely convinced of your previous judgment.]
[However, you no longer have time to care about the rabbit headdress female player. Because your Talent Skills have also been sealed, you can only desperately dodge the shadow’s imminent attack.]
[Unfortunately, your weakened state ultimately makes it impossible to evade the attack, and your arm is penetrated by the shadow’s spike.]
[Seeing this, your face inevitably turns pale. After all, the shadow still possesses the power of fire. As long as it activates its fire ability, you will be left dead and disfigured.]
[However, the shadow does not use its fire ability. It seems as if it’s unable to. Your suspicions are raised. Perhaps the shadow before you was created after the suit-wearing Wu player died, not only possessing the characteristics of the shadow but also able to use the suit-wearing player’s Talents.]
[As a result, after the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain was activated, the shadow could no longer use its fire ability.]
[If this is the case, if you were to die in the game, would it create a shadow that could use the Life Simulator? If it does, it might cause the other players to despair.]
[Moreover, even if it couldn’t use the Life Simulator, just activating your other Talent Skills would still be a major problem. Certain abilities are limited for you, but there’s no restriction for the ‘Undying’ shadow.]
[Besides, the shadows formed by the other players after their deaths would also be problematic. After all, their Talents are far from ordinary, excluding the suit-wearing male player.]
[As many thoughts flash through your mind, you become increasingly wary of the shadow.]
[While feeling cautious, you also retreat with all your might, trying to escape the shadow’s subsequent attacks. Unfortunately, the shadow’s innate strength has not been weakened, even though its Talent Skills have been restricted.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1215 - 1215 309 The Perfect Way to Clear the Level
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1215: Chapter 309: The Perfect Way to Clear the Level! The Reluctant Choice_2 Chapter 1215: Chapter 309: The Perfect Way to Clear the Level! The Reluctant Choice_2 [Inevitably, you didn’t escape the clutches of the shadow and were directly killed by it.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends here…]
…
At the end of the text simulation, Wang Ping frowned deeply, discreetly glancing at the player with the rabbit headdress.
The talent skills of this female player were indeed troublesome.
Wang Ping was not certain whether the player with the rabbit headdress had used her talent skills to affect other players before the game started.
If she had activated her power, he would indeed be in for trouble.
This meant that Wang Ping might have to use the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain to deal with her.
If so, Wang Ping will lose a very powerful trump card.
“Maybe, I can test to see if it’s possible to use talents or item abilities to affect other players before the game starts,”
Wang Ping thought to himself, his eyes flashing.
“If it’s impossible to influence before the game starts, that’s good. The moment the game starts, I can immediately launch a sneak attack and kill her on the spot.”
Having reached this conclusion, a strong killing intent emerged in Wang Ping’s heart.
Nowadays, Wang Ping was no longer the rookie he once was. His mood and killing intent didn’t give him away as soon as they surfaced.
The current Wang Ping kept his appearance and aura calm despite the inner turmoil, hiding his thoughts well from others.
Then, Wang Ping murmured to himself, “System, I want to continue with the free simulation.”
“Ding, Life Simulator initiated, the free simulation starts.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen lit up, and the familiar text appeared for Wang Ping.
[Next, you decided to test the female player with the headdress, trying to see if she could use her talent and abilities to influence other players before the official start of the game.]
[Through your research, you found that other players cannot use their talents and items to harm or influence other players before the official start of the game.]
[This result has relieved you. However, because of your behavior, you have completely angered the other players, attracting all their hate. They all hold grudges against you, and several want to make a move on you.]
[Despite this, you still remained unmoved, quietly waiting for the game’s official start.]
[When the game officially started, you decisively attacked the female player with the rabbit headdress.]
[However, just as you acted, the female player with the rabbit headdress seemed to be well-prepared. A flash of light formed a six-pointed star-shaped shield around her, protecting her instantly.]
[As your fist hit the Six-pointed Star Shield, the shield seemed to change and controlled you.]
[At the same time, all the other players launched attacks on you. You are very familiar with their methods of attack, except for the talent abilities of Ghost Face Player, which you have never seen before.]
[Ghost Face Player took action, transforming into a Flame Demon, unleashing a terrifying flame skill.]
[You are very familiar with this ability. After all, according to the description, this is the ability of the shadow that appeared in the previous simulation.]
[This means, the shadows’ refresh mechanism is random. A new shadow is generated every hour. The first shadow refreshed has the talent ability of the Ghost Face Player, not the shadow of the suit-wearing male player you guessed.]
[This situation is undoubtedly very terrible. After all, if it randomly refreshed your shadow, wouldn’t you have to eliminate yourself as well, generating a Blood Long Knife with your surname?]
[If you don’t do this, you can’t refresh the Blood Long Knife to kill the shadow and get an SSS tier evaluation. But if you do this, you’ll die.]
[Of course, if you’re able to resurrect yourself through your talent skill and refresh the Blood Long Knife, that would be acceptable.]
[Otherwise, you can only stall for time, dragging it out until another shadow refreshes and you can kill it off.]”As numerous thoughts flashed through your mind, at the moment of extreme danger, due to the talent effect of the 5-digit Talent: Desperate Counterattack, your overall attributes significantly improved. Without hesitation, you used the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain.”
“As the item effect of the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain is activated, all attacks completely disappear, and the Six-Pointed Star constraining you shatters.”
“This scene shocked the other six players, their pupils constricting in fear. They hadn’t expected that you possessed such a terrifying special item.”
“You looked at them, your face stern, suggesting that they should be proud to have forced you to use the one-time special item rewarded for SSS tier evaluation.”
“Hearing your words, the expressions of all the other players changed, shocked once again. Because what you said revealed your identity as Heaven Derivative.”
“While the other players were in shock, you didn’t waste time, ferociously taking action, launching an attack on them.”
“Your first target was the rabbit-accessorized female player.”
“Seeing your assault, the rabbit-accessorized female player showed a terrified expression, attempting to dodge. But due to the difference in physical strength and technique, the gap in your close combat skills was huge.”
“As a result, the rabbit-accessorized female player had her head mercilessly blown apart by you.”
“After blowing apart the head of the rabbit-accessorized player, you then turned on the weak young boy player, easily killing him.”
“Seeing your brutal actions, instantly blasting away two players, the fat player, the black-robed female player, the suit-wearing male player, and the ghost face player all wore ugly expressions, completely devoid of any courage to fight you head-on and intended to scatter and escape.”
“However, it was too late for them to escape. You erupted with astonishing speed, easily catching up to them and killing each one.”
“After killing them one by one, you then started to look for the Blood Long Knife at the fastest speed.”
“Finally, you found six different surname-tagged Blood Long Knives in different rooms.”
“Just as you found the six different surname-tagged Blood Long Knives, a shadow appeared before you.”
“The power of this shadow was still flame shadow.”
“Seeing this flame shadow, you finally gave a sigh of relief. If no matter how the players die, the first refreshed shadow is fixed as the flame shadow, then it is much easier. You can easily kill it.”
“Next, without hesitating, you directly engaged in combat with the flame shadow. Because you had long known about its details, through the use of the Blood Long Knife, you easily killed it.”
“Of course, during the combat process, you also tested each Blood Long Knife. In the end, you judged Lin’s Blood-colored Long Knife to be effective. Clearly, the surname of the Ghost Face Player was Lin.”
“As you killed the flame shadow, you then heard Sky Tower Intelligence’s nimble voice, congratulating you for clearing the stage.”
“At this, you showed a look of delight and chose to return.”
“Because of your choice, this simulation ended here…”
…
Wang Ping looked at this text simulation, his eyes flickering, the corners of his mouth slightly lifted.
This simulation could be considered a quite relaxed clearance.
However, the use of the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain was too much of a pity.
“Continue the simulation and see if all the other players can be wiped out without using the Magic-Sealing Domain.”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he secretly thought to himself.
Then, Wang Ping continued the simulation.
But, to Wang Ping’s annoyance, something difficult occurred.
If he didn’t use the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain, he wouldn’t be able to easily wipe out all the other players. They might even team up against him.
“These players are indeed not easy to deal with. The Sky Tower Game is not so easy to perfectly clear after all.”
Wang Ping sighed inwardly.
On the second floor of the Heavenly Tower, he used up the Cursed Doll in order to perfectly clear it, and it seemed like he would have to use the Magic-Sealing Domain this time as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 1216 - 1216 310 Extremely Astonishing Rewards Dao Yi
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1216: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes! Chapter 1216: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes! However, although Wang Ping was somewhat regretful that he had to use the major weapon, 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain, he was never one to hesitate.
If it needed to be used, he’d use it.
As for how to go about handling the Second Generation Chat Group Leader, Dao Yi, he would just have to think of another plan.
Perhaps, after successfully crossing the Sky Tower’s Third Floor in Abyss mode, and receiving an SSS tier evaluation, the reward he’d get would be far more valuable and effective than the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain.
“Speaking of which, after I chose the Abyss mode as my default, the Sky Tower Intelligence mentioned that my rewards would be increased. Perhaps, it’s not impossible for me to get a 4-digit item this time.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shone with anticipation.
Next, Wang Ping calmed his mind and began to wait silently for the game to start.
As soon as the game began, Wang Ping did not hesitate to use the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain.
When Wang Ping used the 5-digit Special Item: Magic-Sealing Domain, all the players present noticed the anomaly, and their faces changed.
“Welcome everyone to my domain, next up, please prepare to die, so my legend can continue.”
Wang Ping looked around at the other six players whose faces had drastically changed, a smile on his face, and said politely.
Once he said this, the other players instantly understood that he was the player in control, and the abnormal state of their talents and items was all caused by him.
The fat player and the others simultaneously launched an attack on Wang Ping without hesitation.
In response, Wang Ping remained calm and killed all these impressive players one punch at a time.
“Now, it’s time for the coins to explode.”
Wang Ping looked at the bodies scattered across the ground, chuckled, and began his looting spree.
From the Ghost Face Player, Wang Ping obtained two items.
The first one was the Ghost Face Mask that the Ghost Face Player was wearing, a low-grade 5-digit special item. With this mask, one can conceal his aura and appearance, making it impossible for others to see through you.
Even the Profound Immortals couldn’t see through its concealing effect.
Besides, this Ghost Face Mask could also summon Ghost Creatures to aid in the battle.
The second item on the Ghost Face Player was the 5-digit low grade special item, Ghost Dance Skeleton, which could turn one into a monster, boosting your fighting power in all aspects.
“Two 5-digit low-grade items, not too shabby. Although for me right now, low-grade special items with 5 digits don’t have much of a use. But in the Sky Tower Game, they should still be handy.”
With a contemplative look in his eyes, Wang Ping mused silently.
It was a shame that these things were ill-gotten spoils and couldn’t be haphazardly sold.
Otherwise, Wang Ping would prefer to dispose of these spoils and exchange them for World Source.
Keeping these spoils on hand ultimately posed risks.
But he just couldn’t bear to throw them away.
Next, he began to loot the Fat Player.
The Fat Player had three special items with him.
Mid-grade 5-digit Special Item: Storage Ring: In the Sky Tower Game, it has the capacity to hold things of up to 1000 cubic meters, and in the outer world, it’s quite terrifying, the size equivalent to a Small Universe, containing a variety of food sources within its self-contained world.
5-digit low-grade Special Item: Light Particle Barrier: Can form a barrier made of light particles. By consuming mental power, you can strengthen the defense intensity.
5-digit low-grade Special Item: Space Restraint: A disposable item. Using this item can seal the surrounding space within a certain range, making it impossible for anyone to break free.
“This Fat Player is quite something, he’s got plenty of goodies on him.”
Wang Ping was impressed.
But neither of these two players had any 6-digit special items. Did they use them in previous games?
“That should be the case. Many items are consumables, it’s pretty normal to use them up.”
Wang Ping remembered this issue and mumbled to himself.
Take him for example, he didn’t want to use the Cursed doll or the Magic-Sealing Domain, but ended up using them anyway.
Next, Wang Ping composed himself and continued to loot.
His next target was the rabbit-accessorized female player.
The rabbit-accessorized female player also had two 5-digit special items.
5-digit low-grade Special Item: Rabbit Headdress: can summon a rabbit with freezing powers to assist in battle.
5-digit middle-grade Special Item: Six-Pointed Light Array: a one-time use item. Once activated, it can form an incredibly strong defensive barrier, and if facing a powerful attack, it can form a six-pointed star array trap to trap the enemy.
Ps: This item can be used passively, as long as you’re subjected to a lethal attack, it will trigger automatically. If used in the outer world, it could withstand a Quasi Fairy King’s attack.
“The items of this rabbit-accessorized female player are quite good. But, she actually has a 5-digit middle-grade special item, could it be that she also had a high evaluation on the second floor of the Heavenly Tower? Not likely SSS, however SS is possible.”
Wang Ping looked at the 5-digit middle-grade Special Item: Six-Pointed Light Array, his gaze flickering.
However, considering the illusion talent skill of this rabbit-accessorized female player, Wang Ping felt that she indeed had the potential to reach the SS level evaluation.
Next, Wang Ping went to loot the suit-wearing male player.

chapters.title: Chapter 1217 - 1217 310 Extremely Astonishing Rewards Dao Yi
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1217: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_2 Chapter 1217: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_2 This time, Wang Ping was somewhat disappointed.
Because the suit-wearing male player didn’t have even a single special item on him.
“No wonder this guy was the first to be killed; he’s really weak. With this foundation, he actually dared to choose the third floor of the Sky Tower’s Abyss mode, what a big heart.”
Wang Ping searched through and through, but couldn’t find any special items, and couldn’t help but show a disgusted expression.
Next, Wang Ping looted the body of the black-robed female player.
This time, Wang Ping found a special item.
Five-figure low-tier special item·Melting Shadow Robe: This item allows the player to meld into shadows, which is a pretty good ability.
“Eh, this symbol…”
After stripping the black-robed female player, Wang Ping discovered that the back of her hand had the same mark as the suit-wearing male player, and he couldn’t help but narrow his eyes.
“No wonder in the first Life Simulator, the black-robed female player killed the suit-wearing male player first; they were actually from the same organization and entered as a team. It was precisely because they were acquainted that the mural painting aroused the black-robed female player’s suspicion about the game. In the end, her judgment was correct; it was indeed ‘Qishaxing’.”
After pondering, Wang Ping sighed.
If he didn’t have the Life Simulator, it wouldn’t be so easy to know the true nature of the game’s content.
“I have to say, this black-robed female player is really ruthless, killing her teammate as soon as the game started.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips.
“However, I can understand. After all, this mark represents an evil force from the Myriad Heavens, so killing teammates is considered a standard operation.”
“Lastly, there’s the Shota player. I hope he has some powerful items on him.”
Wang Ping composed himself and looted the shota player’s body.
Then, Wang Ping obtained two more items.
Five-figure low-tier special item · DesperateTransformation: Wearing this item makes the user very timid, but when facing a desperate situation, the user becomes wild, greatly increasing all attributes and reducing the mental power consumption when using Talent skills.
Five-figure low-tier special item · Bracelet of Justice: A one-time-use item. Upon using this item, it can specifically target and judge an evil creature to destroy it.
PS: The ability cap is at the five-figure Legend level, and the effect in the Sky Tower will change.
“These two items are not very useful for me. It seems that the Shota player is mainly powerful because of his own Talent skills.”
Wang Ping looked at the two items and couldn’t help but frown slightly.
The DesperateTransformation item affects the personality.
Moreover, an item at the mere five-figure tier is really not that useful. Wearing it does more harm than good.
Wang Ping has the Life Simulator, and he needs to be calm in order to do things, so pursuing a little power increase while discarding a stable personality is a case of misplaced priorities.
As for the second item, it is even less useful, especially in the outer world where it won’t help him at all.
Perhaps, it’s only somewhat useful inside the Sky Tower.
However, the condition for using this item is a bit harsh, and it’s only a five-figure low-grade item. As Wang Ping advances through the tower, its power will gradually fall off.
Not to mention that it’s a one-time-use item.
“Oh well, I won’t jump to conclusions so quickly. It would be embarrassing if I accidentally get proven wrong.”
Wang Ping shook his head again, collected the items, and put them all away into the storage ring he had taken from the fat player.
Next was the time to deal with the shadows, and Wang Ping began to take action.
The following developments were also not much different from what happened in Life Simulator.
Wang Ping found the Blood Blade, killed the first shadow, and completed the clearance conditions.
“I want to return.”
Then, Wang Ping spoke to the Sky Tower Intelligence.
“Ding, detected that the main quest has been completed, congratulations on passing the third level Game World · Qishaxing.”
Just as Wang Ping chose to return, the lively voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence sounded.
Then, Wang Ping was instantly enveloped by white light, left the game world, and returned to his exclusive room.
Immediately after, the lively voice of the Sky Tower sounded again.
“Ding, detected that the player completed the main quest in the third floor’s Qisahxing Abyss mode, evaluation A-tier.”
“Ding, detected that the player obtained seven kills, thus perfectly clearing the level, raising the evaluation to SSS tier, and obtaining one SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest.”
“Ding, tower-wide announcement, Player Tianyan, chose Abyss mode, perfectly passed the third floor of the Game World, obtained SSS tier evaluation, becoming the 85th player to obtain an SSS tier evaluation.”
…..
“Phew, I really got an SSS tier evaluation, and now I’m relieved.”
Wang Ping saw the series of messages that appeared on the luminescent screen and wore a smile on his face.
Truth be told, although he was 90% confident that he would get an SSS tier evaluation, he was worried about one thing.
That thing was Qishaxing; he needed to kill his own shadow and make up for the seven kills to get a perfect score.
Now it seems that the conditions of the Sky Tower were not so stringent; killing seven was enough.
It didn’t matter if it was a shadow or another player; just gather seven heads.
“However, are there only 85 players who received an SSS grade on the third floor? This is really getting harder and harder. Keep in mind that this is only the third floor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1218 - 1218 310 Extremely Astonishing Rewards Dao Yi
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1218: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_3 Chapter 1218: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_3 Wang Ping heard the notification sound from the Sky Tower Intelligence again and couldn’t help but smack his lips.
He wondered if all the players who had cleared the game with an SSS tier evaluation had grown to three-digit levels or higher.
If that were true, then would he be considered a three-digit candidate?
“Tsk tsk, three digits, impressive. However, it’s not enough to satisfy my ambition now.”
Wang Ping smacked his lips, marveled for a moment, and then collected his thoughts. He chose to claim the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest and opened it.
As Wang Ping opened the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, golden light emerged, and the pleasant voice of the Sky Tower Intelligence instantly resounded.
At the same time, some images appeared before his eyes.
“Ding, congratulations on opening the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest. You have received the following rewards:
①. Sky Tower game character physique attribute +200.
②. 5-Digit Supreme Special Item: Shattered Light.
③. Four-digit Rule Stone.
④. Four-Digit Low-tier Special Item: Death Rain.”
5-Digit Supreme Special Item: Shattered Light – a one-time-use item. When used, it creates a Light of Destruction, which is extremely powerful and can destroy entry-tier four-digit powerhouses, preventing their resurrection, even with a low-tiered four-digit Resurrection Item.
PS: This item comes from the Sky Tower Game and can be used within it. However, ability values will be adjusted accordingly. Please use it with caution.
Four-digit Rule Stone: possessing this item can evolve your talent into a four-digit talent.
Four-Digit Low-tier Special Item: Death Rain – a one-time-use item. When used, it creates a torrent of death that corrodes everything. Even four-digit legends dare not touch it easily. If an elite four-digit powerhouse touches it, their life will be corroded by the Death Rain and quickly perish.
PS: This item comes from the Sky Tower Game and can be used within it. However, ability values will be adjusted accordingly. Please use it with caution.
PS: This item is extremely dangerous. If used improperly, it can kill the user. Please be extra careful.
“Damn!”
Wang Ping was astonished by the rewards he received this time.
Although he knew his rewards would increase after choosing to permanently set Abyss mode, he didn’t expect such a significant increase.
After all, under normal circumstances, even if he got an SSS tier evaluation for the Sky Tower’s Third Floor, he would only receive two five-digit special items.
However, this time he got a five-digit supreme special item and a low-tiered four-digit special item.
Lastly, he even got a four-digit Rule Stone!
Four-Digit Rule Stone, an item Wang Ping had always dreamt of!
Previously, he racked his brain trying to figure out how to obtain a four-digit Rule Stone, wondering if he had to clear levels 10 to 20 before he could get such a high-level item.
He never expected to receive it on the third floor.
“I can only say that fortune and misfortune are intertwined. Although choosing to set Abyss mode is definitely a trap, the increase in rewards is astonishing.”
Wang Ping marveled in his heart and was extremely satisfied with the rewards. He was absolutely delighted.
“Next, I just need to refresh my Cultivation Reward through the Life Simulator, and I can easily become a four-digit existence. The moment I become a four-digit existence, dealing with the Second Generation Chat Group Master Dao Yi will be like a father spanking his child, and his bizarre talent won’t be able to disgust me by jumping levels.”
Then, the corner of Wang Ping’s mouth turned up slightly, and he began to imagine the scene of beating the second-generation chat group owner Dao Yi.
He originally thought he needed a Demon Forbidden Domain to deal with him, and using up a Demon Forbidden Domain would be troublesome. Now, it seemed that exchanging a Demon Forbidden Domain for so many good items was a jackpot.
Next, Wang Ping made a mental move to leave the Sky Tower space and returned to the villa where Alpha was.
“Alpha, get me a glass of milk tea.”
As soon as Wang Ping returned, he smiled and snapped his fingers at Alpha.
Alpha seemed to understand something, his eyes brightened, and he obediently went to make tea for Wang Ping.
Meanwhile, the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise was once again shaken because Wang Ping received the SSS tier evaluation.
After all, Wang Ping had just chosen to permanently set Abyss mode, and now he had received another SSS tier evaluation. His ability was truly amazing.
“Heaven Derivative…”
Dao Yi, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader, also heard the notification sound and was extremely shocked, and even envious.
This Heaven Derivative, whoever they were, was truly too monstrous, able to clear three floors in such a short time and received SSS tier evaluations.
“If only I could continuously obtain SSS tier evaluations like him, showcasing my potential. With the vastness of these Myriad Heavens, there’s nowhere I couldn’t go.”
Dao Yi murmured to himself.
However, in the end, he sighed and abandoned this futile fantasy.
He had never chosen Abyss mode and had dared not to continue after clearing the ninth floor.
The memory of that creeping shadow of death was still fresh in his mind, triggering fear from his heart.
Although the Sky Tower was a shortcut to becoming a powerful being quickly, its dangers were enough to make most people shudder in fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1219 - 1219 310 Extremely Astonishing Rewards Dao Yi
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1219: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_4 Chapter 1219: Chapter 310: Extremely Astonishing Rewards! Dao Yi Strikes!_4 Next, Dao Yi collected his thoughts, his eyes filled with coldness, and directly contacted someone.
Soon, a shadow appeared in front of Dao Yi, and said sinisterly, “Hehehe, Dao Yi, you’re really ruthless, selling everything of the Second Generation Chat Group, turning your subordinates, brothers, offspring, and even their descendants into slaves just to summon the one-time Demon King Authority.”
“Hmph, no need for your comments. As long as I can deal with Alpha and that person, it’s all worth it.”
Dao Yi snorted coldly, responding.
“Hehehe, interesting, I hope you’ll succeed.”
The shadow laughed strangely, and after throwing a black mist-like item to Dao Yi for the exchange, quickly disappeared.
“A dead friend is not as good as an alive one. As long as I’m alive, anything is possible.”
Dao Yi’s face was gloomy, and his eyes were filled with killing intent.
He then left his residence and went straight to where Alpha was, crushing the black misty item in his hand.
As Dao Yi crushed the black misty item in his hand, he temporarily gained the Demon King Authority, allowing him to forcefully compel someone or a group to play a game with him.
However, because this Demon King Authority was a castrated version, the only game that could be played was a pure duel.
The game would only end when one side died or surrendered.
But purchasing such an item wasn’t a glorious act, so Dao Yi didn’t want to make it widely known.
As a result, on his way here, he set up various array patterns to seal off the area.
“Alpha, and my dear junior, get the hell out here.”
Dao Yi stood in the sky, overlooking the villa below, as he shouted coldly.
…..
Inside the villa, Wang Ping had detected Dao Yi’s presence as soon as he arrived, feeling somewhat surprised.
After Dao Yi used the Demon King Authority, Wang Ping was even more astonished.
“Demon King Authority? No, temporary Demon King Authority? Dao Yi really is willing to spend a fortune.”
Alpha also looked up at the outside, quite surprised.
“My growth rate is too terrifying, so he’s desperate. It’s understandable that he would do something like this.”
Wang Ping finished his tea leisurely and said calmly.
Although it deviated from his plan, Dao Yi’s sudden attack left him no choice but to fight him before he could upgrade to the 4-digit range.
However, Wang Ping’s strength was strong enough, and he had many good things on him, so he wasn’t really afraid of Dao Yi.
It’s just that he used to prefer being more cautious.
“Not coming out? Since you dare not, just go to hell.”
Outside, seeing that Wang Ping and Alpha had no intention of coming out, Dao Yi snorted coldly and launched an attack, unleashing a terrifying power from his palm that struck the villa.
In the Myriad Heavens Paradise, the destructive power of battle was limited, so it didn’t seem as strong as the outer world, but the power wasn’t weakened at all.
As a fighter at the 5-digit limit, Dao Yi’s attack was still quite terrifying.
However, this only applied to ordinary 5-digit limit fighters.
For Wang Ping, Dao Yi’s power was simply too weak.
Facing this attack, Wang Ping only used his power to form a Chaos Energy Shield, easily blocking Dao Yi’s attack and leaving the villa unscathed.
Then, with a flicker of his figure, Wang Ping appeared in the outer world, facing Dao Yi from a thousand meters away.
At this moment, Dao Yi glanced at the intact villa and then at Wang Ping, his face looking ugly.
Through the simple probing just now, he realized something again.
Wang Ping had become even stronger than when he had someone use an item to bomb the universe not long ago.
In such a short period of time, his strength had increased greatly once again.
This growth rate was too abnormal and made him envious to the point of madness.
It was pathetic that after so many years of cultivation, he, Dao Yi, was so easily surpassed by a junior.

chapters.title: Chapter 1220 - 1220 311 Dao Yis Death The First Four-digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1220: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) Chapter 1220: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) “Heh, feeling sour?”
Wang Ping stared at Dao Yi, seemingly seeing through his thoughts, and couldn’t help but sneer.
“Humph, your talent is indeed strong, but such a talent that allows you to rapidly increase your cultivation is destined not to be used in battle. Talent always has its advantages and disadvantages; there’s no such thing as a perfect one.”
Dao Yi coldly snorted without directly answering, but spoke with a gloomy expression.
“And you’ve grown so quickly, though your power is extremely strong, how much of it comes from the special items of Myriad Heavens Paradise?”
“That is, even if you might be more powerful in pure strength, in Myriad Heavens Paradise, the outcome of a battle has never been about who’s stronger. Today, you will die by my hands. And then, using the Temporary Demon King Authority, I will take your talent and become unrivaled.”
In the end, Dao Yi’s face was full of madness, his arms spread wide, revealing his unbridled ambition.
“Heh, quite confident, aren’t you? Not afraid of biting your tongue when the winds blow.”
Wang Ping sneered.
Then, without any interest in continuing to argue with Dao Yi, Wang Ping decided to strike, his figure flashed, and appeared in front of Dao Yi. The Chaotic Immortal Fist fiercely smashed towards his face.
Although Wang Ping didn’t dare to use Life Simulator for simulation in Myriad Heavens Paradise, as it might easily expose him to the higher-ups, his confidence in dealing with Dao Yi was high and fearless.
Just as Wang Ping made his move, a deck of cards appeared before Dao Yi’s eyes, and one card floated out.
This card had a character on it: ‘Seal’.
As the card appeared, Wang Ping found his body restrained, his power suppressed, and his fist stopped in front of Dao Yi’s face.
“Cunning Talent, huh? Truly troublesome.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
“The first card is a restraint; such a pitiful junior, you’re really unlucky.”
Dao Yi looked at the restrained Wang Ping with a mocking expression.
As he spoke, a red-black longsword appeared in Dao Yi’s palm, stabbing fiercely towards Wang Ping’s chest.
Not only that, Dao Yi felt it was insufficient and directly used a special item. Five Arc-Shaped Energy Blades appeared at Wang Ping’s side, slashing towards him from different angles.
However, just as Dao Yi’s attacks and special items were about to hit Wang Ping and mercilessly dismember him, an item was triggered.
This item was none other than the Light Particle Barrier special item that Wang Ping had taken from the chubby player.
“Useless. My sword has a special effect that can shatter energy shields. Although it can only be activated once in a while, it’s enough to determine victory or defeat.”
Seeing the Light Particle Barrier appear around Wang Ping, Dao Yi sneered, easily breaking the barrier with the red-black longsword.
Since he wanted to kill Wang Ping, he naturally had evaluated many situations.
Although he didn’t think that Wang Ping could obtain a variety of items in such a short time, he still prepared for the worst.
Items to break defense shields, weaken recovery, and prevent revival – he tried his best to have everything prepared.
Because of this, he was confident that he could kill Wang Ping with an 80-90% chance.
So, he came here directly, wanting to capture Wang Ping and Alpha in one fell swoop.
Just when Dao Yi thought he was about to kill Wang Ping, something unexpected happened.
Another defense barrier appeared around Wang Ping’s body.
This defense barrier was the Six-Pointed Light Array, a 5-figure mid-tier special item Wang Ping had taken from the rabbit-accessorized female player.
With the appearance of the Six-Pointed Light Array, Dao Yi’s attacks with the longsword in his hand and the Five Arc-Shaped Energy Blades were all blocked.
Then, the special effect of the 5-figure mid-tier special item, the Six-Pointed Light Array, was triggered, changing into the Six-pointed Star Array Trap and trapping Dao Yi instead.
“What!?”
Dao Yi hadn’t expected this to happen, and his face changed drastically.
This kind of item that could withstand his attack and trap him in return must be at least a 5-figure top-grade tier, right?
If not, it must be a one-time-use 5-figure special item.
Wang Ping had only been in Myriad Heavens Paradise for a short time; how could he have such a special item?
Besides, the previous defense item was also of a level above 5-figure.
However, that earlier item was probably a bait, implying that he might have been predicted to have a defense-breaking item.
“Dao Yi, indeed, you’re careful and ruthless in your actions, but unfortunately, you provoked me, the ultimate cheater. So, you’re destined to die here today.”
With a cold face, Wang Ping spoke as another item appeared in the sky.
This item was also taken from the rabbit-accessorized female player. It could summon a giant rabbit with ice abilities to assist in combat.
The next moment, a huge rabbit appeared in the sky, forming a cold aura in its mouth, targeting Dao Yi.
This scene caused Dao Yi’s pupils to suddenly constrict.
Even though the aura of the rabbit in front of him seemed weak, Dao Yi didn’t dare to gamble. He was afraid the rabbit had a special ability.
After all, this rabbit was formed from an item. Strength was secondary – what mattered most was the ability it possessed.
In the fighting laws of Myriad Heavens Paradise, one must take every enemy item seriously; otherwise, they might die miserably.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 - 1221 311 Dao Yis Death The First Four-digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1221: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _2 Chapter 1221: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _2 “Damn it!”
Without further ado, Dao Yi clenched his teeth and used a life-saving item on himself.
A burst of light flashed by, and the binding force of the Six-Pointed Light Array on Dao Yi’s body was forcibly broken.
After breaking the restraint of the Six-Pointed Light Array, Dao Yi evaded the freezing ability of the ice rabbit in embarrassment. To ensure absolute success, he also used an item that increased his speed and disappeared from the spot like a shadow.
Due to Dao Yi fleeing, Wang Ping was affected by the cold wave and was engulfed in it.
Seeing this, Dao Yi not only didn’t feel happy about Wang Ping’s misfortune, but his face became even more gloomy.
Dao Yi knew that he’d been played.
If the freezing ability of this ice rabbit was truly terrifying, Wang Ping would have found a way to avoid it.
But he took the hit head-on, which indicated that this ice rabbit was really just for show. As Dao Yi had sensed, it was weak and did not possess any special freezing and sealing abilities.
As expected, when the cold light beam disappeared, Wang Ping appeared in front of Dao Yi unscathed.
“Tsk tsk tsk, you really have a lot of items on you, senior. However, how many more items can you afford to waste?”
Wang Ping looked at the fleeing Dao Yi and taunted him.
“Hmph, that’s what I should be asking you. I didn’t expect that you would have so many powerful items even though you haven’t been in Myriad Heavens Paradise for long. But this should be all you’ve got, right?”
Dao Yi snorted coldly.
“Next, I don’t need to waste items to kill you urgently. I just need to wait for my Talent Skills to refresh and draw cards again. Once I get a good card, I can invite you, my junior, to your death.”
After a pause, Dao Yi said with murderous intent.
His actions were likely to be guessed by Wang Ping, so there was no need for him to hide them. Instead, it was better to boldly announce them, increase Wang Ping’s pressure, and make him as anxious as possible.
“Hehe, you’re not capable of inviting me to my death.”
Wang Ping sneered, and a pair of wings that looked like stars emerged behind him.
The moment these wings appeared, Dao Yi’s pupils constricted, and he retreated even more, fearing that Wang Ping’s new item possessed some peculiar abilities.
At the same time, Dao Yi cursed Wang Ping mentally, wondering why he had so many high-grade items.
“You’re scared. How boring.”
Wang Ping scoffed, feeling his body’s strength gradually recovering, and the binding force weakening. He began to activate his power, attempting to break free of the restraint.
At the same time, Wang Ping used the special item, Ghost Transformation, which he had obtained from the Ghost Face Player.
Although its grade wasn’t high, Wang Ping wouldn’t despise any increases in strength, no matter how small they were.
Apart from this, increasing his power was secondary – creating psychological pressure on Dao Yi was the most important thing.
With this thought, Wang Ping completed the Ghost Transformation, and a Ghost Face Mask appeared on his face, concealing his aura. At the same time, he summoned Ghost Creatures to attack Dao Yi.
“Don’t think I’ll be scared by these trivial tricks. I won’t make the same mistake twice.”
Mocked by Wang Ping again, Dao Yi coldly snorted and chose to attack the summoned Ghost Creatures from a distance, not falling for the tricks again.
He was forced to expend a card due to his previous anxiety, as he was trapped by Wang Ping’s Six-Pointed Light Array and the short distance between them.
However, he would not make the same mistake twice.
No matter whether these Ghost Creatures possessed any special abilities or not, he could attack from a distance and not let them touch him to avoid any problems.
Perhaps some had abilities triggered by attacking, but Dao Yi also had ways to deal with them. He could summon his Spirit Pet to fight and test their abilities.
And that’s exactly what Dao Yi did. He summoned a Spirit Pet of legendary tier, almost at the five-figure Legend level, to shatter the Ghost Creatures with ranged attacks.
Though this level of Spirit Pet wouldn’t help much in battle, it was good for determining whether an enemy’s attack had any dangerous abilities.
“As I thought, it’s nothing but illusions. My dear junior, I do want to see what else you’ve got up your sleeve.”
Dao Yi sneered coldly, waiting for the right moment to come.
His Cunning Talent was abnormal, with its power varying greatly from card to card.
For example, his Binding Card could restrain an enemy for a whole minute, while also possessing power-weakening effects.
Although the effectiveness of this restraint would diminish with the enemy’s strength, it wasn’t mechanically fixed to last for one minute. For Wang Ping, who had a 5-digit limit, it would be enough to restrain him for 58 seconds or more.
And Dao Yi’s Cunning Talent could draw a new card every minute, without the effect of the previous card disappearing.
In other words, drawing a Binding Card first usually decided victory or defeat.
However, Wang Ping was too unpredictable, so Dao Yi didn’t have complete confidence in this tactic.
“If you want to see what else I can do, you’d better keep your eyes open and see how you’ll fall here.”
Wang Ping laughed, as his whole body’s strength began to erupt, and the binding force rapidly disintegrated.
“How is that possible!?”
Seeing this, Dao Yi’s pupils suddenly shrank, and his face revealed a look of terror.
Only a short time had passed, and Wang Ping had already begun recovering his strength and breaking free from the restraint.

chapters.title: Chapter 1222 - 1222 311 The Death of Dao Yi The First
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1222: Chapter 311: The Death of Dao Yi! The First Four-Digit Talent! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_3 Chapter 1222: Chapter 311: The Death of Dao Yi! The First Four-Digit Talent! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_3 Such power, only a four-digit entity could accomplish.
Could it be that Wang Ping had reached the level of a four-digit entity in terms of power?
“You, are you a 5-digit Breaker?”
Dao Yi’s face turned ugly to the extreme, full of disbelief, gritting his teeth and roaring.
“Correct, now it’s time for your reward. Your death.”
Wang Ping mobilized his body, gradually dispelling the restraining power.
“Damn it! You forced my hand!”
Dao Yi’s face was hideously contorted. He promptly used an artifact.
This artifact was the only four-digit item Dao Yi had acquired.
Four-digit inferior item, Reversing Pearl: After using it, it will reverse its origin to gain tremendous power, allowing the user’s strength to forcefully reach the four-digit level.
Although, the price to use this item is that the user can never enhance their strength again. The power will be permanently fixed, unless an extremely precious high-tier item is used to treat it, otherwise, the user will be locked at this level for the rest of their life.
Considering Dao Yi’s ambition, he would absolutely not use this item unless he was in a dire situation.
His ambition was great, not only did he want to become a four-digit entity, but he intended to reach the four-digit limit, and maybe even the three-digit realm.
However, the appearance of Wang Ping made him desperate, cutting off all his paths to the future.
“Kill him! As long as I kill him and obtain his talent, I have hope to advance further! The side effects of this item are nothing.”
Dao Yi was inwardly chanting madly.
However, as soon as Dao Yi took out the Reversing Pearl with a crazed expression on his face, Wang Ping slightly scowled, directly taking out the 5-digit Supreme Item, the Light of Destruction.
Wang Ping didn’t understand what the item Dao Yi brought out was. He just knew one thing — that item must be robust. It was Dao Yi’s last shot.
Hence, Wang Ping discarded the idea of preserving items, opting to directly use the 5-digit Supreme Item, the Light of Destruction.
As soon as Wang Ping used the 5-Digit Supreme Item — the Light of Destruction, a black-gray aurora instantly formed and shot out towards Dao Yi.
Just as the Light of Destruction was firing towards Dao Yi, he used the four-digit item, the Reversing Pearl.
Upon using the four-digit item, the Reversing Pearl, Dao Yi felt an unprecedented surge of power.
This power dazzled him, giving him the impression that he held the universe in his grasp.
The power of the Immortal King level, compared to the Quasi Fairy King level, was far too mighty.
“With this power, I can easily kill him! Even a 5-digit Breaker cannot truly contend with a four-digit entity, let alone the fact that I have a powerful talent!”
Dao Yi regained his confidence, not minding the approaching Light of Destruction that was already nearby.
His face was cold as he burst into frightening energy, intending to easily block the Light of Destruction.
However, his expression quickly froze, his power was easily penetrated by the Light of Destruction, leaving a large hole in his head.
The Light of Destruction’s destructive property began to spread from his wound, causing everything about him to disintegrate.
Then, Dao Yi turned into ashes without even a chance to utter his last words.
As Dao Yi died, a parchment scroll appeared in front of Wang Ping, declaring his victory.
At the same time, Wang Ping obtained all of Dao Yi’s possessions.
Theoretically, the loser in the Demon King game should be treated like this.
However, since Dao Yi had thoroughly died, Wang Ping naturally could not obtain his ownership.
Besides, Dao Yi didn’t have any items.
Obviously, Dao Yi had also exchanged his items into a one-time strong item in order to deal with him.
For this reason, Wang Ping had to consume many items in this fight, and all he got was Dao Yi’s talent.
5-digit Talent, Trick Cards.
“This talent can be considered extremely powerful. Unfortunately, it will soon lose its effect on me. I’m about to advance to a four-digit entity, and the Life Simulator will be optimized to four digits.”
Wang Ping shook his head, mumbling to himself.
In order for the Trick Cards talent to have a significant use on him in the future, he would need to find another Four-digit Rule Stone.
However, this stone was something he had painstakingly obtained from the Sky Tower Game. He didn’t believe he could be as lucky every time and refresh the four-digit Rule Stone.
Not to mention, as long as the Life Simulator’s talent reached the four-digit level, he could fiercely refresh for four-digit talents.
At that time, it would be much more beneficial to use a four-digit Rule Stone to upgrade the 5-digit Talent, Trick Cards.
“These items should all be destroyed.”
Next, Wang Ping glanced at his many items, his eyebrows slightly raised.
Initially, he did not intend to use these items, but Dao Yi’s talent and his prepared items were indeed somewhat troublesome.
Therefore, for the sake of prudence, he used these items in the middle of the fight.
All these items were tainted goods. The ones who dared to venture into the third floor of the Abyss mode in the Sky Tower, like that fat player, were absolutely not simple. Their background was all astonishing.
Among them, the most annoying were that suited male player and the black-robed woman. Both had come from dark forces where a four-digit limit powerhouse presided.
However, Wang Ping did not find any items on them, so he did not need to worry about anything.
