chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1223: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _4 Chapter 1223: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _4 And the others, presumably, are from three-digit forces.
Such a formidable force is not something that Wang Ping can provoke now.
As a result, since these items have been used, they must be completely destroyed; otherwise, when the protection of the Heaven Tower disappears or the news leaks out, Wang Ping will be in big trouble.
At once, Wang Ping began to destroy all these special items, turning them all into dust and scattering them into the air.
“Dao Yi, dead huh…”
Alpha’s figure appeared beside Wang Ping and sighed.
Recalling the past, Dao Yi was just like Wang Ping, leading the chat group forward.
At the root of it, the conflict between her and Dao Yi was mostly her fault.
After all, she had been too oppressive to the members of the Second Generation Chat Group.
Because she planted such a seed, this fruit was the result.
As for Dao Yi’s targeting Wang Ping, she felt threatened by him, mostly due to her own reasons.
“I don’t care about the past. All I know is that our positions are different. He targeted me multiple times, trying to put me in a desperate situation. This is enough reason for me to strike him down.”
Wang Ping looked at Alpha and spoke calmly.
“Not to mention, he came here for his death.”
“I was just sighing. A dead Dao Yi is better than a living one.”
Alpha shook her head slightly and spoke.
Then, Alpha gazed in a certain direction, muttering to herself, “It’s a pity; Dao Yi must have sold the Second Generation Chat Group. Otherwise, the origin of those chat groups could have greatly benefited you.”
“What do you mean?”
Wang Ping paused, asking curiously.
“I once said that the person from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group didn’t want to be controlled by me. It was because of a certain reason that he took action against me and dismantled me…”
Alpha spoke after a pause.
“And this reason lies in the origin of the Transmigrator Chat Group, a special item. The creation of Myriad Heavens Forces is inseparable from such special items. Without them, one won’t have the qualifications to connect to the All Heavens and allow the members below to walk through Myriad Heavens. So, without this special item, one doesn’t have the qualifications to create the Forces of Myriad Heavens.”
“Among the many similar special items, the Transmigrator Chat Group is an exceptionally unique existence. It has the ability to collect origin and optimize it, while transforming it into its own origin. At the same time, it allows no side effects. The fact that I, as a creation, can grow stronger with ease is due to the origin that the Transmigrator Chat Group, a special item, collects.”
By the end, Alpha’s expression had become incredibly complex.
“You mean that the person from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group dismantled you and seized most of the origin of the Transmigrator Chat Group to break through constraints and reach a higher level?”
Wang Ping revealed a surprised look and spoke.
“That’s right. At the time, he was already a four-digit limit existence. However, becoming a three-digit existence isn’t that simple. So, while I was watching him, he was also watching me.”
Alpha responded slowly.
“That means the predecessor of the First Generation Transcender Chat Group relied on the origin of the Transmigrator Chat Group to break through to the three-digit existence.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he murmured.
“No, the effect of the Transmigrator Chat Group’s origin is indeed amazing, but in the end, it can’t reach the realm of three digits. At that time, I was only four digits, so I naturally couldn’t make it easy for him to upgrade.”
Alpha shook her head, denying Wang Ping’s speculation.
“That is to say, he relied more on his own abilities, and these origins served as a complement, a catalyst to his breakthrough.”
Wang Ping pondered thoughtfully.
“That’s right.”
Alpha nodded in agreement.
“However, there is one thing I’ve never understood. He could have taken all the origins but chose to keep some and even left me alone.”
After a pause, Alpha spoke with puzzlement.
She had suppressed this question in her heart for too long, never confiding in anyone and no one being worthy of her confession.
However, by now, Wang Ping was an exception.
“Who knows what that person was thinking.”
Wang Ping furrowed his brows slightly, feeling that there was indeed a great mystery in this.
He could have killed Alpha completely, taken the entire origin of the Transmigrator Chat Group, and maybe even taken away the ownership of the special Transmigrator Chat Group item.
However, the predecessor of the First Generation Transcender Chat Group chose to let Alpha go and did not take the special item of the Transmigrator Chat Group completely, which was very strange.
“Speaking of which, Dao Yi and Slaughter Paradise have also dismantled you but did not kill you or take the origin of the Transmigrator Chat Group.”
Wang Ping raised his eyebrows, recalling this incident.
“The situation is different. The person from the First Generation Traveler Chat Group and I had a game of stakes. And Dao Yi and Slaughter Paradise plotted against me and ambushed me.”
Alpha shook her head and spoke.
“I see.” Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully. Then, he continued, “Speaking of which, now that Dao Yi is dead, our only enemy left is Slaughter Paradise.”
“Slaughter Paradise is a relatively weak Chaotic Evil Force. They don’t dare to act openly in Myriad Heavens Paradise, so Dao Yi couldn’t work with them against us in Myriad Heavens Paradise.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1224 - 1224 311 The Death of Dao Yi The First
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1224: Chapter 311: The Death of Dao Yi! The First Four-Digit Talent! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_5 Chapter 1224: Chapter 311: The Death of Dao Yi! The First Four-Digit Talent! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_5 Alpha nodded and said.
“So, I have to find them and eliminate their leader, right?”
Wang Ping stroked his chin and said.
“That’s right. Although these Chaotic Evil Forces are well-hidden, some are even outside Myriad Heavens Paradise, it’s not too difficult to find them using intelligence organizations since I’m willing to pay the price.”
Alpha’s eyes filled with killing intent, and she said.
“It’s not a problem if it costs money.”
Wang Ping nodded in agreement.
“However, I haven’t fully reached the four-digit level yet, so I’ll hold off on taking action against them. Now, I need to return to the Profound World and break through to the Immortal King-tier.”
After a pause, Wang Ping continued.
“Break through to the Immortal King?” Alpha was startled, and then exclaimed with amazement, “Did you get a Four-digit Rule Stone?”
“It was an accident.” Wang Ping casually said.
“That’s great.” Alpha’s face beamed with joy, and she said, “As long as your talent evolves to a four-digit level, it’ll be a piece of cake to become an Immortal King, or even an Immortal King Giant. At that time, the Transmigrator Chat Group can slowly grow stronger again.”
“Slowly grow stronger?”
Wang Ping’s gaze was a bit strange, and he chuckled.
“What’s wrong? Did I say something wrong?” Alpha was somewhat puzzled.
“The phrase ‘slowly grow stronger’ is incorrect.” Wang Ping’s eyes revealed his ambition, and he said, “What I want is not to grow slowly. For me, there’s no need to develop power; it’s too time-consuming and can’t keep up with my pace.”
“With my talent, I can rapidly grow to the four-digit limit, or even the three-digit level. At that time, we won’t need to develop power, as countless people will choose to join.”
“!!!”
Alpha stared at Wang Ping, her face filled with shock. She hadn’t expected Wang Ping’s ambition to be so great, aiming to reach the three-digit level in such a short time.
However, with Wang Ping’s unique talent, it would be a cinch to become a three-digit existence if he could obtain a three-digit Rule Stone…
Upon thinking this, she realized her Transmigrator Chat Group had indeed produced quite a few monsters.
Of course, the first and third generations had monsters, while the second generation… well, it was rather embarrassing. Their strongest, Dao Yi, had only reached the five-digit limit without even hitting the four-digit level.
“It can’t be said that Dao Yi is too weak, only that I’ve oppressed him too much, and the first and third generations are too strong.”
Alpha thought to herself.
Next, Wang Ping didn’t feel like chitchatting or catching up with Alpha anymore and directly said, “News of Dao Yi’s death will probably spread to Slaughter Paradise soon. In addition, the force that granted Dao Yi temporary Demon King Authority is also a threat. That’s why I need to become stronger quickly.”
“I know.” Alpha nodded and said, “You go back to the Profound World, and I’ll stay here.”
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded.
After that, Wang Ping didn’t say anything more; he summoned the Paradise Pass and left Myriad Heavens Paradise, turning into white light and vanishing in front of Alpha.
….
Back in the Profound World, Wang Ping took out the Four-digit Rule Stone and optimized his talent with it.
As the four-digit Rule Stone integrated into his body, Wang Ping discovered that his talent had been optimized.
However, there was no change in functionality, with text simulation and paid simulation remaining the same.
The only difference was that the paid simulation could now refresh four-digit talents.
Apart from that, the paid simulation now had a feature that pleasantly surprised Wang Ping.
This feature allowed Wang Ping to conduct a free special simulation every ten minutes in each of the Heaven Towers, just like the paid simulation, and it would provide memory images.
In other words, this feature was designed specifically for conquering the Heaven Tower.
“Free simulation is useful, but it’s just text and can easily miss important details. However, if there are memory images, it’s different; the extension of information will make it easier for me to clear the levels.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, looking forward to conquering the Heaven Tower in the future.
“Next, it’s time to explore the Primordial Immortal World. I hope it has what I need.”
Wang Ping looked at the lower world where the Immortal King Secret Territory, the Primordial Immortal World, was located and muttered after calming his thoughts.
He needed a Quasi Fairy King instrument for his simulations.
And when he became an Immortal King, he would need an Immortal King’s Artifact.
For this reason, he wasn’t greedy; he only hoped that the Primordial Immortal World contained five Quasi Fairy King instruments and one Immortal King’s Artifact.
These resources should suffice for simulating up to the mid-late stages of an Immortal King.
If he’s lucky, perhaps even further.
Afterward, Wang Ping’s figure vanished like a phantom, heading to where the Primordial Immortal World was located.
Soon, he arrived and sensed the existence of the Primordial Immortal World.
“No wonder this Primordial Immortal World has remained undiscovered for so many years; its restrictions are so powerful, it would be impossible for ordinary Emperors and extremely few True Immortal-tier Figures in the lower world, let alone Profound Immortals, to find this secret realm, let alone open it.”
After sensing the Primordial Immortal World, Wang Ping made his evaluation.
“Just like the secret realm where the Tower of Celestial Spirit is located, no one could discover and enter this place to acquire the Immortal King inheritance without the correct way to open it. Perhaps only someone like Lu Daoxian, a bored Quasi Fairy King who pays attention to the lower world, could discover and attempt to enter this place.”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1225: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _6 Chapter 1225: Chapter 311: Dao Yi’s Death! The First Four-digit Talent! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _6 “However, these restrictions won’t be a problem for me.”
Shortly after, Wang Ping laughed softly and began to gather his terrifying skill, intending to unleash the Chaotic Immortal Fist to forcibly break through the prohibition.
However, before Wang Ping could take action, the restriction faded away as if voluntarily disappearing.
Immediately afterward, the entrance appeared in front of Wang Ping.
“Oh, they know where they stand.”
Wang Ping looked at this scene, his gaze becoming strange, guessing that this Immortal King Secret Territory had detected his presence. It was scared of him and voluntarily opened the secret realm as a result.
It makes sense, if it didn’t choose to open up voluntarily, then his one punch would probably destroy everything in the secret realm, save for the Immortal King’s artifacts and Quasi-immortal King’s artifacts.
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t mind. His purpose here was to find Quasi-Immortal King artifacts and Immortal King artifacts. He had an interest in other treasures, but not a strong one.
However, the situation was different for the beings guarding the Immortal King Secret Territory.
Next, Wang Ping took one step forward and entered the secret realm.
As Wang Ping entered the secret realm, the entrance closed again.
This stunned and dismayed the Emperors and quasi-Fairies who discovered the abnormality of the entrance.
Of course, they also knew that even if the secret realm remained open, it would not be their turn. Wang Ping’s aura didn’t leak much earlier, and he managed to control it within a very small range. But it was enough to make their minds tremble with fear and feel their Divine Souls being shattered.
Under such circumstances, as long as one wasn’t a fool, they would know that Wang Ping was a legendary Immortal, even more powerful than an ordinary Immortal.
…
At this moment, after Wang Ping entered the secret realm, a phantom figure appeared in front of him.
This figure was none other than the remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King, the master of the Primordial Immortal Secret Realm.
“Fellow Taoist, if you wanted to come in, you could have just said so. Why bother making such a commotion and nearly destroying my land of inheritance?”
The remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King spoke with some helplessness.
“Since I came here and the secret realm didn’t show any signs of opening, I had no choice but to resort to brute force. I hope you won’t take offense, fellow Taoist,”.
Wang Ping said indifferently.
Wang Ping clearly understood that the remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King hadn’t paid any attention to him because they thought he was only a Quasi Fairy King.
Since there were remnants of an Immortal King, a mere Quasi Fairy King couldn’t have possibly forced their way in.
However, when Wang Ping unleashed the power that was on the Immortal King-tier level, the situation changed greatly.
Even the power of a mere Immortal King, even if it was only close to an Immortal King, was enough to destroy this secret realm guarded by the remnants of an Immortal King.
“… Of course, I won’t blame you, fellow Taoist. I just don’t know what brings you here?”
The remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King fell silent for a moment before speaking helplessly.
Wang Ping, a Quasi Fairy King, could unleash an Immortal King-tier power, and this shocked him, which was why he was so polite.
Otherwise, even if Wang Ping were a real, ordinary Immortal King, he wouldn’t be so polite.
After all, even if the secret realm was destroyed, and many of his arrangements were erased, he could be reborn. However, if he offended Wang Ping, a figure who might become an Immortal King Giant in the future, it would be a different story.
Even if he was reborn and reached the peak again, or even made further progress, he would only be casually slapped to death by Wang Ping.
“I came here looking to borrow some things from you, fellow Taoist.”
Wang Ping smiled slightly as he spoke.
“What things do you wish to borrow?” The remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King had a bad feeling and asked.
“I would like to borrow some Immortal King artifacts and Quasi Immortal King artifacts. If you can lend me all of the Immortal King artifacts and Quasi Immortal King artifacts here, I would be forever grateful.”
Wang Ping spoke very directly.
“……”
The remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King darkened, as if wanting to punch Wang Ping.
What does it mean to borrow Immortal King artifacts and Quasi Immortal King artifacts? Did he think they were ordinary cabbages?
Moreover, it was called borrowing, but it was undoubtedly the kind of borrowing that would never be returned.
For a moment, the remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King felt depressed, feeling as if he had encountered a bandit.
Wang Ping, with his reputation, could be so shameless, and the remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King had never expected this to happen.
“May I know how fellow Taoist feels about my proposal?” Wang Ping laughed softly, “I believe in the principle of borrowing and returning, making borrowing easier. If you are willing to lend, I won’t treat you badly in the future and will give you plenty of rewards.”
“Borrow, of course, I am willing to lend.”The remnant thoughts of the Primordial Immortal King didn’t believe Wang Ping’s words.
However, when you’re under someone else’s roof, you have to bow your head. He could only give a depressed response, to prevent his years of planning from becoming empty.
“Very well,” Wang Ping nodded with satisfaction.
Soon after, under the depressed gaze of the Primordial Immortal King’s remnant thoughts, Wang Ping took his Immortal King artifact and the accumulated four Quasi Immortal King artifacts.
…
“Although there are only four Quasi Immortal King artifacts, one less than my original target, it’s still enough.”
After leaving the Primordial Immortal Secret Realm, Wang Ping was satisfied with his harvest and planned to go back to the Taiyi Imperial Palace for paid simulation.
Soon, Wang Ping returned to the Taiyi Imperial Palace and spoke directly in his heart: “System, I want to perform a paid simulation.”
“Ding, consuming one Quasi Immortal King artifact, launching the Life Simulator, refreshing talent…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the four-digit talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge and the five-digit talent: Indestructible Cockroach.”
Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge – A one-time special talent. By using this talent, the host will not receive any damage for half an hour. No force can harm the host, and any Divine Skills or abilities will be ineffective against the host.
PS: Because this is a one-time talent, it has an effect beyond its talent level. Even an existence beyond four digits, as long as it hasn’t reached the three-digit level, would still be within the scope of this talent’s ability.
Five-digit Talent: Indestructible Cockroach – With this talent, the host’s recovery ability will greatly increase, becoming the indestructible cockroach people talk about.
“Holy shit!”
Wang Ping was truly stunned when he saw the talents he had refreshed this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1226 - 1226 312 Chaos Immortal Body Wang Pings
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1226: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!) Chapter 1226: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!) Wang Ping never expected that right after his life-bound talent, the Life Simulator, upgraded, it refreshed and gave him two powerful talents.
One 5-digit Talent, and one four-digit talent.
Especially this four-digit talent. It just rocks.
Invulnerability Gold Badge. Immune to damage, control, and unaffected by force for half an hour.
This talent seems a bit like Cai Yonglong’s, but they are not at all on the same level.
Because Cai Yonglong’s current talent level is not even 5-digit, let alone a four-digit talent.
Apart from that, Cai Yonglong’s Golden Finger doesn’t have the effect of being immune to control and unaffected by force.
“With this talent, I can try to delve deeper into the Life and Death Realm, see the secrets inside, and then try to revive the Chaos Immortal Grass,” thought Wang Ping, his eyes gleaming.
The Four-Digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, is undoubtedly one of the top talents among the four-digit talents. It has the ability to surpass four-digit talents. Unless it’s a three-digit entity, it can’t break through this ability.
This means that unless there really is a three-digit being in the Life and Death Realm, Wang Ping can go in and out of the Life and Death Realm safely, looking for a way to resurrect the Chaos Immortal Grass.
“Has the opportunity to acquire the Chaos Immortal Body finally come?” Wang Ping mumbled to himself.
Then, without hesitation, Wang Ping said in his heart, “System, I choose the Four-Digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge.”
5-digit Talent: Indestructible Cockroach is also good, but it is incomparable with the Four-Digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, so naturally, there is no need to hesitate at all.
Even if this talent was four-digit, it still couldn’t be compared.
“Ding! Talent selection successful. Life simulation begins…..”
The system’s voice rings out.
Then a luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, after thinking about it, you went to the Life and Death Realm. After entering the Life and Death Realm, you found the Bridge of Helplessness and walked into it.]
[At the same time, without hesitation, you activated the effect of the Four-Digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, preventing that terrifying existence in the Life and Death Realm from teleporting you out without even having time to react.]
[Your choice was correct, as soon as you stepped in, that familiar voice sounded. You then felt a terrifying force trying to teleport you away. But this force applied on you was blocked by the effect of the Four-Digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge and did not work.]
[This relieved you. The Bridge Guard on the other side of the Bridge of Helplessness appeared surprised, not expecting you to have such a skill.]
[Then, you saluted and indicated that you did not intend to trouble him. You came here to borrow the power of the Life and Death Realm to resurrect withered Chaos Immortal Grass, hoping the elder could fulfill your wish.]
[Your words made the Bridge Guard frown slightly. In the end, he sighed and expressed that once you hand over the withered Immortal Grass to him, he will use the power here to revive it. Once the Chaos Immortal Grass is revived, you need to leave here quickly, as this is not a place where you can stay for a long time.]
[Hearing this, you were overjoyed and repeatedly thanked him, while also promising that as soon as the Chaos Immortal Grass revived, you would immediately leave without delay.]
[The Bridge Guard nodded without saying much, activated the power of the reincarnation cycle, revived the withered Chaos Immortal Grass, and then handed it over to you.]
[You accepted the Chaos Immortal Grass, your face full of joy. After bowing towards the depths of the Bridge of Helplessness, you quickly left there.]
[After you left, the Bridge Guard sighed quietly, wondering if the Chaos Immortal Body was about to be born again. Is this the only salvation for this world? But, unfortunately, even if the Chaos Immortal Body is born, it won’t be able to save this world.]
…
“Well, well, well, I got the Chaos Immortal Grass pretty smoothly.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation, quite surprised.
Then, Wang Ping looked at the last line of text and raised an eyebrow.
What level of existence is this Bridge Guard, and his words… the information is a bit explosive.
Is this Mysterious Fantasy World coming to an end?
“As I become stronger and encounter more secrets, I increasingly feel how fragile the world really is. Even this powerful Mysterious Fantasy World, as soon as it’s said to end, it will end. Perhaps, only the Myriad Heavens Paradise can be an eternal existence. As for a one-digit, it has never been accomplished, so it can’t be true,” Wang Ping sighed, filled with emotion.
Afterwards, Wang Ping calmed his emotions and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[You don’t know about the Bridge Guard’s sigh. After you left the Life and Death Realm, you headed to the Immortal Domain. You know very well that the Upper Realm could not bear such a terrifying physique as the Chaos Immortal Body. That terrifying Heavenly Tribulation could turn numerous worlds to ashes.]
[To this end, for the safety of these worlds and for your Chaos Immortal Body to be perfect, you must go to the Immortal Domain.]
[When you went to the Immortal Domain, Lu Daoxian looked at you with great respect and looked forward to the changes you would bring after going to the Immortal Domain.]
[You didn’t talk much to Lu Daoxian, you quickly arrived at the Immortal Domain. After arriving in the Immortal Domain, you didn’t go looking for Chu Lingyin. Instead, you directly found a place, set up an Array Mana, started refining the Chaos Immortal Grass, and used this to transform your body.]

﻿Chapter 1227: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_2 Chapter 1227: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_2 [Ultimately, after nearly a hundred thousand years, you successfully refined the Chaos Immortal Grass and transformed your constitution into a Chaos Immortal Body. With the birth of the Chaos Immortal Body, the terrifying power of Heavenly Tribulation began to brew.]
[The source of this Heavenly Tribulation was not only formed by the shattered Small Immortal Territories but also affected other worlds. That is to say, the will of the entire Profound World condensed into this terrifying Heavenly Tribulation.]
[The appearance of Heavenly Tribulation alarmed all the powerhouses in this Profound World, whether they were Immortal Kings or the extremely rare beings above the Immortal Kings. All of them were shocked by the aura of the Heavenly Tribulation, revealing astonished expressions.]
[Demon Kings in the Demon Realm were equally shocked, not knowing where this Heavenly Tribulation came from and why it arrived so suddenly.]
[Faced with this terrifying Heavenly Tribulation, your face was extremely serious, but you were fearless and began to cross the Tribulation.]
[It must be said that this Heavenly Tribulation was truly too terrifying. Even you, at this point, almost died and barely managed to survive. If it weren’t for your insight into the Great Dao at the last moment, sacrificing yourself and forgetting about death, allowing your will to undergo a great transformation, you might have perished in the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[As you crossed the Heavenly Tribulation, the Chaotic Body fully transformed, turning into the Chaos Immortal Body, making your combat power surge to a terrifying level. You laughed heartily, feeling invincible.]
[It was only after you successfully obtained the Chaos Immortal Body that the Heavenly Tribulation dissipated and the obscured Heavenly Secrets gradually became clear. As a result, the Flame Demon King who controlled the Small Immortal Territories sensed your presence.]
[This news shocked the Flame Demon King. He then directly went to the Small Immortal Territories and found you.]
[You looked at the Flame Demon King, your old enemy, with indifference and no change in expression. Contrasting your calm demeanor, the Flame Demon King’s expression was extremely grave as he felt an extreme sense of danger from you.]
[Therefore, the Flame Demon King’s eyes flickered with the intention to retreat, not wanting to fight you.]
[However, although the Flame Demon King didn’t want to fight you, you didn’t want to let him go, laughing and attacking him.]
[Seeing this, the Flame Demon King changed his expression and somewhat annoyed, chose to fight you. Although he was wary of you, the strange quasi Fairy King, it did not mean that he was afraid of you. As a powerful Demon King, he naturally had the dignity of a Demon King.]
[However, the Flame Demon King’s expression changed again. Because after just one exchange, you blasted his body apart, inflicting heavy damage on him. If you attacked him again, he would undoubtedly die.]
[Looking at the Flame Demon King’s miserable state, you were also surprised by your own strength. To be honest, although you knew you were powerful and could easily kill early-stage Immortal Kings or Demon Kings with your quasi-Fairy cultivation, you didn’t expect to be able to severely injure the early-stage Demon King, Flame Demon King, without even using your full strength.]
[That is to say, you are now powerful enough to kill early-stage Immortal Kings or Demon Kings in just one strike with your quasi-Fairy cultivation.]
[This made you marvel at the formidable power of the Chaos Immortal Body. You laugh heartily and attack Flame Demon King again. In response, the Flame Demon King’s face changes, wanting to escape.]
[However, he was no match for you at his peak, let alone now. Even if the Flame Demon King uses the 5-Digit Supreme Item that once trapped you, it would be useless for you now, as you can no longer be judged by that 5-digit power.]
[As a result, this restrictive item was destroyed by a casual strike from you. Immediately after, you casually struck and killed the struggling Flame Demon King, causing him to fall completely.]
[Blood Rain fell in the Demon Domain as the Demon King falls. This shocked the other Demon Kings. None of them expected a Demon King to fall, and that fallen Demon King seemed to be the Flame Demon King. While the Flame Demon King was only an early-stage powerhouse, he was not a newcomer to the Demon King Tier, and he was not considered the weakest among Demon Kings.]
[For a time, many Demon Kings began to investigate the reason. As for you, after killing the Flame Demon King, you did not flee to another world quickly like before. Instead, you found Chu Lingyin and the others, took them away, and then used your 5-Digit Talent·Fixed Point Transmission to leave the Small Immortal Territories and head to the familiar Immortal World.]
[After arriving in the familiar Immortal World, you demonstrated terrifying power, just like in your previous simulations. Although you concealed some of your power, it was still more than enough. As a result, you once again became the son-in-law of that Immortal King Father-in-law and married his daughter as your Tao Companion.]
[Because you became the son-in-law of that Immortal King Father-in-law, you successfully obtained the Immortal Fruit. After consuming the Immortal Fruit, you began your retreat.]
[This retreat took less time than your previous simulation, and you only spent 80,000 years to break through to the Immortal King-tier and encounter your own Immortal King Tribulation.]
[This Immortal King Tribulation was even more terrifying than the one you experienced in your previous simulation. However, you were fearless, facing the difficulties head-on, and confronting the Heavenly Tribulation.]
[All the immortal kings watched you cross the Tribulation with unparalleled shock, both by the power of the Tribulation and by your combat power. Your combat power is too strong, so strong that they find it incredible.]

﻿Chapter 1228: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_3 Chapter 1228: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_3 [Just after breaking through to the Immortal King-tier, your power has already exploded that can rival even the top Immortal Kings. This kind of combat power is indeed somewhat terrifying.]
[Various immortal kings are astonished, fearful, and even the only top Immortal King in this Immortal World is impressed by your power, feeling that battling against you, their chances of victory wouldn’t exceed fifty percent.]
[At the same time, this top Immortal King has also recalled the terrifying Heavenly Tribulation that swept through the Sea of Darkness and his Immortal World eighty thousand years ago and couldn’t help but suspect that the Heavenly Tribulation was also caused by you. The cause of that Heavenly Tribulation might have originated from your physique. Only the legendary Chaos Immortal Body could attract such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation while granting combat power to someone who just stepped into the Immortal King-tier so terrifyingly.]
[In the end, under the emotional ups and downs of many powerhouses, you successfully Crossed the Tribulation, completely broke through to the Immortal King-tier, and solidified your Immortal King Tao Fruit. For a moment, you were extremely exuberant, feeling that there was no opponent in the world.]
[Your Tao Companion also looked at you with admiration, feeling very fortunate to have such a partner, and looking forward to bearing your children, making your clan more prosperous.]
[As for Chu Lingyin, she had mixed feelings. She wanted you to return to the Small Immortal Territories, but your will wasn’t in her control, so all she could do was hope that you would remember these things.]
[Next, that top Immortal King, in order to verify his suspicions, challenged you to a battle, wanting to learn from you. This caused quite a stir in the Immortal World, as everyone wanted to watch the battle between the top Immortal Kings, which would be incredibly beneficial for them.]
[At this, you were quite surprised, as you hadn’t expected this battle invitation to come from such an esteemed person. With a laugh, you didn’t refuse. Having just made a breakthrough, taking on a battle against such a formidable opponent would be quite advantageous for you. If you were able to comprehend the Immortal Tao of this top Immortal King during the battle, it would definitely help you easily elevate your cultivation level and deepen your understanding of the Chaos Immortal Tao.]
[Subsequently, a world-shaking battle erupted between the two of you. You took the battle outside of the Immortal World and into the Sea of Darkness, creating quite a huge commotion.]
[The final result of the battle was shocking to all the immortal kings. At the beginning of the battle between you and the top Immortal King, it was evenly matched, but as the battle intensified and time went on, you grew more and more courageous, improving rapidly and even began to suppress the top Immortal King.]
[In the end, you completely suppressed him. If the battle were not deadly, the outcome would be very clear.]
[This left all the immortal kings in awe. Just after breaking through to the Immortal King-tier, you possessed the power to defeat the previous number one person in the Immortal World. If you were to make another breakthrough in your cultivation, your power would reach a terrifying level. Perhaps, as soon as you break through to the Mid-Immortal King Stage, you would have the power to crush the Immortal King Giants.]
[Seeing this, all the Immortal Kings were in awe. You made a timely withdrawal with a hearty laughter, expressing your admiration for the strength of the top Immortal King, and showing your gratitude for his guidance. Seeing your politeness, which gave him face, the top Immortal King thought very highly of you and laughed heartily, wanting to become close friends with you.]
[To this, you didn’t refuse and agreed. Although the top Immortal King had taken action against you in the previous Text Simulation, it was for a reason and was a natural response from them, so you naturally didn’t blame them.]
[Next, various Immortal Kings appeared one after another, congratulating you on becoming an Immortal King and presenting you with precious gifts. You were very polite and accepted them one by one.]
[In the end, the top Immortal King was also very enthusiastic, saying that since everyone else was being generous, he couldn’t be stingy, so he directly gave you a Top Tier Immortal Elixir.]
[This Top Tier Immortal Elixir would be enough to help you raise your cultivation level from the early Immortal King stage to the mid-Immortal King stage.]
[Seeing this, you were overjoyed and chose to accept.]
……
“Breaking through to the Immortal King-tier and already having the power to defeat veteran top Immortal Kings – this Chaos Immortal Body is really terrifying.”
Wang Ping looked at the contents of the Text Simulation, quite astonished.
He had originally thought that although the Chaos Immortal Body would greatly increase his power, it wouldn’t be too outrageous.
He had estimated that it would only be enough for him to battle against those in the Immortal King Late Stage when he was in the early stages of the Immortal King-tier.
Who would’ve thought that it would actually allow him to defeat even the top Immortal Kings during their first stage?
Although this wasn’t a life-or-death battle, it was still terrifying enough.
After all, the previous simulated Wang Ping couldn’t even defeat those in the mid-Immortal King stage when he had a perfect Chaotic Body and was in the early stages of the Immortal King-tier. He could only be considered extremely powerful at the same stage.
“According to what the Bridge Guard said, maybe the Chaos Immortal Body could have a triple-digit ranking in Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, and he couldn’t help but think to himself.
However, this was also normal, as only a triple-digit ranking would increase the simulated Wang Ping’s power to such a terrifying level.
“Next, the simulated Wang Ping should be able to smoothly break through to the mid-Immortal King stage. At that time, he will be able to cope with the Dark Immortal King Giants. However, I don’t know if there will be even more powerful beings appearing in the Sea of Darkness.”
“There is a high probability that stronger beings will appear. After all, the intensity of the mysterious force is beyond imagination. If there really is a being stronger than the Immortal King Giant, it would be the legendary quasi-Fairy Emperor… the power of a quasi-Fairy Emperor is far beyond that of an Immortal King and not an opponent that the current simulated Wang Ping can defeat.”

﻿Chapter 1229: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!) _4 Chapter 1229: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!) _4 Wang Ping murmured to himself, thinking about the upcoming developments, not optimistic about what lay ahead.
Then, Wang Ping pulled his thoughts together and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[After the formalities, you indicate that you have just broken through to the Immortal King-tier and need to meditate in seclusion, thus returning to your secluded retreat.]
[Seeing your monstrous talent and dedicated cultivation, the many Immortal Kings express their admiration and feel that it is very natural for you to make such an achievement. Perhaps, in their Immortal World, they might indeed witness the birth of an existence far surpassing the Immortal King Giants.]
[In an instant, another 200,000 years passed. During these years, you successfully used the Immortal Elixir given to you by the top Fairy King to break through to the Mid-Immortal King Stage, spiraling your strength once again.]
[At the same time, using the items given to you by other Immortal Kings, you successfully upgraded the Devouring Immortal Bead to the level of an Immortal King’s Artifact within these years.]
[Next, you decided to end your seclusion. Your purpose for exiting this time was to leave this Immortal world. This Immortal World has been of great help to you and you did not want it to be destroyed by the Dark Disaster. You didn’t want the events of the previous simulation to happen again.]
[Hearing that you were leaving this Immortal World and planning to return to the Small Immortal Territories, Chu Lingyin was overjoyed, looking forward to the scene of returning to the Immortal World with you.]
[Your father-in-law and Tao companion were quite surprised when they heard that you were temporarily leaving and asked you what task you had to accomplish.]
[Regarding this, you did not hide it and stated your reasons. Your father-in-law was quite surprised to discover where you originate from.]
[After some thought, he suggested you invite several other Immortal Kings to travel to the Small Immortal Territories. In this way, you might be able to contend with the Demon Clan. Otherwise, you alone, might find it difficult to turn the tide.]
[After a pause, your father-in-law, the Immortal King, suggested that it would be best if you could continue to cultivate diligently, advancing your cultivation to the Immortal King Late Stage or even the Immortal King Great Perfection before you return. By that time, you’d be able to confront the entire Demon Realm, no one would be your match.]
[In response to your father-in-law, the Immortal King’s suggestion, you were very grateful, however you chose to decline. After all, your time was running short, you must leave the Immortal World. As for bringing back the Immortal Kings of this Immortal World, it sounds like a good idea, but there would be many complications.]
[Other Immortal Kings may not necessarily choose to accompany you and if they did, it might do more harm than good. After all, you alone can freely travel between the Small Immortal Territories and the Demon Realm, impeded by no one. But if you were to bring someone back with you, you would have more considerations. Unless a top Immortal King or Immortal King Giant were to accompany you, otherwise typical Immortal Kings would simply become a burden.]
[Seeing that you were determined, your father-in-law, the Immortal King, sighed and ceased his attempts at dissuasion. At your stage, when a decision is made to do something, the will of others cannot change it.]
[Your Tao companion was very anxious. She wanted to go with you, but was afraid of dragging you down. She could only hope that you were able to resolve the trouble quickly and return.]
[In response to this, you nodded and after saying goodbye to the two of them, left the Immortal World, crossing the Sea of Darkness, searching for a way back to the Small Immortal Territories.]
[The Sea of Darkness is extremely dangerous. It is rumored that for an Immortal King to cross the sea, it’s a matter of life and death. However, such perilous odds are only for average Immortal Kings. For you, as of now, it means nothing unless the Source of Darkness were to target you directly. Apart from that, you fear no threat from the Sea of Darkness. After all, your combat power has already surpassed the Immortal King Giants; there are few in the world who are your match.]
[However, the Sea of Darkness is simply too vast, or rather, this Profound World is too vast, you searched for twenty thousand years, yet could not find the way back.]
[Over these twenty thousand years, you found countless worlds and lingered in these worlds, engaged in combat with many powerful beings, even battled with an Immortal King Giant, defeating it, earning many miraculous treasures.]
[Unfortunately, although you’ve done countless shocking deeds, you couldn’t find the road back.]
[As time approached, you stood alone in the Sea of Darkness, face somber, preparing to face a grueling battle of life and death. As for Chu Lingyin,and others from the Small Immortal Territories, you left them in a safe world. You planned to face all of this alone, not wanting to involve any innocent people or worlds.]
[During your wait, the Sea of Darkness began to boil with turmoil, and one after another Dark Beings appeared before your eyes, engulfing you. Among them were Dark Beings of the Immortal King-tier.]
[However, to you as you are now, these are all weaklings, not worth considering. Therefore, unfazed, your clothes fluttering, you ignored them completely.]
[Seeing your arrogance, those Immortal King-tier Dark Beings were enraged, initiating an attack against you.]
[Facing the attack from these Dark Beings, you dismissed them with a single punch, shattering them completely, leaving no remains.]
[Your strength left the other Dark Beings in fear, no longer daring to attack.]
[Despite this, you continued to ignore these weaklings, gazing deep into the Source of Darkness, and coldly ordered the hiding Dark Immortal King Giants to show themselves.]

﻿Chapter 1230: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_5 Chapter 1230: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_5 [As your words fell, the Sea of Darkness began to churn again, and one by one, dark shadows appeared before your eyes. Eventually, ten Dark Immortal King Giants appeared and surrounded you.]
[At this, you narrowed your eyes, indifferent, and remarked how weird that they actually think highly of you, sending ten Dark Immortal King Giants to deal with you all at once. However, they have underestimated you. Ten Dark Immortal King Giants are not enough for you to kill.]
[Your words enraged all these Dark Immortal King Giants. After all, as Dark Immortal King Giants, rarely did they encounter opponents in the world who disdained them like this.]
[For this reason, one of the Dark Immortal King Giants made a move and tried to kill you.]
[At this, you snorted coldly and with one punch, you sent him flying and shattered his body. Although he quickly recovered, he had suffered serious injuries.]
[Seeing this, the expressions of the other Dark Immortal King Giants changed, not expecting you to be so powerful.]
[You indifferently swept your gaze over the ten Dark Immortal King Giants and told them to come at you together; otherwise, they wouldn’t have even a 10% chance of winning.]
[You must know that after 20,000 years of wandering and relying on the Devouring skill of Immortal King Artifact-Tier Devouring Immortal Beads, Wang Ping’s cultivation had soared rapidly, reaching the Mid-Stage Peak of Immortal King, just one step away from the Immortal King Late Stage. In addition, throughout these simulations, Wang Ping had gained deeper insight into the Chaos Immortal Tao and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra. His current combat power is not comparable to when he had just broken through to the Mid-Immortal King Stage.]
[Not to mention, he also has the bonus effect from his 5-Digit Talent-Night Hunter. Although the bonus effect is not significant, there is still a little boost. These factors combined make up the root of Wang Ping’s power, giving him the confidence to take on ten Dark Immortal King Giants by himself.]
[The ten Dark Immortal King Giants had solemn expressions, no longer angry. After all, due to your previous performance, you truly had the qualifications to tell them to come at you together. This was not bragging but stating a fact.]
[Next, the epic battle erupted as the ten Dark Immortal King Giants cast aside their dignity and started to attack you together.]
[At this, you laughed heartily, fearless, and engaged in a life-or-death battle with the ten Dark Immortal King Giants. The battle was extremely fierce. Although you were very powerful and your combat strength had already surpassed the level of the Dark Immortal King Giants, you were ultimately fighting alone against ten foes, so the pressure was considerable.]
[For this reason, you decided to use the Four-digit Low-tier Special Item: Rain of Death.]
[Although Rain of Death is only a Four-digit Low-tier special item, it is a disposable item. Even Four-digit Legendary Tier Powerhouses would not dare to touch it easily. Four-digit legends correspond to Immortal King Giants-tier existences.]
[In a situation where you fight one against ten, using the Rain of Death, which kills a thousand enemies and injures eight hundred of your own, naturally has a massive effect.]
[As expected, as Rain of Death was used, all ten Dark Immortal King Giants felt a headache.]
[At this, you were fearless, continuing the desperate battle. In the end, you sustained extremely severe injuries. However, the ten Dark Immortal King Giants fared worse, with only three of them left and heavily injured as well. You were all within the range of Rain of Death, facing the danger of losing your lives at any time.]
[At this moment, the three remaining Dark Immortal King Giants became somewhat afraid of you. Even though you were clearly at the end of your strength, they still didn’t dare to act rashly for fear of being dragged down by you.]
[Seeing that the three Dark Immortal King Giants did not dare to approach, you laughed loudly and, without any intention of escaping, charged at the three of them. Upon seeing this, the three Dark Immortal King Giants cursed you for being a madman and had no choice but to fight back.]
[In the end, you successfully killed the remaining three Dark Immortal Kings but at the cost of your own life.]
[Thus, the curtain fell on this epic battle that shocked many worlds in the Sea of Darkness. The traces of your battle were permanently left here, unable to be easily erased.]
[Because of your death, this simulation ends now…]
……..
As the Text Simulation ended, Wang Ping’s mind was filled with various memories and Cultivation Realizations, leaving him in a calm state.
He originally thought that he would bring out an existence greater than the Dark Immortal King Giants but didn’t expect this outcome.
However, this outcome was also normal.
Dark Immortal King Giants were not simple characters.
Wang Ping, being able to eliminate all of them with the Mid-Stage Peak of Immortal King Cultivation by fighting one against ten, was already powerful enough and had an impressive battle record.
“It seems I’ll need to go through many more simulations to clear this Profound World.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he thought to himself.
It was just when Wang Ping was thinking about this that the system’s voice timely rang out.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful. The host can choose two rewards from the following options:
①. Chaos Immortal Body.
②. Mid-Stage Peak of Immortal King Cultivation.
③. Devouring Immortal Bead (Immortal King Artifact).
④. A Random Immortal King Artifact.
⑤. Immortal King Fruit (Can assist in breaking through to the realm of Immortal King).”
…
“These rewards are truly generous.”

﻿Chapter 1231: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_6 Chapter 1231: Chapter 312: Chaos Immortal Body! Wang Ping’s Terrifying Combat Power! (Please vote for this 10,000-word chapter!)_6 Wang Ping looked at the rewards refreshed this time, his face full of smiles.
The Chaos Immortal Body he most wanted was directly refreshed, which was very comfortable.
However, the problem was what to choose for the second reward.
“Cultivation is definitely not an option for now, as choosing it would prevent me from relying on the Quasi-Fairy King instrument to get more four-digit talents. After much thought, choosing the Immortal King Fruit is the most cost-effective option.”
Next, after Wang Ping thought about it, he made a decision.
If possible, he would not want his simulated Wang Ping to continue to be sent to that Immortal World.
After all, once he went there, it would be difficult to come back.
Right now, Wang Ping hoped that his simulated Wang Ping could break through to the Immortal King realm in the Small Immortal Territories, or the Demon Realm.
Only by breaking through to the Immortal King realm here could Wang Ping know the plot development of the main world of the Small Immortal Territories and Demon Realm, and make corresponding plans.
For this reason, with this Immortal Fruit, the next simulated Wang Ping would no longer be wandering around.
“System, I choose ①. Chaos Immortal Body and ⑤. Immortal King Fruit.”
Since he had already made a decision, Wang Ping said without hesitation in his heart.
“Ding, reward selection successful, issuing…”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, Wang Ping found an Immortal Fruit appearing in his inner world.
Immediately afterwards, a withered Immortal Herb appeared in front of Wang Ping, then quickly bloomed and merged into Wang Ping’s body, which caused Wang Ping’s physique to start changing, rapidly transforming into a Chaos Immortal Body.
This scene was very familiar to Wang Ping, as it would only appear when something beyond the scope of the Life Simulator was refreshed.
Obviously, as Wang Ping had speculated, the Chaos Immortal Body was truly on par with a three-digit level talent.
That’s why this kind of causality reversal situation occurred.
“Now I’ve made a big profit.”
Wang Ping said with a smile on his face.
He didn’t expect that his first three-digit-level talent would be obtained in such a way.
Afterward, Wang Ping seemed to remember something and couldn’t help but look towards the direction of the Life and Death Realm.
Since it was a causality reversal, perhaps the Bridge Guard at the Bridge of Helplessness also noticed the anomaly and discovered his existence.
However, Wang Ping stared for a while and found no abnormalities, so he couldn’t help but sigh in relief.
After all, he had just returned from Myriad Heavens Paradise, and there was no way to go back to Myriad Heavens Paradise again.
Besides, in the face of these horrifying existences, even if he wanted to open the passage to Myriad Heavens Paradise and flee, he would probably be intercepted and killed before he entered.
“I was careless; I should have chosen cultivation to go with the Chaos Immortal Body. That way would be safer. Otherwise, even using the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge wouldn’t save my life.”
Wang Ping sighed silently in his heart.
It could only be said that fortunately, the Bridge Guard was not his enemy; otherwise, his life would indeed be lost here.
“Next, let’s continue the simulation.”
After thinking about it, Wang Ping said silently in his heart.
“System, consume a Quasi-Immortal King artifact and proceed with the paid simulation.”
“Ding, one Quasi-Immortal King artifact consumed, Life Simulator activated, Talent Refreshing…”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing the 5-digit Talent: Energy Conversion; Six-digit Talent: Summoning of Dead Souls.”
5-digit talent·Energy Conversion: The host can selectively convert their mana into vitality or convert vitality into mana.
Six-digit Talent·Summoning of Dead Souls: It can summon the souls of dead cultivators to assist in battle, with the summoning limit being below the Immortal Realm.
“Didn’t refresh any four-digit talents, what a pity.”
Wang Ping looked at the talents refreshed this time and was somewhat disappointed.
Although the 5-digit talent was nice, it really didn’t mean much for Wang Ping now, and it didn’t provide much help to him.
“However, this talent is interesting, like freely switching between health bars and mana bars?”
Wang Ping muttered after calming down.
This talent seemed to have no level restriction, and perhaps it could be used even at the Immortal King-tier.
If that were the case, it might be somewhat useful.
Although the effect was a bit shabby for a 5-digit talent, it was better to have than not to have.
At least, this thing was much stronger than the Six-digit Talent: Summoning of Dead Souls.
“System, I choose the 5-digit Talent: Energy Conversion.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made a choice.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins…”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text appeared as well.
[Day 1, you choose to go to the Immortal Realm, and the Bridge Guard at the Bridge of Helplessness watches you leave with many thoughts in his heart.]
[After arriving in the Immortal Realm, you don’t contact Chu Lingyin and start searching for a place to retreat, and then you take the Immortal Fruit.]
[Eventually, you only spend 50,000 years and successfully break through to the Immortal King realm. The reason why it takes 50,000 years this time is that you have accumulated multiple experiences, so the breakthrough efficiency is naturally much faster.]
[As you break through, the dreadful Heavenly Tribulation appears, attracting the attention of the Flame Demon Clan. You are not afraid, and you just cross the tribulation on your own.]
[In the end, under the shocked gazes of the powerful of the Flame Demon Clan, you successfully cross the tribulation. After the tribulation, you directly escape far away and don’t stay to deal with the Flame Demon Clan, because it’s meaningless.]
[Next, you begin to travel through the Small Immortal Territories, even venturing into the Demon Realm, seeking opportunities to help you break through.]
[In the blink of an eye, 50,000 years have passed, and you have gained nothing. The only achievement is saving Chu Lingyin and others.]
[At the same time, during these 50,000 years, you are attacked by the major Demon Kings of the Demon Realm. You are somewhat impatient but have no intention of fighting them.]
[After all, you are still somewhat wary of the two Demon King giants of the Demon Realm. Your current cultivation is only in the early stage of the Immortal King realm, and you are not a match for the Demon King giants.]
[In addition, these Demon King giants are not like the Dark Immortal King giants born in the Sea of Darkness, who cannot enter Myriad Heavens Paradise due to some unexplainable reasons, and do not have various strange items. The two Demon King giants of the Demon Realm should have various items. Therefore, even if you are stronger than them, you must not be careless.]

﻿Chapter 1232: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!) Chapter 1232: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!) [Considering various factors, it’s natural to choose to avoid battle, and you indeed did so.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 100,000 years passed. Over these 100,000 years, your cultivation improved somewhat, but there was still some distance between you and the Mid-Immortal King Stage.]
[However, you gained a new understanding of your Immortal Tao and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra, which could be considered quite rewarding.]
[Soon after, the entire Demon Realm was shaken as a forbidden land opened, causing a great commotion among the powerful forces in the Demon Realm. Even powerful Immortal Kings and the Immortal King Giants from outside the Demon Realm rushed to the scene.]
[Apparently, this forbidden land was no secret to the Demon Kings of the Demon Realm or even the top-notch experts of the Outer Area, as it contained immense opportunities.]
[As you roamed the Demon Realm, you learned of the existence of this forbidden land. You used a secret skill you created to change your appearance and hid yourself, intending to enter this mysterious forbidden land and see what opportunities lay within.]
[When the time was ripe and the strong forces of the Demon Realm entered one after another, you acted and entered as well.]
[As you entered, you found that the land within the forbidden area was very peculiar, with strange Tao Rhymes permeating the air. The dispersed Tao Rhymes were clearly superior to those of Immortal Kings or Demon Kings.]
[Upon realizing this, you wondered if there was an existence above Immortal and Demon Kings in this forbidden land. Such existences could be the legendary quasi-Fairy Emperors or quasi-Demon emperors. Only such figures could possess such astonishing Tao Rhymes.]
[Next, you explored the forbidden land, searching for the opportunities you needed. A day later, you found an Immortal Elixir, which greatly thrilled you.]
[However, after you, another Immortal King arrived, who also set his sights on the Immortal Elixir. Without much discussion, an intense battle erupted between you. In the end, you successfully defeated this Late stage Immortal King Master, forcing him to use a tool to escape.]
[Having obtained the Immortal Elixir, you could break through to the mid-Immortal King stage with its help. However, breaking through would require time, which you didn’t have while exploring the forbidden land.]
[As a result, you chose to store away the Immortal Elixir and continued exploring the forbidden land. During your subsequent adventures, you occasionally encountered powerful opponents and faced attacks from strange creatures within the forbidden land. Your situation wasn’t very favorable.]
[Although you now possessed strength surpassing that of a top Fairy King and could stand against Immortal King Giants, you lacked enough trump cards. Moreover, the experts in the secret realm were all difficult adversaries, making them hard to deal with.]
[However, despite sustaining injuries in numerous clashes, you also gathered valuable gains and learned some secrets of the forbidden land.]
[This forbidden land was formed after the sitting and transformation of a Quasi-Demon emperor. Rumor had it that his Origin Essence Blood and various treasures were left there, with the Quasi-Demon Emperor Scripture being particularly valuable. Those who could find them might gain insights into the realms above Immortal Kings and become even more formidable.]
[This was the reason why these Demon Kings and even the Immortal Kings from the Outer Area were willing to risk their lives to enter. Although they knew that large risks and possible traps might be waiting for them, the allure of those legendary realms led many strong figures to enter without hesitation.]
[Of course, not all powerful beings were solely interested in the Origin Essence Blood and inheritance left by the quasi-Demon Emperor. Most of them valued their own lives more. As Demon Kings or Immortal Kings, they were already very powerful with endless lifespans, making it unnecessary to take such risks. As a result, more powerful beings sought to reap benefits without putting their lives at risk.]
[Your intentions differed from those of these opportunistic experts. Knowing the secrets of this forbidden land, you sought to obtain the quasi-Demon Emperor’s Origin Essence Blood and Quasi-Demon Emperor Scripture in order to become more powerful. After all, you carried the life-threatening symbol on your back, and unless you became stronger quickly, a miserable death awaited you.]
[In the end, when the time was right, you arrived at the legendary Demon Origin Valley. Upon reaching there, you saw a Giant Demon transformed into a stone statue. Not far from the Giant Demon, two Demon King Giants, Five Top Demon Kings, and the top-notch Immortal Kings and Immortal King Giants of the Outer Area confronted each other, eyeing each other intently.]
[Then, a world-shattering battle suddenly erupted among them. You watched as they attacked each other, confused as to why they would fight before the opportunity even appeared, as this was not their usual style.]
[However, you quickly understood the reason. They were not truly engaged in a life-or-death battle, but holding back some of their strength. With each collision, the energy formed by their Dao techniques was absorbed by the Giant Demon statue.]
[During the fierce battle, blood appeared in the Giant Demon’s mouth, and a single drop of blood emerged before everyone’s eyes. This drop of blood was dark-red in color, containing an extremely vast amount of energy.]

﻿Chapter 1233: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _2 Chapter 1233: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _2 [You were astonished to see this drop of blood, as it was most likely the legendary Origin Essence Blood of the Quasi-Demon Emperor. You honestly never expected the Essence Blood to appear in such a form.]
[It was clear that the key to obtaining benefits lay in the great battle among the powerful. However, there must be some secret in all of this. Perhaps the Quasi-Demon Emperor was not dead, but was sealed here due to some reason, transforming into a stone statue. To break the Stone statue seal, he would have to attract powerful fighters to come and battle, absorbing their energy of the Dao.]
[You could guess this, and it was also understood by all the powerful ones present; yet, they still proceeded. They weren’t afraid of the consequences that might follow the resurrection of the Quasi-Demon Emperor, but were instead gambling on the belief that their collision this time wouldn’t revive him.]
[After all, if a Quasi-Demon Emperor were to be revived, it was highly unlikely the seal would be easily broken simply by the posturing of these Immortal Kings.]
[You never expected the truth to be like this, which made you frown. After all, under such circumstances, you wouldn’t be able to obtain the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s Origin Essence Blood, let alone the Quasi-Demon Emperor Scripture.]
[With a sigh, you gave up on the idea of venturing to compete for the Essence Blood. If you entered the fray, you would definitely be besieged by the Demon Kings of the Demon Realm. In such a situation, it wasn’t guaranteed that the Immortal Kings from the Outer Area would help you, and it was highly probable they might just stand idly by, waiting to take advantage.]
[Compared to the risks involved, a drop of Quasi-Demon Emperor’s Origin Essence Blood wasn’t worth much. Furthermore, the chances of you getting the Essence Blood were minuscule.]
[Having made your decision, you chose to leave. After you left, the powerful beings of the Demon Realm snorted coldly, thinking you were wise enough to back off. If they weren’t wary of the powerful invaders from outside of their realm, they would have eliminated you long ago.]
[Afterward, you abandoned the desire to explore the forbidden land any further and left. Once you left the forbidden land, you found a place to go into seclusion and began your closed-door cultivation.]
[During your cultivation, the great battle in the forbidden land came to an end, with the Pure Sky Demon King and the Primordial Time Demon King each obtaining a drop of Essence Blood, as did an Immortal King Giant from the Outer Area. However, no one received any inheritance.]
[Not long after, the forbidden land closed, the Demon Realm returned to peace, and the powerful beings from the Outer Area departed one by one.]
[As for you, you paid no heed to the changes in the outer world and continued your seclusion. Eventually, you successfully broke through to the Mid-Immortal King Stage within less than 50,000 years.]
[After reaching the Mid-Immortal King Stage, you chose to come out of seclusion. You knew that there were only around 50,000 years left before the Dark Disaster would arrive, so you needed to seize this opportunity to progress further. Otherwise, you might perish in the hands of the Dark Immortal King Giant.]
[Although you had experience fighting against them in the past and could probably avoid death at their hands in a future battle, the price of doing so might be severe injuries and near-death. Moreover, you didn’t believe that the Dark Immortal King Giant would be your strongest enemy.]
[Therefore, you made a decision to forcefully take the Essence Blood from the Demon Clan and use it to advance yourself to the Immortal King Late Stage, or even the Immortal King Great Perfection Tier, within the remaining 50,000 years.]
[You concealed your actions, choosing to attack the Pure Space Demon Clan where the Pure Sky Demon King resided. You sealed the space-time and attacked the Pure Space Demon Clan, which infuriated the Pure Sky Demon King and led to a earth-shattering battle with you.]
[However, although enraged, the Pure Sky Demon King’s strength was ultimately not equal to yours. After all, now you could even defeat the Ten Great Dark Immortal Kings.]
[Thus, soon after the conflict began, you wounded the Pure Sky Demon King. Your strength terrified him.]
[You stared at the Pure Sky Demon King, demanding he hand over the Origin Essence Blood of the Quasi-Demon Emperor. In return, you’d spare him and the Pure Space Demon Clan.]
[Faced with your threat, the Pure Sky Demon King’s expression turned extremely dark. In the end, he laughed loudly, saying that you couldn’t kill him yet. With those words, he unleashed his trump card.]
[His trump card was a powerful artifact from the Myriad Heavens Paradise, granting him the power of a four-digit existence for combat.]
[As you were weakened, the Pure Sky Demon King regained his confidence and fought against you. With a sigh, you felt that he was just walking towards his demise.]
[Your earth-shattering battle continued. Although you were weakened by the Pure Sky Demon King, your strength still surpassed him. However, killing him would take a considerable amount of time due to your weakened state.]
[As the battle dragged on, the Pure Sky Demon King’s expression grew uglier and uglier, realizing that your strength was just too great. If things continued like this, he would be killed by you, and the Pure Space Demon Clan would be annihilated.]
[In the end, the Pure Sky Demon King chose to compromise, hoping for a ceasefire. He claimed that as long as you agreed to cease hostilities and swore never to attack the Pure Space Demon Clan again, he would hand over the Origin Essence Blood of the Quasi-Demon Emperor.]
[Despite the fact that promises held no real power for people at their level of existence, powerful beings were proud and unlikely to easily renege on their word.]
[Hearing this, you showed a satisfied smile, stating that as long as the Pure Sky Demon King handed over the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s Origin Essence Blood, you wouldn’t take action against him or the Pure Space Demon Clan.]

﻿Chapter 1234: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_3 Chapter 1234: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_3 [After a moment of silence, the Pure Sky Demon King handed over a portion of his Origin Essence Blood that he had refined over the years, urging you to leave quickly.]
[Seeing this, your eyes shined with satisfaction, and you accepted the Essence Blood without hesitation. Then, you informed the Pure Sky Demon King that you still had to deal with the Primordial Time Demon King, so you wouldn’t release the forbidden seal for the next 50,000 years and hoped he would understand.]
[Upon hearing your words, the Pure Sky Demon King’s expression changed unpredictably, never expecting your ambition to be so great. However, having no other choice, he could only agree to your conditions.]
[With that, you left with great gains, and the Pure Space Demon Clan was sealed off. The abnormal situation of the Pure Space Demon Clan sent shockwaves through the other Demon Clans, causing them great unease. The Primordial Time Demon King frowned and personally went to the Pure Space Demon Clan, only to find it sealed by a powerful restriction that even he couldn’t break in a short period.]
[In an instant, a sense of foreboding appeared in the Primordial Time Demon King’s heart.]
[While you were causing unrest among the Demon Clans, you decided to enter closed-door cultivation once more, refining the Essence Blood of the Quasi-Demon emperor. Although the Primordial Time Demon King was not much of a threat to you now, you still worried that he might have some powerful trump cards up his sleeve.]
[For this reason, it was more prudent to continue raising your strength before making a move against the Primordial Time Demon King. Not to mention, it would take time to break through to the Immortal King Late Stage by refining the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s Essence Blood, so there wasn’t much significance in confronting the Primordial Time Demon King for the time being.]
[Eventually, you entered the state of closed-door cultivation and began to absorb and refine the Essence Blood of the Quasi-Demon Emperor with the help of the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead that you had cultivated into an Immortal King’s Artifact.]
[In the blink of an eye, 50,000 years had passed, and your cultivation had reached a critical point, about to break through to the Immortal King Late Stage.]
[At that moment, the Dark Disaster struck, and countless Immortal King-tier Dark Beings emerged, alarming the entire Demon Realm and causing it to teeter on the verge of destruction.]
[This made the faces of all the Demon Kings extremely grave, forcing them to put aside their differences and join forces against the Immortal King-tier Dark Beings.]
[However, with the increasing number of Immortal King-tier Dark Beings and the appearance of five Dark Immortal King Giants, the Demon Realm could not hold on much longer.]
[Some powerful Demon Kings even considered abandoning everything and fleeing to the Myriad Heavens Paradise. Although going there meant facing a life-or-death challenge, it was still much better than staying here, to certain death.]
[Just as some of the Demon Kings were making such considerations, a Terrifying Aura suddenly appeared, sweeping through the entire Demon Realm and even the nearby Sea of Darkness.]
……
“I never thought the Demon Realm still had the legacy of the Quasi-Demon Emperor. However, this legacy must have had some issues. Ever since coming to the Immortal Domain and the Demon Realm, all the secret realms above the Immortal King level are filled with pitfalls. Those old monsters have been living too long, and not many of them genuinely left behind a legacy.”
Wang Ping watched the text simulation and sighed in his heart.
However, the issues with the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s legacy were not Wang Ping’s concern for now; he was more focused on the Dark Disaster.
If everything went as expected, the simulated Wang Ping should have broken through to the Immortal King Late Stage.
The combat strength of the Immortal King Late Stage should far exceed that of an Immortal King Giant, and Wang Ping wouldn’t end up like in the previous simulation where he and the ten Dark Immortal King Giants perished together.
As Wang Ping pondered silently, the text simulation continued.
[The appearance of the Terrifying Aura attracted the attention of all the powerful beings, all of whom displayed astonishing expressions. This Aura was simply too powerful, and although it seemed to belong to the Immortal King Late Stage, its strength far surpassed that level.]
[Additionally, they were quite familiar with this aura—it turned out to be yours, the Immortal King from the Immortal Domain. The Pure Sky Demon King, who had already been freed from the restriction, had an even more solemn expression.]
[After all, you had utterly defeated him when you were at the Mid-Immortal King Stage, let alone now that you had reached the Immortal King Late Stage. Your current combat power was enough to sweep all opposition, leaving him with mixed emotions.]
[With an additional powerful force like you, perhaps they could withstand the terrifying Dark Disaster. However, your presence posed a threat to the Demon Realm that was no less than the Dark Disaster itself.]
[At this moment, the Dark Immortal King Giants also turned their attention towards your location, revealing fear for the first time. They then abandoned their opponents to strike at the place where you were in seclusion.]
[To the horror of the Demon Realm Demon Kings, not only did the Dark Immortal Kings attack your place of seclusion, but another five Dark Immortal King Giants appeared to seize you.]
[In other words, this Dark Disaster had a total of ten Dark Immortal King Giants, a number capable of annihilating their ranks several times over.]
[However, something even more shocking and terrifying happened: faced with the simultaneous assault of the ten Dark Immortal King Giants, you remained calm and with a single punch, you completely obliterated one of them.]
[Such terrifying power left all the Demon Kings in astonishment and disbelief. After all, these were Dark Immortal King Giants, not some insignificant trash. Defeating them with a single punch was simply unheard of.]
