﻿Chapter 1235: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_4 Chapter 1235: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_4 [Such terrifying battle power has probably far surpassed the Immortal King Giants and is perhaps not too far from the legendary tiers of Quasi-Immortal Emperor and Quasi-Demon Emperor.]
[Your explosive burst also frightens the remaining nine great Dark Immortal King Giants, stopping them in their tracks, not daring to act carelessly. To fight or not to fight, they are at a loss.]
[Seeing the nine Dark Immortal King Giants so fearful, you sneer, implying that they are nothing special. Since they don’t dare to fight, let them all die.]
[As you say this, you strike again, killing one Dark Immortal King Giant with each punch, as if slaughtering chickens or butchering dogs.]
[Your accomplishments chill the Demon Realm Demon Kings since, after all, you are an Immortal King, an enemy of the Demon Realm in a way.]
[After a moment of silence, the Primordial Time Demon King takes a step forward, expressing his gratitude for you settling the Dark Disaster and stating that the Demon Realm and Immortal Domain are not enemies. He says that the Flame Demon Clan’s actions were their own, and they will clean up their mess and apologize to the Immortal World Beings.]
[Upon hearing this, you are surprised and think of the Primordial Time Demon King as someone who can yield and stretch. As such, you calmly reply that this is not enough, and since they agreed that the Flame Demon Clan can do this, they share some of the blame. Therefore, the Demon Clan needs to compensate with a drop of Quasi-Demon Emperor’s Origin Essence Blood and numerous resources.]
[The Primordial Time Demon King’s face changes slightly, and finally sighs, knowing that this world is all about strength and power, and right or wrong is not the most important thing. As a result, he agrees to make satisfactory compensation.]
[Then, the Primordial Time Demon King takes out a drop of Quasi-Demon Emperor Blood Essence that has been refined by more than half, and hands it to you. You don’t mind the fact that the Blood Essence has been refined by half, and calmly accept it.]
[Next, you plan to leave the Demon Realm and head to other worlds.]
[Just as you have this idea, an anomaly occurs again. A blood-colored figure appears, walking from the distant Sea of Darkness. With each step, a Demon King’s body explodes.]
[Seeing this scene, the faces of the Primordial Time Demon King and other Demon Kings change, filled with fear. They know that a great terror is about to descend. The person who has arrived might be someone like the legendary Quasi-Immortal Emperor or Quasi-Demon Emperor.]
[Although Quasi-Immortal Emperors and Quasi-Demon Emperors are only ranked as four-digit limits in Myriad Heavens Paradise, it is only because their power doesn’t reach the three-digit level, and it doesn’t mean that they are at the normal four-digit limit.]
[In fact, the power of Quasi-Immortal Emperors and Quasi-Demon Emperors far surpasses the four-digit limit, transcending their rankings to a certain extent.]
[As such, Immortal Kings are nothing more than ants in front of such beings. Even Immortal King Giants and Demon King Giants are no different from ants in front of them; they can be swatted to death casually.]
[At this moment, all the Demon Kings have only one thought in their hearts: flee to Myriad Heavens Paradise. Faced with such terrifying beings, staying here would only mean death.]
[However, what about their families and the beings of the Demon Realm? They have all been left behind in their minds; only with their survival can the Demon Realm have a future.]
[But, facing such terrifying beings, it’s already too late for them to escape. As the terrifying existence takes another step, blood-colored ripples sweep across the Sea of Darkness towards here.]
[In an instant, the bodies of all Demon Kings stiffen, and then they explode one by one. As for those below the Demon Kings, they turn to ashes without needing to be mentioned.]
[Even you, facing these blood-colored ripples, find it extremely uncomfortable. Although your body doesn’t explode, it’s still extremely difficult to endure.]
[You stare at the blood-colored figure with a serious expression, knowing that your end is near. As powerful as you currently are, facing the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor, there is no hope. As for fighting him, it’s a dream for a fool.]
[However, even though you know there’s no chance of winning, you don’t wait for death. You burn your origin without hesitation, and rush towards the blood-colored figure.]
[Seeing you charge at him, the blood-colored figure doesn’t mock you, but instead praises your courage. If you weren’t a being that had to die, he would choose to recruit you.]
[As for the praise from the blood-colored figure, you don’t respond but just unleash your strongest attack. However, your powerful attack that burns your origin cannot even move him.]
[After easily annihilating your attack, the blood-colored figure praises you once again, saying that if you raise your cultivation to the Immortal King Great Perfection Tier while also elevating your Chaos Immortal Body to the Perfect Domain, you might have the qualifications to fight him. But now, even though you are powerful, you are still too weak compared to him.]
[The words fall, and the blood-colored figure casually slaps out a palm, killing you.]
[Due to your death, this simulation comes to an end….]
……..
With the end of the Text Simulation, various cultivation realizations and memory scenes appear in Wang Ping’s mind.
In the end, Wang Ping takes a deep breath and murmurs, “The simulated Wang Ping’s performance was already strong enough, but the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor was just too powerful. He is not an existence that the current simulated Wang Ping can challenge beyond his level.”』

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1236: Chapter 313: A soaring cultivation! A man slaughters the Demon Realm! (A 10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _5 Chapter 1236: Chapter 313: A soaring cultivation! A man slaughters the Demon Realm! (A 10,000-word chapter seeking monthly votes!) _5 “Great Perfection of Immortal King cultivation, achieved perfection in the Chaos Immortal Body?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered uncertainly.
The Great Perfection of Immortal King cultivation was not a problem.
However, wanting to bring the Chaos Immortal Body to perfection was not easy.
After all, he had absolutely no clue how to bring the Chaos Immortal Body to perfection.
Without any information, his desire to perfect his Chaos Immortal Body was undoubtedly a foolish dream.
“However, it doesn’t matter, I don’t necessarily need to perfect the Chaos Immortal Body. As long as I increase my cultivation and elevate it to the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor, I can face this bloody figure fearlessly. The bloody figure is a quasi-Fairy Emperor, but if I were to become a quasi-Fairy Emperor, I can also fight on par in the same realm, and I won’t fear anyone.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shone with confidence in his own Same Realm Battle Power.
Just as Wang Ping was filled with confidence, the system’s voice rang out just in time.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, you can choose two from the following rewards:
①. Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge.
②. Five-digit Talent: Energy Conversion.
③. Devouring Immortal Demon Bead (Immortal King Artifact).
④. Late-Stage Immortal King cultivation.”
……
“Eh….”
Wang Ping was surprised at the refreshed rewards.
After all, the previous reward did not include the four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge. It was indeed astonishing that it had refreshed this time.
“Seems like, after its evolution, the Life Simulator has hidden features, such as the probability of refreshing previously encountered talents.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he speculated.
“In this case, the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge is undoubtedly a must-choose. As for the second reward…what should I choose….”
Wang Ping glanced at the rewards, in a bit of a dilemma.
Normally, choosing the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead—the Immortal King Artifact—would undoubtedly be the best choice.
After all, if he chose cultivation, he would miss out on chances to refresh his talent.
However, if he chose cultivation, he would truly be invincible in both the Immortal and Demon Realms.
By then, he would certainly not lack Immortal King or Demon King tools and would not be stuck anymore.
In truth, with the current simulation progress, the simulation would be meaningless and continuously stuck unless a powerful four-digit talent appeared as a variable.”
“Forget it, let’s do the paid simulation on the remaining two Quasi Fairy King instruments. If a four-digit talent doesn’t refresh and I get stuck, I’ll have to choose cultivation to break out.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he pondered himself.
“System, I choose ①. Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge and ③. Devouring Immortal Demon Bead (Immortal King Artifact).”
Following that decision, Wang Ping immediately made his choice.
“Ding, Reward Selection Successful….”
The voice of the system rang out.
Then, a set of instructions on how to use the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge suddenly appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
Next, an Immortal King Artifact, the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead, appeared in his inner world.
However, what surprised Wang Ping was that with the appearance of the Immortal King level Devouring Immortal Demon Bead, the devouring bead that was merely a True Immortal Artifact had vanished.
“It seems that the Immortal King level Devouring Immortal Demon Bead has replaced the True Immortal Artifact level bead, and it’s not that a new bead has appeared.”
Wang Ping mused silently.
“Master, I’ve become stronger!”
At this point, the excited voice of the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead rang out, conveying joy to Wang Ping.
This made Wang Ping raise an eyebrow, realizing another fact.
That is, the instrument spirit of the True Immortal Artifact’s Devouring Immortal Demon Bead had replaced the spirit of the Immortal King Artifact level bead.
“This is actually quite human-like, knowing that the True Immortal Artifact level Devouring Immortal Demon Bead belongs to me, Wang Ping. The spirit of the Immortal King Artifact is actually that of the simulated Wang Ping.”
Wang Ping couldn’t help but chuckle.
“Mmm, very good, keep working hard.”
Subsequently, after briefly praising the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead’s instrument spirit, Wang Ping continued with the simulation.
However, the next two simulations went just as Wang Ping expected—they got stuck right away.
Firstly, no powerful talent was refreshed. Both simulations revealed useless six-digit talents and five-digit talents.
Afterwards, the simulated Wang Ping would always be slain by the bloody figure.
Apart from that, the rewards were also quite meager, allowing him to only choose one.
One could say, the gain from these two simulations was mostly the stacking of cultivation insights.
“However, one simulation of a Quasi Immortal Artifact yielded one Immortal King Artifact, so it wasn’t a loss. As for the second reward….”
Wang Ping pressed his brows, looking at the reward list.
Then, without hesitation, Wang Ping chose the cultivation reward.
Following Wang Ping’s choice of the cultivation reward, his cultivation began to skyrocket.
Early-Stage Immortal King!
Mid-Stage Immortal King!
Late-Stage Immortal King!
As Wang Ping’s cultivation reached the Late-Stage Immortal King, he felt he had become extremely powerful.
This was not an illusion. At present, Wang Ping was indeed nearly invincible, with the only threats being the lurking Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor and a few other Quasi-Immortal Emperors in the world.
At present, Wang Ping could definitely be considered among the top ten strongest in this Mysterious Fantasy World.
“However, I still must not become arrogant. Even if I truly become the top-notch powerhouse in this Mysterious Fantasy World, until I become the strongest, there is always a chance of my fall. Not to mention, the peculiar thing about that ‘Regression’ is still not resolved.”

﻿Chapter 1237: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_6 Chapter 1237: Chapter 313: Soaring Cultivation! Slaughtering the Demon Realm Alone! (A large chapter with 10,000 words asking for a monthly ticket!)_6 Wang Ping’s eyes shimmered as he secretly thought.
As long as that mysterious person existed, Wang Ping had to continue striving to become stronger. Only by becoming a three-digit talent or even a top three-digit talent in this Profound World, could he be considered safe.
Thinking of this, Wang Ping’s excited mood gradually calmed down.
“System, how many resources do I need to start a paid simulation?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked in his heart.
“Ding, detecting that the host’s cultivation has reached the late stage of Immortal King. The required resources for a paid simulation are two Immortal King Artifacts.”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Two Immortal King Artifacts? That means I can only simulate once more.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shimmered as he secretly thought.
He had a total of five Immortal King Artifacts on him.
He could not bear to use his life-bound Immortal King’s Artifact: Chaos Immortal Clothes and the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead for paid simulations.
Moreover, the Tower of Celestial Spirit had also helped him, so he couldn’t use it for payment.
As a result, he could only use the Immortal King Artifact of the Primordial Immortal King and an Immortal King Artifact he had obtained as a refresh reward for paid simulations.
“System, I want to start a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping didn’t mind the consumption of two Immortal King Artifacts and directly spoke in his heart.
“Ding, consuming two Immortal King Artifacts. Life Simulator is launching, Talent Refresh in progress….”
The voice of the system resounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful. Congratulations, host, for successfully refreshing the four-digit talent – Innate Dao Seeds and six-digit talent – Ghostly Steps.”
Four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds – With this talent, the enlightenment of the host will be greatly enhanced. It’ll be easier to enter the state of Enlightenment and may be called Dao Seeds.
Six-digit Talent: Ghostly Steps – With this talent, the host’s speed will be slightly increased, and the increase is even greater in the dark.
“Huh, another four-digit talent! And this one is also the type that I need!”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talent, revealing a surprised expression.
Now, Wang Ping had already reached the late stage of the Immortal King realm. If he steadily and persistently kept on simulating, his cultivation would eventually reach the Great Perfection of the Immortal King realm.
Then, he would need to try to comprehend the Dao Law of the quasi-Fairy Emperor and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra to the quasi-Fairy Emperor level.
However, unless he experienced an extreme epiphany in a deadly battle, slow cultivation would surely be time-consuming.
It was undoubtedly difficult to experience an extreme epiphany in a deadly battle, and it was something that could only happen by chance.
Therefore, Wang Ping preferred to slowly comprehend the Dao Law.
Now, with this four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds, combined with the Chaos Immortal Body,
Wang Ping felt that he was not far from comprehending the quasi-Fairy Emperor level Immortal Tao and the Chaotic Immortal King Sutra.
Perhaps, as long as he deeply triggered the effect once and entered a deep Enlightenment state, the simulated Wang Ping could reach that realm.
By then, his combat power would skyrocket again, reaching an incredible level.
“Maybe this simulation will give me a chance to fight that bloody figure.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were full of expectation.
Although he didn’t possess a perfect Chaotic Immortal Body, comprehending the Dao Law of the quasi-Fairy Emperor level and sutra would still greatly enhance his combat power.
“System, I choose the four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds.”
Immediately, Wang Ping made up his mind and made a no-brainer choice; he didn’t even have an interest in giving the other six-digit talent a second glance.
“Ding, Talent selection successful, Life Simulation begins….”
The voice of the system sounded.
Next, the luminescent screen appeared, and familiar text emerged.
[Day One, you chose to go to the Small Immortal Territories. After arriving at the Small Immortal Territories, you still did not seek Chu Lingyin and the others, but simply killed your way to the Demon Realm.]
[In your first battle, you fought the Flame Demon Clan. After effortlessly slaying the Flame Demon King, you took all the good things in the Flame Demon Clan’s treasury.]
[The demise of the Flame Demon King shocked the entire Demon Clan, and they began to investigate the reason. To this end, you did not hide or cover up your intentions, directly declaring that you would stand against the entire Demon Clan on your own. If they were willing to submit to you and hand over all the treasures beneficial to Immortal King-tier beings, you would spare their lives.]
[Your outrageous statement infuriated the entire Demon Clan, and those Demon Kings could no longer stand it. They all took action and marched to kill you, including the Primordial Time Demon King and the Pure Sky Demon King.]
[In response, you looked at these Demon Kings with an emotionless face, thinking that they were too weak.]
[Subsequently, you showed no mercy and killed all those Demon Kings who chose to be your enemies, easily achieving the feat of slaying an entire territory by yourself, just like the predecessor ransmigrator in the first generation chat group.]
….
“Goodness, it’s great to have such a cheat….”
As Wang Ping read the contents of the text simulation, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Initially, he was deeply shocked by the achievements of the ransmigrator predecessor in the first generation chat group.
With his own strength, he had killed all the Immortal Kings in the Immortal World, frightening all the beings of the Immortal World to the point where no one dared to call themselves immortal.
Now, he had effortlessly achieved the same feat….
Moreover, he was only in his thirties….
All that could be said was that a life with a cheat didn’t need explanation.
“Next, with the resources from the Demon Realm at my disposal, breaking through to the Great Perfection of Immortal King realm should be a piece of cake.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered and he secretly thought, continuing to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you used the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead to devour the corpses of all these Demon Kings, simultaneously obtaining all the resources on their persons.]
[Then, you began to cultivate in seclusion, hoping to break through to the Great Perfection Tier of the Immortal King realm as quickly as possible. The complete fall of the Demon Kings shocked the entire Demon Realm, causing all strong Demon clan members to tremble in fear, reaching the brink of terror.]
[At this moment, they experienced the feeling that the Immortal World Beings had over one billion, two thousand years ago. The Immortal World was killed by one person, and no one dared to become immortal; they still lived in the shadow of that person until now. Now, they also experienced this feeling. Although you didn’t make the Demon Clan unable to call themselves demons, your feat of slaughtering the Demon Kings was not inferior to that person’s.]

﻿Chapter 1238: Chapter 314: The Great Battle with the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! Chapter 1238: Chapter 314: The Great Battle with the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! [While you were in closed-door training, your achievements gradually spread to the ears of powerful beings in the Immortal Domain, such as Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian. They were extremely shocked and felt that fortune was finally turning in the favor of the Immortal Domain. They didn’t expect to see the birth of an invincible Immortal King like you, comparable to that monster from back then.]
[The beings of the Immortal World were overjoyed, feeling that with a strong person like you as their backbone, they could finally breathe a sigh of relief and live a proper life in the Small Immortal Territories.]
[In the blink of an eye, 100,000 years passed. With the help of numerous resources and the corpses of Demon Kings from the Demon Realm, you successfully made a breakthrough to the Great Perfection Tier of the Immortal King. After your breakthrough to the Great Perfection Tier, you still had plenty of resources left.]
[However, you were well aware that these resources were not enough for you to make a breakthrough to the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level. The gap between the Immortal King and the quasi-Fairy Emperor was simply too vast. Moreover, you had not yet comprehended the Dao techniques and scriptures of the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level.]
[As a result, you had no intention of leaving seclusion and continued your closed-door training. This time, you began your Enlightenment. Thanks to your four-digit talent: Innate Dao Seeds, your Enlightenment process went smoothly, and you were once again fortunate enough to enter a state of Deep Comprehension of Dao.]
[In the blink of an eye, another 150,000 years passed. These 150,000 years of Enlightenment brought you great benefits, putting you just half a step away from comprehending the Dao techniques and scriptures of the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level.]
[However, instead of continuing your training in seclusion, you chose to leave it. The reason you chose to leave was that the forbidden area of the Quasi-Demon emperor was about to open.]
[Although with your previous combat capabilities, you were strong enough to forcefully break it open, you chose not to do so in order to prevent any accidents from happening.]
[After entering the forbidden area, you didn’t care about the heavenly materials and earthly treasures that could be found there. After all, for you now, unless it was material capable of creating a quasi-Fairy Emperor artifact or a supreme treasure that could help you break through to the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level, everything else was practically useless, only adding a little bit of wealth.]
[However, materials capable of forging quasi-Fairy Emperor artifacts and supreme treasures that could help you break through to the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level were obviously not present in this forbidden area. It could be said that whether such naturally formed treasures still exist in the entire Profound World is an unknown.]
[Therefore, you naturally didn’t have any intention to waste time looking for them. Instead, you went directly to the stone statue transformed by the Quasi-Demon emperor.]
[Upon reaching the stone statue, you didn’t have any intention of feigning an attack. Instead, you unleashed an extremely powerful force and ferociously bombarded the stone statue itself.]
[However, your attack didn’t break the stone statue; instead, its energy was absorbed by the statue.]
[Regarding this, you narrowed your eyes, feeling that the stone statue of this Quasi-Demon emperor was indeed strange. However, it should hide a chance to help you break through to the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level, which you didn’t want to miss.]
[Although you are now extremely powerful, you still don’t have any guarantees to face the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor in a battle fifty thousand years later. Therefore, you will do everything you can to break through to the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor within fifty thousand years to deal with the crisis that will arise in the future.]
[Next, you continued to attack the stone statue, and the energy was absorbed by it. Following that, you clearly sensed that the life force within the stone statue was becoming more and more vigorous. As time passed, the cracks on the statue grew larger.]
[In addition, you sensed a terrifying Demon spirit gradually awakening. You knew that this Quasi-Demon Emperor was about to revive.]
[However, you were not afraid and had already prepared for a fierce battle with him. As a result, you did not stop your attacks on the stone statue.]
[A quarter of an hour later, the stone statue exploded, and the ultimate Demon spirit spread out, causing the entire forbidden area to tremble.]
[Inside the stone statue, a figure with demonic horns and blood-black wings on its back slowly opened its eyes and looked at you. His aura became more terrifying, enough to crush an Immortal King.]
[However, you were still fearless in the face of such a character, remaining expressionless and even having the leisure to make comparisons in your mind. The Quasi-Demon emperor before you was obviously sealed here for some reason. The years of being sealed were extremely long, and even though he had created this forbidden area through certain means to attract strong beings to come and fight, absorbing external energy to break the seal, it still consumed a lot of energy.]
[In other words, although the Quasi-Demon Emperor in front of you was a powerful being at the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s level, he was not at his peak state but was in a very weak state. As a result, the pressure you felt from this Quasi-Demon Emperor was far inferior to that of the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor who had come across the sea.]
[At this moment, seeing that you faced him without any fear and with an indifferent expression, the Quasi-Demon Emperor snorted coldly and arrogantly uttered a sentence, “Not paying respects to the Emperor warrants death.”]
[Upon hearing this, you revealed a mocking expression, stating that a Quasi-Demon Emperor dared to call himself a Demon Emperor, which was utterly nonsensical. In addition, as a Quasi-Demon Emperor, treating his savior in such a manner was truly shameless.]
[Your words made the Quasi-Demon Emperor snort coldly. He had no interest in arguing with you and arrogantly reached out to grab you, intending to devour you as a snack after his revival to replenish his power.]

﻿Chapter 1239: Chapter 314: Battling the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! _2 Chapter 1239: Chapter 314: Battling the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! _2 [Upon this, you sneer coldly and no longer conceal your true combat strength, fully erupting it and fiercely bombarding the quasi-Demon emperor before you.]
[As you burst forth, the quasi-Demon emperor is taken aback, not expecting that you, a cultivator at the Great Perfection of the Immortal King realm, would be able to unleash such terrifying power. Caught off guard, the quasi-Demon emperor is directly knocked far away, his body showing cracks.]
[Granted, this level of injury is nothing to him, but as a rarely-matched quasi-Demon emperor, it’s truly humiliating to suffer defeat at the hands of someone at your Immortal King stage. Because of this, the quasi-Demon emperor becomes enraged, his terrifying power exploding, wanting to instantly suppress and kill you, and eat you as Blood Food.]
[At this point, your expression turns serious, without any hint of negligence, as you clash with the quasi-Demon emperor.]
[However, the quasi-Demon emperor is ultimately the quasi-Demon emperor, and even though he’s extremely weak, he’s not someone you can confront at your current level. After a short time of clashing, you suffer injuries and are on the verge of being killed.]
[Because of this, you don’t hesitate to directly activate your Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, allowing you to enter a state where you are immune to damage and control.]
[Then, you begin to fight completely recklessly, abandoning defense altogether. You even start to burn your own essence, madly elevating your combat power. You find that the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge is a real bug, as you can burn your essence without receiving any damage while the talent is active.]
[Your method of fighting makes the quasi-Demon emperor’s face change, feeling pressured. After all, facing an opponent who doesn’t bother with defense and crazily burns their essence is truly difficult.]
[If he were still at his peak, then he wouldn’t have anything to worry about. Once the effect of your talent ends, he could easily crush you.]
[However, he cannot do so now, as he is far too weak at the moment. Faced with your crazed assault, he is getting injured. If he’s not careful, even his essence might be damaged again.]
[Momentarily, the quasi-Demon emperor grits his teeth in anger, thinking that your talent is too detestable.]
[You pay no heed to the quasi-Demon emperor’s thoughts, continuing your frenzied attacks. During the offensive, you also gain insight into the quasi-Demon emperor’s techniques and his Quasi-Demon Emperor Scripture, absorbing them like a sponge and turning them into your own comprehension, wanting to reach new heights in this battle.]
……..
“Tsk, tsk, this Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge is really overpowered, even the quasi-Demon emperor is annoyed about how despicable it is.” Wang Ping watches the text simulation content and smacks his lips.
“But that’s precisely the effect I was going for. If I had more than this one auxiliary combat-related Four-digit Talent, I’d want to disgust my enemies even more intensely.”
As Wang Ping sighs, the text simulation continues.
[In the blink of an eye, your battle with the quasi-Demon emperor lasts nearly half an hour. The injuries on his body become more severe due to your relentless assault. He feels like vomiting blood and grows the impulse to retreat.]
[He truly never expected that your talent would be this detestable and able to endure for such a long time. It’s like you’re trying to wear him down with attrition.]
[Although he has the urge to retreat, he’s not willing to give up his pride or lose you as a source of sustaining blood. After all, a quasi-Demon emperor facing off with an Immortal King and being defeated across realms would be utterly humiliating. If he flees, he would never be able to show his face in the Mysterious Fantasy World again, and the strong would laugh their heads off.]
[Even if he were to go to Myriad Heavens Paradise, his reputation would suffer greatly, and he would be nailed to the Pillar of Shame. This is something he absolutely cannot tolerate.]
[Therefore, the quasi-Demon emperor prepares to fight you to the end. He doesn’t believe that your perverted talent can continue indefinitely.]
[While he’s thinking this, you enter a marvelous state, and with your understanding of the realm of a quasi-Fairy Emperor just one step away, you successfully use this earth-shattering battle to break through your limitations and comprehend the quasi-Fairy Emperor realm techniques and Immortal Sutras.]
[As you take this step, your combat power surges to a terrifying level. In addition, your Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge still has one minute of effects left. Therefore, you unscrupulously unleash your most terrifying attacks.]
[This sudden change greatly alters the quasi-Demon emperor’s expression, for he never expected you to break through your limitations during your battle with him and gain comprehension of quasi-Fairy Emperor realm techniques and Immortal Sutras.]
[By now, your combat power has far surpassed his current level and is nearly on par with his peak state. Faced with someone like you, the quasi-Demon emperor feels a deadly threat.]
[Due to this, he no longer cares about his pride and instantly decides to flee.]
[Regarding this, you naturally don’t let him have his way. You snort coldly, giving chase without hesitation, not wanting to let the quasi-Demon emperor escape.]
[Seeing your unrelenting pursuit, the quasi-Demon emperor roars angrily, warning you not to push him, for he would rather die and take you with him.]
[Unmoved, you continue your terrifying attacks, wanting to completely suppress and kill the quasi-Demon emperor.]
[Witnessing this, the quasi-Demon emperor becomes completely enraged. Although he could try to escape to Myriad Heavens Paradise, you clearly won’t give him that chance. Furthermore, he has offended terrifying entities in Myriad Heavens Paradise and is fearful of the trials of the Heaven Tower. Therefore, he has no choice but to try and escape from Myriad Heavens Paradise.]

﻿Chapter 1240: Chapter 314: Battling the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! _3 Chapter 1240: Chapter 314: Battling the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent! _3 [In other words, since you want to force him to die, his only option is to take you down with him. As a quasi-Demon emperor, he has experienced all kinds of situations, so he chooses to give up on escaping and directly burns all his origin, desiring to drag you down with him.]
[Faced with this, you become serious and engage in a fierce battle with him. In the end, the quasi-Demon emperor is dragged until the effect of your Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge ends.]
[After the effect of the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge ends, it’s natural that you can’t continue burning your source. As a result, your combat strength drops significantly.]
[Seeing that you no longer burn your source and your combat strength decreased, the quasi-Demon emperor laughs heartily, guessing that the effect of your talent has finally passed. As a result, he laughs loudly, declaring that he will ultimately be the final victor.]
[As the quasi-Demon emperor laughed, he directly brought out an item. This item, a tool from Myriad Heavens Paradise, enveloped the quasi-Demon emperor’s Divine Soul and slipped into your body, attempting to seize your body.]
[At this, your expression changes. Although your combat strength has reached a level where you can fight at the same level as a quasi-Fairy emperor, your cultivation is ultimately weaker than this realm, and your Divine Soul’s strength is no match for the quasi-Demon emperor.]
[Even though the quasi-Demon emperor has been repeatedly weakened, he is still a quasi-Demon emperor, and he also has special items to help him. In other words, you might genuinely be possessed by the quasi-Demon emperor.]
[Seeing this, you sit down cross-legged without hesitation, guarding your mind and desiring to confront the soul of the quasi-Demon emperor. At the same time, the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead is furiously devouring the Demon King’s corpse within your inner world, providing soul power and assisting you in the battle.]
[Your Chaotic fairy clothes also protect your mind and confront the quasi-Demon emperor.]
[However, the quasi-Demon emperor still sneers in the face of this situation, telling you to stop the pointless resistance, that all your methods are useless in front of him.]
[In response, you choose to ignore it, continuing to defend your mind and confront him. During this process, the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead goes insane, not wanting your soul to be devoured and possessed by the quasi-Demon emperor. To this end, it uses swallowing power beyond its limits to crazily devour the body of the Demon King, providing you with power to fight the quasi-Demon emperor’s soul.]
[The result is that the surface of the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead develops dense cracks. Despite this, it still takes no notice and continues to increase its power recklessly.]
[Seeing this, you feel pained and tell the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead to stop. After all, for you, the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead is no different from a descendant, and even closer than a descendant to a host.]
[At this moment, the Chaotic fairy clothes also begin to burn themselves, blocking the invasion of the quasi-Demon emperor’s soul, expressing their determination to share life and death and advance or retreat together with you and the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead.]
[Seeing this, you feel heartbroken, but you’re no longer sad, and you fight against the quasi-Demon emperor’s soul with all your might.]
[Soon after, the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead explodes. Immediately afterward, the Chaotic fairy clothes also burst apart. In the process of confronting souls, you undoubtedly suffer a crushing defeat.]
[In the end, you sigh and choose to self-destruct your soul, desiring to perish together with the quasi-Demon emperor. However, because the quasi-Demon emperor has a protective tool, you ultimately fail to harm him.]
[Due to your death, this simulation ends….]
…….
With the end of the Text Simulation, countless Cultivation Realizations appeared in Wang Ping’s mind, allowing him to comprehend the Dao and Immortal Sutra at the quasi-Fairy Emperor level.
Immediately after, numerous memories and scenes appeared, leaving Wang Ping feeling somewhat at a loss.
After a while, Wang Ping came to his senses and sighed, “These old monsters are truly hard to kill. However, even though we shouldn’t chase down impoverished enemies, if the simulation of Wang Ping didn’t choose to kill the quasi-Demon emperor, once he recovered from his injuries, the simulation of Wang Ping would have been in trouble. Therefore, taking a gamble on killing the quasi-Demon emperor and using his corpse to break through to the level of the quasi-Fairy Emperor is the best choice.”
“It’s just a pity that all of these old monsters have their trump cards. Although the quasi-Demon emperor’s trump card was obviously exhausted, leaving only one item to assist him in body possession, this item combined with his quasi-Demon emperor-level soul power is enough to be deadly.”
After a pause, Wang Ping muttered to himself, “However, now that I have obtained the quasi-Fairy Emperor-level Dao and Immortal Sutra through the Paid Simulation, my strength surpasses his, and I can use the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge to counter-kill the quasi-Demon emperor in the next simulation. If I can refresh another four-digit talent, it will be even more secure.”
Just as Wang Ping was thinking this, the system’s voice timely sounded.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host can choose two of the following rewards:
①. Immortal King Great Perfection Cultivation.
②. Four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds.
③. A random Quasi-Immortal King artifact.
④. A random Immortal King Scripture.”
…..
“System, I choose ①. Immortal King Great Perfection Cultivation and ②. Four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds.”
Wang Ping looked at the list of rewards and made his choice.
Since he couldn’t participate in the Paid Simulation anyway, he might as well continue to choose cultivation improvement to boost his own combat power.
As for the Four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds, it’s not to be missed either, much stronger than the other two rewards.
As Wang Ping collected the Cultivation Reward, his cultivation began to rapidly soar, reaching the level of Immortal King Great Perfection.

chapters.title: Chapter 1241 - 1241 314 Epic Battle with the Semi-Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1241: Chapter 314: Epic Battle with the Semi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent!_4 Chapter 1241: Chapter 314: Epic Battle with the Semi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent!_4 Meanwhile, information about the Four-digit Talent: Innate Dao Seeds also appeared in his mind.
“System, can I use a Demon King Tool for Paid Simulation?”
Immediately, Wang Ping asked this question in his heart.
“Yes. The value of Immortal King’s Artifact and Demon King Tool are equivalent.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Hehe, that’s good. Next, I should head to the Demon Realm.”
After Wang Ping came to his senses, his eyes sparkled, and with one step, he disappeared on the spot.
This time, he had no intention of using the Immortal Domain Channel to enter, he directly forcefully shattered the barrier and entered the Small Immortal Territories.
As Wang Ping arrived in the Small Immortal Territories, a terrifying phenomenon took place. Dragons and phoenixes took flight, and the rich Immortal Rhyme filled the air.
This shocked every Living Being in the Small Immortal Territories.
The common Demon Clan members were amazed, not knowing what was happening.
The powerful Demon Clan members, especially the Quasi-Demon Kings, had their pupils contract and their faces pale in shock.
Because this terrifying phenomenon was a sign of the emergence of an Immortal King.
This means that someone in the Small Immortal Territories had become an Immortal King.
The appearance of an Immortal King was not a good thing for the Flame Demon Clan.
Not to mention, the phenomenon caused by this Immortal King far exceeded a common Immortal King by a lot, the implications of which were even more terrifying on closer thought.
As for the Living Beings in the Small Immortal Territories, Chu Lingyin and Lu Daoxian amongst others had also noticed this terrifying phenomenon, being completely astonished.
Then, they all showed expressions of joy.
After all, the fact that an Immortal King still existed in the Immortal Domain was great news.
Especially Lu Daoxian, the first to suspect Wang Ping, thinking that he had discreetly arrived in the Immortal Domain and broken through to the Immortal King-tier.
Being capable of breaking through to the Immortal King-tier in such a short time was truly amazing.
However, upon further thought, Lu Daoxian felt that this was impossible. Who didn’t spend a long time secluding oneself when breaking through to become an Immortal King?
Therefore, Lu Daoxian thought Wang Ping, this mysterious senior, was originally an Immortal King, but due to some reason, he sealed his cultivation at the Quasi Fairy King Tier and stayed in the lower world.
Now, he has emphatically returned to the Small Immortal Territories.
This obviously indicates something major is underway.
For a time, Lu Daoxian eagerly looked forward to what kind of vitality this mysterious senior, Wang Ping, could bring to the Immortal World Beings.
…
Just as various parties were reacting, Wang Ping’s expression didn’t change. With a flick of his sleeve, the Domain Barrier was directly torn apart.
Then, Wang Ping took a step and went to the Demon Realm.
When Wang Ping arrived in the Demon Realm, due to his powerful strength, the whole Demon Realm seemed to sense it and terrifying changes occurred in the sky and earth.
However, unlike the phenomenon in the Small Immortal Territories, the phenomenon in the Demon Realm tended towards a bloody black colour. There were even scenes of seas of blood and dry bones, filled with oppression, as if signaling the coming of the end days.
This alarmed all the Demon Kings in the Demon Realm. They all emerged from their seclusion, looking in Wang Ping’s direction with grave expressions.
“Immortal King Giant? It’s surprising that the Immortal Domain still has such a strong practitioner.”
The Primordial Time Demon King and the Pure Sky Demon King thought to themselves gravely.
However, despite determining Wang Ping’s cultivation and suspecting he is an Immortal King Giant, an Immortal King Giant could not possibly cause such a huge phenomenon in the Demon Realm, nor could they make them feel such an extreme sense of danger.
Because of this, after their silence, they chose to emerge together, appearing not far from Wang Ping.
With the appearance of the Primordial Time Demon King and the Pure Sky Demon King, the other Demon Kings also emerged one after another, surrounding Wang Ping.
“Powerful practitioner of the Immortal Domain, what’s your purpose in coming to our Demon Realm?”
The Primordial Time Demon King spoke gravely.
“To settle a debt.”
Wang Ping calmly uttered these two words.
“Settle a debt?” The Primordial Time Demon King and the other Demon Kings instantly understood Wang Ping’s intention.
This was clearly an accusation that the Demon Realm had taken advantage of the Immortal Domain’s decline to invade it, killing a large number of Immortal World Beings.
At that moment, the Primordial Time Demon King and the other Demon Kings all looked at the Flame Demon King.
At this, the Flame Demon King’s expression changed.
Facing such a terrifying foe, nobody would want to fight a life and death battle for others.
That’s to say, he was likely to be used as a scapegoat.
“Do you really want to betray our own kind for the sake of an Immortal Domain practitioner? Are you sure that after he kills me, he will let the Demon Clan go?” Immediately, the Flame Demon King shouted, “Non-clan, their hearts will be different. Today, shouldn’t we join hands to kill him, to put an end to future trouble?”
The voice of the Flame Demon King reverberated throughout the entire Demon Realm, causing astonishment among the Demon World Beings.
This also made the expressions of the other Demon Kings somewhat unpleasant.
To throw out the Flame Demon King would be seen as a sign of submission, something quite humiliating.
If this matter spreads, it will damage their prestige.
“Flame Demon King, you brought this upon yourself. You single-mindedly attacked the Small Immortal Territories. It’s only natural that you should bear the responsibility.”
The Primordial Time Demon King’s expression did not change as he calmly spoke.
The resources of the Small Immortal Territories were nothing to them, so they ignored the Flame Demon King’s actions.
For this reason, if the Flame Demon King thought these Demon Kings would bear the consequences and fight a horrific entity for the mistake he made, well, that was impossible.
Even if they could win in a joint attack, it would be at a heavy cost.
Not to mention, winning the fight and being able to kill the foe were two different things.
If they couldn’t kill Wang Ping, then their Ethnic Groups would suffer calamity.
If they couldn’t win, then there’s no need to say more, the entire Demon Clan would face an earthshaking disaster.
The words of the Primordial Time Demon King had all the other Demon Kings nodding in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1242 - 1242 314 Epic Battle with the Quasi-Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1242: Chapter 314: Epic Battle with the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent!_5 Chapter 1242: Chapter 314: Epic Battle with the Quasi-Demon Emperor! The Third Four-Digit Talent!_5 They naturally thought of this as well.
However, this made the expression on Flame Demon King’s face look very ugly.
“One Flame Demon King is not enough to bear this responsibility, nor can it withstand my anger.”
At last, Wang Ping decided to speak again after watching the drama for enough time.
With a step from Wang Ping, the terrifying aura was unleashed without any reservation.
Meanwhile, the chaotic Immortal Domain of the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s level was exposed without any disguise, causing the entire Demon Realm to tremble.
As Wang Ping erupted, all the Demon Kings’ faces underwent a tremendous change.
They looked pale, their faces filled with horror as the shadow of death loomed in their hearts.
As for the Flame Demon King, under Wang Ping’s targeting, he was directly crushed and shattered by the Chaos Immortal Tao of the quasi-Fairy Emperor, dying on the spot.
“Quasi-Fairy Emperor level of Chaos Immortal Tao…”
Primordial Time Demon King’s voice was a bit hoarse, his face full of disbelief, and he was quite frightened.
After all, both quasi-Fairy Emperor and Quasi-Demon emperor were legendary existences, and although there was a Quasi-Demon Emperor statue in the Demon Realm, it didn’t count as alive.
Now, another such person has appeared.
Although it’s clear that the current Mysterious Powerhouse has not truly reached the level of the quasi-Fairy Emperor, they have comprehended the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s Dao, which is equivalent to stepping halfway into that level.
What follows is merely a matter of spending time breaking through their final bottleneck.
To put it bluntly, for the current Mysterious Powerhouse to kill them, it would be as simple as crushing ants.
“Senior, it’s our fault regarding the Immortal Domain’s matter. We should not have ignored the invasion of the Flame Demon Clan. Therefore, as long as you speak, we are willing to pay any price to quell your anger.”
Primordial Time Demon King took a deep breath, bowed to Wang Ping, and spoke with great humility.
“I, for one, do not like to kill, nor do I wish to destroy the Demon Realm. Therefore, you only need to hand over your life-bound Demon weapons and resources beneficial to cultivating at the Immortal Realm and above, and I will spare your lives.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
Upon hearing his words, all the Demon Kings were taken aback, then immediately showed joy and handed over their life-bound Demon King Tools and various resources without hesitation.
Although losing their life-bound Demon King Tools made them very distressed and unwilling, compared to their lives, these Demon King Tools were nothing to them.
As for the resources, though painful to part with, they were even more willing to give them up since they were ready to hand over their life-bound Demon King Tools.
Wang Ping was quite satisfied with the tactfulness of these Demon Kings.
After all, he truly didn’t like to kill, as long as they were tactful, he could spare these guys who posed no threat or major enmity to him.
In the end, Wang Ping’s sole purpose was to reap the benefits suitable for life simulation, not to genuinely kill people or destroy the Demon Realm.
Wang Ping couldn’t do the things the senior in the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group did.
Back then, when the universe was destroyed, it was a desperate move as there was no hope left.
If possible, Wang Ping wouldn’t do such an extreme thing, as there were countless times more living beings in the Demon Realm compared to that universe, so he was even less likely to kill indiscriminately.
Next, without saying much to this group of Demon Kings, Wang Ping’s figure moved, disappearing without a trace.
The group of Demon Kings didn’t notice when Wang Ping disappeared, and when they returned to their senses, they all breathed a sigh of relief, their faces full of gratitude.
Their Demon Realm had almost followed in the footsteps of the Immortal Domain.
“We must warn future generations. Even if a realm has already suffered a catastrophic disaster, one must not invade it lightly. No one knows if a monstrous existence will appear in the realm in the future. If it does, it will be a nightmare for our Demon Realm.”
“After all, not every senior will be as easy to talk to as this mysterious senior.”
Primordial Time Demon King sighed and disappeared as well.
“Next, let’s immediately return the land of the Immortal Domain and find a way to expand its area.”
Pure Sky Demon King also left a sentence and disappeared.
Upon hearing this, the other Demon Kings remained silent, sighed, and left one by one.
…
Meanwhile, Wang Ping found a random place and started the Paid Simulation.
“System, consume two Demon King Tool pieces, I want to use them for a Paid Simulation.”
Wang Ping said in his mind.
“Ding, consuming two Demon King Tool pieces, the Life Simulator is starting, Talent Refreshing in progress…”
The system’s voice sounded.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful; congratulations to the host for successfully refreshing four-digit talent – True Damage; 5-digit Talent – Resurrection of the Dead.”
Four-digit talent – True Damage: The host’s attack will become real damage, ignoring defense and causing maximum harm.
5-digit Talent – Resurrection of the Dead: An advanced version of the Six-digit Talent- Resurrection of the Dead, which can revive oneself and others with five-digit talents.
“Eh, there’s actually another four-digit talent! And this four-digit talent is so powerful!”
Wang Ping looked at the refreshed talent with a face full of joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1243 - 1243 315 Breaking through to Quasi-Fairy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1243: Chapter 315: Breaking through to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The truth about the Life and Death Realm! Chapter 1243: Chapter 315: Breaking through to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The truth about the Life and Death Realm! Four-digit talent – True Damage, the effect of this talent is to completely ignore the physical defense, allowing his attack to cause maximum damage.
This thing is like a direct hit to the source.
I just don’t know if it can be blocked by the shield.
“According to game experience, it should be blocked by energy shields like a shield.”
Wang Ping analyzed silently.
Even if it will be blocked, it’s still outrageous.
After all, this talent, whether in the outer world or the Sky Tower Game, can have a huge effect and bring miracles.
“But this 5-digit Talent: Resurrection of the Dead is a little strange, there’s no label saying it’s a one-time talent, can it be used repeatedly?”
Wang Ping looked at the 5-digit talent: Resurrection of the Dead again, and was greatly surprised by its talent effects description.
“It can’t be used repeatedly. Like the Six-digit Talent: Resurrection of the Dead, it is a one-time talent.”
The system’s voice rang out.
“Tsk, that’s really a shame.”
Wang Ping, hearing the system’s words, smacked his lips regretfully.
If it could be used repeatedly, the 5-digit Talent: Resurrection of the Dead would be no inferior to the four-digit talent and even surpass it in some ways.
“System, I choose the Four-digit talent – True Damage.”
Soon afterward, Wang Ping made his choice in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins… ”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the luminescent screen appeared, and the familiar text emerged.
[On the first day, you choose to forcibly break into the forbidden land where the Quasi-Demon Emperor is located and unseal the Quasi-Demon Emperor. You have another earth-shattering battle with the Quasi-Demon Emperor.]
[This battle is completely different from the last time. Although you didn’t use the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, you can still fight a weakened Quasi-Demon Emperor.]
[In this battle, you successfully tested the effect of the Four-digit talent – True Damage. The effect of this talent is more powerful than you imagined, it can even ignore energy shields, and just like the talent name, as long as you hit the enemy, you can deal the truest damage.]
[Because this talent is too buggy, the Quasi-Demon Emperor ate a big move, he was filled with damage, and his already weakened source suffered a huge injury, his fighting power dropped to below yours.]
[You completely bewildered the weakened Quasi-Demon Emperor, he didn’t expect your talent abilities to be so buggy. However, you didn’t give him any time to breathe, and began to attack him furiously.]
[In the face of this situation, the weakened Quasi-Demon Emperor was completely intimidated, not daring to take your attack head-on, and chose to dodge to avoid further injuries.]
[But this kind of fighting is obviously not good. If it continues, the weakened Quasi-Demon Emperor knows very well that he will be consumed to death by you.]
…
“Good fellow, this talent effect is really powerful.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation and couldn’t help but marvel.
The weakened Quasi-Demon emperor was beaten up by the simulated Wang Ping, it’s really incredible.
It can only be said that if the enemy doesn’t know that he has such a talent, they will definitely suffer a big loss.
After all, normal battles are all about offense and defense, who would know that you have such a metamorphic talent that can completely ignore defense, directly hit the source.
As soon as it comes down, it directly damages the enemy and weakens them a lot. It’s just too ruthless.
“Perhaps this simulation will break through to the quasi-Fairy Emperor level.”
Wang Ping’s eyes twinkled, and he looked forward to the following developments.
As Wang Ping looked forward to it, the text simulation continued.
[Following that, the Quasi-Demon Emperor feels that he can’t hold on anymore, he roars at you not to push too far, otherwise, you’ll both die together. Upon hearing this, you sneer and tell him to give it a try.]
[Your words completely enraged the Quasi-Demon Emperor, and he used the same technique as in the last simulation, intending to fuse with you.]
[However, this time, he is destined to be unlucky. When the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s soul invaded your Sea of Consciousness, you used the effect of the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge without hesitation.]
[Under the effect of the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge, the Quasi-Demon Emperor can’t erode your soul at all and can’t cause you any damage.]
[On the contrary, you can completely ignore the defense and launch a terrifying attack on the Quasi-Demon Emperor. You find that the effect of the Four-digit talent – True Damage is not limited to energy, it also has talent support in the soul aspect.]
[Because of this, the Quasi-Demon Emperor is thoroughly numbed, he didn’t expect that you have so many disgusting abilities. He wants to escape from your Sea of Consciousness. However, you obviously won’t let him succeed. Now, the positions of the hunter and the hunted have completely changed.]
[In the end, the soul of the Quasi-Demon Emperor is crushed and suppressed by you with reluctance and angry howls, his soul imprint erased. Then, you use the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead to temporarily take it down, intending to slowly refine it later.]
[After killing the Quasi-Demon Emperor, you also took away his body and packed up the forbidden land, found a good place, and began to retreat.]
[In this situation, a hundred thousand years have passed in the blink of an eye, and you have successfully upgraded the Chaotic Fairy Clothes and the Devouring Immortal Demon Bead to the quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifact level by refining the Quasi-Demon Emperor’s bones.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1244 - 1244 315 Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1244: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_2 Chapter 1244: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_2 “The reason you chose to first upgrade your life-bound weapon to the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor’s Artifact, is because you remembered something. You were once bound by Chaos Demon King’s dao tool. The moment you reach the four-digit limit, you need to resurrect him, and this resurrection deadline is ten thousand years.”
“That is to say, if you break through to the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor, you will undoubtedly reach the four-digit limit rating of the Myriad Heavens Paradise. At that time, the dao tool will take effect, and you must figure out a way to resurrect the Chaos Demon King.”
“However, you currently do not have any four-digit dao tools on you, so resurrecting Chaos Demon King is an unrealistic task. But if you can’t manage this, you will be subject to the rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise and completely perish.”
“This, undoubtedly, is something you are unable to accept. Thus, you decided to take care of other matters first, before choosing to breakthrough on your cultivation.”
“Just like that, in a blink of an eye, nearly 200,000 years have passed. After nearly 200,000 years, you successfully refined the body of a Quasi-Demon emperor and broke through to the level of quasi-Fairy Emperor.”
“As you attain the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor, you feel immensely powerful to the extreme, getting addicted to this terrifying strength. You believe that you, now, could be considered an invincible existence. If no Immortal Emperors appear, you could be the strongest existence in the world.”
“It was when you were full of such self-confidence that you felt something, saw a glimpse of the future, and saw the impending outbreak of Dark Disaster.”
…….
“I’ve finally reached the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor… I originally thought there would be some twists and turns, but I didn’t expect it to be so smooth.”
Wang Ping, staring at the content of the text simulation, was somewhat surprised.
“After the quasi-Fairy Emperor, it’s the Fairy Emperor. The Fairy Emperor is a three-digit existence in Myriad Heavens Paradise, but I don’t know if there is such a person as a Fairy Emperor in this Mysterious Fantasy World.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, muttering to himself.
To Wang Ping, there is a possibility that a Fairy Emperor exists in this world.
After all, without a three-digit existence sitting down, it is impossible to hinder the existence above the Immortal Realm from other worlds.
The senior from the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group didn’t have any interest in managing these matters.
Other than that, the weird things, should be suppressed by the Fairy Emperor, not the senior from the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group.
After all, the emergence of the bizarre happened long before the senior of the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group.
When that senior was still in the four-digit realm, slaughtering the Immortal King of the Immortal Domain and smashing the Immortal Domain, the bizarre has been existing for a very long time.
Therefore, from this point, it can be judged that the bizarre is definitely not suppressed by him, but by someone else.
This person could very likely be the strongest existence in this Mysterious Fantasy World, a person at the level of Fairy Emperor.”
“However, all of this is just my guess. If it is like this or not, it still needs to be verified.”
Wang Ping’s eyes shone brightly, muttering to himself.
Then, he continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
“Soon, you come back to your senses with an indifferent expression. You don’t need to see the future for the matter of Dark Disaster. After all, you have known the exact time a long time ago.”
“After that, you took a step forward, left the Demon Realm, appeared in the Sea of Darkness, and actively started killing inside.”
“You, displayed an extremely strong divine power. Wherever you go, the aura of a quasi-Fairy Emperor naturally dissipates, causing all the Dark Beings to be destroyed. No Dark Beings could survive, not even the Dark Immortal King Giant.”
“At this moment, a familiar figure appears in front of you. This figure is unmistakably the bloody figure that once killed you, that incredibly powerful Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor.”
“Upon the appearance of the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, he stares at you, no longer with the disdain he had in the past simulation, but with a serious expression. He expresses his surprise that you could reach the level of quasi-Fairy Emperor so quickly.”
“You laugh, stating that they have left him too much time, otherwise, he would not have been able to grow up.”
“The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor shakes his head, explaining that there is nothing else they could have done since his master was entangled by someone else and could not clearly see the past, present, and future. By the time they reacted, you have already grown.”
“Listening to the words of the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, you have many speculations in your heart, and some of your guesses get verified. Just as you are about to inquire further, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor suddenly attacks you. The terrifying power caused the entire Sea of Darkness to shake and numerous worlds to tremble because of this powerful force.”
“As for the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s attack, you are not surprised nor angry, but just burst out with a terrifying fighting power, colliding with him.”
“As soon as you both collided, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor was sent flying by you, suffering severe injuries. The power of the Four-digit talent – True Damage, gave you an absolute advantage in the face-to-face battle.”
“Not to mention, you are intrinsically stronger than the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor. Consequently, even though the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor is not as weak as that Quasi-Demon Emperor, he still suffered a setback the moment the fight began.”
“After the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor restores his injury, he marvels at your strength. Then, he says that even though you are powerful, you are ultimately fighting alone. Therefore, you are destined to die here.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1245 - 1245 315 Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1245: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_3 Chapter 1245: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_3 [As the words of the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor fell, three more extremely powerful auras appeared here. Apparently, three more Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors had emerged.]
[You stared at the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors, your expression extremely solemn, and felt great pressure. If you had to fight against one at the same level, you would not be afraid of anyone, and even against two, you would not be afraid. However, facing four at once, even for you, there would be no chance of survival.]
[After all, who among those able to become Quasi-Immortal Emperors could be considered weak? Even if you were stronger than them, it would be impossible for you to defeat all four of them, even with your four-digit talent – True Damage.]
[Perhaps, only by promoting your Chaos Immortal Body to the Perfect Domain can you fight against all four and slay them.]
[The four Quasi-Immortal Emperors, including the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, didn’t give you much time to think, they chose to strike together, and attacked you.]
[Consequently, you felt enormous pressure and were instantly at an absolute disadvantage.]
[At the same time, due to the collision between you and the five Quasi-Immortal Emperors, the entire Sea of Darkness became even more unstable, and all the upper planes shook wildly. This caused all the sensed Immortal Kings to be extremely terrified, feeling as if a great disaster was imminent.]
[It was during this crisis that a figure clad in white crossed the sea and joined the battlefield.]
[This surprised both you and the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors, as you never expected that there would be other surviving Quasi-Immortal Emperors in the world.]
[However, what surprised you even more was the identity of this Quasi-Immortal Emperor. It turned out to be Chaos Body – Ye Cang, who should have perished.]
[Ye Cang, the former Immortal King Giant who was supposed to die at the hands of a predecessor in the First Generation Transcender Chat Group, had not only escaped death but also broken through his limits and reached the level of a Quasi-Immortal Emperor.]
[Seemingly sensing your astonishment, Ye Cang sighed and admitted that he had indeed died, but someone had revived him.]
[Hearing this, you were quite surprised, vaguely guessing something. It would not be unexpected if this were the doing of the person from the First Generation Chat Group. After all, who else would dare to revive Ye Cang?]
[While you were talking, the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors coldly declared that even if you had a Quasi-Immortal Emperor reinforcing you, in front of them, there was still only one outcome: defeat.]
[Without wasting words, you and Ye Cang joined forces to face the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors. The gap between Quasi-Immortal Emperors was indeed small. Although Ye Cang helped you share the pressure and blocked one of the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors, you still struggled to hold your own with your back against the wall against the other three.]
[Seeing this, Ye Cang sighed, lamented the unpredictability of fate, and then repelled his opponent before joining your side.]
[Ye Cang’s actions surprised you as you didn’t know what he intended to do. After all, temporarily breaking away from an opponent and joining your side of the battlefield was meaningless.]
[Just as you were wondering about this, Ye Cang’s body suddenly shattered and turned into pure Chaos essence, merging into your body. At the same time, a voice rang out.]
[The condition for the Chaos Immortal Body to reach perfection is the voluntary sacrifice of a Quasi-Immortal Emperor with a Perfect Chaotic Body; otherwise, the Chaos Immortal Body can never attain the Perfect Domain.]
[Hearing this, your mind trembled, and you finally understood why Ye Cang had survived and become a Quasi-Immortal Emperor, appearing at a critical moment to help you. Most likely, it was all the work of a predecessor from the First Generation Chat Group. He had calculated everything and paved the way for you.]
[That is to say, Ye Cang was a thoroughly sacrificial pawn, a pitiful chess piece at the mercy of a transcender in the First Generation Chat Group. His existence was meant to help you reach the pinnacle once you became a Quasi-Immortal Emperor.]
[For a moment, you felt a surge of complex emotions. If Ye Cang met such a fate, what would yours be? After all, you too were nothing but a chess piece in the hands of the transcender from the First Generation Chat Group; where would your destiny lie?]
[As you sighed, you found that your Chaos Immortal Body had undergone tremendous changes upon absorbing the Chaos essence of Ye Cang, making it extremely powerful and causing your aura to soar.]
[Seeing this transformation, the faces of the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors became extremely solemn and without hesitation, they launched their most powerful attacks against you, intending to kill you before your metamorphosis was complete.]
[However, their plan failed. Faced with their full-powered attacks, you casually swung your fist and shattered their onslaught. At the same time, you sent all four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors flying, their bodies blasted apart, suffering severe injuries and barely surviving your punch.]
[The four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors struggled to regenerate their bodies, gazing at you, who seemed unstoppable, and fell silent. They were well aware that even though you were also a Quasi-Immortal Emperor, your combat strength was now in an entirely different realm. If you wanted to kill them, it would only take another punch.]
[This cannot be attributed to their weakness, but rather to the incredible power of the Perfect Domain Chaos Immortal Body, which brought a qualitative change to your strength.]
[Seeing the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors falling into silence and losing their will to fight, you felt rather bored and struck again, killing them all.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1246 - 1246 315 Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1246: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_4 Chapter 1246: Chapter 315: Breakthrough to Quasi-Fairy Emperor! The Truth about Life and Death Realm!_4 [Thus, the world lost four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors, as well as one powerful Quasi-Immortal Emperor.]
……
“I never thought things would turn out like this…”
Wang Ping looked at the text simulation, feeling very emotional.
He didn’t expect Ye Cang to appear in this way, and even more surprisingly, for the simulated Wang Ping to obtain the Perfect Chaos Immortal Body in this manner.
“Next, either face the strange or become invulnerable to death.”
Then, Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking secretly in his heart.
At the level of the simulated Wang Ping, unless he commits suicide or reaches a three-digit number of strange, he really couldn’t die.
And it was obviously difficult for strange to take action personally.
If he could do it, he would have done it a long time ago and not waited until now.
“It seems something is wrong. According to the Bridge Guard, once the Chaos Immortal Body emerges, this world will have no salvation. Obviously, the outbreak of strange is not far away. It is just unknown whether the Perfect Domain Chaos Immortal Body is also included by the Bridge Guard.”
Wang Ping showed a sharp expression, murmuring to himself.
As Wang Ping pondered, the text simulation continued.
[You feel very emotional, looking towards the depths of the Sea of Darkness, as if seeing a terrifying existence. You remained silent for a long time, using your Great Divine Skill to purify the darkness of the Sea of Darkness, protecting countless worlds surrounded by the Sea of Darkness.]
[After taking care of these, you leave here and head to the Life and Death Realm.]
[Once in the Life and Death Realm, you meet the Bridge Guard. At this moment, the Bridge Guard has no secrets in your eyes. Undoubtedly, he is also a Quasi-Immortal Emperor-level existence. However, even if he is a Quasi-Immortal Emperor, he can’t possibly be your opponent.]
[What concerns you is the existence behind the Bridge Guard, who can make a Quasi-Immortal Emperor act as a Bridge Guard. There must be an Immortal Emperor behind him. At the same time, the Immortal Emperor is also the one suppressing the strange and protecting the world.]
[As you gaze at the Bridge Guard, he also looks back at you. Obviously, he is not surprised that you came here.]
[In the end, the Bridge Guard spoke, saying that you indeed possess astonishing potential. This may be a characteristic of people from that mysterious Primitive Earth.]
[When he finished speaking, the Bridge Guard fell silent, changing his words and stating that he was not quite right. You are an exception, as other people from Primitive Earth don’t have such perverse talent as yours.]
[You just smiled at the Bridge Guard’s words, not explaining further. You only stared at the Bridge Guard, expressing your desire to know the truth behind the Source of Darkness and the whereabouts of the Immortal Emperor who protects all living beings.]
[In response to your question, the Bridge Guard remained silent for a long time, sighed, and said that you, as a Quasi-Immortal Emperor with a Perfect Chaotic Immortal Body, are qualified to know the greatest secret of this world.]
[Then, the Bridge Guard pointed at the River of Forgetfulness and the Bridge of Helplessness, asking if you know the reason for the appearance of the Life and Death Realm?]
[You shook your head, saying that you only know it should be the work of the Immortal Emperor, but you can’t guess why the Immortal Emperor created such a peculiar place like the Life and Death Realm. It shouldn’t be just for dealing with strange.]
[The Bridge Guard nodded, agreeing with your guess, and said that the Reincarnation Emperor created the Life and Death Realm, the River of Forgetfulness, and the Bridge of Helplessness not for dealing with strange, but for reviving his daughter.]
[Upon hearing this, you were very surprised. An Immortal Emperor would not be unable to resurrect his daughter. Not to mention, the Bridge Guard said the Reincarnation Emperor. It is clear that the path walked by this silently protecting Immortal Emperor should be that of reincarnation. His path would not be unable to resurrect a person.]
[Then, you narrowed your eyes, guessed the reason, and uttered the four words, ‘Sky Tower Game.’]

chapters.title: Chapter 1247 - 1247 316 Generous Rewards Deadly Crisis
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1247: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis! Chapter 1247: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis! [The Bridge Guard nodded, indicating that you guessed correctly. Indeed, the Reincarnation Emperor’s daughter died in the Sky Tower Game. Due to the unique characteristics of the game, once you die in it, you are dead for good, with no way of coming back to life.]
[However, the Reincarnation Emperor was unwilling to give up. Since the special items of Myriad Heavens Paradise were of no use, he tried to bring his daughter back to life using his own Daoist methods. This, undoubtedly, was a challenge to the rules of the Heaven Tower.]
[As you listened to the Bridge Guard, your emotions were hardly calm. It must be said, the Reincarnation Emperor was undoubtedly a great father, and a bold one for daring to challenge the rules of the Heaven Tower.]
[However, while you admired the Reincarnation Emperor, you were also aware that the outcome of all this would not be splendid.]
[Just as you had predicted, the Bridge Guard spoke again. The rules of the Heaven Tower were obviously not something the Reincarnation Emperor could resist. Although the predecessor was astoundingly talented, he still could not bring his daughter back to life.]
[Nevertheless, the Reincarnation Emperor did not give up, opting to try and let his daughter reincarnate. He created a soul using the memory of her existence. It is hard to say if this soul is the original person, but it served as a place to hold his hope.]
[Then, the soul began a long cycle of reincarnation, gradually moving toward the Reincarnation Emperor’s daughter. Up to this day, the Bridge Guard doesn’t know where this soul has ended up.]
[After that, a strange ability emerged. It was quite simple: spreading darkness, absorbing darkness, growing to the extreme, the darkness never ending, and it existing forever.]
[As long as there are Living Beings, there will be a dark side within their hearts. Only by exterminating all Living Beings can this strange power be killed.]
[Listening to the Bridge Guard, you feel a cold shiver run down your spine. No wonder the Source of Darkness exists in every world, yet there is no turbulence; it turned out that it feeds on dark emotions.]
[You have encountered other beings that absorb negative emotions. However, that strange power who has grown to such a level, you have never seen before. No wonder it remains undying; even Alpha has said that it cannot be killed.]
[If nothing goes wrong, an existence of three-digit numbers cannot kill this strange power. Whether a two-digit number can kill it is an unknown. It could be that two-digit numbers don’t care about it and are too lazy to take action, or it could be that they cannot completely kill it.]
[Of course, the second possibility is quite small. After all, the existence of two-digit numbers can destroy the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms with a single thought and can restore them just as easily.]
[For this reason, the most significant probability is that the two-digit numbers are not interested in taking action. Perhaps, there is also the calculation of the two-digit numbers at work here.]
[As you ponder on these thoughts, the Bridge Guard spoke again. The strange power is too dangerous, so after its appearance, the Reincarnation Emperor took action by using his grand reincarnation path to drag the strange power’s essence into the endless cycle of reincarnation, preventing it from causing havoc in the world.]
[This method could greatly slow down the growth rate of the strange power while isolating its influence on the outer world.]
[As the Bridge Guard spoke, he sighed, saying that the Reincarnation Emperor was looking for someone who could help him kill this strange power. Unfortunately, the countless years have passed without anyone growing to the level of an Immortal Emperor.]
[Upon hearing this, you slightly furrowed your eyebrows, feeling confused. After all, the predecessor in the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group had reached the level of two-digit numbers. Could it be that the Bridge Guard was unaware of his existence?]
[As if sensing your confusion, the Bridge Guard shook his head and spoke again. He explained that there was indeed an existence that shared a similar origin with you, who is now an incredibly powerful figure. However, he was not like you, a Primitive Earth person who traversed to this world, so he was not counted.]
[The words of the Bridge Guard left you utterly astonished. After all, you subconsciously believed that the predecessor from the First Generation Transmigrator Chat Group was just like you and Leng Yue, someone who traversed to this world and rose to power, yet it turns out he never actually did.]
