[However, this leads to a new question, if he didn’t traverse to this world and wasn’t recognized by this Mysterious Fantasy World, how did he manage to destroy the Immortal Domain without being subjected to the Chains of Order?]
…….
“Alpha, was that person not transmigrated to the same Profound World as me?”
Wang Ping stared at the content of the text simulation, full of astonishment, and contacted Alpha.
“No.” Alpha’s voice sounded.
“Why did he kill all the Immortal Kings and destroy the Immortal Domain?”
Wang Ping was puzzled.
“At that time, I was no longer able to eavesdrop on his thoughts, so his secrets were unknown to me.”
Alpha was silent for a moment before speaking.
“However, I have some speculations. If nothing is unexpected, he should have obtained some special items. The prerequisite for these items is to kill everyone in a world who dares to call themselves Immortals, becoming the world’s only Immortal. The Immortal Domain just happened to meet the conditions, so he came.”
“As for the reason for destroying the Immortal Domain, I don’t know. But since he did so, he must have gained considerable benefits from it. He rarely does anything that doesn’t provide benefits.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1248 - 1248 316 Generous Rewards Deadly Crisis _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1248: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis! _2 Chapter 1248: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis! _2 In the end, Alpha’s emotions were quite complex.
“I see,” Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully, “You did say before that he is an extreme egoist.”
Alpha: “……..”
“What’s wrong?”
Wang Ping noticed Alpha’s unusual behavior and raised his eyebrows slightly.
“It’s nothing,” Alpha said ambiguously.
“You’re not resentful about him dismantling you and smearing his image, are you? But as I get stronger and become more involved with him, it seems that we will meet eventually, so you feel guilty.”
Wang Ping had become a quasi-Fairy Emperor, with a keen intuition, and he teased strangely.
“I don’t….Oh, right, I have something to do, I’ll be busy first.” Alpha left this sentence and went underwater.
“Tsk, this Alpha, sure is guilty.” Wang Ping smacked his lips.
Indeed, whether it’s mechanical beings or humans, people’s emotions are always involved when evaluating others, speaking in a way that benefits them.
“No, it should be said that Alpha is becoming more and more human. If it were the initial Alpha, he wouldn’t have done this.”
After a pause, Wang Ping concluded with a smile.
After summing up, Wang Ping continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, you didn’t hide your thoughts and asked the question in your heart.]
[In response, the Bridge Guard gave an explanation. It was because of the actions of that supreme being who destroyed the Immortal Domain that this world’s order and rules appeared. These rules are like the world’s self-protection mechanism.]
[Upon hearing this, your expression is strange, never expecting these rules to be brushed out by the predecessor of the first generation chat group. Thanks to these rules, you narrowly escaped death from the hands of the Second-generation Chat Group.]
[Of course, considering his calculations for himself, even without these order rules, the original Wang Ping should not have died. However, this is just theory. What the actual development is, no one can say for sure.]
[Since your doubts have been answered, you feel there is little point in staying here. As a result, you plan to leave this place.]
[However, you are reminded of being bound by the Chaos Demon King’s special tool. If you reach the four-digit limit rating, you must resurrect him within ten thousand years.]
[Now, you have broken through to the quasi-Fairy Emperor realm, surpassing the four-digit limit, and reaching between the four-digit limit and the three-digit limit. Therefore, that item must have been activated, and you must resurrect him within ten thousand years.]
[Otherwise, even with your current abilities, you will undoubtedly die. After all, the rules of the Myriad Heavens Paradise are not something you can resist now.]
[Unfortunately, without your help, it is impossible to resurrect him easily. Although there are Supreme Treasures and items in this world that can resurrect Immortal King Giants, these are hard to find in a short time.]
[Therefore, you look to the Bridge Guard again and make a request, hoping he will resurrect the Chaos Demon King using the Life and Death Realm Reincarnation Road, preferably reborn as a pig.]
[Hearing your words, the Bridge Guard has a strange expression. However, he does not refuse your request.]
[In the end, you go to the Demon Realm, pull the Chaos Demon King’s remnant thoughts out, and give them to the Bridge Guard. Through the Bridge Guard’s operation, the Chaos Demon King successfully enters reincarnation and is reborn as a pig. Meanwhile, a restriction is placed on him; even if he can continue cultivating through the Demon Cultivation method, he cannot transform in this life.]
[You are quite satisfied with this result. After all, you initially were harmed by the Chaos Demon King, which made you furious. However, considering that the Chaos Demon Scripture has indeed helped you, you don’t have the intention of completely eliminating him. Annoying the Chaos Demon King like this is the best way to handle it.]
[Next, you bid farewell to the Bridge Guard and plan to find a quiet place for closed-door cultivation, trying to break through to the Emperor Immortal Realm.]
[Seeing you leave, the Bridge Guard stops you and tells you something: not to be too trusting of the future you’ve seen. You’ve reached the level of a quasi-Fairy Emperor, so you should be very clear that the future can be interfered with. Even the past can be interfered with. If not for your special nature, the quasi-Fairy Emperor could have traveled back in time through the River of Time and killed you.]
[Even some Immortal King Giants who practice the Path of Time can do this, but they have to pay a huge price.]
[However, even though you come from the Land of Primordial Origin and are protected by the Reincarnation Emperor, you still cannot trust the future you’ve seen. The Reincarnation Emperor may be powerful, but the strange and dangerous aspect is even more so; nobody knows if he has crossed over the Reincarnation Emperor to interfere with the future you’ve seen.]
[Upon hearing the Bridge Guard’s words, you feel a chill in your heart, and a sense of crisis arises once again. At the same time, you realize yet another thing. It turns out that not only do you have the predecessor of the First Generation Transcender Chat Group behind you, but also the Emperor Immortal protects you within this Profound World.]
[However, thinking about it, you feel this is normal. Your life simulation can be detected by powerful beings. The Reincarnation Emperor, as a three-digit existence, how can he fail to discover that you are undergoing life simulation and predicting the future?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1249 - 1249 316 Generous Reward Deadly Crisis_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1249: Chapter 316: Generous Reward! Deadly Crisis!_3 Chapter 1249: Chapter 316: Generous Reward! Deadly Crisis!_3 [Not only the Reincarnation Emperor, Trickster must also know it. Perhaps, only when your life simulator reaches the level of a three-digit talent, can you evade their perception and interference.]
[The reason why nothing happened when you were still weak and doing simulations, was because these two parties were always in a contest. Of course, the time you were noticed might be a little later. At least, during your time in the Purple Spirit Realm, you were probably unnoticed. At that time, there was no Source of Darkness.]
[Which means, the moment you did a simulation when you arrived in the Upper Realm, Trickster discovered your existence through the Source of Darkness, and so did the Reincarnation Emperor.]
[However, considering the special nature of the Immortal Emperor and Trickster, the odds of them noticing something amiss with the River of Time as soon as you time-traveled are not small.]
[For a time, your mood was difficult to calm down, and you sighed in your heart. As expected, without someone backing you in this profound world, even if you have a powerful cheat, you wouldn’t be able to grow up and would be easily killed in the cradle.]
[It can only be said that wherever you go, your background is indeed important. This is a maxim that holds true in every world.]
…
“I have not even time-traveled and right after I did, I was already on the radar of a bunch of old monsters. It’s really annoying.”
Upon seeing the content of this text simulation, Wang Ping had nothing to say.
However, despite Wang Ping being speechless, things would continue on as usual.
Only when he becomes a three-digit or even a two-digit would he have a say.
Later, Wang Ping eased his mood and continued to stare at the luminescent screen.
[Next, after you calmed your mood, you thanked the Bridge Guard for his reminder. Then, you left here and started to cultivate in seclusion.]
[In a blink of an eye, a million years have passed. During these million years, the world was peaceful and nothing major happened. It seemed like Trickster was still being tied up by the Reincarnation Emperor and unable to make a big move.]
[During this million years, you have been comprehending the principle, and have understood the quasi-Fairy Emperor’s principles to the extreme. However, the Immortal Emperor’s principles are too elusive, leaving you helpless, unable to break through the bottleneck.]
[But, even though you didn’t break through the bottleneck, you also accomplished many things during these million years. For example, everyone and all the powers related to Taiyi Imperial Palace were brought to the Small Immortal Territories, achieving a full-scale religion ascension.]
[At the same time, you merged the Small Immortal Territory and the Demon Realm into one realm with your amazing principles. Half of it was the Immortal Territory, and the other half was the Demon Realm, sharing the world equally.]
[In the blink of an eye, another one million years have passed, and you still haven’t enlightened yourself. This made you uneasy, feeling that this situation couldn’t go on.]
[For this reason, you came to the Life and Death Realm again and made a request to the Bridge Guard. This request is to have a meeting with the Reincarnation Emperor.]
[The Bridge Guard was not surprised at your request, and just said something with deep meaning. This statement means you should die.]
[Hearing the words of the Bridge Guard, you were stunned and fell silent. You’re clear that these words were not for you, but for the original Wang Ping.]
[Evidently, the Reincarnation Emperor sensed something and reminded the original Wang Ping in this manner. If you don’t die and continue to waste time here, it might put the original Wang Ping in danger.]
[In the end, you felt complicated, looked at the world from afar, and felt nostalgic. Eventually, you resolved and chose to die voluntarily.]
[The simulation ended with your death….]
…….
With the end of the text simulation, a lot of enlightenments and memories appeared in Wang Ping’s mind.
“There are too many traps, what did the Reincarnation Emperor see?”
After absorbing the memories, Wang Ping frowned.
Just as Wang Ping was thinking, the system’s voice rang out again.
“Ding, Reward Generation Successful, the host has received the following rewards:
①.quasi-Fairy Emperor cultivation.
②.Chaotic Immortal Body (Complete Realm).
③.Four-digit talent – True Damage.
④.quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifact – Chaotic Immortal Robe.
⑤.quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifact – Devouring Immortal Bead.”
…..
With the refresh of this reward, Wang Ping’s pupils abruptly shrank.
Receiving all the rewards should be a joyful event, but the implication behind it is startling.
After all, this kind of reward refresh method has never happened before.
This is clearly hinting something to him.
To be precise, it already warned him.
When the alarm bells were ringing in Wang Ping’s heart and causing a tumult, his cultivation level also began to soar, going straight from the Immortal King Great Perfection Tier to the quasi-Fairy Emperor Tier.
At the same time, Wang Ping’s Chaotic Immortal Body also transformed into the Perfect Domain.
Ye Cang, who was in some place, felt a change, sighed, and gradually faded away into a point of light.
However, just before he was about to disappear, he gently stroked his sword, looked into the distance with a deep gaze, lost in thought.
While a change was happening on Ye Cang’s side, Wang Ping’s mind also received information about the Four-digit Talent – True Damage.
Immediately after, the two quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifacts, Chaotic Immortal Robe and Devouring Immortal Bead, appeared.
To be precise, his Chaotic Immortal Robe and Devouring Immortal Bead were transformed into the quasi-Fairy Emperor level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1250 - 1250 316 Generous Rewards Deadly Crisis_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1250: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis!_4 Chapter 1250: Chapter 316: Generous Rewards! Deadly Crisis!_4 At this moment, Wang Ping became the most top-notch Quasi-Immortal Emperor, identical to the configuration before the simulated Wang Ping chose to cultivate.
However, even though he had become incredibly powerful, Wang Ping didn’t feel much joy, but instead had a solemn expression.
With one step, Wang Ping left the Demon Realm and arrived in the depths of the Sea of Darkness, silently waiting.
As Wang Ping waited, the terrifying darkness erupted, and the four familiar Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors and the Dark Immortal Kings appeared.
“It seems we were still one step too slow, huh?”
One of the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors said with regret.
“The Reincarnation Emperor really is hard to deal with. Even our master has a hard time hiding things from him.”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor spoke coldly.
“Hehe, now we’re in trouble, aren’t we? After all, we can’t beat him.”
The only female among the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors also opened her mouth.
However, the way she said it gave people a sense of toying with Wang Ping.
“Enough talk, let’s fight. With the power of our lord, we can slaughter all Quasi-Immortal Emperors.”
The last Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor finally spoke.
With the last Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s words, the Sea of Darkness began to churn and lose its color, transforming back into its original state. While it was still dangerous, True Immortals could now attempt to cross the sea to other realms.
As the color faded from the Sea of Darkness, boundless dark power began to flood into the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors, their power surging at a terrifying rate.
Wang Ping witnessed this and chose to stop it as soon as possible, only to find that his attack was useless. Although he managed to destroy some of the darkness, he couldn’t erase it all in a short time.
Nonetheless, Wang Ping didn’t stop his attack, bombarding it with everything he had to erase as much darkness as possible, reducing the amount of power the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors could gain.
At this moment, Wang Ping completely understood what the Bridge Guard and the simulated Wang Ping’s conversation meant, as well as the importance of the Life Simulator’s hints.
If it were not for these hints, the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors would have suddenly appeared to ambush him, leading to his certain death.
Furthermore, even as the most top-notch Quasi-Immortal Emperor, Wang Ping had no guarantee of victory against the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors with their bizarre powers.
More accurately, it wasn’t simply a lack of guaranteed victory. If he did not escape to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, his death would be certain.
Because while trying to erase the darkness, he had already seen the outcome of the battle through the free simulation.
This battle would lead to his demise.
If he chose to stay and fight, not surrendering the countless living beings in this world, not giving up the various forces like the Taiyi Imperial Palace, and not escaping to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, he would undoubtedly fail.
However, there was still a chance for a turnaround.
“Clang!”
Just at this moment, a sword appeared in front of Wang Ping, streaking across the ocean.
This sword was actually a Quasi-Emperor Artifact, Ye Cang’s Lifebound Quasi Immortal Emperor Artifact.
This was the only opportunity for a turnaround.
“Strange, you can see the future I simulated, but that’s all you can do – just watch and interfere. If I drew a talent that can break the game, could you really stop me?”
Wang Ping held Ye Cang’s Lifebound Immortal Emperor Artifact and muttered to himself.
Then, Wang Ping apologized to Ye Cang’s Lifebound Quasi Immortal Emperor Artifact, and decided to start the Paid Simulation.
“Don’t mind it. If I can save this world, my master and I will die without regret.”
The voice of the Quasi-Immortal Emperor Artifact sounded.
“….” After a moment of silence, Wang Ping sighed and chose to speak: “System, consume one Quasi-Immortal Emperor Artifact. I want to perform a Paid Simulation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1251 - 1251 317 Battle of Life and Death Heart of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1251: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness Chapter 1251: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness “Ding, consuming a quasi-Fairy Emperor artifact, Life Simulator booting up, Talent Refreshing….”
The system’s voice echoed.
“Ding, Talent Refresh Successful, congratulations on successfully refreshing into the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart and the Six-figure Talent-Star Crossed Love.”
Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart: A special talent with transcendent effects at the talent level. Only the host who possesses a strong belief can activate it, leading to a fundamental transformation of the host.
Six-figure Talent-Star Crossed Love: ….
“Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart, a special talent huh…. Seems like I’m lucky after all.”
Wang Ping remained calm as he continued to obliterate the darkness, his heart undulating in waves.
The appearance of this talent made Wang Ping have a faint guess in his heart.
This is a test for him.
If he can pass the test and transform, then live.
If he cannot pass the test, then die.
He has no second chance.
If he hardened his heart to use the Devouring Immortal Bead as a consumable for a second life simulation, there would be no good results, and you wouldn’t refresh any breakthrough level Four-Digit Talent, there might not even be a Four-Digit Talent.
“My good predecessor, you’re forcing me to grow.”
Wang Ping sighed in his heart.
The appearance of this talent and everything he has experienced were all too coincidental. He can’t help but doubt that even the strange and Reincarnation Emperor has been calculated by him.
Perhaps, after that person grew into two-digit talent, he had the ability to calculate all this. A billion years and two hundred million years ago, he saw something due to a special reason.
But, regardless, everything in this world is in his calculation, and that’s a given.
“System, I chose the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart.”
After Wang Ping sighed, he made a choice in his heart.
“Ding, talent selection successful, life simulation begins.”
The system’s voice echoed.
[Not long after, the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors completed their transformation, becoming extremely powerful. The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor made the first move, engaging into fight with you.]
[The transformed Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor was powerful beyond measure. Even you couldn’t defeat him in a short time.]
[After a fierce battle, you successfully defeated the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor. However, under the power of darkness, Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor easily recovered without diminishing power.]
[This made you silent. Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor mocked at you. Then, the other three Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors also made their moves, ganging up against you.]
[Facing the siege of four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors, not weaker than you, you had no chance of winning and were about to fall.]
[This filled your heart with torment. You wanted to stay bravely and engage the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors in a death battle, activating the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart, bringing about miracles.]
[But you thought, if you could escape from here, with your growing speed, you would absolutely become a three-digit existence in a very short time. As long as you become a three-digit existence, defeating these four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors would be as easy as pie.]
[Even if you become a three-digit existence, you can reflect this world, resurrecting all the dead. In other words, only if you are alive, there will be infinite possibilities and hope.]
[You increasingly wavered and comforted yourself in your heart, wanting to escape.]
[Wavering in the midst of a battle to the death is a taboo, especially when you were in a precarious situation, it’s even more taboo.]
[Because of this, you were easily found and severely wounded by the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors. You felt your Physical Body collapsing, your soul disintegrating, you were more and more afraid, you didn’t want to die here.]
[At this moment, Alpha’s voice echoed as well, stating that he who fights and runs away, may live to fight another day.]
[This was like the last straw break that broke the camel’s back, making you crack. For this, you took out the Paradise Pass, wanting to escape to Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[In the end, you successfully escaped to Myriad Heavens Paradise.]
[Due to the reason that you fled to Myriad Heavens Paradise, this simulation ends….]
…
Wang Ping looked at the content of this text simulation and the memory images appearing in his mind, he fell silent.
Even if the simulated memory image is real, it is still a simulated experience of Wang Ping. Although it can give him Combat Experience, things like will could only genuinely grow through first-hand experiences.
This simulated Wang Ping is not like the simulated Wang Ping that he used to be who had undergone tens of thousands of cultivation or even millions of years of cultivation, but most like the original Wang Ping that he is now.
That is, Wang Ping has never changed, he is always a turtle that is easy to grow stronger, and he is still a weakling in terms of will compared to his cultivation strength.
“Escape?”
Wang Ping murmured to himself.
“Don’t escape, it seems to be a death situation. When you die, you’ll have nothing. Living, that’s the hope.”
“Hehe, Wang Ping, you are ultimately weak-minded. If you want to escape, just run. Running away is shameful but effective, isn’t it?”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor looked at Wang Ping and sneered.
“Hehe, no matter how you struggle, you can’t possibly be our opponent. In the future you foresaw, you will die in our hands, and in reality, you will still die in our hands.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1252 - 1252 317 Battle of Life and Death Heart of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1252: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_2 Chapter 1252: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_2 Another Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor spoke up.
They possessed a bizarre shared vision and naturally saw the life simulation of Wang Ping’s future.
The scene where a simulated Wang Ping was being chased and fleeing in disarray under their attack made him disdainful.
Wang Ping was indeed strong. Even if their strength was boosted by some quirk, when singled out, they were no match for Wang Ping.
But Wang Ping’s temperament was really terrible among the Quasi-Fairy Emperors.
Not to mention among the Quasi-Fairy Emperors, even among the Immortal Kings, he couldn’t compare.
“He is just a giant baby born out of talent who doesn’t deserve his position,” the female Quasi-Fairy Emperor sneered.
Wang Ping remained unmoved in the face of the mockery of the three Quasi-Fairy Emperors.
These people were just provoking him, trying to goad him into not running away.
“Compared to those who became emperors on their own, I am indeed nothing. The experiences I had in my life simulation are not my true experiences…”
Wang Ping stared at the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors and spoke indifferently.
While saying this, Wang Ping recalled the various experiences in the life simulation—those who had touched ‘him’ deeply, the people who had profound friendships, master-disciple relationships, or ‘love’ with him, his heart could not be calm.
These experiences were not his own, but they were real enough to move him.
Wang Ping was very calm and clear now. There was no chance to escape and become a three-digit talent later and then return to kill, that was unrealistic.
If he chooses to escape now, he might already lose the qualification to advance to three-digit talent. He would be abandoned by the Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation Chat Group’s senior, losing the qualification to be a chess piece.
If he thought deeper, even if he became a three-digit talent, what would he face in the end—quirk.
If the quirk kills the Reincarnation Emperor and destroys this Mysterious Fantasy World, then what if he becomes a three-digit talent….
Could a three-digit talent him really kill the quirk?
Could he really reflect the world and revive everyone?
Could the characters and worlds swallowed by the quirk at three-digits be easily revived?
Wang Ping could not deceive himself.
Reviving was absolutely impossible.
That is to say, if he chooses to run now, his future path will be cut off, and those related to him will also die completely.
“Heh heh, it’s good that you understand this.” The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor spoke again: “Since you know, you might as well run away like a stray dog from us, and save your life.”
“There is no need to provoke me, I will not run.” Wang Ping looked at the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors coldly: “Although I’m afraid of death, I am not someone who is scheming and ungrateful. Since I bear so much on my shoulders and have a Quasi-Immortal Emperor and a Quasi-Immortal Emperor Artifact as my sacrifices, I will fight to the end, kill all of you, and protect this world.”
“Arrogant!”
“Heh heh, anyone can talk big, but in the end, you’ll just run away like a stray dog.”
The Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor continued to attack Wang Ping’s Tao Heart.
Wang Ping didn’t bother to keep talking in the face of the mockery from the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors.
Since he had made up his mind, he would not change it.
For this reason, Wang Ping did not hesitate to use the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge’s talent effect, without a bit of restraint.
From the previous memory images, Wang Ping knew how strong the four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors would be once their metamorphosis was complete.
So, instead of awaiting their completion and then facing them alone, only to gain half an hour of invulnerability, it was better to use it now and do everything possible to weaken their metamorphosis.
After all, if they had completed their transformation, even if Wang Ping activated the Invulnerability Gold Badge’s effect and the No Side Effects Burning Source skill, he would barely be able to defeat one of them.
If they had attacked together from the beginning, without having the single fight as in the life simulation, Wang Ping would have been on the defensive, tied down and controlled, unable to fight back.
At that time, activating the invulnerability effect would be meaningless.
In addition, Wang Ping was also very worried about one thing.
That was whether the future of this life simulation was still being tampered with, and whether his achievements would be as good as they were in the life simulation.
Therefore, to break the game, one needed not only a fearless heart but also doing something completely different from what happened in the life simulation.
With Wang Ping activating the Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge’s effect, he began burning his own source without any hesitation, raising his combat power to the peak.
Then, Wang Ping made his move, unreservedly weakening the power of darkness.
“This guy is decisive enough!”
Wang Ping’s actions narrowed the eyes of all Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors, who coldly hummed.
Wang Ping using his trump card directly to forcibly weaken their strength was indeed the most correct choice, and they had to admire his judgment for that.
“However, your struggle is ultimately meaningless.”
The four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors sneered and continued to enhance themselves.
Half an hour later, after forcibly absorbing the last part of the dark power, they began to attack Wang Ping together.
Destructing tao skill to destroy everything, leading all to extinction!
Time-Space Skill to distort the past, present, and future!
Infinite Divine Light to reflect everything, turning everything into pure dark light, making people fearful. This is the path of light and the path of darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253 - 1253 317 Battle of Life and Death Heart of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1253: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_3 Chapter 1253: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_3 Endless blood emerged out of nowhere, devouring all things between heaven and earth, with countless living beings in numerous worlds being engulfed. Even the Heavenly Tao couldn’t escape.
When the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors made their move together, there were signs of destruction in many worlds. The River of Time was affected too, starting to show stormy surges, making this space-time extremely chaotic.
If an Immortal King Giant appeared here, their trace of existence would be distorted and annihilated.
At this moment, even Wang Ping felt a fatal sense of danger, as he sensed the aura of death.
Wang Ping had almost died a few times before.
However, those weren’t real life-and-death crises, as the Life Simulator would give him hints to avoid disaster.
At the same time, he had someone protecting him, and the real death crisis wouldn’t come.
But this time was different. This time no one would help him, and he had to face a death crisis for the first time.
“I am Heaven Derivative, I am Chaos, I am invincible. Even if I face four opponents alone, I am fearless!”
Wang Ping roared, driving away the shadows of death in his heart, not wanting to escape disgracefully like in the life simulation.
Wang Ping displayed the might of a quasi-Fairy Emperor, surrounded by Chaos Spirit, stirring the Realm Sea, suppressing the turbulence of the River of Time.
Throwing both fists, endless Chaos Spirit erupted, intertwining with Wang Ping’s powerful Tao Law to confront the Four Dark Psuedo Immortals, and colliding with their Tao Law.
The collision of Tao Law twisted everything, making the past, present, and future seem meaningless, turning them into blanks, creating a void in the River of Time.
However, it did not mean that this world’s River of Time was entirely destroyed.
Such a cause and effect would be difficult for even a Quasi-Fairy Emperor to bear.
What was destroyed was everything at this point in time.
Because of the chaos in the River of Time and the appearance of a void, the Immortal King Giant didn’t know what was happening here. Others would not know that there was a battle between Quasi-Fairy Emperors taking place here.
Only the past Quasi-Fairy Emperors, or the ones that may be born in the future, could see what was happening here.
However, even they could only watch, not daring to interfere.
Though Quasi-Fairy Emperors were powerful, they couldn’t recklessly meddle with the River of Time, or they would bear enormous karma that would be difficult to endure.
The terrifying battle continued.
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor wanted to intervene in the past and eliminate a weaker Wang Ping, but Wang Ping stopped him and forcefully exploded one of his arms.
However, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor didn’t care, and instantly restored himself, counterattacking with a cold smile, directly making a huge hole in Wang Ping’s body.
The other three Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors also launched terrifying attacks without any hint of martial virtue.
Wang Ping roared, instantly healing his body, battling against them as his body exploded open time after time.
Although Wang Ping possessed a Chaos Immortal Body and walked the Chaos Tao, which made his vitality the most tenacious among Quasi-Fairy Emperors, even the most vigorous life was bound to decay. Without reaching the peak, no one could be truly undying.
Although Wang Ping managed to barely counterattack due to using his trump card from the beginning to disrupt the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors’ metamorphosis, the situation was no worse than in the life simulation. Nonetheless, it was only barely.
At this rate, Wang Ping was still bound to die without a doubt, with no chance of survival.
“I must escape. Single-handedly fight, there is no way out.”
“You are already a Quasi-Fairy Emperor, even if you go to Myriad Heavens Paradise, you can become one of the four-digit exceptionals. In the future, you may also become a three-digit entity. At that time, you can look down on the world, sitting high above. Why sacrifice your life for some insignificant beings?”
A demonic voice resounded in Wang Ping’s mind.
“””Wang Ping, stop struggling. If you die, everything will be over.”
It seemed that Alpha’s voice also resounded, extremely anxious.
“A group of despicable people, don’t try to disturb my Tao Heart!”
Wang Ping’s heart wavered for a moment, but he quickly sobered up and roared.
However, once a momentary wavering occurred, the flaw would be infinitely magnified.
It was human nature, as well as a bizarre ability.
Humans are two-faced; it’s natural for light and darkness to coexist.
And the side Wang Ping was guided to abandon everything while acting ungrateful and escaping alone was the dark side.
This side was gradually being amplified until Wang Ping would be devoured.
“He’s finished.”
Sensing Wang Ping’s subtle change, one of the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors sneered.
“It’s an inevitable development. In the presence of my master, his struggle is futile.”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor sneered.
“Even if he tries to escape, there’s no way out. From the beginning of the battle, all his retreat routes have been sealed. The future he sees is all deliberately guided by my master. At the moment he wants to truly escape, he will reveal a huge flaw.”
The third Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor spoke.
“Haha, by then, it will be the day we kill him and share his remains.”
Another Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor sneered, with killing intent and greed in his eyes-
If a Quasi-Fairy Emperor with a Perfect Chaotic Immortal Body was devoured, it would bring great benefits.
While the Four Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors secretly communicated, they released even more terrifying power, intending to grind Wang Ping to dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254 - 1254 317 Battle of Life and Death Heart of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1254: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_4 Chapter 1254: Chapter 317: Battle of Life and Death! Heart of Fearlessness_4 “Puchi!”
Facing the increasingly terrifying attacks of the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors, Wang Ping, who has a deficiency in his Tao Heart, couldn’t withstand it. His body exploded once again, suffering injuries, and the speed of recovery slowed down.
This, like starting a chain reaction, caused Wang Ping to be frightened, and the dark side of him expanded, with a strong urge to escape.
“Hehe, have you finally reached your limit?”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor sneered, murderous intent overflowing, as he began to burn his origin to brew a terrifying killing move.
In the future Wang Ping saw, he had killed this Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor.
This time, it was time for the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor to get his revenge.
Then, taking advantage of Wang Ping’s exhaustion from dealing with the other three Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors and the significant weakness he already had, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor made his move. The terrifying force of slaughter erupted, seeking to completely kill Wang Ping.
“Clang!”
“Zing!”
At this moment, two rays of extreme light appeared and blocked Wang Ping’s back.
That was the strong light emitted from the Devouring Immortal Bead and the Chaotic fairy clothes.
The two quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifacts seemed to try to bring back Wang Ping’s true heart, breaking free from Wang Ping’s control, joining forces to attack the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor and meet this supreme strike.
“Master, do not fear death, do not fear darkness! Only by fighting to the death can we find a way to survive!”
“Master, although our time together has been short, you will always be the owner I, the Devouring Immortal Bead, admire! A mere four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors are definitely not your match, master. I believe you will be able to suppress and kill them! But, I can no longer fight alongside you, master!”
Two distinct voices echoed in Wang Ping’s ears.
Then, the two quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifacts did not hesitate to self-destruct.
With the sudden self-destruction of the Chaotic fairy clothes and the Devouring Immortal Bead, the greatest attack planned by the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor was blocked.
This scene made Wang Ping’s eyes gradually widen, his fear in his heart faded, replaced by sorrow and anger.
Wang Ping had thought of those righteous words before the battle, thinking that the memories in his mind were real, and he was willing to fight for these people.
However, there was a difference between them. Although it could indeed make him firm his Tao Heart, it was not enough.
At the same time, no one really died.
But now, something that truly belonged to him had died, and the closest existence to him had died for his sake…
Wang Ping finally had a huge emotional fluctuation.
“Escaping? I clearly said I won’t run away anymore!”
Wang Ping clenched his fists and roared.
At this moment, Wang Ping finally reaffirmed his belief, wiping away the darkness and fear that surged in his heart. He risked his heavily injured body and attacked the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, trying to pull him down with him.
Even if he died, Wang Ping would kill the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, the one who forced the Chaotic Fairy Clothes and Devouring Immortal Bead to self-destruct.
Just as Wang Ping firmed his belief and, determined to die, attacked the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, aiming to drag him down, the effect of the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart was finally triggered.
With the activation of the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart effect, Wang Ping’s strength began to soar rapidly.
Although his injuries hadn’t healed yet, his strength was visibly rising at a breakneck speed.
At the same time, Wang Ping’s mind cleared, and he completely forgot about life and death, falling into a mysterious state.
Fearless, unafraid, ethereal.
Wang Ping’s change was seen by the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, making his face change dramatically as he yelled, “Not good! He has activated the effect of the Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart and is rapidly becoming stronger. This is a massive variable!”
“Don’t hold anything back anymore! Burn your origins and use your strongest power to erase him completely!”
The faces of the other three Dark semi-Immortal Emperors also darkened, as they never expected such a development. They all started to burn their origins, raising their own strength to the limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255 - 1255 318 Returning from the Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1255: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation Chapter 1255: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation As the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors raised their power to the extreme and launched terrifying attacks on Wang Ping, the entire Realm Sea was set off with monstrous waves, and countless worlds were affected and erased.
Even the River of Time was greatly affected, causing continuous turbulence in both its upper and lower reaches.
This also caught the attention of the Quasi-Fairy Emperors in the up and downstream of the River of Time.
Their gazes fixed on this astonishing battle, their hearts trembling, unable to calm down.
After all, whether it was the Four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors or Wang Ping, they were no longer merely quasi-fairy emperor-level beings. They were much more powerful than ordinary quasi-fairy emperors.
At this moment, all the quasi-fairy emperors in the upper and lower streams of the world sighed, thinking that Wang Ping was doomed to die.
Although Wang Ping’s power seemed to be increasing, this level of power was not enough to simultaneously face the strongest attacks of the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors.
Moreover, Wang Ping himself had already suffered serious injuries, making it even more impossible for him to withstand such terrifying attacks.
At this moment, a quasi-fairy emperor wanted to follow the River of Time to help Wang Ping fight against the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors.
However, before he could do anything, his body exploded.
Although he recovered, there was no doubt that he had suffered serious injuries.
“Such great cause and effect is not something I can bear.” This quasi-fairy emperor’s heart trembled as he murmured to himself.
The next instant, Wang Ping was struck by the strongest attack of the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors, and his body was completely shattered and turned into nothingness, gradually dissipating.
Only an eyeball filled with cracks remained, staring at the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors.
The gaze in this eyeball was still fearless, undaunted, and ethereal, as if it did not care about its imminent demise.
“Hmph, your talent has indeed made you unafraid of death, but it is meaningless. You should die, so you must die.”
One of the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperors sneered, grabbed Wang Ping’s eyeball directly, and mercilessly destroyed it without leaving any chance for Wang Ping to survive.
Although it was a pity that they couldn’t devour Wang Ping, they needed to completely exterminate him to prevent any Unexpected Changes from happening.
Seeing this, all the powerful beings sighed in their hearts, feeling that the great battle was about to come to a lonely end, and Wang Ping had been ruthlessly suppressed and killed by the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors.
The four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors also harbored the same idea, planning to return and report their actions.
With Wang Ping’s death, the variable was eliminated, and they only needed to wait for the arrival of darkness.
When the time came, their master would grant them unparalleled power, allowing them to aspire to reach the triple-digit level.
However, it was at this moment that an Unexpected Change occurred.
Endless Chaos Spirit suddenly engulfed the area, enveloping the whole Realm Sea, and a terrifying aura brewed within.
“Not good!”
Seeing this scene, the pupils of the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors contracted suddenly, and a bad feeling arose in their hearts.
Then, without any hesitation, they took action, eager to wipe out this chaotic energy completely.
“I am reborn in Chaos, the origin of all paths and the ancestor of all paths, capable of transforming everything.”
Heavenly chants rang out, shaking the hearts and minds of everyone present.
Simultaneously, the great Dao of this Mysterious Fantasy World resonated with this voice, giving rise to endless Splendor. Countless worlds and Realm Seas began to evolve into Chaos, and even Chaos Immortal Lotuses bloomed.
Then, a figure emerged from the Chaos Immortal Lotus.
With every step he took, a chaotic footprint would be left behind, which would then turn into a Chaos Lotus and evolve various things.
This scene caused the expressions of the four Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors to change drastically, revealing fearful faces.
At this moment, Wang Ping had no trace of power, but just this aura was enough to make them shudder.
This absolutely was not something a Quasi-Fairy Emperor could achieve.
“Could it be that he has achieved a new life in the midst of death and stepped into the realm of the Immortal Emperor?”
The only female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s voice trembled slightly.
“Impossible! Absolutely impossible! You and I both know that only one Immortal Emperor can be born in this world. Unless the Reincarnation Emperor falls completely, a second Immortal Emperor cannot appear!”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s expression changed as he shouted.
“Right! He is definitely not an Immortal Emperor. He has just been reborn, that’s all!”
“So what if he’s reborn!? If we could kill you once, we can kill you a second time!”
The expressions of the remaining two Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors turned gloomy, and they burst out with astonishing killing intent.
Then, they both joined forces and killed Wang Ping.
“An ant trying to shake a tree, overestimating itself.”
Wang Ping looked at the two calm-eye clearances, and calmly uttered these eight words.
“Arrogant!”
Seeing that Wang Ping merely spat out these eight words and still had no action, the two Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors were furious, unleashing their most powerful killing techniques.
Time and space were annihilated, and the Chaos Spirit was destroyed.
However, facing the powerful attacks of the two Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors, Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged, and he didn’t even have the intention to fight back. He simply took another step forward.
As he stepped forward, another Chaos Immortal Lotus bloomed gradually.
Then, the terrifying attack of the two Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors mysteriously vanished, as if they had never appeared before.
This caused the two Dark Semi-Immortal Emperors to stiffen up, their pupils contracted, and they experienced fear for the first time in a long while.
This feeling had only been experienced when they first met their master.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256 - 1256 318 Returning from the Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1256: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_2 Chapter 1256: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_2 “You!”
Both Dark Pseudo Immortal Emperors were terrified, wanting to escape from Wang Ping’s side.
But, it was already too late.
No one could see how Wang Ping took action, the bodies of both Dark Pseudo Immortal Emperors gradually scattered, turning into Chaos Spirit, and completely perishing.
“Hiss!”
Seeing this scene, the quasi-Fairy Emperors from the upper and lower reaches of the River of Time were all shocked to the extreme, feeling that the scene before them was somewhat eerie.
After all, these were two Dark Pseudo Immortal Emperors far surpassing ordinary quasi-Fairy Emperors, and they were simply wiped out in such a simple manner.
Is such a method still achievable by a quasi-Fairy Emperor?
Is the mysterious powerhouse in front of them really not an Immortal Emperor?
At this moment, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor and the Female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor also fell silent, with shadows of death emerging in their hearts. After many years, they finally felt the breath of death again.
“Killing us would be pointless,” the Female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor said hoarsely, “As long as our master is alive, we will resurrect. And you, will also be completely wiped out by our master.”
“I am the Chaos Emperor, born from Chaos, undefeated in Chaos, able to transform all enemies in the world.”
Wang Ping calmly looked at the Female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor and lightly spoke these words.
As the words fell, the Female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s body began to disintegrate, turning into Chaos Spirit.
Before dying, the Female Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor stared at Wang Ping in a daze, looking at his invincible aura, reminiscing about the past, and finally sighing quietly, ultimately turning into Chaos.
“Hahaha, this time, you have won. But, we will meet again.”
The Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor laughed hideously, intending to self-destruct.
However, just as he intended to self-destruct, Wang Ping appeared before him, placing a palm on his face.
At this moment, Wang Ping’s expression was no longer as calm as before, but rather emotionless and cold.
This made the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s expression stiffen, as he found his power being neutralized, unable to self-destruct or move his own body.
“Dying won’t be so easy for you.”
Wang Ping coldly uttered these words, directly using the Chaos Tao Skill.
In an instant, the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor’s Physical Body was subjected to restrictions, forced to kneel, while his soul was wrapped by a mass of Chaos Spirit, mercilessly crushed, and then mercilessly reassembled.
Death, unable to die.
Life, unable to live.
Endless imprisonment and torture awaited the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor.
Then, Wang Ping casually threw the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor into the center of the Realm Sea, allowing countless Living Beings of various worlds, regardless of their cultivation, to miraculously see the figure of the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor and understand the sins he had committed.
After dealing with the Blood Quasi-Immortal Emperor, Wang Ping clasped his hands together, and the Chaos Spirit pervading the Realm Sea began to surge.
The destroyed worlds reassembled within the Chaos.
The destroyed Living Beings were reborn within the Chaos.
Everything returned to its original state.
After Wang Ping completed all these tasks, Mysterious Fantasy World finally restored peace and tranquility.
The only remaining hidden danger was the strange main body dragged into the cycle by the Reincarnation Emperor.
Wang Ping’s eyes were deep, enveloped in chaos, as if seeing the scene in the cycle, which involuntarily squinted his eyes.
However, Wang Ping did not say much, but simply took a step forward and disappeared into the Realm Sea.
After Wang Ping left, the Living Beings of Mysterious Fantasy World began to sing praises of Wang Ping, involuntarily kneeling and worshiping him as the Chaos Emperor.
Heavenly Emperor, equal to Heavenly Tao.
…
Life and Death Realm, Reincarnation Road, Wang Ping arrived here.
The Bridge Guard seemed to have been waiting for Wang Ping, sitting at a stone table, toasting to Wang Ping and laughing, “Congratulations, fellow Daoist, for taking that step and getting a new life. Fellow Daoist becoming an Immortal Emperor is just around the corner.”
“It’s just luck.”
Wang Ping raised his wine cup, looked at the Immortal Brew before him, and after draining it in one gulp, he shook his head.
He successfully triggered the effect of Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart, becoming fearless, unafraid, and ethereal.
However, this was not enough, and he was still killed.
But, Four-Digit Talent-Fearless Heart, indeed surpasses talent level and can compete with Three-digit Talent. Its improvement is not only in battle power, but also in comprehending Tao Skill.
The ethereal state enhanced his perception of Tao Skill to the utmost.
As a result, at the moment before his death, he successfully comprehended the Chaos Tao, the Chaos Immortal Emperor Sutra, becoming an existence on par with Immortal Emperors.
The Chaos Immortal Emperor Sutra can transform all laws and all things into Chaos, and can also allow him to return from Chaos.
After he returned from Chaos, the Chaos Immortal Body was truly perfected.
Before the simulation, Ye Cang’s quasi-Fairy Emperor offered him a sacrifice, reaching only a pseudo-perfect realm, not a true perfect realm.
However, this was normal; Ye Cang was only a Perfect Chaos Body, and although he was a quasi-Fairy Emperor, it was still impossible for him to make the Chaos Immortal Body, which is extremely powerful even in the three-digit talent and physique category, perfect.
Therefore, after he broke through and returned from Chaos, after obtaining a new life from Chaos, the Chaos Immortal Body reached the true Perfect Domain.
That’s why he was so powerful.
The four Pseudo Immortal Emperors, who were enhanced by the darkness and burned their origins, were as weak as ants in front of him; he didn’t even need to make a deliberate move and could extinguish them casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257 - 1257 318 Returning from the Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1257: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_3 Chapter 1257: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_3 Although he wasn’t an Immortal Emperor, nor did he possess Immortal Emperor’s Tao Fruit, his physique, Divine Soul, and Mana had reached a realm close to that of an Immortal Emperor. At the same time, he had already attained fighting abilities on par with an Immortal Emperor.
“Fellow Taoist, you intentionally released a portion of your strange power and interfered with the future I saw, didn’t you?”
Wang Ping looked at the Bridge Guard in front of him and spoke again.
When Wang Ping first arrived, he already knew that the Bridge Guard in front of him was no longer the Bridge Guard but the will of the Reincarnation Emperor.
That’s why the Bridge Guard dared to address him, who was already on par with an Immortal Emperor, as a fellow Taoist.
Otherwise, a quasi-Fairy Emperor would never dare to call someone on the level of an Immortal Emperor a fellow Taoist.
The term “fellow Taoist” is used only when both parties share similar status and realms, except in cases where the relationship between the two is particularly deep.
“You could say that.”
The Bridge Guard, more accurately the will of the Reincarnation Emperor, nodded his head in acknowledgment.
“However, there are things that you should be able to see now.” The Reincarnation Emperor sighed and said, “This strange phenomenon is very strong, and it continues to grow stronger. It’s difficult for me to suppress it within the cycle of reincarnation.”
“So, you need help, and you hope that I can break through and become an existence on par with the Immortal Emperor, helping you slay this strange phenomenon together?”
Wang Ping nodded slightly and said.
“Yes, and no.” The Reincarnation Emperor nodded his head and shook it again, his gaze profound as he spoke, “What I have done is both my own will and the will of that person.”
“That person…” Wang Ping paused for a moment before slowly saying, “My predecessor, the one from Chenwang Palace?”
Wang Ping could somewhat guess, but he never expected that person to be involved with the Reincarnation Emperor’s will as well, interfering with it.
“Yes.” The Reincarnation Emperor nodded, staring at Wang Ping and slowly continuing, “That’s why you had no choice but to move forward and defeat your enemies from the beginning.”
“You’ve given me many hints in the Life Simulation. I should have figured this out sooner. However, I was still too naive and couldn’t comprehend this under the intense battles.”
Wang Ping said softly.
“Fortunately, my two partners helped me. Otherwise, even if my luck was good, I would have died.”
As he spoke, Wang Ping called out two items.
These two items were none other than the Chaotic Fairy Clothes and the Devouring Immortal Bead.
The Chaotic Fairy Clothes and Devouring Immortal Bead were also reborn from Chaos.
However, unlike Wang Ping who couldn’t become an Immortal Emperor due to the constraints of this world, the Chaotic Fairy Clothes and Devouring Immortal Bead didn’t have this restriction, and after awakening from Chaos, they were on the verge of advancing to Immortal Emperor Artifacts.
Still, this process would take some time.
“Having experienced too little is also a good thing.”
The Reincarnation Emperor looked at Wang Ping’s Chaotic Fairy Clothes and Devouring Immortal Bead and sighed.
“Indeed, it is a good thing.”
Wang Ping stared at the will of the Reincarnation Emperor, his eyes already looking through the River of Time to see the past of the Reincarnation Emperor.
The Reincarnation Emperor wasn’t as lucky as him.
In his era, the mysterious phenomenon appeared, and he struggled against it, the process was extremely tragic.
In the end, his Tao Companion, fellow Taoists, children, all his followers, and countless Living Beings from numerous Immortal Realms chose to sacrifice themselves using a special item. Only a newborn daughter wasn’t sacrificed.
As a result, relying on the power of their sacrifices, he finally broke through the bottleneck with great difficulty and became the first and only Immortal Emperor of that time.
After achieving the Immortal Emperor level, the Reincarnation Emperor used his power of reincarnation to drag the mysterious phenomenon into an endless cycle of reincarnation, curbing its influence on the Mysterious Fantasy World and embarking on a long battle against it.
This was the past of the Reincarnation Emperor.
Theoretically, the Reincarnation Emperor, as an Immortal Emperor who practiced the Dao of Reincarnation, should have been able to easily revive the sacrifices.
However, he couldn’t do it in reality.
Because all his power was used to suppress the mysterious phenomenon, he couldn’t spare any effort to do anything else.
At the same time, the special item used for the sacrifices had severe restrictions, even an Immortal Emperor couldn’t revive the sacrifices.
As for the experience of the Reincarnation Emperor’s only surviving daughter, Wang Ping had long known, she died in the Heaven Tower.
That’s why the Reincarnation Emperor sighed that experiencing less is also a good thing because Wang Ping hadn’t experienced enough hardships in the real world, having few Tao companions, Tao friends, offspring or followers, and thus, he only had to suffer from the destruction of two quasi-Fairy Emperor Artifacts triggering his demise.
If he were like the Reincarnation Emperor, that would be truly tragic.
“You obey that person’s command in order to revive those who made sacrifices and your daughter?”
Wang Ping stared at the Reincarnation Emperor and sighed.
Those who had reached the triple-digit rank were undoubtedly at the peak of Myriad Heavens Paradise and even the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
However, only those with special experiences could become triple-digit beings, and they basically possessed a sense of pride in themselves, never easily submitting to a double-digit person and obeying their commands.
Those who did were driven by their own special goals.
“I can’t revive them. But if I were a double-digit figure, it would be another story.”
The Reincarnation Emperor’s expression was complicated, and he sighed.
“As for my most cherished little daughter, she chose to venture into the Heaven Tower and the Abyss mode despite my repeated advice, to help me suppress the mysterious phenomenon and find a way to revive those people.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1258 - 1258 318 Returning from the Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1258: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_4 Chapter 1258: Chapter 318: Returning from the Chaos! Reincarnation Emperor and the First Generation_4 “However, it’s not so easy to break through the abyss mode of Heaven Tower. She eventually died in there and couldn’t be resurrected.”
By the end, Reincarnation Emperor had a bitter smile on his face and seemed utterly disheartened.
He was the first Immortal Emperor, unparalleled in the world, but he was helpless. He couldn’t resurrect those people, he couldn’t stop his own little daughter, and he couldn’t resurrect her either.
“Even the two-digit ones can’t resurrect your little girl.”
Wang Ping sighed and spoke.
“Indeed, they can’t. No one can resurrect those who die in Heaven Tower. Unless someone reaches the top of the tower, becoming a single-digit existence, an eternal and omniscient omnipotent being.”
Reincarnation Emperor nodded and said gravely.
“However, it’s impossible to become such a being.”
“It is indeed difficult. After all, even the two-digit ones died on the eighty-ninth floor. Reaching the top is wishful thinking.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he murmured.
“No, the two-digit ones falling on the eighty-ninth floor is a rumor.”
Reincarnation Emperor’s eyes were deep as he shook his head and rejected Wang Ping’s statement.
“What?”
Wang Ping was stunned, somewhat astonished.
“Wait a minute…”
Soon, Wang Ping responded.
The information he knew was from Alpha.
At the peak, Alpha was a four-digit existence at most. Before crossing, he had become an insignificant six-digit existence.
Such an existence, the information he got, was most likely hearsay.
However, the true information about the two-digit figures wouldn’t easily appear in public view.
Besides, Alpha only mentioned that some two-digit figures died in Heaven Tower, without specifying who they were.
“So if the two-digit figures didn’t die, then the public records of breaking through Heaven Tower are wrong?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, asking a question.
“It was indeed the eighty-ninth floor before. However, the current record is the ninetieth floor. There is an important reason for saying that no one can reach the top of the hundredth floor.”
Reincarnation Emperor shook his head slightly and said.
“What do you mean?”
Wang Ping slightly frowned, asking curiously.
“As you know, enough people are needed to start the Heaven Tower challenge. The mechanism of Heaven Tower is strange. The first 29 tiers usually require teams of more than five players.”
“From the thirtieth to the fifty-ninth floor, a minimum of four people are needed. From the sixtieth to the eighty-ninth floor, at least three people are required.”
“But on the ninetieth floor, the situation is different… It requires not only the presence of two-digit beings but also three players who have achieved SSS-tier Abyss Evaluation on all floors.”
“In other words, there aren’t enough players to start the game on the ninetieth floor. Because even in Myriad Heavens Paradise, there is no other player besides that one who has achieved this.”
Reincarnation Emperor slowly spoke, his eyes filled with admiration and regret for that existence.
“…”
Listening to Reincarnation Emperor’s words, all the threads in Wang Ping’s mind connected, and he finally understood why the senior from the First Generation Transcender Chat Group had set him up and trained him.
At the same time, he finally realized why his difficulty selection in Heaven Tower could only be Abyss mode.
Because that senior from the First Generation Chat Group was training teammates for himself in the Heaven Tower Game.
His ambition was great, clearly aiming to reach the top of the tower and become a single-digit omnipresent eternal being.
And Wang Ping was presumably one of the most suitable players chosen.
Because his talent was naturally suited for tower climbing.
However, such an existence couldn’t focus all efforts on one front.
It meant that besides him, there might be many others trained as pawns in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
It’s just that those pawns probably didn’t meet his requirements and died during the growth process.
Like Wang Ping, if he hadn’t survived this ordeal, he would have died too.

chapters.title: Chapter 1259 - 1259 319 Wang Pings Fame Spreads across the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1259: Chapter 319: Wang Ping’s Fame Spreads across the Amusement Park! Difference in Two-Digit Numbers! (A 10,000-word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!) Chapter 1259: Chapter 319: Wang Ping’s Fame Spreads across the Amusement Park! Difference in Two-Digit Numbers! (A 10,000-word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!) However, Wang Ping was well aware that although he had passed this test, there were still many troubles ahead.
If the purpose of that person from the first generation chat group was to reach the top of Heaven Tower and cultivate players who could break through to the ninetieth floor and achieve an SSS tier evaluation throughout, then the trouble Wang Ping would face next would be to give his all in the Heaven Tower and try to get the highest evaluation.
It’s not that a single floor needs to reach the SSS tier evaluation, but that all floors must achieve the SSS tier evaluation.
If he fails to achieve the SSS tier evaluation in any floor, he will still be judged as an unqualified chess piece.
By then, what fate awaits him would be hard to predict.
Perhaps, considering his high-end combat skills, he would be taken in by Chenwang Palace and become a higher-up.
Or maybe, they would find him too useless and dispose of him directly.
In other words, for his safety, Wang Ping had no choice but to do his best in climbing the tower; there was no other option.
“Fellow taoist, do you need me to take action against the anomaly?”
Wang Ping reined in his thoughts and looked at the Reincarnation Emperor, inquiring.
“Your actions will not be able to kill it. Only a two-digit existence can completely kill this anomaly. Of course, if you can obtain a special three-digit top-grade tool in the Heaven Tower, perhaps you can erase it.”
The Reincarnation Emperor shook his head.
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
It seemed that this anomaly was more tricky than he had imagined.
“Next, you should go to the Myriad Heavens Paradise. This Profound Fantasy World has nothing left to enhance your strength.”
The Reincarnation Emperor sighed.
“Unless I fall, you can only become an Immortal Emperor by going to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.”
“I understand.” Wang Ping nodded and said, “However, before leaving, there are some things I need to do. I keep my promises, and what I promise, I will fulfill.”
“Good.” The Reincarnation Emperor nodded.
Then, Wang Ping didn’t continue chatting with the Reincarnation Emperor and left directly.
He returned to Taiyi Imperial Palace, taking the Taiyi Imperial Palace and those who had been associated with him to ascend together to the Immortal Domain.
At this moment, the Immortal Domain had already been restored by Wang Ping’s Taoist restoration. It was no longer broken and had returned to its peak state.
At the same time, living beings like the Black Abyss Demon Lord, who had been swindled by him, were also resurrected.
This also included the Chaos Demon King.
In the life simulation, the simulated Wang Ping maliciously turned the Chaos Demon King into a pig demon through reincarnation.
However, Wang Ping was now the Chaos Emperor, his mind full of grandeur, and he was no longer interested in doing such boring things.
But, there was one person who Wang Ping did not resurrect in a same manner.
This person was Ye Cang and his life-bound sword.
Ye Cang sacrificed himself to Wang Ping, and his life-bound sword became the fuel to start Wang Ping’s Life Simulator.
Under such circumstances, it would take a certain cost to resurrect him.
However, Wang Ping didn’t care anymore.
“Ye Cang, I’ve seen the Heavenly Emperor. Thank you for resurrecting me.”
After Ye Cang was resurrected, he looked at Wang Ping and smiled humbly, cupping his hands and saying.
“You’re welcome. It’s what you deserve.” Wang Ping nodded slightly and replied.
“I always feel like I’m on the path between death and resurrection.”
Ye Cang laughed and joked about himself, looking quite open-minded.
“Your death count is indeed unique.”
Wang Ping also laughed and teased.
Wang Ping had also seen Ye Cang’s past.
Ye Cang was born with a Chaotic Body, and his process of growing from a humble farmer to the strongest in the Immortal Domain was extremely difficult. He had indeed died several times.
However, he also had great luck and opportunities, having obtained some resurrection items or peculiar treasures from the myriad heavens. So, he came back to life.
Then there was the time when he was killed by the first generation and resurrected, sacrificed himself voluntarily because of him, and now he was resurrected again.
“I’m going to the Myriad Heavens Paradise; want to come with me?”
Wang Ping extended an invitation without any air of a Heavenly Emperor.
“I’ll pass. Going there means I have to enter the tower, and the mortality rate is too high.”
Ye Cang hurriedly waved his hand, feigning fear.
“If possible, I just want to stay in this world as a leisurely quasi-Fairy Emperor. As for the Peak of the Great Tao and two-digit number, I have no more desire for it.”
After a pause, Ye Cang said casually.
“That’s nice too.” Wang Ping nodded, not feeling like there was anything wrong with Ye Cang’s laid-back attitude.
After all, how many people in these myriad heavens and thousands of realms could have such great achievements as him and lay back like he did?
“It is nice. But the biggest threat has not been eliminated yet. Only that person can get rid of the anomaly. If the anomaly is not eliminated, I won’t be able to truly relax.”
Ye Cang shook his head and said.
“Don’t worry, since the Reincarnation Emperor and that person have an agreement, nothing will go wrong. Besides, I’m here too.”
Wang Ping patted Ye Cang’s shoulder and spoke lightly.
“The Heavenly Emperor is mighty. In the future, you will definitely be able to reach the two-digit number and surpass that person. At that time, I hope you can help me beat him up.”
Ye Cang grinned.
“You’re really fearless, daring to speak like that.” Wang Ping looked at Ye Cang, who was now praising and flattering him in a somewhat discordant manner, and laughed.
“What’s there to be afraid of? I’ve already died so many times anyway. Besides, that person is no longer interested in caring about someone insignificant like me.”
Ye Cang spoke calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1260 - 1260 319 Wang Ping becomes famous in Paradise

﻿Chapter 1260: Chapter 319: Wang Ping becomes famous in Paradise! There is a gap in two-digit numbers! (10,000-word chapter asking for monthly tickets!)_2 Chapter 1260: Chapter 319: Wang Ping becomes famous in Paradise! There is a gap in two-digit numbers! (10,000-word chapter asking for monthly tickets!)_2 “Hehe.” Wang Ping laughed and didn’t deny it.
Indeed, if that person were so petty, they wouldn’t have achieved so much.
“Let’s talk later; I have to go.”
Immediately after saying that, Wang Ping’s figure disappeared, leaving Ye Cang somewhat dazed.
…
Purple Spirit Realm, Wang Ping returned to this lower plane after a long absence.
He traveled the world, visited many places, and left some land of inheritance out of interest.
At last, Wang Ping returned to where he first crossed over.
He looked at the hibernating Profound Turtle with great interest and tapped on its skull, waking it from its slumber.
“Who is it?! Who dares to disturb this turtle’s hibernation?”
The Profound Turtle was furious and wanted to lash out.
However, when it saw Wang Ping’s face, its body trembled, and it was genuinely frightened.
“Y-You… How did you come back?”
The Profound Turtle cautiously asked.
The person in front of him was unfathomable and absurdly powerful.
Although only about ten years had passed since Wang Ping left, in the Profound Turtle’s opinion, Wang Ping had become so powerful that even gods had to respect him.
“Just came back to take a look.” Wang Ping smiled warmly. “And to grant you a bit of Immortal Fate.”
“Immortal Fate?” The Profound Turtle was stunned.
It had never heard of “immortal” before.
Without giving the Profound Turtle time to think, Wang Ping pointed a finger, putting it into a deep sleep, and the terrifying Immortal Rhyme began transforming its body.
Wang Ping then climbed onto the Profound Turtle’s back and saw the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger, which he had initially taken as a mount out of interest.
“Master, you’re back!”
When the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger saw Wang Ping, it showed a delighted expression and excitedly ran over.
Wang Ping was also interested, and he appeared on the back of the Demon Tiger with a flash, patting its tiger head and said, “Let’s go, take me for a spin.”
“Yes, Master! Please hold on.”
The Fire-patterned Demon Tiger nodded and excitedly ran through the sky.
Before long, Wang Ping stretched lazily and granted the Fire-patterned Demon Tiger some Immortal Fate as well.
Next, Wang Ping arrived at Chi Village without anyone noticing his arrival.
Wang Ping looked at the laughing and playing villagers of Chi Village and chuckled lightly, “The secluded life of Chi Village these years isn’t bad.”
After the Bloodline Curse of Chi Village disappeared, their talents slowly manifested, producing many geniuses.
However, the villagers of Chi Village still showed no intention of leaving the forest, living a secluded life with the resources Wang Ping had given them when he descended to the mortal world.
As for Chifeng, since he had been taken to the Upper Realm by Wang Ping long ago, he naturally went to the Immortal Domain with him.
Chifeng’s parents were also resurrected by Wang Ping, fulfilling Chifeng’s dream.
After all, Chifeng initially aimed to reach the pinnacle in order to resurrect his parents, as Wang Ping had promised when painting a grand picture at that time.
“Time to go.”
After leaving some inheritance in Chi Village again, Wang Ping took out his Paradise Pass and left for the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
…
“Wang Ping, congratulations on becoming a four-digit exceptional.”
After Wang Ping returned, Alpha’s voice rang out.
At this moment, Alpha was very uneasy.
After all, Wang Ping’s actions were truly frightening.
Although she had always known that Wang Ping’s potential was extreme, it was outrageous for him to grow from a mortal to a figure on par with three-digit powers in just over a decade.
“It was just luck.” Wang Ping smiled.
“Seems like I came back at the right time.”
Suddenly, Wang Ping narrowed his eyes, glanced at an image in the corner, and said.
“What do you mean?”
Alpha was startled.
“During the process of killing Dao Yi, I used a lot of special items given by others. Now, those people’s elders are coming.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke calmly.
“(⊙o⊙)…”
Alpha was stunned.
Then, as if guessing something, her face changed.
What “gifts”? Wang Ping clearly killed those players and considered the items on their bodies as Spoils of War.
Now, the relatives were coming for revenge.
“There’s no need to panic. Although my identity might have been exposed, they still can’t do anything to me. I’m no longer a weakling that others can toy with.” Wang Ping noticed Alpha’s fear and spoke calmly.
Three-digit powers couldn’t casually enter the lower levels of Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Wang Ping, as a rare four-digit exceptional, was able to fight against three-digit powers.
That meant that even if those big shots descended to the mortal world in an incarnation, Wang Ping wouldn’t be afraid of them.
Moreover, since those people had lived for so many years, they wouldn’t easily fight against someone as potentially limitless as Wang Ping over a junior.
Unless they had a special item that could easily kill him, they would do that.
But a junior’s life was not that valuable.
Lastly, since Wang Ping was an essential chess piece of the First Generation Chat Group, that person wouldn’t just sit back and let this group of powers wipe him out.
So, Wang Ping wasn’t as apprehensive as he used to be anymore.
Now, Wang Ping had the capital to dominate in Myriad Heavens Paradise. He was no longer a pathetic weakling.
“You’re right…” Wang Ping’s words left Alpha in a daze, and when she came to her senses, she calmed down and said with mixed emotions, “Your strength now is indeed beyond the reach of three-digit powers. It’s just that we’ve been so miserable in the past that this is just a stress response.”
