chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1261: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Becomes Famous in Paradise! Even Two Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000 Words Chapter, Seeking Monthly Ticket!)_3 Chapter 1261: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Becomes Famous in Paradise! Even Two Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000 Words Chapter, Seeking Monthly Ticket!)_3 “Understandable.” Wang Ping nodded sympathetically at Alpha.
Then, with a single step, he ascended into the sky, quietly waiting for the enemy to come to him.
Not long after, ripples of space emerged, and a series of figures appeared before Wang Ping.
Each of these individuals had a special tattoo somewhere on their bodies, identical to the one previously possessed by the chubby gamer.
Clearly, these people were from the Food Divine Hall, a power with three-digit skills.
Besides them, more ripples in space appeared.
Then, the people from Falling Stars Pavilion also appeared before Wang Ping.
Upon their arrival, these two groups of powers initially wanted to condemn Wang Ping and make him admit his guilt.
However, when they discovered they couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s true strength, their planned words of reproach were swallowed back down.
After all, to make Wang Ping confess and to gain his ownership, they had brought with them Demon Kings of the legendary four-digit level.
But now, when even the legendary four-digit Demon Kings couldn’t see through Wang Ping’s strength, the situation seemed too unusual.
Moreover, Wang Ping obviously knew they would come beforehand and had arrived early to wait here. This behavior, too, was highly suspicious.
For a moment, their momentum weakened, and they found themselves in a dilemma.
“Heaven Derivative, you killed my Young Palace Master in the Sky Tower Game. Do you admit your crime!?”
Despite their surprise, the people of Falling Stars Pavilion still spoke up, condemning Wang Ping.
They didn’t believe Wang Ping could have grown from a mere five-digit entity to the limit of four digits in just a few months.
If Wang Ping, being Heaven Derivative, had received an SSS tier evaluation three times, then it wouldn’t have been surprising if he had obtained a special item that could conceal his identity and see a glimpse of the future.
“The Sky Tower Game is fair competition, there is no such thing as ‘someone killed someone.’ If she died, it is because she was too weak. There is no reason to say that I killed her.”
Wang Ping stared at the people of Falling Stars Pavilion, smirking.
“Could it be that only the people of Falling Stars Pavilion are allowed to kill others, but no one is allowed to kill your people? Besides, how do you know that I killed her and it wasn’t simply that she couldn’t pass the game and died in it?”
“Hmph, right or wrong, I only know that you are Heaven Derivative, you were in the game with our young palace master, you killed her, and you obtained the special item of Falling Stars Pavilion. This alone is enough to convict you.”
One of the four-digit legendary powers of Falling Stars Pavilion coldly snorted, his murderous intent obvious, with no intention of reasoning with Wang Ping.
On the side, the people of Food Divine Hall chose to observe silently.
After identifying Wang Ping as Heaven Derivative through their item, they investigated many things. They became aware of Wang Ping’s use of a Starburst Pearl in a certain universe.
Besides that, the young Palace Master of Falling Stars Pavilion recently died in the Second Level Game of Tower of Heaven.
With these pieces of information combined, they were aware that Wang Ping had likely killed the young Palace Master of Falling Stars Pavilion.
This time, they invited Falling Stars Pavilion to try and probe Wang Ping’s true strength.
Although the people of Falling Stars Pavilion weren’t fools, compared to Food Divine Hall which only lost a four-digit limit descendant, Falling Stars Pavilion lost their young Palace Master, the daughter of the three-digit strongman, Star God.
That is to say, the resentment of Falling Stars Pavilion was much larger than theirs. Even if they knew Food Divine Hall might be using them, they would not easily let go.
“Such a strong claim of guilt. If you wish to sentence me, you have to see if you have the ability to do so. If Star God himself came, I might be wary of him. But you,” Wang Ping said indifferently, “are hardly qualified.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently, with no intention of further arguing with Falling Stars Pavilion.
After all, whether in the Profound World before or in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, strength speaks louder than words.
Without enough strength, no one will listen to your reasoning.
“Dare to mention the name of Star God directly, the crime is aggravated.”
The people of Falling Stars Pavilion, hearing Wang Ping’s arrogant words, showed an even darker expression.
Then, the four-digit legendary level Demon King of Falling Stars Pavilion stepped forward and directly invoked his Demon King authority in an attempt to pull Wang Ping into the game.
In an instant, black Parchment Scrolls began to fall from the sky.
The game of the Demon King had begun.
This time, it was different from Dao Yi’s time.
Dao Yi’s time was somewhat concealed, but this time, there was no concealment whatsoever.
The residents of the city were all terrified, looking at the sky and the falling black Parchment Scrolls, knowing that the game of the Demon King had begun.
Everybody immediately began to run away, fearing they would be involved in the game of the Demon King.
After all, the Demon King was a special being, and very few Demon Kings of the four-digit level or lower would act so recklessly.
Facing such a terrifying existence, they needed to get as far away as possible. The more they could distance themselves from the commotion, the better.
Otherwise, if they were targeted by a four-digit Demon King, it would truly be a disaster.
Just as the city’s residents were fleeing in panic, the space where Wang Ping was located underwent marvelous changes.
Endless stars emerged, forming a strange Star Labyrinth.
Apparently, this was the exclusive game of the Falling Stars Pavilion Demon King. Once the game started, the environment changed.
Wang Ping was not at all surprised by this change. He casually glanced at the content on the black Parchment Scroll.
The Demon King’s game was simple. Participants had to escape from the Star Labyrinth within a predetermined amount of time.

﻿Chapter 1262: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Gains Fame in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!)_4 Chapter 1262: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Gains Fame in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!)_4 In each star, there might be a trap or useful information.
During the participants’ journey through the Star Labyrinth, the Demon King and his subordinates are able to attack them.
Similarly, the participants can seize the opportunity to counterattack the Demon King; if they manage to kill him, the game would come to an end immediately.
“The exclusive game of Falling Stars Palace, the Star Domain Labyrinth? If it were the Star God himself, that would be a bit troublesome.”
Wang Ping said indifferently.
Currently, Wang Ping could be considered a four-digit exceptional, capable of battling with three-digit opponents.
However, his talent still remained at the four-digit level; it would be easy for the Star God, a three-digit existence, to interfere with his life simulation just like the Reincarnation Emperor did.
Although it could be said that he would notice this interference, it would eventually waste his life simulation.
That is to say, if he wanted to break this game, he would have to outsmart and overpower the Star God, which would be extremely troublesome.
Unfortunately, this game was not personally directed by the Star God; it was just a weak Demon King who happened to be a four-digit legend.
While a four-digit legend’s Demon King was considered quite a big shot in Myriad Heavens Paradise, it was simply too weak for the current Wang Ping.
“Hmph, keep talking tough. Even those with the four-digit limit can’t claim they can win easily in my game, let alone someone like you.”
The voice of the Falling Stars Pavilion Demon King came, extremely annoyed by Wang Ping’s arrogant expression and tone.
Wang Ping didn’t bother saying anything more to the Falling Stars Pavilion Demon King and just casually glanced somewhere in the Star Domain Labyrinth.
Instantly, the dangerous Star Domain Labyrinth exploded, and the Demon King and his subordinates were all torn apart, dying on the spot.
In the face of absolute power, all games are worthless.
Although Myriad Heavens Paradise tested one’s wisdom, when power reached a certain level, most games were trivial; only special games like Sky Tower Game could truly intimidate the strongest.
“Hiss!”
Seeing the Falling Stars Palace members die instantly, the people from Food Divine Hall couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air, feeling their scalps tingle.
At this moment, they felt a chill run down their spines as an incredible guess formed in their hearts.
That is, the Heaven Derivative before them wasn’t a five-digit at all; he wasn’t even a four-digit limit powerhouse they’d previously guessed. He was the legendary four-digit exceptional.
A four-digit exceptional could contend with a three-digit.
In other words, he was a powerful figure standing at the peak of Myriad Heavens Paradise, capable of interacting with their Food Divine Palace Big Shot at the same level.
Subsequently, the people from Food Divine Hall remembered Wang Ping’s fight with Dao Yi, and a feeling of utter frustration filled their hearts.
For a four-digit exceptional to deal with a five-digit limit insect like that, it was simply too much effort to bother with destroying a universe, let alone using a low-level tool like a Starburst Pearl. They were too cautious.
Or was it that Wang Ping was scheming something and just waiting for the fish to take the bait?
After all, the thoughts of such old monsters were usually very deep; no one could know what they were plotting.
For a moment, the people from Food Divine Hall felt incredibly fortunate that they hadn’t chosen to speak up earlier.
Otherwise, they would have definitely been wiped out instantly, and even the four-digit limit Food Divine Palace Big Shot behind them wouldn’t have been able to save them.
Even the Food God himself wouldn’t say anything about it.
After all, daring to provoke a four-digit exceptional and challenge their authority was simply an act of extreme stupidity; even if Wang Ping destroyed them, no one could say anything about it.
To put it bluntly, if they were still alive and returned home, both they and the powerful figure behind them would face Food Divine Hall’s punishment.
Because a four-digit exceptional was far more dangerous than an ordinary three-digit.
Such existences had terrifying growth potential; once they became a three-digit, they would quickly become one of the elite among the three-digit, and they were absolutely not to be trifled with.
“My lord… we once had some friendship with Lord Alpha. Today, we came here to congratulate you on the birth of some powerful individuals in your forces.”
For a moment, the strong people from Food Divine Hall looked at Wang Ping with trepidation and forced a smile, quickly finding an excuse and presenting a pile of delicious food.
Wang Ping looked at the people from Food Divine Hall without saying much. He calmly crushed their Spirit Grids as punishment, and then slapped them away with a casual gesture.
An emperor couldn’t be humiliated, especially by a group of weak four-digit individuals daring to plot against him; even Food God wouldn’t say anything about it if Wang Ping destroyed them.
However, these fat people behind him had some awareness, so he wasn’t interested in bothering with such weaklings.
Anyway, once this group returned home, both they and the people behind them would face punishment.
Next, Wang Ping’s figure flashed, and he returned to the villa, naturally taking the red tea Alpha had brewed for him and leisurely sipping it.
As for the matter of the Sky Tower Game in three days, Wang Ping wasn’t in a hurry anymore.
Things were different now; he no longer needed to worry about any powerful enemies targeting him, and he didn’t have to be in a rush when doing things.
…..
While Wang Ping was enjoying his leisure time, news of the Demon King’s arrival and quick defeat spread rapidly, putting the Third Generation Chat Group at the center of attention.
However, compared to the shock in the lower realms, the reactions of the major powers were even greater.
That’s because they knew more, learning that Wang Ping was Heaven Derivative and had now become a four-digit exceptional.

﻿Chapter 1263: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Becomes Famous in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter, Seeking Monthly Votes!)_5 Chapter 1263: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Becomes Famous in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter, Seeking Monthly Votes!)_5 For a moment, many forces sighed in their hearts, feeling intrigued by the chat group’s influence.
The First Generation Chat Group gave birth to the most dazzling two-digit force in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
The Third Generation Chat Group quickly birthed a four-digit exceptional.
However, in their astonishment, these big shots were all guessing the relationship between Wang Ping and the mysterious individual.
Otherwise, even with Wang Ping’s heaven-defying talent, it would be impossible for him to become a four-digit exceptional in such a short time.
“He really has amazing courage. He chooses to nurture two two-digit forces in order to challenge the tower,”
A two-digit being opened its eyes, gazing at Heaven Tower and sighed softly.
Although there was the obstruction from the mysterious figure, everyone was a two-digit force, and they could deduce his many calculations with the premise of so much information.
It could be said that they didn’t even need to use any effort to deduce, just casually speculating, and they could understand his intentions.
Because he simply did not intend to conceal his ideas, nor did he disdain to conceal them.
Most of the two-digit forces had teamed up with him to challenge the tower.
His goal had always been pure – to reach the top of Heaven Tower. Since no one was qualified to challenge the tower with him now, he chose to nurture two two-digit forces that could achieve an SSS tier evaluation throughout.
This was also the reason why Heaven Derivative Association consistently chose Abyss mode. It was because that mysterious figure had manipulated something.
“No one can nurture a two-digit force, as for achieving an SSS tier evaluation on all floors… since the birth of Heaven Tower, only he has appeared, and I don’t think he will succeed,”
Another two-digit being spoke; they were having a conversation.
“That figure is stunningly brilliant; no one knows if he will succeed. But even if he fails, just this courage alone is something we cannot compare with,”
The previous two-digit being shook its head and sighed.
This made the other two-digits slightly silent.
There were gaps between two-digits and other two-digits.
They were two-digits because they could only be two-digits.
That being was a two-digit because that was the pinnacle realm.
After all, the one-digit had never appeared, so no one knew if it truly existed.
At the same time, it was unknown whether reaching the top of Heaven Tower could turn one into a one-digit force as it was merely a rumor.
…..
The Star Lord Palace’s Star God naturally guessed the mysterious relationship between Wang Ping and that figure as well.
This left him somewhat silent.
Any two-digit being wasn’t something that a three-digit force could provoke.
That individual was unique even among two-digits, let alone one they could provoke.
Moreover, even without the mysterious figure, Wang Ping alone was not someone they could easily deal with.
Wang Ping was a four-digit exceptional, and it wouldn’t be easy to eliminate him.
If Wang Ping stayed in the lower realm, he would have no way to deal with him. Sending his incarnation with a four-digit limit Spirit Grid to deal with Wang Ping in the lower realm would just lead to death.
“Although she’s my favorite daughter, I have to put aside my hatred for the sake of Falling Stars Palace and compromise,”
Star God sighed and chose to let go of his hatred.
After all, he had not just one daughter but many offspring.
Apart from that, the Falling Stars Palace had many disciples, and he couldn’t just fight Wang Ping to the death and let these innocent people die for their hatred.
Doing so would not make him a great father but a foolish leader.
Subsequently, Star God fell silent for a while and left Falling Stars Palace.
…
Two days later, Wang Ping sat in the courtyard, basking in the sun, flipping through books, looking very leisurely.
As for Alpha, she acted like a maid, brewing tea, massaging his shoulders, and rubbing his legs.
These two days, the lower region was not peaceful, and the Third Generation Chat Group was at the center of it all.
However, despite the fame, no one applied to join the Third Generation Chat Group.
That’s because these people were cunning and just observing.
After all, although Wang Ping defeated the Demon King, he also killed someone from the Falling Stars Palace.
Falling Stars Palace was a three-digit force that no one would underestimate. People in the lower realm didn’t know Wang Ping’s background, and they thought the Third Generation Chat Group would eventually be wiped out by Falling Stars Palace.
Under such circumstances, naturally, no one dared to apply to join the Third Generation Chat Group with a casual attitude.
However, Wang Ping and Alpha didn’t care about that.
Most of the people in the lower realm were not qualified to join the current Third Generation Chat Group.
Those who could join the Third Generation Chat Group had to have at least a five-digit potential.
Without reaching five digits, there was no qualification to join.
The requirement for a three-digit force was like that.
For two-digit forces, they only recruited those with potential or strength of four-digit levels. Anything below that had no qualification to join.
“It seems he couldn’t sit still after all. But this time, he isn’t coming with hostility,”
At that moment, Wang Ping looked up at the sky and chuckled lightly.
These words made Alpha slightly puzzled.
However, she quickly understood.
Two days ago, Food Divine Hall apologized to Wang Ping and sent him many precious items.
As for Falling Stars Palace, there was no movement, which led Alpha to think they were unwilling to make peace.

﻿Chapter 1264: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Gains Fame in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!)_6 Chapter 1264: Chapter 319: Wang Ping Gains Fame in the Amusement Park! Even Two-Digit Numbers Have a Gap! (10,000-Word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes!)_6 Now, hearing Wang Ping say this, Falling Stars Pavilion seemed to be planning to apologize as well.
This couldn’t help but surprise Alpha.
As Alpha was surprised, a ray of starlight appeared here, quickly turning into a human form.
This person was none other than the Palace Master of Star Lord Palace, Star God.
“Heaven Derivative Fellow, it took some time to go to the Three-digit World because of some trouble, so please forgive me.”
After Star God appeared, he stared at Wang Ping and spoke.
This made Alpha dumbfounded.
Goodness, Star God, who was a powerful existence even among the three-digits, came down to the world personally to apologize. It was truly staggering.
It should be known that Wang Ping had killed his daughter, and just two days ago, wiped out the people of Falling Stars Palace.
“I can understand.” Wang Ping sat upright and made a gesture for Star God to sit down.
For this, Star God naturally sat down on the jade chair opposite Wang Ping and said directly: “My people from Falling Stars Palace acted without authorization and caused some trouble for the Heaven Derivative Fellow. I apologize to you, fellow taoist, for this sincerity, and I hope you will accept it.”
As the words fell, Star God took out an object.
This item was emitting bright starlight and looked quite mysterious.
Wang Ping glanced at it, and after knowing its details, was somewhat moved.
Three-digit special item – Star Moon God: Holding this special item, one can summon a three-digit Star Moon God to assist in battle. At the same time, the Star Moon God can also merge with the holder, boosting the holder’s combat power.
“Star God Fellow Taoist, you are really generous.” Wang Ping exclaimed.
Although he guessed that Star God must be wary of the person from the First Generation Chat Group, he was still surprised that the other party could come up with such a precious item.
After all, this was a three-digit special item that could summon a three-digit existence to assist in battle.
Moreover, this was a special item, meaning it could be used in the Heaven Tower.
There was no doubt that Star God had truly splurged. Such items, even in a force like Falling Stars Palace, were definitely scarce.
“I don’t want some juniors’ grudges to make fellow daoists have a bad impression of my Falling Stars Palace. My Falling Stars Palace has always been a neutral force and will not offend any strong people.”
Even though Star God’s heart ached, he still said solemnly.
“Hehe.” Wang Ping wasn’t going to believe Star God’s nonsense.
So-called neutral forces were all relative. They only maintained neutrality towards forces or strong people of their own level. If it were not for Wang Ping’s strength and possible background exceeding Falling Stars Palace’s expectations, Star God would not have personally come to apologize, let alone give such a generous three-digit special item.
In the end, it all came down to strength.
Of course, Wang Ping also appreciated Star God’s approach, which greatly eased his hostility towards Falling Stars Palace and Star God.
“There were indeed some conflicts before, but since Star God Fellow Daoist has come to apologize personally and brought out such an amazing treasure, I naturally won’t be bothered anymore.”
Wang Ping smiled insincerely, and after receiving the treasure, he said.
“Star God Fellow Daoist, my Third Generation Chat Group’s style is the same as that of my senior, ‘an eye for an eye.’ We won’t easily provoke any forces. So please rest assured.”
“With fellow daoist’s words, I can rest assured.” Star God looked deeply at Wang Ping, nodded first, and suddenly said, “Please also send my regards to that great one.”
“I will.” Wang Ping’s expression remained unchanged as he nodded.
“Then I’ll leave it to fellow daoist.” After staring at Wang Ping for a while, Star God said, “Since the conflict has been resolved, I have some things to deal with, so I’ll leave first.”
“Take care.” Wang Ping said with a light laugh.
Star God nodded slightly, transformed into starlight, and disappeared.
This time, he didn’t probe too much, but he still gained something.
That was, even without taking that Two-digit person into account, Wang Ping himself was a strong person not inferior to him.
Wang Ping’s feeling was not at all weaker than the long-lost Reincarnation Emperor.
The cultivation system of different worlds is different.
As a result, even among the three-digits, there are differences in strength.
In some worlds, breakthroughs in certain Great Realms just barely reach the three-digit threshold.
But in some worlds, once a breakthrough is made in certain Great Realms, their strength far exceeds that of ordinary three-digits.
The world where the Reincarnation Emperor was located was such a world.
Quasi-Fairy Emperor, although within the Four-digit Limit, had far more power than the ordinary Four-digit Limit.
At the Fairy Emperor level, there was no need to say more. From the quasi-Fairy Emperor to the Fairy Emperor level, there was a true qualitative change.
As a result, Fairy Emperor-level power was considered a very powerful existence among the three-digits, reaching the legendary three-digit level.
However, Wang Ping’s feeling to him was almost the same as that of the Reincarnation Emperor. Although it seemed not as good as the Reincarnation Emperor, it was terrifying enough, reaching the elite three-digit level, close to the legendary rating.
What was even more terrifying was that Wang Ping had not truly broken through to the Fairy Emperor level, but only a quasi-Fairy Emperor.
A quasi-Fairy Emperor with a power close to a three-digit legend was simply too outrageous.
If Wang Ping could break the shackles, or if the Reincarnation Emperor died and Wang Ping broke through to the Fairy Emperor level, Wang Ping’s power would definitely reach the three-digit legendary level, or even possibly reach the three-digit limit level.
After all, Wang Ping had not yet become an Immortal Emperor, but he already possessed such power. Once he became an Emperor, the increase in his power would be truly unimaginable.
Such a character was absolutely not someone he could afford to provoke.
Therefore, Star God was very glad that he chose to personally come and apologize, and even offer valuable three-digit special items.
Otherwise, even if Wang Ping did not break through to the Fairy Emperor level, he would have no confidence in defeating Wang Ping. If Wang Ping became an Immortal Emperor, Falling Stars Palace would surely perish, and he would die as well.
“Another terrifying figure has emerged in this Myriad Heavens Paradise. It is no wonder that he is deeply involved with that person. With such power, it may be a matter of course.”
Star God sighed secretly in his heart, feeling a complex mix of emotions, unable to calm down.
“Hehe, it seems that my strength is stronger than I thought. The upper limit of that Profound World’s power is among the top tier in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.”
After Star God left, Wang Ping’s mouth curved slightly, murmuring to himself.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1265: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule of Stone Chapter 1265: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule of Stone Originally, Wang Ping thought that the Immortal Emperor’s combat power had just barely reached the threshold of three digits, but he didn’t expect that the combat power at this level would be so powerful.
Although the Star God was also probing his relationship with the person from the first-generation chat group, Wang Ping could see that the Star God was also surprised by his own strength.
As rumor has it, the Star God is a three-digit elite-level existence. Wang Ping speculated that his current strength has also reached the level of three-digit elite since he was able to amaze the Star God like that.
“When I break through to the Immortal Emperor level, I’ll probably be able to reach the three-digit limit directly,”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, secretly thinking to himself.
To break through to the Immortal Emperor is a true transformation.
“That is to say, unknowingly, I have already stood at the apex of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.”
Wang Ping sighed with emotion.
In the present observation of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, no world has given birth to a two-digit existence.
Two-digit existences are basically exceptional cases born through the Sky Tower Game.
Therefore, the three-digit limit is the apex of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, and there is no mistake in this statement.
“Breaking through the Immortal Emperor level in the Myriad Heavens Paradise is not easy. However, as long as I continue to climb the tower, it’s only a matter of time before I break through that level and promote to two digits.”
Wang Ping chuckled lightly, full of confidence in himself.
“Wang Ping, you really are a freak.” Alpha listened to Wang Ping’s emotions and couldn’t help but silently complain, “In terms of the speed of becoming stronger, that person is far inferior to you. A four-digit exceptional at the age of thirty-eight, and he is expected to become a three-digit or even a two-digit before the age of one hundred… ”
“The fact that he’s not as good as me only means that my talent is abnormal, not that my abilities are stronger than his.” Wang Ping shook his head, clearly aware of his own situation, “After all, I achieved this through the talent of Life Simulator, while he reached two digits through his own abilities.”
“Actually, he also has a golden finger.” Alpha said after a moment of silence.
“What do you mean?”
Wang Ping raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised.
“None of the first-generation chat group members were assigned talent awakenings at the beginning, but that doesn’t mean that some of them didn’t have their own opportunities.”
Alpha showed a reminiscent expression and began to speak.
“That person is an existence with deep luck. After crossing over, he obtained a special item, which could be considered his golden finger. However, compared to your Life Simulator, the growth speed that this special golden finger brings to him is not so terrifying, and he mainly relies on his own abilities to grow and overcome difficulties.”
“I see.”
Wang Ping nodded thoughtfully.
It seemed that the first generation of people had not completely crossed over nakedly.
However, this was also normal. If the first generation of big shots didn’t have their own opportunities, it would be difficult to become a powerful force in Myriad Heavens.
Ultimately, there were only a few situations that could lead to growth in this world:
Having an astonishing background.
Possessing unmatched talents that could overcome everything.
Being shrewd and an opportunist with good luck.
Having deep luck and incredible air transport.
Being reborn as a great power, surpassing the previous life.
…
Without accidents, that first-generation person should be between the third and fourth types.
As for Wang Ping himself, he would fall into the second category, with his purely talent-based Life Simulator being too buggy, allowing him to grow stronger effortlessly in the early and mid-stages.
Even in the late stages, he would still rely on the Life Simulator.
Of course, he was also somewhat related to the first situation in some sense.
After all, without that first-generation person’s behind-the-scenes planning, Wang Ping would still be dead despite having such an abnormal talent.
“I should start climbing the tower now.”
Wang Ping then composed himself and looked in the direction of the Sky Tower.
This time, he planned not just to challenge one floor, but to attempt multiple floors at once, until he obtained the three-digit Rule Stone and the Immortal Emperor’s chance to break through.
Otherwise, ordinary five-digit and four-digit special items would be useless to him.
“The Sky Tower Game is too dangerous. Even if your strength has greatly increased and your hidden power is astonishing, you still cannot be careless. I’m still counting on you, Wang Ping, to lead the third-generation chat group to greatness when you return.”
Alpha’s expression was gentle, but he was very serious with his reminder.
“Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing.”
Wang Ping smiled.
Then, without saying anything more to Alpha, Wang Ping directly took out the Paradise Pass and communicated with it using his thoughts.
The next moment, Wang Ping was enveloped in a white light and appeared in the Personal Room of the Sky Tower.
“Player Tianyan, welcome back.”
The Sky Tower’s intelligent and engaging voice rang out again.
“It has been detected that Player Tianyan’s combat power has reached the four-digit exceptional level, and his talent level has also reached four digits, with a three-digit special talent on his body. You have successfully triggered the hidden mechanism, Player Tianyan. You have two choices.”
“What choices?”
Wang Ping frowned, a sense of foreboding rising in his heart.
“The first method is to continue to climb the tower as per the normal mode. However, as the floors increase, the time for teaming up will become longer and longer. Also, since the player’s panel is too strong, the difficulty of the Sky Tower Game will increase.”
“The second method is to participate in a special game mode, Player Tianyan. You will save time by skipping the slow tower climbing process and instead participate in an individual special game. If you can pass this special game, your tower climbing progress will directly reach the sixtieth floor, equivalent to obtaining an SSS rating for all previous floors. At the same time, you will be awarded the specific item rewards of a three-digit Rule Stone and the chance to break through to the Immortal Emperor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1266 - 1266 320 Special Mode The Three-Digit Rule
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1266: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_2 Chapter 1266: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_2 The voice of Sky Tower Intelligence seemed somewhat confusing, and text appeared on the screen.
Wang Ping fell silent.
This could be the mechanism of Sky Tower, but it could also be the interference of the second generation again.
“What is the special game? Can my talents still be used normally?”
Wang Ping asked expressionlessly.
“Player Heaven Derivative, as the layers increase, the level of talents and items that can be effective will become higher and higher. This is the rule of Sky Tower. For example, in Abyss mode, once you reach the Fifth Layer, the effects of talents and items with less than six-digit numbers will disappear; once you reach the Tenth layer, the effects of talents and items with less than five-digit numbers will disappear; once you reach the Twenty-Ninth Layer, the effects of talents and items with less than four-digit numbers will disappear; once you reach the Fifty-Ninth Layer, the effects of talents and items with less than three-digit numbers will disappear.”
“You could’ve just said if they can be used normally.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“In special mode, four-digit talents can be used, but their effects will be weakened to some extent. Only three-digit talents can function normally.”
The voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded again.
“Heh, by your logic, I’m actually making a profit here.”
Wang Ping sneered.
Upon reaching the Fifty-Ninth Layer, the effects of four-digit talents and items could no longer be used. Through the special mode, he directly reached the Sixtieth Layer, allowing his four-digit talents to perform extraordinarily.
However, there must be a huge pitfall waiting for him in this so-called special mode.
Only when the difficulty exceeds the total sum of the challenges from previous layers will such a special mode appear, with such rich rewards offered simultaneously.
Otherwise, with the nature of Sky Tower, there would be no way it would give him these two choices.
Of course, the difficulty here refers to the difficulty of him tackling the tower, not the difficulty for other players.
Perhaps, in the subsequent layers before the Sixtieth Layer, his current Life Simulator combined with his current trump cards could easily break through the challenges, so Sky Tower presented him with such choices, forcefully raising the difficulty for him.
However, this is quite normal.
With his four-digit talent Life Simulator, he could access memory viewing for free simulations.
Moreover, his four-digit talent Invulnerability Gold Badge and four-digit talent Real Damage could make him invincible.
Let alone, he now possessed the three-digit special item Star Moon God.
With such trump cards, there wouldn’t be much difficulty for him in tackling the tower normally in the upcoming challenges.
If even he could face problems in the first sixty layers, Wang Ping felt that all three-digit players would be doomed.
“Player Heaven Derivative, what is your choice?”
The voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded again, ignoring Wang Ping’s complaints.
“Heh, of course I choose to tackle the tower normally.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
The special mode was obviously a trap, and he would not choose it.
“Player Heaven Derivative, please make your choice quickly.”
The voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded again.
Wang Ping fell silent, realizing one thing.
Just like when he was locked in Abyss mode, he had no choice from the beginning, and the option given to him was merely a symbolic gesture.
“I choose the special mode.”
For the next half hour, Wang Ping kept choosing to tackle the tower normally, but unfortunately, Sky Tower ignored his choice every time, and repeatedly urged him for half an hour, leaving Wang Ping helpless.
As a result, Wang Ping had no choice but to choose the special mode.
“Ding, congratulations Player Heaven Derivative for successfully choosing the special mode, the game begins.”
After Wang Ping made his choice, the voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded and did not pretend to be deaf and dumb anymore.
This left Wang Ping even more speechless.
The next second, Wang Ping was enveloped in white light and disappeared into the space of Sky Tower, being thrown into the world of the special mode.
…..
When Wang Ping’s vision cleared up again, he realized his unusual state.
In terms of talents, except for his four-digit talents: Invulnerability Gold Badge, Real Damage, and Innate Dao Seeds, all other talents were unusable.
At the same time, although these four-digit talents could still be used, their effects were somewhat brutally weakened.
Four-digit talent Invulnerability Gold Badge had its effect duration reduced to three minutes.
The effect of four-digit talent Real Damage no longer ignored energy barriers and the like, and only took effect when attacking the body, not converting all the damage to true damage.
The effect of four-digit talent Innate Dao Seeds was also weakened, with its comprehension greatly reduced.
As for the four-digit talent Fearless Heart, it was a one-time talent, so it was already gone here.
And his true trump card talent, Life Simulator, suffered terribly as well. It had reverted to the state where he could only use its free feature once a day, which could be described as taking a step back.
The paid mode was now unusable.
Only the three-digit special item Star Moon God was not weakened, only its effects in the Sky Tower game were adjusted differently from the outside world.
However, Wang Ping could accept his talents and item effects being weakened, but the key was that a part of his memory was also blurred.
This part was about his enlightenment and cultivation.
Those memories felt as though they were from before he had traveled through time, which also resulted in a straight-line decline in his control of power and techniques.
That is to say, Wang Ping was now a very special ordinary person, which was quite a terrible feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267 - 1267 320 Special Mode The Three-Digit Rule
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1267: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_3 Chapter 1267: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_3 Wang Ping shook his head slightly, feeling a headache about his current situation.
This so-called special mode seemed to be more troublesome than he had imagined.
“Ding, Special Game·Disordered World begins, the rules are as follows:
① In this game world, every two days, five balloons will appear, and the player·Tian Yan must choose one of them within ten seconds and burst it.
② Among the five balloons, each balloon has a different rule. Once a balloon is burst, the rule inside will be revealed, changing the rules of this world. The player and the native inhabitants of this world must act under this rule, and those who deviate from the rule will die.
③ Clearance method: The host must ensure that after ten days, more than thirty percent of humanity survives. If less than thirty percent survive, it will be considered a failure.”
“Ding, the game will start in thirty minutes, please Player·Tian Yan prepare mentally.”
The intelligent voice of the Heavenly Tower sounded continuously, and a screen appeared in front of Wang Ping.
“…….”
Looking at the game mechanics, Wang Ping was speechless.
Fuck, these broken game rules are too difficult.
Each balloon has one rule, and the rules can stack on top of each other.
At the same time, Wang Ping suspected that after choosing a balloon, the remaining balloons would not disappear, would not refresh, but would only increase.
In other words, the difficulty of this special mode was outrageous.
If it weren’t for his Life Simulator, which could minimize risk to the fullest extent, other players would likely face a much higher chance of death.
Even so, Wang Ping couldn’t guarantee 100% certainty of clearing the game given his current situation.
After all, his Life Simulator could only simulate once a day now.
That is to say, if his luck was too bad, he wouldn’t be able to use the Life Simulator to figure out all the rules of the balloons, make the best arrangements, and thereby minimize risks to the greatest extent.
“Troublesome.”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
With the various bizarre rules stacking up, ensuring that more than thirty percent of humanity survives was not an easy task.
“The best method of clearing the game should be like this…”
After some thought, Wang Ping had some ideas.
First, perform Divine Descent, making most of humanity believe in him in the shortest time possible, and lay the foundation for what is to come.
Second, conduct a global live broadcast, allowing humanity to follow his steps on how to survive under the rules.
Third, choose the most suitable rules to match and minimize the danger index.
Although it still requires some luck to clear the game no matter how hard he worked, Wang Ping had to take it one step at a time.
“Right, I can also create some ways to spread faith before the game starts, so that humanity can believe in me to a greater extent. My Four-digit Innate Dao Seed, even after being reduced, is enough to help me accomplish these things. Not to mention, I can also refer to the doctrines of Taoism and Buddhism.”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, thinking secretly in his heart.
“System, I want to start the free simulation.”
Then, Wang Ping spoke in his heart.
“Ding, Life Simulator starts, free simulation begins…”
The system’s voice sounded.
[After you made the decision, you quickly created the method. Although your time is limited, it is still enough to create a doctrine to spread faith among the remaining humans. After all, the target audience is ordinary people, not cultivators, so the difficulty is not that great.]
[Approximately half an hour later, you successfully created the method and awaited the start of the game.]
[A few minutes later, the game started, and the five balloons suddenly appeared in front of you, making your expression serious. The first balloon was crucial. If it was not chosen well, then Wang Ping would only be able to blindly open the box after the game started, without any chance to choose again. In that case, the danger index would be too high.]
[For this reason, you took a deep breath, hoping that your luck was good enough and chose the Number 3 Balloon. After the Number 3 Balloon was popped by you, the rule inside was also revealed.]
[The rule was that humans couldn’t look up at the sky. If they did, they would die on the spot.]
[As this rule emerged, people from all over the world who looked up at the sky instantly died. However, luckily, most humans now were working and not idly gazing at the sky. As a result, the number of deaths was not high. Nevertheless, if this rule remained unknown, the number of deaths would gradually increase.]
[Of course, you were still quite happy with this result. The rule within the Number 3 Balloon was not too excessive. In other words, you were quite lucky. It’s possible that the level of abusiveness in the rules of the balloons appearing in each round would increase, and the rules in the first round of balloons might not be that outrageous. Everything was unknown and needed exploring.]
[Next, you took action, summoned the Star Moon God, successfully manifested divine miracles, shocked the higher-ups of humanity, and let them broadcast the news of the deity’s arrival into the world in the form of a live broadcast. This helped you spread your faith and save the world.]
[This global live broadcast shocked most of humanity, with only a small portion in poverty-stricken areas failing to see it due to the lack of live broadcasts.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1268 - 1268 320 Special Mode The Three-Digit Rule
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1268: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_4 Chapter 1268: Chapter 320: Special Mode! The Three-Digit Rule Stone_4 [For this reason, you have long prepared a plan. At the same time, let the higher-ups of various countries take action to popularize faith among the people and convey the rule that one must not look up at the sky.]]
[However, although you’ve tried your best, and many humans have become your believers, the nature of humans is rebellious. The more they’re told what they cannot do, the more they like to try. As a result, some unfaithful people chose to face death by looking up at the sky.]
[Then, they all collectively died violently, causing great panic. This also made people believe in your divine words even more.]
[In this way, two days passed. In the early morning of the third day, five more balloons appeared before you. This made your face tense. After pondering, you chose the balloon with code No.7.]
[With the bursting of the balloon coded No.7 by you, the rules within it also appeared. The rule of Balloon No.7 is that humans cannot sleep.]
[This rule made your face change. After all, it’s now early morning when most humans are already resting. Although it’s daytime in other time zones of the planet, this rule appeared too suddenly and is too dangerous.]
[You can already foresee how horrendous the situation would be next.]
[As one would expect, with the emergence of this rule, nearly half of all humans suddenly died, reducing your chance of passing to dangerous levels.]
[This result made you silent. After all, this sudden death is only the beginning. The next humans will not be able to sleep at all. You don’t know how long humans can hold on under these circumstances. After all, human beings can’t sleep. It’s really life-threatening. Even if meditating and keeping your eyes closed, many people find it difficult to stay awake for eight days without dozing off.]
…..
“This special game is really dangerous.”
Wang Ping looked at the content of the text simulation with extreme seriousness.
This special game is more about luck than strength or intelligence.
Bad luck, choosing a terrible rule directly, makes the game unplayable.
[Following this, you spread the rule of humans not being able to sleep. Meanwhile, you continue to create more ways for humans to remain energetic without needing sleep.]
[With the enlightenment of Innate Dao Seeds, you successfully created such a meditation technique and spread it. However, during your process of creating this law, some people died from sleep or dozing off.]
[The number of human survivors on this planet has now dropped to less than 45%.]
[In the blink of an eye, two days passed, and human society had already ground to a halt. If it wasn’t for your spreading of faith and turning most of the surviving humans into fanatical believers, human society would certainly already be in utter chaos.]
[During these two days, the remaining majority of humans have been relying on the meditation method you created to survive.]
[The early morning of the fifth day arrives, and five more balloons appear. You look at these five balloons and fall silent. This time, you don’t burst any immediately but think about whether you can touch the balloons from the first two rounds.]
[If possible, you can test whether the rules in the first two rounds of balloons are simpler. However, you also worry about breaking it and the rules appearing, but not being included in the count, still needing to burst the third round of balloons. In that case, it would really be an explosion.]
[In the end, after the struggle, you chose to be cautious and selected to burst Balloon No.14.]
[As Balloon No.14 was burst, the rules inside were also revealed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1269 - 1269 321 Achieve the only accomplishment
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1269: Chapter 321 Achieve the only accomplishment! Talent upgrade! Chapter 1269: Chapter 321 Achieve the only accomplishment! Talent upgrade! “The rule of the 14th balloon is that humans must maintain eight hours of sleep each day.”
“Upon seeing this rule, your face darkens, knowing that you’re done for. After all, the rule of the 7th balloon is that humans cannot sleep, and if they sleep, they die. Now, there’s another rule that requires maintaining eight hours of sleep. This is purely a death trap with no chances of turning the tables.”
“However, facing difficulties, even in a situation as bleak as certain death, you, as you are now, will not give up your belief in survival. For this, you begin to rack your brains for a possible solution.”
“Eventually, you think of a tactic, which is feigning sleep. While the rule states that you must sleep, it does not specify whether it’s deep sleep, light sleep or feigning sleep.”
“Therefore, if all humans are taught to imagine themselves sleeping during meditation, it might just meet the condition.”
“Once decided, you quickly began creating these methods based on meditation techniques and rapidly spread them.”
“Finally, as a result of your efforts, this method is spread to all living humans who began to try to sleep in this manner.”
“However, the reality proves futile. Faking sleep, if considered sleeping, also triggers the 7th balloon’s rule that disallows sleeping. This resulted in many of the people you used as test subjects dying on the spot.”
“This headache-inducing fact forced you to think of a new solution. Eventually, you came up with a cruel strategy.”
“That is, if the survival rate of humans is expected to remain above thirty percent, then if you could transform humans into a different species before the game begins, leaving only you behind, wouldn’t that result in a hundred percent survival rate?”
“In other words, as long as you ensure your own survival, you can pass the game, even with a perfect score. Even though so many people have already died in this world, and you are certain to die this time, you can still create a path for the original Wang Ping.”
“With this in mind, you started to access the scientific research data of this world, searching for a virus like the Zombie Virus.”
“Unfortunately, no such virus exists in this world. Desiring to research one swiftly is not a simple matter. Your plan to change the human species has failed.”
“In retrospect, you somewhat regret not researching various viruses in the past. If you had, it would have been easier for the original Wang Ping to take action.”
…….
“Sure enough, compared to protecting the human race, transforming the human race presents a higher chance of passing.”
Wang Ping silently thought while looking at the text-based simulation.
As Wang Ping pondered, the text-based simulation continued.
“However, even though there’s no available virus, you have not given up. You began researching the abilities of the three-digit special item Star Moon God. After your research and development, you successfully developed a special ability with the three-digit special item, Star Moon God.”
“This ability is to harness the powers of the stars and constellations, using the power of the Star Moon God, transforming humans into astral beings.”
“Next, with the limited time left, you began trying to transform the remaining humans into astral beings.”
“Under your control, many humans began to transform into astral beings. However, because the number of surviving humans is gradually decreasing, the survival ratio is shrinking.”
“Nevertheless, you don’t care. After all, your death is certain. Your aim is only for the sake of research.”
“Finally, when the time came and the rule of the 14th balloon was triggered, all humans died, and you were eliminated, thus died.”
“Due to your death, this simulation ended.”
….
With the end of the text-based simulation, memory images and various experiments from the simulation began to appear in Wang Ping’s mind.
“I had thought that after evolving into a four-digit talent, the added memory transfer function was reduced to nothing. Unexpectedly, it still exists. In this case, things will be much easier.”
Wang Ping chuckled softly while recalling the memory images in his mind.
Then, Wang Ping didn’t waste any more time and directly summoned the three-digit existence of the Star Moon God.
Despite being in the Heaven Tower, after adjustments, a three-digit existence like holy celestial beings might not possess the same incredible destructive power as they would in the outside world, they’re strong enough, absolutely transcendent beings, capable of destroying cities.
Next, Wang Ping merged with the Star Moon God, dazzling starlights appeared behind him, and his eyes became as profound as the starry sky.
Then, Wang Ping flew into the sky, activating the abilities of the Star Moon God, guiding the starlight from the entire sky, sprinkling it over every corner of the Star Planet.
This scene was absolutely incredible, making many people exclaim in awe.
The relevant departments of many countries also noticed Wang Ping’s existence; they were equally shocked and began to play with their thoughts.
However, no matter what they were thinking, Wang Ping did not care.
Under your control, as the starlight from the entire sky fell, some humans were amazed to find their bodies changing.”
“It seems that turning humans into other races doesn’t cause an abnormal survival rate, which is a relief.”
Wang Ping was intentionally controlling a part of the humans to transform into astral beings first, and while looking at the human death rate on the luminescent screen in front of him, he breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that the rate was still a hundred percent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1270 - 1270 321 Achieving the Only Achievement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1270: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _2 Chapter 1270: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _2 Then, Wang Ping hesitated no longer, amplified the power, wanting to transform all of mankind into star spirits as quickly as he could.
Ultimately, in a mere ten minutes, Wang Ping successfully transformed the vast majority into star spirit followers.
However, Wang Ping did not, in truth, transform all of humanity into star spirit followers.
To prevent the bizarre situation where he himself would not be considered a human, Wang Ping left two humans intact.
Nevertheless, Wang Ping captured these two humans and kept them by his side, always ready to control them, to prevent them from causing any trouble.
Next, Wang Ping waited calmly for the game to start.
Soon after, the game began and Wang Ping chose Balloon No. 3.
The rule forbidding looking up at the sky appeared, causing some individuals to die.
Wang Ping paid this no mind. After all, only two humans remained on the planet Earth, and they were both right by his side, in the basement. There was no way for them to look up at the sky.
Next, Wang Ping started creating laws just as he did in the Life Simulator, to be prepared for anything unexpected.
In the blink of an eye, it was dawn when new balloons appeared. Wang Ping stayed extremely calm.
Admittedly, Wang Ping’s Life Simulator had not yet refreshed its cooldown period after the appearance of the balloons, rendering him unable to simulate and make the correct decisions. But Wang Ping’s law creation went smoothly, and he taught these laws to the human who had already become his fanatic follower, and he did not let these two humans sleep.
Because of this, Wang Ping chose Balloon No.7, choosing the rule that forbids sleeping.
By ten in the morning, Wang Ping found that, at last, the cooldown period of the Life Simulator had ended. He could run another round of free simulation.
Without hesitation, Wang Ping said in his mind, “System, I want to perform a free simulation.”
“Ding. The Life Simulator has initialized. The free simulation begins.”
The system’s voice rang out.
Then, the screen lit up and the familiar text emerged again.
“You continue to refine the laws, waiting for the third round of balloon refresh. You closely observe the changes in the world because all humans have turned into star spirits and thus society has plunged into chaos. True, these star spirits all answer to you and you can command them, but chaos is still unavoidable.”
“You don’t pay much mind to this. In the end, it doesn’t matter how many star spirits there are. As long as they don’t interfere with your game, it’s all good.”
“In the blink of an eye, it is the morning of the fifth day. The balloons appear on time. This time, you naturally evade the No. 14 Balloon. After some thought, you choose the No. 11 Balloon.”
“As you pop No. 11 Balloon, the hidden rule within it is revealed. This rule states that each human must do 300 push-ups each day. Once you start doing push-ups, you must complete them within an hour. Long breaks are not allowed.”
“Seeing this rule, you breathe a sigh of relief. 300 push-ups are certainly a big trouble for ordinary people. If there were still seven billion humans on earth, many would die under this rule. But things are different now, there are only two humans. You can certainly enhance their power, letting them fulfill this rule every day.”
“For that, you successfully live for another two days, keeping these two humans alive. Their physical strength even greatly increased.”
“The morning of the seventh day, the fourth round of balloons starts to refresh. Looking at these five balloons, with a pensive expression, you choose balloon No. 20.”
“With Balloon No. 20 popped, the rule within it is revealed. The appearance of this rule immediately stiffens your expression.”
“Because the rule of Balloon No. 20 is that humans cannot move.”
“With the appearance of this rule, the two humans die instantly due to movement. This shook you and you feared the same end.”
“However, you discover you have not been eliminated. Apparently, even without merging with the Star Moon God, you are still considered part of the human race. Hence, at present, the human survival rate is equivalent to still being above thirty percent.”
“This allows you to breathe a sigh of relief. All you have to do now is hold on for two more days until the fifth round of balloons appear. At that time, if you’re lucky enough and choose a not-so-outrageous rule, you may be able to clear the game.”
“So you wait without making a move. Just like that, two days pass. The morning of the ninth day arrives and the balloons refresh again. After the emergence of the fifth round of balloons, you, with the power of Star Moon God, pop the No. 23 Balloon.”
“As No. 23 Balloon shreds, the rule within it reveals itself. This rule says that humans cannot think.”
“The instant this rule appears, your expression drastically changes. After all, a thought process is continuous. No one can stop thinking in an instant. The moment this rule appears, death is certain. Unless, the person is in a deep state of sleep.”
“However, your reaction is swift, directly invoking the effect of Four-digit Talent: Invulnerability Gold Badge. It must be said, your response was swift. Lucky for you, the death due to the rule did have a slight death transition period. Hence, you successfully dodge death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1271 - 1271 321 Achieving the Only Achievement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1271: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _3 Chapter 1271: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _3 [However, the effect of the four-digit talent ability “Immortality Gold Medal” can only last for three minutes. That is to say, you must enter an ethereal state within these three minutes.]
[This is not difficult for you. Although your memory has been blurred, you are still one of the top existences in the entire heavens and myriad realms. Hence, you easily enter the ethereal state.]
[After three minutes, you don’t die and just stand there quietly.]
[In the end, time passes, and you are still alive, thus successfully passing through this special game.]
[With the game over, this simulation also comes to an end.]
…..
“This darn game is really hard.”
Wang Ping looked at the simulated content and sighed.
This game relies too much on luck; if it hadn’t been for him, other players would probably have a 99% chance of dying.
Even for him, if it weren’t for his superior abilities and luck, he wouldn’t have been sure of successfully completing the game.
“Since I am considered a human, I don’t need to keep these two burdens. Next, I just need to follow the path shown in the text simulation.”
After that, Wang Ping took a deep breath and took action, commanding the Star Moon God to transform the remaining two humans into star spirits as well.
Then, Wang Ping chose a balloon like in a life simulation game and acted cautiously.
In the end, he survived for ten days successfully.
“Ding, congratulations to player Heaven Derivative for passing through the Special Mode. Do you wish to return?”
The pleasant voice of the Sky Tower’s intelligence sounded.
“Return.”
It was only after the voice of the Sky Tower’s intelligence that Wang Ping recovered from his ethereal state and said without hesitation.
As Wang Ping answered, his body was enveloped by a white light, and he disappeared from the game world, returning to his empty room.
“Ding, detecting that player Heaven Derivative has successfully completed the main mission, rated as A-class.”
“Ding, detecting that the human survival rate is 100%, perfectly passing through, the rating upgraded, rated as SSS tier, and obtaining an SSS tier Abyss Treasure Chest.”
“Ding, since the player Heaven Derivative has chosen the Special Mode, he will receive a special reward of a three-digit Rule Stone and an Immortal Emperor opportunity. At the same time, the player Heaven Derivative’s floor will directly reach the Sixtieth Layer, equivalent to passing the first fifty-nine layers, and achieving an SSS tier evaluation for all of them.”
“Ding, an announcement for the entire tower: Player Heaven Derivative has successfully activated the Special Mode, perfectly passed through the special game world, obtained an SSS tier evaluation, and achieved an aggregate achievement equivalent to the SSS tier evaluations of the previous fifty-nine layers of the Abyss Mode, becoming the first player to achieve this. Meanwhile, player Heaven Derivative has obtained the qualification to directly enter the Sixtieth Layer.”
…..
A series of sounds rang out, and with the full tower announcement repeating three times, Wang Ping couldn’t help but smile, quite satisfied with the outcome.
He, Wang Ping, had finally done something shocking in the entire heavens and myriad realms, obtaining an amazing achievement exclusive to himself.
This was an achievement that even the first in the first generation chat group had not achieved.
However, Wang Ping calmed his emotions quickly and couldn’t help shaking his head.
He was already about to become a three-digit limit strongman, yet he was still happy and triumphant over this.
It seemed that he hadn’t lived long enough to be as steady and unflappable as those old monsters.
Of course, it was just Wang Ping who thought this way. In fact, anyone who achieved such a feat would find it hard to hide their happiness, even the old monsters, though they wouldn’t be so smug about it.
At this moment, the entire heavens and myriad realms, especially those who had entered Myriad Heavens Paradise, were in shock, not expecting Wang Ping to once again make such a huge impact in such a short time.
Some strongmen hadn’t entered Myriad Heavens Paradise recently and didn’t know that Wang Ping had already become a four-digit exception. Before, they had only thought that Wang Ping was bold and promising.
As a result, in the blink of an eye, Wang Ping directly jumped to the Sixtieth Layer, which was simply outrageous.
The most terrifying part was that he had actually accomplished something that even two-digit strongmen hadn’t, becoming the first to pass the Special Mode and receive an SSS tier evaluation. This was just too abnormal.
“It looks like we underestimated him.”
“This is no longer a rising star. Perhaps he has already become a bigshot that we can’t catch up to.”
Strongmen outside Myriad Heavens Paradise sighed in their hearts.
As for those extraterrestrial beings within Myriad Heavens Paradise, they were even more shocked and frightened.
There was no way out; the things Wang Ping had done in this period were just too many and too unimaginable.
Even the three-digit beings were all silenced.
Wang Ping was already a four-digit exception, and now he had undertaken the unprecedented Special Mode, obtaining an SSS tier evaluation as well.
They couldn’t imagine what kind of reward Wang Ping would receive.
Perhaps soon, Wang Ping would become the most powerful existence among the three-digit strongmen and then advance to the two-digit realm.
Would the heavens and myriad realms have another two-digit being soon?
In the Food Divine Hall, the Food God, who was eating an exotic creature’s front leg meat, was also shocked, with the meat falling out of his hand.
However, Food God didn’t care about that and just exclaimed, “Gosh, a four-digit exception who’s not even forty years old, who has hopes of becoming a two-digit strongman before turning a hundred, don’t you think this is too ridiculous? Star God, we’re lucky we apologized early, otherwise, you’d really be in trouble.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1272 - 1272 321 Achieving the Only Achievement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1272: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _4 Chapter 1272: Chapter 321: Achieving the Only Achievement! Talent Upgrade! _4 “…..”
Star God was silent, feeling lucky and having mixed emotions.
After some things had happened, they naturally investigated Wang Ping’s past and discovered his real age.
Honestly, they were genuinely frightened.
Even if they were three-digit powerhouses who had lived for a long time, they were still shocked.
A four-digit exception at the age of about thirty-eight, potentially a two-digit powerhouse before the age of one hundred—it was too outrageous.
This kind of growth speed might even frighten two-digit powerhouses.
It’s true that there are many talents in Myriad Heavens Paradise that can help people get stronger rapidly, but those talents are only invincible in the early and mid-phases. Later on, even if their talent level increases, they won’t be so against the heavens.
For example, the talent to become stronger by killing others isn’t that rare. At lower levels, killing someone can seize their cultivation and even their comprehension.
But after reaching the five-digit level, things change.
Even if the level of this kind of talent increases to five digits, it can’t completely seize others’ comprehension.
After all, others’ comprehension is still their own.
In addition, absorbing too much mixed comprehension and walking on a chaotic path may lead to deviations and doom one’s future prospects.
There are limits to talent, too.
However, Wang Ping seemed to be an exception, as if his talent was without shackles.
“With his speed of growth and breaking through the tower, he could indeed become a two-digit powerhouse before one hundred, possibly setting a record that no one can surpass,” Star God said, sighing.
A world that could give birth to a two-digit powerhouse does not exist. The birth of a two-digit powerhouse relies on the game rewards of the Heavenly Tower.
As a result, it doesn’t take much time.
As for the problem of needing a lot of time to break through to Immortal Emperor, it shouldn’t be a problem for him, given his previous cultivation speed.
Therefore, becoming a two-digit powerhouse before the age of one hundred isn’t an empty claim.
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, we’re about to witness history. In this Myriad Heavens Paradise, one more abnormal two-digit powerhouse is going to appear. I don’t know what will happen next,” said the Food God from Food Divine Hall, munching on some meat and mumbling to himself.
…..
When even three-digit powerhouses were shocked, the two-digit powerhouses couldn’t calm down either.
Initially, they thought that even if that being wanted to cultivate a two-digit powerhouse or someone who could get an SSS-tier evaluation throughout their journey, it wasn’t practical.
However, it seems that they are about to be proven wrong.
“It can only be said that it’s not surprising. We are far behind compared to them,” a two-digit powerhouse sighed.
The other two-digit powerhouses remained silent.
“By the way, even if Wang Ping becomes a two-digit powerhouse and arrives on the Ninetieth Floor, he would still need one more of the same level to activate the game,” a two-digit powerhouse said with interest, his eyes flickering.
“Who knows where his other trainee is?”
“Who can know? We can’t even deduce his strategies even if we join forces,” they replied.
Faced with this question, the other two-digit powerhouse was curious but still helplessly shook their heads.
Despite being two-digit powerhouses, they were far different from that being.
…..
As the big figures in Myriad Heavens Paradise discussed in amazement, Wang Ping also looked at his rewards.
He didn’t directly open the SSS-tier Abyssal Treasure Chest but looked at the three-digit Rule Stone instead. He took it, chose to merge and upgrade immediately.
Soon, Wang Ping’s talent had been upgraded.
Life Simulator reached the three-digit level successfully.
At the three-digit level, Life Simulator’s abilities changed again.
Free simulation and free practice disappeared, leaving the three most essential abilities of Life Simulator.
Time and space, creation, and cause and effect.
Time and space allowed Wang Ping to see endless possibilities in the future.
Creation allowed him to consume corresponding energy to create any talent or item he desired.
Cause and effect reversed the cause-effect relationship and changed reality.
The upper limit of these three essential abilities of talent is extremely high!

chapters.title: Chapter 1273 - 1273 322 Generous Rewards from the Abyss
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1273: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! Chapter 1273: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! “Sigh, a three-digit inborn talent is really too overpowered.”
Wang Ping looked at his talent and showed a look of astonishment.
With three abilities with very high upper limits, Wang Ping felt that climbing the tower in the future might be as simple as eating and drinking water.
Foreseeing the future, endless possibilities.
Create the talent and ability suitable to break the game and easily solve future unsolvable problems.
If this isn’t enough, spend a huge price to forcibly reverse cause and effect.
It can be said that for Wang Ping now, unless he encounters a two-digit level existence or a game with extremely perverse rules, he would be an invincible existence.
“My inborn talent seems to be evolving in the direction of omniscience and omnipotence.”
Wang Ping thought of this and his eyes deepened.
Foreseeing the endless possibilities of the future can be considered a subordinate ability of omniscience.
And creation and cause and effect are both subordinate abilities of omnipotence.
“I don’t know what the secret is about me.”
Wang Ping pondered and felt that his true identity might not be that simple.
However, Wang Ping knew that he couldn’t figure out the answer even with wild thinking.
Only when he becomes a two-digit level can he possibly know all the secrets.
Otherwise, even if he reaches the three-digit limit, he will not be able to touch those hidden secrets.
Next, Wang Ping cleared his mind, looked at the rewards of the Immortal Emperor opportunity, and chose to accept them.
Wang Ping originally thought that this reward would give him a treasure or a hint of opportunity to find something.
As a result, it really is like the name suggests, the Immortal Emperor opportunity simply and purely raised his cultivation to the Immortal Emperor level.
Thus, Wang Ping became the second Immortal Emperor in that fantasy world besides the Reincarnation Emperor.
However, he was much stronger than the Reincarnation Emperor, reaching the three-digit limit grade.
“It’s really simple enough.”
Wang Ping exclaimed.
Although he already knew the mechanism of the Sky Tower Game, and the books had recorded the process of players receiving cultivation rewards, the promotion of the Immortal Emperor level was so simple that it felt too terrifying to be compared to watering plants.
“It can only be said that the rumor that reaching the top of the Heaven Tower will make one a single digit isn’t unfounded.”
After Wang Ping sighed, he looked at the last reward.
Wang Ping was very curious about what kind of good things can come out of the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest in this special mode.
As Wang Ping claimed the reward and opened the special SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, a dazzling golden light appeared and the intelligent voice of the Heaven Tower also rang out.
“Ding, congratulations, you have obtained the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest and acquired the following rewards:
1. All Attributes +10000.
2. Three-digit top-grade special item: Proof of the Living.
3. Three-digit top-grade special item: World Withering.
4. Three-digit top-grade special item: God-devouring Insect.
5. Several three-digit special tools, and four-digit special tools.”
Three-digit top-grade special item: Proof of the Living: This item can resurrect a three-digit limit powerhouse. As long as they are not killed by a two-digit existence or a two-digit tool, they can be resurrected unlimitedly.
If killed by a two-digit existence or a two-digit tool, then they can only be resurrected one to three times, specific situations may vary.
In the Sky Tower Game, this item will be adjusted. The effect is to allow players to resurrect. In the game, players can resurrect three times.
If the player fails to pass the game, this item will become a one-time-use tool, resurrecting the player and countering the one-time death elimination penalty of the Sky Tower Game.
Three-digit top-grade special item: World Withering: A one-time special item that, after use, can unleash an extremely terrifying power, causing the heavens and all realms to wither and become nothingness. Even a two-digit existence will be injured by the attack of this item.
PS: This item is a special item and will be adjusted in the Sky Tower Game.
Three-digit top-grade special item: God-devouring Insect: Can summon a single insect with extremely strong devouring ability, reaching the three-digit limit of combat power.
PS: This item is a special item and will be adjusted in the Sky Tower Game.
“Good guy, these three-digit top-grade special items are truly astonishing. Most importantly, the effects of these three special items are very powerful.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list with a surprised expression.
Proof of the Living could allow him to resurrect infinitely in the outside world, even being killed by a two-digit level he could resurrect one to three times, and it could also serve as a resurrection coin for the Sky Tower Game.
As for World Withering, it was even more terrifying, equivalent to being able to unleash a two-digit level power once, directly destroying the heavens and all realms.
It’s true that using this item would also hurt Wang Ping himself, but if used well, it still had a strong deterrent effect.
If used in conjunction with the Proof of the Living, a three-digit limit special item, Wang Ping would have a little more confidence when facing some two-digit level opponents.
As for the three-digit limit item: God-devouring Insect.
This item was slightly ordinary among the three items.
However, being able to have an additional three-digit limit combat power was quite good in itself.
Not to mention that this item could be used in the Sky Tower Game.
Take the previous three-digit intermediate special item Star Moon God, for example, it helped him quite a bit.
Without the existence of the Star Moon God, Wang Ping would have had some difficulty in perfectly clearing the special mode.

chapters.title: Chapter 1274 - 1274 322 Generous Rewards from the Abyss
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1274: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _2 Chapter 1274: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _2 As a result, Wang Ping did not underestimate such special items with summoning types.
Afterwards, Wang Ping looked at his inner world again and found that a pile of four-digit special items had been added.
In these special items, there were low-level four-digit special items, mid-level four-digit special items, high-level four-digit special items, and top-grade four-digit special items.
Even more, there were several four-digit Rule Stones.
Clearly, the reward for skipping levels had made it up for him.
Unfortunately, for Wang Ping at the moment, the four-digit tools, even the four-digit top-grade special tools, were useless.
After all, in the later floors, the four-digit limit tools couldn’t be used either.
Although these tools would become golden fingers for some people if discarded, for Wang Ping now, the grade is really too low.
Then, Wang Ping looked at another pile of items.
The number of tools in this pile was significantly less than that of the four-digit tools, with only about twenty pieces.
These special items were all three-digit special items.
Their levels were mostly low and mid-level three-digit ones, without a single high-level item.
To be honest, outside the tower, these special items won’t help Wang Ping much.
However, inside Heaven Tower, they should still be useful.
“It seems that before the 60th floor, it’s tough to get three-digit special items. Although I fixed Abyss mode and increased the reward quota, and got SSS tier evaluations every time, I can only get mid-level three-digit special tools at most.”
Wang Ping thought quietly.
Thinking this way, three-digit special items are indeed extremely precious, and I guess those three-digit strongmen would have few of them as well.
In other words, for Star God to give a three-digit elite strongman a mid-level three-digit special item-Star Moon God as compensation, it was truly a great loss for him.
“If we calculate this way, those two-digit people, I guess would have few two-digit tools, having two of them is already considered outstanding among the two-digit numbers.”
Thanks to this reward, Wang Ping now has a general understanding of the situation of the strongmen in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Special items are precious, but they don’t seem so because Wang’s performance was too abnormal and his battle records were too exaggerated.
Next, Wang Ping calmed his thoughts and left Heaven Tower.
However, this time, Wang Ping was not teleported to the courtyard but to a strange region.
The energy density in this area was much higher than that of the lower region where Alpha lived. Various kinds of Dao lines, runes, and divine powers were visible, benefiting lower-digit living beings.
