“So, because I’ve become a three-digit limit existence, I am forcibly teleported to the upper mid-tier. This is where three-digit existences live.”
Wang Ping thought thoughtfully.
“So, later on, if I want to go down to the lower realm, I’ll only be able to take the form of incarnation unless I can transcend the rules of All Heavens Paradise.”
As Wang Ping pondered, countless astonishing visions were seen, illuminating the whole Myriad Heavens Paradise.
These scenes left many living beings in shock.
Many living beings were puzzled, but some who had lived in the Myriad Heavens Paradise for a long time knew what these visions represented.
This meant that another three-digit being was born.
Thinking of the previous Heaven Tower announcement, these beings guessed the truth.
Unsurprisingly, the mysterious Heaven Derivative had broken through from being a four-digit breakthrough person to a three-digit one.
Apparently, the reward of the Heaven Tower game this time was quite generous.
Many people were envious, but they could only envy them, feeling an immense awe towards Wang Ping in their hearts.
As for those three-digit existences and two-digit existences, they were equally surprised by the current vision, but not unexpected.
After all, Wang Ping’s background was too significant, not to mention that he had received the only SSS grade reward for his achievement.
“Fellow Daoist Heaven Derivative, I congratulate you on breaking through to Immortal Emperor and becoming a three-digit limit strongman. It’s the first time for you to come to the upper mid-tier area, why not go to my Falling Stars Palace as a guest? I can also explain the situation of the upper mid-tier to you.”
At this time, a figure appeared near Wang Ping, shining with starlight. It was none other than Star God.
He was closer to here and was the first to spot Wang Ping, so he hurried over and greeted him with a smile.
“I have some things to do, so I won’t bother fellow taoist.”
As the saying goes, don’t slap a smiling face, not to mention that Star God’s item had indeed helped Wang Ping a lot. Because of this, Wang Ping politely refused Star God’s invitation with a smile.
Although Wang Ping came to the upper mid-tier for the first time, with his talents, there were no secrets for him here.
Now, all that Wang Ping can fear are the two-digit existences.
However, there are no two-digit existences in the upper mid-tier, so Wang Ping can feel free to use his gifted ability to foresee endless possibilities for the future.
“In that case, let’s forget about it for now. If you have time in the future, do come to my Falling Stars Palace as a guest.”
Star God, a bit regretful, spoke again.
“I will, next time.” Wang Ping nodded.
Then, Wang Ping’s figure disappeared instantly, wandering around the upper mid-tier, appreciating its scenery.
Half an hour later, Wang Ping suddenly stopped and looked at the sky in front of him.
There, a petite girl dressed in a light yellow Hanfu and wearing a fox mask suddenly appeared and looked at him with her clever black eyes, smilingly said, “Wang Ping, guess who I am? If you guess right, I might give you some small rewards.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1275 - 1275 322 Generous Rewards from the Abyss
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1275: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _3 Chapter 1275: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _3 Wang Ping’s eyes showed a strange color, and he asked, “Huang Huihui, the predecessor of the first generation chat group, is it that predecessor who asked you to deliver a message to me?”
“(ˉ▽￣～) Tch~~, you saw through my identity and purpose all at once, how boring.”
Huang Huihui puffed out her cheeks, grumbling.
“…..” Wang Ping looked at this somewhat playful predecessor, and after a smile, he asked, “I’m curious, is that predecessor trapped in the Heaven Tower and unable to get out?”
“Hehe, about that, I have nothing to say. I came here because the palace master asked me to deliver a message. He tells you that if you want to know your background and free yourself from his control, you should become a two-digit number in the shortest time and come to the Ninetieth Floor. Otherwise, you will die.”
“….”
Wang Ping frowned slightly.
He had originally thought that he would finally get some peace, but it seems that the predecessor of the first-generation chat group didn’t want to let him relax.
Or it’s not that the predecessor was impatient, but rather that something shocking was about to happen, so he gave Wang Ping some hints.
No matter which situation it was, Wang Ping obviously had to continue challenging the Tower.
“Oh, right, right, he also told you that he agreed to the task given by the Reincarnation Emperor, and you are to solve that mysterious issue.”
Huang Huihui giggled and spoke again.
“…..” Wang Ping was speechless.
Because it involved that person, Wang Ping’s innate ability did not work, so he didn’t know what Huang Huihui would say.
Now, after learning of her purpose, Wang Ping felt helpless.
The task that the first-generation chat group’s predecessor drew up actually required him to solve, which was somewhat pitiful.
Although, as it is now, he can do everything but revive the Reincarnation Emperor’s daughter, it is somewhat detrimental.
To kill that mystery, he might need to use the three-digit special item World Withering.
To revive those who were sacrificed, the three-digit special item Proof of the Living should be able to do it.
After all, this thing is even capable of reviving the most powerful beings of the three-digit realm, and it does not specify the target of revival.
Of course, wanting to revive that little girl who died in the Heaven Tower should also be possible.
However, Wang Ping did not want to waste such a precious resurrection currency.
“Asking someone to do something always requires some rewards in return, right?”
Wang Ping shook his head and frankly asked for compensation.
“Of course, there is a reward. But you can only get it after you complete the task. If you don’t complete the task assigned by the palace master, there will be no reward. Let me tell you, this reward is very precious, I would want to keep it for myself if I were not afraid of being killed.”
Huang Huihui grinned, speaking somewhat chattily.
“Hehe, that makes me quite excited.”
Wang Ping looked deeply at Huang Huihui and, without saying much, took out the Paradise Pass and left the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
…..
Returning to the Profound World, Wang Ping came back once again.
Originally, Wang Ping thought he would not be back for a while, but he did not expect to return so soon.
It could only be said that fate was unpredictable.
Afterward, Wang Ping steadied his emotions and used his innate ability.
Then, Wang Ping finally understood why the predecessor of the first-generation chat group would let him return to this world to solve the mystery.
When Wang Ping had not yet set foot in the Emperor realm and his innate talent had not yet reached a three-digit number, the future simulated by his life experience was limited, inaccurate, and constantly interfered with.
In fact, the mystery was much stronger than Wang Ping had imagined and was brewing a huge conspiracy. The Reincarnation Emperor could no longer suppress him.
Originally, the Reincarnation Emperor thought he could continue to suppress the mystery for hundreds of thousands of years.
In reality, the Reincarnation Emperor could only suppress the mystery for about ten years. Once the mystery’s scheme was completed, it would be the moment when the mystery emerged from the cycle of reincarnation, devoured the Reincarnation Emperor, and destroyed this Profound World.
In the future Wang Ping saw, without his intervention, all were dark endings, none of which were bright.
“The predecessor of the first-generation chat group seems unable to take action, but even in such a state, there seems to be no secret in these myriad worlds for him. It’s as if he could calculate everything.”
Wang Ping sighed.
If such a person was your backer and had no evil intentions, the sense of security would be overwhelming.
On the other hand, if he had evil intentions towards you and regarded you as a pawn to be abandoned sooner or later, it would indeed be dangerous.
Wang Ping’s feelings towards that person were still quite complicated.
However, Wang Ping did not think much about it. After steadying his emotions, he took a step forward and arrived in the Life and Death Realm.
Wang Ping’s arrival went completely unnoticed by the Bridge Guard, as if Wang Ping did not exist at all.
It could only be said that Wang Ping had become too strong. The Bridge Guard could not discover Wang Ping even if Wang Ping stood in front of him, as long as Wang Ping did not want to be discovered.
“Congratulations, fellow daoist, on your successful promotion to Emperor. Honestly, it’s much faster than I imagined.”
However, the Bridge Guard’s body soon trembled, and his expression changed, becoming full of astonishment.
Obviously, the will of the Reincarnation Emperor had taken control of him.
“It’s just the reward for challenging the Tower.”
Wang Ping smiled and said.
“So that’s it.”
The Reincarnation Emperor nodded, not surprised at all.
Challenging the Tower indeed was a shortcut.
However, even in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, there was no case like Wang Ping, who was able to gain the fortune of the Emperor in just a few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 1276 - 1276 322 Generous Rewards from the Abyss
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1276: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _4 Chapter 1276: Chapter 322: Generous Rewards from the Abyss Treasure Chest! If it’s the First Generation! _4 All that can be said is that Wang Ping must have done something earth-shattering again.
“Fellow Daoist, are you here this time to help me suppress the anomaly?”
Reincarnation Emperor immediately inquired with a smile.
“I think I mentioned it before, it takes someone at the two-digit level to completely kill this anomaly.”
“Indeed, I’m here to help you. Someone from another world informed me to deal with the anomaly because you cannot suppress it anymore.”
Wang Ping nodded slightly, speaking seriously.
“What?”
The pupils of the Reincarnation Emperor constricted, showing his astonishment.
“That anomaly is cunning. Although you managed to drag it into reincarnation, it smuggled part of its body into another world before that. That world is now in absolute darkness. The moment it fully recovers its power will be when you fall.”
Wang Ping spoke slowly.
“…An anomaly indeed, too difficult to deal with.”
After a moment of silence, the Reincarnation Emperor sighed.
“Indeed, it’s tricky. To kill this anomaly, one must completely eliminate it. However, accomplishing that is difficult. It has a lot of contingency plans, and its dark incarnation is present in many worlds.”
Wang Ping nodded, speaking up.
“Normally, only a two-digit figure has the ability to kill it.”
“So, does that mean you’re confident you can kill it?”
The Reincarnation Emperor inquired curiously.
“All I can say is that I will try my best.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly.
In terms of combat strength, Wang Ping was strong, unmatched among the three-digit figures.
However, even with his strength, killing the anomaly was a tall order.
But what made Wang Ping strong was not only his battle prowess; his most powerful asset was his life-bound talent.
Subsequently, Wang Ping withdrew a premium three-digit special item, World Withering, without further ado.
“What is this?”
The Reincarnation Emperor looked at the black sphere in Wang Ping’s hand, inexplicably feeling a sense of dread, which made him uncomfortable.
“A one-time use, premium three-digit special item capable of causing all heavens and worlds to wither, and even harm two-digit figures.”
Wang Ping stated calmly.
“Pfft!”
Hearing Wang Ping’s words, even the Reincarnation Emperor lost his composure. He looked at the item in Wang Ping’s hand in disbelief, truly frightened.
After all, although he was an Emperor and rated as a three-digit legend in Myriad Heavens Paradise, his circumstances were unique, and he seldom entered Myriad Heavens Paradise.
As a result, he could be said to be the poorest among the three-digit figures.
Now, Wang Ping had just become the Emperor and immediately took out a three-digit premium item capable of causing all heavens and worlds to wither and harm two-digit figures. It was simply too shocking.
“You don’t intend to use this dangerous item against the anomaly, do you? If you use this thing against the anomaly, it might die, but we’ll also perish.”
The Reincarnation Emperor’s expression distorted, as he feared that Wang Ping might impulsively use this dangerous item and bring everyone down with him.
“Don’t worry, I have a Resurrection Item that can bring me back to life.”
Wang Ping smirked, speaking with a bit of malicious intent.
“……” Hearing this, the Reincarnation Emperor’s face darkened, feeling that Wang Ping’s words were quite pitiful.
“Just joking; don’t take it too seriously.” Wang Ping had no intention of continuing the joke, and said with a smile, “I didn’t take out this item to use its destructive power against the anomaly, but to borrow the energy and rules it contains for a higher purpose.”
“What do you mean?”
The Reincarnation Emperor was somewhat alarmed.
“Under normal circumstances, there’s no way to solve the anomaly. However, if this vast power is used as fuel to activate my life-bound talent, then it may not be impossible.”
Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled, and he spoke slowly.
Whether it’s using the creation ability to create a powerful one-time Super-Model Talent or item to destroy the anomaly or directly using the Cause and Effect Reversal power, there is hope in killing this troublesome anomaly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1277 - 1277 323 The truth behind the two-digit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1277: Chapter 323: The truth behind the two-digit number! The first two-digit number item Chapter 1277: Chapter 323: The truth behind the two-digit number! The first two-digit number item “Fuel?”
The Reincarnation Emperor was quite surprised.
Wang Ping was so ruthless, actually using such precious and powerful single-use three-digit premium item as fuel.
Of course, what made the Reincarnation Emperor more curious is what exactly Wang Ping wanted to do.
“Your talent should have been upgraded as well,” the Reincarnation Emperor said after contemplating.
“Indeed, it has transformed into the most essential talent ability,” Wang Ping responded without a need to hide his intentions since no one could hurt him now except those with a two-digit number.
“I see.”
The Reincarnation Emperor marveled.
Except for the people of the Primitive Earth, other beings that enter the Myriad Heavens Paradise do not have the qualifications to awaken their innate abilities.
Furthermore, even talent trading between people of Primitive Earth alone was possible. People from Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms have no qualification to obtain talents.
Even if they possess the body of a person from Primitive Earth, they still cannot obtain talents.
Lastly, even descendants born from two Primitive Earth individuals could awaken their talents. Mixed-blood descendants do not qualify.
This has always been a mystery in Myriad Heavens Paradise.
As a result, these strong beings from Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms often find themselves at a disadvantage when facing the same-level people from Primitive Earth.
Naturally, ordinary talent abilities aren’t attractive to the Reincarnation Emperor. Some precious items are no less powerful than talents at the same level, or even stronger.
Only Wang Ping’s kind of monstrous talent can make the Reincarnation Emperor marvel and even feel a little envious.
“Alright, I’m going to start. After I take action, I’ll resurrect your sacrificial beings,” Wang Ping said and shook his head slightly, not discussing further the topic, and his expression turned serious.
Upon hearing this, the Reincarnation Emperor’s eyes widened, waves rose within them, and he seemed quite unsteady.
After all these years, could he finally resurrect those who were sacrificed? Although it was different from what he had imagined—instead of that mysterious helper resurrecting them, it would be Wang Ping—surprises and accidents didn’t matter as long as those beings could come back to life.
“I’m counting on you.”
The Reincarnation Emperor whispered and began protecting Wang Ping.
Wang Ping nodded slightly and started using his Reversal of Cause and Effect talent ability.
At the same time, the Three-digit Premium Special Item: Myriad Realms Withering began to emit terrifyingly strong light, and a force of destruction began to appear.
This made the Reincarnation Emperor’s expression solemn, fearing that the item might go out of control.
Soon, the Reincarnation Emperor sensed the abnormality. The Terrifying Strange being suppressed in the cycle of reincarnation started to let out miserable screams. The endless darkness began to gradually wither and be wiped away.
“What a terrifying power.”
The Reincarnation Emperor was shocked and delighted.
“Is this the power of the Reincarnation Emperor? No, this can’t be his power! Damn, is it that guy? Has he grown to this extent already?” the Strange voice echoed through the cycle of reincarnation, filled with fear, resentment, and a ferocious roar in the end.
“But you can’t kill me; even if you can eradicate the darkness of this world, I will make a comeback from the darkness! Sooner or later, I will overthrow the entire Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms and become an existence that those high and mighty beings fear!”
“You? Overthrow the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms? You’re not there yet.”
Wang Ping’s expression was calm, his voice cold. He then increased his output.
“Ahhhh!”
The Strange felt the speed at which he was being wiped away had increased, and the endless darkness disappeared.
“How is this possible? How can you erase the Dark Seeds I left in various parts of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms? This is absolutely not something a three-digit being could do!”
Feeling his own change, the Strange was finally terrified and found it hard to believe.
“Reversal of Cause and Effect, your death result has already been formed. Now, it’s just the matter of writing the cause of death. If I want you to die, there will be hundreds of ways to die.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently.
“Damn! This is impossible! This level of ability should not be something you can control…”
The Strange yelled in disbelief.
In the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, countless darknesses began to collapse, disintegrate, purify, burn, or be obliterated.
In the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, countless strong beings witnessed this scene and were utterly shocked.
Especially those miserable worlds that constantly struggled against the darkness, they were overjoyed and wept as the darkness vanished before their eyes.
“You seem to have too many last words.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently, clenched his fist suddenly, and the Three-digit Premium Special Item: Myriad Realms Withering in his hand disappeared altogether.
The next moment, the stubborn struggling Strange doppelgangers and Dark Seeds were wiped away at an astounding speed.
Just like that, the Terrifying Strange who was supposed to have the potential to grow into a two-digit being was completely erased by Wang Ping and vanished in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
“Terrifying power.”
After a moment of silence, the Reincarnation Emperor marveled.
For dozens of eras, he had battled against the Strange but could not defeat him. It was horrifying that Wang Ping wiped him away in just a few minutes.
“You are now the strongest three-digit being. It’s a pity that the gap between a three-digit and a two-digit number is too large, causing a Three-digit Breakthrough to never appear. Otherwise, you might be considered a Three-digit Breakthrough,” he concluded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1278 - 1278 323 The Truth of Two-digit Numbers The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1278: Chapter 323: The Truth of Two-digit Numbers! The First Two-digit Number Item_2 Chapter 1278: Chapter 323: The Truth of Two-digit Numbers! The First Two-digit Number Item_2 Pausing for a moment, the Reincarnation Emperor sighed with emotion once again.
“That’s not important.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly, not caring about whether he could become a Three-digit Breakthrough, his only concern was to successfully become a Two-digit number.
Successfully becoming a Two-digit number was not enough, he still needed to face that Transcender Senior and find a way to survive from his grip.
After all, forming a team with such an existence to enter an Instance Epic was too dangerous.
Next, Wang Ping took out the Triple-digit Premium Special Tool – Proof of the Living, mobilized its power, and resurrected all of Reincarnation Emperor’s sacrificed followers.
“I can’t help you resurrect your little daughter temporarily. Once I become a Two-digit number, I will help you resurrect her.”
Wang Ping looked at the Reincarnation Emperor and spoke.
He would never easily use up the Heaven Tower revitalizing effect of the Proof of the Living. That would be a foolish action.
After all, even Wang Ping couldn’t guarantee that he could clear all the games and not die even once.
Therefore, he would wait until he became a Two-digit number, and only after the effect of Proof of the Living was eliminated would he use it to resurrect the Reincarnation Emperor’s little daughter.
Of course, if he could obtain some lower-level resurrection coins in the upcoming tower challenges, it was also a possibility.
Otherwise, using a Triple-digit Premium Special Tool to resurrect a Quadruple-digit being would be too extravagant.
However, the odds of getting any lower-level revival coins were extremely low, Wang Ping did not hold much hope.
“That’s enough. I am grateful. Resurrecting my little daughter is not part of the promised rewards, so I won’t force you.”
The Reincarnation Emperor sensed that beyond the realms of life and death, all the sacrificed followers had come back to life. Even as an emperor, he couldn’t help but let his eyes moisten.
After all, these years he had been too lonely and had always been deeply ashamed of those sacrificed followers.
“Although it was all a plot by that Senior, you have indeed helped me a lot. By suppressing the Strange object and saving this world, you have done great things. If I can help you resurrect, I will do my best.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and spoke earnestly.
“I am someone who repays kindness with even greater kindness, so don’t try to persuade me otherwise.”
“I am deeply grateful.”
Reincarnation Emperor was very moved and bowed deeply to Wang Ping.
“You’re welcome,” Wang Ping shook his head and said, “I just hope you can help me look after my friends in the future.”
As for Wang Ping, he didn’t know if he could survive after teaming up with that Senior from the first generation chat group to tackle the Heaven Tower challenge.
For this reason, he needed to make some arrangements before parting.
Whether it was asking Reincarnation Emperor to take care of his friends or leaving some means to possibly revive himself, it was all necessary.
“As long as I’m here, unless a Two-digit number targets them, no one can hurt them,” the Reincarnation Emperor promised solemnly.
“With your word, I feel relieved,”.
Wang Ping nodded slightly.
After that, Wang Ping did not continue to chat with the Reincarnation Emperor, instead focusing on his own arrangements.
When Wang Ping finished all these things, he went to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
“Welcome back. Congratulations on successfully killing that Strange object. If everything goes as expected, the Heaven Tower will grant you a lot of World Sources. Possessing those World Sources, as long as you retrieve the lost chat group source of Alpha, and add this pearl, you have a chance to advance to Two-digit.”
As soon as Wang Ping returned to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, Huang Huihui laughed delightedly, said this cheekily, and also took out a strange pearl filled with unusual force.
“Isn’t it said that upgrading to Two-digit can only be achieved through Heaven Tower challenges?”
Wang Ping frowned slightly and asked with some confusion.
“Under normal circumstances, it is indeed so. However, that’s just the normal case. In fact, there is another method of promotion, which is also the genuine way to become a Two-digit cultivator. Otherwise, it’s no more than a fake Two-digit number.”
Huang Huihui nodded affirmatively and then spoke mysteriously.
“You mean… the Two-digit cultivators in Myriad Heavens Paradise are all considered fake?”
Wang Ping’s eyes contracted, showing a shocked expression.
“Only Two-digit success achieved through the Heaven Tower’s rewards can be considered a fake. Only those who advance on their own to the Two-digit can be called the true Two-digit. They are also called Transcenders, transcending and dominating over the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.”
Huang Huihui grinned and explained further to Wang Ping.
“Only true Two-digit cultivators can destroy and create Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms at will. Those fake Two-digit ones, although recognized as Two-digit by the Heaven Tower, and have the power to destroy and create Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, they need to pay a huge price to achieve this. And the so-called creation of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms is nothing more than returning to the state before destruction, not truly creating a new one.”
“Hehe, now you should understand the difference between the two.”
“So, only the Senior from the chat group is the genuine Two-digit who advances on his own…Isn’t he the strongest existence in Myriad Heavens Paradise then?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered, his heart not calming down.
Previously, he thought that Senior was powerful, but there should be rivals in the Myriad Heavens Paradise. However, Wang Ping never imagined that the other party would be so terrifying, the only Two-digit Chosen One, the only Transcender.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279 - 1279 323 The Truth of Two-digit Numbers The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1279: Chapter 323: The Truth of Two-digit Numbers! The First Two-digit Number Item_3 Chapter 1279: Chapter 323: The Truth of Two-digit Numbers! The First Two-digit Number Item_3 However, Alpha once said that the first generation leader didn’t become the strongest existence, and there was still a long distance from the strongest one.
Perhaps, Alpha’s knowledge was too shallow and he didn’t know the true details of the first generation leader.
That’s right, Alpha’s peak was only four digits, he couldn’t have much knowledge.
Of course, being far from the strongest might not be an issue.
Even the true Two-Digit existence, compared to One-Digit, seems a little too insignificant.
Besides, Alpha’s creator never showed up; the secrets of Primitive Earth were unknown to all.
“Can the source of the chatting group actually help one advance to Two-Digit? And, what is that thing in your hand?”
Wang Ping came to his senses, staring at the strange bead in Huang Huihui’s hand, and asked curiously.
“You should already know that the source of the chatting group can be transformed into the source you need. That is to say, as long as you have a large amount of world-source, you can use it to transform into the source that helps you transcend. However, this alone is far from enough to advance to the Two-Digit level.”
Huang Huihui chuckled and continued to educate Wang Ping enthusiastically.
“The other two conditions are to refine a Pseudo Two-Digit spirit grid. With these conditions combined, you have a one to three percent chance of breaking the limit and becoming a true Two-Digit.”
“Refining a Pseudo Two-Digit spirit grid…”
Wang Ping’s pupils shrank slightly.
What a ruthless move.
Two-Digit… no, the birth of Pseudo Two-Digit is so difficult, but it was used merely as advancing materials.
That senior, he is quite ruthless indeed.
“So, that means he has killed a Pseudo Two-Digit?”
Wang Ping suddenly thought of something and asked with some astonishment.
“Yes,” Huang Huihui nodded, showing a look of admiration and pride, “The palace master succeeded in advancing by killing a Pseudo Two-Digit and refining its spirit grid. No one knows about this because the palace master erased all traces of that existence. Only those Pseudo Two-Digit beings knew about it.”
“Hehehe, because of this, those Pseudo Two-Digit powerhouses are so afraid of the palace master. This is why they dare not harbor ill intentions towards you. Otherwise, with you being so high-profile, you would have been killed long ago.”
Immediately, Huang Huihui laughed again, teasing those seemingly superior Two-Digit existences in the eyes of others, and also Wang Ping.
“If it weren’t for that senior, I wouldn’t be so high-profile either,” Wang Ping smiled and said casually.
“Haha, that’s true,” Huang Huihui smiled playfully.
“What is that thing in your hand? Is it a Pseudo Two-Digit spirit grid? It doesn’t look like it.”
Wang Ping stared at the strange bead in Huang Huihui’s hand and spoke.
“Of course not,” Huang Huihui rolled her eyes, threw it to Wang Ping, and said, “This is the Two-Digit Tool: Ten Thousand Ways, the only thing you can rely on to save your life.”
“…..”
Wang Ping took the tool, quite surprised.
That senior, he was really generous, giving a Two-Digit tool just like that.
Then, Wang Ping checked the effect of this Two-Digit Tool: Ten Thousand Ways.
Two-Digit Tool: Ten Thousand Ways: By using this tool, the power of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms can be added to one’s body, obtaining an immensely powerful force.
The effect of this tool was simple and straightforward, purely enhancing one’s power.
So, just like when he fought against the Dark Quasi-Immortal Emperor, that senior wanted him to kill the terrifying enemy that was about to arrive with his own power?
At the same time, they wanted him to pave his way to the Two-Digit level.
“Alright, I’ve said everything I have to say, now it’s up to you. If you fail, well, too bad.”
Huang Huihui casually came over, patted Wang Ping’s arm, and muttered.
“If I fail, what will happen?” Wang Ping frowned slightly, slowly saying, “Will the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms be destroyed?”
“Who knows, I’m just the messenger.”
Huang Huihui shrugged.
“……” Wang Ping gave Huang Huihui a deep look and didn’t continue to inquire.
Wang Ping knew that even if he questioned further, he wouldn’t be able to ask anything useful.
However, he could be sure that a great disaster that would sweep across the entire Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms might erupt soon.
This could be the senior’s plan, or it could occur naturally.
Regardless, he must face the imminent catastrophe.
If the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms were destroyed, although not everything would be lost, the people he was familiar with would indeed die.
As for whether the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms would be restored or not, Wang Ping felt there was still a catch.
After all, according to Huang Huihui, those Pseudo Two-Digit beings would have to pay a huge price to destroy and revive the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, and they may not be willing to do so.
Moreover, what if those beings couldn’t resist the upcoming catastrophe?
It was also possible that those Pseudo Two-Digit beings had been warned and were not allowed to take action.
All of these were uncertain.
Anyway, Wang Ping could only rely on himself and not put his hope on others.
“Senior, you really don’t give me any time to catch my breath.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1280 - 1280 323 The Truth of the Two-Digit Number

﻿Chapter 1280: Chapter 323 The Truth of the Two-Digit Number! The First Two-Digit Number Tool _4 Chapter 1280: Chapter 323 The Truth of the Two-Digit Number! The First Two-Digit Number Tool _4 With a helpless shake of his head, Wang Ping refrained from saying more.
After bidding Huang Huihui farewell, he set off towards a certain destination.
The next thing he needed to do was to reclaim the Chat Group Source, which was the very same Chat Group Source that Dao Yi, the Second Generation Chat Group Leader, had sold off.
He could see into the past and the future.
All he could say was that Dao Yi was foolish, obliviously unaware of the precious value of the Chat Group Source and selling it off carelessly.
The faction that granted Dao Yi the Temporary Demon King Authority likewise had no idea about the value of the Chat Group Source.
Neither Dao Yi nor the formidable faction were aware of the truth about the Chat Group Source.
However, the leader of this powerful faction, to his credit, had detected the extraordinariness of the Chat Group Source and was busy researching it.
In the future, his research would uncover some secrets and stir up some waves.
Of course, this future timeline was predicted based on the premise that he did not intervene, or that no major disaster occurred.
…
The Tail Alliance, this force, was quite notorious in the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
That’s because the Tail Alliance was a coalition formed by Demon Kings, infamous in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, and a source of dread and fear for countless people.
Were it not for the overwhelming strength of the Tail Alliance, which boasted over a two-digit number of Three-Digit Demon Kings and a leader who was a Three-Digit pinnacle existence, the notorious Tail Alliance would have been annihilated long ago.
Of course, if that was merely all there was to it, any two-digit existence with a disliking for them could easily annihilated them.
However, such forces usually have complex internal structures, with some two-digit existence backing them one way or another.
This is why they have managed to survive till now, eliciting fear and awe, and striding about confidently.
However, the good fortune of the Tail Alliance was about to end.
Standing aloof and lofty, Wang Ping looked down upon the Tail Alliance below, his face impassive and without any killing intent, just like a still water.
To the current Wang Ping, only a two-digit entity could make him take notice.
Even if the Tail Alliance was the next biggest force in the Myriad Heavens Paradise after the two-digit powerhouses, with no one daring to provoke them, it was still not enough to draw Wang Ping’s interest.
Next, Wang Ping unveiled his overwhelming aura, instantly menacing the Tail Alliance’s headquarters.
In an instant, the Tail Alliance’s headquarter’s grand formation was rapidly activated, but was similarly on the brink of collapse.
This roused all the Three-Digit Demon Kings of the Tail Alliance from their shock, looking fearfully at the sky, putting their own matters aside and reinforcing the grand formation.
“Heaven Derivative, we, the Tail Alliance, have no grudge with you! You attacking us all of a sudden is rather overbearing!”
One of the Three-Digit Demon Kings looked indignant and roared in rage.
As he roared, this three-digit demon king was also shocked, not expecting Wang Ping, who had just become a three-digit, to be so powerful.
This amount of power was on par with the limit of three-digit powerhouses, and not something they could contend with.
“As the Tail Alliance coveted the Chat Group Source, when you were trading with Dao Yi, did you ever consider ‘no grudge, no grievance’?”
Wang Ping said nonchalantly.
“However, I am not here to argue with you today. Tail Demon King, come out.”
“Fellow Daoist, the thing was done by the people below, it has nothing to do with us. If a fellow Daoist is resentful about it, I can kill them to appease you right now, at the same time, we can offer a special three-digit treasure as a token of apology.”
A figure, seeming like a snake, suddenly appeared in mid-air, with a forced smile on his face.
“No need for any apology. My goal is only one, that is to kill you all clean, to clear you rats.”
Wang Ping looked indifferently at the Tail Demon King, speaking calmly.
The future that Wang Ping saw, these Demon Kings had all chosen to be his enemies, always sneaking attacks.
Therefore, Wang Ping had no interest in wasting words with them, directly announcing his intentions, then killing them clean, and reclaiming the Chat Group Source.

chapters.title: Chapter 1281 - 1281 324 Annihilation The Second Special Mode
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1281: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! Chapter 1281: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! “Hmph, if you want to wipe us out, let’s see if you’re capable. Even if you’ve reached the three-digit limit level, how confident are you in dealing with ten three-digit Demon Kings at the same time?”
The Tail Demon King wore a cold expression, radiating murderous intent.
However, he didn’t have any intention of using his Demon King authority to pull Wang Ping into the game world.
After all, taking into account Wang Ping’s game handle and his startling tower climbing rating, Wang Ping either belonged among the cunning smart types or he was the type with terrifying talents.
In the face of such existence, to initiate a game would be asking for trouble.
Once the game starts, even if his strength surpasses Wang Ping’s, he risks defeat.
After all, the Demon King game of Myriad Heavens Paradise requires a corresponding strategy that allows players to win based not purely on a difference in strength, but on wits and luck.
Meanwhile, although Myriad Heavens Paradise prohibits players from fighting among themselves, this rule only applies in the middle and lower-tier cities. There are no such restrictions in the upper layers.
Even if there were, the restriction only exists between ordinary players; a Demon King can attack others at will, but so can others attack the Demon King.
As such, possessing the Demon King’s Token has pros and cons.
“Come out, God-devouring Insect.”
Wang Ping showed no regard for the Tail Demon King, said nothing more, and merely summoned a pitch-black insect. It was about a meter long and had a hideous appearance.
With the emergence of the insect, a horrifying energy spread out, causing the expressions of all the Demon Kings to change dramatically.
The Tail Demon King’s expression also darkened.
He hadn’t expected that Wang Ping would have a summon at the three-digit limit level.
This level of summon shouldn’t be something that a three-digit being could possess.
At the very least, within Myriad Heavens Paradise, he had never heard of a three-digit being capable of such a terrifying summon.
“What does it matter if you have a three-digit limit level summon? As long as our players can hold back the insect, I can easily deal with you.”
The Tail Demon King’s face quickly reverted to a cold stare. He bellowed and lunged towards Wang Ping.
At the same time, the other Demon Kings also attacked the God-devouring Insect in perfect harmony, recklessly using their items.
“Demon Forbidden Domain.”
Wang Ping was calm and uttered softly.
Following his words, a widespread invisible field appeared.
Under this field, all talents and items, except those of Wang Ping’s, couldn’t be used.
Wang Ping had once obtained a 5-digit Talent—Demon Forbidden Domain from the Heaven Tower.
Now that his own talent had reached three digits, he could easily create his desired talent abilities by consuming energy.
Although these temporarily created talent abilities would disappear as soon as he stopped consuming energy, they were still terrifying enough.
The Demon Forbidden Domain being used right now was an ultimate upgraded version of the one-time five-digit item—Demon Forbidden Domain.
“!!!”
The Tail Demon King and others felt their talents and items suddenly become ineffective and their pupils contracted in shock.
They had encountered Demon Forbidden Domains before.
However, they had only encountered ones below the three-digit level.
They had never come across one that could single-handedly seal off three-digit talents and premium items.
Most importantly, such abilities usually nullify the effectiveness of talents and items for both parties.
However, Wang Ping’s summon had not disappeared.
For a moment, the Tail Demon King had a bad premonition.
Wang Ping’s trump card was too terrifying.
Perhaps, he was truly in danger of falling here today.
With that thought, the Tail Demon King and the others did not hesitate to flee in different directions, having no intention whatsoever of fighting Wang Ping head-on.
However, as they just started moving, the God-devouring Insect turned into a mysterious black light and moved first, appearing before a three-digit Demon King and easily devouring it.
Under the Demon Forbidden Domain, items couldn’t be used. This Demon King was weakened, after all, physical strength here was categorized as an item.
Considering that the God-devouring Insect was far stronger than the other Demon Kings, it simply devoured them one by one, easily and instantaneously.
As for Wang Ping, he also moved before the Tail Demon King, appearing before him. The Power of Chaos surged, forming the Chaotic Immortal Fist. With enough power to destroy the Profound World and the horrifying Power of Divergence, it bombarded the Tail Demon King.
The Tail Demon King wore a distressed expression as he could only retaliate with all his might against Wang Ping.
In the next moment, the Tail Demon King was directly blasted off and his body shattered, suffering heavy damage.
Although he quickly recovered, his face was pale and he was startled.
His strength was almost equal to Wang Ping’s just now, theoretically, neither of them should have been able to harm the other.
However, he was easily injured by Wang Ping.
Wang Ping had seen through his thoughts, deciphered his secret technique, and there was also a strange power that dissolved his attack, striking directly at his spirit grid.
As a result, he was in such a predicament that he was heavily injured in one strike, with his spirit grid nearly shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1282 - 1282 324 Annihilation The Second Special Mode
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1282: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! _2 Chapter 1282: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! _2 “Are you, really a three-digit?”
Tail Demon King stared at Wang Ping and asked bitterly.
“Do you think I would be a two-digit?” Wang Ping answered indifferently.
“You can’t be a two-digit.” Tail Demon King fell silent for a moment before continuing, “But you can’t be called a three-digit either. The vitality of a three-digit is too strong. Even if a three-digit limit fights a three-digit legend, it would take hundreds to thousands of times to completely eliminate it. But, you and I are in the same class. However, you almost blasted me with one punch, which is far beyond the level of battle power that a three-digit should have.”
“However, even if your current battle power surpasses that of a three-digit and can be counted as the strongest among the three-digit, you need to pay a bloody price if you want to kill me.”
Tail Demon King paused for a moment and continued with a fierce expression.
“Boring. Your trump card, your thoughts are all in my eyes. So, your tricks won’t work on me.”
Wang Ping spoke indifferently, took a step forward, and invisible ripples spread out.
Then, Tail Demon King’s face changed drastically, and he found that his body couldn’t move and his power was sealed.
Is this some kind of supernatural technique?
No, this is a binding type of special equipment, at least at the three-digit level.
“Your struggle is in vain in front of my talent.”
Wang Ping said this in a somewhat villainous manner before completely blasting Tail Demon King with a punch under his resentful gaze.
Thus, a Demon King, who was just below the two-digit and had a notorious reputation in Myriad Heavens Paradise as a three-digit limit, was killed by Wang Ping’s two punches without even the power to take out his trump card, dying in a very humiliating way.
You can’t say Tail Demon King is weak. It’s just that Wang Ping is too strong.
Now Wang Ping has whatever talent he wants and when combined, it’s simply invincible.
Next, Wang Ping looked at the other Demon Kings.
At this moment, the nine three-digit Demon Kings of Tail Alliance had already killed three God-devouring Insects, leaving seven.
The remaining six Demon Kings all looked in the direction of Wang Ping, shivering all over, and felt the long-lost emotion called fear.
As three-digit Demon Kings, whether they were walking in Myriad Heavens Paradise or the countless worlds, they were objects of fear to others.
They have personally destroyed hundreds of worlds, countless living beings have feared and perished because of their existence.
Now, they also felt fear in their hearts and saw death.
“It seems that the three-digit people in Myriad Heavens Paradise are still worse than the three-digit people who break through the boundary by cultivating themselves.”
Wang Ping looked at these three-digit Demon Kings and made a comment.
For someone like Reincarnation Emperor, they wouldn’t react like this even if they faced certain death in this situation.
It can only be said that Myriad Heavens Paradise is a good place that can easily nurture four-digit and even three-digit powerhouses, but in terms of mental state, they are still worse than those bitter cultivators.
Apart from this, they might also be a bit weaker in terms of their fighting power at the same level.
“God-devouring Insect, how long do you want to play?”
Then, Wang Ping looked at the God-devouring Insect and reprimanded him.
Upon hearing this, the God-devouring Insect embarrassingly scratched its head with its claws and then burst out with even more terrifying speed and power, killing the fleeing Demon Kings one by one.
Afterward, Wang Ping casually glanced at the three-digit Demon Kings below Tail Alliance, and they all burst open and died without leaving their bodies intact.
After the death of the three-digit Demon King, the large formations were no longer able to resist Wang Ping’s power.
Next, Wang Ping took away the ‘gold coins’ that these Demon Kings burst out, especially after taking away the source of the Chat Group, and then left the place.
Because of the not-so-small battle, some three-digit powerhouses arrived here. When they found that Tail Alliance had been wiped out, they all showed shocked expressions, guessing who did it.
Soon after, the news of Tail Alliance being destroyed spread throughout Myriad Heavens Paradise, shocking countless living beings.
The Chaotic Order Power was all overjoyed.
After all, Tail Alliance was sort of the standard bearer for the Chaotic Evil Forces and a force that all the Order Power found headache and even feared.
Now that this force has been wiped out, the Chaotic Evil Forces in the countless realms and Myriad Heavens are no longer strong enough to compete against them.
Unless a terrifying existence supports a new Tail Alliance to emerge.
As for the Chaotic Evil Forces, they were all fearful in their hearts, feeling that their own power must be low-key for a while, otherwise they could also be wiped out.
The countless realms are vast, but for some terrifying beings, they are also small and not hard to find for them.
In the Upper region, two-digit figures with connections to Tail Alliance learned of the incident and were silent, not expressing their stance, completely lacking the courage to take action against Wang Ping.
…..
On Wang Ping’s side, after killing the Demon Kings of Tail Alliance, he came to the lower realm in an avatar form to Alpha’s side.
Wang Ping’s sudden appearance startled Alpha, who then said dazedly: “Wang Ping, congratulations on breaking through to the Fairy Emperor Level and becoming a three-digit existence.”
Although she had been shocked many times, Wang Ping always brought her surprise and even terror.
It hasn’t been long since Wang Ping became a Fairy Emperor, which really shocked Alpha so much that she became numb.

chapters.title: Chapter 1283 - 1283 324 Annihilation The Second Special Mode
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1283: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! _3 Chapter 1283: Chapter 324: Annihilation! The Second Special Mode! _3 38-Year-Old Immortal Emperor, he really exists…
“Being an Immortal Emperor is nothing special. Only when you become a Two-digit number or above can you be considered transcendent.”
Wang Ping shook his head slightly and spoke softly.
“(⊙o⊙)…” Alpha was speechless and couldn’t find any words to say.
“Our chat group should be developed properly. Since I have already become a Three-digit number, theoretically, we should move to the upper-middle level. However, I prefer to get things done in one fell swoop. So, wait until I become a Two-digit number. Then I’ll take you guys directly to the upper-level area, and develop the Third Generation Transmigrator Chat Group into a Two-digit number power comparable to Chenwang Palace.”
At this time, Wang Ping spoke again.
“(⊙o⊙)…” Alpha opened her mouth, not knowing how to respond. Her mind was having trouble processing this.
She really couldn’t have imagined that she would one day mix it up in the upper layers, let alone develop the Transmigrator Chat Group into a Two-digit number power.
“I believe you.” In the end, all Alpha could do was to choke out these four words.
“Are you going to challenge the tower again?”
Next, as if realizing something, Alpha spoke up.
“Yes.” Wang Ping nodded, and said, “I came here to tell you some things and I also have some things to give you.”
“Give those things to me after you finish the tower challenge. Otherwise, what you’re doing now is like telling me your last words.”
Alpha calmed down entirely and spoke seriously.
“What nonsense are you talking about?” Wang Ping patted Alpha’s head and rolled his eyes: “How could I be saying my last words? I’m just taking some precautionary measures.”
Although the senior from the first-generation chat group sent someone to hint at what he should do next.
However, Wang Ping won’t listen to him completely; otherwise, he’d always be his pawn.
As a result, to truly break away and change from a pawn to a flag bearer, Wang Ping felt he had to play his cards differently.
This may carry a certain risk, but it may help him change his identity and break free from control.
“…I understand.”
Alpha was silent for a while and didn’t continue to doubt.
Then, Wang Ping handed many items to Alpha and said, “Before I come back, use these resources to develop the chat group. You can recruit a large number of transmigrators and also focus on cultivating the potential members like Chen Yao and Lin Yuanyuan.”
After saying that, Wang Ping’s avatar disappeared.
Wang Ping gave all the Three-digit top-notch items and below, which were useless to him, to Alpha.
Even the Three-digit top-notch item, Devouring God Insect, Wang Ping handed it over to Alpha for safekeeping.
With these resources and special items, even if a top-tier Three-digit power attacks them, Alpha would still be able to counterattack.
As a result, Wang Ping could be relieved to the greatest extent.
…
Next, Wang Ping’s true body’s thoughts moved, and he appeared in the Sky Tower Space.
“Player Heaven Derivative, welcome back. Are you ready to start the 60th floor game immediately? However, due to the lack of players, you may need to wait in the game space for a longer time.”
Sky Tower Intelligence’s agile voice sounded.
“Sky Tower Intelligence, with my current abilities, slowly challenging the tower and participating in ordinary games have little significance, right?”
Wang Ping’s eyes flickered as he spoke in a deep voice.
“So, could you provide me with another special game? Only special games have any degree of difficulty.”
“Player Heaven Derivative, given your situation, you indeed don’t need to slowly challenge the tower. That would be a waste of time. However, are you sure you want another special game?”
The voice of Sky Tower Intelligence sounded, filled with interest.
This confirmed to Wang Ping once more.
That is, Sky Tower Intelligence can truly manipulate some things secretly.
He still didn’t know whether this was Sky Tower Intelligence’s own idea or the interference of the senior from the first-generation chat group, but Wang Ping couldn’t worry about that now.
He could only hope that this was Sky Tower Intelligence’s own idea.
If not, he’d never be able to escape that man’s control.
“Yes. I want a special game that grants Pseudo Two-digit Spirit Grid Rewards.”
Wang Ping took a deep breath and spoke in a deep voice.
“Player Heaven Derivative, you will obtain Pseudo Two-digit Spirit Grid Rewards in this special game. When you break through this game, you will directly jump to the 80th floor. I wish you an enjoyable game.”
Sky Tower Intelligence’s meaningful voice sounded, causing Wang Ping to furrow his brows slightly.
However, Wang Ping could only suppress his thoughts and chose to start the game.
Then, Wang Ping’s consciousness flickered, and he was enveloped in a white light, arriving in the special mode game world.
When Wang Ping’s vision became clear, he found himself in a small room, sitting on a chair.
In front of the chair was a square table with a deck of cards on it.
On the chair opposite, there was a blond man sitting, staring at him with confident blue eyes, and said, “Player Heaven Derivative, welcome to my game world.”
This made Wang Ping frown slightly.
He sensed his own situation and found it to be as he had expected.
In this special mode, his talents were once again restricted.
This time, the restrictions were even stricter than in the last special mode, as he could only see one future.
At the same time, his creation ability and causal ability couldn’t be used either.
“This is really troublesome.”
Wang Ping sighed.
“This is your personal choice. If you don’t choose the special mode and slowly challenge the tower, with your talents and abilities, you can easily reach the 85th floor.”
The blond man spoke, his tone mocking.
“Are you an incarnation of Sky Tower Intelligence?”
Wang Ping stared at the man, narrowed his eyes, and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1284 - 1284 325 Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1284: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! Chapter 1284: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! “Do you think I could be such an existence?”
In response to Wang Ping’s question, the golden-haired man countered.
“Perhaps you are, perhaps not. But that’s not important. What I need to do now is pass this Special Mode, right?”
Wang Ping calmed his mind and spoke serenely.
If it were just an NPC in the game world, it would obviously not know that he had chosen the Special Mode, let alone mock him.
Thus, the possibility that the golden-haired man in front of him was the embodiment of the Tower’s intelligence was not small.
Of course, it was also possible that the Tower’s intelligence had informed the NPC in this Special Mode about his actions.
“You’re right.” The golden-haired man nodded in approval and continued, “None of those things are important. What’s important is whether you can pass this game.”
“Although you have a chance to revive, even if you fail this game, you can start again. I suppose that’s why you had the confidence to choose the Special Mode.”
The golden-haired man placed his fingers under his chin and spoke with a light laugh.
“However, I need to tell you one thing. That is, although you can revive, if you fail the game, it also means that you lose the opportunity to challenge the Special Mode again. At the same time, you will also lose the chance to get the SSS tier evaluation for all floors. You don’t need me to tell you the consequences.”
“Just tell me what the content of the game is. Since I chose the Special Mode on my own, I have considered all the consequences.”
Wang Ping’s expression remained calm, not showing any fear.
“Hehe.” The golden-haired man chuckled and stopped wasting words. Instead, he picked up the unopened deck of poker cards on the table and said, “The content of this game is simple. We draw one card each, and whoever has the bigger card wins.”
The golden-haired man’s words made Wang Ping frown slightly.
The content of the game was indeed simple.
However, the simpler the game, the bigger the hidden problem.
Otherwise, this Special Mode would be just giving away points.
Especially when his innate ability is to foresee the future, it’s even more like giving away points.
After all, he just needs to foresee the future, look at all the cards once, and he’ll know where the biggest card is.
Apart from that, there are other operations.
“Big king is the biggest, followed by the little king, then Spades 2, and so on. Diamonds 3 is the smallest.”
While Wang Ping was thinking, the golden-haired man spoke again. He skillfully opened the poker cards and said.
Then, in front of Wang Ping, he made sure the poker cards were indeed unopened.
Next, the golden-haired man closed his eyes, mixed up all the cards, and began to shuffle the deck rapidly.
After the golden-haired man finished shuffling, he gestured for Wang Ping to shuffle as well.
At this, Wang Ping frowned slightly and closed his eyes to shuffle the cards too.
During this process, the golden-haired man did not look at him.
After washing the cards, the golden-haired man closed his eyes and shuffled again.
As a result, no one knew where the big and little kings were.
It seemed that the game relied entirely on luck.
“As a player, you have the privilege to draw cards first. Please.”
The golden-haired man looked at Wang Ping and made a gesture of invitation.
On this point, Wang Ping didn’t take the bait, but just frowned and pondered.
The situation was very strange, as if drawing cards was entirely a matter of luck.
However, in the Tower Game, there couldn’t possibly be a game that relied solely on luck.
Therefore, there must be some mystery hidden within this.
If he made a wrong move and his thinking went awry, a tragedy would surely befall him.
“What’s the matter? Are you scared and don’t dare to draw?”
The golden-haired man stared at Wang Ping and asked with a smile.
“Don’t rush me. There’s no time limit for this game, so I can think it through.”
Wang Ping remained calm and collected.
“Hehe, take your time.”
The golden-haired man didn’t seem to be in a hurry and spoke casually.
After the golden-haired man’s words, the room fell into dead silence.
Wang Ping showed no expression, mulling over various possibilities and then rejecting them one by one.
Finally, Wang Ping came up with a chilling possibility.
Though it seemed far-fetched, Wang Ping’s intuition told him that this possibility had more than a thirty percent chance.
Given the limited information available, a probability of over thirty percent was already quite high.
Although this probability was Wang Ping’s own judgment, he believed in his intuition.
After all, luck is part of one’s strength, and intuition can sometimes save lives.
Then, Wang Ping suddenly launched an attack on the golden-haired man, punching him straight in the face.
The punch was fast, accurate, and fierce.
“Bang!”
However, facing Wang Ping’s sudden punch, the golden-haired man caught it steadily, not moving back an inch.
“Hey, hey, hey, attacking your opponent directly is against the rules.”
The golden-haired man laughed and shook off Wang Ping’s fist.
“You didn’t mention this rule, so it’s your fault.” Wang Ping calmly pulled back his fist and spoke.
“Hehe, indeed, I forgot to mention it. So, let me add it now: during the game, you’re not allowed to attack your opponent. If you attack me again next time, there might be a penalty.”
The golden-haired man spoke slowly.
“I understand.”
Wang Ping nodded and looked deep into the golden-haired man’s eyes.
From the probe just now, Wang Ping had discovered some details.
This made Wang Ping more certain of the guess in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1285 - 1285 325 Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1285: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _2 Chapter 1285: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _2 Therefore, he was willing to take a gamble.
Suddenly, Wang Ping summoned the special item, Star Moon God, and fused with it, enhancing his power.
This made the blond man narrow his eyes, watching Wang Ping with great interest, curious to see what he wanted to do.
At this moment, Wang Ping used his gift of simulating the future.
In the future he simulated, there were various possibilities.
Thus, he could easily see the position of each card.
When Wang Ping used his gift and made a move to draw a card, the blond man’s eyes flashed, seemingly enjoying the show.
However, Wang Ping’s next move caught him off guard.
Instead of drawing a card, Wang Ping suddenly changed his move and slapped the table. He used a subtle force to flick the poker cards into the air, making them clearly visible to the naked eye.
Seeing this, the blond man’s pupils contracted, and he thought it was not good. He quickly summoned a Star Moon God just like Wang Ping’s, trying to snatch the big king card.
However, Wang Ping had already fused with the Star Moon God one step ahead and was closer to the card, having plotted his move in advance.
Thus, Wang Ping easily caught the big king card first.
Then, Wang Ping looked at the blond man and said calmly, “Checkmate.”
“Hehe, well played. How did you find out my secret?”
The blond man stopped his move and laughed.
His panel was the same as Wang Ping’s, with even stronger gifts and items. Moreover, he had the advantage of knowing all of Wang Ping’s secrets so that as long as Wang Ping used his gift first, he could interfere with his ability, making Wang Ping see a false future.
“Maybe it’s the game mechanism, or you talk too much. You revealed too much information at the beginning. You know my secret and my gift, so using my gift must come with some big problem.”
Wang Ping spun the big king card in his hand and spoke calmly.
“Later, I attacked you, and although your strength was greater than mine, your control and skill were very similar to mine, making me suspect that you copied everything about me and optimized it.”
“In other words, you are likely capable of interfering with the future I see. As a result, the normal way of playing the game is absolutely unworkable and a dead end. So, I had to bluff and directly steal the card.”
“Hehe, you’re really something. Your speculation and assumptions are numerous, and you’re essentially gambling. However, you did win the bet. In this game, the more powerful gifts and items you have, the more disadvantageous your situation. You really only have this one method to beat me. Even with this method, if I hadn’t been so careless, your probability of winning wouldn’t have exceeded 50 percent.”
The blond man covered his forehead, feeling a little upset.
“However, your action can be considered a violation of the rules. As a result, you will be penalized for violating the rules, and the penalty is death. That is to say, the one-time resurrection effect of your Proof of the Living has been consumed.”
“…”
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping fell silent.
This damn game is really tricky. The normal way of playing leads to a dead end, and using a brute-force method still risks death.
If others were to play the game, the probability of dying would definitely be as high as 99 percent.
After all, other people don’t have resurrection coins.
Of course, other people’s gifts are not as strong as Wang Ping’s, so their chances of passing through the game with luck might be even higher in normal gameplay.
However, Wang Ping also believed that the game was tailor-made for him. If there were other players participating in the Special Mode, he thought the game content might be quite different.
“Anyway, congratulations on successfully clearing the Special Mode.”
At this moment, the blond man spoke again.
As the blond man’s words fell, Wang Ping’s body was wrapped in a white light.
Then, Wang Ping disappeared from the game world and returned to his empty room.
“It seems that he is indeed the avatar of the Tower Intelligence.”
Once Wang Ping returned, he narrowed his eyes.
Normally, after clearing the game, the voice of the Tower Intelligence would ring out, asking if he wanted to return immediately.
But this time, there was no voice, which seemed very unusual.
As Wang Ping pondered, the Tower Intelligence’s agile voice finally rang out.
“Ding, player Tianyan has been detected to have won in the Special Game, receiving an SSS-tier evaluation. You have obtained an SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest.”
“Ding, player Tianyan, congratulations on obtaining the special reward: Pseudo-Two-Digit Spirit Grid. At the same time, player Tianyan’s floor will be advanced to the 80th floor, equivalent to clearing the first 79 floors and achieving an SSS-tier evaluation.”
“Ding, Tower-wide Announcement: Player Tianyan has once again cleared the Special Game World and obtained an SSS-tier evaluation. Player Tianyan will have the qualification to advance directly to the 80th floor.”
…..
“I’ve got the Pseudo-Two-Digit Spirit Grid, and I’m going straight to the 80th floor. The distance between me and that person is getting closer.”
Hearing the voice of the Tower Intelligence, Wang Ping’s eyes sparkled as he muttered to himself.
At this moment, everyone in Myriad Heavens Paradise was once again shocked, even somewhat numb.
It wasn’t their mental strength that was lacking, but rather they were so shocked that words couldn’t describe how they felt.

chapters.title: Chapter 1286 - 1286 325 Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1286: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _3 Chapter 1286: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _3 There was no choice. It hadn’t been long since Wang Ping completed the special game, reached the sixtieth layer, became a three-digit strength, and destroyed the Tail Alliance.
As a result, Wang Ping made such a big commotion in such a short period, which was truly frightening.
Such achievements, even for those with three-digit strength, were astonishing and beyond words.
All praise seemed extremely pale in comparison.
“Is this for real? Did Heaven Tower give him some sort of cheat? No one else has triggered any special game. And now, he just skips layers, all the way to the 80th Floor.”
Even those with two-digit strength had some doubts about their own achievements.
“Regardless of his circumstances, there’s no question that he’s a monster. It’s very unlikely that anyone can surpass his tower-climbing record.”
“Absolutely, this is just too amazing.”
“If everything goes smoothly, he should become a two-digit number now. The reward for the 80th Floor includes a two-digit spirit grid…”
As the person with two-digit strength finished speaking, there was no more response from those with two-digit strength, falling into a completely dead silence.
Their mood was extremely complex.
With the appearance of the monster from Chenwang Palace and then effortlessly breaking the record to reach Heaven Derivative, they felt that they were waste materials.
They were all two-digit numbers, but why did these two need to show off so much?
What’s worse, these two came from the same force, making people even more silent.
“Come to think of it, that guy hasn’t come out for a long time. I have some suspicion that he is trapped on the ninetieth floor and cannot come out.”
At this time, some two-digit person suddenly spoke up.
“Hehe, what are you trying to say?”
Another two-digit person sneered.
“It’s an opportunity. I’ve been investigating for years and discovered the secret behind his strength. Although we are all two-digit numbers, you should all be clear that he is the real two-digit number. According to my investigation, he was able to become a true two-digit number because he refined a fake two-digit spirit grid. In addition, the Chat Group Source also played a crucial role.”
The two-digit person who spoke before patiently persuaded them.
“If that person is trapped in the ninetieth floor of Heaven Tower, perhaps we will also have a chance to step into the realm of a true two-digit number if we take action against Heaven Derivative. By then, even if he comes out, he won’t be able to control everything by himself.”
“Heng Tian, if you want to die, go by yourself. Don’t drag us into it.”
Another two-digit person mocked.
“You are the one behind the Tail Demon King. You have been secretly planning for the Chat Group Source. That’s why you sent the Tail Demon King to act in secret. However, you didn’t expect to be exposed so quickly. At the same time, you didn’t expect Heaven Derivative to grow so fast and a horrific genius to find the Tail Alliance and destroy it.”
“Now that the matter has been exposed, you are afraid of Heaven Derivative taking revenge on you, but we don’t have that worry. As for becoming a true two-digit number, ha, it is not something that can be easily promoted. Even with a method, the success rate won’t exceed 10%. You want to die, but we don’t.”
After that, the auras of those two-digit people all disappeared.
This caused the two-digit strength person named Heng Tian’s face to become incredibly dark.
“A bunch of cowards.”
In the end, Heng Tian could only silently curse the other two-digit strength people in his heart, planning to act alone.
At this point, he could no longer care about the person from Chenwang Palace.
As for apologizing to Wang Ping, he never considered it.
This was not an issue for a true man, but a matter of life and death for one of them.
Heng Tian did not believe Wang Ping would not be interested in becoming a two-digit number.
Since he had thoughts, then he would very likely attack his sworn enemy and seize his spirit grid, which was the precondition for him to upgrade to a two-digit number.
He was a fake two-digit number, and he had to refine a fake two-digit spirit grid again.
The one from before did it the same way.
Immediately, Heng Tian began to take action, preparing to send people to the lower realm to deal with Alpha.
If he could capture Alpha, perhaps it would make Wang Ping hesitate to act.
Originally, Heng Tian did not want to move against Alpha.
After all, Alpha’s background was too big, and her creator was too mysterious.
At the same time, there was also the connection with the person from Chenwang Palace.
Although the person from Chenwang Palace disassembled Alpha and took the Chat Group Source away, no one knew what he was really thinking.
For this reason, Heng Tian targeted the Chat Group Source and Alpha but only dared to act secretly. He instigated Guwu Tao One Union Killing Paradise to act against Alpha and had Tao One rebel and take most of the Chat Group Source.
However, even so, he didn’t have the idea to move against Alpha directly.
Both the person from Chenwang Palace and Alpha’s creator made him extremely apprehensive, and he did not dare to go too far.
But at this point, he had no choice but to take high-profile action against Alpha.
For his survival and promotion to a two-digit number, he had to do it.
….
Just as the two-digit existence Heng Tian took action, Wang Ping also absorbed the fake two-digit spirit grid and successfully advanced to the fake two-digit level.
If Wang Ping came to the outside world, he would definitely be considered the 37th two-digit number.
However, Wang Ping didn’t think about these things for now. He looked at his SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest and chose to open it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1287 - 1287 325 Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1287: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _4 Chapter 1287: Chapter 325: Wang Ping Advancing to the Fake Double Digits! Astonishing Rewards! _4 “Ding, congratulations on opening the SSS-tier Abyss Treasure Chest, you have obtained the following rewards:
①. All Attributes +50,000.
②. Two-digit Low-level Special Item: Eternal Frost.
③. Two-digit Low-level Item: Mithril’s Blessing.
④.. Three-digit top-grade special item: Proof of the Living.
⑤. Incomplete Two-digit Rule Stone.
⑥. Several three-digit special tools.”
Two-digit special item: Eternal Frost: A one-time special item. Using this item can permanently freeze a pseudo two-digit powerhouse.
ps: This item is a special item and will be adjusted accordingly in the Sky Tower Game.
Two-digit special item: Mithril’s Blessing: With this item, any curse or negative effect targeting the holder will be erased and rendered ineffective.
Even when faced with a curse ability that surpasses the level of this item, there will be a corresponding erasing effect.
ps: This item is a special item and will be adjusted accordingly in the Sky Tower Game.
Three-digit top-grade special item: Proof of the Living: ……
Incomplete Two-digit Rule Stone: A broken two-digit Rule Stone. If it can be repaired, it can be used to promote talent.
“These rewards are really generous.”
Wang Ping looked at the reward list with great joy.
Having used up one Proof of the Living, he was now rewarded with another, which made him very happy.
At present, he had reached the pseudo two-digit level and no longer needed this item, so he could consider using it to revive the Reincarnation Emperor’s young daughter.
“Two two-digit special items, these are the most precious rewards.”
Wang Ping looked at the two two-digit special items with a gleam in his eye.
Eternal Frost could permanently freeze a two-digit powerhouse, its effect was undeniably strong.
Although Wang Ping suspected that the two-digit powerhouse mentioned here was most likely a pseudo two-digit powerhouse rather than a true two-digit one, the effect was still strong enough.
As for the two-digit special item: Mithril’s Blessing, it was also powerful, being able to immunize against curses and negative effects.
With this item, Wang Ping, even as a newly promoted pseudo two-digit powerhouse, could face off against veteran two-digit powerhouses without worrying about being underhandedly attacked.
Next, Wang Ping glanced at the other rewards that were not elaborated on and found that there were quite a few good items, including several three-digit top-grade special items.
However, these special items were not as valuable as the Proof of the Living, so they were not singled out.
As for
“But now, it seems I’m still not strong enough to break free from his control. I need an even more powerful trump card.”
Wang Ping’s eyes were deep, and he calmed down again.
However, Wang Ping did not plan to continue climbing the tower for the time being.
What he planned to do next was to advance to a true two-digit level, then find a way to complete the Two-digit Rule Stone, and finally promote his talent.
Once he became a true two-digit powerhouse and his talent reached the two-digit level as well, he would have confidence in fighting against the person from the first generation chat group.
Afterward, Wang Ping retracted his thoughts and decided to leave the Sky Tower Space.
When Wang Ping left the Sky Tower Space, an astonishing vision engulfed the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Ordinary people didn’t know what had happened, but those powerful beings who had lived for a long time understood that a new two-digit powerhouse was born.
At the same time, they guessed that Wang Ping had advanced to the two-digit level.
Many powerful beings were envious and in awe of him.
However, Wang Ping showed no pride at this moment, and his face was somber.
After leaving the Sky Tower Space, his talent abilities were restored to their original state, and he was now a pseudo two-digit powerhouse.
As a result, he saw the future in which Alpha and the members of the Third Generation Chat Group were targeted.
If he had come back a little later, even with the numerous trump cards he had given to Alpha, they could not have resisted the offensive of a two-digit power.
The outcome would be that Alpha was captured alive, and all the familiar faces in the Third Generation Chat Group were also captured alive to threaten him.
“Heng Tian, you’re courting death!”
Wang Ping roared angrily, and the sound echoed throughout Myriad Heavens Paradise.
