chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1288: Chapter 326: The Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms Destroyed! Advancing to a Two-Digit Number Chapter 1288: Chapter 326: The Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms Destroyed! Advancing to a Two-Digit Number This furious roar startled the entire Myriad Heavens Paradise, and even the Various Heavens and Worlds were filled with horrifying anomalies due to Wang Ping’s angry howl.
Although he was only in the fake two-digit realm, his power was terrifying enough to shake the entire Various Heavens and Worlds.
As a result, countless beings were terrified, unsure of what had happened and why such a terrifying existence had become furious.
At the same time, those powerful beings who heard Heng Tian’s name had their pupils constrict, becoming even more fearful.
After all, Heng Tian was a two-digit realm powerhouse, and among the two-digit realm powerhouses, he was considered quite ancient, ranked in the top ten.
Although this ranking was merely based on the time it took for them to break through to the two-digit realm, it was enough to prove their prowess.
Now, someone who was likely a two-digit realm powerhouse called Heng Tian by name, even proclaiming that he should die. The implication was too horrifying.
Without a doubt, a battle between two-digit realm powerhouses was about to erupt.
Even three-digit realm beings were not qualified to participate in the battle between two-digit realm powerhouses. Even if they were to watch, they had to be cautious, or they would be killed by the slightest inadvertent impact.
“Wang Ping, let’s go outside the Paradise. Between you and me, we will decide who is superior and who will live or die.”
Heng Tian’s cold voice rang out, causing the entire Various Heavens and Worlds to tremble once again.
For a time, the powerful beings of the Various Heavens and Worlds all showed horrified expressions, knowing that a great catastrophe was about to occur.
As a result, they did not care about the need to battle through the tower after entering the Myriad Heavens Paradise. Those who had reached quadruple digits, or who had once entered the Myriad Heavens Paradise, all fled like refugees, using their Paradise Passes to escape to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
They were well aware that escaping to the Myriad Heavens Paradise was their only chance of survival.
If they continued to stay in the Various Heavens and Worlds, they would surely die.
It was rumored that two-digit realm beings possessed the power to destroy and create the Various Heavens and Worlds.
During a battle between such powerful beings, the entire Various Heavens and Worlds would be destroyed, and the myriad paths would be obliterated.
By then, even if a two-digit realm powerhouse recreated the Various Heavens and Worlds, whether they would be resurrected was truly a question.
No one was willing to gamble on the compassion of the two-digit realm powerhouse. They could only do their best to grasp that last hope of survival.
“!!!”
In the Profound World, the Reincarnation Emperor was stunned.
Wang Ping had already advanced to the two-digit realm… but this was a bit too fast, wasn’t it?
However, how did he end up confronting Heng Tian, an ancient two-digit realm powerhouse, and in a life-or-death situation no less?
“Sigh, it seems that I won’t be able to protect this world.”
Afterward, the Reincarnation Emperor gazed at his homeland with profound eyes and smiled helplessly.
The impact of the battle between the two-digit realm beings was too vast.
There were rumors of a great war between two-digit realm existences in the distant past.
That battle had destroyed the Various Heavens and Worlds.
Although later a powerful being had restored the Various Heavens and Worlds, no one wanted to experience such a thing again.
Moreover, no one could be certain whether they would be resurrected.
However, even so, the Reincarnation Emperor had no intention of fleeing to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
There was no need.
If Wang Ping could win, everything would be fine.
If Wang Ping lost, as someone from Wang Ping’s faction, he would undoubtedly be hunted down.
At the same time, the members of the third generation chat group who were carrying out tasks in different worlds within the Various Heavens and Worlds were all dumbfounded.
They didn’t know what was going on, but upon hearing the name Wang Ping, many instinctively thought of Wang Ping, the big brother of the group.
As a result, people like Lin Yuanyuan immediately contacted Wang Ping.
However, Wang Ping did not respond.
At this moment, Wang Ping was gazing at Heng Tian in the middle and upper layers of the Myriad Heavens Paradise, locking eyes with him and coldly saying, “No, just to determine who is superior and decide life or death? No, today you will perish and become a stepping stone for me to advance to the two-digit realm.”
The moment his words fell, Wang Ping’s mere thought caused all the subordinates sent by Heng Tian to inexplicably die a violent death, completely dead, with no chance for revival even with resurrection items.
“It’s no wonder that you come from the same lineage as that guy, truly arrogant.”
Heng Tian didn’t care about the death of his subordinates, merely snorting coldly, and directly tore open the space of Myriad Heavens Paradise to head outside.
As existences in the two-digit realm, they could destroy the Various Heavens and Worlds, and erasing existences below the two-digit realm was easily accomplished with just a single thought, without any need for special abilities.
Wang Ping sneered, tore apart the space of Myriad Heavens Paradise as well, went to the Various Heavens and Worlds, and stared at Heng Tian across numerous worlds.
No longer restrained by the rules of Myriad Heavens Paradise, the collision of their gazes instantly ignited a terrifying storm of destruction, with worlds crumbling and vanishing along the way.
Among these destroyed worlds were some powerful enough to give birth to three-digit realm existences.
“Kill!”
Immediately afterward, Heng Tian shouted, his voice shaking the Various Heavens and Worlds, causing countless worlds to shatter and turn into nothingness.
Then, he launched himself toward Wang Ping, with endless darkness engulfing everything.
Time, space, past, present, and future, all lost their meaning in the face of this terrifying power.
Wang Ping snorted coldly, and the horrifying Chaos Spirit erupted, leading to the destruction and rebirth of countless worlds within it. It collided with the endless darkness, entangling and destroying each other.
The battle between two-digit realm existences had officially begun.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1289: Chapter 326: The Destruction of the Heavens and Ten Thousand Realms! Advancing to Two-Digit Number_2 Chapter 1289: Chapter 326: The Destruction of the Heavens and Ten Thousand Realms! Advancing to Two-Digit Number_2 Since both of them relied on the Heaven Tower to advance to a two-digit number, there was no distinction of strength in their spirit grids.
Even though Heng Tian had become a two-digit number in an extremely ancient era, he still hadn’t gained any strength enhancement, as his power had been locked away long ago.
For this reason, Heng Tian could not take a significant advantage.
Of course, Wang Ping could not take any advantage either and was even in a relatively weaker position.
After all, even though Heng Tian couldn’t increase his strength, he had lived through a long period of time. His control over two-digit level power and his combat experience at that level were not something Wang Ping could compare to.
However, just like this, neither could do anything to the other, and neither could wipe out the other or determine the outcome completely.
Even if one party killed the other once, the other party could still come back to life.
As long as people remember Wang Ping and Heng Tian’s existence and know them, even if they unconsciously think of them, Wang Ping and Heng Tian could come back to life.
Of course, the thoughts of other two-digit beings were not counted, as they could block out these rules.
To truly kill the other party, one could only seize their spirit grid and completely erase them from the root.
However, to achieve this, the power gap between the two sides must be huge, or one must have terrifying items. Otherwise, it would be difficult to kill another two-digit number by relying solely on combat.
Heng Tian collided with Wang Ping, and a casual hit would explode countless worlds, causing turmoil in the myriad realms.
With murderous intent, he shouted, “Wang Ping, if this is all you can do, then be my nourishment for advancing to a two-digit number.”
As he said that, Heng Tian directly launched an artifact. Creepy darkness began to spread, and a terrifying curse emerged.
It was a frightening curse that could have a huge influence on a two-digit existence.
Obviously, this was one of the two-digit artifacts possessed by Heng Tian.
“Hehe, a curse? If this is your trump card, then you are nothing more than this.”
Wang Ping erupted with terrifying power, trying to dissolve the curse in vain. However, he remained calm and taunted Heng Tian.
His words made Heng Tian frown.
He found that even though Wang Ping’s power could not dissolve the curse, he was not affected by it.
“It seems that you possess a two-digit artifact that can negate curses.”
Heng Tian said solemnly.
“However, even if the curse doesn’t work on you, you are still no match for me. Youngster, in terms of foundation, you are far behind.”
Heng Tian shouted loudly and used another artifact.
After this artifact appeared, a strange figure emerged from the darkness to attack Wang Ping.
This made Wang Ping frown slightly.
It’s because this bizarre figure also had nearly pseudo two-digit level power.
Although, at the pseudo two-digit level, even if it’s two against one, it is challenging to obliterate each other in a short time and would take a very long time. In the end, one would still be worn down.
For this reason, Wang Ping no longer held back and used a two-digit special item: Eternal Frost.
As the two-digit special item Eternal Frost was activated by Wang Ping,
the terrifying frozen rule manifested across the myriad realms. Countless worlds, the shadow, and even Heng Tian himself were all frozen by this horrifying frost, seemingly turning into eternal ice statues.
Upon seeing this scene, other two-digit beings had chills run down their spines.
This item is too powerful, as it can instantly freeze two two-digit beings.
However, what made them feel more complicated is that Wang Ping, a newly promoted two-digit being, actually possessed so many two-digit artifacts.
Keep in mind that even for these two-digit powerhouses, not many have two-digit artifacts.
For example, ancient two-digit beings like Heng Tian might still have two or three two-digit artifacts, while those relatively young two-digit beings could be considered lucky if they had one two-digit item.
It couldn’t be helped, as obtaining a two-digit artifact is extremely difficult.
Even for the floors above the 80th level of the Heaven Tower, obtaining a two-digit artifact is no easy task, requiring a high rating.
This is truly challenging.
Not to mention that two-digit artifacts are one-time-use items, used up after one use.
Moreover, at their level, no one is willing to challenge the tower easily.
After all, they have already reached the pinnacle of existence. Unless it’s a special situation, there’s no need to risk their lives to obtain a two-digit artifact.
However, although they say that, when they see such a life-and-death battle between two digits after a long time, relying on powerful two-digit artifacts to gain an advantage, they still feel complicated.
“Heng Tian, you won’t just be defeated like this, will you?”
A two-digit being whispered.
“He can’t be defeated so easily.”
A two-digit being responded indifferently.
“He’s been preparing for this day for a long time, and he even traded a special two-digit artifact with me not long ago.”
As soon as these words came out, the other two-digit beings showed interest, knowing that the real show was yet to come.
At this moment, the frozen body of Heng Tian radiated terrifying dark light, illuminating the entire myriad realms.
Then, the myriad realms cried out in pain due to this dark force, and Heng Tian’s aura soared, quickly breaking through the eternal freeze, staring coldly at Wang Ping.
“Wang Ping, don’t think you’re the only one with a special artifact to resist curses and control. If this is your last trump card, then you will be utterly doomed.”

﻿Chapter 1290: Chapter 326: The Destruction of the Heavens and Ten Thousand Realms! Advancing to Two-Digit Number_3 Chapter 1290: Chapter 326: The Destruction of the Heavens and Ten Thousand Realms! Advancing to Two-Digit Number_3 “Hehe, I’ll give you that line back.”
Wang Ping said expressionlessly.
He was mentally prepared for this outcome.
After all, ancient two-digit powerhouses were not so easy to deal with.
However, if possible, Wang Ping really didn’t want to use the two-digit artifact given to him by the senior from the first generation chat group.
Because once he used this artifact and managed to kill Heng Tian with it, it would mean that he was truly calculated to death by that senior.
His calculations included himself playing out of character, forcefully storming the tower and upgrading to the two-digit realm.
At the same time, it also meant that this Heng Tian was nothing more than a pawn of that senior, a pathetic pawn.
Heng Tian thought he was fighting desperately for a promotion to the two-digit realm, but all his actions were deliberately guided by that senior.
Then, Wang Ping stopped wasting words and directly took out the Two-Digit Special Artifact: Wanda as Heng Tian launched a terrifying attack.
As the Two-Digit Artifact: Wanda appeared, the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao resonated with Wang Ping.
Wang Ping’s power also began to rise, carrying a sense of detachment.
Then, with a casual blow, Wang Ping broke Heng Tian’s attack and shattered his body.
This change startled the two-digit powerhouses.
They were not afraid because of Wang Ping’s strength, nor were they afraid because Heng Tian’s body was shattered.
They were simply frightened by the appearance of the Two-Digit Artifact: Wanda.
Back then, the person from Chenwang Palace suppressed the enemy and seized their Spirit Grid after using this artifact, making a strong display.
“How did this artifact end up in Wang Ping’s hands? Could it be that he calculated all of this?”
A two-digit powerhouse was trembling with fear in his heart.
The other two-digit powerhouses also fell silent.
Previously, some had harbored ulterior motives.
Now, their thoughts had completely vanished.
No one knew who else that senior had calculated. Acting recklessly, even if that senior could not leave the Sky Tower, they might still end up dead.
“Damn it! Wang Chen, do you want me to be a stepping stone for him? In that case, I’ll break your game, completely annihilate him, and leave your calculations empty-handed.”
Heng Tian’s body had also recovered. Feeling this familiar yet terrifying power, his expression twisted, unable to accept the fact that he had long been calculated and reduced to a clown.
Because of this, Heng Tian exploded in rage. He refused to accept that he would be annihilated by Wang Ping and have his Spirit Grid taken away, just as the senior had scripted.
Even if it meant mutual destruction, he was determined to break the game!
Seeing the crazed Heng Tian, Wang Ping fell silent.
Two-Digit Artifact: Wanda could invoke the power of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao to strengthen itself.
This artifact didn’t seem strong enough to play a significant role in Pseudo-Two-Digit battles.
After all, even Pseudo-Two-Digit powerhouses could destroy the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms if they paid a great price.
However, the ability to destroy the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms does not mean that the energy levels of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao are weak.
The enhancement of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao is absolutely terrifying, but the power of Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao is too scattered to be combined into a single force. That’s why it seems weaker than Pseudo-Two-Digit and can be destroyed by them at a great cost.
At the same time, the Two-Digit Artifact: Wanda has a hidden potential that has not been revealed.
That is, if a force appears that has a severe negative impact on the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao and may even destroy the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, the effect of this artifact will be maximized. The Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao will bestow the greatest power on Wang Ping, forming a situation where the darker the enemy, the stronger Wang Ping becomes.
Therefore, when Heng Tian burst forth with terrifying and strange power to corrode the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao and break the seal, the effect of the Two-Digit Artifact: Wanda was fully activated.
For this reason, Wang Ping couldn’t help but wonder if Heng Tian’s special artifact was also related to the senior from the first generation chat group.
If so, it was truly frightening.
This feeling of being calculated from beginning to end was truly despairing.
Thus, Wang Ping could understand Heng Tian’s crazed appearance very well.
After all, he was also one of those calculated, except that he was the nurtured party, while Heng Tian was the manipulated and deceived party.
“You can’t break the game. Your fate has long been determined.”
Wang Ping sighed and once again took action, fighting with Heng Tian.
With the help of the special artifact: Wanda, Wang Ping’s power had completely surpassed Heng Tian.
Moreover, as time passed, Wang Ping’s power grew stronger and stronger.
As a result, it quickly formed a crushing situation. Heng Tian was ruthlessly suppressed and annihilated.
“If that’s the case, then you and the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms will accompany me on the road.”
Heng Tian’s face was twisted, and he laughed manically.
At this moment, his body completely disintegrated, his origin annihilated, and the Pseudo-Two-Digit Spirit Grid also emitted a terrifyingly brilliant light.
Then, the destruction began.
The Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms were heading towards destruction, towards an end where everything would cease to exist.
However, at this moment, Wang Ping’s power had reached its peak. All the power of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Tao had gathered in Wang Ping.
Wang Ping sighed, stretched out his hand, and directly grabbed the Pseudo-Two-Digit Spirit Grid that could not self-destruct.
To destroy the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, a Pseudo-Two-Digit existence had to abandon its body, soul, and origin, and maximize the power of the Pseudo-Two-Digit Spirit Grid.

chapters.title: Chapter 1291 - 1291 326 The Destroyed Myriad Heavens and
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1291: Chapter 326: The Destroyed Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms! Advancing to Double Digits_4 Chapter 1291: Chapter 326: The Destroyed Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms! Advancing to Double Digits_4 Though they won’t die, it will make them extremely weak, unable to regenerate for a long time.
Under such circumstances, it will undoubtedly be very dangerous; the other two-digits will not stand by and watch.
After all, everyone would covet a counterfeit two-digit spirit grid.
At this moment, the counterfeit two-digit spirit grid held tightly in Wang Ping’s hand was struggling violently, trying to break free from Wang Ping’s restraint.
Unfortunately, Wang Ping wouldn’t let it have its way and began to forcibly suppress it.
During this process, Wang Ping paid no attention to the destruction of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
He couldn’t stop this situation, he could only protect himself.
However, as long as he suppressed the spirit grid of Heng Tian, refining it, promoting it to a true two-digit.
Then, reviving the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms would merely be an act of passing convenience.
Next, without any hesitation of other two-digits, Wang Ping directly created a different dimensional space using his innate abilities.
Although the three-digit talent couldn’t play a significant effect in the battle of counterfeit two-digits, once the battle is over, creating something that helps suppress the spirit grid and speed up the refining process would be extremely convenient.
Seeing this, the other two-digit beings fell silent.
From the moment Wang Ping used the Two-Digit Tool: Ten Thousand Ways, they guessed the ending.
However, when they witnessed this familiar yet unfamiliar result, their feelings were complex and they felt somewhat depressed inside.
What good is it to be a counterfeit two-digit? If you don’t reach the peak, you’ll still be prey to others.
In the end, after these counterfeit two-digits silently bid farewell to Heng Tian one by one, they turned their gaze away, bidding no more attention.
And in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, the other creatures breathed a sigh of relief when they sensed the terrifying disturbance reaching the Paradise had finally ceased.
However, they soon learned about the news of the destruction of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms and were utterly shocked.
What followed was sorrow.
After all, many people were from the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
Now, their hometown had been destroyed…
It could be said that they had turned into creatures without homes.
Even the strongest creatures would more or less miss their home.
On Alpha’s side, upon knowing Wang Ping was okay, he breathed a sigh of relief, and while joyous inside, he couldn’t help but marvel at the monstrosity that was Wang Ping.
It hadn’t been very long, and he had already become a two-digit powerhouse, and he had even defeated another two-digit being; it was simply against nature.
“A force with two two-digit beings. If the master knew, he would definitely be staggered. I just don’t know where the master has gone.”
Alpha murmured to himself, missing his creator.
…..
In the blink of an eye, several decades passed, the storm gradually subsided, and even the existence of the two-digit Heng Tian was no longer remembered.
This led other two-digit beings and some unique three-digit beings to realize that Heng Tian had been completely erased.
Naturally, they didn’t think Wang Ping had erased a two-digit powerhouse like Heng Tian in just a few decades.
The flow of time in that strange different space must be different.
With Wang Ping shielding it, no one knew how much time had passed in that place.
Time flowed on, and two years later, a terrifying aura had flashed by and disappeared.
This aura was so powerful, but it appeared too quickly and too secretly, so the other two-digits didn’t notice it.
However, the other two-digits soon noticed an anomaly.
That is, the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms had been restored to its original state, and the creatures of the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms didn’t know of its past destruction, as if the great war that happened decades ago never occurred.
This led the other two-digits to fall silent, guessing one thing.
That is, Wang Ping might have, like the one in Chenwang Palace, been promoted to become a real two-digit.
Therefore, they were no longer qualified to sense his existence.
“Now, we can’t even call his name directly.”
A two-digit being sighed.
The other two-digit beings couldn’t help but give bitter smiles, their feelings extremely complex.
Based on the external time, Wang Ping is less than a hundred years old.
As beings who have existed for vast ages, they didn’t dare to call a man who is less than a hundred years old by his real name; it’s just too absurd.
“The second real transcendent being…”
A two-digit being is very envious.
“Indeed, he is the second one. However, I think the third one will likely appear. After all, there’s still one person short of breaking through the ninetieth floor.”
A two-digit being spoke out, murmuring to himself.
Those words led all the two-digit beings into silence.
They didn’t know who the third one that would appear is, or where he is now.
Perhaps, for that being to grow, one of them has to become his stepping stone.
That is, they didn’t know which two-digit would become the unlucky pawn.
It seems like it’s the time to compare luck.
All these two-digit beings couldn’t help but laugh at themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292 - 1292 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1292: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter) Chapter 1292: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter) The translation is as follows:
Amidst the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, a figure emerged from a different time and space.
This person was Wang Ping.
Nowadays, Wang Ping had been promoted to a true Two-digit; with a flick of his finger, he could easily destroy or create the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
It had to be said that this power left Wang Ping in awe.
However, recalling the dangers of his breakthrough, Wang Ping still felt lingering fear.
He almost failed, nearly falling completely.
If not for the critical moment when the Two-Digit Tool: Ten Thousand Ways suddenly imparted him with the experience and secrets of breaking through to a Two-digit, he would not have been able to move from ruin to harmony and step into true Two-digit status.
“I thought that by not following the usual procedures, there might be a possibility to escape his control. In the end, all my actions were within his calculations, even needing his help to advance to Two-digit status. It’s truly frustrating,” Wang Ping sighed.
At this point, Wang Ping had many speculations in his heart. Having reached this stage, he could be calm and not despair.
Next, Wang Ping took a step, instantly crossing endless distances, returning to the Profound World, and met the Reincarnation Emperor.
“I can no longer see through you completely,” the Reincarnation Emperor exclaimed.
“A minor breakthrough. My strength has increased a bit,” Wang Ping chuckled.
The Reincarnation Emperor was speechless. You call this a minor breakthrough, merely an increase in strength?
If even this is just a minor breakthrough, then others might as well not live.
“This artifact can help you resurrect your little daughter. Accept it,” Wang Ping then took out the Three-digit special tool, Proof of the Living, and said.
The Reincarnation Emperor was stunned, then showed joy, taking the artifact and examining it.
Then, he widened his eyes, inhaling sharply.
As an Immortal Emperor, he naturally had vast knowledge. He shouldn’t have been so shocked, but the effect of this artifact was just too outrageous, leaving him in awe.
One could only say that using this thing to resurrect a quadruple digit being was truly a waste.
Such a precious thing, the Reincarnation Emperor truly didn’t dare to accept lightly for a moment.
“Don’t let me become a person who fails to honor his word. And my coming to you is not just to help resurrect your daughter, there is another purpose,” Wang Ping said with a smile.
“I plan to put down roots in the upper region and create a new Two-digit Power. The new power’s initial establishment requires a large amount of talent. So, I hope you can join the Transmigrator Chat Group and become an elder of the chat group.”
“Honored. Whether it’s me or my followers, I believe we will all be proud to join the Transmigrator Chat Group,” the Reincarnation Emperor said without hesitation, his eyes gleaming.
“Mm.”
Wang Ping nodded, not surprised by the Reincarnation Emperor’s choice.
Although many Three-digits were very proud and would not easily join a Two-digit Power, and those Two-digit Powers would not easily accept Three-digits that join midway, the Reincarnation Emperor’s situation was special, naturally not rejecting Wang Ping, only bringing his entire sect to submit.
Next, after Wang Ping bid farewell to the Reincarnation Emperor, he went to see his old friends from the Taiyi Imperial Palace and was also ready to bring some talented people into the Transmigrator Chat Group. Being a Two-digit Strength person, he could naturally easily bring people from the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms to the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
Although they needed to participate in a game immediately after entering the Myriad Heavens Paradise,
The Sky Tower Game was undoubtedly very dangerous.
However, Wang Ping currently was not short on money. Getting a bunch of delay special items was not a problem.
At that time, they could wait until those people were fully prepared before letting them participate in the Sky Tower Game.
…
After taking care of these matters, Wang Ping returned to the Myriad Heavens Paradise, brought Alpha to the Upper region, and established his own Two-digit Power, the Transmigrator Chat Group.
Although Alpha wanted Wang Ping to change the name to something like Chenwang Palace,
Wang Ping had no intention of changing the name; he still preferred the name Transmigrator Chat Group.
As Wang Ping formally created the Two-digit Power Transmigrator Chat Group in the upper region, the big shots of the Myriad Heavens Paradise couldn’t sit still. They came to congratulate him, bringing rich gifts.
At the Immortal Banquet, Lin Yuanyuan, Chen Yao, Cai Yonglong, Zhang Jun, and other ‘elder figures’ of the Transmigrator Chat Group sat in the top seats, feeling a bit dazed.
They never expected that in such a short time, Mr. Wang had already become a Two-digit, becoming one of the most powerful figures in the Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms.
And they, along with him, had risen to high positions, becoming veteran figures of this vast power. It was utterly astonishing.
“To have joined the chat group early on and carried out missions with Mr. Wang, that is indeed our fortune,” Cai Yonglong said, looking at those big shots below who gazed at them with eyes full of envy, his mind filled with complicated feelings, not just joy, but also a slight shutdown, feeling somewhat numb.
To be able to attend this banquet, one had to be at least a quadruple digit or some big shot’s descendant.
As a result, these big shots, whom they weren’t even qualified to see outside and only heard about from legends, envied and coveted them. It was truly mind-boggling.
“Hey, fortunately, I’ve been fawning over and clinging to Mr. Wang since joining the group. Otherwise, I, Qin Tian, wouldn’t be where I am today,” Qin Tian chuckled, feeling a bit smug.
While Cai Yonglong and the others were filled with emotions, Wang Ping, having dealt with those Two-digits, looked at the emissary from Chenwang Palace, Huang Huihui, and nodded at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1293 - 1293 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1293: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter)_2 Chapter 1293: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter)_2 黄惠hui, however, did not act as casually as the first time she met Wang Ping. This time, her expression was serious, showing great respect for Wang Ping.
After all, when they first met, they were equals, so Huang Huihui could speak freely.
But now, Wang Ping had become, like her palace master, a true Two-digit, commanding due respect.
“Seeing these juniors really brings back memories,” Huang Huihui remarked after toasting Wang Ping, feeling nostalgic.
“Oh? What do you mean?” Wang Ping feigned curiosity.
“Back then, I also held onto a strong benefactor, which allowed me to become a Three-digit. As they say, when a person gains power, those around them rise too. Compared to striving on your own, investing well is the true path,” Huang Huihui laughed lightly.
“Indeed. However, they can’t really be considered as investing in me. I was simply being sentimental,” Wang Ping shook his head and said, “The ones truly investing in me were Alpha and my predecessor.”
As he spoke the last words, Wang Ping’s gaze turned meaningful.
“Alpha, she indeed was quite fortunate,” Huang Huihui laughed softly.
“Lord Wang Ping, the palace master asked me to deliver a message, ‘Go and challenge the tower. Once you reach the Ninetieth Floor, he will enlighten you.'”
After a pause, Huang Huihui, full of seriousness, spoke respectfully.
“I will go to the Ninetieth Floor, but not now,” Wang Ping replied calmly.
The chat group had just begun and had not yet developed into a Two-digit power. There was no way he would challenge the tower now.
“I was merely passing on the message. It’s up to you how you proceed,” Huang Huihui replied respectfully.
“Hmm,” Wang Ping nodded and did not continue discussing this matter with Huang Huihui.
After several days, the Immortal Banquet came to a complete end, and the heroes from all sides departed.
Though the Immortal Banquet had ended, the Myriad Heavens Paradise was not at peace. The Transmigrator Chat Group was a hot topic among countless living beings, and its reputation spread throughout the entire heavens and myriad realms, astonishing those qualified to enter or who had entered the Myriad Heavens Paradise.
In a blink of an eye, a million years had passed.
During this million years, due to never filling the quota, Wang Ping was never forced to challenge the tower.
Thus, he was at ease in developing the Transmigrator Chat Group.
Under his dedicated effort, the Transmigrator Chat Group became a true Two-digit power, second only to the Chenwang Palace established by his predecessor of the first generation chat group.
Under his nurturing, whether it was veteran group members or promising new recruits over that million years, they all reached the levels of Four-digit or even Three-digit.
Meanwhile, disciples like Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong, whom he personally mentored, easily became quasi-Fairy Emperors.
Some disciples, like Ye Chen and Bai Tianhong, were even fortunate enough to acquire Three-digit Spirit Grids, becoming Three-digit beings.
As for Alpha, she needed no further mention; she was appointed as an administrator by him.
To this end, Alpha was elevated by him at a great cost to the Three-digit limit, with numerous Three-digit special items to boot.
One might say Alpha was among the most powerful Three-digit beings, perhaps only matched by a Three-digit from the Chenwang Palace if Wang Ping valued Alpha as much as the senior valued that Three-digit.
Hence, Wang Ping no longer needed to worry about the future of the Transmigrator Chat Group.
In the Immortal Court, Wang Ping sat on a chair carved from celestial jade, reading a book.
Behind Wang Ping, Alpha skillfully massaged his shoulders.
Just then, Wang Ping suddenly closed the precious celestial book, looked toward the direction of the Heaven Tower, and said, “Alpha, I leave the Transmigrator Chat Group in your hands. Though you’re a bit naive, with the Reincarnation Emperor assisting you, I have no concerns about any issues arising.”
“Are you leaving?” Alpha’s hands paused, and she asked with some concern.
“Hmm, I should have challenged the tower a million years ago, but I postponed it for the Transmigrator Chat Group. However, if I delay any longer, that senior might become a bit discontent,” Wang Ping nodded slightly and said.
“Most importantly, I want to unravel the mysteries in my heart and ascend the Heaven Tower.”
“I see,” Alpha was silent for a moment, did not stop Wang Ping, and softly said, “I understand, I will safeguard the Transmigrator Chat Group well and await your return. May you have flourishing martial fortune.”
“Hmm, I will return unscathed,” Wang Ping nodded.
Then, without saying much more to Alpha, he vanished silently.
Shortly after, Wang Ping summoned the Two-digits of Myriad Heavens Paradise to accompany him in challenging the tower.
In response, these Two-digits glanced at each other and fell into silence.
“I am not inviting you, but commanding you. If you’re a Two-digit who has reached the Eightieth Floor and do not wish to perish, accompany me to challenge the tower,” Wang Ping gazed calmly at the Two-digits he had summoned.
“Although I dislike behaving overbearingly and harming innocents, for my own life, I must be domineering this once. I hope you can understand.”
Upon hearing this, several of the Two-digits gave wry smiles.
They had no choice.
In the end, Wang Ping successfully found teammates and began his tower challenge.

﻿Chapter 1294: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter)_3 Chapter 1294: Chapter 327 Omniscient and Omnipotent (Final Chapter)_3 “`
Next, nothing unexpected happened. A series of announcements echoed in the Myriad Heavens Paradise, all of them SSS tier evaluations.
And those two-digit numbers whom Wang Ping dragged into the game, initially forced, eventually began to anticipate teaming up with Wang Ping for tower climbing.
Because teaming up with Wang Ping was an effortless win.
Although they were just getting by and didn’t even receive an S tier evaluation, they did at least earn substantial rewards, and later even acquired a two-digit special item.
For a while, these two-digit numbers, who had previously climbed lower tower floors, recalled what a figure at Chenwang Palace had done.
That person was merely gathering numbers as well.
In the end, he also allowed those who teamed up with him to reap significant benefits.
Only, that person’s methods were too ruthless, and the tower climbing process was not as ‘gentle’ and easy as with Wang Ping.
Not long after, Wang Ping smoothly passed through the 89th Floor and arrived at the 90th Floor.
Upon reaching the 90th Floor, the other two-digit numbers were no longer qualified to accompany Wang Ping up the tower; they, as tools, could also exit the stage.
After Wang Ping stepped onto the 90th Floor, he discovered it was a pitch-black space.
In the darkness, there was a glimmer of white light.
Wang Ping looked around and found it was a stone platform paved with White Jade.
On the platform, there sat a graceful man dressed in a Black Robe, sipping a small drink.
Wang Ping approached the platform, looking at this seemingly gentle and elegant man, his eyes flickering and his mood quite complex.
“Have a seat,”
the Graceful Man said warmly to Wang Ping, pouring him a cup of the small drink.
To this, Wang Ping nodded, also sitting cross-legged, naturally taking the cup and downing it in one go.
“I once said, when you came here, I would clear up your doubts.” Wang Chen looked at Wang Ping, a smile playing at the corners of his lips, and said, “So, if you have any questions, feel free to ask me.”
“What is the relationship between you and me?” Wang Ping pondered for a moment before asking this question.
“What do you think, where does the Strange object originate from?”
Wang Chen poured himself another drink, downing it once again, not answering, but instead naturally asking in return.
“The Strange object…”
Wang Ping fell into thought and spoke.
“I think the Strange object should be the dark side of the Sky Tower.”
“Yes, but also no.”
Wang Chen nodded and then shook his head.
“You must be curious about how I can interfere with the Sky Tower. That’s because I reached an agreement with the Sky Tower Intelligence, so I know many secrets.”
Wang Chen said slowly, his eyes deep.
“This Myriad Heavens and Thousands of Realms, according to Earth’s understanding, should be an endless multiverse. But outside this endless multiverse, there’s also an endless multiverse of multiverses.”
“Layer upon layer, it seems,” Wang Ping commented.
“There is indeed a sense of nesting dolls, but that’s the truth. The world is so vast that even a True Two-digit number is nothing before it, it’s difficult to penetrate the origins of this endless existence.”
Wang Chen laughed lightly.
Then, Wang Chen grew serious again, and said solemnly, “Within this endless, endless, endless multiverse, there are dark rules filled with destruction and chaos.”
“The Strange object is a derivative of the darkness. The Sky Tower was created by some terrifying existence to suppress and reclaim these dark rules.”
“The Sky Tower is not related to a one-digit number? One-digit numbers being omniscient and omnipotent, wouldn’t eradicating these dark rules and the Strange object be a piece of cake?”
Wang Ping frowned.
“In theory, yes. However, true omniscience and omnipotence do not exist, only those who come close to that level, and darkness, the Strange object, are creations of his negative emotions. As long as he doesn’t die, they cannot be completely erased, so he can only suppress them.”
Wang Chen shook his head and said.
Upon hearing this, Wang Ping finally understood the origin of the Sky Tower.
“So, the notion that reaching the top of the Sky Tower can make you a one-digit number is a lie?”
Wang Ping frowned again, his face full of helplessness.
“It’s not a lie. Reaching the top of the Sky Tower indeed offers the hope of becoming a one-digit number. However, only one person can achieve that.”
Wang Chen looked deeply at Wang Ping.
“You mean, only I can do it?”
Wang Ping gave a strange look, pointing to himself.
“You are the master of the Sky Tower. As long as you can resolve your inner conflicts and integrate everything with yourself, retrieving your Eternal Heart on the Hundredth Floor, you naturally have the opportunity to truly step into that realm.”
Wang Chen nodded, speaking in a manner that left Wang Ping astounded.
“I’m the master of the Sky Tower? Are you joking?”
Wang Ping gave a strange look, feeling that this senior, Wang Chen, was talking nonsense.
“You truly are the master of the Sky Tower.”
Wang Chen gave a firm response.
“He erased his memories and transformed into countless versions of Wang Ping. Your talents are the closest to his essence and your personality the brightest. In other words, as long as you can reach the top of the Hundredth Floor, there is hope for you to become an Eternal One.”
“Alright…” Wang Ping frowned in contemplation, not expecting his origins to be so significant.
However, if he really made it to the Hundredth Floor, would he still be himself?
This was a question.
“Then what is your stance?”
Wang Ping looked deeply at Wang Chen and spoke solemnly.
“Primitive Earth is the center of the endless, endless, endless multiverse, connecting countless worlds; it’s the birthplace of that being. I cannot enter, nor can I interfere.”
Wang Chen was silent for a while, speaking frankly.
“In other words, if I want to go back and resurrect my parents who died protecting me before I traveled, I must have you become an Eternal One.”
“The Sky Tower Intelligence, whether creating Alpha or cooperating with me, is all to find its reincarnated master.”
“However, the Sky Tower Intelligence is heavily limited—it can only slightly influence game modes within the rules, and liberate travel permissions to Primitive Earth. But it can’t overly interfere with the outer world, and it can’t cultivate people, so it had to choose to cooperate with me.”
“So Alpha’s creator was actually the Sky Tower Intelligence.”
Wang Ping received another piece of information, shocked in his heart.
At last, he realized the careful intentions of this senior, Wang Chen.
As it turned out, he just wanted to return and resurrect his parents—truly a devoted son.
“However, even having reached the 90th Floor, I still need one more person to start the game, don’t I?”
Wang Ping’s gaze flickered as he spoke.
“No, the 90th Floor’s rules are just a facade. In reality, as long as you reach the 90th Floor, my task is considered complete. Then, you can directly reach the Hundredth Floor.”
“In the end, as long as you’ve made it this far, everything ahead is just a formality for you. Next, you simply need to leisurely proceed to the Hundredth Floor and try to reclaim your inherent powers.”
Wang Chen sighed, his feelings particularly complex.
“Alright.”
Wang Ping nodded.
“I hope you succeed in returning to the eternal, fulfilling my wish.”
Wang Chen paused for a moment before speaking again.
This time, he used a respectful address.
Wang Ping gazed at this person, whom he had always seen as a terrifying adversary, calculating across past and future, showing such an expression, his own feelings mixed.
“I will.”
Wang Ping sighed.
Then, Wang Ping’s body was enveloped in white light, leaving that place.
Time was relentless, and in the blink of an eye, millions of years passed.
Wang Ping had long reached the Hundredth Floor, touched the legendary Eternal Heart, and was attempting to merge with it.
Efforts bore fruit, and Wang Ping truly merged with the Eternal Heart, becoming a new pseudo-one-digit number.
However, contrary to what Wang Chen said, his former self was not a pseudo-one-digit number but a true one-digit number, a true Eternal One.
Omniscience and omnipotence meant invincibility and also eternal solitude; to him, the world held no secrets.
Thus, boredom led to negative emotions.
Negative emotions were derivatives of omnipotence, a power he deliberately split off to render himself imperfect.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t even be able to close himself off.
However, as the split-off power grew stronger and got out of control, he created the Sky Tower to suppress it, and at the same time, scattered himself into countless parts, erasing his existence.
And Wang Ping was the reincarnation most compatible with the Eternal Heart found by the Sky Tower Intelligence.
Now that Wang Ping had merged with the Eternal Heart, he became a pseudo-one-digit number.
As soon as Wang Ping wished, reclaiming the Sky Tower, clearing those dark contaminants, regathering that power and merging those countless parts of “him,” consolidating all power unto himself, he could become a true one-digit number.
However, Wang Ping did not intend to do so.
Wang Ping worried that his memories would be overwritten and had concerns.
Therefore, even though he could become a new one-digit number at any time, he chose not to do so for now.
Whether a pseudo-one-digit number or a true one-digit number, both were invincible beings, there was no need to push himself further.
Moreover, even if he could become a one-digit number without concerns, Wang Ping feared becoming another “suicide.”
Next, Wang Ping gave the Sky Tower Intelligence a little reprimand, a small retaliation for its prior “teasing” during the Sky Tower Game.
Then, he fulfilled his promise, reviving Wang Chen’s parents and sending them back to Primitive Earth.
And Wang Ping, too, returned to his original rented room, staring at the instant noodles he hadn’t finished eating, lost in thought.
At last, he looked at his packet of cigarettes, only a few remaining, smiled lightly, picked it up, and leisurely lit a cigarette for himself, comfortably puffing a smoke ring.
Having become an Eternal One, it seemed that he could finally live a leisurely life.
